1: Adam fɔ Set, ni Set hu fɔ Enosh, ni lɛ hu efɔ Kenan.
Kenan fɔ Mahalalel, ni Mahalalel hu fɔ Jared.
Jared fɔ Enok, ni lɛ hu efɔ Metusela mɔ ni fɔ Lamek ni lɛ hu efɔ Noa lɛ.
Noa fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet.
Yafet fɔ bihii kpawo, amɛji Gomer kɛ Magog kɛ Madai kɛ Yavan kɛ Tubal kɛ Meshek kɛ Tiras.
Gomer shwiei ji Ashkenaz kɛ Rifat kɛ Togarma.
Yavan hu shwiei ji Elisha kɛ Spainbii kɛ Kiprobii kɛ Rodobii.
Ham, Noa bi lɛ, bihii ji Kush kɛ Egipt kɛ Libia kɛ Kanaan, mɛi agbɛii ni akɛtsɛɔ amɛshwiei lɛ.
Ham bi Kush lɛ eshwiei ji Seda kɛ Havila kɛ Sabta kɛ Raama kɛ Sabteka. Kush bi Raama shwiei ji Sheba kɛ Dedan.
Kush fɔ binuu ko ni atsɛ lɛ akɛ Nimrod. Lɛ eje shishi efee ehe nuu kãkãlɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ham bi Egipt lɛ eshwiei ji Lidiabii lɛ kɛ Anambii lɛ kɛ Lehabbii lɛ kɛ Naftubii lɛ
kɛ Patrusbii lɛ kɛ Kaslubii lɛ kɛ Kretabii lɛ (mɛi amli ni Filistibii lɛ jɛ lɛ).
Ham bi Kanaan fɔ Sidon, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Het, mɛi agbɛii ni akɛtsɛ amɛshwiei lɛ.
Kanaan nɔŋŋ shwiei ji Yebusbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Girgashbii lɛ,
kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Arkibii lɛ kɛ Sinbii lɛ,
kɛ Arvadbii lɛ kɛ Zemarbii lɛ kɛ Hamatbii lɛ.
Shem (Noa bi lɛ) bihii ji Elam kɛ Ashur kɛ Arpakshad kɛ Lud kɛ Aram kɛ Uz kɛ Hul kɛ Geter kɛ Meshek; ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ agbɛii akɛtsɛɔ amɛshwiei lɛ.
Shem bi Arpakshad fɔ Shela, ni lɛ hu efɔ Eber.
Eber nɛɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ. Atsɛ mɔ kome akɛ Peleg, ejaakɛ efɔmɔ kɛ je lɛ mli bii ateŋ ni gba lɛ bakpe; ni atsɛ Eber bi kome lɛ hu akɛ Yoktan.
Yoktan shwiei ji Almodad kɛ Shelef kɛ Hazarmawet kɛ Yera,
kɛ Hadoram kɛ Uzal kɛ Dikla;
kɛ Ebal kɛ Abimael kɛ Sheba,
kɛ Ofir kɛ Havila kɛ Yoab. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yoktan bii ni.
Bɔ ni wekukpãa lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ Shem nɔ kɛyashi Abram nɔ ji akɛ Shem fɔ Arpakshad, ni Arpakshad fɔ Shela,
ni Shela fɔ Eber, ni Eber fɔ Peleg, ni Peleg fɔ Reu;
ni Reu fɔ Serug, ni Serug fɔ Nahor, ni Nahor fɔ Tera,
ni Tera fɔ Abram (ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abraham hu lɛ.)
Abraham fɔ bihii enyɔ, Isak kɛ Ishmael.
Ishmael bihii lɛ agbɛi nɛ: Nebaiot, Ishmael kromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Kedar kɛ Adbeel kɛ Mibsam
kɛ Mishma kɛ Duma kɛ Masa kɛ Hadad kɛ Tema,
kɛ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Kedema.
Abraham yɛ hemɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Ketura. Abraham kɛ lɛ fɔ bihii ekpaa: Zimran kɛ Yokshan kɛ Medan kɛ Midian kɛ Ishbak kɛ Shua. Yokshan fɔ bihii enyɔ: Sheba kɛ Dedan.
Midian fɔ bihii enumɔ: Efa kɛ Efer kɛ Hanok kɛ Abida kɛ Eldaa. Shwiei ni jɛ Ketura mli ji Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ.
Abraham bi Isak fɔ bihii enyɔ Esau kɛ Yakob.
Esau bihii ji Elifaz kɛ Reuel kɛ Yeush kɛ Yalam kɛ Kora.
Esau bi Elifaz ji mɔ mli ni Teman kɛ Omar kɛ Zefi kɛ Gatam kɛ Kenaz kɛ Timna kɛ Amalek jɛ.
Reuel hu ji mɔ mli ni Nahat kɛ Zera kɛ Shama kɛ Miza jɛ.
Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ, Seir shwiei ni. Seir bii ji Lotan kɛ Shobal kɛ Zibeon kɛ Ana kɛ Dishon kɛ Ezer kɛ Dishan.
Lotan fɔ Hori kɛ Homam. Lotan yɛ nyɛmiyoo ko ni gbɛi ji Timna.
Shobal fɔ Alvan kɛ Manahat kɛ Ebal kɛ Shefi kɛ Onam.
Zebeon fɔ bihii enyɔ, Aia kɛ Ana. Ana nɛɛ fɔ Dishon, mɔ ni fɔ Hamran kɛ Eshban kɛ Itran kɛ Keran lɛ.
Ezer fɔ Bihan kɛ Zaavan kɛ Yaakan. Ni Dishan fɔ Uz kɛ Aran.
Naa bɔ ni ato naa ni aye maŋtsɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dani ato maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel. Bela, Boer bi lɛ ni emaŋ ji Dinhaba lɛ ji mɔ tsutsu ni ye maŋtsɛ.
Yobab, Zera bi lɛ ni jɛ Bozra lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Bela gbele sɛɛ.
Husham, ni jɛ Temanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yobab gbele sɛɛ.
Hadad, Bedad bi lɛ ni jɛ Abit lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Hushan gbele sɛɛ. Ekɛ Midianbii lɛ wu ta, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ Moab ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Samla ni jɛ Masreka baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Hadad gbele sɛɛ.
Shaul ni jɛ Rehobot ni kã faa lɛ naa lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samla gbelɛ sɛɛ.
Baal Hanan, Akbor bi lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Shaul gbele sɛɛ.
Hadad ni emaŋ ji Pau lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Baal-Hanan gbele sɛɛ. Hadad nɛɛ ŋa ji Mehetabel ni ji Me-Zahab biyoo Matred lɛ biyoo lɛ.
Edombii akutsei lɛ ji Timna kɛ Alva kɛ Yetet,
kɛ Oholibama kɛ Ela kɛ Pinon,
kɛ kenaz kɛ Teman kɛ Mibzar,
kɛ Magdiel kɛ Iram.
2: Yakob fɔ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ amɛji Ruben kɛ Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda kɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon,
kɛ Dan kɛ Yosef kɛ Benyamin kɛ Naftali kɛ Gad kɛ Asher.
Yuda fɔ bihii enumɔ. Ekɛ eŋa Bat-Shua, Kanaanyoo lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃, ni ji Er lɛ kɛ Onan kɛ Shela. Yuda kromɔbi Er lɛ fee ehe gbɔmɔ fɔŋ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa gbe lɛ.
Yuda kɛ ebinuu ŋã Tamar lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ hu, Perez kɛ Zera.
Perez fɔ bihii enyɔ, Hezron kɛ Hamul.
Zera fɔ bihii enumɔ, Zimri kɛ Etan kɛ Heman kɛ Kalkol kɛ Darda.
Karmi ni jɛ Perez mli lɛ bi ko ni egbɛi ji Akar lɛ kɛ Israelbii wo amane mli be ni efee nɔ ni esaaa yɛ nihaanii ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã Yehowa lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ.
Etan (Zera bi lɛ) fɔ binuu. Binuu nɛɛ gbɛi ji Azazia.
Hezron fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Yerameel kɛ Ram kɛ Kaleb.
Naa bɔ ni Wekukpãa lɛ kã shi hã kɛjɛ Ram nɔ kɛyashi Yeshai nɔ: Ram fɔ Aminadab, ni Aminadab fɔ Nahashon, ni ebatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kpanaa yɛ Yudabii ateŋ lɛ.
Nahashon fɔ Salma, ni Salma fɔ Boaz,
ni Boaz fɔ Obed, ni Obed fɔ Yeshai.
Yeshai fɔ bihii kpawo. Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Eliab; kromɔbi lɛ sɛɛho lɛ ji Abinadab; ebi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Shimea;
ebi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Netanel, ni ebi ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Radai.
Ozem ji ebi ni ji ekpaa lɛ, ni ebi ni ji kpawo lɛ ji David.
Yeshai fɔ biyei hu ni ji Zeruia kɛ Abigail. Yeshai biyoo Zeruia nɛɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Abishai kɛ Yoab kɛ Asahel.
Ebiyoo Abiail kɛ Yeter, Ishmaelnyo, lɛ hi shi ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Amasa.
Hezron binuu Kaleb kɛ Yeriotyoo, Azuba, hi shi ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Yesher kɛ Shobab kɛ Ardon.
Azuba gbo, ni Kaleb ŋɔ Efrat, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu kome ni ji Hur.
Hur fɔ Uri, ni fɔ Bezaleel.
Be mli ni Hezron eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa lɛ, etee ni eyaŋɔ Makir biyoo ni ji Gilead nyɛmiyoo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Segub,
Segub fɔ Yair mɔ ni ye Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ anɔ lumɔ lɛ.

Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ Geshurbii lɛ kɛ Arambii bashɔ̃ Kenat kɛ ehe maji kɛ akrowai aaashɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa yɛ Yair kɛ Gileadbii lɛ adɛŋ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Gilead tsɛ Makir shwiei ji mɛi ni yɔɔ maji kɛ akrowai nɛɛ amli.
Be ni Hezron gbo lɛ, ebinuu Kaleb ŋɔ Efrat, etsɛ Hezron ŋa okulafo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Ashur mɔ ni to Tekoa maŋ lɛ.
Yerameel, Hezron kromɔbi lɛ fɔ bihii enumɔ: Ram, ni ji ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Buna kɛ Oren kɛ Ozem kɛ Ahia.
Yerameel yɛ ŋa kroko hu ni gbɛi ji Atra. Ekɛ lɛ fɔ Onam.
Ram, Yerameel kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Maaz kɛ Yamin kɛ Eker.
Onam fɔ bihii enyɔ: Shamai kɛ Yada; ni Shamai hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Nadab kɛ Abishur.
Abishur nɛɛ ŋa gbɛi Abihail; ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Ahban kɛ Molid.
Nadad,Abishur nyɛminuu lɛ, fɔ bihii enyɔ: Seled kɛ Apaim. Seled fɔɔɔ ni egbo.
Shi Apaim fɔ Ishi, ni Ishi fɔ Sheshan, ni Sheshan fɔ Ahlai.
Yada, Oman bi Shammai nyɛminuu lɛ, fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yeter kɛ Yonatan. Yeter fɔɔɔ ni egbo.
Shi Yonatan fɔ bihii enyɔ: Pelet kɛ Zaza. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yerameel shwiei sɔŋŋ ni.
Sheshan fɔɔɔ binuu; biyei sɔŋŋ efɔ. Sheshan yɛ tsulɔ Egiptnyo ko ni gbɛi ji Yarha.
Ekɛ ebiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome hã etsulɔ Yarha nɛɛ gblã, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Atai.
Naa bɔ ni wekukpãa lɛ kã shi ha kɛjɛ Atai nɔ kɛyashi Elishama nɔ: Atai fɔ Natan, ni Natan fɔ Zabad.
Zabad fɔ Eflal ni Eflal fɔ Obed,
ni Obed fɔ Jehu, ni Jehu hu fɔ Azaria.
Azaria fɔ Helez, ni Helez fɔ Eleasa;
ni Eleasa fɔ Sismai, ni Sisimai hu fɔ Shalum
ni Shalum fɔ Yekamia, ni Yekamia fɔ Elishama.
Kaled, Yerameel nyɛmi nuu lɛ, kɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ eko hu kromɔbinuu ji Mesha. Mesha fɔ Zif, ni Zif, fɔ Mareshã, ni Maresha fɔ Hebron.
Hebron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Kora kɛ Tapua kɛ Rekem kɛ Shema.
Shema fɔ Raham, mɔ ni fɔ Yorkeam lɛ; ni Rekem fɔ Shamai.
Shamai fɔ Maon, ni Maon fɔ Bet-Zur.
Kaled yɛ hemɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Efa,ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii krokomɛi etɛ̃, Haran kɛ Moza kɛ Gazez. Haran hu fɔ binuu ni ewo lɛ Gazez.
Kaleb bii lɛ eko hu ni gbɛi ji Yadai lɛ fɔ bihii ekpaa: Regem kɛ Yoatam kɛ Geshan kɛ Pelet kɛ Efa kɛ Shaaf.
Kaled yɛ hemɔ kroko hu ni gbɛi ji Maaka; ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ, Sheber kɛ Tirhana.
Maaka nɛɛ kɛ Kaleb saa fɔ bihii enyɔ krokomɛi, Shaaf mɔ ni to Madmana maŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛ Sheva mɔ ni to Makbena maŋ lɛ kɛ Gibea maŋ lɛ hu Shishi lɛ. Biyoo ni Kaled fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Aksa.
Kaleb shwiei krokomɛi agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Hur ji kaleb kromɔbinuu; ekɛ eŋã Efrat lɛ fɔ lɛ. Hur nɛɛ binuu Shobal ji mɔ ni to kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ.
Amɛbinuu ni ji enyɔ ji Salma mɔ ni to Betlehem maŋ lɛ; amɛbinuu ni ji etɛ̃ ji Haref mɔ ni to Bet-Gader maŋ lɛ.
Shobal, mɔ ni to Kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ shwiei ji Haroebii lɛ, kɛ Menahot maŋ lɛ mli bii ayikulɛ fã ko,
Kɛ Itribii ni yɔɔ Kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ Putbii lɛ kɛ Shumatbii lɛ kɛ Mishrabii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi amli Zora maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ kɛ Eshtoal maŋ lɛ hu mli bii lɛ jɛ.
Salma, mɔ ni to Betlehem lɛ, shwiei ji Netofatbii lɛ, Atarot-Bet-Yoabbii lɛ kɛ Zoribii ni ji Manahat maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ fã kome lɛ.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ woloŋmalɔi awekui komɛi hi shi yɛ Yabez maŋ lɛ mli. Amɛji Tiratbii lɛ kɛ Shimeatbii lɛ kɛ Sukatbii lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ Kenbii amɛ, ni amɛjɛ Hamat mɔ ni to Rekab we lɛ shishi lɛ mli.
3: Maŋtsɛ david bihii ni efɔ yɛ Hebron lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ yɛ afii anaa: Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Amnon ni enyɛ ji Ahinoam ni jɛ Yezreel lɛ. Ebi ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Daniel mɔ ni nyɛ ji Abigail ni jɛ Karmal lɛ.
Ebi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Absalom. Absalom nyɛ ji Maaka Geshur Maŋtsɛ Talmai biyoo lɛ. Ebi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Adonia ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Hagit lɛ.
Ebi ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Shefatia ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Abital lɛ; ni ebi ni ji ekpaa lɛ ji Itream ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Egla lɛ.
David fɔ bihii ekpaa nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Hebron he ni eye maŋtsɛ yɛ afii kpawo kɛ fã lɛ. Ebaye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem hu;
ni efɔ bii babaoo yɛ Yerusalem. Ekɛ Bat-Shua ni ji Ameiel biyoo lɛ fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Shimea kɛ Shobab kɛ Natan kɛ Solomon.
Maŋtsɛ David fɔ bihii krokomɛi nɛɛhu. Amɛji Ibhar kɛ Elishua kɛ Elpelet
kɛ Noga kɛ Nefeg kɛ Yafia,
kɛ Elishama kɛ Eliada kɛ Elifelet.
David kɛ ehemɛi lɛ fɔ bihii krokomɛi hu yɛ ebihii nɛɛ asɛɛ. David fɔ biyoo ko hu ni atsɛ lɛ Tamar.
Naa bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon shwiei lɛ wekukpãa lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ lɛ enɔ: Solomon fɔ Rehoboam, ni Rehoboam fɔ Abia, ni Abia fɔ Asa, ni Asa hu fɔ Yehoshafat.
Yehoshafat fɔ Yoram, ni Yoram fɔ Ahazia, ni Ahazia fɔ Yoash.
Yoash fɔ Amazia, ni Amazia fɔ Uzia, ni Uzia fɔ Yotam.
Yotam fɔ Ahaz, ni Ahaz fɔ Hezekia, ni Hezekia fɔ Manase.
Manase fɔ Amon, ni Amon fɔ Yosia.
Yosia fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yohanan, Yehoiakim, Zedekia kɛ Yoahaz.
Ni Yehoiakim fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yehoiakin kɛ Zedekia.
Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin, mɔ ni Babilonbii lɛ ŋɔ lɛ nom lɛ, shwiei lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ. Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin fɔ bihii kpawo: Shealtiel,
kɛ Malkiram, kɛ Pedaia kɛ Shenazar kɛ Yekamia kɛ Hoshama kɛ Hoshama kɛ Nedabia.
Pedaia fɔ bihii enyɔ: Zerubabel kɛ Shimei. Ni Zerubabel fɔ bihii enyɔ: Meshulam kɛ Hanania, kɛ yoo kome ni atsɛ lɛ Shelomit.
Zerubabel fɔ bihii krokomɛi enumɔ hu. Hashuba kɛ Ohel Kɛ Berekia kɛ Hasadia kɛ Yushab-Hesed.
Hananaia fɔ bihii enyɔ: Pelatia kɛ Yeshaia. Yeshaia fɔ Refaia, ni Refaia fɔ Arnan, ni Arnan fɔ Obadia, ni Obadia hu fɔ Shekania.
Shekania fɔ binuu kome ni ji Shemia, ni Shemia fɔ bihii enumɔ: Hatush kɛ Igal kɛ Baria kɛ Nearia kɛ Shabat.
Nearia fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Elioenai kɛ Hizkia kɛ Azrikam.
Elioenai fɔ bihii kpawo: Hodavia kɛ Eliashib kɛ Pelaia kɛ Akub, kɛ Yohanan kɛ Delaia kɛ Anani.
4: Yuda shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nɛ: Perez kɛ Hezron kɛ karmi kɛ Hur kɛ Shobal.
Shobal fɔ Reaia, ni Reaia fɔ Yahat, ni Yahat fɔ Ahumai kɛ Lahad, mɛi ashwiei ni ji Zorabii lɛ.
Kaleb kɛ eŋa Efrat kromɔbinuu ji Hur mɔ ni shwiei yato Betlehem maŋ lɛ. Hur fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Etam kɛ Penuel kɛ Ezer.
Etam fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yezreel kɛ Ishma kɛ Idbash kɛ amɛnyɛmiyoo kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hazelelponi. Penuel ji mɔ ni to Gedor maŋ lɛ, ni Ezer hu ji mɔ ni to Husha maŋ lɛ.
Ashur mɔ ni to Tekoa maŋ lɛ yɛ ŋãmɛi enyɔ, Hela kɛ Naara.
Naara kɛ Ashur fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ahuzam kɛ Hefer kɛ Temeni kɛ Haahashtari.
Ni Hela hu kɛ Ashur fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Zeret kɛ Izohar kɛ Etnan.
Koz fɔ Anub kɛ Zobeba kɛ mɔ mli ni Harum bi Aharhel wekui lɛ jɛ lɛ.
Nuu ko ni gbɛi Yabez lɛ na gbɛi fe enyɛmimɛi lɛ. Tsebelɛ enyɛ wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yabez ejaakɛ enyɛ lɛ kɛɛ, "Hejramɔ mli mifɔ lɛ yɛ,"
shi Yabez sɔle etsɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ojɔɔ mi ni olɛɛ mihusui lɛ amli oha mi, ni obu mihe, ni obaa miyi koni nɔ fɔŋ ko akafee mi. "Nyɔŋmɔ hã Yabez nɔ ni ebi lɛ.
Kɛlub, Shuha nyɛmi lɛ, fɔ Mehir. Mehir fɔ Eshton,
ni Eshton fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Bet-Rafa kɛ Pasea kɛ Tehina. Tehina ji mɔ ni to Nahash maŋ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashwiei lɛ hi Reka maŋ lɛ mli.
Kenaz fɔ bihii enyɔ: Otniel kɛ Seraia. Otniel hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Hatat kɛ Meonotai;
ni Meonotai fɔ Ofra. Seraia fɔ Yoab mɔ ni to Ge-Harashim, ni ji ŋaalɔi amaŋ lɛ. Awo jɛi gbɛi nɛɛ ejaakɛ ŋaalɔi sɔŋŋ ji mɛi ni hi jɛi.
Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Iru kɛ Ela kɛ Naam. Ela fɔ Kenaz.
Yehalelel fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Zif kɛ Zifa Tiria kɛ Asarel.
Ezra fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yeter kɛ Mered kɛ Efer kɛ Yalon. Mered yaŋɔ Bitia, Egipt maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ biyoo kome, Miriam, kɛ bihii enyɔ, Shamai kɛ Ishba. Ishba nɛɛ ji mɔ ni to Eshtemoa maŋ lɛ.
Mered yaŋɔ Yudayoo hu, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yered mɔ ni to Gedor maŋ lɛ, kɛ Heber mɔ ni to Soko maŋ lɛ, kɛ Yekutiel mɔ ni to Zanoa maŋ lɛ.
Hodia ŋɔ Naham nyɛmiyoo lɛ. Shwiei ni amɛwo lɛ hu ashwiei ji Garmbii awekui ni hi keila maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ Maakatbii awekui lɛ ni hi Eshtemoa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Shimon fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amnon kɛ Rina kɛ Ben-Hanan kɛ Tilon. Ishi fɔ bihii enyɔ: Zohet kɛ Ben-Zohet.
Shela, Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ shwiei ji Er, mɔ ni to Leka maŋ lɛ, kɛ Laada, mɔ ni to Maresha maŋ lɛ, kɛ Klala fɛɛfɛo lolɔi awekui ni hi Bet-Ashbea maŋ lɛ mli lɛ;
kɛ Yokim kɛ Kozeba maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ, kɛ Yoash kɛ Saraf, mɛi ni yaye onukpa yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbahi Betlehem lɛ (Blema sane nɛɛ etsɛ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ).
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tsu nii akɛ maŋtsɛ gbɛshɔ̃lɔi, ni maji amli ni amɛhi ji Netaim kɛ Gedera.
Simeon fɔ bihii enumɔ: Nemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Yarib kɛ Zera kɛ Shaul.
Shaul fɔ Shalum, ni Shalum fɔ Mibsam, ni Mibsam fɔ Mishma.
Mishma fɔ Hamuel, niu Hamuel fɔ Zakur, ni Zakur fɔ Shimei.
Shimei fɔ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa kɛ biyei hu ekpaa. Shi moŋ Shimei nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɔɔɔ pii, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛweku lɛ shweree tamɔ Yudabii lɛ.
Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David baye maŋtsɛ lɛ, maji amli ni Simeon shwiei lɛ hi ji Beersheba kɛ Molada kɛ Hazar-Shual,
kɛ Bilha kɛ Ezem kɛ Tolad,
Kɛ Betuel kɛ Horma kɛ Ziklag,
kɛ bet-Markabpt kɛ Hazar-Susim kɛ Bet-Biri kɛ Shaaraim.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛmaji enumɔ krokomɛi hu ji Etam kɛ Ain kɛ Rimon kɛ Token kɛ Ashan.
Sro amɛkrowai fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmaji nɛɛ ahe kɛyashi Baalat maŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ anai lɛ. Simeon shwiei lɛ ŋmala heihei ni amɛhi lɛ kɛ amɛwekui lɛ hu ahe saji amɛfɔ̃ shi.
Amɛwekui lɛ amli onukpai lɛ ji Meshobab kɛ Yamlek kɛ Yosha, Amazia bi lɛ,
kɛ Yoel kɛ Yehu (ni ji Asiel bi Seraia bi Yoshibia bi lɛ);
kɛ Elioenai kɛ Yaakoba kɛ Yeshohaia kɛ Asaia kɛ Adiel kɛ Yesimiel kɛ Benaia;
kɛ Ziza, ni ji Shemaia bi Shimei bi Yedaia bi Alon bi Shifi bi lɛ.
Akɛ ni gbɔmɛi atã ni atsi nɛɛ ji amɛwekui lɛ amli onukpai, ni amɛwekui lɛ hu ayi miifa hewɔ lɛ,
amɛyi mli kɛtee aahuu kɛyanina Gedor maŋ lɛ ni amɛyatao jwɛifɔ amɛha amɛkooloi lɛ yɛ jɔɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ.
Ni amɛyana niyelihe kɛ enɔ jwɛifɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni hi hu; asaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ lɛɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni enɔ jɔ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ nɔ. Sa ko lɛ Hambii ashwiei ji mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.

Shi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ lɛ, lumɛi atã ni atsi nɛɛ fã kɛtee Gedor, ni amɛyakpãtã jɛibii abuui lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛgbe Meunbii ni amɛyania yɛ jɛi lɛ, ni amɛshwie amɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi nɔ ejaakɛ niyelihe yɛ jɛi hã amɛkooloi lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Simeonbii lɛ nɔŋŋ ateŋ mɛi ohai enumɔ fã kɛtee Edom bokãgbɛ. Asafoiatsɛmɛi ni nyiɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahiɛ ji Ishi bihii Pelatia kɛ Nearia kɛ Refaia kɛ Uziel.
Amɛyatua Amalekbii ashwiei ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni na foijee hegbɛ lɛ ni amɛgbe amɛ ni amɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
5: Naa Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ shwiei lɛ. (Ruben ji Yakob kromɔbi; shi ejɛ wɔɔ ni Ruben kɛ etsɛ hewɔ̃ wɔ hewɔ lɛ, Yakob kɛ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ hã Yosef bihii lɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ abuuu Yosef akɛ lɛji kromɔbi yɛ weku lɛ wojiaŋ yɛ kromɔbi gbɛnaa ni akɛha lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ Yuda akutso lɛ ji mɔ ni he bawa fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni emli ejɛ aye maŋtsɛ. Shi kromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ, tsɔ̃ Yosef shwiei lɛ anɔ.)
Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Hanok kɛ Palu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi.
Naa Yoel shwiei lɛ nɛ: Yoel fɔ Shemaia, ni Shemaia fɔ Gog, ni Gog hu fɔ Shimei.
Shimei fɔ Mika, ni Mika fɔ Reaia, ni Reaia fɔ Baal,
ni Baal fɔ Beera, mɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat-Pilneser baŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee be mli ni lɛ ji Rubenbii lɛ alumɔ lɛ.
Beera nyɛmimɛi agbɛii ni yɔɔ Rubenbii awekui ahe saji awojiaŋ ji Yeiel kɛ Zakaria,
kɛ Bela, ni ji Yoel bi Shema bi Azaz bi lɛ. Amɛkutso lɛ hi shi kɛjɛ Areor maŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã shi kɛjɛ jɛi kɛtee kooyigbɛ aahuu kɛyashɛ Nebo kɛ Baal-Meon he.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhi bokãgbɛ shipkɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee aahuu kɛyanina shiaŋã lɛ ni kã shi kɛtee Eufrate Faa lɛ naa lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛkooloi lɛ shwere yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Saul yinɔ lɛ, Rubenbii lɛ fã ta, ni amɛyatua Hagribii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ ni amɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Gilead bokãgbɛ niiaŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Gadbii lɛ hi Rubenbii lɛ akooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji Bashan lɛ nɔ kɛtee bokãgbɛ aahuu kɛyashi Salka maŋ lɛ he.
Amɛweku ni na gbɛi fe ekrokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Bashan lɛ ji Yoel weku lɛ;weku ni nyiɛ no sɛɛ ji Shafam, ni wekui krokomɛi lɛ atsɛmɛi ji Yanai kɛ Shafat.
Amɛnyɛmimɛi Gadbii krokomɛi lɛ, yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ awei lɛ ayibɔ naa ji kpawo: Mikael kɛ Meshulam kɛ Sheba kɛ Yorai kɛ Yakan kɛ Zia kɛ Eber.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Abihail, ni ji Buz bi Yado bi Yeshishai bi Mikael bi Gilead bi Yaroa bi Huri lɛ bi lɛ, shwiei ji amɛ.
Ni, Ahi, ni ji Guni bi Abdiel bi lɛ, ji wekui srɔtoi nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ onukpa.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ hi Gilead kɛ Bashan kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ amli, kɛ Sharon jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ fɛɛ kɛyashwie amɛhusui lɛ anaa tɔ̃ɔ.
(Aŋmlã wekui nɛɛ ahe blema saji nɛɛ be mli ni Yotam yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Yeroboam hu yeɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.)
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ hii tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa(44,760) ni he esa jogbaŋŋ kɛ tsɛŋ kɛ Klaŋte kɛ gãi kɛ tawuu.
Amɛfã ta, ni amɛ kɛ Hagribii ni yɔɔ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Nodad lɛ yawu.

Hagribii lɛ na mɛi yafata amɛhe yɛ ta mli, kɛ̃lɛ aye amɛ kɛ mɛi ni yafata amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ sɔle amɛtsɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ koni eye ebua amɛ yɛ ta lɛ mli. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ bo amɛsɔlemɔ lɛ toi ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ enɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛloo Hagribii lɛ akooloi kɛtee: Yomai akpei ohai nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ toi hu akpei ohai enyɔ nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ tejii hu akpei oha.
Hagribii lɛ babaoo nyɔnyɔi ejaakɛ eji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa akɛ awu nakai ta lɛ. Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ hi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi be ni aŋɔ nom lɛ.
Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ hi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛyi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Bashan aahuu kɛtee kɛyashwie Baal-Hermon kɛ Senir Gɔŋkpɔ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ he.
Amɛtsɛmɛi awie lɛ amli onukpai lɛ ji Efer kɛ Ishi kɛ Eliel kɛ Azriel; kɛ Yeremia kɛ Yodavia kɛ Yadiel. Amɛji hii kãkãlɔi, ni amɛyɛ gbɛi yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awebii lɛ ateŋ. Aŋɔ Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ nom
Shi Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ tɔ̃ amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. Amɛkwa lɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ lɛ ajemawɔji lɛ jamɔ moŋ.

No hewɔ lɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Pul (ni atsɛ lɛ Tiglat-Pilneser hu lɛ) ewo amɛhe, ni efã ta kɛbatua amɛ, ni ebaŋɔ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ nom, ni eloo amɛ kɛtee eyashwie Hala kɛ Habor kɛ Hara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Gozan Faa lɛ hu naa, ni amɛka jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
6: Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.
Kohat fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel.
Amram fɔ bihii enyɔ, Aaron kɛ Mose, kɛ biyoo kome ni ji Miriam. Aaron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Nadad kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Naa bɔ ni Eleazar shwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ jwere shi hã kɛjɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ: Eleazer fɔ Pinehas, ni Peneshas fɔ Abishua.
Abishua fɔ Buki, Buki fɔ Uzi.
Uzi fɔ Zerahia, ni Zerahia fɔ Meraiot.
Meraiot fɔ Amaria, ni Amaria fɔ Ahitub.
Ahitub fɔ Zadok, ni Zadok fɔ Ahimaaz
Ahimaaz fɔ Azaria, ni Azaria fɔ Yohanan,
ni Yohanan fɔ Azaria (mɔ ni ye osɔfo yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ma yɛ Yerusalem lɛ mli lɛ).
Azaria nɛɛ fɔ Amaria, ni Amaria fɔ Ahitub.
Ahitub fɔ Zadok, ni Zadok fɔ Shalum.
Shalum fɔ Hilkia, ni Hilkia fɔ Azaria,
ni Azaria fɔ Sheraia, ni Sheraia fɔ Yehozadak.
Be ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nine nɔ ni ehã aŋɔ Yuda kɛ Yersalembii lɛ nom lɛ, Yehozadak fata mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ahe kɛtee.
Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Gershon kɛ kohat kɛ Merari.
Gershon bii ji Libni kɛ Shimei:
Kohat bii ji Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel,
ni Merari bii ji Maheli kɛ Mushi. Ni bɔ ni Levibii lɛ awekui yɛ tsɛmɛi ayinɔi lɛ anaa jwere shi hã nɛ:
Gershon nɔ mli lɛ, eshwiei ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ji Libni kɛ Yahat kɛ Zima;
kɛkɛ lɛ, Yoa kɛ Ido kɛ Zera kɛ Yeaterai.
Kohat nɔ mli lɛ, eshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ji Aminadab kɛ Kora kɛ Asir;
kɛkɛ lɛ Elkana kɛ Ebiasaf kɛ Asir,
kɛ Tahat kɛ Uriel kɛkɛ lɛ Uzia kɛ Shaul.
Elkana fɔ bihii enyɔ: Amasai kɛ Ahimot.
Yɛ Ahimot nɔ mli lɛ eshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi ji Elkana kɛ Zofai, kɛ Nahat,
kɛ Eliab kɛ Yeroham kɛ Elkana.
Samuel fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yoel, ji kromɔbi, kɛ esɛɛho Abia.
Merari nɔ mli lɛ, eshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ji Maheli kɛ Libni kɛ Shimei kɛ Uza,
kɛ Shimea kɛ Hagia kɛ Asaia.
Mɛi yɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David to koni amɛkwɛ lala ni alaa yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bama Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛto naa, ni amɛsɔmɔ kɛ lala yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ma Yehowa We lɛ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ. Amɛtsu amɛnii bɔ ni ato sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he gbɛjianɔ ahã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Naa hii ni tsu lala he nitsumɔ nɛɛ eko lɛ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ eshwiei: Kohatbii anɔ mli lɛ Heman, ni ji Samuel bi Yoel bi lɛ, ji klɛŋklɛŋ lalatsɛ lɛ. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni wekukpãa kã shi ha kɛyashi Yakob nɔ: Herman tsɛ ji Yoel, ni Yoel tsɛ ji Samuel.
Samuel tsɛ ji Elkana, ni Elkana tsɛ ji Yeroham; Yeroham tsɛ ji Eliel, ni Eliel tsɛ ji Toa.
Toa tsɛ ji Zuf; Zuf tsɛ ji Elkana; Elkana tsɛ ji Mahat, ni Mahat tsɛ ji Amasai.
Amasai tsɛ ji Elkana, ni Elkana tsɛ ji Yoel; Yoel tsɛ ji Azaria, ni Azaria tsɛ ji Zefania.
Zefania tsɛ ji Tahat; Tahat tsɛ ji Asir; Asir tsɛ ji Ebiasaf, ni Ebiasaf tsɛ ji kora.
Kora tsɛ ji Izehar, Izehar tsɛ ji kohat; Kohat tsɛ ji Levi, ni Levi tsɛ ji Yakob.
Asaf ji lalatsɛ ni ji enyɔ ni edamɔɔ ninejurɔ gbɛ lɛ; nɛkɛ ji bɔ bi ewekukpãa kã shi hã kɛyashi Levi nɔ: Asaf tsɛ ji Berekia; ni Berekia tsɛ ji Shimea.
Shimea tsɛ ji Mikael; Mikael tsɛ ji Baseia, ni Baseia tsɛ ji Malkia.
Malkia tsɛ ji Etni; Etni tsɛ ji Zera, ni Zera tsɛ ji Adaia.
Adaia tsɛ ji Etan; Etan tsɛ ji Zima, ni Zima tsɛ ji Shimei.
Shimei tsɛ ji Yahat; Yahat tsɛ ji Gershon, ni Gershon tsɛ ji Levi.
Etan ni jɛ Merari weku lɛ mli, ni lɛji mɔ ni damɔɔ Heman abɛkugbɛ lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ewekukpãa kã shi kɛyashi Levi nɔ: Etan tsɛ ji Kishi; Kishi tsɛ ji Abdi, ni tsɛ ji Maluk.
Maluk tsɛ ji Hashabia; Hashabia tsɛ ji Amazia, ni Amazia tsɛ ji Hilkia.
Hilkia tsɛ ji Amzi; Amzi tsɛ ji Bani, ni Bani tsɛ ji Shemer.
Shemer tsɛ ji Mali; Mali tsɛ ji Mushi; Mushi tsɛ ji Merari, ni Merari tsɛ ji Levi.
Amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ, amɛ amɛdɛŋ akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nitsumɔi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ wo.

Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ ji mɛi ni kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ afɔlei lɛ yaa afɔlesãa latɛ lɛ nɔ amɛyashãa. Amɛnitsumɔ ji jamɔ ni ajaa yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ mli lɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ; asaŋ amɛkpãtãa amɛhãa maŋ lɛ koni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni Israelbii etɔ̃ lɛ afa amɛ. Amɛtsuɔ nitsumɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose ewo he kitã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Bɔ ni Aaron shwiei lɛ wekukpãa lɛ kã shi hã nɛ: Aaron fɔ Eleazar; Eleazar fɔ Pinehas, ni Pinehas fɔ Abishua.
Abishua fɔ Buki; Buki fɔ Uzi, ni Uzi fɔ Zerahia.
Zerahia fɔ Meraiot; Meraiot fɔ Amaria, ni Amaria fɔ Ahitub.
Ahitub fɔ Zadok, ni Zadok fɔ Ahimaaz.
Maji amli ni Levibii lɛ hi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛha Aaron shwiei ni jɛ Kohat mli lɛ nɛ, ejaakɛ amɛji mɛi anɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee.
Akɛ Hebron ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hã amɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ he jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ hu;
shi maŋ lɛ he ŋmɔji kɛ ekrowai lɛ akɛhã Yefune bi Kaleb.
Maji krokomɛi ni akɛhã Aaron shwiei lɛ ji Hebron, ni ji abobaa maŋ lɛ, kɛ Libna kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu, kɛ Yatir kɛ Eshtemoa kɛ maji nɛɛ ahe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Maji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Hilen kɛ Debir,
kɛ Ashan kɛ Bet-Shemesh, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ.

Benyaminbii lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji ni akɛhã Aaron shwiei lɛ ji Geba kɛ Alemet kɛ Anatot, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ. Maji ni akɛhã kohat shwiei lɛ awekui lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛhi amɛmli lɛ ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.
Yɛ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ naa lɛ, ahã Kohatbii awekui ni eshwɛ lɛ maji nyɔŋma yɛ Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Aŋɔ maji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛjɛ Isakarbii lɛ kɛ Asherbii lɛ kɛ Naftalibii kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ, ni akɛhã Gershon shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Ni aklɔ maji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛjɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni akɛhã Merari shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ Israelbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhã Levibii lɛ maji koni amɛhi mli.
Afɔ̃ oshiki, ni adamɔ no nɔ ni akɛ Yuda kɛ Simeon kɛ Benyamin shikpɔji lɛ anɔ maji ni atsi amɛtã nɛɛ hã Levibii lɛ.
Ahã kohatbii lɛ awekui lɛ ekomɛi maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ yɛ Efraimbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maji lɛ ji, Shekem, ni ji abobaa maŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ lɛ kɛ Gezer,
kɛ Yokmeam kɛ Bet-Horon kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji lɛ
Kɛ Aiyalon kɛ Gat-Rimon kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji lɛ.
Ni akɛ Anaigbɛ Manasebii hu amaji ni ji Aner kɛ Bileam kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji shi nɔ hã Kohatbii lɛ.
Naa maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji ni akɛha Gershonbii awekui lɛ: Yɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ Golan yɛ Bashan kɛ Ashtarot hã amɛ.
Yɛ Isakarbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ Kedesh kɛ Daberat,
kɛ Ramot kɛ Anem hã amɛ.
Yɛ Asherbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ Mashal kɛ Abdon
kɛ Hukok kɛ Rehob hã amɛ.
Yɛ Naftalibii lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ kɛdash yɛ Galilea kɛ Hamon kɛ Kiriataim hã amɛ.
Merari shwiei lɛ ateŋ wekui ni eshwɛ lɛ, maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji ni akɛhã amɛ yɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji Rimono kɛ Tabor.
Yɛ Rubenbii lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bakãgbɛ, asaŋ yɛ Yeriko sɛɛ lɛ, ahã amɛ Bezer, ni kã gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛ Yaza,
kɛ Kedemot kɛ Mefaat hu kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ni yɛ Gadbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahã amɛ Ramot, ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ, kɛ Mahanaim,
kɛ Heshbon kɛ Yazer kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ.
7: Isakar fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Tola kɛ Pua kɛ Yashub kɛ Shimron.

Tola fɔ bihii ekpaa: Uzi kɛ Refaia kɛ Yeriel kɛ Yahemai kɛ Ibsam kɛ Shemuel. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ Tola shwiei awekui lɛ anukpai, asaŋ kɛ tatsɛmɛi wuji hu. Maŋtsɛ David yinɔ lɛ Tola shwiei nɛɛ ayibɔ ji akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Uzi fɔ bi kome, ni ji Izrahia. Izrahia fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Mikael kɛ Obadia kɛ Yoel kɛ Ishia. Uzi kɛ ebihii ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsɔmɔ wekui ayitsei.
Amɛŋɔŋɔɔ yei babaoo ni amɛfɔfɔɔ bii pii bɔ ni yinɔ lɛ eko nɔ lɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ hã hii tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa.
No hewɔ lɛ Isakar akutso lɛ mli tabilɔi ayikulɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpawo.
Benyamin fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Bela kɛ Beker kɛ Yediael.

Bela fɔ bihii enumɔ: Ezbon kɛ Uzi kɛ Uziel kɛ Yerimot kɛ Iri. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ akutso lɛ mli wekui amli onukpai, asaŋ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi hu; ni hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ejwɛ yɛ amɛshwiei ateŋ.
Beker fɔ bihii nɛɛhu: Zemira kɛ Yoash kɛ Eliazer kɛ Elioenai kɛ Omri kɛ Yeremot kɛ Abia kɛ Anatot kɛ Alemet.
Be ni akane amɛshwiei ayibɔ yɛ amɛwekui anaa lɛ, ana hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Yediael fɔ binuu kome ni ji Bilhan; shi Bilhan fɔ bihii kpawo: Yeush kɛ Benyamin kɛ Ehud kɛ Kenaana kɛ Zetan kɛ Tarshish kɛ Ahishahar.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ amli onukpai, asaŋ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi hu. Hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai enyɔ yɛ amɛshwie lɛ ateŋ.
Ir fɔ Shupim kɛ Hupim; ni Dan fɔ binuu kome ni ji Hushim. Naftali shwiei lɛ
Naftali fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yaziel kɛ Guni kɛ Yezer kɛ Shalum. Ekɛ Bilha bii ni.
Manase kɛ ehemɔ Aramyoo lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Asriel kɛ Makir mɔ ni tsɛ̃ Gilead tsɛ lɛ.
Makir ŋɔ yei ehã Hupim kɛ Shupim. Makir yɛ nyɛmiyoo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Maaka. Makir binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Zelofehad. Zelofehad fɔ biyei sɔŋŋ.
Makir ŋa ji Maaka, ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ, ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ Peresh kɛ Sheresh. Peresh fɔ bihii enyɔ, Ulam kɛ Rakem;
ni Ulam fɔ binuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Bedam. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Manase bi Makir bi Gilead shwiei lɛ.
Gilead nyɛmiyoo Hamoleket fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Ishod kɛ Abiezer kɛ Mahela.
Shemida fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ahian kɛ Shekem kɛ Likhi kɛ Aniam.
Naa Efraim shwiei lɛ ayinɔia lɛ jɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ: Efraim fɔ Shutela, ni Shutela fɔ Bered; Bered fɔ Tahat, ni Tahat fɔ Eleada, ni Eleada fɔ Tahat.
Tahat fɔ Zabad, ni zabad fɔ Shutela. Efraim fɔ bihii enyɔ krokomɛi efata Shutela he. Amɛji Ezer kɛ Elead ni agbe amɛ be ni amɛtee amɛyaamɔmɔ Gatbii ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɔmɔbii lɛ atsinai ekãa naa lɛ.
Efraim, amɛtsɛ lɛ, ye amɛhe ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba ni amɛbashɛje emii.
Kɛkɛ ni Efraim kɛ eŋã lɛ wɔ, ni yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu. Awo lɛ Beria yɛ amanehulu ni Efraim we lɛ ena lɛ hewɔ.
Efraim fɔ biyoo ko ni gbɛi ji Sheera. Lɛji mɔ ni to maji ni atsɛɔ amɛ, Bet-Horon ni yɔɔ Gɔŋ nɔ kɛ Bet-Horon ni yɔɔ Jɔɔŋ kɛ Uzen Sheera fɛɛ.
Efraim fɔ bi ko hu gbɛi ji Refa. Refa nɛɛ fɔ Reshef; Reshef fɔ Tela, ni Tela fɔ Tahan;
Tahan fɔ Ladan ni Ladan fɔ Amihud; ni Amihud fɔ Elishama.
Elishama fɔ Nuu, ni Nuu fɔ Yoshua.

Amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ koni amɛhi nɔ lɛ, no nɔ Betel maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ aahuu kɛyashi Naaran yɔɔ. Yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ tee aahuu kɛyashɛ Gezer maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ ahe. Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Shekem maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ kɛ Aya maŋ wulu kɛ ehe maji lɛ yɔɔ.
Manase shwiei lɛ adɛŋ maji wuji ejwɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ baje: Bet-Shan kɛ Taanak kɛ megido kɛ Dor. Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ amli Yakob bi Yosef shwiei lɛ hi.
Naa Asher shwiei lɛ: Asher fɔ bihii ejwɛ, Imna kɛ Ishva kɛ Ishvi kɛ Beria, kɛ amɛnyɛmiyoo kome, ni ji Sera.
Beria fɔ bihii enyɔ: Heber kɛ Malkiel mɔ ni to Birzait maŋ lɛ.
Heber fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yaflet kɛ Shomer kɛ Hotam kɛ amɛyɛmiyoo kome, ni hji Shua.
Yaflet hu fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Pasak kɛ Bimhal kɛ Ashvat.
Yaflet nyɛminuu Shomer fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Roga kɛ Yehuba kɛ Aram.
Ni Shomer nyɛminuu Hotam fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Zofa kɛ Imna kɛ Shelesh kɛ Amal.
Zofa shwiei ji Sua kɛ Harnefer kɛ Shual kɛ Beri kɛ Imra,
kɛ Bezer kɛ Hod kɛ Shama kɛ Shilsha kɛ Itran kɛ Beera.
Yeter shwiei ji Yefune kɛ Pispa kɛ Ara;
ni Ula hu shwiei ji Ara kɛ Haniel kɛ Rizia.

Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Asher shwiei ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi ashīai lɛ amli onukpai lɛ, hii kakabãi kɛ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɛi, asaŋ kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ ateŋ onukpai hu. Asher shwiei nɛɛ hiɛ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa ni eshɛ tayaa.
8: Benyamin fɔ bihii enumɔ. Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Bela, ni mɔ ni ji enyɔ ji Ashbel; ebi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Ahara;
ebi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Noha, ni ebi ni ji enmɔ lɛ ji Rafa.
Bela shwiei ji Adar kɛ Gera kɛ Abihud,
kɛ Abishua kɛ Naaman kɛ Ahoa,

kɛ Gera kɛ Shefufan kɛ Huram. 6-7. Naa Ehud shiei lɛ. Amɛji Naaman kɛ Ahia kɛ Gera. Amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli wekui lɛ onukpai ji amɛ fɛɛ, ni kulɛ Geba amɛyɔɔ; shi abashwie amɛ akranaŋ naa kɛje jɛi, ni amɛtee amɛyabɔ mɔfro yɛ Manahat. Gera, ni ji Uza kɛ Ahihud tsɛ, ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Geba hii lɛ ahiɛ kɛyabɔ mɔfro lɛ.
Be ni Shaharaim eshwie eŋãmɛi ni ji Hushim kɛ Baara lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, efɔ bii yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eŋɔ Hodesh efee eŋã, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii kpawo: Yobab kɛ Zibia kɛ Mesha kɛ Malkam,
kɛ Yeuz kɛ Shakia kɛ Mirma. Shaharaim bii lɛ nɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ weku mli onukpai.
Shaharaim kɛ Hushim hu fɔ bihii enyɔ, Abitub kɛ Elpaal.
Elpaal bihii ji Eber kɛ Misham kɛ Shemed mɔ ni to Ono kɛ Lod maji lɛ kɛ akrowai ni bɔle amɛhe lɛ.
Beria kɛ Shema lɛ Ayalonbii lɛ awekui lɛ weku onukpai ji amɛ; amɛji mɛi ni shwie Gat maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ.
Beria shwiei lɛ ji Ahio kɛ Shashak kɛ Yeremot,
kɛ Zebadia kɛ Arad kɛ Eder,
kɛ Mikael kɛ Ishpa kɛ Yoha.
Elpaal shwiei ji Zebadia kɛ Meshulam kɛ Hizki kɛ Heber,
kɛ Ishmerai kɛ Izlia kɛ Yohab.
Shimie shwiei ji Yakim kɛ Zikri kɛ Zabdi,
kɛ Elienai kɛ Ziletai kɛ Eliel,
kɛ Adaia kɛ Beraia kɛ shimrat.
Shashak shwiei ji Ishpan kɛ Eber kɛ Eliel,
kɛ Abdon kɛ Zikri kɛ Hanan,
kɛ Hanania kɛ Elam kɛ Antotia
kɛ ifdeia kɛ Penuel.
Yeroham shwiei ji Shamsheria kɛ Sheharia kɛ Atalia,
kɛ Yaareshia kɛ Elia kɛ Zikri.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji wekui amli onukpai kɛ amɛshwiei ni hi Yerusalem lɛ.
Yiel ji mɔ ni yato Gibeon maŋ lɛ, ni ehi jɛi. Eŋã gbɛi ji Maaka,
ni ekromɔbi ji Abdon. Ebihii krokomɛi lɛ ji zur kɛ Kish kɛ Baal kɛ Ner kɛ Nadab,
kɛ Gedor kɛ Ahio kɛ Zeker,
kɛ Miklot ni ji Shemea tsɛ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛshwiei hi Yerusalem yɛ amɛyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ amasɛi.
Ner fɔ Kish, ni Kish fɔ Saul, ni Saul fɔ Yonatan kɛ Malkishua kɛ Abinadab kɛ Esh-Baal.
Yonatan fɔ Merib-Baal, ni Merib-Baal fɔ Mika.
Mika fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Piton kɛ Melek kɛ Tarea kɛ Ahaz.
Ahaz fɔ Yehoada, ni Yehoada fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Alemet kɛ Azmawet kɛ zimri; ni Zimri fɔ Moza.
Moza fɔ Binea, ni Binea fɔ Rafa, ni Rafa fɔ Eleasa, ni Eleasa fɔ Azel.
Azel fɔ bihii ekpaa: Azrikam kɛ Bokeru kɛ Ishmael kɛ Shearia kɛ Obadia kɛ Hanan.
Ni Azel nyɛminuu Eshek fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Ulam kɛ Yeush kɛ Elifelet.
Ulam bihii lɛ tsɔmɔ hii kãkãlɔi kɛ gãitsɛ̃lɔi kpanakpanaai; ni amɛbihii kɛ bihii abii lɛ ayibɔ fee oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Benyaminbii ji Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ.
9: Akane Israelbii fɛɛ ayibɔ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa. Aŋmã mɛi akanemɔ nɛɛ he saji lɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli. Aŋɔ̃ Yudabii nom kɛtee Babilon; akɛgbla amɛtoi yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ.
Nomi lɛ ateŋ mɛi tsutsu ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbahi amɛmaji amli ekoŋŋ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Israelbii kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ.
Nomi lɛ ateŋ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ kɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ ekomɛi tee Yerusalem ni amɛyahi jɛi.
Yɛ Yudabii ni shi nɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Utai, Imri bi Omri bi Amihud bi lɛ, ji Yuda bi Perez shwiei lɛ anuka.
Ni yɛ Yuda bi Shela shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Asaia ji amɛnukpa.
Ni yɛ Yuda bi zera shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Yeuel ji amɛnukpa. Yudabii nɛɛ awei ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu hi Yerusalem.
Benyaminbii ni shi nɔ kɛyahi Yerusalem lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Salu, ni ji Hasenua bi Hodavia bi Meshulam bi lɛ,
kɛ Ibneia, Yeroham bi lɛ, kɛ Ela, Mikri bi Uzi bi lɛ, kɛ Meshulam, Ibnia bi Reuel bi Shefatia bi lɛ.
Benyaminbii nɛɛ lɛ aweei ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekpaa hi Yerusalem. Amɛ mɛi ni atsi amɛtã nɛɛ fɛɛ weku onukpai ni.
Osɔfoi lɛ ni hi Yerusalem lɛ ji Yedaia kɛ Yehoiarib kɛ yakin,
kɛ Azaria, ni etsɛ ji Hilkia Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ anukpa lɛ, asaŋ ni eji Ahitub bi Meraiot bi zadok bi Meshulam bi lɛ,
kɛ Adaia ni etsɛ ji Yeroham ni eji Pashur bi kɛ Malkiya seshinyo lɛ, kɛ Maasai ni etsɛ ji Adiel, ni eji Yahazera kɛ Meshulam kɛ Meshilemit kɛ Imer seshinyo lɛ.
Osɔfoi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ weku nukpai ni, ni amɛ kɛ amɛwekumɛi ayikulɛ fee akpe kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa, ni amɛhe esa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ amli.
Levibii ni hi Yerusalem lɛ ji Shemaia ni etsɛ ji Hashub, ni eji Azrikam kɛ Hashabia, ni jɛ Merari mli lɛ seshinyo lɛ,
kɛ Bakbakar kɛ Heresh kɛ Galal kɛ Matania ni etsɛ ji Mika ni eseshibii komɛi ji Zikri kɛ Asaf lɛ,
kɛ Obadia ni etsɛ ji Shemaia ni eseshibii ji Galal kɛ Yedutun lɛ, kɛ Berekia ni etsɛ ji Asa, ni eji Elkana ni hi Netofa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ shwie lɛ.
Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hebulɔi ni hi Yerusalem ji Shalum kɛ Akub kɛ Talmon kɛ Ahiman kɛ amɛwekui lɛ amli bii. Shalum ji amɛnukpa.
Kɛbashi nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ naa yɛ bokãgbɛ. Tsutsu ko lɛ kulɛ amɛbuɔ agboi ni yɔɔ Levibii ashihilɛhei lɛ anaa.
Shalum, ni ji Ebiasaf bi kore bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi ni ji Kora shwiei lɛ amɛ amɛbuɔ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ he.
Ni Eleazer bi Finehas mɔ ni Yehowa ena lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ be ko mli.
Zakaria, Meshelemia bi lɛ, hu ji agbonaabulɔ yɛ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.

Mɛi fɛɛ ni ato akɛ agbonaabulɔi lɛ ayikulɛ ji ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Ahala amɛ yɛ amɛwekui anaa yɛ amɛkrowai amli. Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Gbalɔ Samuel ji mɛi ni tu nitsumɔ nɛɛ wo gbɔmɛi nɛɛ atsɛmɛi beebe adɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei ji mɛi ni buɔ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ ni ji Buu lɛ ni ashi akɛ Yehowa We lɛ agboi lɛ anaa.
Agbo yɛ Shihilɛhe lɛ koŋ fɛɛ koŋ, ekooyigbɛ kɛ ewuoyigbɛ kɛ ebokãgbɛ kɛ enaigbɛ; ni agbo fɛɛ agbo yɛ agbonaabulɔnukpa.
Daa gbii kpawo lɛ agbonaabulɔi nɛɛ awekumɛi ni yɔɔ amɛkrowai lɛ amli lɛ baa, ni amɛbatsakeɔ mɛi ni buɔ lɛ.
Agbonaabulɔinukpai ejwɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ Levibii ji amɛ, ni amɛ amɛkwɛɔ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Amɛ amɛbuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nitoohei lɛ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ ahe akɔntaa.
No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ masɛi amɛhihilɛhei yɔɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛbu Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ he, asaŋ ni amɛ gbele enaa agboi lɛ daa leebi.
Levibii lɛ ekomɛi hu kwɛɔ tsɛnsii ni akɛjaa lɛ anɔ. Amɛnitsumɔ ji amɛkpa naa kɛ abahole kɛ kɛji akɛmiiba akɛbaato lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi hu kwɛɔ okplɔ̃i kɛ adekai kɛ tsɛnsii krɔŋkrɔŋi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Amɛkwɛɔ mamu kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ tsofakɛŋmai kɛ krɔbɔo hu anɔ.
Shi osɔfoi abii lɛ ji mɛi ni futuɔ nibii srɔtoi ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma lɛ.
Levinyo ko ni gbɛi ji Matitia, Kroranyo Shalum lɛ kromɔbi lɛ, lɛji mɔ ni kwɛɔ akpiti tɛtrɛbii lɛ ashãa nɔ.
Levibii lɛ anyɛmimɛi ni ji Kohatbii lɛ hu ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ aboloo ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ daa hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ shãa nɔ.

Levibii wekui lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi anitsumɔ ji lamɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ. Wekui nɛɛ amli weku nukpai lɛ hi Sɔlemɔwe lɛ piai amli. Akɛ nitsumɔ ko kwraa ejɛɛɛ sɛɛ gbaaa amɛnaa ejaakɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ lamɔ mli.
Mɛi atã ni atsi kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ ji Levibii lɛ ashikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ kɛ amɛshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ amli weku nukpai lɛ, ni amɛhi Yerusalem lɛ.
Yeiel ji mɔ ni yato Gibeon maŋ lɛ, ni jɛi ehi. Eŋã gbɛi ji Maaka.
Ekromɔbi lɛ gbɛi ji Abdon, ni ebihii krokomɛi ji Zur kɛ Kish kɛ Baal kɛ Ner kɛ Nadab,
kɛ Gedor kɛ Ahio kɛ Zakaria kɛ Miklot.
Miklot fɔ Shimeam. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛshwiei hi Yerusalem yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ amasɛi.
Ner fɔ Kish, ni Kish fɔ Saul, ni Saul fɔ Yonatan kɛ Malkishua kɛ Abinadab kɛ Esh-Baal.
Yonatan fɔ Merib-Baal, ni Merib-Baal fɔ Mika.
Mika fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Piton kɛ Melek kɛ Tarea kɛ Ahaz.
Ahaz fɔ Yara, ni Yara fɔ bihii etɛ̃; Alemet kɛ Azmawet kɛ Zimri. Zimri fɔ Moza.
Moza fɔ Binea, ni Binea fɔ Refaia, ni Refaia fɔ Eleasa, ni Eleasa fɔ Azel.
Azel fɔ bihii ekpaa: Azrikam kɛ Bokeru kɛ Ishmael kɛ Shearia kɛ Obadia kɛ Hanan.
10: Filistibii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ wu, ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ amɛshwie Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Israelbii lɛ jo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ;
shi Filistibii lɛ tiu Israelbii lɛ kɛ Saul kɛ ebihii lɛ. Amɛnine shɛ Saul bihii Yonatan kɛ Abinadab kɛ Malkishua nɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Akɛ ta lɛ nina Saul Kpaakpa. Henyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko yoo Saul, ni etsɛ̃ lɛ gãi, ni epila lɛ ablaŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ etawuu nii lɛ akɛ, "Gblamɔ oklaŋte lɛ ni okɛdu mi bɔ ni afee ni foolɔi nɛɛ akaba amɛbagbe mi, ni amɛye mihe fɛo. "Shi oblanyo lɛ emiii nakai feemɔ, ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔ lɛ naakpa. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Saul gbla lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eklaŋte lɛ ni eho egbee nɔ.
Be ni oblanyo lɛ na akɛ Saul egbo lɛ, lɛ hu eho egbee eklaŋte lɛ nɔ, ni egbo.
Belɛ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ gboi shi kome, kɛkɛ ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ fo.

Be ni Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yezreel Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni asaŋ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ enyɔnyɔi lɛ, amɛjojoo foi amɛshishii amɛmaji lɛ amɛshwiei shi. Filistibii lɛ baŋɔ maji lɛ, ni amɛshi mli.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Filistibii lɛ ba gbohii lɛ ahe nibii kplɔmɔ lɛ, amɛna Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ agbohii lɛ jwere Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Amɛfo Saul yi, ni amɛkplɔ edama lɛ yɛ ehe, ni atsu bɔfoi koni amɛyakpa Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpula, koni amɛyashiɛ ta lɛ mli omanye sane lɛ yɛ amɛwɔji fɛɛ anaa, ni asaŋ amɛshiɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ hu.
Filistibii lɛ kɛ Saul tawuu nii lɛ tee yato amɛjemawɔŋ lɛ eko we, ni akɛ eyitso lɛ yatsotsro amɛjemawɔŋ Dagon we lɛ mli.
Shi be ni Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ fɛɛ nu bɔ ni Filistibii lɛ efee Saul lɛ,
amɛteŋ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ tee ni amɛyawoo Saul gbonyo lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu agbohii lɛ kɛba Yabesh, ni amɛbafu amɛ yɛ tso ko shishi, ni amɛhi ŋmãa gbii kpawo.
Anɔkwa ni Saul eyayeee lɛ hewɔ ni egbo lɛ. Saul eyayeee Yehowa anɔkwa ejaakɛ eyayeee Yehowa kitãi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ etee eyafee nii yɛ sisatsɛlɔ ŋɔɔ ekɛbi nii,
be mli ni Yehowa moŋ nii esa akɛ ebi lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa fo ewala sɛɛ, ni edãi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ehã Yeshai bi David.
11: Israel muu fɛɛ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, wɔ kɛ bo jɛ lá kome.
Nyɛsɛɛ ko be ni Maŋtsɛ Saul yeɔ wɔnɔ lɛ, boji tatsɛ ni nyiɛ Israelbii ahiɛ kɛtee kɛba, asaŋ Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ wo bo shi akɛ, 'Bo oootsɔ̃ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ amɛlimɔ.''"
Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ; kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ David mu, ni amɛwo lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Samuel nɔ ewo shi eto lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Israel muu fɛɛ fã ta kɛtee kɛyanina Yerusalem. Nakai be mli kɛ atsɛɔ Yerusalem akɛ Yebus. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ atsɛɔ amɛ Yebusbii.
Yebusbii lɛ tswa David mpoa akɛ, "Onyɛŋ biɛ oshɛ!" Shi David na eshɔ̃ Zion mɔɔ ni ji Yerusalem maŋ lɛ kɛ̃; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi batsɔ David Maŋ.

David kɛɛ etabilɔi lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ tsuutsu ni aaayatswia Yebusbii lɛ nii lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ asafoiatsɛnukpa kɛ lumɔ fɛɛ. "Kɛkɛ ni Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ akɛ Zeruia lɛ, tsuutsu fã kɛtee eyatua Yebusbii lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ asafoiatsɛnukpa.
Ni akɛni maŋtsɛ David etee eyahi Zion Mɔɔ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, mɔɔ lɛ gbɛi batsɔ David Maŋ.
David saa etswa maŋ lɛ kɛjɛ he ni atsɛɔ akɛ Milo lɛ kpula kɛkpe, ni Yoab hu saa etswa he ni shwɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ kɛyaa lɛ, da kɛkɛ David hewalɛ lɛ daa, ejaakɛ Yehowa Ofe lɛ kɛ lɛ yɛ.

Hii kakabãi ni Maŋtsɛ David yɔɔ lɛ ateiaŋ onukpai, mɛi ni fi esɛɛ kpɛŋŋ yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni asaŋ Israel fɛɛ hu fata amɛhe ni awo David maŋtsɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo shi eto yɛ Israel he lɛ agbɛii kɛ amɛhe saji baa nɛɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ ji Yashobeam, Hakemonnyo lɛ, mɔ hu ni ji hii Kãkãlɔi Etɛ̃ fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ onukpa lɛ. Ewo ekplɔ nɔ lɛ, ekɛgbe mɛi ohai kpaanyɔ yɛ ta kome mli.
Esɛɛmɔ yɛ hii Kãkãlɔi Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ ji Eleazer, Ahohinyo, Dodo bi lɛ.

Lɛ akɛ Maŋtsɛ David wu Pas-Damin ta lɛ be ni Filistibii lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi koni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ awu lɛ. Be ni akɛ ta lɛ shɛ Shikpɔŋ kuku ko ni yɔɔ jɛi ni akoko eyi nɔ obɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ bɔ̃i foijee yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ.
Shi Eleazar nɛɛ ho edamɔ shi akɛ nuu, ni ekpee ta lɛ naa yɛ shikpɔŋ kuku lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu efã shikpɔŋ lɛ he, ni ekɛ esɛɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ. Yehowa hã eye kunim kpeteŋkple.
Gbi ko lɛ hii Kãkãlɔi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɛi etɛ̃ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Adulam Tɛkplo lɛ mli yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ. No mli lɛ Filistibii lɛ ebagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli,
ni amɛfã ko eŋɔ Betlehem, ni amɛyɛ jɛi; David hu yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli.
David hiɛ tsɔ̃ shīa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Namɔ po mana ni eya Betlehem eyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu ebaha mi manu?"

Kɛkɛ ni hii Kãkãlɔi Etɛ̃ nɛɛ gba sa kɛtsɔ̃ Filistibii tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ yɛ ekãa naa kɛho, ni amɛtee amɛyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ Bethlehem maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu, ni amɛkɛbahã David. Shi David emiii nu lɛ numɔ; shi moŋ efɔse eshwie shikpɔŋ akɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛmiishã afɔle eha Yehowa,
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ̃ akɛ manu nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ. Kɛji minu lɛ, hii nɛɛ alã minu lɛ ejaakɛ amɛshã amɛhe afɔle, ni amɛtee amɛyayɛ nu lɛ kɛba. "No hewɔ lɛ David enuuu nu lɛ.
Abishai, Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, ji hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ anukpa. Ekɛ hii ohai etɛ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛ edɛŋ akplɔ gbe fɛɛ, ni ekɛna gbɛi yɛ hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ.
Egbɛi hehe fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ, ni etsɔ amɛnukpa; shi moŋ ekɛ Kakabãi Etɛ̃ lɛ yeee egbɔ.

Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ni jɛ Kabzeel lɛ, hu hii kãkãlɔi lɛ eko ni; ni efee ekãa naa nibii wuji srɔtoi babaoo. Eko ji akɛ egbe Moabbii tabilɔi Kpanakpanai enyɔ komɛi be ko. Be ko hu lɛ ekpleke shi kɛtee ni eyagbe jata yɛ bu ko mli yɛ snoo be mli.

Lɛ nɔŋŋ eku sɛɛ egbe Egiptnyo nyenyereŋŋ ko ni ekwɔlɛ fe mitai enyɔ. Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ akplɔ ni etilɛ tamɔ mamaloo agba tso tilɛ, ni eba koni ekɛ Benaia nɛɛ abanɔ. Benaia hiɛ tso flo ni ekɛyatutua Egiptnyo lɛ; eshɔ̃ akplɔ lɛ ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni ekɛ Egiptnyo lɛ nɔŋŋ akplɔ lɛ gbe lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni Yehoiada bi Benaia fee, ni ekɛna gbɛi yɛ hii Kãkãlɔi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Egbɛi hehe jogbaŋŋ yɛ hii Kãkãlɔi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ; shi moŋ ekɛ Kakabãi Etɛ lɛ yeee egbɔ.
Hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ fãbii ni shwɛɔ lɛ ji Asahel, ni ji Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Elhanan, Dodo bi lɛ ni jɛ Betlehem lɛ,
kɛ Shamot Harornyo lɛ, kɛ Helez, Peletnyo lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Ira, Tekoanyo Ikesh bi lɛ, kɛ Abiezer, Anatotnyo lɛ,
kɛ Sibekai, Hushatnyo lɛ, kɛ Ilai, Ahohinyo lɛ,
kɛ Maharai, Netofatnyo lɛ, kɛ Heled, Netofatnyo Baana lɛ bi lɛ,
kɛ Itai, Ribai ni jɛ Benyaminbii amaŋ Gibea lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Benaia, Piratonnyo lɛ.
Hii kakabãi lɛ fãbii komɛi hu ji Hurai, ni jɛ Gaash fai lɛ anaa lɛ, kɛ Abiel, Arbatnyo lɛ,
Kɛ Azmawet, Baharumnyo lɛ, kɛ Eliaba, Shaalbonnyo lɛ,
kɛ Hashem, Gizonnyo lɛ, kɛ Yonatan, Hararnyo Shage bi lɛ;
Ahiam, Hararnyo Sakar bi lɛ, kɛ Elifal, Ur bi lɛ;
kɛ Hefer, Mekerathnyo lɛ, kɛ Ahia, Pelonnyo lɛ,
Kɛ Hezro, Karmelnyo lɛ, kɛ Naarai, Ezbai bi lɛ.
Mɛi krokomɛi ji Yoel, Natan nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Mibhar, Hagri bi lɛ;
kɛ Zelek, Amonnyo lɛ, kɛ Naharai, Berotnyo lɛ ni hiɛɔ Zeruia bi Yoab tawuu nii lɛ;
kɛ Ira, Itrinyo lɛ kɛ Gareb, Itrinyo lɛ;
kɛ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, kɛ Zabad, Ahlai bi lɛ;
kɛ Adina, Shiza, Rubennyo lɛ bi lɛ ni eji Rubenbii asafoiatsɛ ni ehiɛ tabilɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ.
Hii kakabãi lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ji Hanan, Maaka bi lɛ, kɛ Yoshafat, Mitannyo lɛ,
kɛ Uzia, Ashteratnyo lɛ, kɛ Shama kɛ enyɛmi Yeiel, ni ji Aroernyo Hotam bihii lɛ;
kɛ Yediael kɛ enyɛmi Yoha, Tizinyo Shimri bihii lɛ;
kɛ Eliel, Mahavinyo lɛ, kɛ Yeribai kɛ enyɛmi Yoshavia ni ji Elnaam bihii lɛ, kɛ Itma, Moabnyo lɛ,
kɛ Eliel kɛ Obed kɛ Yaasiel, Mezobanyo lɛ.
12: Be ni David yɔɔ Ziklag he ni eyatee ehe yɛ yɛ Saul, Kish bi lɛ, hewɔ lɛ, hii tabilɔi komɛi tee ni amɛyafata David he. Hii nɛɛ shi tabilɔi kakabãi ni wa David yɛ ta mli lɛ anɔ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ jɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli he ni David hu jɛ lɛ.
Amɛhe esa bɔ ni amɛkɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku fɛɛ tsɛ̃ɔ gãi, ni amɛkɛtswaa aklomia hu.
Amɛnukpai ni kɛ amɛ ba ji Ahiezer, kɛ enyɛmi Yoash, ni ji Shemaa ni jɛ Gibea lɛ bihii lɛ. Mɛi ni shi amɛnɔ lɛ ji Yeziel kɛ Pelet ni ji Azmavetbii; kɛ Beraka kɛ Yehu ni jɛ Anatot;
Kɛ Ishmaia ni jɛ Gibeon, nuu kãkãlɔ kpanaa ni eshi kãkãlɔi Nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛnukpai lɛ eko lɛ, kɛ Yeremia kɛ Yahaziel kɛ Yohanan kɛ Yozabad ni amɛjɛ Gedera lɛ.
Fãbii hu ji Eluzai kɛ Yerimot kɛ Bealia kɛ Shemaria kɛ Shefatia ni jɛ Harof lɛ,
kɛ Elkana kɛ Ishia kɛ Azareel kɛ Yoezer kɛ Yashobeam, Korabii lɛ,
kɛ Yoela kɛ Zebadia Yeroham ni jɛ Gedor lɛ bii lɛ.

Gadbii lɛ ateŋ hii tabilɔi kãkãlɔi komɛi tse amɛhe kɛtee amɛyafata mɛi ni nyiɛ David sɛɛ lɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahe be mli ni David yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Hii nɛɛ ahe esa kɛ tsɛŋ kɛ akplɔ kɛ nɔmɔ, ni amɛhiɛ yɛ kramakrama tamɔ jata hiɛ, ni amɛ he yɛ oya tamɔ gɔ̃ji anɔ soŋai.
Amɛnukpa ni kɛ amɛba ji Ezer; esɛɛmɔ ji Obadia; ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Eliab.
Mɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Mishmana, ni mɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Yeremia;
mɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ ji Atai; mɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ ji Eliel.
Mɔ ni ji Kpaanyɔ lɛ ji Yohanan; mɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ ji Elzabad;
mɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ ji Yeremia; ni mɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ ji Makbanai.
Tabilɔi lɛ amli asafoiatsɛmɛi ji Gadba nɛɛ fɛɛ. Amɛteŋ mɔ ni ji bibioo lɛ enyɛɔ ekɛ mɛi oha kpeɔ; ni mɔ ni ji mɔ wulu lɛ ekɛ mɛi akpe kpeɔ.
Afi lɛ Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, be mli ni Yordan Faa lɛ ni eje ŋa lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fo faa lɛ ni amɛyawo jɔi lɛ amli bii lɛ foi yɛ faa lɛ bakãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Asaŋ Benyaminbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi krokomɛi hu ba David ŋɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.

Ni David je kpo kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji hejɔlɛ nyiɛmɔ nyɛyiɛ kɛba koni nyɛbaye nyɛbua mi lɛ, no lɛ miyɛ he tsui akɛ mi kɛ nyɛ aaafee ekome. Shi kɛji nyɛba koni nyɛbatsɛɔɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ, akɛni miyeko mɔ ko sane fɔŋ ko lɛ, wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaye misane lɛ eha mi."

Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ ba mɛi ni ba lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɔ. Egbɛi ji Amasai, mɔ ni fee sɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ. Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Bo onii ji wɔ, David, ni ogbɛfaŋ wɔyɔɔ, Yeshai bi. Omanye! Hɛɛ, omanye aaabla bo; ni obualɔi lɛ anɔ̃ ji omanye Ejaakɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa bo!" David here amɛ atuu, ni ewo amɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi yɛ etabilɔi lɛ anɔ.

Manasebii lɛ ateŋ hii tabilɔi komɛi tse amɛhe ni amɛbafata David he, be ni David kɛ Filistibii lɛ yaa koni amɛkɛ Saul ayawu lɛ. Moŋ David naaa ewa Filistibii lɛ ta nɛɛ wuu, ejaakɛ Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ tee ajina, ni amɛwo David gbɛ akɛ eku esɛɛ kɛya Ziklag ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Kɛji wɔleee feemɔ lɛ ekɛ wɔyitsei baaya ekɛyakpãtã enuŋtsɔ Saul."

Manase hii lɛ ni bafata David he be ni eku esɛɛ kɛyaa Ziklag lɛ ji Adna kɛ Yosabad kɛ Yediael kɛ Mikael kɛ Yozabad kɛ Elihu kɛ Ziletai. Tabilɔi akpe kuikui asafoiatsɛmɛi ji amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ Manasebii ateŋ.
Amɛye amɛbua David ni ekɛ ojoyelɔi aku lɛ wu. Hii kãkãlɔi saŋŋ ji amɛ, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ awo amɛ tatsɛmɛi.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ mɛi baa amɛbafataa David he. Kɛkɛ ni David bana ta kpeteŋkple ni anyɛɛɛ akane.
Be ni David yɔɔ Hebron lɛ, tabilɔi fɛɛ ni bafata he koni, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo shi eto lɛ, atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ aŋɔ Saul maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã David lɛ ayikulɛ nɛ yɛ akutsei anaa:
Yudabii ateŋ lɛ akpei ekpaa kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ amɛtsɛŋi kɛ akplɔi.
Simeonbii ateŋ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi akpei kpawo kɛ oha,
Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ hii akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Yehoiada, ni ji Aaron we lɛ lumɔ lɛ, kɛ hii akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai kpawo ba;
ni Zadok, oblanyo kãkãlɔ ko kɛ etsɛ we asafoiatsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ ba.
Benyaminbii, ni ji saul nyɛmimɛi, ni bafata David he ji hii akpei etɛ, ejaakɛ Benyaminbii lɛ tsiimɔ yɛ Saul sɛɛ.
Efraimbii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ, amɛba lɛ kuikui yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei anaa.
Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kɛ Kpaanyɔ ni aje gbɛ awo amɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛba ni amɛbawo David Matsɛ.
Isakarbii akutso lɛ mli onukpai ohai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishibii; onukpai nɛɛ ji mɛi ni le nii ni sa akɛ Israel afee, kɛ beyinɔ hu ni sa akɛ efee.
Zebulonbii afalɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni le tawuu jogbaŋŋ, asaŋ amɛle nibii srɔtoi kɛ tawuu hu.
Naftalibii lɛ fee asafoiatsɛmɛi tabilɔi onukpai akpe, kɛ amɛshishibii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo ni hiɛ tsɛŋi kɛ akplɔi.
Danbii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa ni emia hã ta.
Asherbii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni ewula hã ta.
Akutsei lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni ji Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ, ni bafata David he lɛ fee hii akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni le tawuu nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ hiɛmɔ kɛ tawuu.
Tabilɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ emia hã ta, ni amɛto kɛba Hebron kɛ yiŋtoo Kome koni amɛbawo David Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.
Amɛye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ David ŋɔɔ: ni amɛyeyee nii, ni amɛnunuu dãa, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ esra amɛsɛɛ.

Israelbii lɛ ananemɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛ bɛŋkɛ bake amɛ nii. Ni ajɛ aahuu ajɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ aba kɛ tejii kɛ yomai kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi kɛ tsinai ni akɛ niyenii srɔtoi etre amɛ: Mã kɛ agbami kɛ wain kɛ mu. Amɛbake tsinai kɛ toi hu, ni agbe ni aye. Amɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ejaakɛ miishɛɛ eba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
13: Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ tabilɔi akpe akuikui anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi oha kui anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ tee ajina.

No sɛɛ lɛ David kɛɛ Israel gwabɔɔ muu lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji esa nyɛhiɛ, ni Yehowa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ suɔmɔ naa ni lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhãa wɔtsua kɛya wɔnyɛmimɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔji lɛ anɔ he fɛɛ he lɛ aŋɔɔ, kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii ni kɛ amɛyɔɔ yɛ amɛmaji kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ hu aŋɔɔ, akɛ: amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛbashi wɔnɔ,
koni wɔya wɔyawo wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ni Saul yinɔ lɛ wɔshi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ."
Gwabɔɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ kplɛ̃ nɔ akɛ afee nakai ejaakɛ sane lɛ sa amɛhiɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ David bua Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛbakpe, kɛjɛ Egipt husu lɛ naa, yɛ wuoyigbɛ, aahuu kɛyashwie he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa Lebo-Hamat lɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ, koni ayawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Kiriat-Yearim kɛya Yerusalem.

Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Baala maŋ lɛ mli ni ji Kiriat-Yearim, yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ni akɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni elumɔyeli sɛ̃i lɛ ma kerubii lɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi kɛba.
Amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Abinadab we lɛ, ni amɛkɛma shwiili hee ko nɔ, ni Uza kɛ Ahio ji mɛi ni kudɔ shwiili nɛɛ.
Ni David kɛ Israel muu fɛɛ nya kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛ lalai kɛ saŋkui kɛ bɛji kɛ miji kɛ ŋmɛji kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi amɛkɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Be ni amɛshɛ Kidon ŋmããgbeemɔhe lɛ, tsinai lɛ tɛ ni eha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kpa kɛyaagbee shi. No hewɔ lɛ Uza kpã enine mli ni emɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.
Yehowa mli fu Uza akɛ ekpã enine mli emɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli, ni Yehowa tswa Uza nɔ, ni egbo yɛ enajiaŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi.
Sane lɛ dɔ David akɛ Yehowa kɛ Uza ye kɛ joomɔ nakai. Atsɔ he ni sane lɛ ba yɛ lɛ akɛ Perez-Uza kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
David she Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Te mafee teŋŋ mato Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hu?"
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ David hãaa akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ aya Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli;shi moŋ eha awo Adeka lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ afã kɛtee Obed-Edom, Gitnyo lɛ, we lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hi Obed-Edom bii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ eshia lɛ mli nyɔji etɛ̃; ni Yehoea jɔɔ obed-Edom we lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ ni ni eyɔɔ.
14: Maŋtsɛ Hiram, Tiro maŋtsɛ, wo kapintafoi kɛ gbogbotswalɔi gbɛ, ni amɛkɛ tsenedurtsei ba koni amɛbama maŋtsɛ we amɛhã David.
Enɛ hã David na akɛ Yehowa ehã ehe shi akɛ Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, ni asaŋ Yehowa ewo emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ gojoo yɛ Yehowa maŋ Israel.
David ŋɔɔŋɔɔ yei heei efata eŋã mɛi lɛ ahe yɛ Yerusalem, ni David fɔ bihii kɛ biyei efata ebii lɛ ahe.
Bii ni David fɔ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ ji Shamua kɛ Shobab kɛ Natan kɛ Solomon;
kɛ Ibhar kɛ Elishua kɛ Elpelet.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Noga kɛ Nefag kɛ Yafia,
kɛ Elishama kɛ Beeliada kɛ Elifelet.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu akɛ afɔ David mu awo lɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛfã ta kɛba akɛ amɛmiiba amɛbatua David. Be ni David nu lɛ, efã ni ekɛ Filistibii lɛ yakpe.
Filistibii lɛ baye ofɔ̃ yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni David tee ni eyabi Nyɔŋmɔ nii akɛ, "Mifã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ lo? Ooohã maye amɛnɔ kunim lo?" Yehowa here David nɔ akɛ, "Fãa ta lɛ kɛyanina amɛ, ni mahã oye amɛnɔ kunim."

No hewɔ lɛ David fã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ yɛ Baal-Perazim, ni eye amɛnɔ Kunim yɛ jɛi. Ni David kɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa etsɔ̃ minine nɔ egba kɛtsɔ̃ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ tamɔ nu ni eyi kɛsram nɔ. "No hewɔ lɛ atsɛ jɛi akɛ Baal-Petrazim.
Filistibii lɛ shi amɛmãgãi lɛ yɛ jɛi ni amɛjo foi, ni David fã, ni ashã amãgãi lɛ.
Shi Filistibii lɛ fã ta kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
David bi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ekoŋŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaafã ta kɛyatua amɛ kɛjɛ biɛ; shi moŋ lɔgɔmɔ amɛ kɛyaje amɛsɛɛgbɛ koni ojɛ Balsam tsei lɛ aŋlɛnɔ obatua amɛ.
Kɛ onu gbɛɛmɔ yɛ Balsam tsei lɛ ayiteŋ tamɔ naneshigbɛɛmɔ pɛ koni ofã kɛyashwie amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eyi ohiɛ kɛmiiya ayatswia Filistibii ata lɛ nii."
David fee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Gibeon aahuu kɛyashwie Gezer.
Ni David gbɛi hehe kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ; ni Yehowa hã David he ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ.
15: David mamɔ tsui yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli ehã ehe, asaŋ esaa he ko hu, ni eshi buui yɛ jɛi ehã Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ akɛ, "Levibii lɛ pɛ ji mɛi ni baatere Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ejaakɛ amɛji mɛi pɛ ni Yehowa ŋɔ̃ akɛ amɛ amɛta Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he, asaŋ akɛ amɛsɔmɔ lɛ kɛya naanɔ."
David Kpee Israelbii fɛɛ, ni amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalem koni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba he ni asaa ato lɛ lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David Kpee Aaron bii lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu kɛba.
Uriel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi ni ji Kohatbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba.
Asaia nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Meraribii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba;
Yoel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Gershonbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ahiɛ kɛba;
Shemaia nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Elizafanbii ohai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba;
Eliel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Hebronbii nyɔŋmai Kpaanyɔ ahiɛ kɛba;
ni Aminadab nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Uzielbii oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ Osɔfo Abiatar kɛ Levibii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi ekpaa lɛ, ni ji Uriel kɛ Asaia kɛ Yoel kɛ Shemaia kɛ Eliel kɛ Aminadab,

ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ nyɛji Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ashīai lɛ amli onukpai, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛtsuua nyɛhe nyɛfea nyɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ koni nyɛyawo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba he ni misaa mito lɛ lɛ.
Akɛni tsutsu lɛ jeee nyɛ nyɛtre Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni jeee nakai ji ehe gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ, Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli fu wɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tsuu amɛhe amɛfee amɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛyawo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Levibii lɛ kɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ wo adeka lɛ amɛtswa amɛkɔŋ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo kitã yɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ.
David fã Levibii lɛ anukpai lɛ akɛ amɛhala amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ atɛŋ jooshwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi koni amɛla, kɛ mɛi komɛi hu koni amɛkɛ obentai kɛ saŋkui kɛ ŋmɛji ashwɛ joo kɛwo nifeemɔ lɛ he sɔlɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Levibii lɛ famɔ Heman, Yoel bi lɛ, kɛ ewekunyo Asaf, Berekia bi lɛ, kɛ Etan, Kushaia bi lɛ hu yɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ;

ni amɛfamɔ amɛyɛmimɛi Levibii nɛɛ hu koni amɛwa amɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Zakaria kɛ Yaaziel kɛ Shemiramot kɛ Yehiel kɛ Uri kɛ Eliab kɛ Benaia, kɛ Maaseia kɛ Matitia kɛ Elifelehu kɛ Mikneia kɛ agbonaabulɔi Obed-Edom kɛ Yeiel.
Afamɔ Heman kɛ Asaf kɛ Etan lalawolɔi lɛ akɛ amɛ amɛtswa akɔɔble ŋmɛji,
ni Zakaria kɛ Aziel kɛ Shemiramot kɛ Yehiel kɛ Uni kɛ Eliab kɛ Maaseia kɛ Benaia atswa obentai kɛ amɛgbee ŋɛ̃lɛŋɛ̃lɛ;
ni Mititia kɛ Elifelehu kɛ Mikneia kɛ Obed-Edom kɛ Yeiel kɛ Azazia atswa saŋkui kɛ amɛgbee wulu lɛ.
Aŋɔ kenania ni lɛji Levibii lɛ anukpa yɛ lala gbɛfaŋ lɛ akɛ ekwɛ joobilɔi lɛ kɛ lala lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ ele no mli fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ;
ni afãmɔ Berekia kɛ Elkana akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hebulɔi.

Ahala Shebania kɛ Yoshafat kɛ Netanel kɛ Amasai kɛ Zakaria kɛ Benaia kɛ Eliezer, ni ji osɔfoi lɛ, koni amɛkpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ kɛnyiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ. Aha Obed-Edom kɛ Yehia hu fata Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hebulɔi lɛ ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kɛ tabilɔi akpe kuikui anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee koni amɛyawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛba kɛ nyamɔ.
Ni akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ye bua Levibii ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ lɛ, agbe tsina hii kpawo akɛshã afɔle.
David wo klala kpakpa atade, ni no eko atade nɔŋŋ Levibii ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ joobilɔi lɛ, kɛ Kenaia, ni ji joobilɔi lɛ atsɛ lɛ, hu wowoo. David wo klala tsitsinɔhaanii hu.
Israel muu fɛɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba Yerusalem be mli ni aabɔ oshe hoo ni aakpã koŋ bɛji kɛ tɛtrɛmatrɛ, ni aatswia ŋmɛji kɛ saŋkui hu waa diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.
Be ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ shɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Mikal, ni ji Saul biyoo lɛ, yabu samflɛ naa; ni be ni ena David ni miijo, ni eehuru lɛ David he fee lɛ hiɛgble.
16: Akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bama buu lɛ ni David eshi ehã adeka lɛ mli, ni ashã shãa afɔlei ahã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Be ni David eshã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ egbe naa lɛ, etsɛ Yehowa gbɛi ni ekɛjɔ Maŋbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni eja Iraelbii lɛ fɛɛ nii. Eha nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ loo kukuli kome kɛ wainyibii ni aka ni egbi.
David famɔ Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi koni amɛla kɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛjie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ yi koni amɛda lɛ shi ni amɛkɛkafo lɛ.

Asaf ji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anukpa, ni esɛɛmɔ ji Zakaria. Yeiel kɛ Shemiramot kɛ Yehiel kɛ Matitia kɛ Eliab kɛ Benaia kɛ Obed-Edom kɛ Yeiel baatswa saŋkui kɛ obentai lɛ, ni Asaf baatswa ŋmlɛ kɛ egbee ŋɛ̃lɛŋɛ̃lɛ lɛ.
Amɛteŋ osɔfoi enyɔ, ni ji Benaia kɛ Yahaziel, lɛ baakpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ daa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
Belɛ gbi nɛɛ ji Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi ni David kɛ hegbɛ lɛ hã Asaf kɛ enyɛmimɛi Levibii nɛɛ akɛ amɛla kɛkafo Yehowa.
Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi! Nyɛshiɛa egbojee; nyɛhãa maji lɛ alea nibii ni etsu lɛ!
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa lɛ; nyɛlaa kɛkafoa lɛ; nyɛgbaa enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ!
Nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃a egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ; mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ atsui anyɔ amɛmli!
Nyɛyabia Yehowa dɛŋ wamɔ; nyɛyaa ehiɛ nyɛyajaa lɛ daa!
Nyɛkaia naakpɛɛnii ni etsu lɛ; naakpɛɛnii ni efee kɛ mlai ni ewoo lɛ.
Nyɛ etsulɔ Yakob shwiei, nyɛ, Israel shwiei, ni ji mɛi ni eŋɔ,
Naa, lɛji Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; emlai lɛ yɛ hã jeŋ fɛɛ.
Nyɛhiɛ ahia enaanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wiemɔi ni ekɛwo yinɔi akpe shi lɛ anɔ,
ni ji kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kpãŋ lɛ; kɛ kitã lɛ hu ni ekã Isak lɛ,
ni ema nɔ aduatsɔ ehã Yakob akɛ akpɔ, kɛ Israel hu akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ,
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Bo maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã akɛ ogbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ gboshinii."
Be mli ni amɛyi faaa kwraa, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko mli gbɔi
ni miitsomlo kɛjɛ maŋ nɔ kɛmiya maŋ nɔ, kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ kome nɔyeli mli kɛmiiya nɔyeli kroko mli lɛ,
eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni efee amɛ niseniianii; ebɔ maŋtsɛmɛi kɔkɔ yɛ amɛhe,
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkataa mɛi ni mifɔ amɛ mu lɛ ahe, nyɛkafea migbalɔi lɛ nɔ ko."
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ! Nyɛshiɛa edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ daa gbi.
Nyɛgbaa enumnyam lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ kɛ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a mɛi fɛɛ kwa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ kpeteŋkple ni esa gbeyeishemɔ fe nyɔŋmɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amãgãi ni; shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ebɔ ŋwɛi.
Woo kɛ agbojee ebɔlɛ ehe kɛkpe, ni hewalɛ kɛ miishɛɛ eyi eshihilɛhe lɛ mli.
Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, nyɛ akutsei fɛɛ; nyɛkafoa enumnyam kɛ ehewalɛ.
Nyɛŋɔa anumnyam ni sa egbɛi lɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛkɛ afɔle abaa; ni nyɛbaa ewe lɛ mli. Nyɛkotoa Yehowa kɛ nyɛjamɔ atadei.
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he akpokpo yɛ ehiɛ. Je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni ehiŋ lɛ tsimɔ.
Ŋwɛi anya, ni shikpɔŋ mli afi lɛ; ni agba jeŋ maji lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ!"
Ŋshɔ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ ahuu, ni ŋã kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ emli abɔ oshe!
Kooŋ tsei aala kɛ nyamɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, be mli ni ebaa ebaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi ejaakɛ ehi; ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Asaŋ nyɛkɛa akɛ, "Heremɔ wɔ, Ao wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Herelɔ, ni obua wɔnaa, ni ohere wɔ yɛ jeŋ maji lɛ adɛŋ, koni wɔda bo shi ni wɔkafo ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni wɔshwã wɔfɔ̃ onɔ.
Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ!" Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Amen!" Ni amɛjie Yehowa yi.
Kɛkɛ ni David shi Asaf kɛ enyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ yɛ he ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ni amɛkwɛ jamɔ ni ajaa yɛ he ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nɔ daa, bɔ ni gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ jamɔ heɔ.
Asaŋ eshi Obed-Edom, Yedutun bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi Gatbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ koni amɛwa sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni ji Levibii lɛ. Obed-Edom kɛ Hosa lɛ afee amɛ shinaanaakwɛlɔi.
David fã Osɔfo Zadok kɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ, ni ekɛ jamɔ ni ayajaa Yehowa yɛ jamɔhe ni yɔɔ Gibeon lɛ wo amɛdɛŋ,
koni amɛshã shãa afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ, bɔ ni mla ni Yehowa ewo Israel lɛ kɛɔ lɛ.
Mɛi ni ahala afata amɛhe ji Heman kɛ Yedutun kɛ mɛi krokomɛi hu ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ akɛ amɛla kɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ hi tsakeee kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ hewɔ.

Heman kɛ Yedutun ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ tɛtrɛmantrɛi kɛ ŋmɛji kɛ amɛgbee ŋɛ̃lɛŋɛ̃lɛ lɛ kɛ jooshwɛmɔ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni akɛ shwɛɔ joo kɛji aala yijiemɔ lala krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Ni Yedutun bii lɛ ji mɛi ni afee amɛ agbonaabulɔi.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ gblɛ mli, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshīa. Kɛkɛ ni David hu tee ewe eyanina eŋãmɛi kɛ ebii lɛ.
17: Maŋtsɛ David tsu atsɛ gbalɔ Natan ahã lɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ Natan akɛ, "Bɛ oona, mi lɛ mina tseneduru tso tsu mli mikã be mli ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ moŋ yɛ buu mli."
Ntan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Feemɔ nɔ ni kã otsui nɔ akɛ ofee lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ fi osɛɛ."
shi nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Natan akɛ,
"Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ, 'Yehowa kɛɛ, jeee bo obaama tsu ohã mi koni mahi mli.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni miyakpla Israel kɛjɛ Egipt kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mihiko tsu mli dã, fe akɛ buui amli mihi kɛjɛ he kome kɛtee he kroko.
Hei fɛɛ ni mi kɛ Israel fɛɛ enyiɛ lɛ, mibiko Israel maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi ni mifã amɛ akɛ amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ he ko he ko pɛŋ akɛ, mɛɛba ni nyɛmako tseneduru tsu nyɛhako mi?"
"No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ mitsulɔ David akɛ, mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Mi miŋɔ bo yɛ toi asɛɛ yɛ ŋanɔ, ni mifee bo mimaŋ Israel nɔyelɔ,
ni he fɛɛ he ni otee lɛ mifata ohe, ni miplenee ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni mihã ona gbɛi kpeteŋkple tamɔ gbɔmɛi wuji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ mito he ko mihã mimaŋ Israel koni amɛyahi jɛi akɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ mli, he ni agbaŋ amɛnaa yɛ dɔŋŋ, ni basabasa gbɔmɛi haoŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ tamɔ sa lɛ,
be mli ni mito hiɛnyiɛlɔi koni amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ. Mahã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe ajɔ, ni asaŋ miiwo bo shi akɛ mibahã oshwiei ahe shi.
Ogbele sɛɛ lɛ matee mɔ ni jɛ omli shi akɛ maŋtsɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛyeli ama shi.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni baama tsu ehã mi lɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ama shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.
Mibatsɔ̃ etsɛ, ni lɛ hu ebaatsɔ̃ mibi. Mifoŋ suɔmɔ ni mikɛbaasumɔ lɛ sɛɛ tamɔ mifo misuɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Saul, mɔ ni mikpa lɛ ni oba oyeɔ esɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Shi mahã ekura mimaŋ Israel, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ baama shi shiŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.'"
Natan kɛɛ David nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ba yɛ ninaa lɛ mli lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ David tee Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni eyata shi ni esɔle ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, namɔ ji mi, ni mɛni po mli miwe yɔɔ hewɔ ni okura mi kɛbashi benɛ nɛɛ?
Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ jeee nɔ srɔto ko hã bo, Nyɔŋmɔ. Otsɔ̃ɔ wɔsɛɛ shɔŋŋ hu nibii ni baaba miwe lɛ nɔ, Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ; ni oobu mi tamɔ gbɔmɔ wulu ko.
Mɛni dɔŋŋ po yɔɔ minaa ni makɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ nyam ni owo nɛɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ole mi, otsulɔ momo.
Yehowa, gbɔmɔ he ni odɔɔ, kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ osuɔmɔ naa ofee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ koni ohã male nibii wuji ni oto ohã mi.
Yehowa, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni wɔnu naa lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ bo yeɔ egbɔ, ni asaŋ osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni ji nyɔŋmɔ ko.
Mɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ kɛ omaŋ Israel ye egbɔ akɛ maŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, oyakpɔ̃ yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli yɛ Egipt ni ofee lɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ koni okɛ nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni otsu ohã amɛ lɛ ahe gbɛi?
Ofee Israel bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni bo, Yehowa, otsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ.
"No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, Yehowa, hã shi ni owo yɛ mi, otsulɔ kɛ miwe lɛ, he lɛ aba mli bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ shishiishi kɛya naanɔ;
ni ogbɛi lɛ aaada kpeteŋkple, ni aaakɛɛ kɛya naanɔ akɛ, 'Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. 'Ni ooohã miwe lɛ ahe shi shiŋŋ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mi otsulɔ, toi nɔ ni owo akɛ obaahã ewe lɛ atsɔ̃ maŋtsɛmɛi awe lɛ, no hewɔ ni mina ekãa kɛsɔleɔ nɛkɛ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
Yehowa,bɔ nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni okɛ nɛkɛ nɔ kpakpa nɛɛ ewo mi shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, ofai nɛ, ni ojɔɔ mishwiei koni amɛsane asa ohiɛ kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni bo, Yehowa, ojɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ."
18: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David kɛ Filistibii lɛ wu, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eshɔ̃ Gat maŋ lɛ kɛ akrowai ni bɔle lɛ lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.
No sɛɛ lɛ David ye Moabbii lɛ hu anɔ kunim, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ etsuji, ni amɛtsuɔ onia amɛbahãa lɛ.
Asaŋ David fã ta ewo Siria Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer hu, ni eye enɔ kunim kɛyashwie Hamat tɔ̃ɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer nɛɛ fã kɛtee akɛ eyaaŋɔ Eufrate faa lɛ he shikpɔj lɛ ekɛwo eshishi.

David shɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tayaa shwiili akpe, ni emɔmɔ tabilɔi okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpei kpawo kɛ nanenɔyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ. David flɔ shwiili naa okpɔŋɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaji asɛɛ fãi; shi eshi amɛteŋ bɔ ni baahia ahã shwiili oha.
Kɛkɛ ni Siriabii ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ fã kɛba koni amɛbawa Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer yɛ ta lɛ mli, shi David gbe Siriabii lɛ ateŋ gbɔmɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David jra asraafoi kuikui eto Siriabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Damasko, ni Siriabii lɛ tsɔ̃ David tsuji, ni amɛtsuɔ onia amɛbahãa David. Yehowa hã David ye kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃.
David shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ shika tsɛŋi ni Hadadezer tsuji lɛ hiɛhiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba Yerusalem.

David loo akɔɔble babaoo hu diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Tibehat kɛ Kun, ni ji maji ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ, ekɛtee. Solomon kɛ akɔɔble nɛɛ fee Sɔlemɔwe nutoo gbudugbaŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii krokomɛi.
Be ni Hamat Maŋtsɛ Tou nu akɛ David eye Hadadezer ta tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim lɛ,

etsu ebinuu Yoram lɛ Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ koni ebaŋa lɛ, ni ehã lɛ aekoo ehã lɛ, yɛ Hadadezer nɔ kunim ni eye lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer kɛ Tou kɛ amɛhe ewuwuu tai saŋŋ. Yoram hiɛ shika nibii kɛ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ akɔɔble nibii srɔtoi babaoo kɛba ekɛbake maŋtsɛ David.
Maŋtsɛ David jɔɔ nibii nɛɛ anɔ eke Yehowa, ni ekɛfata jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni eloo momo sa yɛ majimaji fɛɛ ni eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ amli kɛba lɛ he. Maji nɛɛ ji Edom kɛ Moad kɛ Amon kɛ Filstia kɛ Amalek.
Abishai ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, gbe Edombii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Nii nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abishai jra asraafoi kuikui eto Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Edombii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ David tsuji. He fɛɛ he ni David tsɔ̃ lɛ Yehowa hã eye kunim.
David ye Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni eye jalɛ sane ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, ji etatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ; ni Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ tuuŋtu woloŋmãlɔ;
ni Zodok, Ahitub bi lɛ, kɛ Ahimelek, Abiatar bi lɛ, amɛji osɔfoi; ni Shawesha ji woloŋmãlɔ.
Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ji tabilɔi ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ David he kpaakpa lɛ atsɛ, ni David bihii lɛ ji maŋtsɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ateŋ onukpai.
19: Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ Nahash gbo, ni ebinuu baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David to eyiŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mibajie mlihilɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ Nahash bi Hanum, ejaakɛ etsɛ mli hi hã mi. "No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ David tsu tsuji kɛtee akɛ amɛyahã Hanum kpoo amɛhã lɛ yɛ etsɛ gbele lɛ hewɔ. Be ni David tsuji lɛ tee Hanum ŋɔɔ yɛ Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyahã lɛ kpoo lɛ,

Amonbii lɛ alumɛi lɛ kɛɛ Hanum akɛ, "Naa, tsumɔ ni David etsu kɛba akɛ abahã bo kpoo nɛɛ lɛ kaasusu akɛ ekɛmiiwo otsɛ hiɛ nyam. Maŋ lɛ sramɔ kɛ eshikpamɔ moŋ hewɔ ni David ewo etsuji gbɛ kɛba nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enyɛ maŋ lɛ ebaŋɔ."
Enɛ hã Hanum mɔmɔ David tsuji lɛ, ni eshɛshɛɛ amɛtsɛŋi fãfãafai eshwie, ni no sɛɛ lɛ eflɔ amɛtadei lɛ anɔ yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu kɛbata amɛdukui anɔ, kɛkɛ ni ejie bɔfoi lɛ gbɛ ni amɛtee.
Be ni abagba David bɔ ni afee etsuji lɛ, etsu ni akɛ tsuji lɛ yakpe yɛ gbɛteŋ ejaakɛ abɔ amɛ ahora fe nine. Ekɛ shɛɛ maje yahã amɛ akɛ amɛwa Yeriko kɛyashi amɛtsɛŋi lɛ aaatsa dani amɛba shiã.

Hanum kɛ Amonbii lɛ na akɛ amɛyatsi David sɛ̃, no hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai akpe tsu akɛtee ayabɔ tayaa shwiili kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi apaa yɛ Mesopotamia Kooyi kɛ Maaka kɛ Zoba yɛ Siriabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛbawa amɛ.

Shwiilii akprei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛ Maaka maŋtsɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ, mɛi apaa ni ayabɔ lɛ ba, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Madeba maŋ lɛ hiɛ. Amonbii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu bua amɛhe naa kɛjɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli amɛ hu amɛbagba ta.
Be ni David nu lɛ ewo Yoab kɛ hii kãkãlɔi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ kɛtee.
Amonbii lɛ je kpo ni amɛbagba ta yɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Shi maŋtsɛmɛi ni ba Amonbii lɛ awamɔ lɛ sɔŋŋ tse amɛha, ni amɛgba amɛta lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yoab na akɛ agba ta awo lɛ yɛ esɛɛ kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ehala Israel tabilɔi kakalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ko mɛi, ni ehã amɛgba ta koni amɛkɛ Siriabii lɛ akpe.
Etabilɔi ni shwɛ lɛ, etu amɛ fɛɛ ewo enyɛmi Abishai shishi. Amɛ lɛ, amɛgba ta lɛ koni amɛkɛ Amonbii lɛ akpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛɛ Abishai akɛ, "Kɛji ona akɛ Siriabii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ minɔ lɛ, ni obaye obua mi; mi hu kɛji mina akɛ Amonbii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ mibaba mibaye mabua bo.
Feemɔ ekãa, ni ohã wɔfee hii yɛ wɔmaŋbii kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ maji lɛ ahewɔ, ni Yehowa aaahã nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ aba mli."
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi ni yɔɔ eshishi lɛ tsɛ kɛyanina Siribii lɛ; shi Siribii lɛ jo foi.
Be ni Amonbii lɛ na akɛ Siriabii lɛ ejo foi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛjo Abihai naa foi ni amɛyabote amɛmaŋ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ku esɛɛ bi eba Yerusalem.
Be ni Siriabii lɛ na akɛ Israelbii lɛ eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, amɛtsu bɔfoi ni ayaŋɔ Siriabii ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛba. Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tatsɛ Shofak nyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛba.
Abagba David, ni no hewɔ lɛ ebua Israel tabilɔi fɛɛ anaa kɛkɛ ni ekɛ amɛ fo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛbanina Siriabii lɛ, ni egba ta ewo amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni abɔ̃i wuu.
Shi Siriabii lɛ joo foi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ. David gbe Siriabii shwiilitsɛmɛi akpei kpawo kɛ tabilɔi nanenɔyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, kɛ amɛtatsɛ Shofak hu.
Be ni maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ na akɛ Israel eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, amɛ kɛ David bakpãtã, ni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ. Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛyaaa amɛyayeee amɛbuaaa Amonbii lɛ dɔŋŋ.
20: Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ afi, be mli ni maŋtsɛmɛi fãa ta lɛ, Yoab ŋɔ Israel ta lɛ ni efã ta ewo Amonbii lɛ, ni ekpãtã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ. Shi Maŋtsɛ David hi shi yɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yerusalem. Yoab yagba ta kɛbɔle Raba maŋ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etua maŋ lɛ, ni eye maŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.

maŋtsɛ shika fai ko yɛ ni akɛbuɔ Amonbii anyɔŋmɔ Molek lɛ shiu lɛ yitso. Maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ tsiimɔ ji shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome, ni ojrawatɛ ko yɛ maŋtsɛ fai lɛ he. David jie ojrawatɛ nɛɛ ni ekɛwo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛ fai lɛ he. No sɛɛ lɛ David loo Raba maŋ lɛ nibii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛtee.
Asaŋ ekpla maŋbii lɛ kɛtee, ni ehã amɛ nitsumɔ ni amɛtsu amɛhã lɛ kɛ saalai kɛ kɔi kɛ lema lɛ. Bɔ ni David fee Amonbii amaji lɛ fɛɛ nɛ. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem.

Fee sɛɛ lɛ ta te shi ekoŋŋ yɛ Gezer yɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ. Sibekai, Hushanyo lɛ, gbe Sipai ni ji hii oblaŋi gojogojoi lɛ ashwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome yɛ ta nɛɛ mli, ni ekɛjɔɔ Filistibii lɛ ahe.
Ta te shi ekoŋŋ yɛ Irsraelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ; ni Elhanan, ni ji Yair bi lɛ, gbe Lahemi ni enyɛmi ji Goliat, Gatnyo lɛ ni ekplɔ tso tilɛ tamɔ mamalolɔ agba tso tilɛ lɛ.
Awu ta ekoŋŋ yɛ Gat. Nuu nyenyereŋŋ ko kɛ ewaabii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ, enine waobii ekpaaekpaa kɛ enane waobii hu ekpaaekpaa, ba ta lɛ. Hii oblaŋi gojogojoi lɛ ashwiei lɛ eko ji lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tswa Israelbii lɛ mpoa. Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan, ni ji David nyɛmi Shimea bi lɛ, tswa nuu lɛ nɔ ni egbe lɛ.
Hii oblaŋi gojogojoi ni hi shi yɛ Gat lɛ ashwiei ji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ni amɛyɔnyɔɔ yɛ David kɛ etsuji lɛ anine naa.
21: Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ, satan te shi ewo Israel, ni ewo David yiŋ akɛ ekane Israel yikulɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Yoab kɛ Tabilɔinukpai lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa nyɛyakanea Israel maŋ muu fɛɛ, kɛjɛa Beersheaba kɛyashia Dan nyɛhãa mi, ni nyɛbakɛa mi koni male maŋbii lɛ ayikulɛ."

Shi Yoab kɛɛ David akɛ, "Yehowa ahã bɔ ni maŋ lɛ yifalɛ yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ aku abɔ he toi ohã! Shi minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, kwɛ jeee mikɛɛ bekɛ otsuji ji amɛ fɛɛ? Mɛɛba mɔ ni minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, kwɛ jeee mikɛɛ bekɛ otsuji amɛ fɛɛ? Mɛɛba mɔ ni minuŋtsɔ taoɔ akɛ afee nɛkɛ nɔ ko ni baahã Israel fɛɛ atɔ̃ nɛɛ?"
Shi Maŋtsɛ David eŋɔɔɔ nɔ ehãaa Yoab. No hewɔ lɛ Yoab yiŋ etee, ni eyakpa Israel fɛɛ, ni eku esɛɛ eba Yerusalem,
ni ekɛ maŋbii lɛ ayibɔ lɛ bahã David. Ana hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpe toi akpe kɛ akpei oha yɛ Israel; ni ana hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ Yuda.
Shi Yoab kaneee Levibii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ eshiii nɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David ehã afee lɛ eŋɔɔɔ enaa.
Nɔ ni afee lɛ eŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ naa, ni no hewɔ lɛ egbla Israel toi.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Mitɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ kple kɛ nii nɛɛ ni mifee lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ miikpa bo fai ni okɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa mi, ejaakɛ miye kwashiai asane naakpa."
Yehowa kɛɛ Gad ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ David he lɛ akɛ,
"Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛ nibii etɛ̃ miishwiei ehiɛ; ekɔ amɛmli ekome, ni mafee mahã lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Gad ba David ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Okɔ amɛmli nɔ ni osumɔɔ:

Kɛji hɔmɔ afii etɛ ni jio, loo akɛ ohe nyɛlɔi baanyiɛ osɛɛ, ni obaajo amɛnaa foi nyɔji etɛ̃ ni jio, loo akɛ Yehowa baawo etsi ni jio, loo akɛ Yehowa baawo etsi nɔ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ Israel nɔ, ni ehã gbele hela aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii etɛ̃ koni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ akpãtã mɛi ahiɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni jio. No hewɔ lɛ feemɔ oyiŋ, ni ohã mi hetoo mikɛyahã mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ."
David to eha Gad akɛ, "Sane lɛ wa hã mi naakpa. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ misumɔŋ ni mayaje gbɔmɔ adesã dɛŋ. Miyɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ emɔbɔnalɛ fa."
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã gbele hela ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Israelbii ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo gboi.

Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo kɛba koni ebafite Yerusalem. Shi be ni bɔfo lɛ baabɔ̃i nifitemɔ lɛ, Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ efɔŋ ni abaafe maŋ lɛ hewɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ bɔfo ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ akɛ, "Efa, agbɛnɛ suu onine. "Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ Ornan, Yebusbyo lɛ, ŋmããgbeemɔhe lɛ masɛi.
David yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ naa Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ, ni klaŋte hiɛ edɛŋ, ni ekpã enine mli yɛ Yersalem nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ maŋ onukpai ni ekɛ amɛ bumɔ kpekpe lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ bu shi.

Ni david kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Ataa, mi mifã akɛ ayakane maŋbii lɛ. Miji mɔ ni etɔ̃ ni efee efɔŋ naakpa lɛ, shi jeee maŋbii nɛɛ; amɛleee he eko, ni amɛhe bɛ mli. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ toigblamɔ lɛ kɛgbla mi kɛ mitsɛwe lɛ toi koni omaŋbii lɛ aye amɛhe."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Gad akɛ ekɛɛ David akɛ eya koni eyama afɔleshãa latɛ ema he ni Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmããgbeemɔhe lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ehã Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ David yiŋ etee yɛ Yehowa famɔ̃ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ Gad nɔ lɛ naa.
Ornan kɛ ebihii ejwɛ lɛ miigbee ŋmãã yɛ ŋmããgbeemɔhe lɛ. Be ni Ornan fo ehe ni ehiɛ gba bɔfo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebihii lɛ yatee.
David miiba Ornan ŋɔɔ, ni Ornan fo ehe ni ena David. No hewɔ lɛ eje kpo yɛ ŋmããgbeemɔhe lɛ ni ekoto David, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
David kɛɛ Ornan akɛ, "Okɛ Oŋmããgbeemɔhe nɛɛ ahã mi mahe, koni mama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi maha Yehowa, bɔ ni afee ni afo gble hela lɛ sɛɛ ahã wɔ. Mibawo bo nyɔmɔ shishiishi."

Ornan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ŋɔɔ ni ofee nɔ ni sa ohiɛ. Naa, mikɛ tsinai lɛ miihã koni akɛshã afɔlei lɛ, ni mikɛ ŋmaagbeemɔhe tsei lɛ hu miiha koni akɛfee lai; ni naa ŋmãã hu koni akɛfee niyenii afɔle. Mikɛ fɛɛ miike!"
Shi Maŋtsɛ David here Ornan nɔ akɛ, "Dabida! Mahe mawo nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni ji enaa pɛpɛɛpɛ. Miŋɔŋ nii ni ji onɔ mihaŋ Yehowa, ni asaŋ mikɛ nɔ ko ni mina lɛ yaka hu eshaŋ afɔle."
No hewɔ lɛ David wo Ornan ŋmããgbeemɔhe shikɔŋ lɛ he nyɔŋmɔ ni naa feɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi shekeli ohai ekpaa, ni ehe jɛi.

Kɛkɛ ni David ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ. Be ni ekɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei eba sɛɛ lɛ, esɔle etsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa here David nɔ, ni ehã la jɛ ŋwɛi ba, ni ebasɔo afɔlei lɛ anaa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa fã bɔfo lɛ, ni ekɛ klaŋte lɛ wo ehebo lɛ mli.
David na nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ mli akɛ Yehowa ehere lɛ nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ eshã afɔlei yɛ Orana, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
No mli lɛ Gibeon ji he ni Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Mose fee yɛ shiaŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɔɔ, ni jɛi ayajaa yɛ.
David nyɛɛɛ jɛi eya koni eyabi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ejaakɛ ŋmiŋmi emɔ lɛ yɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ Klaŋte lɛ hewɔ.
22: Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ akɛ, "Biɛ etsɔ̃ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We; ni biɛ Israel fɛɛ Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ baahi."
David fã akɛ abua gbɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa. Ejra nitsumɔi ehã amɛ. Tɛgbalɔi lɛ ehã amɛko tɛi ni akɛma Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
David hã nitsulɔi lɛ dade babaoo koni akɛflɔ plɛkoobii kɛ klampii ahã agboi lɛ anaa shinai lɛ. Ehã amɛ akɔɔble hu babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ aŋmɛ.
Asaŋ ehe tsenedru tsei babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ akane ejaakɛ Sidonbii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ baha Maŋtsɛ David tsenedru tsei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.

David kɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Mibi Solomon hiɛ fãko, asaŋ ehiɛ esako, ni tsu ni ebaama eha Yehowa lɛ, esa akɛ efee tsu kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ bɔ ni ehenɔ kɛ enyam bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko. No hewɔ lɛ mato tsu lɛ maa he nibii mashwie shi mato lɛ. "No hewɔ lɛ David to tsu lɛ he nibii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ eto dani egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu atsɛ ebi Solomon ahã lɛ, ni efã lɛ akɛ ema tsu eha Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ekɛɛ Solomon, ebi lɛ, akɛ, kulɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mama tsu koni mikɛwo Yehowa mi-Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi hiɛ nyam.
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Oshwie lá shi tsɔ̃, ni owuwuu tai wuji. Kaama tsu ni okɛmiiwo migbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam ejaakɛ oshwie lá shi babaoo yɛ mihiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsɔ̃.
Naa, obaafɔ binuu ko. Toiŋjɔlɛ baaba yɛ eyinɔ, ejaakɛ maha ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ ahã ena toiŋjɔlɛ. Abaatsɛ lɛ Solomon, ni mahã Israel ana toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ eyinɔ.
Lɛji mɔ ni baama shihilɛhe kɛwo migbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam lɛ. Ebaatsɔ̃ mibi, ni matsɔ̃ etsɛ; ni maha emaŋtsɛyeli ahe shi yɛ Israel kɛya naanɔ."
"No hewɔ lɛ, mibi, Yehowa ajɔɔ bo koni onyɛ shihilɛhe lɛ oma oha Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ ohe lɛ.
Yehowa adro bo nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛkɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji etu Israel ewo odɛŋ lɛ, onyɛ maŋ lɛ nɔ okwɛ yɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mla naa.
Kɛji ojwɛ nɔ, ni oye akpɔi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo Israel lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ oooshwere. Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa. Okashe gbeyei, ni otsuoi akafã hu.

Naa, migbo deŋme misaa nibii nɛɛ mito miha Yehowa shihilɛhe lɛ maa: Shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji akpei oha, kɛ jwiɛtɛi hu ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpe toi akpe, kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade ni anyɛɛɛ aŋmɛ tete, ejaakɛ amɛfa fe nine; tsei kɛ tɛi hu yɛ. Shi obaatao nibii nɛɛ eko ogbe yi.
Oyɛ ŋaalɔi hu babaoo: Tɛgbalɔi kɛ tsu tswalɔi kɛ kapinafoi kɛ ŋaalɔi krokomɛi babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ akane,
ni ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade. Tee shi ni owo nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ! Yehowa aaye abua bo!"
Kɛkɛ ni David wo Israel lumɛi fɛɛ kitã akɛ amɛye amɛbua ebi Solomon.
EKɛɛ amɛ akɛ, Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni eha nyɛtoiŋ ejɔ nyɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ ehã miye majimaji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ bii anɔ kunim, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛyɛ nyɛshishi.
