No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ asɔmɔa Yehowa. Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛmaa Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ koni akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii kɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni akɛjaa lɛ lɛ fɛɛ abamamɔ tsu ni ama ni aja Yehowa yɛ jɛi lɛ mli."
23: Be ni david egbɔ kotokoto lɛ, ewo ebi Solomon Israel maŋtsɛ.
Maŋtsɛ David tsɛ Israel lumɛi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe.
Ehã akane Levibii lɛ ateŋ hii ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ Kɛyaa fɛɛ. Amɛyibɔ ni ana lɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ wo amɛteŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ adeɛŋ.
Eto mɛi akpei ejwɛ akɛ agbonaabulɔi, ni eto mɛi akpei ejwɛ hu akɛ amɛjie Yehowa yi kɛ jooshwɛmɔ nibii ni esaa eto koni akɛjie Yehowa yi lɛ.
David jra amɛmli kuikui yɛ Levi bihii ni ji Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari lɛ anaa.
Gerhon fɔ bihii enyɔ: Ladan kɛ Shimei.
Ladan fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yehiel kɛ Zetam kɛ Yoel.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ladan shwiei awei lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ. (Shimie fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Shelomot kɛ Haziel kɛ Haran.)
Shimei fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yahat kɛ Zina kɛ Yeush kɛ Beria.
Yahat ji kromɔbi, ni esɛɛho ji Zina; akɛni Yeush kɛ Beria eyafɔɔɔ bihii pii hewɔ lɛ akane amɛshwiei lɛ akɛ tsɛwe komeŋ bii.
Kohat fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amram kɛ Ishar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel.

Amram, kohet kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose. Ajie Aron kɛ eshwiei lɛ ato akɛ mɛi krɛdɛɛ ni akwɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni akɛjaa lɛ anɔ kɛya naanɔ; asaŋ akɛ amɛ amɛshã tsofãkɛŋma be mli ni ajaa Yehowa; ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa, ni amɛjɔɔ mɛi yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.
Shi akane Mose, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ Shwiei lɛ ashi Levibii lɛ anɔ.
Mose fɔ bihii enyɔ, Gershom kɛ Eliezer.
Gershom shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa ji Shebuel.
Eliezer fɔ binuu kome too pɛ ni ji Rehabia; shi Rehabia fɔ babaoo.
Izhar, kohat binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, fɔ Shelomit. Lɛ etsɔ̃ Izhar shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa.
Hebron, kohat binuu ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Yeria; mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Amaria; mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Yahaziel, ni mɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Yekameam.
Uziel, Kohat binuu ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Mika, kromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Yeshia, mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
Merari fɔ bihii enyɔ: Mahli kɛ Mushi. Mahli hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Eleazar kɛ Kish;
shi Eleazer gbo ni ebɛ binuu fe biyei kɛkɛ. Kish bihii lɛ ŋɔ Eleazer biyei lɛ akɛ ŋãmɛi.
Mushi, Merari binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, fɔ bihii etsɛ̃: Mahli kɛ Eder kɛ Yeremot.
Levi shwiei ni akane amɛ yɛ amɛwei kɛ amɛshiãishãi anaa lɛ nɛ. Aŋmlã amɛgbɛii ekomekome; ni nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ, akɛ lɛ shi Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ David kɛɛ nɔ ko akɛ, "Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã emaŋ lɛ he ejɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛaahi Yerusalem kɛya naanɔ.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ ehe ehīaaa akɛ Levibii lɛ atere Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii ni akɛjaa lɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ."
Yɛ Maŋtsɛ David naagbe gbɛjianɔtoi anaa lɛ, aŋmlã Levibii ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔmai enyɔ kɛyaa agbɛii,

ni ahã amɛ nitsumɔi ni baa nɛɛ akɛ amɛtsu: Amɛwaa Aaron shwiei ni ji osɔfoi lɛ kɛji aaja yɛ Yehowa we lɛ; amɛsaa kpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ piai lɛ amli; amɛtsumɔɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ahe; amɛtsuɔ nitsumɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni kɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ mli sɔɔmɔ he;

amɛkwɛɔ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ he saji anɔ, kɛ mamu ni akɛbashãa niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ kaka ni akɛ ma akpiti shã lɛ. Kɛ nibii ni ashã ni akɛbashãa afɔle lɛ, kɛ mamu ni akɛ mu efutu mli ni akɛbaashã afɔle lɛ. Agbɛnɛ amɛ amɛŋmɛɔ ni amɛsusuɔ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni akɛbaa afɔleshãa lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ amɛlaa kɛdaa Yehowa shi; ni amɛkɛjieɔ eyi hu.
Be fɛɛ be ni aashã afɔle ahã Yehowa yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii anɔ loo yɛ nyɔji heei ajee mli kɛ gbii juji an hu amɛ amɛlaa. Ato Levibii ni be fɛɛ be lɛ amɛ amɛbaatsu nitsumɔi nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko kɛsɔmɔ Yehowa.
Belɛ Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni kwɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Sɔlɛmɔwe lɛ nɔ; ni amɛ amɛwa Aaron shwiei ni ji amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ, ni akɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
24: Shīaishīai ni feɔ Aaron shwiei lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Aaron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi yɛ amɛtsɛ hiɛ, ni amɛshiii bii. No hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛmiɛi Eleazar kɛ Itamar baye osɔfo lɛ.
Zadok ni jɛ Eleazer shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛ Ahimelek ni jɛ Itamar shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ wa Maŋtsɛ David ni ejra Aaron shwiei lɛ mli kuikui yɛ nitsumɔi ni ahã amɛ lɛ anaa.
Ana akɛ Eleazarbii lɛ ateŋ hii shīaiaŋ onukpai lɛ ayi fa fe Itamarbii lɛ ateŋ hii shīaiaŋ onukpai lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ ajra Eleazarbii lɛ amli kui nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa, ni ajra Itamabii lɛ mli kui kpaanyɔ.
Akɛni Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli lumɛi kɛ mumɔŋ lumɛi fɛɛ yɛ Eleazarbii lɛ kɛ Itamarbii lɛ ateŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ hewɔ lɛ, afɔ̃ oshiki ni akɛja nitsumɔi lɛ ahã amɛ.

Kɛji afɔ̃ shi kome ahã Eleazarwe lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shi kome hu ahã Itamarwe lɛ. Ni Shemaia, Natanel bi lɛ, ni jɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ji woloŋmãlɔ mɔ ni ŋmlã bɔ ni oshikifɔ̃ɔ lɛ fɛɛ tee nɔ hã. Eŋmla nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Abiatar bi Ahimalek kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii ashiaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki lɛ gbee Yehoiarib nɔ; ni nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbee Yedaia nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Harim nɔ, ni ejwɛ lɛ gbee Seorim nɔ;
nɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ gbee Malkiya nɔ, ni ekpaa lɛ gbee Miyamin nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee Hakoz nɔ, ni Kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Abia nɔ.
Nɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Yeshua nɔ, ni nyɔŋma lɛ gbee Shekania nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Eliashib nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Yakim nɔ;
nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Hupa nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Yeshebeab nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ gbee Bilga nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa lɛ gbee Imer nɔ;
nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ gbee Hezir nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ Kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Hapizez nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Petahia nɔ, ni nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ gbee Yehekel nɔ.
Nɔ ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Yakin nɔ, ni nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Gamul nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Delaia nɔ, ni nɔ ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Maazia nɔ.
Bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ lɛ ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ nɛ: Amɛyaa Yehowa we lɛ amɛyasɔmɔɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛ Aaron to he gbɛjianɔ yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fãmɔ naa lɛ.
Levibii lɛ ekomɛi hu amli onukpai lɛ agbɛii baa nɛ: Yehedeia ni jɛ Amram bi Shebael mli lɛ,
Ishia, Rehabia shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa lɛ,
Yahat, ni jɛ Izhar bi Shelomit mli lɛ.
Hebron bihii ejwɛ lɛ: Yeria, ni ji onukpa lɛ, kɛ Amaria mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛ Yahaziel mɔ ni ji etɛ̃, kɛ Yekameam mɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ.
Shamir, ni jɛ Uziel bi Mika mli lɛ.
Zakaria, ni jɛ Uziel bi Mika nyɛmi Ishia mli lɛ.
Mahli kɛ Mushi, Merari shwiei lɛ.
Beno kɛ Shoham kɛ Zakur kɛ Ibri, ni ji Merari shwiei ni jɛ Yaazia mli lɛ.
Eleazar, Mahli bi lɛ; shi lɛ lɛ ebɛ bihiii.
Yerameel, Kish bi lɛ.
Mahli kɛ Eder kɛ Yerimot, Mushihii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii abihii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.

Shīa fɛɛ shīa mli onukpa lɛ fã enyɛmimɛi gbekɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome efata ehe kɛfɔ̃ oshiki, ni amɛkɛklɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi lɛ tamɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi Aaronbii lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ. Amɛ hu amɛfee nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Ahimelek kɛ Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
25: Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Levibii lɛ ateiaŋ lumɛi lɛ hala mɛi komɛi yɛ Asafbii lɛ kɛ Hemanbii lɛ kɛ Yedutunbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛto amɛ akɛ amɛ amɛgba kɛji aaja, shi nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛmiitswa obenta kɛ saŋkui kɛ ŋmɛji, ni amɛmiikpã bɛji hu. Mɛi ni ahala kɛ nitsumɔi hu ni ahã amɛ lɛ baa nɛɛ.
Asaf bihii ejwɛ lɛ: Zakur kɛ Yosef kɛ Netania kɛ Asharela. Amɛyɛ amɛtsɛ Asaf shishi. Lɛ lɛ eyɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he, ni egbaa Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ wiemɔ etɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ.

Yedutun bihii ekpaa lɛ: Gedalia kɛ Zeri kɛ Yeshaia kɛ Shimei kɛ Hashabia kɛ Matita. Amɛyɛ amɛtsɛ Yedutun shishi, ni amɛgbaa Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ wiemɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ, nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛmiitswa obenta, ni amɛmiila kɛmiikafo, ni amɛkɛmiida Yehowa shi.
Heman bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ: Bukia kɛ Matania kɛ Uziel kɛ Shebuel kɛ Yerimot kɛ Hanania kɛ Hanani kɛ Eliata kɛ Gidalti kɛ Romamti-Ezer kɛ Yoshbekasha kɛ Malot kɛ Hotir kɛ Mahaziot.
Nyɔŋmɔ dro Heman, maŋtsɛ gbalɔ lɛ, bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ biyei hu etɛ̃. Nyɔŋmɔ hã Heman agbojee da tamɔ bɔ ni ewo he shi eto lɛ.
Heman bii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ eshishi, ni amɛtswaa ŋmɛji kɛ obentai yɛ Yehowa we amɛkɛwaa jamɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli. Shi Asaf kɛ Yedutun kɛ Heman lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shishi.
Gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni ekase Yehowa lalai lɛ lamɔ, asaŋ ni amɛhe esa jogbaŋŋ yɛ mli lɛ ayibɔ ji ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai Kpaanyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni afɔ̃ ashiki ni akɛ jra nitsumɔi lɛ ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ, gbekɛ kɛ onukpa, kɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ ksaelɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Yosef ni jɛ Asafbii ateŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbee Gedalia kɛ enyɛmimɛi kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Zakur kɛ ebihii kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji ejwɛ lɛ gbee Zeri kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji enumɔ lɛ gbee Netania kɛ ebii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji ekpaa lɛ gbee Bukia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee Asharela kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Yesaia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Matania kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ gbee Shimei kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Uzia kɛ ebii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Hashabia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Shubael kɛ ebihii kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Matitia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ gbee Yeremot kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa lɛ gbee Hanania kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ gbee Yoshbekasha kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Hanani kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Maloti kɛ ebihii lɛ enyɛŋmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔmai enyɔ lɛ gbee Eliata kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Hotir kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Gidalti kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Mahaziot kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Romamti-Ezer kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
26: Naa Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ajra Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hebuu nitsumɔi lɛ ahã lɛ: Meshelemia, Koranyo ni ji Kore bi ni jɛ Asafbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Meshelemia fɔ bihii kpawo, ni amɛgbɛii nɛ yɛ fɔmɔ naa: Zakaria kɛ Yedieal kɛ Zebadia kɛ Yatniel,
kɛ Elam kɛ Yehohanan kɛ Eliehoenai.
Mɔ ko hu ji Obed-Edom ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ lɛ, ni edro lɛ bihii kpaanyɔ lɛ. Ebihii nɛɛ agbɛii yɛ fɔmɔ naa baa nɛɛ: Shemaia kɛ Yehozabad kɛ Yoa kɛ Sakar kɛ Netanel,
kɛ Amiel kɛ Isakar kɛ Peuletal.
Obed-Edom bi Shimei fɔ bihii ekpaa ni tsɔ̃mɔ amɛtsɛwe lɛ shīa amli onukpai ejaakɛ hiɛwalɔi ji amɛ lɛ.
Shimei bii nɛɛ agbɛii yɛ fɔmɔ naa ji Otni kɛ Refael kɛ Obed kɛ Elzabad ni enyɛmimɛi ji Elihu kɛ Semakia kãkãlɔi lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi, ni ji Obed-Edom bii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ fee hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ ni eshɛ kɛhã bulɔi anitsumɔ.
Ana hii hiɛwalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛhã buu nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ Meshelemia shwiei lɛ ateŋ.
Hosa ni jɛ Meraribii ateŋ lɛ hu yɛ bihii ejwɛ: Shimri, ni ji onukpa lɛ. Jeee lɛji kromɔbi moŋ, shi etsɛ wo lɛ onukpa;
kɛ Hikia kɛ Tebalaia kɛ Zakaria. Hose shwiei fɛɛ ni aŋɔ awo buu nitsumɔ lɛ mli ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.
Ajra bulɔi nɛɛ amli kuikui, ku fɛɛ ku kɛ enukpa; ni ahã amɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli tamɔ ahã amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Tsɛmɛi ashīaishīai lɛ fɔ̃ oshiki, koni akɛna nɔ agbonaa ni shīa fɛɛ shīa baabu; ayakwɛɛɛ mɛi ni ayi fa kɛ mɛi ni ayifaaa.
Oshiki ni afɔ̃ yɛ bakãgbɛ agbo lɛ hewɔ lɛ gbee Shelemia nɔ; ni nɔ ni afɔ̃ yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ hewɔ lɛ gbee Shelemia bi Zakaria, nuu nilelɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni afɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ, hewɔ lɛ gbee Obed-Edom nɔ; ni nitoohe lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ gbee ebihii lɛ anɔ.
Anaigbɛ Agbo lɛ kɛ Shaleket Agbo lɛ, nɔ ni kã gbɛjegbɛ ni yaa gɔŋ nɔ gbɛ lɛ he lɛ, anaabulɛ lɛ gbee Shupim kɛ Hose nɔ. Aja buube lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni eko faaa fe eko.
Mɛi ekpaa buɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ daa gbi; mɛi ejwɛ buɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni mɛi ejwɛ hu buɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ; shi mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ buɔ nitoohe lɛ daa gbi.
Mɛi ejwɛ buɔ he ni anaigbɛ agbo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ he lɛ, ni mɛi enyɔ buɔ agba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ he.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ajra agbonaabulɔi ni jɛ Korabii lɛ kɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ lɛ amli kuikui ahã.
Levibii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, Ahia ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitoohei lɛ kɛ nibii ni akɛbake Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hu atoohe lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Gershon bi Ladan shwie na shīa babaoo ni eko ji ebinuu Yehiel shīa lɛ.
Ladan bihii enyɔ krokomɛi ni ji Zetam kɛ enyɛmi Yoel ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nitoohei lɛ anɔ.
Ni Amrambii lɛ kɛ Izeharbii lɛ kɛ Hebronbii lɛ kɛ Uzielbii lɛ hu, ahã amɛ amɛ hu amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi.
Shebuel ni ji Mose bi Gershom shwiei lɛ ji lumɔnukpa fe fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ nitoohei lɛ anɔ.
Shebuel wekunyo Eliezer bi ji Rehabia, Rehabia bi ji Yeshaia, ni Yeshaia bi ji Yoram, ni Yoram bi ji Zikri, ni Zikri bi ji Shelomit.

Nɛkɛ Shelomit nɛɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi ji mɛi ni buɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ atoohe lɛ he, ni ji nibii ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ tsɛmɛiawei amli weku nukpai, kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni kwɛɔ mɛi akpe akui kɛ mɛi ni kwɛɔ mɛi ohai akui anɔ lɛ kɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ ejɔɔ nɔ eke Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Amɛjɔɔ tai amli nibii ni amɛha lɛ mli eko nɔ amɛkɛke koni akɛtsu Yehowa we lɛ he nii.

Shelomit kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ adɛŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ake koni akɛtsu Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he nii lɛ yɔɔ. Nibii lɛ ekomɛi ji nibii ni Samuel, gbalɔ lɛ, kɛ Saul, Kish bi lɛ, kɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, kɛ Yoab, Zeruia bi lɛ, jɔɔ nɔ ke lɛ. Nitsumɔi ni ahã Levibii krokomɛi
Akɔ Kenania kɛ ebihii lɛ yɛ Izhar shwiei lɛ ateŋ koni amɛtsu maŋbii ashihilɛ he akɔntabuu woji lɛ ahe nii, koni amɛkwɛ maŋbii ateŋ saji hu amɛkojo.

Akɔ Hashabia yɛ Hebronbii lɛ ateŋ, ni akɛ Israel shikpɔŋ mi yɔɔ Yordan anaigbɛ lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ wo lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi Hebronbii lɛ ateŋ hii hemɔdɛŋbɔlɔi akpe dɛŋ. Akɛɛ amɛkwɛ Yehowa jamɔ saji kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hu sɔɔmɔ saji fɛɛ anɔ.

Yeria ji Hebronbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpa. Maŋtsɛ David maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, atao Hebron shwiei lɛ amli ekãalɔi lɛ ayibɔ, kɛkɛ ni ayana Hebronbii kãkãlɔi yɛ Yazer ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ.

Maŋtsɛ David hala Yeria shwiei nɛɛ ashīashīai lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi Hebronbii nɛɛ ateŋ hii kãkãlɔi kɛ tsɛmɛi awei amli onukpai akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo, ni ekɛ Israel shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni ji Rubenbii kɛ Gadbii kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ, nɔkwɛmɔ wo amɛdɛŋ akɛ amɛkwɛ Yehowa jamɔ saji kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hu sɔɔmɔ saji fɛɛ anɔ yɛ jɛi.
27: Agbɛnɛ naa Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai kɛ tabilɔi akpe kui atatsɛmɛi kɛ tabilɔi oha kui atatsɛmɛi kɛ amɛshishi lumɛi ni sɔmɔ Maŋtsɛ David kɛkura Israel lɛ. Nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ yɛ afi lɛ mli lɛ, ayɛ tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ ni ato ni amɛ amɛsɔmɔɔ yɛ tatsɛ nukpa kome krɛdɛɛ ko shishi kɛkura Israel saji.

Bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ lɛ kɛjra nyɔji lɛ ahã tatsɛmɛinukpai lɛ nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ asafo ni sɔmɔ lɛ, Yashobeam, Zabdiel bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ. Esafo nɛɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Yashobeam jɛ Perez mli; ni lɛji klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ tabilɔi lɛ anɔ tatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ atatsɛ nukpa.
Nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ asafo ni sɔmɔ lɛ, Dodai Ahohinyo lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ. Esafo nɛɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji etɛ̃, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ asafo ni sɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ji Benaia, Osɔfo Yehoiada bi lɛ, Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Benaia nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ji hii Kãkãlɔi Nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ anukpa, ni ebi Amizabad baye esɛɛ akɛ ku nɛɛ nɔkɛlɔ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji ejwɛ, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ asafo ni sɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ji Asahel, Yoab nyɛminuu lɛ, mɔ ni ebi Zebadia baye esɛɛ lɛ. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji enumɔ, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ ji Shamhut, Izharnyo lɛ. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji ekpaa, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ ji Ira, Ikesh bi, Tekonyo lɛ, ni asafo ku lɛ hiɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji kpawo, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni kpawo lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ ji Helez, Efraimnyo lɛ ni jɛ Pelon lɛ. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji kpaanyɔ, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ, ji Sibekai, Zeranyo ni jɛ Husha lɛ. Yudabii ji Zerabii. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji nɛɛhu mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu, lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ, ji Abiezer, Benyaminnyo lɛ ni jɛ Anatot lɛ. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji nyɔŋma, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ, ji Maharai, Zeranyo ni jɛ Netofa lɛ. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ, ji Benaia, Efraimnyo ni jɛ Piraton lɛ. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Tatsɛnukpa ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, mɔ ni kwɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ asafo lɛ nɔ, ji Heldai, Otniel shwiei ni jɛ Netofa lɛ. Esafo lɛ yikulɛ ji tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Lumɛi ni ato koni amɛkwɛ Israel akutsei lɛ anɔ nɛ: Rubenbii lɛ alumɔ ji Eliezer, Zikri bi lɛ; ni Simeonbii lɛ alumɔ ji Shefatia, Maaka bi lɛ.
Levibii lɛ alumɔ ji Hashabia, Kemuel bi lɛ; ni Aaronbii lɛ alumɔ lɛ ji Zadok.
Yudabii lɛ alumɔ ji Elihu, Maŋtsɛ David nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ; ni Isakarbii lɛ alumɔ lɛ ji Omri, Mikael bi lɛ.
Zebulonbii lɛ alumɔ ji Ishmaia, Obadia bi lɛ; ni Naftalibii lɛ alumɔ ji Yerimot, Azriel bi lɛ.
Efraimbii lɛ alumɔ ji Hoshea, Azazia bi lɛ; ni Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ alumɔ lɛ ji Yoel, Pedaia bi lɛ.
Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ alumɔ ji Ido, Zakaria bi lɛ; ni Benyaminbii lɛ alumɔ lɛ ji Yaasiel, Abner bi lɛ.
Danbii lɛ alumɔ ji Azareel, Yehoram bi lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Azareel, Yehoram bi lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Israel akutsei lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ David hãaa akane mɛi ni yeko afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo shi eto akɛ ebaahã Israel yi afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ.

Yoab, ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Zeruia lɛ, bɔ̃i maŋbii kanemɔ lɛ, shi eyagbeee naa. Nyɔŋmɔ gbla Israel toi yɛ mɛi kanemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ; ni no hewɔ lɛ naagbee gbɔmɛi ayikulɛ ni ana lɛ, eyajeee Maŋtsɛ David yinɔ saji anɔ wojiaŋ.

Naa mɛi hu ni ato koni amɛkwɛ amaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii lɛ anɔ: Maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli nitoohei lɛ Azmawet, Adiel bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni nitoohei ni yɔɔ koi asɛɛ kɛ maji kɛ akrowai kɛ mɔji lɛ amli lɛ. Yonatan, Uzia bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.
ŋmɔji lɛ amli nitsulɔi lɛ Esri, kelub bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ;
ni waintromi lɛ Shimei ni jɛ Rama lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni wain ni yɔɔ wain toohei lɛ amli lɛ, Zabdi ni jɛ Shefam lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.
Mu tsei lɛ kɛ sikamore tsei lɛ ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ gɔ̃ji lɛ ashishi jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Baal-Hanan ni jɛ Geder lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni mutoohei lɛ Yoash ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.
Tsinai ni alɛ yɛ Sharon ŋãnɔ lɛ, Shirtai ni jɛ Sharon ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ; ni tsinai ni alɛ yɛ jɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, Shafat, Adlai bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ nɔ.
Yomai lɛ Obil, Ishmaelnyo lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ; ni tejii lɛ Yehedeia ni jɛ Meronot ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ; ni gwaŋtɛŋi kɛ abotiai lɛ Yaziz, Hegrinyo lɛ, ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ji Maŋtsɛ David tsuji ni kwɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii anɔ lɛ.
Yonatan, Maŋtsɛ David tsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔ. Eji ehe nuu ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ, ni ele woloŋ hu. Lɛ kɛ Yehiel, Hekemoni bi lɛ, ji mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ bii nii.
Ahitofel hu,maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔ ni; ni Hushai, Arkinyo lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ lɛ shieŋtsɛ.
Ahitofel gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Yehoiada, Benaia bi lɛ, kɛ Abiatar baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ ŋaawolɔi. Ni Yoab ji maŋtsɛ lɛ tatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ.
28: Maŋtsɛ David Kpee Israel lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem. No hewɔ lɛ akutsei lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ, kɛ kuikui ni sɔ̃mɔɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ, kɛ tabilɔi akpe akuikui kɛ tabilɔi oha akuikui atatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛbii lɛ anibii lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ hii kakãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalem.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David ho edamɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ asafo ni ebabua shi lɛ akɛ, "Agoo, minyɛmimɛi kɛ mimaŋbii! Kulɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mibama tsu diɛŋtsɛ mahã Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ naneshi maaŋoo lɛ hu, ni mito nibii ahe gbɛjianɔ hu hã tsu lɛ maa.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Kaama shīa ohã mi ni aja mi yɛ mli, ejaakɛ tawulɔ ji bo, ni oshwie lá shi.'

Shi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eŋɔ mi yɛ mitsɛwebii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni mi kɛ mishwiei aye Israel maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ. Eŋɔ̃ Yuda yɛ akutsei lɛ ateŋ koni etsɔ̃ hiɛnyiɛlɔ; ni eŋɔ̃ mitsɛwe lɛ yɛ Yudabii awei lɛ ateŋ, ni ena mihe tsui yɛ mitsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, ni ewo mi Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.
Ni Yehowa dro mi bii pii, ni bii nɛɛ fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ eŋɔ̃ mibi Solomon koni ebata Yehowa maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
"Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Obi Solomon ji mɔ ni baama mishīa lɛ, ejaakɛ miŋɔ lɛ mifee mibi, ni matsɔ̃ etsɛ,
ni mahã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi kɛya naanɔ kɛji ekã he eye mikitãi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ tamɔ efeɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ.'

"No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, mimaŋbii, miibi nyɛ yɛ Israel tso muu fɛɛ, ni ji Yehowa asafo ni ewo shi nɛɛ, hiɛ, ni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu miinu, koni nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; nyɛdia amɛsɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ, koni nyɛshi nyɛhã nyɛbii ni baa yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ akɛ gboshinii kɛya naanɔ.

"ni bo, mibi Solomon, ole otsɛ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; osɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ otsuiŋ fɛɛ, asaŋ ojie oyitsoŋ fɛɛ hu ni okɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ! Ejaakɛ Yehowa taoɔ adesã tsuiŋ fɛɛ, ni ele eyitsoŋ fɛɛ. Kɛji otao esɛɛgbɛ lɛ eeehã ona lɛ; shi kɛji okwa lɛ lɛ, eeeshɛ bo efɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.
Naa, kwɛmɔ ohe ni ahi, ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ̃ bo koni oma shīa ni akɛfee Jamɔhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ. Wajemɔ ohe, ni ofee ekãa."

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli tsui lɛ ahe mfoniri ni atɛŋ, hã ebi Solomon. Mfoniri nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni koi lɛ kɛ ehe tsui lɛ,kɛ nitoohei lɛ ŋwɛigbɛ tsui lɛ,kɛ piai ni yɔɔ mligbɛ lɛ, kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe Fɛɛ, he ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ baama lɛ, kamɔ shi hã.

David kɛ wolo kroko ni atɛŋ ha Solomon ni miitsɔ̃ɔ̃ bɔ̃ ni esusu nibii ni baa nɛɛ ahe eha: Yehowa we lɛ he kpoi lɛ kɛ piai ni bɔle kpo lɛ kɛkpe lɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nibii atoohei lɛ, kɛ nibii ni mɛi kɛbake Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu atoohei lɛ.

Asaŋ David kɛ wolo kroko hu hã Solomon ekoŋŋ ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ ahã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ koni amɛkɛtsu amɛnitsumɔi lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, asaŋ kɛkwɛ tsɛnsii kɛ nibii ni akɛtsuɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli nii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Agbɛnɛ David tsɔ̃ɔ Solomon jwiɛtɛi loo shika naa bɔ ni sa akɛ aŋmɛ̃ koni akɛfee tsɛnsii fɛɛ ni akɛtsuɔ Yehowa we lɛ mli nii lɛ,
kɛ bɔ ni shika kanetsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe kanei lɛ aŋmɛ̃, kɛ bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi kanetsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe kanei lɛ hu aŋmɛ̃ yɛ nɔ ni akɛ kanetso fɛɛ kanetso tsuɔ yɛ jamɔ mli lɛ naa.
Etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ shika bɔ ni shika okplɔ̃i ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aboloo lɛ mãa nɔ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko hu aŋmɛ̃, kɛ jwiɛtɛi bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi okplɔ̃i lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko hu aŋmɛ̃,
kɛ bɔ ni shika ŋmiiŋmi ni akɛbaafee fakai lɛ kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ kpuji lɛ aŋmɛ̃, kɛ bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi okpolui lɛ hu aŋmɛ̃.
Etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ bɔ ni shika ŋmiiŋmi tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ aŋmɛ̃; dani etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ afee kerubi ni egbɛ amɛfijianŋ amɛkɛha Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ ashika shwiili lɛ hu ahã.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ akɛ, "Ajie nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mi kɛjɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ni aŋmã; ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi bɔ ni atsɔ̃ akwɛ nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ nɛɛ nɔ kɛtsu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ahã."

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ ebi Solomon akɛ, "Wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa; kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã hu. Ejaakɛ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ji mi, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ osɛɛ; ekwaŋ bo lɛ, eshiŋ bo hu kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooogbe Yehowa We lɛ mãa he nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa.

Ni naa bɔ ni ajra Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ ahã osɔfoi akuu kɛ Levibii akuu lɛ. Ni nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, ayɛ mɛi ni le ŋaa srɔtoi, ni asaŋ amɛyɛ he tsui tsɔ̃ akɛ amɛaatsu nii kɛwa bo; amɛsɛɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ odɛŋ."
29: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ asafo muu lɛ akɛ, "Mibi Solomon, mɔ koome ni Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ̃ lɛ, oblanyo ni,ni ekpako jeŋ shi; shi nitsumɔ ni ebakã enɔ lɛ da, ejaakɛ tsu lɛ jeee gbɔmɔ amãa ahã, shi Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ misaa nibii mito, bɔ ni manyɛ, yɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hewɔ: Shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ tso ni akɛbaatsu amɛhe nibii srɔtoi, dani sro ojrawa tɛi srɔtoi kɛ tɛi ni akɛmamɔɔ nibii amli akɛyeɔ sama kɛ tɛi ni kplɛɔ kɛ tɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwãtãŋwãtã kɛ tɛi ni akɛkaa shikpɔŋ.
Nibii ni misaa mito Shīa Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mãa nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mishika kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni miyɔɔ hu miihã koni akɛfata nibii lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he sane lɛ kã mitsui nɔ.
Mihä shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei kpawo koni akɛka Sɔlemɔwe lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahiɛ;
asaŋ koni ana eko ni ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni esa akɛ akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi afee lɛ. Agbɛnɛ namɔ yɔɔ biɛ ni yɔɔ he tsui akɛ eeesahã afɔle ehã Yehowa?"

kɛkɛ ni tsɛmɛiawei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ kɛ akutsei lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ, kɛ tabilɔi akpe akuikui lɛ tabilɔi oha akuikui atatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he nibii anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ shi amɛtsitsi akɛ amɛaahã nibii lɛ.

Ni amɛha nibii ni baa nɛɛ koni akɛtsu sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa lɛ he nii: shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei enumɔ kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji dalei akpei nyɔŋma kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei nyɔŋma kɛ akɔɔble ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔŋ kɛ dade ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei oha.
Maŋbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ojrawa tɛi lɛ, amɛkɛtee amɛyahã koni akɛwo Yehowa nitoohe lɛ ni Yehiel, Levinyo Gershonnyo lɛ, kwɛɔ nɔ lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nya yɛ nii ni amɛkɛke yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛjɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ amɛkɛ nii eke Yehowa, ni Maŋtsɛ David hu nya naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David jie Yehowa yi yɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Aaajie oyi, Bo Yehowa, ni ji wɔtsɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ.
Yehowa, oda ni Bo oyɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ anumnyam; oyeɔ nii fɛɛ nɔ kunim, ni oje agbo ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ onɔ ni. Yehowa, boji maŋtsɛ ni ota nii fɛɛ nɔ akɛ yitso.
Bo ohãa anaa nii; bo ohãa mɔ hiɛ baa nyam; ni bo oyeɔ nii fɛɛ nɔ. Odɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ fɛɛ yɔɔ; ni hewalɛ ni akɛfeɔ gbɔmɔ mɔ wulu, asaŋ ni akɛhãa mɔ naa hewalɛ lɛ, Bo odɛŋ eyɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔmiida bo shi, ni wɔmiijie ogbɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ yi.
"Ni namɔ po ji mi, ni namɛi po hu ji mimaŋbii, ni wɔnyɛ wɔke nii kɛ tsuijurɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ? Ejaakɛ odɛŋ ni nii fɛɛ jɛɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni wɔkɛhã bo lɛ odɛŋ nɔŋŋ wɔna yɛ.
Ohiɛ lɛ, gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji wɔ, tamɔ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔŋŋ. Wɔgbii ni wɔyeɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hoɔ eyaa tamɔ susuma ni ehiii shi daa lɛ.
Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, nii babaoo ni wɔbua naa wɔkɛbaama shīa wɔkɛwo ogbɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ nyam nɛɛ lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ onii ni, ejaakɛ odɛŋ fɛɛ jɛ.

Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mile akɛ bo lɛ okaa gbɔmɔ tsui okwɛɔ, ni onaa mɛi ni yeɔ anɔkwa he miishɛɛ. Mijɛ mitsuiŋ fɛɛ kɛ suɔmɔ mli mikɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ ke, ni agbɛnɛ miina akɛ omaŋ ni jwere shi nɛɛ hu miike bo nii kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ.
Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob a-Nyɔŋmɔ, hã su nɛɛ ahi owebii atsuiiaŋ kɛya naanɔ, koni amɛhi shi kɛye bo anɔkwa daa.
Dromɔ mibi Solomon koni ekɛ etsui fɛɛ aye okitãi kɛ okpɔi kɛ owiemɔi fɛɛ anɔ koni emã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni misaa ehe nibii mito lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ asafo ni ewo shi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjiea Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi!" Ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ jie Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi; ni amɛmamɔ amɛyi shi amɛja Yehowa, ni amɛkoto maŋtsɛ lɛ hu.

No sɛɛ lɛ amɛshãshãa afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa; ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ amɛsha shãa afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa kɛ tsinahii akpe kɛ ojwɛnii akpe, kɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii hu akpe kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei hu. Amɛshãshãa afɔlei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ahewɔ.

Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ yeyee nii ni amɛnunuu dãi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛ nyamɔ babaoo. Amɛsaa amɛwo Solomon, David bi lɛ, maŋtsɛ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ nɔ. Amɛfɔ lɛ mu yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli akɛ lumɔ kɛ Zadok hu akɛ osɔfo.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon bata Yehowa maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ etsɛ David najiaŋ. Emaŋtsɛyeli shwere, ni Isreal muu fɛɛ bo lɛ toi.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Maŋtsɛ David bihii krokomɛi lɛ hu fɛɛ ba amɛhe shi amɛhã Maŋtsɛ Solomon.
Yehowa dro Solomon, ni etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu kpanaa, ni Israel muu fɛɛ hiɛ sɔ lɛ, ni ehã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ hiɛ ba nyam bɔ ni maŋtsɛmɛi ni nyiɛ ehiɛ yɛ Israel lɛ eko nako nakai henɔ dã.
David, Yeshai bi lɛ, ye Israel muu fɛɛ maŋtsɛ
afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Eye maŋtsɛ afii kpawo yɛ Hebron, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem.
Egbɔ kotokoto dani egbo; ni egbo akɛ niiatsɛ kɛ mɔ ni abuɔ hu, ni ebi Solomon baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ David wala he saji, kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyagbe naa lɛ, aŋmãlã bluublu yɛ gbalɔi Samuel kɛ Natan kɛ Gad ahe saji lɛ amli.
Saji lɛ gbaa wɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David tsɔ̃ eye emaŋtsɛ kɛ bɔ ni hewalɛ ni ehiɛ lɛ naa wa hã, kɛ saji fɛɛ ni ba yɛ lɛ kɛ Israel kɛ maji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ lɛ amli majiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahe lɛ.

1: Paulo, Yesu Kristo bɔfo ni atsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Sostene,

ŋma wolo nɛɛ yhã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ KOrinto lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni atsuu amɛhe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ. Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he ni tsɛɔ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo ni ji wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛI lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ji jɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Miida mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daaa nɛɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nu akɛhã nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hewɔ.
Akɛ nibii fɛɛ mli lɛ ahã nyɛshwere yɛ emli, yɛ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee fɛɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni ama Kristo he odase lɛ nɔ mi yɛ nyɛmli,
ni dromɔ nikeenii ko eshwɛɛɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkwɛɔ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ
Lɛ nɔŋŋ eeewaje nyɛ kɛaatee naagbee ni nyɛhew akaba kpa ko yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbi lɛ nɔ.
Anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛba e-Bi Yesu Kristo, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, naanyobɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Kristo gbɛio mli, akɛ nyɛnaabu afee ekome ni mligblamɔi akɛba nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛa jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ susumɔ kome.
Ejaakɛ Kloe webii lɛ batswa mi adafi yɛ nyɛhe, minyɛmimɛi, akɛ bei yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Nɔ ni kitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ ji akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛɔ akɛ, "MI lɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi.' "mi lɛ, Kristo nɔ ji mi."
Ani agbla Kristo mli ? Ani Paulo asɛŋ ahã nyɛ lɛ? Aloo Paulo gbɛi mli abaptisi nyɛ awo lɛ?
Miida Nyɔŋmɔ shi akɛ mibaptisiii nyɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ ja Kristo kɛ Gaio,
koni mɔ ko aka kɛɛ akɛ mibaptisi lɛ yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi mli.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, mibaptisi Stefana we lɛ, shi mikaiii akɛ mibaptisi mɔ mifata he dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo tsuuuh mi baptisimɔ, shi moŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ, ni jeeee yɛ nilee wiemɔi amli tete, koni Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ akafee yaka.
Ejaakɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he sane lɛ ji kwashiai asane hã mɛi ni hiɛ kpãtãa lɛ; shi wɔ mɛi ni hiɛ wɔyiwala lɛ, eji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ hã wɔ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, "Mafite nilelɔi anilee, Ni ŋaalɔi anaa lɛ hu mahã afee yaka,"
Nɛɛgbɛ nilelɔ yɔɔ? Nɛɛgbɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ yɔɔ? Nɛɛgbɛ je nɛɛŋ naataalɔ yɔɔ? Ani Nyɔŋmɔ hãko je lɛ mli nilee lɛ atsɔ̃ kwashiai asane?
Shi akɛni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee naa lɛ je lɛ nyɛɛɛ etsɔ̃ lɛ, esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ ekɛ kwashiai asane lɛ ni ashiɛɔ lɛ ahere mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ayiwala.
Ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ, naakpɛɛ okadii ashi amɛbiɔ, ni Helabii hu taoɔ nilee;
Shi wɔ lɛ, Kristo ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ wɔshiɛɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ pampi ehã Yudafoi, kɛ Kwashiai asane ehã jeŋmaji lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ lɛ, Yudafoi jio, Helabii jio, Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee hã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwashiai asane lɛ, nilee lɛ mli fe gbɔmɛi anilee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔjɔmɔ lɛ he wa afe gbɔmɛi ahewalɛ.
Shi anɛmimɛi, nyɛkwɛa nyɛtsɛmɔ lɛ, jeee hewalɔi pii, jeee abladei pii atsɛ;
shi moŋ je nɛɛ mli kwashiaianii lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛwo nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble; ni je nɛɛ mli gbɔjɔmɔnii lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛWo nii ni ha wa lɛ ahiɛgble;
ni je nɛɛ mli nii ni abuuu kɛ nii ni agbe he guɔ lɛ Nyɔŋnɔ hala, kɛ nibii ni bɛ lɛ tete, koni ehã nibii ni yɔɔ lɛ afee yaka;
bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko akashwa yɛ ehiɛ.
Shi lɛ ejɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ Kristo Yesu, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ nilee ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã wɔ lɛ mli;
koni, tamɔ bɔ mi aŋma lɛ,. "Mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, eshwã efɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ."
2: Ni mi hu, anyɛmimɛi, be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, jeee wiemɔ flɛmii loo nilee tuutu mikɛba, ni mibajaje Nyɔŋmɔ sane lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ;
ejaakɛ mitooo miyiŋ akɛ male nɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ, akɛ ja Yesu Kristso, mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ
ni Mikɛ nyɛ hi shi yɛ gbɔjɔmɔ kɛ gbeyeisheemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ pii mli;
ni miwiemɔ kɛ mishiɛmɔ lɛ hu jeee gbɔmɛi anileee wiemɔi ni håa mɔ yiŋ tdsɔ̃ɔ mikɛshiɛ, shi moŋ wiemɔi ni jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ hewalɛ kpo.
bɔ ni afee ni nyɛheemɔkɛyeli lɛ akadãmɔ gbɔmɛi anilee nɔ, shi moŋ edãmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ nɔ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔwieɔ nilee wiemɔ yɛ mɛi ni dra yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ ateŋ, shi jeee je nɛɛ mli nilee lii je nɛɛ mli nɔyeli ni jee fɛifɛi lɛ anilee.
Shi moŋ wɔwieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni akɛtee yɛ teem( sane mli lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ saa eto hã wɔnumnyam dani ahe jeŋ shishi,
nilee ni je nɛɛ mli nɔyeli lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛle kulɛ amɛsɛŋ anumnyam Nuŋtsɔ lɛ,
Shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ "Nii mi hiŋmɛi enako ni toi hu nuko ni ebako gbɔmɔ ko tsuiŋ dã ji nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ."
Shi wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ e-Mumɔ lɛ nɔ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ; ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ taoɔ nibii fɛɛ mli, Nyɔŋmɔ nibii ni mli kwlɔ tete.
Shi gbɔmɛi ateŋ namɔ lɛ nii mi yɔɔ gbɔmɔ moi, akɛ ja gbɔmɔ lɛ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ? Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ hu mɔ ko mɔ ko leee, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ,
Shi wɔ lɛ, jeee je nɛɛ mli mumɔ lɛ wɔna, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, koni wɔle nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛdro wɔ lɛ.
Nomɛi hu wɔwieɔ, jeee wiemɔi ni gbɔ ɛi anileee tsɔ̃ɔ wɔwieɔ, shi moŋ wiemɔ ni MuMɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ, ni wɔkɛ mumɔŋnii toɔ mumɔŋnii ahe.
Shi gbɔmɔ su ni akɛfɔ lɛ lɛ heee nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ nii lɛ; ejaakɛ ebuɔ lɛ kwashiai asane, ni enyɛɛɛ naa ena, ejaakɛ mumɔ akɛtaoɔ naa.
Shi mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ kɛ kojoɔ nii fiaa, shi lɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko ekojooo lɛ.
Ejaakɛ "Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii? SHi wɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ Kristo jwɛŋmɔ .
3: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, minyɛɛɛ mikɛ nyɛ awie tamɔ mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi, shi moŋ tamɔ heloŋ gbɔmɛI, tamɔ abifabii yɛ Krsito mli.
Fufɔ mihã nyɛ; shi jeee ŋmaa ni tsii, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye; ni asaŋ amrɔ nɛɛ tete nyɛnyɛɛɛ lolo.
Ejaakɛ heloŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ lolo. Shi gbii abɔ ni awuŋayɛli kɛ bei yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lolo lɛ, ani jeee jheloŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ ni gbɔmɛi ajeŋba nyɛbaa lɛ>?
Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛɔ akɛ, "Mi lɛ Paulo nɔ ji mi," ni Mɔ ko hu kɛɔ akɛ, "Mi lɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi,," Lɛ ani jeee heloŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ?
Agbɛnɛ, Nmaɔ ji Apolo? Namɔ ji Paulo? Amɛji sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni nyɛtsɔ̃ amɛnɔ nyɛhe nyɛye, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛhã lɛ.
Mi lɛ, mitɛo; Apolo shwie nɔ nu; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hã eda.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ mni tɛi lɛ ji nɔ ko, ni jeee mɔ ni shwie nɔ nu lɛ hu, shi mɔ ni hã eda, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni tsɛɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ nɔ nu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekomeŋ; shi amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɔmɔwo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edeŋmegbomɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi nitsulɔi ji wɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmo kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu ni nyɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni ekɛdro mi lɛ naa lɛ, mito shihsi tamɔ tsuwalɔ lɛ naa lɛ, mito shishi tamɔ tsuwaalɔ ko ni hiɛ yɔɔ ŋaa, shi mɔ kroko tswaa nɔ. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akwɛ ni ahi bɔ ni etswaaa nɔ ehãa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ shishi kroko ato fe nɔ ni ato momo ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko kɛ shika loo jwɛitɛi loo tɛi ni jra wa loo tsei loo jwɛi loo gbetselii tswa shishitoo nɛɛ nɔ Lɛ,
mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ baaje kpo faŋŋ; ejaakɛ Gbi lɛ aaajie lɛ kpo, ejaakɛ la mli eeeje kpo yɛ, ni bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ yɔɔ lɛ, la lɛ baajie lɛ kpo.
Kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ ni ji nɔ ni etswa em anɔ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, eeena nyɛmɔwo;
shi kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ aaashã lɛ, enine baanyɛ shi; shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, shi kɛ̃lɛ tamɔ mo ko ni tsɔ̃ la mli.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli?
Kɛ mɔ ko fite Nyɔŋmɔ sɔlemɔtsu lɛ, fitemɔ Nuŋtsɔ aaafite lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni no ji nyɛ.
Mɔ ko akalaka klɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. Kɛji mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ nilelɔ ji lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, efee ehe kwashia, ni etsɔ̃ nilelɔ.
Ejaakɛ je nɛɛ mli nilee lɛ ji kwasiai asane yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ 'Emɔɔ nilelɔ lɛ yuɛ amɛŋaa fɔŋ lɛ mli."
Ni asaŋ aŋma akɛ , "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le nilelɔ ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ akɛ yakanii ni."
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ gbɔmɛi anɔ. Shi nii fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnɔ ni:
Paulo jio, Apolo jio, KEfa jio, je lɛ jio, wala jio, gbele jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio; fɛɛ lɛ nyɛnɔ ni,
Shi nyɛ lɛ Kristo nii ji nyɛ; Shi Kristo lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔŋ.
4: Bɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɛi abu wɔ nɛ, akɛ Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ saji lɛ anɔ tsuji nakpai.
Shi nɔ ni eshwɛ ni ataoɔ yɛ tsuji nukpai adɛŋ ji akɛ ana amɛ akɛ anɔkwafoi =.
Shi mi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko titri ko hã mi akɛ nyɛkojoɔ mi aloo akɛ akɛ gbɔmɛi akojomɔ aaakojomo mi; mi diɛŋtsɛ tete mikojoooo mihe.
Ejaakɛ mileee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee no hewɔ aaabu mi bem; shi mɔ ni kojoɔ mi ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkakojoa nɔ ko dani shɛ be lɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba, mɔ ni kɛ dujiaŋ nibii ni akɛtee lɛ tete aaaba lɛ hiɛ, ni eeejie tsuiiaŋ ajinai lɛ ashi lɛ. Ni no mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana eyijiemɔ kɛaajɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ .
Shi, anyɛmimɛi., nyɛhewɔ mikɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ toɔ mi kɛ Apolo he lɛ, koni nyɛkwɛ wɔ ni nyɛkase nɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Mɔ ko akajwɛŋ fe nɔ ni aŋma lɛ ." koni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ henɔwomɔ akabu mɔ ko fe mɔ kroko.
Shi namɔ buɔ bo akɛ esra bo? Ni asaŋ, mɛni oyɔɔ ni jeeee hã hã o? Shi kɛji hã ahã o lɛ. mɛɛba oshwãa tamɔ nɔ ni jeee hã ahã o lɛ?
Nyɛtrɔ momo! Nyɛna nii momo! Nyɛshi wɔ sɛɛ ni nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ! Ni mina ni kulɛ nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, koni wɔ hu wɔkɛ nyɛ aye!
Ejaakɛ efeɔ mi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ Wɔ ni ji bɔfoi lɛ moŋ efee sɛɛkpelɔi, tamɔ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã gbele; ejaakɛ akɛ wɔ efee kwɛmɔnii ahã je lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ gbɔmɛi.
Wɔ lɛ, kwashiai ji wɔ yɛ Kristo hewɔ , shi nyɛ lɛ, nilelɔ ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli; wɔ lɛ, gbɔjɔlɔi ji wɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ hewalɔi ji nyɛ; nyɛ nyɛhiɛ yɔɔ nyam, shi wɔ lɛ , wɔhiɛ bɛ nyam.
Kɛbashi be nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, hɔmɔ kɛ kumai yeɔ wɔ, ni wɔnyiɛɔ yayai, ni agblagblaa wɔ, mãi, ni wɔbɛ hilɛhe krɛdɛɛ ko.
Ni wɔgboɔ deŋme wɔkɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔniji tsuɔ nii; be ni ajɛɔ wɔ lɛ, wɔmiijɔɔ; be ni awaa wɔ yi lɛ, wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ;
be ni afiteɔ wɔgbɛi lɛ, wɔŋwie naajɔLɛ wiemɔ; afee wɔ tamɔ je lɛ tumunɔnii, mɛi fɛɛ ajwɛi kɛbashi be nɛ.
Miŋmaa enɛɛmɛi ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgble, shi moŋ miiwie miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ tamɔ mibii ni misumɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛyɛ kwɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma tete yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, jeee tsɛmɛi pii nyɛyɔɔ; ejaakɛ mi mitsɔ̃ sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ mifɔ nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
No hewɔ lɛ miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkase mi.

No hewɔ hu ni mitsu Timoteo, ni ji misusuɔmɔ bi kɛ anɔkwafo yɛ NuŋTsɔ lɛ mli lɛ nyɛŋɔɔɔ, ni ebakai nyɛ bɔ ni mibaa mijeŋ mihãa yɛ Kristo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo fɛɛ asafo mli yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.
Shi akɛni mɛi komɛi susuɔ akɛ mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo amɛhe nɔ.
Shi kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miisumɔ lɛ, atsɛŋɔ̃ ni maba ni mabana mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ ahewalɛ, shi jeee amɛwiemɔ.
Ejaakɛ jeee wiemɔ mli Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɔɔ< shi moŋ hewalɛ ,mli.
Te nyɛtaoɔ lɛ tɛŋŋ? Mihiɛ kpãa kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, aloo miba yɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ mli?
5: Aakɛɛ kwraa po akɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ajwamaŋbɔɔ ni bɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ateŋ tete akɛ mɔ ko kɛ etsɛ ŋa woɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛwoɔ, ni nyɛyeee ŋkɔmɔ moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni ajie mɔ ni tsu nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ?
Mi ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli, shi mumɔ mli miyɔɔɔ yɛ lɛ , mikojo mɔ ni tsu nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ momo, tamɔ nɔ ni miyɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛji nyɛnaa kpe shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli ni miyɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ mumɔ mli, ní Nuŋtsɔ Yesu hewalɛ fata he lɛ.
Wɔkɛ gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ awo Satan dɛŋ, koni epiŋ egbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ahere mumɔ lɛ yiwala yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛshwãa lɛ bɛ fɛo. Nyɛleee akɛ misha bibioo shaa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛjiea ma hee, tamɔ bɔ ni akpiti ji nyɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ agbe wɔ- Hehoo Toobi ni ji Kristo lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔyea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ, jeee kɛ masha momo, ni asaŋ jeee kɛ efɔŋ loo nɔshafeemɔ masha, shi moŋ kɛ anɔkwale akpiti ŋmiiŋmi.
Miŋma nyɛ yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ nyɛkɛ ajwamaŋbɔlɔi akabaɔ;
jeee jeŋbii ateŋ ajwamaŋbɔlɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo amimyelɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi ahe kwraa miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nakai ni kulɛ ja nyɛje je lɛ mli.

Shi agbɛnɛ miŋma nyɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ ji ajwamaŋbɔlɔ loo hiɛjoolɔ loo wɔŋjalɔ loo mɔjɛlɔ loo dãatɔlɔ loo mɔjɛlɔ loo dãatɔlɔ loo amimyelɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, nyɛkɛ lɛ akayea nii tete.
Shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, mɛɛ amɛ kojomɔ hu mina? Ani jeee mɛi ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
6: Te kɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ enaanyo na sane ko lɛ, eshiɔ etsitsi ekɛ lɛ yayeɔ sane lɛ yɛ jeŋbii akojomɔhe, shi ekɛ lɛ eyaaa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aŋɔɔ?
Ani nyɛleee akɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ baakojo je lɛ?
Ani nyɛleee akɛ wɔbaakojo ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete, ni mbasroo walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji?
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛyɛ walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji komɛi ayeli lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛhãa mɛi ni asafo lɛ ebuuu amɛ lɛ kojoɔ mɔ?
Miikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgble. Aso nilelɔ komeflo bɛ nyɛteŋ, mɔ ni aaanyɛ enyɛmimɛi ateŋ ekojo?
Shi moŋ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi yayeɔ sane yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ aŋɔɔ po?
Enɛ lɛ aye nyɛnɔ kunim momo, akɛni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe yeyeɔ saji lɛ. Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi afee nyɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ moŋ? Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi aye nyɛ amim moŋ?
Shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛfeɔ nyɛmimɛi tete nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ, ni nyɛyeɔ amɛ amim.

Ani nyɛleee akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ? Nyɛkahãa alakaa nyɛ! Ajwamaŋbɔlɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi loo gbãŋkulɔi loo hii ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔɔ amɛhe yei hãa hii krokomɛi loo hii ni kɛ hii feɔ yakayakanii,
loo julɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo dãatɔlɔi loo mɛiajɛlɔi loo ojotswalɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.
Ni nɛkɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɔɔ sa; shi agbɛnɛ aju nyɛhe, ni asaŋ atsuu nyɛhe, ni abu nyɛ bem hu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ mli.
Miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee nibii fɛɛ hi; miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi mihaŋ nɔ ko aye minɔ.
ŋmaa yɛ hã musu, ni musu hu yɛ hã ŋmaa; shi Nyɔŋmɔ baahã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ afo. Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ, jeee ajwamaŋbɔɔ hewɔ eyɔɔ, shi moŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyɔɔ; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hu yɛ hã gbɔmɔtso lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni ebaatee wɔ hu shi yɛ ehewalɛ naa.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ Kristo henii ni? Belɛ miŋɔ Kristo henii lo? Dabida!
Aloo nyɛleee akɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehe yabɔɔ ajwamaŋ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ gbɔmɔtso kome? Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome."
Shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe bɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ mumɔ kome.
Nyɛjoa ajwamaŋbɔɔ naa foi! Esha fɛɛ esha ni gbɔmɔ feɔ lɛ, jeee egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli eyɔɔ; shi mɔ ni bɔɔ ajwamaŋ lɛ, efeɔ esha eshiɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛbɔmɔtso lɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛna kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ sɔlemɔtsu ni, ni nyɛjeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ lo?
Ejaakɛ ahe nyɛ kɛ jra ni wa. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ awoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
7: Agbɛnɛ, yɛ nii ni nyɛŋma nyɛbahã mi lɛ ahe lɛ, ehi hã nuu akɛ ekata yoo he;
shi ajwamaŋbɔɔ hewɔ lɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewu.
Wu lɛ atsu eŋa lɛ gbɛnaanii ehã lɛ, ni ŋa lɛ hu afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã ewu.
ŋa lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi moŋ ewu lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ wu lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi eŋa lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ.

Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akakãmaa nyɛhe, akɛ ja nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛkpãa gbee akɛ nyɛaafee nakai kɛyashi be ko koni nyɛna dekã nyɛsɔle; ni nyɛfee ekome ekoŋŋ, koni Satan akatsɔ̃ nyɛnaa yɛ nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye hewɔ.
Enɛ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, jeeee kitã miwoɔ nyɛ, shi miiwie kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ agbɛŋmɛɛ yɛ he.
Ka mihewɔŋ kulɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ nɛɛ. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ keenɔ kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ, mɔ ko nɔ nɛkɛ, ni mɔ ko hu nɔ ekroko.
Shi oshijafoi kɛ okulafoi lɛ, miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ehi hã amɛ kɛji amɛhi shi tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu miyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
Shi kɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe nɔ amɛye lɛ, amɛbote gblãshihilɛ mli; ejaakɛ gblãhihilɛ hi fe nɔ ni akɔnɔ aaahao o.
Shi mɛi ni ebote gblãshihilɛ mli lɛ, mi, ni jeee mi tete, shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ moŋ woɔ amɛ kitã akɛ; ŋa akɛtse ewu gblã;
Ni kɛji etse gblã lɛ tete lɛ, ehi shi akɛ mɔ ni bɛ wu, aloo ekɛ ewu lɛ ayakpãtã; ni wu hu aka ŋmɛɛ eŋa he.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, jeeee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi mi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛmi ko yɛ ŋa ni jeee heyelɔ, ni yoo lɛ kplɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ ehe.
Ni kɛ yoo ko hu yɛ wu ni jeeee hetelɔ, ni nuu lɛ kplɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekatse lɛ gblã.
Ejaakɛ atsuuɔ nuu ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ hu he yɛ ewu lɛ mli; ejaakɛ jeee nakai jikulɛ nyɛbii lɛ hu ahe yɛ muji; shi amrɔ nɛɛ amɛhe tse.
Shi kɛ mɔ ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ miigbla ehe shi lɛ, egbla ehe shi; anyɛɛɛ nyɛminuu loo nyɛmiyoo nɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ yɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ hejɔlɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ wɔ kɛba.
Shi, bo yoo, bo obaahere owu lɛ yiwalɛ jio, ole? Aloo bo nuu, bo hu obaahere oŋa lɛ yiwala jio, ole?
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eja nikeenii ehã lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehi shi nakai. Ni nakai mito hu yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Kɛ afo mɔ ko ketia ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, akatsɔ̃ ehe foolɔ; loo mli atsɛ mɔ ko yɛ hu, ekafo ketia.
Ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni fooo hu jeeee nɔ ko, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔyeli moŋ ji nɔ ko.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nɔ shihilɛ mli eyɔɔ ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ ehi.
Ani nyɔji ji o be ni atsɛ o lɛ? Kaahã miidɔ o; shi kɛ ooonyɛ ohe okpɔ̃ lɛ, bɔɔ he mɔdɛŋ.
Shi mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni eji nyɔŋ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ odehe ni; nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ ni eji odehe lɛ, Kristo nyɔŋ ni.
Jra ni wa akɛhe nyɛ; nyɛkatsɔmoa gbɔmɛi anyɔji .
Anyɛmimɛi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nɔ mli ni eyɔɔ ni atsɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ ehi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ
Shi oblayei froi lɛ, mibɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã ko yɛ amɛhe, shi nɔ ni misusuɔ mikɛɔ nɛɛ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ koni eye anɔkwa.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni misusuɔ akɛ ehi ji, hejramɔ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehi hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ.
Mla efi o ekpɛtɛ yoo he? Kaaatao fɛnemɔ. Afɛnɛ o yɛ yoo he? kaatao ŋa.
Shi kɛji oŋɔ yoo hu, ofeko esha; ni kɛji oblayoo fro hu bote gblãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efeko esha; shi gbɔmɔtsoi gbɛfaŋ amɛmanehulu mɛnɛɛmɛi baana; shi mi lɛ, nyɛhe mifoɔ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, be lɛ faa dɔŋŋ; nɔ ni eshwɛ ji akɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋamɛi tete afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ eko; ni mɛi ni foɔ lɛ hu afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni fooo;
ni mɛi ni nyaa afe amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni nyaaa; ni mɛi ni heɔ nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni jeee nɔtsɛmɛi;
ni mɛi ni tsuɔ je nɛɛ he nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni tsuuu he nii; ejaakɛ je lɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa lɛ nɛɛ hoɔ eyaa.
Shi misumɔɔ akɛ nyɛfee yeyeeye. Mɔ ni bɛ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ;
Shi mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esa eŋa lɛ hiɛ.

ni efeɔ jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛ. Yoo ni bɛ wu loo oblayoo fro lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ, koni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kɛ mumɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esane asa ewu hiɛ.
Shi enɛ lɛ, nyɛ ekpakpa hewɔ mikɛɔ, jeee nyɛkuɛ kpãa miwoɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni afee fɛo, koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko wooo nyɛ najiaŋ
Shi kɛji nuu ko susuɔ akɛ ebaaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ eblayoo fro gbɛfaŋ, ni enyɛɛɛ he nɔ ko efee lɛ, efee bɔ ni esumɔɔ, efeee esha; amɛkpee amɛhe.
Shi mɔ ni ekpɛ mli yɛ etsui mli, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efiii lɛ, shi enyɛɔ efeɔ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ ni ekpɛ mli nɛkɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui mli akɛ eeeya nɔ ehiɛ lɛ akɛ eblayoo fro lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni kɛ eblayoo fro lɛ boteɔ gblãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ moŋ, shi mɔ ni boteee gblãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ fe no.
Yoo lɛ, gbii abɔ ni ewu hiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛ mla efi lɛ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ eyɛ hegbɛ akɛ egbã mɔ ni esumɔɔ; shi belɛ afee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Shi kɛji ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, eyɛ hejɔlɛ aahuu. Mijwɛŋmɔ nɛ, ni efeɔ mi akɛ mi hu miyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ.
8: Agbɛnɛ yɛ wɔji afɔle agbɛfaŋ lɛ wɔle akɛ, "Wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ nilee." Nilee hãa mɔ woɔ ehe nɔ, shi suɔmɔ hãa mɔ nane mɔ̃ɔ shi.
Kɛ mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ ele nɔ ko lɛ, eleko bɔ ni sa akɛ ele lolo.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko misumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ le lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ wɔji afɔle nii ayeli he lɛ, wɔle akɛ wɔŋ ko wɔŋ ko jeee fɛifɛi yɛ je nɛɛ mli, ni asaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ, akɛ ja Mɔ kome kɛkɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji nibii komɛi yɛ ni atsɛɔ amɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ŋwɛi amɛyɔɔ jio, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyɔɔ jio, tamɔ bɔ ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi ahe ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi ahe lɛ,
Wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kome pɛ wɔyɔɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ mli ni nibii fɛɛ jɛ ni wɔyɔɔ wɔhã lɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome hu ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ, mɔ nɔ nibii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba ni wɔ hu wɔtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ.

Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ le nii nɛɛ; shi mɛi komɛi yɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔŋjamɔ efee amɛhenɔ, no hewɔ lɛ kɛ amɛmiiye wɔji afɔlenii lɛ, amɛyeɔ lɛ akɛ wɔji afɔlenii, ni enɛ buleɔ amɛ ejaakɛ egbede amɛhenilee.
Shi jeee ŋmaa hãa wɔsaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; kɛ wɔyeeee lɛ ehãaa wɔtɛ nɔ atse, ni asaŋ kɛ wɔye hu ehãaa wɔhi fe nine.
Shi nyɛkwɛa ni ahīa koni nyɛhegbɛ nɛɛ akabatsɔ̃ pampi miihã gbedelɔi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko na bo ni "ole nii" lɛ akɛ ota wɔtsu mli ooye nii lɛ, ani enɛ woŋ mɔ ni egbede lɛ henilee hewalɛ koni eyaye wɔji afɔlenii lɛ?
Ni no lɛ "onilee" lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmi gbedelɔ ni Kristo bagbo yɛ lɛ hu ehewɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.
Shi kɛji nyɛfee nyɛmimɛi lɛ esha nɛkɛni nyɛkɛpila amɛhenilee ni waaa lɛ, no lɛ Kristo nyɛfeɔ esha nyɛshiɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ŋmaa aaahã minyɛmi nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ, miyeŋ loo gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ, koni mikahã minyɛmi lɛ nane miitɔ̃tɔ̃.
9: Ani mihiɛɛɛ mihe? Ani jeee bɔfo ni ji mi? Ani minako Yesu wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ? Jeee minine naa nitsuymɔ ji nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lo?
Kɛji mijeeee bɔfo mihãaaa mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, nyɛ lɛ miji bɔfo mihã nyɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛji mibɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ naaasɔomɔmnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni mikɛfãa mihe yɛ mɛi ni kojoɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.
ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔyeɔ nii ni wɔnuɔ?
Ani wɔbɛ hegvbɛ akɛ wɔhiɛ nyɛmiyoo Kristofonyo ni ji wɔŋa lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ, tamɔ bɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ hu kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ kefa?
Sloo mi kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔhiɔ sui ni wɔtsuuuu nii?
Namɔ yaa ta ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewoɔ ehe nyɔmɔ? Namɔ feɔ waintrom ni eyeeee emli yibii lɛ eko? Aloo namɔ lɛɔ kooloi ni enuuu amɛfufɔ lɛ eko.
Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ ani Gbɔmɛi kɛkɛ wieɔ nakai? Ani Mla lɛ hu ekɛɛɛɛ nakai nɔŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Mose Mla lɛ mli akɛ, "Kaawo tsina ni gblɛɔ able lɛ naabu kotoku.": Ani tsinai ahe dɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ,
Aloo wɔhewɔ nɔŋŋ aŋma, ejaakɛ esa akɛ mɔ ni huɔ lɛ, ekɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ahu, ni mɔ ni kplaa able hu hiɛ aka nɔ akɛ ebaaye eko.
Kɛ wɔdu mumɔŋnii wɔhã nyɛ lɛ, ani eji nɔ ko wɔ,li akɛ wɔɔKpa nyɛheloŋnii lo?
kɛ maji krokomɛi yɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ fe amɛ? Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔfeeee nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ he nɔ ko, shi moŋ wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli, koni wɔkati Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛ.
Ani nyɛleeee akɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, Sɔlemɔwenii lɛ eko nɔŋŋŋ amɛyeɔ? Ni mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ afɔlesha6a latɛ lɛ he lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ niii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ amɛnaa?
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to akɛ mɛi ni jajeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ aye Sanekpakpa lɛ mli nii.
Shi mi lɛ, mifeko nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ekomeflo he nɔ ko. Ni miŋmaaa enɛ koni afee nakai ahã mi; eajaakɛ kɛ na nɔ ni mɔ ko aaahã mishwãa lɛ afee yaka lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji miijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ po jiŋŋ, ejeee shwãanɔ hã mi; ejaakɛ akɛfi minɔ akɛ mijaje; kɛ mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ, kpoo hã mi!
Ejaakɛ kɛ mitsu yɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, miyɛ nyɔŋmɔwo; shi kɛeee suɔmɔ naa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ atu tsulɔnukpayeli awo midɛŋ.
Agbɛnɛ mɛni ji minyɔmɔwo mɔ. No ji akɛ, kɛ mijaje miheeee nɔ ko, bɔ ni afee ni mikafee nɔ ko tuutu yɛ mihegbɛ ni miyɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ he.
Mihiɛ mihw ni mijeeee mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔŋ, kɛ̃lɛ mifee mihe mɛi fɛɛ anyɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi bbaoo anɔ.

Yudafoi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ Yudanyo mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ YUdafoi anɔ; mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ Mla shihsi mihã amɛ, tsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mibɛ Mla shishi, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ anɔ.
Mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni bɛ Mla mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ anɔ, tsɛ mijeeee mɔ ko ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla, shi moŋ miyɛ Kristo mla shishi.
Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ gbedelɔ mihã gbedelɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine shɛ gbedelɔi lɛ anɔ, mitsɔ̃ mihe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mihã mɛi fɛɛ, koni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mikɛhere mɛi komɛi ayiwala.
Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ mifeɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mi hu mana emli jɔɔmɔi lɛ eko.
Ani nyɛleeee akɛ foidamɔ mli lɛ, foidalɔ lɛ fɛɛ daa moŋ, shi mɔ kome kɛkɛ naa emli juromɔ nɔ lɛ? Nyɛdaa foi lɛ nakai, koni nyɛnine ashɛ nɔ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shīɔ akaŋ lɛ, eyeɔ ehe nɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli. Agbɛnɛ amɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ nakai, koni amɛna akekre ni fiteɔ, shi wɔ lɛ, koni wɔna nɔ ni fiteee.
No hewɔ lɛ foi ni midaaa nɛɛ, midaaa lɛ kɛkɛ ni oti emaaa mihiɛ; nɔmɔ ni minɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee kɔɔyɔɔ mikɛnɔɔɔ;
Shi moŋ mitswiaa migbɔmɔtso lɛ nii, ni miyeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ, koni mi ni mishiɛɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ akashɛ mi afɔ̃.
10: Ahi, anyɛmimɛi, misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛhiɛ aje nɔ akɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ hi atatu lɛ shishi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ,
ni abaptisi amɛ fɛɛ awo Mose mli yɛ atatu lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mumɔŋ niyenii kome lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛye,
ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ ni kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ tɛsaa ni kɛ amɛ nyiɛ lɛ mli nu, ni tɛsaa lɛ ji Krisfo.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naaa amɛteŋ mɛi pii ahe tsui, ejaakɛ aplenee amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Shi akɛ enɛɛmɛi eto wɔ okadi, koni wɔkahã nibii fɔ̃ɔji miifee wɔ akɔnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni afee amɛ lɛ.
Asaŋ nyɛkatsɔ̃mɔa amãgãjalɔ tamɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi fee lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, ni amɛte shi ni amɛte shi ni amɛshwɛ."
Ni wɔsaa wɔkabɔ ajwamaŋ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi bɔ ajwamaŋ ni gbi kome nɔ lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔi lɛ.
Ni asaŋ wɔkaka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ka lɛ ni onufui bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛsaa nyɛkawiea huhuuhu tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hu wie huhuuhu ni hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba amɛnɔ ni akɛto okadi ahã wɔ, ni aŋma ni akɛbɔ wɔ kɔkɔ, wɔ mɛi ni je lɛ naagbee bei lɛ anine wɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni susuɔ akɛ edamɔ shi lɛ ekwɛ ehe ni ahi koni ekagbee shi.
Kaa ko bako nyɛnɔ ni jeee gbɔmɔ he nɔ; shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ehãŋ aka nyɛ fe bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ; moŋ, yɛ kaa lɛ mli lɛ, ebaaje gbɛ ni nyɛkɛaaje mli koni nyɛnyɛ mli nyɛnɔ.
No hewɔlɛ, misuɔmɔ mɛi, nyɛjoa wɔŋjamɔ naa foi!
Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ akɛ nilelɔ wieɔ; nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli.
Jɔɔmɔ kpulu lɛ ni wɔjɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo lá lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni? Aboloo ni wɔkumɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni?
Ejaakɛ aboloo kome ni, ni wɔyi pii moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyeɔ aboloo kome lɛ eko.
Nyɛkwɛa Israel! Ani mɛi ni yeɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ bɔɔ lɛ, jeeee naanyo amɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ bɔɔɔ lɛ?
Belɛ mɛni mikɛɛ mɔ? AKɛ amãgã ji nɔ ko?
Dabi, shi moŋ mikɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni wɔŋjalɔ lɛ shãa lɛ, mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji amɛshãa amɛ hãa, shi jeee Nyɔŋmɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ mumɔI fɔ̃ɔji bɔɔ naanyo.
Nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji apkpulu lɛ fɛɛ nyɛnu shi kome; nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ nii kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji anɔ lɛ nɔ nii fɛɛ nyɛye shi kome.
Aloo wɔmiifee ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aye awuŋa? Ani wɔhe wa fe lɛ?
Wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeeee nibii fɛɛɛ hi; wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeee nibii fɛɛ hãa mɔ nane mɔɔ shi.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko akakple miihã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aple ahã enaanyo.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ loo jra nɔ lɛ nyɛyea; shi henileee hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkabea mli;
ejaakɛ "Shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ emlinii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ ni"
Shi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kpee nyɛ okplɔ̃ he ni nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛaama nyɛhiɛ lɛ, nyɛyea ni nyɛkabia mli, yɛ henileee hewɔ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ akɛsha afɔle ahã amãgã lɛ, nyɛkayea yɛ mɔ ni tswa adafi lɛ kɛ henilee hewɔ.
Shi henileee ni mitsɔ̃ɔ, nɛɛ, jeeee bo diɛŋTsɛ onɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ kroko lɛ nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛɛhewɔ sa akɛ mo kroko henilee akojo mihe ji mihiɛ lɛ?
Kɛ shidaa mikɛye lɛ, mɛɛba awieɔ mihe efɔŋ yɛ nii ni mida shi yɛ he lɛ hewɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ, nii nyɛyeɔ jio, nii nyɛnuɔ jio, aloo nɔ kroko nyɛfeɔ jio, nyɛfea fɛɛ nyɛkɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Nyɛkatsɔmɔa pampii nyɛha6a Yudafoi kɛ Helabii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ fɛɛ;
tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mi hu misumɔɔ akɛ nibii fɛɛ mli lɛ masa mɛi afɛɛ hiɛ, ni mitaooo nɔ ni hi hã mi diɛŋtsɛ, shi moŋ nɔ ni hi hã mɛi pii koni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ.
11: Nyɛkasea mi, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mikaseɔ Kristo lɛ.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, miijie nyɛyib akɛ nyɛkaiɔ mi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, ni nyɛhiɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mli bɔ pɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ.
Shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu yitso ji Kristo, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo hu yitso ji nuu, ni Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ekɛ nɔ ko eha eyiteŋ lɛ, eegbe eyitao lɛ he guɔ.
Shi yoo fɛɛ yoo ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ehiɛ eyitso flo lɛ, lɛ hu eegbe eyitso lɛ he guɔ; ejaakɛ etamɔ nɔ ni eshɛ eyi nɔŋŋ pɛ.
Kɛ yoo lɛ ehaaa eyi nɔ lɛ, eku eyi mɔ; shi akɛni eji hiɛgble sane hã yoo akɛ eeeku eyi loo eeeshɛ eyi lɛ, eha eyi nɔ.
Shi nuu lɛ, esaaa akɛ ehaa yiteŋ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ kɛ anumnyam ji lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nuu jɛɛɛ yoo mli, shi yoo moŋ jɛ nuu mli.
Ni asaŋ abɔɔɔ nuu yɛ yoo hewɔ; shi yoo moŋ abɔ yɛ nuu hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ ana hewalɛ he okadi ko yɛ yoo lɛ yiteŋ.
Kɛ̃lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, nuu nyɛŋ ashi yoo sɛɛ, ni yoo hu nyɛŋ ashi nuu sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni yoo jɛ nuu mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nuu hu tsɔ̃ yoo nɔ kɛba; shi nii fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli yɛ nyɛteŋ. Ani eyɛ fɛo akɛ yoo aaasɔle yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ehaaaa eyi nɔ lo?
Ani adebɔɔ diɛŋtsɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nuu ŋmɛ eyi kusuu lɛ, eyɛ hiɛgble hã lɛ,
shi yoo lɛ, kɛji eŋmɛ eyi kusuu lɛ, eji anumnyam hã lɛ? Ejaakɛ akɛ yitsɔi lɛ hã lɛ akɛ hehaanɔ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee ehe naatalɔ yɛ enɛ he lɛ, wɔ lɛ jeee wɔkusum ji no, ni Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ nibii ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛfee nɛɛ, jeee nyɛyi mikɛjieɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛkpe lɛ, jeee ekpakpa jɛɔ mli , shi moŋ efɔŋ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, minu akɛ, kɛ nyɛyabua nyɛhe naa yɛ safo lɛ mli lɛ, mligblamɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni miheɔ miyeɔ fã kɛ fã.
Ejaakɛ sa akɛ mligblamɔi aba nyɛteŋ koni mɛi kpakpai lɛ ajie amɛhe shi faŋŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Agbɛnɛ, kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ he kome lɛ, jee Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ yeli nbyɛba lɛ,
ejaakɛ nyɛniyeli nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛ yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniyenii, ni be ni hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, belɛ mɔ ko etɔ dãa.
Aso nyɛbɛ shīa ni nyɛaaye nii ni nyɛaanu yɛ jɛi? Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ nyɛbuuu, ni nyɛwoɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ ahiɛgblɛ? Te amkɛɛ nyɛ tɛŋŋ? Ani mijie nyɛyi? Enɛ lɛ, mijieee nyɛyi yɛ he.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mina kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ, Akɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu lɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mi nɔŋŋ ni atsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, ekɔ aboloo,
ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛhea nyɛyea, enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso ni akɛhã yɛ nyɛhewɔ; nyɛfea enɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi."
Nakai nɔŋŋ ewo kpulu lɛ hu yɛ niyenii lɛ asɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ yɛ milá lɛ mli; nyɛfea enɛ, shii abɔ ni nYɛaanu lɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi."
Ejaakɛ shii abɔ ni nyɛyeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni nyɛnuɔ nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛmijaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbele lɛ nyɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeba.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni enuɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ bɔ ni esaaaa lɛ, eetɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ elá lɛ nɔ.
Shi gbɔmɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ekwɛ dani eye aboloo nɛɛ eko ni enu kpulu nɛɛ eko.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni yeɔ ni enuɔ bɔ ni esaaa lɛ, kojomɔ moŋ eyeɔ ni enuɔ eha6a ehe lɛ, ejaakɛ eb uuuu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ.
No hewɔ hu ni nyɛteŋ mɛi pii egbɔjɔ ni amɛhe yeɔ, ni mɛi babaoo hu egboi nɛɛ.
Shi kɛji wɔka wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔkwɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ekojoŋ wɔ.
Shi kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miikojo wɔ lɛ, ekɛmiitsɔse wɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akabu wɔ kɛ je lɛ fɛɛ fɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛbaaye nii lɛ, nyɛmɛmɛa nyɛhe.
Shi kɛ hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eye nii yɛ shīa dã,. ni bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkpee lɛ akatsɛ kojomɔ miihã nyɛ. Shi nii ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ miba lɛ, mato amɛ gbɛjianɔ.
12: Agbɛnɛ anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ mahã nyɛle mumɔji ahe nɔ ko.
Nyɛle akɛ be ni nyɛji jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ, amãgãi mumɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ akpla nyɛ kɛtee, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni akpla nYɛ ahã lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ miihã nyɛle akɛ mɔ ko ewieee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ naa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yesu ji musumɔ"; ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ" hu, akɛ ja yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naa.
Dromɔ keenii srɔtoi yɛ, shi Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ hãa;
ni sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛm, shi nuŋtsɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛsɔmɔɔ;
ni nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ amli.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ahãa Mumɔ lɛ jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ emli koni ahi ahã mɛi fɛɛ.
Mɔ ko lɛ, atsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ ahã lɛ nilee wiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu ahã lɛ niishīnamɔ wiemɔ yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa.
Mɔ ko lɛ, ahã lɛ hemɔkɛyeli yɛ nakai MuMɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa.
Mɔ ko lɛ hewalɛnii atsumɔ; mɔ ko lɛ gbalɛ; mɔ ko hu mumɔi ashikpamɔ ni akɛnaa mumɔi amligblamɔi; m0 ko lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu wiemɔi ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Shi nɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ tsuɔ, ni ejaa ehãa bɔ ni esumɔɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ. Wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Gbɔmɔtso kome henii ji wɔ
Shi tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ ekome ni, shi ehiɛ henii pii, ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii pii lɛ fɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ni lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu ji Kristo.
Ejaakɛ Yudafoi ji wɔn jio, Helabii ji wɔ jio, nyɔji ji wɔ jio, wɔhiɛ wɔhe jio, wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome nɔ atsɔ abaptisi wɔ awo gbɔmɔtso kome mli; ni wɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Mumɔ kome akɛhã wɔ ni wɔnu.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ hu jeeee he nɔ kome ni, shu moŋ heniii pii ni.
Kɛji nane aaakɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛni jeee nine ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji mi." lɛ ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ?
Ni kɛji toi hu aaakɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛni jeee hiŋmɛi ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji mi" lɛ, ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ?
Kɛ gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi ni lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ ninumɔ yɔɔ? Kɛ ninumɔ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, nɛɛGbɛ nifuu yɔɔ?
Shi agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henii lɛ eko fɛɛ eko ema gbɔmɔtso lɛ he, bɔ ni esumɔɔ.
Shi kɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ henɔ kome ni lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɔɔ?
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ henii pii ni moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ni.
Hiŋmɛi nyɛŋ ekɛɛ nine akɛ, "Ohe ehīaaa mi;" ni asaŋ yitso nyɛŋ ekɛɛ naji akɛ, "Nyɛhe ehiaa mi."
Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛhe waa kwraa lɛ, amɛ moŋ amɛhe hiãa wɔ titri;
ni niii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛji gbɔmɔtso henii ni hiɛ bɛ nhyam kwraa lɛ, nomɛi titri ahiɛ nyam wɔwoɔ, ni wɔhenii ni bɛ fɛo lɛ moŋ naa hefɛo titri ko;
shi wɔhenii ni yɔɔ fɛo momo lɛ, enɛ he ehīaaa amɛ. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsra gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ, ni nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, ni titri ekɛ woo hãa =
koni mligblamɔ akaba gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli, shi moŋ henii lɛ abaaba amɛhe yi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni kɛji henɔ kome miina nɔ lɛ, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ la naa nɔ, ni kɛji henɔ kome hiɛ ba nyam hu, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ,.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, Kristo gbɔmɔtso ji nyɛ; ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ehenii lɛ eko ji lɛ.

Ni klɛŋklŋɛŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wo mɛi komɛi bɔfoi yɛ asafo lɛ mli, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, gbalɔi, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔlɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, hewalɛ nitsulɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ he dromɔ keenii, yelikɛbualɔi, hiɛnyiɛlɔi, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi.
Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji bɔfoi? Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji gbalɔi?
Ani mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ dromɔ keenii? Ani mɛi fɛɛ wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi? Ani mɛi fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wiemɔoi ashishi?
Shi nyɛhiɛ adɔa dromɔ keenii ni fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe. Ni masaa matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ ni hi fe fɛɛ.
13: Kɛji mikɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi alilɛi wieɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mitsɔ̃ ayawa ni jijieɔ loo ŋmlɛ ni gbɛɔ.
Ni kɛji miyɛ gbalɛ dromɔ keenii, ni minaa teemɔŋnii fɛɛ naa, ni mile nii fɛɛ, ni kɛji miyɛ hemkɛyeli fɛɛ hu, bɔ ni manyɛ gɔji mafãmɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mijeee nɔ ko.
Ni kɛji mikɛ minii fɛɛ kuma mɛi, ni kɛji mikɛ migbɔmɔtso hã nu ashã mi, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ minaaaa sɛɛ ko.
Suɔmɔ toɔ etsui shi'; emli hi; suɔmɔ hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ mɔ nɔ; suɔmɔ eshwãaa; efeee pupuupu;
efeee nii ni esaaa; epleeee lɛ diɛŋTsɛ enɔ, emli wooo la; eniŋŋ efɔŋ he;
enyãaa nɔ sha he; shi anɔkwale moŋ he enyãa;
emiɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ nɔ; emiaa ehiɛ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
Suɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo gbi ko gbi ko. Shi kɛji gbalɛi ni lɛ, amɛsɛɛ baafo; kji wiemɔi ni lɛ, abaafɔ̃ɔ; kɛji nilee ni lɛ, esɛɛ baafo.
Ejaakɛ wɔnii ni wɔle lɛ, fã kɛ fã ni,. ni wɔgbalɛ hu fã kɛ fã ni.
Shi kɛ nɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ba lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ji fã kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.
Be ni miji abiafo lɛ, miwieɔ tamɔ abiafao, mijwɛŋɔ tamɔ abiafao, misusu tamɔ abiafao; shi be ni mitsɔ̃ nuu nakpa lɛ, mishɛrɛ abiafabiianii lɛ mishwie.
Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ ashiashwɛ mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa nii tutuutu, shi no mli lɛ eeefe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; amrɔ nɛɛ mile nii fã kɛ fã, shi no mli lɛ, male nii kɛyi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ale mi kɛyi shi lɛ. ŋamɔ kɛ shidaa
14: Nyɛdia suɔmɔ sɛɛ. Ni nyɛahe, shi titri lɛ, gbalɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, jeee gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ; ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nuuu, akɛni mumɔ mli ewieɔ teemɔ saji yɛ lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ ni akɛhã amɛnane amɔ shi , ni ekɛwo amɛ hewalɛ, ni ekɛshɛje amɛnii.
Mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enane ehãa mɔ̃ɔ shi; shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ , asafo lɛ nane ehãa mɔ̃ shi.
Miisumɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛwie wiemɔi srɔtoi; shi nɔ nɔ ni misumɔɔ titri ji akɛ nuyɛgba; ejaakɛ mɔ ni gba lɛ, efe mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔtoi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shishi bɔ ni afee ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ̃ shi.
Shi agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji miba nyɛŋɔɔ mibawie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni jeee kpojiemɔ loo nilee loo gbalɛ loo nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ko ni lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛ mibahã nyɛna?
Tamɔ bɔ ni nii ni bɛ wala lɛ agbɛɛmɔ yɔɔ lɛ, blɛ jio, saŋku jio, kɛji egbɛɛɛ kɛ gbei srɔtoisrɔtoi lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akpãtãaa loo nɔ ni atswaa lɛ?
Ejaakɛ kɛji tɛtrɛmaŋtrɛ egbɛɛɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ , namɔ aaasaa ehe ato ta?
nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ nyɛ hu, yɛ wiemɔ srotɔ wiemɔ mli lɛ, kɛji nyɛwieee nɔ ni shishi yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ., te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ no lɛ nyɛbaafee tamɔ mɛi ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
Wiemɔ srɔtoi pii yɛ je lɛ mli moŋ, shi ekomeflo bɛ ni shɛ shishi.
Shi kɛji minaaa wiemɔ lɛ shishi lɛ, belɛ mibatsɔ̃ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hu baatsɔ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, akɛni nyɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ mumɔŋ nii ahe lɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtekea nɔ ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, esɔle koni enyɛ estɔ̃ɔ shishi hu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji misɔle kɛ wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, mimumɔ miisɔle nɛ, shi mijwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ewoooo yibii.
Belɛ mɛni sa akɛ mafee Mikɛ aaasɔle; mala lla kɛ mumɔ; shi mala kɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu.
Ejaakɛ kɛ okɛ mumɔ miijɔɔ lɛ, te aaafeee tɛŋŋni mɔ ni leeee mli eko lɛ aahere oshidaa lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Amen", akɛni eleeee nɔ ni okɛɔ lɛ?
Bo lɛ, ooda shi jogbaŋŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ kroko lɛ nane mɔ̃ɔɔ shi.
Midaa mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi akɛ mife nyɛ fɛɛ yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ mli;
shi kɛ̃lɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ awie wiemɔi komekomei enumɔ, koni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi anii moŋ, fe nɔ ni mawie wiemɔi komekomei akpei nyɔŋma yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi amli.
Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkafea nyɛhe gbekɛbii yɛ jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ. Efɔŋ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe abifabii; shi jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni edra.
Aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, "Wiemɔi krokjomɛi kɛ naabui krokomɛi anɔ matsɔ̃ mikɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ aaawie, Shi no hu tete amɛboŋ mi toi, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ ejeee okadi hã henyɛlɔi, shi moŋ eji okadi hã mɛi ni heee yeee; ni gbalɛ lɛ, ejeee mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ heyelɔi anɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛji asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ he kome, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miiwie wiemɔi srɔtoi, ni mɛi ni leee mli eko aloo mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ba jɛi lɛ, ani amɛkɛŋ akɛ nyɛmiiye sɛkɛ?
Shi kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miigba, ni mɔ ko ni heeee yeee aloo eleee mli eko lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, mɛi lɛ fɛɛ agbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ, ni aaaka lɛ, ni nomɛi nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ,
aaajie etsuiŋ teemɔhii akpo faŋŋ, ni no aaahã ekɛ ehiɛ abu shi eja Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeeejaje akɛm "Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛɛlɛŋ."

Belɛ te tɛŋŋ, anyɛmimɛi? Kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yɛ lala ko, mɔ ko hu yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ kpojiemɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ srtɔto ko, mɔ ko yɛ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ko lɛ, afee fɛɛ bɔ ni mɛi anane aaamɔ shi.
Kɛji aawie wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, daa nɛɛ mɛi enyɔ loo, kɛ efa aahuu lɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ pɛ awie, mɔ kome mɔ kome, ni mɔ kome hu atsɔ̃ɔ shishi;
shi kɛji shishitsɔ̃ɔlɔ o bɛ lɛ, m0 ni wieɔ lɛ afee dioo yɛ asafo lɛ mli, shi ewie eha6 lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Shi gbalɔi lɛ, mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ awie, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ahala mli.
Shi kɛji ajie nɔ ko kpo atsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko ni ta shi lɛ, mɔ ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ momo lɛ afee dioo.
Ejaakɛ kɛ afee lɛ mɔ kome mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ akase nii,. ni nyɛgba, koni mɛi fɛɛ akase nii, ni awo mɛi fɛɛ hewalɛ.
Gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa gbalɔi lɛ;
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejeee sakasakafeemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ. Tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ hetselɔi asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ,
yei lɛ afee dioo yɛ safoi lɛ amli, ejaakɛ aŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛwie, shi moŋ amɛba amɛhe shi, tamɔ bɔ ni Mla lɛ kɛɔ lɛ
Shi kɛ amɛmiisumɔ akɛ amɛkase nɔ ko lɛ, amɛbia mɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi yɛ shīa. Ejaakɛ eyɛ hiɛgble hã yei akɛ amɛaawie yɛ asafo mli.
Aloo nyɛŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ? Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛŋɔɔ eba?
Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ gbalɔ loo mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ ji lɛ lɛ, sa akɛ ele akɛ nɔ ni miŋma nyɛ nɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã nI.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko enaaa enɛ lɛ. ashi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛdiɛ adɔa yɛ gbalɛ he, ni wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ lɛ hu nyɛkatsīa naa.
Afee nii fɛɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛ gbɛnaagbɛnaa.
15: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miihã nyɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni mijaaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛmɔ mli, ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ mli hu lɛ,
no akɛhereɔ nyɛyiwala hu, kɛ nyɛmɔ mli bɔ ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; kɛjee nakai lɛ nyɛhe yakatswaa.
Ejaakɛ saji ni he hiaa fe fɛɛ ji akɛhã mi ni mi hu mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ ji akɛ Kristo gbo yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ, ni ahewɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa;
Ni afu lɛ, ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa;
ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Kefa, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi fe ohai enumɔ shi kome, mɛi ni amɛteŋ mɛi pii yɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, shi mɛi komɛi hu ewɔ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yakobo, no sɛɛ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi hu ni mitamɔ mɔ ko ni akpatu afɔ lɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi lɛ miji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ, ni misaaa tete akɛ atsɛɔ mi bɔfo, ejaakɛ miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa miji mɔ ni miji nɛɛ, ni edromɔ ni edro mi lɛ efeee yaka; shi moŋ mitsu nii waa fe amɛ fɛɛ; shi jeee mi mitsu, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, miŋ o, amɛŋ o, nakai wɔshiɛɔ ni nakai hu nyɛhe nyɛye.
Shi kɛji aaashiɛ yɛ Kristo he akɛ atee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, mɛni hewɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ?
Kɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ, belɛ wɔshiɛmɔ lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ hu efee yaka;
ni asaŋ akpa wɔ shi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he amale odaseyelɔi i wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔye Nyɔŋmɔ he odase akɛ etee Krsito shi, Mɔ ni kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ, belɛ eteee lɛ shi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ belɛ Kristo hu ateee lɛ shi.
Ni asaŋ kɛ ateee Kristo shi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛkãmɔ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lolo;
no lɛ mɛi ni ewɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ hu elaaje.
kɛ wala nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ wɔhiɛ kã kristo nɔ yɛ lɛ, wɔnii yɛ mɔbɔ fe gbɔmɔi fɛɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni gbele tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ shitee hu tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam mli ni ,mɛi fɛɛ gboiɔ yɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo mli lɛ aaahã mɛi fɛɛ yi ana wala yɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛhe. Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ ji Kristo, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi ni ji Kristonii lɛ, yɛ ebaa lɛ mli;
no sɛɛ dani naagbee lɛ baaba, be ni ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaahã Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, ni eeefo nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ.
Shi ja eye maŋtsɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaawo enajiashi.
Naagbee henyɛlɔ ni aaakpãta ehiɛ ji gbele.
Ejaakɛ "Ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kwa ewo anajiashi." Shi kɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ekɛ nibii fɛɛ ewo eshishi." lɛ, belɛ ekãshi faŋŋ akɛ nɔ ni kɛ nibii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ bɛ mli.
Shi be ni akɛ nii fɛɛ ewo shishi lɛ, no lɛ Bi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ ehe aaaawo mɔ ni kɛ nii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ shishi, koni Nyɔŋmɔ afee nibii fɛɛ ayitso.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ, te amɛbaafee tɛŋŋ? Kɛ gbohii ateŋ shi kwraa lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ:
Mɛɛba wɔ hu oshrã wɔ ŋmlɛtswaa fɛɛ ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ?
Mina nyɛheshwãa ni miyɔɔ yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Kristo lɛ Yesu mli, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ migboɔ daa gbi.
Kɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ, mikɛ "Kooloi awuyelɔi? Kɛ gbohii eteee shi lɛ, "Nyɛhãa wyea nii ni wɔnua nii, ejaakŋ wɔ̃ lɛ wɔbaagboi!"
Nyɛkahãa ahishiua nyɛ. "Naanyobɔɔ fɔŋ fiteɔ jeŋba kpakpa."
Nyɛhãa nyɛhiɛ akãa shi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛkafea esha; ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi leee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he. Mikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgble.
Shi mɔ ko aaaabi akɛ, "Te aaafee tɛŋŋ atee gbohii ashiŋ? Ni asaŋ mɛɛ gbɔmɔtso amɛkɛaaba?"
Kwashia! Nɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ osuɔ lɛ, ja egbo fɛɛda ni eyi naa wala.
Ni asaŋ nɔ ni osuɔ lɛ, jeee tso ni baaba lɛ oduɔ lɛ, shi moŋ dumɔwu kuli ko kɛkɛ, ni aŋmaa ni jio, dumɔwu kroko ni jio;
shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãa lɛ tso bɔ ni esumɔɔ, ni wu fɛɛ wu lɛ, ehãa lɛ lɛ diɛŋTsɛ etso.
Jeee heloo fɛɛ ji heloo kome: esro gbɔmɛi aheloo, ni esrɔ kooloi aheloo; esro loofɔji aheloo, ni esro nuŋloi anɔ.
Ni ŋwɛi gbɔmɔtsɛi yɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɔ gbɔmɔtsei hu yɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ esro ŋwɛi nii anumnyam, ni esro shikpɔŋ nɔ nii hu anɔ.
Esrɔ hulu anumnuam, ni esro nyɔŋtsre hu anumnyam, ni esro ŋulami anumnyam, ejaakɛ esro ŋulami kome anumnyam yɛ ekroko nɔ he.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbohiiashitee lɛ hu. Aduɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ fitemɔ mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ nɔ ni fiteee mli.
Aduɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ni bɛ nyam mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ anumnyam mli. Aduɔ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, Atsɛɔ lɛ shi yɛ hewalɛ mli.
Aduɔ susuma gbɔmɔtso, ateɔ mumɔ gbɔmɔtso shi. Kɛ susuma gbɔmɔtso yɛ lɛ, mumɔ gbɔmɔtso hu yɛ.
Nakai aŋma hu akɛ, "Adam ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ susuma ni hiɛ kã;" naagbee Adam lɛ tsɔ̃ mumɔ ni hãa mɔ yi naa wala.
Shi jeee mumɔ nɔ lɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ, shi moŋ susuma nɔ lɛ, no sɛɛ lɛ mumɔ nɔ lɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ mli lɛ, su ni; gbɔmɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi.
Bɔ ni mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ; ni bɔ ni ŋwɛinyo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai ŋwɛibii lɛ hu yɔɔ.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ subaŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔbahiɛ ŋwɛinyo lɛ hu subaŋ.
Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ. heloo kɛ lá nine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ fitemɔ hu nine shɛŋ nɔ ni fiteee lɛ nɔ.
Naa, teemɔ sane mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ: Jeee wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaawɔ lɛ, shi abaatsake wɔ fɛɛ,
trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli, be mi aaakpã naagbee tɛtrɛmaŋtrɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ abaakpã tɛtrɛmaŋtrɛ, ni aaatee gbohii ashi ni amɛfiteŋ dɔŋŋ, ni wɔ lɛ, abaatsake wɔ.
Ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ.
Shi be ni nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ, no lɛ wiemɔ aŋma lɛ aaaba mli akɛ, "Amigble yɛ kunim mli."
"Ao, gbele , nɛɛgbɛ okunim lɛ yɔɔ? Ao gbele, nɛɛgbɛ ogãi lɛ yɔɔ?"
Shi gbele gãi lɛ ji esha; ni esha hewalɛ ji Mla lɛ.
Shi shidaa ahã nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ ehãa wɔyeɔ kunim lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni sumɔɔ, nyɛfia shi ni nyɛkagbugbãa ni nyɛtekea nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ mli daa nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ efeŋ yaka yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
16: Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ onia ni atsuɔ ayahã hetsɔlɔi lɛ he lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mito mihã Galata asafoi lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai.
Daa otsi mli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ nɔ ko ato yɛ bɔ ni enaa lɛ naa, koni mikaba dani atsu onia.
Ni kɛji miba lɛ, matsu mɛi ni nyɛbuɔ akɛ amɛsa kɛ woji ni amɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii lɛ aya Yerusalem.
Kɛji esa akɛ mi hu matee lɛ, mikɛ amɛ aaatee.
Shi miyatsɔ̃ Makedonia dani maba nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ Makedonia miyatsɔ̃.
Shi ekolɛ mahi nyɛŋɔɔ fioo, ni ekolɛ maye fɛ̃ibe lɛ hu yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni he fɛɛ he ni maya lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ.
Ejaakɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ minaa nyɛ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ minyiɛ gbɛfãa nɔ kɛkɛ, shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ, matsɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ>
Shi mibahi Efeso kɛyashi Pentekoste gbi lɛ,.
Agble shinaa kpeteŋkple ahã mi kɛhã nitsumɔ ni baawo yibii, shi mɛi ni kuɔ naa lɛ ayi fa.
Shi kɛji Timoteo ba lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ekɛ gbeyeishemɔ akahi shi yɛ nyɛteŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ nitsumɔ etsuɔ tamɔ mi nɔŋŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ mɔ ko akabu lɛ akɛ ejeee mɔ koshi nyɛjiea lɛ gbɛ yɛ hejɔklɛ mli koni eba miŋɔɔ; shi miikwɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Shi wɔnyɛmi Apolo lɛ, mikpa lɛ fai aahuu ni ekɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ; shi ekplɛ̃ɛɛ kwraa akɛ eeeeba amrɔ nɛɛ, shi kɛ ena hegbɛ jiŋŋ eeeba.
Nyɛbua, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, nyɛfea hii, ni nyɛhe awa!
Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛle Stefana shīa bii lɛ, akɛ amɛji Akaia klɛŋklɛŋ yibii, ni amɛkɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ,
koni nuɛ hu nyɛba nyɛhe shi nyɛhã mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nii lɛ eko ni egboɔ deŋme yɛ mli lɛ.
Shi mina miishɛɛ akɛ Stefana kɛ Fortunato kɛ Akaiko eba, ejaakɛ ni nyɛbɛ miŋɔɔ nɛɛ, amɛ amɛbaye nyɛnajiaŋ.
Ejaakɛ amɛbahã mimumɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛmumɔ ena ekaãa. No hewɔ lɛ gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ nyɛlea amɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Asia asafoi lɛ miiba nyɛ. Akwila kɛ Priskila kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ amɛwe lɛ miibi nyɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.Nyɛŋaŋaaa nyɛhe kɛ naa bimɔ nɛ.
Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔ̃ɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sane lɛ, mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ musumɔ! Maran-ata: Nuŋtsɔ, ba.
Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!
Misuɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli! Amen.

1: Wala wiemɔ lɛ yɛ kɛjɛ Shishijee.Wɔnu ni wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛii, wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ni wala lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, ni wɔna, ni wɔyeɔ he odase ni wɔjajeɔ naanɔ wala lɛ, nɔ ni kɛ Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ he sane wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nɔ ni wɔna ni wɔnu lɛ, no wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ hu, koni nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ wɔ abɔ naanyo. Shi wɔnaanyobɔɔ lɛ, Tsɛ lɛ kɛ e-Bi Yesu Kristo lɛ wɔkɛbɔɔ.
Wɔmiiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ ayi obɔ̃.
Ni enɛ ji sane lɛ ni wɔnu kɛjɛ ebi lɛ ŋɔɔ ni wɔsaa wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ. No ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, là ji lɛ, ni duŋ ko kwraa bɛ emli,
Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ wɔkɛ lɛ miibɔ naanyo ni wɔnyiɛɔ duŋ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiimale ni wɔyeee anɔkwa.
Shi kɛji wɔnyiɛɔ lá lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɔɔ là lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe miibɔ naanyo, ni e-Bi Yesu Kristo la lɛ tsumɔɔ wɔhe kɛjeɔ esha fɛɛ mli.
Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ esha ko bɛ wɔhe lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔshishiuɔ, ni anɔkwale lɛ bɛ wɔmli.
Kɛji wɔjaje wɔhe eshai lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, anɔkwafo kɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni ekɛ wɔhe kɛjɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ fɛɛ mli.
Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ wɔfeko esha lɛ, belɛ wɔhã Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ amalelɔ, ni ewiemɔ lɛ bɛ wɔmli.
2: Mibii bibii, miiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ koni nyɛkafee esha. Ni kɛ mɔ ko fee eshia jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ mlidaamɔlɔ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, Yesu Kristo jalɔ lɛ.
Lɛji wɔhe eshai lɛ ahe kpãtãmɔnɔ; shi jeee wɔnɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ hu.
Ni kɛ wɔyeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ, no wɔkɛnaa akɛ wɔle lɛ.
Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Mile lɛ," ni eyeee ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, amalelɔ ji lɛ, ni anɔkwale lɛ bɛ emli.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ ni yeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, lɛ emli Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ eye emuu yɛ. Enɛ wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔyɛ emli.
Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ eyɛ emli lɛ, sa akɛ enyiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu enyiɛɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Suɔmɔmɛi, jeee kitã hee ko miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, shi moŋ kitã momo ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ.Kitã momo lɛ ji wiemɔ ni nyɛnu lɛ.
Shi asaŋ kitã hee miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, nɔ ni ji anɔkwa yɛ Kristo mli kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛmli lɛ, ejaakɛ duŋ lɛ eho, ni anɔkwa là lɛ miitso momo.
Mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ eyɛ la lɛ mli ni enyɛ̃ɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eyɛ duŋ lɛ mli lolo.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eyɛ la lɛ mli, ni nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔnɔ ko bɛ emli.
Shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, duŋ lɛ mli eyɔɔ, ni duŋ lɛ mli enyiɛɔ, ni eleee he ni eyaa, ejaakɛ duŋ lɛ eshwila ehiŋmɛii.
Miiŋma nyɛ, mibii bibii, ejaakɛ akɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ efa nyɛ yɛ Kristo gbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Miiŋma nyɛ, ataamɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Miiŋma nyɛ, oblahii, ejaakɛ nyɛye mɔ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.

Miiŋma nyɛ, gbekɛbii, ejaakɛ nyɛle Tsɛ lɛ. Miiŋma nyɛ, ataamɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ. Miŋma nyɛ,oblahii, ejaakɛ nyɛhe wa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmli, ni nyɛye mɔ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.
Nyɛkasumɔa je lɛ loo nibii ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli. kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ je lɛ, belɛ Tsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ lɛ bɛ emli,
ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ heloo lɛ sɛɛdiinii lɛ kɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ asɛɛdiinii lɛ kɛ shihilɛ mli hewoo lɛ ejɛɛɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli, shi moŋ je lɛ mli ejɛ.
Je lɛ hoɔ eyaa kɛ emli sɛɛdiinii lɛ, shi mɔ ni feɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Gbekɛbii, naagbee ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɛ; ni bɔ ni nyɛnu akɛ Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ miiba lɛ, Kristo henyɛlɔi lɛ pii eba amrɔ nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ wɔle akɛ naagbee ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ.
Wɔteŋ amɛjɛ amɛtee, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛjeee wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi, ejaakɛ wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi ji amɛ kulɛ amɛ kɛ wɔ hi shi.Shi amɛtee bɔ ni afee ni amɛjie amɛhe shi akɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ jeee wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi ji amɛ.
Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛna mufɔɔ kɛjɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ, ni nyɛle ni fɛɛ,
Jeee akɛ nyɛleee anɔkwale lɛ hewɔ miŋma nyɛ nɛɛ, shi moŋ akɛ nyɛle, ni nyɛle akɛ amale komeflo jɛɛɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli.
Namɔ ji amalelɔ, kɛjeee mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ Yesu jeee Kristo lɛ?Mɔ ni kwaa Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ, lɛji Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ,
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaa Bi lɛ, ebɛ Tsɛ lɛ hu; shi mɔ ni gbaa mli kpoo akɛ eheɔ Bi lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ Tsɛ lɛ hu.
