No hewɔ lɛ nyɛ lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, nyɛhãa no ahia nyɛmli.Kɛji nɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ hi nyɛmli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛaahi Bi lɛ kɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli.
Ni enɛ ji ashi ni ewo wɔ lɛ - naanɔ wala lɛ.
Mɛi ni hãa nyɛduɔ gbɛ lɛ ahewɔ miŋmaa nyɛ nii nɛɛ.

Ni nyɛ lɛ, mufɔɔ ni nyɛna kɛjɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmli, ni ehe ehiãaa nyɛ akɛ mɔ ko atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii, shi moŋ bɔ ni emufɔɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii fɛɛ, ni ejhi anɔwale ni jeee amale ni lɛ, bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ nyɛhia emli.
Ni agbɛnɛ, mibii bibii, nyɛhia emli koni be ni eeebapue lɛ, wɔna ekãa ni wɔhiɛ akagboi ni wɔnyɛɛɛ ehiɛ wɔdamɔ yɛ ebaa lɛ mli.
Kɛji nyɛle akɛ jalɔ ji lɛ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ afɔ lɛ kɛjɛ emli.
3: Nyɛkwɛa suɔmɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛsumɔ wɔ, akɛ atsɛ wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii, ni nakai wɔji! Enɛ hewɔ lɛ je lɛ leee wɔ, ejaakɛ eleee nyɔŋmɔ.
Suɔmɔmɛi, agbɛnɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji wɔ, ni anako ajie nɔ ni wɔbaatsɔ̃mɔ lɛ shi; shi wɔle akɛ, be ni aaajie no shi lɛ, wɔɔtamɔ Kristo, ejaakɛ wɔɔna lɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ yɛ emli lɛ, etsuuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe,tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ ehe tsɛ lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ eefee mlatɔ̃mɔnii hu; ni esha lɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ ni.
Ni nyɛle akɛ Kristo jie ehe kpo koni ewo wɔhe eshai kɛya; ni esha ko bɛ emli.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hiɔ emli lɛ, efeee esha; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, enako lɛ ni asaŋ eleko lɛ.
Bii bibii, nyɛkahaa mɔ ko miihã nyɛdu gbɛ.Mɔ ni tsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ, jalɔ ji lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu eji jalɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ,ejɛ abonsam mli; ejaakɛ kɛjɛ shishijee beebe lɛ, abonsam feɔ esha. Enɛ hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ jie ehe kpo koni efite abosam nitsumɔi lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, efeee esha, ejaakɛ esu yɛ emli, ni enyɛŋ esha efee, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ.
Enɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ kɛ abonsam bii lɛ jieɔ amɛhe shi faŋŋ yɛ.Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuuu jalɛnii lɛ, ejɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, nakai nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ enyɛmi hu.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji sane ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, akɛ wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe.
Jeee tamɔ kain mi jɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ mli ni egbe enyɛmi lɛ. Ni mɛɛ hewɔ egbe lɛ?Ejaakɛ enitsumɔi lɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni, shi enyɛmi lɛ nɔ lɛ ja.
Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji je lɛ miinyɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akafea nyɛ yaa.
Wɔle akɛ wɔfo mli kɛjɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli, ejaakɛ wɔsumɔɔ wɔnyɛmimɛi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ ko gbɔmɔgbelɔ ko bɛ naanɔ wala yɛ emli.
Enɛ mli wɔyoɔ suɔmɔ lɛ yɛ, akɛ ekɛ ewala ŋmɛ shi yɛ wɔhewɔ.
Shi mɔ ni yɔɔ je nɛɛ mli nii, ni enaa akɛ efi enyɛmi, ni emli joɔ yɛ enɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ aaahi emliŋ?
Mibii bibii, nyɛkahãa wɔsumɔa mɛi yɛ wiemɔ mli loo lilɛi nɔ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ nitsumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli hu.
Ni no wɔkɛaale akɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli wɔjɛ, ni wɔɔtsɛ wɔtsui wɔŋmɛ wɔmli yɛ nNyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Kɛji wɔtsui, ni ele nii fiaa.
Kɛji wɔtsui ebuuu wɔ fɔ lɛ, wɔnaa ekaã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaa lɛ lɛ, wɔnaa yɛ edɛŋ, ejaakɛ wɔyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ni wɔfeɔ nii ni sa ehiɛ.
Ni enɛ ji ekitã lɛ, akɛ wɔhe e-Bi Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ nɔ wɔye, ni wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo wɔ kitã lɛ.
Ni mɔ ni yeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ hiɔ emli, ni lɛ hu ehiɔ emli; ni nɔ ni wɔkɛleɔ akɛ ehiɔ wɔmli ji Mumɔ ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ.
4: Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛkahea mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ nyɛyea; shi moŋ nyɛkaa mumɔi lɛ nyɛkwɛa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli8 amɛjɛ lo, ejaakɛ amalegbalɔi pii eba je lɛ mli.
Enɛ nyɛkɛaayoo Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ. Mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ ni jajeɔ faŋŋ akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ.
Ni mumɔ fɛɛ mumɔ ni ejajeee akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli lɛ, jeee Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ, shi moŋ no ji Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛnu ehe akɛ eeba, ni agbɛnɛ tete eyɛ je lɛ mli momo lɛ.
Mibii bibii, nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ni nyɛye amalegbalɔi lɛ anɔ kunim; ejaakɛ Mumɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ da fe mumɔ ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛ lɛ, je lɛ mli amɛjɛ, no hewɔ lɛ amɛwieɔ akɛ mɛi ni je lɛ mli, ni je lɛ boɔ amɛ toi.
Wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mli wɔjɛ; mɔ ni le Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi mɔ ni jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, ebooo wɔ toi. No wɔkɛyoɔ anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ kɛ shishiumɔ mumɔ lɛ.
Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛhãa wɔsumɔsumɔa wɔhe; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ. Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ mɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ ni ele Nyɔŋmɔ.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ mɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ.
Enɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ wɔ lɛ jeɔ Kpo yɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ e-Bi koome lɛ kɛba je lɛ mli, koni wɔtsɔ̃ enɔ wɔna wala.
Enɛ mli suɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ, jeee akɛ wɔ ni wɔsumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ lɛ ni esumɔ wɔ, ni etsu e-Bi lɛ ekɛ ebafee wɔhe eshai lɛ ahe kpãtãmɔnɔ.
Suɔmɔmɛi, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔ hu wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔ ko enako lɛ pɛŋ. Kɛji wɔsumɔɔ wɔhe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɔ wɔmli, ni esuɔmɔ lŋ yeɔ emuu yɛ wɔmli.
Nɔ ni wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔhiɔ emli ni lŋɛ hu ehiɔ wɔmli ji akɛ ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ e-Mumɔ lɛ eko ehã wɔ.
Ni wɔ lɛ wɔna ni wɔmiiye odase akɛ Tsɛ lɛ etsu e-Bi lɛ akɛ je lɛ yiwalaherelɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jajeɔ faŋŋ akɛ yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɔ emli, ni lɛ hu ehiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Ni wɔ lɛ wɔ̃le, ni wɔ̃he suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛsumɔɔ wɔ lɛ wɔye. Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ji lɛ, ni mɔ ni hiɔ suɔmɔ mli lɛ,ehiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hu hiɔ emli.
Enɛ mli suɔmɔ lɛ eye emuu yɛ, yɛ wɔmli akɛ wɔɔna ekãa yɛ kojomɔ Gbi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, nakai wɔ hu wɔyɔɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli.
Gbeyeishemɔ bɛ suɔmɔ mli, shi moŋ suɔmɔ ni eye emuu lɛ shwieɔ gbeyeishemɔ, ejaakɛ gbyeishemɔ mli yɛ piŋmɔ; ni mɔ ni sheɔ gbeyei lɛ, enako eye emuu yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
Wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ tsutsu esumɔ wɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ akɛ, "Misumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ," ni enyɛɔ enyɛmi lɛ, amalelɔ ji lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ enyɛmi ni enaa lɛ lɛ,Nyɔŋmɔ ni enaaa lɛ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni eeenyɛ lɛ esumɔ hu?
Ni nɛkɛ kitã nɛɛ wɔna kɛjɛ eŋɔɔ, koni mɔ ni sumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ asumɔ enyɛmi hu.
5: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ akɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ. Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ mɔ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ, Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ mɔ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ, esumɔɔ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ hu.
Kɛji wɔsumɔɔ nyɔŋmɔ ni wɔyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, no wɔkɛleɔ akɛ wɔsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji suɔmɔ ni wɔkɛsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akɛ wɔye ekitãi lɛ anɔ; ni ekitãi lɛ waaa,
ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ, eyeɔ je lɛ nɔ kunim; ni kunim ni wɔye je lɛ nɔ ji wɔhemɔkɛyeli.
Ni namɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ, akɛ ja mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ, akɛ ja mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ?
Yesu Kristo ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ nu kɛ lá mli kɛba,jeee nu kɛkɛ mli, shi moŋ nu kɛ lá mli.Ni Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni yeɔ odase lɛ, ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji anɔkwale lɛ.
Shi mɛi etɛ̃ ji mɛi ni yeɔ odase lɛ, ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji anɔkwale lɛ.
Mumɔ lɛ kɛ nu lɛ kɛ lá lɛ, ni mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ feɔ ekome.
Kɛji wɔhe gbɔmɛi adase lɛ wɔye lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ odase lɛ da fe no; ni Nyɔŋmɔ odase lɛ ji akɛ eye odase yɛ e-Bi lɛ he.
Mɔ ni heɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ odase yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli, mɔ ni heee Nyɔŋmɔ eyeee lɛ, ehã Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ amalelɔ ejaakɛ eheko odase ni Nyɔŋmɔ ye yɛ e-Bi lɛ he lɛ eyeko.
Ni enɛ ji odase lɛ, akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ naanɔ wala ehã wɔ, ni nɛkɛ wala nɛɛ yɛ e-Bi lɛ mli.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ Bi lɛ, eyɛ wala; mɔ ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ebɛ wala hu.
Miiŋma nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, nyɛna nyɛle akɛ nyɛyɛ naanɔ wala.
Ni ekãa ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ ehiɛ lɛ ji akɛ, kɛji wɔba nɔ ko yɛ esuɔmɔ naa lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi.
Ni kɛji wɔle akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaa lɛ lɛ, eboɔ wɔ toi lɛ, belɛ wɔle akɛ nii ni wɔba lɛ lɛ, wɔnine eshɛ nɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ko na enyɛmi miifee esha ni jeee esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ, eba Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeehã lɛ wala, no ji mɛi ni feɔ esha ni jeee esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli; jeee enɛ hewɔ mikɛɔ akɛ eba Nyɔŋmɔ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ esha ni, shi esha ko yɛ ni kɛ mɔ eyaaa gbele mli.
Wɔle akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, efeee esha; shi moŋ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ lɛ lɛ, ekwɛɔ ehe nɔ, ni mɔ fɔŋ lɛ etaaa ehe.
Wɔle akɛ wɔjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ efɔŋ nɔyeli shishi.
Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ eba, ni ehã wɔ jwɛŋmɔ koni wɔle anɔkwafo lɛ. Ni wɔyɛ anɔkwafo lɛ mli, yɛ e-Bi Yesu Kristo lɛ mli, mɔ ni ji anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ naanɔ wala lɛ.
Mibii bibii,nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahīa yɛ wɔji ahe.

1: Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ David egbɔ kotokoto. Tsɛbelɛ etsuji kɛ kuŋtui pii haa ehe moŋ nɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ ehe edɔɔɔ la.
No hewɔ lɛ etsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii hã ni wɔyatao oblayoo fro ko wɔbahã Nii, ni esɔmɔ Nii. Ebaakã Nii mlishi koni Nii Maŋtsɛ he adɔ la."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛtee ni amɛyatao oblayoo fɛɛfɛo yɛ Israel kpokpai anɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi amɛyana Abishag, shunam oblanyoo ko, ni amɛkɛ lɛ bahã Maŋtsɛ David.

Oblayoo lɛ he yɛ fɛo naakpa. Ekwɛ Maŋtsɛ, ni esɔmɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi Maŋtsɛ David Kɛ Abishag naaa nuu kɛɛ yoo bɔlɛ. 5-6. Adonia, David kɛ Hagit bi lɛ, Absalom sɛɛho ni; ni ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa. Be ko lɛ Adonia wo ehe nɔ kɛ shwãa akɛ "Mi, mibaye maŋtsɛ lɛ." No hewɔ lɛ etao shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni buɔ ehe. Etsɛ Maŋtsɛ David kã ko lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ofeɔ enɛɛmɛi?"
Adonia kɛ Yoab, Zeruia bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar kpãŋ he. No hewɔ lɛ Yoab kɛ Abiatar kplɛ nɔ akɛ amɛaaye amɛbua lɛ koni eye maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Shi Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Yehoida bi Benaia kɛ gbalɔ Natan kɛ Shimei kɛ Rei kɛ hii kakabãi ni buɔ Maŋtsɛ David he lɛ bɛ Adonia sɛɛ.

Gbi ko lɛ Adonia yagbegbee tooi kɛ tsinai kɛ kooloi ni ewo fɔ yɛ Onufu Tɛsaa lɛ ni bɛŋkɛ Rogel Nubu lɛ he. Ekpee enyɛmimɛi maŋtsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Yuda hii kãkãlɔi ni ji Maŋtsɛ David tsuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee jɛi.
Shi moŋ Adonia ekpeee Gbalɔ Natan kɛ Benaia, David hebulɔi lɛ, kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi solomon kɛyaaa jɛi.
Be ni Natan nu nii nɛɛ he lɛ eyabi Solomon nyɛ, Batsheba akɛ, "Ani onu akɛ Adonia, Hagit bi lɛ, ewo ehe maŋtsɛ, ni wɔnuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ David leee he eko lo?
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ ba ni mawo o ŋaa, bɔ ni afee ni okɛhere bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ obi Solomon yiwala.
Yiŋ ni oya Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii, ani jeee bo okã oweyoo kitã akɛ obi Solomon ni baata minaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ? Te aye tɛŋŋ ni Adonia moŋ yeɔ maɛtsɛ lɛ nɛɛ?'"
Ni Natan tee nɔ akɛ, "Be ni okɛ maŋtsɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, mi hu manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛba mli ni mibamã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ mí."
Kɛkɛ ni Batsheba yiŋ etee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ pia lɛ mli. Nakai be mli lɛ, akɛni Maŋtsɛ David egbɔ kotokoto hewɔ lɛ, Abishag, Shunamyoo lɛ, ji mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ.
Batsheba bakoto Maŋtsɛ David; ni Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni otaoɔ?"
Ni Batsheba kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii bo okã Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitã akɛ, 'Mibi Solomon baaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ misɛɛ, ni lɛ ebaata misɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.'
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ naa, awo Adonia maŋtsɛ ni bo, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, oleee he eko!
Ni egbe tsinai kɛ kooloi ni ewo fɔ babaoo, ni ekpee maŋtsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar kɛ tatsɛ Yoab, shi otsulɔ Solomon lɛ ekpeee lɛ eko!
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ, Nii bo gbɛ Israel fɛɛ kwɛɔ akɛ oootsɔɔ amɛ mɔ ni baata minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛji ogbo sɛɛ.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ aaaba mli akɛ be ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ etsɔ̃ esɛɛ lɛ, aabu mi kɛ mibi Solomon gbɔmɛi gbohii, ni amɛaagbe wɔ."
Ni naa, be ni Batsheba wieɔ lolo lɛ, gbalɔ Natan hu ebashɛ jɛi.
Ni ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Gbalɔ Natan eba jɛi!" Ni Natan bakoto maŋtsɛ lɛ
ni ekɛɛ, "Ni Maŋtsɛ, ani bo okɛɛ akɛ, 'Adonia aye maŋtsɛ yɛ misɛɛ ni eta misɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ?'

Ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ eyiŋ etee, ni eyagbe tsinai kɛ kooloi ni ewo fɔ kɛ toi babaoo; ni ekpee maŋtsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ ta lɛ nɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar; ni naa, amɛtra ehiɛ amɛmiiyeyee nii, ni amɛmiinunuu dãi. Ni amɛmiibɔ oshe akɛ, 'Maŋtsɛ Adonia yi ana wala.'
Shi mi, otsulɔ lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Yehoiada bi Benaia lɛ ekpeee wɔ.
Ani minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ le nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, ni ohãaa otsuji ana ale mɔ ni baata minuŋtsɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ osɛɛ lo?"
Maŋtsɛ David to he akɛ, "Nyɛtsɛa Batsheba nyɛhãa mi!" Ni Batsheba ba, ni ebadamɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Batsheba akɛ, "Miwo bo shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ misusuma kɛjɛ amanehului fɛɛ mli lɛ hiɛ.
Mikã o, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã akɛ obi Solomon baaye maŋtsɛ yɛ misɛɛ, ni lɛ ebaata miaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ minajiaŋ lɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ mimãa nɔ miŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ hu."
Kɛkɛ ni Batsheba kɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ, "Nyɛtsɛa Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan kɛ Yehoida bi Benaia nyɛhãa mi!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni David kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛŋɔa mitsuji lɛ nyɛfataa nyɛhe, ni nyɛkɛ mibi Solomon ataa mi diɛŋtsɛ mitejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ ayaa Gihon faa lɛ naa.
Ni Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan afɔ lɛ mu yɛ jɛi awo lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ. Nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni nyɛbɔa oshe akɛ, 'Maŋtsɛ Solomon yi ana wala.' kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛbaa.
Ni kɛji eba lɛ, ebata mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ lɛ ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ minajiaŋ, ni lɛ mito lumɔ koni eye Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Benaia kɛɛ, "Amen! Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ahã aba mli nakai!
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ misɔlemɔ ji akɛ ekɛ Solomon ahi shi, ni etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ kple fe o!"
No hewɔ lɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ gbalɔ Natan kɛ Yehoida bi Benaia kɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ wó Solomon amɛta Maŋtsɛ David tejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni akɛ lɛ tee Gihon faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Zadok yawo koŋ kɛ emli mu lɛ kɛjɛ Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛbafɔ Solomon kɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ. Ni amɛkpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni maŋbii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ fɛɛ bo oshe akɛ, maŋtsɛ Solomon yi ana wala!"
Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpãkpãa bɛji ni amɛnyiɛ Solomon sɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ kple kɛba maŋ lɛ mli. Ni amɛhoofeemɔ lɛ hã shikpɔŋ hoso waa diɛŋtsɛ.

Ni be ni Adonia kɛ emɛi lɛ eye nii lɛ etã lɛ, Adonia kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ekpee ni yɔɔ eŋɔɔ lɛ nu hoofeemɔ lɛ he. Be ni Yoab nu tsɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ lɛ, ebi akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ afeɔ hoo kɛ blɔmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli nɛkɛ?"
Ni be ni ewieɔ lolo ni enaa enyɔko shi lɛ, naa, Osɔfo Abiatar bi Yonatan ni eba jɛi; ni Adonia kɛɛ, "Ba, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji o, ni sane kpakpa okɛbaa."
Yonatan to he ehã lɛ akɛ, "Dabida, wɔnuŋtsɔ David ewo Solomon maŋtsɛ!
Bɔ ni eba lɛ nɛ. Maŋtsɛ David hã Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan kɛ Yehoiada bi Benaia kɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ Solomon tee Gihon faa lɛ naa ni eta maŋtsɛ tejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan efɔ lɛ mu amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛku amɛɛsɛ kɛ nyamɔ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli. No ji blɔmɔ kɛ nyamɔ ni nyɛnu he lɛ.
Awo Solomon maŋtsɛ ata etsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.

Ni asaŋ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ ba, ni amɛjɔɔ wɔnuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, 'O-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ahã Solomon gbɛi ahehe fe ogbɛi lɛ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli mli alɛɛ fe onɔ lɛ. 'Maŋtsɛ David kã esaa lɛ nɔ nakai be lɛ mli, ni ema eyi shi ni ekɛɛ,
'Ajie, Yehowa, wɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, lɛ mɔ ni ehã mɔ kome yɛ mimusuŋbii lɛ ateŋ ebata misɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ; ni mihiŋmɛi enã!'"
Kɛkɛ ni Adonia kɛ maŋ ni ekpee lɛ fɛɛ atsui fã, ni amɛtetee shi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔ egbɛ.
Adonia diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eshe gbeyei, hewɔ lɛ etee kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eyamɔmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he akloŋtoi lɛ amli koni akagbe lɛ.
Ayagba Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ, "Naa, Adonia miishe o gbeyei, ni eyamɔmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ akloŋtoi lɛ amli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Maŋtsɛ Solomon akã kitã akɛ ekɛ klante egbeŋ mi.'"
Ni Solomon kɛɛ, "Kɛji efee ehe gbɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ eyiteŋtsɔi kome nɛkɛ enyɔŋ shikpɔŋ; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ ebaagbo."
Ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu ayaŋɔ Adonia kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛba; ni eba ebakoto Maŋtsɛ Solomon. Ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa owe!"
2: Be ni eshwɛ fioo ni Maŋtsɛ David baagbo lɛ, ewo ebi Solomon ŋaa akɛ,
"Mibi, eshwɛ fioo pɛ ni magbo tamɔ bɔ ni adesai fɛɛ gboiɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa taakɛ nuu.

Ye Yehowa, O-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ, ni oba ojeŋ ni oye ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ emlai kɛ edasei lɛ anɔ, taakɛ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mose mla lɛ mli lɛ, koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ofeɔ kɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ oye omanye.
Kɛkɛ lɛ shi ni Yehowa wo mi lɛ baaba mli. No ji, 'Kɛji oshwiei lɛ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ amɛsusuma fɛɛ aaaba amɛjeŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni amɛaaye mi anɔkwa lɛ, no lɛ nuu ni aaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel ebɔŋ bo.'

"Solomon, ohiɛ akakpa nɔ ni Zerua bi Yoab fee mi lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni egbe Israel tatsɛmɛi enyɔ. Ner bi Abner kɛ Yeter bi Amasa, kɛtɔ ta mli lá shi ni ashwie he owele, be mli ni ta bɛ lɛ. Etɔ̃, ni no hewɔ lɛ okɛ lɛ aye
yɛ onilee naa bɔ ni sa ohiɛ pɛ. Shi moŋ kaahã ekɛ eyiteŋ waji miikpleke shi kɛmiiya gbohiiaje yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
"Feemɔ Barzilai, Gileadnyo lɛ, bii lɛ ejurɔ koni ohã amɛye nii yɛ okplɔ̃ he, ejaakɛ amɛwa mi be ni mijo onyɛmi Absalom naa foi lɛ.

Ni naa, mɔ kroko hu ji Gera bi Shimei, ni jɛ Bahurim lɛ. Lɛ lɛ elomɔ mi dikadika gbi ni mitee Mahanaim lɛ. Shi fee sɛɛ be ni ekɛ mi bakpe yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ, mikɛ Yehowa gbɛi kã kitã akɛ, 'Migbeŋ o kɛ klaŋte!'
Shi bo lɛ kaahã ni eye ehe. Nilelɔ ji o; ni ole bɔ pɛ ni ooofee lɛ; egbɔ moŋ nɛ, shi ohã ni agbe lɛ kɛ eyiteŋ waŋ lɛ."
David gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Yerusalem.
Gbii abɔ ni David kɛye maŋtsɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Eye maŋtsɛ ji afii kpawo yɛ Hebron; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem.
Ebi Solomon baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ma shi kpɛŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Gbi ko lɛ Hagit bi Adonia ba Solomon nyɛ Batsheba ŋɔɔ. Ni Batsheba bi Adonia akɛ, "Ani oba yɛ hejɔlɛ mli lo? Ni Adonia kɛɛ, "Hɛɛ, hejɔlɛ mli miba.
Asaŋ miyɛ sane ko ni mi mibakɛɛ o." Ni Batsheba kɛɛ adonia akɛ, "Mɛni sane ni; wiemɔ!"
Ni Adonia kɛɛ, "Ole akɛ kulɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ minɔ ni; ni Israel fɛɛ hiɛ kã minɔ akɛ mi mibaye maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ ehã he kroko, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ etsɔ̃ miŋyɛmi lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ kome pɛ kɛkɛ he fai mikpaa o; kaakãmã mi!" Ni Batsheba kɛɛ, "Wiemɔ!"
Ni Adonia kɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, okɛ minyɛmi Maŋtsɛ Solomon awie, ejaakɛ mile akɛ ekamaŋ o, koni ekɛ Abishag, Shunam yoo lɛ, ahã mi gblã."
Ni Batsheba kɛɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, mi kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ baawie ahã o."

No hewɔ lɛ Batsheba tee Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ yawie ehã Adonia. Be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ na enyɛ Batsheba lɛ, ete shi ekɛ lɛ yakpe, ni ekoto lɛ; kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ho eta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. Ehã ayawo sɛ̃i kroko abahã enyɛ lɛ, ni eta maŋtsɛ ninejurɔ gbɛ.
Ni Batsheba kɛɛ Solomon akɛ, "Nɔ ko bibioo ko mibaba bo nɛɛ; kaakãmã mi." Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, "Bi mi, nyɛ awo, ni mikãmãŋ o."
Ni ekɛɛ, "Hã aŋɔ Abishag, Shunam yoo lɛ, ahã onyɛmi Adonia gblã."
Maŋtsɛ Solomon to he akɛ, "Shi mɛɛba obiɔ Abishag, Shunam yoo lɛ, shi ohã lɛ, Adonia? Bi, maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hu ohā ejaakɛ lɛji minyɛmi nukpa. Mɛɛba obiii nɔ ko ohãaa Osɔfo Abiatar kɛ Zerua bi Yoab hu."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kã Yehowa kitã ekɛɛ, "Kɛji wiemɔ ni Adonia wie nɛɛ lɛ jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma ewie eshi fii, Nyɔŋmɔ awo mi he nyɔmɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ gbii abɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni ehã mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ emã shi kpɛŋŋ, ni eŋɔ mi eta mitsɛ David sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛyeli ehã mi kɛ mishwiei taakɛ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ, ja agbe Adonia ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ."
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu Yehoiada bi Benaia kɛtee ni eyatswa Adonia nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛɛ Osɔfo Abiatar akɛ, "Yaa Anatot yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; kulɛ osa gbele; shi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ migbeee o, ejaakɛ boji mɔ ni otere Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛnyiɛ mitsɛ David hiɛ, ni ona mitsɛ amanehului ni ena lɛ eko.
Shi moŋ mihaŋ ni oye osɔfo dɔŋŋ, bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa wiemɔ ni ewie yɛ Eli we lɛ he yɛ Shilo lɛ aba mli."
Yoab waaa Absalom shi moŋ ewa Adonia. No hewɔ lɛ be ni enu akɛ Adonia egbo lɛ ejo foi kɛtee Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni eyamɔmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he akloŋtoi lɛ amli.
Ni ayagba Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ Yoab ejo foi kɛtee Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli; ni naa, eyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. Kɛkɛ ni Solomon tsu Yehoida bi Benaia ekɛɛ, "Yaa ni oyagbe lɛ."

Ni Benaia tee Yehowa Buu lɛ mli, ni eyakɛɛ Yoab akɛ, "Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, jee kpo." Shi Yoab kɛɛ, "Dabida, shi biɛ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ magbo yɛ!" Ni Benaia yakɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ bɔ ni Yoab kɛɛ nɛ, ni hetoo ni ehã mi nɛ.
Ni Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaafee bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ; tswaa lɛ nɔ koni ogbe lɛ, ni ofu lɛ; koni okɛtɔ la ni Yoab fɔse shwie shi yakatswaa, yɛ mi kɛ mitsɛ we, lɛ he owele.

Yehowa ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá abua eyiteŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ klaŋte gbe mɛi enyɔ be ni mitsɛ David leee he nɔ ko. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni ji jalɔi kɛ mɛi kpakpai fe lɛ. Amɛji Abner, Ner bi lɛ, Israel Tatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Yeter bi Amasa, Yuda tatsɛ lɛ.
Amɛlá abua Yoab kɛ eshwiei ayiteŋ kɛya naanɔ; shi Yehowa ajɔɔ David we lɛ, eshwiei kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛya naanɔ!"
Yehoiada bi Benaia yiŋ etee Yehowa Buu lɛ mli, ni eyagbe Yoab, ni afu lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ, yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔ Yehoiada bi Benaia efee tatsɛ yɛ Yoab najiaŋ, ni eŋɔ Zadok efee Osɔfo yɛ Abiatar najiaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu ayatsɛ Shimei kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Maa tsu ohã ohe yɛ Yerusalem, ni ohi jɛi ni okaje jɛi Kɛmiiya he ko he ko.
Ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni oooje kpo oyafo Kidron faa lɛ, na ole akɛ gbo obaagbo, olá abua boo diɛŋtsɛ oyiteŋ!"
Ni shimei kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wiemɔ lɛ hi; bɔ ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ kɛɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ otsulɔ baafee." Ni shimei hi Yerusalem gbii kplaŋŋ.
Afii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eba mli akɛ Shimei tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ jo foi kɛtee Gat Maŋtsɛ Akish, Maaka bi lɛ ŋɔɔ. Ni atswa Shimei adafi akɛ, "Naa onyɔji lɛ yɛ Gat."
Be ni Shimei nu enɛ lɛ ewo eteji nɔ nii, ni eyiŋ etee Akish ŋɔɔ yɛ Gat ni eyatao enyɔji lɛ. Ni Shimei tee eyakpla etsuji lɛ kɛjɛ Gat kɛba.
Mɔ ko yabɔ Maŋtsɛ Solomon amaniɛ akɛ Shimei eyiŋ kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛtee Gat, ni eku esɛɛ eba ekoŋŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu ayatsɛ Shimei kɛba. Ni Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Te mitsɛ̃ Yehowa mikɛkã o kitã akɛ gbi nɔ ni oooje kpo ni oooyanyiɛ kɛaatee he ko lɛ, na ole akɛ gbo ooogbo lɛ? Okɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Wiemɔ lɛ hi, minu!
Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ oyeee Yehowa kitã lɛ kɛ akpɔ ni miwo o lɛ nɔ?
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Shimei akɛ, 'Ole efɔŋ fɛɛ ni ohiɛ kã he ni ofee mitsɛ David lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa ahã efɔŋ ni ofee lɛ aku sɛɛ abua bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiteŋ.
Shi Maŋtsɛ Solomon lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ, ni mitsɛ David sɛ̃i lɛ aaama shi shiŋŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛaatee naanɔ!'"
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã Yehoida bi Benaia, ni eje kpo ni eyagbe Shimei. Ni maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ Solomon dɛŋ.
3: Solomon kɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ Farao fee shaanuu, ni Solomon Kpee Farao biyoo. Ni ekɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ kɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ Yerusalem he gbogboi lɛ atswaa naa.
Nakai be mli lɛ akɛni amako tsu ahãko Yehowa hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ shã afɔle yɛ wɔŋkoi lɛ amli.
Solomon sumɔɔ Yehowa, ni enyiɛ etsɛ David tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, shi Solomon hu shã afɔle kɛ tsofãkɛŋma yɛ jemawɔji ajamɔhei lɛ.
Afɔleshãa latɛ wulu fe fɛɛ lɛ Gibeon eyɔɔ; no hewɔ lɛ Solomon yiŋ etee koni eyasha afɔle yɛ jɛi. Solomon eshã afɔle fe shii akpe yɛ nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɔɔŋ be ni eyɔɔ jɛi lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ lamɔ mli. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bi mi nɔ ni otaoɔ ni mahã o!"

Ni Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofee mitsɛ David ejurɔ, ni osumɔ lɛ kɛ suɔmɔ kple, ejaakɛ eye o anɔkwa; eja, ni ekɛ o hi shi kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ. Ni bo hu osumɔ lɛ, ni ohã lɛ bi nuu koni eta esɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
Ni amrɔ nɛɛ, Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, owo mi, otsulɔ, maŋtsɛ yɛ mitsɛ sɛɛ. Gbekɛ bibioo kɛ minaa fufɔ sã kɛkɛ ji mi, ni mileee maŋnɔyeli.
Shi esa akɛ maye omaŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ, maŋ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala, maŋ ni amɛfa babaoo bɔ ni anyɛŋ amɛ akane tete lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ dromɔ mi, otsulɔ, nilee koni mikɛye omaŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ jalɛ mli. Hã mayoo srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ehiii teŋ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ manyɛ maye omaŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ hu?"
Ni nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ akɛ Solomon bi enɛ. No hewɔ lɛ,
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Akɛni obi enɛ, shi obiii ni ahã o wala sɛɛtsɛlɛ, ni asaŋ obiii ninamɔ ohãaa ohe, ni osaa obiii ohenyɛlɔi agbele; shi moŋ obi ni ahã bo jwɛŋmɔ kɛ niiasɛɛyoomɔ lɛ,
mɔ ko ehiŋ shi ni aaale nii tamɔ o, ni mɔ ko hu baŋ yɛ osɛɛ ni aaatamɔ o.
Ni asaŋ nɔ ni obiko tete hu maŋɔ mafata he mahã o; ninamɔ kɛ anumnyam fɛɛ, bɔ ni maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ fɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ bo yeŋ hegbɔ owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Kɛ ooobo mi toi, ni oooye mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni otsɛ David fee lɛ, no lɛ mahã ni otsɛ yɛ jeŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon hiɛ tsɛ̃, ni naa lamɔ ni. Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ ewie yɛ mli. Eba Yerusalem, ni ebadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni eshã shãa afɔle. No sɛɛ lɛ eŋmɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ okplɔ̃.
Gbi ko lɛ yei ajwamaŋi enyɔ komɛi badamɔ Maŋtsɛ Solomon hiɛ.
Ni yei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɛ maŋtsɛ, ofai nɛ, mi kɛ nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ tsu kome mli yɛ shīa kome mli. Ni mifɔ bi yɛ shīa lɛ mli.
Enɔ gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eba mli akɛ nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ hu bafɔ; wɔyi enyɔ nɛɛ pɛ wɔyɔɔ shīa lɛ mli. Mɔ ko mɔ ko fataaa wɔhe yɛ shīa lɛ mli.
Nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ binuu lɛ bagbo, ejaakɛ eyakã enɔ.
Ni nyɔɔŋteŋ be ni mi oweyoo, miwɔ lɛ, ete shi, ni ebawo mibi nuu lɛ yɛ mimasɛi, ni eŋɔ lɛ eyawo emlishi, ni ewo ebi nuu ni egbo lɛ ebawo mimlishi.
Be ni mite shi leebi ni mibahã mibi lɛ fufɔ lɛ, naa, egbo! Shi be ni je tsɛre ni mikwɛ lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, mina akɛ jeee mibi ni mifɔ lɛ ni."

Ni yoo kroko lɛ hu kɛɛ, "Dabi, mibi ji hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ni bo obi ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ." Yoo mɔ ni wie klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ bo akɛ, "Dabida, mɔ ni egbo lɛ ji obi lɛ! Mɔ ni egbo lɛ ji obi lɛ, mɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ ji mibi lɛ!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i naataamɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɔ kome kɛɛ, Mibi ji hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ni obi ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ. ' Ni mɔ kome hu kɛɛ, 'Dabi, shi obi ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ, ni mibi ji mɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ.'"
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ saa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbahãa mi klaŋte!" Ni akɛ klaŋte bahã maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ "Nyɛjaa bi hiɛkãalɔ lɛ mli enyɔ, ni nyɛŋɔa fã nyɛhãa mɔ kome, ni akɛ fã ni eshwɛ lɛ ahã mɔ kome!"

Kɛkɛ ni yoo mɔ bi ni ji hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bo akɛ, "Ao, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, mimusuŋ miishã mi yɛ mibi lɛ he. Ofai nɛ, ŋɔɔ bi hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ohã lɛ; akagbe lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ!" Shi mɔ kome lɛ kɛɛ, "Akɛ lɛ akahã wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, aja emli enyɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkagbea lɛ. Nyɛŋɔa bi hiɛkaalɔ lɛ nyɛhãa yoo mɔ ni wie klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ. Ejaakɛ lɛji bi lɛ nyɛ!"
Be ni Israelbii fɛɛ nu bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon bua sane nɛɛ he ehã lɛ, amɛkɛ bulɛ kple hã maŋtsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee yɛ emli, ni no hã enyɛ nɛkɛ kojomɔ ekojo!
4: Solomon ye Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.
Ni etsuji nukpai ni eyɔɔ nɛ: Zadok bi Azaria ji osɔfo.
Elihoref kɛ Ahia, Shisha bii lɛ, ji woloŋmalɔi; Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, ji sajiaŋmlãlɔ.
Yehoiada bi Benaia ji tatsɛnukpa; ni Zadok kɛ Abiatar ji osɔfoi.
Natan bi Azaria lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ kpokpai anɔ tsuji lɛ anɔ; Natan bi Zabud lɛ ji Osɔfo kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ naanyo.
Ahishar kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ; ni Abda bi Adoniram lɛ kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hala nitsulɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Israel maŋ fɛɛ. Amɛ amɛkɛ niyenii baa maŋtsɛ we lɛ daa afi. Daa afi mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ nyɔɔŋ nɔ ni ekɛ niyenii baa.
Amɛgbɛii nɛ: Ben-hur yɔɔ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ben-Deker kwɛɔ Makaz kɛ Shaalbim kɛ Bet-Shemash kɛ Elon-Bet-Hanan.
Ben-Hesed kwɛɔ Arubot, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekwɛɔ Soko kɛ Hefer shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ben-Abinadab kwɛɔ Nafat-Dor. Eŋa ji Tafat, Solomon biyoo lɛ.
Ahilud bi Baana kwɛɔ Taanak kɛ Megido kɛ Bet-Shean yɛ Zaretan masɛi yɛ Yezreel ŋshɔnaa gbɛ, kɛjɛ Bet-Shean kɛyashwie Abel-Mehola kɛ Yokmeam sɛɛ.

Ben-Geber kwɛɔ Ramot-Gilead, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekwɛɔ akrowai komɛi ni ji Manase bi Yair nɔ lɛ anɔ, nɔ ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ. Ekwɛɔ Argob kpokpai ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ. Maji nyɔmai ekpaa kɛ amɛhe gbogboi kɛ shinai ni akɔɔble adabaŋi yɔɔ he ni.
Ido bi Ahinadab kwɛɔ Mahanaim.
Ahimaaz kwɛɔ Naftali. Ekpee Basemat, Solomon biyoo lɛ.
Hushai bi Baana kwɛɔ Asher kɛ Bealot.
Parua bi Yoshafat kwɛɔ Isakar.
Ela bi Shimei kwɛɔ Benyamin
Ur bi Geber kwɛɔ Gilead he ni Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashanbii amaŋtsɛ Og hi lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mɔ kome ko yɛ ni kwɛɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Yuda kɛ Israel yi fa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia. Amɛyeyeɔ nii, ni amɛnunuɔ dãi, ni amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe.
Solomon ye maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ nɔ lumɔ kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, kɛ Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashwie Egipt husui lɛ anɔ. Amɛtsu onia amɛhã Solomon, ni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Solomon gbi kome jenamɔ niyenii ji ashikishaŋ litai akpei enumɔ kɛ ŋmãa mamu litai akpei nyɔŋma.
Tsinai ni ewo fɔ nyɔŋma kɛ tsinai nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni jɛ ŋanɔ lɛɛhei, kɛ toi oha ni fata he. Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ ofrotei kɛ soŋai kɛ baayelɔ kɛ loofɔji ni ewo fɔ shi nɔ.
Solomon ye shikpɔŋ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ, kɛjɛ Tifsa aahuu kɛyashwie Gaza, lɛ nɔ. Eye maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ nɔ. Solomon na toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ ehewɔhewɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ amli.
Ni Solomon yinɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Yuda kɛ Israel hi shi shweshweeshwe. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hi shi yɛ ewaintso kɛ egbami tso shishi kɛjɛ Dan aahuu kɛyashwie Beersheba.
Solomon yɛ okpɔŋɔiatsui akpei ejwɛ kɛhã eshwiilii lɛ, kɛ okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni kwɛɔ Solomon niyenii anɔ lɛ kɛ niyenii baa daa kɛhã mɛi ni bayeɔ nii yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ. Mɔ kome yɛ nyɔɔŋ kome nɔ. Ni amɛhãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko he ahia.
Amɛkɛ akoko kɛ jwɛi hu ni akɛbaahã okpɔŋɔi kɛ kooloi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ baa, bɔ ni afo tɛ ahã amɛ lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã Solomon jwɛŋmɔ ni mli kwɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ kple diɛŋtsɛ.
Solomon lɛ nii fe nilelɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Bokã Egipt lɛ fɛɛ.
Ele nii fe jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ; ele nii fe Etan, Ezrahinyo lɛ kɛ Heman kɛ Kalkol kɛ Darda, Mahol bii lɛ. Solomon gbɛi hehe yɛ jeŋ maji lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛkpe.
Ni Solomon bu abɛi akpei etɛ̃; ni elalai anaa ji akpe kɛ enumɔ.
Ewie tsei ahe, kɛjɛ tsenedru tso ni yɔɔ Lebanon nɔ aahuu kɛyashi tsei bibii ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ gbogboi anɔ ahe. Ewie kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ waamɔ nii kɛ nuŋloi hu ahe.
Maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ fɛɛ nu Solomon nilee lɛ he, no hewɔ lɛ amɛhã mɛi ba, ni amɛbabo Solomon naa wiemɔ toi.
5: Hiram, Tiro maŋtsɛ lɛ, naanyo ji Maŋtsɛ David yɛ ewala beiaŋ fɛɛ. Be ni Hiram nu akɛ afɔ Solomon mu awo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ David sɛɛ lɛ, etsu etsuji kɛba Solomon ŋɔɔ.
Solomon hu tsu akɛ wiemɔ yahã Maŋtsɛ Hiram akɛ,
"Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole bɔ ni mitsɛ David shwe akɛ emã tsu ehã Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jamɔ; shi henyɛlɔi ni bɔle lɛ gba enaa kɛ taitai, hewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ tsu lɛ emã.
Shi agbɛnɛ Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã mikoji anɔ ejɔ mi; henyɛlɔ ko bɛ lɛ, oshrã ko hu bɛ.
Yehowa wo mitsɛ David shi akɛ, 'Obi mɔ ni maŋɔta osɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ osɛɛ lɛ, lɛ eeema tsu ehā mi.' Hewɔ lɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mãmã nakai tsu lɛ mãhã Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ tsu koni omɛi lɛ ayatoo tsenedru tsei yɛ Lebanon ahã mi; bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ooohe mi lɛ mawo akɛ apaafoi lɛ anyɔmɔwo. Mahã mitsuji lɛ tete abafata amɛhe. Ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ole akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ wɔteŋ ni lɛ tsotoomɔ tamɔ Sidonbii."
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Maŋtsɛ Hiram nu Maŋtsɛ Solomon wiemɔi lɛ, ena miishɛɛ babaoo ni ekɛɛ, "Ajie Yehowa yi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, akɛ ehã David bi nilelɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ ni baaye nɛkɛ maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ."
Ni Hiram tsu abakɛɛ Solomon akɛ, "Minu oshɛɛ ni oshɛ mi lɛ; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ mafee. Mahã o tsenedru tsei kɛ sɛsɛo lɛ.

Mitsuji lɛ aaaŋɔ tsei lɛ kɛjɛ Lebanon kɛba ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni mahã afimɔ amɛ atsra kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛyashwie he ni oootsɔ̃ɔ mi. Mahã afɛne amɛ yɛ jɛi, koni ohã abahole kɛya. Nɔ pɛ ni mitaoɔ ni ofee ji akɛ ohã minitsulɔi lɛ niyenii."
No hewɔ lɛ, hiram hã Solomon tsenedru tsei kɛ sɛsɛo bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ni Solomoan hã Hiram ŋmãa ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei nyɔŋmɔ enyɔ kɛ mu tɔi litai ohai ejwɛ ni ji Hiram webii lɛ aniyenii daa afi.
Ni Yehowa hã Solomon nilee tamɔ bɔ ni ewo lɛ shi lɛ; hejɔlɛ hi Hiram kɛ solomon teŋ. Ni amɛkɛ amɛhe kpãŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon fã mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Israel maŋ fɛɛ mli koni amɛya ni amɛyato tsei yɛ Lebanon. Aduram ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ amɛnɔ.
Aja mɛi lɛ amli kui etɛ̃. Mɛi akpei nyɔŋma yaa amɛyayeɔ nyɔŋ kome yɛ Lebanon, ni amɛbayeɔ nyɔji enyɔ yɛ shīa.
Solomon yɛ jatsuterelɔi akpei kpawo kɛ tɛgblaɔi akpei kpaanyɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Solomon yɛ mɛi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai etɛ̃ ni kwɛɔ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ni Solomon fã amɛ, ni amɛgbla tɛi agboi kɛba, tɛi ni jra wa koni akɛto shīa lɛ shishi.
Ni Solomon nitsulɔi lɛ kɛ Hiram nitsulɔi lɛ kɛ Giblibii lɛ ko tɛi lɛ, ni amɛsaa tsei kɛ tɛi lɛ koni akɛma tsu lɛ.
6: Solomon nitsulɔi lɛ bɔi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mãa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zif lɛ nɔ. Nakai beiaŋ lɛ Solomon eye maŋtsɛ afii ejwɛ. Israelbii lɛ shi Egipt nɛɛ afii ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ nɛ.
Solomon tsu lɛ kɛkɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃
Koi ko ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kã sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ.
Afee samfɛji awo tsu lɛ he. Samfɛji nɛɛ lɛɛ yɛ mligbɛ fe ekponɔ gbɛ.
Amamɔ ŋwɛi tsui sɔɔdoi etɛ̃ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ sɛɛ kɛ ekoŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ. Ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fioo.

Tsui ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ kwraa lɛ ekome lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ. Nii ni yɔɔ teŋ lɛ, ekome lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa, ni nii ni yɔɔ yiteŋ kwraa lɛ, ekome lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi kpawo. Afee kpokui yɛ tsu lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe kɛkpe, bɔ ni afee ni nɔsɛŋmɔ mplaŋi lɛ akabote tsu lɛ gbogboi lɛ amli.
Tɛi ni akɛmã tsu lɛ ako fɛɛ yɛ tɛgbamɔ he lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akanu hamle loo lema loo dade ko naa he be ni amãa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
Tsu ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ kwraa lɛ shinaa lɛ naa kã Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ninejurɔgbɛ, no ji wuoyigbɛ; ni akwɔɔ atrakpoi lɔgɔligi lɔgɔligi ko kɛyaa teŋ pia lɛ kɛ pia ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli.
Solomon tswa tsu lɛ egbe naa, ni ekɛ tsenedru mplaŋi kɛ sɛsɛo ŋmoŋmlo sɛŋ nɔ.
Ŋwɛi tsui etɛ̃ ni amãmɔ kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ. Ni akɛ tsenedru tso mɔmɔ amɛ akpɛtɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Solomon akɛ,
"Tsu ni omãa nɛɛ, kɛji oooye mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni oooto mikitãi lɛ fɛɛ, ni oooba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ mafee nɔ ni miwo otsɛ David shi yɛ he lɛ mahã o.
Mahi shi yɛ nyɛ Israelbii ateŋ. Mikwaŋ mimaŋ Israel kɔkɔɔkɔ."
Bɔ ni Solomon fee ema tus lɛ nɛ.
Akɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmlo ha tsu lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe, kɛjɛ shishi kɛyashi ŋwɛi nɔsɛŋmɔ tsei lɛ anaa. Ni akɛ sɛsɛo ka sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ amã no yɛ sɔlemɔtsu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Ni akɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmlo fo ekɛ sɔlemɔtsu lɛ teŋ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi.
Ni tsu ni ji Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni eyɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Tsenedru ŋmoŋmlo ni akɛha tsu lɛ mli lɛ ayeyee fɔfɔi kɛ akpaki sãmãi awo he. Ŋmoŋmlo lɛ eha tɛi lɛ anɔ, hewɔ lɛ anaaa tɛi lɛ ekome nɛkɛ.
Tsu ni amã yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mligbɛ kwraa lɛ jɛi akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mã.
Tsu lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, elɛɛmɔ hu ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi eha tsu lɛ mli fɛɛ; shi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmlo akɛha he.
Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha tsu lɛ hu mli. Ni akɛ shika kɔ̃sɔŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i fo afabaŋ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ tsu lɛ hiɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni shīa lɛ aye emuu hewɔ lɛ, asaa akɛ sika ŋmiiŋmi ha mli fɛɛ. Aha afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ tete ni yɔɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi.
Ni akɛ mutso gbɔ kerubii enyɔ ni kwɔlɔmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma awo He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kerubi fine kome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ; no hewɔ lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.
Ni kerubi kroko lɛ hu fine lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma. Kerubii enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ adramɔ kome kɛ su kome.
Kerubi kome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni ekroko lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Solomon kɛ kerubii lɛ nɛɛ wo mligbɛ tsu lɛ teŋ: Kerubii lɛ egbɛgbɛɛ amɛfijiaŋ, bɔ ni ekome fine saa gbogbo kome he, ni kerubi kroko lɛ fine saa gbogboi kroko lɛ he. Amɛfiji lɛ kpeɔ yɛ tsu lɛ teŋ.
Ni akɛ shika ehã kerubii lɛ ahe.
Ni aye kerubii kɛ tɛŋ kɛ fɔfɔii ni egblegblee sãmãi yɛ shīa lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe, yɛ mligbɛ kɛ kponɔgbɛ fɛɛ.
Ni shīa lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi eka mli.
Akɛ mutso shinaa nta ta He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa. Shinaa lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ tsei enyɔ lɛ kpeɔ yɛ shinaa lɛ yiteŋ.
Ni mutso shinaa nta nɛɛ aye kerubii kɛ tɛŋi kɛ fɔfɔji ni egblegblee sãmãi yɛ amɛhe. Ni akɛ shika eha fɛɛ he.
Nakai nɔŋŋ akɛ mutso kpɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naagbɛ shinaa lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ tsei lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ.
Akɛ sɛsɛo kpɛ shinaa nta; ni shinaa kroko lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ hu adɔrɔɔ. Ni shinaa kroko lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ hu adɔrɔɔ.
Ni aye kerubii kɛ tɛŋi kɛ fɔfɔii ni egblegblee sãmãi awo he; ni akɛ shika eha he fɛɛ.
Ni akɛ tɛ ni ako kɛ tsenedru mplaŋi mã mligbɛ kpo lɛ. Kɛ atswa tɛ klɛmpɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, akɛ tsenedru mplaŋ klɛmpɛ kome foɔ mli.
Solomon maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ Zif nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ, ato Yehowa we lɛ fanesi lɛ shishi.
Ni afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ, yɛ Bul nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ agbe Yehowa shīa lɛ kɛ ehewɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ naa. Bɔ ni ato ehe gbɛjianɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amã lɛ. Afii kpawo akɛmã tsu lɛ.
7: Solomon ma maŋtsɛ we ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. Ekɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ mã fɛɛ egbe naa. 2-3. Emã Asa ko ni akɛ Lebanon tsenedru tso eha mli fɛɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ; ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Amã yɛ akulashiŋi koji ejwɛ anɔ. Koŋ kome hiɛ akulashiŋ nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɔoɔ akpalei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ. Ni akɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmlo esɛŋ tsu nɛɛ nɔ.
Ni gbogboi enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ samfɛji etɛ̃tɛ̃ɛ̃tɛ̃. Eko miikwɛ eko hiɛ.
Shinai etɛ̃tɛ̃ɛ̃tɛ̃ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ kɛyaa asa wulu lɛ hiɛgbɛ. Eko miikwɛ eko hiɛ.
Akɛ akulashiŋi efee koi ko, ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Ni akpãtãŋ leleoo ko ble asa lɛ hiɛ ni aha nɔ.
Solomon maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ, emã kojomɔ saa lɛ nɔ, he ni ayeɔ sane yɛ lɛ. Akɛ tsenedru tso eka mli fɛɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi.
Solomon diɛŋtsɛ shīa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaahi mli lɛ yɛ kpo kroko nɔ, yɛ kojomɔ asa lɛ sɛɛ. Amã lɛ tamɔ kojomɔ asa lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ni Solomon mã shīa hu ehã eŋa ni ji Farao biyoo lɛ. Shīa nɛɛ tamɔ enɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ.

Tsui nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ asa wulu lɛ, akɛ tɛi ni jra wa, tɛi ni asusu ni ako, ni amɛsɛɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɛ akplala esaa he. Akɛka mli kɛjɛ shishi kɛyashi sɔɔdoi lɛ anaa tɔ̃ɔ. Afee lɛ nakai kɛjɛ Yehowa agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi kpo wulu lɛ nɔ.
Ni fanesi lɛ, tɛi ni jra wa sɔŋŋ ni. Amɛdra kplekplei diɛŋtsɛ. Tɛi lɛ ekomɛi aklɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi kpaanyɔ, ni ekomɛi hu ninetslɔi nyɔŋma.
Tɛi ni jra wa ni asusu ni ako ni; tsenedru tso akɛtswa nɔ.

Ni kpo wulu bɔle he kɛkpe. Be ni atswaa lɛ, kɛji atswa tɛ ni ako klɛmpɛi etɛ lɛ, Kɛkɛ lɛ akɛ tsenedru mplaŋ klɛmpɛ̃ kome efɔ̃ nɔ dani atswaa ekroko hu. Nakai nɔŋŋ afee Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kpo lɛ kɛ shīa lɛ he koi lɛ hu.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu ni ayaŋɔ Huram kɛjɛ Tiro kɛba.

Yoo okulafo ko ni jɛ Naftali akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi nuu ji lɛ; shi etsɛ lɛ Tironyo ni. Eji akɔɔble ŋaalɔ ni nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ ŋaa eyi lɛ obɔ̃. Akɔɔble nitsumɔ mli lɛ ehe esa po ni ehiii. Lɛ eba Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔɔ, ni ebatsu enii lɛ fɛɛ ehã lɛ.
Huram fee akɔɔble akulasiŋi enyɔ emãmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. Ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ; ni emlitilɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Ni eshwie akɔɔble yiteŋ kpɔi enyɔ; ni ekɛmãmɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ. Ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Ni ntaŋi ni alo, kɛ fɔfɔii akekrei ni agbɔ tamɔ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i yɛ kpɔi ni yɔɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ lɛ ahe; kpawo yɛ kpɔ kome he, ni kpawo yɛ kpɔ kome hu he.
Ni afee kpɔbii kokrobii klɛmpɛi enyɔ awo ntaŋ lɛ he kɛkpe; ni akɛha akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ni kpɔi ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ yɛ koi lɛ shi lɛ afee amɛ tamɔ fɔfɔii. Amɛkwɔlɔmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ.
Ni yiteiaŋ kpɔi lɛ yɛ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ayiteiaŋ tamɔ akpakii ni amɛyɛ ntaŋ lɛ sɛɛ. Kpɔbii kokrobii lɛ ayibɔ ji ohai enyɔ; ni ato amɛ srɛ̃nɛ̃ɛ yɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ahe.
Huram kɛ akulashiŋi enyɔ nɛɛ mãmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ koi lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. Ni ninejurɔ gbɛ akulashiŋ lɛ awo lɛ Yakin; ni nɔ ni yɔɔ abɛku gbɛ lɛ awo lɛ Boaz.
Afee akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ tamɔ fɔfɔii ni egba. Bɔ ni agbe akulashiŋi lɛ ahe ntsimɔi lɛ anaa nɛ.
Huram fee akɔɔble gbudgbaŋ. Emlikwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma; ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ. Ekutruku mli kɛbɔle lɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Akɛ akɔble fee akpakii kɛbɔle gbudugbaŋ lɛ toi. Ninetalɔi kome hiɛ nyɔŋma. Ato amɛ srɛ̃nɛ̃i enyɔ kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
Akɔɔble gbudgbaŋ nɛɛ mã akɔɔble tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ akotosɛɛ. Etɛ̃ miikwɛ kooyigbɛ; ni etɛ̃ miikwɛ anaigbɛ, ni etɛ̃ miikwɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni etɛ̃ miikwɛ bokãgbɛ; shi amɛsɛɛ gbɛ eyaje mligbɛ.
Etilɛ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ. Ni afee enaabu tamɔ kpulu naabu, tamɔ oflɔ fɔfɔi ni egble enaa; eyeɔ nu litai aaafee akpei ejwɛ.
Huram kɛ akɔɔble fee shwiilii bibii nyɔŋma. Ekome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃,
Bɔ ni afee shwilii lɛ nɛ. Amɛyɛ naabaŋmɔnii ni afee akpɛtɛ shwilii lɛ.
Ni naabaŋmɔnii nɛɛ, afee jatai kɛ tsinai kɛ kerubii amãgãi yɛ nɔ. Afee fɔfɔii hu yɛ he.
Shwiilii fɛɛ shwiili yɛ akɔɔble kokrolontoi ejwɛ kɛ akɔɔble kokrolonto mlitsei. Ni waomɔnii mamɔ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ. Ni waomɔnii lɛ asɔo akpɛtɛ gbudugbaŋ lɛ; afee fɔfɔi akekre sãmãi awo fɛɛ he.
Ni kuɛ ni mã naabuma nɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome. Ni eyiteŋgbɛ lɛ atɛ̃ mli tamɔ sɛ̃i. Ni emli kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni aye sãmãi yɛ he kɛkpe.
Kokrolontoi ejwɛ yɛ naabaŋmɔnii lɛ shishi. Amɛkwɔlɔmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Ni kokrolontoi lɛ afee amɛ tamɔ shwiili naji. Naji lɛ anaabaŋmɔ nii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ amlitsei lɛ kɛ amliblɛmɔtsei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akɔɔble akɛfee.
Ni shwiili fɛɛ shwiili yɛ waomɔnii yɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ he. Ni asɔo akpɛtɛ shwiili lɛ yɛ shishigbɛ.
Ni shwiili lɛ yiteŋ lɛ afee naabaŋmɔ nii ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ fã. Ni nɔbumɔ nɔ lɛ kɛ waomɔnii lɛ asɔo akpɛtɛ.
Ni waomɔnɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ naabaŋmɔ nɔ lɛ he lɛ, kerubii kɛ jatai kɛ tɛŋ sãmãi yɛ nɔ, bɔ ni aaaho nɔ. Ni akɛ fɔfɔi akekre ebɔle amɛ kɛkpe.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee shwiili nyɔŋmɔ lɛ: Amɛ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, amɛsu kɛ amɛdramɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Huram fee akɔɔble botokui nyɔŋma. Shwiili fɛɛ shwiili nɔ ekome. Botoku kome mli lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Ni eyeɔ nu litai ohai kpaanyɔ.
Ekɛ shwiili enumɔ mãmɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ wuoyigbɛ; ni ekɛ enumɔ hu mamɔ ekooyigbɛ. Ekɛ gbudugbaŋ wulu lɛ ma Sɔlemɔwe lɛ wuoyi bokãgbɛ.
Huram fee gbɛi kɛ jwɛiloomɔnii kɛ lalakãi. Huram gbe nitsumɔ ni etsu ehã Maŋtsɛ Solomon yɛ Yehowa we lɛ fɛɛ naa.
Nibii ni Huram fee lɛ nɛ: Akulashiŋi enyɔ kɛ kpɔi kokrobii enyɔ ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ayiteiaŋ. Efee ntaŋi ni akɛha kpɔi kokrobii enyɔ ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi ayiteiaŋ lɛ ahe.
Ni efee ntaŋi enyɔ lɛ ahe kpɔbii kokrobii ohai ejwɛ: Kpɔbii kokrobii srɛ̃nɛ̃i enyɔ yɛ ntaŋ kome he. Afee enɛɛmɛi akɛha kpɔbii kokrobii ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ lɛ ahe.
Huram fee shwiili nyɔŋma kɛ botokui nyɔŋma ni mãmɔ shwiili lɛ anɔ.
Efee gbudugbaŋ agbo kome kɛ tsina amãgai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni emã nɔ.
Huram fee gbɛ̃i kɛ jwɛiloomɔnii kɛ lalakãi. Nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɔɔble ni atsuu he kaŋkaŋ akɛfee ahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon koni akɛsaa Yehowa shīa lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã afee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ Yordan ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ shika shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Sukot kɛ Zaretan teŋ lɛ mli.
Nibii lɛ ayifalɛ sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, Solomon eŋmɛɛɛ koni ena eyikulɛ. Akɔɔble lɛ hu aleee naa.
Solomon fã, ni afee shika nibii hu awo Yehowa we lɛ. Nibii nɛɛ ji: Shika afɔleshãa latɛ kɛ shika okplɔ̃ ni akɛ hiɛmãa aboloo lɛ mãa nɔ lɛ.
Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee kanetsei ni mãmɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, enumɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni enumɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ. Akɛ shika fee fɔfɔii lɛ kɛ kanei lɛ kɛ abɛɛlei lɛ hu.
Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee kai kɛ lalakãi kɛ likɔlikɔi kɛ lajee ŋɛsui; He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛ Sɔlesmɔtsu lɛ naa shinai lɛ asɛɛ sai lɛ hu shika akɛfee.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon gbe Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ nibii fɛɛ ni etsɛ David ejɔɔ nɔ eke, ni ji jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ kɛba ekɛbato Yehowa we lɛ nitoohe lɛ mli.
8: Kɛkɛ ni Solomon bua Israel akutsei kɛ wekui onukpai lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ alumɛi lɛ anaa kɛkpe yɛ Yerusalem yɛ eŋɔɔ, koni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛjɛ Zion ni ji David maŋ lɛ mli kɛba Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli.
Israelbii fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔɔ. Afee enɛ be ni ayeɔ Asesei Agbijurɔ yɛ nyɔŋ lɛ ni ji kpawo lɛ ni ji Etanim nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israel onukpai lɛ bua amɛhe naa lɛ, Osɔfoi lɛ bawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hole Kpee Buu lɛ mli nibii Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni ebuabua amɛhe naa lɛ ho damɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛgbegbee toi kɛ tsinai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni anyɛɛɛ naa abu aloo akane amɛyibɔ tete, ni akɛshã afɔle.
Ni Osɔfoi lɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee, ni amɛkɛyama egbɛhe yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ mli yɛ kerubii lɛ afiji ashishi.
Ni amɛfiji ni amɛgbɛ mli lɛ ha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ ni akɛwoɔ adeka lɛ anɔ.
Tsei lɛ klɛ bɔ ni anaa amɛnaabui kɛji mɔ ko damɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ. Shi anaa yɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ. Tsei nɛɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ Adeka lɛ mli akɛ ja tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni Mose ŋɔto mli yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Yehowa kɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãŋ yɛ, be ni amɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbaa lɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni osɔfoi lɛ je He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ, atatu bayi Yehowa We lɛ mli.
Ebayi Yehowa We lɛ mli bɔ ni osɔfoi lɛ nyɛɛɛ shi adamɔ tete ni amɛsɔmɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa anumnyam lɛ eyi Yehowa We lɛ obɔ̃ tɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon sɔle ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛɛ akɛ, 'Duŋ kpii mli mahi.'
Agbɛnɛ mimã tsu mihã o ni ohi mli, he ni ohi kɛya naanɔ!"
Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ damɔ shi, kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã amɛ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ fɛɛ.
Ekɛɛ, "Ajɔɔ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni wo mitsɛ David shi, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ lɛ ehã eshiwoo lɛ eba mli.

Nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni miyajie mimaŋ Israel kɛjɛ Egipt kɛba nɛɛ, mihalako maŋ ko maŋ ko yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ ni emã tsu koni aja mi yɛ mli. Shi mikɔ bo David pɛ koni oye mimaŋ Israel nɔ.'
Mitsɛ David to eyiŋ akɛ eeema tsu ehã Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi.
Shi Yehowa kɛ mitsɛ David wie akɛ, 'Ehi akɛ oto oyiŋ akɛ obaama shīa ohã mi, ni ofee jogbaŋŋ akɛ oto oyiŋ nakai.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bo ooomã tsu lɛ; shi moŋ omusuŋ bi lɛ lɛji mɔ ni eeemã tsu ehã mi koni aja mi yɛ jɛi.'

"Ni amrɔ nɛɛ, Yehowa ehã ewiemɔ lɛ eba mli, ejaakɛ miye mitsɛ najiaŋ, ni mibata Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa wo shi lɛ. Ni mimã tsu lɛ mihã Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni aja lɛ yɛ jɛi;
ni mito he ko hu yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli mihã Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, nɔ mli ni tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ lɛ, tɛi ni aŋmã kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, be ni amɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbaa, yɛ nɔ lɛ".
Solomon ho edamɔ Yehowa afɔlɛshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni egbɛ enijiaŋ kɛtee ŋwɛi,
ni ekɛɛ, "Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ! Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ŋwɛi yɛ yiteŋ gbɛ loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ shishigbɛ ni tamɔ bo, ni otoɔ kpãŋmɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ohãa otsuji ni boɔ bo toi kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ.
Oye shi ni owo mitsɛ, David, otsulɔ lɛ nɔ. Okɛ onaabu wie, ni oto he nine pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ohã eba mli, taakɛ eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa o fai koni oye oshi hu ni owo mitsɛ David otsulɔ lɛ nɔ. Nɔni owie akɛ, 'Nuu ni aaata Israel Maŋtsɛ Sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ebɔŋ o yɛ mihiɛ, kɛji obii lɛ aaale amɛhenɔkwɛmɔ, ni amɛba amɛjeŋ yɛ mihiɛ, taakɛ oba ojeŋ yɛ lɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa o fai, hã shi ni owo mitsɛ David, otsulɔ lɛ, fɛɛ aba mli.
"Aso bo Nyɔŋmɔ, ooobahi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lo! Naa, ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi nyɛɛɛ o ato, aahuu ni Sɔlemɔtsu nyɔŋɔsiɔii nɛɛ ni mimã nɛɛ!
Shi kɛ̃lɛ hã otsulɔ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ lɛ asa ohiɛ, Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, koni obo blɔmɔ ni mi, otsulɔ, miblɔɔ kɛ sɔlemɔ ni misɔleɔ yɛ ohiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ toi.
Ofai nɛ, ohiŋmɛi ahi nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ he nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane, he ni okɛɛ yɛ he akɛ, 'Migbɛi aaahi jɛi lɛ', koni obo mi, otsulɔ, mifai ni mikpaa bo yɛ biɛ nɛɛ toi.
Ni obo mi, otsulɔ, kɛ omaŋ Israel fai ni amɛaakpa o yɛ biɛ lɛ toi, ni onu yɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ, ni kɛji onu lɛ oŋɔfa!
"Kɛji mɔ ko fee enaanyo esha, ni ahã lɛ kitã ni ekã yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ hiɛ yɛ shīa nɛɛ lɛ,
no lɛ bo toi yɛ ŋwɛi koni okojo otsuji lɛ; buu atɛŋ, mɔ ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ buu lɛ fɔ, ni enii abua eyiteŋ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ bem, lɛ buu lɛ bem ni eŋɔ ehe eye tswaa.
Kɛji omaŋ Israel henyɛlɔi ye amɛnɔ yɛ esha ko ni amɛfee amɛshi o hewɔ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbakpa eshaifaa he fai, yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ mli lɛ,
no lɛ bo toi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni oŋɔ omaŋ Israel he esha lɛ ofa amɛ, ni oŋɔ amɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ ni oŋɔhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
"Kɛji omaŋ Israelbii fee esha, ni no hewɔ otsi nunɛmɔ naa, ni omaŋbii lɛ basɔle yɛ biɛ, ni amɛbo amɛtsɛ o, ni amɛshwa amɛhe yɛ piŋmɔ ni opiŋ amɛ hewɔ lɛ,
no lɛ bo toi koni oŋɔ otsuji kɛ omaŋ lɛ he esha lɛ ofa amɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɔ kpakpa feemɔ, ní ohã nu anɛ ashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ ni oŋɔhã omaŋ lɛ nɔ.

"Kɛji hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji gbele hela ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji aharabata kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la ŋla nii ni adu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsɔle lɛ, bo toi. Kɛji baalabii baye nii lɛ jio, no hu bo amɛ toi. Kɛji omaŋbii ahenyɛlɔi basa amɛyi wo amɛmaji amli yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ, loo gbele hela ko ba lɛ,

no lɛ bo amɛsɔlemɔ toi. Sɔlemɔ fɛɛ sɔlemɔ ni aaasɔle, fai fɛɛ fai ni aaakpa o yɛ shīa nɛɛ, mɔ kome mɔ kome ni jio, mɛi kutuu ni jio,aloo omaŋ Isreal fɛɛ fee esha jio, kɛ mɛi ni le nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kã amɛtsui nɔ, ni amɛbagbɛ amɛnijiaŋ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɛkɛ shīa nɛɛ lɛ,
no lɛ bo amɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ koni oŋɔfa. Ni oye obua mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enifeemɔnii anaa, ejaakɛ bo okome too pɛ ole gbɔmɛi adesai atsuiiaŋ. Okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye bɔ pɛ ni sa lɛ,
bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe o gbeyei, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni oŋɔhã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
"Ni gbɔ tete ni jɛɛ omaŋ Israelbii ateŋ, shi moŋ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ eeejɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ eba,
ejaakɛ maŋsɛɛ bii aaanu ogbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ nii wuji ni ofee he, ni eeebashã afɔle yɛ nɛkɛ shīa nɛɛŋ lɛ,

no lɛ bo lɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ, ni ofee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbɔ lɛ boɔ tsɛɔ o yɛ he lɛ ohã lɛ. Enɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji fɛɛ ale ogbɛi lɛ koni amɛja o tamɔ omaŋ Isrealbii feɔ lɛ. Ni amɛsaa amɛaana amɛle akɛ ogbɛi aŋɔwo nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni mimã kɛhã ojamɔ nɛɛ.
Kɛji ohä omaŋ lɛ fã ta koni amɛkɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ayawu, ni amɛsɔle amɛkpa o fai yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ, shi amɛhiɛ miikwɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala kɛ Solemɔtsu nɛɛ ni mimã mihã o nɛɛ lɛ,
no lɛ bo amɛsɔlemɔ kɛ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ toi yɛ oŋwɛi ni ohã amɛye kunim.
"Kɛji amɛfee esha amɛshi o, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni efeee esha, ni omli fu amɛ, ni ohã amɛhenyɛlɔi ye amɛnɔ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee henyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ nɔ, shɔŋŋ ni jio kpaakpa ni jio,
ni amɛshwa amɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ he ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛjaje amɛtɔ̃mɔ̃i amɛtsɔ̃ɔ o, ni amɛkpa o fai lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, bo amɛsɔlemɔ lɛ toi.
Kɛji amɛshwa amɛhe anɔkwale mli yɛ nakai nomŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsɔle be ni amɛmiikwɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛblematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni mamã mihã o nɛɛ lɛ,
no lɛ bo amɛsɔlemɔ kɛ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ toi yɛ oŋwɛi ji oshihilɛhe lɛ, ni oye obua amɛ.
Ni ŋɔɔ ofa omaŋ ni efee esha lɛ eshi o kɛ efɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ. Hã amɛnomŋɔlɔi lɛ amusuŋ atsɔ̃ amɛ yɛ amɛhe ni amɛna amɛ mɔbɔ.
Ejaakɛ omaŋ kɛ onii ni ojie amɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛ dade flɔnɔɔ mli, ji amɛ.
Wo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋ Israelbii, ni obo amɛ toi be fɛɛ be ni amɛaablɔ amɛtsɛ o lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ. Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, oŋɔ amɛ ohã ohe, ni okɛ amɛ fee omaŋ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, taakɛ owo shi kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ, be ni ojie wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛjɛ Egipt lɛ."
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon egbe sɔlemɔ kɛ fai ni ekpa Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ, ete shi kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, he ni ekūla ni egbɛ enijaŋ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ lɛ.
Eho edamɔ shi, ni eba Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ehã Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ekɛɛ,
"Ajie Yehowa, mɔ ni ehã emaŋ Israel toiŋjɔlɛ taakɛ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Eshiwoi kpakpai fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Mose nɔ ewo lɛ, emli wiemɔ lɛ ekome flo nɛkɛ efeko yaka.
Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ wɔ ahi shi, taakɛ bɔ ni ekɛ wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ hi shi lɛ. Ekashi wɔ, ni esaa ekakwa wɔ hu.
Ehã ni wɔbo lɛ toi kɛ wɔtsui fɛɛ, koni wɔhi shi bɔ ni etaoɔ. Wɔye ekitãi kɛ emlai ni ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ni Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ ahi misɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔi nɛɛ anɔ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ, koni eye ebua mi, etsulɔ, kɛ emaŋ Israel be fɛɛ be ni nɔ ko aaahia wɔ lɛ.
Enɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Yehowa pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ he ko dɔŋŋ.

Nyɛ Yehowa webii, nyɛyea Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anɔkwa, nyɛyea ekpɔi kɛ ekitãi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ ŋmɛnɛ." 62-63. Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛɛ fɛɛ shã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa: Tsina akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ toi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni amɛkɛgbele Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa.

Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ maŋtsɛ jɔɔ kpo lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hiɛ lɛ nɔ efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ jɛi eshã shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ kooloo muu afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ afɔi lɛ yɛ. Efee nakai ejaakɛ akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ ni mã Yehowa hiɛ lɛ edaaa, bɔ ni shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ ahe fɔi lɛ aaaho nɔ.
Solomon kɛ Israel maŋ muu fɛɛ ye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo. Asafo yuu diɛŋtsɛ ba kɛjɛ Hamat niiaŋ yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ Egipt niiaŋ yɛ wuoyigbɛ fɛɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Solomon wo asafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ amɛtee. Amɛjie eyi, ni amɛtee shīa kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni Yehowa efee etsulɔ David emaŋ Israel lɛ hewɔ.
9: Be ni Solomon egbe Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ shīa lɛ mãa kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Solomon taoɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ efee lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ,
Yehowa bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Solomon, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ Gibeon lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minu osɔlemɔ kɛ ofai ni okpa yɛ mihiɛ lɛ. Mitsuu Sɔlemɔwe ni omã nɛɛ he, koni aja mi yɛ jɛi kɛya naanɔ. Mihiŋmɛi kɛ mitsui aaahi he daa.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛji oooba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni otsɛ David fee yɛ tsuijurɔ kɛ jalɛ mli, ni oooye mlai kɛ mikpɔi kɛ mikitãi ni miwo o lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ,
no lɛ maye shi ni miwo otsɛ David lɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Bo oshwiei amli aaajɛ aye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ daa' lɛ.
Shi kɛji bo loo oshwie kpale kɛje misɛɛ, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi kɛ mikkpɔi ni mikɛshwie nyɛhiɛ lɛ anɔ, shi nyɛaaya nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ,

no lɛ makpãtã Israel hiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ ni miŋɔhã amɛ lɛ nɔ. Makwa nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔwe nɛɛ ni mifee lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mihã mihe akɛ jɛi aaaja mi yɛ lɛ. Mɛi aaaye Israel he fɛo, ni eeetsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ yɛ maji krokomɛi ateŋ.
Nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔwe nɛɛ baabutu kwraa, bɔ ni kɛji mɔ ko baho ni ena lɛ, ehe baajɔ̃ ehe, ni eeebo, 'Tsiaa!' Mɛi aaabi akɛ, 'Te eba tɛŋŋ ni Yehowa fee shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe nɛɛ nɛkɛ?'

Ni aaahere nɔ akɛ, 'Ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛnya nyɔŋmɔi krokromɛi ahe, ni amɛja amɛ, ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ. Enɛ hewɔ Yehowa hã nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ eba amɛnɔ lɛ.'"
Solomon ye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ekɛmamɔ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.
Akɛni Tiro maŋtsɛ Hiram lɛ baha Solomon tsenedru tsei kɛ sɛsɛo kɛ shika, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni etaoɔ, hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon hu hã Hiram maji wuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ Galilea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni Hiram jɛ Tiro ebakwɛ maji ni Solomon kɛhã lɛ lɛ, eyasumɔɔɔ maji lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ, "Minyɛmi, mɛɛ maji okɛhã mi nɛɛ?" No hewɔ lɛ Hiram tsɛ maji lɛ 'Kabul' kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi Hiram emaje Maŋtsɛ Solomon shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.

Bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon nyɛ maŋbii lɛ anɔ kɛmā Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ekɛ nɔnyɛɛ saa shikpɔŋ ni kã Yerusalem bokãgbɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni etswa jɛi gbogbo lɛ kɛ Hazor kɛ Megido kɛ Gezer maji wuji lɛ hu.
Egipt maŋtsɛ fã ta eyatua Gezer, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ, ni eshã maŋ lɛ, ni egbe Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ ehã ebi yoo ni ji Solomon ŋa lɛ akɛ gblãyaa nikee.
No hewɔ lɛ Solomon saa maŋ lɛ emã. No sɛɛ lɛ ekɛ nɔnyɛɛ mã Gezer kɛ Bet-Horon ni yɔɔ Jɔɔŋgbɛ lɛ,
kɛ Baalat kɛ Tamar ni yɔɔ Yuda ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon saa emãmɔ maji ni akɛ enibii toɔ amɛmli lɛ fɛɛ: Maji ni atoɔ etayaa shwiilii kɛ maji ni ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi yɔɔ amɛmli, kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwe akɛ emamɔ yɛ Yerusalem kɛ Lebanon kɛ hei ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Amorbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ ni jeee Israelbii ji amɛ lɛ,
amɛ amɛshwiei ni shwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ kpãtãaa amɛhiɛ lɛ ji mɛi ni Solomon nyɛ amɛnɔ kɛtsu nii, ni nakai nyɔji amɛji kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi Israelbii lɛ Solomon eŋɔɔɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko efeee enyɔŋ, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛji esraafoi kɛ elumɛi kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ eshwiiliiatsɛmɛi kɛ ekpɔŋianɔtralɔi.
Nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ onukpai ni kwɛɔ Solomon nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ ayibɔ ji mɛi ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi Egipt maŋtsɛbi yoo lɛ shi David maŋ lɛ mli kɛtee eshīa ni Solomon emã ehã lɛ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Solomon saa shikpɔŋ ni kã Yerusalem bokãgbɛ lɛ hiɛ.

Afi kome mli lɛ, Solomon shãa afɔlei srɔtoi etɛ: Eshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni emã ehã Yehowa lɛ nɔ; ni eshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ nɔ. Belɛ egbe sɔlemɔwe lɛ maa lɛ naa.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kpɛ lɛji babaoo yɛ Ezion-Geber ni bɛŋkɛ Elat yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Hiram famɔ emlakui ni he esa kɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ nitsumɔ, ni amɛkɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsuji lɛ yatsu nii yɛ lɛji lɛ amli.
Amɛtee ofir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyaŋɔ shika ni tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni amɛkɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon.
10: Be ni Sheba maŋnyɛ lɛ nu bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon gbɛi ehehe yɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, efã gbɛ kɛtee Yerusalem, koni eyaka lɛ kɛ saji ni mli wa naakpa.

Maŋnyɛ Sheba kɛ asafo yuu diɛŋtsɛ ba Yerusalem lɛ. Ekɛ yomai ni tere tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ shika babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tɛi ni jra wa ba. Be ni ebashɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon hiɛ lɛ, ebibii Maŋtsɛ lɛ saji babaoo ni ba eyitsoŋ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hã lɛ saji lɛ fɛɛ hetoo, ni eshwɛɛɛ nibimɔ ko ni enyɛɛɛ lɛ hetoo ehã.
Be ni Sheba maŋnyɛ lɛ na Maŋtsɛ Solomon nilee kɛ shīa ni ema lɛ,
kɛ ekplɔ̃ nɔ niyenii kɛ elumɛi ashitramɔ kɛ bɔ ni etsuji ni wo atadei fɛfɛji sɔmɔɔ yɛ niyeniiashi, kɛ shãa afɔlei ni eshãa yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ehe jɔ̃ ehe naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Sheba maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ, "Ohe saji kɛ onilee ni minu he yɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.
Kulɛ miheee miyeee kɛyashi miba, ni mibana kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛi nɛɛ. Ni naa, jeee emli fã tete agba mi lɛ; onilee kɛ oshweremɔ lɛ fa aahuu fe yijiemɔ ni minu lɛ tete.
Ajɔɔ oŋamɛi kɛ otsuji nɛɛ ni sɔmɔɔ bo ni amɛboɔ onilee wiemɔi lɛ toi daa lɛ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, O-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ena ohe tsuijurɔ, ni ekɛ bo eta Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ. Yehowa sumɔɔ Israel kɛmiiya naanɔ. No hewɔ ni ewo bo maŋtsɛ lɛ koni okojo ni oye jalɛ sane."

Agbɛnɛ Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ hã Maŋtsɛ Solomon shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai pii diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tɛi ni jra wa. Kɛjɛ nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsofaikɛŋmai lɛ eko bako dɔŋŋ ni fa babaoo tamɔ nɔ ni Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon lɛ.
Asaŋ Hiram lɛji babaoo lɛ hu ni kɛ shika jɛɔ Ofir baa lɛ kɛ tsei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tɛi ni jra wa jɛ Ofir ba.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ tsei lɛ flɔ afabaŋi ewo Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he. Eŋɔ eko ekɛfee saŋkui kɛ bɛji ehã lalatsɛmɛi lɛ. Akɛ almugtsei nɛɛ eko bako Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ ni hi, ni anako eko dɔŋŋ hu tamɔ nɔ ni akɛba lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ nii ni etaoɔ kɛ nii ni ebi lɛ fɛɛ, dani esro nii ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã Maŋnyɛ Sheba yɛ tsuijurɔ naa. Kɛkɛ ni Maŋnyɛ Sheba kɛ etsuji lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛne afi kome mli lɛ shika ni akɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon lɛ tsiimɔ ji talentai ohia ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa.
Esro shika hu ni jɛɔ jrayelɔi lɛ kɛ guɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ Arabia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ adɛŋ akɛ too ni amɛwoɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon fee tsɛŋi wuji ohai enyɔ, ni ehã akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli ohai ekpaa ha tsɛŋ kome he.
Efee tsɛŋi bibii ohai etɛ, ni akɛ shika ni atswia ni eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji kiloi enyɔ ha tsɛŋi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko he. Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hã aŋɔ fɛɛ ayato Lebanon Koo Asa lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ shwuɔ wu fee maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i kpeteŋkple ko, ni ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha he.

Akwɔɔ atrakpoi ekpaa kɛshɛɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ. Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kpasamɔhe lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, afee lɛ kutruku; ni sɛ̃i lɛ shitamɔhe lɛ, he ko yɛ sɛ̃i lɛ biɛ kɛ ebiɛ ni akɛ niji shwieɔ nɔ; ni jatai enyɔ damɔ he ni akɛ niji shwieɔ lɛ amasɛi.
Ni jitai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ damɔ atrakpoi ekpaa lɛ nɔ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ. Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ko kwraa bɛ maŋtsɛyelihe ko ni tamɔ no.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kpuji fɛɛ ni ekɛnuɔ nii lɛ, shika sɔŋŋ akɛfee; ni nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Lebanon Koo Asa lɛ nɔ lɛ, shika ŋmiiŋmi ni; jwiɛtɛi bɛ mli ejaakɛ abuuu no fɛifɛi yɛ Solomon bei amli.
Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Tarshish lɛji babaoo yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ fata Hiram lɛji lɛ ahe. Ni daa afii etɛ̃ lɛ, elɛji lɛ baa shi kome amɛkɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shwuɔ wu kɛ ofoi kɛ aduji kɛ mɛleoi baa.
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsɔ̃ kpanaa yɛ ninamɔ kɛ nilee mli fe maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
ni jeŋ fɛɛ tao akɛ amɛbana lɛ koni amɛbo enilee ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã lɛ lɛ toi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ba lɛ hiɛ keenii ko kɛba; jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii, atadei wuyawuyai kɛ tawuu nii kɛ tsofakɛŋmai kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi. Daa afi akɛ nibii nɛɛ baa.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon bua tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anaa, ni ena tayaa shwiilii akpe kɛ ohai ejwɛ kɛ okpɔŋnɔtalɔi akpeinyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Eŋɔ amɛteiaŋ mɛi komɛi eto shwiilii amaji lɛ amli, ni eŋɔ mɛi komɛi eto ehe yɛ Yerusalem.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã jwiɛtɛi bu aahuu bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi tsɔ̃ tamɔ tɛ yɛ Yerusalem; nakai nɔŋŋ tsenedru tsei hu fa babaoo tamɔ sikamore tsei yɛ Shefela jɔɔ lɛ he.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa ashɛɔ okpɔŋɔi kɛjɛɔ Egipt kɛ Kilikia; maŋtsɛ lɛ jrayelɔi lɛ yaheɔ lɛ ofoo

Jrayelɔi lɛ yaheɔ tayaa shwiilii ni ekome jra ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli ohai ekpaa; ni eheɔ okpɔŋɔ kome hu jwiɛtɛi shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛjɛɔ Egipt. No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ jrayelɔi nɛɛ anine nɔ nɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ni Hitbii amaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Siriabii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ naa tayaa shwilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ekomɛi amɛheɔ.
11: Maŋtsɛ Solomon sumɔ maŋsɛɛ yei pii yɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ sɛɛ. Ekɛ maŋsɛɛ yei ni jɛ Moab kɛ Amon kɛ Edom kɛ Sidon kɛ Hit shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ hi shi.

Tsɛbelɛ Yehowa ekã Israelbii akitã ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ maŋsɛɛ yei akabotea gblãshihilɛ mli, ejaakɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, amɛaalaka nyɛ koni nyɛyaja amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ." Solomon yasumɔ nɛkɛ maŋsɛɛ yei nɛɛ moŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon Kpee maŋtsɛmɛi abiyei ohai kpawo ni eto hemɛi ohai etɛ̃. Ni nɛkɛ maŋsɛɛ yei nɛɛ hã ekpa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Be ni Solomon gbɔ lɛ, eŋamɛi lɛ etsake lɛ kwraa, ni ekpa yɛ Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni eyayeee Yehowa anɔkwa tamɔ etsɛ David fee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Solomon yaja Astarte, Sidonbii lɛ anyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ Molek, Amonbii lɛ anyɔŋmɔ, ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Solomon fee nɔ ni ji efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni eyeee Yehowa anɔkwa kɛwulaaa shi tamɔ etsɛ David.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon mã jamɔhe ehã Kemosh, Moabbi anyɔŋmɔ ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ, kɛ Molek ni ji Amonbii anyɔŋmɔ ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ hu, yɛ Yerusalem bokãgbɛ.
Ni efee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã eŋamɛi fɛɛ hu ni jɛ majiasɛɛ, mɛi ni shãa tsofakɛŋma kɛ afɔlei hu amɛhãa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mli Solomon, ejaakɛ eje lɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛ: Yehowa mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ shii enyɔ sɔŋŋ lɛ.
Yehowa ewo lɛ enɛ he kitã akɛ ekaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi; shi Solomon yeee kitã ni Yehowa wo lɛ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Solomon akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni oyeee mikpãŋmɔ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ ni miwo o lɛ anɔ lɛ, shɔ̃ kɛ mashɔ̃ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛŋ, ni mikɛaahã otsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ̃, otsɛ David hewɔ lɛ mifeŋ enɛ yɛ oyinɔ; shi obi ni maŋɔ mahã lɛ dɛŋ mashɔ̃ yɛ.
Asaŋ mishɔŋ omaŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛyaŋ; maŋɔ akutso kome mahã obi lɛ, yɛ mitsulɔ Dvid kɛ Yerusalem ni mihala lɛ hewɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa tee henyɛlɔ ko shi ewo Solomon; lɛji Hadad, Edomnyo lɛ; ejɛ Edom odehei aweku mli.
Ejaakɛ David kɛ Edom na ta, ni eye Edom nɔ. Be ni agbe ta lɛ naa lɛ Yoab, David tatsɛ lɛ, tee Edom koni eyafu gbohii lɛ.
Yoab kɛ esɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ hi Edom nyɔji ekpaa, ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yoab gbe hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Edom.
Shi Hadad kɛ Edombii komɛi ni ji etsɛ tsuji lɛ jo foi kɛtee Egipt. No mli lɛ oblanyo fioo ji Hadad.

Amɛfã kɛjɛ Midian kɛtee Paran. Ni amɛŋɔ mɛi komɛi kɛjɛ Paran amɛfata amɛhe kɛtee Egipt, ni amɛtee Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hã Hadad shihilɛhe, ni eto niyenii ehã lɛ, ni esaa ehã lɛ shikpɔŋ hu.
Hadad sane sa Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ jogbaŋŋ aahuu po ni eŋɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa ni ji Maŋnyɛ Tapene lɛ nyɛmi yoo ehã Hadad gblã.
Hadad kɛ Tapene nyɛmi yoo lɛ fɔ ebi nuu Genubat. Tapene tse Genubat fufɔ, ni alɛ lɛ yɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli; ni Genubat kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ hi shi yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.
Be ni Hadad yɔɔ Egipt lɛ, enu akɛ David egbo, ni etatsɛ Yoab lɛ hu egbo. Kɛkɛ ni Hadad yakɛɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya mi diɛŋtsɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Shi Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hadad akɛ, "Mɛni po he hiaa bo yɛ biɛ hewɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ oya bo diɛŋtsɛ oshikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ?" Hadad hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiãaa mi, shi kɛ̃lɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya."
Nyɔŋmɔ tee henyɛlɔ kroko shi ewo Solomon. Lɛji Eliada bi Rezon, mɔ ni jo foi kɛjɛ enuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer ni jɛ Zoba lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.

Rezon bua hii atuatselɔi anaa efata ehe, ni etsɔ̃ amɛhiɛyiɛlɔ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, David eye Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer ni jɛ Zoba nɔ kunim; ni egbe ewebii Siriabii lɛ. Rezon kɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ tee damasko, ni amɛyashi jɛi, ni ewebii lɛ wo lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ.
Etsɔ̃ Israel henyɛlɔ yɛ Solomon yinɔ beiaŋ fɛɛ, ni egba Solomon naa babaoo tamɔ bɔ ni Hadad fee lɛ.
Mɔ ko hu ni te shi wo Maŋtsɛ Solomon ji etsulɔ Yeroboam, ni ji Nebat, Efraimnyo ko ni jɛ Zereda, bi lɛ. Yeroboam nyɛji Zerua, yoo okulafo ko.
Nɔ ni kɛ atuatsemɔ lɛ ba nɛ. Solomon miisaa eetswa Milo ni ji Yerusalem gbogbo ni yɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ. Gbogbo nɛɛ ni yɔɔ etsɛ maŋ lɛ he lɛ he ko ekumɔ.
Solomon yoo akɛ nɛkɛ nuu Yeroboam nɛɛ lɛ, etsuɔ nii waa, hewɔ lɛ ewo lɛ onukpa yɛ nitsulɔi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Manase kɛ Efraimwe lɛ anɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli gbi ko be ni Yeroboam shiɔ Yerusalem lɛ, gbalɔ Ahia, Shilonyo lɛ, yanina lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ. Gbalɔ Ahia wo atade hee kaŋŋ ko. Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ amayɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ahia mɔ etade hee ni ewo lɛ, ni etserɛ mli bibiibii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yeroboam akɛ, "Klɔmɔ kukuji nyɔŋma ohã ohe, ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kɛɛ nɛ, 'Naa, mibashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Solomon dɛŋ, ni maŋɔ akutsei nyɔŋma maha o.
Mitsulɔ David hewɔ kɛ Yerusalem, maŋ ni mikɔ kɛjɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hu hewɔ lɛ, Solomon baaye akutso kome nɔ.

Mibafee enɛ, ejaakɛ Solomon ekwa mi, eyaja Astarte, Sidonbii lɛ anyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ Kemoshi, Moab nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ Molek, Amonbii anyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ebaaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ koni efee jalɛnii ni sa mihiɛ ni eye mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ David fee lɛ.
Shi kɔ̃lɛ mishɔŋ maŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ; shi moŋ mahã eye lumɔ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ. Mafee enɛ yɛ mitsulɔ David mɔ ni mihala ni eye mikitãi kɛ mikpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Mashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Solomon bi dɛŋ, ni maŋɔ emli akutsei nyɔŋma mahã o.
Shi maŋɔ akutso kome mahã ebi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni David shwie ko ahi shi ahã lɛ daa yɛ mihiɛ yɛ Yerusalem, maŋ ni mikɔ mihã mihe koni aja mi yɛ jɛi lɛ.
Yeroboam, mibawo bo maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel ni oye shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ.

Kɛji ooobo mi toi,ni oooye kitai ni miwoɔ bo lɛ nɔ, ni oooba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ, ni ooofee nɔ ni ja yɛ mihiɛ, ni oooye mikpɔi kɛ mikitãi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni mitsulɔ David fee lɛ, no lɛ mi kɛ o aaahi shi; mawo bo Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni mahã oshwiei aye lumɔ yɛ osɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mifee mihã David lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ magbla David shwiei lɛ atoi; shi jeee kɛmiiya naanɔ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ Solomon tao Yeroboam egbe, shi Yeroboam jo foi oya kɛtee Egipt Maŋtsɛ Shishak ŋɔɔ, ni eyahi jɛi aahuu kɛyashi Solomon gbo.
Agbɛnɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Solomon fee kɛ enitsumɔ kɛ enilee lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Solomon he Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Bei abɔ ni Solomon ye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem ji afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Solomon gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛ David maŋ lɛ mli, ni ebi Rehoboam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
12: Rehoboam yiŋ etee Shekem ejaakɛ Israel fɛɛ eba Shekem koni amɛbawo lɛ maŋtsɛ.
Be ni Nebat bi, Yeroboam, mɔ ni jo foi yɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon naa etee eyatee ehe yɛ Egipt lɛ, nu sane nɛɛ he lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Egipt eba.
Maŋbii ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ akutsei lɛ amli tsu koni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba. Kɛkɛ ni Yeroboam kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ba, ni amɛbakɛɛ Rehoboam akɛ
"Otsɛ Solomon hã wɔtsu nii keketee diɛŋtsɛ. No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛji ooogbɔ wɔtɔlɛ kɛ deŋmegbomɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔsɔmɔ o, ni wɔɔfee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ."
Rehoboam kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa dã; ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ nyɛba miŋɔɔ koni nyɛbahe hetoo." No hewɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ lɛ shi lɛ amɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam bi ŋaawoo kɛjɛ onukpai ni sɔ̃mɔ etsɛ Solomon, be ni eyɔɔ jeŋ lolo lɛ adɛŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ ŋaa nyɛwoɔ mi yɛ sane ni maŋbii nɛɛ ebabi mi lɛ hetoo he?"
Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Kɛji ooofee ohe tsulɔ ohã nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ, ni ooosɔmɔ, ni ooobo amɛtoi, ni okɛ amɛ aaawie yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, no lɛ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ otsuji kɛya naanɔ."
Shi Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam kwa onukpai lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ, ni ekɛ oblahii ni ji etipɛŋfoi ni ekɛje nɔ ni agbɛnɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ moŋ tee ajina.
Ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ ŋaa nyɛ hu nyɛwoɔ ni wɔkɛhã maŋbii nɛɛ ni bakɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Feemɔ jatsu kɛ tsiimɔ ni otsɛ kɛtre wɔ lɛ huyɛɛ ohã wɔ lɛ?'"

Ni oblahii ni ji etipɛŋfoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Maŋbii lɛ ni kɛ bawie akɛ, 'Otsɛ kɛ jatsu ni tsii diɛŋtsɛ tere wɔ, shi bo lɛ feemɔ jatsu lɛ huyɛɛ ohã wɔ lɛ', bɔ ni okɛɛ amɛ nɛ, 'Miwoa sɛɛkpelɔ ti fe mitsɛ hɛ.
Agbɛnɛ eyɛ mli akɛ mitsɛ hã nyɛtsu nii keketee moŋ nɛ, shi mi lɛ, maha nyɛ tsu nii keketee fe nakai. Mitsɛ kɛ kplebii yi nyɛ, shi mi lɛ mikɛ dade kplebi baayi nyɛ!'"
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ Yeroboam kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ba Rehoboam ŋɔɔ taakɛ bɔ ni Rehoboam eto amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa dã, ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ nyɛba miŋɔɔ koni nyɛbahe hetoo" lɛ.
Rehoboam hã maŋ lɛ hetoo gbonyo. Ekwa ŋaa ni onukpai lɛ wo lɛ lɛ.

Ekɛ amɛ wie yɛ oblahii lɛ aŋaa ni amɛwo lɛ lɛ naa akɛ, "Miwao sɛɛkpelɔ ti fe mitsɛ hɛ. Eyɛ mli akɛ mitsɛ hã nyɛtsu nii keketee moŋ nɛ, shi mi lɛ, mahã nyɛtsu nii keketee fe nakai. Mitsɛ kɛ kplebii yi nyɛ, shi mi lɛ, mikɛ dade kplebii baayi nyɛ!"
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam booo maŋbii lɛ toi, ejaakɛ Yehowa dɛŋ sane lɛ jɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa ahã ewiemɔ ni etsɔ̃ Ahia, Shilonyo lɛ, nɔ ni ekɛ Nebat bi Yeroboam wie lɛ aba mli.

Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam eŋɔɔ onukpai lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ, maŋbii lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Ani wɔyeɔ David gboshinii ko lo? Wɔyeee Yishai bi David nii. Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔshīai amli. Rehoboam, agbɛnɛ kwɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owe nɔ!" Hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ yiŋ Kɛtee amɛshīai amli.
Shi Rehoboam ye Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yuda kpokpai anɔ maji lɛ amli lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛ.

Shi Matsɛ Rehoboam tsu Adoram, mɔ ni kwɛɔ nitsulɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛtee Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ; shi amɛtswia lɛ tɛ, ni amɛgbe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam he fee oya, ni ebote etayaa shwiili mli, ni ejo foi kɛtee Yerusalem.
Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ, Israel Kooyigbɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tse David we lɛ hiɛ atūa kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

Be ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ Yeroboam eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Egipt kɛba ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛtsu ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba Israel asafo muu ni ekpe hiɛ, ni amɛwo lɛ Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ. Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni nyiɛ David we lɛ sɛɛ akɛ ja Yuda akutso lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ.

Be ni Rehoboam yashɛ Yerusalem lɛ ebua hii tawulɔi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ naa kɛjɛ Yuda we lɛ kɛ Benyanmin akutso lɛ mli koni amɛkɛ Israel we lɛ ayawu, koni amɛshɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ amɛhã Solomon bi Rehoboam ekoŋŋ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Shemaia, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ wie akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam, Solomon bi lɛ, kɛ Yuda we lɛ kɛ Benyamin we lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ,

"Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. 'Nyɛkayaa, ni asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ akawua. Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aku esɛɛ eya ewe; ejaakɛ midɛŋ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ jɛ. '"No hewɔ lɛ Rehoboam kɛ Yudabii kɛ Benyaminbii kɛ maŋbii lɛ bo Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee amɛshīai ekoŋŋ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.

Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam yato Shekem yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni eyahi jɛi. No sɛɛ lɛ ejɛ jɛi ni eyato Penual hu. 26-27. Kɛkɛ ni Yeroboam kɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Bɔ ni nibii yaa lɛ nɛɛ, kɛji mimaŋbii lɛ aaakã he ayaja Yehowa yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, no lɛ maŋbii nɛɛ atsui aaatsɔ̃, ni amɛaagbe mi amɛhã amɛnuŋtsɔ Rehoboam, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, koni maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aku sɛɛ aya David we lɛ ekoŋŋ."

No hewɔ lɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ejwɛŋ sane lɛ he sɛɛ lɛ, efee shika tsinabii amãgãi enyɔ, ni ekɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Shii abɔ ni nyɛyaa Yerusalem nyɛyajaa lɛ efa. Ao Israel, naa onyɔŋmɔi ni yajie o kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ!"
Ni eŋɔ shika tsinabii amãgãi lɛ ateŋ ekome emã Betel, ni ekɛ ekome hu mã Dan.
Kɛkɛ ni enɛ tsɔ̃ esha ehã maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyajaa amãgã ni akɛmã Betel lɛ kɛ nɔ ni akɛma Dan tɔ̃ɔ lɛ hu.
Yeroboam mamɔ shīai yɛ he grɔŋŋi lɛ, ni eŋɔɔ mɛi kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ mli he fɛɛ he kɛkɛ, ni ewoɔ amɛ osɔfoi, tsɛbelɛ amɛjɛɛɛ Leviwe lɛ.

Yeroboam to jamɔ gbijurɔ hee ko yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ jamɔ gbijurɔ ni ayeɔ yɛ Yuda lɛ, ni eshã afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eshã afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni efee yɛ Betel lɛ nɔ ehã shika tsinabi amãgã ni efee lɛ. Ni ekɛ osɔfoi ni ewowoo lɛ to hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni efee lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ, gbi ni lɛ pɛ eto lɛ nɔ lɛ, etee eyashã afɔle yɛ Betel yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni efee lɛ nɔ. Eto gbijurɔ nɛɛ ehã Israel, no hewɔ ni etee eyashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
13: Be ni Yeroboam damɔ shi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ Betel koni eshã tsofakɛŋma lɛ, Yehowa tsu gbalɔ ko kɛjɛ Yuda kɛba Betel.

Yɛ Yehowa famɔ naa lɛ, gbalɔ lɛ gba eshi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Ao afɔleshãa latɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ, naa, abaafɔ binuu ko yɛ David we lɛ, ni aaatsɛ egbɛi Yosia. Lɛ ebaagbe osɔfoi ni shãa afɔlei yɛ onɔ lɛ, ni gbɔmɛi awui tete lɛ eeeshã yɛ onɔ."
Ni gbalɔ lɛ to okadi yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛ ji okadi ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ gbalɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ jɛ. Afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ abaawule lɛ ashwie shi, ni enɔ lamlu lɛ akɛbaashwã."

Be ni Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam nu gbalɛ wiemɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie eshi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɛ Betel lɛ, Yeroboam kpã enine mli kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ gbalɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmɔa nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ!" Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enine ni ekpã mli lɛ shɔ̃ kɛkree, ni enyɛɛɛ esu dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ wule, ni lamlu ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ gbɛ shwã tamɔ okadi ni gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ.

Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, kpa Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ni osɔle ohã mi koni atsa minine lɛ ahã mi ekoŋŋ." No hewɔ lɛ gbalɔ lɛ kpa Yehowa fai, ni atsa maŋtsɛ lɛ nine lɛ ahã lɛ, ni enine lɛ ba eblema ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ gbalɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ba koni wɔtee shīa ni oyaye nɔ ko, ni make o nɔ ko".
Shi gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji okɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli fã aaahã mi tete po lɛ, mi kɛ o eyaŋ, ni asaŋ miyeŋ nii, ni minuŋ nɔ ko yɛ biɛ.
Ejaakɛ nakai Yehowa wiemɔ fã mi akɛ, kaaye nɔ ko, ni kaanu nu, ni gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛtee lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ no nɔŋŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ kɛba."
No hewɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ gbɛ kroko nɔ kɛtee, ni ekuuu esɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔɔ gbɛ ni etsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba Betel lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ nuumo ko hi shi yɛ Betel. Ebihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome bagba lɛ nii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ etsu yɛ Betel nakai gbi lɛ; egba lɛ wiemɔ ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ Yeroboam wie lɛ hu.
Nuumo lɛ bi akɛ, "Be ni eshi jɛi lɛ nɛɛgbɛ etsɔ̃?" Ni ebii lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda kɛba lɛ tsɔ̃ lɛ.
Nuumo lɛ kɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwoa teji nɔ nii nyɛhãa mi." Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo teji nɔ nii amɛhã lɛ, ni eho eta nɔ.
Nuumo gbalɔ lɛ tiu Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ, ni eyanina lɛ ni eta tso agbo ko shishi. Ebi lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda ba lɛ?" Ni ehã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Mi ni."
Gbalɔ nuumo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ba wɔtee shīa ni oyaye nii."
Shi gbalɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minyɛŋ misɛɛ maku ni mikɛ o aya, ni asaŋ mi kɛ o yeŋ nii, ni mi kɛ o enuŋ nu yɛ biɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa wo mi kitã akɛ, kaaye nii, ni kaanu nɔ ko hu yɛ jɛi, asaŋ kaatsɔ̃ gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛtee lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba dɔŋŋ."

Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ nuumo ni jɛ Betel lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mi hu gbalɔ ji mi tamɔ bo nɔŋŋ, ni Yehowa fã ebɔfo, ni ekɛ mi bawie akɛ, yaakpale lɛ ni okɛ lɛ aba shīa koni ebaye nii ni enu nu." Shi gbalɔ nuumo lɛ miimale.
No hewɔ lɛ gbalɔ lɛ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ kɛ gbalɔ nuumo lɛ tee ni eyaye nii yɛ ewe lɛ, ni enu nii.
Be ni amɛtra okplɔ̃ lɛ he amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yehowa wie kɛtsɔ̃ gbalɔ nuumo lɛ ni yakpale Yuda gbalɔ lɛ kɛba lɛ nɔ,
ni egba ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda eba lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Akɛni obooo Yehowa wiemɔ toi, ni oyeee kitã ni Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ wo o lɛ nɔ,'
ni oku osɛɛ oba obaye nii, ni onu nii, yɛ he ni ekɛɛ o yɛ he akɛ, 'Kaaye nii, ni kaanu nɔ ko hu yɛ jɛi,' lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, gbo ooogbo, ni ogbonyo eyaŋ otsɛmɛi lɛ afuuhe lɛ."
Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ eye nii ni enu nii sɛɛ lɛ, gbalɔ nuumo lɛ wo teji nɔ nii ehã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ yiŋ etee; shi be ni eyaa lɛ jata ko kɛ lɛ bakpe ni egbe lɛ. Egbonyo lɛ kã gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni teji lɛ kɛ jata lɛ daamɔ emasɛi.
Mɛi Komɛi ni batsɔ̃ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ na gbonyo lɛ kã gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni jata lɛ damɔ gbonyo lɛ masɛi. Ni amɛba amɛbagba yɛ Betel maŋ lɛ mli he ni gbalɔ nuumo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.

Be ni gbalɔ nuumo lɛ ni yakpale lɛ kɛjɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ nu sane lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni yabooo Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi lɛ ni; no hewɔ ni Yehowa jie jata ewo ehe lɛ, ni etserɛ emli, ni egbɛ lɛ yɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie lɛ naa nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwoa teji nɔ nii nyɛhãa mi." Ni amɛwo teji nɔ nii.
Kɛkɛ ni eyiŋ etee, ni eyana gbonyo lɛ kã gbɛ lɛ nɔ; teji lɛ kɛ jata lɛ damɔ gbonyo lɛ masɛi; jata lɛ yeko gbonyo lɛ, ni esaa etserɛko teji lɛ.
Gbalɔ nuumo lɛ wo Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ teji lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ ku sɛɛ kɛba emaŋ lɛ mli koni amɛbafo lɛ ni amɛfu lɛ.
Eto gbonyo lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbonyobu mli; ni amɛfo lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Kpoo, minyɛmi nuu!"
Agbɛnɛ be ni efu gbonyo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ,"Kɛji migbo lɛ nyɛfua mi yɛ bu ni afu Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ yɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ mli; nyɛtoa miwui lɛ yɛ ewui lɛ amasɛi;
ejaakɛ wiemɔi ni Yehowa fã lɛ koni ewie eshi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ Betel lɛ kɛ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni yɔɔ Samaria maji lɛ anɔ lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ baaba mli kɛ̃."
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam efɔ̃ɔɔ efɔŋ ni efeɔ lɛ feemɔ, shi moŋ eŋɔ mɛi komɛi kɛkɛ, ni ewo amɛ hei grɔŋŋi jamɔhei lɛ osɔfoi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ eye osɔfo lɛ, ewoɔ lɛ osɔfo.
Nɛkɛ enifeemɔ nɛɛ batsɔ̃ esha kple ehã Yeroboam we lɛ. Enɛ ji nɔ ni hã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbee shi.
14: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yeroboam bi Abia he baye.
Yeroboam kɛɛ eŋa akɛ, "Tee shi, tsakemɔ ohe koni akayoo bo akɛ boji Yeroboam ŋa lɛ; yaa Shilo, ejaakɛ gbalɔ Ahia ni wie yɛ mihe akɛ mibaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel lɛ jɛi eyɔɔ.
Oŋɔ aboloo akwabɔi nyɔŋma kɛ keeki kɛ wo atuŋkpã kome ohiɛ odɛ̃ kɛya eŋɔɔ. Yaabi lɛ nɔ ni baaba gbekɛ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni ebaagba bo."
Yeroboam ŋa lɛ fee nakai, ni etee Shilo, ni eba Ahia we lɛ. Shi Ahia enaaa nii, ejaakɛ gbɔlɛ ehã ehiŋmɛii anɔ eha.

Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Ahia akɛ, "Naa, Yeroboam ŋa lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ ebabi nii yɛ ebi nuu lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ he miiye. Kɛji eba lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ." Be ni Yeroboam ŋa lɛ bashe jɛi lɛ, etsake ehe tamɔ yoo kroko.
Shi be ni eshɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni Ahia nu enaneshi gbɛɛmɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ba mli, Yeroboam ŋa! Mɛɛba otsake ohe tamɔ mɔ kroko nɛɛ? Naa, atsu mi oŋɔɔ kɛ sane ko ni wa.
Yaa, ni oyakɛɛ Yeroboam akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mikɔ bo pɛ yɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni miwo o maŋtsɛ.
Mishɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tete yɛ David we lɛ dɛŋ mihã o; shi kɛ̃lɛ otamɔɔɔ mitsulɔ David ni eye mikitãi anɔ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ kɛ etsui fɛɛ lɛ. Efee nɔ ni sa sɔŋŋ yɛ mihiɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, ofee efɔŋ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ohiɛ lɛ. Oto oyiŋ, ni oyafee nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi kɛ amãgãi ni ashwie ohã ohe, ni okɛwo mimli la; ni mi lɛ oshɛ mi ofɔ̃ osɛɛ kwa.

Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mahã sane fɔŋ aye Yereboam we lɛ. Maplene Yereboam we mli nuu fɛɛ nuu hiɛ yɛ Israel: nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ. Makpãtã Yeroboam we lɛ hiɛ kwraa tamɔ abɛɔ wamɔ, ni awoɔ mli la yɛ tumu nɔ ashãa kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni fɛɛ shãa wɛɛ lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Yeroboam nɔ mli ni aaagbo lɛ gbei aaaye lɛ, ni kɛji emɔ ko gbo yɛ ŋanɔ lɛ akpãŋai baaye lɛ, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.'"
Ahia tee nɔ ekɛɛ Yeroboam ŋa lɛ akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ oya owe. Onane ni aaayi Omaŋ lɛ mli pɛ, obi lɛ baagbo.
Israel fɛɛ aaafo lɛ, ni amɛaafu lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ pɛ ejɛ Yeroboam we lɛ mli ni aaafu lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ pɛ emli ana nɔ kpakpa ko yɛ yɛ Yeroboam we lɛ ni sa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Asaŋ Yehowa baatee maŋtsɛ ko shi ahã ehe yɛ Israel, mɔ ni baakpãtã Yeroboam we hiɛ ŋmɛnɛ, amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ.

Yehowa aaatswia Israel nii, tamɔ ohosoɔ glã yɛ faa mli lɛ, ni eeefã Israel kɛjɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ekɛhã etsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ. Yehowa baagbɛ amɛ eshwã Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ; ejaakɛ amɛfee Ashera wɔŋ lɛ amãgãi, ni amɛkɛwo Yehowa mli la.
Yehowa baakwa Israel yɛ eshai ni Yeroboam fee lɛ hewɔ, yɛ eshai ni ekɛhã Israel fɛɛ fee lɛ hewɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yeroboam na lɛ te shi, ni eyi mli etee Tirza. Be ni eshɛ shīa lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ lɛ gbo.
Israel fɛɛ fo lɛ, ni amɛfu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wie kɛtsɔ̃ etsulɔ gbalɔ Ahia nɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yeroboam he saji fɛɛ,nii ni efee, bɔ ni ewu tai kɛ bɔ ni eye maŋtsɛ ehã lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yeroboam ye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ. Egbo, ni afu lɛ, ni ebi Nadab baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.

Solomon bi Rehoboam ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda. Rehoboam eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome be ni ebɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo yɛ Yerusalem. Yerusalem nɛɛ ji maŋ ni Yehowa kɔ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ. Rehoboam nyɛ gbɛi ji Naama, ni Amonyoo ji lɛ.
Yudabii lɛ fee esha shi Yehowa, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe eshai ni amɛfee lɛ hã Yehowa ye awuŋa. Eshai ni amɛfee lɛ fa kwraa fe nii ni amɛblematsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛmãmɔ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi amɛhã amɛhe; amɛkɛ tɛi mãmɔ shiui kɛ Ashera amãgãi, ni amɛjaa yɛ gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi.
Nɔ ni fe fɛɛ ji akɛ, hii kɛ yei yɛ jɛi ni kɛ amɛhe bɔɔ ajwamaŋ yɛ jamɔhei lɛ. Yudabii lɛ fee hiɛgbejianii ni jeŋmaji abii ni Yehowa shwie yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ fee lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Egipt Maŋtsɛ Shishak fã ta ebatua Yerusalem.
Ebaloo Yehowa we lɛ mli jwetri lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli jwetri lɛ; eloo fɛɛ kwa kɛtee. Esaa eloo shika tsɛŋi lɛ ni Solomon fee lɛ kɛtee.
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam hã afee akɔɔble tsɛŋi eto najiaŋ, ni etu fɛɛ ewo bulɔi ni buɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ.
Be fɛɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yaa Yehowa we lɛ bulɔi lɛ hiɛɔ tsɛŋi lɛ, ni kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛkuɔ sɛɛ amɛkɛyatoɔ bulɔi lɛ atsu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Rehoboam he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Nakai bei lɛ amli fɛɛ lɛ Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam kɛ amɛhe wu ta be fɛɛ be.
