Rehoboam gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ afuuhe ni yɔɔ David maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Naama, Amonyoo lɛ. Ni ebi Abia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
15: Be ni Nebat bi Yeroboam eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ Israel lɛ, no mli Abia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ maŋtsɛ afii etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Maaka, Abishalom biyoo lɛ.
Eshai ni etsɛ fee kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ lɛ hu efee, ni eyeee Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anɔkwa tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ David ye anɔkwa lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ David hewɔ lɛ Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã Abia binuu ni ebaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ yɛ Yerusalem koni ehã Yerusalem ahi shi shweshweeshwe.
Yehowa fee enɛ, ejaakɛ David fee nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, ni egbaaa afã yɛ Kitãi ni ewo lɛ lɛ eko eko he ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ, akɛ ja yɛ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, sane lɛ mli pɛ.
Ta ni te shi yɛ Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam teŋ lɛ tsa nɔ aahuu yɛ Abia maŋtsɛyeli beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Abia he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Abia gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli, ni ebi Asa baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Be ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ Israel sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli Asa bɔ̃i matsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekomɛ yɛ Yerusalem. Enaa gbɛi ji Maaka, Abishalom biyoo lɛ.
Asa fee nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eblematsɛ David fee lɛ.
Eshwie hii kɛ yei fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛhe bɔɔ ajwamaŋ yɛ jamɔhei lɛ fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejie amãgãi ni etsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Asa kpa enyɛ Maaka tete maŋnyɛyeli; ejaakɛ enyɛ nɛɛ fee Ashera amãgã ko ni eji nihii nii. Asa flɔ tso amãgã lɛ mli, ni eyashã yɛ Kidron jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Yɛ mli akɛ Asa fiteee jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ eye Yehowa anɔkwa ewala bei abɔ fɛɛ.
Nibii fɛɛ ni etsɛ Abia fee, kɛ nii ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu efee ni atsuu he yɛ tsuijurɔ naa ahã Yehowa lɛ, eyaloo kɛba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ: jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsɛnsii fɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha Maŋtsɛyeli beiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ ta kã amɛteŋ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha fã ta kɛbatua Yuda, ni eŋɔ Rama. Kɛkɛ ni etswa gbogbo ewo Rama he bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko mɔ akaje kpo kɛmiiya Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa ŋɔɔ aloo eeje eŋɔɔ kɛmiiba.

No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Asa loo shika fɛɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ nitoohe lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohe lɛ hu; etu ewo etsuji lɛ adɛŋ, ni etsu amɛ kɛtee Damasko koni akɛyahã Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad, Tabrimon bi, ni eji Hezion nabi lɛ. Wiemɔ ni fata he ji:

"Ha kpãŋmɔ ko akã mi kɛ bo teŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã mitsɛ otsɛ teŋ lɛ. Naa miimaje jwɛitɛi kɛ shika nikee nii. Yaa ni oyaku kpãŋmɔ ni kã okɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha teŋ lɛ mli, koni ejie etabilɔi lɛ kɛje mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."

Ben-Hadad kplɛ̃ Maŋtsɛ Asa wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etsu etatsɛmɛi kɛtee ni amɛyatua Israel maji lɛ. Tatsɛmɛi lɛ ŋɔ maji nɛɛ: Yion kɛ Dan kɛ Abel-Bet-Maaka kɛ shikpɔŋ ni bɛŋkɛ Galilea kpaakpo lɛ kɛ Naftali kpokpaianɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Baasha nu nɔ ni eba lɛ he lɛ efɔ̃ɔ gbogbo lɛ tswaa kɛ Rama he woo, ni etee eyahi shi yɛ Tirza.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Asa hã ashiɛ yɛ Yuda fɛɛ, ashiii mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ mli. Maŋbii lɛ tee Rama ni amɛyaloo Rama tɛi lɛ kɛ mplaŋi lɛ ni Baasha kɛtswaa gbogbo ewo Rama he lɛ kɛba. Maŋtsɛ Asa kɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ yawaje Geba, ni yɔɔ Benyamin kpokpai anɔ lɛ kɛ Mizpa.
Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ Asa he saji fɛɛ ni eshwɛ kɛ ekãa ni efee, kɛ nii fɛɛ kɛ maji ni ewajewaje lɛ aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Asaji Awolo lɛ mli. Shi egbɔlɛ be mli lɛ, nane hela ko kumɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Asa gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ eblematsɛmɛi lɛ afuuhe lɛ yɛ eblematsɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni ebinuu Yehoshafat baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa eye afii enyɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam bi Nadab baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel. Eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel afii enyɔ.
Efee efɔŋ tamɔ etsɛ ni nyiɛ ehiɛ lɛ fee ni ekɛhã Israel fee esha lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Ahia ni jɛ Isakar akutso lɛ mli lɛ binuu Baasha kpãŋ Nadab yinɔ, ni etswa Nadab nɔ ni egbe lɛ. No bei amli lɛ Nadab kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ eyasa Gibeton ni yɔɔ Filistia lɛ yi.
No hewɔ lɛ Baasha gbe Nadab be ni Asa eye maŋtsɛ afii etɛ̃ yɛ Yuda. Kɛkɛ ni lɛ Baasha lɛ ebaye Nadab sɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.

Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Baasha baye maŋtsɛ lɛ, egbe Yeroboam we lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko eshwɛɛɛ ni muɔ tete yɛ Yeroboam we lɛ. Efee enɛ koni wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie kɛtsɔ̃ etsulɔ Ahia, Shilonyo lɛ, nɔ lɛ aba mli.
Eba mli nɛkɛ ejaakɛ Yeroboam fee eshai eshi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ no hã Israel fɛɛ hu fee esha kɛwo Yehowa mli la.
Agbɛnɛ Nadab he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni ta kã Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha teŋ amɛwala beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa ye afii etɛ̃ yɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli Ahia bi Baasha babɔ̃i Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Tirza; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; eba ejeŋ gbonyo tamɔ Yeroboam ni hã Israel fɛɛ fee esha lɛ.
16: Yehowa kɛ Hanani bi Yehu wie, ni ekɛ shɛɛ nɛɛ hã lɛ akɛ ekɛyahã Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha:
"Kulɛ ojeee mɔ ko, shi miwo onɔ kɛjɛ mlu mli, ni mifee bo lumɔ kɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ yɛ mimaŋ Israel. Oyakɔ Yeroboam jeŋba lɛ, ni ohã mimaŋ Israel fee esha, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ wo mimli la.
Hewɔ lɛ mibabɛɛ Baasha kɛ ewe lɛ mashwie, ni mibafee ewe lɛ tamɔ mifee Nebat bi Yeroboam we lɛ lɛ.
Baasha wekunyo fɛɛ wekunyo ni aaagbo yɛ maŋ lɛ, gbei aaaye egbonyo lɛ; ni ewekunyo ni aaagbo yɛ ŋanɔ lɛ, ŋwɛi loofɔji aaaye eloo."
Nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni Baasha fee kɛ ekãa nibii hu ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Baasha gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Tizra; kɛkɛ ni ebi Ela baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.

Yehowa wiemɔ ni ekɛshiɔ Baasha kɛ ewe lɛ akɛtsɔ̃ Hanani bi Yehu nɔ, yɛ eshai ni Baasha fee eshi Yehowa lɛ ahewɔ. Baasha wo Yehowa mli la, jeee yɛ nibii fɔɔji ni efee, tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam efee kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ momo lɛ kɛkɛ ahewɔ, shi moŋ akɛ egbe Yeroboam we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ lɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Baasha musuŋ binuu Ela bɔ̃i Israel maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Tirza. Eye Maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ.
Shi etsulɔ Zimri, etayaa shwiili lɛ amlijaa fã kome ko nɔ asafoiatsɛ lɛ, kpãŋ eyinɔ. Gbi ko be ni Maŋtsɛ Ela etɔ dãa kpɔtɔɔ yɛ etsulɔ Arza, mɔ ni kwɛɔ Tizra maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ we lɛ mli lɛ,
Zimri bote Arza we lɛ mli, ni eyatswa Maŋtsɛ Ela nɔ, ni egbe lɛ. Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ sane nɛɛ ba. Kɛkɛ ni Zimri baye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Ela sɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni shɛ Zimri dɛŋ nɔŋŋ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni egbe Baasha we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ, eshiii Baasha we lɛ mli nuu kome nɛkɛ; egbe kɛ Baasha nanemɛi tete hu.
Belɛ Zimri kpãtã Baasha we lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm hiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ gbalɔ Yehu nɔ ewie eshi Baasha,
yɛ eshai fɛɛ ni Baasha fee kɛ eshai ni ebi Ela hu fee, ni amɛkɛhã Israel fee esha, ni amɛkɛ amãgãjamɔ wo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli la lɛ hewɔ.
Nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni Ela fee kɛ ehe saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zimri bata Israel maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ yɛ Tirza. Eye maŋtsɛ gbii kpawo. Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Israel tabilɔi esa Filistibii amaŋ Gibeton lɛ yi.
Gbi ni tabilɔi lɛ nu akɛ Zimri etee Maŋtsɛ Ela yinɔ apam, ni egbe lɛ lɛ, Israel tso muu fɛɛ wo Omri ni ji tabilɔi lɛ atsɛ lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ ta lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Omri fã kɛjɛ Gibeton kɛba bi Israel fɛɛ fata ehe, ni amɛbasa Tizra yi.
Be ni Zimri na akɛ aŋɔ maŋ lɛ, eyabote maŋtsɛ we lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli kɛkɛ ni ema maŋtsɛ we lɛ naa la, ni eshã lɛ eshwie enɔ, ni egbo.
Egbo yɛ eshai ni efee, kɛ efɔŋ ni efee yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ Yeroboam jeŋba lɛ ni ekɔ efɔ̃ enɔ lɛ hewɔ, asaŋ kɛ efɔŋ ni efee ni ekɛhã Israel hu fee esha lɛ hewɔ.
Nibii krokomɛi ni Zimri fee kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ela yinɔ apam ni ete lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋ lɛ mli gba enyɔ; maŋ lɛ fã kome yɛ Ginat bi Tibni lɛ sɛɛ akɛ lɛ eye maŋtsɛ, ni fã hu yɛ Omri sɛɛ.
Shi mɛi ni yɔɔ Omri sɛɛ lɛ ye mɛi ni yɔɔ Ginat bi Tibni lɛ sɛɛ lɛ anɔ kunim. Tibni nyɔ, ni Omri baye maŋtsɛ,
yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ. Omri ye Israel maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Eye maŋtsɛ lɛ afii ekpaa yɛ Tirza.
Omri tse jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpei ekpaa, ni ekɛhe Samaria gɔŋ lɛ yɛ mɔ ko ni egbɛi ji Shemer lɛ ŋɔɔ. Omri to maŋ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ewo maŋ lɛ Samaria, yɛ gɔŋ lɛ tsɛ Shemer gbɛi lɛ hewɔ. Ewaje maŋ lɛ.
Omri fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ. Efee esha fe maŋtsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ ebakɔ Nebat bi Yeroboam jeŋba lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ehã maŋbii lɛ bote eshafeemɔ kɛ amãgãjamɔ mli, nifeemɔ ni woɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli la lɛ.
Omri he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni efee, kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmŋɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Omri gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria; kɛkɛ ni ebi Ahab baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Ato Omri bi Ahab maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ. Ahab ye Isreal maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Omri bi Ahab fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ fe maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ.
Akɛni eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee lɛ ni jeee fɛifɛi yɛ Ahab hiɛ hewɔ lɛ, etee nɔ, ni eyaŋɔ Sidonbii amaŋtsɛ Etbaal biyoo Yezebel lɛ akɛŋa. No hewɔ lɛ Ahab tee ni eyaja, ni esɔ̃mɔ Baal.
Emã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ehã Baal.
No sɛɛ hu eshɔ̃ jemawɔŋ yoo Ashera lɛ amãgã ema shi. Ahab wo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli la waa fe Isreal maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛho.

Ahab yinɔ ni Hiel, Betelnyo lɛ, yasaa etswa Yeriko maŋ lɛ mli tsui koikoi lɛ. Hiel kromɔbi ni egbɛi ji Abiram lɛ nyɔ yɛ Yeriko saamɔ lɛ shishitoo mli, ni ebi sɛɛkpelɔ Segub hu nyɔ be mli ni atraa maŋ lɛ naa agboi lɛ. Sane nɛɛ ba mli nɛkɛ taakɛ Yehowa etsɔ̃ Nunbi Yoshua nɔ egba eto momo lɛ.
17: Glalɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Elia, Tishbinyo ni ejɛ Gilead, lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab akɛ, "Miikɛɛ bo, yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli akɛ bɔ enyɔŋ, ni nu hu enɛŋ kɛyaashi biɛ afii enyɔ loo afii etɛ̃, bɛja mi, miwie dã."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ,
"Shi biɛ nɛɛ koni oya bokãgbɛ oyatee ohe yɛ Kerit faa nine lɛ masɛi yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ.
Obaana faa nine lɛ mli nu onu, ni mifã kwãakwãalabitei koni amɛlɛ bo yɛ jɛi."
No hewɔ lɛ Elia ye Yehowa fãmɔ lɛ nɔ: Eyi mli, ni etee eyahi Kerit faa nine lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ he.
Kwãakwãalabitei lɛ yahãa lɛ aboloo kɛ loo daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ, ni faa lɛ mli nu lɛ ji nu ni enuɔ.
Shi be ko sɛɛ lɛ, faa lɛ baŋla, ejaakɛ nu enɛɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ,
"Agbɛnɛ yaa zarefat, Sidonbii amaŋ lɛ mli, koni oyahi jɛi. Mifã yoo akulafo ko koni elɛ bo yɛ jɛi."
No hewɔ lɛ Elia yi mli, ni etee Zarefat. Be ni eshɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, ena yoo okulafo ko yɛ jɛi ni eebua lai ŋmɛŋmlɛbii anaa. Elia kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ,"Ofai nɛ ni ohã mi nu fioo manu."
Be ni yoo lɛ yaa koni eyayɛ nu lɛ, Elia tsɛ eyisɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ ni oŋɔ aboloo atrɔma ko ohiɛ odɛ̃ obahã mi."

Yoo okulafo lɛ to he akɛ, "Mina Yehowa hiɛkãlɔ, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ mibɛ aboloo kuku nɛkɛ. Nɔ pɛ ni miyɔɔ ji mamu dɛ̃ kɔkɔ obɔ̃ kome pɛ yɛ gbɛ mli, kɛ mu fioo yɛ tɔ mli. Miilɛ lai ŋmɛŋmlɛbii enyɔoo ko koni mikɛyashã aboloo a mahã mi kɛ mibi lɛ koni wɔye; no sɛɛ lɛ wɔɔgboi kɛ hɔmɔ."
Elia kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei! Yaa koni ayafee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ. Shi moŋ ŋɔɔ mamu lɛ eko okɛshã abooloo fioo ko obahã mi tsuutsu dã; no sɛɛ dani ofee bo kɛ obi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mamu kɛ gbɛ lɛ etaŋ, ni mu kɛ tɔ lɛ hu etaŋ aahuu kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni Yehowa aaahã nu abanɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.'"
Yoo lɛ yi mli etee, ni eyafee bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Elia kɛɛ lɛ lɛ; ni Elia kɛ yoo lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ na nii amɛye gbii kplaŋŋ.
Taakɛ Yehowa tsɔ̃ Elia nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mamu kɛ gbɛ lɛ etãaa, ni mu kɛ tɔ lɛ hu etãaa.
Nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, yoo lɛ ni ji shīanyɛ lɛ, bi nuu lɛ he baye; ehela lɛ mli wo wu, ni naagbee lɛ egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, "Ao Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, mɛni mifee bo! Obato mi koni akai efɔŋ ni mifee, koni agbe mibi nuu lɛ lo?"
Elia kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ obi lɛ ahã mi!" Elia he gbekɛ lɛ yɛ yoo lɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ; kɛkɛ ni ehiɛ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi tsu lɛ mli he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esaa nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia bo etsɛ Yehowa, ni ekɛɛ, "Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ! Aso yoo okulafo ni mibato eŋɔɔ nɛɛ hu okɛyeɔ sane kɛ joomɔ nɛkɛ, ni ogbeɔ ebi lɛ nɛɛ?"
Elia ho ekpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ shii etɛ̃. Kɛkɛ ni ebo waa etsɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ. "Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ! Miikpa bo fai; hã gbekɛ nɛɛ mumɔ akpale aba emli ekoŋŋ koni ehiɛ atsɛ̃!"
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bo Elia faikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni gbɛkɛ lɛ mumɔ kpale kɛba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ehiɛ tsɛ̃.
Agbɛnɛ Elia wo gbekɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ kpleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tsu lɛ mli kɛba shīa lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ bahã enyɛ lɛ; ni Elia kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa obi lɛ; eyi ena wala."
Yoo lɛ here Elia nɔ ekɛɛ, "Kpaako mina mile akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji o lɛɛlɛŋ, ni asaŋ Yehowa wieɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ onɔ!"
18: Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, yɛ nuhɔmɔ lɛ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Elia wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa koni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ Ahab, ni mahã nu anɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Elia yi mli etee koni ekɛ ehe ayatsɔ̃ɔ Ahab. Hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa naakpa yɛ Samaria.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Obadia ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ. Obadia ji gbɔmɔ ko ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei naakpa,
ejaakɛ be ni Yezebel kpãtãa gbalɔi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, Obadia ŋɔ gbalɔi oha, ni ekɛ amɛ tee tɛkploi enyɔ amli, mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ, ni ekɛ aboloo kɛ nu lɛ amɛ.
Ahab kɛɛ Obadia akɛ, "Yaa koni oyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ ni nuhiŋmɛii kɛ jɔi yɔɔ akɛ eko lɛ wɔɔna jwɛi yɛ he ko koni wɔkɛhere okpɔŋɔi lɛ ayiwala, koni shīa kooloi fɛɛ akaŋmɛɛ wɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛ Obadia ja Shikpɔŋ lɛ mli enyɔ amɛhã amɛhe, koni amɛyakpa nɔ kɛho.
Be ni Obadia nyiɛ gbɛ eyaa lɛ, ekɛ Elia yakpe trukaa. Be ni Obadia yoo Elia lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Ani bo, minuŋtsɔ Elia, nɛ?"
Elia herɔ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mi ni! Yaa koni oyakɛɛ onuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, Naa, Elia yɛ biɛ!"
Obadia to he akɛ, "Mɛɛ efɔŋ mifee hewɔ ni okɛ otsulɔ woɔ nɛkɛ haomɔ mli nɛɛ?

Mina Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ maŋ ko maŋ ko loo nɔyelihe ko nɔyelihe ko kwraa bɛ jeŋ ni minuŋtsɔ tsuko kɛyako jɛi akɛ ayatao bo ahã lɛ. Kɛji he ko bii kɛ wiemɔ ba akɛ, 'Ebɛ biɛ lɛ,'ehaa nakai maŋtsɛyeli loo maŋ lɛ kãa lɛ kitã akɛ amɛnako bo lɛɛlɛŋ.
Shi ŋmɛnɛ, naa bo ni ookɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Yaakɛɛ onuŋtsɔ akɛ, naa Elia yɛ biɛ.'

Amrɔ pɛ ni mibashi bo matee lɛ, Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ aaabakpa bo kɛya he ko ni mileee. Kɛji mitee miyakɛɛ Ahab, ni eba, ni ebaninaaa bo lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, ebaagbe mi. Kaimɔ akɛ Yehowa jalɔ ji otsulɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi beebe.
Ani agbako minuŋtsɔ nɔ ni mifee be ni Yezebel gbe Yehowa gbalɔi lɛ, bɔ ni miŋɔ gbalɔi oha mitee tɛkploi amli nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ, ni milɛ amɛ kɛ aboloo kɛ nu lɛ?
Ni agbɛnɛ ŋmɛnɛ ookɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Yaa ni oyakɛɛ onuŋtsɔ akɛ, naa, Elia yɛ biɛ. 'Ebaagbe mi!"
Elia hã hetoo ekɛɛ, "Mina Yehowa hiɛkãlɔ, Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ, akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mikɛ mihe baatsɔɔ̃ Ahab ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Obadia yi mli etee, ni eyabɔ Ahab amaniɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Ahab yiŋ koni ekɛ Elia ayakpe.
Be ni Ahab na Elia lɛ, Ahab kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo Isreal haolɔ lɛ, bo nɛ?"
Elia to he ekɛɛ, "Mihaoko Israel! Bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ moŋ ni ehao Israel ejaakɛ nyɛkwa Yehowa kitãi lɛ, ni nyɛtee nyɛmiija Baal moŋ.

No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ tsu koni ayabua Israel fɛɛ naa abaha mi yɛ Karmel Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ: Baal gbalɔi ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛ Ashera gbalɔi ohai ejwɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nii yɛ Yezebel okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ hu fɛɛ aba."
No hewɔ lɛ Ahab tsu atee, ni ayatsɛ Israelbii fɛɛ kɛba; asaŋ ebua gbalɔi lɛ hu anaa kɛbakpe yɛ Karmel Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni Elia tsi ebɛŋkɛ asafo muu ni ewo shi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛyiŋ aaafee nyɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛyashi yɛ saji enyɔ nɛɛ ahe? Kɛji Yehowa ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ, ni kɛji Baal ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nyɛjaa lɛ. "Shi maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko etswaaa asɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elila kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Mi, mi koome too pɛ ji Yehowa gbalɔ ni eshwɛ, shi Baal gbalɔi lɛ ayibɔ ji hii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.

Abahã wɔ tsina hii enyɔ. Baal webii lɛ amɔ tsinai lɛ ateŋ ekome, nɔ ni amɛ amɛsumɔɔ amɛ ha amɛhe, amɛgbe tsina lɛ koni amɛflɔ emli dukuduku, ni amɛkɛ loo lɛ ashwie lai nɔ; shi moŋ amɛkawo eshishi la. Mi hu masaa tsina nuu kome lɛ, koni mikɛ eloo lɛ ashwie lai nɔ; ni mi hu miwoŋ minɔ lɛ shishi la.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛsɔlea nyɛtsɛa nyɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mi hu masɔle matsɛ Yehowa; amɛteŋ mɔ ni kɛ la baahere tsɛmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ." Maŋbii lɛ here nɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Eja nakai!"

Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Baal gbalɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmɔa tsina hii lɛ ateŋ ekome nyɛhãa nyɛhe, ni nyɛ tsuutsu nyɛsaa nyɛkooloo lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛyi fa; no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛsɔlea kɛtsɛa nyɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛkasɔa lai lɛ naa la."

No hewɔ lɛ Baal gbalɔi lɛ mɔ tsina nuu ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa, ni amɛsɔle kɛ blɔmɔ amɛtsɛ Baal kɛjɛ leebileebi aahuu kɛyashi shwane fintiŋŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Baal, heremɔ wɔ nɔ!" Amɛtumɔ kɛbɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni amɛmã lɛ, shi anuuu gbee ko lɛ, nɔheremɔ ko hu jɛɛɛ he ko baaa.
Shwane mli lɛ Elia ye Baal gbalɔi lɛ ahe fɛo, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛblɔa waa, ejaakɛ nyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ! Eko lɛ benɛ eeshwie eyiŋ, aloo eje kpo, aloo edom, aloo eko lɛ ewɔ koni ehiɛ atsɛ̃."
No hewɔ lɛ gbalɔi lɛ blɔ waa fe tsuutsu lɛ, ni amɛkɛ kakla kɛ klaŋte flɔflɔɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛkusum naa kɛyashi lá bɔ̃i hoo yɛ amɛhe.
Amɛtee nɔ kɛ blɔmɔ hoo lɛ kɛyashi eshɛ shwane niyenii afɔleshãa be; shi fɛɛ lɛ gbee ko ejijeee lɛ, hetoo ko baaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa mi." Maŋ lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Elia saa Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ ni ekumɔ lɛ.
Elia klɔ tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, yɛ Yakob, mɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Abaatsɛ bo Israel" lɛ bii lɛ akutsei lɛ ayikulɛ naa,
ni ekɛ tɛi lɛ mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli. No sɛɛ lɛ etsa bu ni baaye nu litai nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛbɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kpula.
Kɛkɛ ni eto lai lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eflɔ tsina nuu lɛ mli ni ekɛshwie lai lɛ nɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyɛa nu gbɛi obɔbɔi ejwɛ nyɛbashwiea shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ lai nɔ." Be ni afee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, Elia saa ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa etīaa shii enyɔ." Ahã nu lɛ tīa shii enyɔ lɛ, shi Elia kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa etīaa shii etɛ̃." Ahã nu lɛ tīa shii etɛ̃ lɛ.
Nu lɛ tsere kɛnyiɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛbote latɛ lɛ he bu lɛ mli; bu lɛ yi abɔ̃ kɛ nu lɛ.

Shwane niyenii afɔle be lɛ, Gbalɔ Elia tsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, "Ao Yehowa, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, hã ana ale ŋmɛnɛ akɛ boji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, asaŋ akɛ bo otsulɔ ji mi, ni owiemɔ naa mifeɔ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ.
Heremɔ mi nɔ! Ao Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ, koni maŋ nɛɛ kɛna ale akɛ bo, Yehowa, ji Nyɔŋmɔ; ni asaŋ akɛ bo nɔŋŋ oŋɔɔ amɛtsuii ekaple kɛba ekoŋŋ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã la gba kɛbabote afɔle lɛ mli, ni eshã afɔle lɛ kɛ lai lɛ kɛ tɛi lɛ kɛ su lɛ, ni nu lɛ tete ni yɔɔ bu ni bɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli lɛ ŋla wɛɛ.
Be ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ na nɔ ni eba lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ bumɔ shi, ni amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Yehowa lɛ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ! Yehowa lɛ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Elia fã maŋbii lɛ ekɛɛ "Nyɛmɔmɔa Baal gbalɔi lɛ; akahã amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ miijo foi!" Amɔmɔ Baal gbalɔi lɛ, ni Elia ŋɔ amɛ kɛkpeke shi kɛtee Kishon Faa lɛ naa, ni eyagbe amɛ yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ yaa koni oyaye nii ni onu nɔ ko ejaakɛ minu nugbɔ shiimɔ he kɛmiiba."
Kɛkɛ ni Ahab yi mli etee koni eyaye nii, asaŋ ni enu nɔ ko; shi Elia kwɔ kɛtee Karmel Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ yiteŋ; edɔ emli, ni ekɛ eyitso hɔ enakutsei ateŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɔɔ kɛya gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ koni okwɛ ŋshɔŋgbɛ." Tsulɔ lɛ tee eba, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ. "Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ jɛi gbɛ." Elia kɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa shii kpawo ni oyakwɛ."

Shii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, "Naa, atatu bibioo ko ni edaaa fe gbɔmɔ nine miite shi kɛmiijɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli." Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Yaakɛɛ Ahab akɛ, 'Saamɔ otayaa shwiili lɛ koni okpleke shi koni nu lɛ akatsi onaa.'"
Yeee be ko nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni ŋwɛi dī tūu kɛ atatui; kɔɔyɔɔ fã; nu nɛ tsoo diɛŋtsɛ. Ahab fã kɛ tayaa shwiili kɛtee Yezreel.
Shi Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ bayi Elia nɔ; kɛkɛ ni emīa, ni ewo foi kɛyi Ahab hiɛ kɛtee Yezreel tɔ̃ɔ.
19: Ahab bagba eŋa Yezebel nibii fɛɛ ni Elia efee lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ ekɛ klaŋte gbe gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel tsu bɔfo kɛtee Elia ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔi lɛ atswa mi nɔ koni magbo kɛji wɔ benɛ yinɔ lɛ mifeko bo bɔ ni ofee gbalɔi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ."
Elia she gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ ete shi, ni ejo foi koni ehere esusuma yiwala. Etee Beersheba yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eshi etsulɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi,
ni ekome enyiɛ gbi kome jenamɔ gbɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ. Eyata shi yɛ tso kusuu ko shishii ni ebɔi gbele shwee. Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ao Yehowa, efa agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ mihiii fe mitsɛmɛi lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni eho ekã tso kusuu lɛ shishi, ni ewɔ. Trukaa lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo ko bata ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi koni oye nii!"
Elia kwɛ ehe, ni ena aboloo ni ashã yɛ tɛi ni edɔ anɔ kɛ kplu kɛ nu ma eyitsogbɛ. Eye nii lɛ, ni enu nu lɛ, kɛkɛ ni eho ekã shi ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ; ebata ehe, ni ekɛɛ Elia akɛ, "Tee shi ni oye nii, kɛjeee nakai lɛ, gbɛfãa lɛ baadɛŋ bo tsɔ̃."
Kɛkɛ ni Elia te shi, ni eye nii, ni enu nu eshwie nɔ. Niyenii nɛɛ mli hewalɛ lɛ ji nɔ ni hã enyɛ enyiɛ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔ̃ŋ Horeb lɛ he.
Eyashɛ tɛkplo ko he yɛ jɛi, ni ewɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ. Trukaa lɛ Yehowa bi lɛ yɛ jɛi akɛ, "Elia, mɛni ofeɔ yɛ biɛ?"

Elia to he ekɛɛ, "Miye Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, he awuŋa kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ekwa Bo kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkumɔ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klaŋte egbe ogbalɔi lɛ hu, ni mi, mi pɛ eshwɛ, ni amɛmiitao mi hu amɛgbɛ."

Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ, "Jee kpo koni oyadamɔ gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baaho.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa baho: ahum ni naa wa ko tswa, ni egbla gɔji, ni ejwara tɛsai kɛnyiɛ Yehowa hiɛ; shi Yehowa bɛ ahum lɛ mli. Ahum lɛ sɛɛ lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso, shi Yehowa bɛ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ mli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ hosomɔ sɛɛ lɛ, la je; shi Yehowa bɛ la lɛ mli; ni la lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ nyrakee ko gbɛɛ kɛho.
Be ni Elia nu gbɛɛmɔ nyrakee lɛ he lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ hɔ etade yuu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo, ni eyadamɔ tɛkplo lɛ naa. Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko bi lɛ akɛ, "Elia, mɛni ofeɔ yɛ biɛ?"

Elia jie enaa ekɛɛ, "Miye Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, he awuŋa kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ekwa Bo kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkumɔ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klaŋte egbe ogbalɔi lɛ hu ni mi pɛ eshwɛ, ni amɛmiitao mi hu ni mi amɛgbɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ. "Kuu osɛɛ ni oya Damasko ŋa lɛ nɔ; otsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli, koni ofɔ Hazeal mu okɛwo lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ ofɔ Nimshi bi Yehu hu mu okɛwo lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ, asaŋ ofɔ Shafat ni jɛ Abel-Mehola lɛ bi Elisha lɛ mu kɛwo lɛ gbalɔ, mɔ ni baaye onajiaŋ.
Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaje Hazael klaŋte naa gbele mli lɛ, Yehu baagbe lɛ, ni mɔ ni baaje Yehu klaŋte naa gbele mli lɛ, Elisha baagbe lɛ.
Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mashwɛ hiɛkãlɔi akpei kpawo yɛ Israel, mɛi fɛɛ ni kulako shi amɛjako amãgã Baal kɛ mɛi hu ni shwɔko amãgã lɛ naa lɛ."

Elia shi jɛi; eyanina Shafat bi Elisha ni eekwɛ tsinai ntai ni miihu nɔ. Tsinai ntai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nyiɛ ehiɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ naagbee tsinai nta lɛ miihu. Be ni Elia hoɔ Elisha he lɛ, ejie etade yuu ni ewo lɛ, ni ekɛwo Elisha.

Elisha shi tsinai lɛ, ni esha foi kɛyi Elia sɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã maya koni mayashwɔ mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ naa koni mi kɛ amɛ aye shɛɛ dani mabanyiɛ osɛɛ. "Elia to he ekɛɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ koni oya, shi moŋ ohiɛ ahi nɔ ni mifee bo lɛ nɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni Elisha ku esɛɛ, ni eyamɔmɔ tsinai nta ni ekɛhuɔ lɛ, ni egbe amɛ, ni ekɛ tsinai lɛ akuɛŋtsei lɛ fee lai, ni ekɛhoo amɛloo lɛ. Ekɛ loo lɛ hã maŋbii ni ekɛ amɛ tsuɔ nii lɛ, ni amɛye. Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee, ni eyanyiɛ Elia sɛɛ akɛ etsulɔ.
20: Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bua etabilɔi fɛɛ anaa kɛkpe. Ena maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ krokomɛi hu kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shiwiili fata ehe. Kɛkɛ ni efã kɛba, ni ebawo Samaria maŋ lɛ he ka, ni eyatua maŋ lɛ.
Etsu bɔfoi kɛtee Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab ŋɔɔ yɛ Samaria maŋ lɛ mli, ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad kɛɛ oŋɔ ojwiɛtɛi kɛ oshika kɛ oŋamɛi lɛ kɛ obii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ obahã lɛ akɛ enɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab to he ekɛɛ. "Nyɛyakɛa minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad akɛ miklpɛ̃ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ nɔ. Ebaanyɛ ebaŋɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hu ni miyɔɔ."
Bɔfoi lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbakɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Naa bɔ ni Ben-Hadad kɛɛ, mitsu aba oŋɔɔ akɛ oŋɔ ojwiɛtɛi kɛ oshika kɛ oŋamɛi kɛ obii lɛ ohã mi;
Kɛ̃lɛ wɔ nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, mibatsu mitsuji oŋɔɔ koni amɛbakpa owe lɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ awei lɛ amli, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaasa amɛhiɛ lɛ, amɛŋɔ amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ̃ kɛba."

Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab tsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛkwɛ lɛ nyɛbaana akɛ sane fɔŋ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ taoɔ ekɛye mi nɛɛ. Ejaakɛ etsu kɛba miŋɔɔ akɛ miŋɔ miŋamɛi kɛ mibii kɛ mijwiɛtɛi kɛ mishika mihã lɛ, ni mikamãaa lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Kaafo mli, ni kaakplɛ̃ hu."

No hewɔ lɛ Ahab kɛɛ Ben-Hadad bɔfoi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyakɛa minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ akɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ nibii fɛɛ hewɔ ni otsu otsulɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, mibafee; shi enɛ lɛ minyɛŋ mafee." Bɔfoi lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛyabɔ Ben-Hadad amaniɛ.

Ben-Hadad saa etsu Ahab ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mikɛ tabilɔi bɔ ni sa baaa koni abakpãtã omaŋ lɛ hiɛ koni amɛloo emli mlu lɛ tete amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ̃ kɛya fii, no lɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ atswa mi nɔ amɛgbe mi."
Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ hã hetoo ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyakɛa Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad akɛ, tabilɔ kpakpa lɛ, ta sɛɛ dani eshwãa, shi jeee be ni ajeko shishi."
Ben-Hadad nine shɛ Ahab shɛɛ lɛ nɔ be mli ni lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi ni fata ehe kɛfã ta lɛ miinu dãa yɛ amɛbuui lɛ amli. Kɛkɛ ni efã esɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛgbaa sa!" Ni amɛgba sa amɛwo maŋ lɛ he.

Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ ni gbalɔ ko ba Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ: 'Te ona asafo kpekpeŋkpekpeŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ? Naa, mibahã oye amɛnɔ kunim ŋmɛnɛ, koni ona ole akɛ mi ji Yehowa.'"

Ahab bi akɛ, "Namɔ baanyiɛ hiɛ kɛyatua amɛ?" Gbalɔ lɛ to he ekɛɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, oblahiiabii tabilɔi ni yɔɔ kpokpoianɔ amralofoi lɛ ashishi lɛ ji mɛi ni anyiɛ hiɛ. '"Kɛkɛ ni Ahab bi akɛ, "Namɔ baatsɛ ta lɛ?" Gbalɔ lɛ to he akɛ, "Bo ni."

No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab bua oblahiiabii tabilɔi ni yɔɔ kpokpaianɔ amralofoi lɛ ashshi lɛ anaa. Amɛyibɔ fee ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ. Mɛi nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Ahab bua mɛi fɛɛ ni ji Isrealbii lɛ anaa; amɛyibɔ fee akpei kpawo.
Israelbii ata lɛ fã shwane fintiŋŋ. Nakai be mli lɛ Ben-Hadad kɛ ewalɔi maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ miitɔ dãa yɛ amɛbuui lɛ amli.
Amralofoi lɛ ashishi oblahiiabii tabilɔi lɛ tsutsu ni fã. Sralɔi ni Ben-Hadad etsu sa lɛ babɔ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ, "Hii komɛi miiba kɛjɛ Samaria."
Ben-Hadad kɛɛ akɛ, "Hejɔlɛ hewɔ amɛbaa jio, ta hewɔ amɛbaa jio, nyɛmɔmɔa amɛ hiɛkãlɔi."
Amralofoi lɛ ashishi oblahiiabii tabilɔi lɛ ni nyiɛ hiɛ, ni ta ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli,

ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbe Siria tabilɔ ni ekɛkpe. Kɛkɛ ni Siriabii lɛ jo foi, be mli ni Israelbii lɛ miitiu amɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ. Shi Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad kɛ ekpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi komɛi ho tra okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛjo foi.
Maŋtsɛ Ahab je kpo kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa, ni ekpãtã Siria okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiili lɛ ahiɛ: ekpãtã Siriabii lɛ ahiɛ butuu naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ tee Maŋtsɛ Ahab ŋɔɔ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa koni oyasaa ohe oto. Ojwɛŋ nɔ ni eba lɛ he, ejaakɛ wɔsɛɛ afi nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baaba ebatua bo."
Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Israelbii anyɔŋmɔi lɛ gɔji anɔ nyɔŋmɔi ni, no hewɔ ni amɛnine tsɔ̃ wɔnɔ lɛ. Shi hã wɔkɛ amɛ awu yɛ ŋa kplenee nɔ, koni okwɛ akɛ wɔnine tsɔŋ amɛnɔ lo?
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni ofee nɛ: Tsakemɔ maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ tatsɛmɛi agbɛhei lɛ, koni okɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ato amɛnajiaŋ yɛ jɛi.

No sɛɛ lɛ, obua tabilɔi ni falɛ shɛɔ ta ni hiɛ kpãtã lɛ naa, kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwilii abɔ tamɔ tsutsu nibii lɛ afalɛ lɛ koni wɔ kɛ Israelbii lɛ awu yɛ ŋa kplenee nɔ, koni okwɛ akɛ wɔnine tsɔŋ amɛnɔ lo." Ben-Hadad bo etsuji lɛ agbee toi, ni efee bɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ.
Be ni eshɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, Ben-Hadad bua Siria tabilɔi anaa, kɛkɛ ni efã kɛba Afek koni ebatua Israelbii lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni abua Israelbii lɛ hu anaa. Amɛtao niyenii amɛkɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛ hu amɛfã koni amɛkɛ Siriabii lɛ ayakpe. Israelbii lɛ yato shi kui enyɔ bɔ ni amɛmiikwɛ Siriabii lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ. Israelbii lɛ afalɛ tamɔ too kui bibii enyɔ; shi Siriabii lɛ eyi ŋa lɛ nɔ tɔ.

Gbalɔ ko yanina Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, akɛni Siriabii lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ gɔji anɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, shi jeee jɔiaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ lɛ, mibahã oye asafo kpekpeŋkpekpeŋ nɛɛ nɔ kunim, koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa lɛ."
Asafoi enyɔ lɛ jwere shi gbii kpawo bɔ ni mɔnɛ miikwɛ mɔnɛ hiɛ. Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ ta lɛ yakūa naa, ni Israelbii lɛ gbɛ Siria tabilɔi nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei oha gbi kome jenamɔ.

Siria tabilɔi ni shwɛ lɛ jo foi kɛbote Afek maŋ lɛ mli; shi maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ wule eshwie tabilɔi ni eshwɛ ateiaŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ lɛ kpawo nɔ. Ben-Hadad jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli, ni eyatee ehe yɛ pia ko mli.

Kɛkɛ ni Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, wɔna wɔnu akɛ Israel we lɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi mɔbɔnalɔi ji amɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, hã wɔklɔ kpekpe wɔŋmɔlɔ wɔhɛ, koni wɔkɛ taŋkpee hu afimɔ wɔyitsei koni wɔya Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ; ekolɛ eeehere oyiwala."

No hewɔ lɛ Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ kɛ kpekpe ŋmɔlɔ amɛhɛ, ni amɛkɛ taŋkpee fimɔ amɛyitsei, ni amɛba Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Otsulɔ Ben-Hadad kɛɛ, 'Miikpa o fai; hã miyi ana wala.'" Ahab bi amɛ akɛ, "Ani ehiɛ kã lolo? Etamɔ minyɛmi pɛ!"

Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ eka amɛtoi kɛmiibo Ahab naa toi; no hewɔ lɛ, oya nɔŋŋ ni amɛtsɛ naa akɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ onyɛmi ji Ben-Hadad." Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa koni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa!" No hewɔ lɛ Ben-Hadad je kpo kɛba Ahab ŋɔɔ. Ahab hã Ben-Hadad kwɔ etayaa shwiili lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Ben-Hadad kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Maji ni mitsɛ shɔ̃ yɛ otsɛ dɛŋ lɛ mibadãi mahã o. Obaabyɛ hu obafo jra yɛ Damasko ohã ohe, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɛ bafee yɛ Samaria lɛ." Ahab dãi sɛɛ ekɛɛ, "Mi hu miidãmɔ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ nɔ miiŋmɛɛ ohe." Amɛkpãŋ yɛ jɛi, kɛkɛ ni Ahab jie Ben-Hadad gbɛ.
Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ, gbalɔi abii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ enaanyo gbalɔi abii lɛ nɔŋŋ eko akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, tswaa mi nɔ!" Shi enaanyo lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ ni etswa lɛ nɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ gbalɔ bi lɛ kɛɛ enaanyo lɛ akɛ, "Akɛni obooo Yehowa gbee toi hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni oooshi mi lɛ jata aaagbe o." Be ni enaanyo nɛɛ kɛ lɛ egbɛ mli ni eyaa lɛ jata ko yatua enaanyo lɛ, ni egbe lɛ.
Gbalɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ na nuu kroko ko, ni ekɛɛ mɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, tswaa mi nɔ!" Mɔ lɛ tswa lɛ nɔ, ni epila lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ tee, ni eyadamɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ eemɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab hoo mli. No mli lɛ gbalɔ lɛ kɛ yitsofii nɔ efī ehiɛsɛɛ ekɛsake ehe.

Be ni Maŋtsɛ Ahab hoɔ lɛ, gbalɔ lɛ bo etsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Otsulɔ tee ta lɛ eko. Ta lɛ mli lɛ tabilɔ ko kɛ henyɛlɔ ko ni emɔ bahã mi shitoo, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Okɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ato. Kɛji ejo foi lɛ, no lɛ okɛ owala baatse, aloo obaawo eyi nyɔŋmɔ jwiɛtɛi talenta kome.'
Shi be ni otsulɔ hiɛ edɔ yɛ nibii krokomɛi ahe lɛ, nuu lɛ jo foi." Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛɛ akɛ, "Obu atɛŋ lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ. Ja ona owo shika lɛ."
Gbalɔ lɛ he fee oya nɔŋŋ ni ekpɔ yitsofii nɔ lɛ yɛ ehiɛsɛɛ. Jɛi ni Isreal Maŋtsɛ lɛ yoo lɛ akɛ gbalɔi lɛ eko ni.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: 'Akɛni oŋmɛɛ mɔ ni mijɔɔ enɔ mihã o koni ogbe lɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, okɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe baatsɛ yɛ enajiaŋ kɛ omaŋ lɛ hu yɛ emaŋ lɛ najiaŋ.'"
Maŋtsɛ Ahab yiŋ etee ewe yɛ Samaria be mli ni efee gblinii, asaŋ ni ehao hu.
21: Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ sane ko hu ni ba nɛ. Nuu koni egbɛi ji Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, yɛ waintrom yɛ Yezereel. Waintrom nɛɛ yɛ Samaria Maŋtsɛ Ahab mɔɔ lɛ masɛi kpaakpa.

Gbi ko lɛ Ahab kɛɛ Nabot akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ owaintrom lɛ ohã mi koni mikɛfee ameo kɛ shitɔ kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ abɔɔ, ejaakɛ ebɛŋkɛ miwe nɛɛ; mikɛ waintrom ni hi fe onɔ lɛ baato bo najiaŋ, aloo kɛji ooosumɔ lɛ, mawo bo nyɔmɔ kɛji oootsɔ̃ɔ mi ejra."
Shi Nabot kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Yehowa akahã enɛ miigbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ̃ akɛ maŋɔ mitsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ mahã bo."

Ahab ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ ni efee gblinii, ni emli ewo la yɛ wiemɔ ni Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, kɛ lɛ wie lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ. "Mikɛ mitsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ haŋ bo. "Eho ekã esaa nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbogbo, ni ekplɔ̃ɛɛ niyeli.
Eŋa Yezebel ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni ofee gblinii nɛkɛ, ni oyee nii nɛɛ?"

Ahab here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ mikɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, wie ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ŋɔɔ owaintrom lɛ ohã mi, ni mahe, aloo kɛji oosumɔ lɛ mikɛ waintrom kroko aaato bo no najiaŋ. 'Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, mikɛ miwaintrom lɛ hãaa bo."
Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Aso maŋtsɛ kɛ̃ oyeɔ yɛ Israel nɛɛ? Tee shi ni oye nii, ni ona tsui. Mi, mahã onine ashɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, waintrom lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel ŋma woji yɛ Ahab gbɛi mli, ni ekɛ Ahab wolonaasɔomɔnɔ lɛ sɔo woji lɛ anaa, kɛkɛ ni ekɛmaje Yezreel maŋ onukpai kɛ abladei ni kɛ Nabot yɔɔ jɛi lɛ.
Eŋma yɛ woji lɛ amli akɛ, "Nyɛshiɛa akɛ ahī ŋmãa; no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛa maŋbii lɛ kpee, ni nyɛhãa Nabot ataa kpee lɛ yitso;
ni nyɛhãa hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ atraa shi ni amɛmiikwɛ Nabot hiɛ, koni amɛye odase amɛshi lɛ akɛ, 'Olomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ. 'Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ akpla lɛ kɛje kpo koni ayatswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo."
Yezreel maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛ abladei ye wiemɔ ni yɔɔ wolo ni Yezebel kɛmaje amɛ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Amɛshiɛ akɛ ahī ŋmãa, ni amɛhã Nabot yata Kpee ni atsɛ lɛ yitso.

Amɛhã hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ komɛi sɛ̃i, ni amɛmiikwɛ Nabot hiɛ. Hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ kɛ sane shi Nabot yɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ akɛ Nabot lomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kpla Nabot kɛshi maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni atsu ayakɛɛ Yezebel akɛ, "Atswia Nabot tɛ agbe lɛ."
Shɛɛ lɛ ni shɛ Yezebel dɛŋ nɔŋŋ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Tee shi koni oyaŋɔ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, abɔɔ lɛ ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ ekɛaahã bo ni ohe kɛ shika lɛ, ejaakɛ Nabot egbo."
Be ni Ahab nu akɛ Nabot egbo lɛ, oya nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni Ahab ŋɔshwie nɔ kɛmiiya Yezreel koni eyaŋɔ abɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ,
"Yaa koni okɛ Ahab, Isreal Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Samaria lɛ ayakpe. Naa, eyɛ Nabot waintrom lɛ mli; etee akɛ eyaaŋɔ trom lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Ei Ahab, ogbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, koni oŋɔ enii lɛ okɛfee onɔ bɛɛ?' Kɛɛmɔ lɛ ofata he akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: He ni gbei lɛmɔ Nabot lá yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ gbei aaalɛmɔ bo hu olá yɛ.'"
Be ni Ahab na Elia lɛ ekɛɛ, "Ei mihenyɛlɔ, bo onine egbe mi nɛɛ." Elia here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Minine egbe bo lɛɛlɛŋ, ejaakɛ ohã efɔŋfeemɔ eŋɔ bo nom yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ bo: 'Mahã sane fɔŋ aye nyɛ, mibaplenee bo kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni okɛyɔɔ weku yɛ Israel, nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ.
Mafee owe lɛ tamɔ mifee Nebat bi Yeroboam we lɛ Ahia bi Baasha hu we lɛ, ejaakɛ ohã mimli efu, ni ohã Israel efee esha.'
Ni yɛ Yezebel hu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ 'Gbei baaya eloo yɛ Yezreel maŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.'
Kɛji owekunyo ko gbo yɛ maŋ lɛ, gbei aaaye eloo, ni owekunyo ni aaayagbo yɛ ŋa nɔ lɛ, loofɔji aaaye eloo."
(Anɔkwa, mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni eŋɔ ehe ehã efɔŋfeemɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahab. Fɛɛ jɛ ehe ni eŋmɛɛ ehã eŋa Yezebel mɔ ni tsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛfee efɔŋ lɛ.
Efee esha ni yɔɔ hiɛgble kɛ ja ni eyaja amãgãi lɛ, tamɔ Amorbii ni Yehowa shwie yɛ Israelbii ahiɛ lɛ fee lɛ).
Be ni Ahab nu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, egbla etadei lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni ehi ŋmãa, ni ebuɔ kpekpe lɛ tete kɛwɔɔ, ni eyaa ni ebaa ni efee gblinii.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ,
"Ona bɔ ni Ahab humiɔ shi yɛ mihiɛ agbɛnɛ? Akɛni eba ehe shi yɛ mihiɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihaŋ efɔŋ lɛ aba yɛ eyinɔ nɛɛ; ebi yinɔ moŋ ni maha efɔŋ lɛ aba ewe lɛ nɔ yɛ."
22: Israel kɛ Siria hi shi hi shi afii etɛ̃ ni ta ko kwraa bɛ amɛteŋ.
Shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat yiŋ etee eyasra Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab.
Ahab kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Bɛ nyɛle akɛ Ramot-Gilead lɛ wɔnɔ ni? Ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔtra shi, ni wɔfeee he eko koni wɔshɔ̃ yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Ahab bi Yehoshafat akɛ, "Be okɛ mi aaatee koni wɔyatua Ramot-Gilead? "Yehoshafat kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Mi nɔŋŋ ji bo; mimaŋbii lɛ omaŋbii ni, mikpɔŋɔi lɛ okpɔŋi ni."
Shi Yehoshafat kɛshi nɔ akɛ, "Shi, wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ wɔbi Yehowa daaŋ gbee dã."

No hewɔ lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab bua gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛkpe, amɛyi aaafee ohai ejwɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Miya miyatua Ramot-Gilead lo, aloo mikaya?" Gbalɔi lɛ to he akɛ, "Yaa, ni Yehowa baatu maŋ lɛ ewo odɛŋ."
Shi Yehoshafat bi akɛ, "Ani Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ, koni wɔyabi nii yɛ eŋɔɔ?"

Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, "Mɔ kome ko yɛ, ni kulɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔyabi Yehowa daaŋ gbee yɛ eŋɔɔ. Lɛji Imla bi Mikaia lɛ; shi moŋ misumɔɔɔ esane, ejaakɛ egbako gbalɛ kpakpa ko yɛ mihe dã, fe akɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ gbalɛ gbonyo. "Shi Yehoshatfat kɛɛ akɛ, "Nii akakɛɛ nakai!"
Kɛkɛ ni Ahab tsɛ piafonyo ko, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa koni okɛ Imla bi Mikaia lɛ ashɛ biɛ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ!"
Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat ewula kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi atadei kɛtra amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ, yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe ni yɔɔ Samaria agbo lɛ naa kpataa lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ miigba yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni ji Kenaana bi Zedekia lɛ fee dade akloŋtoi, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: 'Enɛɛmɛi okɛbaashimɔ Siriabii lɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oookpãta amɛhiɛ.'"
Gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ miigba gbalɛ koome akɛ: "Yaa koni oyatua Ramot-Gilead, ni obaaye omaye ejaakɛ Yehowa baatu maŋ lɛ ewo maŋtsɛ dɛŋ."
Bɔfo ni tee Mikaia tsɛmɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ naabu kome egba gbalɛ kpakpa ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ hã ogbalɛ lɛ kɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome pɛ nɔ afee pɛ."
Shi Mikaia to he akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛkalɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi lɛ, no mawie."

Be ni Mikaia shɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab hiɛ lɛ, Ahab bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani mikɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat aya koni wɔyatua Ramot-Gilead, aloo wɔkaya?" Mikaia here nɔ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa; nyɛbaaye omanye. Yehowa baajɔɔ maŋ lɛ nɔ ahã nyɛ."
Shi Ahab kɛɛ Mikaia akɛ, "Shii enyiɛ po mahã okã mi kitã akɛ, kɛji okɛ mi miiwie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ okagba mi nɔ kroko fe anɔkwale lɛ kɛkɛ?"
Mikaia to he akɛ, "Miina Israel tabilɔi lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ toi ni bɛ kplalɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, 'Hii nɛɛ bɛ nuŋtsɔ; hã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aku esɛɛ eya shīa yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, "Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ egbaŋ gbalɛ jurɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ yɛ mihe, fe efɔŋ pɛ?"
Mikaia tee no ekɛɛ, "Agbɛnɛ bo Yehowa naa wiemɔ toi! Mina Yehowa ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebɔfoi asafo lɛ fɛɛ damɔ emasɛi yɛ eninejurɔ nɔ kɛ ebɛku nɔ.
Ni Yehowa bi akɛ, 'Namɔ aaayalaka Ahab koni eya ni eyanyɔ yɛ Ramot-Gilead?'" Bɔfoi lɛ ekomɛi kɛɛ nɛkɛ, be mli ni mɛi komɛi hu miikɛɛ nɔ kroko.
Ahiɛ nakai aahuu kɛyashi mumɔ ko je kpo kɛbadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ; ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mi maya mayalaka lɛ."
Ni Yehowa bi lɛ akɛ, "Yɛ mɛɛ Yehowa gbɛ nɔ?" Mumɔ lɛ to he ekɛɛ, "Maya, ni mibatsɔ̃ amale mumɔ yɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa." Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Yaa koni oyalaka lɛ; onine baashɛ enɔ."
Ni Mikaia mu ewiemɔ lɛ naa nɛkɛ, "Enɛ ji nɔ ni eba lɛ. Yehowa ehã ogbalɔi nɛɛ egba amale gbalɛ amɛkɛlaka bo. Shi lɛ lɛ eto akɛ okɛ amanehulu baaya ayakpe!"
Kɛkɛ ni Kenaana bi Zedekia, gbalɔ lɛ, tsi bɛŋkɛ Mikaia, ni egba Mikaia hiɛ mã, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ be nɛ ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ je minɔ, ni ekɛ bo bawie?"
Mikaia to he akɛ, "Gbi ni obaajɛ pia kome mli kɛya pia kroko mli ni oootee ohe lɛ, gbi lɛ nɔ ooona ole."
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ Ahab fã etsulɔ ko ekɛɛ, "Mɔ Mikaia koni okɛ lɛ ayawo Amon maŋ lɛ amralo lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛbi Yoash dɛŋ."
Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ: 'Nyɛwoa lɛ tsuŋ, ni ahã lɛ aboloo fioo kɛ nu fioo pɛ daa gbi akɛ enyienii kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maya mayaye omanye maba.'"
Shi Mikaia kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji otee, ni oyaye omanye, ni oba fii, belɛ jeee Yehowa ni tsɔ̃ minɔ wie lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ toi."
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat fã kɛtee koni amɛyatua Ramot-Gilead.
Ahab kɛɛ Yehshatfat akɛ, "Mibatsake mihe kɛya ta lɛ naa; shi bo lɛ wulamɔ kɛ obladei atadei lɛ." No hewɔ lɛ Ahab tsake ehe kɛtee ta lɛ naa.
Shi Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo etayaa shwiili lɛ anɔ asafoitsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ kitã akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko, mɔ wulu ni jio, mɔ bibioo ni jio, akawua akɛ ja Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ."

No hewɔ lɛ be ni Siria asafoitsɛmɛi lɛ na Yehoshafat lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ pi nɛ!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛgba kɛtee koni amɛkɛ lɛ ayawu. Shi Yehoshafat blɔ, kɛkɛ ni ayoo lɛ.
Be ni shwiili lɛ anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ na akɛ jeee Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni lɛ, amɛkpa esɛɛnyiɛmɔ.

Shi Siria asraafonyo ko gãi ni etsɛ̃ ni jeee gbɛ eje etsɛ̃ lɛ yatsu Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ trukaa, yɛ eŋwɛigbɛ dama lɛ kɛ shishigbɛ dama lɛ kpeehe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ eshwiili kudɔlɔ lɛ akɛ, "Dɔɔ oyi koni okɛ mi aje ta lɛ naa, shi mipila."
Ta lɛ mli wa pam nakai gbi lɛ; ni ahiɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ mli kɛdamɔ shi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli yɛ Siriabii ahiɛ; lá ni jɛ epilamɔ lɛ mli lɛ bua shwiili lɛ mli; egbo gbɛkɛnaashi mli.
Hulushinyɔɔ mli lɛ, ashiɛ yɛ ta lɛ naa akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya eshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ emaŋ."
Belɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab nyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli, ni akɛ egbonyo lɛ ba Samaria, ni abafu lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ayafɔ Ahab shwiili lɛ he yɛ Samaria kpaakpo lɛ naa, ni gbei yalɛmɔ Ahab lá lɛ, ni yei ajwamaŋi yaju amɛhe yɛ mli taakɛ Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Ahab he saji krokomɛi ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ shwuɔ wu tsu ko ni ema kɛ maji fɛɛ ni eto lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ahab gbele sɛɛ lɛ, ebi Ahazia baye esɛɛ akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ.
Asa bi Yehoshafat bɔ̃i Yuda mantsɛyeli yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
Yehoshafat eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumo be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ ji Shilhi biyoo ni egbɛi ji Azuba lɛ.
Yehoshafat ba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ tamɔ etsɛ Asa. Efee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, shi moŋ efiteee jemawɔji ajamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ tee nɔ amɛshã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋma yɛ hei nɛɛ.
Yehoshafat kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kpãŋ, ni amɛhi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ Yehoshafat he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ ekãa ni efee kɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ ewuwuu tai ehã lɛ aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Eshwie hii kɛ yei ajwamaŋbɔlɔi ni ashi yɛ etsɛ Asa yinɔ, yɛ jemawɔji afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ anaa lɛ anaa lɛ fɛɛ kɛje jɛi.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ maŋtsɛ ko bɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amralo ko ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ najiaŋ yɔɔ jɛi.
Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kpɛ Tarshishbii alɛlɛ henɔi komɛi koni akɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛya Ofir yɛ jɛi shika tsuru hewɔ; shi ayanyɛɛɛ akɛya, ejaakɛ lɛji lɛ jwara yɛ Ezion-Geber.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia, Ahab bi lɛ, kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, "Hã otsuji lɛ abashi mitsuji lɛ anɔ yɛ lɛji lɛ amli."Shi Yehoshafat eyakplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ.
Yehoshafat gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ eblematsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni ebi Yehoram baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahab bi Ahazia baye Israel maŋtsɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Ekɔ etsɛ Ahab kɛ enyɛ Yezebel yitsoŋwalɛ jeŋba lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛ Nebat bi Yeroboam, mɔ ni hã Israel fee esha lɛ, hu jeŋba lɛ.
Esɔ̃mɔ, ni eja Baal, ni ewo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli la tamɔ etsɛ fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

1: Petro ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo lɛ ŋma yahã gbɔi ni egbɛ eshwã Ponto, Galata, Kapadokia, Asia kɛ Bitinia lɛ. Amɛji mɛi ni ahala
yɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ le ni ele eto momo lɛ naa. Nyɔŋmɔ fee enɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ hetsuumɔ nɔ, koni amɛkase toiboo ni akɛ Yesu Kristo lá lɛ ashwã amɛnɔ. Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ afa ahã nyɛ!
Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ. Efɔ wɔ ehee yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa, ni ehã wɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni gbooo kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo shi ni ete kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔmiikwɛ gbohinii ni fiteee ni he bɛ kpa ko ni ekwaaa, ni akɛto yɛ ŋwɛi ahã wɔ lɛ gbɛ.
Ni atsɔ̃ɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa atoɔ yiwalaheremɔ ni asaa ato ni abaajie kpo yɛ naagbee be lɛ mli lɛ.
No hãa nyɛmli fliɔ nyɛ, tsɛbelɛ ŋmɛnɛ, kɛ efi, nyɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ fioo ko yɛ kai srɔtoi amli.
No aaahã ana nyɛ hemɔkɛyeli salɛ lɛ akɛ ejra wa aahuu fe shika ni fiteɔ ni aka yɛ la mli tete, kɛhã yijiemɔ kɛ woo kɛ anumnyam yɛ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛnako lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ; ni amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ hu nyɛnaaa lɛ moŋ, shi nyɛhe enɔ nyɛye. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛmli fliɔ nyɛ kɛ miishɛɛ ni anyɛɛɛ agba ni yɔɔ nyam babaoo lɛ,
ejaakɛ nyɛnine miishɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli naagbee ni ji nyɛsusumai ayiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ nɛɛ, gbalɔi ni gba yɛ dromɔ ni nyɛbaana lɛ he lɛ tao sɛɛgbɛ ni amɛtao mli fitsofitso.
Ni amɛsaa amɛtao amɛna be lɛ ni Kristo Mumɔ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, be mli ni eyeɔ amanehulu ni baaba Kristo nɔ kɛ anumnyam ni baaba yɛ nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ ahe odase etoɔ lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni nakai be lɛ yɔɔ.

Ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ, jeee amɛ diɛtsɛ amɛhewɔ, shi moŋ nyɛhewɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ahe, nii ni agbɛnɛ mɛi ni jaje Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni atsu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ mli lɛ eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete shweɔ akɛ amɛaana mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsaa nyɛjwɛŋmɔ, nyɛhiɛ akãa shi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔa dromɔ ni akɛbaahã nyɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ mli lɛ nɔ kwraa.
Nyɛfea nyɛhe bii toibolɔi ni nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ sa be ni nyɛleee nɔ ko lɛ mli akɔnɔi lɛ anaa dɔŋŋ.
Shi moŋ, bɔ ni mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ lɛ yɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ nyɛjeŋba fɛɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ. "Nyɛfea Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi."
Ni kɛ nyɛtsɛɔ mɔ ni kwɛɛɛ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ shi ekojoɔ yɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ naa lɛ akɛ nyɛ-Tsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ abaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyɛgbɔtoo be lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ jeee nibii ni fiteɔ, tamɔ jwiɛtɛi loo shika, akɛkpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛyaka jeŋba ni nyɛna kɛjɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ mli;
shi moŋ Kristo, mɔ ni tamɔ Toobi ni he bɛ kpa loo ŋmamɔ nɔ ko lɛ lá ni jra wa lɛ akɛkpɔ̃ nyɛ.
Ahala lɛ ato momosa dani ato jeŋ shishi, shi ajie lɛ kpo yɛ bei lɛ anaagbee mli yɛ nyɛhewɔ.
Nyɛtsɔ̃ enɔ nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli kɛ nyɛhiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Ni akɛni nyɛtsuu nyɛsusumai ahe yɛ anɔkwale lɛ toiboo mli nyɛhã nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ni osato bɛ mli lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsui krɔŋŋ asumɔsumɔa nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ afɔ nyɛ ehee, ni jeee wui ni fiteɔ, shi moŋ nɔ ni fiteee mli ajɛ afɔ nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ ni hiɔ shi daa lɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ, "heloo fɛɛ tamɔ jwɛi, ni enumnyam lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ jwɛiaŋ fɔfɔi. Jwɛi gbiɔ ni emli fɔfɔi lɛ kplaa.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ." Enɛ ji wiemɔ ni ajaje atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ.
2: No hewɔ lɛ nyɛshɛrɛa efɔŋ fɛɛ kɛ kutumpɔo fɛɛ kɛ shishiumɔ kɛ osato kɛ hetsɛ̃ kɛ mɔhewiemɔ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea.
Akɛ fufɔbii ni afɔ amɛ bianɛ lɛ, nyɛshwea wiemɔ lɛ mli fufɔ krɔŋŋ lɛ, koni nyɛdra yɛ mli kɛna yiwalaheremɔ,
akɛni nyɛsanyɛnaa nyɛna akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli hi lɛ.
Lɛ eŋɔɔ nyɛba akɛ tɛ ni hiɛ kã ni gbɔmɛi ekwa lɛ moŋ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ ehala lɛ ni ejra wa yɛ ehiɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛ hu nyɛhãa atswaa nyɛ akɛ tɛi ni hiɛ kãmɔ afea mumɔŋ tsu ni afee nyɛ osɔfoi aweku krɔŋkrɔŋ, koni akɛshã mumɔŋ afɔlei ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo hewɔ.
No hewɔ hu ni eyɔɔ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli akɛ, "Naa, mikɛ koŋte miiŋmɛ shi yɛ Zion, tɛ ni ahala ni ejra wa. Ni mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ hiɛ gboŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ejra wa hã nyɛ; shi mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ, "Tɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ ekwa lɛ, No nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ"
kɛ "Tɛmɔtɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ehã amɛ." Ejaakɛ akɛni amɛbooo wiemɔ lɛ toi hewɔ lɛ amɛtrɛ, ni no nɔŋŋ ato amɛ ahã;
shi nyɛ lɛ, weku ni ahala ji nyɛ, osɔfoi, maŋtsɛmɛi, jeŋmaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, maŋ ni ekɛfee enɔ, koni nyɛjaje mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛjɛ duŋ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enaakpɛɛ la lɛ he lɛ agbojee lɛ;
nyɛ ni sa lɛ nyɛjeee maŋ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ ji nyɛ, nyɛ ni anaaa nyɛ mɔbɔ, shi agbɛnɛ ana nyɛ mɔbɔ lɛ.
Misuɔmɔmɛi, miiwie miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ gbɔi kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋsɛɛ akɛ nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa heloosɛɛdiinii ni kɛ susuma wuɔ ta lɛ ahe,
ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ateŋ, koni be mli ni amɛwieɔ nyɛhe akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, amɛkɛ nyɛnitsumɔi kpakpai lɛ ni amɛbaana lɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ sramɔ Gbi lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa gbɔmɛi agbɛjianɔtoo fɛɛ gbɛjiannɔtoo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ, maŋtsɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ jio,
lumɛi ni etsu yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anɔ oweletɔɔ hewɔ kɛ ekpakpafeelɔi ayijiemɔ hewɔ kɛ ekpakpafeelɔi ayijiemɔ hewɔ lɛ jio.
Ejaakɛ nakai ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, akɛ ekpakpafeemɔ nyɛkɛaatsī gbɔmɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ lɛ akwashiafeemɔ fɛɛ naa,
akɛ mɛi ni eye amɛhe, shi jeee mɛi ni nyɛkɛ nyɛheyeli lɛ aaafee efɔŋ nɔhaanɔ, shi moŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji.
Nyɛwoa mɛi fɛɛ; nyɛsumɔa nyɛmimɛi lɛ; nyɛshea Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, nyɛwoa maŋtsɛ.
Webii, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ fɛɛ abaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛnuŋtsɔmɛi, jeee mɛi kpakpai kɛ mɛi nuɔ nii ahe hãa mɔ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji dromɔ, kɛ lee ni mɔ ko le Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ ni ena amanehulu ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ tɔ̃ nyɛtɔ̃ ni ayi nyɛ ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ yɛ mli lɛ, mɛɛ anumnyam yɔɔ mli? Shi kɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa ni nyɛna he amanehulu ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no ji nɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ atsɛ nyɛ, ejaakɛ Kristo hu na amanehulu ehã nyɛ ni ekɛfee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ehã nyɛ, koni nyɛnyiɛ enanemaahei lɛ asɛɛ.
Lɛ mɔ ni efeee esha ni asaŋ anaaa shishiumɔ yɛ edaaŋ lɛ.
Mɔ ni be ni ajɛɔ lɛ lɛ, ejɛɛɛ mɔ ko etooo najiaŋ, be ni enaa amanehulu lɛ, elomɔɔɔ mɔ ko, shi moŋ etu esane ewo mɔ ni kojoɔ jalɛ naa lɛ dɛŋ lɛ.

Kristo diɛŋtsɛ etre wɔhe eshai lɛ yɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli kɛtee sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ, koni wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni egboi yɛ esha gbɛfaŋ ni wɔhiɛ akamɔ yɛ jalɛ gbɛfaŋ ni wɔhiɛ akamɔ yɛ lɛ jalɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ; lɛ ehe faji akɛtsa nyɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kulɛ nyɛtamɔ toi ni elaafe, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba nyɛsusumai alɛlɔ kɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
3: Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ hu, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwumɛi lɛ, koni, kɛ mɛi komɛi booo wiemɔ lɛ toi tete lɛ, ashi wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ yei lɛ ajeŋba nɔ ni nine ashɛ amɛnɔ,
ejaakɛ amɛnaa nyɛjeŋba ni he tse ni gbeyeishemɔ yɔɔ mli lɛ.
Ni nyɛhewulamɔ akafee yigbɔɔ kɛ shikawoo kɛ ataadewoo yɛ kponɔgbɛ.
Shi moŋ efee tsui mli gbɔmɔ ni akɛtee yɛ mumɔ ni he jɔ ni yɔɔ kpoo lɛ hewulamɔ ni fiteee lɛ mli lɛ; no ji nɔ ni jra wa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ sa lɛ, nakai ji bɔ ni yei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu ni hiɛ kã Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ wula amɛhe, ni amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi.
Tamɔ bɔ ni Sara bo Abraham toi, ni etsɛɔ lɛ "Nuŋtsɔ" lɛ ebiyei ji nyɛ, kɛ nyɛfeɔ ekpakpa ni nyɛsheee nɔ ko gbeyei lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ wumɛi, nyɛkɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ ahia shi yɛ nilee naa, ni nyɛkɛ woo awoa yoo akɛ mɔ ni he waaa tuuutu ko, akɛni amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ji wala dromɔ lɛ niyelɔi lɛ, koni akatsī nyɛsɔlemɔi lɛ agbɛ.
Shi naagbee lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛa jwɛŋmɔ kome, nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe, nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe akɛ nyɛmimɛi, nyɛmli ashãa nyɛ ahãa nyɛhe, nyɛjwɛŋa heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ.
Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa efɔŋ najiaŋ aloo jɛmɔ yɛ jɛmɔ najiaŋ, shi moŋ nyɛjɔa, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ enɛ hewɔ atsɛ nyɛ, koni nyɛnine ashɛ jɔɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi, "Mɔ ni taoɔ wala asumɔ ni ena gbi kpakpai lɛ, emɔ elilɛi mli kɛje efɔŋ he, kɛ enaabu hu koni ekawie shishiumɔ wiemɔ.
Ewi efɔŋ ni efee ekpakpa. Etao hejɔlɛ ni enyiɛ no sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiŋmɛi kã jalɔ ahe, ni eboɔ amɛfaikpamɔ toi; shi mɛi ni feɔ nifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ejie ehiɛ eka amɛ."
Ni kɛ nyɛbɔɔ ekpakpa he mɔdɛŋ lɛ, namɔ aaafee nyɛ efɔŋ?
Shi kɛ jalɛ hewɔ nyɛnaa amanehulu tete lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ. Shi nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛkahea hu.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ, Kristo lɛ, nyɛbua lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli; ni daa nɛɛ nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, koni nyɛna hetoo nyɛhã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ nyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ shi lɛ;
shi nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ bulɛ ahãa hetoo, ni nyɛhiɛ henilee kpakpa, koni be ni aawie nyɛhe efɔŋ lɛ, mɛi ni gbeɔ nyɛjeŋba kpakpa ni nyɛyɔɔ akɛ Kristofoi lɛ he guɔ lɛ ahiɛ agboi.
Ejaakɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ akɛ nyɛna amanehulu lɛ, ehi moɛ akɛ nyɛaana amanehulu akɛ ekpakpafeelɔi fe nɔ ni nyɛaana amanehulu akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi.
Ejaakɛ Kristo hu na amanehulu yɛ eshia ahewɔ shi kome, lɛ jalɔ lɛ yɛ mɛi ni ejaaa lɛ anajiaŋ, koni ekɛ wɔ aya Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ. Ni agbe lɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ moŋ, shi ahã lɛ wala yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ.
Ni mumɔ lɛ mli etsɔ̃ kɛtee mumɔi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ, eyashiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.

Amɛ mɛi ni blema lɛ amɛbooo toi, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛ etsui shi ni emɛ amɛ aahuu yɛ Noa bei lɛ amli, be ni afeɔ adeka kpeteŋkple lɛ, nɔ mli ni ahere mɛi fioo ni ji mɛi kpaanyɔ lɛ asusumai ayiwala yɛ kɛtsɔ̃ nu mli lɛ,
Ni agbɛnɛ baptisimɔ shi nakai nu lɛ ji ehe okadi lɛ hereɔ nyɛ hu nyɛyiwala. Ejeee hewolo nɔ mujijiemɔ, shi moŋ eji kpãŋmɔ ni ajɛɔ henilee kpakpa mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋɔ, kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo shitee lɛ nɔ,
mɔ ni etee ŋwɛi ni eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni akɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ hegbɛi kɛ hewalɛi fɛɛ ewo eshishi lɛ.
4: Agbɛnɛ akɛni Kristo na amanehulu ehã wɔ yɛ heloo mli hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ nakai jwɛŋmɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ amiaa akɛ tawuunii, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ena amanehulu yɛ heloo mli lɛ, ekpa eshafeemɔ.
Koni be ni eshwɛ ehã lɛ yɛ heloo mli shishilɛ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ekahi shi yɛ gbɔmɛi akɔnɔi anaa dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii anaa.
Ejaakɛ be ni eho momo lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛna be bɔ ni sa nyɛkɛtsu jeŋmajiaŋbii atsui naanii lɛ, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyenyetswibɔɔ, akɔnɔi, dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ, ninumɔ kɛ wɔŋjamɔ hi ahiɔ lɛ amli.
Ni agbɛnɛ ni nyɛhe etswaaa shi nyɛkɛ amɛ eyaaa nɛkɛ shishilɛ gbonyo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ mli hewɔ lɛ, efeɔ amɛ naakpɛɛ ni amɛwieɔ nyɛhe musubɔɔ wiemɔi.
Shi amɛbaabu akɔŋtaa amɛhã mɔ ni esaa ehe eto ni ebaakojo hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ ni ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ gbohii tete hu, koni amɛhi shi yɛ mumɔŋ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ, tsɛ akojo amɛ bɔ ni akojoɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.
Shi nibii fɛɛ anaagbee lɛ eshɛ etã. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛwɛŋmɔ mli atsea ni nyɛhiɛ akãa shi ahãa sɔlemɔi.
Shi titri lɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ mli awa, ejaakɛ suɔmɔ haaa eshai babaoo nɔ.
Nyɛfeefea nyɛhe gbɔ ni huhūumɔ akahi mli.
Nyɛdromɔkeenii lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ena lɛ, nyɛkɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni jeɔ kpo yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi anɔ lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi kpakpai.

Kɛ wiemɔ mɔ ko wieɔ lɛ, ewie lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi; kɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɔ ko sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, esɔ̃mɔ akɛ hewalɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hãa lɛ lɛ mli ejeɔ esɔ̃mɔɔ, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ nii fɛɛ mli; lɛ enɔ ji anumnyam lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛkahãa amanehulu la ni akɛkãa nyɛ lɛ miifee nyɛ sane srɔto ko, tamɔ akɛ nɔ ko srɔto ko feɔ nyɛ lɛ;
shi moŋ bɔbɔ ni nyɛnaa Kristo amanehului lɛ eko lɛ, nakai nyɛmii ashɛa, koni enumnyam kpojiemɔ lɛ mli hu nyɛmii ashɛ ni nyɛmli afli nyɛ.
Kɛ Kristo gbɛi hewɔ ajɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ, ejaakɛ anumnyam Mumɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ.
Shi nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akana amanehulu akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ loo julɔ loo efɔŋfeelɔ aloo mɔ ko ni ehe woɔ mɛi krokomɛi asaji amli.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko na amanehulu akɛ Kristofonyo lɛ, ehiɛ akagbo, shi moŋ ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam ejaakɛ ehiɛ Kristo gbɛi.
Ejaakɛ be ni abaaje kojomɔ shishi kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ eshɛ etã; shi kɛ wɔnɔ tsutsu ejɛ lɛ, belɛ mɛi ni booo Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ, te amɛnaagbee aaafee tɛŋŋ?
Ni kɛ ekpakpa ko dani aaahere jalɔ yiwala lɛ, "Mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei kɛ eshafeelɔ lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ amɛbaadamɔ?"
No hewɔ lɛ mɛi ni naa amanehulu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaa lɛ hu atu amɛsusumai amɛwo bɔlɔ anɔkwafo lɛ dɛŋ yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ mli.
5: No hewɔ lɛ onukpai ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mi ni miji onukpa lɛ eko kɛ Kristo amanehului lɛ ahe odasefonyo ni baana anumnyam ni abaajie kpo lɛ hu eko lɛ; ŋaa ni miwoɔ amɛ nɛ.
Nyɛlɛa Nyɔŋmɔ tooku ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ nyɛkwɛa nɔ, jeee nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ yɛ suɔmɔ naa; tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ, asaŋ jeee sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛgble hewɔ, shi moŋ tsui jurɔ naa;
asaŋ jeee akɛ mɛi ni yeɔ mɛi ni akɛhã nyɛ nɔkwɛmɔ lɛ anɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, shi moŋ mɛi ni feɔ amɛhe nɔkwɛmɔnɔ amɛhãa toiku lɛ.
Ni be ni Tookwɛlɔnukpa lɛ aaajie ehe kpo lɛ, nyɛnine aaashɛ anumnya akekre ni ŋlãaa lɛ nɔ.

Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa onukpai lɛ. Ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbabaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛ heshibaa afee mama nyɛŋmɔa nyɛhɛ, ejaakɛ ŋmale lɛ kɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ kuɔ, hewolɔi anaa, shi edroɔ heshibalɔi."
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nine ni wa lɛ shishi, koni ewo nyɛnɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhaomɔ fɛɛ afɔ̃a enɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛsane kã etsui nɔ.
Nyɛhiɛ akãa shi, nyɛsraa ejaakɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔ, abonsam lɛ, nyiɛ tãmɔ jata ni huɔ eetao mɔ ko emi.
Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli nyɛtsīa lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nakai amanehului lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ hu naa.
Shi dromɔ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛba enaanɔ anumnyam lɛ mli yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, kɛ nyɛna amanehulu fioo nɛɛ etã lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eeesaa nyɛ pɛ, ni eeehã nyɛfi shi shiŋŋ.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ aaaŋɔ hewalɛ ahã kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Mitsɔ̃ wɔnyɛmi Silvano ni ji anɔkwafo tamɔ bɔ ni mibuɔ lɛ lɛ nɔ miŋma nyɛ wolo fioo nɛɛ mikɛmiiwo nyɛ ekãa, ni mikɛmiiye odase miishi sɛɛ akɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa dromɔ lɛ. Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ mli.
Asafo ni yɔɔ Babilon ni ahala amɛ tamɔ ahala wɔ lɛ kɛ mibi Marko hu miibi nyɛ.
Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ suɔmɔ naashwɔmɔ.

1: Nuu ko hi shi yɛ Rama yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ. Egbɛi ji Elkana, ni etsɛ gbɛi ji Yeroham. Zuf bi Tohu bi Elihu bi ji Elkana nɛɛ.
Elkana yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Hana, ni mɔ kome lɛ hu gbɛi ji Penina. Penina yɛ bii shi Hana bɛ bi.
Daa afi lɛ Elkana yaa Shilo eyasɔleɔ ni eshãa afɔle ehãa Yehowa ni ji Tatsɛ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, ni ji Hofni kɛ Finehas, miiye Yehowa osɔfo yɛ Shilo.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi ni Elkana baaya eyashã afɔle lɛ, ehãa eŋa Penina kɛ Penina bihii lɛ kɛ ebiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ loo kukuli.
Shi Hana lɛ eyɛ mli akɛ Elkana sumɔɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi loo kukuli kome nɔŋŋ ehãa lɛ hu, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãko lɛ bi.
Enɛ hãa Hana bienyɛ Penina kɛ fɔmɔ yeɔ Hana he fɛo, ni ekɛwoɔ emli la naakpa bɔ ni ehãa Hana gbigbliɔ emli akɛ Yehowa etsi efɔmɔ naa.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni nibii tee nɔ daa afi. Shii abɔ fɛɛ ni amɛyaa Yehowa we lɛ, ebienyɛ Penina yeɔ ahe fɛo. Kɛkɛ lɛ efeɔ Hana yaafo, ni eyeee nii.
kɛfee nakai lɛ ewu Elkana kɛɔ Hana akɛ, "Hana, mɛɛba ni ofoɔ; ni asaŋ oyeee nii? Mɛɛba ni oyeɔ otsui? Mihiii hãaa bo fe musuŋ bihii nyɔŋma?"
Be ko be ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nɔ ko yɛ Shilo sɛɛ lɛ, Hana te shi ni ewerɛ eho ehe naakpa. Ni efo waa be ni esɔleɔ etsɛɔ Yehowa lɛ.
Nakai beiaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ Osɔfo Eli ta sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinaatso lɛ masɛi.

Hana wo shi ekɛɛ, "Yehowa Taiatsɛ, kɛji oookwɛ mi, oweyoo, mimanehulu nɛɛ, ni oookai mi, ni ohiɛ kpaŋ mi oweyoo nɔ; shi moŋ ooohã mi oweyoo binuu lɛ, no lɛ majɔɔ enɔ mahã bo, Yehowa, ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ; ni asooyi naa esaŋ eyiteŋ."
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Hana hiɛ sɔlemɔ lɛ aahuu yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, Eli kwɛ enaabu.
Shi Hana miiwie yɛ etsui mli. Anuuu egbee akɛ fe enaabu kɛkɛ ni tsɔmɔɔ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Eli susu akɛ dãa Hana etɔ.
Ni Eli kɛɛ Hana akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni oootɔ dãa kɛyashi? Hã ni owain lɛ atserɛ yɛ ohiɛ."
Shi Hana here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Dabida, minuŋtsɔ, miji yoo ko ni miwerɛ eho mihe naakpa. Minuko wain loo dãa ko ni wa; shi moŋ miifɔse mitsui mli awerɛho sane mashwie Yehowa hiɛ.
Kaabu mi, oweyoo akɛ yoo yakagbɔmɔ ko; shi mikɔmɔ kɛ mlila ni awoɔ sɔŋŋ naa miwieɔ yɛ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ nɛɛ."
Eli to he hã Hana ekɛɛ, "Omanye abla o, ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ahã o nii ni obi lɛ lɛ."
Hana kɛɛ Eli akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, ohã misane nɛɛ akã otsui nɔ." Kɛkɛ ni Hana yiŋ etee, ni agbɛnɛ eyatao nɔ ko eye, ni ehiɛ efeee tɔtɔɔtɔ dɔŋŋ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Elkana kɛ eŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa, be ni amɛtee amɛyaja Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Rama. Elkana kɛ eŋa Hana yawɔ, ni Yehowa mɔbɔnalɛ naa lɛ,
be ni shɛɔ afi naakplɔ lɛ Hana ena musu, ni efɔ binuu. Hana wo ebifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ Samuel, ni ekɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ miba lɛ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ."
Be ni afi shɛ lɛ, Elkana kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii lɛ tee koni amɛyashã daa afi naakplɔ afɔle yɛ shi krɛdɛɛ ni ewo lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Hana eyaaa eko ejaakɛ ekɛɛ ewu Elkana akɛ, "Mamɛ kɛyashi matse gbekɛ lɛ fufɔ dani mikɛ lɛ ayapue yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni ehi jɛi kwraa."
Elkana to he ekɛɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ; feemɔ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ. Hii shi kɛyashi oootse abifao lɛ fufɔ. Yehowa ahã eshiwoo lɛ aba mli kɛkɛ." No hewɔ lɛ Hana hi shi, ni ekwɛ abifao lɛ kɛyashi etse lɛ fufɔ lɛ.
Be ni Hana tse gbekɛ lɛ fufɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ tee Yehowa we lɛ yɛ Shilo, ni ehiɛ edɛŋ tsina nuu ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ ŋmaa mamu kiloi nyɔŋma kɛ wain tɔ kome. Nakai be mli tete lɛ Samuel edako.
Agbe tsina nuu lɛ, ni akɛ gbekɛnuu fioo lɛ ba Eli ŋɔɔ,
ni Hana kɛɛ Eli akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, ookai mi. Miji yoo lɛ ni badamɔ omasɛi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ nyɛsɛɛ ko, ni ebakpa Yehowa fai, ni eba lɛ nii lɛ.
Gbekɛ nɛɛ he fai mibakpa lɛ, ni Yehowa ehã mi nɔ ni mibaba lɛ lɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ miijɔɔ enɔ kwraa miihã Yehowa. Mikɛ lɛ miike Yehowa ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ." Kɛkɛ ni amɛja Yehowa yɛ jɛi.
2: Kɛkɛ ni Hana sɔle yɛ jɛi ni ekɛɛ "Yehowa, ohã mimli efli mi, ni minyɛ mihiɛ nɔ miwo. Mibaŋmɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ ohere mi.
"Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko bɛ tamɔ bo, Yehowa, osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; mɔ ko bɛ hewalɛ tamɔ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkawiea kɛ henɔwomɔ nɛkɛ dɔŋŋ; nyɛkawiea kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nilelɔ ni, ni lɛ ekojoɔ adesai anifeemɔnii.
Kãkãlɔi lɛ agãitsei lɛ ekumɔ, ni mɛi ni he waaa lɛ ena hewalɛ.
Mɛi ni kulɛ amɛyeɔ nii amɛtrɔɔ lɛ, amɛmiiye apaa yɛ daaŋ ŋmãa hewɔ, ni mɛi ni kulɛ amɛwɔɔ hɔmɔ lɛ amɛwɔɔɔ hɔmɔ dɔŋŋ. Naa, kene lɛ efɔ kpawo, ni biianyɛ lɛ moŋ etsɔ̃ mɔ kome mɔ.
Yehowa ni gbeɔ mɔ, ni etsiɛɔ mɔ hiɛ hu; ehãa ayaa gbohiiaje, ni ehãa akpaleɔ abaa ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa ni hãa ayeɔ ohai, ni ehãa anaa nii hu; lɛ ebaa mɔ shi, asaŋ lɛ ewoɔ mɔ nɔ hu.
Eteɔ ohaifo shi kɛjɛɔ mlu mli, ni ewoɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ nɔ yɛ tumu nɔ, koni amɛ kɛ abladei atra shi, ni amɛna sɛ̃ii ni yɔɔ nyam anɔ amɛtra, ejaakɛ je lɛ shishitoo lɛ enɔ ni, ni lɛ etswa je lɛ ema nɔ.
Eeebaa enɔkwafoi lɛ ayi, shi mɛi fɔɔji lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ duŋ mli, ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hewalɛ naa eyeɔ kunim yɛ.
Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ, aaakumɔ amɛ dukuduku ashwie shi; eeehã ŋwɛi ashimɔ awo amɛ; Yehowa ji je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ; ebaahã amaŋtsɛ lɛ ana hewalɛ, ni emɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ eeehã eye kunim."
Kɛkɛ ni Elkana ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ yɛ Rama, ni eshi gbekɛnuu fioo, Samuel lɛ, koni esɔmɔ Yehowa yɛ Osɔfo Eli shishi.
Osɔfo Eli bihii lɛ yafee amɛhe yakagbɔmɛi, ni amɛbuu Yehowa,
loo osɔfoi lɛ agbɛnaanii ni sa akɛ amɛhe yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ. Nɔ ni afeɔ ji akɛ kɛji mɔ ko ba afɔleshãa lɛ, osɔfo lɛ tsulɔ baa, be mli ni ahoɔ loo lɛ, ni ehiɛ faka kɛ enyanyɔji etɛ̃.
Tsulɔ lɛ kɛ faka lɛ tsuɔ loo ni ahoɔ lɛ yɛ tsɛŋsi loo dadesɛŋ loo kukwɛi lɛ mli, ni loo fɛɛ loo ni faka lɛ baatsu kɛje kpo lɛ osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Nɛkɛ afeɔ Isrealbii fɛɛ ni yaa afɔleshãa yɛ Shito lɛ.

Shi agbɛnɛ be mli ni anako ashã loo lɛ mli fɔ lɛ tete lɛ, osɔfo lɛ tsulɔ lɛ baa ni ebakɛɔ mɔ ni shãa afɔle lɛ akɛ, "Jiemɔ loo ohã ni ayashã ahã osɔfo lɛ ejaakɛ esumɔɔɔ loo ni ahoo lɛ, eetao loo lɛ eŋmɔŋ."

Kɛji mɔ ni shãa afɔle lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ koni ashã fɔ lɛ dã; no sɛɛ koni ojie loo lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ" lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ toɔ he akɛ, "Dabida, jiemɔ loo lɛ ohã nɔŋŋ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ majie loo lɛ ekãa naa."
No hewɔ lɛ Eli bihii lɛ anɔsha lɛ da yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ eyasɔɔɔ nii ni akɛshãa afɔle ahãa Yehowa lɛ.
Samuel sɔmɔɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Ewoɔ tsitsinɔhaanii ni akɛ klala kpɛ, ni efiɔ emliteŋ.
Enyɛ kpɛɔ atade yuu pɛmpɛoo ko, ni ekɛbahãa Samuel koni ewo kɛji ekɛ ewu ba daa afi afɔleshãa lɛ.
Kɛji amɛba lɛ, Eli jɔɔ Elkana kɛ eŋa lɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, "Yehowa ahã yoo nɛɛ awo shwiei ahã bo yɛ ebi nɛɛ ni ejɔɔ enɔ eha Yehowa hewɔ. "Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛmaŋ.
Yehowa jɔɔ Hana, ni efɔ Samuel sɛɛ bihii etɛ̃ kɛ biyei enyɔ hu. Ni oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ bada yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Eli egbɔ jogbaŋŋ naakpa; ni ababɔɔ lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ebihii lɛ feɔ Israelbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni amɛkɛ yei ni batsuɔ nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ wɔɔ.
No ni Eli kɛɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni nyɛyeɔ nɛkɛ saji? Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miiwie nibii gbohii ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ he, ni miinu.
Nyɛkafea nakai kɔkɔɔkɔ, mibii. Saji ni minuɔ yɛ Yehowa webii anaa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ, ehii.

Kɛji gbɔmɔ fee enyɛmi gbɔmɔ esha lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni kojoɔ lɛ; shi kɛji gbɔmɔ fee esha eshi Yehowa lɛ, namɔ po ni aaakpa fai ahã lɛ?" Shi oblahii lɛ eyabooo amɛtsɛ, Eli, toi ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ ebaagbe amɛ.
Oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ bada ni esane sa gbɔmɛi kɛ Yehowa fɛɛ hiɛ.
Gbalɔ ko ba Eli ŋɔɔ be ko ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Mijie mihe mitsɔ̃ɔ otsɛ we lɛ be mli ni amɛyɔɔ Egipt akɛ Farao nyɔji lɛ.

Ni miŋɔ otsɛ we lɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni eye osɔfo ehã mi, ni esɔmɔ mi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa, ni eshã tsofakɛŋma ehã mi, ni ewo efod lɛ kɛsɔmɔ mi. Ni no hewɔ lɛ miŋɔ afɔlei fɛɛ ni akɛ la shãa mihã lɛ.

Mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ mi hu migbɛfaŋnii ni yɔɔ gbee afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ amli lɛ anɔ, be mli ni miwo nyɛ he kitã; ni obuɔ obihii lɛ moŋ fe mi, ni nyɛkɛ mimaŋbii lɛ afɔle fɛɛ afɔle mli nii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ lɛɔ nyɛ moŋ nyɛhe lɛ?

No hewɔ lɛ mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛɛ akɛ owe lɛ kɛ otsɛmɛi awe lɛ ni baasɔmɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi kɛya naanɔ, shi agbɛnɛ miigbla nakai shiwoo lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni buɔ mi lɛ, mawo amɛhiɛ nyam: Shi mɛi ni ebuuu mi lɛ, abuŋ amɛ ahaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Naa, be lɛ miiba, ni mibagbe owe lɛ kɛ otsɛmɛiawe lɛ mli bii fɛɛ yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ koni akana nuumo yɛ oweku mli.
Ni okɛ hijramɔ baana shweremɔ ni abaahã Israel ashwere lɛ: Shi owe lɛ nuumo ehiŋ mli kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ni owekunyo ni mahã ashwɛ ni esɔmɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa lɛ tete, ehiŋmɛii baajwara, ni ebaaye awerɛho kɛteke nɔ; ni shwiei fɛɛ ni abaawo yɛ owe lɛ baagbo akranaŋ naa gbele.
No ni baaba obihii enyɔ lɛ, Hofni kɛ Finehas, nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ okadi ahã bo. No ji akɛ amɛyi fɛɛ aamɛaagboi gbi kome.
Matee osɔfo anɔkwafo ko shi mahã midiɛŋtsɛ mihe, mɔ ni baafee miyiŋtoo kɛ mitsuinaanii, ni mahã ewo shwiei ni shishi etaŋ, mɛi ni baasɔmɔ yɛ mɔ ni mifɔ lɛ mu lɛ hiɛ daa.

Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mahã ashwɛ yɛ owe lɛ aaaba abakoto gbɔmɔ nɛɛ koni ebaba edɛŋ jwiɛtɛi loo aboloo akwaabɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Mikpa o fai ni ohã mi osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eko matsu bɔ ni afee ni mana midaaŋ ŋmaa kɛkɛ.'"
3: Oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ sɔmɔɔ Yehowa yɛ Eli shishi. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ daaŋ wiemɔ he efɔɔɔ kaa; asaŋ afɔɔɔ ninaa hu namɔ.
Gbi ko lɛ Eli kã shi yɛ ewɔɔhe lɛ; no mli lɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ ebɔ̃i haa, ni no hewɔ lɛ enaaa nii jogbaŋŋ;
ni Yehowa kane lɛ ma nɔ lolo ni enako egbo, ni Samuel hu kã shi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli he ni Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsɛ Samuel ekɛɛ, "Samuel! Samuel!" Ehere nɔ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, Naa mi!"
Samuel sha foi kɛtee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, naa mi; minu akɛ ootsɛ mi." Shi Eli kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Mitsɛko bo, mibi; kuu osɛɛ ni oyakã shi." No hewɔ lɛ Samuel tee ni eyakã shi.
Yehowa saa tsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, "Samuel! Samuel te shi ni etee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, naa mi; minu akɛ ootsɛ mi." Eli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mitsɛko bo, mibi; kuu osɛɛ ni oyakã shi ekoŋŋ."
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Samuel nako ale Yehowa ni asaŋ Yehowa kɛ lɛ awieko dã.
Yehowa saa etsɛ Samuel nɔ ni tīa shii etɛ̃, ni Samuel te shi etee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Ofai nɛ, naa mi, mi nu akɛ ootsɛ mi." Kɛkɛ ni Eli bayoo sɛɛ agbɛnɛ akɛ Yehowa ni tsɛɔ oblanyo fioo lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Yaakã shi; kɛji atsɛ bo ekoŋŋ lɛ, heremɔ nɔ akɛ, 'Wiemɔ Yehowa, shi mi, otsulɔ, miibo bo toi!'" Kɛkɛ ni Samuel tee eyakã shi yɛ ewɔɔhe lɛ.
Yehowa ba ni ebadamɔ shi, ni etsɛ lɛ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ akɛ, "Samuel! Samuel!" Samuel here nɔ akɛ, "Wiemɔ, shi otsulɔ miibo toi."
Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Naa, mibafee nɔ titri ko yɛ Israel, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ he aajɔ̃ ehe.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ mahã nibii fɛɛ ni miwie yɛ Eli we lɛ he lɛ aba mli kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyaashi naagbee.
Mikɛɛ lɛ mito akɛ mibagbla ewe lɛ toi kɛya naanɔ yɛ nɔsha ni ele lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ebihii lɛ bɔ musu amɛshi mi, Nyɔŋmɔ, shi etutuuu ehiɛ ewooo amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mikã Eli we lɛ he kitã akɛ kɛji akɛ gbee afɔle loo niyenii afɔle ko aaakpãtã Eli we lɛ nɔsha lɛ kɛyaashi naanɔ fii."
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel ho ekã shi kɛyashi je tsɛre ni egbele Yehowa we lɛ shinai lɛ. Samuel she he gbeyei akɛ eeegba Eli ninaa lɛ.
Shi Eli tsɛ Samuel ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, " Mibi Samuel'ß, Ehere nɔ akɛ Naa mi."
Eli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni Yehowa kɛɛ bo lɛ? Kaashiu mi nɔ. Kɛji oshiu mi wiemɔ fɛɛ ni ekɛ bo wie lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baagbla otoi yɛ no hewɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel gba Eli nɔ fɛɛ nɔ. ni eshiuuu lɛ sane lɛ eko nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Eli to he ekɛɛ, "Lɛji Yehowa, nɔ ni hi yɛ lɛ ehiɛ lɛ efee!"
Samuel bada, ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ, ni ehãaa Samuel naa wiemɔ ko afee yaka.
No hewɔ lɛ gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ Dan aahuu kɛyashwie Beersheba, na le akɛ Samuel lɛ Yehowa gbalɔ anɔkwafo ni.
Yehowa kã he etsɔ̃ɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ejieɔ ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Samuel yɛ Shilo. Ni kɛji Samuel wie lɛ, Israel fɛɛ boɔ lɛ toi.
4: Filistibii lɛ fã ta koni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayawu. Israelbii lɛ yagba ta yɛ Ebenezer, ni Filistibii lɛ hu gba ta yɛ Afek.
Filistibii lɛ gba wo Isrealbii lɛ, ni be ni akɛ ta lɛ lɛɛ shi lɛ, Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni Isreal tabilɔi aaafee akpei ejwɛ nyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.

Be ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛba amɛshitoohe lɛ, Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni Yehowa ŋmɛ gbɛ ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ wɔnɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛkɛ? Nyɛhãa ni wɔyaŋɔa Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Shilo kɛba biɛ koni ebahi wɔteŋ, koni ahere wɔyiwala yɛ wɔnyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ."
No hewɔ lɛ atsu atee Shilo, ni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enɔ kurubii lɛ, ni ji Yehowa sɛ̃i lɛ, kɛba. Hofni kɛ Finehas, ni ji Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, fata he ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ba lɛ.
Be ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bashɛ shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ bɔ oshe waa bɔ ni ehã shikpɔŋ hoso.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu oshebɔɔ lɛ, amɛbi akɛ, "Mɛɛ oshe abɔɔ waa yɛ Hibribii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli nɛkɛ nɛɛ?" Be ni amɛbana amɛle akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ebashɛ Isrealbii lɛ ata lɛ mli lɛ,
Filistibii lɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Jemawɔŋ ko eba amɛta lɛ mli. sane eye wɔ ei! Nɛkɛ nɔ ko bako dã.
Sane eye wɔ Namɔ po aaajie wɔ yɛ jemawɔji ni ahe yɔɔ gbeyei nɛɛ adɛŋ? Jemawɔji nɛɛ ni hã haomɔ ba Egiptbii lɛ anɔ yɛ Shiŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nyɛwajea nyɛhe, Filistibii, ni nyɛfea hii koni nyɛkatsɔmɔ Hebribii lɛ anyɔji tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛye amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ."

Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Filistibii lɛ wu ta lɛ ekãa naa, ni amɛye Israelbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni Isrealbii lɛ jo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ kɛtee amɛbuui amli. Agbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ Israel tabilɔi aaafee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni nyiɛɔ amɛnane nɔ nyɔnyɔɔi.
Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ashɔ̃, ni Hofni kɛ Finehas, Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, nyɔ.
Benyaminnyo ko jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛba Shilo nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ atade ni etserɛ kɛ eyiteŋ su.

Nuu nɛɛ bashɛ shi be mli ni Eli ta sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ agbo lɛ masɛi ni eesra, ejaakɛ etsui enyɔɔɔ emli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ. Nuu lɛ bote maŋ lɛŋ ni be ni ebabɔ amaniɛ ni ekɛjɛ ta lɛ naa lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ wo yara.
Be ni Eli nuu blɔmɔ hoo lɛ ebi akɛ, "Te blɔmɔ ni ablɔɔ hoo nɛɛ shishi hu?" Nuu lɛ sha ehe ni ebabɔ Eli amaniɛ lɛ.
No mli lɛ Eli eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni ehiŋmɛii anɔ eha, ni enaaa nii ekpakpa ko.
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Miji mɔ ni jɛ ta lɛ naa ba lɛ, ni ŋmɛnɛ nɔŋŋ mijo foi yɛ ta lɛ naa." Kɛkɛ ni Eli bi nuu lɛ akɛ, "Ni te emli tamɔ tɛŋŋ, mibi?"
Bɔfo lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Isreal ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, wɔmaŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ enyɔ. Obihii, Hofni kɛ Finehas hu enyɔ, ni asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ashɔ̃."

Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tã ni atsi nɛkɛ pɛ ni Eli kpa yɛ esɛi lɛ nɔ eyagbee esɛɛgbɛ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ he, ni ekuɛŋ wu kū, ni egbo, ejaakɛ egbɔ ni egbɔmɔtso tsii. Nakai be mli lɛ Eli ekwɛ Isrealbii anɔ fii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.

Eli shaayoo, ni ji Finehas ŋa lɛ, hiɛ musu, ni eshɛ efɔmɔ be etã. Be ni yoo lɛ nu amaniɛ lɛ akɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni eshaanuu lɛ kɛ ewu lɛ fɛɛ hu agboi lɛ, fɔmɔ ta ehe amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni eho esɔ̃ shi ni efɔ.
Be ni yoofɔyoo lɛ heɔ egbo yɛ fɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, yei ni yɔɔ emasɛi amɛwaa lɛ kɛ fɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, shi ofɔ binuu." Shi efooo mli, asaŋ akɛ ejwɛŋmɔ efɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ.
Ewo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, "Ikabod," ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Israel nyam etã," hewɔ lɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee, ni asaŋ eshaanuu lɛ kɛ ewu lɛ fɛɛ egboi.
Esaa ekɛɛ akɛ, "Israel nyam etã, ejaakɛ ashɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ."
5: Be ni Filistibii lɛ shɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, amɛwo kɛjɛ Ebenezer kɛtee Ashdod,
ni amɛkɛtee nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛyɔɔ ni egbɛi ji Dagon lɛ we lɛ, ni amɛkɛyama Dagon amãgã lɛ masɛi.

Enɔ jetserɛmɔ leebi maŋkpa be ni Ashdodbii te shi lɛ, naa, Dagon amagã lɛ ni ekpa egbee shi, ni ehiɛ bu shikpɔŋ yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Ashdodbii lɛ wo Dagon amãgã lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ ma emaahe lɛ ekoŋŋ.

Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maŋkpa be ni Ashdodbii lɛ te shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, naa Dagon ekpa egee shi ekoŋŋ, ni ehiɛ bu shikpɔŋ yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ. Eyitso kɛ eniji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ hu etserɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛjwere kpuku lɛ nɔ. Dagon amãgã kuku lɛ kɛkɛ eshwɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ ni Dagon wɔlumɛi, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni boteɔ Dagon we lɛ, enaaa Dagon kpoku lɛ nɔ yɛ Ashdod kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ.
Yehowa piŋ Ashdodbii lɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ. Ehã abua fuufuu amɛ, ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ yɛ Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli diɛŋtsɛ, kɛ ekpokpai anɔ fɛɛ.
Be ni Ashdod hii lɛ na nɔ ni eba lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Akahã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miihi wɔŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ kɛ wɔnyɔmɔ Dagon fɛɛ miiye kɛ joomɔ."

No hewɔ lɛ amɛtsu ni ayakpee Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ fee kɛba, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, "Te wɔfee Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tɛŋŋ?" Lumɛi lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Awo Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba Gat." No hewɔ lɛ awo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Gat.
Be ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ eyashɛ Gat sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ abua piŋ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ, ni ekɛgbla Gatbii atoi, ni enɛ hã amɛjijaa.

No hewɔ lɛ amɛhã awo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Ekron. Shi be ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yashiɛ jɛi lɛ, Ekronbii lɛ blɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Naa, akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ eba wɔŋɔɔ koni ebagbe wɔ kɛ wɔbii."

No hewɔ lɛ amɛtsu ni ayakpee Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ kɛ, Nyɛhãa akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ akua sɛɛ kɛyaa he ni ejɛ koni ekabagbe wɔ kɛ wɔbii." Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ejijaa ni yɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ miiye kɛ joomɔ ni naa wa yɛ jɛi.
Mɛi ni gboiii lɛ abua fuufuu amɛ, ni maŋ lɛ blɔ waa amɛtsɛ akɛ ahere amɛ.
6: Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ye nyɔji kpawo yɛ Filistibii lɛ aŋɔɔ.

kɛjɛ ni Filistibii lɛ kpee amɛsɔfoi kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nii ni amɛgbaa lɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, "Te wɔfee Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tɛŋŋ? Nyɛtsɔa wɔ nɔ ni sa akɛ wɔkɛfata adeka lɛ he ni wɔkɛku sɛɛ kɛya he ni ejɛ."

Osɔfo lɛ to he akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛmiikpale Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛmiiya lɛ, nyɛkahãa akɛ adeka lɛ miiya eflo. Ja nyɛkɛ afɔle fata he kɛtee nyɛyahã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akɛ nyɛye sɔ̃; no dani nyɛhe aaatã, ni asaŋ nyɛaale nɔ hewɔ ni ekpako nyɛ piŋmɔ lɛ."

Maŋbii lɛ bi akɛ, "Mɛni ji sɔ̃yeli afɔle ni wɔkɛyahã lɛ?" Osɔfoi lɛ jie naa akɛ, "Abua ni fūufuu nyɛ lɛ henɔ nibii enumɔ ni akɛ shika fee kɛ kwakwei hu enumɔ ni akɛ shika fee yɛ Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ayikulɛ naa, ejaakɛ hela kome too Lɛ nɔŋŋ ye nyɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛnɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ nyɛfea abua ni fūufuu nyɛ lɛ henɔ kɛ kwakwei ni bafite nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ henɔ okadii, asaŋ nyɛwoa Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Eko lɛ eeegbɔjɔ piŋmɔ lɛ mli ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛjemawɔji lɛ kɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hu.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ nyɛkpliŋ nyɛtsui tamɔ Egiptbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ fee lɛ.? Kwɛ, be ni ehã amɛna amɛnii ni amɛleee sɛɛ lɛ, bɛ amɛŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛtee?
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛfea shwiili hee; nyɛmɔa tsinayei enyɔ ni aaye amɛ fufɔ lolo, asaŋ ni apã eyako amɛkuɛ dã, ni nyɛfimɔa amɛ nyɛwo shwiili lɛ naa. Amɔnɔ tsinabii lɛ yɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ ahe kɛya shīa.
No sɛɛ lɛ awo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama shwiili lɛ nɔ. Ato shika nibii ni akɛyaahã Yehowa akɛ sɔ̃yeli he afɔle lɛ awo adeka fioo mli, ni akɛma Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi, ni nyɛjie lɛ gbɛ ni eya.

Nyɛkwɛa eyisɛɛ. Kɛji adeka lɛ wo ehiɛ ema lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛtee Bet-Shemesh lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni ye wɔ awui kpeteŋkple nɛɛ lɛ; shi kɛji shwiili lɛ eyaaa jɛi lɛ belɛ wɔna wɔle akɛ jeee Yehowa piŋ wɔ lɛ, shi oshrã ko kɛkɛ ni bashrã wɔ."
Amɛfee bɔ ni akɛɛ amɛ lɛ. Amɛmɔmɔ tsinayei enyɔ ni aaye amɛfufɔ lolo, ni amɛfimɔ amɛ amɛwo shwiili lɛ naa, ni amɛŋa amɛbii lɛ ayi yɛ shiãa.
Amɛwo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ amɛma shwiili lɛ nɔ ni amɛwo adeka lɛ ni amɛto shika kwakwei lɛ kɛ shika abua lɛ amɛwo mli lɛ hu amɛma shwiili lɛ nɔ.

Tsinai lɛ yi teŋpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛwo amɛyi amɛma Bet-Shemesh tɔ̃ɔ. Be ni amɛyaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ belɛ tsinai lɛ miiblɔ. Amɛgbaaa ninejurɔ lɛ, amɛgbaaa abɛku hu. Filistibii alumɛi lɛ nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ kɛ shwilii lɛ sɛɛ aahuu kɛyashɛ Bet-Shemesh husu lɛ nɔ.
Bet-Shemesh miiku ŋmãa nɛkɛ be mli yɛ gɔji ateŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli. Be ni amɛyaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, naa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ; amɛnya jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Shwiili lɛ babote Yoshua ni jɛ Bet-Shemesh lɛ ŋmɔshi, ni ebawa yɛ tɛ wulu ko ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ masɛi. ŋmɔ lɛ shi bii lɛ gbla shwiili lɛ tsei lɛ amli ni amɛkɛ tsinai lɛ shã shãafɔle amɛhã Yehowa.

Levibii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ Kɛ adeka ni ma emasɛi ni shika nibii lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ hu, ni amɛkɛmanɔ tɛ wulu lɛ nɔ. Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ shãshãa afɔlei, ni amɛgbegbee kooloi hu amɛkɛshã afɔlei amɛkɛhã Yehowa nakai gbi lɛ.
Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ na nɔ ni afee lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee Ekron nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Abua ni fuufuu Filistibii lɛ henɔ Shika nii ni Filistibii lɛ fee lɛ, bɔ ni amɛkɛyahã Yehowa akɛ amɛsɔ̃yeli he afɔle yɛ maji lɛ agbɛii amli nɛ: Ashdod nɔ ekome, kɛ Gaza nɔ ekome, kɛ Ashkelon nɔ ekome.

Nakai nɔŋŋ akɛ shika kwakwei lɛ hu yahã yɛ Filistibii lɛ amaji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ ashishi lɛ ayikulɛ naa. Maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe kɛ akrowai fɛɛ shi nɔ. Tɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ma nɔ yɛ Yoshua, Bet-Shemeshnyo lɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli yɛ jɛi eeye sane nɛɛ he odase kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Yehowa gbe Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo komɛi, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiŋmɛii yakwɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli. Enɛ hã maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ ye awerɛho ejaakɛ Yehowa eplenee mɛi baaboo.
Sane nɛɛ hã Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ; "Namɔ po aaanyɛ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ hiɛ adamɔ? Ni kɛ adeka lɛ jɛ wɔŋɔɔ lɛ, namɛi aŋɔɔ po eeeya?"
Kɛkɛ ni Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ stu bɔfoi kɛtee Kiriat-Yearimbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa, Filistibii lɛ ekpale Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ amɛkɛbahã wɔ. Nyɛbaŋɔa kɛyaa."
7: No hewɔ lɛ Kiriat-Yearimbii lɛ bawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni amɛkɛtee Abinadab we lɛ ni ma Kiriat- Yearim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli; ni amɛwo Abinadab bi Eleazar osɔfo koni ebu Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he.
Kpaŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tsɛ yɛ Kiriat-Yearim, ejaakɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ yɛ jɛi, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni akɛ lɛ yashɛ jɛi lɛ, ni Israel fɛɛ ye Yehowa he kumai.

Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛmiikpale kɛmiiba Yehowa ŋɔɔ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛjiea maŋsɛɛ jemawɔji lɛ kɛ Astarte amãgãi lɛ hu ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ nyɛherɛa nyɛshwiea koni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ahãa Yehowa kwraa; asaŋ koni nyɛsɔmɔ ekome too; ni lɛ hu eeejie nyɛ yɛ Filistiibi lɛ adɛŋ."
Israelbii lɛ damɔ wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ ni amɛjie Baal kɛ Asterte amãgãi ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ amɛherɛ amɛshwie, ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa kome pɛ.
Samuel kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Mizpa, ni masɔle makpa Yehowa fai mahã nyɛ."
Isrealbii lɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ Mizpa. Amɛyɛ nu amɛshwie shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛhi ŋmãa nakai gbi lɛ, ni amɛ kɛɛ akɛ wɔtɔ Yehowa nɔ." Ni Samuel hi Mizpa, ni ekojo Israelbii lɛ ateŋ saji yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ Mizpa lɛ, Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fã ta koni amɛbatua Israelbii lɛ. Be ni Israelbii lɛ nu ta ni Filistibii lɛ efã lɛ he lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei,
ni amɛkɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Yaa nɔ ni otsɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ohã wɔ koni ehere wɔ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel ŋɔ too gwaŋtɛŋbi ni atseko lɛ fufɔ, ni eshã lɛ emuu akɛ shãa afɔle ekɛhã Yehowa. Ni Samuel sɔle ekpa Yehowa fai ehã Israelbii lɛ, ni Yehowa here lɛ nɔ.

Be ni Samuel shãa afɔle lɛ, Filistibii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ koni amɛbatua Israelbii lɛ. Shi Yehowa hã ŋwɛi shimɔ gbeyeigbeyei wo Filistibii lɛ nakai gbi lɛ, ni ehã amɛhiɛ bɔ, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ amɛdamɔ.
Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Mizpa ni amɛnyiɛ Filistibii lɛ asɛɛ ni amɛtswia amɛ nii aahuu kɛyashɛ Bet-Kar jɔɔŋgbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel wo tɛ ekɛma shi yɛ Mizpa kɛ Shem teŋ, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ "Ebenezer" ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, "Biɛ Yehowa eye ebua wɔ kɛbashi."
Aye Filistibii lɛ anɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛnaji enyɔ nɛkɛ yiii Israelbii lɛ akpokpai lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ. Ni Samuel yinɔ fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ Filistibii lɛ gbɛ koni amɛbatua Israel.

Maji fɛɛ ni Filistibii lɛ ashɔ̃ yɛ Israelbii lɛ adeŋ lɛ, amɛkpale fɛɛ amɛhã Israel ekoŋŋ, kɛjɛ Ekron aahuu kɛyashwie Gat. Israel nine shɛ eshikpɔji fɛɛ hu ni yaje Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni toiŋjɔlɛ ba Israelbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ hu ateŋ.
Samuel kwɛ Israel nɔ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ni daa afi lɛ efãa gbɛ eyasraa Betel kɛ Gilgal kɛ Mizpa, ni ekojoɔ sajisaji ni eba hei nɛɛ,
ni ekuɔ esɛɛ kɛbaa Rama, ejaakɛ jɛi ewe yɔɔ; ni jɛi hu ekwɛɔ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji yɛ. Samuel ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Rama ehã Yehowa.
8: Be ni Samuel gbɔ lɛ ewo ebihii lɛ kojolɔi ni amɛkojoɔ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji yɛ Israel.
Ekromɔbi ni gbɛi ji Yeol lɛ, kɛ lɛ esɛɛho ni gbɛi ji Abia lɛ ji nɔyelɔi ni ekɛto Beersheba.
Shi Samuel bihii lɛ eyakɔɔɔ amɛtsɛ jeŋba kwraa. Amɛyadi ninamɔ sɛɛ ni amɛhehee nyɔɔŋnii, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ saji ahiɛ amɛbumɔ shi.
Enɛ hã Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa, ni amɛba Samuel ŋɔɔ yɛ Rama,
ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Amrɔ nɛɛ ogbɔ, ni obihii lɛ eyakɔɔɔ ojeŋba. No hewɔ lɛ wo maŋtsɛ ohã wɔ koni lɛ ekwɛ wɔnɔ tamɔ eyɔɔ yɛ majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ anɔ lɛ."
Sane lɛ eyaŋɔɔɔ Samuel naa akɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, "Hã wɔ maŋtsɛ ni ekwɛ wɔnɔ." No hewɔ lɛ, Samuel sɔle etsɛ Yehowa,
ni Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Nibii fɛɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɔ bo lɛ, feemɔ ohã amɛ; ejaakɛ jeee bo amɛkwa, shi mi moŋ amɛkwa akɛ mikaye amɛnɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
