Bɔ pɛ ni amɛfee mi kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni mijie amɛ kɛje Egipt aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni amɛkwa mi ni amɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfeɔ bo hu nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bo amɛ toi; shi kɛ̃lɛ gba mli kpoo okɛɛ amɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nibii ni mɔ ni baaye amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ baatao yɛ amɛdɛŋ."
Samuel gba maŋbii ni biɔ lɛ koni ewo ewo maŋtsɛ ehã amɛ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa wie lɛ fɛɛ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ni baaye nyɛnɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ baaye ahã nɛ: Ebaaŋɔ nyɛbihii lɛ, ni ebaahã amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi akwɛ ekpɔŋɔi, ni mɛi komɛi ajojoo foi kɛnyiɛ eshwiilii ahiɛ.

Ebaawo mɛi komɛi asafoiatsɛmɛi ahã mɛi akpekpei kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ kui ahã ehe. Ebaahã mɛi komɛi ahu eŋmɔji amɛhã lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu akpa eŋmɔshinii, ni mɛi komɛi atswia etawuunii kɛ eshwiilii ahe nii.
Nyɛbiyei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, ebaafee mɛi komɛi tsofakɛŋma futulɔi, kɛ mɛi komɛi nihoolɔi kɛ mɛi komɛi hu aboloo shãlɔi.
Ebaashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ nyɛŋmɔji kɛ nyɛwain abɔi kpakpai kɛ nyɛmutsei ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛbaahã etsuji.
Kɛji nyɛkpa ŋmɔshi ŋmãa k nyɛwain abɔi amli nii lɛ hu, ebaaŋɔ amɛmlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome ni ekɛbaahã epiafo kɛ etsuji.
Ebaashɔ̃ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ nyɛblahii fɛɛfɛji kɛ nyɛtsinai kɛ nyɛteji kpakpai ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ koni amɛyatsu lɛ enii amɛhã lɛ.
Ebaaŋɔ nyɛtoi amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome ehã ehe, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ enyɔji.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛbaafo shi Yehowa efoŋ nyɛdaaŋ."
Shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋbii lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ Samuel toiboo, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔnu; shi fɛɛ Sɛɛ lɛ ja wɔna maŋtsɛ ni eye wɔnɔ kɛ̃,
koni wɔ hu wɔtamɔ majimaji fɛɛ akɛ wɔyɛ maŋtsɛ, ni lɛ ekwɛɔ wɔnɔ, koni asaŋ kɛ ta ba lɛ enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛ wu tai lɛ ehã wɔ."
Be ni Samuel nu hetoo ni maŋbii lɛ hã lɛ ejaje etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Bo amɛ toi, no owo maŋtsɛ ohã amɛ." Samuel kɛɛ Israel hii lɛ agbɛnɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ! Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ."
9: Benyamin nuu niiatsɛ ko hi shi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kish. Etsɛ gbɛi ji Abiel, Benyaminnyo Afia bi Bekorat bi Zeror lɛ bi ni.
Kish nɛɛ yɛ binuu, oblanyo nɛɛ he fɛo yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ; ni kɛjɛ ekɔŋ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ oblanyo lɛ kwɔ fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ Isreal.
Saul tsɛ Kish tejii laaje. Kɛkɛ ni Kish kɛɛ ebi Saul akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ tsuji lɛa teŋ mɔ kome ofata ohe koni oya oyatao tejii lɛ."

Saul kɛ tsulɔ lɛ yakpa Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛyaje Shalisha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛmiitao kooloi lɛ, shi amɛnaaa amɛ. Amɛyakpa Shaalim shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi amɛnaaa amɛ; kɛkɛ ni amɛtee Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ; shi amɛnaaa tejii lɛ.
Be ni Saul kɛ tsulɔ lɛ yashɛ Zuf shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Saul kɛɛ oblanyo ni fata ehe lɛ akɛ, "Hã wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔya shīa; kɛjeee nakai lɛ mitsɛ aaafɔ̃ɔ tejii lɛ ahe jwɛŋmɔ, ni etsui baaye yɛ wɔ moŋ wɔhe."
Oblanyo lɛ kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Ole? Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ko yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli ni abuɔ lɛ jogbaŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni egbaa lɛ baa mli, hã wɔtee wɔyana lɛ; eko lɛ eeegba wɔ nyiɛmɔ ni wɔnyiɛ nɛɛ he nɔ ko."
Saul kɛɛ oblanyo lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nɛkɛ wɔhiɛ ni kɛ wɔtee ni wɔkɛyaahã nuu lɛ? Aboloo ni yɔɔ wɔkotokui amli lɛ hu etã. Mɛni dɔŋŋ wɔhiɛ ni wɔkɛaatee wɔyake Nyɔŋmɔ gbalɔ lɛ?"
Oblanyo lɛ hã Saul hetoo ekɛɛ, "Mihiɛ jwiɛtɛi shekel mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome yɛ biɛ; mikɛbaahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbalɔ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ he ni wɔtsɔ̃."
(Sa lɛ kɛji mɔ ko yaabi Nyɔŋmɔ nii lɛ, bɔ ni akɛɔ yɛ Israel ji "Wɔtee ninalɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ." Ejaakɛ mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ gbalɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ lɛ sa lɛ ninalɔ atsɛɔ lɛ.)
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ Oblanyo lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ! Hã wɔtee." Ni amɛyi mli kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli he ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Be ni amɛhereɔ ŋmeŋme lɛ kɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛkɛ oblayei komɛi pɛ ni amɛmiiya amɛyayɛ nu, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfai nɛ! Ninalɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lo?"
Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Eyɛ. Naa, lɛ eyaa yɛ nyɛhiɛ nɔŋŋ nɛɛ. Nyɛhe afea oya. Amrɔ nɛɛ ebashɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ miishã afɔle ŋmɛnɛ yɛ jamɔhe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Maŋ lɛ mli botemɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛaana lɛ dani eya gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyaye nii. Ja eyashɛ shi dani maŋbii lɛ baaye nii lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ ebaajɔɔ niyenii lɛ nɔ dani mɛi ni akpee lɛ aye. Nyɛyaa oya, ejaakɛ be mli nɔŋŋ ni nyɛnine aaashɛ enɔ nɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Saul kɛ etsulɔ lɛ yiŋ kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli. Be ni amɛboteɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ amɛna Samuel ni eeya jamɔhe grɔŋŋ lɛ. Ni amɛkɛ lɛ kpe.
Gbi ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ dãni Saul ba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa ekɛɛ Samuel akɛ,

"Wɔ benɛ mli lɛ mibatsu nuu ko ni jɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli oŋɔɔ koni ofɔ lɛ mu, ni owo lɛ mimaŋ Israel maŋtsɛ. Lɛ ebaahere mimaŋbii Lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ. Mina amɛnɔnaa lɛ, ni minu tsɛmɔ ni amɛtsɛɔ koni ahere amɛ lɛ."
Be ni Samuel na Saul lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɔ he ni mi kɛ bo wie lɛ nɛ. Mɔnɛ ji mɔ ni baaye mimaŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Saul kɛ Samuel kpe yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ he, kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi ninalɔ lɛ shīa lɛ."
Samuel here saul nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Mi ni. Tsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛya gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ mi baaye nii ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ leebi lɛ mawo bo gbɛ, ni magba bo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbaa ojwɛŋmɔ naa lɛ.
Kɛ ka nyɛteji lɛ ni laaje ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii etɛ̃ lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, kaaye otsui, ejaakɛ ana amɛ. Namɔ ole ni Israel shweɔ amrɔ nɛɛ fe bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ?"

Saul here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Benyaminnyo ji mi, no hewɔ lɛ mijiɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ bibioo fe fɛɛ lɛ mli; ni Benyamin akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ ateŋ humi fe fɛɛ mli mijɛ? Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ mi enɛ nɛɛ lɛ?"
Saul nyiɛ Samuel kɛ etsulɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛtee niyelihe asa lɛ nɔ, ni ehã amɛyatra mɛi aaashɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni akpee amɛ niyeli lɛ ayitso.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ nihoolɔ lɛ akɛ, "Loo lɛ ni mikɛhã bo shitoo ni mikɛɛ bo akɛ okɛto afã lɛ, kɛba."

Nihoolɔ lɛ yawo loo shwuɔ kɛba ni ekɛbama Saul hiɛ. Ni Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Nɔ ni akɛsra osɛɛ nɛ. Ye, ejaakɛ bo ohewɔ akɛto koni kɛ ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ shɛ lɛ okɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ afutu aye nii." No hewɔ lɛ Saul kɛ Samuel ye nii nakai gbi lɛ.
Be ni amɛshi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛkpleke shi kɛba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, afee saa yɛ shīa lɛ yeteŋ ahã Saul, ni ekã jɛi ewɔ.
Enɔ maŋkɛ mra be ni je bɔ̃i tsɛremɔ lɛ, Samuel tsɛ Saul yɛ shīa lɛ yiteŋ ekɛɛ, "Tee shi ni oba koni mawo bo gbɛ ni oya. "Saul te shi, ni lɛ kɛ Samuel fɛɛ je kpo maɛyi teŋpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛɔ maŋ lɛ klotia lɛ Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ tsulɔ lɛ koni ebaho eyi wɔhiɛ koni ekitee. Kɛji eyi hiɛ ni eekitee lɛ, bo lɛ owa ni omɛ shrao koni magba bo nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ bo kɛɛmɔ."
10: Kɛkɛ ni Samuel jie mu kɛ tɔ Saul yiteŋ. Kɛkɛ ni eshwɔ Saul naa ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, Yehowa efɔ bo mu koni oye ewebii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛlumɔ, koni ohere amɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ni ebɔle amɛ lɛ adɛŋ. No okadi ni atoɔ bo yɛ he akɛ Yehowa efɔ bo mu koni oye amɛi lɛ anɔ lumɔ nɛ.

Kɛji okɛ mi gbla mli ŋmɛnɛ ni ooya lɛ, okɛ hii enyɔ komɛi baakpe yɛ Rahel saŋ lɛ he yɛ Zelza, yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baakɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Tejii lɛ ni otee amɛtaomɔ lɛ ana amɛ. No hewɔ lɛ otsɛ efɔ̃ɔ tejii lɛ ahe jwɛŋmɔ, ni etsui miiye yɛ ohewɔ.' Eekɛɛ akɛ, 'Te mafee tɛŋŋ yɛ mibi lɛ hewɔ hu?'

Kɛji oshi jɛi lɛ obaaya ohiɛ aahuu kɛyashi oooyashɛ Tabor odum kpeteŋkple lɛ he. Hii etɛ̃ komei ni miiya Betel eyashã afɔle ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo baakpe yɛ jɛi. Amɛteŋ mɔ kome hiɛ abotiabii etɛ̃, ni mɔ kome hu hiɛ aboloo akwaabɔi etɛ̃, ni mɔ kome hu hiɛ wain wolo tɔ kome.
Amɛbaafla bo, ni amɛbaahã bo aboloo akwaabɔi enyɔ; hemɔ.

No sɛɛ lɛ obaaya oyashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Gibea he ni Filistibii asraafoi yɔɔ lɛ. Kɛji obɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ, okɛ gbalɔi asafo ku baakpe ni amɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛmiikpleke shi, ni akɛ obenta kɛ milɛ kɛ blɛ kɛ saŋku nyiɛ amɛhiɛ, ni asŋ amɛmiigba.
Yehowa mumɔ lɛ baatsi bo, ni obaaya oyashi gbalɔi nɛɛ anɔ kɛgba, ni obaatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kroko kwraa.
Kɛji okadii nɛ ba mli nakai hã bo lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaaje ogbɛfaŋ lɛ ofee ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni baakpla bo.
No sɛɛ lɛ, otsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛya Gilgal. Miiba jɛi ni mibashã shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei. Hii shi yɛ jɛi ni omɛ gbii kpawo kɛyashi mibaba mibanina bo, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ofee."
Be ni Saul tsɔ̃ ehe ni eshi Samuel lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsake Saul tsui. Okadii lɛ fɛɛ ba mli nakai gbi lɛ.
Saul kɛ oblanyo tsulɔ lɛ yashɛ Gibea pɛ, ni gbalɔi asafo ku ko kɛ Saul bakpe. Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ bayi Saul nɔ, ni eyashi gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ni ekɛ amɛ gba.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni le Saul sa, ni asaŋ amɛna akɛ ekɛ gbalɔi lɛ miigba lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Mɛni feɔ Kish bi lɛ nɛɛ? Saul hu etsɔ̃ gbalɔ lo?"
Maŋ lɛ mli nyo ko here nɔ akɛ, "Shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, namɛi po ji amɛtsɛmɛi?" Bɔ ni fee ni ana abɛ akɛ, "Mɛni, Saul hu etsɔ̃ gbalɔ lo" lɛ nɛ.
Be ni Saul egba etã lɛ, etee afɔleshãahe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Saul tsɛkwɛ̃ ko bi Saul kɛ eblanyo tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ nyɛjɛ?" Saul jie naa akɛ, "Wɔtee tejii taomɔ, ni be ni wɔyanaa amɛ lɛ wɔtee Samuel ŋɔɔ."
Saul tsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbaa mi nɔ ni Samuel kɛɛ nyɛ."
Saul kɛɛ etsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ akɛ, "Ekɛɛ wɔ akɛ ana tejii lɛ" Shi Saul egbaaa etsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ nɔ ni Samuel kɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ ni ebaye lɛ he lɛ.
Samuel kpee Isrealbii lɛ kɛba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mi, mikpla Israel kɛje Egipt, ni mijie nyɛ yɛ Egiptbii adɛŋ kɛ majimaji ni gba nyɛnaa lɛ hu adɛŋ.

Shi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛkwa mi, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni hereɔ nyɛyiwala kɛjeɔ nyɛmanehului kɛ nyɛfimɔi fɛɛ amli lɛ, ni nyɛkɛɛ dabida, shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mito maŋtsɛ mihã nyɛ.' No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛtoa kɛbaa mi Yehowa mihiɛ yɛ nyɛkutsei kɛ nyɛshīai anaa."
Samuel hã Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ tsi ba ekomekome, ni oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ yagbee Benyamin akutso lɛ nɔ.

Ehã Benyamin akutso lɛ tsi ba yɛ amɛwekui anaa, ni oshiki ni afɔ lɛ yagbee Matribii awe lɛ nɔ. Naagbee lɛ ehã Matribii awe lɛ mli hii lɛ tsi ba ekomekome, ni oshiku ni afɔ̃ lɛ yagbee Kish bi Saul nɔ. Shi be ni atao lɛ lɛ, anaaa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ ni abi Yehowa nii ekoŋŋ akɛɛ, "Ani gbɔmɔ lɛ hu ba biɛ lo?" Yehowa to he akɛ, "Naa, eyateee ehe yɛ jatsui lɛ ateŋ."
Oya ni asha foi ni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba. Be ni Saul badamɔ mɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekwɔ fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛjɛ ekɔŋ kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Be nyɛna mɔ ni Yehowa eŋɔ lɛ? Mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ lɛ yeee egbɔ yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ."

Agbɛnɛ Samuel gba maŋ lɛ nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ baatsu ahã amɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛgbɛnaanii ni amɛbaatsu amɛhã maŋtsɛ lɛ. Samuel ŋmla nibii lɛ fɛɛ ewo wolo mli, ni ekɛŋmɛ Yehowa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ. Kɛkɛ ni Samuel wo maŋ lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshia.
Saul hu tee ewe lɛ yɛ Gibea, ni hii kãkãbaŋi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsake amɛtsui fata ehe kɛtee.
Shi hii yakagbɔmɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ "Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔnɛ nɛɛ aaahere wɔyiwala lɛ?" Amɛgbe Saul he guɔ, ni amɛbakeee lɛ nɔ ko. Shi Saul ekɛɛɛ nɔ ko.
11: Amonbii amaŋtsɛ Nahash fã ta kɛba, ni ebasa Yabesh yɛ Gilead maŋbii lɛ ayi. Kɛkɛ ni Yabesh hii lɛ tsu ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nahash akɛ, "Okɛ wɔ akpãŋ ni wɔɔsɔ̃mɔ o."

Shi Nahash, Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, hã amɛ hetoo ekɛɛ, "Dani mikɛ nyɛ aaakpãŋ ni wɔfee ekome lɛ, ja nyɛhã mifamɔ nyɛninejurɔ hiŋmɛii fɛɛ Yɛ nyɛyitsei ahe koni kpa ni nyɛbaaje lɛ ahã Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ ashwie shi."
Yabesh maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Nahash akɛ, "Hã wɔ gbii kpawo. Wɔbaatsu bɔfoi kɛya Israel maji fɛɛ anɔ. Kɛji ayanaaa mɔ ko abahere wɔ lɛ koni wɔkɛ wɔhe abahã o."
Be ni Yabesh bɔfoi lɛ yashɛ maŋ ni ji Gibea he ni Saul yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛbɔ amɛmaniɛ lɛ, maŋ tso muu lɛ wo yara.
Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Saul mikpla tsinai kɛjɛ ŋa nɔ kɛmiiba shīa, ni ebi mɔ ko akɛ, "Mɛni eba ni awo yara nɛkɛ nɛɛ?" Ni bɔ lɛ amaniɛ ni Yabesh bɔfoi lɛ kɛba Lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ wo Saul ekãa titri ko be ni enu amaniɛ lɛ, asaŋ emli hu wo la naakpa.

Emɔmɔ tsinai enyɔ egbe, ni eflɔ amɛmli bibiibi, ni ekɛtsu Yabesh bɔfoi lɛ akɛ amɛkɛyakpa Israel majimaji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Ni wiemɔ ni fata he ji akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efãaa ta kɛabaa ebawaaa Saul kɛ Samuel lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaafe mɔ lɛ tsinai lɛ." Israelbii lɛ she nɔ ni Yehowa aaafee amɛ lɛ he gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ eshwɛɛɛ nuu kome ni emīaaa kɛyaaa ta lɛ eko.
Saul hã Israel naa yakpe shi yɛ Bezek, ni be ni ekane amɛ lɛ amɛyibɔ fee akpei ohai etɛ̃, ni Yuda kɔkrɔɔ hii ayibɔ fee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul shɛ bɔfoi lɛ ni atsu kɛba lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyakɛa Yabeshbii yɛ Gilead akɛ, 'Wɔ be ni hulu kɛɛ edamɔɔ lɛ ahere nyɛyiwala.'" Be ni bɔfoi lɛ babɔ Yabeshbii lɛ amaniɛ lɛ amɛtsui nyɔ amɛmli,
ni amɛhã ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nahash akɛ, "Wɔ ni ji wɔ lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe baaba abahã nyɛ koni nyɛfee wɔ bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ."

Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Saul ja etabilɔi lɛ amli kui etɛ̃, ni amɛyatua Amonbii lɛ maŋkɛ hima mli, yɛ amɛnsra lɛ mli, ni amɛtswia amɛ nii kɛyahsi shwane fintiŋŋ. Amonbii ni je gbele mli lɛ gbɛ shwã bɔ ni onaŋ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ nɛkɛ yɛ he kome.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ nakai mɛi ni kɛɛ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ Saul hu ni baaye wɔnɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Akɛ amɛ aba ni wɔgbe amɛ!'"
Shi Saul to he ekɛɛ, "Ashwieŋ la shi ŋmɛnɛ, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ Yehowa ehere Isreal yiwala."
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa ni wɔtea Gilgal koni wɔsaa wɔwo Saul maŋtsɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ jɛi."
No hewɔ lɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ loo mli kɛtee Gilgal, ni amɛyawo Saul maŋtsɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ jɛi. Amɛshãshã shidaa afɔlei yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Saul kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nya jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
12: Samuel kɛɛ Israel fɛɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni nyɛbi mi lɛ mifee, ni miwo maŋtsɛ mihã nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ. Mi lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ migbɔ ni miyi eyɛ, ni mibihii lɛ nyɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ. Mikwɛ nyɛnɔ kɛjɛ miblahiiaŋ aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

Mi nɛ; nyɛyea odase nyɛshia mi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ emɔ̃ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ hu hiɛ. Namɔ tsina mishɔ̃, ni namɔ teji mishɔ̃? Aloo namɔ ojo mitswa, aloo namɔ yi miwa? Ni namɔ dɛŋ mihe nyɔɔŋnii yɛ koni maku mihiɛ mashwie esane nɔ? Nyɛwiea koo, koni mato nyɛ najiaŋ."
Maŋbii lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Otswako wɔ ojo lɛ, owako wɔ yi lɛ, osɔ̃ko mɔ ko dɛŋ nɔ ko hu."
Samuel to he ni ekɛɛ, "Yehowa ji midasefonyo mɔ, ni emɔ̃ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ hu miiye he odase ŋmɛnɛ akɛ mɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ midɛŋ." Amɛto he akɛ, "Lɛji odasefonyo lɛɛlɛŋ."
Samuel kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ji odasefonyo lɛɛlɛŋ, lɛ mɔ ni ehala Mose kɛ Aaron ni ejie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛdamɔa shi nyɛmɛa koni mi kɛ nyɛ akojoa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ekɛhere nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsinamɛi lɛ ahewɔ.
Be ni Yakob tee Egipt ni Egiptbii lɛ yeɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nyɔŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ blɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa tsu Mose kɛ Aaron ni amɛyajie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ Egipt kɛba, ni amɛha amɛbahi biɛ nɛɛ.

Shi nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ kpa Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã, ni Hazor maŋtsɛ Yabin tatsɛ Sisera lɛ, kɛ Filistibii lɛ hu kɛ Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ hu kɛ amŋ wuwuu tai, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ye nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ.
Enɛ hã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ blɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni amɛkɛɛ, 'Wɔfee esha, ejaakɛ wɔkwa bo, Yehowa, ni wɔyasɔmɔ Baali kɛ Astarte moŋ. Shi agbɛnɛ heremɔ wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni wɔbaasɔmɔ bo.'
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa tsu Gideon (ni ji Yerubaal) kɛ Barak kɛ Yefta kɛ mi Samuel hu, ni etsɔ̃ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ hu anɔ ahere nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ yɛ hei fɛɛ; kɛkɛ ni nyɛhi shi shweshweeshwe.
Shi be ni nyɛna akɛ Nahash, Amonbii lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ, afã nyɛyi nɔ ta lɛ, nyɛkɛɛ ni akɛ 'Dabi, wɔkplɛɛɛ; ja wɔna maŋtsɛ ni eye wɔnɔ,' tsɛbelɛ YEhowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji nyɛmaŋtsɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ naa, Maŋtsɛ lɛ ni nyɛtao ni nyɛbi lɛ, ahã nyɛ. Naa Yehowa ewo maŋtsɛ ehã nyɛ.

Kɛji nyɛaashe Yehowa gbeyei, ni nyɛaasɔmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛaaye egbee nɔ, ni nyɛtseŋ ekitã lɛ hiɛ atūa, ni asaŋ nyɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ni yeɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaanyiɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛjeŋ baaja ahã nyɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛyayeee Yehowa gbee nɔ; shi nyɛtse ekitã lɛ hiɛ atua lɛ no lɛ Yehowa baagbla nyɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ fɛɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛkwɛa naakpɛɛ no kɔ ni Yehowa baafee.

Ani jeee ŋmãakuu be mli ji ŋmɛnɛ? Ojogbaŋ! Mibasɔle matsɛ Yehowa koni ehã ŋwɛi ashimɔ, ni nu hu anɛ koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛshi Yehowa kɛ maŋtsɛ ni nyɛbi akɛ ahã nyɛ lɛ, eda naakpa."
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel sɔle etsɛ Yehowa, ni ehã ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni nu nɛ nakai gbi lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ she Yehowa kɛ Samuel gbeyei.
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpa Samuel fai amɛkɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, kpa Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ohã wɔ otsuji koni wɔkagboi, ejaakɛ eshai fɛɛ ni wɔfee sa lɛ wɔfee eko hu wɔfata he akɛ wɔbi akɛ ahã wɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ."
Shi Samuel kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛna nyɛfee nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkakpalea kɛjea Yehowa sɛɛ, shi moŋ nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ.
Nyɛkagbaa afã kɛyanyiɛ yaka nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni asaŋ nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ahere lɛ asɛɛ; ejaakɛ yaka nibii ni.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kwaŋ nyɛ yɛ egbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ; asaŋ esa ehiɛ hu akɛ ekɛ nyɛ afee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Mi hu enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔɔ̃fɔ akɛ makpa sɔlemɔ kɛ nyɛ hãmɔ ni mikɛfee esha mishi Yehowa. Shi moŋ mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja ni sa akɛ nyɛfee.
Nyɛshea Yehowa kɛkɛ gbeyei; asaŋ nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ yɛ anɔkwayeli mli kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ. Nyɛkaia nibii wuji abɔ ni etsu ehã nyɛ lɛ.
Shi naa, no lɛ aaabɛɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ fɛɛ ashwie."
13: Saul eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ be ni ebɔ̃i Israel nɔ yeli akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ lɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.

Saul hala hii tabilɔi akpei etɛ̃ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. Ekɛ hii tabilɔi nɛɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei enyɔ hi Mikmash yɛ Betel yɛ gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛteŋ akpe hu kɛ Yonatan hi Gibea yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Isreal hii ni shwɛ lɛ Saul wo amɛ gbɛ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshīa.

Yonatan yatua Filistibii asraafoi aku ko ni yɔɔ Gibea lɛ, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim. Filistibii lɛ nu sane nɛɛ he, no hewɔ lɛ Saul tsu koni ayakpã tɛtrɛmantɛre ni ashiɛ kɛtsɛ ta yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, koni akɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa toi, Hebribii!
Naa, Saul eyaye Filistibii asraafoi aku ko nɔ kunim, ni no hewɔ lɛ Filistibii lɛ ekã kɛbaaye wie!" Isrealbii here tsɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtiu Saul yɛ Gilgal.

Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ bua amɛhe naa koni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ abawu. Amɛhiɛ ta shwiilii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpei ekpaa kɛ asraafoi ni yafalɛ oookɛɛ ŋshɔnaa shia; ni amɛfã ta kɛgba, ni amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Mikmash yɛ Bet-Aven bokãgbɛ.
Be ni Isreal hii lɛ na akɛ nine miitao akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ (ejaakɛ ta lɛ miinyɛ amɛ) lɛ, mɛi yateetee amɛhe yɛ tɛkploi kɛ bui kɛ tɛsai kɛ gbonyobui kɛ nubui amli,
ni mɛi komɛi hu jo foi amɛyafo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛtee Gad kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Saul yɛ Gilead lolo, ni mɛi ni ena nyiɛ esɛɛ lolo fɛɛ miikpokpo kɛ gbeyei.
Saul mɛ Samuel gbii kpawo, ni ji be ni Samuel to lɛ lɛ; shi Samuel eyashɛɛɛ shi, ni maŋ lɛ hu miijwa kɛmiishi Saul.
Enɛ hã Saul Fã akɛ, "Akɛ shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ abahã mi yɛ biɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Saul shã afɔle lɛ.
Shi afɔle lɛ ni eshã egbe naa pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ naa Samuel ni ebashɛ shi. Saul tee ni ekɛ Samuel yakpe ni efla lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bi Saul akɛ, "Kwɛ, mɛni ofee nɛɛ?" Saul jie enaa akɛ, "Be ni mina akɛ maŋ lɛ miijwa kɛmiishi mi, ni gbi ni oto lɛ ebaho fɛɛ ni obashɛko shi, ni asaŋ Filistibii lɛ anaa ebakpe shi yɛ Mikmash lɛ,
nɔ ni misusu ji akɛ Filistibii lɛ baaba abatua mi yɛ Gilgal, be mli ni mibiko Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, fimɔ na lɛ, mimia mihiɛ, ni mishã afɔle lɛ."

Samuel to he ehã Saul akɛ, "Oye gbɛkɛbii asane pam. Oyeko kitã ni Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wo bo lɛ nɔ. Kulɛ kpaakpo Yehowa baawaje omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ baafo. Yehowa ŋɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui naa gbɔmɔ ni ewo lɛ emaŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ; mɛni hewɔ lɛ oyayeee kitã ni Yehowa wo bo lɛ nɔ."
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Saul shi Gilgal ni etee Geba yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ekane hii tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ, ena mɛi aaafee ohai ekpaa.
Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan kɛ tabilɔi ni fata amɛhe lɛ wa yɛ Geba, yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No mli lɛ Filistibii lɛ ewo shi yɛ Mikmash.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ wo asafoi etɛ̃ gbɛ kɛjɛ amɛta lɛ mli koni amɛyatua Isrealbii lɛ koni amɛha amɛnii. Ku kome tsɔ̃ Ofra gbɛ kɛtee Shual shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ku kome hu tsɔ̃ Bet-Horon gbɛ,
ni ku kome ko hu tsɔ̃ husu lɛ ni kwɛɔ Zeboim Jɔɔ lɛ mli nɔ kɛtee shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ sɔ̃lɔ kome nɛkɛ bɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko, ejaakɛ Filistibii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji afeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ Hebribii lɛ aaasɔ̃ klaŋtei kɛ akplɔi ato amɛhe."
Belɛ Filistibii lɛ aŋɔɔ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yaa ni eyajɔɔ etsina kɔi kɛ shitsaa kɔi kɛ lema kɛ jwɛifoo kakla fɛɛ naa.

Aheɔ amɛ nɔ ko fioo ko kɛji ajɔ tsina kɔi loo shitsaa kɔi naa. Shi kɛji ajɔ tsinakplamɔ dade naa lɛ, aheɔ jwiɛtɛi shekel kome mlijaa etɛ̃ mli enyɔ ni kɛhã lema lɛ naajɔɔ lɛ aheɔ shekel kome mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ gbi ni atswa ta lɛ, anaaa Saul kɛ Yonatan sɛɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ni ehiɛ klaŋte loo akplɔ, fe Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan kɛkɛ ni amɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ eko.
Filistibii lɛ wo asraafoi aku gbɛ kɛtee Mikmash jɔɔ lɛ mli koni amɛyabu jɛi tsɔ̃mɔhe lɛ he.
14: Gbi ko lɛ Saul bi Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ etawunii lɛ akɛ, "Ba ni wɔfo mli wɔyahɛŋ Filistibii asraafoi ni yɔɔ amɛsra lɛ mli yɛ jɛi lɛ." Shi Yonatan wooo etsɛ Saul toi nɔ.
Be nɛɛ lɛ Saul ebawa yɛ aduawa tso ni yɔɔ Migron lɛ shishi yɛ Gibea kpokpaianɔ. Tabilɔi ni fata ehe ayifalɛ aaafee ohai ekpaa,
ni Ahia ji mɔ ni wo efod lɛ. Osɔfo Eli, mɔ ni ye Yehowa osɔfo yɛ Shilo lɛ, bi Finehas bi Ikabod nyɛmi Ahitub bi ji Ahia nɛɛ. Shi maŋ lɛ leee kwrakwra akɛ Yonatan eje amɛteŋ etee he ko.

Gɔji ateŋ tsɔ̃mɔhe he ni Yonatan tao akɛ etsɔ̃ kɛyatua Filistibii asraafoi lɛ, tɛsai enyɔ komɛi ewo lɛ teŋ. Tɛi ni yɔɔ tɛsai nɛɛ amli lɛ anaa eje kpo vɛŋŋvɛŋŋ. Ekome ye afã kome nɛɛ, ni ekome hu yɛ afã kome nɛɛ. Ekome gbɛi ji Bozez, ni ekome hu gbɛi ji Sene.
Ekome ye kooyigbɛ yɛ Mikmash gbɛ, ni ekome lɛ hu ye wuoyigbɛ yɛ Gibagbɛ.

Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ edama lɛ akɛ, "Wɔfo mli wɔtee wɔyahɛŋ foolɔi nɛɛ asraafoi lɛ; shi eko lɛ Yehowa aaaye abua wɔ ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko etsiii Yehowa naa akɛ ekɛ mɛi pii loo mɛi fioo aaahere yiwala."
Oblanyo lɛ ni hiɛ tawuunii lɛ to he ekɛɛ, "Bɔ ni oookɛɛ; mi kɛ bo, yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ."
Yonatan kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ; wɔbaafo mli kɛya amɛŋɔɔ, ni wɔbajie wɔhe kpo koni amɛna wɔ.
Kɛji no sɛɛ ni amɛkɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛmɛa, shi wɔmiiba wɔkɛ nyɛ abakpe' lɛ, wɔbaawa wɔdamɔ wɔnajiaŋ.
Shi kɛji amɛkɛɛ wɔ akɛ 'Nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaa' lɛ, no lɛ wɔbaaya wɔyanina amɛ, ejaakɛ no ji okadi akɛ Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ewo wɔdɛŋ koni wɔye amɛnɔ."

No hewɔ lɛ Yonatan kɛ edama hiɛlɔ lɛ fɛɛ jie amɛhe kpo ni amɛhã Filistibii asraafoi lɛ na amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa, Hebribii lɛ miifaamɔ kpo kɛjɛ bui amli hei ni amɛyateetee amɛhe yɛ lɛ."

Ni Filistibii asraafoi lɛ bo tsɛ Yonatan kɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ edama lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaa! Wɔbaatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ko." Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ edama lɛ akɛ, "Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ, shi Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ewo Israel dɛŋ."

Yonatan nyiɛ yɛ eniji kɛ enaji anɔ kɛkwɔ tɛsaa lɛ, ni etawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ hu fee nakai nɔŋŋ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ. Yonatan yatua Filistibii lɛ ni eku mɛi fɛɛ ni baje hiɛ lɛ eshwie shi, bɛlɛ etawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ hu miigbe mɛi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ klaŋte ni Yonatan tse nɛɛ mli lɛ, lɛ kɛ tawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ana gbohii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ kɛkta kome dalɛ mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome fɛɛ ekome nɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii ni yɔɔ nsra lɛ mli kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛ maji fɛɛ amli fɛɛ jijaa, ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ asraafoi ni yɔ nsra lɛ mli lɛ kɛ mɛi ni tee amɛyaaye ofɔ̃ lɛ. Shikpɔŋ hu hoso, ni ehã jijaamɔ lɛ mli wo wu.
Saul sɛɛ tabilɔi ni ahã amɛbuɔ yɛ Gibea yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yaakwɛ lɛ naa Filistibii lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã kɛmiiya kɛmiiba.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ esɛɛbii lɛ akɛ, Nyɛkanea mɛi lɛ koni wɔkɛtao mɔ ni eje wɔteŋ." Be ni akane mɛi lɛ, Yonatan kɛ etawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni lɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Ni Saul Kɛɛ Ahia, Osɔfo lɛ, akɛ "Yaawo Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba biɛ." Nɛkɛ beiaŋ lɛ he fɛɛ he ni Israelbii lɛ yaa lɛ amɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yaa.
Saul kɛ osɔfo lɛ hiɛ wiemɔ ni hoofeemɔ lɛ naa bawa yɛ Filistibii lɛ ansra lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ osɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Ahi shi dã!"
Saul kɛ tabilɔi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ mia ni agbɛnɛ amɛfã kɛtee ta lɛ naa. Amɛyanina ni Filistinyo klaŋte kã enyɛmi Filistinyo nɔŋŋ nɔ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hiɛ etsɔ̃ ebu shi efee basaa.
Hebribii ni kɛ Filistibii lɛ anɔ kɛba ta lɛ naa lɛ, kpa amɛhe ni amɛhe ni amɛyafata Israelbii lɛ ni kɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan nyiɛ lɛ ahe.
Nakai nɔŋŋ hu Israelbii ni jojoo foi amɛyateetee yɛ ta lɛ naa lɛ, amɛ hu amɛbafata he ni anyiɛ Filistibii lɛ asɛɛ waa.
No hewɔ lɛ yehowa here Israel nakai gbi lɛ. Atswa ta lɛ aahuu kɛho Bet-aven maŋ lɛ he.

Israelbii tabilɔi lɛ na nɔ kɛ hɔmɔ nakai gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ Saul kã maŋ lɛ kitã akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasa enaa nɔ ko dani je aaana ni matɔ mihe owele yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ magbe naa lɛ, loomɔ aaalomɔ mɔ lɛ." No hewɔ lɛ gbi muu lɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kwraa esaaa enaa nɔ ko.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ yashɛ koo ko mli, ni wo jwere shikpɔŋ yɛ jɛi.
Be ni tabilɔi lɛ shɛ koo nɛɛ mli lɛ, wo tsereɔ shwieɔ shi nɛɛ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ewao esaaa eko wooo edaaŋ, ejaakɛ tabilɔi lɛ miishe gbeyei yɛ kitã lɛ hewɔ.
Akɛni Yonatan nuuu be ni etsɛ kãa maŋ lɛ kitã lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ ekɛ tso ni ehiɛ lɛ naa tsɔ wo agbaku lɛ mli, ni eye wo lɛ eko, kɛkɛ ni ekpɔiaŋ tse lɛ.
Shi tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, "Otsɛ kã maŋ lɛ kitã veveeve akɛ, 'Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasa enaa nɔ ko ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, loomɔ kɛ̃ aaaalomɔ lɛ; ni no ji biti ni miŋbii lɛ etɔ kɛ hɔmɔ nɛɛ.'"
Yonatan to he akɛ, "Mitsɛ egba maŋ lɛ naa pam, ejaakɛ wo nɛɛ fioo ko kɛkɛ ni mikɛsa minaa lɛ, nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni mikpɔiaŋ etsɛ mi.
Eji ŋmɛnɛ lɛ maŋbii lɛ yeyee amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anibii ni amɛna ni ashishii lɛ eko, bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ kɛkɛ kulɛ, aso agbeŋ Filistibii lɛ fɛɛ nɛkɛ aahuu?"
Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Mikmash aahuu kɛyashi Ayalon. Ni etɔ Israelbii lɛ butuu.
Amɛbɔi nihaa, ni amɛmɔmɔ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tsinabii fɛɛ, ni amɛgbegbee amɛ yɛ amɛnajiaŋ nɔŋŋ, ni amɛye loo lɛ be mli ni loo lɛ mli lá fɛɛ tsereko.
Ayabɔ Saul amaniɛ akɛ, "Naa, maŋbii lɛ miitɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛmiiye loo ni emli lá fɛɛ tsere ko." Saul here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛnɔkwayeli faaa! Nyɛkokloa tɛ kpeteŋkple nyɛbahãa mi yɛ biɛ!"

Saul tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ni nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, 'Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ etsina loo etoo lɛ aba ni ebagbe lɛ yɛ biɛ ni eye, shi akaye loo lɛ be mli ni emli lá fɛɛ tsereko koni nyɛkɛmiitɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.'" No hewɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mɔ etsina kɛba, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni amɛbabegbee kooloi lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni Saul mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa. No ji klɛŋklɛŋ afɔleshãa latɛ ni Saul mã ehã Yehowa.

Enɛ sɛɛ ni Saul kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔyaa koni wɔyatuaa Filistibii lɛ nyɔɔŋ koni wɔgbe amɛ kɛyashi jetsŋremɔ wɛlɛŋ; ni wɔkashi amɛteŋ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ." Maŋbii lɛ here nɔ akɛ," Bɔ ni oookɛɛ." Shi osɔfo lɛ hu kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔbia Nyɔŋmɔ nii dã."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Saul bi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ekɛɛ, "Miyatua Filistibii lɛ lo? Obaahã Israel aye amɛnɔ kunim lo?" Shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa Saul hetoo nakai gbi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Saul tsu atsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ abahã lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbataoa mli akɛ nyɛaana he ni ajɛ afee esha ni ebaje kpo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lo?
Mina Yehowa, Israel yiwalaherelɔ lɛ, kɛji mibi Yonatan tete ni fee esha nɛɛ lɛ ja egbo." Shi tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hãaa hetoo.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaaye afã kome, ni mi kɛ mibi Yonatan hu baaye afã kome." Maŋbii lɛ sɛɛ kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Bɔ ni oookɛɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba ni ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ ohãaa otsulɔ hetoo? Kɛji esha lɛ mi, loo mibi Yonatan ni fee lɛ, hã Urim atsɔ̃ɔ; shi kɛji owebii Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ajɛ ni afee esha lɛ, no lɛ hã Tummim atsɔ̃ɔ." Oshiki lɛ gbee Saul kɛ Yonatan nɔ, ni maŋbii lɛ ahe je mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfɔ̃a oshiki lɛ yɛ mi kɛ mibi Yonatan nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, "Gbaa mi nɔ pɔtɛɛ ni ofee lɛ." Yonatan gba Saul sane lɛ ekɛɛ, "Mikɛ tso ko ni mihiɛ sa wo fioo, ni mikɛsa minaa. Naa mi, mifee kralo, abaanyɛ agbe mi."
Saul to he ekɛɛ, "Kɛji mihãaaa ogbo fii, Yonatan, no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi, ni egbe mi ekoŋŋ."

Shi maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Yonatan baagbo lo? Lɛ mɔ ni eye kunim kpeteŋkple nɛkɛ nɛɛ ehã Israel lɛ? Akaba mli nakai! wɔna Yehowa akɛ Yonatan yiteŋ tsɔi kome nɛkɛ efaŋ egbeŋ shi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ lɛ tsu nɔ ni etsu ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ." Biɛ tsɔ̃ ni Maŋbii lɛ here Yonatan yiwala kɛje gbele mli.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Saul fɔ̃ɔ Filistibii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ; ni Filistibii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋji lɛ anɔ.

Be ni Saul batsɔ̃ Isreal maŋtsɛ lɛ, ekɛ Israel henyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni ebɔle Israel kɛkpe lɛ wu. Ekɛ Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ kɛ Edombii lɛ kɛ Zoba maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ fɛɛ wuwuu tai. Ni he fɛɛ he ni Saul tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ eyeɔ kunim.
Saul fee ekãa jogbaŋŋ ni ekɛye Amalebii lɛ anɔ kunim n ekɛhere Israelbii lɛ yɛ mɛi ni batuaa amɛ kɛbahaa amɛnii lɛ adɛŋ.
Saul musuŋ bihii lɛ ji Yonatan kɛ Ishvi kɛ Malkishua; ni ebiyei enyɔ lɛ hu agbɛii ji Merab, onukpa lɛ, kɛ Mikal ni ji gbekɛ lɛ.
Saul ŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Ahinoam, Ahimaaz biyoo lɛ. Etatsɛ nukpa fe fɛɛ ji Abner. Saul tsɛkwɛ̃ Ner bi ji lɛ.
Saul tsɛ Kish kɛ Abner hu tsɛ Ner lɛ Abiel bihii ji amɛ.
Saul yinɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii kɛ Filistibii ateŋ ejɔɔɔ kɛ taitai ni naa wa sɔŋŋ. Ni no hewɔ lɛ kɛji Saul na nuu hiɛwalɔ loo kãkãlɔ pɛ, eŋɔ lɛ efata tabilɔi ni buɔ ehe lɛ ahe.
15: Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, Miji mɔ ni Yehowa tsu koni mibafɔ bo mu kɛwo bo emaŋ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi."
Yehowa ni ji Tatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibagbla Amalekbii lɛ atoi yɛ shi ni amɛte amɛwo Israel be mli ni Israel jɛ Egipt ebaa lɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ yaa ni oyatua Amalekbii lɛ, ni okpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛyɔɔ hiɛ. Okɛ amɛhe akake amɛ, shi ogbe amɛ, nuu ni jio, abifao ni kã fufɔ naa ni jio, ogbe fɛɛ."
No ni Saul hã akpee maŋbii lɛ kɛba, ni akane amɛyibɔ yɛ Telem. Ana hii ni nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ akpei nyɔŋma ashi nɔ.
Saul kɛ tabilɔi lɛ fã kɛba Amalekbii amaŋ wulu lɛ niiaŋ, ni ebawo ka yɛ maŋ lɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛ shɛɛ maje Kenbii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, "Nyɛshia Amalebii lɛ ateŋ nyɛyaa koni mikakpãtã nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ejurɔ, be ni amɛjɛ Egipt amɛbaa lɛ." No hewɔ lɛ Kenbii lɛ shi Amalebii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛtee.
Saul kɛ Amalekbii lɛ wu, ni eplenee maɛ kɛjɛ Havila aahuu kɛyashi Shur ni yɔɔ bokã gbɛ lɛ.
Emɔ Amalekbii amaŋtsɛ Agag hiɛkãalɔ; shi agbe emaŋbii lɛ blublu.

Saul kɛ etabilɔi lɛ baa Agag yi. Asaŋ amɛbaa toikɛ tsinai kɛ tsinabii kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi abii lɛ ateŋ kooloi kpakpai fe fɛɛ lɛ hu yi; ni amɛkpãtãaa amɛhiɛ; shi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ kpakpa ko, aloo ni abɛ he nɔ ko feemɔ lɛ amɛkpãtã hiɛ.
Yehowa kɛ Samuel wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Mishwa mihe akɛ miwo Saul maŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ ekpale yɛ misɛɛ, ni eyeee mikitã lɛ anɔ." Sane lɛ fee Samuel mlifu, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.

Ni Samuel te shi enɔjetsɛremɔ maŋkɛ̃ mrã koni enine ayashɛ Saul nɔ leebi. No mli lɛ abatswa Samuel adafi akɛ, "Saul ba Karmel, ni ebama shiu koni akɛkai kunim ni eye lɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ etee Gilgal."
Be ni Samuel yashɛ Saul ŋɔɔ lɛ, Saul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ bo! Miye Yehowa famɔ lɛ nɔ."
Samuel bi Saul akɛ, "Ni mɛni ji toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ ablɔmɔ ni jwere mitoiŋ nɛɛ mɔ?"
Saul jie naa ekɛɛ, "Amalekbii lɛ aŋɔɔ akɛjɛ. Maŋbii lɛ baa toi kɛ tsinai lɛ ateŋ kooloi kpakpai fe fɛɛ lɛ ayi koni amɛkɛbashã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ; shi nibii ni shwɛ lɛ wɔkpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ."
Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Mɛɛ! Magba bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ." Saul to he ekɛɛ akɛ, "Wiemɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo lɛ onaa ohe akɛ mɔ flo ko kɛkɛ; shi ani jeee boji Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ atsɛ? Yehowa fɔ bo mu kɛwo bo Israel? Yehowa fɔ bo mu kɛwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ,
ni Yehowa tsu bo, ni ekɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Yaa koni oyaplenee Amalekbii eshafeelɔi lɛ. Okɛ amɛ awu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni oookpãtã amɛhiɛ kwrakwra.'
Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni oyabooo Yehowa toi, ni otee oyaha ofɔyeli nii, ni okɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ nɛɛ?"
Saul here Samuel nɔ akɛ, "Mibo Yehowa toi. Mimɔ Agag, Amalekbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛba; ni Amalɛk bii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mikpãtã amɛhiɛ musumusu.
Shi tabilɔi lɛ ŋɔ ofɔ̃yeli nibii lɛ amli toi kɛ tsinai ni kulɛ sa amɛhiɛ kpãtãmɔ lɛ ateŋ kooloi kpakpai fe fɛɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛbashã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ yɛ Gilgal."
Shi Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Ani Yehowa nyaa shãa afɔlei kɛ gbee afɔlei ahe fe ni abaabo lɛ toi lo? Naa, toiboo hi fe afɔleshãa, ni ehi fe toi agboi amli fɔ.
Ejaakɛ atuatsemɔ lɛ esha ni tamɔ klamɔ nɔŋŋ, ni kuɛŋtimɔ lɛ esha ni tamɔ amãgãjamɔ nɔŋŋ. Akɛni okwa Yehowa naa wiemɔ lɛ, lɛ hu ekwa bo maŋtsɛ lɛ yeli."
Saul kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Mifee esha, ejaakɛ mitɔ̃ Yehowa fãmɔ lɛ kɛ bo hu owiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ miyashe tabilɔi lɛ agbeyei ni miyabo amɛnaawiemɔ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, miikpa bo fai, koni okɛ mihe esha lɛ afa mi, ni okɛ mi aku osɛɛ kɛya koni miyaja Yehowa."
Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Mikɛ bo ekuŋ misɛɛ kɛyajaŋ ejaakɛ oyaayeee fãmɔ ni Yehowa fã bo lɛ nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hu ekwa bo maŋtsɛ lɛ yeli yɛ Israel."
Be ni Samuel tsɔ̃ ahe konieya lɛ, Saul mɔ Samuel atade lɛ naamuu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni atade lɛ gba.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Yehowa shɔ̃ Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛŋ kɛkɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ni ekɛhã onaanyo ni hi fe bo.
Naa, Israel Anumnyam tsɛ lɛ amaleŋ ni eshwaŋ ehe hu ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ji lɛ, ni eeeshwa ehe."
kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ akɛ, "Mifee esha; shi kɛ̃lɛ wo mihe nyam yɛ mimaŋ onkpai lɛ kɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ, ni okɛ mi aku osɛɛ kɛya ni mayaja Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Samuel ku esɛɛ ni ekɛ Saul tee, ni Saul yaja Yehowa yɛ Gilgal.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ Agag, Amalekbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ." Agag bashɛ Samuel hiɛ kɛ ehiɛ miishɛɛ miishɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyitsoŋ akɛ, "Ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ benɛ ejie gbele sane yɛ eyiŋ."

Shi Samuel kɛɛ Agag akɛ, "Bɔ ni oklaŋte hã yei etsɔmɔ yei ni bɛ bii lɛ, nakai bo hu onyɛ baatsɔ̃ yoo ni bɛ bi yɛ enanemɛi yei ateŋ." Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bamɔ Agag kɛ klaŋte, ni eflɔ emli dukuduku yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Gilgal.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel yi mli etee Rama, ni Saul hu yi mli ni etee ewe yɛ Gibea.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Samuel kɛ ehiŋmɛtsei enyɔ nɛkɛ enaaa Saul dɔŋŋ aahuu kɛyashi Saul gbo; shi Samuel ye Saul he nkɔmɔ. Ni Yehowa shwa ehe akɛ ewo Saul Israel maŋtsɛ.
16: Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni oooye Saul he nkɔmɔ kɛyashi, be mli ni ona ole akɛ mikwa lɛ Israel maŋtsɛyeli"? Wo okoŋ lɛ mli mu obɔ̃; mibatsu bo Yeshai, Betlehemnyo lɛ, ŋɔɔ ejaakɛ miŋɔ maŋtsɛ ye ebihii lɛ ateŋ mihã mihe."
Samuel to he ekɛɛ, "Te mafee tɛŋŋ matee tsumɔ nɛɛ hu? Kɛji Saul nu he lɛ eeegbe mi." Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ tsinabi ohiɛ odɛ̃ kɛya, ni oyakɛɛ akɛ, 'Miba mibashã afɔle mahã Yehowa.'
Kpeemɔ Yeshai kɛba afɔleshãahe lɛ, ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ofee koni ofɔ mɔ ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ mi ohã mi."
Samuel fee nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ lɛ. Be ni eshɛ Betlehem lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛ Samuel bakpe kɛ hekpokpomɔ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Hejɔlɛ baa oba nɛɛ lo?"
Samuel jie naa ekɛɛ akɛ, "Hejɔlɛ baa miba!. Miba mibashã afɔle mahã Yehowa. Nyɛtsuua nyɛhe, ni nyɛ kɛ mi ayaa afɔle lɛ shãa." Etsuu Yeshai kɛ ebihii lɛ ahe, ni ekpee amɛ lɛtee afɔle lɛ shãahe lɛ.
Be ni Yeshai kɛ ebihii lɛ ba ni Samuel na Yashai bi Elaib lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ eyitsoŋ akɛ, "Mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ damɔ Yehowa hiɛ nɛɛ."
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Kaahã ehiɛŋtso loo ekwɔlɛ nyɛnyereŋŋ lɛ miilaka bo. Jeee bɔ ni gbɔmɔ adesa kwɛɔ nii Yehowa kwɛɔ nii. Gbɔmɔ adesa kwɛɔ kponɔgbɛ nii ekɛyeɔ sane, shi Yehowa lɛ kwɛɔ tsuiŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yeshai tsɛ ebi Abinadab ni ehã etsɔ̃ Samuel hiɛ kɛho. Shi Samuel kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɔnɛ hu Yehowa eŋɔko lɛ."
No sɛɛ lɛ Yeshai hã ebi Shama hu baho; shi Samuel kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Mɔnɛ hu Yehowa eŋɔko lɛ."
Yeshai hã ebihii lɛ ateŋ mɛi kpawo habo yɛ Samuel hiɛ; shi Samuel kɛɛ Yeshai akɛ, "Yehowa eŋɔko obii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko."

Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bi Yeshai akɛ, "Ani, oblahii lɛ fɛɛ nɛ? Yeshai to he akɛ, "Eshwɛ amɛteɛ gbekɛ kwraa fe fɛɛ lɛ; emrɔ nɛɛ eekwɛ mitoi lɛ." Samuel kɛɛ Yeshai akɛ, "Tsu koni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba, ejaakɛ wɔwoŋ afɔle lɛ shãa ja ebashɛ biɛ dã."
Yeshai tsu ni ayaŋɔ ebi gbekɛ lɛ kɛba: Etsuɔ fioo, ni ehiŋmɛii yɛ fɛo; anɔkwa ehe yɛ fɛo. Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, "Tee shi ni ofɔ oblanyo lɛ mu, ejaakɛ lɛ nɛ."
Samuel wo mu kɛ koŋ lɛ, ni efɔ David mu yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛa teŋ. Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa mumɔ lɛ yi David nɔ!. Kɛkɛ ni Samuel te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Rama.
Yehowa mumɔ lɛ je Saul nɔ agbɛnɛ, ni Yehowa hãa mumɔ fɔŋ ko moŋ bahaoɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Saul tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔsusuɔ akɛ mumɔ fɔŋ ko ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã haoɔ bo nɛɛ.
Ofãa wɔ otsuji ni damɔ ohiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ kulɛ, wɔɔya wɔyatao mɔ ko ni he esa jogbaŋŋ kɛ saŋkutswaa kɛba koni kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ hã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ bayi ɔnɔ lɛ, etswa saŋku lɛ koni ahi ahã bo."
Saul kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyataoa mɔ ko ni le Sankutswaa jogbaŋŋ nyɛhãa mi, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa."

Oblahii lɛa teŋ mɔ kome here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mile Yeshai, Betlehemnyo lɛ, binuu ko ni ehe esa kɛ Sankutswaa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ; oblanyo kãkãlɔ ni sheee ta naa gbeyei, ni ele mɔ kɛ wiemɔ, ni ehe hu yɛ fɛo, ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Saul tsu bɔfoi k! wiemɔ kɛtee Yeshai ŋɔɔ akɛ, "Hã obi David lɛ ni kwɛɔ otoi lɛ abana mi."
Yeshai kɛ aboloo kɛ wain ni yɔɔ kooloo wolo tɔ mli kɛ abotaibi tere teji, ni ekɛhã David koni ekɛyahã Saul.
David yashɛ Saul ŋɔɔ, ni ebɔi lɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ. Saul basumɔ David sane bɔ sɔŋŋ ni efee lɛ etawuuniihiɛlɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Saul kɛ shɛɛ maje ayahã Yeshai akɛ, Hã David ahi biɛ kwraa, ni esɔmɔ mi ejaakɛ miisumɔ esane."
Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ aba Saul nɔ lɛ, David tswaa saŋku lɛ, ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ jeɔ Saul nɔ; ni Saul he jɔɔ lɛ, ni ehiɔ ehãa lɛ.
17: Filistibii lɛ bua amɛtabilɔi lɛ naa hã ta, ni amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ Soko, ni ji Yudabii amaŋ ko, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Efes-Damin yɛ Soko kɛ Azeka teŋ.
Saul kɛ Israel hii lɛ hu bua amɛhe naa kɛkpe, ni amɛgba ta amɛwo Filistibii lɛ, ni amɛmiikwɛ Filistibii lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Filistibii lɛ jwere gɔŋ kome ko hiɛshi, nai Israelbii lɛ hu jwere gɔŋ kome ko hu hiɛshi, ni jɔɔ kã amɛteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni nuu tatsɛlɔ ko jɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ eje kpo koni ebatsɛ ta. Atsɛɔ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ Goliat ni ejɛ Gat. Ekwɔlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi ekpaa.
Ebu akɔɔble fai ni ewo akɔɔble dama ni edama lɛ tsiimɔ ji akɔɔble shekeli akpei enumɔ.
Ewo akɔɔble tswakoto ni etsimɔ enaji ahe, ni akɔɔble fitii bloblo ko ble ekɔji asɛɛ.
Akplɔ ni hiɛ adɛ lɛ tilɛ tamɔ tso ni bleɔ mamaloo tsɔne yiteŋ tilɛ, ni ekplɔ nɛɛ yitso dade tsiimɔ ji shekeli ohai ekpaa; ni mɔ ni hiɛɔ etsɛŋ lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ.

Goliat baho edamɔ shi, ni ebo etsɛ Israel tabilɔi lɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛba nyɛbagba sa kɛbaatswa ta? Filistinyo ji mi, ni nyɛ hu Saul tsuji ji nyɛ? Nyɛfãa nuu kome ni ekpleke jɔɔ lɛ ni edamɔ nyɛnaa koni ekɛ mi abakpe.
Kɛji enyɛ mi ekɛnɔ ni egbe mi lɛ, wɔɔtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛtsuji. Shi kɛji mi minyɛ! lɛ migbe lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ wɔtsuji koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ wɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Filistinyo lɛ kɛɛ, "Miitswa Israel ta lɛ mpoa ŋmɛnɛ! Nyɛfãa nuu kɛbaa koni ekɛ mi abanɔ."
Be ni Saul kɛ Israelbii lɛ nu Filsitinyo nɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ, ŋmiŋmi diɛŋtsɛ mɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.
Efraimnyo ko ni jɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yeshai lɛ bi ji David. Yeshai nɛɛ yɛ bihii kpaanyɔ, Saul yinɔ lɛ Yeshai egbɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Ebihii onukpai etɔ̃ lɛ nyiɛ Saul sɛɛ kɛtee ta lɛ. Bihii etɛ̃ nɛɛ ni tee ta lɛ agbɛii ji: Eliab, ni ji kromɔbi lɛ, kɛ esɛɛho Abinadab kɛ lɛ hu esɛɛho Shama.
David ji Yeshai bii lɛ ateŋ gbekɛ kwraa. Be ni ebihii Onukpai etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ Saul tee ta lɛ,
kɛfee lɛ David jɛɔ Saul ŋɔɔ ni eyaa eyakwɛɔ etsɛ toi lɛ fioo yɛ Betlehem ni ekuɔ esɛɛ ebaa.
Filistinyo lɛ jeɔ kpo daa leebi kɛ gbekɛ, ni ebadamɔɔ shi ni etsɛɔ Israelbii lɛ ŋanɔ. Efee nakai gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ.
Gbi ko lɛ Yeshai kɛɛ ebi David akɛ, "Hemɔ mamu kiloi nyɔŋma nɛɛ kɛ aboloo akwaabɔi nyɔŋma nɛɛ ni osha ohe oya nsra lɛ mli okɛyahã onyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Okɛ keesui nyɔŋma nɛɛ hu ahã asraafoi akpatsɛ lɛ, mɔ shishi ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ. Okwɛ bɔ ni onyɛmimɛi lɛ yɔɔ, ni okɛ amɛhe okadi ko aba ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ona amɛ, ni asaŋ amɛyɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Saul kɛ amɛ kɛ Israel tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Ela Jɔɔ lɛ mli amɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ miiwu."

David te shi leebi maaŋkpa, ni etu toi lɛ ewo tookwɛlɔ ko dɛŋ ni ewo niyenii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni eshwie nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ Yeshai fã lɛ lɛ. Ebashɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ be mli ni tabilɔi lɛ efã, ni amɛmiibɔ oshe kɛmiiya ta lɛ naa.
Israelbii lɛ ata lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ hu ata lɛ tsi ba, ni ta miikwɛ ta hiɛ.
David shi ejatsu lɛ ehã mɔ ni kwɛɔ tabilɔi lɛ ajatsui lɛ ateŋ, ni eyaŋa enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ.
Ekɛ amɛ hiɛ wiemɔ nɔŋŋ ni nuu tatsɛ kpanaa ko jɛ Filistibii ata lɛ mli edamɔ shi, ni ebabɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ mpoa tswaa tamɔ efeɔ daa lɛ. David nu wiemɔ ni ewie lɛ.
Be ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ na Goliat lɛ amɛjo foi ejaakɛ gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ naakpa.

Wiemɔ fo shi fee sɛɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ akɛ, "Bɛ nyɛmiina nuu lɛ ni efã kpo lɛ, eeba ebabɔ Israel ahora. Naa, mɔ ni baanyɛ lɛ egbɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ baahã mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ niiatsɛ wulu, asaŋ maŋtsɛ kɛ ebiyoo baahã lɛ gblã; no sɛɛ hu lɛ abaahã lɛ kɛ eweku fɛɛ akpa toowoo yɛ Israel."

David bihii komɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni akɛɛ abaafee ahã lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni akɛɛ abaafee ahã mɔ ni aaagbe Filistinyo nɛɛ koni ekpa ahora ni ebɔɔ Israel nɛɛ? Kwɛ Filistinyo foolɔ nɛɛ, lɛ ebɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tai lɛ ahora?"
Hii lɛ here David nɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɔ ni akɛɛ abaafee ahã mɔ ni aaagbe Filistinyo lɛ.

Shi Eliab, David nyɛminukpa lɛ, nu be ni David kɛ hii lɛ wieɔ lɛ, ni Eliab mli wo la wo David ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛni feemɔ oba yɛ biɛ? Namɔ oshi toi fioo lɛ ohã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ? Ona onukpainii ni ofeɔ lɛ? Te ta lɛ kwɛmɔ hewɔ oba nɛɛ?"
David jie enaa ekɛɛ, "Mɛni mifee? Jeee sane kɛkɛ mibi?"
David shi enyɛmi lɛ sɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ehe ekɛ mɔ kroko wie. Ebi sane kome lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni hetoo koome lɛ nɔŋŋ hu ahã lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Be ni anu wiemɔ ni David wie lɛ, ayabɔ Saul amaniɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Saul tsu ni ayaŋɔ David abahã lɛ.
David kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Mɔ ko mɔ ko tsui akafã yɛ nuu nɛɛ hewɔ. Otsulɔ aaatee ekɛ nɛkɛ Filistinyo nɛɛ ayakpe."
Saul kɛɛ David akɛ, "Onyɛŋ Filistinyo nɛɛ hiɛ odamɔ, ejaakɛ bo lɛ gbekɛ kɛkɛ ji o, shi lɛ lɛ ewu ta aahuu kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ."
Shi David here Saul nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Otsulɔ kwɛɔ etsɛ toi. Be fɛɛ be ni jata loo oshishibrishi ko aaabamɔ toi lɛ ateŋ toobi ko lɛ,
mitiuɔ kooloo lɛ miyatswaa lɛ nɔ, ni mishɔ̃ɔ toobi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ. Kɛji jata loo oshishibrishi lɛ te shi ewo mi lɛ, mimɔɔ etsɛŋ, ni mitswiaa lɛ nii, ni migbeɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ, jata kɛ oshishibrishi po migbe amɛ. Akɛni nɛkɛ Filistinyo foolɔ nɛɛ miibɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tai lɛ ahora hewɔ lɛ, eeena nɔ ni kooloi lɛ na yɛ midɛŋ lɛ eko.
Yehowa, mɔ ni jie mi yɛ jata kɛ oshishibrishi daaŋ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeejie mi yɛ Filistinyo nɛɛ dɛŋ." Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ Saul kɛɛ David akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ! Yaa, ni Yehowa aye abua bo."
Saul kɛ edade atade lɛ wo David, ni ekɛ akɔɔble fai bu lɛ, ni ewo lɛ dama eshwie atade lɛ nɔ.

David ŋmɔ Saul tawuu klaŋte lɛ yɛ atade lɛ nɔ. Shi be ni David ka nyiɛmɔ lɛ eyanyɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ ewoko nakai atade dã. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Minyɛŋ mawo nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ mikɛyanɔ, ejaakɛ mikako eko mikwɛko dã." No hewɔ lɛ David jie nibii lɛ yɛ ehe,
ni ekɔ edɛ̃hiɛmɔtsɔ lɛ ehiɛ, ni etee faa lɛ naa eyahala fɔbitɛi enumɔ ekɛwo tookwɛlɔi akotoku ni etsotsro lɛ mli; asaŋ ejie ekromia lɛ ehiɛ, ni etsi ebɛŋkɛ Filistinyo lɛ.
Filistinyo lɛ hu tsi eba, ni ebabɛŋkɛ David.
Be ni Filistinyo lɛ fɔ̃ ehiɛ ni ena David lɛ, ebuuu lɛ, ejaakɛ ena Lɛ akɛ oblanyo fioo kɛkɛ ni tsuɔ oo, kɛ ehiɛ fɛo.
Ebi David akɛ, "Ani gbee ji mi hewɔ ni ohiɛ tso kɛbaa minɔ lɛ?" Be ni Goliat etsɛ esɛɛ jamawɔŋ ekɛlomɔ David sɛɛ lɛ,
ekɛɛ David akɛ, "Ba! Bo lɛ shɛ biɛ; mikɛ oloo baahã loofɔji lɛ ŋaŋ kooloi ni amɛye."
David to he ehã Filistinyo lɛ akɛ, "Bo lɛ ooba minɔ kɛ klaŋte kɛ akplɔ kɛ tsɛŋ; shi mi lɛ mikɛ bo miiba abakpe yɛ Yehowa ni ji Tatsɛ lɛ, Israel tai ni obɔɔ amɛ ahora lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli.

Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baahã maye onɔ kunim, ni mafo oyi, ni mikɛ Filistibii ata lɛ mli gbohii lɛ baahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi kakawuai koni amɛye, koni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ Israel.
Asaŋ asafo ni ekpe nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛaana ale akɛ jeee klaŋte loo akplɔ Yehowa kɛhereɔ mɔ yiwala, ejaakɛ ta lɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ji mɔ ni wuɔ, ni ebaaŋɔ nyɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ."
Be ni Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ bɔ̃i nyiɛmɔ kɛbaa koni ekɛ David abakpe lɛ, David he fee oya, ni esha foi kɛtee tagbamɔhe lɛ koni enina Goliat yɛ jɛi.

Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ enine wo ekotoku lɛ mli, ni ekɔ tɛ ewo akromia lɛ mli, ni ekɔ tɛ ewo akromia lɛ mli ni efɔ̃. Tɛ lɛ yatswa Goliat hiɛnaa ni ebote ehiɛŋtso mli; kɛkɛ ni Goliat gbee shi, ni ehiɛ yabu shi.
Belɛ David kɛ akromia kɛ tɛ ye Goliat nɔ, ni egbe lɛ tsɛbelɛ ehiɛɛ klaŋte po.
David sha foi oya, ni eyaho edamɔ Goliat nɔ, emɔ Goliat klaŋte lɛ egbla yɛ ehebo lɛ mli ni ekɛfo Goliat yi. Be ni Filistibii lɛ na akɛ agbe amɛtatsɛ ni tsɛɔ Israel ŋanɔ lɛ, amɛjo foi.

Kɛkɛ ni Israel kɛ Yida hii lɛ bɔ oshe, ni amɛtiu Filistibii lɛ kɛ foi. Amɛnyiɛ Filistibii lɛa sɛɛ kɛyashi Gat kɛ Ekron agboi lɛ anaa. Gbi lɛ Filistibii pilafoi jwere shi kɛjɛ Shaaraim aahuu kɛyashi Gat kɛ Ekron fɛɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ je Filistibii lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ, amɛbaha Filistibii lɛ anibii yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli.
David kɔ Goliat yitso lɛ kɛba Yerusalem; shi Goliat yitso lɛ kɛba Yerusalem; shi Goliat tawuu dade dama lɛ, David hã ehi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enine nɔ yɛ ebuu mli.
Be ni Saul kwɛɔ David yisɛɛ be ni eyaa koni ekɛ Goliat ayakpe lɛ, ebi tatsɛ Abnar akɛ, "Abnar namɔ bi ji nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ?" Abnar to he akɛ, "Nii, mina onane akɛ mileee,"
Saul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaabi mɔ bi ni ji oblanyo lɛ."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ be ni David eyagbe Goliat ni eku esɛɛ ebaa lɛ, Abner kɛ lɛ tee Saul hiɛ, ni David hiɛ Goliat yitso lɛ.
Saul bi David akɛ, "Namɔ bi ji o, oblanyo?" David jie lɛ naa ekɛɛ, "Otsulɔ Yeshai, Betlehemnyo lɛ, bi ji mi."
18: Be ni Saul ewie egbe naa sɛɛ lɛ, Yonatan bana David he miishɛɛ, ni esumɔ David tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Saul hu ŋɔ David nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ David aku esɛɛ kɛya etsɛ we lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Yonatan sumɔ Daid tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ David bɔ naanyo ni amɛkpãŋ.
Enɛ hã Yonatan jie ehe nibii ni ekɛwula David, ekɛ etade lɛ kɛ emlifiinɔ lɛ hã lɛ.
Tai fɛɛ ni Saul tsu David wuu lɛ, etee eba kɛ omanye; ni no hewɔ lɛ Saul fee David etatsɛmɛi ateŋ mɔ kome, amɛji nɔ ko ni sa Israel hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Saul tsuji lɛ tete fɛɛ ahiɛ.

Be ni David egbe Filistinyo Goliat lɛ, ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ eku amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa shīa lɛ, Israel yei lɛ jɛjɛɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli amɛkɛ lala kɛ joo bakpee Maŋtsɛ Saul. Amɛhiɛ fa bii kɛ ŋoŋoi kɛ miji; ni amɛnya;
ni amɛla be mli ni amɛnyaa lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Saul egbe akpeikpei abɔ, shi David egbe akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ."
Wiemɔ nɛɛ enyaŋɔɔɔ Saul naa kwraa ni emli wo la, ni wiemɔ ni je enaa ji, "Ei! Akɛɛ David egbe gbɔmɛi akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ, shi mi lɛ akpeii amli kɛkɛ. Mɛni shwɛɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ mɔ fe maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔtamɔ?"
Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Saul jie ehiɛ eka David.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ, be mli David tswaa saŋku ehãa Saul tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ daa gbi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã mamu fɔŋ ko bayi Saul nɔ, ni egiri yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli. No mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Saul akplɔ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃.
Saul ekɛɛ yɛ eyitsoŋ akɛ, "Matsu David akplɔ lɛ," shi David we ehe shii enyɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehe je mli.
Agbɛnɛ Saul she David gbeyei, ejaakɛ ena akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ David yɛ, shi lɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa lɛ.
Enɛ hã Saul jie David yɛ emasɛi, ni ewo lɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛtee taitai kɛba;
ni eko fɛɛ eko mli lɛ David yayeɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ.
Be ni Saul na kunim wuji ni David yeɔ lɛ, gbeyei ni esheɔ David lɛ mli bawo wu.
Shi Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ sumɔ David sane ojogbaŋŋ, ejaakɛ enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaa ta ni ekɛ amɛbaa kɛ omanye.

Saul wo David shi akɛ, "Bɛ ona mibiyoo nukpa Merab lɛ? Mikɛ lɛ baahã bo gblã kɛji ooofee ekãa kɛkɛ ni okɛ Yehowa hɛnyɛlɔi lɛ aaawu ahã mi lɛ." Saul susumɔ ji akɛ, lɛ tuuŋtu lɛ, ekɛ enine etaŋ David he, shi Filistibii lɛ ji mɛi ni baagbe David ahã lɛ yɛ tai lɛ eko mli.
David kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Namɔ ji mi, ni namɛi ji miwekumɛi kɛ mitsɛ weku lɛ yɛ Israel, ni matsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ shaanuu?"
Be ni shɛ be ni esa akɛ akɛ Saul biyoo, Merab, ahã David gblã lɛ, akɛ Merab hã Adriel, Meholatnyo lɛ, moŋ.
Nakai be mli lɛ Saul biyoo ni gbɛi ji Mikal lɛ miisumɔ David. Be ni atswa Saul adafi akɛ Mikal miisumɔ David lɛ ena mishɛɛ,
ni ekɛɛ "Yiɛ, Mikɛ Mikal baahã lɛ koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ akpa ehã lɛ, koni Filistibii lɛ anine agbe lɛ ahã mi." Enɛ hã Saul wo David shi nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ akɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ obaatsɔ mishaanuu."

Saul fã etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛnaa David yɛ teemɔ mli, ni nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ ohe mishɛɛ, ni etsuji lɛ fɛɛ hu sumɔɔ osane lɛ, mɛɛba ni okɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ biyoo ehiii shi ni otsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ shaanuu?'"
Be ni Saul tsuji lɛ kɛ David yawie wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, David kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, "Kolɛ nyɛkɛɛ benɛ maŋtsɛ shaanuu tsɔ̃mɔ lɛ shwɛmɔ sane ni? Mi hu nɛ, ohiafobi humi ni mijeee mɔ ko."
Saul tsuji lɛ yabɔ lɛ hetoo ni David hã amɛ lɛ.

Shi Saul tsu amɛ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyakɛa David akɛ aheee Mikal yinii ko kwraa fe Filistibii lɛ afoo naa loo komekomei oha kɛkɛ, koni akɛtɔmaŋtsɛ he owele yɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ." Saul susumɔ ji akɛ foo naa loo lɛ taomɔ nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni Filistibii lɛa nine baagbe David.
Be ni Saul tsuji lɛ yabɔ David amaniɛ lɛ, emii shɛ ehe akɛ ebatsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ shaanuu. No hewɔ lɛ be ni eshwɛ fioo ni gbi lɛ shɛɔ lɛ,
David yiŋ etee, lɛ kɛ eshiishi tabilɔi lɛ, ni eyagbe Filistibii ohai enyɔ, ni eflɔ amɛfoo naa loi lɛ kɛba, ni ebakane ehã maŋtsɛ shaanuu. No hewɔ lɛ Saul kɛ ebiyoo Mikal hã David gblã
Shi be ni Saul kɛ ehiŋmɛi ŋmɛ shi ni ena akɛ Yehowa miibu David he, ni asaŋ akɛ Israel fɛɛ miisumɔ David sane lɛ,
gbeyei ni Saul sheɔ David lɛ mli bawa fe tsuutsu ko lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Saul tsɔ̃ David henyɛlɔ kwraa.
Be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi fãfãa tai; shi be fɛɛ be ni amɛaafã ta lɛ, David yeɔ Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim fe Saul tsuji krokomɛi fɛɛ. Enɛ hã David gbɛi hehe naakpa.
19: Saul wo ebi Yonatan kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ ayitson akɛ amɛgbe David kɛje nine shɛ enɔ. Shi akɛni Saul bi Yonatan sumɔɔ David sane
hewɔ lɛ Yonatan yatswa David adafi akɛ, "Naa, mitsɛ Saul miitao bo egbe. No hewɔ lɛ ole ohenɔ kwɛmɔ wɔ leebi. Otao nififiaŋ he ko koni oyatee ohe yɛ jɛi.
Mi lɛ mibaya mitsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, he ni oyɔɔ lɛ, koni mi kɛ lɛ ayawie ohe. Bɔ ni mibana lɛ mahã ole."
Yonatan tee ni eyana etsɛ Saul ni ewie ehã David, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, kwɛmɔ koni okafee otsulɔ David esha ko, ejaakɛ efeko bo esha ko kwraa; ni asaŋ nibii fɛɛ ni etsu lɛ he eba sɛɛnamɔ ehã bo.

Edɔɔɔ ewala he, ni no hewɔ lɛ etee ni ekɛ Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ, yakpe, ni egbe lɛ, ni Yehowa hã Israel fɛɛ ye kunim kpeteŋkple. Bo diɛŋtsɛ hu ona kunim ni eye lɛ, ni onya he. Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ ofee mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ esha, no ogbe David yakatswaa lɛ?"
Saul bo ebi Yonatan toi, ni Saul kã kitã ekɛɛ, "Mina Yehowa akɛ agbeŋ David."
Enɛ hã Yonatan tee ni eyatsɛ David yɛ eteemɔhe lɛ; ni be ni egba lɛ nɔ ni etee nɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yonatan kɛ David ba Saul ŋɔɔ, ni David ku sɛɛ ebahi Saul ŋɔɔ ni esɔmɔ lɛ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ.
Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ ta ba ekoŋŋ. David fã kɛtee eyawu ta lɛ, ni eye Filistibii lɛ anɔ butuu, ni amɛjo foi yɛ ehiɛ.
Yehowa hã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ bayi Saul nɔ ekoŋŋ. Gbi nɛɛ lɛ Saul hiɛ akplɔ kɛta shi yɛ ewe lɛ mli, ni David miitswa kpãa saŋku lɛ eehã lɛ.
Saul ka akɛ etsu David sha ehe, ni akplɔ lɛ yatsɛkɛ gbogbo lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni David jo foi, ni eje Saul dɛŋ.

Nakai gbi lɛ gbɛlɛ lɛ, Saul wo mɛi gbɛ akɛ amɛyawo David ka yɛ ewe lɛ bɔ ni afee koni lɛ Saul lɛ, enine ashɛ David nɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi koni egbe lɛ. Shi David ŋa, Mikal, wo David ŋaa ekɛɛ, "Kɛji ohereee oyiwala ŋmɛnɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, wɔ lɛ abaagbe bo."
No hewɔ lɛ Mikal shi David kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ mli kɛyi shi ni David jo foi etee, ni eje Saul dɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mikal wo nɔ ko ni agbɔ lɛ tamɔ gbɔmɔ efɔ̃ David saatso lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔ lɛ yitso tsɔle abotia he tsɔi sune lɛ, ni eha nɔ lɛ mama.
Be ni Saul bɔfoi ni etsu akɛ amɛyamɔ David amɛbahã lɛ lɛ shɛ David we lɛ mli lɛ, Mikal kɛɛ bɔfoi lɛ akɛ David naaa hetselɛ.
Shi Saul saa wo bɔfoi lɛ gbɛ ekoŋŋ kɛtee David we lɛ akɛ amɛyana lɛ kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi; ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwoa lɛ kɛ saa lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbahãa mi koni magbe lɛ."
Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ba lɛ amɛbanina amãgã ni tsɔle abotia he tsɔi sune kã David saatso lɛ nɔ.

Enɛ hã Saul bi Mikal akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ ni olaka mi nɛkɛ, ni ojie mihenyɛlɔ lɛ gbɛ etee, ni ohã eje midɛŋ nɛɛ?" Mikal hã Saul hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ewo mi shi ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji owaaa mi koni majo foi lɛ, no lɛ magbe bo.'"
Be ni David jo foi lɛ eba Samuel ŋɔɔ yɛ Rama, ni ebagba lɛ saji fɛɛ ni Saul kɛye lɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Saumuel fɛɛ tee ni amɛyahi Naiot.
Ayatswa saul adafi akɛ, "Naa, David yɛ Naiot yɛ Rama."

Kɛkɛ ni Saul wo bɔfoi gbɛ koni amɛyamɔ David kɛba. Be ni bɔfoi nɛɛ yashɛ Naiot ni amɛyanina Samuel damɔ gbalɔi aku lɛ naa akɛ amɛnukpa ni amɛmiigba lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ bayi bɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni amɛ hu amɛbɔi gbaa.
Ababɔ Saul amaniɛ; no hewɔ lɛ esaa etsu bɔfoi krokomɛi; shi amɛ hu amɛyashi gbalɔi lɛ anɔ. Saul ku sɛɛ etsu bɔfoi ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ nɔ; shi amɛ hu amɛyatsɔ̃mɔ gbalɔi nakai nɔŋŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni Saul diɛŋtsɛ yi mli ni etee Rama. Be ni eyashɛ nubu wulu ni yɔɔ Seku lɛ he lɛ, ebi David kɛ Samuel shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ ji he ni Samuel kɛ David yɔɔ lɛ?" Mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Amɛyɛ Naiot yɛ Rama."
Kɛkɛ ni Saul shwie nɔ kɛjɛ Seku ni eeya Naiot yɛ Rama; shi Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ yi lɛ hu enɔ, ni ehiɛ gbaa yɛ gbɛteŋ aahuu kɛyashi eyashɛ Naiot yɛ Rama.

Kɛkɛ ni Saul hu kplɔ ehe atadei lɛ ni egba yɛ Samuel hiɛ; ni ekã shi kɛ ehe flo nakai gbi lɛ shwane muu lɛ fɛ̃ɛ kɛ nyɔŋŋ muu lɛ fɛ̃ɛ. Bɔ ni fee ni abɔi kɛɛmɔ akɛ, "Mɛni, Saul hu etsɔ̃ gbalɔ hu?" Lɛ nɛ.
20: Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ David jo foi yɛ Naiot yɛ Rama kɛba Yonatan ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mifee? Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ mitɔ̃, ni mɛɛ esha po mifee otsɛ hewɔ ni etaoɔ mi egbe nɛɛ?"
Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Mɛɛ nakai hu ni akɛ abaagbe bo? Nɔ ko bɛ ni mitsɛ baafee ni ewooo mitoi nɔ, nɔ wulu ni jio, nɔ bibioo ni jio. Mɛni hewɔ mitsɛ kɛ sane nɛɛ baatee mi? Ebɛ mli nakai."
Shi David to he ekɛɛ, "Otsɛ le faŋŋ bɔ ni osumɔɔ misane, ni no hewɔ lɛ eyiŋtoo ji akɛ okale, no lɛ sane lɛ baadɔ bo. Mina Yehowa kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ hu akɛ ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ mikɛ gbele teŋ jɛkɛɛɛ."
Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Bi mi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ, ni mafee mahã bo."
David kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ nyɔŋ hee baaje, ni kulɛ esa akɛ mikɛ maŋtsɛ ayata shi aye nii; shi ofai nɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya ni mayatee mihe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi biɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji otsɛ bi mishi lɛ, okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'David bi mi gbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ akɛ eesha foi eya emaŋ Betlehem nɔŋŋ ni eba, ejaakɛ eweku fɛɛ mishã daa afi afɔle yɛ jɛi.'
Kɛji eto he akɛ 'Ojogbaŋ,' lɛ; no lɛ miye mihe. Shi kɛji emli fu lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee mi efɔŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ feemɔ mi ejurɔ nɛɛ, yɛ kpaŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni okɛ mi ekpãŋ lɛ hewɔ. Kɛji miyeɔ fɔ lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ gbee mi; ejaakɛ mɛɛ hewɔ ni okɛ mi aaayahã otsɛ?"
Yonatan kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ̃. Kɛji efo mitoi naa kɛkɛ po akɛ mitsɛ etswa fai shi akɛ ebaafee bo efɔŋ lɛ, ani mikɛŋ bo?"
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, "Kɛji aleee nɔ ni otsɛ aaaŋmɛ bo naa sha lɛ, namɔ po aaahã male?"
Yonatan to he akɛ, "Ba ni wɔtee ŋa lɛ nɔ." No hewɔ lɛ amɛyi mli, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ, amɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ.

Be ni amɛyashɛ jɛi lɛ, Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaaye mi odase. Kɛji mita mutsɛ yitso he mikwɛ, ni mina akɛ eyɛ ohe tsuijurɔ lɛ matsu oŋɔɔ wo, loo wɔsɛɛ, nɛkɛ be mli pɛpɛɛpɛ, koni abawo otoi nɔ.
Shi kɛji mitsɛ eto eyiŋ doo akɛ efɔŋ nɔŋŋ ebafee bo, ni mihãaa ole koni ojo foi oya shweshweeshwe lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa awo mi he nyɔŋmɔ kɛteke nɔ. Yehowa kɛ bo ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ mitsɛ ehi shi lɛ.
Wɔsɛɛ ko kɛji miyɛ wala mli lolo lɛ, omli ahi ahã mi yɛ Yehowa suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ lɛ naa, ni kɛji migbo lɛ,
ohiɛ akpakpa nɔ koni ofee mishwiei ejurɔ kɛya naanɔ. Be ni Yehowa aaakpãtã ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
David we lɛ hiɛ akpakpa Yonatan nɔ. Yehowa aaatɔ David he owele yɛ David henyɛlɔi anɔ."
Yonatan hã David saa kã lɛ kitã ekoŋŋ akɛ ehiɛ akpakpa amɛteŋ suɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Yonatan sumɔɔ David tamɔ bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ Diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ nyɔŋ hee baaje, ni aaabi oshi, ejaakɛ osɛ̃i lɛ nɔ baakã eflo.
Ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ ebaakɔ sɛɛ fe nine akɛ obɛ. Nakai gbi lɛ yɛ yaa ni oyatee ohe yɛ tɛi ni bua shi yɛ jɛi lɛ ahe he ni oyatee ohe yɛ be ni sane nɛɛ tsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ.
Mibatsɛ̃rɛ gãii etɛ̃ mawo tɛi lɛ amasɛi gbɛ oookɛɛ mitsɛ̃ nɔ ko pɔtɛɛ ko gãi.

Kɛkɛ lɛ mibatsu oblanyo fioo ko, ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Yaatao gãii lɛ kɛba.' Kɛji mikɛshi sɛɛ fee sɛɛ akɛ, 'Okwɛɛɛɛ, gãi lɛ yɛ obiɛgbɛ moŋ, klɔmɔ kɛba lɛ,' no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ oba, ejaakɛ mina Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ sane fɔŋ ko yeŋ bo, ni obaafee shweshweeshwe.
Shi kɛji mikɛɛ oblanyo lɛ akɛ, 'Okwɛɛɛ? Gãii lɛ etekw bo' lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ojo foi ni oya, ejaakɛ Yehowa ejie bo gbɛ.
Yehowa ji mi kɛ bo teŋ odase yɛ shii ni wɔwoowoo wɔhe nɛɛ he kɛmiiya naanɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ David yatee ehe yɛ ŋa lɛ mli. Be ni nyɔŋ hee lɛ je lɛ Maŋtsɛ Saul ba niyenii lɛ ashi.
eta esɛ̃i ni maa gbogbo lɛ he lɛ nɔ, nɔ nɔ ni etaa da lɛ, ni Yonatan ta ehiɛ tuuŋtu, ni Abnar ta Saul masɛi. David tamɔhe lɛ kã eflo;
Shi Saul ekɛɛɛ nɔ ko nakai gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ esusumɔ ji, "Sane ko eba David nɔ, ni etsuuko ehe, ni no hewɔ lɛ ehe tseee."
Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ, ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ, be ni David tamɔhe lɛ kã eflo ekoŋŋ lɛ, Saul bi Yonatan akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ Yeshai bi lɛ bako niyeli nyɛ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ?"
Yonatan here Sauil nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "David bi mi gbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ koni eya Betlehem ni eba.

Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Ofai nɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya maba, ejaakɛ wɔweku lɛ mishã afɔle yɛ maŋ lɛ moi, ni minyɛminuu lɛ eshɛ mi akɛ miba. No hewɔ lɛ kɛji oosumɔ misane lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ hã maya ni mayasra minyɛminuu lɛ maba.' Enɛ hewɔ ni ebako maŋtsɛ okplɔ̃ŋmɛɛ lɛ shishi nɛɛ."
Saul mli fu Yonatan naakpa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Gbee yoo yakagbɔmɔ fɔŋ kɛ atuatselɔ bi ni tamɔ bo! Okɛ Yeshai bi lɛ miibɔ, ni okɛmiiwo bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ onyɛ fɛɛ hiɛ mama nɔ yɛ maŋ.
Naa, gbii abɔ ni Yeshai bi nɛɛ hiɛ kã lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ ni jio, omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni jio, eko fɛɛ eko yi etɔ̃. No hewɔ lɛ tsu koni ayaŋɔ lɛ abahã mi ejaakɛ ja egbo."
Yonatan here etsɛ Saul nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ sa akɛ egbo? Mɛni efee?"
Shi kometoo lɛ Saul fɔ̃ ekplɔ lɛ, ni kulɛ ekɛmiitsu Yonatan koni egbe lɛ. Enɛ Yonatan kɛna akɛ etsɛ eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ ebaagbe David.

Yonatan te shi kɛ mlifu ni naa wa kɛshi okplɔ̃ lɛ shi; ni nakai gbi lɛ, ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yonatan yeee mli lɛ eko, ejaakɛ David sane miidɔ lɛ tsɔ̃, ni asaŋ akɛ etsɛ Saul ewo lɛ Yonatan lɛ hiɛgble nɛkɛ.
Gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Yonatan tee ŋa lɛ nɔ bɔ ni ato lɛ, ni ekɛ oblanyo fioo ko nyiɛ.
Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo fioo lɛ akɛ, sha foi koni oyatao gãii ni matsɛ̃rɛ̃ lɛ kɛba." Be mli ni oblanyo lɛ hiɛ foi kɛyaa lɛ Yonatan tsɛ̃ gãi kroko kɛteke lɛ.
Ni be ni oblanyo lɛ yashɛ he ni gãi lɛ yagbee lɛ, Yonatan bo ni ekɛɛ oblanyo lɛ akɛ, "Okwɛɛɛ? Gãi lɛ eteke bo!
Feemɔ mramra, ohe afee oya, kaadamɔ shi!" Oblanyo lɛ yaklɔ gãii lɛ kɛba enuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Anɔkwa, oblanyo lɛ leee nɔ ni afee lɛ shishi kwraa. Yonatan kɛ David kɛkɛ ni le.
Yonatan kɛ enibii lɛ hã oblanyo lɛ. ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Baaho, ni okɛya maŋ lɛŋ."

Oblanyo lɛ tee nɔŋŋ pɛ kɛkɛ ni David fã kpo kɛjɛ tɛi ni bua shi lɛ ahe, ni ekɛ ehiɛ babu shi ni ekoto Yonatan shii etɛ̃. Be ni David kɛ Yonatan eshwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa sɛɛ lɛ, amɛwo yara amɛfo aahuu kɛyashi David nɔ teke nɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Anyɛmi, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔkamɔ wɔhe kitã yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli akɛ, 'Yehowa aye abua mi kɛ bo, kɛ mishwiei kɛ bo hu oshwiei kɛna naanɔ' lɛ, yaaba jogbaŋŋ." Kɛkɛ ni David tsɔ̃ ehe ni etee, ni Yonatan hu ku esɛɛ etee maŋ lɛ mli.
21: David ba Osɔfo Ahimelek ŋɔɔ yɛ Nob maŋ lɛ mli. Ahimelek kɛ hekpokpomɔ bakpee David ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni okome too onyiɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko fataaa ohe lɛ?"

David kɛɛ Osɔfo Ahimelek akɛ, "Minyɛ maŋtsɛ tsumɔ ko nɔ. Ebɔ mi kɔkɔ akɛ, 'Kaahã mɔ ko mɔ ko miile nɔ tsumɔ ni mitsumɔ bo nɛɛ kɛ kitã hu ni miwo bo yɛ he lɛ.' Oblahii ni mikɛyaa lɛ, mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ he ko ni amɛ kɛ mi akpe yɛ.
Mɛni oyɔɔ yɛ onine nɔ? Hã mi aboloo akwaabɔi enumɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooona koni mikɛhiɛ midɛŋ."
Osɔfo Ahimelek here David nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mibɛ aboloo ko kwraa yɛ biɛ fe abolooo krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Kɛji oblahii lɛ eko etako yoo he lɛ no lɛ sane ko bɛ he."

David to he ehã osɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mli lɛ wɔtako yoo he tamɔ bo ni kɛji wɔnyiɛ tsumɔ flo po nɔ ni wɔtaaa yoo he lɛ. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni kɛji oblahii lɛ nyiɛ ŋmɛnɛ tsumɔ wulu ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛhiɛŋ amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?"

Kɛkɛ ni osɔfo lɛ kɛ aboloo krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hã David, ejaakɛ aboloo ko aboloo ko bɛ enine nɔ akɛ ja aboloo ni amɛmãa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, nɔ ji kɛji ajie yɛ jɛi lɛ ja akɛ aboloo kla to emomo lɛ najiaŋ nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ.
Gbi nɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ Saul tookwɛlɔ nukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Doeg, Edomnyo lɛ, yɛ jɛi ni atsi enaa yɛ sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
David kɛɛ Osɔfo Ahimelek akɛ, "Obɛ klaŋte loo akplɔ ko yɛ onine nɔ? Maŋtsɛ tsumɔ lɛ yafee kplakpla, ni no hewɔ lɛ miklaŋte lɛ jio, mikplɔ lɛ jio, mikɔɔɔ ekoeko mihiɛɛɛ midɛŋ kɛbaaa."

Osɔfo Ahimelek jie naa ekɛɛ, "Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ ni ogbe yɛ Ela Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ klaŋte lɛ yɛ biɛ. Ekã tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ sɛɛ ni abla he. Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɔ, ejaakɛ no sɛɛ lɛ klaŋte kroko ko bɛ biɛ dɔŋŋ." Ni David to he ekɛɛ akɛ, "Enɔ bɛ po; kɔ ohã mi."
David shi Nob lɛ mli nakai gbi lɛ; eejo Saul naa foi; ni etee Gat Maŋtsɛ Akish ŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Akish tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ, jeee David lɛ ni etsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ?" Jeee mɔ nɛ he lala alaa akɛjoɔ akɛ, "Saul egbe akpei, ni David egbe akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ lɛ?"
Wiemɔ nɛɛ hã David hɛle shi, ni ebɔ̃i Gat Maŋtsɛ Akish gbeyeishemɔ naakpa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ David tsake enifeemɔ yɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ. Ekwa eye sɛkɛ, ni efee enii oookɛɛ sɛkɛyelɔ kɛji ehiɛ amli. Eŋmli nii yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ nɔ, ni ehã lajɔ̃ tete wu etsɛ̃ŋ mli kpɔtɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Akish bi etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ, gbɔmɔ ni nyɛna akɛ eye sɛkɛ lɛ mɛni nyɛkɛ lɛ baa abahã mi afee?
Sɛkɛyelɔi ahe miihia mi hewɔ ni nyɛyakpla mɔnɛ nɛɛ kɛba koni ebafee sɛkɛyelɔi anii etsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ? Aso esa kwraa akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛkɛ hiɔ miwe nɛɛ mli tete?"
22: David shi Gat maŋ lɛ mli, ni ejo foi kɛtee eyahi Adulam tɛkplo lɛ mli. Be ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ na lelɛ, amɛtee eŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi,

Kɛkɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni aawa amɛ yi, kɛ mɛi hu i hiɛhiɛ nyɔji, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ hu ni bɛ shihilɛ he miishɛ lɛ bua amɛhe naa ni amɛafata David he. Kɛkɛ ni David batsɔ̃ amɛsafoiatsɛ. Hii aaafee ohai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ ni bafata David he nɛɛ.

David shi Adulam tɛkplo lɛ mli ni etee Mizpa yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyakɛɛ Moab Maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, hã mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ afã kɛba ni amɛbahi nyɛŋɔɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni male bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaato mi ahã."
No hewɔ lɛ David shi efɔlɔi lɛ ehã Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni efɔlɔi lɛ hi Moab Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni David yɔɔ tɛkplo lɛ mli lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ gbalɔ lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gad lɛ ba, ni ebakɛɛ David akɛ, "Kaahi tɛkplo nɛɛ mli dɔŋŋ. Shi biɛ ni oya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ," No hewɔ lɛ David shi tɛkplo lɛ mli ni etee eyahi Heret koo lɛ mli.
Gbi nɛɛ Saul yɛ Gibea, ni eta shi yɛ tso ko, ni etsɛɔ lɛ akɛ tamariske tso lɛ shishi yɛ gɔŋkpɔ lɛ nɔ; ehiɛ ekplɔ yɛ edɛŋ, ni etsuji lɛ ebɔle ehe kɛkpe.

Kɛkɛ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ ayana he ni David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ etsuji ni damɔ ehe lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmiibo toi, nyɛ Benyamibii! Ani Yeshai bi lɛ baahã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋmɔji kɛ waintromii hu; aloo eeewo nyɛ mɛi akpekpe akui kɛ mɛi ahaohai akui asafoiatsɛmɛi hu,

Hewɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛkpãŋ miyi nɔ lɛ? Te mɔ ko ejeee nyɛteŋ ebawooo mitoi nɔ akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mimusuŋbi lɛ kɛ Yeshai bi lɛ efee ekome? Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nyɛteŋ ni misane dɔɔ lɛ bɔ ni eeewo mi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ?"
Doeg, Edomnyo lɛ, damɔ Saul tsuji lɛ amasɛi. Kɛkɛ ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mina Yeshai bi lɛ yɛ Nob ni eba Osɔfo Ahimelek, Ahitub bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ,
Ni Ahimelek bi Yehowa nii ehã lɛ, ni ehã lɛ gbɛnɔ niyenii, ni esaŋ ekɛ Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ, klaŋte lɛ hu ehã lɛ."
Enɛ hã Saul tsu koni ayakpee Ahimelek, Ahitub bi lɛ, kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii ni amɛ nɔŋŋ ji osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Nob lɛ fɛɛ abahã lɛ. Be ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ bashɛ Maŋtsɛ Saul hiɛ lɛ,
Saul kɛɛ akɛ, "Oobo toi lo, Ahitub bi?" Ahimelek here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Hɛɛ, minuŋtsɔ!"

Kɛkɛ ni Saul bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni, bo kɛ Yeshai bi lɛ, nyɛkpãŋ miyi nɔ, ni ohã lɛ niyenii, ni asaŋ owo edɛŋ klaŋte, ni obi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ohã lɛ, ni no hewɔ ni ete shi ewo mi, ni ewo mi ka bɔ ni nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ?"

Ahimelek to he ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nɔ ni mile ji akɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko bɛ ni eji ehe anɔkwafo tamɔ David. Maŋtsɛ shaanuu ji lɛ, ni agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ he bulɔi lɛ asafoiatsɛ ji lɛ, ni awoɔ lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.

Jeee ŋmɛnɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbi nɔ ni mini Nyɔŋmɔ nii mihã David. Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ akɛ Maŋtsɛ kɛ sane aaafɔ̃ mi, etsulɔ, loo mitsɛ we lɛ mli mɔ ko kwraa nɔ, ejaakɛ mileee sane nɛɛ he nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa.
Shi Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Ahimelek, ja agbe bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã ehebulɔi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe ni nyɛgbea Yehowa osɔfoi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛwa David eko. Amɛna amɛle akɛ David miijo foi, shi amɛbaawooo mitoi nɔ shi maŋtsɛ lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛawo amɛnine nɔ amɛtswia osɔfo lɛ nii."

No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Saul fã Doeg ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Gbee osɔfoi nɛɛ!" Ni lɛɛlɛŋ, Goeg, Edomnyo lɛ, tsɔ̃ ehe ni edɔ klaŋte eto osɔfoi lɛ anɔ; ni nakai gbi lɛ egbe osɔfoi ni ji mɛi ni woɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ Nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enumɔ sɔŋŋ.
Saul hã akɛ klaŋte kpãtã Nob maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; agbe hii kɛ yei kɛ gbɛkɛbii kɛ abifabii kɛ tsinai kɛ teji kɛ toi fɛɛ.
Shi Ahitub ni Ahimelek bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abiatar lɛ he je mli, ni ejo foi etee David ŋɔɔ,
ni eyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ Saul egbe Yehowa osɔfoi lɛ.
David kɛɛ Abiatar akɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ beebe, be ni mina Doeg, Edomnyo lɛ, yɛ Nob lɛ pɛ ni mina akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ lɛ ebaaya ayakɛɛ Saul. mi ejɛ ni otsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ egboi nɛɛ.
Okɛ mi ahi shi; ni okashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɔ ni taoɔ mi egbe lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ etaoɔ bo hu egbe nɛɛ; ahi kɛji oye mimasɛi lɛ oyɛ shweshweeshwe."
23: Abagba David akɛ Filistibii lɛ eyatua Keila maŋ lɛ, ni amɛmiiha ŋmaa ni yɔɔ ŋmashaahei lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ David bi Yehowa nii akɛ, "Ani miya ni miyatua Filistibii lɛ kɛhere Keila lo?" Yehowa here David nɔ ekɛɛ, "Yaa ni oyatua Filistibii lɛ ni ohere Keila."
Shi David webii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ po lɛ, wɔmiishe gbeyei, aahuu ni wɔtee Keila wɔkɛɛ wɔkɛ Filistibii atai lɛ yaawu."
Enɛ hã David ku sɛɛ ni ebi Yehowa nii ekoŋŋ. Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa Keila lɛ, shi mibahã oye Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim."
No hewɔ lɛ David kɛ ewebii lɛ fã kɛtee Keila ni amɛkɛ Filisitibii lɛ yawu, ni amɛgbe Filistibii lɛ akooloi kɛtee. Bɔ ni fee ni David here Keilabii ayiwala nɛ.
Be mli ni Ahimelek bi Abiatar jo foi kɛtee David ŋɔɔ yɛ Keila lɛ ahiɛ efod lɛ kɛtee.
Be ni ayagba Saul akɛ David yɛ Keila lɛ, nɔ ni Saul kɛɛ ji akɛ "Nyɔŋmɔ ejie David ewo midɛŋ, ejaakɛ akɛni eyabote maŋ ni agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi tra naa mli nɛɛ lɛ, esa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yi."
Ni Saul tsɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ kɛkpe koni amɛfã ta kɛya Keila ni amɛyasa David kɛ ewebii lɛa yi.
Be ni David na le akɛ Saul miito ehe yiŋ fɔŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ Osɔfo Abiatar akɛ, "Kɔ efod lɛ kɛba."
Be ni Abiatar kɛ efod lɛ ba lɛ, David bi Yehowa nii ekɛɛ, "Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, otsulɔ enu akɛ Saul miitao aba Keila koni ebãkpãatã maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ mi mihewɔ.
Ani Keilabii baajie mi awo edɛŋ lo? Ani saul baana ava lɛɛlɛŋ? Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, otsulɔ miikpa bo fai koni ohã male enɛ."
Ni David bi ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Ani Keilabii lɛ aaajie mi kɛ miwebii lɛ amɛwo Saul dɛŋ lo?" Yehowa here nɔ akɛ, "Amɛbaajie nyɛ amɛhã Saul"
Ni fee nakai lɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii aaaafee mɛi ohai ekpaa lɛ ye amɛhe oyai ni amɛshi Keila. Amɛyiŋ amɛtee he fɛɛ he ni amɛna. Ayagba saul akɛ David ejo foi yɛ Keila, ni no hewɔ lɛ Saul efãaa ta lɛ.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ David yabɔ ehe agwaa yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ tɛkploi lɛ amli yɛ Zif ŋa lɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ. Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ Saul miitao David, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa enine eshɛ David nɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ David she gbeyei ejaakɛ ena akɛ Saul eba ebaatao lɛ koni egbe lɛ. David yɛ Zif ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Horesh niiaŋ,
ni Saul bi Yonatan tiu lɛ kɛtee jɛi, ni eyawo David hewalɛ koni ekɛ ehiɛ afɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.
Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mitsɛ Saul nine shɛŋ onɔ. Elɛ enɛ faŋŋ akɛ bo obaaye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni mi matsɔ̃ osɛɛmɔ."
David kɛ Yonatan kamɔ amɛhe kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi mli, ni no sɛɛ lɛ Yonatan hu esɛɛ etee shīa; shi David tee nɔ ehi Horesh.
Kɛkɛ ni Zif hii komɛi yakɛɛ Saul yɛ Gibea akɛ, "Naa, David ebatee yɛ wɔŋɔɔ yɛ Horesh tɛkploi lɛ amli yɛ Hakila Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yuda shiaŋa lɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Ni Maŋtsɛ, wɔle akɛ otsui miishwe tsɔ̃ koni onine ashɛ enɔ. No hewɔ lɛ ba, ni wɔbaajɔ lɛ wɔha bo."
Saul kɛɛ Zif hii nɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛnu he nyɛhã mi.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa, ni nyɛyatoa nyɛlea hɛi pɔtɛɛ ni eshwɛɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ hu ni ena lɛ yɛ jɛi kɛ ehiŋmɛitsei enyɔ, ejaakɛ ahã mile akɛ ele ŋaa naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyataoa hei pɔtɛɛ ni eteɔteɔ ehe yɛ lɛ, ni nyɛbaa nyɛnakɛa mi; ni mikɛ nyɛ baaya. Anɔkwa, kɛji David yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ no lɛ matao lɛ fitsofitso kɛkpa Yuda muu fɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ Zif hii lɛ shi Saul, ni amɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee Zif. Nakai be mli lɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ yɛ Moan shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ jɔɔ ko ni ye Yuda shiaŋa lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ mli.

Be bi Saul kɛ ewebii lɛ yiŋ amɛtee koni amɛyatao David lɛ, abatswa David adafi, ni no hewɔ lɛ David shi jɔɔ lɛ mli kɛtee Moan tɛsaa lɛ mli yɛ ŋ alɛ nɔ. Saul na ele enɛ, kɛkɛ ni etui David kɛtee Moan shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Saul kɛ ewebii lɛ nyiɛ gɔŋ lɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ, David kɛ ewebii lɛ hu nyɛ gɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, ni David he miitswa shi koni eshi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ fiofio lɛ Saul kɛ ewebii lɛ mibɛŋkɛ amɛ koni amɛbamɔmɔ amɛ.
Shi bɔfo ko ba trukaa ebakɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Akɛɛ oye he oyai ni oba, shi Filistibii lɛ batua shikpɔŋ lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Saul je David sɛɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ekɛ Filistibii lɛ yawu. Sane nɛɛ hã awo nakai kpɔ lɛ mli gbɛi akɛ, "Foijee Tɛsaa."
Kɛkɛ ni David shi Maon, ni etee eyahi En-Gedi tɛkploi lɛ amli.
24: Be ni Saul kɛ Filistibii lɛ eyawu ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, abatswa lɛ adafi akɛ, "Naa, David yɛ En-Gedi Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Saul hala Israel tabilɔi fɛɛ amli hii akpei etɛ̃, ni ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee koni eyatao David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ yɛ Duji Atɛsai lɛ nɔ.
Amɛyashɛ tɛkplo ko he yɛ toi atsui komɛi ahe yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni Saul tee niiaŋ yɛ tɛkplo nɛɛ mli. Asomoaŋ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ eyatee yɛ tɛkplo kome too nɛɛ nɔŋŋ sɛɛgbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni David webii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Shi ni Yehowa wo bo akɛ, 'Majie ohenyɛlɔ lɛ mawo odɛŋ koni ofee lɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ' lɛ no eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ." Kɛkɛ ni David te shi, ni etee ni eyafo Saul atade lɛ naabu nigii.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ David henilee bɔi lɛ haomɔ yɛ Saul atade lɛ naabu ni eyafo lɛ hewɔ.

Enɛ hã David kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa akahã enɛ miigbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ akɛ mawo minine nɔ yɛ minuŋtsɔ, mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ, nɔ. Esaaa akɛ minine saa ahe ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ewo lɛ maŋtsɛ ni."
David kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ jɔɔ ewebii lɛ ahe, ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛtutua Saul. Saul te shi eshi tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni egbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ David hu je kpo yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni eyabo Saul yesɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, Nii Maŋtsɛ!" Be ni Saul fo ehe ni ekwɛ esɛɛ lɛ, David kɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni ekoto Saul,
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni oboɔ mɛi anaa toi akɛ mi David, miitao bo efɔŋ lɛ?

Be ŋmɛnɛ ona akɛ ohiŋmɛi tsei enyɔ bɔ ni Yehowa jie bo wɔ midɛŋ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli? Mɛi kɛɛ mi akɛ migbe bo; shi mikɛ ohe ke bo. Nɔ moŋ ni mikɛɛ ji akɛ, 'Mikɛ minine esaŋ minuŋtsɔ he ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu ni.'

Mitsɛ Ataa, Okwɛɛɛ? Otade lɛ naabu ko ni mifo lɛ mihiɛ nɛɛ. Akɛ mifo otade lɛ naabu, ni mitswaaa bo nɔ migbeee bo lɛ, no aaatsɔ̃ɔ bo koni ona ole akɛ mibɛ ohe yiŋtoo fɔŋ ko. Mifeko bo esha ko, shi kɛ̃lɛ bo lɛ gbɔbimɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ogbɔbiɔ mi koni ogbe mi.
Mikɛ misane lɛ fɛɛ ahã Yehowa koni eye ehã mi; ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaatɔ mihe owele yɛ onɔ; shi mi ni ji mi lɛ, mikɛ minine esaŋ ohe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Onukpai buɔ abɛ akɛ, 'Ofɔi yitsoŋ kpaaa la' No hewɔ lɛ, mi lɛ minine esaŋ ohe.
Ni namɔ sɛɛ po Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efã kɛnyiɛ nɛɛ? Namɔ po otuiɔ nɛɛ? Gbee gbonyo ni; oflikiti ni!
Yehowa aaaye misane lɛ ehã mi, ni eeekojo mi kɛ bo teŋ, ni eejie mi yɛ odɛŋ?"
Be ni David kɛ Saul wie nɛkɛ egbe naa lɛ, Saul bi lɛ akɛ, "Bo nɔŋŋ ogbee minuɔ nɛɛ, mibi David? Kɛkɛ ni Saul jwa yaafo,
ni ekɛɛ David akɛ, "Oja fe mi, ejaakɛ be mli ni ofeɔ mi ekpakpa lɛ belɛ mi lɛ miifee bo efɔŋ moŋ kɛmiito bo najiaŋ.
Otsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ ŋmɛnɛ akɛ ekpakpa otaoɔ mi, akɛni Yehowa tu mi wo odɛŋ shi ogbeee mi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ namɔ hu enine shɛɔ ehenyɛlɔ nɔ ni ekɛ ehe keɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa aaafee bo ejurɔ yɛ nɔ ni ofee ohã mi ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ efee faŋŋ ehã mi akɛ bo kɛ obaaba obaye Israel maŋtsɛ, ni Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baahe shi.
No hewɔ lɛ okɛ Yehowa akã mi kitã akɛ ogbeŋ mishwiei ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ bɔ ni afee ni migbɛi akalaaje."
David kã Saul kitã ni ebi lɛ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Saul yiŋ etee ewe; shi David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee tɛkplo lɛ mli.
25: Samuel gbo, ni Israel fɛɛ ba bafo lɛ, ni afu lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ mli yɛ Rama. Samuel fuu sɛɛ lɛ, David kpleke shi kɛtee Paran shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Nuu ko hi shi yɛ Moan, shi enitsumɔhe yɛ Karmel. Niiatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ; eyɛ too gwaŋteŋi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ abotiai hu akpe, ni eeku etoi lɛ ahe tsɔi be nɛɛ mli yɛ Karmel.
Atsɛɔ nuu Nɛɛ Nabal, ni eŋa gbɛi ji Abigail. Yoo lɛ he yɛ fɛo jogbaŋŋ, ni eyɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu naakpa; shi ewu Nabal lɛ yitsoŋ wa, ni ehiɛ kãaa shi. kaleb shwiei ji Nabal nɛɛ.
David nu yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ Nabal miiku etoi ahetsɔi.
No hewɔ lɛ etsɛ oblahii nyɔŋma, ni etsu amɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyaa Nabal ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel, ni nyɛyaŋaa lɛ nyɛhãa mi;
nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, Miihã lɛ omanye! Omanye abla lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ.
Minu akɛ aba aaku otoi lɛ ahetsɔi. Otookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ wɔbahi shi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔfeee amɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, amɛnɔ ko nɔ ko elaajeee gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ Karmel lɛ.

Bo lɛ bi oblahii lɛ, ni amɛbaagba bo. No hewɔ lɛ, ofai nɛ, kwɛmɔ miblahii lɛ ahiɛ, ejaakɛ wɔba yɛ gbi kpakpa nɔ be ni ooŋmɛ okplɔ̃. Ofai nɛ, ohã otsuji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ɔyɔɔ ye onine nɔ lɛ eko koni okɛmaje obi David. "
Be ni David oblahii lɛ yashɛ, ni amɛkɛ David shɛɛ lɛ hã Nabal ni amɛmɛɔ hetoo lɛ,
Nabal hetoo ni ehã amɛ ji akɛ, "Namɔ ji nakai David lɛ? Namɔ ji Israel lɛ? Tsuji ni ejojoo foi amɛshi amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi efa gbii etɛ nɛɛ.
Ani nyɛmiikɛɛ mi akɛ miboloo kɛ minu kɛ milooo ni migbe, ni mikɛbaahã mɛi ni eba ni amɛkuɔ toi ahetsɔi lɛ, mikɛhã mɛi komɛi hu ni mileee he ni amɛjɛ bɛɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni David oblahii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛtee koni amɛyabɔ David amaniɛ.
Amaniɛ lɛ hã David kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akɔ eklaŋte eŋmɔ." Kɛkɛ eyi mli kɛ esɛɛ hii ohai ejwɛ, be mli ni eshi hii ohai enyɔ yɛ sɛɛ koni amɛbu nibii ni asafo lɛ yɔɔ lɛa he.

Be ni oblahii ni david tsu lɛ eshi Nabal ŋɔɔ amɛtee lɛ, Nabal oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome bɔ Nabal ŋa Abagail amaniɛ ekɛɛ, "Naa, David tsu bɔfoi kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba wɔnuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ amɛbahã lɛ omanye, shi wɔnuŋtsɔ gri ni eblɔ ewo bɔfoi lɛ.
Anɔkwa, be ni wɔyɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ David webii nɛɛ amli hi hã wɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Gbiiabɔ fɛɛ ni wɔ kɛ amɛ hi shi lɛ, amɛfeee wɔ efɔŋ ko lɛ, amɛkɔɔɔ wɔnɔ ko nɔ ko.
Moŋ bei fɛɛ ni wɔ kɛa mɛ yɔɔ ni wɔlɛɔ toi lɛ, amɛbu wɔhe shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ ofai nɛ, ni osusu sane nɛɛ he, no okwɛ bɔ ni obaafee, ejaakɛ ashwã wɔnuŋtsɔ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ ayinɔ. Tamɔ bɔ ni ole lɛ, wɔnuŋtsɔ feɔ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ bɔ ni ehiii lɛ sane kɛɛmɔ."

Abigail he fee oya, ni eklɔ aboloo akwaabɔi ohai enyɔ, ni ekɛfata wail wolo tɔi enyɔ, kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋi enumɔ ni asaa momo, kɛ mamu okpolui enumɔ, kɛ wain yibii ni aka ni egbi shabii oha, kɛ agbami ni ablɔ lɛ akwaabɔi ohai enyɔ ahe, ni afi fɛɛ jatsu ni ekɛtre tejii,
ni asaŋ ewo eblahii komɛi agbɛ kɛ jatsu lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛtsɔa mihiɛ nyɛkitea; minyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ nɔŋŋ." Shi etsiii tã ekɛɛɛ ewu Nabal.
Abigail ta teji nɔ kɛmiiya, ni be ni elɔgɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɔŋtɔ̃ ko nɔŋŋ pɛ, naa David kɛ ewebii lɛ hu ni miiba. Kɛkɛ ni Abigail kɛ amɛ yakpe.
Nakai be mli lɛ David ekɛɛ momo sa akɛ, "Yakatswaa po mibaa nibii ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yi mihã lɛ, ni amɛmli ekoeko elajeee lɛ. Ekpakpa ni mifee lɛ lɛ, mishidaa ji enɛ?
Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi kɛji wɔ be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ mishi ewebii lɛ ateŋ nuu kome nɛkɛ hiɛkãalɔ yɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ."
Be ni Abigail na David lɛ ehe fee oya ni eje eteji lɛ nɔ eyi shi, ni eyabu shi yɛ David hiɛ ni ekoto lɛ.
Abigail ho gbee David naji anaa ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

Ofai nɛ, minuŋtsɔ, kaadi nɛkɛ nuu kwashia Nabal nɛɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ eetsu egbɛi lɛ he nii. Gbɛi ni awo lɛ ji Nabal, ni lɛɛlɛŋ kwashiai asane pɛ eyeɔ. Anɔkwale mli lɛ, mi lɛ, oblahii lɛ ni minuŋtsɔ tsu lɛ, minaaa amɛ kwraa.

Minuŋtsɔ, mina Yehowa kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ hu akɛ beiaŋ ni Yehowa etsi onaa koni okaye lá ko yi sɔ̃, asaŋ no okɛ onine akatɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe owele lɛ, ohenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ bo efɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ kwashia tamɔ Nabal.
Agbɛnɛ, minuŋtsɔ, naa nikeenii ni otsulɔ yoo kɛba koni okɛhã oblahii ni nyiɛ osɛɛ lɛ.

Ofai nɛ, okɛ tɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni mitɔ̃ lɛ afa mi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ Yehowa baahã owe aye ejurɔ, ni ehe shi, ejaakɛ minuŋtsɔ miiwu Yehowa tai lɛ ehã lɛ, ni akana nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko yɛ ogbɛfaŋ owala be fɛɛ.

Kɛji gbɔmɔ adesa ko aaata shi awo bo, ni enyiɛ osɛɛ akɛ bo nɔŋŋ etaoɔ egbe lɛ, no lɛ, Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaafi mi-nuŋtsɔ wala afata mɛi ni yɔɔ wala lɛ ahe ato Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Shi ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, Yehowa aaasherɛ amɛ ashwie shwiaa tamɔ afɔ̃ɔ akromia mli tɛ.
Kɛji be lɛ shɛ, ni Yehowa fee nibii juji lɛ fɛɛ ni ewo amɛhe shi eto lɛ ehã minuŋtsɔ, ni ewo bo Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ,
efeŋ minuŋtsɔ dɔlɛ, ni ojwɛŋmɔ hu gbaŋ onaa akɛ oshwie lá shi yakatswaa aloo akɛ minuŋtsɔ tɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe owele. Kɛji Yehowa na fee bo ejurɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ofai nɛ, ohiɛ akpakpa oweyoo nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni David here Abigail nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ mɔ ni tsu bo koni okɛ mi abakpe ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ yi;
Nyɔŋmɔ yiwala dɔŋŋ yɛ oshiɛshikamɔ nɛɛ hewɔ; ni bɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu oyiwala dɔŋŋ akɛ otsi minaa ŋmɛnɛ koni mikaye lá ko yi sɔ̃, ni asaŋ mikatɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe owele.
Anɔkwa, mina Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tsi minaa ni mifeko bo efɔŋ ko nɛɛ, akɛ eji ohe efeee oya koni okɛ mi abakpe kulɛ wɔ be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ eshwɛŋ nuu kome nɛkɛ hiɛkãalɔ ahaŋ Nabai!"
Kɛkɛ ni David mɔ nikeenii ni Abigail kɛba lɛ mli, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ! Kuu osɛɛ ni oya shīa kɛ omanye. Minu nɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ, ni mikplɛ̃ nɔ."
Be ni Abigail ku esɛɛ ni eshɛɔ shīa lɛ Nabal eŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ ewe lɛ mli tamɔ maŋtsɛ. Nabal mii eshɛ ehe fe nine, ni etɔ dã kpɔtɔ. No hewɔ lɛ Abigail ebɔɔɔ lɛ amaniɛ ko kɛyashi je tsɛre nɔ leebi,
be mli ni wain lɛ etserɛ yɛ ehiɛ lɛ. Be ni Nabal ŋa Abigail gba lɛ nibii ni tee nɔ lɛ, Nabal tsui sɔŋŋ ni fã lɛ hã eniji kɛ enaji fɛɛ gboi amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ye ehe.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ aaafee gbii nyɔŋma lɛ Yehowa tswa Nabal nɔ ni egbo.

Be ni David nu akɛ Nabal egbo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ ji akɛ, "Yehowa yiwala dɔŋŋ. Etɔ ahora ni Nabal bɔ mi lɛ he owele ehã mi, ni asaŋ etsī mi, etsulɔ, naa huìkoni mikayafee nɔ fɔŋ. Yehowa ehã Nabal musu ebua eyiteŋ." David tsu fee sɛɛ atee akɛ Abigail yawie koni ekɛ lɛa fee eŋa.
David tsuji lɛ ba Abigail ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "David tsu wɔ oŋɔɔ akɛ wɔbaŋɔ bo wɔhã lɛ akɛ eŋa."
Abigail te shi, ni ekoto tsuji lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛnuŋtsɔ weyoo ji mi, ni mifee kralo tsɔ̃ akɛ mafɔ minuŋtsɔ tsuji anaji ahe."
No sɛɛ lɛ Abigail yaho eta teji nɔ; kɛkɛ ni lɛ kɛ eblayei enumɔ komɛi ni sɔɔmɔ lɛ yɛ yi David tsuji lɛ asɛɛ kɛtee, ni Abigail yatsɔ David ŋa.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ David kɛ Ahinoam, ni jɛ Yezreel lɛ, hu hi shi; ni yei enyɔ nɛɛ ni ji Abigail kɛ Ahinoam, tsɔ̃mɔ David ŋamɛi.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Saul kɛ ebiyoo Mikal, David klɛŋklɛŋ ŋa lɛ, ehã Palti, ni ji Laish ni jɛ Galim lɛ binuu, gblã.
26: Zifbii komɛi ba Saul ŋɔɔ yɛ Gibea amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa David ebatee ehe yɛ Hakila Gɔŋkpɔ ni yɔɔ Yuda ŋa kplanaa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Saul hala Israel hii akpei etɛ̃, ni ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee Zif ŋa lɛ nɔ koni eyatao David.
Saul yato shi yɛ Hakila gɔŋkpɔ ni yɔɔ gbɛ ni kã Yuda ŋa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ he lɛ nɔ. Shi David tee nɔ ehi shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Be ni enu yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ Saul enyiɛ kɛba shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ,
etsu mɛi kɛtee amɛyasra amɛkwɛ, akɛ Saul eba shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛɛlɛŋ lo.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ David diɛŋtsɛ tee Saul shitoohe lɛ, ni eyana he pɔtɛɛ ni Saul kɛ etatsɛ Abnar, Nerbi lɛ, kãmɔ Saul kã shi ewɔ, ni ewebii tabilɔi ebɔle ehe kɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni David bi Ahimelek, Hitnyo lɛ, kɛ Zeruia bi Abishai, Yoab nyɛminuu lɛ, akɛ, "Nyɛteɛ namɔ kɛ mi aaatee Saul shitoohe lɛ mli?" Abishai here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mi kɛ bo aaatee!"

No hewɔ lɛ, David kɛ Abishai tee Saul tabilɔi lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli. Amɛnyanina Saul ni ekã ewebii lɛa teŋ ewɔ, ni ekplɔ lɛ tsɛkɛ shi yɛ eyitsogbɛ, ni Abnar kɛ tabilɔi lɛ kãmɔ ehewɔ kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Abishai kɛɛ David akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ejie ohenyɛlɔ lɛ ewo odɛŋ ŋmɛnɛ. No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ hã matsu lɛ akplɔ lɛ shi kome kɛmɔ shikpɔŋ nyɔŋlo, mihaŋ etia shii enyɔ."
Shi David kɛɛ Abishai akɛ, "Kaakpãtã ehiɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baawo anine nɔ yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu nɔ ni mɔ lɛ aaaŋɔ ehe aye."
David kɛɛ Abishai ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Mina Yehowa akɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ni aaatswa Saul nɔ, aloo ebe baashɛ ni eeegbo, aloo eeetee ta ni eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Yehowa akpa ashwie akɛ mi mawo minine nɔ yɛ mɔ ni lɛ Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ nɔ. Bo lɛ fãa akplɔ lɛ ni tsɛkɛ shi yɛ eyitsogbɛ lɛ, ni owo nu kɛ kpulu lɛ kɛkɛ ni wɔtee."

Kɛkɛ ni David kɔ akplɔ lɛ ni ewo nu kpulu lɛ yɛ Saul yiteŋgbɛ, ni amɛje jɛi amɛtee. Mɔ ko mɔ ko enaa amɛ lɛ, Mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ hu etsɛ̃ɛɛ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hu leee. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ewɔ ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã wɔ ni tsii enyɔ amɛnɔ.
Be ni David etsɛ mli kɛtee eyadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ yɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, he nin gbɛ shwaŋŋ kã ekɛ Saul teŋ lɛ,
eblɔ etsɛ Saul tabilɔi lɛ kɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ohereee nɔ lo, Abner?" Abner here nɔ akɛ, "Bo namɔ oblɔɔ otsimɔɔ maŋtsɛ toi lɛ?"

David here Abner nɔ akɛ, "Abner, kwɛɛ, jeee mikɛɛ boji hii fɛɛ amli nuu yɛ Israel lɛ? Ye aye tɛŋŋ ni obuu onuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he, ni mɔ ko mɔ jɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ ba ni kulɛ ebaakpãtã onuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ?
Ofeee ni ahi kwraa! Mina Yehowa akɛ nyɛsa gbele, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛbu nyɛnuŋtsɔ, ni ji gbɔmɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu, lɛ he. Agbɛnɛ, kwɛ nɛgbɛ maŋtsɛ akplɔ lɛ kɛ enu kɛ kpulu ni ma eyitsogbɛ lɛ yɔɔ?"
Saul yoo David gbee ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mibi David, bo owieɔ lɛ?" David here nɔ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, mi ni.
