Shi mɛɛba ni minuŋtsɔ nyiɛ etsulɔ sɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ? Mɛni mifee; mɛɛ efɔŋ po mifee?

Taflatsɛ, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ abo nɔ ni etsulɔ yɔɔ kɛɛmɔ toi fioo. Kɛji Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ni etee bo shi ewo mi lɛ, mibashã he afɔle kɛkpa he fai. Shi kɛji gbɔmɛi adesai abii ni ehã ote shi owo mi lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa aaawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛshwie mi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ mikani Yehowa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi mɔŋ miya ni miyasɔmɔ jemawɔji.
Kɛji magbo po lɛ, kaahã migbo yɛ he ko ni jeee Yehowa shikpɔŋ nɔ, ejaakɛ naa Israel maŋtsɛ eba mi oflikiti taomɔ tamɔ agbɔbɔi afi yɛ gɔji anɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Saul here nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mifee efɔŋ! Mibi David, kpalemɔ ni oba. Mifeŋ bo efɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ miwala jra wa hã bo. Miye kwashiai asane lɛɛlɛŋ, ni mitɔ̃ fe nine."
David to he eha Saul akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ, naa okplɔ lɛ. Hã oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome aba ni abaŋɔ.
Yehowa woɔ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ejalɛ kɛ enɔkwayeli naa. Yehowa tu bo ewo midɛŋ ŋmɛnɛ, shi mi mi misumɔɔɔ akɛ miwoɔ minine nɔ yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ nɔ.
Bɔ ni mikɛ ohe ke bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu Yehowa aaabaa miwala yi, ni eeejie mi yɛ nɔnai fɛɛ mli."
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ David akɛ, "Mibi David, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ aaajɔɔ bo. Oootsu nibii wuji, ni oooye fɛɛ mli kunim." Kɛkɛ ni David yiŋ etee, ni Saul hu ku esɛɛ kɛtee ejɛɛhe lɛ.
27: David kɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Mihiɛ nɛkɛ aahuu ni Saul nine aaashɛ minɔ gbi ko. ni eeegbe mi. Nɔ pɛ ni sa mi feemɔ agbɛnɛ ji akɛ majo foi kɛya Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No baahã Saul nijiaŋ aje wui, ni ebaafɔ̃ɔ mi gbɔbimɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni maye mihe."
Enɛ hã David kɛ ewebii hii ohai ekpaa ni fata ehe lɛ shwie nɔ kɛtee Maok bi Akish, Gat maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ.
David kɛ ewebii lɛ kɛ eŋamɛi enyɔ, ni ji Ahinoam, Yezreel yoo lɛ, kɛ Abigail, Karmel yoo lɛ ni ji Nabal okulafo, lɛ.
Be ni Saul na le akɛ David ejo foi kɛtee Gat lɛ, Saul kpa David sɛɛ tiumɔ.
David kɛɛ Akish akɛ, "Kɛji ona mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ hã mi he ko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ maji lɛ eko mli koni mayahi jɛi, ejaakɛ efeee mi akɛ ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ mi kɛ bo fɛɛ aaahi maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli."
Akish damɔ David wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ ni ekɛ Ziklag hã David nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Biɛ tsɔ̃ ni Ziklag maŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi anɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
David hi shi afi kɛ nyɔji ejwɛ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ David kɛ ewebii lɛ fãa, ni amɛyatuaa Geshurbii lɛ kɛ Girzibii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii ejaakɛ amɛ amɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ sa.
David yatuaa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ni egbeɔ hii kɛ yei fɛɛ, ni eloɔ amɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛ tejii kɛ yomai kɛ atadei hu, kɛkɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba Akish ŋɔɔ.
Kɛji Akish bi David akɛ, "Ni namɛi ofɔ̃ nyɛyaye ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?" David kɛɔ Akish akɛ, "Wɔyatua Yerameelbii lɛ awuoyigbɛ lɛ, aloo wɔyatua Kenbii lɛ awuoyigbɛ lɛ."

Kɛji David tee ofɔyeli lɛ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, David shiii mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛkãalɔ koni akabaagba yɛ Gat akɛ, "Nɛkɛ kɛ nɛkɛ ji nɔ ni David David feɔ." Bɔ ni David hi shi nɛ, bei abɔ fɛɛ ni eye yɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Akish he David eye, ni ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, "Bɔ ni ehã sane eje emaŋ Israelbii amɛtsine hewɔ lɛ eeesɔmɔ mi daa."
28: Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ Filistibii lɛ tsɛ ta. Kɛkɛ ni amɛbuabua amɛtai lɛ anaa koni amɛkɛ Israel ayawu. Ni Akish kɛɛ David akɛ, "Na ole akɛ bo kɛ owebii lɛ baashi mitabilɔi lɛ anɔ kɛya ta nɛɛ."
David to he ehã Akish akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, obaana nɔ ni otsulɔ baatsu." Akish kɛɛ David akɛ, "Mo! Mibafee bu mihebulɔ owalabe fɛɛ."
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Samuel egbo, ni Israel fɛɛ efo lɛ, ni afu lɛ yɛ Rama, ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli, ni Saul eshwie mɛi ni feɔ nii kɛ klamɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Filistibii atai lŋ bua amɛhe naa ni amɛfã ta kɛba Shunem ni amɛbato shi yɛ jɛi. Saul bu bua Israel tai lɛ anaaa kɛkpe, ni amɛfã kɛba Gilboa amɛbato shi yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Saul na Filistibii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ eshe gbeyei, ni etsui fã naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ Saul tee eyabi Yehowa nii. Shi yɛ lamɔ mli jio, yɛ Urim lɛ naa jio, yɛ gbalɔi anaa jio, Yehowa efooo Saul daaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul fã etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyeyataoa yoo okɔmfo ko nyɛhãa mi koni maya eŋɔɔ mayabi nii." Etsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yoo okɔmfo ko yɛ Endor."

Kɛkɛ ni Saul baklɔ atadei komɛi kɛkɛ ewo ekɛtsake ehe koni akayoo lɛ, ni ekɛ hii enyɔ komɛi fata ehe, ni eyiŋ etee yoo okɔmfo lɛ ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ. Saul kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Miitao koni ofee nii ohã mi, ni otsɛ mɔ tã ni matsi maha bo lɛ ohã mi."
Yoo lɛ to he akɛ, "Bɛ ole sane ni Maŋtsɛ Saul eye kɛho lɛ fɛɛ, bɔ ni ekpãtã okɔmfoi kɛ klamɔfoi ahiɛ ehã yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ? Mɛɛba ni oba otsɔ̃ɔ mi tsɔne koni ohã agbe mi nɛɛ?"
Shi Saul kã yoo okɔmfo lɛ kitã ekɛɛ, "Mina Yehowa akɛ onaŋ amane ko amane ko yɛ nɔ ni obaatsu ohã mi nɛɛhewɔ."
Be ni yoo okɔmfo lɛ na Samuel susuma lɛ, ebo waa ni ekɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Mɛɛba olaka mi nakai? Maŋtsɛ Saul ji bo."
Saul kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei. Mɛni onaa? " Yoo lɛ jie naa akɛ, "Mina sisa ko ni mifã kpo kɛmijɛ shikpɔŋ kɛmiiba."
Ni Saul bi lɛ akɛ, "Te esu hu?" Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Nuumo ko ni baa lɛ; ewo atade yuu ko." Kɛkɛ ni Saul yoo akɛ Samuel ni, ni no hewɔ lɛ ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto sisa lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bi Saul akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ obagba minaa kɛ tsɛmɔ ni obatsɛ mi nɛɛ?" Saul jie naa ekɛɛ akɛ, "Efi mi naakpa. Filistibii lɛ kɛ mi jwere ta nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hu eje misɛɛ bɔ sɔɔ̃ŋ ni yɛ gbalɔi anaa jio, yɛ lamɔ mli jio, Nyɔŋmɔ efooo midaaŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ. Enɛ hewɔ ni minatsɛ bo nɛɛ koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ ni mifee."
Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Kɛji Yehowa eje osɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, mɛɛba oba obiɔ mi nii?
Yehowa tsɔ̃ minɔ ewo bo shi, ni no he nii etsu lɛ. Eshɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛŋ, ni ekɛhã omaŋnyo David.
Ejaakɛ obooo Yehowa gbee toi; ni emli fu Amalek waa lɛ oyatsuuu he nii ohãaa lɛ. No hewɔ ni Yehowa feɔ bo nɔ ni efeɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Fɛɛ ayakã, Yehowa baahã Filistibii lɛ aye bo kɛ Israel fɛɛ nɔ kunim. Wɔ ni ji wɔ lɛ, bo kɛ obihii baaba abashɛ gbohiiajeŋ he ni miyɔɔ nɛɛ, ni Filistibii lɛ baaye Isreal ta lɛ hu nɔ kunim."
Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Saul flɛo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi egbee shi ejaakɛ gbeyei wulu mɔ lɛ yɛ Samuel naa wiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ. Egbɔjɔ bliboo hu, ejaakɛ eyeko nɔ ko nɔ ko shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Fee sɛɛ be ni yoo okɔmfo lɛ tsi ebɛŋkɛ Saul, ni ena akɛ gbeyei emɔ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Saul akɛ, "Oweyoo bo bo toi bianɛ, ni mikɛ mihe wo oshrã mli, ni mifee nɔ ni obi mi akɛ mifee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ ofai nɛ, agbɛnɛ bo hu oweyoo toi. Mahã bo niyenii fioo ko ni oye bɔ ni afee ni ona hewalɛ okɛnyiɛ ogbɛ lɛ."
Saul ekplɛ̃ɛɛ, ekɛɛ, "Miyeee." Shi Saul tsuji lɛ kɛ yoo okɔmfo lɛ fɛɛ nyɛ Saul nɔ; ni naagbee mli lɛ ebo amɛ toi. No hewɔ lɛ Saul te shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni eho ta saa lɛ nɔ.
Oya nɔŋŋ ni yoo lɛ mɔ etsinabi ko ni ewo fɔ lɛ, ni egbe lɛ; ni ekpɔtɔ mamu ekɛshã mã akpiti aboloo.
Ekɛ niyenii nɛɛ bama Saul kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛye. Niyeli lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Saul kɛ etsuji lɛ yiŋ ni amɛtee nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ.
29: Filistibii lɛ bua amɛtai lɛ anaa yɛ Afek. Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Israelbii lɛ hu ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ nubu ko ni yɔɔ Yazreel lɛ masɛi.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ to hɛko kɛ amɛtabilɔi ohahai kɛ akpekpei lɛ, ana David hu kɛ ewebii lɛ shi Akish tabilɔi lɛ anɔ. Amɛnyiɛ asafoiasafoi lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ.

Enɛ hã Filistibii lɛ atatsɛmɛi lɛ bi akɛ, "Mɛni nɛkɛ Filistibii atatsɛmɛi lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Israel maŋtsɛ Saul tsulɔ David lɛ nɛ; ni afii abɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ mi yɔɔ. Kɛjɛ ni eshi Saul kɛbaje miŋɔɔ aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ minako tɔ̃mɔ ko kwraa yɛ ehe."

Shi Filistibii atatsɛmɛi lɛ amli fu Akish naakpa, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wo lɛ gbɛ, ni ohã eku esɛɛ eya maŋ ni ohã lɛ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ. Wɔnyɛŋ wɔ kɛ lɛ aya ta nɛɛ naa koni akayatsɔ̃ ehe moŋ ewo wɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli. Mɛni osusuɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛ aaakpãtã enuŋtsɔ ni etɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, fe wɔwebii ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ ayitsei?"
Kolɛ jeee nɛkɛ David nɛɛ he lala amɛwoɔ ni ahereɔ nɔ yɛ jooi amli akɛ, "Saul egbe ekpekpei lɛ; shi David egbe akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai lɛ?"

Akish tsɛ David, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mina Yehowa akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo, ejaakɛ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni obaje miŋɔɔ aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, minako nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ ohe. Kulɛ misumɔ akɛ oshi minɔ kɛya ta nɛɛ naa, shi maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi lɛ nyãaa ohe.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ kuu osɛɛ ni oya shīa; ni oya yɛ hejɔlɛ mli hu koni okawo Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ mlifu moŋ."

David kɛɛ Akish akɛ, "Shi mɛni kwraa ji nɔ ni mifee? Mɛni, aleee nɔ, ona yɛ mihe kɛjɛ gbi nɛ mikɛ bo bahi shi aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, hewɔ ni mikɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ akaya, koni mikɛ ohenyɛlɔi yawu lɛ?"
Akish here David nɔ akɛ, "Mi mihiɛ lɛ, mile akɛ ohi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo; shi Filistibii atatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛɛ okashi amɛnɔ kɛtee ta lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛtea shi wɔ leebi maŋkpa, bo kɛ owebii lɛ ni fata ohe kɛba lɛ, koni jeŋ ni aatse pɛ nyɛyia mli kɛkua nuɛsɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ David kɛ Ewebii lɛ te shi leebi mra, ni amɛyiŋ koni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,ni Filistibii atai lɛ hu koni amɛya Yezreel.
30: Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ be ni David kɛ ewebii lɛ bashɛ Ziklag lɛ, amɛnyanina akɛ Amalekbii lɛ ebatua Yuda wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Ziklag hu, ni amɛwo Ziklag mli la amɛshã maŋ lɛ,
ni amɛŋɔ emli yei blulbu kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli, kɛjɛ gbekɛbii anɔ aahuu kɛyashi onukpai anɔ fɛɛ. Amɛgbeee mɔ ko mɔ ko fe akɛ amɛloo amɛ fɛɛ kɛtee be ni amɛshiɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni David kɛ ewebii lɛ shɛɔ shi lɛ ashã maŋ lɛ, ni aŋɔ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei fɛɛ nom kɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ ewebii ni akɛnyiɛ lɛ wo yara, ni amɛfo kɛyashi etɔ amɛ bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛfo dɔŋŋ.
David ŋa mɛi enyɔ lɛ, ni ji Ahonoam, Yezreelyoo lɛ, kɛ Abigail Nabal Karmelnyo lɛ ŋa okulafo lɛ, hu Amalekbii lɛ ŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee.

Sane wulu bakã David ŋɔ, ni ehe jra lɛ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ ewebii lɛ kɛɛ amɛbaatswia lɛ tɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ musuŋ miishã lɛ yɛ ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ ahewɔ. Shi Yehowa, David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, waje David ni ewo lɛ hewalɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Osɔfo Abiatar, ni ji Ahimelek bi lɛ akɛ, "Yaakɔ nɔ ni akɛbiɔ nii lɛ obahã mi." Abiatar kɛ nii lɛ bahã David.
Kɛkɛ ni David bi Yehowa nii ekɛɛ, "Mitiu gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lo?" Yehowa hã hetoo akɛ, "Tiumɔ amɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ obaaya oyanina amɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni onine baashɛ nyɛgbɔmɛi lɛ anɔ shweshweeshwe."
No hewɔ lɛ David kɛ hii ohai ekpaa ni fata ehe lɛ yi gbɛ. Be ni amɛshɛ Besor Faa lɛ naa lɛ, esɛɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni emii akɛ amɛaafo faa lɛ, ashi amɛ yɛ jɛi,
ni David kɛ hii ohai ejwɛ tiu Amalekbii afɔ̃yelɔi lɛ. Eshi hii ohai enyɔ yɛ faa lɛ naa ejaakɛ etɔ amɛ bliboo bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ Besor faa lɛ amɛfo.
Be ni amɛyaa lɛ, David webii lɛ na Egiptnyo oblanyo fioo ko yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ David. Ahã oblanyo nɛɛ niyenii eye, kɛ nu hu ni enu;
ni asaŋ ahã lɛ agbami lɛ wainyibii shabii enyɔ hu. Be ni eye nii nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ oblanyo nɛɛ eye gbii etɛ̃ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko eyako edaaŋ, niyenii jio, nu jio.
Agbɛnɛ David bi oblanyo lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ bi ji bo; ni nɛgbɛ hu ojɛ?" Oblanyo lɛ jie naa akɛ, "Egiptnyo bi ji mi. ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii etɛ̃ ni minuŋtsɔ lɛ shi mi ŋmɛ shi ni etee, ejaakɛ hela bamɔ mi.
Wɔtee wɔyatua shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Keretbii lɛ awuoyigbɛ, ni wɔma Ziklag maŋ lɛ naa la wɔshã."

David bi oblanyo lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mikɛɛ oyatsɔ̃ɔ mi ofɔyelɔi nɛɛ lɛ, obaaya lo?" Oblanyo lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akã mi kitã akɛ ogbeŋ mi, ni asaŋ okpaleŋ mi ohaŋ minuŋtsɔ lɛ, ni mikɛ bo baaya minuŋtsɔ̃ɔ bo ofɔ̃yelɔi lɛ."

Be ni oblanyo lɛ kɛ David tee lɛ ayanina ofɔ̃yelɔi lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã he ni amɛyato shi yɛ lɛ fɛɛ, ni aayeyee nii, ni aanunuu dãi, ni aajojoo yɛ nibii babaoo ni amɛyahahaa yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ lɛ ahewɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni David kɛshwie amɛnɔ, ni egbe amɛ kɛjɛ hulushinyɔɔ mli aahuu kɛyashi enɔ jetsɛremɔ gbɛkɛ mli. Amalekbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko he ejeee gbele mli fe oblahii ohai ejwɛ komɛi ni shra yomai ni amɛtra nɔ kɛjo foi lɛ.
David nine shɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Amalekbii lɛ baloo kɛtee lɛ anɔ, kɛ eŋamɛi enyɔ lɛ hu.
Nibii ni Amalekbii lɛ baloo lɛ ateŋ eko kwraa elaajeee. Nɔbibioo ni jio, nɔ wulu ni jio, binuu ni jioo biyoo ni jio, David nine shɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nɔ kɛba.
Ni David loo toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Amalekbii anine nɔ lɛ, ni akpla kooloi nɛɛ kɛnyiɛ hiɛ belɛ aakpao aakɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛ David ofɔ̃yelinii nɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni David bashɛ hii ohai enyɔ lɛ ni bɔ ni etɔ amɛ bliboo hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ David sɛɛ amɛnyiɛ kɛtiu Amalekbii ofɔ̃yelɔi lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ David hã amɛhi shi yɛ Besor Faa lɛ naa lɛ aŋɔɔ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fã kɛbakpee David kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ. Be ni David bɛŋkɛ amɛ lɛ ehã amɛ "Sɛɛ fɛɛ?"

Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni kɛ David tee lɛ ateŋ yitsoŋwalɔi kɛ yakagbɔmɛi lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛni amɛbɛ mli ni wɔtee lɛ hewɔ lɛ nibii ni wɔyashɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, amɛnɔ be mli fe mɔ oŋa kɛ obii ni obaanyɛ obakpla amɛ kɛya kɛkɛ."
Shi David here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji Yehowa ebu wɔhe, ni ehã wɔye mɛi ni batua wɔ lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ, nyɛkafea nakai yɛ nii Yehowa ehã wɔ lɛ he.
Ni namɔ po aaabu nyɛ bem yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli? Naa, bɔ ni mɔ ni tee ta lɛ baana akɛ agbɛnaa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni bu nibii ahe yɛ sɛɛ hu baana akɛ egbɛnaa. Abaaja mɔ fɛɛ mɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ."
Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ David wiemɔ nɛɛ tsɔ̃ akpɔ kɛ mla ehã Israelbii, ni ekã shi nakai kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

Be ni David bashɛ Ziklag lɛ, etsu akɛ nibii ni eyaye amɛ ofɔ̃ lɛ eko tee ayake Yuda maŋ onukpai fɛɛ ni ji ehe gbɔmɛi kpakpai lɛ kɛ shɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, miyaye ofɔ yɛ Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛbake nyɛ nɛ."
Aja nibii nɛɛ ahã maŋ onukpai ni yɔɔ Betel kɛ Rama yɛ Yuda wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛ Yatir,
Kɛ Aroer kɛ Sifnot kɛ Eshtemoa,
kɛ Rakal yɛ Yerameelbii kɛ Kenbii lɛ hu amaji lɛ amli lɛ.
Ahã onukpai ni yɔɔ Horma kɛ Borashan kɛ Atak,
kɛ Hebron fɛɛ eko fɛɛ ni lɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ enyiɛnyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ.
31: Filistibii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ wu ta, ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ amɛshwie Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Filistibii lɛ nyiɛ Saul kɛ ebihii lɛ asɛɛ waa. Amɛnine shɛ Saul bihii Yonatan kɛ Abinadab kɛ Malkishua nɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Akɛ ta lɛ nina Saul kpaakpa. Henyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ na Saul, ni amɛtsɛ̃ lɛ gãi, ni apila lɛ ablaŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ etawuunii lɛ akɛ, "Gblamɔ oklaŋte lɛ, ni okɛdu mi bɔ ni afee ni foolɔi nɛɛ akaba amɛbagbe mi, ni amɛfee mi niseniianii." Shi oblanyo lɛ emiii nakai feemɔ ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔ lɛ naakpa. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Saul gbla lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eklaŋte lɛ, ni eho egbee nɔ.
Be ni oblanyo lɛ na akɛ Saul egbo lɛ, lɛ hu eho egbee eklaŋte lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ Saul fɛɛ gbo.
Bɔ ni Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ Saul tawuunii lɛ kɛ Saul he gbɔmɛi fɛɛ gboi shi kome yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɛ.

Be ni Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yezreel Jɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni Yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbe lɛ na akɛ, Israelbii lɛ ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni asaŋ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ egboi lɛ, amɛjojoo foi amɛshishii amɛmaji amɛshwie shi, ni Filistibii lɛ baŋɔ maji lɛ amɛhi mli.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Filistibii lɛ ba ta lɛ mli gbohii lɛ ahe ni kplɔmɔ lɛ, naa Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛfo Saul yi, ni amɛkplɔ ehenii yɛ ehe, ni atsu bɔfoi koni amɛyakpa Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpula, ni amɛyashiɛ ta lɛ mli sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ yɛ amɛjemawɔji fɛɛ anaa, kɛ maŋbii hu.
Filistibii lɛ kɛ Saul tawuunii lɛ tee yato jemawɔŋ Astarte we lɛ, ni egbonyo lɛ amɛkɛyatsotsro Bet-Shan maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ he.
Shi be ni Yabeshbii ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ nu bɔ ni Filistibii lɛ efee Saul lɛ,
maŋ lɛ mli hii kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ te shi ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛtee, ni amɛyajie Saul gbonyo lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu agbohii lɛ yɛ Bet-Shan gbogbo lɛ he, ni amɛkɛba Yabesh amɛbashã.
Amɛloo gbohii lɛ awui lɛ, ni amɛfu yɛ tso ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ tamaske tso ni yɔɔ Yabesh lɛ shishi, ni maŋ lɛ hi ŋmaa gbii kpawo.

1: Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!
Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhewɔ, ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛtãtsii yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli.
Ni wɔkaiɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛhiɛ ni kã wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ mli hiɛmiamɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔ-Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ, wɔle halamɔ ni ahala nyɛ lɛ,
akɛ wɔ-Sanekpakpa lɛ baaa nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ wiemɔ mli kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔmimaa babaoo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, no ji bɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ wɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, akɛni nyɛkɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ mɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli lɛ.
Ni no ehã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ nyɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ ni egbɛ eshwã, jeee yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛkɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhe ni nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ejije kɛtee he fɛɛ he, ni ehīaaa wɔ nɔ ko kɛɛmɔ tete.
Ejaakɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbaa wɔhe sane bɔ ni wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ bɔ ni nyɛkpale kɛjɛ amãgãi ahe kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni nyɛbasɔ̃mɔ anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ
ni nyɛkwɛ e-Bi lɛ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, Yesu ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ mlifu ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ
2: Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ni wɔba lɛ efeee yaka.
Wɔna nɔ momo, ni afee wɔ niseniianii hu yɛ Filipi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔna ekãa yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli ni wɔkɛjaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ tsɛbelɛ ate shi ashi wɔ babaoo.
Ejaakɛ wɔwiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee shishiumɔ loo nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ loo kutumpɔo mli ejɛ;
shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebu wɔ akɛ wɔsa akɛ atu Sanekpakpa lɛ awo wɔdɛŋ lɛ, nakai wɔwieɔ, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi moŋ tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa Nyɔŋmɔ ni kaa wɔtsuii kwɛɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔwieko naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko pɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, ni wɔtoko hiɛjoomɔ he lakpa ko hu, Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefonyo,
asaŋ wɔtaooo gbɔmɛi ahiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ loo mɛi krokomɛi aŋɔɔ.
Tsɛ wɔyɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔfeɔ wɔhe agboi yɛ nyɛnɔ, akɛni Kristo bɔfoi ji wɔ lɛ; shi moŋ wɔhe jɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ tamɔ bɔ ni bii anyɛ hiɛɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebii dɔdɔɔdɔ lɛ.
Ni akɛni wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ jogbaŋŋ nɛkɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔna he tsui akɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ kɛkɛ wɔkɛaahã nyɛ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔwala tete, ejaakɛ wɔmiisumɔ nyɛ naakpa.

Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkaiɔ wɔtɔlɛ kɛ wɔdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ, akɛ bɔ ni afee ni wɔkatsɔ̃ jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hewɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔmiitsu nii, ni wɔsaa wɔmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefoi akɛ wɔjeŋ ni wɔba yɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, eja, ni shwamɔ ko bɛ he.
Tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛle akɛ wɔhiɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tamɔ tsɛ hiɛɔ ebii.
Ni wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni wɔshɛjeɔ nyɛmii hu, ni wɔkpaa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ kɛbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli kɛ enumnyam lɛ mli lɛ.

Enɛ hewɔ ni wɔ hu wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ be ni nyɛnine shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ wɔnaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛmɔ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eji hu lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, shi jeee akɛ gbɔmɛi awiemɔ ko. Wiemɔ nɛɛ tsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nyɛmli.

Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi ni yɔɔ Yudea yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, ejaakɛ amanehului ni nyɛna yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ amɛ hu amɛna yɛ Yudafoi lɛ adɛŋ;
amɛgbe Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ gbalɔi lɛ hu, ni amɛwa wɔ yi. Amɛsaaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni amɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeee.
Amɛtsīɔ wɔ gbɛ hu akɛ wɔkawie wɔtsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ ni ahere amɛyiwala. Ni amɛkɛwoɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ obɔ̃ daa, shi mlifu lɛ enina amɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Shi wɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, akɛni wɔkɛ nyɛ mli egbla be kukuoo ko yɛ na ni wɔnaaa wɔhe yɛ heloo mli gbɛfaŋ, shi jeee yɛ wɔmumɔ mli hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ shwee pii tao akɛ wɔna nyɛhiɛ ekoŋŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ wɔtao akɛ wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ, mi Paulo, mitao akɛ maba shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ shi Satan tsī wɔ gbɛ.
Ejaakɛ namɔ ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ loo wɔmishɛɛ loo wɔshwãa akekre yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɛ Yesu Kristo hiɛ, yɛ ebaa be lɛ mli lɛ? Ani jeee nyɛ ni?
Ejaakɛ nyɛ nyɛji wɔnumnyam kɛ wɔmiishɛɛ.
3: No hewɔ lɛ, be ni wɔnyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, wɔkpɛ mli akɛ ashi wɔ kome yɛ Atene,
ni wɔtsu Timoteo ni ji wɔnyɛmi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ. Wɔtsu lɛ ni ebawo nyɛ hewalɛ ni eshɛje nyɛmii yɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ,
koni nɛkɛ amanehului nɛɛ akahã mɔ ko mɔ ko miigbugbãa. Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nɔ ni kã shi hã wɔ nɔŋŋ ji no.
Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto akɛ wɔbaana amanehulu, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ni nyɛle lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ ni mi hu, be ni minyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, mitsu Timoteo ni mikɛle nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, akɛ aleeenɔ kalɔ lɛ ebaka nyɛ, ni ehã wɔdeŋme ni wɔgbo lɛ efee yaka lo.

Shi agbɛnɛ ni Timoteo jɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ba wɔŋɔɔ ni ebagba wɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ he sane kɛ kaimɔ kpakpa ni nyɛkɛkaiɔ wɔ daa lɛ kɛ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ akɛ nyɛaana wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔshweɔ ni wɔna nyɛ lɛ
hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmanehulu kɛ wɔhejramɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã nyɛfi shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔna wala hee.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ shidaa po wɔɔnyɛ wɔkɛda Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛ heewɔ yɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ nyɛhe yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ hewɔ?
Nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔkpaa fai babaoo, koni wɔna nyɛhiɛ ni wɔhã nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ aye emuu.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔ-Tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ aaahã wɔgbɛ aja kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni ehã nyɛteke nɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni ehã nyɛtsui afi shi ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe yɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔ-Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ emɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ abaa be lɛ mli.
4: Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkase yɛ wɔŋɔɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛba nyɛjeŋ ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Nyɛmiifee nakai, shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni wɔmiiwo nyɛ ŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nyɛfee ni ateke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛle kitãi ni wɔwo nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii, no ji, nyɛhetsemɔ akɛ nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ he;
ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa lɛ hiɛmɔ yɛ hetsemɔ kɛ woo mli,
jeee yɛ akɔnɔ hiɛdɔɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni jɛŋmajiaŋbi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ.
Ni mɔ ko akatɔ̃ enyɛmi nɔ ni eye lɛ amim yɛ sane nɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ahe oweletɔlɔ ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto ni wɔye he odase lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛɛɛ wɔ ehãaa nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ, shi moŋ hã hetsemɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, mɔ ni kwaa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔ ko ekwaa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ e-Mumɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hãa nyɛ lɛ.
Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ he lɛ, ehīaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe;
ejaakɛ nyɛfeɔ nakai hu nyɛhãa nyɛmimɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Makedonia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ. Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ nyɛfee kɛteke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ni nyɛkɛfea nyɛ oti akɛ nyɛaahi shi dioo ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akawo mɛi asaji amli ni nyɛkɛ nyɛniji atsu nii, bɔ ni wɔwo nyɛ kitã lɛ,
koni nyɛjeŋba afee mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ fɛo, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko akahīa nyɛ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahe sane, koni nyɛkaye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni bɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Yesu gbo ni ete shi lɛ, belɛ nakai nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ baatsɔ̃ Yesu nɔ aŋɔ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ hu afata ehe kɛba.
Ejaakɛ wɔmiikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ naa akɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni wɔbaashwɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ŋ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baakpleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi yɛ oshebɔɔ mli ni ŋwɛi bɔfonukpa gbee kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tɛtrɛmantrɛ miigbɛɛ, ni gbohii ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ tsutsu baate shi,
no sɛɛ lɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, aaasha wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ atatui amli kɛaatee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpeemɔ yɛ Kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni nakai wɔkɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaayahi shi daa.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ashɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii.
5: Shi anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni kɔɔ gbii lɛ kɛ bei lɛ ahe lɛ, ehe ehīaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbii lɛ baaba tamɔ julɔ baa nyɔɔŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be mli ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔyɛ hejɔlɛ ni wɔyɛ shweshweeshwe!" lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ aaabatua amɛ trukaa, tamɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ tuaa yoo ni hiɛ musu lɛ, ni amɛjeŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbɛ duŋ mli ni Gbi Bi aaabati nyɛ shi tamɔ julɔ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, labii ji nyɛ kɛ shwanebii hu, wɔjeee nyɔɔŋ loo duŋ bii.
Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa wɔwɔa tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhãa wɔshia kpe ni wɔhiɛ akãa shi.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni wɔɔ lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛwɔɔ, ni mɛi ni trɔɔ dãa lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛtrɔɔ.
Shi wɔ lɛ, akɛni shwanebii ji wɔ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔhiɛ akãa shi ni wɔwo hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ dama lɛ ni wɔbumɔ dade fai ni ji yiwalaheremɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etooo wɔ ehãaa mlifu, shi moŋ hã yiwalaheremɔnamɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ,
mɔ ni gbo wɔyi gbele, koni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ jio, wɔwɔ jio, wɔkɛ lɛ ahi shi lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛshɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii, ni mɔ fɛɛ ahã enaanyo nane amɔ shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛteŋ ni amɛyeɔ nyɛnɔ onukpa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni amɛwieɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛbua amɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli, yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ. Nyɛhãa hejɔlɛ ahīa nyɛteŋ.
Ni wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃ɔa hejɔ̃lɔi lɛ, nyɛwoa gbeyelɔi lɛ ekãa; nyɛwaa mɛi ni yɔɔ gbedee lɛ; nyɛtoa nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa ni ahīa koni mɔ ko kɛ efɔŋ akato efɔŋ najiaŋ, shi moŋ daa nɛɛ nyɛnyiɛa ekpakpafeemɔ sɛɛ nyɛhãhãa nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ.
Nyɛnaa miishɛɛ daa,
nyɛsɔlea ni nyɛkafɔa;
nyɛdaa shi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli. Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii yɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ.
Nyɛkagbea Mumɔ lɛ;
nyɛkagbea gbalɛi lɛ ahe guɔ.
Nyɛkaa nii fiaa nyɛkwɛa, ni nɔ ni hi lɛ nyɛmɔa no mli.
Nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ efɔŋ su lɛ he.
Shi hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ atsuu nyɛhe kwraa kɛmɔ shi, ni eto nyɛmumɔ kɛ nyɛsusuma kɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso emuu ni shwamɔ ko akahi he yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa be lɛ mli.
Anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni eeefee hu.
Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu.
Nyɛŋaa nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Miikã nyɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã akɛ nyɛhãa akanea nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛmmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ!
Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!

1: Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ, famɔ naa lɛ,
ŋma yahã Timoteo ni ji ebi krɔŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ. Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔ-Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, dɛŋ ahã o!.
Tamɔ bɔ ni be ni miyaa Makedonia ni mikpa o fai akɛ ohi shi yɛ Efeso, koni obɔ mɛi komɛi akɔkɔ akɛ amɛtatsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ krokomɛi.

Ni asaŋ obɔ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛkadi adesãi kɛ wekukpãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ tsralaa lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi kɛ yaka hiɛklamɔ baa fe akɛ eeewa wɔ ni wɔle Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ he yiŋtoo, ni hemɔkɛyeli sane ni lɛ, nakai fai miikpaa o ekoŋŋ.
Shi ŋaawoo lɛ oti ji suɔmɔ ni jɛ tsui ni mli tse kɛ henilee kpakpa kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni osato ko bɛ mli lɛ mli.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni mɛi komɛi eje sɛɛ, ni amɛkpale kɛtee yaka wiemɔ he.
Amɛmiitao amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi, tsɛ amɛnaaa nii ni amɛkɛɔ lɛ loo nii ni amɛwieɔ kɛ nɔmimaa lɛ shishi.
Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ hi kɛji mɔ ko kɛtsu nii bɔ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ale enɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla lɛ, jeee jalɔ hewɔ awo, shi mɛi ahewɔ ni awo moŋ ji mlatɔ̃lɔi kɛ toigbolɔi, mɛi ni he tseee kɛ hebulelɔ, tsɛgbelɔi kɛ nyɛgbelɔi, gbɔmɔgbelɔi,
ajwamaŋbɔlɔi, hii ni kɛ hii wɔɔ, gbɔmɔ julɔi, amalelɔi, kitamlikulɔi, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ yeee lɛ,
yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ lɛ anumnyam Sanekpakpa ni atu awo midɛŋ lɛ naa.
Miida wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Kristo Yesu ni wo mi hewalɛ lɛ shi, akɛ ebu mi anɔkwafo, ni eŋɔ ni ewo sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli,
mi ni tsutsu lɛ miji musubɔlɔ kɛ mɛi ayiwalɔ kɛ mɛi aniseniianifeelɔ lɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ana mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ mileee ni mifeee, yɛ he ni miheee miyeee hewɔ.
Shi wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dromɔ lɛ fa hã mi aahuu kɛtekee nɔ, ni nɔ ni fata he kɛba ji hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli.
Eji anɔkwa wiemɔ ni sa akɛ amɔ mli kwraa, akɛ Kristo Yesu ba je nɛɛŋ eba eshafeelɔi ayiwalaheremɔ, mɛi ateŋ ni mi miji otu lɛ;
shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛ hewɔ ni ana mi mɔbɔ lɛ, koni mi tsutsu mimli Yesu Kristo ajie etsuishitoo lɛ fɛɛ kpo yɛ, ni akɛto mɛi ni baahe enɔ aye ni amɛna naanɔ wala lɛ okadi.
Shi naanɔi a-Maŋtsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni gbooo, mɔ ni anaaa, mɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, aŋɔ woo kɛ anumnyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anãanɔ. Amen!
Kitã ni miwoɔ o nɛ, mibi Timoteo, yɛ gbalɛi ni agba kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ yɛ ohe lɛ anaa, koni okɛwu ta kpakpa lɛ,
ni ohiɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ henilee kpakpa. Nɔ ni mɛi komɛi shɛrɛ shwie ni amɛyashi shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Himeneo kɛ Aleksandro, mɛi ni mitu miwo Satan dɛŋ, koni atsɔse amɛ ni amɛkawie musubɔɔ wiemɔi dɔŋŋ lɛ.
2: Agbɛnɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni miwoɔ he ŋaa ji akɛ ahiɛ faikpamɔi, sɔlemɔi, mlidaamɔi, shidai amli, ahã gbɔmɛi fɛɛ,
ahã maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, koni wɔhi shi kpoo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ kɛ jeŋba ni hiɛ sɔɔ fɛɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ enɛ hi ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Esuɔmɔɔ akɛ ehere gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwala, koni amɛshɛ anɔkwale lɛ lee mli.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome yɔɔ, kɛ Nyɔmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋdamɔlɔ kome hu ni ji gbɔmɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ,
mɔ ni ŋɔ ehe ehã akɛ kpɔmɔ nɔ ehã mɛi fɛɛ. Enɛ ji odase ni aye yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ;
ni no hewɔ awo mi shiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo (anɔkwale miwieɔ yɛ Kristo mli, mimaleee), jeŋmaji atsɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ miitao akɛ hii asɔle yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛhole niji ni he tse nɔ ni mlifu loo naataamɔ akaba mli.
Nakai nɔŋŋ yei hu, amɛkɛ atade ni sa kɛ hiɛ ni gboɔ nɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ awula amɛhe, jeee kɛ yigbɔɔ loo shika loo adiagbai loo atade ni jra wa,
shi moŋ kɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ni sa yei ni tsɛɔ amɛhe akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔi lɛ.
Yoo afee dioo ni ekɛ heshibaa fɛɛ akase nii.
Shi mihãaa yoo hegbɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nii akoo eye nuu nɔ, shi moŋ efee dioo.
Ejaakɛ Adam tsutsu abɔ, no sɛɛ lɛ Hawa.
Ni jeee Adam alaka lɛ, shi yoo lɛ alaka lɛ, ni ebote nɔtɔ̃mɔ mli.
Shi aaahere eyiwala kɛaatsɔ̃ bifɔmɔ nɔ, kɛji ehi shi kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hetsemɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ.
3: Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ; kɛ mɔ ko miitao nɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ, eetao nitsumɔ kpakpa.
Shi esa akɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ afee mɔ ni anaŋ ehe sane ko atã, mɔ ni le nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ,
jeee daanulɔ, jeee ninekpokpookpotsɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni he jɔ, mɔ ni beee, mɔ ni hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ shika nɔ,
mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ jogbaŋŋ, ni ebii boɔ lɛ toi kɛ woo fɛɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko leee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ yeli lɛ, te eeefee tɛŋŋ ekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ huŋ?
Asaŋ jeee mɔ ni bote Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli etsɛko, koni ekawo ehe nɔ ni egbee kojomɔ ni abonsam gbee mli lɛ mli.
Shi sa akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ hu aye ehe odase kpakpa, koni ehe guɔ akagbo ni ekagbee abonsam tsɔ̃ne mli.
Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu esa akɛ amɛfee gbɔmɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee lilɛintasɛmɛi, jeee mɛi ni sumɔɔ dãa, jeee hiɛjoolɔ,
shi mɛi ni hiɛɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ teemɔ sane lɛ yɛ henilee ni he tse mli.
Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi hu aka amɛ akwɛ fɛɛdã; no sɛɛ lɛ, kɛ sane ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛsɔ̃mɔ.
Yei lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ; amɛfee mɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee oshekuyelɔi shi mɛi ni hiɛ kã shi, ni amɛyeɔ anɔkwa yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ amɛfee ŋa komekome tsɛmɛi, mɛi ni yeɔ amɛbii kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshīai anɔ jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ amɛnaa gbɛnaa kpakpa amɛhãa amɛhe, ni amɛnaa ekãa babaoo yɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli.
Mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ etsɛŋ ni maba oŋɔɔ; shi miiŋma o enɛɛmɛi
koni kɛ mitsɛ lɛ, ni ole bɔ ni sa kɛ oba ojeŋ ohã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ asafo lɛ, anɔkwale lɛ akulashiŋ kɛ nɔdaamɔnɔ lɛ mli.

Ni nɔ ko ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ eda kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ teemɔ sane lɛ: Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe shi faŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli, abu lɛ bem yɛ mumɔ mli, bɔfoi na lɛ, ashiɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ, ahe enɔ aye yɛ jeŋ, aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ anumnyam mli.
4: Shi Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ faŋŋ akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli lɛ mɛi komɛi aaakwa hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, amɛaabo lakamɔ mumɔi kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji atsɔ̃ɔmɔi atoi,
kɛtsɔ̃ amalelɔi asatofeemɔ nɔ; amalelɔi ni ashã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhenilee, tamɔ akɛ dade kɛ la shãa nɔ lɛ;
amɛtsiɔ yooŋɔɔ gbɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ahi ŋmaa ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ ni amɛle anɔkwale lɛ kɛ shidaa aye lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ ehi, ni ahiii nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛ shidaa yeɔ lɛ,
ejaakɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ kɛ sɔlemɔ tsuuɔ he.
Kɛji otsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ enɛɛmɛi lɛ, obaafee ohe Kristo Yesu sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, mɔ ni kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ tsɔ̃mɔ kpakpa ni onyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ wiemɔi lɛ lɛɔ ehe.
Shi yeimeji ayakayaka adesãi lɛ tsi ohe kɛjɛ he. Ni otsɔse ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ mli moŋ.
Ejaakɛ hetsɔsemɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso gbɛfaŋ he sɛɛnamɔ faaa, shi hetsɔsemɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɛ nii fiaa mli, ni eyɛ wala ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni baaba lɛ he shiwoo.
Eji anɔkwa wiemɔ ni sa akɛ amɔ mli kwraa.
Enɛ hewɔ wɔgboɔ deŋme ni wɔpleɔ wɔhiɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɔ, mɔ ni ji gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwalaherelɔ lɛ, titri lɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Wo nibii nɛɛ ahe kitã ni otsɔ̃ɔ.
Kaahã mɔ ko miibu akɛ ojeee mɔ ko yɛ oblanyo ni oji lɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ okɛ ohe ato okadi ohã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, yɛ wiemɔ mli, yɛ hetsemɔ mli.
Okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ ŋmalɛi lɛ akananemɔ kɛ asafo lɛ hamɔ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba.
Kaaŋmɛɛ dromɔkeenɔ ni yɔɔ omli ni atsɔ̃ gbalɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ aniji ni akɛshwie onɔ lɛ nɔ akɛhã o lɛ he.
Tsu nii nɛɛ ahe nii, okɛ ohe awo mli kwraa, koni mɛi fɛɛ ana onɔyaa faŋŋ.
Ohiɛ ahi ohe nɔ, ohiɛ ahi tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, hii shi yɛ nii nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ kɛji ofee enɛ lɛ, ooohere bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ mɛi ni boɔ o toi lɛ fɛɛ ayiwala.
5: Kaafãmɔ onukpa ko, shi moŋ owie otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ tsɛ; oblahii hu akɛ nyɛmimɛi;
yei onukpai lɛ akɛ nyɛmɛi; oblayei lɛ hu akɛ nyɛmimɛi yɛ hetsemɔ fɛɛ mli.
Yei okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ wo amɛ.
Shi kɛ yoo okulafo ko yɛ bii loo nabii lɛ, amɛkase Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshīa tsutsu, ni amɛto amɛfɔlɔi lɛ anajiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ejaakɛ enɛ sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Shi mɔ ni ji yoo okulafo lɛɛlɛŋ ni eshwɛ ekometoo lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni ehiɛɔ faikpamɔi kɛ sɔlemɔi amli nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
Shi yoo okulafo ni bɔɔ ahoshwi lɛ, ehiɛ kã nɛ, shi egbo.
Wo amɛ kitãi nɛɛ, koni akana amɛhe sane ko atã.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko kwɛɛɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, titri lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshīabii lɛ, ekpa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ, ni efaŋ mɔ ni heee yeee fe lɛ.
Akaŋɔ yoo okulafo ko awo sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli akɛ ja mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni egbã nuu kome
ni ayeɔ enitsumɔi kpakpai ahe odase, no ji; kɛ elɛ bii, kɛ efee mɛi agbɔ, kɛ efɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi anaji ahe, kɛ eye ebua mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ, kɛ edi nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa sɛɛ lɛ.
Shi yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ, kaaŋɔ amɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ akɔnɔ te shi yɛ amɛmli ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ Kristo he lɛ, amɛtaoɔ gblã,
ni amɛnaa kojomɔ ejaakɛ amɛku amɛklɛŋklɛŋ shiwoo lɛ mli.
Ni amɛsaa amɛkaseɔ hejɔ̃feemɔ, amɛkpaa shi yɛ shīai, ni jeee hejɔ̃lɔi kɛkɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi amɛwiewieɔ mɛi ahe hu, amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli, amɛwieɔ nii ni esaaa.
No hewɔ lɛ miisumɔ akɛ yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ agbã, ni amɛfɔ bii, amɛye amɛwe nɔ, ni amɛkahã henyɛlɔ lɛ miina hegbɛ ko kɛmiijɛ wɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi ekpale eyanyiɛ Satan sɛɛ momo.
Shi kɛ nuu loo yoo heyelɔ ko yɛ wekumɛi yei okulafoi lɛ, ekwɛ amɛ, ni jatsu akakã asafo lɛ nɔ, koni asafo lɛ akwɛ okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ.
Onukpai ni tsuɔ amɛnii jogbaŋŋ akɛ nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, abu amɛ akɛ amɛsa woo toi enyɔ, titri lɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ shiɛmɔ kɛ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ he nii waa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, "Kaawo tsina ni gblɛɔ able naabu kotoku;" kɛ, "Nitsulɔ lɛ, enyɔmɔwo sa lɛ."
Kɛ aflɔ onukpa ko naa lɛ, kaahe okplɛ̃ akɛ ja yɛ odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ naa dã.
Mɛi ni feɔ esha lɛ, okã amɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu ashe gbeyei.
Miiwo o kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo Yesu kɛ ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ oye nii nɛɛ anɔ ni okasha ohe akojo, ni asaŋ okafee nɔ ko yɛ niiaŋkpamɔ.
Kɛ oniji akashwie mɔ ko nɔ oya, ni asaŋ kaafata mɛi krokomɛi ahe kɛfee esha. Too ohe krɔŋŋ.
Kaanu nu kɛkɛ dɔŋŋ, shi nuu wain fioo yɛ omusu kɛ ohelai ni yeɔ o kpitiokpitio lɛ ahewɔ.
Mɛi komɛi ahe eshai jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ ekɛ amɛ yaa kojomɔ mli, shi mɛi komɛi anɔ hu nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nitsumɔi kpakpai hu jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni nii ni ejeee kpo lɛ hu anyɛŋ akɛtee.
6: Tsuji abɔ ni yɔɔ apã shishi lɛ abu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo fɛɛ, koni akawie Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔ.

Shi tsuji ni yɔɔ nuŋtsɔmɛi heyelɔi lɛ akaŋɔ lɛ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ esaaa akɛ hiɛ sɔɔ amɛ, shi moŋ amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ mɛi ni naa sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ he sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi heyelɔi kɛ suɔmɔmɛi ji amɛ. Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nii nɛɛ ni owo he ŋaa.
Kɛ mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kroko ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo wiemɔi ni hi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ naa lɛ nɔ lɛ,
no lɛ ewo ehe nɔ, eleee nɔ ko, shi moŋ eeye ŋwanejee kɛ naataamɔ hela, ni nibii ni jɛɔ mli ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, bei, oshekuyeli, mɛi ahe susumɔi fɔ̃ɔji,
yakayaka blɔmɔi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ mɛi ateŋ ni anaa yɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ efite ni ashɔ̃ anɔkwale lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ ji ninamɔ lɛ.
Shi lɛɛlɛŋ, ninamɔ kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ, kɛji mɔ ko miishɛ enii ahe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔkɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko baaa je nɛɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ nɔ ko aya hu.
Shi kɛ wɔyɛ ŋmaa kɛ hehaanii kɛkɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔmii ashɛ he.
Shi mɛi ni taoɔ afee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ gbeɔ kaa kɛ tsɔ̃ne kɛ kwashiai akɔnɔi pii ni fiteɔ mɔ ni tsiɔ mɛi ewoɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ laajemɔ mli lɛ amli.
Ejaakɛ nibii fɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ ashīshifã ji shikasuɔmɔ ni mɛi komɛi di sɛɛ ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ piŋmɔi babaoo egbulɔ amɛtsui lɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, Ao Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, joo nibii nɛɛ anaa foi, ni onyiɛ jalɛ, Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ, hemɔkɛyeli, suɔmɔ, hiɛmiamɔ, kɛ kpoofeemɔ sɛɛ.
Wuu hemɔkɛyeli he ta kpakpa lɛ, mɔ naanɔ wala lɛ mli, nɔ he hu ni atsɛ o kɛba ni ojaje jajemɔ fɛɛfɛo yɛ odasefoi pii ahiɛ lɛ.
Miiwo o kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa nibii fiaa wala lɛ kɛ Kristo Yesu ni ye jajemɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ he odase yɛ Pontio Pilato yinɔ lɛ hiɛ,
akɛ oye kitã lɛ nɔ, ni kpa ko loo shwamɔ ko akahi he kɛbashi wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo puemɔ lɛ mli,
nɔ ni nɔyelɔ kome ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ajɔɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi a-Maŋtsɛ kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi a-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baahã aba mli yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebe ni sa mli lɛ.
Lɛ ekome eyɔɔ naanɔ shihilɛ ni gbele bɛ mli, ni ehiɔ la ni anyɛŋ abɛŋkɛ mli; gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko enako lɛ dã, ni enyɛŋ lɛ ena hu lɛ. Enɔ ji woo kɛ naanɔ hewalɛ lɛ. Amen!

Niiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ je nɛɛŋ lɛ, wo amɛ kitã ni amɛkabu amɛhe tsɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ akafɔ̃ ninamɔ ni anyɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ he afɔ̃ nɔ lɛ nɔ, shi moŋ amɛkɛfɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni kɛ nibii fɛɛ hãa wɔ babaoo, akɛ wɔye mliŋɔɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛfee ejurɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai amli, amɛsumɔ nihãmɔ, amɛdɛŋ akpɔ.
Amɛbɔ jwetri amɛhã amɛhe ni efee shishitoo kpakpa ehã be ni baaba lɛ, koni amɛmɔ anɔkwa wala lɛ mli.
Ao Timoteo, nii ni atu awo odɛŋ lɛ, baamɔ yi ni okwa yakayaka sanegbaa ni buleɔ mɔ kɛ wiemɔi ni bɛ ekome ni jɛ apasa nilee mli.
Ni mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛyɔɔ ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he lɛ.
Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ashi shi! Amen.

1: Solomon, ni ji Maŋtsɛ binuu lɛ, hã ehewalɛ he shi yɛ emaŋtsɛyelihei lɛ anɔ, ni Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔ lɛ ni etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu kpanaa diɛŋtsɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsɛ tabilɔi akpe akui, kɛ tabilɔi oha akui hu atatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ kojolɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ, kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ, kɛ Israel maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ
amɛbafata ehe. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ amɛ tee jamɔhe ni yɔɔ Gibeon lɛ, ejaakɛ jɛi ji he ni Nyɔŋmɔ Kpee Buu lɛ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose fee be mli ni eyɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
(No be mli lɛ Maŋtsɛ David eyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Kiriat-Yearim kɛba Yerusalem, ni ekɛbato buu lɛ ni, lɛ David lɛ, esaa eto ehã adeka lɛ mli.)
Akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni Bezalel, Hur bi Uri binuu lɛ, fee lɛ hu ma shi yɛ Gibeon lolo yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ. Solomon kɛ Israel asafo lɛ ja Yehowa yɛ jɛi.
Solomon tee akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ naa lɛ he, ni ekɛ kooloi akpe shã afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ lɛ yɛ nɔ.
Nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe kpo estɔ̃ɔ Solomon, ni ekɛɛ, "Bi nɔ ni ooosumɔ akɛ mihã bo!"
Solomon kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Osumɔ mitsɛ David jogbaŋŋ be fɛɛ be, ni ŋmɛnɛ ohã mibaye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ, agbɛnɛ hã shi ni owo mitsɛ David lɛ aba mli. Bo owo mi maŋ ni yifalɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu nɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ;
no hewɔ lɛ dromɔ mi nilee kɛ hiɛshikamɔ koni manyɛ omaŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ makwɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Solomon akɛ, "Akɛ ni obiii akɛ ahã ona nii kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ anunyam, ni asaŋ obiii akɛ ahã ogbe ohenyɛlɔi aloo ahã owala sɛɛ atsɛ tete, shi moŋ nɔ ni kã otsui nɔ ni obi ji akɛ aduro bo nilee kɛ hiɛshikamɔ koni onyɛ mimaŋ ni miwo bo emaŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ okwɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,

naa, miihã ona nilee kɛ hiɛshikamɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ mahã ona nii kɛ jwetri kɛ anunyam fɛɛ hu bɔ ni maŋtsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ ohiɛ ateŋ eko kwraa naaa nakai, ni asaŋ mɛi ni baaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ hu ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko naŋ nakai!"
Solomon shi Gibeon jamɔhe lɛ he ni Kpee Buu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛba Yerusalem, ni ebaye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Solomon bua tabilɔi shwiilitsɛmɛi akpe kɛ ohai ejwɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi hu akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ anaa. Ehã amɛmli fã ko hi ehe yɛ Yerusalem, ni ejra fã ni shwɛ lɛ ewo mji srɔtoi komɛi amli.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika hu bu tamɔ shikpɔŋ tɛ yɛ Yerusalem; ehã seda tso hu bu tamɔ sikamore tso ebu yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ ajɔi amli shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon okpɔŋɔi lɛ Egipt kɛ Kilikia akɛjɛɔ. Ejrayelɔi lɛ yaheɔ amɛ kuikui kɛbaa, ni eko fɛɛ eko kɛ ejra.

Ni etayaa shwiilii lɛ Egipt ashɛɔ kɛjɛɔ. Ekome jra ji jwiɛtɛi kuikui ohai ekpaa, ni okɔŋɔ hu jra ji jwiɛtɛi kukuji oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Maŋtsɛ Solomon jrayelɔi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ anine nɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ni Hitbii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Siria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ naa tayaa shwiiili kɛ okpɔŋɔi amɛheɔ amɛ hu.
2: Matsɛ Solomon to eyiŋ akɛ ebaama Sɔlemɔtsu koni aja Yehowa yɛ jɛi, kɛ maŋtsɛwe hu ehã ehe.
Ehala mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo akɛ jatsu terelɔi. Ehala mɛi akpei kpaanyɔ hu koni amɛyagba tɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni ehala mɛi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ekpaa akɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu tiro Maŋtsɛ Hiram ŋɔɔ, ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni ofee ohã mitsɛ David, ni obahã lɛ tseneduru tsei ekɛma shīa ehi mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mitaoɔ koni ofee ohã mi hu.

Naa, mibama Sɔlemɔtsu mikɛwo Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam. Abaato tsu nɛɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã lɛ, ni abaashã tsofakɛŋmai yɛ jɛi, ni akɛ abooloo baama Yehowa hiɛ yɛ jɛi jɛi daa, ni asaŋ abaashã shãa afɔlei yɛ jɛi akɛja lɛ daa leebi gbɛkɛ kɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ hu, kɛji shɛ nyɔji heei, kɛ gbii juji krokomɛi ni akɛwoɔ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam lɛ anɔ. Gbɛnaa nitsumɔ ni kã shi hã Israel nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Tsu ni mibama lɛ baada kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ ejaakɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eda fe nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ.
Ni namɔ po aaanyɛ ama tsu ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaho mli? Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi tete nyɛɛɛ lɛ ato. No hewɔ lɛ namɔ ji mi ni mimaa tsu mihãa lɛ akɛ ja he kɛkɛ ni abaashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ ahã lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ hã mi nuu ŋaalɔ mɔ ni le shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade he nitsumɔ, ni asaŋ ele samaloo kɛ mama afaseo tsuru kɛ mama tsuru faa kɛ mama bluu mliwoo hu. Efee mɔ ko ni le samayeli hu koni ebafata ŋaalɔi ni mitsɛ David etao amɛ eto yɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ lɛ ahe kɛtsu nii lɛ ahã mi.
Asaŋ miitao hu koni omaje mi seda tsei kɛ saiprɛs tsei kɛ junipa tsei kɛjɛ Lebanon, ejaakɛ mile akɛ otsuji ahe esa pam kɛ Lebanon tsogbamɔ. Mawo mitsuji gbɛ koni amɛbafata otsuji lɛ ahe,
koni amɛsaa tsei babaoo amɛhã mi, ejaakɛ tsu ni mibama lɛ baada kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ, ni ebaafee naakpɛɛ hu.
Mibahã bo ŋmãa mamu ni tsiimɔ ji nsɛnitɛ wulu lɛ akpei enyɔ, kɛ able nsɛnitɛ wulu lɛ akpei enyɔ, kɛ wain litai akpei ohai ejwɛ kɛ mu litai akpei ohai ejwɛ hu yɛ otsuji ni ji tsogbalɔi lɛ ahewɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Hiram, Tiro maŋtsɛ lɛ, hã Solomon ewolo lɛ hetoo. Ekɛɛ yɛ wolo ni eŋma emaje Solomon lɛ mli akɛ, "Suɔmɔ ni Yehowa sumɔ emaŋ lɛ hewɔ ni ewo bo amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ.
Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yi akɛ ehã Maŋtsɛ David bi nilelɔ kɛ hiɛshikalɔ kɛ jwɛŋlɔ fɛɛ ni baama Sɔlemɔtsu ehã Yehowa, kɛ maŋtsɛwe hu ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Miwo nuu ŋaalɔ kɛ jwɛŋlɔ kpanaa ko gbɛ koni ebana bo. Egbɛi ji Huram, mitsɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ.

Enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ ejɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli; shi etsɛ lɛ Tironyo ni. Ele shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ tɛ kɛ tso fɛɛ he nitsumɔ; asaŋ ele samaloo kɛ mama afaseo tsuru kɛ mama bluu kɛ mama tsuru faa kɛ klala mliwoo. No ji ele ŋaa fɛɛ ŋaa tsumɔ, ni eeba koni ebafata oŋaalɔi lɛ, ni ji otsɛ David minuŋtsɔ lɛ, oŋaalɔi lɛ ahe.
No hewɔ lɛ tamɔ owo shi lɛ, okɛ ŋmaa mamu lɛ kɛ able mamu lɛ kɛ wain lɛ amaje otsuji;
ni wɔbaatoo Lebanon tsei bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni otao wɔbahã bo. Wɔbaafimɔ tsei lɛ wɔkɛtsra, ni wɔbaaloo amɛ wɔwo ŋshɔŋ kɛba Yopa koni ohã abahole kɛya Yerusalem."
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã akane gbɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tamɔ estɛ David hã afee lɛ. Amɛyibɔ fee akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enunɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Eto amɛteŋ mɛi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ekpaa akɛ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi koni ajwɛŋ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ atsu.
3: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon bɔi Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa yɛ Yerusalem he tuuŋtu ni etsɛ David saa eto lɛ, yɛ Moria gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ etsɛ David yɛ lɛ, ni ji Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ ŋmaagbeemɔhe lɛ.
Eje tsu lɛ maa lɛ shishi yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ shīa lɛ ni Solomon to eshishi lɛ dalɛ nɛ, blema ko susumɔ kpãa naa lɛ, shīa lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Koi ni yɔɔ tsu lɛ hiɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ; ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha koi nɛɛ mligbɛ fɛɛ.
Tsu wulu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, akɛ saiprɛs tso ha emli fɛɛ, kɛkɛ ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha tso lɛ hu he, ni ayeyee tsɛŋi kɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ asamai yɛ nɔ.
Ni esaa ekɛ ojrawatɛi ka tsu lɛ mli kɛwula mli. Shika lɛ ashɛ kɛjɛ Parwain kɛba.
Ekɛ shika ha tsu wulu lɛ mli fɛɛ-gbogboi lɛ kɛ mplaŋi lɛ kɛ shinaatsei lɛ kɛ shinai lɛ fɛɛ ahe. Aye Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo kerubi samai yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ afee Tsu Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ talentai ohai ekpaa ha mli fɛɛ.
Aŋme shika gramii ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo ni akɛfee plɛkobii. Akɛ shika ha ŋwɛitsui lɛ hu ahe.
Solomon hã akɛ tso gbɔ kerubii enyɔ, ni akɛ shika ha amɛhe, kɛkɛ ni akɛyamamɔ Tsu Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ mli.
Kerubii lɛ afiji lɛ fɛɛ aklɛmɔ aafee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Kerubi kome fine kome ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ ni eyasaa kerubi kome lɛ hu fine kome lɛ ni lɛ hu ekɛlɛ nakai nɔŋŋ lɛ he.
Ni kerubi nɛɛ fine kome ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ lɛ yasaa shīa lɛ gbogbo lɛ he, ni efine kroko lɛ ni hu ekɛlɛ nakai nɔŋŋ lɛ yasaa Klɛŋklɛŋ kerubi lɛ fine lɛ he.
Kerubii nɛɛ afiji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ aklɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Kerubii lɛ damɔ amɛnaji anɔ, ni amɛshiɛ kwɛɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mligbɛ.
Akɛ mama bluu kɛ mama afaseo tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa fee muhɔɔ, ni alo kerubii awo mli.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã afee akulashiŋi enyɔ kɛ amɛyiteiaŋ kpɔbii, ni akɛmamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hiɛ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ, ni kpɔ ni ma eko fɛɛ eko yiteŋ lɛ kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Asaŋ afee kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i ni akɛwo akulashŋi lɛ ayiteŋ. Afee kpɔbii kokrobii oha akɛwo kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ ahe.
Akɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agbo lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ, ekome yɛ kooyigbɛ, ni ekome hu yɛ wuoyigbɛ. Awo wuoyigbɛ akulashiŋ lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yakin, kɛ kooyigbɛ akulashiŋ lɛ akɛ Boaz.
4: Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã afee akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.
Agbɛnɛ ehã afee akɔɔble botoku agbo koni akɛto nu. Ehiɛ lɛɛmɔ kɛjɛ etoi biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ feɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma; emlikwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ, ni kpãa ni bɔle enaabu lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Be ni afee akɔɔble botoku lɛ, aye tsina samai yɛ botoku lɛ toishi sɛrɛnɛɛ shii enyɔ kɛbɔle ehe kɛkpe kpula, ekome ye ekome ŋwɛigbɛ.

Botoku nɛɛ ma tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ akotosɛɛ. Tsinai lɛ ɛtɛ̃ ahiɛ miikwɛ kooyigbɛ, etɛ̃ ahiɛ miikwɛ anaigbɛ, etɛ ahiɛ miikwɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni etɛ̃ hu ahiɛ miikwɛ bokãgbɛ. Botoku nɛɛ ma tsinai nɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛsɛɛgbɛ fɛɛ yɛ botoku lɛ shishi.
Botoku lɛ tilɛ aashɛ dɛ̃lɛɛmɔ, ni akpa botoku lɛ toi oookɛɛ akpaa kɔɔpoo toi tamɔ fɔfɔi ni egba lɛ. Botoku nɛɛ yeɔ nu gbudugbaŋi ohai etɛ̃.

Agbɛnɛ hu afee okpolui gboi nyɔŋma koni akɛmamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni akɛ enumɔ hu amamɔ kooyigbɛ. Akɛ okpolui nɛɛ baafɔ loo ni akɛba akɛbaashã afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ lɛ he. Akɔɔble botoku lɛ mli nu lɛ eyɛ hã osɔfoi lɛ ahejuu.
Asaŋ afee shika kanetsei nyɔŋma tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ afee amɛ lɛ, ni akɛmamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, enumɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni enumɔ hu yɛ kooyigbɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ afee okplɔ̃i nyɔŋma, ni akɛmamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, enumɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ,ni enumɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ. Afee okpolui bibiibii hu oha.
Afo shīaŋgbɛ kpo akɛ osɔfoi lɛ akpo, ni afo kponɔgbɛ kpo wulu hu, ni afee shinai awo kpoi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ, ni aha shinai nɛɛ ahe kɛ akɔɔble.
Akɛ nutoo botoku lɛ ma Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli yɛ wuoyi bokãgbɛ niiaŋ.
Huram fee tsɛnsii kɛ sofii kɛ okpolui hu. Ena egbe nibii fɛɛ ni eba tsumɔ ehã Maŋtsɛ Solomon yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he lɛ naa. Nibii lɛ ji
akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ kɛ kpɔbii kuturukui enyɔ lɛ ni mamɔ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ayiteiaŋ tamɔ oduku lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble ntaŋi enyɔ lɛ ni akɛhaa akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpɔbii enyɔ lɛ ahe lɛ,
kɛ ntaŋi enyɔ lɛ ahe akɔɔble kpɔbii kokrobii ohai ejwɛ lɛ. Atsɛ̃rɛ̃ akɔɔble kpɔbii kokrobii nɛɛ sɛrɛnɛɛ shii enyɔ kɛho awo ntaŋi enyɔ lɛ eko fɛɛ eko he.
Huram nɔŋŋ ni fee naji ni okpolui lɛ mamɔɔ amɛnɔ lɛ, kɛ okpolui lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu.
Efee nu botoku kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ hu ni botoku lɛ ma amɛnɔ lɛ.

Tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni fata amɛhe lɛ, Huram, mitsɛ gbɔmɔ ŋaalɔ kpanaa lɛ, ji mɔ ni kɛ akɔɔble ni kplɛɔ nyaramnyaram fee ehã Maŋtsɛ Solomon koni akɛtsu Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli nii.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã ashwie nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ magbɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã Sukot kɛ Zereda teŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ fee nibii nɛɛ babaoo bɔ sɔŋŋ ni no hewɔ lɛ aleee akɔɔble tsiimɔ ni akɛtsu nii lɛ naa.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã afee shika nibii hu awo Yehowa we lɛ mli. Ekomɛi ji shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ okplɔ̃i ni akɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ maa nɔ lɛ.
Ekomɛi hu ji kanetsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe kanei lɛ ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee ni asuɔ amaa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ato afɔ shi lɛ.
Shika nibii lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ji fɔfɔi asamai lɛ kɛ kanei lɛ kɛ abɛɛlei lɛ,

Kɛ lagbee tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ lajee tsɛnsii lɛ. Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa agboi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ koi lɛ shishi lɛ kɛ shinai ni yɔɔ mligbɛ ni akɛboteɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ hu shika ŋmiiŋmi akɛfee fɛɛ.
5: Be ni Solomon ekwɛ ni agbe nibii fɛɛ ni atsuɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he naa lɛ, eloo jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ nibiinibii lɛ fɛɛ ni etsɛ David ejɔɔ nɔ eke Yehowa lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛbato Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ nitoohe lɛ.

Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kɛ akutsei lɛ kɛ Israelbii atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe. Akpe yɛ Yerusalem koni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ David maŋ, ni ji Zion, kɛba Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli.
Israel hii lɛ fɛɛ anaa bakpe shi yɛ Asesei Agbijurɔ, ni ayeɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israelbii hii lɛ fɛɛ eshɛ shi lɛ. Levibii lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ fã Kpee Buu lɛ hu, ni amɛhole nibii krɔŋkrɔŋ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ hu kɛba.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni naa ekpe shi lɛ yabua shi yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛbote Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli.
Osɔfoi lɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee ni amɛkɛyama egbɛhɛ lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ sɛɛtsu lɛ ni ji He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ mli, yɛ kerubi lɛ afiji lɛ ashishi.
Ejaakɛ kerubii lɛ elɛɛ amɛfiji lɛ amli kɛha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ maahe lɛ nɔ. Ni kerubii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛkete adeka lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ anɔ yɛ amɛŋwɛigbɛ.
Tsei nɛɛ kwɔlɔ, ni anaa amɛnaabui kɛji adamɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe fɛɛ lɛ hiɛ yɛ sɛɛtsu lɛ mli; shi moŋ anaaa yɛ kpo lɛ nɔ he ko he ko. Tsei nɛɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Nɔ ko no ko bɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli ja tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni Mose kɛto mli yɛ Horeb, ni ji Sinai Gɔŋ, he ni Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ yɛ be mli ni amɛjɛ Egipt amɛbaa lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ osɔfo akui srɔtoi lɛ amli bii fɛɛ etsuu amɛhe kɛfee amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ amɛto; mɔ ko emɛɛɛ akɛ eshɛ be ni ekɛ sɔmɔɔ dã;

asaŋ levibii lalatsɛmɛi, ni ji Asaf kɛ Heman kɛ Yedutun kɛ amɛshishibii lɛ kɛ amɛwekumɛi lɛ ewula kɛ klala ataadei fɛɛfɛji, ni amɛhiɛhiɛ ŋmɛji kɛ bɛji kɛ saŋkui kɛdamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ bokãgbɛ. Osɔfoi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni ji tɛtrɛmantrɛkpãlɔi fata lalɔi lɛ ahe.

Tɛtrɛmantrɛkpãlɔi nɛɛ kɛ lalatsɛmɛi lɛ anitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛla kɛjie Yehowa yi, asaŋ kɛda lɛ shi hu. Be ni osɔfoi lɛ je kpo nɔŋŋ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe fɛɛ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ wo lala nɔ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi kɛ ŋmɛji kɛ saŋkui srɔtoi, ni amɛjie Yehowa yi amɛkɛɛ, "Yehowa hi, ejaakɛ emɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ efooo, emɔbɔnalɛ lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. "Kɛkɛ ni atatu bayi Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛŋ obɔ̃;
ni atatu lɛ hewɔ lɛ osɔfoi lɛ nyɛɛɛ shi amɛdamɔ kɛsɔmɔ dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ Yehowa anumnyam ni kplɛɔ nyaramnyaram lɛ eyi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ obɔ.
6: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon sɔle ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa, oto akɛ obaahi atatu duŋ kpii lɛ mli.
Shi agbɛnɛ, mima mɔɔ wulu mihã Bo akɛ oshihilɛhe kɛmiiya naanɔ."
Agbɛnɛ Solomon tsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã Israel asafo muu lɛ ni ewo shi yɛ jɛi lɛ, ni eba Yehowa dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ ehã amɛ
ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi. Lɛ ewo mitsɛ David shi, ni asaŋ ehã eba mli bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
'Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni miyajie mimaŋ lɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba nɛɛ, mikɔko maŋ ko maŋ ko akɛ he ni ama Sɔlemɔtsu yɛ ni aja mi jɛi; ni asaŋ mikɔko mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ mimaŋ Israel nɔyelɔ.
Shi agbɛnɛ mikɔ Yerusalem akɛ he ni aja mi yɛ, ni mikɔ David hu akɛ mɔ ni aye mimaŋ Israelbii anɔ.'
"Kulɛ mistɛ David to eyiŋ akɛ eeema Sɔlemɔtsu koni aja Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi.
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ: 'Ofee jogbaŋŋ akɛ oto oyiŋ akɛ oooma Sɔlemɔtsu koni aja mi yɛ jɛi.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bo obaama Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ, shi omusuŋbi moŋ ni baama mi-Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ehã mi.'
"Agbɛnɛ Yehowa ehã eshiwoo lɛ eba mli nyɔŋma shishiishi, ejaakɛ mibaye mitsɛ sɛɛ yɛ Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni mima Sɔlemɔtsu koni aja Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi,
ni miwo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ni Kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Israel Kpãŋ lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ miyato jɛi."
Agbɛnɛ Solomon ho edamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Isreal asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.

Solomon kɛ akɔɔble etswa atrakwei ko ema kpo lɛ teŋ. Ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ fɛɛ ninetalɔi enumɔenumɔ kɛ ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi etɛ̃. Solomon kwɔ edamɔ atrakwei lɛ nɔ. No sɛɛ lɛ ekula shi yɛ Isreal muu fɛɛ hiɛ, kɛkɛ ni ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi,

ni esɔle ekɛɛ, "Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ bo yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Otoɔ kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ otsuji ekpãŋ, ni ojieɔ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ boɔ bo toi lɛ.
Oye shi ni owo otsulɔ, mitsɛ David lɛ nɔ,akɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ ohã nɔ fɛ nɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ eba mli.

No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, agbɛnɛ ye shi kroko lɛ hu ni owo otsulɔ, mitsɛ David, lɛ nɔ, ni ji nɔ okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mihaŋ nuu ni aaajɛ oshwiei lɛ ateŋ ata Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ abɔ bo kɛji amɛaaye mimlai lɛ anɔ kadikadi tamɔ ofee lɛ.'
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, hã shi fɛɛ shi ni awo otsulɔ David lɛ aba mli agbɛnɛ.
"Shi aso Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi aabahi shi lɛɛlɛŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ" Naa, ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛi amli tete edaaa hãaa bo, aahuu ni Sɔlemɔtsu ni mima nɛɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, na otsulɔ he tsui koni obo esɔlemɔ toi, ni ofee nɔ ni ebiɔ bo lɛ.
Ohiŋmɛi akã Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ he shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ ejaakɛ owo shi akɛ jɛi aaaja bo yɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, ofai nɛ, bo fai ni otsulɔ baakpa bo be mli ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã biɛ lɛ toi.
Ni obo otsulɔ kɛ omaŋ Israel sɔlemɔi ni amɛaasɔle be mli ni amɛtsɔ amɛ hiɛ amɛhã biɛ lɛ toi. Ni kɛji onu sɔlemɔ lɛ he yɛ ŋwɛi, oshihilɛhe lɛ, lɛ okɛfa wɔ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃ enaanyo nɔ, ni abi lɛ koni ekã he kitã, ni mɔ lɛ ba ebakã kitã lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ mli, akɛ esane yɛ mli lɛ,
no lɛ jɛɛ ŋwɛi he ni oyɔɔ lɛ ni obo toi ni okojo otsuji lɛ, ni owo mɔ fɔŋ lɛ nyɔmɔ, ni ohã emusu abua eyiteŋ, ni obu bemyelɔ lɛ bem, ni owo lɛ nyɔmɔ yɛ ejalɛ lɛ naa.

"Kɛji omaŋ Israelbii tɔ̃ onɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ ta mli, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ ni amɛkpale kɛba Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ mli bi amɛbaja bo, ni amɛkpa tɔ̃mɔ lɛ he fai koni okɛfa amɛ lɛ,
jɛɛ ŋwɛi obo amɛ toi, ni okɛ amɛ aba shikpɔŋ ni okɛhã amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
"Kɛji otsi ŋwɛi naa, ni nu enɛɛɛ ejaakɛ omaŋ lɛ etɔ̃ onɔ, ni maŋ lɛ je ehe sɛɛ, ni amɛsɔle amɛkpa bo fai be mli ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ amɛhã Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ yɛ piŋmɔ ni opiŋ amɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
no lɛ jɛɛ ŋwɛi ni okɛ omaŋ Israel tɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa amɛ, asaŋ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ bɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛba amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ amɛhã koni ohã nu anɛ shikpɔŋ ni okɛhã omaŋ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.

"Kɛji hɔmɔ loo gbele hela ni eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio, jeŋ dɔlɛ loo baalabii loo otukpɛi ni ebakpãtã ŋmɔshi nibii ahiɛ ni jio, aloo omaŋ lɛ henyɛlɔi ni ebasa omaŋbii komɛi ayi ewo amɛmaŋ mli ni jio, nɔ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ loo hela fɛɛ hela ni eji lɛ,
bo omaŋ lɛ sɔlemɔ toi. Sɔlemɔ fɛɛ Sɔlemɔ ni Israelnyo kome loo maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baasɔle, loo fai fɛɛ fai ni maŋbii komekomei kɛ haomɔ kɛ ŋkɔmɔ aaahole niji anɔ atsɔ̃ɔ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ kɛkpa bo lɛ,
jɛɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ obo toi ni okɛfa. Bo pɛ ole gbɔmɔ yitsoŋ, no hewɔ lɛ okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye bɔ ni sa mɔ lɛ,
bɔ ni afee ni omaŋbii lɛ ashe bo gbeyei, asaŋ koni amɛhi shi bɔ ni bo otaoɔ bei fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni okɛhã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
"Agbɛnɛ hu gbɔ ni ejeee Israelnyo shi moŋ enu ogbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ he kɛ bɔ ni ofee kralo be fɛɛ be ohã gbɔmɛi lɛ, ni eeejɛ shɔŋŋ eba biɛ ebasɔle yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ mli lɛ,

jɛɛ ŋwɛi, ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ, obo lɛ toi. Ofee nibii fɛɛ ni gbɔ lɛ kpaa he fai lɛ ohã lɛ, bɔ ni afee koni amɛshe bo gbeyei tamɔ omaŋ Israel sheɔ Bo lɛ, asaŋ koni amɛna amɛle akɛ Bo lɛɛlɛŋ ajaa yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni mima nɛɛ mli lɛ.

"Kɛji omaŋ lɛ fã ta yɛ Bo ofamɔ naa koni amɛkɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ayawu lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ ni amɛaasɔle amɛtsɛ Bo, be mli ni amɛhiɛ miikwɛ maŋ nɛɛ gbɛ, ni ji maŋ ni Bo diɛŋtsɛ otse ohã ohe lɛ, kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni mima koni aja Bo yɛ mli nɛɛ gbɛ lɛ,
jɛɛ ŋwɛi obo amɛsɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ toi koni oye obua amɛ koni amɛye kunim.

"Akɛni adesa ko bɛ ni efeee esha lɛ kɛji omaŋ lɛ fee esha shi bo, ni omli fu amɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ oŋmɛ gbɛ ni amɛhenyɛlɔi ye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ ta mli, ni henyɛlɔi lɛ ŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee shikpɔŋ kpɔŋ nɔ, jɛi kɛjɛ jio, ejekɛɛɛ jio,
kɛji be mli ni amɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee lɛ, amɛsusu nɔ ni amɛfee lɛ he, ni amɛbu amɛhe fɔ akɛ amɛtɔ̃, ni amɛfee esha lɛɛlɛŋ,

ni kɛji no hewɔ lɛ amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ, ni amɛkpa bo fai anɔkwale mli kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ amɛyitsoŋ fɛɛ,yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee lɛ, be mli ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ amɛmiikwɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni okɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ otse akɛ omaŋ lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ hu ni mima koni aja bo yɛ mli lɛ,
jɛɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛ lɛ obo amɛsɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ lɛ toi koni okɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa omaŋ lɛ.
"Agbɛnɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa bo fai, naa wɔ mɔbɔ, ohiŋmɛi akã wɔhe, ni obo sɔlemɔ fɛɛ sɔlemɔ ni aaasɔle yɛ biɛ lɛ toi.

Ao! Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ ee! Wo ohe nɔ ni obote ohejɔɔmɔhe lɛ mli, bo kɛ Kpaŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ji ohewalɛ lɛ he okadi lɛ. Ao! Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, hã osɔfoi lɛ afee nii ni ja, ni ohã mɛi ni jaa bo lɛ amii ashɛ yɛ ejurɔ ni ofee amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Ao! Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ kaaku ohiɛ ofɔ̃ maŋtsɛ ni bo oto lɛ lɛ sɔlemɔ nɔ, ni okai osumɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ ni okɛsumɔ otsulɔ David lɛ."
7: Be ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon sɔle egbe naa lɛ, la jɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebabote nibii ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ afɔlei krokomɛi lɛ amli, ni eshã fɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anumnyam la lɛ yi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ obɔ.
Yehowa anumnyam la nɛɛ ni eyi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hewɔ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ nyɛɛɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli abote.

Be ni Israelbii lɛ na la lɛ ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, kɛ Yehowa anumnyam la lɛ ni ebayi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛŋ obɔ̃ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhiɛaŋ bumɔ shi, yɛ he ko ni aka jɛi tɛ, ni amɛja Yehowa, ni amɛda lɛ shi yɛ emlihilɛ kɛ esusɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ shã afɔlei amɛkɛhã Yehowa.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ shã afɔlei amɛkɛhã Yehowa. Maŋtsɛ Solomon shã afɔle kɛ tsinai akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ, kɛ toi hu akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛgbele Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa.

Osɔfoi lɛ damɔ amɛgbɛhe ni ato ahã amɛ lɛ, ni Levibii lɛ damɔ shi amɛmiikwɛ osɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛmiikpã bɛji ni Maŋtsɛ David kewo jamɔ lɛ mli koni akɛjie Yehowa yi lɛ akɛ, Yehowa, esusɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo kɛmiiya naanɔ" lɛ. Nakai be mli lɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ eho edamɔ shi.

No sɛɛ lɛ Solomon tsuu kpo ni yɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hiɛ lɛ he, ni efee lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ejaakɛ eshã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ ahe fɔi lɛ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni lɛ, Solomon lɛ, efee lɛ edaaa hãaa shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ fɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Solomon kɛ Israel asafo kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ lɛ fɛɛ ye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ kɛyashi gbii kpawo. Mɛi jɛ kooyigbɛ shɔŋŋ yɛ Lebo-Hamat aahuu kɛyashwie Egipt faa lɛ naa niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ amɛba amɛbaye afi lɛ eko.
Amɛjɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ gbii kpawo, ni amɛye gbijurɔ lɛ hu gbii ejwɛ, ni gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkpe naagbee Kpee.

Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ, ni ji nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ,Maŋtsɛ Solomon wo maŋ lɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtetee amɛshiai kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ yɛ jɔɔmɔ ni Yehowa ejɔɔ David kɛ Solomon kɛ Israelbii lɛ hewɔ.

Be ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon gbe Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ shīa lɛ maa naa, ni asaŋ nibii fɛɛ ni lɛ, Solomon lɛ, eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee ewo Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, kɛ agbɛnɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshìa lɛ hu mli lɛ, etsu fɛɛ etã lɛ,
Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbi ko nyɔɔŋ. Yehowa kɛɛ Solomon akɛ, "Minu osɔlemɔ lɛ, ni miŋɔ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ akɛ he ni ashã afɔle yɛ akɛhã mi.
Be fɛɛ be ni matsi ŋwɛi naa ni no hewɔ lɛ nu enɛɛɛ, aloo mafã ni baalabii aaabaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔshinii, aloo mahã gbele hela aaabote mimaŋbii ateŋ lɛ,

kɛji mimaŋbii lɛ, ni ji mi diɛŋtsɛ minii lɛ, ba amɛhe shi amɛhã mi, ni amɛsɔle amɛkpa fai, ni amɛtao misɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ ni amɛkpa amɛshihilɛ gbohii lɛ, no lɛ mi hu majɛ ŋwɛi mabo toi, ni mikɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ aaafa amɛ, ni mahã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ashwere ekoŋŋ.
Kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ mihiŋmɛi baahi Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ he, ni mabo sɔlemɔi fɛɛ ni aaasɔle yɛ mli toi,
ejaakɛ miŋɔ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ, nii mitsuu he mifee lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ koni aja mi yɛ mli kɛya naanɔ. Mihiŋmɛi baakã he, ni mitsui aaakã nɔ, ni mabu he daa.
Ni bo ogbɛfaŋ lɛ kɛji ooobo mi toi bɔ ni otsɛ David fee lɛ, ni oooye mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni ooofee nibii fɛɛ ni miwo bo amɛhe kitã lɛ,
no lɛ mibahã omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ bɔ ni mi kɛ otsɛ David kpãŋ lɛ akɛ, 'Oshwie ni baata Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ebɔŋ bo' lɛ.
Shi kɛji bo kɛ omaŋbii lɛ, nyɛkwa mikpɔi kɛ mimlai ni, mikɛshwie nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ, ni moŋ nyɛtee nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi komɛi, ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ,
no lɛ mibashwie nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ ni mikahã nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni mitsuu he mifee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni aja mi yɛ mli lɛ hu mibabule lɛ koni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni majimaji fɛɛ kɛaabu abɛ abaanyɛ lɛ.
"Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaho yɛ nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpeteŋkple ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ he lɛ, ehe aaajɔ̃ ehe, ni eeebi akɛ, 'Mɛni hewɔ Yehowa fee shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ hu nɛkɛ?'

Mɛi aaabua he akɛ, 'Amɛkwa Yehowa, ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yahere amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe yahã nyɔŋmɔi komɛi, ni amɛja amɛ ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ. Enɛ hewɔ Yehowa ehã nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ eba amɛnɔ nɛɛ.'"
8: Afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni Solomon kɛma Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu emaŋtsɛ we lɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
esaa maji ni Maŋtsɛ Hiram hã lɛ, ni ehã Israelbii yahi jɛi.
Solomon fã ta kɛtee ni eyaŋɔ Hamat-Zoba shikpɔŋ lɛ,
ni ewaje Palmpra (Tabor), ni ji shiaŋa lɛ mli maŋ lɛ.
Maji krokomɛi hu ni Solomon saa ji Gɔŋnɔgbɛ Bet-Horon maŋ lɛ kɛ Jɔɔŋgbɛ Bet-Horon maŋ lɛ hu, ni ji maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe kɛ amɛnaa agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi hu lɛ.

Esaa Baalat kɛ maji fɛɛ ni, lɛ Solomon lɛ, eyɔɔ ni atoɔ niyenii yɛ amɛmli lɛ, kɛ hei ni atoɔ etayaa shwiilii yɛ lɛ, kɛ hei ni atoɔ etayaa shwiilii yɛ lɛ, kɛ hei hu ni ekpɔŋɔtalɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Solomon to eyiŋ akɛ ebaama yɛ Yerusalem kɛ Lebanon kɛ agbɛnɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, efee.
Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Kanaaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni jeee Israelbii ji amɛ lɛ,
Solomon nyɛ amɛshwiei ni Israelbii lɛ egbeee lɛ anɔ, ni amɛtsu nii amɛhã lɛ. Ni aaye amɛ nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi Israelbii lɛ, Solomon kɛ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko efeee nyɔŋ koni etsu nii ehã lɛ, amɛ amɛji etabilɔi kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ etayaa shwiiliiatsɛmɛi anɔ onukpai kɛ ekpɔŋnɔtalɔi lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi.
Ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon to tsujinukpai ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni amɛ amɛkwɛɔ nitsumɔi srɔtoi lɛ anɔ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ amli.

Solomon yakpla eŋa Egipt maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ kɛjɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli kɛba shīa ni eje gbɛ ema ehã lɛ lɛ mli ejaakɛ Solomon kɛɛ akɛ, "Ebɛ akɛ miŋa lɛ hiɔ Israel Maŋtsɛ David we lɛ mli, ejaakɛ he fɛɛ he ni ato Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ lɛ he Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni."
Solomon shã shãa afɔlei ekɛhã Yehowa yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ ni ema ema Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ koi lɛ hiɛ lɛ nɔ.

Gbi fɛɛ gbi kɛ enɔ afɔle ni ashã bɔ ni Mose wo he kitã akɛ ashã lɛ. Solomon shã Hejɔɔmɔgbii afɔlei lɛ, kɛ nyɔji heei ashihijee afɔlei lɛ kɛ afi mli gbii juji etɛ̃ lɛ hu anɔ afɔlei lɛ, Nomɛi ji Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ kɛ Otsi Agbijurɔ lɛ kɛ Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ.

Solomon ye akpɔi ni etsɛ David ewo lɛ hu anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ekɛto daa gbi sɔɔmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe gbɛjianɔ ehã osɔfoi lɛ akui lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu ni waa osɔfoi lɛ kɛ lalai alamɔ kɛ nitsumɔi hu lɛ, eto gbɛjianɔ hu ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hebulɔi lɛ yaa kuikui daa gbi amɛyabuɔ sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agboi lɛ anaa bɔ ni David, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, wo he akpɔi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni akpɔi hu ni Maŋtsɛ David ewo osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ yɛ nitoohei lɛ ahe kɛ saji krokomɛi fɛɛ ahe lɛ, aye fɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Belɛ nii fɛɛ ni Solomon wo amɛtsumɔ nɔ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni ato Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shishi aahuu kɛyashi agbe naa ni Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ye emuu lɛ, atsu kɛgbe naa kɛ omanye.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon yiŋ etee lɛlɛmaahei enyɔ ni ji Ezion-Geber kɛ Elat yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋshɔnaa.

Maŋtsɛ Hiram wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esɛrɛfoi ni ahe esa gbɛ kɛ lɛji kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni Solomon tsuji bafata asɛrɛfoi lɛ ahe ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee Ofir amɛyaloo shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ amɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon
9: Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ nu Maŋtsɛ Solomon gbɛi ni ehehe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he nii ni ele lɛ hewɔ. Kɛkɛ ni eyiŋ eba Yerusalem koni ebabi Solomon saji ni wawai koni ekɛka Solomon nilee lɛ naawalɛ ekwɛ. Sheba Maŋnyɛ nɛɛ ba kɛ esɛɛbii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ yomai hu ni tretree tsofakɛŋmai kɛ shika babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ojrawatɛi hu. Be ni maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ Solomon kpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ, ebi Solomon saji blublu ni eto yɛ eyiŋ.
Solomon hã lɛ saji ni ebibii lɛ lɛ fɛɛ hetoo; ekoeko kwraa bɛ mli ni Solomon nyɛɛɛ lɛ naa atsɔ̃ɔ.
Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ na Solomon nilee lɛ mlikwɔlɛ, ni ena mɔɔ lɛ hu ni ema akɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.

Ena niyenii ni akɛbamamɔ Solomon niyeniiashi lɛ, kɛ etsuji lɛ ashitramɔ yɛ okplɔ̃ he. Ena bɔ ni ato nitsumɔi ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli lɛ ahegbɛjianɔ ahã sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ atadei, kɛ bɔ ni niyeniiashi daawolɔi lɛ ewula amɛhã. Agbɛnɛ ena afɔlei ni ashãa fɛɛ ni Solomon shãa yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hu; kɛkɛ ni maŋnyɛ lɛ he jɔ̃ ehe naakpa.
Ni ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ, "Ohe saji kɛ onilee ni minu yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni.
Tsɛbelɛ miheee saji ni minu lɛ miyeee kɛyashi mibashɛ biɛ. Shi agbɛnɛ mibana kɛ mihiŋmɛitsei enyɔ nɛɛ. Moaŋ saji ni agbagbaa mi lɛ shɛɛɛ onilee lɛ mlijaa fã tete. Nibii ni agba mi lɛ baaa ohe kwraa.
Ajɔɔ owebii. Otsuji ni sɔmɔɔ bo, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛbɛŋkɛ bo be fɛɛ be, ni amɛnaa hegbɛ amɛboɔ onaa nilee toi lɛ, amɛto ahuu kple.

Ajie Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi akɛ esa ehiɛ, ni ekɛ bo ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ koni oye maŋtsɛ yɛ biɛ. Akɛni o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ miidɔ Israel he ni eeesumɔ akɛ ebaa amɛyi kɛya naanɔ lɛ, no hewɔ eto bo Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ koni okojo, ni oye jalɛsane yɛ amɛteŋ."

Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ ke maŋtsɛ Solomon shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ tsofakɛŋma pii diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ojrawatɛi hu. Anako tsofakɛŋma ni tamɔ nɔ ni sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛbake Maŋtsɛ Solomon lɛ eko dã.
Maŋtsɛ Hiram tsuji lɛ kɛ Solomon hu tsuji lɛ ni yaa Ofir amɛyaŋɔɔ shika kɛbaa lɛ, loɔ tso kpakpa titri ko hu kɛbaa kɛ ojrawatɛi hu.
Ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ tso lɛ fee atrakpoi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ hu mli. Akɛ eko hu fee saŋkui kɛ obentai akɛhã lalɔi lɛ. Anako nibii nɛɛ ahenɔ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dã.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni maŋnyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ je gbɛ ebi, dani sro nii ni Solomon diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ, ni ekɛ etsuji yiŋ tee Sheba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shika ŋmiiŋmi ni ba Maŋtsɛ Solomon dɛŋ yɛ afi mli lɛ tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa;
dani sro shika ni jrayelɔi kɛ guɔyelɔi lɛ hu kɛbaa lɛ. Arabia maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ amralofoi ni kwɛɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpokpai lɛ anɔ lɛ hu bahãa Maŋtsɛ Solomon shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã atswia shika, ni akɛfee tsɛŋi agboi ohai enyɔ. Tsɛŋi nɛɛ ekome ye shika ni tsiimɔ ji kiloi kpawo.
Afee tsɛŋi bibii ohai etɛ̃ hu ni ekome yeɔ shika kiloi etɛ̃. Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ tsɛŋi nɛɛ yato Lebanon Kooŋ Tsu lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã akɛ shwuɔ wu fee maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i kpeteŋkple ko, ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha he.
Akwɔɔ atrakpoi ekpaa dani ashɛɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i nɛɛ he; ni nane shi maŋoo ni akɛ shika eha he hu ma maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ. Nine yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ he biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni jata ni ashɔ kome damɔ sɛi lɛ nine masɛi.
Ato jatai ni ashɔ̃ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ amamɔ atrakpoi ekpaa lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Atrakpoi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko naabu yɛ ekoŋgbɛ lɛ, jata kome ma jɛi. Afeko nii nɛɛ henɔ pɛŋ yɛ maŋtsɛ ko maŋtsɛ ko yinɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kpuji fɛɛ ni ekɛnuɔ nii lɛ shika akɛfee. Tsɛnsii kɛ amɛhenɔi nibii fɛɛ hu ni yɔɔ Lebanon Kooŋ Tsu lɛ mli lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi nɔŋŋ akɛfee. Solomon yinɔ lɛ abuuu jwiɛtɛi ahãaa fɛifɛi.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ lɛji ni fata Maŋtsɛ Hiram lɛji lɛ ahe kɛyaa Tarshish kɛbaa. Daa afii etɛ̃ lɛ Solomon lɛji lɛ jɛɔ Tarshish baa ni amɛhiɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shwuɔwu kɛ ofoi kɛ aŋfraŋi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ ko maŋtsɛ ko kɛ Solomon yeee egbɔ yɛ ninamɔ kɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ tao akɛ amɛ kɛ Solomon akpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ kɛbo enilee ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛdro lɛ lɛ toi.
Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛɔ edɛŋ nikee kɛbaa: jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii kɛ atadei kɛ tawuunii kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi; ni nɛkɛ akɛ nibii nɛɛ yaa ni abaa daa afi.

Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon yɛ tayaa shwiilii okpɔŋɔi atsui akpei ejwɛ, dani eyɛ tabilɔi okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi hu akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Eto amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ ehe yɛ Yerusalem, ni fãbii ni shwɛ lɛ ejra amɛ ewo maji krokomɛi amli.
Maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ Solomon shishi kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Egipt husui lɛ anɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã jwitɛi bu tamɔ tɛ yɛ Yerusalem, ni ehã tsenedru tsei tsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ sikamore tsei ni yɔɔ Israel gɔji ajɔiaŋ shikpɔŋ anɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon shɛɔ okpɔŋɔi kɛjɛɔ Egipt kɛ maŋsɛɛ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ kɛbaa.

Maŋtsɛ Solomon he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, aŋmla kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyata enaagbee yɛ woji ni agbɛii baa nɛɛ amli: Natan he Saji Awolo lɛ, kɛ Ahia, Shilonyo Gbalɔ lɛ, kɛ Gbalɔ Ido Ninaa lɛ ni ji wolo lɛ ni wieɔ Nebat bi Yeroboam Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hu he lɛ.
Solomon ye Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Solomon tsɔ̃ esɛɛ, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛ David maŋ lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni ebi Rehoboam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
10: Rehoboam yiŋ etee Shekem ejaakɛ Kooyigbɛ Akutsei lɛ fɛɛ anaa ebakpe shi yɛ jɛi koni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ.
Be ni Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, nu he yɛ Egipt, he ni ejo Maŋtsɛ Solomon naa foi kɛtee eyatee yɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ eba.
Kɛkɛ ni Kooyigbɛ Akutsei lɛ tsu koni ayakpee Yeroboam abahã amɛ; ni amɛ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ tee amɛkɛ Rehoboam yawie akɛ,
"Jatsu ni otsɛ hã wɔtre lɛ tsii tsɔ̃ kwraa. Kɛji ogbɔ̃ sɔɔmɔ ni otsɛ hã wɔsɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni shihilɛ mli fee mɛlɛo ehã wɔ lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔsɔmɔ bo."
Rehoboam hã amɛ hetoo akɛ, "Nyɛhãa mi gbii etɛ̃ koni nyɛbahea sane lɛ hetoo." Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam tsɛ hii onukpai ni sɔmɔ etsɛ Solomon akɛ ŋaawolɔi lɛ ajina, ni ebi amɛ ŋaawoo ni ekɛɛ, "Te mihã maŋbii lɛ asane lɛ hetoo mikɛɛ tɛŋŋ?"
Hii onukpai lɛ jie maŋtsɛ lɛ naa akɛ, "Kɛji omli hi hã maŋbii nɛɛ, ni ofee nii ni sa amɛhiɛ ni ohã amɛ naajɔlɛ hetoo lɛ, no lɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ mɔ otsuji daanɛ."
Shi Rehoboam shi ŋaa ni hii onukpai lɛ wo lɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekɛ obalahii ni ji etipɛŋfoi, ni asaŋ amɛ amɛji eŋaawolɔi agbɛnɛ lɛ tee sane lɛ he ajina.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ ŋaa nyɛwoɔ mi? Mɛɛ hetoo mihãa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni ebabi mi akɛ migbɔ̃ sɔɔmɔ ni mitsɛ hã amɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ?"

Oblahii lɛ ni ji maŋtsɛ lɛ tipɛŋfoi lɛ kɛɛ Rehoboam akɛ. "Mɛi ni bakɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Jatsu ni otsɛ hã wɔtre lɛ tsii tsɔ̃ kwraa, shi bo lɛ gbɔ̃ nɔ koni efee mɛlɛo ehã wɔ' lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Miwaosɛɛkpelɔ ti fe mitsɛ hɛ tete.
Mitsɛ tre nyɛ jatsu ni tsii; shi mibaŋmɛ jatsu lɛ nɔ, ni ebatsii aahuu fe mitsɛ kplebi baagwao nyɛ.'"
Be ni gbii etɛ̃ lɛ shɛ lɛ Yeroboam kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ba Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam ŋɔɔ bɔ ni eto amɛ lɛ.
Shi Rehoboam kɛ maŋbii lɛ ewieee kɛ naajɔlɛ. Ekwa ŋaa ni hii onukpai lɛ wo lɛ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam ŋɔ oblahii lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mitsɛ tre nyɛ jatsu ni tsii shi mijatsu lɛ baatsii aahuu fe mitsɛ nɔ lɛ. Mitsɛ kɛ kpãa yi nyɛ; shi mi lɛ mikɛ kplebi baagwao nyɛ."
Belɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam booo maŋbii lɛ toi ejaakɛ nyɔŋmɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ ni, bɔ ni afee koni wiemɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Ahia, Shilonyo lɛ, nɔ ni ekɛ Nebat bi Yeroboam wie lɛ aba mli.

Be ni Israel fɛɛ na akɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam booo amɛ toi lɛ, maŋ lɛ to he ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ weku wɔ kɛ David kɛ eshwiei yɔɔ? "Wɔkɛ Ishai shwiei lɛ bɛ weku! Israel hii nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔshīaīaŋ. Agbɛnɛ David we akwɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe sane ni eye!" Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ yiŋ amɛtee amɛshīai amli,
ni amɛshi Rehoboam koni eye Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yuda majimaji lɛ amli lɛ amaŋtsɛ.

Fee sɛɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam tsu Hadoram, mɔ ni kwɛɔ gbɔmɛi ni anyɛɔ amɛnɔ amɛtsuɔ nii lɛ anɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ. Shi Israelbii lɛ tswia Hadoram tɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ. Enɛ hã Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam he fee oya ni eyabote shwiili mli, ni ejo foi kɛba Yerusalem.
Kɛjɛ nakai gbii lɛ anɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, be fɛɛ be lɛ Israel kooyigbɛ Akutsei lɛ tseɔ David we lɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hiɛ atua.
11: Be ni Rehoboam shɛ Yerusalem lɛ, ebua Yuda kɛ Benyamin akutsei lɛ amli hii tabilɔi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ anaa. Eyiŋtoo ji akɛ ekɛ Israel kooyigbɛ akutsei lɛ miiya ayawu ta koni akutsei lɛ abaje emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishi ekoŋŋ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Gbalɔ Shemaia akɛ,
eyakɛɛ Solomon bi Rehobaom ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin akutsei lɛ amli bii fɛɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛkayaa ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ yawua ta. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akpale aya ewe, ejaakɛ mi mihã nɔ ni eba lɛ ba." Amɛbo Yehowa toi, ni nɔ hewɔ lɛ amɛyaaa dɔŋŋ koni amɛkɛ Yeroboam ayawu.
Rehoboam hi Yerusalem, ni ehã atswa gbogboi awo Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji wuji ni agbɛii baa nɛɛ ahe, ni akɛ wajewajee amɛ:
Betlehem kɛ Etam kɛ Tekoa,
kɛ Bet-Zur kɛ Soko kɛ Adulam,
Kɛ Gat kɛ Maresha kɛ Zif,
kɛ Adoriam kɛ Lakish kɛ Azeka,
kɛ Zora kɛ Ayalon kɛ Hebron.
Ehã awaje maji wuji nɛɛ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni eto tatsɛnukpa koni ekwɛ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ; asaŋ ebua niyenii kɛ mu kɛ wain hu naa eto eko fɛɛ eko mli, kɛ
agbɛnɛ tsɛŋi kɛ akplɔi fɛɛ. Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ Rehoboam ye Yuda kɛ Benyamin akutsei lɛ anɔ.
Osɔfoi kɛ Levibii ni yɔɔ Israel kooyigbɛ kpokpai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba wuoyi ni amɛkɛ amɛhe badɔmɔ Yuda.
Levibii nɛɛ shi amɛŋmɔji kɛ shikpɔji, ni amɛba Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni ba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ koni amɛtsu amɛnii akɛ Yehowa osɔfoi.
Yeroboam wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esɔfoi koni amɛsɔmɔ yɛ wɔji ajamɔhei lɛ kɛ tsinabi amãgãi ni efee lɛ.
Enɛ hã mɛi fɛɛ ni miitao akɛ amɛja Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, anɔkwale mli lɛ, fã kɛjɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli kɛba Yerusalem bɔ ni afee ni amɛnyɛ amɛshã afɔle amɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ abaa lɛ bawo Solomon bi Rehoboam maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewalɛ yɛ Yuda, ni amɛhã ehi shi shweshweeshwe afii etɛ̃ ejaakɛ amɛhi shi bɔ pɛ ni amɛhi shi yɛ David kɛ Solomon yinɔi lɛ amli lɛ.
Rehoboam ŋɔ Mahalat akɛ eŋa. Mahalat tsɛ ji David bi Yeremot, ni enyɛ ji Abihai ni ji Ishai bi Eliab biyoo lɛ.
Amɛfɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yeush kɛ Shemaria kɛ Zaham.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Rehoboam yaŋɔ Maaka, Abasalom biyoo lɛ, hu akɛ eŋa, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Abia kɛ Atai kɛ Ziza kɛ Shelomit.

Ŋamɛi fɛɛ ni Rehoboam ŋɔ ayifalɛ ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni eto hemɛi hu nyɔŋmai ekpaa. Efɔ bihii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ biyei hu nyɔŋmai ekpaa. Rehobaom sumɔ Absalom biyoo Maaka lɛ fe fɛɛ yɛ eŋamɛi kɛ ehemɛi lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ.
Asaŋ ewo ekɛ Maaka bi Abia lɛ onukpa kɛ lumɔ hã enyɛmimɛi lɛ ejaakɛ Rehoboam to eyiŋ akɛ eeewo lɛ maŋtsɛ koni eye esɛɛ.

Rehoboam yɛ hiɛshikamɔ sane akɛ ejra ebihii lɛ fɛɛ ewowoo Yuda kɛ Benyamin shikpɔji lɛ anɔ maji wuji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ amli akɛ lumɛi. Ehã amɛ niyenii babaoo, asaŋ ebibii yei babaoo ashi ehã amɛ akɛ eŋamɛi.
12: Be ni Rehoboam maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ema shi, ni ena hewalɛ lɛ, lɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ fɛɛ gbo Yehowa mlai lɛ anɔ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam yinɔ afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛni amɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, Egipt Maŋtsɛ Shishak batua Yerusalem
kɛ tayaa shwiilii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ, kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa. Ni tabilɔi ni ekɛjɛ Egipt kɛba ta lɛ amɛyi babaoo ni ehiii kanemɔ. Libiabii kɛ Shubbii kɛ Etiopiabii fɛɛ shi nɔ.
Shishak shɔ̃ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ, kɛkɛ ni efã koni ebatua Yerusalem.

Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Shemaia tee ni eyanina Rehoboam kɛ Yuda maŋonukpai ni ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalem yɛ Shishak hewɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ,'Nyɛkwa mi, no hewɔ lɛ mi hu miŋmɛɛ nyɛhe mihã Shishak,'"
Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kplɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa sane ja."

Be ni Yehowa na akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ eje amɛhe sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Gbalɔ Shemaia akɛ, "Amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ mikpataŋ amɛhiɛ, shi mibahere amɛ fioo ko kɛji Shishak batua maŋ lɛ koni Shishak akafee Yerusalem butuu yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa.
Kɛ̃lɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ Shishak tsuji bɔ ni afee ni amɛna srɔto ni yɔɔ mi sɔɔmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu sɔɔmɔ teŋ."
Egipt Maŋtsɛ Shishak batua Yerusalem, ni eloo Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛŋ jwetrii lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛŋ hu jwetrii fɛɛ, kɛ shika tsɛŋi ni Solomon fee lɛ hu kɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam hã afee akɔɔblae tsɛŋi akɛto shika tsɛŋi lɛ anajiaŋ; ni etu akɔɔble tsɛŋi nɛɛ ewo mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ agboi lɛ anaa lɛ asafoitsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ.
Ni be fɛɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ miiya Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ, bulɔi lɛ yaklɔɔ tsɛŋi nɛɛ amɛhiɛɔ, ni kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ amɛkpaleɔ kɛyaa amɛkɛyatoɔ bulɔi atsu lɛ mli.
Akɛ ni Rehoboam ba ehe shi ehã Yehowa hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋmɛɛ emli ni fu Rehoboam lɛ he, ni ekpãtãaa nibii ahiɛ tsɔ̃ ko, ni no hewɔ lɛ nibii shwere kɛ̃ yɛ Yuda.

Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam nane mɔ shi yɛ Yerusalem, ni eye emaŋtsɛ lɛ. Rehoboam eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome be ni ni ebɔi emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye emaŋtsɛ lɛ afi nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo yɛ Yerusalem, ni ji maŋ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ kɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ ateŋ akɛ he krɛdɛɛ ni aja lɛ yɛ lɛ. Rehoboam nyɛ gbɛi ji Naama, ni Amonyoo ji lɛ.
Rehoboam fee nɔ ni ejaaa ejaakɛ ekɛ etsui efɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ eeetao koni ele nɔ ni ji Yehowa suɔmɔnaanii.
Rehoboam he saji lɛ aŋmla kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyata naagbee yɛ Gbalɔ Shemaia kɛ Ninalɔ Idomei ahe saji lɛ amli. Be fɛɛ be lɛ ta kã Yeroboam kɛ Rehoboam teŋ.
Rehoboam tsɔ̃ esɛɛ ni afu lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ. Ebinuu Abia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
13: Be ni Yeroboam na afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni awo Abia hu akɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ.
Abia ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem afii etɛ̃. Abia nyɛ gbɛi ji Milkaia ni ji Uriel ni jɛ Gibea maŋ lɛ mli lɛ biyoo lɛ. Ta te shi yɛ Abia kɛ Yeroboam teŋ.
Abia hiɛ hii kãkãlɔi akpei ohai ejwɛ ni eje gbɛ ehala kɛtee ta lɛ Yerobaom hu kɛ hii tabilɔi akpei ohai kpaanyɔ gba ta koni amɛkɛ Abia akpe.

Tai enyɔ lɛ yakpe yɛ Efraim gɔji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Abia tee eyadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ eko ni gbɛi ji Zemaraim Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ, ni ebo etsɛ Yeroboam kɛ Israel ta lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Agoo! Yeroboam kɛ Israel hii!
Nyɛleee kwraa akɛ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ ni emli ehiii kuu ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ David Kpãŋ naa lɛ Yehowa jɔɔ Israel maŋtsɛyeli nɔ ehã David kɛ eshwiei kɛmiiya naanɔ lo?
Shi Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ te shi, ni etsɛ enuŋtsɔ Solomon ni ji David bi lɛ hiɛ atua.
Ena hii fɔɔji kɛ yakagbɔmɛi efata ehe kɛwo lɛ hewalɛ, ni akɛni nakai be mli lɛ Rehoboam edako, asaŋ ehiɛ waaa hu hewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ amɛ.
Ŋmɛnɛ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛte shi kɛmiishi hewalɛ ni Yehowa ejɔɔ nɔ ehã David shwiei lɛ ejaakɛ nyɛyi fa, ni asaŋ nyɛhiɛ shika tsinabii lɛ ni Yeroboam fee hã nyɛ akɛ nyɛ-nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

Te nyɛshwie Aaron shwiei ni ji mɛi ni yeɔ Yehowa osɔfo lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu, ni nyɛwowoo nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛsɔfoi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni shikpɔji krokomɛi lɛ anɔ bii feɔ lɛ? Te mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hiɛɔ edɛŋ tsina oblayoo loo ojwɛnii kpawo kɛba lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ awo lɛ nakai nibii ni jeee Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ni lɛ osɔfo?
"Wɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni wɔkwako lɛ. Aaron shwiei lɛ ji mɛi ni yeɔ osɔfo, ni amɛsɔmɔɔ Yehowa yɛ wɔteŋ, ni Levibii lɛ hiɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ amli amɛmiitsu pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ amɛshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa Yehowa. Amɛkɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ maa ehiɛ yɛ okplɔ̃ ni atsuu he lɛ nɔ, ni daa gbɛkɛ lɛ amɛsuɔ shika kanetso lɛ nɔ kanei lɛ. Wɔ lɛ, wɔhiɛ mli wɔmiifee nibii ni Yehowa eto akɛ afee lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkwa Yehowa.

Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ, ni lɛ enyiɛ wɔta lɛ hiɛ asaŋ esɔfoi lɛ hu yɛ biɛ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi, ni amɛbaakpã kɛbɔ tawuu oshe amɛwo nyɛ. Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛkakaa kwraa akɛ nyɛkɛ Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ baawu ta. Nyɛyeŋ kunim kɔkɔɔkɔ."

Be mli ni enɛ yaa nɔ lɛ, asomoaŋ Yeroboam ewo tabilɔi gbɛ koni amɛlɔgɔ Yudabii lɛ kɛyawo amɛ ka yɛ amɛsɛɛgbɛ. No mli lɛ Israel ta tso muu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egba ta kɛmiikwɛ Yudabii ata lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, ni ta lɛ fã ko hu ewo Yudabii lɛ aka yɛ amɛsɛɛgbɛ.
