Yudabii lɛ yaakwɛ lɛ naa amɛ ni awo amɛ teŋ. No hewɔ lɛ amɛblɔ kɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni osɔfoi lɛ kpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ,
Kɛkɛ ni Yudabii lɛ bɔ oshe. Abia kɛ Yudabii lɛ fã kɛyatua Israelbii lɛ yɛ oshebɔɔ lɛ mli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ye Yeroboam kɛ Israelbii lɛ anɔ kunim.
Israel tabilɔi lɛ jo foi yɛ Yudabii lɛ ahiɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã Yudabii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ.
Abia kɛ Yudabii lɛ ye Israelbii lɛ anɔ butuu kwraa. Israel hii kãkãbaŋi lɛ ateŋ akpei ohai enumɔ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Belɛ Yudabii lɛ ye Israelbii lɛ anɔ kunim ejaakɛ Yudabii lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ Yehowa ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Abia tiu Yeroboam kɛ etabilɔi lɛ kɛ eta lɛ, ni eyashɔ maji komɛi yɛ edɛŋ. Maji nɛɛ ji Betel kɛ Yeshana kɛ Efron, amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe akrowai hu.
Yeroboam hewalɛ gbɔjɔ kɛjɛ ta nɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ Abia yinɔ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abia tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu. Eŋɔ yei nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ akɛ ŋamɛi, ni efɔ bihii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ biyei hu nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa.
Abia wala he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ ni ji wiemɔi ni ewie kɛ nibii ni efee aŋmla yɛ Gbalɔ Ido wala he sane wolo lɛ mli.
14: Maŋtsɛ Abia tsɔ̃ esɛɛ, ni afu lɛ yɛ david Maŋ lɛ mli. Ebi Asa baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ, ni eyinɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋma.
Asa jeŋba sa Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ ejaakɛ efee nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja hu.
Egu maŋsɛɛ jemawɔji lɛ ajamɔhei lɛ hu, asaŋ ekumɔ shiui ni amamɔ lɛ, ni eflɔ Ashera jemawɔŋ lɛ tsei lɛ eshwie shi.
Kɛkɛ ni efã Yudabii fɛɛ akɛ amɛja Yehowa, ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ asaŋ amɛye emlai lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ anɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Asa gu maŋsɛɛ jemawɔji ajamɔhei lɛ kɛ latɛi ni akɛshãa tsofakɛŋma akɛhãa amɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ amli. Enɛ hã toiŋjɔlɛ ba emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli yɛ eshishi.
Ena hiɛ kɛtswa gbogbo ewo Yuda maji lɛ ekomɛi ahe ekɛwaje amɛ ejaakɛ afii babaoo ni ta bɛ eyinɔ ejaakɛ Yehowa hã etoiŋ jɔ lɛ.

Ekɛɛ Yudabii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔtswaa gbogboi wɔwoa maji nɛɛ ahe, ni wɔmamɔa mɔji hu wɔwoa amɛmli; asaŋ wɔtra amɛnaa agboi, ni wɔwo amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi koni wɔkɛwaje amɛ be mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɔ ni ekã shi ehã wɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ wɔfee nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ lɛ. Wɔfee esuɔmɔnaanii, no hewɔ lɛ ehã wɔhe ejɔ wɔ yɛ wɔhe fɛɛ he." No hewɔ lɛ Yudabii lɛ wajewajee maji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ shwere jogbaŋŋ.

Maŋtsɛ Asa yɛ tabilɔi akpei ohai etɛ̃ yɛ Yuda ni amɛji amɛhe hii ni hiɛɔ tsɛŋi wuji kɛ akplɔ; ni eyɛ tabilɔi akpei ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ yɛ Benyamin, ni amɛ lɛ amɛhiɛɔ tsɛŋi bibii, ni amɛtsɛ̃ɔ gãi. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ ji amɛhe hii kakabaŋi ni aje gbɛ atsɔse.
Kɛkɛ ni Sudannyo ko ni gbɛi ji zera lɛ fã ta kɛba koni ebatua Yuda bii. Ehiɛ tabilɔi akpe toi akpe kɛ tayaa shwiilii hu ohai etɛ̃; ni eba aahuu kɛbashɛ Maresha tɔ̃ɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Asa hu fã kɛ etabilɔi koni ekɛ Zera eyakpe. Biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ gba ta yɛ Zefata Jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Maresha.

Kɛkɛ ni Asa sɔle etsɛ Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ. "Ao! Yehowa, bo lɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni eyeɔ ebuaa hewalɔ kɛ mɔ ni bɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ofeɔ. Ŋmlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli lɛ ye obua wɔ, Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ bo onɔ wɔhiɛ kã, ni asaŋ bo ogbɛi mli wɔba yɛ wɔkɛ ta kpeteŋkple nɛɛ baawu. Ao! Yehowa, boji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kaahã adesa ko nine miitsɔ̃ wɔnɔ."
Yehowa ye Sudanbii ata lɛ nɔ be ni Asa kɛ Yudabii kɛ amɛ bɔi nɔmɔ lɛ, ni Sudanbii lɛ jo foi.

Asa kɛ ta ni fata ehe lɛ tiu Sudanbii lɛ kɛyashi Gerar tɔ̃ɔ. Sudanbii lɛ nyɔnyɔɔ bɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ hiɛkalɔ kome po, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ Asa ta lɛ fee Sudanbii lɛ butuu. Yuda tabilɔi lɛ ha nii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛtee.
Amɛkpãtã maji fɛɛ ni bɔle Gerar lɛ ahiɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa he ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ maji nɛɛ fɛɛ amli bii lɛ. Ni Yudabii lɛ ha maji lɛ fɛɛ amli nii ejaakɛ haanii babaoo yɛ amɛmli.
Amɛtua kooloolɛlɔi komɛi hu yɛ amɛshitoohei amli, ni amɛloo amɛtoi kɛ yomai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛtee, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalem.
15: Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ ba Obed bi Azaria nɔ,

ni eyiŋ etee koni ekɛ Maŋtsɛ Asa ayakpe. Be ni amɛkpe lɛ Azaria kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ Asa kɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin fɛɛ, nyɛboa mi toi. Gbii abɔ ni nyɛmiibo Yehowa toi lɛ, lɛ hu ekɛ nyɛ yɛ. Kɛji nyɛtao lɛ lɛ nyɛbaana lɛ, shi kɛji nyɛkwa lɛ lɛ, lɛ hu ebaakwa nyɛ.
Israel hi shi be kplaŋŋ ni ebɛ anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ebɛ osɔfoi ni tsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ anii, ni ebɛ mla hu.
Shi be ni fimɔ ba, ni amɛkpale kɛyatao Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ lɛ amɛna lɛ.
Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ mɔ ni miiya ni jio, mɔ ni miiba ni jio, amɛ fɛɛ amɛbɛ hejɔlɛ, ejaakɛ kpookpai fɛɛ anɔ ejɔɔɔ kɛ basabasa nifeemɔi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ateŋ egbla kuikui ejaakɛ jaku ete shi ewo jaku, ni maŋ kome kɛ maŋ kome miitswa, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ jramɔ srɔtoi miiye amɛtsui.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfia shi, ni nyɛnijiaŋ akajea wui ejaakɛ nɔ ni nyɛtsuɔ nɛɛ efeŋ yaka."

Be ni Asa nu gbalɛ ni Obed bi Azaria gba lɛ, ena ekãa, ni egu musubɔɔ amãgãi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin shikpɔji lɛ anɔ hei fɛɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ maji ni eshɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ lɛ fɛɛ hu amli. Esaa Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ koi lɛ hiɛ lɛ.

Mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni ji Efraimbii kɛ Manasebii kɛ Simeonbii tse amɛhe kɛjɛ Israel, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe badɔmɔ Maŋtsɛ Asa be ni amɛna akɛ Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ. Maŋtsɛ Asa tsɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ Yudabii kɛ Benyaminbii fɛɛ kpee.
Amɛnaa babua yɛ Yerusalem yɛ Asa maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛkɛ ta mli haanii ni amɛkɛba shīa lɛ mli tsinai ohai kpawo kɛ toi akpei kpawo shã afɔle amɛkɛhã Yehowa nakai gbi lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, amɛkã kitã akɛ amɛbaaja Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛtsui kɛ amɛyitsoŋ fɛɛ,
ni asaŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jaaa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ lɛ gbekɛ ni jio, onukpa ni jio, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, abaagbe lɛ.
Amɛkɛ gbee walɛ kã Yehowa kitã lɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛbɔ oshe, ni akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ kɛ koofɛŋ.
Yuda tso muu fɛɛ nya kitã ni amɛkã lɛ he akɛ amɛjɛ amɛtsuiŋ fɛɛ ni amɛkã; ejaakɛ amɛtao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ, ni amɛna lɛ. Yehowa hã amɛna toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ amɛhe fɛɛ he kɛkpe.

Maŋtsɛ Asa kpa enyɛ Maaka tete po akɛ maŋnyɛ ejaakɛ Maaka fee hiɛgbejianii, no ji akɛ ema amãgã ehã jemawɔŋ Ashera lɛ. Asa kumɔ amãgã ni enyɛ ma lɛ, ni ejwara lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ ni eyashã amãgã lɛ yɛ Kidron Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ Asa naaa egu jemawɔji ajamɔhei ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ eye Yehowa anɔkwa ewala beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Eyaŋɔ nibii fɛɛ ni etsɛ ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ekɛhã Yehowa, kɛ agbɛnɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi nibiinibii ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ekɛhã Yehowa lɛ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ta ko ta ko baaa aahuu kɛyashi Asa maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ.
16: Be ni Maŋtsɛ Asa na afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa akɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, Baasha ni ji Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ fã ta koni ebatua Yuda; ni ebɔi Rama maŋ lɛ wajemɔ kɛ gbogbo bɔ ni afee ni esa Yuda yi koni akanyɛ jɛi atee ni ajɛ jɛi aba hu.
Ni fee nakai lɛ Asa jie Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ nitoohe lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ eko, ni ekɛtsu koni akɛyahã Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad yɛ Damasko. Shɛɛ ni fata shika lɛ he ji akɛ,

"Kpãŋmɔ kã mi kɛ bo teŋ akɛ nanemɛi tamɔ bɔ ni eko hi mitsɛ kɛ bo hu otsɛ teŋ lɛ. Naa jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni mimaje bo. Kuu kpãŋmɔ ni kã okɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha teŋ lɛ mli koni ekɛ etabilɔi lɛ aje mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aya."
Ben-Hadad kplɛ̃ nɔ ehã Asa, ni ewo etatsɛmɛi agbɛ ni amɛyatua Israel maji komɛi. Amɛshɔ̃ Iyon kɛ Dan kɛ Abel-Main kɛ Naftali kpokpai lɛ anɔ maji ni atoɔ niyenii yɛ amɛmli lɛ fɛɛ.
Be ni Baasha nu he lɛ ekpa nitsumɔ ni etsuɔ ekɛwajeɔ Rama lɛ, ni etee.
kɛkɛ ni Asa bua hii anaa kɛjɛ Yuda hiehei fɛɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ tee, ni ayaloo tɛi kɛ mplaŋ ni Baasha kɛtsuɔ nii ekɛwajeɔ Rama lɛ, ni ekɛtee ekɛyatswa gbogbo ewo Geba kɛ Mizpa maji lɛ ahe ekɛwaje amɛ.

Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Gbalɔ Hanani ba Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Akɛni okɛ ohe fɔ̃ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ, shi okɛ ohe eyafɔɔɔ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ hewɔ lɛ bɛ ona akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ta lɛ je odɛŋ?
Ani Sudanbii lɛ kɛ Libiabii lɛ ayi faaa kwraa fe amɛ, asaŋ kɛ amɛtayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi hu babaoo diɛŋtsɛ? Shi te ni nakai be lɛ okɛ ohe fɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, ehã oye amɛnɔ kunim?
Yehowa, ehiŋmɛi kã je lɛ fɛɛ he, ni ehãa mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ lɛ anɔkwa kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ naa hewalɛ. Oye kwashiai asane pam, ni no hewɔ lɛ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ taitai sɔŋŋ ahe obaakã."
Gbalɛ nɛɛ hã Asa mli fu moŋ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehã awo gbalɔ lɛ gboklɛ yɛ mɔɔŋ. Be nɛɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Asa bɔi maŋbii lɛ ekomɛi niseniianiifeemɔ.
Asa wala mli saji lɛ aŋmla kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyashi naagbee fɛɛ yɛ Yuda kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Nane hela ko bamɔ Asa yɛ efi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ nɛɛhu akɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ. Hela lɛ mli bawo wu, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Asa eyatiuuu Yehowa dɛŋ tsamɔ sɛɛ; shi moŋ eyadi tsofatsɛmɛi asɛɛ.
Asa tsɔ̃ esɛɛ yɛ efi ni ji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ,
ni afu lɛ yɛ gbonyobu ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekpɛ eto lɛ mli yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli. Tsofakɛŋmai kpakpai srɔtoistɔtoi diɛŋtsɛ akɛsaa egbonyo lɛ, ni ashɛre la gregre kpeteŋkple akɛfee eyara.
17: Yehoshafat baye etsɛ Asa sɛɛ akɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni ewaje ehe eto Israel.
Eto tabilɔi ta muu yɛ Yuda maji wuji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ amli, ni eto tabilɔi kuikui hu yɛ Yuda koiasɛɛ heihei kɛ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji wuji ni etsɛ shɔ̃ lɛ hu amli.
Yehowa jɔɔ Yehoshafat ejaakɛ ehi shi tamɔ etsɛ hi shi be ni eje emaŋtsɛyeli shishi lɛ; ni eyajaaa jemawɔji.
Eja etsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni eye ekitãi lɛ anɔ; ni eyabaaa ejeŋ tamɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã Yehoshafat maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewalɛ he shi yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni abake lɛ nii babaoo, ni ena nii jogbaŋŋ, ni ehiɛ hu ba nyam.
Ni akɛni eye Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ he awuŋa hewɔ lɛ, egu hei ni ajaa jemawɔji yɛ fɛɛ, ni asaŋ eflɔ jemawɔŋ yoo Ashera lɛ tsei lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ Yuda.
Be ni ena efi ni ji etɛ̃ akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ Yehoshafat wo lumɛi komɛi gbɛ koni amɛya Yuda maji lɛ anɔ amɛyatɔ̃ɔ mɛi nii. Lumɛi nɛɛ ji Ben-Hail kɛ Obadia kɛ Zakaria kɛ Netanel kɛ Mikaia.

Levibii nɛɛhu kɛ osɔfoi enyɔ fata gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe kɛtee. Levibii nɛɛ ji Shemaia kɛ Netania kɛ Zebadia kɛ Asahel kɛ Shemiramot kɛ Yehonatan kɛ Adonia kɛ Tobia kɛ Tob-Adonia. Ni osɔfoi lɛ ji Elishama kɛ Yehoram.
Amɛhiɛ Yehowa Mla Wolo lɛ, ni amɛkɛkpa Yuda maji blublu amli amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ nii.
Yehowa he ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ shikpɔji fɛɛ ni bɔle Yuda lɛ anɔ bii, no hewɔ lɛ eko kwraa ekaaa akɛ ekɛ Yehoshafat aaawu ta.

Filistibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ nibii krokomɛi babaoo bakɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat yɛ ehiɛsɔlɛ hewɔ. Arabiabii komɛi hu bakɛ lɛ ojwɛnii akpei kpawo kɛ ohai kpawo, kɛ abotia hii hu akpei kpawo kɛ ohai kpawo.
Yehoshafat agbojee lɛ tee nɔ shwere. Emamɔ mɔji kɛ nitoohei yɛ Yuda hei fɛɛ,
ni etīa niyenii babaoo etotoo maji nɛɛ amli. Eto hii kãkãlɔi yɛ Yerusalem;
ni bɔ ni ehala amɛ kɛjɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli ehã lɛ nɛ: Adna ji Yuda akutso lɛŋ tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ atatsɛ nukpa, ni eyɛ hii kakabãŋi akpei ohai etɛ̃ yɛ eshishi.
Esɛɛmɔ ji tatsɛ Yehohanan; ehiɛ hii akpei ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ yɛ lɛ eshishi.
Yehohanan sɛɛmɔ ji zikri bi Anasia, mɔ ni jɛ tsuijurɔ naa ekɛ ehe hã Yehowa sɔɔmɔ lɛ; ehiɛ hii akpei ohai enyɔ yɛ eshishi.
Benyamin akutso lɛ mli hii tabliɔi lɛ, amɛtatsɛnukpa ji Eliada, nuu kãkãlɔ kpanaa lɛ. Eyɛ hii ni kɛ gãi kɛ tsɛŋ wuɔ ta akpei ohai enyɔ yɛ eshishi;
Esɛɛmɔ ji Yehozabad kɛ eshishi hii akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ ni aje gbɛ awaje amɛ ahã tawuu.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi sɔmɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Yehashafat yɛ Yerusalem. Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ etotoo tabilɔi yɛ Yuda maji wuji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ amli.
18: Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat na nii jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni egbɛi hehe, ni ewekunyo kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab hu wekunyo bote gblãshihilɛ mli.

Afii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ Yehoshafat yiŋ etee Samaria maŋ lɛ mli ni eyasra Ahab. Ahab gbe toi kɛ tsinai babaoo ekɛfee Yehoshafat kɛ esɛɛbii ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ gbɔ. Ahab bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ egbe Yehoshafat yitso koni eyawa lɛ ni efã ta kɛyatua Ramot-Gilead.
Ahab bi Yehoshafat akɛ, "Bɛ oooyawa mi koni mayatua Ramot-Gilead?" Yehoshafat to he akɛ, "Mifee kralo tamɔ ofee kralo lɛ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ ji mimaŋ lɛ. Wɔ kɛ bo aaatee ta lɛ."
Shi Yehoshafat kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Shi bi Yehowa daaŋ gbee dã."
No hewɔ lɛ Ahab bua gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛkpe. Amɛyibɔ aaafee ohai ejwɛ, ni ebi emɛ akɛ, "Miya miyatua Ramot-Gilead, aloo mikaya?" Gbalɔi lɛ to he akɛ, "Yaa ni oyatua lɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ baahaã oye kunim."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat bi akɛ, "Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ dɔŋŋ ni wɔɔbi Yehowa daaŋ gbee kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ lo?"

Ahab here nɔ akɛ, "Mɔ kome ko yɛ ni kulɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔbi lɛ Yehowa daaŋ gbee. Lɛji Imla bi Mikaia lɛ; shi mitaooo esane ejaakɛ egbako gbalɛ jurɔ yɛ mihe dã, fe be fɛɛ bɛ lɛ efɔŋ egbaa yɛ mihe." Shi Yehoshafat kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Nii akakɛɛ nakai."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahab tsɛ tsulɔ ko, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa ni oyatsɛ Imla bi Mikaia obaha mi mramra."
Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat ewula jogbaŋŋ akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛtra maŋtsɛmɛi asɛii anɔ yɛ ŋmaagbeemɔhe ni yɔɔ Samaria maŋ agbo lɛ naa nɔŋŋ lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ miigbagbaa yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni egbɛi ji Zedekia, ni ji Kenaana bi lɛ, kɛ dade fee akloŋto. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Ahab akɛ, "Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ,'Enɛɛmɛi akɛbaashimɔ Siriabii lɛ Kɛaayashi oooye amɛnɔ kunim.'"
Gbalɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ gba nakai nɔŋŋ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Yaatua Ramot-Gilead, ni obaaye kunim. Yehowa baahã maŋtsɛ aye kunim."
Tsulɔ ni tee eyatsɛ Mikaia lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa efee ekome kɛgba ni ŋɔɔ yɛ Maŋtsɛ toiŋ. No hewɔ lɛ bo hu yaawie wiemɔ ni baaŋɔɔ maŋtsɛ naa nakai nɔŋŋ."
Mikaia kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa yɔɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ baakɛɛ mi lɛ no mibawie."
Be ni Mikaia bashɛ shi lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahab bi lɛ akɛ, "Mikaia, miya Ramot-Gilead miyawu ta aloo mikaya?" Mikaia to he akɛ, "Nyɛyaa! Bɛ nyɛbaaye omanye?"
Shi Ahab kɛɛ Mikaia akɛ, "Shii enyiɛ mawo bo shi akɛ kɛji oogba Yehowa daaŋ gbee ohã mi lɛ, okakɛɛ mi nɔ ko fɛ anɔkwale kɛkɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Mikaia kɛɛ akɛ, "Mina Israel tabilɔi lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ." Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Hii nɛɛ bɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ; amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya ewe yɛ hejɔlɛ mli mɔ."
Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, "Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ egbaŋ gbalɛ jurɔ yɛ mihe kɔkɔɔkɔ akɛ ja gbalɛ fɔŋ?"
Shi Mikaia tee egbalɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "No hewɔ lɛ nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi: Mina Yehowa ni eta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi fɛɛ ewo shi yɛ eninejurɔ nɔ kɛ ebɛku fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ,'Namɔ po aaaya koni eyalaka Israel maŋtsɛ Ahab koni efã ta kɛya Ramot-Gilead koni eyanyɔ yɛ jɛi?' Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ekomɛi miikɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, mɛi komɛi hu miikɛɛ nɛkɛ.
Ahiɛ mli nakai kɛyashi mumɔ ko je kpo, ni ebadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Maye mayalaka lɛ.' Yehowa bi mumɔ nɛɛ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ obaa tsɔ̃?'
Mumɔ lɛ jie naa akɛ, 'Matsɔ̃ Ahab gbalɔi lɛ alilɛi nɔ mahã amɛgba gbalɛ ni amale ni. 'Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mumɔ lɛ akɛ,'Yaa koni oyalaka lɛ; ni onine baashɛ enɔ hu.'
Sane lɛ nɛɛ. Yehowa ehã ogbalɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ emale ehã bo; shi Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ewo shi akɛ okɛ efɔŋ baaya ayakpe."
Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Zedekia, ni ji Kenaana bi lɛ, tsi eba, ni ebagba Mikaia toiŋ ma, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛbe mumɔ lɛ je minɔ, ni ekɛ bo bawie lɛ?"
Mikaia here lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Gbi nɔ ni obaaya oyatee ohe yɛ pia mli lɛ, gbi lɛ obaana ole."
Ni fee nakai lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab fã ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmɔa Mikaia koni nyɛkɛ lɛ ayahãa Amon, maŋ lɛ amralo lɛ, kɛ Yoash, maŋtsɛ binuu lɛ.
Nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ amɛwo lɛ tsuŋ, asaŋ amɛhã lɛ niyenii fioo kɛkɛ kɛ nu hu fioo kɛkɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maya maba kɛ omanye."
Kɛkɛ ni Mikaia to he ehã Ahab ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji otee oba kɛ omanye fīi belɛ jeee Yehowa ni tsɔ̃ minɔ wie lɛ." Asaŋ ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ, "Be nyɛmiibo toi, nyɛ maŋbii fɛɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat fã ta koni amɛyatua Ramot-Gilead.
Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, "Kɛji wɔmiiya ta lɛ tswaa lɛ mibatsake mihewulamɔ; shi bo lɛ owo otadei lɛ nɔŋŋ." No hewɔ lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tee ta lɛ naa ni etsake ehe.
Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ wo etayaa shwiilii lɛ anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko akatswa yɛ ta lɛ mli akɛ ja Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ be ni tayaa shwiilii anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ na Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni; no hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ kɛba koni amɛ lɛ abanɔ. Shi Yehoshafat bo waa etsɛ, ni Yehowa ye bua lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ hã henyɛlɔi lɛ dɔ amɛyi ŋmɛ he kroko,
ejaakɛ be ni tayaa shwiilii asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ na akɛ jeee Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni lɛ, amɛkpale yɛ esɛɛ.

Shi trukaa lɛ gãi ko ni nuu ko tsɛ̃ lɛ yatsu Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ he ni eshishigbɛ dama lɛ kɛ ŋwɛigbɛ dama lɛ kpeɔ yɛ lɛ. Enɛ hã Ahab kɛɛ mɔ ni kudɔɔ eshwiili lɛ akɛ, "Dɔɔ ohe koni okɛ mi ashi ta lɛ naa, shi mipila!"
Ta lɛ naa yawa pam nakai gbi lɛ, shi Maŋtsɛ Ahab hã ahiɛ emli kɛdamɔ eshwiili lɛ mli, ni ekɛ Siriabii lɛ kpe kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi. Aaafee hulushinyɔɔ mli lɛ ni Ahab nyɔ.
19: Yehoshafat ni ji Yuda Maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ shweshweeshwe kɛba ewe lɛ yɛ Yerusalem.

Be ni Yehoshafat baa lɛ gbalɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yehu, Hanani bi lɛ, tee ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yakpe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aso eja gbɛ akɛ owa yitsoŋwalɔ, ni osumɔ mɛi ni nyɛɔ Yehowa lo? Nɔ ni ofee nɛɛ lɛ ehã Yehowa mli efu bo.
Shi ana nibii kpakpai komɛi kɔ̃ yɛ ohe. Eko ji jemawɔŋ Ashera lɛ amãgãi ni okumɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ. Eko hu ji akɛ okɛ otsui fɛɛ eŋmɛ nɔ akɛ obaasɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ."

Yerusalem kwraa ji Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat shihilɛhe. Shi etoɔ be ni afãa gbɛ kɛyanyiɛɔ emaŋbii lɛ anɔ kɛjɛɔ Beersheba aahuu kɛyashiɔ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ bɔ ni afee ni ekpale amɛ koni amɛbaja Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Eto kojolɔi ehã Yuda maji wuji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko,
ni ekɛɛ kojolɔi nɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ kɛji nyɛmiibua sane ko he, ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɛi adɛŋ hewalɛ ahã nyɛ lɛ, shi Yehowa dɛŋ hewalɛ ni; ni eyɛ nyɛmasɛi be mli ni nyɛmiibua sane ko he.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa hegbeyeishemɔ ahia nyɛmli; nyɛkwɛa nyɛnifeemɔnii jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi kutumpɔoyeli kɛ hiɛaŋkwɛmɔ kɛ nyɔɔŋniihemɔ."
Yɛ Yerusalem diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, Yehoshafat hala Levibii komɛi kɛ osɔfoi hu komɛi kɛ agbɛnɛ shīa amli weku nukpai lɛ hu ateiaŋ mɛi komɛi koni amɛkwɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ nɔtɔmɔ saji kɛ maŋbii ateŋ bei hu.
Maŋtsɛ Yeshafat wo kojolɔi nɛɛ kitã ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsua nyɛnii kɛ Yehowa hegbeyeishemɔ kɛ anɔkwayeli shishiishi kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ.

Ni be fɛɛ be ni nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ maji krokomɛi lɛ amli kɛ sane ko aaabahã nyɛ yeli lɛ, gbɔmɔgbee ni jio, mla loo kita loo akpɔ nɔ ni atɔ̃ jio, nyɛtsɔa amɛ mla naa ni abaaye sane lɛ yɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkaye sɔ̃ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni Yehowa mli miifu, ni egbla nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ toi.

Yɛ saji fɛɛ ni kɔɔ Yehowa he gbɛfaŋ lɛ, bɔ ni Amaria, osɔfonukpa lɛ, baabua he lɛ no ji naagbee. Ni saji ni kɔɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he gbɛfaŋ lɛ, bɔni Ishmael bi Zebadia ni ji Yuda amralo lɛ baabua he lɛ no ji naagbee. Levibii lɛ baakwɛ akɛ aaye kojomɔhei lɛ amli buamɔi fɛɛ anɔ. Nyɛfea ekãa kɛtsua nyɛnii; ni Yehowa aye mɔ ni sane yɔɔ mli lɛ sane ehã lɛ!"
20: Be ni bɔfoi komɛi batswa Yehoshafat adafi amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, ta kpeteŋkple ko ejɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Edom kɛba amɛbatua Yuda, ni amɛshɔ̃ Hazazon-Tamar ni ji En-Gedi momo" lɛ,
Yehoshafat she gbeyei. No hewɔ lɛ eto eyiŋ akɛ eeesɔle kɛbi Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ. Enɛ hã efã akɛ ahi ŋmaa yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
kɛkɛ ni Yudabii jɛjɛɛ Yuda maji wuji fɛɛ amli amɛbabua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalem koni atao Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ.
Yuda maji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ hu yabua shi yɛ kpo hee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hiɛ. Ni Yehoshafat ho edamɔ shi yɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ,
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ, boji Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, asaŋ mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ mli maji fɛɛ anɔ. Bo oyɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni baanyɛ bo onaa aku.
Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, oshwie shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ yɛ omaŋ ni ji Israel hiɛ, ni okɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hã oshieŋtsɛ Abraham shwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Amɛshi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bei abɔ; ni amɛma Sɔlemɔtsu yɛ nɔ kɛwo ohiɛ nyam, asaŋ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli akɛ.

kɛji nɔ gbonyo ko, tamɔ ta loo gbele hela loo hɔmɔ, ba wɔnɔ lɛ, wɔbaaba wɔbadamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni ajaa bo yɛ mli lɛ hiɛ, ni wɔbaasɔle kɛbi bo odɛŋ wamɔ yɛ wɔnɔnaa lɛ mli, ni obaabo wɔ toi, ni obaahere wɔyiwala.

"Ŋmɛnɛ, naa Amonbii lɛ kɛ Moabbii lɛ, ni ji Seir Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ, ni amɛbatua wɔ. Be ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ jɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbaa lɛ, ohã amɛtsɔ̃ afã kɛlɔgɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe kɛho, ni no hewɔ lɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ tuaaa amɛ ni amɛaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Nɔ ni amɛkɛdaa wɔ shi ji ba ni amɛto kɛba kɛbashwie wɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni bo okɛhã wɔ akɛ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ.
Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, tɔɔ wɔhe owele ohã wɔ ejaakɛ wɔhe waaa, ni ta kpeteŋkple ni baa wɔnɔ nɛɛ lɛ wɔnyɛŋ amɛhiɛ wɔdamɔ. Ataa, wɔleee bɔ ni wɔɔfee, bo kɛkɛ wɔkwɛɔ nɛɛ."
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yuda hii fɛɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii kɛ hɔi blublu ewo shi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ ba Levinyo ko ni eji Asaf shwie, ni egbɛi ji Yahaziel lɛ nɔ yɛ asafo lɛ teŋ. Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tsɛ ji Zakaria ni ji Matania bi Yeriel bi Benaia bi lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Yahaziel kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, "Nii Maŋtsɛ kɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii fɛɛ ni naa ekpe shi, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nyɛ nɛ, 'Nyɛkashea gbeyei, asaŋ nyɛtsui akafãa hu yɛ ta babaoo nɛɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ta ni abaawu lɛ ebɛ nyɛdɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ eyɔɔ.'
Wɔ̃ ni ji wɔ̃ lɛ, nyɛfãa ta koni nyɛ kɛ amɛ ayakpea. Amɛbaatsɔ̃ Ziz ŋmeŋme lɛ nɔ kɛba. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyaninaa amɛ yɛ jɔɔ lɛ naagbeehe lɛ ni yɔɔ Yeruel shiaŋa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ mli.

Ta nɛɛ lɛ nyɛtswaŋ eko. Nyɛ lɛ nyɛgbaa nyɛta lɛ kɛkɛ koni nyɛdamɔa shi nyɛmɛ koni nyɛkwɛ kunim ni Yehowa baaye ahã nyɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalembii. Nyɛkashea gbeyei, asaŋ nyɛtsui akafãa hu. Wɔ lɛ, nyɛfãa ta koni nyɛ kɛ amɛ ayakpea ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ nyɛ yɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat ma eyi shi ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni Yudabii lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ hu bumɔ shi, ni amɛja Yehowa.
Ni Levibii ni jɛ kohat shwiei lɛ kɛ Kora shwiei lɛ hu ateŋ lɛ ho amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛla kɛ gbee ni wa kɛkafo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

Yuda hii lɛ kɛ Yerusalem hii lɛ fã enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maŋkpa kɛtee Tekoa shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Shi dani amɛfã lɛ Yehoshafat ho edamɔ shi ni ekɛ ta lɛ wie. Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Agoo! Yuda hii kɛ Yerusalem hii, nyɛhea Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛyea, ni nyɛbaanyɛ shi nyɛfi; ni nyɛhea gbalɔi lɛ hu nyɛyea, ni nyɛbaaye omanye."

Be ni Yehoshafat kɛ maŋ lɛ eto ajina sɛɛ lɛ, ehala lalatsɛmɛi komɛi akɛ amɛwula kɛ atadei ni amɛwoɔ yɛ gbii krɔŋkrɔŋi anɔ lɛ koni amɛla kɛjie Yehowa yi kɛnyiɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Ajie Yehowa yi ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo kɛyaa naanɔ!"

Be ni lalatsɛmɛi lɛ wo lamɔ kɛ yijiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã kawolɔi ni aleee he ni amɛjɛ batua mɛi ni eba amɛbaatua Yuda lɛ, ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Amonbii lɛ kɛ Moabbii lɛ kɛ Seir Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ.
Ni amɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu. Kɛkɛ ni no sɛɛ lɛ Amonbii lɛ kɛ Moabbii lɛ sɔŋŋ hu gba wo amɛhe, ni amɛ kɛ amɛhe wu kɛkpãtã amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ butuu.
Be ni Yudabii lɛ yashɛ mɔɔ ko he yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkwɛ he ni henyɛlɔi lɛ baa yɛ lɛ gbɛ lɛ, amɛna akɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ etsɔmɔ gbohii jwere shi ni hiɛkalɔ kome nɛkɛ ejeee amɛmli.

Ni fee nakai lɛ Yehoshafat kɛ etabilɔ lɛ tee ni amɛyaha henyɛlɔi lɛ ahenii. Amɛna tsinai babaoo kɛ atadei kɛ jwinei ni jra wa. Amɛye gbii etɛ̃ ni amɛmiikplɔ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahe nibii, shi nibii nɛɛ fa bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Yudabii lɛ nyɛɛɛ atere.
Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ Yudabii lɛ bubua amɛhe naa yɛ Yijiemɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛjie Yehowa yi yɛ jɛi. Bɔ ni fee ni atsɛɔ jɔɔ nɛɛ akɛ Yijiemɔ Jɔɔ lɛ nɛ.
Yehoshafat nyiɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem kɛ nyamɔ ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã amɛnya yɛ nɔ ni ba amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalem lɛ, amɛtee Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ bɛji kɛ saŋkui kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ heŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ shikpɔji anɔ majimaji fɛɛ be ni amɛnu bɔ ni Yehowa efee Israel henyɛlɔi lɛ yɛ ta mli yɛ Israelbii ahewɔ lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Yehoshafat ye emaŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli ejaakɛ e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã heihei ni bɔlɛ lɛ fɛɛ wooo lɛ naagba ko.
Yehoshafat bɔi Yuda maŋtsɛ yeli be ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ enumɔ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Azub, ni enyɛ tsɛ gbɛi ji Shilhi.
Ehi shi tamɔ etsɛ Asa hi shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Eyagbaaa afã shi eba ejeŋ bɔ pɛ ni Yehowa taoɔ,
shi moŋ eguuu jemawɔji lɛ ajamɔhei lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ bɔiko amɛtsɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ kɛ amɛyitsoŋ fɛɛ.
Yehoshafat he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ shishijee aahuu kɛyagbe naa lɛ, aŋmla yɛ Hanani bi Yehu he saji ni yɔɔ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, tee ni ekɛ Ahazia, Israel maŋtsɛ, ni feɔ nibii gbohii lɛ yafee ekome,
koni amɛkpɛ lɛji ni akɛfã gbɛ kɛya Spain jrayeli. Akpɛ lɛji lɛ yɛ Ezion-Geber.

Shi Eliezer, Dodawahu bi lɛ, jɛ Maresha maŋ lɛ mli ni ebagba eshi Yehoshafat ekɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛ ni okɛ Ahazia eyafee ekome hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa baakpãtã ni ni otsu lɛ hiɛ." Lɛji lɛ jwara ni no hewɔ lɛ eyahii amɛ Spain lɛ yaa.
21: Yehoshafat tsɔ̃ esɛɛ, ni afu lɛ afata etsɛmɛi lɛ ahe yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni ebi Yehoram baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yehoram yɛ nyɛmimɛihii ekpaa ni amɛ hu Israel maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat bii ji amɛ. Amɛji Azaria kɛ Yehiel kɛ Zakaria kɛ Azariahu kɛ Mikael kɛ Shefatia.

Amɛtsɛ lɛ ke amɛ nii babaoo. Ehã amɛ shika kɛ jwitɛi kɛ shika kɛ nibii ni jra wa. Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ehã amɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji wuji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ ekomɛi hu. Shi akɛni Yehoram ji kromɔbi hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ amɛtsɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hã lɛ koni eye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Be ni Yehoram ebata etsɛ maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ehe shi lɛ, egbe enyɛmiɛihii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israel maŋ onukpai komɛi hu.
Yehoram eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebata maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii kpaanyɔ yɛ Yerusalem.
Shihilɛ mli ni Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hi, tamɔ Ahab ba ejeŋ lɛ, nakai shihilɛ mli Yehoram bahi ejaakɛ ekɛ Ahab biyoo yɛ akɛ ŋa. Etɔ̃ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ,
shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa emiii akɛ ekpãtãa David shwiei ahiɛ yɛ kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ David kpãŋ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ewo David shi akɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shiŋ ewe lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Edombii lɛ tsɛ Yuda hiɛ atua yɛ Yehoram yinɔ, ni amɛwo amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ.

No hã Yehoram fã ta kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ etayaa shwiilii fɛɛ kɛyatua Edom. Edombii lɛ bɔlɛ Yuda tabilɔi lɛ kpula kɛkpe; shi Yehoram kɛ etabilɔi lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛyatua Edombii ni ebɔle amɛ lɛ, ni amɛgbu gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛteŋ kɛje kpo.
No hewɔ lɛ Edom bɛ Yuda shishi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Libna hu tsɛ Yehoram hiɛ atūa, ni eje enɔyeli shishi, ejaakɛ Yehoram etɔ̃ Yehowa, etsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ efee jemawɔji ajamɔhei hu yɛ Yuda gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ehã Yerusalembii kɛ Yuda shi Yehowa sɛɛ, ni amɛja jemawɔji, ni amɛkɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Elia ŋma Maŋtsɛ Yehoram wolo, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa nɔ ni Yehowa, ni ji otsɛ David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ: 'Ohiko shi tamɔ otsɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat, loo onii Maŋtsɛ Asa, hi shi lɛ.

Moŋ okɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ajeŋba lɛ, ni okɛhã Yuda kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ miija jemawɔji tamɔ Ahab kɛ eshwiei fee ni Israel shi Yehowa sɛɛ kɛyaja jemawɔji lɛ. Asaŋ onyɛmimɛihii ni ji otsɛ bii lɛ hu ogbe amɛ; ni amɛhi fe bo.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Yehowa baagbla omaŋbii lɛ kɛ oŋamɛi kɛ obii atoi waa, ni ebaakpãtã onii ni oyɔɔ hu hiɛ.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ musuŋ hela kpakpataa ko baamɔ bo, ni hela nɛɛ mli baawo wu daa gbi kɛyashi omlinii baatue.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã Filistibii lɛ kɛ Arabiabii ni yɔɔ Sudanbii lɛ amasɛi lɛ ahe tsɛ̃ Yehoram,
ni amɛfã ta kɛbatua Yuda, ni amɛha nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛna yɛ Yuda, maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli, ni amɛloo kɛtee. Asaŋ amɛŋɔ Yehoram ŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛtee ja enakutsoŋ binuu lɛ pɛ.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ musuŋ hela ni ehiii tsamɔ piŋ Yehoram,
kɛyashi afii enyɔ sɛɛ be mli ni emusuŋnii lɛ tue, ni egbo kɛ hejramɔ. Emaŋbii lɛ shɛreee la akɛwooo egbonyo lɛ hiɛ nyam tamɔ afee ahã etsɛmɛi maŋtsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ.

Yehoram ye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii kpaanyɔ yɛ Yerusalem, ni egbo; ni egbele lɛ edɔɔɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa. Afu lɛ yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli, shi jeee yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ.
22: Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalembii wo Ahazia, ni ji Maŋtsɛ Yehoram binuu gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ, ejaakɛ nakai be mli yɛ Yehoram bihii onukpai lɛ fɛɛ egboi. Arabiabii komɛi ni fã ta kɛba kɛbaye ojo lɛ ji mɛi ni gbe Yehoram bihii onukpai nɛɛ lɛ. No hã Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram bi Ahazia baye maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Ahazia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ be ni awo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afi kome yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Atalia ni eji Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab biyoo kɛ Maŋtsɛ Omri hu nabi yoo lɛ.
Ahazia hu bakɔ Ahab we lɛ jeŋba lɛ ejaakɛ enyɛ lɛ ji eŋaawolɔ, ni ŋai ni ewo lɛ lɛ hã efee efɔŋ.
Efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ Ahab fee lɛ, ejaakɛ etsɛ Yehoram gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Ahab we lɛ mli ajɛ ni awoɔ lɛ ŋaa ni naagbee mli aahuu lɛ no kpãtã ehiɛ lɛ.
Amɛŋaawoo lɛ nɔ enyiɛ ni etee eyawa Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ, ta ni ekɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael yawu yɛ Ramot-Gilead lɛ. Siriabii lɛ pila Yoram yɛ ta lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ Yoram tee eyahi Yezreel koni etsa ehe, ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia tee Yezreel koni eyasra Yoram yɛ ehela lɛ hewɔ.

Shi eji Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo akɛ Ahazia shigbeemɔ atsɔ̃ nɛkɛ sramɔ ni etee eyasra Yoram nɛɛ nɔ. Ejaakɛ be ni eyashɛ jɛi sɛɛ lɛ, etee ni eyawa Yoram koni ekɛ Yehu, Nimshi bi lɛ, ni Yehowa ekɔ lɛ koni ekpãtã Ahab we lɛ hiɛ lɛ ayawu.
Be ni Yehu miifee nɔ ni Yehowa efã akɛ efee ekɛgbla Ahab we lɛ toi lɛ, ekɛ maŋ tsuji lɛ kɛ Ahazia nyɛmimɛihii abii lɛ ni fata Ahazia he kɛba lɛ kpe, ni egbe amɛ.

Etao Ahazia, ni ayamɔ lɛ ni eyatee yɛ Samaria. Akɛ lɛ bahã Yehu, ni agbe lɛ. Shi awo egbonyo lɛ ayafu yɛ enii Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat hewɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ ebɔ mɔdɛŋ ni esɔmɔ Yehowa kɛ eyitsoŋ fɛɛ. Enɛ ha gbɔmɛi tã yɛ Ahab we lɛ mli bɔ ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ jɛi dɔŋŋ ni ebaanyɛ maŋtsɛ eye.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Ahazai nyɛ Atalia nu akɛ ebi Ahazia egbo lɛ, efã akɛ agbe maŋtsɛmɛi ashwiei hii ni yɔɔ Yuda fɛɛ.

Shi Maŋtsɛ Yehoram biyoo ni gbɛi ji Yehosheba lɛ ju shi, ni emɔ Ahazia bi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yoash lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi abihii ni abaagbe lɛ ateŋ, ni ekɛ lɛ kɛ ekwɛlɔ lɛ fɛɛ yato yɛ sɛɛtsu ko mli yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoram biyoo ni ji Yehosheba, Osɔfo Yehoiada ŋa lɛ, fee ni ejie Yoash yɛ Atalia daaŋ, ni enaaa lɛ egbe ejaakɛ Ahazia nyɛmiyoo ji lɛ.
Ekɛ amɛ tee Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli kɛyashi afii ekpaa. Atalia ye maŋnyɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli.
23: Shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Yehoiada kanya ehe. Enine shɛ asraafoi oha ku asafoiatsɛmɛi enumɔ komɛi anɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ, Asafoiatsɛmɛi nɛɛ ji Yeroham bi Azaria, kɛ Yohohana bi Ishmael, kɛ Obed bi Azaria, kɛ Adaia bi Maaseia, kɛ Zikri bi Elishafat.
Asafoiatsɛmɛi nɛɛ teetee Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji wuji fɛɛ amli, ni amɛyatsɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Israel akutsei lɛ amli shiaiŋ onukpai lɛ hu, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalem.

Amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa yabua yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, kɛkɛ ni asafo lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ binuu Yoash kpãŋ. Osɔfo Yehoiada kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, "Naa, maŋtsɛ ni etsɔ̃ esɛɛ lɛ binuu lɛ nɛ. Lɛ esa akɛ eyeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ agbɛnɛ yɛ shi ni Yehowa ewo yɛ David shwiei ahe lɛ hewɔ.
Naa bɔ ni wɔbaafee. Nyɛteŋ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu ni baaba nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ baaja amɛmli kui etɛ̃. Kui etɛ̃ nɛɛ ateŋ ekome baabu Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agboi lɛ anaa;
ku kome baahi maŋtsɛwe lɛ, ni ku kome hu baabu Shishitoo Agbo lɛ naa. Maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ baahi kpoi lɛ anɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli.

Mɔ ko mɔ ko akabote Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii ni eshɛ be ni amɛsɔmɔɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ. Amɛ lɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛbote sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ejaakɛ amɛtsuu amɛhe. Maŋbii fee aye Yehowa gbɛjianɔtoo nɛɛ nɔ.
Levibii lɛ baabɔle maŋtsɛ lɛ he kɛkpe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ baahiɛ etawuunii. He fɛɛ he ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yaa lɛ, amɛhi ehe kɛbu ehe. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baabote Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli lɛ agbe lɛ."

Levibii lɛ kɛ Yuda hii lɛ fɛɛ fee bɔ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada wo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛfee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ ewebii ni baa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ba, ni amɛbafata kui ni kulɛ amɛmiikpa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe; ejaakɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada kpaaa amɛ nitsumɔ koni amɛya shīa.
Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada jra akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi wuji kɛ tsɛŋi bibii ni Maŋtsɛ David yɔɔ ni akɛto Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ekɛhã asraafoi oha kui asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ.

No sɛɛ lɛ eto tabilɔi lɛ edamɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ninejurɔ koŋ lɛ kɛho kɛyashi tsu lɛ abɛku koŋ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛfo sa kɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tawuunii hiɛ edɛ̃.

Agbɛnɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada tee ni eyakpla maŋtsɛbinuu lɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ akere lɛ bafi eyitso, ni ekɛ odaseyeli wolo lɛ wo edɛŋ, ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ. Osɔfo Yehoiada kɛ ebihii lɛ fɔ Yoash mu amɛkɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛ kɛ asafo lɛ bɔ oshe amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala!"
Atalia nu blɔmɔ ni maŋbii ni yaa baa kɛ foi lɛ blɔɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ etiu maŋbii lɛ kɛtee Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he ni amɛ wo shi yɛ lɛ.

Be ni Atalia shɛ jɛi ni ebaakwɛ lɛ, naa maŋtsɛ lɛ ni edamɔ maŋtsɛ shidaamɔhe lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ kpãlɔi lɛ efo ehe sa kpula. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miibɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ, ni aakpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli lalatsɛmɛi lɛ miitswa saŋku, ni akɛmiila yijiemɔ lalai. kɛkɛ ni Atalia kɛ dɔlɛ gbla ehe atadei lɛ, ni ebo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Maŋjwaa sane! Maŋjwaa sane!"

Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada tsɛ tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ, ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛmɔ Maŋnyɛ Atalia kɛje kpo kɛtsɔ̃ tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ; shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaba akɛ enyiɛ Maŋnyɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ. Afee nakai ejaakɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛɛ akɛ esaaa akɛ agbeɔ maŋnyɛ lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ asafo lɛ ŋmɛ gbɛ ni amɔ Maŋnyɛ Atalia kɛtsɔ amɛtɛŋ kɛho. Shi be ni akɛ lɛ shɛ Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ naa, he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛboteɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli lɛ, ni agbe lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Nii nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada kɛ Maŋtsɛ Yoash kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ fee ekome ni amɛkpãŋ akɛ amɛbaahi shi akɛ Yehowa webii.

Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ maŋbii lɛ yabote jemawɔji ajamɔhei lɛ, ni amɛyakumɔ jemawɔji lɛ amãgãi lɛ kɛ jemawɔji lɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ jemawɔji lɛ ajamɔhei lɛ diɛŋtsɛ fɛɛ amɛshwie shi. Naagbee mli lɛ amɛgbe Matan ni ji jemawɔji lɛ awulɔmɔ lɛ amɛfata he.

Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada tu Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ hegbɛjianɔtoi lɛ ewo Levibii osɔfoi lɛ adɛŋ. Ni yɛ Levibii krokomɛi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, bɔ ni David jra amɛmli koni amɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ, asaŋ akɛ amɛ amɛshã Yehowa shãa afɔlei lɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ Mose Mla lɛ mli lɛ, Osɔfo Yehoiada saa ekɛhã amɛ bɔ pɛ ni David eja ehã amɛ eto lɛ. Nakai nɔŋŋ efee kui ni amɛgbɛnaa ji akɛ amɛla lɛ.
Asaŋ ekɛ bulɔi to Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agboi lɛ anaa bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko ni ebule ehe yɛ gbɛ ko nɔ akabote Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ osɔfo Yehoiada tsɛ tabilɔi lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛŋ hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ kɛ akutsei lɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛfata ehe, ni amɛkpla maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛjɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni amɛ kɛ lɛ nyiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ we lɛŋwɛi agbo lɛ mli kɛbote maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ yata maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ nya, ni maŋ lɛ mli jɔ akɛ ni agbe Atalia lɛ.
24: Yoash eye afii kpawo be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Zibia, ni ejɛ Beersheba.
Yoash hi shi bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ yɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada yinɔ fɛɛ.
Yehoiada kpee yei enyɔ ehã Maŋtsɛ Yoash, ni ekɛ amɛ fɔ bihii kɛ biyei.
Eshɛ be ko ni Yoash to eyiŋ akɛ eeesaa Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ heihei ni efitefitee lɛ.

Enɛ hã Yoash tsɛ osɔfoi lɛ Levibii lɛ, ni etsu amɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa Yuda maji fɛɛ amli nyɛyatsua maŋbii fɛɛ too bɔ ni abaana shika koni akɛ eko asaa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ daa afi. Nyɛtsua sane nɛɛ he nii kɛ hiɛdɔɔ. "Shi Levibii lɛ ahiɛ eyadɔɔɔ yɛ sane lɛ he.

No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Yoash tsɛ Osɔfonukpa Yehoiada, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ okwɛɛɛ koni Levibii lɛ ayatsu Yudabii lɛ kɛ Yerusalembii too lɛ ni Mose, Yehowa tsulɔ lɛ, fo ehã Israel fɛɛ koni akɛtsu Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ?"
(Atalia, nakai yoo fɔŋ lɛ, kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ egbla asaŋ eloo Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni akɛtee akɛyaja jemawɔji.)
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Yoash fã, ni Levibii lɛ kpɛ adeka ko ni amɛkɛma Yehowa We lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni atswa he ŋoŋo yɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ akɛ too lɛ ni Mose, Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ lɛ, fo ehã Israelbii be mli ni amɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba ni ebawo enɔ lɛ ehã Yehowa.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na sane lɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛtoo lɛ ba amɛbawo adeka lɛ mli. Abaa aahuu kɛyashiɔ adeka lɛ yiɔ tɔ.

Kɛji fee nakai lɛ Levibii lɛ woɔ adeka lɛ koni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ. Kɛji akɛ adeka lɛ ba lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔlɛ kɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ hu naadamɔlɔ baa ni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ shika lɛ yɛ adeka lɛ mli,kɛkɛ lɛ Levibii lɛ ewo adeka lɛ amɛkɛyama emaahe lɛ ekoŋŋ. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee daa gbi, ni akɛbua shika babaoo naa.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yehoiada kɛ shika lɛ hãa amɛi ni kwɛɔ nii ni atsuɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛbɔɔ tɛ gbogbotswalɔi lɛ kɛ kapintafoi lɛ kɛ dade kɛ akɔɔbleŋaalɔi lɛ apaa koni amɛsaa Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
Nitsulɔi lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ni nitsumɔ lɛ tee nɔ jogbaŋŋ; ni amɛsaa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, ni ena hewalɛ, ni eba eblema.

Be ni agbe Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ saamɔ naa lɛ, shika ni shwɛ lɛ akɛbahã maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yehoiada. Akɛ shika nɛɛ fee tsɛnsii kɛ Okpolui fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa We lɛ mli lɛ nɔ ni akɛjaa kɛ nɔ ni akɛshãa afɔlei, kɛ nɔ ni akɛtoɔ tsofakɛŋma kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi tsɛnsii srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ. Osɔfo Yehoiada wala be mli fɛɛ lɛ atee nɔ ni ashã afɔle be fɛɛ be yɛ Yehowa We lɛ mli.
Osɔfo Yehoiada gbɔ kotokoto; ni be ni ena afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ egbo.
Afu lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli yɛ nibii kpakpai ni etsu ehã Israel kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ e-We lɛ hu he nitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Yehoiada gbele sɛɛ lɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ bɔi amɛhe kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fufuamɔ. Maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔi amɛnaa toiboo.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kpa jamɔ yɛ Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni amɛyaja Asherim jemawɔŋ lɛ kɛ amãgãi. Tɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ hã Yehowa mli fu Yuda kɛ Yerusalem.
Kɛ̃ lɛ Yehowa tsu gbalɔi kɛba ni amɛbabɔ amɛ kɔkɔ; asaŋ koni amɛkpale Yuda Yerusalembii koni amɛhi shi bɔ ni Yehowa toaɔ; shi maŋbii lɛ booo toi.

Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ ba Osɔfo Yehoiada bi Zakaria nɔ, ni eho edamɔ he ko grɔŋŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, 'Te tɛŋŋ ni nyɛyeee mikitã lɛ nɔ ni nyɛkwa Yehowa lɛ, lɛ hu ekwa nyɛ.'"
Maŋbii lɛ tee Zakaria yinɔ apam moŋ, ni yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fãmɔ naa lɛ amɛtswia lɛ tɛ yɛ Yehowa We lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.

Maŋtsɛ Yoash kaiii kwraa anɔkwayeli ni Zakaria tsɛ Yehoiada kɛsɔmɔ lɛ lɛ, ni egbe Zakaria yakatswaa. Be ni Zakaria gboɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa aaabi migbele nɛɛ shi, ni eeetɔ he owole." Yoash maŋtsɛyeli naagbee
Afi nɔ ni sane nɛɛ ba lɛ gbele mli lɛ, Siriabii lɛ fã ta kɛbatua Yoash kɛ Yuda. Be ni amɛbashɛ Yerusalem lɛ amɛkpãtã maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛkɛ nii ni amɛha lɛ fɛɛ tee yahã Damasko maŋtsɛ.
Tabilɔi ni Siriabii lɛ kɛba ta lɛ ayikulɛ fioo, kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa hã amɛye Yuda tabilɔi babaoo lɛ anɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Yudabii lɛ ekwa Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Enɛ nɔ tsɔ̃ ni agbla Maŋtsɛ Yoash toi.

Be ni Siriabii atabilɔi lɛ Shiɔ ni amɛya lɛ, amɛshi Yoash ni epila. Kɛkɛ ni Yoash tsuji lɛ ekomɛi tee Yoash yinɔ apam yɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada bi Zakaria gbele lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛtee amɛyagbe lɛ amɛwo esaa mli. Afu lɛ yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli, shi moŋ afuuu lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ.
Mɛi ni tee Yoash yinɔ apam lɛ ji Zabad, Amonyoo Shimeat bi lɛ, kɛ Yehozabad, Moabyoo Shimrit bit lɛ.
Saji ni kɔɔ Yoash musuŋ bihii lɛ ahe, kɛ gbalɛi srɔtoi ni agba ashi Yoash lɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ saamɔ mli saji lɛ aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛmɛi ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli. Yoash bi Amazia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
25: Amazia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ: ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalem.
Eba ejeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ,shi jeee kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli hewalɛ lɛ shɛ Amazia dɛŋ gbe naa, yeee be ko kwraa ni egbe tsuji lɛ ni gbe etsɛ Maŋtsɛ Yoash lɛ.

Shi moŋ egbeee amɛbii koni ekɛye kitã ni Yehowa ewo yɛ Mose Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ nɔ. No ji akɛ, "Tsɛmɛi akagbo amɛbii atɔ̃mɔ he gbele, ni bii hu akagbo amɛtsɛmɛi atɔ̃mɔ he gbele; shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etɔ̃mɔ he gbele."

Maŋtsɛ Amazia bua Yuda akutsei lɛ kɛ Benyamin hu akutsei lɛ amli hii fɛɛ anaa kuikui yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa. Kɛkɛ ni eto asafoiatsɛmɛi ehã hii oha akui lɛ kɛ hii akpei akui lɛ hu. Hii ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ esɛɛ sɔŋŋ ni yɔɔ kui lɛ amli; ni be ni akpa amɛnaa lɛ ana hii akpei ohai etɛ̃, ni ji mɛi ni aje gbɛ atsɔse ahã tawuu, ni asaŋ amɛhe esa jogbaŋŋ yɛ akplɔ kɛ tsɛŋ kɛ nɔmɔ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ etsɛ jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ aaafee talentai oha, ni akɛtee akɛyabɔ hii tabilɔi kãkãlɔi akpei oha apaa yɛ Israel.
Shi gbalɔ ko ba Maŋtsɛ Amazia ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii okɛ Israel tabilɔi nɛɛ akaya ta lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa bɛ Efraimbii nɛɛ asɛɛ.

Kɛji efee bo akɛ kɛji amɛfata ohe lɛ obaana hewalɛ kɛwu ta lɛ, no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baatswa bo shi yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji, mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ehãa mɔ yeɔ kunim; ni eyɛ hewalɛ ni ehãa mɔ gbeɔ shi."
Amazia bi gbalɔ lɛ akɛ, "Te wɔfee tɛŋŋ mɔ yɛ jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha ni mikɛbɔ Israel tabilɔi lɛ apaa lɛ gbɛfaŋ hu?"Gbalɔ lɛ to he akɛ, "Yehowa baanyɛ eto bo najiaŋ kɛteke nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Amazia wo Israel tabilɔi ni ba lɛ wamɔ lɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛkpale amɛya amɛmaŋ. Efraim tabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛmli ewo la ewo Yudabii lɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ. Amɛyashɛ shīa kɛ mlifu gbeyeigbeyei.
Amazia fee nuu, ni enyiɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛtee ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛ kɛ Edombii lɛ yatswa ta ko yɛ jɛi. Yudabii lɛ gbe Edom tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ jɛi,
ni amɛmɔmɔ tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋma hu. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkpla Edom tabilɔi lɛ kɛtee tɛsaa ko nɔ yɛ Sela maŋ lɛ masɛi, ni amɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ amɛfɔ̃fɔ̃ɔ Edombii lɛ amɛtswia tɛsaa lɛ mli, ni amɛmli tserɛ dukuduku.

Be nɛɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Israel tabilɔi lɛ ni Amazia hã amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni ekɛ amɛ eyaaa lɛ tee ni amɛyatua Yuda maji lɛ kɛjɛ Samaria aahuu kɛyashwie Bet-Horon. Amɛgbe maji lɛ amli gbɔmɛi akpei etɛ̃, ni amɛha nii hu babaoo kɛtee.
Be ni Amazia yaye Edombii lɛ anɔ kunim ni eku esɛɛ ebaa lɛ, etre Edombii ajemawɔji lɛ kɛba. Ebamamɔ jemawɔji lɛ akɛ lɛ ejemawɔji, ni eja amɛ, ni eshã afɔlei hu ekɛhã amɛ.
Yehowa na Amazia mlifu yɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ etsu gbalɔ ko Amazia ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, "Te fee tɛŋŋ ni ojaa mɛi komɛi ajemawɔŋ ni eyanyɛɛɛ nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ tete ehere yɛ bo odɛŋ lɛ hu?"

Shi Maŋtsɛ Amazia fo gbalɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛbe wɔwo bo maŋtsɛ ŋaawolɔ? Mɔ onaabu mli koni mikahã agbe bo!" Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ kpa wiemɔ lɛ; shi etsɔ̃ hiɛ ni ekɛɛ Amazia akɛ, "Nɔ ni ofee lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ miŋaawoo toi ni obooo nɛɛ ehã mina mile akɛ Yehowa eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaakpãtã ohiɛ."
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia kɛ eŋaawolɔi tee ajina. Kɛkɛ ni etsu ni ayakɛɛ Yehoash ni ji Yehu bi Yehoahaz bi lɛ, ni ji Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, akɛ eetsɛ lɛ ŋanɔ.

Shɛɛ nɛɛ hetoo ni Yehoash bahã Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia ji akɛ, "Be ko lɛ Lebanon ŋmei tso tsu ni ayakɛɛ Lebanon tseneduru tso akɛ,' Kɛ obiyoo lɛ ahã mibinuu lɛ gblã.' Shi ŋaŋ koloo ko ni miiho yɛ jɛi ni nu shɛɛ lɛ tee ni eyanaanaa ŋmei tso lɛ nɔ.
Ooshwã akɛ, 'Bɛ oona akɛ miye Edombii anɔ kunim? 'Oyitso efuu. Ole sane ko? Taomɔ ohe ko ota yɛ oshīateŋ Kpoo. Mɛɛba oyatao sane ni baahã bo kɛ Yuda fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã nɛɛ?"
Shi Amazia eyabuuu shɛɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ji akɛ ebaahã aye Amazia nɔ kunim yɛ Edombii ajemawɔji ni eja lɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash fã ta kɛbanina Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yudabii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ damɔ shi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ yɛ Bet-Shemesh.
Israelbii lɛ ye Yudabii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni Yudabii lɛ jojoo foi kɛtee amɛshīaiaŋ.

Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash mɔ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia, ni ji Ahazia bi Yoash bi lɛ, yɛ Bet-Shemesh, ni ekɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem. Yehoash bakumɔ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ eshwie shi kɛjɛ Efraim Agbo lɛ naa aahuu kɛyashi koŋ Agbo lɛ naa. Gbɛ ni kã agboi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ lɛ jɛkɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ohai ejwɛ.

Eloo Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ tsɛnsii kɛ kpuji fɛɛ ni ana lɛ, ni emɔmɔ Obed-Edom shwiei ni buɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ efata nibii lɛ ahe. Eku sɛɛ eloo maŋtsɛ we lɛŋ hu jwetri fɛɛ, ni emɔmɔ nomii babaoo hu ofɔ̃ kɛku esɛɛ kɛtee Samaria.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash tsɔ̃ hiɛ egbo afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ dani Maŋtsɛ Amazia gbo.
Amazia wala he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ aŋmla fɛɛ kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyata naagbee yɛ Yuda kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Abɔi Amazia yinɔ apamtoo yɛ Yerusalem kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni ekwa Yehowa jamɔ beebe. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ naagbee mli aahuu lɛ Amazia jo foi kɛtee Lakish. Shi atiu lɛ kɛtee Lakish lɛ, ni ayagbe lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Awo egbonyo lɛ afɔ okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛba Yerusalem, ni abafu lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli.
26: Yudabii fɛɛ kɔ Amazia binuu ni eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa lɛ akɛ eye maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ sɛɛ.
Amazia etsɔ̃ esɛɛ dani Uzia yashɔ Elat maŋ lɛ ehã Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni etswa gbogbo ewo he.
Uzia eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Yekolia ni jɛ Yerusalem lɛ.
Eba ejeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ tamɔ etsɛ Amazia fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Zakaria ji mɔ ni wo lɛ ŋaa, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ bɔ ni ehi shi ehã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ; ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ wala be mli fɛɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Uzia sɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ; ni bei abɔ fɛɛ ni Uzia sɔmɔ Yehowa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã eshwere.

Maŋtsɛ Uzia fã ta ni ekɛ Filistibii lɛ yawu, ni ekumɔ amɛmaji ni ji Gat kɛ Yabine kɛ Ashdod ahe gbogboi lɛ eshwie shi. No sɛɛ lɛ etotoo maji wuji kɛ amɛhe gbogbo yɛ Ashdod kpokpai anɔ, kɛ agbɛnɛ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei krokomɛi hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ ye ebua lɛ ni eye Filistibii lɛ kɛ Arabiabii ni yɔɔ Gur-Baal lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ Meunbii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
Amonbii lɛ tsu too amɛkɛsɔmɔ Uzia; ni Uzia batsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu naakpa, ni egbɛi hehe kɛshɛ Egipt kpokpai anɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Uzia mamɔ mɔji gojogojo komɛi, ni ekɛwaje Yerusalem maŋ lɛ. Mɔji nɛɛ ekome yɛ Koŋ Agbo lɛ naa, ni ekome yɛ Jɔɔ Agbo lɛ naa, ni ekome hu yɛ Gbogbo Lɔgɔmɔhe lɛ.

Emamɔ mɔji gojogojoi lɛ ekomɛi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ hu; ni etsra nubui pii ejaakɛ eyɛ kooloi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ yɛ jɔɔ naa shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋa lɛ hu nɔ. Akɛni Uzia sumɔɔ humɔ hewɔ lɛ, ehã mɛi hu ŋmɔji, ni amɛfeefee waintromii yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ jɔi lɛ amli fɛɛ.

Asaŋ Maŋtsɛ Uzia yɛ tabilɔi ni efee kralo hã ta be fɛɛ be. Ajra amɛmli asafoiasafoi, ni Yeiel, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ tsulɔ Maaseia ji mɛi ni buɔ tabilɔi lɛ ayikulɛ he akɔntaa. Ni amɛ hu amɛyɛ Hanania ni ji maŋtsɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ shishi.
Tsɛmɛi ashīai lɛ amli hii kãkãbaŋi, ni tabilɔi lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ, fɛɛ ayibɔ ji akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Ni tabilɔi ni atsɔse ato koni amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ henyɛlɔi awu kɛ ekãa lɛ ayikulɛ ji hii akpei ohai etɛ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Uzia fee tsɛŋi kɛ akplɔi kɛ dade faii kɛ dade damai kɛ gãii kɛ akromiai wuji amli tɛi tete ehã Yuda tabilɔi lɛ.

Ŋaalɔi sɔ̃sɔ̃ɔ tsɔnei hã Maŋtsɛ Uzia koni akɛmamɔ mɔji gojogojooi lɛ amli kɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ koji lɛ koni akɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ gãi, asaŋ ni akɛfɔ̃ tɛi wuji hu. Bɔ ni atsɔ̃ aye abua Maŋtsɛ Uzia ni ena hewalɛ lɛ eyɛ naakpɛɛ; ni ehã egbɛi hehe kɛtee shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Hewalɛ ni maŋtsɛ Uzia na nɛɛ hã ewo ehe nɔ, ni no kɛ eshigbeemɔ ba. Uzia je Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ ŋwane, ni etee Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli akɛ eyaashã tsofakɛŋma lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi Osɔfonukpa Azaria kɛ osɔfoi nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ ni ji kãkãlɔi komɛi fata ehe nyiɛ Uzia sɛɛ kɛtee Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli,

ni amɛyatsi lɛ gbɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ Uzia, ejeee ogbɛnaa akɛ, oshã tsofakɛŋma ohã Yehowa. Osɔfoi, ni ji Aaron shwiei, lɛ pɛ ji mɛi ni ajɔɔ tsofakɛŋmashãa nɔ ahã. Shi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni oya! Otɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni obɛ Yehowa dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ ko ni obaana dɔŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Uzia mli fu. No mli lɛ ehiɛ tsɛnsi ni ekɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma lɛ. Emli lɛ ni fu osɔfoi lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni hewolo nɔ hela ko ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei shwie ehiɛnaa kplitsaa yɛ osɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ nɔŋŋ.
Be ni Azaria kɛ osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ na hewolo nɔ hela kplitsaa lɛ ni shwie Uzia hiɛnaa lɛ, amɛtsirɛ eyisɛɛ akɛ eshi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli. Ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ po ehe fee oya ni eye kpo ejaakɛ Yehowa egbla etoi.

Maŋtsɛ Uzia ye hewolo nɔ hela nɛɛ kɛtee egbele mli. Hela lɛ hewɔ lɛ atsi lɛ Yehowa We lɛ mli gbɛ, ni ehi shi yɛ shīa ko mli banee kɛ hela lɛ. Ni fee nakai lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Uzia bi Yotam kwɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ etsɛ lɛ najiaŋ.
Uzia he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, Amaz bi Gbalɔ Yesaia eŋmla fɛɛ kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyagbe naa.
Uzia tsɔ̃ esɛɛ, ni afu lɛ banee yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ hela lɛ hewɔ lɛ akɛ lɛ futuuu maŋtsɛmɛi agbohi lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ebi Yotam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
27: Yotam eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Yerusha, ni Zadok biyoo ji lɛ.
Yotam ba ejeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ Uzia fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, fe akɛ lɛ lɛ ekaaa akɛ ekɛ ehe aaawo sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni asɔmɔɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli. Shi maŋbii lɛ tee nɔ amɛja jemawɔji komɛi.
Maŋtsɛ Yotam ji mɔ ni tswa Kooyi Agbo lɛ ni akɛboteɔ Yehowa We lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni etswa Ofel Gbogbo lɛ hu nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi saŋŋ.
No sɛɛ hu lɛ eto maji ejwɛ yɛ Yuda gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ; ni emamɔ mɔji kɛ mɔji gromogromooi fɛɛ yɛ koi asɛɛ shikpɔji lɛ hu anɔ.

Ekɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ wu ta, ni eye lɛ kɛ eta lɛ nɔ kunim. No hewɔ lɛ Yotam hã Amonbii lɛ bahã lɛ jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha, kɛ ŋmaa nsɛnite wulu lɛ akpe kome, kɛ able hu nakai falɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ amɛkɛsɔmɔ lɛ. Amonbii lɛ basɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nibii nɛɛ falɛ nakai nɔŋŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hu nɔ.
Yotam baje agbo ejaakɛ eshihilɛ mli lɛ ebo Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi.
Yotam he saji krokomɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ tai ni ewu lɛ, kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli nibii ni etsu lɛ aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Israel kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yotam eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa yɛ Yerusalem.
ni egbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni ebinuu Ahaz baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
28: Ahaz eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai kɛ ekpaa yɛ Yerusalem.
Shi moŋ ekɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ajeŋba lɛ, ni ekɛ dade shwie Baal jemawɔji lɛ amãgãi,

ni eshâ tsofakɛŋma yɛ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli ekɛja jemaɔji lɛ. Etee nɔ po esha lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋbii akɛ afɔle ekɛha jemawɔji lɛ. Gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ sa, shi Yehowa shwie amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ agbɛ nɔ be ni Israelbii lɛ jɛ Egipt amɛbaa lɛ akusum ni ehiɔ ji enɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Ahaz tee hei grɔŋŋi ni ji jemawɔji ajamɔhei ni yɔɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ agbɛnɛ tsei kusukusui lɛ ashishi lɛ ni eyashãshãa afɔlei, ni eshãshãa tsofakɛŋma hu yɛ jɛi ekɛja jemawɔji lɛ.

Ahaz jeŋba nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋmɛɛ ehe ehã Siria maŋtsɛ ni ebaye enɔ kunim yɛ ta mli, ni eŋɔ Yudabii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ nom kɛtee Damasko. Nakai nɔŋŋ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ hu baye Ahaz nɔ kunim ni ekpãtã Yudabii ahiɛ musúmusú,
ejaakɛ gbi kome too nɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia binuu lɛ, gbe Yuda tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ. Eba lɛ nɛkɛ ejaakɛ Yudabii lɛ ekwa Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Efraimnyo tabilɔi, nuu kakabãŋ ko ni egbɛi ji Zikri lɛ gbe Maŋtsɛ Ahaz binuu Maaseia lɛ kɛ Azrikam, maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ Elkana, maŋtsɛ sɛɛmɔ lɛ yɛ ta nɛɛ mli.
Israel tabilɔi lɛ ŋɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi Yudabii lɛ ateŋ yei kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei akpei ohai enyɔ nom kɛtee Samaria; asaŋ amɛha Yudabii anii babaoo hu kɛtee.

Be nɛɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ ko yɛ Samaria maŋ lɛ mli ni atsɛɔ lɛ Obed. Be ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ pue kɛ Yuda nomii lɛ yɛ Samaria lɛ, etee ni ekɛ amɛ yakpe, ni ekɛɛ Israel tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, "Naa, Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli ni fu Yuda lɛ no hewɔ ehã nyɛye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ. Shi gbe ni nyɛbe amɛ lɛ yɛ musuŋshãa bɔ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ enu he yɛ ŋwɛi ehã amɛ.
No sɛɛ hu lɛ nyɛto yiŋ akɛ nyɛbaafee Yuda kɛ Yerusalem hii kɛ yei nyɛnyɔji. Aso nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛtɔ̃ko Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ nyɛtoko?
Nyɛle sane ko? Nyɛhãa nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ni nyɛyaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ akua amɛsɛɛ ayaa ejaakɛ Yehowa mli ni efu nyɛ lɛ jeee hiɛ nɛ."

Asaŋ Efraimbii lɛ amaŋ onukpai ejwɛ komɛi hu te shi amɛshi tabilɔi ni jɛ ta amɛbaa shaīa lɛ. Amɛji Azaria, Yehohanan bi lɛ, kɛ Berekia Meshilemot bi lɛ, kɛ Yehizkia, Shalum bi lɛ, kɛ Amasa, Hadlai bi lɛ.

Amɛkɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ nomii nɛɛ akabaa maŋ nɛɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ. Tɔ̃mɔ ni wɔtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ momo sa lɛ eda, ni eyɛ wɔhe mlifu ni naa wa. Nyɛmifee nɛkɛ koni nyɛkɛyawo tɔ̃mɔ hee nyɛbashi nɔ ni kã wɔn lɛ nɔ nyɛhã wɔ?"
Wiemɔ nɛɛ hã tabilɔi lɛ shi nomii lɛ kɛ nii ni amɛha lɛ fɛɛ amɛhã maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋbii ni ewo shi yɛ jɛi lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋ onukpai ejwɛ lɛ klɔ mamai yɛ haanii lɛ amli amɛhã nomii lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi ni mama bɛ amɛhe ekpakpa ko lɛ. Amɛhã amɛ atadei kɛ tokotai amɛwo; ni ahã nomii lɛ nii amɛye amɛtrɔ kɛ nɔ ko hu amɛnu. Mɛi hu ni ena faji lɛ, atotoo nɔ kɛ mu ahã amɛ. Nomii lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi ni egbede ni nyɛɛɛ anyiɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, akɛ amɛ tra tejii anɔ, kɛkɛ ni, maŋ onukpai ejwɛ lɛ kpla nomii lɛ fɛɛ kɛyahã amɛnyɛmimɛi Yudabii ni yɔɔ Yeriko, ni ji tɛŋ maŋ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Samaria.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz tsu Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat Pileser ŋɔɔ akɛ ekɛ etabilɔ aba koni ebawa lɛ,
ejaakɛ Edombii lɛ ebatua Yuda ekoŋŋ, ni amɛŋɔ mɛi nom kɛtee.

Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Filistibii lɛ ebatua Yuda maji ni yɔɔ Yuda anaigbɛ gɔji lɛ ahiɛshi lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ ewuoyigbɛ maji lɛ hu. Amɛshɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ̃ maji nɛɛ, Bet-Shemesh kɛ Ayalon kɛ Gederot kɛ Soko kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ, kɛ Timna kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ,kɛ Gimzo hu kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ, ni amɛbahi maji nɛɛ amli kwraa.
Yehowa ba Yuda shi nɛkɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahaz hewɔ, ejaakɛ Ahaz bɔ nyeyeŋtswi yɛ Yuda, ni eyayee Yehowa anɔkwa.
Be ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat Pileser ba lɛ yɛ nɔ najiaŋ ni eeewa Ahaz kɛwo lɛ hewalɛ lɛ, ebawo Ahaz nɔnaa lɛ mli wu moŋ

ejaakɛ Ahaz loo Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli jwetri lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hu mli nɔ lɛ, kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ hu ashīai amli jwetri fɛɛ, ni ekɛhã Tiglat Pileser, Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi enɛ tete yeee buaaa Ahaz yɛ gbɛ ko nɔ kwraa.
Shi efimɔ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz kã he moŋ egbo Yehowa nɔ toi fe tsuutsu lɛ.

Eshã afɔlei ehã Damaskobii ni ye enɔ kunim yɛ ta mli lɛ ajemawɔji lɛ. Ekɛɛmɔ ji akɛ "Siriabii ajemawɔji lɛ yeɔ buaa Siria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ kɛji mi hu mishã afɔle mihã amɛ lɛ, amɛaaye amɛbua mi." Shi enɛ ni efee lɛ moŋ hã Ahaz kɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ kpãtã butuu

Kɛkɛ ni Ahaz bua Nyɔmɔ We lɛ mli tsɛnsii kɛ kpuji kɛ nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ejwara amɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ eŋmɛ Yehowa We lɛ naa shinai lɛ amli; ni etee eyamamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ehã ehe yɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli akutso fɛɛ akutso mli.
Agbɛnɛ efee hei grɔŋŋi koni ashã tsofakɛŋma akɛja jemawɔji yɛ jɛi yɛ Yuda maji wuji fɛɛ amli. Jeŋba nɛɛ hã Yehowa, etsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli fu lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Ahaz shihilɛ mli saji krokomɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, aŋmla kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyagbe naa yɛ Yuda kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ahaz gbo afu lɛ yɛ Yerusalem, shi jeee yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ, Ebinuu Hezekia ji mɔ ni baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
29: Hezekia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Abia, Zakaria biyoo lɛ.
Hezekia ba ejeŋ ekpakpa bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ tamɔ eseshinyo Maŋtsɛ David fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Emaŋtsɛwomɔ lɛ sɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Hezekia gble Yehowa We lɛ naa shinai lɛ, ni asaŋ esaa fɛɛ.
Etsɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ kpe yɛ Sɔlemɔtsɛ lɛ bokãgbɛ kpote lɛ mli,

ni ekɛ amɛ wie. Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Agoo Levibii, agbɛnɛ nyɛtsuua nyɛhe ni nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, koni nyɛfea Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, We lɛ hu Krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni buleɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ, nyɛjiea yɛ jɛi.
Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ eyayeee anɔkwa, ni amɛfeefee nibii ni ejaaa yɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ. Amɛkwa lɛ, amɛkɔ amɛnane yɛ biɛ ni ji Yehowa We lɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã Yehowa.
Amɛŋamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa shinai lɛ, amɛkwɛ ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli kanei lɛ gboi, ni tsofakɛŋma ni jio, shãa afɔlei ni jio, amɛbashãaa eko yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ amɛhãaa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Yehowa mli fu Yuda kɛ Yerusalem naakpa yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ; ni nɔ ni efee amɛ lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛna bɔ ni eyɔɔ tsuifãa ehã, asaŋ ni ehãa mɔ he jɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Agbegbee wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ ta mli, ni naa, wɔbihii kɛ wɔbiyei kɛ wɔŋamɛi lɛ aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee maŋsɛɛ ni ayaye amɛ nyɔŋ.
"Mito miyiŋ akɛ mi kɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baakpãŋ bɔ ni afee ni efo emlifu lɛ sɛɛ ehã wɔ.
Mibii, nyɛkafea hejɔ̃ yɛ sane nɛɛ mli ejaakɛ nyɛ, nyɛji mɛi ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ehala akɛ nyɛdamɔ ehiɛ nyɛsɔmɔ lɛ asaŋ ni nyɛshã tsofakɛŋma nyɛhã lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Levibii ni yɔɔ jɛi gbi lɛ te shi damɔ shi, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi gbi lɛ yɛ Kohat shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ ji: Amasai bi Mahat, kɛ Azaria bi Yoel; yɛ Merari shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Abdi bi Kish, kɛ Yehalelel bi Azaria; ni yɛ Gershon shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Zima bi Yoa, kɛ Yoa bi Eden.
Yɛ Elizafan shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Shimri kɛ Yeuel; ni yɛ Asaf shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ Zakaria kɛ Matania.
Yɛ Heman shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ Yehusel kɛ Shimei, ni yɛ Yedutum shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ Shemaia kɛ Uziel.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tee ni amɛyabua amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ anaa, ni amɛtsuu amɛhe kɛfee amɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ. No sɛɛ lɛ amɛtee, bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ efã amɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa lɛ, koni amɛyatsuu Yehowa We lɛ mli.

Osɔfoi lɛ bote Yehowa We lɛ mli diɛŋtsɛ koni amɛyatsuu jɛi. Amɛloo nibii fɛɛ ni buleɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛje kpo kɛba Yehowa We lɛ kpote lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ hu loo nibii nɛɛ kɛtee amɛkɛyawo Kidron faa lɛ mli.

Amɛbɔi hetsumɔ nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ, amɛshɛ Yehowa We lɛ koi lɛ shi. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ gbii kpaanyɔ tsuu Yehowa We lɛ he. Amɛgbe nitsumɔ lɛ naa yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa lɛ nɔ.

Levibii lɛ tee Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ amɛyabɔ lɛ amɛniɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔtsuu Yehowa sɔlemɔ Shīatso muu lɛ he wɔgbe naa. Shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Yehowa aboloo lɛ maa nɔ lɛ, kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ hu wɔtsuu he.
Nibii fɛɛ ni kulɛ akɛjaa shi Maŋtsɛ Ahaz shi amɛ sɛɛ be mli ni ekpa Yehowa jamɔ be ni eyeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, wɔkɛ fɛɛ eba, ni wɔtsuu amɛhe. Amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ mamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ."
Oya nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bua maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ anaa, ni ekɛ amɛ tee Yehowa sɔlemɔ shia lɛ mli.

Amɛkɛ tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii kpawo kɛ toobii kpawo kɛ tookpakpoi hu kpawo ba koni akɛshã afɔle kɛfɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ muji lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã, osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Aaron shwiei lɛ, akɛ amɛkɛ kooloi lɛ ashã afɔle yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ osɔfoi lɛ gbe tsinai lɛ, ni amɛsɔo lá lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛlá lɛ shwá afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ, amɛgbe toobii lɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ sɔo kooloi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lá, ni amɛkɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ amɛmɔmɔ too kpakpoi lɛ, ni akɛ amɛkɛ amɛ ba maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋbii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji shwieshwie kooloi lɛ anɔ.

No sɛɛ lɛ osɔfoi lɛ gbe too kpakpoi lɛ, ni akɛ amɛlá lɛ fe Israel he esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ efã akɛ shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ esha he afɔle lɛ ashã fɛɛ ahã Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia hã Levibii lɛ yadamɔ Yehowa We lɛ mli kɛ ŋoŋo kɛ obentai kɛ saŋkui bɔ ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ ninalɔ Gad kɛ agbɛnɛ Gbalɔ Natan nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ efee lɛ.
Levibii lɛ hiɛhiɛ David yinɔ lámɔ nibii krokomɛi lɛ, ni osɔfoi lɛ hiɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ.

Maŋtsɛ Hezekia fã akɛ abɔi shãa afɔle lɛ shãa. Be ni aje afɔle lɛ shãa shishi nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ wo lala, ni akɛkafo Yehowa, ni lalatsɛmɛi lɛ hu bɔi David yinɔ obentai lɛ kɛ ŋoŋoi lɛ kɛ saŋkui lɛ tswaa kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ hu kpãmɔ.
Asafo ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ja Yehowa. Lalɔi lɛ la, ni tɛtrɛmantrɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu tee nɔ amɛkpã bɛji lɛ aahuu kɛyashi agbe shãa afɔle lɛ shãa naa.
Be ni ashã afɔle lɛ abge naa lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ koto shi, ni amɛja Yehowa.
No sɛɛ lɛ Hezekia kɛ maŋ onukpa lɛ bi Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛla lalai ni David flɔ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni Gbalɔ Asaf hu flɔ lɛ amɛkɛjie Yehowa yi. Kɛkɛ ni asafo lɛ koto shi, ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ.

Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ ni nyɛtsuu nyɛhe nyɛhã Yehowa nɛɛ, nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa kɛ nyɛfɔlei lɛ nyɛkɛbadaa Yehowa shi." Asafo lɛ kɛ afɔlei lɛ ba, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ he tsui lɛ kɛ shãa afolei hu ba.
Afɔlei ni asafo lɛ bahã akɛ Yehowa shãa afɔle lɛ ji tsinai nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii oha, kɛ toobii hu ohai enyɔ.
Ni nibii ni ajɔɔ nɔ akɛ aye lɛ fee tsinai ohai ekpaa kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi akpei etɛ̃.

Shi akɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ ayi eyafaaa bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ kooloi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ fɛɛ ahe woji amɛkplɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ wa amɛ kɛyashi agbe nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa. Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ osɔfoi lɛ ekomɛi yatsuu amɛhe, ni amɛbamɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli.

Bɔ ni shãa afɔle lɛ yafa babao diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ yeli kɛ agbɛnɛ shãa afɔle lɛ he dãa afɔle lɛ hu yafa babaoo. Gbɛ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni atsuu Yehowa We lɛ he, asaŋ ni agbele naa ekoŋŋ koni aja yɛ mli lɛ nɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ nya naakpa yɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu ehã amɛ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ nitsumɔ lɛ tee nɔ oya.
30: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsu Israelbii fɛɛ kɛ Yudabii fɛɛ hu aŋɔɔ kɛ shɛɛ akɛ eekpee amɛ koni amɛba Yerusalem amɛbaye Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Hetoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ Yehowa We lɛ mli. Eje gbɛ ni eŋmla woji ekɛmaje Efraim kɛ Manasebii ekɛtsɛ amɛ hu gbijurɔ lɛ yeli.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ Yerusalembii fɛɛ tee ajina yɛ Yerusalem, ni amɛye amɛfua akɛ aye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ gbijurɔ lɛ eyahiii yeli be ni ebe lɛ tuuŋtu shɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ osɔfoi lɛ babaoo tsuuko amɛhe, ni maŋbii lɛ babaoo hu ebashɛko shi yɛ Yerusalem.
Fuamɔ nɛɛ sa maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ amɛma sane lɛ nɔ mi akɛ ashiɛ ahã Israelbii fɛɛ kɛjɛ Beersheba, yɛ wuoyigbɛ, aahuu kɛyashwie Dan, yɛ kooyigbɛ, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba koni abaye Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ Yerusalem ekɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam, ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ mɛi babaoo baaa gbijurɔ lɛ yeli dɔŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ŋmla woji, ni amɛkɛtsu bɔfoi kɛtee Israel kɛ Yuda heihei fɛɛ. Maŋtsɛ lɛ shɛɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Israelbii, nyɛkpalea nyɛbaa Yehowa, ni ji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni lɛ hu eeebɛŋkɛ nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhe je mli, ni Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anine eyashɛɛɛ nyɛnɔ koni amɛŋɔ nyɛ nom lɛ.
Nyɛkafea tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ni eyayeee amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anɔkwa lɛ fee lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã amɛhiɛ kpãtã tamɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnaa lɛ.

Nyɛfea nyɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa Yehowa. Nyɛbaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɛ Yerusalem; etsuu he eto kɛmiiya naanɔ koni nyɛbaja Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi koni Yehowa mli ni efu nyɛ lɛ sɛɛ afo.

Ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛkpale kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ lɛ, mɛi ni baŋɔ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ hu nom kɛtee maŋsɛɛ lɛ amusuŋ baatsɔ̃ amɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni amɛbaaŋmɛɛ nyɛyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ ahe koni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ enɔ ekoŋŋ. Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, drolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji lɛ; ni kɛji nyɛkpale nyɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ, ebaahere nyɛ atuu."
Bɔfoi lɛ yakpa maji fɛɛ anɔ yɛ Efraim kɛ Manase hu; ni amɛtee aahuu kɛyashɛ Zebulon tɔ̃ɔ. Shi maŋbii lɛ ŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛye amɛhe fɛo.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mɛi fioo ko jɛ Asher kɛ Manase kɛ Zebulonbii ateŋ ba amɛhe shi amɛbo tsɛmɔ lɛ toi, ni amɛba gbijurɔ lɛ yeli yɛ Yerusalem.
Nyɔŋmɔ nine kã Yudabii lɛ ahe, ni ehã amɛ fɛɛ amɛna jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛfee ekome, ni amɛye maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ ounkpai lɛ agbɛjianɔtoi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛkɛfee Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii.
Kɛkɛ ni afi mli nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, asafo babaoo diɛŋtsɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalem koni amɛbaye Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ.
Asafo lɛ kumɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi ni amamɔ yɛ Yerusalem heihei fɛɛ ni amɛloo fɛɛ amɛyatsi amɛshwie Kidron Faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛgbe toobii ni amɛkɛbaaye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu ateiaŋ mɛi ni tsuuko amɛhe lɛ ahiɛ gboi bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehã amɛtee ni amɛyatsuu amɛhe. Kɛkɛ ni amɛbamɔ shãa afɔlei lɛ amli ni asha yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eyadamɔ he ni esɔmɔɔ yɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose Mla lɛ eto gbɛjianɔ lɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ heɔ lá ni Levibii lɛ sɔoɔ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛkɛshwãa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi pii yɛ asafo lɛ mli ni amɛtsuuko amɛhe. No hewɔ lɛ Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni gbe nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ a-Hehoo toobii lɛ hã amɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛtoobii lɛ ahe atse ahã Yehowa.

Ejaakɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ kɛ Isakarbii lɛ kɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ni ba afi lɛ yeli lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi babaoo tsuuko amɛhe bɔ ni ji kusum naa; ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛmiiye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ bɔ ni esaaa. Maŋtsɛ Hezekia sɔle sɔlemɔ nɛɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahewɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ omlihilɛ naa lɛ mɔ fɛɛ ni miitao osɛɛgbɛ kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, kɛji etsuuko ehe yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mlai lɛ anaa tete lɛ okɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa lɛ."
Yehowa bo Hezekia sɔlemɔ lɛ toi, ni ekɛfa amɛ, ni efɔŋ ko baaa amɛnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii ni anaa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalem lɛ ye Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ kɛyashi gbii kpawo sɔŋŋ kɛ nyamɔ kple. Daa gbi lɛ Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ laa kɛjieɔ Yehowa yi kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ.

Ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia jie Levibii lɛ ayi pam yɛ bɔ ni amɛhe esa kɛ sɔɔmɔ kɛji aaja Yehowa lɛ hewɔ. Maŋbii lɛ shãshãa shidaa afɔlei, ni amɛyeyee nii kɛyashi gbii kpawo, ni amɛda Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi.
Shi gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ye fua akɛ atsa afiyeli lɛ nɔ gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ. Ni afee nakai kɛ miishɛɛ.

Ejaakɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia hã maŋbii lɛ tsinahii akpe kɛ toi hu akpei kpawo koni amɛkɛshã afɔle, ni maŋ onukpai lɛ hu hã tsinahii akpe kɛ toi hu akpei nyɔŋma. Osɔfoi lɛ hu babaoo tsuu amɛhe, ni amɛfee amɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yudabii blublu kɛ amɛsɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛteŋ Levibii fɛɛ hu, kɛ asafo ni Israel ba lɛ, kɛ gbɔi hu ni jɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛ.
Nyamɔ ni anya yɛ Yerusalem lɛ jeee hiɛ nɛ, ejaakɛ kɛjɛ Maŋtsɛ David bi Solomon yinɔ lɛ, ayeko afi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ yɛ Yerusalem dã.
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ ba Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ amɛhã maŋbii lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ nu sɔlemɔ lɛ, ni ebo toi.
31: Be ni agbe gbijurɔ lɛ yeli naa lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ ni baye gbijurɔ lɛ teetee Yuda kɛ Benyamin maji lɛ amli, ni amɛyakumɔ jemawɔji amãgãi lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛgba Asherim jemawɔŋ lɛ koi fɛɛ, ni amɛfitefitee hei grɔŋŋi ni ajaa jemawɔji yɛ fɛɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi hu. Amɛyafite nibii nɛɛ ahenɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Efraim kɛ Manase hu fɛɛ kɛyashi eshwɛɛɛ ekome flo. KɛKɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ hu ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛkutsei ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.

Maŋtsɛ Hezekia hã akɛ bɔ ni ajra osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ amli kuikui sa lɛ bɔ̃i nitsumɔ ekoŋŋ bɔ ni ku fɛɛ ku yɛ enitsumɔ krɛdɛɛ lɛ. Mɛi yɛ ni shãa afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ lɛ, kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ; ni mɛi yɛ ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ jamɔ lɛ mli, ni mɛi yɛ ni laa kɛjieɔ Yehowa yi; dani mɛi yɛ ni buɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ agboi lɛ anaa.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ nii ni etsu ji akɛ emɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekooloi ni eyɔɔ lɛ eko ehãa, ni akɛshãa daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ afɔlei lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ afɔlei ni ashãa yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ heei shishijee nɔ, kɛ gbii juji krokomɛi lɛ hu anɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ Yehowa Mla lɛ mli lɛ.

Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia fã Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli bii akɛ amɛhã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ nii ni ji amɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, kɛ Levibii lɛ, amɛgbɛfaŋ nii lɛ bɔ ni afee ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɛɛ ahã kɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ naa.

Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni anu famɔ nɛɛ he lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ able kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ wo kɛ ŋmɔshinii srɔtoi ni amɛkpa lɛ amli nii babaoo ba. Amɛkɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome babaoo hu ba.
Kɛkɛ ni Yudabii kɛ Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ amli lɛ hu kɛ toi tsinai kɛ nii ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛkɛke Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome ba, ni amɛto nibii lɛ kuikui.
Afi lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji etɛ̃ nɔ akɛ nibii lɛ bɔi baa; ni ahiɛ kɛbaa aahuu kɛyashi nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, ni agbe naa.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ bana nibii kuikui ni maŋbii lɛ kɛbahã lɛ, amɛjie Yehowa kɛ emaŋ Israel fɛɛ yi.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ nibii lɛ ahe sane,

ni Osɔfonukpa Azaria, ni eji Zadok shwie lɛ, kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ afɔlei lɛ bɔi Yehowa we lɛ baa nɛɛ lɛ, wɔnaa nii wɔyeɔ Wɔtrɔɔ aahuu ni eshwɛɔ babaoo tete. Ejaakɛ Yehowa ejɔɔ emaŋ lɛ, ni no hewɔ nii ni shwɛɔ lɛ sɔŋŋ ji babaoo nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia fã akɛ asaa tsui lɛ yɛ sɔlemɔ shīa lɛ mli. Asaa tsui lɛ,
Kɛkɛ ni aloo nikeenii lɛ kɛ nibii ni ajɔɔ nɔ ake lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm akɛyato tsui nɛɛ amli. Mɔ ni ato lɛ nibii nɛɛ anɔkwɛlɔnukpa ji Konania, Levinyo lɛ; ni enyɛminuu Shimei ji esɛɛmɔ.

Yɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ Osɔfonukpa Azaria hewalɛ naa lɛ, ahala Levibii nyɔŋma komɛi hu akɛ Konania kɛ enyɛmi Shimei shishibii kɛhã nibii lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Yehiel kɛ Azazia kɛ Nahat kɛ Asahel kɛ Yerimot kɛ Yozabad kɛ Eliel kɛ Ismakia kɛ Mahat kɛ Benaia.

Kore ni ji Imna, Levinyo onukpa ni kwɛɔ Bokãgbɛ Agbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, bi lɛ ji mɔ ni ato akɛ ehe nibii ni abakeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ; asaŋ ejie nikee nɛɛ mli nii ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ ni ji tuuŋtu gbɛfaŋ nii lɛ yɛ afɔlei lɛ amli eto afã.

Mɛi ni wa Kore kɛtsu nitsumɔ nɛɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi ni osɔfoi yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ji Eden kɛ Minyamin kɛ Yeshua kɛ Shemia kɛ Amaria kɛ Shekania. Amɛjaa nii lɛ amɛhãa amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ bɔ ni gbɛkɛ kɛ onukpa fɛɛ na pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ kuikui lɛ anaa,
shi jeee yɛ weku kpãa naa. Hii fɛɛ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛyaa ni amɛyaa Yehowa we lɛ amɛyatsuɔ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔ yɛ amɛwekui anaa lɛ, ahãa amɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ nii daa gbi.
Osɔfoi lɛ ajra amɛnitsumɔi lɛ ahã amɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa; ni Levibii lɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ hu, ahã amɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ asafo kui lɛ anaa.

Osɔfoi lɛ aŋmla amɛ kɛ amɛbii bibii kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei fɛɛ agbɛii, no ji amɛsafoi kuikui lɛ amlibii fɛɛ. Ni amɛyeɔ anɔkwa kɛhiɛɔ amɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ hu ejaakɛ aakwɛ gbɛ akɛ be fɛɛ be ni aaatsɛ amɛ amɛnitsumɔi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsumɔ lɛ, amɛyɛ kralo.

Asaŋ Aaron shwiei, ni ji osɔfoi, ni yɔɔ shikpɔji ni yɔɔ maji ni akɛhã Aaron shwiei ahewɔ lɛ anɔ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, hii krɛdɛɛ yɛ ni ato amɛ, ni amɛ amɛjaa nii, yɛ maji srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ amli; ni amɛkwɛɔ ni amɛhãa osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋma egbɛi egbɛfaŋ nii.
Nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsu yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ ji enɛ. Efee nii ni hi kɛ nii ni ja; ni eye anɔkwa hu yɛ Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ewo ehe nitsumɔ nɔ lɛ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli jamɔ gbɛfaŋ jio, Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ jio, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ taomɔ jio, etsu kɛ etsui fɛɛ, ni no hewɔ hu lɛ eye omanye.
32: Nii ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsu nɛɛ kɛ anɔkwa ni eye Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ, Senherib ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ fã ta kɛba, ni ebatua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni egbagbaa ta ni esa maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ ayi. Eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaakumɔ maji lɛ agbogboi lɛ eshwie shi koni eŋɔ maji lɛ.
Be ni Hezekia na akɛ Senherib eto eyiŋ doo akɛ ekɛ Yerusalem baawu lɛ,
lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ etabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ tee ajina, ni amɛye amɛfua akɛ atsimɔ nuhiŋmɛii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ye bua Hezekia.
Amɛbua mɛi babaoo anaa, ni amɛtsimɔ nuhiŋmɛii kɛ fai ni hoɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ ahiŋmɛii bɔ ni afee ni kɛji Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ba Yerusalem lɛ amɛkana nu amɛnu.

Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia kɛ hiɛdɔɔ saa Yerusalem he gbogbo lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ fɛɛ etwa kɛtee ŋwɛi; asaŋ etswa mɔji yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ heihei. Esaa etswa gbogbo kroko hu ewo maŋ lɛ he, ni efee enyɔ. Ewaje Yerusalem kpɔ mli ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Milo lɛ. Efee akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ hu.
Eto tatsɛmɛi ehã maŋ lɛ bii akuikui lɛ, ni ehã amɛ fɛɛ amɛyakpe yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa blohu lɛ mli. Hezekia kɛɛ maŋ lɛ yɛ jɛi kɛ miishɛɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛtsui akafãa yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ asafo babaoo ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ hewɔ! Ejaakɛ mɔ ni kɛ wɔ yɔɔ lɛ da fe mɔ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Lɛ lɛ adesa hewalɛ kɛ lɛ yɔɔ; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ yɔɔ, koni eye ebua wɔ, asaŋ koni ewu wɔtai lɛ ehã wɔ." Maŋbii lɛ na ekãa kɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia wiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ.

Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Senakerib tsu kɛba Yerusalem. No mli lɛ Senakerib kɛ ta ni eyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ eyasa Lakish maŋ yi. Shɛɛ ni ekɛtsu etsuji lɛ kɛbahã Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ ji akɛ,
"Mi Senakɛrib, Asiria maŋtsɛ, mibii nyɛ nɔ ni nɔ nyɛhiɛ kã hewɔ ni nyɛtra Yerusalem lolo be mli ni asa maŋ lɛ yi?
Nyɛnaaa akɛ lakamɔ Hezekia lakaa nyɛ koni ehã hɔmɔ kɛ kumai agbe nyɛ hewɔ ekɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahere wɔyiwala yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ?'
Ani jeee Hezekia nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni efite Yehowa hei grɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalembii akɛ amɛja, ni asaŋ amɛshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ koome pɛ nɔ lɛ?
Nyɛleee kwraa nɔ ni mi kɛ Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ efee shikpɔji krokomɛi anɔ bii lo? Shikpɔji lɛ eko nɔ jemawɔji lɛ eko enyɛ emaŋbii lɛ ayiwala ehere yɛ midɛŋ pɛŋ lo?
Majimaji ni mitsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ lɛ fee amɛ musu lɛ ajemawɔji lɛ, te amɛteŋ nɔ ni ehere emaŋbii ayiwala yɛ midɛŋ pɛŋ, hewɔ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ baanyɛ nyɛyiwala ehere yɛ midɛŋ lɛ?

No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkahãa Hezekia miishishiu nyɛ, ni elakaa nyɛ nɛkɛ; ni asaŋ nyɛkahae lɛ nyɛyea hu. Ejaakɛ maŋ ko maŋ ko loo maŋtsɛ ko maŋtsɛ ko jemawɔŋ nyɛko emaŋbii ayiwala ehere yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ ko dɛŋ dã, aahuu ni nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Enyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ehere yɛ mi midɛŋ."
Asiria maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu wie ahorabɔɔ wiemɔi pii amɛkɛshi Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Mantsɛ Hezekia, Yehowa tsulɔ lɛ fɛɛ.

Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ŋmla woji ekɛbabɔ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ahora. Etswa mpoa yɛ wolo lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni shikpɔji lɛ anɔ jemawɔji lɛ nyɛko ahere amɛmaŋbii ayiwala yɛ midɛŋ dã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Hezekia Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nyɛŋ ahere emaŋ lɛ yɛ midɛŋ."
Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ blɔ kɛ gbee waa yɛ Yudafoi amaŋ wiemɔ lɛ mli amɛtsɛ Yerusalembii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ koni amɛwo amɛhe gbeyei, ni amɛhã amɛjijaa bɔ ni afee ni amɛnyɛ maŋ lɛ amɛŋɔ.
Tsuji nɛɛ wie Yerusalem Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ he tamɔ amɛwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji krokomɛi anɔ jemawɔji lɛ, ni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ninenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ ahe lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ Gbalɔ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, sɔle ni amɛkpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai akɛ ebaye ebua amɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsu bɔfo ko, ni ebagbe tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ kɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ asafoitsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ. No hewɔ lɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛtee eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ hiɛgble. Ni be ni etee eyabote ejamawɔŋ lɛ we lɛ mli lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋ bihii bamɔ lɛ klaŋte, ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa fee ehere Hezekia kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ ayiwala yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Senakɛrib kɛ mɛi krokomɛi fɛɛ adɛŋ nɛ. Asaŋ ehã amɛ kɛ amɛhewɔ maji fɛɛ hi shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Mɛi babaoo kɛ afɔlei ba Yerusalem, ni amɛkɛbahã Yehowa, ni amɛbake Hezekia hu nibii ni jra wa. Ni kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia hiɛ ba nyam yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he baye be nɛɛ mli bɔ ni gbo eheɔ egbo nɛɛ. Shi Hezekia sɔle ekpa Yehowa fai, ni Yehowa bo esɔlemɔ lɛ toi, ni eto Hezekia naakpɛɛ okadi akɛ ehe baawa lɛ.
Shi ejurɔ ni Yehowa fee Hezekia lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ehe nɔ moŋ Hezekia wo, ni ehii shi bɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu Yuda kɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ.
Shi naagbee mli aahuu lɛ Hezekia je ehe sɛɛ, ni lɛ kɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ ba amɛhe shi amɛhã Yehowa; ni no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa gblaaa amɛtoi yɛ Hezekia yinɔ.

Maŋtsɛ Hezekia na edɛŋ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ni ehiɛ ba nyam kple. Efee nitoohei ehã nibii ni eyɔɔ lɛ eko fɛɛ eko, ni ji ejwiɛtɛi kɛ eshika kɛ ojrawatɛi kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsɛŋi kɛ nibii krokomɛi ni ajra wa lɛ fɛɛ.
Emamɔ ŋmaa kɛ wain kɛ mu nitoohei hu; ni emamɔ tsui ehã etsinai kɛ etoi hu.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Hezekia totoo maji, ni ena toi kɛ tsinai kuikui babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dro lɛ nii jogbaŋŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni yatsi Gihon Nuhiŋmɛi lɛ naa yɛ yiteŋgbɛ, ni edɔ nu lɛ yi, ni ehã ebatsɔ̃ Yerusalem anaigbɛ lɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Hezekia mɔ etsumɔ mli lɛ eshwere.

Enɛ hewɔ lɛ be ni Babilon lumɛi lɛ tsu bɔfoi Hezekia ŋɔɔ koni amɛbabi lɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni etsu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he sane lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛɛ Hezekia he ehã ehe nilee koni ekɛka Hezekia ekwɛ, kɛna nɔ ni yɔɔ etsuiŋ.
Nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia fee kɛ bɔ ni esɔmɔ Yehowa ehã lɛ, aŋmla yɛ Gbalɔ Yesaia Amoz bi lɛ, Ninaa Wolo lɛ kɛ Yuda kɛ Isreal Maŋtsɛmɛi ahe Saji Awolo lɛ hu mli.
Hezekia gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ David shwiei maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ mli kɛyaa eyiteŋgbɛ. Yuda kɛ Yerusalembii fɛɛ wo Hezekia hiɛ nyam yɛ egbele mli. Hezekia bi Manase baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
33: Manase eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalem.
Eyanyiɛ nibii gbohii ni majimaji lɛ ni Yehowa shwie yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, be mli ni amɛjɛ Egipt amɛbaa lɛ, feɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

Ejaakɛ jemawɔji ajamɔhei ni etsɛ Hezekia kumɔ lɛ, Manase saa emamɔ, ni emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi hu ehã Baal jemawɔji lɛ; ni asaŋ efee amãgã ehã jemawɔŋ yoo Ashera lɛ, ni eja ŋwɛi nibii srɔtoi ni yɔɔ lɛ, ni esɔmɔ amɛ hu.
Manase mamɔ jemawɔji afɔleshãa latɛi yɛ Yehowa we lɛ; tsɛbelɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ kɛya naanɔ.
Eku sɛɛ ekoŋŋ emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi enyɔ lɛ anɔ koni akɛja nibii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Asaŋ Manase shã ebihii akɛ afɔle yɛ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni eyeɔ ŋkunyaa, ni eklaa, ni efeɔ ashwãi, ni eto sisatsɛlɔi kɛ ayɛi fɛɛ. Etɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ni ekɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ mli la.

Ewo jemawɔŋ ko amãgã ni efee lɛ, ni ekɛyama Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli diɛŋtsɛ, he ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ David kɛ ebi Solomon wie he, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ, yɛ Yerusalem maŋ nɛɛ mli, mikɔ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ akɛ he ni abaaja mi yɛ kɛya naanɔ.
Ni kɛji Israelbii aaajwɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛaaye kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni mitsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ni miwo amɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mihaŋ Israelbii afã amɛnane kɛshi shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ."
Shi Manase laka Yudabii kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ, ni amɛtɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔi ni fe tɔ̃mɔ̃i ni majimaji lɛ ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ Israelbii ahiɛ lɛ tete tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ Manase kɛ emaŋbii lɛ wie, ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ; shi amɛbooo toi.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã Asiria maŋtsɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ fã ta kɛba, ni amɛbatua Yuda. Amɛmɔ Manase, ni amɛkɛ kpoŋ lala lɛ, ni amɛwo lɛ akɔɔble gboklɛ, ni amɛkola lɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Be ni Manase yɔɔ hejramɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, eba ehe shi jogbaŋŋ ehã etsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ekpa Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai akɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ bo Manase faikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni etsu he nii ehã lɛ. Ehã Manase ku esɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem ni ebatsa emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ. Enɛ hã Manase na nɔmimaa akɛ Yehowa lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛɛlɛŋ.

Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Manase tswa gbogbo hee ebɔle David Maŋ lɛ he gbogbo momo lɛ he, kɛjɛ Gihon Nuhiŋmɛi lɛ anaigbɛ, yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli, aahuu kɛho Loo Agbo lɛ he kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ fã ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Ofel lɛ. Ehã gbogbo nɛɛ kwɔ fe gbogbo momo lɛ. Asaŋ eto tatsɛmɛi ehã tabilɔi ni yɔɔ Yuda maji fɛɛ ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli.

Ejie maŋsɛɛ jemawɔji lɛ kɛ amãgãi fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa We lɛ mli, ni ejie jemawɔji afɔleshãa latɛi ni emamɔ yɛ Yehowa We lɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hu, ni ejie afɔleshãa latɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem hei krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu, ni eloo kɛtee Yerusalem maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha, ni eyasherɛ eshwie ŋmaŋmasha lɛ.
Ni esaa ema afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ni akɛjaa Yehowa lɛ, ni eshã shidaa afɔlei kɛ yijiemɔ afɔlei hu yɛ nɔ; ni efã Yudabii fɛɛ akɛ amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ Maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔle yɛ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ, shi amɛyiŋtoo ji akɛ amɛmiishã afɔlei lɛ amɛkɛmiihã Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ.
Nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni Manase fee lɛ, kɛ sɔlemɔ ni esɔle ekɛkpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai lɛ, kɛ wiemɔi ni ninalɔi kɛ lɛ wie yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli lɛ, aŋmla yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.

Manase faikpamɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bo lɛ toi ehã lɛ, kɛ hei grɔŋŋi ni emamɔ jemawɔji ajamɔhei yɛ lɛ, kɛ wɔŋ koi kɛ amãgãi ni efeefee fɛɛ dani eje ehe sɛɛ, ni eba ehe shi ehã Yehowa lɛ, aŋmla yɛ Gbalɔi Ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Manase tsɔ̃ esɛɛ, ni afu lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli, ni ebinuu Amon baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Amon eye nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Yerusalem.
Etɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ tamɔ etsɛ Manase fee lɛ, ni eshã afɔlei ekɛhã amãgãi fɛɛ ni eshɛ fee yɛ eyinɔ lɛ, ni esɔmɔɔ amɛ.
Amon eyabaaa ehe shi kwraa ehãaa Yehowa tamɔ etsɛ Manase ba ehe shi lɛ, shi moŋ etɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔi babaoo.
Kɛkɛ ni Amon tsuji lɛ tee eyinɔ apam, ni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ l diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛwe lɛ mli.
Shi Yudabii lɛ gbe mɛi fɛɛ ni tee Maŋtsɛ Amon yinɔ apam lɛ, kɛkɛ ni awo ebi Yosia maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
34: Yosia eye afi kpaanyɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalem.
Eba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eseshinyo Maŋtsɛ David ba ejeŋ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; egbaaa kɛyaa ninejurɔ lɛ egbaaa kɛyaaa abɛku hu

Yosia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ, be ni edako beebe lɛ, ebɔi eseshinyo David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ kɛ esɛɛgbɛ taomɔ. Be ni ena afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosia bɔi jemawɔji ajamɔhei lɛ kɛ Ashera jemawɔŋ lɛ wɔŋ koi lɛ kɛ amãgã krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ fitemɔ, koni ekɛtsuu Yuda kɛ Yerusalem he.

Ehã akumɔkumɔɔ Baal jemawɔŋ lɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ; ni amɛyiteŋgbɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi ni amamɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ hu, ehã ekumɔ fɛɛ. Ehã akumɔ ni ashimɔ Asherim jemawɔŋ lɛ amãgã lɛ kɛ amãgãi krokomɛi lɛ hu fɛɛ mɔnyɔŋmɔnyɔ, ni akɛshwã mɛi ni be ni amɛyɔɔ wala mli lɛ amɛshã afɔle amɛkɛhã amãgãi nɛɛ asaŋi anɔ.
Eshã jemawɔji lɛ anaa wulɔmɛi lɛ awui yɛ afɔleshãa latɛi ni amɛshã afɔle yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ. Ekɛ enɛ feemɔ tsuu Yuda kɛ Yerusalem he.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosia yiŋ ni etee Manase kɛ Efraim kɛ Simeon maji lɛ amli kɛ hei ni etsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔi fɛɛ aahuu kɛyashwie Naftali tɔ̃ɔ,

ni eyakumɔ jɛi hu afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi lɛ, ni egba wɔŋ koi lɛ, ni eshimɔ Asherim jemawɔŋ lɛ amãgãi lɛ kɛ amãgãi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni eku esɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem.
