Yosia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ, be ni etsuu shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he egbe naa kɛtsɔ̃ jemawɔŋjamɔ ni egu lɛ nɔ lɛ, etsu Shafan, Azalia bi lɛ, kɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ amralo Maaseia kɛ Yoa, Yoahaz bi lɛ ni ji saji aŋmlalɔ ko lɛ, koni amɛyasa Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, We lɛ.

Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tee Osɔfonukpa Hilkia ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ shika ni maŋbii lɛ kɛbahã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ he lɛ yahã lɛ. Levibii ni ji agbonaabulɔi ji mɛi ni bua shika lɛ naa kɛjɛ Manasebii kɛ Efraimbii kɛ Israel akutsei ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ amli bii kɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli bii fɛɛ adɛŋ.
Atu shika lɛ awo nitsulɔinukpai ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ henitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ dɛŋ; ni amɛ hu amɛkɛhã nitsulɔi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Yehowa we lɛ koni amɛkɛsaa shia lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ.
Amɛkɛ shika lɛ hã kapintafoi lɛ kɛ gbogbotswalɔi lɛ koni akɛhe tɛ ni ako kɛ tsei ni akɛfee mplaŋi kɛ tsuhɛhɛmɔ tsei koni akɛsaasaa tsui lɛ ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ŋmɛ gbɛ ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛfitefitee lɛ.

Nitsulɔi lɛ ye anɔkwa kɛtsu nii lɛ. Ato Yahat kɛ Obadia, Levibii ni jɛ Merari shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kɛ Zakaria kɛ Meshulam, ni jɛ Kohat shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ, akɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi koni amɛhã nitsumɔ lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi koni amɛhã nitsumɔ lɛ aya nɔ. Asaŋ ahala Levibii lɛ ekomɛi, mɛi ni ahe esa jogbaŋŋ kɛ lala bɛji kpamɔ,
ni ahã amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kwɛ jatsuterelɔi lɛ anɔ, ni mɛi komɛi hu kwɛ ŋai srɔtoisrɔtoi tsulɔi lɛ anɔ. Levibii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ateŋ mɛi komɛi bu nibii lɛ ahe akɔntaa, ni fabii hu bu agbo naa.
Be ni awoɔ shika ni maŋbii kɛbahã yɛ Yehowa we lɛ he lɛ, Hilkia yana Yehowa Mla Wolo lɛ, ni ji Mla lɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛhã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Hilkia wo enaa nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Shafan, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, akɛ "Miyana Mla Wolo lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli." kɛkɛ ni ekɛ wolo lɛ hã Shafan;
ni Shafan kɛ wolo lɛ bahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nibii fɛɛ ni okɛhã otsuji tsumɔ lɛ amɛmiitsu.
Shika ni akɛto Yehowa we lɛ, wɔyaloo ni wɔkɛyahã mɛi ni kwɛɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ kɛ nitsumɔi lɛ."
Shafan, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Osɔfo Hilkia kɛ wolo nɛɛ hã mi." Kɛkɛ ni Shafan kane wolo lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia nu Mla Wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ, egbla ehe atadei;
ni efã Hilkia kɛ Ahikam, Shafan bi lɛ, kɛ Abdon, Mika bi lɛ, kɛ Shafan, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Asaia, maŋtsɛ tsulɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

"Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyabia Yehowa nii nyɛhãa mi kɛ Israel kɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni eshwɛ yɛ wolo ni ayana lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa mli ni efu wɔ lɛ naa wa jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ eyayeee Yehowa weimɔ nɔ koni amɛfee amɛnii yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anaa."

Maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ lɛ naa hewɔ lɛ Hilkia kɛ mɛi ni atsu fata ehe lɛ yiŋ amɛtee yoo gbalɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hulda lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ akutso ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli. Hasra bi Tokhat bi Shalum, mɔ ni kwɛɔ atadei ni awoɔ akɛsɔmɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli lɛ anɔ lɛ, ŋa ji Hulda nɛɛ. Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ebɔ Hulda amaniɛ lɛ,
Hulda kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyakɛa mɔ ni tsu nyɛ miŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ,
'Mi, Yehowa, mibafee biɛ nɛɛ kɛ emli, bii fɛɛ efɔŋ; mahã loomɔi fɛɛ ni aŋmla yɛ wolo ni akane atsɔ̃ɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ aba mli.
Akɛni amɛkwa mi', ni amɛyashã tsofakɛŋma amɛkɛhã jemawɔji; ni amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii ewo mimli la hewɔ lɛ, mimli efu maŋ nɛɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ bɔ ni enaa la gboŋ.
Shi Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ ni tsu nyɛ akɛ nyɛbabi mi nii lɛ, nyɛyakɛa lɛ akɛ, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, Akɛni be ni onu wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ,

oje ohe sɛɛ, ni oba ohe shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni be ni onu nɔ fɔŋ ni baaba Yerusalem kɛ Yerusalembii anɔ lɛ hu lɛ oba ohe shi yɛ mihiɛ, ni ogbla ohe atade, ni owo yara ni ofo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mibo bo toi.
Naa, obaagbo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; ni nɔ fɔŋ ni mahã aba Yerusalem kɛ Yerusalembii anɔ lɛ ohiŋmɛi enaŋ ekome nɛkɛ.'" Tsuji lɛ ba, ni amɛbabɔ Maŋtsɛ Yosia amaniɛ nɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia tsu ni eyapee Yuda kɛ Yerusalem maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛba.

Kɛkɛ ni lɛ kɛ Yuda hii lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ, no ji maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ mɔ wulu nɔ kɛyashi mɔ bibioo nɔ, yi mli kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ. Maŋtsɛ Yosia kane Kpãŋmɔ Wolo ni ayana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ maŋ muu lɛ toiŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni matsɛ lɛ yadamɔ maŋtsɛ shidaamɔhe lɛ, ni ekã kitã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ akɛ ebaabo Yehowa toi, ni ebaaye ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ etsui fɛɛ, kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni eye wiemɔi ni aŋmla yɛ wolo lɛ mli lɛ anɔ.
Ehã mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem nakai be lɛ, kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ kɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋ. No hewɔ lɛ Yerusalembii lɛ ye kpãŋmɔ ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kpaŋ lɛ nɔ.

Ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia jie musubɔɔ amãgãi bluublu yɛ he fɛɛ he ni ji Israelbii ashikpɔŋ, ni ehã mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ sɔmɔ Yehowa, ni ji amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ewala be mli fɛɛ lɛ maŋ lɛ sɔmɔ Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, pɛpɛɛpɛ.
35: Maŋtsɛ Yosia ye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ Yerusalem ekɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam. Agbe Hehoo toobi lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
Yosia tu osɔfoi anitsumɔi lɛ ewo amɛdɛŋ ekoŋŋ; asaŋ ewo amɛ hewalɛ akɛ amɛtsu Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nii lɛ jogbaŋŋ.

Ekɛɛ Levibii lɛ ni amɛji Israel muu fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ, ni asaŋ amɛjɔɔ amɛhe nɔ amɛhã Yehowa sɔɔmɔɔ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ayamaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon, Israel Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ, ma lɛ mli. Ehiaaa akɛ nyɛaatere adeka lɛ kɛya kɛya. Agbɛ nɛ nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ emaŋ Isreal.
Nyɛsaa nyɛhe yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi awei akuikui lɛ anaa bɔ ni David, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ ebi Solomon to gbɛjianɔ lɛ.
Nyɛtoa gbɛjianɔ koni be fɛɛ be lɛ ana Levibii awekui komɛi koni amɛwa nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni ji maŋbii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei anaa yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni nyɛgbea Hehoo toobi lɛ koni nyɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ bɔ ni kɛji Amɛfee ni amɛbaaye Yehowa wiemɔi ni ekɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ anɔ."

Maŋtsɛ Yosia mɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekooloi lɛ amli gwaŋtɛŋbii kɛ abotiabii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ tsinai hu akpei etɛ̃, ni ekɛhã maŋbii lɛ akɛ akɛ fɛɛ afee Hehoo afɔlei ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eba Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yeli.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ hã maŋ onukpai lɛ hu jɛ tsuijurɔ naa amɛhã maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kooloi. Hilkia kɛ Zakaria kɛ Yehiel, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi nukpai lɛ, hã osɔfoi lɛ toi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ tsinai hu ohai etɛ̃ koni akɛfee hehoo afɔlei.

Ni Konania kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii enyɔ, Shemaia kɛ Netanel, kɛ agbɛnɛ Hashabia kɛ Yeiel kɛ Yozabad, ni ji Levibii lɛ anukpai lɛ, hu hã Levibii lɛ toi akpei enumɔ kɛ tsinai ohai enumɔ koni akɛfee Hehoo afɔlei.
Be ni asaa he agbe naa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ yadamɔ amɛshidaamɔhe lɛ, ni Levibii lɛ hu yadamɔ amɛgbɛhei lɛ yɛ amɛkuikui lɛ anaa bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ efã lɛ.
Levibii lɛ gbegbee Hehoo toobii lɛ, ni osɔfoi lɛ he lã lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ amɛkɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Levibii lɛ kplɔɔ toobii lɛ ahe woji lɛ,
ni amɛjiejie kooloi hei ni ashãa lɛ, ni amɛjra amɛhã maŋbii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei kuikui lɛ anaa koni amɛkɛhã Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Mose Wolo lɛ mli. Nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfee tsinai lɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛshã Hehoo toobii lɛ bɔ ni ato afɔ shi lɛ; shi amɛhoo afɔlei krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ kukwɛii kɛ dadesɛŋi kɛ tsɛnsiii amli, ni amɛkɛhã maŋbii lɛ oya.

No sɛɛ lɛ Levibii lɛ fee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ hu anɔ, ejaakɛ afɔlei ni ashãa lɛ emuu kɛ kooloi lɛ amli fɔi lɛ hu ni ashãa lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ ni ji Aaron Shwiei lɛ eyanaaa dekã kɛyashi jenamɔ. No hewɔ ni Levibii lɛ fee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛniyenbii kɛ osɔfoi lɛ hu anɔ lɛ.

Lalatsɛmɛi ni ji Asafbii lɛ yɛ amɛgbɛhe lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Asaf kɛ Heman kɛ Yedutun, maŋtsɛ ninalɔ lɛ, efã lɛ. Agbonaabulɔi lɛ yɛ amɛgbɛhei yɛ agbo fɛɛ agbo naa, ni akɛni amɛbɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛshiɔ amɛbuuhei lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ feɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛhãa amɛ.
Afee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nakai gbi lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yosai fã akɛ afee koni akɛja Yehowa yɛ Hehoo lɛ yeli mli, kɛ agbɛnɛ shãa afɔlei lɛ shãa yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ hu mli.
Israelbii ni ba gbijurɔ lɛ yeli nakai be lɛ mli lɛ ye Hehoo lɛ kɛ Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ hu gbii kpawo.

Ayeko Hehoo Gbijurɔ ko yɛ Israel ni ekɛ enɛ ye egbɔ pɛŋ kɛjɛ Gbalɔ Samuel yinɔ; ni asaŋ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ eko eko yeko Hehoo ko ni etamɔ nɔ ni Yosia kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Yuda muu fɛɛ kɛ Israelbii ni ba Yerusalem lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ ye nɛɛ.
Yosia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ aye nɛkɛ Hehoo nɛɛ lɛ.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia efee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ ekɛsaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Egipt Maŋtsɛ Neko fã ta kɛba koni ekɛ Karkemishbii ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa lɛ abawu. Kɛkɛ ni Yosia yiŋ etee akɛ ekɛ Neko yaawu.

Shi Maŋtsɛ Neko tsu bɔfoi kɛba Yosia ŋɔɔ kɛ shɛɛ akɛ, "Yuda Maŋtsɛ, mi kɛ bo bɛ sane ko. Mibaaa ŋmɛnɛ akɛ mikɛ bo miiba abawu. Miba mi kɛ maŋ ni mikɛna ta lɛ abawu; ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã mi akɛ miye mihe oyai. Oote shi ooshi Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ Misɛɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ kpa koni ekakpãtã ohiɛ."
Shi Yosia ekplɛɛɛ, shi moŋ efi nɔ akɛ ekɛ Neko baawu ta lɛ. Ebooo wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Neko nɔ ekɛ ekɛ lɛ wie lɛ toi;no hewɔ lɛ etee ekɛ Egipt Maŋtsɛ Neko yawu yɛ Megido ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni awuɔ ta lɛ Egipt gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ agãi mɔ Maŋtsɛ Yosia. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsuji akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ mi ajiea biɛ ejaakɛ mipila abalaŋ."

No hewɔ lɛ etsuji lɛ wo Yosia yɛ eta shwiili lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wo ta shwiili kroko ni ehiɛ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem, ni ebanyɔ yɛ jɛi, ni afu lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ. Yuda kɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ fo Yosia.

Gbalɔ Yeremia fo yaafo lala, ni ekɛfo Maŋtsɛ Yosia. Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ hii kɛ yei lalatsɛmɛi fɛɛ tsīɔ Yosia tã yɛ amɛyaafo lalai amli kɛ ŋmɛnɛ. Kɛkɛ ni nii nɛɛ tsɔ̃ kusum ni bakã shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ yɛ Israel. Yeremia yaafo lala nɛɛ fata Yaafo Lalai Awolo lɛ mli lalai lɛ ahe.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii kpakpai ni efee ekɛye Yehowa mlai lɛ anɔ,
kɛ agbɛnɛ ehe saji lɛ kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyagbe naa lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Israel kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
36: Yudabii kɔ Yosia binuu Yoahaz, ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ sɛɛ, yɛ Yerusalem.
Yoahaz eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ be ni ebata sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem.
Kɛkɛ ni Egipt Maŋtsɛ Neko ba, ni ebakpa Yoahaz akɛ Yerusalem maŋtsɛ, ni asaŋ ehe Yudabii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talenta kome.
Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ to Yoahaz nyɛminuu Eliakim akɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem maŋtsɛ; shi etsakɛ Eliakim gbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Yehoiakim; ni ekpla Yoahaz kɛtee Egipt.
Yehoiakim eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalem. Eyabaaa ejeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ taoɔ.
Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛba ni ebatua Yuda, ni emɔ Yehoiakim, ni ewo lɛ gboklɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ tee Babilon.
Ni Nebukadnezer loo Yehowa we lɛ mli nibii lɛ ekomɛi kɛtee, ni ekɛyawo emaŋtsɛ we lɛ mli yɛ Babilon.

Yehoiakim he saji fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii gbohii ni efee, kɛ agbɛnɛ saji ni awie ashi ejeŋba lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Israel kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ahe Saji Awolo lɛ mli. Yehoiakim binuu Yehoiakin baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yehoiakin eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ Kpaanyɔ be ni ebatã sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ kɛ gbii nyɔŋma yɛ Yerusalem. Lɛ hu eyabaaa ejeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ.

Afi lɛ shishijee mli lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezer wo tsuji gbɛ, ni amɛbamɔ Yehoiakin kɛtee Babilon, asaŋ aloo Yehowa we lɛ ojrawa nibii lɛ ekomɛi afata ehe kɛtee Babilon lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Nebukadnezar to Yehoiakin nyɛminuu Zedekia akɛ yuda kɛ yersalem maŋtsɛ.
Zedekia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome be ni ebata sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalem.
Eyabaaa ejeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, taoɔ. Eyabaaa ehe shi ehãaa Gbalɔ Yeremia mɔ ni Yehowa kɛ ewiemɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ.

Zedekia hu tse maŋtsɛ Nebukanezar hiɛ atūa be mli ni Nebukanezar ehã Zedekia kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekã lɛ, Nebukanezar lɛ, kitã. Zedekia kuɛŋ yati, ni ekpliŋ etsui, ni emiii akɛ ejeɔ ehe sɛɛ ni eboɔ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi.

Asaŋ Osɔfoiu lɛ ateiaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ hu yanyiɛ maji ni bɔle amɛ lɛ ajeŋba gbohii lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛkɛtɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ babaoo, ni amɛbule Yehowa we lɛ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ etsuu he, ni efee lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ.
Shi Yehowa, ni ji Yudabii lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kã he etsuɔ bɔfoi kɛbaa amɛŋɔɔ ejaakɛ emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ emaŋ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hewɔ.

Shi Yudabii lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ, he fɛo moŋ amɛyeyee, ni amɛgbe amɛwiemɔi lɛ ahe guɔ, ni amɛliɔ gbalɔi lɛ. Amɛfee nɛkɛ aahuu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa mli fu emaŋ lɛ kɛteke nɔ bɔ ni ehiii he nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ.

Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Yehowa yakpla Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ebatua Yudabii lɛ, ni egbe Yuda oblahii lɛ kɛnyiɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli tete po. Eyanaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔbɔ, oblanyo jio, oblayoo jio, nuumo jio, yoomo jio, gbɔmɔ kpintiŋkpliŋŋ jio, helatsɛ jio, egbe fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni eloo Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli jwetrii wuji kɛ bibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nitoohei lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ hu ajwetrii fɛɛ tswɛm, ni ekɛtee Babilon.
Ema Sɔlemɔwe lɛ naa la ni eshã lɛ, ni ekumɔ Yerusalem he gbogbo lɛ eshwie shi. No sɛɛ lɛ ema maŋ muu lɛ naa la ni eshã lɛ kɛ emli mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ kɛ jwetrii fɛɛ.
Mɛi ni je gbele mli pɛ eŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon, ni amɛyasɔmɔ lɛ kɛ eshwiei kɛyashi Persia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baye nɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ lɛ ba mli akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ lɛ baakã shi akɛ amaŋfɔ afii nyɔŋmai kpawo koni ehe ni kulɛ esa akɛ ejɔɔ ni enaaa ejɔɔ lɛ ena ejɔɔ. "Ejaakɛ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, eeeye hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ kɛyaashi afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ aaashɛ.

Maŋtsɛ Koresh, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã nɔ ni etsɔ Gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ ewie lɛ ba mli. Yehowa tsi Maŋtsɛ Koresh ni ehã efã, asaŋ eŋma famɔ lɛ ewo wolo nɔ, ni ayashiɛ yɛ Shikpɔji ni yɔɔ eshishi fɛɛ anɔ akɛɛ akɛ,

"Koresh, Persia Maŋtsɛ, famɔ nɛ, 'Yehowa ni ji ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã mitsɔ̃ je lɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ. Efã mi akɛ miyama Sɔlewe mihã lɛ yɛ Yerusalem yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Naa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ, nyɛyaa Yuda; ni Yehowa, ni ji Yuda Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabu nyɛhe, ni ekɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.'"

1: Paulo, ni ji Kristo Yesu bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timotoe lɛ ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ Korinto lɛ kɛ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Akaia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Ajɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ji musuŋtsɔlɛtsɛ kɛ miishɛjemɔ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Eshɛjeɔ wɔmii yɛ wɔmanehului lɛ fɛɛ mli, koni wɔ hu wɔnyɛ wɔkɛ miishɛjemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛshɛjeɔ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmii lɛ ashɛje mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ amii.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Kristo amanehului lɛ baa wɔnɔ Kɛtekeɔ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo hewɔ lɛ wɔmiishɛjemɔ hu faa kɛtekeɔ nɔ lɛ,nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo hewɔ lɛ wɔmiishɛjemɔ hu faa kɛtekeɔ nɔ.
Shi kɛji amanehulu wɔna jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ kɛ yiwalaheremɔ hewɔ ni; ni kɛji wɔmii ashɛjeɔ hu jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ ni hãa nyɛkɛ tsuishitoo miaa nyɛhiɛ kɛnaa nakai amanehului ni wɔnaa lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ ni.
Ni wɔhiɛ ni kã nyɛnɔ lɛ gbugbãa, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔ ni nyɛnaa amanehului lɛ eko lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛnaa miishɛjemɔ lɛ hu eko.
Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, wɔsumɔɔ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔmanehului ni wɔna yɛ Asia lɛ atee nyɛ, akɛ wɔna nɔ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni ni tete,
shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔna faŋŋ akɛ gbele fɔbuu kã wɔnɔ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ akafɔ̃ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe nɔ, shi moŋ wɔkɛfɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ ni teɔ gbohiii ashi lɛ nɔ;
Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ gbele ni yɔɔ gbeyei tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ mli, ni ebaajie wɔ, ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaaya nɔ ejie wɔ,
kɛji nyɛfata he kɛkpa fai nyɛhã wɔ, koni mɛi pii ada shi aha wɔ yɛ dromɔ keenii ni akɛhã wɔ yɛ mɛi pii afaikpamɔ lɛ hewɔ.

Shi wɔshwãa lɛ nɛ: wɔhenilee odase ni eyeɔ wɔ akɛ hetsemɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli, titri lɛ yɛ wɔkɛ nyɛteŋ shihilɛ mli, ni jeee heloo gbɛfãŋ nilee naa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ wɔŋmaaa nyɛ nibii krokomɛi fe nii ni nyɛkaneɔ ni asaŋ nyɛle, ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale kɛwula shi hu,
tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna nyɛle wɔ hu fã kɛ fã akɛ nyɛshãanɔ ji wɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛji wɔshwãanɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Enɛ nɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ hewɔ mito miyiŋ akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ tsutsu lɛ koni nyɛna dromɔ shi enyɔ,
no ji, ni mibatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Makedonia, ni asaŋ maku misɛɛ kɛjɛ Makedonia maba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, koni nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya Yudea.
Belɛ ni mito miyiŋ nakai lɛ, yiŋ flɛflɛ mikɛ fee? Aloo miyiŋ ni mito lɛ, gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ mikɛtom ni makɛɛ "hɛ̃ɛ" "hɛ̃ɛ", kɛ dabi" "dabi", fɛɛ shi kome?
Shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔwiemɔ ni wɔkɛ nyɛ wie lɛ ejeee nɔ ni kɛɔ "hɛ̃ɛ" kɛ "dadi" fɛɛ shi kome.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi Yesu Kristo mɔ ni mikɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo shiɛ ehe sane yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, ejeee "hɛ̃ɛ" kɛ "dabi" fɛɛ shi kome, shi moŋ eji "hɛ̃ɛ".
Ejaakɛ lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi abɔ ni yɔɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ "hɛɛ"; ni no hewɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ enɔ wɔkɛɔ "Amen" kɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni hãa wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ fiɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli ni, efɔ wɔ mu;
lɛ nɔŋŋ esɔo wɔnaa, ni ekɛ Mumɔ lɛ ehã wɔ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu.
Shi mi lɛ, miitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ebaya odase eshi mi kɛji ejeee anɔkwale akɛ nyɛyibaamɔ hewɔ minko maba Korinto lɛ.
Jeee akɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɔŋ wɔyeɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, shi moŋ wɔfata nyɛhe kɛmiitsu nii kɛhã nyɛmiishɛɛnamɔ.
2: Shi mikpɛ mli yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ mihã nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, namɔ baashɛje mimli akɛ mɔ nɔŋŋ ni mihã eye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ?

Ni miŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ, koni kɛ miba lɛ, mɛi ni kulɛ sa akɛ amɛhã mimii ashɛ mihe lɛ akahã miye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnɔ akɛ nyɛaana akɛ mimiishɛɛ ji nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaana akɛ mimiishɛɛ ji nyɛ fɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ.
Shi mli mikɛ yaafonui babaoo ŋma nyɛ, jeee ni nyɛwerɛ aho nyɛhe, shi moŋ ni nyɛna suɔmɔ babaoo ni misumɔɔ nyɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ehã aye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, jeee mi ni ehã miye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, shi, bɔ ni afee ni minaa akaya shɔŋŋ lɛ, ehã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ko kɛ̃.
Nakai mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ ni mɛi pii ekã lɛ fa hã lɛ;
hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛfaa lɛ moŋ ni nyɛhɛjea emii koni ŋkɔmɔyeli tuutu lɛ akahã enijiaŋ je wui.
No hewɔ lɛ miikpa nyɛfai ni nyɛma nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ mi miŋma nyɛ wolo lɛ, koni mikɛna nɔ gbɔmɛi ni ji nyɛ, akɛ nyɛboɔ toi yɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi ni ji nyɛ, akɛ nyɛboɔ toi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ gbɛfaŋ lo.
Shi mɔ ni nyɛkɛ nɔ ko faa nɔ ni mikafa lɛ, kɛ mikɛ nɔ ko efa lɛ, mikɛfa yɛ nyɛhewɔ yɛ Kristo hiɛ;
koni Satan nine akashɛ wɔnɔ, ejaakɛ wɔle eŋaatsɔ̃i lɛ.
Shi be ni miba Troia ni mibashiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ nii agble gbɛ ahã mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ,
minaaa hejɔlɛ yɛ mimumɔ mli, ejaakɛ minaaa minyɛmi Tito hewɔ lɛ mishɛ amɛ, ni miyiŋ kɛtee Makedonia.
Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ nyiɛɔ wɔhiɛ be fɛɛ be yɛ ekunimyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ ehãa enilee ŋmajee lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo ŋmajee ni ekɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔ yɛ mɛi ni ahereɔ amɛyiwala lɛ kɛ mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ,
mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ, eji gbele ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli hã amɛ; shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, eji wala ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli hã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔtamɔɔɔ mɛi pii ni kɛ nibii krokomɛi futuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, shi moŋ wɔwieɔ lɛ ŋmiiŋmi bɔ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, yɛ Kristo mli.
3: Aso wɔbɔ̃i wɔhe yijiemɔ ekoŋŋ? Aloo ehīa wɔ akɛ wɔhiɛ yijiemɔ woji kɛbahã nyɛ loo kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ehīaa mɛi komɛi lɛ lo?
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji wɔwolo ni aŋma yɛ wɔtsui amli ni mɛi fɛɛ le ni amɛkaneɔ lɛ,
ni ajie nyɛ faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛji Kristo wolo ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he, ni jeee blɛgi akɛŋma, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ, jeee yɛ tɛi tɛtrɛi anɔ,shi moŋ yɛ tsuii9 ni ji heloo taoi anɔ.
Shi Kristo hewɔ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nɛɛ.
Jeee akɛ wɔsa yɛ wɔnyɛmɔ naa, ní wɔɔjwɛŋ akɛ nɔ ko jɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmli, shi wɔsalɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ;
lɛ ehã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni sa akɛ akɛfee kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi, jeee nɔ ni aŋma shi moŋ Mumɔ nɔ;ejaakɛ nɔ ni aŋma lɛ gbeɔ mɔ; shi Mumɔ lɛ hãa mɔ yi naa wala.
Shi kɛ gbele sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akpɛ yɛ tɛi tɛtrɛi anɔ lɛ yɛ nyam bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ Mose hiɛ akwe ehiɛ nyam ni sɛɛ foɔ lɛ hewɔ po lɛ,
ani Mumɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam fe no?
Ejaakɛ kɛ fɔbuu sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ yɛ nyam lɛ, ani jalɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam kɛtekeŋ nɔ aahuu?
Ejaakɛ anumnyam lɛ ni fa babaoo tsɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ bɛ nyam yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ nɔ ni hiɔ shi lɛ yɛ nyam aahuu fe no.
Agbɛnɛ akɛni wɔyɔɔ nɛkɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔfeɔ ekãa babaoo,
ni wɔfeee tamɔ Mose ni kɛ hiɛhaamɔ ha ehiɛ, koni Israelbii lɛ.
Shi moŋ aŋa amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa. Ejaakɛ hiɛhaanɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ha kpãŋmɔ momo lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ; ajieko shi akɛ Kristo mli esɛɛ foɔ yɛ.
Shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni akaneɔ Mose wolo lɛ, hiɛhaanɔ ha amɛtsui nɔ;
shi kɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, aaajie hiɛhaamɔ lɛ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji Mumɔ lɛ, ni he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi heyeli yɔɔ.

Shi wɔ fɛɛ ni wɔkɛ hiɛ kpetekple kwɛɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anumnyam lɛ tamɔ akwɛɔ ashiwshwɛ mli lɛ wɔmiitsake wɔmiitsɔ̃mɔ nakai subaɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛmiijɛ anumnyam mli kɛmiiya anumnyam mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ajeɔ Nuŋtsɔ ni ji Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.
4: No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni akɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ ehã wɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa lɛ, Wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui,
shi wɔkwa hiɛgbejianii ni akɛtee lɛ, ni wɔbaaa wɔjeŋ yɛ kutumpɔo mli; ni asaŋ wɔkɛ nibii futuuu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ wɔhe yi wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ henilee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

Shi kɛ ha aha wɔsanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ tete lɛ, mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ amli ni8 je nɛɛ mli nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eshwila mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ yɛ, koni Kristo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ lɛ anumnyam Sanekpakpa la lɛ akakpɛ miihã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔhiɛɔ, shi moŋ Kristo Yesu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ wɔ hu akɛ nyɛtsuji yɛ Yesu hewɔ;
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ la ajɛ duŋ mli akpɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpɛ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam he nilee la lɛ akpɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo hiɛ.
Shi wɔhiɛ nɛkɛ jwetri nɛɛ yɛ su kpuji amli, koni hewalɛ ni fa kɛteke nɔ lɛ afee Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ni jeee wɔnɔ.
Afifiaa wɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔtsui esuuu; wɔfeɔ yaa, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeko wui,
awaa wɔ yi, shi kɛ̃lɛ akwako wɔ; atswiaa wɔ shi,shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔpleneeko.
Daa nɛɛ wɔhiɛ Yesu gbele lɛ yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ nɛɛ, daa nɛɛ atu wɔ awo gbele dɛŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ, koni Yesu wala kɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ amli.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ gbele tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli, shi nyɛ lɛ, wala tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛmli.
Shi akɛni wɔyɔɔ nakai hemɔkɛyeli mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, "Mihe miye hewɔ ni miwie" lɛ, wɔ hu wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ wɔwieɔ;
ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ mɔ ni tee Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shi lɛ, eeetee wɔ kɛ Yesu shi, ni ekɛ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaadamɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛhewɔ afeɔ fɛɛ, koni dromɔ ni fa babaoo lɛ atsɔ̃ mɛi pii ashidaa nɔ ateke nɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnyawoo.
No hewɔ ni wɔtsui efãaa lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ wɔkponɔgbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ fiteɔ kwraa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔmli gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee gbi fɛɛ gbi.
Ejaakɛ wɔmanehulu kple ni jra wɔna naanɔ anumnyam kple ni jra wa aahuu;
ejaakɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni kwɛɔ nii ni anhaa lɛ, shi moŋ nii ni anaaa lɛ wɔkwɛɔ; ejaakɛ nii ni anaa lɛ hiɔ shi be fioo kɛkɛ, shi nii ni anaaa lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyashiɔ naanɔ.
5: Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ, kɛ akumɔ wɔbuu ni wɔyɔɔ mli ni ji wɔshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ shīa jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ tsu ko ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, shīa ko ni jeee niji akɛfee, ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi tete yɛ wɔbuu nɛɛ mli, ni wɔshweɔ akɛ akɛ wɔtsu ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ awo wɔ,
ni kɛ akɛwo wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ anaŋ wɔ akɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ yayai.
Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ buu lɛ mli lɛ hu, akɛni wɔhe jraa wɔ hewɔ lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔŋtsɔi, ejaakɛ wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ ajie wɔhenii, shi moŋ wɔsumɔɔ akɛ awo wɔ nii ashwie nɔ, koni wala lɛ ami nɔ ni gboɔ lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni saa wɔ hã enɛ nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni hã wɔ Mumɔ lɛ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔyɛ tsui daa, ni wɔle akɛ gbii abɔ ni wɔyɔɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli nɛɛ wɔdom kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ;
ejaakɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ, shi jeee ninamɔ naa,
shi wɔyɛ tsui, ni esa wɔhiɛ moŋ akɛ wɔɔdom kɛjɛ gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ mli, ni wɔyahi shía yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ lɛ oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ, shīa wɔyɔɔ jio, dammɔ wɔdom jio, esa ni wɔsa ehiɛ.
Ejaakɛ ja wɔ fɛɛ wɔpue faŋŋ yɛ Kristo kojomɔ dɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana nii ni efee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwo, bɔbɔ ni efee lɛ, ekpakpa jio, efɔŋ jio.
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔle Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ nyɛhenilee mli hu.
Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe yi wɔjieɔ wɔhãa nyɛ ekoŋŋ,shi moŋ wɔkɛmiihæ nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛkɛshwã nyɛfɔ̃ wɔnɔ, koni nyɛna eko nyɛkɛɛ mɛi ni shwãa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ shi jeee yɛ tsui mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ sɛkɛ wɔyeɔ jiŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ wɔyeɔ ni kɛ wɔyɛ shishiishi hu jiŋŋ, nyɛ hewɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ nyɛɔ wɔnɔ, ni wɔkojoɔ nɛkɛ, akɛ, kɛ mɔ kome gbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele lɛ, belɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ egboi.
Ni egbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele, koni mɛi hiɛ kãmɔ lɛ ahiɛ akakãmɔ miihã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛhiɛ akãmɔ ahã mɔ ni gbo ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ ahã amɛ lɛ.
Belɛ, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, wɔleee mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa; ni kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa wɔle Kristo yɛ tete lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ wɔleee lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ko yɛ Kristo yɛ tete lɛ,bɔɔnɔ hee ji lɛ; blema nii lɛ eho; naa, nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ etɔ̃mɔ ehee.
Shi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ekɛ wɔ kpãtã,ni ekɛ kpãtãmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ hã wɔ lɛ, dɛŋ;
no ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ ekɛ je lɛ kpãtã, ni ebuuu amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ ehãaa amɛ, ni etu kpãtãmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔji bɔfoi yɛ Kristo najiaŋ, tamɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ wɔnɔ eewie eetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi: wɔdamɔ Kristo najiaŋ wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ, nyɛhãa akpãtã nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni leee esha lɛ, wɔhewɔ lɛ ehã etsɔ̃ esha, koni wɔ lɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ yɛ emli.
6: Shi akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi ji wɔ yɛ enitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkahã Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ fee yaka.
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Be ni sa mli mibo o toi yɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua o yɛ." Naa, be ni sa jogbaŋŋ nɛ; naa, yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɛ.
Ni wɔtooo mɔ ko mɔ ko pãmpi yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, koni akagbe wɔsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he guɔ.
Shi moŋ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji wɔ. Wɔmiaa wɔhiɛ babaoo. Wɔtoɔ wɔtsui shi yɛ amanehului kɛ fimɔi kɛ jramɔi amli.
Ayiɔ wɔ ni awoɔ wɔ tsuŋ kpitiokpitio. Afeɔ wɔ soisoi. Wɔtsuɔ nii kɛ kpeshii kɛ dɛŋmegbomɔ pii Wɔhiɔ ŋmãa,
ni wɔbɔɔ hetsemɔ he mɔdɛŋ kɛ nilee. Wɔŋmɛɔ wɔtsui shi; wɔmli hi. Yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ naa lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ osato bɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ wɔwieɔ anɔkwale. Ni wɔwoɔ jalɛ tawuunii yɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku fɛɛ.
Mɛi komɛi woɔ wɔhiɛ nyam; ni mɛi komɛi gbeɔ wɔhe guɔ. Mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe efɔŋ, ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe ekpakpa. Anaa wɔ akɛ shishiulɔi, kɛ̃lɛ, anɔkwafoi ji wɔ.
Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni aleee kɛ mɛi ni aleee kɛ mɛi ni ale krɛdɛɛ; tamɔ mɛi ni gboiɔ, ni naa, wɔhiɛ kãmɔ, Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni agblaa amɛ toi, ni kɛ̃lɛ agbeko wɔ.
Wɔ tamɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi, shi wɔmii shɛɔ daa. Wɔ tamɔ ohiafoi, shi wɔmii shɛɔ daa. Wɔ tamɔ ohiafoi, shi wɔfeɔ mɛi pii niiatsɛmɛ, ni wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko, ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔyɛ nii fiaa.
Korintobii wɔkɛ nyɛ ewie faŋŋ; wɔtsui mli egble.
Gbɛ yɛ wɔmli hã nyɛ, shi nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛtsuii amli joɔ.
Nyɛ hu nyɛgblea nyɛsuii amli nakai nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛto wɔ najiaŋ. Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ mibii.
Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ akagblaa kɔŋtso kome, akɛni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeee egbɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɛɛ bɔɔ jalɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃mɔ yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ yeli la kɛ duŋ yɔɔ?
Ni mɛɛ gbeekpãmɔ Kristo kɛ Belial yɔɔ? Aloo mɛɛ nijaa mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ kɛ mɔ ni heee yeee yɔɔ?

Ni asaŋ mɛɛ ekomefeemɔ yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu kɛ amãgãi ateŋ? Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mãhi amɛmli , ni manyiɛ yɛ amɛteŋ. Ni matsɔ̃ amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, "Nyɛjea amɛteŋ, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe, ni nyɛkataa muji nɔ ko he, ni mahere nyɛ atuu.
Ni matsɔ̃ nyɛtsɛ,ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ mibihii kɛ mibiyei."
7: Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni asumɔɔ akɛni wɔna nɛkɛ shiwoi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsuua wɔhe kɛjɛa heloo kɛ mumɔ muji fɛɛ mli, ni wɔhã wɔhetsemɔ aye emuu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli.
Nyɛhãa wɔ gbɛ yɛ nyɛmli! Wɔfeko mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ ko; wɔyeko mɔ ko awui, wɔyeko mɔ ko amim.
Mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛbu nyɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ mikɛɛ momo akɛ wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ yɛ wɔtsui mli bɔ ni gbele mli oo,wɔkɛ nyɛ ekome.
Mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ waa, ni asaŋ mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ babaoo; miyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛjemɔ, miji kɛteke nɔ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ wɔmanehulu lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Ejaakɛshi be ni wɔba Makedonia kɛ hu, wɔnaaa wɔgbɔmɔtso hejɔlɛ kwraa; shi moŋ he fɛɛ he lɛ amanehulu sɔŋŋ wɔnaa: wɔkponɔgbɛ lɛ nɔmɔi, wɔmligbɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔi.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni shɛhjeɔ mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ amii lɛ, kɛ Tito baa lɛ shɛje wɔmii;
Shi jeee ebaa lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ miishɛjemɔ ni nyɛheshwee ni nyɛshweɔ mi lɛ kɛ nyɛheshwamɔ lɛ kɛ mihe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ; enɛ hã mina miishɛɛ babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wolo ni miŋma nyɛ lɛ edɔ nyɛ lɛ, mishwaaa mihe; kɛji mishwa mihe po lɛ, ejaakɛ mina akɛ nakai wolo lɛ edɔ nyɛ, kɛ be kuku po,
agbɛnɛ mimii eshɛ; jeee dɔ ni edɔ nyɛ lɛ hewɔ ni, shi moŋ akɛni dɔlɛ lɛ hã nyɛshwa nyɛhe lɛ hewɔ ni; ejaakɛ edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akajɛ wɔ ni nɔ ko bɔ nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ dɔlɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɛɔ tsuitsakemɔ kɛbaa, tsuitsakemɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa yiwalaheremɔ ni ashwaaa he yɛ he lɛ mli; shi je nɛɛ mli dɔlɛ tsɛɔ gbele.

Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ dɔlɛ ni edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ, nɔ naajiemɔ, mlifu, nɔ gbeyeishemɔ, nɔ shwee, nɔ hiɛdɔɔ, nɔ jalɛ kojomɔ ni etsɛ ewo nyɛmli! Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ nyɛhe tse yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛ miŋma nyɛ tete lɛ, jeee mɔ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, asaŋ hu jeee mɔ ni atɔ̃ enɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe mɔdɛ3 ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ apue faŋŋ ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ wɔmii eshɛ. Shi miishɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ Tito miishɛɛ lɛ he lɛ hã wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ teke nɔ babaoo, ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhã etsui enyɔ emli,
ejaakɛ kɛ mishwã nyɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ko mli lɛ, nyɛwooo ni hiɛgble; shi tamɔ bɔ ni wɔwie nibii fɛɛ anɔkwale mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔshwãa hu ni wɔshwã wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Tito lɛ efee anɔkwale,
ni eyɛ nyɛhe tsui babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ, ejaakɛ ekaiɔ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ here lɛ lɛ.
Mina miishɛɛ akɛ mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
8: Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiihã nyɛlɛ dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛdro Makedonia asafoi lɛ,
akɛ aka amɛ yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiishɛɛ lɛ teke nɔ, ni amɛhía katekate lɛ mli po, amɛjie mlihilɛ falɛ kpo;
ejaakɛ miiye odase akɛ amɛhã bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ, ni amɛhã fe bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ tete yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa,
ni amɛkɛ tutɔmɔ babaoo kpa wɔ fai ni ahã amɛ hu amɛna naanyobɔɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ mli gbɛ,
ni jeee bɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛŋɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe amɛhã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu kɛ wɔ hu, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa.
No hã wɔkpa Tito fai, koni bɔ ni ebɔ̃i momo sa lɛ, nakai etsu dromɔ nitsumɔ nɛɛ kɛgbe naa hu yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtekeɔ nɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ fɛɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni jɛ wɔmli ni eyɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkwɛa koni nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ mli hu lɛ! nyɛteke nɔ.
Miwieee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ mɛi krokomɛi amɔdɛŋbɔɔ mikɛkaa nyɛ hu nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ makwɛ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋŋ lo.
Ejaakɛ nyɛle wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ ni ji niiatsɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ohiafo yɛ nyɛhewɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ ehia lɛ nɔ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi.
Nɔ ni mijwɛŋ yɛ sane nɛɛ he nɛ, enɛ hi hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni akɛbaafee lɛ hu nyɛ tsutsu nyɛje shishi afi beebe nɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛbea feemɔ lɛ naa, koni bɔ ni oya nɔŋŋ ni nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛjɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbea naa.
Ejaakɛ kɛ tsui yɛ he lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko hãa kɛjɛɔ nɔ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ saa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; jeee kɛjɛ nɔ ni ebɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mɛi komɛi ahe ajɔ amɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhao, Shi moŋ koni fɛɛ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ;

nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛna kɛteke nɔ lɛ ayaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ mɛi komɛi nyɛɛɛ ahã lɛ najiaŋ, koni be kroko lɛ nɔ ni amɛ hu amɛna kɛteke nɔ lɛ abaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛhã lɛ najiaŋ, koni aye egbɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ;
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ni bua pii naa lɛ, enaa eko yɛ sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni bua fioo naa hu lɛ,eshwɛɛɛ lɛ eko."
Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛhedɔɔ nɛɛ wo Tito tsui mli lɛ;
ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ wɔkɛŋmɛ ehiɛ ni eba ni ekpɛ̃, shi akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ he tsui waa hewɔ lɛ, eba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔ naa.
Shi nyɛmi ni wɔtsu wɔfata ehe nɛɛ yɛ yijiemɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ;
shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi asafoi lɛ hala lɛ hu, ni ekɛ wɔ anyiɛ ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nitsumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ anumnyam, ni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ he tsui ni wɔɔyɔɔ;
ejaakɛ wɔmiikwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni mɔ ko akawie wɔhe efɔŋ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa nikee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ hewɔ;
ejaakɛ oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ efee fɛo, jeee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.
Shi wɔtsu wɔnyɛmi lɛ hu wɔfata amɛhe, mɔ ni wɔka lɛ kpitiokpitio yɛ nibii pii amli, ni wɔna akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ,shi agbɛnɛ eebɔ mɔdɛŋ po fe tsutsu lɛ, yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ pii lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Tiro lɛ, mihefala ni mikɛtsuɔ nyɛhe nii ji lɛ, ni wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu, asafoi lɛ abɔfoi kɛ Kristo hiɛnyam ji amɛ.
No hewɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ kpo nyɛtsɔ amɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛ.
9: Shi nɔ ni sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛyaa sɔ̃mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ he lɛ, ehīaaa akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɔ ko.

Ejaakɛ mile bɔ ni nyɛna he tsui ni mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ he tsui ni mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ he tsui ni mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ Makedoniabii lɛ akɛ Akaiabii esaa amɛhe amɛto kɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛ afi lɛ beebe; ni nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ ewo mɛi pii ahiɛdɔɔ.
Shi mitsu nyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni wɔshwãa ni wɔshãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ akafee yaka yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛhe bɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ;
ni kɛ banina nyɛ akɛ nyɛsako nyɛhe, ni wɔhiɛ, misumɔɔɔ akɛ makɛɛ akɛ nyɛ nyɛhiɛ, bagboi yɛ wɔhiɛ ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ mli.

No hewɔ lɛ mijwɛŋ akɛ ehīa akɛ makpa nyɛmimɛi lɛ afai ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ ni amɛbasaa nɛkɛ nyɛjɔɔmɔ ni awo shi momo nɛɛ amɛto koni efee klalo akɛ joomɔ nɔ ko shi jeee nɔ ko ni akɛ hiɛjoomɔ miishɔ̃ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
Shi enɛ mikɛɔ akɛ, mɔ ni lɛteɔ nii ahe duɔ lɛ, ekɛ helɛtemɔ hu aaakpa; ni mɔ ni duɔ yɛ jɔɔmɔ mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mli nɔŋŋ eeekpa yɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni ekpɛ mli momo yɛ etsui mli, ni ekajɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli loo nɔnyɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ tsujurɔnaa halɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔmɔɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ akɛ eeehã dromɔ fɛɛ ateke nɔ ahã nyɛ, koni nyɛhe atua nyɛ kwraa yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli daa nɛɛ ni nyɛna nii kɛteke nɔ hã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa;
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Egbɛɔ eshwãa ehãa ohiafoi lɛ; ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ."
Shi mɔ ni kɛ dumɔwui keɔ dulɔ ni ekɛ aboloo hu hãa yeli lɛ, eeehã nyɛjalɛ yibii lɛ hu ashwere;
ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni nyɛfee mlihilɔi kwraa, ni nyɛmlihilɛ lɛ ahã atsɔ wɔnɔ akɛ shidaa aha Nyɔŋmɔ;
ejaakɛ nɛkɛ yelikɛbuamɔ nɛɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee fɛnemɔ kɛkɛ efɛneɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ yɛ fimɔ mli, shi moŋ ehãa adaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi babaoo kɛtekeɔ nɔ hu.

Ejaakɛ odase kpakpa ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ yeɔ lɛ hãa amɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ ye ni nyɛyeɔ Kristo Sanekpakpa ni nyɛjajeɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ mlihilɛ ni nyɛkɛyeɔ nyɛbuaa amɛ kɛ mlihilɛ ni nyɛkɛyeɔ nyɛbuaa amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ,
ni amɛbaasɔle amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛbaashwɛ nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛnɔ kɛteke nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ enikeenii ni anyɛŋ agba lɛ hewɔ!
10: Shi mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ Kristo hejɔlɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ lɛ hewɔ, mi ni akɛɛ kɛ miyɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ mifeɔ mihe humi yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi kɛ mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mijeɔ eka6a miwoɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Shi miikpa nyɛ fai ni kɛ miba lɛ, nyɛkãhã mikɛ hewalɛ ni mito akɛ mikɛbaawie lɛ miijie eka6a kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni susuɔ akɛ wɔtamɔ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo naa lɛ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ moŋ, shi wɔwuuu ta yɛ heloo naa.
Ejaakɛ wɔtawuunii lɛ jeee heloo mli nii ni, shi moŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, hewalɛ ni akɛkumɔɔ mɔ̃ji ni yɔɔ hewɔlɛ ni,
ni wɔkumɔɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ he nɔ ni wɔŋɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwɛŋmɔ nom ni ebo Kristo toi,
ni wɔsaa wɔhe wɔto, koni, kɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ ye emuu lɛ, wɔgbla toigbele fɛɛ he toi.
Nyɛkwɛa nibii bɔ ni nyɛnaa amɛ lɛ. Kɛ mɔ ko heɔ yeɔ akɛ Kristo nɔ ji lɛ lɛ, esusu he ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eji Kristo nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔji Kristo nii.
Ejaakɛ kɛ shwãa po mashwã kɛteke nɔ yɛ wɔhegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mihiɛ gboŋ,
koni mikafee akɛ mɔ ko ni woɔ nyɛhe gbeyei kɛ woji.
Ejaakɛ akɛɔ akɛ, woji lɛ amli saji tsii ni amɛmli wa moŋ, shi kɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɛ biɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe waaa ni ewiemɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ana ale enɛ akɛ, bɔ ni wɔwiemɔ yɔɔ yɛ woji amli kɛ wɔbɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ kɛ wɔyɛ jɛi lɛ wɔnifeenii hu yɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ wɔkaaa akɛ wɔɔbu wɔhe wɔshi mɛi komɛi ni jieɔ amɛhe yi lɛ anɔ, aloo akɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe aaato amɛhe. Amɛ lɛ, akɛni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe susuɔ amɛyooo sɛɛ.
Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔshwãŋ fe nine, shi moŋ, wɔshwãa yɛ susumɔ kpãa ni Nyɔŋmɔ esusu ehã wɔ ni kɛlɛ shɛɔ nyɛ hu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ wɔkpãaa wɔmli tsɔ tamɔ mɛi ni shɛɛɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ klɛŋklɛŋ wɔkɛ Kristo he Sanekpakpa lɛ shɛ nyɛŋɔɔ;
wɔshãaa fe nine yɛ mɛi krokomɛi anitsumɔi ahewɔ; shi wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ shwere lɛ, wɔnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli baagble kɛteke nɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ wɔsusumɔ kpãa lɛ naa,
koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ niiaŋ, ni wɔkashwã wɔfɔ̃ nii ni atsu momo yɛ mɔ kroko nɔ mli lɛ anɔ.
Shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ eshwã efɔ̃!
Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni jieɔ ehe yi lɛ ji mɔ ni sa, shi moŋ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jieɔ eyi lɛ.
11: Mina ni kulɛ nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mikwashiafeemɔ fioo! Shi anɔkwale nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mi.
Ejaakɛ nyɛhe awuŋa ni miyeɔ lɛ, miiye lɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye; ejaakɛ kɛ mitsɛ nyɛhe baa mihã nuu kome ni mikɛ oblayoo fro ni he tsɛ ayahã Kristo.
Shi miishe gbeyei akɛ aleeenɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni onufu lɛ kɛ ekutumpɔo lɛ laka Hawa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafite nyɛ hu nyɛjwɛmɔ ni nyɛŋmɛɛ suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ Kristo lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko ba ni ebashiɛ Yesu kroko ni wɔshiɛko, loo mumɔ kroko ni nyɛnako, loo Sanekpakpa kroko ni nyɛmɔko mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhere lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye egbɔ.
Shi kɛ miji gbɔmɔ ko ni leee nɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ gbɛfaŋ tete lɛ, mijeee nakai yɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ; shi moŋ wɔfee enɛ faŋŋ wɔhã nyɛ, yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
Aloo belɛ akɛ mihe shi koni awo nyɛnɔ ejaakɛ mijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yaka lɛ mifee esha?
Mitsawa asafoi krokomɛi ojo mihe nyɔŋmɔwo yɛ amɛdɛŋ mikɛsɔ̃mɔ nyɛ.

Ni be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ ni efi mi tete lɛ, mifeee jatsu mihãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko, ejaakɛ nii ni hīa mi lɛ,, nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ Makedonia ba lɛ hã shɛ midɛŋ, ni mile mihenɔkwɛmɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni masaa male mihenɔkwɛmɔ, koni mikatsɔ̃ jatsu mihã nyɛ.
Gbii abɔ ni Kristo anɔkwale lɛ yɔɔ mimli nɛɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ mishwãa nɛɛ gbɛ yɛ Akaia niiaŋ.
Mɛɛ hewɔŋ? Akɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ hewɔŋ? Nyɔŋmɔ le.
Nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ, afee, koni mikɛtsi mɛi ni taoɔ mihe sane lɛ agbɛ, ni ana amɛ yɛ amɛshwãanii lɛ amli,tamɔ bɔ ni anaa wɔ hu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ ji amale bɔfoi, nitsulɔi shishiulɔi ni tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ Kristo bɔfoi.
Ni enɛ bɛ naakpɛɛ tete ejaakɛ Satan diɛŋtsɛ tsakeɔ ehe etsɔ̃ɔ la bɔfo;
no hewɔ lɛ kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ tamɔ jalɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ nɔ ko wulu ko; amɛnaagbee baafee tamɔ bɔ ni amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ mɔ ko akabu mi kwashia, shi kɛ jeee nakai lɛ, belɛ nyɛŋɔa mi akɛ kwashia kɛkɛ mɔ, koni mi hu mawo shwãa fioo ko.
Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, miwieee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baawie, shi moŋ tamɔ kwashia wieɔ, yɛ nɔmimaa ni miyɔɔ akɛ miyɛ shwãa nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Akɛni mɛi pii shwãaa yɛ heloo naa hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mashwã eko.
Akɛni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nilelɔi ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ toɔ nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi ni bɛyitseiaŋ;
ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ miiye nyɛ nyɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ko miitswa nyɛ oji kɛ mɔ ko miimɔ nyɛ, kɛ mɔ ko miigbla nyɛhiɛ ma lɛ, nyɛkplɛ̃ɔ lɛ.
Miiwie kɛ hiɛgble akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni wɔfee gbedee tsɔ̃. shi nɔ mli ni mɔ ko feɔ ekãa yɛ lɛ, miiwie tamɔ kwashia, mi hu mifeɔ ekãa yɛ mli.
Hebribii ji amɛ? Mi hu eko ji mi. Isrealbii ni? Mi hu eko ji mi.
Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ? Miiwie tamɔ mɔ ni yitsoŋ kãa lɛ. Mife amɛ yɛ tɔlɛ nitsumɔi ni teke nɔ amli, yɛ gbelei amli kpitiokpitio.
Yudafoi yi mi shii enumɔ, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ, shwɛ ekome ni afee kpãi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Atswia mi kpãi shii etɛ̃, atswia mi tɛi shi kome, mikɛ lɛlɛ sha shi shi etɛ̃. Miye jenamɔ kɛ jetsɛremɔ yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.

Mifã gbɛ kpitiokpitio kɛ emli oshrãi yɛ fai ahiɛ, emli oshrãi yɛ ojowalɔi adɛŋ, emli oshrãi yɛ jeŋmajiŋbii adɛŋ, emli oshrãi yɛ maŋ, emli oshrãi yɛ ŋanɔ, emli oshrãi yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, emli oshrãi yɛ nyɛmimɛi shiwodudui lɛ ateŋ.
Mitsu nii kɛ tɔlɛ, yɛ kpeshii amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai mli, yɛ ŋmaahilɛi amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ fɛi kɛ yayainyiɛmɔ mli.
Nibii ni yɔɔ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ ahe susumɔ.
Namɔ gbedeɔ, ni mi lɛ migbedeee? Namɔ nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ, ni mimli eshãaa mi?
Kɛ ehe ehīa akɛ mashwã kɛ̃ lɛ, mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedemɔnii anɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Krislɛ, le akɛ mimaleee.
Yɛ Damasko lɛ, lumɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ Areta shishi lɛ hã bulɔi bu Damaskobii amaŋ lɛ he ni amɔ mmi,
ni ashi mi yɛ kafu mli kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ ni yɔɔ gbogbo lɛ mli kɛyi shi, ni mijo foi yɛ edɛŋ.
12: Shwãa he ehīa moŋ, shi ehīii hãaa mi, kɛ̃lɛ mibawie ninai kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpojiemɔi ahe.
Mile gbɔmɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli. Afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ nɛ lɛ, ashá nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ; ashá lɛ ni eyɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; ebɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le.
Ni mile nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ akɛ ashá lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, jeee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le.
Shi akɛ asha lɛ kɛtee Paradeiso ni eyanu wiemɔi ni anyɛŋ awie, ni gbɔmɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etīɔ tã lɛ, no lɛ mile.
Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ hewɔ mashwã, shi mishwãŋ mihãŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, akɛ ja yɛ migbedemɔi lɛ ahe.
Ejaakɛ kɛji miitao mashwã lɛ, mifeŋ kwashia, ejaakɛ anɔkwale mawie; shi mikuɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ɔ nɔ, koni aloo enuɔ yɛ minaa lɛ.
Shi bɔ ni afee ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu ko yɛ kpojiemɔi lɛ adramɔ ni amɛdra kɛteke nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahã mi ŋmei ko yɛ miheloo mli, ni ji Satan bɔfo, koni egbla mi mai, ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ mikpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ koni eje minɔ;
ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Midromɔ lɛ fa hã o, ejaakɛ mihewalɛ lɛ, gbedeefeemɔ mli eyeɔ emuu yɛ." No hewɔ lɛ misumɔɔ titri akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedeefeemɔi lɛ anɔ mihe.
No hewɔ lɛ yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ, mimli shɛɔ yɛ gbedeefeemɔi amli, yɛ hiɛnaanɔniinamɔi amli, yɛ fimɔ̃i amli, yɛ yiwaa mli yɛ jramɔ mli; ejaakɛ kɛ mifee gbedee lɛ,no minaa hewalɛ.
Mifee kwashia; nyɛ nyɛnyɛ minɔ ni mifee nakai. Ejaakɛ kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛ moŋ nyɛjieɔ miyi; ejaakɛ kɛji mijeee nɔ ko tete po, ehwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye egbɔ.
Okadii ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ afee yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ tsishitoo fɛɛ mli, yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi amli.
Ejaakɛ mɛni mli nyɛkpeɔ sɛɛ yɛ fe asafoi krokomɛi lɛ fe akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ? Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ tɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ afaa mi!
Naa, enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni misaa mihe akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, shi mikɛ mihe ebafɔŋ nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ jeee nyɛnii lɛ mitaoɔ, shi moŋ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Ejaakɛ esaa akɛ bii tīaa nii toɔ amɛbii.
Shi masumɔ babaoo akɛ mafite nii ni miyɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni asaŋ mikɛ mihe ashã afɔle yɛ nyɛsusumai ahewɔ. Ani esa akɛ bɔ ni suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ faa lɛ, nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ lo?
Nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, eyɛ mli akɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ nɛ; shi akɛni ŋaalɔ ji mi hewɔ lɛ, mimɔ nyɛ yɛ ŋaa mli.
Ani mitsɔ̃ mɛi ni mitsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ eko nɔ miye nyɛ amim lo?
Mikpa Tito fai ni mitsu lɛ kɛ wɔnyɛmi ko; ani Tito baye nyɛ amim ko? Ani jeee nakai mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔkɛnyiɛ? Jeee nakai najiamaamɔhei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ wɔyiɛ?
Asaŋ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnaa sɔŋŋ wɔjieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ lo? Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔwieɔ yɛ, yɛ Kristo mli; shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛna neshimɔmɔ hewɔ wɔwieɔ.
Ejaakɛ miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ, kɛ miba lɛ, mibanaŋ nyɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ, ni nyɛ hu nynaŋ mi bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, pɛsɛŋkuminya, oshekuyeli, mɔhewiemɔ, hefaa, sakasafeemɔ;

ni misaa miishe gbeyei akɛ kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ, mi_nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaba mi shi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ mahã mɛi ni efee esha sa ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii, yɛ amɛmujinii kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ nyeyeŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ
13: Nyɛŋɔɔ ni mibaa nɛɛ ji ni ji shii etɛ̃. Odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ adaaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi.
Mɛi ni efee esha sa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ mito momo, ni asaŋ miikɛɛ amɛ mato be mli ni mikɛɛ be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ lɛ, kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ,
ejaakɛ nyɛmiitao naakpɛɛ okadi ko ni nyɛkɛaana akɛ Kristo wieɔ yɛ mimli, Kristo mɔ ni gbedeee yɛ nyɛmli, shi moŋ ehe waa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ asɛŋ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, ehiɛ kã; ni wɔ hu wɔgbedeɔ yɛ emli; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakãmɔ ahã nyɛ.

Nyɛkaa nyɛ diɛtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lo? Nyɛtaoa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmli nyɛkwɛa. Aloo nyɛleee yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe akɛ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛmli? Kɛ nyɛleee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni esaaa kwraa ji nyɛ.
Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale akɛ wɔ lɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni esaaa.
Shi miikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, koni nyɛkafee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko kwraa, jeee koni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni sa hewɔŋ, shi moɛ koni nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa, ni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni esaaa.
Ejaakɛ wɔnyɛŋ nɔ ko wɔfee wɔshi anɔkwale lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ nɔ ko wɔɔfee lɛ, wɔɔfee wɔhã anɔkwale lɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔnaa miishɛɛ, kɛ wɔfee gbedee ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛyɛ hewalɛ lɛ; shi nɔ he fai ni wɔkpaa ji nyɛ emuuyeli.
No hewɔ hi ni miŋmaa enɛ be ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛɛ, koni kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mikɛ nyɛ akaye waa, yɛ hegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã mi ni mikɛsaa shi jeee ni mikɛfite lɛ naa.
Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛmi ashɛa, nyɛyea emuu, nyɛshɛjea nyɛhe mii, nyɛŋmɔ afea ekome, nyɛhīa shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Nyɛŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ Kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen.

1: Onukpa lɛ ŋma yahã Awula ni ahala lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ, mɛi ni misumɔɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, ni jeee mi kome kɛkɛ, shi mɛi fɛɛ hu ni le anɔkwale lɛ
yɛ anɔkwale ni hiɔ wɔmli ni ekɛ wɔ aaahi shi kɛaaatee naanɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, tsɛ lɛ Bi lɛ, dɛŋ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi yɛ anɔkwale suɔmɔ mli!
Mina miishɛɛ babaoo akɛ mina obii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nyiɛ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ wo wɔ kitã lɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ miikpa o fai, Awula, jeee akɛ belɛ miiŋma o kitã hee ko, shi moŋ nɔ ni wɔyɔɔ kɛje shishijee lɛ, akɛ wɔsumɔsumɔɔ wɔhe.
Ni suɔmɔ lɛ ji akɛ wɔnyiɛ yɛ ekitãi lɛ anaa; kitã lɛ ji akɛ, bɔ ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, nyɛba nyɛjeŋ nakai.
Ejaakɛ shishiulɔi pii eba je lɛ mli, mɛi ni ejajeee akɛ Yesu Kristo eba yɛ heloo mli. Mɔnɛ ji shishiulɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo henyɛlɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkalaaje nii ni nyɛkɛ nitsmɔ ena lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛna nyɔmɔwo muu.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tekeɔ Kristo tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ ni ehiii mli lɛ, ebɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; mɔ ni hiɔ Kristo tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, eyɛ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ.
Kɛ mɔ ko ba nyɛŋɔɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkaherea lɛ kɛbaa nyɛwe, ni nyɛkaflaa lɛ tete;
ejaakɛ mɔ ni flaa lɛ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ ekome yɛ enitsumɔui fɔ̃ɔji lɛ amli.
Kulɛ miyɛ nibii pii ni maŋma nyɛ, shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mikɛ wolo kɛ "blɛgi" ŋmaa, shi moŋ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ abawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ,koni wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ ayi obɔ̃.
Onyɛmiyoo ni ahala lɛ bii lɛ miibi o.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ tse Israel hiɛ atua.

Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia, jɛ eŋwɛi asa ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ samflɛ mli eyagbee shi, ni epila waa. No hewɔ lɛ etsu bɔfoi koni amɛyabi Baal-Zebub, Filistibii anyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ Ekron lɛ nii akɛ, "Ani hela ni yeɔ mi nɛɛ, mana hewalɛ lo?"

Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ fã Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya koni okɛ Samaria maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ ayakpe, ni obi amɛ akɛ, 'Aso Nyɔŋmɔ ko ni bɛ Israel hewɔ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ nɛɛ?'
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.'" No hewɔ lɛ Elia yiŋ etee taakɛ Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ?"

Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Nuu ko kɛ wɔ bakpe, ni ekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa maŋtsɛ ni tsu nyɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛyakɛa lɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, aso Nyɔŋmɔ ko ni bɛ Israel hewɔ ni otsuɔ koni ayabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ nɛɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.'"
Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, "Nuu ni kɛ nyɛ bakpe ni ekɛ nyɛ wie nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, te esu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?"
Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔiatsɛ ni. Ewo atade wuyaa, ni ekɛ kooloo hewolo efi emliteŋ." Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, ni".

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu asafoiatsɛ ni yeɔ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛtee koni amɛyaŋɔ Elia kɛba. Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ emɛi lɛ tee Elia ŋɔɔ; amɛyana lɛ ní eta shi yɛ gɔŋ ko yiteŋ. Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, "Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Nii Maŋtsɛ kɛɛ okpleke shi ni oba!"
Shi Elia kɛɛ asafoitsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji mi lɛ, no lɛ, la ajɛ ŋwɛi ayi shi koni ebashã o kɛ omɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni la jɛ ŋwɛi yi shi, ni ebashã lɛ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ saa etsu asafoitsɛ kroko kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛtee Elia ŋɔɔ. Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kwɔ etee gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyakɛɛ Elia akɛ, "Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Ni Maŋtsɛ efã o akɛ okpleke shi ni oba nɔŋŋ."
Shi Elia hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji mi lɛ, no lɛ, la ajɛ ŋwɛi ayi shi, ni ebashã o kɛ omɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni la jɛ ŋwɛi yi shi, ni ebashã lɛ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ saa etsu asafoiatsɛ kroko hu kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ hu, nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ nɔ. Ni mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Etee eyakula shi yɛ enakutsei anaa yɛ Elia hiɛ, ni ekpa lɛ fai, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, miikpa o fai, naa mi kɛ otsuji nɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Naa, la ejɛ ŋwɛi ebayi shi, ni ebashã klɛŋklɛŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛmɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔi lɛ fɛɛ; shi agbɛnɛ, mi lɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ, hã misusuma jara awa yɛ ohiɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, "Okɛ lɛ akpleke shi kɛya, kaashe lɛ gbeyei!" Kɛkɛ ni Elia te shi, ni ekɛ lɛ tee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

"Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Akɛ nɔ kɛ̃ ni otsu bɔfoi kɛtee koni amɛyabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ Israel ni aaabi edaaŋ gbee, hewɔ lɛ oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ, gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.'"

No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ Ahazia gbo yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni Elia wie lɛ naa; ni akɛni Ahazia bɛ bi kwraa hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmi Yoram baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Yehoram ni ji Yehoshafat bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ nibii fɛɛ ni maŋtsɛ Ahazia fee lɛ, aŋmã fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
2: Agbɛnɛ ba bashɛ ní Yehowa baaŋɔ Elia kɛya ŋwɛi yɛ lasuogbele mli. Elia kɛ Elisha nyiɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ Gilgal;

ni be ni amɛyaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Miikpa o fai, mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Betel." Shi Elisha to he akɛ, "Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo." Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi mli kɛtee Betel.
Gbalɔi akuu ko ni yɔɔ Betel lɛ mli bii lɛ je kpo kɛba Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, "Ani ole akɛ ŋmɛnɛ, Yehowa baaŋɔ onuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya?" Ni ehã amɛ hetoo akɛ, "Mi hu mile; nyɛfea diŋŋ kɛkɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Elisha, mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Yeriko." Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiii bo!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛba Yeriko.
Gbalɔi aku ko ni yɔɔ Yeriko lɛ mli bii lɛ ba Elisha ŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, "Ani ole akɛ ŋmɛnɛ Yehowa baaŋɔ onuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya?" Ni ehã amɛ hetoo akɛ, "Mi hu mile, nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea diŋŋ kɛkɛ!"

Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Mɛɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Yordan Faa lɛ naa." Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiii bo." Hewɔ lɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛyi mli kɛtee.
Ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛtee lɛ, yadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, shi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛdamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia jie etade yuu lɛ ni ekota, ni ekɛtswa nu lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ mli gba kɛtee biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛnyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo faa lɛ.

Be ni amɛfo faa lɛ kɛtee faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Bi mi nɔ ni osumɔɔ ni mafee mahã o, dani aŋɔ mi kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya." Ni Elisha kɛɛ, "Hã mana omumɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ eko bɔ ni aaaha matsɔ mɔ ni baaye onajiaŋ."
Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Obi nɔ ko ni wa naakpa, shi kɛ̃lɛ kɛji oona mi ni aawo mi kɛmiije oŋɔɔ kɛya lɛ, no lɛ aaaba mli nakai ahã o; shi kɛji onaaa mi lɛ, no lɛ onine shɛŋ nɔ."
Be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa ni amɛwieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, la shwiili kɛ la okpɔŋɔi ba, ni amɛbagbla Elia kɛ Elisha teŋ. Ni Elia tsɔ̃ lasuogbele lɛ mli kɛtee ŋwɛi.
Elisha na nii nɛɛ, ni ebo etsɛ Elia akɛ, "Mitsɛ, mitsɛ! Israel hefãlɔ kple! Ao, tee otee lɛ" Ni enɛ sɛɛ lɛ enaa Elia dɔŋŋ Ni emɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etade yuu lɛ mli ni etse mli enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ Elia atade lɛ ni je ehe egbee shi lɛ, ni eku esɛɛ, ni eyadamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ naa.

Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ Elia atade ni je ehe egbee shi lɛ, ni ekɛtswa nu lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ Yehowa, Elia Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɔɔ?" Ni be ni ekɛ atade lɛ tswa nu lɛ mli lɛ, nu lɛ mli gba enyɔ, kɛtee biɛ kɛ biɛ. Ni Elisha tsɔ̃ mli kɛho.
Be ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni jɛ Yeriko lɛ ni damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Elia mumɔ lɛ ebayi Elisha nɔ." Amɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni amɛkoto lɛ,

ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa agbɛnɛ lɛ, naa wɔ otsuji hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ omasɛi, wɔmiikpa o fai, hã wɔya ni wɔyatao onuŋtsɔ lɛ; eko lɛ aleee nɔ, Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ewo lɛ kɛtee, ni eyashɛ lɛ efɔ̃ gɔji lɛ eko nɔ aloo jɔɔi lɛ eko mli." Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Dabida, nyɛkatsūa kɛyaa."
Shi be ni amɛhiɛ enaa gbamɔ aahuu ni efee lɛ ahuntoo lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsūa kɛyaa." No hewɔ lɛ amɛtsū hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛtee, ni amɛyatao lɛ gbii etɛ̃, shi amɛnaaa lɛ.
Ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Elisha ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ Yeriko, he ni emɛɔ yɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani mikɛɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛkaya lo?"

Agbɛnɛ hii komɛi ní jɛ Yeriko maŋ lɛ mli tee Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, maŋ nɛɛ kãmɔhe lɛ hi moŋ nɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni, bo wɔnuŋtsɔ, onaa nɛɛ; shi nu lɛ ehii, ni ehã ashrãkeɔ bii, asaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ hãaa niyenii aba."
Ni efã mɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ ŋoo awoa kã hee mli ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi." Ni amɛkɛbahã lɛ.
Ni etee nuhiŋmɛi lɛ he, ni eyatsi ŋoo lɛ ewo mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mifee nu nɛɛ krɔŋŋ, ni ehaŋ gbele loo shrãkemɔ aba dɔŋŋ.'"
Ni nakai nu lɛ fee krɔŋŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, yɛ Elisha wiemɔ lɛ naa.

Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Elisha jɛ Yeriko eeya Betel; ni be ni eyaa lɛ, gbekɛbii hii bibii komɛi jɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbaye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Yiteŋ kpataatsɛ, jee biɛ ní oya! Yiteŋ kpataatsɛ, jee biɛ ní oya!"
Elisha tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ekwɛ amɛ, ni ekɛ Yehowa gbɛi lomɔ amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni oshishibrishi yei enyɔ jɛ koo lɛ mli ba, ni amɛbatserɛ gbekɛbii hii lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ mli.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Elisha tee Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejɛ jɛi kɛtee Samaria.
3: Yuda maŋtsɛ, Yehoshafat maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahab bi Yehoram baye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Efee esha eshi Yehowa, shi kɛ̃lɛ etamɔɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ Yezebel nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, ekumɔ Baal amãgãi lɛ ni etsɛ fee lɛ eshwie shi.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ esha ni klɛŋklɛŋ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, fee lɛ, nakai esha lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ hu efee, ejaakɛ ehã Israel fee esha, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekpaleee.
Moab maŋtsɛ Mesha lɛ lɛɔ toi, ni daa afi lɛ eyahãa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ toogwaŋtɛŋ bii akpei oha kɛ too ojwɛnii akpei oha ahe tsɔi akɛ daa afi too ni ewoɔ ehãa lɛ.
Shi be ni Israel maŋtsɛ Ahab gbo lɛ, Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ tse Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atūa.
No hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yehoram fã kɛjɛ Samaria ni eyabua etabilɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ naa.

Kɛkɛ ni etsu ayakɛɛ Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ etsɛ mihiɛ atua; ani ooofata mihe ni mikɛ Moabbii lɛ ayawu lo?" Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat hã hetoo akɛ, "Matee; mi nɔŋŋ ji bo, mimaŋ lɛ omaŋ ni, ni mikpɔŋɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni."
Kɛkɛ ni Ywhoshafat bi akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ wɔɔtsɔ̃ kɛtua amɛ lɛ?" Yehoram hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Wɔbaatsɔ̃ Edom ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ tɔ̃ɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ amɛtee. Amɛkpa shi gbii kpawo, ni anaaa nu ahã tabilɔi lɛ kɛ kooloi ni amɛkɛnyiɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Yehowa etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ, koni etu wɔ ewo Moabbii adɛŋ!"

Shi Yehoshafat bi akɛ, "Ani Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ ni wɔɔtee wɔyabi Yehowa nii yɛ eŋɔɔ?" Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ ni fɔse nu shwie Elia niji anɔ lɛ, yɛ biɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat kɛɛ akɛ "Yehowa gbalɔ ji lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat lɛ kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ tee Elisha ŋɔɔ.

Ni Elisha kɛɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ sane mikɛ o yɔɔ? Yaa koni oyabi otsɛ gbalɔi kɛ onyɛ gbalɔi lɛ nii." Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram here nɔ akɛ, "Dabida, ejaakɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ kɛbakpe koni etu wɔ ewo Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ."
Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bei abɔ ni Yehowa, tai a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ hiɛ kã nɛɛ, eji jeee Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛaŋ mihiɛ shwieɔ kulɛ, mikwɛŋ bo hiŋmɛileishi po, aahuu ni makwɛ ohiɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛyaŋɔa saŋkutswalɔ ko nyɛbahãa mi". Agbɛnɛ be ni saŋkutswalɔ lɛ tswaa esaŋku lɛ, Yehowa hewalɛ bayi Elisha nɔ;
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Nyɛtsaa bui yɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ mli fɛɛ.
Nyɛnaŋ ahum, ni asaŋ nyɛnaŋ nunɛmɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ baayi tɔ kɛ nu, koni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ kɛ nyɛlɛɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ anu'".
Elisha tee nɔ akɛ, "Shi enɛ tete lɛ ejeee nɔ ko ni wa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; asaŋ ebaatu Moabbii lɛ hu ewo nyɛdɛŋ;

ni nyɛaaye maŋ wulu fɛɛ maŋ wulu ni atswa gbogbo awo he, kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ fɛo nɔ, ni nyɛaatoo tso kpakpa fɛɛ tso kpakpa, ni nyɛaatsimɔ nubu fɛɛ nubu, ni nyɛkɛ tɛi aaafite amɛshikpɔŋ kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ."
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi afɔle shãa be mli lɛ, naa nu jɛ Edom gbɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ nu.
Be ni Moabbii lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ lɛ efã kɛmiiba ni amɛkɛ amɛ abawu lɛ, ayabua mɛi fɛɛ ni eshɛ tayaa, kɛjɛ oblahii anɔ kɛyashi onukpai anɔ, anaa kɛba, ni akɛ amɛ badamɔ husu lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni amɛte shi leebi maŋkpa, ni hulu miikpɛ yɛ nui lɛ anɔ lɛ, Moabbii lɛ na nu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛhiɛ lɛ akɛ eetsu faa tamɔ lá.
Ni Moabbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Lá nɛ; maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ewuwui, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔyahaa amɛshitoohe lɛ mli nii."

Shi be ni Moabbii lɛ shɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ he lɛ, Israelbii lɛ te shi, ni amɛtua Moabbii lɛ, ni amɛtwsia amɛ nii, ni Moabbii lɛ jo foi kɛje Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ bote Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛgbegbee Moabbii lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni amɛbutu maji wuji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kpakpa fɛɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ lɛ, Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo shɛ etɛ efɔ̃ nɔ kɛyashi shikpɔji lɛ anɔ yi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ tɛ. Amɛtsimɔ nubui fɛɛ; ni amɛtoo tsei kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ. Naagbee lɛ, maŋ wulu ni ashi pɛ ji Kir-Heres; kɛkɛ ni akromiafɔ̃lɔi lɛ yabɔle maŋ lɛ ni amɛŋɔ.
Be ni Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ na akɛ ta lɛ naa wa tsɔ̃ hã lɛ lɛ, eŋɔ hii ohai kpawo ni hiɛ klaŋte efata ehe, koni amɛgba kɛtsɔ̃ henyɛlɔi lɛ ata lɛ mli kɛjo foi kɛya Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ shi amɛnyɛɛɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ ebi nuu ni ji ekromɔbi, ni kulɛ ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ shã shãa afɔle yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ, ehã Moabbii anyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Enɛ wo Israelbii lɛ ahe gbeyei ni amɛgbla amɛhe shi kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
4: Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ŋa okulafo tee Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ataa, naa, otsulɔ ni ji miwu lɛ egbo, ni ole akɛ esheɔ Yehowa gbeyei. Shi amrɔ nɛɛ mɔ ko ni miwu lɛ hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ ebamɔmɔ mibihii lɛ kɛtee eyafee amɛ enyɔji."
Elisha bi yoo lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mifee mihã o? Kɛɛmɔ mi. Mɛni oyɔɔ yɛ shīa?" Yoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, "Otsulɔ yoo bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ shīa, akɛ ja mu tɔ kome too pɛ kɛkɛ."
Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa akutso lɛ mli bii fɛɛ aŋɔɔ ni oyamala gbɛi foji babaoo, bɔ ni ooonyɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ yaa shīa lɛ mli koni oŋa shinaa lɛ owo bo kɛ obii lɛ ayi; koni obɔ̃i mu lɛ fɔsemɔ kɛwo gbɛi lɛ fɛɛ amli; kɛji eko yi obɔ̃ lɛ, wo oma sɛɛ flɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni yoo okulafo lɛ shi gbalɔ Elisha, ni etee eyaŋa shinaa lɛ ewo ekɛ ebihii lɛ ayi. Ni be ni amɛholeɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛbaa lɛ, belɛ eefɔse mu lɛ eewowoo amɛmli.
Be ni gbɛi lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛɛ ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, "Wo gbɛ kroko hu kɛba!" Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Gbɛ lɛ eko bɛ dɔŋŋ." Kɛkɛ ni mu lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Yoo okulafo lɛ tee Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ ni eyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ. Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ mu lɛ koni okɛwo onyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, okɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkɛkwɛa nyɛhe."
Gbi ko lɛ Elisha tee Shunem; yoo niiatsɛ ko yɛ jɛi. Yoo nɛɛ kpee Elisha kɛtee ewe lɛ koni ebaye nii. No hewɔ lɛ be fɛɛ be ni Elisha tsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛhoɔ lɛ, egbaleɔ jɛi eyayeɔ nii.
Yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ ewu akɛ, "Naa, agbɛnɛ, miyoo akɛ nuu nɛɛ ni batsɔ̃ɔ wɔŋɔɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Hã wɔma gbogbo tsu fioo ko, ni wɔkɛ saatso kɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ sɛ̃i kɛ kane amamɔ mli ahã lɛ, koni be fɛɛ be kɛji eba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ ni ebahi jɛi."
Gbi ko lɛ Elisha ku esɛɛ kɛba Shunem, ni etee tsu lɛ mli, ni eyajɔɔ ehe yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ Gehazi akɛ, "Yaatsɛ Shunem yoo lɛ kɛba." Ni be ni eyatsɛ yoo lɛ kɛba lɛ, yoo lɛ badamɔ Elisha hiɛ.

Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ yoo lɛ akɛ, 'Kwɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ogba ohe naa yɛ wɔhewɔ; mɛni ooosumɔ akɛ mifee mihã o? Ani oyɛ sane ko ni ooosumɔ akɛ ayakɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, loo asraafoiatsɛ lɛ lo?'" Yoo lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋbii ateŋ miyɔɔ lɛ, ni nɔ ko he ehiaaa mi."
Elisha bi Gehazi akɛ, "Belɛ mɛni afee ahã lɛ mɔ?" Gehazi to he akɛ, "Ebɛ bi nuu, ni ewu hu egbɔ."
Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, "Tsɛ yoo lɛ kɛba." Ni etsɛ lɛ, ni ebadamɔ shinaa lɛ shi.
Elisha kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Wɔsɛɛ afi naakplɔ benɛ lɛ, ooohiɛ bi nuu yɛ okpɔkɔiaŋ." Yoo lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Dabida minuŋtsɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji o, kaalaka mi."
Be ni shɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ bi nuu tamɔ bɔ ni Elisha ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Be ni gbekɛ lɛ bada lɛ, gbi ko lɛ etee etsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋmãakulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Trukaa lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ blɔ ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Miyitso miigba mi, miyitso miigba mi." Etsɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Wo lɛ oyahã enyɛ!"
Ni ewo lɛ eyahã enyɛ. Gbekɛ lɛ ta enyɛ shwuɔ nɔ kɛyashi shwane, ni egbo.
Ni ewo gbonyo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee eyafɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ saa lɛ nɔ, ni eŋa shinaa ewo eyi, ni eje kpo.
Ebo etsɛ ewu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ hã mi oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ teji yei lɛ ateŋ ekome koni masha mihe maya Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ maba!
Ewu lɛ bi lɛ akɛ "Mɛni hewɔ otaoɔ ni oya eŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?" Ŋmɛnɛ jeee nyɔŋ hee, asaŋ ejeee hejɔɔmɔgbi. Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Kaaye otsui."
Ehã awo teji yoo lɛ nɔ nii ahã lɛ; kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ "Wo teji lɛ foi ni wɔtee; kaagbɔjɔ foijee lɛ mli yɛ mihewɔ, ja mikɛɛ o akɛ ogbɔjɔ mli."
Ni eyi mli etee Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ na lɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ Gehazi akɛ: "Naa, Shunamyoo lɛ baa lɛ.
"Sha foi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ koni okɛ lɛ ayakpe, ni obi lɛ akɛ: 'Te oyɔɔ tɛŋŋ? Te owu hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ? Te gbekɛ lɛ hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?'" Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Wɔyɛ jogbaŋŋ!"

Be ni Shunamyoo lɛ shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebamɔmɔ enaji amli. Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi tsi bɛŋkɛ koni etsi lɛ kɛya sɛɛ. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Ŋmɛɛ lɛ gbɛ ni emɔ mimli, ejaakɛ esusuma ehao naakpa yɛ emli; ni Yehowa kɛtee mi, ni ejieko etsɔ̃ko mi."
Kɛkɛ ni Shunamyoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Ani mibaba bi nuu ko yɛ minuŋtsɔ dɛŋ? Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ okalaka mi?"

Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, "Miamɔ, ni okɔ midɛŋhiɛmɔtso lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni oya. Kɛji okɛ mɔ ko kpe yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kaaŋa lɛ; ni kɛji mɔ ko ŋa o lɛ, kaahere lɛ nɔ, ni oya ni okɛ mitso lɛ ayafɔ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni gbɛkɛ lɛ nyɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛkãlɔ lɛ yɔɔ, ni bo hu oyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, mishiii bo miyaaa." Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛyi mli amɛtee.

Gehazi tsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ kɛtee, ni ekɛ tso lɛ yafɔ̃ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ. Shi gbekɛ lɛ ewieee, ni nɔko etsɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ wala yɛ emli. Hewɔ lɛ Gehazi ku esɛɛ ni ekɛ Elisha yakpe, ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ etsɛ̃ko."
Be ni Elisha bote shīa lɛ mli lɛ, ena gbekɛ lɛ ni egbo lɛ kã esaa lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ ebote tsu lɛ mli, ni eŋa shinaa lɛ ewo amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛyi, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai.
Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ saatso lɛ ni eyabu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛ enaabu bu enaabu nɔ; ni ekɛ ehiŋmɛii bumɔ ehiŋmɛii anɔ, ni ekɛ eniji hu shwie eniji anɔ, ni ekpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ. Ni gbekɛ lɛ he dɔ la.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, Elisha te shi, ni eshera shi kɛtee kɛba shi kome yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni esaa eyakpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. Gbekɛ lɛ tsine shii kpawo, kɛkɛ ni gbele ehiŋmɛi.
Elisha tsɛ Gehazi kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Tsɛ Shunam yoo lɛ kɛba." Ni etee eyatsɛ lɛ kɛba. Be ni yoo lɛ ba lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wo obi lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni eba, ni ebaho egbee Elisha najianaa, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi; no sɛɛ lɛ ewo ebi lɛ kɛje kpo.

Be ni Elisha ku esɛɛ eba Gilgal ekoŋŋ lɛ, no mli lɛ hɔmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Gbi ko be mli ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii tra shi lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ kukwɛi wulu lɛ oma la nɔ, ni ohoo nii ohã gbalɔi nɛɛ."

Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome je kpo etee ŋanɔ koni eyatse shwie. Eyana ŋanɔ baa ko ni haa shi; ni etserɛ baa nɛɛ eko ewo emama naa obɔ̃; ebaflɔ mli ewo kukwɛi ni ma la lɛ nɔ lɛ mli; tsɛbelɛ amɛleee nɔ baa ni ji.
Amɛtsɔ niyenii lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ ni amɛye. Be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, ebɔɔ yɛ niyenii lɛ mli." Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ niyenii lɛ amɛye.
Elisha kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ mamu abaa!" Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ mamu lɛ wo kukwɛi lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛtsɔa nyɛhãa mɛi lɛ ni amɛyea." Ni nɔ ko fɔŋ ko efeee amɛ.

Be kroko lɛ, nuu ko jɛ Baal-Shalishah ba, ni ebahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, akoko kpokploku aboloi akwaabɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ablefɔ hu yɛ kotoku mli. Ni Elisha kɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ ohã gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ni amɛye."
Shi etsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Ani niyenii nɛɛ aaashɛ mɛi oha naa lo?" Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Bo lɛ, ŋɔɔ ohã mɛi lɛ ni amɛye! Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Amɛaaye aahuu ni eko aaashwɛ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ niyenii lɛ ema amɛhiɛ, ni amɛye, ni eko shwɛ, yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.
5: Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Naaman; gbɔmɔ wulu ji lɛ, ni enuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ buɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ enɔ Yehowa tsɔ̃ ehã Siriabii lɛ ye kunim. Yɛŋ akɛ eji asrfonyo kãkãlɔ kpanaa nɛ, shi eeye kpiti.
Be ko lɛ, Siriabii lɛ yatua Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ gbekɛ oblayoo fioo ko nom; ni eyasɔ̃mɔ Naaman ŋa lɛ.
Gbi ko lɛ gbekɛ yoo lɛ kɛɛ ewula lɛ akɛ, "Mina ni minuŋtsɔ yaje gbalɔ ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ ŋɔɔ, kulɛ eeetsa ekpiti lɛ ehã lɛ."
Be ni Naaman nu sane nɛɛ lɛ, etee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyagba lɛ nɔ ni oblayoo lɛ ni jɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.

Ni Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Yaa mɔ! Maŋmã wolo mahã o kɛyahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ." No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋma, kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi shekel akpei ekpaa, kɛ hewulamɔ atadei srɔtoi nyɔŋma kɛtee.
Ni ekɛ wolo lɛ yahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni aŋmã yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ, "Mikɛ wolo nɛɛ miihã ole akɛ, miji mɔ ni miwo Naaman gbɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Eba koni otsa ekpiti lɛ ohã lɛ."

Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kane wolo lɛ egbla ehe atadei, ni ekɛ, "Aso Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, ni migbeɔ mɔ, ni mihãa mɔ yi naa wala, hewɔ ni mɔnɛ tsuɔ miŋɔɔ akɛ mitsa mɔ ko kpiti mihã lɛ nɛɛ? Nyɛjwɛŋa he nyɛkwɛa, ni nyɛaana akɛ, minaa bei kɛkɛ etaoɔ nɛɛ."

Shi be ni Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, nu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ egbla ehe atadei lɛ, etsu atee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ogbla ohe atadei lɛ? Hã eba miŋɔɔ, ni eeena ele akɛ gbalɔ ko yɛ Israel."
No hewɔ lɛ Naaman kɛ ekpɔŋɔ kɛ eshwiilii lɛ ba, ni amɛbadamɔ Elisha we lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Elisha tsu bɔfo ko kɛtee eŋɔɔ akɛ, "Yaa ni oyaju ohe shii kpawo yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ mli, ni aaatsa ohela lɛ ahã o kwraa."
Shi Naaman mli fu ni eyiŋ kɛmiiya, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, miyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ eeeje kpo kɛba miŋɔɔ ebadamɔ shi, ni eeetsɛ Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi, ni ekɛ enine aaahuu jɛi koni etsa kpiti lɛ.
Ani Abana Faa kɛ Farpar Faa ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ, amɛhii fe Israel fai lɛ fɛɛ lo? Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, kulɛ mɛɛba mijuu mihe yɛ nomɛi amli ni mihe tã mɔ?" Ni etsɔ̃ ehe, ni eyiŋ mli, ni kulɛ eeya kɛ mlifu.
Shi etsuji lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wie akɛ, "Ataa, ani kɛji nɔ ko wulu ko gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ ofee kulɛ, ofeŋ lo? Aahuu moŋ ni ekɛɛ o akɛ, 'Yaaju ohe kɛkɛ ni ohe atã lɛ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ Naaman kpleke shi, ni ekɛ ehe yatsɔ Yordan Faa lɛ mli shii kpawo tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ wie lɛ, ni ehe tã, ni ehewolo nɔ bafee trotro ekoŋŋ tamɔ gbekɛ fioo hewolo.

Kɛkɛ ni Naaman ku esɛɛ eba Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, lɛ kɛ emɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ. Eba ni ebadamɔ shi yɛ Elisha hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, agbɛnɛ mina mile akɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ofai nɛ ni ohe otsulɔ dɛŋ nikeenii ko."
Elishã hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ hiɛ kã nɛɛ, miheee nɔ ko." Ni enyɛ enɔ doo akɛ ehe kɛ̃, shi Elisha ekplɛ̃ɛɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji oheee midɛŋ nikee lɛ, belɛ, ofai nɛ ni ohã ni ahã mi sū, bɔ ni teji okpɔŋɔi enyɔ aaatere; ejaakɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, mi otsulɔ, mishaŋ shãa afɔle kroko mihaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja Yehowa kɛkɛ.

Kɛji minuŋtsɔ tee Rimmon, Siria nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ ni eyaaja lɛ, ekpasaa minine. Kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ koto shi eeja lɛ, esa akɛ mikɛ lɛ akoto shi eko yɛ Rimmon we lɛ, Kɛji eeeba lɛ nakai lɛ, Yehowa aŋfa mi, otsulɔ."
Ni Elisha kɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli." Kɛkɛ ni Naaman yi gbɛ etee.

Naaman shɛko he ko shɔŋŋ ko kɛkɛ ni Gehazi, Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ, kɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Naa, minuŋtsɔ eŋɔ Naamaan, Sirianyo nɛɛ he eke lɛ, ni eheee nɔ ni ekɛba lɛ yɛ edɛŋ. Akɛni Yehowa hiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, masha foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ koni mayahe nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi ŋɔ shwie Naaman sɛɛ. Shi be ni Naaman na akɛ mɔ ko hiɛ foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ eyi shi kɛjɛ eshwiili lɛ mli koni ekɛ lɛ ayakpe. Naaman bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni eba?"

Ni Gehazi hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Nɔ ko bako. Minuŋtsɔ tsu mi koni mibakɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ ejɛ Efraim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba miŋɔɔ: ofai nɛ ni ohã amɛ jwiɛtɛi talenta kome kɛ hewulamɔ atadei enyɔ."

Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, "Hã ni mahã bo jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ koni okɛya!" Ni enyɛ enɔ, ni efimɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ lɛ ewo kotokui enyɔ mli, kɛ hewulamɔ atadei fɛfɛji srɔtoi enyɔ lɛ. Ni eŋɔ tere etsuji enyɔ kɛnyiɛ Gehazi hiɛ.
Shi be ni amɛshɛ gɔŋ ni Elisha yɔɔ nɔ lɛ he lɛ, Gehazi he kotokui lɛ yɛ Naaman tsuji lɛ adɛŋ, ni ekɛyato shīa lɛ mli, ni ewo Naaman tsuji lɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni etee eyadamɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ. Elisha bi lɛ akɛ, "Gehazi, nɛgbɛ ojɛ?" Ni ehã hetoo akɛ, "Otsulɔ eyako he ko he ko."

Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo lɛ oleee akɛ yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ miyɛ jɛi, be mli ni ekɛ o bakpe lɛ? Ani be ni aŋɔɔ shika kɛ atadei kɛ mūtsei lɛ waintromi kɛ toogwaŋteŋi kɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ wehii kɛ weyei yɔ mɔ dɛŋ nɛ?
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Naaman kpiti lɛ aaatsɛŋe bo kɛ oshwiei fɛɛ kɛaatee naanɔ." Ni eje ehiɛ kpo kɛ ehe kpiti sakoo tamɔ ayilɔ.
6: Gbi ko lɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Naa, he ni wɔ, owebii nɛɛ, wɔyɔɔ lɛ, yɛ kplokotoo tsɔ̃ hã wɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ ní wɔya Yordan Faa lɛ naa wɔyaflɔ tsei ni wɔkɛbafee shihilɛhei wɔhã wɔhe yɛ jɛi." Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa."
Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, ni okɛ wɔ otsuji aya." Ni ekplɛ̃ nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mi kɛ nyɛ baaya."
Hewɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ tee. Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ amɛtootoo tsei lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome toɔ tso lɛ eko lɛ, dade lɛ fã yɛ lema lɛ yitso eyagbee nu lɛ mli. Ni ebo ekɛɛ, "Ao, minuŋtsɔ, lema lɛ, ma po ayama!"
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha bi akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ eyagbee lɛ?" Be ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ jɛi lɛ, Elisha fo tso kuku ko ni eshɛ efɔ̃ jɛi, kɛkɛ ni amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni dade lɛ batɛo nu lɛ hiɛ.
Ni efã akɛ, "Yaakɔ!" Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kpã enine mli ni ekɔ.
Be ko lɛ ta te shi yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etatsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋɔ, ni amɛkɔɔ he ni amɛkɛbaafee amɛshitoohe.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, lɛ leɔ enɛ, ni etswaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ adafi akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛmiiho; ejaakɛ Siriabii lɛ miiya jɛi."
Kɛkɛ lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ etsu kɛtee he ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ etswa lɛ he adafi lɛ. Enɛ tee nɔ shii abɔ.
Enɛ ye Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui naakpa; no hewɔ lɛ etsɛ etsuji lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Aso nyɛtsɔ̃ŋ mi wɔteŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lo?"

Ni etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Jeee wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ; shi moŋ, Elisha, gbalɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ, lɛji mɔ ni gbaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔi ni owieɔ yɛ osɛɛtsu lɛ mli tete lɛ."
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, "Nyɛyaa nyɛyataoa he ni eyɔɔ, ni matsu ni ayamɔ lɛ kɛba." Kɛkɛ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, eyɛ Dotan."
No hewɔ lɛ etsu ta kple kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛtee jɛi. Amɛshɛ jɛi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ.

Leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ te shi, ni eje kpo, ni ena Siria tabilɔi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii ni amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ. Tsulɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ etee Elisha ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ao minuŋtsɔ, te wɔbaafee tɛŋŋ?"
Elisha here nɔ akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɛi ni kɛ wɔ yɔɔ lɛ fa fe mɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Elisha sɔle akɛ, "Ao Yehowa, miikpa o fai, gblemɔ ehiŋmɛii ni ena nii!" No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa gble oblanyo lɛ hiŋmɛii ni ena nii; ni naa, gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ la shwiilii kɛbɔle Elisha he kɛkpe.
Be ni Siriabii lɛ kpleke shi kɛba Elisha mɔmɔ lɛ, Elisha kpa Yehowa fai akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, hã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashwhila!" Ni amɛshwila yɛ Elisha sɔlemɔ lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Jeee gbɛ lɛ nɛ, ni jeee maŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ hu nɛ. Nyɛnyiɛa misɛɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛ baaya nuu lɛ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ." Ni akɛ amɛ tee Samaria tɔ̃ɔ.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛshɛ Samaria lɛ Elisha sɔle akɛ, "Ao Yehowa, gblemɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahiŋmɛii koni amɛna nii." No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa gble amɛhiŋmɛi, ni amɛna nii; ni naa, amɛna akɛ amɛyɛ Samaria.
Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ na amɛ lɛ ebi Elisha akɛ, "Mitsɛ, ani mitswia amɛ nii? Ani migbe amɛ lo?"

Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Dabida, kaatswia amɛ nii ni ogbe amɛ. Ani mɛi po ni okɛ oklaŋte kɛ ogãi yaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, ogbeɔ amɛ? Ŋmɛɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ koni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nii koni ohã amɛya amɛnuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ."

Ni hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ kple ko, ni be ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ Siriabii lɛ baaa Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbayeee ofɔ̃ dɔŋŋ!
Be kplaŋŋ ko sɛɛ lɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bua eta lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni amɛfã kɛtee amɛyaa Samaria maŋ lɛ yi.

No hewɔ lɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa ba Samaria, aahuu po ní ahɔ̃ɔ teji yitso ahe jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni ahɔ̃ɔ okpo wamɔ okpolu mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome ahe jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ. Afɔɔ ŋaŋ sabolai tsɛmɔ ŋaŋ "okpo fee."
Agbɛnɛ eba lɛ akɛ be ni Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ sheraa shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, yoo ko blɔ kɛtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ofai nɛ, ye obua mi."
Maŋtsɛ lɛ here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Dabi, hã ni Yehowa aye abua o, te mafee teŋŋ maye mabua o hu? Ani mijɛ miŋmãagbeemɔhe loo mijɛ miwainbu mli?"
Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi yoo akɛ, "Mɛni gbaa onaa?" Yoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, "Nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Kɛ obi nuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ ŋmɛnɛ, koni wɔ lɛ, wɔye mi hu mibi lɛ.'
Kɛkɛ ni wɔhoo mibi lɛ, ni wɔye. Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛ obinuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ'; shi lɛ lɛ eŋɔ ebi lɛ etee."
Be ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ nu yoo lɛ wiemɔi lɛ, egbla etadei lɛ yɛ ehe; ni maŋbii ni bɛŋkɛ gbogbo lɛ he lɛ na akɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ wo kpekpe atade yɛ etadei ni ewo lɛ ashishi.
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi, ni esaa egbe mi ekoŋŋ, kɛji Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ, yitso tsa eyitso nɔ ŋmɛnɛ!"

Ni etsu tsulɔ koni eyamɔ Elisha. Shi no mli lɛ Elisha ta shi yɛ eshīa mli, ni onukpai komɛi ni ba lɛ sramɔ lɛ tra emasɛi. Shi dani tsulɔ lɛ shɛɔ Elisha ŋɔɔ lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛle akɛ nakai nuu mɔgbelɔ lɛ ewo mɔ gbɛ ni abafo miyitso lo? Naa, kɛji tsulɔ lɛ ba lɛ, nyɛŋaa shinaa lɛ nyɛwoa eyi kpɛŋŋ ni ekaba mli. Enuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛmiiba."
Be ni Elisha kɛ enukpai lɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ bashɛ eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛ. Mɛni mimɛɔ dɔŋŋ? Mɛni feemɔ shwɛɔ mi dɔŋŋ?"
7: Kɛkɛ ni Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Wɔ be nɛ mli lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria."

Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpasaa enine lɛ here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, "Naa, kɛji Yehowa aaagble samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po, ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo?" Ni Elisha kɛɛ, "Na ooona kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ."
Hii kpitiyelɔi ejwɛ komɛi yɛ Samaria maŋ agbo lɛ naa. Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ: "Mɛni hewɔ ni wɔɔtra biɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔɔgboi?"

Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔbotea maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, hɔmɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni wɔɔgboi yɛ jɛi. Ni kɛji wɔtra biɛ hu gboimɔ nɔŋŋ wɔbaagboi. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛbaa; nyɛhãa wɔyagbea Siriabii lɛ ata lɛ mli moŋ; kɛji amɛhere wɔyi wala lɛ, wɔyi aaana wala; ni kɛji amɛgbe wɔ lɛ belɛ wɔɔgboi kɛkɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi, be ni hiɛ bɔ̃i tuutuu feemɔ lɛ, kpitiyelɔi lɛ te shi amɛtee Siriabii lɛ ata lɛ mli; shi be ni amɛshɛɔ jɛi lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ jɛi.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã Siriabii lɛ nu shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi anane shi gbɛɛmɔi kɛ ta babaoo he; ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ eyabɔ Hitbii kɛ Egiptbii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ apaa koni amɛkɛ wɔ abawu."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi be ni hiɛ feɔ tuutuu lɛ, amɛjo foi amɛshi amɛshitoohe lɛ mli: Amɛshi amɛbuui kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ amɛtejii fɛɛ yɛ mli. Amɛjo foi koni amɛhere amɛyiwala.

Agbɛnɛ be ni nɛkɛ kpitiyelɔi nɛɛ shɛ shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, amɛbote buu kome ko mli, ni amɛyeyee nii, ni amɛnunuu dãi; ni aɛloo jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ mamai, ni amɛkɛyatee. Amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛbabote buu kroko hu mli, ni amɛloo jɛi nii lɛ hu, ni amɛkɛyato.

Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nɔ ni wɔfeɔ nɛɛ ejaaa. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, omanye gbi ni. Shi moŋ kɛji wɔfee diŋŋ ni wɔmɛ kɛyashi jetsɛre leebi lɛ, wɔɔye sɔ̃. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔyaa ni wɔyabɔa amaniɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni amɛshi Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ kɛtee Samaria. Kɛkɛ ni kpitiyelɔi lɛ bo amɛtsɛ maŋ lɛ agbonaabulɔi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Wɔtee Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli; ni naa, anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko lɛ, anuuu mɔ ko mɔ ko he hu akɛ ja okpɔŋɔi ni afimɔ amɛ ŋmɔ̃lɔ̃ shi; ni tejii lɛ hu ŋmɔ̃lɔ̃ shi; ni buui lɛ hu mamɔ shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Siriabii lɛ shi amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni agbonaabulɔi lɛ tswa adafi, kɛkɛ ni sane lɛ yashɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ yiŋtoo ni Siriabii nɛɛ kɛfee enɛ nɛɛ. Amɛle akɛ hɔmɔ miiye wɔ; no hewɔ lɛ amɛje shitoohe lɛ mli amɛtee amɛyateetee amɛhe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔbaaje maŋ lɛ mli wɔyatao niyenii, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaamɔmɔ wɔ hiɛkãalɔi koni amɛbote wɔmaŋ lɛ mli ni amɛŋɔ maŋ lɛ hu."

Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, amɛtamɔ mɛi ni egboi momo lɛ nɔŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔtsua hii komɛi; amɛŋɔ okpɔŋɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ enumɔ kɛya jɛi koni amɛyakwɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu amɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔ shwiilii kɛtee Siria ta lɛ mli. Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa nyɛyakwɛa."

Ni amɛtiu amɛ kɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa tɔ̃ɔ; ni naa, gbɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ eyi tɔ kɛ atadei kɛ nibiinibii ni Siria tabilɔi lɛ eshɛrɛ eshwie yɛ amɛyaiyeli lɛ mli. Bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba, ni amɛbabɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samariabii lɛ je kpo kɛtee, ni amɛyaha Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ. Ni yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, akɛ talenta kome he ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria.

Agbɛnɛ eba mli akɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ asafoiatsɛ, mɔ ni ekpasaa enine lɛ, eto maŋ wulu lɛ agbo lɛ naa akɛ agbonaakwɛlɔ nukpa. Maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, taakɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, kɛɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpleke shi kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔ benɛ beiaŋ lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu koloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa, yɛ Samaria, yɛ nakai agbo lɛ naa lɛ,"

nakai asafoiatsɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Kɛji Yehowa aaagble samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po, ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo' lɛ. Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ ooona kɛ ohiŋmɛii, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ lɛ."
Nakai nɔŋŋ eba enɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni egbo.
8: Agbɛnɛ, Elisha ekɛɛ yoo lɛ ni etsiɛ̃ ebi lɛ hiɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi, bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ, ni oya, koni oyato gbɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni ooona; ejaakɛ Yehowa baahã hɔmɔ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii kpawo."
No hewɔ lɛ yoo lɛ te shi, ni efee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ wie lɛ. Ekɛ ewe lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii kpawo.

Afii kpawo lɛ naagbee mli lɛ, yoo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Be ni eyashɛ jɛi lɛ, etee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyafo ewo enijiaŋ koni akpale eshīa lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ ahã lɛ.
Yoo lɛ yanina maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Gehazi, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, miiwie akɛ, "Gbaa mi nibii wuji fɛɛ ni Elisha efee lɛ."

Gehazi miigba maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔ ni Elisha tsɔ̃ etsīa gbonyo hiɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛkɛ lɛ naa yoo lɛ ni etsīa ebi hiɛ lɛ. Ebafo ewo maŋtsɛ lɛ nijiaŋ yɛ eshīa lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, yoo lɛ nɛ, ni ebi lɛ ni Elisha tsīa ehiɛ lɛ hu nɛ."

Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi yoo lɛ, ni yoo lɛ gba lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã piafonyo ko ehã lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Dãimɔ nibii fɛɛ ni ji yoo nɛɛ nii lɛ ohã lɛ, kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii fɛɛ ni ahɔ̃ɔ kɛjɛ afii kpawo nɛɛ ni eshi eshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ."
Ni Elisha tee Damasko be mli ni Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad lɛ he miiye. Be ni ayagba maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ eba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ,"
maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hazael, epiafoi lɛ eko akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ nikeenii ko ohiɛ odɛŋ ni okɛyahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, koni otsɔ̃ enɔ ni obi Yehowa nii akɛ, 'Aleee nɔ, hela ni miyeɔ nɛɛ lɛ mihe aaawa mi lo?'"

No hewɔ lɛ Hazael tee Elisha ŋɔɔ. Eŋɔ nikeenii ni ji Damasko nibii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ eko ehiɛ edɛ̃, yoomai nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yiteremɔ. Be ni Hazael kɛ Elisha kpe lɛ, Hazael kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Otsulɔ Ben-Hadad tsu mi oŋɔɔ koni mibabi bo akɛ ehe ni yeɔ nɛɛ lɛ eeena hewalɛ kɛ lo?"
Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ohe baawa bo!' Tsɛbelɛ, Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bɔ fɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaagbo."
