Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tsu ehiŋmɛi eshwie Hazael nɔ gãa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Hazael he bɔ̃i lɛ jaramɔ. Kɛkɛ ni trukaa nɔŋŋ ni Elisha bɔ̃i yaafo.

Hazael bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ minuŋtsɔ foɔ nɛɛ?" Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Ejaakɛ mile nɔ efɔŋ ni bo obaafee Israelbii: amɛmɔji ni he wa lɛ obaamamɔ naa la, ni amɛblahii lɛ okɛ klaŋte baagbe amɛ, ni amɛbii fufɔbii lɛ obaaŋɔ amɛ otswia shi, ni amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ obaagblagblaa amɛmli."
Kɛkɛ ni Hazael kɛɛ akɛ, "Mi, otsulɔ ni tamɔ gbee nɛɛ, namɔ ji lɛ ni eeetsu nɔ ko wulu ni tamɔ nɛkɛ?" Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bo obaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Siria."
Ni Hazael ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Elisha ŋɔɔ kɛtee enuŋtsɔ Ben-Hadad ŋɔɔ; ni Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni Elisha kɛɛ o?" Tsulɔ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, "Ekɛɛ mi akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ohe baawa o!"
Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Hazael kɔ saanɔbo, ni ekɛtsɔ nu mli, ni eŋɔhã maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui su aahuu kɛyashi egbo. Kɛkɛ ni Hazael baye Ben-Hadad sɛɛ akɛ Siria maŋtsɛ.
Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoshafat bi Yehoram babɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ be ni awo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii kpaanyɔ yɛ Yerusalem.
Eba ejeŋ gbonyogbonyo tamɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi lɛ; eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ, ejaakɛ Ahab biyoo ji eŋa, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa sumɔɔɔɔ akɛ ekpãtãa Yuda hiɛ yɛ etsulɔ David hewɔ; ejaakɛ ewo lɛ shi akɛ eeehã lɛ kɛ eshwiei atsɔ̃ kane ni baakudɔ Yuda kɛaatee naanɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Yehoram yinɔ lɛ, Edom tse Yuda hiɛ atūa, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwo maŋtsɛ amɛhã amɛhe.

Kɛkɛ ni Yehoram kɛ eta shwiilii lɛ fɛɛ foŋ kɛtee Zair. Edombii lɛ gba kɛbɔle amɛ kɛkpe yɛ jɛi. Shi Yehoram kɛ eshwiilii nɔtalɔi lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba kɛtsɔ Edombii ata lɛ ata lɛ mli, ni amɛjo foi, ni etabilɔi lɛ gbɛ shwã, ni amɛtee amɛshīaiaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ Edombii lɛ tse Yuda hiɛ atūa kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Libna maŋ wulu lɛ hu tse atūa.
Yehu ba Yezreel. Be ni Yezebel nu he lɛ, ediki ehiŋmɛii asɛɛ, ni ehɔ eyi fɛfɛo, ni eyabu samflɛ naa, ni eekwɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ, Yezebel bi akɛ, "Zimri ni ogbe onuŋtsɔ, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?"
Yehu wo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ samflɛ lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ, "Namɔ yɔɔ migbɛfaŋ?" Namɔ? Ni piafoi enyɔ loo piafoi etɛ̃ ko gbo amɛyi naa shi amɛkwɛ lɛ.

Ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛshɛa nyɛfɔ̃a shikpɔŋ!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo lɛ amɛtswa shi; ni elá lɛ eko tsɛŋe shwie gbogbo lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe. Yehu kɛ eshwiilii ni eta mli lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yezebel gbonyo lɛ nɔ kɛho.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni eyaye nii, ni enu nɔ ko eshwie nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyakwɛa ni nyɛfua nɛkɛ yoo musumɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ biyoo ni."
Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee lɛ fuu; shi amɛnaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja eyitsoŋoŋo kɛ enaji kɛ enine kɔkɔi pɛ.
Be ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbabɔ Yehu amɛniɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa wiemɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, nɔ ewie lɛ nɛ: 'Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ,
ni Yezebel gbonyo baatsɔ̃ tamɔ tumu nɔ wamɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko yooo lɛ ni eeekɛɛ akɛ Yezebel nɛ.'"
9: Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Elisha tsɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mĩamɔ, wo nɛkɛ mu kɛ tɔ nɛɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃ oya Ramot-Gilead.
Ni kɛji oshɛ jɛi lɛ taomɔ Yehu, Yehoshafat bi lɛ, ni ji Nimshi nabi lɛ. Ohã ete shi yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, koni okɛ lɛ abote sɛɛtsu mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ wo mu kɛ tɔ lɛ koni ofɔse oshwie eyiteŋ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, miiwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ!’ Kɛkɛ lɛ gbelemɔ shinaa lɛ ni ojo foi; kaashashao shi.”
Kɛkɛ ni oblanyo lɛ ni ji gbalɔ lɛ, yiŋ etee Ramot-Gilead.

Be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, naa ta lɛ mli asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ tara shi amɛkpe; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Asafoiatsɛ, mihiɛ sane ko mihã bo!” Ni Yehu bi akɛ, “Wɔteŋ namɔ okɛwieɔ lɛ?” Ni ehã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bo, asafoiatsɛ Yehu tuuŋtu ni!”

No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu te shi ni amɛbote shĩa lɛ mli, ni oblanyo lɛ fɔse mu lɛ eshwie Yehu yiteŋ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifɔ bo mu kɛwo bo Yehowa maŋbii ni ji Israel maŋtsɛ.
Ni obaabutu onuŋtsɔ Ahab we lɛ, koni mikɛtɔ Yezebel kɛ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ alá, kɛ Yehowa tsuji lɛ fɛɛ alá he owele.
Ejaakɛ Ahab we lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã; ni maplene nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ Ahab we lɛ, nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ, yɛ Israel.
Ni mafee Ahab we lɛ tamɔ mifee Israel maŋtsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, we lɛ, kɛ Baasha, Ahia bi lɛ we lɛ.
Ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko efuŋ lɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ gbele shinaa lɛ, ni ejo foi.

Be ni Yehu ku esɛɛ kɛba enuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi, lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani hejɔlɛ sane ni lo? Mɛni hewɔ ni mɔnɛ sɛkɛyelɔ nɛɛ ba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ewiemɔ yɔɔ.”
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ “Oolaka wɔ, gbaa wɔ nɔ ni ekɛɛ moŋ.” Ni Yehu kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni ekɛɛ mi nɛ; ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Mifɔ bo mu, miwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ.’ ”
Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe fee oya, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ jie etade, ni eŋɔ ha shi yɛ atrakpoi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛkpãkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi amɛkɛɛ, “Yehu eye maŋtsɛ!”
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu, Yehoshafat bi ni ji Nimshi nabi lɛ, kpãŋ Yoram yinɔ. Nakai be mli lɛ Yoram kɛ Israel fɛɛ miibu Ramot-Gilead he, yɛ Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ.

Maŋtsɛ Yoram eku esɛɛ kɛtee Yezreel koni eyatsa pilamɔi ni Siriabii lɛ pila lɛ lɛ, be ni ekɛ Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ yawu lɛ. Ni Yehu kɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛ kɛ mi kɛɛmɔ ni lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko joa foi kɛmiijɛa maŋ lɛ mli ni eyagba yɛ Yezreel.”
Ni Yehu ho ta shwiili mli ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yezreel ejaakɛ Yoram kã shi kɛ hela yɛ jɛi. Ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia eba eŋɔɔ ebaasara lɛ.

Bulɔ ko damɔ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yezreel; ena Yehu kɛ esafo ku lɛ ni amɛmiiba, ni ekɛɛ, “Miina asafo ku ko.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ akɛ, “Tsɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko ni otsu lɛ koni ekɛ amɛ ayakpe, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ”

Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko tee ni ekɛ Yehu yakpe, ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.” Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni etsu okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ni ji enyɔ kɛtee. Be ni eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Ni Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.”
Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ. Ni bulɔ lɛ kɛfata he akɛ, “Shwiili lɛ foiwoo tamɔ Yehu Nimshi nabi lɛ shwiili foiwoo, ejaakɛ ewoɔ shwiili foi tamɔ sɛkɛyelɔ”.

Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ, “Nyɛfea mishwiili lɛ kralo.” Ni amɛfee eshwiili lɛ kralo. Ni Yoram, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ Ahazia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, je kpo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ta eshwiili mli; ni amɛ kɛ Yehu yakpe. Amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yoram na Yehu lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ “Yehu, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?” Yehu here nɔ akɛ, “Te baafee tɛŋŋ ni hejɔlɛ aba hu, bei abɔ ni ŋkunyaayeli kɛ wɔŋjamɔ ni onyɛ Yezebel bato shishi lɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ?”
Kɛkɛ ni Yoram tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ejo foi; ni be ni ejoɔ foi lɛ, ekɛɛ Ahazia akɛ, “Ahazia, atsɔ̃ wɔ akpa!”
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɔ egãi lɛ ni eŋɔ tsɛ̃ Yoram kɔ̃ji ateŋ, ni gãi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yoram tsui mli kɛje kpo, ni egbee eshwiili lɛ mli.

Yehu kɛɛ esafoiatsɛ Bidikar akɛ, “Wo lɛ oshɛ ofɔ̃ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kaimɔ akɛ mi kɛ bo fɛɛ ni tara shwiili mli kɛnyiɛ etsɛ Ahab sɛɛ be ni Yehowa ŋɔ nɛkɛ toigbalamɔ nɛɛ efɔ̃ enɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

‘Nabot lá ni afɔse ashwie shi kɛ ebii lɛ hu alá ni afɔse ashwie shi, ni mina nyɛ, lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikã mihe kitã akɛ mawo he nyɔmɔ yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.’ Yehowa kɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wo lɛ oshɛ ofɔ̃ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.”

Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia na nɔ ni eba lɛ, ejo foi kɛtsɔ̃ Bet-Hagan gbɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehu tiu lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Lɛ hu nyɛtsɛ̃a lɛ gãi.” Ni atsɛ̃ lɛ gãi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli yɛ Gur ŋmeŋme lɛ ni yɔɔ Ibleam masɛi lɛ he. Kɛkɛ ni ejo foi kɛtee Megido, ni eyagbo yɛ jɛi, ni
etsuji lɛ wo egbonyo lɛ amɛwo shwiili lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbafu lɛ yɛ efuuhe lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.
Ahazia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Yehu ba Yezreel. Be ni Yezebel nu he lɛ, ediki ehiŋmɛii asɛɛ, ni ehɔ eyi fɛɛfɛo, ni eyabu samflɛ naa, ni eekwɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ, Yezebel bi akɛ, “Zimri ni ogbe onuŋtsɔ, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?”
Yehu wo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ samflɛ lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ migbɛfaŋ?” Namɔ? Ni piafoi enyɔ loo piafoi etɛ̃ ko gbo amɛyi naa shi amɛkwɛ lɛ.

Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛshɛa nyɛfɔ̃a shikpɔŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo lɛ amɛtswa shi; ni elá lɛ eko tsɛŋe shwie gbogbo lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe. Yehu kɛ eshwiili ni eta mli lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yezebel gbonyo lɛ nɔ kɛho.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni eyaye nii, ni enu nɔ ko eshwie nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakwɛa ni nyɛfua nɛkɛ yoo musumɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ biyoo ni.”
Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee lɛ fuu; shi amɛnaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja eyitsoŋoŋo kɛ enaji kɛ enine kɔkɔi pɛ.
Be ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbabɔ Yehu amaniɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa wiemɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, nɔ ewie lɛ nɛ: ‘Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ,
ni Yezebel gbonyo baatsɔ̃ tamɔ tumo nɔ wamɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko yooo lɛ ni eeekɛɛ akɛ Yezebel nɛ.’ ”
10: Ahab yɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ Samaria. No hewɔ lɛ Yehu ŋmla woji, ni etsu akɛtee Samaria akɛyahã maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ Ahab bii lɛ atsɔselɔi lɛ akɛ,
"Amrɔ pɛ ni nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ aaashɛ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, akɛni nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛŋɔɔ, ni shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu nii kɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he hu yɔɔ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ,
nyɛkwɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni hi kɛ mɔ ni sa fe fɛɛ koni nyɛŋɔ lɛ nyɛta etsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛwu kɛhere nyɛnuŋtsɔ we lɛ."
Shi Samaria lumɛi she gbeyei naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Naa, Maŋtsɛ Yoram kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahazia nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ adamɔ, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ ehiɛ wɔdamɔ hu?"

No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋ lɛ kɛ bii lɛ atsɔselɔi lɛ hu tsu Yehu ŋɔɔ akɛ, "Otsuji ji wɔ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni oookɛɛ wɔ lɛ wɔɔfee. Wɔwooo mɔ ko mɔ ko maŋtsɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, feemɔ kɛkɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehu ŋmã wolo ni ji enyɔ eyahã amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛyɛ migbɛfaŋ, ni myɛfee kralo akɛ nyɛaabo migbee toi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛŋɔa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ayitsei ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ Yezreel wɔ̃ aaafee nɛkɛ be mli pɛpɛɛpɛ." Maŋtsɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ ni tsɔseɔ amɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ amɛyɔɔ.
Be ni wolo lɛ bashɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ, amɛmɔmɔ maŋtsɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛyitsei lɛ amɛwo kɛŋtɛŋi amli, ni amɛtsu akɛyahã Yehu yɛ Yezreel.
Be ni bɔfo bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Akɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ ayitsei lɛ eba lɛ," Yehu fã akɛ, "Nyɛtoa yitsei lɛ kui enyɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi leebi."
Ni leebi lɛ, Yehu je kpo ebadamɔ shi yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ, "Naa, sɔ̃ ko tereee nyɛ. Miji mɔ ni tee minuŋtsɔ yinɔ apam, ni migbe lɛ. Shi namɔ gbegbee mɛnɛɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ hu?
Agbɛnɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni ewie yɛ Ahab we lɛ he lɛ, emli ekome flo efeŋ yaka, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee nɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yehu gbe mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Ahab we lɛ mli yɛ Yezreel lɛ: egbɔmɛi wuji lɛ kɛ eshiɛŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ emɔ ko mɔ ko.
Yehu shi Yezreel, ni eyiŋ kɛmiiya Samaria. Ni be ni eshɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Tookwɛlɔi Atoohetsɔikuuhe lɛ,
Yehu na Maŋtsɛ Ahazia wekumɛi lɛ ekomɛi yɛ jɛi, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Namɛi ji nyɛ?" Amɛto he akɛ, "Ahazia wekumɛi ji wɔ, ni wɔmiiya wɔyasra maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ odehei krokomɛi lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmɔmɔa amɛ hiɛkãlɔi!" Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ hiɛkãlɔi, ni amɛgbe amɛ yɛ Toohetsɔikuuhe bu lɛ he, hii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ, ni eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko.

Ni be ni eje jɛi eŋɔshwie nɔ lɛ, ena Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, ni eeba ni ekɛ lɛ abakpe. Yehu ŋa lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani otsui mli tse hã mi tamɔ bɔ ni mitsui mli tse hã bo lɛ?" Ni Yehonadab hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Hɛɛ, nakai ni." Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ taa midɛ̃." Kɛkɛ ni eta edɛ̃; kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã ekwɔ shwiilii lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ.
Yehu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã ni wɔtee koni oyakwɛ bɔ ni miyeɔ Yehowa he awuŋa mihãa." Kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã eta eshwiili lɛ mli.
Be ni Yehu shɛ Samaria lɛ, Yehu gbe Ahab weku fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ yɛ Samaria; ni eshiii mɔ kome nɛkɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bua Samaria maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ahab sɔ̃mɔ Baal fioo ko kɛkɛ, shi Yehu baasɔ̃mɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛyakpea Baal gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbahãa mi, akashwɛ mɔ ko; ejaakɛ miyɛ afɔle wulu ko ni mibashã mahã Baal. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaa lɛ eyi naŋ wala." Shi ŋaa Yehu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni afee ni ekpãtã Baal Sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ahiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtoa gbijurɔ wulu ko ni akɛja Baal." No hewɔ lɛ ato gbi lɛ.
Ni Yehu kɛ wiemɔ tsu akɛtee Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Ni Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ba; ni eshwɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni baaa. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛba Baal we lɛ, ni Baal we lɛ yi obɔ̃ tɔ.
Ni Yehu fã mɔ ni kwɛɔ jamɔ atadei lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, "Yaajie atadei ohã Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ!" Ni eyajie atadei lɛ ebahã amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛ Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, bote Baal we lɛ mli; ni ekɛɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia ni Yehowa jalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabafutu nyɛ yɛ biɛ, akɛ ja nyɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ kɛkɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛ Yehonadab teee koni amɛyashã afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei amɛhã Baal. Shi Yehu eŋɔ hii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ eto kpo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Kɛji nyɛhã hii ni mikɛbawo nyɛteŋ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome jo foi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni hã ejo foi lɛ kɛ ewala baatse."

Ni eba mli akɛ be ni eshã shãa afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, Yehu kɛɛ bulɔi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbea amɛ, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko miije kpo!" Ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni bulɔi lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ hole amɛ ni amɛshɛrɛ amɛ amɛshwie kpo lɛ nɔ, kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee Baal we lɛ pia mli,
ni amɛyahole Baal we lɛ amãgãi lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyashã.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkumɔ Baal amãgã lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛsaa amɛkumɔ Baal we lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu amɛshwie shi, ni amɛkɛ Baal we lɛ fee kuŋtso kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Nɛkɛ Yehu fee, ni ekpãtã Baal hiɛ yɛ Israel.
Shi Yehu efɔ̃ɔɔ tsinabi amãgã ni Yeroboam, Nebal bi lɛ, kɛma Betel kɛ Dan, ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ jamɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yehu akɛ, "Ofee jogbaŋŋ kɛ feemɔ ni ofee nii ni sa mihiɛ, ni ofee Ahab we lɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ mitsui mli fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, oshwie aaata Israel sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛyashi yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ."
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehu ediii sɛɛ ni eye Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mla lɛ nɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ. Efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam fee ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ feemɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli Yehowa hã Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ dalɛ nɔ bɔ̃i gbɔmɔ. Hazael ni jɛ Siria lɛ ye Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ;
kɛjɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he bokãgbɛ aahuu kɛtee wuoyigbɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Aroer ni yɔɔ Arnon Faa lɛ he lɛ he. No ji Gilead kɛ Bashan shikpɔji lɛ, he ni Gadbii kɛ Rbenbii kɛ Boka Manasebii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Shi Yehu saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ ekãa fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yehu gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria, ni ebi Yehoahaz baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Ni afii abɔ ni Yehu ye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria lɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
11: Agbɛnɛ be ni Ahazia nyɛ Atalia na akɛ ebi lɛ egbo lɛ, ete shi, ni ekpãtã maŋtsɛ shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.

Shi Ahazia bi Yoash pɛ ji mɔ ni he je mli. Kulɛ abaagbe lɛ hu kɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, shi moŋ enyɛkwɛ̃ ni ji Yehosheba, ni ji maŋtsɛ Yehoram biyoo kɛ Ahazia nyɛmiyoo lɛ, here eyiwala. Yehosheba ju shi, ni emɔ Yoash kɛ efufɔhãlɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ yatee sɛɛtsu ko mli yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ koni Atalia akana lɛ ni egbe lɛ.
Ni Yehosheba ŋɔ lɛ eyatee yɛ Yehowa we lɛ afii ekpaa, be mli ni Atalia yeɔ maŋnyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

Shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Yehoiada tsu atee ni ayaŋɔ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ hebulɔi lɛ abahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ. Ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ, ni ehã amɛkã kɛ kitã yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛ bi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni efã amɛ akɛ bɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ, "Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni baabɔ̃i amɛnitsumɔ, yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome afee maŋtsɛwe lɛ he bulɔi,
ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ahi Sur Agbo lɛ naa; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu ahi agbo ni yɔɔ bulɔi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ naa, koni nyɛbu maŋtsɛwe lɛ he, ni nyɛfã he.
Shi nyɛteŋ asafokui enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eyaŋ nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛji mɛi ni amɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Ni nyɛbɔlea maŋtsɛ Yoash he kɛkpe, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahiɛ etawuu nii yɛ edɛ̃ŋ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabɛŋkɛ tabilɔi aku lɛ agbe lɛ. Ni kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ miije kpo jio, eeba shīa jio, nyɛhīa ehe."

Ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fee bɔ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada fã amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋɔ ewebii ni baaa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni kpaa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛba Osɔfo Yehoiada ŋɔɔ.
Ni osɔfo lɛ, eklɔ akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi ni ji maŋtsɛ David nii ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ ehã mɛi ohahai anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ.

Ni bulɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ etawuu nii yɛ edɛ̃ŋ, ni amɛdamɔ shi kɛjɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ wuoyigbɛ aahuu kɛtee maŋtsɛwe lɛ kooyigbɛ kɛbɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ he kɛkpe, koni amɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he.

Kɛkɛ ni Yehoiada jie maŋtsɛ bi, Yoash, lɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ akekre lɛ fi lɛ, ni eŋɔ kpãŋmɔ wolo ni maŋtsɛyeli he mlai yɔɔ mli lɛ ewo edɛŋ; ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ, ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu; ni maŋbii lɛ tswatswaa amɛdɛ̃, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala!"
Be ni Maŋnyɛ Atalia nu bulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ he lɛ, eba maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.

Be ni eyaakwɛ lɛ, naa maŋtsɛ hee lɛ damɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ agbo lɛ naa akulashiŋ lɛ he, bɔ ni ji gbɛnaa lɛ; ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ kpãlɔi yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ masɛi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ miinya, ni amɛniikpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi. Kɛkɛ ni Atalia gbla ehe atadei, ni eblɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Maŋjwaa sane nɛ, maŋjwaa sane nɛ!"

kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada fã asraafoi ohahai anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ Atalia ajea asraafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛyaa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanyiɛ esɛɛ ni aaaba lɛ shɔ̃mɔ lɛ nyɛgbea lɛ." Ejaakɛ osɔfo lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Akagbe lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ mli kɛmiiya maŋtsɛwe lɛ; shi jɛi amɛgbe lɛ yɛ.
Ni osɔfo Yehoiada hã Maŋtsɛ Yoash kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ Yehowa kpãŋ akɛ amɛbaaba amɛjeŋ akɛ Yehowa maŋ. Ni ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ hu kpãŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ ni amɛyabote Baal we lɛ, ni amɛkumɔ Baal we lɛ amɛshwie shi. Baal afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ emãgãi lɛ amɛkumɔ amɛ dukuduku; ni Mattan, ni ji Baal osɔfo lɛ, amɛgbe lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ. Kɛkɛ ni osɔfo Yehoiada to gbɛjianɔ ni bulɔi abu Yehowa we lɛ he.

Kɛkɛ ni lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ he bulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛkpleke shi kɛjɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛtsɔ Bulɔi Agbo lɛ naa gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛba maŋtsɛwe lɛ, ni amɛhã eyata maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.
Akɛni agbe Atalia kɛ klaŋte yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli jɔ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ.
Yoash baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda be ni eye afii kpawo.
12: Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehu maŋtsɛyeli yinɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni Yoash bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Zibia ni jɛ Beersheba lɛ.
Yoash fee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni ehi shi lɛ, ejaakɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeŋbii ajamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ akumɔɔɔ ashwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔlei kɛ tsofiakɛŋmai yɛ jɛi lolo.
Yoash kɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, "Shika fɛɛ ni ajɔɔ nɔ ake ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ too ni sa akɛ ewo lɛ, kɛ shika fɛɛ shika ni mɔ ko jɛɔ etsui mli ekɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ,
osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahe, yɛ mɔ ni lɛ ele lɛ dɛŋ, koni amɛkɛsaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ kɛ he fɛɛ he ni sa akɛ asaa lɛ."
Shi eba mli akɛ kɛbashi Yoash maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ esako Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ ekoeko kwraa lolo.

No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Yoash tsɛ osɔfo Yehoiada kɛ osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛsaaa Yehowa we lɛ tsu koi lɛ? No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, nyɛkɛ shika ni nyɛheɔ lɛ akatoa dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ nyɛŋɔa nyɛhãa koni akɛsaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ."
Osɔfoi lɛ kplɛ̃ nɔ akɛ amɛheŋ shika yɛ maŋbii lɛ adɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ni amɛsaŋ Yehowa we lɛ hu.

Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada wo adeka ko, ni egbu enaanɔ lɛ mli flɔ, ni ekɛ adeka lɛ ma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi. Kɛji oobote Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ, adeka lɛ ye oninejurɔgbɛ; ni osɔfoi ni kwɛɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ shika fɛɛ ni akɛɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ amɛwoɔ mli.

Ni ebaa mli akɛ be fɛɛ be kɛji amɛna akɛ shika lɛ efa yɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ baa, ni amɛbakaneɔ shika ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ni amɛbafimɔɔ shika lɛ amɛwoɔ kotokui amli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛtuɔ shika ni ana lɛ amɛwoɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ; ni amɛ hu amɛkewoɔ kapintafoi kɛ tsumalɔi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Yehowa we lɛ anyɔmɔ.
Ni akɛ eko woɔ bliglɛfoi kɛ tɛkolɔi nyɔŋmɔ, ni akɛ eko heɔ mplaŋi kɛ tɛ, ni akɛsaa Yehowa we lɛ tsukoi lɛ, ni akɛ eko woɔ nyɔmɔ ni abɔɔ yɛ shīa lɛ saamɔ he lɛ.
Shi shika ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ aŋɔɔɔ no eko akɛfeee Yehowa we lɛ jwiɛtɛi kãi, lagbee nii, lalakãi, tɛtrɛmantrɛi aloo shika nii loo jwiɛtɛi nii krokomɛi;
shi akɛhãa mɛi ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, koni akɛsaa Yehowa we lɛ.
Akɛni mɛi adɛŋ ni akɛ shika lɛ woɔ lɛ yeɔ anɔkwa hewɔ lɛ, ehe ehiaaa akɛ amɛbuɔ shika lɛ he akɔntaa ko.
Shi shika ni anaa kɛjɛɔ sɛ̃ afɔle kɛ esha afɔle lɛ mli lɛ, akɛ nomɛi baaa Yehowa we lɛ, nomɛi lɛ osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael fã ta kɛba, ni ekɛ Gat, maŋ wulu lɛ, bawu, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ. Shi be ni Hazael jie ehiɛ eka Yerusalem lɛ,

Yoash, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋ fɛɛ ni etsɛmɛi Yehoshafat kɛ Yehoram kɛ Ahazia, ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi ni eho lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ eke lɛ, kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ shika fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohe lɛ hu, ni etsu akɛyahã Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Hazael shi Yerusalem sɛɛ ni etee.
Agbɛnɛ Yoash he saji kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ Yoash tsuji lɛ te shi, ni amɛkpãŋ eyi nɔ, ni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Milo lɛ, yɛ gbɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛyaa Sila lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni tswia lɛ nii ni egbo lɛ ji Yozakar, Shimeat bi lɛ kɛ Yehozabad, Shomer bi lɛ. Ni amɛfu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amɛsɛi yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni Yoash bi Amazia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
13: Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash, Ahazia bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoahaz, Yehu bi lɛ bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo.
Efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; eshai ni Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, hã Israel fee lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ efee, ni efɔ̃ɔɔ feemɔ.
Ni Yehowa mli wo Israel la, ni no hewɔ lɛ daa nɛɛ Yehowa tuɔ amɛ ewoɔ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael kɛ ebi Ben-Hadad dɛŋ.
Shi Yehoahaz kpa Yehowa fai, ni Yehowa bo lɛ toi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, ena bɔni Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ haoɔ Israel ehãa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jie herelɔ ko ehã, koni ebakpɔ̃ amɛ kɛje Siriabii lɛ adɛŋ; no hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ hi amɛshīai lɛ amli tamɔ tsutsu lɛ yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam we lɛ fɛɛ ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ; shi amɛkã he amɛfee eshai lɛ lolo; ni Ashera amãgã lɛ hu ma Samaria lolo.

No hewɔ lɛ Yehoahaz lɛ, asraafoi pɛ ni shwɛ hã lɛ ji okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ tayaa shwiilii nyŋma kɛ nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma; ejaakɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ eplenee Israelbii lɛ, ni efee amɛ munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu.
Yehoahaz he saji kɛ nibii ni efee kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehoahaz gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ afuuhe lɛ yɛ Samaria; ni ebi Yehoash baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoash bɔ̃i Israel maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria. Eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa.
Lɛ hu efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ fee, ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ, shi ekã he efee eshai lɛ lolo.
Ni Yoash he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee, kɛ ekãa ni efee yɛ ta ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia lɛ wu lɛ mli lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni Yoash gbo ni ebi Yeroboam bata esɛ̃i nɔ. Afu Yoash yɛ Samaria yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi.
Agbɛnɛ, be ni hela ni baagbe gbalɔ Elisha lɛ mɔ lɛlɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoash tee eŋɔɔ eyasra lɛ. Eyafo yɛ ehiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mitsɛ, mitsɛ! Israel hefãlɔ kple!"
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Kɔ gãi kɛ mlibii kɛba!" Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɔ gãi kɛ emlibii kɛba eŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ta gãi lɛ!" Ni eta. Ni Elisha ŋɔ eniji eshwie maŋtsɛ lɛ niji anɔ.

Ni Elisha kɛɛ, "Gblemɔ bokãgbɛ samflɛ lɛ." Ni egble. Ni Elisha kɛɛ "Tsɛ̃!" Ni etsɛ̃ gãi lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa kunimyeli gãimlibii kɛ Siria nɔ kunimyeli gãimlibii nɛ, ejaakɛ obaatswia Siriabii lɛ nii yɛ Afek kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooplenee amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Klɔmɔ gãimlibii lɛ. Tsɛ̃rɛ̃mɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ gãi!" Ni etsɛ̃rɛ̃ shii etɛ̃, ni ekpa.

Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli fu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Eji otsɛ̃rɛ̃ shii enumɔ loo shii ekpaa kulɛ, no lɛ obaatswia Siriabii lɛ nii aahuu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ooopleenee amɛ; shi enɛ lɛ, shi etɛ̃ pɛ obaaye Siriabii anɔ kunim."
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha gbo, ni afu lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ Moab ojoyeli tai lɛ batua Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ nakai afi lɛ mli.

Ni eba mli akɛ, gbi ko be ni amɛyaafu nuu ko lɛ, naa, amɛna ojoyeli ta ko. No hewɔ lɛ amɛshɛ nuu lɛ gbonyo amɛfɔ̃ Elisha gbonyo bu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni amɛjo foi. Ni be ni nuu lɛ gbonyo lɛ he yasa Elisha wui lɛ ahe pɛ, kɛkɛ ni gbonyo lɛ hiɛ tsɛ̃, ni ete shi edamɔ enaji anɔ.
Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael hao Israelbii yɛ Yehoahaz maŋtɛyeli be mli fɛɛ.

Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni etse ehiɛ ehã amɛ, yɛ ekpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kɛ Yakob kɛ Isak ekpãŋ lɛ hewɔ, ni esumɔɔɔ akɛ ekpãtã amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ ehiɛ kpako emaŋ Israel lɛ nɔ kɛbashi benɛ.
Be ni Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael gbo lɛ, ebi Ben-Hadad baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, Yehoahaz bi lɛ, ye Ben-Hadad, Hazael bi lɛ, nɔ kunim shii etɛ̃, ni eshɔ̃ maji ni Hazael shɔ̃ yɛ etsɛ Yehoahaz dɛŋ yɛ ta mli lɛ.
14: Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yoash bi Amazia, bɔ̃i maŋysɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Be ni ebɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yehoadin, ni jɛ Yerusalem lɛ.
Efee Yehowa suɔmɔnaanii, kɛ̃lɛ etamɔɔɔ David, mɔ seshi mli ni ejɛ lɛ. Bɔ ni etsɛ Yoash fee lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ efee.
Ekumɔɔɔ wɔŋjamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ eshwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ miishã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai lɛ yɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ lolo.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Amazia maŋtsɛyeli he shi lɛ, emɔmɔ tsuji ni gbe etsɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni egbe amɛ.

Shi mɛi ni gbe etsɛ lɛ abii lɛ, egbeee amɛ; ejaakɛ edamɔ Yehowa Mla ni ewo yɛ Mose Wolo lɛ mli akɛ, "Akagbe fɔlɔi yɛ amɛbii atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ, ni asaŋ akagbe bii hu yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, efɔŋ ni eeefee lɛ, no he gbele lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo."
Amazia gb Edombii asraafoi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni eŋɔ Sela maŋ wulu lɛ yɛ ta mli, ni ewo lɛ Yokteel kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
No mli Amazia tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, Yehu bi Yehoahaz bi lɛ bi, ŋɔɔ ayatsɛ lɛ ŋa nɔ akɛ, "Ba ni wɔkpe nuu kɛ nuu."

Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash tsu ayakɛɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia akɛ, "Naa, gbi ko lɛ ŋmei tso ko ni yɔɔ Lebanon tsu ayakɛɛ tsenedru tso ni yɔɔ Lebanon akɛ, 'ŋɔɔ obiyoo lɛ ohã mibinuu lɛ gblã." Ni ŋaŋ kooloo ko ni yɔɔ Lebanon lɛ baho, ni ebanaanaa ŋmei tso lɛ nɔ.
Ogbe Edombii, hewɔ lɛ no ehã oowo ohe nɔ. Okɛ no ashwã; shi okɛ no awa owe lɛ. Mɛɛba oshwɛɔ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ he, koni bo okɛ Yuda fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã nɛɛ?"
Shi Amazia booo toi. No hewɔ lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash fã kɛtee, ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia yakpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ yɛ ta mli yɛ Bet-Shemesh ni yɔɔ Yuda nɔ mli lɛ.
Israel ta lɛ ye Yuda ta lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ jo foi kɛtee ewe.

Ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash mɔ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia, yɛ Bet-Shemesh, ni eŋɔ lɛ nom. Ni eba Yerusalem, ni ebakumɔ Yerusalem gbogboi lɛ, kɛjɛ Efraim Agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi Koŋ Agbo lɛ naa ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ohai ejwɛ.
Ni eloo shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ nitoohe lɛ kɛ nomii hu kɛku esɛɛ kɛtee Samaria.
Yehoash he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii ni efee lɛ, kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia wu ehã lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni Yehoash gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria yɛ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ. Ni ebi Yeroboam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash gbele sɛɛ lɛ,Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia hi shi eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Amazia he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Atee Amazia yinɔ apam koni agbe lɛ yɛ Yerusalem; no hewɔ lɛ ejo foi etee Lakish maŋ wulu lɛ mli; shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ tiu lɛ kɛtee Lakish, ni ayagbe lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni awo egbonyo lɛ afɔ̃ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni abafu lɛ yɛ Yerusalem yɛ etsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.
Ni Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ Azaria, ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ Amazia sɛɛ.
Azaria ye Elat nɔ kunim, ni ekpɔ̃ maŋ lɛ ehã Yuda, yɛ etsɛ Amazia gbele sɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia, Yoash bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yeroboam, Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash bi lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome.
Ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yereboam, Nebat bi lɛ fee, ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ.

Lɛ ehã Israel husui lɛ shɛ amɛdɛŋ ekoŋŋ, kɛjɛ Lebo-Hamat ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashi ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ ŋoo ŋshɔ lɛ naa, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ etsulɔ Yona, Amitai bi gbalɔ ni jɛ Gat-Hefer lɛ, nɔ ewie lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa na akɛ Israel amanehulu ni enaa lɛ naa wa naakpa, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni ji nyɔŋ aloo mɔ ni hiɛ ehe, ni aaaye abua Israel.
Shi akɛni Yehowa ekɛko akɛ eeegbe Israel gbɛi yɛ ŋwɛi shishi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ Yeroboam, Yoash bi lɛ nine nɔ ehere amɛyiwala.
Agbɛnɛ Yeroboam he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ ekãa ni efee kɛ bɔ ni ewuwuu tai kɛ bɔ ni eshɔ̃ Damasko kɛ Hamat lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yeroboam gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ, ni ebi Zakaria baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
15: Israel maŋtsɛ Yeroboam yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yuda maŋtsɛ Amazia bi Azaria, mɔ ni gbɛi kroko ji Uzia lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yekolia ni jɛ Yerusalem lɛ. Eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpa, be ni ebabɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yerusalem.
Ni Azaria fee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ Amazia fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ ekumɔɔɔ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ eshwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔlei kɛ tsofãkɛŋmai yɛ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ lolo.

Ni Yehowa kɛ hela fɔŋ piŋ maŋtsɛ Azaria, ni eye kpiti kɛyashi egbele gbi; aŋmɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ koni ehi maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli. Ni maŋtsɛ Azaria bi Yotam kwɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ sɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ, ni eye maŋ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ Azaria he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni Azaria gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ eblematsɛmɛi lɛ afuuhe lɛ yɛ Yerusalem, kɛkɛ ni ebi Yotam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ Zakaria baye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria nyɔji ekpaa.
Zakaria efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebal bi Yeroboam fee ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ.
Ni Yabesh bi Shalum tee Maŋtsɛ Zakaria yinɔ apam, ni etswa lɛ nɔ ni egbe lɛ yɛ maŋ hiɛ, kɛkɛ ni ebaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Zakaria he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, naa, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Belɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yehu wie akɛ, "Oshwiei lɛ aaata Israel sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ," na ba mli.
Yabesh bi Shalum baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel. Yuda maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ; ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔŋ kome yɛ Samaria.
Gadi bi Menahem yiŋ kɛjɛ Tirza kɛba Samaria, ni ebatswa Yabesh bi Shalum nɔ yɛ Samaria, ni egbe lɛ; kɛkɛ ni eye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Shalum he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ apam ni etee lɛ, naa, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.

Be ni Menahem jɛ Tirza eyaa lɛ, eyatswia Tapua kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli kɛ ekpokpaianɔbii fɛɛ nii; ejaakɛ amɛŋmɛɛɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ he amɛhãaa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ etswia amɛ nii, ni emli yeihɔlɔi lɛ egblagblaa amɛmli.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Gadi bi Menahem babɔ̃i Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma yɛ Samaria.
Shi efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee, ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ feemɔ.
Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat Pileser batua Israel, ni Menahem hã Tiglat Pileser jwiɛtɛi talentai akpe koni ewa lɛ ni ehã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi yɛ Israel.

Menahem tsu Israelbii lɛ too, niiatsɛmɛi wuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hã jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni akɛhã Tiglat Pileser, Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ, ni etuaaa Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Menahem he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Menahem gbo, ni afu lɛ, yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi, ni ebi Pekahia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Menahem bi Pekahia bɔ̃i Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee, ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ feemɔ.

Ni Remalia bi Peka, ni ji Pekahia asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ, tee Pekahia yinɔ apam, ni etswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ yɛ Samaria, yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli. Gilead hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ fata Peka he; kɛkɛ ni Peka ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Pekahia sɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Pekahia he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ Remalia bi Peka bɔ̃i Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee, ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ feemɔ.

Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka yinɔ lɛ Tiglat-Pileser, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ fã ta kɛba Israel. Ebaŋɔ Gilead kɛ Galilea shikpɔji lɛ kɛ amɛmli maji nɛɛ: Iyon, Abel-Bet-Maaka, Yanoa, Kedesh, Hazor. Eŋɔ Naftali shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu. Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ Israelbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nom kɛtee Asiria.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yotam yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ela bi Hoshea tee Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, yinɔ apam, ni etswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ, ni ebaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Agbɛnɛ Peka he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, naa, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria bi Yotam baye maŋtsɛ.
Ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli be ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yerusha, Zadok biyoo lɛ.
Efee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; bɔ ni etsɛ Azaria fee lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee.
Kɛ̃lɛ ekumɔɔɔ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ eshwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔlei kɛ tsofãkɛŋmai yɛ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ lolo. Yotam ji mɔ ni tswa Kooyigbɛ Agbo ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yotam he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli Yehowa hã Siria Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, batua Yuda sikpɔŋ lɛ.
Yotam gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ Yerusalem; kɛkɛ ni ebi Ahaz baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
16: Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yotam bi Ahaz bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
No mli lɛ Ahaz eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ; ni eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa. Efeee nɔ ni ja yɛ e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, ejaakɛ ekɔɔɔ eblematsɛ David su kpakpa lɛ.
Efee esha fe Israel maŋtsɛmɛi ni nyiɛ ehiɛ lɛ tete. Egbe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋbi ekɛshã afɔle ehã amãgãi, nɔ ko ni Yehowa hiɔ, ni no hã eshwie jeŋmajiabii lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
Eshãshãa afɔlei kɛ tsofãkɛŋmai yɛ amãgãi ajamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ kɛ gɔji anɔ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi hu.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Siria Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, fã ta, ni amɛ kɛ Yerusalem bawu. Amɛbasa Ahaz yi, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ enɔ kunim amɛye.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Siria Maŋtsɛ Rezin saa eshɔ̃ Elat maŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni eshwie Yudafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Edombii bahi jɛi, ni amɛyɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ahaz tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat-Pileser ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, "Otsulɔ kɛ obi ji mi. Ba ni obahere mi yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ni ete shi ewo mi lɛ, adɛŋ."
Ahaz ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ nitoohe lɛ mli hu, ni ekɛtsu ni akɛyake Asiria maŋtsɛ Tiglat Pileser.
Tiglat Pileser fee nɔ ni Ahaz babi lɛ lɛ. Efã ta eyatua Damasko, ni eye enɔ, ni egbe Maŋtsɛ Rezin, ni eŋɔ Damaskobii lɛ nom kɛtee Kir.
Kɛkɛ ni Ahaz yiŋ kɛtee Damasko koni ekɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat-Pileser ayakpe. Ahaz yana afɔleshãa latɛ ko yɛ Damasko. Ehã atɛŋ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ su, bɔ ni eyɔɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ekɛtsu akɛyahã osɔfo Uria.
Ni Osɔfo Uria ma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni akɛmaje lɛ lɛ henɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ema egbe naa dani Maŋtsɛ Ahaz jɛ Damasko eba.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz jɛ Damasko eba lɛ, ebana afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Ahaz tsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee ehe,
ni eshã eshãa edãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔlei yɛ nɔ, efɔse edãa afɔlɛ lɛ eshwie nɔ, ni eŋɔ eshidaa afɔlei lɛ ala lɛ eshwa afɔleshaa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, Ahaz tsi kɛje Yehowa we lɛ hiɛgbɛ he ni ema, yɛ efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ Yehowa we lɛ teŋ lɛ, ni ekɛyama lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kooyigbɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz fã Osɔfo Uria akɛ, "Mifɔleshãa latɛ wulu nɛɛ nɔ oshã afɔlei nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ: Leebi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ gbɛkɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ shãa afɔle kɛ eniyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ maŋbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shãa afɔlei lɛ, kɛ amɛniiyenii afɔlei alá lɛ kɛ amɛdãa afɔlei lɛ. Oŋɔ shãa afɔlei alã lɛ kɛ afɔlei krokomɛi lɛ alá lɛ fɛɛ oshwã nɔ. Shi akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, no ahi shi ahã mi koni mikɛbi Yehowa nii."
Osɔfo Uria fee bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Maŋtsɛ Ahaz fãmɔ akɔɔble shwiilii ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ anaji lɛ, ni ehole tsɛnsii ni mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ. Ewo akɔɔble gbudugbaŋ lɛ hu yɛ akɔɔble tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ akotosɛɛ, ni eŋɔ ma tɛi ni akɛka shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ gbɛ ni aha eyiteŋ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli (Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛboteɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ) kɛ maŋtsɛ tsɔ̃mɔhe ni yɔɔ agbonaa gbɛ lɛ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, Ahaz tsɔ̃ amɛnaa ehã he kroko.
Agbɛnɛ Ahaz he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Egbo ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ Yerusalem, ni ebi Hezekia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
17: Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahaz yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ela bi Hoshea babɔ̃i Israel maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria. Ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nɛɛhu.
Efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ̃lɛ enɔ lɛ tamɔ̃ɔɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi ni tsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Asiria Maŋtsɛ Shalmaneser, batua Israel, ni Hoshea tsɔ̃ Shalmaneser tsulɔ, ni daa afi lɛ Hoshea woɔ too ehãa lɛ.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ Hoshea kpa too lɛ woo, kɛkɛ ni eyabi So, Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ koni etse atūa. Be ni Shalmaneser na le enɛ lɛ, etsu ayamɔ Hoshea, ni ewo lɛ tsuŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Shalmaneser fã ta ebatua Israel, ni ebasa Samaria yi afii etɛ̃.

Hoshea yinɔ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Samaria. Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ Israelbii nom kɛtee Asiria; eŋɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛtee Hala maŋ wulu lɛ mli; ekɛ mɛi komɛi hu tee Habor Faa lɛ naa yɛ Gozan kpokpai anɔ; ekɛ mɛi komɛi hu tee Media maji wuji lɛ amli.
Samaria gbee shi, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ fee esha shi Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ Farao, Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni ejie amɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ amɛyaja nyɔŋmai krokomɛi moŋ.
Amɛyanyiɛ jeŋmaji ni Yehowa shwiie amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ akusumi lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛyaye Israel maŋtsɛmɛi srɔtoi lɛ akusumi ni amɛsɔ̃sɔ̃ɔ lɛ anɔ.

Ni Israelbii lɛ fee nii ni ejaaa gbɛ amɛshi Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Amɛmamɔ jamɔ hei grɔŋŋi amɛhã amɛhe yɛ amɛmajimaji lɛ fɛɛ amli, amɛmamɔ kɛjɛ bulɔi amɔɔ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ kɛtee maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ mli.
Ni amɛfee Ashera amãgãi, ni amɛfee wɔŋkoi yɛ gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi.
Ni amɛshãshãa tsofakɛŋmai yɛ jamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋmaji ni Yehowa shwie amɛ kɛje amɛhiɛ lɛ fee lɛ; ni amɛfee nibii fɔɔji amɛkɛwo Yehowa mlila.
Ni amɛja wɔji ni tsɛbelɛ Yehowa ewo amɛ shi yɛ he akɛ, "Nyɛkafea nɛkɛ nɔ ko lɛ.

Yehowa tsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ ninalɔi lɛ anɔ, ni ebɔ Israel kɛ Yuda kɔkɔ akɛ, "Nyɛkpalea kɛjea nyɛgbɛi fɔɔji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛyea mikitãi lɛ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, kitãi fɛɛ ni mitsɔ̃ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ miwo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni nyɛ hu gbalɔi lɛ kɛba hã nyɛ lɛ."
Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbooo toi; amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi tamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi ni heee Yehowa amɛ-Nyɔmɔ lɛ amɛyeee lɛ.

Amɛkwa ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ, kɛ kɔkɔ ni ebɔ amɛ lɛ. Amɛyaja yakayaka amãgãi, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ yaka gbɔmɛi; ni amɛyanyiɛ jeŋmaji ni ebɔle amɛ kɛkpe ni Yehowa ewo amɛ kīta yɛ amɛhe akɛ amɛkafee amɛnii tamɔ amɛ lɛ asɛɛ.
Ni amɛkwa Yehowa amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitãi lɛ, ni amɛfee shika tsinabii enyɔ amãgã amɛhã amɛhe. Amɛfee Ashera amãgã, ni amɛja ŋulamii, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Baal.
Amɛŋɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei amɛshãshãa afɔle amɛhã jemawɔji, amɛkla, ni amɛsaa amɛyeyee ŋkunyai. Amɛhɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛhe amɛhã efɔŋfeemɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛkɛwo Yehowa mlila.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu Israel naakpa, ni ehã aŋɔ amɛ nom; eshwɛɛɛ akutso ko akutso ko akɛ ja Yuda akutso lɛ kɛkɛ.
Shi Yudabii lɛ hu yeee Yehowa amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ amɛyanyiɛ Israelbii lɛ akusumi lɛ asɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kwa Israel kɛ Yuda shwiei lɛ fɛɛ, ni ehã amɛna amanehulu, ni egbla amɛtoi, ni etu amɛ ewo nihalɔi adɛŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eshwie amɛ kɛje ehiɛ.
Be ni Yehowa tse Israel kɛje Yuda he lɛ, Israelbii lɛ wo Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, amɛmaŋtsɛ. Yeroboam hã Israel je Yehowa sɛɛ, ni ehã amɛfee esha kpeteŋkple.
Israelbii lɛ yanyiɛ eshai ni Yeroboam fee lɛ nɔŋŋ sɛɛ, ni amɛkpaleee kɛjeee he,

kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa shwie amɛ kɛje ehiɛ kwraa tamɔ bɔ ni ewie kɛtsɔ̃ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ aŋɔ Israelbii nom kɛje amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikɔŋ nɔ kɛtee Asiria, ni jɛi amɛyɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ yaŋɔ mɛi kɛjɛ Babilon kɛ Kuta kɛ Ava kɛ Hamat kɛ Safarvaim, ni ekɛ amɛ ba Israel; ni amɛbahi maji hei ni kulɛ Israelbii ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ hi lɛ. Ni amɛŋɔ Samaria maŋ wulu lɛ hu amɛfata he.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni amɛbahi jɛi klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, amɛjaaa Yehowa; no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã jatai yabote amɛteŋ, ni amɛgbegbee amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi.

No hewɔ lɛ ayakɛɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ bii ni oyaloo obato Israel maji lɛ amli lɛ, amɛleee ahikpɔŋ ni amɛbato nɔ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, etsu jatai kɛba maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ni naa, amɛgbegbee maŋbii lɛ ekomɛi, ejaakɛ amɛleee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaa nii."
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, "Nyɛhãa osɔfoi ni nyɛyaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ayaa ni eyahi jɛi, koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi ni amɛyaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Samaria kɛtee Asiria lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome tee, ni eyahi Betel, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ bɔ ni amɛja Yehowa amɛhã.

Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ bii ni aloo amɛ kɛtee israel nɛɛ feefee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ amɛto jamɔhei grɔŋŋi ni Israelbii ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ efee momo lɛ. Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ bii kɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ to hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ.
Babilonbii lɛ fee Sukot Benot, ni Kutabii lɛ fee Nergal, ni Hamatbii lɛ fee Ashima,
ni Avabii lɛ fee Nibhaz kɛ Tartak; ni Sefarvaimbii lɛ kɛ amɛmusuŋbii shãshãa afɔle amɛhãhãa amɛnyɔŋmɔi ni ji Adramelek kɛ Anamelek.

Amɛja amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfeɔ momo dani aŋɔ amɛ kɛba Israel lɛ. Amɛja Yehowa hu, shi moŋ amɛhala amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi nɔŋŋ, ni amɛwo amɛ osɔfoi yɛ amɛjamɔ hei lɛ; ni osɔfoi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni shãa afɔlei amɛhãa maŋbii lɛ yɛ jamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛjaa Yehowa, ni asaŋ amɛjaa amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔmɔi lɛ hu, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni ayaloo amɛ kɛjɛ mli kɛba lɛ akusumi yɔɔ lɛ.

Kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkã he amɛmiifee nakai kusumii lɛ lolo. Amɛjaaa Yehowa kome pɛ kɛkɛ, ni amɛyeee akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni Yehowa wo Yakob shwiei lɛ anɔ. Yakob mɔ ni Yehowa tsake egbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Israel lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ amɛ kpãŋ, ni ewo amɛ kitã akɛ, "Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni nyɛkakotoa amɛ hu, ni nyɛkasɔmɔa amɛ, ni nyɛkashãa afɔle nyɛhãa amɛ.
Shi moŋ nyɛjaa Yehowa, mɔ ni kɛ hewalɛ kple kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ. Lɛ nyɛjaa, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛshãa afɔle nyɛhãa.
Ni akpɔi kɛ gbɛnaa nii kɛ mla kɛ kitã ni eŋma ehã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛyea nɔ daa nɛɛ. Nyɛkasɔ̃mɔa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Ni kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ. Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Nyɛjaa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni lɛ ebaajie nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ adɛŋ."
Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbooo toi, ni amɛkã he amɛfee amɛsá nii lɛ nɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ nɛkɛ jeŋmaji nɛɛ ja Yehowa, shi amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛmãgãi lɛ hu. amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii hu, bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛ hu amɛfeɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
18: Israel Maŋtsɛ Hoshea, Ela bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahaz bi Hezekia baye maŋtsɛ.
Hezekia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Abi, Zakaria biyoo lɛ.
Ni efee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eblematsɛ David fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Lɛ efite hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, ni ekumɔ amãgãi lɛ, ni egba Ahera wɔŋkoo lɛ, ni ekumɔ akɔɔble onufu ni Mose fee lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛbashi nakai gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ shãa tsofãkɛŋma amɛhãa onufu lɛ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nehushtan.
Hezekia ŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi ni baye nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ninaaa lɛ.
Eye Yehowa anɔkwa; ni ejeee Yehowa sɛɛ, ni eye kitãi ni Yehowa wo Mose lɛ nɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ, ni he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ eyayeɔ omanye. Etse Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atūa, ni esɔ̃mɔɔɔ lɛ.
Lɛ etswia Filistibii lɛ nii kɛyashwie Gaza kɛ ekpokpai lɛ anɔ tɔ̃ɔ, kɛjɛ akrowa bibioo nɔ kɛyashi maŋ wulu ni atswa gbogbo awo he nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ, ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ Hoshea, Ela bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ Shalmaneser fã batua Samaria ni ji Israel maŋ wulu lɛ.
Ni afii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eŋɔ maŋ lɛ. Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji ekpaa, ni ji Isreal Maŋtsɛ Hoshea yinɔ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, aŋɔ Samaria.
Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Israelbii lɛ nom kɛtee Asiria, ni eŋɔ amɛteiaŋ mɛi komɛi eyato Hala maŋ wulu lɛ mli, yɛ Habor Faa lɛ naa yɛ Gozan kpokpai lɛ nɔ; akɛ mɛi komɛi tee Media maji wuji lɛ amli hu.
Samaria gbee shi ejaakɛ amɛbooo Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi, ni amɛtɔ̃ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ kɛ kitãi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose wo amɛ lɛ nɔ; amɛbooo toi, ni amɛyeee nɔ hu.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ Senakerib fã ebatua Yuda maji ni atswa gbogboi awo he lɛ fɛɛ, ni eŋɔ maji lɛ.

Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsu ayakɛɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Senakerib yɛ Lakish akɛ, "Mitɔ̃, hewɔ lɛ ofai nɛ ni oku osɛɛ oya, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooohe mi lɛ mawo." Ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia abahã lɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai ohai etɛ̃ kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohei lɛ ehã.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Hezekia kplɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinai kɛ shinaatsei lɛ ahe shika nii ni lɛ Hezekia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔha he lɛ, ni eŋɔ fɛɛ ehã Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu Tartan kɛ Rabsaris kɛ Rabshake kɛ ta babaoo kɛjɛ Lakish kɛtee Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ, yɛ Yerusalem. Be ni amɛyashɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛyadamɔ ŋwɛigbɛ kpaakpo lɛ nujɔɔ lɛ masɛi, yɛ niiaheflɔi abɔɔ lɛ tempɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni amɛtsɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, Hilka bi Eliakim ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shīa lɛ, kɛ Shibna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ Asaf bi Yoa ni ji maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji anɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, je kpo tee amɛŋɔɔ.
Rabshake kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ nyɛyakɛa Hezekia akɛ, bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple, ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mɛni nɔ kwraa po oŋɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃.
Ani osusuɔ akɛ naafuu wiemɔ kɛkɛ ji tawuu heŋaatoo, loo no ji hewalɛ ni akɛwuɔ ta lo? Namɔ nɔ po ohiɛ kã, hewɔ ni otse mihiɛ atūa nɛɛ?
Naa, oŋɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Egipt nɔ, nakai glã ni eku momo, ni kɛji akpasa lɛ ni egbuɔ mɔdɛ̃ kɛjeɔ kpo lɛ. Nakai Farao, Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, ji hã mɛi fɛɛ ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ.'"

Shi kɛji nyɛaakɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ moŋ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ! Ani jeee lɛ ehei grɔŋŋi kɛ efɔleshãa latɛi lɛ Hezekia jie, ni ekɛɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem akɛ, 'Nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ hiɛ nyɛjaa yɛ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ?'"
Agbɛnɛ ba, koni okɛ minuŋtsɔ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ abata abasa, ni majie okpɔŋɔi akpei enyɔ mahã o, akɛ ooona bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi otra amɛnɔ lo?
Te ooofee tɛŋŋ ohã minuŋtsɔ tsuji bibii lɛ ateŋ asafoiatsɛ kome atsɔ̃ esɛɛ ahã o lɛ; kɛji bi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ohiɛnɔkamɔ fɛɛ yɛ Egipt kɛ etayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ lɛ?
Asaŋ, ani osusuɔ akɛ mije Yehowa sɛɛ, ni mifã mibatua oshikpɔŋ lɛ ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ ni Yehowa leee he eko lo? Yehowa moŋ ni kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Fãa ni oyatua shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okpãtã hiɛ!"

Kɛkɛ ni Hilkia bi Eliakim kɛ Shebna kɛ Yoa kɛɛ Rabshake akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, okɛ wɔ otsuji lɛ awie yɛ Arambii awiemɔ mli, ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ; shi okɛ wɔ akawie Hebribii awiemɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ miibo toi."

Shi Rabshake kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani osusuɔ akɛ minuŋtsɔ tsu mi bo kɛ onuŋtsɔ pɛ kɛkɛ ŋɔɔ kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ? Ani jeee hii lɛ ni tra gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ hu aŋɔɔ etsu mi, mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ akɛ ja amɛye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ ni amɛnu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshãmɔ lɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Rabshake ho edamɔ shi, ni ebo kɛ gbee waa yɛ Hebri wiemɔ lɛ mli akɛ, "Nyɛboa maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ gbee toi.
Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Nyɛkahãa Hezekia milakaa nyɛ; ejaakɛ enyɛŋ ejie nyɛ kɛje midɛŋ.
Ni nyɛkahãa Hezekia miihã nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ miifɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ akɛ, Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala kɛ̃, ni atuŋ maŋ nɛɛ awoŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ!'

Nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi! Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Nyɛkɛ mi abakpãtãa, ni nyɛjea kpo kɛbaa miŋɔɔ. No dani nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye ewain tso kɛ egbami tso yibii, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaanu enubu mli nu,

kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maba ni mabaŋɔ nyɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni tamɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, able kɛ wain shikpɔŋ, aboloo kɛ waintromi ashikpɔŋ, mutsei kɛ wo shikpɔŋ nɔ; ni nyɛyi aaana wala ni nyɛgboiŋ. Ni nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi, kɛji eelaka nyɛ akɛ Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala lɛ.
Ani jeŋmaji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ eko ehere eshikpɔŋ yiwala yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ pɛŋ?
Nɛgbɛ Hamat kɛ Arpad nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ Safarvaim kɛ Arpad nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Ani amɛhere Samaria yiwala yɛ midɛŋ?
Te shikpɔji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ehere amɛshikpɔŋ yiwala yɛ midɛŋ? Ni mɛni hã nyɛsusuɔ akɛ Yehowa aaanyɛ ehere Yerusalem yiwala yɛ midɛŋ lɛ?
Shi maŋbii lɛ etswaaa amɛsɛŋ, ni amɛfooo edaaŋ; ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ewo amɛ kitã akɛ, "Nyɛkafoa edaaŋ!"

Kɛkɛ ni Hilkia bi Eliakim, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shīa lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Asaf bi Yoa ni ji maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji anɔkwɛlɛ lɛ ba Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtadei ni etserɛ, ni amɛyagba lɛ wiemɔi ni Rabshake, Asiria asafoiatsɛ lɛ wie lɛ.
19: Eba mli akɛ be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ ekɛ dɔlɛ gbla etadei yɛ ehe, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eyiŋ etee Yehowa we lɛ.
Ni etsu Eliakim ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shīa lɛ kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ onukpai lɛ ni amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛtee gbalɔ Yesaia Amoz bi lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Haomɔ kɛ jɛmɔ kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ gbi ji ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eta ehe ni ejwa ahoso, shi ebɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛfɔɔ.

Eko lɛ Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ enu Rabshake wiemɔi fɛɛ ni enuŋtsɔ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛtsu lɛ koni ekɛbabɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãlɔ lɛ ahora lɛ, ni Yehowa baakã ehiɛ yɛ wiemɔi ni Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ enu lɛ hewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ sɔlemɔ okpa fai ohã wɔmaŋbii ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ lɛ."
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsuji lɛ ba Yesaia ŋɔɔ lɛ, Yesaia kɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛyakɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Kaashe gbeyei yɛ wiemɔi ni onu ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛbabɔ musu kɛshi mi lɛ hewɔ.
Naa, mikɛ mumɔ ko baawo emli, ni eeenu adafitswaa ko, ni eeeku esɛɛ kɛaatee eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mahã enyɔ yɛ klaŋte naa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Rabshake, Asiria asafoiatsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ, ni eyanina Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Libna maŋ wulu lɛ miiwu; ejaakɛ enu akɛ efã kɛjɛ Lakish kɛtee jɛi.
Be ni Asiriabii lɛ nu akɛ Egipt ta ni Sudan Maŋtsɛ Tirhaka nyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ miiba abatua amɛ lɛ, esaa etsu bɔfoi kɛba Hezekia ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ; akɛ
Bɔ ni nyɛyakɛɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nɛ, "Kaahã o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ohiɛ kã enɔ lɛ miilaka o akɛ, 'Akɛ Yerusalem woŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.'
Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ onu nibii ni Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ efee shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, bɔ ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ butubutu lɛ; ni bo, ni ebaahere oyiwala lo?
Mitsɛmɛi lɛ kpãtã Gozanbii kɛ Haranbii kɛ Resefbii ashikpɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛgbe Betedenbii ni yɔɔ Telasar lɛ. Ani amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ here amɛyiwala lo?
Nɛgbɛ Hamat maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Arpad kɛ Sefarvaim kɛ Hena kɛ Ivah yɔɔ?"
Be ni Hezekia he woji lɛ yɛ tsuji lɛ adɛŋ ni ekane lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ, ni Hezekia yagble wolo lɛ mli efɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ni Hezekia yasɔle ekpa Yehowa fai akɛ, "Ao, Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, bo mɔ ni oyeɔ lumɔ yɛ kerubim lɛ anɔ, bo okome too ji Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Bo obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.
Gboo otoi shi ni obo mi toi. Gbɛɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ Yehowa, ni okwɛ! Onu wiemɔi ni Senakerib kɛtsu ni akɛbaye bo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ohe fɛo lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, eji anɔkwale lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ efite je ŋmajimaji lɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ,
ni amɛshɛrɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ amɛshwie la mli; ejaakɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ji nomɛi; shi moŋ gbɔmɛi aninenaa nitsumɔi ni, tsei kɛ tɛi ni, no hewɔ ni amɛfite amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, bo Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa o fai, heremɔ wɔyiwala kɛjɛ edɛŋ, koni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ ana ale akɛ bo, Yehowa, okome too pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Amoz bi Yesaia tsu kɛba Hezekia ŋɔɔ, ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ. Fai ni okpa mi yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ he lɛ, minu.
Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Senakerib he nɛ: Yerusalem, Zion biyoo oblayoo fro lɛ, gbeɔ ohe guɔ, eliɔ bo, eŋmɔɔ bo yɛ osɛɛ.
Namɔ ahora obɔ, ni owie musubɔɔ wiemɔi oshi lɛ lɛ? Namɔ oblɔ owo lɛ: Ni namɔ ogbɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ owo lɛ? Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni!

Obɔfoi lɛ anɔ otsɔ̃ ni obabɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahora, ni okɛɛ, 'Mikɛ mita shwiilii ekwɔ kɛtee gɔji ayiteiaŋ kɛtee Lebanon sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ. Miflɔ emli tsenedru tsei ni kwɔlɔ lɛ kɛ emli sɛsɛoi ni hi lɛ mishwie shi, ni mibote ekoo hayii lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Mitsatsaa bui, ni minu maŋsɛɛ nui, mikɛ minanetsitsi hã Egipt fai fɛɛ miimii.

"Ani onuko akɛ nakai mifeɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe? Nakai mito miyiŋ kɛjɛ blema beebe, nɔ ni miha eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ. No ji akɛ akpãtã maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ ahiɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i koikoi,
be mli ni amɛmli bii ahewalɛ etã, ni amɛtsui efã, ni amɛluluu. Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi kɛ baa fɔbii kɛ tsu yiteŋ jwɛi hu, loo able tso ni edaaa, ni eŋla.
"Mile oshitee kɛ oshitamɔ kɛ oyaa kɛ obaa fɛɛ kɛ ogrimɔ ni ogri owo mi lɛ hu.
Akɛni ogri owo mi, ni oshwãa lɛ ekwɔ kɛbashɛ mitoiŋ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ mikpoŋ baawo ogugɔŋ, ni mikɛ mimanyoflɛ baawo odaaŋ, ni mikpla bo kɛku sɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ."

Kɛkɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, "Ni enɛ baafee okadi ahã o. Afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛaaye nii ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkwɛ̃, ni afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli hu, nyɛaaye nii ni kwɛ̃ yɛ nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ; shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛdua nii ni nyɛkpaa; ni nyɛfea waintromi hu ni nyɛyea emli yibii.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ ni hiɛ kã yɛ Yuda we lɛ, amɛaatsɛ̃rɛ fãi ekoŋŋ kɛya su mli tɔ̃ɔ tamɔ waintso, ni amɛaawo yibii.
Ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ baashwɛ kɛaajɛ Yerusalem kɛ Zion aba ni amɛhiɛ kã, ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaafee enɛ.

"No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ he nɛ, 'Ebaŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni etsɛ̃ŋ gãi kuli kome gaŋŋ ewoŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli. Ni asraafoi ni hiɛ tsɛŋi bɛŋkɛŋ maŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ kotokui ni shia yɔɔ mli efeŋ tasu kɛsa maŋ lɛ yi.
Gbɛ ni etsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, no nɔŋŋ nɔ eeetsɔ̃ kɛaaku esɛɛ, ni ebaŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mafã maŋ nɛɛ he, ni mahere eyiwala, yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiɛ nyam hewɔ, kɛ shi ni miwo mitsulɔ David lɛ hu hewɔ.'"

Ni eba mli akɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo ko tee Asiria asraafoi lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli, ni eyagbe asraafoi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ jɛi. Be ni je tsɛreɔ lɛ, naa amɛ ni amɛjwere shi ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛgboi.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ Senakerib shi jɛi kɛtee Nineve eyahi jɛi.

Ni eba mli akɛ gbi ko be ni ejaa yɛ enyɔŋmɔ Nisrok we lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋ bihii enyɔ, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer, yagbe lɛ kɛ klaŋte, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee Ararat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebi nuu kroko, Esar-Hadon, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
20: Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, Hezekia he baye ni eehe egbo. Ni gbalɔ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Too owe lɛ gbɛjianɔ, ejaakɛ obaagbo, onaŋ hewalɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia tsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbogbo ni ekpa Yehowa fai ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Ao, Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni misɔ̃mɔ o, ni miye o anɔkwa kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni mifee nɔ ni ja yɛ ohiɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia fo waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Yesaia kɛɛ ejeɔ kpo yɛ mɔ̃ɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ:

"Kūu osɛɛ ni oyakɛɛ Hezekia, mimaŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Yehowa, otsɛ David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, minu ofaikpamɔ lɛ, ni mina ohiɛ yaafonu lɛ; naa, mibatsa o; ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, ooonyiɛ onane nɔ kɛaaya Yehowa we lɛ.
Maŋɔ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ mafata ogbii lɛ ahe. Asaŋ mahere bo kɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ yiwala kɛaajɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ. Mafã maŋ nɛɛ he yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ kɛ shi ni miwo mitsulɔ David lɛ hu hewɔ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ agbami adufao abaa! Aŋɔ eko akɛto asane lɛ nɔ, ni ehe baawa lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia bi Yesaia akɛ, "Mɛni ji okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yehowa baatsa mi, ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ manyɛ manyiɛ minane nɔ kɛya Yehowa we lɛ?"

Yesaia kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Enɛ aaafee okadi ni jɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ahã o, akɛ Yehowa baaye eshi ni ewo bo lɛ nɔ. Ani ooosumɔ akɛ atrakpoi lɛ asusuma ni kã atswere lɛ nɔ lɛ atsi kɛya hiɛ nane fãamɔi nyɔŋma aloo eba sɛɛsɛɛ nanefãamɔi nyɔŋma?"
Hezekia hã hetoo akɛ, "Ewaaa hãaa susuma lɛ akɛ eeeya hiɛhiɛ nane fãamɔi nyɔŋma lɛ, shi moŋ, hã susuma lɛ aba sɛɛsɛɛ nanefãamɔi nyɔŋma lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Yesaia sɔle ekpa Yehowa fai, ni Yehowa hã susuma ni etee hiɛhiɛ momo lɛ ba sɛɛsɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz atrakpoi lɛ anɔ nanefãamɔ nyɔŋma.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Merodak-Baladan, Baladan bi ni ji Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, nu akɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he miiye, hewɔ lɛ eŋma lɛ wolo, ni ekɛ nikeenii fata he ekɛtsu tsuji akɛyahã lɛ.

Maŋtsɛ Hezekia here mɛi ni atsu eŋɔɔ lɛ atuu, ni eŋɔ ejwertri ni eyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ejwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsofakɛŋmai, kɛ mui ni jara wa kɛ etawuu nibii lɛ atoohe fɛɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ewe lɛ loo enɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ he ko he ko ni Hezekia kɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Yesaia ba Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ jɛ kɛba, ni mɛni wiemɔ amɛkɛba?" Hezekia hã hetoo akɛ, "Amɛjɛ Babilon tɔ̃ɔ kɛba."
Gbalɔ Yesaia bi akɛ, "Mɛni amɛna yɛ owe lɛ mli?" Ni Hezekia hã hetoo akɛ, Amɛna nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ miwe lɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ minitoohei lɛ ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, "Bo Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
'Naa, gbii miiba, be ni abaaloo nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ owe lɛ kɛ nibii ni otsɛmɛi lɛ ebua naa eto kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛaatee Babilon, ni ashiŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko.' Yehowa kɛɛ.
Asaŋ bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋbii lɛ ekomɛi tete lɛ, aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee; ni aaafee amɛ osaii ni baasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli."
Hezekia nu Yesaia wiemɔ lɛ shishi akɛ, toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ baaba yɛ lɛ Hezekia lɛ ebe mli; no hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ Yesaia akɛ, "Yehowa wiemɔ ni owie lɛ, wiemɔ jurɔ ni."
Agbɛnɛ Hrzrkia he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ kɛ kpaakpo kɛ ehe nujɔɔ ni efee ni ekɛtsɛ nu kɛba Yerusalem lɛ, aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Hezekia gbo, ni ebi Manase baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
21: Manase eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hefziba.
Nihii nii ni jeŋmaji lɛ fee ni Yehowa shwie amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, nomɛi moŋ Manase fee.

Ejaakɛ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni etsɛ Hezekia fite lɛ esaa emamɔ ekoŋŋ. Emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi koni akɛshã afɔle ahã Baal; ni efee jemawɔŋ yoo Ashera amãgã tamɔ bɔ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab fee lɛ. Asaŋ Manase ja ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ, ni esɔ̃mɔ amɛ hu.
Emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ehã jemawɔji yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, he ni Yehowa ekɛɛ yɛ he akɛ, "Yerusalem ji he ni aaaja mi yɛ" lɛ.
Emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ehã ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi enyɔ lɛ anɔ.
Egbe emusuŋbi ekɛshã afɔle; ekla, ni eye ŋkunyaa; ni eto sisatsɛlɔi kɛ wɔjiatsɛmɛi. Efee efji babaoo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ekɛwo Yehowa mli la.

Ekɛ jɛmawɔŋyoo Ashera lɛ amãgã ni efee lɛ yama Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, he ni Yehowa kɛ David kɛ Solomon wie yɛ he akɛ, "Yerusalem Sɔlemɔwe nɛɛ ji he ni miŋɔ yɛ Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ akɛ he ni aja mi yɛ kɛya naanɔ lɛ.

Asaŋ mihaŋ Israel afã enane kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ ni miŋɔ Israel afã enane kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ miŋɔ mihã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ, ni eyatsomro dɔŋŋ; kɛji amɛjwɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛye kitãi fɛɛ ni miwo amɛ lɛ, kɛ mlai fɛɛ ni mitsulɔ Mose wo amɛ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ."
Shi Israel booo toi; ni Manase laka amɛ,ni amɛfee efɔŋ fe jeŋmaji ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ tete.
Shi Yehowa tsɔ̃ etsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ewie akɛ,
"Akɛni Manase, Yuda maŋtsɛ, tsu nɛkɛ nihiinii nɛɛ, ni efee efɔŋ fe nii ni Amorbii ni tsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ efee lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekɛ ewɔji lɛ hã Yuda hu fee esha hewɔ lɛ,
bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Naa, mikɛ nɔ fɔŋ baaba Yerusalem kɛ Yuda nɔ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ etoii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ mli aaafee lɛ heŋŋ.'
Ni magbla Yerusalem toi tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Samaria lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Israel maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ eshwiei lɛ. Mabɛɛ Yerusalembii fɛɛ mashwie tamɔ atsumɔɔ kã mli keŋkeŋ, ni atsɔ̃ɔ abuɔ shi lɛ.
Ni makwa miwebii ni aaashwɛ lɛ, ni matu amɛ mawo amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ nomii, ni aaaha amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛfee efɔŋ ni mihiɔ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ, ni amɛwowoo mimli la kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ je Egipt lɛ aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ."
Ni asŋ Manase kpãtã mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ ko ahiɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yerusalem he fɛɛ he yi tɔ kɛ la; dani esoro esha ni ehã Yuda fee, esha ni eji efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Manase he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ esha ni efee lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Manase gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Uza abɔɔ ni bɛŋkɛ maŋtsɛ shīa lɛ mli; ni ebi Amon baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Amon eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Meshulemet, Haruz ni jɛ Yotba lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Lɛ hu eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ Manase ba ejeŋ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbɛ ni etsɛ nyiɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛ hu enyiɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni esɔ̃mɔ wɔji ni etsɛ sɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ni eja amɛ.
Ekwa Yehowa, etsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ebaaa ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ lɛ.
Ni Amon tsuji lɛ tee eyinɔ apam, ni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ.
Shi maŋbii lɛ gbe mɛi fɛɛ ni tee maŋtsɛ Amon yinɔ apam lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ wo ebi Yosia maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Amon he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Afū Amon yɛ efūuhe lɛ yɛ Uza trom lɛ mli; ni ebi Yosia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
22: Yosia eye afi kpaanyɔ, be ni ebɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli. Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔnmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yedida, ni Adaia ni jɛ Bozkat lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Yosia fee jalɛ nii ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, ni ekɔ eblematsɛ David nane. Eshihilɛ mli lɛ, egbaaa ninejurɔ lɛ, egbaaa abɛku.
Ni eba mli akɛ Maŋtsɛ Yosia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yosia tsu Azalia bi Shafan, Meshula nabi lɛ, mɔ ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ akɛ,
"Yaa osɔfonukpa Hilkia ŋɔɔ, koni ekane shika ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ ni shinaanaakwɛlɔi lɛ ebua naa kɛjɛ mɛi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ lɛ koni etu shika lɛ ewo nitsulɔi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nɔ lɛ adɛŋ, koni amɛ hu amɛkɛhã nitsulɔi ni saa Yehowa we lɛ.
Amɛji kapintafoi lɛ kɛ tsumalɔi lɛ kɛ gbogbotswalɔi lɛ, koni akɛ eko ahe mplaŋi kɛ tɛi ni ako koni akɛsaa shīa lɛ.
Akahã amɛbu shika ni atuɔ awoɔ amɛdɛŋ lɛ he akɔntaa ko, ejaakɛ amɛyeɔ anɔkwa."
Be ni Shafan yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, Hilkia kɛ wolo ko hã lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miyana Mla Wolo lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ." Shafan kane wolo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Shafan, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, ba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ebagba lɛ akɛ, "Otsuji lɛ eyaŋɔ shika ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni amɛtu amɛwo mɛi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ."
Ni Shafan, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, tsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Osɔfonukpa Hilkia kɛ wolo ko ehã mi." Ni Shafan kane wolo lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Ni be ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia nu Mla Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ekɛ dɔlɛ gbla etadei yɛ ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã osɔfo Hilkia kɛ Shafan bi Ahikam, kɛ Mikaia bi Akbor, kɛ Shafan mɔ ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Asaia, maŋtsɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ,

"Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyabia Yehowa nii nyɛhãa mi kɛ maŋbii lɛ, kɛ Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ nɛkɛ wolo ni ana nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa mli ni ewo la ewo wɔ nɛɛ naa wa naakpa, ejaakɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ booo wiemɔi ni yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ toi, koni amɛye emli wiemɔi ni kɔɔ wɔhe lɛ anɔ."

No hewɔ lɛ Osɔfo Hilkia kɛ Ahikam kɛ Akbor kɛ Shafan kɛ Asaia yiŋ amɛtee gbalɔyoo Hulda ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ. Yerusalem akutso hee ko mli Hulda yɔɔ. Hulda nɛɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ atadei ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli lɛ nɔ.
Hulda kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, nyɛyakɛa maŋtsɛ lɛ ni tsu nyɛ miŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ:
'Naa, mahã nɔ fɔŋ aba biɛ nɛɛ kɛ biɛbii lɛ anɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ wolo ni Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ kane lɛ mli lɛ.
Akɛni amɛkwa mi, ni amɛyashã tsofãkɛŋma amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni amɛkɛ amɛninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ewo mimli la hewɔ lɛ, mimli baawo la awo Yerusalem naakpa.'
Shi bɔ ni nyɛyakɛɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ ni tsu nyɛ akɛ nyɛyabi Yehowa nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɛ, 'Mi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛ. Yɛ wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi ni onu lɛ hewɔ lɛ

otsake otsui, ni oba ohe shi yɛ mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ, ni okɛ dɔlɛ gbla otadei yɛ ohe, ni okɛ dɔlɛ fo yɛ mihiɛ, be ni onu nɔ ni miwie yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ nɛɛ bii ahe akɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ loomɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu minu osɔlemɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mahã ogbo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni aaafu o afata otsɛmɛi lɛ ahe, ni nɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni mahã aba biɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, ohiŋmɛii enaŋ ekoeko.'" Ni hii lɛ hu amɛsɛɛ amɛbabɔ Maŋtsɛ Yosia amaniɛ lɛ.
23: Maŋtsɛ Yosia tsu ni ayabua Yuda kɛ Yerusalem onukpai lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛba eŋɔɔ.

Ni maŋtsɛ Yosia kɛ Yuda hii lɛ kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ yiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kane kpãŋmɔ wolo lɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛtoiŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yadamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ashidaamɔhe lɛ, yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni ekɛ Yehowa kpãŋ akɛ, ebaanyiɛ Yehowa sɛɛ, ni ebaaye emlai lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ esusuma muu lɛ fɛɛ koni eye nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi ni aŋmã yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ wo shi akɛ amɛbaaye kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ nɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã Osɔfonukpa Hilkia kɛ eshishi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ shinaanaakwɛlɔi lɛ akɛ amɛjie nibii fɛɛ ni afee ni akɛjaa Baal kɛ Ashera kɛ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ fɛɛ kɛje Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli, ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia shã fɛɛ yɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ Kidron jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ aloo lamlu lɛ kɛtee Betel.

Maŋtsɛ Yosia shwie wulɔmɛi lɛ ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ eto ni amɛshãa tsofãkɛŋma yɛ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli kɛ hei ni bɔle Yerusalem kpula lɛ. Eshwie mɛi hu ni shãa tsofãkɛŋma amɛhãa Baal kɛ hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere kɛ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ jie Ashera amãgã lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛtee Yerusalem maŋ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Kidron jɔɔ lɛŋ, ni eyashã, ni eshimɔ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni eloo ni ekɛyashwã maŋbii asaŋi lɛ anɔ.
Ni ekumɔ hii ni kɛ amɛhe ehã ajwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ atsui ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ eshwie shi. Jɛi ji he ni yei lɛ loɔ atadei ni akɛjaa Ashera lɛ yɔɔ.

Ni eyaŋɔ osɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli kɛba, ni ebule jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ eshãshãa tsofãkɛŋma yɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ Geba kɛyashwie Beersheba. Ekumɔ amãgãi ni bɛŋkɛ agbo lɛ ni maŋ amralo Yoshua fee lɛ eshwie shi. Yoshua agbo nɛɛ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ abɛkugbɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ osɔfoi lɛ, aŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he yɛ Yerusalem; shi moŋ aŋmɛɔ amɛ gbɛ amɛyeɔ akpiti aboloo ni akɛhãa amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ eko.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia bule Tofet, wɔŋjamɔhe ni yɔɔ Hinombii a-Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akagbe ebinuu loo ebiyoo ekɛshã afɔle ekɛhã wɔŋ Molek lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejie okpɔŋɔi ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ eto ni akɛjaa hulu lɛ kɛje Yehowa we lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Agbo nɛɛ bɛŋkɛ piafonyo Natan-Melek tsu lɛ. Shi tayaa shwiilii lɛ ema naa la ni eshã.

Ni afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz ŋwɛitsu lɛ yiteŋ ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fee, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ni maŋtsɛ Manase fee yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi enyɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yosia kumɔ eshwie shi, ni egblɛ, ni eloo kɛjɛ jɛi, ni ekɛyawo Kidron Jɔɔ lɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ Yosia bule jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni maŋtsɛ Solomon mamɔ yɛ Yerusalem bokãgbɛ lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi ni yɔɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ ni akɛjaa Astarte, Sidonbii lɛ amãgã lɛ, kɛ Kemosh, Moabbii lɛ amãgã lɛ kɛ Molek, Amonbii lɛ amãgã lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia kumɔ amãgãi lɛ, ni egba Ashera wɔŋkoi lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɛ gbɔmɛi awui shwã jɛi.

Asaŋ afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Betel jamɔhe grɔŋŋ lɛ ni Nebat bi Yeroboam ni hã Israel fee esha lɛ fee lɛ, nakai afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ Yosia kumɔ shwie shi. Eshã jamɔhe grɔŋŋ lɛ, ni eshimɔ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni eshã Ashera amãgãa lɛ hu.

Ni be ni Yosia tsɔ̃ ehe lɛ, ena gbohii abui komɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni etsu ayaloo wui lɛ kɛjɛ gbohii abui lɛ amli, ni ebashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛbule lɛ. Efee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ wie bɛ ko lɛ aba mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi akɛ, "Namɔ saŋ ji nɔ ni minaa nɛɛ?" Ni maŋ lɛŋ bii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ Yuda ba ni ebagba nibii ni ofee Betel afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ eto lɛ, lɛ esaŋ ni."
Ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa ehia shi nakai, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akata ewui lɛ ahe!" Ni amɛshi ewui lɛ, kɛ gbalɔ lɛ ni jɛ Samaria ba lɛ hu wui lɛ.
Ni jamɔhei grɔŋŋi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Samaria maji lɛ amli ni Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fee amɛkɛwo Yehowa mlila lɛ, Yosia kumɔ fɛɛ shwie shi, ni efee amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni efee yɛ Betel lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni egbe jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ awulɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eshã gbɔmɛi awui yɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ. Ni eku esɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ Yosia fã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ kɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ayeko nakai Hehoo Gbijurɔ pɛŋ dã kɛjɛ kojolɔi ni kojo Israel lɛ ayinɔ, aahu kɛbashi Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ ayinɔ nɛɛ."
Shi, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Yosia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aye Hehoo nɛɛ akɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam yɛ Yerusalem.

Asaŋ Maŋtsɛ Yosia shwie sisatsɛlɔi lɛ kɛ klamɔfoi lɛ, ni ejie amãgãi kɛ wɔji kɛ wɔŋjamɔ nibii fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalem lɛ. Efee enɛ koni wiemɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ ama shi, Mla Wolo lɛ ni Osɔfo Hilkia yana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ.

Maŋtsɛmɛi ni ye nɔ dani Yosia ba lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni ku esɛɛ kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esusuma muu lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ Mose Mla lɛ fɛɛ naa. Ni maŋtsɛ ko hu eteko shi dɔŋŋ yɛ esɛɛ ni tamɔ lɛ.
Shi kɔ̃lɛ Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ emli ni efu Yuda lɛ he, yɛ mlilawoo nii fɛɛ ni Manase fee kɛwo emli la lɛ hewɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibajie Yuda hu kɛje mihiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mijie Israel lɛ, ni makwa nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni mikɔ ni ji Yerusalem lɛ, kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hu ni mikɛɛ yɛ he akɛ'Jɛi aja mi yɛ' lɛ."
Agbɛnɛ Yosia he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii ni efee lɛ, aŋmla yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.

Be ni Yosia ji maŋtsɛ lɛ, Egipt maŋtsɛ Neko fã eyatua Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa. Ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ etsi Egipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ naa yɛ Megido, shi agbe Maŋtsɛ Yosia yɛ ta lɛ mli yɛ jɛi.

Ni etsuji lɛ ŋɔ egbonyo lɛ amɛwo tayaa shwiili mli, ni akɛ lɛ ku sɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem, ni amɛbafu lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afuuhe lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbonyobu mli. Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ŋɔ Yosia bi Yehoahaz; ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu, ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ sɛɛ.
Ne ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoahaz baye maŋtsɛ lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃; ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hamutal, Yeremia ni jɛ Libna lɛ biyoo lɛ.
Yehoahaz baaa ejeŋ ekpakpa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eblematsɛmɛi lɛ ekomɛi fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ fo, be ni Egipt Maŋtsɛ Neko wo lɛ gboklɛ yɛ Ribla yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ekahi lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yeli yɛ Yerusalem dɔŋŋ lɛ. Egipt Maŋtsɛ Neko hã Yuda wo jwiɛtɛi talentai oha, kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome akɛ too ehã Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Egipt Maŋtsɛ Neko ŋɔ Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi Eliakim, ni ewo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ Yosia najiaŋ; ni etsake egbɛi; ni ewo lɛ Yehoiakim. Shi Yehoahaz lɛ Maŋtsɛ Neko mɔ lɛ kɛtee Egipt, ni jɛi eyagbo yɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim gba too ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ, ni ekɛna jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ ehã Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo etoo ni egba ehã lɛ yɛ eninamɔ naa.
Be ni Yehoiakim bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Zebida. Pedaia ni jɛ Ruma lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Yehoiakim hu baaa ejeŋ ekpakpa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ eblematsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
24: Be mli ni Yehoiakim yeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛbatua Yuda, ni eye enɔ; ni Yehoiakim sɔ̃mɔ lɛ afii etɛ̃. Shi Yehoiakim tse Nebukadnezar hiɛ atūa.
Ni Yehowa tsu Babilonbii atai lɛ kɛ Siriabii atai lɛ kɛ Moabbii atai lɛ kɛ Amonbii atai lɛ kɛbatua Yehoiakim koni amɛfite Yuda taakɛ Yehowa tsɔ̃ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ewie lɛ.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba Yuda nɔ yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa koni ekɛjiɛ Yudabii lɛ kɛje ehiɛ, yɛ eshai fɛɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Manase fee lɛ ahewɔ,
titri lɛ yɛ mɛi ni efeko nɔ ko ni egbegbee amɛ lɛ ahewɔ. Ejaakɛ Manase fɔse mɛi ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ ala babaoo eshwie shi yɛ Yerusalem, ni Yehowa sumɔɔɔ ekɛ nɛkɛ esha nɛɛ afa Manase.
Shi Yehoiakim he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yehoiakim gbo, ni afū lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ afūuhe lɛ; ni ebi Yehoiakin baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.

Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ efãaa kɛ eta lɛ kɛjeee eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaaa he ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ eŋɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛ̃ɛ ni ji Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ Egipt Faa lɛ naa aahu kɛyashi Eufrate Faa lɛ naa.
Be ni Yehoiakin bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Nehushta, Elnatan ni jɛ Yerusalem lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Yehoiakin baaa ejeŋ ekpakpa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yehoiakim maŋtsɛyeli yinɔ lɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛbatua Yerusalem, ni amɛbasa maŋ lɛ yi.
Be ni asaa maŋ lɛ yi lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar diɛŋtsɛ ba jɛi.

Kɛkɛ ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin kɛ enyɛ kɛ ebii kɛ etsuji kɛ elumɛi kɛ epiafoi lɛ je kpo kɛtee, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ. Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ eŋɔ Yehoiakin nom.

Ni eyaloo Yehowa we lɛ jwetri lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ jwetri lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee, ni ejwara shika nibii fɛɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon efee yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli dukuduku eshwie, taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.

Ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋɔ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛtee, amɛyibɔ ji akpei nyɔŋma. Eloo ŋaalɔi kɛ sɔ̃lɔi lɛ fɛɛ hu; eshii mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ja shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ji ohiafoi lɛ kɛkɛ.
Nebukadnezar ŋɔ Yehoiakin kɛ enyɛ kɛ eŋamɛi kɛ piafoi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛtee Babilon.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni naa shiɔ akpei kpawo, kɛ ŋaalɔi kɛ sɔ̃lɔi akpe lɛ nom kɛtee Babilon, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ kãkãlɔi ni eshɛ tayaa ji amɛ.
Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar wo Yehoiakin tsɛkwɛ̃ Matania ni jɛ Yuda lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ Yehoiakin najiaŋ, shi etsake egbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Zedekia.
Be ni Zedekia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hamutal, Yeremia ni jɛ Libna lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Zedekia fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehoiakim fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yehowa mli fu Yerusalembii kɛ Yudabii lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni no hã eshwie amɛ kɛje ehiɛ.
25: Zedekia tse Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hiɛ atūa. No hewɔ lɛ eba mli akɛ Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma yɛ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛbatua Yerusalem, ni amɛsa maŋ lɛ yi, ni amɛmamɔ kpokui amɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Ni asa maŋ lɛ yi aahu kɛyashi Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Nakai afi lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni naa wa ba maŋ lɛŋ; ni no hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ naaa nii amɛye.

Kɛkɛ ni agbu gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ mli, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi nyɔɔŋ kɛtsɔ̃ agbo lɛ ni naa kã gbogboi enyɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛjo foi kɛtsɔ̃ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ lɛ nɔ; tsɛbelɛ Babilonbii lɛ egba kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ kɛkpe.
Shi Babilonbii lɛ ata lɛ tui maŋtsɛ Zedekia, ni amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ; ni etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ je ehe amɛgbɛ amɛshwã amɛshi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛmɔ Zedekia ni amɛkɛ lɛ yahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yɛ Ribla, ni akojo lɛ.
Zedekia hiŋmɛii jwere nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni agbe ebihii lɛ yɛ ehiɛ; ni Nebukadnezar hã ajwara Zedekia hiŋmɛii, ni awo lɛ gboklɛi, ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee Babilon.

Yɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nebuzaradan ni eji maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋaawolɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji maŋtsɛ lɛ asraafoiatsɛ lɛ, bote Yerusalem.
Ni ebashã Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ kɛ Yerusalem shīai lɛ fɛɛ, ni shīa wulu fɛɛ shīa wulu lɛ ekɛ la shã butuu.
Ni Babilonbii lɛ ata lɛ fɛɛ ni fata asraafoiatsɛ lɛ he lɛ kumɔ Yerusalem gbogboi lɛ kɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni asraafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan ŋɔ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni ashi yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni tse amɛhe kɛtee Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, kɛ asafo yuu lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nom kɛtee Babilon.
Shi asraafoiatsɛ lɛ shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ohiafoi kwraa lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ Yuda koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ waintromsaalɔi kɛ okwaafoi.
Ni akɔɔble akulashiŋi lɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ, kɛ shwiilii lɛ kɛ akɔɔble gbudugbaŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ, Babilonbii lɛ jwara amɛ dukuduku, ni amɛloo akɔɔble lɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Ni kukwɛii lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ kaklai lɛ kɛ atoi lɛ kɛ akɔɔble nibii lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, amɛkɔlɔ kɛtee.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ shika aloo jwiɛtɛi fee lɛ amɛkɔlɔ kɛtee. Ŋɛsui lɛ kɛ lalakãi lɛ hu asraafoiatsɛ lɛ kɔlɔ fɛɛ kɛtee.
Shi akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ kɛ gbudugbaŋ kome lɛ shishi adekai lɛ ni maŋtsɛ Solomon fee ehã Yehowa we lɛ, nɛkɛ akɔɔble nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ aleee bɔ ni eŋmɛɔ.
Akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ akwɔlɔmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni eko yiteŋ kpɔ lɛ akɔɔble ni; ni kpɔ lɛ kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃, ni alo ntaŋ akɛha akɔɔble kokrobii lɛ ahe kɛkpe.
Ni Nebuzaradan, asraafoiatsɛ lɛ, ŋɔ Osɔfonukpa Seraia kɛ Zefania, esɛɛmɔ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaanaakwɛlɔi etɛ̃ lɛ nom efata he kɛtee.

Ni eŋɔ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ tabilɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛŋ. Eŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔi enumɔ ni ana amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, kɛ tatsɛ ni buaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anaa kɛyaa ta lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ateŋ hii nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni ana yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nebuzaradan, asraafoiatsɛ lɛ, ŋɔ amɛ ni ekɛ amɛ yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Ribla.
Kɛkɛ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tswia amɛ nii, ni egbe amɛ yɛ Ribla yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ aŋɔ Yudabii lɛ nom kɛje amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nebukadnezar, Babel maŋtsɛ lɛ wo Gedelia, Ahikam bi ni ji Shafan nabi lɛ, amralo koni eye mɛi ni shwɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ lumɔ.

Agbɛnɛ be ni asraafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ kɛ amɛwebii lɛ nu akɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo Gedelia amralo lɛ, amɛba Gedelia ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpah. Mɛi ni ba lɛ ji Natania bi Ishmael kɛ Karea bi Yohanan kɛ Tanhumet bi Seraia, ni ji Netofatnyo lɛ, kɛ Yezania ni jɛ Maaka lɛ, kɛ amɛwebii lɛ.
Gedelia kãmɔ amɛ kɛ amɛwebii lɛ kitã akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei yɛ Babilon tsuji lɛ ahewɔ, nyɛhia shikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ, nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni aaahi ahã nyɛ."

Shi eba mli akɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ Elishama bi Ishmael, ni eji Netania nabi lɛ ni ejɛ maŋtsɛ shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma ba, ni amɛbatswia Gedelia nii ni egbo. Amɛgbe Yudafoi kɛ Babilonbii ni kɛ Gedelia yɔɔ Mizpa lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ te shi, kɛjɛ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ, amɛ kɛ asraafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee Egipt; ejaakɛ amɛmiishe Babilonbii lɛ gbeyei.

Ni eba mli akɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin nomŋɔɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Evil-Merodak baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Babilon. Ena Yuda maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin mɔbɔ ni ejie lɛ kɛje kpabu lɛŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Evilmerodak kɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ, ni ehã lɛ gbɛhe ni kwɔ fe maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi ni kɛ Yehoiakin yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli yɛ Babilon lɛ anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ ehã Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin kpa gboklɛfoi atade woo, ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ye nii daa, ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ni ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ hã ahãa Yehoiakin shika fioo ko daa, koni ekɛhe ehewɔ nii.

1: Simon Petro ni ji Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ bɔfo lɛ ŋma yahã mɛi ni nine eshɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni jra wa tãmɔ wɔnɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo jalɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ afa ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu he nilee lɛ mli.
E-Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ nii fiaa ni hi hã wala kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ eke wɔ yɛ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enumyam kɛ ehewalɛ nɔ etsɛ wɔ lɛ he nilee mli.
