Ni etsɔ̃ nii nɛɛ anɔ hu ekɛ shiwoi kpleikplei ni jra wa lɛ eke wɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ nɔ nyɛjo je nɛɛŋ fitemɔ ni yɔɔ akɔnɔ mli lɛ naa foi ni nyɛna Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ eko.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ nuufeemɔ afata nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ he; nyɛkɛ nilee afataa nuufeemɔ lɛ he;
nyɛkɛ henɔyeli afataa nilee lɛ he; nyɛkɛ hiɛmiamɔ afataa henɔyeli lɛ he; nyɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ afataa hiɛmiamɔ lɛ he;
nyɛkɛ nyɛmimɛi ahedɔɔ afata Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ he; ni nyɛkɛ suɔmɔ afataa nyɛmimɛi ahedɔɔ lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ kɛji nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛmli ni efa lɛ, ehãŋ nyɛfee mɛi bi ebɔɔɔ mɔdɛŋ aloo mɛi ni wooo yibii yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo he nilee lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ lɛ shwilafo ji lɛ, ni enaaa shɔŋŋ nii, ni ehiɛ ekpa ehe ni atsuu kɛjɛ eshai ni efee sa lɛ amli lɛ anɔ.
Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi,nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtsɛmɔ kɛ nyɛhalamɔ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ; ejaakɛ, kɛ nyɛfee enɛ lɛ, nyɛtrɛŋ gbi ko gbi ko.
Ejaakɛ nakai ni aaaŋmɛ nyɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlibotemɔ gbɛ aahuu tsɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ daa nɛɛ majwɛŋ nɔ makai nyɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, tsɛ nyɛle momo, ni nyɛnane emɔ shi yɛ anɔkwale ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ mli.
Shi gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, mibuɔ akɛ eja akɛ mikɛ kaimɔ ahɛle nyɛ shi.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ migbele lɛ baaba nɔŋŋ tãmɔ bɔ ni wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hu ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ.
Shi mabɔ he mɔdɛŋ koni mijeŋjee sɛɛ lɛ, nyehiɛ ahi nii nɛɛ be fɛɛ be.
Ejaakɛ jeee adesai ni aflɔ anɔ wɔdamɔ wɔjaje wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hewalɛ kɛ ebaa lɛ he asne wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, shi moŋ wɔji odasefoi ni na enumnyam kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ wɔhiŋmɛii.
Ejaakɛ ena woo kɛ anumnyam kɛjɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, be ni nakai gbee lɛ kɛ lɛ wie kɛjɛ anumyam kpeteŋkple lɛ mli akɛ, "Mɔnɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni mina ehe tsui lɛ."
Ni nɛkɛ gbee nɛɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu akɛ ŋwɛi ejɛ, be ni wɔ kɛ lɛ yɔɔ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

Ni ama gbalɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ mi ahã wɔ fe tsutsu lɛ, ni kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ no nɔ akɛ lá ni tsoɔ yɛ he ko ni woɔ duŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni je aaatsɛre ni tooloo lɛ aaate shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmiifee jogbaŋŋ.
Ni nyɛlea enɛ tsutsu akɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli gbalɛ fɛɛ gbalɛ lɛ jeee mɔ ko niiashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ gbalɛ ko moŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsire gbɔmɛi ni amɛwie wiemɔi ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã amɛ lɛ.
2: Shi amalegbalɔi hu te shi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, tãmɔ bɔ ni amaletsɔ̃ɔlɔi baaba nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ lɛ. Amɛkɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi aaaba nigii, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni kpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ po, amɛaakwa lɛ, ni amɛkɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni he yɔɔ oya aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ.
Ni mɛi pii aaanyiɛ amɛnyenyentswibɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛhewɔ lɛ aaawie anɔkwale gbɛ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔi.
Ni amɛkɛ hiɛjoomɔ kɛ shishiumɔ wiemɔi aaatao ni amɛna nyɛhe sɛɛ. Shi kojomɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ aaaba amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ wɔɔɔ!
Ejaakɛ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bɔfoi ni fee esha lɛ ahe ekeee amɛ, shi moŋ etsi amɛ ewo gbohiiaje bu kɛ emli duŋ lɛ mli, ni eŋɔ amɛ ehã akɛ akɛ amɛ ato ahã kojomɔ,
ni asaŋ kɛ ekɛ blema je lɛ he ekeee lɛ, shi moŋ Noa ni ji jalɛ shiɛlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni gbe yi fee kpaanyɔ lɛ kɛkɛ yi ebaa, ni ekɛ nu afua lɛ ba mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ aje lɛ nɔ,
ni kɛji sodom kɛ Gomora maji lɛ hu eshã ni ehã amɛtɔ̃ lamlu, ni ekɛ butumɔ kojo amɛ ekɛto mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ okadi,
ni kɛji ejie Lot, jalɔ, mɔ ni hao yɛ nɔ̃tɔ̃lɔi lɛ anyenyentswibɔɔ jeŋba lɛ he lɛ, yɛ mli
(ejaakɛ amɛmlatɔ̃mɔ nitsumɔi lɛ ni jalɔ lɛ na ni enu be ni eyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ piŋ esusuma ni ja lɛ daa gbi) lɛ,
belɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le bɔ ni efeɔ ejieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi yɛ kaa mli, kɛ bɔ ni efeɔ etoɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji yɛ piŋmɔ mli kɛyashi kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ;
shi titri lɛ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo akɔnɔ ni yɔɔ muji sɛɛ, ni amɛbuuu nɔyeli hewalɛ lɛ, tsuisalɔi kɛ yibulɔi ni kɛji amɛmiiye gbɔmɛi agboi ahe osheku ni amŋɛhe kpokpooo;
tsɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete ni yɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ babaoo fe amɛ lɛ, amɛ po amɛwieee amɛhe efɔŋ kɛkojooo amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tamɔ kooloi ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni afɔ amɛ ahã mɔmɔ kɛ gbee lɛ, amɛwieɔ nii ni amɛleee he nɔ ko lɛ he efɔŋ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ aaakpãtãa amɛhiɛ,

ni aaafee amɛ efɔŋ akɛ efɔŋ ni amɛfee mɛi krokomɛi lɛ he nyɔmɔwo. Amɛbuɔ shwane fiŋtiŋŋ ahoshwibɔɔ akɛ nii ni ŋɔɔ; mujiatsɛmɛi ni he yɔɔ taŋ ni; amɛmii shɛɔ yɛ amɛshishimɔi lɛ ahe be ni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeɔ nii lɛ.
Amɛyɛ hiɛmɛii ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gblãfitemɔ ni kpaaa eshafeemɔ. Amɛlakaa susumai ni nane mɔko shi lɛ. Amɛyɛ tsui ni he esa kɛ hiɛjoomɔ; loomɔbii ni.
Amɛje gbɛ ni ja lɛ nɔ, ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛyanyiɛ Beor bi Bileam, mɔ ni sumɔ nɔshafeemɔ mli nyɔmɔwo lɛ, gbɛ lɛ nɔ;
shi akã ehiɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emlatɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ, teji ni leee wiemɔ lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔ gbee wie, ni etsī gbalɔ lɛ kwashiafeemɔ lɛ naa.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji nubui ni nu bɛ mli, atatui ni ahum loɔ kɛyaa, mɛi ni akɛ duŋ kpii lɛ eto ehã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ akɛni naafuu wiemɔi wuji jeɔ amɛna hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ heloo akɔnɔi anɔ amɛkɛ nyenyeŋtswibɔɔ lakaa mɛi ni je mɛi ni baa amɛjeŋ yɛ shishiumɔ mli lɛ adɛŋ etsɛko lɛ;
amɛwoɔ amɛ shi akɛ amɛaaye amɛhe, tsɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ fitemɔ nyɔ̃ji ji amɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni aye enɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyɔŋ ehã mɔ ni ye enɔ lɛ.

Ejaakɛ kɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo he nilee lɛ nɔ amɛjo je nɛɛ mli mujinii lɛ anaa foi ni asaa adu amɛ yɛ nomɛi amli ni aye amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛnaagbee shihilɛ etsɔ̃ efɔŋ fe amɛtsutsu shishilɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ faŋ nɔ ni amɛle ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpale kɛjɛ kitã Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ lɛ he.
Shi anɔkwa abɛ lɛ eba mli yɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Gbee kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshwee he, ni kplotoo ni aju ehe lɛ yakokloɔ ŋmɔtɔ mli."
3: Agbɛnɛ, suɔmɔmɛi, enɛ ji wolo ni ji enyɔ ni miŋmaa nyɛ, ni fɛɛ mli lɛ makai nyɛ ni mikɛhɛle nyɛjwɛŋmɔ krɔŋŋ lɛ shi
ni nyɛkai gbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ a awiemɔi ni amɛwie sa kɛ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ kitã ni bɔfoi ni atsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛle enɛ, akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ hefɛoyelɔi aaaba kɛ hefɛoyeli, ni amɛaanyiɛ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi anaa,
ni amɛaakɛɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ ebaa lɛ he shiwoo lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni tsɛmɛi lɛ tee yawɔwɔi nɛɛ, bɔ ni nibii fɛɛ yɔɔ kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ shishijee mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛyɔɔ nɛɛ."
Kwa amɛkwaa amɛjieɔ amɛhiɛ yɛ enɛ nɔ akɛ ŋwɛi yɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe, ni shikpɔŋ hu jɛ nu mli, ni etsɔ̃ nu mli ebamɔ shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ naa;
no nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ni nu ŋɔ je ni yɔɔ no be lɛ mli lɛ ni ehiɛ kpãtã lɛ.
Shi ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ, nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ etɔ̃ ekɛ amɛ to hã là kɛyashi kojomɔ gbi lɛ ni aaakpãtã mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
Shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa sane kome nɛɛ nɔ, akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, gbi kome tamɔ afii akpe, ni afii akpe hu tamɔ gbi kome.
Jeee tsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hãa eshiwoo lɛ sɛɛ tsɛɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi komɛi susuɔ akɛ esɛɛ etsɛ lɛ, shi moŋ etsui shi etoɔ ehãa wɔ, ejaakɛ esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi alaaje, shi moŋ akɛ mɛi fɛɛ atsake amɛtsui.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ baaba tamɔ julɔ, ni no mli lɛ ŋwɛi lɛ aaaho aya kɛ gbɛɛmɔ, ni je nɛɛ mli shishijeenii lɛ aaashã ni amɛaatsere, ni shikpɔŋ kɛ emli nii lɛ aaashã.
Agbɛnɛ, akɛni nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ baafite hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛ gbɔmɛi sa akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ yɛ jeŋba krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Nyŋɔmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli?
Be mli ni nyɛkewɛɔ gbɛ ni nyɛshweɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Gbi lɛ baa lɛ, nɔ mli ni ŋwɛi aaahere kɛ là ni eeetsere, ni jeŋ shishijeenii hu aaasere yɛ lá mli lɛ!
Shi yɛ eshiwoo lɛ naa lɛ, wɔmiikwɛ ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee ni jalɛ mli lɛ ggbɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, suɔmɔmɛi, akɛni nyɛkwɛɔ nii nɛɛ agbɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ koni ana nyɛ ni muji loo kpa ko bɛ nyɛhe yɛ ehiɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli;
ni nyɛbua wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuishitoo lɛ akɛ yiwalaheremɔ,tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔsuɔmɔ nyɛmi Paulo lɛ hu ŋma nyɛ, yɛ nilee ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ naa lɛ,

tamɔ bɔ ni ewieɔ enɛɛmɛi ahe yɛ ewoji lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ. Woji nɛɛ amli nibii komɛi yɛ ni amɛshishinamɔ wa, ni mɛi ni ekaseko nɔ ko lɛ kɛ mɛi ni nane mɔko shi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ shishi ekroko, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfeɔ ŋmalɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛkpãtãa amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ suɔmɔmɛi,akɛni nyɛ lɛ nyɛle momosa hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsraa, koni akɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji alakamɔ sane lɛ akashãtã nyɛ hu, ni nyɛjɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshifimɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi
Shi nyɛshwerea yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ kɛ nilee lɛ mli. Lɛ nɔŋŋ aŋɔ anumnyam ahã agbɛnɛ kɛ daa. Amen!

1: Saul gbele sɛɛ be ni David ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ ta ni efã kɛyaplene Amalekbii lɛ eba lɛ, ebahi shi gbii enyɔ yɛ Ziklag.
Ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Saul tabilɔ lɛ eko kɛ ehe atade ni etserɛ kɛ eyiteŋ hu mlu ba David ŋɔɔ kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa. Be ni nuu lɛ shɛ David hiɛ lɛ eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto David.
David bi nuu akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛɛ?" Nuu lɛ to he akɛ, "Israel nsra lɛ mli mijo foi kɛjɛ kɛbaa nɛɛ."
David saa ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, "Tenibii amli tamɔ tɛŋŋ? Gbaa mi. "Nuu lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Wɔtabilɔi lɛ ejo foi yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ; agboi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan fɛɛ enyɔnyɔi."
David bi oblanyo lɛ ni gbaa lɛ sane lɛ akɛ, "Te ofee teŋŋ ole akɛ Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan egboi hu?"
Oblanyo lɛ hã David hetoo ni ekɛɛ, "Heniianaa ni miyaje Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni miyanina Saul ni ebu ekplɔ lɛ nɔ, be mli ni henyɛlɔi lɛ ashwiilii lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ miibɛŋkɛ lɛ waa lɛ.
Be ni Saul fo ehe ekwɛ esɛɛ ni ena mi lɛ, etsɛ mi; ni mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Ofai nɛ, naa mi.'
Ebi mi akɛ, 'Bo namɔ ni?' Mijie naa akɛ, 'Ofai nɛ, Amaleknyo ji mi.'
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Tsi oba ni obagbe mi, ejaakɛ ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi, tsɛ wala fioo yɛ mimli.

No hewɔ lɛ mitsi mibɛŋkɛ lɛ, ni migbe lɛ, ejaakɛ mina akɛ eshigbeemɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ eyi naŋ wala. No sɛɛ lɛ mijie maŋtsɛ akekre ni fi eyitso lɛ kɛ ga ni ewo yɛ ekɔŋ lɛ, ni mikɛba mikɛbaahã bo, minuŋtsɔ nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni David mɔ ehe atade lɛ mli, ni egbla lɛ yɛ ewerɛ sɔŋŋ ni eho ehe naa. Mɛi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ hu fee nakai,
ni amɛ ye ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛwo yara, ni amɛfo, ni amɛhi ŋmaa kɛyashi gbɛkɛ yɛ Saul Kɛ ebi Yonatan kɛ Yehowa maŋbii ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ ahewɔ.
David bi oblanyo lɛ ni gbaa lɛ sane lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ nyo ji bo?" Oblanyo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Gbɔ ni ji Amaleknyo ko bi ji mi."
Kɛkɛ ni David bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ ni osheee gbeyei, shi onyɛ owo onine nɔ, ni okɛkpãtã mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ hiɛ nɛɛ?"
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ oblahiibii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ekɛɛ, "Tswaa lɛ nɔ ni ogbe lɛ."
Ni etswa oblanyo lɛ nɔ, ni egbo. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ, "Oyi sɔ̃ atere bo diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ onaabu eye odase eshi bo, ejaakɛ okɛɛ, 'Migbe mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ lala nɛɛ fo Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan,
ni efã akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ Yudabii lɛ lala nɛɛ. (Aŋmã lala nɛɛ yɛ Yashar Wolo lɛ mli).
"Ao Israel, onumnyam lɛ ehiɛ akpãtã yɛ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ nɛɛ. Te aye tɛŋŋ ni kãkãlɔi enyɔnyɔi nɛɛ?
Nyɛkayagbaa enɛ yɛ Gat; akatsi enɛ tã yɛ Ashkelon blohuiaŋ koni Filistibii lɛ abiyei lɛ akanya, ni foolɔi lɛ abiyei lɛ miitumɔ.
"Nyɛ Gilboa gɔji, bɔ loo nu akanɛ nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛnɔ ŋmɔji aŋla. Ejaakɛ jɛi abule kãkãlɔi lɛ atsɛŋi lɛ yɛ, kɛ Saul tsɛŋ lɛ po, ejaakɛ afɔŋ he mu dɔŋŋ.
Mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi lɛ ala lɛ kɛ kãkãlɔi lɛ hu afɔ lɛ Yonatan gãi lɛ ekuuu esɛɛ eflo kɛjɛɛɛ he; ni Saul klaŋte lɛ hu gbe henyɛlɔi lɛ.
"Asumɔ Saul kɛ Yonatan amɛwala be mli, ni amɛhe yɛ fɛo. Amɛgbele mli tete, amɛmli gblaaa; amɛhe yɛ oya fe okropɔŋ po, ni amɛhe wa hu fe jata.
"Nyɛ Israel biyei, nyɛfoa Saul, mɔ ni bumɔ nyɛ mama tsuji fɛɛfɛji, ni ehã nyɛ shika jwinei nyɛshwie nyɛtadei anɔ lɛ.
"Te aye tɛŋŋ ni kãkãlɔi enyɔnyɔi yɛ ta teŋ tuuŋtu nɛɛ hu? Agbe Yonatan yɛ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.
"Osane miidɔ mi, minyɛmi Yonatan; osane eŋɔɔ minaa kɛho. Osuɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ efe yei asuɔmɔ tete.
"Te aye tɛŋŋ ni kãkãlɔi enyɔnyɔi ni tawunii hu ahiɛ ekpãtã nɛɛ?"
2: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David yabi Yehowa nii akɛ, "Ani miya ni miyaŋɔ Yuda maji lɛ eko lo?" Yehowa hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Yaa!" David bi akɛ, "Mɛɛ maŋ nɔ miya?" Yehowa to he akɛ, "Yaa Hebron."
No hewɔ lɛ David yiŋ kɛtee Hebron, lɛ kɛ eŋamɛi enyɔ lɛ, Ahinoam, Yezreelyoo lɛ, kɛ Abigail ni ji Nabal Karmelnyo lɛ okulafo lɛ.
David kɛ hii tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ hu tee, ni amɛyahi Hebron maji lɛ amli.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yuda hii lɛ ba Hebron amɛbafɔ David mu kɛwo lɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ. Be ni agba David akɛ Yabesh Gileadbii lɛ ji mɛi ni fu Saul gbonyo lɛ,
David tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ayakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛfu nyɛnuŋtsɔ Saul nyɛkɛfee lɛ ejurɔ nɛkɛ.
Yehowa asumɔ nyɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni bɛ naagbee, ni eye nyɛ anɔkwa; ni mi hu mafee nyɛ ejurɔ mato najiaŋ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee nɛɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛwajea nyɛhe, ni nyɛfea ekãa, ejaakɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ Saul egbo, ni Yuda akutso lɛ ebafɔ mi mu kɛwo mi amɛmaŋtsɛ."
Saul tatsɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, mɔ Saul bi Ishboshet kɛjo foi kɛtee Mahaniam,
ni jɛi eyawo lɛ Gilead kɛ Ashur kɛ Yezreel kɛ Efraim kɛ Benyamin kɛ Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ.
Saul bi Ishboshet eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ. Yuda akutso lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ nyiɛ David sɛɛ.
David ye Yuda maŋtsɛ yɛ Hebron afii kpawo kɛ nyɔji ekpaa.
Abner, Ner bi lɛ, kɛ Saul bi Ishboshet tsuji lɛ jɛ Mahanaim ni amɛba Gibeon.
Yoab, Zeruia bi lɛ, hu kɛ David tsuji lɛ fã, ni amɛkɛ Ishboshet tsuji lɛ yakpe yɛ Gibeon kpaakpo lɛ naa. Mɛnɛɛmɛi bua kpaakpo lɛ he afã kome nɛɛ, ni Mɛnɛɛmɛi hu bua kpaakpo lɛ he afã kome nɛɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni Abner kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, Agbenɛ ha oblahii lɛ aba amɛbaka amɛ kpɔiaŋ yɛ wɔhiɛ," Yoab here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, amɛmiiba."
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ jɛ Benyaminbii, ni ji Saul bi Ishboshet sɛɛbii, lɛ ateŋ ni amɛ kɛ David tabilɔi lɛ hu ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yaka amɛkpɔiaŋ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mɔ ehenyɛlɔ yitso, ni edu ehenyɛlɔ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kakla, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛyashwie shi, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi shi kome. No hewɔ lɛ atsɛɔ Gibeon kpɔ nɛɛ mli he ni sane nɛɛ ba yɛ lɛ akɛ "Kakla ŋanɔ."
Ta ni awu gbi lɛ mli yawa naakpa, ni David tsuji lɛ wo Abner kɛ Israelbii lɛ foi.
Zeruia bihii etɛ̃, Yoab kɛ Abishai kɛ Asahel, yɛ ta lɛ naa gbi lɛ. Ni Asahel,amɛteŋ mɔ ni joɔ foi tamɔ ŋanɔ soŋai lɛ,
klɔ foi eshwie Abner sɛɛ, ni ejeee Abner sɛɛ egbaaa ninejurɔgbɛ loo abɛkugbɛ.
Abner kwɛ esɛɛ kɛkɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, 'Kwɛ, Ashel, bo ni?" Asahel here nɔ akɛ, "Hɛɛ! Mi ni."
Abner kɛɛ Asahel akɛ, "Gba oninejurɔ gbɛ! Loo obɛkugbɛ koni omɔ oblahiibii lɛ moŋ eko koni oshɔ̃ etawuunii yɛ edɛŋ. "Shi Asahel ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ ekpale yɛ Abner sɛɛ.
Abner ku sɛɛ ekɛɛ Asahel akɛ, "Kpalemɔ ni oku osɛɛ ni oya. Mɛɛba ni obaahã minine akpa yɛ onɔ nɛɛ? Te mafee tɛŋŋ mawo mihiɛ nɔ yɛ onyɛmi Yoab hiɛ hu kɛji eeeba lɛ nakai lɛ?"

Shi Asahel emiii akɛ ejeɔ Abner sɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Abner kɛ ekplɔ lɛ shishi gbu Asahel musu, ni akplɔ lɛ yafã kpo yɛ Asahel sɛɛ, kɛkɛ ni Asahel gbee shi, ni egbo yɛ enajiaŋ nɔŋŋ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni bashɛɔ he ni Asahel gbonyo lɛ kã lɛ waa damɔɔ shi.
Shi Yoab kɛ Abishai nyiɛ Abner sɛɛ aahuu kɛyashi amɛyashɛ Ama Gɔŋkpɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Gia bokãgbɛ, yɛ Gibeon ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ lɛ he; kɛkɛ ni hulu nyɔ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ bua amɛhe naa akɛ asafo ku, ni amɛbafata Abner he, ni amɛyadamɔ gɔŋ ko yiteŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni Abner bo etsɛ Yoab, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aso nɛkɛ sɔŋŋ wɔɔhã klaŋte aye awui lo? Oleee akɛ kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ joomɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni baaba lo? Mɛɛ be nɔŋŋ omɛɔ dani ofã owebii lɛ koni amɛfɔ̃ɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ?"
Yoab hã Abner hetoo ekɛɛ, "Mina Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ kɛjeee wiemɔ ni owie nɛɛ hewɔ ni kulɛ ja wɔ leebi dani miwebii lɛ baafɔ̃ɔ amɛyɛmimɛi lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab hã akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni ewebii lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ, ni asaŋ amɛkpa amɛ kɛ ta lɛ wuu.
Abner kɛ ewebii lɛ nyiɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ kɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛyafo Yordan lɛ, ni amɛtsa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ leebi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛba Mahanaim.
Be ni Yoab ekpa Abner kɛ ewebii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ, ni ebua ewebii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ, ni ebua ewebii lɛ anaa lɛ, ena akɛ eshwɛ Asahel kɛ David webii lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu.
Shi David tsuji lɛ gbe Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Amɛwo Asahel gbonyo lɛ, ni amɛyato lɛ yɛ ewekumɛi afuuhe ni yɔɔ Betlehem lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ Yoab kɛ ewebii lɛ tsa nɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni be ni je kɛɛ etsɛreɔ wɛlɛŋŋ lɛ amɛyashɛ Hebron.
3: Saul we lɛ kɛ David we lɛ wu ta be babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. David hewalɛ tee nɔ shwere; shi Saul we lɛ gbɔjɔmɔ moŋ etee nɔ egbɔjɔ.
David fɔ bihii ekpaa yɛ Hebron. Kromɔbi lɛ ji Amnon, mɔ ni ekɛ Ahinoam, Yezreelyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ.
Binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Kileab, mɔ ni ekɛ Abigail Karmelnyo Nabal okulafo lɛ fɔ lɛ. Binuu ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Absalom mɔ ni ekɛ Geshar Maŋtsɛ Talmai biyoo Maaka fɔ lɛ.
Binuu ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Adonia, mɔ ni ekɛ Hagit fɔ lɛ; binuu ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Shefatia, mɔ ni ekɛ Abital fɔ lɛ;
ni binuu ni ji ekpaa lɛ ji Itream, mɔ ni ekɛ Egla fɔ lɛ. Bihii ni David fɔ yɛ Hebron lɛ nɛ.
Be ni Saul we lɛ kɛ David we lɛ wuɔ ta lɛ, Abner bana hewalɛ yɛ Saul we lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Saul yɛ hemɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Rizpa, ni atsɛɔ etsɛ Aia. Gbi ko lɛ Ishboshet bi Abner sane yɛ Rizpa nɛɛ he ekɛɛ,"Mɛɛba ni oyata mitsɛ hemɔ lɛ he lɛ?

Kɛkɛ ni Abner mli fu naakpa yɛ sane ni Ishboshet bi lɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ Ishboshet akɛ, "Te osusuɔ yɛ mihe tɛŋŋ nɛɛ? Akɛ miyɛ Yuda sɛɛ? Mi ni misɔmɔ otsɛ Saul we lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi kɛ enanemɛi fɛɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni miŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ ni David anyɛ nyɛnɔ kunim eye lɛ, sane ni ofoɔ oŋmɛɔ minɔ yɛ yoo hewɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɛ?
Ojogbaŋŋ! Mi Abner, Nyɔŋmɔ agbe, ni esaa egbe mi ekoŋŋ kɛji mihãaa shi Yehowa wo David lɛ aba mli fii,
akɛ ebaahe maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Saul we lɛ dɛŋ, ni ebaahã David maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahe shi akɛ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Dan aahuu kɛyashwie Beersheba."
Ishboshet nyɛɛɛ he eko eto dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ eeshe Abner gbeyei.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abner tsu bɔfoi kɛtee David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron kɛ shɛɛ akɛ, "Namɔ osusuɔ akɛ ebaaye shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ? Hã ni wɔkpãŋ wɔfee ekome, ni magbla Israel fɛɛ mibawo oshishi."
David hã shɛɛ lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, mi kɛ bo baakpãŋ; shi ja otsu nɔ kome nɛɛ dã: ni no ji akɛ kɛji ooba obana mi lɛ, okɛ Saul biyoo Mikal lɛ aba, kɛjeee nakai lɛ onaŋ mihiɛ."
David saa je gbɛ etsu bɔfoi kɛtee Saul bi Ishboshet ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ akɛ, "Miitao miŋa Mikal, mɔ ni mikɛ Filistibii afoonaa loi oha hã esɛɛnii lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Ishboshet tsu ni ayakpla Mikal yɛ ewu Paltiel, Laish bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ.
Ni Mikal wu lɛ fo Kɛnyiɛ Mikal sɛɛ aahuu kɛyashɛ Bahurim. Be ni eyashɛ jɛi lɛ Abner kɛɛ Paltiel akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ ni oya!" Kɛkɛ ni eku esɛɛ ni etee.
Kɛkɛ ni Abner kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ tee ajina, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Be nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ kulɛ nyɛmiitao David ni eye nyɛmaŋtsɛ?
Be lɛ eshɛ nɛɛ; nyɛtsua he nii ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo shi yɛ David he akɛ, 'Mitsulɔ David nine nɔ matsɔ̃ mahere mimaŋ Israel yiwala yɛ Filistibii kɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ adɛŋ.'"
Abner kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ hu yawie; ni no sɛɛ lɛ eŋɔ shwie nɔ, ni etee eyabɔ David amaniɛ, yɛ Hebron, nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ eto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbafee lɛ.
Be ni Abner bashɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron lɛ, David ŋmɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni fata ehe kɛba lɛ fɛɛ okplɔ̃.

Abner kɛɛ David akɛ, "Mibaya agbɛnɛ koni mayabua Israel fɛɛ naa mahã minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, koni amɛ kɛ bo abakpãŋ kɛfee ekome, koni oye amɛmaŋtsɛ bɔ ni oshweɔ lɛ. "Kɛkɛ ni David jie Abner gbɛ, ni eshi etee shweshweeshwe.
Shi be fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ Yoab kɛ David tsuji lɛ jɛ ojoyeli amɛba kɛ nibii babaoo ni amɛyaha. No mli lɛ Abner bɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ejaakɛ David ejie lɛ gbɛ eshi etee shweshweeshwe.
Be ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi ni kɛ lɛ tee lɛ fɛɛ ebato shi sɛɛ lɛ, agba Yoab akɛ, "Ner bi Abner ba maŋtsɛ ŋɔɔ, ni maŋtsɛ eŋmɛɛ ehe, ni etee shweshweeshwe."
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ, mɛni ofee nɛɛ? Abner ba biɛ ni oŋmɛɛ ehe ni etee?
Ole Ner bi Abner oto? Eba bo lakamɔ kɛkɛ koni ele oyaa kɛ obaa mli, asaŋ ni ele onibii amli hu."
Be ni Yoab shi David eba sɛɛ lɛ, eyatsu bɔfoi koni amɛtiu Abner ni amɛyatsɛ eyisɛɛ amɛhã lɛ. Bɔfoi lɛ yanina Abner yɛ Siria nubu lɛ he, ni amɛ kɛ lɛ ku sɛɛ kɛba. Shi enɛ fɛɛ lɛ David leee he nɔ ko.

Be ni Abner ku esɛɛ ebashɛ Hebron lɛ, Yoab tsɛ lɛ kɛtee afãgbɛ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi akɛ ekɛ lɛ yaato ajina. Kɛkɛ ni Yoab du Abner musuŋ kakla ni enyɔ yɛ enajiaŋ, ni Yoab kɛtɔ enyɛminuu Asahel lá lɛ he owele.
Be ni fee sɛɛ ni David nu nɔ ni eba lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mi kɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, wɔyeee Ner bi Abner lá yi sɔ̃ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Elá lɛ abua Yoab kɛ etsɛ we lɛ yiteŋ, ni mɔ ni he hoɔ lá loo kpitiyelɔ loo mɔ ni ekumɔ ni ja ehiɛ tso dani ehiɔ lɛ nyiɛmɔ, loo mɔ ni gboɔ klaŋte naa gbele loo hɔmɔwɔlɔ akakpa yɛ Yoab sateŋ."
Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ Yoab kɛ enyɛmi Abishai tsɔ ni amɛgbe Abner ejaakɛ egbe amɛnyɛminuu Asahel yɛ Gibeon ta lɛ mli.
David fã Yoab kɛ ewebii lɛ fɛɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛgblaa nyɛhe atadei, ni nyɛbuaa kpekpe nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa. "Maŋtsɛ David nyiɛ Abner gbonyo adeka lɛ sɛɛ.
Ato Abner yɛ Hebron. Be ni ayɔɔ gbonyobu lɛ naa lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David fo Abner, ni ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu wo yara amɛfo.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ lala fo Abner, ni ekɛɛ, "Esa akɛ Abner anyɔ tamɔ yakagbɔmɔ nyɔɔ lo?
Afimɔko oniji lɛ, awoko onaji gboklɛ hu. Bɔ ni mɛi nyɔɔ yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ lɛ nakai onyɔ nɛɛ. "Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lɛ saa wo yara ni amɛfo Abner aahuu.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ maŋ muu fɛɛ tutɔ David gbi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ eye nii, shi Maŋtsɛ David kã kitã ekɛɛ, "Kɛji misa minaa aboloo loo nɔ ko dani hulu nyɔ shi fīī, Nyɔŋmɔ awo mi nyɔŋmɔ."
Maŋ lɛ yoo nɔ ni David fee lɛ sɛɛ, ni esa amɛhiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ saa amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Enɛ hã maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israel hu fɛɛ na le akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ nine bɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, gbele lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛleee akɛ lumɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ wulu ko enyɔ ŋmɛnɛ yɛ Israel lo?
Afɔ mi mu awo mi Israel Maŋtsɛ moŋ nɛ, shi amrɔ nɛɛ nɛkɛ Zeruia bihii nɛɛ asane lɛ ebaje mi ablaŋ, ni ehii mi nɔ ko feemɔ. Yehowa awo efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ yɛ enɔfɔŋ lɛ naa!"
4: Be ni Saul bi Ishboshet nu akɛ Abner egbo yɛ Hebron lɛ, enijiaŋ je wui; ni Israel muu fɛɛ hu fee yɔɔ.

Ishboshet yɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi enyɔ komɛi ni amɛ kɛ mɛi yaa amɛyayeɔ ofɔ̃ kɛbaa. Mɔ kome gbɛi ji Baana, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Rekab. Amɛtsɛ ji Rimon, Benyaminnyo ni jɛ Beerot lɛ (ejaakɛ abuɔ Beerot hu ashiɔ Benyaminbii amaji lɛ anɔ;
shi Beerot lɛ ejo foi kɛtee Gitaim, ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.)

Saul binuu Yonatan yɛ binuu ni enaji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ eje kpa. Gbekɛ nuu nɛɛ eye afii enumɔ be ni Saul kɛ Yonatan gbele lɛ he sane lɛ bashɛ Yezreel. Kɛkɛ ni oblanyo ni kwɛɔ gbekɛ lɛ wo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ jo foi. Shi be ni oblanyo lɛ yeɔ oyai kɛjoɔ foi lɛ gbekɛ nuu nɛɛ gbee shi, ni enaji kumɔ. Gbekɛnuu nɛɛ gbɛi ji Mefiboshet.
Rekab kɛ Baana, ni ji Beerotnyo Rimon bihii lɛ, yi mli kɛtee Ishboshet we lɛ. Amɛshɛ jɛi shwane fintiŋŋ be mli ni Ishboshet kã shi ewɔɔ eshwane wɔ lɛ.
Yoo ni buɔ shīa lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ miishaŋmãa mli nɔŋŋ, ni wɔ sha lɛ, ni ewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ Rekab kɛ enyɛminuu Baana shra ehe kɛbote shīa lɛ mli.
Amɛyanina Ishboshet ni ekã esaa nɔ yɛ epia lɛ mli ewɔ; kɛkɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ, ni amɛfo eyotso. Amɛkɔ Ishboshet yitso lɛ; ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ,
ni amɛkɛba David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron. Amɛbakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Ohenyɛlɔ Saul ni tao bo egbe lɛ, ebi Ishboshet lɛ yitso nɛ. Yehowa etɔ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ he owele ŋmɛnɛ yɛ Saul kɛ eshwiei anɔ."
Shi hetoo ni David hã Rekab kɛ enyɛminuu Baana, ni ji Beerotnyo Rimon bihii lɛ, ji "Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni ebaa miyi yɛ fimɔi fɛɛ amli lɛ,
be ni mɔ ko ba ebagba mi akɛ'Naa, Saul egbo, 'ni eyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ eba ebagba mi sane kpakpa ko lɛ, mimɔ lɛ, ni migbe lɛ yɛ Ziklag, ni mikɛ no wo lɛ nyɔŋmɔ.
Enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni kɛji gbɔmɛi fɔɔji etee amɛyagbe jalɔ yɛ wɔ mli, yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshīa teŋ, ni mibiŋ elá shi yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ni mikpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ?"

Kɛkɛ ni David fã eblahii lɛ, ni amɛgbe Rekab kɛ Baana, ni amɛflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji, ni amɛkɛtsotsro kpaakpo ni yɔɔ Hebron lɛ masɛi. Ni amɛkɔ Ishboshet yitso lɛ, ni amɛyafu yɛ he ni afu Abner yɛ lɛ, yɛ Hebron.
5: Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ba David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, wɔ kɛ bo jɛ lá kome.
Nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ be ni Saul yeɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ, boji tatsɛ ni nyiɛ Israelbii ahiɛ kɛtee kɛba, asaŋ Yehowa wo bo shi akɛ 'Bo oootsɔ̃ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ amɛlumɔ.'"
Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ; kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ David mu, ni amɛwo lɛ Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.
Be ni David bɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Eye Yuda kɔkrɔɔ maŋtsɛ afii kpawo kɛ nyɔji ekpaa, ni eye Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem.

Maŋtsɛ David kɛ ewebii lɛ fã ta kɛyanina Yebusbii ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ yɛ Yerusalem. Yebusbii nɛɛ asusumɔ ji akɛ David nyɛŋ maŋ lɛ eshɔ̃, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛtswa David mpoa akɛ, "Onyɛŋ biɛ oba; shwilafoi kɛ akpakei sɔŋŋ baashwie bo."
Shi David na eshɔ̃ Zion Mɔɔ lɛ kɛ̃, ni ewo jɛi gbɛi David Maŋ agbɛnɛ.

David kɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Namɔ yɔɔ biɛ ni etaooo Yebusbii lɛ asane tamɔ bɔ ni mi, David, minyɛɔ amɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ ena ni etswia amɛ nii? Mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ nujɔɔ lɛ mli koni eyatswia shwilafoi lɛ kɛ akpakei lɛ nii ni egbe amɛ. "Sane nɛɛ hewɔ akɛɔ akɛ, "Shwilafoi kɛ akpakei baaa Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ."
David kɛ Zion fee eshihilɛhe, ni ewo jɛi gbɛi akɛ David Maŋ. Esaa etswa maŋ lɛ ehee, kɛjɛ Milo lɛ he kɛba mli gbɛ ekɛbabɔle mɔɔ lɛ he kpula kɛkpe.
David hewalɛ tee nɔ eshwere ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, fī esɛɛ.
Tiro maŋtsɛ Hiram wo kapintɛfoi kɛ tɛ gbogbotswalɔi agbɛ, ni amɛkɛ tsenedru tsei ba, ni amɛkɛbama maŋtsɛ we amɛhã David.
David na akɛ Yehowa ewo emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ gojoo yɛ Yehowa maŋ Israel lɛ hewɔ.
Be ni David efã kɛjɛ Hebron kɛba Yerusalem sɛɛ lɛ, esaa eŋɔ hemɛi, ni ekpeekpee yei efata eŋamɛi lɛ ahe, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei efata ebii krokomɛi lɛ ahe.
Bii ni David fɔ yɛ Yerusalem ji Shamua kɛ Shobab kɛ Natan kɛ Solomon
kɛ Ibhar kɛ Elishua kɛ Nefeg kɛ Yafia,
kɛ Elishama kɛ Eliada kɛ Elifelet.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu akɛ awo David Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, Filistibii fɛɛ fã ta akɛ amɛyaamɔ David. Shi David nu he, ni no hewɔ lɛ etee ehe yɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Filistibii lɛ ba, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛha jɛi fɛɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni David yabi Yehowa nii ekɛɛ, "Ani mifã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ lo? Ooohã mayɛ amɛnɔ kunim lo?" Yehowa here David nɔ akɛ, "Fãa ta okɛyanina amɛ, ejaakɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mahã oye amɛnɔ kunim."

No hewɔ lɛ David fã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ yɛ Baal-Perazim, (eshishi ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni gbaa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ mli) ni eye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ jɛi. David kɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa etsɔ̃ minine nɔ egba mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ tamɔ nu ni eje ŋa gbaa lɛ. "No hewɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Baal-Perazim lɛ.
Filistibii lɛ shi amɛmãgãi lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛjo foi, ni David kɛ ewebii lɛ loo amãgãi lɛ kɛtee.
Shi Filistibii lɛ fã ta kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Efraim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni David tee eyabi Yehowa nii lɛ, hetoo ni ehã lɛ ji akɛ, "Kaafã ta lɛ kɛyatua amɛ kɛjɛ biɛ, shi lɔgɔmɔ kɛyaje amɛsɛɛgbɛ, koni ojɛ Balsam tsei lɛ aŋlɛnɔ obatua amɛ.
Kɛ onu gbɛɛmɔ yɛ Balsam tsei lɛ ayiteŋ tamɔ naneshi gbɛɛmɔ lɛ, ohe afee oya ni otua amɛ, ejaakɛ no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miyi ohiɛ miyatswia Filistibii lɛ atabilɔi lɛ anii."
David fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ, ni egbe Filistibii lɛ, ni eshwie amɛ kɛjɛ Geba aahuu kɛyashwie Gezer.
6: David bua Israel bii kãkãlɔi fɛɛ anaa kɛkpe ekoŋŋ. Ena gbɔmɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Baala maŋ lɛ mli yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ. Akɛ Yehowa Ofe ni elumɔyeli sɛ̃i lɛ ma kerubii lɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛi ewo adeka lɛ.
Amɛyawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Abinadab we lɛ ni yɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛma shwiili hee ko nɔ. Abinadab bihii, Uza kɛ Ahio, kudɔ shwiili hee ni adeka lɛ ma nɔ lɛ.
Ni Ahio nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
David kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nya kɛ lalai kɛ saŋkui kɛ obentai kɛ fabii kɛ miji kɛ ŋoŋoi amɛkɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ.
Be ni ashɛ Nakon ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ, tsinai lɛ tɛ ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kpa ni eyaagbee shi. No hewɔ lɛ Uza kpã enine mli ni ekɛmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.
Yehowa mli wo Uza la, ni etswa lɛ nɔ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ enine ni ekɛta Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he lɛ hewɔ, ni Uza gbo yɛ enajiaŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ atsɛ jɛi Perez-Uza kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Sane lɛ dɔ David akɛ Yehowa kɛ Uza ye kɛ joomɔ nakai.
David she Yehowa gbeyei nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Te mafee tɛŋŋ mato Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hu?"
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ David sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yaa Yerusalem. No hewɔ lɛ David wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛgba afã kɛtee Obed-Edom, Gitnyo lɛ, we lɛ.
Ato Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Obed-Edom, Gitnyo lɛ, we lɛ mli nyɔji etɛ̃, ni Yehowa jɔɔ Obed-Edom kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ.
Abagba Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Yehowa ejɔɔ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ. "No hewɔ lɛ David tee, ni eyawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛba Yerusalem kɛ nyamɔ.
Kɛji mɛi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ famɔ amɛnaji shii ekpaa lɛ, David gbeɔ tsina kɛ too ni ewo fɔ ekɛshãa afɔle.
David jo kɛ ehewalɛ fɛ ekɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam, ni emia kɛ klala efod pɛ.
Lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu fɛɛ kɛ oshebɔɔ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ yawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Be ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ shɛ Yerusalem lɛ, Mikal, Saul biyoo lɛ, bu samflɛ naa, ni ena Maŋtsɛ David ni eehulu ni eejo kɛmiiwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam, ni David he fee Mikal hiɛgble.
Ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ba, ni akɛyama gbɛhe ni ato ahã lɛ yɛ buu ni David eshi ehã lɛ lɛ mli. No sɛɛ lɛ David shã afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei ehã Yehowa.
Be ni David egbe shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ ashãa naa lɛ, ejɔɔ maŋbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa Ofe lɛ gbɛi mli,

ni eja maŋ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ji Israel asafo muu lɛ mli hii kɛ yei fɛɛ, niyenii. Ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ loo kukuli kome kɛ wainyibii ni aka ni egbi akwaabɔ kome. Ni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ mli, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.

Ni be ni David yiŋ etee ewe lɛ ni eyahã sɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Mikal, Saul biyoo lɛ, je kpo ekɛ lɛ bakpe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aso nyam pi Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ wo ehiɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ kɛ ehe bo ni ejie yɛ etsuji kɛ aweyei ahiɛ tamɔ mɛi ni ahiɛgble tɔ ejwa feɔ lɛ."

Shi David hã Mikal hetoo, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, Yehowa, mɔ ni shi otsɛ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ ni ebaŋɔ mi, ni ewo mi Israel, ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ lɛ, lɛ ehiɛ nyam mijo mikɛwo lɛ; ni majo ŋmɛnɛ, ni majo wɔ mikɛwo ehiɛ nyam.
Maya nɔ moŋ mawo mihe hiɛgble fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ bo ohiɛ; shi weyei lɛ ni otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, amɛ lɛ nyam moŋ mihiɛ aaaba yɛ amɛhiɛ."
Mikal, Saul biyoo lɛ, naaa bi kɛyashi egbo.
7: Be ni Maŋtsɛ David eyahi emɔɔ lɛ mli, ni Yehowa ehã ena hejɔlɛ yɛ ehenyɛlɔi ni bɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ,
etsɛ gbalɔ Natan ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɛ oona akɛ, mi lɛ, mina tsenedru tsu mli mikã be mli ni Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ buu mli?"
Natan hã Maŋtsɛ David hetoo akɛ. "Feemɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kã otsui nɔ akɛ ofee lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa fi osɛɛ."
Shi nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Natan akɛ,
"Yaa ni oyakɛɛ mitsulɔ David akɛ, 'Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: Bo omaa tsu ohãa mi mahi mli?
Kɛjɛ be nɔ ni miyakpla Israelbii yɛ Egipt aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, mihiko tsu mli dã, fe buu mli sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ miyɔɔ.
Hei fɛɛ ni mikɛ Israel fɛɛ enyiɛnyiɛ lɛ, mibiko Israel maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi ni mifãa amɛ akɛ amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko yɛ ko pɛŋ akɛ, mɛɛba po ni nyɛmako tsenedru tsu nyɛhãko mi lɛ?'
"No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ mitsulɔ David akɛ, mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Too okplaa, ni miŋɔ bo, ni mifee bo Israel nɔyelɔ,
ni he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ mifata ohe,miplenee ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni mihã ona gbɛi kpeteŋkple tamɔ gbɔmɛi wuji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ mato he ko mahã mimaŋ Isreal koni amɛyahi jɛi akɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ mli, he ni agbaŋ amɛnaa yɛ dɔŋŋ, ni yiwalɔi haoŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ tamɔ sa,
be ni mito hiɛnyiɛlɔi koni amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ. Ni mahã ohe ajɔ bo yɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ. Asaŋ mi, Yehowa, miiwo bo shi akɛ mibahã owo shwiei babaoo,
ni ogbele sɛɛ lɛ matee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ oshwiei lɛ amli akɛ maŋtsɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ.
Lɛji mɔ ni baama Sɔlemɔwe ehã mi; ni mahã emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.
Mibatsɔ̃ etsɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ mibi. Kɛji efee nɔ fɔŋ lɛ mibagbla etoi tamɔ bɔ ni tsɛ gblaa ebi toi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mimɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ efoŋ yɛ egbɛfaŋ tamɔ bɔ ni mihã mimɔbɔnalɛ lɛ sɛɛ fo yɛ Saul gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɔ ni mikpa lɛ ni obaye esɛɛ lɛ.
Mibahã owe lɛ kɛ omaŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ ama shi shiŋŋ daa kɛaatee naanɔ; omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ baama shi shiŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.'"
Natan gba David wiemɔi nɛɛ kɛ ninaa nɛɛ bɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David bote Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni eho eta shi, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, namɔ ji mi, ni mɛni mli miwe lɛ yɔɔ hewɔ ni ohiɛ mi kɛbashi be nɛ nɛɛ?
Ni kɛ̃lɛ enɛ jeee nɔ ko srɔto ko hã bo, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. Otsɔ̃ɔ wɔsɛɛ shɔŋŋ nibii ni baaba, mi otsulɔ, miwe lɛ nɔ hu. Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ mi shwiei ni mawo.
Mɛni po yɔɔ mi David minaa ni makɛɛ dɔŋŋ? Ejaakɛ bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ole mi, otsulɔ.
Shi ni owo lɛ, akɛ ni eji bo diɛŋtsɛ osuɔmɔnaa hewɔ lɛ, ofee nibii wuji nɛɛ fɛɛ koni okɛtsɛɔɔ mi, otsulɔ, nii.
Anɔkwa, oda kpeteŋkple, Ofe, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ bo yeee egbɔ, ni asaŋ yɛ nii fɛɛ ni wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi lɛ naa lɛ, osɛɛ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.

Mɛɛ maŋ kroko ko yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni etamɔ omaŋ Israel, ni ji maŋ ni bo Nyɔŋmɔ otee oyakpɔ̃ amɛ; ni ofee amɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owebii, ni okɛhe gbɛi, ni otsu nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ohã amɛ, akɛ ogbɛ maŋ muu kɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ oshwã yɛ amɛhiɛ?
Oma omaŋ Israel nɔ mi akɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni bo Yehowa otsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ.
"Agbɛnɛ, Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ, maa shi ni owo yɛ mi, otsulɔ, kɛ ewe lɛ he lɛ nɔ mi kɛya naanɔ; ofee nɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ,
ni ogbɛi lɛ aaada kpeteŋkple, ni aaakɛɛ kɛya naanɔ akɛ, 'Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Israel;' ni mi otsulɔ David we lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ yɛ ohiɛ.
Akɛ bo Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ojie nii nɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi otsulɔ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Mahã oshwiei atsɔmɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, no hã mi, otsulɔ, mina ekãa misɔle nɛkɛ sɔlemɔ nɛɛ.
"Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, boji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni owiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni; ni okɛ nɔ kpakpa nɛɛ ewo mi, otsulɔ, shi.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, na he tsui koni ojɔɔ, mi otsulɔ, miwe lɛ bɔ ni afee ni miwe lɛ ahi shi kɛya naanɔ. Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, owo shi, ni jɔɔmɔ lɛ aaahi mishwiei lɛ anɔ kɛya naanɔ."
8: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David kɛ Filistibii lɛ wu, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eshɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.

No sɛɛ lɛ David ye Moabbii lɛ hu anɔ kunim. Ehã Moabbii ni amɔmɔ lɛ kamɔ shikpɔŋ. Ni kɛji ekɛ susumɔ kpãa susu gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ni ena kpãi enyɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ ehã agbe amɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ esusu kpãa kome, kɛkɛ lɛ ehã amɛyi ena wala. Moabbii lɛ tamɔ David tsuji, ni amɛtsu onia amɛhã lɛ.
David ye Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer, Rehob bi lɛ, hu nɔ kunim, be ni Hadadezer yiŋ etee akɛ eyaaple hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã Eufrate Faa lɛ naa lɛ he lɛ.

David mɔmɔ Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer hii okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpe kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ tabilɔi nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ. David flɔ okpɔŋɔi ni gblaa shwiilii lɛ fɛɛ anaji asɛɛ fãi, shi eshi okpɔŋɔi lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi bɔ ni baahi ahã tayaa shwiilii oha.
Kɛkɛ ni Siriabii ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ ba koni amɛbawa Zoba maŋtsɛ Hadadezer; shi David gbe Siriabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David shi asraafoi eto Siriabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Siriabii lɛ tsɔmɔ David tsuji, ni etsū amɛ onia. Yehowa hã David ye kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he.
David shɔ̃ shika tsɛŋi ni Hadadezer tsuji lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba Yerusalem;
asaŋ eloo akɔɔble babaoo diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Beta kɛ Berotai, maji ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ.
Be ni Toi, Hamat maŋtsɛ lɛ, nu akɛ David eye Hadadezer ta tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ,

etsu ebi, Yoram, Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ koni eyaŋa lɛ ni ehã lɛ aekoo ehã lɛ, yɛ Hadadezer nɔ kunim ni eye lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer kɛ Toi lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe wuwuu tai saŋŋ. Yoram hiɛ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii kɛ akɔɔble nibii ekɛbake David.
Maŋtsɛ David jɔɔ nibii nɛɛ hu anɔ eke akɛ akɛsɔmɔ Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni ejɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni eshɔ̃ kɛjɛ majimaji ni eye amɛnɔ lɛ amli kɛba lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maji lɛ ji Edom kɛ Moab kɛ Amon kɛ Filisti kɛ Amalek. Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer, Rehob bi lɛ, nibii ni ashɔ̃ lɛ ekomɛi hu fata he.
David gbɛi hehe kɛteke nɔ. Be ni eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ ta lɛ ebaa lɛ, eyagbe Edombii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ David shi asraafoi eto Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni Edombii fɛɛ tsɔmɔ David tsuji. Yehowa hã David ye kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he.
David ye Israel maŋtsɛ, ni eye jalɛ sane ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ akɛ Zeruia lɛ, ji David tatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ; ni Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ woloŋmalɔ;
ni Zadok, Ahitub bi lɛ, kɛ Ahimelek, Abiatar bi lɛ, amɛji osɔfoi; ni Seraia ji maŋtsɛ we woloŋmalɔ.
Ni Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ji tabilɔi ni buɔ David he tuuŋtu lɛ atsɛ, ni David bihii lɛ miisɔmɔ akɛ osɔfoi.
9: Gbi ko lɛ David bi akɛ, "Ani Saul shwie ko kwraa yɛ jeŋ lolo lo? Masumɔ akɛ mafee mɔ lɛ ejurɔ yɛ Yonatan hewɔ."
Tsulɔ ko yɛ Saul we lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ziba, ni ayatsɛ lɛ abahã David. Be ni Ziba ba lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji Ziba lɛ?" Ziba jie naa akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, mi ni."
Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani Saul shwie ko kwraa yɛ jeŋ lolo, koni mafee mɔ lɛ ejurɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ lo?" Ziba to he ekɛɛ, "Yonatan musuŋ binuu ko yɛ lolo, ni enaji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ eje kpa."
Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?" Ziba here nɔ akɛ, "Eyɛ Amiel bi Makir we lɛ Lo-Debar."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David tsu atee koni ayaŋɔ Yonatan musuŋ binuu lɛ yɛ Amiel bi Makir we lɛ yɛ Lo-Debar kɛba.

Be ni Mefiboshet, Yonatan binuu ni ji Saul nabi lɛ, shɛ David ŋɔɔ lɛ, eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni eŋa David. Kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Mefiboshet," ni Mefiboshet here nɔ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, naa mi."
David kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei! Miyɛ ejurɔ ni mafee bo yɛ otsɛ Yonatan hewɔ. Mibakpale onii Saul shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ mahã bo; ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ obaata mikplɔ̃ lɛ he, ni okɛ mi baaye ni daa."
Kɛkɛ ni Mefiboshet koto David ni ekɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, namɔ po ji mi, otsulɔ, ni tamɔ gbee gbonyo nɛɛ, ni ona mihe tsuijurɔ nɛkɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ Ziba, Saul tsulɔ lɛ; ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, miikpale nibii ni ji Saul kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ nii lɛ miihã Mefiboshet, onuŋtsɔ nabi lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ okɛ obii lɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ baahu shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni okpa enɔ nii ohã onuŋtsɔ nabi lɛ we lɛ koni amɛna nii amɛye. Shi moŋ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ Mefiboshet onuŋtsɔ nabi lɛ, kɛ mi aaata okplɔ̃ he be fɛɛ be ni wɔye nii. "(Ziba nɛɛ yɛ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ tsuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ.)
Kɛkɛ ni Ziba here Maŋtsɛ David nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mibafee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ efã etsulɔ akɛ efee lɛ. "No hewɔ lɛ Mefiboshet kɛ David ta okplɔ̃ he ye nii tamɔ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ feɔ lɛ.
Mefiboshet yɛ binuu fioo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mika. Ziba shīa lɛ mli bii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ Mefiboshet tsuji.
Mefiboshet ni enaji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ eje kpa lɛ, hi shi yɛ Yerusalem, ni eyeɔ nii yɛ maŋtsɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
10: Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Amonbii amaŋstɛ Nahash gbo, ni ebi Hanun baye esɛɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni David to eyiŋ akɛ ebaajie mlihilɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Hanun tamɔ bɔ ni Hanun tsɛ Nahash mli hi hã lɛ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni David tsu etsuji akɛ amɛyahã Hanun Kpoo amɛhã lɛ, yɛ etsɛ gbele lɛ hewɔ. Be ni David tsuji lɛ yashɛ Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

Amonbii alumɛi lɛ wo amɛnuŋtsɔ Hanun yiŋ akɛ, "Naa, tsumɔ ni David etsu kɛba ni abahã bo kpoo nɛɛ lɛ, kaasusu akɛ ekɛmiiwo otsɛ hiɛ nyam. Maŋ lɛ sramɔ kɛ eshikpamɔ moŋ hewɔ ni David tsu bɔfoi kɛba nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enyɛ maŋ lɛ ebaŋɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Hanun mɔmɔ David bɔfoi lɛ, ni eshɛshɛɛ amɛtsɛŋi fãfãafãi, ni no sɛɛ lɛ eflɔ amɛtadei lɛ anɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ejie bɔfoi lɛ agbɛ amɛtee.
Be ni David nu nɔ ni eba lɛ, etsu ni akɛ bɔfoi lɛ yakpe yɛ gbɛteŋ, ejaakɛ abɔ amɛ ahora fe nine. Ekɛ shɛɛ maje yahã amɛ akɛ amɛwa Yeriko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛtsɛŋi lɛ aaatsa dani amɛba shīa.

Amonbii lɛ na akɛ emɛyata David he. No hewɔ lɛ amɛtsu kɛtee ni ayabɔ Siriabii tabilɔi ni nyiɛɔ nane akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ apaa kɛjɛ Bet-Rehob kɛ Zoba. Amɛyabɔ Maaka maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi akpe kɛ Tob tabilɔi hu akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ apaa.
Be ni David nu lɛ, ewo Yoab kɛ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ata lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ kɛtee koni amɛkɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu.
Amonbii lɛ je kpo, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ amɛmaŋ, Raba, agbo lɛ naa. Shi Siriabii lɛ ni jɛ zoba kɛ Rehob lɛ kɛ Tob hii lɛ kɛ Maaka hii lɛ sɔŋŋ tse amɛhe, ni amɛgba amɛta lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yoab na akɛ agba ta awo lɛ yɛ esɛɛ kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ehala Israel tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ ekomɛi, ni ehã amɛgba ta koni amɛkɛ Siriabii lɛ akpe.
No sɛɛ lɛ etu etabilɔi ni shwɛ lɛ ewo enyɛmi Abishai dɛŋ, ni ekɛ amɛ gba ta koni amɛ lɛ amɛkɛ Amonbii lɛ akpe.
Ekɛɛ Abishai akɛ, "Kɛ ona akɛ Siriabii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ minɔ lɛ koni oba ni obaye obua mi; ni mi hu kɛji mina akɛ Amonbii lɛ anine miitsɔ onɔ lɛ, mibaba mibaye mabua bo.
Feemɔ ekãa, ni hã wɔ fɛɛ wɔfee nuu yɛ wɔmaŋbii kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ maji lɛ ahewɔ, ni Yehowa aaahã nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ aba mli."
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛyanina Siriabii lɛ, shi Siriabii lɛ jo foi yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Be ni Amonbii lɛ na akɛ Siriabii lɛ ejo foi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛjo Abishai naa foi, ni amɛyabote maŋ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ku esɛɛ ni efɔ̃ɔ Amonbii lɛ kɛ ta lɛ wuumɔ, ni eba Yerusalem.
Be ni Siriabii lɛ na akɛ Israelbii lɛ eye amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛbua amɛtabilɔi lɛ anaa kɛkpe.
Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tsu kɛtee koni ayaŋɔ Siriabii lɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛba. Ni amɛba Helam ni Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tatsɛ Shobak lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ.
Be ni David na ele lɛ, ebua Israel tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ekɛ amɛ fo yordan Faa lɛ, ni etee Helam. Siriabii lɛ gba ta wo David, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wu.
Siriabii lɛ jo foi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, shi David gbe Siriabii atayaa shwiiliiatsɛmɛi ohai kpawo kɛ okpɔŋɔianɔtralɔi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. David pila Shobak, Siriabii atatsɛ lɛ, ni enyɔ yɛ ta lɛ naa.
Be ni maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ na akɛ Israel eye amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛ kɛ Israel bakpãtã, ni amɛsɔmɔ Israel. Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ Siriabii lɛ she gbeyei akɛ amɛaate shi amɛyaye amɛbua Amonbii lɛ.
11: Afi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ, be ni maŋtsɛmɛi fãa ta lɛ, David wo Yoab kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ Israel tabilɔi gbɛ, ni amɛyakpãtã Amonbii lɛ ahiɛ. Amɛyasa Raba maŋ lɛ yi; shi David diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ehi shi yɛ Yerusalem.
Gbi ko gbɛkɛnaashi blɛoo mli lɛ, David ete shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli, ni eeshera shi yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ, ni ejɛ jɛi ni ena yoo ko ni miiju ehe. Kɛji okwɛ yoo nɛɛ lɛ ehe yɛ fɛo jogbaŋŋ naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu koni atao mɔ ni yoo lɛ ji. Abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ Eliam biyoo ni; atsɛɔ lɛ Batsheba, Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, ŋa ji lɛ.
David tsu bɔfoi ni ayaŋɔ Batsheba abahã lɛ. Akɛ yoo lɛ ba David ŋɔɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wɔ. (Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Batsheba etee tsuiasɛɛ ni etsuu ehe egbe naa.) Kɛkɛ ni Batsheba ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ.
Batsheba na akɛ ena musu, ni no hewɔ lɛ etsu ayakɛɛ David akɛ ehiɛ musu.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu atee Yoab ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ha Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, abana mi. "No hewɔ lɛ Yoab hã Uria ba David ŋɔɔ.
Be ni Uria ba lɛ David bi lɛ bɔ ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi lɛ yɔɔ, kɛ bɔ ni ta lɛ hu yaa nɔ hãa.
No sɛɛ lɛ David kɛɛ Uria akɛ, "Yaa owe lɛ, ni oyawo otsui. "Be ni Uria shi maŋtsɛ we lɛ, David tsu akɛ akɛ nikee ayahã Uria.
Shi Uria eyaaa ewe lɛ, shi moŋ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi ni buɔ ehe ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ fɛɛ yawɔ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ koi lɛ shi.
Be ni David ba nu akɛ Uria eyaaa ewe lɛ, David bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani jeee gbɛ ojɛ oba nɛɛ? Mɛɛba oyaaa owe lɛ?"

Uria jie naa akɛ, "Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ miiwɔ buui amli, ni minuŋtsɔ tatsɛ Yoab kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ jwere ŋa nɔ. Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni mi lɛ miyaa miwe ni miyayeɔ nii, ni minuɔ dãa, ni mi kɛ miŋa wɔɔ hu? Mina onane akɛ miwoŋ nɛkɛ nɔ ko feemɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Uria akɛ, "Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, hii biɛ ŋmɛnɛ hu mɔ koni wɔ lɛ mawo o gbɛ ni oya. "No hewɔ lɛ Uria hi shi yɛ Yerusalem nakai gbi lɛ kɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ hu.
Ni David tsu ayatsɛ Uria kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛ lɛ ta okplɔ̃ he amɛye nii. Ehã Uria nu dãa ni etɔ, shi nakai gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ hu lɛ Uria kɛ etabilɔi ni buɔ ehe lɛ wɔ maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi, ni eyaaa ewe lɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ David ŋma Yoab wolo, ni ekɛtsu Uria ekɛtee eyahã lɛ.
David ŋma yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ, "Hã Uria adamɔ ta lɛ naa yɛ he ni wa fe fɛɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛgblaa nyɛhe shi nyɛshīa lɛ koni nine atsɔ̃ enɔ ni agbe lɛ."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ be mli ni Yoab foɔ sa ewoɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ, ehã Uria damɔ he ni ele akɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahii kakabãi yɔɔ lɛ.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ Yoab bawu; David tsuji lɛ ekomɛi nyɔnyɔɔ, Uria Hitnyo lɛ hu nyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tsu koni ayabɔ Maŋtsɛ David ta lɛ mli amaniɛ fɛɛ tswɛm.
Ewo bɔfo lɛ shi akɛ, "Kɛji obɔ maŋtsɛ ta lɛ mli amaniɛ lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ogbe naa,
ni aleee nɔ emli aaafu, ni eeebi bo akɛ, 'Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ ta lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ kpaakpa lɛ? Ani nyɛleee akɛ amɛbaajɛ maŋ gbogbo lɛ nɔ amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ nyɛ gãi?

Nyɛkaiii Gideon bi Abimelek gbele lɛ akɛ yoo ni jɛ maŋ gbogbo nɔ ekɛ wiɛbi tswa eyiteŋ yɛ Tebez ni egbo lɛ? Mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛtsi nyɛbɛŋkɛ amɛmaŋ gbogbo lɛ nakai lɛ?' Kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ bi o nɛkɛ lɛ, okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Otsulɔ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, hu enyɔ.'"
Bɔfo lɛ yiŋ eba, ni ehã wiemɔ ni Yoab kɛtsu lɛ lɛ shɛ David deŋ.
Ebakɛɛ David akɛ, "Henyɛlɔi lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli koni amɛkɛ wɔ abawu yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; shi wɔnine tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni wɔshwie amɛ kɛyashi maŋ agbo lɛ naa tɔ̃ɔ.
Jɛi ni gãitsɛlɔi lɛ jɛ maŋ gbogbo lɛ nɔ amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ otsuji gãi, ni maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ ekomɛi gboi. Otsulɔ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ hu egbo."
David kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Yaakɛɛ Yoab akɛ ekahã sane nɛɛ mihao lɛ, ejaakɛ klaŋte yɔɔ nɛɛ ekpaaa mɔ hiɛ ni ekpãtãa. Ehã maŋ lɛ nitswiamɔ lɛ mli awa moŋ koni eye nɔ. Yaawo lɛ hewalɛ."
Be ni Uria ŋa, Batsheba, nu akɛ ewu Uria egbo lɛ, efo ewu lɛ.
Be ni Batsheba eye ŋkɔmɔ egbe naa lɛ, David tsu ni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni etsɔ eŋa. Batsheba kɛ David fɔ binuu. Shi sane ni David ye nɛɛ eŋɔɔ Yehowa naa.
12: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsu Natan David ŋɔɔ; ni Natan ba ni ebakɛɛ David akɛ, "Hii enyɔ komɛi hi maŋ ko nɔ be ko. Amɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ niiatsɛ ni, ni mɔ kome lɛ ohiafo ni.
Niiatsɛ lɛ yɛ toi kɛ tsinai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ,

shi ohiafo lɛ bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko fe gwaŋtɛŋbi yoo bibioo kome pɛ ni eyahe. Elɛ ekooloo nɛɛ ni ekɛ eshīaŋ gbekɛbii lɛ fɛɛ badra. Niyenii ni eyeɔ lɛ, no eko ehãa toobi lɛ, ni ekɛ toobi lɛ nuɔ kpulu kome naa nu; ni kɛfee lɛ ewoɔ lɛ eŋmɛɔ ekpɔkɔiaŋ. Toobi lɛ tamɔ biyoo hã lɛ.

Be ko lɛ gbɔ ko bato nuu niiatsɛ lɛ; shi akɛ ni esumɔɔɔ akɛ emɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etoo loo etsinai lɛ eko ni egbe ehã egbɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eshi ekooloi lɛ asɛɛ, ni eyamɔ ohiafo lɛ gwaŋtɛŋbi lɛ moŋ, ni egbe ehã egbɔ ni ebato lɛ lɛ."
David mli fu niiatsɛ lɛ naakpa, ni ekɛɛ Natan akɛ, "Mina Yehowa akɛ nuu ni ye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ lɛ esa gbele,
ni esa akɛ eto toobi lɛ najiaŋ toi ejwɛ, akɛni enyɛ eye ohiafo lɛ nɛkɛ sane, ni enaaa lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Natan kɛɛ David akɛ, "Boji nakai nuu lɛ. Ni naa nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ, 'Miwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ, ni mihere oyiwala yɛ Saul dɛŋ;
asaŋ ni mikɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ eŋamɛi lɛ hã bo, ni mihã otsɔ̃ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ maŋtsɛ. Eji enɛɛmɛi faaa kulɛ mafata he mahã bo.
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni oku, mi Yehowa, migbee nɔ, ni ofee efɔŋ nɛɛ? Ogbe Uria, Hitnyo lɛ. Ohã Amonbii lɛ gbe lɛ, kɛkɛ ni oŋɔ eŋa lɛ ofee oŋa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ bo hu kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ klaŋte naa gbele kpaŋ yɛ oshwiei ateŋ, ejaakɛ obuuu mi, ni oŋɔ Uria Hitnyo lɛ ŋa lɛ ofee oŋa.
Miiwo bo shi! Mahã gbɔmɔ ajɛ bo nɔŋŋ owe lɛ mli ate shi awo bo; ni ohiɛ tua ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni mashɔ oŋamɛi lɛ mahã owekunyo, ni ekɛ oŋamɛi lɛ baawɔ shwane fintĩŋŋ.
Bo lɛ otee ohe, ni ofee esha lɛ, shi mi lɛ mibafee nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ shwane fintĩŋŋ?'"
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Natan akɛ, "Mifee Yehowa shishi esha," Natan to he ni ekɛɛ David akɛ, "Yehowa hu kɛ esha ni ofee lɛ efa o, ni ogboŋ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ akɛ obuuu Yehowa yɛ nɔ ni ofee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, bi lɛ ni abaafɔ ahã o lɛ yi naŋ wala; gbo eeegbo."
Kɛkɛ ni Natan shi David ni etee ewe. Yehowa hã hela shi bi lɛ ni Uria ŋa lɛ kɛ David fɔ lɛ nɔ, ni gbekɛ lɛ he ye waa naakpa.
David sɔle ekpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai ehã gbekɛ lɛ koni ehe awa lɛ; David hi ŋmaa, ni eho ekã shikpɔŋ yɛ etsu lɛ mli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ewe mli onukpai lɛ tee koni amɛyawo enɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ, shi David ekplɛ̃ɛɛ, ni nii hu emii akɛ eye.

Gbi ni hela lɛ na otsi lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ gbo; shi David tsuji lɛ she gbeyei akɛ amɛaakɛɛ lɛ gbekɛ lɛ gbele lɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Be ni gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ kã lolo po lɛ, wɔkɛ lɛ wie lɛ ebooo wɔ toi. Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ wɔkɛɛ lɛ akɛ gbekɛ lɛ egbo hu? Kɛji akwɛɛɛ ni ahi lɛ eeefee ehe efɔŋ ko."
Shi be ni David na bɔ ni etsuji lɛ wieɔ ablɛbi lɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni eyoo sɛɛ akɛ gbekɛ lɛ egbo. No hewɔ lɛ David bi etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Gbekɛ lɛ egbo,bɛɛ?" Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Egbo".

Kɛkɛ ni David te shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni eju ehe, ni ekpa mu, ni eshwã eyi; kɛkɛ ni etsake etadei lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Yehowa we lɛ, ni eyasɔlɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ David ba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ mli; ni be ni ebi niyenii shi ni akɛ eko bama ehiɛ lɛ, eye.
David tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔnuuu bo shishi! Ejaakɛ be ni gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ kã lɛ, ohi ŋmaa, ni ofo ohã lɛ; shi ni egbo moŋ lɛ ni oyeɔ nii nɛɛ?"
David kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Be ni gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ kã lolo lɛ, mihi ŋmãa ni mifo, ejaakɛ misusumɔ ji akɛ eko lɛ Yehowa aaana mi mɔbɔ, ni eeehã gbekɛ lɛ yi ana wala;
shi agbɛnɛ ni ena egbo lɛ, mɛni mahi ŋmãa mafee? Manyɛ mahã eba wala mli ekoŋŋ? Mi moŋ maya he ni eyɔɔ lɛ; shi lɛ lɛ ekpaleŋ ebaŋ miŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ."
David shɛje eŋa Batsheba mii; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ ni Batsheba fɔ binuu, ni David wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Solomon. Yehowa na gbekɛ lɛ he tsui,
ni etsu Natan gbalɔ lɛ kɛtee ni eyawo gbekɛ lɛ gbɛi "Yedidia ehã Yehowa.
Ni Yoab fã ta Kɛyatua Amonbii amaŋ wulu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Raba lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛwu; ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tsu bɔfoi David ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ: "Miyatua Rababii, ni miŋɔ maŋ lɛ he ni amɛnaa nu kɛjɛɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ buamɔ maŋ lɛ tabilɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ anaa, koni okɛ amɛ abatua amɛmaŋ wulu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni oŋɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mi mikayaŋɔ ni akɛ migbɛi wo maŋ lɛ."
Enɛ hã David bua etabilɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anaa. Kɛkɛ ekɛ amɛ fã kɛtee eyatua Raba ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni David jie shika maŋtsɛ fai ni akɛbu Amonbii ajemawɔŋ Molek lɛ shiu lɛ, ni ekɛbu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyitso. Maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ tsiimɔ aaafee talenta kome, ni ojrawatɛ ko hɔ mli. No sɛɛ lɛ eloo maŋ lɛ mli nibii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.

Maŋbii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ehã amɛ nitsumɔ ni amɛkɛ saalai kɛ kɔi kɛ lema atsu; asaŋ enyɛ amɛnɔ hu ni amɛfo ntayaa amɛhã lɛ. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ekɛ Amonbii amaji lɛ fɛɛ ye ehã. Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem.
13: David binuu Absalom yɛ nyɛbiyoo fɛɛfɛo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tamar. David binuu kroko ni gbɛi ji Amnon lɛ basumɔ Tamar.
Amnon sumɔ enyɛmiyoo nɛɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni suɔmɔ lɛ wo lɛ hela tete, ejaakɛ Amnon leee gbɛ koome nɔ ni eeeetsɔ̃ ni enine aaashɛ Tamar nɔ, ejaakɛ Tamar lɛ oblanyo fro ni.
Amnon yɛ naanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yonadab, ni ji David nyɛminuu, Shimea, lɛ binuu. Mɔlakalɔ jogbaŋŋ ji Yonadab nɛɛ.
Yonadab bi Amnon akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni bo maŋtsɛbi muu lɛ otãa loo gbi fɛɛ gbi nɛɛ? Ogbaaa mi nɔ ni gbaa onaa?" Amnon jie naa ekɛɛ, "Miisumɔ Tamar, minyɛmi Absalom nyɛbiyoo lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yonadab kɛɛ Amnon akɛ, "Yaahɔ osaa mli, ni okwa akɛ ohe miiye; ni kɛji otsɛ ba bo sramɔ lɛ okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ataa, ofai nɛ ni ohã minyɛmiyoo Tamar aba ni ebafee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enine naa niyenii yɛ mihiɛ ni ehiɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni maye,'"

Amnon tee eyakã shi lɛɛlɛŋ, ni ekwa akɛ ehe miiye. Be ni etsɛ, Maŋtsɛ David, ba lɛ sramɔ lɛ, Amnon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ataa, ofai nɛ ni ohã minyɛmiyoo Tamar aba ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebashã aboloi enyɔ oo ko yɛ mihiɛ ni ehiɛ yɛ edɛŋ ni maye."
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu atee Tamar ŋɔɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli, ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa onyɛmi Amnon we lɛ koni oyafee niyenii fioo ko ohã lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Tamar yiŋ etee enyɛmi Amnon we lɛ, ni eyanina lɛ ni ekã saa nɔ. Tamar tī ma, ni ekpɔtɔ ekɛfee niyenii lɛ be mli ni Amnon miikwɛ lɛ; kɛkɛ ni eshã aboloo lɛ.
Amnon miikwɛ nɔŋŋ ni Tamar wo nishãa tsɛnsi lɛ ni etsɔ̃ niyenii lɛ yɛ mli ehã lɛ. Amnon ekplɛ̃ɛɛ yeli, shi moŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, "hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi mimasɛi. "Ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ je kpo yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Amnon kɛɛ Tamar akɛ, "Okɛ niyenii lɛ aba pia lɛ mli koni ohiɛ yɛ odɛŋ ni maye. "Tamar wo aboloo ni eshã lɛ kɛtee enyɛmi Amnon ŋɔɔ yɛ pia lɛ mli.
Shi be ni Tamar tsi bɛŋkɛ Amnon kɛ niyenii lɛ koni eye lɛ, Amnon mɔ Tamar mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minyɛmiyoo, hã ni wɔna bɔlɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Tamar kɛɛ lɛ akɛ. "Dabida, minyɛminuu! Kaamɔ mi akranaŋ naa, ejaakɛ aahi nɛkɛ nɔ ko yɛ Israel! Kaafee nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ!
Bo lɛ oootsɔ̃ tamɔ Israel hii yakagbɔmɛi lɛ eko kɛkɛ, shi mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ po mi kɛ nɛkɛ hiɛgble nɛɛ aaatee? Shi moŋ okɛ maŋtsɛ ayawie he, ni mile akɛ ekɛ mi baahã bo aahuu."
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Amnon booo Tamar toi, ni akɛni ehe wa fe Tamar hewɔ lɛ, emɔ lɛ akranaŋ naa, ni ekɛ lɛ wɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Amnon he tsɛ̃ Tamar waa bɔ ni hetsɛ̃ lɛ naa yawa fe suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ Tamar lɛ; ni ekɛɛ Tamar akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya."
Tamar kɛɛ Amnon akɛ, "Dabida, kaafee mi nakai, ejaakɛ shwiemɔ ni oshwieɔ mi nɛɛ moŋ ji efɔŋ ni naa wa fe klɛŋklɛŋ efɔŋ ni ofee mi lɛ." Shi Amnon booo lɛ toi;
shi moŋ etsɛ oblanyo ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Shwiemɔ yoo nɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ kɛje kpo, ni ola shinaa lɛ sɛɛ."
Tsulɔ lɛ shwie Tamar kɛje kpo, ni ela shinaa lɛ sɛɛ. Tamar wo atade wuyaa kɛ ehe niji kakadaji; blema lɛ no ji maŋtsɛmɛi abiyei froi atade.
Kɛkɛ ni Tamar loo lamlu eshwie eyiteŋ, ni egbla atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo ni ewo lɛ, ni eklɔ eniji eshwie eyiteŋ, ni ehiɛ yaafo gegeege kɛtee.

Enyɛmi Absalom bi lɛ akɛ," Ani onyɛmi Amnon eta ohe lo? Minyɛmiyoo! Kaahã enɛ miiye otsui tsɔ̃, shi moŋ feemɔ dioo; ni kaagba mɔ ko, ejaakɛ oyɛmi ni. "Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Tamar wa enyɛmi Absalom we lɛ, ni ewo ehe tsuŋ yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ David nu saji fɛɛ ni eba lɛ he lɛ, emli wo la naakpa.
Absalom nyɛ Amnon waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ enyɛbi yoo Tamar ni Amnon mɔ lɛ lɛ hewɔ; shi moŋ ejieee dɔlɛ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ Amnon.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ afii enyɔ lɛ, aaku Absalom toi ahetsɔi yɛ Baal-Hazor ni bɛŋkɛ Efraim maŋ lɛ, ni ekpee maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ amɛba jɛi.
Absalom ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii, aaku mitoi ahetsɔi. Ofai nɛ koni Nii kɛ etsuji lɛ abafata mihe kɛnya yɛ jɛi."
Maŋtsɛ David here Absalom nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Dabida, mibi! Kɛji wɔ fɛɛ wɔba lɛ, ebaafee tɔlɛ kɛ naangba tsɔ̃ ehã o" Absalom fi nɔ doo akɛ eekpee mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, shi Maŋtsɛ David ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ; shi moŋ ejɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Absalom kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nakai lɛ, ofai nɛ, hã minyɛmi Amnon kɛ wɔ aya mɔ. "Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ekɛ o aya?"
Absalom hiɛ sane lɛ mli aahuu ni naagbee lɛ Maŋtsɛ David ŋmɛ gbɛ, ni Amnon kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Absalom tee.
Absalom kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Kɛfee lɛ nyɛkwɛa Amnon, kɛji nyɛna akɛ wain lɛ ehã emli efli lɛ, ni mifã akɛ atswa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea lɛ. Nyɛkashea gbeyei ejaakɛ mi mifã nyɛ. Nyɛfea ekãa; nyɛfea hii!"
Asalom tsuji lɛ ye efãmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛgbe Amnon. Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ bihii krokomɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ho tra amɛtejiokpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛjo foi.
Maŋtsɛbii lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ lolo, ni abatswa David adafi akɛ, "Shi ota? Absalom egbe obihii lɛ fɛɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome flo nɛkɛ eshwɛko!"
Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni Maŋtsɛ david ho edamɔ shi, ni egbla atadei lɛ yɛ ehe, ni eho ekã shikpɔŋ. Etsuji fɛɛ ni damɔ emasɛi nakai be lɛ gblagblaa amɛ hu amɛtadei.

Kɛkɛ ni David nyɛminuu, Shimea, bi Yonadab kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Nii, agbeko obihii lɛ fɛɛ. Amnon kome kɛkɛ agbe, ejaakɛ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Amnon mɔ Absalom nyɛbiyoo Tamar, ni efite lɛ lɛ beebe, ni Absalom to eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee nɛkɛ nɔ ko.
No hewɔ lɛ kaahe sane nɛɛ oye akɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ fɛɛ ni egboi lɛ, ejaakɛ Amnon kome kɛkɛ ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ."
Ni fee nakai lɛ Absalom jo foi, Shi trukaa lɛ oblanyo tabilɔ ni miibu lɛ yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena mɛi babaoo ni miiba yɛ Horonaim gbɛ lɛ nɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he. Etee ni eyagba Maŋtsɛ David nɔ ni ena lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yonadab kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Naa, maŋtsɛbii lɛ miiba. Bɔ ni otsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ ni."

Yonadab naa ni nyɔ shi nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ pɛ, naa maŋtsɛbii lɛ ni amɛba. Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo yara, ni Maŋtsɛ David hu kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ wo yara amɛfo aahuu. 37-38. Bi ni Absalom jo foi lɛ, etee Geshur maŋtsɛ Talmai, ni ji Amihud bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ yahi shi afii etɛ̃. David ye ebinuu Absalom he awerɛho daa gbi.
Ni eshwe Absalom; shi Amnon gbɛfaŋ lɛ, David tse etsui eŋmɛ emli ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ egbo momo.
14: Be ni Zeruia bi Yoab na bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui yeɔ yɛ Absalom he ehãa lɛ,

etsu atee Tekoa maŋ lɛ mli ayaŋɔ yoo nilelɔ ko abahã lɛ. Yoab kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Kwaa ni otsɔ̃ ohe ŋkɔmɔyelɔ. Otao yarafemɔ bo obu, ni okakpa mu, koni ofee ohe tamɔ yoo ni eeye emɔ ko ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ be babaoo;
ni oya Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ bɔ ni makɛɛ o nɛɛ. "Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ta wiemɔi lɛ ewo yoo lɛ naa.
Be ni Tekoayoo lɛ yashɛ Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ lɛ, eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Nii, ofai nɛ ni oye obua mi."
David bi yoo lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ji osane lɛ?" Yoo lɛ jie naa akɛ, "Miwu egbo, ni eshi mi okulafo.
Oweyoo bihii enyɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ be yɛ ŋanɔ; ni akɛni mɔ ko bɛ jɛi ni aaakpãtã amɛ hewɔ lɛ, mɔ kome tswa mɔ kome nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.

Amrɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ weku lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ete shi ewo mi. Amɛkɛɛ mijie binuu ni tswa enyɛmi lɛ nɔ ni egbe lɛ lɛ mihã amɛ, koni amɛgbe lɛ kɛtɔ enyɛmi ni egbe lɛ he owele. Be lɛ amɛbaakpãtã mibiiatsɛ lɛ niyelɔ lɛ hu hiɛ. Ni kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, amɛbaahã mihiɛnɔkamɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ atã, ni miwu lɛ hu gbɛi loo eseshi baalaaje yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, bo lɛ yaa owe lɛ; ni matsu osane lɛ he nii."
Tekoayoo lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, kɛji tɔ̃mɔ ko aaaba lɛ, ekã mi kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ nɔ. Sɔ̃ ko sɔ̃ ko akawula maŋtsɛ kɛ eshwiei ayiteŋ."
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ bo aaawie nɔ ko lɛ, okɛ mɔ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ; ni kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ mɔ lɛ etaŋ ohe dɔŋŋ."

Tekoayoo lɛ to he ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ, ofai nɛ, ni okpa Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, koni mɔ ni toaɔ etɔ mibi lɛ lá lɛ he owele lɛ yiŋ atsake koni ekashwie mibi ni eshwɛ lɛ lá shi. "Maŋtsɛ David to he ekɛɛ, "Mina Yehowa akɛ kɛji obi lɛ yiteŋ tsɔi kome nɛkɛ nyɔ shi fīi."
Yoo lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, ni oŋmɛ oweyoo gbɛ koni ekɛɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ nɔ ko. "Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Wiemɔ".

Kɛkɛ ni Tekoayoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba mɔ ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ yeɔ nɛkɛ sane? Bɔ ni obua sane lɛ he ohã nɛɛ lɛ, belɛ gbii abɔ ni maŋtsɛ eyakplako ebi ni enyɔ kooŋ lɛ kɛbako lɛ, maŋtsɛ miibu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ ehe fɔ mɔ.
Gbele kã shi hã wɔ fɛɛ, ni ehãa wɔtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ nu ni atsi ashwie shikpɔŋ, ni ehiii loomɔ dɔŋŋ. Shi mɔ ni toɔ gbɛiianɔ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni enyɔ kooŋ aba shīa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ egbeee lɛ.
Nii, nɔ hewɔ ni miba mikɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ bawie nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ji akɛ maŋbii lɛ wo mihe gbeyei. Enɛ hã mito miyiŋ akɛ maya mikɛ maŋtsɛ ayawie akɛ aleee nɔ eeefee nɔ ni mi, otsulɔyoo, aaabi lɛ lɛ lo.
Ejaakɛ mile faŋŋ akɛ maŋtsɛ aaabo mi toi, ni eeejie mi yɛ nuu ni taoɔ akɛ ejie mi kɛ mibi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã ewebii lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Mina hiɛnɔkamɔ akɛ hetoo ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ aaahã mi lɛ baahã mitsui anyɔ mimli, ejaakɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, ni enaa nɔ kpakpa kɛ nɔ gbonyo. Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ bo."
Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Tekoayoo lɛ akɛ, "Sane ni mibabi bo agbɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, gbaa mi anɔkwale ni yɔɔ mli. "Yoo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ awie."

Maŋtsɛ David bi yoo lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni obafee nɛɛ lɛ, Yoab nine yɛ mli lo?" Yoo lɛ jie sane lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ, "Mina minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ akɛ anɔkwale lɛ shishiishi owie lɛ. Otsulɔ Yoab ni tsu mi, asaŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ eta wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ewo minaa.
Otsulɔ Yoab to ŋaa nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni atsake sane lɛ hiɛ. Shi akɛni minuŋtsɔ le nii tamɔ Nyŋmɔ bɔfo hewɔ lɛ, ele nibii fɛɛ ni yaa nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ mikplɛ̃, no hewɔ lɛ yaa koni okɛ Absalom aba."
Ni Yoab ho egbee shi ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto Maŋtsɛ David, ni eda lɛ shi ekɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ŋmɛnɛ mi, otsulɔ, ena ele akɛ oyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ ejaakɛ, maŋtsɛ, ofee nɔ ni mibi lɛ ohã mi."
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yoab te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Geshur, ni eyaŋɔ Absalom kɛba Yerusalem.
Be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalem lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David hã wiemɔ akɛ, "Eya lɛ diɛtsɛ ewe lɛ mli eyahi jɛi. Mitaooo ehiɛ mana. "Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Absalom gba kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshīa lɛ, ni enaaa maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Nuu ko nuu ko bɛ Israel fɛɛ ni ekɛ Absalom ye egbɔ yɛ hefɛo gbɛfaŋ. Kɛjɛ enaneshi aahuu kɛyashi epampam lɛ, kpa kome nɛkɛ bɛ ehe.
Kɛji eku eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ shekeli ohai enyɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ nsɛnitɛ naa. (Ejaakɛ yitsɔi lɛ tsiɔ yɛ enɔ dani ekuɔ; ni daa afi dani ekuɔ)
Absalom fɔ bihii etɛ̃ kɛ yoo kome ni atsɛ lɛ Tamar; ni eji yoo ko ni he yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Absalom ye afii enyɔ yɛ Yerusalem ni enaaa Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ nɛkɛ.
Enɛ hã Absalom tsu atsɛ Yoab ahã lɛ koni etsu lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Shi Yoab sumɔɔ akɛ eyaa. Absalom ku sɛɛ etsu atsɛ Yoab nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, shi no hu Yoab eyaaa.
No hewɔ lɛ Absalom kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Be nyɛna Yoab ŋmɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ minɔ lɛ masɛi lɛ, nyɛyaa, ni nyɛyamaa akoko ni yɔɔ ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ naa la. "Absalom tsuji lɛ tee ni amɛyama ŋmɔ lɛ naa la.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tee eyanina Absalom yɛ eshīa lɛ mli, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni otsuji lɛ yama miŋmɔ lɛ naa la lɛ?"

Absalom jie naa akɛ, Akɛni mitsu ni atsɛ bo ahã mi, ni obaaa lɛ hewɔ. Miitao bo matsu maŋtsɛ ŋɔɔ koni oyabi lɛ ohã mi nɔ hewɔ kwraa ni mishi Geshur kɛba lɛ. Miyɛ jɛi lolo kulɛ, bɛ no moŋ hi hã mi? "Absalom tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yoab akɛ, "Yaatsu he nii ohã mi koni mana maŋtsɛ hiɛ. Kɛji mitɔ̃ enɔ lɛ koni egbe mi."

Yoab tee eyana maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ebɔ lɛ amaniɛ; ni Maŋtsɛ David tsu ayatsɛ Absalom. Be ni Absalom shɛ shi lɛ eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto Maŋtsɛ David. Maŋtsɛ David shwɔ Absalom naa ekɛhere lɛ atuu.
15: Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Absalom to shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi ehã ehe; ni esaa hii tabilɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ eto koni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.

Eteɔ shi maŋkɛ mra, ni eyadamɔɔ gbɛ ni kã kɛyaa maŋ agbo lɛ naa lɛ toi. Ni kɛji ena mɔ ko ni ehiɛ bei sane ko kɛmiiba koni maŋtsɛ lɛ akwɛ ahã lɛ lɛ, Absalom tsɛɔ mɔ lɛ, ni ebiɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ maŋ nɔ ojɛ?" Kɛji mɔ lɛ to he, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɔ Israel akutso mli ni ejɛ lɛ,
Absalom kɛɔ mɔ lɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwa, osane yɛ mli, ni eja hu; shi naa, mɔ ko bɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he ni aaabo bo toi."
Asaŋ Absalom kɛɔ kɛshiɔ nɔ akɛ, "Mina ni kulɛ awo mi kojolɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ esane ekɛbahã mi lɛ, makwɛ koni aye mɔ lɛ sane lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa."
Kɛ mɔ ni Absalom kɛwieɔ lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ koni ekoto Absalom lɛ, Absalom kpãa enine mli, ni emɔɔ mɔ lɛ mli, ni eshwɔɔ enaa.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Absalom fee egbe Israelbii fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛsane baa yeli yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ yitso, ni ekɛkpla Israelbii fɛɛ eshwie esɛɛ akɛ lɛ ji amɛgbɔmɔ kpakpa, ni ehã Israel hii fɛɛ kɛ amɛyitso hã lɛ.
Afii ejwɛ baho; kɛkɛ ni Absalom kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Ofai nɛ ni oŋmɛ mi gbɛ koni maya Hebron mayaye shi ko ni miwo Yehowa lɛ nɔ maba.
Ejaakɛ be mli ni miyɔɔ Geshur yɛ Siria lɛ, miwo Yehowa shi akɛ kɛji ekɛ mi aaatee Yerusalem ekoŋŋ lɛ no lɛ maba Hebron mi diɛŋtsɛ mabaja lɛ, ni mashã afɔle mahã lɛ,"
Maŋtsɛ David to he akɛ, "Yaa, okɛ gbɛyiɛmɔ jurɔ. "No hewɔ lɛ ete shi, ni etee Hebron.
Kɛkɛ ni Absalom tsu bɔfoi nigii kɛtee amɛyanyiɛ Israelbii akutsei lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛwo amɛyiŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Kɛji nyɛnu ni aakpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ pɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Absalom etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ yɛ Hebron,'"
Absalom Kpee hii ohai enyɔ efata ehe kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛtee kusum ni eyaatsu lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ, tee kɛkɛ amɛtee; amɛleee mli eko kwraa nɔ nyiɛmɔ ni akɛ amɛ nyiɛ lɛ.

Be mli ni Absalom shãa afɔlei lɛ, etsu ayatsɛ Ahitofel, Gilonyo lɛ Maŋtsɛ David ŋaawolɔ, yɛ emaŋ Gilo lɛ abahã lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ he yiŋ fɔŋ ni etoɔ lɛ mli bawa, ni Absalom sɛɛbii lɛ ayi bafa jogbaŋŋ.
Bɔfo ko batswa David adafi ekɛɛ, "Israelbii atsui emɔ Absalom."

Enɛ hã David kɛɛ etsuji fɛɛ ni ekɛyɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔjoa foi, kɛjeee nakai lɛ wɔjeŋ Absalom dɛŋ! Nyɛfea mramra ni wɔtea koni ekabanina wɔ trukaa koni ehã sane fɔŋ baye wɔ, ni ebagbe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli."
Maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Bɔ ni Nii Maŋtsɛ baakɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛshwie nɔ, lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ mli bii fɛɛ, ja ehemɛi yei nyɔŋma komɛi ni eshi koni amɛkwɛ shīa lɛ pɛ.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ esɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ fã ni amɛshiɔ maŋ lɛ klotia lɛ masɛi,
ni etsuji ni ji keretifoi lɛ kɛ Peletifoi lɛ fɛɛ to kɛbatsɔ̃ emasɛi kɛho. Be ni Gatbii hii ohai ekpaa lɛ ni nyiɛ Maŋtsɛ David sɛɛ kɛjɛ Gat kɛba lɛ hu hoɔ kɛyi ehiɛ lɛ,
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Itai, Gatbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔnukpa lɛ, akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni bo hu okɛ wɔ yaa? Kuu osɛɛ moŋ ni okɛ maŋtsɛ hee lɛ ayahi shi, ejaakɛ gbɔ ni ebabɔ mɔfro ji bo.

Kolɛ gbii enyiɛ nɛ ni obadɔmɔ wɔ, hewɔ ni mahã okɛ wɔ aya ni oyatsomlo, be mli hu ni he pɔtɛɛ po ni miyaa lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mileee lɛ? Kuu osɛɛ ni okɛ owebii lɛ aya, ni Yehowa aana bo mɔbɔ; asaŋ eeeye bo anɔkwa hu."
Shi Itai here Maŋtsɛ David nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mina Yehowa, ni mina minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ nane hu akɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ, gbele mli jio, wala mli jio, mi kɛ bo aaatee."
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Itai akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, ba ni obaho". Kɛkɛ ni Itai, Gatnyo lɛ kɛ esɛɛ hii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛhɔi fɛɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ baho.
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ wo yara amɛfo be ni David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fã kɛhoɔ lɛ. Ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ yafo kidron Faa lɛ, ni amɛwo amɛyi amɛma ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ.
Osɔfo Abiatar ba; Osɔfo Zadok hu shɛ shi ni Levibii lɛ fɛɛ fata he ni amɛtrɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ; ni ato Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama shi kɛyashi maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ je maŋ lɛ mli ho amɛgbe naa.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Zadok akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ aya maŋ lɛ mli. Kɛji Yehowa miisumɔ lɛ no lɛ wɔsɛɛ ko kɛ̃, eeehã maku misɛɛ koni maba mabana Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ etoohe lɛ mli fɛɛ ekoŋŋ;
shi kɛji jeee esuɔmɔ naa ji nakai lɛ miyɛ edɛŋ, bɔ ni eeeto mi kɛkɛ."
David tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ Osɔfo Zadok akɛ, "Ole nɔ ko? ŋɔɔ obi Ahimaaz kɛ Abiatar bi Yonatan, ofata ohe kɛku sɛɛ kɛya maŋ lɛ mli.
Mibamɛ yɛ faafoohe lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni minine aaashɛ nyɛdɛŋ adafitswaa ko nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Zadok kɛ Abiatar wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalem, ni amɛyahi jɛi.
Maŋtsɛ David kwɔ Mu Gɔŋ lɛ ni yaafonu jwere ehiɛ, ni eha eyiteŋ, ni asaŋ enyiɛ enane flo. Ni esɛɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ hu eha eyiteŋ; ni be ni amɛyaa lɛ amɛmiifo.
Ni mɔ ko bagba Maŋtsɛ David akɛ Ahitofel hu shi maŋjwalɔi lɛ anɔ. Kɛkɛ ni David sɔle ekpa Yehowa fai, ni ekɛɛ, "Ao, Yehowa, miikpa o fai, hã ŋaa fɛɛ ŋaa ni Ahitofel baawo lɛ atsɔ̃ kwashiai aŋaa."
Be ni David shɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ he ni ajaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ lɛ, ekɛ Hushai, enaanyo Arkinyo lɛ, kpe kɛ ehe atade ni egbla, asaŋ kɛ eyiteŋ fɛɛ mlu.
David kɛɛ Hushai akɛ, "Minaŋ ohe sɛɛ ko kɛji okɛ mi tee;

shi kɛji moŋ oku osɛɛ otee maŋ lɛ mli, ni oyakɛɛ Absalom akɛ, 'Nii Maŋtsɛ, otsulɔ ji mi; nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ otsɛ tsulɔ ji mi; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ mitsɔ̃ otsulɔ lɛ, jɛi baatsɔ̃ ni ooonyɛ ofite ŋaa ni Ahitofel aaawo Absalom lɛ.
Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli. Sane fɛɛ sane ni ooonu kɛaajɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ, obɔ amɛ.
Naa, amɛbihii enyɔ, ni ji Zadok bi Ahimaaz kɛ Abiatar bi Yonatan, yɛ jɛi. Okɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni ooonu lɛ atsu amɛ koni amɛkɛbahã mi."
No hewɔ lɛ David naanyo Hushai ku esɛɛ, ni etee maŋ lɛ mli; ni ekɛ Absalom Yerusalem shɛɛ yafee pɛ.
16: David efo mli yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ fioo kɛmiiya kɛkɛ ni Ziba, Mefiboshet tsulɔ lɛ, kɛ lɛ bakpe trukaa ni ehiɛ tejii enyɔ ni tere aboloo akwaabɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ wainyibii ni aka ni egbi shabii oha, kɛ agbami ŋmɔŋ shabii oha, kɛ wain wolotɔ kome.

Maŋtsɛ David bi Ziba akɛ, "Mɛni okɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ yaafee?" Ziba jie naa, ni ekɛɛ, "Tejii lɛ, koni akɛhã maŋtsɛ weku lɛ ni amɛtra nɔ; ni aboloo lɛ kɛ tsei ayibii lɛ, akɛyahã oblahii lɛ ni amɛye, ni wain lɛ kɛji etɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni ahã mɔ lɛ eko ni enu."
Kɛkɛ ni David bi Ziba akɛ, "Ni nɛgbɛ onuŋtsɔ bi Mefiboshet yɔɔ?" Ziba here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Eyɛ Yerusalem ejaakɛ esusumɔ ji akɛ Israelbii baakpale enii, Saul, maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã lɛ agbɛnɛ."
David kɛɛ Ziba akɛ, "Naa, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Mefiboshet nii lɛ, fɛɛ etsɔ̃ onɔ. "Kɛkɛ ni Ziba here nɔ akɛ, "Miyɛ odɛŋ Maŋtsɛ; omɔbɔnalɛ gbɛ kɛkɛ mikwɛɔ."
Be ni Maŋtsɛ David shɛ Bahurim akrowa lɛ, Saul wekunyo ko ni egbɛi ji Shimei ni atsɛɔ etsɛ akɛ Gera lɛ je kpo ekɛ David bakpe, ni be ni ebaa fɛɛ lɛ, belɛ eelomɔ Maŋtsɛ David.
Etswia David kɛ etsujii fɛɛ tɛ, tsɛ belɛ tabilɔi hii kakãbãi ebɔle David he yɛ eninejurɔ kɛ ebɛku fɛɛ.
Shimei lomɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Jee jɛi ni oya! Gbɔmɔgbelɔ! Yakagbɔmɔ!
Yehowa miiwo bo Saul wekumɛi alá shi ni oshwie lɛ fɛɛ he nyɔŋmɔ. Obashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Saul dɛŋ, ni Yehowa hu eshɔ̃ ekɛhã obinuu Abaslom. Bɛ ona akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni oji hewɔ lɛ ohiɛ ekpãtã?"
Kɛkɛ ni Abishai, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, kɛɛ David akɛ, "Nii, mɛɛ hewɔ oŋmɛ gbee nɛɛ gbɛ, ni elomɔ o? ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya mayafo eyitso."
Shi David kɛɛ Abishai kɛ enyɛbi Yoab akɛ, "Nyɛhe sane ko mɛ? Kɛji eelomɔ mi, ejaakɛ Yehowa ni tsu lɛ koni ebafee nakai lɛ, namɔ yɔɔ hegbɛ ni ebiɔ he sane ko?"

Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Abishai kɛ lɛ David etsuji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mi diɛŋtsɛ mimusuŋbi miitao mi egbe lɛ, mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ nɔ ni Benyaminnyo nɛɛ feɔ lɛ afee nyɛ naakpɛɛ? Nyɛŋmɛa ehe ni elomɔa, ejaakɛ Yehowa ni tsu lɛ koni ebafee.
Eko lɛ Yehowa aaana mi mɔbɔ yɛ mimanehulu nɛɛ hewɔ, ni ekɛ nɔ kpakpa moŋ aaato mi loomɔ ni elomɔɔ mi ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ najiaŋ."
David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ tsa amɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ. Be ni amɛyaa lɛ belɛ Shimei hu nyiɛ David ŋlɛnɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eelomɔ lɛ, asaŋ eetswia lɛ tɛ, ni eegbɛ mlu eewo ehe hu.
Etɔ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ bliboo be ni amɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ. Amɛwa, ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe yɛ jɛi.
Absalom kɛ Israel hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ esɛɛ lɛ bashɛ Yerusalem. Ahitofel fata amɛhe.
Be ni David naanyo Hushai, Arkinyo lɛ, kɛ Abaslom kpe lɛ Hushai ŋa lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nii, hã manye."
Shi Absalom bi Hushai akɛ, "Aso bɔ ni akɛ naanyo nyiɛɔ nɛ? Mɛɛba ni okɛ onaanyo lɛ eyaaa lɛ?"
Hushai jie naa ekɛɛ, "Mɛɛ nakai hu ni? Mɔ ni Yehowa kɛ maŋbii nɛɛ kɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ehala lɛ, lɛ egbɛfaŋ miyɔɔ, ni lɛ mikɛyaa.
Nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, namɔ po esa akɛ misɔmɔɔ yɛ minuŋtsɔ bi sɛɛ? Bɔ ni misɔmɔ otsɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ masɔmɔ bo hu,"
Kɛkɛ ni Absalom kɛɛ Ahitofel akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ, wo mi ŋaa. Mɛni feemɔ wɔyɔɔ?"
Ahitofel kɛɛ Absalom akɛ, "Yaa ni okɛ otsɛ hemɛi lɛ ni eshi yɛ sɛɛ akɛ amɛkwɛ shīa lɛ ayawɔ, koni okɛhã Israel muu fɛɛ ana ale akɛ okɛ otsɛ teŋ etsɛ. No baahã hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ osɛɛ lɛ ahe awa amɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ ashi buu yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ ahã Absalom, ni ekɛ etsɛ hemɛi lɛ wɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mi lɛ ŋaa fɛɛ ŋaa ni Ahitofel aaawo lɛ, aŋɔɔ lɛ tamɔ nii ni atee ayabi Nyɔŋmɔ. No hewɔ ni David kɛ Absalom fɛɛ buɔ eŋaawoo lɛ.
17: Ahitofel kɛɛ Absalom akɛ, "Hã mahala hii tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ koni mi kɛ amɛ atiu David nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ.
Maya mayatua lɛ be ni etɔ lɛ, ni enijiaŋ eje wui lɛ. Etsui baafã, ni maŋbii fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ aaajo foi ashi lɛ; magbe lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ,
ni mikɛ maŋbii ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ aaaku sɛɛ abahã bo tamɔ ayɛmfro ni akɛ lɛ miiya ayahã ewu. Gbɔmɔ kome kɛkɛ gbele otaoɔ, ni maŋbii fɛɛ atoiŋ aaajɔ amɛ."
Ŋaawoo nɛɛ sa Absalom kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Shi Absalom kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛtsɛa Hushai, Arkonyo lɛ, hu kɛbaa koni wɔbo nɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ hu enaa toi."
Be ni Hushai ba Absalom ŋɔɔ lɛ, Absalom kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ŋaa ni Ahitofel ewo nɛ, ani wɔye nɔ lo? Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo hu te okɛɔ tɛŋŋ?"
Hushai hã Absalom hetoo ni ekɛɛ, "Ŋaa ni Ahitofel wo ŋmɛnɛ lɛ ehiii.

Ole akɛ otsɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ tabilɔi hii kakabãi ji amɛ, ni amrɔ nɛɛ amɛhiɛ edɔ tamɔ oshishibrishi yoofɔyoo ni ayaju ebii yɛ ehe yɛ jwɛiiaŋ. Ole hu akɛ otsɛ lɛ tatsɛ Kpanaa ni, ni ekɛ maŋbii lɛ ehiŋ he kome nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ.
Naa, amrɔ nɛɛ eeeya tee ehe yɛ tɛkplo ko mli loo he ko. Kɛji anu akɛ David etua owebii lɛ, nɔ nɔŋŋ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu sane lɛ baakɛɛ kɛkɛ ji akɛ, 'Agbe Absalom webii lɛ bluublu.'
Kɛ eba lɛ nakai lɛ mɔ po ni eji kãkãlɔ, ni etsui wa tamɔ jata tsui lɛ, etsui baafã, ni ehe baajɔ, ejaakɛ Israel fɛɛ le akɛ otsɛ lɛ nuu kakabãa ji lɛ, ni hii ni fata ehe lɛ hu kãkãlɔi ni.
No hewɔ lɛ ŋaa ni miwoɔ ji akɛ obua Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa, kɛjɛ Dan aahuu kɛyashwie Beersheba, amɛyi baafa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia. Bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oya ta lɛ eko.
Ni wɔbaatiu David kɛya he fɛɛ he ni eyɔɔ, ni be ni eeehɛle shi lɛ wɔɔshwie enɔ tamɔ bɔ nyɔɔ lɛ, ni lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ.
Kɛji eeeba lɛ akɛ eeegbla ehe shi kɛaayabote maŋ ko mli lɛ, wɔwebii lɛ fɛɛ baaya ayaklɔ taŋkpei, ni wɔkɛbaashãtã maŋ lɛ wɔyawo jɔɔ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni anaŋ fɔbitɛ kome nɛkɛ yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli."
Absalom kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Hushai, Arkinyo lɛ ŋaawoo lɛ hi fe Ahitofel nɔ lɛ. "Ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ akaye Ahitofel ŋaawoo kpakpa lɛ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa ahã nɔ fɔŋ aba Absalom nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Hushai tee, ni eyabɔ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar nɔ ŋaa ni Ahitofel wo Absalom kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ, kɛ nɔ ŋaa ni lɛ, Hushai lɛ, hu ewo lɛ; ni ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ,

"No hewɔ lɛ nyɛtsua koni aya mramra ni ayakɛɛ David akɛ ekawɔ faafoohei lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ŋmɛnɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ, shi moŋ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ efo faa lɛ kɛya sɛɛ koni nine akabashɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ ni agbe amɛ."

Nɛkɛ bi mli lɛ Osɔfo Abiatar bi Yonatan kɛ Osɔfo Zadok bi Ahimaaz etee amɛhe yɛ Rogel nubu lɛ he, yɛ Yerusalem klotia, ni kɛfee lɛ atsuɔ oblanyo ko kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ wiemɔ yahãa amɛ, ni amɛkɛyahãa Maŋtsɛ David. Bɔ ni afee ni akana amɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yonatan kɛ Ahimaaz eyaaa maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ oblayo ko na amɛ gbi ko, ni etee eyakɛɛ Absalom. No hewɔ lɛ amɛsha amɛhe oyaoya kɛyabote nuu ko shīa yɛ Bahurim. Nuu lɛ yɛ nubu ko yɛ ekpo lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyabote mli.
Nuu lɛ ŋa kɔ mama, ni ekɛha bu lɛ naa, kɛkɛ ni egbɛ ŋmaa mli eka mama lɛ nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ akɔɔɔ sɛɛ.

Be ni Absalom tsuji lɛ bashɛ yoo lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ shīa lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ Yonatan kɛ Ahimaaz yɔɔ. "Yoo lɛ jie naa ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Amɛfo faa nine lɛ kɛtee. "Hii lɛ tiu amɛ, ni amɛyato amɛ, shi be ni amɛnaaa amɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛbaho Yerusalem.

Be ni Absalom tsuji lɛ ebaho amɛtee sɛɛ lɛ, Yonatan kɛ Ahimaaz je kpo yɛ nubu lɛ mli, ni amɛyi mli amɛtee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ amɛyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ, "Ŋaa ni Ahitofel ewo yɛ ohe nɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ ohe afee oya ni ofo faa lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ te shi, amɛyafo Yordan Faa lɛ; ni bi ni je kɛɛ etsereɔ lɛ eshwɛko amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ ni efoko Yordan.
Be ni Ahitofel na akɛ ayeee ŋaa ni ewo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo eteji nɔ nii, kɛkɛ ni eshi kɛtee emaŋ; ni be ni eto enibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ lɛ eyawo esɛ̃ kpãa, ni egbe ehe. Afu lɛ yɛ etsɛ gbonyo fuuhe lɛ mli.
David eshɛ Mahanaim momo dani absalom kɛ Israelbii fɛɛ fo Yordan lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Absalom efee Amase etatsɛ yɛ Yoab najiaŋ. Amasa nɛɛ Ishmaelnyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yeter lɛ kɛ Yoabnyo Zeruia nyɛmiyoo Nahash biyoo Abigail fɔ lɛ.
Absalom kɛ ewebii lɛ yato shi yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Be ni David yashɛ Mahanaim lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ: Shobi, ni ji Nahash ni jɛ Amonbii amaŋ Raba lɛ mli lɛn bi lɛ, kɛ Makir, ni ji Amiel ni ji Amiel ni jɛ Lo-Debar lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ Barzilai, Gileadnyo lɛ ni jɛ Rogelim lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.
Amɛhiɛ sai kɛ kã kɛ kuwɛii kɛ ŋmãa lɛ akoko kɛ ŋmãa ni awiɛ kɛ ma kɛ able kɛ akpatramɔ kɛ yɔɔ ni ashī,
kɛ wo kɛ butru kɛ too kɛ tsina keesui, ni amɛkɛbahã David kɛ ewebii bi fata ehe lɛ koni amɛye, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ etɔ amɛ, ni hɔmɔ kɛ kumai hu fɛɛ eye amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
18: Maŋtsɛ David kane tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ; kɛkɛ ni ejra amɛmli mɛi akpe akui kɛ mɛi oha akui, ni eto ku fɛɛ ku nɔ tatsɛ.

No sɛɛ lɛ eja tso muu lɛ fɛɛ mli etɛ̃. Ekɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ nɛɛ mli ekome wo Yoab shishi, ni ekɛ ekome hu wo Abishai, Zeruia bi Yoab nyɛmi lɛ shishi, ni ekɛ ekome ni eshwɛ lɛ wo Itai, Gatnyo lɛ shishi. Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ etabilɔi lɛ akɛ, "Mi diɛŋtsɛ hu mikɛ nyɛ miiya."

Shi tabilɔi lɛ here David nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Dabida! Okɛ wɔ akaya ta lɛ. Ejaakɛ kɛji wɔjo foi yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ amɛgbaŋ amɛhe naa yɛ wɔhe; ni kɛji agbe wɔyibɔ nɛɛ fã tete lɛ, amɛtsɛŋ lɛ nɔ ko. Shi bo lɛ ojra wa tamɔ wɔyi akpei-nyɔŋma. No hewɔ lɛ ehi moŋ akɛ ohi shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ojɛ biɛ oye obua wɔ."
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ etabilɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hi yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no mafee. "Kɛkɛ ni David yadamɔ maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi, ni etabilɔi lɛ to kɛbaho yɛ mɛi akpe akui kɛ mɛi oha akui anaa.
Maŋtsɛ David wo Yoab kɛ Abishai kɛ Itai kitã ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa mihewɔ, koni nyɛkɛ oblanyoo Absalom lɛ ayea blɛoo. "Tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ nu kitã ni Maŋtsɛ David wo tatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ absalom he lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David webii lɛ fã kɛba ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ bakpe. Awu ta lɛ yɛ Efraim koo lɛ mli.
David webii lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ anɔ yɛ jɛi, ni nakai gbi lɛ aplenee Israelbii lɛ fe nine, mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ nyɔ yɛ jɛi.
Ta lɛ gbɛ shwã jɛi kpokpai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ, ni koo lɛ kpãtã gbɔmɛi ahiɛ kwraa fe klaŋte tete.

Absalom kɛ David tabilɔi lɛ ekomɛi yakpe trukaa. Absalom ta tejiokpɔŋɔ nɔ; ni etee eyatsɔ̃ blɔfo yɔɔyi tso wulu ko shishi, kɛkɛ ni eyitso yaka tso lɛ niji ni ebu kusuu lɛ amli, kɛkɛ ni tejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ sha kɛje Absalom shishi etee, ni eshi Absalom ni etsotsro ŋwɛi kɛ Shikpɔŋ teŋ.
David webii lɛ eko na Absalom ni etee eyakɛɛ Yoab akɛ, "Miyana Absalom tsotsro shi yɛ blɔfo yɔɔyi tso ko nɔ."
Yoab kɛɛ mɔ ni bagba lɛ sane lɛ akɛ, "Ona lɛ lɛɛlɛŋ? Ni mɛɛba ogbeee lɛ yɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ. Kulɛ make bo jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ mlifiinɔ ko hu."

Shi nuu lɛ to he akɛ, "Kpaoo! kɛji akane jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe tete po awo midɛŋ lɛ, miwoŋ minine nɔ mitswaŋ maŋtsɛbi lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔtoiŋ ni Maŋtsɛ David wo bo kɛ Abishai kɛ Itai fɛɛ akpɔ akɛ, 'Mi mihewɔ lɛ nyɛkwɛa koni mɔ ko nine akata oblanyoo, Absalom, lɛ he.'
Kɛji migbo maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ toi, ni migbe Absalom lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ baana ele kɛ̃, ejaakɛ sane ko kwraa bɛ ni enaaa ele; ni ofaŋ mihe."
Yoab to he akɛ, "Miifite be po!" kɛkɛ ni Yoab klɔ akpɔi etɛ̃, ni etee ekɛyatsulɔ Absalom tsuiŋ be mli ni ehiɛ kã lolo yɛ yɔɔyi tso lɛ nɔ.
Oblahii nyɔŋma ni hiɛɔ Yoab tawuu nibii lɛ babɔle Absalom kɛkpe, ni amɛtswia lɛ nii, ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab hã akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni akpa ta lɛ wuu, ni no hewɔ lɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ.
Ajie Absalom gbonyo lɛ, ni ashɛ afɔ̃ bu agbo ko mli yɛ koo lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni amɛto tɛ amɛshwie enɔ aahuu ni etsɔ̃ ku kpeteŋkple. Israelbii lɛ jo foi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.

Be ni Absalom yɔɔ wala mli lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ema shiu ko yɛ Maŋtsɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli akɛ akɛkai lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛɛ ebɛ binuu ni baafɔ ewo lɛ koni egbɛi akagbo. Absalom kɛ egbɛi wo shiu nɛɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ atsɛɔ shiu akɛ Absalom Kaimɔ shiu.
Kɛkɛ ni Ahimaaz, Zadok bi lɛ, kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, "Hã ni masha foi maya mayabɔ maŋtsɛ amaniɛ akɛ Yehowa ehere eyiwala yɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ."
Yoab here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Dabida, jeee bo obaaya ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ oyabɔ amaniɛ. Gbi kroko jiŋŋ, oooya, oyabɔ amaniɛ; ŋmɛnɛ lɛ oyabɔŋ amaniɛ ejaakɛ maŋtsɛbi ni enyɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛɛ enyɔŋ, Sudannyo lɛ, akɛ, "Yaa ni oyagba maŋtsɛ nɔ ni ona. "Sudannyo lɛ koto Yoab kɛkɛ ni ewo foi kɛtee.

Shi Ahimaaz, Zadok bi lɛ, fi nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Yoab akɛ, "Hã ni mi hu maya ni mayabɔ amaniɛ; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaaba lɛ eba!" Yoab here Ahimaaz nɔ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ osumɔɔ doo akɛ bo hu obaaya oyabɔ amaniɛ lɛ? Naa, aekoo ko bɛ ni abaahã o yɛ he!"
Ahimaaz to he akɛ, "Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baaba lɛ, eba! Miisumɔ akɛ mi hu maya. "Yoab to he akɛ, "Yaa mɔ!" No hewɔ lɛ Ahimaaz wo foi kɛyi Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ lɛ nɔ; ni eyaho Sudannyo lɛ he.
Shi Maŋtsɛ David ta shi yɛ maŋ agboi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ koi lɛ shi; ni mɔ ni buɔ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee maŋ gbogbo lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ yiteŋ. Eyaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ naa nuu ko hiɛ foi ekome too kɛmiiba.
Bulɔ lɛ bo etsɛ, ni ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David. Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ bulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji ekome too ni lɛ, belɛ no lɛ atsu lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ sane. "Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ baa ahu kɛyashi ebɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ.

Shi bulɔ lɛ na nuu kroko ko hu ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiba. Kɛkɛ ni ebo etsɛ agbo naa bulɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, nuu kroko ko hu hiɛ foi ekome too kɛmiiba. "Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ akɛ, "Lɛ hu ehiɛ miishɛɛ sane Kɛmiiba."
Bulɔ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mɔ ni nyiɛ hiɛ lɛ foijee tamɔ Osɔfo Zadok bi Ahimaaz foijee pɛpɛɛpɛ. "Maŋtsɛ David to he, ni ekɛɛ, "Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ni; ni ehiɛ sane kpakpa kɛmiiba."

Ahimaaz bo ni ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Wɔye omanye eei!" Kɛkɛ ni eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Ada Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi akɛ ehã oye mɛi ni te shi amɛwo bo, maŋtsɛ, nɔ kunim."
Maŋtsɛ David bi akɛ, "Ani oblanyo Absalom lɛ yɛ jogbaŋŋ lo?" Ahimaaz jie naa akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, be ni Yoab tsu mi otsulɔ lɛ, mi lɛ mina ni aafee gidigidi ko; shi moŋ minaaa male nɔ ni eba."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, bo lɛ tsi ohe oyadamɔ afã dã. "No hewɔ lɛ etsi ehe ni eyadamɔ afã.
Ni naa, Sudannyo lɛ ni atsu lɛ hu ba. Ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ, mihiɛ miishɛɛ sane kɛba; ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa ehã oye mɛi ni te shi amɛwo bo lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim."
Maŋtsɛ David bi Sudannyo lɛ akɛ, "Ani oblanyo Absalom lɛ yɛ jogbaŋŋ lo?" Sudannyo lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mina ni nɔ ni eba enɔ lɛ kulɛ nakai nɔ ko aba ohenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni te shi amɛwo o lɛ fɛɛ nɔ."

Amaniɛ lɛ hã Maŋtsɛ David jijaa. Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ kɛtee pia ni yɔɔ maŋ agbo lɛ yiteŋ lɛ mli, ni eyafo. Be ni eyaa lɛ, efo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Mibi oo! Mibi Absalom! Mibi Absalom eei! Mina ni kulɛ, mibi, mi moŋ migbo yɛ onajiaŋ nɛɛ. Absalom mibi oo, mibi."
19: Ayagba Yoab akɛ Maŋtsɛ David ewo yara eefo yɛ Absalom hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ kunimyeli nyamɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli moŋ ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nakai gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ nu akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ ebinuu lɛ hewɔ.
Enɛ hã maŋbii lɛ ju shi kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli liɔɔliɔɔ tamɔ tabilɔi ni aye amɛnɔ ni amɛjo foi yɛ ta naa kɛba shīa.
Maŋtsɛ David ha ehiɛ, kɛkɛ ni ebo waa, "Ao! Mibi Absalom eei! Ao! Mibi, mibi Absalom!"
Yoab ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ shīa lɛ mli, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii, owo otabilɔi fɛɛ ni here bo kɛ obihii lɛ kɛ obiyei lɛ kɛ oŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ohemɛi lɛ ayiwala lɛ hiɛgble pam ŋmɛnɛ;

ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ osumɔɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ moŋ, ni onyɛɔ osuɔlɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ ŋmɛnɛ akɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ awala jeee fɛifɛi yɛ ohiɛ. Bɔ ni minaa sane lɛ ji akɛ Absalom yɛ wala mli, ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔgboi ŋmɛnɛ kulɛ eŋɔɔ onaa!

Wo ohe nɔ, agbɛnɛ, ni oje kpo, ni oyashɛje otabilɔi lɛ amii. Ejaakɛ kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mina Yehowa akɛ, wɔ be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ eshi o. Ni kɛ eba lɛ nakai lɛ, amanehulu ni ekɛbaaba onɔ lɛ, onako ehenɔ pɛŋ kɛjɛ oblahiiaŋ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ."
Maŋtsɛ David wo ehe nɔ, ni etee eyata maŋ agboi lɛ ateŋ koi lɛ shi. Be ni etabilɔi lɛ nu akɛ ebata koi lɛ shi lɛ, amɛtee amɛyabua ehe. Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Isrealbii lɛ fɛɛ ejojoo foi kɛtee amɛshīai,
