ni amɛmli efu amɛkutseiaŋ onukpai lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ David lɛ, lɛ ejie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehere wɔ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ; shi moŋ agbɛnɛ ejo Absalom naa foi kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni Absalom lɛ hu ni wɔwo lɛ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ, lɛ eyagbo yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ. Mɛɛba Maŋtsɛ lɛ kplamɔ kɛbaa lɛ nyɛwieee he lɛ?"

Be ni David na enu nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ lɛ, etsu ayakɛɛ Osɔfoi Zadok kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar akɛ amɛyakɛɛ Yuda maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni nyɛ moŋ nyɛkpe sɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kplamɔ mli kɛ ewe lɛ mli baa nɛɛ? Israelbii fɛɛ adaaŋ gbee ebashɛ midɛŋ.
Mɛɛba ni nyɛ ni ji minyɛmimɛi ni mi kɛ nyɛ laŋmɔ Kpãa kome lɛ, nyɛ moŋ nyɛkpe sɛɛ yɛ mikplamɔ kɛbaa mli nɛɛ?"
Asaŋ David shɛ amɛ koni amɛyakɛɛ Amasa akɛ, "Miwekunyo ji o, kɛji mitooo bo mitatsɛ yɛ Yoab najiaŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ awo mi nyɔmɔ."
Maŋtsɛ David wiemɔ hã Yudabii fɛɛ atsui mɔ lɛ; hewɔ lɛ amɛtsu ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ David ku esɛɛ eba Yordan lɛ naa, ni Yuda hii lɛ ba Gilead koni amɛbakpee lɛ ni akɛ lɛ afo faa lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Benyaminnyo, Gera, ni jɛ Bahurim lɛ binuu Shimei, ye ehe oyai, ni ekɛ Yuda hii lɛ kplekɛ shi kɛba Yordan naa koni ekɛ Maŋtsɛ david abakpe.
Benyamin hii akpe fata ehe. Ziba, Saul we lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, kɛ ebihii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ etsuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ hu ba. Ni amɛbashɛ Yordan lɛ naa be mli ni Maŋtsɛ David shɛko shi.

No hewɔ lɛ amɛfo faa lɛ kɛtee faa lɛ sɛɛ koni amɛjie maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fɛɛ faa, koni amɛkɛsa Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ. Maŋtsɛ David efee kralo kɛbaabote faafoo lɛlɛ lɛ mli pɛ, kɛkɛ ni Shimei, Gera binuu lɛ, ho ekula enajianaa,
ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, ofai nɛ, ni ohiɛ akpa efɔŋ ni mifee bo gbi ni oshiɔ Yerusalem lɛ nɔ. Kɛ onane ashushua nɔ kwraa koni okakai dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ, ofai nɛ, mile faŋŋ akɛ mifee esha; ni no hewɔ ni naa, miji mɔ tsuutsu ni jɛ kooyi akutsei lɛ amli, miba bo kpeemɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ."
Shi Zeruia bi Abishai here Shimei wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Loomɔ ni Shimei lomɔ mɔ ni Yehowa eto lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, esa gbele."
Shi David to he, ni ekɛɛ Zeruia bi Abishai kɛ enyɛmi Yoab akɛ, "Nyɛhe sane ko mɛ? Nyɛkawoa minajiaŋ. Ani ŋmɛnɛ ni mitsɔ Isreal fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ani abaagbe Israelnyo lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Shimei akɛ, "Agbeŋ o!" Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kã Shimei kitã.

Mefiboshet, Saul nabi lɛ hu ba ebakpee maŋtsɛ lɛ. Kɛjɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ shi Yerusalem lɛ, Mefiboshet fɔko enaji ahe dã lɛ, eshɛko etsɛŋ lɛ, etadei hu efɔko he dã, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ etee kɛbashi gbi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ eba shweshweeshwe lɛ.
Be ni Mefiboshet bashɛ shi kɛjɛ Yerusalem koni ebakpee maŋtsɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, "Mefiboshet, mɛɛba ni ofataa mihe kɛyaaa lɛ?"
Mefiboshet jie naa akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, ole akɛ akpaketsɛ ji mi. Mikɛɛ mitsulɔ lɛ akɛ ewo teji nɔ nii ehã mi koni mata nɔ ni mikɛ bo aya, shi elaka mi kɛ̃,
ni ebafo minaa moŋ efite mi ehã maŋtsɛ. Shi maŋtsɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, no hewɔ lɛ miyɛ odɛŋ, bɔ ni ooofee mi.
Kulɛ esa akɛ agbeɔ mitsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ, shi ohã mibafata mɛi ni yeɔ nii yɛ okplɔ̃ he lɛ ahe. Mɛɛ ejurɔ mitaoɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ dɛŋ dɔŋŋ?"
Shi Maŋtsɛ David to he akɛ, "Kaawie dɔŋŋ! Nɔ ni mikɛɛ ji akɛ Ziba kɛ bo baaja Saul gboshinii lɛ."
Mefiboshet here nɔ akɛ, "Ebaanyɛ fɛɛ tete eŋɔ. Akɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ ebashɛ ewe lɛ shweshweeshwe lɛ, no kɛkɛ fa hã mi."
Barzilai, Gileadnyo lɛ, jɛ Rogelim eba koni ebakwɛ Maŋtsɛ David yisɛɛ. Ejie Maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa koni ewa lɛ ni efo faa lɛ.
Barzilai egbɔ naakpa, eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ. Niiatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ, ni be mli ni Maŋtsɛ David yɔɔ Mahanaim lɛ, ebahãa lɛ niyenii.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã wɔtee Yerusalem koni mayakwɛ o yɛ miwe lɛ."
Shi Barzilai to he ehã Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, "Nii Maŋtsɛ, gbii enyiɛ po eshwɛ mi, hewɔ ni mikɛ o aaatee Yerusalem.

Afi nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ miye nɛɛ, ni amrɔ nɛɛ nɔ ko efeee mi akɔnɔ dɔŋŋ. Nii diɛŋtsɛ po ni miyeɔ jio aloo nii ni minuɔ jio, minuuu ŋɔɔmɔ ko he dɔŋŋ; ni kɛji nuu loo yoo miila po, minuuu kwraa. Jatsu moŋ miyatsɔ̃ mahã minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ.
Miyiŋtoo kɛkɛ ji akɛ miiba mibakwɛ minuŋtsɔ yisɛɛ koni efo Yordan lɛ koni mi kɛ lɛ aya hiɛ fioo kɛkɛ. Mɛɛba ni maŋtsɛ aaato mi najiaŋ?

Ofai nɛ, hã maku misɛɛ maya koni miyagbo yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ, ni afu mi yɛ mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ mlishi. Naa, mibinuu Kimham moŋ. Nii maŋtsɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛya ni eyasɔmɔ Nii Maŋtsɛ koni Nii afee lɛ ejurɔ bɔ ni Nii sumɔɔ."
Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mi kɛ Kimham baaya, ni mafee lɛ ejurɔ ni baasa ohiɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi mi lɛ mafee mahã o."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David shwɔ Barzilai naa, ni ejɔɔ lɛ. Maŋtsɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fɛɛ fo Yordan Faa lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Barzilai hu ku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋ.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israelbii fã ni yakpa lɛ gbɛ lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Gilgal. Kimham fata ehe kɛtee.

Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii Maŋtsɛ, mɛɛba wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudabii lɛ kɛkɛ ni ba amɛbakpee bo, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛfo maŋtsɛ kɛ ebii kɛ hɔi kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fɛɛ faa lɛ?"
Yudahii lɛ here Israelbii lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, Ejaakɛ wɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ jɛ weku kome. Mɛɛba ni enɛ feɔ nyɛ mlifu? Mɛni nyɛle ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ehã wɔ wɔye, aloo ni eke wɔ?"

Israelbii lɛ to he amɛhã Yudabii lɛ akɛ, "Gbɛnaa nii ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David gbɛfaŋ lɛ, wɔyɛ nakai toi nyɔŋma yɛ egbɛfaŋ. Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni nyɛbuuu wɔ. Kwɛ jeee wɔ tsuutsu moŋ wɔwo ŋaa akɛ ayaŋɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛba lɛ?" Shi Yudabii lɛ anaa yawa fe Israelbii lɛ yɛ sane nɛɛ mli.
20: Nuu yakagbɔmɔ ko baje Gilgal. Atsɛɔ lɛ Sheba, ni etsɛ gbɛi ji Bikri, Benyaminnyo lɛ. Sheba kpã tɛtrɛmaŋtrɛ ni ebo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Israel eei! Wɔbɛ gbɛnaa ko yɛ David gbɛfaŋ. Wɔ kɛ Ishai bi lɛ ejaaa nɔ ko. No hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya ewe."
Kɛkɛ ni Israel hii lɛ kpa yɛ David sɛɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ Bikri bi Sheba sɛɛ. Shi Yuda hii lɛ kpɛtɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛjɛ Yordan naa aahuu kɛyashɛ Yerusalem.

Be ni Maŋtsɛ David bashɛ ewe lɛ mli yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, ehã akɛ yei nyɔŋma ni ji ehemɛi lɛ ni eshi akɛ amɛkwɛ shīa lɛ yato he ko banee, ni atsi amɛna awo shīa ko mli. Elɛ amɛ, shi eyaaa amɛmasɛi, ni ehã amɛhi shi tamɔ okulafoi kɛyashi amɛgbele be.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Amasa akɛ, "Yaa ni oyakpee Yuda hii fɛɛ obahã mi yɛ biɛ gbii etɛ̃ mli; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oba biɛ eko."
Amasa yiŋ etee koni eyakpee Yuda hii lɛ ebahã maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi eyatsɛ fe be ni ato lɛ lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Abishai akɛ, "Etamɔ nɔ ni Bikri bi Sheba baagba wɔnaa fe Absalom tete. ŋɔɔ mitabilɔi lɛ, ni nyɛtiua lɛ koni ekayana maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ amli eyabote ni etsɔ̃ jɛi eje wɔdɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abishai kɛ Yoab kɛ tabilɔi lɛ ni ji Keretifoi lɛ kɛ Peletifoi lɛ ni buɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he lɛ, kɛ hii kakãbãi lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Yerusalem koni amɛyatiu Sheba, Bikri bi lɛ.

Be ni amɛyaa ni amɛyashɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Gibeon lɛ he lɛ, Amasa kɛ amɛ bakpe. No mli lɛ Yoab emia kɛ tawuu atade. Afi atade ni ewo lɛ mli, ni klaŋte fi nɔ yɛ ehɛ. Klaŋte lɛ je ehebo lɛ mli egbee shi, be ni Yoab tsiɔ ebɛŋkɛɔ Amasa lɛ.
Yoab ŋa Amasa akɛ, "Te oyɔɔ tɛŋŋ, anyɛminuu?" Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ eninejurɔ mɔ Amasa tsɛŋ mli koni eshwɔ enaa.

Amasa enaaa akɛ Yoab hiɛ klaŋte yɛ edɛŋ; ni no hewɔ lɛ Yoab kɛ klaŋte lɛ du Amasa musuŋ ni Amasa musuŋnii tue shwie shi. Eduuu lɛ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ, ni egbo. Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ enyɛmi Abishai tsa amɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛtiu Sheba, Bikri bi lɛ.
Oblahii tabilɔi ni yɔɔ Yoab shishi lɛ atɛŋ mɔ kome ko ho yadamɔ Amasa gbonyo lɛ masɛi, ni ebo ekɛɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ Yoab kɛ David sɛɛ lɛ, eyi Yoab sɛɛ."

Belɛ Amasa gbonyo lɛ kã shi ni lá ewu ehe kpɔtɔɔ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu. Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ ni ehiɛ gbaa enɔ lɛ, ewaa edamɔɔ shi. Be ni oblanyo lɛ na akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bashɛɔ gbonyo lɛ he yɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ waa damɔɔ shi lɛ, ewo Amasa kɛjɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛyaŋmɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ mama ha enɔ.
Be ni ajie gbonyo lɛ kɛje gbejegbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mɛi lɛ fɛɛ loo mli kɛnyiɛ Yoab sɛɛ kɛtiu Shebs, Bikri bi lɛ.
Sheba tsɔ̃ Israel akutsei lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kɛho, ni be ni eyashɛ Abel Bet-Maaka lɛ, Bikribii lɛ bua amɛhe naa, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ kɛbabote maŋ lɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni Yoab shishi tabilɔi lɛ basa Sheba yi amɛwo Abel Bet-Maaka maŋ lɛ mli. Amɛkɛ su tswa kpoku ni ekwɔlɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ kwɔlɛ yɛ egbɔ. Asaŋ amɛshimɔshimɔɔ gbogbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu koni amɛwule lɛ amɛshwie shi.
Shi yoo nilelɔ ko bo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛboa toi! Nyɛboa toi! Nyɛtsɛa Yoab nyɛhãa mi koni mi kɛ lɛ awiea."
Yoab tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ. Yoo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Boji Yoab lɛ?" Yoab here nɔ akɛ, "Mi ni. "Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ ni obo mi toi. "Yoab kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miibo bo toi."
Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Sa lɛ kɛji anaaa sane ko naa lɛ bɔ ni akɛɔ ji akɛ, 'Aya Abel ni ayabi?'
Ejaakɛ Israel maji ni sumɔɔ hejɔlɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli lɛ ateŋ eko ji Abel. Oba ootoa okpãtã maŋ ni ji biianyɛ hã Israel lɛ hiɛ. Mɛɛba ni obaakpãtã Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ nii hiɛ nɛɛ?"
Yoab here yoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Kpaoo! Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ̃ akɛ makpãtã nyɛmaŋ lɛ hiɛ?

Jeee nakai nyiɛmɔ kwraa wɔnyiɛ. Sane lɛ moŋ ji akɛ nuu ko ni jɛ Efraim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sheba, Bikri binuu lɛ, ete shi ewo Maŋtsɛ David. Nyɛjiea lɛ nyɛhãa wɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ wɔbaashi nyɛmaŋ lɛ ni wɔya. "Yoo lɛ kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, "Kɛfee lɛ abaafɔ̃ eyitso kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ ahã bo."

Yoo lɛ tee ekɛ sane lɛ yafɔ̃ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni ehã amɛfo Sheba yitso, ni afɔ̃ kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ ahã Yoab. Enɛ hã Yoab kpã tɛtrɛmaŋtrɛ, ni etabilɔi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ tuamɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshīa. Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ku esɛɛ eba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Yerusalem.
Agbɛnɛ Yoab ji Israel fɛɛ tatsɛnukpa, ni Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ji Keretifoi kɛ Peletifoi ni ji maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ atsɛ.
Adoniram ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ, ni Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, buɔ nibii ahe akɔntaa.
Sheva ji woloŋmalɔ, ni Zabok kɛ Abiatar ji osɔfoi,
ni David osɔfo kroko hu ji Ira, Yairnyo lɛ.
21: David yinɔ lɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa ko ba afii nɔtonɔto shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ. Enɛ hã David tee ni eyabi Yehowa nii. Yehowa kɛɛ David akɛ, "Enɛ fɛɛ jɛ Saul kɛ ewe lɛ yɛ Gibeonbii lɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ hewɔ."
Gibeonbii nɛɛ, jeee Israelbii ni, shi moŋ Amorbii ni shwɛ ji amɛ. Israelbii lɛ ekã amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkpãtãŋ amɛhiɛ, shi be ni Saul hiɛ dɔ yɛ Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, kulɛ eetao ekpãtã amɛhiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ David tsɛ Gibeonbii lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mifee mihã nyɛ, ni mɛni mikɛkpãtã nyɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛjɔɔ Yehowa webii lɛ?"

Gibeonbii lɛ hã hetoo, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Sane ni kã wɔ kɛ Saul kɛ ewe lɛ teŋ lɛ, anyɛŋ akɛ jwiɛtɛi loo shika akpãtã, ni asaŋ jeee akɛ wɔmiitao Israelnyo ko lá shi wɔshwie. "David bi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mɔ nyɛtaoɔ ni mafee mahã nyɛ?"
Gibeonbii lɛ to he akɛ, "Saul tao akɛ, ekpãtã wɔhiɛ kɛbule wɔshishi kwraa yɛ Israel,
No hewɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ eshwiei amli hii kpawo ohã wɔ koni wɔyasɛŋ amɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Gibea, yɛ Saul, mɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli. "Maŋtsɛ David to he ni ekɛɛ, "Mibahã nyɛ mɛi lɛ."
Kitã ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Saul bi Yonatan kãmɔ amɛhe lɛ hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David shi Yonatan bi Mefiboshet, ni ji Saul nabi lɛ, sɛɛ,
ni eŋɔ mɛi nɛɛ: Armoni kɛ Mefiboshet ni ji bihii enyɔ ni Aia biyoo Rizpa kɛ Saul fɔ lɛ, kɛ bihii enumɔ hu ni Saul biyoo Merah kɛ Adriel, Meholatnyo Barzilai bi lɛ, fɔ lɛ.

David kɛ amɛ wo Gibeonbii lɛ adɛŋ, ni Gibeonbii lɛ sɛŋ amɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ amɛgboi shi kome. Ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ shishijee be lɛ mli asɛŋ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; no mli lɛ abɔi akoko foo.

Kɛkɛ ni Aia, biyoo, Rizpa, Saul hemɔ lɛ, kɔ kpekpe ni eshi lɛ buu eha enɔ yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ he ni gbohii lɛ jwere lɛ, kɛjɛ nikpamɔ shishijee be lɛ mli kɛyashi be ni nu bɔi nɛmɔ kɛ amɛnɔshwiemɔ. Shwane lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ koni loofɔji abasɔmɔ gbohii lɛ anɔ, ni nyɔɔŋ hu eshwieɔ ŋaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhe.
Be ni David nu nɔ ni Rizpa efee lɛ,

etee ni eyaŋɔ Saul wui lɛ kɛ Yonatan hu wui lɛ yɛ Yabesh Gileadbii lɛ adɛŋ kɛba. Ejaakɛ gbi ni Filistibii lɛ gbe Saul yɛ Gilboa lɛ, amɛkɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan gbohii lɛ ba ni amɛkɛbatsotsro shi yɛ Bet- Shan blohu lɛ mli, ni Yebesh-Gileadbii lɛ baju gbohii lɛ kɛtee.
David yaŋɔ Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan wui lɛ kɛjɛ jɛi kɛba, ni ekɛbafata Saul shwiei amli hii kpawo lɛ ni asɛŋ lɛ awui lɛ ahe.

Akɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan wui lɛ tee, ni ayafu yɛ Saul tsɛ Kish fuuhe lɛ, yɛ Zela yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Afee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ efã lɛ. No sɛɛ dani Nyɔŋmɔ bo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ afai ni amɛkpa amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ toi.
Ta te shi yɛ Filistibii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ekoŋŋ, ni David kɛ etabilɔi fã, ni amɛtee amɛ kɛ Filistibii yawu. Nɔmɔ lɛ dɛŋ David, ni be ni akɛshɛ he ko lɛ David tɔ biti.
Kɛkɛ ni nuu oblaŋ gojoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ishbi-Benob lɛ fã kɛba kɛ yiŋtoo akɛ ebaagbe David. Edɛŋ akplɔ tsiimɔ ji akɔɔble shekeli ohai etɛ̃, ni klaŋte hee ŋmɔ ehɛ.

Shi Abishai, ni ji Zeruia bi lɛ, bahere David. Ebatswa Filistinyo lɛ nɔ, ni egbe lɛ. Jɛi ni David tabilɔi lɛ hã David kã amɛ kitã akɛ efataŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ ta dɔŋŋ. Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ wɔ akaya ta dɔŋŋ koni okabahã Israel hiɛnɔkamɔ miitã."
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ wu ta ekoŋŋ yɛ Gob. Ta nɛɛ mli ni Sibekai, Hushanyo lɛ, gbe hii oblaŋi gojogojoi lɛ ashwiei lɛ ateŋ eko ni gbɛi ji Saf lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ku sɛɛ amɛwu ta yɛ Gob ekoŋŋ. No mli Elhanan, ni ji Betlehemnyo Yaare-Oregim bi lɛ, gbe Goliat, Gatnyo lɛ ni ekplɔ mlitso ti tamɔ mamalolɔ agba tso tilɛ lɛ.
Awu ta ko hu yɛ Gat, ni nuu ko kɛ enine kɛ enane waobii ekpaaekpaa ba ta lɛ eko.
Nuu nɛɛ tswa Israelbii lɛ mpoa, kɛkɛ ni Yonatan, ni ji David nyɛmi Shimei bi lɛ, tswa lɛ nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.
Hii oblaŋi gojogojoi ni hi shi yɛ Gat lɛ ashwiei ji oblaŋi ejwɛ nɛɛ ni David kɛ tabilɔi lɛ gbe lɛ.
22: Be ni Yehowa jie David yɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Saul hu dɛŋ lɛ, David la lala nɛɛ:
Yehowa ji mitɛsaa, kɛ mimɔɔ kɛ miherelɔ.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mitsɛsaa, mɔ mli ni mibaa abo yɛ. Ebuɔ mihe tamɔ tsɛŋ, ni efãa mihe, ni ehãa mifeɔ shweshweeshwe. Lɛji miyiwalaherelɔ ni buɔ mihe, ni hereɔ mi kɛjɛɔ nɔnaa mli.
Mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni sa yijiemɔ lɛ, ni ehere mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ. Ajie Yehowa yi!
Gbele ŋshɔkei bɔle mi kɛkpe, ni fai fɔ̃ɔji wo mihe gbeyei.
Gbohiiaje kpãi bɔle mi kɛkpe, ni gbele tsɔ̃ mi tsɔne.
Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, mibo mitsɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ejɛ e-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni enu migbee; miblɔmɔ lɛ yashɛ etoiŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso; ni ekpokpo, ŋwɛi shishitoi lɛ hu hoso, ni amɛkpokpo ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli efu.
Lasu fã kɛjɛ egugɔ mli, ni la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ jɛ edaaŋ; ŋai ni miitsɛ̃ hu jɛ edaaŋ.
Egba ŋwɛi mli, ni ekpleke shi, Yehowa hã ŋwɛi kpoo enaa shi, ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni duŋ kpii yɛ enaneshi.
Eta Kerubi nɔ, ni efliki; ana lɛ ni eta kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ.
Ekɛ duŋ kpii ha ehe, ni atatui kpiikpii ni eyi kɛ nu bɔle ehe kɛkpe.
Ŋai ni miitso kpɛlɛ la kɛjɛ ehiɛ ni kpɛɔ haŋŋ lɛ mli.
Yehowa gbee shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi; Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ wo egbeeŋ.
Etsrɛ̃ egåii lɛ ekɛgbɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ eshwã; ni ekɛ srawa hu wo amɛ foi.
Kɛkɛ ni ana ŋshɔ shishi kã shi, ni agble je lɛ shishitoo atsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ, be ni Yehowa kã ehenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ mlifu blɔ ewo amɛ lɛ.
Yehowa jɛ ŋwɛi ekpã enine mli emɔ mimli, ni esha mi kɛjɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Ehere mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni he wa lɛ adɛŋ; kɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ hu adɛŋ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa tsɔ̃ fe mi.
Amɛbatua mi yɛ amanehulu be mli, shi Yehowa bu mihe.
Ejie mi yɛ oshrã mli, ni ehere mi, ejaakɛ eyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ.
Yehowa dro mi, ejaakɛ mifee nii ni ja; ni ejɔɔ mi, ejaakɛ mifeko efɔŋ ko.
Miye Yehowa mlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mishiko mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Miye emlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mitɔ̃ko ekpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ele akɛ fɔbuu ko bɛ mihe, ni ele akɛ miwi mihe kɛje nɔ fɔŋ he.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa fee mi ejurɔ yɛ mijalɛ naa, yɛ fɔbuu ko ni bɛ mihe lɛ naa.
Mɛi ni yeɔ bo anɔkwa lɛ bo hu oyeɔ amɛ anɔkwa; ni mɔ ni fɔbuu ko bɛ ehe lɛ naa bo akɛ mɔ ni eye emuu.
Mɔ ni he tse lɛ, okɛ ohe tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni he tse; shi mɔ ni yi wa lɛ, okɛ lɛ yeee.
Ohereɔ humii ayiwala, shi henɔwolɔi lɛ obaa amɛ shi.
Yehowa, lɛɛlɛŋ boji kane, ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ hãa minaa nii yɛ duŋ mli.
Anɔkwa, bo ohewalɛ mikɛyeɔ henyɛlɔi anɔ, ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ mikɛhuruɔ henyɛlɔ gbogbo.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shwamɔ ko bɛ enifeemɔ he; ni ewooo shi ni efee yaka. Etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔɔ tsɛŋ ehãa mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Yehowa pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji wɔhefãlɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mibobaa mɔɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ji lɛ; ehãa migbɛ jaa hãa mi.
Ehãa minajiaŋ waa tamɔ ofrote, ni ebaa miyi yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Etsɔ̃ɔ mi tawuu, koni manyɛ akɔɔble gãi matsɛ̃.
Yehowa, obaa miyi, ni ohere mi; oyelikɛbuamɔ ehã mitsɔ̃ mɔ wulu.
Ohã mi foijeehei babaoo, ni migbeko shi pɛŋ.
Mitiuɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni mikpãtãa amɛhiɛ, ni mikpaleee kɛyashi mipleneɔ amɛ.
Mitswiaa amɛ nii bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ, ni amɛnyɔnyɔɔ yɛ minajiashi.
Ejaakɛ omiaa mi kɛhã tawuu; ohãa mihenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ minajiashi.
Ohãa mihenyɛlɔi joɔ minaa foi, ni mikpãtãa mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.
Amɛkwɛ gbɛ, shi yiwalaheremɔ ko bɛ; amɛkwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; shi efooo amɛdaaŋ.
Mishimɔ amɛ muɛmuɛ tamɔ mlu; minaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ gbɛteŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
Ojie mi yɛ mimaŋ maŋsɔi amli, ni obaa miyi akɛ majimaji anɔ maŋtsɛ; ni mɛikpɔi ni mileee tete ebatsɔ̃ mishisbii agbɛnɛ
Maŋsɛɛbii kotoɔ mi, ni kɛ miwie lɛ amɛboɔ mi toi.
Maŋsɛɛbii lɛ anijiaŋ je wui, ni amɛshi amɛmɔji lɛ amli amɛba kɛ hekpokpomɔ.
Yehowa hiɛ kã! Ajie mihefãlɔ lɛ yi! Akafo Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji miyiwalaherelɔ lɛ agbojee.
Lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ ni tɔ mihe owele ni eba maji ashi ewo mishishi,
asaŋ ni ehere mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ lɛ. Yehowa, owoɔ mi otaa mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayiteŋ, ni obaa miyi kɛjɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ majie oyi, Yehowa, matsɔ̃ɔ majimaji lɛ; mala makafo bo.
Ohã maŋtsɛ lɛ eye kunim wuji yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, ni osumɔɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu owo lɛ maŋtsɛ, ni ji David kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ kɛyaa naanɔ.
23: David, Ishai bi lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo enɔ gojoo lɛ, mɔ hu ni Yakob Nyɔŋ lɛ ehala ni eto lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, flɔ lalai kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ nɛɛ ehã Israel. Wiemɔi nɛɛ ji enaagbee wiemɔi.
Yehowa mumɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ minɔ ewieɔ; ewiemɔ kã mililɛi nɔ.
Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ena ewie; Israel hebulɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Mɔ ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni eyeɔ nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ naa lɛ,
etamɔ leebi hulu ni tsoɔ yɛ nunɛmɔ sɛɛ, be ni oblɔtu bɛ; etamɔ nu ni hãa jwɛifɔ fɛ̃ɔ shi yɛ shikpɔŋ."
Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baajɔɔ miwe lɛ nɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ mi ekpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ,kpãŋmɔ ko ni akuŋ mli, shiwoo ko ni atsakeŋ hiɛ. Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ baahã mi yelikɛbuamɔ ni he ehia, kɛ mitaomɔ nii fɛɛ.
Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, amɛtamɔ ŋmei ni ashɛrɛ ashwie; anyɛɛɛ akɛ nine flo ata amɛhe;
mɔ ni aaata he lɛ ja ehiɛ dade kɛ akplɔ; ni akɛ la shãa amɛ wɛɛ.
David tabilɔi kakabãi lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ ji Yosheb-Bashebet, Takemonnyo lɛ, mɔ ni ji "Kakabãi Onukpai Etɛ̃" lɛ ateŋ onukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ. Ewo ekplɔ nɔ lɛ ekɛgbe mɛi ohai kpaanyɔ yɛ ta kome mli.

Esɛɛmɔ yɛ hii kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ ji Eleazar, Dodo Ahohinyo lɛ, bi lɛ. Gbi ko lɛ efata David he, ni amɛtswa Filistibii ni ebabua shi akɛ amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ baawu lɛ mpoa. Isrealbii lɛ naa sɛɛsɛɛ, shi

edamɔ shi akɛ nuu, ni ekpee ta lɛ naa, ni egbe Filistibii lɛ aahuu kɛyashi ekɔ̃ji gboi yɛ ehe bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehiii lɛ eklaŋte lɛ nɔwomɔ dɔŋŋ. Yehowa ye kunim kpeteŋkple nakai gbi lɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ. Fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ ba he ni Eleazer wu ta lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni amɛbakplɔ gbohii lɛ ahe nibii kɛtee.
Hii kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Shama, Agee, Hararnyo lɛ, bi lɛ. Filistibii lɛ babua shi yɛ Lehi, he ni Shikpɔŋ ko ni akɛdu akwɛŋ yɔɔ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ jo Filistibii lɛ anaa foi.
Shi Shama ho edamɔ shi yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni egbe Filistibii lɛ ekafã ŋmɔ lɛ he. Ni Yehowa ye kumin kple ehã Israelbii lɛ nakai gbi lɛ.

Be ni eshwɛ fioo ni abɔiɔ ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ lɛ, Israel hii kakabãi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɛi etɛ̃ komɛi ba David ŋɔɔ yɛ Adulam tɛkplo lɛ mli. Nakai be mli lɛ filistibii lɛ efã ta kɛba, ni amɛbato shi yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
No mli lɛ David yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni Filistibii asraafoi lɛ ebaŋɔ Betlehem.
David shwe shīa ekɛɛ akɛ, "Namɔ po mana koni eya Betlehem eyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu ebahã mi manu?"

Kɛkɛ ni hii Kakabãi etɛ̃ nɛɛ gba kɛtsɔ̃ Filistibii tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ ekãa naa kɛho, ni amɛtee amɛyayɛ nabu lɛ ni yɔɔ Betlehem maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu, ni amɛkɛbahã David. David enuuu, shi moŋ efɔse eshwie shikpɔŋ akɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛmiishã afɔle ehã Yehowa;

ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa, enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ̃ akɛ manu nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ, ejaakɛ yɛ gbɛ ko nɔ lɛ, hii lɛ ni shã amɛhe afɔle lɛ alá ni. "No hewɔ lɛ David enuuu nu lɛ. Ekãa naa nibii kokomɛi ni hii kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ tsu lɛ nɛ.

Abishai, Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛji Zeruia lɛ, ji hii kakabãi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ anukpa. Ekɛ hii ohai etɛ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛ edɛŋ akplɔ gbe amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm. Enɛ hã ena gbɛi yɛ hii Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ.
Egbɛi hehe fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hii kãkãlɔi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ, ni no hewɔ lɛ etsɔ amɛnukpa, shi moŋ eninaaa kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ.

Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ni jɛ Kabzeel lɛ, lɛ hu hii kakabãi lɛ eko ni; ni efee ekãa naa nibii srɔtoi wuji babaoo. Eko ji akɛ egbe Moabbii tabilɔi enyɔ komɛi. Be ko hu lɛ ekplekɛ shi kɛtee, ni eyagbe jata yɛ bu ko mli yɛ snoo be mli.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ esaa egbe Egiptnyo nyenyreŋŋ ko ni hiɛ akplɔ yɛ edɛŋ ekɛmiifã ehe. Shi Benaia hiɛ tso, ni ekɛyatua Egiptnyo lɛ, ni eshɔ̃ akplɔ lɛ yɛ adɛŋ, ni ekɛ Egiptnyo lɛ nɔŋŋ akplɔ lɛ gbe lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ fee, ni ekɛna gbɛi yɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ lɛ ateŋ.
Ena gbɛi jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ, shi eninaaa kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ. David wo lɛ ehebulɔi lɛ anukpa.
Hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni shwɛɔ lɛ ji Asahel, Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Elhanan, Dodo ni Betlehem lɛ bi lɛ.
Kɛ Shama kɛ Elika ni amɛjɛ Harod lɛ, kɛ
Helez Pelet nyo lɛ kɛ Ira, Ikesh ni jɛ Tekoa lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ
Abiezer ni jɛ Anatot lɛ, kɛ Mebunai ni jɛ Husha lɛ, kɛ
Zalmon ni jɛ Ahoh lɛ, kɛ Maharai ni jɛ Netofa lɛ
kɛ Heleb, Baana ni jɛ Netofa lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Itai, Rabai ni jɛ Gibea yɛ Benyamin lɛ;
Benaia ni jɛ Piraton lɛ, kɛ Hidai ni jɛ Gaash faa lɛ he jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ
Abi-Albon ni jɛ Araba lɛ, kɛ Azmawet ni jɛ Bahurim lɛ kɛ
Eliaba ni jɛ Shaalbon lɛ, kɛ Yashen bihii lɛ kɛ Yonatan kɛ
Shama ni jɛ Harar lɛ, kɛ Ahiam Sharar ni jɛ Harar lɛ bi, lɛ kɛ
Elifelet, Ahasbai ni jɛ Maaka lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Elaim, Ahitofel ni jɛ Gilon lɛ bi lɛ'
Hezro ni jɛ Karmel lɛ, kɛ Paara ni jɛ Arbi lɛ kɛ
Igal, Natan bi lɛ ni jɛ Zoba lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Bani ni jɛ Gab lɛ kɛ
Zelek ni jɛ Amon lɛ, kɛ Naharai ni jɛ Beerot lɛ, mɔ ni hiɛɔ zeruia bi Yoab tawuunii lɛ, kɛ
Ira kɛ Gareb ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛjɛ Yatri lɛ, kɛ
Uria Hitnyo lɛ. Tabilɔi kãkãlɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ feɔ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
24: Yehowa mli bafu Israelbii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni etsɔ̃ David nɔ, ni egbla amɛtoi. Yehowa kɛɛ David akɛ, "Yaa ni oyakane Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Yoab ni ji etatsɛnukpa lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ tabilɔi anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ ayakpa Israelbii akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli, kɛjɛ Dan aahuu kɛyashi Beersheba, koni nyɛkane maŋbii lɛ nyɛhã mi koni male amɛikulɛ."

Shi Yoab here Maŋtsɛ David nɔ akɛ, "Nii, Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã maŋbii ayikulɛ ŋmɛnɛ aku abɔ he nakai toi oha, enɛ aaanyɛ aba mli yɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ yinɔ hu. Shi mɛni eba hewɔ ni Nii toaɔ ekane maŋ lɛ nɛɛ?"
Shi maŋtsɛ lɛ hã Yoab kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ye ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ Yoab kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ shi Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ amɛtee koni amɛyakane Israelbii lɛ.
Amɛyafo Yordan faa lɛ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Aroer, ni ji maŋ ni kã Gad Faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ. Amɛjɛ jɛi amɛtee kooyigbɛ kɛyashɛ Yazer.
Amɛtsa nɔ kɛtee Gilead kɛ Kadesh yɛ Hitbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛtee Dan, ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ amɛdɔ amɛyi amɛfɔ̃ anaigbɛ kɛtee Sidon.
Amɛyi wuoyigbɛ agbɛnɛ kɛtee Tiro, ni ji maŋ ni awaje yɛ ta hewɔ lɛ, kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ kanaanbii lɛ amaji lɛ fɛɛ amli, ni amɛyagbe naa yɛ Beersheba yɛ Yuda wuoyigbɛ.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbashɛ Yerusalem nyɔji nɛɛhu kɛ gbii nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɛɛ, be mli ni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
Yoab kɛ maŋbii ni ayakane lɛ ayibɔ lɛ bahã Maŋtsɛ David. Ana hii hiɛwalɔi ni eshɛ tayaa akpei ohai kpaanyɔ yɛ Israel kɛ hii akpei ohai enumɔ hu yɛ Yuda.

Shi be ni David ekane maŋbii lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ehenilee bɔi enaagbamɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Mifee esha kple akɛ mifee nɛkɛ nɔ ko. Ofai nɛ ni okɛfa mi, ejaakɛ miye kwashiai asane naakpã!" 11-12. Yehowa kɛɛ Gad, ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ David he lɛ,akɛ, "Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ mikɛ nibii etɛ̃ miishwie ehiɛ ni ekɔ mli ekome koni mafee mahã lɛ. "Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni David te shi lɛ,

Gab yanina lɛ, ni ebɔ lɛ amaniɛ, asaŋ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Te amɛteŋ nɔ ni okɔɔ lɛ? Akɛ hɔmɔ aba oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii etɛ̃, aloo ohenyɛlɔi anyiɛ osɛɛ ni ojo amɛnaa foi nyɔŋji etɛ̃, aloo gbele hela abayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii etɛ̃? Susumɔ he okwɛ, koni ohã mi hetoo ni mikɛyahã mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ."
David hã Gad hetoo akɛ, "Sane lɛ wa hã mi naakpa. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ misumɔŋ akɛ mayaje gbɔmɔ adesa dɛŋ. Wɔyɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, emɔbɔnalɛ fa."
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã gbele hela babote Israelbii ateŋ kɛjɛ gbi lɛ leebi lɛ kɛyashi be ni ato lɛ. Kɛjɛ Dan aahuu kɛ kɛyashwie Beersheba lɛ hela nɛɛ gbe mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo.

Shi be ni bɔfo ni kpãtãa maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ yaata Yerusalem he lɛ, Yehowa tsake ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ efɔŋ ni eba maŋbii lɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni ekɛɛ bɔfo ni gbeɔ mɛi lɛ akɛ, "Efa, kɛwa biɛ!" No be lɛ mli lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ yɛ Arauna, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmaa gbeemɔhe lɛ.

Be ni David na bɔfo lɛ ni tswiaa maŋbii lɛ nii lɛ David kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Naa, mi mifee esha lɛ; ni mi mitɔ̃ lɛ, shi gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ toi humii nɛɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛfeko nɔ ko. Ofai nɛ, gblamɔ mi kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ moŋ toi."
Nakai gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ Gad ba David ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa ni oyama afɔleshãa latɛ ohã Yehowa yɛ Arauna, Yebusnyo lɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ."
David ye Yehowa famɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eyiŋ etee yɛ Gad wiemɔ lɛ naa.
Be ni Arauna yaakwɛ lɛ, ena Maŋtsɛ David kɛ etsuji miiba eŋɔɔgbɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Arauna je kpo, ni eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto Maŋtsɛ David,

ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni kɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ baa etsulɔ ŋɔɔ nɛɛ?" David kɛɛ Arauna akɛ, "Miba oŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ hemɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi mahã Yehowa koni gbele hela ni ebabote maŋbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ sɛɛ afo."
Arauna to he ehã David akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ koni okɛshã afɔle fɛɛ afɔle ni sa yɛ ohiɛ ohã Yehowa. Naa tsinai koni akɛshã afɔle lɛ, kɛ tsinai akɔŋtsei koni akɛfee lai.
Mikɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ ehã maŋtsɛ tswaa. "No sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ David akɛ, "Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ahe ofɔle lɛ."

Shi David here Arauna nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Dabida! Mibahe, ni mawo o nyɔmɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mikɛ nɔ ko ni mina lɛ yaka akashã afɔle mihã Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. " No hewɔ lɛ David he ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa, ni eshã shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa bo fai ni akpa lɛ ahã Israelbii lɛ toi, kɛkɛ ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo yɛ Israel.

1: Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ dɛŋ ahã nyɛ!
Eji wɔgbɛnaa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ miida naakpa, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ enanemɛi lɛ mifa kɛmiiya nɔ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ tete wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ amli, yɛ nyɛhiɛmiamɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛyiwala kɛ nyɛmanehului ni nyɛnaa lɛ amli lɛ hewɔ.
Eji Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ he okadi, koni abu nyɛ akɛ nyɛsa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni nyɛnaa he nɔ lɛ,
akɛni eja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ mɛi ni haoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehao amɛ eto najiaŋ,
ni nyɛ mɛi ni ahaoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ kɛ wɔ fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ, be ni aaajie Nuŋtsɔ yesu kpo kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi kɛ ebɔfoi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ lalilɛi aaatɔ owele yɛ mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɛi ni booo wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛaana nyɔmɔwo ni ji naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni aaajie amɛ kɛaajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ anumnyam lɛ he,
be ni eeeba koni awo ehiɛ nyam yɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli ni ana enaakpɛɛnii yɛ eheyelɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ahe wɔdase ni wɔye wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aye.
Enɛ hewɔ hu ni wɔsɔleɔ daa wɔhãa nyɛ, koni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa tsɛmɔ lɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ lɛ ahã ekpakpafeemɔ he miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ ayi obɔ̃,
bɔ ni afee ni awo wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛmli ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aba nyam yɛ emli, yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ naa.
2: Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa lɛ kɛ wɔnaa ni abaabua yɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ hewɔ
akɛ nyɛkahãa ahã nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futu oya, ni asaŋ nyɛkahãa akɛ mumɔ ko loo wiemɔ ko loo wolo ko ni aaakɛɛ akɛ ejɛ wɔŋɔɔ lɛ miihã nyɛhao akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ eshɛ etã.
Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miishishiu nyɛ yɛ gbɛ ko gbɛ ko nɔ; ejaakɛ ja jamɔkwamɔ lɛ eba fɛɛdã ni aaajie mlakwamɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ bi lɛ kpo.
Eteɔ shi ewoɔ ehe nɔ eshiɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni atsɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ loo jamɔ lɛ aahuu bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyataa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni ekɛ ehe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkaiii akɛ be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lo?
Ni agbɛnɛ kɛyashi ebe aaashɛ lɛ, nyɛle.
Ejaakɛ mlakwamɔ teemɔsane lɛ miitsu nii momo, shi kɛyashi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ aaaje jɛi kɛkɛ.
Ni no dani aaajie mlakwalɔ lɛ kpo; Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ edaaŋ mumɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ ni ekɛ ebaa lɛ puemɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ.
Mlakwalɔ nɛɛ, Satan nitsumɔ nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ kɛba kɛ amale naakpɛɛnii,
kɛ efɔŋ mli shishiumɔ fɛɛ ni akɛ shishiuɔ mɛi ni hiɛ baakpãtã ejaakɛ amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ ankwale suɔmɔ lɛ mli ni akɛhere amɛyiwala lɛ.
Ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ tsuɔ shishiumɔ hewalɛ kɛbaa amɛŋɔɔ ni amɛhe amale amɛye,
koni akojo mɛi fɛɛ ni heee anɔkwale lɛ amɛyeee, shi amɛnaa efɔŋ moŋ he tsui lɛ.

Shi wɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehala nyɛ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ehã yiwalaheremɔ kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhe ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsuɔ kɛ he ni nyɛheɔ anɔkwale lɛ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ mli etsɔ̃ wɔ-Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ etsɛ nyɛ kɛba, koni nyɛna wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo anumnyam lɛ.
Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛfia shi, ni nyɛhiɛa nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ mli loo wolo mli lɛ mli.
Shi lɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ diɛtsɛ kɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ naanɔ miishɛjemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ kpakpa hã wɔ yɛ dromɔ naa lɛ,
lɛ nɔŋŋ eshɛje nyɛmii ni ewaje nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ kpakpa kɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ mli.
3: Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ahiɛ foi kɛya nɔ ni awo ehiɛ nyam, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.
Ni ajie wɔ kɛjɛ yiwalɔi gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ adɛŋ, ejaakɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli.
Shi anɔkwafo ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mɔ ni aaawaje nyɛ ni eeebu nyɛhe ni ejie nyɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ.
Wɔhiɛ kã nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ nii ni wɔwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, nyɛmiifee ni nyɛaafee hu.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akudɔ nyɛtsuii kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ kɛ Kristo tsuishiŋmɛɛ lɛ mli.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiiwo nyɛ kitã yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, akɛ nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nyɛmi fɛɛ nyɛmi ni feɔ hejɔ̃ ni ehiii shi yɛ nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ naa lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ esa akɛ nyɛkase wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔfeee wɔhe hejɔ̃lɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Ni asaŋ wɔyeee mɔ ko ŋmaa yaka, shi moŋ wɔkɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ kɛ tɔlɛ tsuɔ nii nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane bɔ ni afee ni wɔkafee jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko.
Jeee akɛ wɔbɛ nakai hegbɛ, shi moŋ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhe afee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ wɔhã nyɛ ni nyɛkase.
Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu, wɔwo nyɛ kitã akɛ, "Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ nii lɛ, belɛ ekaya nii hu."
Ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni feɔ hejɔ̃, ni amɛtsuuu nii, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli.
Nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ wɔmiiwo amɛ kitã ni wɔmiiwo amɛŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli akɛ amɛdɛŋ ŋmaa.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa nyɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko booo wɔwiemɔ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ toi lɛ, nyɛkadia lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, koni ehiɛ agbo;
ni nyɛkabua lɛ akɛ henyɛlɔ, shi moŋ nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a lɛ akɛ nyɛmi.
Shi lɛ hejɔlɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ahã nyɛ hejɔlɛ daa yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi.
Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni ji okadi yɛ miwolo fɛɛ wolo mli nɛ; bɔ ni miŋmaa nɛ.
Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.

1: Paulo, ni ji Kristo Yesu bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa kɛ wala ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ he shiwoo naa lɛ,
ŋma yahã esuɔmɔ bi Timoteo. Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ, hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ dɛŋ ohã o!
Midaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni mijaa lɛ kɛ henilee krɔŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni miniimɛi ja lɛ lɛ shi daa kɛ mikai o yɛ mifaikpamɔi amli nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
Ni kɛ mikai ohiɛ yaafonui lɛ, mishweɔ akɛ mana o, koni mayi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mikaiɔ ohemɔkɛyeli ni osato bɛ mli lɛ, ni yɔɔ onaa Loise kɛ onyɛ Eunike mli tsutsu, ni miyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ eyɛ bo hu omli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ miikai o ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenɔ ni yɔɔ omli yɛ miniji ni mikɛshwie onɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, otee lɛ shi ni etso,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa wɔ gbeyeishemɔ mumɔ, shi moŋ hewalɛ kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni sa mumɔ ekɛhã wɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ ohiɛ akagbo yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he odaseyeli lɛ he aloo yɛ mi ni miji egboklɛfonyo lɛ he, shi moŋ naa Sanekpakpa lɛ he amanehulu lɛ eko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa.
Lɛ ehere wɔyiwala ni ekɛ tsɛmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ tsɛ wɔ, jeee wɔnitsumɔi anaa, shi moŋ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋtoo kɛ edromɔ naa, nɔ ni ekɛ hã wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli dani aje be shishi,
ni agbɛnɛ atsɔ̃ wɔyiwalaherelɔ, Yesu Kristo, puemɔ lɛ nɔ ajie lɛ shi faŋŋ lɛ. Lɛ efo gbele sɛɛ, ni ajie wala kɛ naanɔ shihilɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mli.
Enɛ he awo mi shiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo kɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ nɔŋŋ minaa amanehului nɛɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ gbooo; ejaakɛ mile mɔ ni mihe miye lɛ, ni miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ akɛ eeenyɛ ebu nii ni mitu miwo edɛŋ lɛ he kɛyashi nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ.
Hiɛmɔ wiemɔi ni hi ni onu yɛ minaa akɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ lɛ mli yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.
Nɔ kpakpa ni atu awo odɛŋ lɛ buu he yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hiɔ wɔmli lɛ hewalɛ naa! Mɛi ni kpa yɛ Paulo sɛɛ kɛ mɔ ni damɔ esɛɛ kpɛŋŋ
Ole enɛ akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ fɛɛ kpa yɛ misɛɛ; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Figelo kɛ Hermogene.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ana Onesiforo we lɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ ebahãa mi tsui kpitiokpitio, ni ehiɛ gbooo mikɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ lɛ he;
Shi be ni eba Roma lɛ ebɔ mɔdɛŋ etao mi ni ena mi.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahã ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ mɔbɔnalɛ yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ. Ni bɔ ni etsɔ̃ esɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ Efeso lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ole jogbaŋŋ.
2: Agbɛnɛ mibi, bo lɛ ohe awa yɛ dromɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.
Ni nii ni onu yɛ minaa yɛ odase efoi pii ahiɛ lɛ, tuu owo gbɔmɛi anɔkwafoi adɛŋ, mɛi ni aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi hu lɛ.
Naa amanehulu lɛ eko, tamɔ Kristo Yesu tabilɔi kpakpa ko.
Mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ ta gbɛ ni ekɛ ehe wo shīa saji amli, koni esa mɔ ni fã lɛ kɛtee ta lɛ lɛŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko miishi mple hu lɛ, afiŋ lɛ kunim akekre, akɛ ja eshi lɛ mla naa.
Okwaafonyo ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, lɛ tsutsu sa akɛ ena yibii lɛ eko. Jwɛŋmɔ nɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛɛ he,
ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaahã ona nii fɛɛ shishi.
Ohiɛ ahi Yesu Kristo ni te shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni jɛ David shwie mli lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni miikɛɛ yɛ mi-Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ mli lɛ.
No mli amane nɔŋŋ minaa, kɛyashi kpãi amli tete, tamɔ efɔŋfeelɔ ko nɛɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ awooo lɛ kpãa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ mimiaa mihiɛ yɛ saji fɛɛ amli yɛ mɛi ni ahala amɛ lɛ ahewɔ, koni amɛ hu amɛnine ashɛ yiwalaheremɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ kɛ naanɔ anumnyam lɛ nɔ.
Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ, "Kɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ gbo lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ aaana wala hu;
kɛ wɔmia wɔhiɛ lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ hu; kɛ wɔkpa yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, lɛ hu eeekpa yɛ wɔsɛɛ.
Kɛ wɔfeee wɔhe anɔkwafoi lɛ, lɛ lɛ eeehi shi anɔkwafo, Enyɛŋ ekpa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe sɛɛ."
Kaimɔ amɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ, ni oma nɔ mí ohã amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, koni amɛkawu naabu ta ni sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he, shi ebutuɔ mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ moŋ lɛ.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni okɛ ohe adamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni sa nitsulɔ ni hiɛ gbooo, ni tsɔ̃ɔ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Shi yaka wiemɔ nibuleɔ mɔ lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he; ejaakɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nɛkɛ lɛ aaaya nɔ awo wu yɛ bu ni abuuu Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Ni amɛwiemɔ lɛ aaafee tamɔ fla fɔŋ ni yeɔ heloo. Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Himeneo kɛ Fileto,
mɛi ni edu gbɛ kɛjɛ anɔkwale lɛ he, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ shitee lɛ eho momo, ni amɛbutuɔ mɛi komɛi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shishitoo ni wa lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ naasɔomɔnɔ nɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi lɛ, " kɛ "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsiɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ tã lɛ atsi ehe kɛjɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ ahe."
Shi shīa wulu mli lɛ, jeee shikanii kɛ jwiɛtɛinii kɛkɛ yɔɔ jɛi, shi moŋ tsonii kɛ sunii hu yɛ mli, ni ekomɛi lɛ abuɔ amɛ, shi ekomɛi hu abuuu.
Agbɛnɛ kɛji mɔ ko tsuu ehe kɛjɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ amli lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ nɔ ni akɛfeɔ nii ni yɔɔ nyam ni atsuu he krɔŋŋ, ni hi hã shīatsɛ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni asaa ahã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.
Shi oblahiiaŋ sɛɛdii lɛ hu, joo naa foi, ni okɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛjeɔ tsui ni mli tse mli atiu jalɛ, hemɔkɛyeli, suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ sɛɛ.
Shi kwashiai aŋwanejee ni akɛkasee nɔ ko lɛ tsi ohe kɛjɛ he, ejaakɛ kɛ ole akɛ ekɛ bei baa;
shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ ebeɔ, shi moŋ efee mɔ ni mli jɔ hã mɛi fɛɛ, mɔ ni le nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, mɔ ni toɔ etsui shi,
mɔ ni kɛ mlijɔlɛ wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni kuɔ enaa, akɛ aleeenɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ahã amɛ tsuitsakemɔ ni amɛle anɔkwale lɛ.
Ni amɛhiɛ aaatserɛ amɛ ni amɛaaje abonsam tsɔ̃ne lɛ mli lo; ejaakɛ ekɛdu amɛ ni amɛfee esuɔmɔnaanii.
3: Shi na enɛ ole akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli lɛ jramɔ bei baaba.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi aaatsɔ̃mɔ hesuɔlɔi, shikasuɔlɔi, shwãlɔi, hewolɔi, mɔjɛlɔi, fɔlɔi anɔ toigbolɔi, trumui, mɛi ni he tseee,
mɛi ni edɔɔɔ mɔ he, kpãŋmɔmlikulɔi, oshekuyelɔi, mɛi ni nyɛɛɛ amɛkɔnɔ nɔ amɛye, mɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ la, mɛi ni sumɔɔɔ ekpakpa,
sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, mɛi ni feɔ nii ni amɛjwɛŋŋ he, henɔwolɔi, mɛi ni sumɔɔ shwɛmɔ kɛŋɔɔmɔ fe Nyɔŋmɔ,
mɛi ni hiɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ kponɔgbɛ su lɛ mli, shi amɛkwa emli hewalɛ lɛ. Tsi ohe kɛjɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi ahe.
Ejaakɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji mɛi ni juɔ shi boteɔ shīai ni amɛnine shɛɔ yei ni bɛ yitseiaŋ ni esha edɔdɔɔ amɛ ni akɔnɔi srɔtoi kplaa amɛ lɛ anɔ.
Yei ni kaseɔ nii daa, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛshɛ anɔkwale lɛ he lɛ,
Shi tamɔ bɔ ni Yane kɛ Yambre ku Mose naa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ kuɔ anɔkwale lɛ naa; gbɔmɛi ni yitseaŋ efite, mɛi ni jeee mɛi komɛi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Shi amɛyaŋ amɛhiɛ tuutu ko; ejaakɛ amɛkwashiafeemɔ lɛ aaaje kpo fãŋŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi enyɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ hu je kpo lɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, ole mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, mijeŋba, miyiŋtoo, mihemɔkɛyeli, mitsuishitoo, misuɔmɔ, mihiɛmiamɔ,
miyiwai, mimanehului ni mina yɛ Antiokia kɛ Ikonium kɛ Listra lɛ, nɔ yiwai srɔtoi abɔ ni mina ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie mi kɛjɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Shi mɛi fɛɛ hu taoɔ akɛ amɛaahi shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ naa yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, aaawa amɛ yi.
Shi gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ shishiulɔi aaawo wu yɛ efɔŋ mli; amɛlakaa mɛi ni amɛ hu alakaa amɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, hii shi yɛ nii ni okase ni oyɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ amli, ejaakɛ ole mɛi anaa ni okase yɛ,
ni ogbekɛbiiashi ojɛ ole Ŋmalɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni aaanyɛ ahã ole nii hã yiwalaheremɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ.
Ŋmalɛ fɛɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ mli, ni ehe yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ hiɛkãmɔ kɛ mɔsaamɔ kɛ tsɔsemɔ ni yɔɔ jalɛ mli lɛ,
koni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ aye emuu, ni asaa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ahã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.
4: Miifã o yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo ni baaba ebakojo hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii kɛ ahiɛ, ni mikɛ epuemɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ miifã o akɛ,
Shiɛmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, kã he, be ni ji jio, be ni ehiii jio, kã hiɛ, wo ŋaa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nii kɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ,
Ejaakɛ be ko baana ni gbɔmɛi ekplɛŋ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛaabua tsɔ̃ɔlɔi anaa amɛwo amɛhe yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ amɛtoiiaŋ miiflɛ̃ amɛ;
ni amɛaakpla anɔkwale lɛ yɛ amɛtoii asɛɛ, ni amɛaakpale kɛyanyiɛ adesãi asɛɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, ohiɛ akã shi yɛ nii fɛɛ mli, miamɔ ohiɛ yɛ amanehului amli, tsu Sanekpakpashiɛlɔ nitsumɔ lɛ, gbee osɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa kwraa!
Ejaakɛ mi lɛ, aafɔse mila aashwie shi momo kɛ afɔle, ni mimliyimɔ be lɛ eshɛ.
Ta kpakpa lɛ, miwu; foidamɔ lɛ, mida migbɛ naa; hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, mihiɛ mli tswɛ.
Nɔ ni eshwɛ ni kã shi hã mi ji jalɛ akekre lɛ, ni Nuŋtsɔ ni ji jalɛ kojolɔ lɛ baahã mi yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni jeee mikome ebaahã, shi moŋ mɛi bluublu hu ni sumɔɔ epuemɔ lɛ.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba miŋɔɔ oya.
Ejaakɛ ní Dena esumɔ amrɔmrɔ je nɛɛŋ hewɔ lɛ, eshi mi etee Tesalonika. Kreske etee Galata, Tito etee Dalmatia.
Luka pɛ kɛ mi yɔɔ. Ŋɔɔ Marko ni okɛ lɛ aba, ejaakɛ ehe yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã mi yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Tihiko lɛ, mitsu lɛ Efeso.
Atade lɛ ni mishi yɛ Troia yɛ Karpo ŋɔɔ lɛ, kɛ ooba lɛ okɛba, kɛ woji lɛ hu, titri lɛ amɛteŋ nii ni aŋmla yɛ kooloi ahewolo nɔ lɛ.
Aleksandro, sɔ̃lɔ lɛ, fee mi efɔŋ naakpa; Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ato lɛ najiaŋ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Bo hu kwɛ ohe ni ahi yɛ ehe ejaakɛ eku wɔwiemɔi lɛ anaa waa naakpa.
Miklɛŋklɛŋ naajiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko eyawaaa mi, shi moŋ amɛ fɛɛ amɛshi mi; akabu enɛ afɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fi misɛɛ ni ewo mi hewalɛ, koni atsɔ̃ minɔ ashiɛ shiɛmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ, jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ anu; ni ajie mi yɛ jata lɛ daaŋ.
Ni jiemɔ kɛ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaajie mi kɛaajɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ mli, ni eeehere miyawala kɛaatee eŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. Lɛ aŋɔ anumnyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi lɛ. Amen!
Miibi Priskila kɛ Akwila kɛ Onesiforo we lɛ.
Erasto yɛ Korinto lolo; shi Trofimo lɛ, mishi lɛ yɛ Mileto ni ehe miiye.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba dani fɛ̃i be lɛ ashɛ. Eubulo kɛ Pude kɛ Lino kɛ Klaudia kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ miibi o
Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ omumɔ lɛ ahi shi! Dromɔ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi! Amen.

1: Onukpa lɛ ŋma yahã suɔlɔ Gaio, mɔ ni misumɔɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
Suɔlɔ, miikpa fai akɛ oshwere yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli ni ohi hewalɛ, tamɔ( bɔ ni osusuma shwereɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mina miishɛɛ babaoo be ni nyɛmimɛi komɛi ba ni amɛbaye onɔkwale lɛ he odase, bɔ ni onyiɛɔ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ.
Mibɛ miishɛɛ ko ni da fe enɛ akɛ manu akɛ mibii lɛ nyiɛɔ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ.
Suɔlɔ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otsuɔ ohãa nyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔkwale mli ofeɔ yɛ, tsɛbelɛ gbɔi ji amɛ.
Amɛ amɛbaye osuɔmɔ lɛ he odase yɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ; ni kɛ ooowo amɛ gbɛ bɔ ni sa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ooofee jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo gbɛi lɛ hewɔ amɛtee, ni amɛhee nɔ ko yɛ jeŋmajiŋbii lɛ adɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ wɔhereɔ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ atuu, koni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ anɔkwale lɛ he nanemɛi nitsulɔi.
Miŋma wolo mimaje asafo lɛ, shi Diotrefe mɔ ni taoɔ amɛnɔ onukpa aye lɛ hereee wɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miba lɛ mahã nyɛle enifɔ̃ɔjianii ni efeɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ewieɔ wɔhe wiemɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, ni enɛɛmɛi tete hu faaa hãaa lɛ, shi moŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehereee nyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni asaŋ mɛi ni sumɔɔ akɛ amɛaafee nakai lɛ etsīɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni eshwieɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ asafo lɛ mli.
Suɔlɔ, kaakase nɔ ni ji efɔŋ, shi kasemɔ nɔ ni ji ekpakpa moŋ. Mɔ ni feɔ ekpakpa lɛ, ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli; mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ lɛ, enako Nyɔŋmɔ.
Demetrio lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ miiye ehe odase, ni wɔ hu wɔmiiye ehe odase, ni ole akɛ wɔdase lɛ anɔkwa ni.
Kulɛ miyɛ nibii pii ni maŋma o, shi misumɔ̃ɔ akɛ mikɛ "blɛgi" kɛ niŋmaatso ŋmaa o;
shi moŋ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni mana o, ni wɔɔwie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Hejɔlɛ ahã o! Wɔshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ miibi o. Tsɛ wɔshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛii ekomekome ni oŋa amɛ.
Teofilo, miklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ mli lɛ, migba nii fɛɛ ni Yesu babɔ̃i feemɔ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ
kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi, be ni etsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ewo ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ akitãi sɛɛ lɛ.
Emanehulu lɛ sɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ oadaseyeli nibii pii anɔ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ bɔfoi nɛɛ akɛ ehiɛ kã, ni ehã amɛna lɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ, ni ekɛ amɛ wie Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he.
Ni be ekɛ amɛnaa kpe shi lɛ, ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ, "Nyɛkajea Yerusalem, shi moŋ nyɛminaa lɛ;
ejaakɛ Yohane lɛ, nu ekɛbaptisi, shi nyɛ lɛ eyeŋ gbii pii ko ni akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaabaptisi nyɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ be ni amɛnaa bakpe shi lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ani nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli obaatee maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shi oma shi ohã Israel lɛ?"
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Jeee nyɛnɔ ji akɛ nyɛaale bei loo gbii lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ eto yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ mli lɛ.
Shi moŋ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ na ba nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛaana hewalɛ ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ midasefoi yɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yudea kɛ Smaria fɛɛ, kɛyashi jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ."
Be ni ewie nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛmiikwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni awo lɛ, ni atatu ko ŋɔ lɛ kɛje amɛhiɛ kɛtee.
Ni be ni eyaa ni amɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi gãa lɛ, naa, hii enyɔ ni wo atadei yɛji damɔ amɛmasɛi,
ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ Galileabii, mɛɛba nyɛdamɔ shi nyɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi nɛkɛ? Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛje nyɛŋɔɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi nɛɛ, ebaaba nakai nɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna akɛ eyaa ŋwɛi nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ ni kɛ Yerusalem jakɛmɔ aaafee hejɔɔmɔgbi gbɛfãa lɛ nɔ amɛba Yerusalem ekoŋŋ.

Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛtee ŋwɛitsu ko mli, he ni Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea kɛ Filipo kɛ Toma kɛ Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo kɛ Alfeo bi Yakobo kɛ Simon, maŋ he hiɛdɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yakobo bi Yuda hiɔ lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ yei lɛ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hiɛ sɔlemɔ mli waa.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Petro te shi edamɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ (mɛi fɛɛ ni edabua amɛhe naa lɛ aaafeee oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ) ni ekɛɛ,
"Anyɛmimɛi, esa akɛ nɔ ni aŋma ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekɛɛ eto yɛ David naa yɛ Yuda mɔ ni nyiɛ mɛi ni bamɔ Yesu lɛ ahiɛ lɛ he lɛ aba mli,
ejaakɛ abu lɛ ashi wɔnɔ, ni eyɛ egbɛnaa yɛ nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli."
Shi nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ ŋɔ enɔsha ni efee lɛ mli nyɔmɔwo lɛ ehe abɔɔ, ni eyama eyi shi, ni emli gba enyɔ ni emlinii fɛɛ tue shwie shi.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ na le enɛ, no hewɔ lɛ atsɛɔ nakai abɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwiemɔ mli akɛ Akeldama, eshishi ji "Lá-Abɔɔ."
Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ mli akɛ, 'Eshihilɛhe lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akahi mli,' kɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, 'Enɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ hu mɔ kroko aŋɔ.'
"No hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ hii ni kɛ wɔ nyiɛ be mli fɛɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yesu yaa baa yɛ wɔteŋ,
kɛjɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛje wɔŋɔɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome atsɔ eshitee lɛ he odasefonyo afata wɔhe."
Ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, Yosef ni atsɛɔ lɛ Barsaba ni awo lɛ Yusto hu lɛ, kɛ Matia, amɛdamɔ shi.
Ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ, "Bo, Nuŋtsɔ, ni ole gbɔmɛi fɛɛ atsuiiaŋ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ohala
ni eŋɔ nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ bɔfo nitsumɔ ni Yuda eje mli koni ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ lɛ."
Ni amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki, ni oshiki lɛ yagbee Matia nɔ, ni abu lɛ ashi bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ anɔ.
2: Be ni Pentekosete gbi (loo gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ) lɛ shɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ he kome.
Ni trukaa lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko ni tamɔ ahum ni tswaa waa jɛ ŋwɛi ba, ni ebayi shīa he ni amɛtra lɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃.
Ni lilɛii pue; ni ebatra amɛyiteaŋ ekomekome;
ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ bayimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni amɛbɔ̃i wiemɔi krokomɛi awiemɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwo amɛnaa lɛ.
Shi Yudafoi Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeshelɔi komɛi yɛ Yerusalem, ni amɛjɛ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi lɛ anɔ.
Ne be ni anu nɛkɛ gbɛɛmɔ nɛɛ, mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nu akɛ amɛmiiwie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Ani mɛi ni wieɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee Galileabii ni?
Shi te fee tɛŋŋ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ he ni afɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ?
Partiabi kɛ Mediabii kɛ Elambii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mesopotamia kɛ Yudea kɛ Kapadokia, Ponto kɛ Asia,
Frigia kɛ Pamfilia, Egipt kɛ Libia niiaŋ yɛ Kirene masɛi kɛ gbɔi ni jɛ Roma, Yudafoi kɛ mɛi ni etsɔ̃mɔ Yudafoi,
Kretabii kɛ Arabiabii: wɔmiinu akɛ amɛmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ nibii wuji lɛ yɛ wɔwiemɔi lɛ amli."
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Te enɛ shishi?"
Shi mɛi komɛi hu ye fɛo amɛkɛɛ, "Dãa dɔkɔdɔkɔ etrɔ amɛ."
Shi Petro kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ te shi amɛdamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ ekɛ asafo lɛ wie ekɛɛ, "Yudahii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem, nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ, ni nyɛboa miwemɔi lɛ atoi.
Jeee dãa mɛnɛɛmɛi etrɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsusuɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ leebi ŋmlɛ nɛɛhu kɛkɛ nɛ; lɛ, ejaakɛ leebi ŋmlɛ nɛɛhu kɛkɛ nɛ;
shi moŋ enɛ ji nɔ ni gbalɔ Yoel wie lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, 'Ni aaaba mli yɛ naagbee gbii lɛ anɔ akɛ, mafɔse mi-Mumɔ lɛ eko mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ, ni nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba, ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninaai, ni nyɛnukpai lɛ aaala lamɔi.
Ni asaŋ mitsuji hii kɛ mitsuji yei lɛ anɔ hu mafɔse mi-Mumɔ lɛ eko mashwie yɛ nakai gbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛaagba.
Ni mahã naakpɛɛnii aba ŋwɛi, ni okadii hu aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, lã kɛ la kɛ lasu lamɔ.
Hulu aaatsɔ̃ duŋ, ni nyɔŋtsre aaatsɔ̃ lá, dani Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbi wulu ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ aaaba.
Ni aaaba mli akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.'

"Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ atoi! Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ji nuu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii ni etsɔ̃ enine nɔ efee yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ ye ehe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle lɛ.
Yesu nɛɛ ni ajie lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo kɛ enii ni ele eto lɛ naa ahã lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ mɛi ni bɛ mla lɛ anine nɔ nyɛsɛŋ lɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi ni efɛne lɛ kɛjɛ gbele piŋmɔi lɛ amli, akɛni gbele nyɛŋ enaa etsi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ David wie yɛ ehe ekɛɛ, 'Minaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ daa, ejaakɛ eyɛ mininejurɔ nɔ, koni mikadidãa.
No hewɔ lɛ mitsui nyɔ̃ mimli ni mililɛi nya, ni asaŋ migbɔmɔtso hu aaajɔɔ ehe yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli;
ejaakɛ oshiŋ misusuma yɛ gbohiiaje, ni ohaŋ omɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ana fitemɔ.
Ohã mile wala gbɛ̃i lɛ, Ni ooowo mi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ.'
"Anyɛmimɛi, makɛɛ nyɛ faŋŋ yɛ blematsɛ David lɛ he akɛ egbo ni afu lɛ, ni asaŋ eyɛ wɔteŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Akɛni gbalɔi ji lɛ ni ele akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekã lɛ kitã akɛ emusuŋ bii lɛ eko baata esɛi lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ,
ena eto ni ewie Kristo shitee lɛ he akɛ ashiii esusuma yɛ gbohiiaje ni egbɔ̃mɔtso hu fiteee.
Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi; no he odasefoi ji wɔ fɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ akɛni awo enɔ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ ni ena Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo lɛ kɛjɛ Tsɛ lɛ dɛ̃ŋ hewɔ lɛ, efɔse nɔ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ eshwie shi.
Ejaakɛ David eyaaa ŋwɛi, shi lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, ta mininejurɔ nɔ,
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.'
"No hewɔ lɛ Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ale krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ nɛkɛ Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ nɛɛ efee Nuŋtsɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ."
Shi be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ Petro kɛ bɔfoi ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ?"
Ni Petro kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã abaptisi lɛ awo Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, koni akɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ afa nyɛ, ni nyɛaana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔkeenɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ shiwoo lɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, mɛi abɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatsɛ kɛaaba lɛ anɔ ni."
Ni ewie wiemɔi krokomɛi pii ekɛye odase ni ekɛwo amɛ ŋaa akɛ, "Nyɛhãa aherea nyɛyiwala kɛjea yinɔ kɔ̃ɔdɔŋ nɛɛ mli."
Kɛkɛ ni abaptisi mɛi ni he ewiemɔ lɛ, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ akɛ susumai aaafee akpei etɛ̃ fata amɛhe.
Ni amɛhiɛ bɔfoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ abolookuumɔ lɛ kɛ sɔlemɔi lɛ amli.
Ni gbeyei mɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anɔ afee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii pii.
Ni mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ he kome, ni amɛfee amɛnii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ekome;
amɛhɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛshikpɔji kɛ amɛhenii, ni amɛja shika lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni he hīaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Ni daa gbi lɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome yaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni amɛkumɔkumɔɔ aboloo yɛ shīai, ni amɛkɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yeɔ nii,
ni amɛjieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛhiɛ ba nyam yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ mɛi ni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ efataa asafo lɛ he gbi fɛɛ gbi.
3: Gbi ko gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ ni ji sɔlemɔ be lɛ, Petro kɛ Yohane tsa mlu kɛtee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Ni nuu ko yɛ ni ji obubuafo kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ ni awoɔ lɛ daa abataa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ "Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo" lɛ naa, koni ebla nii yɛ mɛi ni yaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ adɛ̃.
Ni be ni ena Petro kɛ Yohane boteɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, eba amɛ nɔ ko.
Shi Petro kɛ Yohane fɛɛ kwɛ lɛ gãa, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ wɔhiɛ!"
Ni ebɔ ehiŋmɛii eto amɛnɔ, ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaana nɔ ko yɛ amɛdɛ̃.
Shi Petro kɛɛ, "Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ mibɛ eko; shi nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ, no mikɛhãa o nɛɛ, Yɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, gbɛi mli lɛ, tee shi ni onyiɛ."
Ni emɔ̃ eninejurɔ mli ni ewo enɔ edamɔ shi; ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaji kɛ enane talɔi l2 amli wa lɛ;
ni ehuru edamɔ shi ni ebɔ̃i nyiɛmɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ kɛbote Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ tuumɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ.
Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ni eejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi;
ni be ni amɛyoo lɛ akɛ lɛji mɔ ni ta Sɔlemɔwe "Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo" lɛ naa eblaa nii lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe babaoo yɛ nɔ ni afee ahã lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi akɛni obubuafo ni atsa lɛ lɛ kpɛtɛ Petro kɛ Yohane hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kutuu kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ ablaanaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ "Solomon Ablaanaa" lɛ nɔ ni amɛhe ejɔ̃ amɛhe.
Be ni Petro na enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ Israelhii,mɛɛba nyɛhiɛ feɔ nyɛ yaa yɛ enɛ hewɔ, aloo mɛɛba nyɛkwɛɔ wɔ gãa nɛkɛ, tamɔ nɔ ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ loo wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ wɔkhã nuu nɛɛ nyiɛɔ nɛɛ?
Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ rewo etsulɔ Yesu hiɛ nyam, Yesu mɔ ni nyɛjie lɛ nyɛhã ni nyɛkwa lɛ yɛ Pontio Pilato hiɛ, be ni lɛ lɛ ekpɛ mli akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe lɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Jalɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkpa fai akɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ awuyelɔ moŋ ake nyɛ,
ni Wala lumɔ lɛ, nyɛgbe lɛ; shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni no he odasefoi ji wɔ.
Ni egbɛi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa ni egbɛi lɛ tsa nuu nɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛle lɛ; ni enɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã efee kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
"Ni agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mile akɛ leee ni nyɛleee hewɔ ni nyɛfee, tamɔ nyɛnukpai lɛ nɔŋŋ;
shi nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ eto momo yɛ egbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa akɛ e-Kristo lɛ aaana amanehulu lɛ, ehã eba mli nakai.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ, koni agbe nyɛhe eshai lɛ,
bɔ ni afee ni mumɔŋ hewalɛwoo ko ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ aba, ni eeetsu Yesu Kristo mɔ ni ejie eto ehã nyɛ momo lɛ;
mɔ ni sa akɛŋwɛi aŋɔ lɛ kɛyashi be ni aaato nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewie he yɛ egbalɔi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ teteete lɛ gbɛjianɔ.
Ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni eeewie etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ mli.
Ni aaaba mli akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ ni boŋ nakai gbalɔ lɛ toi lɛ,aaakpãtã ehiɛ kwraa kɛaaje mɛi lɛ ateŋ!'
Ni asaŋ gbalɔi fɛɛ hu ni wie kɛjɛ Samuel kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtsi nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ atã amɛto.
Nyɛji gbalɔi lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ bii, kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, be ni ekɛɛ Abraham akɛ, 'Ni oshwei mli aaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wekui fɛɛ yɛ'lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee etsulɔ Yesu lɛ shi lɛ, 'Nyɛ tsutsu nyɛŋɔɔ etsu lɛ ni ebajɔɔ nyɛ ni ekpale nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛjɛ enifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ ahe.'"
4: Shi be ni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ wieɔ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ bashwie amɛnɔ,
ejaakɛ efee amɛ mlifu akɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii, ni amɛmiijaje amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ.
Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ, ejaakɛ je ena etã.
Shi mɛi ni nu lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he ye, ni hii lɛ ayibɔ bashɛ aaafee akpei enumɔ.
Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalem,
kɛ Osɔfonukpa Ana, kɛ Kariafa kɛ Yohane kɛ Alekasndro kɛ mɛi abɔ ni jɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ weku lɛ mli lɛ;
ni amɛyaŋɔ Petro kɛ Yohane amɛbadamɔ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewalɛ nyɛkɛfee enɛ, aloo mɛɛ gbɛi mli nyɛfee yɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Petro ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Maŋ mli lumɛi kɛ onukpai!
Kɛji akɛ wɔ miiye sane ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ yɛ ejurɔ ni afee nɛkɛ helatsɛ nɛɛ hewɔ akɛ namɔ nɔ atsɔ̃ atsa lɛ lɛ,
no lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ana ale akɛ, Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, ni nyɛsɛŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, lɛ egbɛi mli nuu nɛɛ damɔ nyɛhiɛ ni ehe ewa lɛ nɛɛ.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋmalɛi lɛ wie yɛ ehe akɛ, 'Tɛ lɛ ni nyɛ ni nyɛji tsutswalɔi lɛ gbe ehe guɔ lɛ, no ebatsɔ̃ koŋtɛ nɛɛ.'
Ejaakɛ yiwalaheremɔ bɛ mɔ kroko mli; ni asaŋ gbɛi kroko hu bɛ ŋwɛi shishi ni akɛhã gbɔmɛi ni sa akɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ ahere wɔyiwala."
Agbɛnɛ be ni amɛna Petro kɛ Yohane ekãa lɛ, ni amɛyoo akɛ jeee woloŋlelɔi kɛ nilelɔi komɛi ji amɛ lɛ, efee amɛhiɛ yaa, ni amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ Yesu ehi shi.
Ni asaŋ akɛni amɛna gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ damɔ shi hewɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa nɔ ko amɛkɛɛ.
Shi amɛfã amɛ akɛ amɛje gwabɔɔ lɛ mli amɛje kpo fioo, ni amɛtee ajina
amɛkɛɛ, "Te wɔɔfee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ okadi ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ afee lɛ yɛ faŋŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ ahiɛ, ni wɔnyɛŋ wɔtso.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ bɔ ni afee ni ekahehe tuutu ko dɔŋŋ yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔwoa amɛhe gbeyei, koni amɛkawie yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ."
Ni amɛtsɛ amɛ kɛba, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkatsi tã ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Yesu gbɛi mli kwraa dɔŋŋ.
Shi Petro kɛ Yohane here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛ eja gbɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ abo nyɛ moŋ toi fe Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛkojoa.
Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛŋ akɛ ja wɔwie nii ni wɔna kɛ nii ni wɔnu lɛ."
Shi be ni gwabɔɔ lɛ saa wo amɛhe gbeyei lɛ, amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛpiŋ amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ miiwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ nɔ ni afee lɛ hewɔ;
ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ naakpɛɛ tsamɔ nɛɛ eye fe afii nyɔmai ejwɛ.
Shi be ni aŋmɛɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛba amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hole amɛgbei anɔ amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, bo ni oji Nyɔŋmɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii fiaa ni yɔɔ amɛmli,
bo mɔ ni otsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ owie yɛ wɔtsɛ David, otsulɔ lɛ, naa okɛɛ akɛ, 'Mɛɛba jeŋmaji lɛ feɔ hoo, ni maji lɛ hu jwɛŋɔ yakanii?
Shikpɔŋ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ete shi edamɔ shi,ni lumɛi lɛ hu anaa ebakpe shi ewo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ!'
"Lɛɛlɛŋ, Herode kɛ Pontio Pilato kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ Israel maji lɛ hu ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ maŋ nɛɛŋ amɛwo otsulɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu, mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ,
koni amɛfee nii abɔ ni onine kɛ oyiŋtoo lɛ eto efɔ shi akɛ afee lɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ hu, Nuŋtsɔ kwɛmɔ amɛmɔhegbeyei ni amɛwoɔ lɛ, ni ohã otsuji lɛ kɛ ekãa pii ajaje owiemɔ lɛ,
ni okpã onine mli ni ohã atsatsaa mɛi, ni atsɔ̃ otsulɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu lɛ gbɛi nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii."
Ni be ni amɛsɔle nɛkɛ lɛ, he ni amɛnaa ebakpe shi yɛ lɛ hoso, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃; ni amɛkɛ ekãa jaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Shi mɛi babaoo lɛ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ tsui koome kɛ susuma koome, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɛɛɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ amli eko akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, shi eyɛ hã amɛ fɛɛ.
Ni hewalɛ kpeteŋkple bɔfoi lɛ kɛye Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shitee lɛ he odase, ni dromɔ kpeteŋkple yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ.
Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ ni efiɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔji loo shīa lɛ hɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ nii ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ ayinii lɛ ba,
amɛkɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa, ni ajaa ahãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bɔ ni hiaa lɛ.
Ni Yose, mɔ ni bɔfoi lɛ wo lɛ Barnaba (eshishi ji: Miishɛjemɔ bi) lɛ, ni ji Levinyo ni esɛɛ jɛ Kipro lɛ,
yɛ shikpɔŋ, ni ehɔ̃ɔ, ni ekɛ shika lɛ ba ni ekɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa.
5: Shi nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania kɛ eŋa Safira lɛ yahɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ ko,
ni nuu lɛ kɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ, ni eŋa hu le he eko, ni ekɛ fã lɛ ba ni ekɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa.
Shi Petro kɛɛ, "Anania, mɛɛba Satan yi otsuiŋ obɔ̃, ni omale otsɔ̃ɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni omale otsɔ̃ɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni okɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ?
Ani be ni eyɔɔ lɛ, jeee bo onɔ ni? Ni be ni ohɔ̃ɔ hu lɛ, shika lɛ jee bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ ni? Mɛɛba oto nɛkɛ yiŋ? Jeee gbɔmɛi omale otsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ."
Ni be ni Anania nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, egbee shi, ni egbo. Ni gbeyei kple mɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ.
Ni oblahii lɛ te shi, ni amɛbasaa lɛ kɛhã fuu, ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo ni amɛyafu lɛ.
Ni aaafee ŋmlɛtswai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ eŋa ni leee nɔ sane ni eba lɛ hu ba jɛi.
Ni Petro bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani bɔ ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhe nɛ? Kɛɛmɔ mi." Ni ekɛɛ, "Hɛɛ, nɛkɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Te fee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛfee naabu kome koni nyɛkɛka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ nɛɛ? Naa, mɛi ni yafu owu lɛ anaji yɔɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, ni amɛaawo bo hu kɛaatee."
Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ egbee shi yɛ Petro najianaa, ni egbo. Ni be ni oblahii lɛ ba lɛ amɛbana akɛ egbo ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyafu lɛ yɛ ewu lɛ masɛi.
Ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu nii nɛɛ.
Shi atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anine nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii pii yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hi Solomon Ablaanaa lɛ nɔ.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ekaaa akɛ ekɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ aaayakpɛtɛ amɛhe, shi maŋ lɛ buɔ amɛ naakpa.
Ni asaŋ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ yeɔ, hii kɛ yei babaoo, bafata amɛhe,
aahuu po ni aholeɔ helatsɛmɛi kɛbaa blohui amli abashwieɔ sai kɛ saatsei anɔ, koni kɛ Petro miiho lɛ, ehɔɔŋ kɛkɛ atsɔ̃ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi anɔ.
Ni mɛi pii jɛ maji ni jwere Yerusalem hewɔ lɛ amli babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhiɛ helatsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji haoɔ amɛ kɛba, ni atsa amɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ ni ji Sadukifoi lɛ akuu lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ ebɔ diɛŋtsɛ,
ni amɛbamɔmɔ bɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ maŋ kpabuŋ.
Shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo bagble tsu lɛ shinai lɛ, ni ejie amɛ ekɛɛ,
"Nyɛyaa nyɛyadamɔa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ nyɛjajea nɛkɛ wala nɛɛ wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a maŋ lɛ!"

Ni be amɛnu lɛ, amɛyiŋ leebi maaŋkpa amɛtee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ amɛyatsɔ̃ɔ nii. Agbɛnɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ba ni amɛbatsɛ akuashɔŋ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛtsu kɛtee tsu lɛ mli koni ayajie bɔfoi lɛ kɛba.
Shi be ni tsuji lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, amɛnaa amɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbagba
akɛ, "Tsu lɛ wɔna akɛ aŋa naa kpɛŋŋ, ni bulɔi lɛ hu damɔ shinai lɛ anaa; shi be ni wɔgble lɛ, wɔnaaa mɔ ko yɛ mli."
Shi be ni osɔfo lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, amɛfee yaa yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ahe (ni amɛbi) akɛ, Te enɛ naa yaakpa tɛŋŋ?"
Ni mɔ ko ba bagba amɛ akɛ, "Naa, hii lɛ ni nyɛwo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ damɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii."
Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ yiŋ ni amɛyaŋɔ amɛ kɛba, jeee nɔnyɛɛ naa, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei, ni akabatswia amɛ tɛi.
Ni be amɛkɛ amɛ ba lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛ badamɔ akushɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi amɛ
akɛ, "Ani wɔwoo nyɛ kita kadikadi akɛ nyɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli? Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni nyɛhã Yerusalem eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛmiitao akɛ nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ lá lɛ baa wɔnɔ."
Shi Petro kɛ bɔfoi lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Esa akɛ aboɔ Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ toi fe gbɔmɛi.
Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ ni nyɛgbe lɛ lɛ, wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tee lɛ shi;
lɛ enɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wo kɛtee eninejurɔ nɔ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ, koni ehã Israel ana tsuitsakemɔ kɛ eshaifaa.
Ni wɔji saji nɛɛ ahe odasefoi, nakai nɔŋŋ ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã mɛi ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ."
Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ ewo amɛmli la ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛaagbe amɛ.
Shi Farisifonyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gamaliel, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ buɔ lɛ lɛ, te shi damɔ shi yɛ akuashɔŋ lɛ teŋ, ni efã akɛ akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aje kpo fioo,
ni ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ aaaye ahã.
Ejaakɛ nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ Teuda te shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ji lɛ, ni hii aaafee ohai ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe yakpɛtɛ ehe; shi agbe lɛ, ni mɛi abɔ ni bo toi lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ shwã ni amɛyi hɛ shi.

Mɔnɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yuda, Galileanyo lɛ, te shi yɛ mɛi akanemɔ be lɛ mli, ni egbla asafo babaoo eshwie esɛɛ; lɛ hu ehiɛ kpãtã ni mɛi ni bo lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛŋmɛa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe ni nyɛkadia amɛsɛɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ nɛkɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ loo nɛkɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ jɛ lɛ, ebaafite;
shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ lɛ nyɛfite, koni nyɛkabafee nyɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wuɔ."
Ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛba, ni amɛyi amɛ, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkawie yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli; ni amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛje akuɔŋ lɛ hiɛ amɛtee kɛ miishɛɛ, akɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ abu amɛ mɛi ni sa akɛ abɔ amɛ ahora.
Ni gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ nitsumɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ shīa.
6: Nakai bei lɛ amli, be ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi faa lɛ, Helenibii lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Hebribii lɛ, ejaakɛ Hebribii lɛ ahiɛ jeɔ Helenibii lɛ akulafoi lɛ anɔ yɛ daa kwɛmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni kasrlɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tsɛ asafo lɛ kɛba, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Esaaa akɛ wɔshiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔyasɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ okplɔ̃i ahe.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtaoa nyɛteŋ hii kpawo ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nilee eyi amɛ obɔ̃, koni wɔkɛ amɛ ato nɛkɛ nitsumɔ ni he hiaa nɛɛ nɔ;
shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔhiɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ wiɛmɔ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli."

Ni wiemɔ lɛ sa asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ni amɛfamɔ Stefano, nuu ko ni hemɔkɛyeli kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃, kɛ Filipo kɛ Prokoro kɛ Mikanora kɛ Timon kɛ Parmena kɛ Nikolao ni emɔ Yudafoi ajamɔ mli ni ejɛ Antiokia lɛ,
ni amɛkɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi babamɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ; ni amɛsɔle ni amɛkɛ amɛniji shwie amɛnɔ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ shwere, ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi bafa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem, ni osɔfoi lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii mɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ni Stefano, mɔ dromɔ kɛ hewalɛ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ, fee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii wuji yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi mɛi komɛi ni jɛ kpeehe ni atsɛɔ lɛ "Mɛi ni eye amɛhe" akpeehe lɛ, kɛ Kirenemɛi kɛ Aleksandriamɛi kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kilikia kɛ Asia lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi te shi ni amɛkɛ Stefano taa naa;
shi amɛnyɛɛ Stefano nilee kɛ mumɔ ni ekɛwieɔ lɛ naa amɛdamɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ mɛi komɛi yafi ni amɛbakɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔnu akɛ ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Mose kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ."
Ni amɛwo maŋbii lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛte shi kɛba enɔ amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee akuashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ amale odasefoi badamɔ shi, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɛ akɛ, "Be fɛɛ be lɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ miiwie miishi he Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Mose Mla lɛ,
ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, aaafite biɛ,ni eeetsake kusumii ni Mose kɛhã wɔ lɛ."
Ni mɛi ni tra akushɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ tsu amɛhiŋmɛii amɛshwie enɔ, ni amɛna ehiɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hiɛ.
7: Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Stefano akɛ, "Ani saji nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai lo?"
Ni ekɛɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi kɛ Ataamɛi, nyɛboa toi! Anumnyam Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jie ehe kpoi etsɔ̃ɔ wɔtsɛ Abraham be ni eyɔɔ Mesopotamia, ni enako ebahi Haran lɛ,
ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Jee oshikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ o lɛ nɔ.'
Kɛkɛ ni eje Kaldeabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyahi Haran. Ni be ni etsɛ gbo sɛɛ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ kɛjɛ jɛi kɛba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔ;
ni ehãaa lɛ nɔyelinɔ ni ji shikpɔŋ ni shɛɔ nane tokota lɛɛmɔ tete, shi ewo lɛ shi akɛ ekɛaahã lɛ kɛ eshwiei ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ, tsɛ no mli lɛ ebɛ bi kwraa po.
Shi bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie ji akɛ, eshwiei lɛ aaayato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ko n, ni aaafee amɛ nyɔji ni aaawa amɛ yi afii ohai ejwɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, 'Makojo nakai maŋ ni amɛaayasɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛaaje jɛi ni amɛaabaja mi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ.'
Ni ekɛ ketiafoo he kpãŋmɔ lɛ hã lɛ; ni no hewɔ efɔ Isak ni efo lɛ ketia gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni Isak fɔ Yakob, ni Yakob hu fɔ blematsɛmɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
Ni blematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ hɔ̃ɔ Yosef kɛtee Egipt, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ yɛ,
ni ejie lɛ yɛ emanehului fiaa mli, ni ehã ehiɛ ba nyam, ni efee nilelɔ yɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ Farao hiɛ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ yɛ Egipt kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
"Shi hɔmɔ kɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple ba Egipt kɛ kanaan Shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ naaa nii amɛye.
Ni be ni Yakob nu akɛ able yɛ Egipt lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ etsu wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtee.
Ni nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef hã enyɛmɛi lɛ yoo lɛ, ni Farao hu bale Yosef weku lɛ.
Ni Yosef tsu ayakpee etsɛ Yakob kɛ eweku lɛ fɛɛ kɛba; amɛyi nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ.
Ni Yakob yiŋ etee Egipt, ni lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ yagboi yɛ jɛi.
Akɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ba Shekem, ni abato amɛ yɛ fuuhe ni Abraham tse shika he yɛ Hamorbii lɛ adɛŋ yɛ Shekem lɛ mli.
"Shi be ni bè ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye eshi ni ewo Abraham lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ lɛ, maŋ lɛ shwere, ni amɛyi fa yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋtsɛ kroko ni leee Yosef lɛ bate shi yɛ Egipt.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ, ekɛ wɔjakubii lɛ ye ŋaa mli ni efee wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ efɔŋ,akɛ ehã amɛshɛrɛ amɛbii abifabii amɛshwie, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkahi jeŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli afɔ Mose, ni ehe yɛ fɛo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni alɛ lɛ yɛ fɛo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni alɛ lɛ yɛ etsɛ we lɛ nyɔji etɛ̃.
Ni be ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ, Farao biyoo lɛ yawo lɛ, ni elɛ lɛ ekɛ lɛ fee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi.
Ni atsɔ̃ɔ Mose Egipt nilee fɛɛ, ni efee mɔ ko ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ ewiemɔi kɛ enitsumɔi amli.
"Be ni eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, eba eyiŋ akɛ eeeyasra enyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ.
Be ni ena akɛ aafee amɛteŋ mɔ ko efɔŋ lɛ, efã ehe, ni etɔ mɔ ni afeɔ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ he owele ni egbe Egiptnyo lɛ.
Ni esusu akɛ kulɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aayoo sɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitsɔ enine nɔ ehere amɛ; shi amɛyooo sɛɛ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ ebanina amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ ni amɛmiinɔ, ni ekpãtã amɛ ekɛɛ, 'Ataamɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji nyɛ; mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ nyɛhe efɔŋ nɛɛ?'
Shi mɔ ni feɔ enaanyo efɔŋ lɛ tsirɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, 'Namɔ wo o wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ?
Ani ootao akɛ ogbe mi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ lɛ ogbe Egiptnyo lɛ?
Ni wiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ Mose ji foi, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Midian shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni efɔ bihii enyɔ yɛ jɛi.
"Shi be ni shɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmeitso ko lalilɛi mli.
Be ni Mose na lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ ninaa lɛ hewɔ; ni be ni etiɔ ebɛŋkɛ ni ekwɛ lɛ enu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbee ni eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
'Miji otsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.' Ni Mose he kpokpo ni ekaaa akɛ eeeyakwɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Jiemɔ otokotai lɛ yɛ onane, ejaakɛ he ni odamɔ lɛ shikPɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Mina mimaŋ ni yɔɔ Egipt lɛ amanehulu lɛ,amɛŋtsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ hu minu;l ni mikpleke shi miba amɛjiemɔ; no hewɔ lɛ ba ni matsu o Egipt.'
"Nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛkwa lɛ amɛkɛɛ, 'Namɔ wo o wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ' lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ koo lɛ mlu lɛ nine nɔ etsu lɛ akɛ lumɔ lɛ kplɔ.
Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpla amɛ kɛje kpo, ni efee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ.
lɛji nakai Mose lɛ ni kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ' lɛ.
Mose ji mɔ ni kɛ asafo lɛ hi ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni edamɔ bɔfo ni kɛ lɛ wie yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ehe wala wiemɔi lɛ ni ekɛbahã wɔ lɛ.
"Shi wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsi lɛ amŋɛto afã, ni amɛtsui kpale kɛtee Egipt ekoŋŋ;
ni amɛkɛɛ Aaron akɛ, 'Feemɔ nyɔŋmɔi ohã wɔ ni amɛnyiɛ wɔhiɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ ni kpla wɔ kɛjɛ Egipt Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ ni efee lɛ.'
Nakai be lɛ mli amɛfee tsinabi amãgã, ni amɛshã afɔle amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛma amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ.

Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsi ehe kɛjɛ amɛhe ni eŋmɛɛ amɛhe akɛ amɛja ŋwɛinii, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ awolo lɛ mli akɛ, 'Nyɛ Israel we, ani nyɛshã kooloi afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle nyɛhã mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?
Dabida, Molok buu lɛ moŋ nyɛwo nyɛtre kɛ nyɛyɔŋmɔ Refan lɛ ŋulami lɛ ni ji amãgãi ni nyɛshɔ ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ.Shi Babilon sɛɛ maloo nyɛ kɛaatee.'
"Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hiɛ Odase Buu lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.Afee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni kɛ Mose wie lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efee lɛ lɛ, no ji efee lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni ena lɛ.
Buu nɛɛ, be ni wɔtsɛmɛi ni ba yɛ sɛɛ lɛ hu anine shɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ Yoshua hiɛ kɛba jeŋmaji ni Nyɔŋmɔ shwie amɛ yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni ehi shi kɛbashi David yinɔ.
David nɛɛ hiɛ ba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ekpa fai ni ahã emã shihilɛhe ko eha Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi Solomon ji mɔ ni mã tsu ehã lɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ ŋwɛinyo lɛ ehii tsui ni akɛ niji fee amli, tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ hu kɛɛ lɛ,
'ŋwɛi lɛ, misɛ̃i ni,'Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ 'ni shikpɔŋ lɛ, minaneshi maaŋoo ni. Mɛɛ tsu nyɛaama nyɛhã mi mɔ, Asaŋ nɛɛgbɛ ji mihejɔɔmɔhe lɛ?
Aso jeee minine fee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ?'
"Nyɛ kuɛŋtilɔi kɛ tsuiiaŋ kɛ toiiaŋ foolɔi! Nyɛ lɛ, daa nɛɛ nyɛkuɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa; bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfeɔ.
Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ waaa lɛ yi? Amɛgbe mɛi ni gba yɛ jalɔ lɛ baa lɛ he amɛto lɛ. Ni agbɛnɛ nyɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ,
nyɛ ni nyɛna Mla lɛ kɛtsɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ, ni nyɛyeee nɔ lɛ."
Shi be ni amɛnu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkpe amɛnyanyɔji ashishi kɛ mlifu.
Shi Stefano ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kwɛ ŋwɛi gãa, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ kɛ Yesu ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ,
ni ekɛɛ, 'Naa, miina ŋwɛi naa egble, kɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Shi amɛblɔ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni amɛtsimɔ amɛtoii, ni amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ke kɛbashwie enɔ,
ni amɛtsire eyi sɛɛ kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyastswia lɛ tɛi. Ni odasefoi lɛ kɛ amɛmamai lɛ shwie oblanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saulo lɛ najianaa.
Ni be ni amɛtswiaa Stefano tɛi lɛ, ebo etsɛ Yesu ni ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, heremɔ mimumɔ lɛ!"
Ni ekula shi, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, kaawo amɛ nɛkɛ esha nɛɛ he nyɔŋmɔ!" Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ mli ewɔ.
8: Shi gbe ni agbe Stefano lɛ ŋɔɔ Saulo hu naa. Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ yiwaa kple te shi wo asafo ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛgbɛ amɛshwã Yudea kɛ Samaria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ shwɛ.
Hii nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi komɛi yato Stefano, ni amɛfo lɛ pam.
Shi Saul bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã asafo lɛ hiɛ, ni ejɛɔ shīa kɛyaa shīa ni eyagblaa hii kɛ yei ni eyawoɔ amɛ tsuŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ yakpa shi, ni amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ.
Ni Filipo tee Samaria maŋ ko nɔ, ni eyashiɛ Krito he sane etsɔ̃ɔ jɛi bii lɛ.
Ni mɛi babaoo kɛ jwɛŋm( kome bo wiemɔi ni Filipo wieɔ lɛ toi be ni amɛnu ni amɛna okadii ni efee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ amumɔi lɛ blɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ni amɛje amɛmli, ni atsa mɛi ni ekumɔ kɛ obubuafoi pii hu.
Ni miishɛɛ babaoo ba nakai maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi nuu ko yɛ maŋ lɛ mli momosa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon ni eyeɔ ŋkunyaa ni ehãa Samariabii lɛ anaa kpɛɔ amɛhe, etsɔ̃ɔ ehe akɛ gbɔmɔ agbo ji lɛ;
ni mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ boɔ lɛ toi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Mɔnɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ."
Ni akɛni ejɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ekɛ ekunyaayeli lɛ ehã amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛboɔ lɛ toi.

Shi be ni amɛhe Filipo ni jaje Nyŋɔmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ amɛye lɛ, abaptisi lɛ, ni ekɛ ehe kpɛtɛ Filipo, ni be ni ena okadii ni afee kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi wuji ni atsu lɛ, enaa kpɛ ehe.
Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ nu akɛ Samariabii emɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛtsu Petro kɛ Yohane kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ,
ejaakɛ ebako amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ, shi baptisimɔ kɛkɛ abaptsis amɛ awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛniji ŋmlɛ̃ amɛnɔ, ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Shi be ni Simon na akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aniji kɛ mɛi anɔ ŋmlɛ̃mɔ lɛ hãa anaa Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ shika ba ebahã amɛ
ekɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa mi hu nɛkɛ hewalɛ nɛɛ koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mikɛ miniji aaaŋmɛ̃ enɔ lɛ ana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ oshika lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ shika akɛheɔ!
Obɛ gbɛnaa loo gbɛfaŋ otsui ejaaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ shwa ohe yɛ onɔsha nɛɛ hewɔ, ni okpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, akɛ aleee nɔ akɛ otsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ aaafa o lo.
Ejaakɛ mina akɛ hiɛkɔɔ eyi bo obɔ̃ tamɔ kɔlikɔ joomɔ ni nɔ̃ sha kpãa lɛ mli oyɔɔ nɛɛ."
Ni Simon here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkpaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai nyɛhãa mi koni nibii ni nyɛwie nɛɛ eko akaba minɔ."
Agbɛnɛ, be ni amɛye oadse ni amɛshiɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba Yerusalem lɛ, amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Samariabii akrowai pii amli.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko kɛ Filipo bawie akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya wuoyigbɛ yɛ tempɔŋ ni kã shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛyaa Gaza lɛ nɔ."
Ni ete shi ni eyiŋ etee. Ni naa, Etiopiabii amaŋnyɛ Kandake lɛ piafonyo ni ji esɔ̃ɔlɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ ejwetri fɛɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ; ebaho Yerusalem eyaja Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni agbɛnɛ eku esɛɛ eta eshwiili mli kɛmiiya ni eekane gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ.
Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ Filipo akɛ, "Yaa ni okɛ ohe ayakpɛtɛ shwiili lɛ he."
Shi be ni Filipo wo foi kɛtee lɛ, enu akɛ eekane Yesaia wolo lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Ani oonu nɔ ni okaneɔ lɛ shishi lo?
Ni ekɛɛ, "Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni manyɛ manu shishiŋ, akɛ ja mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ mi dã?"Kɛkɛ ni ekpa Filipo fai akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abata shi.
Shi ŋmalɛ lɛ he ekaneɔ lɛ nɛ, "Akpla lɛ kɛtee tam( too gwaŋtɛŋ ni ayaagbe lɛ, ni bɔ ni too gwaŋtɛŋbi hiɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ etswaaa esɛŋ.
Be ni aba lɛ shi lɛ akojooo lɛ jalɛ naa; shi eshwiei lɛ, namɔ aaagba amɛhe sane? Ejaakɛ afo ewala sɛɛ kɛjɛ shikPɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Ni piafonyo lɛ bi Filipo akɛ, "Miikpa o fai, namɔ he gbalɔ lɛ wieɔ nɛɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ loo mɔ kroko?"
Ni Filipo gble enaa ni eje shishi kɛjɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni ejaje Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛbashɛ nu ko he, ni piafonyo lɛ kɛɛ, "Naa nu; mɛni tsiɔ mibaptisimɔ gbɛ?"
(Shi Filipo kɛɛ, "Kɛji ohe kɛ otsuiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, oyɛ hegbɛ." Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Miihe miiye akɛ Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.")
Ni efã akɛ shwiili lɛ awa, ni Filipo kɛ piafonyo lɛ fɛɛ yimɔ shi kɛttee nu lɛ mli, ni ebaptisi lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛje nu lɛ mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ sha Filipo kɛtee; ni piafonyo lɛ enaaa lɛ dɔŋŋ, shi eyi gbɛ kɛ nyamɔ.
Shi Filipo lɛ, ana lɛ yɛ Azotu; ni be ni efoɔ mli lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛyashi ebashɛ Kaiarea.
9: Shi Saulo kã he ekɛ gbele miiwo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ahe gbeyei lolo, ni eyiŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ,
ni eyabi lɛ woji ni ekɛya Damasko kpeehei lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji ena mɛi komɛi ni hiɛ nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, hii jio, yei jio, ni efimɔ amɛ ni ekpla amɛ kɛba Yerusalem.
Shi be ni enyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni eebɛŋkɛ Damasko lɛ, trukaa lɛ la kpɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbabɔle lɛ,
ni eflɛo egbee shi, ni enu gbee ko ni miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Saulo, Saulo, mɛɛba owaa mi yi?"
Ni ekɛɛ, "Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?" Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Mi Yesu, mɔ ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ. Ewa hã o akɛ ooofã ntia oshi kooloi akplamɔtso lɛ naa dade lɛ."
Ni ekɛ hekpokpomɔ kɛ ŋmiŋmi kɛɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee?" Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya maŋ lɛ mli, ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ o nɔ ni sa akɛ ofee."
Shi hii ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ etɔ mu kɛdamɔ shi, amɛmiinu gbee lɛ moŋ, shi amɛnaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko.
Ni Saulo te shi; shi be ni egble eshiŋmɛii lɛ, enaaa nii; ni amɛmɔ enine mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ tee Damasko.
Ni enaaa nii, ni asaŋ eyeee nii ni enuuu nɔ ko hu gbii etɛ̃.

Shi Kaselɔi ko yɛ Damasko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya blohu ni atsɛɔ lɛ trɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni oyabi mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ saulo ni jɛ Tarso lɛ shi yɛ Yuda we lɛ; ejaakɛ naa, eesɔle,
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya blohu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Trɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni oyabi mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saulo ni jɛ Tarso lɛ shi yɛ Yuda we lɛ; ejaakɛ naa, eesɔle,
ni Saulo na yɛ ninaa mli akɛ nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania lɛ miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ enine miiŋmɛ enɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ena nii ekoŋŋ."
Shi Anania here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, minu nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ he sane yɛ mɛi pii anaa, akɛ efee omɛi Krɔŋkrŋi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ efɔŋ babaoo;
ni biɛ hu tete ena hegbɛ kɛjɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ adɛŋ akɛ ebafimɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ ogbɛi lɛ."
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa, ejaakɛ mɔnɛ ji midɛŋ dade ni mihala mihã mihe koni ehiɛ migbɛi lɛ kɛya jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Israelbii lɛ hu ahiɛ.
Mibatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ amanehului abɔ ni sa akɛ ena yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni Anania yiŋ etee ni eyabote shia lɛ, ni ekɛ eniji swie enɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Anyɛmi Saulo! Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ o be ni obaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, etsu mi oŋɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ona nii ekoŋŋ ni oyi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
Ni amrɔ lɛ nibii komɛi jɛ ehiɛmɛii anɔ shwie shi tamɔ loototoi, ni ena nii, ni ete shi ni abaptisi lɛ;
ni eye nii, ni ehe wa lɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ eshiɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.

Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Ani jeee mɔnɛ kpãtã mɛi ni tsɛɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, ni jeee no hewɔ nɔŋŋ eba biɛ hu tete koni ebafimɔ amɛ ni ekpla amɛ kɛya osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ?"
Shi Saulo lɛ, ena hewalɛ babaoo, ni ehã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ anaa tã, ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋ akɛ mɔnɛ ji Kristo lɛ.
Shi gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ tee eyi nɔ apam akɛ amɛaagbe lɛ.
Ni Saulo banu amɛkpãŋmɔ lɛ he. Shi amɛbuɔ maŋ agboi lɛ anaa daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ lɛ wo kafu mli nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛshi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛyayi shi.
Ni be Saulo ba Yerusalem lɛ, eka kaselɔi lɛ ahe kpɛtɛmɔ, shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiishe lɛ gbeyei,amɛheee amɛyeee akɛ kaselɔ ji lɛ.
Shi Barnaba ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee bɔfoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni eyagba amɛ bɔ ni ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wie. kɛ bɔ ni efee ekãa yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli yɛ! Damasko.
Ni ekɛ amɛ yaa baa yɛ Yerusalem, ni eshiɛ kɛ ekãa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ mli.
Ni ekɛ Helenibii lɛ wie ni ekɛ amɛ taa naa; shi amɛka lɛ gbee.
Be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ nu he lɛ amɛkɛ lɛ tee Kaoisarea, ni amɛwo lɛ gbɛ kɛtee Tarso.
Agbɛnɛ asafo lɛ na hejɔlɛ yɛ Yudea kɛ Galilea kɛ samaria fɛɛ, ni enane mɔ shi, ni enyiɛɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishewɔ mli, ni ekɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ miishɛjemɔ lɛ shwereɔ.
Shi eba mli akɛ, be ni Petro eyakpa hei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, eba mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ Lida lɛ hu aŋɔɔ.
Ni ebana nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ainea ni ekɛ kuumɔhela ekã saa nɔ afii kpaanyɔ sɔŋŋ.
Ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ainea, Yesu Kristo miitsa o; tee shi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oŋmɛ osaa lɛ!" Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Liba kɛ Sharon lɛ na lɛ, ni amɛtsake ni amɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi yoo kaselɔ ko yɛ yopa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tabita, eshishi ji Darka. Nitsumɔi kpakpai kɛ ejurɔfeemɔ eyi yoo nɛɛ obɔ̃. 37, Shi eba mli akɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, ehe ni amɛkɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ ŋwiɛtsu ko mli.
Lida kɛ Yopa jɛkɛɛɛ kwraa, ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu akɛ Petro yɛ Lida L2, amɛtsu hii enyɔ kɛtee eŋɔɔ amɛyakpa lɛ afi akɛ ekashao shi, shi eba amɛɛɔɔ oya.

Ni Petro te shi ni ekɛ amɛ tee. Ni be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛ tee ŋwɛitsu lɛ mli, ni yei okulafoi lɛ fɛɛ ŋwɛitsu lɛ mli, ni yei okulafoi lɛ fɛɛ badamɔdamɔɔ emasɛi amɛmiifofoi, ni amɛkɛ flakai kɛ atadei ni Dorka fee be ni ekɛ amɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Ni Petro skwie amɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekula shi esɔle, ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbonyo lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Tabita, tee shi!" Ni egble ehiŋmɛii, ni be ni ena Petro lɛ, ete shi eta shi.
Ni Petro mɔ enine mli, ni ewo enɔ; ni etsɛ mɛi Krɔŋkrɔi lɛ kŋ okulãfoi lŋ kɛba, ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛhiɛ hiɛkãalɔ.
Ni anɔ he yɛ Yopa fɛɛ, ni mɛi pii he Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ amɛye.
Ni Petro hi Yopa gbii kplaŋŋ yɛ wolokpoolɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon lɛ ŋɔɔ.
10: Shi nuu ko yɛ Kaisarea ni atsɛɔ lɛ Korneloi ni ji asraafoihaatsɛ yɛ asraafoi akuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Italia kuu lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ ni, ni ekɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni efeɔ maŋbii lɛ ejurɔ pii, ni ekpaa Nyɔŋmɔ fai daa.
Aaafee gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ, ena yɛ ninaa mli faŋŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo ko ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kornelio!"
Ni ekwɛ lɛ gãa ni eshe gbeyei ni ekɛɛ; "Mɛniŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?" Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Osɔlemɔi kɛ onijuji ni ofeɔ lɛ eshɛ ŋwɛi ni efee kaimɔnɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ tsu mɛi kɛya Yopa ni ayakpee Simon mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba;
eyato Simon, wolokpoolɔ ko ni shīa yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ."
