Be ni bɔfo ni kɛ lɛ bawie lɛ etee lɛ, etsɛ ewebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ kɛ asraafonyo ko ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni ji mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome,
ni egba amɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni etsu amɛ Yopa.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ, be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni amɛbɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ, Petro tee sɔlemɔ yɛ tsu yiteŋ aaafee shwane ŋmlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli.
Ni hɔmɔ ye lɛ naakpa, ni eetao nɔ ko eye. Shi be ni afeɔ niyenii lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ enyɔ enɔ,
ni ena akɛ ŋwɛi egble, ni nɔ ko miikpleke shi ni tamɔ mama kpeteŋkple, ni ahiɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ mli aashi kɛmiiba shikpɔŋ;
ni shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ kɛ waamɔnii kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ eko yɛ mli.
Ni gbee ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Petro, tee shi, gbee ni oye."
Shi Petro kɛɛ, "Dabida, Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ miyeko nɔ ko ni buleɔ mɔ loo nɔ ko ni he tseee dã."
Ni gbee lɛ saa kɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, "Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsuu he lɛ, kaabu lɛ akɛ bulemɔnɔ."
Shi afee nakai shii etɛ̃; ni awo nɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ekoŋŋ.
Be ni Petro efee yaa akɛ te nii ni ena nɛɛ shishiŋ lɛ, hii lɛ ni Kornelio tsu lɛ miibibii Simon we lɛ gbɛ; ni amɛbadamɔ agbo lɛ naa
amɛtsɛ ni amɛbi akɛ, "Ani biɛ Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ bato lɛ?"
Shi be ni Petro jwɛŋɔ ninaa lɛ he lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, hii etɛ̃ komɛi miitao o;
no hewɔ lɛ tee shi okpleke shi okɛ amɛ aya, ni okaje ŋwane ko, ejaakɛ mi mitsu amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Petro kpleke shi, ni eyakɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, "Naa, miji mɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ; mɛɛ sane hewɔ nyɛba?"

Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Asraafoiohaatsɛ Kornelio, ni ji nuu jalɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ni Yudafoi amaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ ehe odase lɛ, lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo krɔŋkrɔŋ ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ etsu ni abakpee o kɛba ewe lɛ, koni ebo onaa toi."
Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ amɛ kɛba shīa lɛ ni ebafee amɛ gbɔ. Ni en( jetsɛremɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee ni nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yopa lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi fata ehe kɛtee.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ amɛyashɛ Kaisarea. Shi Kornelio miikwɛ amɛ gbɛ, ni etsɛ ewekumɛi kɛ enanemɛi juji kɛkpe.
Ni be ni Petro boteɔ shīa lɛ, Kornelio kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni eho egbee enajianaa ni eja lɛ.
Shi Petro wo enɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Tee shi, shi mi diɛŋtsɛ hu gbɔmɔ ji mi."
Ni ekɛ lɛ hiɛ sanegbaa kɛbote shīa lɛ, ni eyana mɛi pii ni ebabua amɛhe naa lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle bɔ ni Yudanyo bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekɛ mɔ ko ni ji maŋ kroko nɔ nyo bɔɔ aloo ebaa eŋɔɔ; shi mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ mikatsɛ mɔ ko mɔ ni he tseee loo mɔ ni buleɔ mɔ.
No hewɔ hu ni be ni atsu abatsɛ mi lɛ, mijieee naa ni miba nɛɛ. Ni agbɛnɛ miibi nyɛ, 'Mɛɛ sane hewɔ nyɛbakpee mi nɛɛ?'"
Ni Kornelio kɛɛ akɛ, "ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii ejwɛ aaajee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli nɛkɛ pɛ, miisɔle yɛ mishīa nɛɛ; ni naa, nuu ko ni wo atade kaŋkaŋ badamɔ mihiɛ,
ni ekɛɛ, 'Kornelio, abo osɔlemɔ lɛ toi, ni onijuji ni ofeɔ lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ena.
No hewɔ lɛ tsu kɛya Yopa, ni ayatsɛ Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba; eyato Simon wolokpoolɔ lɛ ni shīa kã ŋshɔ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mitsu oŋɔɔ, ni ofee jogbaŋŋ akɛ oba. No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ biɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ koni wɔbo nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã o akɛ okɛɛ lɛ toi."
Kɛkɛ ni Petro gble enaa ni ekɛɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ, miyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee mɛiahīaŋkwɛlɔ;
Shi moŋ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli lɛ, mɔ ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni etsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ, lɛji mɔ ni saa ehiɛ.
Nyɔmɔ tsu akɛ wiemɔ lɛ yahã Isaelbii ni etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ejaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa etsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ejaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Yesu nɛɛ ji mɛi fɛɛ a-Nuŋtsɔ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle sane lɛ ni ba Yudea ni eje shishi kɛjɛ Galilea, yɛ baptisimɔ ni Yohane shiɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ hewalɛ fɔ Yesu ni jɛ Nazaret lɛ mu, ni ekpaa shi efeɔ ekpakpa ni etsaa mɛi fɛɛ ni abonsam haoɔ amɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ yɛ.
Ni wɔji nibii fɛɛ ni efee yɛ Yudafoi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ yerusalem lɛ he odasefoi. Amɛsɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, ni ehã ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ,
jeee mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, shi moŋ odasefoi ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehala eto momo lɛ, ni ji wɔ mɛi ni wɔkɛ lɛ ye nii ni wɔkɛ lɛ nu, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ.
Ni ewo wɔ kitã akɛ wɔshiɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ ni wɔye odase akɛ lɛji mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã akɛ hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ akojolɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ehe odase gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ aaana ehe eshai faa yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ."
Be ni Petro wieɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lolo lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ba mɛi fɛɛ ni nu wiemɔ lɛ anɔ.
Ni heyelɔi abɔ ni jɛ ketiafolɔi ateŋ ni kɛ Petro ba lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe akɛ afɔse Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔkeenɔ lɛ ashwie jeŋmajiaŋbii hu anɔ,
ejaakɛ amɛ nu akɛ amɛmiiwie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni amɛmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ agbojee lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Petro here nɔ akɛ,
"Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ nu naa atsi, ni akabaptisi mɛnɛɛmɛi ni na Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ?"
Ni efã akɛ abaptisi amɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekɛ amɛ ahi shi gbii fioo ko.
11: Agbɛnɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ hu emɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli.
Ni be ni Petro ba Yerusalem lɛ, mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi ateŋ lɛ kɛ lɛ ná
amɛkɛɛ, "Otee hii foolɔi aŋɔɔ ni okɛ amɛ yaye nii."
Shi Petro je Shishi ni egba amɛ nibii lɛ fɛɛ ekomekome ekɛɛ,
"Miyɛ Yopa maŋ lɛ mli miisɔle, ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni nɔ enyɔ minɔ, ni mina ninaa ko akɛ nɔ ko jɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ mama kple ni ahiɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ mli aashi kɛmiiba shi, ni eba miŋɔɔ kpaakpa.
Ni be ni mitsɛ̃je mihiɛ ni mikwɛ mli lɛ, mina shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛtsɛmɛi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ kooloi ni wamɔɔ kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji yɛ mli.
Ni minu gbee ko hu kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Petro, tee shi, gbee ni oye!'
Shi mikɛɛ, 'Dabida, Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ ko ni buleɔ mɔ aloo nɔ ko ni he tsee eyako midaaŋ dã.'
Shi gbee ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ here mi nɔ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsuu he lɛ, kaabu lɛ nɔ ni he tseee.'
Afee nakai shii etɛ̃, ni agbla fɛɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ekoŋŋ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hii etɛ̃ badamɔ shīa he ni miyɔɔ lɛ agbo lɛ naa ní atsu amɛ kɛjɛ Kaisarea kɛba miŋɔɔ.
Ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛ amɛ aya, ni mikashashao shi kwraa; ni nyɛmimɛi ekpaa hu kɛ mi tee, ni wɔyabote nuu lɛ we lɛ.
Ni egba wɔ bɔ ni ena bɔfo lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ ni edamɔ shi eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Tsu kɛya Yopa ni oyakpee Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ ni edamɔ shi eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Tsu kɛya Yopa ni oyakpee Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba,
ni eeebakɛɛ o wiemɔi ni aaatsɔ̃ nɔ ahere bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ yiwala."
Shi be ni mibɔ̃i wiemɔ lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ bayi amɛnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eyi wɔ hu wɔnɔ tsutsu lɛ.
Ni mikai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Yohane lɛ ekɛ nu baptisi, shi nyɛ lɛ akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaabaptisi nyɛ lɛ.'
Agbɛnɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ nakai nɔkeenɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni ehã wɔ ni wɔheɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ hu lɛ, namɔ ji mi ni manyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa matsi?"
Shi be ni amɛnu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, amɛmua amɛnaa, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam moŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Belɛ jeŋmaji lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ tsuitsakemɔ ni akɛhere amɛyiwala!"
Mɛi ni gbɛ shwa yɛ Stefano amanehulu lɛ mli lɛ fo mli kɛtee Foinikia kɛ Kipro kɛ Antiokia tɔ̃ɔ, shi amɛjajeee wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ja Yudafoi lɛ kɛkɛ.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, Kiprobii kɛ Kirenebii ji amɛ, ni amɛba antiokia amɛ bawie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Helabii lɛ hu, ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ fata amɛhe, ni mɛi babaoo he ye, ni amɛkpale kɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni amɛhe sane lɛ bashɛ Yerusalem asafo lɛ Toiŋ, ni amɛtsu Barnaba kɛtee Antiokia.
Ni be ni ebashɛ jɛi ni ebana Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ, emii shɛ ehe, ni ewo amɛ fɛɛ ekãa akɛ amɛkɛ tsui ni fiɔ shi akpɛtɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji Barnaba ni eyi obɔ̃ Kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli. Ni ana mɛi babaoo afata Nuŋtsɔ lɛ asafo lɛ he.
Ni Barnaba yiŋ etee Tarso ni eyatao Saulo, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ ba antiokia.
Ni eba mli akɛ amɛkɛ asafo lɛ hi shi afi naakplɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi babaoo anii, ni Antiokia klɛŋklɛŋ awo akselɔi lɛ agbɛi yɛ akɛ Kristofoi.
Shi nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, gbalɔi komɛi jɛ Yerusalem ba Antiokia.
Ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Agabo lɛ te shi damɔ shi, ni etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa akɛ hɔmɔ waa baaba jeŋ fɛɛ, ni eba mli nakai yɛ Kaisare Klaudio yinɔ.
Shi kaselɔi lɛ kpɛ mli akɛ amɛaabua nɔ ko naa amɛkɛyahã nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaanyɛ.
Ni amɛfee nakai, ni amɛkɛmaje onukpai lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Barnaba kɛ Saulo nine nɔ.
12: Nakai bei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ lɛ, maŋtsɛ Herode kpã enine mli, eta Kristo asafo lɛ he koni efee asafo lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi efɔŋ.
Ni ekɛ klaŋte gbe Yohane nyɛmi Yakobo.
Ni be ni ena akɛ eŋɔɔ Yudafoi lɛ anaa lɛ, etee nɔ ni emɔ Petro hu. Shi akpiti Gbii lɛ amli ni.
Ni be emɔ lɛ lɛ, ewo lɛ tsuŋ, ni etu lɛ ewo asraafoi akui ejwɛ ni mɛi ejwɛɛjwɛ yɔɔ mli dɛŋ ni amɛbu ehe; ni esusu akɛ Hehoo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ eeejie lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ.
Be mli ni atsi Petro naa yɛŋ tsu lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, asafo lɛ hiɛ sɔlemɔ mli kɛ lɛ hãmɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.

Shi gbi ni Herod taoɔ akɛ ekɛ Petro aba maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ,nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekã asraafoi enyɔ teŋ eewɔ, ni awo lɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i enyɔ, ni bulɔi hu damɔ shinaa lɛ naa amɛmiibu hu damɔ shinaa lɛ naa amɛmiibu tsu lɛ he.
Ni naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko badamɔ emasɛi, ni la kpɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli ni egba Petro ŋmawu ma ni etsiɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Tee shi mramra!" Ni ekɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ klpɔ yɛ eniji.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miamɔ ni owo otokotai lɛ" Ni efee nakai. Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ obo lɛ akete ohe ni onyiɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ obo lɛ akete ohe ni onyiɛ misɛɛ."
Ni enyiɛ kɛje kpo, ni eleee akɛ nɔ ni lɛ fɛɔ lɛ yɛ mli,shi efeɔ lɛ akɛ nii enaa.

Shi be ni amɛho klɛŋklɛŋ bulɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ji enyɔ lɛ ahe lɛ, amɛshɛ dade agbo no kã kɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ he, ni diɛŋtsɛ egble ehe ehã amɛ, ni amɛje kpo ni amɛfo blohu kome mli, ni amrɔ lɛ bɔfo lɛ shi lɛ.
Ni be ni Petro hiɛ tserɛ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Kpaako mina mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsu ebɔfo lɛ kɛba, ni ebajie mi yɛ Herode dɛŋ kɛ nɔ ni Yudafoi lɛ amaŋ lɛ kwɛɔ gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ mli."
Ni be ni eyɔse enɛ lɛ, eba Yohane ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko hu lɛ nyɛ Maria we lɛ, he ni mɛi pii anaa ebakpe shi ni amɛsɔleɔ yɛ lɛ.
Ni be ni Petro shi agbo lɛ, oblayoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Roda lɛ ba toiboo;
ni be ni eyoo Petro gbee lɛ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ naa lɛ egbleee agbo lɛ, shi moŋ ejo foi kɛtee tsu lɛ mli eyakɛɛ akɛ Petro damɔ agbo lɛ sɛɛ.
Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Oye sɛkɛ!" Shi ema nɔ mi akɛ eyɛ mli nakai.Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Belɛ ebɔfo ni."

Shi Petro kã he eeshi; ni be ni amɛgble lɛ, amɛna lɛ, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛfee dioo, ni egba amɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fee ni ejie lɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli lɛ; ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yakobo kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ."
Shi efɔ̃ amɛ nine akɛ amɛfee dioo, ni egba amɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fee ni ejie lɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli lɛ; ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yakobo kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ." Ni eje jɛi etee he kroko.
Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, yoyromɔ ni asraafoi lɛ yoyro yɛ le ni amɛleee nɔ eba Petro nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,jeee hiɛ nɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Herode taoɔ lɛ ni enaaa lɛ lɛ, ekojo bulɔi lɛ ni efã akɛ ayagbe amɛ. Ni Herode je Yudea etee Kaisare ni eyahi jɛi.

Shi Herode mli efu Tirobii kɛ Sidonbii lɛ naakpa; no hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛbatao maŋtsɛ lɛ piafonyo ni gbɛi ji Blasto lɛ hiɛgbɛ ni amɛyakpa hejɔlɛ he fai, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛnaa amɛniyenii kɛjɛɔ.
Gbi ni ato ko nɔ lɛ Herode wo emaŋtsɛ atade lɛ ni eyata kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ maŋ lɛ wie.
Ni mɛi lɛ blɔ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ gbee nɛ, shi jeee gbɔmɔ gbee ni."
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo tswa lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ ekɛ anumnyam lɛ hãaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni gɔ̃gɔ̃mii ye lɛ, ni egbo.
Agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni egbɛ eshwã eshwere.
Be ni Barnaba kɛ Saulo egbe amɛsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ Yerusalem ni amɛŋɔ Yohane, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko hu lɛ, amɛfata amɛhe.
13: Shi gbalɔi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔi komɛi yɛ Antiokia asafo lɛ mli, amɛji Barnaba kɛ Simeon, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Niger hu lɛ, kɛ Lukio, Kirenenyo lɛ, kɛ Manahen, mɔ ni alɛ lɛ kɛ lumɔ Herode lɛ kɛ Saulo.
Shi be ni amɛjaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni amɛhiɔ ŋmaa lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ, "Nyɛjiea Barnaba kɛ Saulo nyɛhãa mi kɛhã nitsumɔi ni mitsɛ amɛ yɛ hewɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛhi ŋmaa ni amɛsɔle, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji ŋmlɛ̃ amɛnɔ ni amɛwo amɛ gbɛ.
Akɛni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ etsu Saulo kɛ Barnaba akɛ amɛya lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee Seleukia, ni amɛkɛ lɛlɛ jɛ jɛi kɛtee Kipro.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ Salami lɛ, amɛjaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ Yudafoi lɛ akpeehei lɛ. Amɛkɛ Yahane hu nyiɛ akɛ amɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ.
Ni be amɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔkpɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛtee Pafo lɛ, amɛna Yudanyo ŋkunyaayelɔ ko ni ji amale gbalɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ber-Yesu lɛ;
ekɛ amralo Sergio Paulo ni ji nuu nileɔ yɔɔ. Amralo nɛɛ tsɛ Barnaba kɛ Saulo kɛba eŋɔɔ, eetao akɛ enu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Shi Elima ŋkunyaayelɔ lɛ (egbɛi lɛ shishi yɛ Hela wiemɔ mli ji no) ku amɛnaa, ejaakɛ eetao ni ekple amralo lɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he.
Shi Saulo mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Paulo hu, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ, kwɛ Elima gãa
ni ekɛɛ, "Ao, bo abosam bi ni shishiumɔ kɛ kutumpɔo fɛɛ eyi o obɔ̃, bo jalɛ fɛɛ henyɛlɔ, aso ofɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi trɔmɔi lɛ akɔdɔmɔ̃?
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nine kã onɔ, ni oooshwila ni onaŋ hulu kɛyaashi be ko."Ni amrɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ afua kɛ duŋ baha enɔ, ni egbugbuu shi eetao mɔ ko amɔ enine mli ayajie lɛ gbɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni amrɔlo lɛ na nɔ ni afee lɛ, ehe eye, ni ehe jɔ̃ ehe yɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ he lɛ hewɔ.
Shi be Paulo kɛ emɛi lɛ fã kɛjɛ Pafo lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛlɛ ba Perga yɛ Pamfilia; ni Yohane shi amɛ, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalem ekoŋŋ.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛfo mli kɛjɛ Perga kɛtee Antiokia ni yɔɔ Pisidia lɛ, ni amɛtee kpeehe lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyata shi.
Ni be akane Mose Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, kpeehe lɛ onukpai lɛ tsu abakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji nyɛyɛ hewalɛwoo wiemɔ ko kɛhã mɛi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ awiea."
Kɛkɛ ni Paulo te shi edamɔ shi, ni efɔ̃ enine ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi Israelhii kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, nyɛboa toi!
Nɛkɛ maŋ Israel nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hala wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni be ni amɛyato gbɔɔ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo maŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ hewalɛ jie amɛ kɛjɛ jɛi.
Ni ekɛ tsuishitoo hiɛ amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ aaafee afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ,
ni ekpãtã jeŋmaji kpawo ahiɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eja amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã amɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.
Enɛ fɛɛ ye aaafee afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ."Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ehã amɛ kojolɔi kɛbashi gbalɔ Samuel nɔ.
Ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛbi maŋtsɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kish bi Saul, nuu ko ni jɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli, hã amɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Ni be ni ekpa lɛ lɛ, etee David shi ni ewo lɛ amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ, ni eye ehe odase ekɛɛ, 'Mina David, Ishai bi lɛ, nuu ni miyɔɔ ehe tsui ni eeefee misuɔmɔnaanii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.'
Mɔnɛ shwie mli Nyɔŋmɔ jie Yesu kɛjɛ yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa ehã Israel akɛ yiwalaherelɔ.
Dani Yesu ba lɛ, Yohane eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisi amɛ.
Ni be ni Yohane egbe enitsumɔ lɛ naa etã lɛ, ekɛɛ, Namɔ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ miji? Jeee miji lɛ; shi naa, mɔ ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ etokotai yɛ enaji.'
"Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi,Abraham shwiei kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ, wɔ atsu akɛ nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ sane nɛɛ bahã."

Ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ, akɛni amɛleee Yesu, ni asaŋ amɛnuuu gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi ni akaneɔ hejɔmɔgbi fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi nɔ lɛ ashishi hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛfɔ ni amɛbu lɛ lɛ ehã gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi lɛ eba mli.
Ni tsɛ amɛnaaa sane ko yɛ ehe ni amɛaadamɔ nɔ kɛbu lɛ gbele fɔ moŋ, kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpa Pilato fai akɛ agbe lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛhã nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ eba mli lɛ, amɛjie lɛ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ,ni amɛyato lɛ yɛ gbonyobu ko mli.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ;
Ni ejie ehe kpo gbii pii etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ jɛ Galilea ba Yerusalem lɛ, ni amɛji odasefoi ha maŋ lɛ.
Ni wɔ lɛ, shi ni ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ,
akɛ no nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã eba mli ehã wɔ ni wɔji amɛbii lɛ, akɛni etee Yesu shi, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ lala ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli hu akɛ, 'Mi-Bi ji o; ŋmɛnɛ mifɔ o lɛ.'
"Shi akɛni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni ekuŋ esɛɛ kɛyaŋ fitemɔ mli dɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Maŋɔ David dromɔnii Krɔŋkrɔŋi ni he shiwoo ma shi shiŋŋ lɛ mahã nyɛ.'
No hewɔ hu ni ekɛɛ yɛ he kroko akɛ, 'Ohaŋ omɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ana fitemɔ' lɛ.
"Ejaakɛ David lɛ, be ni esɔ̃mɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo naa yɛ eyinɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ mli ewɔ, ni aŋɔ lɛ afata etsɛmɛi lɛ ahe, ni ena fitemɔ.
Shi mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi lɛ, enaaa fitemɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɔnɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ajajeɔ eshaifaa atsɔɔ nyɛ lɛ; ni nibii fɛɛ ni anyɛŋ abu nyɛ bem yɛ he yɛ Mose Mla lɛ naa lɛ,
mɔnɛ mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ,abuɔ lɛ bem.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni nɔ ni awie yɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli lɛ akaba nyɛnɔ akɛ,
'Nyɛkwɛa, nyɛ heguɔgbelɔi, ni nyɛhiɛ afea nyɛ yaa, ni nyɛhiɛ akpãtãa, ejaakɛ mibatsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ nyɛyinɔ, nitsumɔ ko ni kɛ mɔ ko gba nyɛ tete lɛ, nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.'"
Shi be ni amɛje kpeehe lɛ, mɛi lɛ kpa amɛ fai akɛ amɛbajaje nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi ni nyiɛ no sɛɛ lɛ nɔ.

Ni be ni mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ ekpa lɛ, Yudafoi kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni emɔ Yudafoi lɛ ajamɔ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba wie tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni amɛwo amɛ ŋaa akɛ amɛhi nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ mli.
Ni hejɔɔmɔgbi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, shwɛ fioo ni eba lɛ akɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ji mɛi ni babua amɛhe naa ni amɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ toi lɛ.
Shi be ni yudafoi lɛ na asafoi lɛ, awuayeli yi amɛ obɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ mususbɔɔ wiemɔi wie shi nii ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ.

Ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba wie kɛ ekãa amɛkɛɛ, "Kulɛ nyɛ tsutsu esa akɛ ajaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ; shi akɛni nyɛŋwã wiemɔ lɛ atɔ̃ɔ; shi akɛni nyɛŋwã wiemɔ lɛ ni nyɛbuuu nyɛhe akɛ nyɛsa naanɔ wala lɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, wɔdɔ wɔyi kɛmiiya jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ nakai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo wɔ kitã akɛ, 'Miŋɔ o midamɔ shi akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ala, koni otsɔ̃ yiwalaheremɔ kɛyashi shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbehei lɛ.'"
Shi be ni jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ nu enɛ lɛ amɛna miishɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam, ni mɛi abɔ ni ajie ato naanɔ wala lɛ he ye.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Shi Yudafoi lɛ wowoo yei Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛbɔ̃i Paulo kɛ Barnaba yiwaa ni amɛshwie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛkpokpo amɛnajiashi mlu amɛshwie amɛnɔ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee Ikonium.
Ni kaselɔi lɛ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
14: Yɛ Ikonium nɛɛ hu Paulo kɛ Barnaba tee Yudafoi lɛ akpeehe lɛ ni amɛyawie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ bɔ ni ehyã Yudafoi lɛ kɛ Helabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo he ye.
Shi Yudafoi ni heee wiemɔ lɛ yeee lɛ wo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ayiŋ koni amɛte shi amɛwo nyɛmimɛi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ tsɛ yɛ jɛi ni amɛkɛ ekãa wie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he, ni lɛ ehã atsɔ̃ amɛnine nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii pii ekɛyew edromɔ wiemɔ lɛ he odase.
Shi maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ amli gba enyɔ, fã fata Yudafoi lɛ kɛ amɛnukpai lɛ bu kɛba ni amɛbatswia amɛ tɛ lɛ ahe.
Shi be ni jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛ amɛnukpai lɛ bu kɛba ni amɛbfee amɛ niseniianii koni amɛbatswia amɛ tɛ lɛ,
bɔfoi lɛ na le ni amɛjo foi kɛtee Likaonia maji lɛ amli, Lisra kɛ Derbe kɛ jɛi niiaŋ,
ni jɛi hu amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Nuu ko yɛ Listra ni ejie obubuafo kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe ni enyiɛko dã, shi shi etaa.
Ni be Paulo wieɔ lɛ, ebo toi. Paulo kwɛ lɛ gãa ni ena akɛ eyɛ hemɔkɛyeli akɛ aaatsa lɛ,
hewɔ lɛ akɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi odamɔ onaji lɛ anɔ trɔ̃mɔɔ!" Ni ehuru eyi shi ni enyiɛ.
Ni be ni asafoi lɛ na nɔ ni Paulo efee lɛ, amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ yɛ Likaonia wiemɔ lɛ mli amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe gbɔmɛi Kɛyimɔ shi kɛba wɔŋɔɔ!"
Ni amɛtsɛ Barnaba akɛ Dio, kɛ Paulo hu akɛ Herme, ejaakɛ lɛji mɔ ni wieɔ amɛnaa.
Shi Dio amãgã ni yɔɔ amɛmaŋ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa lɛ osɔfo lɛ hiɛ tsina hii kɛ nyanyrã akekrei kɛba agbo lɛ naa, lɛ kɛ asafo lɛ miitao amɛshã afɔle.
Shi be ni bɔfoi lɛ ni ji Barnaba kɛ Paulo nu he lɛ, amɛyabote asafo lɛ tɛŋ amɛhiɛ blɔmɔ akɛ,

"Ataamɛi, mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ? Wɔ hu agbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ, ni wɔmiijaje Sanekpakpa wɔmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, koni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nɛkɛ yakayakanii nɛɛ ahe kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ.
Yinɔi ni eho lɛ amli lɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛi lɛ anɔ,
Shi kɛ̃lɛ efɔɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe odaseyeli, shi moŋ efeɔ ejurɔ ni ehãa nu jɛɔ ŋwɛi nɛɔ hãa nyɛ, kɛ bei ni nii baa pii hu, ni ehãa nyɛtrɔɔ, ni miishɛɛ yiɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ obɔ̃bɔ̃."
Ni ekpakpa ko dani amɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ tsi afɔle ni kulɛ mɛi lɛ baashã ahã amɛ lɛ naa.
Shi Yudafoi komɛi Antiokia kɛ Ikonium ba jɛi bawo asafoi lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛtswia Paulo tɛi, ni amɛgbla lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli ejaakɛ amɛsusu akɛ egbo.
Shi be ni kaselɔi lɛ babɔle ehe kɛkpe lɛ, ete shi ni etee maŋ lɛ mli. Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ,ekɛ Barnaba yiŋ kɛtee Derbe.
Ni be ni amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Derbe ni amɛfee mɛi pii kaselɔi lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Listra kɛ Ikonium kɛ Antiokia.
Amɛsaa amɛwo kaselɔi lɛ amumɔŋ hewalɛ, ni amɛwie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, akɛ amɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, ni asaŋ esa akɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ amanehului pii amli kɛboteɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ni amɛfãmɔ onukpai amɛto asafo fɛɛ asafo nɔ, ni amɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ tu amɛ amɛwo Nuŋtsɔ, mɔ nɔ ni amɛhe amɛye lɛ dɛŋ.
Ni amɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ Pisidia kɛba Pamfilia.
Ni be ni amɛjaje wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Perga lɛ, amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛba Atalia.
Ni amɛbote lɛlɛ mli yɛ jɛi, ni amɛfã kɛba Antoikia, he ni atu amɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ dɛŋ kɛhã nitsumɔ ni amɛtsu amɛgbe naa nɛɛ yɛ lɛ.
Shi be amɛba jɛi ni amɛbabua asafo lɛ naa lɛ, amɛgba amɛ nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ eyatsu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ bɔ ni egble gbɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ ni amɛhe amɛye lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ kaselɔi lɛ hi shi gbii kplaŋŋ.
15: Ni mɛi komɛi jɛ Yudea ba ni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji aflɔɔɔ nyɛ ketia yɛ gbɛnaa ni Mose eto lɛ naa lɛ, anyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ahere."

Ni be ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ amɛ taa naa ni amɛkɛ amɛ je ŋwane aahuu lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ to akɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ amɛteŋ m2i krokomɛi hu aya bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni asafo lɛ ebajie amɛ gbɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ Foinikia kɛ Samaria ni amɛgba jeŋmaji lɛ atsakemɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛhā nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ naakpa.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalem lɛ, asafo lɛ kɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ here amɛ atuu, ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ gba amɛ nibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ etsu lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi mɛi komɛi ni jɛ Farisifoi lɛ akuu lɛ mli ni ehe eye lɛ te shi amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Ja aflɔ amɛ ketia ni awo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛye Mose Mla lɛ nɔ."
Ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ babua amɛhe naa, koni amɛtao nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.

Shi be ni amɛyiyii aahu lɛ, Petro te shi damɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi hi, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe Nyɔŋmɔ hala wɔmli, ni eto akɛ minaa jeŋmaji lɛ anu Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ ni amɛhe amɛye.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni le tsuiiaŋ lɛ hã amɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni le tsuiiaŋ lɛ hã amɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ehã wɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekplɛ̃ nɔ,
ni ejieee niiaŋ yɛ wɔ kɛ amɛ teŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ hemɔkɛyeli tsuɔ amɛtsuii ahe.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ mɛɛba nyɛkaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛkɛ kɔŋtso ni wɔji o, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ji o, wɔnyɛɛɛ wɔtere lɛ fɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ akɔŋ?
Shi wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu dromɔ lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ahereɔ wɔyiwala tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ fee diŋŋ ni amɛbo Barnaba kɛ Paulo ni gbaa amɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii abɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ efee yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ atoi.
Be ni amɛwie amɛgbe naa lɛ, Yakobo here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛboa mio toi.
Simeon egba bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ basra jeŋmaji lɛ tsutsu ko ni ehala maŋ kɛjɛ amɛteŋ ehã egbɛi lɛ.
Ni gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi lɛ hu kɛ enɛ yeɔ egbɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
"Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ maku misɛɛ maba, ni masaa David buu ni egbee shi lɛ mama shi; ni etsukoi lɛ hu matswa ekoŋŋ, ni matee lɛ shi mama shi.
Bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛ migbɛi ewo amɛ lɛ atao Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛegbɛ.
"Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni hã ale enɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ kɛɛ.'
"No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ akagba mɛi ni eku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ anaa tuutu;
shi moŋ aŋma amɛ akɛ amɛhi nii fɛɛ ni wɔji ewo he muji; amɛhi ajwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ kooloi ni ashɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ lá.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ Mose yɛ mɛi ni shiɛɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ, ni daa hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ akaneɔ ewoji lɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni esa bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ amɛaafãmɔ hii komɛi yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛteŋ, ni atsu amɛ kɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛya Antiokia. Hii nɛɛ ji Yuda, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Barsaba hu lɛ, kɛ Sila; gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji hiɛnaanɔbii yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Ni amɛŋma wolo amɛhã amɛ akɛ, "Bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ nyɛmi8mɛi lɛ miibi nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ ni yɔɔ Antiokia kɛ Siria kɛ Kilikia lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Akɛni wɔnu akɛ wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi bagba nyɛnaa kɛ wiemɔi komɛi, ni amɛkɛfutu nyɛjwɛŋmɔ, tsɛ jeee wɔ wɔfã amɛ akɛ amɛbafee nakai hewɔ lɛ,
esa wɔhiɛ akɛ, ni wɔnaa efee ekome nɛɛ, wɔfãmɔ mɛi wɔfata Barnaba kɛ Paulo ni wɔsumɔɔ
ni ji gbɔmɛi ni kɛ amɛwala eŋmɛ shi yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi hewɔ lɛ he, ni wɔtsu amɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔtsu Yuda kɛ sila, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ abajaje nibii nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ esa Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni esa wɔ hu wɔhiɛ akɛ wɔkɛ jatsu kroko akatre nyɛ, akɛ ja nii ni he hiaa nɛɛ nɔŋŋ;
akɛ nyɛhi looi ni agbe ahã wɔji kɛ lá kɛ kooloi ni ashɔ̃tɔ̃ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ. Kɛji nyɛwi nyɛhe kɛjɛ enɛɛmɛi ahe lɛ, nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ. Nyɛhia shi jogbaŋŋ!"
Be ni awo mɛi ni atsu lɛ gbɛ lɛ, amɛba Antiokia ni amɛbabua asafo muu lɛ naa ni amɛkɛ wolo lɛ hã amɛ.
Ni be amɛkane lɛ, amɛmii shɛ amɛhe yɛ hawelɛ ni ewo amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Yuda kɛ Sila lɛ, akɛni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu gbalɔi ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwie saŋŋ kɛshɛje nyɛmimɛi lɛ amii ni amɛkɛwo amɛ hewalɛ.
Ni be ni amɛye be fioo yɛ jɛi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ wo amɛ gbɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli kɛtee mɛi ni tsu amɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ.
(Shi Sila lɛ, esa ehiɛ akɛ eeehi jɛi.)
Shi Paulo kɛ Barnaba hi Antiokia amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni mɛi krokomɛi pii hu fee nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shi gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Pauko kɛɛ Barnaba akɛ, "Hã wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔyasra wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni wɔjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni wɔkwɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ."
Ni Barnaba tao akɛ amɛŋɔ Yohane ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko lɛ amɛfata amɛhe.
Shi Paulo lɛ, lɛ lɛ esusu akɛ esaaa akɛ amɛaaŋɔ mɔ ni kpale yɛ amɛsɛɛ yɛ Pamfilia ni ekɛ amɛ eyaaa nitsumɔ lɛ amɛfata amɛhe.
No hewɔ lɛ efee bei aahuu po ni ehã amɛmli gbla, ni Barnaba ŋɔ Marko efata ehe ni amɛtsɔ lɛlɛ mli kɛtee Kipro.
Shi Paulo lɛ, efã sila efata ehe, ni be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ tu lɛ wo Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ Paulo yi mli.
Ni etsɔ̃ Siria kɛ Kilikia eyawo asafoi lɛ ahewalɛ.
16: Kɛkɛ ni Paulo ba Derbe kɛ Listra. Kaselɔ ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Timoteo; enyɛ lɛ Yudayoo ko ni ehe wiemɔ lɛ eye ni, shi etsɛ lɛ Helanyo ni.
Ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Listra kɛ Ikonium lɛ yeɔ ehe odase kpakpa.
Paulo miitao ni ekɛ kaselɔ nɛɛ aya, ni eŋɔ lɛ efo lɛ ketia yɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi niiaŋ lɛ ahewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛle akɛ etsɛ lɛ Helanyo ni.
Shi be ni amɛkpaa maji lɛ anɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ mlai ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ wo lɛ hã amɛ koni amɛye nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ asafoi lɛ na hewalɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni amɛyi faa daa gbi.
Shi akɛni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ etsi amɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛkawie wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Asia hewɔ lɛ, amɛfo mli yɛ Frigia kɛ Galatia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ;
ni amɛba Misia niiaŋ, ni amɛka akɛ amɛaatee Bitinia, shi Yesu Mumɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ Misia ni amɛba Troia.
Ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ Paulo na yɛ ninaa mli akɛ nuu Makedonianyo ko damɔ shi miikpa lɛ fai akɛ, "Ba makedonia ni obaye obua wɔ!"
Shi be ni ena nii lɛ pɛ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ wɔtao akɛ wɔya Makedonia, ejaakɛ wɔkɔ sɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsɛ wɔ kɛmiiya jɛi koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔfã kɛjɛ Troia ni wɔnyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛtee Samotrake, ni enɔ jetsremɔ lɛ wɔba Neapoli.
Wɔjɛ jɛi lɛ, wɔtee Filipi ni ji Makedonia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ wulu kɛ Romabii ashimɔmɔhe lɛ. Ni wɔhi nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli gbii kplaŋŋ.
Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔjɛ maŋ lɛ mli wɔtee faa ko naa, he ni wɔjwɛmɔ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ asɔleɔ yɛ lɛ, ni wɔyatra shi, ni wɔkɛ yei ni ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi lɛ wie.
Ni yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lidia ni ji kɔɔjaŋhɔɔlɔ ko ni jɛ Tiatira maŋ lɛ mli ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ hu nu; lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gble etsui naa akɛ ebo nii ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ toi.
Ni be ni abaptisi lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ, ekpa wɔ fai akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛbu mi akɛ mihe Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miye anɔkwale mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaa miwe lɛ, ni nyɛbahia jɛi." Ni ehiɛ wɔ aahuu, ni wɔkplɛ̃.
Shi gbi ko be ni wɔyaa he ni asɔleɔ yɛ lɛ, tsulɔyoo ko ni klámɔ mumɔ yɔɔ emli kɛ wɔ bakpe; ekɛ eklãmɔ lɛ hãa enuŋtsɔmɛi naa nii pii.
Enyiɛ wɔ kɛ Paulo sɛɛ ni eblɔɔ akɛ, "Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ tsuji ji amɛ, ni amɛmiijaje yiwalaheremɔ gbɛ lɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ."
Ni efee nakai gbii pii. Shi efee Paulo ahuŋtoo kɛho he, ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ mumɔ lɛ akɛ, "Miifã o yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli akɛ oje emli." Ni eje emli yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Be ni enuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛmɔmɔ Paulo kɛ sila ni amɛgbla amɛ kɛtee lumɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ jra lɛ nɔ;
ni be ni amɛkpla amɛ kɛtee asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni ji Yudafoi lɛ ewo wɔmaŋ lɛ mli hirihiri,
ni amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃ɔ kusumii komɛi ni wɔ akɛ Romanbii lɛ wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔmɔɔ mli loo wɔyeɔ nɔ."
Ni maŋbii lɛ hu te shi wo amɛ, ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ hã akplɔ amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe, ni amɛfã akɛ ayi amɛ kpãa.
Ni be ni amɛtswia amɛ kpãi pii lɛ, amɛwo amɛ tsuŋ, ni amɛwo gboklɛfoiakwɛlɔ lɛ kitã akɛ ekɛ amɛ ato shweshweeshwe;
ni akɛni awo lɛ nɛkɛ kitã hewɔ lɛ, etsi amɛ ewo tsu ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ mli tɔɔ, ni ebɔ amɛnaji apã.
Shi nyɔɔŋ teŋ lɛ Paulo kɛ Sila miisɔle ni amɛmiila amɛmijie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; ni gboklɛfoi lɛ miibo amɛ toi.
Ni trukaa lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni tsu lɛ fanesi lɛ hoso, ni amrɔ lɛ, shinai lɛ fɛɛ gblegblei, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãi lɛ kplɔke.
Be ni gboklɛŋɔ̃foiakwɛlɔ lɛ hɛle shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli ni ena akɛ tsu lɛ naa shinai lɛ fɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, egbla eklŋte ni kulɛ ebaagbe ehe, ejaakɛ esusu akɛ gboklɛfoi lɛ ejo foi.
Shi Paulo bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ akɛ, "Kaafee ohe efɔŋ ko, shi wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ biɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ ni abahã lɛ kane, ni esha foi kɛbote tsu lɛ mli, ni ekɛ hekpokpomɔ ho egbee Paulo kɛ Sila hiɛ,
ni ekɛ amɛ je kpo ni ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔmɛi, mɛni sa ni mafee ni ahere miyiwala?"
Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Hemɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ oye, ni aaahere bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ yiwala."
Ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ.
Ni eŋɔ amɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, ni efɔ amɛkpãi lɛ anaa ehã amɛ, ni abaptisi lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ mli bii fɛɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ;
ni ekɛ amɛ tee ewe lɛ, ni eyaŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃, ni emli fli lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ akɛ ehe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ eye.
Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ tsu asraafoi bakɛɛ, "ŋmɛɛmɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ ahe ni amɛya."
Ni gboklɛfoiakwɛlɔ lɛ jaje nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Paulo akɛ, "Asofoiatsɛmɛi lɛ etsu kɛba akɛ aŋmɛɛ nyɛhe, no hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛjea kpo, ni nyɛyabaa jogbaŋŋ."
Shi Paulo kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Wɔ ni Romabii ji wɔ ni abuko wɔ fɔ lɛ, amɛyi wɔ yɛ jra nɔ, ni amɛwo wɔ tsuŋ hu; ni kpaako amɛshwieɔ wɔ nīgīl lo? Dabida, shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛba ni amɛbajie wɔ."
Ni asraafoi lɛ yajaje nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ; ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Romabii ji amɛ lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei.
Ni amɛba amɛbakpa amɛ fai, ni be ni amɛjie amɛ lɛ, amɛtutɔ amɛ akɛ amɛje maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi be ni amɛje tsu lɛ mli lɛ, ametee Libia we lɛ mli. Amɛna nyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni amɛshɛje amɛmii, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee.
17: Paulo kɛ Sila tsɔ̃ Amfipoli kɛ Apolania, ni amɛba Tesalonika, he ni Yudafoi akpeehe ko yɔɔ lɛ.
Ni Paulo tee amɛŋɔɔ tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ yayiyii yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ ahe hejɔɔmɔgbi etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ,
ni etsɔ̃ɔ mli ni ekɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli saji tsɔ̃ɔ naa akɛ ja Kristo lɛ na amanehulu ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni esaa ekɛɛ, "Yesu nɛɛ, mɔ he sane ni mijajeɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, lɛji Kristo lɛ."
Ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi he ye, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛ Paulo kɛ Sila he; nakai nɔŋŋ Helabii Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo kɛ yei hiɛnaanɔbi lɛ hu pii fee.

Shi efee Yudafoi krokomɛi lɛ atãŋ,ni amɛyakla niiahetswialɔi lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛyakpla niiahetswialɔi lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛyakpla niiahetswialɔi lɛ ateŋ hii fɔ̃ɔji komɛi amɛfata amɛhe, ni be ni amɛfee asafo yuu lɛ, amɛwo maŋ lɛ mli hirihiri; ni amɛyatua Yason we lɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛkpla Paulo kɛ Sila amɛyahã maŋ lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛnaaa amɛ lɛ, amɛkpla Yason kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛtee maŋ lɛ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ ni amɛblɔ akɛ, "Mɛnɛɛmɛi ni amɛtsɔ̃ jeŋ hiɛ ebu shi lɛ eba biɛ nɛɛ hu,
ni Yason ehere amɛ yɛ eshīa; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkuɔ Kaisare mla lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ maŋtsɛ kroko yɛ ni ji Yesu ko."
Ni amɛhã maŋbii lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ejijaa kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ.
Ni be ni amɛhe sɛɛdaamɔnii yɛ Yason kɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe.
Ni amrɔ̃ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ jie Paulo kɛ Sila gbɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛtee Beroia. Ni be ni amɛshi jɛi lɛ, amɛyabote Yudafoi lɛ akpeehe lɛ mli.
Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi asu hi fe mɛi ni yɔɔ Tesalonika lɛ, ni amɛ lɛ amɛhere wiemɔ lɛ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ, ni daa gbi lɛ amɛkpaa ŋmalɛi lɛ amli amɛkwɛɔ akɛ nibii nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai lo.
Hewɔ lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi pii he ye, Helayei ni yɔɔ gbɛi kɛ hii hu pii.
Shi be Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Tesalonika lɛ hu akɛ Paulo eyajaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ Beroia hu lɛ, amɛba jɛi hu ni amɛbawo mɛi ayiŋ ni amɛhã amɛjijaa.
Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ yajie Paulo gbɛ ni eya ŋshɔnaagbɛ; shi Sila kɛ Timateo hi Beroia.
Mɛi ni yajie Paulo gbɛ lɛ kɛ lɛ tee Atene tɔ̃ɔ; ni be ni eshɛ amɛ akɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo aba eŋɔɔ oya lɛ, amɛyi mli amɛtee.
Be ni Paulo mɛɔ Sila kɛ Timoteo yɛ Atene lɛ, ena akɛ eji maŋ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ amãgãi sɔŋŋ, ni ehao lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ ekɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ kɛ Helafoi Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ kpeɔ daagbi yɛ jra lɛ nɔ lɛ yiyiɔ.

Shi nilelɔi ni ji Epikuromɛi kɛ Stoamɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ lɛ taa naa ni mɛikomɛi kɛɛ, "Mɛni po naafuutsɛ nɛɛ taoɔ ekɛɛ?" Ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, "Etamɔ mɔ ni jajeɔ maŋsɛɛ jemawɔji ahe sane etsɔ̃ɔ." Amɛkɛɛ enɛ ejaakɛ ejaje Yesu kɛ shitee lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni amɛŋɔ lɛ kɛtee Arepago (kojomɔhe) lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Ani ooohã wɔle nɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hee ni owie he nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ ohã wɔtoii enu maŋsɛɛ saji; hewɔ lɛ wɔmiitao shishi wɔle."
Shi Atenebii fɛɛ kɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ, nɔ ni eshwɛ amɛ pɛ ji sane hee ko gbaa kɛ sane toiboo.
Ni Paulo yadamɔ Areopago lɛ teŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi Atenebii, miyoo yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli akɛ nyɛjaa wɔji pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Ejaakɛ be ni mihoɔ ni mikwɛ nii ni nyɛjaa lɛ, mina afɔleshãa latɛ ko hu ni aŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ ni aleee lɛ nɔŋ.' No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni nyɛleee lɛ ni kɛ̃ lɛ nyɛjaa lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ehe sane mijajeɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni bɔ je lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ lɛ, lɛji ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ nuŋtsɔ lɛ; ehiii Sɔlemɔtsui ni akɛ biji ma amli,
ni asaŋ akɛ gbɔmɛi aniji jaaa lɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni nɔ ko fiɔ lɛ; lɛ moŋ edɛŋ wala kɛ mumɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ jɛɔ hãa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ;
ni lá kome ekɛbɔ gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ, ni amɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni yinɔi ni eto lɛ kɛ amɛshihilɛhei lɛ ahusui lɛ ekpɛ mli eto momo,
koni amɛtao Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ, akɛ aleeenɔ, kɛ amɛgbugbuu shi lɛ, amɛaana lɛ lo; tsɛbelɛ ekɛ wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko teŋ jekɛɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ, 'Emli nɔŋŋ wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni wɔtsiɔ wɔhe ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ;' tamɔ bɔ ni ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛlalatsɛmɛi lɛ ekomɛi hu ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Shi lɛ nɔŋŋ eshwiei ji wɔ hu.'
Shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwiei ji wɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ wɔsusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ tamɔ shika loo jwiɛtɛi loo tɛ ko ni gbɔmɔ kɛ eŋaa kɛ ejwɛŋmɔ fee.
No hewɔ lɛ bei ni aleee lɛ nyɔŋmɔ eku ehiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ eewo gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he kitã akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui,
ejaakɛ eto gbi ko, no nɔ ni ebaatsɔ̃ nuu ni eto lɛ nɔ ekojo jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ni ekɛ shi ni etee lɛ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ naa enɛ nɔ mi ehãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ."
Shi be ni amɛnu gbohiiashitee he lɛ, mɛi komɛi ye ehe fɛo, ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, "Wɔɔsaa wɔbo owiemɔ nɛɛ toi ekoŋŋ."
No hewɔ lɛ Paulo shi amɛ.
Shi hii komɛi kɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛ ehe ni amɛhe amɛye; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Dionisio, Areopagonyo lɛ, kɛ yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Damari lɛ, kɛ mɛi krokomɛi ni fata amɛhe.
18: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Paulo je Atene ni eyiŋ etee Korinto.
Ni eyana Yudafonyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Akwila ni afɔ lɛ yɛ Ponto kɛ eɛa Priskila. Akwila jɛ Italia ba etsɛko. Eba ejaakɛ Kaisare Klaudio efã akɛ Yudafoi fɛɛ aje Roma. Ni Paulo tee amɛɔ̃ŋɔɔ;
ni akɛni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nitsumɔ kome hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ hi ahi, ni etsuɔ nii; amɛnitsumɔ nɛɛ ji buufeemɔ.
Shi daa Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, Paulo yawieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi yɛ kpeehe lɛ, ni ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ etsake Yudafoi kɛ Helabii lɛ.
Shi be ni Sila kɛ Timoteo jɛ Makedonia ba lɛ, Paulo hiɛ dɔ yɛ wiemɔ lɛ he ni eye odase veveeve etsɔ̃ɔ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ.
Shi akɛni amɛkuɔ enaa ni amɛwieɔ musubɔɔ wiemɔi hewɔ lɛ, ekpla ehe eshwie amɛnɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛlá abua nyɛyiteŋ; mi lɛ sɔ̃ ko wulaaa mi. Kɛjɛ be nɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, matee jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni eje jɛi ni etee Nyɔŋmɔjalɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Titio Yusto ni eshīa kpɛtɛ kpeehe lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi kpeehe lɛ onukpa lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Krispo lɛ kɛ ewe muu lɛ fɛɛ he Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ amɛye, ni Korintobii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii hu ni nu wiemɔ lɛ, amɛhe amɛye, ni abaptisi amɛ.
Ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ Paulo yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, shi moŋ wiemɔ, ni okamua onaa,
ejaakɛ mikɛ o yɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko etaŋ ohe ni efeŋ o efɔŋ ko, ejaakɛ miyɛ mɛi pii yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli."
Ni ehi jɛi afi kome kɛ nyɔji ekpaa etsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Shi be ni Galio yeɔ amralo yɛ Akaia lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome te shi wo Paulo, ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ,
amɛkɛɛ, "Nuu nɛɛ woɔ mɛi lɛ ayiŋ ni amɛshi mla lɛ sɛɛ amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ."
Shi be ni paulo baagble enaa pɛ lɛ, Galio kɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, "Yudafoi, eji juu kɛ fɔ̃ sane ko ni kulɛ,esa akɛ mabo nyɛ toi;
shi kɛji wiemɔi loo gbɛii loo nyɛmla lɛ he saji komɛi ni lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkwɛa nɔ; ejaakɛ misumɔɔ akɛ mikojoɔ nɛkɛ saji."
Ni eshwie amɛ kɛjɛ kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Helabii fɛɛ mɔ kpeehe lɛ onukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sostene lɛ, ni amɛyi lɛ yɛ kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ; shi Galio ebuuu enɛɛmɛi ekoeko.
Be ni Paulo ehi jɛi gbii klaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ye shɛɛ, ni ebote lɛlɛ mli kɛmiiya Sirial; ni Priskila kɛ Akwilea kɛ lɛ tee ni eyashɛ eyi yɛ Kenkrea, ejaakɛ ewo shi.
Ni amɛba Efeso, ni ekɛ amɛ gbla mli yɛ jɛi. Ni etee kpeehe lɛ, ni ekɛ Yudafoi lɛ yayiyii.
shi moŋ ekɛ amɛ ye shɛɛ ekɛɛ, "Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ lɛ, maku misɛɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ." Ni efã kɛjɛ Efeso.
Be ni eyakpleke kaisarea lɛ, etee Yerusalem ni eyaŋa asafo lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Yerusalem ni eyaŋa asafo lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Antiokia.
Ni ehi jɛi fioo, ni no sɛɛ lɛ, eyi mli ekoŋŋ ni eyakpa Galatia kɛ Frigia shikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ ewo kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahewalɛ.
Yudanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Apolo ni afɔ lɛ yɛ Aleksandria lɛ ba Efeso. Apolo nɛɛ enaa tse ni ele ŋmalɛi lɛ jogbaŋŋ hu.
Atsɔ̃ɔ nuu nɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ he nii, ni eyɛ ekãa yɛ mumɔ mli ni ewieɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ Yesu he nii fitsofitso, tsɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ kɛkɛ ele.
Ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ kɛ ekãa yɛ kpeehe lɛ. Shi be ni Akwila kɛ Priskila nu ehe lɛ, amɛŋɔ lɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ fitsofitso.
Agbɛnɛ etao akɛ eya Akaia, hewɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ŋma wolo amɛkɛwo kaselɔi lɛ aŋaa ni amɛhere lɛ atuu. Ni be ni eba jɛi lɛ, ewa mɛi ni etsɔ̃ dromɔ lɛ nɔ ehe eye lɛ babaoo.
Ejaakɛ ekɛ hewalɛ hu Yudafoi lɛ anaa yɛ maŋ hiɛ ni ekɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ.
19: Be ni Aplolo yɔɔ Korinto lɛ, Paul yakpa gɔŋ nɔ maji lɛ anɔ kɛbaje Efeso. Ni ebana kaselɔi komɛi,
ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Ani be ni nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ nyɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lo?" Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ko yɛ he ko jiŋŋ, wɔnuko tete."
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Belɛ mɛni mli abaptisi nyɛ awo mɔ?" Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ mli."
Ni Paulo kɛɛ, "Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ,ekɛbaptisi mɛi ni etsake amɛtsui; shi ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, amɛhe mɔ ni baa yɛ esɛɛ lɛ moŋ nɔ amɛye; lɛji Kristo Yesu lɛ."
Ni be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, abaptisi amɛ awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli;
ni be ni Paulo kɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ba amɛnɔ,ni amɛwie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni amɛgba.
Shi hii lɛ fɛɛ aaafee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Ni Paulo tee kpeehe lɛ, ni eyawie kɛ ekãa amɛ ni kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ nyɔji etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ ni amɛhe Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane lɛ amɛye.

Shi be ni mɛi komɛi waje amɛtsui ni amɛbooo toi ni amɛwie tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he efɔŋ yɛ mɛi kɛ ahiɛ lɛ, eje amɛŋɔɔ ni ejie kaselɔi lɛ hu yɛ amɛteŋ, ni daa gbi lɛ eyawieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi yɛ mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tirano lɛ nikesemɔhe lɛ.
Ehiɛ nakai feemɔ aahuu afii enyɔ sɔŋŋ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ, Yudafoi kɛ Helabii lɛ fɛɛ, nu Nuŋtsɔ Yesu wiemɔ lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Paulo nine nɔ etsu hewalɛ nitsumɔi hu ni nɔ ekaaa,
aahuu po ni aŋɔɔ eklaladukui kɛ atade hiɛhaanii tete ayahaa helatsɛmɛi anɔ, ni amɛhelai lɛ tãa ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ hu jeɔ amɛmli.
Shi Yudafoi okɔmfoi ni nyiɛ kpaa shi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ka ni amɛkɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi afã mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ayi akɛ, "Mina Yesu ni Paulo shiɛɔ lɛ."
Osɔfonukpa Skeva, Yudanyo lɛ, bihii kpawo ji mɛi ni feɔ nakai nii lɛ.
Shi mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Yesu lɛ, mile lɛ, ni Paulo hu, mile lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, namɛi ji nyɛ?"
Ni gbɔmɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɔɔ emli lɛ tutua amɛ ni enine tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ ni efee amɛ butuu ni amɛkɛ amɛhe yayai kɛ pilamɔi jo foi kɛjɛ nakai shīa lɛ.
Ni be ni Yudafoi kɛ Helabii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ fɛɛ, ni awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam naakpa.
Ni mɛi ni ehe eye lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii hu ba ni amɛbajaje amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ faŋŋ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Ni ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ hu ateŋ mɛi babaoo ba ni amɛkɛ amɛwoji lɛ babua shi ni amɛshã yɛ mɛi fɛɛ hiɛ; ni be ni abu naa lɛ, efee jwiɛtei kukuji akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Nɛkɛ hewalɛ gbɛ nɛɛ nɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ ekɛ shwere ni eye kunim.
Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Paulo to eyiŋ yɛ mumɔ lɛ mli akɛ eeeyatsɔ̃ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛya Yerusalem, ni ekɛɛ, "Kɛji mishɛ jɛi lɛ, ja miyakwɛ Roma hu."
Shi be ni etsu mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, Timoteo kɛ Erasto, Makedonia lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ehi Asia be fioo.
Shi nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ sakasafeemɔ ko ni bate shi yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ ejeee shwɛmɔ.
Ejaakɛ jwiɛtɛiŋaalɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Demetrio lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi feɔ Artemi sɔlemɔtsui ni hãa ŋaalɔi lɛ naa nitsumɔ pii.
Etsɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ eko lɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi, nyɛle akɛ nɛkɛ ŋaa nɛɛ wɔkɛnaa wɔnii pii lɛ.
Ni nyɛsaa nyɛmiina ni nyɛmiinu akɛ jeee Efeso nɛɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ shwɛ fioo ni Asia fɛɛ lɛ, Paulo nɛɛ ehã mɛi babaoo ayiŋ etsɔ̃, ni ekpale amɛ; ekɛɔ akɛ nii ni akɛ niji fee lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ni.

Miishe gbeyei akɛ, jeee wɔnitsumɔ nɛɛ kɛkɛ he guɔ baagbo, shi moŋ nyɔŋmɔyoo Artemi kekenam lɛ sɔlemɔwe lɛ hu abuŋ lɛ ahaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni enumnyam kpeteŋkple lɛ ni Asia kɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu jaa lɛ baabutu."
Be ni ŋaalɔi lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, amɛmli wo la pam, ni amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ,"Efesobii Artemi lɛ kekenam ni!"
Ni maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ fee sakasaka; ni amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome tsɛ̃ kɛtee nikwɛmɔhe lɛ, ni amɛyamɔmɔ Gaio kɛ Aristarko ni ji Makedoniabii ni fata Paulo he kɛfã gbɛ lɛ.
Shi be Paulo tao akɛ eya mɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kaselɔi lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ;
ni Asia lumɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ni ji Paulo shieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tsu eŋɔɔ abawo lɛ ŋaa akɛ ekakwɛ ni etee nikwɛmɔhe lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni mɛi komɛi blɔɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, mɛi komɛi hu miiblɔ ekroko;ejaakɛ kpee lɛ efee basabasa ni mɛi kpotoo leee nɔ hewɔ ni amɛbakpe tete.
Akɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ tsirɛ Alekasandro yisɛɛ kɛba hiɛgbɛ hewɔ lɛ, mɛi pii susu akɛ lɛ ejɛ ni basabasa lɛ ba. shi Aleksandro fɔ̃ enine eetao akɛ ejieɔ enaa etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛyoo akɛ Yudanyo ji lɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ gbee kome blɔ aaafee ŋmlɛtswai enyɔ sɔŋŋ akɛ, "Efesobii Artemi lɛ kekenam ni!"
Ni be ni maŋ woloŋmalɔ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi Efesobii, nɛɛ gbɔmɔ po leee akɛ Artemi kekenam lɛ kɛ amãgã ni kpleke shi kɛjɛ Dio ŋɔɔ lɛ Efesobii amaŋ nɛɛŋ ewulɔmɔ yɔɔ?
Agbɛnɛ akɛni enɛ he bɛ ŋwanejee hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛfeɔ dioo, ni nyɛkafee gidigidi ko.
Nyɛkɛ hii nɛɛ eba biɛ; amɛjeee sɔlemɔwe nii julɔi lɛ, amɛjeee nyɛnyɔŋmɔyoo lɛ he musubɔlɔi hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Demetrio kɛ enanemɛi ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ mɔ ko yɛ sane ko lɛ, kojomɔ gbii yɛ, ni amralofoi hu yɛ; nyɛhãa amɛkɛ sane lɛ ayaa amɛhiɛ.
Shi kɛji krokomɛi anaa nyɛtaoɔ lɛ, akuashɔŋ lɛ aaaye yɛ mla naa.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wɔkwɛɛɛ ni ahi lɛ, abaaflɔ wɔnaa yɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ basabasafeemɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni wɔbɛ sane ko ni wɔɔnyɛ wɔkɛjie wɔnaa yɛ hoofeemɔ nɛɛ he."
Ni be ni okɛɛ enɛ lɛ, ewo asafo lɛ gbɛ.
20: Be ni gidigidifeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo lɛ, Paulo tsu ayatsɛ kaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ewie etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni ekɛ amɛ ye shɛɛ, ni eyi mli kɛmiiya Makedonia.
Ni be ni eyatsɔ̃ jɛi niiaŋ ni ekɛ wiemɔi pii wo amɛŋaa lɛ, eba Akaia.
Ni eye nyɔji etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi, ni akɛni Yudafoi lɛ ewo lɛ ka be ni eheɔ efã kɛya Siria hewɔ lɛ, eto eyiŋ akɛ eeeku esɛɛ eyatsɔ̃ Makedonia ekoŋŋ.
Ni Sopatre Beroianyo lɛ ni ji Pirho bi lɛ, kɛ Aristarko kɛ Sekundo, Tesalonikabii lɛ, kɛ Gaio, Derbenyo lɛ, kɛ Timoteo, kɛ Asiabii ni ji Tihiko kɛ Trofimɔ lɛ, kɛ lɛ tee Asia.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi tsɔ̃ hiɛ, ni amɛyamɛ wɔ yɛ Troia.
Ni wɔ lɛ wɔfã kɛjɛ Filipi yɛ Akpiti Gbii lɛ asɛɛ, ni gbii enumɔ sɛɛ lɛ wɔyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ yɛ Troia, ni wɔhi jɛi gbii kpawo.
Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ be ni wɔbabua wɔhe naa koni amɛye suɔmɔ niyenii lɛ, Paulo wie tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni ekã wiemɔ lɛ he kɛyashi nyɔɔŋteŋ, ejaakɛ kɛ je tsɛre lɛ ebaayi mli.
Ni asu kanei pii yɛ ŋwɛitsu lɛ mli he ni amɛbua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ.
Shi oblanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Eutiko lɛ ta samflɛ naa, ni wɔ ni tsii loo lɛ, ejaakɛ Paulo wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ jekɛ, ni wɔ ni emɔ lɛ lɛ sɔŋŋ hã ekpa kɛjɛ sɔɔdoi etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ ebagbee shi, ni ayawo lɛ ni egbo.
Ni Paulo kpleke shi, ni eyabu enɔ, ni efua lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkafea hoo, ejaakɛ wala yɛ emli."
Ni be ni ekwɔ kɛba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebakumɔ abaloo lɛ, ni eye eko , ni ekã he ewie aahuu kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ wɛlɛŋŋ, kɛkɛ ni eyi mli.
Ni amɛkɛ gbekɛ lɛ tee shìa ni ehiɛ kã, ni amɛmii shɛ amɛhe naakpa.
Shi wɔ lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ kɛtee lɛlɛ mli, ni wɔfã kɛtee Aso ni wɔyaŋɔ Paulo yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ Paulo lɛ, lɛ lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ hewɔ lɛ bɔ bi eto ji no.
Ni be ni ebanina wɔ yɛ Aso lɛ wɔwo lɛ ni wɔba Mitilene.
Ni wɔfa yɛ jɛi, ni enɔ jetseremɔ lɛ wɔbashɛ Kio ŋlɛnɔ. Ni enɔ jetseremɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ wɔbashɛ Samo, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔba Mileto.
Ejaakɛ Paulo ekpɛ mli akɛ eeeho Efeso he, bɔ ni afee ni ekatsɛ yɛ Asia; ejaakɛ eeye oyai ni kɛ aaaho lɛ, eyashɛ eeye oyia ni kɛ aaaho lɛ, eyashɛ Yerusalem Pentekoste gbi lɛ.
Ni ejɛ Mileto etsu Efeso ayakpee asafo lɛ mli onukpai lɛ abahã lɛ.
Ni be amɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛle bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ mikɛ nyɛ hi shi be muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi nɔ ni miba Asia nɛɛ,
ni mikɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ kɛ yaafonui pii kɛ kai ni ba minɔ yɛ Yudafoi akawoi lɛ amli lɛ sɔmɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;
bɔ ni mishiuuu nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ hã nyɛ nɔ, ni mijaje mistɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ faŋŋ kɛ shīa fɛɛ shīa hu;
ni miye odase mitsɔ̃ɔ Yudafoi kɛ Helabii fɛɛ akɛ amɛkpale kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni amɛhe wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu nɔ amɛye.
Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, naa, efi mi yɛ mumɔ mli hewɔ lɛ miiya Yerusalem, ni mileee nɔ ni baaba minɔ yɛ jɛi,
akɛ ja nɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔkrɔŋ lɛ yeɔ odase faŋŋ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ ekɛɔ akɛ tsuŋwoo kɛ amanehului mɛɔ mi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mibuuu miwala akɛ ejra wa hã mi, bɔ ni afee ni mikɛ miishɛɛ agbe migbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni mina yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu dɛ3 akɛ miye Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ he odase faŋŋ lɛ naa.
"Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ naa, mile akɛ,nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni minyiɛ nyɛteŋ mishiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane lɛ, nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, akɛ miyeee nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko lá yi sɔ̃;
ejaakɛ mijaje Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo muu lɛ fɛɛ misɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni mishiuuu eko nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛlea nyɛhenɔkwɛmɔ kɛ toiku lɛ fɛɛ ni Muɔmɔ KRɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ewo nyɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, koni nyɛlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elã he lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ, kɛ mikpa mihe lɛ, klãjifulɔi baabote nyɛteŋ, ni amɛbaŋ toiku lɛ yi.
Ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛteŋ hu lɛ, hii ni wieɔ nii ni ejaaa aaate shi, ni amɛeakpla kaselɔi lɛ amɛshwie amɛsɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsraa, ni nyɛkaia akɛ afii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ mikɛ yaafonui efɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔkɔbɔɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ Shwane lɛ.
"Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, miitu nyɛ miiwo Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ edromɔ wiemɔ lɛ deŋ; lɛ eyɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛaahã nyɛnane amɔ shi ni ekɛ gboshinii lɛ ahã nyɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni atsuu amɛhe l ateŋ.
Mihiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko jwiɛtɛi loo shika loo atade nɔ.
Nyɛ diɛ3tsɛ nyɛle akɛ nii ni hiãa mi kɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ niji nɛɛ nɔŋŋ tsu he nii.
Mikɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nakai sa akɛ atsu nii ni akɛye abua mɛi ni bɛ hewalɛ, ni akai Nuŋtsɔ Yesu wiemɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewi ɛ akɛ, 'Nɔhãmɔ mli yɛ jɔɔmɔ fe hemɔ.'"
Be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ekula shi ni ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ sɔle.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo bloblo naakpa, ni amɛgbeegbee Paulo kuɛ nɔ, ni amɛshwɔshwɔɔ enaa.
Ni nɔ ni dɔ amɛ titri ji wiemɔ ni ewie akɛ amɛnaŋ ehiɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ. Ni amɛyajie lɛ gbɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli.
21: Agbɛnɛ be ni wɔkɛ amɛ gbla mli lŋ, wɔfã ni wɔnyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛba Ko, ni enɔ jetsremɔ lɛ wɔkɛba Rodo, ni wɔjɛ jɛi wɔba Patara.
Wɔna lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Foinikia ni wɔbote mli ni wɔkɛshwie nɔ.
Shi be Kipro tua wɔhiɛ lɛ, wɔtswa lɛ wɔfã abɛku ni wɔba Siria, ni wɔbakpleke yɛ Tiro; ejaakɛ jɛi abaajie lɛlɛ lɛ mli nii yɛ.
Be ni wɔbana kaselɔi lɛ, wɔhi jɛi gbii kpawo; ni amɛtsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ Paulo akɛ ekaya Yerusalem.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni wɔye gbii lɛ tã lɛ, wɔkɛshwie nɔ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ bajie wɔ gbɛ kɛyashi maŋ lɛ klotia; ni wɔsɔle.
Wɔyeyee shɛɛ ni wɔbote lɛlɛ mli; ni amɛ hu amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛshīi.
Shi wɔ wɔjɛ Tiro wɔba Ptolemai. Ni wɔyaŋa nyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni wɔkɛ amɛ hi shi gbi kome.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔyiŋ kɛtee Kaisareea ni wɔyabote Sanekpakpashiɛlɔ Filipo ni ji mɛi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ we, ni wɔkɛ lɛ hi shi.
ni ekɛ biyei oblayei ejwɛ ni gbaa.
Be ni wɔhi shi gbii kplaŋŋ yɛ jɛi lɛ gbalɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Agabo lɛ jɛ Yudea ba;

ni be ni eba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ, ekɔ Paulo hɛfinɔ lɛ ni ekɛfi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniji kɛ enaji ekɛɛ, "Bɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Nuu mɔ nɔ̃ ni ji hɛfiinɔ nɛɛ, nɛkɛ Yudafoi lɛ baafi lɛ yɛ Yerusalem, ni amɛaaŋɔ lɛ amɛwo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ.'"
Be ni wɔnu enɛ lɛ wɔkɛ jɛibii lɛ fɛɛ kpa Paulo fai akɛ ekaya Yerusalem lɛ.
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ, nyɛmiifo ni nyɛkɛmiiwo mi awerɛhoo? Mi lɛ, jeee fii kɛkɛ misaa mihe mito, shi moŋ gbele diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hewɔ yɛ Yerusalem."
Shi diŋŋ wɔkɛɛ, "Afee bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ."
Ni nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ wɔto wɔnii, ni wɔyiŋ kɛtee Yerusalem.
Ni kaselɔi ni jɛ Kaisarea lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ wɔ tee,ni amɛhã wɔyato Mnason, Kipronyo ko ni ji kaselɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ lɛ; ŋɔɔ.
Be ni wɔshɛ Yerusalem lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ here wɔ atuu.
Ni enɔ Jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Paulo kɛ wɔ tee Yakobo ŋɔɔ; ni onukpai lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ jɛi.
Eŋa amɛ, ni egba amɛ nibii niNyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ esɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nɔ etsu yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ ekomekome.
Shi be amɛnu lɛ, amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Anyɛmi, kwɛmɔ Yudafoi akpei abɔ ni ehe eye nɛɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Mla lɛ he hiɛdɔlɔi ji amɛ.
Shi abatã ohe sane ahã amɛ, akɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ akɛ amɛkwa Mose, ni okɛɔ akɛ amɛkaflɔ amɛbii aketia, ni asaŋ amɛkanyiɛ amɛkusumi asɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ? Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, amɛaanuu akɛ oba.
No hewɔ lɛ feemɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɔ o nɛɛ. Wɔyɛ hii ejwɛ ni ewo shi.

ŋɔɔ amɛ ni okɛ amɛ fɛɛ ayatsuu nyɛhe, ni owo nɔ ni ahãa lɛ ohã amɛ, koni amɛshɛ amɛyi, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ baana akɛ saji ni abagbaa yɛ ohe lɛ ekoeko bɛ mli, shi moŋ bo diɛŋtsɛ tete obaa ojeŋ yɛ Mla lɛ naa, ni oyeɔ nɔ.
Shi jeŋmajiaŋbii ni ehe eye lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔŋma ni wɔkpɛ mli akɛ amɛkaye nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ eko nɔ, shi moŋ amɛhi wɔji afɔlei kɛ lá kɛ kooloi ni ashɔ̃tɔ̃ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ kɛkɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Paulo ŋɔ hii lɛ, ni enɔ jetseremɔ be ni ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ etsuu amɛhe lɛ, ebote Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ beyinɔ ni hetsuumɔ gbii lɛ anaagbee lɛ baashɛ ni abaashã afɔle ahã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Shi be ni eshwɛ fioo ni aaagbe gbii kpawo lɛ naa lɛ, Yudafoi ni jɛ Asia lɛ na lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni amɛta safo lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni amɛbamɔ lɛ;
ni amɛblɔ akɛ, "Ataamɛi Israelbii,nyɛbafataa wɔhe! Naa nuu lɛ ni esaa ekɛ Helabii eba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ekɛbabule He Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ huu."
Ejaakɛ amɛna lɛ kɛ Trofimo ni jɛ Efeso lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli momo hewɔ lɛ amɛsusu akɛ Paulo kɛ lɛ ba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bu, ni maŋbii lɛ sha foi kɛbabua mɛhe naa; ni amɛmɔ Paulo amɛgbla lɛ kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ aŋamɔ shinai lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛheɔ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ, ayatswa asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ adafi akɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ efee gidigidi.
Ni amrɔ lɛ eŋɔ asraafoi kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni ekɛ amɛ kpleke shi kɛ foi kɛbanina amɛ. Be ni amɛna asafoiatsɛ nukpa lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ,amɛfɔ̃ɔ Paulo yii.
Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ ni emɔ emli, ni efã akɛ awo lɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i enyɔ, ni ebi mɔ ni ji lɛ kɛ nɔ ni efee.
Shi be ni asafo lɛ mli mɛi komɛi miiblɔ miikɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ,mɛi komɛi hu miiblɔ miikɛɛ nɔ kroko. Ni akɛni hoofeemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ena anɔkwale lɛ, efã akɛ akɛ lɛ aya mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Ni be ni eshɛ atrakpoi lɛ anaa lɛ, eba mli akɛ asafo lɛ gidigidifeemɔ hewɔ lɛ asraafoi lɛ wo lɛ,
ejaakɛ maŋbii asafo yuu lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ miiblɔ akɛ, "Akɛ lɛ aya!"
Shi be akɛ Paulo baabote mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ebi asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ akɛ, "Ani miyɛ hegbɛ akɛ mikɛ o wieɔ wiemɔ ko lo?" Ebi lɛ akɛ, "Ole Hela wiemɔ?
Belɛ jeee boji Egiptnyo lɛ ni nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ ni ekɛ atuatsemɔ ba ni ekpla hii awuyelɔi akpei ejwɛ eshwie esɛɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ?"

Ni Paulo kɛɛ, "Mi lɛ Yudanyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Tarso, Kilikia maŋ ko ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ mli. Shi miikpa o fai; ŋmɛɛ ni eŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ lɛ, Paulo damɔ atrakpoi lɛ anɔ, ni efɔ̃ maŋ lɛ nine; ni be ni jɛi jɔ koniŋŋ lɛ, ewie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli ekɛɛ
22: "Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi nyɛboa minaa ni mibajie matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ toi."
Ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Hebri wiemɔ ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ, amɛfee diŋŋ fe tsutsu lɛ. Ni ekɛɛ,

"Yudanyo ji mi, ni afɔ mi yɛ Tarso yɛ Kilikia moŋ, shi maŋ nɛɛ mli alɛ mi yɛ, ni Gamaliel naji anaa atsɔse mi yɛ, yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ amla lɛ naa fitsofitso, ni mihiɛ dɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sane he, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛfeɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ;
ni miwaa nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ yi kɛyashiɔ gbele mli, ni mifimɔ̃ɔ hii kɛ yei fɛɛ mihãa ni ayawoɔ amɛ tsuŋ,

bɔ ni osɔfo nukpa lɛ tete kɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye mi odase. Amɛdɛŋ miŋɔ woji kɛjɛ ni kulɛ mikɛyaahã nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ, ni miyafimɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ hu kɛba Yerusalem koni agbla amɛ toi.
"Shi ena mli akɛ, be ni minyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni mibabɛŋkɛ Damasko aaafee huludãamɔ mli lɛ, trukaa lɛ la ko ni kpɛmɔ naa wa jɛ ŋwɛi babɔle mi;
ni miflɛo migbee shi ni minu gbee ko kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Saul, Saul, mɛɛba owaa mi yi?'
Ni mihere nɔ akɛ, 'Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?' Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Mi Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ ni.'
Shi mɛi ni kɛ mi nyiɛ ɛ na la lɛ, shi mɔ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ, amɛnuuu egbee.
Ni mikɛɛ, 'Mɛni mafee, Nuŋtsɔ?' Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Tee shi ni oya Damasko, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ɔ o nibii fɛɛ ni ato akɛ ofee lɛ yɛ.'
Ni akɛni minaaa nii dɔŋŋ yɛ nakai la lɛ kpɛmɔ hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni kɛ mi nyiɛ lɛ mɔ minine mli amɛyawa mi Damasko.
"Shi nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei yɛ Mla lɛ naa, ni Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ wieɔ ehe ekpakpa.
Lɛ eba miŋɔɔ, ni ebadamɔ mimasɛi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Anyɛmi Saul, naa nii!' Ni nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ mina lɛ faŋŋ.
Ni ekɛɛ, 'Wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehala o eto ni ole esuɔmɔnaanii ni ona Nyɔŋmɔ Jàlɔ lɛ ni onu edaaŋ gbee;
ejaakɛ obaatsɔ̃ ehe odasefonyo koni oye nii fiaa ni ona ni onu lɛ ahe odase otsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ mɛɛba oshashaoɔ ohe eshai lɛ ashwie ahã o, ni osɔle otsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
"Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni miku misɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem ekoŋŋ ni misɔleɔ yɛ sɔlemɔwe lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ ni nɔ enyɔ minɔ,
ni mina Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Feemɔ kpa ni oje Yerusalem oya, ejaakɛ amɛboŋ mihe odase ni oyeɔ lɛ toi.'
Ni mikɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛle akɛ miji mɔ nɔŋŋ ni sa lɛ miwoɔ mɛi yɛ kpeehe fɛɛ kpeehe lɛ.
Ni be ni ashwie Stefano, ohe odaseyelɔ lɛ, lá shi lɛ, mi hu midamɔ jɛi, ni mina egbele lɛ he tsui, ni mibu mɛi ni gbe lɛ lɛ atadei lɛ ahe.'
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Yaa, ejaakɛ mibatsu o jeŋmaji lɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ.'"
Ni amɛbo lɛ toi kɛbashi nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ, ni amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ aje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ! Ejaakɛ esaaa akɛ ehiɔ jeŋ."
Shi be ni amɛblɔɔ ni amɛkplɔɔ amɛ he atadei ni amɛgbɛɔ mlu amɛshãa kɔɔyɔɔ mli lɛ,
asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ fã akɛ akɛ lɛ aya mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ kplebii atao eyitsoŋ koni ena ele nɔ sane hewɔ ni Yudafoi blɔɔ amɛwoɔ lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ.
Shi be ni afi lɛ ni abaayi lɛ lɛ, Paulo bi asafoiatsɛ ni damɔ shi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyɛ hegbɛ akɛ! nyɛyiɔ Romanyo ko ni abuko lɛ fɔ kɛ kplebii lo?"
Be ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, etee asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni obaafee nɛɛ? Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ Romanyo ni."
Ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ba ni ebabi lɛ akɛ "Kɛɛmɔ mi, ani Romanyo ji o lo?" Ni ekɛɛ, "Hɛɛ."
Ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Shika pii mikɛhe nɛkɛ maŋnyotsɔmɔ nɛɛ." Ni Paulo kɛɛ, "Shi mi lɛ, fɔ akɛfɔ mi."
Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mɛi ni yaatao eyitsoŋ lɛ je emasɛi ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ hu, akɛni efi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, be ni ena ele akɛ Romanyo ji Paulo lɛ, eshe gbeyei.
Shi akɛni eetao ele nɔ hewɔ krɛdɛɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ flɔɔ enaa hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ efɛne lɛ, ni efã akɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ akushɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ aba, ni ekɛ Paulo kpleke shi, ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ amɛhiɛ.
23: Ni Paulo tɛje ehiɛ ekwɛ akuashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kɛkpe ni ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi! Mi lɛ, henilee kpakpa sɔŋŋ mikɛba mijeŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ."
Shi osɔfonukpa Anania lɛ fã mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ akɛ agba enaabu ma.
Kɛkɛ ni Paulo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ma kɛ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ aaagba o, bo gbogbo ni asha he! Ota shi ookojo mi yɛ Mla lɛ naa, ni osaa ojeɔ Mla lɛ sɛɛ ofãa ni agba mi mã?"
Shi mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ kɛɛ, "Ee! Kwɛɛ! Nyɔŋmɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ ojɛɔ nɛɛ?"
Ni Paulo kɛɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi, mileee akɛ osɔfonukpa ni ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, 'Kaawie omaŋ onukpa he efɔŋ.'"

Shi be ni Paulo yoo akɛ amɛfã kome lɛ Sadukifoi ni, ni amɛfã kroko lɛ Farisifoi ni lɛ, ebo yɛ akuashɔŋ lɛ teŋ akɛ, "Anyɛmimɛi, naa, mi lɛ Farisifonyo ji mi kɛ Farisifonyo bi hu. Hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ hewɔ akojoɔ mi nɛɛ."
Be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, bei ba Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ ateŋ, ni asafo lɛ mli gba enyɔ.
Ejaakɛ Sadukifoi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ ni asaŋ ŋwɛi bɔfo loo mumɔ ko hu bɛ; shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ.

Ni blɔmɔ babaoo bate shi, ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Farisifoi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ te shi ni amɛbe amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔnaaa nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ he; shi kɛji aleenɔ mumɔ ko loo ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ ewie lɛ, no lɛ (nyɛkahãa wɔkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miinɔa.")
Shi be ni bei lɛ mli wa lɛ, asafoiatsɛ nukpa lɛ she gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ amɛaatserɛ Paulo mli hewɔ lɛ, efã asraafoi lɛ akɛ amekpleke shi ni amɛyashɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ aba mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli.
Shi enɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ badamɔ emasɛi ni ekɛɛ, "Paulo, hã otsui anyɔ omli, ekaajɛ bɔ ni oye mihe odase yɛ Yerusalem nɛɛ, ja oyaye odase nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ Roma hu."
Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kpãŋ ni amɛkãmɔ Kitãi akɛ amɛyeŋ nii ni asaŋ amɛnuŋ nɔ ko ja amɛgbe Paulo dã.
Mɛi ni kpãŋ ni amɛkãmɔ amɛhe kitãi nɛɛ fe gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Ni amɛtee osɔfonukpai kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ amɛyakɛɛ, "Wɔkɛ kitãmɔ ekpãŋ akɛ wɔsaŋ wɔnaa nɔ ko nɔ ko ja wɔgbe Paulo dã.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛ akuashɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ayakɛa asafoiatsɛ nukpa lɛ, koni (wɔ lɛ) ekɛ lɛ akpleke shi kɛhba nyɛŋɔɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni esane lɛ mli nyɛbaatao fisofitso, shi wɔ lɛ, dani eeeshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, wɔsaa wɔhe ni wɔgbe lɛ."
Shi Paulo nyɛmiyoo bi ko nu amɛkawoo nɛɛ he, ni eyiŋ kɛtee mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli eyaswa Paulo adafi.
Ni Paulo tsɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "ŋɔɔ nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ eyɛ sane ko ni eyaakɛɛ lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ tee asafoitsɛnukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ekɛ lɛ tee asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ "Gboklɛfonyo Paulo lɛ tsɛ mi kɛtee eŋɔɔ, ni ekpa mi fai akɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ aba oŋɔ, ejaakɛ eyɛ sane ko ni ebaakɛɛ o"
Ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ mɔ enine mli ni ekɛ lɛ tee afã, ni eyabi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ sane oyɔɔ ni obaakɛɛ mi?"
Ni ekɛɛ, "Yudafoi lɛ efee ekome akɛ amɛbaakpa o fai, ni wɔ ni okɛ Paulo akpleke shi kɛba akuashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, tamɔ nɔ ni esane lɛ mli amɛbaatao fitsofitso.
Shi bo lɛ, kaakplɛ̃ amɛ ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɛi fe nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ewo lɛ ka, ni amɛkãmɔ amɛhe kitã akɛ amɛyeŋ nii ni asaŋ amɛnuŋ nɔ ko ja amɛgbe lɛ dã; ni agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛsaa amɛhe, ni amɛmiibo onaa wiemɔ toi."
Kɛkɛ ni asafoitsɛnukpa lɛ wo obolanyo lɛ gbɛ, ni ewo lɛ akpɔ akɛ, "Kaakɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ otsi sane nɛɛ ta6 otsɔ̃ɔ mi."
Ni etsɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛsaa asraafoi ohai enyɔ kɛ okpaŋɔiatsɛmɛi ny(ŋmai kpawo kɛ akplɔiatsɛmɛi hu ohia enyɔ amɛya Kaisarea gbɛkɛ ŋmlɛ nɛɛhu mli.
Nyɛsaa kooloi hu nyɛtoa ni ahã Paulo ata nɔ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ ayahã Amralo Felike shweshweeshwe."
Ni eŋma wolo ni ekɛɛ yɛ mli akɛ,
"Klaudio Lisia miibi amralo jurɔ Felike jogbaŋŋ!
Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ, Yudafoi lɛ mɔ lɛ ni kulɛ amɛbaagbe lɛ, shi be ni mina mile akɛ Romanyo ji lɛ lɛ, mikɛ asraafoi lɛ tee miyashɔ̃ lɛ.
Shi akɛni miitao male nɔ sane hewɔ ni amɛflɔɔ enaa lɛ, mikɛ lɛ tee amɛkuashɔŋ lɛ hiŋɛ,
ni mina akɛ amɛmla lɛ he ŋwanejee saji komɛi ahewɔ amɛflɔɔ enaa lɛ, shi sane ko ni sa gbele loo tsuŋwoo bɛ ehe.
Shi be ni abatswa mi adafi akɛ Yudafoi lɛ ewo nuu lɛ ka lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mitsu akɛ akɛ lɛ aba oŋɔ̃ɔ, ni mifã enaaflɔlɔi lɛ hu akɛ amɛba ohiɛ ni amɛbajaje saji ni amɛkɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni asraafoi lɛ ŋɔ Paulo tamɔ bɔ ni afã amɛ lɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli amɛkɛ lɛ ba Antipatri.
Ni je tsɛre lɛ amɛhã okpɔŋɔiatsɛ mɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ tee, ni amɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni amɛshɛ Kaisarea ni amɛkɛ wolo lɛ Yahã amralo lɛ, amɛkɛɛ Paulo hu badamɔ ehiɛ .
Amralo lɛ kane wala lɛ, ni ebilɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni ejɛ; ni be ni ena ele akɛ Kilikia ejɛ lɛ,
ekɛɛ, "Kɛ onaaflɔlɔi lɛ hu ba lɛ, no dani mabo o toi jogbaŋŋ." Ni efã akɛ akɛ lɛ ato Herode mɔɔ lɛ mli.
24: No sɛɛ gbii enumɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpa,Anania kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi kɛ mlalelɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tertulo lɛ ba jɛi, ni amɛbajaje Paulo he sane amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amralo lɛ.

Ayatsɛ Paulo kɛba, ni Tertulo bɔ̃i enaaflɔmɔ ni ekɛ, "Lumɔ Felike, oyinɔ nɛɛ wɔtoiŋ ejɛ wɔ babaoo, ni asaŋ oshɔŋŋ ninamɔ naa lɛ, nibii pii asaŋ oshɔŋŋ ninamɔ naa lɛ, nibii pii eba hiŋmɛi nɔ yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Wɔheɔ enɛ fɛɛ kɛ shidaa pii yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Shi bɔ ni afee ni misane sɛɛ akajekɛ tuutu ko hewɔ lɛ, miikpa o fai ni obo wɔ toi fioo yɛ omlihilɛ naa.
Wɔna nuu nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni fiteɔ mɛi ayiŋ ni emuɔ atuatsemɔ mumɔ ewoɔ Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni asaŋ eji Nazaremɛi akuu lɛ naa kpãa.
Eka Sɔlemɔwe lɛ bulemɔ, ni wɔmɔ lɛ,(ni kulɛ wɔmiitao wɔkojo lɛ yɛ wɔ-Mla lɛ naa.
Shi asafoiatsɛ nukpa Lisia ba ni ebashɔ̃ lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ ekãa naa, ni ekɛ lɛ tee,
ni efã enaaflɔlɔi lɛ akɛ amɛba oŋɔɔ), ni kɛji bo diɛŋtsɛ obi enaa sane lɛ fɛɛ."'
Ni Yudafoi lɛ hu kã mli wao ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ saji nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai.
Kɛkɛ ni amralo lɛ fɔ̃ Paulo nine akɛ ewie, ni ewo enaa nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Akɛni mile akɛ ojɛ oye shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ amralo etsɛ hewɔ lɛ, mina tsui jurɔ ni mikɛaajie minaa.
Kɛ obi mli lɛ, ooona akɛ gbii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ pɛ nɛ ni mibaho Yerusalem akɛ miyaja Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni asaŋ amɛnako mi dã akɛ mikɛ mɛi miitaa naa aloo miibú mɛi yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, loo kpeehei lɛ, loo maŋ lɛ mli,
ni asaŋ saji ni amɛkɛshwieɔ minɔ nɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ naa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Shi nɔ ni migblaa mli faŋŋ mikɛɔ o ji enɛ akɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ akɛ amaletsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ naa mijaa wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ, miheɔ nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔ lɛ amli lɛ miyeɔ,
ni miyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni mɛnɛɛmɛi hu kwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ gbohiiashitee baaba lɛ, ni jalɔi kɛ mɛi ni ejaaa fɛɛ baate shi,
Enɛ hewɔ mikɛ mihe efɔ̃ɔɔ shi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mama henilee ni sɔ̃ ko wulaaa lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ amli.
"Shi afii pii asɛɛ lɛ miba ni mikɛ nikeenii abahã mimaŋ lɛ ni mashã afɔle hu.
Enɛ feemɔ mli amɛna mi yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ akɛ mitsuu mihe, shi amɛnaaa mi kɛ asafo ko lɛ, amɛnaaa mi kɛ hoofeemɔ ko hu.
Shi Yudafoi komei ni jɛ Asia lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni sa akɛ kulɛ amɛba ohiɛ, ni kɛ amɛyɛ mihe sane ko lɛ ni amɛbajaje.
Aloo mɛnɛɛmɛi diɛŋtsɛ po, kɛ amɛna sane ko ni ejaaa yɛ mihe be ni midãmɔ akuashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ;
akɛ ja nɛkɛ wiemɔ kome ni be ni midamɔ amɛteŋ ni mibo akɛ, 'Gbohiiashitee hewɔ nyɛkojoɔ mi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ' lɛ kɛkɛ."
Shi akɛni Felike le nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ he sane pepɛɛpɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsi amɛ rto, ni ekɛɛ, "Kɛ ji asafoiatsɛ nukpa Lisia ba lɛ, makwɛ nyɛsane lɛ maye."
Ni efã asafoiatsɛ lɛ akɛ ekɛ Paulo ayato, ni ehã ena hejɔlɛ, ni kɛ ehe gbɔmɛi miiba lɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ loo sramɔ lɛ ekatsi amɛ gbɛ.
Gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, Felike kɛ eŋa Durslia ji Yudayoo lɛ ba, ni ehã yatsɛ Paulo kɛba, ni ebo Kristo nɔhemɔkɛyelɔi sane lɛ toi be ni Paulo wieɔ he lɛ.
Shi be ni ewieɔ jalɛ kɛ henɔkwɛmɔ kɛ kojomɔ ni baaba lɛ he lɛ, Felike she gbeyei pam, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ yaa fɛ̃ɛda; shi kɛ mina mihe dekã jiŋŋ, matsɛ o ekoŋŋ."
Shi asaŋ ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ Paulo aaahã lɛ shika ni eŋmɛɛ ehe; no hewɔ lɛ etsɛɔ lɛ kpitiokpitio ni ekɛ lɛ bagbaa sane.
Shi afii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, Porkio festo ba baye Felike najiaŋ; ni akɛni Felike miisumɔ akɛ efee nɔ ni sa Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ hewɔ lɛ, eshi Paulo yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
25: Be ni Festo baye amralo lɛ, enɔ gbii etɛ̃ pɛ ni ejɛ Kasisarea etee Yerusalem.
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpai kɛ Yudafoi lɛ anukpai lɛ baflɔ Paulo naa amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ
amɛmiitao ni ekwɛ amɛhiɛ ni etsu ni ayaŋɔ Paulo kɛba Yerusalem ejaakɛ amɛwo ka koni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Festo here nɔ akɛ Paulo yɛ tsuŋ yɛ Kaisarea, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu etsɛɔ̃ŋ ni ebaaya jɛi.
Hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa nyɛteŋ hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ kɛ mi ayaa jɛi ni kɛ sane fɔŋ ko yɛ nuu lɛ he lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ,"
Ni be ni eye aaafee gbii kpaanyɔ loo nyɔŋma yɛ amɛŋɔ̃ɔ lɛ, eyiŋ etee Kaisarea, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ eyata kojomɔsɛi lɛ nɔ, ni efã akɛ akɛ Paulo aba.
Be ni eba lɛ, Yudafoi ni jɛ Yerusalem ba lɛ babɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛkɛ naaflɔmɔi pii ni mli wa bashwie enɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ naa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Paulo jie enaa ekɛɛ "Mitɔ̃ko Yudafoi amla ko nɔ lɛ, asaŋ mitɔ̃ko Sɔlemɔwe lɛ loo Kaisarea nɔ hu."
Shi akɛni Festo miisumɔ akɛ efee nɔ ni sa Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Paulo akɛ, "Oosumɔ akɛ oya Yerusalem ni miyakojo o yɛ jɛmɛ yɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ ahemɔ lo?"
Shi Paulo kɛɛ, "Kaisare kojomɔsɛi lɛ hiɛ midamɔ nɛɛ, he ni sa akɛ akojoɔ mi yɛ lɛ. Yudafoi lɛ, mitɔ̃ko amɛnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni ole jogbaŋŋ lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miye sane fɔŋ ko ni mifee nɔ ko ni sa gbele lɛ, mikãmãaa gbele; shi kɛ saji ni mɛnɛɛmɛi flɔɔ minaa yɛ he nɛ ekoeko bɛ mli lɛ, mɔ ko nyɛŋ ekɛ mi awo amɛdɛŋ. Mikɛ misane lɛ miihã Kaisare yeli."
Kɛkɛ ni Festo kɛ ajinafoi lɛ hala mli ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ni okɛ osane lɛ ehã Kaisare yeli nɛɛ, Kaisare ŋɔ nɔŋŋ oootee."
Ni gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Agripa kɛ Bernika ba Kaisarea ni amɛbaŋa Festo.
Be ni amɛye gbii kplaŋŋ yɛ jɛi lɛ, festo jaje Paulo sane lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Nuu ko yɛ biɛ ni Felike shi lɛ yɛ tsuŋ,
ni be ni mitee Yerusalem lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Yudafoi anukpai lɛ ba miŋɔɔ kɛ ehe naaflɔmɔ ni amɛkpa mi fai akɛ mibu lɛ fɔ;

ni mito he mihã amɛ akɛ ebɛ Romanbii amla mli akɛ ajɔɔ mɔ ko nɔ ahãa enaaflɔlɔi, ja mɔ ni aflɔ enaa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yaflɔ enaa lɛ ekpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, ni mɔ lɛ ena hegbɛ ejie enaa yɛ sane ni akɛfɔ enɔ lɛ hewɔ dã.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ biɛ lɛ, mikɛshashaoo shi, shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ,miyata kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni mifã akɛ akɛ nuu lɛ aba.
Shi be ni enaaflɔlɔi lɛ badãmɔ shi lɛ, amɛkɛ saji ni misusu lɛ ateŋ ekomeflo baaa ebaflɔɔɔ enaa,
shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔjamɔ heŋwanejee saji komɛi kɛ Yesu ko ni egbo ni Paulo mã nɔ mi akɛ ehiɛ kã ni Paulo mã nɔ mi akɛ ehiɛ kã lɛ he saji amɛhiɛ kɛba.
Ni akɛni mileee b0 ni mafee matao nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, mibi lɛ akɛ eesumɔ akɛ eya Yerusalem ni ayaye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ yɛ jɛi lo?
Shi akɛni Paulo bi akɛ akɛ lɛ ato ni Kaisarea diɛŋtsɛ ayaye esane lɛ hewɔlɛ, mifã akɛ akɛ lɛ ato kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mahã akɛ lɛ aya Kaisare ŋɔɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Agripa kɛɛ Festo akɛ, "Kulɛ masumɔ akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ manu gbɔmɔ lɛ daaŋ wiemɔ." Ni ekɛɛ, "Wɔ lɛ obaanu,"
No hewɔ lɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Agripa kɛ Bernike wula kiŋkãa kɛba ni akɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi nukpai kɛ maŋ lɛ mli gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ babote sanetoiboohe lɛ, ni Festo fã, ni akɛ Paulo ba.
Ni Festo kɛɛ, "Maŋtsɛ Agripa kɛ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ wɔ yɔɔ biɛ, nyɛmiina nuu nɛɛ ni Yudafoi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bakpa mi fai yɛ Yerusalem kɛ biɛ fɛɛ ni amɛblɔ akɛ esaaa akɛ ehiɔ jeŋ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, mina akɛ efeko nɔ ko sa gbele. Ni akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu etu esane lɛ ewo Kaisare dɛŋ hewɔ lɛ, mikpɛ mli akɛ mahã akɛ lɛ aya.
Shi mibɛ sane krɛdɛɛ ko ni kulɛ maŋma mahã Kaisarea; no hewɔ hu ni mikɛ lɛ ba nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ, ni afee ni kɛji atao sane lɛ mli lɛ, mana nɔ ko maŋma.
Ejaakɛ efeɔ mi akɛ ejaaa akɛ akɛ gboklɛfonyo ko majeɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ ni akɛɛ efee."
26: Ni Agripa kɛɛ Paulo akɛ, "Aŋmɛ o gbɛ akɛ oklɔ ogbee." Kɛkɛ ni Paulo fɔ̃ enine ni ejie enaa ekɛɛ,
"Maŋtsɛ Agripa, eji miishɛɛ sane kɛhã mi akɛ mibajie minaa ŋmɛnɛ yɛ ohiɛ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ flɔɔ minaa yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ flɔɔ minaaa yɛ he lɛ hewɔ,
ejaakɛ ole Yudafoi lɛ akusumii kɛ ŋwanejee saji lɛ fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ miikpa o fai ni oŋmɛ otsui shi obo mi toi.
"Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ le mijeŋba kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ, bɔ ni mihi mimaŋ lɛ mli kɛ Yerusalem mihã tsutsu lɛ.
Ni kɛji amɛmiisumɔ akɛ amɛaaye he odase lɛ, amɛle mi sa kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ akɛ miba mijEŋ yɛ wɔjamɔ lɛ mli kuu ni yɔɔ veveeve fe fɛɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ naa akɛ Farisfonyo.
Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, shi ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ hewɔ midãmɔ biɛ ni akojoɔ mi nɛɛ.
No nɔ wɔkutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ hiɛ kã akɛ amɛnine aaashɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ jamɔ mli waa nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Agripa, nɛkɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ Yudafoi lɛ fLɔɔ minãa nɛɛ.
Mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛbuɔ akɛ ebɛ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teɔ gbohii ashi lɛ?
"Shi mi diɛtsɛ hu efee mi akɛ esa akɛ mafee nii pii kɛku Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ gbɛi lɛ naa;
ni mina mifee nakai hu yɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, miwo mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii atsuŋ, ni kɛ abaagbe amɛ lɛ minaa yɛ mli eko,
ni mifɔɔ amɛ yiwaa yɛ kpeehai lɛ fɛɛ, ni minyɛɔ amɛnɔ akɛ amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi,ni miye amɛhe sɛkɛ ko ni wa, ni miwaa amɛyi kɛyaa majiasɛɛ."
"Enɛ mli mihiɛ ni mifã gbɛ kɛmiiya Damasko yɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ ahewalɛ kɛ gbɛŋmɛɛ naa,
ni shwane fiŋtiŋŋ, be ni minyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ, mina la ko ni kpɛɔ fe hulu jɛ ŋwɛi babɔle mi kɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi nyiɛ lɛ.
Ni be wɔ fɛɛ wɔgbeegbee shi lɛ, minu gbee ko kɛ mi wie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ lɛ mli yi? Ewa hã o akɛ oofã ntia oshi kooloi akplamɔ tso lɛ naa dade lɛ.'
Ni mikɛɛ, 'Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?' Ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, 'Mi Yesu ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ ni.
Shi tee shi ni odamɔ onaji anɔ; ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ mijie mihe kpo mitsuɔ̃ɔ o nɛɛ, koni mafee o sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ odasefonyo yɛ nibii ni ona kɛ nii ni mibajie mihe kpo matsɔ̃ɔ o yɛ hewɔ lɛ ahe.
Ni majie o kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ni mitsuɔ o kɛya amɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ adɛŋ,
ni oyagble amɛhiŋmɛii, koni amɛkpale kɛjɛ duŋ mli kɛba lɛ he, kɛjɛ abosam hewalɛ mli kɛba eshaifaa kɛ gboshinii yɛ mɛi ni akɛ minɔ hemɔkɛyeli efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ateŋ.'"
"No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Agripa, migbooo nɔ ni ajie kpo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi atsɔɔ mi lɛ nɔ toi;

shi moŋ mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ tsutsu, kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ, hu, akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni amɛkpale kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni amɛtsu nii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ ni Yudafoi lɛ mɔ mi yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni amɛka mi gbee.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa mikɛdamɔ shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ni miyeɔ odase mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji nɛɛ, ni miwieee wiemɔ ko akɛ ja nii ni gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Mose hu ewie akɛ ebaaba lɛ,
bɔ ni Kristo lɛ baana amanehulu, bɔ ni ebaatsɔ̃ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli ni ebaajaje la lɛ sane etsɔɔ maŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ."
Be ni Paulo jie enaa nɛkɛ lɛ, Festo kɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, "Paulo, sɛkɛ oyeɔ nɛɛ! Woloŋkasemɔ sɔŋŋ ehã oyeɔ sɛkɛ nɛɛ!"
Shi Paulo kɛɛ, "Miyeko sɛkɛ, Festo, lumɔ jurɔ, shi anɔkwale kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ wiemɔi miwieɔ nɛɛ,
ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ni miwieɔ kɛ ekãa mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ le saji nɛɛ amli; ni mikpaa shi akɛ nibii nɛɛ eko yɛ ni akɛtee lɛ; ejaakɛ jeee teemɔ he ko afee enɛ yɛ.
Nto oheɔ gbalɔi lɛ oyeɔ, Maŋtsɛ Agripa? Mile akɛ oheɔ oyeɔ."
Shi Agripa kɛɛ Paulo akɛ, "Shwɛ fioo ni ohã matsake mijwɛmɔ ni matsɔ̃ Kristofonyo."
Ni Paulo kɛɛ, Mina ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hã ba mli akŋɛ, shwɛ fioo jio, shwɛ pii jio, jeee bo okome kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ mi toi ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ hu tsɔ̃ tamɔ mi, shi gboklɛi nɛɛ eko kɛkɛ akawo amɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amralo lɛ Bernike kɛ mɛi ni tra shi lɛ te shi,
ni amɛtee afã ni amɛyawie yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, "Nuu nɛɛ efeko nɔ ko ni sa gbele loo tsuŋwoo."
Ni Agripa kɛɛ Festo akɛ, "Eji nuu nɛɛ kɛ esane lɛ hãko Kaisare yeli kulɛ aaanyɛ ehe aŋmɛɛ."
27: Ni be ni akpɛ mli akɛ wɔbaaya Italia lɛ, amɛŋɔ Paulo kɛ gboklɛfoi krokomɛi hu amɛwo asraafoiahaatsɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yulio ni jɛ Augusto asafo lɛ mli lɛ dɛŋ.
Shi be ni wɔbote Adramitio lɛlɛ ko ni baafã kɛyatsɔ̃ Asia ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ anɔ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔfã, ni Aristarko, Makedonianyo ni jɛ Tesalonika lɛ fata wɔhe.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔyamã Sidon, ni akɛni Yulio hiɛ Paulo dɔdɔɔdɔ hewɔ lɛ, eŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ akɛ eya eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ ni eyajɔɔ ehe.
Ni wɔfã yɛ jɛi lɛ wɔhrã Kipro meo lɛ ejaakɛ wɔmiikpee kɔɔyɔɔ.
Ni be ni wɔfo Kilikia kɛ Pamfilia ŋshɔ lɛ, wɔbamã Mira yɛ Likia.
Ni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ na Aleksandria lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Italia, ni ejie wɔ ewo no mli.
Wɔnyiɛ blɛoo gbii pii, ni ekpakpa ko dani wɔshɛ Knido ŋlɛnɔ, ni akɛni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ wɔ gbɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔshrã Salmone meo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Kreta shishigbɛ;
ni ekpakpa ko dani wɔfo mli yɛ jɛi kɛba he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Lɛjiadaamɔhe Fɛɛfɛo ni bɛŋkɛ Lasea maŋ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ wɔfite be pii, ni akɛni buadayeli be lɛ hu eho momo hewɔ lɛ; ŋshɔhiɛnyiɛmɔ efee gbeyei. Hewɔ lɛ Paulo wo amɛ ŋaa
ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi, mina akɛ amanehulu kɛ nilaajemɔ pii baaba gbɛfãa nɛɛ mli, ni jeee lɛlɛ mli nii lɛ kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ kɛkɛ hiɛ baakpãtã, shi moŋ wɔwala diɛŋtsɛ hu."
Shi asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ heɔ kudɔɔtsɛ lɛ kɛ lɛlɛtsɛ lɛ eyeɔ fe wiemɔi ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ.

Ni akɛni Lɛjiadaamɔhe Fɛɛfɛo lɛ kãaa shi jogbaŋŋ bɔ ni aaanyɛ aye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ jɛi hewɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɛi pii wo ŋaa akɛ afã yɛ jɛi koni akwɛ akɛ aaanyɛ ashɛ Foinike ni ji Kreta Lɛjiadaamɔhe ni kwɛɔ wuoyi-anai kɛ kooyi-anai gbɛ lɛ lo, koni aye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Shi be ni wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ bɔ̃i tswaa nyrakee lɛ, efee amɛ akɛ nɔ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ eba mli, ni amɛfã kɛshrã Kreta he kpaakpa.
Shi etsɛɛɛ kɛkɛ ni ahum ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ kooyi-bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fã kɛbakpee amɛ.
Ni be ni eta lɛlɛ lɛ mli ni enyɛɛɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ ekpee lɛ, wɔhã ekpla.
Ni be ni wɔkɛ foi shrã ŋshɔkpɔ fioo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kauda lɛ meo lɛ, ekpakpa ko dani wɔnyɛ bonto lɛ wɔmɔ.
Amɛwo lɛ, ni amɛkɛ kpãi fimɔ lɛlɛ lɛ, ni akɛni amɛmiishe gbeyei akɛ aleeenɔ amɛaagbee shia nɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛkpa abalaa lɛ, ni amɛkpla kɛkɛ.
Ni akɛni ahum lɛ miitswa wɔ gbeyeigbeyei naakpa hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, amɛjie lɛlɛ lɛ mli nii lɛ eko amɛshwie;
ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ nɔ lɛ wɔkɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔniji jie etɛ̃ nɔ lɛ wɔkɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔniji jie lɛlɛ he nibii lɛ wɔshwie.
Wɔnãaa hulu loo ŋulamii gbii pii ni asaŋ jeee ahum fioo tswaa kɛkpeɔ wɔ lɛ, hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔhiɛ kãaa wala nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Shi be ni gbii pii eho ni wɔyeko nɔ ko lɛ, Paulo te shi edamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Ataamɛi, kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛboɔ mi toi ni akafã yɛ Kreta ni wɔbana amanehulu ni nibii laaje nɛkɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ hu miiwo nyɛ ŋaa akɛ nyɛna tsui, ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yiwala tɔŋ, ja lɛlɛ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ nɔ ni miji kɛ mɔ hu ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ bɔfo badamɔ mimasɛi
ni ekɛɛ, 'Kaashe gbeyei, Paulo! Ja akɛ o yadãmɔ Kaisare hiɛ kɛ̃; ni naa, Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ o yɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ eke o.'
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛnaa tsui, Ataamɛi, ejaakɛ miheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ miyeɔ akɛ bɔ ni abakɛɛ mi lɛ, nakai baaba mli.
Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, wɔɔyasha ŋshɔkpɔ ko nɔ kɛ̃."
Shi gbi ni ji nyŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nyɔŋ lɛ wɔmiikpla kɛmiiya kɛmiiba yɛ Adria ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ. Ni aaafee nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ amlakui shikpɔŋ ko,
ni amɛfɔ̃ susumɔ kpa6a, ni amɛna abasaŋ nyɔŋmai enyɔ; ni be ni amɛtee amɛhiɛ fioo lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ ekoŋŋ ni amɛna abasaŋ nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛshe gbeyei akɛ aleeenɔ wɔɔyagbee tɛsai anɔ, ni amɛŋmɛ sɛkɛi ejwɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛmiishwe ni je atsɛre.
shi be ni amlakui lɛ tao foi aje yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli ni amɛkwa amɛshi bonto lɛ amɛma ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ tãmɔ nɔ ni sɛkɛi amɛyaaŋmɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ yitsogbɛ lɛ,
Paulo kɛɛ asraafoiahaatsɛ lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ akɛ "Kɛji mɛnɛɛmɛi ehiii lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ anyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ahere."
Shi kɛbaa jetsɛremɔ mli lɛ, Paulo kpa amɛ fɛɛ fai akɛ amɛye nɔ ko ni ekɛɛ, "Gbii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ sɔŋŋ nɛ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko eyako nyɛdaaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛye nii ejaakɛ no aaahã nyɛyi ana wala, ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yitsɔi kome ejeŋ eyiteŋ enyɔŋ shi."
Ni be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, ekɔ aboloo, ni eda Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekumɔ mli ebɔ̃i yeli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛna tsui, ni amɛ hu amɛye nii.
Shi wɔ mɛi ni wɔyɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ naa shiɔ mɛi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ekpaa.
Ni be ni amɛye nii ni amɛtrɔ lɛ, amɛshɛrɛ able ni amɛwo lɛ amɛshwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛhã lɛlɛ lɛ fee huyɛhuyɛ.
Ni be je tsɛre lɛ amɛna akɛ amɛleee shikpɔŋ lɛ, shi amɛna ble ko kɛ enaa shia, ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ, kɛ amɛaanyɛ lɛ, amɛaahã lɛlɛ lɛ ayasha shi yɛ jɛi.
Ni amɛflɔ sɛkɛi lɛ amɛewo ŋshɔ lɛ mli,ni amɛfene kudɔɔ lɛ he kpãi lɛ hu, ni amɛshi hiɛgbɛ abalaa lɛ kɛkpee kɔɔyɔɔ ni tswaa lɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ eyi amɛmã shianɔgbɛ.
Shi akɛni amɛyagbee ŋshɔi enyɔ alɛwu nɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ yasha shi; ni eyitsogbɛ lɛ yatsɛkɛ shi shiŋŋ, shi esɛɛgbɛ lɛ; ŋshɔkei lɛ anaawalɛ lɛ jwara lɛ.
Shi asraafoi lɛ ayiŋtoo ji akɛ amɛaagbe gboklɛfoi lɛ, koni amɛteŋ mɔ ko akasre kɛmiiya ni ejo foi.
Shi akɛni asrafoiohaatsɛ lɛ taoɔ Paulo yiwala ehere hewɔ lɛ, etsi amɛyiŋtoo lɛ naa, ni efã akɛ mɛi ni le sremɔ lɛ tsutsu atu agbee ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛya shikpɔŋ;
shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ. Bɔ ni fee ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ shweshweeshwe ji no.
28: Ni be ni wɔje mli sɔŋŋ lɛ, no dani wɔbale akɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Malita.
Jɛibii lɛ fee wɔ ejurɔ pii, ejaakɛ amɛshɛre lɛ, ni amɛhere wɔ fɛɛ tswɛŋ hiɛmɛɛ yɛ nunɛmɔ babaoo kɛ fɛ̃i lɛ hewɔ.
Shi be ni Paulo bua lai ŋmɛŋmlɛbii anaa ni ekɛyawo la lɛ mli lɛ, shinɔ ko jɛɛ la grigri lɛ mli kpɛtɛ enine he.

Be ni jɛibii lɛ na kooloo lɛ kpɛtɛ enine he lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ awuyelɔ ni, ni ahere eyiwala kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli moŋ nɛ, shi oweletɔɔ eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ gbɛ ni eyi ana wala."
Ni ehwãnya koolo lɛ ewo la lɛ mli ni eyeee lɛ awui ko.
Amɛhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eeefuufuu loo eeetswa shi egbo trukaa. Shi be ni amɛkwɛ aahuu ni amɛna akɛ nɔ ko srɔto ko efeee lɛ lɛ, amɛtsake amɛjwɛŋmɔ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko ji lɛ.
ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ onukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Paulo lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ yɛ jɛi niiaŋ; gbɔmɔ nɛɛ here wɔ hiɛmɛɛ ni ekɛ tsuijurɔ fee wɔ gbɔ gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ.
Eba mli akɛ Publio tsɛ kã shi kɛ atridii kɛ fɔ kɛ la wamɔ; ni Paulo tee eŋɔɔ, ni esɔle ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni etsa lɛ.
Be ni afee enɛ lɛ, mɛi krokomɛi hu ni he yeɔ yɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ba, ni atsa amɛ.
Ni ni be ni wɔfaã yɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛhã wɔ nibii ni hehīaa wɔ.
Ni nyɔji etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ wɔyabote Aleksandria lɛlɛ ko ni ekadimɔ ji Dioskurioi (loo nyɔŋmɔi hãaji) ni ebaye fɛi be lɛ yɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli, ni wɔfã kɛtee.
Wɔyadamɔ Sirakusa ni wɔhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃.
Ni wɔjɛ jɛi lɛ, wɔlɔgɔ shi kɛba Regio; ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, be ni wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ bɔ̃i tswaa lɛ, wɔyi mli, ni gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ wɔshɛ Puteoli.
Jɛi wɔbana nyɛmimɛi komɛi yɛ; ni amɛkpa wɔ fai akɛ wɔkɛ amɛ ahi shi gbii kpawo. Kɛkɛ ni wɔyashɛ Roma.
Nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nu wɔhe, ni amɛbakpee wɔ yɛ Apio jaranɔ kɛ Gbɔiatoohei Etɛ̃ lɛ; ni be ni Paulo na amɛ lɛ, eda Nyɔŋmɔ shi ni etsui nyɔ emli.
Ni be ni wɔbashɛ Roma lɛ aŋmɛ Paulo gbɛ akɛ ekome ehi kɛ asraafonyo kome ni miibu ehe.

Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ Paulo hã atsɛ Yudafoi lɛ anukpai ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛbakpe; ni bed ni amɛnaa ebakpe shi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi, mitɔ̃ko mŋ lɛ loo wɔtsɛmɛii lɛ akusumii lɛ anɔ; kɛ̃lɛ akɛ mi wo Romanbii lɛ adeŋ yɛ Yerusalem akɛ gboklɛfonyo.
Be ni amɛtao misane lɛ mli lɛ, amɛsumɔ akɛ amɛŋmɛɛ mihe, ejaakɛ sane ko bɛ mihe kwraa ni sa gbele.

Shi akɛni Yudafoi lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, efi akɛ maŋɔ misane lɛ mahã Kaisare yeli, shi jeee akɛ miyɛ kɛba koni mana nyɛ ni mikɛ nyɛawie ejaakɛ Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ hewɔ ni awo mi nɛkɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ nɛɛ."
Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ wɔnako woji komɛi kɛjɛko Yudea yɛ wɔnako woji komɛi kɛjɛko Yudea yɛ ohe, ni asaŋ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko bako biɛ ebagbako ohe sane ko, ni mɔ ko ebawieko ohe wiemɔ fɔŋ ko.
Shi wɔmiisumɔ akɛ wɔle ojwɛŋmɔ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ kuu nɛɛ wɔle akɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ awieɔ ashiɔ."

Ni be ni amɛto lɛ gbi lɛ, amɛteŋ mɛi pii ba eŋɔɔ yɛ etoohe lɛ, ni kɛjɛ leebi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ lɛ, ejaje Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni eye he odase faŋŋ, ni ejɛ Mose Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli etao ni amɛyiŋ atsɔ̃ kɛba Yesu gbɛfaŋ.
Ni mɛi komɛi he wiemɔi ni ewie amɛye, shi mɛi komɛi hu heee yeee.
Ni akɛni amɛyakpãaa gbee hewɔ lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee be ni Paulo wie wiemɔ nɛɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia naa
akɛ, 'Yaa maŋ nɛɛ ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ nu lɛ nyɛbaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi. Ni na lɛ nyɛbaana nɛ, shi nyɛyoŋ sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋ nɛɛ tsui ekpliŋ, ni amɛtoi wa kɛ ninumɔ, ni amɛmiamia amɛhiŋmɛii, koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛkpale ni mitsa amɛ.'
"No hewɔ lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ, atsu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ eyahã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni amɛ lɛ amɛaabo toi hu."
(Ni be ewie wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛjejee ŋwane babaoo yɛ amɛteŋ.)
Ni Paulo hi shīa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyaŋɔ mli afii enyɔ ni ehereɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baa eŋɔɔ lɛ,
ni eshiɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane lɛ, ni ekɛ ekãa fɛɛ jajeɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Krito he saji lɛ etsɔɔ amɛ, ni mɔ ko ko etsiii lɛ gbɛ.

1: Amos, ni ji tookwɛlɔ ko ni jɛ Tekoa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛ. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jie ninaa nɛɛ yɛ Israel he etsɔ̃ɔ Amos afii enyɔ dani shikpɔŋ hoso, be mli ni Uzia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Yeroboam, Yehoash bi lɛ, hu yeɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Amos kɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa miihūu tamɔ jata yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni egbee miishi yɛ Yerusalem Shikpɔji lɛ anɔ jwɛi fɔ aaaŋla, ni Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yitɛŋ aaagbi."
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Damaskobii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛgblɛ Gileadbii tamɔ akɛ dade gblɛɔ nii.
No hewɔ lɛ mibama Maŋtsɛ Hazael maŋtsɛ we lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.

Mibakumɔ Damasko maŋ lɛ naa agboi lɛ mashwie shi; mibaplenee Aven Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Bet-eden nɔ lɛ hu, ni mibaŋɔ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anom kɛya Kir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yehowa ni kɛɛ."
