Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Gazabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ jaku muu fɛɛ nom kɛtee amɛyahã Edombii.
No hewɔ lɛ mibama Gaza maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.
Mibaplenee Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli bii kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Ashkelon nɔ lɛ hu; ni mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mawo Ekron hu, ni mibakpãtã Filistibii ni baashwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Tiro etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo Edom dɛŋ, ni amɛkaii kwraa nyɛmimɛi akpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ,
No hewɔ lɛ mibama Tiro maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ."

Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Edombii tɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛtse klaŋte yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ bɔ ni musuŋtsɔ̃lɛ ko bɛ mli kwraa; amɛniŋ nii ahe aahuu, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ mlifu he kwrakwra.
No hewɔ lɛ mibama Teman maŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Bazra mɔji lɛ fɛɛ."

Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Amonbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ taitai ni amɛfãfãa bɔ ni afee ni amɛlɛɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ husui amli hewɔ lɛ, amɛgblagblaa Gilaed yeihɔlɔi amusui amli, ni bii lɛ je shwie shi.
No hewɔ lɛ mibama Raba maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã emli mɔji lɛ. Gbi lɛ abaabɔ tawuu oshe, ni ta lɛ naa baawa tamɔ ahum ni efã.
Abaaŋɔ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛaatee. Yehowa ni kɛɛ."
2: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Moabbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛshã Edom maŋtsɛ gbonyo wui kɛyashi etsɔ̃ lamlu, ni amɛkɛshwie ehiɛ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ mibama Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Keriot maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ. Moabbi lɛ baagboi yɛ oshebɔɔ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ hoofeemɔ lɛ mli.
Mibaplenee Moab maŋ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni mibagbe emli lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu mafata he."

Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Yudabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa mlai lɛ, ni amɛyeee ekpɔi lɛ anɔ. Apasa jemawɔji asɛɛ ni amɛyanyiɛ, tamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yanyiɛ lɛ, hã amɛdu gbɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mibama Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã Yerusalem mɔji lɛ fɛɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Israelbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbla lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ jalɔi amɛhe jwiɛtɛi, ni ohiafo lɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ lɛ tokota jra naa.
Amɛnaanaa ohiafoi ayitsei anɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ mlu mli, ni amɛtsirɛɔ mɛi ni ehao kɛyaa gbɛsɛɛ. Mɔ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsɛ fɛɛ kɛ oblayoo kome lɛ nɔŋŋ naa bɔlɛ, ni amɛkɛbuleɔ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛkãmɔɔ atadei ni akɛbato amɛ awaba anɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ naa, ni amɛnuɔ wain ni ahe yɛ mɛi ni abu amɛ fɔ adɛŋ yɛ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
"Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikpãtã Amorbii ni kwlɔ tamɔ tsenedru tsei, ni amɛhe wa hu tamɔ odum lɛ ahiɛ yɛ amɛ, Israelbii, ahiɛ. Mikpãtã amɛnɔ yibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni mifite amɛshishi fãi lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Mijie nyɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpla nyɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba koni nyɛbaŋɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ.
Mitee nyɛbihii lɛ ekomɛi ashi, ni mifee amɛ gbalɔi, ni mifee nyɛblahii lɛ ekomɛi hu Nazirifoi. Israelbii, ebɛ mli nakai lo? Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Shi nyɛhã Nazirifoi lɛ bɔ̃i dãanumɔ, ni nyɛwo gbalɔi lɛ akitã akɛ amɛkagba gbalɛ ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ.
Naa, mibamia nyɛ makpɛtɛ shi tamɔ shwiili ni ewo ŋmaa tɔtɔɔtɔ miaa nii kpɛtɛɔ shi.
Foijee aaalaaje mɔ ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ foijee, hewalɛ aaaŋmɛɛ hewalɔ, ni kãkãlɔ hu nyɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala po ehere.
Gãitsɛ̃lɔi nyɛŋ shi amɛdamɔ lɛ,foijelɔ he ejeŋ mli lɛ, mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ nɔ hu hereŋ eyiwala.
Nakai gbi lɛ kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni tsui esa tete aaajo foi kɛ ehe yayai." Yehowa ni kɛɛ.
3: Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ni Yehowa wie yɛ nyɛhe lɛ toi, nyɛ ni nyɛji jaku muu ni eyajie kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ, 2 "Jeŋ maji fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, nyɛ pɛ ji maŋ ni mile, ni no hewɔ lɛ mibawo nyɛ nibii gbohii ni nyɛfee lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ."
Ani mɛi enyɔ feɔ ekome kɛnyiɛɔ gbɔ kɛji amɛkpãŋko he?
Ani jata hūuɔ yɛ koo mli be mli ni enako kooloo ko ni eeemɔ lo? Ani jata oblayoo woɔ egbee yɛ ebu mli kɛji emɔko loo ko lo?
Ani looflɔ duɔ tsɔne yɛ shikpɔŋ kɛji atsɔ̃ko lɛ tsɔne yɛ jɛi lo? Ani tsɔne fɛɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ be mli ni eduko nɔ ko?
Ani tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɔ yɛ maŋ ni maŋbii lɛ hɛleee shi lo? Ani amane baa maŋ ko nɔ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ lo?
Eji anɔkwale akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee nɔ ko ni ejieee eyiŋtoo lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ.
Kɛji jata miihuu lɛ, namɔ sheee gbeyei? Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ewie lɛ, namɔ baakwa akɛ eshiɛɛɛ gbalɛ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ?
Kɛɛmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ashdod kɛ Egipt mɔji lɛ amli lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Samaria gɔji lɛ anɔ koni nyɛkwɛa basabasa ni afeɔ kɛ niseniianii ni yaa nɔ yɛ Samaria."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ kɛ juu buaa nibii anaa yɛ mɔji lɛ amli. Amɛleee nɔ ni ja gbɛ feemɔ tete.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, 'Henyɛlɔi aaabɔle shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛaakpe, ni amɛaakumɔ nibii ni akɛfãa shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛaaha mɔji lɛ amli nii ofɔ̃ kɛya.'"
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ shɔ̃ɔ too shwuɔji enyɔ loo etoi kuku kɛkɛ po yɛ jata daaŋ lɛ, nakai kɛji eshwɛ saatso tso kuku kɛkɛ loo saashwɛ tete akɛbaahere Israelbii ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ ayiwala."
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛkɛa Yakob shwiei lɛ
akɛ gbi nɔ ni mibagbla Israelbii atoi yɛ amɛtoigbele hewɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã Betel afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ hu ahiɛ. Abaakumɔ akloŋtoi ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ akoji lɛ ashwie shi.
Shīa ni ama ato fɛ̃i be kɛ nɔ ni ama ato latsaa be hu mibakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ shi kome; shīai ni akɛ shwuɔ wu esaa amɛmli fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ni shīa wulu fɛɛ shīa wulu hiɛ baakpãtã," Yehowa kɛɛ.
4: Nyɛ Samaria yei ni nyɛshwishwii tamɔ Bashan tsinayei ni yɔɔ Samaria gɔji anɔ lɛ, nyɛboa wiemɔ nɛɛ toi. Te nyɛwaa ohiafoi ayi, ni nyɛshwishwiaa mɛi ni efī amɛ shi, ni nyɛkɛɔ nyɛwumɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyataoa nɔ ni wɔɔnu kɛba!
Naa, beiaŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, "Gbii miiba ni akɛ kpoŋ baalalaa nyɛ, ni akpla nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛya. Nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ loi ni tsɛ̃rɛ̃ kpoji anaa.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baanyiɛ kɛya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, kɛyashɛ fɔji ni egbulɔ yɛ maŋ gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ ahe, ni aaahole nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ fɔji nɛɛ amli atsirɛ ashwie Harman," Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛbaa Betel nyɛbatɔ̃a mla; nyɛyaa Gilgal nyɛyahãa mlanɔtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afaa; nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔlei abaa koni ashã daa leebi; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ abaa daa gbii etɛ̃.
Nyɛkɛ ma ni esha abashãa shidaa fɔlei lɛ, ni nyɛshiɛa kɛfoa shi akɛ nyɛshãa tsuijurɔ naa afɔlei hu, ejaakɛ nakai feemɔ ji nɔ ni ŋɔɔ nyɛnaa. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Mi, mihã hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, ni daaŋtaa bɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ; aboloo hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ." Yehowa kɛɛ.

"Asaŋ be ni eshwɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ ni akɛkpaa ŋmɔshinii lɛ tete mihãaa nu anɛ nyɛ. Mihã nu nɛ maŋ kome ko nɔ, shi mihãaa enɛ maŋ ko hu nɔ. Nɔ nɛ ŋmɔ ko shi, ni nu enɛɛɛ ŋmɔ ko hu shi, no hewɔ lɛ ŋmɔ ni enɛɛɛ mli lɛ mli nii ŋla.
Maji enyɔ loo etɛ̃ mli bii koni amɛyatao nu ni amɛnu; shi nu ni amɛyana lɛ eyashɛɛɛ amɛnaa. Shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ," Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Mihã kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ emli dɔlɛ fã, ni eŋla nyɛŋmɔshinii, ni baalabii kpãtã nyɛbɔ̃ɔi kɛ nyɛwain tromii kɛ nyɛgbami tsei kɛ nyɛmu tsei bluublu ahiɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ." Yehowa kɛɛ.

"Mihã gbele hela tamɔ Egipt hela lɛ bote nyɛteŋ, ni mihã nyɛblahii lɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli, ni ashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ nyɛkpɔŋɔi yɛ nyɛdɛŋ kɛtee. Mihã nyɛgbohii ni jwere nyɛnsrai amli lɛ je fu wo nyɛ. Shi fɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mikpãtã nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ahiɛ tamɔ mifee Sodom kɛ Gomora lɛ. Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyi na wala lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ la tso ni afã yɛ la naa; ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii, agbɛnɛ mibagbla nyɛ toi. Ni akɛni mibafee nyɛ nakai hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛkɛkpea nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ toigblamɔ naa."
Naa, mɔ ni shɔ̃ gɔji lɛ, ni ebɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, ni egbaa gbɔmɔ nɔ ni ji lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eyiŋtoo. Lɛ mɔ ni ehãa jetsɛremɔ tsɔ̃ɔ duŋ, ni enyiɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, Egbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.
5: Isrealbii, nyɛboa yaafo lala ni miwoɔ nɔ yɛ nyɛhe nɛɛ toi.
Israel oblayeiaŋ etã, egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ. Akwa lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni woɔ enɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Maŋ ni baawo asraafoi akpe gbɛ kɛya ta lɛ, eeeshwɛ asraafoi oha pɛ ahã lɛ, ni maŋ ni woɔ asraafoi oha gbɛ lɛ, eeeshwɛ emɛi nyɔŋma pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba Israel we lɛ."
Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Israelbii ji akɛ, "Nyɛtaoa mi misɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi aaana wala,
shi nyɛkataoa Betel sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛkayaa Gilgal hu, aloo nyɛmiitse mli kɛmiiya Beersheba; ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ Gilgalbii nom, ni Betel hiɛ baakpãtã."
Nyɛtaoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi baana wala. Kɛjeee nakai lɛ Yehowa aaaba tamɔ la ni eje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, ni eeeshã nii. La nɛɛ baakpãtã Betel hiɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe ahã Betel.
Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni jalɛ saneyeli joɔ hãa nyɛ tamɔ taatso, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkɛ jalɛ saneyeli shwishwia shikpɔŋ!

Naa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋulamii, "Wuɔ kɛ ebii kɛ Oŋwɛ" mɔ ni hãa duŋ kpii tsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ, ni ehãa shwane woɔ duŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ. Lɛ mɔ ni efãa ŋshɔ mli nu, ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, Yehowa ji egbɛi.
Ehãa hewalɔ hiɛ kpãtãa kɛkɛ lɛ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hu hiɛ ekpãtã.
Amɛnyɛɔ mɔ ni kãa mɔ hiɛ yɛ koishi, ni mɔ ni wieɔ anɔkwale lɛ, amɛhiɔ ehiɛ.
Akɛni nyɛnaanaa ohiafo nɔ, ni nyɛtsuɔ lɛ able onia fe bɔ ni sa hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tɛ ni ako emamɔ shīai; shi moŋ nyɛhiŋ amɛmli; ni nyɛfeefee wain tromii fɛɛfɛji moŋ, shi nyɛnuŋ amɛmli wain.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛmlanɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa, ni mile eshai ni nyɛfeefee anaawalɛ. Nyɛgbaa jalɔ naa, ni nyɛheɔ nyɔŋnii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ koni ohiafo kɛ esane ashɛ koishi koni aye ahã lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni le nii lɛ, efeɔ diŋŋ nɛkɛ be mli, ejaakɛ be lɛ be fɔŋ ni. 14-15. Nyɛtaoa nɔ kpakpa, shi jeee nɔ fɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi ana wala, kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kpakpa; ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ koishi akɛ aleee nɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaadro Yosef shwiei ni eshwɛ lɛ lo! 16-17. No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, kɛɔ ji akɛ, "Abaawo yara yɛ blohui fɛɛ amli, ni aaablɔ, 'Ao, ao!' Kɛnyiɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ. Abaatsɛ okwaafoi koni amɛbaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni abaatsɛ mɛi ni le yara nɔ yaafo jogbaŋŋ hu koni amɛbafo. Abaawo yara yɛ wain trom fɛɛ wain trom mli ejaakɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛteŋ kɛho kɛgbla nyɛ toi," Yehowa kɛɛ.
Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛshweɔ Yehowa gbi lɛ. Mɛni nyɛbaana yɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ nɔ? Naa, duŋ gbi ni, shi jeee la gbi ni:
nɔ ni baaba lɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni joɔ jata naa foi, ni ekɛ oshishibrishi kpeɔ, loo be ni eba shīa ni ekɛ enine mɔ gbogbo mli lɛ onufu kɔ̃ lɛ.
Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ duŋ aaawo, ni hulu etsoŋ nakai gbi lɛ duŋ kpii aaawo bɔ ni la bɛ he ko he ko.
Miihi nyɛgbii juji lɛ; amɛjeee nɔ ko kɛhã mi; ni nyɛhe naa ni nyɛbuaa kɛjaa mi lɛ tete, mibɛ he miishɛɛ.
Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei tete nyɛhãa mi nɛ, shi miheee. Shidaa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛ nyɛkooloi ni eshwishwii shãa lɛ hu mikwɛɛɛ po.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛlalai lɛ ajea minɔ; mitaooo nyɛsaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ hu toi mabo.
Nyɛyea jalɛ sane moŋ koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ nu ni hoɔ; nyɛhãa jalɛ ahea shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ daa.
"Israelbii, mɛɛ kooloi afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei nyɛshã nyɛhã mi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?
Nyɛbaawo nyɛmãgãi ni nyɛfee nyɛhã nyɛhe ni ji nyɛmaŋtsɛ Sakut kɛ Kaiwan hu nyɛtre;
ni mahã aŋɔ nyɛ nom kɛya Damasko sɛɛ." Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni gbɛi ji Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.
6: Kpoo hã mɛi ni ahe ejɔ amɛ yɛ Zion, kɛ mɛi ni nyɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ Samaria Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, mɛi ni ji lumɛi wuji yɛ maŋ wulu, Israel mli lɛ, mɛi aŋɔɔ ni Israelbii lɛ baa lɛ.

Nyɛhoa kɛyaa Kalne maŋ lɛ mli nyɛyakwɛa jɛi; ni nyɛjɛa jɛi nyɛyaa Hamat maŋ wulu lɛ mli; nyɛtsaa nɔ kɛkplekea shi kɛyaa Filistibii amaŋ ni ji Gat lɛ mli hu. Ani amɛhi fe maŋtsɛyelihei nɛɛ lo; aloo amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ da fe nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ,
nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtsiɔ gbi fɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ nakai feemɔ moŋ hãa gbi fɔŋ lɛ bɛŋkɛɔ nyɛ lɛ?
Kpoo hã mɛi ni kãmɔɔ shwuɔ wu saatsei anɔ amɛwɔɔ, ni amɛkpaa amɛmli yɛ saatsei bibii anɔ, ni amɛyeɔ too ku lɛ mli gwaŋtɛŋbii kɛ tsina tsui amli tsinabii lɛ.
Mɛi ni kɛ saŋku laa yakayaka lalai, ni amɛsɔ̃ɔ saŋkui tamɔ David nɔ lɛ amɛhãa amɛhe.
Mɛi ni kɛ kpuji wuji nuɔ wain, ni mu ni hi fe fɛɛ amɛkpaa, shi Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ edɔɔɔ amɛ kwraa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛ tsutsu aaaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛaatee, ni no baahã ahoshwibɔlɔi lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, "Miihi Israelbii ahewoo lɛ; ni miinyaŋe amɛmɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ maŋɔ amɛmaŋ lɛ kɛ emli nii lɛ fɛɛ mahã."
Aaaba mli akɛ kɛji shwɛ shīa kome mli hii nyɔŋma kɛkɛ po lɛ, amɛbaagboi kɛ̃.

Ni kɛji mɛi ni egbo lɛ eko wekunyo, mɔ ni fuɔ lɛ, baaba koni ebawo gbonyo lɛ kɛje shīa lɛ, wekunyo nɛɛ baabi mɔ ni yɔɔ shīa lɛ mli akɛ, "Ani eshwɛ mɔ ko lolo hɔ shīa lɛ mli fata ohe lo?" Mɔ lɛ aaahere nɔ akɛ, "Dabida!" Gbonyo lɛ wekunyo lɛ baakɛɛ akɛ, "Feemɔ diŋŋ. Wɔkwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni wɔkatsi Yehowa gbɛi tã."
Ejaakɛ Yehowa efã ni shīa wulu fɛɛ shīa wulu baawule butuu, ni shīa bibioo hu baajwa.
Ani okpɔŋɔ joɔ foi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, aloo akɛ tsinahii huɔ yɛ ŋshɔ mli? Shi nyɛhã jalɛ etsɔ̃ ebɔɔ, ni jalɛ yibii etsɔ̃ taatso.
Nyɛnyaa yɛ Lo-Debar maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, "Ani jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ mli wɔjɛ ni mɔshɔ̃ Karnaim maŋ lɛ?"

Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, "Israelbii, naa, mibatee maŋ ko shi mawo nyɛ koni amɛbaŋɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ. Maŋ nɛɛ baahao nyɛ kɛjɛ Lebo-Hamat yɛ kooyigbɛ, aahuu kɛyaa shiŋa kplenee ni atsɛɔ lɛ Araba Nujɔɔ lɛ naa yɛ wuoyigbɛ."
7: Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ. Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ baalabii ku ko. Be nɛɛ mli lɛ afɛ̃ maŋtsɛ jwɛi momo, ni jwɛi lɛ eje shishi eefu kɛmiiba ekoŋŋ.
Be ni baalabii lɛ eye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛfɔ lɛ amɛgbe naa lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Yehowa, Ofe, ofai nɛ, okɛ Israelbii ahe ake amɛ. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛ yi aaana wala hu? Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa."
Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni ona nɛɛ baŋ mli."
Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ. Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ miitao akɛ ekɛ la abla ewebii lɛ atoi. La lɛ ŋla nu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛkɛ ni la lɛ bɔ̃i shikpɔŋ lɛ hu shãa.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Yehowa, ofai nɛ, foo sɛɛ. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Israelbii, owebii lɛ, ayi aaana wala hu? Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa."
Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛ hu baŋ mli."
Yehowa jie ninaa nɛɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔ mi. Mina Yehowa ni edamɔ gbogbo ni akɛ plomo susu ni atswa he; ni ehiɛ plomo yɛ edɛŋ.
Yehowa bi mi akɛ, "Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?" Mito he akɛ, "Plomo." Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, mikɛ plomo nɛɛ miisusu mimaŋ Israelbii ajalɛ. Mihaŋ amɛye amɛhe dɔŋŋ.
Hei ni Isak shwie lɛ jaa yɛ lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amɛŋfɔ̃, ni hei ni Israelbii jaa yɛ lɛ hu baafee koikoi; ni mibafã ta mawo Yeroboam we lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Amazia, Betel osɔfo lɛ, tsu kɛtee Yeroboam, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ akɛ, "Amos etee oyinɔ apam yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ. Ewiemɔi lɛ baafite maŋ lɛ."
Nɔ ni Amos kɛɛ ji, "Yeroboam baanyɔ yɛ ta mli, ni nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ Israelbii kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee."
Osɔfo Amazia kɛɛ Amos akɛ, "Gbalɔ, jee biɛ ni oya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oyaye nii yɛ jɛi koni ogba yɛ jɛi.
Kaakã he oogba yɛ Betel nɛɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ biɛ ji he ni maŋtsɛ lɛ jaa yɛ, ni biɛ nɔŋŋ ji he ni maŋtsɛyelihe nɛɛ Sɔlemɔwe wulu ni fe fɛɛ lɛ hu yɔɔ."
Amos here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Osɔfo Amazia akɛ, "Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, ni asaŋ jeee gbalɔ bi hu ji mi. Shi moŋ koolookwɛlɔ ji mi, ni misaa sikamore tsei ahe hu;
ni kooloo mikplaa ni Yehowa tsɛ mi; ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Yaa, ni oyagba otsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi ejaakɛ okɛɛ mikagba mishi Israel lɛ, ni mikashiɛ mishi Isak we lɛ.

Amazia, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Oŋa baatsɔ̃ ajwamaŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta naa; abaaŋɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni abaaja ahã mɛikpɔji. Bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ maŋsɛɛ obaaya oyagbo yɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ ni ajaaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ; ni Israelbii lɛ nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ amɛ kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee.'"
8: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jie ninaa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi, Mina kɛŋtɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsui.

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi mi akɛ, "Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?" Mihere nɔ akɛ, "Kɛŋtɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsu." Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Mimaŋ Israelbii akpulu eyi agbɛnɛ; mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ; mibagbla amɛtoi.
Nakai gbi lɛ, lalai ni amɛlaa yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ yara ni awo. Gbɔmɛi babaoo baaplenee, ni abaashɛrɛ gbohii ashwie hei fɛɛ nigii, shi mɛi baafee diŋŋ kɛkwɛ."
Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnaanaa mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkpãtãa ohiafoi ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Mɛɛbe po nyɔŋ hee lɛ aaanyɔ shi koni wɔbɔ̃i ŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ? Ni mɛɛbe po abaagbe hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ yeli naa koni wɔbɔ̃i wɔŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ susumɔnɔ ni shɛɛɛ, asaŋ kɛ nsɛnitɛ ni atse nɔ?
Wɔkɛ jwiɛtɛi aaahe ohiafo nyɔŋmɔtsɛ, ni wɔkɛ tokota aaahe mɔ ni efi lɛ, ni ŋmaa shishi tutuu tete wɔɔhɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ jrawalɛ."
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ; "Anɔkwa, mihiɛ kpaŋ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ eko nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baahoso, ni enɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ baaye awerɛhoo. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baafee hãmãhãmã tamɔ bɔ ni Nilo Faa lɛ yiɔ, ni ekuɔ, ni asaŋ ekpɔŋɔ lɛ."
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibahã hulu anyɔ shi shwane koti duŋ awo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane fiŋtiŋŋ.

Mahã gbii juji ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ yarafeemɔ, ni lalai kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni nyɛlaa lɛ baatsɔ̃ yaafo. Nyɛbaabumɔ kpekpe, ni nyɛaashɛshɛɛ nyɛyi, ni nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ fɔlɔi ni miiye amɛbi koome ni egbo he awerɛho. Nakai gbi lɛ naagbee mli baajoo pam.
"Naa, gbii miiba, ni mahã hɔ̃mɔ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Jeee daaŋŋmaa hɔ̃mɔ mɛi baaye lɛ, ni jeee nu hɔ̃mɔ hu, shi moŋ abaaye Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ he kumai.
Mɛi baafo shi kɛjɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛya ŋshɔnaa, ni amɛaajɛ kooyigbɛ kɛya bokãgbɛ ni amɛmiitao Yehowa naa wiemɔ lɛ, shi amɛnaŋ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, oblayei hefɛotsɛmɛi kɛ oblahii fɛɛ baatɔtɔ biti kɛ kumai,
ni mɛi ni kɛ Samaria jemawɔji lɛ kãa kita amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Mina Dan jemawɔŋ lɛ,'loo 'Mina Beersheba jemawɔŋ lɛ,'amɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ."
9: Mina Yehowa damɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Okɛ nii atswia Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpɔbii lɛ waa koni kpokui lɛ ahoso, ni ewule eshwie mɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Mɛi ni ahe baaje mli lɛ mibagbe amɛ yɛ ta mli. Mɔ ko mɔ ko ejoŋ minaa foi lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko hu he ejeŋ mli.
Kɛji amɛtsa shi kɛtee gbohiiaje tete lɛ, minine baashɛ amɛnɔ yɛ jɛi; ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi hu, mibamɔmɔ amɛ kɛkpleke shi kɛjɛ jɛi.
Kɛji amɛyatee amɛhe yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ tete lɛ, mibatao amɛ, ni mibamɔmɔ amɛ; ni kɛ amɛtee ŋshɔ shishi amɛyatee mi yɛ jɛi hu mibafã ŋshɔŋ onufu gbeyeigbeyei lɛ, ni ebaakɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Ni kɛji amɛhenyɛlɔi baŋɔ amɛ nom tete lɛ, mibafã, ni henyɛlɔi lɛ baafã klaŋte yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛaagbe amɛ. Mijie mihiɛ mika amɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ; ejurɔ ko bɛ ni mibafee amɛ."
Nuŋtsɔ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ enine sa je lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ miihoso, ni emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeɔ awerɛhoo, mɔ ni hãa je lɛ yiɔ ni ekpɔ̃ŋɔ tamɔ Nilo Faa lɛ,
mɔ ni ŋwɛiniiaŋ ji he ni epiai yɔɔ, ni ekɛ ŋwɛi ebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni etsɛɔ ŋshɔŋ nu lɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Egbɛi ji Yehowa!
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Israelbii, mijwɛŋɔ nyɛhe tamɔ mijwɛŋɔ Sudanbii ahe lɛ. Bɔ ni mijie Israelbii kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai mijie Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Kreta kɛ Siriabii lɛ hu kɛjɛ Kir.
Naa, mi, Yehowa Ofe, mijie mihiɛ mika Israel, maŋ ni feɔ esha lɛ, ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Shi moŋ mikpãtãŋ Yakob shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ kwrakwra, Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Naa, mibafã, ni mibasha Israelbii lɛ amli yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ ateŋ tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa ŋmaa mli lɛ, ni ŋmaa kuli nɛkɛ egbeŋ shi.
Mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ gbɔmɛi eshafeelɔi ni kɛɔ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ haŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko anina wɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli.'"

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibatee David maŋtsɛyeli ni egbee shi lɛ shi mama shi ekoŋŋ. Mibatsimɔ fɔji ni eba maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni masaa matswa lɛ mama shi tamɔ eyɔɔ blema lɛ.
Ni Israelbii lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ amɛbashɔ̃ Edom shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi fɛɛ ni tsutsu ko lɛ migbɛi kã amɛnɔ lɛ." Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni baatsu nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, ekɛɛ nɛ,

"Naa, gbii miiba," Yehowa kɛɛ "ni nidulɔi kɛ nidumɔ baanina nikpalɔ ni ekpako nii egbeko naa; ni wain yibii baawo babaoo bɔ ni wainŋalɔ nyɛŋ fɛɛ eŋa, ni wain baatsere kɛbaajɛ gɔji lɛ amli, ni eeeho yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ tamɔ faa.

Mibakpale mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba koni amɛbasaa amɛmaji ni efee koikoi lɛ ni amɛhi mli ekoŋŋ; amɛaafee wain tromii ni amɛaanu amɛmli wain; ni amɛaahu abɔɔi ni amɛaaye abɔɔi ni amɛaaye abɔi lɛ amli nii.
Mibadu amɛ yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni anyɛŋ amɛ afã yɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ." Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ ena ekɛɛ.

1: Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suomɔ naa kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo
ŋma yahã nyɛmimɛi hetselɔi kɛ heyelɔi yɛ Kristo mli ni yɔɔ kolose lɛ. Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ shi yɛ nyɛhewɔ daa nɛɛ yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli.
Ejaakɛ wɔnu nyɛ Kristo yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ nyɛsumɔ ni nyɛkɛ sumɔɔ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ he
yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni akɛto ahã nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ. Nyɛnu enɛ momo yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ mli.

Sanekpakpa lɛ eshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni eyɔɔ yɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni eewo yibii ni eeshwere, tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ yɛ nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
Nyɛkase enɛ yɛ Epafra wɔnaanyo tsulɔ ni wɔsumɔɔ, ni ji Kristo anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ hã nyɛ lɛ naa.
Lɛ ebagba wɔ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwoɔ nyɛmli lɛ he sane.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ wɔ hu, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni wɔnu lɛ, wɔfɔ̃ko sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ nyɛ hãmɔ, koni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ esumɔnaanii alee yɛ mumɔŋ nilee kɛ shishinamɔ fɛɛ mli.
Koni nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni asa ehiɛ kwraa ni nyɛwo yibii yɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa mli.
ni awaje nyɛ lɛ naa. No ahã nyɛnyɛ nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ ni nyɛto nyɛtsui shi kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ nɔ fɛ nɔ mli.
Ni nyɛdaa Tsɛ lɛ shi, mɔ ni hã wɔfee mɛi ni sa krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ La lɛ mli lɛ agboshinii lɛ eko yeli.
Ni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ duŋ hewalɛ lɛ mli kɛtee esuɔmɔ Bi lɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ;
lɛ emli wɔna kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ ni ji wɔhe eshai faa lɛ yɛ.
Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni anaaa lɛ subaŋ, lɛji bɔɔnii fɛɛ ateŋ kromɔbi lɛ.

Ejaakɛ emli abɔ nii fiaa yɛ, nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nii ni anaa kɛ nii ni anaaa, maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii jio, nɔyelii jio, onukpayelii jio, hegbɛi jio, nii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enɔ atsɔ̃ abɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ abɔ ahã.
Eyɛ dani nii fiaa yɔɔ, ni emli nii fiaa yɔɔ.
Ni lɛji gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ji asafo lɛ yitso, lɛji shishijee lɛ, gbohii ateŋ kromɔbii lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ nii fiaa mli.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esu muu lɛ fɛɛ ahi emli.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ esɛŋmɔtso nɔ lá lɛ nɔ ekɛ hejɔlɛ ba, ni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kpãtã, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Nyɛ ni sa ni yɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ kɛ nyɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ɔji nyɛ.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele nɔ ekpãtã nyɛ ni ekɛ nyɛ edamɔ shi akɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni he bɛ kpa ko ni sane ko bɛ amɛhe yɛ ehiɛ.

Shi esa ni nyɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ shishitoo lɛ nɔ ni nyɛkatsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ he, Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛnu ni ashiɛɔ atsɔ̃ɔ bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi, ni mi Paulo misɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ mimiishɛɔ yɛ minanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛ hewɔ lɛ amli, ni mikɛ miheloo naa Kristo amɛnehului ni shwɛ lɛ mikɛwoɔ amɛ obɔ̃ hã egbɔmɔtso ni ji esafo lɛ.
Ni mitsɔ̃ esafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ nitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etu ewo midɛŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ kɛwula shi lɛ.
Enɛ ji teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ teteete kɛ yinɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ ahã amɛle nɔ ni ji nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ anumnyam falɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ. Teemɔ sane nɛɛ ji akɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛmli koni nyɛna anumnyam lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ehe sane wɔjajeɔ, ni wɔwoɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ŋaa, ni ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ nilee nɛɛ fɛɛ, koni akɛ mɔ ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo mli.
No he deŋme migboɔ ni mipleɔ yɛ ehewalɛ ni tsuɔ nii kɛ hewalɛ yɛ mimli lɛ naa.
2: Ejakɛ miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle nɔ plemɔ ni mli wa ni mipleɔ yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi abɔ ni enako mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ahewɔ.
Miifee enɛ koni amɛtsɛ amɛtsui amɛŋmɛ amɛmli ni amɛfee ekome yɛ suɔmɔ mli ni amɛna hewalɛ falɛ fɛɛ ni anaa kɛjɛɔ niiashinamɔ mli lɛ ni amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ ni ji Kristo.
Mɔ mli ni akɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee jwetrii lɛ fɛɛ etee yɛ lɛ.
Shi mikɛɛ enɛ, koni mɔ ko kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko akashishiu nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ mikɛ nyɛ bɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli po, mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni mimiishɛɔ kɛ mikwɛ bɔ ni nyɛdamɔ shi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ nyɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ shifimɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni nyɛhere Kristo Yesu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ atuu lɛ, nyɛnyiɛa yɛ emli.
Ni nyɛshishifã amɔ̃ shi ni atswa nyɛ ama enɔ ni nyɛfi shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ ni nyɛteke nɔ kɛ shidaa.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahīa, koni mɔ ko kɛ jeŋ nilee kɛ yaka shishiumɔ ni damɔ gbɔmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anɔ, shi jeee Kristo nɔ lɛ, akaŋɔ nyɛ nom.
Ejaakɛ Kristo mli Nyɔŋmɔ su muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso su mli;
ni nyɛye emuu yɛ emli, lɛ mɔ ni ji onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ yitso lɛ.
Lɛ emli aflɔ nyɛ ketia hu yɛ, jeee ketia ni akɛ nine fo, shi moŋ ketiafoo ni ji heloo gbɔmɔtso lɛ jiemɔ yɛ Kristo ketiafoo lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ afu nyɛ kɛ lɛ yɛ baptisimɔ lɛ mli; ni emli hu atee nyɛ shi yɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa.
Ni nyɛ ni nyɛji gbohii yɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛheloo foo lɛ mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ wala, ni ekɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa nyɛ.
Ni egbe wɔnyɔmɔ ni wɔhiɛ ni aŋma kɛ ekpɔi lɛ, ni ejie kɛtee, ni ekla ekpɛtɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he.
Ni ekplɔ onukpayelii kɛ hewalɛi lɛ ahe nii, ni ebɔ amɛ ahora faŋŋ, ni enyã yɛ amɛnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miikojoa nyɛ nyɛ niyeli loo ninumɔ loo gbii juji loo nyɔji heei loo hejɔɔmɔgbii agbɛfaŋ,
ejaakɛ nii ni baaba lɛ asusuma kɛkɛ ni, shi nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji Kristo.
Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ taomɔ ni etaoɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ aja ŋwɛi bɔfoi miishɔ̃ nyɛjuromɔnii lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ. Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni edamɔ ji ninai, ni eheloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hãa ewoɔ ehe nɔ eflo,
ni ehiɛɛɛ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ mli, mɔ mli ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔi kɛ fai lɛ anɔ enaa nii ni hīaa lɛ kɛjeɔ ni emumɔ̃ɔ ehe kɛshimɔ̃ɔ ehe nɔ kɛdaa bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛkɛ Kristo egbo ni je nɛɛŋ shishijeenii bɛ nyɛnɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ,, mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛhiɔ shi tamɔ nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kamɔ̃ lolo yɛ je nɛɛŋ, ni nyɛhãa awoɔ nyɛ akpɔi akɛ,
"Kaamɔ mli, ni kasaa onaa, ni kaata he tete" lɛ?
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ji nibii ni hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ amɛhe nitsumɔ mli; amɛji akpɔi ni awo yɛ gbɔmɛi akitãi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anaa.
Suɔmɔnaa jamɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɔtso yiwaa hãa nibii nɛɛ feɔ tamɔ nɔ ni nilee yɛ mli nɛ, shi yɛ heloo akɔnɔ naatsii gbɛfaŋ lɛ, ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
3: No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ atee nyɛ kɛ Kristo shi lɛ nyɛtaoa nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, he ni Kristo yɔɔ ni eta Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ yɛ lɛ.
Nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe nyɛjwɛŋa, jeee nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛgboi, ni akɛ nyɛwala lɛ kɛ Kristo etee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Bi ni Kristo, mɔ ni ji wɔwala lɛ, aaapue yɛ anumnyam mli.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛgbea nyɛhenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ: ajwamaŋbɔɔ, nyɛŋemɔ nitsumɔ, mlila, akɔnɔ fɔŋ, kɛ hiɛjoomɔ ni ji wɔŋjamɔ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa toigbelebii lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi amli nyɛ hu nyɛnyiɛ sa, be ni nyɛhi shi yɛ mli lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛshɛrɛa nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea: mlifu, mlila kɛ shwee ni ashewɔ mɔ efɔŋ, kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ hiɛgbejiawoemɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛdaaŋ.
Nyɛkamalemalea nyŋɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛjie gbɔmɔ momo lɛ kɛ enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ nyɛhe,
ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni aafee lɛ ehee yɛ ebɔlɔ lɛ subaŋ nɔ, koni ele lɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
Enɛ mli lɛ Helanyo kɛ Yudanyo, ketiafolɔ kɛ foolɔ, jekɔ̃nyo, nyɔŋ kɛ odehe ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ Kristo ji nii fiaa yɛ mɛi fɛɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii, mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ suɔmɔ mɛi ji nyɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛwoa musuŋ tsɔ̃lɛ, mlihilɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ , kpoofeemɔ, tsuishitoo.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko kɛ mɔ ko na sane ko lɛ, nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛfataa nyɛhe; tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu kɛfa nyɛ lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfea.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛwoa suɔmɔ ni ji kpãa ni fiɔ nibii fɛɛ feɔ lɛ ekome ni ehãa eyeɔ emuu lɛ.
Ni nyɛhãa Kristo hejɔlɛ lɛ ayea lumɔ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli; nɔ he ni atsɛ nyɛ kɛba yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli lɛ. Ni nyɛlea shidaa.

Nyɛhãa Kristo wiemɔ lɛ ahia nyɛmli babaoo; ni nyɛkɛ nilee fɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛhe nii ni nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, ni nyɛkɛ shidaa alaa yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ yɛ wiemɔ loo nitsumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛfea fɛɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, ni nyɛtsɔ̃a enɔ nyɛdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Tsɛ lɛ shi.
Nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛwumɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, ni nyɛmli akajoa yɛ amɛnɔ.
Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; ejaakɛ no sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, koni amɛnijiaŋ akaje wui.
Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛŋfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ amɛsa, shi moŋ yɛ tsui krɔŋŋ mli akɛ mɛi ni sheɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛmusuŋ nyɛtsua, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛtsuɔ nyɛhã ni jeee gbɔmɛi,
ni nyɛle akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ nyɛnine baashɛ gboshinii lɛ anɔ yɛ akɛ nyɛyɔmɔwo.Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Kristo nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ.
Shi mɔ ni feɔ nii ni ejaakɛ gbɛ lɛ, nii ni ejaaa gbɛ nɔŋŋ he nyɔmɔwo eeena, ni hiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛŋ.
4: Nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛkɛ nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni sa pɛ ahãa nyɛtsuji lɛ, ni nyɛlea akɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli, ni nyɛshia kpe yɛ mli kɛ shidaa.
Ni nyɛsaa nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ agble gbɛ ahã wɔ hã wiemɔ lɛ, ni wɔwie Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ, nɔ hewɔ hu ni mikã kpãa mli nɛɛ.
Nyɛsɔlea koni majie no shi faŋŋ bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ.
Nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nilee mli yɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛtsu nyɛbe he nii.
Nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ he abaa nyam daaa ni ŋoo ahi mli, ni nyɛle bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛhãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hetoo.
Tihiko, ni ji suɔmɔ nyɛmi kɛ anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ naanyo tsulɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, aaagba nyɛ mihe saji fɛɛ.
Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni nyɛle bɔ ni wɔyɔɔ, ni eshɛje nyɛmii.
Mitsu lɛ kɛ Onesimo ni ji anɔkwa kɛ suɔmɔ nyɛmi ni jɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ; amɛaagba nyɛ biɛ saji fɛɛ.
Aristarko, minaanyo gboklɛfonyo lɛ, miibi nyɛ; kɛ Marko ni ji Barnaba nyɛmi bi(mɔ ni miwo nyɛ shi yɛ ehe akɛ nyɛhere lɛ atuu kɛ eba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ)
Yoshua ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yutso lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, miibi nyɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi pɛ ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ ni atsɔ̃mɔ tsuiwoo ehã mi.
Epafra ni jɛ nyɛteŋ ni ji Kristo tsulɔ ni daa nɛɛ ekɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ hiɛ sɔlemɔi amli waa kɛhã nyɛ, koni nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ mɛi ni eye emuu ni amɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii fɛɛ feemɔ lɛ, miibi nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ miiye ehe odase akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ naakpa yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Hierappoli lɛ ahe.
Luka, tsofatsɛ ni asumɔɔ lɛ kɛ Dema miibi nyɛ.
Wɔmiibi nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea lɛ, kɛ Nimfa kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ.
Kɛ akane nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa akanea yɛ Laodikea asafo lɛ mli hu, ni nyɛ hu nyɛkane nɔ ni jɛ Laodikea lɛ.
Ni nyɛkɛa Arkipo akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ ni ogbe sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atu awo odɛŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ naa kwraa!"
Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni miŋma nɛ.Nyɛkaia mikɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ!Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!

1: Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛba, ni ebasa Yerusalem maŋ lɛ yi.

Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã eye Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim nɔ kunim. Kɛkɛ ni emɔ Yehoiakim kɛ nomii komɛi hu, ni eloo Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nibii lɛ ekomɛi, ni ekɛ nomii lɛ kɛ nibii nɛɛ tee Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ nibii lɛ yawo enyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ mli nitoohe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã Ashpenaz, epiafonyonukpa ni fe fɛɛ lɛ, akɛ ehala Israelbii nomii lɛ ateŋ maŋtsɛmɛiabii lɛ kɛ abladei ashwiei lɛ ateŋ oblahii komɛi.

Esa akɛ oblahii nɛɛ ahe yɛ fɛo, kpa ko kpa ko akahi amɛgbɔmɔtsei ahe; amɛyɛ tsɔsemɔ, amɛyɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni amɛjwɛŋmɔŋ ka shi kɛhã nikasemɔ, koni atsɔse amɛ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli. Efã hu akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Babilonbii awiemɔ lɛ kɛ amɛwoloŋ hu.
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar to akɛ daa gbi lɛ ahã oblahii nɛɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniyenii kɛfɔkɛfɔ ni eyeɔ kɛ wain hu ni enuɔ lɛ eko. Ekɛɛ akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii afii etɛ̃; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ oblahii lɛ aba abatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Oblahii ni ahala lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Daniel kɛ Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛjɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli.
Piafonyonukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ wo oblahii ejwɛ nɛɛ gbɛii krokomɛi. Ewo Daniel Belteshazar, ni ewo Hanania Shadrak, ni ewo Mishael Meshak, ni ewo Azaria Abednego.
Shi Daniel tswa efai shi akɛ eyeŋ maŋtsɛ niyenii ni ewo fɔ lɛ, ni enuŋ maŋtsɛ wain lɛ hu koni ekabule ehe. No hewɔ lɛ ekpa Ashpenaz, piafonyonukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ, fai akɛ eŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ koni ekabule ehe.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã Ashpenaz hiɛ sɔ Daniel, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe.

Shi moŋ ekɛɛ Daniel akɛ, "Miishe gbeyei akɛ aleee nɔ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ ni eto niyenii kɛ wain ni ekɛhã nyɛ lɛ, baana akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei bɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ nyɛtipɛŋfoi oblahii krokomɛi lɛ agbɔmɔtsei. Enɛ aaahã miwala atɔ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Daniel kɛɛ mɔ ni piafonyonukpa lɛ efã akɛ ekwɛ lɛ Daniel lɛ kɛ Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria nɔ lɛ akɛ,
"Ofai nɛ, hã wɔ tsei ayibii kɛ baibai kɛkɛ koni wɔye kɛ nu flo hu kɛkɛ ni wɔnu kɛyashi biɛ gbii nyɔŋma koni okɛka wɔ, otsuji, okwɛ;
koni no sɛɛ lɛ okɛ wɔ ato oblahii ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ niyenii ni ewo fɔ lɛ ahe. Bɔ ni ooona lɛ odamɔ no nɔ koni ofee wɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ."
Nuu lɛ kplɛ̃ sane ni Daniel kɛfɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eka Daniel kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aniyenii hamɔ lɛ gbii nyɔŋma lɛ ekwɛ.
Gbii nyɔŋma lɛ sɛɛ lɛ ana akɛ Daniel kɛ enanemɛi lɛ ahiɛ efee fɛo, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei eshwishwii fe oblahii krokomɛi lɛ ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli niyenii kpakpai ni ewo fɔ lɛ agbɔmɔtsei.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkwɛlɔ lɛ shi niyenii kɛ wain ni ato akɛ akɛhã amɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni ehã amɛ tsei ayibii kɛ baibai lɛ kɛkɛ, ni amɛye.
Nyɔŋmɔ dro nɛkɛ oblahii ejwɛ nɛɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni amɛnyɛ amɛkase woloŋ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ. Yɛ Daniel gbɛfaŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hã enu ninaa fɛɛ ninaa kɛ lamɔ fɛɛ lamɔ hu shishi efata he.
Be ni be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ eto lɛ shɛ lɛ, Ashpenaz, piafonyo lɛ, kɛ oblahii lɛ fɛɛ tee Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hiɛ ekɛ amɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ wie, ni Daniel kɛ Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria ji mɛi ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ sɔ fe fɛɛ yɛ oblahii lɛ ateŋ. No hewɔ lɛ ehala amɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.
Nilee fɛɛ nilee kɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni maŋtɛ lɛ bi Daniel kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, ena akɛ amɛle nii shii nyɔŋma toi abɔ fe emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli shikpɔji lɛ anɔ ninalɔi kɛ ashwãifeelɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Daniel sɔ̃mɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli aahuu kɛyashi afi nɔ ni Persia Maŋtsɛ Koresh baye Babilon nɔ kunim lɛ.
2: Nebukadnezar maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ela lamɔi komɛi. Lamɔi nɛɛ hã etsui bɔ̃i yeli, ni wɔ tserɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã akɛ ayatsɛ ashwãifeelɔi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi ni yɔɔ Babilonbii ateŋ lɛ abaha lɛ koni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ elamɔi lɛ ashishi. Be ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ shɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ,
ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mila lamɔ ko, ni mitsui miiye akɛ male lamɔ lɛ shishi."
Amɛto he yɛ Aram wiemɔ mli akɛ, "Nii, oyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ! Jajemɔ lamɔ lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ, otsuji, ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ɔ bo shishi."

Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mibabi nyɛ ji akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a mi nɔ lamɔ ni mila lɛ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi hu. Kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ mahã atserɛ nyɛmli, ni aaahã nyɛshīai lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ tumu.

Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ lamɔ ni mila lɛ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ eshishi hu lɛ, no lɛ mibake nyɛ nibii babaoo; asaŋ mibawo nyɛhiɛ nyam hu jogbaŋŋ. Agbɛnɛ nyɛhiɛ nyam hu jogbaŋŋ. Agbɛnɛ nyɛtsɔa mi nɔ lamɔ ni mila lɛ kɛ eshishi hu."
Amɛha hetoo ekoŋŋ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Nii atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lamɔ lɛ, ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ eshishi."
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miina anɔkwale mli akɛ be kɛkɛ nyɛtaoɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛna faŋŋ akɛ miwo akpɔ akɛ

kɛji nyɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mi lamɔ lɛ, toigblamɔ kome kã shi hã nyɛ. Nyɛto nyɛyiŋ akɛ nyɛbaamale, ni nyɛbaashishiu mi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nibii aaatsake. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛtsɔa mi lamɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ no baahã male akɛ nyɛbaanyɛ eshishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ."

Babilonbii lɛ to he amɛhã Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar akɛ, "Nii, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ je nɛɛ mli ni ebaanyɛ bo osane nɛɛ naa etsɔ̃ɔ. Maŋtsɛ ko kwraa ehiko shi pɛŋ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni eje agbo ehã, ni ekɛ nɛkɛ sane efɔ̃ ashwãifeelɔi loo klamɔfoi loo ŋkunyaayelɔi loo Babilonbii ahiɛ dã.
Sane ni Nii Maŋtsɛ biɔ nɛɛ mli wa bɔ ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ naa etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ja wɔnyɔŋmɔi lɛ; ni nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ hu ashishilɛhe bɛ adesai ateŋ."
Hetoo nɛɛ hã Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar mli fu, ni emli wo la naakpa. Kɛkɛ ni efã akɛ agbe nilelɔi ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ he lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ awo akpɔ koni agbe nilelɔi lɛ. Atao Daniel kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ koni agbe amɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni Daniel kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ hiɛshikamɔ bi maŋtsɛ blafoiatsɛ ni egbɛi ji Ariok, mɔ ni afã lɛ koni egbe Babilon nilelɔi lɛ akɛ,
"Mɛni eba hewɔ ni Nii Maŋtsɛ ewo akpɔ ni naa wa nɛkɛ nɛɛ?" Ariok gba Daniel nɔ sane ni eba lɛ.
Daniel tee, ni eyakpa Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fai akɛ eto lɛ be, ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lamɔ ni ela lɛ shishi.
Daniel tee ewe lɛ, ni eyabɔ enanemɛi Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria amaniɛ;

ni ebi amɛ akɛ amɛsɔle amɛkpa Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ fai akɛ emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe; asaŋ amɛbi lɛ koni egbele teemɔŋ sane lɛ hiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe amɛ hu afata Babilonbii nilelɔi krokomɛi lɛ ahe.
Ajie teemɔŋ sane lɛ shishi atsɔ̃ɔ Daniel yɛ ninaa mli nyɔɔŋ, ni Daniel jie Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ yi.
Daniel wo enaa nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ dɛŋ ni nilee kɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ lɛ, yi kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ.
Lɛ etsakeɔ bei kɛ yinɔi lɛ; ekpaa maŋtsɛmɛi, ni etoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi. Lɛ edroɔ jwɛŋmɔ, ni edroɔ nilelɔi niiashishinumɔ;
ejieɔ saji ni mli kwɔlɔ kɛ nibii ni akɛtee kpo etsɔ̃ɔ; ele nii ni yɔɔ duŋ mli, ni he ni eyɔɔ lɛ jɛi la yɔɔ.
Mitsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ, miida bo shi, ni mijie oyi, ejaakɛ odro mi jwɛŋmɔ kɛ hewalɛ ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii ni wɔkpa bo ehe fai lɛ, ejaakɛ oha wɔle maŋtsɛ sane lɛ."

No hewɔ lɛ Daniel yiŋ etee Ariok, mɔ ni maŋtsɛ efã lɛ akɛ ekpãtã Babilon nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaakpãtã nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, shi moŋ okɛ mi aya maŋtsɛ ŋɔɔ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ elamɔ lɛ shishi."
Kɛkɛ ni Ariok nyiɛ Daniel hiɛ kɛtee Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hiɛ oya, ni Ariko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii Maŋtsɛ, miyana nuu ko yɛ Yudabii nomii lɛ ateŋ ni abaanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Nii Maŋtsɛ elamɔ lɛ shishi."
Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi Daniel ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belthazar hu akɛ, "Ani ooonyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi lamɔ ni mila lɛ kɛ eshishi hu?"
Daniel here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Nii, klamɔfonyo ko klamɔfonyo ko loo ashwãifeelɔ loo ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔ ko bɛ ni ebaanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ teemɔŋ sane ni Nii taoɔ lɛ.

Shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ ŋwɛi ni ejieɔ teemɔŋ nibii kpo etsɔ̃ɔ; ni lɛji mɔ ni ejie nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar lɛ. Lamɔ lɛ ni ola, ni ji ninaa ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ bo be ni okã osaa lɛ nɔ, lɛ nɛ,
"Be mli ni Nii Maŋtsɛ kã shi ni ewɔɔ lɛ, ela nibii ni baaba wɔsɛɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni jieɔ teemɔŋ nibii akpo lɛ miihã ole nɔ ni baaba lɛ.
Mi lɛ jeee minii ni mile fe adesai fɛɛ hewɔ ni ajie nɛkɛ teemɔŋ sane nɛɛ shi atsɔ̃ɔ mi; shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ɔ Nii; shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ɔ Nii, oyitsoŋ saji lɛ kɛ lamɔ ni ola lɛ shishi.
"Nii, olamɔ lɛ mli lɛ ona amãgã kpeteŋkple ko; amãgã nɛɛ da, ni eekpɛ waa, ni ema ohiɛ, ni kɛji ookwɛ lɛ ehe yɛ gbeyei naakpa.
Amãgã nɛɛ yitso lɛ akɛ shika fee; etsitsi kɛ eniji lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee, emusu kɛ ehɛ lɛ akɛ akɔɔble fee;
eshwuɔji lɛ akɛ dade fee, ni enaji lɛ fã dade kɛ fã hu su.
Ohiɛ amãgã nɛɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ ni tɛ ko ni jeee gbɔmɔ adesa nine ta he tse kɛjɛ he ko ni ebatswa amãgã lɛ nane dade fã kɛ su fã lɛ nɔ, ni ejwra naji lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni amãgã lɛ he dade lɛ kɛ su lɛ kɛ akɔɔble lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ hu fɛɛ tswɛm jwra wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni amɛfuflu, ni amɛtsɔ tamɔ ablenaashaji ni bua gbo abeleshaahe. Kɛkɛ ni kɔɔyɔɔ loo fɛɛ kɛtee, ni eshwɛɛɛ amɛhe nɔ ko nɔ ko. Shi tɛ lɛ ni batswa amãgã lɛ da, ni etsɔ̃ gɔŋ kpeteŋkple, ni ekple jeŋ fɛɛ.
"Lamɔ lɛ nɛ. Agbɛnɛ wɔɔtsɔ̃ɔ Nii lamɔ lɛ shishi.
Nii Maŋtsɛ, boji maŋtsɛmɛi amaŋtsɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, ni to bo nakai, ni edro bo hewalɛ kɛ agbojee kɛ anumnyam fɛɛ.
Ewo bo hei fɛɛ ni gbɔmɛi adesai kɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji yɔɔ lɛ nɔyelɔ. Amãgã lɛ shika yitso lɛ bo ni.
Bo osɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛyeli kroko aaate shi ni kɛ o yeee egbɔ; maŋtsɛyeli ko hu ni ji etɛ̃ baaba abaye nɔ. Ekadi ji akɔɔble lɛ; ni eeeye je lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛyeli ni baafee ejwɛ lɛ he baawa tamɔ dade. Bɔ ni dade jwraa, ni egblɛɔ nibii fɛɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ baajwra, ni ebaagblɛ nibii fɛɛ.

Bɔ ni ona amãgã lɛ naji kɛ waabii lɛ ni fã lɛ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ su ni, ni fã kroko lɛ dade ni lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli baagba; ni dade hewalɛ lɛ eko baahi emli kɛ̃, tamɔ bɔ ni ona dade kɛ su ni akpɔtɔ lɛ afutu lɛ.
Bɔ ni enine waabii lɛ fã ko dade ni fã ko hu su lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ fã ko he baawa, ni fã ko hu he woŋ.
Bɔ ni ona dade ni efutu su ni akpɔtɔ mli lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi lɛ awekui srɔtoi lɛ kɛ amɛhe baabote gblãshihilɛ mli moŋ nɛ; shi no tsaŋ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni dade nyɛɛɛ ekɛ su atsa lɛ.

Maŋtsɛyelii nɛɛ amli maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ayinɔi amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ baatee maŋtsɛyeli ko ni sɛɛ efoŋ dɔŋŋ shi ema shi. Maŋ ko maŋ ko nyɛŋ enɔ kunim eye. Ebaakpãtã maŋtsɛyelii nɛɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ butuu, ni amɛnɔyeli lɛ asɛɛ aaafo; shi lɛ lɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ baama shi kɛaatee naanɔ.

Bɔ ni ona tɛ ko ni jeee gbɔmɔ adesa nine ni kpɔ lɛ kɛjɛ gɔŋ ko he, ni ebafuflu ãmãgã ni akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble kɛ su kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ ejie nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo, Nii. Lamɔ ni migba Nii nɛɛ, eji anɔkwale; ni eshishi ni mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hu yɛ mli nyɔŋma shiishi."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni eja Daniel, ni efã akɛ ashã afɔle kɛ tsofãkɛŋma ahã Daniel.
Ekɛɛ Daniel akɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ ni fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ anuŋtsɔ lɛ; ni lɛ ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo, ejaakɛ onyɛ ojie nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ kpo."
Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar wo Daniel nɔ, ni ehã lɛ gbɛnaa grɔŋŋ, ni efee lɛ Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔkwɛlɔ, asaŋ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he ŋaawolɔi lɛ fɛɛ anukpa yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ.
Daniel bi maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego eto Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ; shi Deniel lɛ, lɛ lɛ ehi maŋtsɛwe lɛ.
3: Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hã afee shika amãgã ko ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi ekpaa. Afee amãgãi nɛɛ ama shi yɛ Dura ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã akɛ atsu koni atsɛ maŋ nitsulɔi blublu kɛba: amraloi kɛ lumɛi kɛ amraloi asɛɛmɛi kɛ akutsei anɔkwɛlɔi, kɛ maŋtsɛ he ŋaawolɔi kɛ kojolɔi kɛ nitoohei anɔkwɛlɔi, kɛ kpokpai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nitsulɔi koni amɛbaye amãgã lɛ naagbelemɔ kɛ ekpojiemɔ lɛ he odase.

Amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi asɛɛmɛi lɛ kɛ akutsei anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ he ŋaawolɔi lɛ kɛ kojolɔi kɛ nitoohei anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ kpokpai lɛ anɔ nitsulɔi lɛ fɛɛ ba amãgã ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ehã afee lɛ naagbelemɔ kɛ ekpojiemɔ lɛ. Be ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ eyabua shi yɛ amãgã lɛ hiɛ lɛ,
sɔ̃ɔlɔ ko bo waa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Shikpɔji kɛ maji srɔtoi anɔ bii kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛwieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ,

nyɛbaanu tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛmɔ he, kɛkɛ lɛ koofɛŋ kɛ saŋku kɛ ketekɛ obenta kɛ beji kɛ lalai srɔtoi baagbɛɛ kɛnyiɛ sɛɛ. Lalai lɛ he ni nyɛaanu nɔŋŋ lɛ, nyɛkulaa shi nyɛjaa amãgã lɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar efee ema shi lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kulaaa shi koni eja amãgã lɛ, nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ abaashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri mli."
No hewɔ lɛ amrɔ pɛ ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ nu koofɛŋ kɛ saŋku kɛ kete kɛ benta kɛ bɛji kɛ lalai srɔtoi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ, amɛho amɛkula shi, ni amɛja shika amãgã ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛma shi lɛ.
Babilonbii komɛi tsɔ̃ amãgã nɛɛ jamɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfo Yudafoi lɛ anaa.
Amɛyakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar akɛ, "Nii yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ.
Nii, bɛ owo akpɔ akɛ be fɛɛ be ni tɛtrɛmantrɛi kɛ koofɛŋ kɛ bɛji kɛ saŋkui kɛ obentai kɛ lalai srɔtoi lɛ aaagbɛɛ pɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akula shi koni eja shika amãgã lɛ,
ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kulaaa shi koni eja lɛ lɛ, abaashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri mli?
Yudafoi lɛ ni oŋɔ amɛ oto Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ yeee okpɔ nɛɛ nɔ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego."
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ mlifu kɛ mlila fã akɛ ayaŋɔ Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego kɛba; ni ayaŋɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego, ani eyɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ nyɛsɔmɔ̃ɔɔ minyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni nyɛjaaa shika amãgã lɛ ni mifee mima shi lɛ lo?

Agbɛnɛ kɛji nyɛfee kralo nyɛto akɛ kɛji nyɛnu koofɛŋ lɛ kɛ blɛ kɛ saŋku kɛ kete kɛ obenta kɛ lalai srɔtoi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ, nyɛaaho nyɛkula shi, ni nyɛja amãgã ni mifee lɛ, belɛ no lɛ sane etã. Shi kɛji nyɛjaaa lɛ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ abaashɛrɛ nyɛ ashwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri lɛ mli! Mɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ aaanyɛ nyɛyiwala ahere yɛ mi midɛŋ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar akɛ, "Nii, ehīaaa akɛ wɔhã nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ hetoo.
Kɛji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ehere wɔ yɛ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri lɛ mli lɛ, ebaahere wɔ; ni ebaahere wɔ yɛ odɛŋ hu.
Shi kɛji ehereee wɔ po, Nii, na ole akɛ wɔsɔmɔŋ onyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni wɔjaŋ shika amãgã ni ofee oma shi lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar mli wo la fe nine, ni ehiɛ tsake ewo Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego. Amrɔ nɔŋŋ pɛ ni efã akɛ awo flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli la koni edɔ toi kpawo fe bɔ ni ahãa edɔɔ daa lɛ.
Efã asraafoi hewalɔi komɛi hu akɛ amɛfimɔ Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego koni amɛyashɛrɛ amɛ amɛshwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni tsoɔ grigri lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ afimɔ amɛ kɛ amɛheboi kɛ flakai kɛ faii kɛ atadei krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni ashɛrɛ amɛ amɛshwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la grigri lɛ mli.
Akɛni yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ naa lɛ ahã flɔnɔɔ lɛ edɔ waa naakpa hewɔ lɛ, flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli lalilɛii lɛ gbe hii lɛ ni hole gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛyawo flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi etɛ̃, ni ji Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego, nɛɛ yashwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni tsoɔ grigri lɛ mli bɔ ni afimɔ amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.

Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar naa kpɛ ehe, ni ete shi oya, ni ebi ejina foi lɛ akɛ, "Ani jeee gbɔmɛi etɛ̃ wɔfimɔ ni wɔshɛrɛ amɛ wɔshwie la lɛ mli lɛ?" Ajinafoi lɛ here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii, nakai ni."
Nebukadnezar kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miina gbɔmɛi ejwɛ yɛ la lɛ mli. Afimɔko amɛ, ni la lɛ efeee amɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni mɔ ni gbe yi fee ejwɛ lɛ, su tamɔ bɔfo."

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar tsi bɛŋkɛ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la grigri lɛ naa. Kɛkɛ ni ewo enaa nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego, Nyɔŋmɔ ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ tsuji, nyɛjea kpo yɛ la lɛ mli kɛbaa." Kɛkɛ ni Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego je kpo yɛ la lɛ mli kɛba.

Amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ akutsei anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ajinafoi lɛ bua amɛhe naa koni amɛbakwɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ. Amɛyiteŋ tsɔi ŋlãko lɛ, amɛtadei lɛ he ko eshãko lɛ, lasu tete po ejeee fu yɛ amɛhe.

Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛɛ akɛ, "Ajie Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, ejaake etsu ebɔfo, ni ebahere etsuji lɛ ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ enɔ lɛ kɛje gbele mli. Amɛtse mifãmɔ lɛ hiɛ atua, ni amɛkã kitã akɛ nɔ ni amɛaaja he ko bii anyɔŋmɔ fe amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ amɛkɛ amɛwala moŋ baatse.

"No hewɔ lɛ miiwo akpɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Abednego Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ he wiemɔ fɔŋ ko lɛ, he fɛɛ he maŋ loo shikpɔŋ nɔ ni mɔ lɛ jɛ, loo wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni mɔ lɛ wieɔ lɛ, atserɛ egbɔmɔtso mli mɛnyɛmɛnyɛ, asaŋ afiti ashiã hu koni jɛi atsɔ tumu. Amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko kwraa bɛ dɔŋŋ ni baanyɛ ehere gbɔmɔ yiwala tamɔ nɛkɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hã Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego gbɛnaa yɛ Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ.
4: Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋma eyahã mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ majimaji kɛ jakui fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nu, yɛ amɛwiemɔi amli akɛ, "Nyɛhea omanye!
Esa mihiɛ akɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, efee yɛ mihe lɛ magba nyɛ.
"Kwɛ bɔ ni okadii ni Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ tsiitsii hã. Kwɛ bɔ ni enifeemɔ nii yɔɔ naakpɛɛ naakpa. Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni, ni ejɛɔ yinɔ kɛyaa yinɔ!
"Mi, Nebukadnezar, miyɛ hejɔlɛ yɛ mishīa lɛ mli, ni miishwere yɛ mimɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli hu.
Shi mila lamɔ ko ni wo mihe gbeyei, ejaakɛ nibii ni mina yɛ lamɔ lɛ mli, be mli ni mikã shi miwɔ lɛ, yɛ gbeyei.
No hewɔ lɛ mifã akɛ atsɛ nilelɔi ni yɔɔ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛba mihiɛ, koni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ mi lamɔ lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni klamɔfoi lɛ kɛ ashwãifeelɔi lɛ kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi lɛ bashɛ mihiɛ. Migba amɛ lamɔ lɛ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ mi lamɔ lɛ shishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Be ni yi yaawula shi lɛ, Daniel, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belteshazar tamɔ bɔ ni atsɛɔ minyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɔɔ emli lɛ ba mihiɛ, ni migba lɛ lamɔ ni mila lɛ. Mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
'Belteshazar, klalɔi fɛɛ atsɛ, mile akɛ nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɛ omli, ni teemɔŋ sane ko teemɔŋ sane ko waaa hãaa bo; lamɔ ni mila lɛ nɛ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi eshishi:'
"Nɔ ni mina yɛ ninaa lɛ mli, yɛ wɔ lɛ mli, ji tso kpeteŋkple ko ni ma je lɛ teŋ. Tso nɛɛ kwɔ naakpa.
Tso lɛ wo dalɛ nɔ, ni ekwɔ kɛtee kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi bɔ ni anaa lɛ yɛ je lɛ mli he fɛɛ he.
Eyi bai yɛ fɛo, ni ewo yibii babaoo, ni mɛi fɛɛ naa eko amɛyeɔ. Ŋaŋ kooloi yabumɔɔ ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli, ni loofɔji hiɔ eniji lɛ anɔ; ni no gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ yeɔ.
"Mina yɛ ninaa lɛ mli ni bɔfo sralɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko jɛ ŋwɛi kpleke shi.

Ebo waa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛtoa tso lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a shi, ni nyɛflɔa eniji lɛ; nyɛkpaa eyi bai lɛ nyɛshwiea shi, ni nyɛgbɛa eyibii lɛ nyɛshwãa koni ŋaŋ kooloi lɛ ajo foi yɛ shishi aya, ni loofɔji lɛ hu aje eniji lɛ anɔ aya.
Shi ashi etsoku kɛ eshishifãi lɛ yɛ su lɛ mli; akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ afi tsoku lɛ yɛ ŋanɔ jwɛi fɔ lɛ mli. Ŋwɛi bɔ anyɔ enɔ; egbɛfaŋnɔ ayaje ŋaŋ kooloi ateŋ yɛ jwɛiaŋ koni ekɛ amɛ ahi shi.
Ebaaye afii kpawo, ni abaatsake egbɔmɔ adesa jweŋmɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ, ni abaahä lɛ kooloo jwɛŋmɔ.

Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ŋwɛi sralɔi lɛ ekpɛ mli ehã, ni mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu kɛ amɛ kpãa gbee nakai nɔŋŋ, koni adesai fɛɛ kɛna amɛle akɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, eyɛ hewalɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔyeli fɛɛ nɔyeli nɔ, asaŋ akɛ eŋɔɔ hewalɛ ehãa mɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ, ni ekɛ gbɔmɛi amliwoo tete po taa maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i nɔ.'

"Lamɔ ni mi, Nebukadnezar mila nɛ; agbɛnɛ, Belteshazar, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi shishi, ejaakɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli nilelɔi fɛɛ nyɛɛɛ eshishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi, shi bo lɛ obaanyɛ, ejaakɛ nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɛ omli."

Daniel ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belteshazar hu lɛ he jɔ̃ ehe be kplaŋŋ, ni ehao. Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Belteshazar, kaahã lamɔ lɛ loo eshishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ miihao bo." Belteshazar here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, mina ni kulɛ lamɔ nɛɛ kɛ eshishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɔɔ ohenyɛlɔi ahe, shi jeee bo.
Tso lɛ ni ona ni eda mlɛmlɛ, ni ekwɔ kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, anaa lɛ yɛ je lɛ mli hei fɛɛ.
Eyi baa yɛ fɛo, ni ewo yibii babaoo, ni mɛi naa eko amɛyeɔ, ni ŋaŋ kooloi yabumɔɔ ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli, ni loofɔji hiɔ eniji lɛ anɔ.
"Nii, boji nakai tso lɛ. Bo lɛ oda, ni ohe wa. Oda aahuu kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi, ni ohewalɛ miiye je lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

Nii Maŋtsɛ, ookwɛ ninaa lɛ kɛkɛ ni bɔfo sralɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko jɛ ŋwɛi kpleke shi. Ekɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Nyɛtoa tso lɛ koni afite lɛ! Shi ashi eshishifã kɛ etsoku yɛ su lɛ mli. Akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ afi tsoku lɛ, ni ashi lɛ yɛ ŋanɔ jwɛfɔ mli koni bɔ anyɔ enɔ, ni ehi ŋaŋ kooloi ateŋ yɛ jwɛiiaŋ kɛyashi afii kpawo.'
"Nii, ninaa lɛ shishi nɛ; ni no ji yiŋ ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ eto yɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ he.

Abaashwie bo kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni obaaya oyahi ŋaŋ kolooi ateŋ, ni obaakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina. Ŋwɛi bɔ baanyɔ onɔ yɛ jwɛiaŋ, afii kpawo, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, yɛ hewalɛ yɛ adesa maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɔ; asaŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ, lɛ ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli hãa.
Akɛ bɔfo sralɔ lɛ fã akɛ ashi tsoku kɛ eshishifã lɛ yɛ su lɛ mli lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ obaaku sɛɛ obaye omaŋtsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ, kɛji ona oyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ, mɔ ŋaa ni mawo bo nɛɛ mli. Kpa eshafeemɔ koni ofee nɔ ni ja. Naa ohiafoi amɔbɔ akɛ aleenɔ no aaahã ohe ajɔ bo lo."
Enɛ fɛɛ ná ba Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nɔ.
Lamɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ nyɔjinyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, be ni Nebukadnezar miishera shi yɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ we lɛ yiteŋ lɛ
ekɛɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ Babilon maŋ nɛɛ dalɛ. Mikɛ mihewalɛ tswa lɛ ma shi akɛ maŋtsɛ maŋ; ni eeye mihewalɛ lɛ kɛ agbojee he odase."
Maŋtsɛ lɛ naa enyɔ̃ɔɔ shi, ni gbee ko gbɛɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar, bo nɔ ni mikɛɔ bo nɛɛ toi! Ashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛŋ;

asaŋ aaashwie bo kɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ kɛya ŋaŋ kooloi ateŋ koni okɛ amɛ ayahi shi. Obaakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina afii kpawo, ni ooona oyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, yɛ hewalɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi amaŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɔ, asaŋ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli hãa."

Nɔ ni gbee lɛ wie lɛ ba mli yɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nɔ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ashwie lɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni ekpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina. Ŋwɛi bɔ nyɔ egbɔmɔtso nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eyi tsɔi tsa kusuu tamɔ okropɔŋ tsɛji, ni ewaabii anaa tsa oookɛɛ looflɔ waabii anaa.

Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar he sane wolo lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Afii kpawo sɛɛ lɛ, mi, Nebukadnezar, miwo mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛ ŋwɛi kɛ heshwamɔ. Kɛkɛ ni mijwɛŋmɔ ku sɛɛ eba mimli ekoŋŋ, ni mihiɛ tserɛ mi. Kɛkɛ ni mikafo Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, ni miwo mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam; ejaakɛ, Lɛ ebaaye nɔ kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi jeee fɛifɛi yɛ ehiɛ, ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ adesai fɛɛ yɛ eshishi. Mɔ ko nyɛŋ enine etswa efɔ̃, loo eeebi lɛ akɛ, 'Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ?"

"Be ni mihiɛ etserɛ mi sɛɛ lɛ, woo ni awoɔ mi kɛ migbojee kɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ he anumnyam te shi ekoŋŋ. Misɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ tao misɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛhere mi atuu akɛ maŋtsɛ ekoŋŋ. Amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ hewalɛ lɛ wo midɛŋ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbu mi akɛ lumɔ fe tsutsu lɛ po.
"No hewɔ lɛ mi, Nebukadnezar miijie Ŋwɛi Maŋtsɛ lɛ yi, ni miiwo lɛ, ni miiwo ehiɛ nyam. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ hi, ni eja hu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ, enyɛɔ ebaa mɔ lɛ shi."
5: Gbi ko lɛ Maŋtsɛ Belshazar tsɛ enukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpe okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple ko, ni ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ nu dãa kutuu.

Be mi ni anuɔ dãa lɛ, Belshazar fã akɛ ayahole shika kɛ jwɛitɛi kpuji lɛ ni etsɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yaloo yɛ Yerusalem Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛba, koni lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ enukpai lɛ kɛ eŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ehemɛi lɛ kɛnu dãa.
Kɛkɛ ni ayahole shika kpuji lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kpuji lɛ ni ayaloo yɛ Yerusalem Sɔlemɔwe, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli lɛ kɛba. Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ kɛ eŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ehemɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛnu dãa,
Be ni amɛnuɔ dãa lɛ, amɛkafo nyɔŋmɔi ni akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ tso kɛ tɛ efee lɛ fɛɛ.

Be ni amɛta niyeniiashi lɛ, trukaa lɛ gbɔmɔ nine je kpo, ni ebaŋma nii yɛ asa lɛ gbogbo lɛ he, he ni akɛ kaaloo esha lɛ, yɛ kanetso ni ma shi lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Maŋtsɛ Belshazar miikwɛ nine lɛ be ni eŋmãa nii lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ tsake amrɔ, ni etsui fã, ni eshe gbeyei bɔ sɔŋŋ ni etalɔiaŋ jɔ biɛɛ, ni enakutsei kpokpo.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ bo waa akɛ ayaŋɔ ashwãifeelɔi lɛ kɛ klalɔi lɛ kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi lɛ abahã lɛ. Be ni Babilon nilelɔi nɛɛ ba lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ni baanyɛ gbogbo nɛɛ he niŋmãa nɛɛ ekane, ni asaŋ etsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi lɛ, abaawula lɛ kɛ lumɔ atade afaseo kɛ shika kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ kuɛnii. Ebaatsɔ̃ nɔyelɔ ni ji etɛ̃ yɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ nilelɔi lɛ fɛɛ ka niŋmãa lɛ kanemɔ kɛ eshishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ.
Sane lɛ hao Maŋtsɛ Belshazar naakpa, ni ehã ehiɛ tsake. Ehe onukpai lɛ hu fee yaa.

Wiemɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ wieɔ yɛ asa lɛ nɔ lɛ hã jɛi fee hoo. Enɛ hã maŋnyɛ lɛ ba okplɔ̃ŋmɛɛ asa lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋnyɛ lɛ wo enaa nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nii, oyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ! Kaahao, ni kaahã nɔ ko miigba onaa.

Nuu ko yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli ni nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɔɔ emli. Otsɛ yinɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ jie hiɛshikamɔ kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpo tamɔ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ anilee yɔɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ otsɛ, Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar, wo lɛ woloŋlelɔi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ ashwãifeelɔi kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi fɛɛ anukpa.

Enilee lɛ naa wa jagbaŋŋ. Ehiɛ kã shi, ni ele nii bɔ ni enyɛɔ lamɔi kɛ ajenui kɛ teemɔŋ saji fɛɛ ashishi etsɔ̃ɔ. No hewɔ lɛ hã ayaŋɔ nuu nɛɛ ni egbɛi ji Daniel, ni otsɛ wo lɛ Belteshazar lɛ, kɛba. Ebaanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo niŋmãa lɛ shishi."
Ayaŋɔ Daniel oya abahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji Daniel lɛ, Yudabii nomii ni mitsɛ yaŋɔ kɛjɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ?
Minu ohe akɛ nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ naa wa naakpa; anaa akɛ ohiɛ kã shi, ni ole nii, ni oyɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu pam.
Mikpee nilelɔi kɛ ashwãifeelɔi nɛɛ kɛba biɛ koni amɛbakane nɛkɛ niŋmãa nɛɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi; shi amɛnyɛɛɛ niŋmãa lɛ shishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.

Minu ohe akɛ onyɛɔ onaa teemɔŋ nibii, ni otsɔ̃ɔ shishi. Kɛji ooonyɛ niŋmãa nɛɛ okane koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi lɛ, abaawula bo kɛ lumɔ atade afaseo kɛ shika kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ kuɛnii, ni obaatsɔ̃ nɔyelɔ ni ji etɛ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
Daniel here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nii, nikeenii lɛ ahi shi koni okɛhã mɔ kroko. Shi kɛ̃lɛ mibakane niŋmãa lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Nii, koni matsɔ̃ɔ Nii eshishi hu.
"Nii Maŋtsɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ hã otsɛ Nebukadnezar tsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ wulu ni yɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ agbojee kɛ anumnyam kpeteŋkple;

ni agbojee ni adro lɛ naa hewɔ lɛ shikpɔji kɛ asafoi kɛ wiemɔi stɔtoi anɔ bii bluublu sheɔ lɛ gbeyei, ni mɛi ahe kpokpoɔ yɛ ehiɛ. Mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ egbe lɛ lɛ, egbeɔ lɛ, ni mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ehi wala mli lɛ, ehãa ehiɔ wala mli. Mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ewo enɔ lɛ, ewoɔ enɔ; ni mɔ hu ni esumɔɔ akɛ eba lɛ shi lɛ, ebaa lɛ shi.
Shi be ni ewo ehe nɔ, ni ekpliŋ etsui, ni etsɛ ehe lɛ, akpa lɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni enumnyam lɛ bɔ lɛ.

Ashwie lɛ kɛje adesai ateŋ; ejwɛŋmɔ tsɔ̃ tamɔ kooloo jwɛŋmɔ, ni eyahi ŋaŋ tejii ateŋ, ni ekpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina. Ŋwɛi bɔ nyɔ egbɔmɔtso nɔ aahuu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, eyɛ hewalɛ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɔ, ni mɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, lɛ maŋtsɛ ewoɔ.
"Bo Belshazar, Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar bi lɛ, ole sane nɛɛ fɛɛ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ obaaa ohe shi;

shi moŋ owo ohe nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ. Otee oyaloo kpuji kɛ okpolui ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ kɛba, ni bo kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ oŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ohemɛi lɛ kɛbanu dãa. Enɛ sɛɛ hu lɛ nyɛjie wɔji srɔtoi ni akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ tso kɛ tɛ efee lɛ ayi, nibii ni amɛnãaa nii, ni amɛnuuu nii, ni amɛleee nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ yi. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni lɛ edɛŋ owala kɛ oyaakɛbaa fɛɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ojieee lɛ moŋ eyi.
No hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu nine nɛɛ, ni ebaŋma nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ.
"Ni nii ni aŋma lɛ nɛ, 'MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN.' Niŋmãa lɛ shishi ji akɛ, 'Akane, akane, aŋmɛ akwɛ, ni aja mli'.
Wiemɔi lɛ ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ diɛŋtsɛ nɛ: 'Akane,' lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ekane omaŋtsɛyeli gbii lɛ; oye omle otã.
'Aŋmɛ akwɛ' lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ aŋmɛ bo yɛ nsɛni mli akwɛ, ni ana akɛ otsiimɔ shɛɛɛ nɔ ko;
ni 'aja mli' lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ aja omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni akɛhã Medianbii lɛ kɛ Persiabii lɛ."
Maŋtsɛ Belshazar fã amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, akɛ awulu Daniel kɛ lumɔ atade afaseo, kɛ shika kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ kuɛnii hu; asaŋ ashiɛ akɛ Daniel ji nɔyelɔ ni ji etɛ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ agbe Babilon Maŋtsɛ Belshazar;
ni Dario, Medianyo lɛ, ŋɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ. Nakai be mli lɛ Dario eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ.
6: Esa Maŋtsɛ Daroi hiɛ, ni eto amraloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ akɛ amɛkwɛ emaŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Eto maŋ onukpai nɔkwɛlɔi wuji etɛ̃ hu koni amraloi lɛ abu amɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ ahe akɔŋtaa, bɔ ni afee ni maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ ko hiɛ akakpãtã. Onukpãi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji Daniel.
Daniel mumɔ kɛ emɔdɛŋbɔɔ naa wa, ni ana akɛ ehe esa fe onukpai krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ to eyiŋ akɛ ebaaŋɔ Daniel eto emaŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni onukpai nɔkwɛlɔi krokomɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ amɛaana tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ Daniel he lo, koni amɛkɛflɔ enaa. Shi akɛni Daniel yeɔ anɔkwa hewɔ lɛ amɛ naaa sane ko loo tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, 'Wɔnaŋ sane ko sane ko wɔkɛshi nɛkɛ Daniel nɛɛ akɛ ja yɛ e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ mla lɛ gbefaŋ kɛkɛ wɔɔna eko yɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ Dario yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!

Nii, wɔ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli onukpai nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ akutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ ajinafoi lɛ, wɔtee ajina, ni wɔkpɛ mli akɛ Nii, awo akpɔ ko, ni akwɛ akɛ aye akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Akpɔ nɛɛ afee akɛ kɛyaashi gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baashi bo, Nii, osɛɛ, ni esɔle ebi nyɔŋmɔ ko loo gbɔmɔ adesa ko dɛŋ nɔ ko lɛ, ashɛ nakai mɔ lɛ afɔ̃ jatai abu lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ, Nii Maŋtsɛ, ofai nɛ ni owo akpɔ nɛɛ, ni aŋmã awo woloŋ, ni osɔo naa koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ Mediabii kɛ Persiabii amla ni atsakeee hiɛ lɛ."
Maŋtsɛ Dario hã aŋmã akpɔ lɛ awo woloŋ, ni esɔo naa.

Be ni Daniel na ele akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ enine ewo akpɔ ni aŋmã lɛ shishi lɛ, eyiŋ etee ewe. Eŋwɛi pia lɛ he samfɛji lɛ kwɛɔ Yerusalem gbɛ kɛji agble. Ekulaa shi esɔleɔ shii etɛ̃ daa gbi, ni edaa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi. Gbi ko lɛ Daniel yasɔle nakai nɔŋŋ.
Daniel henyɛlɔi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba, ni amɛbanina Daniel ni eesɔle eekpa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai.

Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛtee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Nii, bɛ owo akpɔ ko akɛ kɛyaashi biɛ gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baashi bo osɛɛ, ni eeebi nyɔŋmɔ ko loo gbɔmɔ adesa ko nii lɛ ashɛ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ afɔ̃ jatai abu lɛ mli?" Maŋtsɛ lɛ to he akɛ, "Nakai ni. Mediabii kɛ Persiabii amla ni, ni atsakeee hiɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ."
Amɛhere nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, Daniel, Yuda nomii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, ebuuu bo, Nii, kɛ akpɔ ni owo lɛ fɛɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ esɔleɔ shii etɛ̃ daa gbi."
Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ naakpa be ni enu sane nɛɛ, ni esusu he bɔ ni eeefee ehere Daniel yiwala. Esusu sane lɛ he aahuu kɛyashi hulushinyɔɔ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɛi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛbanina maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii, na ole akɛ yɛ Mediabii kɛ Persiabii amla naa lɛ akpɔ loo kitã ni maŋtsɛ ena ewo lɛ atsakeee."
No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fã, ni atee ayaŋɔ Daniel kɛba, ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ jatai abu lɛ mli. Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Daniel akɛ, "O-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni osɔmɔɔ anɔkwale mli lɛ; lɛ eeejie bo."

Ayawo tɛ kɛba, ni akɛbatsi jatai abu lɛ naa. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewolonaasɔomɔ ga lɛ sɔo tɛ lɛ naa; elumɛi lɛ hu sɔosɔoo bu lɛ naa kɛ amɛwolonaasɔomɔ gai lɛ koni akatsake yiŋ ni ato yɛ Daniel he lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋtsɛwe lɛ mli. Ehi ŋmãa nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni ehãaa akɛ hiɛtserɛjiemɔ nɔ ko abɛŋkɛ lɛ. Wɔ tserɛ kwrakwra yɛ ehiŋmɛiŋ.
Be ni hiɛ bɔ̃i gblemɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi mra, ni ehe fee oya kɛtee jatai abu lɛ naa.

Be ni ebɛŋkɛ bu lɛ naa he ni Daniel yɔɔ lɛ, ewo egbee nɔ, ni ekɛ awerɛhoo gbee bo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Daniel, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tsulɔ, ani o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni osɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ daa lɛ enyɛ ejie bo yɛ jatai lɛ adɛŋ lo?"
Daniel here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ao! Nii, oyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etsu ebɔfo lɛ kɛba, ni ebaŋamɔ jatai lɛ anaabu, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛyeko mi awui ko, ejaakɛ yɛ lɛ ehiɛ lɛ miyeɔ bem, ni bo Nii hu, mitɔ̃ko onɔ."
Maŋtsɛ lɛ mii shɛ ehe naakpa, ni efã akɛ ajie Daniel yɛ bu lɛ mli. Ajie Daniel yɛ bu lɛ mli ni apilako ehe ko he ko, ejaakɛ ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã, ni ayamɔmɔ mɛi ni yaflɔ Daniel naa hã maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie jatai abu lɛ mli, amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛŋamɛi fɛɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ shɛɛɛ bu lɛ shishi tete ni jatai lɛ mɔmɔ amɛ ni amɛjwra amɛwui amli.

Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario ŋmã wolo ekɛmaje majimaji kɛ asafoi kɛ je lɛ mli wiemɔi srɔtoi ashikpɔji anɔ bii fɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhea omanye! 26 Miiwo kitã akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ minɔyeli nɛɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ, ehe akpokpo, ni eshe Daniel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei." "Lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ; anyɛŋ emaŋtsɛyeli hiɛ akpãtã, ni ehewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ.
Jielɔ kɛ herelɔ ji lɛ; etoɔ okadii, ni efeɔ naakpɛɛ nii yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ehere Daniel yɛ jatai lɛ adɛŋ."
Daniel nɛɛ shwere yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ kɛ Maŋtsɛ Koresh, Persianyo lɛ, hu yinɔ.
7: Babilon Maŋtsɛ Belshazar klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Daniel la lamɔ ko, ni ena ninaa ko be mli ni ekã shi ewɔ. Eŋma lamɔ lɛ efɔ̃ shi; ni lamɔ nɛɛ mli saji titrii ji enɛ.
Daniel ŋma akɛ, "Mina yɛ minanaa lɛ mli akɛ nyɔɔŋ kɔɔyɔɔ efã kɛjɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ehã ŋshɔ fee hãmãhãmã.
Kɛkɛ ni kooloi wuji ejwɛ ni soro amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko famɔ kpo kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli.

Klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ tamɔ jata, shi eyɛ fiji tamɔ okropɔŋ fiji. Mihiɛ kooloo nɛɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ ni akplɔ efiji lɛ yɛ ehe, ni awo enɔ, ni akɛ lɛ damɔ enaji enyɔ nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ damɔɔ shi. No sɛɛ lɛ ahã lɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ.
Kooloo ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ oshishibrishi. Awo lɛ adamɔ efã kome nɔ; ŋmawutsei etɛ̃ kɔ̃ enaa yɛ enyanyɔji ateŋ. Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa nɔ ni oye loo babaoo bɔ ni obaanyɛ."
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mihiɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ ni kooloo kroko ko hu fã kpo. Etamɔ kootsɛ; shi eyɛ fiji ejwɛ, ni etamɔ nɔ ko ni aŋɔ nɔyeli hewalɛ kpeteŋkple ahã lɛ.

Mihiɛ kwɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fã kpo. Ehe yɛ gbeyei kɛ naakpɛɛ fɛɛ; eyɛ hewalɛ naakpa. Eyɛ dade nyanyɔji kpakpatakpakpataa, ni ekɛjwara eniyenii lɛ amli dukuduku ni eye; ni fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ ekɛ enaji naanaa nɔ. Esro lɛ kwraa yɛ kooloi krokomɛi ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ ba lɛ ateŋ. Lɛ lɛ eyɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma.

Mihiɛ akloŋtoi lɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ lɛ naa akloŋto hee bibioo ko ekwɛ̃ kɛje kpo yɛ amɛteŋ. Akloŋto bibioo nɛɛ fãmɔ akloŋtoi memeji lɛ ateŋ etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ eshwie. Akloŋto nɛɛ yɛ hiŋmɛii tamɔ gbɔmɔ hiŋmɛii ni eyɛ naabu, ni ekɛmiiwie shwãa wiemɔi agboiagboi.

Mihiɛ ninaa lɛ kwɛmɔ aahuu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni akɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii bamamɔ shi. Kɛkɛ ni mɔ ko ni onaa akɛ afɔ lɛ etsɛ naakpa baho eta shi. Etade yɛɔ futaa, ni eyiteŋ waŋ hu yɛɔ futaa. Emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ miitso kɛ la, ni sɛ̃i lɛ naji ahe kokrolonto lɛ hu mitso grigri.
La miiho yɛ ehiɛ tamɔ faa hoɔ. Gbɔmɛi akpeiakpei akpei abɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, ni mɛi huuhaa abɔ hu damɔ ehiɛ. Kɛkɛ ni kojolɔi lɛ batra shi, ni agble woji lɛ anaa, ni abɔi kojomɔ.

Mitee nɔ mikwɛ ninaa lɛ, yɛ wiemɔi agboiagboi ni minuɔ akloŋto bibioo lɛ wieɔ lɛ hewɔ. Mihiɛ kwɛmɔ aahuu kɛyashi mina akɛ agbe kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, ni afite egbɔmɔtso lɛ, ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ la lɛ mli koni eshã.
Kooloi krokomɛi lɛ ni shwɛ lɛ, ashɔ̃ hewalɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ; shi akɛ amɛhe ke amɛ kɛyashi be kɛ ŋmlɛtswaa pɔtɛ̃ɛ ko.
Mina yɛ nyɔɔŋ ninaa lɛ mli nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ adesa. Ekpleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni atatu ebɔle ehe kɛba mɔ ni Etsɛ Naakpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ebadamɔ ehiɛ.

Ahã lɛ nɔyeli kɛ anumnyam kɛ maŋtsɛyeli hewalɛ koni majimaji kɛ asafoi srɔtoi kɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi ashikpɔji anɔ bii fɛɛ asɔ̃mɔ lɛ. Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni, ni esɛɛ efoŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ hiɛ akpãtã.
Ninai lɛ wo mihe gbeyei, ni mimumɔ hao yɛ mi, Daniel, mimli.
Mitsi mibɛŋkɛ mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni mibi lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ mi ninaa lɛ shishi kɛ anɔkwale krɛdɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi nibii lɛ ashishi.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Nɛkɛ kooloi gbeyeigbeyei ejwɛ nɛɛ damɔ shi ha maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ komɛi ni baate shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔsɛɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ bii hetselɔi lɛ anine baashɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ, ni eeehi amɛdɛŋ kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni mitao akɛ male kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, nɔ ni esro lɛ kwraa yɛ kooloi krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ he sane. No he yɔɔ gbeyei naakpa kɛ enyanyɔji ni wa tamɔ dade kɛ ewaabii tamɔ akɔɔble ni ekɛjwra kooloi ni ena ebaaye lɛ amli dukuduku lɛ, ni fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ hu ekɛ enaji naanaa nɔ lɛ.

Mitao hu akɛ male akloŋtoi nyɔŋma ni mamɔ kooloo lɛ yitso he lɛ ahe sane. Mitao hu akɛ male akloŋto kome lɛ nɔ ni fã kpo, ni be ni eje kpo lɛ efãmɔ akloŋtoi lɛ ateŋ etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishifãi fɛɛ eshwie lɛ hu he sane. Lɛ eyɔɔ hiŋmɛii, ni eyɛ naabu, ni ekɛwieɔ wiemɔi agboiagboi tamɔ nɔ ni efe akloŋtoi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Mihiɛ kwɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni nɛkɛ akloŋto nɛɛ fã ta ewo Nyɔŋmɔ webii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim,
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mɔ ni Etsɛ Naakpa lɛ ba, ni ebadu Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ bem. Kɛkɛ ni be bashɛ, ni aŋɔ nɔyeli hewalɛ awo mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ adɛŋ.

Mɔ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ damɔ shi hã maŋtsɛyeli ni ji ejwɛ ko ni baaba abaye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ebaasro lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahe.Ebaafite shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ebaanaanaa nɔ, ni ebaakpãtã hiɛ.
Akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ damɔ shi hã maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋma komɛi ni baate shi yɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ yinɔ. Amɛsɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ kome kroko hu ko baate shi. Ebasro lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ komɛi ãshi.

Maŋtɛ nɛɛ baawie eshi Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, ni ebaahã etɔ Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ jogbaŋŋ. Eeeto eyiŋ po akɛ eeetsakɛ Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ajamɔ mlai lɛ kɛ gbii juji ni amɛyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ebaaye amɛnɔ kɛyashi afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã.
No sɛɛ lɛ ŋwɛi kojolɔi aaatra shi akojo lɛ, ni abaashɔ̃ nɔyeli hewalɛ lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni aaakpãtã ehiɛ butubutu.

Kɛkɛ lɛ abaatu shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyeli hewalɛ lɛ kɛ egbojee lɛ fɛɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ adɛŋ. Amɛmaŋtsɛyeli hewalɛ nɛɛ sɛɛ efoŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɛi fɛɛ baasɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛbaabo amɛ toi."
Sane lɛ naagbee nɛ. Sane nɛɛ gba, mi Daniel, minaa naakpa, ni ehã migbɔmɔtso tsake; shi mikɛ sane lɛ to minakutsoŋ.
8: Maŋtsɛ Belshazar yinɔ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ajie ninaa ko ekoŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ mi, Daniel, yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ninaa lɛ sɛɛ.
Mina yɛ ninaa nɛɛ mli akɛ miyɛ maŋtsɛmaŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Susan ni yɔɔ Elam kpokpaianɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli. Midamɔ Ulai Faa lɛ naa.

Be ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ lɛ, mina gwaŋtɛŋ nuu agbo ko damɔ faa lɛ naa. Eyɛ akloŋtoi enyɔ; akloŋtoi nɛɛ kwɔlɔ naakpa, ni ekome kwɔ fe ekome; shi akloŋtoi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni kwɔ lɛ no moŋ ji akloŋto nini gwaŋtɛŋ nuu lɛ je sɛɛkpee.

Mina akɛ gwaŋtɛŋ nuu nɛɛ miishi kɛmiiya anaigbɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ. Kooloo ko kooloo ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ edamɔ; mɔ ko hu nyɛɛɛ nɔ ko ashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ. No hewɔ lɛ efee nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ, ni efee ehe agbo.

Miisusu ninaa nɛɛ he nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ lɛ naa too kpakpo ko epue kɛjɛ anaigbɛ kɛmiiba. Efo mli kɛ foi waa kɛtsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni enane diɛŋtsɛ esaaa shikpɔŋ. Akloŋto agbo kome ma too kpakpo nɛɛ hiŋmɛii ateŋ.
Etsɛ̃ kɛbanina gwaŋtɛŋ nuu ni yɔɔ akloŋtoi enyɔ lɛ ni mina akɛ edamɔ faa lɛ naa lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ fɛɛ tutua lɛ.

Be ni too kpakpo lɛ bɛŋkɛɔ gwaŋtɛŋ nuu lɛ, emli ewo lɛ la naakpa. Eshi gwaŋtɛŋ nuu lɛ, ni ekumɔ eklontoi enyɔ lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ. Gwaŋtɛŋ lɛ nyɛɛɛ too kpakpo lɛ hiɛ adamɔ. Too kpakpo lɛ tsi gwaŋtɛŋ nuu lɛ etswa shi, ni enaanaa enɔ. Mɔ ko kwraa bɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛaashɔ̃ gwaŋtɛŋ nuu lɛ yɛ edɛŋ.

kɛkɛ ni too kpakpo nɛɛ bɔ̃i ehenɔwomɔ, ejaakɛ esusu akɛ eje agbo. Shi be ni ehe kɛɛ ewaa kwraa lɛ, aku eklonto agbo lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni akloŋtoi ejwɛ krokomɛi je kpo faŋŋ yɛ akloŋto agbo kome lɛ najiaŋ ni amɛmiikwɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Akloŋto bibioo kome ko kwɛ̃ kɛjɛ akloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ ekome mli. Akloŋto nɛɛ bada kpeteŋkple, ni ekpã emli kɛtee wuoyigbɛ kɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ shiwoo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ fɛɛ.
Ebada aahuu kɛyashɛ ŋulamiiaŋ, ni etserɛ ŋulamii lɛ ekomɛi etswia shikpɔŋ, ni enaanaa amɛnɔ.
Ewo ehe nɔ aahuu kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi asafo lɛ lumɔ lɛ tete nɔ; ni eshɔ̃ daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni efite He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Aŋɔ asafo lɛ ahã lɛ kɛ daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ hu; ni enɛ lɛ eji tɔ̃mɔ; ashɛ anɔkwale afɔ̃; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akloŋto lɛ fee lɛ shwere.

Kɛkɛ ni minu mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko gbee miiwie, ni minu ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kroko hu bi mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni wie lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ninaa nɛɛ baakã he kɛyashi? Mɛɛ be mlatɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ baatsī daa gbi afɔleshãa krɔŋŋ lɛ naa kɛyashi? Ni mɛɛ be nɔŋŋ abaanaanaa ŋwɛi asafo lɛ nɔ, ni abaabule He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛyashi."
Ejie naa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ebaaya nɔ kɛyashi gbii akpe kɛ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Kɛkɛ lɛ abaatsuu He Krɔnkrɔŋ lɛ he koni etsɔ̃ bɔ ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ."
Be ni mi, Daniel, mina nɛkɛ ninaa nɛɛ, ni miitao eshishi male lɛ, mina mɔ ko tamɔ gbɔmɔ badamɔ mihiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni minu gbɔmɔ gbee bo kɛjɛ Ulai Faa lɛ teŋgbɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Gabriel ei! Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mɔnɛ ninaa lɛ shishi."
Gabriel tsi eba he ni midamɔ lɛ; shi gbeyei mɔ mi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi. Kɛkɛ ni Gabriel kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Ao! Gbɔmɔ Adesa bi, na ole akɛ je lɛ naagbee he ninaa nɛ."
Ekɛ mi hiɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni wɔ ni tsii banyɔ minɔ. Shi Gabriel ta mihe, ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi,
ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Naa, mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni baaba yɛ mlifu lɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli. Je lɛ naagbee be ni ato lɛ he ninaa nɛ.
"Gwaŋtɛŋ nuu agbo ni ona kɛ eklontoi enyɔ lɛ damɔ shi hã Media kɛ Persia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Hela maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he okadi ji too kpakpo lɛ; ni akloŋto wulu kome lɛ ni ma ehiŋmɛii ateŋ lɛ ji eklɛŋklɛŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni akloŋto kome nɛɛ kū, ni akloŋtoi ejwɛ baye enajiaŋ lɛ, nakai Hela maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli baagbla ejwɛ; shi amɛteŋ ekoeko hewalɛ shɛŋ klɛŋklɛŋ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewalɛ lɛ.
"Kɛji maŋtsɛli ejwɛ nɛɛ anaagbee be lɛ bɛŋkɛ, ni yiwalɛ saji ni amɛyeyee hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ agbla amɛtoi lɛ, maŋtsɛ hiɛwalɔ ko ni le ŋaa fɔŋ baate shi.
Ebaana hewalɛ kple; shi ehewalɛ lɛ jɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli. Ebaakpãtã nibii ahiɛ butuu, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeefee lɛ, ebaaye omanye yɛ mli. Ebaakpãtã hewalɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ tete ahiɛ.

Eŋaalee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ lakamɔ baafa pii, ni ebaawo ehe nɔ. Ebaakpãtã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ, be mli ni amɛleee amɛhe be. Ebaate shi ewo jeŋ fɛɛ Lumɔi alumɔ lɛ; shi abaakpãtã ehiɛ, be mli ni adesa nine etako ehe tete.
Naa, daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ afɔle ni ashãa lɛ he ninaa ni agbla mli atsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ, anɔkwale ni. Shi bo lɛ okɛto onakutsoŋ, ejaakɛ be klaŋŋ baaho aya dani sane nɛɛ baaba mli."
Sane nɛɛ hã, mi Daniel, mifeevii; ni mihe yɛ be saŋŋ; kɛkɛ ni mite shi, ni mitee miyatsa nitsumɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛwo midɛŋ lɛ nɔ. Mihe jɔ̃ mihe yɛ ninaa nɛɛ hewɔ; ni minuuu shishi.
9: Ahashwerosh bi Dario, Media fɔmɔbi lɛ, ye Kaldeabii amaŋtsɛ.
Eklɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ mli, be ni, mi Daniel, mihiɛ woji amli kwɛmɔ lɛ, mina akɛ afii abɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia akɛ Yerusalem baakã shi amaŋfɔ̃ kɛyashi lɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Mihi ŋmãa, ni mibu kpekpe, ni mita lamlu mli kɛmiitao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛgbɛ yɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ mli.
Mikpa Yehowa mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, ni mijaje tɔ̃mɔi mikɛɛ, "Ao! Nuŋtsɔ, boji Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei ni yeɔ ekpãŋmɔ nɔ, mɔ ni suɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo hã mɛi bi sumɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
"Wɔfee esha, ni wɔtɔ̃; wɔfee yitsoŋwalɛ nibii, ni wɔtse ohiɛ atūa, ni wɔyeee okitãi kɛ omlai lɛ anɔ.
Wɔboko otsuji gbalɔi lɛ ni kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔlumɛi lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔjaku muu lɛ fɛɛ wie yɛ ogbɛi mli lɛ toi.

Ao! Nuŋtsɔ, bo lɛ onɔ ji jalɛ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔnɔ ji hiɛgble tamɔ eyɔɔ wɔnɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔ mɛi ni ji Yudabii kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ kɛ Isreaelbii fɛɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni eyaje shɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔji anɔ ni ogbɛ amɛ oshwã, yɛ anɔkwa ni amɛyayeee bo hewɔ lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, hiɛgble nɛɛ sa wɔ, wɔ kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔlumɛi lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, musuŋtsɔ̃lɔ ji bo, ni okɛ esha faa tsɛbelɛ wɔtse ohiɛ atūa,
ni wɔbooo bo Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, owiemɔ toi, ni wɔhiii shi bɔ ni otsɔ̃ otsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ owo wɔ mla akɛ wɔhi shi lɛ.
Israel tso muu fɛɛ etɔ̃ omla lɛ, ni amɛyeee omla lɛ nɔ; no hewɔ lɛ amɛgba afã. Enɛ ehã amɛloo musu ni aŋmã yɛ Mose, otsulɔ lɛ, Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Ekɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple ni eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ lɛ ema wiemɔ ni ewie eshi wɔ lɛ nɔ mi. Ogblako maŋ ko toi nɛkɛ pɛŋ dã, yɛ je nɛɛ mli fɛɛ, tamɔ ogbla Yerusalem toi nɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Mose Mla lɛ mli lɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ wɔkpako bo Yehowa fai, ni wɔkpaleko kɛjeko wɔnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe, ni wɔboko anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, enɛ hewɔ ni ohã efɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ bo lɛ jalɔ ji bo yɛ nii fɛɛ ni ofeɔ gbɛfaŋ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔbooo bo toi.
"Ao! Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ ni okɛ nineshiwalɛ jie wɔ, omaŋ lɛ, kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛna gbɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, wɔfee esha, ni wɔwa yi.

Ao! Nuŋtsɔ, yɛ ojalɛ saneyeli hewɔ lɛ, ofai nɛ, foo omli ni efu Yerusalem kɛ omli ni ewo lɛ la lɛ sɛɛ. Bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ kɛ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni. Eshai ni wɔfee kɛ eshai hu ni wɔtsɛmŋɛi lɛ fee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, omaŋ Yerusalem kɛ omaŋbii lɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi yɛ majimaji ni bɔle wɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo otsulɔ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ nɛɛ pɛ toi. Nuŋtsɔ, ohiɛ aba nyam ekoŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.

Ao! Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, ofai nɛ ni obo mi toi; wo ohiɛ nɔ koni okwɛ wɔmaŋfɔ̃i lɛ kɛ maŋ ni akɛ ogbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ. Ejaakɛ wɔbaaa ohiɛ kɛ wɔfaikpamɔ yɛ wɔjalɛ naa; shi moŋ wɔmiikpa bo fai yɛ omusuŋtsɔle kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ.
Ao! Yehowa, bo wɔ toi koni ofee he eko ohã wɔ. Ao! Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, ofai nɛ, kaatsɛ kwraa ni ofee he eko ohã wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ogbɛi kpɛtɛ omaŋ lɛ kɛ omaŋbii lɛ ahe."
Be ni misɔleɔ, ni mijajeɔ mihe eshai lɛ kɛ mimaŋbii, Israelbii lɛ, hu ahe eshai lɛ, ni mikpaa Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai yɛ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
mihiɛ mli miisɔle lolo kɛkɛ lɛ naa bɔfo Gabriel, mɔ ni mina yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ninaa lɛ mli lɛ ni efliki kɛba mimasɛi trukaa. No mli lɛ eshɛ be mli ni ashãa gbɛkɛnaashi afɔle lɛ.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Daniel, miba koni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo gbalɛ lɛ shishi.
Be ni oje shishi ni obɔi Nyɔŋmɔ faikpamɔ lɛ, afã mi, ni no hewɔ miba koni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo shishi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ bo naakpa. No hewɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ he koni onu ninaa lɛ shishi.

"Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto ni ekɛbaafo omaŋbii lɛ kɛ omaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eshai kɛ nifɔɔjianii ni afee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai kpawo toi kpawo; abaafo eshafeemɔ sɛɛ; abaakãtã eshafeelɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ; ni jalɛ saneyeli aaabaye nɔ kɛya naanɔ; abaawo ninaa kɛ gbalɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃; ni abaasaa ajɔɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.

Na ole, ni onu shishi, akɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni afã akɛ ayatswa Yerusalem maŋ lɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehala, ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ aaashɛ shi lɛ, afii kpawo toi kpawo baaho. Abaasaa atswa Yerusalem maŋ lɛ, ni abaasaa emli gbɛjegbɛi lɛ, ni abaasaa atswa egbogboi lɛ. Ebaahi shi nɛkɛ kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ toi kpawo; shi nɛkɛ be nɛɛ baafee fimɔ bei.

Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ naagbee mli lɛ, abaagbe hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efɔ lɛ mu lɛ trukaa, ni enaŋ mɔ ko; ni lumɔ ni baa abaye nɔ lɛ webii lɛ baafite Yerusalem maŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Ta kɛ nibii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ baaba tamɔ nu afua yɛ be lɛ naagbee nɛɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo shi eto lɛ.

Lumɔ nɛɛ kɛ mɛi babaoo baakpãŋ kɛyashi afii kpawo; shi afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã sɛɛ lɛ, lumɔ nɛɛ baagu shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle shãa kwraa. Abaafee amãgã ni buleɔ He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama he ni yɔɔ grɔŋŋ fe fɛɛ yɛ sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli; ni amãgã nɛɛ baama jɛi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto kɛbaagbla mɔ ni kɛ amãgã lɛ bama jɛi lɛ toi aaashɛ."
10: Persia Maŋtsɛ Koresh yinɔ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, ajie ninaa kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Daniel mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belteshazar hu lɛ. Sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwa, ni ekɔɔ haomɔ kpeteŋkple ko he. Atsɔ̃ɔ Daniel, ni enu sane lɛ shishi.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mi Daniel, mina otsii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ ni miiye ŋkɔmɔ.
Miyeee niyenii ni ŋɔɔ, miyeee loo lɛ, minuuu wain, ni mikpaaa mu hu kɛyashi otsii etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ shɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, midamɔ faa wulu ni gbɛi ji Tigris lɛ naa.
Miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina nuu ko ni ewo klala atade, ni Ufaz shika kpãa fi emliteŋ.
Egbɔmɔtso miikplɛ oookɛɛ ojrawatɛ, ni ehiɛ miikplɛ nyramnyram tamɔ srawa; ehiŋmɛii tamɔ kɔtii ni asu. Eniji kɛ enaji ahe miikpɛlɛ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he; ni egbee jije tamɔ asafo yuu gbee.
Mi Daniel, mi koome mina ninaa lɛ. Hii ni fata mihe yɛ jɛi lɛ enaaa ninaa nɛɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ŋmiŋmi ni naa wa mɔmɔ amɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛjojoo foi, ni amɛyatetee amɛhe.
No hewɔ lɛ ebashwɛ mi, mi koome ni miikwɛ ninaa kpeteŋkple nɛɛ. Migbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ tã, ni mihiɛ fɛɛ tsake, ni hewalɛ ko bɛ mimli dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni minu nuu lɛ gbee ni eewie. Be ni minu ewiemɔ lɛ, ni migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, ni nɔ nyɔ minɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni nine ko bata mihe, ni ewo minɔ. Mikula shi yɛ minakutsei anaa, ni mikɛ miniji nyɛmɔ shi, ni mikpokpo.

Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Daniel, Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ bo naakpa. Tee shi ni odamɔ shi, koni obo wiemɔi ni mikɛ bo baawie lɛ toi, ejaakɛ atsu mi oŋɔɔ." Be ni bɔfo lɛ kɛ mi ewie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mite shi midamɔ shi kɛ hekpokpomɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Daniel, kaashe gbeyei! Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ enu sɔlemɔi ni osɔle kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi nɔ ni okpɛ oyiŋ akɛ obaaba ohe shi ohã Nyɔŋmɔ. Anu osɔlemɔ lɛ, ni no hewɔ miba nɛɛ.

Be ni mibaa lɛ bɔfo ni buɔ Persia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he lɛ batsi mi gbɛ gbii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome. Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni gbɛi ji Mikael lɛ ba, ni ebaye ebua mi. Mishi Mikael kɛ Persia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ bɔfo lɛ yɛ jɛi,
ni miba koni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni baaba omaŋbii lɛ anɔ wɔsɛɛ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ninaa ona lɛ."
Be ni bɔfo lɛ kɛ mi ewie nɛkɛ egbe naa lɛ, mima mihiɛ shi, ni mitɔ mu.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ ni esu tamɔ gbɔmɔ adesa lɛ kɛ enine sa minaabu he. Kɛkɛ ni mibɔi wiemɔ, ni mikɛɛ bɔfo ni damɔ mihiɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ninaa lɛ eha mihewojiaŋ fɛɛ miiwa mihe, ni mifee gbedee.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mi, minuŋtsɔ tsulɔ, kɛ minuŋtsɔ aaawie hu? Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ ni jio, mumɔŋ nɔ jio, eko fɛɛ eko etã yɛ mimli."
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ ba, ni ebata mihe, ni mina gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ ekoŋŋ.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Ao! Gbɔmɔ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ bo pam, kaashe gbeyei; otsui anyɔ omli, ni ofee ekãa." Be ni ekɛ mi wie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mina ekãa, ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, wiemɔ, ejaakɛ owo mi hewalɛ."

Bɔfo lɛ to he ni ekɛɛ, "Ole nɔ hewɔ ni miba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ lo? Miiku misɛɛ koni mikɛ bɔfo ni buɔ Persia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he lɛ ayawu. Kɛji miye enɔ kunim sɛɛ lɛ, Hela maŋtsɛyeli bɔfo lɛ hu baaba koni ekɛ mi abawu.
Shi mibagba bo nɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Anɔkwale Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli lɛ. No ji akɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni waa mi ni mikɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi wuɔ akɛ ja Mikael, nyɛ Israel lumɔ lɛ."
11: "Maŋtsɛ Dario, Medianyo lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ mli lɛ,mi hu midamɔ shi, ni mifi Mikael sɛɛ kɛwo lɛ hewalɛ.

Nɔ ni magba bo agbɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni." Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ krokomɛi baaba abaye Persia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Maŋtsɛ mɔ ni baanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, ebaana nii fe mɛi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Ni kɛji etsɔ̃ enii ni ena lɛ nɔ ena hewalɛ lɛ, ebaawo majimaji ayiŋ, ni abaate shi awo Hela maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
"Maŋtsɛ kãkãlɔ ko baate shi nɛkɛ be mli, ni emaŋtsɛyelihe lɛ baada kpeteŋkple, ni ebaaye etsuinaa sane.
