Ekɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ ana afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa niyenii lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; shi nii ni eeena kɛjɛ etsɛmɛiawe lɛ ekome enɔ ni. Wɔŋjamɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ
"Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkakasea jɛibii lɛ amusubɔɔ nii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akagbe ebinuu loo ebiyoo ekɛshã afɔle; akana klamɔfonyo loo ashwãifeelɔ loo okɔmfo loo ŋkunyaayelɔ,
loo hoŋkpãatsɛ loo sisatsɛlɔ loo ayɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko lɛ; ni no hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ.
Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akana tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ nyɛhe. Awo Gbalɔ he shi
"Maji anɔ bii ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛboɔ klamɔfoi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi atoi; shi nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛfee nakai nɔ ko.
"Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi yɛ nyɛ nyɛteŋ, ni lɛ toi esa akɛ nyɛbo.
"Gbi ni akpe yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, nyɛkpa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔnyɛŋ wɔnu Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛtsɛ gbee aloo wɔna enumnyam ni kpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram lɛ dɔŋŋ koni wɔkagboi.'
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ 'Amɛwiemɔ lɛ ja naakpa.
Mibaatee gbalɔ ko shi tamɔ bo mahã amɛ, yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ebaakɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ nɔ ni mikɛha lɛ akɛ ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni booo wiemɔi ni ebaawie yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ toi lɛ, mibagbla mɔ lɛ toi yɛ no hewɔ.

Shi gbalɔ ni aaato lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ni ewie wiemɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli, be mli ni jeee mi mifã lɛ akɛ ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ, ja agbe lɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ gbalɔ ko ni aaawie yɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi agbɛi amli hu agbe lɛ.'
"Nyɛaabi nyɛhe akɛ, 'Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔle gbalɛ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ hu?

Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ kɛji gbalɔ ko wie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli, ni gbalɛ lɛ baaa mli loo ebɛ mli lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ jeee Yehowa dɛŋ nakai wiemɔ lɛ jɛ. Gbalɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni to eyiŋ ni ewie, ni no hewɔ lɛ kaashe nakai gbalɔ lɛ gbeyei."
19: "Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã maji anɔ bii lɛ ni eŋɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ eha nyɛ lɛ ahiɛ ni nyɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ amɛmaji lɛ kɛ amɛshīai lɛ ni nyɛhi mli lɛ, 2-3. nyɛhalaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji etɛ̃ nyɛtoa. Nyɛjaa shikpɔŋ tso muu ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli etɛ̃. Nyɛhalaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji etɛ̃ nyɛtoa bɔ ni afee ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni egbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, enyɛ ejo foi oya kɛya jɛi eyaba abo.

"Mla ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔbgbelɔ ni aaajo foi kɛya abobaa maŋ ko mli koni ehere eyiwala lɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni nine aaayakpa yɛ enaanyo nɔ, be mli ni jeee akɛ ebɛ mɔ lɛ ewo emli momo sa lɛ, ejo foi kɛya abobaa maji lɛ eko mli, koni efee shweshweeshwe.

Wɔŋɔ lɛ akɛ nyɛyi enyɔ nyɛtee koo ko mli nyɛyaafo tso, ni be ni nyɛ teŋ mɔ kome wo elema lɛ nɔ koni efo tso lɛ, lema lɛ fã yɛ etso lɛ he, ni eyatswa mɔ kome ni egbe lɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaanyɛ ajo foi kɛya maŋ nɛɛ eko mli, ni eyi aaana wala.

Ejaakɛ kɛji abobaa maŋ koome too ayɔɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli baajekɛ, ni mɔ ni agbe lɛ lɛ wekunyo ni baatɔ mɔ ni egbo lɛ lá lɛ he owele lɛ, baatiu gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ, be mli ni etsui he ejɔko, ni kɛji eyanina lɛ lɛ, eeetswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ; tsɛbelɛ esaaa akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ agbo, ejaakɛ enyɛko mɔ ni egbe lɛ lɛ etoko.

No hewɔ ni mifãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛhala maji etɛ̃ nyɛto lɛ. 8-9. "Nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ krokomɛi hu nyɛkɛfataa abobaa maji etɛ lɛ ahe kɛji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli ehã nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ fɛɛ hã nyɛ lɛ. Kɛji nyɛye nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni kitai lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, eeeŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ.
Nyɛfea enɛ koni akashwie mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá shi yakatswaa yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaye lá yi sɔ̃.

"Shi kɛji mɔ ko miinyɛ enyɛmi, ni no hewɔ lɛ eyawo enyɛmi lɛ ka, ni etua lɛ, ni etswa lɛ nɔ, ni epila lɛ ablaŋ, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo, ni gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ jo foi kɛtee nɛkɛ abobaa maji nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli lɛ.
Gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ atsu koni ayaŋɔ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yɛ abobaa maŋ lɛ mli kɛba. Kɛji akɛ lɛ ba lɛ onukpai lɛ atu lɛ awo mɔ ni esa akɛ etɔ lá he owele lɛ dɛŋ koni egbe gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ.
Akana lɛ mɔbɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ajie mɔ ni eye bem lɛ lá yi sɔ̃ kɛje Israel nɔ, koni ahi ahã nyɛ. Blema husui lɛ
"Kaajie onaanyo kɛ bo teŋ husu nɔ okadi ni blemabii lɛ eto jeeŋmɔ lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa nyɛ koni etsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ. Odaseyeli he akpɔi
"Akadamɔ odasefonyo kome naa wiemɔ nɔ abu mɔ ko fɔ. Esa akɛ ana odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ anaa wiemɔ dani adamɔ no nɔ kɛbu fɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane mli.
Kɛji mɔ ko to yiŋsha yɛ enaanyo he, ni ekata sane efɔ̃ enaanyo lɛ nɔ lɛ,
mɛi enyɔ ni sane kã amɛteŋ lɛ aba osɔfoi kɛ kojolɔi ni tsuɔ nii nakai be lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Yehowa jamɔhe lɛ.
Kojolɔi lɛ atao sane lɛ mli fitsotso. Kɛji ana akɛ sanetsɛ lɛ je gbɛ ekata sane efɔ̃ enyɛmi lɛ nɔ yaka, ni eye amale odase eshi enyɛmi lɛ,
afee lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni etao akɛ afee enyɛmi lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛkɛjie nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Mɛi krokomɛi baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ, ni ebaahã amɛshe gbeyei, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko efeŋ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ eko yɛ nyɛteŋ dɔŋŋ."
Akana mɔbɔ kwraa; akɛ wala atse wala; akɛ hiŋmɛi atse hiŋmɛi; akɛ nyanyɔŋ atse nyanyɔŋ; akɛ nine atse nine, ni akɛ nane atse nane.
20: "Kɛji nyɛmiiya nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ayawu ta, ni nyɛna amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu shwiilii kɛ tabilɔi babaoo ni ayi fa fe nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ.
Kɛji be lɛ shɛ ni nyɛbaabɔ̃i ta lɛ wuumɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ aje kpo kɛba koni ekɛ tabilɔi lɛ abawie,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Hiiabii Israelbii, nyɛboa toi! Ta ebanina nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi yaakpe. Nyɛtsui akafãa; nyɛkashea gbeyei, ni nyɛhe akakpokpoa; nyɛkahãa ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔa nyɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ,
ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yaa ta lɛ koni ekɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayawu ahã nyɛ koni nyɛye kunim.'

"Osɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni ema tsu hee ni egbleko naa lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baagble tsu lɛ naa.
Mɔ hu ni efee waintrom hee, shi ebɔiko emli yibii yeli lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaye trom lɛ mli nii lɛ.
Ni mɔ hu ni etsɛ yoo he baa, shi eyaŋɔko yoo lɛ, lɛ hu eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaŋɔ yoo lɛ.'
"Asaŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni miishe gbeyei, ni etsui efã lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe koni ekahã enyɛmimɛi tabilɔi krokomɛi lɛ atsui miifã tamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.'
Kɛji asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ wie gbe naa lɛ, afãmɔ tatsɛmɛi ni amɛnyiɛ asafoiasafoi lɛ ahiɛ.
"Kɛji nyɛyanina maŋ ko ni nyɛbaatua maŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃a hiɛ koni nyɛbia maŋbii lɛ kɛji amɛmiisumɔ hejɔlɛ loo ta.
Kɛji ahã nyɛ naajɔlɛ hetoo, ni agble maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ ahã nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, nyɛnyɛa amɛnɔ koni amɛtsu nii amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛsɔmɔ nyɛ.
Shi kɛji maŋ lɛ kɔɔɔ hejɔlɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɔ ta lɛ, no lɛ nyɛsaa maŋ lɛ yi.
Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛye maŋ lɛ nɔ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛgbea amli hii fɛɛ.
Shi maŋ lɛŋ yei lɛ kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ kɛ shīa kooloi lɛ, no ji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, nyɛŋɔa akɛ ta mli nii ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛdro nyɛ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni nyɛkɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ krokomɛi ni kɛ nyɛteŋ jekɛ pii anɔ lɛ aye ahã.
"Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea amɛmaji lɛ amli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Nyɛbulea amɛshishi wɛɛ, ni ji Hitbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaabii lɛ kɛ Perizbiii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã nyɛ ni nyɛfee lɛ.
Nyɛgbea amɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ musubɔɔ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛkɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ koni nyɛkafee esha nyɛshi Yehowa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ.
"Kɛji nyɛkɛ maŋ ko miiwu ni afee ni nyɛŋɔ, lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni maŋ lɛ yisamɔ lɛ sɛɛ etsɛ ehã lɛ, nyɛkaflɔa maŋ lɛ yeli tsei lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni nyɛkɛna ta lɛ lo?
Shi moŋ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛflɔ tsei ni ayeee amɛyibii lɛ koni nyɛkɛfee tawuu nibii koni nyɛkɛsa maŋ lɛ yi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaye maŋ lɛ nɔ."
21: "Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni agbe lɛ afɔ̃ ŋanɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni aleee mɔ ni gbe lɛ lɛ,
nyɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ kojolɔi lɛ aya, ni amɛyasusu he ni agbe gbɔmɔ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ kɛ maji ni yɔɔ jɛiniiaŋ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko jekɛmɔ.
Maŋ ni kɛ gbonyo lɛ bɛŋkɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ amɔ tsina oblayoo ni akɛtsuko nii dã.
Amɛkpla tsina lɛ kɛya jɔɔ ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli, he ni ahuko ni aduko nii yɛ dã. Amɛkū tsina lɛ kuɛ mli yɛ jɛi.
Osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levibii lɛ, atsi aba ejaakɛ amɛji mɛi ni Yehowa ehala akɛ amɛsɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkojo bei loo mɔnɔtswaa sane fɛɛ sane yɛ egbɛi mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ maŋ ni bɛŋkɛ gbonyo lɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ afɔ amɛdɛ̃ amɛshwie tsina oblayoo lɛ nɔ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ aku tsina lɛ kuɛ mli yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Nakai be mli lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Jeee wɔ ni wɔshwie lá nɛɛ shi, ni asaŋ wɔleee mɔ hu ni gbe lɛ.
Yehowa, ofai nɛ, ona omaŋ Israel ni oyakpɔ̃ lɛ mɔbɔ koni okɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ lá shi ashwie yaka nɛɛ sɔ̃ akatere Israel.'
Nyɛtsɔ̃a nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ koni nyɛfea nɔ ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ afee lɛ koni nyɛkɛjie mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ lɛ lá yi kɛje Israel nɔ." Ta mli yei nomii
"Kɛji otee ta, ni Yehowa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã oye ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, ni omɔ nomi,
ni yoo fɛɛfɛo ko yɛ nomɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni oosumɔ lɛ, ni otao akɛ oŋɔ lɛ ofee oŋa lɛ,
no lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aya owe, ni ohã eshɛ eyi, ni ejie ewaobii anaa;
ni etsake ehe nom atade lɛ. Yoo lɛ ahi owe lɛ, ni efo etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛyashi nyɔŋ kome. No sɛɛ dani oŋɔ yoo lɛ koni otsɔ̃ ewu, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ oŋa.

Kɛji eshɛ be ko ni sumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ oŋmɛɛ yoo lɛ he koni eye ehe tswaa, koni eya he ni lɛ esumɔɔ. Obɛ hegbɛ akɛ ohɔ̃ɔ yoo lɛ oheɔ shika, ni okaye lɛ nyɔŋ hu ejaakɛ ona ota ehe." Binuu kromɔ gbɛnaa nɔ
"Kɛji nuu ko yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, ni esumɔɔ mɔ kome lɛ, shi esumɔɔɔ mɔ kome; ni ekɛ yei enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ fɔ bihii, shi eŋa ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ ji kromɔbi lɛ,
Kɛji shɛ be, ni ebaaje egboshinii ehã ebii lɛ, ebɛ hegbɛ akɛ eŋɔɔ yoo ni esumɔɔ esane lɛ binuu akɛ ekromɔ binuu yɛ yoo ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ najiaŋ.
Yoo ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ ji ekromɔbi, ni lɛ eŋɔ egboshinii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai lɛ toi enyɔ lɛ ehã akɛ kromɔbi gbɛnaa nɔ." Bi toigbolɔ he akpɔ
"Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ binuu toigbolɔ kɛ atūatselɔ, bi ni booo efɔlɔi atoi, tsɛbelɛ amɛmiikã lɛ nɔŋŋ, shi ebooo toi lɛ,
no lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛya amɛmaŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ ahiɛ yɛ koishi.
Amɛkɛɛ maŋ lɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, 'Wɔbi nɛɛ toigbolɔ kɛ atuatselɔ ni booo wɔ toi lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋtswi ebɔɔ, ni etɔɔ dãa hu.'
Maŋ lɛ mli hii fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛ koni egbo bɔ ni afee ni akɛjie su fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Israel fɛɛ baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei." Mlai srɔtoi
"Kɛji abu efɔŋfeelɔ ko gbele fɔ, ni asɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso no lɛ,
akahã egbonyo lɛ miihi tso lɛ nɔ ni je tsɛre nɔ. Afu mɔ lɛ gbi nɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ loomɔ kã enɔ koni nyɛkabule shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ."
22: "Kɛji ona onyɛmi tsina loo etoo ni edu gbɛ lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ ohiɛ oto afã; shi moŋ kplamɔ kooloo lɛ kɛku sɛɛ oyahã onyɛmi lɛ.
Kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ shīa bɛŋkɛɛɛ bo, aloo oleee lɛ lɛ, no lɛ kplamɔ kooloo lɛ kɛya bo diɛŋtsɛ owe, koni kooloo lɛ ahi oŋɔɔ kɛyashi nɔtsɛ lɛ aaababi shi, ni okɛ enii aku sɛɛ ahã lɛ.
Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ofee onyɛmi teji loo etade loo enɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni elaaje ni ooona; okaho he ni otee.
"Kɛji ona onyɛmi teji loo etsina ni egbee shi lɛ, kaaho ehe ni otee; shi moŋ ye obua koni awo kooloo lɛ nɔ adamɔ shi.
"Yoo akawo hii atade, ni nuu akawo yei atade ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi mɔ ni feɔ nakai.
Oblayoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ akɛɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, 'Mikɛ mibiyoo nɛɛ hã nuu nɛɛ gblã; shi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ etaooo lɛ.
Obaanyɛ omɔmɔ looflɔ bii lɛ ni oŋmɛɛ looflɔ nyɛ lɛ he, ni ebaahi ehã bo, ni owala sɛɛ baatsɛ hu.
"Kɛji oma tsu hee lɛ, foo afabaŋ okɛbɔle tsu lɛ yiteŋ naabu fɔfɔoo lɛ, koni mɔ ko akaje tsu lɛ yiteŋ ebagbee shi ni obaye elá yi sɔ̃.
"Kaadu nɔ kroko ofutu wain yɛ owain trom mli; no lɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli nii fɛɛ kwa, wain yibii lɛ ni jio, nii ni odu ofutu lɛ lɛ ni jio, baatsɔ nɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni fɛɛ baaŋmɛɛ bo.
"Kaatsa tsina kɛ teji fɛɛ okɛhu.
"Kaawo atade ni akɛ odonti kpãa kɛ kuntu kpãa lo lɛ asaasaa.
"Feemɔ ahwanya owo otade koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe.
"Kɛji nuu yaŋɔ yoo, ni be ni ekɛ lɛ ena bɔlɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ esumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ dɔŋŋ,
ni no hewɔ lɛ eflɔ hiɛgbeji asaji eshwie yoo lɛ nɔ akɛ be ni ekɛ lɛ bɔ lɛ enaaa lɛ akɛ oblayoo fro lɛ,
no lɛ oblayoo fro lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ akɔ okadi ni yeɔ he odase akɛ amɛbi lɛ oblayoo fro ni lɛ, kɛya onukpai lɛ ahiɛ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ eflɔ heguɔgbee saji eshwie mibiyoo lɛ nɔ akɛ enaaa lɛ oblayoo fro. Shi naa okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mibiyoo lɛ oblayoo fro ni. 'No sɛɛ lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ alɛɛ mama lɛ mli amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ onukpai lɛ.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ amɔ nuu lɛ koni agwao lɛ.

Gwaomɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, agbe lɛ shika gbele jwiɛtɛi shekeli oha; ni akɛ shika nɛɛ ahã oblayoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ewo Israel fɔmɔbi oblayoo fro lɛ he muji yakatswaa. Yoo lɛ atsa nɔ ni ekɛ nuu lɛ ahi shi akɛ eŋa; ni nuu lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ eshwieɔ yoo nɛɛ kɛyaashi lɛ nuu lɛ aaashi jeŋ.
"Shi kɛji sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ nuu lɛ enaaa oblayoo lɛ akɛ oblayoo fro lɛ,

maŋ onukpai lɛ akpla oblayoo lɛ kɛya etsɛ agbo naa, koni maŋ lɛ mli hii atswia oblayoo lɛ tɛ ni egbo, ejaakɛ efee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel akɛ ele nuu dani eshi etsɛ we lɛ etee gblã. Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaajie su fɔŋ nɛɛ kɛje nyɛteŋ.
"Kɛji ana nuu ko ni ekɛ mɔ ko ŋa miina bɔlɛ lɛ, agbe nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ koni akɛgu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ Israel.
"Kɛji atsɛ oblayoo fro ko he baa, ni nuu kroko kɛ lɛ kpe yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, no lɛ,

nyɛkplaa nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ kɛyaa nakai maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa koni atswia amɛ tɛ yɛ jɛi ni amɛgboi. Yoo lɛ sa gbele ejaakɛ maŋ teŋ eyɔɔ, ni ebaanyɛ ebo etsɛ; shi ebooo; nuu lɛ hu sa gbele ejaakɛ efite enaanyo ŋa. Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaagu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
"Shi kɛji ŋa mli nuu lɛ na oblayoo ni atsɛ ehe baa lɛ yɛ, ni nuu lɛ mɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, no lɛ agbe nuu lɛ kome pɛ.
Oblayoo lɛ, akafee lɛ nɔ ko ejaakɛ efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko ni sa akɛ agbe lɛ yɛ no hewɔ. Bɔ ni mɔ ko teɔ shi etuaa enaanyo ni egbeɔ lɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ji nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ nuu lɛ mɔ oblayoo ni atsɛ ehe baa lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ naa bɔlɛ lɛ; ni oblayoo lɛ blɔ, shi mɔ ko bɛ ni aaahere lɛ.
"Kɛji nuu ko kɛ oblayoo fro ni mɔ ko etsɛko ehe baa kpe, ni emɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ,

nuu lɛ awo oblayoo fro yinii, ni ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ehã oblayoo fro lɛ tsɛ. Yoo lɛ atsɔ̃ nuu lɛ ŋa, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ni nyɛ oblayoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ; asaŋ nuu lɛ wala beiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ enyɛŋ yoo nɛɛ eshwie gbi ko gbi ko.
"Nuu ko nuu ko bɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛ etsɛ ŋa loo etsɛ hemɔ naa bɔlɛ, koni ekɛshwie etsɛ hiɛ shi."
23: "Nuu ni afo enuutso aloo asa lɛ lɛ, ekaya Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
"Ajwamaŋbi ko akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli; ni eshweiei Kɛyashi yinɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ bii tete akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
"Amonnyo loo Moabnyo akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli. Amɛshwiei ayinɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ bii tete amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akaba gwabɔɔ lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko;
ejaakɛ be ni nyɛjɛ Egipt ni nyɛbaa lɛ, amɛhiɛɛɛ niyenii kɛ nu amɛkɛbakpeee nyɛ, shi moŋ amɛyabɔ beor bunuu Balaam apaa kɛjɛ Petor yɛ Mesopotamia akɛ ebalomɔ nyɛ.
Shi Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, booo Balaam toi, shi moŋ ehã loomɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miisumɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛkataoa amɛ ekpakpa loo ejurɔyeli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
"Nyɛkanyaŋea Edombii ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi ji amɛ, ni nyɛkanyaŋea Egiptbii hu ejaakɛ nyɛyato gbɔ yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pɛŋ.
Amɛshwiei ayinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛyaa lɛ nɔ bii baanyɛ amɛba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli. Muji akahi tabilɔi ahe
"Kɛji nyɛfã ta ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi yaawu ni nyɛyato shi yɛ he ko lɛ, nyɛlea nyehenɔ kwɛmɔ koni nyɛkafee nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko.
Kɛji muji ba nuu ko he yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli ejaakɛ eshwie ehe shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ aje shitoohe lɛ mli koni eyahi sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Gbɛkɛnaashi mli lɛ ekɛ nu aju ehe, ni kɛ hulu nyɔ shi lɛ eku esɛɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli.
"Ato he ko akɛ kuŋtso yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni aya jɛi.
Mɔ ni miiya kuŋtso nɔ ahiɛ tso hu afata etawuu nii he. Ekɛ tso nɛɛ atsa bu koni esɔ̃ nɔ; ni kɛji egbe naa lɛ etsi wamɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yɛ jɛi bɔ ni afee ni ebu nyɛhe, ni asaŋ ehã nyɛye nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim. No hewɔ lɛ muji nɔ ko akahi shitoohe lɛ mli koni ehã Yehowa kpa yɛ nyɛsɛɛ." Mlai krokomɛi
"Kɛji nyɔŋ ko jo foi yɛ enuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ, ni ebaba Israelbii abo lɛ, akakpale nyɔŋ lɛ ayahã enuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Nyɛhãa ekɛ nyɛ ahia shi yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ mli; ni nyɛkayea lɛ nyɔŋ.
"Israel fɔmɔbi, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, akafee ehe jamɔhe lɛ mli ajwamaŋbɔlɔ.
Nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ mli shika akabahã yɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ mli yɛ eshiwoo ko hewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi jamɔhe lɛ mli ajwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ shika lɛ fɛɛ.
"Kɛji ofa onyɛmi Israelnyo shika loo niyenii loo nɔ ko ni aheɔ ehe kpa lɛ, lɛ lɛ kaahe lɛ nii lɛ he kpa.
Mɔ kpɔŋ lɛ, hemɔ lɛ nii lɛ he kpa; shi Israelnyo lɛ kaahe lɛ nii he kpa. Nyɛyea mla nɛɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaatsu nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛaŋɔ nɛɛ nɔ.
"Kɛji owo Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi lɛ kaahã shiwoo lɛ nɔyeli lɛ sɛɛ miitsɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, baabi bo nyɔmɔ yɛ shiwoo lɛ he; ni no aaafee esha ehã o.
Ejeee tɔ̃mɔ kɛji owooo Yehowa shi;
shi kɛji ona owo shi lɛ, esa akɛ ojwɛŋ nɔ koni oye shiwoo lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni owo Yehowa shi yɛ tsuijurɔnaa lɛ.
"Kɛji otee onaanyo waintrom mli lɛ, obaanyɛ oye wain yibii lɛ bɔ ni ooonyɛ; shi moŋ okatse yibii lɛ eko owo onii amli akɛ okɛmiiya shīa.
Kɛji oyabote onaanyo ŋmaaŋmɔ mli lɛ, obaanyɛ okɛ onine aku ŋmaa lɛ eko ni okpe bɔ ni ooonyɛ, shi okɛ nikpamɔ kakla akakpa ŋmaa lɛ.
24: "Kɛji nuu ko ŋɔ yoo ko efee eŋa, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ nuu nɛɛ naaa yoo lɛ he miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ ena hiɛgbejianii ko yɛ yoo lɛ he, ni no hewɔ lɛ eŋma mligblamɔ wolo ekɛwo yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ehã eje ewe lɛ,
ni yoo nɛɛ tee ni eyagbã nuu kroko,
ni sɛɛkpee wu nɛɛ hu eyasumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ, ni lɛ hu eŋma mligblamɔ wolo ekɛwo yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ehã eje ewe lɛ, aloo sɛɛkpee wu nɛɛ gbo lɛ,

no lɛ yoo nɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wu ni shwie lɛ lɛ aka ŋɔ yoo lɛ ekɛmiifee eŋa ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ abule yoo lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ miihi nɛkɛ gblãshihilɛ. Nyɛkafea nɛkɛ esha ni nyɛkɛmiibule shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhaa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ Mlai Krokomɛi
"Kɛji nuu ko kpee yoo hee lɛ ekaya ta; ni akɛ nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko akafɔ̃ enɔ akɛ etsu. Ahã eye ehe afi naakplɔ yɛ eshīa teŋ koni ehã eŋa ni ekpee lɛ mii ashɛ ehe.
"Mɔ ko akahe enaanyo wiɛ loo wiɛbi akɛ awabatoonɔ, ejaakɛ kɛji efee nakai lɛ belɛ gbɔmɔ wala eheɔ akɛ awaba lɛ.
"Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni eju enyɛmi Israelnyo, ni eeye lɛ nyɔŋ aloo eyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ, agbe nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ koni akɛgu nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
"Kɛji hewolo nɔ hela gbonyo ko mɔ mɔ ko lɛ, ekwɛ ni ahi, ni ejwɛŋ nɔ, ni efee bɔ ni osɔfoi ni ji Levibii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ efee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛfea bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ osɔfoi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Miriam yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɛjɛ Egipt nyɛbaa lɛ.
"Kɛji ofa onaanyo ko nɔ ko lɛ kaatiu lɛ kɛtee eshīa mli koni oyahe nɔ ni ekɛbaato bo awaba lɛ;
shi moŋ daamɔ agbo naa, ni mɔ ni okɛ nii lɛ efa lɛ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ekɛtoɔ awaba lɛ baaje kpo ekɛbahã bo.
Kɛji ohiafo ji lɛ lɛ kaahã ehebo lɛ hi oŋɔɔ ni obu kɛwɔ ni je tsɛre nɔ.
Kpalemɔ ohã lɛ kɛji hulu yaanyɔ shi, bɔ ni afee ni ohiafo lɛ ana ehebo lɛ ebu kɛwɔ koni eda bo shi; ni osane baasa Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hɛ.
"Kaawa apaafonyo ohiafo ni efi lɛ yi. Nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo ni jio, gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ ateŋ eko ni jio, akawa lɛ yi.
Wo lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ apaa ni obɔ lɛ lɛ he nyɔmɔ dani hulu anyɔ shi (ejaakɛ ohiafo ji lɛ, ni nakai nyɔmɔwo lɛ nɔŋŋ ebɔleɔ), koni ekafo etsɛ Yehowa ewo bo, ni no tsɔ̃ esha ehã bo.
"Tsɛmɛi akagbo bii ayi gbele, ni bii hu akagbo tsɛmɛi ayi gbele; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efɔŋ ni efee hewɔ.
"Kaatsɔ̃ gbɔ loo awusã sane hiɛ obu shi; ni kaahe okulafo hebo akɛ awaba.
Shi nyɛkaia akɛ aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje jɛi; no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã nɛɛ koni nyɛye nɔ lɛ.
"Kɛji okpa oŋmɔshinii, ni ohiɛ kpa ke kome nɔ yɛ ŋmɔ lɛŋ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ oyawo; shi moŋ oshi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛji otse omutso yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ okpa niji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ otserɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ; shi nomɛi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo.
Kɛji otse owaintrom mli yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ trom mli dɔŋŋ; shi yibii ni eshwɛ kpɛkpɛo lɛ oha gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo.
Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɔji ji nyɛ yɛ Egipt, ni no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitãi akɛ nyɛfee nɛkɛ lɛ."
25: "Kɛji mɛi enyɔ miibe, ni amɛkɛ amɛsane lɛ tee kojomɔhe koni akojo lɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ bem lɛ abu lɛ bem, ni mɔ ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ abu lɛ fɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ sa yii lɛ, kojolɔi lɛ ahã abu lɛ shi koni ayi lɛ kpãa, yɛ kojolɔi lɛ ehiɛ, yɛ efɔŋ ni efee lɛ naa.
Kɛji efa aahuu lɛ atswa lɛ kpãa nyɔŋmai ejwɛ; akateke nɔ, no lɛ ashwie onyɛmi Israelnyo lɛ hiɛ shi yɛ ohiɛ.
"Tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ able lɛ akawo enaabu kotoku. Nɔ ni afee ahã nyɛmi ni egbo

"Kɛji nyɛmimɛi hii enyɔ hi shi yɛ he kome, ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome gbo ni ebɛ binuu lɛ, mɔ ni egbo lɛ ŋa lɛ akashi weku lɛ mli eyagbã mɔ kpɔŋ. Ewu ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ gbɛnaa ji akɛ eŋɔ yoo lɛ akɛ eŋa koni etsu wu gbɛnaa nii ehã lɛ.
Kromɔ binuu ni yoo nɛɛ aaafɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ nuu ni egbo lɛ bi kɛ niyelɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ.

Shi kɛji mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ eŋɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ, no lɛ enyɛminuu lɛ ŋa lɛ aya maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Miwu nyɛminuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ mi awo shwie ahã enyɛminuu lɛ koni enyɛmi lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israel; esumɔɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ wu nyɛminuu gbɛnaa nii ehãa mi.'
Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ atsɛ mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ, koni amɛ kɛ lɛ awie he. Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ma nɔ mi ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Misumɔɔɔ akɛ maŋɔ lɛ akɛ ŋa lɛ',

no lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ nyɛminuu lɛ okulafo lɛ atsi abɛŋkɛ ewu lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ yɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni ejie nuu lɛ tokota nane kome yɛ ehe, ni efɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie nuu lɛ hiɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni sa nuu ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ esaa enyɛminuu we nɛ.'
Ni nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ abaatsɛ ewe yɛ Israel akɛ, 'Mɔ ni ajie etokota we'. Mlai krokomɛi
"Kɛji hii miinɔ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ŋa tsi ebɛŋkɛ koni ebahere ewu lɛ yɛ enaanyo ni enine etsɔ̃ ewu lɛ nɔ dɛŋ, ni yoo nɛɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ nuu kome lɛ nuutso lɛ,
afo yoo nɛɛ nine lɛ; akana yoo lɛ mɔbɔ ko kwraa.
"Kaato nsɛnitɛi srɔtoi enyɔ, nɔ ni shɛɔ kɛ nɔ ni shɛɛɛ yɛ oflɔtɔ mli;
ni kaato susumɔ nii hu srɔtoi enyɔ yɛ shīa, nɔ ni da kɛ nɔ ni edaaa.
Nyɛhãa nsɛnitɛ kɛ susumɔ nii lɛ ashɛa shishiishi koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ;
ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi mɛi fɛɛ ni shishiuɔ mɔ.
"Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Amalekbii lɛ fee nyɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ be ni nyɛjɛ Egipt nyɛbaa lɛ,
bɔ ni amɛyasheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ ni amɛtua nyɛ, be ni etɔ nyɛ ni nyɛtɔ biti lɛ, ni amɛgbegbee nyɛsɛɛbii fɛɛ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ kɛji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, nyɛbulea Amalekbii lɛ ashishi kwraa koni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ. Nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ."
26: Kɛji oyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa bo akɛ onɔ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ohi nɔ lɛ,
okɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nii ni obaakpa, yɛ oŋmɔ mli yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa eŋɔ ehã bo lɛ nɔ lɛ, eko awo kɛntɛŋ mli koni okɛya he koome ni Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Yaa osɔfo ni tsuɔ jɛi nii nakai be mli lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Miikɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ mibashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ehe shi akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ nɔ.'
"Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfo lɛ baahe kɛntɛŋ lɛ yɛ odɛŋ, koni ekɛma Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ okɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, 'Aramnyo ni ebɔ ko ji mitsɛ; ekɛ mɛi fioo ko tee Egipt, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ jɛi. Shi eshwiei ayi bafa, ni etsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa yɛ jɛi.
Shi Egiptbii lɛ hiɛ wɔ soisoi, ni amɛwa wɔ yi, ni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni wɔblɔ wɔtsɛ Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ebo wɔ toi, ni ena bɔ ni ahaoɔ wɔ lɛ kɛ deŋme ni wɔgboɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ wɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bakpɔ̃ wɔ yɛ Egipt yɛ ehewalɛ kɛ enineshiwalɛ naa. Ehã naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei nibii ba, ni ekɛto okadi.
Ni ekɛ wɔ eba biɛ nɛɛ, ni ekɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ hã wɔ, shikpɔŋ ni ewo fɔ ni baa nii babaoo lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni bo, Yehowa, okɛhã mi lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii ni mikpa lɛ eko eba. 'Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ okɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ ama Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni oja yɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Onya nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, edro bo lɛ he, bo kɛ owe lɛ mli bii kɛ Levibii kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ.

"Afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni ji mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome hãmɔ afi lɛ, kɛji okɛ oŋmɔshi nii mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ehã Levibii lɛ kɛ gbɔi lɛ kɛ awusãi lɛ kɛ okulafoi lɛ ogbe naa, koni amɛna nii amɛye yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ,

yaakɛɛ yɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, 'Mijie nii Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ minii mli yɛ miwe lɛ, ni mikɛhã Levibii kɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi bɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ. Mitɔ̃ko okitãi lɛ eko nɔ, ni mihiɛ hu kpako kita ko nɔ.

Miyeko nii nɛɛ ni mijie lɛ eko yɛ mikɔmɔyeli beiaŋ lɛ,mifiteko nii lɛ eko be ni mibule mihe lɛ, mikɛ eko hu eshãko afɔle mihãko gbonyo ko. Miye Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbee nɔ, ni mifee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ.
Jɛɛ oshihilɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, ni okwɛ koni ojɔɔ omaŋ Israel kɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni okɛhã wɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni okã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã lɛ.' Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ webii
"Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miiwo bo kitã akɛ oye ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ. No hewɔ lɛ kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ koni okɛ otsui kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ aye nɔ.
Ogba mli kpoo ŋmɛnɛ okɛɛ Yehowa akɛ lɛ ji o-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni obaaba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, ni obaaye ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekitai lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ, ni obaabo lɛ toi.
Yehowa hu egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ o, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ji o tamɔ bɔ ni ewo o shi lɛ, ni eebi o koni oye ekitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ,
koni yɛ yijiemɔ kɛ gbɛi kɛ anumnyam gbɛfaŋ lɛ, Israel agbojee akwɔ fe maji fɛɛ agbojee yɛ lɛ mli. Oootsɔ̃ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ."
27: Agbɛnɛ Mose kpã ewo maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ, yɛ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyea kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni gbi nɔ ni nyɛaafo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛholea tɛi kplei nyɛmamɔa shi, ni nyɛmaa hiɛ ni amɛnɔ afee troto,
koni nyɛŋmã nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ fɛɛ nyɛwo amɛnɔ, ni nyɛkɛya shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi eto lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛtee lɛ, nyɛkɛ tɛi ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ amamɔa shi yɛ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛmaa hiɛ ni amɛnɔ afee troto.
Nyɛmaa afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ tɛi ni akɛ dade naa esako amɛhe dã,
ejaakɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni amaa akɛhã Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ tɛi ni dade naa esako he ama. Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛshãa shidaa afɔle lɛ hu yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛyea nii yɛ jɛi koni nyɛnyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.
Ni nyɛŋmaa nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ, koni amɛje shi faŋŋ yɛ tɛi lɛ anɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ osɔfoi ni ji Levibii lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ, "Israelbii, nyɛfea diŋŋ ni nyɛ boa toi.ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ maŋ;
no hewɔ lɛ nyɛboa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛyea ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ." Toigbele he Loomɔi
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Mose fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ,
"Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan faa lɛ, akutsei nɛɛ adamɔ Gerizim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛjɔɔ maŋ lɛ: Simeon kɛ Levi Yuda kɛ Isakar kɛ Yesef kɛ Benyamin.
Ni akutsei nɛɛ hu adamɔ Ebal Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛlomɔ: Ruben kɛ Gad kɛ Asher kɛ Zebulon kɛ Dan kɛ Naftali.
Ni Levibii lɛ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛɛ Israel muu fɛɛ akɛ,
"'Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ŋaalɔ nilee nɔ ekɛ su loo tso loo dade feɔ amãgã ni ejaa lɛ yɛ teemɔŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni wooo etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ. Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni tsiɔ lɛ kɛ enaanyo teŋ husu nɔ okadi kɛyaa sɛɛ. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni hãa shwilafo duɔ gbɛ. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo sane hiɛ ebuɔ shi. 'Ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ estɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ewo etsɛ hiɛ mama nɔ. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo wɔɔ, 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ enyɛmiyoo ni ji etsɛbi loo enyɛbi wɔɔ, 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni eshaayoo ni ji eŋa nyɛ wɔɔ. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni gbeɔ enaanyo gbɔmɔ yɛ teemɔŋ lɛ. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni heɔ nyɔɔŋnii koni eyagbe mɔ ko ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'
"'Alomɔ mɔ ni yeee nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ anɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ ehaŋ mlai lɛ ama shi lɛ. 'Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, 'Amen!'"
28: "Kɛji oobo Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni ooojwɛŋ nɔ, ni oooye kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baawo onɔ gojoo fe shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ.
Obaana Yehowa, o-Nyɔmŋɔ lɛ, dɛŋ jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ aaanina bo yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛji ooobo Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee toi.
"Aaajɔɔ o yɛ maŋ, ni aaajɔɔ o yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.
"Aaajɔɔ omusuŋ bii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ oshiaŋ koolio abii kɛ otoi kɛ otsinai abii fɛɛ.
"Aaajɔɔ okɛntɛŋ ni okɛyakpaa nii lɛ kɛ otsese hu.
"Aaajɔɔ oyaa kɛ obaa mli fɛɛ.
"Yehowa aaahã oplenee ohenyɛlɔi ni aaabatua bo. Amɛaanyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛaabatua bo, shi amɛaatsɔ̃ gbɛi kpawo nɔ amɛaajo foi kɛaaje ohiɛ.
"Yehowa aaajɔɔ onitsumɔ, ni eeehã oboŋoi ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛ onine taa he aaashwere; ni eeejɔɔ bo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
"Yehowa aaaŋɔ bo, Israel, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã o kitã lɛ, kɛji oye Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ, ni oba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ.
No lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaana akɛ Yehowa kɛ egbɛi ewo bo akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ, ni amɛbaashe o gbeyei.
Yehowa baahã oshwere babaoo. Omusuŋ bii kɛ okooloi abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii fɛɛ aaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo otsɛmɛi lɛ he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã o lɛ nɔ.

Yehowa aaagble eŋwɛi niikpakpai anaa eha o; eeha nu anɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ be ni sa mli; eeejɔɔ onine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ; ooona nii, ni ooofala maji pii nii, shi bo lɛ ofaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko dɛŋ. 13-14. Kɛji oooye Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ, ni ji kitãi ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ni oookwɛ ni oooye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, asaŋ kɛji okplaŋ kɛjeŋ kitã ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ eko he, ni ogbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku, ni oyanyiɛŋ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni oyajaŋ amɛ lɛ, Yehowa aaafee bo yitso, shi jeee lei; onɔ sɔŋŋ ebaawo, ni eban bo shi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Toigbele yibii
"Shi kɛji aaaba mli akɛ obooo Yehowa toi ni ojwɛŋŋ nɔ ni oye ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ miimɛ o:
"Aaalomɔ o yɛ maŋ, ni aaalomɔ o yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.
"Aaalomɔ okɛntɛŋ kɛ otsese hu.
"Aaalomɔ omusuŋ bii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ otsinai abii kɛ otoi abii.
"Aaalomɔ o yɛ oyaa mli, ni aaalomɔ o yɛ obaa mli hu.
"Yehowa aaalomɔ bo, ni eeehã ojijaa, ni onijiaŋ aaaje wui yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofee mli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni aaafite bo, ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã oya mli yɛ nibii fɔɔji ni ofee lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ okwa Yehowa.
Yehowa aaahã oye gbele hela kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã ohiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni oyaa koni oyaŋɔ okɛfee onɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa aaahã oye wɔlɔmɔ fɔŋ kɛ atridii kɛ fuumɔ hela; ebaahã jeŋ adɔ waa, ni nu enɛŋ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ tamɔ la aaatswa, ni nibii aaaŋla, nibii nɛɛ aaanyiɛ osɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ŋwɛi ni yɔɔ oyiteŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ akɔɔble, ni shikpɔŋ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ dade.
Yehowa aaahã shia kɛ mlu atsɔ̃ onu ni aaanɛ ahã bo; amɛaajɛ ŋwɛi amɛbayi bo yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.
"Yehowa aaahã henyɛlɔi aye onɔ. Ooonyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛyatua amɛ; shi gbɛi kpawo nɔ oootsɔ̃ ojo foi kɛje amɛhiɛ. Osane lɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelihei fɛɛ atsui afã.
Ogbonyo aaatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, ni onaŋ mɔ ko po ashwie amɛ kɛje ohe.
Yehowa aaahã asanei ni ye Egiptbii lɛ eko kɛ fala kɛ abuasha kɛ kpla ni ehiii tsamɔ aye bo.
Yehowa aaahã oye sɛkɛ, ni oooshwila, ni oyiŋ baakã bo.

Ooogbugbuu shi shwane fintiŋŋ tamɔ shwilafo ni yɔɔ duŋ mli be fɛɛ be. Obaatsɔ̃ ogbutsɛ, ni onɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa shwereŋ, ni aaahi bo nyŋɔyeli kɛ ojotswaa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ daa nɛɛ, ni onaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni aaahere bo.
"Oootsɛ yoo he baa, shi nuu kroko moŋ ni kɛ lɛ aaawɔ; oooma tsu, shi owɔŋ mli; ni ooofee wain trom, shi oyeŋ emli yibii.

Ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ otsina agbe, shi onaŋ eloo lɛ eko oye, ni ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ oteji akranaŋ naa kɛya, ni akpaleŋ lɛ lɛ abahaŋ bo dɔŋŋ. Abaahã ohenyɛlɔi abamɔmɔ otoi kɛya, ni onaŋ mɔ ko abahere bo.
Abaaŋɔ obihii kɛ obiyei akɛ nomii ahã mɛi kpɔ̃ji be mli ni oona kɛ ohiŋmɛi nɔŋŋ, ni obaakwɛ amɛsɛɛkuu gbɛ kɛ tɔlɛ daa gbi; shi onyɛŋ he nɔ ko ofee.
Maŋsɛɛ maŋŋ ko ni oleee kwrakwra aaaba ebaloo oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ nii ni otsu oto fɛɛ kɛya eyaye. Yi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaawa o, shi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaashwishwia o daa nɛɛ,
ni ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni ooona lɛ aaaye o sɛkɛ.
Yehowa aaahã asanei ni anaa jraa ni ehiii tsamɔ atsɛrɛ onajutsei anaa kɛ oshuɔji ahe; ebaatsɛ̃rɛ̃ kɛjɛ oyiteŋ aahuu kɛyashi onaneshi.
"Yehowa aaakpla o kɛ omaŋtsɛ ni oto ohã ohe lɛ fɛɛ kɛaatee maŋsɛɛ maŋ ko ni bo loo otsɛmɛi leee mli; jɛi oooyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni akɛ tso kɛ tɛ fee yɛ.
Oootsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ kɛ naakpɛɛ nɔ ni akɛbaabu abɛ yɛ maji amli he ni Yehowa kɛ o aaatee lɛ.
"Okɛ dumɔ wui babaoo baaya oyadu yɛ ŋmɔ mli, shi nii fioo pɛ obaana okpa kɛba, ejaakɛ baalabii aaaye tsimɔ.
Ooofee waintromi, ni obaakura amɛ, shi onaŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko onu lɛ, onaŋ amɛmli wain yibii lɛ hu oye, ejaakɛ gɔgɔmli aaaye.
Obaahi mutsei yɛ okpokpai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nɛ, shi onaŋ mutso mu okpa, ejaakɛ omutsei ayibii lɛ aaakpla be mli ni amɛsrako.
Oofɔ bihii kɛ biyei nɛ, shi ohiŋ bi, ejaakɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ nom.
Otsei lɛ kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii lɛ baalabii aaaye fɛɛ.
"Gbɔ ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ agbojee aaakwɔ fe ogbojee, shi bo lɛ ogbojee lɛ aaaba shi daa.
Lɛ lɛ ebaana nii efa bo, shi bo lɛ onaŋ nɔ ko ofa lɛ; eeetsɔ̃ yitso, ni bo lɛ oootsɔ̃ lei.
"Naa, nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ aaaba onɔ, ni amɛaanyiɛ osɛɛ, ni amɛaanina bo yɛ hei fɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni hiɛ aaakpãtã, ejaakɛ obooo Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbee toi, ni oyeee ekitãi ni ewo bo lɛ anɔ.
Amɛaatsɔ̃ naakpɛɛ okadi amɛhã bo kɛ oshwei kɛaatee naanɔ,
"Ejaakɛ yɛ nii ni Yehowa jɔɔmɔ hã ona babaoo lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ jaaa Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ okɛ hɔmɔ lɛ kumai kɛ yayai kɛ hiamɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli aaasɔmɔ ohenyɛlɔi ni Yehowa baahã abatua bo lɛ. Henyɛlɔi nɛɛ kɛ dade apã aaawo okuɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã ohiɛ.
Yehowa kɛ maŋ ko aaajɛ shɔŋɛ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛaajɛ je lɛ naagbeehe, abatua bo trukaa, shwim tamɔ okropɔŋ flikiɔ, maŋ ko ni onuuu amɛwiemɔ,
maŋ ni hiɛ yɔɔ kramakrama; amɛhiɛ eshwieee onukpa hiɛiaŋ lɛ, amɛnaaa gbekɛ mɔbɔ hu.
Amɛbaaye otsinai abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛyaashi aaakpãtã ohiɛ; amɛshiŋ able loo wain loo mu loo otsinabii loo otoobii lɛ eko amɛhaŋ bo kɛyaashi amɛaakpãtã hiɛ.
Amɛaasa oyi amɛwo omaji lɛ fɛɛ amli kɛyashi omaji lɛ ahe gbogboi grɔŋŋi ni awaje, ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ lɛ, amɛaakumɔ ogbogboi lɛ amɛshwei shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
"Hiamɔ ni ohenyɛlɔi aaahã ahia bo, be mli ni asa oyi lɛ hewɔ lɛ oooye bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋbii, obihii kɛ obiyei, ni Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã bo lɛ aloo.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛteŋ nuu ni he jɔ, asaŋ ni ekpaaa niiaŋ po musuŋ aaajoo yɛ enyɛmi kɛ eŋa ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛ emusuŋbii ateŋ mɔ ni eshwɛ ehã lɛ tete nɔ,
bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehaŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko abi lɛ loo ni eyeɔ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ oyi ni asa kɛ fimɔ ni ohenyɛlɔ ehã efi bo yɛ omaji fɛɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, obɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛteŋ yoo ni he jɔ ni alɛ lɛ fɔfɔɔle, mɔ ni ekaŋ akɛ eenyiɛ enane folo ejaakɛ eyɛ wɔrɔmii kɛ bɔdɔbii, musuŋ aaajoo yɛ ewu ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛ emusuŋ binuu kɛ emusuŋ biyoo fɛɛ hu nɔ.
Ebaaye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi ni efɔ eŋmɔŋ sɛɛnii kɛ emusuŋ bii nigii, ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he esɛ̃ yɛ omaji lɛ ayi ni ohenyɛlɔ esa kɛ fimɔ ni efi bo lɛ hewɔ.
"Kɛji okwɛɛɛ ni ahi koni oye nɛkɛ mlai ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anɔ, ni ooshe Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi ni yɔɔ nyam kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ lɛ gbeyei lɛ,
no lɛ Yehowa aaahã helai ni anaa wa abaye bo kɛ oshwei, helai ni anaa wa, asaŋ ni amɛsɛɛ efooo.
Eeehã helai lɛ ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei, nɔ ni ona Egiptpii ye eko lɛ aye bo; ni helai nɛɛ baaka ohe.
Hela fɛɛ hela kɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ hu ni atsīko tã yɛ nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa aaahã eko aye bo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.
Tsɛbelɛ sa lɛ nyɛyi fa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii, shi nyɛyi fioo kɛkɛ aaashwɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi.
Bɔ ni Yehowa nya he akɛ efee nyɛ ejurɔ koni ehã nyɛyi afa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeenya he akɛ ekpãtã nyɛhiɛ koni efite nyɛ, ni aaashwie nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
"Ni Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, kɛjɛ je lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyashi naagbeehe kome hu, ni nyɛbaaya nyɛyaja tso kɛ tɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni nyɛ loo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ leee.
Onaŋ hejɔlɛ, ni asaŋ onaŋ nanemaahe hu yɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ; aaahã otsui afã, ni ooofee yeyeeye kɛ tsuiyeli yɛ jɛi;
oyiŋ aaafee bo kɔshikɔshi yɛ owala he, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmiŋmi aaamɔ bo, ni oleŋ kɛji oyi aaana wala lo.
Leebi lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Mina ni je ena', ni gbɛkɛ lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Mina ni je etsɛre'. Obaakɛɛ nɛkɛ yɛ ŋmiŋmi ni emɔ bo kɛ ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni onaa lɛ ahewɔ.

Ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ aaawo lɛji amli kɛaaya Egipt ekoŋŋ, tsɛbelɛ eji gbɛ ko ni ewo nyɛ he shi akɛ nyɛfaŋ dɔŋŋ; ni nyɛaahɔ̃hɔ̃ɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛhã nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ akɛ nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko heŋ nyɛ nyɛ tete."
29: Kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ ekɛ isrealbii lɛ akpãŋ yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi nɛ; esoro kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ yɛ Horeb Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he lɛ.
Mose tsɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa fee Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nyɛna haomɔi kplei lɛ kɛ okadii lɛ kɛ naakpɛɛ nii wuji lɛ;
shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, Yehowa hãko nyɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni nyɛkɛaanu nɔ ba lɛ shishi, loo hiŋmɛii ni nyɛkɛaana nii loo toii ni nyɛkɛaanu nii.
Mi mikpla nyɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ; nyɛtadei suuu yɛ nyɛhe, nyɛtokotai hu tserɛɛɛ yɛ nyɛnaji.
Nyɛhiɛɛɛ aboloo lɛ, nyɛhiɛɛɛ wain loo dãa ni wa; shi Yehowa hã nyɛ nyɛhehiamɔnii fɛɛ koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ lɛji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ni be ni nyɛbashɛ biɛ lɛ, Heshbon Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og fã ta kɛba amɛkɛ wɔ bawu; shi wɔye amɛnɔ kunim,
ni wɔŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni wɔjra shikpɔŋ lɛ wɔhã Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛjwɛŋa kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anɔ koni nyɛye nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛshwere yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ mli.
"Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛdamɔ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ, nyɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ, kɛ nyɛmaŋ nitsulɔi lɛ, kɛ nyɛ Israel maŋ lɛ mli hii fɛɛ,
kɛ nyɛbii bibii lɛ, kɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ, kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nyɛshitoohei lɛ amli lɛ, laiyalɔi kɛ faaŋyalɔi fɛɛ.
Nyɛba ŋmɛnɛ koni nyɛ kɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, abote kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kãa nyɛ he kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ mli,
koni ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, Yehowa ama nɔ mi akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ji nyɛ, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi momo sa, be ni ekã nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kitã lɛ.
Shi jeee nyɛ kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛkpãŋ nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ,
shi moŋ ekɛ wɔ kɛ mɔ hu ni bɛ biɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ miikpãŋ nakai nɔŋŋ.
"Nyɛle bɔ ni wɔhi shi yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔhã, kɛ bɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ majimaji ateŋ kɛba lɛ.
Nyɛna maji nɛɛ amusubɔɔ nibii ni ji amɛmãgãi ni akɛ tso kɛ tɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ.

Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛteŋ nuu ko loo yoo ko loo weku ko loo akutso ko yiŋ akatsɔ̃ ŋmɛnɛ ni ekpale yɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni etee eyaja nakai maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ; no lɛ nakai mɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tso shishifã ni woɔ tsoyibii ni joɔ kɛ emli ebɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ.

Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ baahã ehe tsui kɛji enu kitã ni ji kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ni ebaakɛɛ ehe akɛ, 'Mikpliŋ mitsui kɛmiifee nɔ ni mi misumɔɔ moŋ nɛ, kɔ̃lɛ mibaye mihe. 'Enɛ baahã mɔ kpakpa kɛ mɔ fɔŋ hu fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã.

Yehowa kɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ he ekeŋ lɛ, shi moŋ Yehowa mlifu kɛ ewuŋayeli aaate shi awo lɛ, ni loomɔi fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ aaababua gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yiteŋ kɛyashi Yehowa baagbe egbɛi yɛ je lɛ mli.
Yehowa kɛ ehiɛ aaaka lɛ dikadika yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli, yɛ nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli loomɔi ni yɔɔ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anaa.
"Wɔsɛɛ yinɔbii, ni ji nyɛshwiei ni aaaba yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ, kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ni aaajɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ aaawie he kɛji amɛna haomɔi kɛ helai ni Yehowa ehã eba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

Amɛaana bɔ ni swɔɔ kɛ ŋoo egbe shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ, ni ehiii enɔ nidumɔ, ni ebaaa nii, ni jwɛi tete ekwɛɛɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ. Amɛaana akɛ efite tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ Adama kɛ Zeboim maji lɛ ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ emlifu kɛ emilila naa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ majimaji fɛɛ aaabi akɛ, 'Mɛni ba ni Yehowa fee shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ? Mɛni kɛ mlifu ni naa wa nɛkɛ ba?'
Hetoo ni mɛi aaahã ji akɛ, 'Ejɛ kwamɔ ni amɛkwa Kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛ kpãŋ be mli ni eyakpɔ̃ amɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛtee ni amɛyajajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ, ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ, nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛleee, asaŋ ni Yehowa ewo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkaja amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni ehã loomɔi fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ babua enɔ bii lɛ ayiteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gri, ni efã amɛ yɛ emlifu kɛ emlila lɛ naa, ni eshɛrɛ amɛ eshwie maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.'
"Teemɔŋ nibii lɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koome nɔ ni; shi kɛji ajie nɔ ko kpo atsɔ̃ɔ pɛ, nɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔ kɛ wɔbii anɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ, bɔ ni afee ni wɔye mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ kwa nɔ.
30: "Mikɛ saji nɛɛ ni ji jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ miishwie nyɛhiɛ; kɛ ena eba nyɛnɔ beiaŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ maji anɔ fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eshwie nyɛ kɛtee lɛ, ni nyɛaakai nɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛfee lɛ,
ni nyɛ nyɛbii nyɛaakpale kɛba Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ aaaye egbee nɔ, bɔ ni miwo nyɛ kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ,
no lɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaana nyɛ mɔbɔ ekoŋŋ. Emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ, ni eeeku sɛɛ ebua nyɛnaa kɛaajɛ majimaji anɔ hei fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, egbɛ nyɛ eshwã lɛ kɛaaba.
Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni eeeshɛrɛ amɛ ashwie je lɛ mli naagbeehei tete po lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaabaŋɔ amɛ kɛaaje jɛi kɛaaba.
Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ aaaba nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛbaŋɔ. Yehowa aaahã nyɛshwere, ni nyɛyi aaafa hu fe nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei hu atsake nyɛtsui bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ asumɔ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni nyɛyi ana wala.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ abashwie nyɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ nyɛhetsɛ̃lɔi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ anɔ;
ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛaaku sɛɛ nyɛbo Yehowa toi, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ anɔ.

Yehowa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nyɛnine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ ashwere, ni nyɛmusuŋ bii kɛ nyɛtsinai abii kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii fɛɛ hu ashwere babaoo ahã nyɛ: ejaakɛ Yehowa aaana nyɛhe miishɛɛ ni eeehã nyɛshwere ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ena nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ lɛ.

Ebaafee nakai kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛaakpale kɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛaaba Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ lɛ.
"Kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko ni wa tsɔ̃ hã nyɛ, ni ebɛ shɔŋŋ hu.
Jeee ɛwɛi eyɔɔ ni no hewɔ lɛ nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Namɔ aaakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi ahã wɔ koni eyaŋɔ ekɛbahã wɔ, ni wɔnu ni wɔye nɔ?
Ni jeee ŋshɔ sɛɛ hu eyɔɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Namɔ aaafo ŋshɔ koni eyaŋɔ ekɛbahã wɔ, ni wɔnu ni wɔye nɔ?'
Dabida, wiemɔ lɛ bɛŋkɛ nyɛ kpaakpa; eyɛ nyɛdaaŋ ni eyɛ nyɛtsuii amli hu, no hewɔ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nɔ nyɛye aahuu.
"Naa, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ wala kɛ gbele kɛ ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ miishwie nyɛhiɛ.

Kɛji nyɛaaye Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛaaba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛyi aaana wala. Nyɛyi aaafa, ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛyaa nyɛaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi kɛji nyɛtsui yagba afã, ni nyɛgbo toi, ni alaka nyɛ, ni nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni nyɛsɔmɔ amɛ lɛ,
no lɛ miigba mli kpoo miikɛɛ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã, ni nyɛwala sɛɛ etsɛŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Miitsɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ koni amɛbaye he odase akɛ mikɛ wala kɛ gbele, kɛ jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ hu eshwie nyɛhiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɔa wala bɔ ni afee ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ ayi ana wala.

Nyɛsumɔa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛboa lɛ toi, ni nyɛkpɛtɛa lɛ. Ejaakɛ no aaahã nyɛyi ana wala ni nyɛtsɛ yɛ jeŋ koni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa kã nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob he kitã akɛ ekɛaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ."
31: Mose tee nɔ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ wie,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ amrɔ nɛɛ; minyɛɛɛ yaakɛbaa lɛ dɔŋŋ, asaŋ Yehowa, ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Ofoŋ nɛkɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ.'
Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ aaanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛfo faa lɛ; ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaakpãtã majimaji lɛ ahiɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ koni nyɛŋɔ. Yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa lɛ, Yoshua aaanyiɛ kɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ.
Yehowa aaafee maji lɛ bɔ pɛ ni afee Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi Sihon kɛ Og kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ be ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Yehowa aaatu amɛ awo nyɛdɛŋ; ni nyɛfee amɛ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛfee amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛhe awaa, ni nyɛfea ekãa; nyɛkashea gbeyei lɛ, nyɛtsui akafãa hu yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni kɛ nyɛ nyiɛ kɛyaa lɛ; eshiŋ nyɛ, ni ekwaŋ nyɛ hu."

Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Yoshua kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ, "Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa, ejaakɛ bo okɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ baaya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ, ni bo nɔŋŋ oooja shikpɔŋ lɛ ohã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Yehowa ji mɔ ni aaanyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya; ni ekɛ bo aaahi shi; ehaŋ onine anyɛ shi lɛ, eshiŋ bo hu. Kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã hu." Akane Mla Wolo lɛ shi kome daa afii kpawo
Kɛkɛ ni Mose ŋma mla lɛ ewo wolo mli, ni ekɛhã osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levi shwiei, mɛi ni tereɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ Israelbii lɛ amaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ.
Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Daa afii kpawo naagbee, ni ji heyeli be ni akɛ nyɔmɔ keɔ lɛ, kɛji eshɛ Asesei Agbijurɔyeli lɛ,
be ni Israel maŋtso muu fɛɛ ebapue yɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ yɛ he ni lɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ fɛ lɛ, akane nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ awo amɛtoiiaŋ.

Abua maŋ lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ, koni amɛbo mlai lɛ atoi ni amɛkase bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei koni amɛjwɛŋ nɔ ni amɛye mla nɛɛ mli weimɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛbii hu ni leee mlai nɛɛ amɛto lɛ akase ni amɛshe Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei bei abɔ fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaafo Yordan Faa lɛ ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.' Naagbee fãmɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Naa, ogbele be eshɛ etã. Tsɛ Yoshua kɛba koni bo, okɛ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni matu nitsumɔ lɛ mawo edɛŋ. " Mose kɛ Yoshua tee, ni amɛyadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
Yehowa bapue yɛ Buu lɛ mli yɛ atatu kutuu mli, ni atatu lɛ badamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Naa, eshwɛ fioo ni obaagbo ni ogbele sɛɛ lɛ maŋ nɛɛ baakwa mi, ni amɛbaaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni amɛyaanina yɛ shikpɔŋ ni amɛyaa nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Amɛbaakwa mi, ni amɛaaku kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ amɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli.

Kɛji eba mli nakai lɛ mimli aaawo amɛ la yɛ nakai be lɛ mli; ni mibakwa amɛ, ni mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ, ni aaaye amɛnɔ. Saji fɔɔji babaoo kɛ haomɔi baaba amɛnɔ, ni ebaahã amɛbi yɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, 'Kwɛɛ jeee Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni bɛ wɔteŋ dɔŋŋ lɛ hewɔ ni nɛkɛ nifɔɔjianii nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ?'
Anɔkwa, nakai be lɛŋ lɛ mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ yɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtee amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
"No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ŋmaa nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ. Lala lɛ ahi amɛdaaŋ. Enɛ baaye mi kɛ Israelbii ateŋ odase.

Ejaakɛ kɛji mikɛ amɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni mikã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ Kitã yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ, ni amɛna nii amɛye ni amɛtrɔ, ni amɛshwishwii lɛ, amɛbaakpale kɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛaaya amɛyasɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛaagbe mihe guɔ moŋ, ni amɛaaku mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.

Kɛji saji fɔɔji kɛ hejramɔ babaoo eba amɛnɔ lɛ, lala nɛɛ aaaye mi kɛ amɛteŋ odase, ejaakɛ amɛshwiei ahiɛ kpaŋ lala nɛɛ nɔ, ni lala lɛ aaahi amɛdaaŋ daa. Amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ po, dani mikɛ amɛ aaaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mile yiŋ ni amɛtoɔ momo."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose ŋma nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tu nitsumɔ lɛ ewo Yoshua, Nun binuu lɛ, dɛŋ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa, ejaakɛ boji mɔ ni okɛ Israelbii lɛ baaya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo he shi akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ; mikɛ bo baahi shi."
Be ni Mose eŋma mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ ewo wolo mli egbe naa owura kosɛɛ lɛ,
Mose fã Levibii Osɔfoi ni tereɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛŋɔa nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛŋmɛa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi koni eye nyɛhe odase yɛ jɛi.
Mile bɔ ni nyɛtseɔ atūa kɛ bɔ ni nyɛkuɛŋ ti hã hu. Nyɛmiitse Yehowa hiɛ atua amrɔ nɛɛ po ni mihiɛ kã ni mi kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, shi migbele sɛɛ lɛ te aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ?
Nyɛtsɛa nyɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋ nitsulɔi onukpai lɛ hu kɛbaa miŋɔɔ bɔ ni afee ni mawie nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ mawo amɛtoii amli koni matsɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ koni amɛnaye mi kɛ amɛteŋ odase.

Ejaakɛ mile faŋŋ akɛ migbele sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaafite kwraa, ni nyɛbaŋ nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ wɔsɛɛ aahuu lɛ, efɔŋ ji nɔ ni baaba nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaafee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii baawo emli la." Mose Lala lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wie nɛkɛ lala ni baa nɛɛ mli wiemɔ lɛ fɛɛ ewo Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ toiiaŋ kɛyashi egbe naa.
32: "Ŋwɛi, bo mi toi, shi mibawie; ni shikpɔŋ, bo minaa wiemɔi nɛɛ toi.
Mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ aaashwie shi tamɔ nu ni miinɛ, ni eeenyɔ tamɔ, tamɔ futufuli ni miishwã jwɛfɔ nɔ, tamɔ nu kulibii yɛ bai anɔ.
Mibajie Yehowa gbɛi yi! Nyɛwoa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam!
"Tɛsaa ji lɛ, enitsumɔ hi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efeɔ lɛ ja. Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo ji lɛ; nɔ sha ko bɛ ehe; jalɔ kɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ.
Shi nyɛyeee lɛ anɔkwa; no hewɔ lɛ jeee ebii ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, yɛ nyɛhe kpa hewɔ; yinɔ kɔ̃ɔdɔŋ ni eje eŋɛlɛnɔ ji nyɛ.
Aso Yehowa shidaa moŋ nɛ, kwashiai ni bɛ yitseiaŋ? Aso jeee lɛji nyɛtsɛ, mɔ ni bɔ nyɛ, mɔ ni fee nyɛ mɛi komɛi, ni ehã nyɛnane mɔ shi lɛ?
"Nyɛkaia blema jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ nyɛjwɛŋa yinɔi ni eho lɛ ahe; nyɛbia nyɛtsɛmɛi, ni amɛaagba nyɛ, kɛ nyɛnukpai lɛ hu, ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ.
Be ni ŋwɛinyo lɛ ja shikpɔŋ lɛ ekɛhã jeŋ majimaji lɛ ni egbla adesai abii amli lɛ, ejie maji lɛ ahusui eshwie shi faŋŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ayibɔ naa.
Yehowa ŋɔ Yakob akɛ gboshinii ni ena; ejaakɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ ji emaŋbii lɛ.
"Ena lɛ yɛ shiaŋa shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, yɛ ŋa olɛŋɛlɛ shwaŋŋ ko nɔ. Ebu ehe, ni ekura lɛ hu; ebaa eyi tamɔ ehiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ.
Bɔ ni okropɔŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ebii flikimɔ, ni egbɛɔ efijaŋ ekɛsɔoɔ amɛ, ni ehiɛɔ amɛ koni amɛkagbee shi lɛ,
nakai Yehowa koome nyiɛ ewebii ahiɛ, ni maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko fataa ehe.
"Ehã Israel ye gɔji anɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ; Israel ye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii lɛ. Ena wo kɛjɛ tɛsai amli, ni emutsei shwere yɛ tɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.
Tsinai kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi hã fufɔ ni efi; egwaŋtɛŋ yei kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ hii shwishwii kɛ fɔ tamɔ Bashan tsinai kɛ abotiai; ni enu wain kpakpa.
"Yehowa webii lɛ shwere shi amɛtse atuã; amɛshwishwii, ni amɛhe wa, ni amɛhe shãmɔ hu. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkwa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ amɛ lɛ moŋ, ni amɛbuuu Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji yiwalaheremɔ Tɛsaa lɛ.
Amɛtee Yehowa awuŋayeli shi kɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛja lɛ, ni esha ni amɛfee hewɔ lɛ amɛwo lɛ mlifu.
Amɛshã afɔlei amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi ni jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko, nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛleee, kɛ nyɔŋmɔi hei ni akɛba etsɛko, nii ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ sheko amɛ gbeyei dã.
Nyɛbuuu Tɛsaa ni babɔ nyɛ ade lɛ, ni nyɛhiɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
"Be ni Yehowa na enɛ lɛ enyaŋe ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ, yɛ emli la ni amɛwo lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ ko dɔŋŋ,' Makwɛ bɔ ni amɛnaagbee baatamɔ ahã, ejaakɛ yinɔbii toigbolɔi ji amɛ, bii ni yeee anɔkwa.
Amɛhã miye nɔ ni jeee nyɔŋmɔ he awuŋa yakatswaa; amɛwo mimli la kɛ amɛmãgã lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ mi hu mahã amɛye maŋ ko ni bɛ nɔ ko mli he awuŋa. Mahã amɛmli awo la yɛ kwashiai amaŋ ko hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ mimlifu ehã la ko ehere, ni eetso kɛmiiya gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ; ebaashã je lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii, ni ebaashã gɔji lɛ ashishitoi diɛŋtsɛ.
"Maloo haomɔi mabua amɛyiteŋ, matsɛ̃rɛ̃ amɛ gãii ni miyɔɔ.
Hɔmɔ baaha amɛtã loo, ni jeŋ dɔlɛ kɛ hela baagbe amɛ. Mawo kooloi kakawuai agbɛ koni amɛbatua amɛ, kɛ onufui kɛ amɛnaa ebɔɔ hu gbɛ koni amɛbakɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Klaŋte aaanu lá yɛ blohui amli, ni piai amli baafee gbeyei. Ebaakpãtã oblanyo kɛ oblayoo kɛ bi fufɔoo kɛ wajiatsɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Kulɛ makɛɛ akɛ, 'Magbɛ amɛ mashwã kɛya shɔŋŋ, ni mahã hiɛ akpa amɛnɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.'
Shi mishe gbeyei akɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi aaashwã ni amɛaaŋɔ nɔ ni eba lɛ ekroko ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔ ni wɔye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, jeee Yehowa ni fee amɛ enɛ.'
"Israel jeee ehe maŋ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ; ni sanesɛɛkɔmɔ ebɔ amɛ.
Eji amɛle nii kulɛ amɛaanu nɔ ni ba lɛ shishi, ni amɛaayoo bɔ ni amɛnaagbee mli aaabatamɔ.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni gbɔmɔ kome kɛkɛ woɔ mɛi akpe foiŋ, ni gbɔmɛi enyɔ kɛkɛ hu woɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma foiŋ? Nɔ ni Kɛba ji amɛ-Tɛsaa lɛ ekwa amɛ, ni Yehowa eŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã.
Ejaakɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yeɔ enɛ he odase akɛ amɛtɛsaa, amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔɔɔ wɔ-Tɛsaa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeŋ ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ba lɛ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora jeŋba lɛ; amɛjeŋba fɛɛ etsɔ̃ ebɔɔ, ni amɛyibii miijoo pam;
amɛwain lɛ shikpai ebɔɔ ni, tamɔ blika naa ebɔɔ pɛ.
"Mikɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ eto; mikɛŋmɛ shi, ni eemɛ amɛ.
Oweletɔɔ kɛ toigblamɔ lɛ, mi minɔ ni; amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ lɛ miiba shwiaa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa baafã ewebii ahe; ebaana amɛ mɔbɔ kɛji ena akɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ etã, ni eshwɛko mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa, mɔ ni hiɛ ehe jio, nyɔŋ jio.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa baabi akɛ, nɛgbɛ tɛsaa, amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ;
nibii ni amɛkɛ kooloi ni amɛkɛmiishã afɔle lɛ amli fɔi lɛ hã, ni amɛfɔse wain amɛshwie shi amɛhã amɛ akɛ amɛnu lɛ? Amɛba amɛbaye amɛbua amɛ, amɛbafã amɛhe koo!
"'Te nyɛna akɛ Mi nɔŋŋ ji Mi, ni misɛɛ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ? Migbeɔ, ni mihãa wala, mipilaa mɔ, ni mitsaa mɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nɔ ko ashɔ̃ yɛ mi midɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ miiwo minine nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi, ni miikɛɛ akɛ, miyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ,
kɛji mijɔ miklaŋte lɛ naa, ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ ni miwo jalɛ saneyeli nɔ lɛ, mibatɔ mihe owele yɛ mihenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni mibagbla mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ toi.
Lá baawu migãimlibii ahe, ni miklaŋte lɛ baaye loo. Lá baatsere yɛ migãimlibii anaa, ni miklaŋte baagbe mɔ ni teɔ shi woɔ mi lɛ. Minaŋ mɔ ni egba ewo mi mɔbɔ, pilafo lɛ kɛ nomi fɛɛ yeŋ amɛhe.'
"Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛkɛ Yehowa webii lɛ anyaa, ejaakɛ etɔ etsuji alá he owele, ni etɔ ehe owele yɛ ehenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni ekɛ ewebii atɔ̃mɔi efa amɛ."
Mose kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ba, ni amɛbakane lala nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo Israelbii lɛ atoiiaŋ. Mose naagbee wiemɔ
Be ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ewie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ egbe naa lɛ,
ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛshwie nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akãa nyɛtsui nɔ; ni nyɛkpãa nyɛwoa nyɛbii atoiiaŋ koni amɛjwɛŋ nɛkɛ mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛye nɔ;
ejaakɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ jeee wiemɔi foji hã nyɛ, shi maŋ nyɛwala diɛŋtsɛ ni; ni no hewɔ lɛ nyɛwala sɛɛ aaatsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ kɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ."
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kwɔɔ abarim gɔ̃ŋ nɛɛ, ni ji Nebo gɔ̃ŋ ni yɔɔ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekwɛɔ Yeriko maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, koni okwɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa Isrealbii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.
Obaagbo yɛ nakai gɔŋ ni obaakwɔ lɛ nɔ koni oyanina omɛi lɛ tamɔ onyɛmi Aaron gbo yɛ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyaina emɛi lɛ,
ejaakɛ, bo kɛ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkwa mi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he yɛ Kadesh, yɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ nyɛwooo mihiɛ nyam akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ hiɛ.
Obaana shikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ moŋ nɛ; shi ya ni oyaŋ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mikɛhãa Israelbii lɛ nɔ."
33: Jɔɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose kɛjɔɔ Israelbii lɛ dani egbo lɛ nɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa jɛ Sinai Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ ekpɛ kɛjɛ Edom eshwie wɔnɔ; ekpɛ kɛjɛ Edom eshwie wɔnɔ; ekpɛ kɛjɛ Paran Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ; ejɛ mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ akpei nyɔŋma lɛ aŋɔɔ kɛ la plamplam ni ma eninejurɔ nɔ.
"Anɔkwa, edɔɔ emɛi ahe, ehiɛ emɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ wɔkula enajia naa ni wɔmiibo egbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi.
Wɔyeɔ Mla lɛ ni Mose kɛhã wɔ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ no ji Yakob shwiei agboshinii.
Belɛ Yehowa tsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel be ni maŋbii babua amɛhe naa ni Isreal akutsei lɛ fɛɛ naa kpe shi lɛ.
Mose kɛɛ yɛ Reben akutso lɛ he akɛ, 'Ruben yi ana wala, eshishi akabule; emli hii anɔ akagbɔ'"
Ekɛɛ yɛ Yuda akutso lɛ he akɛ, Yehowa, bo Yuda toi; kplamɔ lɛɛ kɛbafata akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ahe. Nuŋtsɔ, bo diɛŋtsɛ wuu ohã Yuda koni oye obuu lɛ ni enyɛ ehenyɛlɔi ekɛwu."

Ekɛɛ yɛ levi akutso lɛ he akɛ, "Bo Yehowa, hã Urim kɛ Tumim ajie osuɔmɔnaa nii kpo atsɔ̃ɔ omaŋ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ omɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ji Levibii lɛ anɔ. Oka amɛ okwɛ yɛ Masa, ni okɛ amɛ taa naa yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he.
Amɛkɛɛ yɛ amɛtsɛ kɛ amɛnyɛ he akɛ, 'Wɔbuuu amɛ, ni amɛkwa amɛnyɛmimɛi, ni amɛshi amɛmusuŋbii asɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmɔ owiemɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛye okpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃ɔ Yakob shwiei okpɔi lɛ, kɛ Israel omla lɛ. Amɛ amɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ ohiɛ kɛ shãa afɔle muu yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.'
Ao! Yehowa, jɔɔmɔ Levi shwiei lɛ, ni amɛninenaa nitsumɔ asa ohiɛ; tswiamɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ amɛ lɛ nii, koni amɛkanyɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ."
Mose kɛɛ yɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ he akɛ, mɔ ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ehiɔ Yehowa masɛi shweshweeshwe. Ebuɔ ehe gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekpɔkɔiaŋ ji ekamɔhe."
Mose kɛɛ yɛ Yosef akutso lɛ he akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ bɔ, ŋwɛi nikeenii ni jra wa fe fɛɛ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi nu hu.
Yehowa ajɔɔ Yosef kɛ tsoyibii kpakpai diɛŋtsɛ ejɔɔ lɛ kɛ ŋmɔshinii kpakpai babaoo ni baa yɛ be ni sa mli.
Ehã ŋmɔshinii kpakpai akwɛ̃ yɛ eblema gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni naanɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu aba nii babaoo,

Yehowa ajɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ koni eba nii babaoo, bɔ ni skikpɔŋ nyɛɔ ebaa nii. Mɔ ni hi ŋmeitso lɛ mli lɛ ana Yosef akutso lɛ he miishɛɛ. Akɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ adro Yosef; jɔɔmɔ aba ekekre ni fi eyitso lɛ nɔ, lɛ mɔ ni ji lumɔ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Yosef kromɔbi lɛ je agbo tamɔ tsina nuu; ni ekoji ni ji Efraim mɛi akpei nyɔŋma, kɛ Mansase akpei nyɔŋma ni amɛkɛbaashimɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛaatsirɛ amɛ kɛaatee jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ."
Ni ekɛɛ yɛ Zebulon akutso lɛ he akɛ: "Zebulon, nya yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ jrayeli hewɔ' ni bo Isakar hu, nya onii ni ona yɛ shīa lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛaatsɛ mɛi kɛaaya amɛgɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ: Jɛi amɛaashã afɔlei ni sa yɛ ejaakɛ amɛna nii kɛjɛ ŋasɔ hiɛ, ni amɛna shīa mli jwetri ni akɛtee lɛ hu."
Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Gad akutso lɛ he nɛ: Akafo Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni lɛɔ Gad husui lɛ amli lɛ. Gad bu shi tamɔ jata ni miiwɔ, ni etserɛɔ mɛi anaji, ni ekpɔɔ yitso heloo.

Ekɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ ehã ehe, ejaakɛ jɛi tatsɛ gbɛnaa shikpɔŋ ni afo ato lɛ kã. Kɛkɛ ni eba maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ ni ebafata Israel he, ni akɛ Yehowa mlai lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ kojo maŋ lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa."
Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Dan akutso lɛ he nɛ: "Dan lɛ jatabi ni tamɔɔ kɛjɛ Bashan ni."
Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Naftali akutso lɛ he nɛ: "Naftali, bo lɛ adro o naakpa, Yehowa ejɔɔ bo jogbaŋŋ; ŋɔɔ wuoyigbɛ kɛ Galilea kpaakpo lɛ ofee onɔ."
Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Asher akutso lɛ he nɛ: "Ajɔɔ Asher fe fɛɛ yɛ bii ateŋ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ aaasumɔ esane; ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ aaashwere kɛ mu tso.
Akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble adabãi aaalalaa omaŋ agboi asɛɛ; ni bɔ ni ogbii falɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ohewalɛ aaahi.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni taa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekɛ agbojee tsɔ̃ɔ atatuaŋ kɛbayeɔ ebuaa bo lɛ.
Naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji obobaahe, ni enaanɔ niji lɛ hiɛ omli. Eshwie henyɛlɔi lɛ kɛje ohiɛ, ni ekɛɛ o akɛ, kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ'.
No hewɔ lɛ Isrealbii lɛ aaahi shi shweshweeshwe. Yakob nubu lɛ aaahi shikpɔŋ ni ablɛ kɛ wain pii baa yɛ nɔ, ni ŋwɛi bɔ nyɔɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi shwieɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Israel, omli ashɛ ohe! Namɔ tamɔ bo, maŋ ni Yehowa ehere oyiwala? Mɔ ni ji oyelikɛbuamɔ tsɛŋ kɛ okunimyeli klaŋte lɛ? Ohenyɛlɔi aaashwie amɛnaa shi amɛhã o, ni obaanaanaa amɛhei grɔŋŋi lɛ anɔ."
34: Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɛ Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekwɔ Nebo Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ kɛtee pisga Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ ni Kwɛɔ Yeriko maŋ lɛ hiɛ yiteŋ. Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛjɛ Gilead kɛyashi Dan,
kɛ Naftali fɛɛ, kɛ Efraim kɛ Manase shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashwie Mediterenia ŋshɔ lɛ anaihbɛ.
Ekɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, kɛ Yeriko ni ji tɛŋmaŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli ŋa kplenee lɛ kɛyashi Zoar tɔ̃ɔ?
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob shi yɛ he akɛ 'Mikɛbaahã nyɛshwiei' lɛ, no nɛ. Mihã ona kɛ ohiŋmɛitsei enyɔ, shi jɛi ni oyaŋ."
Yehowa tsulɔ Mose gbo yɛ jɛi yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa;
ni Yehowa fu Mose yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Betpeor ŋlɛnɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa leee Mose saŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Mose eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ be ni egbo lɛ; no mli lɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ efeko lɛ tuutuu lɛ, egbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ hu nɔ gbɔko.
Israelbii lɛ fo Mose gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ, dani amɛkɛgbe Mose yarafeemɔ kɛ lɛ fomɔ lɛ naa.
Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nilee mumɔ, ejaakɛ Mose kɛ eniji eshwie enɔ ejɔɔ enɔ. No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ bo Yoshua toi, ni amɛfee tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã Mose lɛ.
Gbalɔ ko eteko shi dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel tamɔ Mose mɔ ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Gbalɔ ko hu efeko okadii kɛ naakpɛnii tamɔ nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu Mose ni eyafee yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Egipt maŋtsɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Gbalɔ ko hu bako ni eyɛ hewalɛ kple, ni efee naakpɛɛnii kɛ gbeyeinii tamɔ Mose fee yɛ Israelbii ahiɛ lɛ.

1: Nilelɔ lɛ, ni ji David binuu lɛ, ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ wiemɔi nɛ,
"Yakanii amli yakanɔ!" Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Yakanii amli yakanɔ! Fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni."
Mɛni gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme fɛɛ ni egboɔ yɛ jeŋ he?
Yinɔ hoɔ eyaa, ni yinɔ baa; shi je lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Hulu lɛ teɔ shi, ni hulu lɛ saa eyanyɔɔ shi, ni eyeɔ oyai kɛyaa he ni eteɔ shi yɛ lɛ.
Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa kɛyaa wuoyigbɛ; ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa kɛbaa kooyigbɛ; kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ bɔleɔ shi kɛyaa kɛbaa.
Faa fɛɛ faa naa yaboteɔ ŋshɔ mli, kɛ̃lɛ ŋshɔ yiii. Hei ni fai lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛhoɔ kɛyaa be fɛɛ be.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, henaagbamɔ sɔŋŋ ni; shi adesa nyɛɛɛ ekɛɛ. Etɔɔɔ hiŋmɛi kɛ nikwɛmɔ, ni etɔɔɔ toi hu kɛ ninumɔ.
Nɔ ni eba dã lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baaba ekoŋŋ; ni nɔ ni afee dã lɛ, no nɔŋŋ abaafee ekoŋŋ; nɔ hee ko nɔ hee ko bɛ jeŋ.
Ani nɔ ko yɛ jeŋ ni aaanyɛ akɛɛ yɛ he akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ, enɛ lɛ nɔ hee ni?" Eba jeeŋmɔ yɛ yinɔi ni etsɔ wɔhiɛ lɛ amli.
Akaiii blema nibii, ni akaiŋ nii ni baaba, ni yinɔi ni baaba lɛ kaiŋ ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ mli sane.
Mi, Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ, miye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem.
Mikɛma mihiɛ akɛ mikɛ nilee baagbugbuu shi, kɛtao nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ; ni naa, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ yakanii ni.
Etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Nii ni ekɔ̃dɔ̃ lɛ ehiii jajemɔ trɔmɔɔ dɔŋŋ; ni nii ni eko bɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ akane efalɛ.
Mikɛɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe akɛ, "Mile nii jogbaŋŋ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalem dã lɛ, ni nibii ashi ni mikpa egble mijwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee mli pam."
Mikɛma mihiɛ akɛ mibatao male nɔ ni ji nilee kɛ nɔ ni ji sɛkɛyeli kɛ nɔ ni ji kwashiafeemɔ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ nilee tuutu lɛ, ekɛ naagba nyiɛ, ni mɔ ni hãa nilee faa lɛ, ehaomɔi hu faa.
2: Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ maka nɔ ni ji mliflimɔ makwɛ; shwɛ oyinɔ!" Shi naa, enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.
Mikɛɛ yɛ ŋmlɔ he akɛ, "Sɛkɛyeli ni"; ni mikɛɛ yɛ miishɛɛ hu he akɛ, "Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he?"

Mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ tao mli mikwɛ akɛ wain baahã mana miishɛɛ lo? Asaŋ mikɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee tao mli bɔ ni mafee mamɔ buulufeemɔ koŋ mli kɛdamɔ shi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mana nɔ ni hi hã gbɔmɛi abii akɛ amɛfee yɛ jeŋ, yɛ amɛwala be kukuoo lɛ mli.
Mitsu nitsumɔi wuji; mimamɔ shīai mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, ni mifee waintromi hu mihã mihe;
mifee abɔi kɛ tromi mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, ni mitɛo aduawa tsei srɔtoi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ mli;
mije bukoi ni akɛ amɛmli nu shwieɔ tsei ni atɛo lɛ anɔ;
mihe hii nyɔhi kɛ yei nyɔji fɛɛ, ni afɔfɔɔ nyɔji hu ahã mi yɛ miwe lɛ mli; mina toi kɛ tsinai fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ amɛhi Yerusalem.

Mibua shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ mishishi maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ shikpɔji anɔ bii adɛŋ jwetri naa mihã mihe. Mina hii lalɔi kɛ yei lalɔi fɛɛ ni laa kɛjieɔ mihiɛtserɛ; ni miyɛ nuu tsuinaa nii ni ji shieŋnyɛmɛi babaoo hu.
Mibatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu, ni migbojee bakwɔ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ amɛhi Yerusalem dã lɛ, ni nilee hu ebɔɔɔ mi.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni fee mi akɔnɔ lɛ, mikamaaa mihe. Mitsiii mihe naa yɛ miishɛɛ ko miishɛɛ ko gbɛfaŋ, ejaakɛ mina nibii fɛɛ ni migbo amɛhe daŋme lɛ ahe miishɛɛ. Deŋme ni migbo lɛ he sɛɛnamɔ ji no.

Shi be ni misusu nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛ minine etsu, kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔ mi kɛtsu nii lɛ hu fɛɛ he lɛ, nɔ ni mina ji akɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli. Anɔkwa, nɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni adesa naa he sɛɛ yɛ jeŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛni po maŋtsɛ ni ebaye maŋtsɛ kroko sɛɛ baanyɛ efee? Nɔ ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ fee lɛ, no nɔŋŋ pɛ lɛ hu ebaafee. No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, miku sɛɛ misusu nilee kɛ sɛkɛyeli kɛ kwashiafeemɔ he.
Mina akɛ nilee hi fe kwashiafeemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni la hi fe duŋ lɛ,
ni nilelɔ lɛ enyiɛɔ kɛ hiɛshikamɔ; shi kwashia lɛ, enyiɛɔ duŋduŋ tamɔ mɔ ni nyiɛ duŋ mli; shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛshɛɛ mli ekome.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, "Sane koome ni baa kwashia nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ ni baaba minɔ. Nɛgbɛ mɔ mikɛ nilee pii nɛɛ yaa?" Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, "Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni."
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni akaiii kwashia kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ, nakai akaiii nilelɔ bei fɛɛ, ejaakɛ be ni wɔsɛɛ ko baashɛ lɛ hiɛ ekpa amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ jeeŋmɔ. Bɔ ni nilelɔ gboɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kwashia hu gboɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ jeŋshihilɛ je mitsine, ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ hao mi, ejaakɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Deŋme fɛɛ ni migbo yɛ jeŋ je mitsine, ejaakɛ mina akɛ mibashi fɛɛ kwa mibahã mɔ ni baaba ebaye misɛɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baafee nilelɔ jio, kwashia ni jio, namɔ le? Ni kɛ̃lɛ nii fɛɛ ni migbo he deŋme ni mina yɛ nilee naa, yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, lɛ ebaaye. Enɛ hu yakanii ni.
No hewɔ lɛ minijiaŋ je wui akɛ migbo deŋme kɛtsu nii nɛkɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli;
ejaakɛ bei komɛi lɛ mɔ ko ni egbo deŋme kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ ŋaa shīɔ egboshinii lɛ ehãa mɔ ni gboko nii lɛ he deŋme ko, ni ebayeɔ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii kɛ nɔ fɔŋ kple ni.
Mɛni ji nɔ ni gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme ni egboɔ kɛ etɔlɛ he yɛ je nɛɛ mli?
Ejaakɛ ewala gbii fɛɛ lɛ piŋmɔ ni, ni enitsumɔ fɛɛ lɛ mlifu sɔŋŋ tɔ, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ tete ewɔɔɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ sɔŋŋ. Enɛ hu yakanii ni.
Nɔ ko bɛ hã gbɔmɔ adesa fe akɛ nii ni egbo he deŋme ni ena lɛ, eye eko, ni enu eko, ni ena ehe miishɛɛ. Enɛ hu mina akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ,
ejaakɛ namɔ ji mɔ ni baanyɛ eye nii aloo ena miishɛɛ ko kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ nine bɛ mli?

Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ droɔ lɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ; shi eshafeelɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãa ebuaa, ni etīaa nii anaa emaa shi, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhãa mɔ ni feɔ esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
3: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ ebe ni ato ahã lɛ; ni sane fɛɛ sane ni baa je nɛɛ mli yɛ ebe ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto.
Fɔmɔ be yɛ, ni gbele be hu yɛ; nidumɔ be yɛ, ni nikpamɔ be hu yɛ.
Be yɛ ni agbeɔ, ni be yɛ hu ni atsaa; be yɛ ni akumɔɔ nɔ ni ama, ni bɛ yɛ hu ni atswaa amaa shi.
Yaafo be yɛ, ni ŋmlɔ be hu yɛ; awerɛhooyeli be yɛ, ni be yɛ ni ajoɔ.
Be yɛ ni aklɔɔ tɛi ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ, ni be yɛ hu ni akɛbuaa tɛi anaa; be yɛ ni aloɔ mɔ atuu, ni be yɛ hu ni alooo mɔ atuu.
Be yɛ ni ataoɔ nii, ni be yɛ hu ni aŋmɛɔ nii ahe; be yɛ ni akɛ nii toɔ, ni be yɛ ni ashɛɔ nii afɔ̃ɔ.
Be yɛ ni atserɛɔ nii amli, ni be hu yɛ ni akpɛɔ nii; be yɛ ni afeɔ dioo, ni be hu yɛ ni awieɔ.
Suɔmɔ be yɛ, ni nyɛɛ be hu yɛ; ta be yɛ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ be hu yɛ.
Mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme ni egboɔ he?
Mina nitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛfɔ̃ adesai anɔ koni amɛgbo he deŋme lɛ.
Ehãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ feɔ akɔnɔ yɛ ebe mli, asaŋ ekɛ naanɔ he susumɔ ewo adesa mli, kɛ̃lɛ adesa nyɛŋ ena ele nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu kɛjɛ jeŋ shishitoo kɛyaagbee naanɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ mina akɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni hi hã gbɔmɛi, beiaŋ ni amɛyɔɔ wala mli, fe akɛ amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe, ni amɛye jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ni amɛshwɛ amɛyinɔ;
asaŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ ji akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye, ni enu, ni ena deŋme ni egboɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ.
Miyoo akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fee lɛ, ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; anyɛŋ akɛ nɔ ko afata he lɛ, anyɛŋ ajie nɔ ko kɛje mli hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ efee nɔ lɛ nakai, bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ adesa ashe lɛ gbeyei. Nɔ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ebaho etee dã, ni nɔ hu ni baaba lɛ eba dã. Nyɔŋmɔ tiuɔ nɔ ni eba ni ewo lɛ gbɛ kɛtee momo lɛ sɛɛ.
Asaŋ mina akɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, afeɔ efɔŋ yɛ he ni akojoɔ yɛ tete, ni afeɔ yiwalɛ nii yɛ he ni esa akɛ ayeɔ jalɛ sane yɛ tete.
Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo jalɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eto be ehã sane fɛɛ sane kɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ."
Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, yɛ adesai agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ miika amɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ amɛtamɔ kooloi nɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ adesa naagbee kɛ kooloo hu naagbee lɛ fɛɛ ekome; bɔ ni mɔnɛ gboɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔnɛhu gboɔ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mumɔ kome amɛyɔɔ, ni gbɔmɔ ehiii fe kooloo, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ji amɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ he koome lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyaa; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ su mli amɛjɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃ su ekoŋŋ.
Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛɛ akɛ adesa mumɔ lɛ eyaa ŋwɛi, ni kooloo mumɔ lɛ eyaa su mli?
No hewɔ lɛ, miyoo akɛ nɔ ko ehiii fe enɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ aye enitsumɔ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ no ji egbɛfaŋ nɔ. Namɔ baanyɛ ekɛ adesa aku sɛɛ kɛba jeŋ koni ebana nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ egbele sɛɛ?
4: Asaŋ mikwɛ yiwalɛ nibii ni afeɔ yɛ je lɛ mli lɛ. Naa yaafonui jwere mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ahiɛ, shi amɛbɛ mɔ ko ni shɛjeɔ amɛmii. Mɛi ni waa amɛ yi lɛ yɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni shɛjeɔ amɛmii.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni misusu ji akɛ mɛi ni egboi momo lɛ anɔ hi fe mɛi ni yɔɔ wala mli lolo nɛɛ.
Shi mɔ ni nɔ hi fe mɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni anako afɔ lɛ, ni ebanako nibii fɔɔji ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ miyoo akɛ deŋme ni gbɔmɔ gboɔ fɛɛ, kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, fɛɛ jɛɔ ehiɛ ni kɔ̃ɔ enaanyo nɔ. Enɛ hu yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Kwashia kotaa eniji ekɛtaa shi, ni hɔmɔ gbeɔ lɛ.
Dɛ̃kɔkɔ kome mli nii ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ mli lɛ, ehi fe niji enyɔ ni akɛmiigbo yaka deŋme tamɔ ayeɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔ.
Asaŋ mina yakanii ko yɛ jeŋ.

No ji mɔ ko ni ebɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko, ebɛ bi lɛ, ebɛ nyɛminuu hu, kɛ̃lɛ ekpaaa deŋme gbomɔ, ni nii ni ena hu esaaa ehiɛ. Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ biko ehe dã akɛ, "Kwɛ, namɔ kwraa hewɔ ni migboɔ deŋme, ni mikamaa mihe jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔ nɛɛ?" Enɛ hu yakanii ni, kɛ awerɛhoo sane fɛɛ.
Mɛi enyɔ hi fe mɔ kome, ejaakɛ mɛi enyɔ naa deŋma ni amɛgboɔ lɛ he sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji shi amɛgbee lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛ̃ aaawo enaanyo nɔ. Shi mɔ ni ekoome lɛ, kpoo hã lɛ ejaakɛ kɛji egbee shi lɛ, mɔ ko bɛ ni aaawo enɔ.
Asaŋ kɛji mɛi enyɔ kamɔ shi lɛ, amɛhe dɔɔ la; shi te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ni ekome lɛ ehe aaadɔ la hu?
Kɛji mɔ ko tua mɔ ni ekome lɛ, mɔ lɛ nine nyɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ enɔ; shi kɛji mɛi enyɔ ni lɛ, amɛbaaye mɔ ni tua amɛ lɛ nɔ. Kpãa ni akɛ kpãa blãwai etɛ̃ elo lɛ emlitsemɔ wa.
Oblanyo ohiafo nilelɔ hi fe maŋtsɛ nuumo kwashia ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ ŋaawoo dɔŋŋ,
Tsɛbelɛ gboklɛfoiatsuŋ ejɛ ni abaye maŋtsɛ lɛ, aloo afɔ lɛ ohiafo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Misusu gbɔmɛi hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ ni yaa baa yɛ jeŋ kɛ oblanyo hu, mɔ ni baaba ebaye maŋtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ he.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ayi fa bɔ ni anyɛŋ amɛ akane, shi maŋtsɛ ta amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ. Kɛ̃lɛ yinɔ ni baaba lɛ nyaŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ he. Anɔkwa, enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
5: Kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ kɛji ooya Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ. Kɛji ooya jɛi oyabo wiemɔ toi lɛ, ehi fe oooya jɛi oyashã afɔle ni kwashiai yaa amɛyashãa lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛleee akɛ amɛmiifee nɔ fɔŋ.
Kaahã onaa miifee blɛblɛ, ni kaahã otsui miihã osha ohe owie yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋwɛi eyɔɔ, ni bo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oyɔɔ, no hewɔ lɛ kaahã owiemɔ miifa.
Ejaakɛ kɛji odi lamɔ sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ nitsumɔ pii shwieɔ onɔ; wiemɔ pii akɛyoɔ kwashia.
Kɛ owo Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ, kaahã shiwoo lɛ nɔyeli sɛɛ miitsɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɛ kwashiai ahe tsui; shi ni owo lɛ ye nɔ.
Faŋ nɔ ni owooo shi kwraa, fe nɔ ni owo shi ni oyeee nɔ.
Kaaŋmɛ onaabu gbɛ ni ehã ofee esha; ni kaakɛɛ yɛ bɔfo lɛ hiɛ akɛ onaa ni etɛ shi. Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli afu yɛ owiemɔ hewɔ ni efite oninenaa nitsumɔ lɛ?
Kɛji lamɔi fa pɛ, wiemɔi hu efa; shi bo lɛ oshe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.

Kɛji ona akɛ aawa ohiafo ko yi, asaŋ aatsɔ̃ jalɛ saneyeli hiɛ aaabu shi, ni afeee nɔ ni ja yɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ lɛ, kaahã enɛ miifee bo naakpɛɛ, ejaakɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ, tsulɔnukpa ko ni fe lɛ yɛ ni kwɛɔ enɔ, ni tsulɔi krokomɛi hu yɛ lolo ni amɛgbɛnaa kwɔlɔ fe klɛŋklɛŋ tsulɔi lɛ.
Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ kɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ŋmɔji yɔɔ nɔ nɔ.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ shika lɛ, etɔɔɔ shika; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ ninamɔ etɔɔɔ ninamɔ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.
Kɛninamɔ fa lɛ, naabui ni yeɔ nii lɛ hu faa. Mɛɛ sɛɛ nɔtsɛ lɛ naa? Sɛɛ ni enaa ji akɛ kɛji ekɛ ehiŋmɛi kwɛ enii lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ.
Apaafonyo na nii babaoo eye jio, fioo ena eye jio, ewɔɔ kɛ miishɛɛ, shi niiatsɛ nii ni ena lɛ he jwɛŋmɔ hãaa ena wɔ ewɔ.
Awerɛho sane ko ni mina yɛ jeŋ nɛ; gbɔmɔ adesa tīaa nii naa ehãa ehe, shi no nɔŋŋ moŋ ni yeɔ lɛ awui.
Nii nɛɛ fɛɛ hiɛ kpãtãa kɛji akɛtee jarayeli. Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ bi nɛ, shi nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ edɛŋ ni ebaashi ehã ebi lɛ.
Bɔ ni ejɛ enyɛ musuŋ eba kɛ ehe yayai lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeeku esɛɛ kɛaatee bɔ ni eba lɛ, ni ekɔŋ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛyaŋ.
Awerɛho sane nɛ; bɔ pɛ ni eba lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeetee. Mɛɛ sɛɛ ena fe akɛ egbo deŋme flo;
ni ewala gbii fɛɛ amli lɛ, ehi duŋ kɛ awerɛho kɛ mlila kple kɛ hela mli, ni jeŋshihilɛ je etsine?

Naa, nɔ ni mikpa shi mina akɛ ehi, ni esa hã gbɔmɔ adesa feemɔ ji akɛ eye, ni enu; ni deŋme fɛɛ ni egboɔ yɛ ewala kukuoo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, eye emli ŋɔɔmɔ koni ena miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ no ji egbɛfaŋ nɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã ena shika kɛ nii kɛ hewalɛ koni eye eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ, emɔ egbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ mli, ni emii ashɛ edeŋmegbomɔ he. Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nikeenii ni.
Ejaakɛ esusuŋ ewala gbii lɛ ahe tsɔ̃, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã etsui eyi obɔ kɛ miishɛɛ.
6: Nɔ fɔŋ ko yɛ ni mina yɛ jeŋ ni ebu yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.

Mɔ ko hiɔ shi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hãa enaa shika kɛ nii kɛ anumnyam bɔ ni nɔ ko bɛ ni eshweɔ ni enaaa; shi kɛ̃lɛ edrooo lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛye eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ; shi moŋ mɔkpɔŋ ji mɔ ni bayeɔ eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ. Enɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni eji hejramɔ sane kple.
Kɛji mɔ ko fɔ bii oha, ni ewala sɛɛ tsɛ, ni eye afii babaoo, shi eyeee jeŋ nibii kpakpai amli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ni enaaa fuu kpakpa hu lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ abifao ni ashrake tete nɔ hi fe lɛ.
Sharakemɔ bi lɛ yaka eba jeŋ lɛ; enyiɛ duŋ mli kɛba, ni duŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa, ni hiɛ jeɔ enɔ.
Enaaa hulu lɛ, eleee nɔ ko nɔ ko hu; kɛ̃lɛ lɛ moŋ enaa hejɔlɛ fe mɔ ni
aaaye afii akpei enyɔ tete, shi eyeee jeŋ nibii kpakpai lɛ amli ŋɔɔmɔ ko. Ani jeee he koome mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ yaa lo?
Gbɔmɔ tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme fɛɛ lɛ, emusu kɛkɛ hewɔ; kɛ̃lɛ gbɔmɔ leee mitɔ.
Mɛni ji nɔ ni nilelɔ kɛfe kwashia? Ni mɛni ohiafo naa kɛji ele bɔ ni ahiɛɔ he ahãa yɛ mɛi ahiɛ?
Nɔ ni onaa kɛ ohiŋmɛii lɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni oshweɔ. Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli ni.
Nɔ ni eba dã lɛ, awo lɛ gbɛi momo; ni ale nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ, asaŋ akɛ gbɔmɔ nyɛɛɛ ekɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ fe lɛ afu daa.
Wiemɔ pii lɛ ekɛ yakanii pii nyiɛ; ni mɛni ji sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ mli hã gbɔmɔ?
Namɔ le nɔ ni hi hã gbɔmɔ adesa ni eyɔɔ yaka wala be kukuoo nɛɛ ni hoɔ tamɔ lamɔ nɛɛ mli? Ni namɔ baanyɛ egba gbɔmɔ nɔ ni baaba jeŋ yɛ egbele sɛɛ?
7: Gbɛi kpakpa hi fe mu ni jra wa, ni gbele gbi hi fe fɔmɔ gbi.
Kɛji otee shīa ni aafee yara yɛ mli lɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni otee shīa ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ esa akɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ahi nɔ akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anaagbee ji gbele.
Awerɛho hi fe ŋmɔlɔ; ejaakɛ awerɛho baahã ohiɛ afee mɔbɔmɔbɔ moŋ nɛ, shi ehãa jwɛŋmɔ mli gbleɔ.
He ni nilelɔ tsui kãa ji shīa ni yara yɔɔ mli; shi he ni kwashia tsui kãa ji shīa ni mliflimɔ yɔɔ mli.
Ehi akɛ ooonu ni nilelɔi miikã bo, fe nɔ ni ooonu ni kwashiai miila kɛmiikafo bo.
Ejaakɛ kwashiai aŋmlɔ lɛ, etamɔ ŋmei flɛmɔ yɛ kukwɛi shishi la mli. No hu yakanii ni.
Niseniianii hãa nilelɔ tsɔ̃ɔ kwashia, ni nyɔɔŋnihãmɔ fiteɔ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ.
Nɔ ko naagbee hi fe eshishijee; ni tsuishitoo mumɔ hi fe hewoo mumɔ.
Kaahã omli fu oya, ejaakɛ kwashiai amiinaa ji he ni mlifu yɔɔ.
Kaakɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛsɛɛ ŋɔɔ fe ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ?" Ekaajɛ jeee nilee mli obaajɛ obi nɛkɛ sane.
Nilee ni gboshinii fata he he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã hiɛkãalɔi;
ejaakɛ nilee baa mɔ yi tamɔ shika baa mɔ yi lɛ, shi nɔ ni nilee kɛfe shika ji akɛ nilee baa mɔ ni yɔɔ eko yi.
Susumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ he. Namɔ baanyɛ ejaje nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ekɔ̃dɔ̃ lɛ.
Be ni nibii eshwere lɛ, nya; ni kɛji joomɔ be ba lɛ susumɔ he; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ jɛ, bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ adesa akanyɛ ele nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ.
Mina mihiɛ nii yɛ yaka je nɛɛ mli. Jalɔ gboɔ yɛ ejalɛ nifeemɔ mli, ni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ moŋ wala sɛɛ tsɛɔ yɛ efɔŋ ni efeɔ mli.
Kaafee ohe jalɔ tuutu; asaŋ kaafee ohe nilelɔ tuutu. Mɛɛba oookpatã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ?
Kaafee ohe yiwalɔ tuutu, ni asaŋ kaafee kwashia. Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ ogbo be ni ogbele be shɛko.
Ehi akɛ omɔɔ enɛ mli, ni kaajie onine yɛ he; ejaakɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ebaaje fɛɛ mli shweshweeshwe.
Nilee hãa nilelɔ kome naa hewalɛ ni fe nɔyelɔi nyɔŋma ahewalɛ yɛ maŋ.
Anɔkwa, adesa ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni ekpakpa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ efeɔ, ni efeee esha.
Kaadi gbɔmɛi anaa wiemɔi fɛɛ asɛɛ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ ooonu ni otsulɔ miilomɔ bo;
ole yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyitsoŋ akɛ bo hu olomɔ mɛi komɛi shii abɔ pɛŋ.
Mikɛ nilee eka enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ mikwɛ. Mitswa fai shi akɛ male nii; shi miyanyɛɛɛ.
Namɔ baanyɛ ena? Esɛɛ jɛkɛ, ni emli kwɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ nɔ akɛ mibagbɛlɛ shi matao nilee kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli. Mitao akɛ male yitsoŋwalɛ ni yɔɔ buulufeemɔ mli, kɛ bɔ ni buulufeemɔ lɛ sɛkɛyeli ni.

Mina nɔ ko ni joɔ fe gbele tete; no ji yoo. Etsui mli eyi kɛ tsɔnei kɛ yai ni akɛduɔ mɔ, ni eniji lɛ kɔ̃sɔŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ ni fimɔɔ mɔ ni. Mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei jeɔ yoo akpa mli; shi eshafeelɔ lɛ yoo duɔ lɛ.
Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, mihiɛ taomɔ mli ekomekome lɛ, nɔ ni mina nɛ.
Nibii ni mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ etao aahuu lɛ, minako. Mɛi akpe mli lɛ, mina nuu kome pɛ ni yɔɔ hiɛsɔɔ; shi minaaa yoo kome nɛkɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Naa, nɔ ni kɛkɛ ni mina ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ adesa koni ehi shi krɔŋŋ; shi gbɔmɔ adesa ni eto ŋai srɔtoi.
8: Namɔ kɛ nilelɔ ye egbɔ; ni namɔ nuɔ nibii ashishi? Nilee hãa gbɔmɔ saa ehiɛ kɛŋmɔlɔ, ni ehiɛtumɔ laajeɔ.
Ye maŋtsɛ lɛ fãmɔ nɔ; yɛ okitã krɔŋŋ ni okã lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaahã enɔyeli hao bo.
Kɛji sane lɛ eŋɔɔɔ enaa lɛ kaashashao shi; oshi ehiɛ oya, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ feɔ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ.
Kɛji maŋtsɛ kɛɛ lɛ, akɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ; ni namɔ po baanyɛ lɛ ebi akɛ, "Mɛni po ofeɔ nɛɛ?"
Mɔ ni yeɔ famɔ nɔ lɛ, enaaa amane. Nilelɔ le beyinɔ kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni eeetsɔ̃ efee nɔ ni yɔɔ feemɔ;
ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ be kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ atsuɔ ehe nii; kɛ̃lɛ naagba kpaaa yɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ.
Gbɔmɔ ko leee nɔ ni baaba, ni namɔ hu aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ bɔ ni ebaaba lɛ ehã?

Mɔ ko kwraa bɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛaatsī gbɔmɔ wala mumɔ naa koni ekafã yɛ emli; ni gbi ni gbɔmɔ gboɔ lɛ, mɔ ko kwraa bɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ. Ta ko ni wɔnyɛŋ naa foi wɔje ni; ni nɔ ko hu nyɛŋ ehã mɛi ni ahe yɔɔ mli aje mli.
Be ni mitao nii fɛɛ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ ni gbɔmɔ adesa kpɔfuɔ enyɛmi gbɔmɔ yɛ mli nɛɛ mli fitsofitso lɛ, nɔ ni mina nɛ:

Mina mɛi fɔɔji ni egboi ni afu amɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ awalabeiaŋ lɛ, anaa amɛ amɛyaa amɛbaa yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ; shi amɛgbele mli lɛ, ajie amɛyi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, he nɔŋŋ ni amɛfee nakai efɔɔji lɛ yɛ lɛ. Enɛ hu shishinumɔ bɛ he.
Akɛ ni awooo esha he nyɔmɔ oya hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahe ehomɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.
Yɛ mli akɛ eshafeelɔ feɔ esha shii oha, ni ewala sɛɛ tsɛɔ moŋ nɛ, kɛ̃lɛ mile akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ebaahi ehã amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei;
shi yiwalɔ lɛ ehiŋ ehaŋ lɛ, ni ewala sɛɛ etsɛŋ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ, ejaakɛ esheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.

Nɔ ko hu ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ ni shishinumɔ bɛ he nɛ; gbɔmɛi kpakpai komɛi naa amanehului ni sa gbɔmɛi fɔɔji moŋ; ni yiwalɔi komɛi yɛ ni amɛna dromɔ ni sa gbɔmɛi kpakpai moŋ. Nɔ ni mikɛɛ ji akɛ enɛ hu lɛ shishinumɔ bɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni mikafo miishɛɛ ejaakɛ nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ hã gbɔmɔ yɛ hulu shishi nɛɛ, fe akɛ eye nii ni enu nɔ ko, ni ena miishɛɛ. Eeenyɛ ekã he efee enɛ be mli ni eyɔɔ wala ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ yɛ je nɛɛŋ.
Be ni mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ nɔ akɛ matao male nii koni manu nii ni yaa nɔ, yɛ je nɛɛŋ shishi, hewɔ ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ naaa wɔ ewɔ lɛ,

mina mile Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ nitsumɔi fɛɛ; shi mina akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ baagba ehe naa ehã lɛ, enuŋ nii ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ shishi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Tsɛbelɛ nilelɔ aaakɛɛ akɛ ena ele nii fɛɛ nɛ, shi anɔkwale ji akɛ enyɛŋ ele nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
9: Mikɛ mitsui fɔ̃ nibii nɛɛ anɔ, ni mitao fɛɛ mli. Nɔ ni mina ji akɛ jalɔi kɛ nilelɔi kɛ amɛnifeemɔi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ fɛɛ yɔɔ; suɔmɔ ni jio, nyɛɛ ni jio, gbɔmɔ ko leee. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kã gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ yakanii ni,

ejaakɛ jalɔ kɛ mɔ ni ejaaa, kɛ gbɔmɔ kpakpa kɛ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ni he tse kɛ mɔ ni he tseee, kɛ mɔ ni shãa afɔle kɛ mɔ ni eshãaa afɔle fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛnaagbee kome. Nɔ ni baa gbɔmɔ kpakpa nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baa efɔŋfeelɔ nɔ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ baa mɔ ni kãa kitã kɛ mɔ ni kãaa kitã fɛɛ nɔ.

Nɔ ko ni ejaaa yɛ nii fɛɛ ni afeɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ ji akɛ mɛi fɛɛ anaagbee afee ekome. Gbɔmɛi atsuiiaŋ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ efɔŋ kɛ sɛkɛyeli nifeemɔi, beiaŋ ni amɛyɔɔ walaŋ, shi no sɛɛ lɛ amɛgboiɔ, ni amɛyaa gbohiiaje.
Shi mɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, eyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko kɛ̃ ejaakɛ gbee hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ehi fe jata ni egbo.
