Ejaakɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ amɛle akɛ amɛbaagboi, shi gbohii lɛ amɛleee nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko hu ni amɛbaana dɔŋŋ, ni hiɛ kpaa amɛnɔ kwraa.
Amɛsuɔmɔɔ kɛ amɛnyɛɛ kɛ amɛwuŋayeli fɛɛ eho etee momo; ni kɛyaashi naanɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ amɛhe bɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
Yaa nɔ oye oboloo kɛ miishɛɛ, ni onu owain hu kɛ mliflimɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ nɔ momo.
Hã otadei ahiɛ ayɛ be fɛɛ be; wo oyiteŋ mu be fɛɛ be hu.
Okɛ oŋa ni osumɔɔ lɛ ahi shi yɛ miishɛɛ mli, bei abɔ ni oyɔɔ yaka wala ni Nyɔŋmɔ edro bo yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ deŋme ni ogbo yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ, ogbɛfaŋ nɔ ni ona yɛ jeŋ ji no.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tsumɔ ni ooomɔ mli lɛ, tsu kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ gbohiiaje he ni oyaa lɛ, nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ nitsumɔ loo yiŋshwiemɔ loo nilee loo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ eko bɛ jɛi.

Asaŋ mina akɛ jeŋ ni ayɔɔ mli nɛɛ lɛ, jeee be fɛɛ be mɔ ni najiaŋ wa yeɔ foidamɔ mli kunim, aloo kãkãlɔ yeɔ ta mli kunim; aloo nilelɔ naa edaaŋ ŋmaa, aloo hiɛshikãlɔ tsɔ̃ɔ niiatsɛ, aloo mɔ ni he esa yɛ nitsumɔ ko mli hiɛ baa nyam; shi amɛ fɛɛ lɛ dromɔ naa kɛkɛ ni.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ adesa leee ebe. Kɛji be lɛ banina lɛ trukaa lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ faaŋ loo ni ahiɛ, loo loofɔji ni akɛ tsɔne edu amɛ.
Nilee sane ko hu ni mina yɛ jeŋ ni enɔ bɛ hã mi nɛ:
Be ko lɛ maŋtsɛ wulu ko tee akɛ eyaatua maŋ bibioo kɛ emli bii fioo ko. Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ sa maŋ bibioo lɛ yi, ni etswa kawoo gbogboi ekɛbɔle maŋ lɛ.
Nuu ohiafo ko yɛ maŋ bibioo lɛ mli, ni lɛ etsɔ̃ enilee nɔ ehere maŋ lɛ yiwala. Shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kaiii nuu ohiafo nɛɛ.
Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ nilee hi fe hewalɛ, tsɛbelɛ abuuu ohiafo nilee, ni akɛ ewiemɔ efeee nɔ ko.
Nilelɔ wiemɔ ni ewieɔ lɛ ablɛbi lɛ, anuɔ, ni ehi fe blɔmɔ ni nɔyelɔ blɔɔ yɛ kwashiai ateŋ.
Nilee he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ fe tawuu nii; shi eshafeelɔ kome kpãtãa nii kpakpai babaoo hiɛ.
10: Adɔ̃dɔ̃ji ni egboi hãa ojeŋma feelɔ ojeŋma tete shaa, ni ejeɔ fu; no hewɔ lɛ buulu feemɔ fioo lɛ efiteɔ nilee kɛ nyam nitsumɔ fɛɛ.
Nilelɔ tsui kplaa lɛ kɛyaa nɔ ni ja he; shi kwashia tsui kplaa lɛ kɛyaa nɔ ni ejaaa he.
Kɛji kwashia nyiɛ tempɔŋ nɔ tete po lɛ, enaaa jwɛŋmɔ, ni ehãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa akɛ kwashia ji lɛ.
Kɛji onɔyelɔ mli fu bo lɛ, no akahã oshi ogbɛnaa ni ohiɛ yɛ eshishi lɛ, ejaakɛ saneheŋmɛɛmɔ lɛ ejɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ̃i wuji tete ahe.
Mina nɔ ko ni ejaaa gbɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli ni nɔyelɔi feɔ.
Aholeɔ kwashiai anɔ atraa hei grɔŋŋi; ni akɛ niiatsɛmɛi traa hei ni bɛ nyam.
Ni mina nyɔji tra okpɔŋɔi anɔ be ni lumɛi nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ tamɔ nyɔji.
Mɔ ni tsaa bu lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbee mli, ni mɔ ni gbuɔ gbogbo ewoɔ mli lɛ, lɛ onufu aaakɔ̃.
Mɔ ni tsaa tɛ lɛ, lɛ tɛ pilaa, ni mɔ hu ni gbaa lai lɛ, lɛ awui lai yeɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ko lema naa egbo, ni ejɔɔɔ naa lɛ, no lɛ ja emia ekpɔiaŋ waa. Nilee akɛtoɔ nifeemɔ he dani ayeɔ kunim.
Akamɛ ni onufu kɔ̃ mɔ dani akɛ ŋkunyaayeli kū enaa; no lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.
Nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ hãa ehiɛ baa nyam, shi kwashia naabu kpãtãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.
Ejeɔ ewiemɔ shishi kɛ kwashiai awiemɔi, ni egbeɔ naa kɛ sɛkɛyelɔi awiemɔ.
Kwashia wieɔ babaoo. Gbɔmɔ ko leee nɔ ni baaba; ni mɔ ko hu nyɛŋ egba lɛ nɔ ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ.
Kwashia deŋmegbomɔ hãa etɔɔ lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni maŋ gbɛ tete lajeɔ lɛ.
Kpoo hã bo, maŋ ni omaŋtsɛ lɛ gbekɛ ni, ni olumɛi tsɛɔ yelikɛnumɔ leebi.
Shi ajɔɔ bo, bo maŋ ni omaŋtsɛ lɛ abladei abi ni, ni olumɛi lɛ tsɛɔ okplɔ̃ yɛ be ni sa mli koni amɛye nii ni amɛna gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ, shi jeee koni amɛtrɔ dãa.
Hejɔ̃ hãa tsu duɔ, ni anihao hãa tsu wuleɔ ewoɔ mli.
Ŋmaa hãa mɔ miishɛɛ, ni wain hãa mɔ mli fliɔ lɛ, shi eko fɛɛ eko lɛ shika akɛfeɔ.
Kaalomɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ oyitsoŋ tete, ni kaalomɔ niiatsɛ hu yɛ osɛɛtsu mli, ejaakɛ gbogbo he yɛ flɔ.
11: Feemɔ ejurɔ oto, ni wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ aaafee bo ejurɔ.
Feemɔ mɛi kpawo loo kpaanyɔ ejurɔ, ejaakɛ oleee sane gbonyo ni nyiɛ gbɛ baa yɛ jeŋ.
Kɛji atatuiaŋ yi tɔ kɛ nu lɛ, amɛnɛɔ nu amɛshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji tso yaagbee shi, ni eyagbee wuoyigbɛ loo kooyigbɛ lɛ, eshigbeemɔhe lɛ nɔŋŋ ekãa.
Mɔ ni sraa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, eduŋ nii, ni mɔ hu ni kwɛɔ atatui lɛ, ekpaŋ nii.
Bɔ ni onyɛŋ ole bɔ ni feɔ ni mumɔ baa bi ni yɔɔ yoohɔlɔ musuŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ onyɛŋ ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ tsuɔ enii fɛɛ.
Du odumɔwui leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ onyɛŋ ole wui lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni baahi, enɛ loo enɛ, loo kɛji fɛɛ aaahi.
La ŋɔɔ, ni kɛji hiŋmɛi miina hulu lɛ, gbɔmɔ naa miishɛɛ.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ ye afii babaoo lɛ, ena miishɛɛ yɛ fɛɛ mli; shi moŋ ekai akɛ gbele duɛ be fa. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baa lɛ yakanii ni.
Oblanyo, nya yɛ oblahiiaŋ; hã omii ashɛ ohe yɛ oblahiiaŋ fɛɛ; ye otsui naa sane; feemɔ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ; shi moŋ kaimɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo baakojo yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ofee lɛ ahewɔ.
Jiemɔ mlifu kɛje oyiŋ, ni kaapiŋ ohe yɛ nɔ ko hewɔ, ejaakɛ ogbekɛbiiashi kɛ oblahiiaŋ lɛ yakanii be ni.
12: Kaimɔ obɔlɔ lɛ yɛ oblahiiaŋ, be ni gbii fɔɔji lɛ kɛ afii fɔɔji lɛ nako ashɛ, be mli ni obaakɛɛ akɛ, "Jeŋshihilɛ eŋɔɔɔ" lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ hulu la lɛ kɛ nyɔŋtsere lɛ kɛ ŋulamii lɛ baafee sulii, ni atatui baabua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ nunɛmɔ sɛɛ.

Nakai be lɛ ogbɔmɔtso shīa lɛ he bulɔi, ni ji oniji lɛ baakpokpo, ni onaji kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ lɛ egbɔjɔ, ni onyanyɔji, nigblɛlɔi lɛ, nyɛɛɛ nii amɛgblɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ eshwɛ amɛyi fioo ko kɛkɛ, ni hiŋmɛii lɛ ni kwɛɔ samfɛji lɛ amli nii lɛ anɔ eha.

Toii lɛ ni anaa kamɔ ni boɔ blohuiaŋ toi lɛ nuŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ; amɛnuŋ nigblɛmɔ tsɔne lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni naa eba shi lɛ he ekpakpa ko. Looflɔ gbee aaatsīɛ bo yɛ wɔ mli moŋ, shi ooonu yei lalɔi agbei, ejaakɛ oshrãi sɔŋŋ yɔɔ gbɛteŋ.

Oooshe hei ni kwɔlɔ gbeyei, ni onyiɛmɔ tete baatsɔ̃ oshrã ahã bo. Oyiteŋ baayɛ tamɔ odoŋti ni egba, ni ohetsimɔ baawa ahã bo, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ bo akɔnɔ dɔŋŋ. Akɛni gbɔmɔ adesa miiya enaanɔ shīa lɛ, no hewɔ ni yarafeelɔi foɔ shi yɛ blohuiaŋ lɛ.
Jwiɛtɛi kɔ̃sɔŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ lɛ baatse, ni shika kane lɛ baatswa shi ni ejwa, ni faaŋyaa gbɛ lɛ baajwa yɛ nubu lɛ naa.
Wɔsū gbɔmɔtsei lɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ sū mli ekoŋŋ, he ni amɛjɛ lɛ, ni mumɔ lɛ hu baaku esɛɛ eya Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni ejɛ eba lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Yakanii mli yakanii, Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ; fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni.
Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ le nii, ni etsɔ̃ɔ emaŋbii lɛ nii ni ele lɛ eko. Ekase abɛi ahe nii, ejwɛŋ amɛhe ni ekɛ amɛ to shihilɛ he ekwɛ kɛ hiɛshikamɔ.
Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ bɔ mɔdɛŋ etao wiemɔi ni ŋɔɔ, asaŋ ni ja, ni eŋmla anɔkwale wiemɔi.
Nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔi lɛ etamɔ kplamɔ tso. Tookwɛlɔ koome ni yɔɔ lɛ, ewiemɔi ni abua naa lɛ yɛ kpɛŋŋ tamɔ plɛkoo ni aka awo tso mli.
Mibi, kwɛmɔ ni ahi yɛ enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ. Woloŋmaa bɛ naagbee, ni nikasemɔ tuutu lɛ gbɔmɔtso tɔlɛ ni.
Sane tso muu lɛ ni onu lɛ fɛɛ naagbee nɛ. She Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni oye ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ enɛ ji nitsumɔ kwraa ni gbɔmɔ yɔɔ tsɔmɔ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo wɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔfee gbɛfaŋ, ehi jio, ehiii jio, teemɔŋ nibii fɛɛ fata he.

1: Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ ŋma yahã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ji heyelɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ:
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ mumɔŋ jɔɔmɔ ejɔɔ wɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, lɛ ehala wɔ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ emli dani ato jeŋ shishi, koni wɔfee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni wɔhe akahi kpa ko yɛ ehiɛ.
Ni ejɛ suɔmɔ mli ejie wɔ eto ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ ebii yɛ Yesu Kristo hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ naa lɛ;
koni akɛjie edromɔ ni ekɛdro wɔ yɛ mɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ mli lɛ anumyam lɛ yi.
Lɛ emli wɔna kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ yɛ, ni ji nɔtɔ̃mɔi afaa lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ elálɛ nɔ, yɛ edromɔ falɛ lɛ naa.
Ehã dromɔ fa kɛteke nɔ ehã wɔ yɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ehã wɔle eyiŋtoo ni ji teemɔ sane lɛ ni ekpɛ mli eto bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ Kristo mli.
Ebaahã egbɛjianɔtoo lɛ aba mli yɛ be ni sa lɛ mli, koni eŋɔ nibii fɛɛ eto yitso kome shishi yɛ Kristo mli, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Lɛ emli wɔna gboshinii lɛ hu yɛ, wɔ mɛi ni ajie wɔ ato yɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nibii fiaa lɛ gbɛjianɔtoo naa, yɛ eyiŋ ni eto bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ lɛ naa,
bɔ ni afee ni wɔ mɛi ni wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Kristo nɔ lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ enumnyam lɛ yijiemɔ.
Lɛ emli akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni awo he shi lɛ sɔo nyɛ hu nyɛnaa yɛ be ni nyɛnu anɔkwale lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ji yiwalaheremɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ji wɔgboshinii lɛ ayibaafoonɔ kɛyaashi Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enii lɛ hã enumnyam lɛ yijiemɔ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ mi hu, be ni minu nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ,
mifɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shidaa, shi mikaiɔ nyɛ yɛ misɔlemɔi amli,
koni wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji anumnyam Tsɛ lɛ ahã nyɛ nilee kɛ kpoijiemɔ mumɔ yɛ le ni nyɛaale lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli.
Nyɛmligbɛ hiŋmɛii anɔ atse, koni nyɛna nyɛle nɔ ni ji hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni yɔɔ etsɛmɔ lɛ mli, kɛ egboshinii lɛ anumnyam lɛ falɛ yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi amli,
kɛ nɔ ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ dalɛ ni tekeɔ nɔ babaoo hãa wɔ mɛi ni wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ yɛ enyɛmɔ hewalɛ nitsumɔ lɛ naa lɛ.
Hewalɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ etsu yɛ Kristo mli, be ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni ekɛ lɛ ta eninejurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛiiniiaŋ,
yɛ onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi ni awo, jeee be nɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ, shi be ni baabalɛ mli hu lɛ anɔ.
Ni ekɛ nibii fiaa ewo enajiashi, ni ekɛ lɛ efee nibii fɛɛ yitso ehã asafo lɛ
ni ji egbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ lɛ mɔ ni ewoɔ mɛi fɛɛ obɔ̃ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli lɛ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ.
2: Nyɛ hu kulɛ gbohii ji nyɛ yɛ nyɛ nɔtɔ̃mɔi kɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli.
Ni nyɛnyiɛ yɛ mli sa yɛ no je nɛɛŋ su lɛ naa, yɛ lumɔ ni yɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli hewalɛ ni ji mumɔ ni tsuɔ nii amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ toigbele bii amli lɛ naa.
Amɛteŋ wɔ fɛɛ hu wɔhi wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ sa yɛ wɔheloo akɔnɔi lɛ amli, ni wɔtsu nii ni heloo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, ni wɔbi bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu yɔɔ wɔnɔ yɛ wɔfɔmɔsu lɛ naa, tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa babaoo lɛ, etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ babaoo ni ekɛsumɔ wɔlɛ nɔ,
ni wɔ ni kulɛ gbohii ji wɔ yɛ nɔtɔ̃mɔi amli lɛ, etsiɛ wɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ hiɛ, dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala!
Ni etee wɔ kɛ lɛ shi, ni eŋɔ wɔ kɛlɛ fɛɛ eta ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ lɛ Kristo Yesu lɛ mli.
Efee enɛ koni bei ni baaba lɛ amli lɛ ejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ falɛ ni teke nɔ lɛ kpo yɛ emli ni hi hã wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala kɛtsɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ, ni enɛ lɛ, jeee nyɛmli ejɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ ni,
jeee nitsumɔi amli ejɛ koni mɔ ko akashwã.
Ejaakɛ enine naa nitsumɔnii ji wɔ, abɔ wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ahã nitsumɔi kpakpai ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto koni wɔnyiɛ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛji jeŋmajiaŋbii yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ ketiafolɔi ni akɛ niji flɔ amɛ ketia yɛ heloo mli lɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ foolɔi lɛ,
nyɛbɛ Kristo nakai be lɛ mli. Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ yɛ Israel maŋ biyeli gbɛfaŋ kɛ gbɔi yɛ kpãŋmɔi ni damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo nɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ hu, nyɛbɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko, ni nyɛbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tete yɛ je nɛɛŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ, Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ Kristo lá lɛ nɔ nyɛbɛŋkɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛji wɔhejɔlɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ kui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ efe ekome, ni ekumɔ gbogbo afabaŋ ni yɔɔ teŋ ni ji nyɛɛ lɛ.
Ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo gu Mla lɛ kitãi kɛ akpɔi lɛ, koni ekɛ mɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ abɔ gbɔmɔ hee kome yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli ni ehã hejɔlɛ aba,
ni ekpãtã amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ, nɔ nɔ ni egbe nyɛɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Ni eba ebajaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ enɔ wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa gbɛ, yɛ Mumɔ kome mli, kɛyaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ jeee gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ananemɛi maŋbii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii,
ni atswa nyɛ ama bɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ shishitoo lɛ ni ekoŋtɛ ji Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ.
Emli atswa tsu muu lɛ fɛɛ afee ekome yɛ, ni eeda eefee Sɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli;
ni emli atswaa nyɛ awoɔ afee Nyɔŋmɔ shihilɛhe yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ.
3: Enɛ hewɔ ni mi, Paulo, ni miji Kristo Yesu gboklɛfonyo hã nyɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ,
kɛji nyɛnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ edromɔ ehã mi hã nyɛsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ,
kpojiemɔ nɔ etsɔ̃ ehã mile teemɔ sane lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni miŋma nyɛ fioo momo lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛkane lɛ, nyɛaanyɛ nyɛyoo akɛ mina Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ shishi.
Teemɔ sane nɛɛ, yinɔi ni eho lɛ mli lɛ ahãaa gbɔmɛiabii ale, tamɔ bɔ ni agbɛnɛ ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ ebɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
No ji akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ hu niyelɔi lɛ ekomɛi kɛ gbɔmotso lɛ henii lɛ ekomɛi kɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hu ekomɛi ji amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Sanekpakpalɛ nɔ.
No he sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nikee nii ni aatsɔ̃ ehewalɛ nitsumɔnɔ akɛhã mi lɛ naa,
mi ni miji bibioo fe hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akɛ nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ ehã mi, akɛ mijaje Kristro nifalɛ ni anyɛɛɛ shishi ana lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ.
Ni mihã mɛi fɛɛ ana teemɔ sane lɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ faŋŋ, teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ yinɔi ni eho lɛ amli kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ mli lɛ,
koni agbɛnɛ atsɔ̃ asafo lɛ nɔ ahã onukpai kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ hegbɛyɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ ale Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi pii anɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ fee nii nɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ enaanɔ yiŋ ni eto yɛ Kristo Yesu, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli lɛ naa.
Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔna ekãa ni wɔkɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ hewalɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ miikpa nyɛ fai, ni nyɛnijiaŋ akaje wui yɛ mimanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛnumnyam ni.
Enɛ hewɔ ni midrɔɔ minakutsei mihãa Tsɛ lɛ,
mɔ mli ni nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ, "tsɛ" yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ jɛ lɛ.
Ni yɛ enumnyam falɛ naa lɛ ehã nyɛtsɔ̃ e-Mumɔ lɛ nɔ nyɛhe awa kpiŋtiŋŋ yɛ nyɛmli gbɔmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ,
ni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni Kristo ahi shi yɛ nyɛtsui amli, ni nyɛshishifã amɔ shi ni nyɛma shi shiŋŋ yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
Miisɔle ni nyɛna hewalɛ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ ayoo Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ lɛɛmɔ kɛ ekɛlɛ kɛ enɔkwɔlɛ kɛ emlikwɔlɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛle esuɔmɔ ni teke nilee fee lɛ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ ayimɔ nyɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ efeɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ babaoo fe nii fɛɛ ni wɔkpaaa he fai loo wɔjwɛŋɔ, yɛ ehewalɛ ni tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli lɛ naa lɛ.
lɛ aŋɔ anumnyam ahã yɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!
4: No hewɔ lɛ mi ni miji gboklɛfonyo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa tsɛmɔ ni akɛtsɛ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛnyiɛa kɛ heshibaa fɛɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ fɛɛ kɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ ni nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe kɛ suɔmɔ.
Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ kpãa ni fiɔ nyɛ lɛ ato ekomefeemɔ ni jɛɔ Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔtso kome kɛ Mumɔ kome yɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ kome ji nɔ ni yɔɔ tsɛmɔ ni atsɛ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ kome, hemɔkɛyeli kome baptisimɔ kome
Nyɔŋmɔ kome, mɛi fɛɛ a-Tsɛ kome nɔ ni yɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli ni eyɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Shi wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, akɛ dromɔ lɛ ehã lɛ yɛ Krsito nikeenii asusumɔ lɛ naa.
No hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni eŋɔ nomi anom, ni ekɛ nikeenii hã gbɔmɛi."
Shi ni akɛɛ ekwɔ lɛ, te eshishiŋ, kɛjeee shi hu ekpleke kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ shishiniiaŋ tsutsu lɛ?
Mɔ ni kpleke shi lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ hu ji mɔ ni kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛii fɛɛ ayiteŋ, koni eyi nii fiaa obɔ̃ lɛ.
Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehã mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃mɔ bɔfoi, mɛi komɛi lɛ gbalɔi, mɛi komɛi hu Sanekpakpashiɛlɔi, ni mɛi komɛi hu nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔi.
Efee enɛ koni akɛsaa hetselɔi lɛ ahã sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ tswaa,
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔɔshɛ ekomefeemɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ ehe nilee mli lɛ he. Ni wɔfee nuu ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo emuuyeli lɛ susumɔ naa;
koni wɔkakã he wɔfee abifabii ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hosoɔ amɛ tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ nii, ni ekplaa amɛ kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ gbɔmɛi aŋaafɔŋtoo kɛ kutumpɔo ni akɛshisiuɔ mɛi lɛ naa.
Shi moŋ wɔfee anɔkwafoi yɛ Suɔmɔ mli, ni wɔdra yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ tamɔ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ.

Lɛ emli gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔ fɛɛ talɔ ni ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ emɔmɔɔ ehe eshimɔshimɔɔ ehe nɔ yɛ. Ni ehe mɔɔ ehe, ni kɛ henɔ fɛɛ henɔ miitsu enii jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehãa gbɔmɔtso lɛ daa, ni emaa ehe yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ miikɛɛ ni miima nɔ mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, akɛ nyɛkanyiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋbii lɛ nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛyaka jwɛŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ dɔŋŋ,
ejaakɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli ewo duŋ. Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wala gbɛfaŋ, akɛni nilee ekaaa amɛ ni amɛtsui hu ekpliŋ lɛ.
Amɛbɛ henumɔnii dɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛŋɔ amɛhe amɛhã nyenyeŋtswibɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ hiɛjoomɔ tsuɔ nyaŋemɔ nii fɛɛ kwa.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, jeee nakai nyɛkase Kristo lɛ,
Kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛnu ehe, ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii yɛ emli hu, tamɔ bɔ ni ji anɔkwale yɛ Yesu mli lɛ,
akɛ nyɛshɛ nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ momo yɛ nyɛsa jeŋba lɛ naa gbɔmɔ ni efite yɛ shishiumɔ sɛɛdii lɛ anaa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃.
Ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi heei yɛ mumɔ ni nyɛkɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ,
ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni abɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ nɔ yɛ anɔkwa jalɛ kɛ hetsemɔ mli, tamɔ atade.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛshɛa amale nyɛfɔa ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awie anɔkwale, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso kome henii ji wɔ.
Nyɛmli afūa, shi nyɛkafea esha; hulu akanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛmlifu lɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ nyɛkaŋmɛa abonsam lɛ gbɛ.
Mɔ ni juɔ lɛ ekaju dɔŋŋ, shi ebɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniji atsu nitsumɔ kpakpa, koni ena nɔ ko ni ekɛhã mɔ ni ehia lɛ lɛ.
Wiemɔ sha ko wiemɔ sha ko akaje nyɛnaa kwraa; shi moŋ wiemɔ ni hi ni ehia koni ehã mɔ nane amɔ shi ni akɛdro mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛkafea Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nidɔɔnii; lɛ emli lɛ asɔo nyɛnaa yɛ ato kpɔ̃mɔ gbi lɛ.
Nyɛhãa mlijoomɔ kɛ mlila kɛ mlifu kɛ blɔmɔ kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ sɛɛ afoa yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Shi nyɛmli ahia ahãhãa nyɛhe, nyɛmusuŋ atsɔ̃tsɔ̃a nyɛ yɛ nyɛhe, nyɛkɛfafaa nyɛhe, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛfa nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.
5: No hewɔ lɛ nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ bii ni asumɔɔ.
Ni nyɛnyiɛa yɛ suɔmɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhewɔ akɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔle ni akɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni jeɔ ŋma krɔŋŋ lɛ.
Shi ajwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ fɛɛ loo hiɛjoomɔ lɛ akatsi tã tete yɛ nyɛteŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi.
Nakai nɔŋŋ akatsī hiɛgbejianitsumɔ kɛ kwashiaiawiemɔ kɛ fɛoyeli ni ji nibii ni esaaa lɛ tã yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ akɛ, ajwamaŋbɔlɔ ko ajwamaŋbɔlɔ ko loo hiɛjoolɔ ko ni ji wɔŋjalɔ bɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ Kristo kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ wiemɔ foji miishishiua nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa toigbelebii lɛ anɔ lɛ,
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akabɔa amɛhe.
Ejaakɛ sa lɛ duŋ ji nyɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; nyɛnyiɛa tamɔ la bii.
Ejaakɛ la lɛ yibii jeɔ kpo yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ anɔkwale fɛɛ mli.
Nyɛkaa nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛna nɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ;
ni nyɛkatsua duŋ nitsumɔi ni wooo yibii lɛ eko, shi nyɛjiea amɛ shi.
Ejaakɛ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛteɔ lɛ, eyɛ hiɛgble akɛ aaatsi tã tete.
Shi nii fɛɛ ni akɛ la jieɔ amɛ shi lɛ, anaa lɛ faŋŋ; ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni anaa lɛ faŋŋ lɛ, la ni.
No hewɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, bo mɔ ni owɔɔ lɛ, ni ote shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni Kristo aaatso ahã o!"
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ bɔ ni nyɛaanyiɛ nyɛhã, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni leee nii, shi moŋ tamɔ nilelɔi,
mɛi ni tsuɔ amɛbe he nii, ejaakɛ gbii nɛɛ gbii fɔ̃ɔji ni.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkafea nyɛhe mɛi ni bɛ yitsoŋ, shi moŋ nyɛyoa nii ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ.
Ni nyɛkatrɔa dãa, nɔ mli ni yakayaka jeŋba yɔɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛyimɔa obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ,
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe awiewiea yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, nyɛlaa ni nyɛtswaa saŋku yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Nyɛdaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa yɛ nii fiaa hewɔ yɛ wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli,
ni nyɛbabaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ Kristo gbeyeishemɔ mli.
Nyɛ yeigbayei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwumɛi lɛ, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛfeɔ nyɛhãa.
Ejaakɛ wu lɛ ji ŋa lɛ yitso, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu ji asafo lɛ yitso, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji gbɔmɔtso ni ji asafo lɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ.
Shi tamɔ bɔ ni asafo lɛ baa ehe shi ehãa Kristo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ yei lɛ hu afee ahã amɛwumɛi lɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ asafo lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ ehewɔ,
koni ekɛ hejuu yɛ nu mli kɛ wiemɔ atsuu ehe ni ehã efee krɔŋkrɔŋ,
koni eŋɔ lɛ edamɔ shi ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɛ anumnyam asafo ni kpa ko loo nɔ kūaikūai ko loo nakai nɔ ko bɛ ehe, shi moŋ efee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ.
Nakai sa akɛ wumɛi hu asumɔ amɛŋamɛi, tamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei. Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eŋa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esumɔɔ,
Ejaakɛ mɔ ko enyɛko lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo dã, shi moŋ elɛɔ lɛ ni ehiɛɔ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ asafo lɛ;
ejaakɛ egbɔmɔtso henii ji wɔ.
"Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ heloo kome."
Teemɔ sane ni tsii nɛ; mi lɛ mikɛtoɔ Kristo kɛ esafo lɛ he.
Shi ekɔɔ nyɛ hu nyɛhe ekomekome; esa akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asumɔ eŋa, tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe; koni ŋa lɛ ashe ewu.
6: Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi lɛ atoi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; ejaakɛ enɛ ja.
"Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ," no ji klɛŋklɛŋ kitã ni hiɛ shiwoo akɛ,
"Koni ahi ahã o, ni otsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Ni nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, shi moŋ nyɛlɛa amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ ewiemɔkɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ, tamɔ akɛ nyɛmiifee nyɛhã Kristo;
jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni atoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛsalɛ, shi tamɔ Kristo tsuji ji jieɔ amɛmusuŋ amɛfeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii,
ni amɛkɛ tsuijurɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɛi.
Ni nyɛle akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nyɔŋ ji lɛ jio, odehe jio, nɔ ekpakpa ni efeɔ lɛ, no he nyɔmɔwo ebaana kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Ni nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ, nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ni nyɛfɔ̃a amɛhe gbeyeiwoo ni nyɛle akɛ nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛ egbɛfaŋ.
Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛhe awaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ nyɛmɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ abonsam ŋaatsɔ̃i lɛ ana nyɛdamɔ.
Ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɛi wɔkɛna lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ onukpayelii kɛ hegbɛi kɛ je nɛɛŋ duŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji ni yɔɔ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɔlɔa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ amɛnaa nyɛkpee yɛ gbi fɔŋ le nɔ, ni be ni nyɛgbe fɛɛ naa lɛ nyɛnyɛ shi nyɛdamɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛkɛ anɔkwale afia nyɛhɛ ni nyɛwo jalɛ dama lɛ
ni nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ awo nyɛnaji;
nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyehiɛa hemɔkɛyeli tsɛŋ lɛ mli; no nyɛkɛaanyɛ mɔfɔŋ lɛ gaimlibii ni tsoɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛgbe lɛ;
ni nyɛŋɔa yiwalaheremɔ akɛ dadefai, kɛ mumɔŋ klaŋte ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ fɛɛ asɔlea be fɛɛ be yɛ mumɔ mli, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛsraa, ni nyɛkãa he daa nyɛkpaa fai nyɛhãa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ fɛɛ
kɛ mi hu, koni kɛ migble minaa lɛ, akɛ wiemɔ awo minaa nii mikɛ ekãa ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ mli teemɔ sane lɛ
ni mitsuɔ he nii akɛ bɔfo yɛ kɔ̃sɔŋkɔ̃sɔ mli nɛɛ. Nyɛkpaa fai koni yɛ ejajemɔ lɛ mli lɛ mawie kɛ ekãa bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ.
Shi bɔ ni afee ni nyɛ hu nyɛle bɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛ nii ni mitsuɔ lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ nyɛmi Tihiko ni ji sɔ̃ɔlɔ anɔkwafo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ aaagba nyɛ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛle bɔ ni wɔyɔɔ, ni ehã nyɛtsui anyɔ nyɛmli.
Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛmimɛi lɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ ahi shi. Amen!

1: Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ye shikpɔji oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo nɔ akɛ maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ India aahuu kɛyashi Etiopia.
Susa maŋ lɛ mli ji he ni emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ yɔɔ, ni jɛi ejɛɔ ni eyeɔ maji lɛ anɔ.
Emaŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ ehã elumɛi kɛ etsuji fɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli. Mɛi okplɔ̃ ni eŋmɛ lɛ ji Persia kɛ Media shikpɔji lɛ anɔ tatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amralofoi lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɔ nyɔji ekpaa, ni ekɛjie emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ he nibii ni woɔ ehiɛ nyam, asaŋ ni tsɔ̃ɔ egbojee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ.

Be ni akɛ nibii lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ agbe naa lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsɛ mɛi wujiwuji kɛ mɛi bibii hu fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli nakai beiaŋ lɛ okplɔ̃, gbii kpawo yɛ trom ko ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ he lɛ kpote lɛ mli.

Bɔ ni awula kpote lɛ mli ahã nɛ. Akɛ tɛi eŋɔlii kɛ tɛi yɛji kɛ tɛi bluu kɛ tɛi diji eka kpo lɛ nɔ; ni akɛ tɛi yɛji akulashiŋi emamɔ tɛi ni aka lɛ anɔ. Jwiɛtɛi gai yɛ akulashiŋi nɛɛ ahe. Akɛ kpãa yɛŋ fɛɛfɛo kɛ kpãa afaseo emɔmɔ mamai yɛji fɛɛfɛji kɛ mamai bluu lɛ hu anaa; kɛkɛ ni akɛŋmlɔ jwiɛtɛi akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ, ni ehã mamai lɛ tsotsro shi. Mlikpãmɔ saatsei pɛmpɛbii ni akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi fee mamɔ kpote lɛ mli hei komɛi.
Gbi lɛ awo dãa yɛ shika kpuji srɔtoisrɔtoi amli. Maŋtsɛ lɛ hã awo mɛi ni ekpee lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edãa ni enuɔ lɛ eko babaoo, bɔ ni ewo ehiɛ nyam akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ wo ewe lɛ mli tsuji lɛ mla akɛ ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ dãa bɔ ni mɔ lɛ baanyɛ anu; mɔ ni enuuu lɛ akɛkafi enɔ; ni mɔ ni baanu lɛ akakama lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Maŋnyɛ Vashti ŋmɛ yei sɔŋŋ hu okplɔ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli diɛŋtsɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ be ni dãa lɛ ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ mli efli lɛ lɛ, etsɛ epaifoi kpawo ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ. Amɛji Mehuman kɛ Bizta kɛ Harbona kɛ Biztha kɛ Abagta kɛ Zeter kɛ Karkas.
Kɛkɛ ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛya koni amɛyaŋɔ Maŋnyɛ Vashti kɛba ehiɛ; ebu emaŋnyɛ fai lɛ kɛba. Anɔkwa emaŋnyɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo jogbaŋŋ, ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh miitao akɛ egbɔi lɛ ana emaŋnyɛ lɛ he fɛo lɛ.
Shi Maŋnyɛ Vashti kwa, ni eyaaa tsɛmɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu piafoi lɛ akɛ abatsɛ lɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ mli fu naakpa ni emli wo la.
Kɛji sane ko ba nɛkɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh sumɔɔ akɛ ebi ŋaawoo yɛ nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni le shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mlai amli kɛ saneyeli mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ adɛŋ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ etsɛ eŋaawolɔi lɛ.
Mɛi adɛŋ ŋaawoo ni efɔɔ bimɔ ji Karshena kɛ Shetar kɛ Admata kɛ Tarshish kɛ Meres kɛ Marsena kɛ Memukan ni ji Persia kɛ Media lumɛi ni hiɛ gbɛnai wujiwuji yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ.
Ekɛɛ ŋaawolɔi nɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛni, yɛ mla lɛ naa, esa akɛ afeɔ Maŋnyɛ Vashti akɛni mi, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh, mitsu piafoi kɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ?"

Kɛkɛ ni Memukan kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ akɛ, "Jeee Nii Maŋtsɛ kɛkɛ nɔ Maŋnyɛ Vashti etɔ̃ lɛ, shi moŋ etɔ̃ lumɛi fɛɛ kɛ majimaji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh shishi shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ lɛ mli bii lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji ayagba akɛ, 'Naa, Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh fã akɛ ayatsɛ Maŋtsɛ Vashti abahã lɛ lɛ, maŋnyɛ lɛ baaa lɛ,' sane lɛ baagbɛ eshwã yei fɛɛ ateŋ, ni ebaahã yei awumɛi ahe guɔ agbo yɛ amɛŋamɛi ahiɛ.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Persia kɛ Media lumɛi lɛ aŋamɛi ni baanu nɔ ni maŋnyɛ lɛ efee lɛ baabɔ amɛwumɛi amaniɛ. Wumɛi ahe guɔ baagbo yɛ ŋamɛi ahiɛ, ni enɛ kɛ mlifu babaoo baaba.

No hewɔ lɛ kɛji Nii Maŋtsɛ miisumɔ lɛ, Nii Maŋtsɛ awo akpɔ, ni aŋma ashi Persia kɛ Media mlai lɛ anɔ, (asaŋ ni akɛɛ hu) akɛ Maŋnyɛ Vashti akana Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh hiɛ dɔŋŋ. No sɛɛ lɛ, Nii, okɛ emaŋnyɛyeli lɛ ahã yoo kroko ni fe lɛ.
Kɛji ashiɛ Nii Maŋtsɛ dɛŋ akpɔ nɛɛ yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli shikpɔŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ heihei fɛɛ lɛ, ebaahã yeigbãyei fɛɛ ahiɛ asɔ amɛwumɛi, mɛi wuji kɛ mɛi bibii fɛɛ."
Ŋawoo lɛ sa Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛ elumɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fee nɔ ni Memukan kɛɛ lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsu kɛ woji kɛtee eshikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Aŋma shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ wolo lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niŋmãa kɛ ewiemɔ mli akɛ, "Nuu fɛɛ nuu lɛ, lɛ eye ewe nɔ; ni nɔ ni lɛ ebaakɛɛ lɛ, no afee naagbee."
2: Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ, be mli ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh mlila lɛ naa eba shi tete po lɛ, kɛfee lɛ ekaiɔ Vashti kɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ, kɛ nɔ hu ni afee lɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko wo maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nii Maŋtsɛ, hã atao oblayei froi ni ahe yɔɔ fɛɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ahã bo.

Maŋtsɛ baanyɛ eto tsuji yɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ koni amɛbua oblayei froi ni ahe yɔɔ fɛo lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛba yei awe lɛ mli yɛ Susa, ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli. Atu oblayei nɛɛ awo Hegai ni ji maŋtsɛ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ yei asaji anɔ lɛ dɛŋ koni ekwɛ ni ahiɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Ni oblayoo ni baasa maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, Nii Maŋtsɛ aŋɔ lɛ akɛ maŋnyɛ ato Vashti najiaŋ." Maŋtsɛ lɛ na akɛ ŋaawoo lɛ hi, ni no hewɔ lɛ eye nɔ.
Nakai be mli lɛ Yudanyo ko yɛ Susa, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mordekai. Benyaminnyo Yair bi ji lɛ, ni efeɔ Shimei nabi kɛ Kish nanakansua.
Eshi nomii ni fata Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yekonia he lɛ anɔ, be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yaŋɔ Yekonia nom kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛba Babilon lɛ.

Be ni Mordekai baa lɛ ekɛ etsɛkwɛ̃ ko biyoo ko ba, ejaakɛ awusa ni. Oblanyo nɛɛ gbɛi ji Ester, shi Hebri mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Hadasa. Oblayoo lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni ehiɛŋtso yɛ akɔnɔ pam. Be ni enyɛ kɛ etsɛ fɛɛ gboi lɛ, Mordekai ŋɔ lɛ ekɛfee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebiyoo.
Be ni ashiɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kitã kɛ akpɔ lɛ, ni abua olayei pii anaa kɛtee Susa mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Ester fata he eko kɛtee, ni akɛ amɛ yahã Hegai yei akwɛlɔ lɛ.

Ester hiɛ ba nyam yɛ Hagai hiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ etsɛɛɛ kwraa kɛkɛ ni Hagai kɛ mui kɛ niyenii kpakpai kuma Ester. Fee sɛɛ lɛ Hagai jie Ester ni ekɛ lɛ yato yei awe lɛ mli he ko ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni eje gbɛ hu ehala oblayei kpawo yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli ablawai lɛ ateŋ, ni ekɛ amɛ to Ester he koni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ.
Ŋaa ni Mordekai wo Ester hewɔ lɛ, Etser (kɛ ŋaawoo lɛ to eyiŋ) ni egbaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko emaŋ kɛ eweku mli ni ejɛ.
Daa gbi lɛ Mordekai yashraa shi yɛ yei awe lɛ kpo lɔ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni ele bɔ ni Ester yɔɔ, kɛ bɔ ni eyaa nɔ ehãa.

Be ni ayeɔ akɛsaa oblayoo gbɔmɔtso ji nyɔji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Oblayoo lɛ kɛ mire mu gbɔleɔ egbɔmɔtso nyɔji ekpaa; ni ekɛ nyɔji ekpaa kroko hu kpaa krɔboɔ kɛ tsofãkɛŋmai. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, atoɔ naa ni aŋɔɔ oblayoo fɛɛ oblayoo akɛyahãa Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni oblayoo lɛ biɔ lɛ ahãa lɛ yɛ yei awe lɛ mli ni ekɛ saa ehe kɛyaa maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.

Eyaa maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ gbɛkɛ, ni enɔ leebi lɛ akplaa lɛ kɛyaa yei awe kroko mli, ni akɛ lɛ yawoɔ Shaashgaz, maŋtsɛ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ hemɛi lɛ, dɛŋ. Oblayoo lɛ eyaaa maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ bɛja maŋtsɛ lɛ ena ehe tsui ni etsu kɛ yoo lɛ gbɛi akɛ atsɛ lɛ ahã lɛ.

Agbɛnɛ ebashɛ Ester ni ji Mordekai tsɛkwɛ̃ Abihail biyoo mɔ ni eŋɔ lɛ efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaya maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Ester diɛŋtsɛ biii nɔ ko nɔ ko koni ekɛsaa ehe kɛya. Nɔ ni Hegai, maŋtsɛ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ yei lɛ, kɔ hã lɛ lɛ, no Ester kɛsaa ehe. Ni Ester he fee mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ lɛ akɔnɔ pam.
Kɛkɛ ni aŋɔ Ester ayahã Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli we lɛ mli. Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji kpawo lɛ mli Tebet nyɔŋ lɛ ni ji nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ akɛ Ester yahã lɛ lɛ.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ sumɔ Ester fe oblayei krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Ester hiɛ ba nyam jogbaŋŋ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ fe yei fɛɛ; ni ena ehe miishɛɛ fe oblayei lɛ fɛɛ ni no hewɔ lɛ ekɛ maŋnyɛyeli akekre lɛ fi Ester yitso kɛkɛ ni ewo lɛ maŋnyɛ yɛ Vashti najiaŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple ekɛwo Ester hiɛ nyam; ni ekpee eshishi lumɛi kɛ etsuji fɛɛ kɛba okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi. Ehã eshishi shikpɔji lɛ ye gbi ko akɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi; ni ekekee mɛi nii babaoo bɔ ni sa maŋtsɛ. Mordekai here Maŋtsɛ lɛ yiwala
Be ko hu be ni abua oblayei lɛ anaa ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ ahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, no mli lɛ Mordekai shi maŋtsɛ koishi onukpai lɛ anɔ.
Nɛkɛ be mli fɛɛ lɛ Ester egbako mɔ ko kwraa akɛ Yudayoo ji lɛ, taakɛ bɔ ni Mordekai ewo lɛ kitã lɛ. Ejaakɛ Ester miiye Mordekai gbee nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ tamɔ be mli ni Mordekai kwɛɔ enɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.

Be mli ni Mordekai tsuɔ nii yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ koishi lɛ, Bigtan kɛ Teresh, maŋtsɛ piafoi enyɔ komɛi ni shi mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli shinaai anaa lɛ ahe lɛ, na maŋtsɛ lɛ he mlifu; ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbaagbe Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh.
Be ni Mordekai na nu yiŋtoo nɛɛ lɛ, eyakɛɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester; ni Ester hu bɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ lɛ ni Mordekai ebabɔ lɛ lɛ.

Be ni atao sane lɛ mli lɛ, ebakã shi faŋŋ akɛ eyɛ mli anɔkwale. No hewɔ lɛ asɛŋ Bigtan kɛ Teresh yɛ tso nɔ, ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh fã, ni aŋma sane nɛɛ awo Yinɔ Asaji wolo lɛ mli yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hiɛ.
3: Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh wo nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Haman lɛ maŋsɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa ni fe fɛɛ. Haman nɛɛ tsɛ gbɛi ji Hamedata, ni ejɛ Agag seshi mli.
Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh fã akɛ etsuji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ esɔ̃ɔmɔ mli lɛ akula ni amɛkoto Haman be fɛɛ be. Tsuji lɛ fɛɛ fee nakai ja Mordekai pɛ ni ekotooo Haman.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsuji krokomɛi lɛ bi Mordekai akɛ, "Mɛɛba otɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ kitã lɛ?"

Be ni tsuji lɛ kɛ Mordekai ekplɛɛɛ akɛ eeekoto Haman lɛ, Mordekai kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ Yudanyo ji lɛ ni no hewɔ lɛ enyɛŋ ekoto Haman. Tsuji lɛ yabɔ Haman amaniɛ koni amɛkwɛ kɛji Haman baakplɛ nɔ ehã Mordekai lo.
Ni be ni Haman na akɛ Mordekai kulãaa lɛ lɛ, ni ekotooo lɛ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Haman mli fu naakpa.

Akɛni akɛɛ Haman akɛ Yudanyo ji Mordekai hu hewɔ lɛ, Haman to eyiŋ akɛ ekpãtãŋ Mordekai kome kɛkɛ hiɛ, shi moŋ ekɛ Mordekai he nu baaju Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh matsɛyeli shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ahe.

Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nisan lɛ nɔ lɛ, Haman hã abɔ̃i oshiki, ni ji Pur, fɔ̃ɔ daa gbi kɛtao gbi ni hi hã eyiŋtoo lɛ he nitsumɔ. Afɔ̃ oshiki nɛɛ aahuu kɛyashi nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni ji Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni Haman kɛɛ maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh akɛ, "Nii, Gbɔmɛi komɛi egbɛ eshwã omaŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji kɛ akpokpai fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛ lɛ esro amɛkusum kwraa yɛ maŋbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ he, ni amɛyeee maŋtsɛ mlai lɛ anɔ hu. Enɛ lɛ esaaa akɛ Nii aŋmɛ gbɛ nakai.

Kɛji esa Nii Maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, no lɛ Nii awo akpɔ akɛ agbe amɛ. Kɛji maŋtsɛ kplɛ̃ nɔ nakai lɛ, no lɛ miiwo shi akɛ mahã jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei nyɔŋma koni akɛwo maŋ fotro lɛ mli koni akɛtsu maŋ lɛ he nii."
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ jie ewolonaasɔomɔ waoga ni ewo lɛ yɛ enine, ni ekɛhã Hamedata bi Haman ni ji Yudafoi lɛ ahenyɛlɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛɛ Haman akɛ, "Gbɔmɛi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni jio, shikai ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ni jio mikɛ fɛɛ ewo odɛŋ. Feemɔ amɛ bɔ ni osusuɔ akɛ esa."

No hewɔ lɛ afi lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Haman kpee maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔi lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛnaa bakpe shi. Amɛŋma wolo lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Haman fã amɛ akɛ amɛŋma lɛ koni akɛyahã amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi ni kwɛɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli onukpa fɛɛ onukpa hu. Shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ aŋma ewolo lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniŋmãa mli, ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ lɛ aŋma ewolo lɛ yɛ ewiemɔ mli. Aŋmla woji lɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh gbɛi mli, ni akɛ ewolonaasɔomɔ waoga lɛ sɔo naa.

Kɛkɛ ni akɛ woji lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛtee maŋtsɛ lɛ shishi shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Wiemɔ ni yɔɔ woji lɛ amli ji akɛ gbi kome jenamɔ, ni ji nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni ji Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aplenee Yudafoi ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he, oblahii jio, hiimeji jio, gbekɛbii jio, yei, jio agbe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akɛbule amɛshishi ni asaŋ aha nibii ni amɛyɔɔ.
Wolo lɛ fã hu akɛ Shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, ashiɛ akpɔ nɛɛ koni maji fɛɛ ana ale koni asaa he ato gbi ni ato lɛ.

Bɔfoi lɛ kɛ woji lɛ shi kɛfoi yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fãmɔ naa kɛtee shikpɔji lɛ anɔ. Ashiɛ akpɔ lɛ yɛ Susa ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli hu. Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛ Haman ho tra shi ni amɛnu dãa, be mli ni akpɔ lɛ ehã Susa maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ejijaa lɛ.
4: Be ni Mordekai na le nibii fɛɛ ni afee lɛ, ekɛ awerɛhoo gbla ehe atadei lɛ, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu; asaŋ eloo lamlu ewo eyiteŋ. Kɛkɛ ni eje kpo kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli kɛ yaafo gegeege.
Etee eyawa maŋtsɛwe lɛ agbo lɛ naa; ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ebuɔ kpekpe kɛboteɔ maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ mli.

Shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kitã kɛ akpɔ lɛ yashɛ lɛ, ŋkɔmɔyeli kpeteŋkple bagbee shi yɛ jɛi Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ. Amɛhi ŋmãa, amɛyeŋkɔmɔ, amɛwo yara amɛfo, ni mɛi babaoo klɔ kpekpe amɛbu, ni amɛho amɛkamɔ lamlu mli.
Be ni Ester ablawai lɛ kɛ epiafoi lɛ bagba lɛ nɔ ni Mordekai feɔ lɛ, Ester ye jramɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Etsu ni akɛ atadei tee yahã Mordekai koni ekɛtsake kpekpe lɛ yɛ ehe; shi Mordekai heee atadei lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Etser tsɛ Hatak, maŋtsɛ lɛ piafoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko ni ato akɛ esɔmɔ lɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ, ni etsu lɛ Mordekai ŋɔɔ koni eyatao nɔ sane ni eba lɛ kɛ nɔ ni kɛba hu.
Hatak tee Mordekai ŋɔɔ yɛ blohu ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ mli.
Mordekai gba lɛ sane ni eba enɔ lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ shika hu ni Haman ewo shi akɛ ebaana ewo maŋ fotro lɛ mli kɛji ana aplenee Yudafoi lɛ.
Ekɛ mla ni awo yɛ Susa akɛ akpãtã Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ nɔ wolo hã Hatak akɛ ekɛyatsɔ̃ɔ Ester. Asaŋ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ eya maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyakpa lɛ fai, ni ewie he ehã emaŋbii Yudafoi lɛ.
Hatek tee ni eyabɔ Ester nɔ ni Mordekai kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Ester kɛ wiemɔ tsu Hatak koni eyakɛɛ Mordekai akɛ,

"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio ni eeeya eyanina maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ trukaa, be mli ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuko kɛ mɔ lɛ gbɛi tuuŋtu akɛ atsɛ mɔ lɛ ahã lɛ lɛ, mla ni kã shi ji akɛ abaagbe mɔ lɛ. Mla ni kã shi ni ale kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji anɔ aahuu kɛyashi maŋbii fɛɛ anɔ ji enɛ. Shi kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ wo eshika tsi lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ no dani mɔ lɛ yi naa wala. Kɛjɛ gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuko koni atsɛ mi ahã lɛ."
Be ni wiemɔ nɛɛ shɛ Mordekai dɛŋ lɛ,
Mordekai hu tsu kɛ hetoo nɛɛ koni akɛyahã Ester, "Kaasusu akɛ ni oyɔɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ bo lɛ ohe baaje Yudafoi fɛɛ asane nɛɛ mli.

Ejaakɛ kɛji omua onaa kɛta shi yɛ nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli tete, yelikɛbuamɔ baajɛ he ko kɛ̃ aba ahã Yudafoi, ni abaahere amɛyiwala, shi bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã. Namɔ aaale akɛ eko lɛ nɛkɛ be nɛɛ hewɔ ni ahã obatsɔ̃ maŋnyɛ nɛɛ lɛ."
Ester kɛ hetoo nɛɛ tsu akɛyahã Mordekai.

"Yaa ni oyabua Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ anaa kɛkpe; ni nyɛhia ŋmãaa, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mi. Nyɛkayea nii, ni nyɛkanua nu hu shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃. Mi hu mi kɛ miblayei lɛ baahi ŋmãa nakai nɔŋŋ. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mibaya mayana maŋtsɛ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ mla eŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ nakai. Keji miyagbo yɛ no hewɔ po jiŋŋ efee nɔ ko."
Kɛkɛ ni Mordekai yiŋ etee, ni eyafee bɔ ni Ester kɛɛ eyafee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
5: Be ni Ester ehi ŋmãa gbii etɛ̃ lɛ eklɔ emaŋnyɛ atadei lɛ ewo, kɛkɛ ni ebote maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli, ni etee eyadamɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ asa lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Nakai be mli lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ asa lɛ nɔ. Eta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni ehiɛ miikwɛ asa lɛ shinaa lɛ naagbɛ.

Be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ na Maŋnyɛ Ester damɔ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ena maŋnyɛ lɛ he tsuijurɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekpã enine mli ni ekɛ shika tsi ni ehiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Ester hiɛ. Ester tsi ebɛŋkɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ enine ta tsi lɛ (yitso lɛ) he.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Maŋnyɛ Ester, mɛni sani ni; mɛni otaoɔ? Nɔ ni ji lɛ bi, ni abaafee ahã bo aahuu, kɛji mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlijaa ni po."
Ester to he akɛ, "Kɛji Nii Maŋtsɛ baasumɔ lɛ, no lɛ Nii kɛ Haman aba okplɔ̃ ko ni miiŋmɛ mahã Nii lɛ he ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ atsɛ Haman kɛba mramra koni amɛya Ester okplɔ̃ ni eŋmɛɔ lɛ lɛ he amɛyaye nii. Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Haman tee okplɔ̃ ni Maŋnyɛ Ester ŋmɛ lɛ he.
Be mli ni anuɔ wain lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ bi Ester akɛ, "Mɛni ji osane lɛ; mɛni otaoɔ? Nɔ ni ji lɛ bi, ni mafee mahã bo aahuu kɛji mi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlijaa ni po."
Ester here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

"Kɛji mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ Nii Maŋtsɛ hiɛ, ni Nii yɛ he suɔmɔ akɛ eeefee nɔ ni mabi lɛ ehã mi lɛ, no lɛ Nii kɛ Haman aba okplɔ̃ kroko ko ni mibaŋmɛ amɛ wɔ lɛ he koni mikɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ ni mabi lɛ aŋmɛ Nii hiɛ wɔ." Haman to Mordekai gbele he ŋaa
Haman shi maŋtsɛwe lɛ gbi lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ mlifimɔ. Shi be ni ena Mordekai yɛ maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi, ni Mordekai eteee shi ehãaa lɛ, asaŋ ni ehe hu kpokpooo lɛ, Haman mli wo Mordekai la naakpa.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Haman ye ehe nɔ, ni eyiŋ etee ewe lɛ, ni etsu ayatsɛ enanemɛi abahã lɛ; etsɛ eŋa Zeresh hu abafata enanemɛi lɛ ahe.
Haman kɛ enii ni eyɔɔ kɛ emusuŋbii ayifalɛ kɛ bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo enɔ grɔŋŋ kɛ bɔ ni ehiɛ hewalɛ fe lumɛi kɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ shi ehe nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Etee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Maŋnyɛ Ester po hãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ aba okplɔ̃ ni eŋmɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he akɛ ja mi, ni wɔ hu ekpee mi kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛmiiya wɔyaye nii.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni minaa Mordekai Yudanyo lɛ ta maŋtsɛ koi shi lolo lɛ mitsui etɔɔɔ."

No hewɔ lɛ eŋa lɛ kɛ enanemɛi lɛ fɛɛ wo lɛ ŋaa akɛ, "Hã akla tsei ama shi; ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Obi maŋtsɛ lɛ koni asɛŋ Mordekai yɛ nɔ wɔ leebi. No sɛɛ lɛ okɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ aya okplɔ̃ lɛ he kɛ miishɛɛ." Ŋaa ni awo nɛɛ ŋɔɔ Haman naa; ni no hewɔ lɛ ehã akla sɛŋmɔtso lɛ ama shi.
6: Nakai gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ wɔ tse yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiŋmɛiŋ. No hewɔ lɛ efã akɛ ayakɔ yinɔi asaji ahe wolo lɛ kɛba koni abakane estɔ̃ɔ lɛ.

Sane ko ni akane lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Mordekai hã ana ale akɛ Bigtan kɛ Teresh, ni ji maŋtsɛ piafoi enyɔ komɛi ni fata mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli shinai anaa ahe lɛ, to yiŋ akɛ amɛbaagbe Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi akɛ, "Mɛni afee akɛwo Mordekai hiɛ nyam yɛ nɔ ni etsu nɛɛ hewɔ?" Maŋtsɛ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni yɔɔ emasɛi lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Afeko nɔ ko nɔ ko ahãko lɛ."

Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi akɛ, "Namɔ yɔɔ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ?" No mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Haman ebashɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni eeba ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ abawie he koni asɛŋ Mordekai yɛ tso ni ehã akla ama shi ahã Mordekai sɛŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Haman eshɛ shi, edamɔ kpo lɛ nɔ." Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Hã ni eba mli!"

Be ni Haman ba lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji maŋtsɛ miisumɔ akɛ ewo nuu ko hiɛ nyam lɛ, mɛni esa akɛ afee ahã mɔ lɛ?" Haman susu yɛ eyiŋ akɛɛ, "Namɔ po maŋtsɛ baasumɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam nɛɛ akɛ ja mi?"
No hewɔ lɛ Haman hã maŋtsɛ lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Nuu lɛ ni maŋtsɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
Nii Maŋtsɛ ahã aklɔ maŋtsɛ atadei ni maŋtsɛ woɔ daa lɛ ekomɛi, ni aŋɔ okpɔŋɔ ni maŋtsɛ eta nɔ dã, ni akɛ maŋtsɛ akekre afata he.

Atu atadei kɛ okpɔŋɔ lɛ awo maŋtsɛ lumɛi onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome dɛŋ koni ekɛwula nuu lɛ ni Nii Maŋtsɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ. Nuu nɛɛ ni awoɔ ehiɛ nyam lɛ ata okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ kɛfo blohuiaŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli be mli ni onukpa lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ. Abɔ oshe kɛnyiɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ akɛ, 'Nɛkɛ abaafee ahã mɔ ni maŋtsɛ miisumɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ nɛ.'"

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Haman akɛ, "Ohe afee oya, koni oŋɔ atade kɛ okpɔŋɔ lɛ, ni oyafee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ohã Mordekai, Yudanyo lɛ, ni taa maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi lɛ. Okashi nɔ ko ni otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ afee lɛ ekoeko."

No hewɔ lɛ Haman ŋɔ atade lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔ lɛ kɛtee. Ekɛ atade lɛ yawula Mordekai, ni ehã ekwɔ eta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eta nɔ kɛfo blohuiaŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni Haman bɔ oshe kɛnyiɛ Mordekai hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, bɔ ni afeɔ ahãa mɔ ni Nii Maŋtsɛ miisumɔ akɛ ewo ehiɛ nyam lɛ nɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Mordekai ku esɛɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi; shi Haman he fee oya ni eyiŋ kɛtee ewe lɛ kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli ni eha eyi nɔ.

Egba eŋa Zeresh kɛ enanemɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ oshrã ni eyashrã lɛ lɛ. Haman nanemɛi nilelɔi lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ hu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji abɔ̃i bo shibaa yɛ Mordekai ni jɛ Yudafoi aseshi mli lɛ hiɛ lɛ, belɛ no lɛ onyɛŋ lɛ mɔ; bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaafe bo." Haman gbele
Ahiɛ sanegbaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ piafoi komɛi bashɛ shi, ni amɛbaŋɔ Haman kplakpla kɛtee Maŋnyɛ Ester okplɔ̃ŋmɛɛ lɛ he.
7: Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Haman tee amɛkɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester yaaye nii.

Be ni anuɔ dãa yɛ niyenii lɛ shi yɛ gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Ester ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Maŋnyɛ Ester, mɛni ji osane lɛ; mɛni otaoɔ? Nɔ ni ji lɛ bi, ni mafee mahã bo aahuu, kɛji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mlijaa po ni."

Maŋtsɛ Ester here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nii Maŋtsɛ, kɛji mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ ohiɛ, ni maŋtsɛ yɛ he tsuijurɔ akɛ ebaafee nɔ ni mibabi lɛ lɛ, nɔ ni mibiɔ ji akɛ akɛ miwala akɛ mi; asaŋ akɛ mimaŋbii hu awala akɛ amɛ.

Amrɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ahɔ̃ɔ wɔ, mi kɛ mimaŋbii lɛ, ahã koni akpãtã wɔhiɛ, ni agbe wɔ kɛbule wɔshishi. Eji ahɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei kɛkɛ kulɛ egbaŋ minaa, ni kulɛ mikɛŋ nɔ ko, ejaakɛ piŋmɔ ni abaapiŋ wɔ lɛ ejeee nɔ ko kwraa kɛji akɛto maŋtsɛ nii ni baafite he."
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh here nɔ, ni ebi Maŋnyɛ Ester akɛ, "Namɔ to yiŋ kɛbaafee nɛkɛ nɔ ko? Namɔ ni, ni nɛgbɛ mɔ lɛ yɔɔ?"
Maŋnyɛ Ester to he akɛ, "Wɔhenyɛlɔ kɛ wɔyinɔ apamtolɔ lɛ, lɛji Haman, gbɔmɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Haman tsui fã yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ hiɛ.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi kɛ mlifu kɛshi okplɔ̃ lɛ he kɛtee trom ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he lɛ mli. Haman na maŋtsɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi sha akɛ kɛji ena lɛ Haman lɛ efɔŋ lɛ, eeefee. No hewɔ lɛ Haman te shi koni ekpa Maŋnyɛ Ester fai koni akɛ ewala ake lɛ.

Ho ni Haman ho egbee shi yɛ saatso fioo ko ni Ester ta nɔ lɛ naa, koni ekpa lɛ fai pɛ, kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ jɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he trom lɛ mli kɛba he ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ yɛ lɛ. Ni ebanina Haman nɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Aso ebaatua maŋnyɛ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ miwe mli lo?" Maŋtsɛ lɛ naa ni nyɔɔ shi nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni piafoi lɛ ha Haman hiɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni piafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko ni gbɛi ji Harbona lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nii, bɛ Haman ekla tso ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ ema ewe lɛ akɛ ekɛbaasɛŋ Mordekai mɔ ni here oyiwala lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, "Nyɛyasɛŋa lɛ yɛ ŋɔ!"
No hewɔ lɛ atee ni ayasɛŋ Haman moŋ yɛ tso ni ekla akɛ ebaasɛŋ Mordekai yɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ mlila lɛ jɔ.
8: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ŋɔ Haman, Yudafoi lɛ ahenyɛlɔ lɛ, shīa ni ekɛhã Maŋnyɛ Ester; ni Mordekai bɔ̃i maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ yaa ejaakɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester tsɔ̃ɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh emɔ ni ji Mordekai.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ jie ewaoga ni ekɛsɔoɔ wolo naa, ni ehe yɛ Haman dɛŋ lɛ yɛ ewao ni ekɛhã Mordekai. Ester tu Haman shĩa lɛ ewo Mordekai dɛŋ koni ekwɛ nɔ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Ester kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yawie ekoŋŋ. Eyaho ekula Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh naji anaa, ni ekɛ yaafo kpa lɛ fai akɛ efo efɔŋ ni Haman, Agagnyo lɛ, eto akɛ afee Yudafoi lɛ mli ehã amɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kpã enine mli ni ekɛ tsi ni ehiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Ester hiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Ester te shi edamɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ,
ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nii, kɛji esa ohiɛ lɛ, no lɛ hã aŋmã wolo koni akɛyatsi yiŋsha ni Hamedata bi Haman, Agagnyo lɛ, to koni ekɛkpãtã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Nii Maŋtsɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ahiɛ lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ aso manyɛ naa madamɔ kɛji sane fɔŋ nɛɛ banina mimaŋbii lɛ, ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ kɛbule amɛshishi?"
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh kɛɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester kɛ Mordekai, Yudafonyo lɛ, akɛ, "Naa, mihã asɛŋ Haman yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ayinɔ ni ekpãŋ lɛ hewɔ, ni mikɛ shīa lɛ hu eke Ester.

Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛŋma Yudafoi lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaasumɔ yɛ sane nɛɛ he yɛ mi, migbɛi mli. Asaŋ nyɛkɛ miwolo naasɔomɔ ga lɛ asɔoa wolo lɛ naa, ejaakɛ wolo ni aŋmã yɛ maŋtse gbɛi mli, asaŋ ni akɛ ewolo naasɔomɔ ga lɛ esɔo naa lɛ, anyɛŋ emli sane lɛ mli afo."

Sane nɛɛ ba yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji etɛ̃ ni ji nyɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Siwan lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ. Mordekai tsɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔi lɛ kɛkpe; ni amɛŋmã wolo lɛ bɔ ni Mordekai fã akɛ amɛŋmã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni akɛtee ayahã Yudafoi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ shikpɔji srɔtoi lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ kɛjɛ India aahuu kɛbashi Sudan. Fɛɛ fee shikpɔji oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo. Shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ aŋmã ewolo lɛ yɛ lɛ eniŋmãa mli, ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ lɛ aŋmã ewolo lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewiemɔ mli. Yudafoi lɛ hu awolo lɛ aŋmã yɛ amɛniŋmãa kɛ amɛwiemɔ mli.
Mordekai hã aŋmla woji lɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh gbɛi mli, ni akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ wolonaasɔomɔ ga lɛ sɔo amɛnaa. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ woji lɛ tsu bɔfoi ni tra maŋtsɛ lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni afoijee naa wa lɛ ekomɛi anɔ kɛtee.

Woji lɛ kɛɛ akɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh ehã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ hegbɛ koni amɛbua amɛhe naa amɛbɔ asafoi ni amɛdamɔ shi kɛfã amɛhe. Kɛji mɛi komɛi aaabatua amɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ko nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ mɛi lɛ awu kɛfã amɛhe ni amɛgbe amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛ hɔi kɛ yei fɛɛ kɛbule amɛshishi; ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛha mɛi nɛɛ anibii amɛhã amɛhe,
yɛ gbi kome nɔ. Gbi nɛɛ ji nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni egbɛi ji Adar, lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyeli shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ.
Wolo lɛ fã akɛ ashiɛ emli sane lɛ akɛ akpɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ koni maŋbii fɛɛ ana ale, asaŋ koni Yudafoi lɛ asaa amɛhe amɛto nakai gbi lɛ, ni amɛtɔ amɛhe owele yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi ho tra maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ okpɔŋɔi komɛi anɔ, yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ naa, ni amɛhe fee oya amɛkɛ woji lɛ tee. Ashiɛ akpɔ nɛɛ yɛ Susa ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ hu mli.

Mordekai je maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ etee, ni ewo maŋtsɛ atade ni akɛ mama bluu kɛ mama yɛŋ akpɛ, kɛ enɔ atade wuyaa ni akɛ klala yɛŋ kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kpɛ. Shika akekre agbo fi eyitso. Susu maŋ lɛ nya ni amɛna miishɛɛ.
Yudafoi lɛ ahe tse amɛ, ni amɛnya, ni amɛmli fli amɛ jogbaŋŋ; asaŋ hiɛ sɔ amɛ.

Anɔkwa shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh shɛɛ kɛ akpɔ lɛ yashɛ lɛ, jɛi Yudafoi lɛ na miishɛɛ, ni amɛnya, ni amɛŋmɛŋmɛɛ okplɔ̃, ni amɛyeyee gbii juji. Shikpɔji anɔ bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo tsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe Yudafoi tete, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ.
9: Kɛkɛ ni nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Adar lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ bashɛ, ni ji gbi ni abaaye maŋtsɛ kitã kɛ akpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Be mli ni Yudafoi lɛ ahenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ kã nɔ akɛ amɛbaana Yudafoi lɛ anɔ hewalɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛnɔkamɔ nɛɛ tsake ekroko, ni Yudafoi lɛ moŋ na hewalɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.

Yudafoi lɛ buabua amɛhe naa kuikui yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyelihei lɛ amli majimaji lɛ amli akɛ amɛkɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni baatua amɛ lɛ baawu. Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ amɛhiɛ adamɔ, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ.
Anɔkwa, shikpɔji lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ maŋtsɛ nii ye bua Yudafoi lɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miishe Mordekai gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Mordekai etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli, ni daa gbi lɛ nɛkɛ ehewalɛ lɛ daa kɛyaa nɔ; ni egbɛi ehehe kɛkple shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ fee amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ. Amɛfã klaŋte yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbegbee amɛ, ni amɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Yɛ Susa, ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ mli lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kpãtã mɛi ohai enumɔ ahiɛ.
Amɛgbe Parshandata kɛ Dalfon kɛ Aspata,
kɛ Porata kɛ Adalia kɛ Aridata,
kɛ Parmashta kɛ Arisai kɛ Aridai kɛ Waizata,
ni ji Hamedata bi Haman, Yudafoi ahenyɛlɔi lɛ, bihii nyɔŋma lɛ fɛɛ hu. Shi Yudafoi lɛ ehaaa mɛi anii.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ayabɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh mɛi ayibɔ ni agbe yɛ Susa ni ji maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Maŋnyɛ Ester akɛ, "Yɛ Susa maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ kɛkɛ mli lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ egbegbee mɛi ohai enumɔ kɛ Haman bihii nyɔŋma lɛ hu. Belɛ te amɛfee tɛŋŋ mɔ yɛ nɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ hu? Kɛ̃lɛ mɛni oyɔɔ ni obaabi lolo? Mɛni otaoɔ ekoŋŋ, ni aaafee ahã o!"

Ester to he ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji Nii baasumɔ lɛ, aŋmɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ gbɛ koni wɔ hu lɛ, amɛfee bɔ ni amɛfee ŋmɛnɛ yɛ mla lɛ naa lɛ ekoŋŋ; asaŋ akɛ Haman bihii nyɔŋma lɛ agbohii lɛ atsotsro tso nɔ."
Maŋtsɛ lɛ fee nakai. Awo mla yɛ Susa, ni ahole Haman bihii nyɔŋma lɛ agbohii lɛ, ni akɛ amɛ tsotsro shi yɛ maŋ jranɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ bua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsaa amɛgbegbee mɛi ohai etɛ̃ yɛ Susa; shi moŋ amɛhaaa mɛi anii.

Yudafoi krokomɛi ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔyelihei krokomɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ hu buabua amɛhe naa kuikui ni amɛfã amɛwala he, ni amɛgbegbee amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ, ni amɛna hejɔlɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Shi moŋ amɛhaaa mɛi anii.
Afee nii nɛɛ yɛ Adar nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ. Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ jɔɔ amɛhe ni amɛgbeee mɔ ko. Amɛye gbi lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ, ni amɛtsɛtsɛɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ nyamɔ.

Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Susa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ gbe amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛkɛ ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe yɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛfee okplɔ̃ŋmɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ gbijurɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ akrowai amli, ni ji maji ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe lɛ, yeɔ Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ kɛ okplɔ̃ŋmɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ, ni amɛkekeɔ amɛhe nii. Purim Gbijurɔyeli lɛ
Mordekai hã aŋmlã nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ, ni ekɛ woji tsu, ni akɛyahã Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ fɛɛ,
ni ekɛfo efɔ̃ shi ehã Yudafoi lɛ akɛ amɛye Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ daa afi,

ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ anɔ Yudafoi lɛ ahe jɔ amɛ kɛjɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ. Nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ amɛwerɛhoo lɛ tsɔ̃ miishɛɛ, ni amɛkɔmɔyeli tsɔ̃ nyamɔ. No hewɔ lɛ amɛfee nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ okplɔ̃ŋmɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ kɛ henikee kɛ ohiafoi anikee gbii.
Yudafoi lɛ kɔ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ ni amɛfee tamɔ bɔ ni Mordekai ŋmã akɛ amɛfee lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ afiyeli ehã amɛ.

Haman, Hamedata, Agagnyo lɛ bi lɛ, ni fee ehe Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ ahenyɛlɔ tsɔ̃ ŋaa koni ekpãtã Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ. Efɔ̃ oshiki, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Pur lɛ, koni ena gbi nɔ ni akpãtã Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ kɛbule amɛshishi.
Shi Ester yana maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋmã wolo, ni naagbee mli lɛ ehã Yudafoi lɛ ayinɔ ŋaa fɔŋ ni Haman etsɔ̃ lɛ babua lɛ moŋ eyiteŋ, ni asaŋ lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ tso nɔ yɛ maŋ jranɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ awo gbii nɛɛ gbɛi akɛ Purim yɛ gbɛi Pur lɛ hewɔ. Wolo ni Mordekai ŋmã lɛ mli saji lɛ kɔ nɔ ni amɛ, Yudafoi lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ hu na yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli, kɛ nɔ ni ba amɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ lɛ,

Yudafoi lɛ to gbii nɛɛ akɛ gbijurɔ. Amɛfo amɛŋmɛ shi amɛhã amɛhe kɛ amɛshwiei kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni aaabadɔmɔ amɛ akɛ amɛye gbii enyɔ nɛɛ daa afi, yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli kɛbɔ hu ni ato akɛ aye amɛ ahã lɛ; ni ekaho amɛyi kɔkɔɔkɔ.

Amɛfo akɛ Yudafoi aweku fɛɛ weku ni yɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ, yɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ, yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ amli, hiɛ ahi nɛkɛ gbii enyɔ nɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛye Purim gbii nɛɛ, ni ekaho amɛyi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei akai gbii nɛɛ kɛya yinɔi ayinɔi fɛɛ.
Maŋnyɛ Ester, Abihail biyoo lɛ, kɛ Mordekai, Yudanyo lɛ, ŋma wolo yɛ hewalɛ ni amɛna lɛ naa, ni amɛkɛma Purim gbijurɔyeli lɛ he wolo ni Mordekai eŋmã lɛ nɔ aduatsɔ.

Atsu ni akɛ wolo nɛɛ tee ayahã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh nɔyelihei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ. Akɛ wolo lɛ mli wiemɔ ba omanye ahã amɛ; asaŋ abi amɛ koni amɛhi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ anɔkwale mli,
koni amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei aye Purim gbii lɛ yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni amɛto be kɛ gbɛjianɔ ni amɛkɛhiɔ ŋmãa, ni amɛkɛfeɔ yara lɛ.
Maŋnyɛ Ester wolo ni eŋmã lɛ ma nɛkɛ Purim gbijurɔyeli kusum nɛɛ nɔ aduatsɔ; ni aŋmã awo wolo mli afɔ̃ shi.
10: Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh tsu enɔyeli shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ onia kɛjɛ ŋshɔnaa aahuu kɛyagbee koiasɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
He ni egbojee shɛ kɛ nibii ni etsu yɛ ehewalɛ kɛ enyɛmɔ naa, kɛ he ni ewo Mordekai nɔ grɔŋŋ kɛyashɛ lɛ aŋmla fɛɛ yɛ Media kɛ Persia Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.

Mordekai, Yudanyo lɛ, batsɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Ahashwerosh diɛŋtsɛ sɛɛmɔ tuuŋtu, kɛ gbɔmɔ wulu hu yɛ enyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ; amɛbuɔ lɛ, ni amɛsumɔɔ esane; ni lɛ hu be fɛɛ be lɛ etao emaŋbii lɛ kɛ emɛshwiei fɛɛ ekpakpa; ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ.

1: Yakob musuŋ bihii ni fata ehe kɛtee Egipt lɛ agbɛii nɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ ewe:
Ruben kɛ Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda,
Isakar kɛ Zebulon kɛ Benyamin,
Dan kɛ Naftali kɛ Gad kɛ Asher.
Yakob shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ ji nyɔŋmai kpawo. Shi ebi Yosef lɛ, lɛ lɛ eyɛ Egipt momo.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yosef kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ nakai yinɔbii lɛ fɛɛ bagboi.
Shi amɛshwiei ni ji Israelbii lɛ, fɔfɔɔ ni amɛshwere babaoo. Amɛyi bafa, ni amɛna hewalɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛyi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ.
Agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ hee ko ni leee Yosef baye Egipt nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ kɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa, Israelbii lɛ ayi efa, ni amɛna hewalɛ hu fe wɔ.
Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ amɛ ayea ŋaa mli koni amɛyi akafa dɔŋŋ ni ebaba akɛ be ni ta ehe shi lɛ amɛyafata wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ moŋ ahe ni akɛ wɔ miiwu koni amɛjo foi kɛshi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ, Egiptbii lɛ totoo nitsumɔ nɔkwɛlɔi yɛ Israelbii lɛ anɔ koni amɛkɛ nitsumɔi keketekeketei awa amɛ yi. Israelbii mamɔ nitoo maji ni ji Pitom kɛ Rameses amɛhã Faraõ.
Shi babaoo ni Egiptbii lɛ waa Israelbii lɛ yi lɛ, babaoo moŋ ni Israelbii lɛ ayi faa ni amɛshwereɔ ji no. Enɛ hã Egiptbii lɛ atsui su Israelbii lɛ anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛhiɛ Israelbii lɛ nyɔji ahiɛmɔ shɛii.
Amɛhã amɛnaa su, ni amɛfo ntayaa, ni amɛtsu ŋmɔshi nitsumɔi srɔtoi, ni enɛ hã jeŋ shihilɛ je Israelbii lɛ atsine.
Kɛkɛ ni Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Shifra kɛ Pua, ni ji Hebriyei yoofɔlɔi lɛ, akɛ,
"Kɛji nyɛtee Hebri yei lɛ fɔmɔ ni nyɛna yɛ sɛ̃i ni yoofɔyoo lɛ taa nɔ efɔɔ lɛ shishi akɛ bi lɛ nuu ni lɛ, nyɛgbea lɛ; shi kɛji yoo ni lɛ ehi shi.'
Shi yoofɔlɔi lɛ yashe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni amɛfeee nɔ ni Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, shi moŋ amɛhere gbekɛbii hii lɛ ayiwala.
Enɛ hã Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tsɛ yoofɔlɔi lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ. Mɛɛba ni nyɛhãa gbekɛbii hii lɛ ayi naa wala lɛ?"

Yoofɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Ejaakɛ Hebriyei lɛ tamɔɔɔ Egipt yei lɛ; amɛ lɛ amɛyɛ kamkam bɔ ni be ni yoofɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ eshɛɔ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ amɛfɔ momo." 20-21. Akɛni yoofɔlɔi lɛ yashe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ to amɛ ejurɔ, ni eduro amɛ bii. Yɛ Israelbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, amɛtee nɔ amɛshwere, ni amɛna hewalɛ naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao wo emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akpɔ akɛ, "Binuu fɛɛ binuu ni Hebri yoo aaafɔ lɛ nyɛshɛa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a Nilo faa lɛ mli, shi biyoo lɛ nyɛhãa eyi anaa wala."
2: Be nɛɛ mli lɛ nuu ko ni jɛ Leviwe yaŋɔ Leviwe nɔŋŋ yoo ko.
Yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu. Ena akɛ abifao lɛ he yɛ fɛo, hewɔ lɛ ekɛ lɛ tee nyɔji etɛ̃.
Shi be ni eyanyɛɛɛ lɛ ekɛtee dɔŋŋ lɛ, etao adai kɛntɛŋ, ni ekɛ amã tsara he fɛɛ, ni ekɛ abifao lɛ ŋmɛ mli, ni eyashi lɛ ema glãi amli yɛ faa lɛ naa.
Belɛ abifao lɛ nyɛmiyoo damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ eekwɛ nɔ ni aaaba enɔ.
Farao biyoo ba ehejuu yɛ faa lɛ naa, ni eweyei lɛ miishera shi yɛ faa lɛ toi. Kɛkɛ ni ehiŋmɛi ba kɛntɛŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ glãi lɛ ateŋ, ni etsu eweyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni eyawo kɛba.
Be ni Farao biyoo lɛ gbele naa lɛ, naa abifao kã mli ni eefo. Emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ ehe, ni ekɛɛ, "Hebribii lɛ abihii lɛ eko nɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni abifao lɛ nyɛmiyoo lɛ babi Farao biyoo lɛ akɛ, "Ani miyatsɛ Hebriyoo fufɔhãlɔ ko mibahã o koni ehã lɛ fufɔ ehã o lo?"
Farao biyoo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, "Hɛɛ! Yaa!" Gbekɛyoo lɛ tee ni eyatsɛ abifao lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛba.
Ni Farao biyoo lɛ kɛɛ yoo ni ayatsɛ kɛba lɛ akɛ, "Hemɔ abifao nɛɛ koni oyakwɛ lɛ ohã mi, ni mawo o nyɔmɔ." Ehe abifao lɛ kɛtee ni eyakwɛ lɛ.
Be ni gbekɛ lɛ bada lɛ, yoo lɛ kɛ lɛ tee eyahã Farao biyoo lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ Farao biyoo bi. Ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ mijie lɛ kɛjɛ nu mli." Mose jo foi kɛtee Midian
Mose bada. Gbi ko lɛ etee eyasra emaŋbii Hebribii lɛ, ni eyana nii ni ahãa amɛtsuɔ lɛ. Ehiŋmɛiŋ, no Egiptnyo ko tswa Mose nyɛmimɛi Hebribii lɛ eko nɔ.
Mose kwɛ ehe biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni be ni enaaa mɔ ko lɛ, egbe Egiptnyo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ tee shia mli.
Je tsɛre nɔ hu Mose tee eyasra enyɛmimɛi lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ naa Hebribii enyɔ ni miinɔ. Ebi mɔ ni eye sane fɔŋ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ ni oyiɔ onyɛmi Hebrinyo?"

Mɔ ni eye sane fɔŋ lɛ hã Mose hetoo akɛ, "Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ? Gbe otaoɔ ni ogbe mi tamɔ ogbe Egiptnyo lɛ?" Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsui fã, ni ekɛɛ, "Ei, ana ale sane nɛɛ!" 15-16. Be ni Farao nu nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ lɛ, etao Mose egbe. Shi Mose jo Farao naa foi kɛtee Midian shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyahi jɛi. Mose ta nubu ko naa, ni Yetro, ni ji Midian osɔfo lɛ, biyei kpawo lɛ ba jɛi koni amɛbasha nu amɛwo tsesei amli amɛhã amɛtsɛ toi lɛ ni amɛnu.
Shi tookwɛlɔi komɛi bashwie amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Mose te shi ni efa oblayei lɛ ahe, ni ehã amɛtoi lɛ nu ehã amɛ.
Be ni oblayei lɛ ba amɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, "Te fee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛba mra nɛkɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?"
Amɛjie naa akɛ, "Egiptnyo ko bajie wɔ yɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni esaa esha nu tete ehã toi lɛ amɛnu."
Yetro bi ebiyei lɛ akɛ, "Ni nɛgbɛ nuu lɛ yɔɔ? Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛshi lɛ? Nyɛtsɛa lɛ kɛbaa koni ebaye nii"
Mose kplɛ̃, ni ekɛ Yetro hi shi. Yetro kɛ ebiyoo Zipora hã Mose gblã.
Zipora fɔ binuu, ni Mose wo lɛ Gershom ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, "Mibato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ."
Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ bagbo. Ni Israelbii lɛ dɔmɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛfo amɛtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ nu amɛkɔmɔyeli lɛ, ni ekai kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kpãŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekwɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ Isrealbii lɛ, ni amɛsane bakã etsui nɔ.
3: Mose miikwɛ eshaanuu Yetro, Midian osɔfo lɛ, toi. Gbi ko lɛ ekpla toi lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ anaigbɛ, ni eyaje Horeb, Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ lalilɛi, yɛ ŋmeitso ko mli. Mose kwɛ ŋmeitso lɛ gãa ejaakɛ eetso nɛ, shi eshãaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ matsi mabɛŋkɛ ni mayakwɛ naakpɛɛ nii nɛɛ, nɔ hewɔ ni ŋmeitso lɛ eshãaa lɛ.
Be ni Yehowa na akɛ Mose miibɛŋkɛ ni eyakwɛ lɛ, ejɛ ŋmeitso lɛ teŋ etsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Mose, Mose!" Mose here nɔ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ naa mi!"
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaatsi oba dɔŋŋ! Jiemɔ otokotai lɛ, shi he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni."
Esaa ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mi ji otsɛmɛi a Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsī ehiɛ, ejaakɛ eeshe gbeyei akɛ eeekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, mina amanehulu mli ni miwebii lɛ yɔɔ yɛ Egipt lɛ, ni minu ŋkɔmɔ blɔmɔ ni amɛblɔɔ koni abahere amɛ yɛ amɛkplalɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ hu. Amɛnidɔɔ nii lɛ kã mitsui nɔ pam.

Naa, mikpleke shi miba amɛjiemɔ yɛ Egiptbii lɛ adɛŋ, koni makpla amɛ kɛshi Egipt kɛya shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni da, ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni niyenii pii yɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ, he ni Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii yɔɔ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ akɔmɔyeli lɛ jwere mitoiŋ, ni mihiɛ tua bɔ ni Egiptbii haoɔ amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ ba ni matsu o Farao ŋɔɔ koni oyajie mimaŋ Israel kɛje Egipt."
Shi Mose kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Namɔ ji mi, ni matee Farao ŋɔɔ ni mayajie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Egipt?"
Nyɔŋmɔ to he akɛ, "Mi kɛ bo ni yaa lɛ, ni enɛ ji nɔ ni aaaye he odase akɛ mi mitsu o lɛ. Kɛji oyajie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Egipt kɛba lɛ, nyɛbaa gɔ̃ŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ he nyɛbajaa mi."
Ni Mose here nɔ akɛ, "Kɛji mitee Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ miyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsu mi nyɛ ŋɔɔ nɛɛ', ni amɛaabi mi akɛ, 'Te egbɛi hu' lɛ, te mikɛɛ amɛ tɛŋŋ?"
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Miji mɔ ni miji. Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Miji mɔ ni miji tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ.'"

Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Migbɛi kwraa nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni no yinɔi fɛɛ kɛtsɛ mi.'

Yaa ni oyabua Israel onukpai lɛ anaa, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, ni ekɛɛ, Mikwɛ, ni mina nyɛ kɛ nɔ ni afeɔ nyɛ yɛ Egipt lɛ,
ni miiwo shi akɛ majie nyɛ kɛje Egipt amanehulu lɛ mli kɛya Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ kpakpa ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.

"Israel onukpai lɛ aaabo o toi, ni okɛ amɛ aya Egipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa, Hebribii a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikpa o fai, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ ni wɔya gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ nyiɛmɔ koni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.'
Shi mi lɛ mile akɛ Egipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni nyɛya, ja anyɛ enɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ majie mihewalɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ Egipt, ni mikɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni mafee yɛ jɛi lɛ aaagbla Egipt toi, ni no sɛɛ dani eeehã nyɛya.
"Ni mahã Egiptbii ahiɛ asɔ nyɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni be ni nyɛaatee lɛ, nyɛyaŋ lɛ efolo.
Yoo fɛɛ yoo amala shika nii kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ mamai yɛ Egiptyoo ni ji ehe gbɔmɔ kɛ eshiaŋyoo dɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛwowoo nyɛbihii kɛ biyei. No nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni nyɛaakpakpaa Egiptbii lɛ ahe nii kɛaatee."
4: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Naa, Israelbii lɛ heŋ mi amɛyeŋ, amɛboŋ mi toi hu, ejaakɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa ejieko ehe kpo etsɔ̃ko bo.'"
Ni Yehowa bi Mose akɛ, "Mɛni yɔɔ odɛŋ lɛ?" Ejie naa akɛ, "Tso."
Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Shɛ ofɔ̃ shikpɔŋ!" Mose shɛ tso lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kɛkɛ ni tso lɛ tsɔ̃ onufu, ni Mose jo onufu lɛ naa foi kɛtee sɛɛ.
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kpã onine mli ni omɔ elei!" Mose kpã enine mli, ni emɔ onufu lɛ lei lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ tso ekoŋŋ yɛ edɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Enɛ amɛkɛaahe amɛye akɛ Yehowa, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔɔ o."
Asaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Abɛnɛ okɛ onine ahɔ omiinaa." Mose kɛ enine lɛ hɔ emiinaa, ni be ni ejie lɛ, naa nine lɛ ni hela ko tamɔ kpiti eshwie he fuu.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ onine ahɔ omiinaa ekoŋŋ." Esaa ekɛ enine lɛ hɔ jɛi. Be ni ejie lɛ, naa ehewolo lɛ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kɛji amɛheee bo amɛyeee, ni asaŋ amɛbooo bo toi yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ okadi lɛ naa lɛ, okadi ni ji enyɔ lɛ naa lɛ amɛaabo bo toi.

Shi kɛji amɛheee bo amɛyeee yɛ okadii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛbooo bo toi hu lɛ, no lɛ yɛɛ Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ eko ni ofɔse oshwie shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ, ni nu lɛ ni oyɛ yɛ faa lɛ mli lɛ aaatsɔ̃ lá yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ."
Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Ofai nɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ! Minaa tseee kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe, ni kɛjɛ beyinɔ hu ni okɛ mi, otsulɔ, wie nɛɛ fɛɛ, minaa tseko, ni mililɛi tsii."
Yehowa bi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ bɔ naabu hã gbɔmɔ? Namɔ bɔ mumui loo toimulɔ, loo mɔ ni naa nii loo shwilafo? Ani jeee mi, Yehowa nɛɛ nɔŋŋ?
No hewɔ lɛ yaa otsumɔ lɛ, shi mibawa bo kɛ wiemɔ, ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ o nɔ ni owie."
Shi Mose here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, mi-Nuŋtsɔ, tsu mɔ kroko."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mli wo Mose la, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Ani onyɛmi Aaron, Leinyo lɛ, bɛ? Mile akɛ enaa tse. Ni ŋmlɛtswaa nɛɛ po enyiɛ gbɛ eeba ni ekɛ bo abakpe, ni kɛ ena o lɛ eeenya ohe kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ.
Bɔɔ lɛ amaniɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ. Mibawa o kɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ wiemɔ mli, ni matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee.
Aaron aaatsɔ̃ onaawielɔ yɛ okɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, ni eeewie yɛ onajiaŋ, ni bo hu oootsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ohã lɛ.
Okɔ tso nɛɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, no okɛbaafee naakpɛɛ nii lɛ." Mose ku esɛɛ etee Egipt

Mose ku esɛɛ etee eshaanuu Yetro ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, "Miikpa o fai, hã maku misɛɛ maya Egipt mayakwɛ akɛ minyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ wala mli lolo lo. " Yetro to he akɛ, "Yoo, yaa ni oba, gbɛ aŋmɛ ahã o."
Mose yɛ Midian lolo ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ oya Egipt ejaakɛ mɛi ni tao bo agbe lɛ egboi."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose ŋɔ eŋa kɛ ebihii lɛ etra teji nɔ, ni eyiŋ kɛmiiku esɛɛ kɛya Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ tso lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Kɛji oyashɛ Egipt lɛ kwɛmɔ ni naakpɛɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, ofee yɛ Farao hiɛ; shi mi lɛ mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui, ni ehãŋ maŋ lɛ aya.
Okɛɛ Farao akɛ mi Yehowa mikɛɛ, 'Mikromɔ binuu ji Israel,
ni miikɛɛ o akɛ, hã mibinuu lɛ aya, no lɛ naa, magbe okromɔ binuu lɛ.'"
Amɛyashɛ shitoohe ko yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni Yehowa bahɛŋ Mose, ni eetao lɛ egbe.
Kɛkɛ ni Zipora kɔ tɛ kakla ni naa ba, ni ekɛfo ebinuu lɛ ketia; ekɛ loo ni efo lɛ sa Mose naji ahe, ni ekɛɛ, "Lá ayɛmfrowu ji o".
Ketiafoo lɛ hewɔ ni Zipora kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Eji anɔkwale akɛ nuu ni feɔ hii anii ji o", lɛ.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Yaa ni okɛ Mose ayakpe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ." Aaron tee, ni ekɛ Mose yakpe yɛ Sinai, Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni eshwɔ enaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose jaje wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛtsu lɛ lɛ, kɛ okadii fɛɛ hu ni efã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Aaron.
Ni Mose kɛ Aaron tee Egipt, ni amɛyabua Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ fɛɛ anaa.
Aaron jaje wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose ewie lɛ, ni Mose fee okadii lɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ.
Maŋ lɛ he lɛ ye. Ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Yehowa ekwɛ, ni ena Israelbii lɛ amanehulu lɛ, amɛmamɔ amɛyitsei ashi ni amɛja.
5: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaye gbijurɔ amɛhã mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ,'"
Farao bi amɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji nakai Yehowa lɛ hewɔ ni esa akɛ mabo lɛ toi, ni mahã Israel aya? Mileee Yehowa ko, ni Israel hu mihãaa amɛya."

Mose kɛ Aaron to he akɛ, "Hebribii a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. No hewɔ lɛ wɔmiikpa o fai koni ohã wɔya gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni ekabatutua wɔ kɛ gbele hela loo ta."
Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni bo Mose, kɛ Aaron, nyɛhãaa maŋbii lɛ ajwɛŋ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ? Nyɛyaa nyɛyatsua nyɛnii!
Agbɛnɛ moŋ ni maŋ lɛ yi efa momo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni nyɛhãa amɛjɔɔ amɛhe nɛɛ!"
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Farao wo Israelbii lɛ akplalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kitã akɛ,
"Nyɛkahãa Israelbii lɛ jwɛi, tamɔ tsutsu lɛ, ni amɛkɛfo ntayaa lɛ dɔŋŋ. Amɛya amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyatao jwɛi amɛhã amɛhe,
shi ntayaa abɔ ni amɛfoɔ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa amɛfoa nakai nɔŋŋ, nyɛkatsea nɔ. Amɛmiifee anihao hewɔ ni amɛblɔɔ akɛ, 'Hã wɔya ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!'
Ahã nitsumɔ lɛ anyɛ amɛ jogbŋŋ koni etɔ amɛ ni amɛkana hiɛ amɛbo lakamɔ wiemɔi toi."
Israelbii lɛ akplalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyakɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Farao kɛɛ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, ehãaa nyɛ jwɛi dɔŋŋ;
nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyaa nyɛyatoa jwɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaana eko yɛ; shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ atseŋ nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ nɔ dɛ̃rɛ̃."
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii nitsulɔi lɛ gbɛ shwã Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛyabuabua gbetselii anaa amɛkɛfee jwɛi.
Kplalɔi lɛ tsirɛ Israelbii lɛ ayisɛɛ akɛ amɛgbe amɛdaa gbi nitsumɔ lɛ naa tamɔ be mli ni ahãa amɛ jwɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni Farao kplalɔi lɛ yi Israelbii ni afee amɛ nɔkwɛlɔi akɛto nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛgbeee daa gbi ntayai ni ato ahã nyɛ ni nyɛfo lɛ anaa tamɔ sa lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ tee Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyablɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛɛ sane okɛyeɔ wɔ, otsuji nɛɛ?
Ahãaa wɔ jwɛi, shi akɛɛ doo wɔfo ntayaa kɛ̃. Aayi wɔ yɛ no hewɔ, tsɛbelɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ jɛ omaŋbii lɛ."
Farao here amɛnɔ ekɛɛ, "Hejɔ̃lɔi ni nyɛji hewɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ, 'Hã wɔya, ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa lɛ.'
Nyɛyaa nyɛyatsua nii lɛ moŋ. Jwɛi nii ji jwɛi lɛ ahaŋ nyɛ eko, shi ntayai lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ nyɛbaafo nakai nɔŋŋ,"
Israelbii lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ na akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ be ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkatsea nyɛdaa gbi ntayaa ni sa ni nyɛfo lɛ nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ lɛ."
Be ni amɛshi Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyaa lɛ, amɛyanina Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛmiimɛ amɛ.
Amɛkɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ, "Yehowa akojo nyɛ ejaakɛ nyɛhã wɔsane eje Farao kɛ etsuji agugɔŋ fū, ni nyɛwo amɛdɛ̃ klaŋte ni amɛkɛgbe wɔ." Mose ye ŋkɔmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa
Kɛkɛ ni Mose saa eku esɛɛ etee Yehowa hiɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Ao! Yehowa, mɛɛba moŋ ofee wɔ, omaŋ lɛ, efɔŋ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba kwraa otsu mi biɛ mɔ?
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni miba mikɛ Farao bawie yɛ ogbɛi mli nɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ moŋ sɔŋŋ efeɔ omaŋ lɛ, ni jiemɔ hu ojieko amɛ."
6: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kpaako obaana nɔ ni mibafee Farao. Ja minineshiwalɛ naa dani eeehã Israelbii lɛ aya. Anɔkwa, minineshiwalɛ naa hu dani eeeshwie amɛ kɛje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ." Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Mose
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miji Yehowa,
mi mijie mihe kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ. Shi migbɛi Yehowa lɛ, mihãaa akɛ no ale mi.
Ni misaa mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋ akɛ mikɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ baahã amɛ, shikpɔŋ ko ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ hu, minu Israelbii ni Egiptbii lɛ yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ akɔmɔyeli blɔmɔ lɛ he, ni mikai mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ mikɛɛ, 'Miji Yehowa, ni majie nyɛ, ni mawo Egiptbii lɛ ajatsu lɛ yɛ nyɛkuɛ nɔ, ni mahere nyɛ kɛje nyɔŋ ni amɛyeɔ nyɛ lɛ mli. Mikɛ mihewalɛ aaakpɔ̃ nyɛ, ni no nɔŋŋ mikɛaagbla Egiptbii lɛ atoi.
Maŋɔ nyɛ mafee mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛaale akɛ miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni jie nyɛ yɛ Egipt nyɔŋyeli lɛ mli lɛ.
Mikɛ nyɛ aaatee Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob lɛ nɔ. Miji Yehowa.'"
Mose bɔ Israelbii lɛ amaniɛ, shi amɛbooo Mose toi yɛ amɛwerɛ ni eho amɛhe kɛ amɛnɔ nyɔŋyeli ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Yaa ni okɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ayawie, ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ aje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛya."
Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Mi-Nuŋtsɔ, Israelbii lɛ tete boko mi toi, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Farao aaabo mi toi hu; ni minaa hu tseee nɛɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron wie, ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛya Iseralbii lɛ kɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, koni amɛyajie Israelbii lɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mose kɛ Aaron wekukpãa
Yakob, ni batsɔ̃ Israel lɛ, kromɔbi Ruben bihii nɛ: Hanok kɛ Palu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ruben wekui lɛ ayitsie lɛ.
Simeon bihii nɛ: Yemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Ohad kɛ Yakin kɛ Zohar kɛ Saul, Kanaanyoo lɛ bi lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Simeon wekui lɛ ayitsei.
Levi bihii nɛ: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa. Levi ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
Gershon bihii nɛ: Libni kɛ Shimei. Amɛ hu amɛna wekui.
Kohat bihii nɛ: Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel. Kohat ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃.
Merari bihii nɛ: Maheli kɛ Mushi. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levi wekui lɛ ayitsei yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa.
Amram ŋɔ enyɛkwɛ Yokebed, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose. Amram ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
Izhar bihii nɛ: Kora kɛ Nefeg kɛ Zikri.
Uziel bihii nɛ: Mishael kɛ Elzafan kɛ Sitri.
Aaron ŋɔ Aminadab biyoo Elisheba, ni ji Nehashon nyɛmiyoo lɛ. Ekɛ lɛ fɔ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Kora bihii nɛ: Asir kɛ Elkana kɛ Abiasaf. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Kora wekui lɛ ayitsei lɛ.
Aaron bi Eleazar ya ŋɔ Putiel biyoo ni ekɛ lɛ hi shi, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Pinehas. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii awei kɛ shīai lɛ ayitsei lɛ.
Aaron kɛ Mose nɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyajiea Israelbii lɛ Kɛjea Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ" lɛ;
amɛ amɛyabi Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ koni eŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛshi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Yehowa fã Mose kɛ Aaron
Gbi nɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Miji Yehowa. Kɛɛmɔ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mikɛ bo wieɔ lɛ."
Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Naa, minaa tseee. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Farao aaabo mi toi hu"
7: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Naa, miiha otsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ohã Farao, ni onyɛmi Aaron aaatsɔ̃ ogbalɔ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifã bo ni owie lɛ, kɛɛmɔ onyɛmi Aaron, ni lɛ ekɛ Farao awie koni eŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛshi eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛ ya.
Shi mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui, ni okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii babaoo ni mafee yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
eboŋ nyɛ toi. No baahã mikɛ Egipt aye kɛ joomɔ, ni magbla etoi, ni majie mimaŋ Israel kɛje Egipt.
Kɛ migbla Egiptbii lɛ atoi, ni mijie Israelbii lɛ kɛje amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no Egiptbii kɛaale akɛ miji Yehowa."
Mose kɛ Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Be ni amɛ kɛ Farao yawie nɛɛ lɛ, Mose eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni Aaron hu eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni Aaron hu eye afii nyɔŋmai Kpaanyɔ kɛ etɛ̃. Aaron tso lɛ
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,
"Kɛji Farao kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛfea naakpɛɛ nɔ ko' lɛ, no lɛ Mose, kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, 'Kɔ otso lɛ ni okɛfɔ̃ shi yɛ Farao hiɛ; ni tso lɛ aaatsɔ̃ onufu.'"
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ, ni amɛfee bɔ ni Yehowa efã amɛ lɛ. Aaron kɛ etso lɛ fɔ shi yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, ni tso lɛ tsɔ onufu.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao hu hã ayatsɛ nilelɔi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi kɛba. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Egipt ashwãifeelɔi lɛ. Amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛ ŋkunyaayeli ŋai lɛ fee nakai nɔŋŋ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ etso fɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni tsei lɛ tsɔmɔ onufui; shi Aaron tso lɛ mimii amɛtsei lɛ.
Shi Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ. Amanehului ba Egipt nɔ, Nu tsɔ la
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Farao tsui wa, ekplɛɛɛ ni maŋ lɛ yaa.
Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ leebi. Ebaaje kpo eya faa lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni oyadamɔ jɛi omɛ lɛ.
Okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa, ni ji Hebribii lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsu mi oŋɔɔ koni mibakɛɛ o akɛ, hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaja mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni naa, okplɛ̃ko kɛbashi benɛ.
Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, enɛ okɛaale akɛ miji Yehowa lɛ. Naa, mikɛ tso ni mihiɛ yɛ midɛ̃ nɛɛ baatswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ baatsɔ̃ lá.
Nilo Faa lɛ mli loi baagboi, ni faa lɛ baasha bɔ ni Egiptbii aaanyaŋe Nilo numɔ!'"

Ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, 'Kɔ otso lɛ ni okpã onine mli yɛ Egipt nu fɛɛ nu, ni ji fai kɛ nujɔi ni aje gbɛ agbla kɛ bukoi kɛ nu ni bua shi fɛɛ, nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔmɔ lá. Nu ni yɔɔ tso kɛ tɛ gogai amli fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ lá.'"
Mose kɛ Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ. Aaron wo etso lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛtswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, kɛkɛ ni faa lɛ mli nu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ lá.
Loi ni yɔɔ faa lɛ mli lɛ gboi, ni faa lɛ sha bɔ ni Egiptbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ Nilo mli nu amɛnu. Lá sɔŋŋ ji Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he.
Shi Egipt ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ hu kɛ amɛŋkunyaayelɔi fee nakai nɔŋŋ. Enɛ hã Farao tee nɔ ekpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Ni Farao ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ, ni nɔ ni afee lɛ gbaaa enaa kwraa.
Ni Egiptbii fɛɛ jejee nubui yɛ faa lɛ hewɔ koni amɛna nu amɛnu ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛ Nilo Mli nu amɛnu.
Ni be ni Yehowa ehã Nilo faa lɛ etsɔ̃ lá sɛɛ lɛ, gbii kpawo baho ni faa lɛ yɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
8: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ koni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ; hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ mi.
Shi kɛji okplɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛya lɛ, mikɛ kɔkɔdenei baahao oshikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Nilo Faa lɛ baawo kɔkɔdenei nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, ni kɔkɔdenei nɛɛ aaaba owe lɛ kɛ osa nɔ kɛshɛ osɛɛtsuŋ; amɛaaba otsuji ashīai kɛ omaŋbii lɛ ateŋ kɛ nyɛflɔnɔi kɛ nyɛmã tsesei fɛɛ amli.
Kɔkɔdenei lɛ aaatumɔ kɛnyiɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ omaŋbii kɛ otsuji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ tete.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, 'Kɔ otso lɛ ni okpã onine mli yɛ fai kɛ nujɔi ni agbla kɛ nu ni buabua shi lɛ anɔ, ni oha kɔkɔdenei atumɔ kɛba Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ Aaron kpã enine mli yɛ Egipt nu ni buabua shi lɛ anɔ. Kɛkɛ ni kɔkɔdenei lɛ ba, ni amɛbaha Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Shi ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ kɛ amɛŋkunyaayeli ŋai lɛ fee nakai nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ hu amɛhã kɔkɔdenei ba Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao fã, ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkpaa Yehowa fai koni ejie kɔkɔdenei lɛ yɛ mi kɛ mimaŋbii lɛ anɔ, ni mahã Israelbii lɛ aya koni amɛyashã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa."
Mose here Farao nɔ akɛ, "Bo diɛŋtsɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ beyinɔ ni mikpa fai mihã bo kɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋbii lɛ koni ajie kɔkɔdenei lɛ yɛ bo kɛ owe lɛ kɛ omaŋbii ashîai, ni ashwɛ faa lɛ mli nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ."
Farao jie naa akɛ, "Wɔ". Mose kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aaafee bɔ ni obi lɛ koni okɛna ole akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Yehowa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Kɔkɔdenei lɛ baaje bi kɛ owe lɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ kɛ omaŋbii lɛ anɔ aya. Nilo Faa lɛ mli nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ aaashwɛ."
Ni Mose kɛ Aaron gbla amɛhe shi, ni Mose tee eyasɔle etsɛ Yehowa yɛ shi ni ewo Farao yɛ kɔkɔdenei lɛ ahe lɛ hewɔ.
Yehowa fee bɔ ni Mose bi lɛ lɛ, ni kɔkɔdenei lɛ gboi yɛ shīai kɛ kpoi anɔ kɛ jwɛiaŋ.
Ni Egiptbii lɛ buabua kɔkɔdenei gbhii lɛ anaa kuikui, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ sha.
Shi be ni Farao na akɛ ena mumɔhe fioo lɛ, ekpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ. Tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ ba
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ Aaron koni ekpã enine mli ni ekɛ etso lɛ atswa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mlu lɛ koni mlu lɛ atsɔ̃ tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ."
Mose kɛ Aaron fee nakai. Aaron kpã enine mli, ni ekɛ etso lɛ tswa shikpɔŋ mlu lɛ, ni mlu lɛ tsɔ̃ tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ, ni eku eshwie gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ nɔ. Shikpɔŋ mlu fɛɛ tsɔ tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ yɛ Egipt.
Kɛkɛ ni Egipt ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ ka, yɛ amɛŋkunyaayeli ŋai lɛ anaa koni amɛha tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ lɛ eko aba, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ. Tɔ̃ŋtɔ̃ŋ lɛ ha gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ niŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu." Shi Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ. Ofɔii ba
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Tee shi leebi maŋkpa ni oyafo Farao be mli ni eyaa faa lɛ naa, koni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ, 'Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaja mi.
Naa, kɛji ɔŋmɛɛɛ mimaŋ lɛ gbɛ ni amɛya lɛ, mahã ofɔii abaha bo kɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋbii lɛ. Egiptbii ashīai amli kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ hu aaayi tɔ kɛ Ofɔii lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ matɛ̃ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mimaŋ lɛ yɔɔ nɔ lɛ mashi, koni ofɔii lɛ akaya jɛi, bɔ ni afee ni ole akɛ miji Yehowa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ni mikɛ tɛ̃ ni matɛ̃ amɛ mashi nɛɛ aaato bo okadi koni okɛna srɔto ni yɔɔ mi mimaŋ lɛ kɛ bo omaŋ lɛ teŋ. Wɔ ni ji wɔ lɛ mato nɛkɛ okadi nɛɛ.'"
Ni Yehowa fee nakai, ni ofɔii babaoo ba Farao we lɛ kɛ etsuji ashīai lɛ kɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Ni ofɔii lɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtã.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao fã ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa nyɛyashãa afɔle lɛ nyɛhãa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛshãa yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ."
Shi Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Ebahiŋ nakai feemɔ, ejaakɛ Egiptbii anihiinii wɔkɛbaashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Kɛji wɔkɛ Egiptbii anihiinii shã afɔle yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ, ani amɛtswiaŋ wɔ tɛ?
Esa ni wɔnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ kɛya ŋa nɔ koni wɔyashã afɔle lɛ wɔhã Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ ni efã wɔ."
Farao to he ekɛɛ, "Mibaŋmɛ nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛya koni nyɛyashã afɔle nyɛshã Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, shi shɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkayaa. Nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mi."

Mose jie naa akɛ, "Naa, mibashi maya koni mayasɔle mabi Yehowa koni ofɔii lɛ aje Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii anɔ wɔ. Shi shishiumɔ sane kɛkɛ ni Farao akaye dɔŋŋ, akɛ ehaŋ maŋ lɛ aya ayashã afɔle ahã Yehowa."
Ni Mose gbla ehe shi etee eyasɔle ekpa Yehowa fai.
Ni Yehowa fee nɔ ni Mose bi lɛ lɛ, ni ejie ofɔii lɛ yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ anɔ. Eshwɛɛɛ ekome flo.
Shi Farao kpliŋ etsui ekoŋŋ, ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ aya.
9: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Hebribii a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya koni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ mi.
Shi kɛji okplɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛya, ni okã he ootsi amɛnaa lolo lɛ,
no lɛ Yehowa baatswia nyɛkooloi ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ nii, ni ebaahã otswashiogbo ni naa wa abote nyɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ tejii kɛ yomai kɛ tsinai kɛ toi lɛ ateŋ.
Shi Yehowa aaahã srɔto aba Israelbii akooloi kɛ Egiptbii akooloi ateŋ, ni Israelbii akooloi lɛ ateŋ ekoeko gboŋ.'
Ni Yehowa to be ekɛɛ, 'Wɔ lɛ Yehowa baafee nii nɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.'
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Yehowa fee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ; Egiptbii akooloi lɛ fɛɛ gboi, shi Israelbii akooloi lɛ ateŋ ekome flo nɛkɛ gbooo.
Ni Farao tsu ayakwɛ, ni ayana akɛ Israelbii akooloi lɛ ateŋ ekome flo nɛkɛ gboko. Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ehãaa maŋ lɛ aya. Asanei ba
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, "Nyɛkpitía flɔɔɔnɔɔ mli lamlu nyɛkɔkɔi obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni Mose kɛshwã ŋwɛi yɛ Farao hiɛ.
Lamlu nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ mlu, ni eeegbɛ eshwã Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ; eeetsɔ̃ asane ni fuɔ, ni efɛlɛɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ahe yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ,"
Mose kɛ Aaron kpiti flɔnɔɔ mli lamlu lɛ, ni amɛbadamɔ Farao hiɛ, ni Mose kɛ lamlu lɛ shwã ŋwɛi. Kɛkɛ ni lamlu lɛ tsɔ̃ asane ni fuɔ ni fɛlɛɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ahe.
Egipt ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ nyɛɛɛ Mose hiɛ tete amɛshɛ yɛ asanei lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ asane lɛ etsɛ̃rɛ̃ ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ kɛ Egiptbii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛ
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Tee shi wɔ leebi maŋkpa ni oyadamɔ Farao hiɛ, ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Hebribii a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya koni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ mi,
ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ lɛ mahã haomɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ aba bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ kɛ omaŋbii lɛ anɔ koni okɛna ole akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ mi yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Kulɛ bɛnɛ mijie mihewalɛ kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ, ni mihã gbele hela etswa bo kɛ omaŋbii, ni nyɛhiɛ ekpãtã momo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi enɛ hewɔ mihã oyɔɔ wala mli lolo koni majie mihewalɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ bo koni akɛtsi mitã yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ.
Okã he oowo ohe nɔ yɛ mimaŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ohãaa amɛya.
Naa, wɔ aaafee benɛ mli lɛ mahã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi ni naa wa naakpa diɛŋtsɛ anɛ bɔ ni anako ehenɔ dã yɛ Egipt kɛjɛ ni ato maŋ lɛ nɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
