No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ tsu ni ayaŋɔ okooloi kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ kɛba shīa okɛbato, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni aaana yɛ ŋa nɔ ni akɛ lɛ baaa shīa lɛ, nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ aayi lɛ ni eeegbo.'"
Farao tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni yashe Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, ehã etsuji kɛ ekooloi fɛɛ jo foi kɛba shīa;
shi mɔ ni eyabuuu Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ, eshī etsuji kɛ ekooloi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kpã onine mli kɛya ŋwɛi koni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi anɛ ashwie gbɔmɛi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ."
Mose wo etso lɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛ, ni srawa gbla. Yehowa hã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛɛ nɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni enɛɔ lɛ belɛ srawa lɛ hu miigbla plamplam kɛnyiɛ mli. Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ nɛ waa naakpa bɔ ni anako ehenɔ dã yɛ Egipt kɛjɛ be mli ni etsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ.
Ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ yi nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloo nɔ; ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ kpãtã ŋanɔ tsei kɛ bai fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Shi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ ji hɛ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛɛ eko enɛɛɛ yɛ
Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsu ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ mifee esha. Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, shi mi kɛ mimaŋ lɛ mɛi fɔɔji ji wɔ.
Nyɛkpaa Yehowa fai koni ŋwɛishiimɔ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ akpa; shi efa; ni mahã nyɛya, ni mintsiŋ nyɛnaa dɔŋŋ."
Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Amrɔ pɛ ni maje kpo ye maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, mahole miniji anɔ matsɛ Yehowa, ni ŋwɛishiimɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ asɛɛ aaafo, ni ekoeko baŋ dɔŋŋ, koni ona ole akɛ je lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni.
Shi mile akɛ bo kɛ otsuji lɛ nyɛnako nyɛshe Yehowa ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei."
Akoko kɛ tso ni ajieɔ kpãa ni akɛloɔ ojrawa mama yɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ kpãtã, ejaakɛ akoko lɛ ewo, ni tso lɛ hu ehere momo.
Shi ŋmaa kɛ able hiɛ kpãtãaa ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ amɛkpeɔ sɛɛ kɛwoo.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose shi Farao, ni eje maŋ lɛ mli hu, ni ehole eniji anɔ etsɛ Yehowa. Kɛkɛ ni ŋwɛishiimɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ asɛɛ fo, ni nu lɛ kpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛmɔ.
Shi be ni Farao na akɛ nunɛmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ kɛ ŋwɛishiimɔ lɛ asɛɛ efo lɛ, esaa efee esha ekoŋŋ, ni lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ saa kpliŋ amɛtsui.
Farao bakpliŋ etsui, ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ aya tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto yɛ Mose naa lɛ.
10: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ, shi mihã akpliŋ etsui, ni etsuji lɛ hu ekpliŋ amɛtsui bɔ ni afee ni mafee naakpɛɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ,
koni ogba obii kɛ obii abii nibii ni mifee yɛ Egipt, kɛ naakpɛɛ okadii ni mifee yɛ amɛteŋ, ni okpã owo amɛtoiiaŋ koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ miji Yehowa."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa, Hebribii a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mɛɛ beyinɔ po oookplɛ̃ koni oba ohe shi ohã mi? Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya koni amɛyaja mi.
Shi kɛji okplɛ̃ɛɛ ni mimaŋ lɛ aya lɛ, no lɛ naa, wɔ kpaakpa wɔ lɛ, mahã baalabii aba okpokpai lɛ anɔ,
ni amɛaaha shi bɔ sɔŋŋ ni anaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ tete, ni amɛaaye nii fɛɛ ni shwɛ hã nyɛ yɛ ŋa nɔ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ kpatãaa hiɛ lɛ. Amɛaaye bai fɛɛ ni tsɛ̃rɛ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛtsei anɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ lɛ.
Ni amɛaayimɔ oshīai kɛ otsuji fɛɛ ashīai kɛ Egiptbii fɛɛ ashīai amli tɔtɔɔtɔ, bɔ ni otsɛmɛi kɛ oniimɛi enako ehenɔ pɛŋ kɛjɛ be ni afɔ amɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.'" Ni Mose tsɔ̃ ehe, ni eshi Farao.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni nuu nɛɛ aaahao wɔ kɛyashi? Hã Israelbii lɛ aya ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Ani oleko lolo akɛ Egipt hiɛ miikpãtã?"
No hewɔ lɛ ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba Farao hiɛ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Shi moŋ, namɛi kɛ namɛi ji mɛi ni baaya lɛ?"
Mose jie naa ekɛɛ, "Wɔbii bibii lɛ ni jio, wɔnukpai lɛ ni jio, wɔbihii jio, wɔbiyei jio, wɔtoi kɛ wɔtsinai jio wɔkɛ fɛɛ baaya ejaakɛ wɔyaaye gbijurɔ wɔhã Yehowa."
Farao kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛ miŋmɛ gbɛ ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ tee fīī bɛ Yehowa ejɔɔ nyɛ. Kolɛ jeee yiŋ fɔŋ ko nyɛto nɛɛ?
Dabida, nyɛhii lɛ kɛkɛ nyɛyaa nyɛyasɔ̃mɔa Yehowa, ejaakɛ no nɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ. " Ni ashwie Mose kɛ Aaron kɛje Farao hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kpã nine mli yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni baalabii aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛbayɛ bai fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ eshi lɛ."
Mose wo etso lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko batswa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, gbi lɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni be ni je tsɛreɔ lɛ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ kɛ baalabii lɛ eba.
Baalabii lɛ bashwie Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Amɛha Egipt kpokpai lɛ anɔ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. Baalabii bako ni tamɔ amɛ nakai dã, ni amɛsɛɛ hu eko baŋ nakai dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ amɛha shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wo duŋ, ni amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bai fɛɛ kɛ tsei ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ shi lɛ anɔ yibii fɛɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsu oya mli, ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mifee esha mishi Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mifee nyɛ hu esha.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ okɛ mihe esha lɛ afa mi, shi kome nɛɛ kɛkɛ, ni nyɛkpa Yehowa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai koni ejie nɛkɛ toigblamɔ ni gbeɔ mɔ nɛɛ kɛkɛ yɛ minɔ."
Mose shi Farao etee, ni eyakpa Yehowa fai.
Ni Yehowa hã anai kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa naakpa batswa, ni eloo baalabii lɛ blublu kɛtee eyashwie Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli. Baalabii lɛ ateŋ ekome flo nɛkɛ eshwɛɛɛ yɛ Egipt kpokpai lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ aya. Duŋ wo
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kpã onine mli kɛya ŋwɛi koni duŋ awo yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, duŋ kabitii."
Mose kpã enine mli kɛtee ŋwɛi, kɛkɛ ni duŋ kpii wo yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ gbii etɛ̃.
Duŋ nɛɛ wo bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko enaa enaanyo, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko shiii he ni duŋ lɛ banina lɛ yɛ lɛ kɛyashi gbii etɛ̃. Shi jeŋ tse heŋŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ashihilɛhei lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsɛ Mose ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa koni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔa Yehowa; nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛbii lɛ aya, shi nyɛshīa nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ."
Shi Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Ja ohã wɔna kooloi hu ni akɛshãa gbee afɔle kɛ shãa afɔlei wɔhiɛ wɔdɛ̃ ni wɔkɛyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Wɔkooloi aku lɛ hu ja wɔkɛtee, ni ashiŋ kooloo kome tete yɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi eko wɔkɛyaasɔ̃mɔ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ kwraa wɔleee amɛteiaŋ nii ni wɔkɛyaasɔmɔ Yehowa akɛ ja wɔshɛ jɛi dã."
Shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ Israelbii lɛ aya.
Ni Farao bɔ Mose kɔkɔ ekɛɛ, "Jee mihiɛ ni oya. Okwɛ ohe ni ahi koni okaba mihiɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni ooobapue ekoŋŋ yɛ mihiɛ lɛ gbo ooogbo."
Mose here Farao nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, mibaŋ ohiɛ dɔŋŋ."
11: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Eshwɛ amanehulu wulu kome ni mahã aba Farao kɛ Egipt nɔ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ eeehã nyɛje biɛ nyɛya. Be ni eeehã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛya kwraa lɛ, shwiemɔ tete ebaashwie nyɛ kɛje biɛ.
Agbɛnɛ kpã owo Israelbii lɛ atoiŋ akɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo amala jwiɛtɛi nii kɛ shika nii yɛ enaanyo Egiptnyo dɛŋ."
Yehowa hã Egiptbii lɛ ahiɛ sɔ Israelbii lɛ. Anɔkwa, Farao tsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ. Anɔkwa, Farao tsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ buɔ Mose akɛ gbɔmɔ wulu diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni Mose kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: 'Nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ maje kpo makpa Egipt,
ni Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ aaagboi kɛjɛ Farao kromɔbi ni baaye esɛɛ yɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi nyɔŋyoo ni yɔɔ wiɛ sɛɛ lɛ kromɔbi lɛ tete nɔ. Kooloi po akromɔbii fɛɛ baagboi.
Ni aaawo yara babaoo yɛ Egipt Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni anako ehenɔ dã, ni asaŋ ehenɔ ko hu baŋ dɔŋŋ.
Shi yɛ Israelbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, gbɔmɔ jio, kooloo jio, gbee tete shiŋ esɛŋ ewoŋ lɛ, koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ Yehowa miitsɔ̃ɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ Egiptbii kɛ Israelbii ateŋ.
Nakai be lɛ otsuji fɛɛ aaakpleke shi aaaba miŋɔɔ, ni amɛaabakoto mi amɛkɛɛ, Jee biɛ ni oya, bo kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ matee.'"
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Farao ebaboŋ nyɛ toi bɔ ni afee ni minaakpɛɛ nii lɛ afa yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Mose kɛ Aaron fee nɛkɛ naakpɛɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Farao nɛ, shi Yehowa hã Farao kpliŋ etsui ni ehãaa Israelbii lɛ ashi eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛya.
12: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ,
"Nɛkɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ afi mli klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ kɛ afi shishijee ahã nyɛ.
Nyɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ awie akɛ, Nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ amɔmɔ toobi kome kome yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, shīa fɛɛ shīa lɛ toobi kome.
Shi kɛji shīa lɛ bii faaa hãaa toobi muu lɛ yeli lɛ, no lɛ shīatsɛ lɛ kɛ ekuuŋnyo, mɔ ni shīa tsa enɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aye yɛ mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ naa. Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akane mɛi abɔ ni fa hã toobi lɛ yeli.
Nyɛŋɔa toobi ni kpa bɛ ehe, nuu ni eye afi, yɛ too gwaŋtɛŋi loo too abotiai lɛ ateŋ.
Nyɛkɛ toobi nɛɛ atoa kɛyashi nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ koni Israelbii fɛɛ agbegbee amɛ gbɛkɛnaashi.
Akɛ lá lɛ eko adiki shīai hei ni abaaye yɛ lɛ agboi lɛ ashinaatsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ yiteŋ nɔ lɛ hu he.
Aye loo lɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ. Ashã, ni akɛ aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kɛ shwie ni joɔ aye.
Akaye lɛ eŋmɔŋ, ni akɛ nu akahoo, shi moŋ ashã, eyitso kɛ eshwɔji kɛ emlinii lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛkashwɛa eko nyɛtoa ni je tsɛre nɔ lɛ, nyɛwoa mli la ni nyɛshãa.
Ni bɔ ni nyɛyɛ lɛ nɛ. Nyɛfimɔa nyɛmliteiaŋ, ni nyɛwoa nyɛtokotai, ni nyɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtsei ahiɛa nyɛdɛ̃, ni nyɛyea lɛ paopao, shi Yehowa Hehoo ni.
"Ejaakɛ matsɔ̃ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli, ni magbe Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, koni mahã Egipt nyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe guɔ agbo, miji Yehowa.
Lá lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shīai amli ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ ahe okadi. Kɛji mina lá lɛ pɛ mateke nyɛ, ni mikpataŋ nyɛhiɛ be ni matswia Egipt gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi nii lɛ.
Nɛkɛ gbi nɛɛ atsɔ̃ kaimɔ gbi ahã nyɛ, ni nyɛye lɛ akɛ Yehowa gbijurɔ, ni etsɔ̃ akpɔ ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei kɛya naanɔ." Akpiti gbijurɔyeli lɛ

"Aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã nɛɛ nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo. Shi klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ beebe lɛ, nyɛjiea masha fɛɛ masha yɛ nyɛshīai amli. Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ masha yɛ nyɛshīai amli. Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaye masha aboloo yɛ gbii kpawo nɛɛ eko nɔ lɛ, aaakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ Israel.

Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja Nyɔŋmɔ, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ hu nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ nakai nɔŋŋ. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbii nɛɛ amli ja nitsumɔ ni kɔɔ nɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye he kɛkɛ.
Nyɛyea nɛkɛ akpiti gbijurɔ nɛɛ nyɛkɛkaia gbi nɔ ni mijie nyɛ fɛɛ yuu kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ akpɔ ehã nyɛ kɛya naanɔ.
Nyɛbɔ̃ia aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã nɛɛ yeli kɛyashi nyɔɔŋ lɛ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ gbɛkɛ.
Akana masha ko yɛ nyɛshiai amli gbii kpawo, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye masha nii lɛ, gbɔ ni jio, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, ehiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ Israel-bii ateŋ.
Nyɛkayea masha nii, nyɛyea akpiti nyɛshihilɛhei fɛɛ." Klɛŋklɛŋ Hehoo lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjiea toi nyɛtoa yɛ nyɛwekui lɛ anaa, ni nyɛgbea kɛyea Hehoo lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ lá lɛ awoa lalakã mli, ni nyɛkɛ ŋshɔŋ kotsa atsɔ lá nɛɛ mli koni nyɛkɛdiki agbo lɛ shinaatsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ yiteŋ nɔ lɛ hu, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akajea kpo kɛba shinaashi kɛyashi leebi.

Ejaakɛ Yehowa baaho koni eyatswia Egiptbii nii. Kɛji ena lá lɛ yɛ shinaatsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ eyiteŋ nɔ lɛ he pɛ, Yehowa baateke nyɛshiai lɛ, ni eŋmɛŋ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ gbɛ ni ebote nyɛshīai lɛ amli koni ebatswia nyɛ nii.
Nyɛyea gbɛjianɔtoi nɛɛ anɔ, ni etsɔ̃ akpɔ ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii kɛya naanɔ.
Ni kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nɛkɛ jamɔ nɛɛ mli.
Ni kɛji nyɛbii aaabi nyɛ akɛ, 'Te nyɛjamɔ nɛɛ shishi hu?' lɛ,
nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa Hehoo afɔle ni, ejaakɛ be ni etswia Egiptbii lɛ nii lɛ, eho Israelbii ashīai lɛ ahe yɛ Egipt ni etɛ̃ wɔshīai lɛ eshī.'" Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ mamɔ amɛyi shi, ni amɛja Yehowa,
ni Israelbii lɛ gblɛ mli, ni amɛyafee bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ afee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kromɔbii lɛ agbele

Gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ Yehowa tswia Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ nii, kɛjɛ Farao kromɔbi lɛ ni baaye etsɛ sɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛyashi gboklɛfonyo ni kã kpabu mli lɛ kromɔbii kɛ shīa kooloi akromɔbii fɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao te shi nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, lɛ kɛ etsuji fɛɛ kɛ Egiptbii fɛɛ, ni amɛwo yara waa yɛ Egipt fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eyashwɛɛɛ shīa ko ni gbonyo bɛ mli.
Nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Farao tsu ni ayatsɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjea mimaŋbii ateŋ nyɛyaa, nyɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ, nyɛyasɔ̃mɔa Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛbi lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ hu ayaa tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ lɛ. Kɛfee lɛ nyɛsɔlea eko nyɛhãa mi koni jɔɔmɔ lɛ eko anina mi hu."
Ni Egiptbii lɛ tsirɛ Israelbii lɛ ayisɛɛ akɛ amɛhe afee oya ni amɛshi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɛbaahã wɔ fɛɛ wɔgboi."
Israelbii lɛ hole amɛmai ni nako asha ni yɔɔ tsesei amli lɛ, ni amɛfimɔ tsesei lɛ amɛwowoo amɛmamai amli, kɛkɛ ni amɛhole amɛtswia amɛkɔ̃ji.
Nakai be mli lɛ Israelbii lɛ efee bɔ ni Mose ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛmala jwiɛtɛi nii kɛ shika nii kɛ mamai yɛ Egiptbii lɛ adɛŋ.
Yehowa ha Egyptbii lɛ ahiɛ sɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛhãhãa amɛ nibii ni amɛbibii amɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ kpakpla Egiptbii lɛ ahenii kɛtee. Israelbii lɛ shi Egipt
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ yi mli kɛjɛ Rameses kɛtee Sukot, hii ni nyiɛ amɛnane aaafee akpei ohai ekpaa, soro yei kɛ gbekɛbii.
Maji srɔtoi anɔ bii babaoo hu fata he kɛtee kɛ agbɛnɛ toi kɛ tsinai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ mã ni amɛkɛjɛ Egipt lɛ eko shã mã akpiti keeki ejaakɛ eshako akɛ ni Egiptbii lɛ shwie amɛ bɔ ni amɛwooo mɛɛ koni mã lɛ asha lɛ, ni no hewɔ hu lɛ amɛsako niyenii amɛtoko gbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ.
Be abɔ ni Israelbii lɛ ye yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Gbi ni amɛna afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa webii lɛ blublu shi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni akɛni Yehowa shi kpe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛjie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Egipt hewɔ lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ batsɔ̃ kpeshii nyɔɔŋ ehã Israelbii kɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ, ni amɛyeɔ lɛ akɛ Yehowa gbijurɔ. Hehoo lɛ he akpɔi
Ni Yehowa Kɛɛ Mose Kɛ Aaron akɛ, "Hehoo lɛ he akpɔi nɛ: Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko akaye eko.
Shi nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ ni akɛ shika he lɛ lɛ, ofo lɛ ketia dani eye eko.
Mɔ ni ebato nyɛ gbɔ kɛ apaafonyo hu akaye eko.
Shīa fɛɛ shīa aye enɔ, akɛ loo lɛ eko akaje kpo yɛ shīa lɛ, asaŋ akajwa loo lɛ mli wui lɛ eko.
Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aye gbɛjianɔtoi nɛɛ anɔ.
Shi kɛji gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ miitao akɛ eyeɔ Hehoo lɛ ekɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam lɛ, hã aflɔ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ ketia dani eba ni ebaye eko, ni eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ Israelnyo nɔŋŋ. Shi foolɔ ko foolɔ ko akaye eko.
Mla kome akã shi ahã maŋnyo kɛ mɔ ni bato nyɛ gbɔ fɛɛ."
Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fee bɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose kɛ Aaron kitã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yehowa jie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa.
13: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kromɔbi nuu fɛɛ kromɔbi nuu, ni ji binuu fɛɛ binuu in gbeleɔ musu naa, yɛ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi, ejaakɛshi minɔ ni." Akpiti gbijurɔ lɛ
Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkaia nɛkɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni ji gbi nɔ ni nyɛje Egipt nyɔŋyeli shishi lɛ, ejaakɛ nineshiwalɛ naa Yehowa jie nyɛ kɛje jɛi, No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkayea masha nii.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nyɛmiishi Egipt yɛ Nikpamɔ Nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.

Kɛji Yehowa kɛ nyɛ yashɛ Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ kpakpa ni da ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni nyenii pii yɔɔ nɔ, nɔ ni ekã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ ekɛbaahã nyɛ, lɛ nɔ lɛ jamɔ ni nyɛkɛja lɛ yɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛ:
Aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã lɛ nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo; shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ Yehowa gbijurɔ ni.
Aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã lɛ nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo; akana masha aboloo ko yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ loo masha nɔ ko yɛ nyɛkpokpai anɔ he ko he ko.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛtsia tã, ni nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbii gbijurɔ nɛɛ shishi akɛ, 'Nɔ ni Yehowa fee ehã wɔ be mli ni wɔjeɔ Egipt lɛ hewɔ ni wɔfeɔ enɛ.'
Nyɛkaia gbijurɔ nɛɛ. Nyɛhãa efea tamɔ okadi ko ni fi nyɛnineshi aloo ni kpɛtɛ nyɛhiɛŋtso nɔ koni Yehowa mla lɛ akã nyɛdaaŋ, ejaakɛ nineshiwalɛ naa Yehowa jie nyɛ kɛje Egipt.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyea nɛkɛ akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ ebe lɛ mli. Kromɔbii kpɔ̃mɔ
"Kɛji Yehowa kɛ nyɛ yashɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ ekɛaahã nyɛ lɛ,
binuu fɛɛ binuu ni gbleɔ musu naa lɛ, nyɛjɔa enɔ nyɛhãa mi, Yehowa. Nyɛshiai amli kooloi akromɔ bihii hu Yehowa nii ni.
Teji Kromɔbinuu fɛɛ kromɔbinuu lɛ nyɛkɛ too akpɔ̃a lɛ. Shi kɛji nyɛkpɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ aku ekuɛŋ. Shi gbɔmɔ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi lɛ nyɛkpɔ̃a lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛbii bi nyɛ wɔsɛɛ ko akɛ, 'Ni te gbijurɔ nɛɛ shishi hu lɛ,'nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ,' 'Nineshiwalɛ naa Yehowa jie wɔ kɛje Egipt he ni aye wɔ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ.

Ejaakɛ be ni Farao kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ kwrakwra akɛ eŋmɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔshi Egipt lɛ, Yehowa gbe Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ kromɔbii nɔ. Enɛ hewɔ ni kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni gbleɔ musu naa, ni ji nuu lɛ, wɔkɛshãa afɔle wɔhãa Yehowa lɛ, shi wɔkromɔ bihii lɛ, amɛ lɛ wɔkpɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ.
Nyɛhãa enɛ afea tamɔ okadi ko ni fi nyɛnine shi aloo ni kpɛtɛ nyɛhiɛŋtso nɔ ejaakɛ nineshiwale naa Yehowa jie wɔ kɛje Egipt.'" Atatu kutuu kɛ la kutuu

Be ni Farao ŋmɛ Israelbii lɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛya lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kplaaa amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ; tsɛbelɛ jɛi gbɛ lɛ jekɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Koni Israelbii lɛ kɛ ta ko akayakpe yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni no hã amɛshwa amɛhe ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Egipt akoŋŋ."
No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Israelbii lɛ lɔgɔ shi kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ he ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ. Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Egipt ni amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã ta.

Mose loo Yosef gbonyowui lɛ kɛtee tamɔ bɔ ni Yosef ehã Israelbii lɛ ekã kita amɛto lɛ. Yosef ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ̃ be ko; kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ koni nyɛwo migbonyo wui lɛ kɛje biɛ."
Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Sukot, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Etam yɛ ŋa lɛ naa.
Shwane mli lɛ Yehowa nyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ tamɔ atatu kutuu koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ hu enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ tamɔ atatu la kutuu koni ehã amɛna nii; ni amɛnyiɛ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Shwane mli lɛ atatu kutuu lɛ ejeee amɛhiɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ hu la kutuu lɛ ejeee amɛhiɛ.
14: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛdɔ amɛyi ni amɛyato shi yɛ Pi-Hahirot hiɛ, yɛ Migdol kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ teŋ, yɛ Baal-Zefon masɛi. Nyɛtoa shi yɛ eŋlɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
No aaahã Farao asusu ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Israelbii lɛ eyadu gbɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ, shiaŋa lɛ esa amɛyi.'
Mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui koni etui nyɛ, ni no aaahã Farao kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ ashe mi gbeyei, ni Egiptbii baana ale akɛ miji Yehowa lɛ." Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ ni akɛɛ amɛ lɛ.

Be ni ababɔ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ Israelbii lɛ ejo foi amɛtee lɛ, Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ tsake amɛjwɛŋmɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ mɛni po wɔfee nɛɛ, ni wɔhã Israelbii lɛ kpa wɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni amɛtee nɛɛ?"
No hewɔ lɛ Farao saa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etayaa shwiilii lɛ, ni eloo esraafoi efata ehe.
Esaa eŋɔ tayaa shwiilii ohai ekpaa ni aje gbɛ ahala, agbɛnɛ kɛ Egipt shwiilii fɛɛ kɛ amɛnɔ tatsɛmɛi eshwie esɛɛ.
Shi Yehowa hã Egipt maŋtsɛ Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni etiu Israelbii lɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ nine ni tsii lɛ hiɛ amɛ kɛyaa lɛ.

Egiptbii lɛ yi Israelbii lɛ asɛɛ kɛ Farao okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ asraafoi fɛɛ. Ni amɛyanina Israelbii lɛ ni amɛto shi yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa, yɛ Pi-hahirot masɛi yɛ Baal-Zefon hiɛ.
Farao kɛ eta tsi bɛŋkɛ. Be ni Israelbii lɛ yaahole amɛhiŋmɛii nɔ lɛ, naa Farao kɛ Egiptbii lɛ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba. Gbeyei mɔmɔ Israelbii lɛ naakpa, ni amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa.
Ni amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Ani gbonyobui ni bɛ Egipt hewɔ ni okpla wɔ kɛba koni wɔbagboi yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɛɛ? Mɛɛba oye wɔ nɛkɛ sane, ni oloo wɔ kɛjɛ Egipt kɛba biɛ nɛɛ?
Ani jeee wiemɔ ni wɔkɛ o wie yɛ Egipt lɛ nɛ akɛ, 'Fɔ̃ɔmɔ ni ohã wɔsɔ̃mɔ Egiptbii lɛ kɛkɛ?' Shi faŋ nɔ moŋ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔ Egiptbii lɛ fe nɔ ni wɔɔyaagboi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Ni Mose here Israelbii lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei! Nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ ni nyɛkwɛa nyɛyiwala ni Yehowa baahere ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ. Ejaakɛ Egiptbii ni nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Yehowa baawu ahã nyɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛfea diŋŋ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni oblɔɔ otsɛɔ mi? Kɛɛmɔ Israebii lɛ akɛ amɛya amɛhiɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, wo otso lɛ nɔ ni okpã onine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ koni ogba ŋshɔ lɛ mli enyɔ koni Israelbii lɛ anyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ kɛya.
Mahã Egiptbii lɛ akpliŋ amɛtsui koni amɛnyiɛ Israelbii lɛ asɛɛ, ni maye Farao kɛ eta shwiilii kɛ ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
Ni kɛji miye Farao kɛ eta shwiilii kɛ ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, Egiptbii aaana amɛle akɛ miji Yehowa."
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ ni nyiɛ Israelbii lɛ ata lɛ hiɛ lɛ gbla ehe shi eyaje amɛsɛɛgbɛ, ni atatu kutuu lɛ je amɛhiɛgbɛ ni eyashi yɛ amɛsɛɛgbɛ,
yɛ Egiptbii ata lɛ kɛ Israelbii ata lɛ teŋ. Shwane lɛ atutu lɛ woɔ Egiptbii lɛ hiɛ duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ ekpɛɔ ehãa Israelbii lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ gbi lɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi nyɛɛɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi abɛŋkɛ.

Mose kpã enine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni naa wa batswa nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni ehã ŋshɔ lɛ gbla kɛtee sɛɛ, yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni emli gba enyɔ, ni eshi shikpɔŋ gbiŋ efɔ̃ shi yɛ eteŋ,
ni Israelbii lɛ yi shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ, ni nu lɛ ma shi tamɔ gbogbo yɛ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku.
Egiptbii lɛ tiu Israelbii lɛ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛbote ŋshɔ lɛ mli. Amɛkɛ Farao okpɔŋɔi kɛ etayaa shwiilii kɛ ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Ni maŋkɛ mra mli lɛ Yehowa jɛ atatu kutuu kɛ la kutuu lɛ mli ekwɛ Egiptbii ata lɛ, ni ehao amɛ.
Ehã amɛshwiilii lɛ anaji lɛ bɔi fuu, ni ekɛwo Egiptbii lɛ hejramɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Egiptbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔjoa Israelbii lɛ anaa foi ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ wɔ miiwu miihã amɛ."
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kpã onine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ koni ŋshɔ lɛ abaha Egiptbii kɛ amɛtayaa shwiilii kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ anɔ."

No hewɔ lɛ Mose kpã enine mli yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ. Ni jetsɛremɔ mli leebi lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ yiridi kɛjɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ kɛmiiba abatsa ekoŋŋ, ni Egiptbii lɛ wo foi, shi amɛkɛ ŋshɔ lɛ bakpe, ni Yehowa hã Egiptbii lɛ ahiɛ kpãtã yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ.
Ŋshɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ ba, ni ebaha Farao shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi kɛ eta muu lɛ fɛɛ ni tiu Israelbii lɛ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ; eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome tete po.
Shi Israelbii lɛ nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo hã amɛ yɛ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku.
Nakai gbi lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa fee ehere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala kɛjɛ Egiptbii adɛŋ nɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ na Egiptbii lɛ jwere ŋshɔ lɛ naa ni amɛgboi.
Ni Israelbii lɛ na Yehowa hewalɛ wulu ni ejie lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Egiptbii lɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ she Yehowa gbeyei, ni amɛhe Yehowa kɛ etsulɔ Mose amɛye.
15: Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ la nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ kɛjie Yehowa yi, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Mala majie Yehowa yi, ejaakɛ eye kunim kpeteŋkple kɛwo ehiɛ nyam; okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ lɛ etsirɛ amɛ ewo ŋshɔŋ.
Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala, ni lɛ etsɔ̃ miyiwalaherelɔ. Lɛ ji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni majie eyi, mitsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ ni, ni mawo ehiɛ nyam.
Yehowa, lɛ tawulɔ ni. Ani jeee egbɛi ji Yehowa? 4 "Farao shwiilii lɛ kɛ eta lɛ eloo ewo ŋshɔŋ, ni etatsɛmɛi kpanakpanaa lɛ, amii amɛ nu yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli.
Ŋshɔ lɛ ha amɛnɔ, ni amɛshiu kɛtee nu shishi tamɔ tɛ.
Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ hiɛ eba nyam, Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ tsɛrɛɔ henyɛlɔ mli.
Ogbojee lɛ naa sɔŋŋ lɛ, obutu mɛi ni te shi wo bo lɛ. Omlila lɛ gri wo amɛ, ni eshã amɛ tamɔ la shãa gbetseli.
Omu oshwie ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nu lɛ bua ehe naa, ni ŋshɔkei lɛ ho damɔ shi keikei, ŋshɔ teŋteŋ nu lɛ shɔ̃ etsɔ̃ kpɔ.
Henyɛlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, 'Matiu amɛ mayamɔmɔ amɛ. Maja nomŋɔɔ nii lɛ, mitsui aaanyɔ mimli. Magbla miklaŋte ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ.'
Ohã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ha amɛnɔ; amɛshiu tamɔ sumui yɛ nu hamahama lɛ mli.
"Namɔ tamɔ Bo, Yehowa, yɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ? Namɔ tsuɔ nyam nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei kɛ naakpɛɛ?
Okpa oninejurɔ mli, ni Shikpɔŋ lɛ mi amɛ.
Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ okpla maŋ ni okpɔ̃ nɛɛ. Ohewalɛ naa lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛshɛ oshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Jeŋ maji lɛ nu he, ni amɛhe kpokpo, ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ Filistibii lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ shiofɔ̃ eshi Edom maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ, Moab kãkãlɔi lɛ ahe kpokpo; Kanaanbii fɛɛ ehao.
Gbeyei kɛ ŋmiŋmi eloo amɛ, onineshi tsiimɔ sɔŋŋ ehã amɛmu shi dɛoo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa, omaŋ lɛ aaaho, kɛyaashi mɛi ni okpɔ̃ lɛ aaaho.
Okɛ amɛ aaaba ni obato amɛ shi yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ogɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa aaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ." Miriam lala lɛ
Be ni Farao okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ eshwiilii lɛ kɛ ekpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi lɛ bote ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa hã ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ ku esɛɛ ebaha amɛnɔ, shi Israelbii lɛ nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ ŋshɔ lɛ mli kɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔyoo Miriam, Aaron nyɛmiyoo lɛ, kɔ fao ehiɛ edɛ̃, ni yei lɛ fɛɛ klɔ fabii kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛsha ni amɛjo.
Miriam wo lala ekɛɛ, "Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa ejaakɛ eye kunim kɛwo ehiɛ nyam; etsirɛ okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ lɛ ewo ŋshɔŋ." Nu ni joɔ lɛ
Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa kɛtee Shur ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni amɛnaaa nu.
Be ni amɛyashɛ he ko ni gbɛi ji Mara lɛ amɛyanina nu; shi Mara nu nɛɛ ehiii numɔ ejaakɛ eejoo. No hewɔ awo jɛi Mara lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛni wɔbaanu mɔ?"
Mose bo etsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ tso ko; ni be ni ekɔ ni eshɛ efɔ nu lɛ mli lɛ, nu lɛ baŋɔɔ. Jɛi Yehowa wo Israelbii lɛ kitã kɛ akpɔ yɛ, ni jɛi hu ekã amɛ yɛ,

ni ekɛɛ, "Kɛji nyɛaaye Yehowa, ni ji nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee nɔ kadikadi, ni nyɛaafee nɔ ni ja gbɛ yɛ ehiɛ, ni nyɛaaye ekpɔi kɛ kitãi fɛɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ helai ni mihã yɛ Egiptbii lɛ ekoeko yeŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, nyɛtsalɔ lɛ."
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ ba Elim he ni nubui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amitsɔrɔbi tsei nyɔŋmai kpawo yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛbato shi yɛ jɛi yɛ nu lɛ he.
16: Israelbii asafo lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Elim kɛtee Sin ŋa ni kã Elim kɛ Sinai teŋ lɛ nɔ. Amɛyashɛ jɛi Egipt shimɔ lɛ sɛɛ nyɔji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Amɛkɛɛ, "Yehowa hã wɔgboi yɛ Egipt be ni wɔtra loo kɛ kukwɛii ahe ni wɔyeɔ nii wɔtrɔɔ lɛ moŋ kulɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni nyɛjie wɔ kɛba ŋa nɛɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkɛ hɔmɔ abagbe asafo muu nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ."

Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Naa, mibahã aboloo ajɛ ŋwɛi anɛ ashwie shi ahã nyɛ. Daa gbi lɛ maŋbii lɛ aje kpo ayabua naa bɔ pɛ ni aaashɛ amɛyeli gbi kome. Mikɛ enɛ baaka amɛ makwɛ akɛ amɛaaye mimla lɛ nɔ aloo amɛyeŋ nɔ.
Shi gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, hã ni amɛsaa nɔ ni amɛbuaa naa daa gbi lɛ falɛ toi enyɔ amɛto."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Leebi lɛ nyɛaana Yehowa anumnyam lɛ, ejaakɛ enu huhuuhu wiemɔi ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ namɛi ji wɔ ni nyɛwieɔ huhuuhu nyɛshiɔ wɔ?"

Mose tee nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji gbɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa hã nyɛ loo nyɛye, ni leebi lɛ ehã nyɛ aboloo nyɛye nyɛtrɔ, ejaakɛ enu huhuuhu wiemɔi ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ lɛ lɛ, wɔlɛ nɛgbɛ wɔdamɔ? Jeee wɔ nyɛwieɔ huhuuhu nyɛshiɔ lɛ, shi Yehowa ni."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, Nyɛtsia nyɛbaa Yehowa hiɛ; enu nyɛ huhuuhu wiemɔi lɛ."
Be ni Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ wieɔ lɛ, amɛkwɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni naa, Yehowa anumnyam lɛ epue yɛ atatu lɛ mli.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Minu Israelbii lɛ ahuhuuhu wiemɔi lɛ. Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ nyɛaaye loo, ni leebi lɛ nyɛaaye aboloo nyɛtrɔ, ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.'"
Gbɛkɛnaashi mli lɛ trakɔkɔi baha Israelbii lɛ shihilɛhe lɛ. Leebi mli lɛ bɔ nyɔ kɛbɔle Israelbii lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe kpula.
Be ni bɔ lɛ kpla lɛ, ana nibii tɛtɛrɛbii kokrobii bibiibii komɛi jwere ŋa lɛ nɔ fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni efi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ na nibii nɛɛ, amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, "Kolɛ mɛni nɛ?" Ejaakɛ amɛleee nɔ ni ji. Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Aboloo ni Yehowa hã nyɛ koni nyɛye lɛ nɛ.
Ŋmaa nɛɛ he kitã ni Yehowa ewo nɛ: 'Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abua bɔ ni eeenyɛ eye naa, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa nii afee tsenesa loo gomer kome falɛ yɛ nyɛyibɔ naa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aklɔ ahã mɛi abɔ ni ekɛyɔɔ ebuu mli lɛ.'"
Israelbii lɛ fee nakai. Mɛi komɛi klɔ pii, ni mɛi komɛi klɔ fioo.
Shi be ni akɛ tsenesa yaasusu lɛ, mɔ ni klɔ pii lɛ enaaa eko yɛ sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni klɔ fioo hu eshwɛɛɛ lɛ eko dani ashɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ na bɔ ni eeenyɛ eye.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo maŋbii lɛ shi ekɛɛ, "Mɔ ko akashwɛ eko ni je miitsɛre nɔ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mɛi komɛi eyabooo Mose toi ni amɛshwɛ eko. Be ni je tsɛre lɛ ewo gɔgɔmi, ni esha. Enɛ hã Mose mli wo amɛ la.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ daa leebi lɛ Israelbii lɛ yaklɔɔ ŋmaa lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, bɔ ni eeenyɛ eye kɛkɛ. Kɛji hulu naa wa lɛ esereɔ.
Gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛklɔ daa gbi niyenii lɛ falɛ toi enyɔ, mɔ kome nɔ tsenesai enyɔ, ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ onukpai lɛ babɔ Mose amaniɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Yehowa fã: 'Wɔ lɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi ni, Yehowa hejɔɔmɔgbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni. Nyɛshãa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ shãa, ni nyɛhoa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ hoomɔ. Nɔ ni baashwɛ lɛ nyɛkɛtoa ni je atsɛrea nɔ.'"
Amɛkɛ nii ni shwɛ lɛ to ni je tsɛre nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ lɛ; niyenii lɛ eshaaa lɛ, ewooo gɔgɔmi hu.
Ni Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyea enɛ ŋmɛnɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa hejɔɔmɔgbi ji ŋmɛnɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛnaŋ eko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ nyɛklɔ.
Nyɛbuaa ŋmaa lɛ naa gbii ekpaa ejaakɛ gbi ni kpawo lɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi ni, ni no nɔ lɛ eko baŋ."
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛi komɛi je maŋbii lɛ ateŋ tee ŋmaa klɔmɔ, shi amɛyanaaa eko amɛklɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaakwa mikitãi kɛ mimlai lɛ?
Nyɛnaaa akɛ ni Yehowa hã nyɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, no hewɔ ni ehãa nyɛ gbii enyɔ niyenii yɛ gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahi eshīa, mɔ ko akaje egbɛhe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ jɔɔ amɛhe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.
Israelbii lɛ wo niyenii nɛɛ gbɛi akɛ mana. Edalɛ tamɔ mlɛ bibii, ni eyɛɔ futafuta, ni eŋɔɔmɔ tamɔ akpaanɔɔ kɛ wo.

Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Kitã ni Yehowa ewo nɛ, 'Nyɛkɛ niyenii nɛɛ tsenesa kome falɛ atoa nyɛhãa nyɛshwiei koni amɛbana ŋmaa ni mikɛlɛ nyɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ be mli ni mijie nyɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Wo kpulu ni osusu mana tsenesa kome falɛ owo mli, ni okɛyama Yehowa hiɛ koni akɛto ahã nyɛshwiei yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli."
Aaron kɛ mana lɛ yama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ koni akɛto.
Ni Israelbii lɛ ye mana afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛyashi amɛyanina shikpɔŋ ni amɛaanyɛ nɔ amɛhi. Amɛye mana lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛyashɛ Kanaana shikpɔŋ lɛ husu naa.
("Gomer" loo tsenesa kome feɔ "efa" loo yiteremɔ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome.)
17: Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Sin ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛtotoo shi yɛ gbɛ teŋ yɛ Yehowa famɔ naa kɛyashi amɛyashɛ Refidim; shi nu bɛ jɛi ni maŋ lɛ baanu.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Hã wɔ nu wɔnu!" Mose here amɛ nɔ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ mi beɔ? Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkaa Yehowa?"
Shi kumai ye maŋ lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛwie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ obajie wɔ yɛ Egipt? Koni okɛ kumai abagbe wɔ kɛ wɔbii kɛ wɔkooloi?"
No hewɔ lɛ Mose bo etsɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, "Te mafee maŋ nɛɛ mahã teŋŋ? Tɛ amɛheɔ amɛtswia mi nɛɛ!"
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Halamɔ Israel onukpai lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi komɛi ofata ohe, ni okɔ otso lɛ ni okɛtswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni okɛ amɛ atsɔ̃ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛya.
Naa, mibadamɔ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, ni nu baajɛ mli aba koni maŋ lɛ anu." Ni Mose fee nakai yɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ.
Ni Mose wo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Masa kɛ Meriba yɛ shwamɔ ni Israelbii lɛ shwa Yehowa lɛ kɛ nɔ ni amɛwie amɛkɛka lɛ akɛ, "Ni Yehowa yɛ wɔteŋ kɛ̃ nɛ? Lɛ hewɔ. Israelbii kɛ Amalekbii wu ta
Amalekbii lɛ fã ta kɛbanina Israelbii lɛ yɛ Refidim, ni amɛkɛ amɛ wu.
Ni Mose fã Yoshua ekɛɛ, "Halamɔ hii ni amɛya amɛ kɛ Amalekbii lɛ ayawu ahã maŋ lɛ. Mi lɛ mibadamɔ gɔŋkpɔ lɛ yiteŋ wɔ, ni mahiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tso lɛ yɛ midɛ̃."
Yoshua fee bɔ ni Mose fã lɛ lɛ, ni amɛtee amɛ kɛ Amalekbii lɛ yawu, ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Hur kwɔ gɔŋkpɔ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ.
Kɛji Mose wo enine nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ Amalekbii lɛ anɔ; shi kɛji Mose kɛ enine ba shi pɛ Amalekbii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ.

Shi Mose niji bɔ̃i lɛ shɔ̃ɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ awo tɛ akɛto Mose shishi ni eho eta nɔ, ni Aaron kɛ Hur hiɛ eniji lɛ amli, mɔ kome yɛ biɛ, ni mɔ kome hu yɛ biɛ, ni eniji lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ kɛyashi hulushinyɔɔ mli.
Ni Yoshua kpãtã Amalek kɛ emaŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Ŋmaa kunimyeli nɛɛ he sane lɛ owo wowlo mli ofɔ̃ shi koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔ nɔ; ni okpã owo Yoshua toiŋ akɛ mibagbe Amalek kwrakwra yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ."
Ni Mose ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ "Yehowa ji miflaŋaa,"
ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛwoa Yehowa aflaŋaa lɛ nɔ. Yehowa kɛ Amalek baawu kɛjɛ yinɔ Kɛyaashi yinɔ."
18: Yetro, Midian osɔfo lɛ, ni ji Mose shaanuu lɛ nu nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee ehã Mose kɛ emaŋ Israel lɛ he, no ji bɔ ni Yehowa jie Israel kɛjɛ Egipt lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yetro, Mose shaanuu lɛ, yiŋ etee Mose ŋɔɔ. Eŋɔ Zipora, Mose ŋa lɛ ni Mose hã eku esɛɛ etee Midian lɛ,
kɛ Mose bihii enyɔ lɛ efata ehe kɛtee. Bihii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbɛi ji Gershom, ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ, "Miyato gbɔ yɛ Maŋsɛɛ",
ni mɔ kome lɛ hu gbɛi ji Eliezer ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ, "Mitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni wa mi, ni ehe mi kɛje Farao dɛŋ gble mli."
Yetro, Mose Shaanuu lɛ, kɛ Mose ŋa lɛ kɛ ebihii enyɔ lɛ ba Mose ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ he ni Israelbii lɛ eyato shi yɛ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ.
Ni Yetro hã ayakɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mi oshaanuu, mi kɛ oŋa kɛ obihii enyɔ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose je kpo ekɛ eshaanuu lɛ yakpe. Mose koto lɛ ni eshwɔ enaa; amɛflaflaa amɛhe, ni amɛba Mose buu lɛ mli.
Ni Mose gba eshaanuu lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa fee Farao kɛ Egiptbii yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ. Egba lɛ haomɔi hi ni ba Israelbii lɛ anɔ yɛ amɛbɛfãa lɛ mli, kɛ bɔ ni fee ni Yehowa jie amɛ yɛ mli.
Yetro mii shɛ ehe yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni Yehowa efee yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahewɔ, akɛ ejie amɛ yɛ Egipt nyɔŋyeli shishi.
Ni Yetro kɛɛ, "Ajie Yehowa yi, lɛ mɔ ni ejie nyɛ yɛ Farao kɛ Egiptbii lɛ adeŋ, ni ejie emaŋ lɛ yɛ Egiptbii anɔyeli shishi lɛ.
Kpaako mina mile akɛ Yehowa fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ ejaakɛ eto Egiptbii lɛ kpa, akɛni amɛwo amɛhe amɛhã Israelbii lɛ, ni Yehowa ba amɛ shi."
Ni Yetro, Mose shaanuu lɛ, yashã shãa afɔle kɛ afɔlei krokomɛi ehã Yehowa, ni Aaron kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ba koni amɛ kɛ Mose shaanuu lɛ abaye nii yɛ he Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Kojolɔiwoo
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Mose ho eta shi, ni ekura maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji, ni maŋ lɛ jwere enɔ kɛjɛ leebi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Be ni Mose shaanuu lɛ na nibii fɛɛ ni Mose tsuɔ ehãa maŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ji nɔ ni otsuɔ ohãa maŋ lɛ nɛɛ? Mɛɛba okome too ota shi, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ jwere onɔ nɛkɛ leebileebi jenamɔ nɛɛ?"
Mose hã lɛ hetoo ekɛɛ, "Ebaa lɛ nakai ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ baa amɛbabiɔ mi Nyɔŋmɔ daaŋ gbee.
Kɛji amɛna sane ko lɛ amɛkɛbaa miŋɔɔ, ni mikuraa, ni mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpɔi kɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ."
Mose shaanuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni ofeɔ nɛɛ ehiii.
Ebaatɔ bo kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hu. Nitsumɔ nɛɛ fa tsɔ̃ hã o; okome too onyɛŋ otsu.
Agbɛnɛ bo migbee toi; mawo bo ŋaa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ aye abua o. Bo lɛ feemɔ maŋbii lɛ anaadamɔlɔ yɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ koni okɛ amɛsaji lɛ ashwie Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ;
ni otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpɔi, nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, ni ohã amɛle bɔ ni sa akɛ amɛba amɛjeŋ amɛhã, kɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ amɛfee.

Ni asaŋ halamɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ mli hii ni aaanyɛ atsu gbɛnaa ni abaahã amɛ lɛ he nii, mɛi ni amɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei hu, ni amɛji anɔkwafoi ni heee nyɔɔŋnii, koni oto amɛ kui anɔkwɛlɔi: Mɛi nyɔŋmanyɔŋma kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ-enumɔ kui kɛ mɛi ohaoha kui kɛ akpeakpe kui anɔkwɛlɔi.

Ohã amɛ amɛkura saji ni baaba maŋbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ be fɛɛ be. Sane wulu fɛɛ sane wulu lɛ, no lɛ akɛba ohiɛ; shi saji bibii fɛɛ lɛ kui anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ aye, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛmɔ mli amɛhã o koni efo tsɔ̃ ehã o.
Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fãa bo nɛ. Kɛji ofee nakai lɛ, ooonyɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ naa odamɔ, ni maŋbii nɛɛ fɛɛ hu aaayashɛ amɛshɛɛhe yɛ hejɔlɛ mli."
Mose bo eshaanuu lɛ toi, ni efee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ehala maŋ lɛ fɛɛ mli hii ni aaanyɛ atsu gbɛnaa ni abaahã amɛ lɛ he nii, ni eto amɛ kui anɔkwɛlɔi: Mɛi nyɔŋma nyɔŋma kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ kui kɛ mɛi ohaoha kui kɛ mɛi akpeakpe kui anɔkwɛlɔi.
Nɔkwɛlɔi nɛɛ kuraa maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji be fɛɛ be. Saji wuji lɛ amɛkɛbaa Mose ŋɔɔ; shi saji bibii fɛɛ lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkuraa.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Mose shaanuu Yetro kɛ lɛ ye shɛɛ, ni Yetro ku esɛɛ etee emaŋ.
19: Gbi ni Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, enɔ nyɔji etɛ̃ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni amɛyashɛ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Refidim ji he ni amɛfã kɛjɛ dani amɛyashɛ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛbato shi yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ. Yehowa jɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ etsɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ Yakob shwiei, ni ji Israelbii, lɛ akɛ,
'Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛna nɔ ni mifee Egiptbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni mihiɛ nyɛ kɛ hewalɛ tamɔ okropɔŋ, ni mikɛ nyɛ bashɛ miŋɔɔ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji nyɛaabo mi toi, ni nyɛaaye mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaatsɔ̃ mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ yɛ maji fɛɛ ateŋ; ejaakɛ je lɛ fɛɛ lɛ minɔ ni.
Mibafee nyɛ osɔfoi abladei, mibafee nyɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nɔ ni okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ nɛ.'"
Mose ku esɛɛ eba, ni ebatsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Ni maŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ shi kome amɛkɛɛ, "Nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ wɔɔfee." Mose hã Yehowa le hetoo ni maŋ lɛ hã lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Miiba oŋɔɔ yɛ atatu kpii mli koni kɛ mi kɛ bo miiwie lɛ, maŋ lɛ anu ni amɛhe bo hu amɛye kɛya naanɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Yaa maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni otsuu amɛhe ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ; ni ohã amɛfɔ amɛtadei ahe,
ni amɛsaa amɛhe amɛto gbi ni ji etɔ̃ lɛ, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ Yehowa baakpleke shi kɛba gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiŋmɛiŋ.
Foo akrabatsa okɛtsi maŋ lɛ gbɛ, ni obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛkwɛa ni ahīa koni nyɛkakwɔa gɔŋ lɛ, aloo ni nyɛtaa ehusu lɛ he.' Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ gbe aaagbe lɛ.

Mɔ ko mɔ ko nine akata nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ he, shi atswia lɛ tɛ aloo atsɛ̃rɛ̃ lɛ gãi. Kooloo ni jio, gbɔmɔ ni jio, akahã eyi na wala. Shi kɛji akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni esɛɛ tsɛ aahuu lɛ, no dani amɛba gɔŋ lɛ he."
Mose kpleke shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba maŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni etsuu maŋ lɛ he, ni amɛfɔfɔɔ amɛtadei ahe.
Ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa hã, wɔ bɛ mli, wɔsɛɛ. Nuu akaya yoo masɛi."
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ leebi lɛ ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni srawa gbla ni atatu kpii ko baha gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; tɛtrɛmantrɛ ko gbɛɛ waa naakpa, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ shitoohe lɛ fɛɛ kpokpo.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ maŋ lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ shitoohe lɛ koni amɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ayakpe, ni amɛyadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ shishi.
Sinai Gɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miije lasu, ejaakɛ Yehowa e kpleke shi kɛba gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ la mli. Lasu lɛ fãa kɛyaa ŋwɛi tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli lasu, ni gɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hoso waa naakpa.
Be ni tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ yaa nɔ gbɛɔ waa lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Mose wie, ni Nyɔŋmɔ here lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋwɛishiimɔ.
Be ni Yehowa kpleke shi kɛba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, etsɛ Mose akɛ eba gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ; ni Mose tee.
Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kplekemɔ shi ni oyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ kpɔ̃kpɔ̃ɔkpɔ̃ akɛ amɛkatse mli kɛmiiba Yehowa ŋɔɔ amɛbakwɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ, koni amɛteŋ mɛi pii miiplenee.
Asaŋ hã osɔfoi lɛ ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa atsuu amɛhe koni Yehowa akakpãtã amɛhiɛ."
Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Maŋ lɛ nyɛŋ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aba ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ okpã owo wɔtoiŋ akɛ, 'Nyɛfoa akrabatsa nyɛwoa gɔŋ lɛ he nyɛfea lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kplekemɔ shi oya ni okɛ Aaron akwɔ kɛba, shi kaahã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ miiteke akrabatsa lɛ kɛkwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛba mi, Yehowa, miŋɔɔ koni mikaplenee amɛ."
Mose kpleke shi kɛba maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ amɛ.
20: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ wie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ ekɛɛ:
"Miji Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni mi mijie o yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
"Kaana nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi yɛ misɛɛ.
"Kaafee amãgã ko loo nɔ ko ni tamɔ nii ni yɔɔŋwɛi loo nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo nii ni yɔɔ nu mli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ ohã ohe.

"Kaaja amɛ, ni kaasɔ̃mɔ amɛ hu, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋa ji mi, ni miwoɔ tsɛmɛi kɛ bii anyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ nɔ.
"Shi mɛi akpei abɔ fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ mi, ni amɛyeɔ mikitãi anɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ amɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee, ni minaa amɛ mɔbɔ.
"Kaahiɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli yakayaka, ejaakɛ Yehowa ebuŋ mɔ ni tsɛɔ egbɛi yakayaka lɛ bem.
"Ohiɛ ahi hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ ni oye lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Tsu nii gbii ekpaa ni ofee onii fɛɛ,
shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔgbi ni hã Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No nɔ lɛ okatsu nɔ ko, bo jio, obinuu jio, obiyoo jio, owenuu jio, oweyoo jio, okooloo jio, ogbɔ ni ebato omaŋ jio.
Ejaakɛ gbii ekpaa Yehowa kɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ amɛmli nibi fɛɛ; ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ejɔɔ ehe. No hewɔ ni Yehowa jɔɔ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, ni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
"Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mi, Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
"Kaagbe gbɔmɔ.
"Kaafite gblã.
"Kaaju.
"Kaaye amale odase yɛ onaanyo he.
Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ onaanyo nɔ ko nɔ, eshīa jio, eŋa jio, ewenuu jio, eweyoo jio, etsina jio, eteji jio, enɔ kroko jio, ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nɔ." Israelbii lɛ she gbeyei
Be ni Israelbii lɛ na bɔ ni ŋwɛi shimɔɔ, ni srawa gblaa, ni tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɔ, ni gɔŋ lɛ fãa lasu lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei ni amɛkpokpo, ni amɛdamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Bo moŋ okɛ wɔ awie, ni wɔɔbo toi, shi kaahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ miiwie ni wɔbagboi."
Mose kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ kaa Nyɔŋmɔ ba nyɛ kaa, bɔ ni afee ni lɛ egbeyeishemɔ ahi nyɛmli daa koni nyɛfee esha."
Shi maŋ lɛ damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ lolo; kɛkɛ ni Mose tsi ebɛŋkɛ duŋ kpii lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ mli lɛ. Afɔleshãa latɛi ahe mlai
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ Isrealbii lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛna akɛ ŋwɛi mijɛ mi kɛ nyɛ wie nɛɛ.
Nyɛkafea mihenɔ jwiɛtɛi loo shika amãgãi; nyɛkafea ekoeko nyɛhãa nyɛhe koni nyɛja amɛ nyɛfata mihe.

Nyɛshɔ̃a su afɔleshãa latɛ nyɛhãa mi, ni no nɔ nyɛshãa afɔlei yɛ, shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi kɛ tsinai lɛ yɛ. He fɛɛ he ni mato mahã nyɛ akɛ aja mi yɛ lɛ, maba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi ni majɔɔ nyɛ.
Kɛji nyɛkɛ tɛ miima afɔleshãa latɛ nyɛhã mi lɛ, akɛ tɛ ni ako akama ejaakɛ ŋaa dade naa ni aaasa tɛ lɛ he pɛ ebule lɛ.
Ni okafee atrakpoi owo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni akana oyayaiaŋ yɛ atrakpoi lɛ kwɔɔ mli.'"
21: "Agbɛnɛ okɛ mlai nɛɛ ashwie Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ.
Kɛji ohe Hebrinyo akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ esɔ̃mɔ afii ekpaa, ni afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe ni eye ehe tswaa.
Kɛji ekome eba lɛ, ekome nɔŋŋ eya. Shi kɛji ekɛ eŋa ba lɛ, no lɛ eŋa lɛ kɛ lɛ aya.
Kɛji enuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã lɛ ŋa, ni ekɛ yoo lɛ efɔ bihii loo biyei lɛ, no lɛ yoo lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ etsɔ̃ enuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nuu lɛ kome too aya.
Shi kɛji nyɔŋ lɛ gba mli kpoo ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Miisumɔ minuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ miŋa kɛ mibii lɛ, ni misumɔɔɔ akɛ mashi amɛ maya mayaye mihe lɛ,'
no lɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ aya Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ehã edamɔ jamɔhe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa loo shinaatso lɛ he, ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ fitii agbu nyɔŋ lɛ toi, ni nyɔŋ lɛ asɔ̃mɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
"Kɛji nuu ko hɔ̃ɔ ebiyoo akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ, biyoo nɛɛ akatsɔ̃ gbɛ nɔ ni hii nyɔji tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ amɛhe lɛ nɔ eye ehe.
Kɛ nyɔŋ yoo nɛɛ esaaa enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ akɛ eeeŋɔ lɛ efee eŋa lɛ, no lɛ ehã abakpɔ̃ lɛ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɛ hegbɛ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ ehãa maŋsɛɛnyo, ejaakɛ no lɛ eku eshiwoo mli.
Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ yoo lɛ hã ebinuu gblã lɛ, nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ yoo nɛɛ ahi shi akɛ ebiyoo.
Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ yaŋɔ yoo ni ji enyɔ ebafata nyɔŋyoo lɛ he lɛ, no akahã etsɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ daaŋ ŋmaa kɛ ehebo kɛ egblãshihilɛ mli gbɛnaa nii nɔ.
Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsuuu nibii etɛ̃ nɛɛ ehãaa nyɔŋ yoo lɛ, no lɛ nyɔŋ yoo lɛ aye ehe tswaa, ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ aheɔ eyi shika ko." Awuiyeli he mlai
"Mɔ ni aaatswa enyɛmi gbɔmɔ nɔ, ni mɔ lɛ aaagbo lɛ, lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Kɛjeee ka eyawo lɛ, shi oshrã naa ni, enine kpa yɛ mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ ejo foi eyaba abo yɛ he ko ni mato mahã nyɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ko to ŋaa fɔŋ yɛ enyɛmi gbɔmɔ he, ni eje gbɛ eyatua lɛ, ni egbe lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ eyaba abo yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa tete po, ajie lɛ kɛje jɛi ni ayagbe lɛ.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagba etsɛ loo enyɛ ma lɛ agbe lɛ.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaju gbɔmɔ lɛ, eyahɔɔ lɛ jio, eto lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ ehã ehe jio, agbe lɛ.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaalomɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ agbe lɛ.
"Kɛji hii miinɔ ni mɔ kome tswa enaanyo lɛ tɛ aloo ema lɛ atswɛrɛ, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔɔɔ mli gbooo, shi efee lɛ hela kɛkã shi lɛ,
kɛji helatsɛ lɛ na ete shi ekoŋŋ, ni emɔ tso mli enyiɛ kɛje kpo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ eye ehe, shi moŋ ewo be ni helatsɛ lɛ efite lɛ he nyɔmɔ, ni ekwɛ koni atsa helatsɛ lɛ ni ehe atã kwrakwra.
"Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ tso tswa enyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo, ni nyɔŋ lɛ nyɔ yɛ enine naa lɛ, ja atɔ nyɔŋ lɛ he owele yɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi kɛji jɛ tsɛre nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi kome loo gbii enyɔ lɛ, akatɔ owele yɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ nyɔŋ lɛ ni egbo lɛ, lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ, eshika ni elaaje ni.

"Kɛji hii miinɔ ni amɛkɛ nɔmɔ lɛ yapila yoohɔlɔ, ni emusu lɛ fite, shi eyeee lɛ awui kroko kɛfataaa he lɛ, agbe nuu mɔ ni pila yoohɔlɔ lɛ shika gbele. Yoo wu lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ nyɔmɔ ni ekɛfɔ̃ɔ nuu lɛ nɔ nɛ, shi moŋ bɔ ni saneyelɔi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nakai nuu lɛ awo.
Shi kɛji sane fɔŋ ba yɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ oweletɔɔ lɛ afee atoŋ kɛ atoŋ, no ji akɛ wala atsɛ wala,
ni akɛ hiŋmɛi atsɛ hiŋmɛi, ni akɛ nyanyɔŋ atse nyanyɔŋ, akɛ nane atse nane,
akɛ la fla atse la fla, akɛ pilamɔ atse pilamɔ, ni akɛ kplebi naa fla atse kplebi naa fla.
"Kɛji mɔ ko tswa enyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo hiŋmɛi nɔ, ni hiŋmɛi lɛ fite lɛ, ehã nyɔŋ lɛ aye ehe tswaa yɛ ehiŋmɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã enyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo nyanyɔŋ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ nyɔŋ lɛ he koni eyaye ehe tswaa yɛ enyanyɔŋ lɛ hewɔ." Kooloi anuŋtsɔmɛi asɔ̃
"Kɛji tsina shi nuu loo yoo, ni mɔ lɛ gbo lɛ, atswia tsina lɛ tɛ ni agbe lɛ, ni akaye eloo lɛ, shi tsinatsɛ lɛ aye ehe.
Shi kɛji tsina lɛ fɔɔ mɔ shimɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, ni abɔ nɔtsɛ lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ he, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ewooo ekooloo lɛ tsuŋ, ni eyagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, atswia tsina lɛ tɛ, ni tsinatsɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Shi kɛji aahe tsinatsɛ lɛ kpãtãmɔ nii lɛ, no lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni aheɔ lɛ lɛ, ewo koni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma.
Kɛji tsina lɛ yashi mɔ ko binuu loo biyoo lɛ akɛ tsinatsɛ lɛ aye yɛ mla kome nɛɛ nɔŋŋ naa.
Kɛji tsina lɛ yashi nyɔŋ nuu loo nyɔŋ yoo lɛ tsinatsɛ lɛ ahã nyɔŋ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwiɛtɛi shekel nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni no sɛɛ hu lɛ atswia tsina lɛ tɛ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko shi bu naa eŋmɛ aloo eyatsa bu ni etsiii nɔ, ni tsina loo teji ko yagbee mli lɛ,
mɔ ni tsa bu lɛ awo koolootsɛ lɛ ekooloo lɛ he nyɔmɔ koni bu tsɛ lɛ aŋɔ kooloo gbonyo lɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko tsina pila enaanyo tsina, ni kooloo lɛ gbo lɛ, mɛi enyɔ lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ tsina hiɛkalɔ lɛ koni amɛja shika lɛ, ni kooloo ni egbo lɛ hu amɛja.
Shi kɛji ale ato akɛ tsina lɛ fɔɔ mɔshimɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, shi tsinatsɛ lɛ wooo tsina lɛ tsuŋ lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ tsina ato mɔ lɛ tsina lɛ najiaŋ ehã lɛ koni mɔ ni tsina yashi lɛ aŋɔ tsina ni egbo lɛ."
22: "Kɛji mɔ ko yaju tsina loo too, ni eyagbe aloo eyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ekɛ tsinai enumɔ ato tsina kome najiaŋ, ni ekɛ toi ejwɛ ato too kome najiaŋ. Shi kɛ ebɛ nɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ koni akɛtse nii ni eju lɛ.
Kɛ ji ana kooloo ni eyaju lɛ hiɛkãlɔ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, tsina ni jio, teji ni jio, too ni jio, eku ebɔ he toi enyɔ eto najiaŋ.
"Kɛji ana julɔ nyɔɔŋ ni eejwa mɔ ko shinaa ni ebote mli, ni atswa lɛ nɔ ni egbo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ yeee ela yi sɔ̃.
Shi kɛji shwane agbe lɛ lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ yeɔ ela yi sɔ̃.

"Kɛji mɔ ko ŋmɛɛ ekooloo he, ni eyaye ŋmɔ loo waintrom ko mli nii, aloo mɔ ko kwɛɛɛ ekooloo lɛ nɔ, ni ekooloo lɛ yaye mɔ kroko ko ŋmɔshinii kɛ, koolootsɛ lɛ kɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋmɔshi loo waintrom mli nii ni hi fe fɛɛ ato nii ni afite lɛ najiaŋ.
"Kɛji mo ko wo la, ni etso kɛyamɔ ŋmeii, ni eshã able kɛ aboŋo, loo able ni akuko, loo ŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni wo la lɛ ato nii ni hiɛ kpãtã lɛ najiaŋ shishiishi.
"Kɛji mo ko kɛ shika loo nibii hã enaanyo shitoo, ni aju nii lɛ yɛ mɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni amɔ julɔ lɛ, julɔ lɛ kɛ nii ni eju lɛ toi enyɔ ato najiaŋ.
Shi kɛji anaaa julɔ lɛ, no lɛ shīatsɛ lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ebatsɔɔ akɛ enine etako enaanyo lɛ nii lɛ he.

"Niiaheplemɔ fɛɛ ni aaate shi lɛ, tsina he ejɛ jio, teji he jio, too he jio, atade he jio, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eji ni aaaple he ni mɔ ko aaakɛɛ akɛ enɔ ni lɛ, akɛ sane lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu lɛ fɔ lɛ, ekɛ nɔ lɛ toi enyɔ ato enaanyo lɛ nii lɛ najiaŋ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ eteji loo tsina loo too kooloo fɛɛ kooloo hã enaanyo shitoo, ni kooloo lɛ gbo, aloo aye lɛ awui, aloo ofɔ̃yelɔi bamɔ lɛ kɛtee, shi anaaa mɔ ko aye he odase lɛ,
mɔ ni akɛ nɔ lɛ hã shitoo lɛ ayakã Yehowa kitã akɛ enine etako enaanyo lɛ nii lɛ he. Nɔtsɛ lɛ akplɛ̃ nɔ, ni mɔ ni akɛ nii lɛ hã shitoo etoŋ nɔtsɛ lɛ najiaŋ.
Shi kɛji ju aju nii lɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ eto nɔtsɛ lɛ najiaŋ.
Kɛji kooloo kakawua ko ni tserɛ kooloo lɛ, ekɛ kooloo gbonyo lɛ abaye odase koni ekato najiaŋ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko yama kooloo ko yɛ enaanyo dɛŋ, ni eye kooloo lɛ awui, aloo egbo be mli ni nɔtsɛ lɛ bɛ jɛi lɛ, mɔ ni yama kooloo lɛ ato najiaŋ shishiishi;
shi kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ, no lɛ akato najiaŋ. Kɛji apaayeli akɛ kooloo lɛ ba lɛ, no lɛ akato najiaŋ ejaakɛ epaayeli nyɔmɔ ni awo hewɔ eba." Jeŋba he mlai
"Kɛji nuu ko yalaka oblayoo fro ni atsɛko ehe baa, ni ekɛ lɛ wɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ ahã yoo lɛ yinii koni etsɔ̃ eŋa.
Shi kɛji yoo lɛ tsɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ yoo lɛ kɛ nuu lɛ hãmɔ kwraa lɛ, nuu lɛ ahã bɔ ni ji oblayoo fro yinii kɛ̃.
"Akaŋmɛ yoo ŋkunyaayelɔ gbɛ ni ehi jeŋ.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ kooloo aaawɔ lɛ esa akɛ agbe lɛ.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaashi Yehowa sɛɛ ni eeeyashã afɔle ehã nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ akpãtã ehiɛ butubutu.
"Akaye gbɔ sane ni ejaaa, ni akawa lɛ yi ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔi yɛ Egipt dã.
Akawa yoo okulafo loo awusa yi.
Kɛji awa amɛ yi, ni amɛfo amɛtsɛ mi lɛ, ja mibo amɛyaafo toi.
Mimlifu naa aaawa naakpa, ni magbe nyɛ yɛ ta mli, ni nyɛ ŋamɛi aaatsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi, ni nyɛbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ awusai.
"Kɛji ofa mimaŋbii ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ ohiafo ko shika lɛ, kaaye lɛ wie, ni kaahe hekpa hu.
Kɛji eeeba lɛ po akɛ onaanyo kɛ ehebo aaato bo awaba lɛ, okɛ ehebo lɛ aku sɛɛ ohã lɛ dani hulu ayanyɔ shi,
ejaakɛ no pɛ ji nɔ ni ekɛhaa ehe, ehewolo nɔ mama ni. Mɛni eha kɛwɔ? Kɛji efo etsɛ mi lɛ mabo lɛ toi ejaakɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji mi.
"Kaawie oshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kaalomɔ maŋ onukpa.
"Kɛji oŋmɔshi nii ba, ni kɛ oŋa owain kɛ omu lɛ, kaashashao shi ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ abahã lɛ. Jɔɔmɔ obihii ateŋ kromɔ lɛ nɔ ohã mi.
Nakai nɔŋŋ hu ofee otsinai kɛ toi. Kooloo kromɔ nuu lɛ ehi enyɛ masɛi gbii kpawo, ni gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ ojɔɔ enɔ ohã mi.
"Nyɛaatsɔ̃ mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhã mi. No hewɔ lɛ loo ni ŋaŋ kooloo etserɛ lɛ lɛ nyɛkayea, ashɛrɛ ashwie ahã gbeii.
23: "Kaawie nɔ ni bɛ mli. Kaafi gbɔmɔ fɔŋ sɛɛ kɛmiiye kutumpɔo odase.
Kaanyiɛ mɛi ni yi fa sɛɛ kɛyafee efɔŋ, ni kaanyiɛ nɔ ni mɛi pii kɛɔ sɛɛ ni okɛɛ nɔ ko ni aaahã atsɔ sane hiɛ abu shi,
asaŋ kaasaa ohiafo sane he ohã lɛ yɛ saneyeli mli.
"Kɛji ona ohenyɛlɔ tsina loo teji ni edu gbɛ lɛ kplamɔ lɛ obahã lɛ.
Kɛ oyanina mɔ ni kɛ bo yeee kɛ eteji ni teji lɛ jatsu tsii fe lɛ lɛ, kwɛmɔ ni okaho amɛhe otee, shi moŋ ye obua nɔtse lɛ koni awo kooloo lɛ nɔ adamɔ shi.
"Kaatsɔ̃ ohiafo sane hiɛ obu shi yɛ saneyeli mli.
Kaafo sane ofɔ̃ mɔ nɔ, ni kaagbe jalɔ kɛ mɔ ni he bɛ sane ko mli ejaakɛ mihaŋ efɔŋfeelɔ aye ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Kaahe nyɔɔŋnii ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋnii shwilaa nɔkwɛlɔ, ni efiteɔ mɔ ni sane ja sane.
"Nyɛkawaa gbɔ yi, akɛ ni nyɛle bɔ ni gbɔ tsui nuɔ nii ahe ehãa lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔi yɛ Egipt dã." Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ kɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ
"Ahu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akpa enɔ nibaanii lɛ kɛyashi afii ekpaa;

shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ahã shikpɔŋ lɛ ajɔɔ ehe ni ekã shi efolo koni omaŋ lɛ mli ohiafoi lɛ ana enɔ nii amɛklɔ amɛye, ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hu ana aye. Nakai nɔŋŋ ofee owain trom kɛ omutso trom.
"Otsu nii gbi ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ okɛjɔɔ ohe, bɔ ni afee ni otsina kɛ oteji ajɔɔ amɛhe, ni nyɔŋ yoo bi kɛ ogbɔ awo amɛtsui.
"Nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ. Nyɛkatsīa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi agbɛii tã, akanu yɛ nyɛnaa tete." Gbiijuji etɛ̃ lɛ
"Daa afi lɛ nyɛyea gbiijuji etɛ̃ nyɛhãa mi.

Nyɛ yea Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ. Bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ, nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã. Nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo yɛ be ni ato lɛ, ni ji Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ no nɔ nyɛshi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No be lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ko akaba mi jamɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ edɛŋ afɔle.
"Nyɛyea Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔ lɛ ni ji ŋmɔshinii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii agbijurɔ lɛ; ni nyɛyea Ŋmaa naabuamɔ kɛtoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ afi lɛ naagbee mli, be ni nyɛbuaa ŋmɔshi nii anaa nyɛtoɔ lɛ.
Daa afi lɛ nyɛteŋ nuu fɛɛ nuu abaja Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shii etɛ̃ yɛ nɛkɛ gbii juji etɛ̃ nɛɛ anɔ.
"Kooloo ni akɛbaashã afɔle ahã mi lɛ, nyɛkɛ masha aboloo akafataa he; ni kooloo ni akɛshã afɔle ahã mi lɛ, nyɛkahãa je miitsɛre emli fɔ lɛ nɔ.
"Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshinii ni nyɛbaakpa lɛ nyɛkɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ. Akahoo toobi kɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu." Shiwoi kɛ Akpɔi
"Naa, miwo bɔfo gbɛ ni enyiɛ nyɛhiɛ koni ebaa nyɛyi yɛ gbɛteŋ koni ekɛ nyɛ ayashɛ he ni misaa mito lɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ egbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛyea ewiemɔ nɔ. Nyɛkatsea ehiɛ atua; ekɛ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔtɔmɔ ekeŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ ehiɛ mihewalɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛye egbee nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ matsɔ̃ henyɛlɔ mahã nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ nyɛ tswaa baatswa.
Mibɔfo lɛ aaanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛyanina Amorbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Perezbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ,ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ butubutu.
Nyɛkajaa ni nyɛkasɔ̃mɔa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, asaŋ nyɛkakasea gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anifeemɔ nii hu, shi moŋ nyɛ butua amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni nyɛkumɔa amɛshiui lɛ butubutu nyɛshiea shi.
Kɛji nyɛsɔ̃mɔ mi, Yehowa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, madro nyɛ niyenii kɛ nu, ni makɔ hela yɛ nyɛteŋ mashɛ mafɔ̃ kwraa.
Yoo shrãkeŋ, ni anaŋ yoo kene yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mahã nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ.
"Mahã miheŋmiŋmi atsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ amɔmɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ dani nyɛaayanina amɛ, ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ ni nyɛaashɛ lɛ aaajija yɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Matsu sosomotii kɛaatsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ. Mashwie Hivbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Shi moŋ mishwieŋ amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ afi kome nɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ akabatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, koni ŋaŋ kooloi ayi bafa yɛ nɔ wo nyɛ.
Fiofio mibashwie amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛyi aaafa, ni nyɛaaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Mafo husu mahã nyɛ kɛjɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa, agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, ejaakɛ mahã nyɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anɔ kunim koni nyɛshwie amɛ.
Amɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ jio, amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jio, nyɛkɛ amɛ akakpãŋa kpãmɔ ko.
Nyɛkahãa amɛhia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛmiihã nyɛfee esha nyɛshi mi. Ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ eeetsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã nyɛ."
24: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Bo kɛ Aaron kɛ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo akwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ koni nyɛbaja yɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Mose, okome pɛ otsi obɛŋkɛ Yehowa; mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ akatsi amɛbɛŋkɛ, ni maŋbii lɛ hu kɛ bo akakwɔ kɛmiiba."
Mose ba ni ebajaje Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ. Ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ kɛ gbee kome amɛkɛɛ, "Wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa ewie lɛ wɔɔye nɔ."
Mose ŋmla Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shi. Kɛkɛ ni ete shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ehole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ edamɔ shi yɛ Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ anaa.
Ni etsu Israelbii lɛ ateŋ oblahii komɛi, ni amɛkɛ tsina hii yashã afɔle kɛ shidaa afɔle amɛhã Yehowa.
Mose kɛ lá lɛ fã wo lalakãi amli, ni lá lɛ fã ni shwɛ lɛ efɔ̃ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Agbɛbɛ ekɔ kpãŋmɔ wolo lɛ, ni ekane yɛ maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ wɔɔfee, ni wɔɔbo lɛ toi."
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Mose wo lá lɛ, ni ekɛshwã maŋbii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa, kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ yɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ he lɛ nɔ lá nɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Israel onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee,
ni amɛyana Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Amɛna ni ena nemaahei lɛ efee tamɔ he ko ni akɛ safiro tɛ eka; safiro tɛ nɛɛ mlitsemɔ lɛ enɔ bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ efeee Israel onukpai nɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ko, shi amɛna Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi, ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kwɔɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni obamɛ, ni mikɛ tɛi tɛtrɛbii ni maŋmla mlai lɛ kɛ kitãi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ baaha o, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ etsulɔ Yoshua te shi, ni Mose kwɔ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi ekɛɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhia biɛ nyɛmɛa wɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛba. Aaron kɛ Hur kɛ nyɛ yɛ biɛ. Kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ sane ko lɛ akɛyahã amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ Mose kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ, ni atatu lɛ baha gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni Yehowa anumnyam la lɛ kpleke shi kɛba Sinai gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Atatu lɛ ye gbii ekpaa ni eha gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ Yehowa jɛ atatu lɛ mli etsɛ Mose.
Yehowa anumnyam lɛ, kɛji Israelbii lɛ miikwɛ lɛ, amɛnaa lɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ tamɔ lɛ grigri ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ.
Mose kwɔ gɔŋ lɛ, ni ebote atatu lɛ mli. Eye nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
25: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Bi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛkɛ nikee nii aba. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ he tsui akɛ ehã lɛ, lɛ edɛŋ nikee nii nyɛhea nyɛhãa mi.
Ni nikee nii ni amɛkɛba lɛ nɛ: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble,
kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kɛ abotia he tsɔi,
kɛ ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru kɛ nuŋgbee he wolo kɛ tso.
Ekrokomɛi hu ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane, kɛ tsofai ni akɛfutuɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu mli lɛ. Ekomɛi hu ji tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa.
Abake oniketɛi ni akɛbaamamɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ kɛ ehewulamɔ nii lɛ eko ni atsɛɔ lɛ efod lɛ amli lɛ.
Ohã Israelbii lɛ afee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ ko amɛhã mi koni mahi amɛteŋ.
Bɔ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ su kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ hu asu lɛ, nyɛfea lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ
"Ohã amɛkpɛ tso adeka. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Ashwie adeka lɛ mli kɛ ehe fɛɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni akɛ shika abaŋ adeka lɛ naa fɛɛ kɛkpe kpula.
Ashwie shika gai ejwɛ ato adeka lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ. Gai enyɔ aye afã kome, ni enyɔ hu aye afã kome lɛ.
Akɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko agbɔlɔ tsei bloblobii ni ashwie amɛhe shika.
Akɛ tsei nɛɛ ahɔlɔ gai ni yɔɔ adeka lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ amli koni akɛwo.
Tsei lɛ ahɔlɔ gai lɛ amli, akajie yɛ mli.
Okɛ odase yeli tɛi lɛ ni mikɛbaahã o lɛ awo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.
"Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔi kome kɛ fã.
Otsawia shika, ni okɛfee kerubii enyɔ omamɔ naanɔ lɛ nɔ koji lɛ anɔ.
Kerubi kome yɛ koŋ kome kɛ ekome hu yɛ koŋ kome lɛ. Sɔomɔ kerubii nɛɛ okpɛtɛ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Kerubii lɛ agbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛya ŋwɛi ni amɛkɛha naanɔ lɛ nɔ, ni kerubi kome akwɛ kerubi kome hiɛ, asaŋ amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi amɛkwɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ.
Okɛ odaseyeli tɛi lɛ ni mikɛbaahã o lɛ awo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli koni okɛ naanɔ lɛ abu naa.

Gbɛ ni kã kerubii enyɔ lɛ ateŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ mi kɛ bo kpeehe, ni jɛi majɛ mi kɛ bo aaawie nibii fɛɛ ni mifã o akɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ. Okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Aboloo lɛ maa nɔ lɛ
"Okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko akpɛ okplɔ̃. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Oshwie ehe shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekoji lɛ okɛ shika abaŋ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe.
Ogbɔ tso blawãa ni elɛɛmɔ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ koni okɛkpɛtɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ toi kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni okɛ shika abaŋ tso blawaa nɛɛ naa kpula.
Feemɔ shika gai ejwɛ okɛwo okplɔ̃ lɛ naji ejwɛ lɛ ahe.
Gai nɛɛ aye tso blawaa lɛ shishi tuuŋtu, ni nomɛi amli akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ ahɔlɔ.
Okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko agbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ, ni oshwie he shika koni akɛwo okplɔ̃ lɛ.
Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee okplɔ̃ lɛ he plɛtei kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma baawo amɛmli lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ okpolui kɛ kpuji ni akɛbaaye ŋkpai lɛ.
Ni okɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa mihiɛ lɛ ama okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ yɛ mihiɛ daa. Kanetso lɛ
“Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia afee kanetso. Otswia shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛfee eshimaatso lɛ kɛ eshishi nii ni ema nɔ lɛ fɛɛ. Ehe tɔi lɛ kɛ ehe kpɔbii lɛ kɛ ehe fɔfɔi samai lɛ fɛɛ atsa akɛ nɔ muu kome.
Kanetso lɛ ahiɛ niji ekpaa, niji etɛ̃ aye afã kome nɛɛ, ni niji etɛ̃ hu aye afã kome nɛɛ.

Afã kome ahiɛ tɔi etɛ̃ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi; tɔ fɛɛ tɔ kɛ ekpɔ kɛ efɔfɔi sama yɛ nine kome he, ni afã kome lɛ hu ahiɛ tɔi etɛ̃ tamɔ ŋmɛi, tɔ fɛɛ tɔ kɛ ekpɔ kɛ efɔfɔi sama yɛ nine kome he. Nakai sɔŋŋ afee niji ekpaa lɛ fɛɛ ni kanetso lɛ egbla lɛ.
Kanetso lɛ shimaatso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ena tɔi ejwɛ ni tamɔ ŋmɛi kɛ amɛhe kpɔbii kɛ fɔfɔi samai.
Ni kpɔi amamɔ kanetso lɛ hu niji ntai enyɔɔnyɔ lɛ ashishi yɛ shimaatso lɛ he, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ niji ekpaa lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kpɔ yɛ eshishi.
Amɛhe tɔi lɛ kɛ fɔfɔi samai lɛ kɛ shimaatso lɛ fɛɛ atsa akɛ nɔ muu kome, ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi atswia fɛɛ.
Ofee kanei kpawo omamɔ kanetso lɛ nɔ, koni kɛji asu lɛ amɛkpɛ kɛya hiɛgbɛ.
Kanetso lɛ he abɛɛlei lɛ kɛ ehe lagbee nii lɛ akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee.
Aŋmɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome koni akɛfee kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Kwɛmɔ ni ofee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ."
26: "Okɛ mamai nyɔŋma ni alo kɛ klala yɛŋ futaa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ ni anyɛne afee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Alo kerubii awo mli.
Mama kome kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai lɛ fɛɛ adramɔ afee ekome.
Okpɛ mamai lɛ enumɔ otsra, eko tsa eko naa, kɛfee mama muu kome, ni okpɛ enumɔ krokomɛi lɛ hu otsra, eko tsa eko naa, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛfee mama muu kome.
Okɛ kpãa bluu aŋmɔlɔ aflãi owo mama muu kome naa, ni ofee mama muu kroko lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Oŋmɔlɔ aflãi nɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome naa kɛ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ hu yɛ mama muu kroko lɛ naa.
Ofee kpoji Nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni okɛlala mamai enyɔ lɛ anaabui lɛ otsra Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ mama lɛ koni etsɔ̃ nɔ muu kome.
"Okɛ abotia he tsɔi afee mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome okɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mama kome kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome nɛɛ fɛɛ adramɔ afee ekome.
Otsra mamai enumɔ aŋklo kɛ mamai ekpaa hu aŋklo. Mama ni ji ekpaa ni baaye buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ odɔ mli enyɔ.
Oŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mamai enumɔ ni otsra lɛ aŋklo lɛ naa, kɛ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ hu yɛ mamai ekpaa ni otsra lɛ aŋklo lɛ naa.
Ofee akɔɔble kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni okɛlala aflãi lɛ, ni okɛtsra buu mama lɛ koni efee nɔ muu kome.
Buu mama ni shwɛɔ lɛ, ni ji mama fã lɛ ni dɛŋ nɔ lɛ, odɔ ofɔ̃ nɔ koni ekã nɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.
Ni buu mamai lɛ akɛlɛ mli ninetalɔ kome ni dɛŋɔ nɔ yɛ afã kome nɛɛ, kɛ ninetalɔ kome hu ni dɛŋɔ nɔ yɛ afã kroko lɛ, ebɔ nɔ koni ekã Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ koni eha Buu lɛ he.
"Okɛ ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofã tsuru aha buu lɛ nɔ, ni okɛ nuŋgbee wolo aha yiteŋ oto nɔ.
"Okɛ tso afee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi ni baamamɔ shi lɛ.
Mplaŋ kome kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Ojie nyanyɔji enyɔ yɛ mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ he koni onyɛ okɛtsa eko kɛ eko. Bɔ ni omamɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ nɛ:
Mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ aye Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ.
Okɛ jwiɛtɛi afee nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ owo mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ ashishi koni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ama enyɔ nɔ.
Kpee buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ aye jɛi,
kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni enyɔ yɛ mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ shishi.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, he ni ye kɛyaa anaigbɛ lɛ, mplaŋi ekpaa aye jɛi.
Okɛ mplaŋi enyɔɔnyɔ ajie Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Okɛ koŋ kome mplaŋi enyɔ lɛ abɔ he kɛkɛ yɛ amɛshishigbɛ; shi otsa amɛ yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ga lɛ yi. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ofee koji enyɔ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ abaana mplaŋi kpaanyɔ yɛ sɛɛgbɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ama enyɔ nɔ.
"Okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko afee mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ ohã mplaŋi ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kome,
ni mplaŋi ni yɔɔ ŋmawuiaŋ kome lɛ hu ana mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ; ni sɛɛgbɛ, ni ji anaigbɛ, mplaŋi lɛ ana mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni mlibɛlɛmɔ nii ni baaye mplaŋi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekã shi emuu kɛjɛ koŋ kome kɛyagbe naa yɛ kome lɛ.
Okɛ shika aha mplaŋi lɛ ahe, ni okɛ shika nɔŋŋ afee gai ni akɛ mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ baahɔlɔ mli lɛ; ni mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ hu okɛ shika aha he.
Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ bɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ o yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, oma lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
"Okɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru faa kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne afee mu hɔɔ. Akɛ ŋaa alo kerubii awo muhɔɔ nɛɛ mli.
Okɛ muhɔɔ lɛ atsotsoro kpoji anaa yɛ tso akulashiŋi ni aha amɛhe shika lɛ ahe. Akɛ shika afee kpoji lɛ, ni akulashiŋ lɛ amamɔ jwiɛtɛi nibii ejwɛ anɔ.
Okɛ kpoji lɛ alala muhɔɔ lɛ kɛtsotsoro shi, ni okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ abama muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ koni muhɔɔ lɛ afo He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe fɛɛ lɛ teŋ ahã nyɛ.
Okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ, ni ji kpãtãmɔ sɛ̃i lɛ, abu naa yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ.
Okɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ ama muhɔɔ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kooyigbɛ, ni kanetso lɛ aye Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli wuoyigbɛ koni ekwɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ hiɛ.
"Ni buu lɛ naa shinaa lɛ, okɛ mama ni akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru faa kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne elo, asaŋ ni akɛ abui elo nii awo mli afee.
Ni okɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko afee akulashiŋi enumɔ ohã shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ. Okɛ shika aha tsei nɛɛ ahe, ni owo amɛhe shika kpoji kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ."
27: "Okɛ tso lɛ eko akpɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi enumɔ, ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ aye egbɔ; ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔi etɛ̃.
Feemɔ aklontoi omamɔ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ anɔ. Aklontoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ afee nɔ muu kome, ni okɛ akɔɔble aha latɛ muu lɛ fɛɛ he.
Ofee latɛ lɛ he ŋɛsui ni akɛloo elamlu lɛ, asaŋ ofee ehe sofii kɛ ekpolui kɛ fakai kɛ lajee tsɛnsii hu. Okɛ akɔɔblɛ afee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Ofee akɔɔble ntaŋ, ni okɛ akɔɔble nɔŋŋ afee gai owo ntaŋ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ.
Okɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ lɛ awo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli ni eyakã latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
Okɛ tso lɛ eko agbɔlɔ tsei bloblobii, ni oha amɛhe akɔɔble.
Okɛ tsei nɛɛ ahɔlɔ gai lɛ amli yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ koni akɛwo.
Okɛ ŋmoŋmolo akpɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni gbɛ ahi emli. Okpɛ latɛ lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ o yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ." Kpee Buu lɛ he afabaŋ lɛ
"Ofee kpo owo Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he. Ewuoyigbɛ lɛ akɛ klala kpakpa ni ekɛlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi oha afee muhɔɔ ahã jɛi.
Amamɔ muhɔɔ lɛ he akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii nyɔŋmai enyɔ koni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji lɛ kɛ mliblɛmɔ nii lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi afee.

Ni asaŋ kpo lɛ kɛlɛ nɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ hu, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi oha. Akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ nakai nɔŋŋ ahi jɛi kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Shi akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji kɛ mliblɛmɔ nii lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi afee.
Kpo lɛ lɛɛmɔ nɔ he ni ye anaigbɛ lɛ jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, nu akulashiŋi nyɔŋma kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋma ni amɛmamɔ nɔ ahi jɛi.
Kpo lɛ lɛɛmɔ mli he ni ye bokãgbɛ, ni ji ehiɛ lɛ, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Muhɔɔ ni ekɛlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ aha kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ afã kome kɛ ehe akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Agbo lɛ afã kome lɛ hu jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ ehe akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃.

Kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naahaa nii lɛ akɛ mama ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ kpãa yɛŋ srãsrã ni anyɛne, asaŋ ni akɛ abui elo nii ewo mli afee. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ehe akulashiŋi ejwɛ kɛ amɛshishi nibii ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Akulashiŋi fɛɛ ni bɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ, akɛ jwiɛtɛi afee amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii kɛ amɛhe kpoji lɛ, ni akɛ akɔɔble afee amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ.

Kpo lɛ kɛlɛ ahiɛ ninetalɔi oha, elɛɛmɔ ahiɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ ahiɛ ninetalɔi enumɔ. Akɛ klala kpakpa afee emli muhɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ akɔɔble afee akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ.
Ni nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbaatsu Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nii kɛ ehe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ kpo lɛ hu shiŋmlitsei lɛ akɛ akɔɔble afee fɛɛ." Kanetso lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ
"Fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛbahã bo mutso mu ni mli tse krɔŋŋ ni akɛsu kane lɛ koni ahã kane lɛ ama nɔ be fɛɛ be.

Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ asu kane lɛ ama muhɔɔ ni etsī Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkwɛ koni kane nɛɛ atso kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ kɛyashi leebi yɛ mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi hã Israelbii ayinɔbii fɛɛ."
28: "Ŋɔɔ onyɛmi Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ, ni ji Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar, kɛjɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ koni amɛsɔmɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi.
Ni okpɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ nyam kɛ fɛo ohã onyɛmi Aaron.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni midro amɛ ŋaa ni baanyɛ nii ni obaama amɛ lɛ amɛtsu lɛ, okɛ amɛ awie koni okɛ hewulamɔ nibii lɛ kpɛɛ awo amɛdɛŋ.

Ni hewulamɔ nibii ni abaakpɛ lɛ nɛ: tsitsinɔhaa nii kɛ efod kɛ atade yuu kɛ flaka ni alo nii awo mli kɛ fai kɛ mliteŋfīi nii. Amɛkpɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi nɛɛ amɛhã onyɛmi Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ koni amɛkɛsɔ̃mɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi.
Ahã ŋaalɔi nɛɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa.
"Amɛkɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa ni alo nii awo mli afee efod lɛ.
Akpɛ mamai hwīahwīabii enyɔ ni baakã kɔŋ nɔ akɛtsa efod lɛ koji enyɔ koni akɛ nomɛi aŋmɔ efod lɛ.
Akɛŋaa kome lɛ nɔŋŋ afee kɔŋ nɔ mamai hwīahwīabii nɛɛ, ni akɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa ni alo nii awo mli lɛ nɔŋŋ eko afee.
"Klɔmɔ oniketɛi enyɔ ni oŋmla Israelbii lɛ agbɛii owo amɛnɔ.
Gbɛii lɛ amli ekpaa ahi tɛ kome nɔ, ni ekpaa ni eshwɛ lɛ hu ahi tɛ kome lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa.
Bɔ ni shikaŋaalɔ yeɔ sama ewoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nii nɔ lɛ, nakai okpɛ Yakob bii lɛ agbɛii lɛ owo tɛi enyɔ lɛ nɔ. Ni osere shika okɛbɔle tɛi lɛ koni amɛmamɔ mli.

Okɛ tɛi enyɔ nɛɛ amamɔ efod lɛ he mamai hwīahwìabii ni baakã kɔŋ nɔ lɛ anɔ koni akɛkai Yakob bii lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ be fɛɛ be ni Aaron aaaba Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, Israel akutsei lɛ agbɛii yɛ ekɔji enyɔ lɛ anɔ koni makai amɛ daa.
Seremɔ shika okɛbɔle tɛi lɛ koni amɛmamɔ mli,
ni okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa koni okɛlala shika ni asere abɔle tɛi lɛ." Tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ

"Okɛ ŋaa afee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ ohã osɔfonukpa lɛ, ni ekɛtao Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaa nii ele. Nibii ni okɛfee efod lɛ okɛ no nɔŋŋ eko afee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ okɛ no nɔŋŋ eko afee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ: kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa.
Ofee lɛ ni adɔ mli enyɔ afɔ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ aye egbɔ: ekɛlɛ afee klakate kome kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu klakate kome.
Oto tɛi klɛ̃mpɛ̃i ejwɛ omamɔ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ nɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ klɛ̃mpɛ̃ lɛ mli tɛi afee ojrawatɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ rubi kɛ topasiɔn kɛ garneto lɛ.
Klɛ̃mpɛ̃ ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli tɛi lɛ afee emeraldo kɛ safiro kɛ daiamɔnd.
Klɛ̃mpɛ̃ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli tɛi lɛ afee turkwise kɛ kalkedɔn kɛ amɛtisto,
ni klɛ̃mpɛ̃ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ mli tɛi lɛ afee berilo kɛ onike kɛ yaspi.

Tɛi lɛ ayibɔ baafee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni amɛkɛ Yakob bihii lɛ agbɛii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ anyiɛ yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa, koni tɛi lɛ adamɔ shi ahã Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ. Akpɛ gbɛii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nii nɔ lɛ, tɛ fɛɛ tɛ kɛ egbɛi yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ anaa.
Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi afee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa.
Ofee shika gai enyɔ okɛwo tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ yiteŋgbɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Okɛ shika kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ alala gai enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ koji lɛ.

Kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ anaabui enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ anaabui enyɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, okɛlala shika ni asere kɛbɔle tɛi enyɔ lɛ shishi lɛ amli, koni okɛŋmɔlɔ tɛi lɛ omɔmɔ efod lɛ he mamai hwīahwīabii lɛ ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ yɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Ofee shika gai enyɔ owo tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ afã kome ni adɔ awo shishigbɛ koni ekã efod lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni asaŋ ofee gai enyɔ hu ni okɛmamɔ efod lɛ he osɛŋ mamai hwīahwīabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ naa, yɛ amɛshishigbɛ tsamɔhe yɛ efod lɛ mlifīi nɔ lɛ ŋwɛi.
Akɛ kpãa bluu aŋmɔlɔ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ he gai lɛ akpɛtɛ efod lɛ he gai lɛ, koni tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ akã efod lɛ mlifii nii lɛ nɔ, koni ekaje he.
"No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Aaron miiba He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ Israel akutsei lɛ agbɛii ni aŋmla yɛ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ nɔ lɛ miiba mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ koni makai amɛ daa.

Ni okɛ Urim kɛ Turim lɛ awo tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni amɛhi Aaron tsui nɔ kɛji eeba mihiɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni Aaron anyɛ ale miyiŋtoo yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe be fɛɛ be." Osɔfoi Ahewulamɔ nibii krokomɛi
"Okɛ kuŋtu bluu sɔŋŋ akpɛ efod lɛ shishi atade yuu lɛ.
Ajie kuɛ awo atade lɛ he, ni akɛ mama ni alo abaŋ kuɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe koni ekagba.
Okɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa afee kpɔbii kokrobii kɛbɔle atade lɛ afee kpɔbii kokrobii kɛbɔle atade lɛ naamuu lɛ, kɛkpe, ni shika ŋmɛji atsotsoro kpɔbii lɛ ateiaŋ kɛkpe nɛkɛ:
shika ŋmlɛ kome kɛ kpɔ kokroo kome, shika ŋmlɛ kome kɛ kpɔ kokroo kome kɛbɔle atade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ kɛkpe.
Atade nɛɛ Aaron awo ni ekɛsɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfo koni kɛ eeba mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ jio, eeje kpo yɛ jɛi jio, anu ŋmɛji lɛ agbɛɛmɔ koni ekagbo.
"Otswia shika ŋmiiŋmi fɛtɛfɛtɛ, ni oŋma yɛ nɔ, tamɔ nii ni aŋma yɛ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ, akɛ, 'Afee lɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa.'
Okɛ shika ni atswia fɛtɛfɛtɛ nɛɛ akpɛtɛ mama bluu nɔ, ni okɛfi osɔfonukpa fai lɛ ni eta fai lɛ hiɛ.
Nii nɛɛ ahi Aaron hiɛnaa tuuŋtu koni tɔ̃mɔi fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ etɔ̃, yɛ nikee lɛ hãmɔ mli lɛ, akã Aaron nɔ.
Ni okɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta alo flaka lɛ, ni okɛ klala fɛfɛo akpɛ fai lɛ, ni okɛ abui alo nii owo mlifii nii lɛ mli.
"Aaron bihii lɛ hu, okpɛ flakai kɛ mlifii nii kɛ faii ohã amɛ. Ofee nibii nɛɛ ni efee nyam kɛ fɛo.
Okɛ nibii nɛɛ awula onyɛmi Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ofata ehe, ni ofɔ amɛ mu, ni owo amɛ osɔfo, ni otsuu amɛhe koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi.
Okpɛ klala tswakoto ohã amɛ koni amɛwo kɛkete amɛyayaiaŋ kɛjɛ hɛ kɛyashi shwuɔ.

Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ awo tswakoto nɛɛ kɛji amɛmiiba Kpee Buu lɛ mli aloo kɛ amɛmiibɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛbasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli koni amɛkaloo musu ni amɛgboi. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi kɛmiiya naanɔ hã Aaron kɛ eshwiei ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ."
29: "Nɔ ni ofee okɛtsuu Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ahe koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi nɛ: Mɔ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ too ojwɛnii enyɔ ni kpa bɛ amɛhe.
Ŋɔɔ aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kɛ mã akpiti keeki ni awo mli fɔ, kɛ mã akpiti akpaanɔɔ ni akpa hiɛ fɔ. Akɛ ŋmaa ma afee fɛɛ.
Okɛ nibii nɛɛ awo kɛtɛŋ kome mli, ni amɛhi kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni okɛba; tsina lɛ kɛ toi enyɔ lɛ afata he.
"Ŋɔɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni okɛ nu aju amɛhe.
No sɛɛ lɛ okɛ wulamɔ nibii lɛ awula Aaron: Flaka la kɛ efod lɛ shishi atade yuu lɛ, kɛ efod lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ; naagbee lɛ okɛ efod lɛ mlifii nii lɛ afi emliteŋ.
Okɛ fai lɛ abu lɛ, ni okɛ shika ni atswia fɛtɛfɛtɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ata fai lɛ hiɛ.
Agbɛnɛ owo mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ koni ofɔse oshwie Aaron yiteŋ ni okɛfɔ lɛ mu.
"Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ oŋɔ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛba ni owo amɛ flakai,
ni okɛ mlifii nii lɛ afimɔ amɛmli, ni obumɔ amɛ faii lɛ. Bɔ ni owo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ osɔfo nɛ koni osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ afee amɛnɔ ni kã shi akɛ naanɔ akpɔ.
"Ohã akɛ tsina nuu lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsina lɛ yiteŋ,
ni ogbe tsina lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Oŋɔ tsina lá lɛ eko koni okɛ owao atsɔ eko okpa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he akloŋtoi lɛ ahe, ni ofɔse lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ oshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Jiemɔ fɔ fɛɛ ni ha tsina lɛ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ, kɛ mlɛbo lɛ fã ko kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ hu, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, ni oshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi tsina lɛ loo lɛ kɛ ehe wolo lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ, ayashã fɛɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ ahe esha afɔle ni.
"Asaŋ oŋɔ toi ojwɛnii lɛ ateŋ ekome, ni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie eyiteŋ,
ni ogbe too lɛ, ni okɛ elá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Flɔmɔ too lɛ mli kukuji, ni ofɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ eshwuɔji lɛ ahe, ni okɛfata loo kukuji lɛ kɛ yitso lɛ he,
ni oma too ojwɛni muu lɛ fɛɛ naa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eji afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa; ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ.
"Omɔ too ojwɛni kome lɛ hu agbɛnɛ, ni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie eyiteŋ,
ni ogbe too lɛ, ni okɛ too lá lɛ eko asa Aaron ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ ebihii lɛ hu aninejurɔ toii anaa kɛ amɛninejurɔ kɛ nanejurɔ gɔŋtii anaa, ni okɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe.

Agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lá ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ eko kɛ mɔmufɔɔ mu lɛ hu eko ni okɛshwã Aaron kɛ ehewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; ni okɛshwã Aaron bihii lɛ hu kɛ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, koni okɛfee Aaron kɛ ehewulamɔ nibii lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu kɛ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.

"Jiemɔ too ojwɛni lɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ elei ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ emlinii ahe fɔ lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he, kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ hu, kɛ too lɛ ninejurɔ shwuɔ (ejaakɛ osɔfowoo afɔle too ojwɛni ni),
ni oŋɔ aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ mã akpiti keeki ni awo mli fɔ kome, yɛ aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kafu ni maa mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ lɛ mli,
ni okɛwo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛfɔ̃ niyenii nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ afɔle ni amɛhãa mi, Yehowa.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ohe nibii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛ̃ ni oma fɛɛ naa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni oshã ofata shãa afɔle lɛ he akɛ afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa; ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ.
"Too ojwɛnii lɛ ni akɛshã Aaron osɔfowoo afɔle lɛ, jiemɔ etsitsi lɛ koni ofɔ̃ otsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ afɔle ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã mi Yehowa ni. Tsitsi nɛɛ afee ogbɛfaŋnɔ.
"Agbɛnɛ too tsitsi lɛ kɛ shwuɔ lɛ ni afɔ̃ɔ akɛ afɔle ni afɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ji loo ni ajie yɛ too ojwɛni ni akɛshã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ osɔfowoo afɔle lɛ, feemɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Enɛ atsɔ̃ gbɛnaa nii ni akã shi daa ni sa akɛ Israelbii lɛ atu ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. Ejkaakɛ eji osɔfo gbɛnaa nii ni yɔɔ nii ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbaashã Yehowa toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ mli.
"Aaron hewulamɔ nibii Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ ebihii lɛ anii yɛ egbele sɛɛ, ni no amɛwo kɛji aafɔ amɛ mu koni atu osɔfoyeli lɛ awo amɛdɛŋ.
Ni Aaron binuu, mɔ ni baaye enajiaŋ akɛ osɔfonukpa, lɛ, ewo nibii nɛɛ gbii kpawo kɛji eeba Kpee Buu lɛ mli ebasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
"Oŋɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni lɛ loo lɛ koni ohoo yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ loo lɛ aye aboloo lɛ ni yɔɔ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Amɛye nii ni akɛkpãtãa ni akɛwo amɛ osɔfo, ni asaŋ akɛfee amɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Mɔ flo ko akaye nii nɛɛ eko ejaakɛ nɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Kɛji osɔfowoo afɔle loo aboloo lɛ eko shwɛ ni je tsɛre nɔ lɛ, no lɛ akɛ la ashã; akaye ejaakɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
"Bɔ ni mifã o nɛɛ, feemɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ nakai. Gbii kpawo okɛwo amɛ osɔfo lɛ.

Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ omɔ tsina kome koni okɛshã afɔle ni okɛkpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ esha ni afee hewɔ, ni okɛ kpãtãmɔ ni obaakpãtã nɛɛ nɔŋŋ akpla afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha, ni ofɔ latɛ lɛ mu koni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Okɛ gbii kpawo akpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha hewɔ koni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi, bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaasa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ afee Krɔŋkrɔŋ." Daa gbi afɔle
"Agbɛnɛ afɔle ni oshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nɛ: Daa gbi lɛ toobii enyɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Okɛ toobi kome ashã afɔle leebi, ni okɛ ekome hu ashã afɔle gbɛkɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ toobi lɛ okɛ ŋmaa mamu yiteremɔ kilo mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome, ni akɛ fɔ ni ashi mli lita mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome ekpɔtɔ afata he, kɛ wain lita mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome ni akɛshã afɔle lɛ.
Ni toobi kome lɛ hu okɛshã afɔle gbɛkɛ. Okɛ niyenii kɛ dãa, tamɔ leebi nibii lɛ afalɛ nakai nɔŋŋ, afata he ni oshã, ni ahã ejɛ ŋmã. Eji afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa, ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ.
Etsɔ̃ afɔle ni ashãa daa yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ amli, yɛ mi Yehowa, mihiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. Jɛi mikɛ nyɛ aaakpe yɛ, ni mikɛ o awie yɛ.
Ni jɛi mikɛ Israelbii lɛ aaakpe yɛ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ he Krɔŋkrɔŋ, yɛ minunyam lɛ hewɔ.
Mahã Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ afee Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni asaŋ mafee Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi.
Ni mahi Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni matsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ miji Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni mahi amɛteŋ lɛ; mi Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
30: "Oma latɛ ni ashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ. Akɛ tso afee.
Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu afee ninetalɔ kome, ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ aye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔi enyɔ. Ehe akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ afee nɔ muu kome.
Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi aha he, eyiteŋ kɛ ehe fɛɛ kɛkpe, kɛ ehe akloŋtoi lɛ hu, ni okɛ shika abaŋ latɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe.
Ofee shika gai enyɔnyɔ owo latɛ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ, yɛ shika ni akɛbaŋ naa lɛ shishi, koni akɛ tsei bloblobii ahɔlɔ gai nɛɛ amli ni akɛwo.
Okɛ tso lɛ eko agbɔ tsei nɛɛ ni aha he shika.
Okɛ latɛ lɛ ama muhɔɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ, ni ji he ni mikɛ o aaakpe yɛ lɛ, hiɛ.
Aaron ashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ. Daa leebi kɛji etee kanei lɛ saamɔ hã suu lɛ eshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ;
ni kɛji etee eyasu kanei lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, eshã tsofakɛŋma nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ nɔ. Daa tsofakɛŋmashãa nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ akã shi ahã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ.
Akashã tsofakɛŋma ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ loo kooloo loo niyenii afɔle ko kwraa yɛ nɔ, ni akafɔse wain akɛ dãa afɔle ashwie nɔ.

Aaron kɛ kooloo ni akɛkpãtãa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ esha ni afee hewɔ lɛ lá lɛ akpa latɛ lɛ akloŋtoi lɛ ahe, ni akɛkpãtã shi kome daa afi. Efee kpãtãmɔ nii nɛɛ shi kome daa afi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli. Eji nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ hã mi, Yehowa." Kpee Buu Shihilɛhe lɛ hetooyeli
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kanemɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni kɛ ona amɛyikulɛ lɛ, ohã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo eyi too yɛ ekpɔ̃mɔ hewɔ ehã mi Yehowa, koni gbele hela akaba amɛteŋ kɛbakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ kanemɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ni too ni áye lɛ nɛ: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakane lɛ lɛ awo jwiɛtɛi shekel fã yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shekel lɛ tsiimɔ naa akɛ shidaa afɔle ni akɛhãa mi, Yehowa. (Shekel kome feo gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ.)
Mɛi ni abaakane lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewo mi, Yehowa mitoo nɛɛ.
Kɛji aawo, mi Yehowa mitoo nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛkpãtãa nyɛhãa nyɛwala lɛ, niiatsɛ akahã fe jwiɛtɛi shekel fã nɛɛ, ni ohiafo hu akahã nɔ ni shɛɛɛ nakai.

Hemɔ kpãtãmɔ too nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii adɛŋ ni akɛto koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he nii, koni ehã Yehowa akai Israelbii lɛ daa ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ too lɛ miikpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛhã nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwala." Akɔɔble Okpolu lɛ
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Asaŋ okɛ akɔɔble afee okpolu. Okɛ akɔɔble nɔŋŋ afee shimaa nɔ koni okpolu lɛ ama nɔ. Okɛma Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni oyɛ nu owo mli,
koni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe.
Kɛji amɛyaabote Kpee Buu lɛ mli aloo amɛyaabɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, kɛbasɔ̃mɔ mi ni amɛshã afɔle ni akɛ la shãa amɛhã mi Yehowa lɛ, amɛfɔflɔ amɛhe koni amɛkagboi.
