Amɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe koni amɛkagboi; ni enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ahã Aaron kɛ eshwiei yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli kɛya naanɔ." Mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ
Asaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Ŋɔɔ tsofakɛŋma kpakpai nɛɛ fɛɛ eko: Tso mli mu ni jeɔ ŋma shekel ohai enumɔ, kɛ sinamon ni jeɔ ŋma nakai bɔ fã, ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kooŋkpãa ni jeɔ ŋma ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ,
kɛ kashia tso lɛ hu kilo etɛ̃ ni aŋmɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa, kɛɛ mutso mu lita kome.
Futumɔ nibii nɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ojeŋmafeelɔ futuɔ ojeŋma ehãa, ni okɛfee mu, ni ji mu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ.
Okɛ mu nɛɛ ashwã Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ,
kɛ nibii nɛɛ hu: okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe nii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe nii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe nii lɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ,
kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okpolu lɛ ni yɔɔ nane ni ta shi lɛ.
Ofee enɛ koni okɛtsuu amɛhe ni ehã amɛfee krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi, bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaasa amɛhe lɛ aaafee krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ofɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ mu, ni ofee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛye osofo amɛhã mi.
Ni okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Naa, enɛ baafee mimu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛbaafɔ mɔ mu yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli.
Akɛkafɔ mɔ folo ko kɛkɛ, ni nyɛkafea eko hu ni afutu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ afutu no lɛ. Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni, ni ahi shi nakai ahã nyɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafutu mu ko tamɔ no, aloo ekɛ mu ekɛ mu nɛɛ eko aaasa mɔ folo ko kɛkɛ he lɛ atswa enaneshi tu.'" Tsofakɛŋma lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ tsofakɛŋmai srɔtoi nɛɛ fɛɛ eko: krɔbɔo kɛ oshiko kɛ galbano. Tsofakɛŋmai nɛɛ okɛ mire ŋmiiŋmi afata he; ŋmɛɛ eko fɛɛ eko falɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ,
ni okɛfee tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa. Awo mli ŋoo koni ekafite, ni afutu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ojeŋmafeelɔ futuɔ ojeŋma ehãa. Emli atse, ni efee Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Oshimɔ eko ni ebo mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni okɛ eko ama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, he ni mikɛ o aaakpe yɛ lɛ. Tsofakɛŋma nɛɛ afee nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi ahã nyɛ.
Tsofakɛŋma ni obaafee nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkakwɛa bɔ ni afutu lɛ ahã lɛ nɔ ni nyɛmiifee eko nyɛmiihã nyɛhe. Abu lɛ akɛ nɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hã mi Yehowa.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafee eko tamɔ no, ni eeeshã lɛ atswa enaneshi tu."
31: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Naa, mije gbɛ mitsɛ Bezaleel, ni ji Hur bi Uri binuu lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛŋ lɛ,
ni mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ ewo emli obɔ̃, ni midro lɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee ni akɛnyɛɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ atsuɔ,
koni ekɛye sama, ni ekɛŋa shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble ŋaa,
ni ekɛflɔ tɛi ni akɛtraa nibii amli, ni ekɛkpɛ tso ni akɛtsuɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoisrɔtoi fɛɛ.

Ni naa, mi nɔŋŋ miŋɔ Ahisamak binuu Oholiab ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛŋ lɛ mifata Bezaleel he. Mɛnɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni ŋaa yɔɔ amɛhiŋmɛiŋ lɛ, midro amɛŋaa koni amɛnyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni miwo bo he kita nɛɛ amɛtsu:
Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enaanɔ ni buɔ naa lɛ, kɛ Buu lɛ he nii lɛ,
kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii lɛ, kɛ kanetso ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee lɛ kɛ ehe nii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ,
kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ akɔɔble okpolu lɛ.
Ni asaŋ amɛfee wulamɔ nibii fɛfɛji lɛ ni ji Aaron, Osɔfo lɛ, hewulamɔ nii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nii ni amɛkɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛfee mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni abaashã yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ. Amɛfee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni mi mifã bo lɛ." Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Asaŋ mihejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nyɛyea, ejaakɛ eji okadi yɛ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kɛmiiya nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mifeɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyea hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ hã nyɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabule gbi nɛɛ lɛ gbɛ aaagbe lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaatswa enaneshi tu.
Atsu nii gbii ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔgbi kɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hã mi Yehowa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ gbe aaagbe lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ aye hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, amɛye yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ.
Mi kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ okadi ji no kɛmiiya naanɔ; ejaakɛ gbii ekpaa, mi Yehowa, mikɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ mijɔɔ mihe, ni miwo mitsui.'"
Be ni Yehowa kɛ Mose ewie egbe naa yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ tɛi enyɔ ni ji tɛi tɛtrɛbii ni lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ewao eŋma nii yɛ nɔ lɛ hã Mose.
32: Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Mose eyatsɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekplekeee shi lɛ, amɛbua amɛhe naa, ni amɛtee Aaron ŋɔɔ amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi ni ofee nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkplɔa shika toiiaŋnii ni yɔɔ nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ atoiiaŋ lɛ nyɛbahãa mi."
Maŋ lɛ fɛɛ kplɔ shika toiiaŋnii ni yɔɔ amɛtoiiaŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛbahã Aaron.
Aaron he toiiaŋnii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛ̃, ni esere fɛɛ, ni ekɛ ŋaayeli dade tsu he nii, ni eshwie lɛ tsina. Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ, "Israel, naa wɔ nyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!"
Be ni Aaron na enɛ lɛ, ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ tsina lɛ hiɛ; kɛkɛ ni eshiɛ, ni ekɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ, aye gbijurɔ ahã Yehowa."
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ te shi maŋkɛ mra, ni amɛshãshãa shãa afɔlei, ni amɛkɛ niyenii afɔlei hu ba, ni maŋ lɛ ho tra shi, ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nii hu, ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛte shi amɛshwɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kplekemɔ shi oya ni oya, shi omaŋbii lɛ ni okɛjɛ Egipt kɛba lɛ ewo amɛhe muji.

Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɛɛ amɛje gbɛ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ. Amɛkɛ shika efee tsinabi, ni amɛja lɛ, ni amɛshã afɔlei hu amɛhã lɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ yɛ ehe ji, 'Israel, naa wɔnyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!'"
Yehowa tee nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mina nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ akɛ maŋ ko ni kuɛŋ ti.
No hewɔ lɛ hã mimli awo la awo amɛ koni maplenee amɛ; shi bo lɛ mahã otsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple."
Mose kpa Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ekɛɛ, "Yehowa, mɛɛba ni omli woɔ la woɔ omaŋ ni okɛ hewalɛ kple kɛ nineshiwalɛ eyakpɔ̃ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ?

Mɛɛ hewɔ hu ni ooohã Egiptbii ana hegbɛ amɛwie akɛ, 'Moaŋ yiŋ fɔŋ ni eto hewɔ eyajie amɛ kɛtee lɛ, koni eyagbe amɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ ni eplenee amɛ yɛ shikpŋ lɛ nɔ.' Na tsui ohã amɛ, ni efɔŋ ni oto oyiŋ akɛ obaafee amɛ lɛ, okɛfa amɛ.

Kaimɔ otsuji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob, mɛi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ okã amɛ kitã, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Mahã nyɛshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ ni miwo nyɛ shi yɛ he lɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ akɛ amɛboshinii kɛya naanɔ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ efɔŋ ni kulɛ eto akɛ ebaafee Israelbii lɛ fa amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɔ ehe, ni eje gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpleke shi ni tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni aŋma nii yɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛ hiɛ fɛɛ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃.
Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ninenaa nitsumɔ ji tɛi tɛtrɛbii lɛ, ni nii ni aŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtrɛbii lɛ anɔ lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ni ŋma.
Be ni Yoshua nu akɛ aabɔ oshe hoo yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Aablɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli tamɔ ta mli blɔmɔ."
Shi Mose here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Nɔ he ni minuɔ lɛ, ejeee mɛi komɛi kunimyeli he oshebɔɔ, ni ejeee yaafo ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nine etsɔ̃ mɛi komei anɔ hu, shi moŋ lala ni aahere nɔ ni."
Ni amrɔ pɛ ni Mose bɛŋkɛ shitoohe lɛ ni ena tsina lɛ kɛ joo ni maŋ lɛ joɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni emli wo la, ni ekɛ tɛi tɛtrɛbii lɛ tswia shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo tsina lɛ ni maŋbii lɛ efee lɛ, ni ekɛwo la mli ni eshã, ni egbɛlɛ lɛ mlumlu, ni ekɛshwã nu hiɛ, ni ehã Israelbii lɛ nu.
Ni Mose bi Aaron akɛ, "Mɛni po maŋbii nɛɛ fee o hewɔ ni ohã amɛfee esha kple nɛkɛ?"
Aaron jie enaa ekɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ mli akawo mi la. Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole akɛ maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ efɔŋ feemɔ."
Ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, "Feemɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ ni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Egipt Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ."
Ni mito he mihã amɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ shika nii lɛ ekplɔ kɛba, ni amɛkplɔ kɛba, ni mikɛwo la mli, ni etsɔ̃ tsina nɛɛ."
Be ni Mose na akɛ maŋ lɛ efee yuuyaa (ejaakɛ Aaron ehã amɛfee yuuyaa, ni amɛbɔ amɛhe ahora amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi) lɛ,
Eyadamɔ shitoohe lɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ebo etsɛ ekɛɛ, "Namɔ yɔɔ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ? Mɔ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ!" Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Mose ŋɔɔ.

Ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Nuu fɛɛ nuu akɔ eklaŋte eŋmɔ, ni nyɛnyiɛa maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, kɛjɛ agbonaa kɛya agbonaa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enyɛmi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enaanyo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe ehe gbɔmɔ.'"
Levibii lɛ fee bɔ ni Mose fã amɛ lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ mli hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔ nanaki gbi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe nɔ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛhã Yehowa sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akɛni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ te shi ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi lɛ, Yehowa ejɔɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ."
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfee esha kpeteŋkple. No hewɔ lɛ makwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛya Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Eko lɛ eeebo mifaikpamɔ toi, ni eeeŋɔ nyɛhe esha lɛ efa nyɛ."
Ni Mose ku esɛɛ etee Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Ao, maŋ nɛɛ efee esha kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ akɛ amɛfee shika amãgã amɛhã amɛhe.
Ofai nɛ, okɛ amɛhe esha lɛ afa amɛ; shi kɛji ehiii nakai feemɔ lɛ no lɛ gbee mi moŋ migbɛi yɛ wolo ni oŋma omɛi agbɛii yɛ mli lɛ mli."
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mɔ ni efee esha eshi mi lɛ, lɛ egbɛi magbe yɛ miwolo lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, yaa ni oyakpla maŋ lɛ kɛya he ni mi kɛ bo ewie he eto lɛ. Naa, mibɔfo lɛ aaanyiɛ ohiɛ, shi moŋ kɛji gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibagbla amɛtoi yɛ esha ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã gbele hela bote Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛfee, ni Aaron fee shika tsina lɛ.
33: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Yi mli, ni oje biɛ, bo kɛ maŋ ni oyajie kɛjɛ Egipt kɛba lɛ, kɛya shikpɔŋ ni mikã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ehe kitã akɛ, 'Oshwiei mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã' lɛ nɔ.
Mibatsu mibɔfo kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ, ni mashwie Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii kɛ Perezbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Nyɛmiiya shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni baa nii nɔ, shi mikɛ nyɛ enyiɛŋ kɛyaŋ, ejaakɛ maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, koni moŋ mikayakplenee nyɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ."
Be ni Israelbii lɛ nu nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ amɛye ŋkɔmɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ fɔ̃ɔ jwinewoo.

Ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, ni kɛji mibaye hiŋmɛitswaa kome kɛkɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ mibaplenee nyɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkplɔa jwinei lɛ yɛ nyɛhe koni makwɛ nɔ ni mafee yɛ nyɛhe.'"
No hewɔ ni Israelbii lɛ jie amɛhe jwinei fɛɛ, ni amɛkpa woo kɛjɛ be ni amɛ shi Horeb, ni ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ. Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ

Kɛji Israelbii lɛ to shi lɛ Mose kɛ Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yaa ni eyashiɔ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. Ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Kpee Buu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miitoa Yehowa nii ebi lɛ, ejeɔ kpo kɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Be fɛɛ be ni Mose aaaje kpo kɛmiiya Buu lɛ he lɛ, maŋbii teteɔ shi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ badamɔɔ ebuu shinaa shi, ni amɛhiɛɔ Mose yisɛɛ kwɛmɔ aahuu kɛyashiɔ eboteɔ Buu lɛ mli.
Kɛji Mose bote Buu lɛ mli lɛ, atatu kutuu lɛ kplekeɔ shi, ni ebadamɔ Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wieɔ.
Kɛ maŋ lɛ na atatu kutuu lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa amɛmamɔɔ amɛyii shi, ni amɛjaa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ ebuu shinaa shi.
Yehowa kɛ Mose wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ tamɔ mɔ kɛ enaayo wieɔ. Kɛji Mose ku esɛɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, etsulɔ Yoshua, Nun binuu oblanyo lɛ, lɛ lɛ eshii Buu lɛ mli. Yehowa wo shi akɛ ebaahi ewebii ateŋ
Ni Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaaŋɔ maŋ nɛɛ kɛya' shi moŋ ohãko male mɔ ni obaatsu ni ekɛ mi aya. Kɛ̃lɛ bo nɔŋŋ okɛɛ akɛ, 'Mile bo jobaŋŋ, ni miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ miikpa Bo fai, kɛji ona he miishɛɛ lɛ, hã male oyiŋtoo (yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe) bɔ ni afee ni male bo, koni masa ohiɛ. Kaimɔ hu akɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ omaŋ ni."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mikɛ nyɛ aaatee, ni mahã oye kunim."
Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Kɛ bo okɛ wɔ eyaaa lɛ, no lɛ kaaloo wɔ kɛ miijɛ biɛ kɛmiiya,
ejaakɛ mɛni aaatsɔ̃ɔ akɛ oyɛ mi kɛ omaŋ nɛɛ he miishɛɛ akɛ ja tee ni okɛ wɔ aaatee lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ana akɛ soro wɔ, ni ji mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ, yɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Nɔ ni okɛɛ nɛɛ hu mafee, ejaakɛ miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ, ni mile o jogbaŋŋ."
Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Kɛ nakai ni lɛ hã mana onunyam lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mibahã minumnyam lɛ abaho yɛ ohiɛ, ni mibatsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi, Yehowa lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ. Mibadro mɔ ni mibadro, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ ehe mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ.
Shi moŋ, onyɛŋ mihiɛ ona, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko enaŋ mihiɛ ni eyi aaana wala."
Yehowa tee nɔ ekɛɛ, "Naa, tɛsaa ko yɛ mimasɛi yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, daamɔ jɛi.
Shi be mli ni minunyam lɛ hoɔ lɛ maŋɔ o mawɔ tɛsaa lɛ tɛkpolo lɛ mli, ni mi kɛ minine aaatsi onɔ kɛyashi mibaho dã.
Kɛkɛ lɛ majie minine lɛ, ni ooona mikotosɛɛ gbɛ, shi mihiɛ lɛ no lɛ anaaa."
34: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Ko tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nii lɛ koni maŋma klɛŋklɛŋ tɛi tɛtrɛbii ni ojwara lɛ anɔ wiemɔi lɛ mawo nɔ.
Wɔ lɛ osaa ohe, ni oba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ okɛ ohe abatsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ jɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafata ohe kɛmiiba lɛ, akana mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko, ni akana toi loo tsinai miiba abaye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he.:
Kɛkɛ ni Mose ko tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nii lɛ, ni ete shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ekwɔ kɛtee Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ lɛ, ni ehiɛ tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpleke shi yɛ atatu mli kɛbanina Mose, yɛ he ni edamɔ lɛ, ni Yehowa tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Yehowa batsɔ̃ Mose hiɛ kɛho, ni etsɛ ehe ekɛɛ, "Yehowa, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ drolɔ lɛ, mɔ ni toɔ etsui shi, ni emli eyi kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwale babaoo lɛ,

mɔ ni yɔɔ suɔmɔ hã mɛi akpei abɔ, ni ekɛ tɔ̃mɔ kɛ esha faa, shi ehãaa tɔ̃lɔ̃ ko aye ehe tswaa, ni ewoɔ bii nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anajiaŋ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Ni Mose he fee oya, ni ekoto shi, ni eja Yehowa,

ni ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ona mihe miishɛɛ lɛ, miikpa bo fai akɛ Nuŋtsɔ ahi wɔteŋ kɛya, yɛ mli akɛ gbɔmɛi ni kuɛŋ it ji maŋ nɛɛ. Okɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi kɛ wɔhe esha afa wɔ koni okɛ wɔ afee onɔ." Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ ekoŋŋ

Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Naa, mi kɛ nyɛ baakpãŋ. Mibafee naakpɛɛ nii yɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni ji nii ni eko bako dã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, loo yɛ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ, ni mɛi ateŋ ni oyɔɔ lɛ kɛaana Yehowa nitsumɔ, ejaakɛ mi kɛ bo baatsu nii ni yɔɔ gbɛyei.
Ye mlai ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ anɔ. Naa, mibahã Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Perezbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ajo nyɛnaa foi.
Kwɛmɔ ohe ni ahi koni okɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni nyɛyaa lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋ koni no batsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã nyɛ.
Shi moŋ nyɛkumɔa amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ, ni nyɛfitea amɛkrabatsai lɛ, ni nyɛflɔa amɛ-Ashera lɛ wɔŋ koo lɛ nyɛ-shwiea.
"Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔ kroko ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni egbɛi ji 'Awuŋa' lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋa ni.
Ni nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko, ejaakɛ kɛji amɛmiija amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni amɛshã amɛfɔle lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ ko aaatsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛaayaye amɛfɔleshãa niyenii lɛ eko.
Nakai nɔŋŋ eeehã nyɛyaŋɔŋɔɔ amɛbiyei akɛ ŋamɛi nyɛhã nyɛbihii, ni kɛji amɛbiyei lɛ tee amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jamɔ lɛ, nyɛbihii lɛ aaanyiɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ asɛɛ amɛje misɛɛ, ni amɛaayaja ŋamɛi lɛ asɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
"Kaafee dade amãgã ko ohã ohe.
"Nyɛyea Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ. Bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ; nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã. Nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo, yɛ be ni ato ni ji Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛshi Egipt.
"Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji nuu ni gbleɔ musu naa lɛ minɔ ni, tsina ni jio, too ni jio.
Shi teji kromɔbi lɛ akɛ toobi akpɔ̃ lɛ, shi kɛji asumɔŋ ni akpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ no lɛ aku ekuɛŋ. Okpɔ̃ bihii ateŋ kromɔbii fɛɛ. "Mɔ ko mɔ ko akapue kɛ edɛ̃ folo yɛ mihiɛ.
"Atsu nii gbii ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ajɔɔ he, humɔ be mli jio, nikpamɔ be mli jio, ajɔɔ he.
"Asaŋ nyɛyea Otsii Agbijurɔ lɛ, be mli ni akuɔŋmaa kpokploku lɛ, kɛ Ŋmaa naabuamɔkɛtoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ afi lɛ naagbee mli.
"Daa afi lɛ nyɛteŋ hii lɛ fɛɛ abapue yɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ shii etɛ̃.
Ejaakɛ mibashwie majimaji yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni malɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli kɛya shɔŋŋ, ni daa afi shii etɛ̃, be mli ni nyɛba Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ ekɔŋ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eeeta he.
"Akɛ masha aboloo akafata kooloo he akɛshã afɔle ahã mi; ni je hu akatsɛre Hehoo Gbijurɔ afɔle lɛ eko nɔ.
"Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni nyɛbaakpa lɛ, nyɛkɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ. "Akahoo toobi kɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu."
"Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Ŋmaa wiemɔi nɛɛ ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa mi kɛ bo kɛ Israel ekpãŋ yɛ."

Mose ye nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ni ji Kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ ewo tɛi tɛtrɛbii lɛ anɔ, eyeee nii lɛ enuuu nu hu. Mose kpleke shi kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ
Be ni Mose jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpleke shi, ni tɛi tɛtrɛbii enyɔ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃ lɛ, eleee kwraa akɛ wiemɔi ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ehã ehiɛ miikpɛ.
Be ni Aaron kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ na Mose lɛ ehiɛ miikpɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei akɛ amɛaabɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Shi Mose tsɛ amɛ, ni Aaron kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni Mose kɛ amɛ wie.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose, ni ewo amɛ kitãi lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Be ni Mose kɛ maŋ lɛ wie egbe naa lɛ, ekɛ mama ko ha ehie.
Kɛji Mose tee Yehowa hiɛ ekɛ lɛ yawie lɛ, ekpaa mama nɛɛ yɛ hiɛ kɛyashiɔ ejeɔ kpo, ni ebakɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ naa Mose hiɛ akɛ eeekpɛ, ni Mose saa ekɛ mama lɛ haa ehiɛ kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni eeetee ekoŋŋ akɛ Yehowa ayawie.
35: Mose bua Israelbii lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kitãi ni Yehowa ewo akɛ nyɛye nɔ nɛ;
Aŋɔ gbii ekpaa akɛtsu nii, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ atsɔ̃ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã nyɛ, Yehowa hejɔɔmɔgbi krɔŋŋ ni. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ nɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ.
Nyɛkashɛrea la yɛ nyɛshihilɛhei lɛ ekoeko mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ." Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nikee nii.
Mose kɛɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Naa nɔ ni Yehowa efã koni afee:
Nyɛkɛ nikee nii abahãa Yehowa; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ he tsuijurɔ akɛ ehã lɛ, lɛ ekɛ nikee abahã Yehowa: Shika kɛ jwɛitɛi kɛ akɔɔble,
kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afeseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala fɛfɛo, kɛ abotia he tsɔi
kɛ too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofã tsuru kɛ nuŋgbee wolo kɛ tso.
Ekrokomɛi hu ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane kɛ tsofai ni akɛfutuɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu mli lɛ, Ekomɛi hu ji tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa.
Akɛ oniketɛi aba abake, nɔ ni akɛbaamɔ osɔfonukpa tsitsinɔ haa nii lɛ kɛ ehewulamɔ nii lɛ eko ni atsɛɔ lɛ efod lɛ mli. Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ he nibii lɛ
"Ni nyɛteŋ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni le ŋaa nitsumɔ lɛ eba ebawa kɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa efã ni afee lɛ:
nomɛi ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ebuu lɛ kɛ nɔ ni haa nɔ lɛ, kɛ ekpoji lɛ kɛ ehe mplaŋi lɛ kɛ emliblɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ.
Ekomɛi hu ji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ ehe tsei bloblobii, kɛ enaanɔ ni bu naa lɛ, kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ ni tsīɔ ehiɛ lɛ,
kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ, kɛ ehe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ,
kɛ kanetso lɛ kɛ kanei lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ.
Ekrokomɛi ji tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei bloblobii lɛ, kɛ kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ,
kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, kɛ latɛ lɛ he tsei bloblobii lɛ, kɛ ehe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ.
Ekrokomɛi hu ji kpo lɛ he muhɔi lɛ kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii ni amɛmamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ,
kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiŋmlitsei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ hu he shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe taŋkpei lɛ.

Ekrokomɛi hu nɛ: Osɔfoi lɛ ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni nomɛi ji Aaron ni ji Osɔfo lɛ hewulamɔ nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ. Maŋbii lɛ kɛ nikee ba
Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ je Mose hiɛ ni amɛtee.

Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sane lɛ eta etsui mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ena he tsuijurɔ lɛ, hiɛ edɛŋ nikee ebahã Yehowa koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ ehe sɔ̃ɔmɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu ahe nii.

Hii lɛ yei fɛɛ ba ni amɛhiɛ tsitsinaatsɛɛ nii kɛ toiiaŋnii, kɛ waogai kɛ nineshi kpotiai, kɛ shika kɛ jwinei srɔtoi. No ji mɛi ni abɔ ni yɔɔ he tsuijurɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ shika nɔ ko ebahã Yehowa.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ kuŋtu bluu loo kuŋtu afaseo loo kuŋtu tsuru faa loo klala fɛfɛo loo abotia he tsɔi loo too ojweni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru loo nuŋgbee wolo lɛ ekɛba.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni na jwiɛtɛi loo akɔɔble lɛ ekɛba akɛ Yehowa nikee nii, ni mɔ hu ni yɔɔ tso ni abaanyɛ akɛtsu sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ ekɛba.
Kɛkɛ ni yei fɛɛ ni le kpãatsɛ̃mɔ kɛ amɛnine tsɛ̃ kpãa, ni amɛkɛ nii ni amɛtsɛ̃ lɛ ba, no ji kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru faa kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futaa.
Yei fɛɛ ni he esa kɛ abotia hetsɔi kpãatsɛ̃mɔ lɛ amɛtsɛ̃ eko kɛba.
Ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ oniketɛi kɛ ojrawatɛi krokomɛi ni akɛbaamɔmɔ efod lɛ kɛ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ amli lɛ ba;
asaŋ amɛkɛ tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ ba.

Israelbii lɛ bake Yehowa nii yɛ tsuijurɔ naa. Nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni nu he yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ eeehã nɔ ko lɛ, ekɛbake, koni akɛtsu nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ atsɔ̃ Mose nine nɔ atsu lɛ. Ŋaalɔi ni baama Kpee Buu lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Naa Yehowa eje gbɛ ekɔ Bezaleel, ni ji Hur bi Uri binuu lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli.
Edro lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ kɛ ŋaa kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee ni akɛnyɛɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ atsuɔ,
Koni ekɛ shika kɛ jwɛitɛi kɛ akɔɔble aŋa ŋai srɔtoi,
ni eflɔ tɛi ni akɛtraa nibii amli, asaŋ ni ekpɛ tso mli koni akɛtsu ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoisrɔtoi fɛɛ.
Asaŋ Yehowa kɛwo Bezaleel kɛ Ahisamak binuu Oholiab ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛŋ lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ŋaa nitsumɔi.

Edro amɛ nilee koni amɛkɛŋa ŋai srɔtoi fɛɛ, tamɔ samayeli loo niloo kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa mliwoo nɛkɛ, kɛ mamaloo diɛŋtsɛ hu. No ji amɛle nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni ŋaalɔ tsuɔ lɛ tsumɔ. "
36: Mose tee nɔ ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Bezaleel kɛ Oholiab kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni Yehowa edro lɛ ŋaa kɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛbaanyɛ nibii srɔtroi lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛbaama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amɛfee lɛ, baatsu nibii nɛɛ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ." Maŋbii lɛ bake nibii babaoo
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Bezaleel kɛ Oholiab kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni Yehowa edro lɛ ŋaa, asaŋ ni eyɔɔ he tsui akɛ etsu nii lɛ eko lɛ kɛba,
ni ekɛ nibii lɛ fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbake Yehowa, yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ hã amɛ. Maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛkɛ tsuijurɔ naa nibii lɛ miiba amɛkɛmiike daa leebi.
Enɛ hã ŋaalɔi lɛ ni tsuɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nibii srɔtoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shi enitsumɔ ni etsuɔ,
ni amɛba amɛbakɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Maŋbii lɛ kɛ nibii ni fa fe nitsumɔ ni Yehowa efã ni atsu lɛ miiba."
No hewɔ lɛ, Mose fã akɛ ashiɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli fɛɛ akɛ, "Nuu jio, yoo jio, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko akaba dɔŋŋ hã Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ henitsumɔ lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɔ̃ɔ kɛbaa,
ejaakɛ nibii ni ana lɛ fa aahuu fe bɔ ni he ehia hã nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ. Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ maa

Mɛi ni tsuɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ŋaa yɔɔ amɛhiŋmɛiaŋ lɛ ŋɔ mamai nyɔŋma amɛkɛfee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Amɛkɛ klala yɛŋ futaa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa fee buu mamai nɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ ŋaa ni mli wa ye kerubii samai amɛwo mli.
Mamai lɛ eko fɛɛ eko kɛlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai nɛɛ fɛɛ adramɔ kome.
Amɛkpɛ mamai lɛ enumɔ amɛtsra, eko tsa eko naa, kɛfee mama muu kome, ni amɛkpe mamai enumɔ krokomɛi lɛ hu amɛtsra, eko tsa eko naa kɛfee mama muu kome nakai nɔŋŋ.
Amɛkɛ kpãa bluu ŋmɔlɔ aflãi yɛ mama muu kome naa, ni amɛfee nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa.
Amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome naa, kɛ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa. Biɛ kɛ biɛ aflãi nɛɛ eko kɛ eko yɛ ŋlɛnɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ shika fee kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni amɛkɛ kpoji lɛ lala mamai muji enyɔ lɛ amɛtsa, ni buu mama lɛ tsɔ̃ nɔ muu kome.
Ni amɛkɛ abotia he tsɔi fee mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome akɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mamai lɛ ekome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ. Mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ fɛɛ adramɔ kome.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsra mamai enumɔ aŋklo kɛ mamai ekpaa hu aŋklo.
Amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mamai enumɔ ni atsra afee emuu kome lɛ naa, ni amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa.
Amɛfee akɔɔble kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni akɛlala aflãi lɛ atsra koni buu mama lɛ afee nɔ muu kome.
Amɛkɛ too ojweni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofã tsuru fee nɔhaanɔ koni akɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ nuŋgbee wolo hu fee nɔhaanɔ kroko koni akɛha nɔ ato nɔ.
Amɛkɛ tso lɛ eko fee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi ni mamɔ shi lɛ.
Mplaŋ kome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ yɛ nyanyɔji enyɔ koni anyɛ akɛtsa eko kɛ eko. Nɛkɛ amɛfee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ.
Bɔ ni amɛmamɔ mplaŋi lɛ amɛhã nɛ: Mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ,
ni amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi fee nibi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ amɛwo mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ ashishi ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ nɔ enyɔ.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ye jɛi,
kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ma enyɔ nɔ.
Ni Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, he ni ye anaigbɛ, lɛ mplaŋi ekpaa yɛ jɛi.
Amɛkɛ mplaŋi enyɔɔnyɔ jie Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Amɛhã koŋ kome mplaŋi enyɔ lɛ bɔ he kɛkɛ yɛ amɛshishiŋi enyɔ lɛ bɔ he kɛkɛ yɛ amɛshishigbɛ, shi atsa amɛ yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ga lɛ yi. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee koji enyɔ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ ana mplaŋi kpaanyɔ yɛ sɛɛgbɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ma shishi nibii enyɔ anɔ.
Ni amɛkɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko fee mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ amɛhã mplaŋi ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kome,
ni mplaŋi ni yɔɔ ŋmawuiaŋ kome lɛ hu na mlibɛlɛmɔ nii enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Amɛhã mlibɛlɛmɔ nii ni ye mplaŋi lɛ ateŋ lɛ kã shi emuu kɛjɛ koŋ kome kɛyagbe naa yɛ koŋ kome lɛ.
Amɛkɛ shika shwie mplaŋi lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛ shika nɔŋŋ fee amɛhe gai ni akɛ mlibɛlɛmɔ nii baahɔlɔ mli lɛ, ni mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ hu amɛkɛ shika shwie he.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru faa kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne fee muhɔɔ, ni akɛŋaa ni mli wa lo kerubii samai amɛwo mli.

Amɛkɛ tso lɛ eko fee akulashiŋi ejwɛ amɛto muhɔɔ lɛ he; amɛshwie akulashiŋi nɛɛ ahe shika, ni amɛkɛ shika nɔŋŋ fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji lɛ, ni amɛkɛ jiɛtɛi fee nibii ejwɛ amɛwo akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru faa kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne, asaŋ ni akɛ abui elo nii ewo mli fee Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naahaa mama lɛ.

Amɛmamɔ akulashiŋi enumɔ kɛ amɛhe kpoji amɛhã shinaa lɛ naahaa mama lɛ. Amɛkɛ shika shwie akulashiŋi lɛ ayitsei lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ hu ahe, shi akɛ akɔɔble fee nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ.
37: Bezaleel kɛ tso kpɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni ekwɔlɛ hu ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Eshwie adeka lɛ mli kɛ ehe fɛɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekɛ shika baŋ adeka lɛ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe.
Efee shika gai ejwɛ eto adeka lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ. Gai enyɔ ye afã kome, ni gai enyɔ hu ye afã kome lɛ.
Ekɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko gbɔlɔ tsei bloblobii, ni eshwie amɛhe shika;
ekɛ tsei nɛɛ hɔlɔ gai ni yɔɔ adeka lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ amli koni akɛwo.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Etswia shika ekɛfee kerubii enyɔ emamɔ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Kerubi kome yɛ koŋ kome, ni ekome hu yɛ koŋ kome lɛ. Esɔo kerubii nɛɛ ekpɛtɛ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Kerubii lɛ egbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni amɛkɛha naanɔ lɛ nɔ, ni kerubi kome miikwɛ ekome hiɛ, asaŋ amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi kɛmiikwɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ. Okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Aboloo lɛ maa nɔ lɛ kpɛɛ
Bezaleel kɛ tso lɛ eko kpɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Eshwie he shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekɛ shika baŋ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe.
Asaŋ egbɔ tso blawa ni lɛɛmɔ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ, ni ekɛkpɛtɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ toi kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Efee shika gai ejwɛ ewo okplɔ̃ lɛ naji ejwɛ lɛ ahe.
Gai nɛɛ ye tso blawa lɛ shishi tuuŋtu, ni nomɛi amli akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ hɔlɔ.
Ekɛ tso lɛ eko nɔŋŋ gbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ, ni eshwie tsei lɛ ahe shika.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee okplɔ̃ lɛ he nibii ni ji plɛtei kɛ kpuji ni akɛbaashã wain afɔle lɛ. Kanetso lɛ feemɔ

Bezaleel kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia fee kanetso lɛ. Etswia shika ŋmiiŋmi ekɛfee eshimaa tso lɛ kɛ eshishi nii ni emaa nɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ehe tɔi lɛ kɛ ehe kpɔbii kɛ ehe fɔfɔi samai lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ nɔ muu kome.
Kanetso lɛ yɛ niji ekpaa: Niji etɛ̃ ye afã kome nɛɛ, ni etɛ hu ye afã kome nɛɛ.
Afã kome hiɛ tɔi etɛ̃ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi, tɔ fɛɛ tɔ kɛ ekpɔ kɛ efɔfɔi sama yɛ nine kome he. Nakai sɔŋŋ afee niji ekpaa lɛ fɛɛ ni kanetso lɛ egbla lɛ.
Kanetso lɛ shimaatso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ tɔi ejwɛ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi kɛ amɛhe kpɔbii kɛ fɔfɔi samai.
Ni kpɔi mamɔ kanetso lɛ he, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ niji ekpaa lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kpɔ yɛ eshishi.
Tɔi lɛ kɛ fɔfɔi samai lɛ kɛ kpɔbii lɛ kɛ niji lɛ kɛ kanesto lɛ shimaatso lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia afee nɔ muu kome.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi nɔŋŋ fee kanetso lɛ he kanei kpawo lɛ kɛ ehe abɛɛlei lɛ kɛ ehe lagbee nii lɛ kanetso lɛ he aklotɛi bibii lɛ fɛɛ.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome fee kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ. Tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ kpɛɛ

Bezaleel kɛ akasia tso kpɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ. Ekɛlɛ ninetalɔ kome kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔ kome; ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye agbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi enyɔ. Ehe akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ nɔ muu kome.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi shwie latɛ lɛ he, eyiteŋ kɛ ehe fɛɛ kɛkpe kpula.
Efee shika gai enyɔnyɔ ewo latɛ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ, yɛ shika ni akɛbaŋ naa lɛ shishi, koni akɛ tsei ahɔlɔ mli ni akɛwo latɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ tso gbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ, ni ekɛ shika shwie he. Mufɔɔ mu lɛ kɛ Tsofakɛŋma lɛ feemɔ
Ekɛ ŋaa ni akɛfeɔ ojeŋma fee mu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsofãkɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ.
38: Bezaleel kɛ tso kpɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ. Latɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi enumɔ; ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi etɛ̃.
Efee akloŋtoi emamɔ latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ anɔ. Akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ fee nɔ muu kome, ni ekɛ akɔɔble ha latɛ muu lɛ fɛɛ he.
Efee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nibii lɛ fɛɛ: kukwɛii lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ fakai lɛ kɛ lajee nii lɛ. Ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɔɔble ekɛfee.
Efee akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ.
Efee gai ejwɛ ewo akɔɔble ntaŋ nɛɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ koni akɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ ahɔlɔ mli.
Ni ekɛ tso lɛ eko gbɔ tsei bloblobii nɛɛ, ni ekɛ akɔɔble ha he,
ni ekɛ tsei bloblobii nɛɛ hɔlɔ gai lɛ amli yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ koni akɛwo. Ŋmoŋmolo ekɛfee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni gbɛ kã mli. Akɔɔble Okpolu lɛ feemɔ
Bezaleel kɛ akɔɔble fee okpolu kɛ ehe akɔɔble nane ni ta shi koni akɛfɔflɔ he lɛ. Akɔɔble ni akɛfee lɛ yei ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ ahswishwɛi akɛfee. Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he kpo lɛ
Bezaleel fee kpo ewo Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he. Ewouoyigbɛ lɛ ekɛ klala kpakpa ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha fee muhɔɔ eha jɛi.
Emamɔ muhɔɔ nɛɛ he akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee.
Kpo lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ hu jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha. Emamɔ akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee.

Kpo lɛ he ni ye anaigbɛ lɛ jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ehe akulashiŋi nyɔŋma kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋma ni amɛmamɔ nɔ. Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmliblɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee.
Kpo lɛ he ni ye bokagbɛ, ni ji ehiɛ lɛ, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Muhɔɔ ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ ha kpo lɛ hiɛgbɛ afã kome, kɛjɛ agbo lɛ he kɛyashi kpo lɛ koŋ. Muhɔɔ nɛɛ he akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Ni kpo lɛ hiɛgbɛ afã kome lɛ hu, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ, kɛ ehe akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃.
Muhɔɔ ni bɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ klala kpakpa akɛfee.

Kpo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ akɔɔble akɛfee, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, ni amɛyiteŋhaa nii lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi nɔŋŋ fee nii ni akɛble amɛteŋ lɛ.

Kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naahaa mama lɛ akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru faa kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futaa ni anyɛne lo nii wo mli kɛ abui. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ hu ji ninetalɔi enyɔ tamɔ kpo lɛ nɔ muhɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Agbo lɛ hiɛ akulashiŋi ejwɛ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi feefee amɛhe gai lɛ kɛ amɛyitsei ahehaa nii lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ kpo lɛ hu he shiŋmlitsei ni bɔle lɛ kpula lɛ, akɔɔble akɛfee fɛɛ. Dadei ni akɛma Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ

Naa bɔ ni dadei srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛma Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ maa mli lɛ naa yakpa, be ni Mose fã Itamar, ni ji Aaron, osɔfo lɛ binuu lɛ, koni ekwɛ Levibii lɛ anɔ koni amɛbu fɛɛ naa lɛ.
Bezaleel, ni ji Hur ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi Uri bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni fee nibii ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ atsu lɛ fɛɛ.

Mɔ ni fata ehe ji Ahisamak ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi Oholiab, mɔ ni he esa kɛŋaayeli kɛ samajiemɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ ele bɔ ni akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru faa kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta loɔ nii awoɔ mama mli lɛ.

Shika ŋmiiŋmi fɛɛ ni akɛtsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ maa mli fɛɛ, ni ji shika ni akɛbake Yehowa lɛ, naa yashiɔ talentai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ shekel ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nsɛnitɛ naa.
Jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni akane lɛ hã lɛ naa yashiɔ talentai oha kɛ shekel akpe kome ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ ni aŋmɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nsɛnitɛ naa.
Be ni akane mɛi lɛ, ana mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa.

Ajie jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli talentai oha ni akɛfee nibii ni Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ nibii ni muhɔɔ lɛ hu akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ. Akɛfee nibii nɛɛ oha, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ talenta kome feɔ akulashiŋ kome.
Ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi shekel akpe kome ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ ni shwɛ lɛ fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛyitsei ahehaa nii lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ.
Akɔɔble fɛɛ ni abake lɛ naa yashiɔ talentai nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ shekel akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Ni no akɛfee nibii ni Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nibii lɛ fɛɛ.

No nɔŋŋ eko akɛfee nibii ni kpo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ kɛbɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ, kɛ nibii ni kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ hu mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei fɛɛ ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei hu ni bɔle kpo lɛ kɛkpe kpula lɛ.
39: Amɛkɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa fee hewulamɔ nibii ni yɔɔ fɛo naakpa koni akɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Amɛfee osɔfonukpa hewulamɔ nibii amɛhã Aaron tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa fee efod lɛ.
Ni amɛtswia shika fɛtɛfɛtɛ, ni amɛflɔ lɛ kpãikpãi, ni akɛfee ŋaabii awo kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa lɛ mli.
Amɛfee mama hwīahwīabii ni baakã kɔŋ amɛkɛtsa efod lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ koni akɛŋmɔ efod lɛ.

Amɛkɛŋaa kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ nibii kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ eko fee efod lɛ mlifii nii lɛ; nibii nɛɛ ji kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa ni alo nii awo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Ni amɛflɔ oniketɛi, ni amɛkɛhlɔ shika gai amli ni amɛkpɛ Israelbihii lɛ agbɛii lɛ amɛwo tɛi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ,
Ni amɛkɛ tɛi lɛ mamɔ efod lɛ he mama hwīahwīabii ni kãa kɔ̃ŋ nɔ lɛ anɔ koni akɛkai Yakob bihii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ Tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ feemɔ
Bezaleel kɛ ŋaa ni mli wa naakpa nakai nɔŋŋ fee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni afee efod lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ekɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa kɛ klala kpakpa fee.
Efee tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ koji ejwɛ, ni adɔ mli enyɔ afɔ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ: ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔ kome.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛto tɛi klɛ̃mpɛ̃i ejwɛ amɛmamɔ nɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ klɛ̃mpɛ̃ɛ lɛ mli tɛi fee ojrawatɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ rubi kɛ topasiɔn kɛ garneto lɛ.
Klɛ̃mpɛ̃ɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli tɛi lɛ fee ameldo kɛ safiro kɛ daiamɔnd.
Klɛ̃mpɛ̃ɛ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli tɛi fee turkwise kɛ kalkedɔn kɛ amɛtisto,
ni klɛ̃mpɛ̃ɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ mli tɛi lɛ fee berilo kɛ onike kɛ yaspi. Akɛ tɛi lɛ mamɔ shika gai amli.

Tɛi lɛ ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni tɛi nɛɛ agbɛii kɛ Yakob bihii lɛ agbɛii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nyiɛ yɛ Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ naa. Akpɛ gbɛii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ, tɛ fɛɛ tɛ kɛ egbɛi.
Ni amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa, amɛkɛwo tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ naa.
Ni amɛfee shika gai hu enyɔ amɛwo tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ yiteŋgbɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ shika kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i enyɔ lɛ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ lala gai enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ koji lɛ.
Kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ anaabui enyɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, amɛkɛlala shika ni asere kɛbɔle tɛi enyɔ lɛ ashishi lɛ, ni amɛkɛyaŋmɔ efod lɛ he mama hwīahwīabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ yɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Amɛfee shika gai enyɔ amɛwo tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ afã kome, ni adɔ awo shishigbɛ koni ekã efod lɛ nɔ koji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛsaa amɛfee shika gai krokomɛi enyɔ ni amɛkɛmamɔ efod lɛ he mama hwīahwīabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ anaa yɛ amɛshishigbɛ tsamɔhe, yɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ fɛfɛo lɛ yiteŋgbɛ.

Ni amɛkɛ mama bluu fimɔ tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ he gai lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ efod lɛ he gai lɛ, koni tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ akã efod lɛ mlifii nii fɛfɛo lɛ nɔ koni akɛje nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. Osɔfoi Ahewulamɔ nibii krokomɛi lɛ feemɔ
Akɛ mama bluu sɔŋŋ kpɛ efod lɛ shishi atade yuu lɛ.
Ajie kuɛ awo atade lɛ he, ni akɛ mama baŋ kuɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe koni ekagba.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo fee kpɔbii kokrobii kɛbɔle atade lɛ naamuu lɛ kɛkpe.
Ni amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee ŋmɛji, ni amɛkɛŋmɛji nɛɛ flɔ kpɔbii kokrobii lɛ ateiaŋ yɛ atade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ naa kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe nɛkɛ:
Shika ŋmlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome, shika ŋmlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome aahuu kɛbɔle atade yuu lɛ ni abaawo kɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ naamuu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm kɛkpe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ klala kpakpa fɛfɛo lo flakai amɛhã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ,
Amɛkɛ klala kpakpa nɔŋŋ fee osɔfonukpa fai lɛ kɛ osɔfoi bibii afaii pɛmpɛbii lɛ kɛ tswakotoi lɛ hu.
Ni amɛkɛ klala kpakpa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru faa fee mlifii nɔ lɛ, ni alo nii awo mli tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee nii ni taa osɔfonukpa fai lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni amɛŋma wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛwo nɔ tamɔ aŋmaa nii yɛ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ akɛ, "Afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛfī kɛkpɛtɛ kuŋtu bluu nɔ, ni akɛta osɔfonukpa fai lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ. Nitsumɔ lɛ naagbee
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee agbe Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ henitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa ahã. Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ Mose, no ji Buu lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ekpoji lɛ kɛ eplaŋi lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni amɛmamɔɔ nɔ lɛ,
kɛ buu lɛ nɔhaa nii lɛ ni ji too ojwɛni wolo lɛ ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru lɛ kɛ nuŋgbee wolo ni haa no nɔ lɛ, kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ amɛkɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enaanɔ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ,
kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ hu ba.
Nibii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe kanei lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ,
kɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ,
Ekrokomɛi ji akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa latɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ latɛ lɛ he tsei bloblobii lɛ kɛ ehe nii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ.

Ekrokomɛi hu ji kpo lɛ muhɔi lɛ kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he taŋkpei lɛ kɛ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni akɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ,
kɛ osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii fɛfɛji ni akɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Nomɛi ji Osɔfo Aaron hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ tsu nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mose kwɛ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni naa, bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ afee lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɔɔ amɛ.
40: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, maa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama mli, ni okɛ muhɔɔ lɛ atsī hiɛ.
Okɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ aya Buu lɛ mli, ni oto nibii ni sa akɛ amamɔ nɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ omamɔ nɔ, ni okɛ kanetso lɛ aya mli, ni okɛ ehe kanei lɛ amamɔ nɔ.
Okɛ shika latɛ ni akɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma lɛ ama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, ni okɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ aha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa.
Agbɛnɛ okɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Okɛ okpolu lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni okɛ nu awo mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ owo kpo lɛ oma shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ tswɛm, ni okɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ aha naa.
"Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ owo mu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ okɛfɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ emli nibii lɛ fɛɛ koni okɛfee lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ofɔ shãa afɔlɛ latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ni okɛfee latɛ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni etsɔ̃ afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ.
Ofɔ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ hu mu ni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
"Agbɛnɛ okɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni okɛ nu aju amɛhe.
No sɛɛ lɛ okɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ awula Aaron, ni ofɔ lɛ mu okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni eye osɔfo ehã mi.
Okɛ Aaron bihii lɛ hu aba ni okɛ flakai lɛ awo amɛ,
ni ofɔ amɛ hu mu tamɔ ofɔ amɛtsɛ mu lɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi. Amɛmufɔɔ nɛɛ aaahã osɔfoyeli atsɔ̃ amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei abihii anɔ kɛya naamɔ."
Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ shi Egipt lɛ enɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ ashi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama shi.
Mose ji mɔ ni shi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ema shi. Ekla nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ baamamɔ nɔ lɛ, etee mplaŋi lɛ shi emamɔ shi, ni ekɛ mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ bɛlɛ teiaŋ, kɛkɛ ni etee ekulashiŋi lɛ shi emamɔ shi.
Elɛɛ buu mama lɛ mli ekɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔhaanɔ lɛ ha nɔ to nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ni Mose kɛ tɛi ni aŋmla kitãi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ hɔlɔ Adeka lɛ he, ni ekɛ naanɔ lɛ bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eshi muhɔɔ lɛ ekɛtsi Adeka lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose wo okplɔ̃ lɛ ekɛyama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ,
kɛkɛ ni eto aboloo lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ eshwie nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ewo Kanetso lɛ eyama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehe kanei lɛ mamɔ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ shika tsofãkɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ,
ni eshã tsofãkɛŋma yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ mama lɛ ha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa,
Ekɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni eshã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ewo okpolu lɛ ema Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni ekɛ nu wo mli,
ni no sɛɛ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe.
Kɛji amɛbaa ya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni kɛji amɛbaabɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ amɛfɔflɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.

Ni Mose tee kpo lɛ shi ema shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ ha naa. Kɛkɛ ni Mose gbe nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa. Atatu ni shi ema Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni atatu baha Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anumnyam lɛ yi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ Mose nyɛɛɛ ebote Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ejaakɛ atatu lɛ eha Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anumnyam lɛ hu eyi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli obɔ̃.
Israelbii lɛ agbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, kɛji atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛfãa kɛyaa amɛhiɛ;
shi kɛji atatu lɛ wooo ehe nɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛfãaa kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni eeewo ehe nɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa atatu lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane, ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ atatu lɛ kpɛɔ la ni Israelbii lɛ naa gbɛ.

1: Yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be ni miyɔɔ nomii lɛ ateŋ yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ, agbele ŋwɛi naa, ni mina Nyɔŋmɔ he ninaai.
Nakai nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be mli ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin eye afii enumɔ yɛ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ,
Yehowa kɛ mi, osɔfo Ezekiel, Busi bi lɛ, wie yɛ Babilon yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ bayi minɔ yɛ jɛi.
Be ni mikwɛɔ lɛ, naa, ahum ko ni naa wa fã kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ehewɔ fɛɛ miikplɛ, ni la miikplɛ nyramnyram kɛmiijɛ mli, nɔ ko tamɔ akɔɔble ni miitso yɛ la lɛ mli.
Ni mina nibii ejwɛ komɛi yɛ ahum lɛ mli, amɛhiɛ gbɔmɔ su.
Amɛtɛŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hiɛi ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ, kɛ fiji hu ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ.
Amɛniji ja trɔmɔɔ, amɛnanetokotai tamɔ tsina koklotoi; ni amɛhe kplɛɔ kaŋkaŋ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he.
Amɛyɛ gbɔmɔ niji yɛ amɛfiji ashishi yɛ amɛŋmawuiaŋ ejwɛ lɛ; ni amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ amɛfiji lɛ yɔɔ nɛ:
Amɛfiji lɛ eko kɛ eko kpeɔ; kɛ amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yaa ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
Bɔ ni amɛhiɛi yɔɔ nɛ; amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ yɛ ehiɛgbɛ; eninejurɔ hiɛ lɛ, jata hiɛ ni; ni ebɛku hiɛ lɛ, tsina hiɛ; ni esɛɛ hiɛ lɛ, okropɔŋ hiɛ.
Amɛgbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ. Amɛtɛŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ, ni fiji lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko saa enaanyo nɔ he; ni amɛyɛ fiji enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ hu; ni nomɛi lɛ amɛkɛ hahaa amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ ahe.
Amɛtɛŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ lɛ kwɛɔ hei srɔtoi ejwɛ shi kome; no hewɔ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛyaa amɛhiɛ tɛ̃ɛ shi kome; ni he fɛɛ he ni mumɔ lɛ yaa lɛ, jɛi amɛyaa; ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
Agbɛnɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ ŋai la ni miitso yɛ nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ateŋ, tuuŋtu, ni enyiɛ amɛteŋ kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ kɔti ni miitso; la lɛ kpɛmɔ naa wa, ni srawa gblaa kɛjɛɔ la lɛ mli.
Nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ shaa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ srawa.
Agbɛnɛ be ni mikwɛɔ nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ, mina kokroloŋtoi ejwɛ mamɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ nii lɛ amasɛi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ekome.
Bɔ ni afee kokroloŋtoi lɛ nɛ. Kɛ okwɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛtamɔ ojrawatɛ ni kplɛɔ nyramnyram oookɛɛ ashwishwɛ. Amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ henɔ kome. Ni bɔ ni afee amɛ lɛ tamɔ kokroloŋto ni hɔ kokroloŋtoi mli.
Kɛji amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛnyiɛɔ kɛyaa amɛkoji ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ eko nɔ, bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
Gai yɛ kokroloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ ahe, asaŋ gai lɛ eyimɔ tɔ kɛ hiŋmɛii ni bɔle amɛhe fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Kɛji nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, kokroloŋtoi lɛ hu nyiɛɔ amɛŋmawuiaŋ; ni kɛji amɛhole amɛhenɔ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ, kokroloŋtoi lɛ hu ehole amɛhe nɔ.
Akɛni nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ mumɔ yɛ kokroloŋtoi lɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni mumɔ lɛ yaa lɛ jɛi amɛyaa, ni amɛkɛ kokroloŋtoi lɛ holeɔ amɛhenɔ shi kome.

Kɛji nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, kokroloŋtoi lɛ hu fɛɛ nyiɛɔ; ni kɛji amɛwa lɛ, kokroloŋtoi lɛ hu waa. Shi kɛji amɛhole amɛhe nɔ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, koklolontoi lɛ hu holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛjeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ, nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su lɛ mumɔ lɛ yɛ koklolontoi lɛ hu amli.
Nɔ ko ni alɛɛ mli kɛte nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ayiteŋ, eha shi tamɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekplɛɔ nyramnyram tamɔ ashwishwɛ.
Nɛkɛ nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ekpã amɛfiji amli trɔmɔɔ yɛ nɔ ni ha shi lɛ shishi, fine kɛ fine miikpe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ ni ekɛha egbɔmɔtso he.
Kɛji amɛmiifliki lɛ minuɔ ni amɛfijiaŋ miigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ; asaŋ etamɔ ta mli hoofeemɔ jijemɔ lɛ: etamɔ Ofe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ gbee. Kɛ amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛfiji lɛ baa shi.
Kɛji amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛba amɛfiji lɛ ashi lɛ, gbee ko gbɛɔ kɛjɛɔ atatu ni yɔɔ amɛyiteŋ lɛ mli.
Nɔ ko ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ni esu tamɔ safiro ojrawatɛ ma nɔ lɛ ni ha shi lɛ yiteŋ. Ni nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su ta nɔ ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.
Mina akɛ kɛjɛ he ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛyaa eŋwɛigbɛ lɛ miikplɛ tamɔ akɔɔble; ekplɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la ni ebɔ tɔo. Mina hu akɛ kɛjɛ nɔ ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛbaa eshishigbɛ lɛ tamɔ la. Ehewɔ fɛɛ etse haŋŋ.
Bɔ ni anaa kwaabuɛtɛ su kɛji efo yɛ atatuiaŋ yɛ nunɛmɔ be mli lɛ, nakai ehe ni ekpɛ haŋŋ lɛ yɔɔ. Bɔ ni Yehowa anumnyam su yɔɔ nɛ.
2: Ni be ni mina enɛ lɛ miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, kɛkɛ ni minu mɔ ko gbee ni miiwie akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tee shi odamɔ shi, mikɛ o baawie."
Be ni ekɛ mi wie lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ bote mimli, ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni minu ni ekɛ mi miiwie. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ adesa, miitsu bo Israelbii, ni ji maŋ atuatselɔi ni etse mihiɛ atua lɛ, aŋɔɔ. Amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ etɔ̃ minɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti, ni amɛbuuu mi hu. Miitsu o amɛŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni mi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ nɛ;
ni akɛni toigbɔlɔi ji amɛ nɛɛ, amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, amɛaana amɛle kɛ̃ akɛ gbalɔ ko ebahi amɛteŋ.'

"Ni bo, gbɔmɔ adesa, kaashe amɛ gbeyei, ni kaashe amɛwiemɔi lɛ hu gbeyei. Eyɛ mli akɛ oyɛ ŋmei kɛ kpitikpitii ateŋ, ni ota nyɔŋmɔŋkrakoi anɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, kaashe amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi gbeyei ni kaahã hiŋmɛi ni amɛkɛbaakwɛ bo lɛ miihao bo; ejaakɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni.
Bo lɛ ŋɔɔ miwiemɔ lɛ ohã amɛ; amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, na ole akɛ toigbolɔi ji amɛ.
"Shi, bo gbɔmɔ adesa, bo nɔ ni mikɛɔ bo lɛ toi; kaafee ohe toigbolɔ tamɔ nakai toigbolɔi amaŋbii lɛ; gbɛɛ odaaŋ ni oye nɔ ni mikɛhãa bo nɛɛ."
Ni be ni mikwɛ lɛ mina nine ni akpã mli ni hiɛ wolokpo ni aŋma nii yɛ mli ni akɛmiihã mi.
Egble mli elɛɛ shi yɛ mihiɛ. Aŋma nii yɛ ehiɛ kɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ; ni aŋma yaafo kɛ awerɛhoo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli wiemɔi yɛ mli.
3: Kɛkɛ ni gbee lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ adesa, nɔ ni akɛhã o lɛ ye; ye wolokpo nɛɛ, ni oya ni okɛ Israel we lɛ ayawie."
Kɛkɛ ni migbɛ midaaŋ, ni ekɛ wolokpo lɛ hã mi ni maye.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ adesa, ye wolokpo ni mikɛhã o lɛ; ye, ni okɛwo omusu obɔ̃ tɔ." Kɛkɛ ni miye; ni eŋɔɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ adesa, yiŋ ni oya Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ ni okɛ miwiemɔ lɛ ayahã amɛ;
ejaakɛ mɛi aŋɔɔ ni mitsuɔ bo lɛ, amɛjeee mɛi ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ ko ni wa; shi moŋ miitsu bo Israelbii aŋɔɔ.
Amɛjeee majimaji babaoo ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ ni wa, ni onuuu shishi. Anɔkwa, kɛji nakai gbɔmɛi aŋɔɔ tete po mitsu bo lɛ, amɛaabo bo toi.
Shi Israel we lɛ boŋ bo toi, ejaakɛ amɛsumɔɔɔ akɛ amɛboɔ mi toi; ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti ni amɛtsui hu wa.
Naa, mihã ohiɛ etsii hu fe amɛhiɛ, ni ohiɛ hu ewa fe amɛhiɛ.
Bɔ ni daiamɔnd wa fe tswɛrɛbo lɛ, nakai mihã ohiɛ ewa fe amɛhiɛ. Kaashe amɛ gbeyei, ni kaahã hiŋmɛi ni amɛkɛbaakwɛ bo lɛ miihao bo; ejaakɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni."
Gbee lɛ saa ekɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ adesa, bo miwiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛ o wieɔ lɛ toi, ni okɛto otsuiŋ.
Agbɛnɛ yi mli ni oya omaŋbii ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ. Amɛbo bo toi jio, amɛbooo bo toi jio bo lɛ okɛɛ amɛ.'"
Agbɛnɛ lɛ mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko gbɛɛmɔ yɛ misɛɛgbɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ, ni gbee lɛ kɛɛ, "Jiemɔ miijie Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anumnyam lɛ yi yɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ."
Nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su lɛ afiji ni saa eko kɛ eko he lɛ agbɛɛmɔ kɛ kokroloŋtoi ni yɔɔ amɛŋmawuiaŋ lɛ amli gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ kpeteŋkple.
Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ewo mi kɛtee. Mitee kɛ mlila ni naawa naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni miba nomii ni yɔɔ Kebar faa lɛ naa yɛ Tel-Abib lɛ aŋɔɔ; ni miho mita shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni minaa ekpɛ mihe gbii kpawo sɔŋŋ. Yehowa to Ezekiel bulɔ
Gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mito bo bulɔ mihã Israel we lɛ; ni be fɛɛ be ni oooonu minaaa wiemɔ lɛ, obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ohã mi.

"Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, gbo ooogbo, ni obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni osaa owieee otsɔ̃ɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ ni eje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni ehere eyiwala lɛ, nakai efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ baagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, shi elá lɛ, bo odɛŋ mabi shi yɛ.
Shi kɛji obɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni ekpaaa efɔŋ lɛ feemɔ, ni ejeee ebyɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ mli nɛ, shi bo lɛ ohere oyiwala.

"Miikɛ o ekoŋŋ akɛ, kɛji mɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni ja kpa ejalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ, ni efee nɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, ni mito lɛ pampi lɛ, ebaagbo; ejaakɛ obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, ni ejalɛ nii ni efee pɛŋ lɛ akaiŋ; shi elá lɛ, bo odɛŋ mabi shi yɛ.
"Shi kɛ̃lɛ, kɛji obɔ mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekafee esha, ni efeee esha lɛ, no lɛ eyi baana wala ejaakɛ ebo kɔkɔbɔɔ toi, ni bo hu ohere oyiwala." Ezekiel baatɔ mu
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni jɛi mikɛ o aya wie yɛ."
Hewɔ lɛ mite shi ni mitee jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni naa, Yehowa anumnyam lɛ ni tamɔ anumnyam ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ yɛ jɛi. Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.
Shi Mumɔ lɛ babote mimli ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni ekɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaa ni oyaŋa oyi owo owe lɛ.
Ni bo, gbɔmɔ adesa naa, akɛ kpãi baashwie onɔ ni akɛfi o, koni okanyɛ oje kpo otee mɛi ateŋ.
Asaŋ mahã olilɛi akpɛtɛ odaaŋ, ni otɔ mu bɔ ni afee ni okanyɛ okã amɛ; tsɛbelɛ toigbɔlɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ.
Shi kɛji mikɛ o bawie ekoŋŋ lɛ, magbele onaa ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni sumɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ebo toi, ni mɔ ni sumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ekabo toi; ejaakɛ toigbɔlɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ.'"
4: Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ adesa, kɔ ntayaa ni okɛfɔ ohiɛ, ni otɛŋ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ yɛ nɔ.
Teŋmɔ nibii nɛɛ kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe: Kawoo gbogbo kɛ mɔji kɛ kpoku kɛ tabilɔi ni baatua maŋ lɛ, kɛ gbogbokuumɔ nibii ni mamɔ he.
Okɛ dade ni atswia lɛ tɛtrɛɛ afee gbogbo koni efo bo okɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ; ni ojie ohiɛ oka lɛ. Ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ atua maŋ lɛ, ni bo otuaa maŋ lɛ nɛɛ. Enɛ ji okadi hã Israelbii lɛ.
"Agbɛnɛ kã obɛku nɔ, ni okɛ Israelbii lɛ atɔmɔ lɛ aŋmɛ onɔ ni gbii abɔ ni okã obɛku nɔ lɛ obaatre amɛtɔmɔ lɛ.
Miiŋɔ amɛ afii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu toigblamɔ be lɛ mafee gbii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu mahã o. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ obaatere Isrealbii lɛ atɔmɔ lɛ.
Kɛ ogbe nakai gbii lɛ anaa lɛ, obaakã shi ekoŋŋ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, agbɛnɛ lɛ kã oninejurɔ nɔ, ni okɛtre Yuda we lɛ tɔmɔ lɛ. Mihao gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni okɛkã shi, ni gbi kome lɛ afi ni.
"Jiemɔ ohiɛ oka Yerusalem maŋ lɛ; ni ojie onine he eflo koni ogba oshi lɛ.
Mikɛ kpãi baafimɔ bo akpɛtɛ shi, ni onyɛŋ ohe otsɔ̃ kɛjɛ abɛku nɔ kɛya ninejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi be ni ooogbe okawoo gbii lɛ anaa dã.
"Agbɛnɛ, ŋɔɔ ŋmãa kɛ akoko kɛ akpatramɔ kɛ yɔɔ kɛ blɔfoakoko kɛ able, ni okɛwo nɔ kome mli, ni okɛ-shã aboloo ohã ohe. Ye aboloo nɛɛ be ni okã obɛku nɔ gbii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu lɛ.
Oniyenii ni obaaye lɛ ŋmɛɛ kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ gbi kome; ye nii shi kome daa gbi.
Ni nu hu ni obaanu lɛ susumɔ kpuji enyɔ; nuu nu shi kome daa gbi.
Ni okɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ afee lai ni okɛshã akoko aboloo lɛ, ni oye yɛ amɛhiɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai pɛ Israelbii lɛ baaye amɛniyenii ni amɛhiɔ lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei, ni mashwie amɛ kɛya lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mibuleko mihe dã, kɛjɛ miblahiiaŋ aahuu kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ. Miyeko nɔ ko ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo loo kooloo ko tserɛ lɛ dã. Asaŋ hu loo ko ni ahiɔ esako minaa dã.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kwɛ, mahã okɛ tsina wamɔ ashã oboloo lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ najiaŋ".
Esaa ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, mahã niyenii he asɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem, ni amɛkɛ tsuiyeli baaŋmɛ aboloo amɛye, ni amɛkɛ hejramɔ baasusu nu amɛnu.
Mafee enɛ koni aboloo kɛ nu he ahia amɛ, ni amɛbaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhe kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ, ni amɛaatrã loo yɛ amɛtoigblamɔ mli."
5: Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɔ klaŋte ni naa ba ni okɛfee yikulɔi asooyi, ni okɛshɛ oyi kɛ otsɛŋ. Agbɛnɛ kɔ nsɛni ni oŋmɛ tsɔi lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli, ni oja mli etɛ̃.

Mli jaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, shãa yɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, be ni agbe kawoo gbii lɛ anaa lɛ. Kɔ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ni okɛ klaŋte aflɔ mli dukuduku be ni obɔleɔ maŋ lɛ kɛkpe lɛ, ni okɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni eshwɛ lɛ ashwã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli, ni magbla klaŋte kɛnyiɛ sɛɛ.
Ŋɔɔ yitsɔi lɛ fioo ko kɛkɛ ni okɛŋmɔ otade lɛ naa.
Ŋɔɔ no nɔŋŋ mli eko ni oshɛrɛ oshwie la lɛ mli ni oshã. La baajɛ enɛ mli ebote Isreal we lɛ fɛɛ."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, "Yerusalem nɛ; mikɛ lɛ ema majimaji ateŋ, ni shikpɔji krokomɛi ebɔle he kɛkpe.
Yerusalem eku mimlai lɛ amli fe majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ; eku mimlai wuji lɛ hu amli fe shikpɔji krokomɛi ni bɔle ehe kɛkpe lɛ. Ekwa mimlai lɛ ni eyeee mikpɔi lɛ hu anɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ nɛ, "Nyɛfeɔ basabasa fe majimaji krokomɛi ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyeee akpɔi kɛ mlai ni miwo nyɛ lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛye jeŋmaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ moŋ amlai lɛ anɔ lɛ,
hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Naa, mi, midiɛŋtsɛ mikɛ o ena, mi magbla otoi yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ.
Musubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mafee o nɔ ko ni mifeko dã, ni asaŋ mifeŋ enɔ eko dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ tsɛmɛi baagbe amɛbii amɛye yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni bihii baagbe amɛtsɛmɛi amɛye; magbla nyɛtoi! Hiɛkãalɔi ni baashwɛ lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
"Asaŋ gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛni okɛ taŋtaŋnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ musubɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ ebule mihekrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ makpãtã ohiɛ; mikuŋ mihiɛ mifɔŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ; ni minaŋ o mɔbɔ." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.

Gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ baakplenee oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome yɛ omli, mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome baanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa yɛ maŋ lɛ sɛɛ; ni oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ni mafã klaŋte kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Bɔ ni mimlifu naa aaawa ahã nɛ, ni mimli baawo amɛ la waa; ni matɔ mihe owele; koni amɛna amɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie yɛ miwuŋayeli naa, be ni mimlifu amɛ waa lɛ.
Asaŋ mahã otsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ ahorabɔɔ nɔ yɛ majimaji ni bɔle bo lɛ ateŋ, kɛ mɛi hu ni hoɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
"Kɛ mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila kojo o lɛ, magbla otoi, ni oootsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔ nɔ kɛ heguɔgbee nɔ kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ nɔ kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ nɔ ohã jeŋmaji ni bɔle ohe kɛkpe lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, miewie enɛ.
Be ni mikɛ hɔmɔ aaakpãtã ohiɛ tamɔ gaimlibii ni atsɛ̃rɛ̃ kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ, no ni hɔmɔ aaaye o waa, mi mafo nyɛniyenii namɔ sɛɛ.
Mibahã hɔmɔ kɛ kooloi awuyelɔi aba nyɛnɔ ni amɛaakpakpaa obii lɛ yɛ ohe kɛya, ni gbele hela kɛ láshishwiemɔ hu aaaba, ni mikɛ ta aaabakpãtã ohiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
6: Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ, ni ogba oshi amɛ ni okɛɛ akɛ,
Nyɛ Israel gɔji, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ toi. Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi kɛ nujɔi kɛ jɔi voovooi lɛ nɛ. Naa, midiɛŋtsɛ mafã klaŋte mawo nyɛ, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ.
Nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aaakumɔ nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ. Mashɛrɛ nyɛmɛi ni enyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ mashwie nyɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ."
Mikɛ Israelbii lɛ agbohii lɛ aaashwie amɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni magbɛ gbohii lɛ awui lɛ mashwã nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe.

Hei fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛmaji lɛ aaatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni aaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ abaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ baakpãtã. Abaakumɔ nyɛmãgãi lɛ, ni abaakpãtã hiɛ, ni nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, abaakumɔ, ni nyɛnitsumɔi lɛ abaagu.
Mɛi aaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa yɛ nyɛteŋ. No nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, miji, Yehowa.
"Shi mashwɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hiɛkãalɔi. Nyɛaana mɛi komɛi ni eje klaŋte naa gbele mli yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ. Kɛji agbɛ nyɛ ashwã majimaji lɛ anɔ lɛ,

no lɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ aaakai mi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee lɛ. Kɛji mikumɔ amɛyiŋ flɛflɛ tsui ni hã amɛkɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ yanyiɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, amɛaanyaŋe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe yɛ nifɔɔjianii kɛ musubɔɔ nii ni amɛfee lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
No dani amɛaana amɛle lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mi, miji Yehowa, jeee wiemɔ flo kɛkɛ miwie akɛ mafee amɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Tswaa odɛ ni okɛ onane ashi shi, ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Kpoo ha Israel we lɛ yɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii fɔɔji lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ. Amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela naa.'
Mɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ gbele hela baagbe lɛ, ni mɔ ni bɛŋkɛ hu baagbo yɛ klaŋte naa, ni mɔ ni abaa eyi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu, hɔmɔ baagbe lɛ. Bɔ ni mimlifu ni naawa lɛ baatsu amɛhe nii kɛyata nɛ.

Ni nyɛaana nyɛle mi, akɛ miji Yehowa, be ni nyɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔi lɛ jwere nyɛwɔji lɛ ateŋ yɛ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe; ekomɛi aaajwere gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ gɔji fɛɛ ayiteaŋ hu, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi, kɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso fɛɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso kusuu shishi; he fɛɛ he ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amɛwɔji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ mɛi aaajwere jɛi.

Mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ yɛ amɛshihilɛhei lɛ fia kwa, ni mafite amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni mafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛjɛ shiaŋa ni yɔɔ ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ kɛyaashi Ribla yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ, no dani amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."
7: Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɛ: Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ naagbee lɛ eshɛ! Shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anaagbee lɛ eshɛ etã.
Naagbee lɛ ebanina bo, ni majie mimlifu lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ o agbɛnɛ, ni makojo o yɛ ojeŋba naa; ni magbla otoi yɛ omusubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ hewɔ.
Bei abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbla otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, miji Yehowa.
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, amanehulu nyiɛ amɛnehulu sɛɛ kɛmiiba.
Naa eeba, naagbee lɛ eshɛ, naagbee lɛ eba kɛ̃, eshɛ etã, ete shi ewo bo. Naa eeba.
Naa eeba! Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii nyɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ enina nyɛ! Be lɛ eshɛ; gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, gbi ni abaanu blɔmɔ, ni ejeee miishɛɛ blɔmɔ, shi moŋ hejramɔ blɔmɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
"Agbɛnɛ etsɛŋ ni mafɔse mimlila lɛ mashwie onɔ, ni mafã mimlifu kɛ eshishi fɛɛ mashwie onɔ, ni magbla otoi yɛ ojeŋba naa, ni mikɛ o aaaye kɛ joomɔ yɛ omusubɔɔ nibii lɛ fia ahewɔ.
Be abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbla otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, miji Yehowa ni tswaa mɔ nɔ lɛ.
Naa, gbi lɛ nɛ! Naa, eeba! Ohiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ eshɛ toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli egba afofro; ni hewoo hu egba ahwanya.
Yitsoŋwalɛ eda aahuu esa etsɔ̃ dade. Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛninamɔ kɛ amɛnumnyam fɛɛ lɛ ekoeko eshwɛŋ.
Be lɛ eshɛ, gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. Nihelɔ akanya, ni nihɔɔlɔ lɛ hu akaye ŋkɔmɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kã asafo lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ.

Jrayelɔ ko ni yɔɔ wala mli lolo lɛ eyaŋ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ he dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmnɔ mlifu kã asafo mu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu nɛɛ ekpaleŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hereŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala yɛ nishaianii ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ, afee kralo hu atã; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa ta lɛ, ejaakɛ mimli efu asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ." Israel maŋ lɛ he eshai ahenyɔmɔwoo
"Aawuu yɛ gbɛjeegbɛi anɔ, gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ yɛ shīa mli, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋanɔ lɛ nyɔɔ yɛ klaŋte naa; mɔ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela kpãtãa ehiɛ.
Shi kɛji hiɛkãalɔi komɛi aaaje mli lɛ, amɛaayahi gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ okpoi ni jɛ jɔɔ mli. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baaye ehe esha he ŋkɔmɔ.
Nijiaŋ fɛɛ tswɛm baaje wui, ni nakutsei fɛɛ tswɛm baakpokpo tamɔ ayawa mli nu.
Amɛaabumɔ kpekpe, ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛ, amɛyiteaŋ aaakpa ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi hu.

Amɛjwiɛtwɛi lɛ amɛaashɛrɛ amɛshwie blohuiaŋ, ni amɛaabu amɛshika lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni anyaŋeɔ. Amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika lɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ. Nomɛi haŋ amɛtrɔ, ni ehaŋ amɛmusu ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ etsɔ̃ pampi ehã amɛ.
Amɛjwinei fɛɛfɛji ni amɛkɛsaa amɛhe kɛtaoɔ yaka anumnyam lɛ, amɛkɛfee amɛmusubɔɔ amãgãi kɛ nibii ni ahiɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ mi, Yehowa, miha etsɔ̃ nɔ ko ni he tseee ehã amɛ.
"Mikɛ amɛnii aaawo mɛikpɔji adɛŋ koni amɛhã; ni maha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mɛi fɔɔji lɛ aŋɔ akɛ nomnii, ni amɛaabule lɛ.
Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã koni amɛbule mihe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; julɔi aaabote mli ni amɛaabulɛ lɛ ni amɛaafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
"Akɛni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ lashishwiemɔ, ni maŋ lɛ mli eyi tɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ,
mahã majimaji lɛ ateŋ mɛi fɛɛ fɔɔji fe fɛɛ abaŋɔ amɛshīai lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ. Mibafo amɛhewalɛ ni amɛkɛshwãa lɛ sɛɛ; ni aaabule amɛhei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Kɛ hejramɔ ba lɛ amɛaatao toiŋjɔlɛ, shi amɛnaŋ eko.

Amanehulu aaanyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ; akɛɛ akɛɛ sane aaanyiɛ akɛɛ akɛɛ sane sɛɛ. Amɛbaabi gbalɔ lɛ ni egba mɛ ninaa, nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ tete ahiɛ lɛ, mla lɛ jeee fɛifɛi, ni onukpai lɛ wooo ŋaa kpakpa.

Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaaye ŋkɔmɔ. Ni lumɔ lɛ nijiaŋ aaaje wui, ni gbeyei aaahã gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he aaakpokpo. Bɔ ni amɛjeŋba yɔɔ lɛ nakai mikɛ amɛ baaye; ni bɔ ni amɛkojoɔ mɛi lɛ nakai makojo amɛ; ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi miji Yehowa."
8: Israelbii anomŋɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be ni mita miwe lɛ, ni Yuda onukpai lɛ tra mihiɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa hewalɛ yi minɔ yɛ jɛi.
Mikwɛ, ni naa, mina nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ. Kɛjɛ ehɛgbɛ kɛbaa eshishigbɛ su lɛ anaa lɛ tamɔ la; ni kɛjɛ ehɛgbɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛigbɛ su lɛ kplɛɔ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he.

Ekpã nɔ ko ni esu tamɔ nine mli ni ekɛ mɔ̃ miyiteŋ tsɔi ni efi tɔo lɛ mli. Mumɔ lɛ wo minɔ kɛtee shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi tɛŋ, ni ekɛmi tee Yerusalem yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he ninaai lɛ amli. Ekɛ mi ba mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo ni kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ shinaa lɛ naa, he ni amãgã ni hãa Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ awuŋa lɛ ma lɛ.
Ni naa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anumnyam lɛ kpɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ ninaa nimina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ kooyigbɛ." Ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni naa, afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, nakai amãgã lɛ ni haa Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ awuŋa lɛ ma jɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, oona nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ? Musubɔɔnii wuji ni Israelbii lɛ feɔ yɛ biɛ bɔ ni afee ni maje mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛya sɛɛ shɔŋŋ. Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii wuji krokomɛi ni fe anɛ."
Ekɛ mi ba kpo lɛ nɔ shinaa lɛ naa, ni be ni mikwɛ lɛ mina flɔ ko yɛ gbogbo lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbuu gbogbo lɛ mli." Ni be ni migbu gbogbo lɛ mli lɛ mina shinaa ko.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Botemɔ mli ni oyakwɛ nɔ musubɔɔnii ni amɛfeɔ yɛ biɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ mibote mli ni miyakwɛ; ni mina akɛ atɛŋ waamɔnii kɛ kooloi ni ahiɔ srɔtoi abɔ, kɛ Israel we lɛ wɔji lɛ fɛɛ amfonirii yɛ gbogbo lɛ he kɛbɔle kɛkpe.

Ni Israel we lɛ mli hii onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo damɔ wɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni Shafan bi Yaazania damɔ amɛteŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ etsofakɛŋmashaa ŋɛsu yɛ edɛŋ, ni tsofakɛŋma ni eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi tamɔ atatu.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, oona nɔ ni Israel we lɛ onukpai lɛ feɔ yɛ dujiaŋ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miija amãgãi yɛ esɛɛtsu mli lo? Nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ ji akɛ, 'Yehowa enaaa wɔ. Yehowa ekwa shikpɔŋ lɛ.'"
Ekɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii krokomɛi ni fe enɛ ni amɛfeɔ."
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba Yehowa shīa lɛ agbo lɛ shinaa ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ naa; ni naa, yei tra jɛi ni amɛmiifo jemawɔŋ Tamuz.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ona enɛ? Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii wuji ni fe enɛɛmɛi."

Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba Yehowa we lɛ mligbe kpo lɛ nɔ; ni naa, yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ koi lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ, hii aaafee nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛtsɔmɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, be mli ni amɛhiɛiaŋ miikwɛ bokãgbe lɛ, amɛmiija hulu yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmo Adesa, ona enɛ? Ani nihiinii ni Yuda we lɛ feɔ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ efaaa ehãaa amɛ lo? Ni amɛhã yiwalɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ kɛmiiwo mimli la amɛfata he nɛɛ lo? Naa, amɛmaa mi gɔŋti amɛjɛɔ mi.
No hewɔ lɛ mikɛ amɛ baaye kɛ joomɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa. Mihaŋ amɛŋɔ amɛhe amɛye; minaŋ amɛ mɔbɔ. Amɛaablɔ amɛwo mitoiŋ yɛ gbee ni wa shi miboŋ amɛ toi."
9: Minu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, "Nyɛbaa biɛ, nyɛ, maŋ blafoi; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahiɛ gbɔmɔgbee dade yɛ edɛŋ."

Ni naa, hii ekpaa jɛ kponɔgbɛ agbo ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ naagbɛ amɛba. Amɛtɛŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ emɔgbee dade yɛ edɛŋ. Nuu ko hu fata amɛhe ni ewo niyɛŋ, ni etsotsro nɔ ko ni nibii ni akɛŋmãa nii yɛ mli. Amɛtee mli ni amɛyadamɔ akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anumnyam lɛ wo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ bɔɔnibii kɛ amɛfiji lɛ anɔ, he ni eyɔɔ lɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaa lɛ shi: Etsɛ nuu lɛ ni wo niyɛŋ ni etsotsro nɔ ko ni akɛŋmãa nii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaakpe Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ; hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi ni amɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ musubɔɔnii ni afeɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kadimɔ amɛhiɛnai."
Ni minu akɛ ekɛɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛkpaa maŋ lɛ mli; nyɛtswiaa mɛi anii; nyɛkakua nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa nɔ ko nɔ, ni nyɛkanaa mɔbɔ hu.

Nyɛgbea onukpai kɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ yei blublu, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akadi ehiɛnaa lɛ, lɛ lɛ nyɛkataa ehe. Nyɛjea shishi kɛjɛa mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ." No hewɔ lɛ amɛbɔi kɛjɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hiɛ lɛ anɔ.

Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbulea Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni egboi lɛ agbohii lɛ ashwiea kpoi lɛ anɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃. Agbɛnɛ, nyɛjea kpo!" No hewɔ lɛ amɛje kpo amɛbote maŋ lɛ mli amɛyatswia mɛi anii ni amɛgbe amɛ.

Be ni amɛgbeɔ mɛi lɛ ni ashi mikome too lɛ, miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi ni mibo mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtsɔ, Yehowa ani ookpãtã Israel mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ omli ni efu Yerusalem waa lɛ naa lo?"

Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Israel kɛ Yuda efee esha kple, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ lashishwiemɔ, ni toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli hu eyi maŋ lɛ mli obɔ̃; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Yehowa ekwa shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni Yehowa enaaa wɔ.'
No hewɔ lɛ mihaŋ mɔ ko aŋɔ ehe aye; minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi moŋ mahã amɛmusu abua amɛyiteŋ."
Ni naa, nuu lɛ ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ, mɔ ni tsotsro nɔ ko ni nibii ni akɛŋmãa nii yɔɔ mli lɛ, ku esɛɛ eba, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, "Mifee bɔ ni ofã mi lɛ."
10: Agbɛnɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa nɔ ko pue yɛ atatu ni yɔɔ bɔɔnibii lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ lɛ mli, nɔ lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni akɛ safiro ojrawatɛ fee.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nuu lɛ ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa kokroloŋtoi ni yɔɔ adebɔɔnibii lɛ ashishi lɛ ateŋ ni oyakpitiŋai ni miitso owo okɔkɔi amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni okɛshwã maŋ lɛ mli." Ni etee yɛ mihiɛ.
Adebɔɔ nibii lɛ damɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ wuoyigbɛ he ni nuu lɛ bote mli yɛ lɛ; kɛkɛ ni atatu ko yi Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ tɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anumnyam lɛ kpɛmɔ lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ bɔɔnibii lɛ anɔ kɛtee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni atatu lɛ yi Sɔlemɔwe lɛ obɔ̃, ni Yehowa anumnyam kpɛmɔ lɛ yi kpo lɛ nɔ obɔ̃.
Anu adebɔɔnibii lɛ afijiaŋ gbɛɛmɔ lɛ yɛ kponɔgbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ. Ni gbɛɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ gbee kɛji eewie lɛ.
Be ni Yehowa fã nuu ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa ni oyakpiti la ni yɔɔ kokroloŋtoi lɛ ateŋ, yɛ adebɔɔnibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ", etee kpo lɛ nɔ, ni eyadamɔ kokroloŋtoi lɛ ateŋ ekome masɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni adebɔɔnibii lɛ ateŋ ekome kpã enine mli kɛjɛ adebɔɔnibii ateŋ ewo la ni yɔɔ adebɔɔnibii ateŋ lɛ mli, ni ekpiti la lɛ eko, ni ekɛwo nuu ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ kɔkɔiaŋ; nuu lɛ he, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo.
Mina akɛ adebɔɔnibii nɛɛ yɛ niji tamɔ gbɔmɛi aniji yɛ amɛfiji lɛ ashishi.
Mikwɛ ni mina akɛ kokroloŋtoi ejwɛ yɛ adebɔɔnibii lɛ ahe; kokroloŋto kome yɛ bɔɔnɔ kome he. Kokroloŋtoi lɛ ahe kplɛɔ tamɔ ojrawatɛ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ krisolito lɛ.
Kɛji okwɛ amɛ lɛ, kokroloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ su kome, tamɔ nɔ ni eko hɔ eko mli.

Kɛji nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɛi asu lɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, amɛnyiɛɔ amɛkoji ejwɛ lɛ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe. Shi moŋ koŋ fɛɛ koŋ kokroloŋto lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni ayaa lɛ, lɛ esɛɛ ekrokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛɔ kɛyaa; ni ekrokomɛi lɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔɔ amɛhe kɛji amɛmiinyiɛ.
Hiŋmɛii yɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahe: amɛkotosɛɛ kɛ amɛniji ahe kɛ amɛniji ahe fɛɛ hiŋmɛii sɔŋŋ. Kokroloŋtoi ni adebɔɔnibii ejwɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ tete ahe eyi obɔ̃ kɛ hiŋmɛii sɔŋŋ.
Ni kokroŋlontoi lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minu kɛ mitoi akɛ atsɛ amɛ ni amɛtsɔmɔ̃ɔɔ amɛhe.
Nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɛi asu nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ hiɛ lɛ tsinanuu hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ jata hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ okropɔŋ hiɛ ni.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔɔnibii lɛ hole amɛhe nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ. Enɛɛmɛi ji nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ.
Kɛji bɔɔnibii lɛ miinyiɛ lɛ kokroloŋtoi lɛ hu nyiɛɔ, ni kɛ bɔɔnibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ ni amɛfliki kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kokroloŋtoi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ koklomɔ.
Kɛji bɔɔnibii lɛ wa damɔ shi lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ kokroloŋtoi lɛ hu ewa kɛdamɔ shi, kɛ amɛfliki kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ amɛkɛ kokroloŋtoi lɛ fɛɛ yaa ŋwɛi, ejaakɛ bɔɔnibii lɛ amumɔ yɛ amɛmli.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa anumnyam lɛ je Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni eyadamɔ bɔɔnibii lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ.

Miikwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni bɔɔnibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ, ni amɛfliki kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee, ni kokroloŋtoi lɛ kpɛtɛ amɛhe. Amɛyadamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anumnyam lɛ kpɛ yɛ amɛnɔ.
Nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɛi asu ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shishi lɛ nɛ; miyoo akɛ bɔɔnibii ni.
Amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ kɛ fiji hu ejwɛ; ni nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ niji yɛ amɛfiji lɛ ashishi.
Shi amɛhiɛi lɛ tamɔ hiɛi ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ kɛyaa ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ.
11: Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni ekɛ mi tee Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ bokãgbe agbo lɛ naa. Ni naa, mina hii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Azur bi Yaazania kɛ Benaia bi Pelatia, maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ.
Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni toɔ yiŋshai, ni amɛwoɔ ŋaa gbohii yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Be ni akɛmaa tsu shɛko. Maŋ nɛɛ tamɔ dadesɛŋ ni ma la nɔ, ni wɔji emli loo lɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ yi minɔ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, 'Nyɛ Israelbii, nakai nyɛsusuɔ; mile nibii ni nyɛsusuɔ yɛ nyɛyitseiaŋ fɛɛ.
Nyɛha mɛi ni nyɛgbegbee lɛ ayi efa yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni eblohuiaŋ eyi tɔ kɛ gbohii babaoo.'"
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, "Mɛi ni nyɛgbegbee nyɛshwie maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛji loo lɛ, ni maŋ nɛɛ ji dadesɛŋ lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, abaashwie nyɛ kɛje maŋ nɛɛ mli."
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛshe klaŋte gbeyei, shi klaŋte nɔŋŋ mahã afa awo nyɛyi.
Mibashwie nyɛ kɛbaaje maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni mikɛ nyɛ baawo gbɔi adɛŋ, ni makojo nyɛ.
Ni klaŋte naa nɔŋŋ nyɛanyɔnyɔi yɛ, makojo nyɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ husu nɔ, ni nyɛkɛaana nyɛle akɛ, mi 'Miji Yehowa,'
Maŋ nɛɛ tsɔŋ dadesɛŋ ehaŋ nyɛ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛtsɔŋ emli loo. Mikɛ nyɛ baaye yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ husui lɛ fɛɛ anaa.
Ni nyɛaale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa, ejaakɛ nyɛhiko shi yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbako nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ anaa; shi moŋ maŋsɛɛbii ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ moŋ amlai lɛ anɔ nyɛye."

Ni eba mli akɛ be ni migbaa lɛ, Benaia bi Pelatia tswa shi egbo trukaa. Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, ni mibo waa akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ani obaakpãtã mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ?" Nyɔŋmɔ wo nomii lɛ ashi
Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,

"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ miiwie bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi, ojakubii ni ji Israelbii fɛɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ahe. Amɛkɛɛ, 'Nomii lɛ eyaje shɔŋŋ bɔ ni amɛnyɛŋ Yehowa amɛja. Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ehã wɔ akɛ wɔnɔ ni.'

"No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ nomii lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, yɛŋ akɛ mijie amɛ kɛtee shɔŋŋ kɛyafutu maji krokomɛi amli bii, ni migbɛ amɛ mishwã shikpɔji anɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsɔ̃ teemɔhe krɔŋkrɔŋ mihã amɛ be fioo ko kɛ̃ yɛ hei ni amɛtee lɛ."
"No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni mi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mi kɛɛ nɛ, mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ maji amli ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ, shikpɔji hu ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba, ni maŋɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ maha amɛ.'
Ni kɛji amɛba lɛ amɛaajie taŋtaŋnii kɛ musubɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛaaje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni mahã amɛ tsui kroko, ni mikɛ mumɔ hee baawo amɛmli; majie amɛ tsui ni wa tamɔ tɛ lɛ kɛje amɛmli ni mahã amɛ loo tsui;
bɔ ni afee ni amɛba amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni amɛye mimlai lɛ anɔ, koni amɛtsɔ̃ miwebii ni mi hu matsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ.
Shi mɛi ni amɛtsui nyiɛ taŋtaŋnii kɛ musubɔɔnii asɛɛ lɛ, magbla amɛtoi, ni mahã amɛsɔ̃ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ. Mi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ." Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ je Yerusalem
Kɛkɛ ni bɔɔnibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ, ni kokroloŋtoi lɛ kɛ amɛ hole amɛhe nɔ, ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anumnyam lɛ shī yɛ amɛyiteŋgbɛ.
Yehowa anumnyam lɛ wo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, kɛtee gɔŋ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Mina yɛ ninaa lɛ mli akɛ Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni ekɛ mi tee nomii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon; kɛkɛ ni mumɔ lɛ je minɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni migba nomii lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa jie kpo tsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ.
12: Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛi ni toi egbo ateŋ oyɔɔ lɛ; shi amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii; amɛyɛ toii hu shi amɛnuuu nii, ejaakɛ maŋ ni toi egbo ji amɛ."

No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ adesa, too onibii tamɔ mɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom, koni ofã shwane be ni amɛmiikwɛ o. Jee he ni oyɔɔ lɛ kɛya he kroko ni amɛmiikwɛ o. Eko lɛ amɛaakɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ sɛɛ, tsɛ, gbɔmɛi toigbolɔi ji amɛ.
Okɛ onibii ni tamɔ nomŋɔɔ jatsu lɛ aje kpo shwane yɛ amɛhiɛ; shi yi mli gbɛkɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ; tamɔ nɔ ni ooya nomŋɔɔ mli.
Gbuu gbogbo lɛ mli yɛ amɛhiɛ koni otsɔ̃ jɛi kɛje kpo yɛ amɛ hiɛ.
Kɛji hiɛ bu lɛ, wo ogbɛfaa jatsu lɛ otswa okɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ ni okɛje kpo. Haa ohiɛ koni okana shikpɔŋ ni oyaa nɔ lɛ. Mikɛ bo miito okadi mahã Israel we lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni mifee bɔ ni Yehowa fã mi lɛ. Mikɛ minibii lɛ je kpo shwane tamɔ mɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom, ni gbɛkɛ mli lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbu gbogbo lɛ mli; ni be ni hiɛ bu lɛ miwo mijatsu lɛ mitswa mikɔŋ ni mije kpo yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ani Israel we lɛ, ni ji toigbolɔi awe lɛ, biko bo akɛ, 'Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ lo?'
Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, nɔ ni ofee nɛɛ gbalɛ ni; ni ekɔɔ lumɔ ni yeɔ nɔ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, kɛ Israel we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ahe.
Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni ofee nɛɛ ji okadi hã amɛ; bɔ ni ofee otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ, nakai abaafee amɛ, abaaŋɔ amɛ nom, ni amɛbaatsɔmɔ nomii.'
Amɛteŋ lumɔ lɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ, lɛ ebaawo ejatsu etswa ekɔŋ kɛje kpo be mli ni hiɛ ebu. Ebaatsɔ̃ gbogbo ni agbu aha lɛ mli kɛje kpo. Ebaaha ehiɛ, ni ekana shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni eyaa lɛ kɛ ehiŋmɛi.
"Maŋmɛ miyaa lɛ, ni eeedu lɛ tamɔ tsɔne, ni mikɛ lɛ baaba Babilon maŋ wulu lɛ mli. Shi jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ tete ehiŋmɛi enaŋ, tsɛbelɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ eeegbo yɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ, kɛ eyelikɛbualɔi lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã kɔɔyɔŋ yɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni magbla klaŋte kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
"Kɛji migbɛ amɛ mishwã majimaji kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ no amɛkɛaale akɛ, mi miji Yehowa.

Shi kɛ̃lɛ mashi mɛi fioo ko ni amɛaaje klaŋte kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela gbele mli. Amɛaajaje nihiinii ni amɛfee lɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ majimaji ni amɛyaa mli lɛ anɔ, ni amɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa." Gbalɔ ni miikpokpo lɛ
Yehowa saa ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye nii; kɛji ooye lɛ, ha ohe akpokpo ni kɛji oonu nu lɛ, ha ohe ajo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.

Kɛkɛ lɛ kɛɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ yɛ Yerusalembii ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, amɛniyenii lɛ, tsuiyeli amɛkɛaaye, ni amɛnu lɛ hu, hejɔ̃mɔ amɛkɛaanu; ejaakɛ yiwalɛnii ni maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ fee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ aba niyenii dɔŋŋ.
Maji ni ahi mli dã lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa." Abɛ ni ale kɛ gbalɛ ni aleee
Yehowa kɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛni ji abɛ ni nyɛbuɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ he akɛ, 'Gbii miiho kɛmiiya, ni gbalɛ ko baaa mli lɛ?'
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, mibaha nɛkɛ abɛ ni abuɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ afo, ni abuŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel.' Shi moŋ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ be ni eshɛ, ni gbalɛ fɛɛ gbalɛ baana aba mli,.
Ejaakɛ amale ninaa ko ejeŋ kpo dɔŋŋ, ni gbalɛ ni akɛlakaa mɔ ko hu baŋ mli dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel we lɛ.
Shi mi Yehowa, mibawie, ni wiemɔ ni mibawie lɛ baaba mli. Atsiŋ atoŋ dɔŋŋ. Ao! Nyɛ toigbolɔi awe, nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ mibawie, ni mibafee hu. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, Israelbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, 'Oninaa lɛ yeɔ bei pii dani ebaa mli, ni ogbalɛi lɛ hu kɔɔ be ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ he.'
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, atsiŋ miwiemɔ lɛ eko etoŋ dɔŋŋ, shi wiemɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ baaba mli. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ."
13: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi Israel gbalɔi lɛ ni sɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbalɛi lɛ. Kɛɛmɔ gbalɔi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Kpoo ha gbalɔi kwashiai lɛ ni nɔ ni amɛmumɔ kɛɔ amɛ lɛ, no amɛgbaa, tsɛ amɛnako nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ.
Ao, Israelbii, nyɛgbalɔi lɛ etsɔmɔ osɔi ni hlɔ tsukoi amli.
Amɛbuuu fɔji lɛ anaa, ni amɛtswaaa gbogbo amɛwooo Israel we lɛ he, bɔ ni eeenyɛ ekpee ta naa yɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ nɔ.
Amɛfoɔ amale saji amɛtãa, ni amɛgbaa amale gbalɛi. Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Yehowa kɛɛ,' be mli ni Yehowa tsuko amɛ; ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpaa gbɛ akɛ amɛwiemɔi lɛ aba mli.
Ani kɛji miwieko, shi nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa kɛɛ' lɛ, no lɛ ani jeee yaka ninaa nyɛnaa, ni amale gbalɛ nyɛgbaa lɛ lo?"
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ amɛ nɛ, "Akɛni nyɛkɛɔ nibii ni bɛ mli, ni nyɛmaleɔ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mikɛ nyɛ ena; mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

Mate shi mawo gbalɔi ni naa ninaai ni bɛ mli, ni amɛmaleɔ lɛ; amɛhiŋ mimaŋ lɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ mli, ni asaŋ aŋmaŋ amɛgbɛii yɛ Israel we lɛ wolo lɛ mli, ni amɛyiŋ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu; ni nyɛkɛale akɛ mi, miji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa lɛ.
"Naa! Akɛni amɛlakaa mimaŋ lɛ akɛ 'Omanyɛ eba,' be mli ni omanyɛ ko bɛ lɛ. Mimaŋbii lɛ tswaa gbogbo ni amale gbalɔi lɛ shaa he kaaloo;
Kɛɛmɔ mɛi ni kɛ kaaloo shaa gbogbo lɛ he lɛ akɛ ebaagbee shi. Nu baanɛ waa, nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji baanɛ, ni ahum baatswa,
Ni no lɛ gbogbo lɛ baagbee shi; ani abiŋ nyɛ akɛ, 'Kaaloo lɛ ni nyɛkɛsha gbogbo lɛ he lɛ, nɛgbɛ ehe sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ?'
"No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mikɛ mlifu aaahã ahum atswa, ni mikɛ mlila aaahã nu anɛ waa, ni mahã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji aaanɛ kɛkpãtã nii ahiɛ.
Makumɔ gbogbo ni nyɛkɛ kaaloo esha he lɛ mashwie shi; ni eshishitoo lɛ aaaje kpo faŋŋ. Eshigbeemɔ mli lɛ eeegbee nyɛ nɔ, ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛaale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa.
"No ni mimli baafu gbogbo lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni sha he kaaloo lɛ. No ni makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ gbogbo lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni mei ni sha he lɛ hu bɛ dɔŋŋ,
mɛi ni ji Israel gbalɔi ni gba yɛ Yerusalem he, ni amɛna omanye ninaai yɛ ehe, tsɛbelɛ, omanye ko bɛ lɛ; mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ." Gbalɛ ni kɔɔ yei amale gbalɔi ahe
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo omaŋ lɛ mli biyei lɛ ni kaa amɛhiɛ amɛgbaa lɛ; gbaa oshi amɛ.
