Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, kpoo ha yei ni kpɛɔ sɛbɛi amɛŋmlɔɔ mɛi anijiashi, ni amɛkpɛɔ yitso fɛɛ yitso dalɛ he yiteŋhaa mama amɛhãa mɛi, ni amɛkɛlakaa gbɔmɛi kɛjeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee he. Ani nyɛbaadu miwebii lɛ, ni nyɛbaa susumai krokomɛi ayi yɛ nyɛsɛɛnamɔ hewɔ?

Akoko dɛ kɔkɔi obɔ̃bɔ̃i kɛkɛ kɛ aboloo atrɔmai kɛkɛ ahewɔ lɛ, nyɛbuleɔ mi yɛ mimaŋ mli, ni nyɛgbeɔ mɛi ni esaaa akɛ amɛgboiɔ, ni nyɛhereɔ mɛi ni sa akɛ amɛgboi lɛ moŋ ayiwala. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛmaleɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ni boɔ toi lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, mitaooo sɛbɛi ni nyɛkɛlakaa mɛi lɛ, ni matserɛ amɛ yɛ nyɛnijiashi mashwie, ni mibaha susumai ni nyɛdu tamɔ loofɔji lɛ aye amɛhe.
Ni matserɛ nyɛyiteŋhaa mamai lɛ hu, ni makpɔ̃ miwebii lɛ kɛjɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ni amɛhiŋ nyɛdeŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa.
"Nyɛkɛ amale hãa jalɔ nijiaŋ jeɔ wui, tsɛbelɛ, mi lɛ mihako enijiaŋ aje wui; ni nyɛwoɔ mɔ fɔŋ moŋ ekãa, no hewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ekpale kɛje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ahere eyiwala.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛnaŋ lakamɔ ninaai dɔŋŋ, ni klamɔ hu nyɛklaŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ makpɔ̃ mimaŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."
14: Agbɛnɛ Israel onukpai lɛ ekomɛi ba amɛbabi Yehowa nii. Amɛtra shi yɛ mihiɛ
ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛtsuii eŋmɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛhã amɛnishaia nii lɛ etsɔ̃ pampi ma amɛhiɛ. Ani esa akɛ maŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛbabi mi nii kwraa lo?

"No hewɔ lɛ okɛ amɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Israel we ni kɛ etsui ŋmɛɔ emãgãi anɔ, ni ehaa enishaianii tsɔ̃ɔ pampi maa ehiɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ, ebaa gbalɔ ŋɔɔ ebabiɔ nii lɛ, mi, Yehowa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mahã lɛ hetoo yɛ emãgãi lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ naa,
bɔ ni afee ni matsake Isrealbii lɛ atsui, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛmãgãi lɛ anɔ amɛtse amɛhe kɛje mihe.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuii ni nyɛkpalea kɛjea nyɛmãgãi lɛ ahe, ni nyɛjiea nyɛhe kɛjea nihiinii lɛ fɛɛ ahe.

"Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Israel we, loo gbɔi ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Isreal he ko ni tseɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ mihe, ni ekɛ etsui ŋmɛɔ amãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni ehãa enishaianii tsɔ̃ɔ pampi ehãa lɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ ebaa gbalɔ ŋɔɔ ni ebi mi nii eha lɛ lɛ, mi Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ maha lɛ hetoo.
Majie mihiɛ maka nakai mɔ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ baafee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ni akɛbuɔ abɛ, ni majie lɛ yɛ miwebii lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛkɛaale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa.
"Ni kɛji nɔ ko aaalaka gbalɔ lɛ ni ewie wiemɔ ko lɛ, bɛlɛ mi, Yehowa, miji mɔ ni laka nakai gbalɔ lɛ, ni mikɛ lɛ aaaye; makpãtã ehiɛ kɛaaje mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Abaagbla amɛ fɛɛ amɛtoi. Gbalɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yabiɔ gbalɔ lɛ nii lɛ fɛɛ aaana toiglamɔ kome.

Mibafee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni Israel we lɛ akatse amɛhe kɛmiije mihe ni amɛyadu gbɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛ nifɔɔjianii lɛ miibule amɛhe dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ amɛtsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mi hu matsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ." Noah, Daniel kɛ Hiob
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛji shikpɔŋ ko nɔ bii fee esha shi mi, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa, ni mite shi miwo amɛ, ni mifo amɛniyeniinamɔ sɛɛ, ni mihã hɔmɔ ba nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
kɛji nɛkɛ hii etɛ̃ nɛɛ, ni ji Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob, futu amɛ tete po lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ aaahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala; Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Kɛji miha kooloi awuyelɔi bakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ̃ ni amɛplenee enɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ kɛhooo yɛ kooloi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ,

kɛji nɛkɛ jalɔi etɔ̃ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi tete lɛ, gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ amɛbihii loo amɛbiyei po yiwala amɛhere. Amɛaahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
"Aloo kɛji mifã klaŋte miwo nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, akɛ klaŋte akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
kɛji nɛkɛ hii jalɔi etɛ̃ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi tete lɛ, gbii abɔ ni miji Nyuŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ binuu loo biyoo po yiwala ahere; shi amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala amɛaahere.
"Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛji mihã gbele hela ko ba nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ mlifu hã lá shwie shi koni makpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ lɛ;

kɛji Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob tete po yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ nɛɛ, mi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ akɛ amɛnyɛŋ amɛbihii loo amɛbiyei tete po ayiwala amɛhere; amɛkɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ baahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala."

Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Te eeetamɔ tɛŋŋ kɛji miha nibii ejwɛ ni mikɛgblaa toi, ni ji klaŋte kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ kooloi awuyelɔi kɛ gbele hela lɛ ba Yerusalem, ni miha amɛkpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ahiɛ yɛ mli?

"Ni kɛji hiɛkãalɔi komɛi aaashwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛaanyɛ amɛhere amɛbihii kɛ biyei ayiwala lɛ, kɛji nakai bihii kɛ biyei lɛ ba nyɛŋɔɔ ni nyɛna amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔi pɛ, nyɛbaanu shishi akɛ toigblamɔ ni mikɛba Yerusalem yɛ enifɔɔjianii ni efee lɛ he lɛ, esa lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛna amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ pɛ nyɛbaanu shishi, no aaahã nyɛle akɛ nii fɛɛ ni mifee Yerusalem lɛ mifee ni shishinumɔ yɛ he." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
15: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛni waintso kɛfe tso kroko? Mɛni waintso nine kɛfa tsei krokomɛi ni yɔɔ koo lɛ mli lɛ?
Ani akɛ etso lɛ feɔ nɔ ko kwraa? Ani gbɔmɔ kɛ eko gbɔɔ shiŋmlitso ni akɛ nii tsotsroɔ nɔ lo?
Naa, akɛfeɔ lai ni ashãa. Kɛji enaa bu biɛ kɛ biɛ shã, ni eteŋ hu fɛɛ eshã etsɔ̃ŋai lɛ, ani ehiɔ kɛhã nɔ ko feemɔ kwraa lo?
"Naa, be ni eji waintso muu po, akɛtsuuu nɔ ko, ni kɛji la ŋla lɛ ni etsɔ ŋai lɛ, no lɛ ani aaanyɛ akɛtsu nɔ ko kwraa lo?"
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Bɔ ni mihãa la shãa waintso kɛ tsei krokomɛi fɛɛ yɛ koo mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ maŋɔ Yerusalembii lɛ mahã.
Majie mihiɛ maka amɛ, ni kɛji amɛje la lɛ mli tete lɛ, la lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ baakpãtã amɛhiɛ. No ni nyɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa, kɛji mijie mihiɛ mika amɛ lɛ.
Mibaha shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mi anɔkwa." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
16: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, jajemɔ musubɔɔnii ni Yerusalem efee lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni okɛɛ Yerusalem akɛ,
Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ Yerusalem nɛ, ojɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ nɔ, ni jɛi afɔ o lɛ. Amornyo ji otsɛ, ni Hityoo ji onyɛ.
Asaŋ yɛ ofɔmɔ mli lɛ, gbi ni afɔ o lɛ, afooo olaŋmɔ, akɛ nu hu juuu ohe ni ohe aje, akɛ ŋoo kpaaa ohe hu, ni akɛ mama hu eblaaa ohe.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko enaaa bo mɔbɔ ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ ni eeefee nibii nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko ehã o, shi moŋ ashɛ bo afɔ ŋa kplanaa nɔ, ejaakɛ anyaŋe o kɛjɛ gbi ni afɔ bo lɛ beebe.
"No ni be ni mibatsɔ̃ omasɛi kɛho lɛ, mina o ni ookoklo shi yɛ ola mli. Mikɛ o wie yɛ ola lɛ mli akɛ,
'Oyi ana wala koni oda tamɔ ŋanɔtso.' Kɛkɛ ni oda, ni okwɔ, ni oshɛ oblayoo, ni oje fufɔ, ni oyitsɔi klɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ onyiɛ yayai kɛ ohe pasaa.
"Be ni mibatsɔ̃ omasɛi kɛho ekoŋŋ lɛ, naa, mina akɛ oda ni oshɛ gblã, ni miha o mimama lɛ eko ni mikɛtsi oyayai nɔ. Hɛɛ, misumɔ bo kɛha gblãshihilɛ, ni mikɛ o kpãŋ, ni otsɔ̃ minɔ." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ nu ju ohe ni mifɔ ohe lá lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ohe, ni mikpa o mu.
Mibu o mama hu ni aye samai yɛ mli, ni miwo o nuŋgbee wolo tokota; mifi o duku yɛŋ, ni mibu bo sliki mama.
Misaa miwula o kɛ jwinei, miwo onineshi gai, ni mikɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ ŋmɛ okuɛ.
Miwo ogugɔŋ ga, ni miwo otoiiaŋ toiiaŋnii. Mikɛ akekre fɛɛfɛo fi oyitso.
Nɛkɛ awula bo kɛ shika kɛ jwɛitɛi ni owoɔ. Ni ohebo ji klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ sliki kɛ mama ni alo nii awo mli. Oye shikishaŋnii kpakpa kɛ wo kɛ mu, ni ohe fee fɛo jogbaŋŋ naakpa, ni otsɔ̃ maŋnyɛ.
Ogbɛi hu hehe kɛtee jeŋ maji srɔtoi anɔ yɛ ohe fɛo lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ bɔ ni miwula bo lɛ hã ohe fee fɛo kɛmɔ shi." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Shi odi ohe fɛo kɛ ogbɛi ni ehehe lɛ sɛɛ ni obɔ ajwamaŋ; ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ wɔɔ kɛkɛ.
Okɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ otadei lɛ ekomɛi wulaa ohei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni obɔɔ ajwamaŋ yɛ amɛnɔ, nɔ ni afeko eko dã, ni asaŋ afeŋ nakai nɔ ko hu.
Osaa oŋɔ ojwinei fɛɛfɛji ni ji mishika kɛ mijwiɛtɛi ni mihã o lɛ eko okɛfee hii amãgãi ohã ohe, ni okɛ amɛbɔ ajwamaŋ.
Okɛ otadei ni aye ŋaabii awo amɛmli lɛ ha amãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni okɛ mimu kɛ mitsofakɛŋma lɛ mamɔ amɛhiɛ.
Asaŋ milɛ o kɛ ashikishaŋ kpakpa kɛ mu kɛ wo, ni miniyenii ni mikɛhã o lɛ, nomɛi okɛmamɔ amãgãi lɛ ahiɛ koni eje ŋma ewo amɛ." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Asaŋ obihii kɛ obiyei ni ofɔ ohã mi lɛ hu ogbe amɛ okɛshã afɔlei ohã amãgãi lɛ ni amɛye.
Ani ajwamaŋbɔɔi nɛɛ faaa hãaa bo hewɔ ni ogbe mibii lɛ, ni okɛ amɛ shã afɔlei ohã amãgãi lɛ?
Be ni ofeɔ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ ni obɔɔ ajwamaŋ lɛ, okaiii be ni oji abifao ni onyiɛ yayai kɛ ohe pasaa, ni okokloɔ yɛ olá mli lɛ." Yerusalem Ajwamaŋbɔɔ
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Kpoo, kpoo hã o! Ejaakɛ onifɔɔjiãnii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
ofo akrabatsa fɛɛfɛo ohã ohe, ni ofee otutui wuji ohã ohe yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu mli.
Omamɔ otutui wuji lɛ yɛ ŋmaŋmasha fɛɛ ŋmaŋmasha nɔ, ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ kɛkɛ wɔɔ shii abɔ.
Okɛ Egiptbii, mɛi ni amɛkɔnɔ fa, ni okɛ amɛ je husu lɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ; ni obɔ ajwamaŋ shii abɔ ni okɛwo mimli la.
"Naa, agbɛnɛ, mite shi miwo bo, ni magbla otoi; ni mitsɛ nɔ ni ji ogbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ. Mikɛ o hã ohenyɛlɔi fulɔi ni ji Filistibii lɛ abiyei lɛ ni hiɛ gboɔ yɛ onifɔɔjianifeemɔi lɛ ahe lɛ.
"Osaa okɛ Asiriabii lɛ hu bɔ ajwamaŋ ejaakɛ otɔɔɔ; okɛ amɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ eshɛɛɛ onaa.
Nakai nɔŋŋ okɛ Babilonbii ni ji jrayelɔi lɛ hu bɔ ajwamaŋ, ni no tete hu shɛɛɛ onaa."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Kwɛ bɔ ni akɔnɔ eyi otsuiŋ obɔ̃, ni okɛbɔɔ ajwamaŋ, ni ohiɛ gbooo he;
ni omamɔɔ opiai lɛ omaa ŋmaŋmasha fɛɛ ŋmaŋmasha ni ofeɔ ojamɔhe krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu mli; tsɛ ofeee onii tamɔ ajwamaŋ tete; ejaakɛ bo lɛ oheee shika.
Bo lɛ, oji ohe ŋã gblãfitelɔ ni jeɔ ewu sɛɛ.
Hii keɔ ajwamaŋi fɛɛ anii, shi bo lɛ bo moŋ oŋɔɔ onikeenii lɛ okeɔ osuɔlɔi fɛɛ, ni ohãa amɛ nyɔɔŋnii koni amɛjɛ he fɛɛ he amɛba oŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛo ababɔ.

Bo lɛ, esro bo kwraa yɛ yei ajwamaŋbɔlɔi krokomɛi ahe, ejaakɛ bo lɛ, mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ osɛɛ etɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ bo wɔɔ; asaŋ mɔ ko wooo bo nyɔmɔ akɛ ekɛ bo ewɔ, shi bo moŋ owoɔ mɛi anyɔmɔ, no hewɔ ni sro bo kwraa lɛ." Nyɔŋmɔ gbla Yerusalem toi
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, bo ajwamaŋ, bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Oshwie ohiɛ shi, yɛ osuɔlɔi kɛ wɔji ahiɛ, ni ojie oyayaiaŋ kpo yɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ mli. Ni ogbe obii okɛshã afɔle oha wɔji.

Enɛ hewɔ lɛ naa, mabua osuɔlɔi ni okɛ amɛ ye ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ anaa, mɛi ni osumɔɔ kɛ mɛi ni osumɔɔɔ hu fɛɛ naa kɛkpe. Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ hei fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ mawo o, ni majie oyayaiaŋ matsɔɔ amɛ, koni amɛna oyayaiaŋ fɛɛ.
Asaŋ makojo bo tamɔ akojoɔ yei ni kuɔ gblã mli ni amɛshwieɔ là shi hu lɛ; ni mikɛ mlifu kɛ awuŋayeli aaatɔ lá he owele yɛ onɔ.

Ni maŋɔ bo mawo osuɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛbaakumɔ opiai lɛ, ni amɛbaafite ohei grɔŋŋi ni oja yɛ lɛ. Osuɔlɔi lɛ aaakplɔ ohe atadei hu, ni amɛaaŋɔ ojwinei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ni amɛaashi bo kɛ ohe yayai kɛ ohe pasaa."
"Osuɔlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi asafo yuu aaate shi awo bo ni atswia bo tɛ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛklaŋtei aaaflɔ omli dukuduku.
Amɛkɛ la aaashã oshīai lɛ, ni amɛaakojo bo yɛ yei babaoo ahiɛ; ni maha ofɔ̃ɔ ajwamaŋbɔɔ, ni owoŋ osuɔlɔi ni kɛ bo wɔɔ lɛ anyɔmɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni maha mimli ni ewo bo la lɛ naa ajɔ, ni miyeŋ ohe awuŋa, mafee diŋŋ, ni mimli fuŋ bo dɔŋŋ."

Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, "Akɛni okaiii bɔ ni mikɛ o hi shi hã yɛ oblayeiaŋ, shi moŋ okɛ onifɔɔjianii nɛɛ fɛɛ wo mi mlifu hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, naa, maha onifɔɔjianii lɛ abua oyiteŋ. Bɛ obɔ nyɛnyeŋtswi hu oshi nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ nɔ?
"Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni buɔ abɛ lɛ, aaabu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ ashi bo akɛ, 'Bɔ ni nyɛ (awo) yɔɔ lɛ, nakai ebiyoo yɔɔ.'
Onyɛ ni nyaŋe ewu kɛ ebii lɛ, ebiyoo ji bo; ni onyɛmimɛiyei ni nyaŋe amɛwumɛi kɛ amɛbii lɛ amɛnyɛmiyoo ji bo. Hityoo ji nyɛnyɛ, ni Amornyo ji nyɛtsɛ.
"Onyɛmiyoo nukpa ji Samaria, mɔ ni kɛ ekrowai yɔɔ okooyigbɛ lɛ; ni onyɛmiyoo gbekɛ ji Sodom, mɔ ni kɛ ekrowai lɛ yɔɔ owuoyigbɛ lɛ.
Shi obaaa ojeŋ tamɔ amɛ, ni ofeee amɛnifɔɔjia nii lɛ eko moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, be fioo mli lɛ ofite fe amɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli."
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, onyɛmiyoo Sodom kɛ okrowai lɛ efeee nɔ fɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni bo kɛ obiyei lɛ fee lɛ.
Naa, efɔŋ ni onyɛmiyoo ni ji Sodom fee lɛ ji akɛ ekɛ ebiyei lɛ woɔ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛyɛ ŋmãa babaoo ni amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ hu, shi amɛyeee amɛbuaaa ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni afi amɛ.
Amɛwo amɛhe, ni amɛfee musubɔɔnii yɛ mihiɛ, hewɔ lɛ be ni mina lɛ, mishwie amɛ.
"Samaria hu efeee eshai ni ofee lɛ mli fã tete po, shi bo lɛ ofee musubɔɔnii babaoo ni fe amɛnɔ lɛ, ni kɛji akɛ omusubɔɔnii lɛ to onyɛmimɛiyei lɛ anɔ lɛ he lɛ abuɔ amɛ jalɔi fe bo.

Agbɛnɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ hu ohiɛgble aaatere bo; ejaakɛ obu onyɛmimɛiyei lɛ bem, ejaakɛ musubɔɔnii ni mihiɔ ni ofee lɛ fa fe amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛja fe bo. Agbɛnɛ hã ohiɛ agbo ni otere ohiɛgble, ejaakɛ obu onyɛmimɛiyei lɛ abem." Abaasaa Sodom kɛ Samaria ekoŋŋ
"Makpale Sodom kɛ ekrowai lɛ anibii lɛ mahã amɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ maha Samaria kɛ ekrowai lɛ anine ashɛ amɛnibii lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ, ni makpale bo hu onibii lɛ maha o yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Koni otere ohiɛgble lɛ ni ohiɛ agbo yɛ musubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ, koni onyɛmimɛi lɛ ana akɛ amɛhi fe bo.
Onyɛmimɛiyei ni ji Sodom kɛ ekrowai lɛ kɛ Samaria kɛ ekrowai lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba amɛsa shihilɛhe lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ bo hu okɛ okrowai lɛ aaaku nyɛsɛɛ kɛaaba nyɛsa shihilɛhe lɛ.
Te be mli ni okɛ hewoo yeɔ omele lɛ, onyɛmiyoo ni ji Sodom lɛ ji odaaŋ kotsa,
dani ajie onifɔɔjianii lɛ kpo. Agbɛnɛ okɛ lɛ eye egbɔ, ni Edombii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, aaaye ohe fɛo, ni nakai nɔŋŋ Filistibii kɛ amɛkrowai ni amɛhe tsɛ̃ɔ bo lɛ aaaye ohe fɛo.
Aaagbla otoi yɛ nifɔɔjianii kɛ nihiinii ni ofeɔ lɛ hewɔ." Yehowa kɛɛ. Kpãŋmɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, "Bɔ ni ofee lɛ nakai pɛ mikɛ o baaye, ejaakɛ otswa okitã lɛ ofɔ̃ afã, ni oku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ makai kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ o kpãŋ yɛ oblayeiaŋ lɛ, ni mikɛ o aaakpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ.
"No dani oookai ojeŋba fɔŋ lɛ, ni ohiɛ aaagbo, kɛji miŋɔ onyɛmimɛiyei onukpai kɛ onyɛmimɛiyei gbekɛbii lɛ mibahã o akɛ obiyei lɛ, shi jeee akɛ mikɛ o teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
"Maha mikɛ o teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ ama shi, ni obaale akɛ miji, Yehowa;
Oookai enɛ ni ohiɛ aaagbo, ni okatswa odaaŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛgble lɛ hewɔ, be ni mikɛ nifɔɔjianii ni ofee lɛ fɛɛ efa o lɛ," Yehowa kɛɛ.
17: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gba Israelbii lɛ ajenu, ni obu amɛ abɛ akɛ
bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple kɛ efiji agboi kɛ etsɛji kakadaji ko ni yɔɔ. Eyɛ tsɛji fɛɛfɛji bibii kɛ emli samaisamai. Eba Lebanon gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaku tsenedurutso lɛ yiteŋ.
Eku eniji fɔbii lɛ ayiteŋ fɔflɔoo lɛ eko ni ekɛkɔ̃ enaa kɛtee jrayeli shikpɔŋ ko nɔ. Ekɛtee eyatɛo yɛ guɔyelɔi amaŋ ko mli.
Agbɛnɛ esaa ekɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dumɔ wu lɛ eko ni ekɛtee eyadu yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ. Ekɛ dumɔ wu lɛ tee he ni nu pii yɔɔ, ni edu yɛ faa lɛ toi kpaakpa.
Wu lɛ kwɛ̃ ni eda etsɔ waintso agbo ni ebu gbidii; eniji lɛ kwɔlɔ kɛtee okropɔŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ gbɛ, ni tso lɛ shishifãi lɛ he shi. Kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ waintso, ni egbla niji, ni etsrɛ bai hu.

"Shi okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple kroko hu ni yɔɔ kɛ efiji kplei kɛ etsɛji pii. Ni naa, nɛkɛ waintso nɛɛ dɔrɔ eshishifai lɛ kɛ eniji lɛ kɛba okropɔŋ kroko nɛɛ ŋɔɔgbɛ, koni okrɔpɔŋ nɛɛ ashwie waintso lɛ nɔ nu pii fe he ni eyɔɔ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ.
Okropɔŋ lɛ fã waintso lɛ kɛjɛ akofi nɔ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni eyatɛo yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni nu pii yɔɔ no nɔ, koni egbla niji, ni ewo yibii ni etsɔ̃ waintso kpakpa.

"Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa biɔ nɛ. Ani nɛkɛ waintso nɛɛ aaahere? Ani klɛŋklɛŋ okropɔŋ lɛ baŋ ni ebafã waintso lɛ kɛ eshishi fã fɛɛ, ni eflɔ eniji lɛ eshwie, koni eyibaa fɔbii lɛ fɛɛ aŋla? Ebiŋ hewalɛ tsɔ̃ loo mɛi babaoo ni akɛfã tso lɛ kɛ eshishi fã fɛɛ afɔ̃ shi.
Naa, kɛji afã ayatɛo lɛ, ani eeehere? Ani kɛ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa lɛ lɛ jeee ŋlamɔ eeeŋla kwraa yɛ akofi nɔ he ni atɛo lɛ yɛ lɛ!" Atsɔ̃ɔ Abɛ lɛ shishi
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Bi atuatselɔi awe lɛ akɛ, ani nyɛnaaa abɛ nɛɛ shishi? Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, naa, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem ni ebaŋɔ emli maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ emli lumɛi lɛ, ni ekpla amɛ eshwie esɛɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ odehei lɛ eko, ni ekɛ lɛ kpãŋ; ni ehã odehe lɛ kã lɛ kitã akɛ ebaaye lɛ anɔkwa. Kɛkɛ ni emɔmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ kɛtee,
koni ekɛba jɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shi ni ekawo ehe nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni kɛ eye ekpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi.

Shi Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tse Babilon maŋtsɛ nɛɛ hiɛ atua, ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtee Egipt, koni ahã lɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tabilɔi babaoo. Ani eeehi ehã lɛ? Aso gbɔmɔ ni feɔ nibii tamɔ enɛɛmɛi lɛ eeeye ehe lo? Ani eeeku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni kɛ̃lɛ eeeye ehe lo?"
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Babilon, he ni maŋtsɛ, mɔ ni wo lɛ maŋtsɛ, kɛ mɔ ni ekwa ekitã lɛ, kɛ mɔ kpãŋmɔ mli ni eku yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ eeegbo yɛ.
Kɛji Babilonbii lɛ tswa kpokui, ni amɛtswa kawoo gbogboi koni akɛkpãtã mɛi pii ahiɛ lɛ, Farao kɛ eta kple lɛ kɛ esafo babaoo lɛ nyɛŋ Yuda eye ebua yɛ ta mli.
Akɛni ebuuu kitã ni ekã lɛ, ni eku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, akɛni ekplɛ̃ nɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ efee anɛɛmɛi fɛɛ hewɔ lɛ ehe ejeŋ mli."
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mikitã ni ebuuu lɛ, kɛ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ni eku mli lɛ, mikɛ he sɔ̃ aaabua eyiteŋ.
Mafɔ̃ enɔ miyaa lɛ, ni eeedu mitsɔne, ni mikɛ lɛ aaaba Babilon, ni magbla etoi yɛ jɛi, yɛ shi ni ete ewo mi lɛ hewɔ.
Ni akɛ klaŋte aaakpãtã etabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie lɛ." Nyɔŋmɔ wo hiɛnɔkãmɔ he shi
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Mi diɛŋtsɛ maku tsenedrutso yiteŋ kɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ ni mayatɛo. Maku eniji fɔbii lɛ ayiteŋ fɔflɔooi lɛ, ni mayatɛo yɛ gɔŋ ni kwɔ grɔŋŋ ko nɔ.
Israel gɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ matɛo yɛ; ni eeegbla niji, ni eeewo yibii, ni eeetsɔ̃ tsenedrutso fɛɛfɛo, ni loofɔji srɔtoi fɛɛ aaabahi enɔ, amɛaahi eniji ashishi hɔŋŋ lɛ mli.
Ni ŋanɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mihãa tso ni kwɔ lɛ baa shi, ni miwoɔ tso tɛkɛɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi; Mihãa tso ŋmɔŋ gbiɔ ni mihãa tso gbiŋ fɛoɔ. Mi, Yehowa, miwie, ni mafee hu."
18: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ,
"Mɛni ji shishinumɔ ni nyɛkɛbuɔ abɛ nɛɛ yɛ Isreal shikpɔŋ lɛ he akɛ, 'Tsɛmɛi lɛ eye wainyibii ŋmlikitii, ni bii lɛ moŋ anyanyɔji eshwã' lɛ?
"Gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbuŋ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel." Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Naa, gbɔmɛi fɛɛ awala lɛ, minɔ ni. Bɔ ni tsɛ wala ji minɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ bi hu nɔ ji minɔ. Gbɔmɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbo.
"Ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni ji jalɔ, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja.
Eyeee nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ. Ni ewooo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛɛɛ Israel we lɛ wɔji lɛ tete, ni enyiɛɛɛ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ, ni ebɛŋkɛɛɛ yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ.
Ewaaa mɔ yi; shi ekpaleɔ nyɔmɔtsɛ awabatoonii ehãa lɛ; ni etswaaa ojo; ehaaa mɔ ko nɔ ko, shi moŋ ehãa mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ nii eyeɔ; asaŋ mɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ ebuɔ lɛ mama.
"Ekɛ shika efaaa ni ehe hekpa fe nine. Ewiɔ ehe yɛ eshafeemɔ he, ni ekojoɔ mɔ kɛ mɔ teŋ yɛ jalɛ naa.
Ebaa ejeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni eyeɔ mimlai lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ fɔ binuu yiwalɔ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ.
Bi nɛɛ efeee nii ni sa feemɔ nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko; shi moŋ eyeɔ nii ni akɛshãa afɔle ahãa wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ; ni enyiɛɔ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ.
Ewaa ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ yi. Etswaa ojo, ni ekpaleee nyɔmɔtsɛ awabatoonii ehãaa lɛ. Ejaa amãgã, ni efeɔ musubɔɔnii.
Efaa shika ni eheɔ hekpa fe nine. Aso nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ yi aaana wala? Eyi naŋ wala. Akɛni efee nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ fɛɛ eko hewɔ lɛ gbo kɛ̃ eeegbo; ela aaabua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ.
"Shi agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ fɔ binuu ko, ni ebinuu nɛɛ na eshai fɛɛ ni etsɛ lɛ efee lɛ, ni eshe gbeyei, ni efeee nakai eshai lɛ eko.
Ni eyeee nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni ejaaa Israel we lɛ amãgãi lɛ ekoeko. Ni enyiɛɛɛ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ.
Ni efeee mɔ ko efɔŋ, eheee mɔ ko awabatoonii; etswaaa mɔ ko ojo. Shi moŋ ehãa mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ aboloo, asaŋ mɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ, ebuɔ lɛ mama.

Ewiɔ ehe yɛ eshafeemɔ he, ni ekɛ shika efaaa ni ehe hekpa ni fe nine. Ni eyeɔ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni ebaa ejeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa. Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ egboŋ yɛ eshai ni etsɛ efee lɛ ahewɔ, shi moŋ eyi aaana wala kɛ̃.
Shi etsɛ lɛ, akɛni etswaa ojo, ni ejuɔ enyɛmi, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ehiii yɛ emaŋbii ateŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, gbo eeegbo yɛ ehe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
"Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛbiɔ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ hewɔ esaaa akɛ bi naa amanehului yɛ esha ni etsɛ efee hewɔ?' Kɛji bi lɛ yeɔ jalɛ sane, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja, ni eyeɔ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ esa akɛ eyi ana wala kɛ̃.

Gbɔmɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ gbo eeegbo. Bi enaŋ amanehulu yɛ eshai ni etsɛ efee ahewɔ, ni tsɛ hu enaŋ amanehulu yɛ eshai ni ebii efee ahewɔ. Jalɔ aaana ejalɛnii ni efee lɛ he nyɔmɔwo, ni mɔ fɔŋ hu aaana efɔŋ ni efee lɛ he nyɔmɔwo.
"Shi kɛji eshafeelɔ fɔ̃ɔ eshai fɛɛ ni efeɔ, ni eye mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni eye jalɛ sane, ni efee nɔ ni ja lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ.
Tɔmɔi ni etɔ̃ lɛ akaiŋ ekoeko dɔŋŋ, akɛaafa lɛ. Ejalɛnii ni efee lɛ hewɔ lɛ eyi aaana wala.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa miibi akɛ, "Aso minyaa efɔŋfeelɔ gbele he lo? Dabida, nɔ ni mitaoɔ moŋ ji akɛ etsake ejeŋba koni eyi ana wala."

"Shi kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ ni efee esha, ni efee musubɔɔ nii ni mɔfɔŋ feɔ lɛ, aso eyi aaana wala lo? Jalɛnii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akaiŋ ekoeko. Etɔmɔi ni etɔ̃ lɛ kɛ eshai ni efee lɛ, eeegbo yɛ nomɛi ahewɔ.
"Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yeee jalɛ sane. Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛboa toi ko! Ani mi, miyeee jalɛ sane? Ani jeee nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛyeee jalɛ sane?
Kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ, ni efee efɔŋ lɛ, gbo eeegbo yɛ no hewɔ. Ebaagbo yɛ efɔŋ ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Asaŋ kɛji mɔ fɔŋ fɔ̃ɔ eshai ni efeɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni eye mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ja ni ehi lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Ejaakɛ ekɔ eyiŋ, ni efɔ̃ɔ enifɔɔjia nii lɛ fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ.
Kɛ̃lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yeee jalɛ sane.' Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, ani mi ni miyeee jalɛ sane lo? Ani jeee nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛyeee jalɛsane?

"No hewɔ lɛ, Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, makojo nyɛ, makojo nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enifeemɔ nii anaa. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ, ni nyɛfɔ̃a nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ; koni nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ akakpãtã nyɛhiɛ.
Nyɛkpaa efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛshi mi lɛ feemɔ, ni nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ ni nyɛnaa mumɔ hee. Ao Israelbii, shi mɛɛba ni nyɛaagboi?
Minyaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko gbele he. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ koni nyɛyi anaa wala."
19: Wo yaafo lala nɔ okɛfo Israel lumɛi Lɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ,
"Ani onyɛ lɛ jeee jatayoo ni? Ni ebu jata oblahii ateŋ ni elɛ ebii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ?
Ni etsɔse ebii lɛ ateŋ ekome ni etsɔ̃ jata oblanyo; ekase loomɔmɔ, ni eyeɔ gbɔmɔ tete?
Jeŋmaji lɛ bɔ ehe oshe; ni adu lɛ yɛ amɛbu lɛ mli; ni amɛkɛ kpoji gbla lɛ kɛtee Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni enyɛ mɛ aahuu lɛ, ehiɛnɔkãmɔ tã. Esaa eŋɔ ebii lɛ ateŋ ekroko efee jata oblanyo.
Be ni eda etsɔ̃ jata oblanyo lɛ ekɛ jatai lɛ nyiɛ aahuu. Ekase gbɔbimɔ ni eyeɔ gbɔmɔ tete.
Ejwra amɛ mɔji, ni efite maji hu; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ she gbeyei yɛ ehuumɔ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni jeŋmaji lɛ gba wo lɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛfɔ̃ enɔ yaa, ni adu lɛ yɛ amɛbu lɛ mli.
Ni amɛkɛ kpoji gbla lɛ amɛwo kooloi adeka mli; ni amɛkɛ lɛ yahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ to mɔɔ lɛ mli; bɔ ni afee ni akanu egbee yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Onyɛ tamɔ waintso ni atɛo yɛ faa toi; egbla niji, ni ewo yibii babaoo, ejaakɛ enaa nu pii.
Eniji lɛ na hewalɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ tsi. Ni ewo ekwɔlɛ nɔ yɛ niji kusukusui lɛ ateŋ. Ni ana ekwɔlɛ kɛ eniji kusukusuu lɛ.
Shi akɛ mlila fã lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ gbi lɛ, ni eyibii lɛ kpla, ni etso ni wa lɛ gbi, ni eshã wɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ afã lɛ ayatɛo yɛ ŋanɔ, yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni la jɛ tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mli ni eshã eniji lɛ kɛ eyibii lɛ fɛɛ; ni tso bɛ emli dɔŋŋ ni aaanyɛ akɛfee maŋtsɛ tsi dɔŋŋ. Awerɛhoo lala nɛɛ alaa akɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ daa.
20: Yɛ wɔnomŋɔɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israel onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ba miŋɔɔ koni amɛbabi Yehowa nii. Amɛbatra shi yɛ mihiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, okɛ Israel maŋ onukpai nɛɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ani mi nibimɔ nyɛbaa nɛɛ? Gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, Mihaŋ nyɛbi mi nii.
Ani oookojo amɛ? Gbɔmɔ Adesa? Ani oookojo amɛ? Belɛ hã amɛle musubɔɔnii ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, gbi ni miŋɔ Israel lɛ mikã Yakob shwiei lɛ akitã ni mihã amɛle mi yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mikã amɛ kitã akɛ, 'Miji Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.'
Nakai gbi lɛ mikã amɛ kitã akɛ majie amɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya shikpɔŋ ko ni mito miha amɛ lɛ nɔ; shikpɔŋ ni hi ni ebaa nii, ni eji shikpɔji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahɛrɛ musubɔɔnii ni ehiŋmɛii nyaa he lɛ eshwie; ni nyɛkɛ Egipt wɔji lɛ akabulea nyɛhe! Miji Yehowa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!

Shi amɛtse mihiɛ atua, ni amɛbooo mi toi. Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko shɛrɛɛɛ musubɔɔnii ni ehiŋmɛii nyaa he lɛ eshwieee, ni Egipt wɔji lɛ hu ahewɔ lɛ, mito miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ mlila kɛ mlifu aaafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mifeee; mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ yɛ migbɛi hewɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mikagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ, mɛi ahiɛ ni mihã amɛle mi yɛ, be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ ba ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Miwo amɛ mlai kɛ akpɔi lɛ, ni kɛ gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ.
Asaŋ miŋɔ mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ mihã amɛ, koni nomɛi atsɔ̃ okadi yɛ mi kɛ amɛteŋ, koni amɛkɛle akɛ mi Yehowa, miji mɔ ni tsuuɔ amɛhe.

"Shi Israel we lɛ tse mihiɛ atua yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ anaa, shi moŋ amɛkwa mikpɔi ni kɛ gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ; ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ hu naakpa. No hewɔ lɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ mimlila aaaplenee amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kwrakwra.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ; mɛi ahiɛ ni mi mijie Israel kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ mikã amɛ kitã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ mikɛ amɛ baŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ nɔ; shikpɔŋ ni hi ni ebaa nii, ni eji shikpɔji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
"Ejaakɛ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa. Ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ hã amɛwɔji lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ mina amɛ mɔbɔ, ni mikpãtãaa amɛhiɛ ni mipleneee amɛ kwrakwra yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
"Mikɛɛ amɛbii yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ amlai lɛ anaa, ni nyɛkayea amɛkpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkɛ amɛwɔji lɛ akabulea nyɛhe.
Yehowa, miji nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ moŋ anaa; ni nyɛyea mimlai lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni nyɛfea mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni nomɛi atsɔ̃ okadi yɛ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ; koni nyɛkɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, miji nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.'

"Shi nyɛbii lɛ hu tse mihiɛ atua; amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mlai lɛ anaa, ni amɛyeee mikpɔi lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; mlai ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ; amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ hu. Kɛkɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ mimlifu kɛ mimlila naa yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ,
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ; mɛi ahiɛ ni mi, mijie Israelbii lɛ yɛ, kɛje Egypt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ, mikã amɛ kitã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ;
ejaakɛ amɛyeee mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ yakɔ̃ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ awɔji lɛ anɔ.
"No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu miwo amɛ mlai ni ehiii, kɛ akpɔi ni haŋ amɛna wala.
Mibule amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnikeenii anɔ, no ji amɛkromɔbii ni amɛgbe kɛshã afɔle lɛ, koni mahã amɛhe ajɔ̃ amɛhe. Mifee enɛ, koni amɛkɛna amɛle akɛ, miji Yehowa.
"No hewɔ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, enɛ mli hu nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ bɔ musu amɛshi mi yɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mi anɔkwa.

Ejaakɛ be ni mihã amɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikã kitã akɛ mikɛaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ, loo tso kusuu fɛɛ tso kusuu ni amɛaana lɛ, amɛyashãa amɛ afɔlei lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛkɛ afɔleshãa nɛɛ wo mimli la; jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛshãa amɛtsofakɛŋmai lɛ yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛfɔse amɛdãa afɔle lɛ amɛshwie shi yɛ.
Mibi amɛ akɛ, mɛni ji nakai he grɔŋŋ lɛ ni nyɛyaa lɛ? No hewɔ atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ 'He Grɔŋŋ' kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ani nyɛaabule nyɛhe tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ; ani nyɛaanyiɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii lɛ asɛɛ ni nyɛdu gbɛ?

Gbii abɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii yahãa wɔji, ni nyɛgbeɔ nyɛbihii nyɛkɛshãa afɔlei nyɛhãa amɛ lɛ, nyɛmiibule nyɛhe kɛ nɛkɛ nyɛwɔji nɛɛ ajamɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Ao, Israel we, nyɛmiiba ni nyɛbabi mi nii? Gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mihaŋ nyɛbi mi nii! Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nɔ ni nyɛsusuɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, wɔɔtamɔ jeŋmaji kɛ shikpɔji anɔ wekui lɛ, ni wɔsɔmɔ tso kɛ tɛ lɛ, ebaŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ." Nyɔŋmɔ gblaa toi, ni ekɛfaa
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ mlila ni naa wa baaye nyɛnɔ maŋtsɛ.
Mikɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ mlila baajie nyɛ kɛaajɛ shikpɔji ni agbɛ nyɛ ashwã amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ.
Ni mikɛ nyɛaaba majimaji lɛ ateŋ ni mabua nyɛnaa kɛaajɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni jɛi magbla nyɛtoi yɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ."
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni migbla nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ atoi yɛ Egipt ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ magbla nyɛ hu nyɛtoi.
"Maha nyɛtsɔ̃ kplamɔtso lɛ shishi, ni makane nyɛ ekomekome mawo kpãŋmɔ mli.
Ni majie atuatselɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni etɔ̃ minɔ lɛ kɛaaje nyɛteŋ. Majie amɛ kɛaajɛ he ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi amɛnane yiŋ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. No dani nyɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."

Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, "Ao, nyɛ Israel we, (nyɛ lɛ kɛji nyɛboŋ mi toi lɛ, kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ) nyɛyaa ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ayasɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewɔji lɛ; shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ nyɛabo mi toi kɛ̃, ni migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii lɛ kɛ nyɛwɔŋjamɔ lɛ babuleŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ."

Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, "Shi migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji Israel Gɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jɛi Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaasɔmɔ mi yɛ; mana amɛhe tsui yɛ jɛi, ni mabi nyɛfɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛnikeenii kpakpai lɛ kɛ nyɛkeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ shi.

Kɛji mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ amli, ni mibua nyɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji ni agbɛ nyɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba lɛ, mana nyɛhe tsui tamɔ nɔ ko ni jeɔ ŋma, ni majie mikrɔŋkrɔŋ ni miji lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni majimaji aaana.
Kɛji mikɛ nyɛ bashɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni mikã he kitã akɛ maŋɔhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ miji Yehowa.
Ni jɛi nyɛaakai nyɛjeŋba kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛfee ni nyɛkɛbule nyɛhe lɛ yɛ, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe aaafee nyɛ nyaŋemɔ yɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, nyɛ Israel we, kɛji mikɛnyɛ ye yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ, shi jeee yɛ nyɛjeŋba gbohii lɛ ahewɔ, loo nyɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi miji Yehowa." Wuoyigbɛ la lɛ
Yehowa kɛmi wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã wuoyigbɛ; wiemɔ oshi Yuda wuoyigbɛ lɛ; gbaa oshi wuoyigbɛ koo lɛ.

Kɛɛmɔ Yuda wuoyigbɛ koo lɛ akɛ, bo Yehowa wiemɔ toi. Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: naa, mawo la yɛ omli, ni eeeshã omli tso ŋmɔŋ fɛɛ tso ŋmɔŋ, kɛ tso gbiŋ fɛɛ tso gbiŋ. La ni tsoɔ grigri lɛ agbeŋ, ni eeeshã he fɛɛ he kɛaajɛ wuoyigbɛ aahuu kɛyashi kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ baana akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi miwo la lɛ, ni anyɛŋ agbe."
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, amɛkɛɔ yɛ mihe akɛ, 'Ani jeee abɛbuaŋ sɔŋŋ ewieɔ yɛ?'"
21: Yehowa kɛ miwie ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oha Yerusalem ni oshiɛ oshi hei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, he ni ajaa yɛ lɛ; gbaa oshi Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ,
ni okɛɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ o ena, ni magbla miklaŋte lɛ kɛaaje ehebo lɛ mli, ni mikɛaagbe jalɔ kɛ mɔfɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Akɛni makpãtã jalɔ kɛ mɔfɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ kɛaaje nyɛteŋ hewɔ lɛ mafã miklaŋte lɛ kɛjɛ ehebo lɛ mli mawo gbɔmɛi kɛjɛ wuoyigbɛ aahuu kɛyashi kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
No gbɔmɛi fɛɛ kɛaana ale akɛ, mi Yehowa mifã miklaŋte kɛjɛ ehebo lɛ mli, ni akɛwoŋ ehebo lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
"No hewɔ lɛ bo, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, hūumɔ kɛ awerɛhoo kple yɛ amɛhiɛ.

Ni kɛji amɛbi bo akɛ, 'Mɛni hewɔ ohūuɔ lɛ? Okɛɛ akɛ, 'Saji ni minu lɛ hewɔ ni. Kɛji eba mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashe gbeyei, ni kɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ baakplɔke, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɔ̃ feetɔ, ni nukutsei fɛɛ tswɛm baakpokpo tamɔ ayawaŋ nu. Naa, be lɛ eshɛ, ni ebaaba mli kɛ̃;'" Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔn Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ akɛ, nɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ, mikɛɔ nɛ, Klaŋte! Klaŋte! Ajɔ klaŋte naa, ni asha he kaŋkaŋ.
Ajɔ naa koni akɛgbe mɔ; asha he ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ tamɔ srawa. Aso wɔmli afli wɔ? Mibi, ogbe kpãa kɛ tsɔsemɔ fɛɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ akɛ klaŋte lɛ ehã ni esha he, koni efee lɛ kralo kɛhã nitsumɔ. Ajɔ naa, ni asha he kaŋkaŋ koni akɛwo mɔgbelɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Gbɔmɔ Adesa, wo yara ni ofo, ejaakɛ afã klaŋte awo miwebii lɛ. Afã klaŋte awo Israel lumɛi fɛɛ. Ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ miwebii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ahã klaŋte; hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyia nyɛhe ma.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa miibi, akɛ, 'Nyɛjwɛŋa he jogbaŋŋ, ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ kɛ nyɛkwa tsɔsemɔ lɛ toigblamɔ lɛ baŋ lo?'"
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, no hewɔ lɛ gbaa. Tswaa odɛ̃ koni klaŋte lɛ ni baagbe mɛi lɛ abamɔ amɛ nɔtonɔto. No ji klaŋte ni baakpãtã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ lɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ gbele ebɔle amɛhe kɛkpe;
koni amɛshe gbeyei, ni mɛi babaoo agbeegbee shi hewɔ mitsɔ̃ klaŋte lɛ naa mihã maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa. Mikɛ klaŋte ni kplɛɔ tamɔ srawa lɛ ehã. Ehe miikpɛ tamɔ srawa. Asha he kɛha mɔgbee.
Klaŋte, bãa kɛya ninejurɔ ni obã kɛya abɛku, tsɔ̃ ohe ni ofo kɛya he fɛɛ he. Hã enyɔ loo mli.
Mi hu matswa midɛ̃, ni mimlifu lɛ naa aba shi. Mi Yehowa, miwie." Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ klaŋte lɛ
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kadimɔ gbɛjegbɛi enyɔ nɔ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ eklaŋte lɛ aaanyɛ atsɔ nɔ kɛba lɛ. Gbɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaanyɛ ajɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ kɛba. Too gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ okadi oma maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ.

Okadi lɛ ekome atsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛ ni ekɛ eklaŋte lɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba Raba, ni ji Amonbii lɛ amaŋ lɛ mli; okadi kroko lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ kɛya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbote Yerusalem ni atswa gbogbo awo ehe lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Ejaakɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ damɔ gbɛŋta lɛ naa, yɛ heni gbɛi enyɔ lɛ gbaa akloŋta yɛ lɛ. Ebaahoso gaimlibii kɛkla ni eeebi emãgãi lɛ anii, ni eeekwɛ afɔle kooloo ni agbe lɛ mlɛbo mli fitsofitso.
Eklamɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ ninejurɔgbɛ kɛya Yerusalem, koni ebɔ ta oshe, ni awo naa nɔ ablɔ, ni aŋɔ gbogbokuumɔnii apiŋ gboi lɛ ahe, ni atswa kpokui ni amamɔ mɔji ni wa.
Eeefee Yerusalembii lɛ akɛ klamɔ ni bɛ mli ni, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ maji ekpãŋ, shi moŋ esa akɛ amɛkai amɛnɔsha lɛ akɛ abaamɔmɔ amɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Akɛni nyɛha ana eshai ni nyɛfee lɛ, ni nyɛnifɔɔjianii eje kpo yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ mli, ni mikai nyɛ hewɔ lɛ abaamɔmɔ nyɛ kɛya nomŋɔɔ mli.
Bo Israel lumɔ, yiwalɔ ni he tseee, bo ni obe eshɛ kɛhã onaagbee toigblamɔ,
bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ o nɛ, Jiemɔ oyifiinɔ lɛ, ni jiemɔ okekre lɛ yɛ oyitso. Nibii ehiŋ shi tamɔ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ; nɔ ni eba shi lɛ, awo nɔ; ni nɔ ni awo nɔ lɛ, aba lɛ shi.
Butumɔ! Butumɔ! Butumɔ mabutu maŋ lɛ. Anaŋ he okadi ko kwraa kɛyaashi mɔ gbɛnaa ni ji lɛ aaaba, ni lɛ maŋɔ hã." Klaŋte lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ
"Ni bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ Amonbii lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nyɛ yɛ ahora ni amɛbɔɔ Israel lɛ he nɛ, kɛɛmɔ akɛ, 'klaŋte, agbla klaŋte kɛhã gbɔmɔgbee; asha he kaŋkaŋ, ni ekpɛ tamɔ srawa.'
"Nii ni nyɛnaa lɛ amale ninaa ni, ni nyɛgbalɛi hu amale gbalɛi ni, koni nyɛkɛ sɔ̃ lɛ afɔ̃ lumɛi kɛ mɛi fɔɔji ni egboi lɛ anɔ. Amɛ lɛ, amɛnaagbee hiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ eshɛ.
Kɛ klaŋte awo ehebo lɛ mli, Makojo bo yɛ heni abɔ o yɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ ni ojɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Mimli baawo bo la, ni mimlifu ni waa wa ni tsoɔ tamɔ la lɛ aaaba onɔ; ni majie bo mawo hii dikalɔi yitsoŋwalɔi ni le nifitemɔ heŋaa lɛ adɛŋ.
Nyɛbaatsɔ̃ latɛ naa lai; aaashwie nyɛlá shi akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni akaiŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
22: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ,
"Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ani oookojo, ani oookojo maŋ ni ashwieɔ lá shi yɛ mli lɛ? Belɛ hã ele emusubɔɔnii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, maŋ ni ashwieɔ là shi yɛ emli, asaŋ ni efeɔ amãgãi ni ekɛbuleɔ ehe lɛ; ebe aaashɛ,
lá shi ni oshwie kɛ amãgãi ni ofee okɛbule ohe lɛ hewɔ lɛ oye fɔ; ehã ogbii lɛ ebɛŋkɛ; afii ni ato ahã bo lɛ eshɛ. No hewɔ lɛ miha jeŋmaji lɛ miibɔ bo ahora, ni shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ miiye ohe fɛo.
Mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ o kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ aaaye ohe fɛo, bo mɔ ni ohe guɔ egbo, ni basabasafeemɔ eyi omli obɔ̃.
Naa, Israel lumɛi ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tswaa efai shi akɛ ebaashwie lá shi yɛ omli, bɔ ni eeenyɛ.
Abuuu tsɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ omli, ayeɔ gbɔ amim yɛ omli; awaa awusa kɛ okulafo yi yɛ omli.
Obuuu minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni obuleɔ mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ.
Mɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni yeɔ osheku, bɔ ni afee ni ashwie mɛi alá shi; mɛi komɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni amɛyeɔ afɔlei ni ashã ahã amãgãi lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu yɛ nyɛteŋ ni bɔɔ nyɛnyeŋtswi.
Mɛi komɛi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi aŋamɛi naa bɔlɛ yɛ omli, ni mɛi komɛi tuaa yei ni etee tsuiasɛɛ, ni amɛhe tseee lɛ yɛ omli.
Mɔ kɛ enaanyo ŋa naa bɔlɛ; mɔ ko hu kɛ ebinuu ŋa naa bɔlɛ; mɔ ko hu kɛ enyɛmiyoo ni ji etsɛbi naa bɔlɛ yɛ omli.
Mɛi heɔ nyɔɔŋnii, koni ashwie lá shi yɛ omli; aheɔ hekpa ni fe nine, ni atswaa nanemɛi ojo. Nyɛhiɛ ekpa minɔ." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ mitswa midɛ̃ mishwie onɔ yɛ shishiumɔnii ni ona kɛ lá shi ni oshwie yɛ omli lɛ hewɔ.
Gbi ni mikɛ o aaaye lɛ, aso ooonyɛ naa odamɔ? Aloo ooonyɛ onine nɔ po owo? Mi, Yehowa, miwie, ni mafee.
Magbɛ omlibii lɛ mashwã jeŋmaji kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛaatsuu ohe muji lɛ mashwie.
Ni ohe guɔ baagbo yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ, ni ooona ole akɛ miji Yehowa lɛ." Nyɔŋmɔ niiahetsuumɔ flɔnɔɔ lɛ
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, Israel we lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ shikafei ehã mi. Amɛ fɛɛ kwa lɛ, jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ sanyaa kɛ dade kɛ sumui ni asere yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ shishi muji ji amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Akɛni nyɛ blublu nyɛtsɔmɔ shikafei hewɔ lɛ, naa, mabua nyɛnaa mawo Yerusalem,

taakɛ bɔ ni mɛi buaa jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ sumui kɛ tsɛnsi naa amɛwoɔ flɔnɔɔ mli ni ahuuɔ la awoɔ he, ni asereɔ lɛ, nakai mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila aaabua nyɛnaa, ni mikɛ nyɛ aaawo la mli ni masere nyɛ.
Mabua nyɛnaa ni mahuu mimlifu mlila lɛ mashwie nyɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaasere.
Bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi sereɔ yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaasere nyɛ yɛ Yerusalem; ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mihuu mimlila lɛ mishwie nyɛnɔ.'" Israel Hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ahe eshai lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel akɛ, boji shikpɔŋ ko ni ohe tseee, ni nu hu enɛŋ onɔ yɛ mimlifu be lɛ mli.
Emli lumɛi lɛ tamɔ jatai ni huuɔ ni amɛmiitserɛ amɛmilɛ loo mli; amɛkpãtã gbɔmɛi awala ahiɛ; amɛshɔ̃ mɛi ajwetri kɛ nii ni jra wa yɛ amɛdɛŋ; amɛhã yei pii etsɔmɔ okulafoi yɛ Yerusalem.

Omli osɔfoi lɛ ku mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni amɛbule minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ; amɛhãaa ana srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni abule teŋ; asaŋ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ, ni amɛbuuu mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ abule mi yɛ amɛteŋ.
"Emli lumɛi lɛ tamɔ klaji ni tserɛɔ milɛloo mli, amɛshwieɔ lá shi, amɛkpãtãa mɛi ahiɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo shishiumɔ ninamɔ.
Emli gbalɔ lɛ maleɔ ekɛhaa eshai nɛɛ anɔ tamɔ akɛ kaaloo shaa gbogbo he lɛ. Amɛnaa amale ninaa, ni amɛgbaa amale gbalɛi akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.' Be mli ni mi Yehowa miwieko tete.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ tswaa ojo, ni amɛjuɔ amɛwaa ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ ayi, ni amɛyeɔ gbɔ amim, ni atooo lɛ najiaŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ, mitao akɛ mana mɔ ko kɛjɛ amɛteŋ ni eeetswa gbogbo ni ewule lɛ, ni eeebu flɔ lɛ naa yɛ mihiɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ, koni mikafite lɛ; shi minaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko.
No hewɔ lɛ mimli wo amɛ la, ni mikɛ mlifu plenee amɛ, ni miha amɛmusu ebua amɛyiteŋ." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
23: Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, yei enyɔ komɛi, ni ji yoo kome musuŋbii hi shi.
Be ni amɛji oblayei yɛ Egipt lɛ amɛbɔ ajwamaŋ yɛ jɛi, ni jɛi atra amɛfufɔi ahe yɛ, ni jɛi hu afite amɛ yɛ.
Onukpa lɛ gbɛi ji Ohola, ni fioo lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Oholiba. Mikɛ amɛ hi shi, ni mikɛ amɛ fɔfɔɔ bihii kɛ biyei. Ohola damɔ shi kɛha Samaria, ni Oholiba damɔ shi kɛhã Yerusalem.
Ohola je misɛɛ ni eyabɔ ajwamaŋ, ni ehiɛ yakɔ̃ esuɔlɔi lɛ ni ji Asiriabii lɛ anɔ.
Tabilɔi ni woɔ afaseo atadei ji amɛ; amraloi kɛ lumɛi kɛ oblahii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi sɔŋŋ ji amɛ.
Asiria hii ni ajegbɛ ahala lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ amɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ lɛ, eja amɛwɔji lɛ, ni ekɛbule ehe.
Efɔ̃ko ajwamaŋbɔɔ ni ebɔi kɛjɛ Egipt lɛ, ejaakɛ hii kɛ lɛ wɔ eblayeiaŋ ni amɛmiamia eblayeiaŋ kpokpoai lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ lɛ basabasa tamɔ ajwamaŋ ko.
No hewɔ lɛ mitu lɛ miwo esuɔlɔi lɛ ni ji Asiriabii ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛjie eyayaiaŋ kpo amɛmɔmɔ ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛkɛ klaŋte gbe lɛ; ni etsɔ wiemɔ ni yei kɛyeɔ fɛo akɛ akojo lɛ.
"Oholiba na nɔ ni ba enyɛmiyoo Ohola nɔ lɛ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ehiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ naa wa fe Ohola nɔ lɛ, ni ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ hu fe enyɛmiyoo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Oholiba hiɛ kɔ̃ Asiriabii ni ji amralofoi kɛ lumɛi kɛ tabilɔi ni ewula kɛ tayaa atadei kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi, ni ji oblahii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mina akɛ ebule ehe, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ.
"Shi Oholiba tee nɔ lolo kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ; ena Babilon hii mfonirii ni akɛ atiifɔ tsuru etɛŋ yɛ gbogbo he.
Ena akɛ amɛkɛ hɛfiinii efimɔ amɛhɛi, ni amɛkɛ yitsofiinii kakaaji efimɔ amɛyitsei; mfoniri nɛɛ mli bii lɛ tamɔ Babilon lumɛi ni afɔ yɛ Kaldea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni ena amɛfonirii lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtee lumɛi nɛɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon.
Kɛkɛ ni Babilon hii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ bawɔ, ni amɛkɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ bule lɛ. Agbɛnɛ be ni ekɛ amɛ ewo muji egbe naa lɛ amɛje etsine.
Bɔ ni ebɔ ajwamaŋ faŋŋ lɛ, ni ejie eyayaiaŋ kpo lɛ hã esane je mitsine tamɔ bɔ ni enyɛmiyoo lɛ sane je mitsine lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ etee nɔ ebɔ ejwamaŋ lɛ fe nine, ni ekai eblayeiaŋ bei amli ni eyɔɔ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ebɔɔ ajwamaŋ lɛ.
Ehemɛi ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ nɛɛ anuutso tamɔ teji nɔ, ni amɛhenu hu tamɔ okpɔŋɔ he nu.
Bo, Oholiba, nɛkɛ oshwɛ oblayeiaŋ basabasa nyiɛmɔi ni onyiɛ, be ni Egiptbii lɛ miamia ofufɔi, ni amɛfite o lɛ." Nyɔŋmɔ kojo Oholiba
"No hewɔ lɛ, bo Oholiba, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ; naa mibatee osuɔlɔi ni amɛje otsine lɛ shi mawo o, ni maha amɛte shi amɛwo o kɛjɛ he fɛɛ he.

Maha hii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ ajɛ Babilon kɛ Kaldea kɛ Pekod kɛ Shoa kɛ Koa kɛ Asiria fɛɛ aba. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ oblahii kɛ amraloi kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi kɛ gbɛnaahiɛlɔi kɛ tabilɔi ni tra okpɔŋɔi anɔ ji amɛ.
Ni mɛi pii kɛ ta shwiilii kɛ tsɔnei ni gblaa nii aaajɛ kooyigbɛ aba; ni amɛaagba amɛwo ohe kɛ tsɛŋi bibii kɛ dade fai, ni maha amɛ hegbɛ ni amɛkojo bo yɛ amɛmlai anaa.
Mimli aaafu o koni amɛkɛ o aye yɛ mlila naa. Amɛaaflɔ ogugɔ kɛ otoii, ni amɛkɛ klaŋte aaagbegbee omɛi ni baashwɛ lɛ. Amɛaaloo obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ kɛaaya, ni omɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ la aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Amɛaakplɔ otadei lɛ yɛ ohe, ni amɛaajie ojwinei fɛɛfɛji lɛ.
Bɔ ni mafee ni mikɛku ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ ni obɔi kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa nɛ; no aaahã owoŋ ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ Egiptbii lɛ, ni okaiŋ amɛ hu dɔŋŋ."
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, mibatu bo mawo ohenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni eje otsine lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛkɛ o aaaye yɛ yiwalɛ naa. Amɛaaloo nii ni ogbo deŋme yɛ he lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛaashi o yayai kɛ ohe pasaa; ni amɛaajie ojwamaŋbɔɔ yayaiaŋ kpo. Ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ ji nɔ ni kɛ enɛ ba onɔ.
Aaafee bo enɛɛmɛi ejaakɛ okɛ jeŋmaji lɛ yabɔbɔɔ ajwamaŋ, ni oyanyiɛ amɛwɔji lɛ asɛɛ ni okɛwo ohe muji,
Onyiɛ onyɛmiyoo lɛ nanefaamɔi lɛ asɛɛ, no hewɔ lɛ migbla otoi tamɔ migbla etoi lɛ nɔŋŋ."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Ooonu nii kɛaajɛ onyɛmiyoo lɛ kpulu lɛ mli; emli kwɔ, ni eda. Abaaŋmɔ bo, ni abaaye ohe fɛo. Ejaakɛ emli nii lɛ fa.
Dãa aaatɔ o, ni owerɛ aaaho ohe. Onyɛmiyoo Samaria toigblamɔ lɛ gbeyei kɛ fitemɔ kpulu ni.
Obaanu nii yɛ mli, ni ooolɛmɔ mli. Ooofamɔ oyitsɔi tete, ni oootserɛ ofufɔi ahe; ejaakɛ mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, "Akɛni ohiɛ ekpa minɔ, ni oshɛ mi ofɔ osɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, obaana ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ he nɔ." Nyɔŋmɔ kojo yei enyɔ lɛ
Yehowa bi mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa ani obaakojo Ohola kɛ Oholiba? Belɛ jajemɔ musubɔɔnii ni amɛfee lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛfite gblã, ni amɛshwie lá shi; amɛkɛ amɛwɔji lɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ, ni bii ni mikɛ amɛfɔ lɛ, tete amɛkɛ amɛ fee niyenii amɛkɛhã amɛwɔji.
Asaŋ nɔ hu ni amɛfee mi nɛ: Amɛwo mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ gbi ni amɛgbe amɛbii lɛ amɛhã amɛwɔji lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛbabule mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛbafee miwe lɛ.
"Asaŋ, amɛtsu bɔfoi kɛtee majiasɛɛ shɔŋŋ tete po ayaŋɔ hii abaha amɛ; ni kɛ amɛba lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ yei enyɔ nɛɛ juɔ amɛhe, ni amɛdikiɔ amɛhiŋmɛii asɛɛ kɛ adibri, ni amɛwulaa amɛhe kɛ jwinei.
Amɛtaa saa fɛɛfɛo nɔ, ni aŋmɛɔ okplɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ mitsofakɛŋma kɛ mimu lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ.
Anu mɛi babaoo anyamɔ gbee yɛ jɛi, ni ayaŋɔ dãatɔlɔi kɛjɛ ŋa nɔ kɛba ni amɛkɛ nineshigai bawo yei lɛ aniji, ni amɛkɛ akekrei fɛɛfɛji fimɔ amɛyitsei.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, hii ni yɛ yoo nɛɛ wɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee ajwamaŋ amɛbɔɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ amɛkɛ lɛ yawɔɔ tamɔ akɛ yoo ajwamaŋ wɔɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ amɛkɛ hiɛkɔɔ kɛ Ohola kɛ Oholiba ni ji yei nyenyeŋtswii lɛ yawɔ.
Shi kojolɔi jalɔi baabu amɛ fɔ akɛ gblãfitelɔi kɛ yei láshishwielɔi, ejaakɛ gblãfitelɔi kɛ yei láshishwielɔi ji amɛ."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Mahã asafo yuu abatua amɛ ni awo amɛhe gbeyei ní aha amɛ.
Asafo lɛ atswia amɛ tɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛklaŋtei lɛ ashwie amɛ; ni amɛaagbegbee amɛbihii kɛ biyei lɛ, ni amɛaashãshãa amɛshīai lɛ.
Nɛkɛ mafee ni mikɛku ahoshwibɔɔ naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kwraa koni akɛbɔ yei fɛɛ kwa kɔkɔ ni amɛkabɔ ajwamaŋ nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ tamɔ nyɛfee lɛ.
Ni mawo nyɛ yei enyɔ nɛɛ, nyɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛ nyɛwɔji lɛ bule lɛ he nyɔmɔ, ni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ mi, miji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa."
24: Nomŋɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ŋmãa ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ ofɔ̃ shi, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ ji gbi krɛdɛɛ nɔ ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ sa Yerusalem yi lɛ.
Buu weku ni toi agbo lɛ abɛ nɛɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Okɛ dadesɛŋ ama la nɔ, ni okɛ nu awo mli.
Okɛ loo ni aflɔ lɛ kukulii awo mli: Hei ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ eshwuɔ lɛ kɛ ekɔŋ lɛ akɛ wui ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ afata he ni eyi obɔ̃.
Ŋɔɔ too ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ ekome, too lai owo lateŋ yɛ dadesɛŋ lɛ shishi. Ha ni nu lɛ atswa, hoomɔ, ni wui lɛ tete abe."

No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Kpoo hã maŋ ni ashwieɔ lá shi yɛ emli; nakai maŋ lɛ; etamɔ dadesɛŋ ni mli edɔŋkanale, ni ŋkanale lɛ yɛ mli lolo. Klɔmɔ loi lɛ yɛ dadesɛŋ lɛ mli ekomekome, kaahala mli.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni agbe yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ alá yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lolo. Lá nɛɛ jwere tɛsaa kpataa nɔ, jeee shikpɔŋ nɔ eshwie bɔ ni akɛ su aaanyɛ aha nɔ.
Mihã mɛi ahiɛ ni akpãtã lɛ alá lɛ shwie tɛsaa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, koni akanyɛ nɔ su aha, bɔ ni afee ni etee mimlifu shi ni ehã matɔ he owele.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, kpoo ha maŋ ni ashwie lá shi yɛ emli lɛ. Mi diɛŋtsɛ hu mato laii pii mawo eshishi.
Ha lai lɛ afa, shɛremɔ la lɛ, hoomɔ loo lɛ ni ebe jogbaŋŋ, ni otsɔ̃ wonu lɛ yɛ dadesɛŋ lɛ mli; ha wui lɛ tete aŋla.
Agbɛnɛ kɛ dadesɛŋ flo lɛ ama ŋai la lɛ nɔ koni edɔ klakla, ni akɔɔble dadesɛŋ lɛ atsu hɛŋŋ, bɔ ni afee ni emli muji lɛ asere, ni ŋkanale lɛ aje kwraa.
Migbo he yaka deŋme, shi kɛ̃lɛ, emli ŋkanale titrii lɛ, lá tete nyɛɛɛ ajie.
Ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ mujinii lɛ no ji ŋkanale lɛ. Akɛni kulɛ mitsuu ohe ni ohe atse shi ohe tseee hewɔ lɛ, hii shi yɛ ohe muji lɛ mli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni matɔ mihe owele, ni mimii aaashɛ mihe.

Mi, Yehowa, miwie, ni ebaaba mli, ni mafee hu, mifɔŋ, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ, ni mishwaŋ mihe hu, bɔ ni ojeŋba yɔɔ lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni onifeemɔnii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nakai naa makojo bo yɛ; Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ." Gbalɔ lɛ ŋa gbo
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, mibaŋɔ mɔ ni ji ohiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ lɛ trukaa kɛje ohe kɛya. Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ kaawo yara, ni okafo hu, ni ohiŋmɛiŋ akakpla nu tete.
Fo yɛ osɛŋ, kaahã oyaafo je kpo ni anu yɛ onaabu. Kaafee yara ko. Okɛ obɔnduku lɛ afi oyitso, ni owo otokotai lɛ; okɛ mama ko akabla onaabu, ni kaaye yara nɔ niyenii hu."
Mikɛ maŋ lɛ wie leebi mli, ni gbɛkɛ mli lɛ, miŋa lɛ gbo. Hewɔ lɛ enɔjetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, mifee bɔ ni afã mi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ bi mi akɛ, "Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ? Ani oootsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ nɛɛ shishi?"
Mihã amɛ hetoo akɛ,

"Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, Kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Naa, mibabule mihekrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji nyɛhewalɛ ni nyɛkewoɔ nyɛhe nɔ lɛ; hekrɔŋkrɔŋ ni ji nyɛhiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ lɛ kɛ nyɛsusumai ashwee lɛ. Nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei ni nyɛshi yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, akɛ klaŋte baagbe amɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛbaafee tamɔ bɔ ni mifee mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɛɛ: Nyɛkɛ mama eblaŋ nyɛnaabui, ni nyɛyeŋ yara nɔ niyenii hu.
Nyɛbaafimɔ nyɛbɔnduku lɛ, ni nyɛtokotai lɛ aahi nyɛnaji, nyɛwoŋ yara, asaŋ nyɛfoŋ, shi moŋ yɛ nyɛnishaianii ahewɔ lɛ, nyɛaatrã loo, ni nyɛaakɛ̃mɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛhe.
Enɛ baaha Ezekiel atsɔ̃ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ahã nyɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeefee lɛ, nakai nyɛaafee. Kɛji enɛ ba mli lɛ, no dani nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa lɛ.
"Agbɛnɛ lɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbi nɔ ni mafite amɛ-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni ji amɛmiishɛɛ kɛ amɛhiɛnyam, amɛhiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ kɛ amɛtsuiŋ nitaomɔnii lɛ, ni makpãtã amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ hu ahiɛ lɛ.
nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ni lɛ lɛ ehe eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ abatswa bo adafi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ aaagble onaabu, ni okɛ mɔ ni he eje mli lɛ aaawie, ni otɔŋ mu dɔŋŋ; no hewɔ lɛ oootsɔ̃ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ oha amɛ, ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."
25: Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Amonbii lɛ, ni ogba oshi amɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ Amonbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa wiemɔ toi, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, akɛni nyɛnya, ejaakɛ abule mi-He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni afee Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aŋɔ Yuda we lɛ nom lɛ

hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ bo maha mɛi ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ni amɛye onɔ. Amɛbaafee tabilɔi ashitoohei yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, amɛbaato maji amɛhi mli yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛbaaye otsei ayibii lɛ, ni amɛaanu otsina fufɔ lɛ.
Maha Rama atsɔ̃ yomai aniyelihe, ni maha Amonbii amaji wuji lɛ baatsɔ toi atsu. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa.
"Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, akɛni otswa odɛ̃, ni otumɔ kɛ miishɛɛ, ni okɛ yiŋsha ni yɔɔ omli fɛɛ nya, ni oye Israel yɔɔ waa

hewɔ lɛ, naa, mite shi miwo bo, ni maŋɔ bo mahã jeŋmaji lɛ ni amɛha onibii. Makpãtã ohiɛ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ ateŋ; ni mafite o yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; makpãtã ohiɛ, ni ooona ole akɛ mi, miji Yehowa." Moab he gbalɛ
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, "Akɛni Moab kɛɛ akɛ, naa, Yuda tamɔ shikpɔji krokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ
hewɔ lɛ, mifite Moab anumnyam maji wuji ni buɔ ehusu nɔ lɛ. Maji nɛɛ ji Bet-Yeshimot kɛ Baal-Meon kɛ Kariataim. No baahã Moab he akã aha henyɛlɔi.
Mikɛ Moab baafata Amonbii lɛ ahe maha bokãgbɛbii lɛ ni amɛŋɔ, ni akaiŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
Mibagbla Moabbii atoi, ni amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa." Edom he gbalɛ
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɔ nɛ, akɛni Edom tɔ ehe owele yɛ Yuda we lɛ nɔ, ni yɛ oweletɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ etɔ̃ baaboo lɛ,
hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mate shi mawo Edom, ni makpãtã emli gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ hiɛ; ni mafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃; ni kɛjɛ Teman aahuu kɛyashi Dedan lɛ amɛbaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa.
Mibatsɔ̃ mimaŋ Israelbii anɔ matɔ mihe owele yɛ Edom nɔ. Israelbii kɛ Edom baaye yɛ mimlifu kɛ mimlila naa. Ni amɛaale bɔ ni mitɔɔ owele mihãa." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. Filistia he gbalɛ
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, akɛni Filistibii lɛ to yiŋsha yɛ amɛtsuiŋ ni amɛkɛtɔ mɛi ni ji amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛjɛ teteete lɛ anɔ owele, ni amɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ kwraa kɛmɔ shi
hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa mate shi mawo Filistibii lɛ, ni maplenee Kekretibii lɛ, ni makpãtã mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
Mikɛ mlifu kple baakã amɛ, ni matɔ mihe owele jogbaŋŋ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni no amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa, kɛji mitɔ mihe owele yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ."
26: Be ni wɔyɔɔ wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, akɛni Tiro kɛɛ yɛ Yerusalem he akɛ, 'Yiɛ, akumɔ maŋbii agbo lɛ, enaa kã hã mi. Ni akɛni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ nɛɛ lɛ, mibashwere!' Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ,
"Bo Tiro, naa, mikɛ o ena, ni mahã majimaji babaoo ate shi awo bo tamɔ ŋshɔkei kumɔɔ lɛ.
Amɛbaafite Tiro gbogboi lɛ, ni amɛbaakumɔ emɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ amɛshwie shi. Kɛkɛ lɛ mabɛɛ enɔ su tete, ni mafee lɛ tɛsaa kpataa.
Eeetsɔ̃ mɔ ni jeŋmaji aaaha enii.
Ni eshikpɔji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔ hu akɛ klaŋte baagbe maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ Tirobii aaana ale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, maha Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar, ni ji maŋtsɛmɛi amaŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ asraafoi babaoo ajɛ kooyigbɛ abatua Tiro.
Ekɛ klaŋte baakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ ohewɔ maji ni jwere ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ ahiɛ, eeetswa ka gbogbo ewo ohe, ni eeetswa kpoku ewo ohe; ni ekɛ tsɛŋi babaoo baaba abatua bo.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baahã akɛ gbogbokuumɔnii lɛ ashimɔ ogbogboi lɛ, ni akɛ lemai aaakumɔ omɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ.

Ekpɔŋɔi ayifalɛ sɔŋŋ naa lɛ, amɛnaneshi mlu kpɔŋŋ lɛ aaatsi onɔ. Kɛji eetsɔ̃ ogboi lɛ amli kɛbote omaŋ lɛ mli tamɔ aboteɔ maŋ ni ajwa egbogbo awo mli lɛ, ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ ablɔmɔ kɛ enigblamɔ shwiilii kɛ eta shwiilii agbɛɛmɔ naawalɛ sɔŋŋ naa lɛ ogbogboi lɛ aaahoso.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ kɛ ekpɔŋɔi lɛ akoklotoi lɛ aaanaanaa oblohuŋ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; ekɛ klaŋte aaakpãtã omaŋbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni okulashiŋi ni wa lɛ aaagbeegbee shi.
Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ baaha ojwetrii kɛ oguɔ nii ni oyɔɔ lɛ, amɛbaakumɔ ogbogboi lɛ, ni amɛbaafite oshīai fɛɛfɛji lɛ; ni tɛi lɛ kɛ tsei lɛ kɛ sū lɛ tete amɛbaaloo amɛyawo ŋshɔ mli.
Mahã olalai lɛ agbɛɛmɔ sɛɛ afo, ni anuŋ okpãa saŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ dɔŋŋ.
"Mahã otsɔ̃ tɛsaa kpataa, he ni akaa yaa yɛ. Asaŋ bo amaŋ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie.
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ Tiro nɛ, ani ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ ahe kpokpoŋ yɛ oshigbeemɔ lɛ gbeemɔ naa, be ni pilafoi miikɛ̃mɔ, ni aaakpãtã omɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ omli lɛ?

Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋshɔhiɛ lumɛi fɛɛ aaajɛ amɛsɛii anɔ akpleke shi, amɛaajie amɛtadei lɛ, amɛaakplɔ amɛheboi wuji ni alo nii awo mli lɛ, amɛaabu hekpokpomɔ tamɔ abua mama, amɛaashwata shikpɔŋ ni amɛhe baakpokpo blibli; be fɛɛ be lɛ amɛhe baajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ohewɔ.
Amɛaawo yara yɛ ohewɔ amɛaakɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Bo maŋ ni ogbɛi ehehe, ni okɛ omlibii fɛɛ hiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ hewalɛ; bo, ni ohe ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle o yɛ shikpɔŋ, te aye tɛŋŋ ni osha shi yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ nɛɛ?
Agbɛnɛ, ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ ahe miikpokpo gbi nɔ ni ogbee shi lɛ. Hɛɛ, ŋshɔkpɔi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔŋ anaa ekpɛ amɛhe yɛ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ hewɔ.'
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, kɛji mifee omaŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, tamɔ maji ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli lɛ eko, kɛji mihã ŋshɔŋ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ baha onɔ, ni nu babaoo tsimɔ onɔ lɛ,

no ni manyɛ onɔ koni okɛ mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ ayafata blemabii ni yɔɔ jɛi momo lɛ ahe. Maha bo kɛ mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ ahi shi yɛ gbohiiaje yɛ naanɔ amaŋfɔi lɛ amli, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko akahi omli dɔŋŋ, aloo ona gbɛhe ko yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu.
Maha onaagbee afee gbeyei, ni ohiŋ shi dɔŋŋ; tsɛbelɛ mɛi aaatao bo nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, anaŋ bo dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
27: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Agbɛnɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye Tiro ŋkɔmɔ,
ni okɛɛ Tiro, maŋ ni kã ŋshɔnaa, ni ekɛ ŋshɔnaa majimaji yeɔ guɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Ao Tiro, okɛɛ akɛ, 'Mihe yɛ fɛo kɛwula shi.'
Ohusu yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ. Mɛi ni kpɛ o akɛ lɛlɛ lɛ kpɛ o fɛɛfɛo kɛwula shi.
Amɛkɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ sɛsɛotsei sɔŋŋ hɛhɛ o, ni Lebanon tsenedru akɛfee oshimaatso lɛ.
Bashan tsei wuji akɛgbɔ tablɔi lɛ. Kipro tsei akɛfee odɛke, ni akɛ shwuɔ wu ka mli.
Obalaa lɛ Egipt klala fɛɛfɛo ni alo nii awo mli akɛfee; no nɔŋŋ ji oflaŋaa Onɔhaa buu lɛ, mama bluu kɛ afaseo ni akɛjɛ Kipro ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ akɛfee.
Sidonbii kɛ Arvadbii ji owirilɔi. Bo diɛŋtsɛ omli ŋaalɔi ji okudɔɔtsɛmɛi.
Gebal onukpai kɛ ŋaalɔi ni yɔɔ omli lɛ ji srɛŋkifoi ni tsimɔɔ omli fɔ̃ɔji lɛ. Ŋshɔ hiɛ lɛji kɛ amɛsraafoi fɛɛ baa omli amɛbayeɔ bo jra.
"Pershiabii kɛ Lydiabii kɛ Libiabii yɛ otabilɔi lɛ ateŋ; amɛkɛ tsɛŋ kɛ dade fai tsotsroɔ shi yɛ otabilɔi ashihilɛhei lɛ amli; amɛ amɛhãa ohiɛ baa nyam.
Arvadhii kɛ Helekhii buɔ yɛ ogbogboi lɛ anɔ kɛkpeɔ, ni Gamad hii buɔ yɛ omɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ anɔ. Amɛkɛ amɛtsɛŋi lɛ tsotsroɔ ogbogboi lɛ ahe kɛkpeɔ. Amɛ amɛhãa ohe feɔ fɛo kɛwulaa shi.
"Spainbii kɛ bo ye jra, ejaakɛ oyɛ guɔ nibii babaoo; amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ dade kɛ tsɛnsi kɛ sumui baa ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Helabii kɛ Tubalbii kɛ Meshekbii kɛ bo ye jra. Amɛkɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ akɔɔble nibii baa ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔyeli nibii lɛ.
Togramabii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi baa ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Rodobii kɛ o ye jra. Ŋshɔnaa maji babaoo kɛ o ye jra krɛdɛɛ ko; amɛ lɛ amɛkɛ shwuɔ wu kɛ ebɔnetsei bawoɔ oguɔ nibii ni amɛbaheɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ.
Siria hu kɛ o ye jra ejaakɛ oyɛ nii babaoo. Amɛkɛ karfuŋklei, mama afaseo tsuru ni alo nii awo mli, kɛ klala kpakpa, kɛ tɛ̃ŋlɛo kɛ rubitɛi baa, ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ o ye jra, amɛkɛ ŋmãa kɛ olive mu kɛ agbami kɛ wo kɛ mu kɛ tsofakɛŋma baa, ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Damasko kɛ o ye oguɔ nibii babaoo lɛ he jra. Ekɛ o ye jra yɛ guɔ nibii srɔtoisrɔtoi babaoo ni oyɔɔ lɛ ahewɔ. Ekɛ wain jɛɔ Helbon, ni akɛ toi ahetsɔi yɛŋ futaa jɛɔ Shar baa.
Amɛkɛ wain jɛɔ Uzal batsekeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ. Akɛ dade nibii kɛ kashia kɛ sinamon batsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Dedan kɛ o ye okpɔŋɔtamɔ sɛ̃i nɔ mama jra.
Arabiabii kɛ Kedar lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ ji mɛi ni osumɔ amɛ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii kɛ ojwɛnii kɛ abotiai ajrayeli jogbaŋŋ.
Sheba kɛ Rama jrayelɔi kɛ o ye jra. Amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋmai fɛɛ mli ekpakpai kɛ tɛi ni jra wa fɛɛ kɛ shika baa batsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Haran kɛ Kane kɛ Eden kɛ Sheba kɛ Ashur kɛ Kilmad kɛo ye jra.
Maji nɛɛ kɛ o ye atadei kpakpai kɛ mama bluu ni alo nii awo mli atadei, kɛ tsu mli kapɛtii ni hiɛ sui srɔtoi ni akɛ taŋkpee kpãa efimɔ mli kpɛŋŋ jra.
Spain lɛji lɛ woɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, otamɔ lɛlɛ ni awo lɛ nii obɔ̃ yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ.
Mɛi ni wiriɔ bo lɛ kɛ bo etee ŋshɔ teŋ tɔ̃ɔ; shi bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ ejwara o yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ.
Oshika kɛ oguɔnii kɛ ojrayelinii kɛ osrafoi kɛ okudɔɔtsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni tsimɔɔ ofɔji lɛ, kɛ oguɔyelɔi kɔ otabilɔi fɛɛ kɛ osafo muu fɛɛ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ shiu yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ, yɛ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Be ni okudɔɔtsɛmɛi lɛ blɔ waa lɛ, shikpɔŋ hoso
ni wirilɔi lɛ fɛɛ kpleke shi kɛjɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli. Asrɛfoi lɛ kɛ kudɔɔtsɛmɛi lɛ badamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Amɛwo ohe yara ni amɛfo bo waa. Amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteŋ ni amɛkoklo lamlu mli.
Amɛshɛ amɛyi yɛ ohewɔ, ni amɛbu kpekpe. Amɛwo yara, ni amɛfo bo waa kɛ dɔlɛ naakpa.
Yɛ amɛlelewɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ amɛwo yaafo lala amɛkɛfo bo akɛ, 'Namɔ akpãtã ehiɛ pɛŋ yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ tamɔ Tiro?
Be ni akɛ oguɔ nibii jɛ ŋshɔŋ kɛba lɛ oha mɛi pii trɔ; onii ni ona babaoo kɛ ojrayeli nibii lɛ, oha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi na nii.
Agbɛnɛ, ŋshɔ ejwara o, ni oshiu kɛtee ŋshɔ shishi; oguɔ nibii kɛ osrafoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ bo eshiu.'
"Ŋshɔnaa majiaŋbii fɛɛ ahe ejɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ohewɔ, ni gbeyei ni naa wa emɔmɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ hu efee amɛ yaa.
Majimaji anɔ jrayelɔi miibo bo 'Tsiaa', ejaakɛ onaagbee lɛ efee gbeyei, ni olaaje kɛmiiya naanɔ."
28: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ,

"Gbɔmɔ Adesa kɛɛmɔ Tiro lumɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, 'Owoɔ ohe nɔ ni otsɛɔ ohe nyɔŋmɔ,' Okɛɔ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, ni mita nyɔŋmɔi lɛ alumɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔteŋ;' tsɛbelɛ gbɔmɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji bo, shi jeee nyɔŋmɔ ko. Tsebelɛ obuɔ ohe akɛ ole nii tamɔ nɔ ni nyɔŋmɔ ji o.
Efeɔ bo akɛ ole nii fe Daniel, ni teemɔŋ sane ko bɛ ni oleee.
Onilee kɛ oniiashishinumɔ eha ona nii; ona shika kɛ jwɛitɛi owo ofotroi amli.
Jrayeli he nilee kple ni oyɔɔ eha onii ni oyɔɔ efa baaboo; ni oninamɔ lɛ eha oowo ohe nɔ.
"No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ; akɛni efeɔ bo akɛ ole nii tamɔ nyɔŋmɔ ko
hewɔ lɛ, naa, mahã gbɔi amaji lɛ ateŋ maŋ ni he yɔɔ gbeyei fe fɛɛ, abatua bo; amɛkɛ klaŋte aaabakpãtã nibii fɛɛfɛji ni okɛ onilee na lɛ ahiɛ, amɛaahã onumnyam aaaba shi.
Amɛbaanyɛ onɔ amɛwo gbohiiaje bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni obaagbo, obaagbo mɛi ni gboiɔ yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ lɛ agbele lɛ eko.
Be ni oyɔɔ mɛi ni gbeɔ bo lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, ani ooonyɛ okɛɛ akɛ 'Nyɔŋmɔ ko ji mi?' Be mli ni gbɔmɔ kɛkɛ ji bo., shi ojeee nyɔŋmɔ ko lɛ?
Obaatsɔ̃ gbɔi anine nɔ ni ogbo foolɔi agbele, ejaakɛ mi, miwie. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ." Tiro Maŋtsɛ lɛ butumɔ
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye Tiro maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, koni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ; bo lɛ, osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ, ole nii jogbaŋŋ, ni ohe yɛ fɛo kɛwula shi.

Ohi Eden, Nyɔŋmɔ abɔɔ lɛ mli. Okɛ tɛ fɛɛ tɛ ni jra wa wula ohe: ojrawatɛi ni ji, rubi kɛ daiamɔnd kɛ topasion kɛ beril kɛ sardio kɛ yaspi kɛ safiro kɛ ɛmɛraldo kɛ gaanɛt. Oyɛ fabii kɛ bɛji ni ashwie amɛhe shika. Gbi nɔ ni abɔ bo lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ afee amɛ ahã o.
Miha mibɔfo ni mifɔ lɛ mu bu ohe; ohi shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni onyiɛ tɛi ni tsoɔ tamɔ la ateŋ.
Kɛjɛ be ni abɔ o lɛ shwamɔ ko bɛ ojeŋba he kɛyashi obɔi efɔŋfeemɔ.
Ojrayeli shweremɔ hewɔ lɛ awuyeli yi bo obɔ̃, ni ofee esha; ni no hewɔ ni mishwie bo kɛje Nyɔŋmɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni bɔfo ni buɔ ohe lɛ shwie bo kɛje tɛi ni tsoɔ tamɔ la lɛ ateŋ.
Owo ohe ejaakɛ ohe yɛ fɛo. Onilee ha ofee onii tamɔ buulu. Miŋɔ bo mitswa shi; miŋmɛ bo yayai yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ koni amɛkwɛ o.
Onishaianii lɛ afalɛ yɛ ojrayeli mli anɔkwa ni oyeee lɛ, okɛbule ohei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. Mihã la je yɛ omli ni eshã bo wɛɛ, ni mihã otsɔ̃ lamlu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni na bo lɛ ahiɛ.
Ni Maji ni le o fɛɛ she gbeyei, ejaakɛ onaagbee yɛ gbeyei, ni olaaje kɛmiiya naanɔ." Gbalɛ ni shiɔ Sidon
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oha Sidon koni ogba oshi lɛ akɛ,
bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, bo Sidon, naa mikɛ bo ena, ni mawo mihiɛ nyam yɛ ohewɔ, ni omaŋbii kɛaale akɛ miji Yehowa, kɛji migbla mɛi ni yɔɔ omli lɛ atoi ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ miha lɛ.

Ejaakɛ mibaha gbele hela abote omli, ni maha ashwie lá shi yɛ oblohui lɛ amli. Gbohii aaajwere shi yɛ oblohui lɛ amli; mɛi aaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte ni akɛjɛ okoji anɔ fɛɛ naa. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa." Aaajɔɔ Israel
"Maji ni bɔle Israel we lɛ, ni amɛbɔ lɛ ahora lɛ ateŋ eko eteŋ shi epilaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ, tamɔ ŋmei loo aklati. No amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa."

Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Kɛji mibua Israel we lɛ naa kɛjɛ majimaji ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ amli, ni miwo mihiɛ nyam kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, no lɛ, amɛaahi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã mitsulɔ Yakob lɛ.

Amɛbaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe, amɛbaamamɔ tsui, ni amɛbaafee waintromii. Amɛbaahi shi shweshweeshwe be ni magbla majimaji ni bɔle amɛ, mɛi ni bɔ amɛ ahora lɛ atoi lɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."
29: Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ afii nyɔŋma lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo Farao, Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ogba oshi lɛ kɛ Egipt muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ,
bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mi kɛ bo ena, bo Farao ni ji, Egipt Maŋtsɛ, bo baa wulu kple ni yɔɔ efaai lɛ amli ni oshwãa okɛɔ akɛ, 'Nilo Faa lɛ, minɔ ni, ni mi mibɔ mihã mihe.'
Mikɛ kpoŋ baala okadaa, ni mahã ofaa lɛ mli loi lɛ akpɛtɛ ohetotoi lɛ ahe; ni magbla bo kɛjɛ ofaa lɛ mli kɛ faa lɛ mli loi lɛ fɛɛ ni kpɛtɛ ohetotoi lɛ ahe lɛ kɛba.
Mibashɛ bo mafɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ, bo okɛ oloi ni jɛ ofaa lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ. Obaaya oyagbee ŋa kplanaa nɔ, ni awoŋ bo, ni afuŋ bo hu. Mikɛ bo eha shikpɔŋ kooloi kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji ni amɛye o.
Enɛ baaha Egiptbii fɛɛ ana ale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa; ejaakɛ amɛtsɔmɔ glã amɛhã Israel we lɛ."
"Be ni amɛkɛ amɛnine mɔ omli lɛ, omli kumɔ, ni okplɔ amɛkoji fɛɛ; be ni amɛkpasa bo lɛ, oku, ni amɛhɛ lɔŋe.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mafã klaŋte mawo bo, ni maplenee omli gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ.
Ni maha Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ olɛŋlɛ. No Egiptbii kɛaale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa. Akɛni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Nilo Faa lɛ minɔ ni, ni mi mibɔ lɛ,'

no hewɔ lɛ, naa, mi kɛ o ena, ni mikɛ ofaa Nilo lɛ hu ena; ni mafee Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ olɛŋlɛ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kwraa, kɛjɛ Migdol ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ kɛyashi Aswan ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ aahuu kɛyashi Sudan husui anɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ ni kooloo ko hu tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ. Ahiŋ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ.

Mafee Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ shikpɔji amaŋfɔ̃i amli amaŋfɔ̃; ni emaji wuji lɛ hu aaatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ maji ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ ateŋ. Mashwie Egiptbii lɛ mawo majimaji lɛ anɔ ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ."
Hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, "Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mabua Egiptbii lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ mɛi ateŋ ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ.
Makpale Egiptbii lɛ, ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba Patros ni ji Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni amɛaahi jɛi akɛ mɛi ni aba amɛlumɔyeli shi.
Ebaatsɔ̃ maŋtsɛyelii lɛ atɛŋ nɔ ni aba lɛ shi fe fɛɛ, ni ewoŋ ehe nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ. Ni maha ehewalɛ nɔ agbɔ bɔ ni eyeŋ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ lumɔ dɔŋŋ.

Egipt efeŋ maŋ bɔ ni Israel we lɛ kɛ ehe baafɔ̃ enɔ dɔŋŋ, bɔ ni aaafee Egipt ahã lɛ, eeehã Israel we lɛ akai akɛ etɔ̃ akɛ eyabi Egipt dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ. No Israel kɛaale akɛ mi, miji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa." Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baaye Egipt nɔ kunim
Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,

"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hã etabilɔi lɛ gbo deŋme ni naa wa yɛ Tiro tuamɔ hewɔ. Ewebii lɛ tsu nii waa ni yiteŋ fɛɛ yiteŋ kpa, ni kɔŋ fɛɛ kɔŋ nɔ kplɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ nãaa nɔ ko kɛjɛɛɛ Tiro akɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo yɛ amɛdeŋme ni amɛgbo yɛ Tiro tuamɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ mli.

Agbɛnɛ, bɔ ni mi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mi kɛɔ nɛ, naa Mikɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar dɛŋ; ni ebaaha emli nii, ni ebaakpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni emli jwetri lɛ ekɛbaaya; ni no baatsɔ̃ etabilɔi lɛ anyɔmɔwo.
Mikɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ eha lɛ akɛ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ he nyɔmɔwo, ejaakɛ mi etsu nii lɛ eha." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ maha hewalɛtsɛ ko ate shi yɛ Israel we lɛ ni magble bo Ezekiel onaa ni owie yɛ amɛteŋ. No amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."
30: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛwɔa lele! Kpoo hã nakai gbi lɛ.
Gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, Yehowa gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. Gbi lɛ aaafee oblɔtu gbi. Eeefee majimaji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ be.
Aaafã klaŋte awo Egipt ni ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ mɛi yɛ Sudan. Mɛi baanyɔnyɔi yɛ Egipt, ni abaaloo enii babaoo ni eyɔɔ lɛ kɛya; ni abaafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
"Akɛ klaŋte baaplenee Sudanbii kɛ Lydiabii kɛ Libiabii kɛ Arabbii kɛ Kubbii kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ hu ni kɛ Egipt efee ekome lɛ.

"Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni fi Egipt sɛɛ lɛ aaaplene, ni ehewalɛ ni ekɛshwãa lɛ baaba shi kɛjɛ Migdol ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashi Aswan yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa. Mi Yehowa miwie.
Eshikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔji ni ji amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli amaŋfɔ̃, ni emaji wuji lɛ hu baafata maji wuji ni abutu amɛ lɛ ahe.
Kɛji mima Egipt naa la mishã, ni mikpãtã mɛi ni ye bua lɛ lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, no amɛkɛaale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa.

"Gbi nɔ ni mafite Egipt lɛ, matsu tsuji kɛtsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli ni amɛyawo Sudanbii ni kpaaa ta ko gbɛ lɛ ahe gbeyei. Egipt butumɔ lɛ baahã ŋmiŋmi amɔmɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ, naa, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ baana aba.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, matsɔ̃ Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, nine nɔ mafo Egipt ninamɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ.
Lɛ kɛ emɛi lɛ ji maŋ ni he yɔɔ gbeyei fe maji fɛɛ. Amɛbaaba amɛbakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; amɛbaafã klaŋte amɛwo Egipt, ni amɛbaahã gbohii ayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ.
Ni mahã Nilo Faa lɛ amii; ni mikɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo mɛi fɔ̃ɔji adɛŋ. Matsɔ̃ mɛi kpɔ̃ji anine nɔ, ni mahã shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni mafite nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Mafite amɛmɔji lɛ; ni mahã akumɔ amɛmãgãi ni yɔɔ Memfis lɛ. Ayeŋ lumɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ Egipt, ni mahã Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aba gbeyei.
Mahã Patros, ni yɔɔ Egipt wuoyigbɛ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ni mawo lɛ mashã Zoan ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ; ni magbla Tebes maŋ wulu lɛ toi.
Mimli baawo la waa awo Pelusium ni ji Egipt mɔ̃ɔ ni wa lɛ, ni maplenee asafo yuu ni yɔɔ Tebis lɛ.
Mawo la mashã Egipt, ni Pelusium baakɛ̃mɔ. Abaawule ni akumɔ Tebes gbogboi lɛ ashwie shi.
Oblahii ni yɔɔ Heliopolis kɛ Bubatis baanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa, ni aaaŋɔ amɛyei lɛ nom.
Duŋ baawo shwane yɛ Tehafnehes, gbi nɔ ni mafite Egipt nɔyeli hewalɛ lɛ, ni ehewalɛ ni ekɛwoɔ ehe lɛ sɛɛ baafo. Atatu ko baaha Egipt nɔ, ni abaaŋɔ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ nom.
Bɔ ni magbla Egipt toi maha nɛ, ni no ekɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa." Egipt Maŋtsɛ hewalɛ fitemɔ
Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, miku Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nine; ni naa, akɛ flanɔfii mama efiko nɔ, koni etsa ni emli awa bɔ ni eeenyɛ klaŋte mli emɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ Farao ni ji, Egipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ena, ni makumɔ eniji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni akumɔ momo lɛ fɛɛ, ni maha klaŋte lɛ aje edɛŋ agbee shi.
Mashwie Egiptbii lɛ mawo majimaji lɛ anɔ, ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ni mawo Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ, ni mikɛ miklaŋte lɛ baawo edɛŋ; shi Farao lɛ, lɛ lɛ maku enine, ni eeekɛ̃mɔ yɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ tamɔ mɔ ni apila lɛ gbele nɔ.
Mawaje Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, shi Farao niji aaakplɔ; ni amɛaale akɛ mi, miji, Yehowa. Kɛji mikɛ miklaŋte lɛ wo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, eeefã ewo Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Mashwie Egiptbii lɛ mawo majimaji lɛ anɔ ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ; ni amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa,"
31: Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, bi Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, Namɔ nyɛtamɔ yɛ agbojee mli?
Naa, nyɛtamɔ Asiria, ni mikɛ miito Lebanon tsenedru kɛ eniji fɛɛfɛji kɛ eshishi hɔɔŋ, tso grɔŋŋ ni eyiteŋ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ he.
Ena nu, shikpɔŋ ofɔ̃ ehã eda, ni ekwɔ grɔŋŋ Faai lɛ hã he ni etɛo tso lɛ yɛ lɛ nu, ni nu lɛ gbla niji kɛtee kooŋ tsei lɛ fɛɛ ashishi.
Akɛni ena nu hewɔ lɛ ekwɔ fe kooŋ tsei lɛ fɛɛ. Eniji wuji lɛ dra, ni eniji bibii lɛ klɛ; ejaakɛ eshishi fãi lɛ na nu babaoo.
Ŋwɛi loofɔji fɛɛ fee amɛtsui yɛ eniji wuji lɛ ateŋ, ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ fɔ amɛbii yɛ eniji bibii ashishi; ni eshishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli jeŋmaji wuji fɛɛ hi.
Edalɛ lɛ yɛ fɛɔ naakpa. Eniji bibii aklɛmɔ hu yɛ akɔnɔ, ejaakɛ eshishi fãi lɛ tee shikpɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ kɛyanina nu pii.

Tsenedrui ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ trom lɛ mli lɛ, ekoeko kɛ lɛ yeee egbɔ; sɛsɛo lɛ kɛ eniji wuji lɛ yeee egbɔ, ni papaoi lɛ jeee fɛifɛi kɛ okɛ amɛto bibii lɛ ahe. Tso ko tso ko bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ trom lɛ mli ni kɛ lɛ ye egbɔ kɛ he fɛo.
Mi mifee, ni mihã eniji bibii lɛ abumɔ hã ehe fee fɛo lɛ, ni Eden tsei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ trom lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ kɔ̃ enɔ.
"No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, akɛni ekwɔ grɔŋŋ, ni eyiteŋ shɛ atatuiaŋ hewɔ lɛ, efee ŋtɛŋ;
hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ ewo jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ eko ni he wa lɛ dɛŋ; ekɛ lɛ aye waa; bɔ ni sa eyitsoŋwalɛ lɛ. Ejaakɛ mishwie lɛ.

Gbɔi ni ji jeŋ majimaji lɛ ateŋ yiwalɔi ni fe fɛɛ lɛ too lɛ fɔ̃ shi, ni amɛshi lɛ. Eniji bibii lɛ shwie gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ jɔɔi lɛ amli, ni eniji wuji lɛ kumɔ shwie nujɔɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli. Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mɛi fɛɛ bashi ehɔɔŋ lɛ mli amɛtee.
Ŋwɛi loofɔji basɔ̃mɔ etsokuku ni eshwɛ lɛ nɔ; ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ banyiɛ eniji bibii lɛ anɔ.

Afee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni tso fɛɛ tso ni ma shi yɛ faa toi akakwɔ kakadaŋŋ, ni ebai yashɛ atatuiaŋ nɛkɛ dɔŋŋ; bɔ ni afee ni tso fɛɛ tso ni shishifã naa nu lɛ akakwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi kɛyanina amɛ. Ejaakɛ aŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ ahã gbele; akɛ amɛ eshi gbɔmɛi adesai kɛ mɛi hu ni yaa gbohiiaje lɛ anɔ.

"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, kɛ ekpleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje lɛ, mahã bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ awo yara yɛ ehewɔ ni matsi efaai lɛ anaa, ni nu ko nu ko hoŋ. Mahã Lebanon gɔji lɛ anɔ awo duŋ, ni ŋa nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ baatɔ biti yɛ ehewɔ.

Kɛ mitsi lɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ ayisɛɛ miwo gbohiiaje bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Mahã majimaji lɛ ahoso yɛ eshigbeemɔ gbɛɛmɔ lɛ naa. Eden tsei fɛɛ kɛ Lebanon tsei kpakpai ni he fe fɛɛ lɛ ni naa nu kpakpa lɛ amii baashɛ amɛhe yɛ gbohiiaje.
Amɛ hu amɛkɛ lɛ baaya gbohiiaje kɛyanina mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ. Hɛ̃ɛ! Nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni hi tso lɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.

"Belɛ yɛ anumnyam kɛ agbojee gbɛfaŋ lɛ, namɔ po otamɔ yɛ Eden tsei lɛ ateŋ? Aaatoo bo kɛ Eden tsei krokomɛi lɛ, ni akɛ nyɛ baawo gbohiiaje; ni oookã foolɔi kɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ ateŋ. Bɔ ni Farao kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ anaagbee baatamɔ nɛ." Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ.
32: Yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ Obuɔ ohe akɛ jata ko yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, shi moŋ, otamɔ báa yɛ faa mli, otswaa aŋmɔ yɛ onui lɛ amli, okɛ onaji taa nu mli ni okpɔtɔɔ fai lɛ.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, maŋmɛ onɔ adrã yaa yɛ majimaji ateŋ, ni aaagbla o kɛba shia nɔ.
Mashɛ o mafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ; ni mafɔ̃ o mashɛ mafɔ shikpɔŋ kplanaa nɔ, ni mahã ŋwɛi loofɔji abasɔmɔ onɔ, ni mahã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kooloi aye o amɛtrɔ.
Mikɛ oheloo baashwã gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛ ogbohii lɛ aaawo jɔɔi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Mikɛ olá ni hoɔ lɛ baafɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ kɛyashi gɔji lɛ anɔ tete, ni olá lɛ aayi nujɔɔi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Kɛji mikpãtã ohiɛ lɛ, mahã ŋwɛi hiɛ aha, ni eŋulamii lɛ awo duŋ. Mikɛ atatu aaaha hulu lɛ hiɛ, ni nyɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ.
Magbe ŋwɛi kanei ala ni kpɛɔ lɛ yɛ onɔ; ni mahã duŋ awo yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Kɛji mikpãtã ohiɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mikpla bo kɛtee shikpɔji ni oleee anɔ lɛ, no baahã mɛi pii atuii aye.

Kɛji mifɔ̃fɔ̃ɔ miklaŋte lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ, mahã majimaji pii ahe ajɔ̃ amɛhe ni ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu yɛ ohewɔ. Gbi nɔ ni ooogbee shi lɛ amɛteŋ amɛhe, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he aaakpokpo hiŋmɛitswaa fɛɛ hiŋmitswaa, amɛtɛŋ fɛɛ mɔ he aaakpokpo yɛ ewala hewɔ.
"Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ Egipt nɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ kɛ eklaŋte aaabatua bo.

Mahã asraafoi kãkãlɔi kɛ klaŋte abakpãtã omaŋbii babaoo lɛ ahiɛ; asraafoi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, yiwalɔi fe fɛɛ ni jɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ ji amɛ. Amɛbaafite nibii ahewɔ ni Egipt wo ehe lɛ, ni abaakpãtã maŋbii kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Maplenee emli shīa kooloi fɛɛ kɛaajɛ faai lɛ anaa. Ni gbɔmɔ nane ko etaŋ mli dɔŋŋ; asaŋ shīa kooloi akoklotoi etaŋ mli dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mahã amɛnu fɛɛ nu hiɛ atɛ̃, ni mahã amɛfai lɛ aho nyaa tamɔ mū. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Kɛji mifee Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni mikpãtã emli nii fɛɛ hiɛ, ni miplenee emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, no dani amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa.
Nɛkɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ yarefeemɔ lala, ni majimaji lɛ amli biyei lɛ baala amɛkɛfo Egipt kɛ emlibii babaoo lɛ. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ."
Yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, fo Egipt kɛ emaŋbii babaoo lɛ, mɛi ni abaatsirɛ amɛ kɛ maji wuji abiyei lɛ hu awo gbohiiaje kɛyafata mɛi ni etee gbohiiaje momo lɛ ahe lɛ.
Bi akɛ 'Ohe yɛ fɛo fe namɔ?' Kplekemɔ shi kɛya gbohiiaje ni akɛ o anyaŋmɛ foolɔi lɛ amasɛi!
Egiptbii lɛ baafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ ahe, ni aaafu emɛi babaoo lɛ afata ehe.
Egipt kãkãlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni wa amɛ yɛ ta mli lɛ baakɛɛ yɛ amɛhe yɛ gbohiiaje akɛ, 'Foolɔi lɛ ni nyɔ yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ ekpleke shi kɛba gbohiiaje, ni amɛkamɔ shi diŋŋ!'
"Asiria yɛ jɛi ni esafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ asaŋi ebɔle lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ klaŋte naa amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ.
Amɛsaŋi lɛ yɛ gbohiiaje teŋteŋ tɔ̃ɔ, asafo lɛ asaŋi lɛ ebɔle lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esaŋ lɛ he kɛkpe; amɛ mɛi ni amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, klaŋte naa amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ.

"Elam yɛ jɛi ni esafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ asaŋi ebɔle lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ klaŋte naa amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ. Foolɔi ni kpleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje ni. Amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, agbɛnɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi.

Elam kã mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ ateŋ. Esafo yuu lɛ asaŋi lɛ ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ foolɔi ni, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa. Amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; agbɛnɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaaa gbohiiajeŋ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi. Amɛkamɔ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔi lɛ ateŋ.
"Meshek kɛ Tubal yɛ jɛi, kɛ amɛsafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛsaŋi lɛ ebɔle amɛhe kɛkpe. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ foolɔi ni, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa; ejaakɛ amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

"Amɛ lɛ, afuuu amɛ tamɔ afu blema kãkãlɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kpleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje kɛ amɛtawuunii lɛ; mɛi ni ahã amɛtsɔle amɛtawuu klaŋtei, ni akɛ amɛtsɛŋi eshwie amɛnɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ kãkãlɔi nɛɛ ehã ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pɛŋ.
Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, bo Egipt, abaakumɔ bo, ni oooyakã foolɔi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ ateŋ.
"Edom yɛ jɛi; emaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ elumɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi. Mɛi ni yɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛkamɔ mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ ateŋ. Amɛ hu amɛkamɔ foolɔi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiajeŋ lɛ ateŋ.

"Kooyigbɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ Sidonbii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi. Amɛmɛi ni amɛhe he wa lɛ hã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛkɛ mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ hu fɛɛ etee gbohiiajeŋ kɛ hiɛgble. Foolɔi ni kɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ kamɔ shi, ni amɛkɛ mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiajeŋ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi.
"Kɛji Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ na amɛ lɛ emii aaashɛ ehe yɛ esafo yuu lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ esafo yuu lɛ hu nyɔŋyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Akɛni ehã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, abaafu lɛ kɛ esafo yuu lɛ ashi foolɔi kɛ mɛi ni akɛ klaŋte gbegbee amɛ yɛ ta mli anɔ. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ."
33: Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛ omaŋbii lɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji mihã ta ba shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fã amɛteŋ mɔ kome akɛ bulɔ,
ni ena akɛ ta miiba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ kɛtswa maŋ lɛ adafi lɛ,
no lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni ebooo adafitswaa lɛ toi lɛ, kɛji ta lɛ banina lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, elá abua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ.
Ejaakɛ enu tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ, shi ebooo adafitsswaa lɛ toi; elá abua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ayiteŋ. Eji ebo adafitswaa lɛ toi kulɛ eeehere eyiwala.

Shi kɛji bulɔ lɛ na ta lɛ miiba, ni ekpãaa tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni etswaaa maŋ lɛ adafi, ni ta lɛ ba ni mɔ ko tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, no lɛ, mɔ ni gbo lɛ, egbo yɛ enishaianii ahewɔ moŋ nɛ, shi mabi elá shi yɛ bulɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
"No hewɔ lɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mito bo bulɔ mihã Israel we lɛ. Be fɛɛ be ni ooonu wiemɔ ko kɛaajɛ minaa lɛ, bɔɔ amɛ kɔkɔ oha mi.

Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, 'Bo efɔŋfeelɔ, gbo ooogbo!' Ni owieee obɔɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekpale kɛje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ; nakai efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ, eeegbo yɛ enishaianii lɛ ahewɔ moŋ nɛ, shi mabi elá shi yɛ odɛŋ.
Shi kɛji obɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekpale kɛje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ ekpaleee lɛ, eeegbo yɛ enishaianii lɛ ahewɔ, shi bo lɛ ooohere oyiwala." Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nifeemɔnii kɛ ehe nyɔmɔwoo
"Agbɛnɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ nɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ pɛŋ ji akɛ, 'Wɔtɔmɔi lɛ kɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ miisu wɔtsui, ni ehã wɔfrã loo. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ, ni wɔyi ana wala hu?'

Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ gbii abɔ ni mi, miji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, minaaa efɔŋfeelɔ gbele he miishɛɛ; shi moŋ minaa miishɛɛ kɛji efɔŋfeelɔ tsake ejeŋba, ni eyi na wala. Ao Israel we, nyɛkpalea, nyɛ kpalea kɛjea nyɛgbɛi fɔɔji lɛ anɔ koni nyɛyi ana wala. Mɛni hewɔ nyɛaagboi?

"No hewɔ lɛ bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ omaŋbii lɛ akɛ jalɔ lɛ ejalɛ nyɛŋ lɛ ajie kɛji etɔ̃; ni kɛji efɔŋfeelɔ hu kpa efɔŋfeemɔ lɛ, adamɔŋ efɔŋ ni efee momo lɛ nɔ ni abu lɛ fɔ. Ni jalɔ hu etsutsu jalɛ haŋ eyi ana wala kɛji efee esha.,
Kɛ mikɛɛ jalɔ akɛ eyi aaana wala, ni ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ ejalɛ lɛ nɔ, ni efee esha lɛ, ejalɛnii fɛɛ ni efee kɛho lɛ, akaiŋ ekoeko; shi moŋ ebaagbo yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Asaŋ, kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ 'Gbo kɛ̃ ooogbo,' ni ekpa eshafeemɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ja ni ehi lɛ,
kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ kpale nɔ ni akɛbato lɛ awaba eha nɔtsɛ, ni ekpale nɔ ni ekɛ ojotswaa shɔ̃ lɛ ehã; kɛji eye mlai ni hãa wala lɛ anɔ, ni efeee efɔŋ lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ.
Esha fɛɛ esha ni efee kɛho lɛ akɛ ekoeko ebuŋ lɛ fɔ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ eyi aaana wala, egboŋ.
"Shi, omaŋbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ ejaaa;' tsɛbelɛ amɛ moŋ, nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ni ejaaa.
Kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ ni efee efɔŋ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ no hewɔ.
Ni kɛji efɔŋfeelɔ fɔ̃ɔ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ja ni ehi lɛ, eyi baana wala.
Kɛ̃lɛ, nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ ejaaa.' Bo Israel we, makojo nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enifeemɔnii anaa." Yerusalem fitemɔ he adafitswaa
Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nuu ko ni ejo foi kɛjɛ Yerusalem ba miŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ mi akɛ abutu maŋ lɛ.
Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ gbɛkɛ, ni mitɔ mu dani foijelɔ lɛ ba, shi leebi mli be ni foijelɔ lɛ ba miŋɔɔ lɛ, agble minaa ni mitɔko mu dɔŋŋ. Esha ni maŋbii feɔ
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, maŋbii ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, 'Abraham lɛ, gbɔmɔ kometoo ni, kɛ̃lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ enɔ, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔyi fa; akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eha wɔ akɛ wɔŋɔ.'
"No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛyeɔ loo ni emli lá tsereko; ni amãgã jamɔ kɔ̃ɔ nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛshwieɔ lá shi; aso shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ kɛ̃?
Nyɛfãa klaŋte nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe, nyɛfeɔ musubɔɔnii; nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo ŋa bɔɔ ajwamaŋ; Aso shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ kɛ̃?

"Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi, miji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ akɛ klaŋte baakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli lɛ ahiɛ, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa kplanaa nɔ lɛ, maŋɔ lɛ maha ŋaŋ kooloi ni amɛye. Mɛi ni yɔɔ mɔji kɛ tɛkpoji amli lɛ, gbele hela aaagbe amɛ.
Makpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni ebaatsō amaŋfɔ̃; ni ehewalɛ ni ekɛshwãa lɛ sɛɛ baafo; ni Isreal gɔji lɛ anɔ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ.
Amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, miji Yehowa, kɛji mikpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ musubɔɔnii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ." Gbalɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ sane
"Shi bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, omaŋbii lɛ wieɔ ohe yɛ gbogboi ahe kɛ shīai ashinai ashi, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɔ amɛhe akɛ, 'Nyɛbaa nyɛbaboa nɔ wiemɔ ni jɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ toi.'
