Ni amɛbuaa amɛhenaa kɛbaa oŋɔɔ akɛ maŋ, ni amɛbatraa ohiɛ akɛ mimaŋbii, ni amɛboɔ owiemɔ lɛ toi, shi amɛyeee nɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛsumɔɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ amɛnaabu, shi amɛkɛ amɛtsui fɔɔ amɛsɛɛnamɔ nɔ.
Shi, naa, bo lɛ otamɔ mɔ ko kɛkɛ ni kɛ gbee ni ŋɔɔ laa suɔmɔ lalai, ni etswaa saŋku jogbaŋŋ ohã amɛ. Ejaakɛ amɛnuɔ owiemɔ lɛ nɛ, shi amɛyeŋ nɔ.
Kɛ enɛ ba mli lɛ, naa, ebaana eba mli kɛ̃, no dani amɛkɛaale akɛ gbalɔ ko ehi amɛteŋ pɛŋ."
34: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi Israel tookwɛlɔi lɛ. Gbaa ni okɛɛ amɛ, amɛ mɛi ni ji maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, ni amɛji tookwɛlɔi lɛ. Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Ao, nyɛ Israel tookwɛlɔi ni nyɛlɛɔ nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛhe. Ani esaaa akɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ alɛ toi lɛ?
"Nyɛyeɔ amɛfɔ, ni nyɛkɛ amɛhetsɔi feɔ mama nyɛbuɔ, ni nyɛgbeɔ nii ni eshwishwii lɛ nyɛyeɔ; shi nyɛlɛɛɛ toi lɛ.

Toi ni egbɔjɔ lɛ, nyɛwajeee amɛ; nii ni he yeɔ lɛ, nyɛtsaaa amɛ; nii ni epila lɛ nyɛfimɔɔɔ amɛpilamɔi lɛ anɔ; nii ni edu gbɛ lɛ, nyɛyakplaaa amɛ kɛbaaa shīa; ni nii ni elaaje lɛ nyɛyataooo amɛ; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nɔnyɛɛ kɛ yiwalɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛgbɛ amɛshwã ejaakɛ amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ niyenii amɛha ŋaŋ kooloi awuyelɔi fɛɛ.
Mitoi lɛ gbɛ shwã, ni amɛtsomlo kɛnyiɛ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpoi ni kwɔlɔ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Mitoi lɛ egbɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni diɔ amɛsɛɛ aloo etaoɔ amɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ nyɛ tookwɛlɔi, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.

Mitoi lɛ etsɔ̃ milɛloo; amɛtsɔmɔ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ aniyenii; amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ ejaakɛ mitookwɛlɔi lɛ ayataooo amɛ; shi moŋ amɛyeɔ nii amɛtɔɔ, shi amɛlɛɛɛ mitoi lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ gbii abɔ ni mi, miji Yehowa Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ,
nyɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.

Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ ena, ni mabi mitoi lɛ ashi kɛjɛ amɛdɛŋ. Magu amɛ toi lɛ akwɛmɔ, ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ elɛŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe dɔŋŋ. Mahe mitoi lɛ yɛ amɛ dɛŋ koni amɛkana amɛ amɛye dɔŋŋ." Tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, mi, mi diɛŋtsɛ madi mitoi lɛ asɛɛ ni matao amɛsɛɛgbɛ.
Bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ taoɔ etooku ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ matao mitoi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ. Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã kɛtee, yɛ gbi ni atatu kɛ duŋ kpii ewo nɔ tete.

Maŋɔ amɛ kɛaajɛ majimaji anɔ bii ateŋ, ni mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; ni maŋɔ amɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Malɛ amɛ yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ gɔji ateaŋ jɔi lɛ amli kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shihilɛhei fɛɛ.
Mikɛ jwɛfɔ kpakpa aaalɛ amɛ; Israel gɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ anɔ aaafee amɛniyelihe. Amɛaabumɔ shi yɛ niyelihe kpakpa shikpɔŋ nɔ; ni Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni jwɛfɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ yɔɔ lɛ amɛaayɛ nii yɛ.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mafee mitoi lɛ akwɛlɔ, ni mahã amɛbumɔ shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.

"Too fɛɛ too ni elaaje lɛ, matao lɛ, ni nɔ ni edu gbɛ lɛ, makpla lɛ kɛba shīa; ni nɔ ni epila lɛ, mafi epilamɔ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ mawaje lɛ. Nɔ ni ewo fɔ, kɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ makpãtã ehiɛ. Mikɛ amɛ baaye yɛ jalɛ naa.
"Nyɛ mitoi, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikojoɔ gwaŋtɛŋ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ teŋ; mikojoɔ ojwɛni kɛ too kpakpo teŋ.

Ani jwɛi kpakpa ni nyɛnaa nyɛyeɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛtsui etɔ̃ɔɔ hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji naanaa nyɛjwɛi kpakpa ni shwɛɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ? Ani nu hu ni hiɛ tɛ̃ kɔtekɔte ni nyɛnuɔ lɛ, nyɛtsui etɔ̃ɔɔ hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji kpɔtɔɔ nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ!
Ani esa akɛ mitoi lɛ aye niyenii ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji enaanaa nɔ lɛ, ni amɛnu nu ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji ekpɔtɔ lɛ?
"No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ amɛ nɛ, naa, Mi, midiɛŋtsɛ mibakojo too ni ewo fɔ kɛ too ni etã loo lɛ teŋ.
Akɛni Nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔ̃ji tsirɛɔ toi lɛ; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛkoji hɛlɛɔ amɛmli helatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛyashiɔ nyɛgbɛɔ kui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛshwãa majiasɛɛ.
hewɔ lɛ, mibahere mitoi lɛ ayiwala, ni amɛtsɔŋ kooloi anaa loo dɔŋŋ. Mibakojo gwaŋtɛŋ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ teŋ.
Mibato tookwɛlɔ kome maha amɛ, ni ji mitsulɔ David, ni lɛ eeele amɛ; ebaalɛ amɛ ni eeetsɔ̃ amɛkwɛlɔ."
"Ni mi, Yehowa, matsɔ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ; ni mitsulɔ David baatsɔ lumɔ aha amɛ. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Mikɛ amɛ baakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni baahã amɛhe ajɔ amɛ, ni mashwie kooloi awuyelɔi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛhi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ ŋa nɔ; amɛaawɔ yɛ koo mli.
"Ni mibajɔɔ amɛ kɛ hei ni bɔle migɔŋkpɔ lɛ he lɛ, ni maha nu anɛ yɛ ebe mli, ni nu lɛ aaatsɔ jɔɔmɔ aha amɛ.

Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋanɔ tsei baawo amɛyibii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba nii babaoo, ni amɛaaahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛji mikumɔ amɛkɔŋtsei ni akɛbɔ amɛ apã lɛ, ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ mɛi ni yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, no amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa.
Amɛtsɔŋ tamɔ kooloo naa loo amɛhaŋ jeŋmaji lɛ dɔŋŋ; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ yeŋ amɛloo. Amɛaabahi shi shweshweeshwe, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei.
Maha niyenii babaoo aba amɛŋmɔji ashi bɔ ni afee ni hɔmɔ aka plenee amɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni maji krokomɛi lɛ hu egbeŋ amɛhe guɔ dɔŋŋ.
Amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi, Yehowa amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ yɛ, ni amɛ Israel we lɛ amɛji mimaŋ. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ!
Ni nyɛ lɛ, mitoi ji nyɛ, milɛɛhe toi ji nyɛ. Miji nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ! Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi kɛɛ!"
35: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ogba oshi lɛ akɛ,
bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, Edom shikpɔŋ, mikɛ o ena, ni makpãtã ohiɛ, mafee o amaŋfɔ̃ butubutu.
Makpãtã omaji wuji lɛ ahiɛ, ni obaatsɔ shikpɔŋ amaŋfɔ̃, ni ooona ole akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa.
"Akɛni onyɛ Israel hiɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe, ni yɛ Israel amanehulu be mli lɛ, oŋɔ amɛ oha ni akɛ klaŋte kpãtã amɛhiɛ, be mli ni agblaa amɛtoi nɔ ni ji naagbee nɔ lɛ, yɛ amɛhe eshai ahewɔ;
no hewɔ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, masaa bo maha láshishwiemɔ, ni láshishwiemɔ baanyiɛ osɛɛ. Oshwie lá shi, no hewɔ lɛ láshishwiemɔ baanyiɛ osɛɛ.
Maha Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ butubutu, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ.
Maha ogɔji lɛ anɔ ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbohii, ni mɛi ni enyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa lɛ agbohii aaayimɔ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ ojɔi kɛ onujɔi lɛ amli.
Maha otsɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ omaŋ wuji lɛ ekoeko mli. Enɛ okɛaana ole akɛ mi, miji, Yehowa.
"Nɔ ni okɛɛ ji akɛ, 'Yuda kɛ Israel maji enyɔ lɛ minii ni, ni amɛshikpɔji enyɔ lɛ hu minii ni hewɔ lɛ maŋɔ amɛ;' tsɛbelɛ, mi Yehowa, miyɛ jɛi.

No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, gbii abɔ ni miji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mi hu mikɛ nyɛ baaye tamɔ bɔ pɛ ni nyɛkɛ mimaŋbii lɛ yɛ kɛ mlifu kɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Ni maha amɛle akɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee amɛ lɛ he toigblamɔ nyɛnaa lɛ.
Maha nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, minu musubɔɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ Israel gɔji lɛ akɛ 'amɛtsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã wɔ ni wɔkpãtã hiɛ lɛ.'
Mi diɛŋtsɛ minu bɔ ni ejɛ nyɛnaa ni nyɛkɛ henɔwomɔ wie wiemɔi babaoo nyɛshi mi lɛ. 14 "Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, maha otsɔ amaŋfɔ̃ koni je lɛ mli fɛɛ anya!

Bɔ ni onya yɛ Israel we lɛ gboshinii lɛ ahewɔ ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ mafee o. Obaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ni Seir gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm, hu baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."
36: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ Israel gɔji lɛ, ni nɔ ni okɛɛ amɛ nɛ, nyɛ Isreal gɔji, nyɛboa, Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, akɛni Israel henyɛlɔ lɛ nya ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Yiɛ, agbɛnɛ blema gɔji lɛ etsɔmɔ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ,'

hewɔ lɛ, gbaa ni okɛɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ! Majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ fee nyɛ maŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni amɛwie nyɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni eha nyɛtsɔmɔ majimaji krokomɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ. Amɛsopa nyɛ ni amɛye nyɛhe osheku hu.

No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ Israel gɔji, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa wiemɔ toi. Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ kɛ nujɔɔi lɛ kɛ jɔɔi lɛ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ, kɛ maji wuji ni ashi ashwie shi eflo lɛ, ni amɛtsɔmɔ kooloo naa loo kɛ hefɛoyeli nii amɛha majimaji ni eshwɛ ni bɔle amɛ kɛkpe lɛ nɛ.

"No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, miiwie kɛ awuŋayeli ni naa wa miishi maji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ Edom fɛɛ, mɛi ni kɛ miishɛɛ ŋɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ kɛfee amɛnɔ, ni amɛbuuu akɛ minɔ ni. Amɛŋɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã amɛhe akɛ haanii ni amɛhi nɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ gbaa yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni okɛɛ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ kɛ nujɔi lɛ kɛ gɔji ateŋ jɔi lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, nyɛkɛɛ awuŋa ni miyeɔ hewɔ lɛ, miiwie kɛ mlifu akɛ, nyɛhã jeŋmaji lɛ eshwie mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛo nɛ, Miikã midiɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ, majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ hu hiɛ baashwie shi nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shi nyɛ, Israel gɔji lɛ nyɛnɔ tsei lɛ baagbla niji, ni amɛbaawo yibii nyɛha mimaŋ Israel lɛ; ejaakɛ etsɛŋ ni Israelbii aaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛmaŋ ekoŋŋ.
Shi naa, miyɛ mihã nyɛ, ni matsɔ mihiɛ mahã nyɛ, gɔji lɛ, ni abaahu nyɛnɔ, ni abadu nii yɛ nyɛnɔ.
Maha Israel we lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm yi afa toi abɔ. Abaahi maji wuji lɛ amli ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaatswa tsu koi lɛ.
Maha gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ayi afa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, amɛaafɔfɔi, ni amɛyi aaafa. Ni mahã gbɔmɛi ahi nyɛnɔ tamɔ tsutsu lɛ; ni mafee nyɛ ejurɔ pii fe tsutsu lɛ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ, mi miji Yehowa.
Naa, mahã gbɔmɛi anyiɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ, ni mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ tete anyiɛ yɛ onɔ. Amɛaaŋɔ bo akɛ amɛnɔ ni oootsɔ̃ amɛgboshinii kwraa, ni ogbeŋ amɛbii lɛ hɔmɔ dɔŋŋ.
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, eyɛ mli akɛ mɛi kɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ kpãtãa gbɔmɔ hiɛ ni gbekɛbii tɛooo yɛ nɔ moŋ,
shi agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛkpãtãŋ gbɔmɔ hiɛ dɔŋŋ ni gbekɛbii hu gboiŋ yɛ nyɛnɔ dɔŋŋ. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ."
Majimaji ni yeɔ ohe fɛo lɛ, mihaŋ onu oheguɔ ni amegbeɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni onaŋ amɛ maŋbii ahorabɔɔ lɛ, ni mihaŋ omaŋ lɛ nane atɔ̃tɔ̃. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. Israel wala hee lɛ
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, be ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii bule shikpɔŋ lɛ. Amɛjeŋba yɛ mihiɛ lɛ tamɔ yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ ni ehe tseee.
No hewɔ lɛ mimli wo amɛ la naakpa yɛ lá shi ni amɛshwie yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛhã amãgãi ni amɛkɛbule shikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Migbɛ amɛ mishwã majimaji lɛ ateŋ kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ. Amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii ahewɔ lɛ migbla amɛtoi.

Be ni amɛtee majimaji lɛ amli lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni amɛshɛ lɛ amɛgbe migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni mɛi kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe ji akɛ, 'Yehowa webii nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ naa amɛ ni amɛje amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.'
Shi migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni Israel we lɛ hã agbe he guɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ he ni amɛtee lɛ dɔ mi.
"No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛ Israel we, jeee nyɛhewɔ mafee nɔ ko, shi moŋ, migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛgbe he guɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, hei ni nyɛyahi lɛ, hewɔ.

"Masaa mafee minumnyam gbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ ni abule lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛhu nyɛgbe he guɔ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Kɛji kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ lɛ, misaa mifee minumnyam gbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ, no amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋɔ nyɛ kɛaaje maji lɛ amli, ni mabua nyɛnaa kɛaaje shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛ aaaba nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mikɛ nu ni mli tse baashwã nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛhe baatse. Ni matsuu nyɛwɔji ahe muji ni yɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ hu.
"Mahã nyɛ tsui hee ni mikɛ mumɔ hee baawo nyɛmli, ni majie nyɛstui ni wa tamɔ tɛ lɛ kɛje nyɛ mli ni mahã nyɛ heloo tsui ni he jɔ.
Mikɛ mi-Mumɔ lɛ baawo nyɛmli, ni mahã nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbaaye mimlai lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛbaahi shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ; ni nyɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni mihu matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ.
Majie nyɛ kɛjɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni woɔ nyɛhe muji lɛ mli; mafã, ni ŋmãa aaaba babaoo, ni mahaŋ nyɛye hɔmɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Mahã tseiayibii kɛ ŋmɔshinii afa pii koni hɔmɔ akaha nyɛhiɛ shwie shi yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Enɛ baahã nyɛkai nyɛjeŋba fɔŋ ni nyɛba kɛ nii gbohii ni nyɛfee lɛ; ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe aaafe nyɛ nyaŋemɔ yɛ eshai ni nyɛfee lɛ kɛ musubɔɔ nii ni nyɛfeefee lɛ ahewɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, bo Israel we, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ jeee nyɛhewɔ mafee enɛ nɛɛ; nyɛhiɛ agboia ni nyɛhiɛ ashwiea shi yɛ nyɛjeŋba hewɔ.
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, gbi nɔ ni matsuu nyɛhe kɛjɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ, mahã mɛi ahi maji wuji lɛ amli, ni abaasaa tsu koi lɛ amamɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni kulɛ yɛ mɛi ahiɛ lɛ ekã eflo lɛ, abaahu nɔ, bɔ ni ekaŋ shi eflo dɔŋŋ.

Mɛi baana, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni kulɛ ekã shi eflo lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ tamɔ Eden trom nɛɛ; ni maji ni tsɔmɔ amŋfɔ̃i ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ amɛmli lɛ, nomɛi amli gbɔmɛi ebahi ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe nɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ jeŋmaji ni eshwɛ ni bɔle nyɛ kɛkpe lɛ aaana ale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi ni misaa tsu koi lɛ mitswa, ni he ni ka shi eflo lɛ, mitɛo nii yɛ jɛi. Mi, Yehowa miwie ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ji lɛ, mafee.
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mahã Israel we lɛ abi mi enɛ hu ni mafee mahã amɛ; no ji akɛ mahã amɛyi afa tamɔ toiku.
Mahã maji wuji ni etsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbɔmɛi babaoo tamɔ toi kui ni akɛyaasha afɔle yɛ Yerusalem yɛ egbii juji lɛ anɔ lɛ. Enɛ amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa."
37: Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ bayi minɔ, ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔ mi kɛje kpo, ni eyayi mi shi yɛ jɔɔ ko mli. Wui eyi jɔɔ lɛ mli obɔ̃ tɔ.
Enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛbɔle wui lɛ kɛkpe; ni naa; amɛfa naakpa; asaŋ amɛhe ekwakwao hu naakpa.
Ebi mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, aso wala aaanyɛ wui nɛɛ amli aba ekoŋŋ." Mihã hetoo akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, bo pɛ ole."
Ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Gbaa ni okɛɛ wui nɛɛ akɛ, nyɛ wui ni nyɛhe ekwakwao, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ wui nɛɛ nɛ, naa maha mumɔ abote nyɛmli ni wala baaba nyɛ mli.
Maha nyɛna fãi, ni mahã loo aba nyɛhe ni mahã hewolo aha nyehe. Mikɛ mumɔ baawo nyɛmli ni wala baaba nyɛ mli, ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ, mi miji Yehowa."
No hewɔ lɛ migba, taakɛ afã mi lɛ. Be ni migbaa lɛ, minu gbɛɛmɔ kɛ hetsirɛmɔi ahe. Kɛkɛ ni wui lɛ bua amɛhe naa, ni wu kɛ ewu tsa.
Be ni mikwɛ lɛ amɛna fãi kɛ hewolo; shi mumɔ bɛ amɛmli.

Agbɛnɛ Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛ mumɔ lɛ awie ni okɛɛ mumɔ lɛ akɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, bo mumɔ, jɛɛ jɛŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ mli ni obamu oshwie nɛkɛ mɛi ni agbegbee nɛɛ anɔ koni amɛna wala."
No hewɔ lɛ migba taakɛ afã mi lɛ, ni mumɔ ba amɛmli, ni wala ba amɛmli, ni amɛte shi amɛdamɔ amɛnaji anɔ, amɛyi fa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa nɛkɛ wui nɛɛ Israel we muu lɛ fɛɛ ni. Naa, amɛwieɔ akɛ 'wɔwui ahe ekwakwao, ni wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ etã, ni abɛɛ wɔ kwraa ashwie.'

No hewɔ lɛ gbaa ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nnɛ, Ao, mimaŋbii, naa, mibagble nyɛgbonyobui lɛ anaa, ni matee nyɛ shi kɛaajɛ nyɛgbonyobui lɛ amli, ni mikɛ nyɛ aaaba nyɛmaŋ, ni ji Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ao, mimaŋbii, kɛji migbele nyɛgbonyobui lɛ anaa ni mitee nyɛ shi kɛjɛ nyɛgbonyobui lɛ amli lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa.

Mikɛ mi-Mumɔ lɛ baawo nyɛmli, ni wala baaba nyɛmli, ni maŋɔ nyɛ kɛya nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛbaale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ, ni mifee hu." Yehowa kɛɛ. Yuda kɛ Israel yɛ Maŋtsɛyeli kome shishi
Yehowa kɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,

"Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɔ tso kome koni oŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Yuda kɛ Isrealbii ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ nɛ.' Agbɛnɛ kɔ tso kroko hu koni oŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ 'Yosef tso,' ni ji Efraim kɛ Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ nɔ nɛ.
"Agbɛnɛ lɛ okɛ tso kome atsa tso kome nɔ, koni amɛtsɔ tso kome yɛ odɛŋ.
Ni kɛji omaŋbii lɛ bi bo akɛ, 'Otsɔ̃ɔɔ wɔ enɛ shishi lo?' lɛ."

Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, 'Naa mibakɔ Yosef tso ni yɔɔ Efraim kɛ Isreal akutsei ni fata ehe lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, ni mikɛ no kɛ Yuda tso lɛ baatsa. Mafee amɛ tso kome koni amɛfee tso kome yɛ midɛŋ.'
"Hiɛmɔ tsei ni oŋma nii yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ yɛ odɛŋ ni amɛna,
koni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, majie Israelbii lɛ kɛaajɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ hei ni amɛtee lɛ, ni mabua amɛnaa kɛaaje hei fɛɛ; ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mafee amɛ maŋ kome yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ. Amɛaahi maŋtsɛ kome shishi ni amɛfeŋ maji enyɔ dɔŋŋ. Mligblamɔ hu baŋ amɛmaŋtsɛyeli mli dɔŋŋ.

"Amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi kɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii lɛ kɛ eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ekoeko buleŋ amɛhe dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ mahere amɛyiwala kɛaajɛ eshai ni amɛfee ni etse amɛ kɛje mihe lɛ amli, ni matsuu amɛhe; kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaatsɔ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ.
Mitsulɔ David baaye amɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛaana lumɔ kome. Amɛbaakwɛ koni amɛye mimlai lɛ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ.
Amɛaahi shikpɔŋ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hi nɔ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã mitsulɔ Yakob lɛ. Amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii baahi nɔ kɛya naanɔ; ni mitsulɔ David baaye amɛnɔ lumɔ kɛya naanɔ.
Mikɛ amɛaakpãŋ toiŋjɔlɛ kpãŋmɔ, ni ebaafee naanɔ kpãŋmɔ yɛ mi kɛ amɛ teŋ. Majɔɔ amɛ ni mahã amɛshwere, ni mikɛ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, baama amɛteŋ, ni ebaahi jɛi kɛya naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mi kɛ amɛ baahi jɛi, ni matsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.
Kɛji mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ ni ji Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ, no majimaji kɛaale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mitsuuɔ Israel he, mifeɔ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ."
38: Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Gbɔmɔ Adesa tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo Gog, ni ji Meshek kɛ Tubal lumɔnukpa ni yɔɔ Magog shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Gbaa oshi lɛ ni okɛɛ akɛ,
bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, bo Gog, ni oji Meshek kɛ Tubal lumɔnukpa, naa, mikɛ o ena,
ni madɔ oyi, ni mawo okadaaŋ kpoŋ, ni magbla bo kɛ ota lɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo. Magbla okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔtalɔi ni wo amɛdamai fɛɛ; asafo kple ni hiɛ amɛtsɛŋi wuji kɛ tsɛŋi bibii kɛ klaŋte.
Magbla Pershiabii kɛ Sudanbii kɛ Libiabii fɛɛ ni amɛhiɛhiɛ tsɛŋi ni amɛbu dadefai lɛ hu mafata amɛhe.
Tabilɔi ni jɛ Gomer kɛ Bet-Togarma ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ fɛɛ aaashi onɔ; asafo kple diɛŋtsɛ.
Saamɔ ohe ni ofee kralo, bo kɛ ta ni bua shi kɛbɔle ohe lɛ fɛɛ, koni obu amɛhe.

Afii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ abaabua omɛi lɛ anaa. No sɛɛ lɛ obaate shi oshi shikpɔŋ ni akpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ ta mli kɛba lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ ni kã shi eflo daa, he ni abua mɛi pii anaa kɛjɛ majimaji anɔ kɛba lɛ. Ajie emaŋbii lɛ kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ amli, ni agbɛnɛ amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛfee shweshweeshwe.
Bo okɛ ota lɛ fɛɛ aaafã kɛaaba tamɔ ahum, ni majimaji pii aaafata ohe ni ooofee tamɔ atatu ni baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ susumɔ pii baaba oyiŋ, ni obajwɛŋ efɔŋfeemɔ he.
Obaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Mafa kɛyatua akrowai ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe lɛ, ni mayatua mɛi ni yɔɔ kpoo ni amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe, maji ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe, ni amɛbɛ agbosɛɛ adabaŋi kɛ agboi hu lɛ.
Oooyaha nii, ni oooyatswa ojo. Ooote shi oyatua amaŋfɔ̃i ni agbɛnɛ mɛi yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni abua amɛnaa kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ ni amɛyɔɔ tsinai kɛ nibii pii yɛ majimaji ni bɔle amɛ lɛ ateŋ lɛ.'

Shebabii kɛ Dedanbii kɛ jrayelɔi ni jɛ Spain kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ baabi bo akɛ, 'Nihaa obaa nɛɛ? Ani oba ni obaha nii lo? Ani obua ota asafo lɛ naa kɛkpe kɛbatswa ojo ni nyɛkɛha nii koni nyɛkɛloo jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsinai kɛ nibii pii kɛya?'
"No hewɔ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ Gog akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, gbi nɔ ni mimaŋ Israel aaahi shi shweshweeshwe lɛ, no ooote shi owo amɛ.
Bo okɛ mɛi babaoo ni tra okpɔŋɔi anɔ ni fata ohe lɛ kɛaaje ojɛɛhe ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaaba, ta asafo kple diɛŋtsɛ.
Ooote shi owo mimaŋ Israel; nyɛyi falɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛji gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ mahã otua mishikpɔŋ lɛ, ni bɔ ni mafee bo yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, baahã amɛle mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, ani bo ohe miwie yɛ blema gbii lɛ amli kɛtsɔ̃ mitsuji, ni ji Israel gbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɛi ni gba afii babaoo yɛ nakai beiaŋ akɛ mahã obatua amɛ lɛ." Nyɔŋmɔ gbla Gog toi
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbi nɔ ni Gog baate shi abatua Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ, mimli baawo la waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Ejaakɛ mikɛ awuŋayeli kɛ mlila miigba mli kpoo makɛɛ akɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ kukrudu ni naa wa baashi yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋshɔŋloi kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ waamɔnii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he baakpokpo yɛ mihegbeyei naa. Abaatsirɛ gɔji atswia shi, ni tɛsai ni kwɔlɔ lɛ baagbeegbee shi, ni aaawule gbogbo fɛɛ gbogbo ashwie shi.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, mikɛ hejramɔ aaaba Goŋ nɔ, ni nuu fɛɛ nuu baawo klaŋte nɔ yɛ enaanyo nɔ.
Mikɛ gbele hela kɛ láshishwiemɔ baagbla etoi; ni mahã nu ni naa wa kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi kɛ la kɛ swɔɔ anɛ ashwie lɛ kɛ etai lɛ kɛ mɛi babaoo ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ.
Ni enɛ mikɛaahã maji fɛɛ ale akɛ mida ni mihe tse; ni amɛaana amɛle hu akɛ miji Yehowa."
39: "Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, agbɛnɛ, gbaa oshi Gog ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, bo Gog, ni boji Meshek kɛ Tubal lumɔnukpa, naa mikɛ o ena,
ni madɔ oyi ni mikɛ o aaajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ kɛaaba, ni makpla bo hu kɛaaba Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ matswa ogãitso lɛ kɛaaje onine abɛku dɛŋ, ni mahã ogãimlibii lɛ aje oninejurɔ dɛŋ ashwie shi.
Bo Gog, mahã okɛ otai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ majimaji ni fata ohe lɛ fɛɛ anyɔnyɔi yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ. Mikɛ nyɛgbohii lɛ baahã loofɔji ni yeɔ gbɔmɔ loo kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi awuyelɔi ni amɛtserɛ nyɛ loo.
Obaanyɔ yɛ ŋa kplenee nɔ; ejaakɛ mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.
Asaŋ mawo Magog kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli lɛ la. Ni mɛi fɛɛ kɛaale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa.
Ni maha mimaŋ Israelbii ale migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ. Mihaŋ agbe migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ dɔŋŋ. Kɛkɛ lɛ majimaji baale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi miji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, gbi ni miwie ehe lɛ, gbi lɛ miiba, ni ebaaba nɔŋŋ kɛ̃.

Kɛkɛ lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Israel maji lɛ mli lɛ baaje kpo amɛyaloo tawuu nibii lɛ ni amɛaama naa la amɛshã fɛɛ. Amɛaaŋɔ tsɛŋi bibii kɛ ewuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gãitsei kɛ gãimlibii lɛ kɛ kpotii kɛ akplɔi ni amɛkɛbaafee lai amɛshã afii kpawo.

Bɔ ni afee ni amɛkayalɛ lai kɛjɛ ŋanɔ, ni amɛkayaflɔ tsei hu kɛjɛ koo mli; ejaakɛ amɛkɛ tawuu nibii lɛ baafee lai amɛshã. Mɛi ni ha amɛnibii lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛ hu amɛaaha amɛ nibii amɛtse; ni mɛi ni tswa amɛ ojo lɛ, amɛ hu amɛaatswa amɛ ojo amɛtse." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ. Gog fuu

Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mahã Gog fuuhe ko yɛ Isreal, yɛ Gbɛnyiɛlɔi Ajɔɔ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ. Gbɛnyiɛlɔi Ajɔɔ nɛɛ mli abaafu Gog kɛ esafo yuu lɛ yɛ, ni gbohii lɛ ayifalɛ baatsi gbɛnyiɛlɔi agbɛ, ni no aaahã awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Hamon-Gog Jɔɔ.
Israel, we lɛ aaaye nyɔji kpawo sɔŋŋ kɛfu amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛtsuu shikpɔŋ lɛ he.
Israelbii fɛɛ baafata hɛ kɛfu gbohii lɛ, ni no baahã amɛgbɛi ahehe, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ majie minumnyam lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ; Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nyɔji kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ baafamɔ mɛi krɛdɛɛ koni nakai mɛi lɛ, akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bei fɛɛ koni amɛfu gbohii ni eshwɛ ni jwere shi ni afuko amɛ lɛ koni akɛtsuu shikpɔŋ lɛ he.
Ni kɛji amɛmiikpa shi ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko na gbonyo wu lɛ, eto okadi ko yɛ gbonyo wu lɛ he; okadi lɛ ahi jɛi kɛyashi be ni fulɔi lɛ aaaba abafu wu lɛ yɛ Gog Asafo Yuu Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Maŋ ko atsɛɔ lɛ 'Asafo Yuu' hi shi. Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaafee atsuu shikpɔŋ lɛ he."

Bɔ ji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ loofɔji srɔtoi fɛɛ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ akɛ, nyɛjɛa he fɛɛ he nyɛbaa nyɛbabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ migbee afɔle kpeteŋkple ni misaa mito mihã nyɛ yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ he. Nyɛbaaye loo ni nyɛbaanu lá.
Nyɛbaaye kãkãlɔi aloo, ni nyɛbaanu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɛi alá. Nyɛbaaye ojwɛnii kɛ toogwaŋtɛŋbii kɛ too kpakpo kɛ tsinahii, ni ji Bashan kooloi sɔŋŋ ni ewofɔ lɛ aloo.
Migbee afɔle ni misaa mito nyɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaaye fɔ aahuu kɛyaashi nyɛbaatrɔ, ni nyɛbaanu lá aahuu kɛyaashi ebaatɔ nyɛ tamɔ dãa.
Ni yɛ mikplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ, nyɛbaaye okpɔŋɔi kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtralɔi kɛ kãkãlɔi kɛ tabilɔi srɔtoi aloo nyɛtrɔ. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ." Abaakpale Israel kɛba ekoŋŋ
"Maha majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ana minumnyam lɛ; amɛbaana bɔ ni miye jalɛ sane mihã, kɛ bɔ ni mikɛ minine ŋmɛ amɛnɔ lɛ.
Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ, Israel we lɛ baale akɛ, mi, miji Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

Majimaji lɛ hu baale akɛ eshai ni Israel we lɛ fee lɛ hewɔ amɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ. Akɛni amɛtɔ̃ minɔ lɛ, no hewɔ ni mitsi mihe yɛ amɛhe, ni mitu amɛ miwo amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ ni akɛ klaŋte gbegbee amɛ yɛ ta mli lɛ.
Mujinii ni amɛfee lɛ kɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa mikɛ amɛ ye yɛ, ni mitsi mihe yɛ amɛhe lɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ makpale Yakob shwiei ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni maha Israel we lɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ. Maye migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he awuŋa.
Kɛji amɛbahi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko wooo amɛhe gbeyei lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpa nɔ akɛ be ni amɛtɔ̃ minɔ lɛ amɛhiɛ shwie shi.
Makpale amɛ kɛaajɛ majiasɛɛ kɛaaba, ni mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni maha majimaji lɛ ale akɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, miji Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mihã aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee majiasɛɛ, ni misaa miyabua amɛnaa kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni mishiŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ jɛi.
Mafɔse mi-Mumɔ lɛ mashwie Israel we lɛ nɔ, ni mitsiŋ mihe kɛjɛŋ amɛhe dɔŋŋ," Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
40: Yerusalem fitemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ, wɔna afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ nomŋɔɔ mli. Afi nɛɛ shishijee nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa hewalɛ ba minɔ yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ tuuŋu.
Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ mi kɛba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ ninaa mli, ni ekɛ mi yadamɔ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ ko nɔ. Gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mina nɔ ko tamɔ maŋ ni ato yɛ mihiɛgbɛ.
Be ni ekɛ mi ba jɛi lɛ, naa, nuu ko ni egbɔmɔtso su tamɔ akɔɔble su yɛ jɛi. Ehiɛ kpekpe kpãa kɛ susumɔtso yɛ edɛŋ, ni edamɔ shinaa lɛ shi.

Nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gblemɔ ohiŋmɛi ni okwɛ nii jogbaŋŋ; ni ogbɛ otoiŋ hu ni onu nii jogbaŋŋ, ni okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mikɛbaatsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ no hewɔ akɛbo ba biɛ. Nibii ni onaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ Israel we lɛ."

Mina Sɔlemɔwe ko ni atswa gbogbo kɛbɔle lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe. Susumɔtso ni nuu lɛ hiɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa, emli ninetalɔ kome feɔ ninetalɔ kɛ dɛ̃lɛɛmɔ. Nuu lɛ susu kɛ gbogbo lɛ, etimɔ fee ninetalɔ kome kɛ ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔ kome.
Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ atrakpoi lɛ kɛtee bokãgbe agbo lɛ he; ni esusu agbo lɛ kpoku lɛ, efee ninetalɔ kome.

Gbɛ ko kã ablanaa lɛ naa; tsui bibii etɛ̃ yɛ gbɛ lɛ biɛ, ni etɛ̃ hu yɛ biɛ. Tsui bibii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. Gbɛ ni kã tsu bibioo kɛ tsu bibioo teŋ lɛ feɔ ninetalɔi enumɔ. Agbo lɛ kpoku lɛ ni yɔɔ koi lɛ naagbɛ ni kã kɛyaa shiã lɛ mligbɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome;
Kɛkɛ ni esusu agbo lɛ koi lɛ, efee ninetalɔ kome;
agbɛnɛ esusu agbo lɛ ni etimɔ ji ninetalɔi kpaanyɔ, ni eshimaamɔnii lɛ ninetalɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ. Agbo lɛ koi lɛ ye mligbɛ kɛbɛŋkɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ he lɛ, tsui bibii etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ; ni etɛ̃ hu yɛ biɛ; ni tsui etɛ̃ lɛ adramɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ shimaamɔnii lɛ ni yɔɔ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ hu adramɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni esusu agbo lɛ lɛɛmɔ ni efee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni gbɛ ni kã kɛboteɔ mli lɛ lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.
Atswa kpoku yɛ tsui bibii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ. Kpoku fɛɛ kpoku lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome ni etimɔ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Abɛnɛ esusu agbo lɛ kɛjɛ tsui bibii lɛ ateŋ ekome sɛɛgbɛ kɛyashi ekroko hu sɛɛgbɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛjɛ gbogbo kome he kɛtee ekroko he.
Esaa esusu gbɛ ni kã koi lɛ shi kɛboteɔ agbo lɛ naa kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ. No hu fee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Kɛjɛ agbo ni atsɔ̃ɔ mli kɛboteɔ mli lɛ hiɛ kɛyashi mligbɛ agbo lɛ koi lɛ hiɛ lɛ, efee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Samfɛji yɛ agbo lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛbɔle; ni samfɛji yɛ mligbɛ koi lɛ hu he kɛkpe; ni akpɛ tɛŋi samai yɛ mligbɛ tsui bibii lɛ ahe. Agbonaa kpo lɛ
Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi tee agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ; ni naa, piai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ mli, ni aka kpo lɛ nɔ tɛ kɛkpe yɛ piai lɛ ahiɛ.
Agboi lɛ ahiɛ fɛɛ lɛ aka jɛi tɛ kɛkpe. Agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ jɔɔ mligbɛ fe mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Nuu lɛ susu kɛjɛ shishigbɛ agbo lɛ hiɛ kɛyashi mligbɛ kpo lɛ hiɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi oha. Kooyigbɛ Agbo lɛ
Agbɛnɛ eyi mihiɛ kɛtee kooyigbɛ. Agbo ko yɛ jɛi ni hiɛ kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ mli kɛyaa agbonaa kpo lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni esusu akɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ.
Ehiɛ tsui bibii etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ, ni etɛ̃ hu yɛ biɛ, ni eshimaamɔ nii kɛ ekoi lɛ adramɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ agbo lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Esamfɛji lɛ kɛ ekoii lɛ kɛ bɔ ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi awo he lɛ adramɔ tamɔ agbo ni hiɛ kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ nɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ. Asaŋ akwɔɔ atrakpoi kpawo kɛyaa he, ni ekoi lɛ yɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.

Tamɔ bɔ ni agbo yɔɔ bokãgbɛ kpo lɛ he lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ agbo ko yɔɔ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ ŋlɛnɔ; ni eboteɔ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ. Esusu kɛjɛ agbo kome he kɛtee agbo kome he, ni efee ninetalɔi oha. Wuoyigbɛ Agbo lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tee wuoyigbɛ; ni naa, agbo kroko yɛ jɛi hu. Esusu eshimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ, ni amɛdramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Samfɛji yɛ tsui lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ he kɛbɔle kɛkpe, tamɔ eyɔɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ ahe lɛ nɔŋŋ. Agbo lɛ mligbɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Atrakpoi kpawo akwɔɔ kɛyaa he; ni ekoi lɛ yɛ mligbɛ. Akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi yɛ mligbɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ ahe, eko yɛ biɛ ni eko hu yɛ biɛ.
Agbo ko hu yɛ mligbɛ kpo ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ he; ni nuu lɛ susu kɛjɛ agbo kome he kɛtee agbo kroko he yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, ni no hu fee ninetalɔi oha. Mligbɛ kpo lɛ, kɛ Agbo lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛbote mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ. Esusu wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ, ni edalɛ lɛ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.

Etsui bibii lɛ kɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ adramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ adramɔ nɔŋŋ. Samfɛji yɛ etsui lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Koii ebɔle lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Ekoi lɛ kwɛɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi yɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ ahe, ni akwɔɔ atrakpoi kpaanyɔ kɛyaa agbo lɛ he. Mligbɛ kpo lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Agbo lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi bote mligbɛ kpo ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ mli, ni esusu agbo lɛ; ni edalɛ lɛ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.

Etsui bibii lɛ kɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoii lɛ adramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni samfɛji yɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe kɛ koi lɛ hu kɛkpe. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Ekoi lɛ kwɛɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi samai yɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ ahe biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni atrakpoi kpaanyɔ akwɔɔ kɛyaa he. Mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ Kooyigbɛ Agbo lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tee kooyigbɛ abgo lɛ naa, ni esusu; edalɛ lɛ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Etsui bibii lɛ kɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoii lɛ edramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni samfɛji bɔle he kɛkpe. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Eshimaamɔnii lɛ kwɛɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi samai yɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ ahe biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni akwɔɔ atrakpoi kpaanyɔ kɛyaa he. Tsui ni bɛŋkɛ Kooyigbɛ Agbo lɛ
Pia ko kɛ enaa shinaa yɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ ni yɔɔ agboi lɛ ahe lɛ amasɛi. Jɛi ji he ni afɔɔ kooloi ni akɛbaashã afɔlei lɛ ahe yɛ.
Okplɔ̃i enyɔ mamɔ agbo lɛ koi lɛ fã kome lɛ mli, ni okplɔ̃i enyɔ mamɔ afã kroko lɛ hu mli. Okplɔ̃i nɛɛ anɔ agbeɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle kɛ esha afɔle kɛ sɔ̃ he afɔlei lɛ yɛ.
Koi lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ naagbɛ lɛ, okplɔ̃i enyɔ mamɔ jɛi. Koi lɛ migblɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ nɔŋŋ naa lɛ, akplɔ̃i enyɔ hu yɛ jɛi.
Okplɔ̃i fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ayibɔ ji kpaanyɔ; ejwɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni ejwɛ hu yɛ kpo lɛ nɔ. Okplɔ̃i nɛɛ anɔ agbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ.

Tɛ ni ako okplɔ̃i ejwɛ yɛ jɛi, ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle. Tɛ ni ako okplɔ̃i lɛ ekome kɛlɛ ji nimetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ, kɛ ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔ kome. Nɛkɛ tɛi nɛɛ anɔ akɛ dadei ni akɛgbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa shãafɔle lɛ kɛ gbee afɔle lɛ shwieɔ.
Akla tso akɔtɔkloi ni hiɛ dɛ̃lɛɛmɔ kome yɛ mligbɛ kɛbɔle kɛkpe kpula. Loo ni akɛshãa afɔle lɛ, akɛshwieɔ okplɔ̃i lɛ anɔ.

Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi jɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ kɛba mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni naa piai enyɔ yɛ jɛi, ekome yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ masɛi, ni ekroko lɛ hu yɛ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ masɛi.
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, osɔfoi ni tsuɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli nii lɛ anɔ ni.

Ni tsu ni hiɛ kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ, osɔfoi ni tsuɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nii lɛ anɔ ni. Osɔfoi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Zodakbii ni jɛ Levi shwiei lɛ amli ji amɛ. Amɛ pɛ ji mɛi ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa, ni amɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ." Mligbɛ kpo lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni esusu kpo lɛ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha ni elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ; koji ejwɛ ni. Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɛ anaigbɛ ni afɔleshãa latɛ ma Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hiɛ.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba shīa lɛ koi lɛ shi, ni esusu koi lɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ, efee ninetalɔi enumɔ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ. Agbo lɛ lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Koi lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ɛjwɛ. Akwɔɔ atrakpoi nyɔŋma kɛyaa he. Akulashiŋi mamɔ shimaamɔnii lɛ amasɛi ekome yɛ biɛ ni ekome hu yɛ biɛ.
41: Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi ba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni esusu akulashiŋi lɛ, ni eko fɛɛ eko timɔ biɛ kɛ biɛ fɛɛ lɛ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa.
Enaagbɛ lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma; ni gbogbo ni yɔɔ naa gbɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ timɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni etee mligbɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni esusu akulashiŋi ni mamɔ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko timɔ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi ekpaa. Enaagbɛ lɛ lɛɛmɔ fee ninetalɔi kpawo.

Esusu tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛlɛ, efee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ; nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Biɛ ji He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fee Fɛɛ lɛ." Tsui ni kpɛtɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ gbogboi lɛ
Kɛkɛ ni esusu Sɔlemɔwe lɛ gbogbo lɛ, etimɔ fee ninetalɔi ekpaa; ni piai ni bɔle Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ.

Piai ni amamɔ kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he kɛkpe lɛ srɔdoi etɛ̃tɛ̃ɛtɛ ni; ni srɔdo kome hiɛ piai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Gbogbo ni atswa kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, be ni eyaa ŋwɛigbɛ lɛ, belɛ aabɛ he bɔ ni afee koni tsui bibii lɛ atsiimɔ akakã Sɔlemɔwe lɛ gbogbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔ tsɔ̃.

No hewɔ lɛ kɛ ajɛ sɛɛgbɛ aakwɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ gbogbo lɛ, anaa akɛ fɛɛ tilɛ ekome kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ kɛyashiɔ ŋwɛi. Atswere agboi enyɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ gbogbo lɛ he. No hewɔ lɛ anyɛɔ ajɛɔ shishi srɔdo lɛ nɔ kɛyatsɔ̃ɔ teŋ srɔdo lɛ nɔ kɛyaa srɔdo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.

Mina hu akɛ atswa kpoku kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he kɛkpe. Piai lɛ ashishitoo gbogbo lɛ tilɛ fee tso kome, ni ji ninetalɔi ekpaa. 9-11. Agbonaagbɛ piai lɛ agbogbo lɛ tilɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ. Piaipiai lɛ anaa shinaa lɛ miikwɛ gbɛ ni ashi lɛ. Shinaa kome naa ka kooyigbɛ ni shinaa kroko hu naa ka wuoyigbɛ, ni gbɛ ni ashi lɛ lɛɛmɔ hiɛ ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛbole kɛkpe. Anaigbɛ tsu lɛ

Tsu ko yɛ ni kwɛɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ anaigbɛ. Elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai kpawo, ni egbogbo lɛ timɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛbɔle kɛkpe kpula, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu. Sɔlemɔwe lɛ fɛɛ susumɔ
Nuu lɛ susu Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ekɛlɛ fee ninetalɔi oha, ni kpo lɛ kɛ tsu lɛ kɛ egbogboi lɛ hu fee ninetalɔi oha.
Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hiɛgbɛ kɛyaa bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛ jɛi kpo lɛ lɛɛmɔ lɛ fee ninetalɔi oha.
Agbɛnɛ esusu tsu ni kwɛɔ kpo ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ lɛ kɛ ehe ablanaai ni ye ebiɛ kɛ ebiɛ lɛ akɛlɛ; efee ninetalɔi oha. Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he nibii Sɔlemɔwe lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ,
akɛ ŋmoŋmlo eka fɛɛ mli bɛbɔle kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ aahuu kɛyashi samfɛji lɛ ahe. Samfɛji nɛɛ hu ahahaa amɛhe.
Ayeyee kerubii kɛ tɛŋ samai awo Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ. Ayeyee samai nɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ aahuu kɛtee shinai lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ.
Ato samai lɛ anaa. Tɛŋ nyiɛ kerub sɛɛ; nakai sɔŋŋ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛbɔle. Kerub fɛɛ kerub yɛ hiɛi enyɔ:
Gbɔmɔ hiɛ kɛ jata hiɛ. Be ni gbɔmɔ hiɛ lɛ miikwɛ tɛŋ lɛ afã biɛ lɛ, jata hiɛ lɛ hu miikwɛ tɛŋ lɛ afã kroko lɛ hu. Aye samai nɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli gbogboi lɛ ahe.
kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ kɛyashi shinaa lɛ yiteŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Sɔlemɔwe lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaatsei lɛ amli lɛɛmɔ kɛ kɛlɛ fɛɛ ye egbɔ. Tso Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ Nɔ ko ma shi yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni etamɔ tso afɔleshãa latɛ.

Ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi enyɔ. Ekoji lɛ kɛ eshishi lɛ kɛ nɔ ni akɛha he lɛ tso akɛfee. Nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Enɛ ji okplɔ̃ ni maa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ." Shinai lɛ
He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ shinaa nta.
Ni shinaa nta lɛ agbleɔ yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
Ni ayeyee Kerubii kɛ tɛŋi asamai yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinai lɛ ahe, taakɛ aye awo gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ. Akɛ tso efee agba yɛ koi lɛ kponɔgbɛ.
Samfɛji ni aflɔflɔɔ mli yɛ koi lɛ shi biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni aye tɛŋi asamai yɛ piai lɛ kɛ kpokui lɛ ahe.
42: Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi je kpo ni ekɛ mi tee agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ. Ni ekɛ mi tee tsu ko ni ye Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ mli. Tsu nɛɛ kɛ tsu ko ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ jekɛɛɛ.
Tsu lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.

Tsu nɛɛ afã kome miikwɛ kpo ko ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Tsu nɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he. Tsu lɛ afã kroko lɛ miikwɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo ni aka nɔ tɛ lɛ nɔ. Ama tsu nɛɛ srɔdoi etɛ̃, ni eko fɛɛ eko lɛ srɔdoi ni ye shikpɔŋgbɛ lɛ mli lɛɛ fe nɔ ni ma enɔ lɛ.
Ablanaa ko kã piai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi oha. Piai lɛ ashinai lɛ ye kooyigbɛ.
Piai ni yɔɔ ŋwɛigbɛ srɔdo lɛ mli lɛ draaa tamɔ nii ni yɔɔ teŋ kɛ shikpɔŋgbɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ ablanaa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛigbɛ srɔdo lɛ nɔ lɛ lɛɛ fe ablanaa ni yɔɔ teŋ kɛ shishigbɛ srɔdoi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Ama tsu lɛ srɔdoi etɛ̃, shi moŋ amɛbɛ akulashiŋi tamɔ bɔ ni tsui krokomɛi ni yɔɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ eko lɛ. No hewɔ abɛ ŋwɛigbɛ piai lɛ amli fe piai ni yɔɔ teŋ kɛ shishigbɛ lɛ.
Gbogbo ko yɛ kponɔgbɛ, ni eyɛ piai lɛ aŋlɛnɔ kɛyaa agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ. Eekwɛ piai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Piai ni yɔɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ; shi tsui ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hiɛgblɛ lɛ ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha.
Kɛjɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ he ni gbogbo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, gbɛ ko kã shi kɛboteɔ piai lɛ amli.
Gbɛ ko hu kã piai lɛ ni yɔɔ tsu lɛ kɛ kpo lɛ ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Wuoyigbɛ piai lɛ tamɔ kooyigbɛ piai lɛ nɔŋŋ. Amɛklɛmɔ kɛ amɛlɛɛmɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ; amɛnaagbɛi kɛ amɛhe shinai kɛ bɔ ni ato amɛ ahã lɛ hu tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbɛ ko kã wuoyigbɛ piai lɛ ashishigbɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛboteɔ mli lɛ. Gbogbo ko fo wuoyigbɛ piai nɛɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ piai lɛ ateŋ.

Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Piai ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ kɛ piai ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ ni amɛhiɛ kwɛɔ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ lɛ, nomɛi ji piai krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. Jɛi osɔfoi ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa lɛ yeɔ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋi ni fe fɛɛ lɛ yɛ. Afɔlei nɛɛ ji niyenii afɔle kɛ esha afɔle lɛ kɛ esha afɔle lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ, ejaakɛ hei krɔŋkrɔŋi ni.

Kɛji osɔfoi lɛ bote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, amɛkaje kpo kɛmiiya agbonaa kpo lɛ nɔ, be mli ni amɛjieko amɛtadei ni amɛwo kɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ amɛshwieko shi, ejaakɛ atadei krɔŋkrɔŋi ni. Amɛklɔ atadei krokomɛi amɛwo dani amɛbɛŋkɛ he ni maŋbii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ." Sɔlemɔwe lɛ dalɛ yɛ ekpoŋɔgbɛ
Agbɛnɛ be ni nuu lɛ gbe Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mligbɛ lɛ susumɔ naa lɛ, ekɛ mi je kpo kɛtsɔ agbo ni hiɛ kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ mli. Eyasusu Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kponɔgbɛ lɛ dalɛ.
Ekɛ susumɔkpãa lɛ susu bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Etsɔ ehe ni esusu kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Esaa esusu wuoyigbɛ lɛ hu, ni efee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Asaŋ esusu anaigbɛ lɛ ni no hu fee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Esusu ehei ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ. Atswa gbogbo kɛbɔle he fɛɛ kɛkpe. Gbogbo lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. Akɛ gbogbo lɛ fo he ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋ, kɛ he ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tɛŋ.
43: Fee sɛɛ lɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi ba bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ naa,
ni naa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anumnyam lɛ jɛ bokãgbɛ miiba. Ebaa lɛ jijemɔ ni ekɛba lɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ; kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpɛ kɛ enumnyam lɛ.
Ninaa ni mina lɛ tamɔ ninaa ni mina be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ba koni ebafite Yerusalem maŋ lɛ. Nɛkɛ ninaa nɛɛ etamɔ nɔ ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.
Yehowa anumnyam lɛ tsɔ̃ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛbote Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli.
Mumɔ lɛ wo mi ni ekɛ mi ba mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ; ni naa, Yehowa anumnyam lɛ yi Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli obɔ̃ tɔ.
Be mli ni nuu lɛ damɔ mimasɛi lɛ, minu akɛ Yehowa miiwie kɛmiijɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli.

Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ shimaahe ji biɛ nɛɛ, ni biɛ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ji minane maahe. Biɛ nɛɛ mahi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ kɛaate naanɔ; ni Israel we lɛ woŋ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji dɔŋŋ. Amɛ, loo amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔji krokomɛi ajamɔ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi agbohii buleŋ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.

Amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tswa amɛkpoku lɛ yɛ mikpoku lɛ masɛi; ni amɛkɛ amɛshinaatso lɛ ma mishinaatso lɛ masɛi; gbogbo kɛkɛ fo mikɛ amɛteŋ. Amɛkɛ musubɔɔnii ni amɛfee lɛ wo migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, no hewɔ lɛ miplene amɛ yɛ mimlifu naa.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ, amɛkpa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jamɔ, ni amɛjie amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbohii lɛ kɛje mimasɛi, hewɔ lɛ mahi amɛteŋ kɛaatee naanɔ."
Agbɛnɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, susumɔ bɔ ni Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɔɔ hã, kɛ esu fɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Israel we lɛ koni amɛhiɛ agboi yɛ eshai ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ.

Ni kɛji amɛhiɛ gboi yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, no lɛ ojie Sɔlemɔwe lɛ su lɛ kɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ ehe gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ kɛ ekpojeehei lɛ kɛ emlibotemɔhei lɛ kɛ esu lɛ fɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Ŋmãa yɛ amɛhiɛ ni amɛna, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkwɛ ni amɛye mlai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he mla nɛ. No ji akɛ, "Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni ema lɛ, kɛ ehewɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ ni kã he kɛbɔle lɛ lɛ fɛɛ baafee he ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ. Naa, Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he mla lɛ nɛ.

"Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hu dalɛ lɛ nɛ. Susumɔnɔ ni akɛsusu Sɔlemɔwe lɛ no nɔŋŋ akɛsusu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ. Eshishigbɛ lɛ, awo nɔ ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu afee ninetalɔ kome; ni etoi lɛɛmɔ afee dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ kɛbɔle. Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kwɔlɛ afee nɛkɛ.
Kɛjɛ eshishi ni ma shikpɔŋ kɛyamɔ eshishi sɛ̃i lɛ, ninetalɔi enyɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome; kɛjɛ sɛ̃i fioo lɛ nɔ kɛyashi sɛ̃i wulu lɛ nɔ lɛ afee ninetalɔi ejwɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome.
Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yiteŋ he ni akɛ afɔle lɛ fɔ̃ɔ ni ashãa lɛ, ninetalɔi ejwɛ, ni kɛjɛ jɛi kɛyaa ŋwɛigbɛ lɛ akloŋtoi ejwɛ yɛ he.
Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yiteŋ he ni akɛ afɔle lɛ fɔ̃ɔ ni ashãa lɛ kɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ: Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.

Eshishi sɛ̃i lɛ kɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ fɛɛ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ: Ekɛlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ. Etoi lɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ fã, kɛ eshishigbɛ nɔ lɛ ninetalɔ kome kɛbɔle. Atrakpoi ni akwɔɔ kɛyaa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ aye bokãgbɛ." Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hetsuumɔ
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he mlai nɛ: gbi nɔ ni aaama afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni aaashã shãaafɔle ni akɛ lá ashwã nɔ lɛ,
ŋɔɔ tsina oblanyo ohã osɔfoi ni ji Levibii ni jɛ Zadok weku lɛ mli lɛ mɛi ni bɛŋkɛɔ mi ni amɛsɔmɔɔ mi lɛ, koni amɛkɛshã esha he afɔle.
Ŋɔɔ elá lɛ eko ni okɛdiki afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he akloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ ahe, kɛ etoi ni bɔle lɛ kpula kɛkpe lɛ he. Bɔ ni ofee; ni okɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni okɛkpãtã hu oha lɛ lɛ nɛ.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ tsinanuu ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔlei lɛ ni ashã yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛ, he ni ato akɛ eshã yɛ lɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, okɛ too kpakpo hu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe eshã esha he afɔle, ni akɛjie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha lɛ tamɔ akɛ tsinanuu lɛ nɔ lɛ tsuu he lɛ.
Kɛji ogbe hetsuumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, okɛ tsinanuu ni kpako bɛ ehe kɛ too ojwɛni ni kpako bɛ ehe eshã afɔle.
Okɛ amɛ aba mi Yehowa mihiɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ ŋoo ashwã amɛnɔ koni ashã akɛ shãa afɔle ahã mi, Yehowa.
Daa gbi lɛ oha too kpakpo kɛ tsina oblanyo kɛ ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã esha he afɔle ahã mi kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Osɔfoi lɛ aŋɔ gbii kpawo ni amɛkɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni amɛha ehe atse.

Kɛji hetsuumɔ gbii lɛ anaa tã lɛ, kɛjɛ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛyaa lɛ osɔfoi lɛ ashã nyɛshãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛshidaa afɔlei lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ mana nyɛhe tsui." Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ.
44: Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛ mi ku sɛɛ kɛba He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kponɔgbɛ shinaa ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ naa. Aŋa shinaa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Shinaa nɛɛ aŋa daa; akagble, ni mɔ ko akatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbote mli; ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbote mli, hewɔ lɛ aŋa daa.
Lumɔ lɛ pɛ ji mɔ ni aaanyɛ ayata jɛi eyaye aboloo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Lɛ pɛ etsɔ̃ agbo lɛ koishi gbɛ lɛ kɛbote mli ni etsɔ̃ jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛje kpo." Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mlibotemɔ he mlai
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tsɔ̃ kooyi gbɛ agbo lɛ naa gbɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hiɛ. Mikwɛ, ni naa, Yehowa anumnyam lɛ eyi Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ obɔ̃. Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ̃ nɔ, okɛ ohiŋmɛi akwɛ, ni okɛ otoi anu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni makɛɛ bo yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he akpɔi kɛ mlai lɛ ahe lɛ. Kadimɔ koni ole jogbaŋŋ mɛi ni sa akɛ amɛboteɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli, kɛ mɛi ni esaaa akɛ amɛboteɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
"Kɛɛmɔ toigbolɔi lɛ, ni ji Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, ao Israel we, nyɛmusubɔɔnii lɛ, nyɛkpaa!

Kɛji nyɛkɛ miniyenii afɔle ni ji fɔ kɛ lá lɛ miiba lɛ, nyɛkaŋmɛa maŋsɛɛbii ni ji tsuiŋ foolɔi lɛ gbɛ ni amɛmiiba mi-He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni amɛbule lɛ. Nyɛmusubɔɔnii fɛɛ lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, nyɛku mikpãŋmɔ lɛ hu mli nyɛfata he.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛtsuuu minibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahe nii yɛ mi-He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛto maŋsɛɛbii ni amɛtsu.
"Maŋsɛɛbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni ji tsuiŋ foolɔ kɛ helooŋ foolɔ akabote mi-He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ." Atse Levibii lɛ kɛje Osɔfoi lɛ ahe
"Shi moŋ Levibii ni shi mi kɛtee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ ni amɛyanyiɛ amɛwɔji asɛɛ be ni Israelbii du gbɛ lɛ, abaagbla amɛtoi.

Amɛbaasɔmɔ yɛ mi-He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, amɛbaabu mi-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ agboi lɛ anaa, ni amɛbaasɔmɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli hu. Amɛ amɛbaagbe kooloi ni akɛbaashã shãaafɔlei lɛ, kɛ maŋbii lɛ afɔlei lɛ; ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛbaawa maŋbii lɛ ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ.
Akɛni Levibii lɛ sɔmɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ amɛwɔji lɛ anaa, ni no hã Israel we lɛ fee esha hewɔ lɛ, mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikã mihe kitã akɛ mibagbla amɛtoi.
Amɛbɛŋkɛŋ mi koni amɛbasɔmɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi; ni amɛbɛŋkɛŋ minibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ ekoeko kwraa he. Shi moŋ, amɛhiɛ baashwie shi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ, mikɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli nitsumɔ baawo amɛdɛŋ koni amɛtsu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa ni atsu yɛ mli lɛ." Osɔfoi lɛ

"Osɔfoi lɛ ni jɛ Levi akutso lɛ mli, ni amɛji Zadok shwiei, mɛi ni kã he amɛsɔmɔ mi yɛ mi-He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, be mli ni Israelbii lɛ du gbɛ kɛje mihe lɛ, amɛ amɛbaabɛŋkɛ mi ni amɛsɔmɔ mi. Amɛ amɛbaashã fɔ kɛ lá afɔle lɛ amɛha mi. Yehowa kɛɛ.
Amɛ amɛbaabote mi-He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛ amɛbaabɛŋkɛ mikplɔ̃ lɛ ni amɛsɔmɔ mi; ni amɛ amɛbaatsu minii amɛhã mi.
Kɛ amɛmiiya Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛwo klala atadei. Amɛkawo kuŋtu nɔ ko nɔ ko be mli ni amɛsɔmɔɔ yɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ agboi lɛ anaa kɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
"Amɛfi klala bɔnduku, ni amɛwo klala tswakoto. Amɛkafi amɛmli kɛ nɔ ko ni baahã latsa baatsa amɛ.

Ni kɛji amɛmiije kpo kɛya maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛjie amɛtadei ni amɛwo kɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛshwie He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ piai lɛ amli. Amɛwo atadei krokomɛi koni nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akatsɛŋe maŋbii lɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ akashɛ amɛyi, ni amɛkato amɛyi hu; shi moŋ amɛshwao nɔ kɛkɛ.
Osɔfo ko osɔfo ko akanu wain kɛji eeya mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Amɛkaŋɔ yoo okulafo loo yoo ni ashwie lɛ; shi moŋ osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ oblayoo fro ni jɛ Israel we lɛ shwiei lɛ amli, loo okulafo ni ji osɔfo ko ŋa okulafo.
"Osɔfo lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni jeee krɔŋkrɔŋ teŋ. Amɛha amɛle srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tseee kɛ nɔ ni he tse teŋ.

Kɛji naataamɔ ko te shi lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ nɔŋŋ afee kojolɔi ni amɛkura sane lɛ yɛ mimlai kɛ akpɔi lɛ anaa. Amɛye mimlai kɛ mikpɔi ni kɔɔ migbii juji ni mito lɛ ahe lɛ anɔ. Amɛfee mihejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Amɛkaya gbonyo ko he ni amɛkɛbule amɛhe; kɛ̃lɛ yɛ tsɛ loo nyɛ loo binuu loo biyoo, loo nyɛminuu loo nyɛmiyoo ni bɛ wu pɛ he amɛaanyɛ amɛbule amɛhe yɛ.
Kɛji ebule ehe lɛ emɛ kɛyashi gbii kpawo dani ehe aaatse.
Gbi nɔ ni eyaa He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ koni eyasɔmɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eyashã ehe esha afɔle. Mi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ.
"Osɔfoi lɛ bɛ gboshinii ko; miji amɛgboshinii. Amɛkana gboshinii ko kwraa yɛ Israel. Miji amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Nii ni amɛye ji niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ esha he afɔle lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ. Asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ajɔɔ nɔ yɛ Israel atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Nyɛŋmɔshinii fɛɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛshãa afɔlei nyɛhãa mi lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni. Asaŋ klɛŋklɛŋ ma aboloo ni nyɛaashã lɛ, akɛhã osɔfoi lɛ, koni mijɔɔmɔ ahi nyɛwe.
Osɔfoi lɛ akaye looflɔ ko aloo kooloo ko ni gbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele, aloo kooloo ko tserɛ lɛ ni egbo."
45: Kɛji nyɛmiija shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛfoa eko nyɛhãa Yehowa, akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ko. Eshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ. Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he fɛɛ he afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Afo eshikpɔŋ ni ji egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ mli eko ni ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ. Biɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ama. Shikpɔŋ ni akã he kɛbɔle lɛ lɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ, afo emli eko; no kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma. Ni jɛi afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ, no mli Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ama.
Shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni shwɛɔ lɛ, akɛhã osɔfoi lɛ ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa ni amɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ. Etsɔ he ni abaamamɔ amɛshīai yɛ, ni jɛi hu afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ fã ko ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma lɛ akɛhã Levibii ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ. Amɛmamɔ maji yɛ nɔ ni amɛhi mli.

Shikpɔŋ lɛ mli he krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ masɛi lɛ nyɛfoa shikpɔŋ ko hu ni lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi akpei enumɔ, kɛ ekɛlɛ ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ; ni ama maŋ yɛ nɔ, ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaanyɛ jɛi ahi. Lumɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ

Afo shikpɔŋ lɛ eko ahã lumɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ. Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ yɛ anai. Ni ebokãgbɛ husu lɛ eyamɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ. Bɔ ni afee ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni aha Israel weku lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko afee pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ lumɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ Israel, koni milumɛi lɛ akawa mimaŋbii lɛ ayi dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ lumɛi lɛ aha Israel we lɛ ana shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa. Mlai ni awoɔ lumɔ lɛ

Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Ao, nyɛ Israel lumɛi, bɔ ni nyɛfee lɛ efa. Nyɛfɔ̃a yiwalɛ kɛ nɔnyɛɛ nifeemɔi lɛ, ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane koni nyɛfee nɔ ni ja. Nyɛkpaa mimaŋbii lɛ shwiemɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Nyɛkɛ ŋsɛnii ni ja kɛ efa ni ja kɛ bat ni ja asusua nii.
"Efa kɛ bat aye egbɔ, koni bat lɛ aye homer mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome, ni efa lɛ hu homer mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome; homer, afee tɛ ni afo.
"Susumɔnii krokomɛi nɛ; Gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ feɔ shekel kome. Shekeli nyɔŋmai enyɔ, shekeli nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ shekeli nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ afee mina kome ahã nyɛ.

"Afɔle ni nyɛbaashã nɛ; Ŋmãa efa mlijaa ekpaa mli ekome ni ji homer mlijaa nyɔŋmai ekpaa mli ekome, ni ji homer mlijaa nyɔŋmai ekpaa mli ekome. Akoko hu efa mlijaa ekpaa mli ekome, ni ji homer mlijaa nyɔŋmai ekpaa mli ekome.
Mu he mla nɛ: Mu bat kome mlijaa nyɔŋmai mli ekome, ni ji mu kor mlijaa oha mli ekome. (Kor tamɔ homer nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ bat nyɔŋma feɔ homer kome)

Too he mla nɛ: Israel weku fɛɛ weku ajie too kome yɛ tooi ohai enyɔ mli ekɛbashã afɔle. Akɛ nibii nɛɛ ashã niyenii afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle kɛ shidaa afɔle koni akɛkpãtã nyɛhe eshai lɛ aha nyɛ. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ aŋɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ ahã lumɔ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ.

Lumɔ lɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ ji akɛ, lɛ eha kooloi ni akɛbaashã afɔlei ni ji shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ gbii juji kɛ nyɔji heei kɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii kɛ Israelbii agbii juji krokomɛi ni amɛyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Lɛ nɔŋŋ eha nɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ shãaafɔle lɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ, koni akɛkpãtã aha Israel we lɛ." Gbiijuji lɛ
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ tsina oblanyo ni kpa ko kwraa bɛ ehe, koni okɛtsuu He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he.

Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ kooloo ni akɛshã esha he afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko, koni ekɛdiki Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaatsei lɛ ahe kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishitoo koji ejwɛ lɛ ahe; ekɛdiki shinaatsei ni yɔɔ agbo ni kã kɛyaa mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe hu.
Nyɛfea nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ nyɛhã mɔ ni jeee kwa ekwa efee esha, loo mɔ ni leee ni efee esha ko lɛ, koni akɛtsuu Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he.
"Asaŋ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛyea Hehoo lɛ. Aye aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã gbii kpawo.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ lumɔ lɛ ahã tsinanuu kome ni akɛshã esha afɔle ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Gbijurɔyeli gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ lɛ, ehã tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛniii kpawo ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe, ni akɛshã shãa afɔle aha Yehowa. Daa gbi lɛ ehã kpakpo kome hu ni akɛshã esha he afɔle.
Nɔ ni ehã ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle nɛ ŋmãa efa kome afata tsinanuu kome he, ni ŋmãa efa kome afata ojwɛni kome he; ni ŋmãa efa fɛɛ efa lɛ akɛ mu hiŋ kome afata he.

Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ abaaye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ, gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, lumɔ lɛ ahã nibii nɛɛ akɛshã esha afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei kɛ mu lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ."
46: Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ ni kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ, aŋa daa nitsumɔ gbii ekpaa lɛ; shi hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ agble, ni nyɔŋ hee gbi lɛ nɔ hu agble.

Ni lumɔ lɛ ajɛ kponɔgbɛ etsɔ̃ agbo lɛ koi lɛ shi kɛbote mli, ni eyadamɔ agbo lɛ shinaatso lɛ he. Osɔfoi lɛ ashã eshãa afɔle lɛ kɛ etoiŋjɔlɛ afɔlei lɛ ahã lɛ, ni eja Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa yɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ naa; ni eje kpo. Shi agbo lɛ, akaŋa kwraa kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi.
Maŋbii lɛ aba Yehowa hiɛ ni amɛbaja lɛ yɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ kɛ nyɔji heei lɛ anɔ.
Shãa afɔle ni lumɔ lɛ kɛba ebaha Yehowa yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ ji too gwaŋtɛŋbii ekpaa ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Niyenii afɔle ni afata ojwɛni kome he ji, ŋmãa efa kome; ni niyenii afɔle ni afata gwaŋteŋbii lɛ ahe ji bɔ ni lɛ eeenyɛ. Ekɛ mu hin kome afata ŋmãa efa kome fɛɛ efa kome he.
Nyɔŋ hee gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ lumɔ lɛ baahã tsina oblanyo kome kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋbii ekpaa kɛ ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe.
Niyenii afɔle ni baafata tsinanuu kome he ji ŋmãa efa kome; ni ojwɛni kome hu ŋmãa efa kome; ni gwaŋtɛŋbii lɛ hu ŋmãa bɔ ni lɛ eeenyɛ ehã. Ni ekɛ mu hin kome afata ŋmãa efa kome fɛɛ efa kome he.
Kɛji lumɔ lɛ baabote mli lɛ etsɔ̃ agbo lɛ koi lɛ shi gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛya mli, ni etsɔ̃ jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛje kpo.

"Kɛji maŋbii lɛ miiba abaja Yehowa yɛ gbiijuji lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛbote mli ni abaja lɛ, etsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛje kpo. Ni mɔ ni aaatsɔ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛbote mli lɛ, etsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛje kpo. Mɔ ko akatsɔ̃ agbo ni etsɔ̃ kɛba mli lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛje kpo. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛje kpo.
Kɛji maŋbii lɛ miibote mli lɛ, lumɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ abote mli; ni kɛ amɛmiije kpo hu, ekɛ amɛ aje kpo.

Gbijurɔ fɛɛ gbijurɔ nɔ lɛ niyenii afɔle ni afata tsina oblanyo kome he ji ŋmãa efa kome; ni ojwɛni kome hu nɔ lɛ ji ŋmãa efa kome; ni ekɛ ŋmãa bɔ ni eeenyɛ afata gwaŋtɛŋbii lɛ ahe. Ni mu hin kome afata ŋmãa efa kome fɛɛ efa kome he.

"Kɛji lumɔ lɛ baashã tsuijurɔ naa afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, shãa afɔle jio, shidaa afɔle jio, agble agbo ni kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ ahã lɛ koni ekɛ eshãa afɔlei lɛ loo shidaa afɔle lɛ ayahã tamɔ efeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ eje kpo; ni kɛ eje kpo sɛɛ lɛ, aŋa agbo lɛ." Daa gbi afɔle lɛ
"Daa gbi leebi lɛ, ekɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle ahã Yehowa. Eshã afɔle nɛɛ daa leebi.
Ekɛ niyenii afɔle afata he daa leebi. Eŋɔ ŋmãa mamu efa mlijaa ekpaa mli ekome, ni ekɛ mu hin mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome afata he, ni akɛkpɔtɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa. Akpɔ ni akã shi daa ji no.
No hewɔ lɛ aha gwaŋtɛŋbi lɛ kɛ ŋmãa mamu lɛ kɛ mu ni akɛbaasha shãa afɔle lɛ daa leebi. Daa shãa afɔle ji no." Lumɔ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Kɛji lumɔ lɛ kɛ egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli eko kɛ ebihii lɛ eko lɛ, no atsɔ̃ ebi lɛ nɔ; egboshinii ni ena ji no.

Shi kɛji lumɔ lɛ fo egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko eke etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahi tsulɔ lɛ dɛŋ kɛyashi heyeli afi lɛ nɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛku sɛɛ ehã lumɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Shi ebihii lɛ pɛ baanyɛ aŋɔ gboshinii ni akɛke amɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.

Asaŋ lumɔ lɛ akashɔ̃ maŋbii lɛ agboshinii lɛ eko ni eshwie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ. Shi moŋ ekɛ nɔ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ mli eko ahã ebihii lɛ ni etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akashɔ̃ mimaŋbii lɛ eko gboshinii yɛ edɛŋ." Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli kpatai lɛ
Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi tsɔ̃ gbɛ ko ni kã agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli kɛtee kooyigbɛ he ni osɔfoi lɛ atsui krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Ni jɛi lɛ mina he ko yɛ tsui lɛ anaigbɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Biɛ nɛɛ ji he ni osɔfoi lɛ baahoo sɔ̃ afɔlei kɛ esha afɔlei lɛ yɛ; ni biɛ amɛaashã niyenii afɔlei lɛ yɛ; bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛkaje kpo kɛmiiya agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akatsɛŋe maŋbii lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ mi je kpo kɛba agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛbɔle kpo lɛ nɔ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ. Ni koŋ fɛɛ koŋ lɛ kpo yɛ jɛi.
Ni koŋ fɛɛ koŋ lɛ afo kpo bibioo ko yɛ jɛi; ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃; kpoi bibii ejwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛdramɔ ekome.
Atswa tɛ gbogbo kɛbɔle kpo fɛɛ kpo he kɛkpe kpula, ni afee latɛi akpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ yɛ shishigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Biɛ nɛɛ ji kpatai, he ni Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli suɔlɔi lɛ baahoo loo ni maŋbii kɛbashã afɔlei lɛ yɛ."
47: Nuu lɛ kɛ mi ku sɛɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ekoŋŋ; ni naa, nu miiho kɛmiijɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinaa kpoku lɛ shishi kɛmiiya bokãgbɛ he ni Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hiɛgbɛ kwɛɔ lɛ. Nu lɛ miiho kɛmiijɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ wuoyigbɛ yɛ shinaa lɛ kpo ku lɛ shishi, yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni akɛ mi je kpo kɛtsɔ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ mli, ni akpla mi kɛlɔgɔ shi kɛba agbonaagbɛ agbo ni kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ naa. Ni nu lɛ miiho kɛmiijɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Nuu lɛ hiɛ susumɔ kpãa yɛ edɛŋ ni etee bokãgbɛ eyasusu nu lɛ ni efee ninetalɔi akpe, ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛfo nu lɛ, ni nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ ta nane kpɔ nɔ.
Esaa esusu nu lɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi akpe; ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛfo nu lɛ, ni nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ ta nakutso. Esusu ninetalɔi akpe kroko hu, ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛfo. Nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ ta hɛ.
Esusu nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi akpe, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ faa ni minyɛɛɛ mafo. Ejaakɛ nu lɛ mli kwɔ ni etsɔ̃ faa ni anyɛɛɛ afo, shi srɛmɔ asreɔ kɛfoɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ebi mi akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ona enɛ?" Kɛkɛ ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba faa lɛ naa ekoŋŋ.
Ni be ni miku misɛɛ miba lɛ, mina tsei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ yɛ faa lɛ toi biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ hoɔ kɛyaa bokãgbɛ, ni emaa eyi shi kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ enaa yawoɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli. Kɛji nu lɛ bote Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ehãa Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli ni tsɔ̃ɔ nuŋma."

"He fɛɛ he ni nujɔɔ nɛɛ hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ, jɛi kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni hiɛ kã lɛ yi baana wala, ni emli loi baafa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. Ejaakɛ nujɔɔ nɛɛ hoɔ ewoɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni ehãa Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nuŋma, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ enaa wala.
Wolɛi aaadamɔ shi kɛjɛ En-Gedi ŋshɔnaa aahuu kɛyagbee En-Eglaim ŋshɔnaa tɔ̃ɔ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ yaa kamɔhe. Emli loi srɔtoisrɔtoi aaafa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ tamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli loi lɛ.
Shi ni ni yɔɔ emukpoi kɛ ehewɔ ŋmiamɔi lɛ amli lɛ tsɔŋ nuŋma. Nomɛi baanyɔ ŋoo.

Yelitsei srɔtoisrɔtoi fɛɛ baakwɛ̃ yɛ faa lɛ toi biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni amɛyibai kplaŋ ni amɛyibii hu kplaŋ shi moŋ nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ lɛ, amɛbaawo yibii heei, ejaakɛ nuŋma ni jɛɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hãa amɛ nu. Amɛyibii aaatsɔ̃ niyenii, ni amɛyibai lɛ aatsɔ̃ tsabaa." Shikpɔŋ lɛ husui lɛ
"Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛbaaja nyɛhã Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ehusui nɛ: Yosef akutso lɛ ana toi enyɔ.
Mikã shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛjaa lɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana pɛpɛɛpɛ tamɔ enyɛmi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ nɛ: Kooyigbɛ lɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyatsɔ Hetlon kɛ Lebo-Hamat kɛ Zedad,
Kɛ Berota kɛ Sibraim ni kã Damasko kɛ Hamat husu lɛ nɔ lɛ. Husu lɛ atsa nɔ aahuu kɛyashi Hazer-Hatikon ni kã Hauran husu naa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kooyigbɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ he kɛtsɔ bokãgbɛ kɛya Hazer-Eno ni kã Damasko kɛ Hamat husui lɛ anaa yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ. Enɛ aaatsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ husu lɛ.

"Bokãgbɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Hazer-Enon ni kã Hauran kɛ Damasko teŋ lɛ. Aŋɔ Yordan Faa lɛ akɛ husu, bɔ ni Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ aye anaigbɛ, ni Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ hu aye bokãgbɛ. Husu lɛ akã shi aahuu kɛyashi Tamar tɔ̃ɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ ŋshɔ lɛ he. Enɛ baatsɔ̃ bokãgbɛ husu.
"Wuoyigbɛ husu lɛ nɛ. Kɛjɛ Tamar kɛtsɔ̃ Meribat-Kadesh Faa lɛ he, kɛtsɔ̃ Egipt nujɔɔ lɛ he kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ. Enɛ baatsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ husu.
"Anaigbɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ he, ni etsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ aahuu kɛyashi he ko yɛ Lebo-Hamat ŋlɛnɔ. Enɛ baatsɔ̃ anaigbɛ husu lɛ.
Nɛkɛ nyɛjaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhaa nyɛhe yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ anaa.

Nyɛfɔ̃a oshiki kɛjaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhãa nyɛhe, ni etsɔ̃ gboshinii eha nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni amɛfɔɔ bii yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ. Amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ Israel fɔmɔbii nɔŋŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ aja shikpɔŋ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ akɛ gboshinii hã nyɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ anaa.
"Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli ni gbɔ ko yɔɔ lɛ, aha lɛ gboshinii lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ akutso lɛ mli." Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
48: "Bɔ ni aja shikpɔŋ lɛ aha Israel akutsei lɛ nɛ: Dan akutso lɛ na kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ yɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛtsɔ Hetlon maŋ wulu lɛ kɛtsɔ Lebo-Hamat kɛyamɔ Hazar-Enom yɛ Damasko kooyigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ. Dan shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kã shi kɛjɛ bokã kɛtee anai.
Asher shikpɔŋ lɛ tsa Dan nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Naftali nɔ tsa Asher nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Manase nɔ lɛ tsa Naftali nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Efraim nɔ lɛ tsa Manase nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Ruben nɔ lɛ tsa Efraim nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Yuda nɔ lɛ tsa Ruben nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ. He ko krɛdɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ

"Nyɛfoa shikpɔŋ lɛ he ko krɛdɛɛ ni kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ je husu kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyashi anaigbɛ nyɛfoɔ shi. No lɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, ni ekɛlɛ atamɔ gbɛfaŋnii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anai husu lɛ nɔ. He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama teŋ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ he krɛdɛɛ ni nyɛbaafo nyɛfɔ̃ shi kɛha Yehowa lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ.

Shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ, bɔ ni ajra lɛ nɛ: Asusu ekɛlɛ ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛ kooyigbɛ ni wuoyigbɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ bokãgbɛ ni anaigbɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ama shikpɔŋ nɛɛ teŋ.
Akɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ahã osɔfoi ni afɔ amɛ mu ni jɛ Zadok shwiei lɛ amli lɛ. Amɛ amɛji mɛi ni sɔmɔ mi anɔkwale mli be ni Israelbii kɛ Levibii lɛ du gbɛ lɛ.
Enɛ afee amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ mli, ni ebɛŋkɛ Levibii lɛ ahusu lɛ.

Levibii lɛ hu ana amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ osɔfoi lɛ ahusu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ. Ekɛlɛ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyashi anaigbɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ emumɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛyashi wuoyigbɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma.
Amɛkahɔ̃ɔ eko, ni amɛkɛkatsake eko hu. Amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ krɛdɛɛ ni akɔ nɛɛ he ko he ko akahã mɔ ko, ejaakɛ eji shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ha Yehowa.

"Agbɛnɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni shwɛɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi akpei enumɔ kɛ ekɛlɛ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ lɛ akã shi akɛ kwamaŋnɔ, ni akɛfee shihilɛhei kɛ maŋ he shikpɔŋ, ni maŋ lɛ ahi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ teŋ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, no ji ninetalɔi akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛjɛ koŋ kome kɛyamɔ koŋ kome.
"Shikpɔŋ ni akã shi eflo yɛ maŋ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛbɔle lɛ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛtee wuoyigbɛ afee ninetalɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛjɛ bokã kɛtee anai hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shikpɔŋ ni shwɛɔ ni kã shi yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ. Akɛ no afee ŋmɔ koni ana niyenii kɛjɛ mli aha nitsulɔi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ maŋ lɛ he nii lɛ.
Maŋ lɛ mli nitsulɔi ni jɛ Israel akutsei lɛ amli lɛ, ahu jɛi.

"Belɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfo nyɛfɔ̃ shi kɛha he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ, no ji ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ. 21-22 "Agbɛnɛ shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ ni kã Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ he biɛ kɛ biɛ, kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyashi anaigbɛ lɛ, afee lumɔ lɛ nɔ. Ekã shi kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he kɛtee bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa, ni anaigbɛ hu ekã kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ. Ekooyigbɛ husu ji he ni Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ kã lɛ, ni ewuoyigbɛ husu ji Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ husu naa." Akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ashikpɔŋ
"Ni akutsei ni eshwɛ lɛ nɛ: Kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Benyamin nɔ ni.
Ni Benyamin husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Simeon nɔ ni.
Ni Simeon husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Isakar nɔ ni.
Ni Isakar husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zebulon nɔ ni.
Ni Zebulon husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Gad nɔ ni.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛha Gad akutso lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Tamar kɛnyiɛ wuoyi anaigbɛ kɛyamɔ Meriba-Kadesh Faa lɛ kɛtso Egipt nujɔɔ lɛ he kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Enɛ ji shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛbaaja nyɛha Israel akutsei lɛ; amɛgboshinii kɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnii ji enɛ. Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ." Yerusalem agboi lɛ
"Yerusalem maŋ lɛ hiɛ agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ gbogbo kome koŋ kɛyashi gbogbo kroko koŋ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ, ni eko fɛɛ eko hiɛ agboi etɛ̃;
ni akɛ Israel akutsei lɛ agbɛi ewo agbo fɛɛ agbo. Kooyigbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Ruben kɛ Yuda kɛ Levi.
Bokãgbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Yosef kɛ Benyamin kɛ Dan.
Wuoyigbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Simeon kɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon, ni anaigbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Gad kɛ Asher kɛ Naftali.
Hewɔ lɛ gbogbo ni bɔle maŋ lɛ he kpula kɛkpe lɛ ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ. Kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi ji: 'Yehowa yɛ jɛi!'"

1: Koresh, Perisa maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa wiemɔ ni ewie kɛtsɔ̃ Yeremia nɔ lɛ aba mli hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kanya Koresh yɛ mumɔ lɛ mli, ni ehã aŋmã, ni ashiɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli he fɛɛ he akɛ,
"Bɔ ni Koresh, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Yehowa ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ ewo midɛŋ, ni efã mi akɛ miyama shīa mihã lɛ yɛ Yerusalem yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa webii ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, Yehowa efã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ koni afã kɛya Yerusalem yɛ Yuda, koni ayama Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shīa lɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ajaa yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, we lɛ.

Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshwɛ yɛ nomii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni eyato gbɔ yɛ lɛ, jɛmɛbii lɛ aye abua lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ nibiinibii kɛ kooloi. Asaŋ amɛhã nikee nii yɛ tsuijurɔ naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shīa ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ hewɔ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛ Benyamin wekui lɛ ayitsei kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kanya amɛ yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ, fã koni amɛya ni amɛyasaa Yehowa shīa lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ amɛna.
Mɛi ni kɛ amɛ je shwieka lɛ fɛɛ wa amɛ kɛ jwɛitɛ okpolui pɛmpɛbii kɛ shika kɛ nibii nibii kɛ kooloi kɛ nibii ni jra wa; ni asaŋ amɛhã nikeenii yɛ tsuijurɔ naa.
Yehowa we lɛ okpolui kɛ kpuji ni Nebukadnezar yaloo kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛba akɛbawo ejemawɔŋ lɛ we lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Koresh jie amɛ kpo.
Maŋtsɛ Koresh tu nibii nɛɛ ewo Mitredat, shikatolɔ lɛ dɛŋ; ni Mitredat kane, ni eŋmla ewo wolo mli ehã Sheshbazar, Yuda lamɔ lɛ.
Nibii nɛɛ ayibɔ nɛ: shika okpolui nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, jwɛitɛi okpolui akpe, ŋɛsui nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu,
shika kpuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, jwɛitɛi kpuji ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋma, kɛ kpuji krokomɛi akpe.
Nibii lɛ fɛɛ, shikanii kɛ jwɛitɛi nii lɛ, feɔ akpei enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ. Nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Sheshbazar ji mɔ ni kɛba be ni akɛ mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ jɛ Babilon kɛba Yerusalem lɛ.
2: Agbɛnɛ naa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba Yerusalem kɛ Yuda lɛ agbɛii. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee emaŋ.
Mɛi ni nyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛba ji Zerubabel kɛ Yeshua kɛ Nehemia kɛ Seraia kɛ Reelaia lɛ Mordekai kɛ Bilshan kɛ Mispar kɛ Bigewai kɛ Rehum kɛ Baana. Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii lɛ ayibɔ nɛ:
Paroshbii lɛ: akpei enyɔ kɛ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ.
Shefatiabii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ.
Arabii lɛ: ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ.
Pahat-Moabbii ni jɛ Yeshua kɛ Yoabbii lɛ, akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Elambii lɛ, akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Zatubii lɛ: ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
Zakaibii lɛ: ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Banibii lɛ, ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Bebaibii lɛ, ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Azgadbii lɛ: akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Adonikambii lɛ, ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa.
Bigewaibii lɛ: akpei enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekpaa.
Adinbii lɛ: ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Aterbii ni jɛ Hezekia nɔ lɛ mli lɛ: nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Bezaibii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Yorabii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Hashumbii lɛ, ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ etɛ̃.
Gibarbii lɛ: nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ.
Betlehembii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Netofabii lɛ: nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekpaa.
Anatotbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyo.
Azmawetbii lɛ: nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Kitriat-Arimbii kɛ Kefirabii kɛ Beerotbii lɛ: ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃.
Ramabii kɛ Gebabii lɛ: ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome.
Mikmashbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Betelbii kɛ Aibii lɛ: ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Nebobii lɛ: nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Magbishbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekpaa.
Elam kroko lɛ mli bii lɛ: akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Harimbii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Lodbii kɛ Hadidbii kɛ Onobii lɛ: ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Yerikobii lɛ: ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
Senaabii lɛ: akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Osɔfoi lɛ ni ji Yedaiabii ni jɛ Yeshua we lɛ: ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃.
Imerbii lɛ: akpe kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Pashurbii lɛ: akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpawo.
Harimbii lɛ: akpe kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo.
Levibii lɛ ni ji Yeshuabii kɛ Kademielbii ni jɛ Hodaviabii ateŋ lɛ: nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ.
Lalatsɛmɛi ni ji Asafbii lɛ: oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ abii ni ji Shalumbii kɛ Aterbii kɛ Talmonbii kɛ Akubbii kɛ Hatitabii kɛ Shobaibii lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ nɛɛhu.
Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ: Zihabii kɛ Hasufabii kɛ Tabaotbii lɛ.
Kerosbii kɛ Siahabii kɛ Padonbii lɛ,
Lebanabii kɛ Hagababii kɛ Akubbii lɛ,
Hagabbii kɛ Shamlaibii kɛ Hananbii lɛ,
Gedelbii kɛ Gaharbii kɛ Reaiabii lɛ,
Rezinbii kɛ Nekodabii kɛ Gazambii lɛ,
Uzabii kɛ Peseabii kɛ Besaibii lɛ,
Asnabii kɛ Meunimbii kɛ Nefisimbii lɛ,
Bakbukbii kɛ Hakufabii kɛ Harhurbii lɛ,
Bazlutbii kɛ Mehidabii kɛ Harshabii lɛ,
Barkosbii kɛ Siserabii kɛ Temabii lɛ,
Nezaibii kɛ Hatifabii lɛ.
Solomon tsuji lɛ abii lɛ: Sotiabii kɛ Hasoferetbii kɛ Perudabii lɛ,
Yaalabii kɛ Darkonbii kɛ Gidelbii lɛ.
Shefatiabii kɛ Hatilbii kɛ Pokeret-Hazebaimbii kɛ Amibii lɛ.
Sɔlemɔwe lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Solomon tsuji abii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛyibɔ ji ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enyɔ.
Naa mɛi ni fã kɛjɛ Tel-Mela kɛ Tel-Harsha kɛ Kerub kɛ Adan kɛ Imer kɛba, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei loo amɛseshi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Israelbii ji amɛ.
Delaiabii kɛ Tobiabii kɛ Nekodabii ashwiei lɛ feɔ gbɔmɛi ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.

Mɛi komɛi jɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ ni amɛ hu amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛtsɛmɛi awei nakai nɔŋŋ. Amɛji Habaiabii lɛ kɛ Hakozbii lɛ kɛ Barzilaibii lɛ. (Barzilai nɛɛ, eŋɔ Barzilai, Gileadnyo lɛ, biyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛkɛ ni ekɔ eshaanuu Barzilai gbɛi lɛ).
Osɔfoi nɛɛ tao amɛweku gbɛi wolo lɛ, shi anaaa; hewɔ lɛ ahã amɛkpa osɔfoyeli ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
Amralo lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkaye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ eko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni osɔfo ko aaate shi ni ekɛ̃ Urim kɛ Tumin aaatao nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sunɔɔ akɛ afee.
Mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ fɛɛ naa shiɔ akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Esoro amɛtsuji hii kɛ amɛweyei. Mɛnɛɛmɛi hu anaa shiɔ akpei kpawo kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo. Amɛhiɛ hii lalatsɛmɛi kɛ yei lalatsɛmɛi ohai enyɔ,
okpɔŋɔi ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa, tejiokpɔŋɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejɛ kɛ enumɔ,
yomai ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ, tejii akpei ekpaa kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Be ni mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ bashɛ Yehowa we lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi bake nii yɛ tsuijurɔ naa yɛ Yehowa we lɛ hewɔ, koni akɛsaa ama Yehowa we lɛ etsutsu shimaahe lɛ.
Onukpai nɛɛ hã bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ ni akɛwo nitsumɔ lɛ fotro lɛ mli: shika kiloi ohai enumɔ, jwɛitɛi kiloi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ, kɛ osɔfoi atadei oha.

Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hi Yerusalem kɛ ehewɔ akrowai amli; ni lalatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hi maji ni ahã amɛ lɛ amli; ni Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ hi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaji amli.
3: Be ni nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ shɛ ni Israelbii ni ba lɛ ehe shi yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ, amɛ bluublu amɛbabua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalɛm.

Kɛkɛ ni Yeshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ enanemɛi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Zerubabɛl, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ ewekumɛi kɛ nitsumɔ wo mli, ni amɛna Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koni amɛshã shãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gbɔmɔ Mose mla lɛ mli lɛ.

Tsɛbelɛ nomii lɛ she maŋsɛɛbii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ gbeyei moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɛ eshimaahe lɛ nɔŋŋ. Amɛshã leebi shãa afɔlei kɛ gbɛkɛ shãa afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa.
Amɛye asesei agbijurɔ lɛ hu, tamɔ bɔ ni ato lɛ, ni amɛshã daa gbi shãa afɔlei lɛ, yɛ yibɔ ni ato ahã daa gbi lɛ naa.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ hu amɛshã daa shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee afɔlei lɛ kɛ gbii krɔŋkrɔŋi fɛɛ anɔ shãa afɔlei ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ashã lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nii ni ekɛbakeɔ Yehowa yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ.
Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛnɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ amɛjɛ amɛbɔ̃i shãa afɔlei lɛ ashãa kɛ Yehowa hãmɔ, tsɛbelɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ anako ato shishi.

Maŋbii lɛ hã shika kɛhã gbogbotswalɔi kɛ srɛŋkifoi lɛ anyɔmɔwoo. Asaŋ amɛhã niyenii kɛ dãa kɛ mu akɛ akɛhã Sidonbii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ, koni amɛyaŋɔ tsenedru tsei kɛjɛ Lebanon kɛba Yopa ŋshɔ lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Koresh, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ, ehã amɛ hegbɛ akɛ afee lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Israelbii lɛ ba Yehowa we lɛ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, enɔ afi ni ji enyɔ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ, enɔ afi ni ji enyɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Yeshua, Yozadak bi lɛ, kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba Yerusalem lɛ bɔ̃i nitsumɔ lɛ. Amɛfamɔ Levibii fɛɛ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ koni amɛkwɛ Yehowa we lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ.

Yeshua kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, kɛ Kadmiel kɛ ebii ni ji Yuda weku lɛ, fee ekome kɛkɔ Nyɔŋmɔ we le nitsumɔi lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ lɛ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ. Levibii ni jɛ Henadad weku lɛ mli kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi hu ye bua amɛ.

Be ni tsumalɔi lɛ to Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ fanesi lɛ shishi lɛ, osɔfoi ni ewula kɛ amɛtadei lɛ badamɔ shi kɛ amɛtɛtrɛmantrɛi ni amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛ Levibii lɛ ni ji Asafbii lɛ hu kɛ amɛŋoŋoi, koni amɛkafo Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ david eto gbɛjianɔ lɛ.

Amɛla ni amɛhereheree nɔ amɛkɛkafo Yehowa, ni amɛkɛda lɛ shi amɛkɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ Israel lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ." Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔ oshe waa amɛkɛkafo Yehowa yɛ Yehowa shīa lɛ shishitoo lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii, mɛi ni ji hiimeji ni na klɛŋklɛŋ shīa lɛ fo waa, be ni ato shīa nɛɛ shishi yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ; shi mɛ babaoo hu bɔ oshe waa kɛ nyamɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ yooo emli nɔ ji nyamɔ oshebɔɔ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji yaafo blɔmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ bɔ oshe waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni anu yɛ shɔŋŋ.
4: Agbɛnɛ be ni Yuda kɛ Benyamin henyɛlɔi lɛ nu akɛ mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ miima Sɔlemɔtsu ahã Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ,

amɛba Zerubabel kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ, nu amɛbakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ nyɛ amãa; ejaakɛ nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni nyɛjaa lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔjaa, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔshãa afɔle wɔhãa kɛjɛ Esar-Hadon Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ŋɔ wɔ kɛba biɛ lɛ yinɔ."

Shi Zerubabel kɛ Yeshua kɛ, Israel tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpa ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛ wɔmiima shīa wɔhã wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeee wɔkɛ nyɛ sane ni; shi sɔŋŋ wɔɔma wɔhã Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni maŋtsɛ Koresh, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo wɔ kitã lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni eba ebahii shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tao akɛ amɛhã Yudafoi lɛ anijiaŋ aje wui ni amɛwo Yudafoi lɛ ahe gbeyei koni amɛkama shīa lɛ.
Amɛbɔ amralofoi apaa amɛwo Yudafoi lɛ koni amɛhã Yudafoi lɛ ayiŋtoo lɛ afee eflo kɛjɛ Koresh, Persia Maŋtsɛ lɛ be mli aahuu kɛyashi Dario, Persia maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ.
Be mli nu Ahashwerosh bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ŋmãa wolo kɛyaflɔɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem lɛ anaa,.
Asaŋ Artashasta yinɔ lɛ Bislam kɛ Mitredad kɛ Tabeel kɛ enanemɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ŋmã wolo yahã Artashasta, Pershia maŋtsɛ lɛ. Aŋmã wolo yɛ Siriabii aniŋmãa mli, ni atsɔ̃ɔ shishi hu yɛ Siria wiemɔ mli.
Rehum, ajinafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ ŋma Yerusalem he wolo amɛyahã maŋtsɛ Artashasta akɛ,

"Mɛi ni ŋmã wolo nɛɛ ji Rehum, ajinafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni fata amɛhe kɛtsuɔ nii lɛ kɛ, kojolɔi lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ mlijai anɔyelɔi kɛ tsujinukpai kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Erek kɛ Babilon kɛ Susa, ni ji Elambii lɛ,
kɛ mɛi krokomɛi ni eshwɛ ni Osnapar gbɔmɔ wulu ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ loo amɛ ebato Samaria maji lɛ amli kɛ hei krokomɛi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ."
Wolo lɛ mli sane nɛ, "Aaŋmã wolo nɛɛ ayahã maŋtsɛ Artashasta. Maŋtsɛ Artashasta tsuji ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ adɛŋ wolo nɛɛ jɛ.

Wɔmiitao ni Nii Maŋtsɛ ana ale akɛ Yudafoi lɛ ni jɛ oŋɔɔ ba wɔŋɔɔ nɛɛ ebahe shi yɛ Yerusalem, ni amɛmiito atuatsɛlɔi amaŋ fɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Amɛtswa ehe gbogboi lɛ amɛgbe naa etã, ni amɛmiisaa efanesi lɛ hu,

Shi belɛ, Nii Maŋtsɛ ana ale akɛ kɛji ato nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni agbe ehe gbogboi lɛ anaa lɛ, no lɛ maŋbii lɛ woŋ onia kɛ maŋ too he kɛ gbɛjee too lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni be ni yi yaawula shi lɛ, ebaaye maŋtsɛ fotro lɛ awui.
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni Nii dɛŋ nii wɔyeɔ hewɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ wɔɔKwɛ ni Nii Maŋtsɛ he guɔ agbo; ni no hewɔ wɔtsu koni abatswa Nii Maŋtsɛ adafi nɛɛ,

koni atao yɛ otsɛmɛi awolo ni aŋmã nibii ni eba awo mli afɔ̃ shi lɛ mli. Kɛji akwɛ wolo mli lɛ, abaana yɛ mli akɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni. Amɛwoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ mlijai anɔyelɔi anaagba; ni kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, mɛi ayiŋ amɛwoɔ koni atsɛ atua. Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ ajwa maŋ nɛɛ.
Wɔmiihã Ni Maŋtsɛ ale akɛ kɛji ato nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni atswa ehe agbogboi lɛ, no lɛ, bo Nii, onaŋ nɔyeli he ko yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ."

Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu akɛ hetoo ba akɛ, "Miiŋma wolo nɛɛ mayahã Rehum, ajianafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛhefatalɔi ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ Samaria kɛ hei krokomɛi yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛ lɛ, miiŋa nyɛ.
Wolo ni nyɛkɛtsu akɛbahã wɔ lɛ, akane shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ atsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Mifã ni atao mli; ni ana akɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ maŋ nɛɛ teɔ shi ewoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; atseɔ atua, yɛ mli, ni awoɔ mɛi ayiŋ yɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ ahe.
Asaŋ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji hu eyi Yerusalem ni amɛye Eufrate Faa lɛ biɛgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni atsuɔ onia kɛ maŋ too kɛ gbɛjee shika ahãa amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛwoa akpɔ koni nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ afɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ too, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni akpɔ aaajɛ miŋɔɔ aba.
Nyɛkɛ sane nɛɛ akashashaoa shi, koni nibii akabafite waa wo mi."

Be ni akane Maŋtsɛ Artashasta wolo ni eŋmã lɛ yɛ Rehum kɛ Shimshai, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni fata amɛhe kɛtsuɔ nii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, amɛyiŋ kɛba Yerusalem oya, ni amɛbanina Yudafoi lɛ. Amɛkɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔnyɛɛ tsi Yudafoi lɛ anaa.
Kɛkɛ ni afɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ he nitsumɔ; ni ekã shi nakai kɛyashi Maŋtsɛ Dario, Persia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.
5: Nakai be mli lɛ gbalɔ Hagai kɛ gbalɔ Zakaria, Ido bi lɛ, gba yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli amɛhã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Yeshua, Yozadak bi lɛ, te shi ni amɛbɔi Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni Yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ mãa. Nyɔŋmɔ gbalɔi enyɔ lɛ fī amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛwa amɛ.

Nakai be mli lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Tatnai ni ji amralo ni kwɛɔ Eufrate faa lɛ biɛgbe lɛ kɛ Shetar-Boznai amɛnanemɛi lɛ, ba mɛi ni maa tsu lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nɔ ni amɛbi mɛi ni maa lɛ nɛ, "Namɔ fã nyɛ akɛ nyɛma nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ ni nyɛgbe naa?"
Asaŋ amɛbi mɛi ni maa tsu lɛ akɛ, "Hii ni maa lɛ, te amɛgbɛii hu?"
Shi Yudafoi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiŋmɛi kã Yudafoi onukpai lɛ ahe, ni mɛi ni ba lɛ, atsiii amɛ gbɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni sane lɛ yashɛ Dario ŋɔɔ ni eŋma hetoo kɛba.

Wolo ni Tatnai ni ji amralo ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ kɛ Shetar-Boznai kɛ mɛi ni fata amɛhe ni ji amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ tsu akɛyahã maŋtsɛ Dario lɛ mli lɛ, amɛbɔ lɛ amaniɛ, ni amaniɛ lɛ nɛ,
"Akɛ wolo nɛɛ miitsu ayahã Maŋtsɛ Dario. Nii hã manye!"

"Wɔmiitao ni Nii Maŋtsɛ ana ale akɛ wɔyiŋ wɔtee Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔtee Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ we lɛ. Aama kɛ tɛi kpleikplei, ni akɛ tsei eshwie egbogboi lɛ anɔ. Ahiɛ nɛkɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ mli kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ, ni eeya nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii lɛ edɛŋ.
"Kɛkɛ ni wɔbi amɛnukpai lɛ mɔ ni fã amɛ akɛ amɛma nɛkɛ shīa nɛɛ ni amɛsaa ehe kɛ emli amɛgbe naa lɛ.
Asaŋ wɔbibii amɛgbɛii hu, koni wɔŋmla amɛnukpai lɛ agbɛii ni wɔhã ole.
"Hetoo ni amɛhã wɔ nɛ, 'ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji ji wɔ. Wɔmiisaa shīa ni Israel maŋtsɛ agbo ko ma ni egbe naa jeeŋmɔ afii babaoo nɛ lɛ.
Shi akɛni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wo ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli la hewɔ lɛ, ehã Babilon maŋtsɛ, Nebukadnezar, Kaldeanyo lɛ, baye amɛnɔ kunim. Nebukadnezar kumɔ nɛkɛ shīa nɛɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋbii lɛ nom kɛtee Babilon.
Shi Koresh, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yinɔ klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo akpɔ akɛ abama nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ.

Shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛ jwɛitɛi nibii ni Nebukadnezar baloo yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ Babilon lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ Koresh jie yɛ Babilon sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli. Etu ewo mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sheshbazar ko ní ewo lɛ amralo yɛ Yuda lɛ dɛŋ;
ni efã Sheshbazar koni ekɛ nibii nɛɛ aya ni ekɛyawo Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ mli koni ehã asaa ama Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ yɛ eshimaahe lɛ.,
Kɛkɛ ni nɛkɛ Sheshbazar nɛɛ ba ni ebato Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ shishi. Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ mli aahuu kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ akã he aama, shi agbeko naa lolo.'
