"No hewɔ lɛ kɛji esa Nii Maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehã atao yɛ he ni akɛ saji ni aŋmla ashwie shi lɛ toɔ, yɛ Babilon lɛ, akɛ eyɛ mli akɛ Maŋtsɛ Koresh ewo akpɔ akɛ ayama nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ Yerusalem lo, koni Nii Maŋtsɛ atsu ni abakɛɛ wɔ nɔ ni esumɔɔ ni afee yɛ sane nɛɛ he."
6: Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Dario fã koni ayatao yɛ shīa ni akɛ saji ni aŋmla ashwie shi lɛ toɔ mli yɛ Babilon lɛ.
Shi Ekbatana, maŋtsɛmaŋ ni yɔɔ Media shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli ji he ni ayana wolo ko yɛ; ni sane ni aŋmã yɛ mli nɛ,

"Maŋtsɛ Koresh klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo akpɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We kɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ he akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ shīa ni yɔɔ Yerusalem ni ashãa afɔlei yɛ mli lɛ, ama, ni ahã efanesi lɛ awa. Ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Egbogboi lɛ, bɔ ni abaatswa lɛ nɛ, Kɛ atswa tɛi wuji klɛmpɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ ashwie nɔ tso klɛmpɛ kome. Nyɔŋmɔ ni aaabɔ yɛ he lɛ, ajɛ maŋtsɛ we froto lɛ mli awo.

Asaŋ shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛ jwɛitɛi nibii ni Nebukadnezar yaloo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ mli ni akɛba Babilon lɛ, akɛku sɛɛ ahã ni akɛya Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ mli ni akɛyato amɛtoohe koni ahã ahi Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Dario ŋmã hetoo eyahã Tatnai, faa lɛ anaigbɛ amralo lɛ, kɛ Shetar-Boznai kɛ amraloi ni fata amɛhe yɛ faa lɛ anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni efã amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjea jɛi nyɛyaa sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Nyɛŋmɛa gbɛ koni atsu Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ; nyɛkagbaa nitsumɔ lɛ naa. Nyɛhãa Yudafoi lɛ amralo lɛ kɛ amɛ onukpai lɛ amã Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ yɛ emãahe lɛ.

Asaŋ miiwo akpɔ matsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni esa akɛ nyɛfee nyɛhã nɛkɛ Yudafoi onukpai nɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shīa lɛ maa lɛ gbɛfaŋ. Onia ni atsuɔ yɛ faa lɛ anaigbɛ ahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, aye oyai ni ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ emli eko ni amɛkɛwo nyɔmɔ ni aaabɔ lɛ fɛɛ koni nitsumɔ lɛ akakpɛŋsɛŋ.

Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he hiaa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ: tsinai oblahii, ojwɛnii, toi aloo toobii ni akɛshãa shãa afɔlei ahãa ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋmãa, ŋoo, wain loo mu lɛ, ahã osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ; ahã amɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi; ni akafo mli,
koni amɛshã afɔlei ni jeɔ ŋma amɛhã ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkpa fai koni maŋtsɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ ayi ana wala.
Asaŋ miiwo akpɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsake fãmɔ ni mifã nɛɛ hiɛ lɛ, ajie etsu nɔ mplaŋ ni agbɔ naa akɛtsu emli. Ahã eshīa lɛ atsɔ̃ tumu.

Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni fee shīa nɛɛ ejamɔhe lɛ abutu maŋtsɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaka akɛ eeetsake fãmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ aloo akɛ eeekumɔ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ. Mi, Dario, miwo akpɔ nɛɛ. Aye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Tatnai, faa lɛ anaigbɛ amralo lɛ, kɛ Shetar-Boznai kɛ amɛnanemɛi nitsulɔi lɛ fee bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Dario fã akɛ afee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Yudafoi onukpai lɛ ma Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni etee nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Hagai, gbalɔ lɛ, kɛ Zakaria, Ido bi lɛ, gbalɛ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛna, ni amɛgbe naa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã lɛ kɛ Persia maŋtsɛ Koresh kɛ Dario Artashasta akpɔ lɛ naa.
Agbe shīa lɛ naa yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, yɛ Adar nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Isrealbii lɛ, osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ye gbi ni agbleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ naa lɛ akɛ gbijurɔ. Amɛye lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ.

Ni Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ naagblemɔ lɛ mli lɛ amɛkɛ tsinai oha, ojwɛnii ohai enyɔ, toobii ohai ejwɛ shã afɔle; ni amɛkɛ too kpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ shã shãa afɔle amɛhã Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ayibɔ lɛ naa.
Ni amɛto osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛsafokui lɛ, kɛ Levibii yɛ amɛmlijai lɛ anaa amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ, taakɛ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mose wolo lɛ mli lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ ye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
Osɔfoi Lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ bluublu etsɔ̃ hiɛ amɛtsuu amɛhe, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhe etse. Amɛgbe Hetoo toobii lɛ amɛhã mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe.

Israelbii lɛ ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ ye Hehoo toobi lɛ. Mɛi krokomɛi hu ni ye ji mɛi fɛɛ ni etse amɛhe yɛ nii ni buleɔ mɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔŋjalɔi feɔ lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe ebabɔ Israelbii lɛ ahe koni amɛtao Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ lɛ.

Amɛkɛ nyamɔ ye Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo; ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã amɛmli efli amɛ, akɛni ehã Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui emɔ amɛ koni ewo amɛ hewalɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
7: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ yɛ Persia Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ lɛ, nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ezra lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Babilon kɛba. Lɛji Ezra, Seraia bi kɛ Azaria nabi lɛ. Ezra kaŋsowa kɛ nanashishiu kɛ nanadodao kɛ nii kɛ nii ji Hilkia kɛ.
Shalum lɛ Zadok kɛ Ahitub kɛ
Amaria kɛ Azaria kɛ Meraiot kɛ
Zerahia kɛ Uzi kɛ Buke kɛ.
Abishua kɛ Pinehas kɛ Eleazar kɛ osɔfonukpa Aaron.

Ezra ni jɛ Babilon ba nɛɛ, eji mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ni mla ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ, ele mli jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ yɛ enɔ; hewɔ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ Osɔfo kɛ Levibii kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ Sɔlemɔmɛi sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu fata Ezra he kɛba.
Amɛbashɛ Yerusalem yɛ maŋtsɛ Artashasta maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ Babilon ji klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbashɛ Yerusalem, yɛ Ezra Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yeli kɛbuamɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni kã Ezra tsui nɔ ji akɛ eeekase Yehowa mla lɛ ni eye nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akpɔi lɛ kɛ mli lɛ yɛ Israel maŋ lɛ mli.
Wolo ni Maŋtsɛ Artashasta kɛhã Ezra, osɔfo kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ lɛ ni le Yehowa kitãi kɛ akpɔi ni ewo Israel lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli sane nɛ,
"Artashasta, maŋtsɛmɛi amaŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋmã ehã osɔfo Ezra ni ji mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni le ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ mli jogbaŋŋ lɛ.
Miiwo akpɔ akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni jɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛaatee Yerusalem lɛ, amɛkɛ o aya.
Maŋtsɛ kɛ ejinafoi kpawo lɛ tsuɔ o koni oyatao Yuda kɛ Yerusalem saji amli yɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla ni ohiɛ lɛ naa.
Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni maŋtsɛ kɛ ejinafoi lɛ eke Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ashihilɛhe yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, ŋɔɔ kɛya.

ŋɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ hu ni ooona yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛya. Asaŋ, nikeenii ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ aaake yɛ tsuijurɔ naa yɛ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ no hu kɛya.
"Nɛkɛ shika nɛɛ kwɛmɔ ni akɛhe tsinai, ojwɛnii, toobii kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔle, koni okɛyashã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ nɔ.
Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni aaashwɛ lɛ nyɛkafea nɔ ni sa okɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ahiɛ ni nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sumɔɔ.
Asaŋ nibii ni akɛhã o ni akɛsɔmɔ yɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, tuu ohã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ hiɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaahia lolo yɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ hewɔ ni sa akɛ ohã lɛ, jɛɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli ohe.
"Mi, Maŋtsɛ Artashasta, miiwo jwetritolɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ akpɔ akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni osɔfo Ezra, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni le ŋwɛi NYɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ mli jigabŋŋ lɛ, aaabi nyɛ lɛ, aye oyai ni afee,
Kɛyashi jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai, kɛ ŋmaa nsɛnitɛ wulu akpei nyɔŋma, kɛ wain litai akpei enyɔ kɛ mu litai akpei enyɔ, kɛ ŋoo tsiimɔ bɔ ni he ehia.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ŋwɛi maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo he akpɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa ni afea fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ he koni emli akafu maŋtsɛ kɛ ebii ni baaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ.

Asaŋ wɔmiihã nyɛna nyɛle akɛ osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ lalɔi kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ tsuji ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We nɛɛŋ, lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etsuɔ amɛ onia loo too loo agbɛjee shika ko.

"Ni bo, Ezra hu, yɛ nilee ni o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã o lɛ naa lɛ, fãamɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ sane amɛyeɔ lɛ kojolɔi fɛɛ ni le o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ koni amɛkojo mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ ateŋ saji. Mɛi ni leee lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃a amɛ ni amɛle.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeee o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, akojo lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ koni toigblamɔ ni sa lɛ akɛhã lɛ. Gbele jio, naneshitutswaa jio, nii anaatsii jio, tsuŋwoo jio."
Kɛkɛ ni Ezra kɛɛ, "Ajie Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi akɛ ekɛ nɛkɛ nɔ ko wo maŋtsɛ lɛ yiɛ akɛ ewula Yehowa we ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ.

Yɛ mɔbɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ena mi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mina hiɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ejinafoi lɛ kɛ elumɛi agboi lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. Hewalɛ ni ewo mi hewɔ lɛ mina ekãa mikɛbua Israelbii lɛ ateŋ onukpai lɛ anaa koni amɛkɛ mi afã kɛba."
8: Mɛi ni kɛ mi, Ezra, fã kɛjɛ Babilon, be mli ni Artashasta yeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai nɛ:
Pinehas we lɛ, Gershom ji mɔ ni jɛ jɛi. Itamar we lɛ, Daniel. David we lɛ, Hatush, Shekania bi lɛ.
Parosh we lɛ, Zakaria kɛ hii oka kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni aŋmla amɛgbɛii ashi enɔ.
Pahat-Moab we lɛ, Elihoenai, Zeharia bi lɛ ni hii ohai enyɔ shi enɔ.
Zatu we lɛ, Shekania, Yahaziel bi lɛ, ni hii ohai etɛ̃ shi enɔ.
Adin we lɛ, Ebed, Yonatan bi lɛ, ni hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ shi enɔ lɛ.
Elam we lɛ, Yeshaia, Atalia bi lɛ, ni hii Nyɔŋmai kpa shi enɔ.
Shefatia we lɛ, Zebadi, Mikael bi lɛ, ni hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ shi enɔ.
Yoab we lɛ, Obadia, Yehiel bi lɛ, ni hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ shi enɔ.
Bani we lɛ, Shelomit, Yosifia bi lɛ, ni hii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa shi enɔ.
Bebai we lɛ, Zakaria, Bebai bi lɛ hii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ shi enɔ.
Azgad we lɛ, Yohanan, Hakatan bi lɛ; hi nii oha kɛ nyɔŋma shi enɔ.
Adonikam we lɛ bii ba sɛɛkpee. Amɛgbɛii nɛ: Elifelet, Yeuel kɛ Shemiaai; ni hii nyɔŋmai ekpaa shi amɛnɔ.
Begwai we lɛ, Utai kɛ Zakur; ni hii nyɔŋmai kpawo shi amɛnɔ.
Mibua amɛnaa kɛtee faa ko ni hoɔ kɛyaa Ahawa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ toi. Wɔhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃. Be ni mikpa maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ lɛ minaaa Levinyo ko yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ mitsu ayatsɛ Eliazer kɛ Ariel kɛ Shemaia kɛ Elnatan kɛ Yarib Elnatan kɛ Nathan kɛ Zakaria kɛ Meshulam ni ji hiɛnaanɔbii, kɛ Yoiarib kɛ Eltnatan ni ji tsɔ̃ɔlɔi hu lɛ kɛba.

Mitsu amɛ Ido, Kasifia maŋ lɛ mli onukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ. Mihã amɛ wiemɔ ni amɛkɛyahã Ido kɛ enanemɛi Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni yɔɔ Kasifa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, koni amɛwo mɛi agbɛ kɛba Kasifa maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛbasɔmɔ yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ.

Wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dromɔ naa lɛ, amɛkɛ Sherebia, nuu ko ni hiɛ kã shi ni jɛ Maheli ni ji Levi bi kɛ Israel nabi lɛ tsɛmɛiawebii lɛ ateŋ, kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfeɔ gbɔmɛi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ bahã wɔ.
Amɛkɛ Hashabia kɛ Yeshaia ni jɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni ji enyɛmimɛi kɛ ebii hu bahã wɔ.
Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni David kɛ etsuji lɛ hala ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Levibii lɛ fata he. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ atsi amɛgbɛii ata
Kɛkɛ ni mishiɛ yɛ jɛi akɛ ahi ŋmãa yɛ Ahawa Faa lɛ naa, koni wɔba wɔhe shi wɔhã wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni wɔkpa lɛ fai koni ehã wɔ kɛ wɔbii kɛ wɔnabii fɛɛ afee shweshweeshwe yɛ wɔgbɛfãa lɛ mli.

Ejaakɛ eefee mi hiɛgbe akɛ makpa maŋtsɛ lɛ fai ni ehã wɔ asraafoi kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtralɔi ni amɛbi wɔhe yɛ henyɛlɔi ni yɔɔ gbɛteŋ lɛ ahewɔ. Eefee mi hiɛgble ejaakɛ wɔkɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ: wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yeɔ buaa mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ efeee nɔ ko lɛ enaaa amɛhe miishɛɛ ni egblaa amɛtoi waa.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔhi ŋmãa, ni wɔkpa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai yɛ enɛ hewɔ, ni efee nɔ ni wɔbi lɛ ehã wɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mifamɔ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ onukpai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ: Sherebia kɛ Hashabia kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma.
Miŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ nibii ni ji Sɔlemɔwe lɛ nikeenii ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ejianfoi lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ Israel fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ kekee lɛ miwo amɛdɛŋ.
Nɔ ni miŋmɛ miwo amɛdɛŋ lɛ nɛ:

Jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ; jwɛitɛi tsɛŋsii ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmii ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha; shika kpuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni tsiimɔ ji dalei akpe kome, tsɛŋsii enyɔ ni akɛ akɔɔble kaŋkaŋ ni jra wa tamɔ shika fee.
Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛha Yehowa, ni nibii lɛ hu he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ. Jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ tsui jurɔ naa akɛhã Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛbua he ni nyɛkɛtoa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaŋmɛ yɛ Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Lɛvibii lɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ ahiɛ, yɛ Yehowa we lɛ piai lɛ amli."
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ loo jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ kɛ nibii ni aŋmɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛya wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yerusalem.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔfã yɛ Ahawa Faa lɛ naa kɛmiiya Yerusalem, Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ bu wɔhe, ni ejie wɔ yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi abɔ ni yawo wɔ ka yɛ gbɛteŋ lɛ hu adɛŋ.
Wɔshɛ Yerusalem, ni wɔye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.

Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ kɛ nibii lɛ yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni atu awo Meremot, Uria bi ni ji osɔfo lɛ, kɛ Eleazar, Pinehas bi ni fata ehe lɛ adɛŋ. Mɛi ni fata amɛhe ji Levibii enyɔ ni ji Yozabad. Yeshua bi lɛ, kɛ Noadia, Binui bi lɛ.
Akane nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aŋmɛ, ni aŋma afɔ̃ shi nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ.

Mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ bashã shãa afɔlei amɛhã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ: tsinahii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ha Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ojwɛnii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ ekpaa, kɛ toobii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo, kɛ esha he afɔle tookpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ akɛshã shãa afɔlei aha Yehowa.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ mlai lɛ hã amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate lɛ anaigbɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ye amɛbua maŋ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.
9: Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ, onukpai lɛ ba miŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ mi akɛ, Israel maŋbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tseko amɛhe yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahe, yɛ nii amɛfeɔ ni Yudafoi hiɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ. Nii nɛɛ ji nii ni Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Yebushbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Egiptbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ feɔ lɛ.
Yudahii eŋɔŋɔɔ maŋsɛɛ yei amɛhã amɛ diɛŋTsɛ amɛhe akɛ ŋamɛi, ni amɛbihii hu efee nakai nɔŋŋ. Belɛ jaku ni he tse lɛ ebule amɛhe. Onukpai lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ triti tɔ̃ɔ mla nɛɛ.
Be ni minu nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, migbla mihe atade kɛ mihebo, ni mifãmɔ miyiteŋ tsɔi kɛ mitsɛŋ; ni mihe jɔ̃ mihe kɛta shi.

Kɛkɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ yɛ wiemɔ ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ wie yɛ mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ mla ni amɛtɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ miŋɔɔ. Shi mi lɛ mihe jɔ̃ mihe kɛta shi aahuu kɛyashi gbɛkɛ afɔleshãa be lɛ mli.
Be ni gbɛkɛ afɔleshãa be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mite shi kɛ nkɔmɔ ni miyeɔ lɛ kɛ mihe atade kɛ mihebo ni atserɛ lɛ, ni miho mikula minakutsei anaa. Migbɛ minijiaŋ mitsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ,
ni mikɛɛ "Ao, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mihiɛ egbo, ni eefee mi hiɛgble akɛ mawo mihiɛ nɔ makwɛ ohiɛ, mi-Nyɔŋɔ; ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ esu wɔ, ni wɔfɔ ni wɔye lɛ da ni ekwɔ tamɔ ŋwɛi.

Fɔbuu kã wɔnɔ kɛjɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ayinɔ aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Wɔnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ ohã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ wɔsɔfoi lɛ anɔ. Akɛ klaŋte ekpãtã wɔhiɛ, aŋɔ wɔ nom, wɔnibii ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ aha, ni ashwie wɔhiɛ shi tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.

Agbɛnɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, odro wɔ be kukuoo ko. Ohã wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi eye amɛhe kɛjɛ nyɔŋyeli mli, ni ohã wɔ he ko yɛ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni wɔfee shweshweeshwe yɛ jɛi; koni wɔhiŋmɛii agble, ni wɔyi ana wala be mli ni wɔyɔɔ nyɔyeli mli lɛ.

Ejaakɛ nyɔji ji wɔ; shimɔ kɛkɛ oshiko wɔ yɛ wɔnyɔŋyeli lɛ mli; shi moŋ ohã Persia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛvena wɔ mɔbɔ, ni ohã wɔyi ena wala koni wɔma oshia lɛ ni wɔsaa emli tsukoi lɛ. Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ efo afabaŋ ewo wɔhe yɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem, koni wɔfee shweshweeshwe.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni wɔɔkɛɛ yɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ? Wɔyeee okitãi lɛ ni otsɔ̃ otsuji, gbalɔi lɛ, anine wɔ owo lɛ anɔ.
Amɛkɛɛ wɔ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni wɔyaŋɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni enɔ bii lɛ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii ni ahiɔ lɛ ebule lɛ. Amɛkɛ smɛnijiinii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi abɔ̃ kɛ muji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ he.

Enɛ hewɔ lɛ ogbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei akahã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii agblã; ni asaŋ, wɔkaŋɔ amɛbiyei wɔhã wɔbihii. Gbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ wɔkatao hejɔlɛ loo shweremɔ wɔhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbi ko gbi ko. Amɛkɛɛ wɔfee nakai bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe awa ni wɔye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii kpakpai lɛ ni wɔshi wɔhã akɛ gboshinii kɛya naanɔ.
Nii ni ba wɔnɔ akɛ toigblamɔ yɛ wɔshaianii kɛ wɔfɔ kpeteŋkple ni wɔye lɛ hewɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, bo wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, owoko wɔ nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni sa wɔnifɔɔjianii lɛ, ni ohã wɔhiɛ kã.

Aso wɔɔku okitãi lɛ amli ekoŋŋ, ni wɔkɛ wɔhe ayabɔ maji ni feɔ nihiinii nɛɛ ahe ni wɔkɛ amɛ aye yooŋɔɔ lo? Aso omli fuŋ wɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni oookpãtã wɔhiɛ ogbe naa bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, aloo mɔ ko mɔ ko hu ejeŋ mli lo?

Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, jalɔ j io; ejaakɛ ashi wɔ akɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Naa, wɔyɛ ohiɛ akɛ mɛi ni eye fɔ. Ejaakɛ wɔfɔ ni wɔye lɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ ohiɛ adamɔ."
10: Shi be mli ni Ezra sɔleɔ ekpaa fai ni ekɛ ehe tswiaa shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ, ni ejajeɔ eshai ni Israel fee lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii, babua amɛhe naa kɛbɔle lɛ. Amɛmiifo blobloblo.

Kɛkɛ ni shekania, Yehiel bi lɛ ni jɛ Elam tsɛmɛiawebii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kɛ Ezra wie ekɛɛ, "Wɔtɔ̃ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ wɔyaŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ateŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ tete hiɛnɔkamɔ yɛ hã Israel yɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔkɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akpãŋa, koni wɔshwie yei lɛ kɛ bii lɛ hu yɛ minuŋtsɔ kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã lɛ gbeyei lɛ aŋaawoo naa, koni wɔye mla lɛ nɔ.
Kwɛmɔ ni ofee, ejaakɛ bo osane ni. Wɔfī osɛɛ; feemɔ ekãa ni otsu he nii."
Kɛkɛ ni Ezra te shi, ni ebi osɔfoi kɛ Levibii lɛ nukpai lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛkãmɔ kitã akɛ amɛbaafee bɔ ni akɛɛ lɛ; ni amɛkãmɔ kitã lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Ezra te shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Yehohanan ni ji Eliashibi lɛ bi lɛ sɛɛtsu lɛ mli. Ehi jɛi ni eyeee nii lɛ, asaŋ enuuu nu hu, ejaakɛ eeye nkɔmɔ yɛ mla ni mɛi jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ etɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ ashiɛ tɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ ahã mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba lɛ akɛ amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛbakpe yɛ Yerusalem.
Akɛɛ kɛshi nɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaa kɛyashi gbii etɛ̃, tamɔ bɔ ni lumɛi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ efã akɛ aba lɛ, aaajɔ enii anɔ ake, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu aaajie lɛ yɛ mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ ateŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛ Benyamin hii lɛ babua amɛhe naa kɛkpe yɛ Yerusalem yɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ mli, yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baho tra he ko kpataa ko ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hiɛ lɛ. Gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ yɛ Sane nɛɛ he, ni asaŋ nu ni nɛɔ waa lɛ ehã amɛmiikpokpo.
Osɔfo Ezra te shi damɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtɔ̃, ejaakɛ nyɛyaŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei, ni nyɛkɛhã Israel fɔ ni eye lɛ eda.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛjajea nyɛtsɔ̃a Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; nyɛfea esuɔmɔnaanii, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ ahe."
Kɛkɛ ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ waa amɛkɛɛ, "Nakai ni; esa akɛ wɔfee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.
Shi wɔyi fa babaoo naakpa yɛ biɛ, ni nunɛmɔ be nɛ. Wɔnyɛŋ blohu nɛɛŋ wɔdamɔ, be mli ni nitsumɔ lɛ ejeee gbi kome loo gbii enyɔ tete nitsumɔ, ejaakɛ wɔfee efɔŋ waa yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.

No hewɔ lɛ hã wɔlumɛi lɛ aye asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ najiaŋ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ wɔmaji lɛ amli ni amɛŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ aba yɛ be ni ato mli. Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli onukpai kɛ emli kojolɔi afata amɛhe kɛba, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mlifu ni naa wa ni kã wɔnɔ lɛ aaje wɔnɔ."
Mɛi pɛ ni te shi shi nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ ji Yonatan, Asahel bi lɛ, kɛ Yahezeia, Tikwa bi lɛ; ni Meshulam kɛ Shabetai, Levinyo lɛ, fī amɛsɛɛ.

Mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ mli ba lɛ fee tamɔ bɔ ni ato gbejianɔ lɛ. Afãmɔ osɔfo Ezra kɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, ni atsi amɛ fɛɛ amɛgbɛii atã. Nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛyatra shi koni amɛtao sane lɛ mli.
Be ni shɛɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ hii fɛɛ ni eŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei lɛ egbe naa.
Yɛ osɔfoi abii agbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɛi ni ana yɛ tsɛmɛiawe ji Yeshua, Yozadak bi lɛ ni enyɛmimɛi abii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni amɛŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei ji: Maseia kɛ Eliezer kɛ Yarib kɛ Gedalia.
Amɛwo shi akɛ amɛaashwie amɛŋamɛi lɛ. Amɛfɔ ni amɛye hewɔ lɛ amɛhã ojwɛni koni akɛshã sɔ̃ afɔle.

Pashur tsɛmɛiawe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Elioenai kɛ Maaseia kɛ Ishmael kɛ Netanel kɛ Yozabad kɛ Elasa.
Levibii ateŋ lɛ, Yozabad kɛ Shimei kɛ Kelaia ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Kelita hu lɛ, kɛ Petania kɛ Yuda kɛ Eliezer.
Lalatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Eliashib. Agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Shalum kɛ Telem kɛ Uri.

Zatu tsɛmɛiawe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Elivenai kɛ Eliashib kɛ Matania kɛ Yeremot kɛ Zabad kɛ Aziza.
Bebai tsɛmɛiawe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Yehohanan kɛ Hanania kɛ Zabai kɛ Atai.
Bebai tsɛmɛiawe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Meshulam kɛ Maluk kɛ Adaia kɛ Yeshub kɛ Sheal kɛ Yeremot,
Pahat-Moab tsɛmɛiawe lɛ abii lɛ Ateŋ lɛ, Adna kɛ Kelal kɛ Benaia kɛ Maaseia kɛ Matania kɛ Bezaleel kɛ Binui kɛ Manase.
Harim tsɛmɛiawe bii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, Eliezer kɛ Ishia kɛ Malkia kɛ Shemaia kɛ Simeon,
kɛ Benyamin kɛ Maluk kɛ Shemaria.

kɛ Banaia kɛ Bedeia kɛ Keluhi

kɛ Maknadebai kɛ Shashai kɛ Sharai

Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei; hewɔ lɛ amɛ shwie yei lɛ kɛ amɛbii lɛ fɛɛ.

1: Mi Paulo ni miji bɔfo ni mibɔfonitsumɔ lɛ jɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ, ni jeee gbɔmɔ ko nu hu etsɔ̃, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ lɛ,
kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni mi yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ŋma wolon nɛɛ yahã Galatia asafo lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ ahã nyɛ;
Yesu Kristo ni kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ, koni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ jeŋ fɔ̃ŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔ-Tsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ.
Enɔ ji anumnyam lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Efee mihiɛ yaa akɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe kɛjɛ mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ yɛ Kristo dromɔ mli lɛ he kɛya Sanekpakpa kroko he.
shi jeee Sanekpakpa kroko ni, fe akɛ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ ni hãa nyɛjwɛŋnɔ futuɔ, ni amɛtaoɔ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi.
Shi kɛji wɔ po aloo bɔfo ni jɛ ŋwɛi tete bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, yɛ nɔ ni wɔjaje wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!
Tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ momo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋmikɛɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Kɛ mɔ ko bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔnyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛmɔ mli nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!"
Ejaakɛ be nɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahiɛ gbɛ mitaoɔ loo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ gbɛ? Aloo miitao gbɔmɛi ahiɛ masa? Ejaakɛ kɛ mikã he miitao masa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, jeee Kristo tsulɔ ji mi.
Shi miihã nyɛle, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ sanekpakpa ni mijajelɛ, ejɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ;
ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ ko dɛŋ mina kɛjɛ, ni jeee tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hu atsɔ̃ɔ mi, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ naa mina yɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛnu misa jeŋba lɛ he yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli. Bɔ ni miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi fe nine ni mibɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ makpãtã ehiɛ;
ni mitee hiɛ yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli fe mitipɛŋfoi pii yɛ mijakubei ateŋ, ni mihiɛ dɔ naakpa yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ he.
Shi be ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie mi eto kɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ beebe ni ekɛ edromɔ lɛ tsɛ mi kɛba lɛ hiɛ,
akɛ eeejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi lɛ kpo etSɔ̃ɔ mi, koni mijaje ehe Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mibiii gbɔmɔ ko ŋaawo yɛ he,
ni misaa miyaaa Yerusalem hu yɛ mɛi ni ji bɔfoi dani mi hu mitsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ miyiŋ kɛtee Arabia ni misaa miku misɛɛ kɛba Damasko ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ etɛ̃ lɛ, mitee Yerusalem ni miyale Kɛfa, ni mihi eŋɔɔ gbii nyɔŋMa kɛ enumɔ;
shi minaaa bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko akɛ ja Yakobo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ.
shi nii ni miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, naa, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ mikɛɔ yɛ akɛ mimaleee.
NO sɛɛ lɛ miba Siria kɛ Kilikia niiaŋ.
Shi aleee mihiɛ yɛ Yudea asafoi ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ amli;
shi amɛnuɔ kɛkɛ akɛ akɛɔ akɛ, "Mɔ ni be ko mlini ewa wɔ yi lɛ, agbɛnɛ eejaje hemɔkɛyeli ni tsutsu lɛ ebɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã hiɛ lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ."
Ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mihewɔ.
2: Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ misaa mikɛ Barnaba tee Yerusalem, ni miŋɔ Tito hu mifata mihe.
Shi mitee yɛ kpojiemɔ ko naa, ni mikɛ Sanekpakpani mishiɛɔ yɛ jeŋmajilɛ ateŋ lɛ yaŋmɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ sɔŋŋ ahiɛ bɔ ni afee ni foi ni midaa aloo ni mida lɛ akafee yaka.
Shi Tito tete ni kɛ mi yɔɔ ni eji Helanyo lɛ, enyɛɛɛ enɔ akɛ efo ketia.
Mɛi ni wo ketiafoo sane nɔ ji amale nyɛmimɛi komɛi n ju shi kɛbafutu wɔ, ni amɛba nigii koni amɛbasra wɔhe ni wɔye yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, koni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ;
shi wɔkplɛ̃ɛɛ ni wɔbo amɛ toiŋmɛlɛtswa kome po tete, koni Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ ahi shi da ahã nyɛ.
Shi mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ amɛyɔɔ gbɛi lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa lɛ, jeee mihe sane ko ni, Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ehalaaa lɛ, mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mi nɔ ko amɛfataaa he;
Shi moŋ be ni amɛna akɛ atu foolɔi ateŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ jajemɔ lɛ awo midɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni atu ketiafolɔi anɔ lɛ awo Petro dɛŋ,
ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsu nii yɛ Petro mli ni ehã eye bɔfo yɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ etsu nii yɛ mi hu mimli yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ,

be ni amɛyoo domɔ ni akɛhã mi lɛ, Yakobo kɛ Kefa kɛ Yohane ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, amɛkɛ naanyobɔɔ ninejurɔ lɛ ta mi kɛ Baraba dɛ̃, koni wɔ lɛ wɔya jeŋmaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛ lɛ amɛya ketiafolɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ;
Shi ohiafoi kɛkɛ amɛkɛɛ wɔkai, ni no nɔŋŋ he mɔdɛŋ mibɔ akɛ mafee.
SHi be ni Kefa ba Antiokia lɛ midamɔ ehiɛ miku enaa, ejaakɛ eye sane ni ejaaa.

Ejaakɛ dani mɛi komɛi aaajɛ Yakobo ŋɔɔ aba lɛ, ekɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ yeɔ niii; shi be ni amɛba lɛ, egbla ehe shi ni etse ehe, ejaakɛ eeshe mɛi ni jɛ ketiafoi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛ lɛ fee nakai osato lɛ, ni amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ gbla Barnaba kɛtee amɛgbɛfaŋ.

Shi be ni mina akɛ amɛnyiɛɛɛ trɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpalɛ anɔkwale lɛ naa lɛ, mikɛɛ Kefa yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ, "Kɛ bo ni oji Yudanyolɛ ohiɔ shi tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋnyoni jeee tamɔ Yudafonyo lɛ, mɛɛba onyiɛɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛshi tamɔ Yudafonyolɛ, mɛɛba onyɛɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhi shi tamɔ Yudafoi?"
Afɔ wɔ Yudafoi akɛ ni wɔjeee eshafeelɔi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli,

shi akɛni wɔle akɛ abuuu gbɔmɔ bem kɛjɛɛɛ Mla nitsumɔi amli, akɛ ja atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔhe Kristo Yesu nɔ wɔye, koni abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni jeeee Mla nitsumɔi amli, ejaakɛ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem kɛjɛŋ Mla nitsumɔi amli.
SHi agbɛnɛ kɛji wɔ ni wɔtaoɔ akɛ abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo mli lɛ ana wɔ akɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu eshafeelɔi ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ Kristo ji esha sɔ̃ɔlɔ lo? Dabida!
Ejaakɛ kɛ nii ni mikumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mimaa ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔ.
Ejaakɛmi lɛmitsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ migbo yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, koni mihiɛ akã ahã Nyɔŋmɔ.

Asɛŋ mi kɛ Kristo; hewɔ lɛ jeeemi mihiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, shi Kristo ni hiɛ kã yɛ mimli; shi mihiɛni kã yɛ heloo mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni sumɔ mi ni ekɛ ehe hã yɛ mihewɔ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli mihiɛ kã yɛ.
Miŋwãaa Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ Mla nɔ jalɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, belɛ Kristo lɛ yakatswaa egbo lɛ.
3: O Galatiabii ni bɛ yitsoŋ! Namɔ kpɛ nyɛ ayɛ, nyɛ ni atɛŋ Yesu yɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛhiɛ akɛ mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ?
Enɛ kɛkɛ mitaoɔ male yɛ nyɛna: Mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi amli nyɛna kɛjɛ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi mli?
Aso nɛkɛ nyɛbɛ yitsoŋ? Ni nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ mumɔ bɔ̃i lɛ, agbɛnɛ heloo nyɛkɛbaagba naa lo?
Nɔ babaoo ni nyɛna nɛɛ, yakatswaa nyɛna lo (Kɛ eyɛ mli akɛ yakatswaa nyɛna lɛ)?
Belɛ mɔ ni kɛ Mumɔ lɛ hãa nyɛ ni etsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi ahewɔ efeɔ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛboɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ hewɔ ni?
Tamɔ bɔ ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu anɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ.
NO hewɔ lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, amɛji Abrahambii.
Shi akɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ ena momo akɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu jeŋmaji lɛ abem yɛ hewɔ lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Abraham eto akɛ, "Omli aaajɔɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ."
Belɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ Abraham heyelɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ Mla nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ, loomɔ kã amɛnɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, "Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eyaaa nɔ efeee nii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ."
Shi eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla mli lɛ abuŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko bem yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ "Jalɔ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli mli eyi aaana wala yɛ;"
shi Mla lɛ, jeee hemɔKɛyeli sane ni, shi moŋ "Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli."
Kristo kpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ Mla lɛ loomɔ lɛ mli, akɛni etsɔ̃ loomɔ ehã wɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, "Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsotsro tso nɔ lɛ;"
koni Abraham jɔɔmɔ lɛ aba jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli, ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli ana Mumɔ ni awo he shi lɛ.
Anyɛmimɛi, miiwie lɛ gbɔmɛiaŋ: gbɔmɔ kpãŋmɔ tete, kɛji akplɛ̃ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko kwaaa, ni asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fataaa he.
Shi Abraham lɛ, akɛ lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ wie shiwoo wiemɔi lɛ. Ekɛɛɛ akɛ, "kɛ oshwiei lɛ" tamɔ nɔ ni ekɛ mɛi pii miiwie, shi moŋ tamɔ mɔ kome akɛ, "Kɛ oshwie lɛ." mɔ ni ji Kristo lɛ.
Shi nɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ji akɛ Mla ni awo yɛ afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eguuu kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ema nɔ aduatsɔ eto lɛ ni ehã shiwoo lɛ afee yaka.
Shi kɛ gboshinii lɛ jɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ jeee shiwoo lɛ mli ejɛ dɔŋŋ; shi Abraham lɛ, shiwoo nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛke lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ mɛɛ ji Mla lɛ mɔ? Akɛhaã ni akɛna nɔtɔ̃mɔi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni shwie ni awo lɛ shi lɛ aaaba; ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ atsɔ̃ awo Mla lɛ, ni akɛwo mlidaamɔlɔ dɛŋ.
Shi mlidaamɔlɔ sane lɛ, ejeee mɔ kome nɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ kome ji lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mla lɛ shiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi lɛ lo? Dabida! Ejaakɛ eji awo mla ko ni aaanyɛ wala ahã kulɛ, anɔkwale mli lɛ wɔbembuu baajɛ mla nɔyeli mli.
Shi moŋ; ŋmalɛ lɛ eŋa nibii fɛɛ yi ewo esha shishi, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛ shiwoo lɛ ahã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lŋ.

Shi dani hemɔkɛyelilɛ ba lɛ, aŋɔ wɔyi tamɔ gboklɛfoi awo Mla shishi kɛyashi hemɔkɛyeli ni abaalɛ etsɛ̃ wɔtsɔselɔ kɛmiiya Kristo ŋɔɔ koni etsɔ̃ wɔtsɔselɔ kɛmiiya Kristo ŋɔɔ koni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem
Shi ni hemɔkɛyeli ba nɛɛ, wɔbɛ tsɔselɔ lɛ shishi dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli kɛtsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ
ejaakɛ nyɛ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi nyɛ awo Kristo mli lɛ, nyɛwob Kristo.
Yudanyo bɛ lɛ, Helanyo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nyɔŋ bɛ lɛ, odehe hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nuu bɛ lɛ, yoo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ: ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
Shi kɛji Kristo nii ji nyɛ lɛ, belɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ, kɛ gboshiniiyelɔi hu yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa.
4: Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni gboshiniiyelɔ lɛ ji abifao lɛ, srɔto ko bɛ ekɛ nyɔŋ teŋ, tsɛbelɛ lɛji nii lɛ fɛɛ tsɛ;
Shi moŋ eyɛ anɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsuji nukpai ashshi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni tsɛ lɛ eto lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu, be ni wɔji abifaibii lɛ, akɛ wɔ wo je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anyɔŋyeli lɛ shishi.
Shi be ni be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ e-Bi lɛ kɛba, yoo fɔ lɛ, eba Mla shishi lɛ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ bii.
Shi akɛni bii ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu e-Bi lɛ Mumɔ lɛ kɛba nyɛtsuii amli, ni eboɔ akɛ, "Aba, Ataa!"
No hewɔ lɛ ojeee nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ bi ji o, ni kɛji bi ji o lɛ, belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ efee o niyelɔ hu.
Shi be mli ni nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛfee nyɛhe nyɔji nyɛhã nibii ni yɛ amɛbɔɔsu naa lɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔi ni lɛ;
shi agbɛnɛ moŋ ni nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ele nyɛ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkuɔ nyɛsɛɛ kɛya shishijee nibii ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ko afee ni bɛ hewalɛ ko lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ?
Nyɛyeɔ gbii kɛ nyɔji kɛ bei kɛ afii ahe gbɛjianɔ ni ato lɛ nɔ.
Miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ yakatswaa migba mihe naa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ.
Mikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtamɔa mi, ejaakɛ mi hu mitamɔ nyɛ. Nyɛfeko mi efɔŋ ko;
shi nyɛle akɛ heloo gbedemɔ mli mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mijaje lɛ,
ni nɔ ni ji naatsɔ̃ɔmɔ hã nyɛ yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛgbeee he guɔ ni asaŋ nyɛnyaŋeeee; shi moŋ nyɛhere mi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, tamɔ Kristo Yesu diɛŋtsɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nɛɛgbɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ miiye nyɛhe odase akɛ ehiɔ feemɔ jikulɛ nyɛfamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii tete nyɛhã mi.
Ani mitsɔ̃ nyɛhenyɛlɔ akɛ mikɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale lɛ? 17.Jeeee nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ kpakpo ko mɛi komɛi bɔɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao akɛ amɛtsi nyɛ wɔŋɔɔbaa gbɛ moŋ, koni nyɛbɔ amɛ moŋ amɛhe mɔDɛŋ.
SHi ehi akɛ abɔ nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ daa kɛji akɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa fee, ni jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Mibii bibii ni mikɔ̃mɔɔ kɛ nyɛ nyɛfɔmɔ ekoŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaashɔ̃ Kristo subaŋ yɛ nyɛmli.
Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ nyɛmasɛi amrɔ nɛɛ ni mitske gbɛ nɔ ni matsɔ̃ ni mikɛ nyɛ awie, ejaakɛ miyiŋ feɔ mi kɔshikɔshi yɛ nyɛhewɔ!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhi Mla shishi lɛ, nyɛkɛa mi, ani nyɛnuuu Mla Lɛ lo?
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ Abraham yɛ bii enyɔ, mɔ kome lɛ, ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, ni mɔ komehu ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ Lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa; shi mɔ ni ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ shiwoo naa.
Nibii nɛɛ abɛ ni. Enɛɛmɛi ji kpãŋmɔi enyɔ lɛ. Ekome lɛ jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ Lɛnɔ, ni nyɔŋyeli lɛ edfɔɔ ewoɔ: no ji Hagar;
ejaakɛ Hagar ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ yɛ Arabia; shi ekɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ Yerusalem lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ekɛ ebii lɛ ji nyɔJi;
Shi ŋwɛi Yerusalem lɛ ji odehe lɛ, ni ji wɔnyɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, "La nyamɔ lala, bo kene ni ofɔɔɔ; wo nyamɔ nɔ ni oblɔ kɛ miishɛɛ, bo ni okɔ̃mɔɔɔ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ lɛ moŋ bii fa fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ po!"
Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔ lɛ, shiwoolɛ bii ji wɔ tamɔ Isak.
Shi tamɔ bɔ ni no be lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa la waa mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ yi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ hu.
Shi mɛniŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ? "Shwiemɔ nyɔŋyoo lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɔŋyoo bi lɛ ekɛ odehe lɛ bi lɛ yeŋ gboshinii lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔjeee nyɔŋyoo lɛ bii, shi moŋ odehe lɛ bii.
5: Kristo ehã wɔye w(he, no hewɔ lɛ nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ, ni nyɛkahãa abɔa nyɛ nyɔŋyeli apã lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Naa, mi Paulo, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛhãa aflɔ nyɛ ketia lɛ, Kristo he baŋ sɛɛnamɔ haŋ nyɛ.
Shi misaa miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ni foɔ ketia lɛ akɛ ehiɛ nyɔmɔ, no ji akɛ eye Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ abu nyɛ bem Mla mli lɛ, nyɛte nyɛhe kɛjɛ Kristo he; nyɛjɛ dromɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi.
Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɛɔ jalɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, jeee ketiafoo, ni asaŋ jeee foo hu ni nyɛɔ nɔ ko efeɔ, shi moŋ hemɔkɛyeli ni tsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ nɔ etsuɔ nii lɛ.
Kulɛ nyɛmiiya nɔ jogbaŋŋ; namɔ po tsi nyɛ akɛ nyɛkabo anɔkwale lɛ toi?
Jwɛŋmɔ tsakemɔ nɛɛ, jeee mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ mli ejɛ.
Masha bibioo hãa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ shaa.
Mi lɛ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ ebaŋ lɛ akɛ nyɛaajwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ kroko; shi mɔ ni haoɔ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ lɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji lɛ, esɔ̃ abua eyiyteŋ.
Shi mi lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji ketiafoo lɛ mishiɛɔ lolo lɛ, mɛɛbamɔ ni awaa mi yi lolo? Nakai ni kulɛ, sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he pãmpi lɛ Sɛɛ efo.
Ao mina ni kulɛ mɛi ni hãa nyɛgbugbbãa lɛ flɔ amɛhenii tete po amɛshwie.
Ejaakɛ heyeli mli atsɛ nyɛ kɛba, anyɛmimɛi; si nyɛheyeli lɛ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkahãa etsɔ̃a hegbɛ ehã heloo lɛ taomɔnii, shi moŋ nyɛtsɔa suɔmɔ nɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe.
Ejaakɛ Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli yɛ wiemɔ kome nɛɛ mli akɛ, "Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ."
Shi kɛ nyɛkɔ̃mɔkɔ̃mɔɔ nyɛhe ni nyɛyeyeɔ nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakpãtãa nyɛhe hiɛ.
Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji, "Nyɛnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ naa, ni nyɛfeŋ heloo akɔnɔi lɛ anaa nii."
Ejaakɛ nii ni heloo lɛ taoɔ lɛ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ eyaaa, ni nii ni Mumɔ lɛ hu taoɔ lɛ kɛ heloo lɛ eyaaa; enɛɛmɛi kɛ amɛhe yeee,m enɛ hewɔ lɛ nii ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ nyɛfee.
Shi kɛ Mumɔ lɛ kplaa nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbɛ Mla lɛ shishi.
Shi heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ: nomɛi ji ajwamaŋbɔɔ, mujinitsumɔ, nyenyeŋtswibɔɔ,
wɔŋjamɔ, suu, nyɛɛ, bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, bei mumɔ, atuatsemɔ, mligblamɔ,
hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, dãatɔɔ, dãanumɔmli basabasafeemɔ kɛ nii ni tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ momo lɛ, akɛ mɛi ni feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛnine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋTsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.
Shi Mumɔ lɛ yibii ji suɔmɔ, miishɛɛ hejɔlɛ, tsuishitoo, mlihilɛ ejurɔfeemɔ, hemɔkɛyeli,
kpoofeemɔ, henɔyeli. Enɛɛmɛi lɛ mla ko eguuu.
Shi mɛi ni ji Kristo mli nii lɛ, amɛsɛŋ heloo lɛ kɛ ehiɛdɔɔnii kɛ ekɔdɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛji wɔhiɛ kã yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa hu.
Wɔkatao yaka anumnyam ni wɔwowoo wɔhe mlila ni wɔhiɛ kɔ̃ wɔnanemɛi anɔ.
6: Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji mɔ ko miitɔ̃ ni amɔ lɛ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛji mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ nyɛsaaa nakai mɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ; ni ole ohe nɔ kwɛmɔ koni bo hu akaka o.
Nyɛjatsuilɛ nyɛkpeekpea nyɛhe kɛtrea, ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ nyɛaatsɔ nyɛye Kristo mla lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji refeɔ mɔ ko akɛ mɔ ko ji lɛ be mli ni ejeee mɔ ko lɛ eeshishiu ehe.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enitsumɔ ekwɛ, ni no dani eeena nɔ ko yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli kɛkɛ ni eshwã efɔ̃ nɔ, ni jeee mɔ kroko nɔ̃ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaatre lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejatsu .
Shi mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ etsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ aja nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ
Nyɛkalakaa nyɛhe, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aliii lɛ,. Ejaakɛ nɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɔ duɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ ebaakpa.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni duɔ nii yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo mli lɛ, eheloo lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa fitemɔ kɛjɛ; shi mɔ ni duɔnii yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa naanɔ wala kɛjɛ.
Shi nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa wɔ, ejaakɛ kɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui lɛ, wɔbaakpa hu yɛ be ni sa mli.
Belɛ be mli ni hegbɛ yɔɔ hã wɔ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔfea mɛi fee ejurɔ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni ji hemɔkɛyeli lɛ webii lɛ.
Nyɛkwea ni aŋmaa okadii adramɔ ni mikɛŋma nyɛ wolo kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minine!
Mɛini taoɔ akɛ amɛ hiɛ aba nyam yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛnyiɛɔ nyɛnɔ ni aflɔ nyɛ ketia, be ni afee kɛkɛ ni akawa amɛuyi yɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni aflɔ amɛ ketia lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tete yeee Mla lɛ nɔ; shi moŋ amɛmiitao akɛ aflɔ nyɛ ketia, koni amɛshwã amɛfɔ̃ nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nii nɛɛ nɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ̃ akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ akɛ ja wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ asɛŋ je lɛ ahã mi, ni mihu asɛŋ mi ahã je lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni asaŋ foo hu jeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ nɔ ni i nɔ ko ji bɔɔnɔ hee tsɔ̃mɔ.
Ni mɛi abɔ ni aaanyiɛ yɛ nɛkɛ jeŋba he mla lɛ naa lɛ, hejɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ aba amɛ kɛ "Nyɔŋmɔ Israel" lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko akagba minaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu pilamɔ okadii lɛ yɛ migbɔmɔtso lɛ he.
Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ yɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi, anyɛmimɛi. Amen.

1: Shishijee mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ olɛŋlɛ, ni efee flóŋŋ, ni duŋ ha nu babaoo ni ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ ha nu lɛ hiɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, "La aba." Kɛkɛ ni la ba.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ la lɛ hi. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbla la lɛ kɛ duŋ lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ la lɛ shwane, ni duŋ lɛ etsɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ. Je na, ni jɛ tsɛre, ni no ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, "Atatu aba koni eja nu lɛ mli enyɔ".
No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ fee atatu lɛ ni eja nu lɛ mli enyɔ koni ana nu yɛ atatu lɛ shishi ni ana nu yɛ atatu lɛ yiteŋ, ni eba mli nakai.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ he ni atatu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ akɛ ŋwɛi. Je na, ni je tsɛre; no ji gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, "Nu ni yɔɔ ŋwɛishishi lɛ abua ehe naa yɛ he kome, koni ana shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ!" Ni eba mli nakai.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ he ni egbi lɛ akɛ shikpɔŋ; ni nu ni ebua ehe naa lɛ etsɛ lɛŋ shɔ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ lɛ akwɛ̃ bai kɛ tsei kɛ jwɛi; tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, kɛ yeli tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ yɛ ehenɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ! Ni eba mli nakai.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ kwɛ̃ tsei kɛ bai kɛ jwɛi; tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, kɛ yeli tsei ni woɔ yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli, eko fɛɛ eko kɛ ehenɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.
Ni je na, ni je tsɛre; ni no fee gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, "Kanei aba ŋwɛi atatu lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ teŋ srɔto ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ okadii kɛ bei kɛ gbii kɛ afii,
ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kanei yɛ ŋwɛi atatuiaŋ ni amɛtso yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ" Ni eba mli nakai.
Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ kanei wuji enyɔ lɛ koni ewulu lɛ aye shwane nɔ ni bibioo lɛ aye nyɔɔŋ nɔ, ni ebɔ ŋulamii lɛ hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ wo ŋwɛi atatu lɛ mli koni amɛtso yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
koni amɛye shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ nɔ, ni amɛgbla la lɛ kɛ duŋ lɛ mli. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.
Ni je na ni je tsɛre ni no fee gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, "Nu lɛ awo loi nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, ni loofɔji afliki yɛ ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli!"
No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋshɔŋ loi wuji lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni tsiɔ ehe ni nu lɛ ewo nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ lɛ. Asaŋ ebɔ loofɔji fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛfɔa koni nyɛyi afaa ni nyɛyimɔa fai kɛ ŋshɔ mli obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni loofɔji afa yɛ shikpɔnŋ lɛ nɔ!"
Ni je na ni je tsɛre, ni efee gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ lɛ awo bɔɔnii ni hiɛ kã yɛ amɛhenɔ: Shiã kooloi kɛ kooloi ni wamɔɔ kɛ ŋaŋ kooli yɛ amɛhenɔ!" Ni eba mi nakai.
Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ŋaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ kɛ shiã kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shIkpɔŋ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ ehi.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa gbɔmɔ adesa yɛ wɔsu nɔ, tamɔ wɔhenɔ, koni eye ŋshɔŋ loi kɛ loofɔji kɛ shiã kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ!"
No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ adesa yɛ esu nɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ nɔ ebɔ lɛ yɛ, ebɔ nuu, ni ebɔ yoo.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ amɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afaa. Nyɛyea ŋshɔŋ loi kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni tsiɔ ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ."
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, mikɛ tsei ni woɔ dumɔwui kɛ tsei ni woɔ yeli yibii ni wui yɔɔ mli ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ehã nyɛ koni nyɛye."
"Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ kɔɔyɔɔŋ looflɔ fɛɛ looflɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ emli lɛ, mikɛ baa fɔ fɛɛ baa fɔ ehã lɛ koni eye!" Ni eba mli nakai.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛ nibii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ, ni naa, ehi naakpa. Ni je na ni je tsɛre; ni no fee gbi ni ji ekpaa.
2: Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni agbe ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ fɛɛ bɔɔ naa ahã.
Be ni shɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ egbe enitsumɔ ni etsu lɛ fɛɛ naa; ni ejɔɔ ehe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ ni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ no nɔ ejɔɔ ehe yɛ, be ni egbe ebɔɔ nitsumɔ ni etsu lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ.
Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋbɔɔ he saji nɛ.
ŋanɔ baa ko bɛ ni ŋanɔ jwei ko nako akwɛ̃ ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hãko nu anɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni gbɔmɔ ko be ni huɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi afua teɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ, ni eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ nu.
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ sū shɔ̃ gbɔmɔ, ni emu wala mumɔ ewo egugɔ mli, ni gbɔmɔ tsɔ bɔɔnɔ ni hiɛ kã.
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ fee trom yɛ Eden yɛ bokagbɛ, ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ ni eshɔ̃ lɛ to jɛi.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hã tsei fɛɛ ni kɛ akwɛ ni aaaba mɔ tsine ni amɛhi hã yeli hu kwɛ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ sū lɛ mli. Ehã wala tso kɛ ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋlee tso hu kwɛ̃ yɛ trom lɛ teŋ.
Ni faa ko hoɔ yɛ Eden mli ni hãa trom lɛ nu. Egblaa niji ejwɛ kɛjɛɔ jɛi.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Pishon. Ehoɔ kɛbɔleɔ Hawila shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, he ni shika yɔɔ lɛ.
Nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shika lɛ hi naakpa; ni bedola ojeŋma kɛ onike tɛ hu yɛ jɛi.
Faa ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Gihon. Ehoɔ kɛbɔleɔ Kush shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Faa ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbɛi ji Tigris. Ehoɔ yɛ Asiria bokagbɛ. Faa ni ji ejwɛ lɛ gbɛi ji Eufrate.
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ bato Eden trom lɛ mli koni ehu mli ni ebu he.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ, "Trom lɛ mli tsei lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yibii lɛ ye bɔ ni osumɔɔ;
shi ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋlee tso lɛ yibii lɛ kaaye ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni oooye eko lɛ, gbo ooogbo!"
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Ehiii akɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ koome hiɔ shi, mafee hefatalɔ ko ni sa lɛ mahã lɛ"

No hewɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ sū shɔ̃ ŋanɔ kooloi kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ; ni ekɛ amɛ ba gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ koni ekwɛ bɔ ni eeetsɛ amɛ; ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni hiɛ kã lɛ, no nɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ egbɛi.
Gbɔmɔ lɛ wo shīa kooloi fɛɛ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ gbɛi; shi lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, anako hefatalɔ ko ni sa lɛ ahã lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hã wɔ ni tsii nyɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ni ewɔ. Be ni ewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie eŋmawu wui lɛ ekome, ni ekɛ loo tsi wui lɛ anajiaŋ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ŋmawu wu ni ejie yɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ fee yoo, ni ekɛ lɛ ba gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mihe nɔ nɛ! Wu ni jɛ miwui amli, kɛ loo ni jɛ miheloo mli nɛ. Mɔ nɛ lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ yoo ejaakɛ nuu mli ajie lɛ kɛjɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome.
Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ, nyiɛ yayai, shi amɛhiɛ gbooo he.
3: Onufu ji Kooloo ko ni le ŋaa fe kooloi fɛɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ. Ebi yoo lɛ akɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ trom lɛ mli tsei ayibii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ nyɛkaye lɛ?"
Ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ onufu lɛ akɛ, "Trom lɛ mli tsei ayibii lɛ wɔyeɔ,
shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ tso ni yɔɔ trom lɛ teŋ lɛ nɔ yibii lɛ, 'Nyɛkayea, ni nyɛkataa he tete, kɛjeee nakai lɛ nyɛbaagboi."
Onufo lɛ kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Jeee gboimɔ nyɛaagboi;
shi moŋ le Nyɔŋmɔ le akɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛaaye eko lɛ, nyɛhiŋmɛi aaagble, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ lɛ, ni nyɛaale ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ."
No hewo lɛ be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ tso lɛ hi hã yeli ni afeɔ hiŋmɛi akɔnɔ ni tso lɛ baa mɔ tsine ni ehãa mɔ leɔ nii lɛ, etse enɔ yibii lɛ eko ni eye ni ehã ewu lɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu eko ni eye.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiŋmɛi gble ni amɛna akɛ amɛnyiɛ yayai. Amɛkpɛ akwadu baa amɛkɛfee mama amɛkɛha amɛhe.
Amɛnu Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he ni enyiɛ trom lɛ mli be bi gbɛkɛnaashi kɔɔyɔɔ shwie lɛ; ni Adam kɛ eŋa lɛ tee amɛhe yɛ trom lɛ mli tsei lɛ ateŋ koni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akana amɛ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Adam ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ oyɔɔ?"
Ni Adam kɛɛ, "Minu ohe yɛ trom lɛ mli, ni mishe gbeyei ejaakɛ minyiɛ yayai ni miyatee mihe."
Nyɔŋmɔ bi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ kɛɛ o akɛ onyiɛ yayai? Te tso lɛ ni miwo bo he kitã akɛ okaye eyibii lɛ eko lɛ, no oye nɛɛ?"
Ni Adam kɛɛ akɛ, "Yoo lɛ ni okɛfata mihe lɛ, lɛ ehã mi tso lɛ yibii lɛ eko ni miye."
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ofee nɛɛ?" Ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ, "Onufu lɛ ni laka mi ni miye."
No hewɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ onufu lɛ akɛ, "Enɛ ni ofee hewɔ lɛ, alomɔ o yɛ shīa kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ ateŋ. Omusu nɔ ooonyiɛ, ni sū oooye owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Mikɛ nyɛɛ aaaŋmɛ bo kɛ yoo lɛ teŋ, kɛ oshwiei kɛ eshwiei ateŋ. Eshwiei aaatswa oyitso nɔ, no bo hu oshwiei aaakɔ̃ enane tsitsi."
Yoo lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã mahã ohe ajra o, yɛ omusuhiɛmɔ mli. Hejramɔ mli ooofɔ bii yɛ; owu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ oootao, ni lɛ eeeye onɔ."
Ni Adam lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Akɛni obo oŋa lɛ toi ni oye tso lɛ ni miwo o he kitã akɛ okaye eyibii lɛ eko lɛ hewɔ lɛ, alomɔ shikpɔŋ sū yɛ ohewɔ. Hejramɔ okɛaana enɔ nii oye owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ŋmei kɛ aŋɛ̃ŋlɛ̃ eeewo ehã o, ni ŋanɔ baa oooye.
Ohiɛ latsaa mli oooye nii yɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooku osɛɛ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ sū mli; ejaakɛ emli ajie o kɛjɛ; sū ji o, ni sū mli ŋɔŋŋ oooku osɛɛ kɛaatee."
Adam wo eŋa lɛ gbɛi akɛ Hawa ejaakɛ lɛji adesai fɛɛ anyɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ kooloo he wolo fee atadei ehã Adam kɛ eŋa lɛ, ni ekɛwo amɛ. Ashwie Adam kɛ Hawa kɛje Trom lɛ mli
Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Naa, gbɔmɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ wɔteŋ mɔ kome, ni ele ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ. Agbɛnɛ, eko lɛ eeekpã enine mli ni etse wala tso lɛ yibii lɛ eko ni eye koni ehiɛ akã kɛya naanɔ."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shwie lɛ kɛje Eden trom lɛ mli koni ayahu shikpɔŋ, nɔ mli ni ajie lɛ kɛjɛ lɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shwie Adam, ni ekɛ kerubim kɛ klaŋte ni miifo ehe ni kplɛɔ tamɔ la to Eden trom lɛ hiɛ yɛ bokagbɛ koni ebu gbɛ ni yaa wala tso lɛ he lɛ he.
4: Adam kɛ eŋa Hawa na bɔlɛ. Hawa na musu ni efɔ Kain, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mina binuu yɛ Yehowa yelikɛbuamɔ naa."
Kain sɛɛ lɛ efɔ enyɛmi Habel. Habel tsɔ̃ tookwɛlɔ, ni Kain tsɔ̃ okwaafonyo.
Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ Kain kɛ eŋmɔshi nii lɛ eko yashã afɔle ehã Yehowa.
Habel hu kɛ etoi lɛ akromɔbii ni ewo fɔ ba ekɛbashã afɔle. Yehowa hiɛ sɔ Habel kɛ efɔle lɛ;
shi ehiɛ esɔɔɔ Kain kɛ afɔle lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Kain mli wo la naakpa, ni etū ehiɛ.
Yehowa bi Kain akɛ, "Mɛɛba omli ewo la, ni mɛɛba otū ohiɛ nɛkɛ?
Aso kɛji ofee ekpakpa lɛ, ohiɛ baŋ nyam? Kɛji ofeee ekpakpa lɛ, esha bu oshinaa lɛ shi, ni bo osɛɛgbɛ etaoɔ lɛ; shi bo lɛ ye enɔ kunim."
Kɛkɛ ni Kain kɛɛ enyɛmi Habel akɛ, "Ha ni wɔya ŋa lɛ nɔ wɔba." Be ni amɛyɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Kain te shi wo enyɛmi Habel ni egbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi Kain akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ onyɛmi Habel yɔɔ?" Kain to he akɛ, "Mileee; ani minyɛmi lɛ, enɔkwɛlɔ ji mi lo?"
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ofee nɛɛ? Onyɛmi lɛ la miiblɔ kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ sū mli eetsɛ mi.
Agbɛnɛ alomɔ o yɛ shikpɔŋ ni gbɛ edaaŋ ekɛmi onyɛmi lɛ la lɛ yɛ odɛŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji ohu shikpɔŋ lɛ ebaŋ nii ehaŋ o yɛ ehewalɛ naa dɔŋŋ. Kobɔlɔ kɛ shikpalɔ oootsɔ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!"
Kain kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Mitɔmɔ lɛ he nyɔmɔwo lɛ da fe bɔ ni manyɛ matre.
Naa, oshwie mi ŋmɛnɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni matee mihe yɛ ohiɛ. Mitsɔ̃ kobɔlɔ kɛ shikpalɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana mi lɛ, eeegbe mi."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Kain akɛ, "Dabida! Kɛji mɔ ko gbe Kain lɛ, aaatɔ Kain he owele shii kpawo. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa to okadi yɛ Kain he koni kɛji mɔ ko na lɛ lɛ, ekagbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Kain je Yehowa hiɛ etee, ni eyahi shi yɛ Nod shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Eden bokagbɛ.
Kain kɛ eŋa lɛ na bɔlɛ, ni ena musu ni efɔ Henok. Kain to maŋ ni ekɛ ebi Henok gbɛi wo maŋ lɛ.
Henok fɔ Irad; Irad fɔ Mehuyael; Mehuyael fɔ Metushael; ni Metushael fɔ Lamek.
Lamek ŋɔ yei enyɔ: Mɔ kome gbɛi ji Ada ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Zila.
Ada fɔ Yabal, lɛji mɛi ni hiɔ buui amli, ni amɛlɛɔ kooloi lɛ atsɛ.
Yabel nyɛmi lɛ gbɛi ji Yubal; saŋkutswalɔi kɛ blɛkpãlɔi fɛɛ atsɛ ji lɛ.
Zila hu fɔ Tubalkain, ni ji ayawa nibii kɛ dade nibii fɛɛ sɔ̃lɔ lɛ; ni Tubalkain nyɛmiyoo gbɛi ji Naama.
Lamek kɛɛ eŋamɛi lɛ akɛ, "Ada kɛ Zila, nyɛboa migbee toi, Migbe oblayo ko: ejaakɛ epila mi.
Kɛji aaatɔ Kain he owele shii kpawo lɛ, asonɔkwa Lamek lɛ, aaatɔ ehe owele shii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo!"
Adam kɛ eŋa Hawa na bɔlɛ ekɔŋŋ, ni Hawa fɔ binuu, ni Hawa wo lɛ Set, ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bi kroko eto mi Habel ni Kain gbe lɛ lɛ najiaŋ."
Set hu fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Enosh. Nakai be lɛ mli gbɔmɛi bɔi Yehowa gbɛi tsɛmɔ kɛ lɛ jamɔ.
5: Adam shwiei lɛ ahe sane nɛ. Gbi ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ Adam lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ su nɔ ebɔ lɛ yɛ.
Ebɔ nuu ni ebɔ yoo ni ejɔɔ amɛ ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ "Gbɔmɔ adesa" gbi nɔ ni ebɔ amɛ lɛ.
Adam eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ momo dani efɔ binuu tamɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Set.
Be ni afɔ Set sɛɛ lɛ, Adam hi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ afii abɔ fɛɛ ni Adam ye dani egbo ji afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Set eye afii oha kɛ enumɔ ni efɔ Enosh.
Be ni efɔ Enosh sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afi ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpawo, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei.
Hewɔ lɛ be ni Set gbo lɛ afii ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Enosh ye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu ni afɔ Kenan.
Be ni efɔ Kenan sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni Enosh gbo lɛ, afii abɔ fɛɛ ni eye ji afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ.
Kenan eye afii nyɔŋmai kpawo dani efɔ Mahalalel;
Mahalalel fɔmɔ sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Efɔ bihii kɛ beyei krokomɛi.
Hewɔ lɛ be ni Kenan gbo lɛ afii ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋma.
Mahalalel eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ dani efɔ Yared.
ni be ni efɔ Yared sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ afii fɛɛ ni Mahalalel ye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ.
Yared ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ dani efɔ Henok;
ni be ni efɔ Henok sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpaanyɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni Yared gbo lɛ, afii abɔ ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ.
Henok ye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ dani efɔ Metusela, ni be ni efɔ Metusela sɛɛ lɛ, eja Nyɔŋmɔ afii ohai etɛ̃,
ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ afii ni Henok ye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ.
Henok mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ mli waa, no hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtɛɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ anaaa lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Metusela ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpawo dani efɔ Lamek;
be ni efɔ Lamek sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enyɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni Mutusela gbo lɛ, afii ni eye lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ nɛɛhu.
Lamek ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enyɔ dani efɔ binuu.
Ewo lɛ Noa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɔ nɛ baashɛje wɔmii yɛ wɔninenaa nitsumɔ kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔɔ wɔ yɛ loomɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ lomɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ."
Be ni Lamek fɔ Noa sɛɛ lɛ, ehi shi afii ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ; ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Lamek gbo lɛ, afii fɛɛ ni eye lɛ fee ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo.
Be ni Noa eye afii ohai enumɔ lɛ efɔ Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet.
6: Be ni gbɔmɛi bɔ̃i fɛomɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni afɔfɔɔ biyei ahã amɛ lɛ,
Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ yana akɛ gbɔmɛi abiyei lɛ ahe yɛ fɛo, ni amɛŋɔŋɔɔ amɛteŋ yei fɛɛ ni amɛsumɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mimumɔ lɛ nyɛŋ ahi gbɔmɔ mli kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ heloo ji gbɔmɔ ni ebaagbo ni afii abɔ ni ebaaye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ."
Nakai bei lɛ amli kɛ no sɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔbii lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi abiyei lɛ fɔfɔɔ asaabui yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Bii nɛɛ tsɔmɔ gbɔmɛi kãkãlɔi ni agbɛii hehe kɛjɛ blema bei lɛ amli tɔ̃ɔ.
Be ni Yehowa na akɛ gbɔmɛi anɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ ekwɔ tso yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nibii ni amɛsusuɔ yɛ amɛyiŋ daa nɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ,
edɔ lɛ naakpa akɛ ebɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni Yehowa shwa ehe.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Makpãtã gbɔmɔ ni mibɔ lɛ lɛ hiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi kooloi kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ kɛ loofɔji anɔ ejaakɛshi edɔ mi akɛ mibɔ amɛ."
Shi Yehowa na Noa he miishɛɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Noa shwiei lɛ. Noa ji jalɔ ni eye emuu yɛ eyinɔbii lɛ ateŋ; ni efeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii.
Noa fɔ bihii etɛ̃. Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi efite yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi kɛ awuyeli.
Nyɔŋmɔ na akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ efite ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ efite amɛjeŋba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Noa akɛ, "Mito miyiŋ akɛ makpãtã heloo fɛɛ hiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ awuyeli. Naa, mibakpãtã amɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Ŋɔɔ timba ni okɛkpɛ adeka ohã ohe. Feemɔ tsui yɛ mli ni okɛ amã akpa emli kɛ ehewɔ fɛɛ kɛtsimɔ ehe fɔji lɛ.
Bɔ ni ofee lɛ ohã nɛ. Adeka lɛ kɛlɛ ninetalɔi ohai etɛ̃, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Hɛhɛmɔ adeka lɛ ni oha ekpa nu ninetalɔ kome yɛ ekoji anɔ. Haa adeka lɛ yiteŋ. Feemɔ shinaa yɛ adeka lɛ he. Feemɔ adeka lɛ sɔɔdoi etɛ̃: shishi nɔ, kɛ nɔ ni ji enyɔ kɛ nɔ ni ji etɛ̃.
Ejaakɛ naa, mahã nu efua aha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni akɛkpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ mli lɛ hiɛ yɛ ŋwɛishishi nɛɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã.
Shi bo lɛ mi kɛ bo aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ, ni ooobote adeka lɛ mli, bo kɛ obihii lɛ kɛ oŋa kɛ obihii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã yɛ heloo mli lɛ, ŋɔɔ srɔtoi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo, ni okɛya adeka lɛ mli koni ahere amɛyiwala afata ohe.
Ŋɔɔ loofɔji yɛ ahɛhenɔ, kɛ kooloi yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ yɛ ahɛhenɔ, srɔtoi fɛɛ lɛ, enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, kɛba oŋɔɔ yɛ adeka lɛ mli koni ahere amɛyiwala.
Ŋɔɔ niyenii fɛɛ niyenii ni ayeɔ lɛ eko oto yɛ adeka lɛ mli. Obua naa oto ohã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ amɛ."
Noa fee nakai; bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee.
7: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Noa akɛ, "Bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbotea adeka lɛ mli ejaakɛ boji mɔ ni mina akɛ jalɔ yɛ mihiɛ yɛ yinɔ nɛɛ mli.
Ŋɔɔ kooloi ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ kpawokpawo, nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ kooloi ni he tseee lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo,
kɛ loofɔji hu kpawokpawo, nuu kɛ yoo, ofata ohe koni akɛhere amɛshwiei fɛɛ yiwala yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi eshwɛ gbii kpawo ni mahã nu aba abanɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni makpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni mibɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Noa fee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Noa eye afii ohai ekpaa be ni nu afua lɛ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Noa kɛ eŋa kɛ ebihii kɛ ebii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ bote adeka lɛ mli yɛ nu afua lɛ hewɔ.
Kooloi ni he tse kɛ kooloi ni he tseee kɛ loofɔji kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
enyɔɔnyɔ, nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ Noa tee adeka lɛ mli tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ.
Gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nu afua lɛ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Noa wala be mli afi ni ji ohai ekpaa lɛ mli, yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ, ni bu wulu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ hiŋmɛii fɛɛ flɛ, ni agble ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ;
ni nu tue ni enɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Noa kɛ ebii lɛ, Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet, kɛ Noa ŋa lɛ kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ aŋamɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, bote adeka lɛ mli,
amɛ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ shīa kooloi fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ waamɔ nii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛhenɔ, kɛ loofoji fɛɛ yɛ amɛhenɔ. Fijatsɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ flikilɔi fɛɛ bote adeka lɛ mli.
Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni wala yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ateŋ enyɔɔnyɔ kɛ Noa tee adeka lɛ mli.
Heloo fɛɛ heloo ni hiɛ kã, nuu kɛ yoo, tee adeka lɛ mli taakɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã lɛ lɛ. Ni Yehowa ŋa Noa yi.
Nu afua lɛ damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Nu lɛ fa, ni ewo adeka lɛ nɔ, ni adeka lɛ shi shikpɔŋ.
Nu lɛ he shi, ni efa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni adeka lɛ tɛo nu lɛ hiɛ.
Nu lɛ he shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahuu po ni eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gɔji ni kwlɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
Nu lɛ kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni esu gɔji lɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ.
Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loofɔji kɛ shīa kooloi kɛ ŋanɔ kooloi kɛ waamɔ nii kɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ plenee.
Bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni muɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ lɛ gboi.
Akpãtã nibii fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloi kɛ waamɔ nii kɛ loofɔji anɔ; akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ Noa kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ adeka lɛ mli lɛ pɛ.
Nu lɛ damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
8: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kai Noa kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi lɛ kɛ shīa kooloi lɛ fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ adeka lɛ mli lɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko batswa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nu lɛ bɔ̃i kpɔ̃ŋmɔ.
Aŋamɔ nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ anaa; ni nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kpa.
Nu lɛ hiɛ kpɔ̃ŋmɔ fiofio yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni gbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ nu lɛ nɔ gbɔ.
Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, adeka lɛ yama shi yɛ Ararat gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Nu lɛ hiɛ kpɔ̃ŋmɔ aahuu kɛyashi nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ. Nakai nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ana gɔji lɛ ayiteaŋ.
Gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Noa gble adeka ni efee lɛ samflɛ lɛ,
ni etsu kwãakwãalabite ko. Kwãakwãalabite lɛ hiɛ yaa kɛ baa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nu lɛ mii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Noa tsu okpo ko koni ekɛna kɛji nu lɛ emii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lo.
Shi be ni okpo lɛ tee lɛ enaaa he ko esɔ̃ ejaakɛ nu lɛ ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lolo. Hewɔ lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba Noa ŋɔɔ yɛ adeka lɛ mli.
Noa mɛ gbii kpawo kroko, ni esaa etsu okpo lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Okpo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ gbɛkɛnaashi, ni naa, mutso baa fɔ kɔ̃ enaa. Enɛ hã Noa na le akɛ nu lɛ emii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Esaa amɛ gbii kpawo kroko hu, ni etsu okpo lɛ ekoŋŋ, shi okpo lɛ ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa eŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.

Eba mli akɛ Noa wala mli afi ni ji ohai ekpaa kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ, yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nu lɛ mii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni Noa jie nɔ ni ekɛha adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ekwɛ ni ena akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ egbi.
Nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi kwraa.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Noa wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Jee adeka lɛ mli, bo kɛ oŋa kɛ obii kɛ obii aŋamɛi ni fata ohe lɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã, ni ji heloo fɛɛ heloo ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ, loofɔji kɛ kooloi kɛ nii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, okɛ amɛ aje kpo koni amɛfɔ ni amɛyi afa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Noa kɛ ebii lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii lɛ aŋamɛi ni fata ehe lɛ je kpo;
kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ fɛɛ kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni tsiɔ ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ je kpo yɛ adeka lɛ mli yɛ amɛwekui anaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Noa ma afɔleshãa latɛ ehã Yehowa. Eŋɔ shīa kooloi ni he tse lɛ fɛɛ mli eko, ni ekɛshã shãa afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

Be ni Yehowa here afɔle lɛ ŋma jurɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Milomɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ hewɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nii ni gbɔmɔ jwɛŋɔ yɛ eyiŋ lɛ efɔŋ ni kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi; ni asaŋ mikpãtãŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã hiɛ dɔŋŋ, tambɔ bɔ ni mifee nɛɛ.
Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nidumɔ kɛ nikpamɔ, latsaabe kɛ fɛ̃ibe, agbiɛnaa kɛ ahrabata, shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ sɛɛ efoŋ."
9: Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ Noa kɛ ebii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afaa, ni nyɛyia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ ashe nyɛ gbeyei ni nyɛheŋmiŋmi amɔ amɛ, nyɛdɛŋ atu amɛ awo.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni tsiɔ ehe ni ehiɛ kã lɛ atsɔ̃ nyɛniyenii, ni tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ shwie ŋmɔŋ ehã nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ehã nyɛ.
Shi loo ni lá ni ji ewala yɔɔ mli lɛ nyɛkayea.
Shi anɔkwa mabi nyɛlá ni ji nyɛwala lɛ shi; mabi shi yɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni kpãtãa lá hiɛ lɛ dɛŋ, na mabi gbɔmɔ lá shi yɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ ejaakɛ enyɛmi ji lɛ.
Mɔ ni shwieɔ gbɔmɔ lá shi lɛ, gbɔmɔ nɔŋŋ aaashwie lɛ hu elá shi kɛ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ.
"Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfɔa ni nyɛyi afaa; nyɛwoa shwiei babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛyi afaa yɛ nɔ."
Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Noa kɛ ebii ni fata ehe lɛ akɛ,
"Naa, mikɛ mikpãŋmɔ miima shi mahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ni aaaba yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ,
kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ, ni ji loofɔji kɛ shīa kooloi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ni fata nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ.
Mahã mikpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ ama shi, ni nu afua lɛ ebapleneŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ nu afua ko ebakpãtãŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ."
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni mi kɛ nyɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ ekpãŋ kɛyaa yinɔi ni baaba lɛ fɛɛ lɛ he okadi.
Mikɛ mikwaabuɛtɛ miito atatui lɛ amli, ni efee kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ je lɛ teŋ he okadi.
Kɛji mihã atatui wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ana kwaabuɛtɛ lɛ yɛ atatui lɛ amli lɛ,
makai kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni mi kɛ nyɛ kɛ nibii srɔtoisrɔtoi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ, ni nu tsɔ̃ŋ afua ni eeekpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã hiɛ dɔŋŋ.
Kɛji kwaabuɛtɛ lɛ fo yɛ atatui lɛ amli lɛ, mana ni makai minaanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni kã mi kɛ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ."
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Noa akɛ, "Enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ he okadi."
Noa bii lɛ ni jɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ ji Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet. Ham ji Kanaan tsɛ.
Mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ji Noa bihii lɛ; amɛmli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ jɛ gbɛ shwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Noa nitsumɔ ji humɔ; lɛji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni fee waintrom.
Enu wain ni etɔ, ni ekã ebuu lɛ mli kɛ ehe yayai.
Ham, kanaan tsɛ lɛ, yana etsɛ yayaiaŋ ni ayakɛɛ enyɛmimɛi enyɔ lɛ yɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Shem kɛ Yafet kɔ mama ni amɛkɛfɔ̃ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɔ̃ji anɔ ni amɛnyiɛ sɛɛsɛɛ ni amɛtee amɛkɛyaha amɛtsɛ yayaiaŋ, amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛhiɛ amɛhã sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛnaaa amɛtsɛ yayaiaŋ.
Shi be ni dãa lɛ tserɛ yɛ Noa hiɛ ni ena ele nɔ ni ebi gbekɛ lɛ efee lɛ lɛ,
ekɛɛ akɛ, "Alomɔ Kanaan; nyɔji amli nyɔŋ eeetsɔ̃ ehã enyɛmimɛi lɛ."
Asaŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, Shem Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni Kanaan atsɔ̃ Shem nyɔŋ."
"Nyɔŋmɔ ahã Yafet shwiei ashwere. Ehi Shem buui lɛ amli ni Kanaan atsɔ̃ Yafet nyɔŋ."
Nu afua lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Noa hi shi afii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Afii ni Noa ye dani egbo lɛ fɛɛ feɔ afii ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
10: Noa bihii ni ji Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet ashwiei nɛ; amɛfɔ bihii yɛ nu afua lɛ sɛɛ.
Yafet bii ji Gomer kɛ Magog kɛ Madai kɛ Yavan kɛ Tubal kɛ Meshek kɛ Tiras.
Gomer bii ji Ashkenaz kɛ Rifat kɛ Togarma.
Yavan shwiei ji Elishah kɛ Spainbii kɛ Kiprobii kɛ Rodebii.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi amli mɛi jɛ amɛgbɛ amɛshwã ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji kɛ ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ anɔ. Yafet shwiei nɛɛ hi amɛshikpɔji anɔ yɛ amɛwekui amli yɛ amɛmaji amli, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.
Ham shwiei ji Kushbii kɛ Egyptbii kɛ Libiabii kɛ Kanaanbii.
Kush shwiei ji Sebabii kɛ Havilabii kɛ Sabtabii, kɛ Raamabii kɛ Sabtekabii; Raama shwiei ji Shebabii kɛ Dedanbii.
Kush fɔ bi ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nimrod, ni ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni tsɔ̃ kãkãlɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eji gbɔbilɔ kpanaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ afɔɔ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, "Etamɔ Nimrod, gbɔbilɔ kpanaa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ."
Eje emaŋtsɛyeli shishi yɛ babilon kɛ Erek kɛ Akad. Maji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyɔɔ.
Ejɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛtee Asiria, ni eyato Nineve maŋ lɛ kɛ Rehobot Ir kɛ Kala.
kɛ Resen ni yɔɔ Nineve kɛ Kala maŋ wulu lɛ teŋ lɛ.
Egipt shwiei ji Ludiabii kɛ Anambii kɛ Lehabbii kɛ Naftubii
kɛ Patrusbii kɛ Kaslubii kɛ Kaftorbii, mɛi amli ni Filistibii lɛ jɛ lɛ.
Kanaan fɔ Sidon, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Het.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ eshwiei ji Yebusbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Girgashbii.
kɛ Hivbii kɛ Arkbii kɛ Sinbii
kɛ Arvadbii kɛ Zemarbii kɛ Hamatbii. Fee sɛɛ lɛ Kanaanbii akutsei kɛ gbɛ shwã,
aahuu kɛyashi amɛhusu lɛ shɛ Sidon kɛtsɔ̃ Gerar kɛyashi Gaza, kɛjɛ jɛi kɛtsɔ̃ Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ Adama kɛ Ziboim kɛyashi Lasha.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ham shwiei lɛ. Amɛhi shi yɛ amɛwekuiaŋ kɛ amɛmajiaŋ yɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ anɔ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.
Shem ni ji Yafet nyɛmi nukpa lɛ hu yɛ bii. Hebribii fɛɛ lɛ Shem shwiei ni.
Shem fɔ Elam kɛ Ashur kɛ Arpakshad kɛ Lud kɛ Aram.
Aram bii ji Uz kɛ Hul kɛ Geter kɛ Meshek.
Arpakshad fɔ Shela; ni Shela fɔ Eber.
Eber fɔ bii enyɔ, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Peleg, ejaakɛ ebei lɛ amli agbla shikpɔŋ lɛ mli; ni enyɛmi lɛ gbɛi ji Yoktan.
Yoktan fɔ Almodad kɛ Shelef kɛ Hazarmawet kɛ Yera kɛ,
Hadoram kɛ Uzal kɛ Dikla
kɛ Obal kɛ Abimael kɛ Sheba kɛ
Ofir kɛ Havila kɛ Yobab. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yoktan shwiei ni.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ jɛ Mesha kɛtee Sefar boka gɔŋ lɛ he.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Shem shwiei lɛ. Amɛhi shi yɛ amɛwekuiaŋ kɛ amɛmajiaŋ yɛ amɛshikpɔji anɔ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋ wiemɔ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Noa shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekukpãa naa. Amɛhi amɛmajiaŋ yɛ amɛshikpɔji anɔ. Amɛmli jeŋ maji lɛ jɛ gbɛ shwã jeŋ fɛɛ yɛ nu afua lɛ sɛɛ.
11: Tsutsu lɛ, jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ wieɔ wiemɔ kome.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni amɛfã gbɛ kɛjɛ bokagbɛ lɛ, amɛyana ŋa kplenee ko yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛhi jɛi.
Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔfoa ntayaa ni wɔshãa ni egbī keketee!" Ni amɛna ntayaa ni wa yɛ tɛ najiaŋ, ni asaŋ amɛkɛ sū tswãa tswa gbogbo lɛ.
Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔtoa maŋ wɔhãa wɔhe, ni emli mɔ̃ɔ yiteŋ ayashi ŋwɛi, ni wɔkɛhe gbɛi koni wɔkagbɛ wɔshwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowah kpleke shi kɛba ni ebakwɛ maŋ kɛ mɔ̃ɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesai ema lɛ.
Yehowah kɛɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ, gbɔmɛi kome ni, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛwieɔ wiemɔ kome, ni nɔ ni amɛaafee wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ, eshishijee kɛkɛ po nɛ, etsɛŋ kwraa ni amɛaafee nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ.
Nyɛhãa wɔkplekea shi ni wɔyatsakea amɛwiemɔ lɛ ni wɔfee lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoisrɔtoi, koni mɔ ko akanu enaanyo wiemɔ dɔŋŋ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gbɛ amɛ eshwã kɛje jɛi kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛfɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ too.
No hewɔ lɛ atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Babilon, ejaakɛ jɛi Yehowa tsake shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ awiemɔ yɛ, ni jɛi Yehowah jɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shem shwiei nɛ: Shem eye afii oha ni efɔ Arpakshad yɛ nu afua lɛɛ sɛɛ afii enyɔ.
Be ni Shem fɔ Arpakshad sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enumɔ eshwie nɔ, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Be ni Arpakshad ye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ lɛ, efɔ Shela.
Be ni Arpakshad fɔ Shela sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Shela eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni efɔ Eber.
Be ni Shela fɔ Eber sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwe kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ eshwiei nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Eber eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ejwɛ ni efɔ Peleg.
Be ni efɔ Peleg sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ eshwiei nɔ, efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Peleg eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni efɔ Reu.
Be ni efɔ Reu sɛɛ lɛ eye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Reu eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ ni efɔ Serug.
Be ni Reu fɔ Serug sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ kpawo eshwiei nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Serug eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni efɔ Nahor.
Be ni Serug fɔ Nahor sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii ohai enyɔ eshwie nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Nahor eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu ni efɔ Tera.
Be ni Nahor fɔ Tera sɛɛ lɛ, eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu eshwiei nɔ; efɔ bihii kɛ biyei krokomɛi.
Tera eye afii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni efɔ Abram kɛ Nahor kɛ Haran.
Tera shwiei nɛ. Tera fɔ Abram kɛ Nahor kɛ Haran, ni Haran fɔ Lot.
Haran gbo yɛ etsɛ Tera hiɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni afɔ lɛ yɛ ni ji Ur yɛ Babilon lɛ.
Abram kɛ Nahor ŋɔ yei; Abram ŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Sarai, ni Nahor ŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Milka, ni ji Iska tsɛ Haran biyoo lɛ.
Shi Sarai fee kene, ni no hewɔ lɛ ebɛ bi.
Tera ŋɔ ebi Abram kɛ Haram bi Lot ni ji enabi lɛ kɛ eshaayoo Sarai, ni ji ebi Abram ŋa lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛje Ur yɛ Babilon koni amɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ: Shi be ni amɛbashɛ Haran lɛ, amɛhi jɛi.
Tera ye afii ohai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, ni egbo yɛ Haran.
12: Yehowah kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Jee oshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛ ojakumɛi ateŋ kɛ otsɛ we lɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ o lɛ nɔ.
Mahã otsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple, ni majɔɔ o, ni mahã ogbɛi ahehe, ni oootsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ!
Majɔɔ mɛi ni jɔɔ o, ni mɔ ni lomɔɔ o lɛ, malomɔ lɛ; kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wekui fɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abram yiŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni Lot kɛ lɛ tee. Abram eye afii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ, be ni eyiŋ kɛjɛ Haran lɛ.
Eŋɔ eŋa Sarai lɛ kɛ enyɛmi nuu bi Lot lɛ, kɛ amɛnibii fɛɛ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Be ni amɛshɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ
Abram tee ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛyashi eyashɛ Shekem; etseŋ kɛtee tso krɔŋkrɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ More ŋa lɛ mli lɛ he. Nakai be mli lɛ, Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jie ehe kpo estɔ̃ɔ Abram ni ekɛɛ, "Oshwiei mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã." No hewɔ lɛ, Abram mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa, mɔ ni jie ehe kpo tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ.
Abram fã yɛ jɛi kɛtee gɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ Betel bokagbɛ lɛ he, ni eshi ebuu yɛ jɛi; Betel ye anaigbɛ, ni Ai ye bokagbɛ. Jɛi hu ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ ehã Yehowa, ni eja Yehowa yɛ jɛi.
Abram tsa egbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya wuoyi gbɛ lolo.
Shi hɔmɔ ko ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; no hewɔ lɛ Abram yiŋ kɛtee Egipt koni eyato gbɔ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaashɛ Egipt lɛ, ekɛɛ eŋa Sarai akɛ, "Mile akɛ yoo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ji o, ni kɛ ana o lɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo;
ni eeeba mli akɛ kɛ Egiptbii lɛ na o lɛ, amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, "Eŋa ni." Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaagbe mi, shi bo lɛ amɛaahere oyiwala.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ minyɛmiyoo ji o, koni ahi ahã mi yɛ ohewɔ, ni miyi ana wala hu yɛ ohewɔ."
Be ni Abram bashɛ Egipt lɛ, Egiptbii lɛ na yoo lɛ akɛ ahe yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Farao lumɛi lɛ hu na lɛ, ni amɛyajie eyi amɛhã Farao, ni abaŋɔ yoo lɛ kɛtee Farao we lɛ.
Sarai hewɔ lɛ Farao hiɛ Abram jogbaŋŋ. Ni no hewɔ lɛ Abram na toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tejihii kɛ webii kɛ weyei kɛ tejiyei kɛ yomai.
Shi Abram na Sarai hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã Farao kɛ ewe lɛ na amanehulu ni naa wa.
No hewɔ lɛ Farao tsɛ Abram ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ofee mi nɛɛ? Mɛɛba okɛɛɛ mi akɛ yoo lɛ oŋa ni lɛ?
Mɛɛba okɛɛ akɛ onyɛmiyoo ji lɛ, ni ohã miŋɔ lɛ mifee miŋa lɛ? Agbɛnɛ naa oŋa, ŋɔɔ lɛ ni oya!"
Kɛkɛ ni Farao famɔ hii komɛi eto ehe akɛ amɛyajie lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ gbɛ.
13: Abram kɛ eŋa kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ je Egipt, ni Lot fata ehe; amɛtee wuoyigbɛ.
No mli lɛ Abram ena nii babaoo: Shīa kooloi kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika tsuru.
Etsa egbɛfãa lɛ nɔ fiofio kɛjɛ wuoyigbɛ aahuu kɛtee Betel. Eyashɛ he ko yɛ Betel kɛ Ai teŋ, he ni eshi ebuu lɛ yɛ ni ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ tsutsu ko lɛ.
Biɛ Abram ja Yehowa yɛ.
Lot ni kɛ Abram nyiɛ lɛ hu yɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ buui,
ni no hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ faaa hãaa amɛ bɔ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaahi he kome, ejaakɛ anɛnibii fa.
Kɛkɛ ni bei ba Abram koolookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ Lot koolookwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abram kɛɛ Lot akɛ, "Kaahã bei miiba mi kɛ o teŋ kɛ mikoolookwelɔi lɛ kɛ okoolookwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ nyɛmimɛi ji wɔ.
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ. Tse ohe yɛ mihe. Kɛji okɔ abɛkugbɛ lɛ, no lɛ makɔ ninejurɔgbɛ; ni kɛji okɔ ninejurɔgbɛ lɛ, no lɛ makɔ abɛkugbɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Lot wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkpe, ni ena akɛ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ frɔ̃frɔ̃ aahuu kɛtee Zoar tɔ̃ɔ. Etamɔ Yehowa trom lɛ aloo Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Yehowa kpãtãko Sodom kɛ Gomora hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Lot kɔ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni efã kɛtee bokagbɛ. Bɔ ni fee ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛgbla mli nɛ.
Abram hi Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Lot hi maji ni yɔɔ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ amli. Lot shi ebuu lɛ shii abɔ kɛyashi be ni eyashɛ Sodom.
Shi Sodombii lɛ yiwalɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛfeɔ esha amɛshiɔ Yehowa.
Be ni Lot kɛ Abram egbla mli sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Wo ohiɛ nɔ, ni ojɛ he ni oyɔɔ lɛ okwɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ bokagbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni onaa nɛɛ,
bo kɛ oshwiei mikɛbaahã kɛaatee naanɔ.
Mahã oshwiei afa tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu, ni kɛji mɔ ko aaanyɛ shikpɔŋ mlu akane lɛ, belɛ aaanyɛ oshwiei lɛ hu akane.
Tee shi, nyiɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ nɔ, shi bo mikɛbaahã."
Kɛkɛ ni Abram fã ebuu lɛ, ni eba ebahi Mamre tsei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ni yɔɔ Hebron lɛ amasɛi, ni ama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa.
14: Babilon maŋtsɛ Amrafel kɛ Elasar maŋtsɛ Ariok kɛ Elam maŋtsɛ Kedorlaomer kɛ Goiim maŋtsɛ Tidal abei amli lɛ,
maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fã ta amɛshi Sodom maŋtsɛ Bera kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛ Birsha kɛ Adma maŋtsɛ Shinab kɛ Zeboim maŋtsɛ Shemeber kɛ Bela ni ji Zoar Maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ fee ta kome yɛ Sidim jɔɔ lɛ ni etsɔ̃ Ŋoo ŋshɔ agbɛnɛ lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ sɔmɔ Kedorlaomer afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, shi afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtse atūa.
Afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Kedorlaomer kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni fata ehe lɛ ba ni amɛbaye Refabii anɔ kunim yɛ Ashterot Karnaim. Amɛye Zuzbii anɔ yɛ Ham, ni amɛye Embii anɔ yɛ Kiriataim ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Amɛye Horbii hu anɔ yɛ amɛgɔŋ Edom lɛ nɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi El-Paran ni kã shiaŋa kplanaa lɛ naa lɛ.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛba En-mishphat, (no ji Kadesh) ni amɛye Amalekbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, kɛ Amorbii ni yɔɔ Hazazon-Tamar lɛ hu anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Sodom maŋtsɛ kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛ kɛ Adma maŋtsɛ kɛ Ziboim Maŋtsɛ kɛ Bela, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zoar hu lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ fã, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Sidim jɔɔ lɛ mli,
ni amɛkɛ Elam maŋtsɛ Kedorlaomer kɛ Goiim maŋtsɛ Tidal kɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ Amrafel kɛ Elasar maŋtsɛ Ariok bawu; maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ wu.
Shi Sidim jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amãtɛ bui sɔŋŋ yɔɔ jɛi. Awo Sodom kɛ Gomora maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ afoi, ni amɛnyɔnyɔɔ bui lɛ amli, shi maŋtsɛmɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ jo foi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ lɛ ŋɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora nii fɛɛ kɛ niyenii fɛɛ, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee.
Amɛŋɔ Abram nyɛmibi Lot ni yɔɔ Sodom lɛ hu kɛ enibii kɛtee.
Shi nuu ko ni jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ ba ni ebagba Abram, Hebrinyo lɛ ni ehe shi yɛ he ni Mamre, Amornyo lɛ, wɔŋ koo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Shi Eshkol kɛ Aner nyɛmi ji Mamre; ni amɛkɛ Abram ekpãŋ.
Be ni Abram nu akɛ aŋɔ enyɛmibi lɛ nom lɛ, ekɛ etsuji ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ ni le ta he nii, ni afɔ amɛ yɛ ewe lɛ, fã ta, ni etiu maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtee Dan.
Ekɛ etsuji lɛ gba ta wo amɛhe nyɔɔŋ, ni enine tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni etiu amɛ kɛtee Hoba ni yɔɔ Damasko kooyigbɛ lɛ.
Eŋɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enyɛmibi Lot lɛ hu kɛ enibii lɛ, kɛ yei lɛ hu kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba.
Be ni Abram eye Kedorlaomer kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ kunim ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ tee eyakpee lɛ yɛ Shaveh Jɔɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi Maŋtsɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Na Salem maŋtsɛ Melkizedek kɛ aboloo kɛ wain ba. Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ osɔfo ji lɛ.
Ejɔɔ Abram ni ekɛɛ, "Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ ajɔɔ Abram,
ni ajie Ŋwɛi Flooflo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni hã oye ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ yi." Ni Abram hã Melkizedek nii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ migbɔmɛi lɛ ohã mi, shi haa nibii lɛ ŋɔɔ ohã ohe."
Shi Abram kɛɛ Sodom maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mina Ŋwɛi Floolo Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ,
akɛ kɛjɛ kpãa nɔ aahuu kɛyashi tokota naa kpãa nɔ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji onɔ lɛ, kɛji mikɔ eko fii! Koni okakɛɛ akɛ, 'Mi, mifee Abram niiatsɛ.'
Miŋɔɔɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja nɔ ni oblahii lɛ eye kɛkɛ, kɛ hii ni kɛ mi tee lɛ, Aner kɛ Eshkol kɛ Mamre; amɛ lɛ hã ni amɛŋɔ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ."
15: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Abram wie yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, Abram, mabu ohe, ni mabaa oyi"
Shi Abram kɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni obaahã mi, mi ni minyiɛ ni mibɛ bi ni mɔ ni baaye migboshi nii lɛ ji Eliezer, Damaskonyo nɛɛ?"
Abram tee nɔ ekɛɛ, "Naa, mi lɛ, ohãko mi shwie ko, ni nyɔŋ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ miwe lɛ baaye minii."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Mɔ nɛ yeŋ onii; shi moŋ bi ni aaajɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋ lɛ, lɛ ebaaye onii."
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abram je kpo ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ ŋwɛi koo, ni okane ŋulamii akɛ ooonyɛ amɛ okane lo." Ekɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Bɔ ni oshwiei aaatamɔ nɛ."
Abram kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa na ehe tsui jurɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Miji Yehowa mɔ ni jie o kɛkɛ Ur yɛ Babilonbii shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni maŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ mahã o akɛ onɔ lɛ."
Shi Abram bi akɛ, "Ao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni mikɛaale akɛ eeetsɔ̃ minɔ?"
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ tsinayoo ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ too abotiayoo ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ ojwɛni ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ kosɛɛ okpo kɛ shiã okpo aba."
Abram kɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba. Abram flɔ amɛmli enyɔɔnyɔ, ni eto fãfãi lɛ eshwie biɛ kɛ biɛ, eko yɛ eko ŋlɛnɔ; shi loofɔji lɛ eflɔɔɔ emɛmli.
Kɛkɛ ni loofɔji ni yeɔ loo akpleke shi basɔmɔ kooloi agbohii lɛ anɔ, shi Abram shwie amɛ.
Be ni hulu yaa enyanyɔ shi lɛ, wɔ ni tsii nyɔ Abram nɔ, ni duŋ kpii kɛ gbeyei ni naa wa mɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Na ole akɛ oshwiei aaatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni jeee amɛnɔ nɔ ni amɛaasɔ̃mɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ aaawa oshwiei lɛ ayi afii ohai ejwɛ.
Shi nakai jeŋmaŋ lɛ hu ni amɛaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ, magbla amɛtoi, ni no sɛɛ lɛ, oshwiei lɛ aaashi jɛi kɛ nii babaoo.
Bo lɛ oooyanina otsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; ni aaafu o be mli ni ogbɔ gbɔlɛ kpakpa.
Shi yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ oshwiei lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba biɛ ekoŋŋ; ejaakɛ eshai ni Amorbii feɔ lɛ shɛko he ni kɛ eshɛ ni abaagbla amɛtoi."
Ni be ni hulu enyɔ shi ni hiɛ ebu lɛ, naa, kukwɛi kɛ emli la ni miifã lasu kɛ kɔti ni miitso gboŋaa batsɔ̃ loi fãfãafãi lɛ ateŋ kɛho.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abram kpãŋ ni ekɛɛ "Oshwiei lɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã, kɛjɛ Egipt faa lɛ naa kɛyashi faa kpeteŋkple ni ji Eufrate Faa lɛ naa.
Kenbii kɛ Kenizbii kɛ Kadmonbii,
kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Refabii,
kɛ Amorbii kɛ Kanaanbii kɛ Girgashbii kɛ Yebusbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ."
16: Agbɛnɛ Sarai, Abram ŋa lɛ fɔɔɔ; shi eyɛ weyoo Egiptyoo ko ni egbɛi ji Hagar.
Ni Sarai kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Naa, Yehowa etsi mifɔmɔ naa. Okɛ minyɔŋyoo lɛ ayawɔ; eko lɛ mana bii kɛaatsɔ̃ enɔ." Ni Abram bo Sarai toi.
No hewɔ lɛ Sarai ŋɔ Egiptyoo Hagar, eweyoo lɛ, ehã ewu Abram gblã, be ni Abram eye afii nyɔŋma yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Abram kɛ Hagar na musu; shi be ni Hagar na akɛ ehiɛ musu lɛ, ewula lɛ heguɔ gbo yɛ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Sarai kɛɛ Abram akɛ, "Sane ni eŋɔɔɔ ni akɛyeɔ mi nɛɛ, sɔ̃ lɛ atre o! Mikɛ miweyoo lɛ hã o; shi kɛjɛ be ni ena akɛ ena musu lɛ, mihiɛ eshwiei shi yɛ ehiɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ aaakojo mi kɛ o teŋ sane nɛɛ."
Shi Abram kɛɛ Sarai akɛ, "Naa, oweyoo lɛ yɛ odɛŋ; feemɔ lɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ." No hewɔ lɛ Sarai nyɛ Hagar hiɛ, ni Hagar jo foi kɛje eŋɔɔ.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ na Hagar yɛ nubu ko he yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ Shur gbɛ lɛ nɔ nubu lɛ he.
Bɔfo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Hagar! Sarai weyoo, nɛgbɛ ojɛ? Ni nɛgbɛ hu oyaa?" Hagar to he ekɛɛ, "Miijo foi kɛjɛ miwula Sarai ŋɔɔ."
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ kɛya owula lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oba ohe shi ohã lɛ."
Asaŋ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Hagar akɛ, "Fa mahã oshwiei afa babaoo bɔ ni anyɛŋ amɛ akane."
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ Hagar akɛ, "Naa, ohiɛ musu ni obaafɔ binuu ni gbɛi ni ooowo lɛ ji Ishmael, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ena bɔ ni onaa nɔ ni oyoyro lɛ,
shi gbɛkɛ lɛ aaafee enii tamɔ ŋaŋ teji, ekɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu kɛ lɛ aaana, ni ekɛ ewekumɛi efeŋ nɔ ko."
Hagar bi ehe akɛ, "Ani mina Nyɔŋmɔ lɛɛlɛŋ ni fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mihiɛ kã lolo nɛɛ?" No hewɔ lɛ etsɛ Yehowa mɔ ni kɛ lɛ wie lɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ni naa mi."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ atsɛ nɛkɛ bu nɛɛ akɛ, "Beer la hai-roi", eshishi ji, "Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni enaa mi" lɛ nubu. Nubu nɛɛ yɛ Kadesh kɛ Bered teŋ.
Ni Hagar kɛ Abram fɔ binuu, ni Abram wo ebi ni Hagar fɔ lɛ gbɛi akɛ Ishmael.
Abram eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpaa be ni Hagar kɛ lɛ fɔ Ishmael lɛ.
17: Be ni Abram eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ, Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miji Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, ba ojeŋ yɛ mihiɛ koni shwamɔ ko akahi ohe.
Mikɛ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ mi kɛ bo teŋ, ni mahã oshwiei afa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abram ŋɔ ehiɛ ebu shi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
Mikɛ bo miikpãŋ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ maji pii atsɛ.
Atsɛŋ bo Abram dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ aaatsɛ no Abraham, ejaakɛ mahã ofee maji pii atsɛ.
Mahã owo shwiei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ni mahã majimaji ajɛ omli ni maŋtsɛmɛi aaajɛ omli.
"Mahã mipkãŋmɔ ni kã mi kɛ o teŋ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ, ni eeetsɔ̃ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ehã oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli; matsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ mahã bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ.
Mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni obato gbɔ yɛ nɔ nɛɛ baahã bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ. Kanaan shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ oshwiei anɔ kɛya naanɔ, ni matsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ."
Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, "Yɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ lɛ, bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛyinɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Bɔ ni nyɛbaato mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ bo kɛ oshwiei ni aaabaye osɛɛ lɛ teŋ nɛ: Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ afo lɛ ketia.
Aflɔ nyɛ ketia, ni no atsɔ kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ lɛ he okadi.

Binuu fɛɛ binuu ni eyɔɔ nyɛteŋ ni eye gbii kpaanyɔ lɛ, afo lɛ ketia; bibuu fɛɛ binuu yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ owe lɛ jio, akɛ oshika he lɛ yɛ gbɔ ni jɛɛɛ oshwiei lɛ eteŋ jio, afo lɛ ketia.
Fo afo mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ owe lɛ mli kɛ mɔ ni okɛ oshika he lɛ fɛɛ ketia koni mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ahi nyɛheloo mli akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ.
Nuu foolɔ ko ni afoko lɛ ketia lɛ akabu lɛ ashi mimɛi lɛ anɔ; eku mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli."
Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, "Oŋa Sarai lɛ, kaatsɛ egbɛi akɛ Sarai dɔŋŋ, shi abaatsɛ lɛ Sara.
Majɔɔ lɛ ni asaŋ mahã okɛ lɛ afɔ binuu. Majɔɔ lɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ maji anyɛ, ni maji anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi aaajɛ emli."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni eŋmɔ, ni ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Ani nuu shi eye afii oha lɛ aaanyɛ ekɛ yoo afɔ bi lo? Sara ni eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu lɛ aaanyɛ afɔ bi lo?
Abraham kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Ao, mina ni kulɛ Ishmael yi na wala yɛ ohiɛ."
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Okɛ oŋa Sara lɛ baafɔ binuu, ni obaawo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Isak. Mahã mi kɛ lɛ kpãŋmɔ ahã eshwiei ni aaaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ.
Yɛ Ishmael hu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mibo bo toi. Naa, majɔɔ lɛ; mahã eshwere ni ewo shwiei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. Eeefɔ lumɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni mahã efee maŋ kpeteŋkple.
Shi mikpãŋmɔ lɛ, Isak mɔ ni Sara kɛ o aaafɔ biɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, lɛ mikɛaakpãŋ."
Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abraham ewie egbe naa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ shi Abraham ni etee ŋwɛi.

Kɛkɛ ni Abraham ŋɔ ebi Ishmael kɛ hii fɛɛ ni afɔ yɛ ewe lɛ kɛ hii fɛɛ ni ekɛ eshika he, nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ eshīa mli bii lɛ eteŋ lɛ, ni eflɔ amɛ fɛɛ ketia yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie lɛ.
Abraham eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu be ni afo lɛ ketia lɛ,
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ afo Abraham kɛ ebi Ishmael fɛɛ ketia.
Abraham we lɛ bii fɛɛ, mɛi ni afɔ yɛ shīa kɛ mɛi ni akɛ shika he yɛ gbɔi adɛŋ fɛɛ, aflɔ amɛ ketia afata ehe.
18: Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Abraham yɛ Mamre tsei lɛ ahe, be ni eta shi yɛ buu lɛ shinaa lɛ na shwane ketekete lɛ.
Abraham yaawo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekwɛ lɛ, naa hii etɛ̃ damɔ emasɛi. Be ni ena amɛ lɛ, esha foi kɛjɛ buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi kɛtee koni eyakpee amɛ. Ekoto amɛ
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mi-Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji ona mihe tsui jurɔ lɛ, miikpa o fai, kaaho otsulɔ he ooya.
Hã ni ayɛ nu fioo kɛba ni nyɛkɛfɔ nyɛnaji ahe, ni nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe yɛ tso lɛ shishi
