koni mayakɔ aboloo atrɔma kome kɛba ni nyɛkɛwo nyɛdaaŋ. No sɛɛ koni nyɛfoŋ kɛya, akɛni nyɛbatsɔ̃ otsulɔ ŋɔɔ nɛɛ." Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Feemɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham yiŋ kɛtee Sara ŋɔɔ oya mli yɛ buu lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, "Feemɔ mramra, tii mã kiloi etɛ̃ koni okpɔtɔ ni okɛshã aboloo."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham sha foi kɛtee tsinai lɛ ateŋ ni eyamɔ tsinabi ni esako ni hi, ni ekɛhã etsulɔ ko, ni tsulɔ lɛ ye ehe oyai ni ekɛfee niyenii.
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham wo butru kɛ fufɔ kɛ tsinabi loo ni akɛfee niyenii lɛ ni ekɛbamamɔ gbɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni edamɔ amɛhiɛ esɔ̃mɔ amɛ yɛ tso lɛ shishi ni amɛye nii lɛ.
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ oŋa Sara yɔɔ?" Ni eto he ekɛɛ akɛ, "Eyɛ buu lɛ mli."
Amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ maku misɛɛ maba oŋɔɔ wɔsɛɛ afi benɛ mli ni be ni maba lɛ oŋa Sara ena binuu." Sara damɔ buu lɛ mli gbɛ yɛ shinaa lɛ shi yɛ Abraham sɛɛgbɛ eebo toi.
Abraham kɛ Sara fɛɛ egblɔ ni amɛye afii pii, ni Sara ekpa tsuiasɛɛ yaa.
No hewɔ lɛ Sara ŋmɔ yɛ eyitsoŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Belɛ migbɔlɛ nɛɛ mli be ni miwu etsɔ̃ nuumo nɛɛ, mɛɛ miishɛɛ wɔɔna yɛ nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ mli."
Yehowa bi Abraham akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ ni Sara ŋmɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Aso lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mi ni mitsɔ yoomo nɛɛ mana bi mafɔ lo?' lɛ.
Ani nɔ ko wa hã Yehowa lo? Be ni mito lɛ maba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ afi naakplɔ benɛ, ni Sara aaana binuu!"
Shi Sara tso ni ekɛɛ, "Miŋmɔko," ejaakɛ eeeshe gbeyei. Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Dabida, oŋmɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni hii etɛ̃ lɛ yi mli kɛjɛ jɛi ni amɛtsɔmɔ amɛhiɛ amɛhã Sodom gbɛ, ni Abraham kɛ amɛ tee eyajie amɛ gbɛ.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ nɔ ni mibafee nɛɛ eteŋ Abraham.
Abraham baatsɔ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa, ni abaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ,
ejaakɛ mile lɛ akɛ eeefã ebii kɛ ewebii ni baa yɛ esɛɛ lɛ koni amɛbo mi toi ni amɛfee nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja koni nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, miwo shi yɛ ehe lɛ aba mli."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛni nibii ni awieɔ ashiɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora lɛ fa, ni amɛhe eshai lɛ efa naakpa hewɔ lɛ,
makpleke shi matee mayakwɛ akɛ nibii fɔɔji ni awieɔ ashiɔ amɛ ni minuɔ lɛ eyɛ mli nakai lo? Ni kɛji ebɛ mli nakai lɛ, koni male."
No hewɔ lɛ hii enyɔ lɛ tsɔ amɛhe ni amɛtee Sodom gbɛ; shi Abraham damɔ shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lolo.
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham tsi ebɛŋkɛ Yehowa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ani oookpãtã jalɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ shi kome lo?
Ekolɛ benɛ jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ aaahi maŋ lɛ mli. Ani kɛji nakai lɛ, oookpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni okɛfaŋ maŋ lɛ yɛ jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ ahewɔ?
Enɛ akagbale o fɔ̃ɔfɔ akɛ oooye nɛkɛ sane, ni ooogbe jalɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ shi kome, ni jalɔ aaana nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ nɔŋŋ lo! Enɛ akagbale o! Ani shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kojolɔ lɛ, ekojoŋ kojomɔ ni ja lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mana jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ Sodom maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, mikɛbaafa maŋ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jalɔi lɛ ahewɔ."
Abraham here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, miŋɔ mifɔ̃ minɔ akɛ mikɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaawie, tsɛbelɛ mi lɛ su kɛ lamlu kɛkɛ ji mi.

Ekolɛ be nɛ, aaahswɛ mɛi enumɔ dani ashɛ jalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ. Ani oookpãtã maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ mɛi enumɔ ni shwɛ dani ashɛ lɛ hewɔ?" Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Kɛji mana mɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ, mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ."
Abraham kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wie ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Eko lɛ aaana jalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ jɛi." Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mifeŋ nɔ ko yɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ ahewɔ."
Abraham wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ mli akawo la akɛ mawie. Eko lɛ aaana gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi." Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mina mɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi lɛ, mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ."
Abraham kɛɛ akɛ, "Miŋɔ mifɔ̃ minɔ akɛ mikɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaawie. Eko lɛ aaana mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ jɛi." Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ ahewɔ."
Abraham kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtsɔ mli akawo la kɛji mawie shi kome nɛɛ pɛ kɛkɛ. Ekolɛ aaana mɛi nyɔŋma yɛ jɛi." Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ ahewɔ."
Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Abraham wie etã lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋ etee ni Abraham ku esɛɛ kɛba shīa.
19: Bɔfoi enyɔ lɛ shɛ Sodom gbɛkɛ mli. Lot ta shi yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Be ni ena bɔfɔi lɛ, ete shi ni ekɛ amɛ yakpe. Ekoto shi ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
Ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔmɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai, nyɛgbaa kɛbaa nyɛtsulɔ we lɛ koni nyɛbafɔa nyɛnaji ahe ni nyɛwɔa gbɛkɛ nɛɛ koni nyɛte shi maŋkɛ mra nyɛya!" Shi amɛkɛɛ, "Dabida, wɔbaawɔ blohu lɛ mli."
Shi Lot hiɛ amɛ aahuu, ni amɛbagbale eŋɔɔ; ni amɛbote ewe lɛ. Efee niyenii ehã amɛ, ni eshã aboloo, ni amɛye.
Shi dani gbɔi lɛ yakamɔ shi lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli hii ni ji Sodom hii lɛ, oblahii kɛ hiimeji fɛɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ eshwɛɛɛ mɔ kome nɛkɛ po, babɔle shīa lɛ kɛkpe.
Amɛtsɛ Lot ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ hii ni ba oŋɔɔ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Jiemɔ amɛ ohã wɔ koni wɔkɛ amɛ awɔ!"
Lot je kpo eba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eŋmɛ shinaa lɛ mli yɛ esɛɛ
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miikpa nyɛ fai, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkafea nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ.
Miyɛ biyei enyɔ ni nako ale nuu; nyɛhãa mikɛ amɛ ajea kpo abahãa nyɛ, ni nyɛfea amɛ nɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; shi nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ lɛ nyɛkafea amɛ nɔ ko, ejaakɛ no hewɔ ni amɛba amɛbaba mi abo lɛ."

Shi maŋbii lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Jee jɛi!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛtee nɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ bato wɔ gbɔ akɛ mɔ kpɔŋ, ni eetao efee ehe kojolɔ! Agbɛnɛ wɔkɛ bo moŋ baaye sane fɔŋ fe ogbɔi lɛ." Amɛbɔle Lot ni amɛtsi amɛba koni amɛbajwa shinaa lɛ.
Shi bɔfoi lɛ kpã amɛnine mli, ni amɛsha Lot kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ shīa lɛ mli, ni amɛŋa shinaa lɛ.
Ni bɔfoi lɛ hā mɛi ni damɔ shinaa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ shwila, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ; amɛtatra shi kɛtao shinaa lɛ naa gbɛ.
Agbɛnɛ bɔfoi lɛ bi Lot akɛ, "Ani oyɛ mɔ ko yɛ sɛɛ yɛ biɛ tamɔ shaanuu ko kɛ bihii kɛ biyei kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛkɛ ni ji onɔ yɛ maŋ nɛɛŋ lo? Okɛ amɛ aje biɛ.
Shi wɔbaakpãtã maŋ nɛɛ hiɛ, ejaakɛ nibii ni awieɔ ashiɔ amɛ lɛ naa wa waa dieŋtsɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni etsu wɔ koni wɔbakpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Lot je kpo ni ekɛ ashaahiimɛi lɛ ni baŋɔ ebiyei lɛ wie akɛ, "Nyɛtea shi, nyɛshīa biɛ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baakpãtã maŋ nɛɛ hiɛ!" Shi Lot shaahiimɛi lɛ ŋɔ Lot wiemɔ lɛ akɛ shwɛmɔ nɔ ko.
Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ tsirɛ Lot yisɛɛ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Tee shi, ŋɔɔ oŋa kɛ obiyei enyɔ ni yɔɔ biɛ lɛ koni akakpãtã ohiɛ afata maŋbii lɛ ahe."
Lot shashao shi, shi Yehowa na lɛ mɔbɔ. No hewɔ lɛ hii lɛ mɔmɔ lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebiyei enyɔ lɛ aniji ashi, ni akɛ amɛ je kpo kɛje maŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni amɛkɛ Lot kɛ ebiyei lɛ eje kpo nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ Lot akɛ, "Joo foi ni ohere oyiwala; kaakwɛ osɛɛ, ni kaawa yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli he ko he ko. Joo foi kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ koni akakpãtã ohiɛ."
Shi Lot kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao mi-Nuŋtsɔmɛi, ekaba lɛ nakai.
Naa, otsulɔ ena hiɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni ona mi mɔbɔ kpeteŋkple akɛ ohere miyiwala. Shi moŋ minyɛŋ foi maje kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ; miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ aaabanina mi ni magbo.
Naa, maŋ nɛɛ bɛŋkɛ bɔ ni aaanyɛ ajo foi kɛaatee jɛi. Edaaa moŋ nɛ, shi miyi aaana wala yɛ jɛi."
Ni bɔfo ni kɛ Lot wieɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mikplɛ̃ nɔ ni obi nɛɛ hu nɔ, ni mikpãtãŋ maŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Ohe afee oya ni ojo foi kɛya jɛi, ejaakɛ mifeŋ nɔ ko akɛ ja obote jɛi dã." Akɛni Lot tsɛ maŋ lɛ maŋ bibioo hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Zoar.
Be ni Lot shɛ Zoar lɛ hulu eje.
Yehowa hã swɔɔ kɛ la nɛ kɛjɛŋwɛi ashwie Sodom kɛ Gomora nɔ,
ni ekpãtã nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ kɛ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ maji lɛ amli bii fɛɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii ni ekwɛ̃kwɛ̃ɛ fɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
Shi Lot ŋa lɛ kwɛ esɛɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ ŋɔɔ kpɔ ema shi.
Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa etee he ni edamɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ lɛ,
ni etsɔ ehiɛ ehã Sodom kɛ Gomora gbɛ kɛ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekwɛ, ni naa, lasu miifã kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ flɔnɔɔŋ lasu.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni eba lɛ nɛ. Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtã maji ni yɔɔ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kai Abraham ni ejie Lot kɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli be ni ekpãtã maji ni Lot hi mli lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
Lot kɛ ebiyei enyɔ lɛ shi Zoar, ni amɛyahi gɔji lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ Lot miishe Zoar hii lɛ gbeyei. Eyahi tɛkplo ko mli, lɛ kɛ ebiyei enyɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Lot biyoo nukpa lɛ kɛɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔtsɛ egbɔ ni nuu ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aaabaŋɔ wɔ ni ekɛ wɔ afɔ.
Ba koni wɔhã wɔtsɛ wain ni enu ni etɔ, koni wɔkɛ lɛ awo shwiei."
Ni amɛhã amɛtsɛ wain enu nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli. Onukpa lɛ yiŋ etee ni ekɛ etsɛ yawɔ, ni Lot leee be ni ebi lɛ bakã shi kɛ be ni ete shi.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ biyoo nukpa lɛ kɛɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, nyɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mikɛ mitsɛ yawɔ; hã ni wɔhã lɛ wain enu gbɛkɛ nɛɛ hu koni bo hu oya okɛ lɛ ayawɔ koni wɔkɛ wɔtsɛ afɔ bii."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛhã amɛtsɛ wain enu nakai gbɛkɛ lɛ hu; ni gbekɛ lɛ hu yiŋ etee, ni ekɛ lɛ yawɔ; ni Lot leee be ni ebi lɛ bakã shi kɛ be ni ete shi.
Bɔ ni fee ni Lot beyei enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛ na musu nɛ.
Kromɔbi lɛ fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Moab; lɛ eshwiei ji Moabbii lɛ.
Ni gbekɛ lɛ hu fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Ben-Ami; eshwiei lɛ ji Amonbii lɛ.
20: Abraham fã yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ kɛtee wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eyahi Kadesh kɛ Shur teŋ, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Gerar.
Abraham kɛɛ yɛ eŋa hewɔ akɛ, "Minyɛmiyoo ji lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek, Gerar maŋtsɛ lɛ, tsu ayaŋɔ Sara abahã lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ba Abimelek ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ yɛ lamɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, obaagbo yɛ yoo lɛ ni oyaŋɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko ŋa ni."
Shi Abimelek nako ata Sara he, no hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ani ooobutu maŋ ko ni efeko efɔŋ ko lo?

Ani jeee Abraham diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Minyɛmi yoo ji lɛ' lɛ? Ni yoo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛɛ akɛ, 'Minyɛmi nuu ji lɛ' lɛ? Mihe nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ mi lɛ miye, ni nɔ ni mifee nɛɛ lɛ, mijɛ tsui ni tse mli mikɛ fee, ni midɛŋ hu diii.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abimelek yɛ lamɔ lɛ mli akɛ, "Hɛɛ, mi hu mile akɛ onɔkwale fɛɛ okɛfee enɛ. Asaŋ, mi ni mitsi onaa koni okafee esha oshi mi, no hewɔ ni mihãaa o hegbɛ akɛ ota ehe lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛ nuu lɛ ŋa lɛ aku sɛɛ oyahã lɛ ejaakɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ, ni eeesɔle ekpa fai ehã o, ni oyi aaana wala. Shi kɛji okɛ lɛ hãaa lɛ lɛ, no lɛ na ole akɛ gbo ooogbo, bo kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ji onɔ lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Abimelek te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni etsɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ, ni ebɔ amɛ nɔ ni ba lɛ fɛɛ; ni hii lɛ she gbeyei naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek tsɛ Abraham ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ? Mɛni esha mifee o hewɔ ni otsi mi kɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ owo esha kpeteŋkple tamɔ nɛkɛ mli nɛɛ? Nɔ ni afeee ofee mi nɛɛ."
Asaŋ Abimelek bi Abraham akɛ, "Mɛni osusu hewɔ ofee enɛ?"
Abraham to he akɛ, "Miyasusu akɛ ekolɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni amɛbaaagbe mi yɛ miŋa lɛ hewɔ.
Ni asaŋ eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ minyɛmiyoo ni, ejaakɛ mitsɛbi ni, shi jeee minyɛbi ni, ni etsɔ miŋa.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mije mitsɛ we lɛ ni miyatsomlo lɛ, mikɛɛ miŋa lɛ akɛ, 'Enɛ ji ejurɔ ni mitaoɔ ni ofee mi: He fɛɛ he ni wɔɔshɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ yɛ mihe akɛ minyɛminuu ni.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek ŋɔ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ wehii kɛ weyei eyahã Abraham, ni ekɛ eŋa Sara lɛ ku sɛɛ ehã lɛ.
Abimelek kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, "Mishikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ; hii he ni osumɔɔ."
Ni Sara lɛ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, mihã onyɛminuu lɛ shika jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe ni yeɔ odase yɛ mɛi ni kɛ o yɔɔ lɛ ahiɛ akɛ muji ko bɛ ohe."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsa Abimelek kɛ eŋa kɛ eweyei lɛ, ni amɛfɔfɔɔ bii,
ejaakɛ kulɛ Yehowa eŋa yei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Abimelek we lɛ amusu naa yɛ Abraham ŋa Sara sane lɛ hewɔ.
21: Yehowa badro Sara tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ ni Yehowa fee nɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ ehã lɛ.
Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ to hã Sara lɛ shɛ, ni Sara na musu ni ekɛ Abraham fɔ binuu yɛ egbɔlɛ mli.
Abraham wo ebi ni ekɛ Sara fɔ lɛ gbɛi akɛ Isak.
Ni Abraham fo ebi Isak ketia be ni gbekɛ lɛ ena gbii kpaanyɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Abraham eye afii oha be ni efɔ ebi Isak lɛ.
Ni Sara kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ewo minaaŋmlɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ aaaŋmɔ eko."
Asaŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Kulɛ namɔ aaagba Abraham akɛ Sara aaahã ebii afufɔ? Shi mi kɛ lɛ efɔ bi yɛ egbɔlɛ mli."
Gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni atse lɛ fufɔ; ni Abraham ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple gbi nɔ ni atse lɛ fufɔ lɛ.
Shi Sara na Ishmael, Hagar Egiptyoo lɛ binuu lɛ ni ekɛ Abraham fɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ Sara bi Isak miishwɛ.
Ni Sara kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, "Shwiemɔ tsulɔyoo nɛɛ kɛ ebi lɛ ni amɛya koni tsulɔyoo nɛɛ binuu lɛ kɛ mibi Isak akaja agboshinii lɛ.
Wiemɔ nɛɛ eŋɔɔɔ Abraham naa kwraa yɛ ebi Ishmael hewɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, 'Kaahã oblanyo lɛ kɛ otsulɔyoo lɛ sane lɛ miidɔ bo. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Sara aaakɛɛ o lɛ, bo egbee toi ni ofee ejaakɛ Isak gbɛi mli aaatsɛ oshwiei agbɛi yɛ.
Tsulɔyoo lɛ binuu lɛ hu, mahã etsɔ̃ maŋ kple ejaakɛ oshwie ji lɛ.'"
Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa. Ekɔ aboloo ni ewo nu kɛ tɔ ekɛtswa Hagar kɔŋ. Ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ hu hã Hagar, kɛkɛ ni ewo lɛ gbɛ. Hagar yi mli ni eyatsomlo yɛ Beersheba ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni nu lɛ tã yɛ wolo tɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Hagar ŋmɛɛ gbekɛ lɛ he efɔ̃ koowie ko mli.
Ni etee eyata sɛɛ flɛŋŋ aaafee tɛfɔ̃ɔ jekɛmɔ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Minyɛŋ makwɛ gbekɛ lɛ gbele." Eho eta shi yɛ gbekɛ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ ni gbekɛ lɛ jwa yaafo.
Nyɔŋmɔ nu oblanyo lɛ gbee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Hagar, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni gbaa onaa Hagar? Kaashe gbeyei, shi Nyɔŋmɔ enu gbekɛ lɛ gbee yɛ he ni gbekɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Tee shi ni owo gbekɛ lɛ nɔ, hiɛmɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ejaakɛ shi mahã etsɔ maŋ kpeteŋkple."
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gble Hagar hiŋmɛii, ni ena nubu ko. Eyiŋ etee, ni eyayɛ nu ewo wolo tɔ lɛ mli obɔ̃, ni ehã gbekɛnuu lɛ eko enu.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɛkɛnuu lɛ yɛ ni eda. Ehi shi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ gãitsɛ̃lɔ ni he esa naakpa.
Ehi shi yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni enyɛ yaŋɔ yoo kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ebahã lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Abimelek kɛ etatsɛ Fikol bakɛɛ Abraham akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ o yɛ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ofeɔ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akã mi kitã yɛ biɛ nɛɛ akɛ oyeŋ mi loo mibii loo mihɔi kutumpɔo; shi bɔ ni miyeɔ o anɔkwa lɛ, nakai obaafee mi kɛ shikpɔŋ ni obato gbɔ yɛ nɔ nɛɛ."
Ni Abraham kɛɛ akɛ, "Makã kitã lɛ".
Shi Abraham kɛ Abimelek wie kɛ dɔlɛ yɛ nubu ko ni Abimelek tsuji lɛ eshɔ̃ ekãa naa yɛ edɛ lɛ he.
Ni Abimelek kɛɛ akɛ, "Mileee mɔ ni ye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, ni bo hu otsiii tã okɛɛɛ mi lɛ, asaŋ minuko da hu, akɛ ja ŋmɛnɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ toi kɛ tsinai hã Abimelek ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãŋ.
Abraham jie toi lɛ amli gwaŋtɛŋ biyei kpawo eto afã.
Abimelek bi Abraham akɛ, "Nɛkɛ gwaŋteŋ biyei kpawo ni ojie oto afã nɛɛ, te eshishiŋ?"
Ni Abraham kɛɛ, "Gwaŋteŋ biyei kpawo nɛɛ, ŋɔɔ yɛ midɛŋ koni okɛye odase ohã mi akɛ mi mije nɛkɛ nubu nɛɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Abraham tsɛ jɛi Beersheba, ejaakɛ jɛi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkãmɔ kitã yɛ.
Amɛkpãŋ yɛ Beersheba. Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛ etatsɛ Fikol te shi, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Abraham tɛo tso ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ tamarisketso lɛ yɛ Beersheba, ni eja Yehowa, Naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi.
Abraham to gbɔ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ be kplaŋŋ.
22: Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ eba mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ka Abraham ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Abraham!" Ni Abraham kɛɛ, "Naa mi!"
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ obi Isak ni ji obi koome ni odɔɔ ehe lɛ, ni oyiŋ oya Moria Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛ lɛ ayashã afɔle yɛ jɛi, yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome ni matsɔ̃ɔ o lɛ nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Abraham te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ewo eteji nɔ nii, ni eŋɔ eblahii lɛ enyɔ kɛ ebi Isak lɛ efata ehe. Egba lai ni ekɛyaashã shãa afɔle lɛ; ni eyiŋ eeya he ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ.
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Abraham wo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ena jɛi yɛ shɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛɛ eblahii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ kɛ teji lɛ ahīa biɛ; mi kɛ oblanyo lɛ miiya he ni jeɔ lɛ wɔyaja Nyɔŋmɔ ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kɛ afɔleshãa lai lɛ tre ebi Isak, ni eŋɔ la lɛ kɛ kakla lɛ ehiɛ edɛ; ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ amɛyi mli amɛtee.
Be ni amɛyaa lɛ, Isak kɛ etsɛ Abraham wie, ni ekɛɛ, "Ataa!" Etsɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Naa mi, mibi!" Ni Isak kɛɛ, "Naa, la kɛ lai nɛ, shi nɛgbɛ too gwaŋteŋ bi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ yɔɔ?"
Abraham to he akɛ, "Mibi, Nyɔŋmɔ dieŋtsɛ aaahã too gwaŋtɛŋ ni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛtee.
Be ni amɛshɛ he ni Nyɔŋmɔ estɔ̃ɔ lɛ, Abraham ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi. Eto lai lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni efi ebi Isak lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham kpã enine mli ekɔ kakla lɛ koni ekɛgbe ebi lɛ.
Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Abraham ekɛɛ, "Abraham, Abraham!" Abraham here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Naa mi!"
Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaahã onine miisa oblanyo lɛ he, ni asaŋ kaafee lɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko! Shi mina mile agbɛnɛ akɛ osheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, akɛni okamaaa lɛ obi koome nɛɛ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham wo ehiɛ nɔ; eyaakwɛ ehe lɛ, naa ojwɛni ko yɛ esɛɛgbɛ ni eklontoi elalaa koo. Abraham tee eyamɔ ojwɛni lɛ, ni eŋɔ lɛ eshã shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ ebi lɛ najiaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ Abraham wo jɛi gbɛi akɛ "Yehowa aaakwɛ." No hewɔ akɛɔ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ akɛ, "Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaakwɛ yɛ lɛ."
Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi etsɛ Abraham nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ,
ni ekɛɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ, akɛni ofee enɛ ni okamaaa mi obi lɛ ni ji obi kometoo lɛ,
hewɔ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ majɔɔ o, ni mahã oshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii kɛ ŋshɔnaa shia. Oshwiei lɛ aaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ kunim.
Ni oshwiei lɛ amli aaajɛ ajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ, ejaakɛ obo mi toi."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham ku esɛɛ kɛba eblahii lɛ aŋɔɔ. Amɛte shi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛŋɔshwie nɔ kɛba Beersheba. Abraham hi shi yɛ Beersheba.
Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ abakɛɛ Abraham akɛ, "Naa, Milka hu kɛ onyɛmi nuu Nahor efɔ bii."
Kromɔbi lɛ ji Uz kɛ enyɛmi Buz kɛ Kemuel ni ji Aram tsɛ lɛ;
kɛ Kesed kɛ Hazo kɛ Pildash kɛ Yidlaf kɛ Betuel.
Betuel fɔ Rebeka. Mɛi kpaanyɔ nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Milka kɛ Abraham nyɛmi Nahor fɔ.
Nahor hemɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Reuma lɛ hu kɛ Nahor fɔ Teba kɛ Gaham kɛ Tahash kɛ Maaka.
23: Afii abɔ ni Sara ye yɛ jeŋ ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo.
Sara gbo yɛ Kiriat-Arba, ni ji Hebrom ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Abraham ye Sara he ŋkɔmɔ ni efo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham te shi yɛ egbonyo lɛ he, ni ekɛ Hitbii lɛ yawie akɛ,
"Mɔ kpɔŋ ji mi, ni mibato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Nyɛhãa mi he ko mahe koni mikɛfee fuuhe ni mato miŋa gbonyo ni kã mihiɛ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi."
Hitbii lɛ here lɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ,
"Nuŋtsɔ, bo wɔ toi; wɔbuɔ bo akɛ lumɔ kple yɛ wɔteŋ. Wɔfuuhei lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, fuu ogbonyo lɛ yɛ mli; wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ o gbɛ akɛ okafu ogbonyo lɛ yɛ fuuhe lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham te shi, ni ekoto shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni ji Hitbii lɛ,
ni ekɛ amɛ wie ekɛɛ; "Kɛji nyɛyɛ he tsui akɛ mifu migbonyo ni kã mihiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛkpaa Zohar bi Efron lɛ fai nyɛhãa mi,
koni ekɛ etɛkplo ni ji Makpela tɛkplo lɛ ni yɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee he lɛ ahã mi. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ji tɛkplo lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ ehã mi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni mahe mikɛfee mufuuhe lɛ."
Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, ta Hitbii lɛ ateŋ, ni ehere Abraham nɔ bɔ ni Hitbii lɛ fɛɛ nu yɛ amɛtoiŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni boteɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ hiɛ akɛ,
"Dabida, minuŋtsɔ, bo mi toi! Shikpɔŋ lɛ mikɛmiihã o, ni tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ hu mikɛmihãa o, mimaŋbii lɛ ahiɛ mikɛhãa o yɛ nɛɛ, fuu oŋa lɛ gbonyo lɛ yɛ jɛi."
Kɛkɛ ni Abraham ho koto shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛɛ Efron yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ atoiŋ,
akɛ, "Miikpa o fai, bo mi toi. Masumɔ matse shika mikɛhe shikpɔŋ lɛ; hemɔ shika lɛ yɛ midɛŋ koni mafu migbonyo lɛ yɛ jɛi."
Efron here Abraham nɔ akɛ,
"Minuŋtsɔ, bo mi toi. Shikpɔŋ ni naa ji jwiɛtɛi shekel ohai ejwɛ lɛ, mɛni ji no yɛ mi kɛ o teŋ? No hewɔ lɛ fuu ogbonyo lɛ."
Abraham kplɛ̃ nɔ ehã Efron, ni eŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi ni Efron tsī tã yɛ Hitbii lɛ atoiŋ lɛ ehã lɛ, efee jwiɛtɛi shekel ohai ejwɛ yɛ jrayelɔi asɛnii tɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni atu Efron shikpɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Makpela, yɛ Mamre bokagbɛ lɛ, awo Abraham dɛŋ. Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ kɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ kɛ tsei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ehusui lɛ anɔ lɛ,
tsɔ̃ Abraham nɔ yɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ hu ni tee maŋ koi lɛ shi lɛ ahiɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abraham fu eŋa Sara yɛ nakai tɛkplo lɛ ni yɔɔ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ mli, yɛ Mamre bokagbɛ (no ji Hebron) yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Hitbii lɛ tu abɔɔ nɛɛ kɛ emli tɛkplo lɛ amɛwo Abraham dɛŋ, ni atsɔ̃ egbonyofuuhe.
24: Abraham egbɔ, ni eye afii pii; ni Yehowa ejɔɔ Abraham yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli.
Abraham kɛɛ etsulɔ ni ji ewe lɛ mli onukpa ni lɛ ekwɛɔ nii fɛɛ ni Abraham yɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ba ni okɛ onine abahɔ mishuɔ shishi
koni mahã okã Yehowa, ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitã akɛ oŋɔŋ Kanaanbii ni miyɔɔ amɛteŋ nɛɛ abiyei lɛ eko akɛ ŋa ohaŋ mibi Isak;
shi moŋ oootee mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ miweku lɛ mli ni oyaŋɔ yoo obahã lɛ."
Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ Abraham akɛ, "Eko lɛ, yoo lɛ ebakplɛŋ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Kɛ eba lɛ nakai lɛ, ani mikɛ obi lɛ aku sɛɛ aya shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni ojɛ kɛba lɛ lo?"
Abraham kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okɛ mibi lɛ akaku sɛɛ kɛmiiya jɛi.

Yehowa, ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ mi kɛjɛ mitsɛ we lɛ kɛ mikwekumɛi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ mi wie ni ekã mi kitã akɛ, 'Oshwiei maŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ mahã lɛ,' lɛ eeetsu ebɔfo kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ ni oyaŋɔ yoo kɛjɛ jɛi obahã mibi lɛ.
Kɛji yoo lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ eeenyiɛ osɛɛ kɛba lɛ, no lɛ, ohe eje mikitã nɛɛ mli; mibi lɛ kɛkɛ ni okɛ lɛ akaku sɛɛ kɛmiiya jɛi."
Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛ enine hɔ enuŋtsɔ Abraham shuɔ shishi ni ekã lɛ kita yɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ enuŋtsɔ yomai lɛ ateŋ nyɔŋma, ni eŋɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ nikeenii kpakpai srɔtoi ehiɛ edɛ̃, ni eyiŋ kɛtee maŋ he ni Nahor hi yɛ Mesopotamia kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Tsulɔ lɛ hã yomai lɛ bumɔ shi yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ, yɛ nubu ko he, gbɛkɛnaashi be mli ni yei jeɔ kpo baa nuyɛɛ lɛ.
Esɔle ekɛɛ "Ao, Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ! Miipka o fai ni ohã mihe aba nii ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni ojie osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ minuŋtsɔ Abraham.
Naa, midamɔ nubu nɛɛ he, ni maŋ lɛ mli bii abiyei miije kpo miiba nuyɛɛ.

Hã aba mli akɛ oblayoo mɔ ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Miikpa o fai, too ogbɛ lɛ kɛba shi ni manu nu lɛ eko,' ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, 'Nuu, ni mahã oyomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu' lɛ, lɛ efee mɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ojie ohã otsulɔ Isak. Enɛ mikɛaale akɛ ojie osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ minuŋtsɔ."
Enaa naaa anyɔ shi kɛkɛ lɛ naa Rebeka, Betuel biyoo lɛ, ni eje kpo eeba ni egbɛ tswa ekɔŋ. Betuel nɛɛ, Abraham nyɛmi Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka bi ji lɛ.
Oblayoo nɛɛ ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa; oblayoo fro ni, ni nuu ko etako ehe dã. Ekpleke shi kɛtee bu lɛ mli ni eyawo egbɛ lɛ obɔ̃, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo kɛba.
Abraham tsulɔ lɛ sha foi ekɛ lɛ yakpe ni ekɛɛ, "Miikpa o fai ni ohã manu ogbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ fioo."
Oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ, "Nuu, minuŋtsɔ." Kɛkɛ ni ehe fee oya ni eto gbɛ lɛ ehiɛ edɛ̃ ni ehã lɛ nu enu.
Be ni tsulɔ lɛ enu egbe naa lɛ, oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ, "Mayɛ eko mahã oyomai lɛ hu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaanu amɛtã."
Ehe fee oya ni etsɔ̃ egbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ ewo nunumɔ nɔ lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni esha foi etee bu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ eyayɛ nu lɛ ni eyɛ ehã yomai lɛ fɛɛ.
Tsulɔ lɛ fee diŋŋ ni ekwɛ oblayoo lɛ too koni ekɛle akɛ Yehowa ehã egbɛfãa lɛ efee omanye lo.
Be ni yomai lɛ enu nu lɛ egbe naa lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi ga ni jra wa ekɛwo oblayoo lɛ gugɔŋ, ni eŋɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi nineshi gai agboi enyɔ hu ekɛwo oblayoo lɛ niji.
Kɛkɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ biyoo ji o? Kɛɛmɔ mi koo! Ana wɔɔna gbɛ yɛ otsɛ we lɛ koni wɔyato jɛi?"
Oblayoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, "Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka bi Betuel lɛ biyoo ji mi."
Asaŋ oblayoo lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔyɛ jwɛi kɛ kooloi aniyenii pii, ni gbɛ hu yɛ bɔ ni aaanyɛ ato jɛi?
Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ma eyi shi, ni eja Yehowa ni ekɛɛ,
"Aaajie Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi akɛ ehãko esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enɔkwayeli lɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ minuŋtsɔ nɔ; ni mi hu Yehowa ebatsɔ̃ɔ mi minuŋtsɔ wekumɛi awe gbɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni oblayoo lɛ sha foi kɛtee eyagba mɛi ni yɔɔ enyɛ we lɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ.
Rebeka yɛ nyɛmi nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Laban; Laban nɛɛ sha foi kɛje kpo ni etee nuu lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ nubu lɛ hɛ.
Be ni Laban na ga lɛ kɛ nineshi gai lɛ yɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ niji, ni asaŋ enu wiemɔi ni Rebeka kɛɛ nuu lɛ kɛ wie lɛ, eba nuu lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ he ni edamɔ yɛ yomai lɛ amasɛi yɛ bu lɛ he lɛ,
ni Laban kɛɛ nu lɛ akɛ, "Ba shīa, bo mɔ ni Yehowa ejɔɔ o! Mɛɛ hewɔ odamɔ ŋmaŋmasha? Shi misaa shīa lɛ mihã o, kɛ gbɛ hu mihã yomai lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ nuu lɛ ba shīa lɛ, ni Laban jie yomai lɛ anɔ nii lɛ. Ehã nuu lɛ jwɛi kɛ niyenii ni akɛhã yomai lɛ. Asaŋ ehã tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ nu ni amɛkɛfɔ amɛnaji ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni akɛ ninenii bama tsulɔ lɛ hiɛ koni eye. Shi tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Miyeŋ nii ja mibɔ mimaniɛ ni mihiɛ kɛba lɛ dã." Ni Laban kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wiem ɔ!"
No hewɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Abraham tsulɔ ji mi.
Yehowa ejɔɔ minuŋtsɔ naakpa, ni etsɔ̃ niiatsɛ wulu. Yehowa ehã lɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ webii kɛ weyei kɛ yomai kɛ tejii.
Minuŋtsɔ ŋa Sara kɛ minuŋtsɔ fɔ binuu be ni Sara egbɔ sɛɛ, ni minuŋtsɔ Abraham eŋɔ enii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ ehã ebinuu nɛɛ.
Minuŋtsɔ hã mikã kitã akɛ, 'Kaaŋɔ Kanaanbii, mɛi ashikpɔŋ nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ abiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko akɛ ŋa ohã mibinuu lɛ;
shi moŋ yaa mitsɛ we lɛ kɛ wekumɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ koni oyaŋɔ ŋa obahã mibinuu lɛ.'
Ni mikɛɛ minuŋtsɔ akɛ, 'Eko lɛ yoo lɛ ebanyiɛŋ misɛɛ kɛbaŋ.
Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Yehowa, mɔ toi ni miboɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ, aaatsu ebɔfo afata ohe, ni eeehã oye omanye, ni obaaya oyaŋɔ ŋa yɛ mijaku kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ obahã mibinuu lɛ.
Ja nakai dani ohe aaaje mikitã nɛɛ mli. Kɛji otee mijakubii aŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ yoo lɛ hãaa bo lɛ, no lɛ ohe eje mikitã lɛ mli.'
"Be ni mibashɛ nubu lɛ he ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, misɔle mikɛɛ, 'Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛji ooohã migbɛ ni minyiɛ nɛɛ afee omanye lɛ,
no lɛ naa miidamɔ nubu nɛɛ he, ni hã aba mli akɛ oblayoo ni aaaje kpo aba nuyɛɛ ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ miikpa o fai ni ohã mi ogbɛ lɛ mli nu lɛ fioo manu,
ni eeekɛɛ mi akɛ, nuu, ni masaa mayɛ eko mahã oyomai lɛ hu lɛ, hã lɛ efee yoo krɛdɛɛ ni Yehowa ejie ehã minuŋtsɔ bi lɛ.'
Be ni mikɛɛ miwieɔ migbeɔ naa yɛ miyitsoŋ pɛ lɛ, naa, Rebeka epue ni egbɛ tswa ekɔŋ kɛmiiba. Ekpleke shi kɛtee bu lɛ mli eyayɛ nu. Mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ ni ohã mi nu lɛ fioo.'
"Ehe fee oya, ni eto egbɛ lɛ ehiɛ edɛ ni ekɛɛ, 'Nuu ni mahã oyomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu!' No hewɔ lɛ minu, ni ehã yomai lɛ hu eko amɛnu.
Kɛkɛ ni mibi lɛ akɛ, 'Namɔ bi ji o?' Ni ekɛɛ, 'Nahor kɛ eŋa Milka binuu Betuel lɛ bi ji mi." No hewɔ lɛ mikɛ ga lɛ wo egugɔŋ, ni mikɛ nineshi gai lɛ wo eniji.
Kɛkɛ ni mima miyi shi, ni mija Yehowa, ni mijie Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ jurɔ koni mikɛbaŋɔ minuŋtsɔ wekunyo biyoo mahã ebinuu lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ kɛji nyɛkɛ minuŋtsɔ aaaye ye mlihilɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli naa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkɛa mi; ni kɛjeee nakai hu, nyɛkɛa mi, koni male bɔ ni mafee."
Kɛkɛ ni Laban kɛ Betuel here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ŋɔɔ sane nɛɛ jɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, wɔbɛ nɔ ko ni wɔbaakɛɛ.
Naa, Rebeka lɛ nɛ, ŋɔɔ lɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya ni eyatsɔ onuŋtsɔ binuu lɛ ŋa, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ."
Be ni Abraham tsulɔ lɛ nu amɛnaa wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, eho ebu shi ni eja Yehowa.
Agbɛnɛ tsulɔ lɛ jie jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii kɛ mamai kɛba, ni ekɛhã Rebeka. Asaŋ ehã Rebeka nyɛminuu lɛ kɛ enyɛ hu nibii ni jra wa.
Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ ye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Amɛwɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ. Be ni amɛte shi leebi lɛ, Abraham tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwoa mi gbɛ koni maya minuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ."
Shi Rebeka nyɛminuu lɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Hã oblayoo lɛ kɛ wɔ ahi shi gbii fioo, akɛ gbii nyɔŋma nɛkɛ, koni no sɛɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya."
Shi tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Nyɛkatsia minaa, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã migbɛfãa lɛ eye omanye; nyɛwoa mi gbɛ ni maya minuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ!"
Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔbaatsɛ oblayoo lɛ koni wɔbi edaaŋ gbee."
Amɛtsɛ lɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ nuu nɛɛ aaatee lo?" Ni Rebeka kɛɛ akɛ, "Matee."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo amɛnyɛmiyoo Rebeka kɛ tsulɔyoo nukpa kɛ Abraham tsulɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe kɛba lɛ gbɛ.
Amɛjɔɔ Rebeka amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔnyɛmiyoo, tsɔ mɛi akpei huhaa anyɛ, ni oshwiei aye amɛhenyɛlɔi amaji anɔ kunim."
Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka kɛ eblayei lɛ te shi, ni amɛho amɛtra yomai lɛ anɔ koni amɛya; kɛkɛ ni Abraham tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ Rebeka, ni amɛŋɔ shwie nɔ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Isak ejɛ nubu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ, "Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni enaa nii lɛ nubu" lɛ kpokpai anɔ eba. Nubu nɛɛ yɛ Kanaan wuoyigbɛ.
Gbɛkɛnaashi mli lɛ, Isak je kpo etee ŋa lɛ nɔ eyaashwie eyiŋ. Be ni ewo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, naa yomai miiba.
Rebeka hu wo ehiɛ nɔ, ni be ni ena Isak lɛ, eje yoma lɛ nɔ eyi shi.
Ebi Abraham tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ni nyiɛ ŋa lɛ mli kɛbaa ni ekɛ wɔ abakpe nɛɛ, namɔ ni?" Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ lɛ ni." Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka kɔ ehiɛhaa nɔ lɛ ni ekɛha ehiɛ.
Tsulɔ lɛ gba Isak nii fɛɛ ni eyatsu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Isak kɛ Rebeka ba buu ni enyɛ Sara hi mli lɛ mli. Isakŋɔ Rebɛka ni ebatsɔ eŋa ni esumɔ lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ Rebeka shɛje Isak mii yɛ enyɛ gbele lɛ sɛɛ.
25: Abraham ŋɔ yoo kroko. Yoo lɛ gbɛi ji Ketura.
Abraham kɛ Ketura fɔ Zimran kɛ Yokshan kɛ Medan kɛ Midian kɛ Ishbak kɛ Shua.
Yukshan fɔ Sheba kɛ Dedan. Dedan bii ji Ashurbii kɛ Letushbii kɛ Leumbii;
Midian bii ji Efa kɛ Efer kɛ Hanok kɛ Abida kɛ Eldaa. Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Ketura shwiei ni.
Abraham kɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ hã Isak.
Shi ehemɛi lɛ abii lɛ, Abraham hã amɛ nikeenii be mli ni ehiɛ kã beebe, ni ewo amɛ gbɛ kɛje ebi Isak he kɛtee bokagbɛ yɛ bokagbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Afii abɔ ni Abraham ye dani egbo ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ.
Ni Abraham gbo yɛ gbɔlɛ kpakpa mli, nuumo ni, ni egbɔ kotokoto.
Isak kɛ Ishmael ni ji ebii lɛ fu lɛ yɛ Makpela tɛkplo lɛ mli. Tɛkplo nɛɛ yɛ Efron, ni ji Zohar Hitnyo lɛ bi lɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Mamre bokagbɛ lɛ mli.
Abraham he nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ Hitbii lɛ adɛŋ. Jɛi afu Abraham kɛ eŋa Sara fɛɛ yɛ.
Abraham gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ebinuu Isak. Ehi shi yɛ "Mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni naa mi" lɛ nubu lɛ he.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Abraham bi Ishmael ni Egiptyoo Hagar ni ji Sara weyoo lɛ kɛ Abraham fɔ lɛ shwiei.
Yɛ fɔmɔ naa lɛ Ishmael bihii lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Nebaiot, lɛji kromɔ, kɛ Kedar kɛ Abdeel kɛ Mibsam
kɛ Mishma kɛ Duma kɛ Masa,
kɛ Hadad kɛ Tema kɛ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Kedema.
Ishmael bihii lɛ, amɛji akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ablematsɛmɛi, ni akɛ amɛgbɛii wo amɛkrowai kɛ amɛshitoohei lɛ.
Afii abɔ ni Ishmael ye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo. Egbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ ewekumɛi ateŋ.
Ishmael shwiei nɛɛ he shi kɛjɛ Havila kɛyashi Shur. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Egipt ŋlɛnɔ kɛyaa Asiria gbɛ. Amɛtse amɛhe kɛje Abraham shwiei krokomɛi lɛ ahe.
Abraham bi Isak shwiei nɛ: Abraham fɔ Isak.
Isak eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni eŋɔ Rebeka ni ji Betuel Aramnyo ni jɛ Mesopotamia lɛ biyoo lɛ. Laban, Aramnyo lɛ nyɛmiyoo ni.
Isak kpa Yehowa fai ehã eŋa lɛ ejaakɛ efee kene. Yehowa bo efaikpamɔ lɛ toi ni eŋa Rebeka na musu.
Bii lɛ shimɔshimɔɔ amɛhe yɛ musu lɛ mli. Ni Rebeka kɛɛ, "Mɛɛba sa akɛ nɛkɛ nɔ ko afee mi?" No hewɔ lɛ etee eyabi Yehowa.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Jeŋmaji enyɔ yɛ omusuŋ, ni maŋ kome he aaawa fe ekome, ni onukpa lɛ aaasɔmɔ gbekɛ lɛ."
Be ni Rebeka fɔmɔ be shɛ lɛ, efɔ hãaji.
Mɔ ni ba klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ etsuɔ fɔɔ kɛ ehe tsɔi sulaŋŋ tamɔ ofo; awo lɛ Esau.
No sɛɛ lɛ enyɛmi lɛ hu ba ni enine hiɛ Esau nanetsitsi mli, ni awo lɛ Yakob. Be ni afɔ amɛ lɛ, Isak eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Gbekɛbii lɛ badra. Esau le gbɔbimɔ jogbaŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ efɔɔ ŋa mli yaa; shi Yakob lɛ gbɔmɔ kpoo ni, ni ehiɔ shīa.
Isak sumɔɔ Esau ejaakɛ milɛloo ŋɔɔ enaa shi Rebeka sumɔɔ Yakob.
Gbi ko lɛ Yakob miihoo nii, ni Esau jɛ ŋa lɛ mli eba ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ.
Esau kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Miikpa o fai, hã mi nɛkɛ niyenii tsuru nɛɛ eko maye, shi hɔmɔ miiye mi." No hewɔ lɛ awo Esau gbɛi akɛ Edom.
Shi Yakob kɛɛ Esau akɛ, "Hɔɔmɔ okromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ohã mi dã!"
Ni Esau kɛɛ akɛ, "Miigbo kɛ hɔmɔ, ni mɛni kromɔbi gbɛnaa nɛɛ baafee ehã mi?"
Yakob kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kã mi kitã yɛ nɔ dã!" Hewɔ lɛ Esau kã lɛ kitã ni ehɔ̃ɔ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ehã Yakob.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob hã Esau aboloo kɛ abɔbɔi ni ehoo lɛ eko. Esau ye, ni enu nɔ ko eshwie nɔ; kɛkɛ ni ete shi, ni eyiŋ etee. Bɔ ni fee ni Esau ŋmɛɛ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa ni ebuuu lɛ nɛ.
26: Hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; sro klɛŋklɛŋ hɔmɔ ni ba yɛ Abraham yinɔ lɛ. Isak yiŋ etee Filistibii amaŋtsɛ Abimelek ŋɔɔ yɛ Gerar.
Shi Yehowa jie eke kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Isak ni ekɛɛ: "Kaaya Egipt; shi hii shi ye shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ o lɛ nɔ;
too gbɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ; ni mikɛ o aaahi shi, ni majɔɔ o, ejaakɛ bo kɛ oshwiei mikɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ baahã,

ni maye kitã ni makã otsɛ Abraham lɛ nɔ. Mibahã oshwiei afa tamɔ bɔ ni mikã otsɛ Abraham kitã lɛ. Mibahã oshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii, ni mibaŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔji nɛɛ fɛɛ mahã oshwiei lɛ. Oshwiei lɛ mli aaajɛ ajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jeŋ maji lɛ fɛɛ,
ejaakɛ Abraham bo migbee toi, ni eye mimlai kɛ mikitãi lɛ anɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Isak hi shi yɛ Gerar.

Ni be ni jɛibii lɛ bi eŋa lɛ he sane lɛ, eto he akɛ, "Minyɛmi yoo ni." Ejaakɛ eeshe gbeyei ni ekɛɛɛ akɛ: "Miŋa ni." Ni ekɛɛ hu yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, "Bɔ ni afee ni jɛibii lɛ akabagbe mi yɛ Rebeka hewɔ; ejaakɛ Rebeka he yɛ fɛo."
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Isak ehi jɛi be kplaŋŋ lɛ, Filistibii amaŋtsɛ Abimelek bu samflɛ naa, ni ena ni Isak kɛ eŋa Rebeka miishwɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek tsɛ Isak ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Eei, asomoaŋ, yoo lɛ oŋa ni! Te fee tɛŋŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Minyɛmi yoo ji lɛ lɛ?' " Ni Isak kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni afee ni akagbe mi yɛ ehewɔ, no hã mikɛɛ nakai lɛ."
Ni Abimelek kɛɛ, "Mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ? Shwɛ fioo ni maŋbii lɛ eko kɛ oŋa lɛ ana bɔlɛ. Eba lɛ nakai kulɛ ohã sɔ̃ etre wɔ."
Ni Abimelek wo maŋ lɛ fɛɛ kitã akɛ, "Mɔ ni aaata nuu nɛɛ loo eŋa lɛ he lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!"
Ni Isak fee ŋmɔ, ni edu nii yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ena nakai bɔ toi oha yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa jɔɔ lɛ.
Ni Isak tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu, Ni eshwere aahuu kɛyashi etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ agbo kpanaa.
Ena too kui kɛ tsina kui kɛ webii pii. Ni Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ kɔ̃ enɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nubui fɛɛ ni Isak tsɛ Abraham tsuji lɛ je yɛ lɛ Abraham lɛ yinɔ lɛ, Filistibii lɛ tsimɔ fɛɛ ni amɛloo su amɛwo amɛmli obɔ̃ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛɛ Isak akɛ, "Jee wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni oya. Ejaakɛ ohe ewa fe wɔ!"
No hewɔ lɛ Isak je jɛi ni eyashi ebuu yɛ Gerar jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ehi jɛi.
Ni Isak saa eje nubui lɛ ni aje yɛ etsɛ Abraham yinɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ Abraham gbele sɛɛ lɛ Filistibii lɛ tsimɔ; ni eŋɔ gbɛii ni etsɛ Abraham ŋɔ wo amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ ewo amɛ ekoŋŋ.
Ni Isak bihii lɛ tsa nubu yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli ni amɛna nu yɛ jɛi.
Ni Gerar koolookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ Isak koolookwɛlɔi lɛ be ni amɛkɛɛ, "Nu nɛɛ wɔnɔŋ." No hewɔ lɛ Isak wo nubu lɛ gbɛi akɛ, "Esek" ejaakɛ amɛ kɛ lɛ be yɛ he.
Isak tsuji lɛ je nubu kroko, ni amɛbe yɛ no hu he. No hewɔ lɛ Isak wo nubu lɛ akɛ, "Sitna"; eshishi ji "Hetsɛ̃".
Isak fã eshi jɛi, ni eyaje nubu kroko ni no lɛ amɛbeee yɛ he; ni Isak tsɛ nubu lɛ akɛ "Rehobot"; eshishi ji, "Yehowa ehã wɔ gbɛ koni wɔshwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Isak shi jɛi etee Beersheba.
Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Miji otsɛ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mikɛ o yɛ, ni majɔɔ o; mãhã oshwiei afa yɛ mitsulɔ Abraham hewɔ."
Isak mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi, ni eja Yehowa yɛ jɛi; ni eshi ebuu lɛ yɛ jɛi. Ni Isak je nubu yɛ jɛi hu.
Abimelek kɛ enaanyo Ahuzal kɛ etatsɛ Fikol jɛ Gerar ba Isak ŋɔɔ.
Ni Isak kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ, nyɛ ni nyɛnyɛɔ mi ni nyɛshwie mi yɛ nyɛmasɛi lɛ?"
Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Naa, wɔna akɛ Yehowa kɛ o yɛ, no hewɔ lɛ hã ni wɔkɛ o akpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ko,
akɛ ofeŋ wɔ efɔŋ ko ejaakɛ wɔfeko o efɔŋ ko akɛ ja ekpakpa kɛkɛ; ni wɔsaa wɔwo o gbɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; ni Yehowa ejɔɔ o!
Ni Isak ŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃, ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko.
Ni amɛte shi leebi mãŋkpa ni amɛkãmɔ amɛhe kitãi. Ni Isak wo amɛ gbɛ ni amɛshi eŋɔɔ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Ni eba mli nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ Isak tsuji lɛ ba ni amɛbagba lɛ nubu ni amɛje lɛ he sane akɛ, "Wɔyanina nu."
Ni Isak wo nubu lɛ akɛ "Shiba." No hewɔ ni atsɛɔ maŋ lɛ akɛ, "Beersheba" kɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ.
Be ni Esau ye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, ekpee Hit oblayei enyɔ komɛi: Yudit, Hitnyo Beeri biyoo lɛ, kɛ Basemat Elon biyoo lɛ.
Ni yei nɛɛ ahe sane lɛ fee Isak kɛ Rebeka dɔlɛ waa diɛntsɛ.
27: Be ni Isak egbɔ, ni ehiŋmɛii anɔ eha ni enaaa nii lɛ, etsɛ ebi nukpa Esau, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mibi!" Ni Esau here nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa mi!"
Isak kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, migbɔ, ni mileee migbele gbi.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ klɔmɔ ogbɔbimɔ nibii lɛ, ogãi kotoku kɛ ogai lɛ, ni oje kpo oya ŋa lɛ mli ni oyami milɛloo obahã mi,
koni okɛbafee niyenii kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni misumɔɔ lɛ, ohã mi maye koni majɔɔ o dani magbo."
Be ni Isak kɛ ebi Esau wieɔ lɛ, Rebeka miibo toi. No hewɔ lɛ be ni Esau eyiŋ etee ŋa lɛ mli eyaami milɛloo lɛ kɛba lɛ,
Rebeka yakɛɛ ebi Yakob akɛ, "Minu akɛ otsɛ kɛ onyɛmi Esau miiwie akɛ,
'Yaatao milɛloo, ni okɛfee niyenii kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ obahã mi maye koni majɔɔ o yɛ Yehowa hiɛ dani magbo.'
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mibi, bo nɔ ni mikɛɔ bo nɛɛ toi!
Yaa toi lɛ ateŋ ni oyamɔmɔ toobii kpakpai enyɔ yɛ abotiai lɛ ateŋ obahã mi ni mikɛfee niyenii kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ mahã otsɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ,
koni okɛyahã otsɛ ni eye, bɔ ni afee ni ejɔɔ o dani egbo."
Shi Yakob kɛɛ enyɛ Rebeka akɛ, "Naa, minyɛmi Esau lɛ tsɔiatsɛ ji lɛ, shi mi lɛ, mihe yɛ trotro.
Eko lɛ mitsɛ aaatra mihe ni matsɔ shishiulɔ yɛ ehiɛ ni maloo loomɔ mabua miyiteŋ, shi minaŋ jɔɔmɔ moŋ."
Enyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Oloomɔ lɛ ababua mi miyiteŋ, mibi; bo mi toi kɛkɛ ni oyamɔmɔ toi lɛ obahã mi!"
No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob yiŋ etee ni eyamɔmɔ toobii lɛ ebahã enyɛ; ni enyɛ kɛfee niyenii kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ sumɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka klɔ ebi nukpa Esau atadei fɛɛfɛji ni yɔɔ eŋɔɔ yɛ shīa lɛ, ni ekɛwo Yakob, ebi gbɛkɛ lɛ,
ni ekɛ toobii lɛ ahe woji lɛ wo Yakob niji kɛ ekuɛ, hei ni yɔɔ trotro lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ niyenii kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ kɛ aboloo ni eshã lɛ wo ebi Yakob dɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob ba etsɛ ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, "Ataa!" Ni etsɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Naa mi!" Bo namɔ ni, mibi?"
Ni Yakob kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Mi Esau, okromɔbi lɛ ni; mifee bɔ ni okɛɛ mi lɛ. Ofai nɛ, tee shi ota shi ni oye mimilɛloo lɛ eko koni ojɔɔ mi!"
Isak kɛɛ ebi lɛ akɛ, "Te fee tɛŋŋ ni ona lɛ oya nɛkɛ, mibi?" Ni Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, "Ejaakɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ye ebua mi nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Isak kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Tsi oba, mibi, ni matra ohe makwɛ akɛ mibi Esau lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni, aloo jeee lɛ ni."
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob tsi ebɛŋkɛ etsɛ Isak, ni Isak tra ehe, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Gbee lɛ Yakob gbee ni, shi niji lɛ Esau niji ni."
Isak yooo Yakob, ejaakɛ eniji ahe yɛ tsɔi sulaŋŋ tamɔ enyɛmi Esau niji ahe pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Isak jɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ebi akɛ, "Ani bo mibi Esau pɔtɛɛ nɛ lo?" Ni Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, "Mi ni".
Kɛkɛ ni Isak kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Okɛ niyenii lɛ abahã mi koni maye mibi milɛloo lɛ eko koni majɔɔ o." No hewɔ lɛ Yakob kɛ niyenii lɛ bahã lɛ, ni eye. Ebahã Isak wain hu, ni enu.
Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ Isak kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mibi, tsi obɛŋkɛ mi koo koni obashwɔ minaa!"
Ni etsi ebɛŋkɛ ni ebashwɔ enaa, ni Isak nu Yakob atadei lɛ amliŋma lɛ, ni ejɔɔ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ bɔ ni mibi lɛ he jeɔ ŋma, tamɔ ŋa frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni Yehowa ejɔɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ahã o ŋwɛi bɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ mli fɔ lɛ eko, kɛ ŋmãa kɛ wain babaoo hu.
Maji asɔ̃mɔ o, ni je lɛŋ maji akoto o. Ye onyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ lumɔ, no onyɛ bihii lɛ akoto o. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaalomɔ o lɛ, alomɔ lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɔɔ o lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ!"
Be ni Isak egbe Yakob jɔɔmɔ lɛ naa ni Yakob kɛɛ ejeɔ etsɛ Isak hiɛ nɔŋŋ pɛ lɛ, naa enyɛmi Esau hu; ejɛ emilɛ lɛ eba.
Ni lɛ hu efee niyenii kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni ekɛmiiba ebahã etsɛ. Ni ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Ataa, tee shi ni ota shi ni oye obi milɛloo lɛ eko koni ojɔɔ mi."
Etsɛ Isak bi lɛ akɛ, "Bo namɔ ni?" Ni Esau to he akɛ, "Mi, okromɔbi Esau ni."
Kɛkɛ ni Isak he kpokpo blibli waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Namɔ mɔ ji mɔ ni kɛ milɛloo bahã mi ni miye fɛɛ dani obaa nɛɛ, ni mijɔɔ lɛ, ni aaajɔɔ lɛ hu lɛ?"
Be ni Esau nu etsɛ wiemɔ lɛ, ebo waa diɛŋtsɛ kɛ awerɛhoo babaoo ni ekɛɛ etsɛ Isak akɛ, "Mi hu jɔɔmɔ mi eko, Ataa!"
Shi Isak kɛɛ, "Onyɛmi lɛ kɛ shishiumɔ ebahe ojɔɔmɔ lɛ kɛtee."
Esau kɛɛ, "Egbɛi Yakob ni awo lɛ lɛ, ebla lɛ. Shii enyɔ sɔŋŋ ni eshishiu mi nɛ; mikromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ eshɔ̃, ni agbɛnɛ ebahe mijɔɔmɔ lɛ hu!" Ni Esau bi etsɛ akɛ, "Ani oshwɛɛɛ jɔɔmɔ lɛ eko ohãaa mi?"
Isak to he ekɛɛ Esau akɛ; "Mifee lɛ onuŋtsɔ, ni mikɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ fee efee etsuji. Miŋɔ ŋmãa kɛ wain mihã lɛ; ni bo lɛ, mɛni mafee mahã o mɔ, mibi?"
Kɛkɛ ni Esau kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Ataa, ani jɔɔmɔ kome pɛ kɛkɛ oyɔɔ? Hã mi jɔɔmɔ ko kɛ̃, Ataa!" Ni Esau jwa yaafo.
Etsɛ Isak here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ ni fɔ bɛ mli nɔ ooohi, Kɛ he ni ŋwɛi bɔ enyɔɔɔ yɛ.
Okalŋte naa oyi aaana wala yɛ, ni onyɛmi lɛ ooosɔ̃mɔ. Shi aaaba mli akɛ, kɛ ople ohe lɛ, oookpɔ̃ ohe yɛ edɛŋ."
Esau nyɛ Yakob yɛ jɔɔmɔ ni etsɛ jɔɔ lɛ hewɔ. Ekɛɛ yɛ eyitsoŋ akɛ, "Etsɛŋ tsɔ ko ni aaafee mitsɛ yara, kɛkɛ lɛ magbe minyɛmi Yakob."
Shi abagba Rebeka ebi nukpa Esau wiemɔ nɛɛ, ni etsu ayatsɛ Yakob, ebi gbekɛ lɛ, kɛba ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, onyɛmi Esau kɛ gbe ni ebaagbe o miihã ehe tsui.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibi, bo mi toi, joo foi oya kɛya minyɛmi Laban ŋɔɔ yɛ Haran,
ni okɛ lɛ ayahi shi gbii fioo ko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni onyɛmi lɛ tsui he aaajɔ;
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni onyɛmi lɛ mlifu lɛ naa aaaba shi ni ehiɛ aaakpa nɔ ni ofee lɛ lɛ nɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ matsu ni abaŋɔ o kɛku sɛɛ kɛba. Mɛɛba nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛaaŋmɛɛ mi gbi kome?"
Kɛkɛ ni Rebeka kɛɛ Isak akɛ, "Esau ŋamɛi Hityei lɛ ehã mijeŋshihilɛ eje mitsine. Kɛji Yakob hu aaaŋɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ Hityei nɛɛ eko akɛ eŋa tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ, no lɛ faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ."
28: Kɛkɛ ni Isak tsɛ Yakob ni ejɔɔ lɛ, ni ewo lɛ akpɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Kaaŋɔ yoo yɛ Kanaan yei lɛ ateŋ.
Yaa onyɛ tsɛ Betuel we lɛ, yɛ Mesopotamia, ni oyaŋɔ onyɛ nyɛmi nuu Laban biyei lɛ eko akɛ oŋa.
Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ajɔɔ o, ni ehã oshwere ni owo shwie babaoo koni oshwiei atsɔ̃ majimaji asafo.
Bɔ ni ejɔɔ Abraham lɛ, ejɔɔ bo kɛ oshwiei nakai nɔŋŋ koni ogbɔtoo shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã otsɛ Abraham lɛ atsɔ̃ onɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Isak wo Yakob gbɛ koni eya Mesopotamia yɛ Aramnyo Betuel bi Laban ni ji Yakob kɛ Esau nyɛ Rebeka nyɛminuu lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Esau na akɛ Isak ejɔɔ Yakob, ni ewo lɛ gbɛ kɛtee Mesopotamia koni eyaŋɔ yoo yɛ jɛi.
Ena ele hu akɛ be ni Isak jɔɔ Yakob lɛ, ewo lɛ akpɔ akɛ ekaŋɔ yoo yɛ Kanaan yei lɛ ateŋ, ni Yakob ebo etsɛ kɛ enyɛ toi ni etee Mesopotamia.
Esau na hu akɛ etsɛ nyãaa Kanaan yei lɛ ahe.
Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ lɛ, Esau yiŋ etee Abraham bi Ishmael ŋɔɔ, ni eyaŋɔ ebiyoo Mahalat, Nabaiot nyɛmi yoo lɛ, efata eŋamɛi ni eyɔɔ lɛ ahe.
Yakob jɛ Beersheba ni eyiŋ eeya Haran.
Eshɛ he ko ni eto jɛi ejaakɛ hulu enyɔ shi. Ekɔ jɛi tɛi lɛ eko etsɔle, ni ekã jɛi ewɔ.
Ni ela ni aŋtswere ko ma shikpɔŋ ni eyiteŋ eyashi ŋwɛi. Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi miikwɔ miikpleke,
ni Yehowa damɔ aŋtswere lɛ yiteŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Miji Yehowa, Otsɛ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; shikpɔŋ ni okã nɔ nɛɛ, bo kɛ oshwiei mikɛbaahã.
Oshwiei aaafa tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu, ni ooogbɛ oshwã anai kɛ boka kɛ kooyi kɛ wuoyi. Bo kɛ oshwiei amli aaajɛ ajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akutsei fɛɛ.
Na ole akɛ mikɛ o yɛ ni he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ, mabu ohe, ni mikɛ o aaaba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ mishiŋ bo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mafee nɔ ni mitsi tã mikɛɛ bo lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ ewɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa yɛ biɛ kwa, ni mi lɛ mileee nɛɛ"!
Yakob she gbeyei, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Biɛ nɛɛ yɛ gbeyei, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Biɛ nɛɛ yɛ gbeyei eei! Biɛ nɛɛ jeee he ko he ko akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we, ni ŋwɛi naa agbo nɛ!"
Yakob te shi leebi maŋkpa ni etee tɛ lɛ ni etsɔle lɛ shi ema shi ekɛto okadi, ni efɔse mu eshwie nɔ.
Ewo jɛi Betel; shi sa lɛ, nakai maŋ lɛ gbɛi ji luz.
Yakob wo shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi aaahi shi, ni eeebu mihe yɛ gbɛ ni miyanyiɛ nɛɛ mli, ni eeehã miŋmãa maye kɛ atade mawo,
ni maku misɛɛ maba mitsɛ we lɛ kɛ omanye lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ,
ni nɛkɛ tɛ nɛɛ ni mikɛma shi mikɛto okadi nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ we; ni maŋɔ nibii fɛɛ ni ooohã mi lɛ amlijaa nyɔŋma kome mahã o."
29: Yakob wo anane nɔ yɛ egbɛfaa lɛ mli, ni eyashɛ bokagbɛbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni ewo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena nubu ko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ena too kui etɔ̃ bumɔ shi yɛ he ejaakɛ nakai bu lɛ mli nu ahãa amɛ amɛnuɔ. Tɛ ni kã bu lɛ naa lɛ da.
Kɛji too kui lɛ fɛɛ ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ bu lɛ he lɛ, tookwɛlɔi lɛ koloɔ tɛ lɛ kɛjeɔ bu lɛ naa ni amɛhãa toi lɛ nu, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkoklo tɛ lɛ amɛto bu lɛ naa ekoŋŋ yɛ egbɛhe.
Yakob bi tookwɛlɔi lɛ akɛ, "Minyɛmimɛi, nɛgbɛ nyɛjɛ?" Amɛto he akɛ, "Wɔjɛ Haran."
Yakob bi amɛ akɛ, Ani nyɛlɛ Nahor bi Laban lɛ lo?" Amɛto he akɛ, "Wɔle lɛ."
Esaa ebi amɛ akɛ, "Eyɛ jogbaŋŋ lo?" Amɛto he akɛ, "Eyɛ jogbaŋŋ. Naa, ebiyoo Rahel po kɛ toi baa nɛɛ!"
Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, je nako kwraa. Eshɛko be ni ebuaa toi lɛ anaa. Nyɛhãa amɛ nu amɛnua koni nyɛhãa amɛyayea nii."
Shi amɛto he akɛ, "Wɔnyɛŋ amɛ nu wɔhã akɛ ja abua too kui kui lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni akoklo tɛ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa dani wɔɔnyɛ amɛ nu wɔhã."
Be ni Yakob kɛ amɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, Rahel kɛ etsɛ toi lɛ bashɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ lɛ ekwɛɔ amɛ.
Be ni Yakob na Rahel, enyɛ nyɛmi nuu Laban biyoo lɛ, kɛ enyɛ nyɛmi nuu Laban toi lɛ, Yakob tsi etee ni eyakoklo tɛ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa, ni ehã enyɛ nyɛminuu Laban toi lɛ nu Amɛnu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob shwɔ Rahel naa, ni Yakob jwa yaafo.
Yakob kɛɛ Rahel akɛ, "Otsɛ wekunyo ji mi, ni Rebeka binuu ji mi." Kɛkɛ ni Rahel sha foi etee eyagba etsɛ.
Be ni Laban nu enyɛmi yoo bi Yakob he sane lɛ, esha foi etee lɛ kpeemɔ. Eloo Yakob atuu, ni eshwɔ enaa. Ekɛ lɛ ba ewe lɛ. Yakob gba Laban saji fɛɛ ni ba lɛ,
ni Laban kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Asonɔkwa, mi diɛntsɛ mila ji o!" Yakob kɛ lɛ hi shi nyɔŋ kome.
Ni Laban kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Akɛni miwekuyo ji o hewɔ lɛ ani esa akɛ osɔ̃mɔ mi yaka lo? Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ bɔ ni obaahe mi."
Laban yɛ biyei enyɔ. Onukpa lɛ gbɛi ji Lea, ni gbekɛ lɛ gbɛi ji Rahel.
Lea hiŋmɛii yɛ sukusuku, shi Rahel hiɛ yɛ fɛo ni egbɔmɔtso hu yɛ fɛo.
Yakob sumɔ Rahel, no hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ Laban akɛ, "Mibasɔ̃mɔ o afii kpawo yɛ Rahel, obiyoo fioo lɛ hewɔ."
Laban to he akɛ, "Ehi akɛ mikɛ lɛ ahã o fe nɔ ni mikɛ lɛ aaahã nuu kroko. Okɛ mi ahi shi."
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob sɔ̃mɔ afii kpawo yɛ Rahel hewɔ; ni suɔmɔ sɔŋŋ ni esumɔɔ Rahel hewɔ; ni suɔmɔ sɔŋŋ ni esumɔɔ Rahel hewɔ lɛ, afii lɛ ho oya yɛ ehiɛ tamɔ gbii fioo ko kɛkɛ.
Agbɛnɛ yakob Kɛɛ Laban akɛ, "Okɛ miŋa lɛ ahã mi koni mikɛ lɛ ahi shi ejaakɛ migbe misɔ̃ɔmɔ be lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Laban bua jɛi bii lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni eŋmɛ okplɔ̃.
Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ ebiyoo Lea moŋ yahã Yakob ni Yakob kɛ Lea wɔ.
(Laban kɛ eweyoo ko ni gbɛi ji Zipla lɛ hã ebiyoo Lea akɛ Lea weyoo.)
Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, Yakob na akɛ Lea ni. Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛɛ Laban akɛ, 'Mɛni sane oye mi nɛɛ? Ani jeee Rahal hewɔ misɔ̃mɔ o lɛ? Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni oshishiu mi nɛkɛ?'"
Laban to he akɛ, "Wɔshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, afeee nakai. Ahãaa gbekɛ gblã dani ahã onukpa gblã.
Gbee mɔ nɛ otsi lɛ naa ni wɔkɛ mɔ kome lɛ hu baahã o, kɛji osɔ̃mɔ mi afii kpawo krokro."
Yakob fee nakai; egbe Lea otsi lɛ naa. Kɛkɛ ni Laban kɛ ebiyoo Rahel hu hã lɛ gbla.
(Laban kɛ eweyoo Bilha hã ebiyoo Rahel akɛ Rahel weyoo).
Rahel hu bawɔ Yakob ŋɔɔ. Yakob sumɔ Rahel fe Lea; ni esɔ̃mɔ Laban afii kpawo kroko yɛ Rahel hewɔ.
Be ni Yehowa na akɛ Yakob sumɔɔɔ Lea lɛ, egble Lea musu naa, shi eŋa Rahel musu naa ni efee kene.
Lea na musu ni efɔ binuu. Ewo lɛ Ruben, ni ekɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ Yohowa ena mimanehulu lɛ. Agbɛnɛ lɛ miwu baasumɔ mi."
Lea na musu ekoŋŋ, ni efɔ binuu. Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛni Yehowa enu akɛ asumɔɔɔ mi hewɔ lɛ, ehã mi binuu nɛɛ hu." Ni ewo lɛ Simeon.
Esaa enu musu, ni efɔ binuu ekoŋŋ. Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miwu kɛ ehe baakpɛtɛ mihe, ejaakɛ mikɛ lɛ efɔ bihii etɔ̃." Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, ewo gbɛkɛ lɛ Levi.
Ena musu ekoŋŋ, ni efɔ binuu. Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ, majie Yehowa yi!" No hewɔ lɛ ewo gbekɛ lɛ Yuda; kɛkɛ ni efo fɔmɔ dã.
30: Be ni Rahel na akɛ ekɛ Yakob fɔɔɔ lɛ, ebɔi enyɛmiyoo Lea lɛ he awuŋayeli, ni ekɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Okɛ mi afɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ magbo!"
Yakob mli wo Rahel la, ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ani miji Nyɔŋmɔ ni etsi omusuŋbii anaa lɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Rahel kɛɛ, "Mikɛ miweyoo Bilha miihã o ŋɔɔ lɛ ni okɛ lɛ afɔ ashwie mishuɔ nɔ mɔ, koni mi hu mana bii kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ"
No hewɔ lɛ Rahel kɛ eweyoo Bilhã hã Yakob gbla. Bilha yawɔ Yakob ŋɔɔ;
Bilha na musu, ni ekɛ Yakob fɔ binuu.
Kɛkɛ ni Rahel kɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ eye misane lɛ ehã mi, ebo mi toi, ni ehã mi binuu." No hewɔ lɛ ewo abifao lɛ Dan.
Bilha, Rahel weyoo lɛ, na musu ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛ Yakob fɔ binuu ni ji enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Rahel kɛɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ minyɛmi yoo lɛ enɔ nɔmɔ ni mli wa, ni miye kunim." No hewɔ lɛ ewo abifao lɛ Naftali.
Be ni Lea na akɛ ekpa fɔmɔ lɛ, ekɛ eweyoo Zilpa hã Yakob gblã.
Lea weyoo Zipla lɛ Kɛ Yakob fɔ binuu.
Lea kɛɛ akɛ, "Omanye sane nɛ;" no hewɔ lɛ ewo abifao lɛ Gad.
Lea weyoo Zipla kɛ Yakob fɔ binuu ni ji enyɔ:
ni Lea kɛɛ akɛ, "Mina miishɛɛ ejaakɛ yei aaatsɛ mi yoo ni yɔɔ mishɛɛ;" ni ewo abifao lɛ Asher.
Be ni ŋmãakuu be shɛ lɛ, Ruben yana suɔmɔ tso yibii ko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni etse eko, ni ekɛbahã enyɛ Lea. Kɛkɛ ni Rahel kɛɛ Lea akɛ, "Miikpa o fai ni ohã mi obi lɛ suɔmɔ tso yibii lɛ eko."

Shi Lea kɛɛ Rahel akɛ, "Aso ni oshɔ̃ miwu lɛ, no faaa hãaa o, obaashɔ̃ mibi lɛ suɔmɔ tso yibii lɛ hu?" Rahel to he akɛ, "Kɛji ooohã mi obi lɛ suɔmɔ tso yibii lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ obaanyɛ oyawɔ Yakob ŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ."

No hewɔ lɛ gbɛkɛ mli be ni Yakob jɛ ŋmɔ mli ebaa lɛ, Lea je kpo ni ekɛ lɛ Yakpe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ, ja obawɔ miŋɔɔ ejaakɛ mikɛ mibi lɛ suɔmɔ tso yibii lɛ ebɔ o apaa!" No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob kɛ lɛ wɔ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ bo Lea sɔlemɔ toi, ena musu; ni ekɛ Yakob fɔ binuu ni ji enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Lea kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mi mipaabɔɔnii, ejaakɛ mikɛ miweyoo lɛ ehã miwu gblã;" ni ewo abifao lɛ Isakar.
Ni Lea na musu ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛ Yakob fɔ binuu ni ji ekpaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Lea kɛɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mi gblãnii fɛɛfɛo. Agbɛnɛ miwu baawo mihiɛ nyam, ejaakɛ mikɛ lɛ efɔ bihii ekpa sɔŋŋ." No hewɔ lɛ ewo gbɛkɛ lɛ Zebulon.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Lea fɔ biyoo, ni ewo lɛ Dina.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kai Rahel; Nyɔŋmɔ bo esɔlemɔ toi, ni egble emusu naa.
Rahal na musu, ni efɔ binuu, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ejie mihiɛgble lɛ."
Ewo gbɛkɛ lɛ Yosef, eshishi ji, "Yehowa ahã mafɔ binuu ekoŋŋ."
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Rahel efɔ Yosef sɛɛ lɛ, Yakob kɛɛ Laban akɛ, "Wo mi gbɛ ni maya mijɛɛhe kɛ mishikpɔŋ nɔ.
Okɛ miŋamɛi kɛ nibii ni misɔ̃mɔ o yɛ amɛhewɔ lɛ ahã mi ni maya ejaakɛ bo diɛntsɛ ole bɔ ni misɔ̃mɔ o mihã."
Shi Laban kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ oooŋmɛ mi gbɛ ni mawie lɛ, mitsɔ̃ gbalɛ nɔ mina mile akɛ bo ohewɔ ni Yehowa ejɔɔ mi nɛɛ.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni obaahe mi, ni mahã o."
Yakob kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole bɔ ni misɔ̃mɔ o mihã kɛ bɔ hu nu okooloi lɛ eshwere yɛ midɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ be ni miba lɛ, kooloi fioo ko kɛkɛ oyɔɔ; shi amrɔ nɛɛ amɛshwere babaoo; mi mihewɔ Yehowa ejɔɔ o babaoo nɛɛ. Shi agbɛnɛ mɛɛbe mabua nɔ ko naa mahã mi diɛntsɛ miwe hu."
Laban bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mahã o?" Yakob hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Kaahã mi nɔ ko nɔ ko. Kɛ ooofee nɔ ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ o nɛɛ ohã mi lɛ, no lɛ masaa malɛ okooloi lɛ ni makwɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ.

Ŋmɛnɛ hã ni makpa otoi lɛ fɛɛ mli ni mahala toobi fɛɛ toobi ni he yɔɔ truntrãi kɛ damdam yɛ gwaŋteŋi lɛ amli, kɛ nii ni he yɔɔ damdam kɛ nii ni he yɔɔ truntrãi yɛ abotiai lɛ ateŋ lɛ. Nomɛi aaatsɔ minyɔmɔwo.

Ni kɛfee sɛɛ ni ooobakwɛ minyɔmɔwo lɛ, miye bo anɔkwale jio, miyeko bo anɔkwale jio, obaana. Abotiai lɛ amli eko fɛɛ eko ni he bɛ truntrãi kɛ damdam kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi lɛ amli nii ni he diii lɛ kɛ ooona eko yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, belɛ no lɛ juunii ni."
Laban to he akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ; afee bɔ ni okɛɛ nɛɛ."

Ni nakai gbi lɛ Laban jie too kpakpoi ni he yɔɔ truntrãi kɛ damdam lɛ kɛ abotia yei ni he yɔɔ truntrãi kɛ damdam lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko ni eyɛŋ ta ehe, kɛ gwaŋtɛŋbi fɛɛ gwaŋtɛŋbi ni diɔ, ni etu amɛ ewo ebii lɛ adɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ebii lɛ shi Yakob kɛtee he krokro ni jekɛmɔ ji gbii etɔ̃ gbɛnyiɛmɔ, ni Yakob kwɛ Laban toi ni shwɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yakob klɔ libne tsei ŋmɔji kɛ luz tsei kɛ blɔfoŋkatiɛ tsei ni eye amɛhe sãmãi yɛji, ni ehã tsei lɛ amli eyɛji lɛ je shi.
Ekɛ tsei ni eye amɛhe sãmãi nɛɛ shwie tsesei ni toi lɛ banuɔ nu yɛ amli lɛ amli, bɔ ni toi lɛ aaana sãmãi lɛ kɛji amɛba nu lɛ nu mɔ lɛ, too hii lɛ kwɔɔ too yei lɛ yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛ too hii lɛ kwɔ too yei lɛ yɛ tsei lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, toi lɛ fɔfɔɔ toobii ni he yɔɔ sãmãisãmãi kɛ nii ni he yɔɔ truntrãi kɛ damdam.
Yakob tserɛ too gwaŋtɛŋbii lɛ eto afã, ni etsɔ̃mɔ toi lɛ ahiɛ ehã Laban toi ni he yɔɔ sãmãisãmãi lɛ Kɛ nii ni diɔ lɛ fɛɛ. Ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtɛ etoo ku lɛ to afã, ni ekɛ amɛ futuuu Laban toi lɛ.
Kɛ toi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ amɛhe miina bɔlɛ lɛ, Yakob kɛ tsei lɛ shwieɔ tsesei lɛ ahiɛ, koni toi lɛ ana bɔlɛ yɛ tsei lɛ ateŋ.
Shi toi ni yɔɔ wudɔwudɔ lɛ ekɛ tsei lɛ eshwieee amɛhiɛ. No hewɔ lɛ toi wudɔwudɔi lɛ tsɔmɔ Laban nii, ni nii ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ tsɔmɔ Yakob nii.
Enɛ hã yakob shwere waa naakpa. Ena toi babaoo kɛ weyei kɛ wehii kɛ yomai kɛ tejii.
31: Yakob nu ni Laban bihii lɛ miiwiewie akɛ, "Yakob eshɔ̃ wɔtsɛ nii fɛɛ; wɔtsɛ nii lɛ ekɛna ehe nɛɛ."
Agbɛnɛ Yakob na akɛ gbii etɛ̃ nɛɛ Laban tseee ehiɛ ehãaa lɛ dɔŋŋ tamɔ sa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ kɛya otsɛmɛi kɛ owekumɛi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mi kɛ o aaahi shi."
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob tsu ayatsɛ Rahel kɛ Lea kɛba ŋa lɛ nɔ, he ni etoi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "mina akɛ gbii etɔ̃ nɛɛ nyɛtsɛ tseee ehiɛ ehãaa mi dɔŋŋ tamɔ sa lɛ. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni mitsɛ jaa lɛ kɛ mi yɛ.
Nyɛ diɛntsɛ ny ɛle akɛ mihewalɛ fɛɛ mikɛsɔ̃mɔ nyɛtsɛ;
kɛ̃lɛ nyɛtsɛ shishiu mi, ni etsake minyɔmɔwo shii nyɔŋma; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa lɛ hegbɛ ni efeee mi efɔŋ ko.
Kɛji ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Toi kɛ amɛhe truntrãi lɛ aaatsɔ onɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ efɔ bii kɛ amɛhe damdam.'
Nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ fee ni eshɔ̃ nyɛtsɛ kooloi lɛ ehã mi.
"Toi lɛ amusunamɔ be mli lɛ, miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina yɛ lamɔ mli akɛ too kpakpoi ni kwɔɔ too yei lɛ, amɛhe yɛ truntrãi kɛ damdam kɛ ŋwãtãŋwãtã.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi yɛ lamɔ lɛ mli akɛ, 'Yakob!' Ni mikɛɛ akɛ, 'Naa mli!'
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Wo ohiɛ nɔ, ni ooona akɛ too kpakpoi lɛ fɛɛ ni kwɔɔ too yei lɛ amɛhe truntrãi kɛ damdam kɛ ŋwãtãŋwãtã ejaakɛ mina nii fɛɛ ni Laban feɔ bo lɛ.

Miji Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ o yɛ Betel, he ni oŋɔ tɛ okɛto okadi yɛ, ni ofɔ okadi tɛ lɛ mu, ni owo mi shi yɛ lɛ. Agbɛnɛ tee shi oyá no ni oya; jee shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ koni oku osɛɛ oya shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni afɔ bo yɛ lɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Rahel kɛ Lea here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔbɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ ko loo gboshinii ko dɔŋŋ yɛ wɔtsɛ we lɛ.
Ani jeee mɛi kpɔji ebuɔ wɔ? Ejaakɛ ehɔ̃ɔ wɔ, ni eye wɔyi nii lɛ hu.
Shi nii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eshɔ̃ yɛ wɔtsɛ dɛ lɛ, no ji wɔ kɛ wɔbii anɔ. No hewɔ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ o lɛ feemɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob te shi, ni eŋɔ ebii kɛ eŋamɛi lɛ etra yomai anɔ;
ni ekpla kooloi lɛ kɛ enii fɛɛ ni ena lɛ, ni ji nii ni ena yɛ Mesopotamia lɛ, ni eŋɔ eshwie nɔ kɛmiiya etsɛ Isak ŋɔɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Laban etee eyaaku etoi lɛ ahe tsɔi, ni Rahel ju etsɛ shīa amãgãi lɛ.
Yakob laka Laban, Aramnyo lɛ ejaakɛ ekɛ efoijee lɛ tee Laban.
Yakob jo foi kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ, ni etee eyafo Eufrate Faa lɛ, ni ewo eyi ema he ni Gilead gɔji lɛ yɔɔ lɛ gbɛ.
Gbi ni ji etɔ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, eyakɛɛ Laban akɛ Yakob ejo foi.
No hewɔ lɛ Laban ŋɔ ewekumɛi efata ehe, ni etiu Yakob gbii kpawo gbɛ kɛyashi eyanina lɛ yɛ Gilead gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Laban, Aramnyo lɛ, yɛ wɔ mli ni ekɛɛ Laban akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okɛ Yakob akawie wiemɔ fɔŋ ko."
Laban yanina Yakob. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Yakob eshi ebuu yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni Laban kɛ ewebii lɛ hu shi amɛbuu yɛ Gilead gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Laban kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Mɛni ofee nɛɛ? Olaka mi ni oŋɔ mibeyei lɛ kɛmiiya tamɔ mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom yɛ ta mli nɛɛ?
Mɛɛ hewɔ ni ojo foi dujiaŋ ni oshɛɛɛ mi koni kulɛ mikɛ lala kɛ milɛ̃ kɛ kpãa saŋku ayajie o gbɛ kɛ miishɛ?
Ni mɛɛ hewɔ ohãaa mana hegbɛ koni mashwɔ minabihii kɛ mibiyei lɛ anaa mikɛ amɛ aye shɛɛ lɛ? Nɔ ni ofee lɛ kwashiai asane oye nɛɛ.
Kulɛ manyɛ mafee bo efɔŋ; shi otsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mi wie nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Kwɛmɔ ohe ni ahi koni okɛ Yakob akawie wiemɔ fɔŋ ko.'
Agbɛnɛ, yaa oyaa nɛɛ, ejaakɛ ohiɛ etsɔ̃ otsɛ we lɛ; shi mɛɛba mɔ ni oju mimãgãi lɛ?"
Yakob to he, ni ekɛɛ, 'Miyashe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ oooshɔ̃ obiyei lɛ yɛ midɛŋ akranaŋ naa.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ dɛŋ ni ooona owɔŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ agbe lɛ. Taomɔ nɔ ni ji onɔ yɛ minibii nɛɛ eteŋ, yɛ wekumɛi ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ ahiɛ koni okɔ onii." Shi Yakob leee akɛ Rahel ni eju amãgãi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Laban bote Yakob buu lɛ mli kɛ Lea buu lɛ mli kɛ weyei enyɔ lɛ hu abuu lɛ mli, shi enaaa ewɔŋ lɛ. Ni eje kpo yɛ Lea buu lɛ mli, ni ebote Rahel nɔ lɛ mli.
Shi Rahel eklɔ amãgãi lɛ, ni ekɛwo yoma nɔ nii lɛ mli, ni eho eta nɔ. Laban nyɛmɔnyɛmɔɔ shi yɛ buu lɛ mli fɛɛ, shi enaaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Rahel kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Ekafee minuŋtsɔ mlifu akɛ minyɛɛɛ shi mate yɛ ohiɛ ejaakɛ mifee yei anii." No hewɔ lɛ Laban tao amãgãi lɛ aahuu, shi enaaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob mli wo la, ni ekɛ Laban be. Yakob kɛɛ Laban akɛ, "Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ mitɔ̃, ni mɛɛ esha hu mifee, ni ohiɛ edɔ kɛnyiɛ misɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ?
Kolɛ ni ota minibii lɛ fɛɛ mli nɛɛ, mɛni ona ni ji oshīa nibii lɛ eko? Kɛji ona eko lɛ, okɛ sane nɛɛ aŋmɛ miwekumɛi kɛ bo hu owekumɛi nɛɛ ahiɛ koni amɛye wɔteŋ sane lɛ ni amɛbu bem ni amɛbu fɔ.
Mikɛ o bahi shi nɛɛ, afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ nɛ; ogwaŋtɛŋ yei kɛ obotia yei shrakeko, ni otoi lɛ ateŋ ojwɛnii lɛ hu miyeko eko.
Kooloi lɛ ateŋ nii ni kooloi awuyelɔi tserɛɔ lɛ, mikɛbahãaa bo, mitoɔ bo najiaŋ. Nyɔɔŋ aju eko jio, shwane jio mi, midɛŋ oheɔ yɛ.
Bɔ ni mishihilɛ lɛ fee nɛ: Latsaa tsaa mi shwane, ni fɛ̃i yeɔ mi nyɔɔŋ, ni wɔ hu tseɔ yɛ mihiɛ.

Afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, bɔ ni miyɔɔ yɛ owe lɛ nɛ. Mikɛ emli afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ sɔ̃mɔ bo yɛ obiyei enyɔ lɛ ahewɔ ni mikɛ afii ekpaa hu sɔ̃mɔ bo kɛkwɛ otoi lɛ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, otsakɛ minyɔmɔwo shii nyɔŋma sɔŋŋ.

Kɛjeee mitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ ni Isak sheɔ lɛ lɛ ni kɛmi yɔɔ jikulɛ, anɔkwale sane ji akɛ obaawo mi gbɛ kɛya kɛ midɛ flo. Shi Nyɔŋmɔ na mimanehulu kɛ minine naa nitsumɔ ni naa wa lɛ, hewɔ ni ekã ohiɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ lɛ."
Laban here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Biyei nɛɛ mibiyei ni, ni bii lɛ hu mibii ni; toi lɛ mitoi ni; ni nibii ni onaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ minɔ ni. Shi ŋmɛnɛ mɛni manyɛ mafee mibiyei lɛ loo amɛbii ni amɛfɔfɔɔ lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, ba ni mi kɛ bo akpaŋ koni no atsɔ̃ odase yɛ mi kɛ bo teŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob wo tɛ ema shi, ni ekɛto okadi;
ni ekɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbuaa tɛi anaa." Amɛklɔ tɛi, ni amɛto lɛ ku amɛma shi; ni amɛye nii yɛ jɛi yɛ tɛ ku lɛ he.
Laban wo tɛ ku lɛ Yegar-Sahaduta; shi Yakob lɛ, ewo lɛ Galed.
Laban kɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛkɛ tɛ ku nɛɛ miiye odase yɛ mi kɛ bo teŋ ŋmɛnɛ." No hewɔ ni atsɛɔ tɛ lɛ akɛ Galed lɛ.
Atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Mizpa hu ejaakɛ Laban kɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa hiŋmɛi ahi mi kɛ bo fɛɛ he, be mli ni wɔgbla mli nɛɛ.
Kɛji owa mibiyei lɛ ayi aloo oooyaŋɔ yei krokomɛi ofata mibiyei lɛ ahe lɛ, gbɔmɔ ko bɛ biɛ moŋ, shi kaimɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefonyo yɛ mi kɛ bo teŋ."
Laban saa ekɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Oona nɛkɛ tɛ ku ni ma shi nɛɛ, ni oona nɛkɛ okadi tɛ ni mikɛma mi kɛ bo teŋ nɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ tɛ ku nɛɛ ji odase, ni nɛkɛ okadi tɛ nɛɛ hu ji odase akɛ, mi lɛ, mihoŋ tɛ ku nɛɛ he mibaŋ oŋɔɔ ni mibafee bo efɔŋ, ni bo hu ohoŋ tɛ ku nɛɛ kɛ okadi tɛ nɛɛ he obaŋ miŋɔɔ ni obafee mi efɔŋ.
Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nahor Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afee kojolɔ yɛ wɔteŋ." Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kã Mɔ ni gbeyei etsɛ Isak she lɛ kitã.
Kɛkɛ ni eshã afɔle yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni etsɛ ewekumɛi lɛ niyeli. Amɛye nii, ni amɛhi shi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Laban te shi, ni eshwɔshwɔɔ enabii kɛ ebiyei lɛ anaa, ni ejɔɔ amɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Laban kɛ amɛ gbla mli, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋ.
32: Kɛkɛ ni Yakob hu kɛshwie nɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi kɛ lɛ bakpe.
Be ni ena amɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Enɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ta nɛ!" Ni ewo jɛi Mahanaim.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tsu mɛi kɛtsɔ ehiɛ kɛtee enyɛmi Esau ŋɔɔ yɛ Seir yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Wiemɔ ni ekɛtsu amɛ nɛ, "Nyɛkɛa minuŋtsɔ Esau akɛ, bɔ ni otsulɔ Yakob kɛɛ nɛ: 'Miyato gbɔ yɛ Laban ŋɔɔ, ni mitsɛ yɛ jɛi aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Minã tsinai kɛ tejii kɛ toi kɛ tsuji hii kɛ tsuji yei, ni mitsu ni abakɛɛ bo, minuŋtsɔ, koni kɛ miba lɛ ona mihe tsui jurɔ.'"
Mɛi ni atsu lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba Yakob ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔtee onyɛmi Esau ŋɔɔ, ni lɛ hu ekɛ hii ohai ejwɛ miiba abakpee bo."
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tsui fã, ni efee yeyeeye naakpa. Eja emɛi lɛ kɛ toi lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ kɛ yomai lɛ amli kui enyɔ ni ekɛɛ,
"Kɛji Esau batua ku kome nɛɛ ni etswia amɛ nii lɛ, koni ku kome ni eshwɛ lɛ ana gbɛ ajo foi."
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob sɔle ekɛɛ, "Mitsɛ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mitsɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa, bo mɔ ni okɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Kuu osɛɛ oya oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ owekumɛi aŋɔɔ, ni mafee bo jogbaŋŋ' lɛ,
osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ onɔkwayeli fɛɛ ni ojie kpo otsɔ̃ɔ otsulɔ lɛ, ekome flo nɛkɛ esaaa mi. Dɛhiɛmɔtso kɛkɛ mihiɛ kɛfo Yordan nɛɛ; shi agbɛnɛ mitsɔ asafo kui enyɔ.
Miikpa o fai koni ojie mi yɛ Esau, minyɛmi lɛ, dɛŋ shi miishe lɛ gbeyei, koni ekaba ni ebatswia wɔ fɛɛ nii, mi kɛ nyɛmɛi lɛ kɛ bii lɛ.
Bo okɛɛ akɛ, 'Mafee o jogbaŋŋ, ni mahã oshwiei afa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia, ni anyɛŋ amɛyibɔ akane yɛ amɛyifalɛ naa.'"
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob wɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekɛ nii ni ehiɛ lɛ eko yake enyɛmi Esau;
too abotia yei ohai enyɔ kɛ too kpakpoi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, too gwaŋtɛŋ yei ohai enyɔ kɛ too ojwɛnii nyɔŋmai enyɔ
kɛ yomai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni miihã amɛbii fufɔ lolo kɛ amɛbii lɛ, kɛ tsina hii nyɔŋma kɛ tsina yei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ teji yei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ teji hii nyɔŋma.
Yakob kɛ nibii nɛɛ wo etsuji lɛ adɛŋ kuikui, ni ekɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsɔa mihiɛ ni nyɛhãa gbɛ akãa ku kɛ ku teŋ."
Yakob wo klɛŋklɛŋ ku lɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ kitã akɛ, "Kɛji minyɛmi Esau kɛ o kpe ni ebi o akɛ, 'Namɔ gbɔmɔ ji o, ni nɛgbɛ oyaa, ni namɔ nii ji enɛɛmɛi ni nyiɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ?' lɛ,
no lɛ ohã lɛ hetoo akɛ, 'Otsulɔ Yakob nikeenii ni ekɛtsu akɛ akɛbake minuŋtsɔ Esau ni; ni naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ enyiɛ wɔsɛɛ?'"
Nakai kitã nɔŋŋ ewo mɔ ni ji enyɔ kɛ mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ hu ni nyiɛ kui lɛ asɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ nyɛnina Esau lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ lɛ awie nɛ;
ni nyɛsaa nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, naa 'Otsulɔ Yakob nyiɛ wɔsɛɛ.'" Esusumɔ ji akɛ, "Mikɛ nikeenii ni nyiɛ hiɛ nɛɛ yaakpãtã lɛ, ni no sɛɛ dani mayana ehiɛ; eko lɛ eeekwɛ mihiɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni akɛ nikeenii lɛ tsɔ Yakob hiɛ, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ekɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ wɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ.
Yakob te shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ eŋamɛi enyɔ lɛ kɛ eweyei enyɔ lɛ kɛ ebihii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ yafo faa lɛ yɛ Yabok faahoohe lɛ.
Ehã amɛfo faa lɛ kɛ nii ni eyɔɔ fɛɛ.
Ni ebashwɛ Yakob kome. Nuu ko kɛ lɛ banɔ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ.
Be ni nuu lɛ na akɛ enyɛɛɛ Yakob lɛ, etswa Yakob joŋku nɔ, ni joŋku talɔ lɛ hwãŋ yɛ nɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Hã maya, shi je miitsɛre!" Shi Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, "Mihaŋ oya, ja ojɔɔ mi dã."
Nuu lɛ bi Yakob akɛ, "Te atsɛɔ o tɛŋŋ?" Yakob to he akɛ, "Atsɛɔ mi Yakob."
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Atsɛŋ o Yakob dɔŋŋ, shi Israel aaatsɛ o, ejaakɛ okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi eshi mple, ni oye kunim."
Yakob kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miikpa o fai ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi ogbɛi." Shi nuu lɛ kɛɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ obiɔ migbɛi?" Ni ejɔɔ Yakob moŋ yɛ jɛi.
Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, "Mina Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ migbooo." No hewɔ lɛ ewo jɛi Peniel.
Be ni efoŋ yɛ Peniel lɛ, je etsɛre lɛ, ni eetsutsɔ egboŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ Israelbii yeee joŋku he loo, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ tswa Yakob joŋku lɛ nɔ, ni ejoŋku lɛ hwãŋ.
33: Yakob wo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ, ni naa Esau miiba kɛ mɛi ohai ejwɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Yakob ja gbekɛbii lɛ amli ehã Lea kɛ Rahel kɛ weyei enyɔ lɛ.
Ekɛ weyei lɛ kɛ amɛbii lɛ to hiɛgbɛ; Lea kɛ ebii lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni Rahel kɛ Yosef nyiɛ sɛɛ kwraa.
Shi lɛ Yakob lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eho eyi ekui lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ; ni be ni eyaa lɛ ekoto shi flɛoflɛo shii kpawo dani eyashɛ enyɛmi lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi Esau sha foi ekɛ lɛ bakpe. Eloo Yakob atuu, ni eho egbee ekuɛ nɔ, ni eshwɔ enaa, ni amɛfo.
Be ni Esau wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ena yei lɛ kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ, ebi Yakob akɛ, "Namɛi ji mɛi ni kɛ o nyiɛ nɛɛ?" Ni Yakob to he akɛ, "Bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ edro otsulɔ lɛ ni."
Kɛkɛ ni weyei lɛ tsi ba, amɛ kɛ amɛbii lɛ, ni amɛbakoto Esau.
Lea hu kɛ ebii lɛ tsi ba ni amɛbakoto Esau. Ni naagbee kwraa lɛ Yosef kɛ Rahel hu ba ni amɛbakoto lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Esau bi akɛ, "Kuikui ni mikɛkpe nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ te eshishi hu?" Ni Yakob hã hetoo akɛ, "Bɔ ni afee ni minuŋtsɔ ahã mi hiɛ."
Shi Esau kɛɛ akɛ, "Minyɛminuu, nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ fa, hã onɔ lɛ ahi shi ahã o!"
Shi Yakob kɛɛ, "Dabida; miikpa o fai, kɛji mina hiɛ yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, no lɛ hemɔ midɛŋ nikeenii lɛ; ejaakɛ ohiɛ ni mina nɛɛ lɛ etamɔ nɔ ni mina Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ pɛ, ni ohere mi atuu hu.
Miikpa o fai koni ohe midɛŋ nikeenii ni akɛbahã o nɛɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ edro mi, ni misaa miyɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hu." Ni Yakob hiɛ Esau kɛ wiemɔ aahuu kɛyashi be ni ehe nikeenii lɛ.
Esau kɛɛ, "Hã ni wɔŋɔshwie nɔ koni wɔya; mi lɛ matsɔ ohiɛ."
Shi Yakob kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ le akɛ gbekɛbii lɛ ahiɛ esako; asaŋ mihiɛ toi kɛ tsinai ni hãa amɛbii fufɔ; amɛsane kã mitsui nɔ: kɛji atsirɛ amɛyisɛɛ gbi kome jenamɔ lɛ, kooloi lɛ fɛɛ aaabagboi.
No hewɔ lɛ, minuŋtsɔ atsɔ̃ etsulɔ hiɛ, ni mi lɛ manyiɛ blɛooblɛoo bɔ ni kooloi lɛ ni nyiɛ mihiɛ lɛ kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ aaanyɛ anyiɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mashɛ minuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ Edom."
Ni Esau kɛɛ, "Hã mashi mɛi ni kɛ mi nyiɛ lɛ eko mato ohe." Yakob to he akɛ, "Mɛɛ hiamɔ ehia? Hã mi mana hiɛ yɛ minuŋtsɔ hiɛ kɛkɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Esau ku esɛɛ nakai gbi lɛ, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Edom.
Yakob kɛshwie nɔ kɛtee Sukot ni eyama etsu yɛ jɛi, ni efee asesei ehã ekooloi lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ awo jɛi Sukot.
Be ni Yakob ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Mesopotamia ebaa lɛ, ebashɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ ko ni ji Shekem lɛ shweshweeshwe, ni eto shi yɛ maŋ lɛ klotia.
Yakob kane sika jwiɛtɛi kukuji oha, ni ekɛhe shikpɔŋ he ni ebato shi yɛ lɛ yɛ Hamorbii lɛ adɛŋ. Shekem tsɛ ji Hamor nɛɛ.
Yakob ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ "El, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
34: Gbi ko lɛ Dina, Lea biyoo ni Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yei komɛi sramɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Shekem, Hamor Hivnyo lɛ, binuu na Dina, ni emɔ lɛ ekɛ lɛ wɔ akranaŋ naa, ni efite lɛ.
Shekem tsui mɔ Yakob biyoo Dina lɛ, ni esumɔ oblayoo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ wie tsui jurɔ naa.
Shekem kɛɛ etsɛ Hamor akɛ, "Yaakpee oblayoo nɛɛ ohã mi."
Agbɛnɛ Yakob nu akɛ abule ebiyoo Dina. Shi no mli lɛ, ebihii lɛ kɛ ekooloi lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ. Hewɔ lɛ Yakob mɔ enaabu mli kɛyashi be ni amɛba.
Shekem tsɛ Hamor tee Yakob ŋɔɔ, koni ekɛ lɛ ayawie Dina he.
Be ni Yakob bihii lɛ nu he lɛ, amɛjɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ amɛba. Edɔ oblahii nɛɛ, ni amɛmli wo la naakpa ejaakɛ afee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel, akɛni nuu lɛ kɛ Yakob biyoo lɛ wɔ, shi esaaa akɛ afeɔ nakai nɔ ko lɛ.
Shi Hamor kɛ amɛ wie ekɛɛ, "Mibinuu Shekem tsui emɔ nyɛbiyoo lɛ; miikpa nyɛ fai koni nyɛkɛ lɛ ahã lɛ gblã.
Nyɛkɛ wɔ ayea yooŋɔɔ, nyɛkɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ ahãa wɔ gblã, ni nyɛ hu nyɛŋɔa wɔbiyei nyɛfea ŋamɛi.
Nyɛkɛ wɔ ahia shi. Shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi hã nyɛ; nyɛhia nɔ ni nyɛtsua nɔ nii koni nyɛna nii yɛ nɔ nyɛhãa nyɛhe akɛ nyɛnɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Shekem kɛɛ Dina tsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa mihiɛ abaa nyam yɛ nyɛhiɛ shi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaaba mi lɛ, mahã nyɛ.
Nyɛbia mi gblãnii kɛ nikeenii; bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛ koni nyɛkɛ oblayoo lɛ ahã mi."
Yakob bii lɛ laka Shekem kɛ etsɛ Hamor hiɛ ejaakɛ Shekem ebule amɛnyɛmi yoo Dina lɛ.
Yakob bii lɛ kɛɛ Shekem kɛ etsɛ Hamor akɛ, "Wɔnyɛŋ nɛkɛ nɔ ko wɔfee ni wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmi yoo ahã mɔ ko ni ji foolɔ ejaakɛ no lɛ wɔto kpa.
Nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ kɛkɛ dani wɔɔkplɛ̃ nɔ wɔhã nyɛ ji akɛ nyɛbaatsɔmɔ tamɔ wɔ, ni abaaflɔ nyɛteŋ hii lɛ fɛɛ ketia.
No lɛ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei baahã nyɛ gblã, ni wɔ hu wɔɔŋɔ nyɛbiyei, ni wɔkɛ nyɛ aaahi shi, ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ maŋ kome.
Shi kɛji nyɛbooo wɔ toi koni nyɛhã afo nyɛ ketia lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔŋɔ wɔbiyoo lɛ ni wɔya."
Wiemɔ nɛɛ sa Hamor kɛ ebi Shekem hiɛ.
Oblanyo lɛ kɛ sane lɛ ashashaooo shi, ejaakɛ etsui emɔ Yakob biyoo lɛ. Oblanyo nɛɛ abuɔ lɛ fe etsɛ lɛ mli bii fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Hamor kɛ ebi Shekem tee agbonaa koi lɛ shi, ni amɛkɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ mli hii lɛ wie amɛkɛɛ,
"Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ wɔ ye yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; no hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa amɛhia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtsu nɔ nii. Shikpɔŋ lɛ hu da aahuu hã amɛ. Nyɛhãa wɔŋɔa amɛbiyei lɛ, ni wɔ hu wɔkɛ wɔbiyei lɛ ahã amɛ gblã.
Shi ja afo wɔteŋ hii fɛɛ ketia tamɔ bɔ ni afo amɛ lɛ dani gbɔmɛi lɛ aaakplɛ̃ ni amɛ kɛ wɔ ahi shi ni amɛkɛ wɔ aaafee maŋ kome.
Amɛkooloo kui kɛ amɛnii ni amɛyɔɔ kɛ amɛshīa kooloi fɛɛ lɛ, ani jeee wɔnii ebaatsɔmɔ? Nyɛhãa wɔkplɛ̃a wɔhãa amɛ kɛkɛ koni amɛkɛ wɔ ahi shi."
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ni tee agbonaa koi lɛ shi lɛ ŋɔ nɔ ni Hamor kɛ ebi Shekem kɛɛ lɛ nɔ, ni aflɔ Shekem maŋ lɛ mli hii fɛɛ ni eshɛ tayaa lɛ ketia.
Shi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, be ni amɛfaji lɛ ewo wu lɛ, Yakob bihii enyɔ ni ji Simeon kɛ Levi, Dina nyɛmmɛii lɛ, klɔ amŋɛklaŋtei, ni amɛbatua maŋ lɛ trukaa, ni amɛgbe hii lɛ fɛɛ.
Amɛkɛ klaŋte gbe Hamor kɛ ebi Shekem hu, ni amɛyaŋɔ Dina yɛ Shekem we lɛ, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee.
Yakob bii krokomɛi lɛ banina mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔi lɛ, ni amɛha maŋ lɛ mli nii, ejaakɛ Shekem ebule amɛnyɛmiyoo lɛ.
Shekem maŋbii lɛ atoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ amɛtejii kɛ amɛnii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ nii ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ, Yakob bii lɛ loo fɛɛ kɛtee.
Amɛsaa amɛŋɔ maŋbii lɛ ajwetri fɛɛ kɛ amɛbii bibii fɛɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi fɛɛ nom, ni amɛha amɛwei amli nibii fɛɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛɛ Simeon kɛ Levi akɛ, "Nyɛwo mi amaneŋ, ni nyɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni ji Kanaanbii kɛ Perizbii lɛ baanyaŋe mi. Ni mi hu nɛ, ni miyikulɛ ji fioo nɛɛ. Kɛji amɛaabua amɛhe naa amɛbatua mi lɛ, amɛaagbe mi, ni amɛaakpãtã miwe lɛ hiɛ."
Shi Simeon kɛ Levi kɛɛ, "Ani eja gbɛ akɛ afee wɔnyɛmi yoo lɛ tamɔ afeɔ ajwamaŋ ko kɛkɛ lo?"
35: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Yaa Betel ni oyahi jɛi, ni oma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ohã Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ o be ni ojo onyɛmi Esau naa foi lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob kɛɛ ewe lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjiea maŋsɛɛ wɔji ni yɔɔ nyɛtɛŋ lɛ nyɛshɛraa nyɛshwiea, ni nyɛtsua nyɛhe ni nyɛtsakea nyɛtadei.
Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Betel koni mayama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi mahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni bo misɔlemɔ toi yɛ mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ ni ewa mi yɛ gbɛ ni mifã lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛ maŋsɛɛ wɔji lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛdɛŋ lɛ kɛ amɛtoiaŋnii lɛ bahã Yakob; kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛtee eyafu yɛ tso kple ko ni ma Shekem masɛi lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋɔshwie nɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ he ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ maji fɛɛ ni bɔle amɛ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ amɛtiuuu Yakob webii lɛ.
Yakob kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ bashɛ Luz ni ji Betel ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi, ni etsɛ jɛi El-Betel, ejaakɛ jɛi Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe shi etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ, be ni ejo enyɛmi Esau naa foi lɛ.
Ni Debora, mɔ ni kwɛɔ Rebeka kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Betel wuoyigbɛ yɛ tso kple ko shishi. No hewɔ lɛ awo tso lɛ gbɛi akɛ Allon-bakukut.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yakob ekoŋŋ, be ni ejɛ Mesopotamia eba lɛ, ni ejɔɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ogbɛi ji Yakob; atsɛŋ bo Yakob dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ aaatsɛ o Israel." No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ Israel.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miji Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ; fɔ ni oyi afa. Maŋ kɛ maji babaoo aaajɛ omli, ni maŋtsɛmɛi hu aaajɛ omli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhã Abraham kɛ Isak lɛ, bo mikɛbaahã, ni oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baaahã."
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ shi Yakob yɛ he ni ekɛ lɛ wie yɛ lɛ, ni etee ŋwɛi.
Yakob ŋɔ tɛ eto okadi yɛ he ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie yɛ lɛ, ni efɔse wain kɛ mu eshwie nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob wo he ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie yɛ lɛ gbɛi akɛ Betel.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛ ewebii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Betel. Be ni eshwɛ gbɛ kukuoo ko lolo dani amɛshɛɔ Efrat lɛ, Rahel bɔi kɔ̃ɔmɔ, ni kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli yawa.
Be ni fɔmɔ lɛ mli ewa nɛkɛ lɛ, yoofɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ Rahel akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛshi obaafɔ nuu ekoŋŋ."
Be ni Rahel etɔ biti ni eehe enyɔ lɛ, ewo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ Benoni; shi etsɛ wo lɛ Benyamin.
Rahel gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Efrat ni ji Bethlehem gbɛ lɛ he.
Yakob kɛ tɛ ko to okadi yɛ Rahel saŋ lɛ nɔ; ni no hewɔ lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Rahel saŋ nɔ tɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Israel ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yakob hu lɛ tsa egbɛfaa lɛ nɔ, ni eyashi ebuu lɛ yɛ Eder mɔɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.
Be ni Yakob yɔɔ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ruben yi mli etee ekɛ etsɛ hemɔ Bilha lɛ yawɔ; Yakob nu sane nɛɛ he. Yakob yɛ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Lea bihii ji Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda kɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon.
Rahel bihii ji Yosef kɛ Benyamin.
Bilha, Rahel weyoo lɛ, bihii ji Dan kɛ Naftali.
Ni Zilpa, Lea weyoo lɛ, bii ji Gad kɛ Asher. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Yakob bihii lɛ ni efɔ yɛ Mesopotamia lɛ.
Yakob ba etsɛ Isak ŋɔɔ yɛ Mamre loo Kiriat-Arba ni bɛŋkɛ Hebron lɛ, he ni Abraham kɛ Isak bato gbɔ yɛ lɛ.
Afii ni Isak ye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.
Isak tsɔ̃ nuumo ni egbɔ kotokoto; egbo ni afu lɛ yɛ ewekumɛi amasɛi be mli ni eye afii babaoo lɛ. Ni ebii ni ji Esau kɛ Yakob fu lɛ.
36: Esau ni atsɛɔ lɛ Edom lɛ shwiei nɛ.
Esau ŋɔ Kanaan yei. Amɛji Hitnyo Elon biyoo Ada kɛ Hivnyo Zibeon bi Ana biyoo Oholibama lɛ
kɛ Ishmael biyoo Basemat ni ji Nebaiot nyɛmiyoo lɛ.
Ada kɛ Esau fɔ Elifaz, ni Basemat fɔ Reuel.
Oholibama fɔ Yeush kɛ Yolam kɛ Kora. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Esau bihii ni efɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Esau ŋɔ eŋamɛi kɛ ebihii kɛ ebiyei kɛ eshīaŋbii fɛɛ kɛ etsinai kɛ ekooloi ni elɛɔ kɛ enitsumɔ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enii fɛɛ ni ena yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eshi enyɛmi Yakob kɛtee shikpɔŋ ko nɔ,
ejaakɛ amɛnii ni amɛna lɛ fa tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ amɛhi shi yɛ he kome. Amɛkooloi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ amɛhooo shikpɔŋ ni amɛbato gbɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Esau yahi Edom gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Esau ni ji Edombii ablema tsɛ lɛ, eshwiei nɛ:
Esau bihii lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Elifaz, Esau ŋa Ada bi lɛ; Reuel Esau ŋa Basemat bi lɛ.
Elifaz hu bii ji Teman kɛ Omar kɛ Zefo kɛ Gatam kɛ Kenaz.
Esau bi Elifaz hemɔ ji Timna. Timna kɛ Elifaz fɔ Amalek. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Esau ŋa Ada lɛ bii.
Reuel bii ji Nahat kɛ Zera kɛ Shama kɛ Miza. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Esau ŋa Basemat lɛ bii.
Esau ŋa Oholibama ni ji Zibeon bi Ana biyoo lɛ bi ni ekɛ Esau fɔ ji Yeush kɛ Yalam kɛ Kora.
Shīai ni jɛ Esau mli nɛ: Elifaz we, Esau kromɔbi lɛ, Teman we kɛ Omar we kɛ Zefo we kɛ Kenaz we,
kɛ Kora we kɛ Gatam we kɛ Amalek we. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Elifaz lumɛi yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Ada shwiei ji amɛ.
Shīai ni jɛ Esau bi Reuel we lɛ mli nɛ: Nahat we kɛ Zera we kɛ Shama we kɛ Miza we. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Reuel lumɛi yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Esau ŋa Basemat shwiei ji amɛ.
Esau ŋa Oholibama we lɛ mli bii ji Yeush we kɛ Yalam we kɛ Kora we. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ana biyoo Oholibama ni ji Esau ŋa lɛ shwiei bii.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ Esau bii ji amɛ, ni amɛwei nɛ. Esau lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Edom lɛ.
Sier ni ji Hornyo lɛ shīa lɛ mli bii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ: Lotan we kɛ Shobal we kɛ Zibeon we kɛ Ana we,
kɛ Dishon we kɛ Ezer we kɛ Dishan we. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Horbii ni ji Seir bii ni yɔɔ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ awei lɛ.
Lotan shwiei ji Hori kɛ Heman; ni Lotan nyɛmiyoo ji Timna.
Shobal shwiei ji Alvan kɛ Manahat kɛ Ebal kɛ Shefo kɛ Onam.
Zibeon bii ji Aia kɛ Ana. Mɔ nɛ ji Ana lɛ ni yana nuhiŋmɛi ni mli edɔ la yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ be ni elɛɔ etsɛ Zibeon tejii lɛ.
Ana bii ji Dishon kɛ Oholibama.
Dishon bii ji Hemdan kɛ Eshban kɛ Itram kɛ Keran.
Ezar bii ji Bilham kɛ Zaavan kɛ Akan.
Dishan bii ji Uz kɛ Aran.
Horbii awei nɛ: Lotan we kɛ Shobal we kɛ Zibeon we kɛ Ana we,
kɛ Dishon we kɛ Ezer we kɛ Dishan we. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Horbii lɛ awei ni ye lumɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa yɛ Seir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Mɛi ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dani awo maŋtsɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ nɛ:
Beor bi Bela ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Edom, ni emaŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Dinhaba.
Be ni Bela gbo lɛ, Yobab, Zera ni jɛ Bozra lɛ bi lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yobab gbo ni Husham ni jɛ Temanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Husham gbo ni Bedad bi Hadad ni ye Midian nɔ kunim yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ. Emaŋtsɛmaŋ gbɛi ji Avit.
Hadad gbo ni Samla ni jɛ Masreka lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Samla gbo ni Shaul ni jɛ Rehobot ni kã Eufrate faa lɛ he lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Shaul gbo ni Akbor bi Baal-Hanan lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Akbor bi Baal-Hanan gbo, ni Hadar baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ. Emaŋtsɛmaŋ gbɛi ji Pau; ni eŋa ji Mehetabel, Mezehab biyoo Matred bi lɛ.
Esau shwiei ji nɛkɛ Edombii nɛɛ: Timnabii, Alvabii, Yetebii,
Oholibamabii, Elabii, Pinonbii,
Kenazbii, Temanbii, Mizarbii,
Magdielbii, Irambii. Hei ni Edombii nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko hi lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛi wo jɛi. Esau nɔŋŋ ji Edom ni ji Edombii atsɛ lɛ.
37: Yakob hi shi yɛ etsɛ gbɔtoo shikpɔŋ ni ji Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yakob weku lɛ he sane nɛ. Be ni Yosef eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ, ewaa enyɛmimɛi ni ji etsɛ ŋamɛi Bilha kɛ Zilpa bii lɛ kɛkwɛɔ amɛtsɛ toi lɛ. Yosef baflɔɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anaa ehãa amɛtsɛ.
Yakob sumɔɔ Yosef fe ebii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ egbɔlɛ mli binuu ni. Ekpɛ atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo ko kɛ eniji kakadaji ehã Yosef.
Be ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛtsɛ sumɔɔ Yosef fe amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛ lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ awie yɛ tsui jurɔ naa dɔŋŋ.
Be ko lɛ Yosef la lamɔ ko ni be ni egba enyɛmimɛi lɛ lamɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛɛ ni amɛnyɛɔ lɛ lɛ mli wo wu moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa lamɔ ni mila nɛɛ toi,
Wɔ miifimɔ ŋmãa kei yɛ ŋmɔshi; ni naa, miŋmãa ke lɛ te shi damɔ shi trɔmɔɔ, ni nyɛŋmãa kei lɛ babɔle miŋmãa kɛ lɛ, ni amɛkoto lɛ."
Enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aso osusuɔ akɛ obaatsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ ni oye wɔnɔ lo?" No hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛ lɛ fe tsutsu lɛ ye yɛ elamɔi kɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni esaa ela lamɔ kroko hu, ni egba enyɛmimɛi lɛ ekɛɛ; "Naa, mila lamɔ ko ekoŋŋ. Mila ni hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome bakoto mi."
Shi be ni egba etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ lamɔ lɛ, etsɛ kã ehiɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni lamɔ ola nɛɛ? Belɛ kotomɔ mi kɛ onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ aaaba abakoto o lo?"
Enyɛmimɛi lɛ bɛ lɛ amɛwo amɛmli; shi etsɛ kɛ wiemɔ lɛ to anakutsoŋ.
Gbi ko be ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ etee amɛkwɛɔ amɛtsɛ toi lɛ yɛ Shekem lɛ,
Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Te onyɛmimɛi lɛ miikwɛ toi yɛ Shekem? Ba ni matsu o amɛŋɔɔ." Ni Yosef here nɔ akɛ, "Naa mi, tsu mi."
Yakob kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni oyakwɛ akɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jogbaŋŋ lo koni obakɛɛ mi." Kɛkɛ ni etsu Yosef kɛjɛ Hebron jɔɔ lɛ mli; ni Yosef ba Shekem.
Nuu ko na Yosef ni eetsomlo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni nuu lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni otaoɔ?"
Ni ekɛɛ, "Miitao minyɛmimɛi lɛ. Miikpa o fai, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi he ni amɛlɛɔ amɛtoi lɛ yɛ."
Ni nuu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Amɛje biɛ, shi minu ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Dotan.'" No hewɔ lɛ Yosef tiu enyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni eyanina amɛ yɛ Dotan.
Shi be ni amɛna lɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ ni enako ebɛŋkɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛkpãŋ eyinɔ akɛ amɛbaagbe lɛ.
Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Naa, lamɔiatsɛ lɛ baa lɛ.
Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ ni wɔshɛa lɛ wɔfɔ̃a bui lɛ eko mli, ni wɔkɛɛ akɛ, 'Kooloo fɔŋ ko eye lɛ,' koni wɔkwɛ kɛji elamɔi lɛ aaaba mli."
Shi be ni Ruben nu yiŋ ni ato lɛ, akɛni eetao ni ejie lɛ yɛ amɛdaŋ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkahãa wɔgbea lɛ."
Ruben saa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashwiea lá shi, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ lɛ awoa bu nɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛkafea lɛ efɔŋ ko!" Ruben kɛɛ enɛ bɔ ni afee ni ejie lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ koni ekɛ lɛ ayahã etsɛ ekoŋŋ.
Be ni Yosef shɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkplɔ atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo kɛ eniji kakadaji lɛ yɛ ehe,
ni amɛmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wo bu lɛ mli; shi bu flo ni, nu bɛ mli.

Kɛkɛ ni amɛho amɛtra shi ni amɛbɔi niyeli. Be ni amɛwo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛna Ishmaelbii gbɛnyiɛlɔi aku ko ni jɛ Gilead miiba kɛ amɛyomai ni tre tsofãkɛŋmai kɛ gbonyowoo tsofã kɛ ohɛ ni jeɔ ŋma kɛmiiya Egipt.
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ sɛɛ wɔɔna yɛ mli kɛji wɔgbe wɔnyɛmi lɛ ni wɔtsimɔ nɔ?
Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔbɔɔa lɛ wɔhãa Ishmaelbii lɛ; shi nyɛkahãa wɔkɛ wɔnine miita ehe, ejaakɛ wɔnyɛmi kɛ wɔla ji lɛ." Ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ bo lɛ toi.
Kɛkɛ ni Midia guɔyelɔi lɛ bashɛ jɛi; ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ jie Yosef yɛ bu lɛ mli; ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ lɛ amɛhã Ishmaelbii lɛ amɛhe jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋkmai enyɔ. Ishmaelbii lɛ kɛ Yosef tee Egipt.
Shi be ni Ruben ku esɛɛ kɛba bu lɛ he ekoŋŋ lɛ, Yosef bɛ bu lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Ruben gbla ehe atadei lɛ,
ni eku esɛɛ kɛba enyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ; "Gbekɛ lɛ bɛ jɛi; te mafee tɛŋŋ?"
Kɛkɛ ni amɛklɔ Yosef atade lɛ, ni amɛgbe too kpakpo ko, ni amɛkɛ atade lɛ tsɔ la lɛ mli.
Ni amɛkɛ atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo lɛ tsu ni akɛyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛtsɛ; amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔna nii nɛɛ, kwɛmɔ akɛ obi lɛ atade lɛ ni loo jeee noŋ."
Ni Yakob yoo atade lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Miba lɛ atade lɛ ni! Kooloo kakawua ko eye lɛ; tserɛmɔ etserɛ Yosef mli nɛɛ?"
Ni Yakob gbla ehe atade lɛ, ni ekɔ kpekpe emia ehɛ, ni eye ebi lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ gbii pii.
Ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ fɛɛ te shi koni amɛbashɛje emii, shi ekplɛɛ miishɛjemɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Ŋkɔmɔyeli mikɛaaya ayanina mibi lɛ yɛ gbohiiaje." Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ Yosef tsɛ tsɔ efo lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Midianbii lɛ eyahɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ Egipt amɛhã Potifar ni ji Farao piafonyo kɛ eblafoiatsɛ lɛ.
38: Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yuda shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ ni eyahi Adulamnyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hira lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Yuda na Kanaannyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Shua lɛ biyoo ko yɛ jɛi; eŋɔ oblayoo lɛ efee eŋa.
Oblayoo lɛ na musu ni efɔ binuu. Yuda wo gbekɛ lɛ Er.
Yoo lɛ na musu ekoŋŋ. Efɔ binuu ni ewo lɛ Onan.
Esaa efɔ binuu ekoŋŋ ni ewo lɛ Shela. Eyɛ Akzib be ni efɔ gbekɛ nuu lɛ.
Yuda ŋɔ yoo ehã Er, ebi kromɔ lɛ. Yoo lɛ gbɛi ji Tamar.
Shi Er, Yuda kromo lɛ fee ehe gbɔmɔ fɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Yehowa gbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ Onan akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ onyɛminuu lɛ ŋa lɛ akɛ kulayeliŋa, koni owo shwiei ohã onyɛmi nuu lɛ."
Shi Onan le akɛ bii lɛ ebatsɔ̃ŋ enɔ, No hewɔ lɛ kɛ etee enyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ ŋɔɔ ekɛ lɛ yawɔ lɛ, ejieɔ ehe nu lɛ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ efiteɔ, koni ekahã enyɛmi lɛ miina shwiei.
Nɔ ni efee lɛ, efɔŋ ni yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa gbe Onan hu.

Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ eshaayoo Tamar akɛ, "Yaahi shi akɛ okulafo yɛ otsɛ we lɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mibi Shela lɛ aaada." Ekɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ eeshe gbeyei akɛ Shela hu baagbo tamɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Tamar tee eyahi etsɛ we lɛ.
Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ, Yuda ŋa Shua biyoo lɛ bagbo; ni be ni Yuda etsɛ etsui eŋmɛ emli lɛ, ekɛ enaanyo Hira, Adulamnyo lɛ, yiŋ tee etoohetsɔi kulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Timna.
Ayakɛɛ Tamar akɛ, "Oshaanuu miiya Timna eyaku etoi lɛ ehe tsɔi."

Kɛkɛ ni Tamar jie ekulafeemɔ atadei lɛ yɛ ehe efɔ shi, ni ekɛ hiɛhaanɔ ha ehiɛ, ni ekɛ mama bla ehe koni akayoo lɛ; ni eyata shi yɛ Enaim klotia, yɛ Timna gbɛ lɛ toi ejaakɛ ena akɛ Shela eda, shi kɛ̃lɛ aŋɔɔɔ lɛ, Tamar lɛ, ahãaa Shela gblã.
Be ni Yuda na Tamar lɛ, esusu akɛ yoo ajwamaŋ ko ni, ejaakɛ eha ehiɛ.
Yuda gba kɛtee eŋɔɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ toi, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, hã ni maba oŋɔɔ," ejaakɛ eleee akɛ eshaayoo lɛ ni. Tamar bi Yuda akɛ, "Mɛni obaahã mi koni okɛ mi ayawɔ?"
Yuda to he akɛ, "Mahã amɔ too kpakpo bi ko yɛ toi lɛ ateŋ abahã o." Ni Tamar kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ kɛji okɛ nɔ ko aaato mi awaba kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooohã akɛtoo lɛ aba lɛ."
Yuda bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mikɛto o awaba lɛ?" Tamar to he akɛ, "Owolonaasɔomɔnɔ kɛ ehe kpãa lɛ kɛ odɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛ nibii lɛ hã Tamar, ni etee ekɛ lɛ yawɔ. Fee sɛɛ lɛ Tamar na musu,
Tamar te shi, ni eyiŋ etee. Eyajie ehiɛhaanɔ lɛ efɔ shi, ni ekɔ ekulafeemɔ atade lɛ ewo.
Yuda kɛ too kpakpo bi lɛ hã enaanyo Adulamnyo lɛ kɛtee koni eyahe ewabatoo nii lɛ yɛ Tamar dɛŋ; shi enaanyo lɛ enaaa Tamar.
No hewɔ lɛ ebi maŋbii komɛi ni yɔɔ Enaim lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ yoo ajwamaŋ lɛ ni ta Enaim gbɛ lɛ toi lɛ yɔɔ?" Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Yoo ajwamaŋ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ."
Yuda naanyo lɛ ku esɛɛ eba Yuda ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minaaa lɛ, ni esaŋ jɛibii lɛ kɛɛ, 'Yoo ajwamaŋ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ.'"
Yuda kɛɛ akɛ, "Hã ni eŋɔ kɛya, kɛjeee nakai lɛ wɔhiɛ aaashwie shi. Mihã okɛ too kpakpo bi lɛ tee, ni onaaa lɛ."
No sɛɛ aaafee nyɔji etɛ̃ lɛ, abakɛɛ Yuda akɛ, "Oshaayoo Tamar eyabɔ ajwamaŋ, ni nɔ ni ena yɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ mli ji akɛ ena musu." Yuda fã akɛ, "Amɔ lɛ kɛje kpo koni ashã lɛ."
