Be ni akɛ Tamar jeɔ kpo kɛbaa lɛ, etsu atee eshaanuu Yuda ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuu mɔ ni nibii ji enɛɛmɛi lɛ, lɛ mikɛna musu lɛ." Asaŋ Tamar kɛɛ, "Kwɛmɔ akɛ oooyoo mɔ ni nibii ji wolonaasɔomɔnɔ nɛɛ kɛ ehe kpãa nɛɛ kɛ tso nɛɛ lo?"
Yuda yoo nibii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Akɛni miŋɔɔɔ lɛ mihãaa mibi Shela lɛ esane ja." Ni Yuda etaaa Tamar he dɔŋŋ.
Be ni shɛ Tamar fɔmɔ be lɛ, ana akɛ hãaji ni yɔɔ emusu mli lɛ.
Be ni efɔɔ lɛ, hãaji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome jie enine kɛje kpo, ni yoorfɔlɔ lɛ mɔ mli. Ekɛ kpãa tsuru fi nine lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ tsutsu ba."
Shi abifao lɛ su enine lɛ, kɛkɛ ni enyɛmi lɛ je kpo kɛba, no yoofɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Bo diɛŋtsɛ ogbu gbɛ kɛje kpo." Ni awo gbekɛ lɛ Perez.
No sɛɛ lɛ, enyɛmi lɛ ni kpãa tsuru lɛ yɔɔ enineshi lɛ hu ba, ni awo lɛ Zera.
39: Ishmaelbii lɛ kɛ Yosef tee Egipt, ni amɛyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ amɛ hã Potifar, ni ji Farao piafonyo kɛ eblafoiatsɛ lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ, ni ehã efee nɔbatsɛ.
Enuŋtsɔ Egiptnyo lɛ we lɛ eyɔɔ. Potifar na akɛ Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ, ni ehãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yosef feɔ lɛ shwereɔ yɛ edɛŋ.
Enɛ hã Yosef na hiɛ yɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni lɛ esɔ̃mɔɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ. Potifar fee Yosef ewe lɛ nɔkwɛlɔ nukpa ni etu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ewo edɛŋ.
Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Egiptnyo lɛ wo Yosef enukpa yɛ ewe lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa jɔɔ Egiptnyo lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yosef hewɔ. Yehowa jɔɔmɔ ba Egiptnyo lɛ shīa nii kɛ eŋmɔshi nii fɛɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Potifar tu enibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ewo Yosef dɛŋ, ni egbaaa ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he ja nɔ ni ebaaye kɛkɛ. Kɛji ona Yosef lɛ ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Yɛ mli aahuu lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋa lɛ kɛ hiŋmɛi ko bɔi Yosef kwɛmɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ mi abawɔ."
Ni Yosef ekplɛ̃ɛɛ; shi ekɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ gbaaa ehe naa yɛ enɔ ko nɔ ko he yɛ shīa nɛɛ, ejaakɛ etu enii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ewo midɛŋ.

Ehã mi hewalɛ yɛ shīa nɛɛ nɔ tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ekamaaa mi nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja bo pɛ kɛkɛ; ejaakɛ bo lɛ eŋa ji bo. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni mafee efɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni tamɔ nɛkɛ hu ni mafee esha mashi Nyɔŋmɔ hu?"
Yoo lɛ hiɛ Yosef kɛ wiemɔ daa nɛɛ, shi Yosef eŋɔɔɔ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ awɔ aloo ebɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ gbi lɛ eko lɛ, Yosef tee shīa lɛ eyaatsu nii. Shīa lɛ mli bii lɛ ekoeko bɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ mɔ Yosef atade lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ, "Okɛ mi abawɔ!" Shi Yosef shi atade lɛ ewo edɛŋ, ni ejo foi kɛje kpo.
Be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ Yosef eshi etade lɛ yɛ edɛŋ ni ejo foi kɛje kpo lɛ,
etsɛ eshiaŋ bii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbakwɛa nɔ ko! Miwu eyaŋɔ Hebrinyo bi nɛɛ kɛba shīa nɛɛ koni ebaye wɔhe fɛo. Eba miŋɔ koni ekɛ mi abawɔ, ni miblɔ waa.
Ni be ni ena akɛ miwo migbee nɔ miiblɔ waa lɛ, eshi etade lɛ efɔ̃ mimasɛi, ni ejo foi kɛje kpo."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ Yosef atade lɛ fɔ̃ emasɛi kɛyashi Yosef nuŋtsɔ lɛ ba shīa.
Kɛkɛ ni eyajaje sane lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ ewu lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɔŋnuu Hebrinyo lɛ ni okɛba shīa nɛɛ lɛ, eba ni ebahlɔ mi.
Shi be ni mibo waa lɛ, eshi etade lɛ ehã mi, ni ejo foi."
Be ni Yosef nuŋtsɔ lɛ nu sane ni eŋa lɛ jaje etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni onyɔŋnuu lɛ bafee mi nɛ" lɛ, emli wo la naakpa.
Ni Yosef nuŋtsɔ lɛ mɔ lɛ, ni eyawo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ he ni awoɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ gboklɛfoi atsuŋ yɛ lɛ, jɛi Yosef hi.
Shi Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ. Ena lɛ mɔbɔ ni ehã ena hiɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi akwɛlɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Gboklɛfoi akwɛlɔ lɛ tu gboklɛfoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ tsu lɛ mli lɛ ewo Yosef dɛŋ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni atsuɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ, Yosef ni kwɛɔ nɔ.
Gboklɛfoi akwɛlɔ lɛ gbaaa ehe naa yɛ nii ni etu ewo Yosef dɛŋ lɛ he, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ, Yehowa hãa eyeɔ omanye.
40: Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ dãawolɔ lɛ kɛ ebolooshãlɔ lɛ tɔ̃ amɛnuŋtsɔ ni ji Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ.
Farao mli fu epiafoi enyɔ nɛɛ, ni ji edãawolɔ nukpa lɛ kɛ ebolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ,
ni eyawo amɛ tsuŋ yɛ blafoiatsɛ lɛ shīa yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli he ni akɛ Yosef ewo lɛ.
Blafoiatsɛ lɛ tu piafoi lɛ ewo Yosef dɛŋ ni ekwɛɔ amɛnɔ. Piafoi enyɔ lɛ ye be kplaŋŋ yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
Gbi ko nyɔɔŋ lɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛla, Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ dãawolɔ nukpa lɛ kɛ ebolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ elamɔ, kɛ lamɔ lɛ shishi hu.
Be ni Yosef tee amɛ ŋɔɔ leebi lɛ, eyoo akɛ amɛfee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ ebi farao piafoi nɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli yɛ enuŋtsɔ shīa lɛ mli lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛfee mɔbɔmɔbɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛkɛ?"
Amɛto he akɛ, "Wɔla lamɔi komɛi, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ shishi." Yosef kɛɛ, "Ani lamɔ shishitsɔɔmɔ lɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni? Nyɛ fai nɛ, nyɛgbaa mi lamɔi lɛ!"
No hewɔ lɛ daawolɔi anukpa lɛ gba Yosef elamɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Milamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mina ni waintso ko ma mihiɛ.
Egbla niji etɛ̃, amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni efimɔ afofro kpɔi, ni egba afofro, ni ewo wainyibii shabii ni etsu.
Mihiɛ Farao kpulu mli; ni mitserɛ wain yibii lɛ, ni maŋa miwo kpulu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni mikɛ kpulu lɛ hã Farao."
Yosef kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa olamɔ lɛ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ. Niji etɛ̃ lɛ damɔ shi hã gbii etɛ̃.
Biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, Farao aaajie o yɛ tsuŋ, ni ekɛ o aaayato ogbɛhe lɛ ekoŋŋ ni okɛ Farao kpulu lɛ aaawo edɛŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ofeɔ sa lɛ be ni bo ji edãawolɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji ehi ehã o lɛ, miikpa o fai koni okai mi, ni omli ahi ahã mi koni otsi mitã otsɔ̃ɔ Farao koni abajie mi yɛ tsu nɛɛŋ.
Shi ju aju mi yɛ Hebribii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni biɛ nɛɛ hu mifeko nɔ ko ni sa akɛ akɛ mi awo kpabuŋ nɛɛŋ."
Be ni abolooshãlɔi anukpa lɛ na akɛ lamɔ lɛ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ yɛ miishɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Mi hu mila lamɔ ko. Milamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mina ni mitre bodobodo kɛŋtɛŋi etɛ̃.
Kɛŋtɛŋ ni ma yiteŋ tɔɔ lɛ, niyenii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni ashãa ahãa Farao lɛ yɛ mli, ni loofɔji miiye yɛ kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ mli yɛ miyiteŋ."
Yosef hã hetoo ni ekɛɛ, "Naa olamɔ lɛ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ. Kɛŋtɛŋi etɛ̃ lɛ damɔ shi hã gbii etɛ̃.
Biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, Farao aaajie bo yɛ tsuŋ ni ni eeefo oyi ni ekɛ bo aaatsotsro tso nɔ, ni loofɔji aaaye oheloo."
Ni eba mli akɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, Farao fɔmɔgbi ni. Eŋmɛ etsuji fɛɛ okplɔ̃ ni ejie edãawolɔi anukpa lɛ kɛ abolooshãlɔi anukpa lɛ yɛ tsuŋ yɛ enukpa lɛ ahiɛ.
Ehã edãawolɔi anukpa lɛ yaye egbɛhe lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni lɛ ekɛ kpulu lɛ wo Farao dɛŋ.
Shi abolooshãlɔi anukpa lɛ, esɛŋ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yosef tsɔ̃ɔ amɛlamɔi lɛ ashishi lɛ.
Shi dãawolɔ nukpa lɛ eyakaiii Yosef; ehiɛ kpa enɔ.
41: Afii naakplɔi enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, Farao la lamɔ ko. Ela ni edamɔ Nilo faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ naa, tsinayei dukudukuu fɛɛfɛji kpawo fã kpo kɛjɛ faa lɛ mli, ni amɛyabɔi niyeli yɛ faa naa glãi lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni tsina yei kpawo krokomɛi ni amɛtra loo ni amɛhe efee nyaŋemɔ hu fã kpo kɛjɛ faa lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ. Amɛbadamɔ tsinai krokomɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ Nilo faa lɛ naa.
Ni tsinai ni he yɔɔ nyaŋemɔ ni amɛtra loo lɛ ye tsinai kpawo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni amɛshwishwii dukudukuu lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Farao hiɛ tsɛ̃.
Esaa ewɔ ni ela ekoŋŋ. Lamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ena ni able tso kome ekpɛ sɛɛbii kpawo ni eba kpokploo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, able tso ni ekpɛ sɛɛbii kpawo ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ egbi amɛ kekree hu kwɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni able sɛɛbii kpawo ni egbi kekree lɛ mii able sɛɛbii ni eba kpokploo lɛ. Farao hiɛ tsɛ̃ ni ena akɛ lamɔ ni.
Leebi lɛ etsui bɔ̃i yeli. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ etsu ayatsɛ Egipt nifeelɔi lɛ kɛ nilelɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba, ni egba amɛ elamɔ lɛ; shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ Farao lamɔ lɛ shishi etsɔ̃ɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni dãawolɔ nukpa lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Mikai mitsɔ̃mɔ ŋmɛnɛ.
Omli fu wɔ, otsuji lɛ, ni owo wɔ tsuŋ yɛ blafoiatsɛ lɛ we lɛ, mi kɛ abolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ fɛɛ.
Be ni wɔyɔɔ jɛi lɛ, mi kɛ lɛ fɛɛ la gbi ko nyɔɔŋ, wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ elamɔ kɛ lamɔ lɛ shishi.
Hebrinyo oblanyo ko ni ji blafoiatsɛ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ yɔɔ jɛi. Wɔgba wɔlamɔi lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ shishi, mɔ nɛ lamɔ kɛ eshishi, mɔ nɛ hu lamɔ kɛ eshishi.
Bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ shishi lɛ, eba mli nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ. Akɛ mita migbɛhe ekoŋŋ, ni abolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, asɛŋ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsu ayatsɛ Yosef. Ajie lɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi akpabuŋ lɛ mli oya kɛba; ni eshɛ eyi ni etsake etade, ni eba ebadamɔ Farao hiɛ.
Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Mila lamɔ ko, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ mi shishi atsɔ̃ɔ. Minu ni akɛɛ yɛ ohe akɛ keji onu lamɔ ko lɛ, onyɛɔ shishi otsɔ̃ɔ."
Yosef here Farao nɔ akɛ, "Jeee mi mihewalɛ naa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ni aaahã Farao hetoo ni hi."
Kɛkɛ ni Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Milamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, midamɔ Nilo Faa lɛ naa,
ni tsinayei fɛɛfɛji kpawo ni amɛshwishwii dukudukuu fã kpo kɛjɛ faa lɛ mli, ni amɛbɔi niyeli yɛ faa lɛ naa glãi lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni tsinayei krokomɛi kpawo hu nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛba; amɛnii yɛ mɔbɔ, amɛhe yɛ nyaŋemɔ naakpa ni amɛtrãtrãa loo, bɔ ni minako amɛhenɔ pɛŋ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Tsinai ni etra loo kɛ amɛhe nyaŋemɔ nɛɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ tsinai kpawo ni eshwishwiii lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛye amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛmusu etsɔ̃ɔɔ kwraa akɛ amɛye nɔ ko ejaakɛ amɛkã he amɛyɛ kanyakanya tamɔ tsutsu lɛ nɔŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni mihiɛ tsɛ̃.
Misaa mina yɛ lamɔ mli ni able sɛɛbii kpokploo kpawo ba tso kome yi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, naa able sɛɛbii kpawo ni ekwɛ̃. Able sɛɛbii nɛɛ, nii bɛ yi ni amɛyɛ legelege ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ egbi amɛ kekree.
Abletsei legelegei nɛɛ mii able sɛɛbii kpokplokpoo kpawo lɛ. Migba lamɔ nɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nifeelɔi lɛ, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko naaa he nɔ ko ekɛɛ mi."
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Farao, lamɔi lɛ ekome ni. Nyɔŋmɔ ejie nɔ ni ebaafee kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Farao.
Tsinai kpakpai kpawo lɛ damɔ shi hã afii kpakpai kpawo, ni able sɛɛbii kpakpai kpawo lɛ hu damɔ shi hã afii kpakpai kpawo, lamɔ lɛ lamɔ kome ni.
Tsinai kpawo ni etratra loo ni he yɔɔ nyaŋemɔ ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ ba lɛ, afii kpawo ni; ni abletsei kpawo ni nɔ ko bɛ amɛsɛɛbii lɛ ayi ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ egbi amɛ kekree lɛ damɔ shi hã hɔmɔyeli afii kpawo.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni mikɛɛ Farao akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Farao nɔ ni ebaafee lɛ.
Naa, afii kpawo miiba ni abaana niyenii babaoo yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Shi no sɛɛ lɛ, hɔmɔyeli afii kpawo baaba, ni mɛi ahiɛ aaakpa ŋmãa kpɔtɔɔ ni ba Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni hɔmɔ lɛ baakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Hɔmɔ ni baanyiɛ sɛɛ aba Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ haŋ akai ŋmãa kpɔtɔɔ ni ba lɛ dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ enaa baawa naakpa.
Akɛni akɛ lamɔi srɔtoi enyɔ nɛɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ Farao nɔ koome lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo lɛ baaba mli lɛɛlɛŋ, ni etsɛŋ ni ebaaba mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ hã Farao atao mɔ ko ni hiɛ kã shi, ni ele nii koni ehã lɛ ekwɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Hã Farao ato nɔkwɛlɔi krokomɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni afii kpawo ni niyenii baaba kpɔtɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Farao aŋɔ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niyenii lɛ amlijaa enumɔ mli ekome eto.
Asaŋ hã ni nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ abua niyenii fɛɛ ni aaana yɛ nakai afii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ amli lɛ naa; amɛbua able naa amɛto koni no afee niyenii ni akɛto yɛ maji lɛ amli.
Aŋɔ nakai niyenii lɛ ato sɛɛ ahã shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ hɔmɔ afii kpawo lɛ ni baaba Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ koni hɔmɔ lɛ akakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ahiɛ."
Wiemɔ lɛ sa Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ;
ni Farao kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Ani wɔɔnyɛ wɔna mɔ ko ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ yɔɔ emli tamɔ mɔnɛ?"
No hewɔ lɛ Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ejie enɛ fɛɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ o lɛ, belɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni hiɛ kã shi ni le nii tamɔ bo.
Bo obaaye miwe lɛ nɔ, ni bo toi mimaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ aaabo; sɛ̃i lɛ gbɛfaŋ pɛ mafe bo yɛ."
Farao saa ekɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Naa, miito bo amralo yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Farao jie ewolonaasɔomɔ ga lɛ yɛ ewao, ni ekɛwo Yosef wao; ewula lɛ kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo atadei ni ekɛ shika kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ ŋmɛ ekuɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ehã Yosef ta eshwiili ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli ni abɔ oshe kɛnyiɛ Yosef hiɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkotoa lɛ! Nyɛkotoa lɛ!" No hewɔ lɛ Farao wo Yosef Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ onukpa.
Asaŋ Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Mi Farao, mi miji Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baawo enine nɔ efee nɔ ko aloo efã enane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni jeee bo oŋmɛ gbɛ."
Farao wo Yosef Egipt gbɛi akɛ Zafenat-Panea; ni eŋɔ Asenat, Heliopolis maŋ lɛ mli Osɔfo Potifera lɛ biyoo lɛ ehã lɛ gblã. Ni Yosef fãa gbɛ eyakpaa Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Yosef eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ be ni ebɔi Farao, Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ. Ni Yosef shiɔ Farao koi lɛ shi efãa gbɛ kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Niyenii kpɔtɔɔ afii kpawo lɛ mli lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ ba niyenii babaoo kɛteke nɔ.
Yosef bua niyenii ni ba kpɔtɔɔ yɛ afii kpawo lɛ mli yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa, ni ekɛ niyenii to maji lɛ amli; maŋ fɛɛ maŋ lɛ, ekɛ niyenii ni ana yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmɔjiashi lɛ to jɛi nɔŋŋ.
Yosef bua abole babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni fa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia naa eto kɛyashi beyinɔ ni efɔ̃ɔ able lɛ naa buu ejaakɛ anyɛɛɛ eyikulɛ naa abu dɔŋŋ.
Dani hɔmɔ afii lɛ ba lɛ, Yosef efɔ bihii enyɔ. Ekɛ Asenat, Heliopolis maŋ lɛ Osɔfo Potifera biyoo lɛ, fɔ amɛ.
Yosef wo ekromɔbi lɛ Manase ni ekɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mihiɛ ekpa mihaomɔ lɛ kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ nɔ."
Ewo mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ Efraim ni ekɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã miwo shwiei yɛ mimanehulu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Agbɛnɛ niyenii kpɔtɔɔ afii kpawo ni ba yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ sɛɛ bafo; ni hɔmɔyeli afii kpawo lɛ naa je,
tamɔ bɔ ni Yosef ekɛɛ lɛ. Hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ krokomɛi fɛɛ nɔ; shi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he lɛ niyenii yɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni hɔmɔ ba Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ fo tsɛ Farao ni ehã amɛ niyenii. Farao kɛɛ Egiptbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa Yosef ŋɔɔ, ni nɔ ni eeekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea."
No hewɔ lɛ be ni hɔmɔ lɛ egbɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef gble ŋmãatoohei lɛ fɛɛ naa, ni ehɔ̃ɔ able ehã Egiptbii lɛ ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa naakpa yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ mɛi jɛ majimaji fɛɛ nɔ kɛba Egipt koni amɛbahe able yɛ Yosef ŋɔɔ yɛ Egipt ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa naakpa yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
42: Be ni Yakob na le akɛ able Egipt lɛ, ekɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛkwɛkwɛɔ nyɛhiɛ gãagãa nɛkɛ?"
Etee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, minu akɛ able yɛ Egipt; nyɛyaa jɛi ni nyɛyahea able nyɛbahãa wɔ koni wɔyi ana wala ni wɔkagboi."
No hewɔ lɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛi ni ji etsɛbii nyɔŋma lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Egipt koni amɛyahe able.
Shi Yakob hãaa Benyamin, Yosef nyɛbi etsɛbi lɛ, kɛ etsɛbii krokomɛi lɛ aya, ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, "Koni aleee nɔ oshrã ko akayashrã lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob bii lɛ yɛ mɛi ni ba ablehemɔ lɛ ateŋ; ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ eba Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu.
Yosef ji lumɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni lɛ ehɔ̃ɔ able ehãa mɛi fɛɛ. Enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba, ni amɛbakoto lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.
Yosef na enyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni eyoo amɛ; shi ekɛ amɛ ye tamɔ gbɔi, ni etutu ehiɛ ewo amɛ. Ebi amɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ nyɛjɛ?" Amɛto he akɛ, "Wɔjɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔba niyeniihemɔ."
Yosef yoo enyɛmimɛi lɛ, shi amɛ lɛ, amɛyooo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kai lamɔi ni ela yɛ amɛhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Sralɔi ji nyɛ; nyɛba ni nyɛbakwɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ yayaiaŋ."
Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, dabi, shi moŋ niyenii hemɔ otsuji ba.
Nuu kome bii ji wɔ fɛɛ; anɔkwafoi ji wɔ; jeee sralɔi ji otsuji."
Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Dabi, nyɛba nyɛbaakwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yayaiaŋ."
Amɛto he akɛ, "Wɔ otsuji lɛ, nyɛmimɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ji wɔ, nuu kome bii ji wɔ kɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; wɔteŋ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ yɛ wɔtsɛ ŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ; ni mɔ kome bɛ jeŋ."
Shi Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ: Sralɔi ji nyɛ.
Nɔ ni akɛaana nyɛnɔkwale nɛ. Mina Farao akɛ nyɛjeŋ biɛ nyɛyaŋ, ja nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ ebashɛ biɛ dã.
Nyɛtsua nyɛteŋ mɔ kome ni eyaŋɔa nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ kɛbaa be mli ni nyɛ lɛ awo nyɛ kpabuŋ lɛ, koni akɛkpa nyɛ wiemɔi lɛ shi akɛ anɔkwafoi ji nyɛ lo; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mina Farao akɛ sralɔi ji nyɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ewo amɛ fɛɛ tsuŋ gbii etɛ̃.
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmiɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfea nɔ ni mibakɛɛ nɛɛ, koni nyɛyi ana wala, shi mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ji mi.
Kɛ anɔkwafoi ji nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa atsīa nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome naa yɛ kpabuŋ lɛ mli, koni nyɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nyɛŋɔ able kɛya yɛ hɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛshīai lɛ hewɔ,
ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ. No akɛaana akɛ nyɛwiemɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, koni nyɛkagboi." Amɛfee nakai.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ, wɔyeɔ fɔ yɛ wɔnyɛmi lɛ hewɔ akɛni wɔna bɔ ni esusuma hao ni ekpa wɔ fai aahuu ni wɔbooo toi lɛ. No hewɔ ni nɛkɛ haomɔ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ."
Ruben here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Ani mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛkafea gbekɛ lɛ esha ko, ni nyɛbooo toi? No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ ela shi abiɔ nɛɛ!"
Shi amɛleee akɛ Yosef enu nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ shishi ejaakɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni jieɔ enaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef tsɔ̃ ehe kɛje amɛmasɛi ni eyafo. Eku esɛɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛ amɛbawie. Ejie Simeon yɛ amɛteŋ ni efi lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef fã akɛ awo amɛkotokui lɛ amli able obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika aku sɛɛ awo ekotoku mli ekoŋŋ. Efã hu akɛ ahã amɛ gbɛ nɔ niyenii. Ni afee nakai ahã amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛjatsui lɛ tre amɛtejii lɛ, ni amɛyi gbɛ.
Be ni amɛshɛ shitoohe ko ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome fɛne ekotoku naa ni ebaahã eteji niyenii lɛ, ena eshika lɛ kã able lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku lɛ mli,
ni ekɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Akpale mishika lɛ ahã mi, ni naa, no po yɔɔ mikotoku lɛ mli nɛɛ!" Enɛ hã amɛtsui fã kɛ hekpokpomɔ ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, "Mɛni ji enɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee wɔ nɛɛ?"
Be ni amɛbashɛ amɛtsɛ Yakob ŋɔɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛgba lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ba amɛnɔ lɛ akɛ,
"Nuu lɛ ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ lɛ hãhã ehiɛ ewo wɔ, ni ebu wɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ sralɔi.
Shi wɔkɛɛ lɛ akɛ 'Anɔkwafoi ji wɔ; jeee sralɔi ji wɔ.
Nyɛmimɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ji wɔ, nuu kome musuŋ bii ji wɔ, mɔ kome bɛ jeŋ, ni gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ yɛ wɔtsɛ ŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!'
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni mikɛbaana akɛ anɔkwafoi ji nyɛ nɛ: nyɛshīa nyɛteŋ mɔ kome nyɛhãa mi ni nyɛŋɔa able yɛ hɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛshīai amli lɛ hewɔ kɛyaa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ mibana akɛ jeee sralɔi ji nyɛ shi moŋ anɔkwafoi, koni majie nyɛnyɛmi lɛ mahã nyɛ ni nyɛye jra yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.'"
Shi be ni amɛjie amɛkotokui lɛ amli nii lɛ, naa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika ni afi kã ekotoku mli. Be ni amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ fɛɛ na shika ni afimɔfimɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei.
Ni amɛtsɛ Yakob kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkpakpaa mibii yɛ mihe, Yosef bɛ, ni Simeon bɛ, ni nyɛbaaŋɔ Benyamin hu kɛya. Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ haomɔ eji kɛhã mi."
Kɛkɛ ni Ruben kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Kɛ mikɛ Benyamin ekuuu sɛɛ ebahãaa o lɛ, no lɛ gbee mibihii enyɔ lɛ; bo lɛ tuu lɛ owo midɛŋ, ni mikɛ lɛ baaku sɛɛ abahã o ekoŋŋ."

Shi Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibi lɛ kɛ nyɛ eyaŋ ejaakɛ enyɛmi lɛ egbo, ni lɛ ekome pɛ eshwɛ; kɛji oshra ko yashra lɛ yɛ gbɛ ni nyɛyaanyiɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ he ni miyi eyɛ kɛshɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbaahã magbo kɛ awerɛhoo sɔŋŋ."
43: Hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa lolo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛye amɛble ni amɛkɛjɛ Egipt kɛba lɛ etã lɛ, amɛtsɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ekoŋŋ, nyɛyahea niyenii fioo nyɛbahãa wɔ."
Shi Yuda kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuu lɛ gba mli kpoo ekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ akɛ ja nyɛnyɛmi lɛ fata nyɛhe kɛba dã.'
Kɛji obaahã wɔnyɛmi lɛ afata wɔhe kɛya lɛ, no lɛ wɔbaaya wɔyahe niyenii lɛ wɔbahã bo;
Shi kɛji ohaŋ eya lɛ, no lɛ wɔyaŋ, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ akɛ ja nyɛnyɛmi lɛ fata nyɛhe kɛba dã.'"
Ni Yakob kɛɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛfee mi efɔŋ nɛkɛ akɛ nyɛtsitã nyɛkɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ nyɛyɛ nyɛmi kroko hu lɛ?"

Amɛto he akɛ, "Nuu lɛ bi wɔ kɛ wɔweku he sane fitsofitso akɛ, 'Ani nyɛtsɛ yɛ jeŋ lolo? Ani nyɛyɛ nyɛminuu kroko hu?' Ni wɔha lɛ nɛkɛ sanebimɔi nɛɛ ahetoo. Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ wɔle akɛ eeekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi lɛ abaa' lɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ etsɛ Yakob akɛ, "Okɛ gbekɛ lɛ awo midɛŋ ni wɔyi mli kɛya, koni wɔ kɛ bo kɛ wɔbii bibii lɛ ayi ana wala, ni wɔka gboi.
Mikɛ miwala baato awaba yɛ enajiaŋ; bi eshi yɛ midɛŋ. Kɛji mikɛ lɛ ekuuu sɛɛ ebahãaa bo ni ona lɛ kɛ ohiŋmɛi lɛ, no lɛ mi, maye eyi sɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ,
ejaakɛ kɛjeee shi wɔshashao lɛ kulɛ benɛ wɔtee Egipt wɔba shii enyɔ momo."

Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɛ Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni nyɛbaafee nɛ: nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nibii kpakpai lɛ eko awoa nyɛjatsui amli koni nyɛkɛyakea nuu lɛ: Gbonyowoo tsofã fioo, wo fioo, tso mli amã fioo, tsofãkɛŋma, kɛ ohɛ ni jeɔ ŋma kɛ amitsrɔbi kɛ ŋmɛ.
Asaŋ shika ni nyɛkɛyaahe nii lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nakai toi enyɔ, ejaakɛ shika lɛ ni akɛwo nyɛkotokui amli lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛkɛku sɛɛ kɛya, benɛ ekolɛ hiɛ ni je nɔ.
Nyɛŋɔa nyɛnyɛmi lɛ hu, ni nyɛyia mli nyɛyaa nuu lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Aba mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ahã nuu lɛ musuŋ atsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, koni eŋmɛɛ nyɛnyɛmi mɔ kome lɛ kɛ Benyamin he ehã nyɛ. Shi mi lɛ, kɛji aaakpakpaa mibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ mihe jiŋŋ, efeee nɔ ko."
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob bii lɛ ŋɔ nikee nii lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ shika falɛ toi enyɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ, kɛ Benyamin; ni amɛŋɔshwie nɔ kɛtee Egipt, ni amɛyashɛ Yosef hiɛ.
Be ni Yosef na Benyamin fata amɛhe lɛ, ekɛɛ ewe lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ aya shīa, ni omɔ kooloo okɛfee niyenii oto, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ mi baaye nii shwane nɛɛ."
Nuu lɛ fee bɔ ni Yosef kɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ tee shīa lɛ.

Shi amɛshe gbeyei yɛ Yosef shīa lɛ ni akɛ amɛ tee lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Shika lɛ ni aku sɛɛ akɛwo wɔkotokui lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ be ni wɔba lɛ hewɔ akɛ wɔ ba biɛ nɛɛ, koni etao sane eshi wɔ koni ekɛ wɔ aye koni eŋɔ wɔ efee enyɔji ni eshɔ̃ wɔtejii lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ Yosef we lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wie yɛ shīa lɛ shinaa lɛ shi,
amɛkɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, wɔnuŋtsɔ, klɛŋklɛŋ be ni wɔbahe niyenii lɛ,
ni wɔyashɛ shitoohe ko ni wɔfɛne wɔkotokui lɛ anaa lɛ, naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika kã able lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku lɛ mli, wɔshika lɛ yɛ bɔ ni aŋmɛ lɛ naa pɛpɛɛpɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ hiɛ wɔdɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ.
Ni wɔkɛ shika kroko hu ehiɛ wɔdɛ kɛba kɛhã niyenii hemɔ. Wɔleee mɔ ni kɛ wɔshika lɛ wo wokotokui lɛ amli."

Nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛnaa tsui; nyɛkashea gbeyei. Eeefee akɛ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã nyɛto ahuu yɛ nyɛkotokui lɛ amli ejaakɛ nyɛshika lɛ minine shɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni ejie Simeon ebahã amɛ."
Be ni sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ kɛ hii lɛ ba Yosef we lɛ, ehã amɛ nu ni amɛfɔ amɛnaji ahe; ni ehã amɛtejii lɛ niyenii.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob bihii lɛ fee nikee nii ni amɛhiɛ lɛ klalo amɛto Yosef shīabaa shwame lɛ ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ amɛ kɛ lɛ baaye nii yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Yosef ba shīa lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛnikee nii ni amɛhiɛ lɛ bahã lɛ ni amɛkoto lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef bi amɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛtsɛ nuumo lɛ ni nyɛtsi etã lɛ eyɛ jeŋ lolo? Ani eyɛ jogbaŋŋ lo?"
Amɛto he amɛkɛɛ, "Otsulɔ, wɔtsɛ lɛ, eyɛ jeŋ lolo, ni eyɛ jogbaŋŋ." Kɛkɛ ni amɛho amɛkula shi yɛ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef wo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ena enyɛmi Benyamin, enyɛ musuŋbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Ani nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ ni nyɛtsi etã nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, lɛ nɛ lo?" Ni Yosef kɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ajɔɔ bo, mibi!"
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef he fee oya koni eje kpo, ejaakɛ emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni eetao he ko eyafo yɛ. No hewɔ lɛ ebote esɛɛtsu lɛ mli, ni eyafo yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni efɔ ehiɛ ni eje kpo. Emia ehiɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkɛ niyenii abamamɔa shi!"

Akɛ enɔ eyimuu bama shi, ni ahã hii lɛ hu anɔ yimuuyimuu; ni ahã Egiptbii lɛ hu ni kɛ Yosef yeɔ nii lɛ anɔ yimuuyimuu; ejaakɛ Egiptbii kɛ Hebribii kaaa nine yɛ kã kome mli yeee nii; ejaakɛ Egiptbii mihii no.
Be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ batra ehiɛ, kromɔbi lɛ yɛ enukpa gbɛhe, ni gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ hu yɛ egbekɛ gbɛhe lɛ, amɛkwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ naakpɛɛ.

Ajie niyenii kɛjɛ niyenii ni ma Yosef okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli ahã enyɛmimɛi lɛ; shi Benyamin nɔ lɛ fa fe amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ lɛ toi enumɔ. Amɛkɛ Yosef ye nii, ni amɛkɛ lɛ nu nii, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ na miishɛɛ.
44: Yosef fá eshīa lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, "Wo hii lɛ akotokui amli niyenii obɔ̃bɔ̃, bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ amɛtre, ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika afɔ̃ eble lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku mli,
ni okɛ mipkulu ni ji mijwiɛtɛi kpulu lɛ afata able shika lɛ he okɛfɔ̃ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ able lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku lɛ mli." Sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ fee bɔ ni Yosef kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Leebi be ni hiɛ gble pɛ ni awo Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ agbɛ kɛ amɛtejii lɛ.

Be ni amɛshi maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛshɛko shɔŋŋ he ko kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ eshīa lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi ni otiu gbɔmɛi lɛ ni kɛ oyanina amɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ 'Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ efɔŋ eto ekpakpa najiaŋ nɛɛ? Mɛɛba nyɛju minuŋtsɔ jwiɛtɛi kpulu lɛ?
No minuŋtsɔ kɛnuɔ dãa, ni asaŋ no ekɛklaa. Nyɛfee efɔŋ naakpa akɛ nyɛfee enɛ.'"
Be ni eyanina amɛ lɛ, eti nɛkɛ wiemɔi ni Yosef wie nɛɛ mli ehã amɛ.
Amɛhã hetoo akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ minuŋtsɔ wieɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ? Kpaoo, otsuji nyɛŋ nɛkɛ nɔ ko afee.
Shika lɛ ni wɔna jwere wɔble lɛ nɔ yɛ wɔkotokui lɛ amli lɛ, bɛ wɔkɛku sɛɛ kɛjɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ wɔkɛba hã bo; te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni wɔɔju jwiɛtɛi loo shika yɛ onuŋtsɔ lɛ shīa mli hu?
Otsuji nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ dɛŋ ni aaana yɛ lɛ, gbo eeegbo; ni wɔ hu wɔtsɔ̃mɔ minuŋtsɔ nyɔji."
Ni sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Afee bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ lɛ; mɔ dɛŋ ni aaana yɛ lɛ eeetsɔ̃ minyɔŋ, shi nyɛ mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ sɔ̃ ko wulaŋ nyɛyi."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe fee oya, ni amɛtotoo amɛjatsui lɛ amɛmamɔ shi, ni amɛfɛnefɛnee amɛkotokui lɛ anaa.
Yosef sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ bɔi kpulu lɛ taomɔ kɛjɛ onukpa lɛ nɔ, ni eyagbe naa yɛ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ; ni eyana kpulu lɛ yɛ Benyamin kotoku lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ dɔlɛ gblagblaa amɛhe atadei; ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo ejatsu etre eteji, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni Yuda kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ bashɛ Yosef shīa lɛ, Yosef yɛ jɛi lolo; ni amɛho amɛgbeegbee shikpɔŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni pam nyɛfee nɛɛ? Ani nyɛleee akɛ gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ mi lɛ, ele klamɔ̃ lo?"

Yuda here nɔ akɛ, "Mɛni wɔbaakɛɛ minuŋtsɔ? Mɛɛ wiemɔ kwraa yɔɔ wɔnaa? Aloo te wɔbaajie wɔnaa wɔhã tɛŋŋ? Nyɔŋmɔ ena otsuji anɔsha lɛ; naa, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ minuŋtsɔ nyɔji, wɔ kɛ mɔ dɛŋ ni ana kpulu lɛ yɛ lɛ fɛɛ."
Shi Yosef kɛɛ akɛ, "Kpaoo! Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ɔfɔ̃; mɔ dɛŋ ni ana kpulu lɛ yɛ lɛ, lɛ kɛkɛ eeetsɔ minyɔŋ; shi nyɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, nyɛyaa nyɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli."
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda tsi ebɛŋkɛ Yosef ni ekɛɛ, "Ofai nɛ, minuŋtsɔ, hã otsulɔ awie nɔ kome pɛ, ni minuŋtsɔ abo mi toi ni kaahã omli wo otsulɔ la ejaakɛ otamɔ Farao diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ.
Minuŋtsɔ bi etsuji akɛ, 'Ani nyɛyɛ tsɛ loo nyɛminuu ko?'
Ni wɔkɛɛ minuŋtsɔ akɛ, 'Wɔyɛ tsɛ nuumo kɛ nyɛminuu gbekɛ ni ji wɔtsɛ nakutsoŋbi. Gbekɛ nɛɛ enyɛbi lɛ egbo; ni lɛ ji enyɛbi koome ni eshwɛ; ni etsɛ sumɔɔ lɛ'
Kɛkɛ ni okɛɛ otsuji akɛ, 'Nyɛyaŋɔa lɛ kɛbaa koni mana lɛ kɛ mihiŋmɛi.'
Ni wɔkɛɛ minuŋtsɔ akɛ, 'Gbekɛ lɛ nyɛŋ etsɛ eshi, ejaakɛ kɛji eshi etsɛ lɛ, etsɛ baagbo.'
Kɛkɛ ni okɛɛ otsuji akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ nɛɛ baaa lɛ, nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ dɔŋŋ.'
"Be ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔtee mitsɛ, otsulɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, wɔgba lɛ wiemɔi ni minuŋtsɔ wie lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni wɔtsɛ kɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛyaa ekoŋŋ ni nyɛyahea niyenii fioo ko nyɛbahãa wɔ' lɛ, wɔkɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
'Wɔnyɛŋ wɔya, shi kɛji wɔnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ fata wɔhe lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔtee; shi wɔnyɛŋ nuu lɛ hiɛ wɔna akɛ ja wɔnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ fata wɔhe dã.'
Kɛkɛ ni mitsɛ, otsulɔ lɛ, kɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ miŋa Rahel, lɛ ekɛ mi fɔ bihii enyɔ;
mɔ kome eshi mi ni mikɛɛ akɛ, tserɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ kooloo ko etserɛ emli lɛ, ni minako lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Kɛji nyɛŋɔ mɔ nɛ hu yɛ mihe kɛtee ni oshrã ko yashrã lɛ lɛ, no lɛ he ni migbɔ kɛshɛ kɛ miyiteŋ waŋ nɛɛ, nyɛbaahã magbo kɛ awerɛhoo.'
"No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, kɛji mitee mitsɛ otsulɔ ŋɔɔ, ni gbekɛ lɛ fataaa wɔhe lɛ, akɛni ewala ji gbekɛ lɛ wala lɛ,
kɛ ena akɛ gbekɛ lɛ bɛ wɔteŋ lɛ, eeetwa shi egbo; ni bɔ ni otsulɔ egbɔ kɛ eyiteŋ waŋ nɛɛ, otsuji aaahã egbo kɛ awerɛhoo.
Ejaakɛ otsulɔ kɛ ewala to mitsɛ awaba yɛ gbekɛ lɛ najiaŋ akɛ, 'Kɛji mikɛ gbekɛ lɛ ekuuu sɛɛ ebahãaa bo lɛ, no lɛ no sɔ̃ lɛ atre mi yɛ mitsɛ hiɛ miwala bei abɔ fɛɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, ofai nɛ, hã otsulɔ ahi biɛ akɛ minuŋtsɔ nyɔŋ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ najiaŋ koni ohã gbekɛ lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aku sɛɛ aya.
Ejaakɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ maku misɛɛ maya mitsɛ ŋɔɔ kɛji gbekɛ lɛ fataaa mihe hu? Nɔ ni baafee mitsɛ lɛ minyɛŋ makwɛ kɛ mihiŋmɛi."
45: Agbɛnɛ Yosef nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ emia dɔŋŋ yɛ mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, kɛkɛ ni efã ekɛɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aje kpo ashi mi." No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ emasɛi be ni ejie ehe shi etsɔ̃ɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ejwa yaafo bɔ ni Egiptbii lɛ kɛ Farao we lɛ mli bii lɛ tete nu he.
Ekɛɛ enyimimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Mi Yosef nɛ. Ani mitsɛ yɛ jeŋ lolo?" Shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ hetoo ahã ejaakɛ amɛjijaa yɛ ehiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa mi koo!" Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ lɛ. Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miji nyɛnyɛmi Yosef mɔ ni nyɛhɔɔ kɛba Egipt lɛ.
Amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛkahãa edɔa nyɛ ni nyɛmli akawowoa nyɛhe la hu yɛ hɔɔmɔ ni nyɛhɔɔ mi kɛba biɛ lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ni tsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛba biɛ koni atsɔ̃ minɔ ahere mɛi ayiwala.
Ejaakɛ afii enyɔ nɛ ni bɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eshwɛ afii enumɔ hu lolo ni aduŋ nii ni akpãŋ nii hu.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ koni ahã nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ ashwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni ahere nyɛteŋ mɛi babaoo ayiwala aha nyɛ.
Belɛ, jeee nyɛ nyɛhã mibaje biɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ ni; ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehã mitsɔ̃ tamɔ nɔ ni Farao tsɛ ji mi, ni ewo mi ewe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ nuŋtsɔ kɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔyelɔ.
Nyɛhe afea oya ni nyɛyaa mitsɛ ŋɔɔ nyɛyakɛa lɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni obi Yosef kɛɛ nɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ ewo mi Egipt fɛɛ nɔ nuŋtsɔ, ba miŋɔɔ; kaatsɛ.
Ba ni obahi Goshen kpokpai anɔ yɛ Egipt, bɔ ni afee ni abɛŋkɛ mi, bo kɛ obii kɛ onabii kɛ otoi kɛ otsinai kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ɔyɔɔ;
ni malɛ o yɛ jɛi; ejakɛ eshwɛ hɔmɔ afii lɛ enumɔ lolo ni baaba; koni bo, kɛ owebii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ o yɔɔ lɛ akabaye ohia.'
"Ni naa, nyɛhiɛ tua, ni minyɛmi Benyamin hu hiɛ tua akɛ mi, Yosef diɛŋtsɛ mi kɛ nyɛ wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɛyagbaa mitsɛ bɔ ni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ Egipt lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛna lɛ. Nyɛhe afea oya koni nyɛkɛ mitsɛ abaa biɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef fua enyɛmi Benyamin ni ejwa yaafo, ni Benyamin hu fua lɛ ni lɛ hu ejwa yaafo.
Yosef saa eshwɔshwɔɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ naa ni efo. No sɛɛ lɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔi wiemɔ.
Be ni anu sane nɛɛ he yɛ Farao we lɛ akɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ eba lɛ, eŋɔɔ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ anaa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ onyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ nɔ ni misumɔɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Nyɛfimɔa jatsui nyɛtrea nyɛtejii lɛ, ni nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ
ni nyɛyaŋɔa nyɛtsɛ kɛ nyɛbii kɛ nyɛhɔi kɛbaa. Mibahã nyɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhi nɔ ni nyɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ.
Asaŋ ofã amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛfea enɛ; nyɛŋɔa shwiilii kɛjɛa Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa yɛ nyɛbii kɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ ahewɔ koni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsɛ aba.
Nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe yɛ nyɛnibii ni nyɛbaashi hewɔ ejaakɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ nibii kpakpai fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnɔ ni.'"
Yakob bihii lɛ fee nakai; ni Yosef hã amɛ shwiilii yɛ Farao fãmɔ lɛ naa, ni ehã amɛ gbɛ nɔ niyenii hu.
Asaŋ ehã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hetsakemɔ atade; shi Benyamin lɛ, ehã lɛ shika jwɛitɛi kukuji ohai etɛ̃ kɛ hetsakemɔ atadei srɔtoi enumɔ.
Nibii ni ekɛ maje etsɛ Ataa lɛ nɛ: tejii nyɔŋma ni tre Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii kpakpai, kɛ tejiyei nyɔŋma ni tre able kɛ aboloo ni etsɛ baaye yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ewo enyɛmimɛi lɛ agbɛ. Be ni amɛyiɔ mli lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkayabea yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ."
Ni amɛkashwie nɔ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛba amɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛbakɛɛ amɛtsɛ akɛ, "Ataa, Yosef yɛ jeŋ lolo, ni lɛ eyeɔ lumɔ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Yakob yiŋ fee lɛ kɔshikɔshi ejaakɛ eheee amɛ eyeee."
Shi be ni amɛgba lɛ wiemɔ ni Yosef kɛ amɛ wie lɛ fɛɛ ni ena shwiilii ni Yosef hã koni akɛbaŋɔ lɛ kɛba lɛ, amɛtsɛ Yakob he tse lɛ,
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Omanye sane! Mibi Yosef yɛ jeŋ lolo! Matee mayana ehiɛ dani magbo!"
46: No hewɔ lɛ Yakob fã kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ, ni eba Beersheba. Eshã afɔlei ehã etsɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob wie yɛ ninaa mli nyɔɔŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Yakob, Yakob!" Ni Yakob here nɔ akɛ, "Naa mi."
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miji Yehowa, otsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Kaashe Egipt yaa gbeyei ejaakɛ mahã oshwiei atsɔ̃ jeŋmaŋ kpeteŋkple yɛ jɛi.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mi kɛ amɛ aaatee Egipt, ni mi kɛ oshwiei aaasa aba ekoŋŋ; ni ooogbo ofɔ̃ Yosef tsitsiŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yekob kɛshwie nɔ kɛjɛ Beersheba. Ebihii lɛ ŋɔ lɛ Yakob lɛ, kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ tra shwiilii lɛ ni Farao hã akɛ akɛbaŋɔ lɛ Yakob lɛ amli.
Asaŋ amɛŋɔ amɛkooloi kɛ amɛnibii ni amɛna yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛba Egipt, Yakob kɛ eshwiei lɛ fɛɛ;
ebihii kɛ ebihii lɛ ebihii kɛ ebiyei kɛ ebihii lɛ abiyei, eshwiei fɛɛ ekɛba Egipt lɛ.
Yakob shwiei ni ba Egipt lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Yakob kɛ ebii lɛ: Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ,
ebihii ji Harnok kɛ Pallu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi.
Simeon bihii nɛ: Yemeul kɛ Yamin kɛ Ohad kɛ Yakin kɛ Zohar kɛ Shaul ni ji Kanaanyoo lɛ bi lɛ.
Levi bihii nɛ: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.
Yuda bihii nɛ: Er kɛ Onan kɛ Shela kɛ Perez kɛ Zera, shi Er kɛ Onan gboi yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni Perez bihii ji Hezron kɛ Hamul.
Isakar bihii nɛ: Tola kɛ Pau kɛ Yashub kɛ Shimron.
Zebulon bihii nɛ: Sered kɛ Elon kɛ Yakleel.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Lea bihii kɛ amɛnyɛmiyoo Dina ni ekɛ Yakob fɔ yɛ Mesopotamia lɛ. Yakob bii ni ekɛ Lea fɔ fɛɛ feɔ gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai etɔ̃ kɛ etɛ.
Gad bihii nɛ: Zefon kɛ Hagi kɛ Shuni kɛ Ezbon kɛ Eri kɛ Arodi kɛ Areli.
Asher bihii nɛ: Imna kɛ Ishvah kɛ Ishvi kɛ Beria kɛ amɛnyɛmiyoo Sera. Beria bihii ji Heber kɛ Malkiel.
Shwiei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa nɛɛ ji bii ni Yakob kɛ Zilpa, nyɔ̃ŋyoo lɛ ni Laban kɛhã ebiyoo Lea lɛ fɔ.
Yakob ŋa Rahel bihii ji Yosef kɛ Benyamin.
Yosef hu fɔ bii yɛ Egipt. Ekɛ Osɔfo Potifera biyoo Asenat lɛ fɔ Manase kɛ Efraim.
Benyamin hu bii ji Bela kɛ Beker kɛ Ashbel kɛ Gera kɛ Naaman kɛ Ehi kɛ Rosh kɛ Mupim kɛ Hupim kɛ Ardi.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Rahel kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛyibɔ ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Dan bi nɛ: Hushim.
Naftali bii ji Yazeel kɛ Guni kɛ Yezer kɛ Shillem.
Shwiei kpawo ni Yakob kɛ Bilha, nyɔ̃ŋyoo lɛ ni Laban kɛhã ebi Rahel lɛ wo nɛ.
Yakob shwiei diɛŋtsɛ ni ekɛba Egipt lɛ ayibɔ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa, esro ebihii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ.
Yosef bihii ni afɔ yɛ Egipt lɛ ji bihii enyɔ. Belɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni jɛ Yakob we lɛ ni amɛba Egipt lɛ ayibɔ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Agbɛnɛ Yakob tsu Yuda kɛtsɔ ehiɛ kɛtee Yosef ŋɔɔ koni Yosef atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ kɛya Goshen; ni amɛba Goshen.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef saa eshwiili ni eyiŋ etee koni eyakpee etsɛ Yakob yɛ Goshen; ni be ni Yosef na etsɛ lɛ, eloo lɛ atuu ni efo eshwie ekuɛ nɔ aahuu.
Israel kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ ni mina ohiɛ akɛ oyɛ jeŋ lolo nɛɛ, kɛ migbo tete po miyajɔɔ mihe."
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ akɛ, "Miiya Farao ŋɔɔ mayagba lɛ akɛ, 'Minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ ni yɔɔ Kanaan lɛ eba miŋɔɔ.
Gbɔmɛi lɛ tookwɛlɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛlɛɔ kooloi. Amɛkɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ amɛnii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ eba.'
Yosef kɛɛ, 'Kɛ Farao aaabatsɛ nyɛ ni eeebi nyɛ akɛ, Mɛni ji nyɛnitsumɔ? Lɛ'
nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, 'Otsuji lɛɔ kooloi kɛjɛ wɔblahiaŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ koni ehã nyɛhi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ Egiptbii nyaŋeɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji koolookwɛlɔ.'"
47: No hewɔ lɛ Yosef yiŋ etee eyakɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Mitsɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ejɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba. Amrɔ nɛɛ amɛyɛ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef hala enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enumɔ ni ekɛ amɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ Farao.
Farao bi Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ji nyɛnitsumɔ?" Amɛhã Farao hetoo akɛ, "Otsuji lɛ koolookwɛlɔi ji amɛ, wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ."

Ni asaŋ amɛkɛɛ Farao akɛ, "Wɔba gbɔtoo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ejaakɛ otsuji kooloi lɛ naaa nii amɛye yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ wɔmiikpa o fai ni ohã otsuji ahi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Otsɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ eba oŋɔɔ.
Naa, Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ, hã otsɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ahi shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ. Ni kɛ ole amɛteŋ mɛi ni he esa yɛ koolookwɛmɔ mli lɛ, tuu mitsinai lɛ akwɛmɔ owo amɛdɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛ etsɛ Yakob ba ni ekɛ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ Farao, ni Yakob jɔɔ Farao.
Agbɛnɛ Farao bi Yakob akɛ "Afii enyiɛ oye?"

Ni Yakob hã hetoo akɛ, "Afii abɔ ni miye yɛ jeŋ shihilɛ mli ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ. Mifii lɛ faaa ko moŋ nɛ, shi hejramɔ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ amɛmli. Eshɛɛɛ wala afii babaoo ni mitsɛmɛi lɛ ye yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob jɔɔ Farao ni eje Farao hiɛ etee.
Ni Yosef hã etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ shihilɛhe. Ehã amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fɛɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ebɛŋkɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Rameses lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Farao efã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ.
Yosef hã etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ niyenii yɛ amɛbii ayibɔ naa.
Agbɛnɛ niyenii bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa ewa naakpa, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ Egipt kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ miihe amɛgboi kɛ hɔmɔ.
Ni Yosef bua shika ni mɛi ni jɛ Egipt kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛbahe able lɛ naa. Ni Yosef kɛ shika nɛɛ ba Farao we lɛ mli.
Ni be ni shika fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Egipt kɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tã lɛ, Egiptbii lɛ fɛɛ ba Yosef ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã wɔ nii wɔye! Shi mɛɛ hewɔ ni oookwɛ ni wɔɔgboi yɛ wɔshika ni etã hewɔ."
Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ni nyɛshika etã nɛɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛkooloi ahãa mi ni mahã nyɛ niyenii yɛ nyɛkooloi lɛ anaa."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛ amɛkooloi lɛ bahã Yosef ni ehã amɛ niyenii eŋɔ tsake okpɔŋɔi kɛ too kui kɛ tsina kui kɛ tejii. Ni ehã amɛ niyenii akɛhe amɛkooloi fɛɛ nakai afi lɛ.

Be ni nakai afi lɛ ho lɛ, amɛba Yosef ŋɔɔ yɛ afi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko atee wɔ-nuŋtsɔ, ni ji akɛ, Wɔshika kɛ wɔkooloo kui lɛ fɛɛ etã; wɔkɛ fɛɛ ebahã wɔnuŋtsɔ; eshwɛko nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja wɔgbɔmɔtsei ni onaa nɛɛ kɛ wɔshikpɔji pɛ.

Mɛɛ hewɔ oookwɛ ni wɔgboi ni wɔshikpɔji lɛ hu aje wɔdɛŋ lɛ? ŋɔɔ niyenii ohe wɔ kɛ wɔshikpɔji lɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ mɔ Farao nyɔji koni wɔshikpɔji lɛ hu atsɔ̃ enɔ. Hã wɔ dumɔwui koni wɔyi ana wala ni wɔkagboi ni wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ batsɔ amaŋfɔ̃."
No hewɔ lɛ Yosef he Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ehã Farao ejaakɛ Egiptnyo fɛɛ Egiptnyo hɔ̃ɔ eshikpɔŋ yɛ hɔmɔ waa ni yeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ Farao nɔ̃;
ni gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ enyɔji yɛ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he.
Osɔfoi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ kɛkɛ ni eheee ejaakɛ amɛyɛ sisɛ̃ ni ato ni Farao hãa amɛ, ni sisɛ̃ nɛɛ amɛyeɔ; no hewɔ lɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ mihe nyɛ kɛ nyɛshikpɔji lɛ mihã Farao. Agbɛnɛ, naa dumɔwui! Nyɛdua yɛ nyɛŋmɔji lɛ amli.
Kɛ shɛ nikpamɔbe lɛ, nyɛbaaja nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli enumɔ; Farao baaŋɔ ekome; ni nyɛbaaŋɔ ejwɛ lɛ. No eko nyɛbaadu, ni no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛbaaye, no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛwebii baaye."
Maŋbii lɛ here Yosef nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Ohere wɔyiwala! Kɛ ooosumɔ lɛ, hã wɔtsɔmɔ Farao nyɔji."
No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef ŋɔ enɛ efee akpɔ efɔ̃ shi yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ aja ŋmɔshinii mli enumɔ ni Farao aŋɔ ekome. Osɔfoi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔɔ Farao nɔ.
Bɔ ni fee ni Israelbii lɛ hi shi yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Goshen lɛ nɛ. Israelbii nɛɛ nanaa shikpɔji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfɔfɔɔ ni amɛshwere babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Yakob hi shi yɛ Egipt afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo. No hewɔ lɛ afii abɔ ni Yakob ye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpawo.
Be ni Yakob gbele be eshɛ etã lɛ, etsɛ ebi Yosef ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ oyɛ mihe tsui jurɔ lɛ, okɛ onine abahɔ milagbaateŋ ni owo mi shi akɛ obaaye mi anɔkwa. Kaafu mi yɛ Egipt.
Shi moŋ kɛji migbo lɛ, wo mi kɛje Egipt ni oyafu mi yɛ mitsɛmɛi lɛ afuuhe lɛ." Ni Yosef here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mafee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ."
Shi Yakob kɛɛ, "Kã mi kitã!" No hewɔ lɛ Yosef kã lɛ kitã. Kɛkɛ ni Israel ma eyi shi yɛ esaatso lɛ yitsogbɛ ni esɔle.
48: Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ abakɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Naa, otsɛ he miiye." No hewɔ lɛ Yosef ŋɔ ebihii enyɔ ni ji Manase kɛ Efraim efata ehe kɛtee.
Ayakɛɛ Yakob akɛ, "Obi Yosef miiba oŋɔɔ." Kɛkɛ ni Yakob mia ehiɛ ni ete shi eta saatso lɛ nɔ.
Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ Luz yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejɔɔ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
'Naa, mahã ofɔ pii ni obaashwere, ni mahã oshwiei atsɔmɔ maji pii, ni mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ aaahã oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.'"
Yakob tsa ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Obihii enyɔ ni ji Efraim kɛ Manase ni ofɔ yɛ Egipt dani miba oŋɔɔ lɛ, minii ji amɛ. Efraim kɛ Manase etsɔ̃mɔ mibii tamɔ Ruben kɛ Simeon nɔŋŋ;
ni bii ni ooofɔ yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ afee bo onii; shi yɛ gboshiniyeli gbɛfaŋ lɛ, aaabu amɛ ashi Efraim kɛ Manase nɔ.
Ejaakɛ be ni mijɛ Mesopotamia ni mibaa Kanaan lɛ, Rahel gbo shi mi yɛ gbɛ teŋ, be ni eshwɛ gbɛ kukuoo dani ashɛɔ Efrat lɛ, ni mifu lɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ gbɛ ni yaa Efrat ni ji ŋmɛnɛ Betlehem lɛ he."
Be ni Yakob na Yosef bihii lɛ, ebi akɛ, "Namɛi nɛ?"
Yosef kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Mibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mi yɛ Egipt lɛ nɛ." Yakob kɛɛ, "Okɛ amɛ aba ni majɔɔ amɛ."
Shi gbɔlɛ ehã Yakob hiŋmɛi anɔ eha, ni enaaa nii jogbaŋŋ. Yosef tsi gbekɛbii lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etsɛ. Yakob shwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa ni eloo amɛ atuu,
ni ekɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Misusuko kɔkɔɔkɔ akɛ mana ohiɛ; ni naa, Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mina obii hu."
Agbɛnɛ Yosef hole gbɛkɛbii lɛ yɛ Yakob nakutsei anɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
Yosef mɔmɔ gbekɛbii enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amli, Efraim ye Yakob abɛku nɔ, ni Manase ye Israel ninejurɔ nɔ, ni etsi amɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yakob.
Kɛkɛ ni yakob kpã eninejurɔ mli ni ekɛŋmɛ Efraim ni ji gbekɛ lɛ yiteŋ, ni ekɛ ebɛku tsɔ̃ eninejurɔ lɛ nɔ akɛŋmɛ Manase yiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ Manase ji kromɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob jɔɔ Yosef ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni mitsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak sɔ̃mɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ekwɛ minɔ miwala gbii fɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ,
bɔfo ni jie mi kɛjɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ mli lɛ, ajɔɔ gbekɛbii nɛɛ. Amɛhewɔ lɛ, migbɛi kɛ mitsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak agbɛi gboŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Amɛyi afa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Be ni Yosef na akɛ etsɛ kɛ eninejurɔ eŋmɛ Efraim yiteŋ lɛ, enaaa he miishɛɛ, ni ewo etsɛ nine nɔ koni ejie kɛjɛ Efraim yiteŋ kɛyaŋmɛ Manase yiteŋ.
Ni Yosef kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Jeee nakai ni Ataa, ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji kromɔbi; okɛ onine jurɔ aŋmɛ lɛ moŋ eyiteŋ."
Shi etsɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mibi, mile, mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ onukpa lɛ hu aaatsɔ̃ maŋ kple, ni eeetsɔ agbo; shi kɛ̃lɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kpeteŋkple fe lɛ, ni eshwiei aaatsɔ majimaji babaoo."
No hewɔ lɛ Yakob jɔɔ gbekɛbii lɛ nakai gbi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛ nyɛgbɛi Israelbii kɛaajɔɔ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ ahã otsɔ̃ tamɔ Efraim kɛ Manase.'" Bele Yakob ŋɔ onukpa gbɛhe lɛ ehã Efraim.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Naa, mi lɛ, migbele be eshɛ etã, shi nyɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ baahi shi, ni ekɛ nyɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛya nyɛblematsɛmɛi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Asaŋ, bo pɛ ji mɔ ni miŋɔ Shekem shikpɔŋ lɛ mihã, shi jeee onyɛmimɛi lɛ, nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛ miklaŋte kɛ migãi shɔ̃ yɛ Amorbii lɛ adɛ̃ lɛ."
49: Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tsɛ ebii lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa koni magba nyɛ wɔsɛɛ saji ni baaba nyɛ nɔ:
"Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛboa mi toi; nyɛ Yakob bihii, nyɛboa nyɛtsɛ Yakob toi!
"Ruben, bo ji mikromɔbi, miblahiiaŋ be hewalɛ mli bi, mɔ ni fe fɛɛ yɛ gbɛnaa kɛ hewalɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Otamɔ nu hamahama ni damɔɔɔ he kome; ofeŋ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ doŋŋ, ejaakɛ okɛ mihemɔ wɔ, ni owo misaa he muji ni obule misaatso.
Simeon kɛ Levi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ni; amɛkɛ amɛklaŋtei lɛ tsūɔ yiwalɛ nii.
Mihiŋ amɛjinatoo mli, ni mitaŋ amɛkpei amli. Amɛmlifu mli lɛ, amɛgbe gbɔmɔ, ni amɛkɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ fee tsinai akpaketsɛmɛi.
Alomɔ amɛmlifu, ejaakɛ enaa wa; alomɔ amɛmlila, ejaakɛ eyi wa. Magbla amɛmli mawo Israel magbɛ amɛ mashwã Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
"Yuda, onyɛmimɛi lɛ aaajie oyi. Oooye ohenyɛlɔi anɔ; otsɛbii lɛ aaakoto o!
Yuda lɛ, jata binuu ni; mibi yagbe milɛloo ni eku esɛɛ eeba! Eedɛkɛ shi, eebumɔ shi tamɔ jata, tamɔ jata yoo; namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ ajije?
Maŋtsɛyeli ejeŋ Yuda dɛŋ, ni nɔyeli hu ejeŋ eshwiei adɛŋ; gbii abɔ ni jeŋmaji kɛ amɛ onia baa, ni amɛbaa amɛhe shi amɛhãa lɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ etejibi aaaŋɔ wain tso, ekɛ eteji yoo bi aaaŋmɔ wain tso ni wa. Ekɛ wain aaafɔ etade he, ekɛ wain tsurɔ fɔɔ aaafɔ ehebo he.
Ehiŋmɛi aaatsu fɔɔ fe wain, ni enyanyɔji aaayɛ futaa, fe fufɔ.
"Zebulon aaahi ŋshɔ naa; ni eeetsɔ̃ lɛji adaamɔhe, ni ekɛ Sidon aaaje husu.
"Isakar lɛ, teji ni hewa ni, ni ebuɔ shi yɛ kooloi atsui ateŋ.
Enaa akɛ hejɔɔmɔhe lɛ hi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ akɔnɔ. Ni eŋɔɔ ekoto sɛɛ ehãa ni atre lɛ jatsu. Ni enyɛɔ enɔ ni etsu nii tamɔ nyɔŋ.
"Dan aaatsɔ̃ lumɔ ehã amɛi lɛ ni amɛaatamɔ Israel akutsei krokomɛi lɛ.
Ni Dan aaatsɔ̃ onufu ni ble gbɛ toi, onaŋka ni naa yɔɔ ebɔɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ toi, ni ekɔ̃ɔ okpɔŋɔ nanetsitsi, ni enɔtalɔ lɛ kpaa gbeɔ shi.
"Yehowa, oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ, gbɛ miikwɛɔ nɛɛ!
"Gad lɛ ojotwalɔi asafo aaabatua lɛ, shi lɛ moŋ eeewo amɛ foi.
"Asher shikpɔŋ aaaba nii kpɔtɔɔ nii ni sa maŋtsɛ.
Naftali lɛ ofrote ni foɔ shi kɛkɛ ni; ni enaa ŋɔɔ.
"Yosef lɛ, tso nine ni woɔ yibii ni, tso nine ni ma nuhiŋmɛi he, ni eniji kwlɔɔ gbogbo.
Gãitsɛlɔi kɛ hiɛdɔɔ batua lɛ, ni amɛtsrɛ lɛ gãi kɛ yiwalɛ.
Shi egãi lɛ yɛ hewalɛ kpɛŋŋ. Eniji kɛ ekɔ̃ɔji ahe yɛ oya; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ni hã lɛ nakai hewalɛ lɛ. Tookwɛlɔ lɛ, ni ji Israel tɛsaa lɛ, gbɛi lɛ tsu enɛ.

Otsɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni aaaye abua bo Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ baajɔɔ bo. Lɛ eeejɔɔ o kɛ jɔɔmɔi ni jɛ ŋwɛi kɛ jɔɔmɔi ni jɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi nui lɛ amli. Eeejɔɔ o kɛ fufɔ ni kɔ̃ɔ, eeejɔɔ o kɛ fɔmɔ nii kpakpa.
Otsɛ jɔɔmɔi lɛ mli wa fe naanɔ gɔji lɛ, kɛ naanɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ ajɔɔmɔi lɛ. Jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ ashwie Yosef yiteŋ, eshwie lɛ mɔ ni ajie lɛ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ato afã lɛ pampam.
Benyamin lɛ, klaŋ ni yɔɔ hahaaha ni. Leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ emɔɔ emilɛloo ni eyeɔ."
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ; ni wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɛ kɛ amɛ wie be ni ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ jɔɔmɔ ni sa lɛ lɛ, no ekɛjɔɔ lɛ.
Yakob wo amɛ kitã ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ miiya mitsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ. Nyɛfūa mi nyɛfataa mitsɛmɛi lɛ ahe yɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, abɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ mli.
Tɛkplo nɛɛ yɛ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Mamre bokagbɛ, yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nɔ ni Abraham diɛŋtsɛ he kɛ abɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, dɛŋ, ni eŋɔ fee efuuhe lɛ.
Jɛi afu Abraham kɛ eŋa Sara yɛ; jɛi afu Isak kɛ eŋa Rebeka yɛ; ni jɛi mifu Lea hu yɛ.
Abɔɔ nɛɛ kɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, ahe yɛ Hitbii lɛ adɛŋ."
Be ni Yakob ewo ebii lɛ akitã nɛkɛ egbe naa lɛ, ebua enaji anaa eshwie saa lɛ nɔ, ni ebu enaa. Afu lɛ afata emɛi lɛ ahe.
50: Kɛkɛ ni Yosef ho egbee etsɛ nɔ ni efo ni eshwɔ enaa.
Yosef fã etsuji tsofawɔlɔi lɛ akɛ amɛwo etsɛ tsofa, ni amɛwo lɛ.
Amɛkɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ wo lɛ tsofa lɛ; ejaakɛ gbii abɔ ni ayeɔ kɛwoɔ tsofa lɛ ji no. Egiptbii lɛ fo Yakob gbii nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Be ni afo Yakob agbe naa lɛ, Yosef kɛɛ Farao we lɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ, kɛ nyɛyɛ mihe tsui jurɔ lɛ, miikpa o fai, nyɛwoa farao toi nɔ akɛ
Mitsɛ hã mikã lɛ kitã akɛ, 'Naa, eshɛ migbele be; mibu lɛ ni mitsa mihã mihe yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jɛi oyafu mi yɛ!' No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni mayato mitsɛ ni maku misɛɛ maba."
Farao to he akɛ, "Yaa ni oyafu otsɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ehã okã lɛ kitã lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yosef yiŋ etee ni eyafu etsɛ. Farao tsuji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ewe onukpai lɛ kɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ onukpai fɛɛ
kɛ Yosef shīaŋbii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ fata ehe kɛtee; amɛbii kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛkɛ amɛshi yɛ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi hu kɛ Yosef tee; asafo yuu diɛŋtsɛ kɛ lɛ tee lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni amɛshɛ Atad ableshaahe lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛfee yara wulu yɛ jɛi; ni Yosef fo etsɛ gbii kpawo.

Be ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni ji Kanaanbii lɛ na ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ yɛ Atad ableshaahe lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ Egiptbii lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ." No hewɔ lɛ awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Abel-Mizraim, eshishi ji Egiptbii Akɔmɔyeli. Eyɛ Yordan sɛɛ.
Yakob bii lɛ ye amɛtsɛ kitã ni ewo amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛwo lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyafu lɛ yɛ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli tɛkplo lɛ mli. Abɔɔ nɛɛ Abraham diɛŋtsɛ he kɛ tɛkplo lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, dɛŋ yɛ Mamre bokagbe ni ekɛfee efuuhe lɛ.
Be ni Yosef efu etsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ tee etsɛ fuu lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Egipt ekoŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛtsɛ egbo lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Ekolɛ Yosef ebɛ wɔ ewo emli, ni eeetɔ ehe owele yɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ ni wɔfee lɛ lɛ hewɔ."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã ayakɛɛ Yosef akɛ, "Otsɛ wo kitã dani egbo akɛ,

'Bɔ ni nyɛkɛ Yosef awie nɛ, Miikpa o fai ni okɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ atɔmɔi kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ afa amɛ ejaakɛ amɛfee o efɔŋ.' No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wɔmiikpa o fai ni okɛ otsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji lɛ atɔmɔi lɛ afa amɛ!" Be ni amɛkɛ Yosef wie nɛkɛ lɛ efo.
Kɛkɛ ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ tee amɛyabumɔ shi kɛ ehiɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Naa, otsuji ji wɔ!"
Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei! Minɛŋ maye Nyɔŋmɔ najiaŋ mafee nɔ ko.
Tsɛbelɛ, nyɛ lɛ, nyɛto nyɛyiŋ akɛ nyɛaafee mi afɔŋ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hã etsɔ̃ nɔ kpakpa; bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ no nɔ ahere mɛi babaoo ayiwala, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei! Mibalɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ." Bɔ ni ehã enyɛmimɛi lɛ atsui ni eshɛje amɛmii nɛ.
Yosef hi shi yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ. Ni eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma.
Yosef na Efraim nanakansowai; ni Manase bi Mikir bii lɛ hu afɔ amɛ ashwie eshuɔ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Migbele be eshɛ; shi sramɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaabasra nyɛ kã, ni eeekpla nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ ni ekã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kitã yɛ he lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef hã enyɛmimɛi, Yakob bii, lɛ kã lɛ kitã ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ aaakai nyɛ kɛ̃. Kɛ eeebajie nyɛ lɛ, nyɛjiea miwui lɛ kɛjea biɛ kɛyaa."
Be ni Yosef eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma lɛ egbo. Amɛwo lɛ tsofa, ni akɛ lɛ wo adeka mli yɛ Egipt.

1: Ninaa ni Yehowa jie etsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Habakuk lɛ nɛ.
"Ao, Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mablɔ kɛyashi dani ooobo mi toi? Mɛɛ beyinɔ matsɛ bo kɛyashi dani ooobahere wɔ kɛje yiwalɛ mli?
Mɛɛba ohãa minaa nifɔɔjianii nɛɛ, ni bo hu okwɛɔ haomɔi nɛɛ lɛ? Nifitemɔ kɛ henitswiamɔ sɔŋŋ ebɔle mihe kɛkpe, ni nɔmɔ kɛ bei ete shi yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Ejaakɛ mla lɛ hewalɛ egbo, ni no hewɔ lɛ ayeeee jalɛ sane. Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ebɔle jalɔ lɛ kɛkpe, ni no hewɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ abu shi."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ emɛi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛhe baajɔ̃ nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ yɛ nii ni nyɛbaana lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ miitsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ amɛteŋ yɛ nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ, ni kɛji agba nyɛ lɛ nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ!.
Naa, mitee Babilonbii lɛ ni yi wa, asaŋ ni amɛhe ejɔɔɔ lɛ ashi. Amɛfãa kɛkpaa je lɛ mli shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kɛyaŋɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ.
Amɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ gbeyei mɔmɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ, no amɛfeɔ, ni no ji nɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mla.
"Amɛkpɔŋɔi ahe yɛ oya fe mlaŋtswi, ni amɛhiɛ yɛ kramakrama fe klaji ni je ena amɛ kɛ hɔmɔ. Amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ jɛɔ shɔŋŋ amɛbaa; amɛshaneɔ shi kɛ foi tamɔ okrɔpɔŋ shaneɔ shi eshaa eniyenii.
"Amɛtai lɛ fãa kɛbaa kɛ yiwalɛ kɛbayeɔ shikpɔji anɔ; ni amɛhe ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ mɛi kɛji amɛmiiba. Amɛnomii ni amɛbuaa naa lɛ ayifalɛ tamɔ shia.
Amɛyeɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ahe fɛo; ni lumɛi ahe feɔ amɛŋmlɔ. Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko shɔ̃mɔ waaa hãaa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtreɔ sū amɛkɛbaaa mɔɔ lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ amɛshɔ̃.
Ni amɛfoɔ mli kɛhoɔ shwiaa kɛyaa tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, amɛji amɛhe efɔŋfeelɔi, ni hewalɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ no ji nɔ ni amɛjaa."
"Yehowa, kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome! Ohaŋ wɔgbɔi! Ao, Yehowa, okɔ Babilonbii lɛ, ni bo ohã amɛma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã wɔtoigblamɔ.
Shi te aaafe tɛŋŋ ni okwɛ ni efɔŋ aya nɔ hu? Ohiŋmɛi yɛ krɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni okɛaakwɛ koni nifɔɔjianii aya nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ mɛɛba ni ofee dioo be mli ni efɔŋfeelɔi kpãtãa mɛi ni hi fe amɛ hiɛ?
"Ejaakɛ ohã gbɔmɛi etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋshɔŋloo loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waamɔnii ni bɛ nɔyelɔ.
Babilonbii lɛ kɛ kpoŋ shaa gbɔmɛi oookɛɛ loi ji amɛ; amɛfɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi anɔ yaa, ni amɛgblaa amɛ tamɔ adrã; ni amɛnyaa ni amɛmli fliɔ amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛshãa afɔle amɛkɛjaa amɛyaa lɛ, ni amɛshãa tsofãkɛŋma amɛkɛhãa amɛtsãani lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi hãa amɛnaa nii kpɔtɔɔ amɛyeɔ.
"Aso Babilonbii nɛɛ baakã he aye amɛhewalɛ nɛɛ mli nii daa, koni amɛya nɔ nɛkɛ sɔŋŋ kɛplenee majimaji lɛ amli bii ni mɔbɔnalɛ ko kwraa bɛ mli lo?"
2: Mibakwɔ mayadamɔ shi kɛbu yɛ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ koni makwɛ nɔ ni Yehowa baakɛɛ mi, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni ebaahã mi yɛ mikɔmɔyeli lɛ hewɔ.
Yehowa hã mi hetoo nɛɛ, "Kpɛ ninaa nɛɛ faŋŋ yɛ tɛi tɛtrɛbii anɔ koni anyɛ akane oya.
Ninaa nɛɛ be lɛ shɛko moŋ, shi eeye ehe oyai kɛba. Kɛji eshashao shi tete po jiŋŋ, bo lɛ mɛɛ, ejaakɛ ebaaba kɛ̃ ni etsɛŋ.
Ni shɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɛ; 'Naa, mɔ ni efeee jalɛnii lɛ, eyi naŋ wala; shi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ ehemɔkɛyeli nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ ni eyi ana wala.'"
Naa, wain lakaa mɔ. Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ ehe lɛ, enyɛɛɛ shi ehi. Efeɔ fuu tamɔ gbohiiaje; ni etamɔ gbele, etɔko dã. Ebuaa majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii anaa kɛbaa, ni etīaa amɛ ehãa ehe.
Aso majimaji nɛɛ fɛɛ yeŋ lɛ yɔɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Kpoo hã mɔ ni haa nii ni ele faŋŋ akɛ jeee enɔ ni, kɛ mɔ ni loɔ awabatoonii eshwieɔ enɔ lɛ. Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni? "
Naa, trukaa ni onyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaate shi awo bo. Mɛi ni hiɛ etsɛ̃ lɛ aaaha onii.
Akɛ ni oha majimaji babaoo anii hewɔ lɛ, bo hu majimaji lɛ amli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaha onii yɛ gbɔmɛi ala shi ni oshwie, kɛ yi ni owa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
Kpoo hã mɔ ni etsɔ̃ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ ena nii ehã ewe, ni ebɔ mɔdɛŋ eyama etsu yɛ he ko grɔŋŋ bɔ ni afee ni efee shweshweeshwe koni efɔŋ ko akasa ehe lɛ.
Ogbɛjianɔtoo lɛ eyagbla hiɛgble ebashwie owe lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ ni oplenee lɛ ehã bo diɛŋtsɛ owala hiɛ ekpãtã moŋ.
Gbogbo mli tɛ tete miiblɔ kɛmiishi nyɛ, ni tsu yiteŋ mplaŋ lɛ hu miihere tɛ lɛ blɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛ lashishwiemɔ toɔ maŋ, ni ekɛ efɔŋfeemɔ tswaa maŋ lɛ.
Naa, aso jeee Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ sane nɛ, akɛ gbɔmɔ atsu nii, ni lá abakpãtã hiɛ lo, ni majimaji lɛ agbo deŋme yaka lo?
Moŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baayi tɔ kɛ Yehowa anumnyam lɛ he nilee, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi tɔ kɛ nu lɛ.
Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni ojɛɔ mlifu mli ohãa onaanyo dãa enuɔ, ni etɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni okwɛ eyayaiaŋ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ bo hu, yɛ hiɛnyam najiaŋ lɛ, hiɛgble baamɔ bo. Bo hu obaanu eko koni odidãã. Kplu ni yɔɔ Yehowa ninejurɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kɛbashɛ onɔ, ni ohiɛnyam lɛ baatsɔ̃ hiɛgble ni naa wa.
Awui ni nyɛye Lebanon lɛ baasu nyɛtsui fe nine; emli kooloi lɛ hiɛ ni nyɛkpãtã lɛ baahã nyɛshe gbeyei, ejaakɛ nyɛshwie gbɔmɛi alá shi, ni nyɛwa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ayi.
Mɛni ji amãgã he sɛɛnamɔ? Ŋaalɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ kɛkɛ ni; ni egbaaa mɔ ko nɔ ko fe amale. Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mɔ ni fee amãgã lɛ kɛ ehiɛ afɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eninenaa nitsumɔnii, ni ji amãgã mumui nɔ?
Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni okɛɔ tso akɛ, "Ohiɛ atsɛ̃!" Ni okɛɔ tɛ mumui hu akɛ, "Tee shi!" Ani amãgã baanyɛ ejie ninaa atsɔ̃ɔ bo? Naa, akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi baaha ehe nɛ, shi moŋ wala kome nɛkɛ bɛ emli.
Naa, Yehowa yɛ e-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
3: Sɔlemɔ ni Gbalɔ Habakuk sɔle nɛ,
"Ao Yehowa, minu nii ni otsu lɛ he, ni miishe gbeyei. Yehowa, tsu onitsumɔi wuji lɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ wɔyinɔ nɛɛ hu nɔ. Hã ale yɛ afii nɛɛ amli nɔŋŋ. Omlifu mli tete lɛ, hã omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo!
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jɛ Edom kɛmiiba; Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ miiba kɛjɛ Paran Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Enumnyam lɛ ha ŋwɛi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ eyijiemɔ.
Ekpɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la; la kplɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edɛŋ he ni ji ehewalɛ teemɔhe lɛ.
Tsɛŋemɔ hela nyiɛɔ ehiɛ, ni gbele hela nyiɛ esɛɛ tuuŋtu.
Ewa edamɔ shi, ni shikpɔŋ hoso, Ekwɛ, ni maji lɛ ahe kpokpo. Naanɔ gɔji lɛ gbɛ shwã ni naanɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ ba shi, yɛ hei ni enyiɛ blema ko lɛ,.
Mina, Kushanbii miishe gbeyei, ni Midianbii ahe miikpokpo.
Yehowa, ani fai omli wo la wo? Fai ni omli fu, loo ŋshɔ ni ogri owo? No hewɔ ota kunimyeli okpɔŋɔ kɛ tayaa shwiili mli kɛbaa nɛɛ?
Ojie ogãi lɛ hebo lɛ, ni ofee kralo kɛbaatsɛ̃. Okɛ fai egbla shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
Gɔji lɛ na bo, ni amɛhosohosoo; nu tue kɛbaho yoo. Bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ wo egbee; ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi.
La ni ogãimlibii lɛ kplɛ kɛ okplɔi lɛ hu akplɛmɔ hã hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere wa damɔ shi.
Okɛ mlila shi shi kɛtsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni onaanaa majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛho yɛ mlifu naa.
Otee oyahere omɛi lɛ ayiwala, koni oyahere mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ yiwala. Ojwra mɔ fɔŋ lɛ weku lɛ yitso, ni oŋmɛ lɛ yayai kɛjɛ eshwuɔ kɛyata ekuɛ.
Okɛ okplɔ lɛ gbulu etabilɔi ni ba tamɔ lasuogbele koni amɛbagbɛ mi amɛshwã kɛ mliflimɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni amɛba ohiafo piŋmɔ yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ.
Okɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ naanaa ŋshɔ ni ji nu kpeteŋkple ni kumɔɔ lɛ nɔ.
Minu enɛɛmɛi, ni mihe kpokpo; gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hã minaabu jo bliblibli. Mikpɔiaŋ fee gbedee, ni minaji tɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ. Mibata shi kpoo mamɛ gbi ni abaahao mɛi ni baa koni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ abawu lɛ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ agbãmi tso gbaŋ afofro, ni yibii ehiŋ wain tsei anɔ; eyɛ mli akɛ mu tsei ayibii baafee yaka, ni anaŋ ŋmɔshi niyenii; eyɛ mli akɛ toi fɛɛ aaagboi, ni tsinai aaatã yɛ tsina tsui amli nɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ mi lɛ mibanya, ni mimli aaafli mi yɛ Yehowa miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ woɔ mi hewalɛ; ehãa minaji feɔ tamɔ ofrote naji kɛnyiɛɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ. (Akɛhã Lalatsɛnukpa lɛ koni akɛ kpãa saŋku atswa.)

1: Maŋtsɛ Dario, Persia nɔyelɔ lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ hã Gbalɔ Hagai ekɛbahã Yuda Amralo Zerubabel Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hagai akɛ, "Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛɔ akɛ be ni sa akɛ asaa atswa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shɛko."
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ tsu Hagai kɛyahã maŋbii lɛ akɛ,
"Miwebii, aso esa nyɛhiɛ akɛ nyɛhi nyɛtsui ni asɛŋ nɔ amli, be mli ni miwe nɛɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ lo?
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛjwɛŋa nyɛjeŋba he jopgbaŋŋ.

Nyɛduɔ nii babaoo, shi fioo pɛ nyɛnaa nyɛkpaa. Nyɛyeɔ nii, shi nyɛtrɔɔɔ; ni nyɛnuɔ dãa shi nyɛtrɔɔɔ dãa. Nyɛbuɔ mama, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko efeee kulɔɔ. Ni mɔ ni yeɔ apaa ni awoɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ hu lɛ, ekɛwoɔ kotoku ni shishi egbulɔ mli."
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Nyɛjwɛŋa, nyɛjeŋba he jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛyaa gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛyaflɔa tsei kɛbaa nyɛkɛbamaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni mimii baashɛ mihe, ni mapue yɛ minumnyam mli.

"Nyɛkwɛɔ ŋmɔshi nii babaoo gbɛ, shi ebafeɔ fioo kɛkɛ. Ni kɛji nyɛkɛ nikpamɔnii lɛ ba shīa hu lɛ, mifliɔ nii lɛ mishwãa. Mɛni hewɔ mifeɔ nakai lɛ? Ejaakɛ mi-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ edɔ kɛmiitsu ewe he nii.
No hewɔ ni ŋwɛi etsi nu naa ni enɛɛɛ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu baaa niyenii lɛ.
No hewɔ mihã nuhɔmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni esa able kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ nibaanii fɛɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi kɛ ninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ ahe nɛɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Zerubabel, Sheatiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni shwɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ fɛɛ, bo Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wiemɔi lɛ atoi. Amɛshe gbeyei yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Hagai, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ, kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa tsumɔ lɛ naa akɛ, "Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ!"

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tee Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli bii ni shwɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba lɛ hu fɛɛ amumɔ shi, ni amɛtee amɛyatsu Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he nii.
Amɛtsu nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
2: Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ,
'Namɔ eshwɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni na bɔ ni nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔwe nɛɛ tsutsu anumnyam lɛ yɔɔ hãa. Te nyɛnaa lɛ tɛŋŋ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ? Bɛ ejeee fɛifɛi yɛ nyɛhiɛ?
Shi agbɛnɛ Zerubabel, wajemɔ ohe! Bo Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi, bo hu wajemɔ ohe! Nyɛ, maŋbii fɛɛ, nyɛwajea nyɛhe. Nyɛtea shi, nyɛtsua nii, ejaakɛ mi kɛ nyɛ yɛ,
tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛ shi be ni nyɛshi Egipt lɛ. Mimumɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ, no hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei." Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yehowa, Taistsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Eshwɛ be, be kukuoo ko kɛkɛ ni mibahoso ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mibahoso je lɛ mli majimaji lɛ, ni abaaloo amɛmli jwetrii lɛ kɛaaba biɛ mikɛbawo Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli, ni eeeyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ anumnyam sɔŋŋ.
Je lɛ mli jwɛitɛi fɛɛ kɛ shika fɛɛ lɛ mi, minɔ ni. Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.
Sɔlemɔwe nɛɛ sɛɛkpee anumnyam lɛ baafe etsutsu anumnyam lɛ, ni biɛ majɛ mahã miwebii lɛ ashwere, Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ mikɛɛ."
Nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wie.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ Hagai akɛ, "Bi osɔfoi lɛ koni amɛhã bo sane nɛɛ hetoo:

'Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ loo ni akɛmiishã afɔle mli eko ehɔ atade naamuu mli, ni atade lɛ naamuu lɛ yasa aboloo loo niyenii ni ahoo loo wain loo mu loo niyenii fɛɛ niyenii ko he lɛ, ani no feɔ nii lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lo?'" Sane nɛɛ hetoo ni osɔfoi lɛ hã ji akɛ, "Dabida".
Kɛkɛ ni Hagai bi osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, "Shi kɛji mɔ ni eyata gbonyo he ni ekɛbule ehe ta nibii nɛɛ eko he hu lɛ, ani ebule nii lɛ lo?" Osɔfoi lɛ to he akɛ. "Hɛɛ".

Kɛkɛ ni Hagai kɛɛ, "Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ji bɔ ni maŋ nɛɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli bii lɛ ebule amɛhe yɛ mihiɛ ni nakai pɛ hu ji bɔ ni abule amɛninenaa nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛbashãa afɔle amɛkɛhãa mi lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ nyɛsusua nɔ ni eba nyɛnɔ kɛho lɛ he. Dani nyɛbɔ̃i Sɔlemɔwe lɛ tswaa lɛ,
te nyɛyaa ŋmãakuu, ni be mli ni nyɛmiikwɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛbaana ŋmãa kei ohai enyɔ lɛ, nyɛyaninaa kei oha pɛ? Mɔ ni baa wain bu naa akɛ eeba ebayɛ wain gbɛi oha lɛ, ebaninaa wain gbɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ pɛ?
Mihã hela kɛ lamɔ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi fite nyɛninenaa nitsumɔnii fɛɛ, shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleee kɛbaaa miŋɔɔ.
Nyɛkadia kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nɔ ni baaba, ŋmɛnɛ ji nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ, ni ji gbi nyɛto Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shishi lɛ.
Bɛ dumɔ wu ko bɛ aboŋo mli, ni wain tso kɛ agbami tso kɛ akutu tso kɛ mu tso woko? Shi naa, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ mibajɔɔ nyɛ.,"
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ ni ji enyɔ tsu Gbalɔ Hagai, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni mibahoso ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu,
ni mibakpa maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni mibafo amɛlumɔyeli sɛɛ. Mibakpãtã tayaa shwiilii kɛ shwiilii lɛ amlitralɔi fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ adɔ amɛhe amɛgbegbee amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛhe.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi, mitsulɔ, mibaŋɔ bo koni oye maŋbii lɛ alumɔ yɛ mi migbɛi mli, ejaakɛ boji mɔ ni mihala." Mi, Taiatsɛ, mi mikɛɛ.

1: Sa lɛ bei srɔtoi amli kɛ gbɛi srɔtoi anɔ NYɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛ wɔ-tsɛmɛi lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔi lɛ anaa.
Shi nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ anaagbee mli lɛ, e-Bi lɛ na ekɛ wɔ wie yɛ. Ekɛ lɛ efee nibii fɛɛ yelɔ, ni enɔ hu etsɔ̃ efee je lɛ.

Lɛji enumnyam lɛ kpɛmɔ kɛ esu lɛ mfoniri lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ wiemɔ lɛ hiɛɔ nibii fɛɛ. Be ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋTsɛ ehew etsuu wɔhe kɛjɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ, etee eyata shi yɛ anumnyam-Tsɛ agbo lɛ nine jurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi,
ni bɔ ni efe ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu ena gbɛi ni fe amɛnɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, "Mi-Bi ji o; ŋmɛnɛ mifɔ o?" Ni asaŋ, "Matsɔ̃ e-Tsɛ, ni lɛ hu eeetsɔ̃ mi-Bi."
Ni be ni ekɛ kromɔbi lɛ baa je nɛɛ mli lɛ, ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Nyɔŋm_ bɔfoi fɛɛ aja lɛ."
Ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ekɛɛ yɛ amɛhe akɛ, :Mɔ ni feɔ ebɔfoi lɛ mumɔi, ni esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu efeɔ amɛ lalilɛii lɛ."
Shi Bi lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, "Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ma shi kɛmiiya naanɔI anaanɔ, ni omaŋtsɛ tso lɛ, jalɛ maŋtsɛ tso ni.
Osumɔɔ jalɛ, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ; hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ mu lɛ efɔ o fe onanemɛi lɛ."
Ni ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ, "Nuŋtsɔ, shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ŋwɛi lɛ oninenaa nitsumɔ ni.
Amɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpãtã, shi bo lɛ, ohiɔ shi daa. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaasuu tamɔ atade;
ni oookota amɛ tamɔ mama. Ni amɛaatsake; shi bo lɛ, oyɛ bɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ofii lɛ etãaa."
SHi ŋwɛi bɔfoi Lɛ ateŋ namɔ pi ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, "Ta minine jurɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo?"
Ani amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee mumɔ bɔfoi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ ji a,ɛ, ni atsuɔ amɛ ni amɛbasɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni nine baashɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ amɛgboshinii lɛ?
2: No hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ wɔjwɛŋmɔ ahi nii ni wɔnu lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ, koni wɔkakplaŋ kɛjɛ he be ko.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni awie yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi anaa lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ, ni awo nɔtɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ nɔtɔ̃mɔ kɛ toigbele fɛɛ toigbele ha nyɔmɔ bɔ ni ja lɛ,
te wɔ lɛ wɔbaafee tɛŋŋ wɔjo nyɔmɔwo naa foi hu, kɛji wɔbuuu nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ lɛ? Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu wie he, ni mɛi ni nu lɛ hu ma nɔ mí amɛhã wɔ,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ okadi kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛnii asrɔtoi kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hãmɔ lɛ miiye odase miishi nɔ, yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ jeee ŋwɛi bɔfoi ashishi akɛ jeŋ ni baaba ni wɔwieɔ he lɛ wo.
Shi mɔ ko ye odase faŋŋ yɛ he ko akɛ, "Mɛni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni okaiɔ lɛ? Aloo gbɔmɔ bi hu ni ojwɛŋɔ enɔ?
Shwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni ohã ekɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi aye egbɔ; okɛ anumnyam kɛ woo efi lɛ akekre, Ni oŋɔ lɛ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ.
Oŋɔ nibii fɛɛ kwa owo enajiashi." Kɛ akɛɛ, "ekɛ nibii fɛɛ ewo enajiashi." lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛwooo eshishi. Shi amrɔ nɛɛ wɔnako wɔna akɛ nibii fɛɛ yɛ eshishi.

Shi mɔ ko ni be kuku ko mli lɛ ahã shwɛ fioo ni ekɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi aye egbɔ lɛ, wona akɛ Yesu ni, mɔ ni gbele mli nɔnaa hewɔ ni akɛ anumnyam kɛ woo fi lɛ akekre lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa lɛ esa enaa gbele ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.

Ejaakɛ esa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ hewɔ ni nii afii yɔɔ kɛ mɔ nɔni tsɔ̃ ni nii fiaa yɔɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni afee ni eŋɔ bi babaoo kɛba anumnyam mli lɛ, ehã amɛyiwalaheremɔ Tatsɛnukpa lɛ atsɔ̃ amanehului amli ahu kɛewula shi.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ mɛi ajhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni atsuuɔ amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ jɛ mɔ ko mli; no hewɔ jɛ ni ehiɛ gbooo akɛ eeetsɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ .
Ni ekɛɛ, "Matsí ogbɛi lɛ tã matsɔ̃ɔ minyɛmimɛi lɛ; asafo mli hu mala majie oyi yɛ."
Ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Maŋɔ mihiɛ mafɔ̃ enɔ." Ni asaŋ, "Naa mi kɛ bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã mi lɛ!:"
No hewɔ lɛ akɛni bii lɛ hiɛ heloo kɛ lâ kome hewɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eŋɔ no nɔŋŋ eko tamɔ amɛ, koni etsɔ̃ gbele nɔ ekpãtã mɔ ni yɔɔ gbele nɔ hewalɛ ni ji abonsamlɛ hiɛ,
ni ekpɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ ni gbele gbeyeishemɔ hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɔJi yɛ amɛwala be fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, jeee ŋwɛi bɔfoi eyeɔ ebuaa, shi moŋ Abraham shwiei.
No hewɔ lɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ esa akɛ etamɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni etsɔ̃ mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ anɔkwa osɔfonukpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni ekpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ena kaa mli amanehulu hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɔ eyeɔ abuaa mɛi ni akaa amɛ lɛ.
3: Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ena ŋwɛi tsɛmɔ lɛ eko, nyɛjwɛŋa wɔhemɔkɛyeli jajemɔ lɛ he bɔfo kɛ osɔfonukpa ni ji Kristo Yesu lɛ he,
mɔ ni ye mɔ ni to lɛ nakai gbɛhe lɛ anɔKwa, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose hu ye anɔkwa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔni mɔ ko ni ema shía woo fa fe shīa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Yesu hiɛ yɔɔ nyam fe Mose.
Ejaakɛ shīa fɛɛ shīa lɛ, mɔ ko kɛ̃ ma, shi mɔ ni maa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni Mose lɛ, eye anɔkwa yɛ eshīa muu lɛ fɛɛ mli akɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ, koni eye nii ni abaawie lɛ ahe odase,
Shi Kristo lɛ, eye anɔkwa akɛ Bi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe, lɛ ewe ji wɔ, kɛji wɔhiɛ nɔhiɛkãmɔ mli ekãa kɛ eshãa lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ kɛyashi naagbee lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ nu Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ, ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ,
nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee yɛ mlilawoo gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ,
he ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ minaa, ni amɛka mi, ni amɛna minitsumɔi lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ lɛ, afii.
Hewɔ lɛ mimli wo nakai yinɔbii lɛ ala ni mikɛɛ. 'Amɛduɔ gbɛ yɛ amɛtsui amli daa. shi amɛleee migbɛi lɛ.'
No hã mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli akɛ, 'Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii!"
Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, anyɛmimɛi, koni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko akahi tsui fɔŋ ni heee yeee ni ekpale kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, hIɛkãalɔ lɛ, he.
Shimoŋ nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔa nyɛhe gbi fɛɛ gbi ni atsɛɔ lɛ "ŋmɛnɛ" lɛ, koni esha lakamɔ akahã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko tsui kpliŋ.
Ejaakɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Kristo nanemɛi niyelɔi, kɛji wɔhiɛ wɔhe ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ kɛyashi naagbee lɛ.
Ni akɛɛ akɛ, "ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbeee lɛ, Nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛo lɛ fee yɛ mlilawoo lɛ mli" lɛ,
namɛi nu ni amɛwo emli la lɛ? Ani jeee mɛi ni kɛ Mose je Egipt lɛ fɛɛ ni?
Ni nanemɛi emli fu afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ? Ani jeee mɛi ni fee esha ni amɛtswia shi amɛgboi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ni nanemɛi akitã ekæ akɛ amɛboteŋ ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ? Ani jeee mɛi ni gbo toi lɛ?
Ni wɔnaa akɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ hewɔ amɛnyɛɛɛ mli amɛbote lɛ.
4: No hewɔ lɛ ni ashi ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mlibotemɔ he shiwoo ahã wɔ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni ekaba akɛ eŋmɛɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko.
Ejaakɛ wɔ hu ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ajaje atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ wiemɔ ni amɛnu lɛ he eyabaa sɛɛnamɔ ko ahãaa amɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni nu lɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɔ̃ɔɔ mli.

Ejaakɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhe wɔye lɛ wɔmiibote nakai hejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "No hã mikã kitã mimlifu lɛ mli akɛ, 'Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii'" tsɛ agbe nitsumɔI lɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni ewie yɛ he ko yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ he nɛ, "Ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ehe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ enitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli."
Ni biɛ nɛɛ esaa ekɛɛ, "Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii!"
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ mɛi komɛi baabote mli, ni mɛi ni ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tsutsu lɛ boteee mli yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ lɛ,
esaa eto gbi ko ekoŋŋ, ni etsɛ lɛ, "ŋmɛnɛ" yɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ David nɔ ewie be babaoo nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mli, ni atsī tã momo lɛ, akɛ, "ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ, nYɛkawajea nyɛtsui."
Ejaakɛ eji Yoshua na hã amɛ hejɔɔmɔ kulɛ, fee sɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ewieŋ yɛ gbi kroko he dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ hejɔɔmɔgbiyeli ko kã shi kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ebote ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ejɔɔ ehe kɛjɛ enitsumɔi lɛ amli, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ehe kɛjɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔbɔa mɔdɛŋ koni wɔbote nakai hejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni mɔ ko akagbee toigbele ni he okadi nɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.

Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ hiɛ ka ni eyɛ hewalɛ ni ebaa ba fe klaŋte kɛ enaa nta, ni egbuɔ kɛboteɔ mli aahuu kɛyasheɔ susuma kɛ mumɔ lɛ, kɛ talɔi kɛ wuiaŋfɔi lɛ akpeehei lɛ ni eji tsuiiaŋ susumai kɛ jwɛŋmɔi lɛ akojolɔ.
Ni ateee bɔɔnɔ ko yɛ ehiɛ, shi nibii fɛɛ yɛ fa3ŋ ni agble nɔ yɛ lɛ mɔ ni wɔkɛyɔɔ sane lɛ hiɛ.
Agbɛnɛ, akɛni wɔyɔɔ osɔfonukpa kpeteŋkple, ni efɔoŋ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋwɛiiaŋ, ni ji Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔmɔa Bi lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔmɔa jajemɔ lɛ mli ni awaa.
Ejaakɛ wɔsɔfonukpa ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ ejeee mɔ ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ anu wɔgbedemɔi lɛ ahe ahã wɔ, shi eji mɔ ko ni aka lɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ tamɔ wɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ esha ko esha ko bɛ ehe.
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔkɛ ekãa atsia abɛŋkɛa dromɔ sɛ̃i lɛ, koni wɔnine ashɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nɔ ni wɔna dromɔ ni aaaye abua wɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.
5: Ejaakɛ osɔfonukpa fɛɛ osɔfonukpa ni ahala kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, awo lɛ osɔfo ni edamɔ gbɔmɛi anajiaŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nii agbɛfaŋ, koni ekɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei abahã yɛ eshai ahewɔ,
akɛ mɔ ko ni nyɛɔ ehiɛɔ mɛi ni leee nii kɛ mɛi ni edu gbɛ lɛ blɛoo, akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ gbedemɔ ebɔle lɛ kɛkple lɛ.
Ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ ehe ehīa akɛ eshã eshai ahe afɔle ehã ehe, tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ ehãa maŋ lɛ.
Ni mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ nyam nɛɛ ehãaaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ kɛ, tamɔ etsɛ Aaron hu lɛ,.
Nakai nɔŋŋ Kristo hu, jeee lɛ ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe osɔfonukpa kɛna hiɛnyam, shi moŋ mɔ ni kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mi-Bi ji o, mi, mifɔ o ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ."
Tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ he kroko hu akɛ, "Osɔfo ji o kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa" lɛ.

Kristo lɛ, be ni eyɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ blɔmɔ ni naa wa kɛ yaafonui ɔ̃ŋɔ sɔlemɔi kɛ faikpamɔi ehã mɔ ni baanyɛ eyiwala ahere kɛjɛ gbele mli lɛ, tamɔ afɔle, ni e-Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ hewɔ lɛ abo lɛ toi.
Ni tsɛ belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekase toiboo kɛjɛ amanehului ni ena lɛ amli.
Ni be ni ehi kɛ wula shi lɛ, etsɔ̃ mɔ ni naanɔ yiwalaheremɔ jeɔ emli ehã mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ,
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ osɔfonukpa yɛ Melkezedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa.
Wɔyɛ wiemɔi pii ni wɔɔwie yɛ enɛ he ni shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ wa, ni nyɛyɛ shɔ̃ɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ ni kulɛ benɛ lɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tsɔ̃ɔlɔi moŋ lɛ, ehe ehīa akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ amli shishijee nibii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni fufɔ he ehia amɛ, shi jeeee niyenii ni tsii.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ fufɔ lɛ , eleee jalɛ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he nɔ ko; ejaakɛ fufɔooo ji lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni edra lɛ anɔ ji niyenii ni tsii, mɛi ni fɔ amɛfɔɔ feemɔ lɛ ehã amɛhenumɔnii lɛ ele ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ teŋ srɔto.
6: NO hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔshīa Kristo he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ shishijeenibii lɛ, ni wɔfo mli kɛya tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni sa onukpai ahe; ni wɔkakã he wɔto mitsumɔi ni egboi ahe tsuitsakemɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli.
kɛ baptisimɔi ahe nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ niji kɛ nɔshwiemɔ, kɛ gbohiiashitee kɛ naanɔ kojomɔ he saji lɛ ashishi ekoŋŋ.
Ji wɔɔfee enɛ aahuu, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni la etso amɛnɔ pɛŋ ni amɛsa amɛnaa ŋwɛi nɔkeenɔ lɛ ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko.
ni amɛsa Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ kpakpa lɛ kɛ jeŋ ni baaba kɛ mli hewalɛi lɛ anaa;
ni no sɛɛ ni amɛgbee shi lɛ anyɛŋ amɛ atsake afee ehee ekoŋŋ ahã tsuitsakemɔ, akɛni amɛmiisɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ekoŋŋ amɛmiihã amɛhe, ni amɛmiibɔ lɛ ahora amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni miiɔ nu ni nɛɔ shwieɔ enɔ kpitiokpitio ni ebaa nii ni hã mɛi ni huɔ nɔ lɛ, enaa Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔmɔ lɛ eko.
Shi kɛ ŋmei kɛ aŋlɛ̃lɔ̃ ekwɛ̃ɔ lɛ, ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, ni ebɛŋkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ loomɔ, ni enaagbee ji shãa.
Shi wɔsuɔmɔ mɛi, wɔmiikɛɛ nɛkɛ moŋ, Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔhiɛ kã nyɛnɔ akɛ nyɛsane hi fe nakai, ni yiwalaheremɔ aaanyiɛ sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee mɔ ni yeɔ sane ni ejaaa ni ehiɛ aaakpa nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni nyɛjie kpo yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ni nyɛkɛsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛ lolo lɛ.
Shi Wɔmiiao akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ajie nɛkɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ kpo, koni nyɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ nɔmimaa kɛyashi naagbee,
koni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ kpɔkee, shi moŋ nyɛkɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ tsuishitoo nɔ naa shiwoi lɛ anane.
Ejaakɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo Abraham lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni eeekã lɛ kitã hewɔ lɛ, ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã.
Ekɛɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ, jɔɔmɔ majɔɔ o ni da hu maha oshwiei afa."
Ni akɛni Abraham to etsui shi hewɔ lɛ, enine shɛ shiwoo lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi yɔɔ nɛɛ, mɔ ni fe amɛ lɛ, lɛ kitã amɛkãa, ni amɛŋ2anejee fɛɛ naagbee ji kitãkãmɔ ni akɛmaa sane nɔ aduatsɔ l.
No hewɔ hu ni be ni Nyɔŋmɔ tao akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shiwoo lɛ yelɔi lɛ akɛ eyiŋtoo lɛ tsakeee kwraa lɛ, ekɛ kitã damɔ mli.
koni wɔtsɔ̃ saji enyɔ ni tsakeee ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛŋ amale yɛ mli lɛ anɔ wɔna miishɛjemɔ ni wa. ni wɔ mɛi ni wɔyabɔ abo lɛ wɔkɛmɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni kã wɔhiɛ lɛ mli;'
Nɔ ni wɔhiɛ tamɔ wɔsusuma sɛkɛ ni tseee ni efi shi shiŋŋ ni ebote mli kɛtee muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ.,
he ji hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ ni ji Yesu, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ naanɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa lɛ, bote hã wɔ lɛ.
7: Shi Melkizedek nɛɛ, lɛji Salem maŋtsɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ osɔfo, ni kɛ Abraham yakpe be ni eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbee ní ejɔɔ lɛ lɛ,
ni Abraham hã lɛ nomŋɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai nyɔŋmɔ mli ekome. Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ egbɛi lɛ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ji "Jalɛ Maŋtsɛ;" no sɛɛ lɛ eji Salem Maŋtsɛ hu, ni no shishi ji "Hejɔlɛ Maŋtsɛ."
Ebɛ tsɛ lɛ, ebɛ nyɛ, ebɛ wekukpãa, ebɛ gbii ashishijee loo wala naagbee tete; shi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ehiɔ shi akɛ osɔfo daa nɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛkwɛa bɔ nu mɔnɛ da hã, akɛ blematsɛ Abraham lɛ tete ŋɔ nomŋɔɔnii kpakpai lɛ amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome ehã lɛ!
Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni tsuɔ osɔfoi anitsumɔ lɛ hu yɛ kitã ko akɛ amɛhe mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ yɛ Mla lɛ naa, no ji yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ adɛŋ, tsɛ amɛ hu amɛjɛ Abraham mli;
shi mɔ ni bɛ wekukpãa ko yɛ amɛteŋ nɛɛ, ehe mlijai nyɔŋmalɛ mli ekome yɛ Abraham ete dɛŋ, ni ejɔɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ shiwoi lɛ tete.
Shi ebɛ ŋwanejee ko kwraa akɛ mɔ ni da fe mɔ lɛ, lɛ ejɔɔ mɔ ni edaaa lɛ. '
Ni asaŋ, biɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni gboiɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni heɔ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ, shi jɛi lɛ, mɔ ko ni aye ehe odase akɛ ehiɔ shi daa lɛ he.
Ni, kɛ makɛɛ nakai lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ Abraham nɔ lɛ ahe mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ yɛ Levi ni heɔ no lɛ hu dɛŋ,
Ejaakɛ eyɛ etsɛ lɛ mli lolo, be ni Melkizedek kɛ lɛ bakpe lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ kɛji emuuyeli tsɔ̃ Levibii asafoyeli lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ (ejaakɛ no nɔ atsɔ̃ awo maŋ lɛ Mla lɛ), mɛɛ hiamɔ ehia lolo akɛ osɔfo kroko ate shi yɛ Melkizedek hnɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa?
Ejaakɛ kɛ atsake osɔfoyeli lɛ, belɛ eha ehīa akɛ atsake Mla lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ mɔ he ni akɛɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ lɛ ejɛ akutso kroko mli, nɔ mli ni mɔ mo jɛko ebasɔ̃mɔko yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ he pɛŋ;
ejaakɛ eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Yuda mli wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jɛ, shi nakai akutso lɛ Mose ewieee he nɔ ko yɛ osɔfoyeli hewɔ.
Ni ejeɔ kpo faŋŋ kwraa fe nɛkɛ kɛji osɔfo te shi ni tamɔ Melkizedek.
osɔfo ni jeeee heloo kitã mla naa awo lɛ yɛ, shi moŋ wala ni fiteee lɛ hewalɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ aye odase akɛ, "Osɔfo ji o kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa."
Ejakɛ kitã ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ, akɛni ebɛ hewalɛ ni ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hewɔ lɛ agu,
ejaakɛ Mla lɛ hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko aye emuu, shi agbɛnɛ ahã hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni hi fe no eba, nɔ nɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔbɛŋkɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Shi Kristo lɛ, kitãkãmɔ akɛwo lɛ, yɛ mɔ ni kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ekã kitã ni eshwaŋ ehe, akɛ, 'Osɔfo ji o kɛmiiya naanɔ,'" lɛ wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ,
babaoo ni kpãŋmɔ ni Yesu ji sɛɛdaamɔlɔ yɛ mli lɛ hi fe no ji no.
Ni amɛ lɛ, akɛni gbele hãaa amɛwo shihilɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi pii amɛye osɔfoi;
shi mɔnɛ lɛ, akɛni ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ hewɔ lɛ, esɔfoyeli lɛ sɛɛ efoooo.
No hewɔ hu lɛ enyɛɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛbaa Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ ayiwala ehereɔ kwraa, akɛni eyɛ daa koni edamɔ mli ehã amɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yesu lɛ Osɔfonukpa ni sa wɔ pɛ nɛ. Mɔ ni he tse, ni efɔŋ ko bɛ ehe bɛ kpa ko, ni etse ehe kɛjɛ esha he, ni awo enɔ ahã ekwɔ fe ŋwɛii.

Ehe Ehīaaa lɛ, tamɔ nakai osɔfonukpai lɛ, akɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ eshã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai ahe afɔle tsutsu, dani eshã maŋ lɛ hu nɔ. Ejaakɛ efee enɛ shi kome nyɔŋlo, be ni oŋɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ege eshã afɔle lɛ!
Ejaakɛ Mla lɛ, gbɔmɛi gbedelɔi eŋɔwoɔ osɔfonukpai lɛ, shi wiem( ni akɛhã kitã yɛ Mla lɛ sɛɛ lɛ ewo Bi ni eye emuuu kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ Osɔfonukpa.
8: Shi nii ni wɔwieɔ lɛ mli sane titri nɛ, nɛkɛ Osɔfonukpa wɔyɔɔ; Osɔfonukpa ni ta mɔ ni je agbo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi
akɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ anɔkwa Buu lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ shi ni jeee gbɔmɔ ko shi lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔ.

Ejaakɛ osɔfonukpa fɛɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ, awo lɛ koni eŋɔ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei ebahã; no hewɔ lɛ ehīa akɛ mɔnɛ hu ana nɔ ko ni ekɛbahã. 4 Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyɔɔ kulɛ, eyeŋ osɔfo tete, ejaakɛ osɔfoini kɛ nikeenii yahãa yɛ Mla lɛ naa yɛ,

tsɛ amɛ lɛ ŋwɛi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ kɛ esusuma kɛkɛ mli amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ Mose, be ni ebaafee buu lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni ofee nibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ o yɛ gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa."
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ osɔfoyeli ni Kristo ena lɛ hi kwraa fe tsutsunɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni kpãŋmɔ ni eji emlidaamɔlɔ lɛ hi fe tsutsunɔ ni adamɔ shiwoi ni hi fe tsutsunii lɛ anɔ lɛ akpãŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eji sane ko bɛ tsutsunɔ lɛ he kulɛ, ataooo gbɛ ahãaa nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwa amɛ ekɛɛ, "Naa, gbii miiba, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ni mikɛ Israel we lɛ kɛ Yuda we lɛ aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ hee,
jeee tamɔ kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ Gbi nɔ ni mimɔ amɛnine shi ni mikɛ amɛ je Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ. Ni mi hu mijwɛŋŋ amɛnɔ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
Shi enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ Israel we lɛ baakpãŋ yɛ nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, Mikɛ mimlai aaawo amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli, ni maŋma mawo amɛtsui mli, ni matsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.
Ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko etsɔ̃ŋ emaŋnyo loo wnyɛmi dɔŋŋ akɛ,'Le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.' Ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛaale mi, kɛaajɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mana amɛ mɔbɔ yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ, ni amɛhe eshai lɛ hu mikaiŋ dɔŋŋ."
Ekɛ wiemɔ "ehee" ni ekɛɛ nɛɛ ehã klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ efee emomo. Shi nɔ ni efee emomo kɛ nɔ ni egbɔ lɛ, etsɛŋ ni eeelaaje.
9: Agbɛnɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ he gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ ashi buu ko amã shi, ni he ni oyiɔ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, kanetso kɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ hiɛmaa aboloi lɛ yɔɔ jɛi; atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Shi mumɔɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ buu yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe fɛɛ!
Jɛi shika tsofãkɛŋma shãa nɔ lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka ni akɛ shika ehe he fɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ; no mli shika kpulu kɛ emli mana lɛ kɛ Aaron tso ni gba afofro lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔ tɛi tɛtrɛbii lɛ yɔɔ.
Ni no nɔ anumnyam kerubem ni ha kpãtãmɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ; nii ni amrɔ nɛɛ wɔnyɛŋ amɛhe wɔwie ekomekome lɛ.
Ni be ni asaa nibii nɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ yaa klɛŋklɛŋ buu lɛ mli daa gbi, amɛyatsuɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ;
shi buu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛkɛ yaa mli shi kome daa afi, ni eyaaa ni ehiɛɛɛ lá, ni ekɛyahãa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ tɔ̃mɔi ni amɛleee lɛ ahewɔ lɛ.
Enɛ MUmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ gbii abɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ buu lɛ mã shi lolo nɛɛ, belɛ gbɛ ni akɛyaa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anako ajie shi atsɔ̃ɔ.
Eji benɛ be lɛ he okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei ni akɛbahãa lɛ nyɛŋ ahã mɔ ni jaa lɛ aye emuu yɛ henilee gbɛfaŋ,
ejaakɛ nibii nɛɛ kɔɔ niyenii kɛ ninumɔnii kɛ hejuu srɔtoi ni heloo gbɛnaanii ni ato akɛ afee kɛkɛ ahe kɛyashi be ni aaasaa nibii fɛɛ afee amɛ ehee.
Shi Kristo ni ba akɛ nibii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ ahe Osɔfonukpa lɛ, etsɔ̃ buu ni da ni hi kɛwula shi fe klɛŋklɛŋnɔ lɛ mli; buu ni jeee niji akɛfee, no ji akɛ jeee je nɛɛ mli bɔɔnii amli ejɛ;
ni asaŋ jeee too kpakpoi loo tsinabii alá lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃, shi moŋ etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá lɛ nɔ ebote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli shi kome nyɔŋlo ekɛna naanɔ kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ too kpakpo kɛ tsinai alá kɛ tsina yoo lamlu ni atsɔɔ ashwãa mɛi ni ebule amɛhe lɛ anɔ lɛ tsuuɔ amɛhe ni amɛhe tseɔ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ,
enyiɛ nɔŋŋ Kristo ni tsɔ̃ naanɔ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ eŋɔ ehe ni kpa ko bɛ he lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ tsumɔŋ wɔhenilee lɛ he kɛjɛŋ nitsumɔi gbohii amli, koni wɔsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ.

Ni enɛ hewɔ eji kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ amɛ lɛ anine ashɛ naanɔ gboshinii lɛ ni ewo he shi lɛ nɔ, akɛni ekɛ egbele kpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ amli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ he ni awo sahmaŋsheo yɛ lɛ, ehe ehia akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mɔ ni wo lɛ egbo,
ejaakɛ samaŋsheo lɛ, ja agbo dani enaa hewalɛ, akɛni kɛji mɔ ni wo lɛ hiɛ kã lolo lɛ, ebɛ hewalɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ hu ashiii lá sɛɛ awoooo lɛ.

Ejaakɛ be ni Mose ejaje kitã etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ tsinabii kɛ too kpakpoi lɛ alá lɛ kɛ nu kɛ topo gwaŋtɛŋ hetsɔi tsuru kɛ hisopo, ni ekɛ shwã wolo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ
ekɛɛ, "Naa, kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo nyɛ he kitã lɛ lá lɛ nɛ."
Ni buu lɛ hu kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he nii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ lá lɛ shwã nɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni shwɛ fioo ni lá akɛtsuuɔ nii fɛɛ he yɛ Mla lɛ naa; ni kɛ ashwieee lá shi lɛ, akɛfaaa.
Belɛ eha ehīa akɛ nii ni ji ŋwɛinii lɛ afoniri nɛɛ akɛ enɛɛmɛi atsuu he; shi ŋwɛinii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, afɔlei ni hi fe nomɛi akɛtsuuɔ he.
Ejaakɛ jeee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛ niji fee ni ji nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ afoniri kɛkɛ lɛ mli Kristo yabote lɛ; shimoŋ ŋwɛi diɛŋtsɛ eyabote, koni agbɛnɛ eyapue yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ahã wɔ.
Asaŋ eyaboteee jɛi koni eŋɔ ehe ehã shii abɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ yaboteɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ daa afi kɛ lá ni jeeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ;

ejaakɛ nakai ni kulɛ, esa akɛ ena amanehulu kpitiokpitio kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee beebe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ shi kome kɛkɛ ajie lɛ kpo yɛ bei lɛ anaagbee lɛ mli, koni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ni ekɛshã afɔle lɛ ajie esha lɛ.
Gbii abɔ ni ekã shi ehã gBɔmɛi akɛ shi kome amɛgboiɔ, shi no sɛɛ lɛ abaakojo amɛ lɛ,
nakai nɔŋŋ Kristo hu, akɛni aŋɔ lɛ ahã shi kome koni etre mɛi pii ahe eshai kɛya lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ eeeshi esha ebapue ehã mɛi ni kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ ni ehere amɛuiwala.
10: Ejaakɛ nii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ asusuma kɛkɛ Mla lɛ hiɛ, ni jeee nibii lɛ asubaŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni, hewɔ lɛ enyɛŋ ekɛ daa afi afɔlei ni ashãa nɔtonɔto lɛ ahã mɛi ni babɛŋkɛɔ lɛ ahi kɛwula shi gbi ko gbi ko.
