Jeee nakai kulɛ ani afɔŋ afɔlei lɛ shãa? Ejaakɛ kulɛ mɛi ni bajaa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ atsuu amɛhe shi kome lpɛ lɛ, amɛbɛ eshai ahe nilee kwraa dɔŋŋ.
Shi moŋ afɔlei Lɛ, kaimɔ akɛ kaiɔ eshai daa afi,
ejaakɛ anyɛŋ akɛ tsinai kɛ too kpakpo alá ajie eshai.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni Yesu baa je nɛɛ mli lɛ akɛɛ, "Afɔle kɛ nikeenii lɛ osumɔɔɔ, shi gbɔmɔtso osaa ohã mi,
Shãa afɔlei kɛ esha he afɔlei esaaa ohiɛ,
No ni mikɛɛ, 'Naa, miba, aŋma mihe sane yɛ wolokpo lɛ mli. Ni mibafee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, osuɔmɔnaanii lɛ.'"
Be ni ekɛɛ tsutsu lɛ akɛm "Afɔle kɛ nikeenii kɛ shãa afɔle kɛ esha he afɔlei lɛ osumɔ̃ɔɔ, ni esaaa ohiɛ hu," (nii ni akɛbahãa yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ);
ni esaa ekɛɛ, "Naa, miba nu mibafe bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, osuɔmɔnaanii lɛ," ejie tsutsu nɔ lɛ koni ekɛ nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ama shi.
Nakai suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ mli atsuu wɔne yɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo gbɔmɔtso ni ekɛhã shi kome nyɔŋlo lɛ nɔ.
Ni osɔfo fɛɛ osɔfo lɛ, gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, edamɔɔ shi esɔ̃mɔɔ, ni eshãa nakai afɔlei lɛ nɔŋŋ kpitiokpitio, nii ni nyɛɛɛ eshai ajie gbi ko gbi ko lɛ.
Shi Kristo lɛ, lɛ lɛ, be ni eshã eshai ahe afɔle shi kome nyɔŋlo lɛ, eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Ni nɔ ni eshwɛ ji akɛ eemɛ "Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaaŋɔ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ afee enajiashi maaŋoo."
Ejaakɛ afɔle kome ni eshã lɛ, ekɛhã mɛi ni atsuu amɛhe lɛ ehi kɛwula shi nyɔŋlo.
Ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu yeɔ wɔ odase; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ momo akɛ,
"Enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ amɛ aaakpãŋ yɛ nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ. Mikɛ mimlai lɛ aaawo amɛtsuii amli, ni maŋma mawo amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli,
Ni amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛ amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ mikaiŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ."
Ni he ni akɛ enɛɛmɛi efa yɛ lɛ, eshai ahe afɔLeshãa ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔyɛ ekãa ni wɔkɛaabote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ Yesu lã lɛ hewɔ.
Eji gbɛ hee ni ji wala gbɛ ni eje ehã wɔ kɛtsɔ̃ muhɔɔ lɛ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo lɛ mli.
Ni asaŋ akɛni wɔyɛ Osɔfonukpa kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ.
nyɛhãa wɔkɛ anɔkwa tsui ababɛŋkɛa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni wɔyɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ mli, kɛ tsui hu ni atsuu he ni ebɛ henilee fɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ, kɛ gbɔmɔtso ni akɛ nu ni mli tse eju he.
Ni nyɛhãa wɔmɔa wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ jajemɔ lɛ mli ni awaa ni ekagbugbãa, ejaakɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ anɔkwafo ni.
Ni nyɛhãa wɔyɔseyɔsea wɔhe, koni wɔhiɛ adɔ suɔmɔ kɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe,
Ni wɔkakwa wɔhe naabuamɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi komɛi fɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, shi moŋ wɔwowoo wɔhe ŋaa, ni titri lɛ akɛni nyɛmiima akɛ Gbi lɛ miibɛŋkɛ nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ kwa wɔkwaa wɔfeɔ esha, be ni wɔna wɔle anɔkwale lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, belɛ eshai ahe afɔle ko bɛ dɔŋŋ;
shi kojomɔ gbɛkwɛmɔ ni yɔɔ gbeyei kɛkɛ, kɛ la grigri ni baashã henyɛlɔi lɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kwa Mose Mla lɛ, anaaa lɛ mɔbɔ, shi mɛi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ odaseyeli naa lɛ agbeɔ lɛ.
Belɛ gbɔmɔ ko ni enaanaa Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ ni ebu kpãŋmɔ lá ni akɛtsuu ehe lɛ akɛ yaka nɔ ko, ni efee dromɔ Mumɔ lɛ niseniianii lɛ, te nyɛsusuɔ akɛ toigblamɔ ni sa lɛ mli baawa tɛŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ wɔle mɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ, "Minɔ ji oweletɔɔ, ni mawo he nyɔmɔ" lɛ; ni asaŋ, "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaakojo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ."
Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ dɛŋ gbeemɔ yɛ gbeyei pam.
Shi nyɛkaia be ni eho lɛ, be ni la atso yɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ yɛ amanehulu ta babaoo mli.
Eko mli lɛ akɛ jɛmɔ kɛ amanehului sɔŋŋ hã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ kwɛmɔnii, ni eko hu mli lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ kwɛmɔnii, ni eko hu mli lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni afee amɛ nakai lɛ ananemɛi nɔnalɔi;
ejaakɛ nyɛmusuŋ shã nyɛ yɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ gboklɛi lɛ ahewɔ, ni nyɛnii ni aha lɛ hu nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ kplɛ̃, akɛni nyɛle akɛ nyɛyɛ jwetri ni hi fe no aahuu ni hiɔ shi daa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashɛa nyɛmli ekãa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a ejaakɛ eyɛ nyɔmɔwo kpeteŋkple.
Ejaakɛ tsuishitoo he ehīa nyɛ, koni, be ni nyɛfee Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, nyɛnine ashɛ shiwoo lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ, "Be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mɔ ni baa lɛ aaaba, ni etsɛŋ kwraa.
SHi mɔ ni ja yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ, yi aaana wala; ni kɛ ekpa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ misuma naŋ ehe tsuijurɔ."
Shi wɔ lɛ, jeee mɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛyaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji wɔ, shi moŋ wɔji mɛi ni kɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa amɛsusuma yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi.
11: Shi hemɔkɛyeli ji nii ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ anɔ hewalɛnamɔ kɛ nii ni anãaa lɛ anɔmimaa.
Ejaakɛ no mli aye blemabii lɛ ahe odase kpakpa yɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli wɔkɛyoɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wiemɔ bɔ je lɛ, hewɔ lɛ nibii ni anaa lɛ jɛ nibii ni anãaa lɛ mli.
Hemɔkɛyeli Habel kɛshã afɔle ni fe Kain nɔ lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ, no hewɔ hu ni aye ehe odase akɛ jalɔ ji lɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he enikeenii lɛ; ni no nɔŋŋ nɔ etSɔ̃ɔ ewieɔ lolo, tsɛ egbo.
Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ aŋɔ Henok kɛtee (ŋwɛi), koni ekana gbele, ni anãaa lɛ dɔŋŋ akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee lɛ; ejaakɛ dani aaaŋɔ lɛ kɛya lɛ aye ehe odase akɛ esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Shi kɛji hemɔkɛyeli bɛ lɛ anyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ esa; ejaakɛ mɔ ni baa Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ja ehe eye akɛ eyɛ, ni eji mɛi ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ anyɔmɔwolɔ hu.
Hemɔkɛyeli Noa hu kɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi be ni ehã ele nii ni anako lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ, ni ekɛkpɛ adeka ehã ewe lɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ; no nɔ hu etsɔ̃ ebu je lɛ fɔ, ni enine shɛ jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ nɔ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Abraham kɛbo toi be ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ lɛ. ni eyiŋ etee he ni eyaa.
Hemɔkɛyeli akɛyahi shiwoo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ gbɔ, ni ekɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ni ekɛ amɛji nakai shiwoo lɛ nɔŋŋ yelɔi lɛ hi buui amli;
ejaakɛ eekwɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ shishitoo ni wa etolɔ kɛ emalɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛc gbɛ,
Hemɔkɛyeli Sara hu kɛna hewalɛ ni ekɛna musu, ni lɛ ni egbɔ eho lɛ aahuu lɛ efɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ ebu lɛ anɔkwafo.
No hewɔ hu ni ajɛ mɔ kome ni tamɔ mɔ ni egbo momo lɛ mli afɔ mɛi ni fa babaoo tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii loo ŋshɔ naa shia ni anyɛɛɛ akane lɛ.,
Hemɔkɛyeli mli mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ gboi yɛ. Shɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛna nii ni awo he shi lɛ yɛ ni amɛnya he, tsɛ amɛnine shɛko nɔ, ni amɛjaje akɛ gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nakai nibii lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ amɛmiishwe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ.
Ni eji amɛhiɛ yɛ he ni amɛjɛ kɛba lɛ nɔ kulɛ, amɛyɛ hegbɛ nu amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee jɛi ekoŋŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛmiitao maŋ ni hi fe no, ni ji ŋwɛi nɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ efeee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛgble akɛ aaatsɛ lɛ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ esaa maŋ eto amɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli naa Abraham ŋɔ Isak eyashã afɔle be ni akã lɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ ebi kome lɛ ba ebahã, be ni enine eshɛ shiwoi lɛ anɔ momo lɛ.
Lɛ mɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Isak mli aaatsɛ oshwie yɛ" lɛ;
ejaakɛ ebu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛaatee lɛ shi kɛaajɛ gbohii ateŋ tete, ni lɛɛlɛŋ, kɛ aaawie lɛ abɛbuaŋ lɛ, enine shɛ enɔ ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ jɛi..
Hemɔkɛyeli Isak kɛjɔɔ Yakob kɛ Esau yɛ nii ni baaba lɛ ahewɔ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Yakob kɛjɔɔ Yosef bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ be ni egboɔ ni ehiɛ edɛ̃hiɛmɔtso lɛ mli kɛma eyi shi esɔle lɛ.
Hemkɛyeli Yosef hu kɛtsī Israelbii lɛ Egipt jee lɛ tã be nui ejeɔ jeŋ ni ewo lɛ diɛŋTsɛ ewui lɛ ahe kitã lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Mose fɔlɔi lɛ kɛŋɔ lɛ tee nyɔji etɛ̃ be ni afɔ lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ gbekɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni amɛsheee maŋtsɛ lɛ akpɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ be ni Mose da lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Farao biyoo lɛ bi,
eeesumɔ moŋ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ ana amanehulu fe nɔ ni eeeye esha mli ŋɔɔmɔ be fioo ko lɛ;
ebuɔ Kristo hewɔ ahorabɔɔ lɛ akɛ nii babaoo fe Egipt jwetri lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔSɛɛ nyɔmɔwo gbɛ ekwɛɔ.
Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛje Egipt ni esheeee maŋtsɛ lɛ mlifu lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ emɔ mɔ ni anaaa lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ emɔ mɔ ni anaaa lɛ lɛ mli tamɔ nɔ ni eena lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛto Hehoo lɛ kɛ ladikimɔ lɛ, koni mɔ ni kpãtãa kromɔbii lɛ ahiɛ akata Israelbii lɛ ahe.
Hemɔkɛyeli amɛkɛfo ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ, nɔ ni Egiptbii lɛ hu ka feemɔ, ni emii amɛ lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli naa Yeriko gbogboi lɛ kumɔ shwie shi be ni Isaraelbii bɔle lɛ gbii kpawo lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ Rahab, ajwamaŋ lɛ, pleneee efataaamɛi ni heee yeee kɛ ahe lɛ, ejaakɛ ehere sralɔi lɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ.
Ni mɛni makɛɛ dɔŋŋ? Ejaakɛ minaŋ mihe dekã bɔ ni mikɛaagba Gideon kɛ Barak, Samson kɛ Yefta, David kɛ Samuel kɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahe sane:
mɛi ni tsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ amɛye maŋtsɛyelii anɔ kunim, amɛtsu jalɛnii, amɛnine shɛ shiwoi anɔ, amɛtsimɔ jatai anaa,
amɛgbe la hewalɛ, amɛje klaŋtei anaa, amɛna hewalɛ kɛjɛ gbedemɔ mli, amɛhe wa yɛ ta mli, amɛwo mɛib kpɔ̃ji ata lɛ foi.
Yei anine shɛ amɛmɛi ni egboi lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ kɛtsɔ̃ shitee nɔ. Shi mɛi krokomɛi hu, akɛ piŋmɔ gbe amɛ, ni amɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ kpɔ̃mɔ, koni amɛnine ashɛ shitee ni hi fe no lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi komɛi hu aye amɛhe fɛo ni ayi amɛ kplebii ni awo amɛ gboklɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ;
atswia amɛ tɛi, akɛ klaŋte gbe amɛ; ahã amɛwo too gwaŋteŋi kɛ too abotiai awoji kɛnyiɛ, ohīa hīa amɛ, awa amɛ yi, afee amɛ niseniianii;
mɛi ni je nɛɛŋ esaaa amɛ lɛ, amɛtsomlo yɛ shiaŋai kɛ gɔ̃ji anɔ, kɛ tɛkploi kɛ shikpɔŋ fɔ̃ɔJi amli.
Ni mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, aye amɛhe odase kpakpa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ hewɔ moŋ, shi amɛnine shɛɛɛ shiwoonii lɛ anɔ,
ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ esaa nɔ ko kpata eto wɔ, koni amɛkaye emuu amɛshi wɔ.
12: No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔ hu, akɛni wɔyɔɔ odasefoi babaoo ni ebɔle wɔ tamɔ atatu nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔshɛa jatsu fɛɛ jatsu kɛ esha ni ebɔle wɔ kpula lɛ wɔfɔ̃a. Ni wɔkɛ hiɛmiamɔ ada foi ni kã wɔhiɛ lɛ.

Ni wɔkwɛ hemɔkɛyeli shishijelɔ kɛ naagbelɔ ni ji Yesu lɛ, mɔ ni nyamɔ ni kã ehiɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ emia ehiɛ yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he amanehulu lɛ mli. Ni ebuuu hiɛgble lɛ, ni eyata shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛjwɛŋa mɔ ni ŋmɛ etsui shi ehã nibii ni eshafeelɔi kɛɛ kɛshi lɛ lɛ he, koni ekaje nyɛtsine ni nyɛsusumai miitɔ biti.
Nyɛnako nyɛgbee hiɛ kɛyashi lájee mli yɛ nyɛ kɛ esha tawuu lɛ mli;
ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa hewalɛwoo wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ wieɔ bɔ ni akɛ bii wieɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Mibi, kaabu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ akɛ nɔ ko bibioo, ni asaŋ, kɛ ehã ohiɛ lɛ, kaahã onijiaŋ miije wui;
ejaakɛ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ lɛ, lɛ etsɔseɔ, ni eyiɔ bi fɛɛ bi ni ekɛfeɔ enɔ lɛ."
Nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ yɛ nɔnaa lɛ mli akɛ tsɔsemɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyɛ akɛ ebii; ejaakɛ mɛɛ bi yɔɔ ni etsɛ tsɔseee lɛ?
kɛji nyɛnaaa tsɔsemɔ ni mɛi fɛɛ naa lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ ajwamaŋbii ji nyɛ, shi jeee kpeemɔ yoo bii.
Asaŋ wɔyɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ tsɛmɛi ni tsɔseɔ wɔ, ni wɔbuɔ amɛ, Ani esaaa akɛ wɔba wɔhe shi fe nakai wɔhã mumɔi a-Tsɛ lɛ koni wɔyi ana wala?
Amɛ lɛ, gbii fioo ko kɛkɛ amɛtsɔseɔ wɔ koni ahi ahã wɔ ni wɔna ekrɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ lɛ eko.
Shi tsɔsemɔ fɛɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ efeee mɔ akɛ miishɛɛ nɔ ni, shi dɔlɛ nɔ moŋ; shi kɛ fee sɛɛ lɛ ewoɔ hejɔlɛ yibii ni ji jalɛ lɛ eha6a mɛi ni tsɔsemɔ lɛ esa amɛ lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛwajea niji ni egbede kɛ nakutsei ni egbɔjɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛfea gbɛi ni yɔɔ tsɔ̃mɔɔ nyɛhãa nyɛnaji, koni otsɔɔlɔ nane akahwaŋ, shi moŋ atsa lɛ.
Nyɛtiua nYɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ateŋ hejɔlɛ sɛɛ kɛ hetsemɔ ni kɛ mɔ ko shi enaŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni mɔ ko akaŋmŋɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ he, koni shishifã kɛ joomɔ ko akakwɛ̃ ni ehao nyɛ ni ekɛbule mɛi pii.
Koni mɔ ko akafee ehe jwamaŋbɔlɔ loo mɔ ni ebuuu Nyɔŋmɔ nii, tamɔ Esau ni hɔ̃ɔ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ehe ŋmaa shikomeyeli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ, be ni fee sɛɛ ni etao akɛ ena jɔɔmɔ lɛ, akwa lɛ; ni enaaa; tsɛbelɛ ekɛ yaafonui tao tsuitsakemɔ hegbɛ.
Jeee Sinai Gɔŋ ni tsoɔ kɛ la ni anaa kɛ hiŋmɛi kɛ atatu kpii kɛ duŋ kabitii kɛ ahum,
kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ wiemɔi agbɛɛmɔ ni mɛi ni nu lɛ kpa fai akɛ akawie eko afata he dɔŋŋ lɛ he nyɛba;
ejaakɛ kitã he dɔŋŋ akɛ, "Kɛji kooloo ko tete ta gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, atswia lɛ tɛ" lɛ, amɛnyɛɛ mli amɛhi.
Ni nɔ ni pue lɛ he yɛ gbeyei babaoo aahuu bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ, "Miishe gbeyei, ni mihe miikpokpo."
Shi moŋ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ maŋ; ŋwɛi Yerusalem lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi akpeiakpei abɔ ahenaabuamɔ lɛ,
kɛ kromɔbii ni aŋma amɛgbɛii yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ asafo lɛ he nyɛba. Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji mɛi fɛɛ akojolɔ lɛ, jalɔi ni ehi kɛwula shi lɛ amumɔi lɛ,
kɛ kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ Yesu lɛ, kɛ lá ni atsɛɔ ashwã ni wieɔ wiemɔ kpakpa fe Hebal nɔ lɛ, aŋɔɔ.
Nyɛkwɛa ni ahīa, koni nyɛkakwa mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ mɛi ni kwa mɔ ni wie tsɔ̃ɔamɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe ejeee mli lɛ, belɛ wɔ lɛ, wɔhe ejeŋ mli kwraa kɛji wɔkpale kɛjɛ mɔ ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ he.
Lɛ egbeee hoso shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ no be lɛ mli, shi agbɛnɛ ewo shi ekɛɛ, "Mahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ shi kome ekoŋŋ, ni jeee shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi ŋwɛi hu."
"Shi kome ekoŋŋ" ni ekɛɛ lɛ, ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ fŋŋ akɛ nii ni ahosoɔ lɛ aaaho aya, ejaakɛ nii ni afee ni, koni nii ni hosoŋ lɛ ahi shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔna maŋtsɛyeli ni anyɛŋ ahoso lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔdaa shi ni wɔkɛsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni sa ehiɛ kɛ woo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ!
Ejaakɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, la ni fiteɔ nii hu ji lɛ.
13: Nyɛhãa nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ahīa shi daa.
Gbɔfeemɔ hu, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ; ejaakɛ no nɔ mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃ fee ŋwɛi bɔfoi agbɔ ni amɛleee.
Nyɛkaia mɛi ni awo amɛ gboklɛi lɛ tamɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ kãmɔ mli, kɛ mɛi afeɔ amɛ efɔŋ lɛ hu, akɛni nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ heloo mli lolo lɛ.
Awo gblã hiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛteŋ, ni akabule gblã saa hu; shi ajwamaŋbɔlɔi kɛ gblãŋkulɔI lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo amɛ.
Shikasuɔmɔ akaba nyɛjeŋba mli; ni nyɛmii ashɛ nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ he; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ, "Mishiŋ o ni misaa mikwaŋ o gbi ko gbi ko."
Bɔ ni afee nɔ wɔna ekãa ni wɔkɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji miyelikɛbualɔ, ni misheŋ gbeyei. Mɛni gbɔmɔ aaafee mi?"
Nyɛkaia nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, mɛi ni wie Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; nyɛkwɛa amɛshihilɛ lɛ naagbee, ni nyɛkasea amɛmemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Yesu Kristo lɛ, bɔ ni eyɔɔ nyɛ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eyɔɔ kɛyaa naanɔ.
Nyɛkahãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔi srɔtoi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi krokomɛi kɛ nyɛ miililaa shi; ejaakɛ ehi akɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ awo tsui hewalɛ, shi jeee niyenii ni hãa mɛi ni tsuɔ he nii lɛ ana sɛɛ ko yɛ mli lɛ.
Wɔyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ko ni mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ buu lɛ mli lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛyeɔ enɔ nii.
Ejaakɛ kooloi ni osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ amɛlá kɛyaa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ esha hewɔ lɛ agbohii lɛ ayashãa yɛ nsra lɛ sɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu, bɔ ni afee ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá lɛ atsuu maŋ lɛ he lɛ, agbo lɛ sɛɛ ena amanehulu lɛ yɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, nyɛhãa wɔjea kpo kɛyaa eŋɔɔ yɛ nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni wɔtere ehorabɔɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔbɛ maŋ ni hiɔ shi yɛ biɛ, shi maŋ ni baaba lɛ moŋ sɛɛgbɛ wɔtaoɔ.
Belɛ nyɛhãa wɔtsɔ̃a enɔ ni wɔkɛ yijiemɔ afɔle abahãa Nyɔŋmɔ daa; no ji, naabui ni jajeɔ egbɛi lɛ yibii lɛ.
Shi ejurɔfeemɔkɛ nikee lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ; ejaakɛ nakai afɔle saa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ jogbaŋŋ.

Nyɛboa nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ atoi, ni nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa amɛ; ejaakɛ amɛ amɛbuɔ nyɛsumai lɛ ahe akɛ mɛi ni baabu he akɔŋtaa, koni amɛkɛ miishɛɛ afee nii sɛɛ, shi jeee kɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔ; ejaakɛ no ehiii hãaa nyɛ.
Nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔyɛ nɔmimaa okɛ wɔyɛ henilee kpakpa, ni wɔmimaa akɛ wɔyɛ henilee kpakpa, ni wɔmiitao akɛ wɔba wɔjeŋ fɛɛfɛo yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
Ni miikpa nyɛ fai babaoo akɛ nyɛfee nakai, koni akpale mi ahã nyɛ oya.
Shi hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie toi lɛ akwɛlɔ kpeteŋkple ni ji wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ lá lɛ mli lɛ,
lɛ esaa nyɛ ehã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa, ni nyɛfee esuɔmɔnaanii, ni etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ efee nɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ nyɛmli. Lɛ aŋɔ anumnyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛmɔ wiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ wiemɔ kukuoo miŋma mimaje nyɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ aŋmɛɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo he, ni kɛ eba mra lɛ mikɛ lɛ aaaba mabana nyɛ.
Wɔmiiba nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm. Mɛi ni jɛ Italia lɛ miibi nyɛ.
Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.

1: Yehowa wiemɔ ni ekɛ Hosea, ni ji Beeri bi lɛ , wie yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi Uzia kɛ Yotam kɛ Ahaz kɛ Hezekia ayinɔ lɛ nɛ. No mli lɛ Yeroboam, Yoash bi lɛ, miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.

Be ni Yehowa kɛ Hosea bɔ̃i wiemɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Hosea akɛ, "Yaa ni oyaŋɔ yoo ajwamaŋ koni okɛ lɛ afee oŋa; ni bii ni okɛ lɛ baafɔ lɛ baafee ajwamaŋ bii tamɔ bɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ekwa mi, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Hosea tee ni eyaŋɔ Diblaim biyoo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gomer lɛ. Gomer na musu ni efɔ binuu.

Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, "Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, 'Yezreel' ejaakɛ eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni lá shi ni Yehu shwie yɛ Yezreel maŋ lɛ mli lɛ mibatɔ he owele yɛ eshwiei anɔ, ni mibagu Yehu we lɛ maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibafite Israel tawuu hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yezreel jɔɔ lɛ mli."
Gomer na musu ekoŋŋ, ni efɔ biyoo. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, "Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, Lo-Ruhama: 'Mɔbɔnalɛ etã', ejaakɛ mikaŋ he mihaŋ mimusuŋ atsɔ̃ mi yɛ Israelbii ahe, ni mikɛfaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ Yuda he, ni mi Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibahere amɛyiwala; shi moŋ mitsɔ̃ŋ gãi loo klaŋte loo ta loo okpɔŋɔi loo tayaa okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ mihereŋ amɛyiwala."
Be ni Gomer etse ebi Lo-Ruhama fufɔ lɛ, esaa ena musu, ni efɔ binuu ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, "Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, Lo-Ammi 'Nyɛjeee mimaŋ,' ejaakɛ Israelbii jeee mimaŋ dɔŋŋ, ni mi hu jeee amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi."

Shi kɛ̃lɛ Israelbii ayikulɛ aaatamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia ni anyɛŋ asusu aloo akane. Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, he ni akɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛjeee mimaŋ lɛ,' jɛi nɔŋŋ abaakɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bii ji nyɛ."
No mli Yudabii kɛ Israelbii anaa aaabakpe shi kɛfee ekome, ni amɛaato mɔ koome akɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ, ni amɛaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yezreel gbi lɛ gbi wulu ni.
2: No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛa nyɛnyɛmimɛi hii, Israelbii, lɛ akɛ Ammi, "Mimaŋ ji amɛ" kɛ nyɛmimɛi yei lɛ hu akɛ Ruhama, "Mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe."
"Mibii, nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛ awiea, ejaakɛ jeee miŋa ji lɛ dɔŋŋ; ni mi hu jeee ewu ji mi. Nyɛkɛ lɛ awiea koni ekpa ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ, ni efo egblãfitemɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ maŋmɛ lɛ yayai tamɔ gbi ni afɔ lɛ lɛ; mahãetsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋanɔ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ egbi, ni mikɛ kumai baagbe lɛ.
Asaŋ minaŋ emusuŋbii lɛ hu amɔbɔ, ejaakɛ yoo ajwamaŋ bii ji amɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛnyɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ; efee hiɛgbejianii kɛna amɛ musu. Ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, 'Hã maya mayatiu mishieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; amɛ amɛhãa mi niyenii kɛ nu kɛ mikuŋtu kɛ klala lɛ kɛ mimu kɛ dãa.'
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mikɛ ŋmei gbogbo kɛsa eyi koni matsi lɛ gbɛ.

Eeetiu eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ nɛ, shi eninaŋ amɛ; ni eeetao amɛ, shi enaŋ amɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ lɛ eeetao amɛ, shi enaŋ amɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ lɛ eeekɛɛ ehe akɛ, 'Hã makpale kɛya miklɛŋklɛŋ wu lɛ ŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ be ni mikɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ehi hã mi moŋ fe amrɔ nɛɛ.'
Te eŋɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ miji mɔ ni hã lɛ able kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛkɛjaa jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mashɔ̃ mible lɛ kɛ wain lɛ hu kɛ kuŋtu kɛ klala ni enaa ebuɔ lɛ.
Maŋmɛ lɛ yayai agbɛnɛ matsɔ̃ɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ lɛ ahere yɛ midɛŋ.
Mafo mliflimɔ gbii juji ni eyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ, nyɔji heei kɛ afi gbii juji lɛ, kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ.
Ni maŋla ewaintsei lɛ kɛ agbami tsei lɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ nomɛi ji nɔ ni enaa yɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ akɛ enyɔmɔwo lɛ. Mahã fɛɛ atsɔ̃ koo koni ŋaŋ kooloi aye amɛnɔ nii.
Magbla etoi yɛ tsofakɛŋma ni etee eyashã ehã Baal jemawɔji yɛ amɛgbii juji lɛ anɔ lɛ hewɔ. Ewula kɛ jwinei kɛtee eyanyiɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ, ni ehiɛ kpa minɔ." Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ mibagbe eyitso ni mi kɛ lɛ aaatee ŋa lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ; mi kɛ lɛ aaayawie naajɔlɛ wiemɔ yɛ jɛi koni eyiŋ atsɔ̃ kɛba shīa.
Makpale ewain tromii lɛ mahã lɛ, ni mahã Amanehulu Jɔɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ Hiɛnɔkãmɔ Agbo ahã lɛ. Eeehere mi nɔ tamɔ efee yɛ eblayeiaŋ lɛ be ni ejɛ Egipt eba lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ ebaatsɛ mi 'Miwu' ekoŋŋ, shi jeee 'Mi-Baal' dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ mibakɔ jemawɔji Baali lɛ agbɛii yɛ edaaŋ; ni etsiŋ amɛtã tete po dɔŋŋ.

"Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mikɛ ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii ni wamɔɔ fɛɛ aaakpãŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ koni amɛkaye nyɛ awui; ni makumɔ gãi kɛ klaŋte amli, ni mahã tawuu sɛɛ afo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaahi shi shweshweeshwe.
"Israel, mibatsɛ ohe baa akɛ miŋa kɛaatee naanɔ; Maye bo anɔkwa, ni maye o jalɛ sane, Masumɔ bo, ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe.
Maye mishiwoo nɔ, ni mafee bo miŋa, ni ooole akɛ miji Yehowa.
Nakai be lɛ mahã mimɛi, Israelbii, asɔlemɔ lɛ hetoo.
Mahã nu anɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ aba able kɛ wain kɛ mu ahã Israel.

Mahã mimɛi lɛ ahe shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mahã amɛshwere. Mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ akɛ 'Mɔbɔnalɛ etã' lɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni atsɛ amɛ akɛ 'Nyɛjeee mimɛi' lɛ, mibana amɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ. Ni makɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Mimɛi ji nyɛ,' ni amɛaahere nɔ akɛ 'boji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.'"
3: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaa ekoŋŋ ni oyasumɔ yoo ni ewu sumɔɔ lɛ, shi lɛ lɛ ekɛ nuu kroko miifite gblã. Osumɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, misumɔɔ mimɛi Israelbii lɛ; tsɛbelɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛkwa mi, ni amɛtee wɔji aŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ wain yibii yashãa afɔle amɛhãa amãgãi."
No hewɔ lɛ mikɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ akoko kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yahã yoo lɛ;
ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ hii shi kɛyɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ ohã mi; okabɔ ajwamaŋ, ni okayagbã nuu ko; ni mi hu mahi shi mahã o."
Ejaakɛ nakai pɛ Israel baahi shi gbii pii ni amɛbɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛbɛ lumɛi hu; asaŋ amɛshãaa afɔle; ni amɛbɛ shiu lɛ amɛbɛ efod kɛ terafim hu ni akɛbiɔ nii.

Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii baaku amɛsɛɛ, amɛaakpale, ni amɛaabatao Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, amɛaabatao amɛmaŋtsɛ ni ji David shwie ko hu sɛɛgbɛ. Nakai be lɛ amɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ aaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eeejɔɔ amɛ kɛ nibii kpakpai yɛ naagbee bei lɛ amli.
4: Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ena. "Anɔkwayeli kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ etã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni eleee Nyɔŋmɔ hu yɛ shikpoŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni eshwɛ amɛ pɛ ji kitãkamɔ kɛ amale kɛ mɔgbee kɛ juu kɛ gblãfitemɔ; amɛkuɔ mla fɛɛ mla mli, ni amɛshwieɔ lá shi ni eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baagbi, ni enɔ nibii fɛɛ baagboi. Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ nuŋ loi tete baagboi."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ko akashwa mɔ ko, ni mɔ ko akakã mɔ ko hiɛ hu, ejaakɛ nyɛ, Osɔfoi lɛ, nyɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni mikɛyɔɔ sane.
Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛaatɔ̃ shwane, ni gbalɔi lɛ hu kɛ nyɛ baatɔ̃ nyɔɔŋ; no hewɔ lɛ mibakpãtã Israel, nyɛnyɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã ejaakɛ amɛleee nii. Akɛni okwa nilee hewɔ lɛ, mi hu miikwa bo akɛ misɔfo; ni akɛni ohiɛ ekpa o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mihiɛ miikpa obii lɛ anɔ.
"Bɔ ni amɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, ayi faa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfeɔ esha babaoo amɛshiɔ mi; ni no hewɔ lɛ mibahã amɛhiɛ nyam lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛgble.
Amɛtsɔ̃ esha ni mimɛi lɛ feɔ lɛ nɔ amɛna nii, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛshweɔ akɛ mɛi aya nɔ afee esha.
Magbla osɔfoi lɛ atoi tamɔ maŋbii lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ amɛjeŋba hewɔ; mawo amɛnishaianii ni amɛfee lɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Amɛbaaye nii nɛ, shi amɛtrɔŋ, ni amɛaabɔ ajwamaŋ nɛ, shi amɛshwereŋ kɛ bii, ejaakɛ amɛkwa mi, Yehowa, ni amɛtee wɔji moŋ aŋɔɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Wain momo kɛ wain hee fɛɛ hãa nilee ŋmɛɔ mɔ.
Mimɛi biɔ tso akɛ egba, ni amɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtso lɛ gbaa amɛ teemɔŋ saji, ejaakɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ mumɔ ehã amɛkwa amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni amɛdu gbɛ, amɛtee wɔji aŋɔɔ.

Ameshã afɔlei yɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ, ni amɛshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ; ameshã yɛ odum kɛ onyai kɛ papao tsei ashishi, ejaakɛ tsei lɛ ahɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli hi. "Enɛ hewɔ ni nyɛbiyei lɛ bɔɔ ajwamaŋ, ni nyɛbihii aŋamɛi lɛ fiteɔ gblã lɛ.

Shi kɛji nyɛbiyei lɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ lɛ migblaŋ amɛtoi, ni kɛji nyɛbihii aŋamɛi lɛ hu fite gblã lɛ migblaŋ amɛtoi, ejaakɛ nyɛ, hii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tete lɛ nyɛ kɛ ajwamaŋi ni yɔɔ jamɔhe lɛ yabɔɔ ajwamaŋ, ni nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ shãa wɔŋjamɔ afɔlei lɛ. Naa, maŋ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ kpãtãa.

"Kɛji nyɛ, Israelbii, yeee mi anɔkwa yɛ mi jamɔ mli lɛ, nakai su lɛ akabla Yuda hu. Nyɛkayaa Gilgal, ni nyɛkayaa Bet-Aven hu nyɛyajaa; ni nyɛkɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ akakãa kitã akɛ 'Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ nɛɛ!'
Isrealbii akuɛŋ ti tamɔ tsina oblayoo. Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Yehowa aaalɛ amɛ tamɔ alɛɔ toobii yɛ ŋa shwaŋŋ nɔ hu?
Israel ekɔ wɔŋjamɔ efɔ enɔ; nyɛŋmɛa ejeŋ he nyɛhãa lɛ.
Kɛji amɛnunuu dãi ni amɛtrɔ sɛɛ lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ etsa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛsumɔɔ hiɛgble moŋ fe hiɛnyam.
Kɔɔyɔɔ fɔŋ ko baatswa amɛ waa, ni ebaahã amɛhiɛ agboi yɛ wɔŋjamɔ afɔleshãa hewɔ."
5: "Nyɛ Osɔfoi, nyɛboa sane nɛɛ toi! Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkaa toi! Nyɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli bii, nyɛfea toi, shi naa, abaakojo nyɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe tamɔ akpa ni atsɔ̃ yɛ Mizpa, kɛ yaa ni akɛlɛɛ shi yɛ Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ ebote nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ mli vii yɛ Akasia maŋ lɛ mli, mibagbla amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ toi waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Mile Efraim bɔ ni eyɔɔ tsɔ̃; no hewɔ lɛ Israel kɛ ehe eteeko mi. Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, Efraim, oje misɛɛ, ni Israel ebule ehe."
"Amɛnifeemɔnii hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ amɛku kɛba amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ mumɔ ebote amɛmli, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛleee mi, Yehowa dɔŋŋ.
Israel shwãa nii lɛ miiye odase moŋ eeshi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Israel kɛ Efraim hiɛ baakpãtã, ni Yuda hu kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.
Amɛkɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai baaya ayashã afɔle kɛtao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, shi amɛnaŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa egbla ehe shi eshi amɛ.
Akɛni amɛji Yehowa sɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyafɔ gbɔi abii. Shi nyɔŋ hee ni baaje lɛ mli lɛ abaakpãtã amɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ."
"Akpã ta tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ Gibea! Akpã koofɛŋ lɛ yɛ Rama! Abɔ oshe yɛ Bet-Aven! Ohe akpokpo, Benyamin!
Gbi nɔ ni abaagbla Efraim toi lɛ, ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. Naa, nɔ ni baaba Israel akutsei lɛ anɔ lɛ no mikɛɛ nɛɛ.
"Yuda lumɛi lɛ tsiɔ husu kɛyaa sɛɛ kɛjuɔ shikpɔŋ. Mahã mimlifu ate shi awo amɛ tamɔ nu ni etue.
Efraim kã piŋmɔ mli. Nyɔŋmɔ ebu lɛ fɔ ejaakɛ etswa efai shi akɛ eyaanyiɛ yaka nii asɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitsɔ̃ omlɛ̃gɛ̃ ni baaye Efraim, kɛ fla ni baakpãtã Yuda hiɛ.
"Be ni Israel na hela ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ni Yuda hu na fla ni efã lɛ, Efraim tee Asiria maŋtsɛ kpanaa lɛ ŋɔɔ eyabi edɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ, shi Asiria nyɛɛɛ amɛ tsofa efee aloo etsa amɛ.
Mibahuru tamɔ jata mayi Israel kɛ Yuda hu nɔ, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mibatserɛ amɛmli, kɛkɛ lɛ mishi amɛ mitee. Mashãtã amɛ kɛya ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ehere.
"Mibagbla mihe shi mashi amɛ kɛaayashi amɛaaklpɛ̃ amɛtɔ̃mɔ nɔ, ni amɛaabatao misɛɛgbɛ. Eko lɛ fimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaatao mi."
6: Maŋbii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Akɛni lɛ etserɛ wɔmli lɛ, lɛ eeetsa wɔ; ni akɛni lɛ etswia wɔ nii lɛ, lɛ eeefi nɔ ehã wɔ.
Gbii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, eeetsīɛ wɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ eeetee wɔ shi, ni wɔ kɛ lɛ aaahi shi.

Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa mɔdɛŋ wɔlea Yehowa. Bɔ ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ daa gbi lɛ je tsɛreɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ. Ebaaba wɔŋɔɔ tamɔ agbiɛnaa nunɛmɔ tueɔ shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Shi Yehowa kɛɔ akɛ, "Ao! Israel, mɛni mafee ohe? Ao! Yuda, te mafee bo tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ leebi atatu; etamɔ osuɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ leebi atatu; etamɔ leebi bɔ ni kplaa oya.
No hewɔ ni mitsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ migbla amɛtoi, ni mikɛ midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ kã amɛ, ni kojomɔ ni mikojo amɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ kane.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ ji suɔmɔ ni tsakeee shi jeee afɔle; nɔ ni mitaoɔ ji lee ni aleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shi jeee shãaafɔle.
"Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam fee lɛ, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa.
Gilead lɛ nɔfɔŋfeelɔi amaŋ ni, ni lá ewu amɛhe.
Tamɔ bɔ ni ojotswalɔi woɔ mɔ ka lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ pɛ osɔfoi lɛ efee ekome amɛgbeɔ mɛi, ni amɛfeɔ nishaianii yɛ Shekem gbɛteŋ.
Mina gbeyei nii ko yɛ Israel: Efraim kɛ amãgãjamɔ miibɔ ajwamaŋ yɛ jɛi; abule Israel.
"Ni bo, Yuda, hu mito be ni nɔ ni oduɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, obaakpa eyibii.
7: "Kɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ matsa mimiɛ Israelbii lɛ koni amɛshwere pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Efraim kɛ Samaria nifɔɔjianii lɛ eje kpo: no ji mɔshishiumɔ kɛ juu kɛ ojotswaaa yɛ gbɛteŋ.
Efeee amɛ kwraa akɛ miina amɛnifɔɔjinaa lɛ fɛɛ. Shi naa amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ ebɔle amɛ, ni miikwɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ hãa maŋtsɛ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe, ni amɛkɛ mɔshishinyiɛmɔ wiemɔ hãa lumɛi hu naa miishɛɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛiashishinyiɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa yɛ jamɔ mli. No hewɔ lɛ amɛtamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la ni awo ni nishãlɔ eŋmɛɛ he koni etso kɛyashi ma ni akpɔtɔ lɛ aaafu kɛha shãa.
Gbi nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ye egbijurɔ lɛ, lumɛi lɛ kɛ dãatɔɔ wo amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhe hela. Maŋtsɛ ta fɛoyelɔi tete po adɛ̃.
Yisto fɔŋ ni amɛto yɛ amɛtsui mli lɛ sukɔɔ yɛ amɛmli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni leebi lɛ etsoɔ grigri tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la.
"Amɛkɛ mlila ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ gbegbee amɛnɔyelɔi lɛ. Amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nyɔnyɔi, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ebooo etsɛɛɛ mi."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Bɔ ni Israel kɛ ehe fufuaa maŋsɛɛ maji anɔbii lɛ, ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ aboloo ni ebe fã kɛ fã.
Gbɔi lɛ ehã ehewalɛ etã, shi eyooko; eyiteŋ eje waŋ, shi ekɔɔɔ sɛɛ.
Israel shwãanii lɛ miye odase miishi lɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋbii lɛ kpaleee koni amɛba mi, Yehowa amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, aloo koni amɛtao misɛɛgbɛ.
Israel etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpo kwashia ni bɛ yitsoŋ; ŋmɛnɛ lɛ eetsɛ Egipt koni ebawa lɛ; wɔ lɛ eetsɛ Asiria.
Shi kɛji amɛshi kɛmiiya nɔŋŋ lɛ mibafɔ̃ amɛ nɔ yaa madu amɛ tamɔ aduɔ looflɔ, ni mibagbla amɛtoi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.
"Kpoo hã amɛ ejaakɛ amɛshi mi, ni amɛbɔ ko. Amɛhiɛ ekpãtã ejaakɛ amɛtse mihiɛ atūa. Mi lɛ mitao akɛ mahere amɛyiwala; shi amɛ lɛ amɛmalemaleɔ mihe.
Amɛfooo amɛtsɛɛɛ mi kɛjɛɛɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ; shi moŋ amɛsai anɔ amɛfoɔ waa yɛ. Kɛji amɛmiisɔle yɛ able kɛ wain he lɛ, amɛkɛ kakla flɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ feɔ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ etse mihiɛ atūa.
Yɛ mli akɛ miji mɔ ni tsɔse amɛ, ni mihã amɛna hewalɛ nɛ, shi daa nɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ pɛ amɛjwɛŋɔ yɛ mihe.
Amɛkã he amɛmiija Baal lolo, ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãitso ni waaa. Naafuu wiemɔi ni amɛlumɛi lɛ wieɔ lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa. Ni enɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɔ ni akɛaaye amɛhe fɛo yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
8: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Kpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ okɛhɛle mɛi ashi. Henyɛlɔ miiba tamɔ okropɔŋ ebayi Yehowa we lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ eku mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mi, ni amɛtɔ̃ mimla lɛ nɔ.
Mi amɛblɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ akɛ, 'Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, boji mɔ ni wɔ, Israelbii, wɔle.'
Israelbii ekwa nɔ kpakpa lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ henyɛlɔi aaanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
"Amɛto maŋtsɛmɛi, shi jeee mi minɔ amɛtsɔ̃; ni amɛhole lumɛi hu ni mileee mli eko kwraa. Amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika fee amãgãi ni baakpãtã amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ.
Mitaooo tsinabi ni ajaa yɛ Samaria maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kwrakwra. Mimli ewo amɛ la naakpa. Mɛɛ beyinɔ po amɛaaba amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Israel?
Ŋaalɔ ko ni fee tsinabi lɛ; shi naa, jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni. Nakai tsinabi lɛ ni ajaa yɛ Samaria lɛ, aaajwra lɛ dukuduku.
Ejaakɛ akɛni amɛdu kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ lasuogbele ji yibii ni amɛbaakpa. Able ekpɛŋ bi kome nɛkɛ ni aaanaaye. Ni kɛji able lɛ abaaye tete lɛ, gbɔi moŋ aaabaye.
Majimaji lɛ emi Israel momo, ni enɛ ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ tsɛŋsi ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Ejaakɛ Israel tsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋaŋ teji ni miifo shi. Etee eyabi Asiria dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ; asaŋ Efraim bɔ maŋsɛɛbii apaa koni amɛbu ehe.
Amɛbɔ majimaji apaa moŋ, shi agbɛnɛ mibabua amɛnaa kɛkpe, ni magbla amɛtoi. Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ amɛbaakpa maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi too.
"Israelbii mamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi koni amɛkɛdãi esha ni amɛfee lɛ, shi afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ moŋ etsɔ̃ eshafeemɔ nɔ.
Kɛji miŋma mimlai lɛ shii akpei abɔ tete mihã amɛ lɛ, amɛbaaŋɔ mlai lɛ akɛ mɔkpɔŋ dɛŋ nii.

Amɛsumɔɔ afɔleshãa. Amɛgbeɔ kooloi amɛkɛshãa mifɔlei lɛ akɛ loo kɛkɛ ni ayeɔ. Eji nɔ ko ni esaaa mihiɛ. Ni no hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ mibakai eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ni mibawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ. Egipt kɛ̃ amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.
"Ejaakɛ Israel hiɛ kpa ebɔlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni emamɔ mɔji moŋ ehã ehe; ni Yuda hu tswa gbogbo ewo emaji pii ahe. Shi mawo amɛmaji lɛ amli la ni mashã amɛmɔji lɛ."
9: Israel, omli akafli o, ni kaanya tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ. Ejaakɛ bo lɛ oje o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni oyeee lɛ anɔkwa. Ohɔ̃ɔ ohe tamɔ ajwamaŋ yɛ he fɛɛ he ohã jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ no hãa anaa able lɛ.
Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ able kɛ mu lɛ shɛŋ nyɛnaa, ni anaŋ wain hu.
Asaŋ Israel ehiŋ Yehowa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi ebaaku sɛɛ eya Egipt nyɔŋyeli mli; ni amɛaayaye nii ni he tseee yɛ Asiria.

Amɛnyɛŋ amɛfɔse wain amɛshwie shi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa, aloo amɛshã afɔlei ni sa amɛhã lɛ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ nii ni amɛaaye lɛ aaabule mɛi fɛɛ ni aaaye eko tamɔ yara nɔ nii buleɔ mɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ nii ni amɛaaye lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhɔmɔ kɛkɛ amɛkɛaagbe, shi ekoeko shɛŋ Yehowa hiɛ.
Te nyɛbaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji eshɛ gbijurɔyeli be loo Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ hu?

Ejaakɛ amɛbaashi kɛya Asiria, ni Egipt aaabua amɛgbohii lɛ anaa ni aaafu amɛ yɛ Memfis. Hei ni amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ toɔ lɛ amli baatsa kɛ sɔ̃nsɔ̃rɔ̃i, ni ŋmeitsei hu aaatsa yɛ amɛshīai amli.
Toigblamɔ gbii lɛ eshɛ, be ni abaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ pɛ ni sa lɛ lɛ eshɛ. Israel baana ele akɛ gbalɔ lɛ buulu ni, ni mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ sɛkɛyelɔ ni yɛ enishaianii hewɔ.
Gbalɔ lɛ ato lɛ akɛ bulɔ ahã Israel, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ webii lɛ. Shi he fɛɛ he ni eeetsɔ̃ lɛ atsɔ̃ lɛ tsɔne, ni e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shīa diɛŋtsɛ mli lɛ nyɛɛ anyɛɔ lɛ.
Amɛbote eshafeemɔ mli vii tamɔ bɔ ni eba yɛ Gibea lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ mibaniŋ eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ahe, ni mibawo amɛ nyɔmɔ.

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mina Israel lɛ etamɔ wain yibii ni atoɔ lɛ ahuu yɛ ŋanɔ. Mina nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni tsu yɛ agbami tso nɔ. Shi be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shɛ Poer Gɔŋ le he lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i jemawɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Poer lɛ jamɔ. Enɛ hã amɛsane je migugɔŋ fu tamɔ wɔji ni amɛjaa lɛ nɔŋŋ asane.
Israel agbojee sɛɛ aaafo tamɔ looflɔ flikiɔ lɛ. Afɔŋ bi dɔŋŋ lɛ, ahiɛŋ musu dɔŋŋ, asaŋ anaŋ musu tete dɔŋŋ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Ni kɛji amɛna bii amɛlɛ tete mibagbe bii nɛɛ, ni mishwɛŋ ekome nɛkɛ. Anɔkwa, kɛji miŋmɛɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe lɛ sane kɛ joomɔ baaye amɛ pam.
"Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni minaa kã shi hã Efraimbii ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eeekpla ebii lɛ eyahã koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ."
Mɛni masumɔ akɛ ofee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ? Yehowa, hã amɛmusu ashrake, ni amɛfufɔi fɛɛ agbi.

Yehowa kɛɛ, "Amɛto amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ feemɔ shishi yɛ Gilgal, ni jɛi mibɔ̃i amɛ nyɛɛ yɛ. Amɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ mibashwie amɛ kɛje mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Misumɔŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ! Amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ etse mihiɛ atua.
Israel lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ tso ni egbo; hela emɔ lɛ, ni eha eshishi fãi fɛɛ egboi; ni no hewɔ lɛ ewooo yibii dɔŋŋ. Kɛji amɛna amɛfɔ lɛ, mibagbe amɛmusuŋbii ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ."
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ, baakwa emɛi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛbooo lɛ toi. Amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ateŋ.
10: Israel tamɔ wain tso ni efū baa ni eewo. Babaoo ni Israelbii lɛ shwereɔ lɛ babaoo ni amɛmamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ji no. Bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baa nii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛsaa shiui ni amɛkɛjaa lɛ hu ahe.
Amɛyeee anɔkwa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, amɛbaana he nyɔmɔwo. Yehowa baakumɔ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ eshwie shi, ni ebaafite amɛshiui lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔbɛ maŋtsɛ ejaakɛ wɔsheee Yehowa gbeyei. Shi kɛji wɔyɛ maŋtsɛ po lɛ mɛni ebaanyɛ efee ehã wɔ?

Amɛwieɔ huu kɛkɛ ni amɛleee nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ. Amɛwoɔ shi babaoo ni amɛle akɛ amɛyeŋ nɔ, ni amɛkpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi yaka ni sɛɛnamɔ bɛ he. No hewɔ lɛ toigblamɔ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ ebɔɔ ŋmei ni efɛ̃ shi yɛ ŋmɔshi akofii anɔ ahã amɛ.
Samaria maŋ bii lɛ aaashe gbeyei, ni amɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Bet-Aven shika tsinabi lɛ hewɔ. Amɛ kɛ wulɔmɛi lɛ ni jaa tsinabi lɛ baawo yara amɛfo yɛ enyam ni afo sɛɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Anɔkwa, abaawo shika tsinabi lɛ kɛya koni akɛyake Asiria maŋtsɛ kple lɛ. Ni no baahã hiɛgble amɔ Israel, ni ehiɛ baashwie shi yɛ ŋaa gbonyo toi ni ebo lɛ hewɔ.
Samaria maŋtsɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tso kuku ni kplaŋɔ yɛ faa hiɛ.

Betel gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ hei ni Israelbii lɛ jaa amãgãi yɛ ni amɛkɛgbo toi lɛ, aaakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ. Ŋmei kɛ aŋlɛ̃ŋlɛ̃i baakwɛ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ anɔ yɛ jɛi. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baablɔ amɛkɛɛ gɔji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhaa wɔnɔ!" Ni amɛaakɛɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu akɛ, "Nyɛbashwiea wɔnɔ!"
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Israel, ofee esha kɛjɛ Gibea esha lɛ nɔ beebe, ni ohiɛ esha lɛ mli oofee lolo. Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ ta ni afã ashi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ninaa bo yɛ Gibea?
Mibate shi mawo toigbolɔi lɛ, ni mibagbla amɛtoi bɔ ni misumɔɔ. Maji baafee ekome awo Israelbii, ni abaagbla amɛtoi yɛ eshai enyɔ lɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.

"Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel tamɔ tsina oblayoo ni atsɔse lɛ, ni enyaa he kɛ̃, akɛ akɛ lɛ miigbee ŋmaa lɛ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ miwooo ekuɛ fɛɛfɛo lɛ kɔŋtso. Shi agbɛnɛ mibawo Israel kuɛ kɔŋtso. Yuda baashãtã tsina kɔi ekɛhu; ni Israel baaninɛ nɔ ni ehu lɛ."

Nyɛfea nii ni ja tamɔ aduɔ wu kpakpa, ni nyɛaakpa misuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yibii. Nyɛjea wala hee shishi tamɔ asaa shikpɔŋ atoɔ nidumɔ, ejaakɛ be yɛ lolo bɔ ni sa ni nyɛkɛaatao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ kɛyaashi eeeba ebajɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nii anɔ.
Nyɛdu efɔŋ, ni nyɛkpa nɔsha, ni nyɛye yibii ni amale wo: "Ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ kɛ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ayifalɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ ta aaabanina nyɛ, ni aaakpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Shalman kpãtã Bet-Arbel maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ ta mli, ni eplenee emli yeifɔyei kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ lɛ.
Nakai nɔ ko pɛpɛɛpɛ baaba nyɛnɔ, nyɛ Betelbii. Efɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ baagbo leebi maŋkpa."
11: Yehowa kɛɛ, "Israel gbekɛbiashi beebe misumɔ lɛ kɛjɛ; Egipt tɔ̃ɔ eyɔɔ ni mitsɛ lɛ akɛ mibi.
Shi shii abɔ ni mitsɛɔ lɛ lɛ, shii abɔ ni eyaa sɛɛsɛɛ moŋ eshiɔ mi ji no; ni amɛyaa nɔ amɛshãa afɔlei amɛshãa Baal, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amãgãi.
Tsɛbelɛ mi mifee Israel tataa ni ele nyiɛmɔ. Mihole amɛ mifɔ̃ mikpɔkɔiaŋ, shi amɛŋɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ mi mihere amɛ.
Mikɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlitsɔ̃lɛ gbla amɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ; ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ni fãa amɛdaaŋ manyoflɛ, ni mikɛ niyenii ma amɛhiɛ."
"Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Asiria aaaye amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛkpaleɔ kɛbaa miŋɔɔ.
Taitai baate shi yɛ amɛmaji lɛ anɔ, ni abaakumɔ amɛmaji lɛ agboi lɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnilee nɔ.
Beiaŋ ni mimɛi lɛ ekã akɛ shimɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaashi mi lɛ, kɛ̃ɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaakɛ̃mɔ yɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni kã amɛkuɛ lɛ hewɔ, shi mɔ ko woŋ yɛ amɛnɔ.

"Ao Israel, te mafee tɛŋŋ maŋmɛɛ ohe hu? Te mafee tɛŋŋ makwa bo hu? Aso manyɛ ohiɛ makpãtã tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Adma lɛ; aloo tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ Zeboim ye lɛ? Mitsui miitswa yɛ mimli, ni mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe.
Mikɛ mlifu yeŋ osane lɛ. Mikpãtãŋ Israel hiɛ dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, shi jeee gbɔmɔ. Mi, Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ mlifu.
"Mimɛi lɛ baanyiɛ, mi Yehowa, misɛɛ; beyinɔ ni mabo tamɔ jata lɛ amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ. Amɛhe aaakpokpo kɛaajɛ anaigbɛ kɛba.
Amɛaaba kɛaajɛ Egipt kɛ hekpokpomɔ tamɔ loofɔji; amɛaaba tamɔ okpoi kɛaajɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshīai amli ekoŋŋ. Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Israelbii ebɔle mihe kɛkpe kɛ amale kɛ mɔshishiumɔ, ni Yudabii kã he amɛmiitse miihiɛ atūa, mi ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo kɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
12: "Israelbii agbi muu mli tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme lɛ, ehe baaa sɛɛnamɔ ko, shi moŋ efiteɔ nii. Amɛhã amale kɛ yiwalɛ ebu yɛ amɛteŋ. Amɛ kɛ Asiria ekpãŋ, ni amɛ kɛ Egipt miiye mu jra."
"No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Yudabii lɛ yɛ sane. Ebaawo Israelbii nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛjeŋba naa; eeegbla amɛtoi yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii anaa.
Amɛtsɛ Yakob lɛ ekɛ enyɛmi lɛ na be ni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ musuŋ; ni be ni eda lɛ Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hu.
Yakob kɛ bɔfo lɛ nɔ, ni eye kunim; efo etsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo lɛ ni ebi edɛŋ jɔɔmɔ. Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpe yɛ Betel, ni jɛi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie yɛ.
Ni Yehowa, ji Tai a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni Yakob kɛwie lɛ, ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, ni no akɛkaiɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ hu, enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛhea nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ nyɛyea, ni nyɛkpalea kɛbaa eŋɔɔ. Nyɛnaa mɛi mɔbɔ; nyɛyea jalɛ sane, ni nyɛyea anɔkwa daa kɛkwɛa lɛ gbɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "jrayelɔ ni kɛ nsɛni ni atse etɛ nɔ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ, shishiulɔ ji lɛ.
Israel kɛɔ akɛ, 'Shi bɛ mitsɔ̃ niatsɛ, bɛ mina nii babaoo? Mideŋmegbomɔ mli nii lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ anaaa tɔmɔ ko ni tamɔ esha yɛ mihe?
Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛ jɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe kɛba lɛ. Mahã nyɛhi buui amli ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee yɛ gbii juji anɔ lɛ.
"Mi mikɛ gbalɔi lɛ wie, ni mijie ninaa srɔtoi mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ; asaŋ mitsɔ̃ amɛnɔ mibubuu mimɛi lɛ abɛi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ aaja amãgãi yɛ Gilead; shi mɛi fɛɛ ni jaa amɛ lɛ aaagboi. Aagbe tsinai akɛmiishã afɔle yɛ Gilgal; shi afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tɛi kuikui kɛkɛ yɛ amɛŋmɔjiashi akofii lɛ ateŋ."
Yakob jo foi kɛtee Mesopotamia. Eyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ ŋa hewɔ; eyakwɛ mɔ ko toi yɛ ŋa hewɔ.
Yehowa tsu gbalɔ ni eyahere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala kɛje Egipt kɛba, ni gbalɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ekura amɛ.
Israelbii ewo Yehowa mli la naakpa; ni no hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ amɛgboi; ni amɛmusu aaatere amɛ. Yehowa baagbla amɛtoi ejaakɛ amɛwo lɛ hiɛgble.
13: Kulɛ kɛji Efraim shwiei lɛ wie lɛ, mɛi ahe kpokpoɔ yɛ Israel. Awo Efraim nɔ yɛ Israel; shi kɛtsɔ̃ jemawɔŋ Baal jamɔ nɔ lɛ, Efraim shwiei lɛ tɔ̃, ni no hewɔ amɛgboi.

Amɛkã he amɛmiifee esha lɛ lolo kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛii yahãa ŋaalɔi, ni amɛhãa akɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ shwieɔ amãgãi kɛ wɔji ahãa amɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Ashã afɔle ahã amɛ!" Mɛi ni yashãa afɔlei lɛ shwɔɔ tsinabi amãgãi lɛ anaa.
No hewɔ lɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baalaaje tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋmaagbeemɔhe kɛyaa lɛ, aloo tamɔ leebi bɔ ni kplaa, loo afua ni hoɔ oya.
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni here nyɛyiwala kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe lɛ. Nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ ko akɛ ja mi; ni mi misɛɛ hu lɛ yiwalaherelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikwɛ nyɛnɔ yɛ shiaŋa ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ,
shi be ni nyɛna nii nyɛye ni nyɛtrɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni nyɛwo nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kpa minɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ mibahuru mayi nyɛnɔ tamɔ jata; mibawo nyɛ ka tamɔ mlaŋtswi yɛ gbɛtoi.
Mibatua nyɛ oookɛɛ oshishibrishi ni amɔmɔ ebii yɛ ehe tuaa mɔ, ni mibatserɛ nyɛmli maye yɛ minajiaŋ tamɔ jata. No ji akɛ mibasterɛ nyɛmli mɛnyɛmɛnyɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ kooloo awuyelɔ tsɛrɛɔ loo mli lɛ.
"Kwɛ, Israel! Mibakpãtã ohiɛ; ni namɔ aaanyɛ oyiwala ahere?
Nɛɛgbɛ omaŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ koni ehere oyiwala; aloo nɛgbɛ nyɛlumɛi lɛ ni baafã nyɛhe lɛ yɔɔ, mɛi ahewɔ ni nyɛbi akɛ, 'Ahã wɔ maŋtsɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ?'
Mihã nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, shi yɛ mlifu naa; ni miŋɔ amɛ kɛtee yɛ mlila naa.
"Abua Israel nishaianii lɛ kɛ etɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa ato ahã lɛ.
Yoofɔyoo kɔ̃ɔmɔ be miiba ehã Israel; shi ehe bi kwashia ni eji hewɔ lɛ, emaaa eyi shi ebaaa awosojwaahe lɛ.
Mibahereŋ amɛ yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ; mibaŋ amɛyi yɛ gbele mli? Gbele, nɛgbɛ otsɛŋemɔ hela yɔɔ; ni Gbohiiaje, nɛgbɛ oniiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ yɔɔ? Minaŋ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ.
Israel aaafrɔke tamɔ ŋɔi, shi bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la lɛ, ni ji Yehowa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, baafã kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba; ebaŋla amɛnuhiŋmɛii kɛ nubui fɛɛ amli nu; asaŋ eeekpãtã amɛnɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jra hiɛ.
Samaria yi sɔ̃ lɛ baatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ; emli bii lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ ta mli, akɛ emli abifabii lɛ aaatswiatswia shi; ni aaagbla amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ amli."
14: Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkpalea kɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ. Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ehã nyɛtrɛ, ni nyɛgbee shi.
Nyɛkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ, nyɛyakpaa lɛ fai kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛ efɔŋ ni wɔfee lɛ afa koni omɔ wɔfaikpamɔ nɛɛ mli, ni wɔɔkafo o.
Asiria nyɛŋ wɔyiwala ahere gbi ko gbi ko; ni tayaa okpɔŋɔi hu nyɛŋ afã wɔhe. Asaŋ amãgã ni wɔkɛ wɔniji fee lɛ wɔtsɛŋ lɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ dɔŋŋ. Yehowa, bo lɛ omusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ o yɛ awusãi ahe."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Mibahã amɛkpa anɔkwa ni amɛyeee lɛ. Mibasumɔ amɛ kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ejaakɛ miŋmɛɛ mimli ni fu amɛ lɛ he.
Mibatsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni enyɔ shiaŋa nɔ mahã Israelbii. Amɛbaagba floŋŋ tamɔ fɔfɔi; ni amɛfãi aaaya su mli shɔŋŋ tamɔ Lebanon tsei.
Eniji ni ebaatsrɛ̃ aaalɛɛ shi, ni ehe fɛo aaatamɔ mu tso nɔ. Eeeje ŋma tamɔ Lebanon seda tsei lɛ.
Amɛbaaba amɛbahi mifiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ. Amɛaafɛo tamɔ abɔɔ, ni amɛaafrɔke tamɔ wain tso, ni amɛgbɛi aaahehe tamɔ Lebanon wain.
Israelbii kɛ wɔji naŋ nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ. Mibabo amɛsɔlemɔ toi. Mibatsɔ̃ tso ni eyi baa kplaaa mahã amɛ, ni mibabaa amɛyi; nyɛjɔɔmɔi fɛɛ baajɛ mi midɛŋ."

Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, enu saji nɛɛ ashishi; ni hiɛshikãlɔ lɛ ekɔ sɛɛ. Naa, Yehowa gbɛi fɛɛ ja, ni nomɛi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛbaa ejeŋ; nomɛi anaa mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii hiɔ shi yɛ; shi eshafeelɔi tswaa egbɛi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛtrɛɔ, ni amɛgbeɔ shi.

1: Ninaa ni ajie atsɔ̃ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ hu he, yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ, Uzia kɛ Yotam kɛ Ahaz kɛ Hezekia, ayinɔ nɛ:
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Ŋwɛi, bo toi, ni shikpɔŋ bo hu feemɔ toi, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, miiwie. Milɛ bii ni amɛdra, shi amɛ lɛ, amɛtsɛ mihiɛ atua.
Tsina le mɔ nɔ̃ ni ji lɛ, ni teji hu le he ni enuŋtsɔ eto eniyenii adeka yɛ. Shi Israel lɛ, lɛ lɛ eleee enɛ mli ekoeko; miwebii lɛ bɛ niiashishinumɔ."
Ao! Eshafeelɔi amaŋ, gbɔmɛi ni eyi tɔ kɛ eshafeemɔ, efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei, gbɔmɛi nifitelɔi ni amɛkwa Yehowa, ni amɛgbe Isreal Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ, ni amɛ kɛ lɛ teŋ atserɛ kwraa.
Mɛni hewɔ nyɛyaa nɔ nyɛtseɔ atua koni aya nɔ agbla nyɛtoi lolo nɛɛ? Nyɛyitso muu lɛ fɛɛ he miiye, ni nyɛtsui fɛɛ hu etɔ biti.
Kɛjɛ yiteŋ aahuu kɛyashi naneshi lɛ, he ko he ko bɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ he ni atswã bɛ jɛi fe pilamɔi kɛ faji kɛ faji ni amɛmli miihohoo lá. Anyamɔko faji lɛ, afimɔko lɛ, akɛ mu etoko amɛnɔ hu.
Nyɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃, ni amamɔ nyɛmaji wuji lɛ anaa la ashãshãai. Gbɔi miiye nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii yɛ nyɛhiɛ; amɛbutu nyɛshikpoŋ lɛ, ni amɛhã etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Yerusalem pɛ eshwɛ, ni lɛ hu asa eyi. Etsɔ̃ tamɔ asese ko yɛ waintrom mli, loo aba ni ma kukumba ŋmɔ mli.
Yehowa eshwɛɛɛ hiɛkãalɔi fioo ko hãaa wɔ kulɛ, wɔsane lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora.
Nyɛ Sodom maŋnɔyelɔi, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi; ni nyɛ Gomorabii, nyɛboa nɔ ni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ nyɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi.
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Mɛni nyɛfɔlei babaoo lɛ ji hã mi? Shãa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛ gwaŋtɛŋ hii shãa lɛ kɛ kooloi ni eshwishwii afɔi lɛ eje mitsine. Tsinahii kɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii kɛ tookpakpoi alá lɛ, mitaooo dɔŋŋ.
Namɔ kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛba mi jamɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ enɛɛmɛi aba mikpoi lɛ anɔ? Nyɛkabanyiɛa mikpoi lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ!

Nyɛkɛ nyɛyakayaka afɔlei akabaa dɔŋŋ; amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ. Miihi tsofãkɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee gbiijuji lɛ, kɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi kɛ gwai ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ. Eshai efite gbiijuji ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ mitaooo.
Misusuma miihi nyɔŋ hee gbiijuji kɛ gbiijuji krokomɛi ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ jatsu amɛhã mi, ni etɔ mi kɛtremɔ.
Kɛji nyɛhole nyɛniji anɔ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã; nyɛbaasɔle kakadaŋŋ nɛ, shi miboŋ nyɛ toi. Lá ewu nyɛniji ahe tsɔ̃.
Nyɛjua nyɛhe koni nyɛhãa nyɛhe atsea; nyɛkɛ nyɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ ajea mihiɛ, ni nyɛkpaa efɔŋfeemɔ.
Nyɛkasea ekpakpafeemɔ, nyɛtaoa jalɛ sane sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛkwɛa koni akauyea amim, nyɛfãa awusa he, ni nyɛwiea nyɛhãa okulafo."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa agbɛnɛ; nyɛhãa wɔtaoa naa. Kɛji nyɛhe eshai lɛ tsuɔ tamɔ lá tete po, amɛbaayɛ futaa tamɔ snoo; ni kɛji amɛtsuɔ fɔɔ tamɔ kɔɔjaŋ po, amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ too he tsɔ̃i yɛŋ.
Kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ, ni nyɛfee toibolɔi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii kpakpai lɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ, ni nyɛtse atūa lɛ, no lɛ akɛ klaŋte baakpãtã nyɛhiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Te fee tɛŋŋ ni maŋ ni kulɛ eyeɔ anɔkwa lɛ etsɔ̃ ehe ajwamaŋ nɛɛ. Sa lɛ aye jalɛ sane yɛ ehe fɛɛ he, ni jalɛ saneyelɔi pɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi; shi agbɛnɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi sɔŋŋ yɔɔ jɛi.
Ojwiɛtɛi lɛ atsɔ̃ jwiɛtɛifee, ni owain lɛ ashi mli nu.
Omli lumɔi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ atuatselɔi kɛ julɔi ananemɛi. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miinya nyɔɔŋniihãmɔ he ni amɛhiŋmɛii etsu kɛnyiɛ mɛi adɛŋ nikee sɛɛ. Amɛfãaa awusa he lɛ, amɛyeee okulafo sane amɛhãaa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Ofe Koome lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, "Mikɛ mimlifu lɛ baashãkã mihenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni mibatɔ mihe owele yɛ nyɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, anɔ.
Mikɛ bo baaye, ni mibasere ojwiɛtɛifei lɛ fɛɛ, ni majie omli muji nii fɛɛ mashwie.
Mato kojolɔi mahã o tamnɔ eyɔɔ tsutsu ko lɛ, kɛ ajinafoi hu tamɔ blema lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ, bo Yerusalɛm, aaatsɛ o jalɛ maŋ."
Jalɛsaneyeli ji nɔ ni aaahere Yerusalem maŋ lɛ kɛ emli mɛi fɛɛ ni aaashwa amɛhe lɛ ayiwala.
Shi maŋ lɛ atuatselɔi lɛ kɛ eshafeelɔi lɛ aaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni mɛi ni baakwa Yehowa lɛ, abaaplene amɛ.
Ebaafee nyɛ hiɛgble akɛ nyɛja tsei wuji; asaŋ nyɛhiɛ aaashwie shi akɛ nyɛfeefee tromii komɛi,
ejaakɛ nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ tso wulu, ni eyi baa eboo loo trom ni nu bɛ mli.
Hewalɔ hewalɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ anaanu kpãa; enifeemɔnii baatsɔ̃ lasrɛ̃mi, ni lasrɛ̃mi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ baasɔo anaanu kpãa lɛ naa la, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe.
2: Yuda kɛ Yerusalem he sane ni Amoz bi Yesaia na nɛ.
Ebaaba mli akɛ naagbee mli lɛ, gɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ma nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ gɔŋ ni kwɔ fe gɔji fɛɛ. Abaawo enɔ fe gɔji lɛ fɛɛ, ni aaajɛ jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ aba jɛi.

Ni mɛi babaoo baakɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔyaa Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyaa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, koni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ bɔ ni etaoɔ akɛ wɔhi shi wɔhã, koni wɔba wɔjeŋ nakai, Ejaakɛ mla lɛ, Zion ebaajɛ, ni Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ, Yerusalem ebaajɛ."

Ni ebaakojo majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni ebaakã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ, ni ebaabu atɛŋ ehã mɛi babaoo. Amɛbaatswia amɛklaŋtei lɛ amɛkɛsɔ̃ kɔii ni amɛkɛ amɛkplɔi lɛ hu baasɔ̃ adidai. Maŋ ko kɛ maŋ ko wuŋ ta, ni amɛkaseŋ tawuu dɔŋŋ.
Ao, nyɛ Yakob we, nyɛbaa agbɛnɛ koni wɔnyiɛ Yehowa la lɛ mli
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ekwa ewebii ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ, ejaakɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔji klalɔi babaoo ebafutu amɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ klalɔi tamɔ Filistibii lɛ, ni maŋsɛɛbii moŋ amɛkɛbɔɔ.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni anyɛɛɛ naa abu. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi kɛ okpɔŋɔi, ni amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ anyɛɛɛ naa akpa.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ yakayaka amãgãi, ni amɛkotoɔ shi amɛjaa amɛninenaa nitsumɔnii, nii ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛniji fee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ adesa diɛŋtsɛ ebɔ ehe ahora ni eba ehe shi kwraa. Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ enɛ akafa amɛ.
Botemɔ tɛsaa tɛkplo mli, ni yaatee ohe yɛ su mli ni ojo Yehowa he gbeyei lɛ kɛ egbojee anumnyam lɛ naa foi.
Gbi ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaaba gbɔmɔ adesa hewoo kɛ henɔwomɔ fɛɛ shi, ni gbi lɛ Yehowa koome pɛ hiɛ baaba nyam, ni aaawo enɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ gbi ko ni eto ni ekɛbaaba ntɛŋfeemɔ kɛ henɔwomɔ kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ fɛɛ shi.
Gbi nɛɛ lɛ abaaba Lebanon tsenedrutsei gojogojoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Bashan tsei wuji lɛ fɛɛ,
kɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi ni kwɔlɔ lɛ fɛɛ,
kɛ mɔji gojogojoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gbogboi ni awaje lɛ fɛɛ ashi,
ni abaashwie Spain lɛji lɛ kɛ amɛmli ŋaa nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.
Gbi lɛ abaaba gbɔmɔ adesa hetsɔ̃ɔɔmɔ kɛ ntɛŋfeemɔ fɛɛ shi, ni Yehowa koometoo pɛ nɔ abaawo gojoo,
ni yakayaka amãgãi lɛ baaho aya kwraa.
Gbi nɔ ni Yehowa aaaba ebahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ, gbɔmɛi baabote tɛsaa tɛkploi kɛ shikpɔŋ bui amli koni amɛtee amɛhe yɛ Yehowa he gbeyei kɛ egbojee anumnyam lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ gbɔmɛi baasherɛ amɛshika amãgãi kɛ jwɛitɛi amãgãi ni amɛfee amɛhã amɛhe ni amɛjaa lɛ amɛshwie amɛhã obishii kɛ aputupatai.
Amɛbaaya amɛyabote tɛkploi kɛ tɛsaa amli fɔji amli bɔ ni afee ni amɛnyɛ amɛjo foi yɛ Yehowa he gbeyei kɛ egbojee anumnyam lɛ naa be ni Yehowa aaate shi ebahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Nyɛwia nyɛhe kɛjea gbɔmɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ emli nɛɛ he, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ebɛ nɔ ko mli.
3: Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baajie mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yerusalem kɛ Yuda kpasa akɛ sɛɛtso lɛ kɛya. Ebaajie amɛdaaŋ ŋmãa, ni ebaahã amɛye nuhɔmɔ.
Ebaajie nuu ekãalɔ lɛ kɛ tabilɔ lɛ kɛ kojolɔ lɛ kɛ gbalɔ lɛ kɛ okɔmfo lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpa lɛ.
Ebaajie tabilɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ gbɛnaahiɛlɔ lɛ kɛ maŋ ajinafonyo lɛ. Ebaajie ashwãifeelɔ ni ha esa lɛ kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔ ni he esa lɛ fɛɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mibahã gbekɛbii hii atsɔmɔ amɛnɔ lumɛi, ni fufɔbii baaye amɛnɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ aaawawaa amɛhe yi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawa enyɛmi yi. Oblahii ebuŋ amɛnukpai, ni maŋ bii yakagbɔmɛi ebuŋ mɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam.
Be miiba, be ni tsɛmɛiawebii baamɔ amɛteŋ mɔ kome, ni amɛaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Anyɛmi, bo lɛ oyɛ hebo, no hewɔ lɛ obaaye wɔlumɔ koni okwɛ wɔwe ni ekumɔ nɛɛ nɔ."
Shi gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baakɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Mibɛ niyenii loo hehaabo yɛ mishīaŋ ni mikɛaanyɛ mikɛwa nyɛ. Nyɛkafea mi nyɛlumɔ."
Ejaakɛ Yerusalem ejwa, ni Yuda hu egbee shi, ejaakɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛte shi amɛwo Yehowa, ni amɛhiɛ eshwieee ehiɛiaŋ tete.
Amɛmɛiahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ baaye odase eshi amɛ. Eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ amɛkɛteee, shi moŋ amɛkɛshwãa tamɔ Sodom fee lɛ. Kpoo hã amɛ! Ejaakɛ amɛfee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhe efɔŋ.
Kɛɛmɔ jalɔi lɛ akɛ ebaahi ehã amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaye amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ mli yibii.
Shi kpoo ha efɔŋfeelɔ; ehiŋ ehaŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni ekɛfee mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, no nɔŋŋ akɛbaafee lɛ.
Naa, shikafalɔi miiwa mimaŋbii lɛ ayi, ni amɛnyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ shishiuɔ amɛ. Ao! Miwebii, nyɛmaŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ miihã nyɛmiidu gbɛ, ni amɛmiihã nyɛnane miitɔ̃tɔ̃.
Yehowa eho eta esɛi nɔ, ni ekɛ ewebii lɛ baaye sane.
Yehowa kɛ emaŋ onukpai kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ miikojo akɛ, "Nyɛji mɛi ni nyɛkpa waintrom lɛ mli nii ni nyɛye lɛ. Ohiafoi adɛŋ nibii ni nyɛhahaa lɛ yɛ nyɛshīai lɛ amli.
Te nyɛjwɛŋɔ tɛŋŋ hewɔ ni nyɛmiaa mimaŋ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ ohiafoi ahiɛ shwishwiaa shi nɛɛ lɛ? Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, miibi nyɛ!"
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Yerusalem yei lɛ woɔ amɛhe, amɛtsīaa kɛ amɛkuɛkuumɔ kɛ ahoshwibɔɔ hiŋmɛii kɛ amɛnanetalɔŋ gai ni miigbɛɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mibahã gbɛ̃i ashwie Yerusalem biyei ayiteiaŋ, ni ebaahã amɛyitsei ahe akpekpei, ni mi Yehowa, mahã amɛnyiɛ yayai."
Nakai be lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaakplɔ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ yɛ amɛhe nanetalɔŋ gai lɛ kɛ yifii dukui lɛ,
kɛ amɛkuɛnii lɛ kɛ kuɛnii kɛ enaa kpɔbii lɛ kɛ nineshinii lɛ kɛ dukui lɛ,
kɛ yitsɔisaamɔ nibii lɛ kɛ nineshi gai kɛ mlifiinii lɛ kɛ ojeŋma tɔi lɛ kɛ sɛbɛi lɛ;
kɛ wolonaasɔomɔ waogai lɛ kɛ gugɔŋ gai lɛ,
kɛ afiyeli hewulamɔ atadei lɛ kɛ atadei wuyawuyai lɛ kɛ nɔhaa atadei lɛ kɛ kotokui bibiibii ni amɛhiɛɔ lɛ,
kɛ atadei ni akɛ mama ni mli yɔɔ haŋŋhaŋŋ ekpɛ lɛ kɛ klala atadei lɛ kɛ bɔndukui lɛ kɛ hiɛhaanii lɛ.

Amɛjeŋmai lɛ baatsɔ̃ nɔ ko ni jeɔ fu, amɛkɛ taŋkpee baafi amɛmli yɛ mlifiinii najiaŋ, ni yiteŋ ni ekpe aaabaye yi ni ahɔ najiaŋ, ni kpekpe aaabaye atade wuyaa najiaŋ, ni amɛhe fɛo lɛ baatsɔ̃ hiɛgble nɔ.
Omli hii lɛ baanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa, ni ohii kãkãlɔi lɛ hu yɛ ta mli.
Maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ baaye ŋkɔmɔ kɛ awerɛho, ni maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni afee lɛ shwɛm ni eshwata shikpɔŋ.
4: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ yei kpawo baamɔ nuu kome kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ni amɛbaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔlɛ wɔhe, ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔhe mama wɔbu. Nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ kɛkɛ ji akɛ akɛ ogbɛi atsɛ wɔ koni okɛjie wɔhiɛgble."
Nakai be lɛ Yehowa tso nine lɛ baafee fɛo, ni ebaashwere, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii aaafee shwãanɔ kɛ nyam ahã Israelbii ni eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baashwɛ yɛ Zion, ni eeehi shi yɛ Yerusalem lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaŋma egbɛi afata hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Yerusalem lɛ,
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa lɛ ebaakojo ni ebaatsuu Israelbii ahe, ebaafɔ Yerusalem he muji lɛ kɛ lá shi ni ashwie yɛ jɛi lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baahã atatu aha Zion Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ asafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi anɔ shwane, ni gbɛkɛ lɛ ebaahã amɛ lasu ni kpɛɔ tamɔ la, ejaakɛ enumnyam lɛ baaha amɛnɔ tamɔ agba.
Ebaatsɔ̃ hɔ̃ɔŋ shwane koni hulu akashã amɛ, ni eeefee abobaahe kɛ teemɔhe yɛ ahum kɛ nunɛmɔ mli.
5: Hã mãla suɔmɔ lala mahã mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ ewaintrom lɛ he. Mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ waintrom yɛ gɔŋ ni baa nii jogbaŋŋ nɔ.
Etsa mli, ni efamɔ emli tɛi ni etɛo waintsei kpakpai yɛ mli; ema mɔ̃ɔ yɛ teŋ, ni etsa wain bu hu yɛ mli. Ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ trom lɛ baawo wainyibii kpakpai, shi ewo kooŋ wainyibii moŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni mishieŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, "Agbɛnɛ nyɛ Yerusalembii kɛ nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛ fai nɛ, nyɛkojoa mi kɛ miwaintrom lɛ teŋ.
Mɛni esa akɛ afee mitrom lɛ lolo ni mifeko? Be ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ewo wainyibii kpakpai lɛ, mɛni hewɔ ni ewo kooŋ wainyibii moŋ nɛɛ?
"Agbɛnɛ mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni mibafee miwaintrom lɛ. Mibajie ehe afabaŋ lɛ koni kooloi akpãtã ehiɛ. Mibakumɔ ehe gbogbo lɛ hu koni anaanaa enɔ kɛho.
Mibahã emli atsa; akplɔŋ emli tsei lɛ ahe, ni ahuŋ he; kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii baatsa yɛ mli. Mibawo atatui lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkanɛ nu amɛshwie nɔ."
Israel ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, waintrom lɛ, ni Yudabii lɛ ji waintsei kpakpai ni etɛo lɛ; ni ekwɛ jalɛ saneyeli gbɛ ni naa lashishwiemɔ moŋ ena, ni yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ najiaŋ lɛ, yaafo moŋ afo!.

Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheheo mɛi ashīai nyɛfataa shīai ni nyɛyɔɔ ahe, ni nyɛŋɔɔ mɛi aŋmɔji nyɛfataa nyɛŋmɔji ahe. Nyɛhiɛ nɛkɛ ni eshwɛŋ shikpɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ he ko ni abaashi nyɛ pɛ koni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wie yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoiŋ akɛ, "Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, shīai pii baatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃, shīai wuji fɛɛfɛji baakamɔ shi ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ waintrom kpãi nyɔŋma dalɛ, wain litai kpaanyɔ pɛ abaana kɛjɛ mli, ni able kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ ni adu lɛ, abaana able kiloi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ pɛ kɛjɛ mli."
Ni kpoo hã mɛi ni teɔ shi maŋkɛ mra ni amɛyanyiɛɔ dãatseiaŋ, mɛi ni traa shi yɛ dãa he kɛyashiɔ jenamɔ yi waa, ni wain hãa amɛhiɛ feɔ laŋlaŋ.
Amɛkɛ saŋku kɛ obenta kɛ milɛ̃ kɛ blɛ kɛ wain yeɔ amɛgbiijuji lɛ, shi amɛbuuu Yehowa, nifeemɔnii, ni amɛnãaa eninehaa nitsumɔi lɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ abaaŋɔ miwebii lɛ nom, ejaakɛ amɛleee nii. Hɔmɔ miigbe amɛhiɛnaanɔbii lɛ, ni maŋbii babaoo baagboi kɛ kumai.
No hewɔ lɛ gbohiiaje elɛɛ esɛŋ, ni egbvɛ edaaŋ hatoo fe nine kɛmiimɛ Yerusalem lumɛi lɛ kɛ esafo yuu lɛ kɛ mɛi ni feɔ hoo lɛ kɛ mɛi ni mlifiɔ amɛ lɛ koni emi amɛ.
Abaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛgble, ni abaaba nuu fɛɛ nuu shi, ni hewolɔi lɛ hu aaaba amɛ shi.
Shi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jieɔ egbojee kpo kɛtsɔ̃ jalɛnii ni efeɔ nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔakɛ ehe tse Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛɛlɛŋ kɛtsɔ̃ jalɛ sane ni eyeɔ lɛ nɔ.
Too gwaŋtɛŋbii aaaye nii yɛ ŋanɔ he ni jwɛifɔ yɔɔ, ni abotiabii ni eshwishwii aaaye nii kɛnyiɛ amaŋfɔŋ tsui koi lɛ ateŋ.
Kpoo hå mɛi ni kɛ amale kpãa gblaa nɔsha, ni amɛkɛ shwili he taŋkpee diɛŋtsɛ gblaa esha lɛ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Yehowa he afee oya; Nɔ ni eto akɛ ebaafee lɛ, efee koni wɔkwɛ. Ha ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ yiŋ ni eto lɛ ebɛŋkɛ wɔ ni ba mli koni wɔle".

Kpoo hã mɛi ni tsɛɔ nɔ fɔŋ akɛ nɔ kpakpa ni amɛtsɛɔ nɔ kpakpa akɛ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ. Kpoo hã mɛi ni ŋɔɔ duŋ amɛfeɔ lɛ, ni amɛŋɔɔ la hu amɛfeɔ duŋ lɛ. Kpoo hã mɛi hu ni ŋɔɔ nɔ ni joɔ amɛfeɔ nɔ ni ŋɔɔ, ni amɛŋɔɔ nɔ ni ŋɔɔ amɛfeɔ nɔ ni joɔ lɛ.
Kpoo hã mɛi ni buɔ amɛhe nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ amɛhe hiɛtɛ̃lɔi lɛ!
Kpoo hã mɛi ni feɔ ekãab kɛ wainnumɔ! Kpoo hã mɛi ni waa amɛ kɛ dãa ni wa futumɔ!
Kpoo hã mɛi ni heɔ nyɔɔŋnii ni no hãa amɛŋmɛɔ mɔ ni efe efɔŋ he tswaa lɛ, ni amɛhãa mɔ ni sane ja gbɛnaanii ŋmɛɔ lɛ lɛ!

No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni lalilɛi shãa gbetseli, ni la ni tsoɔ shãa jwɛi gbiŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfãi lɛ aaakpɔtɔ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ baatswa amɛfrofro lɛ ashwie, ejaakɛɛ amɛkwa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mla lɛ, ni amɛgbe ISrael Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ wiemɔ lɛ he guɔ.

Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu ewebii lɛ, ni ewo enine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni egbla amɛtoi. Gɔji lɛ hoso, ni amɛgbohii lɛ jwere blohui amli oookɛɛ shīai jwɛi ni abɛɛ ashwie. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ naa bako shi, shi ekpã enine lɛ mli lolo.
Yehowa baato okadi ekɛtsɛ maŋ ko ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ; ebaakpã blɛ ekɛtsɛ lɛ kɛjɛ jeŋ naagbeehe lɛ. Ni naa, maŋ nɛɛ baafee oya aba mramra.
Etɔɔ̃ŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tɛŋ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛfiinii fɛneŋ, mɔ ko mɔ ko tokota naa kpãa tseŋ.
Amɛgãimlibii anaa ba, ni amɛtataa amɛgãi lɛ; amɛkpɔŋɔ akoklotoi tamɔ tswrɛbo, ni amɛshwiilii anaji lɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛhe oyaoya tamɔ lasuogbele.
Amɛhūuɔ tamɔ jata, amɛhūuɔ tamɔ jata oblahii pɛ; amɛshiɔ amɛsɛŋ ni amɛyeɔ kooloo ni amɛgbɔbiɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛmɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ kooloo ni amɛmɔ lɛ yiwala ahere.
Amɛaashi amɛsɛŋ amɛwo Israel nakai gbi lɛ, ni amɛsɛŋshimɔ lɛ aaagbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ. Ni kɛji akwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɔ ni aaana ji duɛ kɛ awerɛhoo sɔŋŋ, bi oblɔtu aaaha hulu la hiɛ.
6: Afi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Uzia gbo lɛ, mina Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni eta Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ni kwɔ gojoo ko nɔ. Atade yuu ni ewo lɛ eyi Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ebɔ̃.
Serafim damɔ Maŋtsɛ lɛ he kɛbɔle. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji ekpaaekpaa. Ekɛ enyɔ haa ehiɛ, ni ekɛ enyɔ haa enaji ahe, ni ekɛ enyɔ hu flikiɔ.
Mɔnɛ boɔ ekɛɔ mɔnɛ akɛ, "Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ! Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ eyi obɔ kɛ enumnyam lɛ."
Serafim lɛ ablɔmɔ lɛ ha solemɔwe lɛ shinai lɛ ashishi fanesi hoso, ni Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yi tɔ kɛ lasu.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Kpoo hã mi, shi milaaje! Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni naabu he tseee ji mi; ni miyɛ maŋ ni emli bii awiemɔi ahe tseee ateŋ, ejaakɛ mihiŋmɛi ena Maŋtsɛ ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni serafim lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome fliki kɛba miŋɔɔ. Ehiɛ ŋai ni miitso ni ekɛ abɛɛle yakɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ ŋai ni tsoɔ lɛ sa minaabu he, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, akɛni enɛ esa onaabu he nɛɛ lɛ, ajie onɔsha lɛ, ni akɛ ohe esha efa bo."
Kɛkɛ ni minu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbee ni miikɛɛ akɛ, "Namɔ matsu, ni namɔ aaatee ahã wɔ?" Mikɛɛ akɛ, "Naa mi! tsu mi!"
Ni Nuiŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaa koni oyakɛɛ maŋbii nɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛkɛ nyɛtoi aanuu nɛ; shi nyɛnuŋ shishi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii aaana nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Hã nɛkɛ maŋbii nŋɛɛ akpliŋ amɛtsui. ni ohã amɛtoi awa; asaŋ shwilamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii koni amɛkana nii; amɛkanu nii, asaŋ amɛkanu sane shishi ni amɛmiikpale ni amɛna tsamɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtso, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ?" Eto ehe akɛ, "Kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maji lɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i ni adesa ko bɛ amɛmli, ni shīai lɛ aaajwere shi efoji ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kwraa.
Yehowa aaakpla maŋbii lɛ kɛaatee shɔŋŋ, ni hei pii aaakamɔ shi efoji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Ni kɛji eshwɛ maŋbii lɛ amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome tete yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaaku sɛɛ akpãtã amɛhiɛ. Shi amɛaatsɔ tamɔ tso kple ni atoo agbee shi ni eshwɛ ekuku yɛ su mli. Tso kuku nɛɛ lɛ dumɔ wu Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni."
7: Be ni Ahaz ni ji Uzia bi Yotam bi lɛ ji Yuda Maŋtsɛ lɛ, Siria Maŋtsɛ Remalia bi lɛ fã ta kɛba, ni amɛbatua Yerusalem, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ maŋ lɛ amɛŋɔ.
Be ni Yeda Maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Aram kɛ Efraim efee ekome lɛ, Ahaz kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ atsui fã, ni amɛkpokpo tamɔ kooŋ tsei ni ahum ebote amɛteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yesaia akɛ, "Bo kɛ obi Shear Yashub yɛ yiteŋgbɛ kpaakpo lɛ naa, yɛ niiahefɔlɔi abɔɔ lɛ tempɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Kɛɛmɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Kwɛ ohe ni ahi, ni ofee dioo; kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui nu akafã yɛ grimɔ waa ni Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Siriabii kɛ Remalia bi Maŋtsɛ Peka egri lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ tsei kukuji ni miijie lasu kɛkɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Siriabii lɛ kɛ Israel kɛ eMaŋtsɛ, Remalia bi lɛ, etee oyinɔ ajina fɔŋ. Amɛkpãŋ akɛ
amɛbaatua Yuda koni amɛwo ehe gbeyei ni amɛŋɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã amɛhe koni amɛto Tabeel binuu akɛ Maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
"Shi mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, miikɛɛ akɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ baŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ,
ejaakɛ Siria he waaa fe Damasko, ni Damasko he waaa fe Maŋtsɛ Rezin. Yɛ Israel gbɛfaŋ lɛ biɛ afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ mli lɛ abaabutu lɛ, ni efeŋ maŋ dɔŋŋ.
Israel he waaa fe Samaria, emaŋ wulu lɛ, ni Samaria he waaa fe Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia binuu lɛ. Kɛji nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhiŋ shi akɛ maŋ."
Yehowa saa ekɛ wiemɔ tsu yaha Maŋtsɛ Ahaz akɛ,
"Bi Yehowa, O-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadi. Ooonyɛ oyabi yɛ gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ, loo yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tete."
Shi Ahaz to he akɛ, "Mibiŋ ni ahã mi okadi ko, ni mikaŋ Yehowa mikwɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia to he akɛ, "Nyɛboa toi koo, agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Maŋtsɛ David shwiei! Aso gbɔmɛi ni nyɛhao lɛ faaa hãaa nyɛ hewɔn ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu nɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ okadi. Naa, Oblayoo fro ko baana musu, ni ebaafɔ binuu, ni eeewo lɛ gbɛi Imanuel
Be ni binuu nɛɛ hiɛ aaafã ni eeele nɔ ni ji ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ lɛ, no mli lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɔ, ni aana fufɔ kɛ wo aye.
Ejaakɛ be ni gbekɛ nɛɛ aaada ni ekwa nɔ fɔŋ ni ekɔ nɔ kpakpa lɛ, Maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei nɛɛ lɛ ashi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
"Yehowa baahã bo kɛ omaŋbii lɛ kɛ David shwiei fɛɛ atsɔ̃ gbii kɛ joomɔ komɛi amli ni eko bako dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni Israel tse ehe yɛ Yuda he nɛɛ, eeekpla Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛbanina nyɛ.
"Nakai be lɛ Yehowa baakpã blɛ kɛtsɛ Egiptbii, ni amɛaabu kɛba tamɔ adɔdɔji kɛjɛ Nilo Faa lɛ jɛɛhe kɛ̃. Ni ebaatsɛ Asiriabii, ni amɛaake tamɔ wobii kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛaaba amɛbasɔmɔ jɔi voovoi kɛ tɛsai amli fɔji lɛ amli kɛ ŋmei tsei fɛɛ anɔ amɛbaatsī jwɛi fɛɛ jwɛi nɔ.
"Nakai be lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaabɔ Siria Maŋtsɛ lɛ apaa kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ tamɔ asooyi, ni eeebashɛ nyɛyiteiaŋ tsɔi kɛ nyɛnaji ahe tsɔi kɛ nyɛtsɛŋi hu fɛɛ.
"Nakai be lɛ mɔ ni aaalɛ tsina biyoo kome kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi enyɔ lɛ,
fufɔ ni eeena lɛ falɛ naa sɔŋŋ lɛ, eeena butru eye, ejaakɛ butru kɛ wo sɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaye.
"Nakai be lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni sá lɛ waintsei akpe ŋmo yɔɔ, nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ aheɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai akpe lɛ, jɛi baatsa kɛ kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmɛii sɔŋŋ shikpɔŋ.
Mɛi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii aaaya ayagbɔbi yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmɛii shikpɔŋ.
Ni gɔji fɛɛ ni akɛ kɔi hu amɛnɔ sa lɛ, nyɛyaŋ amɛnɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaashe kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmɛi lɛ gbeyei. Jɛi baatsɔ̃ tsinai kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi aniyelihe."
8: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kɔ tao kpeteŋkple koni akɛ niŋmaa okadii ni dra aŋma wiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ nɔ, 'Haanii yaa oya! Ofɔ̃yelinii yaa mramra.'"
Mina odasefoi anɔkwafoi enyɔ, ni ji Osɔfo Uria kɛ Zakaria, Yeberekia bi lɛ, ye mi odase.
Mitee yoo, ni ji gbalɔyoo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ena musu, ni efɔ binuu. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ 'Oya Haanii,' 'Ofɔ̃yeli mramra,'
ejaakɛ dani gbekɛ lɛ aaale 'Ataa loo Awo tsɛmɔ lɛ,' aaaloo nii ni Damasko yɔɔ kɛ haanii ni Samaria yɔɔ hu kɛnyiɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ hiɛ kɛaatee."
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Maŋ nɛɛ kwa Shiloa Faa lɛ mli nu ni hoɔ blɛoo lɛ, ni amɛkpokpo yɛ Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ miiba koni amɛbatua amɛ.

Amɛbaashwie amɛnɔ tamɔ faa wulu Eufrate. Emli nu babaoo lɛ aaasram nɔ boboobo, ni eeeha nujɔi fɛɛ anɔ, ni eeeje ŋa kɛaayabote Yuda shukpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaayi kɛyaashi eeeyata gbɔmɔ kuɛ, ni eeekple shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ fɛɛ, Ao Imanuel."
Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛ tsuifãa! Nyɛ majimaji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe.
Nyɛkpãŋa; shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka. Nyɛkɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ, shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ.
Yehowa kɛ mi wie kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ni ebɔ mi kɔkɔ akɛ mikaba mijeŋ tamɔ maŋbii lɛ. Ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni maŋbii nɛɛ tsɛɔ lɛ apãm lɛ, nyɛkatsɛa lɛ apãm; asaŋ nyɛkashea nɔ ni amɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛtsuji akafãa hu.
Shi moŋ nyɛbua Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, akɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni lɛ moŋ gbeyei nyɛshea, ni lɛ ehe ŋmiŋmi amɔa nyɛ,
ni eeetsɔ̃ɛ̃ he Krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã nyɛ; eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ tɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ehã Israel akutsei enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ yaa kɛ tsɔne hu ehã Yerusalembii lɛ.
Mɛi babaoo aaatrɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ, ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. Aaadu amɛ yɛ tsɔne mli, ni aaamɔmɔ amɛ."
Nyɛ mikaselɔi lɛ, nyɛbaa tsɔsemɔ wiemɔi lɛ ayi yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Miikwɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ etee Yakob we lɛ gbɛ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ enɔ.
Naa, mi kɛ bii ni Yehowa ehã mi lɛ, Wɔji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni hiɔ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii hã Israel.

Kɛji mɔ ko aaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyabia okɔmfoi kɛ klamnɔfoi ni wieɔ gugɔjiaŋ kɛ akroma gbee lɛ nii lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ aso esaaa akɛ maŋbii biɔ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ moŋ nii? Aso esa akɛ ebiɔ gbohiinii ehaa hiɛkãalɔi moŋ?"
Nyɛtoa he akɛ, "Nyɛmɔa Yehowa wiemɔ kɛ ehe odaseyeli lɛ mli. Anɔkwa, nɔ ni nifeelɔi lɛ kɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, nɔ kpakpa ko ejɛŋ mli."
Amɛaakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ hejramɔ kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa, ni amɛbaalomɔ amɛMaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Amɛaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ amɛkwɛ ŋwɛi,
ni amɛaakwɛ shikjpɔŋ hi. Shi naa, amɛnaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko fe hejramɔ kɛ duŋ kabiti; ni aaatsi amɛ awo duŋ kabitii lɛ mli.
9: Shi kɛ̃lɛ duɛ kabitii lɛ woŋ mɔ ni aaahi jramɔ mli lɛ he gbeyei.
Mɛi ni nyiɛ duɛ mli lɛ, ena lɛ kpeteŋkple kpo; mɛi ni hi duŋ kabitii shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, la ekpɛ ehã amɛ.
Ohã maŋbii lɛ ayi efa, Ohã amɛnyamɔ efa. Amɛmiinya yɛ ohiɛ tamɔ anyaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli, loo tamɔ mɛi nyaa kɛji amɛmiija haanii.
Ejaakɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni tsɔ̃ jatsu lɛ, kɛ amɛkplamɔ tso lɛ kɛ amɛnɔyelɔ lɛ dɛŋ kpãa lɛ okumɔ fɛɛ mli, tamɔ ofee Midian ta lɛ.
Ejaakɛ aspaatre fɛɛ aspaatre ni tabilɔi kɛbaashimɔ shi yɛ ta lɛ mli kɛ atade fɛɛ atade ni lá ewu mli lɛ, akɛbaafee lai ni ashã.
Ejaakɛ afɔ bi ahã wɔ! Afɔ binuu ahã wɔ. Elumɔyeli kã ekɔŋ. Abaatsɛ lɛ "Naakpɛɛ ŋaawolɔ," "Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ, Naanɔtsɛ, Hejɔlɛ Lumɔ."

EMaŋtsɛyeli lɛ shweremɔ kɛ edɛŋ toiŋjɔlɛ lɛ, esɛɛ efɔŋ yɛ David Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, kɛ eMaŋtsɛyeli hei fɛɛ. Ekɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ nɔ ni ja feemɔ baahã eMaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi kɛya naanɔ. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hiɛdɔɔ baafee enɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ wiemɔ emaje ekɛmiishi Israel, ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ,
ni Efraimbii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Samaria fɛɛ aaanaa ale, amɛ mɛi ni amɛkɛ henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo jwɛŋmɔ kɛɔ akɛ,
"Brikisi tsui lɛ ekumɔ, shi wɔ lɛ wɔkɛ tɛ ni ako baatswa tsui lɛ, ni atoo sikamore tsei lɛ ashwie shi, shiu wɔ lɛ, wɔɔtɛo tsenedru tsei yɛ amɛnajiaŋ."
Yehowa aaatee henyɛlɔi ashi awo amɛ.
Siriabii miijɛ bokãgbɛ, ni Filistibii hu miijɛ anaigbɛ hatoo amɛkɛbami Israel. Kɛ̃lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ naa ejɔŋ; etoigblamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
Isrealbii lɛ kpalee amɛbaa mɔ ni gbla amɛtoi lɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛtaooo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ gbi kometoo nɔ lɛ Yehowa baafo Israel yitso kɛ elei fɛɛ; ebaafo blɛo kɛ glã fɛɛ gbi kome.
Maŋ onukpa kɛ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɔ ji yitso lɛ, ni gbalɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji lei lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ehã maŋbii lɛ edu gbɛ, ni amɛ mɛi ni anyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã.

No hewɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ naŋ amɛblahii lɛ ahe miishɛɛ, ni emusuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛwusãi kɛ amɛkulafoi lɛ ahe. Ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, ebɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ, ni asaŋ efɔŋfeelɔ ni, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wieɔ kwashiai fu lɛ ejɔŋ; etoigblamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
Maŋbii lɛ ayitsoŋwalɛ tsoɔ tamɔ la. Eshãa kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii fɛɛ; esɔoɔ koo hayii anaa la, ni elasu pikɔŋŋ lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu lɛ naa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ shã. Maŋbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ latso ni tsoɔ; mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaa enyɛmi.
Amɛaashra nii amɛye yɛ ninejurɔgbɛ, shi hɔmɔ aaaye amɛ kɛ̃, ni amɛaaye nii yɛ amɛbɛkugbɛ hu, shi amɛtrɔŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye enaanyo loo.
Manase aaate shi awo Efraim, ni Efraim hu aaatua Manase, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaate shi amɛwo Yuda. Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ, ni etoigblamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
10: Kpoo ha mlawolɔi ni woɔ mlai ni ejaa, kɛ mɛi ni ŋmlaa mlai ni ekɛfeɔ mɛi niseniianii lɛ.
Mɛi nɛɛ hãa atsɔ̃ɔ ohiafo sane hiɛ abuɔ shi, ni akɛshɔɔ mimaŋbii ateŋ ophiafo lɛ agbɛnaa nii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni aha okulafoianii, ni ashɔ̃ awusãi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ yɛ nakai toigblamɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni ahum baatswa kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ kɛba lɛ? Namɔ ŋɔɔ nyɛaajo foi kɛaaya nyɛyatao yelikɛbuamɔ; ni nɛgbɛ nyɛaashi nyɛnii ni nyɛna lɛ yɛ?
Eshwɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ fe akɛ amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ yɛ gboklɛfoi ateŋ, aloo amɛ hu amɛnyɔnyɔɔi. Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mifu lɛ ejɔŋ; ni etoigblamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
A! Asiria, mlifu kpoti, mimlila tso!
Mifã lɛ miwo maŋ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ he. Mifã lɛ koni ayatua mɛi ni mimli efu amɛ lɛ, koni eyaha amɛ, koni eshɔ̃ amɛdɛŋ nii, koni enaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa blohuŋ ŋmiamɔ.
Shi jeee nakai ji Asiria yiŋtoo, ni jeee nakai ejwɛŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ. Shi moŋ nɔ ni yɔɔ eyiŋ ji akɛ eyaakpãtã maji ahiɛ wɛɛ, ni jeee maji fioo ko hu,
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni ekɛɔ ji akɛ, "Ani mitatsɛmɛi lɛ jeee Maŋtsɛmɛi sɔŋŋ ni?
Ani Kalno tamɔ̃ɔɔ Karkemesh, ni Hamat tamɔ̃ɔɔ Arpad, ni Samaria tamɔ̃ɔɔ Damasko hã mi?
Bɔ ni miye shikpɔji ni jaa amãgãi ni tsiitsii fe Yerusalem kɛ Samaria amãgãi anɔ lɛ,
Enyiɛ nɔŋŋ amãgãi lɛ tamɔ mifee Samaria kɛ emli amågãi lɛ?:"
Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbe enitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ Yerusalem lɛ, ebaagba Asiria Maŋtsɛ toi yɛ eshwãa kɛ ehewoo lɛ hewɔ.

Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ kɛ minilee na mitsu enɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã shi, Mitsirɛ majimaji ahusuio kɛtee sɛɛ, ni mishɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ amɛmli jwetri; mitsirɛ mɛi ni tra Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ mitswa shi tamɔ tsina feɔ.
Minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii ni amɛna anɔ tamɔ aloɔ looflɔ woji yɛ etsu mli be ni ebɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii anɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baatswa efijiaŋ aloo etswa esɛŋ ekɛɛ nɔ ko."

Shi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, "Ani lema baanyɛ eshwã ewo mɔ ni hiɛ emli lɛ lo? Aloo ani saalai baanyɛ ete shi ewo mɔ ni hiɛ lɛ lɛ? Ani tso nyɛɔ mɔ ni hiɛ lɛ lɛ moŋ nɔ ewoɔ? Aloo kpamɔ tso moŋ nyɛɔ mɔ ni ejeee tso nɔ ewoɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, lootãa hela aye etabilɔi ni eshwishwii lɛ, ni aaawo enyam lɛ shishi la, ni eeetso tamɔ la.
Nyɔŋmɔ, Israel kane lɛ atsɔ̃ la, ni Isreal Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ la lilɛi, ni ebaatso, ni ebaashã ŋmeii kɛ kpitikpitii ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ fɛɛ gbi ko.
Isreal koo ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ, Yehowa baakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ kɛmɔ shi wɛɛ tamɔ gbele hela kpãtãa helatsɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Kooŋ tsei ni aaashwɛ afalɛ shɛŋ no ko bɔ sɔŋŋ ni gbekɛ tete aaanyɛ amɛyibɔ akane.

Be miiba, ni nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel kɛ Yakob shwiei ni ahe eje gbele mli lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ efɔŋ mɔ ni tswia amɛ nii lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ, nɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli.
Mɛi fioo ni eshwɛ aaaba Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛwebii, Israelbii, ayi fa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia moŋ, shi nyɛyi fioo ko pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba. Hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni ato miimɛ nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ jalɛ yɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baakpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛmɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, "Ao mimɛi ni yɔɔ Zion, nyɛkashea Asiriabii lɛ gbeyei kɛji amɛkɛ dadei kɛ amɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtsei tswia nyɛ tamɔ Egiptbii lɛ fee nyɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eshwɛ be fioo, kɛkɛ lɛ mimli ni efu nyɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni mibatsɔ̃ mlifu lɛ mahã amɛ, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mibadɔ kplebi mato amɛnɔ magwao amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Midianbii lɛ yɛ Oreb TɛSaa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Mibawó tso nɛɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ tamɔ mifee yɛ Egipt lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibawo Asiria jatsu lɛ kɛje nyɛkɔŋ, ni abaakumɔ apã ni kã nyɛkuɛ lɛ."
Henyɛlɔ lɛ ejɛ Rimon ebashɛ Ai. Etsɔ̃ Migron kɛho, ni ekɛ Mikmash efee ejatsutoohe.
Amɛtsɔ̃ gɔji ateŋ tsɔ̃mɔhe lɛ, ni amɛwɔ yɛ Geba. Rama miikpokpo, ni Maŋtsɛ Saul maŋ Gebea ejo foi.
Ao Galimbii, nyɛblɔa! Ao, Laishabii, bo toi! Anatotbii, nyɛhãa amɛ hetoo.
Madmenabii hiɛ foi, ni Gebim maŋ lɛ mli bii miijo foi kɛyatao abobaahe.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ ebaato shi yɛ Nob, ni ebaawo atswɛrɛ nɔ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ Zion Gɔŋ, ni ji Yerusalem lɛ.
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hewalɛ ko baaflɔ tsei aniji lɛ eshwie shi. Nii ni ekwɔlɔ gojogojoo lɛ ebaaflɔ amɛ eshwie shi; ni nii ni ehole amɛhe nɔ lɛ, abaaflɔ nɔ.
Yehowa kɛ lema baagba koo hayii lɛ, ni Lebanon baagbee shi kɛ etsei wujiwuji lɛ fɛɛ.
11: Tso fɔ aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ Ishai tso kuku lɛ mli, ni tso nine ko aaahere kɛaajɛ eshishi fã lɛ mli awo yibii.
Ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ baahi enɔ, ni ebaadro lɛ nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ mumɔ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ hewalɛ mumɔ kɛ Yehowa he nilee kɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ mumɔ.
Eeena Yehowa gbeteishemɔ he miishɛɛ. Bɔ ni ehiŋmɛii naa lɛ; jeee nakai ebaakojo; bɔ ni etoi nuɔ lɛ, jeee nakai ebaakojo.
Shi moŋ eeekojo ohiafo lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ni eeebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ humii lɛ atɛŋ yɛ jalɛ naa. Ekɛ edaaŋ wiemɔ aaaplenee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, ni ekɛ emumɔ lɛ aaagbe mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
Ni eeeye emaŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛanɔkwayeli.
Klaŋ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii baahi shi, ni kootsɛ kɛ abotiabi baabumɔ shi, ni tsinabi kɛ jatabi baahi he kome, ni gbɛkɛ bibioo baakpla amɛ.
Tsinayoo kɛ oshishibrishi baaye nii yɛ he kome, ni amɛbii hu baabumɔ shi yɛ he kome, ni jata baakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina nɔŋŋ.
Gbekɛ fufɔoo baashwɛ yɛ shikãa bu naa, ni bi ni atsɛ lɛ fufɔ kɛ enine baaawo onufu bu mli, ni efeŋ lɛ nɔ ko.
Afeŋ efɔŋ, ni afiteŋ nii yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Zion, nɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa he nilee baayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi obɔ kɛ nu lɛ.
Be miiba be ni Maŋtsɛ ni aaajɛ Ishai mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ aflaŋaa ni ashi ahã majimaji lɛ. Lɛ esɛɛgbɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaatao, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ hiɛ baaba nyam.

Nakai be mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ baakpɔ̃ ewebii ni eshwɛ lolo lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, kɛjɛ Asiria kɛ Egipt kɛ Patros kɛ Sudan kɛ Elam kɛ Babilon kɛ Hamat, asaŋ kɛ ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ anɔ kɛaaba.
Yehowa aaashi aflaŋaa etsɔ̃ɔ maji lɛ kɛto okadi akɛ eebua Israelbii ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie lɛ kɛ Yudabii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋ koni ejwɛ lɛ nɔ kɛbakpe.
Ni Israel yeŋ Yuda he awuŋa dɔŋŋ, ni Yuda hu efeŋ Israel awuŋa dɔŋŋ, ni Yuda hu efeŋ Israel henyɛlɔ dɔŋŋ.
Shi amɛbaafee ekome amɛyatua Filistibii yɛ anaigbɛ; ni amɛbaafee ekome amɛyaha bokãgbɛbii lɛ anibii. Amɛbaaye Edom kɛ Moab nɔ kunim, ni Amonbii baabo amɛtoi.
Yehowa baafite he ni Egipt Faa lɛ kɛ enaa woɔ ŋshɔŋ yɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baahã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ atswa yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaŋla Faa lɛ niji kpawo lɛ, ni mɛi aaanyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo.
Ni eeetsɔ̃ tempɔŋ ehã emaŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, mɛi ni eshwɛ aaajɛ Asiria aba lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni jɛi tsɔ̃ gbɛ ha Israel be ni amɛje Egipt lɛ.
12: Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ obaala okɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa, miida o shi, ejaakɛ omlifu mi moŋ, shi omlifu lɛ enaa ejɔ, ni oshɛhe mimii.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji miyiwalaherelɔ. Mihiɛ baakã enɔ, ni misheŋ gbeyei ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
Nyɛkɛ nyamɔ aaayɛ nu yɛ yiwalaheremɔ bui lɛ amli.'
Ni nakai gbi lɛ, nyaakɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, nyɛtsɛa egbɛi lɛ. Nyɛhãa majimaji lɛ alea nibii ni efee; nyɛhãa alea akɛ egbɛi tsii.
Nyɛlaa kɛkafoa Yehowa, ejaakɛ efee nibii wuji. Nyɛhãa alea enɛ yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ.
Ao, nyɛ Zion maŋbii, nyɛblɔa, ni nyɛnyaa, ejaakɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome ni da lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ."
13: Babilon toigbamɔ he gbalɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Amoz bi Yesaia nɔ nɛ.
Nyɛshīa aflaŋaa yɛ gɔŋ kɛ eyiteŋ kpataa nɔ, koni amɛbabote lumɛi agboi amli.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mifã mimɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji mitabilɔi kakabãi lɛ, koni amɛkɛ mɛi ni nyaa kɛ hewoo lɛ aye yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa.
Nyɛboa toi! Aafee hoo yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ majimaji ni jɛ Maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji anɔ ahoofeemɔ ni; Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, miibua tabilɔi asafo naa kɛha tawuu.
Amɛjɛ shikpɔji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ anɔ; Yehowa miiba kɛ mlifu kɛ tawuunii koni ebakpãtã je lɛ he fɛɛ hiɛ.
Nyɛwɔa lele ejaakɛ gbi ni Yehowa to lɛ eshɛ shi etã. Akɛni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ jɛ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, ebaaba mli kɛ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ niji baagboi yɛ ehe, gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ atsuii baafã,
ni amɛbaajijaa; ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛbaababla shi tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ; amɛaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛhiŋmɛii aaatsu tamɔ lá.
Naa, gbi ni Yehowa eto lɛ miiba. Gbi lɛ baafee yiwalɛ gbi ni jɛ mlila kɛ mlifu ni naa wa mli. Ebaaha je lɛ atsɔ̃ amŋfɔ̃, ni aaakpãtã emli eshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛje je lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ gbi lɛ ŋulamii krokomɛi lɛ kɛ oŋwɛ̃ fɛɛ kpɛŋ, ni hulushitee mli tɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ.
Mibagbla je lɛ toi yɛ emli nifɔ̃ɔjianii hewɔ, ni mibagbla mɛi fɔ̃ɔji atoi yɛ amɛnɔshai lɛ ahewɔ. Mibaha hewolɔi ahetsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo, ni mibaba yiwalɔi ahenɔwomɔ lɛ shi.
Mibahã gbɔmɔ adesa he asɛ̃ fe shika ŋmiiŋmil adesa he baasɛ̃ fe Ofir shika ŋmiiŋmi.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu ni naa wa lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, yɛ emlila naa lɛ, ebaahã ŋwɛi he kpokpo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaakpokpo kɛjɛ egbɛhe.
"Gbɔmɔ adesa baatsɔ tamɔ soŋai ni afã lɛ, loo tamɔ too gwaŋtɛŋi ni mɔ ko bɛ ni buaa amɛnaa. Ni no hewɔ lɛ mɛi fɛɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛmaŋbii aŋɔɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawo foi kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana lɛ lɛ, aatsu lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaamɔ lɛ lɛ, eeenyɔ kɛ klaŋte naa.
Amɛmiikwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaaŋɔ amɛbii atswia shi yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛshīa lɛ, aaahahaa amɛmli nii, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ abaato amɛ kabonaa."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, miitee Midianbii ashi mawo Babilon. Amɛ lɛ amɛbuu jwiɛtɛi, ni shika ekɔ̃ɔ amɛhiɛ.
Amɛgãii baagbe oblahii lɛ, amɛmusuŋ etsɔ̃ŋ amɛ yɛ bii ni yɔɔ musuŋ tete he, ni amɛnaŋ gbekɛbii mɔbɔ.
Babilon, Maŋtsɛyelii amli oje lɛ ni ji Babilonbii anumnyam kɛ shwãanii lɛ, baatsɔ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora be ni Nyɔŋmɔ butu amɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ, asaŋ akɛ jɛi efeŋ shilɛhe yɛ yinɔ ko yinɔ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ. Arabnyo ko eshiŋ ebuu yɛ jɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔ ko kɛ etoi eyaŋ niyeli yɛ jɛi.
Jɛi aaatsɔ ŋaŋ kooloi ashibumɔhe, ni tsui ni yɔɔ jɛi aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ patui. Dagumai kɛ jɛi aaafee amɛshihilɛhe, ni sasabonsamii aaajo kɛnyiɛ jɛi.
Klãji aaablɔ yɛ eMaŋtsɛmɛi ashīai fɛɛfɛji lɛ amli. Babilon be lɛ eshɛ etã; atsiŋ ebe lɛ kɛyaŋ sɛɛ ahaŋ lɛ."
14: Yehowa musuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ Yakob he, ni eeena Israel he tsuijurɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛ Isrealbii lɛ aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ. Maŋsɛɛbii aaabafata amɛhe, ni amɛaadɔmɔ Yakob we lɛ.

Maŋsɛɛbii aaawa Israelbii lɛ kɛaayashɛ Israelbii shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ hii nyɔji kɛ yei nyɔji aha Israelbii lɛ. Israelbii lɛ aaaŋɔ mɛi ni ŋɔ amŋ nom lɛ nom, ni amɛaaye mɛi ni fee amɛ niseniianii lɛ anɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi.
Kɛji Yehowa ha nyɛ hejɔlɛ kɛjɛ piŋmɔ kɛ tɔlɛ kɛ nyɔŋ keketee ni aye nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ,
Nyɛkɛ wiemɔi aaabɔ Babilon Maŋtsɛ ahora akɛ, "te aye tɛŋŋ ni mlifu ni shimɔɔ shi lɛ sɛɛ efo nɛɛ? Te eye tɛŋŋ ni haolɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ nɛɛ?
Yehowa efo yiwalɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni Yehowa ekumɔ nɔyelɔi adɛŋ tsi lɛ mli.
mɔ ni kɛ mlila tswia majimaji lɛ nii babaoo ni etooo enine shi lɛ, yɛ maji ni eye amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ena hejɔlɛ, ni enɔ ejɔ; ni amɛmiila nyamɔ lalai.
Sɛsɛoi lɛ miiye o yɔɔ, ni Lebanon tsenedru lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji ni ba bo shi nɛɛ lɛ, tsotoolɔ ko bɛŋkɛko wɔ.'
"Gbohiiaje ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi esaa ehe eeba ebakpee bo. Ekanya mɛi fɛɛ ni ye onukpa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ ohewɔ; ni mɛi ni ye Maŋtsɛ yɛ maji amli miihole amɛhe nɔ kɛmiijɛ amɛMaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ.
Amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛbaabi bo akɛ, 'Bo hu gbɔjɔ nɛkɛ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ? Otsɔ̃ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ, pɛpɛɛpɛ?'
Aba ogbojee shi kɛba gbohiiaje, bo kɛ osaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu. Omlɛgɛ ji saa ni obaakã nɔ, ni gɔgɔmii ji maam ni obaaha.
"Bo Toloo, Jetsɛremɔ okadi, te aye tɛŋŋ ni ojɛ ŋwɛi obaagbee shi nɛɛ? Te aye tɛŋŋ ni, bo ni oba majimaji ashi lɛ, akɛ o etswa shi nɛɛ?
Shi bo lɛ okɛɛ ohe akɛ, 'Mibakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi kɛho Nyɔŋmɔ ŋulamii lɛ ahe. Mawo miMaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ni mata nɔ yɛ kpee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Makwɔ kɛteke atatui lɛ, ni mibafee mihe tamɔ ŋwɛi Grɔŋŋnyo lɛ.'
Shi moŋ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee gbohiiaje, kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
"Mɛi ni aaana o lɛ, aaakwɛ o gãa, ni amɛaabi amɛhe akɛ, 'Kwɛɛ nuu lɛ ni hã shikjpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ni ehã Maŋtsɛyeli ahe kpokpo lɛ.
Mɔ ni kpãtã maji ahiɛ, ni eha je lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ shiaŋa kpataa, ni eŋmɛɛɛ enomii ahe koni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ?
Jeŋ maji lɛ aMaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kamɔ shi kɛ anumnyam, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ egbonyo bu mli.

Shi bo lɛ ashɛ o afɔ̃ kɛjɛ ogbonyobu lɛ mli tamɔ bi ni ashrake lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ aaanyaŋe lɛ. Nɔ ni ona okɛha ohe ji mɛi ni akɛ klaŋte egbe amɛ lɛ agbohii, ni amɛkpleke shi kɛtee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ gbohii ni anaanaa amɛnɔ lɛ.
Akɛ bo fataŋ amɛhe afuŋ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ okpãtã oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni ogbe omaŋbii lɛ. Atsiŋ efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei atã dɔŋŋ gbi ko gbi ko.
Nyɛsaa gbɛhe nyɛtoa Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ bii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi anɔsha lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkate shi amɛmiiŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛmiifee amɛnɔ, ni amɛmiimamɔ maji amɛmiiwo je lɛ mli obɔ̃."
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibate shi mawo Babilonbii, ni makpåtã amɛhiɛ, egbɛi kɛ enii ni eyɔɔ kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ.
Mibahã jɛi atsɔ̃ shadebuai ashihilɛhe kɛ kpaakpo ashikpɔŋ. Mikɛ blɔ baabɛɛ lɛ mashwie." Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ bɔ ni misusu lɛ, nakai ebaaba mli; ni bɔ ni mito miyiŋ lɛ, je ena ena mli nakai.
No ji akɛ mibakpãtã Asiriabii ni yɔɔ mishikpɔŋ, Israel, nɔ lɛ ahiɛ. Mibanaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ migɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛbaawó Asiriabii apã ni kã Israelbii anɔ Lɛ kɛje amɛkuɛ."
