Enɛ ji yiŋ ni ato yɛ je lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ, ni jib minine ni akpã mli kɛtee maji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ nɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto eyiŋ, ni namɔ baaku naa? Ekpã enine mli, ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa aku?
Afi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz gbo lɛ, ajie ninaa nɛɛ ahã.
Ao Filistia, kaanya, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkanyaa akɛ tso ni yi nyɛ lɛ eku; ejaakɛ blikã baajɛ klɛŋklɛŋ onufu lɛ mli eba, ni lɛ ebi lɛ aaafee onufu flikiɔ.
Ohiafoi amli ohiafo lɛ aaana nii eye, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ehia lɛ aaakamɔ shi yɛ hiɛjɔlɛŋ shweshweeshwe; shi mikɛ hɔmɔ baagbe nyɛ, ni nyɛmɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ mibagbe amɛ.
Nyɛ Filitia maji fɛɛ, nyɛwoa yara; nyɛblɔa, nyɛfoa, nyɛtsui afãa, ejaakɛ lasu ko efã kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ; ni tabilɔi ni baa lɛ, yakagbɔmɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ.
Mɛɛ hetoo aaahã Filitia bɔfoi lɛ" Aaakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Yehowa eto Zion shishi akɛ maŋ, ni jɛi ewebii shitswialɔi lɛ aaababa abo yɛ."
15: Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ toigblamɔ he gbalɛ nɛ; Akɛni akpãtã Ar maŋ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ. Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ. Ni Kor maŋ lɛ hiɛ ni akpãtã nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ.
Dibonbii lɛ ekwɔ kɛtee amɛwɔŋjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyafo. Moabbii ewɔ lele yɛ Nebo kɛ Medeba maji lɛ ahewɔ. Amɛshi yi fɛɛ yi kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ tsɛŋ.
Amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛnyiɛ blohuiaŋ, ni amɛwɔ lele kɛ yaafo tsoo yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ kɛ jaji anɔ.
Heshbon kɛ Eleale majiaŋbii lɛ miiblɔ, ni aanu amɛgbee yɛ Yahaz tɔ̃ɔ. Moab tabilɔi lɛ miiblɔ waa; amɛyoyro.
Mitsui miiye miihã Moab. Emli foijelɔi eshɛ Zoar kɛ Eglat Shelishiya; mɛi kɛ yaafo miikwɔ kɛmiiya Luhit, ni mɛi hu ewo maŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he yara yɛ Horonaim gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nimram Faa lɛ egbi; jwɛi eŋla, ni jwɛfɔ bɛ he ko he ko, ni baa ŋmɔŋ hu bɛ he ko he ko.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛtretree nii babaoo ni amɛyɔɔ kɛ nii ni amɛtīa fɛɛ kɛmiifo faa naa kpãi ajɔɔ lɛ kɛya.
Ejaakɛ Moab husui anaa fɛɛ lɛ yaafo sɔŋŋ. Yaafo lɛ shɛ Eglaim kɛ Beer-Elim tɔ̃ɔ,
ejaakɛ Dibon ana amanehulu ni naa wa fe nakai. Mɛi ni na foijee hegbɛ kɛjɛ Moab lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibafã jata mawo amɛhe.
16: Amɛkɛ toobii amaje kɛjɛ Sela maŋ lɛ mli, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, koni akɛyahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ yɛ Yerusalem yɛ Zion gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Moabbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tanɔ loofɔji ni miitsomlo kɛmiiba, amɛtamɔ loofɔji abii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ, faafoohe lɛ.
Amɛmiikɛɛ Yudabii akɛ, "Nyɛwoa wɔ ŋaa, ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane nyɛhãa wɔ. Nyɛfea tamɔ shwane fiŋtiŋŋ hɔ̃ɔŋ nyɛhãa wɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ lɛ atea, ni nyɛkatsɔa foijelɔi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ,

Nyɛhãa Moabbii ni ashwie amɛ lɛ abato nyɛ gbɔ; nyɛfea nyɛhe teemɔhe nyɛhãa amɛ yɛ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ dɛŋ. Kɛji mɔ ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo, ni mɔ ni naanaa mɛi anɔ lɛ elaaje yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

abaajɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee mli afo Maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i ko ama shi. Mɔ ko baajɛ David shwiei ateŋ eta sɛ̃i nɛɛ nɔ, ni ebaaye Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli; ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔ mli, ni ebaakwɛ akɛ aaye jalɛ sane."
Yudabii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔnu bɔ ni Moab wo ehe ehã; ewo ehe tsɔ̃. Wɔnu ehetsɔɔmɔ kɛ ehewoo kɛ ehetsɛmɔ. Shwãa ni eshwã lɛ fɛɛ asomoaŋ eflo ni."
Belɛ nyɛhãa Moab awoa yara; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo yara ahã Moab. Aye ŋkɔmɔ waa yɛ Kir-Heres wainyibii ni ablɔ lɛ hewɔ.

Ejaakɛ Heshbon ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã, ni Sibma waintsei lɛ hu ahiɛ ekpãtã. Waintso ni eyibii hã majimaji alumɔ trɔ dãa lɛ niji eyashɛ Yazer tɔ̃ɔ, ni egba bokãgbɛ kɛtee shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni etee anaigbɛ kɛyashɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mifo miha Sibma waintsei lɛ taakɛ mifo miha Yazer wainyibii lɛ, Ao Heshbon kɛ Eleale, mikɛ yaafonu baaju nyɛhe, ejaakɛ miishɛɛ ni okɛkpaa wainyibii kɛ oŋmãa lɛ sɛɛ efo.
Nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ etã yɛi ŋmɔji lɛ amli, ni alaaa yɛ waintromi lɛ amli lɛ, abɔɔɔ oshe yɛ jɛi; wainŋalɔ ko eŋaaa wain lɛ, lala emushi kɔ̃i yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ misusuma miifo emli tamɔ kpãa saŋku yɛ Moab hewɔ, ni mitsui mli miishã mi miihã Kir-Heres.
Kɛji Moabbii gba amɛhe naa kɛtee amɛwɔjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyasɔle yɛ amɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, nɔ ko jɛŋ mli baŋ.
Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Moab he nyɛsɛɛ ko nɛ.

Shi amrɔ nɛɛ Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, "Biɛ afii etɛ̃ mli lɛ, tamɔ afii ni apaafonyo yeɔ yɛ apaayelihe lɛ, Moab anumnyam lɛ he guɔ baagbo, tsɛbelɛ amɛyi fa babaoo, ni emɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayifalɛ shɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni amɛnaŋ hewalɛ ko."
17: Damasko he gbalɛ nɛ, "Naa, abuŋ Damasko ashiŋ maji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ, shi ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Abaashi Siria maji lɛ ashwie shi kɛya naanɔ. Toi kɛ tsinai kɛ jɛin baafee amɛniyelihe, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei.
Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko ni wa eshwɛŋ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Damasko yeŋ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ; ni mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ Siria lɛ ahiɛ aaashwie shi tamɔ Israel. Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Gbi miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ Israel anumnyam lɛ nɔ baagbɔ, ni eninamɔ ni ehã eshwi lɛ baatsɔ̃ ohia, ni ebaatã loo.
Israel baatsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmɔ ni ŋmãakulɔ eflɔ emli abletsei lɛ eshwie shi, ni eku amɛyi able lɛ; ebaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli ŋmɔ ni eye mli ŋmãa kpɛkpɛo butuu.

Shi kɛ̃lɛ eeeshwɛ mɛi fioo yɛ Israel tamɔ bɔ ni kɛji ahoso mutso ni eshwɛɔ yibii enyɔ loo etɛ̃ kɛ yɛ tso lɛ yiteŋ fɔfɔoo lɛ; loo bɔ ni eshwɛɔ yibii ejwɛ loo enumɔ oo ko yɛ aduawa tso ni ewo baaboo nɔ lɛ. Mi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ."
Nakai gbi lɛ mɛi ahiɛ baasɔ amɛ-Bɔlɔ lɛ; ni amɛbaakwɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ gbɛ.
Amɛbuŋ afɔleshãa latɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛniji fee lɛ amɛhaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko. Amɛkɛ nii ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛniji fee tamɔ Asherim woŋkoi lɛ loo tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi lɛ efeŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛmaji ni he wa lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ maji ni Hivbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ jo foi shi ni amɛtsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i be ni amɛjoɔ Israelbii lɛ anaa foi lɛ, ni nibii ahiɛ baakpãtã lɛ.
Israel, ohiɛ ekpa oyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okaiii obobaa Tɛsaa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ mli akɛ oootɛo tsɛi fɛɛfɛji, ni ooofee wɔŋkoo oha maŋsɛɛ wɔŋ,
ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ ahere gbi nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ, ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ agba afofro gbi leebi lɛ nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ nɔ, shi nikpamɔ lɛ baaje odɛŋ, ni gbi lɛ aaatsɔ ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ hejramɔ ni naa wa gbi.
Ao! Mɛi babaoo afoofeemɔ nɛ; amɛhoofeemɔ lɛ miigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ! Ao! Maji ahoofeemɔ nɛ; amɛmiigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔkei wuji agbɛɛmɔ.
Maji lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ tamɔ ŋshɔi agbɛɛmɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋa amɛyi, ni amɛaajo foi kɛaatee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni aaawo amɛ foi tamɔ gɔŋ nɔ tutuu yɛ lasuogbele mli.
Ni gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ aaahã ŋmiŋmi amɔmɔ mɛi, shi be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ anaŋ amɛ yɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ! Mɛi fɛɛ ni tswaa wɔ ojo kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni haa wɔ nii lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni amɛnaagbee aaatamɔ ahã.
18: Ao! Shikpɔŋ ko yɛ Sudan fai lɛ asɛɛ ni anuɔ fijiaŋtswaa yɛ nɔ,

ni etsuɔ ebɔfoi ni traa ada lɛji amli kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nilo faa lɛ hiɛ. Nyɛ bɔfoi ni nyɛhe yɔɔ oya, nyɛyaa maŋ ko ni emli bii kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro lɛ aŋɔɔ. Asheɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gbeyei yɛ kpaakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ ji amɛ. Fai ejra amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
Nyɛ jeŋ gbɔmɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji ashi aflaŋaa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa, ni kɛji akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ nyɛboa toi.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Majɛ mishishilɛhe lɛ makwɛ kpoo tamɔ hulutsoo mli dɔlɛ, loo tamɔ atatu mli bɔ yɛ nikpamɔ be mli.
Dani aaashɛ nikpamɔ be lɛ, be ni afofro lɛ ekpla, ni wainyibii bibii lɛ epue lɛ, ekɛ klaŋte aaaflɔ niji lɛ ni atsrɛ lɛ kɛ niji ni egblagblai lɛ eshwie.
Abaahsi gbohii lɛ ashwie shi ahã gɔji lɛ anɔ loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi; ni loofɔji lɛ baaye amɛ hulutsoobe mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ baaye amɛ yɛ fɛibe mli."

Nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro ni asheɔ amɛ gbeyei yɛ kpakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ, ni fai ejra amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli baatere nikeenii kɛbaha Yehowa, Taistsɛ lɛ, yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni ajaa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ.
19: Egipt toigblamɔ he gba lɛ nɛ. Naa, Yehowa ta atatu ni hiɛ foi nɔ kɛmiiba Egipt. Egipt amãgãi lŋ atui efã yɛ ehiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mahã Egiptbii ate shi awo Egipt bii nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛhe baawu: mɔ kɛ enyɛmi, mɔ kɛ enaanyo, maŋ kɛ maŋ kɛ Maŋtsɛyeli kɛ Maŋtsɛyeli.
Mahã Egiptbii awerɛ aho amɛhe fe nine, ni amɛyiŋtoi fɛɛ baafee yaka. Amɛbaaya amãgãi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ sisai aŋɔɔ amɛyabi nii.
Mibaŋɔ Egiptbii mawo nɔyelɔ yitsoŋwalɔ ko dɛŋ, ni Maŋtsɛ ko ni esane wa baaye amɛnɔ. Mi Yehowa, ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mikɛɛ."
Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu baaŋla, ni faa lɛ bagbi;
nujɔi ni agbla awo faa lɛ he lɛ amli nu baasha; ni Egipt Nilo Faa lɛ niji lɛ amli ni baakpɔŋ ni ebaagbi, ni neŋ kɛ glãi lɛ hu baakpɔtɔ.
Nilo Faa lɛ toihei komɛi baakamɔ shi efoji, ejaakɛ ŋmɔshi nii ni adu yɛ Nilo Faa lɛ toitoi lɛ baaŋla, ni kɔɔyɔɔ baatswa amɛ kɛya.
Mɛi ni ji wolɛi ni hɛɔ baaye ŋkɔmɔ; mɛi ni shãa loo yɛ Nilo faa lɛ mli anine baashɛ shi.
Mɛi ni kpooɔ ananaŋse anijiaŋ baaje wui, ni mɛi fɛɛ hu ni loɔ klala aaaye jramɔ.
Mamalolɔi kɛ ninenaa nitsulɔji fɛɛ atsui baaye.
Zoan maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kwashiai sɔŋŋ ni. Farao ŋawolɔi ni le nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ aŋawoo lɛ etsɔ buuluiaŋawoo. Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ Farao akɛ, "Nilelɔi abii ji wɔ, ni blema amŋtsɛmɛi ashwiei ji wɔ lɛ?"
Agbɛnɛ Egipt, nɛgbɛ onilelɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Hã amɛgba koni amɛhã ole nɔ yiŋtoo ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto yɛ ohe.
Zoan lumɛi lɛ etsɔmɔ kwashiai, ni Memfis lumɛi hu alaka amɛ. Mɛi ni ji Egipt akutsei lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ehã Egipt edu gbɛ.
Yehowa ehã awo Egipt ŋaa gbonyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ Egipt yiŋ feɔ lɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni edidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ didãa kɛji eeshwe.
Belɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ awa Egipt. Maŋ lɛ mli niiatsɛ jio, ohiafo jio, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi jio, mɛi ni bɛ gbɛi jio amɛnyɛŋ lɛ amɛwa.
Be miiba ni Egiptbii baatsɔmɔ tamɔ yei. Amɛhe baakpokpo kɛ gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, nine nɔ ni ebaawo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Yudabii ahe baaba gbeyei ahã Egiptbii. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aatsī Yuda gbɛi tã yɛ etoiŋ lɛ, eeeshe gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yiŋ ni eto yɛ Egiptbii ahe lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai be lɛ abaawie Hebribii awiemɔ lɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji enumɔ amli; ni amɛaakã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kitã. Abaatsɛ nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ ekome akɛ, "Hulu Maŋ."
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, abaama afɔleshãa latɛ ahã Yehowa yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ tutuutu, ni abaatswa akulashiŋ amã shikpɔŋ lɛ husu nɔ ahã Yehowa.
Akulashiŋ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ okadi kɛ odaseyeli nɔ ahã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ytɛ mɛi ni waa amɛ yi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeetsu yiwalaherelɔ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ, ni eeebafã amɛhe, ni eeehere amɛyiwalaa,
Yehowa aaajie ehe shi etsɔ̃ɔ Egiptbii, ni Egiptbii aaana ale Yehowa nakai be lɛ, ni amɛkɛ afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle aaabasɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛaawo Yehowa shi, ni amɛaye nɔ.
Yehowa aaagbla Egiptbii atoi, eeetswia amɛ nii, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ eeetsa amɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaakpale kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eeebo amɛfaikpamɔ toi, ni eeetsa amɛ.
Kɛji eshɛ nakai be lɛ, gbɛjegbɛ aaakã shi kɛaaje Egipt kɛya Asiria; ni Asirianyo aaaba Egipt, Ni Egiptnyo hu aaaya Asiria, ni Egiptbii kɛ Asiriabii aaaja Yehowa yɛ he kome.
Nakai be lɛ Israel lɛ Egipt kɛ Asiria aaatsɔ̃mɔ tipɛŋfoi; ni maji etɛ̃ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ahã je lɛ mli maji fɛɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaajɔɔ amɛ akɛ, "Ajɔɔ Egipt, ni ji mimaŋ lɛ, kɛ Asiria, ni ji mininenaa nitsumɔ lɛ, kɛ Israel, mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ ni mihala lɛ."
20: Afi nɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sargon tsu etatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ebatua Filistibii amaŋ Ashdod, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ,
Yehowa etsɔ̃ hiɛ afii etɛ̃ momo ekɛɛ Amoz bi Yesaia akɛ, "Yaa koni oyajie kpekpe lɛ yɛ ohɛ, ni ojie otokotai lɛ hu." Yesaia fee nakai, ni enyiɛ yayai kɛ enane flo hu.
Be ni aŋɔ Ashdod sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni mitsulɔ Yesaia nyiɛ yayai kɛ enane flo afii etɛ̃ekɛtro Egipt kɛ Sudan naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ.
Nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ aaakpla Egipt kɛ Sudan akɛ nomii kɛaatee. Abaakpla gbɛkɛbii kɛ onikpai fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe yayai kɛ amɛdukui ahe ni kã kɛ amɛnane flo hu; ni Egipt hiɛ aaashwie shi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaaho ni amɛnaa aaakpɛ amɛhe yɛ Sudan ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ enɔ lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ Egipt hu ni amɛshwã amɛfɔ enɔ lɛ hewɔ.

Ni nakai be mli lɛ, nɛkɛ ŋshɔ nɛɛ naa bii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Naa nɔ ni eba mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kã amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ, mɛi ni wɔjo foi kɛtee wɔyaba abo yɛ amɛŋɔɔ koni ahere wɔ yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ anɔ. Belɛ, wɔ lɛ, te wɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔjke mli hu?'"
21: Babilon he gbalɛ nɛ. Nɔ ni lasuogble tswaa kɛjɛɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, nakai haomɔ aaajɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni he yɔɔ gbeyei nɔ aba.

Ajie ninaa ko ni yɔɔ gbeyei atsɔ̃ɔ mi: mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko sɛɛgbɛ, kɛ nifitelɔ ni miifite nii. Elam, kwɔɔ kɛyai Media, yaasa maji lɛ ayi! Mahã ŋkɔmɔi fɛɛ ni Babilon eha eyeɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo! '
No hewɔ lɛ mihiɛ mli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ piŋmɔ, kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe; kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ. Mishɔ kwekweekwe, hewɔ lɛ minuuu nii. Mijijaa hewɔ lɛ minaaa nii.
Mihiɛ miidi mi; ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi; gbɛkɛ ni mishweɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ moŋ ehã mi.
Ninaa lɛ mli lɛ mina ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃, akɛ kuŋtui lɛɛ shi, aaye nii, ni aanu nii. Trukaa lɛ abo akɛ, "Tatsɛmɛi, nyɛtea shi; nyɛfɔa tsɛŋi lɛ ahe mu."
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi nɛ! "Yaa! Hã ni mɔ ko ayabu, ni nɔ ni eeena lɛ, ehã ni ale.
Kɛji ena mɛi tra okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni ena mɛi hu ni tra tejii kɛ yomai anɔ lɛ, etɛ̃je ehiɛ, ni ebo nɔ ni ebaanu lɛ toi jogbaŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ bo waa ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, midamɔ buuhe nɛɛ gbi muu fɛɛ, ni mibu nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ hu.,
Trukaa lɛ, naa okpɔŋɔtalɔi komɛi ni miiba; amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ!" Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahere nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Babilon egbee shi! Hɛɛ! Egbee shi! Emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ akumɔ ashwie shi nɛɛ!"
Ao mimaŋ Israel, ni otamɔ ŋmãa ni agbee ni asha mli. Nɔ ni minu yɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, no mikɛɛ bo nɛɛ.
Edom he minaa nɛ. Abo atsɛ mi kɛjɛ Edom akɛ, "Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmlɛtswaa be mli nɛ? Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmlɛtswaa be mli nɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Je miitsɛe shi moŋ je baana ekoŋŋ. Kɛji nɔ ko otaoɔ obi lɛ, bi! Kuu osɛɛ ni obabi!"
Arabia he ninaa nɛ. Nyɛ Dedan gbɛnyiɛlɔi asafo, Arabia ŋa lɛ mli nyɛbaaya nyɛyato shi yɛ.
Nyɛ Temanbii, nyɛhaa mɛi ni kumai yeɔ amɛ lɛ nu ni amɛnu, ni nyɛhaa abobalɔi lɛ niyenii ni amɛye,
Ejaakɛ amɛjo foi kɛjɛ ta mli gbele naa, kɛjɛ klaŋte ni agbla awo amɛ kɛ gãi ni abaatsɛ̃ kɛ ta mli oshrãi fɛɛ ana.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Biɛ afi mli, tamɔ apaafonyo apaayeli afi be lɛ, Kedar anumnyam fɛɛ sɛɛ baafo.
Kedar hii kãkãlɔi gãitsɛ̃lɔi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayi faŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɛ."
22: Ninaa ni kɔɔ Ninaa Jɔɔ lɛ he nɛ. Mɛni ji tsui ayiteŋ ni bo kɛ omɛi fɛɛ akwɔ kɛtee nɛɛ?
Maŋ kɛ emli kiŋkãa, maŋ ni mli efli lɛ, omli eyi kɛ hoofeemɔ. Omɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔi lɛ, jeee klaŋte naa amɛnyɔnyɔɔi yɛ, ni jeee ta mli hu amɛgboi yɛ.
Olumɛi lɛ afa kwa ejo foi; ahiɛɛɛ gãi tete ni amɔmɔ amɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni ana amɛ lɛ, amɔmɔ amɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛjojoo foi kɛtee shɔŋŋshɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, nyɛfɔa mi kwɛmɔ; nyɛhãa mafoa kɛ dɔlɛ. Nyɛkagbaa nyɛhe naa nyɛshɛjea mimii yɛ maŋbii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã lɛ hewɔ.

Ejaakɛ gidigidifeemɔ kɛ nibii ni anaanaa nɔ kɛho kɛ nibii ni afee basaa yɛ Nina Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ jɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ. Akumɔ gbogboi ashwie shi, ni blɔmɔ ni amŋbii lɛ blɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, ejije kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Elam tabilɔi ba kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii; ni Kirbii hu ba ni amɛhiɛ amɛtsɛŋi.
Ojɔi kpakpai lɛ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tayaa shwiilii, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ gba sa yɛ Yerusalem agboi lɛ anaa.
Akpa Yuda he mama. Nakai gbi lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ tawuu nibii ni yɔɔ tawuu nibii atoohe lɛ anɔ,
Nyɛ na akɛ David maŋ Yerusalem hei ni agbugbuu awo mli lɛ fa, ni nyɛtswa nubu koni nyɛkɛto nu ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ kpaakpo lɛ mli lɛ eko.
Nyɛkane Yerusalem shīai lɛ, ni nyɛkumɔ shīai lɛ ekomɛi koni nyɛna tɛ nyɛkɛwaje maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ.
Nyɛgba nujɔɔ yɛ gbogboi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ koni nyɛkɛbua kpaakpo momo lɛ mli nu lɛ naa yɛ jɛi. Shi nyɛyakwɛɛɛ ni nyɛyabuuu Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni to nɔ ni ba lɛ hegbɛjianɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, ni asaŋ ehã eba mli lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, tsɛ koni nyɛfo ni nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛshɛshɛɛ nyɛyi ni nyɛmia kɛ kpekpe.
Shi moŋ nyɛna, ni nyɛmli fli nyɛ. Nyɛgbegbee tsinai kɛ toi, ni nyɛye, ni nyɛnu dãi, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnua dãi ejaakɛ wɔ bɛnɛ wɔgboi."
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ni wie, ni minu kɛ mitoi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwa, aŋɔŋ nɛkɛ nɔsha nɛɛ afŋ nyɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaagboi."
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Ba yaa Shebna, tsulɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ; ni okɛɛ Lɛ akɛ!,
mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ yɛ biɛ; ni namɛi ji owekumɛi yɛ biɛ, hewɔ ni okpɛɔ fūuhe yɛ he grɔŋŋ nɛɛ; ni okpɛɔ tɛsaa mli otoɔ okɛfeɔ ofūuhe lɛ?
Naa, bo nuu hewalɔ, Yehowa baawo bo eshɛ efɔ̃. Ebaamɔ omli tswɛ, ni eeefɔ̃ bo kɛbɔle yɛ kɔɔyɔɔŋ,
ni eeeshɛ bo efɔ̃ tamɔ bɔɔlo ni ashɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kplanaa nɔ. Jɛi ooogbo yɛ, bo, onuŋtsɔ we lɛ mli hiɛgbejiatsɛ, ni jɛi otayaa shwiilii fɛɛfɛji lɛ aaaka.
Mashwie bo yɛ onitsumɔ lɛ mli, ni oyelihe aaabɔ bo."
Nakai gbi lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Shebna akɛ, "Kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibatsɛ mitsulɔ Eliakim, Hilka bi lɛ,
ni maŋɔ otade yuu lɛ mawo lɛ, ni mikɛ ohiɛfiinɔ lɛ baafi ehɛ, ni maŋɔ ohewalɛ lɛ mahã lɛ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ tsɛ eha Yerusalembii kɛ Yuda we lɛ.
Maŋɔ David we lɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ naa samfee mawo edɛŋ; kɛji egbele lɛ, Mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ aŋa; ni kɛji eŋa lɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbele.
Mahã emã shi shiŋŋ tamɔ shiŋmlitso ni aka sɛɛ kpɛŋŋ; ni ebaahã etsɛ we lɛ hiɛ aba nyam.
"Eweku lɛ mli bii kɛ hɔi asaji fɛɛ baakã enɔ. Amɛbaatsotsro enɔ tamɔ kɔɔpoi bibii kɛ ewuji tsotsro tso nɔ lɛ.
Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, shiŋmlitso lɛ ni akɛ amɛma shi shiŋŋ lɛ, aaawɔtsɔ ni ebaagbee shi, ni jatsu ni tsotsro nɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã." Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ.
23: Nyɛ Tiro lɛji amli asrɛfoi, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmaŋ Tiro lɛjiamaahe lɛ hiɛ. Ajɛ Kipro shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahã amɛle nɔ ni eba lɛ.
Ao nyɛ ŋshɔnaabii, Ao Sidon jrayelɔi, nyɛfea kpoo! Nyɛtsulɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ,
ni amɛnyiɛ fai wuji hu ahiɛ amɛye jra. Amɛye Shihor able, ni ji Nilo Faa lɛ he nikpamɔnii lɛ jra. Nyɛ kɛ majimaji ye jra.
Ao Sidon, ohiɛ agbo; ejaakɛ ŋshɔ ewie, ŋshɔ shishi diɛŋtsɛ ewie akɛ, "Mikɔ̃mɔko dã, asaŋ mifɔko dã. Milɛko oblahii dã lɛ, milɛko oblayei hu dã."
Kɛji sane lɛ yashɛ Egipt lɛ, jɛibii baahoo yɛ Tiro sane ni abagba lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɛ Foinikiabii ni kã ŋshɔnaa, nyɛwɔa lele, nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa Spain.
Kwɛ, nyɛmaŋ ni ji blema maŋ Tiro kɛ emli miishɛɛ babaoo lɛ ni yato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɛ. (Tiro)
Namɔ to nɛkɛ yiŋ yɛ Tiro he, lɛ maŋ ni etioɔ Maŋtsɛmɛi, maŋ ni ejrayelɔi lɛ lumɛi sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, ni eguɔyelɔi ahiɛ ba nyam yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ?
Yehoewa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni to nɛkɛ yiŋ. Eto yiŋ nɛɛ koni ekɛba amɛhe ni amɛwoɔ, yɛ hiɛnyam ni amɛna hewɔ lɛ shi, bɔ ni afee ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anumnyam gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ agboi.
Ao Spainbii, nyɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛya hua; nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni tsīɔ nyɛ gbɛ dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa ewo enine nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ehoso Maŋtsɛyelii. Efã akɛ afite Kanaan mɔji lɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ao Sidon, ni awaa obii yi, omli akafli o dɔŋŋ! Sidonbii, nyɛtea shi koni nyɛyaa Kipro, shi jɛi hu nyɛnaŋ hejɔlɛ."

Naa Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ, Babilonbii lɛ ji mɛi ni hã jwɛiaŋ kooloi kakawuai kpãtã Tiro maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, shi jeee Asiriabii lɛ. Babilonbii lɛ mamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmɔji ni kwɔlɔ, ni amɛkumɔ Tiro mɔji ni yɔɔ sa lɛ, ni amɛhã Tiro fee koikoi.
Ao Spain lɛji amli bii, nyɛwɔa lele, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ ahiɛ.

Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ, hiɛ aaakpa Tiro nɔ kɛyaashi afii nyɔŋjmai kpawo, ni ji be niu Maŋtsɛ kome yeɔ yɛ maɛtsɛ sɛ̃i nɔ lɛ. Afii kpawo lɛ naagbee lɛ, Tiro sane baatsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni alaa yɛ yoo ajwamaŋ he akɛ,
"Ajwamaŋ ni hiɛ ekpa onɔ, kɔ saŋku koni okɛyakpa maŋ lɛ mli. Tswaa saŋku lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni ola lalai babaoo bɔ ni afee ni akai bo ekoŋŋ."
Afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ naagbee lɛ, Yehowa baahã Tiro aku sɛɛ ebɔi ejrayeli lɛ ekoŋŋ. Ebaafee ehe apaafonyo ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ.

Tiro baajɔɔ ejrayeli mli nii kɛ apaa ni abaabɔ lɛ mli nii hu nɔ ehã Yehowa. Atīaŋ esɛɛnamɔ lɛ naa amaŋ shi, shi ejrayeli lɛ mli nii baahã ana niyenii baaboo kɛ mamai fɛɛfɛji ahã mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ Yehowa lɛ.
24: Naa, Yehowa baakpãtã je lɛ hiɛ koni efee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃? Ebaatsɔ̃ je lɛ hiɛ ebu shi, ni ebaagbɛ enɔ bii lɛ eshwã.

Bɔ ni abaafee maŋbii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee osɔfo lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee nyɔŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee enuŋtsɔ lɛ; bɔ ni abaafee weyoo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee ewula lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee nihelɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee nihɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ; bɔ ni abaafee mɔ ni kɛ nii fliɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee mɔ ni fliɔ nii lɛ, ni bɔ ni abaafee mɔ ni ahiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee mɔ ni hiɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Abaakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu, ni abaashi lɛ shwɛm, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, ni ja ena eba mli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ miigbi, ni eeŋla; je lɛ miigbede, ni eeŋla; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ miigbede.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ mlai lɛ anɔ, ni amɛyeee akpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛku naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ loomɔ miikpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni enɔ bii miina nɔ yɛ amɛfɔyeli hewɔ. Enɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi etã ni eshwɛ mɛi fioo ko kɛkɛ.
Wain tete miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni waintso lɛ miigbi. Mɛi ni mli fli amɛ fɛɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ.
Miji kɛ kpãa saŋkui agbɛɛmɔi kɛ nyamɔ lɛ ejɔ, ni mlifliɔi lɛ ablɔmɔ sɛɛ efo.
Wainnumɔ kɛ lala sɛɛ efo, ni dãa ni wa miijoo yɛ dãanulɔ daaŋ.
Maŋ kɛ emli basabasa nifeemɔ lɛ hiɛ ekpatã; aŋmɔ emli shīai fɛɛ ashinai koni mɔ ko akabote eko mli.
Aablɔ yɛ blohui lɛ amli yɛ wain hewɔ; miishɛɛ fɛɛ naa eba shi; afo miishɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Afee maŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni akumɔ agboi lɛ amli dukuduku.
Nɔ ni baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ nɛ. Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mitso ni akpa enɔ yibii loo waintso ni akpa enɔ wainyibii atã.
Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaahole amɛgbei anɔ amɛaala kɛ miishɛɛ. Mɛi aaajɛ anaigbɛ amɛbɔ oshe kɛkafo Yehowa agbojee,
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam yɛ bokagbɛ. Ŋshɔnaa maji, nyɛwoa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.

Wɔmiinu yijemɔ kɛ Jalɔ Koome lɛ hiɛ nyamwoo lalai kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ. Shi mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, "Miitã loo! Miitã loo! Kpoo ha mi, ejaakɛ kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo! Kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo waa diɛŋtsɛ!
Ao shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, gbeyei nii kɛ bu ni atsa kɛ tsɔne ni atsɔ̃ miimɛ nyɛ!
Mɔ ni baajo foi kɛji anu gbeyei sane lɛ, ebaagbee bu lɛ mli; ni mɔ ni baakwɔ kɛje kpo yɛ bu lɛ mli lɛ, ebaadu tsɔne; ejaakɛ aaagbele ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ shitoo lɛ aaahoso.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ewule, shikpɔŋ lɛ egbla, shikpɔŋ lɛ ehoso waa adiɛŋtsɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ dãatɔlɔ ni miididãa, ebaahoso tamɔ aboŋo yɛ ahum mli. Etɔmɔ lɛ tsii yɛ enɔ, ni ebaatsi lɛ egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
"Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baagbla ŋwɛi asafo lɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni abaagbla shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu atoi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Abaabua amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa awo bu ko mli tamɔ gboklɛfoio. Abaaŋa amɛyi awo gboklɛfoi atsu ko mli, ni be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, abaagbla amɛtoi.
Nyɔŋtsere kpɛŋ, ni hulu etsoŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taistsɛ lɛ, baaye nɔ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yerusalem, ni ebaajie enumnyam lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ."
25: Ao Yehowa, boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ; mibakafo bo, mibajie ogbɛi lɛ yi. Ejaakɛ ostu naakpɛɛnii. Oyiŋ ni oto kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ oye ehe anɔkwa.
Oha maŋ lɛ fee koikoi; maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ koikoi; Maŋsɛɛbii aMaŋtsɛ we lɛ ekumɔ, ni akuŋ sɛɛ amaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ maŋ ko ni he wa baawo ohiɛ nyam; ni yiwalɔi amaji lɛ baashe o gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã ohiafo, otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã mɔ ni ehīa yɛ ehīamɔ be mli. Otsɔ̃ abobaahe yɛ ahum mli, kɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ latsa be mli; ejaakɛ yiwalɔi amlifu lɛ, etamɔ ahum ni miitswa,
loo lamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ. Shi bo Yehowa, ojɔɔ Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ he, ni yiwalɔ lɛ he ejɔ tamɔ bɔ ni atatu jɔɔ jeŋ dɔlɛ he lɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ fɔŋ niyenii sɔkɔɔ kɛ wain momo ni adoo nɔ jogbaŋŋ baaŋmɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Ni yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ebaajie ŋkɔmɔ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ atatu ni ha majimaji fɛɛ anɔ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ; eeewo awerɛho ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ muhɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ.
Eeekpãtã gbele hiɛ kɛaatee nanɔ, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ hiɛiaŋ yaafonui fɛɛ. Ebaafo emaŋ lɛ hiɛgble lɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ wiemɔ nɛ.
Nakai be lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɛ. Wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ enɔ akɛ eeehere wɔ. Yehowa ni wɔhiɛ kã enɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa, ni wɔnyaa yɛ edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ hewɔ."
Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ baafã gɔŋ nɛɛ he. Shi Moabbii lɛ abaanaa naa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa jwɛi nɔ yɛ bu ni yɔɔ tumu nɔ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Moabbii aaakpã amɛniji amli yɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ serelɔ kpãa eniji amli ekɛsereɔ lɛ. Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baaba Moab hewoo kɛ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ fɛɛ shi.
Ebaakumɔ Moab mɔji grɔŋŋi kɛ ehe gbogboi lɛ; eeekumɔ fɛɛ eshwie shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ mlu aaaye egbɔ.
26: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaala lala nɛɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Wɔmaŋ ni wa, Yehowa tswaa kunimyeli tamɔ gbogboi kɛ kawoohei ewoɔ he.
Nyɛgbelea maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ koni maŋ ni emli bii feɔ jalɛnii asaŋ yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ abote mli.
Yehowa ohãa maŋ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ naa toiŋjɔlɛ krɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ bo onɔ amɛhiɛkãa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔa Yehowa nɔ daa ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, naanɔ tɛsaa ni.
Ejaakɛ eba mɛi ni tra hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ashi; ni maŋ ni kwɔ lɛ, eba lɛ shi, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ eye egbɔ; ewo lɛ etswa mlu mli.
Mɛi ni aye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ, amɛmiinaanaa enɔ agbɛnɛ; ohiafoi miinaanaa enɔ.
Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ, egbɛ jaa hãa lɛ. Ao, Jalɔ Koome, ohãa jalɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ feɔ trɛtrɛ hãa lɛ.
Yehowa, wɔmiikwɛ bo gbɛ yɛ okojomɔi lɛ amli; wɔmiishwɛ ogbɛ̃i ni kaiɔ wɔ saji lɛ.
Nyɔɔŋ lɛ, misusuma shweɔ bo, mimumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli taoɔ bo kɛ hiɛdɔɔ. Ejaakɛ ojalɛ saneyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, je lɛ mli bii kɛkaseɔ jalɛ nifeemɔ.
Kɛji ana efɔŋfeelɔi amɔbɔ lɛ, amɛkɛkaseee nɔ ni ja feemɔ; shi moŋ amɛyeɔ saji fɔ̃ɔji yɛ he ni afeɔ jalɛnii yɛ, ni enaaa Yehowa agbojee lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, owo onine nɔ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnaaa. Hã amɛna joomɔ ni ojoɔ yɛ omaŋbii ahe lɛ koni amɛhiɛ agboi. Hã la ni oto hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ao Yehowa, oooha wɔna toiŋjɔlɛ ejaakɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni wɔtsu lɛ, boji mɔ ni otsu.
Ao Yehowa, Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, nuŋtsɔmɛi krokomɛi ebaye wɔnɔ kɛho; shi bo pɛ ogbɛi lɛ kɛkɛ wɔle.
Amɛgboi, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ; amɛtsɔmɔ sisai ni ateŋ shi dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ ogbla amɛtoi, ni okpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ao Yehowa, ohá maŋ lɛ ashwere, olɛɛ maŋ lɛ husai amli ni enɛ ewo ohiɛ nyam.
Ao Yehowa, amɛhejramɔ mli lɛ, amɛtao osɛɛgbɛ; amɛsɔle amɛkpa bo fai be ni ogblaa amɛtoi lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, bɔ ni yoo ni hiɛ musu kɛ̃mɔɔ ni eblɔɔ yɛ enɔnaa lɛ mli kɛji fɔ̃mɔ eshɛ shi etã lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔyɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
Wɔhiɛ musu, ni wɔmiikɛ̃mɔ; wɔfɔɔɔ gbɔmɔ; shi wɔfɔ kɔɔyɔɔ. Wɔnyɛko shikpɔŋ lɛ yiwala wɔhere; wɔnyɛko nɔ ko wɔtsu.
Omɛi ni egboi lɛ ahiɛ aaatsɛ̃, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ aaate shi. Ao nyɛ su mli bii, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a, ni nyɛlaa kɛ miishɛɛ! Ejaakɛ obɔ ni nyɔɔ lɛ, bɔ ni kpɛlɛɔ ni, ni ooohã gbohii lɛ ate shi.
Mimaŋbii, nyɛbaa! Mimaŋbii, nyɛbotea nyɛpiai lɛ amli, ni nyɛŋamɔa nyɛshinai lɛ nyɛwoa nyɛyi. Nyɛtea nyɛhe hiŋmɛitswaa fioo ko kɛyaashi Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.

Ejaakɛ, naa, Yehowa miije kpo kɛmiijɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ koni ebagla je lɛ mli bii atoi yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaajie lá shi ni ashwie yɛ enɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni ehaŋ mɛi ni agbe yɛ enɔ lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ."
27: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ klaŋte agbo ni naa ba ni wa hu baabamɔ Leviatan, onufu lɔgɔligi lɛ, ni eeegbe ogboole ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛlaa yɛ waintrom fɛɛfɛo lɛ he nyɛkɛa akɛ,
"Mi, Yehowa, misaa mli; mishwieɔ enɔ nu be fɛɛ be. Mibuɔ ehe nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko akafite emli nɔ ko.
Mimli fuko. Eji ŋmenii kɛ kpitikpitii baawo mi naagba kulɛ, mate shi mawo amɛ, ni mibashã fɛɛ tswɛm.
Kɛji miwebii ahenyɛlɔi lɛ miitao, ni amɛkɛ mi kpãtã. Hɛɛ! Ja amɛna amɛkɛ mi kpãtã!"
Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel eeetsɛ̃rɛ̃ fãi tamɔ tso, ni Israel aaagba afofro hu, ni eyibii aaayi jeŋ fɛɛ.
Ani Yehowa eyi Isreal tamɔ eyi mɛi ni yi Israel lɛ? Aloo egbe Israel tamɔ egbe mɛi ni gbe Israel lɛ?
Okɛ amɛ ye bɔ ni ja gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnomŋɔɔ nɔ. Yehowa kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ loo amɛ kɛtee be ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ kɛji Yakob gblɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ amli tɛi lɛ munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ kaaloo tɛi ni afuflu, ni Ashera wɔŋkoi kɛ tsofãkɛŋmashãa latɛi bɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ lɛ baafa lɛ, ni no aaatsɔ̃ yibii ni etɔ̃mɔkɛfaa lɛ aaawo ahã lɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shihilɛhe ni ashi afɔ shi ni akwa lɛ tamɔ shiaŋa. Tsinabii miiye nii yɛ jɛi; amɛbuumɔɔ shi yɛ jɛi, ni amɛyeɔ nii.
Kɛji emli tsei aniji lɛ gbi lɛ, akumɔɔ ni yei baa ni amɛyashãa. Ejaakɛ amɛjeee maŋ ni nuɔ nii ahsishi. No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni bɔ amɛ lɛ musuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni enaŋ amɛ mɔbɔ.
Ao Israel, nakai gbi lɛ, Yehowa aaahala nyɛ ekomekome kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyaashi Egipt husu lɛ nɔ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni miigbee ŋmãa.

Aaakpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ wulu ko nakai gbi lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni elaaje yɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ kɛtee Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaba, ni amɛaabaja Yehowa yɛ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yerusalem.
28: Kpoo hã Israel dãatɔlɔi hewolɔi lɛ! Kpoo hã Israel anumnyam fɔfɔi fɛɛfɛo ni kã ekuɛ lɛ! Kpoo hã fɔfɔi akekre ni yɔɔ Israel lumɛi ni etrɔ kɛ ŋmãa kɛ wain lɛ ayitsei ahe lɛ.
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ hewalɔ kɛ kãkãlɔ ko; etamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ ni miinɛ kɛ ahum ni kpãtãa n ii ahiɛ; etamɔ nu ni eje ŋa ni eeho boboobo, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baaloo nibii etswia shi.
Nibii ni Efraim dãatɔlɔi lɛ kɛwulaa amɛhe lɛ akɛ nane aaanaanaa nɔ;
ni Efraim lumɛi lɛ anumnyam fɛɛfɛo ni ŋlaa lɛ baalaje tamɔ agbami ni shaa etsuɔ dani eshɛɔ etsulɛ be, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana nɔŋŋ lɛ, etseɔ eyeɔ oya.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, aaatsɔ̃ anumnyam fɔfɔi kɛ akekre fɛɛfɛo ehã ewebii ni aaashwɛ lɛ.
Eeehã kojolɔ lɛ mumɔ ni hãa ayeɔ jalɛsane; ni eeewo mɛi ni fãa maŋ agbo lɛ he hewalɛ.

Wain ehã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahiɛ miidī amɛ, dãa ni wa ehã amɛmiidã. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ miididã kɛ dãa ni wa. Wain ehã amɛluluui, ni amɛmiididãa kɛ dãa ni wa. Amɛnãaa ninaa kpakpa koni amɛgba pɛpɛɛpɛ; dãa hãaa amɛnyɛ amɛbua sane he jogbaŋŋ.
Aamɛshwe amɛkpa okplɔ̃i ni amɛtra sɛɛ lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ; he ko kwraa bɛ ni muji bɛ jɛi.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Namɔ kwraa nii ebaatsɔ̃ɔ mɔ, ni namɔ kwraa ebaagbla sane mli etsɔ̃ɔ? Abifaobii ni atsɛ amɛ fufɔ, loo mɛi ni ayahole amɛ yɛ fufɔ naa?
Ebaatsɔ̃ɔ nii bɔ ni mla nyiɛ mla sɛɛ, ni akpɔ nyiɛ akpɔ sɛɛ, biɛ fioo kɛ jɛi hu fioo lo?"
Dabida; shi mɛi ni naa tseee kɛ maŋsɛɛbii anɔ Yehowa baatsɔ̃ ekɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ awie.
Mɛi ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Hejɔlɛ nɛ. Nyɛhãa mɛi ni etɔ amɛ anaa hejɔlɛ; ni naa tsuiwoohe, kɛ̃lɛ amɛboo toi."

No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ "Mla ni nyiɛ mla sɛɛ, kɛ akpɔ ni nyiɛ akpɔ sɛɛ, kɛ liamɔ ni nyiɛ liamɔ sɛɛ, kɛ biɛ fioo kɛ jɛi hu fioo." Ahã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛya sɛɛsɛɛ koni amɛyagbeegbee shi ni akumɔ amɛ ni tsɔne adu amɛ ni amɔmɔ amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhefɛoyelɔi ni yeɔ Yerusalem maŋbii anɔ, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi!

Akɛni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Wɔ kɛ gbele ekpãŋ, ni wɔ kɛ gbohiiaje hu eye afua, no hewɔ lɛ kɛji ekplebii ni naa wa lɛ miigwao mɛi kɛmiiho lɛ, ebaŋ he ni wɔyɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ amale efee wɔbobaahe, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ teɔ kutumpɔo sɛɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, mikɛ tɛ ko miima shi akɛ Zion shishitoo tɛ; eji tɛ ni aka akwɛ, koŋtɛ ni jra wa ni ma shi shiŋŋ; ni aŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ehe kpokpoŋ.'"
Mikɛ jalɛ saneyeli baafee nɔ ni akɛbaasusu shishitoo lɛ, ni mikɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ baafee kpåa ni akɛbaana ejalɛ. Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi baaloo amɛlei ni nyɛkɛfee abobaahe lɛ kɛya, ni nu baafite nyɛteemɔhe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ aaafo nyɛ lɛ gbele teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni bɔ ni nyɛ kɛ gbohiiaje eye efua lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni kɛji ekplebii ni naa wa lɛ miiho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ.
Shii abɔ ni ebaaho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ ejaakɛ ebaaho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ ejaakɛ ebaaho daa leebi kɛ daa shwane kɛ daa nyɔɔŋ, ni sane lɛ shishinumɔ lɛ ebaafee gbeyei pam.
Ejaakɛ saatso lɛ baafee kuku tsɔ̃ bɔ ni aaanyɛ mli akpã yɛŋ nɔ; ni saanɔbo lɛ hu elɛŋ bɔ ni aaanyɛ akota he awo mli.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaaho edamɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni efee yɛ Perazim Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni eeegri tamɔ egri yɛ Gibeon Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ni eeetsu enaakpɛɛ nii.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛkafea fɛoyeli dɔŋŋ koni akamia kpãi ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli kpɛŋŋ moŋ; ejaakɛ minu akpɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, wo yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ he lɛ.
Nyɛboa toi koni nyɛnu migbee; nyɛfea diŋŋ koni nyɛnu nɔ ni mawie lɛ!
Ani okwaafoi ni miitao amɛdu nii lɛ, humɔ lɛ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛhuɔ daa lo? Aloo shi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛtsaa, ni amɛjwaraa emli kpɔi lɛ?
Kɛji amɛsaa shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni amɛswãaa kowɛ, ni amɛduuu sulu? Ani amɛduuu ŋmãa lɛ srɛnɛɛ kɛ akoko lɛ yɛ gbɛhe ni sa lo? Ani amɛduuuu able yɛ husai lɛ anɔ lo?
Amɛduɔ, ejaakɛ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii, ni egblaa mli etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Akɛ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso egbeee kowɛ, ni akɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔɔ sulu nɔ kɛhooo; shi moŋ akɛ tso gbeɔ kowɛ lɛ, ni akɛ dɛ̃hiɛmɔtso gbeɔ sulu lɛ.
Agblɛɔ able akɛshãa aboloo; agblɛɔ lɛ kɛ ŋaa. Kɛji aha okpɔŋɔi agbla shwiili kɛtsɔ ŋmãa nɔ kɛho blɛoo lɛ, eflɛɛ lɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ji mɔ dɛŋ ni nilee nɛɛ hu jɛ. Enilee yɛ naakpɛ, ni ejwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.
29: Ni Yehowa kɛɛ, "Kpoo hã Nyɔŋmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ji Yerusalem diɛŋtsɛ lɛ. Kpoo hã maŋ he ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ to shi yɛ lɛ! Nyɛyea afi mli gbijuji lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; daa afi lɛ nyɛyea!
Kɛ̃lɛ mi, Nyɔŋmɔ mahã hejramɔ aba Yerusalem nɔ. Ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ aaaba maŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni Yerusalem baayi obɔ̃ kɛ lá tamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni lá ewu he kpɔtɔɔ.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni David fee lɛ, mibatua bo, ni mibabɔle ohe kɛkpe, ni mibasa oyi, ni mibatswa kawoo gbogbo mabɔle ohe.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooojɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ owie; owiemɔi lɛ aaajɛ sumli agbɛɛ blɛoo; ogbee aaajɛ shikpɔŋ egbɛɛ tamɔ sisa gbee, ni obaawie ablɛbi kɛajɛ su mli.
"Ohenyɛlɔi gbɔi lɛ ayifalɛ aaatamɔ mlu, ni yiwalɔi lɛ aaafee tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa. Ni trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ,
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛishiimɔ kɛ shikpɔŋshomɔ kɛ gbɛɛmɔ kpeteŋkple kɛ lasuogbele kɛ ahum kɛ la ni kpãtãa niihiɛ aaakpɔ̃ bo.
Ni amji fɛɛ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ he ni afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mã lɛ wuɔ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ebatua lɛ kɛ emɔji ni amɛhaoɔ lɛ lɛ, asane lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ lamɔ̃, tamɔ nyɔɔŋ ninaa kɛkɛ.

Bɔ ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ laa ni ena nii eeye, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ hɔmɔ lɛ miiye lɛ lolo, aloo bɔ ni mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ laa ni eenu nu, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ efee gbedee, ni kumai lɛ miiye lɛ lolo lɛ, nakai maji fɛɛ ni kɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ wuɔ lɛ asane aaafee.
"Nyɛhãa nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe, ni nyɛlua! Nyɛshwilaa nyɛhe koni nyɛtsɔmɔa shwilafoi! Nyɛtrɔa dãa shi jeee kɛ wain; nyɛdidãa, shi jeee kɛ dãa ni wa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã wɔ ni mli tsii mumɔ enyɔ nyɛnɔ. Nyɛ gbalɔi, Yehowa eŋamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛ ninalɔi, Yehowa kɛ nɔ̃ eha nyɛhiɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ahe ninaa lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ wolo ni asɔo naa mli wiemɔi eha nyɛ. Kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni eeenyɛ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, 'Kanemɔ' lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ 'Minyɛŋ, ejaakɛ aɔoa naa.'
Ni Kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni nyɛŋ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, 'Kanemɔ wolo nɛɛ' lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Minyɛŋ makane.'"

Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛni maŋbii nɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ mi kɛ amɛnaabu kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabu kɛɛ woɔ mi, shi amɛtsui kɛ mi teŋ jekɛ kwraa, ni jamɔ ni amɛjaa mi lɛ ejeee fɛifɛi fe wiemɔi ni amɛkase amɛwo amɛyitseiaŋ kɛkɛ amɛwieɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibafee naakpɛɛ nibii yɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ ahiɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛhe baajɔ̃ amɛhe. Amɛhii nilelɔi lɛ anilee lɛ baafee yaka, ni amɛhii hiɛtɛ̃lɔi lɛ ahiɛtɛ̃ɛ lɛ aaaŋmɛɛ amɛ.
Kpoo hã mɛi ni kaa akɛ amɛyiŋtoi aaate Yehowa, ni amɛfeɔ dujianii, mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Namɔ naa wɔ?" loo "Namɔ le wɔ? lɛ!"

Nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nibii ahiɛ nyɛbuɔ shi. Ani abaaŋɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ akɛ nishɔ̃ɔ su? Ani nɔ ko ni mɔ ko fee aaanyɛ ekɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni fee nɔ lɛ he akɛ, "Jeee lɛ efee mi!" lo? Aloo nɔ ko ni ashɔ̃ aaakɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni shɔ̃ nɔ lɛ he akɛ, "Elee nɔ ko?"
Te etsɛŋ ni Lebanon koo lɛ baatsɔ ŋanɔ humɔhe ni baa nii, ni aaaŋɔ ŋanɔ humɔhe lɛ akɛ koo?
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, toimulɔi tete baanu wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi ni shwilafoi ahiŋmɛi anɔ ni ewo duŋ lɛ aaatsɛ, ni amɛaana nii.
Humii baana miishɛɛ hee yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni ohiafoi amli aaafli amɛ yɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ yiwalɔi aaatã, ni hefɔoyelɔi asɛɛ aaafo, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni shiɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he kpe lɛ, aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ,
Mɛi ni hãa mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ kojolɔ tsɔne yɛ koishi, kɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nɔ ni bɛ mli ni no hãa atsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni sane ja sane hiɛ abuɔ shi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa mɔni kpɔ̃ Abraham lɛ kɛɔ yɛ Yakob we ɛ he nɛ, "Agbɛnɛ yakob we lɛ hiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ, ni ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji ena ebii lɛ, ni ji minenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ, amɛaakplɛ̃ Yakob Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ eyɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛɛlɛŋ, ni amɛaaashe Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni mɛi ni wieɔ hūhūuhū lɛ aaakase nii."
30: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Kpoo hã bii kaniŋkajelɔi ni yaa ajina ni mi, mibɛ mli, ni amɛkpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi ni jeee mitsui naa yiŋtoi ni, ni amɛkɛfeɔ esha amɛshiɔ esha nɔ.
Amɛyiŋ amɛtee Egipt, be mli ni amɛbiii mi ŋaawoo, koni amɛyaba Egipt Maŋtsɛ abo koni amɛyatao teemɔhe yɛ Egipt.
Shi Egipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ Hewalɛ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi, ni Egipt abo ni nyɛyaabɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ eshɛ Zoan, ni amɛbɔfoi lɛ hu eshɛ Hanes, ni ji Egipt maji wuji lɛ anɔ nɛ.
kɛ̃lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaagboi yɛ maŋbii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hã amɛ lɛ hewɔ; amɛyeŋ amɛbuaŋ amɛ, ni amɛnaŋ amɛhe sɛɛ ko; shi hiɛgble kɛ ahorabɔɔ moŋ amɛaana."

Kooloi ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli lɛ ahe ninaa nɛ, "Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ haomɔ kɛ hejramɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni jatayoo kɛ jatanuu hūuɔ yɛ, he ni shinɔ kɛ flikiɔ yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛloɔ amɛnii ni amɛna lɛ amɛtreɔ tejibii ni amɛkɛ amɛjwetrii tereɔ yomai kɛyaa maŋ ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ kɛha amɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Akɛni Egipt dɛŋ yilikɛbuamɔ lɛ bɛ fɛifɛi, ni enyɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko etsu hewɔ lɛ, mitsɛɔ lɛ 'Naafuutsɛ ni etīii ehe.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ yaa ni oyaŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtrɛbii anɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni oŋma owo wolo mli koni ekã shi akɛ odaseyelinɔ ehã wɔsɛɛ be kɛya naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi atuatselɔi, bii amalelɔ ni amɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ Yehowa toiboo ji amɛ.
Amɛkɛɔ ninalɔi lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛkanaa nii' ni amɛkɛɔ gbalɔi lɛ hu akɛ, 'Nyɛkagbaa anɔkwale gbalɛ nyɛtsɔa wɔ; shi moŋ nyɛyɛ wɔ awiea wiemɔ ni ŋɔɔ; nyɛgbea shishinumɔ gbalɛi moŋ;
nyɛshīa gbɛ lɛ, nyɛgbaa afã kɛjea tempɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nyɛ kɛ wɔ akawiea Israel mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he dɔŋŋ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nɔ ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ "Akɛni nyɛkwa wiemɔ nɛɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ yawalɛ kɛ kutumpɔo nɔ, asaŋ nyɛshwãa hu nyɛfɔɔ nɔ,
hewɔ lɛ nɔsha ni nyɛfee nɛɛ aaahã nyɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo gojoo ni mli egba, ni ekpa, ni eehe egbee shi, ni trukaa hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ eeekumɔ eshwie shi.
Ekuumɔ lɛ aaafee tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ ni ajwara lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ bɔ ni anaaa eŋɛsuko kome po nɛkɛ kɛkɛ yɛ ekoi lɛ amli ni aaanyɛ akɛje la yɛ latɛ mli, aloo akɛyɛ nu yɛ dudɔ mli tete.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Isreal Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, "Sɛɛkuu kɛ baa kɛ diŋŋfeemɔ mli nyɛyi aaana wala yɛ; kpoofeemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli nyɛhewalɛ yɔɔ. Shi moŋ nyɛkwa,
ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, Dabida! Wɔɔtra okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛjo foi. No hewɔ lɛ foi kɛ̃ nyɛaajo. Ni nyɛkɛɛ hu akɛ, 'Wɔɔtra okpɔŋɔi ni foijee naa wa nɔ.' No hewɔ lɛ mɛi ni aaatiu nyɛ lɛ hu afoijee naa baawa.
Gbɔmɔ kome too yiŋaa naa lɛ, mɛi akpe aaajo foi; nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaajo foi kɛji mɛi enumɔ ŋa nyɛyi kɛyaashi neyinɔ ni aaashwɛ mɛi fio tamɔ aflaŋaa tso ni ma Gɔŋ yiteŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa miimɛ koni edro nyɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ efee kralo koni ena nyɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane ni. Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã enɔ lɛ."
Ao nyɛ Zionbii ni nyɛ yɔɔ Yerusalem, nyɛwoŋ yara nyɛfoŋ dɔŋŋ. Emusuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe kɛji nyɛblɔ nyɛtsɛ lɛ. Kɛji enu blɔmɔ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ hetoo.
Yɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã amanehulu kɛ haomɔ eba nyɛnɔ moŋ nɛ, shi nyɛ-Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ eteŋ ehe dɔŋŋ, shi nyɛhiŋmɛii aaana nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ.
Ni ninejurɔgbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, abɛkugbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, nyɛtoii aaanu wiemɔ ko yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ akɛ, "Gbɛ lɛ nɛ, nyɛyia nɔ!"
Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaabule nyɛmãgãi ni ashwie he shika lɛ hu. Nyɛaashɛrɛ amɛ nyɛshwie tamɔ nibii ni ahe tseee; nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, "Aloo amɛ ashwie kɛjɛ wɔhiɛ."
Eeehã nu anɛ ashwie nyɛdumɔ wui ni nyɛdu lɛ nɔ, kɛ ŋmãa ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaawo yibii babaoo. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛtsinai lɛ aaaye nii yɛ ŋa ni lɛɛ nɔ,
ni nyɛtsina kɛ tejii ni akɛhuɔ lɛ aaaye nii ni ŋoo Yɔɔ mli, ní akɛ sofi kɛ ŋmɔshi faka esha mli.
Ni gbi bɔ ni aaaplenee gbɔmɛi babaoo, ni amɛmɔji lɛ aaagbeegbee shi lɛ, faa baaho yɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi fɛɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi ni kwɔlɔ fɛɛ anɔ.

Ni nyɔŋtsere aaakpɛ tamɔ hulu tsoɔ, ni hulu aaatso bɔ ni etsoɔ daa lɛ toi kpawo, tamɔ gbii kpawo mli hulutsoo ni abua naa, gbi ni Yehowa aaafimɔ emaŋ lɛ pilamɔ anɔ, ni eeetsa faji ni ewo amɛ be ni etswia amɛ nii lɛ.
Naa Yehowa hewalɛ jɛ shɔŋŋ miiba! Emlifu miitso, ni eeje lasu kpɔŋŋ; enaa miitswa afui kɛ mlila, ni elilɛi tamɔ la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ.
Emumɔ ni emuɔ lɛ tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛbata kuɛ, ni ebaakpãtã maji ahiɛ koni ekɛsha amɛmli tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa nii amli lɛ. Ebaawo majimaji lɛ adaaŋ manyofiɛ koni ekpla amɛ kɛya.

Nyɛaala lala ko tamɔ bɔ ni alaa nyɔɔŋ kɛji aaye gbijurɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ko lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛtsui aaayimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ tamɔ mɛi ni aakpã blɛ aahã amɛ, be mli ni amɛnyiɛ kɛyaa Yehowa, ni ji Israel Tɛsaa lɛ, we lɛ.
Ni Yehowa aaahã anu enumnyam gbee lɛ, ni eeehã ana ehewalɛ nine ni kplekeɔ shi lɛ kɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ, la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ aaatso, ni atatui aaaflɛ, ni nu kɛ nyɔŋmɔtɛi aaanyɛ.
Asiriabiii aaayoyro kɛji amɛnu Yehowa gbee lɛm be ni ebaatswa amɛ nɔ kɛgbla amɛtoi lɛ.
Bɔ ni miji kɛ saŋkui agbɛɛmɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, nakai Yehowa baatswa amɛ kpãa kɛgbla amɛtoi. Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Asiriabii lɛ baaawu.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ni asaa he lo ato kɛha Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ shãa. Jɛi kwɔ, ni elɛɛ, ni eyi kɛ la kɛ lai babaoo. Ni Yehowa mumɔ ni emuɔ ni tamɔ la lɛ baama laii lɛ anaa la,
31: Kpoo ha mɛi ni yaa Egipt amɛyataoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ tayaa shwiilii anɔ ejaakɛ amɛfa, kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi hu anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa naakpa, shi amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ moŋ nɔ, loo amɛbiii Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ po!
Tsɛbelɛ, Lɛji nilelɔ, ni ehãa efɔŋ baa, ni ekpaleee enaa, shi eteɔ shi ewoɔ efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ buaa efɔŋfeelɔ.

Egiptbii lɛ gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ; jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛ, ni amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ heloo kɛ lá ni, shi jeee mumɔi ni. Kɛji Yehowa wo enine nɔ lɛ mɔ ni yeɔ buaa mɔ lɛ aaatɛ, ni mɔ ni ayeɔ abuaa lɛ lɛ hu aaagbee shi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.

Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi nɛ, "Bɔ ni kɛji jata loo jatabi miihūu yɛ emilɛ loo he, ni atsɛ tookwɛlɔi asafo tete awo ehe, ni amɛblɔmɔ wooo ehe gbeyei, ni ebuuuu hoo ni amɛaafee lɛ tete lɛ, nakai Yehowa, Taistsɛ lɛ, aaaba abawu yɛ Zion Gɔŋ kɛ ehewɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Bɔ ni loofɔji flikiɔ kɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ ŋwɛi kɛbuɔ amɛtsui ahe lɛ, Nakai Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, baabu Yerusalem he; ebaabu ehe, ni ebaaba eyi, ekɛ ehe baake lɛ, ni ebaahere lɛ.
"Ao, Israelbii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nYɛbaa mɔ ni nyɛtsɛ ehiɛ atua lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashɛrɛ ejwɛitɛi amãgãi kɛ eshika amãgãi ni ekɛ eniji fee ni no hã nyɛfee esha lɛ eshwie.
Asiria hiɛ baakpãta yɛ klaŋte ni jɛɛɛ adesa dɛŋ naa; klaŋte ni jeee adesa ko sɔ̃ baakpãtã ehiɛ, ni ebaajo klaŋte naa foi; eblahii lɛ aaanyɛ amɛnɔ koni amɛtsu nii keketee.
Emaŋtsɛ lɛ baajo foi kɛ tsuifãa, ni elumɛi lɛ aaajo foi kɛ hekpokpomɔ amɛshi amɛflaŋaa lɛ." Yehowa, mɔ ni ajaa lɛ yɛ Zion ni efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli la tsoɔ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ ekɛɛ.
32: Naa, Maŋtsɛ ko baaba eba ye nɔ, ebaaye jalɛ sane; ni lumɛi hu baaba abaye jalɛ sane.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ teemɔhe be, mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ miitswa, loo abobaahe be mli ni ahum miitswa; eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa nɔ, loo tamɔ tɛsaa kple hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi ni hiŋmɛi nɔ tse baana nɔ fɛɛ nɔ faŋŋ, ni mɛi hu ni toiiaŋ tse baabo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ toi jogbaŋŋ.
Mɛi ni kulɛ amɛtsuii yɔɔ floflo lɛ aaakase nilee kpakpa, ni momohalɔi awiemɔ mli aaatsɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni amɛlilɛi tɛrɛŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Atsɛŋ kwashia akɛ ablade dɔŋŋ ni shishiulɔ hu abuŋ lɛ oje dɔŋŋ.
Kwashia wieɔ kwashiai awiemɔ, ni nishaianii ehe ejwɛŋɔ, ni enifeemɔ etsɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ; ewieɔ eshiɔ Yehowa. Ehãaa mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ niyenii, ni egbeɔ mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ kumai.
Shishiulɔ nifeemɔ lɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni; etoɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa koni ekɛ amale wiemɔi akpãtã ohiɛfo hiɛ kɛji ohiafo sane ha tete po lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni ji ablade lɛ, efeɔ abladei anii, ni efãa nɔ kpakpa he hu.
Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛtea shi, nyɛboa mi toi! Nyɛ biyei hu ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ̃ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa miwiemɔi lɛ!
Nyɛ yei ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, biɛ afi kɛ nɔ ko fioo mli lɛ, nyɛhe aaakpokpo, ejaakɛ wainyibii aaakpla, ni eko baŋ dɔŋŋ ni aaana atse.
Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa! Nyɛkplɔa nyɛtadei koni nyɛnyiɛ yayai koni nyɛklɔa kpekpe nyɛŋmɔlɔ nyɛhe.
Nyɛyia nyɛtsitsi nɔ ma yɛ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ fɛɔ kɛ waintsei ni woɔ yibii pii lɛ ahewɔ;
yɛ ŋmɛi kɛ kpitikpiti ni aaakwɛ̃ yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ. Hɛɛ! Yɛ shīai ni eyimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ maji ni miishɛɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ aaajo foi ashi mɔɔ, ni aaashi maŋ ni emli kɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ afɔ̃ shi. Gɔŋkpo kɛ buumɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kooloi abui kɛ ŋaŋ tejii amiishɛɛnamɔhe kɛ toi hu aniyelihe kɛaate naanɔ.
Be miiba ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaafɔse Mumɔ lɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi eshwie wɔnɔ, ni shiaŋa lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii, ni shikpɔŋ ni baa nii aaatsɔ̃ koo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni abaafee nɔ ni ja yɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ nɔ.
Jalɛ saneyeli lɛ hesɛɛnamɔ baafee toijɔlɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ shihilɛ kɛ nyɛmi hemɔkɛyeli.
Mimaŋbii ashihilɛhei baayi kɛ toijɔlɛ, amɛaahi shi shweshweeshwe kɛ kpoo.
Nyɔŋmɔtɛ aaanɛ koo lɛ nɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ lakpatsa, ni aaafite maŋ lɛ kwrakwra.
Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛduduu nii yɛ fai fɛɛ atoii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛ tsina kɛ teji he koni amɛyanyiɛ hei ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ.
33: Kpoo hã bo, fitelɔ, bo mɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ efiyteko bo. Kpoo hã bo, bo mɔshishinyiɛlɔ ni mɔ ko enyiɛko oshishi. Kɛji ogbe onifitemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaakpãtã ohiɛ; ni kɛji ogbe mɔshishinyiɛmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaanyiɛ oshishi.
Ao Yehowa, dromɔ wɔ, shi bo pɛ gbɛ wɔkwɛɔ. Daa gbi lɛ bo ofeɔ wɔhewalɛ kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ yɛ fimɔ be mli.
Kɛji oshi yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, mɛi joɔ foi; ni kɛji owo ohe nɔ lɛ maji gbɛɔ shwãa.
Aaaha nyɛnomŋɔɔnii tamɔ baalabii; ni abaake kɛba onɔ tamɔ otukpɛi.
Awo Yehowa nɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ eyeɔ nii fɛɛ nɔ, Eeehã Yerusalem ayi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ,
ni eeehã nyɛyinɔ afee shweshweeshwe, ni eeedro nyɛ nilee kɛ ŋaa babaoo. Ninamɔ kple ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ.
Naa, kãkãlɔi lɛ miiblɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni bɔfoi ni bɔ mɔdɛŋ ko toiŋjɔlɛ aba lɛ miifo bloblo.
Gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kã eflo, ni gbɛnyiɛlɔi eyaaa baaa. Akumɔ kpãŋmɔi amli, ni abuuu fuamɔi ni aye afua, ni abuuu gbɔmɔ adesa ahãaa fɛifɛi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni eeŋla. Lebanon kooŋ tsei ayibii ekpla, ekoi lɛ miigbi. Sharon jɔɔ shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ etsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni Bashan kɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibai miikpla.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ, mibate shi! Agbɛnɛ mibawo mihe nɔ! Agbɛnɛ abaawo minɔ!
Nyɛhiɛ tutuu mūsū, ni nyɛbaafɔ jwɛi; mumɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛgugɔŋ lɛ, la ni, ni no nɔŋŋ baashã nyɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ kaaloo ni ashã; amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmei ni aflɔ ashwie shi ni awoɔ mli la ni ashãa.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mifee lɛ toi, ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbɛŋkɛ, nyɛ̃kplɛa mihewalɛ lɛ nɔ."
Eshafeelɔi ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ miishe gbeyei, ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ahe miikpokpo. Amɛkɛɛmɔ ji, "Wɔteŋ namɔ baanyɛ la naa edamɔ kɛyashi naanɔ?"
Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii, ni awieɔ nɔ ni ja, mɔ ni nyaaa wieyeli mli nii he, ni eheee nyɔɔŋ nii, mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi koni ekanu láshishwiemɔ yiŋtoi ahe, ni eŋamɔɔ ehiŋmɛii koni ekana nɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ,
lɛji mɔ ji baahi gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni tɛsai aaatsɔ̃ mɔji ahã lɛ, Ebaana nii eye, ni ebaana nu enu.
Okɛ ohiŋmɛii baana Maŋtsɛ lɛ he fɛo, kɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni ká shi shwaŋŋ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Kaimɔ kɛkɛ oookai nyɛsɛɛ ko gbeyei ni oshe lɛ. Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane shika lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni amɛ too ni aye lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane mɔji lɛ yɔɔ?
Onaŋ gbɔmɛi hetsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ dɔŋŋ, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔi wa ni anuuu shishi, ni amɛwiemɔ kɛ momohaa ni anuuu shishi.

Kwɛmɔ Zion, maŋ he ni wɔyeɔ wɔgbii juji lɛ yɛ lɛ! Ohiŋmɛii aaana Yerusalem akɛ toiŋjɔlɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe. Eye tamɔ buu ni ma shi shiŋŋ, buu ni afamɔŋ ehe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ni ehe taŋkpei lɛ ekoeko tseŋ.
Jɛi Yehowa aaahi yɛ enumnyam mli aha wɔ. fai wuji kɛ bibii fɛɛ aaahi jɛi; shi moŋ lɛlɛ agbo ni awiriɔ ko kɛ meele ko nyɛŋ fai lɛ ekoeko mli etsɔ̃ kɛho.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ji wɔkojolɔ, Yehowa ji wɔnɔyelɔ. Yehowa ji wɔMaŋtsɛ; lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaahere wɔyiwala.
Otaŋkpei lɛ amli egbɔjɔ, amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhã shimaatso lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ; amɛnyɛɛɛ abalaa lɛ amɛshi; No hewɔ lɛ nyɛshwiea amɛnɔ, nyɛhaa amɛnii; nyɛjaa nyɛhãa bɔ ni obubuafoi tete aaana amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekɛŋ akɛ, "Mihe miiye." Akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe eshai aaafa amɛ.
34: Ao nyɛ majimaji, nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa koni nyɛbabopaa toi. Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, nyɛboa toi. Hã jeŋ muu lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ, je lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ mli afee toi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa mli efu majimaji lɛ fɛɛ; egri ewo amɛtai lɛ, ji ajɔɔ amɛ nɔ, ni eŋɔ amɛ eha koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Abaashɛrɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ashwie, ni gbohii lɛ aaaje fu, ni amɛlá aaakpa gɔji lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ.
Hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii aaasere, ni aaakota ŋwɛi tamɔ wolo. Amɛtabilɔi lɛ fɛɛɛ aaatswiatswia shi tamɔ baa kplaa yɛ waintso nɔ loo agbamitso nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa esaa klaŋte lɛ eto yɛ ŋwɛi. Naa, klaɛŋte lɛ baayi edom nɔ, maŋ ni ajɔɔ enɔ aha hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ.

Yehowa klaŋte lɛ amɛlá kɛ fɔ ewu he kpɔtɔɔ; tamɔ topo gwaŋteŋi kɛ too kpakpoi alá kɛ agbɛnɛ ojwɛnii asabai ahe fɔ ni akɛshã afɔle. Ejaakɛ Yehowa miishã afɔle yɛ Bozra, ni ebaakpãtã wala hiɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Edom.
Gbɔmɛi baanyɔnyɔi tamɔ wuoi kɛ tsina hii kɛ tsina ajebui. Lá baakpa amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpɔtɔɔ, ni amɛshikpɔŋ su baafee ŋɛlɛŋŋ kɛ fɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ be lɛ ni, be ni ebaaye Zion sane lɛ ehã lɛ koni eto lɛ najiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ.
Edom fai lɛ baadi tuuŋ tamɔ kootaa, ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ su aaatsɔ̃ɛ̃ tamɔ swɔɔ. Eshikpɔŋ tso muu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ kootaa ni miitso.
Ebaatso nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ, ni ebaaje lasu kɛya naanɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃? Yinɔi fɛɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ dɔŋŋ kɛaate naanɔ.
Jɛi aatsɔ̃ kpokukpoku kɛ kɔtɔkɔi agoshinii; ni patui kɛ kwakwaalabitei aaahi jɛi. Yehowa baaha eshikpɔŋ lɛ agbo koni etsɔ̃ olɛŋlɛ, ni nɔ kpakpa ko ehiŋ nɔ.
Aaawo jɛi akɛ, "Maŋnɔyeli bɛ" ni akɛ emli ukmɛi fɛɛ efeŋ fɛifɛi.
Ŋmɛi kɛ sansrɔ kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛ fɛɛ aaakwɛkwɛ̃ɛ yɛ amɛmɔji lɛ kɛ amɛmaji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli. Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe kɛ dugumai hu ahilɛhe.
Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ klãji aaabakpe yɛ jɛi, ni sasabonsami hu aaatsɛtsɛɛ amɛhe yɛ jɛi. Jɛi nɔŋŋ sisai aaaya koni amɛyatao hejɔɔmɔhe.
Patu aaafee etsu yɛ jɛi, eeemɛ yɛ jɛi ni eeebu eii lɛ anɔ uyɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ mli, Akromai aaayabua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi ekomekome.
Nyɛtaoa yɛ Yehowa wolo lɛ mli koni nyɛkanea. Kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ ekome flo nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ ni eyaŋ jɛi, ni eko eko hefatalɔ ebɔŋ lɛ. Ejaakɛ eje Yehowa naa, ni efã, ni Emumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni baabua amɛnaa.
Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔɔ̃ŋŋ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oshiki eha amɛ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ kɛaate naanɔ, ni amɛaahi nɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.
35: Shiaŋa lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ aaanya, shiaŋa lɛ mii aaashɛ ehe ni eeegba afrofro tamɔ fɔfɔi.

Shiaŋa lɛ aaagba afrofro babaoo, ni emli aaafli lɛ, ni eeenya kɛ lala. Aaaŋɔ Lebanon anumnyam lɛ ahã lɛ, kɛ Karmel kɛ Sharon wulamɔ lɛ hu. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana Yehowa anumnyam lɛ, kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ agbojee lɛ.
Nyɛwajea mɛi ni anijiaŋ eje wui lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni anakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkea mɛi ni tsui fãa lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfea ekãa. nyɛkashea gbetei! Naa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ baaba koni ebatɔ nyɛhe owele. Ebaaba koni ebahere nyɛyiwala."
Kɛkɛ lɛ aaagbla shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii, ni aaagble toimulɔi hu atoii;
obubuafoi aaaatumɔ tamɔ ofrote, ni mumuii baala kɛ nyamɔ; ejaakɛ ni aaatue, ni eeeho tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.
Shiaŋa ni enɔ edɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kpaakpo, ni shikpɔŋ ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ baayi obɔ̃ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii. Ŋaŋgbei ashibumɔhei lɛ baatsɔmɔ hei ni nu tra, ni glã kɛ ntoo aaakwɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.
Gbɛjegbɛ aaakã jɛi, ni aaatsɛ gbɛ lɛ, "Gbɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ." Mɔ ko ni he tseee enyiɛŋ nɔ, ni kwashiai tete eduŋ gbɛ yɛ nɔ.
Jata ko jata ko ehiŋ jɛi; kooloo kakawua ko kwraa tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ, akɛ ja mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛyiwala lɛ kɛkɛ.
Mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛ lɛ, aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaaba Zion kɛ nyamɔ lala. Amɛnii aaashɛ kɛya naanɔ; amɛaayi kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyammɔ, amɛyeŋ ŋkɔmɔ ni amɛdɔmɔŋ ŋtsɔi dɔŋŋ.
36: Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji Nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ Senakerib fã ta. ni ebatua Yuda maji fɛɛ ni atswa gbogbo awo he, ni eŋɔ maji lɛ.

Asiria Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ wo etsulɔnukpa lɛ tabilɔi babaoo gbɛ kɛjɛ Lakish kɛbabina Maŋtsɛ Hezekia Yɛ Yerusalem. Tsulɔnukpa lɛ wa yɛ temɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni mamalolɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, yɛ nujɔɔ ni yiteŋgbɛ kpaakpo lɛ mli nu lɛ nyiɛɔ mli lɛ masɛi.

Kɛkɛ ni tsuji nɛɛ, Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ Maŋtsɛ shīa tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, Maŋtsɛ we lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji ni aŋmla lɛ anɔ lɛ, je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛtee eŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ kɛɛ amŋ akɛ, "Nyɛyakɛa Hezekia akɛ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, 'Mɛni po nɔ ohiɛ kã nɛɛ?'
Osusuɔ akɛ naabu wiemɔ kɛkɛ ji naa kɛ hewalɛ ni akɛwuɔ ta lo? namɔ po nɔ ohiɛ kã hewɔ ni otse mihiɛ atūa nɛɛ?
Ohiɛ kã Egipt nɔ. Naa, Egipt' lɛ glã dɛ̃hiɛmɔtso ni eku ni, ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ, etsuɔ edɛ̃. Nakai Egipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ ji hã mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kãa enɔ lɛ."

Asiria Maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ. "Shi kɛji oookɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ,' ani jeee lɛ ehei grɔŋŋi kɛ efɔleshãa latɛi lɛ Hezekia kumɔ be ni ekɛɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalembii akɛ, 'Nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ koome nɛɛ he nyɛbaaja yɛ lɛ?
Agbɛnɛ ba koni okɛ minuŋtsɔ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ, abata abasa. Mahã bo okpɔŋɔi akpei enyɔ kɛji obaana bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi, hii tabilɔi, otra amɛnɔ.
Te ooofee tɛŋŋ onyɛ minuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi bibii fe fɛɛ, lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome po hiɛ odamɔ be mli ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ Egipt tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ lɛ?
Osusuɔ akɛ ba ni miba mibatua shikpɔŋ nɛɛ koni makpãtã hiɛ lɛ, Yehowa fataaa mihe? Yehowa moŋ ni kɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Faa kɛya koni oyatua shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okpãtã hiɛ.'"

Kɛkɛ ni Elikiam kɛ Shebna kɛ Yoa kɛɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, okɛ otsuji awie yɛ Aram wiemɔ mli moŋ, ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ no hu. Okɛ wɔ akawie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli yɛ maŋbii mni jwere gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ atoiŋ."

Shi tsulɔnukpa lɛ to he ekɛɛ akɛ, "Aso nyɛ kɛ nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛkɛ ŋɔɔ minuŋtsɔ tsu mi kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ? Dabida! Miba maŋbii nɛɛ ni tra gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ hu kɛ wiemɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛbaaye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ mi amɛbaanu amɛshãmɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔnŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔnukpa lɛ ho edamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ waa, ni ekɛɛ yɛ! Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ, "Nyɛboa Maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ toi!
Bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nyɛ, ejaakɛ enyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ehere.'
Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miihã nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ miifɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala;' atuŋ maŋ nɛɛ awoŋ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.'
Nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi. Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ keɔ nɛ, 'Nyɛjea kpo nyɛbaa koni nyɛ kɛ mi abakpãtãa, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye ewaintso kɛ egbamitso yibii, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anu enubu mli nu,
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba mabaloo nyɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni tamɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ko ni ablei kɛ wain yɔɔ nɔ, aboloo kɛ waintromi shikpɔŋ.
Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nuyɛ akɛ Yehowa baahere nyɛyiwala.' Ani jeŋmaji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ eko ehere eshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ pɛŋ?
Nɛgbɛ Hamat kɛ Arpad nyɔmɔji lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ Sefarvain nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Ani amɛhere Samaria yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ?
Te nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ ateŋ nɔ ni ehere amɛshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje midɛŋ pɛŋ, hewɔ ni Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ eeehere Yerusalem yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ lɛ?"
Shi Yerusalem lɛ etswaaa amɛsɛŋ, ni amɛfooo edaaŋ, ejaakɛ shi Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ewo amɛ ji, "Nyɛkahãa lɛ hetoo ko kwraa."

Kɛkɛ ni Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ ni kwɛɔ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, blema woji ni aŋmla anɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, ba Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ amɛhe atadei ni egbla, ni amɛbagba lɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ wiemɔ lɛ.
37: Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nu sane lɛ, egbla ehe atadei, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni etsu Elikiam, mɔ ni kwɛɔ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ, kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ osɔfonukpai ni amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛtee Gbalɔ Yesaia ŋɔɔ.
Amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Hezekia kɛɛ nɛ, "Haomɔ kɛ ahora bɔɔ kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ gbi ji ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Wɔtsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eshɛ elagbaŋ, shi ebɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛbaafɔ.

Ekolɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, enu tsulɔnukpa lɛ, mɔ ni enuŋtsɔ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu lɛ koni ebaye Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ he fɛo lɛ, wiemɔi lɛ. Aba mli akɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, enu ahorabɔɔ wiemɔi lɛ, ni ebaagbla mɔ ni wie lɛ toi. No hewɔ lɛ sɔlemɔ okpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai yɛ wɔmaŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahewɔ."
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsuji lɛ ba Yesaia ŋɔɔ lɛ,
Yesaia kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyakɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Kaashe gbeyei yɛ wiemɔi ni onu ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ kɛbabɔ mi ahora lɛ hewɔ.
Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛ mumɔ ko baawo emli ni aaahã enu sane ko, ni no aaahã eku esɛɛ kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mibahã enyɔ yɛ klaŋte naa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ'"
Asiria Maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ ku esɛɛ etee, ejaakɛ enu akɛ eMaŋtsɛ lɛ eshi Lakish. Eyanina Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Libna miiwu.
Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Egipt Maŋtsɛ kɛ Sudan Maŋtsɛ Tirhaka efã kɛmiiba koni amɛkɛ lɛ abawu. Be ni enu sane nɛɛ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛ wolo kɛtee Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ,
"Nyɛyakɛa Hezekia, Yuda Maŋtsɛ lɛ, akɛ, "Kaahã o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ohiɛ kã enɔ lɛ miilaka bo akɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ yeŋ Yerusalem nɔ kunim.'
Be onu nɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ efee shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, bɔ ni amɛkpåtãa hiɛ butuu lɛ? Ani osusuɔ akɛ abahere oyiwala?
Majimaji lɛ ni mitsɛmɛi lɛ kpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ, ani amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ehere amɛyiwala? Ekomɛi ji Gozan kɛ Haran kɛ Rezef kɛ Betlehembii lɛ ni kulɛ amɛhi Telasar lɛ?
Nɛgbɛ hamat Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Arpad Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Sefervaim, Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Hena Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Eva Maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ"
Hezekia he wolo lɛ yɛ bɔfoi lɛ adɛŋ, ni ekane, kɛkɛ ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa ewe lɛ, ni eyagble wolo lɛ mli efɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ,
ni esɔle ekɛɛ, 16: "Ao Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ ni oMaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ma Kerubim anɔ, boji Nyɔŋmɔ hã Maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ, bo okoome pɛ obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.
Ao Yehowa, ba otoi shi ni obo toi. Ao Yehowa, gbɛɛ ohiŋmɛi ni okwɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ lɛ. Bo wiemɔ fɛɛ ni Sakerib kɛtsu kɛba koni akɛbabɔ bo, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ahora lɛ toi.
Ao Yehowa, wyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ ekpãtã majimaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ ahiɛ,
ni amɛhole maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ amɛshrɛ amɛshwie la mli ni ashãshãai, ejaakɛ nomɛi lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi kwraa ni, shi moŋ gbɔmɛi aniji anaa nitsumɔnii ni, tso kɛ tɛ ni, ni no hewɔ afite amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, Ao wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ wɔ yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ kɛna ale akɛ bo okoome ji Yehowa."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, kɛ wiemɔ tsu ayahã Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ "Bɔ ni Yehowa, Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, Akɛni okpa mi fai yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sanakerib he hewɔ lɛ,
nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ yɛ Sankerib he nɛ, Zion biyoo oblayoo fro, Yerusalem ebuuu bo, Sanakerib, ehãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Namɔ ahora obɔ, ni asaŋ ojɛ lɛ lɛ? Namɔ oblɔ owo, ni ogbɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ owo lɛ lɛ? Mi Israel Mɔ-Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni.

Otsɔ̃ otsuji anɔ, ni obabɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahora, ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Mikwɔ kɛtee gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ, Kɛtee Lebanon sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ. Miflɔ emli tsenedrui ni kwɔlɔ lɛ kɛ emli sɛsɛoi kpakpai ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ. Mibote ekoo ni mli ti lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mli.
Mitsatsaa bui, ni minu amɛmli ni, ni mikɛ minaneshi ha Egipt shikpɔŋ nɔ fai fɛɛ tswɛm ŋla.'

"Ani onuko kwraa akɛ mi, mito nibii nakai kɛjɛ blema beebe lo? Ni nibii ni mito kɛjɛ blema lɛ mihã eba mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ okpãtã maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe ahiɛ koni amɛtsɔmɔ nii ni akumɔ abua shi kuikui.
Amɛmli bii ahewalɛ eyashɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; amɛtsui fã, ni amɛyoyro, ni amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ ŋanɔ jwɛi loo bai fɔbii ni etsɛ̃ yɛ tsu yiteŋ ni amɛdraaa, shi amɛŋlaa oya lɛ.
"Mile oshitee kɛ oshitamɔ, kɛ oyaa kɛ obaa mli fɛɛ, kɛ ogrimɔ ni ogri owo mi lɛ.
Akɛni ogri owo mi, ni minu shwãa ni oshwã lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ kpoŋ baatsɛ̃rɛ̃ ogugɔ mli, ni mikɛ mimanyoflɛ baawo odaaŋ, ni mibakpale bo kɛku osɛɛ kɛya; mikɛ bo baatsɔ̃ gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ, "Nɔ ni baaba lɛ he okadi mitoɔ bo nɛɛ: afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛbaaye ŋmãa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekwɛ̃; wɔsɛɛ afi hu nakai ŋmãa nɔŋŋ nyɛaaye. Shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛdua nii ni nyɛkpaa, ni nyɛfea waintromii hu, ni nyɛyea amɛmli yibii.
Yudabii ni eshwɛ, ni ji mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ, baashwere tamɔ tsei ni etsɛ̃rɛ̃ fãi kɛtee shikpɔŋ ni amɛwo yibii.
Ejaakɛ eeeshwɛ mɛi kɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalem kɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aaaje gbele mli. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, hiɛdɔɔ lɛ baatsu enɛ."
"No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kwɛ yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ he nɛ, 'Ebaŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni etsɛ̃ŋ gãi kome nɛkɛ tete ewoŋ mli, ni ekɛ etsɛŋ ko baŋ jɛi, ni asaŋ etswaŋ kpoku ko ewoŋ he.
He ni etsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ eeetsɔ̃ kɛaaku esɛɛ kɛaatee; ni eboteŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli.' Yehowa kɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mibanu maŋ nɛɛ he koni mahere eyiwala yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ kɛ mitsulɔ David hu hewɔ."
Yehowa bɔfo ko tee Asiria tabilɔi lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli, ni eyagbe mɛio akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enumɔ. Be ni ate shi leebi maŋkpa lɛ, naa gbɔmɛi lɛ jwere shi ni amɛgboi.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sanakerib gbla ehe shi ni eku esɛɛ eteeshīa, ni eyahi Nineve.

Ni gbi ko pɛ ni etee ejaa yɛ enyɔŋmɔ ni egbɛi ji Nisrok we lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ebihii, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer, kɛ klaŋte gbe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ebihii nɛɛ jo foi kɛtee Ararat shikpoŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni bihii lɛ eko ni egbɛi ji Esa-Hardon lɛ baye Senakerib sɛɛ akɛ Maŋtsɛ.
38: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, hela mɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia, ni eehe egbo, Gbalɔ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, tee eyasra lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Too owe lɛ he gbɛjianɔ, ejaakɛ oyi naŋ wala; obaagbo'"
Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia tsɔ̃ ehiɛ eha gbogbo lɛ, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai,
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ao Yehowa miikpa bo fai, kaimɔ bɔ ni misɔmɔ bo kɛ anɔkwa kɛ mitsuiŋ fɛɛ, ni mifee nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia fo blobloblo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yesaia akɛ,
"Yaa koni oyakɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Yehowa, otsɛ David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ: Minu ofaikpamɔ lɛ, ni mina oyaafo lɛ; maŋɔ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ mafata owala be lɛ he.
Asaŋ mahere bo kɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ yiwala kɛjɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ. Ni mabu maŋ nɛɛ he'"
"Enɛ ji okadi ni tsɛ̃ɔ bo akɛ mibafee nii ni mikɛɛ lɛ.
Naa, mibahã atrakpoi lɛ asusuma ni hulu ni nyɔɔ shi hãa ebakãa atswere ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ atsi kɛya sɛɛsɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma." Kɛkɛ ni susuma lɛ tsi kɛtee sɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma.
Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he eye, ni ehe ewa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eŋma yijiemɔ lala nɛɛ:"
Misusu akɛ miwala teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, mshi kɛya gbohiiaje agoi lɛ anaa, mayaye mifii ni eshwɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Misusu akɛ minaŋ Yehowa dɔŋŋ yɛ! hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Minaŋ gbɔmɔ adesa ko hu dɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ.
afo miwala sɛɛ tamɔ akpaa tookwɛlɔ buu ni ashi, tamɔ mamalolɔ kotaa ni efoɔ mana nɔ yɛ mamaloo tsɔne nɔ. Gbi kome jenamɔ lɛ miwala sɛɛ efo.
Mifo mitsɛ yelikɛbuyamɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ. Ojwara miwui amnli tamɔ jata, Ofo miwala sɛɛ gbi kome jenamɔ.
Miblɔ tamɔ nyɔŋmɔbitɛte loo kpokukpoku; miye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpo. Ŋwɛikwɛmɔ sɔŋŋ hã mihiŋmɛii shiu. Ao Yehowa, efi mi, daamɔ mli oha mi.
Te makɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ejaakɛ ekɛ mi ewie; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efee nɔ ni ba lɛ. Ehii mi wɔɔ, ejaakɛ misusuma miiye awerɛhoo.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, Enɛɛmɛi anɔ adesai tsɔ̃ɔ amɛhiɔ shi; ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ amli mimumɔ yɔɔ, Ao tsa mi, ni oha miyi ana wala.
Naa, miejurɔyeli hewɔ jɛ ni mina hejramɔ baaboo lɛ, Ojie miwala kɛje hiɛkpåtãmɔ mli, ejaakɛ osherɛ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ oshwie osɛɛ.
Gbohiiaje ejieŋ oyi, ni gbele hu kafoŋ bo; gbohii eŋɔŋ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔŋ anɔkwayeli lɛ nɔ.
Hiɛkãalɔi hɛɛ, hiɛkãalɔi moŋ ji mɛi ni jieɔ oyi, tamɔ bɔ ni mifeɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ. Tsɛmɛi ni hãa bii leɔ anɔkwayeli lɛ.
Yehowa ohere miyiwala, ni no hewɔ lɛ wɔkɛ saŋku aaala milalai lɛ, wɔwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Yesaia kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ eŋɔ agbami ni awie eto esane lɛ nɔ, ni ehe baawa lɛ,
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi Yesaia akɛ, "Mɛɛ okadi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ manyɛ maya Yehowa we lɛ ekoŋŋ?"
39: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, babilon Maŋtsɛ, Merodak-Baladan, Baladan bi lɛ, tsu tsuji koni amɛkɛ woji ni eŋmla kɛ nikeenii baha Hezekia he eye, ni ehe ewa lɛ.

Hezekia here tsuji lɛ atuu, ni eŋɔ amɛ kɛtee shīa ni etoɔ ejwɛtri yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni ekɛ jɛi nii yatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ: jwɛitɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsofaikɛŋmaai kɛ mi ni jra wa kɛ etawuunii fɛɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ enitoohei lɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ enitopohei loo enɔyelihe lɛ mli ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Yesaia ba Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi Lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛbɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ jɛ ba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ, ni mɛɛ amaniɛ amɛkɛba?" Hezekia here nɔ akɛ, "Shɔŋŋ he ko amɛjɛ miŋɔɔ nɛɛ; amɛjɛ Babilon.
Yesaia tee nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mɛni amɛna Yɛ owe lɛ," Hezekia ha hetoo akɛ, "Amɛna nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ miwe lɛ mli; Nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa bɛ minitoohei lɛ amli ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ,"
Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, "Bo nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ toi,
"naa, gbii miiba, bi abaaloo nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ owe lɛ mli kɛ nii ni otsɛmɛi lɛ ebua naa eto kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛaatee Babilon bɔ ni ashiŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, Yehowa kɛɛ.
Asaŋ aaaŋɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ obii ni ooofɔ lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi kɛaatee, ni amɛaatsɔmɔ piafoi yɛ babilon Maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli'"
Hezekia to he ha Yesaia ekɛɛ, "Yehowa naa wiemɔ ni owie nɛɛ hi." Ejaakɛ esusu akɛ elumɔyeli be lɛ baafee shweshweeshwe kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
40: "Nyɛshɛjea, nyɛshɛjea mimaŋ lɛ mii!" Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ
"Nyɛkɛ Yerusalembiii awie tsuijurɔ naa; ni nyɛkɛa Yerusalembii akɛ amɛtawuu be lɛ sɛɛ efo, ni akɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ efa. Eshai ni amɛfee lɛ amɛna he nyɔmɔwo toi enyɔ kɛjɛ Yehowa dɛŋ"."
Gbee ko miibo akɛ, "Nyɛsaa gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛjajea gbɛjegbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ nyɛhãa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Awó jɔɔ fɛɛ jɔɔ nɔ, ni aba gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ shi; Ahã hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi lɛ afee trɛnɛɛ, ni hei ni yɔɔ gɔjigɔji lɛ afee kplanaa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ abaajie Yehowa anumnyam kpo, ni gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ baana, ejaakɛ enɛ jɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ naa."
Gbee ko miino akɛ, "Blɔmɔ"! Ni mikɛɛ, "Te miblɔ mikɛɛ tɛŋŋ?" "Blɔmɔ akɛ heloo fɛɛ heloo lɛ jwɛi ni; ni ehoɔ eyaa tamɔ ŋanɔ fɔfɔi.
Jwɛi gbiɔ, ni fɔfɔi hu kplaa kɛji Yehowa ha kɔɔyɔɔ tswa kɛtsɔ̃ nɔ. Eji anɔkwale akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ jwɛi ni.
Jwɛi gbiɔ, ni fɔfɔi hu kplaa shi wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ."
Aoa Zion, miishɛɛ saneshiɛlɔ, kwɔɔ kɛya gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ. Yerusalem miishɛɛ saneshiɛlɔ, wo ogbee nɔ kɛ hewalɛ, wo nɔ, kaashe gbeyei! Kɛɛmɔ Yuda maji lɛ akɛ, "Naa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ miiba!"
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ miibaa kɛ hewalɛ, ni eeeye nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛmiiba.
Eeelɛ etooku lɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ; eeehiɛ etoobii lɛ yɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ; Eeeloo amɛ eshãkã etsiŋtsiŋ ni eeekpla toonyɛmɛi lɛ blɛoo.
Namɔ kɛ edɛ̃ kɔkɔ esasu ŋshɔ falɛ pɛŋ; ni ekɛ edɛ̃lɛɛmɔ esusu ŋwɛi dã?" Namɔ kɛ nikaakpolu eka shikpɔŋ su pɛŋ, ni eŋmɛ Gɔji lɛ kɛ ŋmeŋmei lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli dã?
Namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa mumɔ lɛ bɔ ni efee dã, loo namɔ etsɔ̃ eŋaawolɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii dã?
Namɔ Yehowa kɛtoɔ ajina bɔ ni afee ni etɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii, ni namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ jalɛ saneyeli? Namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nilee pɛŋ; namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ dã?
Naa, majimaji lɛ tete tamɔ nu kɔi kome yɛ goga mli ha Yehowa, ebuɔ amɛ tamɔ nsɛni he mlu. Nshɔkpɔi lɛ tamɔ mlu kulibii yɛ ehiɛ.
Lebanon kooloi lɛ afalɛ lɛ efaa ha shãa afɔle, ni emli tsei shɛɛɛ lai ni akɛshãa afɔle.
Majimaji lɛ fɛɛ jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko, yɛ ehiɛ, ni ebuɔ amɛ akɛ yakanii, ni amɛjeee fɛifɛi hu yɛ ehiɛ.
Belɛ namɔ nyɛkɛaato Nyɔŋmɔ he, ni mɛ ni yɔɔ su ni tamɔ esu?
Amãgã? No lɛ ŋaalɔ ni shwieɔ, ni shikaŋaalɔ kɛ shika haa he; ni esɔ̃ɔ jwɛitɛi kɔ̃sɔ̃kɔ̃sɔ̃i ewoɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛ jwɛitɛi loo shika lɛ, Eŋɔɔ tso ni wa, ni etaoɔ ŋaalɔ ni he esa, ni egbɔɔ amãgã ni nyɛɛɛ ehe etsi.
Ani nyɛlee? Ani nyɛnuko dã? Ani agbako nyɛ je lɛ shishijee sane? Ani nyɛnuko bɔ ni ato eshishi ahã?
Mɔ ni ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i Lɛ nɔ yɛ je lɛ yiteŋ, yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ ni enaa je lɛ mli gbɔmɛi tamɔ agãi pɛ lɛ, lɛ efee, mɔ ni kpa ŋwɛi mli eha shi tamɔ muhɔɔ, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli tamɔ buu ni ahiɔ mli lɛ.
Lɛ ehãa lumɛi feɔ shwɛm, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelɔi lɛ! tsɔ̃ɔ yaka nɔ ko.
Amrɔ pɛ ji aaatɛo amɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni aaadu amɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni amɛaatsɛ̃ fã yɛ su mli lɛ, Yehowa tswaa kɔɔyɔɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛŋlaa, niu ahum loɔ amɛ kɛyaa tamɔ tutuu.
Namɔ nyɛkɛaato mi mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaaye egbɔ? Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ.

Nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi ni nyɛkwɛa! Namɔ bɔ ŋulamii nɛɛ? Lɛ mɔ ni ejieɔ amɛsafoi lɛ kpo, ni ekaneɔ amɛyibɔ, ni ewoɔ amɛ fɛɛ gbɛi lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni fee. Ehewalɛ kple kɛ enyɛmɔ naa lɛ, amɛteŋ ekome flo nɛkɛ elaajee.
Ao Israel, Mɛɛba okɛɔ akɛ, "Yehowa leee mihaomɔi, ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kwɛɛɛ koni aye mi jalɛ sane" Lɛ.
Ani oleee? Ani onuko dã Yehowa ji naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔlɔ lɛ. Etɔɔɔ lɛ, ni egbɔjɔɔɔ hu, ni aleee ejwɛŋmɔ mlikwɔlɛ.
Ehãa mɔ ni egbɔjɔ naa hewalɛ, ni mɔ ni bɛ nyɛmɔ lɛ, ehãa lɛ nyɛmɔ ni mli wa.
Oblahii bibii aaagbɔjɔ, ni eeetɔ amɛ; ni oblahiia ni edra saŋŋ tete aaagbeegbee shi, ni amɛaafee bliboo.
Shi mɛi ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, amɛaana hewalɛ hee: amɛaafliki tamɔ okropɔŋ amɛaajo foi, ni etɔŋ amɛ amɛaanyiɛ hu, ni amɛgbɔjɔŋ.
41: Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ" "AO nyɛ ŋshɔnaa maji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛfea diŋŋ, nyɛboa mi toi! Majimaji anɔ bii ana hewalɛ hee! Hã amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ koni amɛwie amɛsane lɛ. Nyɛhãa wɔ fɛɛ wɔkpea koni wɔkojoa!

Namɔ ji mɔ ni tee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ? Namɔ hãa eyeɔ Maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ majmaji anɔ lɛ? Ekɛ eklaŋte lɛ hãa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ mlu, ni egãi lɛ gbɛɔ amɛ eshwãa tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔyɔɔ hiɛ.
Enyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ, ni ehoɔ amɛhe shweshweeshwe ni enane esaaa shikpɔŋ tete.
Namɔ tsu enɛ, ni namɔ fee enɛ? Namɔ tsɛɔ yinɔbii kɛjɛɔ jeŋ shishitoohe tɔ̃ɔ? Mi Yehowa, miji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ; ni mi, Yehowa, mi kɛ naagbee mɔ aaafee naagbelɔ.
Ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ ena, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei! Shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ miikpokpo! Amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ, ni amɛna.
Mɔ Fɛɛ mɔ miiye miibua enaanyo. Amɛmiikɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, 'Na tsui.'
Kapintafonyo woɔ shikaŋaalɔ ekãa, ni mɔ ni kɛ hamle jajeɔ nii ahiɛ lɛ hu feɔ mɔ ni tswiaa nii yɛ sɔ̃ŋmɛtɛ nɔ nakai nɔŋŋ. Ekɛɔ yɛ nii ni asɔ̃ɔ lɛ he akɛ 'Ehi!' Ni amɛklaa mli plɛkoo koni ekakpɔ!
Shi bo Israel, mitsulɔ Yakob, mishieŋtsɛ Abraham shwie, ni miŋɔ bo;
bo ni miŋɔ bo kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei kɛba, bo ni mitsɛ o kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ koji shɔŋŋ, ni mikɛɛ o akɛ, 'Mitsulɔ ji o, miŋɔ o, ni mishɛŋ o mifɔŋ."
Kashe gbeyei, shi mi mi kɛ o yɔɔ; kaakwɛkwɛɛ ohe ejaakɛ miji o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!" Mibawaje o, mibaye mabua o; mibahiɛ! omli kɛ mikunimyeli ninejurɔ lɛ!
Naa, mɛi fɛɛ ni mli efu bo lɛ, ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi! Mɛi ni kɛ bo tswaa lɛ aaafee shwɛm, ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Obaatao mɛi ni kɛ bo ena lɛ, shi onaŋ amɛ; mɛi ni kɛ bo wuɔ lɛ aaafee shwɛm.
Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa. o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mihiɛ oninejurɔ mli. Mi, mikɛɔ bo akɛ, 'Kaashe gbeyei, mibaye mabua bo lɛ.'"
Yehowa kɛɛ, "kaashe gbeyei, bo gɔgɔmi Yakob! Kaashe gbeyei, bo Israel, gɔgɔmi bibioo! Miikɛɛ o akɛ maye mabua bo! Okpɔ̃lɔ lɛ ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Naa, mibafee bo glɛmɔ tsɔne kɛ enyanyɔji heei ni naa ba; ni obaagblɛ gɔji lɛ, ni oooshimɔ amɛ muɛmuɛ, oooha gɔŋkpɔi lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ tutuu.
Ooosha amɛmli ni kɔɔyɔɔ aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee, ni ahum aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã. Shi bo lɛ, omii aaashɛ ohe yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni oooshwã ofɔ̃ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
"Kɛji ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ ye nu he kumai, shi nu bɛ, ni amɛlilɛii anɔ gbi kɛ kumai lɛ, Mi, Yehowa, mibabo amɛ toi, kɛji amɛtsɛ mi. Mi, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikwaŋ amɛ.
Mibahã fai aho yɛ gɔŋ kpataai anɔ, ni nuhiŋmɛii baatsrɛ̃ yɛ nujɔi lɛ amli, Mahã kpaakpo abua shi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli, ni nu baaho yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Mahã tsenedru kɛ yɔɔyi kɛ mirtotsei kɛ mu tso akwɛ̃ ytɛ shiaŋa nɔ. Mibatɛo sɛsɛo kɛ papao kɛ wawa koni amɛtsɔ̃ koo yɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Ni mɛi baana, ni amɛaasusu he, ni amɛaanu shishi, ni amɛaale akɛ Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔ ni, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ji mɔ ni fee."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ nyɛsane lɛ abaa, nhyɛ jemawɔji!" Yakob Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, "Nyɛkɛ nyɛklamɔ nibii lɛ abaa
Koni amɛgba nɔ ni baaba amɛtsɔ̃ɔ wo. Nyɛtsɔa wɔ blema nibii nɛ, nɔ ni amɛji, koni wɔsusu he, koni wɔle nɔ ni baajɛ mli aba, aloo nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛgbaa wɔ nibii ni baaba lɛ.
Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ wɔsɛɛ nibii ni baaba koni wɔkɛna wɔle akɛ nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ. Nyɛfea nɔ kpakpa loo nɔ fɔŋ ko koni wɔtsui afã ni wɔshe gbeyei.
Naa, nyɛjeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ hu jeee fɛifɛi. Mɔ ni jaa nyɛ lɛ, musubɔlɔ ni.
"Mitee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ, ni eeba; eeeja mi kɛjɛ hulu shitee mii, ni eeena nɔyelɔi anɔ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ naa su.
Namɔ gba kɛjɛ shishijee mli koni wɔle? Ni namɔ tsɔ̃ hiɛ egba dani eba mli, koni wɔkɛɛ akɛ, 'Ewiemɔ lɛ ja' Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni lɛ ekɛɛ; mɔ ko kwraa ejajeko nɔ ko; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni nuɔ nyɛwiemɔ lɛ.
Mi tsuutsu mikɛɛ Zion akɛ, "Mitsu bɔfo kɛ sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ kɛtee Yerusalem akɛ ebii miiba.
Shi be ni mikwɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ, ŋaawolɔ ko bɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɔ ni kɛji miba lɛ sane ko ni eeehã mi hetoo.
Naa, nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, lakamɔnii ni; amɛnitsumɔi lɛ hu jeee fɛifɛi, ni amɛmãgãi lɛ hu kɔɔyɔɔ flo ni."
42: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa mitsulɔ, mɔ ni mihiɛ emli, mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ, minaa ehe tsuijurɔ lɛ. Mihã eyi obɔ̃ kɛ mimumɔ lɛ, Ebaahã majimaji lɛ ale nɔ ni ji jalɛ saneyeli.
Eblɔŋ, ni ewoŋ egbee nɔ, ni ehaŋ anu egbee yɛ blohuiaŋ.
Glã ni edɔ lɛ, ekuŋ, ni kane ni tsoɔ sulii lɛ, egbeŋ; eeejie jalɛ kpo anɔkwayeli mli.
Enitsumɔ naa baŋ shi, ni enijiaŋ ejeŋ wui kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeehã jalɛ saneyeli amã shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ miikwɛ emla gbɛ."
Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji Yehowa lɛ, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekpã mli, mɔ ni bɔ shikpɔŋ elɛɛ shi, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ, mɔ ni hãa mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mumɔ, kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ nɔ lɛ wala lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,
"Miji Yehowa; mi mitsɛ bo yɛ jalɛ naa. Mimɔ onine mli, ni miiba oyi; miŋɔ bo mifee kpãŋmɔ mihã maŋ lɛ kɛ la hã majimaji lɛ,
koni ogble shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii, ni ojie gboklɛfoi yɛ gboklɛfoi atsuŋ; koni ojie gboklɛfoi ni tra kpabuŋ duŋ mli lɛ.
"Mi, miji Yehowa, migbɛi ji no; mikɛ minumnyam haŋ mɔ kroko, ni mikɛ miyijiemɔ haŋ amãgãi.
Naa, tsuutsunii ni migba lɛ eba mli; agbɛnɛ nii hee mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ; miikɛɛ nyɛ dani eba mli."

Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛlaa nyɛkɛjiea eyi kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeheei lɛ! Nyɛjiea eyi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛɔ ŋshɔ hiɛ; nyɛjiea eyi, nyɛ ŋshɔ mli bɔɔnii fɛɛ! Nyɛlaa, nyɛ ŋshɔ naa shikpɔŋji lɛ anɔ hu, nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛhãa shiaŋa lɛ kɛ emɔ maji lɛ ahole amɛgbei anɔ; nyɛhãa mɛi ni yɔɔ Kedar akrowai lɛ ajiea eyi! Nyɛhãa mɛi ni yɔɔ Sela maŋ wulu lɛ mli lɛ alaa nyamɔ lala; nyɛhãa amɛbɔa oshe kɛjɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ.
Nyɛhãa amɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam, ni amɛjie eyi yɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli.
Yehowa afã tamɔ tabilɔi; etee amlifu shi tamɔ kãkãlɔ. Eebo waa; eebɔ oshe! Eetsɔ̃ ehenyiɛlɔi lɛ ehewalɛ.
Mimua minaa be kplaŋŋ mɛ, mifee dioo; migbe mitsui. Shi agbɛnɛ mibablɔ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔ̃mɔ̃; mamu kɛ tsuisuu, mimumɔ shiŋ shi.
Makpåtã gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛnɔ jwɛi fɛɛ agbi, mahã fai atsɔ̃mɔ faakpɔi, ni mahã kpaakpoi hu amii.

Ni makpla shwilafoi kɛtsɔ̃ tempɔŋi ni amɛtsɔ̃ko nɔ dã nɔ; mabu amɛhe kɛtsɔ̃ nanegbɛ ni aleee nɔ. Mahã amɛhiɛ duŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ la, ni hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi lɛ afee trɛnɛɛ. Nii nɛɛ mafee mahã amɛ, ni mikwaŋ amɛ.
Shi mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔɔ amãgãi anɔ, ni amɛkɛɔ amãgãi ni ashwie lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛji wɔnyɔŋmɔi lɛ," aaashwie amɛ kɛku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ toimulɔi, nyɛboa toi! Ni nyɛ shwilafoi, nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ koni nyɛna nii!
Namɔ eshwila tamɔ mitsulɔ lɛ, ni namɔ emu toi tamɔ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ? Namɔ eshwila tamɔ mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi lɛ? Namɔ eshwila tamɔ Yehowa tsulɔ lɛ?
Israel, ona nibii babaoo, shi otɛ̃jee ohiɛ okwɛɛɛ amɛ. Otoii anaa kã nɛ, shi onuuu nii."
Esa Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ ejalɛ lɛ hewɔ akɛ egbla mla lɛ mli koni ehã mla lɛ hiɛ aba nyam.
Shi emaŋbii lɛ aju amɛ, ni aha amɛ, ni amɔmɔ amɛ awo bui amli, ji aŋɔ amɛ atee gboklɛfoi atsuiaŋ; amɔmɔ amɛ ni jielɔ ko bɛ he ko ni mɔ ko hu bɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Akɛ amɛnii ni aha lɛ ahã amɛ."
Nyɛteŋ namɔ baabo enɛ toi, namɔ eka etoi koni enu nii ni baaba lɛ?
Namɔ ŋɔ Israel ehã nihalɔ lɛ, ni namɔ ŋɔ Yakob ehã ojotswalɔi lɛ? Ani jeee Yehowa? Mɔ ni wɔfee esha wɔshi lɛ, mɔ ni wɔkplɛ̃ɛɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ nyiɛmɔ, ni wɔbooo emla lɛ toi lɛ ni?
No hewɔ lɛ efɔse emlifu ni naa wa lɛ eshwie wɔnɔ, ni ehã wɔnɔ ta joomɔ. Esherɛ la ewo wɔhe kpula, shi wɔnuuu shishi, eshã wɔ, shi no gbaaa wɔnaa.
43: Shi agbɛnɛ Yakob, bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ. Ao Israel, bɔ ni mɔ mi shɔ̃ bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei ejaakɛ makpɔ̃ o. Mikɛ ogbɛi etsɛ o; mi, minɔ ji o!
Kɛji oofo faa mli kwɔ lɛ, mikɛ bo yɛ; ni oofo faa hu nu lɛ esuŋ bo; kɛji onyiɛ la mli lɛ, eshaŋ bo, ni lalilɛi lɛ kpãtãŋ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ,. Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, o-Yiwalaherelɔ lɛ. Miŋɔ Egipt miha akɛ okpɔmɔnii; miŋɔ Sudan kɛ Sheba miha mikɛtsake bo.
Akɛni ojra wa ha mi, ni ohiɛ nyam, ni misusumɔɔ osane hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ gbɔmɛi maha yɛ onajiaŋ ni maŋɔ majimaji maha kɛtsake bo.
Kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mi mikɛ o yɔɔ. Maŋɔ oshwiei kɛaajɛ bokã kɛba, ni mabua onaa kɛaaje anai.
Makɛɛ kooyigbɛ akɛ, 'Ŋmɛɛmɔ amɛhe!' Ni makɛɛ wuoyigbɛ akɛ, 'Kaatsi amɛnaa;' ŋɔɔ mibihii lɛ kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ kɛ mibiyei lɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei kɛba,
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋɔ mi, migbɛi awo lɛ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi mibɔ lɛ, koni ehã mihiɛ aba nyam lɛ."
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, "Tsɛ mimaŋbii lɛ kɛba kojomɔ. Amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii shi amɛnaaa nii; amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii.

Ha majimaji fɛɛ naa abakpe ni gbɔmɛi fɛɛ abua amɛhe naa. Te amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni aaannyɛ agba nɔ ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ egba nɔ ni yaa nɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ? Amɛhã amɛdasefoi lɛ aba amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ koni abu amɛ bem; asaŋ amɛbaye odase akɛ amɛwiemɔ lɛ eba mli anɔkwaleŋ."

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Israelbii, nyɛji midasefoi, mɛi ni miŋɔ akɛ mitsuji koni nyɛle mi ni nyɛhe mi nyɛye, ni nyɛnu shishi akɛ, mi, mi koome ji Nyɔŋmɔ. Mi, misɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ; eko bako dã ni ekoeko baŋ hu.
"Mi, mi nɔŋŋ miji Yehowa lɛ, ni misɛɛ lɛ yiwalaherelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛɛ nɔ ni baaba mito, ni mibahere nyɛyiwala Maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko efeko nakai dã; nyɛji midasefoi."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Miji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ mi ni. Mɔ ko bɛ ni aaaanyɛ ashɔ̃ mɔ ko yɛ midɛŋ. Kɛji miifee nɔ ko lɛ, namɔ aaanyɛ naa atsi?"
Bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Kpɔ̃lɔ, Israel Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Nyɛ, nyɛhewɔ lɛ, mibatsu ta kɛya koni eyatua Babilon. Mibakumɔ amɛgboi lɛ fɛɛ mashwie shi, ni Babilonbii anyamɔ lɛ baatsɔ awerɛhoo.
Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nyɛ Maŋtsɛ Mɔ ni bɔ Israel lɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Be ko lɛ Yehowa gba gbɛ kɛttsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ mli; egba tempɔŋ kɛtsɔ̃ nu hamahama mli.
Ekpla ta kple kɛtee hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, tawuu shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi baaboo. Amɛjwere shi, amɛnyɛŋ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ; amɛgboi tamɔ kane mli odonti."
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ, "Nyɛjiea nyɛjwɛŋmɔ yɛ tsutsu saji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkahiɛa blema nibii lɛ amli.
Ana, mibafee nɔ ko hee ko. Amrɔ nyɛnaa lo? Mibaje gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni mahã faa atue yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.
Ŋaŋ kooloi tete aaawo mihiɛ nyam, ŋaŋ gbei kɛ okpɔŋɔ loofɔji fɛɛ, ejakaɛ mahã nu aba ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni fai hu baatue yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, koni mimaŋ, mɛi ni mihala lɛ, ana nu amɛnu.
Koni mɛi ni mibɔ mihã mihe lɛ ajie miyi."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Israel, ojaaa mi! Israel, ogbaaa ohe naa yɛ mihe!
Okɛ otoo lɛ ebaahãaa mi koni ekɛshã shãaafɔle; ni okɛ oshãa afɔlei lɛ wooo mihiɛ myam. Mikɛ niyenii afɔle gbako onaa, ni mihãaa etɔ bo kɛ krɔbɔohamɔ.
Okɛ oshika heee tsofakɛŋma obahãaa mi; ni okɛ okooloi amli fɔ lɛ ebashɛjeee mimii. Moŋ okɛ ohe eshai lɛ ehao mi, ni okɛ onishaianii lɛ eha etɔ mi."
"Kɛlɛ mi, mi nɔŋŋ ji mɔ mi ŋɔɔ ohe eshai lɛ efaa, yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ, ni mikiaŋ ohe eshai lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Kaimɔ mi. Ha ni wɔkojo. Jajemɔ osane lɛ akɛ aaabu bo bem lo!
Oklɛŋklɛŋ tsɛ fee esha, ni mɛi ni damɔɔ mli hãa bo lɛ tɔ̃ minɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ mibule He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ. Mikɛ Israel hã ni akpãtã ehiɛ, Isreal he guɔ gbo."
44: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao mitsulɔ Israel, Yehowa shwiei, mibewii ni mihala, nyɛboa toi agbɛnɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ bo, mɔ hu ni shɔ̃ bo yɛ onyɛ musuŋ beebe, ni ebaaye ebua bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, Kaashe gbeyei, mitsulɔ Yakob, miwebii ni mihala, ni misumɔɔ,
Ejaakɛ mibanɛ ni mashwie shikpɔŋ ni yeɔ nu kumai nɔ, ni mahã fai atue yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ. Mahã oshwiei ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ mimumɔ lɛ, ni mijɔɔmɔ aaahi oshwiei anɔ.
Amɛaakwɛ̃ tamɔ jwɛi ni enu nu, tamɔ faa toi ŋɔi.
Mɔnɛ baakɛɛ mɔnɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa nɔ ni ji mi; ni mɔ kroko aaaŋɔ Yehowa gbɛi awo ehe, ni mɔ ko hu aaaŋma yɛ enine he akɛ, 'Yehowa nɔ nɛ.' ni eeeŋɔ Yehowa gbɛi awo ehe."
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Maŋtsɛ. Israel Kpɔ̃lɔ̃, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Miji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ kɛ naagbee mɔ; kɛjɛ mi, misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Namɔ kɛ mi ye egbɔ? Ha mɔ lɛ akɛɛ, ha ejaje yɛ mihiɛ. Kɛjɛ blema, namɔ egba nii ni nyiɛ gbɛ kɛbaa dã. Amɛgba wɔ nii ni baaba hu.
Nyɛhe akakpokpoa ni nyɛkashea gbeyei! Ani jeee blema beebe mijɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ minaa? Nyɛji midasefoi! Ani misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ? Tɛsaa ko bɛ he ko he ko, mileee eko."
Mɛi ni feɔ amãgã bɛ nɔ ko mli, ni nibii ni amɛnaa he miishɛɛ lɛ ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ. Mɛi ni jaa amãgãi nɛɛ lɛ ashwila, ni amɛleee nii, ni aaawo amɛ hiɛgble
Namɔ hu gbaa ehe naa efeɔ nyɔŋmɔ aloo, eshwieɔ amãgãi ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ?
Naa, amɛjalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ aaagboi. Mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ amãgãi lɛ, adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ. Ha amɛ fɛɛ amɛbabua amɛhe naa; hã amɛjie amɛhiɛ, amɛbaakpokpo, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi.
Sɔ̃lɔ ji mɔ ni sɔ̃ɔ. Ekɛ ŋai kɛ la tsuɔ he nii, ni ekɛ hamlɛ tswiaa kɛ ekɔjiaŋ hewalɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ. Hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ, ni ehewalɛ tãa, shi enuuu nu, ni no hewɔ lɛ etɔɔɔ biti.
Kapitafonyo ŋmɔɔ kpãa yɛ tso he; eyereɔ kpãa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ pɛnsil kadiɔ he. Egbɔɔ tso lɛ he kɛ dade, ni ekɛ kɔmpas tɛŋɔ nii yɛ tso lɛ nɔ; egbɔ tso lɛ gbɔmɔ su pɛpɛɛpɛ fɛɛfɛo, ni ekɛyawoɔ gbatsu mli,
Etoɔ tsenesuru tsei, aloo eyahalaa kooŋ tsei loo odum, ni ehaa edaa ni enaa hewalɛ yɛ kooŋ tsei lɛ ateŋ. Etɛoɔ tsenedurutso, ni nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nɔ ni, edaa.
