Gbɔmɔ ŋɔɔ tso lɛ eko ekɛfeɔ lai, ni ekɛ eko hu feɔ amãgãi. Ekɛ eko shɛreɔ la ewereɔ, ni ekɛshãa aboloo hu; Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ tso lɛ eko nɔŋŋ feɔ nyɔŋmɔ, ni ejaa. Ekɛ eko gbɔɔ amãgã, ni ekotoɔ shi ejaa lɛ.
Ekɛ tso lɛ eko shɛreɔ la, ni ekɛshãa loo eyeɔ ni etɔɔ; asaŋ ewereɔ tso lɛ la, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, "Yiɛ, mihe edɔ, mina la!"
Tso ni eshwɛ lɛ ekɛgbɔɔ amãgã efeɔ enyɔŋmɔ, ni ekotoɔ lɛ, ni ejaa lɛ, ni esɔleɔ etsɛɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, "Heremɔ mi, ejaakɛ boji minyɔŋmɔ."
Amɛleee nii, asaŋ amɛkɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ hu, ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii eshwila ni amɛnaa nii; amɛjwɛmɔi anaa eŋamɔ hu, ni amɛnuuu nii ashishi.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko jwɛŋmɔ baaa nɔ, asaŋ nilee loo sanesɛɛkɔmɔ hɛleee mɔ ko kwra shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ tso lɛ fã shã ŋai, ni mikɛŋai lɛ shã aboloo kɛ loo fɛɛ ni miye. Esa akɛ makito tsoku lɛ lo?"
Mɔ niyeɔ lamlu tete po, aaanu lɛ shishi. Esusumɔ kɔɔdɔŋ lɛ eha edu gbɛ, ni enyɛŋ eyiwala ehere, ni ekplɛŋ mɔ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, "Kwɛ, nɔ ni yɔɔ mininejurɔ mli lɛ, jeee lakamɔnii ni lo?"
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao Israel, kaimɔ enɛ, kaimɔ akɛ mitsulɔ ji o. Mi mibɔ o; mitsulɔ ji o. Ao Israel, mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ!
Mihã ohe eshai lɛ ekplaŋ kɛtee tamɔ atatu, ohe eshi lɛ mli tamɔ afua. Kpalemɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ mi, mikpɔ̃ bo."

Ao ŋwɛi, la ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu enii! Ao Shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, bɔɔ oshe! Ao gɔji, nyɛwoa lala nɔ! Ao koo kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni yɔɔ mli, nyɛlaa! Ejaakɛ Yehowa ekpɔ̃ Israel ni aawo ehiɛ nyam yɛ Israel." 24 Bɔ ni Yehowa, o-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Miji Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ, mɔ ni ekome too ekpã ŋwɛi mli eha shi, ni ekome pɛ elɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mɔ ni hãa amalelɔi agbalɛi feɔ yaka, ni ehãa klamɔi tsɔ̃ɔ kwashiai, mɔ ni kūɔ nilelɔi anaa, ni ehãa amɛnilee lɛ tɔ̃ɔ kwashiai anii lɛ.

Emaa etsulɔ wiemɔ nɔ mi, ni ehãa ebɔfoi agbalɛ baa mli taakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ Yerusalem he akɛ, 'Mɛi baahi mli ekoŋŋ', ni ekɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji wuji lɛ ahe akɛ, 'Abaasaa amamɔ amɛ, ni maha tsui ni akumɔ ate shi ekoŋŋ' lɛ.
Lɛ ekɛɔ ŋshɔ akɛ 'Omli nu agbi, mibahã ofai lɛ hu amii?"
Ekɛɛ yɛ Koresh he akɛ, 'Mitookwɛlɔ ji lɛ lɛ, ni ebaafee nii ni sa mihiɛ'; ni ekɛɛ yɛ Yerusalem he akɛ, 'Abaasaa ama' ni ekɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hu he akɛ, 'Abaato oshishi ekoŋŋ.'"
45: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Koresh mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu, mɔ ni mimɔ eninejurɔ mli koni maba majimaji ashi yɛ ehiɛ, koni maba Maŋtsɛmɛi ashi, ni magbele shinai yɛ ehiɛ, koni akaŋamɔ agboi awo lɛ lɛ nɛ,
"Manyiɛ ohiɛ, ni mahã hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi afee trɛnɛɛ, ni majwra akɔɔble agboi lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni makumɔ amɛsɛɛ dade adabaŋi lɛ amli.
Maŋɔ jwetrii ni aŋɔ tee duŋ mli, kɛ ojrawa nibii ni akɛtee yɛ teemɔhei lɛ mahã o, koni ona ole akɛ maji Yehowa, Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ ogbɛi tsɛ o lɛ.
Mitsulɔ Yakob ni ji Israel, mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ lɛ hewɔ ni Kuros, mikɛ ogbɛi tsɛ o, ni miwo o gbɛi, tsɛbelɛ oleee mi lɛ."
"Miji Yehowa, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; mi misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ. Mahã ona hewalɛ tsɛbelɛ oleee mi,
koni kɛjɛ hulushiteehe kɛyashwie anaigbɛ fɛɛ lɛ, adesa ana ale akɛ mi misɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
MI mahãa la kɛ duŋ fɛɛ baa; mihãa anaa hejɔlɛ, mi mihãa jramɔ baa. Miji Yehowa, mɔ ni feɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.'"
"Ao Ŋwɛi, nɛɛ nu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi! Ha atatui afɔse jalɛ ashwie shi! Shikpɔŋ agbele enaa koni yiwalaheremɔ aba, koni eha jalɛ saneyeli hu akwɛ̃, Mi, Yehowa, mafee enɛ!
Kpo hã mɔ ni kɛ Ebɔlɔ lɛ fuɔ daa! Sū ni yɔɔ nishɔ̃lɔ dɛŋ ji lɛ. Ani shikpɔŋ sū biɔ nishɔ̃lɔ akɛ, 'Mɛni okɛ mi shɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ'? Aloo, ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni oshɔ̃ lɛ niji bɛ he'?
Kpoo ha bi ni kɛɔ etsɛ akɛ, 'Mɛni bi obaafɔ?" Aloo ebiɔ yoo ni miikɔ̃mɔ akɛ, 'Ni okɔmɔɔ nɛɛ mɛɛ bi obaafɔ?'
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Ebɔlɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, "Mɛɛ hegbɛ nyɛyɔɔ akɛ nyɛaabi mi mibii lɛ ahe sane, aloo nyɛaatsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ ni esa akɛ mikɛ miniji afee?'
Mi mibɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, mi mibɔ gbɔmɔ minine kpã ŋwɛi mli miha shi. Hulu, nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii, ŋwɛi nibii lɛ, mi mifamɔ naa ni amɛba.

Mi diɛŋtsɛ mitee Koresh shi koni etsu miyiŋtoo lɛ he nii, asaŋ oni ejaje nibii. Mahã egbɛi fɛɛ aja aha lɛ; eeesaa etswa mimaŋ lɛ, ni eeeŋmɛɛ minomii lɛ ahe jeee yɛ yinii loo sɛɛnamɔ ko hewɔ." Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.

Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Israel nɛ, "Nii Egipt yɔɔ lɛ kɛ Sudan hu jrayeli mli sɛɛnamɔnii lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ onii; ni Sebahii, hii gojogojoi lɛ, aaatsɔmɔ onyɔji. Amɛaakamɔ gboklɛi amli kɛaanyiɛ osɛɛ; amɛaaba ni amɛaakoto bo. Amɛaakpa bo fai amɛkɛɛ, 'Bo pɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ yɔɔ, ni lɛ esɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Anɔkwale mli lɛ, boi Nyɔŋmɔ ni etee ehe. Ao, Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ, Yiwalaheremɔ!
Mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ amãgãi Lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaanyiɛ kɛ hiɛgble.
Shi Yehowa aaahere Isreal yiwala kɛya nanɔ; nyɛhiɛ gboiŋ, ni asaŋ nyɛhiɛ eshwieŋ shi kɔkɔɔkɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ.'"

Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ewaje lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ, ni ebɔɔɔ lɛ koni ekã shi eflo, shi ebɔ lɛ koji ahi nɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Miji Yehowa, ni kɛjɛ mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ."
Jeee teemɔ mli miwie yɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ni enɔ ewo duŋ ko nɔ. Mikɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtaoɔ mi yakal; nyɛtaoɔ mi yɛ he ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ. Mi Yehowa, miwieɔ anɔkwale. Nɔ ni ja lɛ, no mikɛɔ.'"

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa oni nyɛbaa, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaa kutuu, nyɛ, maji lɛ amli bii ni nyɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli! Mɛi ni tereɔ amɛtso amãgãi lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ, ni amɛsɔleɔ amɛhãa nyɔŋmɔ ni nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ehere lɛ, amɛleee nii.

Nyɛbaa koni nyɛbajajea nyɛsane lɛ; nyɛhãa amɛyaa ajina! Namɔ ji mɔ ni jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ egba nɔ ni eba nɛɛ? Namɔ kɛɛ enɛ kɛjɛ blema? Ano jeee mi, Yehowa, ni? Ni misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ kɛ Yiwalaheremɔ? Misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ."
"Jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛbaa miŋɔɔ, koni ahere nyɛyiwala. Ejaakɛ mi pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kɛjɛ misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi ekã mihe kitã: Jalɛ wiemɔ ko eje minaa, ni ekuŋ esɛɛ eflo. Nakutso fɛɛ nakutso aaakūla mi, ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi aaakã kitã akɛɛ akɛ,
"Yehowa kɛjɛ mli jalɛ kɛ hewalɛ yɔɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni te shi wo lɛ lɛ, aaaba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ kɛ hiɛgble.
Yehowa mli Israel shwiei fɛɛ aaaye bem yɛ, ni enɔ amɛaashwã amɛfɔ̃.
46: "Babilon nyɔŋmɔi lɛ anaagbee nɛ! Be ko ni eho lɛ, aja Bel kɛ Nebo. Shi amro nɛɛ afimɔ amɛ ashwie tejii akotosɛɛ akɛ jatsu ni kooloi tere ni etɔ amɛ.
Amãgãi lɛ kotokotoo shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛmamɔmamɔɔ amɛhiɛ shi; amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛfɛne, ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛmiiya.
"Ao, Yakob shwiei, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ, nyɛboa mi toi. Nyɛ mɛi ni mihiɛ nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛfɔmɔ mli, ni mikura nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛhɔŋɔɔ mli beebe,
ni kɛyaashi gbɔlɛ mli lɛ mi nɔŋŋ ni; ni kɛyaashi nyɛwaŋjee mli tete mi nɔŋŋ ni. Mi mibɔ nyɛ, ni nɔŋŋ mahiɛ nyɛ; mi miwa nyɛ ni mahere nyɛyiwala.
Namɔ nyɛkɛbaato mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaaye egbɔ? Namɔ nyɛkɛbaato mihe ni mi aaafee pɛ?
Mɛi ni fɔseɔ shika kɛjɛɔ flɔtɔ mli shwieɔ shi, ni amɛŋmɛɔ jwɛitɛi yɛ nsɛni mli lɛ, amɛbɔɔ shikaŋaalɔ apaa, ni efeɔ nyɔŋmɔ ko ehãa amɛ, ni amɛhoɔ amɛkotoɔ shi, ni amɛjaa lɛ.
Amɛwoɔ lɛ amɛtswaa amɛkɔŋ, ni amɛtreɔ lɛ kɛyaa; amɛkɛ lɛ yamaa shi yɛ he ko, ni jɛi emaa; enyɛɛɛ ehe etsi kɛjɛ emaahe lɛ. Kɛji ablɔ atsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehereee mɔ nɔ; ni ehereee mɔ yiwala kɛjɛɛɛ ehaomɔ mli.
"Nyɛ eshafeelɔi, nyɛkaia sane nɛɛ, ni nyɛsusua he. Nyɛkaia lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛkaia blema teteetenii lɛ. Mi nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ Sɛɛ dɔŋŋ. Miji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ mi.
Mi, mijɛ shishijee lɛ mli ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nibii ni anako afee tete. Mi, mikɛɔ akɛ; 'Miyiŋtoi aaaba mli, ni mibafee nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ miyiŋ.'
Miitsɛ miyiŋtoo naa nuu ko kɛmiijɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ. Ebaagba shi kɛba tamɔ okropɔŋ. Mina miwie, ni mahã eba mli; mito miyiŋ, ni mafee hu.
Nyɛ tsuisalɔi, nyɛboa mi toi, nyɛ ni nyɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ teŋ ejekɛ!
Miha miyiwalaheremɔ ebɛŋkɛ; ebɛ shɔŋŋ. Midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ etsɛŋ. Mibahere Yerusalem, ni mahã Israel hiɛ aba nyam."
47: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Babilon, oblayoo fro, kplekemɔ shi koni obata mlu mli! Ta shikpɔŋ; Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ko bɛ ha o, bo Kaldeabii abiyoo, ejaakɛ atsɛŋ bo oje kɛ mɔ ni ahiɛɔ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ dɔŋŋ.
Klamɔ wiɛbii ni owiɛ ma, jiemɔ ohiɛhaa nɔ lɛ, otade yuu lɛ, drɔmɔ onaji ahe mama kɛya ŋwɛi koni ofo faa lɛ.
Aaajie oyayaiaŋ kpo, ni ohiɛgblɛ aaabakã shi. Matɔ owele, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ minãa."
Wɔ-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ao Babilon, ta shi kpoo yɛ duɛ mli, ejaakɛ atsɛŋ bo nɔyelihei amaŋnyɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mimli wo mimaŋ lɛ la, ni mibule minɔyeli nɔ lɛ, ni miŋɔ amɛ miwo odɛŋ. Omusuŋ etsɔ̃ɔɔ bo yɛ amɛhe; hiimeji tete po okɛ amɛ ye kɛ joomɔ.
Osusu akɛ obaaye maŋnyɛ kɛya naanɔ. No hewɔ lɛ okɛ nase nɛɛ wooo otsuiŋ, ni oyajwɛŋŋ bɔ ni naagbee lɛ aaatamɔ ahã.
No hewɔ lɛ, bo enɛ toi, bo ni onyaa jeŋ nɔɔmɔyeli he ni ota shi ni ohe ejɔ bo, ni okɛɔ ohe akɛ, "Miji mi, ni mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, mitsɔŋ okulafo, ni migboŋ bi hu."
Nibii enyɔ nɛɛ aaaba onɔ trukaa yɛ gbo kome nɔ. Okunyaayeli babaoo kɛ osɛbɛi babaoo lɛ ahewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, aaakpakpaa obii yɛ ohe, ni oootsɔ̃ okulafo hu.
Onifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ nli lɛ, efee bo akɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe; ni okɛɛ ohe akɛ, "Mɔ ko enaaa mi." Oŋaa kɛ onilee lɛ ha odu gbɛ, ni okɛɛ ohe akɛ, "Miji mi, ni mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɛŋŋ."
Shi sane fɔŋ baaye bo, no oleŋ bɔ ni ooofee ni oje mli. Oshrã aaashrã bo, ni onyɛŋ okpa oshwie. Hiɛkpãtãmɔ aaabaniba o trukaa bɔ ni okpaaa gbɛ.
"Yaa nɔ kɛ okablɛfiimɔ kɛ okunyaayeli babaoo ni ogbo he deŋme kɛjɛ oblahiiaŋ lɛ, akɛ aleee nɔ eeenyɛ eye ebua bo lo; alɛ eleee nɔ ohe aaafee gbeyei.
Ŋaawoo pii lɛ eje otsine. Ha mɛi ni le ŋwɛi nibiiaŋ lɛ kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kɛji nyɔŋ je ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni baaba onɔ lɛ, ate shi koni amɛhere oyiwala!
Naa, amɛtamɔ gbetseli, ni la aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ wɛɛ; amɛnyɛŋ amɛhe amɛhere kɛjɛ la lɛ naawalɛ mli. Enɛ jeee ŋai la ni awereɔ, loo la ni ataa he awereɔ.
Mɛi ni ogbo amɛhe deŋme lɛ, bɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛha o nɛ; oŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi ni wo bo ŋaa lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaashi o; Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaahere oyiwala."
48: Nyɛ Isrealbii, nyɛ mɛi ni akɛ Israel gbɛi ewo nyɛ, ni nyɛjɛ Yuda mli, nyɛboa enɛ toi! Nyɛkɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ kãa kitã ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ, shi anɔkwale kome nɛkɛ bɛ mli.
Nyɛtsɛɔ nyɛhe maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli bii, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ nyɛkpasa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mɔ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Mijɛ jeeŋmɔ ko mitsɔ̃ɔ nii ni baaba. Eje minaa, ni miha ana ale, ni trukaa lɛ mifee, ni amɛba mli.
Akɛni mile akɛ ofeɔ ntɛŋ, ni okuɛŋ ti tamɔ dade, ni ohiɛŋtso wa keketee tamɔ akɔɔble hewɔ lɛ,
mijɛ jeeŋmɔ mi migba o. Mikɛɛ bo dani aba mli, koni okakɛɛ akɛ, mimãgã ni akɛ tso gbɔ loo amãgã ni ashwie lɛ fã, ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba.
Onu momo, ni agbɛnɛ ona nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ. Belɛ bɛ obaakple nɔ? Kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ Lɛ mibaha onu nibii heei, nibii ni akɛtee nibii ni oleee.
Kpaako mifeɔ, amɛba sa. Onuko amɛhe sane lɛ dã ja ŋmɛnɛ, koni okakɛ akɛ, 'Naa, mile mito'
Onuko dã, ni oleee otooo sa; otoi egbeko dã kɛjɛ blema beebe; ejaakɛ mile akɛ kutumpɔfoi anii afeɔ, ni kɛjɛ ofɔmɔ mli beebe lɛ ale bo akɛ atuatselɔ.
Migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, miitsi mimlifu lɛ mato. Mi, miyijiemɔ hewɔ lɛ, miito mitsui shi maha o koni mikakpãtã ohiɛ.
Naa, mitsuu ohe, shi oshɛɛɛ jwɛitɛi. Mikɛ amanehulu fee la mikɛtsuu ohe, ni mikɛka bo mikwɛ akɛ oshɛɔ lo.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ ni mifeɔ enɛ, ejaakɛ mɛni hewɔ aaagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ? Mikɛ minumnyam lɛ haŋ mɔ kroko."
"Ao, Yakob, bo mi toi; Israel, bo mɔ ni mitsɛ, bo mi toi. Mi ni, miji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ, ni mi nɔŋŋ ji naagbee mɔ lɛ!
Mi, minine to shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni mi, mihewalɛ lɛɛ ŋwɛi mli ha shi. Kɛji mitsɛ amɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ blublu amɛbadamɔɔ mihiɛ,
"Nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbua nyɛhe naa koni nyɛbaboa toi. Te nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni egba enɛɛmɛi eko lɛ? Mɔ ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, lɛ ebaatsu yiŋ ni Yehowa eto yɛ Babilon he lɛ he nii; ebaata shi ewo Babilon.
Mi, mi nɔŋŋ miwie, ni mifɔ̃ minaa mitsɛ lɛ. Mi nɔŋŋ mikɛ lɛ ba, ni egbɛ aaaja aha lɛ.
Nyɛtsia myɛbɛŋkɛa mi nyɛbaboa enɛ toi. Kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ miwieee yɛ dujiaŋ; ni dani nɔ ko baaba mli lɛ, miyɛ jɛi, Ni agbɛnɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ etsu mi kɛ Emumɔ lɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa, o-Kpɔ̃lɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Miji Yehowa, O-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tsɔɔ bo nii ni ha o, mɔ ni tsɔɔ bo gbɛ ni esa akɛ onyiɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ao, eji oye mikitãi lɛ anɔ kulɛ, oooshwere tamɔ faa; ni okunimyeli aaatsra nɔ tamɔ ŋshɔkei.
Omusuŋbii aaafa tamɔ shia, ni oshwiei aaafa tamɔ mlu. Agbeŋ amɛgbɛi, ni akpãtãŋ amɛhiɛ yɛ mihiɛ."
Nyɛshia Babilon nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Kaldea nyɛyaa. Nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ miishɛɛ; nyɛhaa anua yɛ je lɛ naagbeehe akɛ, "Yehowa ekpɔ̃ etsulɔ Israel."
Be ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, kumai yee amɛ. Eha nu jɛ tɛsaa mli ho hã amɛ; egba tɛsaa lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ tue kɛje kpo.
"Hejɔlɛ ko bɛ hã mɛi fɔ̃ɔji" Yehowa kɛɛ.
49: Ao, nyɛ ŋshɔnaa maji, nyɛboa mi toi; ni nyɛ majimaji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛfea toi. Yehowa tsɛ mi dani afɔ mi. Be ni miyɔɔ minyɛ musuŋ beebe ni Yehowa wo mi gbɛi.
Ehã miwiemɔ naa ba tamɔ klaŋte; ekɛ mi tee yɛ dɛkɔkɔ teŋ. Eha mitsɔ tamɔ gãimlibi ni asha he kaŋkaŋ; ni eŋɔ mi etee egãimlibii akotoku lɛ mli.
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Israel, mitsulɔ ji o; bo onɔ baatsɔ̃ ni abaawo mihiɛ nyam.
Shi mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, "Migbo deŋme yakatswaa; mifite mihewalɛ eflo yakatswaa." Kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ, ni minyɔmɔwo yɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, Yehowa mɔ ni shɔ̃ɛ̃ mi yɛ musuŋ koni mibatsɔ̃ etsulɔ ni maŋɔ Israel kɛba eŋɔɔ, koni abua Israel naa abaha lɛ. Akɛni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etsɔ mihewalɛ.

Ekɛɛ, "Efaaa akɛ ooofee mitsulɔ ni otee Israel akutsei lɛ ashi, ni okɛ Israelbii ni abaa amɛyi lɛ aku sɛɛ kɛba amɛjaku shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛjɛ: shi moŋ miiŋɔ bo mafee jeŋ majimaji lɛ ala, moni midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ayashɛ je lɛ naagbeehe."

Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Kpɔ̃lɔ, kɛ e-Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ mɔ ni agbe ehe guɔ, ni jeŋ majimaji lɛ hi ehiɛ, nɔyelɔi anyɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, "Majitsɛmɛoi aaana lɛ ni amɛaate shi amɛhã lɛ; ni lumɛi hu aaana lɛni amɛaakamɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa ehala lɛ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eji anɔkwafo."

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibo bo toi yɛ be ni sa mli, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua bo yɛ, ni mibaa oyi koni kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, mi kɛ maji fɛɛ akpãŋ, koni ofee shikpɔŋ lɛ shi oma shi, ni oja amɛgboshinii ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ oha amɛ.

Okɛɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛjea kpo koni nyɛye nyɛhe;' ni mɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ mli lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ hu akɛ, 'Nyɛboa la hiɛ.' Amɛaaye nii yɛ gbɛjegbɛi atoi, ni gɔji ni koo bɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛniyelihe.
Hɔmɔ yeŋ amɛ, ni kumai hu yeŋ amɛ. Hulu eshaŋ amɛ, ni shiaŋa anɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ hu esaŋ amɛhe, ejaakɛ mɔ ni musuŋtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ amɛhe lɛ aaakpla amɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛaatee nubui ahe.
"Maha migɔji lɛ anɔ atsɔ gbɛ, ni aaasaa migbɛjegbɛi lɛ afee amɛ teŋpɔŋi.
Naa, miwebii aaajɛ shɔŋŋ aba; ni naa, aaajɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ hu aba, ni mɛi aaajɛ Aswam shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ aba."
"Ŋwɛi, lá kɛ miishɛɛ! Shikpɔŋ, bɔɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ! Gɔji, nyɛlaa nyamɔ lala! Ejaakɛ Yehowa eshɛje emaŋ lɛ mli; ni emɛi ni nii yɔɔ mɔbɔ lɛ, emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amehe.
Shi Yerusalem kɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ekwa mi, mi-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ ekpa minɔ!"
Yehowa to he akɛ, "Aso yoofɔyoo hiɛ aaakpa ebi fufɔoo nɔ, ni emusuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ emusuŋbi he? Kɛji yoofɔyoo tete hiɛ aaakpa ebi nɔ lɛ, mi lɛ, mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ.
Yerusalem, naa, miŋma ogbɛi yɛ midɛkɔkɔŋ; mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ."
"Mɛi ni baasaa atswa bo ama shi lɛ miiba nɔŋŋ, ni mɛi mi fee bo amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ baashi omli ni amɛya.
Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ ohe kɛkpe; Owebii lɛ miibua amɛhe naa; amɛmiiba oŋɔɔ. Gbii abɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, amɛaatsɔ tamɔ jwine, ni okɛ amɛaawula ohe tamɔ ayɛmfro feɔ lɛ."
"Eyɛ mli akɛ afite oshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni afee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ moŋ nɛ, shi agbɛnɛ, mɛi baaba omli aahuu bɔ ni onaŋ gbɛ ohã amɛ; ni mɛi ni ha afee bo amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ kɛ bo teŋ aaajekɛ shɔŋŋ.
Bii ni ofɔ yɛ ojramɔ be lɛ mli lɛ aaakɛɛ yɛ otoiŋ akɛ, 'Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ fiŋtɔŋŋ tsɔ ha wɔ; tsi oya koni wɔna shihilɛhe.'
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobi ohe akɛ 'Namɔ fɔ bii nɛɛ ha mi? Akpakpaa mibii yɛ mihe ni mitsɔ̃ kene ni bɛ bi. Aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee. No hewɔ lɛ namɔ lɛ amɛ? Naa, ashi mi koome pɛ kɛkɛ; belɛ nɛgbɛ Mɛnɛɛmɛi jɛ mɔ?'"
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, mawo minine nɔ mafɔ majimaji lɛ anine, ni amɛaahiɛ obihii lɛ yɛ amɛkpɔkɔiaŋ kɛaaba.

Maŋtsɛmɛi aaatsɔmɔ tamɔ tsɛmɛi aha nyɛ, ni maŋnyɛmɛi aaatsɔmɔ tamɔ yei fufɔhalɔi ahã nyɛ. Amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaabumɔ shi, amɛaakoto nyɛ, ni amɛaalɛmɔ nyɛnaji ahe mlu. Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ miji Yehowa. Mɛi ni hiɛ kã minɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ gboiŋ."
Ani anyɛɔ ashɔ̃ɔ nii ni kãkãlɔ eyaha yɛ edɛŋ? Aloo anyɛɔ ashɔ̃ɔ nomii ni hewalɔ emɔmɔ yɛ edɛŋ?
Shi bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Aashɔ̃ kãkãlɔ dɛŋ nomii lɛ, ni hewalɔ haanii lɛ, aaahe yɛ edɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni kɛ bo aaana lɛ, mi kɛ lɛ ena, ni mahere bii lɛ ayiwala.
Maha ohaolɔi lɛ agbegbee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛlá aaatɔ amɛ dãa. Kɛkɛ lɛ adesai fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Kpɔ̃lɔ kɛ Yiwalaherelɔ,
50: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Nɛgbɛ nyɛnyɛ shwiemɔ wolo ni mikɛshwie lɛ lɛ yɔɔ? Minyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ namɔ mihɔɔ nyɛ miha? Dabida! Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ ni ahɔɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛtɔmɔi lɛ ahewɔ ashwie nyɛnyɛ.

"Mɛɛba miba, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ? Mɛɛba mibo mitsɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hereee mi nɔ lɛ? Ani minine efo kuku bɔ ni minyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala mahere? Aloo mibɛ hewalɛ ni mikɛaakpɔ̃ mɔ? Naa, mifãa, ni ŋshɔ miiɔ. Mihaã fai gbiɔ ni amɛtsɔmɔɔ tamɔ shiaŋa, ni amɛmli loi gboiɔ ni amɛshaa, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa nu.
Mihãa ŋwɛi diɔ, ni ebuɔ kpekpe.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ eha mi nilelɔ lilɛi bɔ ni afee ni male bɔ ni mikɛ miwiemɔ akanya mɔ ni egbede aha. Daa leebi lɛ, ehɛleɔ mi shi, ni egbleɔ mitoiŋ koni mibo nɔ ni eyɔɔ mi tsɔ̃ɔmɔɔ toi akɛ kaselɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa lɛ eha mi niiashishinumɔ, ni mitseko ehiɛ atūa, asaŋ minaaa sɛɛsɛɛ.
Mitsɔ mikotosɛɛ miha yilɔi kɛ midabii hu miha mɛi ni famɔɔ tsɛŋ; ni mijooo hiɛgble kɛ lajɔ̃ naa foi.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ ebuaa mi; no hewɔ lɛ mihiɛ eshwieko shi; no hewɔ ni mimia mihiɛ kɛdamɔ naa; ni mile akɛ mihiɛ eshwieŋ shi.
Mɔ ni buɔ mi bem lɛ ebɛŋkɛ. Namɔ kɛ mi aaaye sane? Ha wɔ fɛɛ wɔdamɔ shi. Namɔ ji mɔ ni ekɛ mi ena? Ha ekɛ mi akpe!
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni yeɔ buaa mi. Namɔ aaabu mi fɔ? Naa, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaasuu tamɔ atade ni omlɛ̃gɛ aaanyɛ amɛ.
Nyɛteŋ namɔ sheɔ Yewhowa gbeyei? Namɔ boɔ etsulɔ lɛ gbee toi? Kɛji mɔ lɛ nyiɛ duŋ mli, ni la etsooo hãaa lɛ po, hã ekɛ ehiɛ afɔ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ ehe akpasa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Naa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛwoɔ la koni eshã mɛi, nyɛ moŋ nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. Nɔ ni nyɛbaana kɛaajɛ midɛŋ nɛ, Haomɔ mli nyɛaajwere. Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛaanyiɛ la ni nyɛwo lɛ mli.
51: Yehowa kɛɛ, "Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ ni akpɔ̃ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa tɛsaa ni agba nyɛ kɛjɛ mli lɛ, Kɛ tɛ bu ni atsa nyɛ kɛjɛ mli lɛ he.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛtsɛ Abraham kɛ Sara, mɛi amli ni nyɛjɛ lɛ, ekome ni; shi mijɔɔ lɛ, ni mahã ewo shwiei babaoo.

Ejaakɛ Yehowa baashɛje Yerusalem mii; ebaashɛje hei fɛɛ ni efee koikoi lɛ amii; ebaahã eŋa lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ tamɔ Eden, ni eshiaŋa lɛ baatsɔ tamɔ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ abɔɔ. Jɛi baasɔ kɛ mliflimɔ kɛ nyamɔ kɛ shidaa lalai.
"Mimaŋbii, nyɛboa mi toi! Mimaŋ, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa mi! Ejaakɛ mibawo mli, ni mijalɛ saneyeli aaatso la aha majimaji lɛ.
Midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etã; miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ baaje kpo, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ maye majimaji lɛ anɔ. Ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ miikwɛ mi gbɛ, ni amɛhiɛ kã mihewalɛ lɛ nɔ.

Nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nyɛkwɛa ŋwɛi; ni nyɛkwɛa shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi hu. Ejaakɛ ŋswɛi baalaaje tamɔ lasu, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baasuu tamɔ atade ni enɔ gbɔmɛi aaagboi tamɔ adɔdɔji; shi miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ, ni mikpɔmɔ lɛ bɛ naagbee.
"Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni le nɔ ni ji jalɛ, nyɛboa toi, nyɛ maŋbii ni mimla lɛ yɔɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ, nyɛkashea adesa dɛŋ ahorabɔɔ gbeyei! Asaŋ nyɛtsuii akafãa yi limɔ ni aaali nyɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã tamɔ mama ni omlɛ̃gɛ̃ eye, loo kuŋtu ni gɔgɔmii eye. Shi mikpɔmɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ; ni miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ aaahi shi yinɔi fɛɛ.

Tee shi, tee shi koo! Yehowa, wo ohewalɛ nine lɛ nɔ. Tee shi tamɔ ofee blema ko lɛ, tamɔ yɛ jeeŋmɔ yinɔi komɛi anɔ lɛ. Aso jeee bo oflɔ ŋshɔŋ kooloo Rahab lɛ mli dukuduku lɛ? Aso jeee bo oflɔ kooloo drako gbeyeigbeyei lɛ mli lɛ?
Aso jeee bo oha ŋshɔ mii lɛ? Ani jeee bo oha bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli nu mii, ni ogba gbɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli oha mɛi ni okpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛfo mli kɛho lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛaaba Zion kɛ lala. Amɛaanya, ni amɛmii aaashɛ; Amɛyeŋ awerɛho lɛ, amɛdɔmɔŋ ŋtsɔi dɔŋŋ."
Yehowa mikɛɛ akɛ, "Mi Mishɛjeɔ nyɛmii! Mɛɛba osheɔ adesa ni baagbo, adesa ni etamɔ jwɛi gbeyei,

ni ohiɛ ekpa Yehowa, obɔlɔ lɛ, moŋ nɔ? Ohiɛ ekpa mɔ ni lɛɛ ŋwɛi mli eha shi, ni eto je lɛ shishi lɛ nɔ? Mɛɛba osheɔ gbeyei jenamɔ tuu yɛ haolɔ lɛ grimɔ kɛ ehe ni esaa kɛkpãtã ohiɛ lɛ hewɔ? Ni nɛgbɛ haolɔ lɛ grimɔ lɛ yɔɔ po?
Etsɛŋ kwraa ni aaaŋmɛɛ gboklɛfoi lɛ ahe; amɛgboiŋ, ni amɛwala sɛɛ baatsɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛaaye ebɔŋ amɛ.
Ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni teɔ ŋshɔ shi, ni emli ŋshɔkei feɔ hamahama lɛ. Migbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.
Mi milɛɛ ŋwɛi mli miha shi, ni mito je lɛ shishi. Mikɛɛ Yerusalem akɛ, 'Miwebii ji nyɛ! Mikɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ewo nyɛnaa, ni mikɛ minine miibu nyɛhe."
Ao Yerusalem, wo ohe nɔ! Wo ohe nɔ! Tee shi odamɔ shi! Onu toiŋgblamɔ kpulu lɛ mli dãa ni jɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ dɛŋ lɛ. Ni onu owo omli, ni olɛmɔ kpulu lɛ mli, ni eha oodidãa.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ebii ni efɔ lɛ ateŋ ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ; mɔ kome flo nɛkɛ bɛ bii ni elɛ lɛ ateŋ ni aaamɔ enine mli.
Saji enyɔ nɛɛ eba onɔ: Ta ekpãtã oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni hɔmɔ hu eye omaŋbii. Namɔ aaashɛje omii?
Obii lɛ etɔ biti; amɛkamɔkamɔɔ shi yɛ blohui lɛ fɛɛ akoji tamɔ baayelɔ ni adu lɛ yɛ tsɔne mli. Amɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Yehowa mlila kɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kãmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ Yerusalem nɔnalɔi ni nyɛdidãa tsɛbelɛ nyɛtrɔko dãa, nyɛboa toi,
Bɔ nin Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, O-Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni yeɔ emaŋ lɛ sane ehaa lɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Naa, mihe didãamɔ dãa kpulu lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ; nyɛnuŋ mimlifu naa kpulu lɛ mli daa lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Maŋɔ maha nyɛhaolɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛkamɔa shi koni wɔnyiɛa nyɛnɔ kɛhoa.' Ni nyɛtsɔ tamɔ gbɛjegbɛ koni wɔnyiɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ."
52: Ao Yerusalem, ohiɛ atsɛ̃! Ohiɛ atsɛ̃! Teemɔ ohewalɛ lɛ shi! Ao Yerusalem, maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, wulamɔ kɛ otadei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ejaakɛ foolɔi kɛ mɛi ni he tsee boteŋ ogboi lɛ mli dɔŋŋ!
Ao Yerusalem ni aŋɔ bo nom, tee shi? Kpokpomɔ ohe mlu lɛ, Tee shi ota shi! Zion biyoo ni aŋɔ bo nom, fɛnemɔ kpãa ni yɔɔ okuɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Be ni ahɔɔ nyɛ lɛ aheee nyɛyi shika ko; ni jeee shika hu akɛbaakpɔ nyɛ. Shi bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ,
Jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ mimaŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tee Egipt ni eyahi jɛi akɛ gbɔi. Shi Asiriabii lɛ wa amɛyi yakatswaa.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ mɛni mafee yɛ he akɛni miina mimaŋ lɛ ni Babilonbii ŋɔ amɛ nom yakatswaa lɛ? Amɛnɔyelɔi shwãa kɛkɛ amɛshwãa, Yehowa kɛɛ, ni gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ amɛgbeɔ migbɛi lɛ he guɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ mimaŋbii lɛ aaale migbɛi lɛ; ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛaale akɛ miji mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, 'Naa, mi nɛ lɛ.'"
Kwɛ bɔ ni sane kpakpashiɛlɔ ni shiɛɔ hejɔlɛ, sane kpakpashiɛlɔ ni shiɛɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ naji yɔɔ fɛo yɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ, mɔ ni kɛɔ Zion akɛ "Naa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni yeɔ Maŋtsɛ agbɛnɛ."
Bo toi! Omɛi ni buɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ehole amɛgbei anɔ, ni amɛmiila Kɛ miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiina faŋŋ akɛ Yehowa eku esɛɛ kɛmiiba Zion!
Yerusalem tsui koikoi, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛwoa nyamɔ lala nɔ! Ejaakɛ Yehowa eshɛje emaŋ lɛ mii, ehere Yerusalem Yiwala.
Yehowa ejie ehewalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaana wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtreɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ nibii lɛ, nyɛkataa nɔ ko ni he tseee he; nyɛtsuaa nyɛhe, ni nyɛshīa, nyɛshīa Babilon nyɛyaa.
Shi moŋ nyɛshiŋ nyɛyaŋ yɛ hejojoomɔ naa; ni asaŋ jeee yɛ foijee naa hu; ejaakɛ Yehowa baanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ baanyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Naa, mitsulɔ lɛ baashwere, aaawo ehiɛ nyam. ni aaawo enɔ; aaawo enɔ gojoo.
Mɛi babaoo ahe aaajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ehewɔ; ejaakɛ ehiɛ afite bɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ dɔŋŋ; egbɔmɔtso hu tamɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɛi adesai anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ eeehã maji baboo anaa akpɛ amɛhe; Maŋtsɛmɛi aaaamua amɛnaa yɛehewɔ, Ejaakɛ amɛbaana nii ni agbako amɛ dã, ni amɛbaanu nɔ ni amɛnuko dã lɛ shishi."
53: Maŋbii lɛ to he akɛ, "Namɔ aaahe sane ni Wɔnu lɛ eye? Ni namɔ Yehowa ejie ehewalɛ nine lɛ kpo etsɔɔ?
Ejaakɛ ekwɛ yɛ ehiɛ tamɔ tso fɔ, tamɔ tso shishi fã ni etsɛ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ mli. Ehe bɛ nyam lɛ, ebɛ su ko hu ni aaaha wɔkwɛ lɛ; ni ehe bɛ fɛo ko hu ni aaaha ehe afee wɔ akɔnɔ.
Agbe ehe guɔ, ni gbɔmɛi kwa lɛ, eye awerɛho, ni ele hejramɔ etamɔ mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ hiɛ atoa afã kɛ ana lɛ lɛ. Agbe ehe guɔ, ni wɔbuuu lɛ wɔhãaa fɛifɛi.
"Anɔkwa, wɔhelai lɛ, lɛ etre, ni wɔhejramɔi lɛ, lɛ ehole eshwie enɔ. Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔbu lɛ akɛ mɔ ko kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbla etoi, ni ena nɔ.
Shi apila lɛ yɛ wɔ moŋ wɔtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ; atswia lɛ nii yɛ wɔnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ. Agbla etoi koni wɔna hejɔlɛ, ni ehe faji lɛ akɛtsaa wɔ.
Wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm wɔtamɔ toi ni edu gbɛ. Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ, ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnɔsha lɛ fɔ̃ enɔ.
Afee lɛ niseeniianii., ni apiŋ lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ etswaaa esɛŋ. Bɔ ni too gwaŋtɛŋbi ni akɛ lɛ yaa ayagbe lɛ, loo too gwaŋɛŋbii feɔ dioo yɛ ehetsɔikulɔi ahiɛ lɛ, nakai etswaaa esɛŋ lɛ.
Aye lɛ toikɔdɔmɔ sane, ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee. Namɔ aaanyɛ asusu nɔ ni aaaba enɔ? Ejaakɛ asha lɛ kɛje hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee. Mimaŋbii lɛ atɔmɔi ahewɔ apiŋ lɛ lɛ!
Atsa ebu yɛ eshafeelɔi ateŋ, tsebelɛ efeko esha ko lɛ, emaleko hu dã, ni afu lɛ yɛ niiatsɛmɛi ateŋ.
"Eji Yehowa yiŋtoo akɛ atswa lɛ nɔ, ni apila lɛ. Kɛji eŋɔ ehe eshã afɔle yɛ esha hewɔ lɛ, ebaana shwiei ni ewala sɛɛ aaatsɛ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ lɛ enɔ lɛ, nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ aaashwere.
Esusuma haomɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeena nii ni aaahã etsui anyɔ emli. Kɛtsɔ̃ mitsulɔ jalɔ lɛ nilee nɔ lɛ, eeehã aŋɔ mɛi baaboo akɛ jalɔi, ni eeetre amɛnishaianii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ maha lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ mɛi wuji ateŋ; ni ekɛ hewalɔi aaaja haanii, ejaakɛ eŋɔ ehe aha gbele ni abu lɛ ashi mlanɔtɔlɔi anɔ, kɛ̃lɛ etre mɛi pii ahe eshai, ni edamɔ mli eha eshafeelɔi.
54: "Yerusalem, yoo kene, wö nyamɔ lala nɔ! Bo ni okɔ̃mɔko dã, blɔmɔ kɛ miishɛɛ! Ejaakɛ nɔ ni ewu kwa lɛ lɛ, ebii ayi baafa fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ bii."
Yehowa kɛɛ "Lɛɛmɔ obuu lɛ mli, kpã oshihilɛhe lɛ mamai lɛ amli. Kaalɛte he; ha etaŋkpei lɛ aklɛ, no okla oshiŋmlitsei lɛ ni awa.
Ejaakɛ ooolɛɛ shi kɛya ninejurɔgbɛ kɛ abɛkugbɛ fɛɛ; ni oshwiei aaaye majimaji anɔ, ni amɛaahe shi yɛ maji ni kamɔ shi amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli.
Kaashe gbeyei! Ejaakɛ ohiɛ eshwieŋ shi; ni ohe akajra bo, ejaakɛ agbeŋ ohiɛ dɔŋŋ. Ejaakɛ ohiɛ aaakpã oblayeiaŋ hiɛgble lɛ nɔ, ni okulafeemɔ mli hejramɔ lɛ okaiŋ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ obɔlɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ wu aha o. Yehowa Taistsɛ ji egbɛi, ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ ji Okpɔ̃lɔ lɛ. Je lɛ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji egbɛi.
Yehowa miitsɛ o kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, "Israel, otamɔ yoo ni ewu ekwa lɛ, ni eeye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ mumɔ mli, tamɔ oblahiiaŋ ŋa ni ashwie lɛ.
Hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ mikwa o, shi mikɛ mlitsɔlɛ kple baabua onaa.
Mikɛ mihiɛ tee bo hiŋmɛitswaa yɛ mlifu ni eteke nɔ naa; shi mikɛ naanɔ suɔmɔ aaahã mimusuŋ atsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohewɔ." Bɔ ni Yehowa, o-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,
"Be nɛɛ tamɔ Noa be lɛ ha mi. Bɔ ni mikã kitã akɛ Noa be lɛ mli nu afua lɛ ebahaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ, nakai mikãa kitã akɛ mimli fuŋ bo, ni mikaŋ ohiɛ.

Gɔji lɛ aaaje amɛshihilɛhei lɛ aya, ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu aaafamɔ kɛaatee nɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ ha bo lɛ tsakeŋ, ni mi kɛ bo teŋ toiŋjɔlɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu mikuŋ mli." Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ohe lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,
"Ao Yerusalem ni apiŋ bo, maŋ ni ahum tswa bo, shi ashɛjeee omii, naa, mikɛ ojrawatɛi baatswa bo mama shi, ni mikɛ safiro tɛ baatswa ofanesi lɛ.
Mikɛ rubi tɛ baatswa omɔji lɛ, ni mikɛ ojrawa tɛ baafee ogboi lɛ, ni ohe gbogbo lɛ hu, mikɛ tɛi ni jra wa baatswa.
Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ omli bii lɛ nii, ni amɛbaashwere jogbaŋŋ.
Jalɛ shihilɛ aaahe shi yɛ omli. Yiwalɛ nifeemɔ kɛ bo teŋ baajekɛ, no hewɔ lɛ osheŋ gbeyei; ni tsuifãa nifeemɔ bɛŋkɛŋ bo; no hewɔ lɛ otsui efaŋ.
Kɛji mɔ ko aaabatua bo lɛ, jeee mi ejɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaate shi awo bo lɛ, lɛ moŋ ebaagbee shi.
"Naa, mi, mibɔ sɔ̃lɔ mɔ ni huɔ ŋai la ekɛsɔ̃ɔ tawuunii lɛ. Ni mi nɔŋŋ mibɔ tabilɔ mɔ ni kpãtãa nibii ahiɛ lɛ.
Shi tawuunii ko kwraa bɛ ni asɔ̃ ni aaanyɛ bo awui aye. Ooona hetoo oha wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni aaawie ashi bo. Enɛ ji nɔ ni asaa ato. Yehowa tsuji agboshinii kɛ amɛjalɛ ni jɛ midɛŋ lɛ." Yehowa kɛɛ.
55: Yehowa kɛɛ, "Huui! Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kumai yeɔ nyɛ, nyɛbaa nu he! Nyɛ mɛi hu ni bɛ shika, nyɛbaa nyɛbahea ŋmãa nyɛyea! Nyɛbaa! Nyɛnahea wain kɛ fufuɔ, jeee kɛ shika shi moŋ kɛ nyɛdɛ flo.

Mɛɛba nyɛkɔɔ shika nyɛkɛheɔ nɔ ni jeee ŋmãa? Ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnitsumɔŋ nyɔmɔwɔ heɔ nɔ ni hãaa mɔ atɔ? Nyɛboa mi toi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛfea nɔ ni makɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛaaye niyenii kpakpa fe fɛɛ, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ.
"Nyɛfea toi, ni nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ! Nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛyi aaana wala. Mi kɛ nyɛ baakpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, ni ji mimɔbɔnalɛ ni sɛɛ efooo ni mikɛwo David shi lɛ.
Naa, mifee lɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ tatsɛ, koni etsɔ̃ mihe odaseyelɔ ehã majimaji lɛ.
Naa, ooofɔ̃ nine otsɛ maji ni oleee; ni maji ni leee bo hu aaahiɛ foi kɛaaba oŋɔɔ, yɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ewo ohiɛ nyam!
Nyɛtaoa Yehowa be mli ni eeehã ana lɛ. Nyɛtsɛa lɛ be mli ni ebɛŋkɛ.
Ha mɔ fɔŋ lɛ akwa ejeŋba fɔŋ lɛ; ni nɔshafeelɔ atsake ejwɛŋmɔ. Ha eku esɛɛ kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ lɛ yɛ ehewɔ. Ekpale kɛba wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛaafa lɛ aahuu.
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Ejaakɛ jeee mijwɛŋmɔi ji nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ni jeee nyɛgbɛi lɛ ji migbɛi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai migbɛi lɛ kwɔ fe nyɛgbɛi lɛ, ni mijwɛŋmɔ kwɔ fe nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ.
"Ejaakɛ bɔ ni nu kɛ snoo nɛɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi shwieɔ shi, ni ekuuu esɛɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, akɛ ja eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nu, ni eha eba nii, ni ewo yibii, ni eha nidulɔ wui, ni ekɛ niyenii eha mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ni wiemɔ ni yeɔ jɛɔ midaaŋ lɛ hu aaafee. Ekuŋ esɛɛ kɛbaŋ miŋɔɔ eflo, shi moŋ eeetsu nɔ ni mito mihãlɛ lɛ lɛ; ni eeeye kunim yɛ nɔ hewɔ ni mitsu lɛ lɛ mli.
"Ejaakɛ nyɛbaashi Babilon kɛ nyamɔ, ni aaakpla nyɛ kɛshi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli. Gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ aaawo nyamɔ lala nɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni ŋanɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ aaatswa amɛdɛ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ŋmeitso najiaŋ lɛ sɛsɛo aaakwɛ̃, ni aklati najiaŋ lɛ, shɔ̃ aaakwɛ̃. Enɛ baatsɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kaimɔ mɔ, kaimɔ nɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ."
56: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Nyɛyea jalɛ sane, ni nyɛfea nɔ ni ja, ejaakɛ midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ eshɛ shi etã, ni abaajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ adesa ni feɔ enɛ. No ji mɔ ni hiɛɔ mi kpɛŋŋ, ni eyeɔ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, ni ebuleee hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ ni ewieɔ he kɛjɛɔ efɔŋ he."
Gbɔ ni kɛ ehe ebakpɛtɛ Yehowa lɛ ekakɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa baajie mi yɛ emɛi lɛ ateŋ." Osai hu akakɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, tso gbiŋ kɛkɛ ji mi, ni abuŋ mi ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ anɔ."
Osaii ni yeɔ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, ni amɛfemɔ nii ni sa mihiɛ, ni amɛhiɛɔ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli tswɛ lɛ,
Maha amɛna gbɛi yɛ mi-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ, gbɛi ni hi fe bihii kɛ biyei. Maha amɛna gbɛi ni baahi shi kɛya naanɔ fɛ, ni agbeŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Gɔji ni kɛ amɛhe baakpɛtɛ Yehowa koni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ ni amɛsumɔ egbɛi lɛ, asaŋ koni amɛtsɔmɔ etsuji lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni toɔ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛɔ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ lɛ,

amɛji mɛi ni mikɛaaba Zion, ni ji mi-Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni maha amɛnya yɛ mi-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ. Amɛshãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛfɔlei krokomɛi lɛ aaasa mihiɛ yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Ejaakɛ aaatsɛ miwe lɛ akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ a-Sɔlemɔwe.
Bo ni Yehowa Ofe mɔ ni kpla emaŋ Israel kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛku sɛɛ kɛba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Masaa mapkla mɛi krokomɛi kɛba kɛbafata mɛi ni mikpla kɛba momo lɛ ahe."
Nyɛ ŋanɔ kooloi kɛ nyɛ koo mli kooloi hu fɛɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛbayea nii!
Isreal maŋhebulɔi lɛ eshwila; amɛleee nii. Gbei mumui ji amɛ; amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛblɔ; amɛwieɔ yɛ wɔ mli; amɛkamɔɔ shi, ni amɛsumɔɔ widɔiwɔɔ.
Gbei fulɔi ni; amɛleee mitɔ! Nɛkɛ tookwɛlɔi ni ji maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi nɛɛ lɛ hu, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ; amɛ fɛɛ amɛklɔ amɛgbɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miifo ekome enɔ mli.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa, nyɛhaa wɔwoa wain wɔmaa shi ni wɔnua bo ni wɔɔɔnyɛ. Wɔ hu baatamɔ ŋmɛnɛ, ni eeeteke nɔ po."
57: Jalɔ hiɛ kpãtãa, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ esane lɛ wooo etsuiŋ Aŋɔɔ gbɔmɛi kpakpai kɛjeɔ jeŋ kɛyaa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nuuu shishi. Ejaakɛ aŋɔɔ gbɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ kɛyaa kɛjeɔ haomɔ mli, ni eboteɔ hejɔ lɛ mli.
Mɛi ni ba amɛjeŋ yɛ jalɛ naa lɛ, amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli yɛ gbohiiaje.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsia nyɛbaa biɛ, nyɛ klamɔfoi abii kɛ gblafitelɔi abii kɛ ajwamaŋi abii.
Namɛi ahe fɛo nyɛyeɔ lɛ. Namɛi nyɛgbɛɔ nyɛdaaŋ hatoo nyɛwoɔ, ni nyɛliɔ lɛ? Ani jeee toigbolɔi kɛ amalelɔi ashwiei ji nyɛ lo?
Nyɛkɛ heloo akɔnɔ fɔŋ feɔ yakayakanii yɛ tso fɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi. Nyɛgbeɔ nyɛmusuŋbii nyɛkɛshãa afɔle yɛ jɔi amli kɛ tɛsaa fɔji amli.
Nyɛklɔɔ fai anaa fɔbitɛi, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛjaa amɛ akɛ wɔŋ. Nyɛfɔseɔ dãa nyɛshwieɔ shi nyɛhaa amɛ akɛ afɔle, ni nyɛshãa niyenii afɔle nyɛkahaa amɛ. Aso mitsui aaanyɔ mimli yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ?
Nyɛyaa gɔji ni kwɔlɔ somlomoo lɛ anɔ nyɛyashãa afɔle, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe wɔɔ yɛ jɛi.

Nyɛkɛ nyɛmãgãi ni anyaŋeɔ lɛ mamɔɔ nyɛshinai ashi. Nyɛkwaa mi, nyɛjieɔ nyɛyayai amli, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛsuɔlɔi kwɔɔ kɛyaa nyɛsaatsei ni lɛɛlɛɛ anɔ; nyɛwoɔ amɛ nyɔmɔ koni amɛkɛ nyɛ awɔ; jɛi nyɛgbeɔ nyɛkɔnɔ yɛ.
Nyɛwoɔ ojeŋmai, ni nyɛkpaa muŋma kɛyaa, ni nyɛyajaa wɔŋ Molek. Otsuɔ obɔfoi kɛyaa shɔŋŋ, kɛyaa gbohiaajeŋ tete.
Ogba ohe naa kɛtao wɔji krokomɛi, shi okɛɛɛ ohe akɛ, "Sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he. Ona hewalɛ hee, no hewɔ lɛ ogbɔjɔɔɔ.
"Namɔ gbeyei oshe, ni otsui fã, hewɔ ni omale, ni okaniii mi, ni oyasusuuu mihe lɛ? Aso diŋŋ ni mifee ni miŋamɔ mihiŋmɛii nɛɛ lɛ hewɔ ni osheee mi gbeyei lɛ?
Mibajaje ojalɛ ni osusuɔ akɛ oja lɛ kɛ onifeemɔnii hu fɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ, shi ooona akɛ onaŋ sɛɛko yɛ mli.

Kɛji obla waa lɛ, ha owɔji lɛ obua naa lɛ ahere o! Kɔɔyɔɔ aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee; gugɔ mli kɔɔyɔɔ tete aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee. Shi mɛi ni baa mi abo lɛ aaaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛye, ni migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, Zion, lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjea gbɛ lɛ, nyɛjea! Nyɛjea gbɛ lɛ. Nyɛjiea pampi fɛɛ pampi yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ agbɛ lɛ nɔ.

"Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Mɔ Koome ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo, naanɔ Mɔ ni gbɛi ji Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ kɛ HeKrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mihiɔ; asaŋ mikɛ mɔ ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ ni ebaa ehe shi yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ hiɔ shi.' koni maha heshibalɔi amumɔ ana wala hee, ni mɛi ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ lɛ atsuii ana wala hee.'
Ejaakɛ mibeŋ kɛyaŋ naanɔ, ni jeee daa mimli aaawo la, ejaakɛ mi midɛŋ mumɔ jɛɔ, ni mi mibɔ wala mumɔ.
Nɔ sha ni yɔɔ ehiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, mimli wo la; migwao lɛ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ tee lɛ, ni mimli fu; shi etee nɔ ekwa mi, ni eye etsui naa sane.
"Mina gbɛ fɔŋ ni enyiɛ lɛ, shi mibatsa lɛ, Mibakpla lɛ, ni mibashɛje lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ amii.
Hejɔlɛ, hejɔlɛ aha mɔ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ kɛ mɔ ni bɛŋkɛ fɛɛ. Mibatsa miwebii lɛ.
Shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ amɛtaɔ ŋshɔ ni efee hamahama, ejaakɛ enyɛɛɛ eŋmɛ dɛmm, ni ŋshɔkei lɛ loɔ muji kɛ ŋmɔtɔ ebubuaa shi.
Hejɔlɛ ko bɛ ha mɛi fɔ̃ɔji." Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
58: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Blɔmɔ waa! Kaaha onaa miiba shi. Wo ogbee nɔ tamɔ tɛtrɛmantrɛ. Jajemɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ahe eshai lɛ otsɔɔ amɛ; tsɔɔmɔ Israel we lɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ.

Tsɛbelɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ amɛtaoɔ misɛɛgbɛ, ni maɛshweɔ akɛ amɛle migbɛi lɛ tamɔ maŋ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane, ni amɛkwako amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mlai lɛ. Amɛtaoɔ akɛ mabu amɛ bem akɛ jalɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ."
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Mɛɛba wɔhiɔ ŋmaa, ni bo, Yehowa, onaaa lɛ? Mɛɛba wɔhumiɔ shi, ni onaaa lɛ." Shi Yehowa kɛɛ, "Naa, nyɛŋmãahilɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ mli nyɛfoɔ, ni nyɛwaa nyɛnitsulɔi fɛɛ ayi.
Naa, nyɛŋmãahilɛ be mli lɛ, nɔ ni eshwɛ nyɛ kɛkɛ ji bei kɛ nɔmɔ, ni nyɛmamɔɔ nyɛhe atswɛrɛi kɛ yiwalɛ. Nɛkɛ ŋmãa ni nyɛhiɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ haŋ anu nyɛgbee yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ani nɛkɛ ŋmãahilɛ mito lɛ? Enɛ ji ŋmãahilɛ ni gbɔmɔ kɛhumiɔ shi lɛ? Ani no ji yishimaa kɛ kpekpebumɔ lɛ lamlumlikamɔ lo? Enɛ nyɛtsɛɔ lɛ ŋmãahilɛ gbi ni sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ?
"Ani jeee enɛ moŋ ji ŋmãahilɛ ni mito lɛ; akɛ akpa toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli kɔŋtso lɛ he ŋmei lɛ koni aha mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ aye amɛhe koni akamɔ apã fɛɛ apã?
Ani jeee no ji akɛ oboloo akuma mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ, ni oŋɔ ohiafo ni bɛ shihilɛhe lɛ kɛba owe lɛ, ni kɛji ona mɔ ko ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ ohã lɛ mama, ni okɛ ohe akatee bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe gbɔmɔ.
"No lɛ ojalɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ leebi hulu, ni otsamɔ hu aaafee oya, ni ojalɛ aaanyiɛ ohiɛ, ni Yehowa anumnyam lɛ aaanyiɛ osɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobo otsɛ, ni Yehowa aaahere bɔ nɔ; ooobo otsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, 'Naa mi!' "Kɛji nyɛkpa mɛi gboklɛwoo yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛkpa wao kɛmɔtsɔɔmɔ kɛ mɔ he efɔŋ wiemɔ,
Kɛji oha mɔ mi ehīa lɛ lɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, no dani ola lɛ aaakpɛ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli, ni oduŋ kpii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ shwane.
Ni Yehowa aaakpla bo daa, ni eeehã bo ohiamɔnii yɛ fimɔ be mli, ni eeehã bo hewalɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ tamɔ trom ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli, loo tamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni nu kplaaa yɛ mli.
Omɛi lɛ aaasaa oblema tsui koi lɛ atswa; amɛaatswa tsui lɛ amɛmamɔ blema fanesii srɔtoi lɛ anɔ, Aaatsɛ nyɛ mɛi ni saa gbogboi lɛ amɛtswa kɛ mɛi ni saa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ koni mɛi anyɛ nɔ ahi."

Yehowa kɛɛ, "Kɛji oto hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ akɛ gbi Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni ofɔ̃ɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ mlifomɔ yɛ migbi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji obu Yehowa gbi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ohiɛ sɔ Yehowa gbi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛji owo gbi lɛ, ni ofeee bo diɛŋtsɛ otsuinaa nii, ni ofooo bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ mli, ni otsuuu bo diɛŋtsɛ onii lɛ, loo otiuuu otsuinaanii sɛɛ, aloo owieee yaka wiemɔi yɛ nɔ lɛ,
No lɛ maha oye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei grɔŋŋi fɛɛ anɔ, ni omii aaashɛ Yehowa he, ni oooye otsɛ Yakob gboshinii lɛ." Yehowa kɛ enaabu ekɛɛ.
59: Naa, Yehowa nine efoko kuku bɔ ni no hewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ yiwala ehere; asaŋ etoii hu tsimɔko bɔ ni enuuu nii.
Shi moŋ nyɛnishaianii lɛ ji nii ni egbla nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ. Nyɛhe eshai lɛ ji nii ni etsī nyɛhiɛ, hewɔ ni ebooo nyɛ toi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ lá ebule nyɛniji, ni nyɛkɛ nishaianii ebule nyɛwabii; nyɛnaabu wieɔ amale wiemɔi, kutumpɔo wiemɔi ji nɔ ni kã nyɛlilɛi nɔ.

Mɛi ni asane ejaaa lɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni samaa mɛi, ni mɔ ni sane bɛŋ moŋ ni kɛ sane yaa kojomɔ sɛ̃i hiɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amale naajiemɔi anɔ, ni amɛtoɔ abla; amɛtoɔ yiŋ sha, ni no kɛ nɔshaafeemɔ baa.
Yiŋ shai ni amɛtoɔ lɛ yeɔ awui tamɔ shinɔ ni naa joɔ wɔji. Kɛji wɔji lɛ eko fɛ lɛ, onufu ji nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ wɔlɔ lɛ eko lɛ gbo egboɔ. Amɛnifeemɔ tamɔ anaanu ntaŋ;
ni ntaŋi lɛ nyɛɛɛ atsɔ̃ mama ni aaanyɛ aha. Nishaianii pɛ amɛfeɔ, ni niseniianii pɛ amɛkɛ amɛniji tsuɔ.
Amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni amɛyeɔ oyai kɛshwieɔ mɔ ni fɔbuu ko bɛ ehe lɛ lá shi. Nɔ he pɛ ni amɛjwɛŋɔ ji nɔsha, ni nifitemɔ kɛ niihiɛkpãtãmɔ anaa yɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
Toiŋjɔlɛ ni ji toiŋjɔlɛ lɛ amɛleee eko, ni jalɛ saneyeli bɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ. Amɛkɔ̃dɔkɔdɔ̃ɔɔ amɛgbɛi, ni mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ nakai gbɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ he ejɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "No hewɔ ni jalɛ saneyeli kɛ wɔteŋ jekɛ lɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ bɛŋkɛɛɛ wɔ lɛ. Wɔkwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ la akpe aha wɔ, shi moŋ duŋ mli wɔnyiɛɔ.
Wɔtatraa yɛ gbogbo he tamɔ shwilafoi, ni wɔgbugbuɔ shi tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ hiŋmɛii; wɔtrɛɔ shwane fintiŋŋ tamɔ nɔ ni hiɛ ebu, ni wɔnyiɛɔ hiɛkãalɔi ateŋ tamɔ mɛi ni egboi.
Wɔ fɛɛ wɔhuuɔ tamɔ oshishibrishi, wɔyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpoi; wɔkwɛɔ jalɛ saneyeli gbɛ, shi ekoeko ejeee gbɛ, wɔshweɔ yiwalaheremɔ, shi ekɛ wɔteŋ jekɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, wɔtɔmɔi lɛ fa tsɔ̃ yɛ ohiɛ, ni wɔhe eshai lɛ yeɔ odase shiɔ wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔtɔmɛi lɛ jwere wɔhiɛ, wɔshishinaii lɛ hu wɔle fɛɛ.
Wɔtɔ̃, ni wɔkwa Yehowa, ni wɔkpale yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ. Yiwalɛ kɛ atuatsemɔ wiemɔi wɔwieɔ; amale wiemɔi ni wɔtoɔ yɛ wɔtsuiiaŋ lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ wɔnaa.
Jalɛ saneyeli ekpale kɛtee sɛɛ, ni jalɛ eyadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ejaakɛ anɔkwale etã yɛ blohuŋ, ni anɔkwale bɛ nɔ ko mli.
Anɔkwale elaaje, ni mɔ ni wiɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ efɔŋ he lɛ ayɔseɔ moŋ kɛ lɛ moŋ etɔ̃."
Ena, ni enaa kpɛ ehe akɔ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni edamɔ mli eha mɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ amim; ni no hewɔ lɛ ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ here eyiwala, ni ejalɛ lɛ ye bua lɛ.
Jalɛ aaatsɔ dama ni eeewo, ni yiwalaheremɔ aaatsɔ dade fai ni eeebu, ni oweletɔɔ aaatsɔ bo ni eeeha, ni hiɛdɔɔ ni naa wa ekɛaafee emama.
Bɔ ni amɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ebaafee amɛ eto najiaŋ. Emli aaawo la awo mɛi ni kɛ lɛ ena lɛ, ni eeewo henyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛyanina ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛaashe Yehowa gbɛi lɛ gbeyei yɛ anaigbɛ; aaashe ehewalɛ lɛ gbeyei yɛ hulushiteehe, ejaakɛ ebaaba tamɔ faa ni etue ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ etsi eyisɛɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Mibaba Zion taakɛ kpɔ̃lɔ, akɛ kpɔ̃lɔ ha Yakob shwiei ni ekpale kɛje nifɔ̃ɔjianiifeemɔ mli lɛ.
Ni naa, mi lɛ kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋɔ nɛ: Mimumɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, kɛ miwiemɔi ni mikɛwo onaa lɛ, ha akã bo kɛ oshwiei ashwiei fɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ."
60: Tee shi ni otso ejaakɛ ola lɛ eshɛ shi etã, ni Yehowa anumnyam lɛ miikpɛ yɛ onɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, duŋ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni duŋ kpii aaaha majimaji lɛ anɔ. Shi bo lɛ, Yehowa la aaate lɛ shi aha bo, ni enumnyam lɛ aaakpɛ yɛ onɔ.
Ni maji aaatsi kɛbɛŋkɛ ola lɛ, ni Maŋtsɛmɛi aaaba ola ni kpɛɔ yɛ onɔ lɛ he.
Wo ohiɛ nɔ, koni okwɛ ohe kɛkpe; ooona maɛ fɛɛ ni amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛmiiba oŋɔɔ. Obihii lɛ aaajɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ aba, ni obiyeilɛ, aaahiɛ amɛ yɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kɛaaba.
Nakai be lɛ ohiŋmɛi aaana; ooona miishɛɛ kɛteke nɔ, ni otsui aaatɔ, ni ooonya. Ejaakɛ akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ajwetrii aaabahã bo; akɛ amɛjwetrii lɛ aaajɛ ŋshɔsɛɛ aaabãhã o.
Yomai asafo yuu aaabua ohe kutuu, ni ji Midian kɛ Efa yoomai oblahii lɛ. Amɛaatre shika kɛ krɔbɔo kɛaajɛ Sheba kɛaaba; ni mɛi aaagba nɔ ni Yehowa efee lɛ he sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ.
Aaabua Kedar toi fɛɛ anaa abaha o, kɛ Nebaiot too ojwɛnii lɛ hu akɛ afɔle. Akɛ amɛ aaashã afɔle ni sa mihiɛ yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mawo minumnyam sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Mɛɛ ji nibii nɛɛ ni hoɔ tamɔ atatu loo tamɔ okpoi ni eku amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba amɛtsu naa nɛɛ?

Lɛji ni jɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔji anɔ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii miiba ni. Amɛkɛ obihii lɛ kɛ amɛjwiɛtɛii kɛ amɛshika miiba kɛbawo Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni i Isreal Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam; ejaakɛ eha ohiɛ eba nyam.
Yehowa mikɛɛ Yerusalem akɛ, "Gbɔi aaatswa ohe gbogboi lɛ, ni amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aaasɔmɔ bo; ejaakɛ mitswa o nɔ yɛ mimlifu mli; shi mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe yɛ mimlihilɛ lɛ naa.
Ogboi lɛ anaa aaakamɔ be fɛɛ be; shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, aŋamɔŋ, koni Maŋtsɛmɛi anyiɛ amɛwebii ahiɛ, koni amɛkɛ majimaji lɛ ajwetrii lɛ abaha o.
Shi maji ni sɔmɔɔɔ bo lɛ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ; nakai maji lɛ, kpãtãmɔ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu.
Lebanon kooŋ tsei kpakpai, ni ji sɛsɛo kɛ odum kɛ odanta, akɛaaba akɛbawula mihe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni mawo he ni midamɔɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Mɛi ni wa bo yi lɛ abii lɛ hu aaaba abakoto bo; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni gbe ohe guɔ aaaba abakula onaji anaa. Amɛaatsɛ bo 'Yehowa maŋ wulu,' 'Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ Zion lɛ.'
Kulɛ akwa bo, ni anyɛ bo; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ omli kɛhooo; shi no najiaŋ lɛ, maha oje agbo, ofee naanɔ anumnyam kɛ naanɔ nyamɔ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛya yinɔ.
Oooye majimaji kɛ Maŋtsɛmɛi anii tamɔ abifao yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ, ni okɛaana ole akɛ, mi, Yehowa, miji oyiwalaherelɔ; ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ji okpɔ̃lɔ.

"Maha o shika yɛ akɔɔble najiaŋ, ni maha o jwiɛtɛi yɛ dade najiaŋ; tso najiaŋ lɛ, mahao akɔɔble; ni tɛi anajiaŋ lɛ, maha o dade. Onɔyelɔi lɛ waŋ bo yi dɔŋŋ, ni maha amɛkɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ aye onɔ.
Anuŋ yiwalɛ he dɔŋŋ yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo nifitemɔ loo niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ he yɛ ohusui amli he ko he ko; mafa ohe ni mabu ohe; matsɔ yiwalaheremɔ gbogbo maha o. Ni ooojie miyi, ejaakɛ mikpɔ̃ o.
"Jeee hulu ni baatso la dɔŋŋ aha o shwane, ni jeee nyɔŋtsere ni baakpɛ koni jeŋ atse aha o gbɛkɛ; shi moŋ Yehowa ni aaatsɔ̃ ola kɛaaatee naanɔ, ni o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ onumnyam;
Ohulu lɛ enyɔŋ shi dɔŋŋ, ni onyɔŋtsere lɛ hu woŋ duŋ; ejaakɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ ola kɛaatee naanɔ, ni okɔmɔyeli gbii lɛ hu sɛɛ aaafo.
Omaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaafee nɔ ni ja, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ kɛya naanɔ, amɛji tso ni mitɛo akɛ mi mininenaa nitsumɔ nii koni akɛwo mihiɛ nyam.
Mɔ bibioo fe fɛɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ weku muu, ni weku bibioo lɛ aaatsɔ̃ jaku muu. Kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Mi, Yehowa, maha eba mli oya."
61: Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mumɔ lɛ yɛ minɔ. Efɔ mi mu, ni etsu mi koni mibashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi. Etsu mi koni mibashɛje mɛi ni efee bliboo kɛ awerɛho lɛ amii, koni mishiɛ heyeli mitsɔ̃ɔ nomii lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ.
Etsu mi koni mibashiɛ akɛ Yehowa dromɔ afi lɛ kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ oweletɔɔ gbi lɛ eshɛ, koni mishɛje ŋkɔmɔyelɔi fɛɛ amii.

Etsu mi koni mɛi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Zion lɛ mibana amɛ ayilɔ yɛ lamlu najiaŋ, ni yɛ awerɛho najiaŋ lɛ, mibaha amɛmii ashɛ. Amɛaafee tamɔ tsei ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ tɛo. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaafee nii ni ja, ni aaajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ nii ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛaatswa blema tsui koi lɛ; ni amɛaasaa tsutsubii lɛ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ, ni amɛaato maji lɛ efite lɛ ehee ekoŋŋ ni ji yinɔi pii anɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ.
Maŋsɛɛbii aaalɛ nyɛtoi lɛ, ni mɛi kpɔji aaahu nyɛŋmɔji amɛha nyɛ, ni amɛaasaa nyɛwaintsei ahe aha nyɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, aaatsɛ nyɛ Yehowa osɔfoi, ni mɛi aaatsɛ nyɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi. Nyɛaabaye jeŋ maji lɛ anii, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ yɛ jeŋ majiaŋbii lɛ anii lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɛhiɛgble kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ aaafo, nyɛmii aaashɛ nyɛhe, yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛninamɔ lɛ aaaku abɔ he, ni nyɛaana miishɛɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, misumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; miihi juu kɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ feemɔ. Mibato amɛ najiaŋ shishiishi, ni mi kɛ amɛ aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Amɛshwiei agbɛi aaahehe yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛbii hu aaana gbɛi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaana amɛ aaakplɛ̃ nɔ akɛ mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛ ji amɛ.

Manya waa yɛ Yehowa hewɔ; ni misusuma mli aaafli lɛ yɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ewo mi yiwalaheremɔ atade, ni ekɛ jalɛ maam eha mi, tamɔ bɔ ni ayɛfro wu wulaa ehe loo bɔ ni ayɛmfro wulaa kɛ jwine lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni shikpɔŋ hãa nii kwɛ̃ɔ, ni trom hãa nii ni adu yɛ mli lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ lɛ, nakai Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã jalɛ kɛ yijiemɔ akwɛ̃ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
62: Zion hewɔ lɛ mimuaŋ minaa, ni Yerusalem hewɔ lɛ mijɔŋ mihe kɛyaashi bem ni eye lɛ aaaje kpo faŋŋ tamɔ leebi hulu, ni eyiwala ni ahere lɛ aaatso tamɔ kɔti.
Jeŋ maji lɛ aaana obemyeli lɛ, ni Maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaana onumnyam; ni akɛ gbɛi heei ni Yehowa aaawo bo lɛ aaatsɛ bo.
Oootsɔ̃ tamɔ akekre fɛɛfɛo yɛ Yɛhowa dɛŋ; oootsɔ̃ tamɔ Maŋtsɛ fai yɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

Atsɛŋ bo, "Mɔ ni akwa lɛ" dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ aaatsɛ o "Mitsui naa gbɔmɔ"; ni aaatsɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ hu "Kpeemɔ yoo"; ejaakɛ Yehowa ena ohe tsuijurɔ ni oshikpɔŋ lɛ hu "Kpeemɔ yoo"; ejaakɛ Yehowa ena ohe tsuijurɔ ni oshikpɔŋ lɛ hu aaakpee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni oblanyo kpeɔ oblayoo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni bɔ bo lɛ aaakpee bo; ni bɔ ni ayɛmfro wu nyaa ayɛmfro he lɛ, nakai o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaanya ohe.
Ao Yerusalem, mito bulɔi yɛ ogbogboi lɛ anɔ. Shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛmuaŋ amɛnaa. Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkaiɔ Yehowa shiwoi lɛ, nyɛkajɔa nyɛhe;
ni nyɛkahãa ejɔa ehe kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeehã Yerusalem ama shi, ni eeehã ena gbɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Yehowa ewo ehewalɛ nine lɛ nɔ ekɛkã ehe kita akɛ, "Anɔkwa, mikɛ oble lɛ haŋ ohenyɛlɔi amɛye dɔŋŋ, ni maŋsɛɛbii enuŋ owain ni ogbo he deŋme lɛ dɔŋŋ;
shi mɛi ni buaa naa woɔ aboŋoŋ lɛ, amɛ amɛaaye, ni amɛaajie Yehowa yi; ni mɛi ni buaa wainyibii lɛ anaa kɛbaa shīa lɛ, amɛ amɛaanu wain lɛ, Yɛ mihe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ."
Nyɛjea kpo, nyɛjea kpo, nyɛtsɔa agboi lɛ amli; nyɛjea maŋ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nyɛtoa maŋbii lɛ. Nyɛsaa, nyɛsaa gbɛjegbɛ lɛ; nyɛklɔa enɔ tɛi lɛ; nyɛshia aflaŋaa kɛtoa okadi nyɛhãa maŋbii lɛ.
Naa, Yehowa eha ashiɛ kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe lɛ akɛ, Nyɛkɛa Zion bi yoo lɛ akɛ, "Naa, oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ miiba; naa, ehiɛ enyɔmɔwo kɛmiiba, ni mɛi ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ nyiɛ eihɛ kɛmiiba. "
Ni ebaatsɛ amɛ akɛ "Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ," Ni bo hu aaatsɛ o, "Mɔ ni ataoɔ esɛɛgbɛ Maŋ ni akwaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ"
63: Namɔ ji mɔ ni jɛ Bozra, maŋ ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ, baa nɛɛ? Namɔ nɛ, ni ewula kɛ atade ni tsuɔ faa, ni etsīaa yɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli nɛɛ? Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mi Yehowa ni; mɔ ni wieɔ yɛ jalɛ mli, mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛhereɔ yiwala lɛ."
Mɛɛba ohe bo lɛ tsuɔ nɛkɛ; mɛɛba otadei lɛ tamɔ mɔ ni ŋaa wain atade nɛɛ?
Yehowa to he akɛ, "Mi koome too miŋa, minaanaa jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ tanɔ anaa wain lɛ. Minaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli, ni amɛmli nu tsɛŋe wo mitadei lɛ amli, ni ewu mitadei lɛ amli fɛɛ nɛ.
Ejaakɛ oweletɔɔ gbi ko yɛ mitsui mli, ni mikpɔ̃mɔ afi lɛ eshɛ.
Mikwɛ mihe, shi yilikɛbualɔ ko bɛ; ni minaa kpɛ mihe akɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni mɔɔ mli haa mi. No hewɔ lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ ni here miyiwala, ni mimlila lɛ ni mɔ mli hã mi.
Minaanaa majimaji lɛ anɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli, ni mifɔse amɛlá mishwie shikpɔŋ."
Mibagba Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ kɛ Yehowa yijiemɔ lɛ matsɔ̃ɔɔ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa efee eha wɔ lɛ kɛ ejurɔ pii ni efee Israel we lɛ yɛ emusuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ emlihilɛ ni fa lɛ naa lɛ hewɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Mimaŋ ji amɛ, bii ni lakaŋ mi." No hewɔ ehere amɛ
yɛ amɛhaomɔi fɛɛ amli lɛ. Jeee tsulɔ loo ŋwɛi bɔfo ni here amɛyiwala, shi Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ jɛ esuɔmɔ kɛ emɔbɔnalɛ mli ehere amɛyiwala, ni ehole amɛ, ni ehiɛ amɛ yɛ blema beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtse atūa, ni amɛfee Emumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nidɔnii. No hewɔ lɛ etsɔ amɛŋhenyɛlɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛ amɛ wu.
Kɛkɛ ni emaŋ lɛ kai Mose blema be lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni to Emumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni ha enumnyam hewalɛ lɛ tsɔ Mose nɔ etsu nibii wuji lɛ yɔɔ? Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni gba ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekɛna naanɔ gbɛi eha ehe lɛ,
Mɔ ni kpla amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ? Amɛtrɛɛ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ trɛɔ yɛ shiaŋa nɔ."
Yehowa mumɔ lɛ ha amɛna hejɔlɛ tamɔ tsinai ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa jɔɔ mli jwɛfɔ he. Nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Yehowa kpla emaŋ lɛ, ni ekɛna anumnyam gbɛi ehã ehe.
Yehowa, maa oyi shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi koni ojɛ ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ onumnyam shihilɛhe lɛ okwɛ! Nɛgbɛ ohiɛdɔɔ kɛ ohewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Otsuiŋshãlɛ kɛ omusuŋtsɔ̃lɛ babaoo lɛ eŋmɛɛ wɔ.
Ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ, tsɛbelɛ Abraham leee wɔ, ni Isreal hu eŋɔɔɔ wɔ akɛ bii; shi bo Yehowa lɛ bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ kɛ wɔkpɔ̃lɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe ejaakɛ nakai ji ogbɛi.
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛba ohaa wɔduɔ gbɛ kɛjɛɔ ogbɛi lɛ anɔ? Mɛɛba owajeɔ wɔtsui koni wɔkashe o gbeyei lɛ? Otsuji kɛ okutsei lɛ ahewɔ lɛ kuu osɛɛ.
Be fioo pɛ Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hi omɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ adɛŋ; shi agbɛnɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ enaanaa Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
Wɔtsɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni oyeko amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔ pɛŋ, kɛ mɛi ni akɛ ogbɛi tsɛko amɛ dã.
64: Ao, kulɛ otserɛ ŋwɛi mli, ni okpleke shi koni gɔji lɛ ana o ni amɛhe akpokpo yɛ ohiɛ,
tamɔ bɔ ni la hãa lai tsoɔ, ni ehaa nu tswaa lɛ, koni eha ohenyɛlɔi ale ogbɛi. Ba koni obajie ohewalɛ lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, koni eha jeŋ maji lɛ ahe akpokpo yɛ ohiɛ!
Be ni ofee naakpɛɛnii ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni wɔhiɛ kãaa nɔ lɛ, okpleke shi, ni gɔji lɛ kpokpo yɛ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ anuko dã, ni efoko mɔ ko mɔ ko toi naa dã, ni hiŋmɛi hu enako Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ bo osɛɛ ni feɔ nɔ ehaa mɛi ni hiɛ kã enɔ lɛ!
Ohereɔ mɛi ni kɛ miishɛɛ feɔ jalɛnii, mɛi ni kaiɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ amɛba amɛjeŋ amɛha lɛ atuu. Omli fu wɔ, shi wɔkã he wɔfee esha lɛ lolo. Yɛ omlifu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, wɔkã he wɔfee esha lolo.
Wɔ fɛɛ wɔtsɔmɔ tamɔ mɔ ko ni he tseee, ni wɔjalɛ nifeemɔnii lɛ tamɔ takoshwɛ. Wɔnishaianii lɛ ehã wɔfee tamɔ baa gbiŋ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa wɔ kɛyaa.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni sɔleɔ tsɛɔ o, mɔ ko bɛ ni baa odɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ, ejaakɛ okɛ ohiɛ etee wɔ, ni oŋmɛɛ wɔhe oha wɔnishaianii lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ bo, Yehowa, bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ. Wɔ lɛ su ji wɔ, ni boji wɔshɔ̃lɔ, ni oninenaa nitsumɔ ji wɔ fɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kaaha omli miifu wɔ fe nine, ni kaakai wɔhe eshai lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Omaŋbii ji wɔ; naa wɔ mɔbɔ.
Omaji Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ etsɔmɔ ŋanɔ: Zion etsɔ ŋanɔ, Yerusalem etsɔ amaŋfɔ̃.
Wɔsɔlemɔ we ni yɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ fɛo lɛ, nɔ mli ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ jie oyi yɛ lɛ, ama naa la ashã. Akpãtã wɔhei fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ao Yehowa, aso enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ooosu ohe lo, ooofee diŋŋ, ni ooowa wɔ yi tuutu lo?
65: Yehowa kɛɛ, "Mihaa mɛi ni biko mi nii lɛ hetoo, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mihaa mɛi ni taoko mi lɛ naa mi. Mikɛɔ maŋ ni sɔleko tsɛko mi lɛ akɛ, Naa mi! Naa mi!
Migbɛɔ miniji amli daa nɛɛ mihaa maŋ atuatselɔi ni nyiɛɔ gbɛ ni ehiii nɔ, mɛi ni nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi anaa lɛ.
Atuatselɔi nɛɛ jeɔ kpetekplee amɛwoɔ mimli la daa. Amɛshãa afɔle yɛ abɔi amli amɛhaa wɔji, ni amɛshãa tsofãkɛŋma yɛ ntayai anɔ amɛhãa wɔji.
Amɛyatraa tɛkploi ni afu gbohii yɛ mli amli, ni amɛyatsɛɔ sisai gbɛkɛgbɛkɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛyeɔ kplotoo loo tete, ni amɛfaa wonu ni akɛ wɔŋ naa loo hoo.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Tsi ohe kɛya sɛɛ. Kaabɛŋkɛ mi ejaakɛ mihe tse fe bo.' Mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ amɛsukɔɔ mi, amɛtamɔ la ni tsoɔ gbi muu fɛɛ.
"Naa, aŋma afɔ mihiɛ akɛ, 'Mifeŋ dioo; mibatɔ he owele; mikuŋ mihiɛ mifɔŋ nɔ ni amɛfee lɛ nɔ; mibawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ kɛ̃
yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anishaianii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.'" Yehowa kɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa saa ekɛɛ nɛ, "Bɔ ni anaa yɛ wainyibii amli, ni no hewɔ lɛ akɛɔ akɛ, 'Akafite lɛ, ejaakɛ abaana ehe sɛɛ' lɛ, nakai mafee yɛ mitsuji lɛ ahewɔ; mikpãtãŋ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
Mibajɔɔ Israelbii ni jɛ Yuda mli lɛ, ni amɛshwuei aaabaŋɔ migɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ, ni jɛi mitsuji ni sɔmɔɔ mi lɛ aaahi.
Amɛaaja mi, ni amɛaakpla amɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛya Sharon ŋa ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛkooloi aaaya Akor Jɔɔ ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ hu mli koni amɛyaye nii.
"Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkwa Yehowa, ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa egɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Zion lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛŋmɛɔ ekplɔ̃ nyɛkɛhãa shade wɔŋ, ni nyɛfɔseɔ wain ni afutu mli nyɛshwieɔ shi nyɛhãa shɛɛ mli wɔŋ lɛ,
mibajɔɔ nyɛnɔ mahã klaŋte. Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaagbo otɔfo gbele, ejaakɛ mitsɛ nyɛ, shi nyɛhereee minɔ, miwie ni nyɛbooo toi; shi nyɛfɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni nyɛkɔ nɔ ni nyɛle akɛ misumɔɔɔ lɛ moŋ.

No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ. Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaaye nii atɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ hɔmɔ baaye nyɛ. Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaana nu amɛnu, shi nyɛ lɛ kumai aaaye nyɛ Naa mitsuji lɛ aaanya, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛhiɛ aaagboi.
Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaala kɛ tsuijurɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛaafo kɛ tsuiŋshãlɛ, ni nyɛaafo yoo kɛ mumɔ ni werɛ eho ehe.
Mihalamɔbii lɛ aaatsi nyɛtã amɛkɛlomɔ, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaagbe nyɛ. Shi etsuji lɛ eeewo amɛ gbɛi kroko.

Koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa jɔɔmɔ aha ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kãa kita yɛ shikpɔŋ, akã anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã, ejaakɛ mihiɛ ekpa tsuutsu haomɔi lɛ anɔ, ni aŋɔ atee yɛ mihiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, miibɔ ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee, ni akaiŋ tsuutsu nii lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ ebaŋ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ mli dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛnyaa, ni nyɛmli afia nyɛ kɛya naanɔ, yɛ nii ni mibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ naa, miibɔ Yerusalem hee koni etsɔ̃ mliflimɔ kɛ emli bii hu ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ.
Mimli aaafli mi yɛ Yerusalem he, ni manya mimaŋbii lɛ ahe, ni anuŋ yaafo kɛ blɔmɔ he yɛ Yerusalem dɔŋŋ.

Bi fufɔoo ko bɛ jɛi ni aaaye gbii fioo kɛkɛ yɛ wala mli, loo onukpa ko ni eyi yɛŋ yɛ jeŋ. Gbɔmɔ kpakpa aaaye afii oha nɛ, shi aaana lɛ akɛ oblanyo; ni mɔ fɔŋ ni naa afii oha lɛ, aaaŋɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni alomɔ lɛ.
Amɛaamamɔ shīai, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛaahi mli; amɛaafee wain abɔɔi, ni amɛaaye amɛmli wain tsei lɛ ayibii.

Amɛmamɔŋ shīai ni mɛi krokomɛi moŋ ahi mli, ni amɛhuŋ hu ni mɛi krokomɛi moŋ aye, ejaakɛ bɔ ni odum tsɛɔ yɛ koo mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mimaŋbii awala sɛɛ aaatsɛ; ni mihalamɔbii lɛ aaaye amɛnine naa nitsumɔ mli nii daa.
Amɛgboŋ yaka deŋme, ni amɛfɔŋ bii amɛhaŋ oshrã, ejaakɛ mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ lɛ ashwiei ji amɛ, ni ajɔɔ amɛ hu amɛshwiei.
Ni aaaba mli akɛ dani amɛaatsɛ mi lɛ mahere amɛ nɔm ni be ni amɛwieɔ lolo lɛ, amabo amɛtoi.
Klaŋ kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋbi aaakpe nii yɛ he kome, ni jata aaaye jwɛi tamɔ tsina; ni onufu lɛ sū aaafee eniyenii. Ayeŋ awui ko, ni akpãtãŋ nii ahiɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ Zion, migɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ," Yehowa kɛɛ.
66: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Ŋwɛi lɛ, mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ni; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ, minaneshi maaŋoo ni; belɛ mɛɛ tsu nyɛaama nyɛha mi mɔ, ni nɛɛgbɛ aaafee mihejɔɔmɔ he?
Mi minine bɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ minɔ ni," Yehowa kɛɛ. "Shi mɔ he tsui ni minaa nɛ, mɔ ni ji humi, ni eshwaa ehe yɛ etsui mli, ni ehe kpokpoɔ yɛ miwiemɔ lɛ naa."

"Mɔ ni gbeɔ tsina lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔ nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni kɛ toobi shãa afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni kɛ gbee shãa afɔle nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni shãa niyenii afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni kɛ kplotoo lá baahã nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni shãa krɔbɔo afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni jaa wɔŋ nɔŋŋ. Mɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ eklɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛi, ni amɛnaa nihiinii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu maha amanehulu aba amɛ nɔ, ni maha nɔ gbeyei ni amɛsheɔ lɛ aba amɛnɔ. Ejaakɛ mitsɛ, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko hereee nɔ; miwie ni amɛbooo toi; shi moŋ amɛfee nɔ ni ji efɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni amɛfee nɔ moŋ ni esaaa mihiɛ."

Nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhe kpokpoɔ yɛ ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ. "Nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni mihii nyɛ, ni amɛkwa nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, yeɔ nyɛ he fɛo amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam akɛ ehere nyɛ, koni wɔna nyamɔ ni nyɛaanya lɛ.' Shi amɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi.
Nyɛboa toi, aafee hoo yɛ maŋ lɛ mli. Gbee ko miijɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ. Yehowa mɔ ni baawo ehenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ gbee ni.
"Mimaŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ yoohɔlɔ ni dani eeebɔi kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efɔ momo, mɔ ni dani fɔmɔ piŋmɔ lɛ aaata ehe lɛ, efɔ binuu momo.
Namɔ enu kɛkɛ sane pɛŋ? Namɔ ena nɛkɛ nɔ ko pɛŋ? Ani gbi kome abɔɔ maŋ lo? Ani gbi kome akɛnaa jaku lo? Kɛ̃lɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Zion bɔi kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni efɔ ebii lɛ.
Aso mahã ajwa awoso, ni mihaŋ afɔ? Aso mi ni mihãa afɔɔ lɛ, maŋa musu lɛ naa lo?" O-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
"Nyɛ kɛ Yerusalem anyaa, ni nyɛmli aflia nyɛ yɛ ehewɔ. Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, nyɛ kɛ lɛ anaa miishɛɛɛ, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ!
Nyɛbaana eshweremɔ lɛ eko nyɛye nyɛtrɔ, tamɔ abifao yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ etɔɔ lɛ."

Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Mahã nyɛshwere babaoo tamɔ faa ni hoɔ, ni majimajiaŋbii lɛ anii ni amɛna lɛ aaayiridi, tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛteke nɔ, kɛba nyɛdɛŋ. Nyɛaatamɔ abifao ni yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ; aaahiɛ nyɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kɛ suɔmɔ yɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ.
Bɔ ni binyɛ shɛjeɔ ebi mii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu mashɛje nyɛmii, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ nyɛhe yɛ Yerusalem.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛaana kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii, ni nyɛtsui aaanyɔ nyɛmli, ni nyɛgbɔmɔtsei aaafrɔke tamɔ jwɛfɔ, ni aaana ale akɛ Yehowa nine kã etsuji ahe, shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ emli aaafu amɛ."
Ejaakɛ naa, Yehowa aaaba kɛ la, ni eshwiilii lɛ aaanyiɛ lasuogbele mli kɛaaba, ni ekɛ mlila kple aaawo ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ; ni ekɛ la lilɛii aaakã ehenyɛlɔi.
Ejaakɛ la Yehowa kɛbaakojo, ni ekɛ klaŋte aaakojo jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, ni mɛi ni Yehowa aaagble lɛ ayi aaafa babaoo naakpa.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛi ni feɔ amɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni amɛtsuuɔ amɛhe kɛha tsei kɛ tɛi ajamɔ ni amɛtoɔ srɛnɛɛ kɛyaa wɔkoiaŋ, ni amɛyayeɔ kplotoo kɛ obishi kɛ kwakwe loo lɛ, amɛnaagbee eshɛ.
Ejaakɛ mile amɛnitsumɔi kɛ amɛsusumɔi, ni miiba koni mibabua jeŋ maji fɛɛ anaa, ni amɛaaba, ni amɛaabana minumnyam lɛ;

ni amɛaana okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miji mɔ ni gblaa amɛtoi lɛ. "Ni matsu mɛi ni ahe baaje toigblamɔ lɛ mli lɛ kɛaatee Spain kɛ Libya kɛ Lydia, ni ji gãitsɛlɔi amaŋ lɛ. Matsu kɛya Tubal kɛ Helabii ŋshɔkpɔi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ ni amɛnuko mihe, asaŋ amɛnako minumnyam, lɛ bii hu aŋɔɔ. Amɛaajaje minumnyam lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ.

Ni amɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ aaaba akɛ nikee abahã Yehowa. Amɛaatra okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛ shwiilii kɛ akpakãii amli kɛ teji kɛ yoomai anɔ kɛba Yerusalem, migɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, taakɛ bɔ ni Isrealbii hiɛɔ amɛnikeenii yɛ nibii ni mli tse amli kɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ," Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Maŋɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi mafee osɔfoi kɛ Levibii," Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Bɔ mni ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee ni mafee lɛ aaahi shi yɛ mihiɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛshwiei kɛ nyɛgbɛi aaahi shi yɛ mihiɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Ni aaaba mli akɛ nyɔŋ hee fɛɛ nyɔŋ hee kɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi fɛɛ aaaba abaja yɛ mihiɛ," Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Ni amɛaaje kpo amɛyakwɛ mɛi ni tse mihiɛ atua lɛ gboiŋ, ni la ni baashã amɛ lɛ agbeŋ. Amɛhe aaafee heloo fɛɛ heloo nyaŋemɔ."

1: Yakobo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo tsulɔ lɛ ŋma yahã akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ. Miiŋa nyɛ!
Minyɛmimɛi, kɛji aka nyɛ yɛ nibii srɔtoi pii amli lɛ, nyɛbua lɛ miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ,
ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli kaa lɛ hiɛmiamɔ baa.
Ni nyɛhãa hiɛmiamɔ lɛ agbea enitsumɔ naa kɛwulaa shi, koni nyɛhi kɛwula shi ni nyɛye emuu ni nɔ ko akashwɛ nyɛ.
Shi kɛ nilee he ehia nyɛteŋ mɔ ko lɛ, ekpa Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa mɛi fɛɛ fa ni ewieee mɔ ko hiɛ lɛ fai, ni aaahã lɛ.
Shi ekpa fai yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni ekaje nɔ ko nɔ ko he ŋwane; ejaakɛ ŋwanejelɔ lɛ etamɔ ŋshɔke ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa kɛyaa kɛbaa.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbɔmɔ ko akasusu akɛ eeena nɔ ko yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ;
jwɛŋmɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛ ko fii shi yɛ egbɛ ko gbɛ ko nɔ.
Nyɛmi ni ji humi lɛ ashwã yɛ enɔwomɔ lɛ mli,
shi niiatsɛ lɛ eshwã yɛ eshibaa lɛ mli; ejaakɛ ebaaho eya tamɔ jwɛiaŋ fɔfɔi.
Ejaakɛ hulu teɔ shi kɛ jeŋ dɔlɛ, ni eŋlãa jwɛi lɛ, ni efɔfɔi lɛ kplaa shwieɔ shi, ni efɛo lɛ fiteɔ; nakai nɔŋŋ niiatsɛ lɛ hu hiɛ baakpãtã yɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni miaa ehiɛ yɛ kaa mli lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ aka lɛ ni esa lɛ, eeena wala akekre ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ewo mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ.
Kɛji aaka mɔ ko lɛ, ekakɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ miika mi," ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akaaa lɛ ni efeee efɔŋ hu, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ekaaa mɔ ko.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɔnɔ ni gblaa lɛ ni lakaa lɛ lɛ kaa lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ akɔnɔ lɛ, kɛ eŋɔ hɔ lɛ, efɔɔ esha, ni esha lɛ hu, kɛ eda egbe naa lɛ, efɔɔ gbele.
Nyɛkahãa alakaa nyɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ.
Dromɔnii kpakpai fɛɛ kɛ nikeenii ni hi kɛwula shi fɛɛ lɛ; ŋwɛi ejɛɔ ekplekeɔ shi, kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi lai a-Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, mɔ mli ni tsakemɔ loo duŋ ni tsakemɔ kɛbaa bɛ lɛ.
Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔ naa ekɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ fɔ wɔ, koni wɔfee tamɔ enibɔɔnii lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii.
No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he afee oya kɛ ninumɔ; ehumi shi kɛ wiemɔ; ehumi shi kɛ mlifu.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ tsuuu Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛnii.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛshɛrɛa nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ kɛ efɔŋ ni afeɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea, ni nyɛkɛ heshibaa aherea wiemɔ lɛ ni atɛo yɛ nyɛmli ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛaahere nyɛsusumai ayiwala lɛ.
Shi nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa wieɔ lɛ nɔyelɔi, shi jeee wiemɔ lɛ nulɔi kɛkɛ, ni nyɛkɛmiishishiu nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe.
Ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko ji wiemɔ lɛ nulɔ kɛkɛ shi ejeee enɔyelɔ hu lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni kwɛɔ ehiɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni kwɛɔ ehiɛ su lɛ yɛ ashishwɛ mli;
ejaakɛ ekwɛɔ ehe, ni eyaa; shi amrɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ehiɛ kpaa bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi mɔ ni kwɛɔ heyeli mla ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ fitsofitso ni ekãa he efeɔ ni ejeee mɔ ni nuɔ ni ehiɛ kpaa nɔ, shi moŋ etsuɔ he nii lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ yɛ efeemɔ lɛ mli.
Shi kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni ewooo elilɛi manyoflɛ, shi moŋ eshishiuɔ ehe lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ jamɔ lɛ, yaka ni.
Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ ni he tse ni ehe bɛ muji ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, hiɛ ji enɛ, akɛ mɔ asra awusai kɛ okulafoi yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ mli, ni ekwɛ ehe nɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli koni ekawo ehe muji.
2: Minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkɛ mɛi ahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ aŋkahiɛa wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo ni ji anumnyam Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji nuu ko ni wo shika ga kɛ atade fɛɛfɛo babote nyɛkpeehe lɛ, ni ohiafo ko hu ni wo ataade taŋtaŋ babote mli,
ni nyɛhiɛ sɔ mɔ ni wo ataade fɛɛfɛo lɛ ni nyɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Baata he kpakpa nɛɛ," ni ohiafo lɛ, lɛ nyɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo lɛ damɔ jɛi aloo baata minaji anaa yɛ biɛ" lɛ,
ani jeee niiaŋ nyɛjieɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni kojolɔi ni hiɛ jwɛŋmɔi fɔ̃ɔji nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ lɛ?
Minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ, nyɛboa toi! Ani jeee je nɛɛ mli ohiafoi ni ji niiatsɛmɛi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli gbɛfaŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehala, koni maŋtsɛyeli ni ewo mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ?
Ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛshwieɔ ohiafo lɛ hiɛ shi. Ani jeee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ yeɔ nyɛnɔ waa, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛgblaa nyɛ kɛyaa kojomɔhei lɛ?
Ani jeee amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛwieɔ gbɛi kpakpa ni akɛtsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ he efɔŋ lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ kɛji nyɛye kitã ni ji Mla lɛ mli otu ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ" nɔ yɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmiifee jogbaŋŋ.
Shi kɛji mɛi ahiɛiaŋ nyɛkwɛɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmiifee esha, ni Mla lɛ kãa nyɛ akɛ mlatɔ̃lɔi.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni aaaye Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ tete, shi eeetɔ̃ yɛ ekome mli lɛ, eye fɔ yɛ fɛɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ, "Kaafite gblã" lɛ, ekɛɛ hu akɛ, "kaagbe gbɔmɔ." Ni kɛ ofiteee gblã shi ogbeɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, otsɔ̃ mlatɔ̃lɔ.
Nyɛwiea ni nyɛfea nyɛnii akɛ mɛi ni heyeli mla akɛbaakojo amɛ.
Ejaakɛ kojomɔ mli lɛ, mɔ ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ anaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; mɔbɔnalɛ yeɔ kojomɔ nɔ kunim ni eshwãa.
Minyɛmimɛi, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ eyɛ hemɔkɛyeli, shi ebɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ mli? Ani hemɔkɛyeli lɛ aaanyɛ eyiwala ahere?
Kɛji nyɛminuu ko loo nyɛmiyoo ko nyiɛ yayai ni enaaa edaaŋŋmaa,
ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, nyɛyawerea la, ni nyɛyayea nii nyɛtrɔa;" shi ehãaa amɛ nii ni hīaa gbɔmɔtso lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he?
Nakai nɔŋŋ hemɔkɛyeli hu kɛ nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ, eji hemɔkɛyeli ni egbo.
Shi mɔ ko aaakɛɛ, "Bo lɛ, oyɛ hemɔkɛyeli, ni mi lɛ, miyɛ nitsumɔi." Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi ohemɔkɛyeli ni nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ ni mi hu majɛ minitsumɔi lɛ amli matsɔ̃ɔ o mihemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Bo lɛ oheɔ oyeɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔ kome ni? Ofee jogbaŋŋ; mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji hu heɔ yeɔ ni amɛhe kpokpoɔ.
Ao, yaka gbɔmɔ, Ootao ole akɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni egbo ni lo?
Wɔtsɛ Abraham lɛ, ani jeee nitsumɔi amli ajɛ abu lɛ bem be ni ekɛ ebi Isak yaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Oona akɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ enitsumɔi lɛ nyiɛ ni nitsumɔi lɛ amli ejɛ ni ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ ye emuu lɛ.
Ni ŋmalɛ lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Shi Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ" lɛ ba mli, ni atsɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shieŋtsɛ.
Nyɛmiina akɛ nitsumɔi amli ajɛɔ abuɔ gbɔmɔ bem, shi jeee hemɔkɛyeli kɛkɛ mli.
Nakai nɔŋŋ Rahab, ajwamaŋ lɛ hu, ani jee nitsumɔi amli ajɛ abu lɛ bem beni ehere bɔfoi lɛ atuu ni ejie amɛ gbɛ kɛtsɔ gbɛ kroko nɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔtso ni mumɔ bɛ mli lɛ ji gbonyo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hemɔkɛyeli ni nitsumɔi bɛ he lɛ hu ji hemɔkɛyeli ni egbo.
3: Tsɔ̃ɔlɔi akafa yɛ nyɛteŋ, minyɛmimɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ wɔbaana kojomɔ ni mli wa fe mɛi Krokomɛi anɔ.
Ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ babaoo. Kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃ɔɔ yɛ wiemɔ mli lɛ, lɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ ni hi kɛwula shi ji lɛ, ni eyɛ hewalɛ akɛ ekɛaawo gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ manyoflɛ.
Shi kɛji wɔkɛ okpɔŋɔi amanyoflɛi wo amɛdaaŋ ni amɛbo wɔ toi lɛ fɛɛ.
Naa, lɛji hu tsɛ amɛdra aahuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa kplaa amɛ, ni shi kɛyaa he fɛɛ he ni kudɔɔtsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ lilɛi hu henɔ bibioo ni, shi eshwãanii wuji. Naa, la bibioo hu, nyɛkwɛa koo bɔ sɔŋŋ ni eshãa!
Ni lilɛi lɛ hu, la ni; wɔhenii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, lilɛi ji nishaianii ajeŋ muu; ni ebuleɔ gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ ni emaa fɔmɔŋ tsakpãa lɛ naa la, ni abosamiiaje enaa ela lɛ kɛjɛɔ.
Ejaakɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔli kɛ nii ni wamɔɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli lɛ ahenɔ fɛɛ henɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ nyɛɔ jɔɔ amɛhe, ni ejɔɔ amɛhe.
Shi lilɛi lɛ, gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko nyɛɛɛ ehe ajɔɔ; nɔ fɔŋ ni eflegeje ní eyi obɔ̃ kɛ ebɔɔ ní gbeɔ mɔ ni.
No nɔŋŋ wɔkɛjieɔ Nuŋtsɔ kɛ Tse lɛ yi, ni no nɔŋŋ hu wɔkɛlomɔɔ gbɔmɛi ni abɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ nɔ lɛ.
Daa kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ jɛɔ. Minyɛmimɛi, enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ, esaaa akɛ eba lɛ nakai.
Aso nubu yɔɔ nɛɛ, ebaa nuŋma kɛ nu ni joɔ kɛjɛɔ hiŋmɛi kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli?
Minyɛmimɛi, aso agbami tso aaanyɛ mutso yibii awo? Aloo waintso aaawo agbami? Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ ŋoobu nyɛŋ nu ŋma aba.
Namɔ ji nilelɔ kɛ sanesɛɛkɔlɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ? Ekɛ jeŋba kpakpa atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ nilee kpoofeemɔ mli.
Shi kɛ awuŋayeli fɔŋ kɛ bei yɛ nyɛtsui mli lɛ, nyɛkashwãa ni nyɛmalea nyɛhia anɔkwale lɛ.
Nɛkɛ nilee nɛɛ, jeee ŋwɛi ejɛ, shi moŋ shikpɔŋ nɔ nɔ ni, heloo naa nɔ ni, mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji anɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ he ni awuŋayeli kɛ bei yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi sakasakafeemɔ kɛ nishaianii fɛɛ yɔɔ.
Shi nilee ni ji ŋwɛi lɛ, Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ ehe tse, no sɛɛ lɛ ehe jɔ, ehiɛ kã shi, eboɔ toi, eyi obɔ̃ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ yibii kpakpai, ejieee niiaŋ, efeee osato.
Shi jalɛ yibii lɛ, hejɔlɛ mli aduɔ yɛ ahãa mɛi ni feɔ hejɔlɛnii lɛ.
4: Nɛɛgbɛɛ tawui kɛ nɔmɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ jɛ? Jeee nyɛkɔnɔi ni wuɔ ta yɛ nyɛhenii lɛ amli lɛ mli ejɛ lo?
Nyɛshweɔ nɔ ko, ni nyɛnaaa; nyɛgbeɔ mɛi ni nyɛyeɔ awuŋa, ni nyɛnine nyɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ashɛ; nyɛnɔɔ ni nyɛnine nyɔ̃ɛɛ nɔ ashɛ; nyɛnɔɔ ni nyɛwuɔ ta; nyɛnaaa nɔ ko ejaakɛ nyɛkpaaa he fai.
Nyɛkpaa he fai hu, ni nyɛnaaa, ejaakɛ fai fɔŋ nyɛkpaa, koni nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔkɔi lɛ akpãtã hiɛ.
Gblãfitelɔi! Nyɛleee akɛ naanyo ni akɛ jɛ lɛ bɔɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛɛ ni lo? No hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ ekɛ je lɛ abɔ naanyo lɛ etsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ henyɛlɔ.
Aloo nyɛsusuɔ akɛ yaka ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, "Hiɛkɔ̃ɔ sɛɛ mumɔ ni hiɔ wɔmli lɛ diɔ lɛ?"
"Shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekuɔ hewolɔi anaa, shi edroɔ heshibalɔi."
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa Nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ. Nyɛtsīa abonsam gbɛ ni eeejo nyɛnaa foi.
Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa Nyɔŋmɔ ni, ni eeetsi ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ. Nyɛtsuua nyɛniji ahe, nyɛ eshafeelɔi, ni nyɛhãa nyɛtsuii ahe atsea, nyɛ jwɛŋmɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛi.
Nyɛwerɛ ahoa nyɛhe ni nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛfoa. Nyɛŋmlɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli, ni nyɛmiishɛɛ hu atsɔ̃ gbliniifeemɔ.
Nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni eeewo nyɛnɔ.
Nyɛkawiewiea nyɛhe, anyɛmimɛi. Mɔ ni wieɔ enyɛmi he aloo ekojoɔ enyɛmi lɛ, Mla lɛ ewieɔ eshiɔ ni Mla lɛ ekojoɔ lɛ. Shi kɛ ookojo Mla lɛ, jeee Mla lɛ nɔyelɔ ji o, shi Mla lɛ kojolɔ moŋ ji o.
Mɔ kome ji mlawolɔ kɛ kojolɔ, mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛhereɔ mɔ yiwala ni ekɛkpãtã mɔ hiɛ hu lɛ. Shi bo lɛ, namɔ ji o ni okojoɔ onaanyo?
Agbɛnɛ nyɛ hu! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ loo wɔ wɔɔtee maŋ nɛɛ mli loo maŋ nɛɛ mli ni wɔyaye afi kome yɛ jɛi, ni wɔɔye jra, ni wɔɔa sɛɛ;"
tsɛ nyɛleee wɔ sane, mɛni ji nyɛwala lɛ? Eji lamɔ ni pueɔ be fioo ko, ni kɛ fee sɛɛ lɛ elaajeɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ sa moŋ akɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miisumɔ ni wɔyi ana wala lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔfee enɛ loo enɛ"
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛshwãa; nɛkɛ shwãa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ ni.
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni le ekpakpafeemɔ ni efeee lɛ, esha ji no hã lɛ.
5: Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ niiatsɛmɛi, nyɛfoa ni nyɛwɔa lele yɛ awerɛhoianii ni baaba nyɛnɔ lɛ ahewɔ!
Nyɛnii ni nyɛna lɛ eshra, ni nyɛtaadei lɛ hu omlɛ̃gɛ̃i eye.
Nyɛshika kɛ nyɛjwiɛtɛi lɛ edɔ ŋkanale, ni amɛhe ŋkanale lɛ aaaye odase ashi nyɛ, ni eeeye nyɛhewojiaŋ tamɔ lá. Nyɛbɔ jwetri yɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli.
Naa, nitsumɔi ni kpa nyɛŋmɔjiaŋnii lɛ anyɔmɔwo ni nyɛkɛhãaa amɛ lɛ miiblɔ, ni nikpalɔ lɛ ablɔmɔi lɛ ebabote tai a-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ toiiaŋ.
Nyɛye nyɛnaani yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbɔ ahoshwi. Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsuii ni ewo fɔ kɛhã gbee gbi lɛ.
Nyɛbu jalɔ lɛ fɔ, ni nyɛgbe lɛ, etsīii nyɛ gbɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛŋmɛa nyɛtsui shi kɛyashia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ. Naa, okwaafonyo lɛ mɛɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ nibaanii ni jra wa lɛ, ni eŋmɛɔ etsui shi yɛ he kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni enaa agbiɛnaa kɛ gbo nunɛmɔlɛ.
Nyɛ hu nyɛmɛa nyɛtsui shi, ni nyɛnaa hiɛnɔkamɔ ni nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ eshɛ etã.
Nyɛkadɔmɔa ŋtsɔi nyɛwowoa nyɛhe, anyɛmimɛi, koni akakojo nyɛ. Naa, kojolɔ lɛ damɔ shinaa lɛ naa.
Minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkɛ gbalɔi ni wie yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ afea amanehulu kɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ.
Naa, wɔbuɔ mɛi ni mīaa amɛhiɛ lɛ akɛ mɛi ni ajɔɔ mɛ. Nyɛnu Hiob hiɛmiamɔ lɛ he, kɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã enaagbee fee hã; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ babaoo, ni enaa mɔbɔ.
Shi titri lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛkakãa kitã, nyɛkakɛa akɛ "mina ŋwɛi" aloo "mina shikpɔŋ", aloo nyɛkã kitã kroko; shi nyɛ-"hɛɛ" lɛ afee "hɛɛ;", ni "dabi" lɛ afee "dabi", koni nyɛkagbee kojomɔ mli.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko miina amanehulu lo? Esɔle. Mɔ ko ena tsuijurɔ? Ela yijiemɔ lalai.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko nãaa hewalɛ? Etsɛ asafo lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli ni amɛsɔle amɛhã lɛ.
Ni sɔlemɔ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ aaahere helatsɛ lɛ yiwala, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi, ni kɛji efee esha lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛjajea nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃a nyɛhe, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛhe ata. Jalɔ sɔlemɔ ni mli wa lɛ nyɛɔ nii babaoo etsuɔ.
Elia ji gbɔmɔ adesa tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ, ni esɔle sɔlemɔ ko koni nu akanɛ, ni nu enɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔji epkaa sɔŋŋ.
Ni esaa esɔle, ni nu jɛ ŋwɛi shwie shi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ ba enii.
Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko du gbɛ kɛjɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli ni mɔ ko miikpale lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ,
ele akɛ mɔ ni kpaleɔ eshafeelɔ kɛjɛɔ egbɛduu mli lɛ eehere gbɛdulɔ lɛ susuma yiwala kɛjɛ gbele mli, ni eeha eshai pii anɔ.

1: Yeremia, Osɔfo Hilkia ni hi shi yɛ Anatot yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bi lɛ, wiemɔi nɛ:
Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia, Amon binuu lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.

Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim, Yosia inuu lɛ, yinɔ hu lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie ekoŋŋ kɛyashi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia, Yosia binuu lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ naagbee. Nakai afi lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ mli aŋɔ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ nom.
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Dani mibɔ bo yɛ onyɛ musuŋ beebe lɛ, mile o; ni dani afɔ bo lɛ, mifee bo krɔŋkrɔŋ momo, ni miwo bo gbalɔ mihã majimaji lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni mito he akɛ, "Ao! Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ! Naa, mileee wiemɔ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ̃ kɛkɛ ji mi."
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Gbekɛ kɛkɛ ji mi', shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni mibatsu bo lɛ, yaa, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mafã o akɛ owie lɛ, no ji nɔ ni owie.
Kaashe mɛi aŋɔɔ ni obaaya lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ, mikɛ bo yɛ koni mahere o. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpã enine mli, ni ekɛta minaabu he, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Naa, mikɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ewo onaa.
Ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, mihã bo hewalɛ yɛ maji lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyelii lɛ anɔ, koni ofãmɔ nii, ni okumɔ oshwie shi, koni okpãtã hiɛ, ni obutu, ni osaa otswa oma shi ni otɛo ekoŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi mi akɛ, "Yeremia mɛni onaa nɛɛ?" Mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Blɔfoŋkatiɛtso nine ni."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Anɔkwale ni, ejaakɛ miishi miwiemɔi lɛ ahe kpe bɔ ni afee ni mahã aba mli."
Yehowa kɛ mi wie nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni ebɔ mi akɛ, "Mɛni onaa lɛ?" Mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Miina kukwɛi ko ni emli nii miitswa. Kukwɛi lɛ hiɛ miikwɛ biɛgbɛ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Sane fɔŋ baajɛ kooyigbɛ aba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ anɔ.

Ejaakɛ naa, miitsɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji srɔtoi lɛ anɔ bii koni amɛba, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i aaama Yerusalem agboi lɛ anaa kɛ egbogboi lɛ ahe kɛkpe. Amɛbaatua Yuda maji wuji lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Mibagbla miwebii lɛ atoi yɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ hewɔ akɛni amɛkwa mi, ni amɛyashã tsofakɛŋmai amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji efee amãgãi, ni amɛja amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bo Yeremia miamɔ, tee shi koni oyakɛɛ amɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mibafã bo akɛ okɛɛ lɛ. Otsui akafã yɛ amɛhewɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mahã ojija yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Naa, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ mihã otsɔ̃ tamɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he, tamɔ dade akulashiŋ, tamɔ akɔɔble gbogbo koni okɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ elumɛi kɛ esɔfoi kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ana.
Amɛbaate shi amɛwo bo, shi amɛyeŋ onɔ kunim, ejaakɛ mikɛ bo yɛ koni mahere bo. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
2: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

"Yaa, koni oyashiɛ owo Yerusalembii atoiiaŋ, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mikaiɔ oblayeiaŋ anɔkwa ni oye mi lɛ, kɛ osuɔmɔ tamɔ ayɛmfro suɔmɔ lɛ. Mikaiɔ bɔ ni onyiɛ misɛɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni aduko nii yɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Israel hã Yehowa, eŋmãakpamɔ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni. Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaata ehe lɛ baaye sɔ̃. Ni sane fɔŋ baaye amɛ, Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.'"
Nyɛ Yakob shwiei, nyɛ Israel akutseiaŋ wekui, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ na yɛ mihe; hewɔ ni amɛtse amɛhe yɛ mihe kɛtee flɛŋŋ, ni amɛyadi yakayakanii asɛɛ ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃mɔ yakayakanii nɛɛ?

Amɛbiii akɛ, 'Nɛgbɛ Yehowa mɔ ni jie wɔ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɔ ni nyiɛ wɔhiɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, mɔ ni nyiɛ wɔhiɛ yɛ shiaŋa kɛ enɔ buibui lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ko ni nu bɛ nɔ ni enɔ ewo duŋ kpii, shikpɔŋ ko ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ kɛho, he ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ ahi lɛ?'
Mikɛ nyɛ ba shikpɔŋ ni baa nii nɔ koni nyɛye enɔ ŋmãa ke enɔ nibii kpakpai lɛ. Shi be ni nyɛbashɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛbule mishikpɔŋ lɛ, ni nyɛhã migboshinii lɛ tsɔ̃ musubɔɔnii.
Osɔfoi lɛ po biii akɛ, 'Nɛgbɛ Yehowa yɔɔ?' Mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi mla lɛ tete leee mi; maŋnɔyelɔi lɛ tɔ̃ minɔ, ni gbalɔi lɛ gba yɛ Baal hewalɛ naa; ni amɛyadi nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ lɛ asɛɛ."
"Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ lɛ mi, Yehowa, mikɛ nyɛ yɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛbii abii hu baatao naa.
Nyɛfoa mli kɛyaa Kipro ŋshɔnaa maji amli nyɛyakwɛa, aloo nyɛtsua kɛyaa Kedur hu, ni nyɛyatao mli fitsofitso nyɛkwɛa akɛ nɛkɛ sane ko eba jɛi dã lo?
Ani maŋ ko yɛ ni etsake enyɔŋmɔi pɛŋ? Tsɛbelɛ nakai nyɔŋmɔi lɛ jeee fɛifɛi! Shi miwebii lɛ kɛ amɛnumnyam lɛ etsake nii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Ao! Ŋwɛi, onaa akpɛ ohe yɛ enɛ hewɔ; ŋmiŋmi amɔ o, ni ohe ajɔ̃ ohe babaoo, Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ miwebii lɛ efee nifɔ̃ɔjianii srɔtoi enyɔ: amɛkwa mi, mi, ni maji wala nu fɛɛ jɛɛhe lɛ; ni amɛyakpɛkpɛɛ nubui amɛhã amɛhe, nubui ni ejwra ni nyɛɛɛ nu ato."
"Ani Israel lɛ, nyɔŋ ni? Ani nyɔŋ bi ni afɔ yɛ enuŋtsɔ we ni lo? Mɛɛba mɔ ni etsɔ̃ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ milɛ loo nɛɛ?
Jatai blɔ wo lɛ; amɛblɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ. Amɛkpãtã eshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, emaji lɛ kamɔ shi amaŋfɔ̃i ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli.
Asaŋ Memfis kɛ Tahpanhes hii lɛ ejwa opampam.
Israel, aso jeee bo diɛŋtsɛ oyatao nɛkɛ sane ohã ohe akɛ okwa Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, be mli ni ekplaa bo yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ni agbɛnɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ obaana kɛ Egipt ni oyaa koni oyanu Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ eko lɛ? Loo mɛɛ sɛɛ obaana kɛ Asiria ni oyaa koni oyanu Eufrate Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ eko lɛ?

Bo diɛŋtsɛ onifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ baagbla otoi, ni kwamɔ ni okwa mi lɛ baabu bo fɔ. Na ole, ni oyoo akɛ kwamɔ ni okwa mi, Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ ni, ni ebaajoo ehã bo. Mihe gbeyeishemɔ bɛ omli. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ."

"Blema ko beebe ni oku opã lɛ, ni otserɛ kpãi ni fimɔ bo lɛ mli, ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Misɔ̃mɔɔɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko!' Shi gɔ̃ŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔ yiteŋ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi oyakotoɔ shi ojaa, ni okwaa mi yɛ.
Mitɛo bo akɛ wain tso kpakpa ni jɛ wu kpakpa mli. Shi te fee tɛŋŋ ni ofite otsɔ̃ kooŋ wain tso kwraa nɛɛ?
Kɛji oju ohe ni osha ohe kɛ samla ni naa wa akɛ mɛ tete, mibana otɔ̃mɔ lɛ ni ekadi ohe kɛ̃. Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɛ.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ, 'Mibuleko mihe, miyajako wɔŋ Baal lɛ? kwɛmɔ ojeŋ ni oba yɛ gɔji ateŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ni ooona ole nɔ ni ofee. Otamɔ ŋaŋ yoma oblayoo ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiya biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Otamɔ ŋaŋ teji yoo ni ele ŋaŋɔhilɛ, ni miifu kɔɔyɔɔ mli kɛmitao nuu. Namɔ baanyɛ ekɔnɔ naa etsi? Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni miitao lɛ ni etɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛji etsuiasɛɛyaa be shɛ pɛ mɛi anine shɛɔ enɔ.
Israel, kwɛmɔ koni okahiɛ onane flo, asaŋ koni osɛ̃ŋ akagbi kɛ kumai. Shi okɛɛ akɛ, 'Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko bɛ? Ejaakɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi misumɔɔ, ni amɛsɛɛ manyiɛ.'"
'Bɔ ni kɛji amɔ julɔ ni ehiɛ gboɔ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii ahiɛ baagbo, maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ amɛlumɛi kɛ amɛsɔfoi kɛ amɛgbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ,

mɛi ni kɛɔ tso akɛ, 'Mitsɛ ji o' kɛ mɛi hu ni kɛɔ tɛ akɛ, 'Bo ofɔ mi' lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baagbo, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ, shi jeee amɛhiɛ amɛhã mi. Shi amɛfimɔ be mli lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Tee shi, ni ohere wɔyiwala.'
"Shi Yuda, nɛɛgbɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni ofee ohã ohe lɛ yɔɔ? Amɛte shi akɛ amɛaanyɛ oyiwala amɛhere yɛ ofimɔ be lɛ mli lo? Ao! Yuda, te nyɔŋmɔi ni oyɔɔ lɛ ayifalɛ tamɔ maji ni oyɔɔ lɛ ayibɔ nɔŋŋ?
Mɛɛba mɔ nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ mi lɛ? Nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛtse mihiɛ atūa." Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yakatswaa po ni mitswia nyɛbii lɛ anii lɛ ejaakɛ no tsakeee amɛ. Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛdɛŋ klaŋte ni gbegbee nyɛgbalɔi lɛ tamɔ jata kakawua ni kpatãa nii ahiɛ.
Nyɛ, yinɔ nɛɛ nɔ bii, nyɛjwɛŋa Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ ahe. Ani mitsɔ̃ ŋanɔ mihã Israelbii lo; loo shikpɔŋ ni enɔ ewo duŋ kpii? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ, ni miwebii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, "Wɔye wɔhe; wɔbaaa oŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ?"
Ani oblayoo hiɛ kpaa ehewulamɔnii anɔ, ani ayɛmfro hiɛ kpaa ekpeemɔ atade nɔ? Shi mi lɛ miwebii lɛ ahiɛ ekpa minɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ.
Anɔkwa, ole gbɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ ni nine shɛɔ suɔlɔ nɔ, no hewɔ lɛ yei fɔ̃ɔji tete po ekase nii kɛjɛ odɛŋ.
Ohiafoi ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ alá yɛ otade namui lɛ amli, jeee nififiaŋ mina enɛ yɛ shi moŋ, he fɛɛ he; ni
okɛɔ akɛ, "Mifeko efɔŋ ko. Eji anɔkwale akɛ Yehowa efo emli ni fu mi lɛ sɛɛ." Shi naa, mi Yehowa, mibagbla otoi yɛ kɛɛmɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, "Mifeko esha ko lɛ hewɔ."
Mɛɛba ni olilaa shi sɔŋŋ nɛkɛ, ni otsakeɔ onane nakai? Egipt baahã ohiɛ agbo tamɔ bɔ ni Asiria hã ohiɛ gbo lɛ.
Obaajɛ Egipt oba ni oniji jwere oyiteŋ kɛ awerɛhoo, ejaakɛ jwere oyiteŋ kɛ awerɛhoo, ejaakɛ mɛi ni ohiɛ kã amɛnɔ lɛ, Yehowa ekwa amɛ, ni nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ ni obaana yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
3: Mi, mibi akɛ, "Kɛji nuu ko shwie eŋa, ni yoo lɛ shi nuu lɛ, ni eyatsɔ̃ muu kroko ŋa lɛ, ani nuu lɛ kuɔ esɛɛ eyaŋɔɔ nakai yoo lɛ ekoŋŋ? Nɔ ko ni tamo nɛkɛ lɛ ebuleɔ shikpɔŋ, nɔ ni mimɛi lɛ yɔɔ nɔ lɛ. Israel te okɛ shieŋtsɛmɛi babaoo eyabɔ ajwamaŋ, ni ooku osɛɛ oba miŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ?

Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni yɔɔ kpataa lɛ. Te amɛteŋ he ni akɛ bo ebɔko ajwamaŋ yɛ lɛ? Otaa gbɛi atoii omɛɔ shieŋtsɛmɛi tamɔ Arabianyo woɔ ka yɛ shiaŋa mli kɛmɛɔ gbɛnyiɛlɔ. Okɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ ni naa wa ebule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ ni atsi nunɛmɔ naa; ni gbo nu enɛɛɛ nɛɛ; shi ohiɛ yoo ajwamaŋ hiŋmɛi lolo; ni ohiɛ gbooo he.
"Ani otsɛko mi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ, 'Mitsɛ Ataa, boji mitsɛ kɛjɛ migbɛkɛbiiashi,
omli fuŋ mi kɛyaŋ naanɔ, ni obɛŋ mi owoŋ omli kɛyaŋ naanɔ?' Israel, nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ofee nɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni obaanyɛ ofee."
Yehowa bi mi yɛ Maŋtsɛ Yosia yinɔ akɛ, "Bɛ ona nɔ ni Israel ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ fee lɛ? No ji bɔ ni etee gɔ̃ŋ fɛɛ gɔ̃ŋ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi eyabɔ ajwamaŋ yɛ jɛi lɛ?
Mi, misusu akɛ kɛji efee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ tete sɛɛ lɛ, ebaaku esɛɛ eba miŋɔɔ; shi ebaaa; ni enyɛmiyoo Yuda hu ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ na nɔ ni Israel fee lɛ.
Ena akɛ ajwamaŋ ni Israel ni yeee anɔkwa bɔ hewɔ lɛ mishwie lɛ akɛ miŋa. Shi kɛ̃lɛ Israel nyɛmiyoo Yuda ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ, eyasheee gbeyei; shi moŋ lɛ hu etee ni eyabɔ ajwamaŋ lɛ eko.
Shi akɛni ajwamaŋbɔɔ efeee lɛ hiɛgble hewɔ lɛ ekɛ tsei kɛ tɛi fɛɛ fite gblã, ni ebule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ni yɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yuda, Israel nyɛmiyoo ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ, kpaleee kɛbaaa miŋɔɔ kɛ etsui fɛɛ, shi moŋ kwa ekwa eba miŋɔɔ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Israel ni yeee ewu anɔkwa po etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ yɛ mlɛo fe Yuda nɔ lɛ.

Yaa koyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni oyashiɛ yɛ jɛi, ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Israel ni yeee ewu anɔkwa, kpalemɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ! Mituŋ mihiɛ miwoŋ nyɛ ejaakɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ji mi. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ. Mibɛŋ nyɛ miwoŋ mimli kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
Kplɛ̃mɔ otɔ̃mɔi lɛ anɔ kɛkɛ akɛ oyakpa shi yɛ heihei kɛnyiɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi asɛɛ yɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi, ni asaŋ obooo mi toi. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

Ao! Nyɛ bii ni yeee anɔkwa, nyɛkpalea nyɛbaa, ejaakɛ miji nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ; ni nyɛmaŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli lɛ maŋɔ gbɔmɔ kome, ni weku fɛɛ weku mli lɛ maŋɔ gbɔmɛi enyɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ baaba Yerusalem. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Ni mahã nyɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitsui naa nɔkwɛlɔi. Amɛbaalɛ nyɛ kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ nakai be mli, be ni nyɛfɔfɔi, ni nyɛyi efa pii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, awieŋ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he dɔŋŋ; ajwɛŋ ehe lɛ, akaiŋ lɛ ni ataoŋ lɛ, ni akpɛŋ ekroko dɔŋŋ.
