Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ abaatsɛ Yerusalem akɛ Yehowa Maŋtsɛ Sɛ̃i, ni majimaji bluublu aaabua amɛhe naa kɛaaba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Yerusalem amɛbaja mi. Amɛ kɛ kuɛntilɛ efeŋ nɔ ni amɛtsui fɔŋ kɛɔ amɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Yuda akutso lɛ baaya ayafata Israel akutso lɛ he ni amɛaajɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kutuu kɛaaba shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ amɛgboshi nii lɛ nɔ.'"
"Misusu he bɔ ni maŋɔ bo mashi mibii anɔ, ni mahã bo shikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo gboshinii ko ni yɔɔ fɛo fe majimaji fɛɛ anɔ. Ni efee mi akɛ oootsɛ mi akɛ, "Mitsɛ Ataa," ni okpaleŋ yɛ misɛɛ dɔŋŋ;
shi bɔ ni yoo ni yeee ewu anɔkwa jeɔ ewu sɛɛ lɛ, Ao! Israel, nakai oyeko mi anɔkwa. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Anu gbee ko gbɛɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpatai lɛ anɔ. Israelbii ayaafo kɛ faikpamɔ ni, ejaakɛ amɛba amɛjeŋ gbonyo, ni amɛhiɛ ekpa Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ.
"Ao! Bii ni yeee anɔkwa nyɛkpalea nyɛbaa! Matsa anɔkwa ni nyɛyeee hela lɛ." Nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, wɔmiiba oŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ boji Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Eji anɔkwa akɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ jamɔ hoo lɛ lakamɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni. Anɔkwa, Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ edɛŋ Israel yiwalaheremɔ yɔɔ.
Shi kɛjɛ wɔblahiiaŋ beebe lɛ nakai hiɛgbejianii, ni ji Baal jamɔ lɛ, eye wɔdɛŋnii fɛɛ ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gbo he deŋme: amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ.

Nyɛhãa wɔhiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ aha wɔnɔ tamɔ mama, ejaakɛ wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛjɛ wɔblahiiaŋ aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔfee esha wɔshi Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni wɔboko Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee toi."
4: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Israel, kɛji ooku osɛɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ lɛ, ba! Kɛji ojie omusubɔɔ nibii lɛ kɛje mihiɛ, ni oshashaooo shi,
ni kɛji okã kitã akɛ, 'Mina Yehowa' kɛ onɔkwale fɛɛ, ni okojo yɛ jalɛ naa, ni ohi shi krɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ jeŋ maji lɛ aaayɔse amɛjɔɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa mli, ni amɛaajie mi, Yehowa, miyi."
Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli bii nɛ, "Nyɛhua nyɛshikpɔŋ ni ahuko nɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkadua nyɛwui lɛ yɛ ŋmei ateŋ.

Nyɛjiea nyɛtsuii amli muji lɛ nyɛshwiea tamɔ afoɔ kɛtia kɛjieɔ foo koni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ahã Yehowa. Nyɛ Yudahii kɛ nyɛ Yerusalembii, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mimlila lɛ baanina nyɛ tamɔ la yɛ nyɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ, ni ebaashã nii, mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe."
Akɛɛ yɛ Yuda, ni ashiɛ yɛ Yerusalem hu akɛ, "Akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ shipkɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, Abɔ oshe waa akɛ, 'Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛhãa wɔyaa maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli!'
Nyɛhãa aflaŋaa atsɔ̃a nyɛ Zion gbɛ, nyɛjoa foi, nyɛyabaa abo! Nyɛkashashaoa shi, ejaakɛ miihã sane fɔŋ ajɛ kooyigbɛ aba abakpãtã nyɛhiɛ wɛɛ.
Jata ko efã kpo kɛjɛ ekoowie mli kɛmiiba, maji ahiɛkpãtãlɔ ko efã kɛmiiba; Eshi eshihilɛhe lɛ kɛmiiba ni ebaakpãtã nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, koni nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, hei ni gbɔmɛi ehiŋ dɔŋŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmiaa kɛ kpekpe nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ, ni nyɛwoa yara, ejaakɛ Yehowa efoko emli ni fu wɔ waa lɛ sɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ekãafeemɔ baaŋmɛɛ maŋtsɛ kɛ lumɛi; osɔfoi lɛ ahe baajɔ̃ amɛhe, ni gbalɔi ahiɛ baafee amɛ yaa."
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ lakamɔ olaka gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ Yerusalembii fɛɛ? Ejaakɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛbaana toiŋjɔlɛ; no moŋ ji klaŋte ni akɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ nɛɛ?'"

Be miiba be ni abaakɛɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ Yerusalembii fɛɛ akɛ, "Kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni mli edɔ la efã kɛjɛ shiaŋa kɛ gɔji kɛ amɛyiteiaŋ kplanai lɛ anɔ; eeba abashwie miwebii lɛ anɔ. Eeba koni ebasha ŋmaa mli tutuu eshwie koni ŋmaa lɛ he atse.
Kɔɔyɔɔ ni baaba ahã mi lɛ naa wa kwraa fe enɛ. Agbɛnɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ji mɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni abaagbla amɛtoi ahã nɛɛ."
Naa, henyɛlɔ lɛ efã kɛmiiba tamɔ atatu; etayaa shwiilii lɛ tamɔ lasuogbele; ni ekpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe yɛ oya fe okropɔŋ. Kpoo hã wɔ. Wɔhiɛ ekpãtã!
Ao! Yerusalem, fɔ otsuiŋ nishaianii lɛ oshwie, bɔ ni afee ni ahere oyiwala. Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po susumɔ fɔ̃ɔji aaahi oyiŋ kɛyashi?
Gbee ko miigbɛɛ waa kɛjɛ Dan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eekɛɛ akɛ sane fɔŋ ko miijɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ aba.
Akɛɛ maji lɛ akɛ henyɛlɔ miiba; asaŋ akɛɛ Yerusalem akɛ mɛi jɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ amɛbasa eyi. Henyɛlɔi nɛɛ baablɔ amɛwo Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ayi.
Amɛbaabɔle Yerusalem he kɛkpe tamɔ ŋmɔ he bulɔi, ejaakɛ Yerusalem tse mihiɛ atūa.
Yuda, ojeŋba kɛ onifeemɔnii ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ sane eba onɔ nɛɛ. Ohiɛkpãtãmɔ nɛ, ni eejoo pam, ni eetsu otsui mli.
Miigbo! Miigbo! Miigbo kɛ ŋkɔmɔ! Ao! Mitsui miiwa mihe, mitsui miitswa kplakpla! Minyɛɛɛ dioo mafee, ejaakɛ miinu tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ ta oshebɔɔ.
Amanehulu nyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ tuuŋtu, akpãtã shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ hiɛ; afite mibuui lɛ trukaa, ni hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ agbla mibuui lɛ ahe mamai lɛ.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ makã he mana ta aflaŋaa, ni manu tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛyashi?
Ejaakɛ kwashiai ji miwebii lɛ amɛleee nii; bii kwashiai ji amɛ, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ. Amɛhe esa kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ shi ekpakpafeemɔ ebɔ amɛ.
Mikwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, naa, ekã shi olɛŋlɛ; ni efee floŋŋ; ni mikwɛ ŋwɛi hu lɛ, la ko bɛ jɛi.
Mikwɛ gɔji lɛ, naa, amɛmiihoso, ni gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ miitsi kɛmiiya kɛmiiba.
Mikwɛ, ni naa, gbɔmɔ komeflo nɛkɛ bɛ he ko he ko; ni loofɔji buublu efliki kɛtee.
Mikwɛ, ni naa, shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ etsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni enɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, yɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ; "Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ moŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mifiteŋ lɛ butuu kɛgbeŋ naa.
Ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni ŋwɛi baadi tūu, ejaakɛ mi, mina mikɛɛ, ni mito miyiŋ momo. Mishwaŋ mihe, ni mikpaleŋ miyiŋtoo lɛ hu.
Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ joɔ foi kɛji anu okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ gãitsɛ̃lɔi ahe; amɛboteɔ koowieiaŋ amɛkwɔlɔɔ tɛsai, ajoɔ foi ashiɔ majiaŋ ashwieɔ shi, ni ashiii gbɔmɔ kome nɛkɛ yɛ amɛmli.
Ao! Yerusalem ni oyi etɔ̃, Mɛɛba moŋ ni owula kɛ mama tsuru kɛ shika jwine ni oflɔ ohiŋmɛii asɛɛ? Yakatswaa ofeɔ ohe fɛɛfɛo lɛ. Osuɔlɔi lɛ ekwa bo, ni amɛmiitao bo amɛgbe.
Ejaakɛ minu yoo ni miikɔ̃mɔ he. Kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ ekromɔbi kɔ̃ɔmɔ. Yerusalem ni tsui miisu lɛ gbee ni; ni ekpã enijiaŋ eebo akɛ, 'Kpoo hã mi! Miinyɔ yɛ mɛi ni gbeɔ mi ahiɛ.'"
5: Nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ, koni nyɛkadi nɔ ni nyɛbaana. Nyɛtaoa yɛ Yerusalem blohuiaŋ akɛ nyɛaana mɔ ko ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ni taoɔ akɛ eye anɔkwa lo? Keji nyɛaana lɛ, no lɛ mikɛYerusalem he aaafa lɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Wɔna Yehowa" shi amale kitã amɛkãa lɛ.
Ao, Yehowa, aso jeee anɔkwayeli gbɛ okwɛɔ kɛjɛ amɛdɛŋ? Otswia amɛ nii, shi ewaaa amɛhe. Oplenee amɛ, shi amɛkɛkaseee nii. Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui moŋ fe kūatɛ, ni amɛmiii tsuitsakemɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Gbɔmɛi ni bɛ gbɛi nɛ: no hewɔ lɛ amɛleee nii; ejaakɛ amɛleee bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ aba ejeŋ ehã; amɛleee amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ.

Maya gbɔmɛi wuji lɛ aŋɔɔ koni mikɛ amɛ ayawie; ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛle jeŋba gbɛ ni Yehowa kpaa, ni ji amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ." Shi amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛkwa Yehowa nɔyeli lɛ. amɛtserɛ nɔyeli kpãi ni fimɔ amɛ lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ jata ko aaafã kɛaajɛ koo lɛ mli ebagbe amɛ; Klaŋ ko aaajɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ aba ni ebakpãtã amɛhiɛ. Mlaŋtswi ko ewo ka yɛ amɛmaji lɛ ahe; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ amɛmli aje kpo lɛ, eeetserɛ emli; ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa tsɔ̃, kwamɔ ni amɛkwa mi lɛ naa wa.
"Te aaafee tɛŋŋ manyɛ mikɛfa bo hu? Obii lɛ kwa mi, ni amɛtsɛɔ nibii ni jeee nyɔŋmɔi amɛkɛkãa kitã. Kɛji mihã amɛ nii amɛye ni amɛtrɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛje mi, amɛwu lɛ, sɛɛ amɛtee ajwamaŋi awe.
Okpɔŋɔhii ni alɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ ni, ni eko fɛɛ eko blɔɔ kɛnyiɛɔ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, 'Mikagbla amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ ni mikɛtɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ nɔ lo?'
"Abote ewain tromii lɛ amli ni aflɔ waintsei lɛ ashwie, shi moŋ akafite tromii lɛ kwraa kɛmɔ shi. Akplɔ etsei aniji lɛ ashwie. Ejaakɛ amɛjeee mi, Yehowa, minii.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ fɛɛ yeee mi anɔkwa kwrakwra, Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa webii lɛ emale yɛ Yehowa he, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Efeŋ wɔ nɔ ko; nɔ fɔŋ ko baŋ wɔnɔ; ta ko ebaninaŋ wɔ, ni wɔyeŋ hɔmɔ hu.
Gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔ baatsɔ̃ kɔɔyɔɔ, ejaakɛ jeee Yehowa naa wiemɔi amɛwie lɛ. Bɔ ni abaafee amɛ nɛ!"
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Akɛni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ewie wiemɔi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa Yeremia, miihã miwiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ la yɛ odaaŋ, ni maŋbii lɛ baatsɔ̃ lai, ni la lɛ baashã amɛ wɛɛ.
"Nyɛ Israelbii, naa, miihã maŋ ko ajɛ shɔŋŋ aba koni ebatua nyɛ. Eji blema maŋ, ni ehe wa naakpa; maŋ ko ni nyɛnuuu ewiemɔ, ni kɛji awie tete lɛ nyɛnuuu shishi. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Amɛgãimlibii akotoku lɛ tamɔ gbonyobu ni naa kã. Hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ji amɛ,

ni amɛbaaye nyɛŋmɔshinii ni nyɛkpa kɛ niyenii fɛɛ, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ amɛye; amɛbaagbegbee nyɛtoi kɛ tsinai amɛye, ni amɛbaaye nyɛwaintsei kɛ agbãmitsei ayibii fɛɛ; ni nyɛmaji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe ni nyɛhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ, amɛbaafite fɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Shi kɛ̃lɛ nakai be lɛ mli po lɛ, mikpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ kɛwulaŋ shi.

Ni, Yeremia, kɛji omaŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, ni mɛni hewɔ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ye wɔ nɛkɛ sane? lɛ, okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkwa mi, Yehowa, ni nyɛyaja maŋsɛɛbii anyɔŋmɔi yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nyɛbaaya nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ maŋsɛɛbii yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ejeee nyɛnɔ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛa Yakob shwiei lɛ, ni nyɛkɛa Yuda shwiei lɛ hu akɛ,
nyɛboa enɛ toi koo! Kwashiai ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni nyɛyɔɔ hiŋmɛii shi nyɛnaaa nii, asaŋ nyɛyɔɔ toii hu shi nyɛnuuu nii.

Ani nyɛsheee mi gbeyei; nyɛhe kpokpooo yɛ mi, mihiɛ? Mi, ni mikɛ shia fo husu mikɛsa ŋshɔ naa, naanɔ husu ko ni ŋshɔ nyɛŋ eteke kɔkɔɔkɔ, husu ko ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ŋshɔkei aaashimɔ lɛ ahã lɛ, amɛnyɛŋ amɛwule lɛ, ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ŋshɔ aaafee hamahama ahã lɛ enyɛŋ lɛ eteke lɛ?
Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akuɛŋ ti, ni atuatselɔi ni; amɛgba afã, ni amɛshi mi amɛtee.
Amɛkɛɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, 'Nyɛhãa wɔshea Yehowa, wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei, lɛ mɔ ni ehãa nu nɛɔ gbo kɛ agbiɛnaa yɛ ebe mli hãa wɔ lɛ, ni ehãa nikpamɔ bei baninaa wɔ lɛ.'
Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ehã enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eŋmɛɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛhe eshai lɛ ehã nɔ kpakpa ebɔ nyɛ.
"Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ; amɛwoɔ gbɔmɛi ka tamɔ looflɔdulɔi woɔ antɛo lɛ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔnei amɛkɛduɔ gbɔmɛi.
Amɛshīai amli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ mɔshishiumɔ tamɔ looflɔtsu ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ loofɔji. No hewɔ lɛ amɛna nii, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi wuji,
amɛshwishwii, ni amɛhewolo hiɛ kpɛlɛɔ; amɛyeɔ sane fɔŋ hoɔ he, ni amɛkojooo yɛ jalɛ naa amɛhãaa awusa, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã lɛ; amɛfãaa ohiafo gbɛnaa he amɛhãaa lɛ hu.
"Mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, 'Mikagbla amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ, ni mikatɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lo?
Afee naakpɛɛnii kɛ gbeyeinii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Gbalɔi lɛ gbaa amale gbalɛi, ni nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ osɔfoi lɛ no osɔfoi lɛ feɔ, ni nɔ ni afeɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ mimaŋbii lɛ hu anaa. Shi kɛji naagbee be lɛ shɛ lɛ, te nyɛbaafee tɛŋŋ?'"
6: Ao! Nyɛ Benyaminbii, nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Yerusalem ni nyɛhere nyɛyiwala. Akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ Tekoa, nyɛkɛ lasu pukɔŋŋ atoa okadi yɛ Bet-Hakerem, ejaakɛ sane fɔŋ ni ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ kpeteŋkple miibu tamɔ oblɔtu kɛmiijɛ kooyigbɛ kɛmiiba.
Mibakpãtã Zion maŋ Yerusalem ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni ehe yɔɔ akɔnɔ lɛ hu hiɛ.
Lumɛi kɛ amɛwebii baaba abatua lɛ; amɛbashishii amɛbuui kɛbɔle Yerusalem kpula, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baato eniyenii he ni esumɔɔ.

Amɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhoa ta nyɛwoa lɛ; nyɛtea shi koni wɔfãa ta lɛ kɛyatua lɛ shwane!" Shi amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, "Kpoo hã wɔ kɛji wɔtee benɛ ejaakɛ je miina, ni hiɛ miibu ni gbɛkɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ elɛɛ shi kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Belɛ nyɛhãa wɔtea shi, ni wɔfãa nyɔɔŋ kɛyatuaa lɛ, ni wɔkpãtã emɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ ahiɛ!"

Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, "Nyɛtoa Yerusalem he tsei lɛ nyɛshwiea shi, koni nyɛkɛ tswaa kpokui nyɛkɛsaa Yerusalem yi. Maŋ ni abaagbla etoi ni, ejaakɛ anaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ mli fe yiwalɛ saneyeli sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ.
Bɔ ni nubu baa emli nu yi koni ehi krɔŋŋ lɛ, nakai Yerusalem baa enifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ ayi. Henitswiamɔ kɛ niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ he anuɔ yɛ mli; ni hela kɛ pilamɔi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ minaa yɛ mli.
Ao, Yerusalem, kwɛmɔ ni ahi; kɛjeee nakai lɛ mibashi o, ni mibafee o amaŋfɔ̃, ni oootsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ nɔ."

Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Abɛɛ Israelbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ashishi kwraa tamɔ ayeɔ kpɛkpɛo yɛ waintsei anɔ lɛ. Nyɛkpaa tso niji lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ koni nyɛtserɛa yibii fɛɛ yibii yɛ tsei lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wainyibiitselɔ feɔ lɛ.
"Namɛi mikɛaawie, ni mabɔ amɛ kɔkɔ, ni amɛaabo mi toi? Naa, amɛtoii etsimɔ no hewɔ lɛ amɛnuuu nɔ. Naa, Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli sane ehã amɛ, ni amɛnaaa he mishɛɛ.

Hewɔ lɛ mi hu mimli ewo la naakpa tamɔ Yehowa nɔŋŋ; ni mlila lɛ naatsii etɔ mi." Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Fɔsemɔ mimlila lɛ oshwie gbekɛbii ni yɔɔ blohuiaŋ kɛ oblahii akui lɛ hu fɛɛ anɔ. Abaamɔmɔ nuu kɛ eŋa fɛɛ kɛya, ni hiimeji kɛ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ kotokoto hu abaamɔmɔ amɛ.
Amɛshīai kɛ amɛŋmɔji kɛ amɛŋamɛi fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krokomɛi moŋ anii, ejaakɛ mibagbla shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ atoi. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miishishiu mɛi koni ekɛna nii; ni kɛjɛ gbalɔ nɔ kɛyashi osɔfo nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shihilɛ mli lɛ kutumpɔo sɔŋŋ ni.
Amɛtsaa miwebii lɛ apilamɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Omanye ei! Omanye ei!' Be mli ni omanye ko kwraa bɛ.

Kɛji amɛfee nihiinii lɛ, ani amɛhiɛ gboɔ he? Dabida, amɛhiɛ gbooo he ekome flo nɛkɛ; amɛhiɛgble tɔ ejwa. No hewɔ lɛ be mli ni mibagbla miwebii lɛ atoi lɛ, amɛbaafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi lɛ ahe, No baafee amɛnaagbee. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyadamɔa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ ahe, ni nyɛkwɛa. Nyɛbia he ni blema gbɛi ni ja lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni ji gbɛ kpakpa lɛ yɔɔ koni nyɛnyiɛa no nɔ, ni nyɛsusumai atsuii aaanyɔ amɛmli." Shi hetoo ni amɛhã ji, "Wɔnyiɛŋ nɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, miito bulɔi mahã nyɛ, ni miikɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛboa tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛmɔ toi, ni nyɛyea nɔ.' Shi amɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔboŋ toi!'"
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ, majimaji kɛ asafoi, nyɛboa nɔ ni baaba gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ toi.
Shikpɔŋ, bo toi! Miihã hiɛkpãtãmɔ abanina gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ no ji yibii ni amɛjeŋba ewo; ejaakɛ miwiemɔi lɛ amɛboko toi, ni amɛkwa mimlai lɛ.
Mɛni mifeɔ krɔbɔo ni jɛ Sheba, kɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ sinamon ni jeɔ ŋma he? Shãa afɔlei ni nyɛshãa nyɛhãa mi lɛ, miheee; nyɛkooloo afɔlei lɛ hu esaa mihiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, 'Naa, mato gbɔmɛi nɛɛ pampi, ni amɛbatrɛ ni tsɛmɛi kɛ bii kɛ kuuŋnyo kɛ naanyo fɛɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã.'"
Bɔ ni Yehowa keɔ nɛ, "Naa, mɛi komɛi miijɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba; maŋ wulu ko miifã kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe tɔ̃ɔ kɛba.
Amɛhiɛ gãi kɛ akplɔ, amɛyi wa, ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ ni amɛnyiɛmɔ gbɛɔ hoo tamɔ ŋshɔ. Amɛtra okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛgba ta kɛmiiba; amɛkɛ bo Zion, miiba abawu."
Yerusalem kɛɛ, "Wɔnu amɛhe momo; ni no ehã wɔnijiaŋ eje wui, ni wɔtsui efã, ni tamɔ yoo ni miikɔ̃mɔ ni ebaafɔ!
Ehiii wɔ kpojee kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yaa, tempɔŋi lɛ anɔ nyiɛmɔ hu ebɔ wɔ, ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ efã klaŋte, ni he fɛɛ he efee gbeyei."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Ao, mimaŋbii, nyɛklɔa kpekpe nyɛbumɔa, nyɛkokloa shu yɛ lamlu mli, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa waa tamɔ afoɔ bi koome ni egbo, ejaakɛ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ baaba ebatua nyɛ trukaa."
"Mifee bo tamɔ shikakalɔ yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ koni okpa amɛ shi ni ona bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ.
Kaniŋkajelɔi kpanakui sɔŋŋ ji amɛ, ni amɛtsui wa tamɔ akɔɔble loo dade. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔfitelɔi ji amɛ, amɛyeɔ mɛi ahe osheku kɛfoɔ shi.
Afoto lɛ miihuu la lɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni la lɛ eŋlã sumui lɛ fɛɛ. Yakatswaa akã he atsuuɔ sumui lɛ he lɛ, ejaakɛ anyɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi gbohii lɛ ajie yɛŋ ashwie.
Atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fei, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekpoo amɛ."
7: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie nɛ, 2-3 "Yaadamɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ agbo lɛ mli koni owie wiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi. Nyɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɛkɛ agboi nɛɛ amli nyɛyajaa Yehowa, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ toi. Nyɛsaa nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii hu, ni mahã nyɛhi shi yɛ biɛ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ akafɔ̃a nɛkɛ lakamɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔ akɛ, 'Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe nɛ! Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe nɛ! Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe nɛ!'
"Shi moŋ kɛji nyɛtsake nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii lɛɛlɛŋ, kɛji nyɛkojo mɔ kɛ enaanyo teŋ yɛ jalɛ naa,
kɛji nyɛyeee gbɔ loo awusã loo okulafo amim, ni nyɛshwieee mɔ ko ni efeko nɔ ko lá shi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ biɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyajaaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi nyɛkɛfee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe efɔŋ lɛ,
no lɛ mahã nyɛhi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mijɛ jeeŋmɔ mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ kɛya naanɔ.
"Naa, nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ lakamɔ wiemɔi ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ anɔ.
Aso nyɛaaju, ni nyɛaagbe gbɔmɔ, ni nyɛaafite gblã, ni nyɛaakãmɔ amale kitãi, ni nyɛaashã tsofakɛŋma nyɛkɛhã Baal, ni nyɛaayaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee,
kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛba nyɛbadamɔ mihiɛ yɛ mishīa nɛɛ ni nyɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔhe eje mli;' kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtee nyɛyafee nihiinii ni mihiɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ lo?
Aso nɛkɛ mishīa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ julɔi ateemɔhe yɛ nyɛhiɛ lo?
Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mina nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ momo. Nyɛyaa miwe lɛ ni yɔɔ Shilo lɛ, he ni aja mi yɛ tsuutsu lɛ, nyɛyakwɛa nɔ ni mifee yɛ jɛi yɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ akɛni nyɛ hu nyɛfee nibii gbohii nɛɛ fɛɛ eko, ni mikɛ nyɛ ewie aahuu, shi nyɛbooo mi toi, ni mitsɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ-hereee mi nɔ lɛ,
hewɔ lɛ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mifee Shilo lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mibafee mishīa nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ, kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Mibashwie nyɛ kɛje mihiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mishwie nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni ji Efraim shwiei lɛ fɛɛ kɛje mihiɛ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, "Bo lɛ kaasɔle okpa fai ohã nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ. Kaafo, ni okasɔle hu ohã amɛ; kaadamɔ mli ohã amɛ yɛ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ miboŋ bo toi.
Ani onaaa nibii ni amɛfeɔ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli, kɛ nɔ ni amɛfeɔ yɛ Yerusalem blohui lɛ amli lɛ?

Gbekɛbii lɛ yalɛɔ lai kɛbaa, ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shɛreɔ la lɛ, ni yei lɛ kpɔtɔɔ ma lɛ ni akɛshãa aboloo akɛyahãa jemawɔŋ yoo ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ Ŋwɛi Maŋnyɛ lɛ, ni amɛfɔseɔ dãa amɛshwieɔ shi akɛ afɔle amɛkɛhãa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi koni amɛkɛwo mimli la.
Shi mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, 'Aso mi, mimli la amɛwoɔ lɛ lo? Ani jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe mlila amɛwoɔ, ni amɛkɛwoɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe hiɛgble lo?
No hewɔ lɛ mi, Yehowa, bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛ, 'Naa, mimli baafu, ni mimli baawo Sɔlemɔwe nɛɛ, gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi kɛ ŋanɔ tsei kɛ ŋmɔshi niyenii fɛɛ la. Mimlila lɛ naa baawa tamɔ la ni miitso, ni anyɛŋ agbe.'"
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Nyɛkɛ shãa afɔlei lɛ afataa kooloo afɔlei lɛ ahe koni nyɛye loo lɛ;
ejaakɛ be ni miyajie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ ewieee he, ni asaŋ miwooo amɛ kitã ko yɛ shãa afɔle kɛ kooloo afɔle shãa he.
Shi moŋ miwo amɛ kitã akɛ, 'Nyɛyea migbee nɔ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛbaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ; nyɛbaa nyɛ jeŋ yɛ kitãi ni miwo nyɛ lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã nyɛ.'
Shi amɛbooo mi toi lɛ, amɛyeee migbee nɔ hu; shi moŋ amɛyanyiɛ nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ kɛ amɛtsuii fɔ̃ɔji ni wa lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ sɛɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛ amɛjeŋba fite fe tsustu lɛ.
Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mikã he miitsu mitsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ amɛŋɔɔ be fɛɛ be,
shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛbooo mi toi, ni amɛyeee migbee nɔ; shi moŋ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛfee nifɔ̃ɔjianii fe amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete.
"No hewɔ lɛ, Yeremia, okɛ amɛ baawie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛ, shi amɛboŋ bo toi; ni kɛji otsɛ amɛ hu amɛhereŋ bo nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ kɛ, 'Nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhe maŋ ni booo Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi, ni nyɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ. Anɔkwale egbo yɛ nyɛteŋ, atsiii tã dɔŋŋ po.'"
"Yerusalembii, nyɛkua nyɛyi nyɛshwiea, nyɛwoa yara yɛ gɔji kpataai lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekwa, ni ekpoo yinɔbii ni emli efu amɛ nɛɛ!
"Ejaakɛ Yudabii lɛ efee nɔ fɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ. Amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi ni mihiɔ lɛ eyamamɔ mi-Sɔlemɔwe ni ajaa mi yɛ mli yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛbule jɛi.
Ni amɛyama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Tofet yɛ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli, koni amɛgbe amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei amɛkɛshã afɔle. Enɛ ji nɔ ko ni mifãko akɛ afee; ebako miyiŋ tete po.
Naa, gbii miiba, ni atsɛŋ jɛi akɛ Tofet loo Hinom Jɔɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ abaatsɛ jɛi Gbɔmɔgbee Jɔɔ, akɛni jɛi abaafu gbohii yɛ; ejaakɛ he kroko bɛ ni aaafu amɛ yɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ gbohii lɛ baatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko eshwieŋ amɛ.
Mafo nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ kɛ Yerusalem blohui fɛɛ amli. Anuŋ ayɛmfro kɛ ayɛmfro wu gbee dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃."
8: Yehowa kɛɛ, "Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, abaaloo Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Yerusalembii akromɔbii fɛɛ awui yɛ amɛgbonyobui lɛ amli.

Abaagbɛ wui nɛɛ amli aka hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii, ni ji nibii ni amɛsumɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛyanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ ni amɛja amɛ lɛ. Abuaŋ amɛwui nɛɛ anaa, ni afuŋ hu; shi moŋ amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ wamɔ yɛ tumu nɔ.
Jaku fɔŋ nɛɛ mli bii fɛɛ ni aaashwɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni mishwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ, amɛaashwe akɛ amɛgboi fe nɔ ni amɛaahi wala mli. Mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ mikɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Aso kɛji agbee shi lɛ, ateee shi? Aloo kɛji adu gbɛ lɛ akuuu sɛɛ?
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ egba afã, ni amɛka jɛi kwraa nɛɛ? Amɛhiɛ shishiumɔ mli kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ kpalemɔ.

Mikɛ tsuishitoo bo amɛtoi; shi amɛwieee anɔkwale. Mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni nifɔ̃ɔjianii ni efee lɛ edɔ lɛ, ni no ehã etsake etsui. Shi moŋ ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɛni mifee?' Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɛɔ akɛ 'Mɛni mifee?' Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni okpɔŋɔ shaa foi kitikiti kɛboteɔ ta mli lɛ.
Klitso ni ji looflɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi tete le be ni esa akɛ eku esɛɛ eba; nakai nɔŋŋ kosɛɛ okpo hu kɛ nyɔŋmɔbitɛte kɛ kpokukpoku fɛɛ le amɛbaabe; shi mimɛi lɛ leee mi, Yehowa, mimlai lɛ.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Wɔ lɛ wɔle nii, ni Yehowa mla lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ lɛ? Naa, woloŋmalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛmale niŋmaa ehã mla lɛ etsɔ̃ amale mla.
Nilelɔi nɛɛ abaawo amɛ hiɛgble, amɛbaajijaa, ni abaaŋɔ amɛ nom, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ. Belɛ nɛgbɛ amɛnilee lɛ yɔɔ mɔ?

Enɛ hewɔ lɛ maŋɔ amɛŋamɛi lɛ mahã mɛi krokomɛi; ni mikɛ amɛŋmɔji lɛ baahã mɛi ni baaye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ. Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ joɔ; ni kɛjɛ gbalɔ nɔ kɛyashi osɔfo nɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shishiuɔ mɔ.
Amɛmiitsa mimaŋbii lɛ apilamɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Omanye ei! Omanye!' Be mli ni omanye ko kwraa bɛ.

Ani kɛji amɛfee musubɔɔnii lɛ, efeɔ amɛ hiɛgble? Dabida! Efeee amɛ hiɛgble kome flo nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛgble tɔ ejwa. Be mli ni mibagbla amɛtoi lɛ, abaabutu amɛ, ni amɛbaafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi lɛ ahe. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ, "Be ni miba miwebii lɛ anaabuamɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ waintsei ni wainyibii bɛ nɔ, loo agbami tsei ni agbami bɛ nɔ, ni amɛnɔ bai tete eŋlã; ni nii ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ hu eje amɛdɛŋ."

Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba mɔ wɔtra shi nɛkɛ lolo? Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa; nyɛhãa wɔbotea maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ amli koni wɔhiɛ ayakpãtã yɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ wɔhe ehã hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ehã wɔ nu ni awo mli ebɔɔ koni wɔnu, ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.
Wɔkwɛ toiŋjɔlɛ gbɛ, shi nɔ kpakpa ko baaa, wɔkwɛ tsamɔ gbɛ, shi naa, tsuifãa moŋ ni pue.

Anuɔ henyɛlɔi lɛ akpɔŋɔi lɛ atsinemɔ kɛjɛɔ Dan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ kpokpoɔ kɛji amɛkpɔŋɔhii lɛ blɔ. Amɛmiiba amɛbakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ, wɔmaŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Ejaakɛ, naa, miiwo onufui agbɛ kɛba nyɛteŋ, ni ji blikai, ni ŋkunyaayeli ko ŋkunyaayeli ko nyɛɛɛ amɛhe ajɔɔ koni amɛbakɔ̃mɔ nyɛ."
Mikɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ anyɛŋ atsa, mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli.

Naa, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ, minuɔ mimaŋbii ablɔmɔ akɛ, "Ani Yehowa bɛ Zion lo? Zion maŋtsɛ lɛ bɛ Zion?" Yehowa, amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ, to he akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛwo mi mlifu kɛ maŋsɛɛ amãgãi ni nyɛkotoɔ ni nyɛjaa lɛ?"
Maŋbii lɛ blɔ akɛ, "Nikpamɔbe lɛ eho, ni atse nii agbe naa, ni ahereko wɔyiwala."
Mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli, yɛ mimaŋbii ahejramɔ lɛ hewɔ. Miiye ŋkɔmɔ; mihe ejɔ̃ mihe.
Ani tsofã bɛ Gilead lo? Tsofatsɛmɛi bɛ jɛi lo? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni atsako mimaŋbii lɛ?
9: Mina ni kulɛ miyitso lɛ nubu ni; ni mihiŋmɛii hu nuhiŋmɛii ni koni mikɛfo mimaŋbii ni enyɔnyɔi lɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ gbɛnyiɛlɔi atoohe yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ he ko, koni mashi mimaŋbii ateŋ maya jɛi. Ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ gblãfitelɔi ji amɛ; kutumpɔfoi asafo ji amɛ.
Amɛlilɛi edrɔ tamɔ gãitso; amale ehe shi waa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fe anɔkwayeli moŋ. "Amɛjɛɔ nɔ fɔŋ kome he kome he kɛyaa ekroko he, ni amɛleee mi po." Yehowa kɛɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akwɛ ehe ni ahi yɛ enaanyo hewɔ; mɔ ko kɛ ehe akafɔ̃ enyɛmi nɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ etsɔ̃ ehe shishiulɔ, ni naanyo fɛɛ naanyo etsɔ̃ mɔ he oshekuyelɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shishiuɔ enaanyo, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ewieee anɔkwale; amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛlilɛi malemɔ; amɛfeɔ efɔŋ, ni amɛmiii tsuitsakemɔ.
Yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔnii ni amɛfeɔ nɔtoonɔtoo hewɔ lɛ, amɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛaale mi. Yehowa kɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, matsuu amɛhe koni maka amɛ yɛ la mli makwɛ, ejaakɛ mɛni dɔŋŋ manyɛ mafee yɛ miwebii nɛɛ ahewɔ?
Gãimlibi ni gbeɔ mɔ ji amɛlilɛi; kutumpo wiemɔ pɛ ele. Mɔ kɛ enaanyo wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ tsɛbelɛ ewo lɛ ka yɛ etsuiŋ.
Aso mikagbla amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ? Mikatɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lo? Mi, Yehowa, miibi."

Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Mawo yara mafo gɔji lɛ waa, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ ŋamɔ kooloi aniyelihei lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ jɛi fɛɛ eŋlã, ni mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ jɛi kɛhooo dɔŋŋ. Anuuu tsinai agbee yɛ jɛi; ni jwɛiaŋ loofɔji kɛ kooloi tete ejo foi kɛshi jɛi amɛtee."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mahã Yerusalem atsɔ̃ maŋ koikoi, ebaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe. Yuda maji lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi."
Kɛkɛ ni mibi akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ mɛɛ hewɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã, ni etsɔ̃ shiaŋa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ kɛhooo nɛɛ? Namɔ ji nilelɔ ni aaanu enɛ shishi? Namɔ ji mɔ ni bo Yehowa ojie otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni egba?"
Yehowa here nɔ akɛ, "Enɛ fɛɛ hewɔ ni mimɛi lɛ ekwa mimlai ni miwo amɛ lɛ; ni amɛbooo migbee toi, ni amɛfeee bɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Shi moŋ amɛkɛ kuɛŋtilɛ fee nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ, ni amɛyaja Baal amãgã lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ amɛfee lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ ji enɛ, "Naa, mibalɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ taatso, ni mahã amɛ nu ni ebɔɔ yɔɔ mli amɛnu.
Mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã maji anɔ, hei ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee; mahã henyɛlɔi afã klaŋte kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maplenee amɛ kwraa."
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjwɛŋa sane lɛ he, ni nyɛtsɛa yarayei kɛbaa; nyɛtsua koni ayaŋɔa yei ni ahe esa kɛ yara nɔ lala kɛba."
Maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa amɛhe afea oya ni amɛla yarafeemɔ lala yɛ wɔ wɔhewɔ, koni wɔhiŋmɛii afɔse yaafonu ashwie shi, ni wɔhiŋmɛinaatsɔi atsere kɛ yaafonu."
Ejaakɛ wɔnu yaafo blɔmɔ kɛjɛ Zion akɛ, "Kwɛ bɔ ni akpãtã wɔhiɛ ahã. Ashwie wɔhiɛ shi naakpa, akɛ ahã wɔshi wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni akumɔ wɔshīai lɛ fɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Awomɛi nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, ni nyɛhãa ewiemɔ lɛ abotea nyɛtoiiaŋ. Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbiyei lɛ yarawoo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsɔ̃ɔ enaanyo yaafo lala.
Ejaakɛ gbele ekwɔ kɛtsɔ̃ samfɛji amli kɛbatua wɔ, ni ebote wɔmaŋtsɛ wei amli ebaplenee gbekɛbii yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni ekpãtã oblahii hu ahiɛ yɛ blohui amli."
Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mikɛɛ nɛ, "Gbɔmɛi agbohii baajwere shi yɛ ŋanɔ tamɔ tumu ni ashwã awo ŋmɔ mli, loo tamɔ ŋmaa nyaŋkui jwereɔ shi yɛ ŋmaakpalɔi asɛɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaabua naa.
Nilelɔ akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ enilee nɔ. Hewalɔ hu akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ ehewalɛ nɔ, ni niiatsɛ akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ eninamɔ nɔ;
shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, eshwã efɔ̃, enɛ moŋ nɔ; akɛ ele mi, ni enuɔ mi shishi, akɛ miji Yehowa ni misuɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo, ni miyeɔ jalɛ sane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Enɛɛmɛi ahe moŋ minyaa. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, be miiba ni mibagbla Israelbii ni efo ketia lɛ atoi ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ mɛi ni efoko ketia lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Mibagbla Egipt kɛ Yuda kɛ Edombii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ bii ni shɛɔ amɛyitsei ahe lɛ hu atoi, ejaakɛ maji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ foolɔi ni, ni Israelbii lɛ hu tsuiŋ foolɔi ji amɛ."
10: Israelbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa keɔ toi,
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkakasea maji krokomɛi lɛ ajeŋba, ni nyɛkashea ŋwɛi okadii agbeyei, ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ ji mɛi ni sheɔ nomɛi agbeyei.
Amɛkusumi lɛ lakamɔ ni; amɛyafoɔ tso yɛ koo mli kɛbaa ni ŋaalɔ kɛ lema gbɔɔ,
amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika shwieɔ he kɛwulaa lɛ, ni akɛ hamle kɛ plɛkoo klaa lɛ kpɛtɛɔ shi koni ekagbee shi.

Amɛmãgãi nɛɛ tamɔ blantu ni akɛshwieɔ kooloi yɛ waatrɛ ŋmɔ mli, amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛwie; ni holemɔ aholeɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛnyiɛ. Nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ efɔŋ ko amɛfee lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ ekpakpa hu amɛfee.
Yehowa, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ bo. Bo lɛ oje agbo, ni ogbɛi hu je agbo, ni eyɛ hewalɛ.
Bo majimaji fɛɛ amaŋtsɛ, namɔ po ni sheŋ bo gbeyei? Ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ pɛ osa woo. Majimaji lɛ anɔ nilelɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi anɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ bo.
Buului kɛ kwashiai sɔŋŋ ji amɛ; yakanii amɛkaseɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ tso amãgã dɛŋnii amɛkaseɔ lɛ.
Akɛ jwiɛtɛi ni atswia jɛɔ Spain baa, ni akɛ shika jeɔ Ufaz baa. Tsoŋaalɔ kɛ shikaŋaalɔ ninenaa nitsumɔi ni. Abuɔ amɛ mama bluu kɛ mama afaseo tsuru, ŋaalɔi ni ahe esa aninenaa nitsumɔ sɔŋŋ ni.
Shi Yehowa ji anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ. Lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kɛ Naanɔ Maŋtsɛ lɛ. Emlifu hãa shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni maji nyɛɛɛ emlila lɛ naa adamɔ.
"Bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ amɛ nɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni jeee amɛ amɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baakpãtã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ atatuiaŋ fɛɛ.'"
Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ebɔ je lɛ yɛ enilee naa, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli eha nɔ yɛ eŋaa naa.
Kɛji ewo egbeiaŋ lɛ, nu shimɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ; ni ehãa afua teɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ kɛbaa. Lɛ ehãa srawa gblaa yɛ nunɛmɔ mli, ahum fãa kɛjɛɔ hei ni ekɛ lɛ eto.
Gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ kwashia ni leee nii ni; shikaŋaalɔ fɛɛ shikaŋaalɔ hiɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ emãgã hewɔ, ejaakɛ emãgãi ni eshwie lɛ apasa ni; ni wala mumɔ bɛ amɛmli.
Yakayaka nibii ni; mɔ akɛlakaa, be ni abaagbla amɛtoi lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpãtã.
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ enɛɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ lɛji mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ; ni eŋɔ Israel ekɛfee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.
Bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ maŋ ni asa eyi mli, buamɔ onibii ni jwere shikpɔŋ anaa,
ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Mibafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii tamɔ afɔ̃ɔ aklomia mli tɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ; ni mibahã amɛhe ajra amɛ bɔ ni amɛbaanu he."
Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ blɔ akɛ, "Kpoo hã wɔ! Wɔpilamɔ lɛ naa wa!" Shi wɔkɛɛ akɛ, "Hejramɔ nɛ moŋ; shi esa akɛ wɔdamɔɔ naa."
Afite wɔbuui lɛ ni amɛhe taŋkpei lɛ fɛɛ etserɛ. Wɔbii lɛ fɛɛ eshi wɔ amɛtee; amɛbɛ he ko he ko. Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaashi wɔbuui lɛ dɔŋŋ asaŋ ni eeewo amɛhe mamai lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mihere nɔ akɛ, "Wɔmaŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ kwashiai ni; amɛbiii Yehowa dɛŋ gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ, no hewɔ ni jeŋ ehiii hãaa amɛ, ni wɔmaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ egbɛ eshwã lɛ.
Naa, sane eba, onu he? Kooyigbɛ maŋ ko miihūu kɛmiiba, eeba koni ebafee Yuda maji lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ koni maji lɛ atsɔ̃ ŋaaŋgbei ashihilɛhe."
Ao! Yehowa, mile akɛ gbɔmɔ adesã gbɛ bɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ; ni adesa bɛ ewala nɔ hewalɛ.
Ao! Yehowa, kã owebii; shi bɔ ni sa kɛkɛ; jeee yɛ omlifu naa, koni okaplenee wɔ.
Gblamɔ majimaji lɛ ni leee bo lɛ atoi, ni okɛ mɛi hu ni jaaa bo lɛ aye, ejaakɛ amɛkpãtã Yakob shwiei lɛ ahiɛ, amɛplenee amɛ butuu, ni amɛfee amɛshihilɛhei lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
11: Yehowa kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ,
"Bo kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ atoi koni okɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ awie.
Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Isreal Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ. Mɔ ni yeee kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ alomɔ lɛ.

Kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, asaŋ ni miwo amɛ kitã yɛ he be ni mijie amɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni amɛhe dɔ la yɛ tamɔ dade flɔnɔɔŋ lɛ. Mifã nyɛ akɛ nyɛbo migbee toi, ni nyɛye nibii ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni mi hu matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ,
bɔ ni afee ni matsu kitã ni mikã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ he nii, no ji akɛ mahã amɛ Shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii koni amɛhi nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni mihere nɔ akɛ, "Yehowa, aba mli nakai."
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaashiɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji kɛ Yerusalem blohuiaŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛboa nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ atoi, ni nyɛyea nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mikpã miwo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ atoiŋ gbi nɔ ni mijie amɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni mikã he miikpã miiwo amɛtoiŋ lolo kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ, nyɛboa migbee toi.

Shi amɛbuuu, ni amɛbooo toi hu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ tsuiwalɛ fee nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ. No hewɔ lɛ mikɛ kpãŋmɔ kometoo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni miwo amɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ amɛye nɔ, shi amɛyeee nɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ nɔŋŋ gbla amɛtoi.'"
Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Yudabii kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ etse mihiɛ atūa.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛmiifee nibii fɔ̃ɔji ni amɛblematsɛmɛi ni booo miwiemɔ toi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ. Amɛtee amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi. Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ fɛɛ ekū mikpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ naa, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ ji akɛ mibahã sane fɔŋ aye amɛ, ni amɛhe ejeŋ mli. Amɛbaablɔ amɛtsɛ mi nɛ, shi miboŋ amɛ toi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli bii lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ hu baaya amɛyablɔ amɛtsɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa lɛ, shi nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala amɛhere kwraa yɛ amɛfimɔ be lɛ mli.

Ao! Yuda, onyɔŋmɔi lɛ ayi efa tamɔ omaji lɛ ayifalɛ, ni bɔ ni gbɛjegbɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli lɛ fa lɛ, nakai nyɛmamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi nyɛkɛfeɔ hiɛgbejianii, no ji nyɛkɛshãa tsofakɛŋma nyɛhãa Baal.
No hewɔ lɛ bo, Yeremia, kaakpa mi fai ohã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; asaŋ kaablɔ osɔle ohã amɛ, ejaakɛ miboŋ toi be mli ni amɛaatsɛ mi yɛ amɛfimɔ mli lɛ."
Etee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ gbɛnaa misuɔlɔ yɔɔ yɛ mi-Sɔlemɔwe be mli ni eyafee nifɔ̃ɔjianii ni mihiɔ lɛ? Ani naashiwoo kɛ kooloo afɔleshãa baanyɛ atsi hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni baa lɛ naa lo? Ani omii aaashɛ ohe lo?
Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ Yehowa wo bo gbɛi, 'Mutso ni ebu fɛɛfɛo ni woɔ yibii kpakpai.' Shi agbɛnɛ Yehowa baahã ahum kpeteŋkple ko agba ni ebaasɔo tso nɛɛ naa la, ni ebaashã kɛ ehe niji fɛɛ.
"Naa, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mɔ ni batɛo bo yɛ biɛ lɛ ewie efɔŋ eshi bo, ejaakɛ Israelbii kɛ Yudabii efee nɔ fɔŋ, no ji akɛ amɛshã tsofakɛŋma amɛhã Baal amɛkɛwo mimli la."
Yehowa hã mile, ni esaa eka nɔ ehã mi ekoŋŋ akɛ atee miyinɔ apam, ni miyoo yiŋtoo lɛ.

Mitamɔ too gwaŋtɛŋ ni he jɔ, ni akpla lɛ kɛtee koni ayagbe lɛ. Shi mileee kwraa akɛ mi miheŋaa fɔŋ amɛto be ni akɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔkpatãa tso lɛ kɛ eyibii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; nyɛhãa wɔjiea lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi aje lɛ mli koni akakai lɛ kwrakwra dɔŋŋ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni misɔle nɛkɛ, "Ao! Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, bo ni okojoɔ yɛ jalɛ naa, bo ni okaa gbɔmɔ susumɔ kɛ etsui fɛɛ okwɛɔ, hã mana owele ni obaatɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ bo odɛŋ mitu misane lɛ fɛɛ miwo."
No hewɔ lɛ Anatotbii lɛ ni tao mi amɛgbe, ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Kaagba yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli dɔŋŋ, no lɛ wɔbaagbe bo" lɛ,
nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe nɛ, "Naa, mibagbla amɛtoi, amɛblahii lɛ baagboi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛbihii lɛ kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ baagboi kɛ hɔmɔ,
bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko ehaŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ afi nɔ ni mibagbla Anatotbii lɛ atoi lɛ, mibahã sane fɔŋ aye amɛ pam."
12: Yehowa, kɛji mi kɛ bo taa naa tete lɛ onɔ jaa; kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ mi sane nɛɛ miifɔ̃ ohiɛ. Mɛni hewɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji agbɛ jaa hãa amɛ, ni kutumpɔfoi shwereɔ lɛ?
Otɛoɔ amɛ, ni amɛfãi mɔmɔɔ shi, amɛdraa, ni amɛwoɔ yibii. Amɛwieɔ ohe ekpakpa kɛ amɛnaabu shi amɛtsui mli lɛ, amɛ kɛ bo teŋ jekɛ.
Shi, Yehowa, mi lɛ ole mi, ni onaa minifeemɔnii; ni okaa bɔ ni mijwɛŋɔ yɛ ohe okwɛɔ. Shatãmɔ amɛ kɛya tamɔ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ, ni ojɔɔ amɛnɔ oto kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni abaagbe amɛ lɛ.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaagbi, ni ŋa lɛ nɔ jwɛi aaaŋlã kɛyashi? Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ehã enɔ koolɔi kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ etã; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Enaŋ bɔ ni wɔnaagbee aaatamɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Yeremia, kɛji okɛ gbɔmɛi da foi ni amɛhã eje otsine lɛ, te ooofee tɛŋŋ okɛ okpɔŋɔi ashi mple hu? Ni kɛji shikpɔŋ trɛnɛɛ nɔ tete ogbee shi yɛ lɛ, te ooofee tɛŋŋ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he koo hayii lɛ amli hu?
Ejaakɛ onyɛmimɛi kɛ otsɛ we lɛ, amɛ tete po amɛkwa bo; ni amɛmiitao bo efɔŋ waa diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛji amɛdɔkɔ amɛnaa amɛhã bo tete lɛ, kaahe amɛ oye."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mikwa mimaŋ Israel, mishi migbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ sɛɛ, miŋmɛɛ mimaŋ ni misumɔɔ kɛ mitsui fɛɛ lɛ he miwo ehenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Mimɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛwo mi tamɔ koo mli jata, ni amɛblɔɔ amɛwoɔ mi, no hewɔ lɛ minyɛɔ amɛ.
Ani mimɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ looflɔ looyelɔ kɛ ehe ŋwãtãŋwãtã ehã mi lo? Ani loofɔji looyelɔi ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe kpula? Yaa koni oyabua ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ anaa ni okɛ amɛ aba koni amɛbaye nii.
Tookwɛlɔi babaoo ekpãtã miwain abɔɔ lɛ hiɛ, amɛnaanaa migbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ; amɛhã migbɛfaŋnɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ etsɔ̃ ŋa kpataa.
Amɛhã etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ekã shi amɛŋfɔ̃ eefo eetsɛ mi. Shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, shi jeee mɔ ko mɔ ko he sane ko ni.
Niiahiɛkpãtãlɔi eba shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gɔji kpataai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã klaŋte miiye nii kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyagbee enaagbeehe kome; adesa ko adesa ko kwraa bɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
Mimɛi lɛ du ŋmaa; shi amɛkpa ŋmei. Amɛgbo deŋme; shi amɛnaaa he sɛɛ ko. Yehowa mlifu lɛ naawalɛ hewɔ lɛ, nii ni amɛbaakpa lɛ baafee amɛ hiɛgble."

Yehowa kɛɛ, "Miyɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛɔ yɛ Israel hewɔ maji fɔ̃ɔji ni efite shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã mimaŋ Israel lɛ ahe. Naa, mibashwie nakai gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni mibahere Yudabii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Shi be ni mishwie amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe, ni mibaku sɛɛ mikɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ kɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ni kɛji be ni aaashɛ nakai be lɛ amɛkase mimɛi lɛ ajeŋba, ni amɛkɛ migbɛi aaakã kitã akɛ, 'Mina Yehowa, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ Baal gbɛi kɛ kitãkãmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibaŋɔ amɛ mashi mimɛi lɛ anɔ.'
Shi kɛji maŋ ko booo toi lɛ, no lɛ mafã nakai maŋ lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ, ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
13: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaa koni oyahe hɛŋmɔɔ bo koni okɛŋmɔ ohɛ; okɛ mama nɛɛ akatsɔ nu mli."
Yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa lɛ, mitee miyahe hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ, ni mikɛŋmɔ mihɛ.
Yehowa kɛ mi wie nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Yaa Eufrate Faa lɛ naa koni okɛ hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ ni oyahe ni ŋmɔ ohɛ lɛ ayatee tɛsaa flɔ ko mli yɛ jɛi."
No hewɔ lɛ miyi mli mitee, ni mikɛ hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ yatee yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã mi lɛ.
Gbii kplãŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Tee shi! Yaa Eufrate Faa lɛ naa koni oyakɔ hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ ni mifã bo akɛ okɛyatee yɛ jɛi lɛ kɛba."
Kɛkɛ ni miyiŋ mitee Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, ni miyatsa hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ yɛ he ni mikɛyato lɛ; ni naa bo lɛ efite bɔ ni ehiii hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ.
No sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ,
"Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ. Nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ji bɔ ni mibafo Yuda hewoo lɛ kɛ Yerusalem hu hewoo babaoo lɛ sɛɛ mahã.

Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ efee amɛhe gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji ni booo miwiemɔi toi. Amɛkɛ kuɛŋtimɔ feɔ nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ, ni amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛja amɛ moŋ. No hewɔ lɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ hɛŋmɔɔ bo nɛɛ ni ehii hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko femɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.

Bɔ ni hɛŋmɔɔ bo kpɛtɛɔ mɔ he lɛ, nakai mihã Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ kpɛtɛ mihe koni amɛtsɔ̃ mimaŋ, koni amɛhã mana gbɛi kɛ yijiemɔ, koni amɛhã mihiɛ aba nyam; shi amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi. bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ."
"Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ: Awo kpulu fɛɛ kpulu obɔ̃ kɛ wain. Amɛbaakɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Aso wɔ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ wɔleee akɛ kpulu fɛɛ kpulu baayi obɔ̃ kɛ wain lo?

Kɛkɛ lɛ obaakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ ji akɛ, 'Naa, mibahã shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ atrɔ dãa kpɔtɔɔ, kɛjɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni ji David shwiei ni bayeɔ esɛɛ anɔ kɛyashi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni mibamɔmɔ tsɛmɛi kɛ bii fɛɛ mikɛtswiatswia amɛhe; ni mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ minaŋ mɔbɔ, ni mikɔ̃ŋ mifliŋ, ni mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ŋ mi akɛ mikpãtã amɛhiɛ.'"
Nyɛfea toi ni nyɛboa toi! Nyɛkawoa nyɛhe ejaakɛ Yehowa ewie.
Nyɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam, be ni ehãko duŋ awo nyɛ be ni nyɛbɔ̃iko trɛmɔ yɛ gɔji ni anɔ ewo duŋ lɛ anɔ; ni be mli ni okwɛɔ la gbɛ lɛ ehãa duŋ moŋ woɔ, ni duŋ woɔ kabitii.
Shi kɛji nyɛbooo toi lɛ, mibafo yɛ teemɔ mli yɛ nyɛhewoo lɛ hewɔ; mibafo bloblo kɛ dɔlɛ, ejaakɛ aŋɔ Yehowa webii lɛ nom.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ hu akɛ, 'Nyɛbaaa nyɛhe shi, ejaakɛ akpa nyɛ lumɔyeli. Nyɛtraa humi sɛ̃i nɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛnumnyam akekre lɛ eje nyɛyitso egbee shi.
Asa Yuda wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ayi, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ amɛ ahere. Aŋɔ Yuda fɛɛ nom; aŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nom kɛtee.
"Yerusalem, wo ohiɛ nɔ koni okwɛ henyɛlɔi ni jɛ kooyigbɛ baa nɛɛ. Nɛɛgbɛ mɛi ni akɛhã bo akɛ okwɛ amɛnɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɛi ni ji onumnyam lɛ?
Mɛni oookɛɛ kɛji mɛi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ otsɔse amɛ koni amɛfee onanemɛi lɛ, awo amɛ moŋ onukpa yɛ onɔ? Ani ewaŋ ohe tamɔ yoo ni miikɔ̃mɔ piŋɔ lɛ?
Ni kɛji obi ohe akɛ, Mɛɛba ni nɛkɛ sane eba minɔ? lɛ, na ole akɛ onishaianii ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ ni akpa ohe mama, ni ashwie ohiɛ shi nɛɛ.
Ani mɔdiŋ aaanyɛ ehewolo su etsake, aloo mlaŋtswi aaanyɛ ehe truntrai lɛ etsake? Kɛji amɛaanyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ mɛi ni efɔŋfeemɔ eka nyɛnɔ nɛɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛaanyɛ ekpakpa nyɛfee.
Mibagbɛ nyɛ mashwã tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ etswa kɛjɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni minɔ, ni okɛ ohiɛ fɔ̃ amale nyɔŋmɔi moŋ anɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mibawo ohiɛ mama nɔ koni ohiɛ ashwie shi.

Mina nii ni mihiɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ, kɛ misɛɛ ni ojeɔ ni oyajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, kɛ onyenyeŋtswi ni obɔɔ lɛ, kɛ ajwamaŋ ni obɔɔ nyaŋemɔnyaŋemɔ yɛ ŋanɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ. Kpoo hã bo, bo Yerusalem! Mɛɛbe abaakã he atsuu ohe kɛyashi?"
14: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ nu hɔmɔ he nɛ,
"Yuda miiye ŋkɔmɔ, egboi anaabulɔi lɛ etɔ biti; amɛjwere shikpɔŋ amɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni Yerusalem miiblɔ waa.
Emaŋ abladei lɛ tsuɔ amɛtsuji lɛ faŋŋ; amɛyashɛɔ nubui lɛ anaa, shi amɛnaaa nu; ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa; kɛ amɛgbɛi foji; amɛhiɛgboiɔ, amɛluɔ ni amɛhaaa amɛyiteiaŋ.
Akɛni nu enɛɛɛ, ni shikpɔŋ egbi keketee hewɔ lɛ, okwaafoi ahiɛ egboi; no hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛ amɛnine etsi amɛhiɛ.
Ofrote yoo tete shiɔ ebi ŋmɔŋ ejaakɛ jwɛi bɛ he ko he ko ni ayeɔ.
ŋaŋ teji damɔɔ gɔji kpataai anɔ ni amɛhakuɔ kɔɔyɔɔ tamɔ ŋaŋgbei amɛhiŋmɛii eshiu, ejaakɛ baa kome flo bɛ he ko he ko.
'Wɔnishaianii lɛ miibu wɔ fɔ moŋŋ; shi Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, feemɔ he eko ohã wɔ; tsɛbelɛ wɔsɛɛsɛɛyaa lɛ fa tsɔ̃, ni wɔɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Ao! Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ, bo ni ohereɔ eyiwala yɛ fimɔ bɛ mli, mɛɛba ofee tamɔ gbɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo tamɔ gbɛnyiɛlɔ ni gbaa eyatoɔ gbɛkɛ toohe nɛɛ?
Mɛɛba ofee tamɔ nuu ni elu tamɔ kãkãlɔ ni nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ehere nɛɛ? Ao! Yehowa oyɛ wɔteŋ tuuŋtu ni ogbɛi akɛwo wɔ; kaashi wɔ.'"

Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe nɛ, "Nɛkɛ amɛsumɔ akɛ amɛkpa shi, ni etɔɔɔ amɛ kɛ shikpaa lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mihereŋ amɛ atuu dɔŋŋ. Agbɛnɛ mibakai amɛnishaianii lɛ moŋ, ni mibagbla amɛtoi yɛ amɛ he eshai lɛ ahewɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kaakpa ejurɔyeli he fai ohã maŋ nɛɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ amɛbaahi ŋmaa nɛ, shi miboŋ amɛfaikpamɔ blɔmɔ lɛ toi; ni amɛbaashã shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔle hu nɛ, shi mimɔŋ mli; ni mikɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ hela baaplenee amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, naa gbalɔi lɛ kɛɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛnaŋ ta ko, ni nyɛnaŋ hɔmɔ ko; shi moŋ mahã nyɛ toiŋjɔle ni sɛɛ efooo yɛ biɛ nɛɛ.'"

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbalɔi lɛ miigba amale gbalɛi yɛ migbɛi mli. Jeee mi mitsu amɛ lɛ, jeee mi mifã amɛ lɛ, jeee mi, mikɛ amɛ ewie hu. Amɛmiigba amale ninaai kɛ yaka klamɔi kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiŋ lakamɔi amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ yɛ gbalɔi nɛɛ ni gbaa yɛ mi migbɛi mli, tsɛbelɛ mitsuko amɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Ta kɛ hɔmɔ nɔŋŋ nɔ abaatsɔ̃ akpãtã gbalɔi nɛɛ ahiɛ.

Ni ta kɛ hɔmɔ nɔŋŋ nɔ abaatsɔ̃ akpãtã mɛi ni amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hu ahiɛ. Ni abaashɛrɛ amɛ kɛ agbohii ashwie Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ,ni anaŋ mɛi ni baafu amɛ tete. Mibawo amɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ he nyɔŋmɔ."
Yehowa fã mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Ahã mihiŋmɛiiaŋ akpla nu shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ ni esɛɛ akafo; ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ epila,aye amɛ awui ablaŋ.

Kɛji miyiŋ mitee ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, naa, gbohii ni enyɔnyɔɔi yɛ ta mli, kɛji miku misɛɛ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, naa gbɔmɛi ni hɔmɔ egbe amɛ. Ni gbalɔi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ miitsu amɛnitsumɔi lɛ shi amɛleee nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ."
Yehowa, aso oshɛ Yuda ofɔ̃ kwrakwra? Ani onyaŋe Zionbii lo? Mɛɛba mɔ otswia wɔ nii ni opila wɔ bɔ ni ehii tsamɔ nɛɛ? Wɔkwɛ hejɔlɛ gbɛ, shi nɔ kpakpa ko baaa; wɔhiɛ kã tsamɔ nɔ; shi gbeyei nii moŋ ba.
Ao! Yehowa, wɔmiikplɛ̃ wɔnifɔ̃ɔjianii kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kaakwa wɔ; kaahã Yerusalem hiɛ miishwie shi; he ni ogbojee maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Kaimɔ kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ wɔ kpãŋ lɛ; ni okaku mli.
Ani majimaji lɛ alagbãalagbã wɔji lɛ ateŋ eko nyɛɔ ehãa nu nɛɔ? Loo ŋwɛi tete nyɛɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehãa nu nɛɔ? Ao! Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo pɛ gbɛ wɔkwɛɔ, ejaakɛ bo pɛ otsuɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kwa.
15: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kɛji Mose kɛ Samuel tete po damɔ mihiɛ lɛ, minaŋ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe tsui. Shwiemɔ amɛ kɛje mihiɛ ni amɛya!

Ni kɛji amɛbi bo akɛ, 'Nɛɛgbɛ wɔya?' lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ ji enɛ, 'Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔɔ ahã klaŋte lɛ, klaŋte nɔŋŋ baagbe amɛ. Ni mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã hɔmɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ naa nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛbaagboi yɛ. Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã nomŋɔɔ lɛ, nomŋɔɔ mli nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaate.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛ akɛ, mibahã nibii srɔtoi ejwɛ komɛi aba amɛnɔ. Ta baaba abakpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni gbei baashãtã amɛ, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi baaye amɛloo.
Mahã jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ ahe ajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni Hezekia bi Manase, ni ji YUda maŋtsɛ lɛ, fee yɛ Yerusalem lɛ hewɔ.'"
Yehowa tee nɔ akɛ, "Ao Yerusalem, namɔ baana bo mɔbɔ, ni namɔ baaye bo ŋkɔmɔ? Namɔ baaba ebabi oshi?
Okwa mi, ni sɛɛsɛɛ kɛkɛ oyaa; no hewɔ ni miwo minine nɔ yɛ onɔ ni mikpãtã ohiɛ lɛ; ohe musuŋtsɔ̃lɛ etɔ mi.
Misha nyɛmli yɛ agbonaa tamɔ ashaa ŋmãa mli koni kɔɔyɔɔ abaloo nyɛ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ amli kɛya tamɔ tutuu. Migbe miwebii abi yɛ amɛhe, mikpãtã miwebii lɛ ahiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtsakeee amɛjeŋba gbonyo lɛ.
Mihã amɛyei okulafoi ayi efa fe ŋshɔnaa shia Mihã sane fɔŋ eye oblahii anyɛmɛi, ejaakɛ mihã hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ ekpãtã amɛblahii ahiɛ shwane fintiŋŋ. Mihã ŋmiŋmi kɛ tsuifãa sane eba amɛnɔ trukaa.

Yoo ni efɔ kpawo lɛ etɔ biti; nɔ nyɔ enɔ, ni egbo; ehulu enyɔ shi shwane fiŋtiŋŋ; awo lɛ hiɛgble, ni ashwie ehiɛ shi. Ni amɛteŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, majɔɔ amɛnɔ mahã amɛhenyɛlɔi aklaŋte. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Minyɛ Awo, kpoo hã mi akɛ ofɔ mi! Naa mi ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mi miibe, ni akɛ mi miitaa naa sɔŋŋ. Mifako mɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ, mɔ ko hu efako nɔ ko yɛ midɛŋ; shi loomɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lomɔɔ mi.
Ao! Yehowa, kɛji mikpako bo fai mihãko amɛ bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã amɛ; aloo eji yɛ amɛfimɔ kɛ hejramɔ bei amli lɛ, mitutɔko bo mihãko amɛ kulɛ, hã amɛloomɔ lɛ aba mli.
Ani mɔ ko baanyɛ kooyigbɛ dade ni akɛ akɔɔble efutu mli lɛ mli aku lo?
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Eshai fɛɛ ni amɛfee yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he hewɔ lɛ, mahã henyɛlɔi abaha amɛjwetri kɛ amɛnii fɛɛ yaka.
Mahã amɛyasɔ̃mɔ amɛhenyelɔi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni amɛleee jɛi nɔ, ejaakɛ mimlifu lɛ tamɔ la ni ashɛre, ni ebaatso kɛya naanɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Yehowa, ole misane lɛ fɛɛ. Kaimɔ mi koni obaye obua mi, ni otɔ mihe owele yɛ mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ anɔ. Kaaŋmɛ otsui shi ohã amɛ, ni no ha amɛnine shɛ minɔ. Kaimɔ akɛ bo ohewɔ abɔɔ mi ahora nɛɛ.
Ao! Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, be ni minu owiemɔi lɛ mimɔ mli, ni ehã mina miishɛɛ, ni mimli fli mi, ejaakɛ akɛ ogbɛi ewo mi.
Mitaaa mɛi ni amɛmli efli amɛ ateŋ, ni mimli efliii mi. Mi koome mita shi yɛ ofãmɔ naa, ejaakɛ ohã mimli efu naakpa.
Mɛɛba minɔnaa nɛɛ kã he daa, ni mifla lɛ ehiii tsamɔ, ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ tãlɛ nɛɛ. Ani ofee tamɔ faa ni lakaa mɔ loo faa ni ŋlãa oha mi?"

shi Yehowa to he akɛ, "Kɛji okpale lɛ, mibaŋɔ bo ekoŋŋ, ni obaasɔ̃mɔ mi. Kɛji owie wiemɔi ni ahe yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ, shi jeee nɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ lɛ, no lɛ obaawie minaa ekoŋŋ. Amɛ amɛaakpale kɛba oŋɔɔ, shi jeee bo ni obaakpale kɛya amɛŋɔɔ.
Mahã otsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo ni wa, tamɔ akɔɔble ohã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; amɛkɛ bo baawu nɛ, shi amɛyeŋ onɔkunim, ejaakɛ mikɛ bo yɛ, ni mibahere oyiwala.
Mibahere bo yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji adɛŋ, ni mibakpɔ̃ bo yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
16: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Kaakpee yoo yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni okafɔ bihii loo biyei yɛ biɛ nɛɛ,
ejaakɛ nɔ ni baaba bihii kɛ biyei ni afɔ yɛ biɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ ni fɔfɔɔ amɛ yɛ biɛ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nɛ.

Gbele helai baagbegbee amɛ; ayeŋ amɛhe ŋkɔmɔ, ni afuŋ amɛgbohii lɛ tete; ni amɛbaajwere shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ wamɔ. Amɛbaanyɔnyɔɔi yɛ klaŋte kɛ hɔmɔ naa, ni amɛgbohii lɛ baatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã loofɔji kɛ jwiiaŋ kooloi.
"Kaaya shīa ko ni afeɔ yara yɛ mli, ni kaaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni kaaye amɛ ŋkɔmɔ hu, ejaakɛ hejɔlɛ ni mihã amɛ kɛ mimlihilɛ kɛ mimusuŋtsɔlɛ ni miyɔɔ hã amɛ lɛ mifo fɛɛ sɛɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi wuji kɛ mɛi bibii lɛ fɛɛ baagboiyɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ. Afuŋ amɛ, ni afeŋ amɛyara hu. Mɔ ko mɔ ko bãmɔŋ ehe kɛ kakla aloo eshɛŋ eyiteŋ kɛyeŋ amɛgbohii lɛ ahe ŋkɔmɔ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaŋ ekɛŋkɔmɔyelɔ ko ayaye nii koni ekɛshɛje emii yɛ mɔ ko ni egbo hewɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko haŋ mɔ ko ni etsɛ loo enyɛ egbo nɔ ko ni enu ekɛsheje mɔ lɛ mii.
"Kaaya shīa ko ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ mli ni okɛ mɛi yata shi oye nii ni ayeɔ lɛ eko, ni onu nɔ ni anuɔ lɛ hu eko.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, 'Naa, mibahã nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ gbee kɛ ayɛmfrowu kɛ ayɛmfro gbee fɛɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, kɛ nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ."
"Kɛji okɛ maŋbii lɛ wie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ ni amɛbi bo akɛ, 'Mɛni hewɔ ni Yehowa to eyiŋ ni egbla wɔtoi waa nɛkɛ? Mɛni tɔ̃mɔ wɔtɔ̃? Mɛɛ esha po ji nɔ ni wɔfee wɔshi Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ?' lɛ,
no lɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kwa mi, ni amɛtee amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛja amɛ; amɛkwa mi ni amɛyeee mimla lɛ nɔ.

Ni nyɛfee efɔŋ fe nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete, ejaakɛ naa nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ nɔ ni etsui fɔŋ lɛ kɛɔ lɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ eboɔ mi toi. 13 No hewɔ lɛ mashɛrɛ nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ mashwie shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, he ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee koni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ minaŋ nyɛ mɔbɔ.'"
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, be miiba ni akɛ Yehowa gbɛi kãŋ kitã lɛ, akɛŋ hu dɔŋŋ akɛ, 'Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie Israelbii kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,'

shi moŋ abaakɛɛ akɛ; Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie Israelbii kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ ni eshwie amɛ kɛtee nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba ekoŋŋ lɛ. 'Ejaakɛ mibakpla amɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ."
"Naa, miitsu koni ayaŋɔ wolɛimɛi pii abahã mi koni amɛbahɛ amɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ mibatsu koni ayaŋɔ gbɔbilɔi abahã mi ni amɛbagbɔbi amɛ yɛ gɔji kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi kɛ tɛkploi afɔji blublu amli.
Ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ mihiŋmɛii jwere nɔ, ekoeko bɛ ni minaaa.
Mibawo tɔ̃mɔi ni amɛtɔ̃ kɛ eshai ni amɛfee lɛ amɛyakayaka amãgãi foji lɛ ebule mishikpɔŋ lɛ; amɛhã enɔ eyi tɔ kɛ amɛmusubɔɔ nii lɛ."

"Yehowa, boji mihewalɛ kɛ mimɔɔ ni wa kɛ mibobaahe yɛ fimɔ be mli. Bo oŋɔɔ maji aaajɛ je lɛ naagbeeehei aba, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ebanaaa gboshinii ko akɛ ja lakamɔ kɛ yaka nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko.
Aso gbɔmɔ adesa aaanyɛ nyɔŋmɔi efee ehãi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe? Nɔ ni eeefee lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔ ni."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibahã amɛna amɛle shi kome nɛɛ kɛwula shi nɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ni miyɔɔ koni amɛna amɛle akɛ miji Yehowa."
17: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Yuda he esha lɛ akɛ dade niŋmaatso kɛ enaa daiamɔnd piɔpiɔ kpɛ wo amɛtsui tao lɛ nɔ; akpɛ yɛ amɛfɔle shãa latɛi lɛ akoji lɛ anɔ.
Amɛbii lɛ kaiɔ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔ Ashera lɛ amãgãi ni yɔɔ tsei ni ebu kusukusuui ashishi kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi anɔ,
kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ hu anɔ lɛ. Yuda, ojwetrii kɛ onii ni oyɔɔ fɛɛ hu lɛ, mibajɔɔ nɔ mahã henyɛlɛlɔi koni amɛbaha kɛya. No baafee eshai ni ofee yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ he toigblamɔ.
Obaaŋmɛɛ ogboshinii ni mikɛhã bo lɛ he ofɔ̃ shi, ni mibahã oyasɔ̃mɔ ohenyɛlɔi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni oleee nɔ, ejaakɛ mimlifu lɛ tamɔ la ni ashɛre, ni ebaatso kɛya naanɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ, mɔ ni shiɔ̃ Yehowa sɛɛ, ni ekɛ ehe kpasaa adesa hewalɛ.
Etamɔ tso fɔ ni ma shiaŋa nɔ; yɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋooŋoo ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ jɛi; ebɛ ekpakpa ko ni ebaafee.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ, mɔ ni Yehowa ji ehiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Etamɔ tso ni atɛo yɛ faa toi; etsrɛ̃ɔ eshishi fãi kɛyaninaa nu lɛ. Esheee gbeyei kɛji jeŋdɔle be shɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ eyaa nɔ ewoɔ yibii, etsui yeee kɛji nu enɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ eyibaa hīo shi frɔ̃frɔ̃.
Tsui yɔɔ nɛɛ elakaa mɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ; efite kwraa. Namɔ aaanu lɛ shishi?
Mi, Yehowa, mitaoɔ gbɔmɔ yitsoŋ, ni mikaa tsui mikwɛɔ. Mikɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeɔ yɛ yibii ni ewoɔ naa.
Mɔ ni taoɔ nii ni jeee gbɛ kpakpa nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, etamɔ afi ni yabuɔ wɔji ni jeee lɛ eŋmɛ nɔ. Eninamɔ lɛ ŋmɛɔ lɛ yɛ ewala teŋ,ni enaagbee mli lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ kwashia.
He ni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anumnyam maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i gojoo lɛ ma kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, jɛi ji wɔjamɔhe lɛ.
Ao! Yehowa, bo Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ, mɛi fɛɛ ni kwaa bo lɛ ahiɛ baagboi; mɛi ni kpaleɔ yɛ osɛɛ lɛ agbɛi aaalaaje tamɔ nɔ ni aŋma yɛ mlu mli, ejaakɛ amshi Yehowa ni ji wala nubu lɛ sɛɛ."
Ao! Yehowa, tsa mi, ni mihe aaatã; heremɔ miyiwala koni miyi ana wala, ejaakɛ bo oyi mijieɔ.
Naa, maŋbii lɛ biɔ mi akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ yɔɔ? Hã aba mli koo!"
Yehowa, minyɛko onɔ pɛŋ akɛ ohã nɔ fɔŋ aba maŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni mishweko hu akɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ aba. Yehowa, bo ole enɛ, ni nii fɛɛ ni je minaa lɛ jwere ohiɛ.
Kaawo mihe gbeyei, ejaakɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ boji mibobaahe.
Hã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ ahiɛ agboi; shi mi lɛ kaahã mihiɛ miigbo. Hã amɛtsui afã, shi mi lɛ kaahã mitsui miifã. Hã gbi fɔŋ lɛ abanina amɛ; kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ, ni oku sɛɛ okpãtã amɛshiɛ butuu.
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaa ni oyadamɔ Maŋbii Agbo lɛ naa, he ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ kɛbaa maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛjɛɔ kpo lɛ. Yaadamɔ Yerusalem agboi fɛɛ hu anaa,
koni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi, nyɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Yudabii kɛ nyɛ Yerusalem maŋbii, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ agboi nɛɛ amli lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, Nyɛkwea jogbaŋŋ yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwala hewɔ koni nyɛkaterea jatsu ko yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ, aloo nyɛtre jatsu ko kɛtsɔ̃ Yerusalem agboi nɛɛ amli kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli.

Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛkatre jatsu ko kɛmiijɛ shīa ko mli kɛmiije kpo yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ. Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko; shi moŋ nyɛyea hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ akitã yɛ he akɛ amɛfee lɛ.
Shi moŋ kɛ̃lɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ booo mi toi, ni amɛyeee nɔ; shi amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi ni amɛbooo mi toi koni amɛkase nii.'

"Shi mi, Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛbo mi toi, ni nyɛkɛ jatsu ko jatsu ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ agbo ko mli kɛteee maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ, shi moŋ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni nyɛtsuuu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ nɔ lɛ,

no lɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛmɛi ni taa David maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ baaya nɔ atsɔ̃ agboi nɛɛ amli ni amɛtra tayaa shwiilii amli kɛ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛshishi lumɛi lɛ hu aaatra okpɔŋi anɔ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ agboi lɛ amli kɛba maŋ lɛ mli; ni Yudabii kɛ Yerusalem hu aaafee nakai, ni gbɔmɛi baahi Yerusalem maŋ nɛɛ mli kɛaate naanɔ.

Mɛi kɛ shãa afɔle kɛ kooloi afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai aaaba kɛaajɛ Yuda maji lɛ anɔ kɛ heihei ni bɔle Yerusalem lɛ; mɛi baajɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ kɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ wuoyigbɛ ŋa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aba Yehowa we lɛ abada lɛ shi.

Shi kɛji nyɛbooo mi toi akɛ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni no gbi lɛ nɔ, mɔ ko tere jatsu ko kɛtsɔ̃ Yerusalem agboi lɛ eko mli kɛba maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibama maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Yerusalem mli mɔji lɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ agbe.'"
18: Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Tee shi ni oya gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shīa lɛ mli, ni jɛi mikɛ bo baawie yɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ miyiŋ mitee gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shīa lɛ mli, ni miyanina lɛ ni eta egbɛshɔ̃ɔ tsɔne lɛ sɛɛ eetsu nii.
Mina akɛ kɛji nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shɔ̃ɔ lɛ fite yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, esaa ekpɔtɔɔ su lɛ mli ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛshɔ̃ɔ nɔ kroko ni saa ehiɛ bɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Ao! Israelbii, aso esaaa akɛ mifeɔ nyɛ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ fee sū ni gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ midɛŋ.
Be fɛɛ be ni makɛɛ yɛ maŋ ko loo maŋtsɛyeli ko he akɛ mafã lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ koni majwara lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ lɛ,
kɛji nakai maŋ ni miwie ehe lɛ kpa amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ feemɔ lɛ, mitsakeɔ mijwɛmɔ, ni efɔŋ ni mito akɛ mibafee amɛ lɛ mifeee.
Ni be fɛɛ be ni makɛɛ yɛ maŋ ko loo maŋtsɛyeli ko he akɛ mãmã lɛ mãmã shi, ni eshwere lɛ,
kɛji nakai maŋ lɛ loo maŋtsɛyeli lɛ fee efɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni ebooo migbee toi lɛ, no lɛ mibafo ekpakpa ni mito akɛ mibafee lɛ lɛ mli.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛɛmɔ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ akɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ amɛ nɛ, 'Naa, misusu nyɛhe efɔŋ, ni mikɔ nyɛyi tɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akpa ejeŋba gbonyo lɛ, ni etsake esu kɛ enifeemɔnii fɔŋ lɛ.'
Shi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Oowie eflo; nɔ ni wɔfeɔ lɛ, wɔbaafee ŋmɛnɛ wɔbaafee wɔ. Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baaye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui naa sane bɔ ni esumɔɔ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "nyɛbia yɛ majimaji lɛ amli akɛ namɔ enu nɛkɛ sane dã? Israel, oblayoo fro lɛ efee nɔ fɔŋ ni yɔɔ gbeyei.
Ani snoo ekpa nyɔɔ yɛ Lebanon gɔji anɔ pɛŋ? Ani gɔji lɛ anɔ nu egbi dã, ani nu ŋanii ni hoɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo dã?
Shi mi lɛ, mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpa minɔ, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa yaka nyɔŋmɔi Amɛtrɛtrɛɛ yɛ blema gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛje teŋpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyanyiɛ nane gbɛi anɔ.
Amɛhã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ, ni abaabo lɛ 'tsia!' Daa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho lɛ he aaajɔ̃ ehe, ni eeehoso eyitso.
Mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, tamɔ mlu ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ etswa. Mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã, ni mikwɛŋ amɛ kwraa yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpãŋã Yeremia yinɔ, akɛni osɔfoi yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔyɛ mɛi ni baatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ mla lɛ naa, ni nilelɔi yɛ ni baawo wɔ ŋaa, ni gbalɔi hu baahi shi amɛgba amɛhã wɔ. Nyɛbaa koni wɔkɛ wɔlilɛi afitea lɛ, ni nyɛkahãa wɔboa ewiemɔ kome flo toi."
No hewɔ lɛ misɔle mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Yehowa, ofai nɛ, bo mi toi; asaŋ obo mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ hu toi.
Aso efɔŋ moŋ akɛtoɔ ekpakpa najiaŋ? Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛtsa bu amɛhã mi koni migbee mli. Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni midamɔ ohiɛ ni mikpa fai mihã amɛ koni omli ni efu amɛ lɛ sɛɛ afo.

No hewɔ lɛ hã amɛbii lɛ lɛ aye hɔmɔ, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛnyɔnyɔɔi yɛ klaŋte naa; hã amɛŋamɛi lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi kɛ mɛi ni amɛmusuŋbii egboi yɛ amɛhe. Gbele hela abagbe amɛteŋ hii lɛ, ni amɛblahii lɛ anyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa yɛ ta mli.
Be ni ooohã henyɛlɔi aaabashwie amɛnɔ trukaa lɛ, hã ni anu blɔmɔ yɛ amɛshīaiaŋ, ejaakɛ amɛtsa bu amɛhã mi koni migbee mli, ni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mi tsɔnei hu koni madu.
Shi Yehowa, bo lɛ ole miyinɔ apam ni amɛyaa lɛ. Okɛ efɔŋ ni amɛfee nɛɛ akafa amɛ; kaaku ohiɛ ofɔ̃ amɛhe eshai lɛ anɔ. Hã abutu amɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni okɛ amɛ aye be mli ni omli efu lɛ."
19: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yaa ni oyahe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ sū kpulu, ni oŋɔ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ofata ohe,
ni okɛ amɛ atsɔ̃ Gbɛshɔ̃lɔ Agbo lɛ mli kɛyaa Hinom bi lɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli, koni oshiɛ wiemɔi ni makɛɛ bo lɛ yɛ jɛi.

Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi. Mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ mibahã sane fɔŋ aye maŋ nɛɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ he baajɔ̃ ehe.

Ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ ekwa mi, ni amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma ni amɛshãa amɛhãa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ tete hu leee lɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ tete hu leee lɛ ebule maŋ lɛ; asaŋ amɛfɔse mɛi ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ lɛ alã amɛshwie biɛ obɔ̃.
Ni amɛmamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi yɛ Baal jamɔhei lɛ, ni amɛshãa amɛmusuŋbii yɛ nɔ akɛ shãa afɔle amɛhãa Baal. Mifãko amɛ, ni nakai nɔ ko bako mijwɛŋmɔ mli tete dã.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, be miiba, ni atsɛŋ he ni wɔyɔɔ nɛɛ Tofet loo Hinom jɔɔ dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ abaatsɛ biɛ akɛ Gbɔmɔgbee Jɔɔ.

Mahã Yudabii kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii ayiŋtoi fɛɛ afee yaka yɛ biɛ. Mahã amɛnyɔnyɔɔi yɛ klaŋte naa yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni taoɔ amɛ efɔŋ amɛfee lɛ ahiɛ. Mahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi aye amɛgbohii lɛ.
Mahã maŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ, ni abaabo lɛ 'tsia' Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho lɛ he aaajɔ̃ ehe, ni ebaabo 'tsia' yɛ amanehulu ni maŋ lɛ ena lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ henyelɔi baasa maŋ lɛ yi, ni ebaafi maŋbii lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni fɔlɔi baaye amɛmusuŋ bihii kɛ amɛbiyei, ni mɛi baagbe amɛnanemɛi amɛye.'
"No sɛɛ lɛ ojwa kpulu lɛ yɛ hii ni kɛ bo baaya jɛi lɛ ahiɛ,

ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ. 'Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ majwa maŋ nɛɛ, ni mibakpãtã emli bii ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ajwaa gbɛshɔ̃lɔ kpulu ni ehiii tsramɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ. Tofet nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ he ni mɛi baafu amɛgbohii yɛ, ejaakɛ anaŋ he ko he ko ni abaafu gbohii yɛ dɔŋŋ.
Bɔ ni mibafee maŋ nɛɛ kɛ emli bii lɛ nɛ, ebaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Tofet.

Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli shīai kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi awei fɛɛ he ni ashãshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ amɛtsui lɛ ayiteiaŋ akɛhã ŋulamii, asaŋ ni akɛ dãa shwie shi ahã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi yɛ jɛi lɛ, abaabule amɛ fɛɛ tseɛm tamɔ Tofet.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia jɛ Tofet, he ni Yehowa tsu lɛ akɛ eyagba yɛ lɛ eba, ni ebadamɔ Yehowa sɔlemɔwe lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ,
"Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Naa, efɔŋ fɛɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mibafee maŋ nɛɛ kɛ ehe majimaji lɛ, mibafee amɛ kɛ̃, ejaakɛ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi.'"
20: Be ni Yeremia gba nɛkɛ gbalɛi nɛɛ lɛ, Osɔfo Pashur, Imer bi lɛ, ni lɛji Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli tsulɔnukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ, nu nɔ ni Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Pashur hã agwao Gbalɔ Yeremia, ni no sɛɛ lɛ abɔ lɛ apã yɛ Benyamin Agbo lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yiteŋgbɛ lɛ naa.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Pashur fɛne Yeremia yɛ apã lɛ mli sɛɛ lɛ, Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa tsɛŋ ogbɛi akɛ Pashur dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ abaatsɛ bo 'Gbeyeinɔ, yɛ he fɛɛ he;

ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ akɛ. 'Naa, mahã otsɔ̃ gbeyeinɔ ohã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ onanemɛi fɛɛ, ni ohiŋmɛi jwere nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛaanyɔnyɔɔi yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi aklaŋte naa. Majɔɔ Yuda fɛɛ nɔ mawo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni ebaaŋɔ maŋbii lɛ kɛaatee Babilon ni ebaaya eyagbe amɛ kɛ klaŋte.

Asaŋ maŋ nɛɛ nii ni eyɔɔ kɛ nii ni egbo he deŋme kɛna kɛ enibii ni jra wa hã lɛ kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi ajwetrii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ majɔɔ nɔ mahã maŋbii lɛ ahenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni amɛbaaha ni amɛshɔ̃ yɛ maŋbii lɛ adɛŋ ni amɛbaaloo kɛya Babilon.
Ni bo Pashur tuuŋtu lɛ, abaaŋɔ bo kɛ oshīa mli bii fɛɛ nom kɛaatee Babilon. Jɛi oooyagbo yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ aaafu bo kɛ onanemɛi fɛɛ ni ogba amale gbalɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ yɛ.
Ao! Yehowa, olaka mi, ni mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni alaka lɛ. Oyɛ hewalɛ fe mi, ni oye minɔ. Mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni aŋmɔɔ lɛ daa jenamɔ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ po yeɔ mihe fɛo.
Be fɛɛ be ni miwieɔ lɛ, ja miblɔ; miblɔɔ akɛ, "Yiwalɛ sɔŋŋ" Kɛ "niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ." Ejaakɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ abɔɔ mi ahora, ni ayeɔ mihe fɛo daa jenamɔ.
Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, "Mitsiŋ Yehowa tã ni miwieŋ yɛ egbɛi mli dɔŋŋ lɛ," minuɔ he yɛ mitsuiŋ akɛ nɔ ko miitso tamɔ la ni atsi naa awo miwui amli. La nɛɛ naatsii etɔ mi, ni minyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ.

Minuɔ akɛ aawie ablɛbi akɛ, "He fɛɛ he efee gbeyei, Nyɛflɔa enaa, nyɛhãa wɔflɔa enaa!" Minanemɛi tete ni kɛɔ enɛ nɛɛ, ni amɛmiikwɛ akɛ minane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ lo. Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Eko lɛ aaalaka lɛ ni wɔnine aaashɛ enɔ, ni wɔɔtɔ wɔhe owele yɛ enɔ."
Shi Yehowa kɛ mi yɛ eji kãkãlɔ ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei. No hewɔ lɛ miyiwalɔi lɛ baatɛrɛ amɛhiɛ baagbo kpɔtɔkpɔtɔɔ, ejaakɛ amɛyeŋ minɔ kunim. Amɛhiɛgble lɛ, hiɛ kpaŋ nɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ao, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ ni okaa jalɔ okwɛɔ, ni onaa etsuiŋ kɛ eyitsoŋ saji fɛɛ, hã mana amɛnɔ owele ni obaatɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mitu misane lɛ miwo odɛŋ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi. Ehereɔ ohiafo yiwala yɛ yiwala adɛŋ.
Alomɔ gbi ni afɔ mi lɛ, gbi nɔ ni minyɛ fɔ mi lɛ akajɔɔ nakai gbi lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Alomo nuu ni bakɛɛ mitsɛ akɛ, "Afɔ binuu ahã bo," ni no hã emii shɛ ehe lɛ.
Nakai nuu lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ maji ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni amɛnii efeee lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ. Hã enu blɔmɔ he leebi kɛ tayaa oshebɔɔ he shwane,
ejaakɛ egbeee mi ewooo minyɛ musuŋ koni minyɛ musuŋ atsɔ̃ migbonyobu koni musu lɛ ahi ehe kɛya naanɔ.
Mɛɛba kwraa mijɛ musuŋ mije kpo koni mibagbo deŋme ni maye awerɛhoo ni mijeŋshihilɛ naagbee afee hiɛgble nɛkɛ?
21: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie nɛ, be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia tsu Malikia bi Pashur kɛ Maaseia bi Osɔfo Zefania kɛtee Yeremia ŋɔɔ ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Ofai nɛ, bi Yehowa nii ohã wɔ, ejaakɛ Nebukanezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ efã ta ebatua wɔ. Eko lɛ aleee nɔ Yehowa aaafee enaakpɛɛnii lɛ eko yɛ wɔhewɔ koni no ahã Nebukadnezar kɛ eta lɛ aku esɛɛ kɛya."
Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia kɛɛ amɛ akɛ,

"Nyɛyakɛa Maŋtsɛ Zedekia akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Naa, mibakpãtã tawuunii ni nyɛhiɛ ni nyɛkɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi Kaldeabii ni esa nyɛyi yɛ Yerusalem gbogboi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ wuɔ lɛ; mibabua fɛɛ naa kɛba maŋ lɛ teŋ.
Mibagri, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ moŋ mikɛ nyɛ baawu kɛ nineshwalɛ yɛ mlifu kɛ mlila na.
Ni mibatswia maŋ nɛɛ mli gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ anii, ni gbele hela ni yɔɔ gbeyei baagbegbee amɛ.

Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ etsuji kɛ maŋbii fɛɛ ni ahe baaje gbele hela lɛ loo klaŋte naa gbele lɛ loo hɔmɔ naa gbele lɛ mli lɛ, majɔɔ amɛnɔ mahã Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukanezar kɛ maŋbii ahenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ maŋbii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ, ni Nebukadner baagbe amɛ yɛ Klaŋte naa. Enaŋ mɔbɔ lɛ, emusuŋ eshaŋ lɛ, ni ehaŋ mɔ ko aye ehe hu.'
"Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ Yerusalembii lɛ akɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, 'Naa, mikɛ wala gbɛ kɛ gbele gbɛ fɛɛ miishwie nyɛhiɛ.

Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahi maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ta mli loo kɛtsɔ̃ hɔmɔ nɔ loo kɛtsɔ̃ gbele hela nɔ. Shi mɔ ni baaje kpo eya koni ekɛ ehe ayahã Babilonbii ni ebasa nyɛyi yɛ nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã ni ewala aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ ahuutoonii ni ena yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ mijie mihiɛ mika maŋ nɛɛ akɛ efɔŋ ji nɔ ni mibafee amɛ; shi jeee ekpakpa. Aaatu maŋ eeema enaa lá, ni eeehã lɛ wɛɛ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi koni mikɛɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ we lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi,

Nyɛ David shwie! Nyɛyea jalɛ sane be fɛɛ be. Mɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ amim lɛ nyɛhea lɛ yɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ amim lɛ dɛŋ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ no lɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii fɔ̃ɔji lɛ ahemɔ lɛ, mimlila aaatso yɛ nyɛnɔ tamɔ la, ni ebaatso, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ agbe."
Naa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, mikɛ nyɛ ena. Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Namɔ baanyɛ wɔ ebatua, ni namɔ baanyɛ egbu kɛbabote wɔmaŋ lɛ mli?"
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Shi naa, mibagbla nyɛtoi yɛ yibii ni nyɛjeŋba ewo lɛ naa. Mibama nyɛkoo lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni bɔle lɛ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
22: Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Okɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ aya Yuda maŋtsɛ we lɛ,
ni oyakɛɛ akɛ, 'Bo Yuda maŋtsɛ ni ota Maŋtsɛ David sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, bo kɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋbii ni tsɔ̃ɔ agboi nɛɛ amli kɛyaa kɛbaa, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi.

Yehowa kɛɛ nyɛkojoa yɛ jalɛ naa, ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane; ni nyɛherea mɔ ni aaye lɛ amim lɛ yɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ amim lɛ dɛŋ; ni nyɛkafea gbɔ loo awusa loo okulafo efɔŋ; asaŋ nyɛkawaa amɛyi; ni nyɛkashwiea mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá shi yɛ biɛ.

Anɔkwa, kɛji nyɛye wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ David shwiei lɛ baaya nɔ ata David maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsuji lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋbii lɛ baaya nɔ atra tayaa shwiili amli kɛ okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ agboi nɛɛ amli kɛya kɛba.
Shi kɛji nyɛbuuu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.'"
Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ he ji akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ, otamɔ Gilead kɛhã mi; asaŋ otamɔ Lebanon gɔji lɛ hu moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mahã otsɔ̃ shiaŋa, maŋ ni adesa ko adesa ko ehiii mli.
Majie nifitelɔi ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ elema mawo bo; ni amɛbaatoo otsenedru tsei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ni amɛbaaloo amɛwo la mli.

"Ni majiamaji anɔ bii pii aaabatsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ he kɛho, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaabi akɛ, 'Meni hewɔ ni Yehowa fee maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ? Abaajie naa akɛ, 'Ejaakɛ amɛkwa kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ amɛ kɛ Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, teŋ lɛ, ni amɛyaja nyɔmɔi krokomɛi moŋ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ.'"
Nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛkafoa Maŋtsɛ Yosia mɔ ni egbo lɛ, ni nyɛkayea ehe ŋkɔmɔ hu. Shi moŋ nyɛfoa waa nyɛhãa Yoahaz mɔ ni yaa nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ ekuŋ esɛɛ ebaŋ dɔŋŋ. Ni enaŋ ejaku shikpɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi Yoahaz mɔ ni baye etsɛ sɛɛ akɛ, "Yuda maŋtsɛ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee lɛ he nɛ, ekuŋ esɛɛ ebaŋ biɛ dɔŋŋ,
shi he ni aŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee lɛ jɛi eeegbo yɛ, ni ehiŋmɛi enaŋ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ!"
Kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ juu kɛfɔ̃ nɔ emaa eshīa ni egbleɔ mli kɛtsɔ̃ɔ shishiumɔ nɔ; mɔ ni hãa enaanyo tsuɔ nii hãa lɛ eflo, ni ewooo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Mana shīa kpeteŋkple kɛ emli ŋwɛitsui ni dra." Ejieɔ samfɛji ewoɔ he ni eke tsenedru tso kaa mu eshaa he kɛ ama tsura fɔɔ.
Ani osusuɔ akɛ tsenedru mple ni oshiɔ lɛ no feɔ bo maŋtsɛ? Otsɛ hi shi, ni eye nii, ni enu nii, ni ekojo jalɛ naa, ni eye jalɛ sane, ni no hewɔ lɛ ehi ehã lɛ!
Eye nɔnalɔ kɛ ohiafo sane ehã lɛ; ni no hã ehi ehã lɛ lɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, ohiŋmɛi kɛ otsui kã juukɛfɔ̃ nii kɛ mɛi ni efeko efɔŋ lá shishwiemɔ nɔ. Ni owaa mɛi ayi keketee.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi Yehoakim he nɛ, "Awoŋ yara afoŋ lɛ; akɛŋ lɛ akɛ 'Kpaa Nuŋtsɔ! Ao, kpoo, Maŋtsɛ!'
Aaafu lɛ tamɔ afuɔ teji; aaashãta lɛ ayashɛ afɔ̃ Yerusalem agboi lɛ asɛɛ."
Yerusalem maŋbii, nyɛkwɔa nyɛyaa Lebanon ni nyɛyablɔa; nyɛyaa Bashan nyɛyablɔa, kɛ Moab gɔji lɛ hu anɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛsuɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Be ni oyɔɔ nii pii lɛ, mikɛ bo wie; shi okɛɛ akɛ obooo mi toi. Ojeŋba kwraa nɛ kɛjɛ oblahiaaŋ, oboko mi toi dã.
Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ baaloo olumɛi lɛ kɛya, abaaloo onanemɛi akɛ nomii kɛya; kɛkɛ lɛ ohiɛ aaagbo ni ohiɛ aaashwie shi yɛ onifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkãmɔ Lebanon tsenedru tsui amli shweshweeshwe ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ, kɛji hejramɔ ba lɛ, nyɛaana tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, kɛji bo Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim bi Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin tete po ji wolonaasɔomɔ ga ni yɔɔ mininejuɔ lɛ, minakpɔ o yɛ miwao,
ni matu bo mawo Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnerzar kɛ emaŋbii Babilonbii ni taoɔ bo amɛgbe ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei hu lɛ adɛŋ.
Mibashɛ bo kɛ onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ fɛɛ mafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, he ni jeee jɛmɛ afɔ nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ, ni jɛi nyɛbaagboi yɛ.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛbaashwe akɛ amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba nɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛkuŋ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaŋ jɛi dɔŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Aso Yehoiakin etsɔ̃ mɔ ni abuuu tamɔ nu gbɛ ko ni mɔ ko taooo dɔŋŋ lo? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni ashwie lɛ kɛ ebii ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie shikpɔŋ ko ni amɛleee nɔ nɛɛ?"
Ao Shikpɔŋ, Shikpɔŋ Shikpɔŋ! Bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛŋɔa nuu nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni bɛ bi; mɔ ko ni shwereŋ ewala be mli fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eshwie ko eshwie ko naŋ David sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ eta eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ."
23: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Kpoo hã lumɛi ni kpãtãa miwebii lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛgbɛɔ mitoi lɛ amɛshwãa lɛ.

Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɔ yɛ lumɛi ni kwɛɔ miwebii lɛ anɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, 'Nyɛkwuraaa miwebii lɛ, ni nyɛgbɛ amɛ nyɛshwã, ni nyɛshwie amɛ kɛtee. No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ mibawo nyɛ nyɛifeemɔnii fɔ̃ɔji lɛ ahe nyɔŋmɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mibabua miwebii ni eshwɛshwɛɛ yɛ majimaji ni mishwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ anaa, ni mikɛ amɛ baaba amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ; ni amɛaafɔfɔi, ni amɛyi aaafa pii.
Mato lumɛi, mɛi ni baalɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ; ni amɛsheŋ gbeyei, ni amɛtsui hu efaŋ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko elaajeŋ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
"Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, naa be ko miiba ni matee maŋtsɛ jalɛ saneyelɔ ko shi ni jɛ David mli. Ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ nilee naa, ni ebaakojo jalɛ naa ni ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Lɛ eyinɔ lɛ abaahere Yuda yiwala, ni Israel baahi shi shweshweeshwe; ni gbɛi ni akɛbaatsɛ lɛ ji, 'Yehowa ji wɔjalɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "No hewɔ lɛ naa, be ko miiba ni akɛŋ dɔŋŋ akɛ, 'Mina Yehowa mɔ ni jie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ;'

shi moŋ abaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie ni ekpla Israelbii ashwiei lɛ kɛje kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, hei ni eshwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ kɛba lɛ.' Nakai be mli lɛ amɛbaahi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Mitsui fɛɛ ejwara, ni miwui miikpokpo bliblibli. Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ dãatɔlɔ mɔ ni dãa ekploka lɛ yɛ Yehowa kɛ ewiemɔi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ahewɔ.

Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ mɛi ni jeɔ Yehowa sɛɛ. Jeŋba fɔŋ amɛbaa, ni nɔ fɔŋ mli ekãa amɛfeɔ. Yehowa loomɔ hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye awerɛho, ni ŋa lɛ nɔ hei ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ fɛɛ egbigbii. Amɛjeŋba lɛ efɔŋ ni, ni amɛhewalɛ lɛ amɛkɛfeee nɔ kpakpa.
Gbalɔ kɛ osɔfo fɛɛ lɛ, amɛjeee Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi; ni minaa amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ yɛ miwe lɛ mli tete Yehowa kɛɛ.
Amɛnyiɛmɔhei fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ shikpɔŋ ni shamɔɔ yɛ duŋ mli ahã amɛ; jɛi abaatswiatswia shi, ejaakɛ afi nɔ ni abaagbla amɛtoi lɛ mahã sane gbonyo aye amɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mina esha ni Samaria gbalɔi lɛ fee lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃ Baal nɔ amɛgba, amɛhã mimaŋ Israel du gbɛ.

Shi nɔ mina yɛ Yerusalem gbalɔi lɛ ahe lɛ, eyɛ gbeyei. Amɛfiteɔ gblã, ni amɛmaleɔ; amɛwo efɔŋfeelɔi ahewalɛ, no hewɔ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko kpaaa efɔŋ feemɔ. Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom, ni maŋbii lɛ tamɔ Gomora hã mi.

No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ mikɛɔ yɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahe nɛ, "Naa, mibahã amɛ tatso akɛ amɛniyenii, ni mibahã amɛ nu ni ebɔɔ yɔɔ mli amɛnu, ejaakɛ Yerusalem gbalɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ efɔfeemɔ jɛ ni egbɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ."

Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɔ maŋbii nɛ, "Nyɛkaboa gbalɔi ni gbaa tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ awiemɔi lɛ atoi; amɛmiihã nyɛ yaka hiɛnɔkãmɔ. Nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi kɛɔ amɛ lɛ, no amɛgbaa lɛ, shi jeee nɔ ni jɛ mi, Yehowa, minaa.
Nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ mɛi ni ebuuu mi, Yehowa, miwiemɔ lɛ ji, 'Nɔ ko gbaŋ nyɛnaa; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efee ehe kuɛŋ ti lɔ lɛ amɛkɛɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko bɛ ni baaba onɔ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Amɛteŋ namɔ Yehowa kɛto ajina dã, ni no hewɔ lɛ ena, ni enu Yehowa naa Wiemɔ? Loo amɛteŋ namɔ ebo owie mɔ lɛ toi, ni eye nɔ?
Naa, Yehowa mlifu lɛ, ahum ni, ni efã kɛje kpo tamɔ lasuogbele, ni ebaawula mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ ayi.
Yehowa mlifu lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nɔ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ena efee egba naa. Wɔsɛɛ ko dani nyɛaanu sane nɛɛ shishi jogbaŋŋ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mitsuko gbalɔi nɛɛ; amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ ni amɛgbaa; mikɛ wiemɔ ko woko amɛnaa; shi amɛmiigba yɛ migbɛi mli.
Eji mikɛ amɛ eto ajina lɛɛlɛŋ kulɛ, amɛaahã maŋbii lɛ anu minaa wiemɔi lɛ, ni kulɛ amɛaaha maŋbii lɛ akpa amɛjeŋba fɔŋ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ.
"Aso kɛji mibɛŋkɛ lɛ no dani Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi? Shi kɛji miyɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi lo?"
Aso mɔ ko baanyɛ atee ehe yɛ teemɔhe ko ni minaŋ lɛ yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lo? Yehowa kɛɛ. "Ani jeee mi ni miyi ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ obɔ̃ lɛ? Mi, Yehowa, miibi.
Minu nɔ ni gbalɔi ni gbaa amale gbalɛi yɛ mi, migbɛi mli ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Mila lamɔ ko; mila lamɔ ko lɛ.'
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po ni gbalɔi nɛɛ baajɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsuiia amɛgba amale gbalɛ kɛyashi?
Ani amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛkɛ lamɔi ni amɛgbaa amɛnanemɛi lɛ baahã mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ akpa minɔ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ kpa minɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhã Baal lɛ?
Gbalɔ ni ela lamɔ ko lɛ, egba lamɔ lɛ; ni gbalɔ ni mikɛ miwiemɔ ewo enaa lɛ, ewie wiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale mli. Mɛni tutuu kɛ able yɔɔ jaa?
Ani miwiemɔ lɛ etamɔɔɔ la; ni etamɔɔɔ hamle ni jwaraa tɛsaa mli wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, mikɛ gbalɔi ni ŋɔɔ miwiemɔ yɛ amɛnanemɛi gbalɔi krokomɛi anaa wiemɔ amɛfeɔ amɛnɔ lɛ ena.
Naa, mikɛ gbalɔi ni wieɔ wiemɔi ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsɔ̃, shi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ' lɛ ena." Yehowa kɛɛ.

"Naa, mi Yehowa, mikɛ gbalɔi ni gbaa amale lamɔi lɛ ena. Malemɔ ni amɛmaleɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ miwebii amɛyiŋ flɛflɛ lɛ haa miwebii lɛ duɔ gbɛ. Mitsuko amɛ, ni mifãko amɛ nɛkɛ nitsumɔ hu. No hewɔ lɛ amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko kwraa hã maŋ nɛɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, Yeremia, kɛji maŋ nɛɛ mli bii lɛ eko loo gbalɔ ko loo osɔfo ko bi bo akɛ, 'Mɛni ji Yehowa jatsu lɛ', ohere nɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛ, nyɛ nɔŋŋ ji jatsu lɛ; ni Yehowa baashɛ nyɛ efɔ̃.'
Ni gbalɔ loo osɔfo loo maŋnyo ni kɛ wiemɔ 'Yehowa jatsu lɛ' baafee edaaŋ kotsa lɛ, mibagbla mɔ lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ toi yɛ ehewɔ.
Nɔ ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abi enaanyo kɛ enyɛmi moŋ ji akɛ, 'Mɛi hetoo Yehowa hã,' loo 'Te Yehowa kɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Wiemɔ ni ji 'Yehowa jatsu' lɛ, ekaje mɔ ko naa kwraa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ no etsɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ adaaŋ kotsa, ejaakɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ, ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wiemɔi lɛ ahiɛ nyɛbu shi.
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Yeremia, bi gbalɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ hetoo Yehowa ehã nyɛ? loo 'Te Yehowa kɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Kɛji wiemɔ 'Yehowa jatsu lɛ' je nyɛnaa, be mli ni mitsu abakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ wiemɔ ni ji Yehowa jatsu lɛ akaje nyɛnaa dɔŋŋ, ni wiemɔi nɛɛ eje nyenaa lɛ,
naa, nyɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mibawo mashɛ mafɔ̃ kɛje mihiɛ.
Nyɛhe ahora ni nyɛbaabɔ kɛ nyɛhiɛ ni baagbo kɛya naanɔ lɛ hiɛ ejeŋ nɔ gbi ko gbi ko."
24: Be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukanezar ebaŋɔ Yehoiakim bi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin kɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ kɛ ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃lɔi lɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛtee Babilon sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa jie ninaa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi: Mina agbãmi kɛ kɛntɛŋi enyɔ mamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛŋtɛŋi lɛ ateŋ ekome lɛ agbãmii kpakpka ni tamɔ agbãmi ni tsu klɛŋklɛŋ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ mli. Shi kɛntɛŋ kroko lɛ agbãmii gbohii yɔɔ mli, ni hi ni amɛhii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete.

Yehowa bi mi akɛ, "Yeremia, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?" Mihere nɔ akɛ, "Agbãmii; ni amɛteŋ agbãmii kpakpai lɛ, amɛhi jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ; shi amɛteŋ gbohii lɛ, amɛhiii, ni hi ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhii yeli tete."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ,

"Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mikɛɔ ji akɛ bɔ ni agbãmii kpakpai lɛ hi lɛ, nakai nomi ni jɛ Yuda, mɛi ni mijie kɛjɛ biɛ nɛɛ kɛtee Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ yɛ mihiɛ; majie mlijɔlɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.

Mahã mihiŋmɛi akã amɛhe ni mafee amɛ ekpakpa; ni mikɛ amɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ. Matswa amɛ mãmã shi tamɔ amãa tsu, ni mikumɔŋ amɛ; matɛo amɛ tamɔ atɛoɔ tso, ni mifamɔŋ amɛ mishwieŋ.
Mibahã amɛ tsui ni baahã amɛle mi akɛ miji Yehowa; ni amɛbaatsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mibatsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ.

"Shi nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, bɔ ni mibafee agbãmii gbohii nɛɛ ni hi ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete lɛ, nakai mibafee Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ mai ni yɔɔ Egipt Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mibahã amɛtsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ; ni abaaye amɛhe fɛo, ni abaabɔ amɛ ahora ni amɛ ba atsɔmɔ mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ yɛ heifɛɛ ni mi bagbɛ amɛ mashwã kɛya lɛ.
Mibahã ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela abote amɛteŋ kɛyashi abaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ."
25: Afi nɔ ni Yosia bi Yehoiakim na afii ejwɛ akɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Nebukadnezar hu na afi akɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie Yuda maŋbii fɛɛ ahe;
ni mikɛɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ hu akɛ,

"Afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ nɛ, kɛjɛ Amon bi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wieɔ, ni mi hi mikɛɔ nyɛ be fɛɛ be nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, shi nyɛbooo toi.
Yehowa etsu etsuji fɛɛ ni ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔŋŋ; shi nyɛbooo toi lɛ, nyɛyeee nɔ hu.
Amɛbakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akpa ejeŋba gbonyo kɛ enifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ aahuu kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkasɔ̃mɔa ni nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛniji akafea amãgãi ni nyɛja amɛ nyɛkɛwo mimli la, ni mifee nyɛ efɔŋ.'
'Shi Yehowa kɛɛ nyɛbooo lɛ toi, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛninenaa amãgãi ni nyɛfee lɛ wo emli la, ni nyɛkɛye nyɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛhe awui.'
"No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, 'Akɛni nyɛbooo miwiemɔi lɛ atoi hewɔ lɛ,

naa, mibatsu koni ayaŋɔ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ anɔ bii lɛ kɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hu abahã mi, ni mahã amɛfã ta kɛbatua Yuda shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɛ enɔ bii lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ ni aboɔ lɛ 'tsia!' Ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi kɛya naanɔ.
Asaŋ mibahã nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ ayɛmfrowu kɛ ayɛmfro gbee lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ jɛi; anaŋ mc ko ni koto wiesɛɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ, anaŋ kane ni asu yɛ jɛi he ko he ko.
Shikpɔŋ tso muu nɛɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shiaŋa tete; ni majimaji nɛɛ baasɔ̃mɔ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ afii nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Shi afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mibagbla Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ toi yɛ niifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛbaafee lɛ hewɔ; ni mahã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mahã wiemɔi fɛɛ ni miwie mishi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni ji nii fɛɛ ni Yeremia gba shi majimaji lɛ, ni aŋmã yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, aba mli.
Ejaakɛ mawo Babilonbii lɛ anyɔmɔ yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii kɛ amɛninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji baaye amɛ nyɔŋ.'"
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Hemɔ wain kpulu nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ; mlifu ji wain ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; ni ohã majimaji fɛɛ ni mibatsu bo amɛŋɔɔ lɛ anu eko.
Amɛbaanu, ni amɛbaadidãa, ni amɛbaaye sɛkɛ tete yɛ ta ni mibahã afã kɛbatua amɛ lɛ hewɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni mihe kpulu lɛ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; ni mihã majimaji fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu mi amɛŋɔɔ lɛ nu wain lɛ. Mɛi ni nu ji,
Yerusalem kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji wuji lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ mɛi kɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shiaŋa kɛ nɔ ni aboɔ lɛ "tsia" kɛ loo mɔ nɔ tamɔ eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Mɛi krokomɛi hu ni nu Yehowa mlifu lɛ eko nɛ: Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ,
kɛ maŋsɛɛbii ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ hu. Uz shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Ashkelon kɛ Gaza kɛ Ekron kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli hu fɛɛ nu eko.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Edombii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Amonbii lɛ,
kɛ Tiro maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Sidon maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ,
kɛ Dedan maŋ lɛ kɛ Tema maŋ lɛ kɛ Buz maŋ lɛ hu kɛ gbɔmɛi komɛi ni shɛɔ amɛyitsei ahe lɛ.
Mɛi krokomɛi hu ji Arabia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ futufutu gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ mli lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ,
Kɛ Zimri maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Elam maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Media maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ,

Kɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ. Je lɛ mli maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ asa amɛnaa mlifu wain lɛ eko. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hu aaanu eko.
"Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, nyɛnua, nyɛtrɔa daã, ni nyɛgbegbea shi ni nyɛkanyɛ shi nyɛte dɔŋŋ yɛ ta ni mibahã afã kɛbatua nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.'
Shi kɛji amɛmiii akɛ amɛaahe kpulu lɛ yɛ odɛŋ ni amɛnu lɛ, no lɛ, okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ ji, 'Ja nyɛna nyɛnu kɛ̃!

Ejaakɛ naa, kɛ mije shishi miifee maŋ wulu ni akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛ lɛ ni nyɛŋɔɔ nyɛhe nyɛyeɔ tswaa hu?' Nyɛŋɔŋ nyɛhe nyɛyeŋ nakai, ejaakɛ miihã afã ta kɛbatua nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ. Mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ mikɛɛ.
