Ejaakɛ nyɛ Moabbii, akɛni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nyɛhewalɛ lɛ kɛ nyɛjwetrii lɛ anɔ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu abaaŋɔ nyɛ nom. Abaaŋɔ nyɛwɔŋ Kemosh lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm hu nom.
Hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ baafite maŋ fɛɛ maŋ. Maŋ ko maŋ ko he ejeŋ mli, jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã, ni abaafite ŋa kplanaa lɛ hu. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Nyɛhãa Moab fiji koni ekɛfliki kɛya, ejaakɛ amaji lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.
(Alomɔ mɔ ni tsuɔ Yehowa nitsumɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ lɛ, ni alomɔ mɔ hu ni kɛ eklaŋte egbeŋ mɔ lɛ!)"
"Moab yɛ hejɔlɛ mli kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ ni eyɛ shweshweeshwe; atsɔ̃ko lɛ kɛjɛko nɔ kome mli awoko nɔ kroko mli dã; Aŋɔko lɛ nom dã, no hewɔ lɛ etamɔ dã ani enaanu gboko dã, ni eŋma hu tsakeko.
"No hewɔ lɛ gbi ko miiba, Yehowa kɛɛ, be ni mibawo mɛi agbɛ kɛba koni amɛbafɔse Moab amɛshwie tamɔ afɔseɔ dãa ashwieɔ shi ni amɛjwara lɛ dukuduku tamɔ ajwaraa tɔi lɛ.
kɛkɛ lɛ kemosh baawo Maobbii hiɛgble tamɔ bɔ ni Betel, ni Israelbii ahiɛ kã enɔ lɛ, wo Israel hiɛgble lɛ.
"Moabbii, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, kãkãlɔi kɛ ta mli kãkãlɔi ji wɔ?
Moab kɛ emaji lɛ ahiɛ akpãtã nɛɛ; ni amɛmli hii kãkãlɔi lɛ hu ni enyɔnyɔi nɛɛ. Mi, Maŋtsɛ ni atsɛɔ mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ,mi mikɛɛ.
Moab hiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, ni emanehulu lɛ eshɛ shi etã.
"nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɛŋkɛ Moab, nyɛyea lɛ ŋkɔmɔ; kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛle bɔ ni egbɛi ehehe, nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Te aye tɛŋŋ ni otsi wulu lɛ kɛ otsiamɛtso ekumɔ nɛɛ?'
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Dibon, nyɛshia nyɛbojee sɛɛ nyɛkplekea shi nyɛbatraa shikpɔŋ mlu mli, ejaakɛ Moab hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ ete shi ewo nyɛ, ni ekumɔ nyɛmɔji lɛ eshwie shi.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Aroer, nyɛdamɔa gbɛ lɛ he nyɛsraa koni nyɛbia mɔ ni ena foijee he gbɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, akɛ 'Mɛni eba?'
Amɛbaahere nɔ akɛ, 'Ashwie Moab hiɛ shi, ejaakɛ akpãtã ehiɛ; Nyɛgbaa yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kpokpai an akɛ akpãtã Moab hiɛ!'
"Akpãtã maji ni jwere gɔji lɛ ayiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ nɔ lɛ ahiɛ. Amɛji Holon kɛ Yaza kɛ Mefat,
Dibon kɛ Nebo Bet-diblataim,
kɛ Kirataim kɛ Bet-Gamul kɛ Bet-Meon,
Kɛ Keriot kɛ Bozra kɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ kɛ kpaakpa fɛɛ.
Moab akloŋte ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ, akpɔ, ni akpãtã ehewalɛ lɛ hiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa Moab atɔa dãa, ejaakɛ ewo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa nɔ. Moab baakoklo shi yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ eshwee ni eshwe mli, ni abaaŋmɔ lɛ.
Te oŋmɔ Israel? Ani ona Israel akɛ efutu julɔi ateŋ hewɔ ni be fɛɛ be ni oootsi etã lɛ ohosoɔ oyitso lɛ?
"Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Moab, nyɛshia nyɛmaji wuji lɛ amli koni nyɛbahia tɛkploi amli. Nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe tamɔ okpo ni feɔ etsu yɛ gɔji afɔjiaŋ.
Wɔnu bɔ ni Moab wo ehe nɔ ehã; etsɛ ehe tsɔ̃. Anu ehenɔwomɔ kɛ ntɛŋ feemɔ kɛ ehetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ ekuɛŋtimɔ lɛ.
Mile shwãa ni eshwã lɛ. Eshwãa ni eshwã lɛ kɛ enifeemɔnii fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni.
No hewɔ lɛ mawo yara yɛ Moabbii ahewɔ; mafo Moabbii fɛɛ; mafo, maye Kir-Heresbii ŋkɔmɔ.
Ao Sibma, mafo bo febɔ ni mafo Yazer. Sibma, otamɔ waintso, ni ohe niji etelke ŋoo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛtee kɛyashɛ Yazer tɔ̃ɔ. Shi naa, otsei ayibii kɛ owainyibii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.
Nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ sɛɛ efo yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ nɔ. Mihã wain tsereee yɛ wain bui amli dɔŋŋ; mɔ ko eŋaaa wain yɛ jɛi kɛ nyamɔ lala; blɔmɔ ni anuɔ lɛ ejeee miishɛɛ blɔmɔ.
"Heshbonbii kɛ Elealebii miiblɔ, ni aanu amɛblɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ Yahaz. Anu blɔmɔ lɛ kɛjɛ Zoar aahuu kɛtee Horanaim kɛ Eglat-Shelishiya tɔ̃ɔ, ejaakɛ Nimrim Faa lɛ tete eŋla.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ mibahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shãa afɔle yɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni shãa tsofakɛŋma hãa Moab nyɔŋmɔi lɛ akpa feemɔ.
"No hewɔ lɛ Moabbii kɛ Kir-Heresbii ahe ŋkɔmɔ miibo yɛ mitsui mli tamɔ awerɛho lala ni aakpã kɛ bɛlɛ, ejaakɛ amɛjwetrii fɛɛ ni amɛtīa lɛ efee yaka.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ eshɛ eyi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ eku etsɛŋ, abamɔbamɔɔ niji ahe, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ kpekpe eŋmɔ ehɛ akɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli he okadi.
Moab tsui ayiteiaŋ fɛɛ kɛ eblohuiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ayeɔ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ mijwara Moab tamɔ kpulu ni mɔ ko mɔ ko taooo.
Te akpãtã Moab hiɛ ahã tɛŋŋ nɛɛ? Kwɛ bɔ ni emli bii lɛ ewo yara! kwɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ esɛɛ ehã henyɛlɔ kɛ hiɛgble. Etsɔ̃ fɛoyeli nɔ kɛ gbeyei nɔ ehã maji fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa mɔ ko baaba ebayi Moab nɔ gleŋ tamɔ okropɔŋ ni egbɛ efijiaŋ,
ni ebaaŋɔ Moab maji ni ebaashɔ̃ emɔji lɛ. Ni nakai be lɛ Moab hii kãkãlɔi lɛ atsui aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ tsui.
Abaakpãtã Moab hiɛ bɔ ni etsɔŋ maŋ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ ewo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa nɔ.
Ao, Moabbii, tsuifãa saji kɛ bui ni atsatsaa kɛ tsɔnei ni atsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ miimɛ nyɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mɔ ni aaajo gbeyei lɛ naa foi lɛ, eeeyagbee bu lɛ mli; ni mɔ ni aaakwɔ kɛje bu lɛ mli lɛ, eeeyadu tsɔne lɛ. Ejaakɛ mahã nɛkɛ jramɔi nɛɛ aba Moabbii anɔ, afi nɔ ni mibagbla amɛtoi lɛ.
Foijelɔi ni amɛtɔ biti tao hejɔɔmɔhe yɛ Heshbon hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli, shi la efã kɛjɛ Heshbon; la lilɛi efã kɛjɛ Maŋtsɛ Sihon we lɛ. Eshã Moab hiɛnaa ni ji bii hoofeelɔi lɛ apampam.
Ao Moab, kpoo hã bo. Kemosh egbe ejeŋ naa, ejaakɛ aŋɔ emli bihii lɛ nom, ni amɔmɔ yei lɛ hu nyɔji.
Shi naagbee mli aahuu lɛ, mibahã Moab nine ashɛ nibii ni eŋmɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ, 'Bɔ ni mikɛ Moab baaye mahã kɛyatã nɛ.'"
49: Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Amonbii ahe nɛ, "Ani Israel bɛ bihii, aloo Israel bɛ mɛi ni yeɔ enii hewɔ ni mɛi ni jaa wɔŋ Molek lɛ eba ŋɔ Gadbii ashikpɔŋ, ni amɛbahi jɛi maji lɛ amli lɛ?

Naa, mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ be miiba, be ni mahã mɛi ni yɔɔ Amonbii amaŋ wulu Raba lɛ mli anu ta oshebɔɔ he. Ebaatsɔ̃ koikoi, ni abaashã ekrowai lɛ wɛɛ kɛmɔ shi, ni Israel baaye mɛi ni baye enɔ lɛ anɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.

Ao Heshbon, wɔ lele, shi akpãtã Ai maŋ lɛ hiɛ. Nyɛ Raba yei, nyɛfoa,nyɛmiaa kɛ kpekpe, nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ, nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ koowieiaŋ, ejaakɛ abaaloo nyɛwɔŋ Molek kɛ ewulɔmɛi lɛ kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛya nomŋɔɔ mli.
Nyɛni nyɛshwãa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli, mɛɛba ni nyɛshwaã nyɛfɔ̃ɔ nyɛ hewalɛ ni mugbojɔ nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Namɔ baanyɛ shi ete ewo wɔ?'

Naa, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nyɛ ji akɛ mibahã mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle nyɛ abahɛŋ nyɛ kɛ tsuifãa sane, ni abaashwiei nyɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baajo foi bɔ ni ekwɛŋ esɛɛ tete, ni mɔ ko ehiŋ shi ni baabua foijelɔi lɛ anaa.
Shi naagbee mli lɛ mibahã Amonbii anine ashɛ nibii ni eŋmɛɛ amɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Edombii ahe nɛ, "Ani nilee bɛ Teman dɔŋŋ? Ani ŋaawoo elaaje hiɛshikãlɔi lo? Ani amɛnilee etã?
Nyɛ Dedanbii, nyɛdɔa nyɛyi, ni nyɛjoa foi nyɛyatea nyɛhe yɛ nififiaŋ bui amli, ejaakɛ mibahã amanehulu aba Esaubii anɔ.
kɛji wainnyibiitselɔi ba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, ani amɛshii yibii lɛ ashishi ni aye lɛ kpɛkpɛo lo? Aloo kɛji julɔi tete ba oŋmɔshiniijuu nyɔɔŋ lɛ, amɛjuuu bɔpɛ ni amɛtaoɔ lo?
Shi naa, mi lɛ mifee Esaubii pasaa; mijie amɛteemɔhei lɛ akpo, ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛhe amɛtee dɔŋŋ. Akpãtã Edombii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi kɛ amɛshwiei kɛ amɛnanemɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ. ŋmɛnɛ, Edom bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ.
Shi owusai lɛ ohã mi; mibakwɛ amɛnɔ shweshweeshwe; ni hã okulafoi lɛ ahe mi aye."
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɔ, "Kɛji mɛi ni kulɛ esaaa akɛ agblaa amɛtoi lɛ abaagbla amɛtoi lɛ, ani bo lɛ obaaye ohe? Oŋɔŋ ohe oyeŋ tswaa; esa akɛ agbla otoi kɛ̃.
Ejaakɛ mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ bozra sane lɛ baafee gbeyei, abaabɔ lɛ ahora, ni abaakpãtã ehiɛ ni akɛ egbɛi baakã kitã ni emaji fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ."
Minu saji ni jɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ; ni awo bɔfo hu gbɛ kɛtee majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, "Nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi anaa kɛkpea koni nyɛbatuaa Edom.
Ejaakɛ naa, mibaba bo shi kwraa yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni ohe guɔ baagbo yɛ mɛi ahiɛ.

Bɔ mɔ ni ohɔ tɛkplo mli, kɛ bo mɔ hu ni oyɔɔ gɔ̃ŋ yiteŋ, oshishiu bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ gbeyei ni owo ohe kɛ ni owo lɛ. kɛji oshihilɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ niiaŋ tete po tamɔ okropɔŋ feɔ lɛ, mibaba bo shi." Yehowa, kɛɛ.
"Edom sane baatsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ, ni mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ Edom he kɛho lɛ baashe gbeyei, ni ebaabo lɛ 'gbeeakle'.
Bɔ ni atsɔ abutu Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ amɛhewɔ maji lɛ, mi Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee Edom bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi, ni mɔ ko hu eyatoŋ gbɔ yɛ jɛi, ni mɔ ko hu eyatoŋ gbɔ yɛ jɛi.

Naa, bɔ ni jata fãa kɛjɛɔ Yordan Faa he koo hayii mli kɛbaa ebatuaa too ku yɛ amɛniyelihe lɛ, nakai mibaba trukaa, ni mahã Edombii ajo foi amɛshi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mi, mibato mɔ ni misumɔɔ koni eye Edom nɔ. Ejaakɛ namɔ kɛmi ye egbɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛboa yiŋ ni mi, Yehowa, mito yɛ Edom he, kɛ nɔ ni mikpãŋ akɛ mafee Temanbii toi. Abaashãtã amɛbii bibii lɛ tete po kɛaatee, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he baajra lɛ yɛ nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ hewɔ.
Edom shigbeemɔ lɛ baahã shikpɔŋ tete ahoso, ni blɔmɔ ni amɛbaablɔ lɛ abaanu yɛ Akaba Bele lɛ kpokpai anɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Naa, nakai be lɛ mɔ ko baagba shi shwiaa kɛba tamɔ okropɔŋ ni egbɛ efijiaŋ kɛbatua Bozra, ni Edom hii kãkãlɔi lɛ atsui baatsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni mikɔ̃mɔ tsui."
Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Damaskobii ahe nɛ, "Hamatbii kɛ Arpadbii ejijaa, ejaakɛ amɛnu sane fɔŋ; amɛtsui efã fe nine, ni amɛyoyro; amɛfee tamɔ ŋshɔ ni efee hamahama ni amɛnaaa hejɔlɛ.
Damaskobii egbɔjɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛsɛɛ koni amɛjo foi; ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ' amɛhe miijra amɛ, ni amɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔ̃mɔ.
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni maŋ ni miishɛɛ yɔɔ mli sa lɛ, ajwa sam ashi lɛ nɛɛ?
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ eblahii lɛ baabyɔnyɔi yɛ eblohuiaŋ, ni abaaplenee etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ. Mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ.
Mama Damasko maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad mɔji lɛ blublu."
Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛɛ Kedar kɛ maji bibii ni yɔɔ Hazor maŋ lɛ shishi ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ye amɛnɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, Bɔ ni, Yehowa, kɛɛ nɛ, "Nyɛtea shi, nyɛyatuaa Kedar, ni nyɛkpãtãa bokãgbɛbii lɛ ahiɛ!
Ashɔ̃ amɛbuui lɛ kɛ amɛbuui lɛ ahe mamai lɛ, aŋɔ amɛtoi lɛ kɛ amɛnibii fɛɛ kɛya. Ashɔ̃ amɛfukpɔŋɔi lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛya; ni mɛi baablɔ awo amɛ akɛ, "He fɛɛ he efee gbeyei!'
"Nyɛ Hazorbii, nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa shɔŋ nyɛyahlɔa bui amli, ejaakɛ naa, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nedukadnezar eto nyɛhe yiŋ fɔŋ.
Nyɛtea shi, nyɛyatuaa maŋ ni he ejɔ lɛ ni eyɔɔ shweshweeshwe, maŋ ni agboi loo agbosɛɛadabaŋi ahe ehiaaa amɛ, maŋ ko ni ekɛ ehe ebɔɔɔ maŋ ko he, shi ekome eyɔɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
"Abaahã amɛfukpɔŋɔi lɛ, ni amɛtsinai lɛ baatsɔ̃ ojoyelinii. Mibagbɛ mɛi ni kuɔ amɛyi fãfãafãi lɛ mashwã jɛŋ he fɛɛ he abanina amɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Hazor baatsɔ̃ ŋaaŋgbei ashihilɛhe; ebaatsɔ̃ naanɔ amaŋfɔ̃, ni adesa ko adesa ko ehiŋ jɛi, ni mɔ ko hu eyatoŋ gbɔ yɛ jɛi. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ Elambii ahe nɛ, yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee mli.
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Naa, mibakpãtã Elam gãitsɛlɔi ni ji Elam hewalɛ lɛ ahiɛ,
ni mahã kɔɔyɔɔ atswa kɛjɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ abashwie Elam nɔ, ni mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ ni ji kɔɔyɔi lɛ ajɛɛhei lɛ, ni maŋ ko ehiŋ shi ni Elambii ni mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã lɛ eyajeŋ jɛi.

Mahã Elambi atsui afa yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni taoɔ amɛhiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ ahiɛ. Mibafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ mimlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ. Mibahã agbla klaŋte kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ;
Makpãtã amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ ahiɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ mikɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i lɛ aaabama Elam. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Shi naagbee mli aahuu lɛ, mibahã Elam nine ashɛ nibii ni eŋmɛɛ lɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ."
50: Nɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ ewie yɛ Babilon maŋ lɛ kɛ emli bii lɛ ahe nɛ,

"Shiɛmɔ koni okɛɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ, shii aflaŋaa, ni oshi; okashiu nɔ ko nɔ; kɛɛmɔ akɛ Aye Babilon nɔ kunim. Awo lɛ hiɛgble Mardruk werɛ eho ehe. Ashwie Babilon amãgãi lɛ ahiɛ shi, amɛnaa diɛŋtsɛ ekpɛ amɛhe.
"Ejaakɛ maŋ ko efã ta kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛmiiba ebatua Babilon, ni ebaahã Babilon atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, fɛɛ baajo foi ashi jɛi, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko ehiɛ jɛi."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm baabua amɛhe naa amɛba kɛ yaafo amɛbatao Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ.
Amɛbaabi he ni gbɛ ni yaa Zion lɛ kã, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛbaa koni wɔ kɛ Yehowa ayakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ni akuŋ mli asaŋ ni hiɛ kpaŋ nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ.'
"Mimaŋbii lɛ tamɔ toi ni elaaje; amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ ehã amɛdu gbɛ, amɛkpla amɛ kɛnyiɛ gɔji anɔ, amɛkɛ amɛ ejɛ gɔ̃ŋ wulu nɔ kɛtee gɔ̃ŋ bibioo nɔ, ni shīagbɛ elaaje amɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni naa amɛ lɛ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, 'Wɔyeee fɔ, ejaakɛ amɛfee esha amɛshi Yehowa, mɔŋɔɔ ni amɛshihilɛhe diɛŋtsɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.'
"Nyɛjoa foi yɛ Babilon; nyɛshia Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nyɛfea nyɛhe tamɔ tookpakpoi kɛnyiɛa tookui lɛ ahiɛ.

Ejaakɛ naa, mitee maji wuji shi yɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ miiba abatua Babilon. Amɛbaagba ta amɛwo Babilon, ni jɛigbɛ abaajɛ aye Babilon nɔ kunim. Amɛgãii lɛ tamɔ hii kãkãlɔi ni jɛɛ ta mli baaa shīa kɛ amɛniji nyɔŋma.
Abaaha Babilon, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni baayaha Babilon lɛ baana nii bɔ ni amɛtsui baatɔ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛha miwebii anii, eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛmiinya, ni nyɛmli efli nyɛ tamɔ tsinabi oblayoo ni miigblɛ able; ni nyɛmiiblɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ nuu moŋ nɛ,
shi naa, nyɛ lɛ, ehiɛ baashwie shi pam. Naa, nyɛmaŋ wululɛ baatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ateŋ bibioo fe fɛɛ; ebaatsɔ̃ ŋa kpataa ni enɔ egbi tamɔ shiaŋa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa mlifu naa lɛ, adesa ko ehiŋ jɛi, shi ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kwrakwra. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ Babilon he kɛho lɛ naa aaakpɛ ehe, ni eeebo lɛ 'gbeeakle' yɛ bɔ ni afee lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
"Nyɛ gãitslɔi, nyɛgbaa ta kɛbɔlea Babilon he kɛkpea. Nyɛtsrɛ̃a lɛ nyɛgãii lɛ, nyɛkasɛ̃sɛ̃a gãimlibii lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ Babilon efee esha eshi Yehowa.

Nyɛbɔa oshe Kɛbɔlea lɛ. Babilon ehole eniji anɔ akɛ enyɛɛɛ ta lɛ dɔŋŋ; ehe gbogboi lɛ ewule, akumɔ amɛ ashwie shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ ji no. Nyɛtɔa nyɛhe owele yɛ enɔ; bɔ ni efee mɛi komɛi lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Nyɛkaŋmɛa mɔ ko gbɛ ni edu nii yɛ Babilon, ni nyɛkaŋmɛa mɔ ko gbɛ ni ekpã ŋmɔshinii yɛ Babilon. Henyɛlɔi aklaŋte hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatao emaŋbii asɛɛgbɛ, ni ebaajo foi kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ."
"Israel tamɔ toi ni gbɔbimɔ ni jatai gbɔbiɔ amɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehã amɛgbɛ amɛshwã. Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ji mɔ ni ye eloo, ni sɛɛkpee be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ji mɔ ni ekpe ewui lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, 'Naa, mibagbla Babilon maŋtsɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ toi tamɔ bɔ ni migbla Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ toi lɛ.
Mibakpale Israel kɛba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ebaaye Karmel kɛ bashan shikpɔji lɛ anɔ nii, ni eeetɔ kɛ Efraim kɛ Gilead gɔji lɛ anɔ nii lɛ.
kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, aaatao nishaianii yɛ Israel, shi anaŋ eko, ni anaŋ esha ko yɛ Yuda hu, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni mibahã ashwɛ lɛ, maŋɔ amɛhe mafa amɛ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.'"
"Nyɛfãa nyɛyatuaa Merataimbii kɛ Pekodbii lɛ. Nyɛgbea amɛ, nyɛnyiɛa amɛsɛɛ, nyɛplenea amɛ kwrakwra. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ; nyɛfea bɔ ni mifã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Aanu tawuu he yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni aakpãtã nibii ahiɛ pam.
te aye tɛŋŋ ni jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ hamle lɛ ajwara lɛ ni akumɔ lɛ ashwie shi nɛɛ? te aye tɛŋŋ ni Babilon etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ yɛ maji ateŋ nɛɛ?
Ao, Babilon, mitsɔ̃ bo tsɔne, ni odu; shi oleee; ana bo, ni amɔ bo, ejaakɛ okɛ Yehowa fu daa.
Yehowa egble etawuu nibii atoohe lɛ naa, ni ejie emlifu tawuu nibii lɛ akpo ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ nitsumɔ ni ebaatsu yɛ Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛjɛa hei fɛɛ nyɛbatuaa lɛ, nyɛjwaraa eboŋoi ashinai lɛ; nyɛbuaa haanii lɛ anaa tamɔ ŋmaa kei, ni nyɛkpãtãa maŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu, ni nyɛkashīa enɔ ko nɔ ko.
Nyɛgbea Babilon hii lɛ tamɔ agbeɔ tsina hii; nyɛkplaa amɛ kɛyaa nyɛyagbea amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm. Kpoo hã amɛ! Ejaakɛ amɛtoigblamɔ be lɛ eshɛ.
"Naa, mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ ejo foi kɛjɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee Yerusalem, amɛmiigba akɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etɔ e-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he owele.

"Nyɛtsɛa gaitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ nyɛwoa Babilon he, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lɛ gãitsɛ̃mɔ aya eko. Nyɛsaa maŋ lɛ yi kɛkpea; ni nyɛkahãa mɔ ko naa fɔijee hegbɛ. Bɔ ni Babilon fee mɛi komɛi lɛ nyɛkɛ lɛ ayea Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, fuū daa.
No hewɔ lɛ abaagbegbee eblahii lɛ ashwã eblohuiaŋ, ni abaaplenee etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nakai be lɛ mli. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
"Bo maŋhewolɔ, naa, mi kɛ bo ena. Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, ejaakɛ ogbi lɛ eshɛ be ni mibagbla otoi lɛ.
Hewolɔ lɛ baatɛ, ni ebaagbee shi, ni enaŋ mɔ ko awo enɔ. Mibama emaji wuji lɛ anaa la, ni ebaashã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni bɔle lɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Aaye Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ hu fɛɛ anɔ keketee; ni mɛi ni baŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ hiɛ amɛ kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ koni amɛya amɛmaŋ.
Shi amɛ-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ he wa, ni egbɛi ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ. Ye kɛ̃ ebaaye amɛsane lɛ ehã amɛ koni hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi Babilonbii lɛ, haomɔ ji nɔ ni baanina amɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Ta baanina emaŋbii kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ enilelɔi lɛ.
Ta baanina okɔmfoi nifeelɔi lɛ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ kwashiai. Ta baanina ehii kãkãlɔi lɛ koni amɛhiɛ akpãtã.
Ekpɔŋɔi kɛ taayaa shwiilii lɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã; maŋsɛɛ tabilɔi ni futu amɛ lɛ, hu ahiɛ baakpãtã; ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ yei! Abaagbɛ amɛ ashwã koni aha amɛ.
Nu enɛŋ, hewɔ lɛ fai fɛɛ baaŋla, ejaakɛ Babilon eyi tɔ kɛ amãgãi nɛɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ eye amɛ sɛkɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ Babilon baatsɔ̃ klaŋ odigblɛmi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi krokomɛi ashihilɛhe; duguma baahi jɛi, gbɔmɛi ehiɛ jɛi dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ; ni asaŋ gbɔmɔ adesa yinɔ ko yinɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi dɔŋŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ,
tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ butu Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ amɛhewɔ majimaji lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko ehiii jɛi, ni asaŋ mɔ ko ni jɛ yoo musuŋ eyatoŋ gbɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ, mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.
"Naa, maŋ wulu ko miijɛ kooyigbɛ aba, maŋ ko ni hewa, kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi babaoo miijɛ je lɛ naagbeehei shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ amaba kɛ ta.
Amɛhiɛ amɛgãi kɛ akplɔi amɛyi wa, ni amɛnaa mɔbɔ. kɛji anu amɛkpɔŋɔi ni amɛtra amɛnɔ lɛ ahe lɛ, egbɛɔ tamɔ ŋshɔ. Amɛmia tamɔ nuu ni miiya ta. Ao! Babilon, amɛmiiba amɛkɛ bo abawu.
Babilon maŋtsɛ nu amɛhe pɛ, kɛkɛ ni enijiaŋ je wui, ni etsui fã tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ ni ebaafɔ.
"Naa, mafã tamɔ jata ni ejɛ Yordan faa lɛ he koo hayii lɛ mli ni ebatua kooloi yɛ jwɛifɔ ŋanɔ, ni mahã amɛjo foi trukaa kɛje jɛi; ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mafã mɔ ko koni eye maŋ lɛ nɔ. ejaakɛ namɔ tamɔ mi?

No hewɔ lɛ nyɛboa bɔ ni Yehowa esusu yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ he kɛ bɔ ni eto eyiŋ ni ebaafee Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ehã lɛ toi. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ abaashãtã amɛbii bibi kɛya maŋsɛɛ, ni maŋbii ahe baajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji anu he akɛ aŋɔ Babilon nom lɛ, shikpɔŋ baahoso, ni abaanu Babilon awerɛho blɔmɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ."
51: Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, "Matee mumɔ ko ni fiteɔ nii shi mawo Babilon kɛ emli bii ni ji Kaldeabii lɛ,
ni matsu mɛi kpɔ̃ji kɛya Babilon koni amɛsha emli tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ shaa ŋmaa mli lɛ. Nakai gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, abaajɛ Babilon hewɔ hei fɛɛ abatua lɛ, ni amɛbaafee eshikpɔŋ lɛ shwɛm.
Akaŋmɛ gãtsɛ̃lɔ ko gbɛ ni etsɛ̃ egãi lɛ, ni akaŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ ni ewo edade dama tete. Akɛ eblahii lɛ eko kwraa he akake lɛ; akpãtã etabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ butuu.
Mɛi baanyɔnyɔi yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni pilafoi baajwere blohui lɛ amli.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekwako amɛ; shi Babilonbii lɛ amɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ nifɔ̃ɔjianii babaoo ni amɛkɛtɔ̃ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Babilon teŋ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala. Nyɛkahãa aplenea nyɛ yɛ Babilon toigblamɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ be lɛ mli, ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ be lɛ eshɛ, no ji Babilon toi ni egblaa nɛɛ.
Babilon tamɔ shika kpulu yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ ehã jeŋ maji fɛɛ trɔ dãa; jeŋ maji lɛ hu edɛŋ wain lɛ eko, no hewɔ lɛ jeŋ maji lɛ ye sɛkɛ.
Babilon egbee shi trukaa, ni ehiɛ ekpãtã; nyɛfoa lɛ; akɛ tsofa ato epilamɔ lɛ nɔ, eko lɛ aaatsa lɛ.
Kulɛ wɔɔtsa Babilon, shi ehiii lɛ tsamɔ. Nyɛshia lɛ, ni nyɛhãa wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ nɔ he ni ejɛ, ejaakɛ Babilon toigblamɔ lɛ eshɛ ŋwɛi, ni awo nɔ kɛyashɛ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛa akɛ Yehowa ehã wɔjalɛ lɛ eje kpo; nyɛbaa koni wɔyagbaa yɛ Yerusalem nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etsu lɛ.

"Yehowa etsiɛ Mediabii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ amumɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ yiŋ ni eto yɛ Babilon maŋ lɛ he ji akɛ ebaakpãtã ehiɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ no baatɔ e-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he owele. Tabilɔi ni eba maŋ lɛ tuamɔ lɛ asafoitsɛmɛi lɛ fã akɛ, 'Nyɛjɔa gãimlibii lɛ anaa, ni nyɛklɔa tsɛŋi!'
Nyɛfãa kɛ aflaŋaa, nyɛyatuaa Babilon maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ; nyɛbua jogbaŋŋ, nyɛtoa bulɔi; nyɛtoa mɛi ni baawo Babilon maŋ lɛ he ka ejaakɛ nɔ ni Yehowa to eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee Babilonbii lɛ ena efee.
Ao! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ he ni nu babaoo yɔɔ, ni nyɛyɔɔ jwetri babaoo, nyɛnaagbee eshɛ, ni afo nyɛwala sɛɛ.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kita akɛ, 'Mahã tabilɔi tamɔ baalabii afalɛ abayi omli obɔ̃ tɔ, ni amɛbaabɔ kunimyeli oshe.'"
"Yehowa bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ejɛ nilee mli ebɔ je lɛ, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli kɛ ŋaa.
Kɛji ewo egbee lɛ, nu ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shimɔɔ, ni ehãa afua teteɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ. Ehãa srawa gblaa yɛ nunɛmɔ mli, ni ehãa ahum fãa kɛjɛɔ he ni eto amɛ yɛ.
Adesa lɛ kwashia no, enilee faaa; shikaŋaalɔ fɛɛ shikaŋaalɔ hiɛ egbo, yɛ amãgãi ni efee lɛ ahewɔ; lakamɔ nibii ni, ni mumɔ bɛ amɛmli.
Amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, mɔ akɛlakaa; be ni abaagbla amɛtoi lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baakpãtã.
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ enɛɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ lɛ ebɔ nibii fɛɛ kwa; ni Israel ji maŋ ni eŋɔ akɛ enɔ. "Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ji egbɛi.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, Babilon, boji mihamle, boji mitawuunii. Bo mikɛjwraa majimaji wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ bo mikɛkpãtãa maŋtsɛyerlii ahiɛ.
Bo mikɛkumɔɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ lɛ, ni bo mikɛkumɔɔ tayaa shwiilii ni bo mikɛkumɔɔ shwiilii kɛ kudɔlɔi lɛ.
Bo onɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ migbeɔ nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ onukpa kɛ gbekɛ, kɛ oblanyo kɛ oblayoo;
Bo mikɛkpãtãa tookwɛlɔ kɛ etoi ahiɛ, kɛ okwafonyo kɛ ehumɔ kooloi ahiɛ, kɛ amraloi kɛ lumɛi hu ahiɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibawo Babilon maŋ lɛ kɛ Babilonbii fɛɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfee Yerusalem lɛ he nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Ao, Babilon ni otsɔ̃ ohe gɔ̃ŋ ni oofite shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ, naa, mikɛ bo ena; mawo minine nɔ yɛ onɔ, ni makoklo bo kɛjɛ tɛsai lɛ anɔ maŋtswa shi, ni mahã otsɔ̃ gɔ̃ŋ ni eshã.
Akɔŋ omli tɛ ko akɛtswaŋ koŋtɛ loo akɛto tsu shishi; shi moŋ obaatsɔ̃ maŋ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ."

Nyɛhia tayaa aflaŋaa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ. Nyɛsaa maji lɛ nyɛhãa ta nyɛwoa Babilon. Nyɛwoa maŋtsɛyeli ni ji Ararat kɛ Mini kɛ Ashkenaz ŋaa koni amɛfã ta amɛwo Babilon. Nyɛfãa tatsɛ koni enyiɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛyatua lɛ. Nyɛkɛ okpɔŋɔi abaa babaoo tamɔ baalabii.
Nyɛsaa maji lɛ kɛhã ta nyɛwoa Babilon. Maji nɛɛ ji, Media maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛshishi amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amɛshishi lɛ afee kralo.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ejijaa, ni eekpokpo, ejaakɛ Yehowa miitsu eyiŋ ni eto akɛ ebaahã Babilon atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi lɛ he nii.
Babilon tabilɔi kãkalɔi lɛ ekpa ta lɛ wuu; amɛhlɔ amɛmɔji lɛ amli, amɛhewalɛ egbɔjɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ yei. Akumɔ amɛgboi lɛ asɛɛ adabãi lɛ, ni eshīai lɛ miitso kɛ la.
Tsulɔ ni hiɛ foi kɛ kpeɔ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ wiemɔ ni amɛkɛmiiya amɛ kɛyatswa Babilon maŋtsɛ adafi akɛ aŋɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm!
Aŋɔ maŋ lɛ faafoohe lɛ, ni hebuu mɔji lɛ ashã, ni tabilɔi lɛ atsui efã.

Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, 'Babilon kɛ emli bii etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmaagbeemɔhe ni aagbee ŋmaa yɛ jɛi; eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni be lɛ baashɛ, ni abaaloo amɛ kɛya tamɔ ŋmɔshinii ni akpa.'"
Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar eye mi, ni ekpãtã mihiɛ; ehã mitsɔ̃ tsɛnsi flo; ni emi mi tamɔ jeŋ miɔ nii; ewo emusu obɔ̃ kɛ minibii ni ŋɔɔŋɔɔ lɛ, ni eŋa mimli ni fɛɛ tswɛm.
Zionnyo akɛɛ akɛ, "Yi ni awa mi kɛ miwekumɛi lɛ yi sɔ̃ atere Babilon." Yerusalem akɛɛ akɛ, "Babilonbii aye milá yi sɔ̃"
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Naa, mibaye osane lɛ mahã bo, ni mibatɔ ohe owele. Mibahã he ni Babilon naa enu kɛjɛɔ lɛ agbi, ni mahã emli fai lɛ aŋla;
ni Babilon baatsɔ̃ koikoi kɛ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho naa baakpɛ ehe, ni ebaabo lɛ 'gbeeklae,' ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.
Babilonbii fɛɛ baahuu tamɔ jatai, ni amɛbaalɔ tamɔ jatabii.
Be mli ni amɛmli ewo la lɛ, mibaŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃, ni mahã amɛtrɔ dãa koni amɛmli afli amɛ, ni wɔ baanyɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ kɛaatee naanɔ. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Mibakpla amɛ tamɔ gwaŋtebii kɛ gwaŋtɛŋhii kɛ tookpakpoi kɛya koni agbe amɛ.":
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Te aye tɛŋŋ ni aŋɔ Babilon nɛɛ, ni ashɔ̃ he ni jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ kafoɔ nɛɛ lɛ? Te aye tɛŋŋ ni Babilon sane etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ nɛɛ?
ŋshɔ tete egri ewo Babilon, ni ŋshɔkei wujiwuji ni gbɛɔ lɛ ebaha enɔ.
Emaji wuji lɛ etɔ̃mɔ gbeyei nɔ; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ hei ni nu enɛɛɛ yɛ kɛ shiaŋa, shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiii nɔ, gbɔmɔ adesa ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ jɛi kɛhooo.
Mibagbla Bel, Babilonbii awɔŋ lɛ toi, ni mahã egɔi nibii fɛɛ ni emimii. Majimaji anɔ bii eloŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ eŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ. Babilon maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ ekumɔ eshwie shi.
Miwebi Israelbii, nyɛshia Babilon. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ajo Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa foi ni ehere eyiwala.

Nyɛtsui akafãa, ni nyɛkashea gbeyei kɛji nyɛnu sane ko yɛ afi ko nɔ, ni afi kroko hu nɔ lɛ nyɛnu sane kroko. Nyɛtsui akayea ni nyɛkashea gbeyei kɛji nyɛnu henitswiamɔ ni maŋtsɛmɛi tswiaa amɛhe shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ be lɛ miiba be ni mikɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amãgãi lɛ baaye kɛ joomɔ lɛ. Abaashwie Babilon shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ shi, ni emli gbɔmɛi lɛ baanyɔnyɔi yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ emli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ baala kɛ miishɛɛ kɛye Babilon he fɛo, ejaakɛ mɛi baajɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ abakpãtã ehiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Esa akɛ Babilon agbee shi yɛ Israelbii ni egbegbee lɛ ahewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Babilon hewɔ lɛ agbegbee jeŋ majimaji anɔ bii lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛje klaŋte naa gbele mli, nyɛyaa, Nyɛkadamɔa shi. Nyɛkaia Yehowa yɛ shɔŋŋ he ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ tete, ni nyɛkaia Yerusalem hu.
Nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔhiɛ egboi ejaakɛ wɔnu wɔhorabɔɔ lɛ kɛ wɔdiɛŋtsɛ wɔtoi, ni wɔhiɛ eshwie shi kpɔtɔɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ebabote Yehowa we lɛ mli hei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, be miiba ni mikɛ Babilon amãgãi lɛ baaye kɛ joomɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pilafoi fɛɛ baakɛ̃mɔ.
Kɛ Babilon kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi tamɔ mɛ, ni kɛ ewaje emɔji lɛ akɛ mɛ, kɛ̃lɛ mibawo mɛi agbɛ kɛyakpãtã ehiɛ. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa toi! Aablɔ kɛjɛ Babilon! Babilon shikpɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ he blɔmɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa mifee Babilon amaŋfɔ̃, ni eefo efuufeemɔ sɛɛ. Henyɛlɔi tabilɔi keɔ Kɛbaa kɛ blɔmɔ tamɔ ŋshɔke gbɛɛmɔ.
Ejaakɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ eba Babilon nɔ, ni amɔmɔ etabilɔi lɛ, ni akumɔ amɛgãii amli dukuduku, ejaakɛ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toigbalɔ ji lɛ, ni ewoɔ nifeemɔ fɔŋ he nyɔmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mibahã Babilon lumɛi lɛ kɛ nilelɔi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ atrɔ dãa, ni naanɔ wɔ baanyɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ dɔŋŋ. Mi, Maŋtsɛ, mɔ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.
Abaakumɔ Babilon gbogbo lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ ashwie shi shwɛtɛɛ,ni egboi gojogoojoi lɛ abaashã. Majimaji lɛ miigbo deŋme yaka, ni amɛhenaagbamɔ lɛ la baashã. Mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ."
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ etee Babilon. Ekɛ epiafonyonukpa Seraia ni ji Maseia bi Neria bi lɛ tee. Gbalɔ Yeremia kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ maje Seraia.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia ŋma efɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ ni baaba Babilon nɔ lɛ ewo wolo mli; wiemɔi fɛɛ ni eŋmla lɛ kɔɔ Babilon he.
Yeremia kɛɛ Seraia akɛ, "Kɛji oshɛ Babilon lɛ kwɛmɔ koni okane wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔle akɛ, 'Ao Yehowa, okɛɛ yɛ maŋ nɛɛ he akɛ obaakpãtã ehiɛ butubutu kɛmɔ shi bɔ ni adesa loo kooloo ko ehiŋ mli, ni ebaakã shi amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.'
Kɛji okane wolo nɛɛ ogbe naa lɛ, fii wolo lɛ okpɛtɛ tɛ, koni oshɛ ofɔ̃ Eufrate Faa lɛ teŋ tɔ̃ɔ,
ni okɛɛ akɛ, Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Babilon baashiu, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ ni mi, Yehowa, mibakpãtã lɛ hewɔ.'" He ni Yeremia kɛ ewiemɔ lɛ wa nɛ.
52: Zedekia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalem. Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hamutal, Yeremia ni jɛ Libna lɛ biyoo lɛ.
Zedekia fee efɔŋ eshi Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Anɔkwa, akɛni Yehowa mli efu waa hewɔ lɛ, ekpoo Yerusalembii kɛ Yudabii fɛɛ, ni eshwie amɛ kɛje ehiɛ. Zedekia tse Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atūa,

ni no hewɔ lɛ Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã kɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ kɛba, ni amɛbatua Yerusalem. Amɛsa Yerusalem maŋ lɛ yi, ni amɛtswatswaa kpokui amɛkɛbɔle Yerusalem kɛkpe.
Asa Yerusalem yi aahuu kɛyashi zedekia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Afi nɛɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni eba Yerusalem lɛ naa bawa bɔ sɔŋŋ ni maŋbii naaa nɔ kɔ nɔ ko amɛye.

Kɛkɛ ni agbu gbɛ awo maŋ gbogbo lɛ mli, ni maŋ lɛ mli hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kɛje maŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ. Amɛtsɔ̃ agbo ko ni enaa kã maŋ lɛ he gbogboi enyɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ mli, tsɛbelɛ Babilon tabilɔi lɛ ebɔle Yerusalem maŋ lɛ kɛkpe nɔŋŋ. Tabilɔi foijelɔi nɛɛ tsɛ̃ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛtee.
Shi Babilon tabilɔi lɛ tiu maŋtsɛ Zedekia. Amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, ni Zedekia tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ yɛ ehe amɛshwã,
Amɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ bahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yɛ Ribla, yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekojo Zedekia.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ gbe Zedekia bihii lɛ yɛ ehiɛ; asaŋ egbe Yuda lumɛi lɛ hu fɛɛ yɛ Ribla.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Nebukadnezar hã afamɔ Maŋtsɛ Zedekia hiŋmɛii, ni ewo lɛ gboklɛ, ni ekpla lɛ kɛtee Babilon, ni eyawo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ jɛi kɛyashi Zedekia gbo.

Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nebuzaradan ni ji Nebukadnezar hebulɔi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ bote Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli,
ni eshã Yehowa sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ amŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ Yerusalem shīai fɛɛ. Eshã shīa wulu fɛɛ shīa wulu,
ni Babilon tabilɔi ni fata maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan he lɛ kumɔ gbogboi fɛɛ ni bɔle Yerusalem he kɛkpe lɛ amɛshwie shi.

Nebuzaradan ŋɔ maŋbii lɛ ekomɛi nom kɛtee Babilon: ohiafoi kposakposai lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi komɛi, kɛ maŋbii ni shwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ ekomɛi, kɛ tabilɔi ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtee amɛkɛ amɛhe yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mliŋaalɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ.
Shi Nebuzaradan, maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ lɛ, shi maŋ lɛ mli ohiafoi kposakposai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni amɛtsɔmɔ waintrom mlisaalɔi kɛ okwaafoi.
Babilonbii lɛ kumɔ akɔɔble akulashiŋi ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ, kɛ amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble nutoo gbudugbaŋ wulu lɛ dukuduku, ni amɛloo akɔɔble lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Amɛŋɔ kukwɛii lɛ lɛ sofii lɛ kɛ lajee tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛshãa tsofakɛŋma lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛshãa tsofakɛŋma lɛ akɔɔble tsɛnsii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛtee.

Nebuzaradan loo nibii fɛɛ hu ni akɛ shika loo jwiɛtɛi fee lɛ hu kɛtee: enɛɛmɛi ji okpolui bibii lɛ kɛ lajee tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛsɔoɔ kooloi alá lɛ, kŋɛ kukwɛii kɛ kanetsei lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛshãa tsofakɛŋma lɛ kɛ okpolui ni akɛshãa daa gbi afɔle lɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji shikanii lɛ eŋɔ kɛtee akɛ shika, ni nɔ ji jwiɛtɛi nii lɛ eŋɔ kɛtee akɛ jwitɛi.

Shi akɔɔble ni akɛfee akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ kɛ gbudugbaŋ wulu lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble okpɔŋɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni gbudugbaŋ lɛ ma amɛnɔ lɛ kɛ amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon fee ewo Yehowa we lɛ lɛ, anyɛɛɛ etsiimɔ aŋmɛ.
Akulashiŋi enyɔ, ni akɔɔble lɛ diɛŋtsɛ timɔ feɔ waobii ejwɛ timɔ.
Akɔɔble kpɔ ko ma akulashiŋ lɛ yiteŋ. Kpɔ nɛɛ kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ, ni akɔɔble ntaŋ kɛ emli kpɔbii kokrobii ha yiteŋ kpɔ lɛ he kɛkpe. Nakai nɔŋŋ ji bɔ ni akulashiŋ kome lɛ hu yɔɔ.
Kpɔbii kokrobii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ ekpaa yɛ akulashiŋ lɛ kponɔgbɛ. Kpɔbii kokrobii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ntaŋ lɛ he kɛkpe feɔ ohã.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan mɔmɔ Osɔfonukpa Seraia kɛ esɛɛmɔ Osɔfo Zefania kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ agbo lɛ naabului etɛ̃ lɛ.

Mɛi komɛi hu ni emɔmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli nɛ: maŋ lɛ mli tabilɔi atatsɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔi kpawo komɛi ni nine shɛ amɛnɔ kɛ tatsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔ ni ji esɛɛmɔ hu ni buaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tabilɔi anaa lɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tabilɔi anaa lɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hiɛnaanɔbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa komɛi ni ana yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Nebuzaradan, maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ lɛ, kpla amɛ kɛtee, ni ekɛ amɛ yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Ribla.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ twia amɛ nii, ni egbe amɛ yɛ Ribla yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni aŋɔ Yudabii lɛ nom kɛjɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee.
Gbɔmɛi abɔ ni Nebukadnezar ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ nɔ: yɛ efi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, eŋɔ Yudafoi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ nyŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ, ebaŋɔ mɛi ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ nom yɛ Yerusalem;

ni Nebuzaradan, asafoiatsɛ lɛ, baŋɔ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ nom kɛtee yɛ Nebukadnezar maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ. Nomii lɛ fɛɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.

Afi nɔ ni Evilmerodak baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Babilon lɛ, ena Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim mɔbɔ, ni ejie lɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli. Sane nɛɛ ba yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin mɔbɔ, ni ejie lɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli. Sane nɛɛ ba yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin nomŋɔɔ lɛ afi ni nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo lɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Evilmerodak hiɛ sɔ Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin pam, ni ehã lɛ gbɛnaa ni nɔ kwɔ fe maŋtsɛmɛi nomii krokomɛi ni amɛ hu amɛ kɛ lɛ yɔɔ Babilon lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehoiakin tsake gboklɛfoi atade lɛ yɛ ehe; ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ nii yɛ ekplɔ̃ he daa gbi ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Daa gbi lɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa lɛ shika fioo ko ni ekɛheɔ nii ni he hiaa lɛ kɛyashi egbele be.

1: Nuu ko hi shi yɛ Uz shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; egbɛi ji Hiob. Esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe yɛ efɔŋ he. Eji gbɔmɔ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe, asaŋ efeɔ nii ni ja hu.
Hiob fɔ bihii kpawo kɛ biyei etɛ̃.
Eyɛ toi akpei kpawo kɛ yomai akpei etɛ̃ kɛ tsinai akpe kɛ teji yei ohai enumɔ kɛ tsuji babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Hiob ji bokãgbɛbii lɛ ateŋ niiatsɛ fe fɛɛ.

Hiob bihii lɛ toɔ naa ekomekome, ni amɛŋmɛɔ amɛhe okplɔ̃. Kɛji eshɛ mɔ ko nɔ lɛ, ebihii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ yaa mɔ lɛ we lɛ. Hii lɛ tsuɔ kɛyaa, ni ayatsɛɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi yei etɛ̃ lɛ hu kɛbaa, ni amɛkɛ amɛ bayeɔ nii, ni amɛnuɔ dãa.

Kɛji aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛbɔle bihii lɛ anɔ kɛkpe lɛ, Hiob teɔ shi daa leebi maŋkpa, ni eyashãa shãa afɔlei ehãa ebii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, yɛ amɛyibɔ naa koni akɛtsuu amɛhe. Ejaakɛ Hiob kɛɔ akɛ, "Benɛ mibihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko efee esha ko ni aleee, ni ekwa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ etsuiŋ. Enɛ ji nɔ ni Hiob feɔ daa."
Be ko lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ni sɔmɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ tee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Abonsam futu amɛ kɛtee, ni lɛ hu eyadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ eko.
Nyɔŋmɔ bi Abonsam akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛɛ?" Abonsam to he akɛ, "Mijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikpaa kɛ shishramɔ yɛ nɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi Abonsam akɛ, "Osusu mitsulɔ Hiob he akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni tamɔ lɛ ni eji nuu anɔkwafo ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe yɛ efɔŋ he, ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja?"
Abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani yaka Hiob sheɔ bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, gbeyei lɛ?
Bɛ ofo afabaŋ okɛbaa lɛ kɛ ewe kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ yi shweshweeshwe. Ojɔɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ nɔ, ni ekooloi eshwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi agbɛnɛ bo lɛ kpã onine mli ofite enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ, koni okwɛ akɛ ekwaŋ bo yɛ ohiɛ lo."
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abonsam akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, mijɔɔ enii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ nɔ miwo odɛŋ. Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛkɛ ni okɛ onine akasa." Kɛkɛ ni Abonsam je Yehowa hiɛ ni etee.
Gbi ko lɛ Hiob bihii lɛ kɛ ebiyei lɛ eyakpe, ni amɛmiiye nii, ni amɛmiinu wain yɛ amɛnyɛminuu onukpa lɛ we lɛ mli.
Bɔfo ko ba Hiob ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsinai lɛ miihu, ni teji yei lɛ hu miiye nii yɛ amɛmasɛi.
Trukaa ni Sabiabii batua amɛ, ni amɛmɔmɔ kooloi lɛ kɛtee; amɛgbe otsuji lɛ kɛ klaŋte; mikome too pɛ mihe je mli, ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ."

Tsulɔ lɛ hiɛ wiemɔ lɛ mli lolo kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ kroko ko ba, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, "Srawa gba kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni ebayi toi lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ anɔ, ni eplenee amɛ fɛɛ; mi kome too pɛ mihe je mli, ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ."

Be ni lɛ hu ewieɔ lolo lɛ, tsulɔ kroko ko hu bashɛ shi, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, "Kaldeabii ba, kɛ kui etɛ̃ amɛbatua yomai lɛ, ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ kɛtee, ni amɛkɛ klaŋte gbe tsuji lɛ, mi kome too pɛ mihe je mli, ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ."
Tsulɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ma enaa lolo, kɛkɛ lɛ naa tsulɔ kroko ko hu eba, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, "Obihii lɛ kɛ obiyei lɛ miiye nii, ni amɛmiinu wain yɛ amɛnyɛmi nuunukpa lɛ we lɛ mli,

kɛkɛ ni ahum kple ko tswa kɛjɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni ebabote shīa lɛ mli, ni eshimɔ shīa lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ, ni eshīa lɛ wule eshwie oblahii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛgboi; mi kome too pɛ mihe je mli ni miba mibatswa bo adafi nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Hiob te shi, ni ekɛ awerɛhoo gbla ehe atade lɛ, eshɛ eyi, ni eho ebu shikpɔŋ, ni esɔle.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Yayai mikɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ miba, ni yayai mikɛaaku misɛɛ kɛaatee. Yehowa ni ŋɔ hã, ni Yehowa ebaŋɔ kɛtee; aaajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi kɛ̃!"
Saji ni ba nɛɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ Hiob shwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni no atsɔ̃ esha ahã lɛ.
2: Be ni eshɛ gbi ko ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi ni sɔmɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ tee amɛyadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, Abonsam futu amɛ kɛtee, ni lɛ hu eyadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ eko.
Yehowa bi Abonsam akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛ?" Abonsam to he akɛ, "Mijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; miyakpa nɔ; ni miyashra shi yɛ nɔ."

kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi Abonsam akɛ, "Osusu mitsulɔ Hiob he akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni tamɔ lɛ, ni anɔkwafo ni, ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe yɛ efɔŋ he; ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja? Ehiɛ enɔkwayeli lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ lolo tsɛbelɛ ohã mite shi miwo lɛ koni mikpãtã ehiɛ yakatswaa!"
Abonsam to he hã Yehowa akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ baaŋmɛɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ he, bɔ ni afee kɛkɛ ni eyi ana wala.
Shi bo lɛ taa egbɔmɔtso he kɛkɛ okwɛ akɛ ekwaŋ bo yɛ ohiɛ lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Abonsam akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, mijɔɔ enɔ miwo odɛŋ; shi obaa ewala yi kɛkɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Abonsam shi Yehowa hiɛ, ni etee; ni ehã asane ni waa mɔ he waa tsrɛ̃ Hiob kɛjɛ enaneshi aahuu kɛyashi epampam.
Hiob kɛ ŋɛsuko wamɔɔ ehe, ni eho eta mlu mli.
Hiob ŋa bi lɛ akɛ, "Ohiɛ anɔkwayeli nɛɛ mli kpɛŋŋ lolo? Mɛɛba okwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ koni ogbo?"
Hiob kɛɛ eŋa lɛ akɛ, "Oowie tamɔ bɔ ni yei kwashiai lɛ wieɔ lɛ. Nɔ kpakpa lɛ wɔhe kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ. Mɛɛba ni nɔ fɔŋ lɛ wɔkahe?" Enɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, Hiob naa tɛɛɛ shi, ni ewieee wiemɔ gbonyo ko.

Be ni nanemɛi etɛ̃ komɛi ni Hiob yɔɔ lɛ nu amɛnehulu fɛɛ ni eba Hiob nɔ lɛ he lɛ, amɛjɛjɛɛ amɛshihilɛhei amɛba Hiob ŋɔɔ. Enaanyo Elifaz jɛ Teman, ni Bildad jɛ Shua, ni Zofar jɛ Naama. Nanemɛi nɛɛ ye fua akɛ amɛaatee kutuu amɛyaye Hiob ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛshɛje emii.
Nanemɛi nɛɛ na Hiob yɛ shɔŋŋ, shi amɛyooo lɛ. Shi be ni amɛyoo Hiob lɛ, amɛfo waa; amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ dɔlɛ gbla ehe atade, ni amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteiaŋ.
Nanemɛi lɛ ho amɛta Hiob masɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ, shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii kpawo sɔŋŋ. Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ Hiob ewieee wiemɔ kome nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ eena nɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
3: Be nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Hiob gble enaa, ni elomɔ gbi ni afɔ lɛ lɛ.
Hiob kɛɛ akɛ,
"Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, hã gbi nɔ ni afɔ mi lɛ hiɛ akpãtã; hã gbi gbɛkɛ ni akɛɛ akɛ, 'Ana binuu musu lɛ hiɛ akpãtã.'
Hã jeŋ awo duŋ nakai gbi lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ akatiu esɛɛ, ni jeŋ akatse yɛ nɔ.
Hã enɔ atsi kpii kɛ duŋ; hã atatu kabitii atsi yɛ enɔ, hã duŋ ni ewo kpii shwane lɛ awo ehe gbeyei.
Hã duŋ kpii awo nakai nyɔŋ lɛ mli; kaahã emii shɛ ehe yɛ afi lɛ mli gbii lɛ ateŋ eko nɔ; akabu lɛ ashi afi lɛ mli nyɔji lɛ anɔ.
Hɛɛ, hã nakai gbi lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo kene; akanu miishɛɛ gbee he yɛ nɔ!
Hã mɛi ni lomɔɔ gbi alomɔ lɛ, mɛi ni le boŋso hiɛlawoo lɛ.
Hã emaŋkɛ̃ ŋulamii lɛ afɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ; hã etao la, shi ekana eko; ni ekana hulu haaigblamɔ.
Ejaakɛ eŋmɛ gbɛ ni afɔ mi ni etsiii minyɛ musu naa, ni ehã miina jramɔ.
"Mɛɛba migbooo yɛ mifɔmɔ mli; mɛɛba minyɔɔɔ be ni ashwie mi shi lɛ?
Mɛɛbi shwuɔ he mi fɔ̃ enɔ; ni mɛɛba fufɔ hã mina lɛ miye?
Kulɛ benɛ miho mikã shi kpoo; kulɛ be miwɔ, ni kulɛbenɛ mihe ejɔ mi
kɛkã maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ jeŋ ajinafoi lɛ, mɛi ni saa mamɔɔ mɔji ni ekumɔ hãa amɛhe lɛ,
loo tamɔ lumɛi shikatsɛmɛi, mɛi ni shīaiaŋ eyimɔ kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Aloo mɛɛba mitsɔ̃ɔɔ shrakemɔ bi ni enãaa hulu la lɛ?
Jɛi lɛ yitsoŋwalɔi kpaa mɔ haomɔ; ni mɛi ni etɔ amɛ woɔ amɛtsui.
Gboklɛfoi fɛɛ ahe jɔɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi; ni amɛnuuu kplalɔ gbee dɔŋŋ.
Mɔ bibioo kɛ mɔ wulu feɔ pɛ yɛ jɛi, ni nyɔŋ yeɔ ehe yɛ enuŋtsɔ dɛŋ.
"Mɛɛba ahãa mɔ ni yɔɔ haomɔ mli lɛ lá; ni ahãa mɔ ni werɛ eho ehe wala?
Mɔ ni shweɔ gbele, shi gbele baaa lɛ, ni atsaa shi etaoɔ gbele fe bɔ ni atsaa shi ataoɔ jwetri ni akɛtee lɛ;
mɔ ni mii shɛɔ fe nine, ni enyaaa kɛji ena gbonyobu lɛ.
Mɛɛba ahãa gbɔmɔ ni aŋɔ ewala atee, gbɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ esa eyi lɛ la?
Ŋkɔmɔyeli etsɔ̃ miniyenii, ni mifɔseɔ mligbigblimɔ mishwieɔ shi tamɔ nu.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni misheɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baa minɔ, ni nɔ ni mitsui fãa yɛ he lɛ, no ji nɔ ni minaa.
Mihe ejɔko mi, ni minako miyitso toohe; mibɛ hejɔlɛ shi haomɔ miiba lolo. "
4: Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, hã Hiob hetoo ekɛɛ,
"Kɛji aka bo kɛ wiemɔ lɛ, eeefee bo mlifu lo? Shi kɛ̃lɛ namɔ aaanyɛ enaa emua?
Naa, otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi babaoo nii kɛho, ni owo mɛi hu ni nijiaŋ eje wui hewalɛ.
Owiemɔ ehere mɔ ni etɛ̃ ni eyaagbee shi; mɛi ni nakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ lɛ, owo amɛ hewalɛ; ni amɛnyɛ shi amɛdamɔ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ eshɛ onɔ, shi onaaa tsui; esa ohe, no ojijaa nɛɛ.
Kwɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni osheɔ lɛ no nɔ ohiɛ kã, ni onɔkwaleyeli jeŋba lɛ ji ohiɛnɔkãmɔ?
"Kɛ ohiɛ awo mli okwɛ! Namɔ hiɛ ekpãtã pɛŋ be mli ni ekefo efɔŋ ko? Aloo nɛɛgbɛ aplenee mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii yɛ pɛŋ?
Bɔ pɛ ni mina nɛ: Mɛi ni huɔ nɔsha ŋmɔ, ni amɛduɔ yiwalɛ wui lɛ nomɛi nɔŋŋ amɛkpaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ ni shwieɔ amɛnɔ lɛ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ, ni emlifu kɔɔyɔɔ pleneɔ amɛ.
Ajɔɔ jata huumɔ kɛ oloowɔ gbee he, ni akumɔ jatabii atsoji fɛɛ.
Jata ni he wa gboɔ kɛ enaaa kooloo emɔ ni eye, ni jata yoo bii gbɛɔ shwãa.
"Be ko lɛ, minu wiemɔ ko; efo mitoi naa nyɔɔŋ
be ni wɔ ni tsii nyɔɔ mɛi anɔ ni ninai ahejwɛŋmɔ
hã ŋmiŋmi mɔ mi, ni mikpokpo kɛshɛ miwuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mumɔ ko bafo mihiɛ; mihe tsɔi te shi damɔ shi.
Mumɔ lɛ wa edamɔ shi kɛŋŋ; shi miyooo esu." Shi su ko badamɔ mihiɛ, jɛi fee koniŋŋ, kɛkɛ ni minu gbee ko.
"Aso adesa ko aaaja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ? Aso adesa ko he aaatse yɛ ebɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ?
Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ etsuji anɔ, ni enaa tɔ̃mɔ yɛ ebɔfoi tete ahe lɛ,
ani osusuɔ akɛ ekɛ ehe baafɔ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ, gbɔmɔ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ su mli ni afufluɔ lɛ tamɔ omlɛ̃gɛ̃?
Gbɔmɔ hiɛ kãa leebi, shi egboɔ trukaa gbɛkɛnaashi. Ehiɛ kpãtãa, ni mɔ ko ebuuu ehe akɔŋtaa.
Kɛji atserɛ emli fãi lɛ; aso amɛgboiii yɛ be mli ni amɛnako jwɛŋmɔ lolo lɛ?"
5: "Agbɛnɛ Hiob, boo ni otsɛ akɛ mɔ ko kwraa yɛ ni aaahere bo nɔ lo? Bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ŋɔɔ oootee?
Eji anɔkwale sane akɛ mlila sɔŋŋ gbeɔ kwashia, ni awuŋayeli gbeɔ mɔ ni hiɛ etɛ̃ɛɛ.
Mina kwashiai ni miihe shi ahe dã; shi amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni milomɔ amɛwe lɛ.
Amɛbii kɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ teŋ jekɛ, anaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ koishi, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaahere amɛ.
Hɔmɔwɔlɔi aaaye enikpamɔ nii, ŋmei ateŋ nii eeena eklɔ; mɛi aaaye enii he kumai.
Amanehulu jɛɛɛ mlu mli baaa, ni haomɔ hu ekwɛ̃ɛɛ kɛjɛɛɛ shikpɔŋ;
shi gbɔmɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ ahã haomɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni lalilɛi tsrɛ̃ɔ kɛjɛɔ la mli kɛyaa ŋwɛi lɛ.
"Miji bo kulɛ, matao Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ matu misane lɛ mawo,
lɛ mɔ ni efeɔ nibii wuji ni anaaa naa, kɛ naakpɛɛɛ nibii hu ni ehiii kanemɔ lɛ.
Ehãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eshwieɔ ŋmɔji anɔ nu;
Eholeɔ humii anɔ grɔŋŋ, ni eshɛjeɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi amii.
Efiteɔ ŋai ni hiɛtɛ̃lɔi tsɔ̃ɔ, ni ehãa amɛnine nyɛɔ shi.
Ekɛ ŋaatsɔlɔ̃i nɔŋŋ aŋaa duɔ amɛ, ni afiteɔ mɛi fɔɔji ayiŋtoi fɔɔji lɛ.
Duŋ woɔ amɛ shwane fitiŋŋ, ni amɛgbugbuɔ shi shwane mlemle tamɔ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ nyɔɔŋ.
Ahereɔ awusai ayiwala kɛjeɔ mɛi fɔɔji adaaŋ, ni ehereɔ ohiafo yɛ yiwalɔ dɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ ohiafo yɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ, ni toikɔ̃dɔ̃mɔ saneyeli muɔ shi kɔ̃i.
"Naa, ajɔɔ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kãa lɛ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ ekafee bo dɔlɛ kɛji Ofe lɛ kã bo.
Ejaakɛ epilaa mɔ, shi lɛ nɔŋŋ efiɔ nɔ, etswaa mɔ nɔ, ni enine nɔŋŋ tsaa.
Ebaajie bo yɛ amanehului babaoi amli hu, nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ bo.
Hɔmɔ be mli lɛ ebaajie bo yɛ gbele mli, ni ta mli hu lɛ, oooje klaŋte naa.
Nyɔŋmɔ baabaa oyi kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ naabu fitemɔ mli; ni kɛji hiɛkpãtãmɔ miiba lɛ osheŋ gbeyei.
Oooŋmɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ hɔmɔ fɛɛ, ni osheŋ naŋ kooloi agbeyei.
Tɛi ehiŋ shikpɔŋ ni ohuɔ mli, ni naŋ kooloi kɛ bo aaahi shi kpoo.
Enɛ aaahã ole akɛ owe lɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe, ni oookpa otoi anaa, ni ooona akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe.
Ooona hiɛnɔkamɔ akɛ oshwiei ayi aaafa tamɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ jwɛi.
Ooogbɔ kotokoto dani ooogbo, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋmãa tsɛɔ ni esaa dani ebashɛɔ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
Hiob, nɔ ni wɔkpa shi wɔna nɛ. Anɔkwale ni, no hewɔ lɛ okɛbu ohe.
6: Hiob here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
Ao, mina ni aŋmɛ minaagbai kɛ mihejramɔ fɛɛ yɛ nsɛni mli.
Ejaakɛ aaana akɛ etsii fe ŋshɔnaa shia, ni no hewɔ ni minaa wiemɔi lɛ efeŋ mɔ ko naakpɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ etsɛ̃rɛ̃ mi gãi, ni miinu gãimlibii lɛ anaa ebɔɔ lɛ he yɛ mimli; Nyɔŋmɔ he ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi emuu.
Ani ŋaŋ teji blɔɔ be ni ena jwɛi eekpe, aloo tsina blɔɔ yɛ eniyeniiashi?
Ani ayeɔ nii mutɛ ni ŋoo bɛ mli? Aloo mɛɛ ŋɔɔmɔ yɔɔ wuɔwɔlɔ mli eyɛŋ lɛ mli?
Nii ni misusuma sumɔɔɔ akɛ eyeɔ lɛ nomɛi nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ miniyenii ni minyaŋeɔ nɛɛ.
"Ao, mina ni kulɛ mina mitaomɔ nii; ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mi mishweenii.
Mina ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpãtã mihiɛ eeeŋmɛ enine gbɛ ni etsrɛ mimli!
Kulɛ mimii aaashɛ mihe, mimli aaafli mi pam yɛ minɔnaa ni akɛfaaa lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ mikwako Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ wiemɔi lɛ.
Mihewalɛ enyiɛ, hewɔ ni mamia mihiɛ mamɛ? Mɛɛ ji minaagbee, hewɔ ni mato mitsui shi?
Ani mihewalɛ lɛ tɛ hewalɛ ni? Loo miheloo lɛ akɔɔble ni?
Anɔkwa, mibɛ hewalɛ ko dɔŋŋ, minyɛmɔ fɛɛ etã.
"Mɔ ni kwaa enaanyo ejurɔfeemɔ lɛ, esheee Ofe lɛ gbeyei.
Minyɛmimɛi lɛ yeee anɔkwale tamɔ faa ni hoɔ, tamɔ jɔɔ mli faa ni yiɔ ni eŋlaa;
amɛhiɛ diɔ oookɛɛ aisi, ni amɛyi tɔ kɛ snoo.
Kɛji dɔlɛ ba pɛ amɛlaaje; kɛ jeŋ dɔ pɛ amɛmii.
Gbɛnyiɛlɔi asafo gbaa afã kɛjeɔ amɛgbɛ nɔ, amɛyafoɔ shi kɛtao nu yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.
Tema kɛ Sheba gbɛfalɔi asafoi taoɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ,
shi amɛhiɛ gboiɔ akɛ amɛŋɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ nɔ, ejaakɛ kɛji amɛshɛ he pɛ, amɛhiɛ shwieɔ shi.
Bɔ pɛ ni nyɛji nyɛhã mi nɛ, mimanehulu ni nyɛna lɛ, ehã nyɛmiishe gbeyei.
Ani mibi akɛ nyɛke mi nɔ ko, aloo nyɛkɛ nyɛnii ni nyɛyɔɔ ayawo mɔ ko daaŋnii ahã mi?
Aloo nyɛhere mi yɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ, aloo nyɛkpɔ̃ mi yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ?
Nyɛtsɔa mi; nyɛhãa manua shishi, koni nɔ mli ni mitɔ̃ yɛ lɛ, mafee diŋŋ.
Anɔkwa wiemɔ yɛ hewalɛ; shi mɛni kãmɔ ni nyɛkãa mi lɛ baanyɛ etsu?
Ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛkã gbɔmɔ yɛ wiemɔ hewɔ, be mli ni mɔ ni bɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ wiemɔ lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ ni lɛ?
Nyɛaafɔ̃ awusa nɔ oshiki, ni nyɛaaye nyɛnaanyo yi jra.
Shi agbɛnɛ, nyɛtɛjea nyɛhiɛ nyɛkwɛa mi; ejaakɛ mimaleŋ mitsɔŋ nyɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ!
Nyɛfai nɛ, awa jɛ! Nyɛkafea esha; awa jɛi, misane lɛ ja.
Ani wiemɔ ko ni ejaaa eje minaa dã? Ani mileee nɔ kpakpa yɛ nɔ fɔŋ he?"
7: "Ani gbɔmɔ wala yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ jeee tɔlɛ kɛ deŋmegbomɔ? Ani ewala gbii tamɔɔɔ apaafonyo wala gbii?
Ani etamɔɔɔ bɔ ni apaafonyo kwɛɔ epaabɔɔnii gbɛ lɛ?
Nakai mihi shi shwɛm nyɔji abɔ ni mikã jramɔ mli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Kɛji miho mikã shi lɛ, bɔ ni mibablaa shi nɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ hu sɛɛ jekɛɔ, ni mibiɔ mihe akɛ, mɛɛbe je aaatsɛre ni mate shi?"
Miheloo ewo gɔgɔmi kɛ muji; miheloo lɛ hiɛ gbiɔ kɛkɛ lɛ afɛlɛ.
Migbii lɛ hoɔ oyaoya fe mamalolɔ akokrowa tete, ni amɛmiitã ni hiɛnɔkamɔ ko bɛ.
"Nyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ akɛ miwala lɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni, ni nɔ kpakpa bɛ ni mihiŋmɛi baana dɔŋŋ.
Mɔ hiŋmɛi ni naa mi nɛɛ, enaŋ mi dɔŋŋ. Ookwɛ mi nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni malaaje.
Bɔ ni atatu tseɔ, ni elaajeɔ lɛ, nakai mɔ ni yaa gbohiiajeŋ ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ;
ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa ewe dɔŋŋ ni hiɛ kpaa enɔ kwraa.
No hewɔ lɛ mimuaŋ minaa! Mikɛ mimumɔŋ hejramɔ baawie; mibawie misusuma nidɔɔnii.
Ani ŋshɔ loo boŋso ji mi hewɔ ni otoɔ mɔ ko ni ebu mihe lɛ?"
Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, "Misaa aaashɛje mimii, ni mipiŋmɔ he aaajɔ yɛ misaa mli lɛ,
Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛ lamɔi miiwo mihe gbeyei, ni okɛ ninai hãa ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ masumɔ ni amia misɛ̃ ni magbo moŋ fe nɔ ni makã lootãa wuiwui nɛɛ mli.
Jeŋhilɛ eje mitsine; mihiŋ shi kɛyaŋ naanɔ. Ŋmɛɛmɔ mihe, ejaakɛ miwala tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
Namɔ ji gbɔmɔ, hewɔ ni obuɔ ehe akɔŋtaa nɛkɛ, ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe kwraa po;
ni osraa lɛ daa leebi, ni okaa lɛ okwɛɔ hiŋmɛitswaa fɛɛ hiŋmɛitswaa nɛɛ?
Mɛɛ beyinɔ okpãŋ nii kwɛmɔ; mɛɛbe po oooŋmɛɛ mihe, koni mana be mami misɛŋnu?
Bo adesai ahebulɔ, kɛji mifee esha lɛ, mɛni po mina mifee bo? Mɛɛba ni ojie ohiɛ oka mi? Mɛɛba mitsɔ̃ jatsu mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ mihe nɛɛ?
Mɛɛba okɛ mitsɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaaa mi koni ofɔ minɔsha lɛ yɛ mihe? Ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ su mli makã ni obaatao mi, shi onaŋ mi yɛ he ko he ko."
8: Kɛkɛ ni Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, here Hiob nɔ ekɛɛ,
"Mɛɛba po ooohiɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ amli kɛyashi, onaa wiemɔi ni tamɔ ahum wulu nɛɛ?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ jalɛ hiɛ ebuɔ shi? Aloo Ofe lɛ kɔdɔ̃ɔ etoi eyeɔ sane?
Kɛji obii lɛ tɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, no lɛ egbla amɛtoi bɔ ni sa amɛ.
Kɛji obaatao Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ ni okpa Ofe lɛ fai,
ni kɛji ohe tse ni oja lɛ, no lɛ anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ baaye ebua o, ni ebaadro bo we kpakpa ekoŋŋ.
Osa shihilɛ lɛ baafee nɔ ko bibioo, shi owɔsɛɛ shihilɛ baafe nɔ wulu.
"Ofai nɛ, bo lɛ bi tsutsu yinɔbii, ni abo nɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi ekpa shi ni amɛna lɛ toi.
Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, nyɛ kpaakpa nyɛ afɔ wɔ, ni wɔleee nɔ ko nɔ ko, ejaakɛ wɔgbii yɛ jeŋ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ.
Ani blematsɛmɛi nɛɛ etsɔŋ bo nii; ami amɛgbaŋ bo, ani amɛwieŋ amɛnilee mli wiemɔi?
"Ani adã kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ he ni ŋmiamɔ bɛ lo? Ani glã shwereɔ yɛ he ni nu bɛ?
Be mli ni amɛgba afofro, ni anako aflɔ lɛ, amɛŋlaa amɛshiɔ jwɛi krokomɛi fɛɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kpaa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛnaagbee yɔɔ nɛ; mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, ahiɛnɔkamɔ aaafite.
Ehiɛnɔkamɔ mli tserɛɔ, ehiɛnɔkamɔ lɛ tamɔ anaanu ntaŋ.
Ehoɔ ekpasaa ewe lɛ, shi ewe lɛ nyɛɛɛ shi ema; emɔɔ mli waa; shi no nyɛɛɛ lɛ asɔo."
Gbɔmɔ shwereɔ yɛ hulu hiɛ, ni niji ni etsrɛ̃ lɛ haa etrom lɛ nɔ.
Efãi blaa tɛi kui, etsɔ̃ɔ tɛsai amli tete.
Kɛji akpãtã ehiɛ yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, no lɛ he ni ehi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatso yɛ ehe ekɛɛ akɛ, "Minako bo dã!"
Shi naa, miishɛɛ ni eyɔɔ ji akɛ gbɔmɛi krokomɛi baakwɛ̃ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
"Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ kwaaa mɔ ni tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ehe; ni asaŋ etooo he nine ehãaa efɔŋfeelɔi.
Ebaahã odaa aaayi obɔ̃ kɛ ŋmlɔ, ni odaa ayi obɔ kɛ oshebɔɔ.
Ohenyɛlɔi ahiɛ aaagboi, ni yiwalɔi awei aaalaaje."
9: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob hã Bildad hetoo ekɛɛ:
Mile lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nakai ji sane lɛ, shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni adesa aja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛŋ?
Kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaataa naa lɛ, mɔ lɛ nyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ saji akpe mli ekome kɛkɛ naa ejie.
Nilelɔ ji lɛ, ni eyɛ hewalɛ; namɔ ete shi ewo lɛ, ni eye kunim pɛŋ?
Efãmɔɔ gɔji, ni amɛleee kwraa kɛji etsɔ̃mɔ amɛ ebu shi yɛ emlifu mli.
Ehosoɔ je lɛ kɛmɔɔ eshishitoo; ni ekulashiŋi ni tre je lɛ hosoɔ.
Efãa hulu, ni ehiii lɛ shitee; ni esɔoɔ ŋulamii anaa, ni amɛkpɛɛɛ.
Lɛ ekoome ekpã ŋwɛi mli elɛɛ shi, ni enaanaa boŋso nɔ yɛ ŋshɔŋ.
Lɛ ebɔ Jeŋkpawo kɛ Oŋwɛ kɛ Wuɔ kɛ ebii kɛ wuoyigbɛ ŋulamii lɛ.
Efeɔ nibii wuji ni anaaa naa; kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni aleee amɛyibɔ.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mihe kɛhoɔ, ni minaaa lɛ; ehoɔ eyaa, ni miyooo lɛ.
Naa, nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ ekɔɔ; namɔ aaanyɛ enaa atsi? Namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ?"
"Nyɔŋmɔ eŋmɛŋ emlifu lɛ he, ni mɛi ni ye bua Rahab lɛ aaabakua lɛ.
Te mafee tɛŋŋ mahã lɛ hetoo hu? Mɛɛ wiemɔi anɔ matsɔ̃ mi kɛ lɛ awie?
Yɛ mli akɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe moŋ, shi minyɛŋ lɛ hetoo mahã; hewɔ lɛ fai moŋ makpa mikojolɔ lɛ.
Kɛji mitsɛ lɛ ni ehere minɔ po, miheŋ minyeŋ akɛ eebo mi toi.
Ejaakɛ ekɛ ahum kumɔɔ mi, ni ehãa mifaji lɛ faa yakatswaa.
Ehãaa mana mumɔhe shi ewoɔ mi jramɔ moŋ.
Kɛji aaye lɛ hewalɛ naa lɛ, naa, lɛ nɛ; ni kɛji aafee jalɛnii lɛ, namɔ kɛ lɛ kedeɔ?
Yɛ mli akɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe, kɛ̃lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minaa wiemɔ baabu mi fɔ. Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe moŋ nɛ, shi eeetsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mihiii.
Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe, shi mitsɛɛɛ mihe nɔ ko. Jeŋshihilɛ eje mitsine.
Fɛɛ ekome! No hewɔ lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, "Jeŋshihilɛ eje mitsine; mɔ ni shwamɔ bɛ ehe, kɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
Kɛji oshrã gbe mɔ ko ni tɔ̃mɔ bɛ ehe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɔɔ.
Ekɛ je lɛ ewo mɔ fɔŋ dɛŋ; eha enɔ kojolɔi ahiɛ. Kɛjeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ, namɔ ni mɔ?
"Migbii lɛ ahe yɛ oya fe foijelɔ, amɛhoɔ amɛyaa, ni amɛnaaa nɔ kpakpa ko.
Amɛhoɔ amɛyaa shwiaa tamɔ glã lɛji, tamɔ okropɔŋ gbaa eyiɔ kooloo nɔ.
Kɛji mikɛɛ majie mihiɛ yɛ mikɔmɔi lɛ anɔ, ni masaa mihiɛ, ni mana tsui lɛ,
mipiŋmɔi lɛ aaawo mihe gbeyei moŋ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ obuŋ mi bem.
Ni abaabu mi fɔ kɛ̃; mɛɛba mɔ magba mihe naa yaka?
Kɛji miju mihe kɛ snoo nu, ni mifɔ midɛ̃ hu kɛ samla lɛ,
kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, oootsi mi owo bu mli; ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe atade tete aaahã mihe anyaŋe mi.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee adesa tamɔ mi koni mahã lɛ hetoo; ni wɔya ni akojo wɔ yɛ kojomɔhe.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni aaadamɔ wɔteŋ, ni eeeŋɔ enine efɔ̃ wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔnɔ ni ekpãtã wɔteŋ.
Hã ekpa mi piŋmɔ, koni ehe ŋmiŋmi akamɔ mi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mawie ni lɛ gbeyeishemɔ bɛ mli; ejaakɛ jeee nakai miyɔɔ."
10: "Mijeŋshihilɛ eje mitsine. Mikɛ mikɔmɔi lɛ baashwie shi kpookpoo. Mibawie mitsui mli dɔlɛ fɛɛ.
Mibakɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, 'Kaabu mi fɔ!' Tsɔɔmɔ mi nɔ hewɔ ni okɛ mi ena nɛɛ.
Aso eja gbɛ yɛ ohiɛ, akɛ owa mɔ yi, ni onyaŋe bo diɛŋtsɛ oninenaa nitsumɔ nii. Ni ona mɛi fɔɔji ayiŋtoi moŋ ahe tsuijurɔ lo?
Ani adesa hiŋmɛi ohiɛ, ni okwɛɔ nii tamɔ adesa?
Ani ogbii tamɔ adesa gbii, loo ofii tamɔ adesa afii;
hewɔ ni otiuɔ mitɔ̃mɔi asɛɛ, ni odiɔ esha ni mifee sɛɛ;
tsɛbelɛ ole akɛ miyeee fɔ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ ashɔ̃ mi yɛ odɛŋ?
Oniji shɔ̃ mi, ni amɛbɔ mi, ni agbɛnɛ ofo ohe, ni okɛ nakai niji lɛ nɔŋŋ miikpãtã mihiɛ.
Kaimɔ akɛ okɛ sū bɔ mi. Ani oohã matsɔ̃ sū ekoŋŋ?
Ohã mitsɛ hewalɛ, ni ekɛfɔ mi, ni ohã mida yɛ minyɛ musuŋ.
Okɛ wui kɛ fãi tsra migbɔmɔtso, ni okɛ loo kɛ hewolo ha mihe.
Odro mi wala, ni suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi sɛɛ efooo, ni odɛŋ kwɛmɔ ebaa miyi.
Kɛ̃lɛ okɛ nibii ni eba minɔ nɛɛ tee mi yɛ otsui mli, yɛ oyiŋtoo naa.
Kɛji mifee esha lɛ, okadiɔ ohãa mi, ni okɛ mitɔmɔ lɛ efaaa.
Kɛji mifee nɔ fɔŋ lɛ, kpoo hã mi! Kɛji mifee nɔ ni ja tete lɛ, minyɛɛɛ miyi nɔ mawo, ejaakɛ mihiɛ egbo kpɔtɔɔ, ni miikwɛ mihejramɔ lɛ moŋ.
Kɛji mikanya mihe lɛ, ogbɔbiɔ mi tamɔ jata, ni ofeɔ naakpɛɛ nibii oshiɔ mi.
Otsakeɔ odasefoi ni wieɔ shiɔ mi, ni ohãa omlifu naa waa yɛ minɔ, ni ohãa ta nyiɛɔ ta sɛɛ kɛtuaa mi.
Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba oŋmɛ gbɛ ni afɔ mi mɔ? Mina ni migbo dani hiŋmɛi ko na mi;
ni kɛjɛ musuŋ lɛ awo mi ayafu, ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni afɔko lɛ kwraa.
Te miwala gbii faaa? Ŋmɛɛnɔ mihe koni mawo mitsui fioo,
dani maya he ni kɛ mitee, ni mijɛŋ jɛi mibaŋ dɔŋŋ, he ni ji duŋ kpii kɛ gbele hɔ̃ɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ,
duŋ kpii shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ sakasaka, he ni la ji duŋ lɛ."
11: Kɛkɛ ni Zofar, Naamanyo lɛ here Hiob nɔ, ni ekɛɛ,
"Ani awieɔ babaoo nɛkɛ ni ahãaa hetoo, ni ahãa naafuutsɛ ŋɔɔ ehe eyeɔ? Ani naafuu wiemɔ hãa mɔ sane jaa?
Hiob, aso owiemɔi babaoo nɛɛ aaahã mɛi afee dioo? Ni kɛji oye mɛi ahe fɛo lɛ, mɔ ko akawo bo hiɛgble?
Okɛɛ nɔ ni owieɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni, ni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ ohe tse.
Ao, kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ awie, egbɛ edaaŋ ekɛ bo awie,
koni egble teemɔŋ nilee hiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo, ejaakɛ enilee yɛ naakpɛɛ. Na ole akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo yeko bɔ ni sa otɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Ani ooonyɛ ona Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔŋ nibii anaa? Ani ooonyɛ ole he ni Ofe lɛ hewalɛ yataa?
Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ kwɔ fe Ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi; mɛni obaanyɛ ofee yɛ he? Ni emli kwɔ voo fe gbohiiajeŋ; mɛni obaanyɛ ofee yɛ he?
Ekɛ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ, ni elɛɛ fe ŋshɔ.
Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ ba, ni ebamɔ o ewo kpabuŋ, ni etsɛ bo kojomɔ lɛ, namɔ aaanyɛ enaa atsi?
Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɛi ni ji yakagbɔmɛi lɛ, kɛji ena nɔ sha lɛ, aso eeeku ehiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ?
Kwashiai baabɔ̃i jwɛŋmɔ namɔ, be ni naŋ teji baafɔ bi ni he jɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ.
Kɛji osaa otsuiŋ ekpakpa lɛ, ooohole oniji anɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Kɛji nɔ sha ko yɛ odɛŋ lɛ, hã eya sɛɛ flɛŋŋ ni ogu nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ yɛ owe lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, anɔkwa, ooonyɛ ohiɛ nɔ owo, ni kpa ko bɛ ohe, ni ooona ekãa ni osheŋ gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ ohiɛ aaakpa ohaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; obaakai haomɔi lɛ tamɔ faaŋ nu ni eho etee kɛkɛ.
Owala be mli aaatse fe shwane, ni kɛji duŋ wo yɛ mli tete lɛ, eeetsɔ tamɔ leebi.
Otsui aaakã omli, ejaakɛ oyɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu ohe, ni ooojɔɔ ohe, ni ooofee shweshweeshwe.
Oookã shi, ni mɔ ko woŋ ohe gbeyei; mɛi babaoo aaababi odɛŋ wamɔ.
Shi mɛi fɔɔji lɛ aaashwila, ni amɛnaŋ foijeehe. Amɛhiɛnɔkamɔ pɛ ji gbele.
12: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
Ŋwanejee bɛ he akɛ nyɛji maŋ lɛ, ni kɛji nyɛgboi pɛ, nilee hu egbo.
Shi mi hu miyɛ jwɛŋmɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ; Nyɛfeee mi milee. Namɔ leee wiemɔi ni nyɛwie nɛɛ?
Naa mi ni mitsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli nɔ mihã minanemɛi. Mi ni mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ehereɔ mi nɔ, ni miyeɔ jalɛsane, ni shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe lɛ, mi, mitsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli nɔ nɛɛ.
Mɔ ni he ejɔ lɛ lɛ, ejwɛŋmɔ ji akɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ amanehulu mli lɛ esa ehefɛoyeli. No ji nɔ ni sa mɔ ni eshane ni eyaagbee shi lɛ.
Julɔi atoiiaŋ ejɔ amɛ yɛ amɛshīai amli, ni mɛi ni woɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli la hu yɛ shweshweeshwe, tsɛbelɛ amɛhewalɛ ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ.
Bo lɛ bi kooloi, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nii; bi loofɔji, ni amɛaagba o sane;
loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nii; ni ŋshɔŋ loi hu aaagba o sane.
Te nibii nɛɛ ateŋ nɔ ni leee akɛ Yehowa nine ji nɔ ni bɔ lɛ lɛ?
Lɛ edɛŋ nibii fɛɛ ni muɔ awala kɛ adesa mumɔ fɛɛ yɔɔ.
Bɔ ni toi kaa wiemɔi ekwɛɔ lɛ, nakai lilɛi hu saa niyenii naa ekwɛɔ.
Nilee yɛ onukpai adɛŋ, shi walasɛɛtsɛlɛ mli jwɛŋmɔ yɔɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eyɛ nilee kɛ hewalɛ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ.
Kɛji ekumɔ nɔ ko eshwie shi lɛ, mɔ ko bɛ ni baanyɛ esaa etswa ema shi; ni kɛji eŋa mɔ ko yi lɛ, mɔ ko nyɛŋ agbele mɔ lɛ.
Kɛji etsi nunɛmɔ naa lɛ, fai miiɔ; ni kɛji eŋmɛɛ he lɛ fai yimɔɔ, ni amɛjeɔ ŋa kɛhaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Lɛ adɛŋ hewalɛ kɛ nilee fɛɛ yɔɔ; mɔ ni eshishiuɔ mɔ kɛ mɔ ni ashishiuɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enɔ ji amɛ fɛɛ.
Ehãa nilee ŋmɛɔ ajinafoi, ni ehãa kojolɔi tsɔ̃ɔ kwashiai.
Ekpaa maŋtsɛmɛi, ni ekɛ kpãa fimɔɔ amɛhɛ.
Ekplɔɔ osɔfoi ahewulamɔnii yɛ amɛhe, ni ebaa mɛi ni hiɛ hewalɛ shi.
Ehãa wiemɔ tete ŋmɛɔ mɛi ni hiɛ kã amɛnɔ, ni eshɔ̃ɔ hiimeji anilee yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Ehãa lumɛi ahe guɔ gboɔ, ni efoɔ hewalɔi ahewalɛ sɛɛ.
Ejieɔ nibii ni hlɔ dujiaŋ lɛ kpo, ni ehãa la kpɛɔ yɛ hei ni duŋ yɔɔ.
Ehãa maji jeɔ agbo, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpãtãa amɛhiɛ. Elɛɔ maji amli, ni amɛdraa, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpãtãa amɛhiɛ.
Eshɔ̃ɔ nilee yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii amaŋtsɛmɛi adɛŋ; ni ehãa amɛtsomloɔ yɛ ŋanɔ he ni nanegbɛ tete bɛ.
Amɛgbugbuɔ shi yɛ duŋ ni la ko bɛ mli lɛ mli, ni ehãa amɛdidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔi.
13: Naa, mina nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛi, ni mitoi hu enu, ni minu shishi.
Nɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, mi hu mile; nyɛfeee mi yɛ enɛɛmɛi agbɛfaŋ.
Shi mi lɛ Ofe lɛ mitaoɔ mikɛwie, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni mitaoɔ mikɛyiyi ni matsɔ̃ɔ lɛ misane lɛ naa.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ abla eto nyɛhiɛ, tsofatsɛmɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko mli ji nyɛ fɛɛ.
Ao, nyɛmuaa nyɛnaa moŋ kulɛ eeehi pam, ejaakɛ no aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnilee.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛboa misane lɛ toi, ni nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa minaajiemɔ lɛ.
Ani nyɛaato abla nyɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ naa, ni nyɛaawie nɔ ni bɛ mli nyɛhã lɛ?
Ani nyɛmiiwie kɛmiifã Nyɔŋmɔ he lo? Ani nyɛbaawie nyɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ?
Ani kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ tao nyɛsaji amli lɛ, nyɛaaye nyɛhe? Ani nyɛaanyɛ nyɛlaka Nyɔŋmɔ tamɔ alakaa adesa lo?
Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ baakã nyɛhiɛ kɛji nyɛkwɛ hiɛiaŋ yɛ dujiaŋ tete.
Aso egbojee lɛ woŋ nyɛhe gbeyei ni ehe ŋmiŋmi hu mɔŋ nyɛ?
Abɛi ni nyɛbubuɔ lɛ tamɔ lamlu; wiemɔi ni nyɛkɛfãa nyɛhe lɛ tamɔ magbɛ.
Mɛɛ hewɔ maŋɔ miheloo makɔ̃ minaa koni mahiɛ miwala yɛ midɛŋ?
Naa, kɛji eeegbe mi tete lɛ, mibɛ sane ko; mibafã mijeŋba he yɛ ehiɛ kɛ̃.
Enɛ nɔŋŋ aaatsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ nyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ aba.
Nyɛboa nɔ ni mawie nɛɛ toi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛhãa minaajiemɔ lɛ aya nyɛtoiiaŋ.
Naa, misaa minaajiemɔ mito; mile akɛ abaabu mi bem.
Namɔ yɔɔ jɛi ni ekɛ mi batao naa? Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ, no lɛ mibafee diŋŋ koni magbo kɛkɛ.
Feemɔ nibii enyɔ nɛɛ pɛ ohã mi, ni miteŋ mihe yɛ ohiɛ.
Suu onine yɛ mihe kwraa, ni kaahã ohe ŋmiŋmi miimɔ mi.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɛ mi, ni mibahere bo nɔ, aloo ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni mawie ni ohã mi hetoo.
Minishaianii kɛ mihe eshai lɛ, enyiɛ ni? Hã male minishaianii kɛ mihe eshai lɛ.
Mɛɛba okɛ ohiɛ teɔ mi, ni obuɔ mi akɛ ohenyɛlɔ lɛ?
Aso obaafã baa ni kɔɔyɔɔ ehuu lɛ tsui; ni obaanyiɛ able shishi tutuu sɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ okɛ saji ni naa wa miishi mi, ootsɛ miblahiiaŋ tɔ̃mɔ̃i tete asɛɛ.
Obɔ minaji apã, ni ohiŋmɛi kã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifeɔ he; minanefaamɔi hu owo he husu.
Adesa tamɔ nɔ ko ni ekpɔtɔ, etamɔ mama ni omlɛ̃gɛ̃ eye.
14: Gbɔmɔ ni yoo fɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, kukuoo kɛkɛ ji ewala be lɛ; ni emli eyi tɔ kɛ haomɔ sɔŋŋ.
Ewala nɛɛ tamɔ fɔfɔi; ekwɛ̃ɔ, ni eŋlaa shwiaa; ehoɔ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ, ni etsɛɛɛ.
Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ ona be ookwɛ lɛ, ni ootao akɛ lɛ eye sane lo?
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ana nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ srɔto lɛ?
Akɛni ato ewala be lɛ, ni nyɔji abɔ ni ebaaye yɛ odɛŋ lɛ, belɛ owo ewala he husu momo.
Jiemɔ ohiɛ yɛ enɔ; kaafo edaaŋ konu amii ashɛ ehe yɛ ewala mli tamɔ apaafonyo.
Tso tete yɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ akɛ kɛji atoo lɛ lɛ, eeehere ekoŋŋ, ni niji ni ebaatsɛ̃rɛ̃ baadra, amɛgboiŋ.
Yɛ mli akɛ efãi baatsɛ̃ yɛ sū mli ni etsoku lɛ baagbo yɛ suŋ,
Shi nu ni eeena nɛkɛ pɛ, eeetsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ, ni eeetsɛ̃rɛ̃ niji tamɔ tsoŋmɔŋ.
Shi gbɔmɔ gboɔ, ni enyɔɔ shi. Kɛji mumɔ na fã yɛ emli lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ lɛ yɔɔ dɔŋŋ?
Bɔ ni nu tãa yɛ kpaakpo mli, ni faa miiɔ ni egbiɔ lɛ,
nakai gbɔmɔ hoɔ, ekãa shi ni eteee shi dɔŋŋ. Kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ŋwɛi aaaho aya lɛ, ehiɛ etsɛŋ, ni atsiɛŋ lɛ yɛ wɔ lɛ mli.
Mina ni kulɛ oŋɔ mi otee yɛ gbohiiaje, ni oŋɔ mi ohɔ shi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni omlifu lɛ aaaho, koni oto be ohã mi, ni okai mi.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ gbo lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã ekoŋŋ? Mibato mitsui shi mamɛ yɛ misɔ̃ɔmɔ be lɛ mli kɛyaashi be aaashɛ ni aaaŋmɛ̃ɛ mihe.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobo otsɛ mi, ni mahere o nɔ; ni oootao oninenaa bɔɔnii lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.
Ni ohiŋmɛi baakã minyiɛmɔ he, ni obuŋ minifɔɔjianii ahe akɔŋtaa;
aaasoɔ minifɔjianii anaa awo kotoku mli, ni obaatsimɔ minifɔɔjianii lɛ anɔ.
Shi bɔ ni gɔŋ tete gbeɔ shi, ni efufluɔ, ni atsiɔ tɛsaa kɛjeɔ eshimaahe,
ni nu yeɔ tɛi ahe, ni eloɔ shikpɔŋ su kɛyaa lɛ, nakai ofiteɔ gbɔmɔ adesa hiɛnɔkamɔ.
Oyeɔ gbɔmɔ hewalɛ nɔ kɛyaa naanɔ, otsakeɔ ehiɛ, ni oshwieɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ni ehoɔ eyaa.
Kɛji ebii ahiɛ miiba nyam lɛ, eleee; ni kɛji amɛhiɛ miishwie shi hu eleee.
Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ pɛ egbɔmɔtsoŋ piŋmɔ he enuɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ pɛ ehe ŋkɔmɔ eyeɔ."
15: Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Aso nilelɔ hãa sane hetoo kɛ wiemɔ huu nɛkɛ, ni ehãa emusu ayi abɔ̃ kɛ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ?
Aso ekɛ wiemɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ baajie enaa; aloo eeejie enaa kɛ wiemɔ ni shishinumɔ bɛ he?
Ojie Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ yɛ ojwɛŋmɔŋ, ni ootsi sɔlemɔ naa yɛ ehiɛ;
ejaakɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miijie onifɔɔjianii lɛ kpo, ni ohiɛ shishiulɔi alilɛi.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ miibu bo fɔ, shi jeee mi; bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wuemɔ miiye odase miishi o.
Ani boji klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ ni afɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ? Aloo aŋɔ bo hɔ dani abɔ gɔji lɛ?
Ani ona anu Nyɔŋmɔ ajinaŋ sane? Ani bo pɛ odɛŋ nilee yɔɔ?
Mɛni kwraa ole ni wɔ lɛ wɔleee? Mɛni shishi onu, ni wɔ lɛ efeko faŋŋ ehãko wɔ lolo.
Wɔjiatsɛmɛi kɛ hiimeji fɛɛ yɛ wɔteŋ ni amɛye otsɛ ni fɔ bo onukpa kwraa.
Omii ni Nyɔŋmɔ shɛjeɔ lɛ, efaaa lo? Aloo wiemɔ ni akɛ bo wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ lɛ jeee nɔ ko hã o?
Mɛɛba otsui sha bo, ni mɛɛba ohiŋmɛii tswaa kplɛkplɛ,
ni ote shi owo Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ omumɔ mli, ni ohãa wiemɔi ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi jeɔ onaa?
Namɔ ji adesa ni ehe aaatse, loo gbɔmɔ ni jɛ yoo musuŋ ni eeefee nɔ ni ja?
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ tete anɔ; ni ŋwɛi tete he tseee yɛ ehiɛ.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ, ni mɔ ni feɔ musubɔɔnii, asaŋ ni efite adesa ni nifɔɔjianiifeemɔ ji enu ni enuɔ lɛ, ekɛ ehe aaafɔ̃ enɔ lɛ?
Hiob, bo mi toi; mibagba bo nɔ ni mina yɛ jeŋ,
nɔ ni nilelɔi egba, ni ji nɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi kɛteee amɛ lɛ.
Amɛ tuuŋtu aŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã; gbɔi futuuu amɛ.
Yiwalɔ, mɔ ni waa mɛi krokomɛi ayi lɛ, piŋɔ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Gbee ni yɔɔ gbeyei gbɛɔ yɛ etoiiaŋ, ni julɔ batuaa lɛ be mli ni ehe ejɔ lɛ.
Eheee eyeee akɛ eeeku esɛɛ kɛaajɛ duŋ mli, ni klaŋte ji nɔ ni aaagbe lɛ,
ni akpaŋai miimɛ ni amɛye eloo. Ele akɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ lɛ etã.
Jramɔ kɛ fimɔ woɔ ehe gbeyei; amɛyeɔ enɔ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ni efã ta.
Ete shi ewo Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ewo ehe nɔ yɛ Ofe lɛ nɔ.
Ehiɛ tsɛŋ kpakpataa, ni etsɛ̃ kɛ kuɛŋtimɔ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.
Eshwi kɛbamɔ ehiɛ fɛɛ.
Maji amaŋfɔŋi amli ehi, yɛ shīai ni esaaa akɛ gbɔmɔ aaahi mli, hei ni baatsɔmɔ koikoi lɛ.
Enaŋ nii, ni enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete etsɛŋ, asaŋ etsɛ̃ŋ fã yɛ su mli.
Ejeŋ duŋ lɛ mli; la baashã niji ni etsɛ̃rɛ̃ lɛ; ni kɔɔyɔɔ baakpla efɔfɔi ashwie.
Ekaŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ yakanii anɔ ni ekɛmiilaka ehe, ejaakɛ yakanii nɔŋŋ ebaakpa.
Eshɛŋ ebe, ni ebaaŋla tamɔ tso nine, ni eyi baa frɔkeŋ dɔŋŋ.
Eyibii ŋmlikiti lɛ eeekpla eshwie shi tamɔ waintso;
Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔɔji woŋ shwiei, ni shīai ni akɛ nyɔɔŋ nihemɔ mamɔ lɛ, la aaakpãtã hiɛ.
Nifɔɔji ahe ŋaa amɛtoɔ, ni amɛfeɔ nifɔɔjianii; ni mɔshishiumɔ eyi amɛtsuiiaŋ tɔ."
16: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob to he akɛ,
"Mini saji ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi aahuu; miishɛjelɔ gbohii ji nyɛ fɛɛ.
Aso yaka wiemɔi nɛɛ agbeŋ naa? Ni mɛni ta omli hewɔ ni ohere wiemɔ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ?
Eji nyɛgbɔmɔtso baje migbɔmɔtso mli jikulɛ, mi hu mawie tamɔ nyɛwieɔ nɛɛ; mawie mashi nyɛ, ni mahoso miyitso mawo nyɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kulɛ mawo nyɛ hewalɛ kɛ midaaŋ wiemɔ, ni midaaŋ wiemɔ baahã nyɛwerɛho lɛ naa aba shi.
Kɛji miwie lɛ, mipiŋmɔ lɛ ejɔɔɔ, ni kɛji mifee dioo hu, enɔ enyiɛ po ni gbɔɔ?
Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ ehã eje mitsine; ehã mihe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ etã.
Ehã mikūakūai ni enɛ yeɔ odase eshiɔ mi; milootãa lɛ yeɔ odase shiɔ mi faŋŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mlifu etserɛ mimli; ebɛ mi ewo emli; ekpe enyanyɔjiashi ewo mi; etsu ehiŋmɛi eshwie minɔ tamɔ henyɛlɔ feɔ.
Mɛi gbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ amɛwoɔ mi kɛ naakpɛɛ; amɛgblaa mitoiiaŋ ma kɛbɔɔ mi ahora; amɛbuaa amɛhe naa amɛwoɔ mi.
Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ mi ehã mɛi fɔɔji, ni etu mi ewo yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
Kulɛ mihe ejɔ mi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɔ miyinɔ tɛ; emɔ mikuɛ, ni ekɛ mi tswia shi, ni ekumɔ mi dukukuku.
Egãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ bɔle mi kɛkpe kpula; ekɛ kakla gbla misabai amli, ni ekɔ̃ɔɔ efliii kwraa; efɔse midrɔ eshwie shikpɔŋ.
Epila mihei srɔtoi; ni etsɛ̃ kɛba minɔ oookɛɛ henyɛlɔ tabilɔ.
Mikpɛ kpekpe miha miheloo he. Naa mi, mita mlu mli tamɔ mɔ ni eye enɔ kunim.
Yaafo ehã mihIɛ etsu fɔɔ, ni mihiŋmɛiianaa etitii, ni edi tuŋŋ;
tsɛbelɛ mikɛ minine yeko awui ko, ni misɔleɔ mikpaa Nyɔŋmɔ fai kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ.
Ao shikpɔŋ, kaaha milá lɛ nɔ! Ao, shikpɔŋ, kaatsimɔ sane fɔŋ ni aye mi lɛ nɔ; hã miyaafo ashɛ hei fɛɛ.
Naa, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ tete midasefonyo yɛ ŋwɛi mɔ ni baawie ehã mi lɛ yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo.
Minanemɛi miiye mihe fɛo; shi miifo miitsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Mina mɔ ko ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ awie ahã mi, tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ damɔɔ mli hãa enaanyo gbɔmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ biɛ afii fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ, mibaya he ni mikuŋ misɛɛ kɛjɛŋ kɛbaŋ dɔŋŋ.
17: Misusuma etɔ bahao; miwala gbii lɛ etã, gbonyobu miimɛ mi!
Anɔkwa ji akɛ hefɛoyelɔi ebɔle mi, ni mihiŋmɛii jwere mlilawoo nibii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ nɔ.
Miiye o anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ, he mi oye!
Akɛni oŋamɔ amɛjwɛŋmɔi anaa koni amɛkanu sane shishi hewɔ lɛ, ohaŋ amɛye minɔ kunim ko.
Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ enanemɛi asɛɛgbɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji aja amɛnii lɛ, ena eko lɛ, ebii ahiŋmɛii tete aaafite.
Efee mi nɔ ni akɛbuɔ abɛ ehã maŋbii, ni mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni afɛ̃ɔ lajɔ̃ ashwieɔ ehiɛ.
Awerɛho sɔŋŋ ehã mihiŋmɛi nɔ efee kusuu, ni miniji kɛ mi naji efee kanyakanya, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ.
Enɛ hãa mɛi ni feɔ jalɛ nii ahe jɔ̃ɔ amɛhe; ni mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ griɔ ewoɔ mɔ fɔŋ.
Kɛ̃lɛ jalɔ lɛ fiɔ shi yɛ egbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ni niji ahe tse hewalɛ shwereɔ kɛyaa naanɔ.
Shi nyɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛbaa; shi manaŋ nilelɔ ko nilelɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Migbii lɛ eho etee; miyiŋtoi, ni ji nɔ ni mitsui shwe lɛ, fɛɛ efee yaka.
Amɛkɛ gbɛkɛ feɔ shwane, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "La ebɛŋkɛ."
Kɛji miŋɔ miwe lɛ akɛ gbohiaaje, kɛ miŋmɛ misaa lɛ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli,
ni kɛji mikɛɛ bu lɛ akɛ, "Mitsɛ ji bo", ni mikɛɛ gɔgɔmi akɛ, "Minyɛ loo minyɛmiyoo ji o lɛ",
no lɛ nɛɛgbɛ mihiɛnɔkamɔ yɔɔ? Namɔ baana mihiɛnɔkamɔ lɛ?
Ani hiɛnɔkamɔ hu aaaya Gbohiiajeŋ? Ani wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ baakpleke shi kɛya su mli lo?"
18: Kɛkɛ ni Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, here nɔ Hiob nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
"Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ooogbe wiemɔ naa? Susumɔ he koni wɔwie.
Mɛɛba obuɔ wɔ tamɔ tsinai? Mɛɛba wɔtamɔ mɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ yɛ ohiɛ lɛ?
Bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛ omlifu yeɔ bo nɔŋŋ ohe awui. Aso ootao akɛ ashi je lɛ ahã bo, aloo ohewɔ lɛ abaafamɔ tɛsai ashwie?
Hɛɛ, abaagbe mɔ fɔŋ kane lɛ, ni ela lɛ etsoŋ dɔŋŋ!
Ewe lɛ mli kane egbo, ni agbe kane ni ye eyiteŋ lɛ.
Enaji ni efamɔɔ waawaa lɛ nɔ baagbɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋtoi baatsi lɛ atswa shi.
Ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyiɛɔ kɛyaboteɔ yaa mli, ni yaa lɛ duɔ lɛ.
Enanetsitsi aaadu jwao, ni kpãa ni akɛtsɔ tsɔ̃ne aaadu lɛ.
Akɛ kpãa etee sū mli eto lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ lɛ akpa yɛ gbɛteŋ.
Ehewɔ nibii fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ ehã ŋmiŋmi emɔ lɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ kpaakpa.
Ehewalɛ baatã, ni amɛnehulu efee kralo eto etɛmɔ kɛ shigbeemɔ.
Hela baakpãtã ehewolo hiɛ, gbele kromɔbi lɛ baaye eniji kɛ enaji.
Aaakpɔ lɛ yɛ shīa ni ehiɛ kã nɔ lɛ mli; ni akɛ lɛ aaatee maŋtsɛ ni hãa ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Mɔkpɔŋ aaayahi ewe lɛ mli kɛji ashwã mli swɔɔ kɛgbe emli muama sɛɛ.
Eshishifãi lɛ aaagbi yɛ shishigbɛ ni eniji hu aaaŋla yɛ eyiteŋ.
Akaiŋ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni atsiŋ egbɛi atã yɛ blohuŋ.
Ashwie lɛ kɛje la hiɛ kɛtee duŋ mli, ni ashwie lɛ kɛje jeŋ.
Ebi loo eshwie bɛ emaŋbii ateŋ, ni eshwɛko mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ shihilɛhe lɛ mli.
Anaigbɛbii ahe aaajɔ̃ amɛhe, yɛ nɔ ni eba enɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ bokãgbɛbii hu
Anɔkwa, bɔ pɛ ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ashīai feɔ nɛ; mɔ ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɛkɛ eshihilɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ."
19: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ akɛ,
"Mɛɛ beyinɔ nyɛaagba minaa, ni nyɛkɛ wiemɔ aaasu mitsui kɛaayashi?
Shii abɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmiibɔ mi ahora; efeee nyɛ hiɛgble akɛ nyɛmiitɔ̃ minɔ?
Kɛji eyɛ mli tete akɛ mifee efɔŋ lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ nyɛhe?
Kɛji nyɛmiiwo nyɛhe nɔ yɛ minɔ, ni nyɛmiiŋɔ mimanehului lɛ akɛ minɔ fɔŋ lɛ he okadi lɛ,
no lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ebu mi fɔ, ni ekɛ eyaa lɛ ebɔle mi kɛsa miyi.
Naa, miblɔɔ akɛ aawa mi yi, shi ahereee mi nɔ; miboɔ koni aye abua mi, shi ayeee mi jalɛ sane.
Etswa gbogbo ekɛsa minaa, ni no hewɔ lɛ minyɛɛɛ maho; ni ehã migbɛ lɛ nɔ ewo duŋ.
Ekpakpla mininamɔ fɛɛ yɛ mihe, ni efo minumnyam fɛɛ sɛɛ.
Ekpãtã mihiɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ni egbe naa ehã mi; ni efo mihiɛnɔkamɔ lɛ efɔ̃ shi tamɔ atoɔ tso.
Nyɔŋmɔ mli ewo la ewo mi, ni ebuɔ mi akɛ ehenyɛlɔ.
Etabilɔi lɛ ba kutuu, amɛfo sa amɛwo mihe, ni amɛbɔle miwe lɛ kɛkpe.
Nyɔŋmɔ ehã minyɛmimɛi ekwa mi, ni mɛi ni le mi etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe mɛikpɔ̃ji amɛhã mi.
Miwekumɛi egbla amɛhe shi, mishieŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ ekpa minɔ;
mishīa mli gbɔi ahiɛ ekpa minɔ, mitsujiyei buɔ mi akɛ gbɔ, mitsɔ̃ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Kɛji mitsɛ mitsulɔ lɛ, efooo midaaŋ; kɛji mikpa lɛ fai tete, nakai nɔŋŋ.
Midaaŋ lamɔ eje fu ewo miŋa, minyɛ musuŋbii tete nyɛɛɛ mihe fu naa amɛdamɔ.
Mihe guɔ egbo yɛ gbekɛbii tete ahiɛ, ni amɛshwieɔ shi kɛ ŋmɔlɔ kɛji amɛna mi.
Mishieŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ miinyaŋe mi, ni mɛi ni misumɔɔ etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhiɛ amɛwo mi.
Miwui ekpɛtɛ mihewolo, ni drɔmɔ naa kɛkɛ ni miyɔɔ wala mli nɛɛ.
Ao, minanemɛi, nyɛnaa mi mɔbɔ! Nyɛnaa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nine eta mihe!
Mɛɛba nyɛwaa mi yi tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee mi lɛ?
Ao, mina ni kulɛ aŋmã minaa wiemɔi lɛ! Ao, mina ni kulɛ aŋmã awo wolo mli!
Mina ni kulɛ akɛ pɛi kpɛ wiemɔ lɛ, ni akɛ sumui wo mli yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, koni ehi shi kɛya naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ, mi-kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ hiɛ kã, ni naagbee mli lɛ eeedamɔ misɛɛ;
ni kɛji mihewolo hiɛ kpãtã nɛkɛ sɛɛ, ni heloo bɛ mihe lɛ, mana Nyɔŋmɔ.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ mana, ni mayoo lɛ; ejeee mɔkpɔŋ ko. Mitsui miitse yɛ mimli!
Kɛji nyɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ wɔwa lɛ yi!" Kɛ "Sane tso muu fɛɛ lɛ jɛ lɛ" lɛ,
nyɛshea klaŋte gbeyei, klaŋte lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kɛ kojomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ kojomɔ ko yɛ."
20: Kɛkɛ ni Zofa, Naamanyo lɛ, here Hiob nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
"Miyiŋ kɛ mi ewie, ni mihe miitswa shi ni mahã bo hetoo.
Minu jɛmɔi ni ojɛ mi lɛ, ni mile hetoo ni mahã bo.
Aso oleee kɛjɛ teteete, kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni abɔ gbɔmɔ adesa ato shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ,
akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anyamɔ sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ, ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei amiishɛɛ yeɔ hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ!
Egbojee aaakwɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi, ni eyitso tete aaashɛ atatuiaŋ,
Kɛ̃lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã kɛya naanɔ tamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ. Mɛi ni ena amɛ pɛŋ lɛ aaabi akɛ, 'Nɛgbɛ amɛtee?'
Ebaalaaje tamɔ lamɔ, ni anaŋ lɛ; ebaalaje tamɔ nyɔɔŋ ninaa.
Mɛi ni ena lɛ lɛ, enaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ enaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ekɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ eniji baadãi enii ni ena kɛjɛ ohiafoi adɛŋ lɛ ehã amɛ. Ebii baatao koni ohiafoi ana amɛhe tsuijurɔ.
Egbɔmɔtso yɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ kɛ oblahiiaŋ hewalɛ nɛ, shi fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ sū.
Yɛ mli akɛ nɔfɔŋfeemɔ ŋɔɔ enaa, ni ekɛteɔ yɛ elilɛi shishi,
ni emiii akɛ eŋmɛɔ he, shi etsiɔ̃ naa yɛ edaaŋ,
kɛ̃lɛ eniyenii lɛ tsakeɔ yɛ emusuŋ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ shinɔi adrɔ yɛ emli.
Emimiɔ mɛi ajwetrii shi eshweɔ fɛɛ ekoŋŋ. Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ fɛɛ kɛjɛɔ emusuŋ.
Eeeshwɔ shinɔi anaa ebɔɔ, ni no aaagbe lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni blikã ekɔ̃ lɛ.
Ehiŋmɛi enaŋ fai lɛ ekwɛ, fai ni hoɔ ni eyi kɛ wo kɛ fufɔ lɛ.
Eeedãi nibii ni egbo he deŋme fɛɛ ehã, ni enaŋ hegbɛ eye eninenaa nitsumɔ mli ŋɔɔmɔ,
ejaakɛ ewa ohiafoi ayi, ni ekwa amɛ, ni shīa ni jeee lɛ ema lɛ, eshɔ̃ɔ ekãa naa.
Akɛni fufeemɔ leee mitɔ hewɔ lɛ, eyeee nii ni ŋɔɔ enaa ni eshwɛ eko.
Kɛji eye nii lɛ eshwɛɛɛ eko, noi hewɔ lɛ eninamɔ sɛɛ etsɛŋ.
Enii ni ena babaoo lɛ mli po, eeefī lɛ, ni hejramɔ ni baaba enɔ lɛ naa baawa pam.
Nyɔŋmɔ baahã emlifu ni naa wa lɛ anina lɛ, ni ebaanɛ eshwie enɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ eniyenii ni aaayi emusu obɔ̃.
Ebaajo dade tawuunii anaa foi; shi akɔɔble gãi aaagbu emli kɛho.
Abaagbla gãi lɛ, ni ebaaje kpo yɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli; gãi lɛ naa kãŋkãŋ lɛ fãa kɛjɛɔ edrɔ mli; ni gbele ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ.
Ejwetri ni ena fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã; la ni mɔ ko mɔ ko huuu baashã enii ni eshwɛ yɛ eshīa mli fɛɛ.
Ŋwɛi aaajie enifɔɔjianii kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, ni je lɛ aaate shi awo lɛ.
Enii ni ena fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto ehã gbɔmɔ fɔŋ nɛ, gboshinii ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ hã lɛ nɛ.
21: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob hã hetoo ekɛɛ:
Nyɛboa nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ toi jogbaŋŋ, ni no afee nɔ ni nyɛkɛaashɛje mimii.
Nyɛnaa tsui nyɛhãa mi, ni mi hu mawie; ni kɛji miwie migbe naa lɛ, koni nyɛye mihe fɛo.
Ani gbɔmɔ mikɛna lɛ? Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mato tsui shi?
Nyɛkwɛa mi, ni nyɛhe aaajɔ̃ nyɛhe; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnine aaato nyɛnaabu.
Kɛji mijwɛŋ he lɛ, miwerɛ hoɔ, ni ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi.
Mɛni hewɔ mɛi fɔɔji ayi naa wala, amɛgblɔɔ, ni amɛjeɔ agbo kɛ hewalɛ?
Amɛnaa amɛbii ashweremɔ, ni amɛnabii draa yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Asheee gbeyei yɛ amɛshīai amli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ edɔɔɔ kpãa etooo amɛnɔ.
Amɛtsina hii lɛ kwɔɔ; ni efeee yaka, ni amɛtsina yei lɛ shrãkeee.
Amɛhãa amɛbii jeɔ kpo, ni amɛtumɔɔ kɛ shwɛmɔ tamɔ toobii.
Amɛlaa kɛnyiɛɔ milɛ̃ kɛ saŋku sɛɛ; ni amɛnyaa kɛji blɛ gbɛɛ.
Amɛyeɔ ejurɔ yɛ amɛwala mli, ni amɛyaa gbohiiaje kpoo kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
Yiwalɔi kɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Jeee wɔnɔ! Wɔtaooo wɔle bɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ aba jeŋ ahã
Namɔ ji Ofe lɛ, ni esa akɛ wɔsɔmɔ lɛ lɛ? Ni mɛni sɛɛ wɔɔna kɛji wɔsɔle wɔkpa lɛ fai?"
Naa, amɛshweremɔ lɛ aso jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ mli eyɔɔ? Shi yiwalɔi asusumɔ nɛɛ lɛ, mi lɛ miŋɔɔɔ nɔ.
Shii enyiɛ agbe mɛi fɔɔji akane lɛ, ni amanehulu eba amɛnɔ, aloo Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛpiŋ yɛ emlifu naa
ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa, loo tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa?
Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ etīa amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ anaa eto ahã amɛbii. Dabida! Nyɔŋmɔ baagbla efɔŋfeelɔ toi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔfɔŋ lɛ hewɔ, koni amɛna amɛle nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛfee lɛ.'
Hã ena lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ ehiŋmɛii ni esa enaa Ofe lɛ mlifu lɛ eko.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ ŋkɔmɔ eyeɔ yɛ ebii ni eshi he, kɛji egbii esɛɛ efo yɛ jeŋ?
Aso mɔ ko aaanyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee etsɔ̃ɔ, lɛ mɔ ni ekojoɔ ŋwɛibii tete po lɛ?
Mɔ ko gboɔ ni eyɛ hewalɛ kpitiŋkpliŋŋ be mli ni eyɔɔ hejɔlɛ, ni etoiŋ hu ejɔ lɛ,
ni egbɔmɔtso eshwi ni ewui amli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ fɔ tsɔtsɔ̃ɔtsɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ko hu gboɔ yɛ awerɛho mli, ni eyeko ŋɔɔmɔ ko kwraa dã.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛyajwereɔ su mli, ni gɔgɔmii haa amɛhe.
Naa, mile nyɛjwɛŋmɔi kɛ ŋaa ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ kɛgba minaa fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛbiɔ akɛ, 'Nɛgbɛ lumɔ lɛ we lɛ yɔɔ agbɛnɛ, gbɔmɔ ni ji yiwalɔ lɛ?'
Nyɛbiko gbɛfalɔi lɛ anii, ni odase ni amɛyeɔ lɛ nyɛŋɔɔɔ nɔ,
akɛ abaa yiwalɔ yi yɛ amanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ni mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ahereɔ eyiwala?
Namɔ kãa yiwalɔ hiɛ, ni namɔ woɔ lɛ nɔ ni efee he nyɔmɔ?
Kɛji atre lɛ ni ayaafu lɛ, abuɔ esaŋ lɛ he tete.
Nakai mɛi fɛɛ aaanyiɛ esɛɛ; ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee ayifa babaoo.
Mɛɛba mɔ nyɛaasumɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ yaka wiemɔi ashɛje mimii lɛ? Nyɛwiemɔi lɛ amale sɔŋŋ ni."
22: Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, here Hiob nɔ ekɛɛ,
"Aso adesa ko he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ? Anɔkwa, nilelɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe sɛɛ enaa.
Ani eji miishɛɛ sane hã Ofe lɛ kɛji ofeɔ nii ni ja? Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ naa he sɛɛ kɛji ohi shi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ohe?
Ani gbeyei ni osheɔ lɛ hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kãa ohiɛ, ni ekojoɔ bo nɛɛ?
Ani jeee oyiwalɛ nifeemɔi ni naa wa kɛ onifɔɔjianii ni aleee naa lɛ hewɔ ekɛ bo yeɔ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ onyɛ onyɛmimɛi anɔ, ni amɛto bo awaba yakatswaa; ni oshɔ̃ amɛheboi oŋmɛ amɛ yayai.
Mɔ ni etɔ lɛ lɛ, ohãaa lɛ nu ni enu; ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ hu okamaa lɛ niyenii.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, lɛ eŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni mɔ ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ, lɛ ehiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yei okulafoi lɛ, ashwieɔ amɛ, amɛyaa kɛ amɛdɛ̃ flo.
No hewɔ lɛ tsɔnei ebɔle o kɛkpe, ni ŋmiŋmi emɔ bo trukaa,
duŋ ewo bo, ni no hewɔ lɛ onaaa nii, ni nu afua eha onɔ.
Aso Nyɔŋmɔ bɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ? Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni ŋulamii lɛ ekomɛi yɔɔ shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ hã.
No hewɔ lɛ okɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɛni ji nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ le? Ani eeenyɛ etsɔ̃ duŋ kpii lɛ mli ekojo lo?'
Osusuɔ akɛ atatui kabitii etsimɔ enɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ enaaa nii, ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ husu lɛ naa esheraa shi yɛ?
Ani obaaba blema jeŋba gbonyo ni yiwalɔi lɛ ba lɛ eko?
Mɛi ni ashra amɛ kɛtee dani eshɛ amɛbe, ni afɔ amɛshishitoo ashwie kɛ nu?
Amɛkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, 'Jee wɔnɔ!' Ni 'Mɛni Ofe lɛ baanyɛ wɔ efee?'
Tsɛbelɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni hã amɛshīai shwere kɛ nii. Minuuu mɛi fɔɔji lɛ shishi!
Mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii naa, ni efeɔ amɛ miishɛɛ; mɛi ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ yeɔ amɛhe fɛo.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Anɔkwa, akpãtã wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni nii ni amɛshi hu lɛ akpãtã hiɛ.'
Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpãtã, koni otoiŋ aaajɔ bo; no nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ni oooye ejurɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ enaa wiemɔi lɛ amli, ni okɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ato otsuiŋ.
Kpalemɔ kɛya Ofe lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oba ohe shi. Kpa nibii ni ejaaa feemɔ lɛ yɛ owe lɛ mli.
Kɛ okɛ oshika yawo mlu mli, ni okɛ Ofir shika yawo faa ni hoɔ shishi tɛi amli,
no oŋɔ Ofe lɛ ofee oshika, kɛ ojwiɛtɛi ni jra wa lɛ,
no dani omli aaafli bo yɛ Ofe lɛ hiɛ, ni ooowo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ!
Sɔlemɔ okpa lɛ fai ni eeebo bo toi; ni oooye oshiwoi lɛ anɔ.
Nɔ ni oooto oyiŋ akɛ ooofee lɛ eeeye omanye ehã o, ni la aaakpɛ ahã o yɛ ogbɛ nɔ!
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baa mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ shi, ni heshibalɔ lɛ, ehereɔ eyiwala.
Ehereɔ mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko yiwala. Eeehere oyiwala kɛji ofeko esha."
23: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ akɛ,
"Ŋmɛnɛ hu mikɔmɔyeli lɛ naa wa; minyɛɛɛ mitsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ naa mamɔ.
Ao, mile he ni mana lɛ yɛ kulɛ maya esɛi lɛ hiɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mikɛ misane lɛ baafɔ̃ ehiɛ, ni mibaklɔ misane lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
Mana male nɔ hetoo ni eeehã mi ni mana manu nɔ ni eeekɛɛ mi lɛ shishi.
Aso Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi aaatao naa yɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa? Dabida; eeebo mi toi kɛ̃.
Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaayiyi yɛ jɛi; ni mikojolɔ lɛ aaabu mi bem ni maye mihe kɛaatee naanɔ.
Naa, kɛji mitee bokãgbɛ lɛ, ebɛ jɛi, ni miba anaigbɛ hu, minaaa lɛ.
Mitao lɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ, shi minaaa lɛ; mitsɔ̃ mihe kɛtee wuoyigbɛ hu, shi mihiŋmɛi gbaaa enɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ le minanefãamɔi fɛɛ; kɛji eka mi ekwɛ lɛ ebaana mi akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi.
Minyiɛ enanefãamo sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; no mli minyiɛ; migbako afã.
Mitswako Nyɔŋmɔ naa wiemɔ ko mifɔ̃ko afã dã; mikɛto mitsui shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
Etsakeee; ni Lɛ lɛ eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛ sa, ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa eku. Nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.
Nɔ ni eto ehã mi lɛ, ebaafee kɛgbe naa; ni nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi pii yɛ eyiŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi yɛ ehiɛ; kɛji mishwie miyiŋ lɛ, misheɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mitsui efã; Ofe lɛ ewo mihe gbeyei,
ejaakɛ duŋ ebɔle mi kɛkpe ni duŋ kabitii ha mihiɛ.
24: "Mɛɛba Ofe lɛ etooo be pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni ekojoɔ, ni mɛɛba mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ tete leee ekojomɔ bei lɛ?
Mɛi tsirɛɔ husui kɛyaa sɛɛ, amɛshɔ̃ɔ mɛi akooloi ni amɛkɛshiɔ amɛkooloi anɔ amɛlɛɔ.
Amɛshɔ̃ɔ awusãi atejii yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛyaa; amɛhãa okulafo kɛ etsina toɔ amɛ awaba.
Amɛtsirɛɔ ohiafoi kɛjeɔ gbɛteŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shitswialɔi fɛɛ teeteɔ amɛhe.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, ohiafoi lɛ nyiɛ ŋanɔ ni amɛmiitao niyenii tamɔ ŋaŋ teji amɛhã amɛbii koni amɛye.
Ŋanɔ amɛflɔɔ kooloi aniyenii yɛ; ni yiwalɔi awaintromii amli amɛyeɔ kpɛkpɛo yɛ.
Amɛkamɔɔ shi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe yayai, ni fɛ̃i be hu amɛbɛ hehaanɔ.
Gɔji lɛ anɔ nyɔŋmɔ eyi amɛ, ni amɛhlɔ tɛsai amli, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ abobaahe yɛ he ko he ko.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi tseɔ abifao awusã ni kã fufɔ naa; ni amɛbiɔ, ni ohiafo kɛ ebi abifao tete batoɔ amɛ awaba.
Ohiafoi nyiɛ yayai ni mana bɛ amɛhe; ni amɛtreɔ jatsu kɛ hɔmɔ.
Amɛfeɔ mu yɛ yiwalɔi amɛtsei ateŋ; amɛŋaa wain kɛ wain tsɔnei nɛ, shi kumai yeɔ amɛ.
Aanu mɛi ni miigboi akɛ̃ɛmɔ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni pilafoi miiblɔ kɛmiitsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ; kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ booo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.
Mɛi yɛ ni amɛkwa la lɛ, amɛnuuu egbɛjianɔtoo shishi, ni amɛhiii shi yɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ hu.
Gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ teɔ shi leebi mra ni eyaa eyagbeɔ ohiafo kɛ shitswialɔ, ni kɛji je na hu lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ julɔ.
Ni gblãfitelɔ hu mɛ̃ɔ hiɛbulɛ ni ekɛ nɔhaanɔ haa ehiɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, "Mɔ ko yooŋ mi."
Amɛjwraa shīai yɛ duŋ mli nyɔɔŋ; ni shwaneshwane lɛ amɛŋmɛɔ amɛyi amɛwoɔ tsuŋ; ni amɛkɛ hulu la lɛ bɛ sane ko.
Ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ duŋ kpii lɛ ji amɛleebi; ejaakɛ duŋ kpii mli gbeyei nibii lɛ ji amɛnanemɛi. (Zofa)
Yiwalɔ lɛ, faa shaa lɛ kɛyaa shwiaa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ lomɔɔ eshikpɔŋ ni eshi lɛ; eyaaa ewaintrom lɛ mli gbɛ dɔŋŋ eyaŋaaa wain.
Jeŋ gbimɔ kɛ dɔlɛ hereŋŋ hãa snoo nu miiɔ, nakai gbohiiaje hu loɔ eshafeelɔi kɛyaa.
Hiɛkpaa amɛ nɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ, akaiii amɛgbɛii tete dɔŋŋ; ni no hewɔ lɛ akuɔ yiwalɛ mli tamɔ tso.
Amɛyeɔ yoo kene ni bɛ bi dɛŋ nii, ni amɛfeee yoo okulafo ejurɔ ko kwraa.
Kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ehewalɛ nɔ ehãa hewalɔi awala sɛɛ tsɛɔ; amɛteɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ, kɛji jeŋshihilɛ je amɛtsine.
Nyɔŋmɔ hãa amɛhiɔ shi shweshweeshwe, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ no nɔ, shi ehiŋmɛi kã amɛjeŋba he daa.
Awoɔ amɛ nɔ be kukuoo ko, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛlaaje; amɛgbiɔ tamɔ jwɛi, ni aflɔɔ amɛ ashwieɔ tamɔ akuɔ able.
Kɛji jeee nakai ji sane lɛ, namɔ baanyɛ ekɛɛ akɛ amalelɔ ji mi, asaŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ekome nɛkɛ bɛ mli?
25: Kɛkɛ ni Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
"Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ, mɛi fɛɛ ashe lɛ gbeyei; ehã toiŋjɔlɛ ehe shi yɛ eŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ani aaanyɛ etabilɔi ayibɔ akane? Namɔ kwraa nɔ ela lɛ etsooo yɛ?
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ hu ni adesa aaaja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ hu? Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni gbɔmɔ ni jɛ yoo musuŋ lɛ he aaatse hu?
Naa, yɛ ehiɛ lɛ ŋyɔŋtsere kpɛɛɛ, ni ŋulamii lɛ hu ahe tseee;
mbasro adesa ni ji omlɛ̃gɛ̃, adesa fɔmɔbi ni ji gɔgɔmi nɛɛ?"
26: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
"Ei, bɔ ni oyeɔ obuaa mɔ ni bɛ hewalɛ nɛ? Ei, bɔ ni ohereɔ mɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛn yiwalɛ nɛ?
