Kwɛ, bɔ ni owoɔ mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ŋaa ni ojieɔ nilee babaoo kpo otsɔ̃ɔ nɛ?
Namɔ wa bo kɛwie lɛ, ni namɔ mumɔ jɛ omli je kpo nɛɛ? (Bildad)
Gbohii asusumai lɛ miikpokpo, ni fai lɛ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ miikpokpo.
Gbohiiaje kã shi kpetekplee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko ehaa nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Elɛɛ kooyigbɛ ŋwɛi lɛ mli eha shi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni eŋɔ je lɛ etsotsro shi ni etsotsroo nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tīaa nu naa yɛ atatu mli, kɛ̃lɛ nu lɛ tsiimɔ fɛɛɛ atatu lɛ.
Ehãa atatu lɛɔ shi, ni ehaa nyɔŋtsere hiɛ fɛɛ.
Efo akrabatsa yɛ ŋshɔ sɛɛ ni no etsɔ̃ husu ni kã la kɛ duŋ lɛ teŋ.
Akulashiŋi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe kpokpoɔ, ni amɛhe jɔ̃ɔ amɛhe kɛji ekã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Ejɔɔ ŋshɔ he yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ekɛ enilee kpãtã sasabonsaŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Emumɔ ji nɔ ni hãa ŋwɛi tseɔ, ni ekɛ enine kpãtãa onufu ni miijo foi ni eya lɛ hiɛ.
Naa, ehewalɛ lɛ he okadii nyɔŋɔsiɔ̃i komɛi kɛkɛ nɛ; ni ewiemɔ ablɛbi fioo kɛkɛ wɔnuɔ lɛ. Shi namɔ aaanyɛ ele Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛwula shi."
27: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob wo ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ,
"Mina Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tswa misane lɛ efɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni hã miwerɛ ho mihe lɛ, akɛ,
gbii abɔ ni wala yɔɔ mimli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ hãa mimuɔ nɛɛ,
amale ejeŋ minaa, ni mililɛi lakaŋ mɔ ko.
Enɛ akagbale mi akɛ mabu nyɛ bem; kɛyaashi magbo lɛ, miŋmɛŋ mibemyeli lɛ he.
Mihiɛ mijalɛ lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, ni miŋmɛŋ he; mihenilee ebuuu mi fɔ yɛ wiwalaŋ gbii lɛ ko kwraa he.
Hã mihenyɛlɔ atsɔ̃ tamɔ yiwalɔ, ni hã mɔ ni teɔ shi ewoɔ mi lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ fɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛni ji mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ efo ewala sɛɛ, ni eshɔ̃ ewala yɛ edɛŋ lɛ?
Kɛji fimɔ ba enɔ lɛ, ani Nyɔŋmɔ aaabo eblɔmɔ toi?
Ani emiishɛɔ yɛ Ofe lɛ hewɔ, aloo esɔleɔ ebiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuɔamɔ be fɛɛ be?
Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ tsuɔ; mikɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ Ofe lɛ he eteŋ nyɛ.
Naa, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛna; mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni nyɛwieee wiemɔi ni ahe yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ?
Mɔ ni mɔfɔŋ naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ nɛ, nɔ ni Ofe lɛ yɔɔ hã yiwalɔ nɛ.
Kɛji ebii ayi fa babaoo lɛ, klaŋte amɛyi fa amɛhãa, ni eshwiei lɛ aboloo shɛŋ amɛnaa.
Bii ni eshiɔ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, gbele hela gbeɔ amɛ; ni amɛkulafoi lɛ foŋ amɛ tete.
Yiwalɔ buaa jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu, ni eeebua atadei anaa eto tamɔ mɛ;
eeebua naa nɛ, shi mɔ ni baawo ji jalɔ, ni mɔ ni fɔbuu bɛ ehe ji mɔ ni baaja ejwiɛtɛi lɛ.
Shīa ni emaa lɛ etamɔ anaanu ntaŋ, loo asese ni bulɔ efee.
Eyakãa shi akɛ niiatsɛ, shi ebaŋ lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ; be ni eeegble ehiŋmɛi lɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ tamɔ faa ni eje ŋa loɔ nibii; ahum woɔ lɛ kɛyaa nyɔɔŋ.
Bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ woɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ebɛɔ lɛ kɛjeɔ eshīaŋ kɛyaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa enɔ ni enaaa lɛ mɔbɔ; be ni etaoɔ foi eje kɛje edɛŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tswaa edɛŋ eshwieɔ enɔ, ni eboɔ lɛ 'tsiaa' kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ mli.
28: Anɔkwa, bui yɛ ni atsaa jwiɛtɛi yɛ mli, ni hei yɛ ni anaa shika ni asereɔ yɛ.
Atsaa dade yɛ shikpɔŋ ni asereɔ akɔɔble kɛjɛɔ tɛ mli.
Mɛi sheee duŋ gbeyei, ni amɛboteɔ duŋ mli amɛyataoɔ tɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ kabitii lɛ mli kɛyaa duŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
Mɛi yatsaa shika bui yɛ hei ni gbɔmɔ bɛ. Gbɛfãlɔi ahiɛ kpaa amɛnɔ; amɛtsotsroɔ kpãa naa kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ shika bui lɛ amli.
Shikpɔŋ mli niyenii jɛɔ; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ shishi lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ ni la eshã.
Emli tɛi amli anaa safiro yɛ, ni shika futru hu yɛ mli.
Okropɔŋ leee jɛigbɛ lɛ, akroma ko hiŋmɛi enako jɛi dã.
Kooloi kakawuai lɛ eko kwraa nane yiko gbɛ lɛ nɔ dã, ni jata tsɔ̃ko enɔ kɛhoko dã.
Gbɔmɔ kɛ enine tsaa tswrɛbo tɛ, ni etsaa gɔji ashishi ekɛwuleɔ amɛ eshwieɔ shi.
Be mli ni ekpɛɔ gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tɛsai amli lɛ, ehiŋmɛi naa ojrawatɛi fɛɛ.
Etsīɔ fai anaa koni amɛkanyɛ amɛho, ni nii ni akɛtee shishi lɛ, ejieɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ.
Shi nɛɛgbɛ abaana nilee yɛ? Ni nɛɛgbɛ ji he ni niiashishinumɔ yɔɔ?
Gbɔmɔ leee ejrawalɛ; ni anaaa lɛ yɛ hiɛkãlɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ŋshɔŋ bu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ, 'Ebɛ mimli!' Ni ŋshɔ hu kɛɛ, "Ebɛ miŋɔɔ!"
Atseee shika aheee, ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi ni baashɛ enyɔmɔwo.
Ofir shika shɛɛɛ ejra; nakai nɔŋŋ ji ojrawatɛ onike loo safiro.
Shika kɛ ashwishwɛ kɛ lɛ yeee egbɔ; ni akɛtsakeŋ shika jwinei kpakpai diɛŋtsɛ.
Atsiŋ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o kɛ kɔli tã yɛ he ni eyɔɔ; nilee jra wa fe adiagba.
Etiopia ojrawatɛ topasion kɛ lɛ yeee egbɔ, ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni baashɛ ejra.
Belɛ nɛɛgbɛ nilee jɛɔ mɔ, ni nɛɛgbɛ ji he ni niiashishinumɔ yɔɔ?
Aŋɔtee, ni hiɛkãlɔ ko hiŋmɛi enaŋ; akɛtee loofɔji ni flikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi tete.
Gbele kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛɛ, 'He kɛkɛ wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi ni aawie.'
Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ni le gbɛ ni kã kɛyaa he; ni lɛ ele he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, enaa jeŋ naagbeehei bluublu, ni enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi.
Be ni eŋmɛ kɔɔyɔɔ hewalɛ ehã lɛ, ni esusu ŋshɔi kɛ fai afalɛ,
be ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni nu anɛ ahã, kɛ bɔ ni srawa agba kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi ahã lɛ;
no mli Nyɔŋmɔ na nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ji nilee; ni eka etɛ naa ekwɛ ni eŋɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ adesã akɛ, 'Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, no ji nilee, ni hewii kɛjɛ efɔŋ he ji jwɛŋmɔ.'
29: Hiob bɔ̃i wiemɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ,
"Ao, mina ni kulɛ mitsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ be ko ni eho lɛ, be mli ni Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ mihe lɛ,
be ni ela lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ miyiteŋgbɛ ni minaa nii yɛ duɛ mli lɛ.
No be mli lɛ, minibii shwere, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanyobɔɔ bu miwe lɛ he.
Ofe lɛ kɛ mi yɛ, ni mimusuŋbii hu bɔle mihe kɛkpe.
Mitsinai kɛ mitoi hãa mi fufɔ babaoo, ni mimutsei shwere yɛ tɛsai amli.
Kɛji mije kpo kɛtee maŋ koi lɛ shi, ni miyata shi yɛ blohuŋ lɛ,
oblahii lɛ hãa mi gbɛ kɛji amɛna mi, ni onukpai lɛ teɔ shi hãa mi,
lumɛi tete fɔ̃ɔ wiemɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji toɔ amɛnaabu;
abladei agbei laajeɔ, ni amɛlilɛi kpɛtɛɔ amɛdaaŋ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ mihe jɔɔ mi, ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛkafoɔ mi.
Ejaakɛ mihereɔ ohiafo ni foɔ kɛ awusã ni bɛ bualɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni hiɛ heɔ akpãtã lɛ jɔɔmɔ baninaa mi, ni mihãa okulafo tsui nyɔɔ emli kɛ nyamɔ.
Jalɛ ji mimama ni mibuɔ, ni mijalɛ saneyeli ji mitade kɛ akekre.
Mitsɔ̃ hiŋmɛi mihã shwilafo, ni mitsɔ̃ naji mihã obubuafo.
Mitsɔ̃ tsɛ mihã ohiafoi ni mɛi ni mileee amɛ tete mitao amɛsaji amli mihã amɛ.
Mikumɔ mɔfɔŋ lɛ nyanyɔji yɛ edaaŋ, ni ehã eŋmɛɛ nɔ ni kɔ̃ enaa ni eyaaye lɛ he efɔ̃ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, "Mishīateŋ magbo yɛ ni migbii baafa tamɔ shia.
Mitamɔ tso ni efãi etsɛ̃rɛ̃ kɛtee kɛyanina nu, ni bɔ nyɔɔ ebai anɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Mɛi ahiɛ sɔɔ mi be fɛɛ be, ni hewalɛ ni migãi ni yɔɔ midɛŋ wo mi lɛ nɔ gbɔɔɔ."
Mɛi bo mi toi, ni amɛmɛ, ni amɛfee kpoo kɛmɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ.
Kɛji miwie sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko ewieee dɔŋŋ; ni miwiemɔi lɛ boteɔ amɛmli.
Amɛkwɛɔ miwiemɔ gbɛ tamɔ okwaafonyo kwɛɔ nunɛmɔ gbɛ.
Miŋmɔɔ kɛji mina akɛ amɛtsui miiye, ni mihiɛŋmlɔ̃ lɛ woɔ amɛ hewalɛ.
Mi, mito amɛshihilɛ lɛ he gbɛjianɔ, ni mihi shi mihã amɛ akɛ yitso; mihi shi yɛ etabilɔi ateŋ akɛ maŋtsɛ. Mihi shi akɛ mɔ ni shɛjeɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi amii.
30: Shi agbɛnɛ mɛi ni miye amɛ onukpa miiŋmɔ mi; mɛi ni mibuŋ amɛtsɛmɛi bɔ ni maŋɔ amɛ mafata gbei ni buɔ tookui tete ahe lɛ anɔ.
Mɛɛ sɛɛ mibana yɛ mɛi ni egblɔ ahe?
Ohia kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa hãa amɛkpeɔ ŋa gbiŋ nɔ tsei ashishifãi.
Amɛfamɔɔ shiaŋaŋ tsei, ni amɛtserɛɔ koowie bai ni ameshɛreɔ blɔtsei amɛwereɔ.
Ashwieɔ amɛ kɛjeɔ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni awɔɔ amɛyi tamɔ awɔɔ julɔ yi.
Nujɔi ajɔi amli kɛ shikpɔŋ bui kɛ tɛkploi amli amɛaahi.
Koowiei ashishi amɛblɔɔ yɛ; sansrɔ̃i ashishi amɛbuaa amɛhe naa yɛ.
Kwashiai yakagbɔmɛi abii; ayi amɛ, ashwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi agbɛnɛ, mitsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ kotsa ni mitsɔ̃ fɛoyeli wiemɔ mihã amɛ.
Amɛnyaŋeɔ mi; amɛwiɔ amɛhe yɛ mihe, kɛji amɛna mi lɛ amɛtsɛ̃ɔ lajɔ̃.
Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã migbɔjɔ ni eba mi shi hewɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ gbooo nɔ ni amɛfeɔ he yɛ mihiɛ.
Yakagbɔmɛi teɔ shi yɛ mininejurɔ nɔ, ni amɛshwieɔ mi kɛyaa sɛɛ, ni amɛkaa mihiɛ kpãtãmɔ tete.
Amɛtsimɔɔ migbɛ ni matsɔ̃ nɔ, ni amɛbɔɔ mihiɛkpãtãmɔ he mɔdɛŋ, ni mɔ ko ebooo amɛ tswai!
Amɛkeɔ kɛbaa tamɔ mɛi ni egbu gbogbo ewo mli ni amɛbashwieɔ minɔ.
Adɔ gbeyei nibii ayi kɛba minɔ, minumnyam eyã oookɛɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni etswa kɛtee; kɔɔyɔɔ etswa nii ni mina fɛɛ kɛtee tamɔ atatu.
Agbɛnɛ eshɛ migbele be ni mikã nɔnaa mli gbii abɔ nɛɛ.
Duŋ lɛ hãa miwui amli kpeɔ mi, mipiŋmɔ lɛ ejɔɔɔ.
Enaawalɛ lɛ kpītĩɔ mitade lɛ efiɔ lɛ kɛmɔɔ misɛ̃.
Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ mi efɔ̃ ŋmɔtɔ mli, ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu kɛ lamlu.
Miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo, shi ohereee mi nɔ; mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi misɔleɔ; shi okwɛɛɛ mi po.
Oowa mi yi; okɛ ohewalɛ fɛɛ miipiŋ mi.
Owoɔ mi owoɔ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli, ni etswaa mi kɛfoɔ shi; ni otswiaa mi shi kɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ ahum lɛ mli.
Hɛ̃ɛ, mile akɛ okɛ mi baaya ayahã gbele, ni ji shīa ni ato ahã hiɛkãlɔi fɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ aso mɔ ni kã hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli kpãaa enineŋ yɛ emanehulu lɛ mli ni ebi yelikɛbuamɔ lo?
Ani mifooo mihãaa mɔ ni yɔɔ haomɔ mli? Ani misusuma werɛ hooo hãaa ohiafo?
Shi be ni mikwɛ nɔ kpakpa gbɛ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ moŋ ni ba; ni be ni mimɛ la lɛ duŋ moŋ wo mi.
Mitsui miitswa kɛ hejramɔ, ni enyɔɔɔ shi; amanehulu gbii enina mi.
Duŋ ewo mi kɛmiiya kɛmiiba; ni hulu etsooo ehãaa mi kwraa, mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi yɛ maŋ, ni mibiɔ yelikɛbuamɔ.
Mitsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei anyɛmi kɛ okpɔŋɔloofɔji anaanyo.
Mihewolo edī, ni eekplɔ yɛ mihe eeshwie shi; ni miwui amli miishã mi.
Mikpãa saŋku lɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli, ni migblɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ mɛi ni miifo agbee.
31: Mikã mihiŋmɛi kitã ni no hewɔ lɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ mahã oblayoo fro he afee mi akɔnɔ hu.
Mɛni mana kɛaajɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi nɛɛ dɛŋ? Ni mɛni aaafee migbɛfaŋnɔ ni Ofe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ baahã mi?
Ani jeee hiɛkpãtãmɔ kã shi hã mɛi ni feɔ nɔ fɔŋ? Ni oshrã yɔɔ hã mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ leee mijeŋba, ni ekaneee minanefãamɔi?
Kɛji miba mijeŋ kɛ kutumpɔo, ni miye oyai mishishiu mɔ ko lɛ,
no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nsɛni ni ja aŋmɛ mi koni ena akɛ kpako bɛ mihe.
Kɛji migba afã yɛ minyiɛmɔŋ, ni mitsui eyadi mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ, ni muji ko kpɛtɛ miniji ahe lɛ,
no lɛ nii ni madu lɛ, mɔ kroko aaaye, ni ŋmɔshinii ni aaakwɛ̃ ahã mi lɛ, afãmɔ ashwie.
Kɛji minaanyo ŋa he efee mi akɔnɔ pɛŋ, ni miyawo ka yɛ minaanyo shinaa shi pɛŋ lɛ,
no lɛ hã miŋa ahoo nii ahã nuu kroko, ni mɛi krokomɛi kɛ lɛ ana bɔlɛ.
Ejaakɛ hiɛgbeji asane kpeteŋkple ni; eji nɔ fɔŋ ni kojolɔi lɛ baagbla he toi,
ejaakɛ tɔmɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ la ni baashã nii kɛshɛ agboŋsamiiaje, ni ebaashã nii ni miyɔɔ fɛɛ wɛɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Kɛji miyeee mitsulɔ nuu loo mitsulɔ yoo jalɛ sane be ni amɛ kɛ mi ena lɛ,
no lɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ te shi wo mi lɛ? Kɛji eba kojomɔ lɛ, te majie minaa makɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ani mɔ ni bɔ mi ewo musuŋ lɛ jeee lɛ nɔŋŋ ebɔ amɛ? Ani jeee mɔ koome shɔ̃ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ musuŋ?
Kɛji mikãma ohiafoi nii ni amɛtaoɔ, aloo mihã jeŋ fee okulafo awerɛho,
aloo miye nii mi kome pɛ, ni mihãaa awusãi eko
tsɛbelɛ mi mihiɛ lɛ akɛ tsɛ kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ, ni kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe lɛ mi, miwa lɛ.
Kɛji mina mɔ ko ni efĩ lɛ ni mama bɛ ehe, loo ohiafo ko ni bɛ nɔ ni ehaa lɛ,
no lɛ mahã lɛ mama ni akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoo he tsɔi lo koni ehe afee kulɔɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ ebaajie miyi kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ.
Kɛji miwo minine nɔ yɛ awusã ko nɔ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ abaabu mi bem yɛ kojomɔhe lɛ
no lɛ mikɔ̃ŋ lɛ akpɔ yɛ mikɔ̃ŋ wu lɛ he, ni minine hu atse kɛje kɔ̃ŋ wu lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ misheɔ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ gbeyei. Ni minyɛŋ Ofe lɛ hiɛ madamɔ.
Keji miŋɔ shika mifee mihiɛnɔkamɔ, aloo mitsɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi mihiɛnɔkamɔ,
ni minya ejaakɛ minii ni mina fa babaoo, ni minine eshɛ nii babaoo nɔ.
ni hewɔ ni mija hulu kɛji eetso, loo nyɔŋtsere kɛji eekpɛ fɛɛfɛo kɛmiiho.
Kɛji nɔ ko elaka mitsui ni miwo amɛ yɛ teemɔŋ ni mishwɔ minine naa kɛ hiɛsɔlɛ mihã amɛ lɛ,
no hu nifɔɔjianii ni esa akɛ kojolɔi lɛ awo he nyɔmɔ ni. Ejaakɛ kulɛ miyeko Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anɔkwa.
Minyako yɛ oshrã ni eshrã mihenyɛlɔ hewɔ, ni mimli efliko mi be ni amanehulu eba enɔ.
Miŋmɛko minaabu gbɛ ni efee esha, ni mitaoko egbele kɛ kitãkãmɔ.
Mishīaŋbii ekɛŋ akɛ, 'Wɔteŋ namɔ yeko edɛŋ niyenii etɔko dã?'
Gbɔ ko gbɔ ko etooo blohuŋ; migbleɔ mishinaa mihãa gbɔ be fɛɛ be.
Mitsimɔko mitɔ̃mɔi anɔ tamɔ Adam, ni mikɛ minɔsha lɛ etoko mimli.
Misheko mɛi asafo lɛ gbeyei, ni bɔ ni wekui baanyaŋe mi hu wooo mihe gbeyei, ni no hewɔ ni mifee diŋŋ, ni mishiii shīaŋ mijeee kpo ejaakɛ miishe amɛ gbeyei.
Ao, mina mɔ ko ni aaabo mi toi! Naa, minine naa okadi! Ofe lɛ ahã mi hetoo! Ao, mina ni kulɛ mɔ ni kɛ mi ena lɛ eŋmla saji ni ekɛshiɔ mi lɛ ewo wolo hiɛ!
Anɔkwa, kulɛ mawo matswa mikɔŋ, ni mikɛbaafee akekre mafi miyitso.
Kulɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee, ni matsi mabɛŋkɛ lɛ tamɔ lumɔ!
Kɛji shikpɔŋ ni mihu nɔ blɔ wo mi ni enɔ akofii wo yara kutuu;
kɛji mikpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yibii miye ni miwooo nyɔmɔ, ni no nɔ tsɔ̃ ni nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gboi lɛ,
no lɛ ŋmei akwɛ̃ yɛ ŋmãa najiaŋ, ŋmei gbohii akwɛ̃ yɛ able najiaŋ." Hiob wiemɔ lɛ naagbee nɛ.
32: Kɛkɛ ni hii etɛ̃ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Hiob hetoohãmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ Hiob wiemɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko.
Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel ni jɛ Ram weku lɛ mli lɛ, mli wo la. Emli wo la ewo Hiob, ejaakɛ Hiob bu ehe jalɔ ni eshwa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Emlifu Hiob nanemɛi etɛ̃ lɛ hu, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa hetoo ko amɛhã Hiob, tsɛbelɛ amɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ amɛbua he akɛ Hiob yeɔ fɔ.
Elihu mɛ be fioo dani ekɛ Hiob wie, ejaakɛ Hiob nanemɛi lɛ ye lɛ onukpa.
Be ni Elihu na akɛ hii etɛ̃ nɛɛ bɛ nɔ ko dɔŋŋ ni amɛkɛɔ Hiob lɛ, emli wo la.
Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel bi lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Gbekɛ ji mi yɛ afii amli, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛdra; no hewɔ lɛ mishe gbeyei ni mikɛ misusumɔ aŋmɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ nyɛji mɛi ni esa akɛ nyɛwie; nyɛ waŋtsɛmɛi nyɛwieɔ ni akaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mumɔ ni yɔɔ adesa mli, Ofe lɛ mumɔ ni ekɛmuɔ lɛ, no hãa enaa jwɛŋmɔ.
Jeee dalɛ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii, ni jeee gbɔlɛ hu ni hãa anuɔ sane shishi.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛboa mi toi koni mihu mawie mijwɛŋmɔ.
Naa, mito mitsui shi mibo nyɛwiemɔi lɛ atoi, mimɛ beiaŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ lɛ.
Mibo nyɛ toi aahuu; ni naa, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ekuuu ewooo Hiob naa; aloo nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ehã ewiemɔi lɛ ahetoo.
Nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔle nii. Nyɔŋmɔ ni aaaku enaa, shi jeee gbɔmɔ.'
Ewieko eshiko mi, ni mikɛ nyɛnaa wiemɔi lɛ haŋ lɛ hetoo.
Ashi amɛ shi, amɛhãaa hetoo dɔŋŋ; amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni esa akɛ mimɛɔ ejaakɛ amɛwieee; amɛdamɔdamɔɔ shi ni amɛhãaa wiemɔ ko hetoo dɔŋŋ?
Mi hu makɛɛ minɔ; ni mi hu mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.
Ejaakɛ minyɛɛɛ mamua minaa dɔŋŋ; mumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli ekplɛ̃ɛɛ mi dɔŋŋ.
Naa, mitsui etsɔ̃ tamɔ wain ni atsi naa kpɛŋŋ, ni ebɛ mumɔhe, etamɔ wain wolotɔi hei ni heɔ aflɛ.
Mawie koni mana hejɔlɛ. Ja migble minaa mihã hetoo.
Mikwɛŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ, ni midɔkɔŋ minaa mihaŋ mɔ ko.
Ejaakɛ mileee mɔhlɔmɔ; nakai ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mi-Bɔlɔ lɛ, aaafo miwala sɛɛ biɛ be kukuoo mli."
33: "Ni agbɛnɛ, Hiob, bo toi, ni ofee toi ohã miwiemɔi fɛɛ.
Naa, migble minaa ni mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.
Wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mawie lɛ jɛ mitsui mli krɔŋŋ; ni mawie nɔ ni mile anɔkwaleŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni bɔ mi, ni Ofe lɛ mumɔ lɛ hãa miyi naa wala.
Kɛji ooonyɛ lɛ, too he ohã mi; saamɔ ohe; saamɔ nɔ ni obaakɛɛ lɛ oto.
Naa, mi kɛ bo ye egbɔ yɛ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ; mi hu sū nɔŋŋ akɛshɔ̃ mi.
Naa, mihe ŋmiŋmi akawo ohe gbeyei; minyɛŋ onɔ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, owie owo mitoiiaŋ, ni minu owiemɔi lɛ.
Okɛɛ akɛ, 'mihe tse, tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe; miyeɔ bem, ni mikefo esha ko.
Naa, eetao sane efo eŋmɛ minɔ; ebuɔ mi akɛ ehenyɛlɔ.
Ebɔ minaji apã, ejie ehiɛ eka mi.'
Naa, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, enɛ mli lɛ osane lɛ ejaaa; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ da aahuu fe adesa.
Mɛni hewɔ oshwaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, 'Ehãaa miwiemɔi lɛ eko kwraa hetoo lɛ.'
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wieɔ shii abɔ fɛɛ ni adesa ediii sɛɛ.
Nyɔɔŋ be ni wɔ ni tsii enyɔ adesai anɔ yɛ emɛsai amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔ kɛ nyɔɔŋ ninaa nɔ
ni egbleɔ adesai atoiiaŋ ni ekɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ woɔ amɛhe gbeyei
koni ehã adesa akpale kɛjɛ enifeemɔnii he, ni ehã adesa akpa ehenɔwomɔ lɛ.
Etsiɔ adesa susuma naa koni ekayagbee Bu Kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli; ebuɔ ewala hu he koni akakpãtã hiɛ kɛ klaŋte
Nyɔŋmɔ gblaa adesa toi kɛ saa mli piŋmɔ kɛ ewuiaŋ kpemɔ,
ni no hãa edaaŋ gboɔ kɛ niyeli, ni ekpoɔ niyenii ni kpɔɔ ewɔlɔmɔ tete.
Etãa loo ni ehiii lɛ kwɛmɔ, ni egbɔmɔtsoŋ wui ni kulɛ anaaa lɛ bajwereɔ shi faŋŋ.
Ebɛŋkɛɔ gbohiiaje, ni ewala bɛŋkɛɔ gbele bɔfoi lɛ.
Kɛji ena bɔfoi akpe lɛ ateŋ eko damɔ mli hã lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ ni hi hã lɛ,
ni ena gbɔmɔ mɔbɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Jiemɔ lɛ kɛjɛ gbohiiajeyaa mli, mina eyinii ni akɛkpɔ̃ lɛ.'
No lɛ eheloo aaatsɔ̃ ef́ɔ tamɔ gbekɛ nɔ, ni eeeku sɛɛ etsɔ̃ oblanyo ekoŋŋ.
Eeekpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, ni eeedro lɛ; ni eeeba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ nyamɔ. Eeegba eyiwalaheremɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi.
Ni eeela yɛ adesai ahiɛ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, 'mifee esha, ni mikɔ̃dɔ̃ nɔ ji ja; ni akɛ mihe fa mi;
Ehere misusuma kɛje gbohiiaje ni mihiɛ kã lolo.'
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ shii abɔ ehãa gbɔmɔ
koni ehere eyiwala kɛje gbohiiaje koni wala afee enɔ.
Ao Hiob, ka otoi! Bo mi toi, feemɔ diŋŋ, mibawie!
Kɛji oyɛ nɔ ko ni oookɛɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mi! Wiemɔ, shi miitao bo bem mabu.
Kɛ jeee nakai lɛ, bo moŋ bo mi toi; feemɔ diŋŋ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee."
34: Kɛkɛ ni Elihu kɛɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛ nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, nyɛboa miwiemɔ toi, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa mi,
ejaakɛ toi akɛŋmɛɔ wiemɔ akwɛɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ lilɛi saa niyenii naa akwɛɔ lɛ.
Nyɛhãa wɔkɔa nɔ ni ja, nyɛhãa wɔsusua he yɛ wɔteŋ wɔna nɔ ni hi.
Ejaakɛ Hiob ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Miyeɔ bem' shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi yeee yɛ jalɛ naa;
bem ni miyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, abu mi amalelɔ; Mifla lɛ bɛ tsabaa, tsɛbelɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe.
Namɔ ena mɔ ko tamɔ Hiob, mɔ ni bɔɔ musu tamɔ anuɔ nu pɛŋ?
Mɔ ni kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii bɔɔ naanyo, ni ekɛ gbɔmɛi fɔɔji nyiɛɔ?
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaabɔ naanyo!'
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi. Enɛ akagbale Nyɔŋmɔ fɔɔŋfɔ akɛ eeefee nɔ fɔŋ, aloo Ofe lɛ, eeefee nɔ ko ni ejaaa hu.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa, ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ yeɔ yɛ ejeŋba naa.
Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ yeee toikɔ̃dɔ̃mɔ sane; ni Ofe lɛ tsɔ̃ɔɔ sane hiɛ ebuuu shi.
Namɔ ji mɔ ni kɛ je lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ hã lɛ? Namɔ kɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hã lɛ?
Kɛji eeeŋɔ emumɔ lɛ yɛ je lɛŋ, ni eeehã mumɔ lɛ akpale kwraa kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ.
no lɛ heloo fɛɛ heloo hiɛ aaakpãtã; ni gbɔmɔ aaatsɔ̃ sũ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji oyɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ bo toi! Bo nɔ ni makɛɛ lɛ toi!
Ani mɔ ni taooo jalɛ saneyeli baanyɛ mɛi anɔ eye? Ani ooobu mɔ ni ja ni eyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ fɔ?
Ani ooobu mɔ ni kɛɔ maŋtsɛ akɛ 'Yakagbɔmɔ' kɛ lumɛi hu akɛ, 'Yitsoŋwalɔi?'
Ni ekwɛɛɛ lumɛi ahiɛ ni ebuuu niiatsɛ fe ohiafo, ejaakɛ lɛ eninenaa nitsumɔ nii ji amɛ fɛɛ kwa lɛ bem?
Trukaa gbɔmɔ gboɔ; ahosoɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni ehoɔ eyaa; hewalɔi hoɔ amɛyaa, ni amɔtsɔ̃ɔɔ adesa nine nɔ.
Ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛi jwere gbɔmɔ adesa jeŋba nɔ, ni onaa enyiɛmɔhei fɛɛ.
Duŋ kabitii bɛ he ko he ko ni mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii aaanyɛ atee amɛhe yɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ etoko be pɔtɛɛ ko ehãko adesa ko ni eeeya kojomɔ yɛ lɛ ehiɛ.
Ekpãtãa hewalɔi ahiɛ ni etaooo amɛsaji amli, ni eholeɔ mɛi krokomɛi etoɔ amɛnajiaŋ.
Akɛni ele amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ, ebutuɔ amɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.
Egblaa mɛi fɔɔji atoi yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛkpale yɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛbuuu egbɛi lɛ ekoeko;
ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛhã ohiafoi ayaafo yashɛ eŋɔɔ; ni enu mɛi ni efĩ amɛ lɛ ablɔmɔ.
Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ fee diŋŋ lɛ, namɔ baanyɛ lɛ ashwa? Kɛji ekɛ ehiɛ tee lɛ namɔ baanyɛ ehiɛ lɛ ena?
Nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ afee koni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ akaye maŋ nɔ, ni ekahã maŋbii gbee oshrã mli.
Ejaakɛ ani mɔ ko ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dã akɛ 'Agbla mitoi. Mifeŋ nɔ ni ehiii dɔŋŋ;
tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi nibii ni minaaa; koni kɛji mifee nɔ ni ehiii lɛ mikafee nakai dɔŋŋ?'
Akɛni okwa egbɛi lɛ, ani Nyɔŋmɔ baafee nɔ ni otaoɔ ehã o lo? Kɛɛmɔ nɔ ni ole lɛ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ esa akɛ okɔɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ; shi jeee mi matsɔ̃ɔ bo.
Mɛi ni nuɔ nii ashishi baakɛɛ mi; ni nilelɔi ni nuɔ nɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ baakɛɛ akɛ,
'Hiob wieɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli; nilee bɛ ewiemɔ mli.'
Mina ni kulɛ aka Hiob akwɛ kɛyashi naagbee, ejaakɛ hetoi ni ehãa lɛ tamɔ mɛi fɔɔji anaa wiemɔ.
Ejaakɛ eetse atūa efata esha ni efee lɛ he, eetswa edɛ̃ eshwie wɔnɔ ni eewie babaoo eeshi Nyɔŋmɔ."
35: Kɛkɛ ni Elihu saa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ,
"Aso osusuɔ akɛ eja gbɛ akɛ oookɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ohe,
hewɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he? Mɛɛ ejurɔ miyeɔ kɛji mifee esha lɛ?'
Mahã bo kɛ onanemɛi ni fata ohe lɛ fɛɛ hetoo.
Kwɛmɔ ŋwɛi! Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni atatui lɛ yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ yɛ oyiteŋ!
Kɛji ofee esha lɛ, mɛni ona ofee Nyɔŋmɔ? Kɛji ofee esha lɛ shii abɔ po, mɛɛ awui no yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ?
Kɛji jalɔ ji bo lɛ, mɛni okɛwa Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo mɛni enaa kɛjɛɔ odɛŋ?
Esha ni ofeɔ lɛ, adesa tamɔ bo awui eyeɔ, ni ojalɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔ eyeɔ ebuaa.
Yiwaa babaoo hãa maŋbii lɛ blɔɔ; amɛblɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ yɛ ojei ayiwalɛ nifeemɔnii ahewɔ.
Shi mɔ ko kwraa ekɛɛɛ akɛ, 'Nɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mibɔlɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɔ ni hãa hiɛnɔkamɔ yɛ fimɔbe mli kɛ
mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii fe bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ, ni ehãa wɔleɔ nii fe ŋwɛi loofɔji lɛ?'
Amɛblɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ shi Nyɔŋmɔ efooo amɛdaaŋ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii kɛ amɛhenɔwomɔ hewɔ.
Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ booo yaka yaafo toi, ni Ofe lɛ ebuuu hu.
Nɔ ni wa fe fɛɛ ji akɛ, oookɛɛ akɛ onaaa lɛ, ni sane lɛ kã ehiɛ, ni oomɛ lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifugblaaa mɔ toi, ni ediii tɔ̃mɔ sɛɛ yrɛdɛɛ hewɔ lɛ,
Hiob, oowie huu, oowie babaoo ni nilee bɛ mli."
36: Elihu tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Na tsui ohã mi fioo, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ko naa, ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔ ko lolo ni mibawie mahã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Minilee babaoo lɛ mli majɛ matsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mi-Bɔlɔ lɛ yeɔ jalɛ sane.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwa wiemɔ miwieɔ lɛ. Mɔ ko ni le nii jogbaŋŋ damɔ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo, ni enyaŋeee mɔ ko mɔ ko; eniiashishinumɔ naa wa jogbaŋŋ.
Ehãaa mɔ fɔŋ yi ana wala, shi ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ.
Ehiŋmɛi kãa jalɔ he, ni ehãa amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ tamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni tra sɛ̃ii anɔ ni awoɔ amɛnɔ gojoo.
Kɛji awo amɛ gboklɛi ni amanehulu efimɔ amɛ lɛ,
kɛkɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni amɛfee, amɛtɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛhenɔwomɔ lɛ.
Egbleɔ amɛtoiiaŋ, ni amɛnuɔ kãmɔ ni ekãa amɛ akɛ amɛkpa nishaianii feemɔ lɛ.
Kɛji amɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ lɛ, amɛaaye amɛwala be lɛ yɛ ejurɔyeli mli, kɛ amɛfii lɛ hu yɛ miishɛɛ mli.
Shi kɛji amɛbooo toi lɛ, no lɛ amɛleŋ nii, ni amɛaagboi yɛ klaŋte naa.
Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ mlifu he; kɛji efi amɛ tete lɛ amɛbiii Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ.
Amɛgboiɔ yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ, ni amɛwala sɛɛ foɔ kɛ hiɛgble kɛ tɔlɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔseɔ gbɔmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ amanehulu nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔnaa gbeleɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ jie bo kɛje jramɔ mli; kɛba he ko ni ohe jɔ bo yɛ, ni okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ niyenii.
Shi agbɛnɛ aagbla otoi bɔ ni sa bo pɛpɛɛpɛ; aagbla otoi yɛ jalɛ naa.
Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni akɛ nyɔɔŋnihamɔ akalaka o; ni kaahã ninamɔ miihã oodu gbɛ.
Aso oyaafo baanyɛ bo ahere, aloo ohewalɛ kɛ oshika aaanyɛ nɔ ko afee?
Kaashwe ni duŋ awo, be ni maji ahiɛ aaakpãtã lɛ.
Kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ ni okabɔ̃i eshafeemɔ; ejaakɛ oosumɔ enɛ moŋ fe nɔnaa.
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo yɛ ehewalɛ lɛ naa; ni mɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ lɛ ye egbɔ?
Namɔ baanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni sa akɛ efee, aloo namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, 'Ofee nɔ ko ni ejaaa'.
Kaimɔ koni okafo enifeemɔ ni adesai fɛɛ ewo he lala lɛ.
Adesai fɛɛ miikwɛ enifeemɔ kɛmiijɛ shɔŋŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ adesa nuuu shishi.
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ da, shi wɔleee lɛ; ni wɔnyɛŋ efii ni eye wɔkane
Ejaakɛ egblaa nu kulibii kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni ehãa afua tsɔ̃ɔ nu,
ni ŋwɛi fɔseɔ shwieɔ shi, ni ebashwieɔ adesai fɛɛ anɔ babaoo.
Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ anu bɔ ni atatui ha ŋwɛi lɛ shishi, aloo eeenu ŋwɛishiimɔ shishi?
Naa, egbɛ ŋwɛi srawa mli kɛbɔle ehe; shi ehãŋshɔ shishi wo duŋ.
Ejaakɛ gbɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ elɛɔ adesai nɛ, ni ekumaa amɛ niyenii babaoo.
Ekɛ enine mɔɔ ŋwɛi srawa mli ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ he ni egba kɛyayi.
Ŋwɛi srawa gbɛɛmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni eji, akɛ mɔ ko ni mli fūɔ yɛ nishaianii hewɔ."
37: "Ŋwɛishiimɔ lɛ hãa mitsui tswaa ni tse po eheɔ etse yɛ mimli nɛɛ.
Nyɛboa Nyɔŋmɔ gbee ni ji ŋwɛishiimɔ lɛ toi, kɛ shiimɔ ni jɛ edaaŋ lɛ.
Eŋmɛɔ he ewoɔ ŋwɛi shishi fɛɛ, ni ŋwɛi srawa gblaa kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ŋwɛishiimɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewoɔ egbee kɛ agbojee; ni etsiii srawa naa be mli ni eshiɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ gbeeshiimɔ yɛ naakpɛɛ ni efeɔ nibii wuji ni wɔjwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he.
Ekɛɔ snoo akɛ, 'nɛɛ oshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛɔ nu kɛ futufuli akɛ, nɛɛ waa!'
Ejieɔ gbɔmɔ nine yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ he, koni adesai fɛɛ ana ale akɛ lɛ efeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋaŋ kooloi yaa amɛbuiaŋ, ni amɛhlɔ amɛshihilɛhei lɛaŋ.
Ahum jɛɔ wuoyigbɛ ebaa, ni fɛ̃i hu jeɔ kooyigbɛ.
Mumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ muɔ lɛ naa hãa nu fiɔ kpɔ, ni fai fɛɛ fiɔ tɔo tsɔ̃ɔ aisi.
Ehãa atatui yiɔ kɛ nu ni ehãa srawa kpɛlɛɔ yɛ atatui lɛaŋ.
Amɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ egbɛjianɔtoo naa; amɛyeɔ efãmɔ nɔ yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Bei komɛi lɛ, ehãa enɛɛmɛi baa koni egbla gbɔmɛi atoi, bei komɛi lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ yibaamɔ hewɔ, ni bei komɛi hu koni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ ni eyɔɔ.
Ao, bo enɛ toi, Hiob, da gãa koni ojwɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ efãa amɛ ehãa, ni ehãa la kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ atatu mli?
Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni le nii kɛwula shi lɛ feɔ etsuɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔ ni hãa atatu sɛŋɔ shi lɛ?
Ele bo bɔ ni otadei amli dɔɔ la, be ni ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ efee shiŋŋ yɛ wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ?
Ani obaanyɛ olɛɛ ŋwɛi, ni tamɔ dade kãŋkãŋ ni ashwie nɛɛ, mli oha shi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee lɛ?
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ wɔjwɛŋmɔ naa etã, wɔbɛ nɔ ko ni wɔbaakɛɛ.
Akakɛɛ lɛ akɛ masumɔ mawie; mɔ ko bɛ ni baasumɔ akɛ ekpãtã ehe hiɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ adesa nyɛɛɛ la lɛ ekwɛ, kɛ jeŋ tse tete, ejaakɛ atatui eha hiɛ; shi kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa lɛ eloɔ atatui lɛ kɛyaa.
La tsuru fɔɔ kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ kooyigbɛ kɛbaa. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ he anumnyam lɛ hãa wɔsheɔ gbeyei.
Ofe lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ lɛ wɔna; ehewalɛ da, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane; ekpãŋ jalɛ saneyeli.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ adesai fɛɛ, nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɛi ni buɔ amɛhe nilelɔi lɛ, ebuuu amɛ."
38: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli ehã Hiob hetoo ekɛɛ,
"Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi ni nilee bɛ mli ehã mijwɛŋmɔ hiɛ ehua nɛɛ?
Feemɔ kralo odamɔ shi tamɔ nuu, shi mibabi bo sane ni ohã hetoo.
Be ni mito je lɛ shishi lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ oyɔɔ? Kɛji ole he nɔ ko lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mi!
Namɔ ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni eda ehã; aloo namɔ ji mɔ ni mɔ kpãa mli kɛsusu adalɛ lɛ? Bɛ ole?
Mɛni nɔ ato je lɛ shishi ama? Namɔ ji mɔ ni to ekoŋtɛ lɛ?
Be ni leebi ŋulamii lɛ fɛɛ la kutuu ni ŋwɛibii lɛ bɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ lɛ?
Aloo namɔ ŋamɔ agboi lɛ ekɛtsi ŋshɔ lɛ naa, be ni etue kɛjɛ je lɛ shishitoo he lɛ.
Be ni mihã atatui tsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hebo, ni mihã duŋ kpii hu tsɔ̃ mama ni mikɛbla lɛ lɛ?
Be ni mito je lɛ husui ni mikɛ agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabãŋi tsi enaa,
ni mikɛɛ akɛ, 'Biɛ nɛɛ obaawa, ni okafo mli; ni biɛ oshɔkei wuji lɛ baawa.'
Hiob, ni oba jeŋ nɛɛ, ofã Ni je etsɛre dã? Ni otsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ egbɛhe pɛŋ?
Ani ofã jetsɛremɔ ni emɔmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee hei lɛ amli koni ehwanya mɛi fɔɔji fɛɛ kɛje nɔ eshwie dã lo?
Jetsɛremɔ hãa gɔji kɛ jɔi jeɔ shi faŋŋ tamɔ atade ni akumɔ mli loo tamɔ naasɔomɔnɔ ni ta magbɛ hiɛ.
Ehãa mɛi fɔɔji enãaa hei nu amɛaatsɔ̃, ni amɛniji ni amɛkɛtsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ kumɔɔ yɛ amɛhe.
Aso oshɛ he ni ŋshɔ jɛɔ lɛ pɛŋ; ni oshera shi kɛnyiɛŋshɔ shishi dã?
Ani ajie gbohiiaje agboi lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ bo, aloo ajie duŋ kpii lɛ naa agboi lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ bo?
Ani ole je lɛ dalɛ? Kɛji ole nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, wiemɔ!
Nɛgbɛ atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa he ni la jɛɔ, loo nɛɛgbɛ ji duŋ shihilɛhe,
koni otsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ ni kã shi kɛyaa eshihilɛhe lɛ mli, koni oŋɔ lɛ oyato ehusu nɔ?
Bɛ ole, ejaakɛ ofii fa babaoo ni no mli lɛ afɔ bo!
Obote tsui ni mito snoo yɛ mli, loo tsui ni mito nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi yɛ mli pɛŋ,
ni ji nii ni mito mihã amanehulu be loo nɔmɔ kɛ ta be lɛ?
Nɛgbɛ gbɛ ni yaa heni hulu la lɛ jɛɔ egbɛɔ eshwãa, loo he ni bokãgbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ jɛɔ eshwãa je lɛ mli lɛ kã?
Namɔ egba nujɔɔ efɔ̃ shi koni nu ni miinɛ anyiɛ mli, ni eje gbɛ ehã srawa,
bɔ ni afee ni nu anɛ ashwie shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nɔ, kɛ shiaŋa he ni adesa ko bɛ hu nɔ?
Namɔ hãa shikpɔŋ olɛŋlɛ ni kã shi eflo naa ofɔ̃, ni jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ?
Ani nu ni nɛɔ yɛ tsɛ, loo namɔ ni fɔ bo?
Namɔ musuŋ aisi jɛ, ni namɔ fɔ ŋwɛi bɔ ni efimɔ kpɔbii.
Nu fiɔ, ni ewaa tamɔ tɛ, ni ŋshɔ hiɛ fɛɛ waa keketee.
"Ani obaanyɛ okɛ kɔsɔŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ afimɔ Wuɔ kɛ ebiiŋ? Aloo obaanyɛ kpãi ni fimɔ Oŋwɛ ofɛne?
Ani obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii ni kplɛɔ lɛ he ni amɛtsɔ̃ kɛya kɛji amɛje, aloo obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Jeŋ Kpawo kɛ ebii lɛ gbɛ?
Ani ole akpɔi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi, aloo obaanyɛ ohã nakai akpɔi lɛ aye shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ?
Ani obaanyɛ owo ogbee nɔ ni ofã atatui lɛ koni amɛnɛ nu amɛshwie onɔ?
Ani obaanyɛ ofã srawai akɛ amɛgbla, ni ani amɛaaba oŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ bo akɛ, 'Naa wɔ?'
Namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ looflɔ̃ ibis be ni Nilo baasraŋ nɔ? Aloo namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ wuɔ nuu akɛ nu baanɛ?
Namɔ yɔɔ nilee ni ekɛbaanyɛ atatui lɛ ekane? Aloo ebaanyɛ ekpoo amɛnaa shi koni amɛnɛ nu
ni baahã su akpɔtɔ ni efimɔ kukulibii efee tɔo?
Ani bo omiɔ milɛ̃loo ohãa jata, aloo ohãa jatabii loo amɛyeɔ shɛɔ amɛnaa
be ni amɛbumɔ amɛbui amli, aloo amɛhlɔ odɔtoi amli amɛwo ka lɛ?
Namɔ hã kwaakwaalabite niyenii, be ni ebii bibii blɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtsomloɔ, ejaakɛ niyenii bɛ lɛ?
39: "Ani ole be mli ni afɔɔ gɔjianɔ abotiai lo? Ona ofrote ni eefɔ dã?
Ole nyɔji abɔ ni amɛhiɛɔ musu? Ole amɛfɔmɔ be lo?
Ani ole be mli ni amɛsɔ̃ɔ shi amɛfɔɔ amɛbii lo?
Amɛbii lɛ naa hewalɛ, ni amɛdraa yɛ jwɛiiaŋ; amɛjeɔ kpo, ni amɛkuuu amɛsɛɛ amɛbaaa dɔŋŋ.
Namɔ ŋmɛ̃ɛ ŋaŋ teji he koni eye ehe? Namɔ fɛne kpãa lɛ ehã teji?
Ni miŋɔ ŋa kplanaa lɛ mihã lɛ akɛ eshīa, ni miŋɔ mukpo shikpɔŋ lɛ mihã lɛ akɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ.
Esumɔɔɔ hoo ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ni enuuu mɔ ko ni miikpla lɛ gbee.
Gɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ɔ eniyelihe, ni etaoɔ nii ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ yɛ jɛi eyeɔ.
Ani koo mli tsina aaakplɛ̃ ni esɔ̃mɔ bo? Aloo eeesumɔ ni ebawɔ kooloi awɔɔhe?
Ani obaanyɛ owo tsinaa nuu kpãa ni etsa akofii, aloo etsa akofii yɛ jɔi amli kɛnyiɛ osɛɛ?
Ani okɛ ohe aaafɔ̃ enɔ yɛ ehewalɛ kple lɛ hewɔ, aloo oooshi nitsumɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ oŋmɛ enɔ?
Ani oheɔ lɛ oyeɔ akɛ ekɛ onikpamɔnii lɛ baaku esɛɛ aba, ni eeebua oŋmãa lɛ naa kɛaaba?
Duguma tswaa efijiaŋ kɛ ntɛŋ; shi hewalɛ kome nɛkɛ bɛ mli ni ekɛaafliki.
Ejaakɛ eshiɔ ewɔji lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ koni shikpɔŋ mlu mli dɔlɛ lɛ ahã amɛhe adɔ la.
Ni ehiɛ kpaa nɔ akɛ mɔ ko kɛ enane aaanyɛ ajwara amɛ; ni ŋaŋ kooloi aaanyɛ amɛnaanaa nɔ.
Ewaa ebii bibii lɛ ayi, tamɔ nɔ ni jeee ebii ni; etɔlɛ lɛ aaanyɛ afee yaka kɛ̃lɛ̃ esheee no gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã nilee ebɔ lɛ, ni jwɛŋmɔ hu ehãaa lɛ eko.
Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ, ni ebaabɔ̃i fɔijee lɛ eŋmɔɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
"Hiob, boji mɔ ni hã okpɔŋɔ hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ? Ekuɛ he tsɔi funyaŋ lɛ, bo ohã lɛ?
Ani bo ohãa okpɔŋɔ huluɔ tamɔ baalabi tuɔ lɛ? Etsinemɔ gbɛɛmɔ yɛ gbeyei!
Ekɛ enane gbɛɔ shi yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli, enyaa yɛ ehewalɛ lɛ hewɔ; ejeɔ kpo ekɛ tabilɔi yakpeɔ.
Eleee nɔ ni ji gbeyei, ni ekpokpooo yɛ no hewɔ; ni ejooo foi yɛ ta naa.
Gãimlibii akotoku gbɛɔ woɔ lɛ, ni akplɔ kplɛɔ nyramnyram woɔ lɛ.
Ekɛ hiɛdɔɔ kɛ grimɔ kpitiɔ shi; enyɛɛɛ shi edamɔ kɛji tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛ.
Kɛji tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Yiɛ, eshɛ!' Enyiɛ shɔŋŋ ni enuɔ ta he fu, kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ efaamɔi kɛ blɔmɔ he.
Ani bo onilee naa ni laalɔɔ flikiɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni egbɛɔ efijiaŋ etsɔ̃ɔ wuoyigbɛ?
Ani bo ofamɔ naa ni okropɔŋ woɔ ehe nɔ ni eyafeɔ etsu yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ?
Tɛsaa ni kwɔ fe fɛɛ nɔ he ni yɔɔ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ, efeɔ eshihilɛhe yɛ.
Jɛi ejɛɔ ni enaa kooloo ni eeemɔ; ehiŋmɛi naa shɔŋŋ nii.
He ni gbohii jwere lɛ, jɛi okropɔŋ yɔɔ; ni ebii bibii lɛ nuɔ gbohii lɛ alá."
40: Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Hiob akɛ,
"Aso mɔ ni miitao mɔ he tɔmɔ ekɛɛ lɛ ebaanyɛ ekɛ Ofe lɛ ataa naa? Mɔ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitaa naa lɛ, hã ehã hetoo.
Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here Yehowa nɔ ni ekɛɛ,
"Naa, mijeee mɔ ko; mɛɛ hetoo mahã? Mikɛ minine eto minaabu.
Miwie shi kome, ni mitoŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ. Miwie shii enyɔ; ni miyaŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli ekɛ Hiob wie ekoŋŋ,
"Miamɔ tamɔ nuu; mibabi bo sane koni ojie mi naa.
Aso ooka ni otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mitɔ̃? Oobu mi fɔ koni oye bem?
Aso ohewalɛ shɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ, ni obaanyɛ ohã ogbee ashi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ lo?
Kɛji nakai lɛ, no lɛ wulamɔ ohe koni ogbojee akwɔ ni onumnyam ada kple.
Grimɔ kɛ mlifu ni okɛnina hewolɔ fɛɛ hewolɔ koni oba lɛ shi;
hɛɛ hewolɔ fɛɛ hewolɔ lɛ oba lɛ shi, ni otsirɛ yiwalɔi otswia shi yɛ hei ni amɛdamɔ.
Tsiimɔ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ owo shikpɔŋ, ni ofimɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yɛ gbohiiaje,
Kɛkɛ lɛ mi hu makplɛ̃ no mahã bo akɛ oyɛ hewalɛ ni baanyɛ ehã oye kunim.
Kwɛmɔ nuŋshwuɔ; mi, mibɔ lɛ tamɔ mibɔ bo. Ekpeɔ jwɛi tamɔ tsina,
shi kwɛmɔ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehɛ mli, kɛ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehewojiaŋ fãi lɛ mli.
Ehãa elei shɔ̃ɔ ketetee tamɔ tsenedru, ni atswɛ̃tsɛ̃ fãi ni yɔɔ eshwuɔji amli lɛ.
Ewui wa tamɔ akɔɔble, ni eniji kɛ enaji tamɔ dade adabãŋ.
Leji Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ titri ko; mɔ ni bɔ lɛ lɛ pɛ nyɛɔ enɔ eyeɔ,
Ejaakɛ ŋmɛi tsei lɛ hãa lɛ hɔɔŋ yɛ he ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ yashwɛɔ yɛ lɛ.
Ehoɔ ekãa shi yɛ ŋmei tsei ashishi, ni eteɔ ehe yɛ glãi amli yɛ ŋmiamɔ mli,
ejaakɛ ŋmei tsei lɛ hãa lɛ hɔɔŋ ni faa lɛ mli jwɛi lɛ bɔleɔ ehe kɛkpeɔ.
Naa, kɛji faa lɛ fee hamahama tete ewooo ehe gbeyei; kɛji Yordan yi kɛbata esɛ̃ tete po eyoyrooo.
Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ eje ehiɛgbɛ ni emɔ lɛ, aloo ekɛ tsɔne adu egugɔ?"
41: "Obaanyɛ okɛ kpoŋ asha leviatan aloo okɛ kpãa afi elilɛi akpɛtɛ edaaŋ?
Ani ooonyɛ owo egugɔŋ kpãa aloo okɛ kpoŋ aaala ekadaa?
Ani eekpa bo fai babaoo? Aloo ekɛ bo aaawie naajɔlɛ wiemɔi?
Ani ekɛ bo aaakpãŋ akɛ oŋɔ lɛ ofee otsulɔ kɛya naanɔ lo?
Ani okɛ lɛ baashwɛ tamɔ akɛ looflɔ shwɛɔ, aloo obaafi lɛ ohã oblayei lo?
Ani wolɛi baaba amɛbaye enaa? Ani amɛaaflɔ emli amɛhã jrayelɔi lo?
Ani ooonyɛ otsulɔ akplɔi owo ehewojian obɔ̃, aloo oootsulɔ eyitso kɛ wuoyaa akplɔ?
Kɛ onine ata ehe okwɛ, ni ofeŋ nakai ekoŋŋ, ohiɛ kpãŋ nɔmɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ nɔ.
Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baana leviatan lɛ enijiaŋ jeɔ wui, ni egbeɔ shi.
Kãkãlɔ ko kãkãlɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ awo ehiɛ la. Belɛ namɔ ji mɔ ni aaanyɛ mi mihiɛ adamɔ mɔ?
Namɔ kwraa etsɔ̃ hiɛ efee nɔ ko ehã mi, koni mato lɛ najiaŋ? Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ, minɔ ni.
Mibawie eniji kɛ enaji kɛ ehewalɛ kple kɛ egbɔmɔtso he daa.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni baanyɛ ehewolo lɛ ekpɔ; aloo eta enyanyɔji nta lɛ he.
Namɔ baanyɛ agble edaa kɛyanina enyanyɔji ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ.
Ehe totoi ni ato amɛ klɛmpɛi tsra nɔ ha ekoto sɛɛ, ni atsra amɛ tamɔ nɔ ni asɔo amɛnaa.
Eko tsa eko nɔ tsikitsiki, bɔ ni kɔɔyɔɔ tete nyɛɛɛ amɛteŋ etsɔ̃.
Akɛ eko etsa eko nɔ, amɛkpɛtɛ amɛhe bɔ ni ehiii amɛteŋ tsemɔ.
Kɛji etsine lɛ ekplɛɔ la, ni ehiŋmɛiiaŋ tamɔ leebi hulu haai.
La fãa kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ tamɔ haai; la srɛmii flɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ.
Egugɔŋ fãa lasu tamɔ lamɔ faã kɛjɛɔ kukwɛi ni ma la nɔ mli, loo tamɔ jwɛi ni miishã lasu.
Egugɔŋ mumɔ tsɛ̃ɔ ŋai, ni edaaŋ fãa la.
Ekuɛ mli ehewalɛ yɔɔ, hewɔ lɛ eyɛ gbeyei kɛji oyaje ehiɛgbɛ.
Eheloo lɛ kpɛtɛ ehe kpɛŋŋ bɔ ni anyɛɛɛ akpɔ.
Etsui wa tamɔ tɛ, ewa tamɔ wiɛ.
Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ lɛ, kãkãlɔi sheɔ gbeyei; ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ amɛ kɛji ekãnya ehe.
Kɛji abã lɛ klaŋte lɛ, efooo; ni akplɔ loo gãi loo loogbee akplɔ nyɛɛɛ lɛ afo.
Dade tamɔ jwɛi ni egbi, ni akɔɔble tamɔ tso ni ekpɔtɔ hã lɛ.
Gãimlibi wooo lɛ foi; ni aklomia mli tɛ tsɔ̃ɔ gbetseli hãa lɛ.
Tsokpoti tamɔ gbetseli, ni efeɔ lɛ ŋmlɔ kɛji atsrɛ̃ lɛ akplɔ.
Emlishi totoi lɛ tamɔ gbɛ ko naabu sakasaka lɛ, ni ehoɔ ekãa ŋmɔtɔ lɛ mli tamɔ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso.
Ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa tamɔ nula; ni afui ni etswaa lɛ tamɔ mu ni ma la nɔ.
Esɛɛ mo kpɛɔ ni ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa afui tamɔ waŋ.
Esaso kooloo ni sheee nɔ ko nɔ ko gbeyei bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ebuuu nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he wa, lɛji kooloi hewalɔi fɛɛ atsɛ."
42: Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here Yehowa nɔ ekɛɛ,
"Yehowa, mile akɛ onyɛɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ofeɔ, ni oyiŋtoo ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ naa aku.
Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi ni nilee bɛ mli teɔ nilee nɔ? No hewɔ lɛ miwie nibii ni minuuu shishi, nibii ni ahe yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃ hã mi bɔ ni minuuu amɛshishi.
Okɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Bo toi; ni mawie. Mibabi o sane koni ohã mi hetoo!'
Mitoi kɛkɛ mikɛnu ohe, shi agbɛnɛ mihiŋmɛi ena bo.
No hewɔ lɛ eedɔ mi, ni mishwa mihe yɛ sū kɛ lamlu mli."
Be ni Yehowa kɛ Hiob ewie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Elifaz, Temanyo lɛ, akɛ, "Mimli ewo bo kɛ onanemɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ la, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ mitsulɔ Hiob fee lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛmɔmɔa tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo kɛyaa mitsulɔ Hiob ŋɔɔ koni nyɛkɛyashãa shãa afɔle nyɛhãa nyɛhe. Mitsulɔ Hiob baakpa fai ehã nyɛ ni mibabo efaikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni mikɛ nyɛ yeŋ yɛ nyɛkooloofeemɔ lɛ naa, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ Hiob fee lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Elifaz, Temanyo lɛ, Kɛ Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, kɛ Zofar, Naamanyo lɛ, yiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyafee bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ lɛ; ni Yehowa mɔ Hiob faikpamɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni Hiob ekpa fai ehã enanemɛi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hã Hiob saa eshwere ekoŋŋ. Yehowa ku nii fɛɛ ni Hiob yɔɔ sa lɛ ebɔ he toi enyɔ ehã lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Hiob nyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi yei lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni le lɛ sa lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni amɛ kɛ lɛ ye nii, ni amɛye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛshɛje emii yɛ sane fɔŋ ni Yehowa hã ye lɛ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ke Hiob jwiɛtɛi kuku kɛ shika ga.
Yehowa jɔɔ Hiob yɛ enaagbee wala beiaŋ fe bɔ ni ejɔɔ lɛ tsutsu lɛ. Hiob na gwaŋtɛŋi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ yomai akpei ekpaa kɛ tsinai akpei enyɔ kɛ teji yei akpe kome.
Esaa efɔ bihii kpawo kɛ biyei etɛ̃.
Ewo ebiyoonukpa lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yemima, ebiyoo ni ji enyɔ lɛ ewo lɛ Kezia, ni ebiyoo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ewo lɛ Keren-Hapak.
Yoo ko kwraa bɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni ehe yɛ fɛo tamɔ amɛ. Amɛtsɛ Hiob hã amɛ egboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ ehã amɛnyɛmimɛi hii lɛ.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Hiob saa ehi shi afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni ena eshwiei kɛyashi amɛyinɔ ni ji ejwɛ nɔ bii.
Ni Hiob gbo be ni eji nuumo kotokoto ni eye afii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.

1: Naa shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã Yoel, Penuel binuu lɛ
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdra, nyɛboa toi, nyɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi. Nɔ ni eba nɛɛ, ani eko eba dã yɛ nyɛyinɔ, loo yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi ayinɔ tete?
Nyɛgbaa nyɛbii, koni nyɛbii lɛ agba amɛbii, ni amɛbii lɛ hu agba yinɔ ni baa yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ.
Baalabii baha wɔŋmɔshinii; nɔ ni ku kome shwɛ lɛ, ku ni nyiɛ sɛɛ baye.
Nyɛ gaalei, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a ni nyɛfoa; nyɛ wainnulɔi, nyɛwɔa lele, ejaakɛ nyɛwain dɔkɔdɔkɔ lɛ eje nyɛdaaŋ.
Baalabii, ta muu, ebatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ; amɛhe wa, ni anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane; amɛnyanyɔji anaa ba tamɔ jata nyanyɔji.
Amɛkpãtã wɔwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ; amɛkpe wɔgbãmitsei lɛ ahe. Amɛkplɔ tsei lɛ ahe totoi lɛ, kɛyashi niji lɛ ahe yɛ sakoo.
Wo yara tamɔ oblayoo ni foɔ eblayeiaŋ wu.
Niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa sɛɛ efo yɛ Yehowa we lɛ. Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ afɔlei bɛ hã Yehowa.
Akpãtã ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ; shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã ŋmaa lɛ hiɛ, wainyibii lɛ egbi, mutsei lɛ eŋla.
Nyɛ okwaafoi, nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ. Nyɛ waintromkwɛlɔi, nyɛwoa yara yɛ ŋmaa kɛ akoko hewɔ, ejaakɛ ŋmɔshinii lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.
Waintsei lɛ eŋla; agbãmitsei lɛ egboi; akututsei kɛ tɛŋi kɛ atīatsei, yelitsei fɛɛ egbigbii. Nyamɔ etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.

Osɔfoi, nyɛbua kpekpe, ni nyɛwoa yara; Nyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔlɔi, nyɛwɔa lele. Nyɛbotea Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, nyɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi, ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle ni akɛyaa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, atsi naa.
Nyɛfãa koni ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ, nyɛtsɛa kpee hu. Nyɛbuaa onukpai lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ anaa kɛyaa Yehowa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni nyɛblɔa nyɛtsɛa lɛ.
Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ shi etã! Gbi ni Ofe lɛ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ baafee gbeyei!
Be wɔhiŋmɛi kã nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni akpãtãa wɔniyenii hiɛ, ni nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ hu sɛɛ efo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ?
Dumɔwui lɛ egboi yɛ su kukulii lɛ ashishi, aboŋoi lɛ kamɔ eflo, ŋmaatoohei lɛ akumɔ, ejaakɛ ŋmaa lɛ eŋla.
Kwɛ bɔ ni tsina kui lɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ kɛ nɔnaa, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ jwɛifɔ, ni toikui lɛ hu miina nɔ.
Bo, Yehowa, miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ la ekpãtã ŋanɔ jwɛifɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni lalilɛi eshã ŋa lɛ nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ.
Ŋaŋ kooloi tete miiblɔ miitsɛ o, ejaakɛ fai lɛ egbi, ni la akpãtã ŋanɔ jwɛifɔ hiɛ.
2: Nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ Zion, nyɛboa oshe yɛ migɔ̃ŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ! Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ahe akpokpo, ejaakɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ miiba; eshɛ shi etã.
Duŋ kɛ jeŋ tuutuufeemɔ gbi ni, atatu kɛ oblɔtu kpii gbi ni, Baalabii ta muu miiba tamɔ duŋ gbɛɔ shwãa gɔji anɔ lɛ. Nɔ ko ni tamɔ enɛ bako dã, ni asaŋ esɛɛ lɛ eko baŋ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee yinɔi ayinɔ.
Baalabiii lɛ yeɔ tsei lɛ tamɔ la yeɔ nii. Amɛhiɛgbɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ tamɔ Eden trom, shi amɛsɛɛgbɛ lɛ etamɔ ŋa kpataa. Nɔ ko nɔ ko ejeee amɛdɛŋ.
Amɛsu tamɔ okpɔŋɔi, amɛshaa foi tamɔ ta okpɔŋɔi.
Kɛji amɛmiitumɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, egbɛɔ tamɔ shwiilii; egbɛɔ tamɔ lalilɛi ni miishã gbetseli fɛlɛɔ; amɛtamɔ ta kpeteŋkple ni eto kɛbaagba ta.
Kɛ amɛmiiba lɛ, maji ahe kpokpoɔ, ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ shaleɔ.
Amɛtsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ kãkãlɔi, amɛkwɔɔ gbogboi tamɔ tabilɔi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ egbɛ nɔ; amɛtsakeee amɛgbɛ koni eeeba akɛ mɔ ko aaayaje mɔ ko gbɛ nɔ;
mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛ egbɛ nɔ. Amɛgbaa shi kutuu kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tawuu afabaŋi amli, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko etsiii amɛ gbɛ.
Amɛyatuaa maŋ; amɛjoɔ foi yɛ gbogboi anɔ; amɛkwɔɔ kɛboteɔ shīai amli, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ samfɛji amli tamɔ julɔi.
Kɛji amɛmiiba lɛ, shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni ŋwɛi kpokpoɔ bliblibli. Hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere woɔ duŋ, ni ŋulamii fɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ.
Yehowa woɔ egbee, ni afãa eta lɛ. Esra lɛ da naakpa, ni mɛi ni yeɔ efãmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane. Yehowa gbi lɛ, ebaafee gbeyei! Namɔ po aaanyɛ naa adamɔ?
"Shi amrɔ nɛɛ po Yehowa kɛɛ, nyɛshwaa nyɛhe anɔkwale mli, ni nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli."
Nyɛtsɛrɛa nyɛtsuii, shi jeee nyɛtadei; nyɛkpalea kɛbaa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ drolɔ kɛ mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ; emli fuu mra, ni eyeɔ eshiwoo nɔ; ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa, ni eshwaa ehe yɛ nɔ fɔŋ hewɔ.
Ekolɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatsake ejewɛŋmɔ, ni eeejɔɔ nyɛŋmɔshinii, ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle aaabahã Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ Zion; nyɛfãa akɛ ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni nyɛtsɛa kpee ni mli wa.
Nyɛbuaa maŋ lɛ naa, nyɛsaa amɛ nyɛhãa kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ; nyɛbuaa gbekɛbii kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ fufɔ lɛ anaa! Ayɛmfro wu tete aje kpo yɛ esɛɛtsuŋ, ni ayɛmfro hu aje kpo yɛ epiaŋ.
Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ afo, ni amɛsɔle yɛ koi lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Yehowa, naa bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; kaahã maji krokomɛi miiye wɔhe fɛo amɛkɛɛ. 'Nɛɛgbɛ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa ye shikpɔŋ lɛ he awuŋa ni ena emaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ.
Ehere amɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ. "Agbɛnɛ mibahã nyɛ able kɛ wain kɛ mu, koni nyɛye nyɛtrɔ; maji krokomɛi ebɔŋ nyɛ ahora dɔŋŋ.

Nɔ ni jɛ kooyigbɛ ba lɛ, majie yɛ nyɛhe kɛaatee shɔŋŋ, ni mashwie lɛ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ nɔ. Eta ni yɔɔ hiɛgbɛ lɛ mashwie amɛ mawo Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli; ni amɛta ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ matsi amɛ mawo Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli, Amɛgbohii lɛ ahe sã kɛ fu aaate shi; makpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
"Shikpɔŋ, kaashe gbeyei, omii ashɛ ohe ni onya, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu nii wuji.
Nyɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ niyelihe lɛ jwɛifɔ lɛ miifrɔke, ni tsei miiwo amɛyibii, agbãmi kɛ waintso hu ewo pii.
"Nyɛ Zionbii, nyɛmli aflia nyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ efee ehã nyɛ lɛ hewɔ. Ehã nu enɛ ehã nyɛ bɔ ni sa, ehã gbo kɛ agbiɛnaa enɛ ehã nyɛ tamɔ efeɔ daa lɛ.
Ŋmaagbeemɔhei lɛ aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmaa, amɛhe bui lɛ aaateke nɔ kɛ wain kɛ mu.
Nii ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi kɛ gɔ̃gɔ̃mii lɛ eye, yɛ afii ni amɛba lɛ mli lɛ, mato nyɛ najiaŋ. Mi mihã baalabii ta babaooo lɛ ba batua nyɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛaana nii pii nyɛaaye nyɛaatrɔ. Nyɛaajie Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ etsu naakpɛɛ nii ehã nyɛ. Agbɛŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ dɔŋŋ.
No lɛ Israelbii, nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ miyɛ nyɛteŋ; nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi ji nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ. Agbeŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ.
"Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ; nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba, nyɛhiimeji lɛ aaala lamɔi, ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninaai.
Nyɛtsuji hii tete kɛ nyɛtsuji yei hu mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ mashwie amɛnɔ yɛ nakai be lɛ mli.
"Mahã ana gbi lɛ he okadii yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, láshishwiemɔ kɛ la kɛ lasu kpɔŋŋ.
Hulu aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔŋtsere aaatsu faa tamɔ lá. Dani Yehowa gbi wulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ aaaba.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasɔle atsɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyi wala. Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ. Mɛi komɛi ahe aaaje mli, yɛ Zion Gɔŋ, Yerusalem; mɛi ni mahala lɛ ayi aaana wala."
3: Yehowa kɛɛ, "Nakai be lɛ mahã Yuda kɛ Yerusalem aku sɛɛ ashwere ekoŋŋ.

Mabua maji lɛ fɛɛ anaa ni mikɛ amɛ aaakpleke shi kɛaatee Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Makojo amɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛfee mimaŋ lɛ hewɔ. Agbɛnɛ mimaŋ Israelii lɛ amɛshwã maji lɛ amli, ni amɛja Israel shikpɔŋ ni ji mishikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja nomii lɛ amɛhã amɛhe. Amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii hii amɛkɛhe ajwamaŋi, ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii yei amɛkɛhe wain amɛnu.
"Tiro kɛ Sidon kɛ Filistia shikpɔji fɛɛ, mɛni nyɛtaoɔ nyɛfee mi? Ani nɔ ko ni mifee najiaŋ nyɛtaoɔ nyɛto mi? Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ shwiaa, ni mahã nii ni nyɛfee lɛ aku sɛɛ ababua nyɛyiteŋ;
ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔ mijwiɛtɛi kɛ mishika lɛ, ni minibii ni jra wa lɛ nyɛloo kɛtee nyɛjamɔhei lɛ.
Nyɛhɔ̃ɔ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ nyɛhã Helabii, ni nyɛjie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ mibahã amɛshi he ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ amɛ kɛtee lɛ. Mibafee nyɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee amɛ lɛ.
Mahã ahɔ̃ɔ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ ahã Yudabii lɛ, ni Yudabii lɛ aaahɔ̃ɔ amɛ ahã Shebabii ni ji maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ bii lɛ. Mi, Yehowa, miwie enɛ.
"Nyɛshiɛa shiɛmɔ nɛɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ akɛ, 'Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛhãa ta; nyɛtsɛa nyɛtabilɔi fɛɛ anaa ni nyɛfãa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔii asɔ̃a klaŋtei ni nyɛkɛ adɔi lɛ asɔ̃a akplɔi; mɔ ni yɔɔ wudɔwudɔ tete akɛɛ akɛ, Mihe wa.'
Nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛkpe, nyɛhe afea oya kɛbaa, ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.'" Yehowa, hã ota lɛ aba abatua amɛ.
"Maji lɛ asaa amɛhe koni amɛba Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Jɛi, mi Yehowa, mibata makojo maji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛbɔle lɛ yɛ.
Nyɛflɔa amɛ nyɛshwiea shi tamɔ aflɔɔ ŋmaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ; nyɛnaanaa amɛ tamɔ aŋaa wainyibii yɛ wain tsɔne ni eyi tɔ mli kɛyashiɔ wain lɛ bɔ̃iɔ hoo lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyitsoŋ wa tsɔ̃."
Gbɔmɛi akpeiakpei abɔ yɛ Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Jɛi ji he ni Yehowa Gbi ni eshɛ etã lɛ baaba yɛ.
Hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere ewo duŋ, ni ŋulamii efɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ.
Yehowa miihuu kɛjɛ Zion, ni egbee miijije kɛjɛ Yerusalem; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ miihoso. Shi Yehowa ji abobaahe hã emaŋ lɛ, kɛ mɔɔ ni wa hu hã Israelbii lɛ.
"Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ, miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mihiɔ Zion, migɔ̃ŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yerusalem aaatsɔ̃ maŋ wulu krɔŋkrɔŋ; gbɔi nyɛŋ enɔ amɛye kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nakai gbi lɛ, gɔji lɛ anɔ aaayi tɔ kɛ waintromii, ni aaana tsinai yɛ gɔ̃ŋ fɛɛ gɔ̃ŋ nɔ; ni nu aaaho yɛ Yuda jɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli. Nuhiŋmɛi aaaho kɛaajɛ Yehowa We lɛ, ni eeeyahã Akasia Jɔɔ lɛ nu.

"Egipt aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni Edom aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni egbo; ejaakɛ amɛbatua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshwie enɔ bii ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi. 20-21. Matɔ mɛi ni agbe lɛ alá he owele. Mikɛ mɛi ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ ahe ekeŋ amɛ. Shi kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi aaahi Yuda kɛ Yerusalem, ni mi, Yehowa, mahi Zion gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ."

1: Shishijee mli lɛ Wiemɔ lɛ yɛ momo, ni Wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ ni weimɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ shishijee mli lɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ.
Lɛ enɔ atsɔ̃ afee nibii fɛɛ, ni ashii lɛ afee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni afee.
Emli wala yɔɔ, ni wala lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ala lɛ;
ni la lɛ tsoɔ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli, ni duŋ lɛ nyɛɛɛ enɔ eye.
Nuu ko yɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ kɛba, atsɛɔ lɛ Yohane.
Eba odaseyeli, ni ebaye la lɛ he odase koni mɛi fɛɛ atsɔ̃ en( ahe aye.
Jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji la lɛ; shi moŋ eba la lɛ he odaseyeli.
Anɔkwa la lɛ ni taoɔ hã mɔ fɛɛ lɛ baa je lɛ mli nɛɛ.
Je lɛ mli la lɛ yɔɔ, ni enɔ atsɔ̃ afee je lɛ, shi je lɛ leee lɛ.
Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi aŋɔɔ eba, ni mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋbii lɛ hereee lɛ.
Shi mɛi abɔ ni here lɛ, ni amɛhe egbɛi lɛ nɔ amɛye lɛ, ehã amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii,
mɛi ni jeee lã loo heloo loo nuu ko suɔmɔ naa afɔ amɛ yɛ, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ amɛ.
Ni Wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ adesa, ni ebahi shi yɛ wɔteŋ, ni wɔna enunyam lɛ akɛ Tsɛ lɛ bi Koome lɛ anumnyam. ni dromɔ kɛ anɔkwale eyi lɛ obɔ̃.
Yohane ye ehe odase ni ebo ekɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ ni mɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, 'Mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ efe mi, etsɔ̃ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ dani miyɔɔ lɛ.'"
Ejaakɛ ebɔ̃yimɔ lɛ mli jɛ ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔna dromɔ wɔshi dromɔ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ Mla lɛ, Mose nɔ atsɔ̃ akɛhã; shi dromɔ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ, Yesu Kristo nɔ etsɔ̃ kɛba.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ko enako lɛ pɛŋ; Bi koome ni yɔɔ Tsɛ lɛ mlishi lɛ, lɛ abajie lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ.
Ni enɛ ji Yohane odase ni eye be ni Yudafoi lɛ tsu osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛjɛ Yerusalem ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji o?"
Ni egba mli akɛ, "Jeee miji Kristo lɛ."
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji o mɔ? Elia ji o?" ni ekɛɛ, "Jeee lɛji mi." Gbalɔ lɛ ji o? Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Dabi."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji o? (Kɛɛmɔ wɔ) koni wɔna hetoo ko wɔyahã mɛi ni tsu wɔ lɛ; Te okɛɔ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe tɛŋŋ?
Ekɛɛ, "Miji mɔ gbee ni boɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛjajea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ,'" tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia kɛɛ lɛ.
Ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ jɛ farisifoi lɛ ateŋ;
ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Kɛjeee Kristo lɛ loo Elia loo gbalɔ lɛ ji o lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ obaptisiɔ mɔ?"
Yohane here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mi lɛ mibaptisiɔ yɛ nu mli, shi mɔ ko damɔ nyŋɛteŋ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛleee lɛ.
lɛji mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ, mɔ tokota naakpãa ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ lɛ."
Afee nii nɛɛ yɛ Betania, yɛ Yordan sɛɛ, he ni Yohane baptisiɔ yɛ lɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yehane na Yesu miiba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Naa Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ ni woɔ je lɛ esha lɛ kɛyaa lɛ!
Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, 'Nuu ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni ehe akɛ, 'Nuu ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ dani miyɔɔ lɛ.'
Ni mi lɛ̃ mileeee lɛ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Israel hewɔ, ni miba mibaptisiɔ yɛ nu mli nɛɛ."
Ni Yohane ye odase ekɛɛ, "Mina Mumɔ lɛ yi shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ okpo, ni ebahi enɔ.
Ni mi lɛ mileee lɛ, shi mɔ ni tdu mi akɛ mibaptisi yɛ nu mli lŋɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Mɔ nɔ ni ooona akɛ Mumɔ lɛ yiɔ ni ehiɔ enɔ lɛ, lɛji mɔ ni baptisiɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli lɛ.'
Ni mina, ni miye he odase akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɛ."
Asaŋ enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yohane kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ damɔ shi;
ni be Yesu hoɔ lɛ, ekwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Naa Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ!"
Ni kaselɔi enyɔ lɛ nu ewiemɔ lɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ.
Ni Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena akɛ amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ?" Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Rabi'"(eshishi ji:Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ), "Nɛɛgbɛ ohiɔ?"
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbakwɛa." No hewɔ lɛ amɛtee ni amɛyana he ni ehiɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ hi shi nakai gbi lɛ. Ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji ejwɛ mli ni.
Mɛi enyɔ lɛ ni nu ni Yohane wie ni amɛyanyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi lɛ.
Lɛ eyana lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi Simon tsutsu, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "ɔna Mesia (ni eshishi ji Kristo,) loo (mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu) lɛ."
Ni ekɛ lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ. Ni Yesu kwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Boji Simon, Yona bi lɛ, aaatsɛ o Kefa (eshishi ji Petro loo tɛsaa)."
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yesu miitao akɛ eyaa Galilea, ni ena Filipo' ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ misɛɛ!"
Shi Filipo jɛ Betsaida, Andrea kɛ Petro maŋ lɛ mli.
Filipo hu na Natanael, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔna mɔ ni Mose ŋma ehe sane yɛ Mla lɛ mli, kɛ mɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ hu ŋma ehe sane lɛ, Yesu, yosef bi ni ŋma ehe sane lɛ, Yesu, yosef bi ni jɛ zazaret lɛ."
Ni Natanael kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani nɔ ko kpakpa ko aaanyɛ ajɛ Nazaret?" Filipo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ba ni obakwɛ."
Yesu na Natanael miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, "Naa anɔkwa Israelnyo, mɔ mli ni apase bɛ lɛ,"
Natanael bi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ ole mi yɛ?" Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mina o fɛɛdã ni Filipo tsɛ o, be mli ni oyɔɔ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ."
Natanael here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Rabi, boji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, boji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ."
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ni mikɛɛ o akɛ mina o yɛ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ hewɔ oheɔ oyeɔ nɛɛ? Ooona nii wuji ni fe enɛ."
Ni etee nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaana akɛ ŋwɛi naa kã ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ miikwɔ miikpleke yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ."
2: Enɔ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ akpee yoo yɛ Kana yɛ Galilea; ni Yesu nyɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni akpee Yesu hu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛtee yookpeemɔ lɛ.
Ne be ni eani lɛ tã lɛ, Yesu nyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Amɛbɛ wain."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Ohe sane mɛji no, Awo? Miŋmlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko."
Enyɛ kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea."
Ni tɛ botokui ekpaa mamɔ shi yɛ jɛi, yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ahetsuumɔ hewɔ, ekome yeɔ susumɔ gbɛi enyɔ loo etɛ̃.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwoa botokui lɛ amli nu obɔ̃bɔ̃." Ni amɛwo amɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyɛa eko nyɛyahãa piafonyo lɛ." Ni amɛyɛ kɛtee,
Shi be ni piafonyo lɛ sa enaa nu ni etsɔ̃ wain, ni eleee he ni jɛ, shi tsuji lɛ ni etsɔ̃ wain, ni eleee he ni jɛ, shi tsuji lɛ ni yɛ nu lɛ lɛ kɛkɛ le lɛ, etsɛ ayɛmfrowu lɛ,
ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, wain kpakpa ekɛbamaa shi klɛŋklɛŋ, ni eŋɔɔɔ lɛ baa; shi bo lɛ okɛ wain kpakpa lɛ moŋ eto kɛbashi benɛ."
Enɛ Yesu fee yɛ Galilea ekɛje ekadii ashishi ni ekɛ enumnyam lɛ tsɛ̃ɔ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ he enɔ amɛye.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ eyiŋ etee kapernaum, lɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ, shi amɛyeee gbii pii ko yɛ jɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ a-Hehoo lɛ eshɛ eta6, ni Yesu tee Yerusalem.
Ni eyana mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ tsakeɔ Shika hu tra shi yɛ amɛkplɔi ahe yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Ni ekɛ taŋkpei bibii fee kplebii ni ekɛshwie amɛ fɛɛ kɛ toi kɛ tsinai lɛ kɛje Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ shikatsakelɔi lɛ ashika lɛ eshwie shi; ni etsirɛ okplɔ̃i lɛ eswai shi;
ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjiea nii nɛɛ kɛjea biɛ, nyɛkɛ mi-Tsɛ we lɛ akafea jranɔ."
Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ aŋma akɛ, "Owe lɛ he hiɛdɔɔ lɛ eye mi."
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Mose okadi okɛtsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ, "Mɛɛ okadi okɛtsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ oyɛ hegbɛ akɛ ofeɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?"
" Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkumɔa solemɔtsuɔ nɛɛ, ni gbii etɛ̃ mli lɛ mama ekoŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, "Afii nyɛŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaa akɛma Sɔletsu nɛɛ, ni bo lɛ gbii okɛaama lo?"
Shi lɛ lɛ, egbɔmɔtso akɛ sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he ewieɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohi ateŋ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ ekɛɛ enɛ, ni amɛhe ŋmale lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yesu wie lɛ amɛye.
Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu yɔɔ Yerusalem yɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mɛi pii ona okabii ni efee lɛ, ni amɛhe egbɛi lɛ nɔ amɛye.
Shi Yesu diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ ele amɛ fɛɛ amɛsu.
Ni ehe ehīaaa akɛ mɔ ko aye gbɔmɔ he odase ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ele nɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ tsui mli.
3: Nuu ko yɛ ni jɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nikodemo ni ji Yudafoi lɛ anukpa;
lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Rabi, wɔle akɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba ji o; ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ afee okadii ni ofeɔ nɛɛ, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ."
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ o akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ ŋwɛi afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ena."
Nikodemo bi lɛ akɛ, "Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni be ni gbɔmɔ egbɔ lɛ ni aaafɔ lɛŋ? Ani eeenyɛ ebote enyɛ musu mli ekoŋŋ ni afɔ lɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "Miikɛɛ o anɔkwale akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ nu kɛ Mumɔ mli afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli ebote.
Nɔ ni ajɛ heloo mli afɔ lɛ, heloo ni; ni nɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ, mumɔ ni.
Ohiɛ akafee o yaa akɛ mikɛɛ o akɛ, 'ja ajɛ ŋwɛi afɔ nyɛ' lɛ.
Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, he ni esumɔɔ etswaa kɛyaa, ni egbɛɛmɔ onuɔ, shi oleee he ni ejɛɔ kɛ he ni eyaa; nakai ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ lɛ."
Nikodemo here nɔ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nii nɛɛ aaanyɛ aba mli hu?"
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Te Israel tsɔ̃ɔlɔ ji o? Ni oleee enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?
Miikɛɛ o anɔkwale akɛ, nɔ ni wɔle lɛ, no wɔwieɔ; ni nɔ ni wɔna lɛ, no he odase wɔyeɔ; shi nyɛŋɔɔɔ wɔdase lɛ.
Kɛ mikɛ nyɛ wie shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe ni nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ wie ŋwɛinii ahe ni nyɛaahe nyɛyeŋ?
Ni mɔ ko ekwɔko kɛyako ŋwɛi, akŋ ja mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi kpleke shi lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Ni bɔ ni Mose wo onufu lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ sa akɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ,
koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala."
"Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ je lɛ, akɛ eŋɔ e-Bi koome lɛ ehã, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ hiɛ akakpãtã, shi moŋ ena naanɔ wala.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuuu e-Bi lɛ kɛbaaa je lɛ mli koni ebakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ koni atsɔ̃ enɔ ahere je lɛ, shi moŋ koni atsɔ̃ enɔ enɔ ahere je lɛ yiwala.
Mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ,akojo lɛ momo, ejaakɛ ehe ko Nyɔŋmɔ Bi koome lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ eyeko.
Shi kojomɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ la lɛ eba je lɛ mli, ni gbɔmɛi sumɔɔ duŋ lɛ moŋ fe la lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni;
ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ nyɛɔ la lɛ, ni ebaaa la lɛ he, koni akajie enitsumɔi lɛ ashi.
Shi mɔ ni feɔ anɔkwalenii lɛ baa la lɛ he, koni enitsumɔi lɛ aje kpo, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli atsu yɛ."
Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kɛ ekaseklɔi lɛ Yudea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ bahi jɛi ni ebaptisiɔ.
Ni Yohane hu miibaptisi yɛ Ainon yɛ Salim masɛi, ejaakɛ nu pii yɛ jɛi, ni mɛi baa ni mɛi baa ni abaptisiɔ amŋɛ;
ejaakŋɛ no mli lɛ anako awo Yohane tsuŋ.
Agbɛnɛ naataamɔ bate shi yɛ Yohane kaselɔi lɛ kɛ Yudafonyo ko teŋ yɛ hetsuumɔ he.
Ni amɛba Yohane ŋɔɔ ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Rabi, mɔ ni kɛ o hi Yordan sɛɛ ni oye ehe odase lɛ, naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eebaptisi, ni mɛi fɛɛ miiya eŋɔɔ."
Yohane here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Gbɔmɔ nyɛŋ ana nɔ ko, akɛ ja ajɛ ŋwɛi akɛhã lɛ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye mi odase akɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, jeee miji Kristo lɛ, shi moŋ atsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni hiɛ ayɛmfro lɛ, lɛji ayɛmfrowu; shi ayɛmfrowu lɛ shieŋtsɛ ni damɔ shi boɔ lɛ toi lɛ, nya enyaa yɛ ayɛmfrowu lɛ gbee hewɔ. No hewɔ lɛ nɛkɛ minyamɔ nɛɛ eba mli.
Lɛ lɛ, ja eshwere, ni mi lɛ, minɔ gbɔ."
Mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ.Mɔ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɛ, ni shikPɔŋ lɛ he ewieɔ. Mɔ ni jɛŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ,
ni nɔ ni ena ni enu lɛ, no he odase eyeɔ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ edase lɛ.
Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ eadse lɛ, esɔo naa akɛ anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi ewieɔ; ejaakɛ jeee susumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ susuɔ Mumɔ lɛ ehãa lɛ.
Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ bi lɛ, ni etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ.
Mɔ ni heɔ Bi lɛ nɔ ni booo Bi lɛ toi lɛ, enaŋ wala; shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mli fu hiɔ enɔ.
4: Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu na le akɛ Farisifo lɛ enu akɛ eena kaselɔi, ni eebaptisi mɛi babaoo fe Yohane, 2.tsɛbelɛ lɛ Yesu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaptisii; shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ ni baptisi_ lɛ,
eje Yudea ni eyiŋ etee Galilea ekoŋŋ.
Shi ja etsɔ̃ɔ Samaria. 5, Agbɛnɛ ebashɛ Samaria maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sikarni bɛŋkɛ shikPɔŋ kukuoo ko ni Yakob kɛhã ebi Yosef lɛ masɛi.
Shi Yakob nubu lɛ yɛ jɛi. Ni akɛni gbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ etɔ Yesu hewɔ lɛ, eho eshwata shi yɛ nubu lɛ he. (Ebashɛ jɛi) aaafee ŋmlɛ nyɔŋmɔ kɛ enyɔ mli.
Ni Samariayoo ko ba nuyɛɛ. Yesu kɛɛ kɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã mi nu lɛ eko manu."
No mli lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ etee maŋ lɛ mli amɛyaahe niyenii.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Samariayoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Te tɛŋŋ ni bo Yudanyo lɛ obaa mi Samariayoo lɛ nu ni onuŋ?"(Ejaakɛ Yudafoi kɛ Samariabii enuuu tsene kome naa nu.)
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Eji ole Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kɛɔ o akŋɛ, 'Hã mi eko manu lɛ' kulɛ, bo moŋ oooba lɛ ni eeehã o wala nu."
Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, obɛ nɔ ni okɛaanyɛ, ni bu lɛ mli kwɔ hu; nɛɛgbɛ ona wala nu lɛ mɔ?
Ani ofe wɔtsɛ Yakob ni hã wɔ nubu lɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enu mli nui, kŋɛ ebii kɛ ekooloi lɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ nu nɛɛ lɛ, kumai baaye lɛ ekoŋŋ;
shi mɔ ni nuɔ nu ni mi mãhã lɛ,lɛ kumai yeŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ; shi moŋ nu ni mahã lɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nu hiŋmɛi ni baa kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli yɛ emli."
Yo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, hã mi nu nɛɛ eko, koni kumai akaye mi, ni miba biɛ mibayɛ ni dɔŋŋ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa ni oyatsɛ owu, ni okɛ lɛ aba biɛ."
Yoo lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mibɛ wu" Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ okɛɛ akɛ, 'mibɛ wu' lɛ;
ejaakɛ ogbã hii enumɔ, ni mɔ ni ogba6a amrɔ nɛɛ tete, jeee owu ji lɛ; no lɛ owie anɔkwa."
Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, mina akɛ gbalɔ ji o.
Gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ sɔle yɛ,ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ akɛ Yerusalem ji he ni sa akɛ asɔle yɛ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ 'Awo, he mi oye akɛ ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni jee gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ jeee Yerusalem ni nyɛaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ.
Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleeee mɔ ni nyɛjaa; wɔ lɛ, wɔle mɔ ni wɔjaa, ejaakɛ walaheremɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ ejɛ.
Shi Kɛ̃lɛ ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ momo, be ni anɔkwa jalɔi lɛ aaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli, ejaakɛ jalɔi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi Tsɛ lɛ taoɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔŋ, ni mɛi ni jaa lɛ lɛ, ja amɛja lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli."
Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mile akɛ Mesia ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ miiba; kɛ eba lɛ, eeegba wɔ nii fɛɛ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mi ni mikɛ o wieɔ nɛɛ, mi ni."
Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba, ni amɛ hiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ ekɛ yoo miiwie, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko bii lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni obiɔ lɛ." Aloo "Mɛni wiemɔ okɛ lɛ wie?"
Agbɛnɛ yoo lɛ shi enugbɛ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee maŋ lɛ mli, ni eyakɛɛ mɛi lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa nuu ko ni ejaje nii fɛɛ ni mifee etsɔ̃ɔ mi, akɛ jee Kristo lɛ ni mifee etsɔ̃ɔ mi, akɛ jeee Kristo lɛ ni lo?"
No hewɔ lɛ amɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli amɛba eŋɔɔ.
Shi no mli lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, "Rabi, ye nɔ ko ."
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miyɛ ŋmaa ni miyeɔ, ni nyɛleee."
No hewɔ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Ani mɔ ko ebahã lɛ nɔ ko eye?"
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miŋmaa ji akɛ mafee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii, ni magbe enitsumɔ lɛ naa.
Ani nyɛkɛɛɛ akɛ, 'Eshwɛ nyɔji ejwɛ ni ablekuumɔbe lɛ shɛɔ?' Naa, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ ni nyɛkwɛa ŋmɔji lɛ bɔ ni amɛgba futaa momo ni sa kpamɔ.
Ni mɔ ni kpaa lɛ naa enyɔmɔwo, ni ebuaa yibii anaa etoɔ naanɔ wala, koni mɔ ni duɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kpaa lɛ fɛɛ anya shi kome.
Ejaakɛ enɛ mli ni wiemɔ ni awie akɛ, 'Mɔ ko duɔ ni mɔ ko kpaa' lɛ baa mli yɛ.
Mi lɛ mitsu nyɛ koni nyɛyakpa nɔ ni jeee nyɛ nyɛgbo he dɛŋme; mɛi krokomɛi egbo he dɛŋme, ni mɛi krokomɛi egbo he deŋme, ni nyɛba amɛdeŋme egbomɔ lɛ mli."
Ni Samariabii lɛ ni jɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye yɛ yoo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛye odase akɛ, "Ekɛɛ mi nii fɛɛ ni mifee pɛŋ lɛ " hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni Samariabii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekɛ amɛ ahi shi; ni ehi jɛi gbii enyɔ.
Ni mɛi pii ni fe tsutsubii lɛ saa he ye yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewiemɔ lɛ hewɔ;
ni amɛkɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ wɔmiihe wɔmiye, jeee bo owiemɔ lɛ hewɔŋ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu, ni wɔna wɔle akɛ, anɔkwale, mɔnɛ ji lɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ."
Gbii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ eyiŋ kɛjɛ jɛi etee Galilea,
tsɛbelɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eye odase akɛ gbalɔ ko hiɛ bɛ nyam yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Be ni eba Galilea lɛ, Galileabii lɛ ni na nii fɛɛ ni efee yɛ Yerusalem yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ here lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛtee gbijurɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu ba kana yɛ Galilea, he ni ehã nu tsɔ̃ wain yɛ lɛ, ekoŋŋ. Ni maŋtsɛ wenuu ko yɛ lɛ, ekoŋŋ. Ni maŋtsɛ wenuu ko yɛ Kapernanum ni ebi he miiye.
Ni be ni enu akɛ Yesu ejɛ Yudea eba Galilea lɛ, etee ni eyatutɔ lɛ akɛ eba ni ebatsa ebi lɛ, ejaakɛ eeehe egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ nyɛnaaa okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii lɛ, nyɛheee nyɛyeee."
Maŋtsɛ wenuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ba dani mibi lɛ agbo."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa, obi lɛ yi ena wala." Ni nuu lɛ he nɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ lɛ eye, ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi be ni eyaa lɛ, etsuji lɛ bakpe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Obinuu lɛ he ewa lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ ebi amɛ nɔ ŋmlɛtswaaa nɔ ni ehe bɔ̃i amɛ nɔ ŋmlɛtswaa nɔ ni ehe bɔ̃i lɛ waa, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ shwane ŋmlɛ kome mli ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni tsɛ lɛ kɛna akɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Obi lɛ he ewa lɛ." lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni; ni ekɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ he ye.
Enɛ ji okadi ni ji enyɔ ni Yesu fee, be ni ojɛ Yudea eba Galilea lɛ.
5: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ agbijurɔ ko bashɛ, ni Yesu tee Yerusalem.
Kpaakpo ko yɛ Yerusalem yɛ Toi Agbo lɛ masɛi, ni Hebri wiemɔ mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Betesda, ni koii enumɔ yɛ he.
Enɛɛmɛi amli helastsɛmɛi pii shwilafoi, akpakei kɛ obubuafoi kãmɔ (ni amɛmɛɔ nu lɛ mlitaa.
Ejaakɛ bei komɛi lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kplekeɔ shi kɛbaa kpaakpo lɛ mli ni ebataa nu lɛ mli; kɛkɛ lɛ emlitaa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yagbeɔ nu lɛ mli tsutsu lɛ, hela fɛɛ hela ni eyeɔ lɛ ehe tãa.)
Nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni ehe eye afii nyɔŋma etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Yesu na lɛ ni ekã shi, ni akɛni ele akɛ etsɛ aahuu lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, "Oosumɔ akɛ ohe awa o lo?"
Helatsɛ lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, mibɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ abata nu lɛ mli ni eeewo mi eyawo kpaakpo lɛ mli; shi miiya lɛ, mɔ kroko tsɔ̃ɔ mihiɛ eyabeɔ mli."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi, kɔ osaa lɛ, ni onyiɛ!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ he wa lɛ, ni ewo esaa lɛ ni enyiɛ.Shi nakai gbi lɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi ni.
No hewɔ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ mɔ ni atsa lɛ akɛ, "Hejɔɔmɔgbi nɛ, obɛ hegbɛ akɛ otreɔ osaa."
Ehere amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Mɔ ni tsa mi lɛ, lɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Kɔ osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ.'"
Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji mɔ ni kɛɛ o akɛ, 'Kɔ osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ lɛ?"
Shi mɔ ni atsa lɛ leee mɔ ni ji; ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ jɛi, ni Yesu egbla ehe shi.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yana lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, ohe ewa o; kaafee esha dɔŋŋ, koni efɔŋ ni fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ akaba onɔ."
Nuu lɛ yiŋ etee ni eya gba Yudafoi lɛ akɛ Yesu ji mɔ tsa lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ yudafoi lɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka Yesu, ejaakɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ efee nii nɛɛ.
Shi Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mi-Tsɛ miitsu nii kɛbashi be nɛ, ni mi hu miitsu."
No hewɔ titri Yudafoi lɛ taoɔ lɛ agbe lɛ, ejaakɛ jeee akɛ ebule hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ kɛkɛ, shi asaŋ etsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ e-Tsɛ, ni efee ehe akɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ye egbɔ.

No hewɔ lɛ Yesu lɛ Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Bi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋ eto eyiŋ efee nɔ ko, ja nɔ ni ena akɛ Tsɛ lɛ miifee; ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ feɔ lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ Bi lɛ hu feɔ.
Ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ Bi lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nibii fiaa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efeɔ lɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nitsumɔi wuji ni fe enɛɛmɛi tete, ni nyɛnaa aaakpɛ nyɛhe.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ teɔ gbohii ashi ni ehãa amɛ wala lɛ , nakai nɔŋŋ Bi lɛ hu hãa mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ wala.
Ejaakɛ Tsɛlɛ ekojooo mɔ ko, shi moŋ etu kojomɔ lɛ fɛɛ ewo Bi lɛ dɛŋ;
koni mɛi fɛɛ abu Bi lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛbuɔ Tsɛ lɛ.Mɔ ni ebuuu Bi lɛ, ebuuu Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu lɛ lɛ hu.
"Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ ni eheɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni ebaŋ kojomɔ mli, shi moŋ efo mli yɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ; ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ miiba, ni eshɛ etã, ni gbohii lɛ aaanu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbee, ni mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ aaana wala.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Bi lɛ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli.
Ni ehã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekojo hu, ejaakɛ lɛji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ.
Enɛ akafee nyɛ naakpɛɛ; ejaakɛ ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ miiba, nɔ mli ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ gbohii abui amli lɛ aaanu egbeee,
ni amɛaje kpo, mɛi ni efee ekpakpa lɛ aaate shi kɛaatee wala mli, ni mɛi etsu nishaianii lɛ aaate shi kɛaatee kojomɔ lɛ mli."
"Mi diɛŋtsɛ minyɛŋ miyiŋ mato mafee nɔ ko; bɔ ni minuɔ lɛ nakai mikojoɔ, ni mikojomɔ lɛ jalɛ kojomɔ ni, ejaakɛ mitaooo nɔ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ misumɔɔ, shi moŋ nɔ ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ sumɔɔ.
Kɛji mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase miyeɔ lɛ, midase lɛ jeee anɔkwale.
Mɔ kroko yɛ ni yeɔ mihe odase, ni mile akɛ odase ni eyeɔ yɛ mihe lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsu atee Yohane ŋɔɔ, ni eye anɔkwale lɛ he odase.
Shi mi lɛ, mikɛ mihe efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔ ko odesa nɔ; shi bɔ ni afee ni ahere nyɛyiwala hewɔ miwieɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ.
Yohane ji kane ni tsoɔ ni ekpɛɔ lɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛmli afli nyɛ be kukuoo kɛkɛ yɛ elã lɛ mli.
Shi mi lɛ, miyɛ odase ni fe Yohane nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ ehã mi akɛ migbɛ naa lɛ, nakai nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yeɔ mihe odase akɛ Tsɛ lɛ tsu mi.
Ni Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eye mihe odase. Nyɛnuko egbee dã lɛ, asaŋ nyɛnako esubaŋ dã;
ni ewiemɔ lɛ mɔɔɔ shi yɛ nyɛmli, ejaakɛ nyɛheee mɔ ni etsu lɛ nyɛyeee.
Nyɛtaoɔ ŋmalei lɛ amli, ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nomɛi amli nyɛnaa naanɔ wala yɛ; ni nomɛi nɔŋŋ ji nii ni yeɔ mihe odase lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛsumɔɔɔ akɛ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ ni nyɛna wala.
"Mitaoo gbɔmɛi ahiɛnyam.
Shi moŋ mikpa nyɛ shi akɛ nyɛbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ yɛ nyɛmli.

Mi lɛ miba yɛ mi-Tsɛ gbɛi mli, ni nyɛhereee mi; kɛji mɔ kroko ba yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛi mli lɛ, lɛ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛhe nyɛyeŋ, nyɛ ni nyɛtaoɔ anumnyam yɛ nyɛteaŋ, shi anumnyam ni jɛ( Nyɔŋmɔ koome lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ nyɛdii sɛɛ lɛ?
Nyɛkasusua akɛ mi mibaflɔ nyɛnaa mahã Tsɛ lɛ; mɔ ko yɛ ni miiflɔ nyɛnaa, lɛ ji Mose, mɔ nɔ ni nyɛŋɔ nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔ̃ lɛ.
Shi eji nyɛhe Mose nyɛye kulɛ, mi hu nyɛaahe mi nyɛye; ejaakɛ mihe sane eŋma lɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛheee eŋmalɛi lɛ nyɛyeeee lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛaahe miwiemɔi lɛ nyɛyeŋ?"
6: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yiŋ etee Galilea ŋshɔ ni ji Tiberia ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Ni mɛi babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ, ejaakɛ amana naakpɛɛ nii ni efee yɛ hela tsɛmɛi lɛ ahe lɛ.
No Yesu tee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, lɛ ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yatra jɛi.
Shi Hehoo lɛ, no ji Yudafoi lɛ agbijurɔ lɛ, eshɛ etã.
Yesi yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ ebi Filipo akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ wɔɔyahe aboloo yɛ wɔhã mɛnɛɛmɛi amɛye?"
Shi enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekɛka lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ele nɔ ni ebaafee.
Filipo here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Denarioi ohai enyɔ naa aboloo shɛŋ amɛ, bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana fioo ko."
Ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Andrea lɛ, ni ji Simon Petro nyɛmi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Gbɛkɛ nuu ko yɛ biɛ biɛ ni yɔɔ aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi bibii enyɔ; shi mɛi pii nɛɛ, amɛnɛɛgbɛ enɛ shɛɔ?"
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa mɛi lɛ atraa shi." Shi jwɛi pii yɛ jɛi, ni hii ni amɛyibɔ aaashɛ akpei enumɔ lɛ ho tra shi.
Ni Yesu klɔ aboloi lɛ, ni be ni eda shi lɛ, eja eha6 mɛi ni tra shi lɛ, kɛ loi lɛ hu eko, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ.
Be ni amɛtrɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbuaa fufuji ni eshwɛ lɛ anaa, koni nɔ ko akalaaje."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbua aboloi enumɔ lɛ afufuji ni mɛi ni ye lɛ shwɛ lɛ anaa amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni gbɔmɛi lɛ na naakpɛɛnii ni Yesu fee lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Anɔkwa, mɔnɛ ji gbalɔ ni baa je lɛ mli lɛ!"
Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ amɛbaaba ni amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛyawo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ekome too egbla ehe shi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa,
ni amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni amɛmiifo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛya Kapernam. Shi duŋ ewo fɛɛ lɛ, Yesu bako amɛŋɔɔ lolo;
ni ahum ko ni batswa hewɔ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ fite.
Be ni amɛwiri aaafee shitoi etɛ̃ loo ejwɛ lɛ, amɛna Yesu ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ ni eebɛŋkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miŋ, nyɛkashea gbeyei."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛ miishɛɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛba lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni amrɔ lɛ lɛlɛ lɛ yakpleke he ni amɛyaa lɛ.
Enɔjetsɛremɔ lɛ, asafo ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ na akɛ lɛlɛ kroko bɛ jɛi dɔŋŋ akɛ ja ekome kɛkɛ, ni amɛna hu akɛ Yesu kɛ kaselɔi lɛ eyaaa lɛlɛ lɛ mli, shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛkɛ (Kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ) yiŋ kɛtee;
tsɛbelɛ lɛji krokomɛi jɛ Tiberia ba he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ da shi ni amɛye aboloo lɛ yɛ lɛ masɛi;
no hewɔ lɛ, be ni asafo lɛ na akɛ Yesu loo ekaselɔi lɛ bɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛbote lɛji amli, ni amɛba Kapernaum amɛmiitao Yesu.
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Rabi, te be ni oba biɛŋ?"
Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee okadii lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nɛɛ, shi moŋ akɛni nyɛye aboloo lɛ eko ni nyɛtrɔ lɛ hewɔŋ.
Nyɛkatsua ŋmaa ni fiteo lɛ he nii, shi moŋ nyɛtsua ŋmaa ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaahã nyɛ lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ lɛ enaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ esɔo."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Tewɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔtsu Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ nyɛhe mɔ ni etsu lɛ nɔ nyɛye."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Belɛ mɛɛ okadi ofeɔ ni wɔna koni wɔhe o wɔye? Mɛni otsuɔ?
Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ mana lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ,, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, 'Ehã amɛ aboloo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi amɛye' lɛ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee Mose ji mɔ ni hã nyɛ aboloo lɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, shi mi-Tsɛ moŋ hãa nyɛ anɔkwa aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aboloo lɛ ji mɔ ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekplekeɔ shi ni eŋɔɔ wala ehãa je lɛ."
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, hã wɔ aboloo nɛɛ daa."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miji wala aboloo lɛ; mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko, ni mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, kumai hu yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛna mi, ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛhãa mi lɛ aaaba miŋɔɔ, ni mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, mishwieŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ejaakɛ jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ misuɔmɔnaaniifeemɔ hewɔ mijɛ ŋwɛi miba, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaaniifeemɔ hewɔŋ.
Shi enɛ ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ekɛhã mi lɛ, mikahã amɛteŋ mɔ ko miilaaje, shi moŋ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakkɛ enɛ ji mí-Tsɛ suɔmɔnaanii, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ Bi lɛ ni eheɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ wie ehe huhuuhu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Miji aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ;"
ni amɛkɛɛ, "Ani jeee Yosef bi Yesu lɛ ni wɔle etsɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nɛ? Mɛɛba mɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Mijɛ ŋwɛi' nɛ?"
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkawiewiea huhuuhu yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Mɔ ko nyɛŋ aba miŋɔɔ, akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi lɛ gbla lɛ dã, ni mi lɛ matee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli akɛ, 'Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaafee mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii.' Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni enu enɛ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ naa ni ekase hu lɛ, ebaa miŋɔɔ.
Jeee akɛ mɔ ko ena Tsɛ lɛ pɛŋ, ja mɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ; lɛ ena Tsɛ lɛ.
Anɔ kwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ eyɛ naanɔ wala.
Miji wala aboloo lɛ.
Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye mana yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni amɛgboi.
Enɛ ji aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi ba lɛ; kɛji mɔ ko ye aboloo nɛɛ eko lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ. Shi aboloo ni mikɛbaahã lɛ lɛ ji miheloo ni mikɛbaahã yɛ je lɛ wala hewɔ lɛ."
Miji aboloo ni hiɛ kã ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ; kɛji mɔ ko ye aboloo nɛɛ eko lɛ, koni gbɔmɔ aye ni ekagbo.
No hewɔ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ taataa naa yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Te mɔnɛ baafee tɛŋŋ ni enyɛ ekɛ eheloo ahã wɔ ni wɔyeŋ?
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛnyɛnuuu elá lɛ, nyɛbɛ wala yɛ nyɛmli.
Mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ matee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ miheloo lɛ anɔkwa ŋmaa ni, ni milá lɛ anɔkwa numɔnɔ ni.
mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ ehiɔ mimli, ni mi hu mihiɔ emli.
Bɔ ni Tsɛ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tsu mi, ni Tsɛ lɛ hewɔ mihiɛ kã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni yeɔ mi lɛ hu hiɛ aaakã yɛ mihewɔ.
Aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba nɛ; etamɔɔɔ nɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye ni amɛgboi lɛ; mɔ ni yeɔ aboloo nɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ."
Ewie nii nɛɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehe ko yɛ Kapernaum lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii nu enɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Wiemɔ ni wa nɛ; namɔ aaanyɛ toi abo?"
Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ ekaselɔi lɛ miihuhuu yɛ enɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani enɛ tɔ̃tɔɔ nyɛnane nɛɛ?
Shi kɛji nyɛna Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya ŋwɛi he ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ, ni hu?
Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni hãa wala lɛ; heloo lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko. Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ, mumɔ ni, ni wala ni.
Shi nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ ni heee yeee."Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ shishijeee lɛ Yesu le mɛi ni heee yeeee lɛ kɛ mɔ hu ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ, "Enɛ hewɔ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ miŋɔɔ aba, ja Tsɛ lɛ ehã lɛ hegbɛ lɛ."
Jɛ no nɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii ku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ enyiɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu bi mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛ hu nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee?"
Simon Petro here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ŋɔɔ wɔɔtee? Bo oyɔɔ naanɔ wala wiemɔi lɛ;
ni wɔ lɛ wɔhe wɔye ni asaŋ wɔna wɔle akɛ boji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!"
Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Ani jeee nyɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mihala? Shi nyɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ abonsam ni!"
. Shi Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, he ewieɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛji mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
7: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kpa shi yɛ Galilea. Esumɔɔ akɛ eyakpaa shi yɛ Yudea, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ miitao lɛ agbe.
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ Asesei agbijurɔ lɛ eshɛ etã.
No hewɔ lɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Jee biɛ ni oya Yudea, koni okaselɔi lɛ hu ana onitsumɔi ni otsuɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ko ni etao akɛ ale jogbaŋŋ lɛ efeee nɔ ko yɛ teemɔ mli. Akɛni oofee nibii nɛɛ lɛ, jiemɔ ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ."
Shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ tete po heee enɔ yeee.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mibe lɛ nako ashɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbe lɛ daa nɛɛ eshɛ.
Je lɛ nyɛɛɛ nyɛ anyɛ; shi mi lɛ enyɛɔ mi, ejaakɛ miyeɔ ehe odase akɛ enitsumɔi lɛ nitusmɔi fɔ̃ɔji ni.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛyaa gbijurɔ nɛɛ yeli; shi mi lɛ minako maya, ejaakɛ mibe lɛ nako ashɛ."
Be ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, ehi shi yɛ Galilea.
Shi be ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ etee gbijur0 lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, lɛ hu etee, shi ejieee ehe shi, shi moŋ efee tamɔ mɔ ko ni mitee ehe.
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ bɔ̃i lɛ taomɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Nɛɛgbe eyɔɔ?"
Ni huhuhuhu wiemɔ pii ete shi yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ yɛ ehe. Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji lɛ;" ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ, "Dabi, hã moŋ ehã asafo lɛ duduɔ."
Tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko ejeee faŋŋ ewieee ehe yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ.
Shi be ni shɛ gbijurɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Yesu tee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Ni Yudafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, "Te mɔ nɛ ni ekaseko nii lɛ fee tɛŋŋ ni ele woji amli nii nɛkɛ?"
Yesu here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Minitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ.
Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, ebaayoo yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɛ aloo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ.
Mɔ ni toɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enumnyam etaoɔ, shi mɔ ni taoɔ mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ anumnyam lɛ, lɛ lɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ, ni nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ emli.
Ani jeee Mose hã nyɛ Mla lɛ? Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee Mla lɛ nɔ. Mɛni hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nyɛgbe lɛ?"
Asafo lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ omli; namɔ taoɔ o agbe?"
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nitsumɔ kome mitsu, ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnaa ekpɛ nyɛhe yɛ he.
Mose kɛ keriafoo lɛ hã nyɛ jeee akɛ lɛ Mose lɛ eŋɔɔ ejɛ, shi moŋ ejɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ ni hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛ foɔ mɔ ketia .
Kɛji hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ afoɔ mɔ ketia bɔ ni afee ni akatɔ̃ Mose Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛmli fuɔ mi akɛ mitsa gbɔmɔ muu lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ?
Nyɛkakwɛa hiɛiaŋ nyɛkojoa, shi moŋ nyɛkojoa jalɛ kojomɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalembii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, "Ani jeee mɔ ni amɛtaoɔ amɛgbe lɛ nɛ?
Ni naa, faŋŋ ewieɔ yɛ nɛɛ, ni amɛkɛɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko. Ekolɛ benɛ onukpai lɛ ena ele lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mɔnɛ ji Kristo lɛ?
Shi mɔnɛ lɛ, wɔle he ni ejɛ; shi Kristo lɛ be ni eeeba lɛ, mɔ ko leŋ he ni ejɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu tsɔ̃( nii yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ebo ekɛɛ, "Nyɛle mi, ni asaŋ nyɛle he ni mijɛ; ni mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaaa, shi moŋ anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ,ni nyɛleee lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ mile lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni lɛ etsu mi."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛmiitao amɛmɔ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe, ejaakɛ eŋmlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.
Shi asafo lɛ mli mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Be ni Kristo lɛ aaaba lɛ, ani eeefee okadii pii fe nii ni mɔnɛ feɔ nɛɛ?"
Farisifo lɛ nu akɛ asafo lɛ miiwie nii nɛɛ ahe huhuhuhu yɛ ehe; ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ tsu tsuji koni amɛyamɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi, ni mibya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba."
No hewɔ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ mɔnɛ baaya ni wɔnaŋ lɛ? Ani mɛi ni egbɛ eshã Helabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ ebaaya, ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ Helabii lɛ anii?
Mɛɛ wiemɔ ewie nɛɛ, 'Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛbalɛ?'"
Shi naagbee gbi ni ji gbii juji lɛ ateŋ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yesu yadamɔ shi ni ebo ekɛɛ,"Kɛji kumai miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eba miŋɔɔ ni ebanu nu.
Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, fai ni wala nu yɔɔ mli aaajɛ emli aho."
Shi Mumɔ lɛ ni mɛi ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ baana lɛ he ewie nɛɛ; shi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nako aba, ejaakɛ anako awo Yesu hiɛ nyam.
Be ni asafo lɛ mɛi komɛi nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Gbalɔ lɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛŋ!"
Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, "Kristo lɛ nɛ!" Shi mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ, "Ani Kristo lɛ, Galilea ebaajɛ?
Ani ŋmalɛ lɛ ekɛɛɛ akɛ David shwiei lɛ mli kɛ Betlehem maŋ he ni David hi lɛ, jɛi Kristo lɛ baajɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni mligblamɔ ba asafo lɛ mli yɛ ehewɔ.
Shi kulɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi miitao akɛ amɔɔ lɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni tsuji lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ. Amɛbi tsuji lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ lɛ baaa?"
Tsuji lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Bɔ ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ wieɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ewieko nakai dã."
Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Ani nyɛ hu alaka nyɛ?
Ani onukpai lɛ loo Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ehe enɔ eye?
Shi asafo ni leee Mla nɛɛ, alomɔ amɛ."
Nikodemo, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ba Yesu ŋɔɔ be ko lɛ, kɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Kɛ anuko mɔ ko daaŋ gbee ni aaale nɔ ni efee lɛ, wɔmla lɛ buɔ le fɔ lo?"
Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani bo hu Galilea ojɛ? Taomɔ mli okwɛ, shi gbalɔ ko eteko shi kɛjɛko Galilea pɛŋ." 53.(Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.
8: Shi Yesu yiŋ etee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni leebi maaŋkpa lɛ eba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni eho eta shi etɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii.
Ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifaoi lɛ ŋɔ yoo ko ni amɔ lɛ yɛ gblãfitemɔ mli kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛhã edamɔ teŋ,
ni amɛkɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, gblãfitemɔ mli diɛŋtsɛ amɔ lɛ yɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ.
Mla lɛ mli lɛ Mose wo wɔ kitã akɛ atswia nɛkɛ yei atɛi. Shi bo lɛ, te okɛɔ tɛŋŋ?"
Shi enɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ amɛkɛtsɔ̃ lɛ, koni amɛna nɔ ko amɛkɛyaflɔ enaa. Ni Yesu koto shi, ni ekɛ ewao ŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Shi be ni amɛhiɛ lɛ bimɔ lɛ, ewo ehe nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni esha bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ tsutsu etswa lɛ tɛ lɛ."
Ni esaa ekoto shi ekoŋŋ, ni eŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Be ni amɛnu nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ,amɛbɔ̃i kpojee ekomekome, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ nɔ kɛyashi sɛɛkpee mɔ nɔ, ni bashwɛ Yesu kome kɛkɛ kɛ yoo lɛ ni edãmɔ te lɛ mli.

Shi be ni Yesu wo ehe nɔ ni enaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja yoo lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, "Awo, nɛɛgbɛ onaaflɔlɔi lɛ yɔɔ, Ani mɔ ko ebuko o fɔ?" Ni ekɛɛ, "Mɔ ko ebuko mi fɔ, Nuŋtsɔ." Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mi hu mibuuu o fɔ; yaa, shi kaafee esha dɔŋŋ."
Yesu ye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe odase
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, "Miji je lɛ mli la lɛ. Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ misɛɛ lɛ, enyiɛŋ duŋ mli gbi ko gbi ko, shi moŋ eeena wala la lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe odase oyeɔ; odase lɛ bɛ mli."
Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Kɛ miiye mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase hu jiŋŋ. midase lɛ anɔkwale ni, ejaakɛ mile he ni mijɛ kɛ he ni miyaa, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleee he ni mijɛ aloo he ni miyaa.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛkojoɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi kojoɔ; mi lɛ mikɛjooo mɔ ko.
Ni kɛ mikojoɔ tete po, mikojomɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni; ejaakɛ jeee mi kome ni, shi moŋ mi kɛ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ ni.
Ni asaŋ nyɛmla lɛ mli hu aŋma akɛ, 'Mɛi enyɔ oadse lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.'
Mi lɛ miyeɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase, ni Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ hu yeɔ mihe odase."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ o-Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ?" Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "Nyɛleee mi ni nyɛsaa nyɛleee mi-Tsɛ; nyɛle mi jikulɛ, nyɛaale mi-Tsɛ hu."
Yesu wie wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nitoohe lɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ; ni mɔ ko mɔɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋmlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Mi lɛ miiya, ni nyɛaatao mi, ni nyɛhe esha lɛ mli nyɛaagboi yɛ; he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba."
No hewɔ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, "Ani eyaagbe ehe hewɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, 'he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba'lɛ?"
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ shishi nɛɛ, mi lɛ mijɛ ŋwɛi; nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ je nɛɛ mli, mi lɛ mijɛɛɛ je nɛɛ mli.
No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee akɛ mi nɛɛ ji lɛ lɛ, nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli."
Agbɛnɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji o?" Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nɔ nɔŋŋ ji o?" Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ.
Miyɛ nyɛhe saji pii ni mawie ni mikɛaakojo nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ni minu yɛ enaa lɛ, omɛi nɔŋŋ miwieɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ."
Amɛleee akɛ Tsɛ lɛ he akɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Be ni nyɛaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli nyɛaale akɛ mi ni, ni akɛ mitooo miyiŋ mifeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ bɔ ni mi-Tsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ.
Ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ kɛ mi yɛ; tsɛ lɛ shiko mi kome, ejaakɛ mi lɛ nɔ ni sa ehiɛ mifeɔ daa."
