Be ni ewieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, mɛi pii he enɔ ye.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ Yudafoi ni ehe lɛ eye lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛhi shi yɛ miwiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, minɔkwa kaselɔi ji nyɛ,
ni nyɛaale anɔkwale lɛ, ni anɔkwale lɛ aaahã nyɛye nyɛhe."
Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Abraham shwiei ji wɔ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ̃ko mɔ ko nyɔji pɛŋ; te tɛŋŋ ni bo okɛɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛaaye nyɛheŋ?'"
Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, esha lɛ nyɔŋ ji lɛ.
Nyɔŋ ehiii shīa kɛyaaa naabɔ; shi bi hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛji Bi lɛ hã nyɛye nyɛhe lɛ, no nyɛaaye nyɛhe lɛɛlɛŋ.
Mile akɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, ejaakɛ miwiemɔ hooo nyɛmli.
Mi lɛ, nɔ ni mina yɛ mi-Tsɛ he lɛ, no miwieɔ; ni nyɛ hu, nɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ nyɛtsɛ naa lɛ, no nyɛfeɔ."
Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔtsɛ ji Abraham." Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Abrahambii ji nyɛ jikulɛ, nyɛaatsu Abraham nitsumɔi.
Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, mi gbɔmɔ ko ni mikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale ni minu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa lɛ; Abraham efeee enɛ.
Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɛ nitsumɔi nyɛtsuɔ lɛ." Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ afɔɔɔ wɔ yɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ mli; Tsɛ kome wɔyɔɔ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ji nyɛ-Tsɛ kulɛ,nyɛaasumɔ mi; ejaakɛ mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba; ni asaŋ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaa, shi moŋ lɛ etsu mi.
Shi mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛnaaa miwiemɔ naa lɛ? Ejɛ miwiemɔ toi ni nyɛbooo lɛ.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛ ni nyejɛ emli ji abonsam, ni nyɛtsɛ lɛ suɔmɔnaanii nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ nyɛfee. Lɛ lɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ji lɛ kɛjɛ teteete,ni ekɛ anɔkwale lɛ bɛ sane ko, ejaakɛ anɔkwale bɛ amli. Kɛ eemale lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, akɛni miwieɔ anɔkwale hewɔ lɛ,, nyeheee mi nyɛyeee.
Nyɛteŋ namɔ kãa mi yɛ esha ko he? Shi kɛji anɔkwale miwieɔ lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ?
Mɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, enuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi; no hewɔ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛnuuu lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛjɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli."
Yudafoi lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani jeee gbɛnaa wɔkɛɔ akɛ Samarianyo ji o, ni mumɔ fɔŋ hu yɛ omli lɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "Mumɔ fɔŋ bɛ mimli, shi miiwo mi-Tsɛ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛmiishwie mihiɛ shi moŋ.
Mitaooo ni diɛŋtsɛ minumnyam; shi mɔ ko yɛ ni taoɔ ni ekojoɔ ehãa mi.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji mɔ ko ye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, enaŋ gbele kɛaatee naanɔ."

Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kpaako wɔna wɔle akɛ mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ omli. Abraham gbo, ni gbalɔi lɛ hu gboi, ni bo lɛ okɛɔ akɛ, 'Kɛji mɔ ko ye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, esaŋ enaa gbele gbi ko gbi kɛaatee naanɔ.'
Ani ofe wɔtsɛ Abraham ni gbo lɛ? Ni gbalɔi lɛ hu gboi. Te otsɛɔ ohe tɛŋŋ nɛɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ ko; mi-Tsɛ ji mɔ ni woɔ mihiɛ nyam, mɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ lɛ,
ni nyɛleko lɛ, shi mile lɛ, ni miyeɔ ewiemɔ nɔ.
Nyɛtsɛ Abraham mli fli lɛ akɛ eeena migbi lɛ, ni ena ni emii shɛ ehe."
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Onako oye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni ona Abraham lo?"
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, miyɛ momo dani afɔ Abraham."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛklɔ tɛi ni amɛbaatswia lɛ; shi Yesu tee ehe, ni eje Sɔlemɔwe lɛ etee.
9: Ni be ni Yesu hoɔ lɛ, ena nuu ko ni eshwila kɛjɛ efɔmɔ mli.
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, namɔ fee esha, mɔnɛ loo efɔlɔi, hewɔ ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo lɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Jeee esha ni mɔnɛ loo efɔlɔi fee hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ ana aje kpo yɛ mli.
Mi lɛ, ni je etsɛre nɛɛ, ja mitsu mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, je baana, be ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ nii atsu.
Gbii abɔ ni miyɔɔ je lɛ mli nɛɛ, je lɛ la ji mi."
Be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni ekɛ lajɔ̃ lɛ kpɔtɔ su, ni ekɛ su lɛ kpa shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii anɔ,
ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaaju ohe yɛ Siloam (eshishi ji, Mɔ ni atsu lɛ) Kpaakpo lɛ mli." Kɛkɛ ni etee eyaju ehe, ni eba ni eena nii.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ekuŋbii kɛ mɛi ni na lɛ tsutsu ko akɛ sisɛ̃lɔ ji lɛ lɛ kɛɛ, "Ani jeee mɔ ni kulɛ etaa shi ni esisɛ̃ɔ lɛ nɛ?"
Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, "Lɛ ni." Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, "Jeee lɛ ni; etamɔ lɛ." Ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ, "Mi ni."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Te fee tɛŋŋ ni ohiŋmɛii lɛ gbleŋ?"
Ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yesu lɛ kpɔtɔ su, ni ekɛkpa mihiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Yaa Siloam Kpaakpo lɛ mli ni oyaju ohe.'Ni be ni mitee miyaju mihe lɛ, mina nii."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?" Eto he akɛ, "Mileee."
Ni amɛŋɔ mɔ ni tsutsu ni eshwila lɛ kɛtee Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Shi gbi ni Yesu kpɔtɔ su ni ekɛgble ehiŋmɛii lɛ Hejɔɔmɔgbi ni.
Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ hu saa bi lɛ bɔ ni fee ni ena nii lɛ.Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Su ni akpɔtɔ ekɛkpa mihiŋmɛii anɔ, ni miyaju mihe, ni minaa nii nɛɛ."

No hewɔ lɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, "Nuu nɛɛ jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ eyeee hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ mla lɛ nɔ." Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, "Te gbɔmɔ ko ni ji eshafeelɔ aaafee teŋŋ nienyɛ efee naakpɛɛnii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi hu?" Ni mligbamɔ ba amɛteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi shwilafo lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Bo hu, te okɛɔ yɛ ehe tɛŋŋ akɛni egble ohiŋmɛii lɛ?" Ni ekɛɛ, "Gbalɔ ji lɛ."{
Shi Yudafoi lɛ heee yeee akɛ shwilafo ji lɛ sa ni agbɛnɛ enaa nii nɛɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛyatsɛ efɔlɔi
ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛbi ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ afɔ lɛ shwilafo lɛ nɛ? Te fee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni agbɛnɛ enaa niiŋ?"
Efɔlɔi lɛ here amɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔle akɛ wɔbi lɛ nɛ, ni wɔle akɛ afɔ lɛ shwilafo;
shi bɔ ni fee ni enaa nii agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, wɔleee; eda, nyɛbia lɛ; lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaawie ehã ehe."
Efɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe Yudafoi lɛ agbeyei; shi Yudafoi lɛ ekpãŋ eto akɛ, kɛji mɔ ko gba mli kpoo kɛɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ, abaashwie mɔ lɛ kɛjɛ kpeehe lɛ.
No hewɔ ni efɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Eda, nyɛbia lɛ diɛŋtsɛ" lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɛ nuu ni sa ni eji shwilafo lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "ŋɔɔ anumnyam ohã Nyɔŋmɔ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔle akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ eshafeelɔi ji lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Eshafeelɔ ji lɛ jiŋŋ, mileee; nɔ kome mile, akɛ kulɛ shwilafo ji mi, shi agbɛnɛ miina nii."
Ni amɛbi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Mɛni efee o? Te efee tɛŋŋ ni egble ohiŋmɛii lɛ?"
Ehere amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Mikɛɛ nyɛ momo, ni nyɛnuuu:mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ toi nyɛbo ekoŋŋ? Ani nyɛ hu nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ ekaselɔi?"
Amɛjɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Boji ekaselɔ, shi wɔ lɛ Mose kaselɔi ji wɔ.
Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose wie; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, wɔleee he ni ejɛ."
Nuu lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,'Enɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ, akɛ nyɛleee he ni ejɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ egble mihiŋmɛii lɛ!
Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ booo eshafeelɔi atoi; shi kɛji mɔ ko sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni efeɔ esumɔnaanii lɛ, eboɔ lɛ toi.
Kɛjɛ ni abɔ ade nɛɛ anuko akɛ mɔ ko egble mɔ ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo hiɛmɛii dã.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ kulɛ enyɛŋ nɔ ko efee."
Amɛhere nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo lɛ, esha mli kwraa afɔ o yɛ, ni bo moŋ otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii nɛɛ?" Ni amɛshwie lɛ.
Yesu nu akɛ amɛshwie lɛ; ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, "Oohe Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ ooye lo?"
Ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Namɔ ji lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ koni mahe enɔ maye?"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Ona lɛ momo, ni asaŋ mɔ ni kɛ o wieɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ni."
Ni ekɛɛ, "Miihe miiye, Nuŋtsɔ." Ni ekula shi eja lɛ.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, "Kojomɔ hewɔ miba je nɛɛŋ, koni mɛi ni enaaa nii lɛ ana nii, ni mɛi ni naa nii lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ shwilafoi."
Ni Farisifo lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nu enɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Ani wɔ hu shwilafoi ji wɔ?"
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Eji nyɛshwila moŋ kulɛ, nyɛhe bɛ esha; shi agbɛnɛ nyɛhe bɛ esha; shi agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Wɔmiina nii.' No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhe esha lɛ yɛ nyɛhe lolo."
10: Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔɔ shinaa lɛ ni ekɛbote toi atsu lɛ mli, shi moŋ etsɔ̃ɔ he kroko ekɛkwɔɔ lɛ, julɔ kɛ ojotswalɔ ji lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ shinaa lɛ mli kɛboteɔ mli lɛ, toi lɛ akwɛlɔ ji lɛ.
Lɛ shinaa naabulɔ lɛ gbleɔ, ni toi lɛ nuɔ egbee, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etoi lɛ agbɛi tsɛɔ amɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ jeɔ kp.
Ni kɛ ejie toi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ, ni toi lɛ nyiɛɔ esɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛle egbee.
Amɛnyiɛŋ mɔkpɔŋ sɛɛ, shi moŋ amɛaajo enaa foi, ejaakɛ amɛleee mɛi kpɔji agbee."
Yesu bu amɛ abɛ nɛɛ; shi amɛ lɛ amɛnuuu nɔ ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ shishi.
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Miji toi lɛ ashinaa lɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ mihiɛ ba lɛ, julɔi kɛ ojotswalɔi ji amɛ; shi toi lɛ booo amɛ toi hu.
Miji shinaa lɛ. Mi lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko tsɔ̃ minaa etee mli lɛ, aaahere eyiwala ni eeetee mli ni eeeje kpo, ni eeena lɛɛnii.
Julɔ baaa yaka, shi juu kɛ gbee kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hewɔ ebaa; mi lɛ miba bɔ ni afee ni amɛna wala ni amɛna ni ateke nɔ.
"Miji tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ. Tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ kɛ ewala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ etoi lɛ anajiaŋ.
Shi mɔ ni ji apaafonyo ni ejeee toi lɛ akwɛlɔ, mɔ ni toi lɛ jeee enɔ lɛ naa akɛ klaŋ miiba, ni eshiɔ toi lɛ, ni ejoɔ foi, ni klaŋ lɛ bamɔmɔɔ toi lɛ ni egbɛɔ amɛ eshwãa.
Apaafonyo lɛ joɔ foi ejaakɛ apaafonyo ji lɛ, ni toi lɛ ahe edɔɔɔ lɛ.
tamɔ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ le mi, ni mi hu mile Tsɛ lɛ. Ni mikɛ miwala mi hu mile Tsɛ lɛ. Ni mikɛ miwala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ toi lɛ anajiaŋ.
"Miyɛ toi krokomɛi ni jɛɛɛ toi atsu nɛɛ mli; ni nomɛi hu, ja miŋɔ amɛ kɛba, ni amɛbanu migbee,, ni toi lɛ fee kuu kome kɛ kwɛlɔ kome.
No hewɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ mi lɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ miwala ŋmɛɔ shi, koni maŋɔ ekoŋŋ.
Mɔ ko shɔ̃ɔɔ yɛ midɛŋ, shi moŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛŋmɛɔ shi; miyɛ hewalɛ akɛ mikɛŋmɛɔ shi, ni miyɛ hewalɛ akɛ miŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ; bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ mi nɛ."
Wiemɔi nɛɛ ahewɔ lɛ mligblamɔ saa ba Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ ekoŋŋ.
Ni amɛteŋ mɛi pii kɛɛ, "Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli ni eye sɛkɛ; mɛɛhewɔ nyɛboɔ lɛ toi?"
Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, "Jeee mɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli wiemɔi nɛ. Ani mumɔ fɔŋ aaanyɛ shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii agble?"
Agbɛnɛ aaye Sɔlemɔtsu Nɔjɔɔmɔ Gbijurɔ yɛ Yerusalem, ni fɛ̃ibe mli ni.
Ni Yesu miishera shi yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɛ Solomon koi lɛ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ babɔle ehe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ooohã wɔyiŋ afee wɔ kɔshikɔshi kɛyashi? Kɛ boji Kristo lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ faŋŋ."
Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Mikɛɛ nyɛ momo shi nyɛheee nyɛyeee. Nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ yɛ mi-Tsɛ gbɛi mli lɛ lɛ, nomɛi miiye mihe odase;
shu nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛheee mitoi lɛ eko.
Mitoi lɛ nuɔ migbee, ni milɛ amɛ, ni amɛnyiɛɔ misɛɛ,
Mi-Tsɛ ni ŋɔ amɛ ehã mi lɛ fe mɛi fɛɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ashɔ̃ amɛ yɛ mi-Tsɛ dɛŋ.
Mi kɛ Tsɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ekomeŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ klɔ tɛi ekoŋŋ akɛ amɛbaatswia lɛ.
Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai pii ni jɛ mi-Tsɛ ŋɔɔ; te nakai nitsumɔ lɛ ateŋ nɔ hewɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ mi tɛi nyɛtswia nɛɛ?"
Yudafoi lɛ here lɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Jeee nitsumɔ kpakpa ko hewɔ wɔbaatswia o tɛi lɛ, shi moŋ musubɔɔ hewɔŋ, ejaakɛ bo ni gbɔmɔ ji o lɛ, ootsɛ ohe Nyɔŋmɔ."
Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Ani aŋmako yɛ nyɛ-Mla lɛ mli akɛ, 'Mikɛɛ, nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ?'
Kɛji mɛi aŋɔɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ba lɛ tete lɛ etsɛ amɛ nyɔŋmɔi, ni anyɛŋ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli aku lɛ,
nyɛmiikɛɛ mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni etsu lɛ kɛba je lɛ mli lɛ akɛ, 'Obɔ musu', akɛni mikɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji mi'lɛ?
Kɛjeee mi-Tsɛ nitsumɔi mitsuɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkahea mi nyɛyea;
shi kɛji no mitsuɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛyea mi nyɛyeee lɛ, nyɛhea nitsumɔi lɛ kɛkɛ nyɛyea mɔ, koni nyɛle ni nyɛhew nyɛye akɛ Tsɛ lɛ yɛ mimli, ni mi hu miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛmiitao ekoŋŋ akɛ amɛmɔ lɛ, shi eje amɛdɛŋ.
Ni eyiŋ etee Yordan sɛɛ ekoŋŋ, he ni Yohane baptisi yɛ tsutsu lɛ, ni eyahi jɛi.
Ni mɛi pii ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Yohane efeee naakpɛɛnii ko moŋ; shi nii fiaa ni ewie yɛ nuu nɛɛ he lɛ, anɔkwaŋ."
Ni mɛi pii he enɔ amɛ ye yɛ jɛi.
11: Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lazaro ni jɛ Betania, Maria kɛ enyɛmi Martamɛi akrowa lɛ, he miiye.
(Maria ni kɛ mukɛŋma kpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ lɛ nyɛmi Lazaro he yeɔ nɛɛ.)
No hewɔ lɛ enyɛmimɛi yei lɛ tsu aba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, naa, mɔ ni osumɔɔ lɛ he miiye."
Shi be Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Nɛkɛ hela nɛɛ jeee gbele hela ni, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ hewɔ eba, bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ nɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam."
Yesu sumɔɔ Maria kɛ enyɛmiyoo lɛ kɛ lazaro fɛɛ.
Shi be ni enu akɛ ehe miiye lɛ, emɛ yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ gbi enyɔ.
Ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Yudea ekoŋŋ."
Kaselɔi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, eyako gbi ko ni Yudafoi lɛ tao bo tɛi atswia lɛ, ni ooya jɛi ekoŋŋ lo?"
Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "Ani jeee ŋmlɛtswai nyɔŋma kɛ! enyɔ yɔɔ gbi kome mli? Kɛji mɔ nyiɛ shwane lɛ, etɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ enaa je nɛɛ mli la lɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ nyiɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, etɛɔ, ejaakɛ la bɛ."
Ewie nii nɛɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Wɔshieŋtsɛ Lazaro ewɔ; shi miiya ni mayatsīɛ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ wɔ ewɔ lɛ, no lɛ ehe baawa lɛ."
Shi egbele he Yesu wie lɛ; shi amɛ lɛ amɛsusu akɛ wɔ kpakpa he ewieɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ, "Lazaro egbo;
ni nyɛ hewɔ lɛ eŋɔɔ minaa akɛ mibɛ jɛi, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhe nyɛye; shi nyɛhãa wɔyaa eŋɔɔ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ Toma, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo lɛ, kɛɛ enanemɛi kaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔ hu wɔyaa, ni wɔ kɛ lɛ ayagboa."
Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu shɛ jɛi lɛ, ebana akɛ eye gbii ejwɛ momo yɛ bu lɛ mli.
Shi Betania kɛ Yerusalem teŋ jekɛmɔ aaafee shitoi enyɔ.
Ni Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii eba Marta kɛ Mariamɛi aŋɔɔ, koni amɛbaye amɛ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ amɛnyɛmi nuu lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni Marta nu akɛ Yesu miiba lɛ, etee eyakpee lɛ; shi Maria lɛ, lɛ lɛ eta shīa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Marta bakɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, eji oyɛ biɛ kulɛ, minyɛmi lɛ gboŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ hu mile akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã o."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Onyɛmi lɛ baate shi."
Marta kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, tee lɛ mli yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mi lɛ miji shitee lɛ kɛ wala lɛ; mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, kɛji egbo tete lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã;
ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni eheɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, egboŋ gbi ko kɛaatee naanɔ. Oheɔ enɛ oyeɔ lo?"
Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, miheɔ miyeɔ akɛ boji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni baa je lɛ mli lɛ."
Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee ni eyatsɛ enyɛmi Maria lɛ nigi, ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eba; eetsɛ o."
Be ni enu lɛ, ete shi oya ni eba eŋɔɔ.
Shi Yesu nako ashɛ akrowa lɛ, shi eyɛ hegbɛ ni Marta kɛ lɛ yakpe yɛ lɛ lolo.
Be ni Yudafoi lɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ shīa lɛ ni amɛyeɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ na akɛ Maria ete shi oya kɛje kpo lɛ, amɛtiu lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ eeya fuuhe lɛ eyafo yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni Maria ba he ni Yesu yɔɔ lɛ ni ena lɛ lɛ, eho egbee enajianaa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, eji oyɛ biɛ kulɛ, minyɛmi lɛ gboŋ!"
Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yuse na lɛ akɛ eefo, kɛ Yudafoi lɛ hu ni kɛ lɛ ba lɛ, akɛ amɛ hu amɛmiifo lɛ, ehūu yɛ emumɔ mli, ni ehao;
ni ekɛɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ nyɛto lɛ yɛ?" Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ba ni obakwɛ."
Yesu fo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, "Kwɛ bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ!"
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, "Ani nuu nɛɛ ni gble shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ nyɛŋ efee ni kulɛ nuu nɛɛ akagbo?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu saa hūu yɛ emli ekoŋŋ, ni etee fuuhe lɛ; shi tɛkplo ni, ni tɛ bu naa.
Yesu kɛɛ, "nyɛjiea tɛ lɛ." Marta, mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛmiyoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, be nɛ mli lɛ efite, ejaakɛ eye gbii ejwɛ sɔŋŋ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani mikɛɛɛ o akɛ kɛji ohe oye lɛ, ooona Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ?"
No hewɔ lɛ amɛjie lɛ lɛ, ni Yesu hole ehiŋmɛii anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ekɛɛ, "Ataa, miida o shi akɛ obo mi toi lɛ.
Mile akɛ daa oboɔ mi toi, shi asafo lɛ ni damɔ biɛ lɛ hewɔ mikɛɔ enɛ, koni amɛhe amɛye akɛ bo otsu mi."
Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ebo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, "Lazaro ee, jee kpo!"
Ni gbonyo lɛ je kpo,fuu mamai lɛ fimɔ enaji kɛ eniji, ni duku fi ehiɛ. Yesu kɛɛ amɛakɛ, "nyɛfɛnea lɛ, ni nyɛhãa eyaa."
No hewɔ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ ni ba Maria ŋɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he Yesu nɔ amɛye, be ni amɛna nii ni efee lɛ.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yiŋ tee Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛyagba amɛ nii ni Yesu fee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ tsɛ kpee, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Te wɔfeɔ tɛŋŋ, ejaakɛ nuu nɛɛ miifee naakpɛɛnii pii?
Kɛji wɔŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ aaahe enɔ aye; ni Romabii lɛ aaaba ni amɛaabashɔ̃ wɔ-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ."
Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome, Kaiafa ni yeɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ lɛ nyɛleee nɔ ko kwraa,
ni nyɛsaa nyɛjwɛŋŋ hu akɛ ehi hã wɔ akɛ mɔ kome agbo yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ,fe nɔ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã lɛ."
Shi enɛ lɛ, jeee lɛ diɛ3tsɛ eto eyiŋ ewie, shi moŋ, akɛ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, gba egba akɛ Yesu baagbo yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ;
ni jeee yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ hewɔ kɛkɛ, shi bɔ ni afee ni ebua Nyɔŋmɔ bii ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ hu naa efee kuu kome.
Ni kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkpɛ mli akɛ amɛbaagbe lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu ejieee ehe kpo faŋŋ kɛnyiɛɛɛ yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ dɔŋŋ, shi eje jɛi etee shikpɔŋ ko ni kã ŋa lɛ naa lɛ nɔ, yɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Efraim lɛ mli, ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yahi jɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ a-Hehoo lɛ eshɛ etã. Ni mɛi babaoo jɛ koi asɛɛ amɛtee Yerusalem, dani Hehoo lɛ ashɛ, koni amɛyatsuu amɛhe.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i Yesu taomɔ, ni be ni amɛdamɔdamɔɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, "Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ, ani ebaŋ gbijurɔ lɛ?"
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ewo kitã akɛ, kɛ mɔ ko le he ni eyɔɔ lɛ etswa adafi, koni ayamɔ lɛ.
12: Be ni eshwɛ gbii ekpaa ni ayeɔ Hehoo lɛ, Yesu ba Betania, he ni Lazaro, mɔ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, yɔɔ lɛ.
Amɛŋmɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ni Marta sɔmɔ; ni Lazaro fata mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tra okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni Maria ŋɔ "nardo" mu ŋmiiŋmi ni jra wa naakpa ni etsiimɔ ji nsɛnitɛ kome, ni ekɛkpa Yesu naji ahe ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ enaji lɛ ahe; ni mu lɛ ŋma yi shīa lɛ mli tɔ.
Shi Yuda Iskriot, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, kɛɛ,
"Mɛɛhewɔ ahɔ̃ɔɔ mu nɛɛ denarioi ohai etɛ̃ ni akɛ shika lɛ ahã ohiafoi?"
Shi enɛ ni ekɛɛ nɛɛ, jeee ohiafoi lɛ ahe ni dɔɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ julɔ ji lɛ, ni lɛ etoɔ fotro lɛ, ni ejuɔ nɔ ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ, "Kaagba enaa; efee enɛ eto mifuu gbi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa; shi mi lɛ, jeee daa nyɛkɛ mi aaahi shi."
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii na le akɛ Yesu yɛ jɛi, ni amɛba, jeee Yesu kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ koni amɛna Lazaro, mɔ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ hu.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kpɛ mli akɛ amɛaagbe Lazaro hu,
ejaakɛ ehewɔ jɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii tee ni amɛyahe Yesu nɔ amɛye lɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni mɛi babaoo ni eba gbijurɔ lɛ nu akɛ Yesu miiba Yerusalem lɛ,
amɛklɔ blɛoi, ni amɛje kpo amɛyakpee lɛ, ni amɛblɔ akɛ "Hosiana! Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ!"
Shi Yesu ena teji bi ko ni eho eta nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ,
"Kaashe gbeyei, Zion biyoo! Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba. Eta tejibi nɔ."
Shi ekaselɔi lɛ enaaa nii nɛɛ ashishi mra mli, shi be ni awo Yesu hiɛ nyam lɛ, no dani amɛkai akɛ aŋma nii nɛɛ ye ehe, ni no afee ahã lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ asafo ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ be mli ni etsɛ Lazaro kɛjɛ gbonyobu lɛ mli ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohiiateŋ lɛ ye he odase.
Enɛ hewɔ hu ni asafo lɛ yakpee lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ efee naakpɛɛnii nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, "Te nyɛna akɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ fɛi nyɛfee! Naa,je lɛ efã kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ!"
Shi Helabii komɛi yɛ mɛi ni ba koni amɛbaja Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ ateŋ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ba Filipo ni jɛ Betsaida yɛ Galilea lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, wɔmiitao akɛ wɔna Yesu."
Filipo ba ni ebabakɛɛ Andrea, ni Andrea kɛ Filipo bakɛɛ Yesu.
Ni Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "ŋmlɛtswaa ni akɛbaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam lɛ eshɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ ŋmaa kuli enyɔɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbo lɛ, no lɛ eyɛ akɛ ŋmaa kuli kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛji egbo lɛ, ewoɔ yibii pii.
Mɔ ni dɔɔ ewala yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, eeeto lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ wala mli.
Kɛji mɔ ko misɔ̃mɔ mi lɛ, enyiɛ misɛɛ, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, jɛi misɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ hu aaahi; kɛji mɔ ko miisɔ̃mɔ mi lɛ, mi-Tsɛ aaawo lɛ."
"Agbɛnɛ misusuma miihao, ni mɛni makɛɛ? Ataa, heremɔ mi kɛjɛ ŋmlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli! Shi asaŋ enɛ hewɔ miba ŋmlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ataa, wo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam!" Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, "Mina miwo ehiɛ nyam, ni masaa mawo ehiɛ nyam ekoŋŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni asafo ni damɔ jɛi ni nu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ eshi!" Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, "ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ ewie!"
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Jeee mi hewɔ gbee nɛɛ ba, shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛhewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ je nɛɛŋ kojomɔ lɛ eshɛ; agbɛnɛ abaafã je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ ashɛ afɔ̃.
Ni mi lɛ, kɛji awo minɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, magbla mɛi fɛɛ kɛaaba miŋɔɔ."
Shi enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni ebaagbo.
Asafo lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ wɔnu yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ Kristo lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni bo lɛ okɛɔ akɛ ja awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ? Namɔ ji nɛkɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi nɛɛ?

Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Be kukuoo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ehã la lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛnyiɛa koni duŋ akabanina nyɛ; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ duŋ akabanina nyɛ; sahi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli lɛ, eleee he ni eyaa.
Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhea la lɛ nɔ nyɛyea, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la bii."
Efee naakpɛɛnii babaoo yɛ amɛhiɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛheee enɔ amɛyeee,
koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ ni ewie lɛ ana aba mli akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye, Ni namɔ ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ?"
Enɛ hewɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛye lɛ, ejaakɛ Yesaia saa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ,
"Eshwila amɛhiŋmɛii, ni ekpliŋ amɛtsui; koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni mitsa amɛ."
Nii nɛɛ lɛ Yesaia kɛɛ, ejaakɛ ena enumnyam lɛ, ni ewie ehe.
Kɛ̃lɛ onukpai lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii he enɔ ye; shi Farisifoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ amɛjajeee faŋŋ, koni akashwie amɛ kɛjɛ kpeehe lɛ;
ejaakɛ amɛmiisumɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛnyam fe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.
Shi Yesu bo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, jeee mi minɔ eheɔ eyeɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ;
ni mɔ ni naa mi lɛ naa mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.
Mi lɛ miba je lɛ mli akɛ la, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ akahi duŋ lɛ mli.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko nu miwiemɔi lɛ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, mikojooo lɛ; ejaakɛ mibaaa koni mibakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ miba koni mibahere je lɛ yiwala.
Mɔ ni kwaa mi ni emɔɔɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, eyɛ mɔ ko ni kojoɔ lɛ. Wiemɔ ni miwie lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ yɛ nagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ miwieee; shi Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ moŋ ewo mi kitã, nɔ ni mikɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni miwie.
Ni mile akɛ ekitã lɛ naanɔ wala ni; no hewɔ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ."
13: Dani Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ aaashɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le akɛ eŋmlɛtswaa ni ekɛbaaje nɛɛ mli kɛya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ eshɛ hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai esumɔ amɛ kɛyashi naagbee.
Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, belɛ abonsam kɛwo Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, tsui mli momo, akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ
akɛni Yesu le akɛ Tsɛ lɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ, ni esaa eeya Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ,
ete shi yɛ niyenii lɛ ashi, ni ejie etadei lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɔ papaŋ ni ekɛŋmɔ ehɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ efɔse nu ewo okpolu mli, ni ebɔ̃i ekaselɔ lɛ anaji ahe fɔmɔ, ni ekɛ papaŋ ni ŋmɔ ehɛ lɛ tsumɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ebashɛ Simon Petro nɔ, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, bo ofɔɔ minaji ahe nɛɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nɔ ni mifeɔ nɛɛ, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ oleee, shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ, obaale."
Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaafɔ minaji ahe kɔkɔɔkɔ." Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Kɛji mifɔɔɔ onaji ahe lɛ, obɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ ko yɛ miŋɔɔ."
Simon Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɛ, jeee minaji ahe kɛkɛ mɔ, shi moŋ miniji kɛ miyitso hu."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ni aju ehe lɛ, ehiaaa lɛ hefɔflɔmɔ, akɛ ja enaji ahe fɔmɔ kɛkɛ, shi ehe eje kɛmɔ shi; ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe eje moŋ shi jeee nyɛ fɛɛ ni."
Ejaakɛ ele mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ; no hewɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe eje lɛ."
Agbɛnɛ, be ni efɔ amɛnaji ahe ni eklɔ etadei lɛ ni ewo ni eho eta shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛnu nɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ shishi lo?
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛɔ mi Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ; ni eja, ejaakɛ nakai ji mi.
Agbɛnɛ, kɛji mi, Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mifɔ nyɛnaji ahe lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛ hu nyɛfɔfɔɔ nyɛnanemɛi anaji ahe.
Shi okadi mito mihã nyɛ, koni bɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfee nakai.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋ efeee enuŋtsɔ, ni asaŋ bɔfo efeee mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛle nii nɛɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ kɛji nyɛye nɔ.
"Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe miwieɔ; mi lɛ mile mɛi ni mihala; shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli akɛ, 'Mɔ ni yeɔ midɛŋ aboloo lɛ, ewo enanetsitsi eshi mi.
Agbɛnɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ mato dani aba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ mi ni.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni here mɔ ni mitsuɔ lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ ehereɔ lɛ; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ."
Be ni Yesu kɛɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, ehao yɛ mumɔ mli, ni egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ aselɔi lɛ kwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ, ni amɛnaaa mɔ koome he ni ewieɔ lɛ.
Shi kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ ta emasɛi kpaakpa yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Simon Petro bɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi akɛ ebi lɛ mɔ he ni ewieɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nakai kaselɔ lɛ ho kpasa Yesu tsitsi ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ni?"
Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "lɛji mɔ ni mikɛ atrɔma lɛ tsɔ mli ni ekehã Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ.
Ni atrɔma lɛ sɛɛ pɛ ni Satan bote Yuda mli. Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ, feemɔ mramra!"
Shi mɛi ni tra okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee nɔ hewɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ nakai lɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi susu akɛ ni Yuda toɔ fotro lɛ, no hewɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ eyahe nii ni he hiaa amɛ eto gbijurɔ lɛ, aloo akɛ ekɛ nɔ ko ahã ohiafoi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni ehe atrɔma lɛ, amrɔ lɛ eje kpo. Shi je ena.
Be ni Yuda kpo lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, "Agbɛnɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam, ni atsɔ̃ enɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Kɛji atsɔ̃ enɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu aaawo ehiɛ nyam yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli, ni eeewo ehiɛ nyam oya.
Bii bibii, be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi; nyɛaatao mi, ni bɔ ni mikɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, 'He ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba'lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ nyɛ hu agbɛnɛ nɛɛ.
Kitã hee mikɛhãa nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe.
Kɛji nyɛsumɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ, no mɛi fɛɛ kɛaale akɛ mikaselɔi ji nyɛ." Yesu gba bvɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto
Simon Petro bi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, nɛɛgbɛ oyaa?" Yesu here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "He ni miyaa lɛ, onyɛŋ misɛɛ onyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ooonyiɛ misɛɛ wɔsɛɛ ko."
Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, mɛɛhewɔ minyeŋ osɛɛ manyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ? Miwala tete mikɛaaŋmɛ shi yɛ ohewɔ."
Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Okɛ owala aaaŋmɛ shi yɛ mihewɔ? Anɔkwale mikɛɔ o akɛ, wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni oookwa mi shii etɛ̃."
14: "Nyɛkayea nyɛtsui; nyɛhea Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyea, ni mi hu nyɛhea minɔ nyɛyea.
Shihilɛhei pii yɛ mi-Tsɛ we lɛ; jeee nakai ni kulɛ makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miiya ni mayasaa gbɛhe mato nyɛ lo?
Ni kɛji mitee ni miyasaa gbɛhe mito nyɛ lɛ, mibaba ekoŋŋ ni mibaŋɔ nyɛ kɛya he ni mi diɛŋtsɛ miyɔɔ lɛ, koni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛhi jɛi.
Ni he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛle, ni gbɛ lɛ hu, nyɛle."
Toma kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, wɔleee he ni oyaa, ni ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ gbɛ lɛ wɔle hu?"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miji gbɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ kɛ wala lɛ; mɔ ko baaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, akɛ ja etsɔ̃ minɔ.
Eji nyɛle mi kulɛ, nyɛaale mi-Tsɛ hi; ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛle lɛ, ni nyɛna lɛ."
Filipo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni no fa hã wɔ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, oleko mi lolo, Filipo?Mɔ ni ena mi lɛ, ena Tsɛ lɛ, ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ 'Tsɔ̃mɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ?'
Ani oheee oyeee akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli? Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ lɛ, jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ; shi Tsɛ lɛ ni hiɔ mimli lɛ, lɛ etsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ.
Nyɛhea mi nyɛyea akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli; shi kɛji nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ, nyɛhea mi nyɛyea yɛ minitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eeetsu, ni eeetsu nii ni fe nomɛi tete, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛɛakpa he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee, koni Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ aba nyam kɛtsɔ̃ Bi lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji nyɛkpa nɔ ko he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee."
"Kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ mi lɛ nyɛaaye mikitãi lɛ anɔ.
Ni mi lɛ mabi Tsɛ lɛ ni eeehã nyɛ Hefatalɔ kroko, koni ekɛ nyɛ ahi shi kɛya naanɔ;
Hefatalɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni je lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ aŋɔ, ejaakɛ enaaa lɛ ni asaŋ eleee lɛ lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛle lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ nyɛ yɔɔ, ni eyɛ nyɛmli.
Mishiŋ nyɛ awusai; miiba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni je lɛ enaŋ mi dɔŋŋ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛaana mi; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã, ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aaakã.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛaale akɛ miyɛ mi-Tsɛ mli, ni nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ mimli, ni mi hu miyɛ nyɛmli.
Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mikitãi lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, lɛji mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, mi-Tsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni mi hu masumɔ lɛ, ni majie mihe shi matsɔ̃ɔ lɛ."
Yuda, jeee Isakariot, bi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni eba hewɔ ni wɔ pɛ obaajie ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ, ni jeee je lɛ?"
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko misumɔ mi lɛ, eeeye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mi-Tsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni wɔɔba eŋɔɔ, ni wɔkɛ lɛ aaahi shi.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ mi lɛ, eyeee miwiemɔi lɛ anɔ; ni wiemɔ ni nyɛnuɔ lɛ jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ.
"Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ be mli ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ.
Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ baatsu yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii fɛɛ, ni eeekai nyɛ nii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ.
"Hejɔlɛ mishiɔ mahã nyɛ, hejɔlɛ ni ji minɔ lɛ mikɛhãa nyɛ, jeee bɔ ni je lɛ hãa lɛ mihãa nyɛ nɛɛ. Nyɛtsui akayea, ni asaŋ nyɛkasehea gbeyei.
Nyɛnu akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Miiya, ni mibaba nyɛŋɔɔ. Nyɛmiisumɔ mi kulɛ, nyɛaana miishɛɛ akɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔ, ejaakɛ mi-Tsɛ da fe mi.
Ni agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ dani eba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, ni nyɛhe nyɛye.
Mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ nibii pii dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ je lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ miiba, ni ebɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ minɔ;
shi bɔ ni afee ni je lɛ ana ale akɛ miisumɔɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ wo mi kitã lɛ nakai mifeɔ lɛ. Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔjea biɛ wɔyaa."
15: "Miji anɔkwa waintso lɛ, ni mi-Tsɛ ji okwaafonyo lɛ.
Mihe nine fɛɛ nine ni wooo yibii lɛ, eflɔɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko ni woɔ yibii lɛ, ekplɔɔ he, bɔ ni afee ni ewo yibii pii fe tsutsu lɛ.
Nyɛhe etse momo yɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ ewie lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɛhia mimli, ni mi hu mahi nyɛmli. Tamɔ bɔ ni tso nine nyɛŋ awo yibii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ akɛ ja ema waintso lɛ he lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛnyɛŋ akɛ ja nyɛhi mimli.
"Miji waintso lɛ, nyɛji niji lɛ. Mɔ ni hiɔ mimli ni mi hu mihiɔ emli lɛ, lɛ ewoɔ yibii pii; ejaakɛ kɛjeee miŋ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ nɔ ko nyɛfee.
Kɛji mɔ ko ehii mimli lɛ, ahɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ tamɔ tso nine, ni egbiɔ, ni abuaa naa awoɔ la mli, ni ashãa.
Kɛji nyɛhi mimli ni miwiemɔi lɛ hi nyɛmli lɛ, nyɛaakpa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ he fai, ni aaafee ahã nyɛ.
Nɔ ni akɛwoɔ mi-Tsɛ hiɛ nyam ji akɛ nyɛwo yibii pii, ni nyɛfee mikaselɔi.
"Bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ sumɔ mi lɛ, nakai mi hu misumɔ nyɛ; nyɛhia misuɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛji nyɛye mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛaahii misuɔmɔ lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni miye mi-Tsɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni mihiɔ esuɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
"Mikɛ nyɛ ewie enɛɛmɛi, koni mimiishɛɛ lɛ ahi nyɛmli, ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu.
Mikitã ji akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni misumɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ko bɛ suɔmɔ ni da fe enɛ, akɛ mɔ kɛ ewala aaaŋmɛ shi ahã eshieŋtsɛmɛi .
Kɛji nyɛfee nii ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, no lɛ mishieŋtsɛmɛi ji nyɛ.
Mitsɛɛɛ nyɛ tsuji dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsulɔ leee nɔ ni enuŋtsɔ feɔ, shi moŋ shieŋtsɛmɛimatsɛ nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii fɛɛ ni minu yɛ mi-Tsɛ naa lɛ, mitsi tã mikɛɛ nyɛ.
Jeee nyɛ nyɛhala mi, shi mi moŋ mihala nyɛ, ni mito nyɛ koni nyɛ hu nyɛya ni nyɛyawo yibii, ni nyɛyibii lɛ ahi shi, koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ.
Enɛ ji kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ, akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe."
"Kɛji je lɛ minyɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mi tsutsu enyɛ.
Eji je lɛ mli nyɛjɛ kulɛ, je lɛ aaasumɔ nyɛ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, shi akɛni nyɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ mihala nyɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛhiɛ ahia wiemɔni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ, akɛ, 'Nyɔŋ efeee e-Nuŋtsɔ.' Kɛ amɛwa mi yi lɛ, amɛaawa nyɛ hu yi; kɛ amɛye miwiemɔ nɔ lɛ, amɛaaye nyɛ hu nyɛnɔ nɔ.
Shi amɛkɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaafee nyɛyɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛleee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.
Mibaaa mikɛ amɛ ebawieee jikulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛbɛ amɛhe esha lɛ he naajiemɔ ko.
Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ eenyɛ mi-Tsɛ hu.
Eji mitsuuu nitsumɔi ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsuko eko dã yɛ amɛteŋ kulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe;shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛna, ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi kɛ mi-Tsɛ fɛɛ.
Shi afee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni wiemɔ ni aŋma yɛ amɛ-Mla lɛ mli akɛ, 'Amɛnyɛ mi yakatswaa' lɛ ana aba mli.
"Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni mibatsu nyɛŋɔɔ kɛaajɛ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni jɛɔ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ baa lɛ, kɛ eba lɛ, eeeye mihe odase;
ni nyɛ hu nyɛaaye odase, ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ mi yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee."
16: "Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnane akatɔ̃tɔ̃.
Amɛaashwie nyɛ kɛaajɛ kpeehei lɛ. Ni be baaba tete, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbeɔ nyɛ lɛ aaasusu akɛ ekɛmiija Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni amɛaafee enɛɛmɛi,ejaakɛ amɛleee Tsɛ lɛ ni amɛleee mi hu.
Shi mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni kɛ be lɛ shɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkai akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ. Shi kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ mikɛɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ."
"Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, miiya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko biii mi akɛ, 'Nɛɛgbɛ oyaa?'
Shi ni mitsi nii nɛɛ atã mikɛɛ nyɛ hewɔ lɛ; ŋkɔmɔyeli eyi nyɛtsuiiaŋ obɔ̃.
Kɛ̃lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale, ehi hã nyɛ akɛ matee; ejaakɛ kɛji miyaaa lɛ, Hefatalɔ lɛ baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ; shi kɛji mitee lɛ, matsu lɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Ni lɛ lɛ, kɛji eba lɛ, eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha kɛ jalɛ kɛ kojomɔ he.
Eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha he, ejaakɛ amɛheee minɔ amɛyeee;
eeekã je lɛ jalɛ he, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ;
eeekã je lɛ yɛ kojomɔ he, ejaakɛ akojo je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ momo lɛ.
"Miyɛ nibii pii lolo ni makɛɛ nyɛ, shi nyɛnyɛŋ mli nyɛmɔ amrɔ nɛɛ.
Shi kɛji lɛ, anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ, ena eba lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ anɔkwale lɛ fɛɛ mli gbɛ; ejaakɛ etoŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieŋ; shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeenu lɛ, no eeewie, ni nii ni baa lɛ, eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Lɛ ebaawo mihiɛ nyam, ejaakɛ eeeŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko ni eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Nii fia ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, minɔŋ; no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ebaaŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko, ni etsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ."
"Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi ateŋ mɛi komɛi bibii amɛhe akɛ, "Mɛni ji nɔ ni ekɛɔ wɔ nɛɛ. 'Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi kɛ ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ?'"
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛni ji 'eshwɛ fioo' lɛ ni ekɛɔ lɛ? Wɔleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ nɛɛ."
Yesu na akɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛbiɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ni mikɛɛ akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi lɛ, no he nii nyɛbibiɔ nyɛhe nɛɛ?
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaafo ni nyɛbaawo yara, shi je lɛ baanya; nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaawo yara, shi je lɛ baanya; nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ, shi nyɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ aaatsɔ̃ miishɛɛ.
Kɛji yoo miikɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ehaoɔ, ejaakɛ eŋmlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; shi kɛ efɔ bi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekaiii hejramɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ miishɛɛ ni enaa akɛ efɔ gbɔmɔ kɛba je lɛ mli lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai ji nyɛ hu; amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ; shi mibana nyɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛtsui aaanyɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko shɔŋ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
"Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbiŋ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko. Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ eeehã nyɛ.
Kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ nyɛbiko nɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli; nyɛbia, ni nyɛaana, koni nyɛmishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu."
"Nii nɛɛ, abɛbuai amli mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ yɛ nɛɛ. Be miiba, ni mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ yɛ abɛbuai amli dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ faŋŋ majaje Tsɛ lɛ he sane matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaabi nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ yɛ migbɛi mli, shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mi mabi Tsɛ lɛ mahã nyɛ;
ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ miisumɔ nyɛ, akɛni nyɛsumɔ mi, ni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ lɛ.
Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba je lɛ mli, ni miije lɛ mli maya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ."
Ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, agbɛnɛ oowie faŋŋ ni owieee yɛ abɛbua mli.
Agbɛnɛ wɔna akɛ ole nii fɛɛ ni ehiaaa o akɛ mɔ ko biɔ o sane ko; enɛ wɔkɛheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ojɛ."
Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ nyɛmiihe nyɛmiiye?
Naa; ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ po, ni nyɛbaagbɛ nyɛshwã ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaya emaŋ, ni nyɛaashi mi kome; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mi kome ni, ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ.
Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛna hejɔlɛ yɛ mimli. Je lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛbaana amanehulu,hi nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛmli, miye je lɛ nɔ kunim."
17: Be ni Yesu wie nii nɛɛ lɛ, ewo ehiɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni ekɛɛ, "Ataa, ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; wo o-Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam, koni o-Bi lɛ hu awo ohiɛ nyam;
tamɔ bɔ ni ohã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ, koni mɛi fɛɛ ni okɛhã lɛ lɛ, ehã amɛ naanɔ wala lɛ.
Shi enɛ ji naanɔ wala lɛ, akɛ amɛle bo, anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, mɔ ni otsu lɛ.
Miwo ohiɛ nyam yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, akɛni nitsumɔ lɛ ni okɛhã mi tsumɔ lɛ, migbe naa lɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ, Ataa, kɛ anumnyam ni miyɔɔ yɛ oŋɔɔ dani abɔ je lɛ awo mihiɛ nyam yɛ omasɛi."
"Mijie ogbɛi lɛ shi mitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi ni okɛhã mi kɛjɛ je lɛŋ lɛ. Onii ji amɛ, ni okɛ amɛ hã mi, ni amɛye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ amɛle akɛ nii fiaa ni okɛhã mi lɛ, oŋɔɔ ejɛ;
ejaakɛ wiemɔi lɛ ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ; ni amɛmɔ mli, ni amɛna amɛle anɔkwale mli akɛ oŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni amnɛhe amɛye akɛ bo otsu mi.
Amɛ mibiɔ mahã; jeee je lɛ mibiɔ mahã, shi moŋ mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ onii ji amɛ.
Minii fɛɛ lɛ onɔŋ, ni onii fɛɛ lɛ minɔŋ, ni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ amɛmli.
Mibɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ, shi mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ je lɛ mli, ni mi lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ. Ataa Krɔŋkrɔŋ, mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, too amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni amɛfee ekome tamɔ wɔ.
Be ni mikɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mito amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli. Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mibu amɛhe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko elaajeko, ja laajemɔ bi lɛ, koni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli.
Ni agbɛnɛ miiba oŋɔɔ, ni miiwie nii nɛɛ yɛ je lɛ mli, koni amɛna mimiishɛɛ lɛ ni eye emuu yɛ amɛmli.
Mikɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehã amɛ, ni je lɛ miinyɛ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ.
Mibiii akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ ni oto amɛ shweshweeshwe.
Amɛ jɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mijɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ.
Feem( amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli; owiemɔ lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni otsu mi je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu mitsu amɛ je lɛ mli.
Ni amɛ hewɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mifɔ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni amɛ hu afee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale mli."

"Shi jeee mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛkɛ mibiɔ mahã, shi miibi mahã mɛi ni baahe minɔ aye ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee ekome, tamɔ bɔ ni bo, Ataa, oyɔɔ mimli ni mi hu miyɔɔ omli lɛ, koni amɛ hu amɛfee ekome yɛ wɔmli, ni je lɛ ahe akɛ bo otsu mi.
bɔ ni afee ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee ekome, tamɔ bɔ ni bo, Ataa, oyɔɔ mimli ni mi hu miyɔɔ omli lɛ, koni amɛ hu amɛfee ekome yɛ wɔmli, ni je lɛ ahe aye akɛ bo otsu mi.
Ni anumnyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ, koni amɛfee ekome tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔyɔɔ ekome lɛ.
Miyɛ amɛmli, ni bo hu oyɛ mimli, koni amɛfee ekome kɛwula shi, ni je lɛ ale akɛ bo otsu mi, ni osumɔɔ amɛ tamɔ osumɔɔ mi lɛ.
Ataa, mɛi ni okɛha6 mi lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ he ni miyɔɔ lɛ amɛkɛ mi abahi jɛi, koni amɛna minumnyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ osumɔ mi dani ato je lɛ shishi.
Ataa Jalɔ, je lɛ leee o, shi mi lɛ mile o, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi le akɛ bo otsu mi;
ni mijie ogbɛi lɛ kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni masaa majie lɛ kpo matsuɔ̃ɔ, koni suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi lɛ ahi amɛmli, ni mi hu mahi amɛmli."
18: Be ni Yesu wie nɛkɛ sɔlemɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ je kpo amɛyafo Kedron faa lɛ kɛtee he ni trom ko yɔɔ lɛ ni ekɛ amɛ tee mli.
Shi Yuda, mɔ ni yatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu le jɛi, ejaakɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ fɔɔ kpee yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ Yuda yaŋɔ asraafoi kɛ tsuji kɛjɛ osofonukpai kɛ Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛhiɛhiɛ kanei kɛ hai kɛ awuyeli dadei kɛba jɛi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le nii fiaa ni baa enɔ lɛ, eje kpo ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Namɔ nyɛtaoɔ?"
Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ." Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mi nɛ." Shi Yuda, mɔ ni yatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu kɛ amɛ damɔ shi.
Agbɛnɛ be ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mi nɛ"lɛ, amɛnaa sɛɛsɛɛ ni amɛyagbeegbee shi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ esaa ebi amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Namɔ nyɛtaoɔ?" Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ."
Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miŋ no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji mi nyɛtaoɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa mɛnɛɛmɛi ayaa."
(Ekɛɛ enɛ) koni wiemɔ ni ewie akɛ, "Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mihako amɛteŋ mɔ ko alaaje" lɛ aba mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ simon Petro gbla klaŋte ni ehiɛ lɛ ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ nyɔŋ lɛ ni efo eninejurɔ toi; nyɔŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Malko.
No hewɔ lɛ yesu kɛɛ Petro akɛ, "Kɛ oklaŋte lɛ awo ehebo lɛ mli! Ani kpulu ni mi-Tsɛ kɛhã mi lɛ, mikanu?"
Kɛkɛ ni asraafoi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ Yudafoi lɛ atsuji lɛ mɔ Yesu ni amɛfi lɛ,
ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee Ana ŋɔɔ tsutsu, ejaakɛ Kaiafa ni yeɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ shaanuu ji lɛ.
Shi Kaiafa ji mɔ ni wo Yudafoi lɛ aŋaa akɛ ehi akɛ mɔ kome gboɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ.
Ni Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kroko nyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ. Osɔfonukpa lɛ le nakai kaselɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ Yesu bote osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔ̃ɔ te lɛ mli;
shi Petro damɔ agbo lɛ sɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nakai kaselɔi kroko lɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ le lɛ lɛ je kpo ni eyakɛɛ yoo ni buɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, ni eŋɔ Petro kɛba shīa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ oblayoo lɛ ni buɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ kɛɛ Petro akɛ, "Te bo hu nuu nɛɛ kaselɔi lɛ eko ji o?"Ekɛɛ, "Dabi."
Shi nyɔji lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ damɔ jɛi,amɛkɛ ŋãi esherɛ la, ejaakɛ fɛ̃i miiye ni amɛmiiwere; ni Petro hu akɛ amɛ damɔ shi eewere eko.
Agbɛnɛ osɔfoonukpa lɛ bi Yesu ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ etsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he saji.
Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Faŋŋ miwie mitsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ. Daa nɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, he ni Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ kpeɔ yɛ lɛ, ni miwieee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ dujiaŋ.
Mɛɛba obiɔ mi moŋ? Bi mɛi ni babaoɔ mi toi lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ; naa, mɛnɛɛmɛi le nii ni mikɛɛ."
Be ni Yesu wie nɛkɛ lɛ, tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni damɔ jɛi lɛ gba lɛ ma ni ekɛɛ, "Hetoo ni ohã osofonukpa lɛ nɛ?"
Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, ye efɔŋ lɛ he odase, shi kɛji ekpakpaŋ lɛ, mɛɛhewɔ oyiɔ mi?"
Ni Ana hã akɛ lɛ tee osɔfonukpa Kaiafa ŋɔɔ yɛ kpãa mli.
Shi Simon Petro damɔ shi eewere la lolo. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Te bo hu ekaselɔi lɛ eko ji o?"Petro tso ni ekɛɛ, "Dabida."
Osɔfonukpa lɛ nyɔji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ji mɔ ni Petro fo etoi lɛ wekunyo, kɛɛ, "Ani minaaa okɛ lɛ yɛ trom lɛ mli?"
Ni Petro tso ekoŋŋ, kɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkpla Yesu kɛjɛ Kaiafa ŋɔɔ Kɛtee kojomɔhe lɛ. Ni eshɛ maŋkɛ̃. Ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛboteee kojomɔhe lɛ, koni amɛkabule amɛhe, bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo Hehoo lɛ yeli.
No hewɔ lɛ Pilato je kpo ba amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Mɛɛ naaflɔmɔ nyɛkɛba yɛ nuu nɛɛ he?"
Amɛhere nɔ akɛ, "Jeee efɔŋfeelɔ ji kulɛ, wɔkɛ lɛ ebahaŋ o."
Kɛkɛ lɛ Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛŋɔa lɛ, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyakojoa lɛ yɛ nyɛmla lɛ naa." Ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔgbeɔ mɔ ko;"
koni Yesu wiemɔ ni ewie ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni egbaagbo lɛ aba mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato saa bote kojomɔhe lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni etsɛ Yesu, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ?"
Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiŋ oto owieɔ enɛ nɛɛ, aloo mɛi komɛi gba o nakai yɛ mihe?"
Pilato here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ani Yudafonyo ji mi? Bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋbii kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ o hã mi.Mɛni ofee?"
Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "Mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛɛɛ je nɛɛŋ; mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛ je nɛɛ mli kulɛ misɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ aaaple he, koni akaŋɔ mi ahã Yudafoi lɛ; shi enɛ lɛ, mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛɛɛ biɛ."

No hewɔ lɛ Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, "Belɛ maŋtsɛ ji o kɛ̃?" Yesu here nɔ akɛ, "Okɛɛ; ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ ji mi. Mi lɛ, enɛ hewɔ afɔ mi, ni enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ miba je lɛ mli, koni mibaye anɔkwale lɛ he odase. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ anokwale lɛ mli lɛ nuɔ migbee."
Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ji anɔkwale?" Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, eje kpo kɛtee Yudafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mi lɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko kwraa yɛ ehe.
Shi nyɛyɛ gbɛnaa ko akɛ miŋmɛɔ mɔ kome he mihãa nyɛ yɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mihã nyɛ lo?"
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Jeee mɔnɛŋ, shi Baraba moŋ!" Shi Baraba lɛ, ojotswalɔŋ.
19: Kɛkɛ ni Pilato ŋɔ Yesu ni eyi lɛ kplebii,
ni asraafoi lɛ kɛ ŋmei fee akekre ni amɛkɛfi eyitso, ni amɛwo lɛ atade tsuru ko,
ni amɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, "Hã manye, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ! Ni amɛgbla lɛ mai.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato je kpo ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa, mikɛ lɛ eje kpo kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu je kpo ni ŋmei akekre lɛ fī eyitso ni ewo atade tsuru lɛ. Ni Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa gbɔmɔ lɛ!"
Be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Sɛŋmɔ lɛ, sɛŋmɔ lɛ!"Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋɔa lɛ ni nyɛyasɛŋa lɛ mɔ, ejaakɛ mi lɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe."
Yudafoi lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ mla, ni wɔmla lɛ naa lɛ esa gbele, ejaakɛ efee ehe Nyɔŋmɔ Bi."
Be ni Pilato nu nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ, eshe gbeyei fe tsutsu lɛ;
ni ebote kojomɔhe lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni ebi Yesu hãaa lɛ hetoo.
Ni Pilato kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Okɛ mi ewieee? Ani oleee akɛ miyɛ hegbɛ akɛ miŋmɛɔ ohe, ni mmiyɛ hegbɛ hu akɛ misɛŋɔ o?"
Yesu here nɔ akɛ "Kɛjeee ŋwɛi ajɛ akɛhã o lɛ, kulɛ onaŋ hewalɛ ko yɛ minɔ. No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni jie mi wo odɛŋ lɛ he esha lɛ da fe onɔ lɛ."
Kɛjɛ no nɔ lɛ Pilato tao ehe eŋmɛɛ; shi Yudafoi lɛ blɔ akɛ, "Kɛji oŋmɛɛ mɔnɛ he lɛ, ojeee Kaisare shieŋtsɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ ehe maŋtsɛ lɛ ete shi ewo Kaisare."
Be ni Pilato nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, ekɛ Yesu je kpo, ni eyata kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, yɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ "Yɛkamɔ" ni Hebri wiemɔ mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ "Gabata" lɛ.
Shi Hehoo lɛ Hesaamɔkɛtoo Gbi ni, aaafee shwane ŋmlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli ni. Ni ekɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, Naa nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ!"
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Okɛ lɛ aya, okɛ lɛ aya! Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!" Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ, misɛŋ lɛ lo?" Osɔfonukpai lɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Wɔbɛ maŋtsɛ ko akɛ ja Kaisare."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ lɛ hã amɛ ni ayasɛŋ lɛ. Ni amɛkɛ Yesu tee.
Ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etre esɛŋmɔtso lɛ kɛtee he ni atsɛɔ jɛi Yitsoŋoŋoŋhe ni Hebri mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ "Golgota" lɛ.
Jɛi amɛyasɛŋ lɛ yɛ; ni amɛkɛ mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ fata ehe, mɔ kome yɛ biɛ ni mɔ kome hu yɛ biɛ, ni Yesu yɛ teŋ.
Ni Pilato ŋma nɔ ko ekpɛtɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ yiteŋ; nɔ ni eŋma nɛ, "YESU NAZARENYO, YUDAFOI Lɛ AMAŋTSɛ Lɛ."
Nɛkɛ nii ni aŋma nɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kane, ejaakɛ he ni asɛŋ Yesu yɛ lɛ bɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ; ni aŋma yɛ Hebri kɛ roma kɛ Hela wiemɔ mli.
Ni Yudafoi lɛ asɔfonukpai lɛ kɛɛ Pilato akɛ, "Kaaŋma akɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Miji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ.'"
Pilato here nɔ akɛ, "Nɔ ni miŋma lɛ, miŋma."
Be ni asraafoi lɛ sɛŋ Yesu lɛ, amɛklɔ etadei lɛ, ni amɛja mli ejwɛ, asraafonyo kome nɔ ekome; ni amɛkɔ eflaka lɛ hu. Shi flak lɛ bɛ tsamɔhe; alo kɛkɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi.

No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nyɛkahãa wɔgblaa no, shi nyɛhãa wɔfɔ̃a nɔ osihiki ni wɔna mɔ nɔ ni aaatsɔ̃." Koni ŋmalɛ ni kɛɛ akɛ, "Amɛja mitadei lɛ amli amɛhã amɛhe, ni mihebo lɛ amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oskiki lɛ aba mli. Enɛ ji nɔ asraafoi lɛ fee lɛ."
Shi Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛ nyɛmiyoo, Maria, Klopa ŋa lɛ, kɛ Maria Magbalena damɔ esɛŋmɔtso lɛ masɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu na enyɛ kɛ kaselɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ damɔ shi lɛ, ekɛɛ enyɛ akɛ, "Awo, obi nɛ!"
Fee sɛɛ lɛɛ ekɛɛ kaselɔ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, onyɛ nɛ!" Ni kɛjɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ kaselɔ lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le akɛ agbe nii fɛɛ naa momo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ŋmalɛ lɛ aba mli lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Kumai miiye mi."
Nɔ ma jɛi kɛ emli ashiŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛkɛma hisopotso naa, ni amɛkɛto enaa.
Ni be ni Yesu he ashiŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Agbe naa!" Ni ema eyi shi, ni ebu enaa.

Shi Hesaamɔkɛtoo Gbi ni, ni bɔ ni afee ni amɛgbohii lɛ akahi sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ(ejaakɛ nakai hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ gbi wulu ni) hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ yakpa Pilato fai akɛ akumɔ amɛnaji ni ajie amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ asraafoi lɛ tee, ni amɛyakumɔ mɛi ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ anaji, klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi be ni amɛshɛ Yesu nɔ ni amɛna akɛ egbo momo lɛ, lɛ lɛ amɛkumɔ̃ɔɔ enaji;
shi moŋ asraafoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ akplɔ tsu eŋmawuiaŋ, ni amrɔ lɛ lá kɛ nu jɛ mli ho.
Ni mɔ ni na lɛ, lɛ eye he odase nɛɛ, ni edase lɛ anɔkwaŋ, ni ele akɛ anɔkwale ewieɔ, koni nyɛhe nyɛye.
Ejaakɛ afee nii nɛɛ, koni nɔ ni aŋma akɛ, "Akuŋ ewu ko" lɛ aba mli.
Ni asaŋ ŋmalɛ kroko kɛɛ, "Amɛaakwɛ mɔ ni amɛtsu lɛ nɔ lɛ."

Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yosef ni jɛ Arimatia ni ji Yesu kaselɔ shi Yudafoi lɛ ahemɔ hewɔ lɛ ejieee ehe shi lɛ, yabi Pilato koni ehã eyajie Yesu gbonyo lɛ; ni Pilato ŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ. No hewɔ lɛ etee ni eyajie Yesu gbonyo lɛ kɛtee.
Ni nikodemo, mɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ be ni ebaaba Yesu ŋɔɔ lɛ eba nyɔɔŋ lɛ, hu kɛ "mire" kɛ "aloe" ni afutu aaafee kiloi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ba.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klalai lɛ kɛ tsofãi lɛ fimɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yudafoi feɔ fuɔ mɔ lɛ.
He ni asɛŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ, trom lɛ mli ni atoko mɔ ko yɛ mli pɛŋ;
no hewɔ lɛ amɛyato Yesu yɛ jɛi yɛ Yudafoi lɛ a-Hesaamɔkɛtoo gbi lɛ hewɔ,ejaakɛ gbonyobu lɛ bɛŋkɛ.
20: Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ maŋkɛ mra be ni hiɛ nako agble lɛ, Maria Magdalena ba bu lɛ he, ni ena akɛ ajie tɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni esha foi, ni eba Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kome lɛ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Amɛwo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ mli, ni wɔleee he ni amɛkɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Petro kɛ nakai kaselɔ kome lɛ je kpo, ni amɛyiŋ kɛmiiya bu lɛ he.
Ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo foi; shi kaselɔ kome lɛ ho Petro he, ni lɛ tsutsu eshɛ bu lɛ he;
ni be ni ema eyi shi lɛ, ena klalai lɛ jwere shi, shi eyaaa bu lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Simon nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛba, ni ebote bu lɛ mli, ni ena klalai lɛ jwere shi;
shi duku ni akɛfi eyitso lɛ kãaa klalai lɛ amɛsɛi, shi moŋ akumɔ mli ni ekã he kroko banee.
Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ kaselɔ lɛ ni ba bu lɛ he tsutsu lɛ hu bote mli, ni ena, ni ehe eye;
ejaakɛ kulɛ amɛnuko ŋmalɛ lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ ja ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ shishi lolo.
Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee shīa.
Shi Maria damɔ bu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ eefo. Ni be ni efoɔ lɛ, ema eyi shi ekwɛ bu lɛ mli,
ni ena ŋwɛi bɔfoi enyɔ ni wo atadei yɛji tra shi yɛ he ni kulɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ kã lɛ, mɔ kome yɛ yitsogbɛ ni mɔ kome hu yɛ najishigbɛ.
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Awo, mɛɛba ofoɔ?" Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ejaakɛ amɛwo mi-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛtee, ni mileee he ni amɛkɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ."
Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe ekwɛ esɛɛ, ni ena Yesu damɔ shi, shi eleee akɛ Yesu ni.
Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, "Awo, mɛɛba ofoɔ? Namɔ otaoɔ?" Lɛ lɛ esusu akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ bo owo lɛ kɛje biɛ lɛ, tsɔ̃mɔ mi he ni okɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ, koni mayawo lɛ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Maria!" Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ lɛ yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ, "Rabuni!" (Eshishi ji, Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ")
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaata mihe; miyako ŋwɛi yɛ mi-Tsɛ ŋɔɔ; shi yaa minyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, miiya ŋwɛi yɛ mi-Tsɛ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ."
Maria Magdalena ba ni ebagba kaselɔi lɛ akɛ ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ,ni bɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wie nɛ.

Kɛkɛ lɛ nakai gbi lɛ ni ji otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ gbɛkɛ, be ni Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ lɛ aŋamɔ shinai he ni kasrelɔi lɛ ebua amɛhe naa yŋ lɛ Yesu ba ni ebadamɔ amɛ teŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!"
Ne be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, ekɛ edɛ̃i lɛ kɛ eŋmawuiaŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ na miishɛɛ akɛ amɛna Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ! bɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ! Bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ tsu mi lɛ, nakai mi hu mitsuɔ nyɛ nɛɛ."
Ni be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, emu eshwie amɛnɔ, ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, emu eshwie amɛnɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhea Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!
Mɛi ahe eshai ni nyɛkɛaafa amɛ lɛ, akɛfa amɛ; ni mɛi ahe eshai ni nyɛkɛaato lɛ, akɛto."
Shi Toma, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo(eshishi ji, "haaji") lɛ, bɛ amɛteŋ ni Yesu ba lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kaselɔi kromɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔna Nuŋtsɔ lɛ." Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ja mina miwao ewo plɛkoobii lɛ anajiaŋ, ni mikɛ minine ehɔ eŋmawuiaŋ lɛ, dani mahe maye."
Ni gbii kpaanyɔ sɛɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yɛ tsu mli, ni Toma hu yɛ mli. Ni aŋamɔ shinai lɛ ni Yesu ba, ni ebadamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!"
No sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ Toma akɛ, "Okɛ owao aba biɛ ni obakwɛ midɛ̃ lɛ mli, ni okɛ onine abahɔ miŋmawuiaŋ lɛ, ni okaje ŋwane, shi moŋ ohe oye."
Toma here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mi-Nuŋtsɔ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Toma, ni ona mi hewɔ lɛ, ohe oye; ajɔɔ mɛi ni enaaa ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛhe amɛye lɛ."
Agbɛnɛ naakpɛɛ okadii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni Yesu fee yɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ahiɛ ni aŋmaaa yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli;
shi enɛɛmɛi lɛ aŋma koni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Yesu ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ni kɛ nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ, nyɛaana wala kɛtsɔ̃ egbɛi lɛ nɔ.
21: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yesu saa jie ehe kpo ekoŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ yɛ Tiberia ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Ni bɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɛ.
Simon Petro kɛ Toma ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo lɛ, kɛ Natanael ni jɛ Kana yɛ Galilea lɛ, kɛ Zebedeo bii lɛ, kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ hu yɛ he kome kutuu.
Simon Petro kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miiya wuo." Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔ hu wɔkɛ o miiya." Amɛyiŋ ni amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ amɛbeee nɔ ko.
Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, Yesu badamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, shi kaselɔi lɛ leee akɛ lɛ ni.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, "Bi, nyɛyɛ niyenii ko lo?" Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Dabi."
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfɔ̃a yaa lɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ ninejurɔ gbɛ, ni nyɛaana nɔ ko." Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ̃, ni loi lɛ afalɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛanyɛɛɛ yaa lɛ amɛgbla.
No hewɔ lɛ kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ Petro akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni." Be ni Simon Petro nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni lɛ, ekɛ etade lɛ ŋmɔ ehɛ, ejaakɛ eta shi yayai, ni etu egbee ŋshɔ lɛ mli.
Shi kaselɔi krokomɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ lɛlɛ bibioo lɛ mli kɛba, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ jekɛɛɛ, shi aaafee ninetalɔ oha loo nɔ kɛkɛ, ni amɛmiigbla yaa lɛ kɛ loo lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛkpleke lɛ, amɛbana ŋãi kɛ la yɛ jɛi, ni loo jwre nɔ, kɛ aboloo.
Yesu kɛɛ akɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ loo ni nyɛgbe bianɛ lɛ eko abaa."
Simon Petro tee lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni eyagbla yaa lɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ kɛ emli loo wuji obɔ̃,oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ ni loo lɛ fa nɛkɛ moŋ, shi kɛlɛ yaa lɛ gblaaa.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa nyɛbakpaa nyɛnaa nɔ ko." Ni kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ bimɔ akɛ, "Namɔ ji o?" Ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Nuŋtso lɛ ni.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu ba ni ebakɔ aboloo lɛ, ni ekɛhã amɛ, kɛ loo lɛ hu. 14 Enɛ ji shiiɛtɛ̃ ni Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ.
Be ni amɛye nii lɛ tã lɛ, Yesu bi Simon Petro akɛ, "Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi fe mɛnɛɛmɛi lo?" Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ o." Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Lɛɛ miitoobii lɛ!"
Esaa ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ akɛ, "Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi lo?"Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ o." Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ mitoi lɛ!"
Ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ akɛ, "Oosumɔ mi lo?" lɛ; ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ole nii fiaa, ole akɛ miisumɔ o." Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Lɛɛ mitoi lɛ!
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ o akɛ, be ni oji oblanyo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ omīaa ni onyiɛɔ he ni osumɔɔ; shi kɛ ogbɔ lɛ, oookpã oniji amli, ni mɔ kroko aaamīa o, ni ekɛ o aaatee he ni osumɔɔɔ."
Shi ekɛɛ enɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni Petro baagbo kɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam. Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!"
Shi be Petro tsɔ̃ ehe lɛ, ena kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ; lɛji mɔ ni kpasa Yesu tsitsi yɛ niyenii lɛ ashii ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ namɔ baatsɔ̃ɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ?"
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Petro na lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ "nuŋtsɔ, shi mɔnɛ hu?"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe? Bo lɛ nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni wiemɔ nɛɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ akɛ nakai kaselɔ lɛ gboŋ; tsɛ Yesu ekɛɛɛ lɛ akɛ egboŋ, shi moŋ ekɛɛ, "Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe?"?"
Mɔnɛ ji kaselɔi ni yeɔ nii nɛɛ ahe odase lɛ, ni lɛ eŋma ni nɛɛ, ni wɔle akɛ edase lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.
Shi nii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni Yesu fee, ni kɛji, misusumɔ akɛ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋ woji ni kulɛ aaaŋma lɛ eto.

1: Gbi ko lɛ Yehowa kɛ Yona, Amitai bi lɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ Yona akɛ,
"Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli koni oyashiɛ oshi maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni emli bii lɛ feɔ lɛ miina fɛɛ."

Shi be ni Yona yi mli lɛ, ewo ehiɛ ema Spain gbɛ moŋ. Eyiŋtoo ji akɛ eejo Yehowa tsumɔ lɛ naa foi. Etee Yopa; eyana lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Spain. No hewɔ lɛ ewo lɛlɛ lɛ mlitamɔ he nyɔmɔ, kɛkɛ ni ebote mli koni ekɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli bii lɛ aya Spain, koni ejo foi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Shi Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni naa wa jogbaŋŋ tswa yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ. Ahum fã waa, ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni lɛlɛ lɛ baajwa.

Amlakui lɛ she gbeyei, kɛkɛ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ blɔ etsɛ nɔ ni ejaa akɛ ebahere amɛ. Fee sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ jie lɛlɛ lɛ mli jatsu lɛ amɛwo ŋshɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni lɛlɛ lɛ afee huyɛhuyɛ ahã amɛ. Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yona etee lɛlɛ lɛ shishigbɛ eyakã shi, ni lɛ lɛ, ewɔ vii diɛŋtsɛ.
Lɛlɛtsɛ lɛ yana Yona yɛ eshikamɔhe lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ataa, bo lɛ wɔɔ owɔɔ lo? Tee shi ni osɔle otsɛ nɔ ni ojaa akɛ aleeenɔ emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ wɔhe koni ebahere wɔ koni wɔhiɛ akakpãtã lo.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔfɔ̃a oshiki kɛtao mɔ koome hewɔ ni nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ." Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki lɛ; ni oshiki lɛ gbee Yona nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ gbaa wɔ. Te bo ohewɔ jɛ ni oshrã nɛɛ fɛɛ ebashrã wɔ nɛɛ? Mɛni otsuɔ? Nɛgbɛ ojɛ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ? Mɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ojɛ, ni mɛɛ maŋ nɔ fɔmɔbi ji bo?"
Yona jie naa akɛ, "Hebrinyo ji mi; ni Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi ni lɛ ebɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ fɛɛ lɛ mijaa."
Be ni Yona egba amɛ akɛ eejo foi yɛ Yehowa tsumɔ naa lɛ, amlakui lɛ she gbeyei jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ Yona akɛ, "Mɛni ofee nɛɛ?"
Nakai be mli fɛɛ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ miiya nɔ eefee hãmãhãmã sɔŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, "Mɛni kɛ̃ wɔfee bo, ni eeeha ŋshɔ lɛ aŋmɛ ahã wɔ?"
Yona hã hetoo akɛ, "Nyɛwoa mi, ni nyɛshɛa mi nyɛfɔa ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni ŋshɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ ahã nyɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ mi mihewɔ ni nɛkɛ ahum kpeteŋkple nɛɛ tswaa nyɛ nɛɛ."
Amlakui lɛ mia amɛhiɛ amɛwiri kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ; shi amɛnyɛɛɛ ejaakɛ ŋshɔ lɛ tee nɔ efee hãmãhãmã ekpee amɛ.
Enɛ hã amlakui lɛ sɔle amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Yehowa, wɔmiikpa bo fai, kaahã wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ nuu nɛɛ wala hewɔ. Ela yi sɔ̃ akatere wɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔle akɛ bo lɛ, ofeɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ wo Yona, ni amɛshɛ lɛ amɛfɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ.
Amlakui lɛ she Yehowa gbeyei bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehã amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, asaŋ mɛi wowoo shii srɔtoi hu.
Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ, ŋshɔŋloo kpeteŋkple ko mi Yona, ni Yona hi loo nɛɛ musuŋ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃.
2: Yona yɛ ŋshɔŋloo lɛ musuŋ, kɛkɛ ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai,
ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ, miblɔ mitsɛ Yehowa, ni ehere mi nɔ; miblɔ kɛjɛ gbohiiaje musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ, ni Yehowa, obo migbee toi.
Oshɛ mi ofɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtee ŋshɔ shishi tɔ̃ɔ, ni nu babaoo bɔle mihe kɛkpe; ni oshɔkei kɛ omlɛ̃mɛ̃i lɛ kumɔ shwie minɔ.
Misusu akɛ ashwie mi kɛje ohiɛ, ni te mafee tɛŋŋ mana o-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ?
Nu lɛ su mi, ni mitsui bɔ̃i suu; ŋshɔ lɛ su mi emuu, ni wosuma bla miyitso fɛɛ.
Mikpleke shi kɛtee gɔji ashishitoo hei diɛŋtsɛ po, shikpɔŋ ni enaa agboi lɛ sa miyi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ. Shi Yehowa, mi Nyɔŋmɔ, ohere miyiwala kɛjɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni misusuma tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ, mikai Yehowa, ni misɔle, ni onu misɔlemɔ lɛ yɛ o-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mɛi ni jaa yaka amãgãi lɛ, amɛyeee bo anɔkwa.
Shi mi lɛ, mala makafo bo, ni mashã afɔle mahã bo; shi ni miwo lɛ, maye nɔ. Yiwalaheremɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa fã ŋshɔŋ loo lɛ, ni eyashwe Yona eŋmɛ shikpɔŋ.
3: Yehowa kɛ Yona wie ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli, koni okɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ ayahã amɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yona te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Nineve yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa. Nineve lɛ maŋ kpeteŋkple jogbaŋŋ ni, ejaakɛ ayeɔ gbii etɛ̃ dani anyiɛɔ kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ krotia kome kɛyashɛɔ ekrotia kroko.
Yona je shishi koni etsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli kɛho. Be ni enyiɛ gbi kome gbɛ lɛ, ewo eshiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, biɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, abaabutu Nineve."
Ninevebii lɛ he Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ amɛye; ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛfã akɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ wulu nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ bibioo nɔ lɛ, ahi ŋmaa, ni abu kpekpe kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ.
Be ni Nineve maŋtsɛ lɛ nu wiemɔ lɛ, ete shi yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni ejie etaade fɛɛfɛo ni ewo lɛ yɛ ehe efɔ̃ shi, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eho eta lamlu mli.
Ewo akpɔ, ni ehã ashiɛ yɛ Nineve maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, "Nii Maŋtsɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ miiwo akpɔ akɛ,'Gbɔmɔ jio, kooloo jio, tsina kɛ too hu, amɛteŋ ekoeko akasa enaa nɔ ko; akaye nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ, akanu nu hu;
shi moŋ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ abu kpekpe, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asɔle kɛ hiɛdɔɔ atsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; asaŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsake ejeŋba gbonyo lɛ, ni akpa yitsoŋwalɛ sane ni akɛyeɔ mɛi lɛ,
akɛ aleeenɔ Yehowa hu aaatsake eyiŋ ni eto lɛ, ni eeeŋmɛɛ emli ni efu waa lɛ he, ni no aaahã wɔhiɛ akakpãtã lo!'"
Nyɔŋmɔ na nɔ ni Ninevebii lɛ fee lɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛjeŋba fɔŋ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hu ŋmɛɛ efɔŋ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee amɛ lɛ he, ni egblaaa amɛtoi.
4: Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fee yɛ Ninevebii ahe lɛ eŋɔɔɔ Yona naa kwraa, ni efee lɛ mlifu tete.

No hewɔ lɛ esɔle, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Yehowa, ani jeee nɔ ni mikɛɛ be mli ni miyɔɔ mimaŋ lɛ eba mli nɛɛ? Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni mijɛ mra mijo foi kɛmiiya Spain lɛ. Ejaakɛ mile akɛ bo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ drolɔ kɛ musuŋtsɔ̃lɔ ji bo; omli fuuu mra, ni omɔbɔnalɛ fa, ni otsakeɔ oyiŋtoo yɛ toigblamɔ he.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, Yehowa, foo miwala nɔ ohã mi, ejaakɛ faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ fe nɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ."
Yehowa bi Yona akɛ, "Kolɛ omli ni ewo la nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yona shi Nineve maŋ lɛ mli. Etee ni eyafee asese fioo ko yɛ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni eho eta eshishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli koni emɛ kɛyashi eeena nɔ ni baaba maŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa hã adedeŋkruma ko kwɛ̃, ni eha Yona yiteŋ koni ehã lɛ hɔɔŋ koni efo ehehiamɔ lɛ sɛɛ ehã lɛ. Yona na adedeŋkruma lɛ he miishɛɛ naakpa.
Shi gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã gɔgɔmi baye adedeŋkruma lɛ, ni egbe lɛ.

Ni be ni hulu te shi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni mli edɔ batswa, ni Yona tɔ biti yɛ hulu ni shã epampam lɛ naawalɛ hewɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Yona shwe gbele, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ fe nɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ."
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, "Kolɛ omli ni ewo la yɛ adedeŋkruma lɛ he nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?" Yona here nɔ akɛ, "Eja gbɛ akɛ mimli awo la bɔ sɔŋŋ po ni kɛji gbele tete lɛ magbo."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yona akɛ, "Adedeŋkruma lɛ ni gbi kome nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ ni ekwɛ̃, asaŋ ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ ehiɛ ekpãtã, tso ni ogboko ehe deŋme ko, ni jeee bo hu ohã ekwɛ̃ lɛ, esane miidɔ bo.
Mɛɛba esaaa akɛ mi lɛ Nineve sane adɔ mi, maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛkɛ kɛ emli gbɔmɛi fe akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko kɛ emli toi kɛ tsinai babaoo hu lɛ?"

1: Yehowa tsulɔ Mose gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ni lɛji Mose sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ akɛ,
"Mitsulɔ Mose egbo, no hewɔ lɛ saamɔ ohe koni bo kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ afo Yordan Faa nɛɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.
He fɛɛ he ni nyɛnane shi aaasa lɛ mikɛhã nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo minaa shi mihã Mose lɛ.
"Nyɛhusu ji kɛjɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛ nɛkɛ Lebanon gɔji nɛɛ ahe kɛyashi faa wulu ni ji Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, kɛtsɔ̃ Hitbii ashikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛyashi Mediterenia ŋshɔ lɛ naa yɛ anaigbɛ fɛɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ ohiɛ adamɔ owalagbii abɔ fɛɛ. Bɔ ni mikɛ Mose hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ bo aaahi shi; mishiŋ o, ni mikwaŋ o hu.
Wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa; ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã maŋbii nɛɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ehe kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ, bo obaahã etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
"Bo lɛ wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ; asaŋ ojwɛŋ nɔ, ni oye mla ni mitsulɔ Mose wo bo lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Kaagba afã kɛmiiya ninejurɔ loo abɛku bɔ ni afee ni oye omanye yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ofeɔ mli.

Kaahã nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ miikpa yɛ odaaŋ; shi jwɛŋmɔ he be fɛɛ be, nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane, ni ojwɛŋ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni ohiɛ ahi ohe nɔ, ni ofee bɔ ni aŋma yɛ mli lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejaakɛ no baahã oshwere.
Ani jeee mi mifã o? Wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa. Kaahã ŋmiiŋmi miimɔ bo, ni asaŋ otsui akafã ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mifī osɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa."
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua fã maŋ lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ,

"Nyɛkpaa maŋ lɛŋ koni nyɛwoa maŋbii lɛ shi. Nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛtaoa gbɛ nɔ niyenii nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, nyɛbaafo Yordan Faa nɛɛ koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ.'"
Agbɛnɛ Yoshua kɛɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛkaia wiemɔ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛ nyɛ wie akɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã nyɛ he ko ni nyɛaajɔɔ nyɛhe yɛ; ni ekɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baakɛ nyɛ.
Nyɛbaashi nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛbifaabii kɛ nyɛkooloi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Mose kɛhã nyɛ yɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ; shi nyɛteŋ hii fɛɛ ni eshɛ tayaa amia kɛnyiɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ahiɛ koni nyɛye nyɛbua amɛ,

kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaahã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu ana he ko ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ehã nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ, be mli ni amɛ hu shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa amɛ aaashɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ. No sɛɛ dani nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba nyɛshikpɔŋ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛhã nyɛ yɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbahi nɔ."
Maŋbii lɛ to he amɛhã Yoshua amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni owo wɔ ehe kitã lɛ wɔɔfee, ni he fɛɛ he ni oootsu wɔ lɛ wɔɔtee.
Bɔ ni wɔbo Mose toi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔɔbo bo hu toi. Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, kɛ bo ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ Mose hi shi lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatse ohiɛ atuã, ni efeee nɔ ni ofã akɛ efee lɛ, aaagbe lɛ. Bo lɛ wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ."
2: Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, tsu hii enyɔ nigīi kɛjɛ Shitim koni amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa nyɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛbaa, shi titri lɛ Yeriko." Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛyato yoo ajwamaŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Rahab lɛ we.
Ni atee ayakɛɛ Yeriko maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii komɛi eba biɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ koni amɛbasra shikpɔŋ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yeriko maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu kɛtee Rahab ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, jiemɔ hii lɛ ni ba oŋɔɔ ni amɛbato owe lɛ kɛba, ejaakɛ amɛba koni amɛbasra shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ."
Shi Rahab kɛ hii enyɔ lɛ tee, ni ekɛɛ bɔfoi ni atsu lɛ akɛ, "Eji anɔkwale akɛ hii komɛi ba miŋɔɔ; shi mileee he ni amɛjɛ.
Be ni je na ni abaaŋã maŋ agbo lɛ, kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ je kpo; shi moŋ mileee he ni amɛtee; nyɛtiua amɛ mramra, ni nyɛbaanina amɛ."
Shi no mli lɛ Rahab eŋɔ̃ egbɔi lɛ eyatee tsei ni akɛ amɛhe toto feɔ kpãa shishi yɛ etsu lɛ yiteŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ tiu hii lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Yordan Faa lɛ naagbɛ kɛtee faafoohe lɛ tɔ̃ɔ. Amrɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ je kpo pɛ, ni aŋã maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ.
Rahab gbɔi enyɔ lɛ nako amɛkamɔ shi, ni etee amɛŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ,
ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mile akɛ Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ehã nyɛ, ni nyɛhe ŋmiiŋmi emɔmɔ wɔmaŋbii fɛɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ejijaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ;
ejaakɛ wɔnu bɔ ni Yehowa hã ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli nu lɛ gbi yɛ nyɛhiɛ be ni nyɛshi Egipt lɛ. Asaŋ wɔnu bɔ ni nyɛfee Amorbii amaŋtsɛŋmɛi enyɔ, ni Sihon kɛ Og, ni Yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ musumusu nyɛhã lɛ.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔnu saji nɛɛ lɛ, wɔtsui fã, ni shi ofɔ shi nuu fɛɛ nuu nɔ yɛ nyɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛji ŋwɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔŋwɛi shishi lɛ nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, nyɛkɛ Yehowa akãa mi kitã akɛ gbii abɔ ni mifee nyɛ ejurɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛbaafee mitsɛ we lɛ ejurɔ nakai nɔŋŋ; ni nyɛbaato mi okadi krɛdɛɛ ko,
ni nyɛbaahere mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi hii kɛ minyɛmimɛi yei kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ayiwala koni nyɛjie wɔ kɛje gbele mli."
Hii lɛ wo Rahab shi amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔwala lɛ owala ni. Kɛji nyɛjieee wɔ shi lɛ, no lɛ kɛji Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hã wɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ bo aaaye yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ anɔkwale naa."
Kɛkɛ ni Rahab shiu hii lɛ kɛ taŋkpee kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ mli kɛyimɔ shi, ejaakɛ Rahab shīa lɛ ama akpɛtɛ maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ, ni jɛi Rahab yɔɔ.

Rahab kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa gɔji lɛ anɔ koni mɛi ni atsu akɛ amɛyatao nyɛ lɛ kɛ nyɛ akakpe. Nyɛtea nyɛhe yɛ jɛi gbii etɛ̃ kɛyashi mɛi ni etiu nyɛ lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba; no sɛɛ dani nyɛyi gbɛ nyɛya."
Hii lɛ kɛɛ Rahab akɛ, "Wɔbaaye kitã ni ohã wɔkã bo nɛɛ nɔ.

Naa, kɛji wɔbashɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, okɛ kpãa tsuru faa nɛɛ afi samflɛ ni okɛ wɔ tsɔ̃ mli kɛyimɔ shi lɛ he. Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ ohã otsɛ kɛ onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ otsɛ we lɛŋ bii fɛɛ ababua amɛhe naa yɛ oŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ owe lɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko aaaje kpo yɛ owe lɛŋ ayi blohu lɛŋ lɛ, mɔ lɛ lá abua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ, ni eyi sɔ̃ ko treee wɔ. Shi kɛji mɔ ko yɛ oŋɔɔ yɛ owe lɛŋ, ni mɔ ko nine ta ehe lɛ, no lɛ no sɔ̃ lɛ atre wɔ.
Shi kɛji oyajie wɔ shi lɛ, no lɛ wɔhe eje kitã ni ohã wɔkã bo nɛɛ mli."
Rahab kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ nɛɛ aba mli nakai." Kɛkɛ ni ewo hii lɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee; ni Rahab fī kpãa tsuru lɛ etsotsro samflɛ lɛ he.

Hii lɛ shwie nɔ kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni amɛhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃ kɛyashi mɛi ni atsu akɛ amɛtiu amɛ lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba. Mɛi ni tiu hii lɛ tao Israelbii ni atsu lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, shi amɛnaaa amɛhe okadi ko kwraa.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii abɔfoi enyɔ lɛ kpleke gɔ̃ŋ lɛ, ni amɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛba Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba lɛ saji ni ba amɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Amɛkɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Yehowa etu shikpɔŋ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ lɛɛlɛŋ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ejijaa yɛ wɔhewɔ."
3: Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛ̃ɛ fã kɛjɛ Akasia shitoohe lɛ, ni amɛba Yordan Faa lɛ naa. Amɛwɔ yɛ jɛi dani amɛfo faa lɛ.
Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ maŋnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kpa shitoohe lɛ mli,

ni amɛwo maŋbii lɛ shi amɛkɛɛ, "Kɛji nyɛna osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levibii lɛ, tre Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛho pɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfãa kɛjɛa hei ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ koni nyɛnyiɛa sɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna he ni gbɛ lɛ kã, ejaakɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ko gbɛ nɛɛ nɔ dã.
Kɛ̃lɛ gbɛ akã nyɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ teŋ, gbɛ ni kɛji asusu lɛ aafee ninetalɔi akpei enyɔ; nyɛkabɛŋkɛa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ."
Yoshua kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsua nyɛhe ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ Yehowa baafee naakpɛɛ nii yɛ nyɛteŋ."
Ni ekɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwoa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ koni nyɛkɛnyiɛa maŋ lɛ hiɛ." Osɔfoi lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni amɛkɛnyiɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Mibabɔ̃i ohiɛ nyamwoo kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛkɛna amɛle akɛ bɔ ni mikɛ Mose hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ bo hu baahi shi.
Wo osɔfoi ni tre Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kitã akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛyanina Yordan Faa lɛ, nyɛwaa nyɛdamɔa faa lɛ mli.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua tsɛ maŋbii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsia nyɛbaa biɛ koni nyɛbaboa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi."

Be ni maŋbii lɛ tsi ba lɛ, Yoshua kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Enɛ nyɛkɛaale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni akɛ shwiemɔ eeeshwie Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Girgashbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ Kɛaaje nyɛhiɛ.
Naa, shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miitsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛmiiho kɛmiiya Yordan mli.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhalaa hii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛjɛa Israel akutsei lɛ amli, no ji akutso fɛɛ akutso ahã nuu kome.

Ni naa, amrɔ pɛ ni osɔfoi ni tere Yehowa, ni ji shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, Adeka lɛ anaji aaasa Yordan mli nu lɛ mli lɛ, ni lɛ aaakpa hoo, ni nu ni jɛɔ yiteŋgbɛ baa lɛ baawa, ni eeema shi tamɔ gbogbo."
Lɛɛlɛŋ be ni maŋbii lɛ famɔ amɛbuui lɛ koni amɛyafo Yordan lɛ, ni osɔfoi tre Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛnyiɛ amɛhiɛ,
ni mɛi ni tre Adeka lɛ bashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa, ni osɔfoi lɛ ni tre Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ anaji na sa nu lɛ mli pɛ (ejaakɛ Yordan lɛ jeɔ ŋã nikpamɔ be mli fɛɛ),

kɛkɛ ni nu ni jɛ yiteŋgbɛ baa lɛ wa, ni ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, yɛ Adam ni ji maŋ ko ni bɛŋkɛ Zaretan lɛ he. Kɛkɛ ni nu ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaboteɔ Araba ŋshɔ, ni ji ŋoo ŋshɔ, lɛ mli lɛ tã, ni esɛɛ fo kwraa. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fo faa lɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ tuuŋtu.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfoɔ faa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ ni tre Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ wa damɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ yɛ Yordan teŋ tuuŋtu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ fo faa lɛ tã.
4: Be ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ efo Yordan Faa lɛ etã lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ,
"Halamɔ hii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛjɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, akutso fɛɛ akutso lɛ nuu kome,
koni ofã amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛholea tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yordan teŋ he ni osɔfoi lɛ anaji mãmɔ lɛ koni nyɛtre kɛfo mli kɛya he ni nyɛyaato ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ, nyɛkɛyamãmɔshi yɛ jɛi.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua tsɛ hii nyɔŋmɔ kɛ enyɔ ni ehala yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, akutso fɛɛ akutso lɛ eŋɔ̃ nuu komɛ yɛ mli,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsɔ̃a Yehowa Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛyaa Yordan teŋ, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo tɛ kome atswa ekɔŋ yɛ Israelbii akutsei lɛ ayibɔ naa.
Enɛ afee okadi ahã nyɛ koni wɔsɛɛ ko kɛji nyɛbii bi nyɛ akɛ, 'Te nɛkɛ tɛi nɛɛ ashishi hulɛ,'
nyɛjie naa nyɛhã amɛ akɛ, 'Yordan Faa lɛŋ nu lɛ sɛɛ fo yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ be ni akɛfo Yordan lɛ.' No hewɔ lɛ tɛi nɛɛ baaatsɔ̃ kaimɔ nɔ ahã Israelbii kɛya naanɔ."

Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ ni Yoshua fã amɛ lɛ: Amɛhole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ teŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ akutsei lɛ ayibɔ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua lɛ. Amɛtre tɛi nɛɛ kɛba he ni Israelbii lɛ to shi yɛ gbi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ tɛi lɛ bamamɔ shi yɛ jɛi.
Yoshua diɛŋtsɛ hu hole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ komɛi emãmɔ shi yɛ Yordan teŋ he ni osɔfoi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ anaji mãmɔ lɛ. Tɛi nɛɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

Osɔfoi lɛ ni tre Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ wa damɔ shi yɛ Yordan teŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fã Yoshua akɛ ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ koni afee lɛ naa, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose fã Yoshua lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Israelbii lɛ ahe fee oya kɛfo lɛ.
Be ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ efo faa lɛ etã lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hu fo, kɛkɛ ni amɛyi maŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manase akutso lɛ fã lɛ mīa kɛnyiɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛfo mli tamɔ bɔ ni Mose fã amɛ lɛ.
Hii aaafee akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni esaa amɛhe kɛhã ta nyiɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛtee ta yɛ Yeriko ŋã kplanaa lɛ nɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ Yehowa wo Yoshua hiɛ nyam etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii fɛɛ, ni amɛshe Yoshua gbeyei ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ tamɔ amɛshe Mose gbeyei lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ,
"Fã osɔfoi ni tre Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ akɛ amɛje Yordan Faa lɛ mli."
No hewɔ lɛ Yoshua fã osɔfoi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjea Yordan lɛ mli!"
Be ni osɔfoi lɛ ni tre Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ je Yordan lɛ mli, ni amɛnaji sa shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni Yordan mli nu lɛ yiridi kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni esram nɔ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ fo Yordan lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyato shi Gilgal yɛ Yeriko bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ.
Yoshua kɛ tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni ahole yɛ Yordan lɛ mli lɛ mãmɔ shi yɛ Gilgal nɛɛ,
kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛbii aaabi nyɛ wɔsɛɛ ko akɛ, 'Te nɛkɛ tɛi nɛɛ ashishi hulɛ,'
nyɛgbaa nyɛbii lɛ akɛ, 'Israel nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo Yordan nɛɛ,'
ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ hã Yordan mli nu lɛ gbi hã nyɛ kɛyashi bɛyinɔ ni nyɛfo nyɛtã tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ, be ni ehã egbi ehã wɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔfo wɔtã lɛ,
koni je lɛŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Yehowa yɛ hewalɛ, koni nyɛshe Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei kɛya naanɔ."
5: Be ni Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan sɛɛ yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii amaŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔnaa lɛ nu akɛ Yehowa hã Yordan lɛ mli nu lɛ gbi kɛyashi Israelbii lɛ fo faa lɛ tã lɛ, amɛtsui fã, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mli ekãa laaje yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahewɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Feemɔ tɛ kaklai koni oflɔ Israelbii lɛ ketia."
Yoshua fee tɛ kaklai lɛ, ni ekɛflɔ Israelbii ketia yɛ Gibeat Haaralot (eshishi ji Ketia Foohe).
Nɔ hewɔ ni Yoshua flɔ Israelbii lɛ ketia lɛ nɛ: Israelbii ni shi Egipt lɛ ateŋ hii fɛɛ, ni ji tabilɔi lɛ, egboi yɛ gbɛteŋ yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ be ni ajɛ Egipt abaa lɛ.
Hii fɛɛ ni shi Egipt lɛ aflɔ amɛ ketia momo; shi mɛi fɛɛ ni afɔ yɛ gbɛteŋ be ni ajɛ Egipt abaa lɛ, aflɔko amɛ ketia.

Israelbii nyiɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ kɛyashi maŋ lɛ mli hii tabilɔi ni fata he be ni ashi Egipt lɛ fɛɛ gboi, ejaakɛ amɛbooo Yehowa toi; ni no hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kã amɛ kitã akɛ ehaŋ amɛna shikpɔŋ lɛ ni, lɛ Yehowa ekã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ehe kitã akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ, ni ji shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ abii ni ebaye amɛsɛɛ lɛ, amɛji mɛi ni Yoshua fo amɛ ketia nɛɛ, ejaakɛ foolɔi ji amɛ, akɛni aflɔko amɛ ketia lɛ.
Beni afo maŋ lɛŋ hii fɛɛ ketia lɛ agbe naa lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ hi shi yɛ shitoohe ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ kɛyashi hii lɛ ahe tã.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ bi nɛɛ, mifɔ nyɛhe muji ni awo yɛ Egipt lɛ mishwie." No hewɔ ni atsɛɔ shitoohe nɛɛ akɛ Gilgal kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ Gilal lɛ, amɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋã kplanaa lɛ nɔ.
Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ gbi lɛ tuuŋtu nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii: Amɛye ma akpiti aboloo kɛ able fɔ ni ashã.
Ni gbi ni amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii lɛ eko lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ pɛ kɛkɛ ni mama lɛ sɛɛ fo, ni Israelbii lɛ naaa mana dɔŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii ji nii amɛye nakai afi lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yoshua ebɛŋkɛ Yeriko lɛ, gbi ko trukaa eyaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, naa nuu ko damɔ ehiɛ ni egbla eklaŋte ehiɛ. Yoshua tsi bɛŋkɛ nuu lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Wɔgbɛfaŋ oyɔɔ aloo wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ?"
Nuu lɛ to he ekɛɛ, "Dabi; miba akɛ Yehowa ta lɛ nɔ tatsɛ." Kɛkɛ mi Yoshua kɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni eja lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni minuŋtsɔ kɛɔ etsulɔ?"
Yehowa ta lɛ nɔ tatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Jiemɔ otokota lɛ yɛ onane, ejaakɛ he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni." Ni Yoshua fee nakai.
6: Be nɛɛ mli lɛ aŋã Yeriko maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa kpɛŋŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ hewɔ: Mɔ ko mɔ ko ejɛɛɛ mli ejeee kpo lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko hu eyaaa mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Naa, mibahã oye Yeriko kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ehii kãkãlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim.
Bo kɛ hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔlea Yeriko maŋ lɛ kɛkpea, shi kome daa gbi. Nyɛfea nakai kɛyashia gbii ekpaa.
Osɔfoi kpawo ahiɛ bɛji kpawo ni akɛ ojwɛni akloŋto fee kɛnyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ. Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛbɔlea maŋ lɛ shii kpawo be mli ni osɔfoi lɛ miikpã bɛji lɛ.

Kɛji amɛkpã ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji lɛ, ni nyɛnu gbɛɛmɔ lɛ ni esɛɛ tsɛ kakadaŋŋ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ abɔ oshe waa, ni maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ baagbee shi shwɛtɛɛ, koni Israel tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli."
Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, tsɛ osɔfoi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwoa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni nyehãa osɔfoi kpawo ahiɛa ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji kɛnyiɛa Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ."
Ni Yoshua kɛɛ maŋ lɛ hu akɛ, "Nyɛfãa kɛhoa, ni nyɛbɔlea maŋ lɛ kɛkpea, ni nyɛhãa tabilɔi lɛ anyiɛa Yehowa Adeka lɛ hiɛ."
Be ni Yoshua kɛ maŋ lɛ wie lɛ, osɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji kpawo lɛ fo mli kɛho yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛyi hiɛ, ni amɛmiikpã bɛji lɛ, ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Tabilɔi lɛ nyiɛ osɔfoi ni kpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni tabilɔi lɛ ekomɛi hu nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ sɛɛ. Be ni anyiɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ belɛ aakpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ.
Shi Yoshua wo maŋ lɛ shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkabɔa oshe, ni nyɛkahãa anua nyɛhe ni anyɛmiiwe kɛyashi gi nɔ ni makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛbɔ oshe lɛ; no dani nyɛbɔ oshe."
Yoshua hã akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bɔle Yeriko maŋ lɛ shi kome, ni asafo lɛ ba amɛshitoohe lɛ mli, ni amɛbawɔ jɛi.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Yoshua te shi leebi maŋkpa, kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ,

ni osɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛɔ ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, yi mli ni amɛmiikpã bɛji lɛ; hii tabilɔi lɛ nyiɛ osɔfoi ni kpãa bɛji lɛ ahiɛ, ni ta ni nyiɛɔ sɛɛ lɛ nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ sɛɛ. Be mli ni anyiɛ kɛyaa lɛ bɛlɛ aakpã bɛji lɛ.
Gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ hu Israelbii lɛ bɔle maŋ lɛ shi kome kɛkɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛshitoohe lɛ mli. Nɛkɛ sɔŋŋ amɛfee kɛyashi gbii ekpaa.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, asafo lɛ te shi mra hiɛ futɛfutɛ mli be ni je bɔ̃i tsɛremɔ, ni amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ bɔ ni amɛfeɔ daa lɛ shii kpawo. Nakai gbi lɛ kɛkɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ shii kpawo.
Shibɔlemɔ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ be ni osɔfoi lɛ ekpã bɛji lɛ, Yoshua kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbɔa oshe! Shi Yehowa kɛ maŋ lɛ eke nyɛ tswaa.
Maŋ lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, akpãtã hiɛ ahã Yehowa, ja Rahab, yoo ajwamaŋ lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ eŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ ewe lɛ; amɛ kɛkɛ yi abaa, ejaakɛ Rahab ji mɔ ni kɛ bɔfoi lɛ ni wɔtsu lɛ tee.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia kɛkɛ yɛ musunii lɛ ahewɔ, koni nyɛkakɔa eko ni nyɛkɛloo musu koni kɛtsɔ̃ no nɔ lɛ nyɛhã Israel asafo muu lɛ hu loo musu, ni ehã amane ba Israel nɔ.
Shi moŋ jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ kɛ shika fɛɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ akɔɔble loo dade fee lɛ, ajɔɔ nɔ ahã Yehowa, ni no hewɔ lɛ aloo ni akɛba Yehowa nitoohe lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ bɔ oshe, ni akpã bɛji lɛ. Be ni asafoi lɛ nu bɛji lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ, amɛbɔ oshe kpeteŋkple. Kɛkɛ ni Yeriko maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ gbee shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ bote maŋ lɛ mli, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ni amɛŋɔ̃ maŋ lɛ.
Amɛkpãtã maŋ lɛŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hiɛ yɛ klaŋte naa, hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai, kɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tejii fɛɛ.
Yoshua kɛɛ hii enyɔ lɛ ni etsu kɛtee amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa yoo ajwamaŋ lɛ shīa lɛ koni nyɛyaŋɔa lɛ kɛ ehe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ eŋɔ̃ɔ kɛjea kpo tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkã lɛ kitã lɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ oblahii lɛ ni tee nigii amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ bote maŋ lɛŋ, ni amɛyaŋɔ Rahab kɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ ewekumɛi fɛɛ kɛje kpo kɛba, ni ahã amɛ he ko ni amɛhi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Israelbii lɛ shã Yeriko maŋ lɛ kɛ emli nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ja jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ nibii ni akɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade fee kɛkɛ. Nomɛi lɛ amɛtee amɛkɛyawo Yehowa we lɛ nitoohe lɛ.
Yoshua here Rahab, yoo ajwamaŋ lɛ, kɛ etsɛ we lɛ kɛ emɛi fɛɛ ayiwala, ni Rahab yahi Israelbii ateŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; ejaakɛ lɛji mɔ ni kɛ bɔfoi ni Yoshua tsu, ni amɛyasra Yeriko lɛ tee.

Ni Yoshua kã amɛ kitã yɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, "Mɔ ni aaate shi akɛ ebaasaa Yeriko maŋ nɛɛ ema lɛ, alomɔ lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Ekɛ ekromɔbi wala baatse nitsumɔ lɛ shishitoo, ni ekɛ ebi sɛɛkpelɔ wala baatse maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ tramɔ."
Yehowa bu Yoshua he, ni no hewɔ lɛ egbɛi hehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
7: Israelbii lɛ tɔ̃, ni amɛyayeee kɔkɔ ni abɔ amɛ yɛ musunii lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Akan, ni ji Zabdi bi Karmi bi lɛ, ni jɛ Zera we yɛ Yuda akutso lɛŋ lɛ, kɔlɔ musunii lɛ eko. Enɛ hã Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua tsu hii kɛjɛ Yeriko koni amɛya Ai maŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Betaven masɛi yɛ Betel bokãgbɛ lɛ. Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyasraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛkwɛa." Hii nɛɛ tee ni amɛyasra Ai,
ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba, ni amɛbakɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Kaahã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miiya; wo hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ kɛkɛ gbɛ kɛya ni amɛyatua Ai. Kaahao maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ amɛya ejaakɛ Aibii lɛ ayi faaa kwraa."
No hewɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ kɛkɛ yi mli kɛtee, shi amɛyanyɛɛɛ Aibii lɛ ahiɛ amɛdamɔ.

Aibii lɛ gbe Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa. Aibii lɛ wo Israelbii lɛ foi kɛjɛ Ai maŋ agbo lɛ naa kɛtee Shebarim, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ be ni amɛkplekeɔ jɔɔ lɛ. Sane nɛɛ hã Israelbii lɛ atui fã, ni amɛhe jɔ tamɔ nu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kɛ dɔlɛ gbala amɛhe atadei, ni amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteiaŋ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛi bumɔ shi yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ;
ni Yoshua kɛɛ akɛ, "Ao! Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni hewɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fo Yordan lɛ kɛba? Koni okɛ wɔ abawo Amorbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛkpãtã wɔhiɛ? Wɔle nɛkɛ kulɛ wɔkplɛ̃ ni wɔhi Yordan lɛ sɛɛ kɛkɛ.
Ao! Nuŋtsɔ, te makɛɛ tɛŋŋ be ni Israel enaa sɛɛsɛɛ yɛ ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ baanu he, ni amɛaaba amɛbabɔle wɔ kpula, ni amɛbaakpãtã wɔhiɛ butuu. No hewɔ lɛ te ofeɔ tɛŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ hu?"
Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Tee shi; mɛni hewɔ ni okɛ ohiɛ ebu shi?
Naa, Israel etɔ̃ minɔ; amɛgbo toi, ni kɔkɔ ni mibɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛyayeee nɔ, ni amɛkɔlɔ musunii lɛ eko tete amɛkɛfutu amɛnibii amli; ni asaŋ amɛju, ni amɛmale hu.
"No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ahiɛ amɛdamɔ, amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã amɛhenyɛlɔi, ejaakɛ amɛloo musu. Mikɛ nyɛ ehiŋ shi dɔŋŋ ja nyɛjie musunii lɛ yɛ nyɛnibii amli nyɛshwie.

Tee shi; tsuumɔ maŋbii lɛ ahe. Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛtsua nyɛhe nyɛkɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛtoa wɔ', ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Israelbii, nyɛkɔlɔ musu nibii lɛ eko, no hewɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ nyɛdamɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaajie musunii lɛ nyɛshwie.'
