2: Agbɛnɛ Yehowa bɔfo jɛ Gilgal kɛba Bokim ni ebakɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ Egipt ni mikɛnyɛ ba shikpɔŋ ni mikã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛɛ: 'Mikuŋ mikpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko,
ni nyɛ hu nyɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko; amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ nyɛkumɔa.' Shi nyɛbooo mifãmɔ lɛ toi. Mɛni nyɛfee nɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ mi hu nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji mishwieŋ amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, shi moŋ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛ tsɔne."
Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ wie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ atoiŋ lɛ, maŋ lɛ wo yara amɛfo.
Amɛwo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Bokim, ni amɛshã shãa afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa yɛ jɛi.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Yoshua wo maŋ lɛ gbɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ayanɔ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Maŋ lɛ sɔmɔ Yehowa gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni Yoshua yɔɔ lɛ, kɛ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni onukpai ni hi shi yɛ Yoshua gbele sɛɛ ni amɛna Yehowa nitsumɔi wuji fɛɛ ni etsu ehã Israel lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Yehowa tsulɔ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, gbo be ni eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma.
Afu lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Timnat-Heres yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ Gaash gɔŋ lɛ kooyigbɛ.
Nakai yinɔbii lɛ hu fɛɛ gboi, ni yinɔ kroko ba yɛ amɛsɛɛ ni amɛleee Yehowa aloo nitsumɔi ni etsu ehã Israel lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Amɛkwa Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni ji amɛhewɔhewɔ maji lɛ a-nyɔŋmɔi lɛ asɛɛ. Ni amɛwo Yehowa mli la.
Ni amɛfɔ̃ɔ Yehowa jamɔ, ni amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ Astarte nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli wo Isrealbii lɛ la ni ehã ofɔ̃yelɔi baye amɛ ofɔ̃. Asaŋ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ wo amɛhenyɛlɔi ni bɔle amɛ kɛkpe lɛ ahewalɛ shishi, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ amɛdamɔ dɔŋŋ.
He fɛɛ he ni Isrealbii lɛ aaafã ta kɛaatee lɛ, Yehowa kɛ amɛ yeɔ kɛ joomɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ kɛ bɔ ni ekã amɛ kitã lɛ. Enɛ hã efi Israelbii lɛ waa naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tee ta hiɛnyiɛlɔi ashi. Amɛ amɛhereɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ mɛi ni bahaa amɛnibii kɛyaa lɛ adɛŋ.

Shi amɛhiɛyiɛlɔi lɛ hu amɛbooo amɛ toi, ejaakɛ amɛjeɔ Yehowa sɛɛ amɛyanyiɛɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ ni amɛjaa amɛ. Etsɛɛɛ kɛkɛ lɛ amɛŋmɛɛ shihilɛ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hi ni amɛye Yehowa kitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ he; amɛ lɛ amɛyeee kitãi lɛ anɔ.

Be fɛɛ be ni Yehowa aaatee hiɛnyiɛlɔi ashi ehã Israelbii lɛ, Yehowa yeɔ ebuaa hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ni amɛhereɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ ŋtsɔi ni Israelbii lɛ dɔmɔɔ yɛ mɛi ni waa amɛ yi kɛ mɛi ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ dɔɔ Yehowa.

Shi kɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ gbo pɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛjeŋba fiteɔ fe amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete yɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ ni amɛyanyiɔ ni amɛsɔmɔɔ amɛ, ni amɛjaa amɛ lɛ hewɔ. Amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ nibii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ, ni amɛkpaaa amɛkuɛŋtimɔ jeŋba lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli woɔ la woɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, "Akɛni nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ etɔ̃ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ni miwo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ akitã yɛ he lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbooo mi toi,
hewɔ lɛ mi hu kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ mishwieŋ jeŋmaji ni shwɛ be ni Yoshua gbo lɛ ekoeko yɛ amɛhiɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛ maji nɛɛ baaka Israel makwɛ akɛ amɛaajwɛŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ akɛ amɛhi shi lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ jwɛŋ nɔ lɛ lo, aloo amɛ lɛ amɛfeŋ nakai."
No hewɔ ni Yehowa shi nakai jeŋmaji lɛ, ni eshwieee amɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ, ni ehãaa Yoshua aye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ.
3: No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa shi jeŋmaji komɛi koni ekɛka Israelbii fɛɛ ni leee Kanaan tai lɛ ahe nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ ekwɛ.
Efee enɛ bɔ ni afee kɛkɛ ni Israelbii ayinɔi lɛ, titri lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi ni wuko ta dã lɛ, ale ta he nɔ ko ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tawuu.

Jeŋmaji ni ashi lɛ ji Filistibii alumɛi enumɔ lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Hivbii ni yɔɔ Lebanon gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ Baal-Hermon gɔŋ lɛ he kɛyashi he ni gɔji ateŋ gbɛ ni akɛyaa Hamat lɛ kã lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ashi jeŋmaji nɛɛ ni akɛ amɛ aka Israelbii lɛ akwɛ akɛ amɛaaye Yehowa kitãi ni etsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ lo.
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ hi Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ateŋ.
Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ abiyei; amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛbiyei hãahãa Israelbii lɛ abihii agblã; ni Israelbii lɛ sɛ̃mɔ jeŋmaji nɛɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ amɛshi Yehowa. Amɛhiɛ kpa Yehowa, amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ Ashera nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli wo Israelbii lɛ ala, ni ehã Mesopotamia maŋtsɛ Kushan-Rishataim ye amɛnɔ kunim ni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ afii kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ blɔ tsɛ Yehowa, ni etee herelɔ ko shi ehã amɛ, ni ehere amɛ. Lɛji Otniel, Kaleb nyɛmi gbekɛ Kenaz bi lɛ.
Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bayi Otniel nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ. Efã ta, ni Yehowa hã enine tsɔ̃ Mesopotamia maŋtsɛ Kushan Rishataim lɛ nɔ ni eye enɔ kunim.
No hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ Otniel, Kenaz bi lɛ gbo.
Israelbii lɛ saa fee efɔŋ ekoŋŋ amɛshi Yehowa. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã Moab maŋtsɛ Eglon na hewalɛ fe Israelbii lɛ.
Eglon bua Amonbii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii lɛ anaa eshi enɔ, ni eba ebaye Israelbii lɛ anɔ yɛ ta mli. Eŋɔ Yeriko, tɛŋ maŋ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ sɔ̃mɔ Moab maŋtsɛ Eglon afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ blɔ tsɛ Yehowa, ni etee yiwalaherelɔ shi ehã amɛ. Lɛji Ehud, Gera Benyaminnyo lɛ bi lɛ, abɛkulɔ ni. Israelbii lɛ tsu lɛ ekɛ nikeenii tee yahã Moab maŋtsɛ Eglon.
Ehud sɔ̃ klaŋte kɛ enaa nta. Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome. Ehud kɛfi enanejurɔ shuɔ yɛ etade lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ nikeenii lɛ yahã Eglon, Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ. Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ eshwi naakpa.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Ehud kɛ nikeenii lɛ ehã Eglon etã lɛ, Ehud wo mɛi ni tere nikeenii lɛ agbɛ ni amɛtee.

Shi Ehud diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eku esɛɛ yɛ he ni tɛ amããi ni yɔɔ Gilgal lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Ni ebakɛɛ, "Nii maŋtsɛ, miyɛ teemɔŋ sane ko ni mibagba o." Kɛkɛ ni Eglon kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjea kpo nyɛshia wɔ!" Kɛkɛ ni Eglon tsuji lɛ fɛɛ gbla amɛhe shi.
Be ni Eglon kome too ta shi yɛ eŋwɛitsu ni ehereɔ kɔɔyɔɔ yɛ mli lɛ mli lɛ, Ehud tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ Eglon akɛ, "Mihiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa wiemɔ ko ni mibakɛɛ o." Kɛkɛ ni Eglon te shi yɛ esɛi lɛ nɔ.
Ehud kpã enine abɛku lɛ mli, ni efã klaŋte lɛ yɛ nanejurɔ shuɔ lɛ he, ni ekɛdu Eglon musuŋ.
Klaŋte lɛ tso lɛ nyiɛ dade lɛ sɛɛ kɛbote emusuŋ. Fɔ batsī dade lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ Ehud gblaaa klaŋte lɛ kɛjɛɛɛ Eglon musu mli, shi klante lɛ yaje kpo yɛ esɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ehud je kpo kɛtee ablanaa lɛ nɔ. Eŋãmɔ shinai lɛ ewo Eglon yi, ni eŋmlɛ mli.
Be ni Ehud eje kpo etee lɛ, tsuji lɛ ba; ni be ni amɛna akɛ aŋãmɔ ŋwɛitsu lɛ shinai lɛ amɛsusu akɛ, "Benɛ etee niiasɛɛ yɛ kɔɔyɔɔheremɔ tsu lɛ mli."
Amɛmɛ aahuu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he dɔŋŋ. Shi be ni egbleee shinai lɛ lolo lɛ, amɛyakɔ samfee lɛ. Be ni amɛgble shinai lɛ, naa amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ kã shikpɔŋ ni egbo!
Be ni amɛlilaa shi lɛ Ehud ejo foi etee momo. Efoŋ yɛ tɛ amãgãi lɛ ahe, ni ejo foi kɛtee Seira.
Be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, ekpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ lɛ kpleke shi gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ, ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ.

Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛnyiɛa misɛɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baahã nyɛye nyɛhenyɛlɔi Moabbii lɛ anɔ kunim." No hewɔ lɛ amɛkpleke shi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ. Amɛŋɔ Yordan faafoohei ni atsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛyaa Moab lɛ, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni efoɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ gbe Moabbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi aaafee akpei nyɔŋma, hii hewalɔi sɔŋŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko naaa hegbɛ ajo foi.
Nakai gbi le aba Moab shi awo Israel shishi. Enɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.
Hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni ba ye Ehud sɛɛ ji Shamar, Anat bi lɛ. Ekɛ tsinakplamɔ tso gbe Filistibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ohai ekpaa, ni lɛ hu ekɛhere Israelbii lɛ.
4: Ehud gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ ekoŋŋ amɛshi Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa hã Yabin, Kanaan maŋtsɛ, ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Hazor lɛ ye amɛnɔ kunim. Etatsɛ ji Sisera, ni yɔɔ Jeŋmaji Haroshet lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ blɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa koni eye ebua amɛ, ejaakɛ Yabin yɛ dade tayaa shwiilii ohai nɛɛhu, ni ewa Israelbii lɛ ayi waa naakpa afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, gbalɔ yoo Debora, Lapidot ŋã lɛ, ji Israelbii lɛ akojolɔ.
He ni etaa ji tɛŋtso lɛ shishi yɛ Rama kɛ Betel teŋ, yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ. Israelbii lɛ yaa eŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi ni eyeɔ amɛteŋ saji ehãa amɛ.

Debora tsu ayakpee Barak, Abinoam bi lɛ, kɛjɛ Kadesh ni yɔɔ Naftali lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Fãmɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fãa bo nɛ: 'Yaaŋɔ hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛjɛ Naftalibii kɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ateŋ ni ofãta kɛya Tabor gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Makpla Sisera, Yabin tatsɛ lɛ, kɛ eshwiilii kɛ etabilɔi babaoo lɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ yɛ Keshon Faa lɛ naa, ni mibahã oye enɔ kunim.'"
Barak kɛɛ Debora akɛ, "Kɛji okɛ mi aaatee lɛ, ni lɛ matee; shi kɛji okɛ mi eyaaa lɛ, no lɛ miyaaa."
Debora kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ o aaatee, kɛ̃lɛ nɔ ni oyaa oyatsu nɛɛ mli anumnyam lɛ efeŋ onɔ; ejaakɛ yoo ko ji mɔ ni Yehowa baahã eye Sisera nɔ kunim. "Kɛkɛ ni Debora te shi ni ekɛ Barak tee Kadesh.
Barak hã ayakpee Zebulonbii kɛ Naftalibii kɛba Kadesh; ni hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ lɛ ka nane kɛtee. Debora hu kɛlɛ tee.
Shi Heber, Kennyo lɛ, etse ehe yɛ Kenbii ni ji Mose shaanuu Hobab shwiei lɛ ahe, ni eyashi ebuu lɛ yɛ tso kple ni ma Zaananim ni yɔɔ Kadesh masɛi lɛ he tɔ̃ɔ.
Be ni ayatswa Sisera adafi akɛ Barak, Abinoam bi lɛ, efã ta kɛtee Tabor gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
Sisera bua edade tayaa shwiilii ohai nɛɛhu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋbii amaŋ Haroshet kɛba Kishon Faa lɛ naa.

Kɛkɛ ni Debora kɛɛ Barak akɛ, "Tee shi, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ ji gbi ni Yehowa baahã oye Sisera nɔ kunim. Ani jeee Yehowa efã kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ?" No hewɔ lɛ Barak kpleke shi kɛjɛ Tabor gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Hii akpei nyɔŋma lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Yehowa hã Sisera kɛ eta lɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ Barak klaŋte naa. Kɛkɛ ni Sisera yi shi yɛ eshwiilii lɛ mli, ni ejo foi yɛ enane naa.
Barak kɛ emɛi lɛ tiu shwiilii lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ kɛtee Jeŋbii amaŋ Haroshet lɛ, ni Sisera tabulɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klaŋte naa; eshwɛɛɛ mɔ kome nɛkɛ flo.
Shi Sisera jo foi yɛ enane naa kɛtee Yael, Kennyo Heber ŋã lɛ buu lɛ mli; ejaakɛ Toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ Yabin, Hazor maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ Heber, Kennyo lɛ, we lɛ teŋ.
Yael je kpo ekɛ Sisera yakpe ni ekɛɛ Sisera akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, gba kɛba miŋɔɔ; kaashe gbe yei!" No hewɔ lɛ Sisera gba kɛtee Heber ŋã lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ buu lɛ mli, ni Yael kɛ Saanɔ bo ha Sisera nɔ.
Sisera kɛɛ Yeal akɛ, "Ofai nɛ ni ohã mi nu fioo manu, shi kumai miiye mi." No hewɔ lɛ Heber ŋã lɛ gble fufɔ wolotɔ naa, ni ehã lɛ eko enu. Kɛkɛ ni eha Sisera nɔ.
Sisera kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, "Daamɔ buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi. Kɛ mɔ ko ba ni ebi o akɛ, 'Ani mɔ ko yɛ biɛ lo? lɛ, okɛɛ mɔ lɛ akɛ, Dabi!'"

Shi Yael, Heber ŋã lɛ, kɔ buu he shiŋmlitso, ni ekɔ hamle ehiɛ edɛŋ. Edɛkɛ shi kɛtee Sisera ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ shiŋmlitso lɛ yaka etoi shi kɛyamɔ shikpɔŋ, ejaakɛ etɔ Sisera ni ewɔ vii. No hewɔ lɛ Sisera gbo.

Be ni Barak tiuɔ Sisera lɛ, Yael je kpo ekɛ Barak yakpe ni ekɛɛ Barak akɛ, "Ba, ni mikɛ nuu lɛ ni otaoɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ o." Be ni Barak tee Yael buu lɛ mli lɛ, naa Sisera ni ekã shi ni egbo, ni shiŋmlitso lɛ tsɛkɛ etoi shi.
No hewɔ lɛ nakai gbi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hã Israelbii lɛ ye Kanaan maŋtsɛ Yabin nɔ kunim.
Israelbii lɛ hãaa Yabin, Kanaan maŋtsɛ lɛ, ana mumɔ he kɛ ta kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
5: Kɛkɛ ni Debora kɛ Barak, Abinoam binuu lɛ, la nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ akɛ,
"Akɛni tatsɛmɛi nyiɛ Israel ta lɛ hiɛ, ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ here amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛboa toi! Nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi! Nyɛfea toi! Nyɛ lumɛi! La mala, saŋku matswa mahã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa.
Yehowa, be ni ojɛ Seir obaa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ŋwɛi tsere nu shwie shi, Be ni ofã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Edom ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ! Hɛɛ, tue kɛjɛ atatuiaŋ shwie shi.
Gɔ̃ji lɛ hoso yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu Sinai fee yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.
"Shamar, Anat bi lɛ, yinɔ, Yael be lɛ mli lɛ, jrayeli gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kã eflo, ni gbɛnyiɛlɔi juɔ shi nyiɛɔ.
Mɛi ahe sɛ̃ yɛ Israel maji lɛ amli. Amɛhe sɛ̃ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni bo Debora, ote shi akɛ nyɛ Awo yɛ Israel.
Amɛhala nyɔŋmɔi hei, kɛkɛ ni ta shɛ agboi lɛ anaa, anãaa tsɛŋ loo akplɔ ko yɛ hii akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ dɛŋ yɛ Israel.
Mina Israel tatsɛmɛi lɛ ahe tsui, kɛ mɛi ni here amɛhe yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
"Nyɛgbaa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtra tejii yɛji anɔ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtra kuŋtui fɛfɛji anɔ, kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni atswaa saŋku yɛ nuyɛɛhei lɛ, amɛaagba Yehowa kunim lɛ, Israel okwaafoi akunim lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mɛi lɛ kpleke shi kɛjɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli.
Tee shi, Debora! Tee shi! Wo ohe nɔ, Barak, okɛ onomii lɛ aya, tee shi, tee shi, la lala ko, bo Abinoam bi!
Kɛkɛ ni abladei lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kpleke shi. Yehowa mɛi lɛ kpleke shi yɛ Yehowa hewɔ amɛyanina kãkãlɔi lɛ.
Efraim amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ kɛtee jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni bo Benyamin, amɛnyiɛ bo kɛ owekumɛi lɛ asɛɛ, tatsɛmɛi lɛ kpleke shi kɛjɛ Makir kɛba, ni Zebulon ji he ni tatsɛmɛi nukpai lɛ jɛ kɛba.

Isakar lumɛi lɛ fata Debora he kɛba, Isakar ni yeɔ Barak anɔkwa, amɛsha foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ kpaakpa kɛtee jɔɔ lɛ mli; shi Ruben mli egba. Amɛyiŋ fee amɛ kɔshikɔshi. Amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ amɛfee akɛ amɛmiiba.
Mɛɛba omɛɔ yɛ toiatsui lɛ ateŋ, ni oboɔ bɛlɛ ni akɛtsɛɔ toi lɛ toi? Ruben akutso lɛ mli egba, amɛyiŋ fee amɛ kɔshikɔshi.
Gilead ta shi yɛ Yordan sɛɛ, mɛɛba Dan mɛɔ yɛ lɛji lɛ amli? Asher esɛ̃ koniŋŋ kɛta ŋshɔ lɛ naa, eta ŋshɔ blei lɛ anaa.
Zebulon ji maŋ ni kɛ ehe wo oshrã kɛ gbele mli, Naftali hu nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ.
"Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ba amɛbawu ta. Amɛkɛ Kanaan maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ bawu yɛ Taanak yɛ Megido fai lɛ anaa; shi amɛnaaa jwiɛtɛi ko amɛhã.
Ŋulamii jɛ ŋwɛi wu, amɛjɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ amɛkɛ Sisera wu.
Kishon faa lɛ loo amɛ kɛtee, faa ni keɔ kɛbaa, Kishon Faa lɛ. Misusuma, fãa nyiɛmɔ kɛ hewalɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni okpɔŋɔ akoklotoi lɛ shimɔ shi waa, kɛ hurumɔ ni ekpɔŋɔi lɛ huruɔ kɛ foi lɛ.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ, 'Nyɛlomɔa Meroz, nyɛlomɔa emli bii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbafataaa Yehowa he, amɛbafataaa Yehowa he yɛ kãkã lɔi lɛ ateŋ.'
Ajɔɔ Yael yɛ yei fɛɛ ateŋ, Kennyo, Heber ŋã lɛ. Ajɔɔ lɛ fe yei ni hiɔ buui amli lɛ fɛɛ.
Eba nu, ni ehã lɛ fufɔ. Ekɛ fufɔ hiɛ fɔ bahã lɛ, yɛ abladei akpulu mli.
Ekpã enine mli ekɔ shiŋmlitso. Ekɛ eninejurɔ kɔ nitsulɔi ahamle, ni ekɛka etoi shi. Etswa Sisera nɔ ni ejwra eyitso wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ;
eyrɔde, ni egbee shi, ekã shi ni etsiii ehe yɛ Yael naji anaa; enajianaa eyrɔde yɛ, ni egbee shi lɛ. He ni eyrɔde yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ egbee shi yɛ ni enyɔ.
"Sisera nyɛ miifli samflɛ lɛ mli, eekwɛ nii kɛmiitsɔ̃ samflɛ fɔji lɛ amli. Mɛɛba eshwiilii lɛ baa lɛ sɛɛ etsɛ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba ekpɔŋɔi lɛ akoklotoi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ ekpe sɛɛ nɛkɛ?
Yei ni yɔɔ ehe lɛ ateŋ nilelɔi lɛ to he hã lɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu eto he ehã ehe akɛ;

'Amɛna haanii ko kɛ̃ ni amɛmiija, nuu fɛɛ nuu aaana oblayoo kome loo enyɔ tete; bɛ mi, Sisera, hu mana haanii lɛ amli mamai ni awo amɛ tsofã? Mamai enyɔ ni awo amɛ tsofã, ni alo nii awo mli koni mikɛha mikuɛ?'
Yehowa, bɔ nɔŋŋ ni ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã nɛ! Shi mɛi ni sumɔɔ o lɛ aaatãmɔ hulu, be ni eteɔ shi yɛ ehewalɛ mli lɛ." No sɛɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
6: Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ amɛshi Yehowa. No hewɔ lɛ ehã Midianbii ye Israelbii lɛ anɔ afii kpawo.
Midianbii lɛ anineshi wa naakpa yɛ Israelbii lɛ anɔ. Midianbii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tao bui yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ tɛkploi kɛ mɔji amɛhã amɛhe.
Kɛji Israelbii lɛ du nii lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Midianbii kɛ Amalekbii kɛ bokã gbɛbii lɛ efã kɛbatua amɛ.
Amɛbɔɔ nsra amɛwoɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛfiteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii lɛ kɛyashiɔ Gaza kpokpai anɔ tɔ̃ɔ. Amɛshiii niyenii ko aloo too loo tsina loo teji yɛ Israel.
Ejaakɛ amɛbaa kɛ amɛkooloi kɛ amɛbuui. Amɛbaa babaoo tamɔ baalabii; ni amɛ kɛ amɛyoomai lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ akane. Amɛbaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbakpãtãa hiɛ.
Midianbii lɛ hã Israelbii lɛ ahewalɛ nɔ gbɔ kwraa. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ blɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa.
Be ni amɛblɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ Yehowa yɛ Midianbii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ,
Yehowa tsu gblaɔ ko kɛba maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Miŋɔ nyɛ kɛjɛ Egipt kɛba, ni mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɔŋyeli mli.
Ni mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ Egiptbii lɛ adɛŋ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni waa nyɛyi lɛ adɛŋ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni waa nyɛyi lɛ adɛŋ; ni mishwie amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni miŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mihã nyɛ.
Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miji Yehowa nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi nyɛkashea Amorbii ni yɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ gbeyei.' Shi nyɛbooo migbee toi."
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ba ebata Yoash, Abiezernyo lɛ, blɔfo yɔɔyitso ni yɔɔ Ofra lɛ shishi. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Yoash bi Gideon lɛ miigbee ŋmãa yɛ wainbu mli, bɔ ni afee ni Midianbii lɛ akana.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Gideon ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuu kãkãlɔ, Yehowa kɛ o yɛ."

Gideon kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, minuŋtsɔ, kɛ Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ? Nɛgbɛ enaakpɛɛnii lɛ fɛɛ ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gbaa wɔ ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Ani jeee Egipt Yehowa jie wɔ kɛjɛ' lɛ yɔɔ? Ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ Yehowa eshɛ wɔ efɔ̃, ni eŋmɛɛ wɔhe ehã Midianbii lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã Gideon ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa kɛ ohewalɛ nɛɛ koni oyahere Israel yɛ Midianbii lɛ adɛŋ! Miji mɔ ni tsuɔ o lɛ?"
Gideon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, minuŋtsɔ, te mafee tɛŋŋ manyɛ mahere Israel lɛ? Naa, miweku lɛ ji weku ni bɛ hewalɛ fe fɛɛ yɛ Manase, ni mi, miji bibioo fɛ fɛɛ yɛ mitsɛ we lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mibaye mabua o, ni ooogbe Midianbii lɛ butuu tamɔ agbeɔ mɔ kome."
Gideon kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ kɛ ona mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ, no lɛ hã mi okadi ko akɛ bo okɛ mi wieɔ nɛɛ.
Ofai nɛ, kaaje biɛ kɛyashi be ni maba mikɛ nikeeni aaabama ohiɛ." Yehowa to he akɛ; "mahi shi kɛyashi be ni oooku osɛɛ oba."
No hewɔ lɛ Gideon tee ni eyasaa abotiabi. Ekɛ ma kiloi nyɔŋma fee akpītī. Ekɛ loo lɛ wo kafu mli ni ekɛ ehe nu lɛ wo kukwɛi mli. Ekɛ je kpo kɛba bɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ tso lɛ shishi, ni ekɛbama ehiɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "okɛ loo lɛ kɛ akpītī lɛ ashwie tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, ni ofɔse ehe nu lɛ oshwie nɔ."

Gideon fee nakai. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kpã edɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tso lɛ naabu sa loo lɛ kɛ akpītī lɛ he. La jɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli ni ebashã loo lɛ kɛ akpītī lɛ wɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ laaje yɛ Gideon hiɛ.
Be ni Gideon yoo akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni lɛ, ekɛɛ, "ao, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ! Yehowa bɔfo pam mina hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ!"
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "na tsui, kaashe gbeyei, ogboŋ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa, ni etsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ji hejɔlɛ." Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɛ Ofra ni ji Abiezerbii a-Ofra lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.

Nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "Yaaŋɔ otsɛ tsina nuu nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, ni eye afii kpawo lɛ, koni oyakumɔ Baal afɔleshãa latɛ ni ji ostɛ nɔ lɛ. Asaŋ foo nyɔŋmɔ yoo Ashera tso ni ma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi lɛ.

Maa afɔleshãa latɛ ohã yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ tɛsaa ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ yiteŋ. Too tɛi ni okɛbaama lɛ gbɛjianɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ ato lɛ; koni oŋɔ tsina nuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, ni okɛshã shãa afɔle. Okɛ Ashera tso ni obaafo lɛ afe lai ni okɛshã."
No hewɔ lɛ Gideon ŋɔ etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma, ni efee bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ lɛ. Shi akɛni eeshe etsɛ we lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ gbeyei hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ efee nii nɛɛ shwane, shi moŋ nyɔɔŋ efee.

Shi be ni maŋbii lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa lɛ, naa Baal afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni akumɔ ashwie shi; afo Ashera tso ni ma emasɛi lɛ, ni akɛ tsina nuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ eshã shãa afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ama lɛ nɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ bibii amɛhe akɛ, "Namɔ yɛ nɛkɛ sane?" Be ni amɛtao mli ni amɛbi mli lɛ!, akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni ye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ Yoash akɛ, "Jiemɔ obi lɛ kɛba ni agbe lɛ; ejaakɛ ekumɔ Baal afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni efo Ashera tso ni ma emasɛi lɛ."

Shi Yoash bi mɛi fɛɛ ni ebakpe ewo ehe lɛ akɛ, "ani nyɛ nyɛbaabe nyɛhã Baal lo? Aloo nyɛ nyɛbaafã Baal he? Mɔ ni baabe ahã Baal lɛ, aaagbe lɛ dani je aaatsɛre. Kɛ nyɔŋmɔ ji Baal lɛ efã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yɛ efɔleshãa latɛ ni akumɔ lɛ hewɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ nakai gbi lɛ awo Gideon gbɛi akɛ, "Yerubaal", eshishi ji "Baal kɛ lɛ atswa, ejaakɛ ekumɔ efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Midianbii kɛ Amalekbii kɛ bokãgbɛbii lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa. Amɛfo Yordan faa lɛ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Yezreel jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Shi Yehowa mumɔ lɛ bayi Gideon nɔ. Gideon kpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ ekɛtsɛ Abiezerbii lɛ koni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Etsu kɛtee Manase fɛɛ ni ayakpee amɛ hu koni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ. Etsu kɛtee Asher kɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali; ni amɛba koni amɛkɛ lɛ ayakpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Kɛji minine nɔ obaatsɔ̃ ohere Israel tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ,
mikɛ gwaŋtɛŋ wolo baaha ŋmãashaahe lɛ. Kɛji bɔ nyɔ wolo lɛ kome kɛkɛ nɔ, shi shikpɔŋ muu fɛɛ egbi lɛ, no lɛ mana male akɛ minine nɔ obatsɔ̃ ohere Israel tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ."
Eba mli nakai. Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Gideon te shi leebi mra. Eŋã toowolo lɛ mli, ni nu ni eŋã yɛ mli lɛ fee tsene obɔ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Omli akafu mi; mawie shi kome nɛɛ pɛ. Miikpa o fai, hã maka shi kome hu makwɛ: Hã wolo lɛ kɛkɛ agbi shi bɔ anyɔ shikpɔŋ lɛnɔ fɛɛ."
Nyɔŋmɔ hã eba mli nakai yɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli; wolo lɛ kɛkɛ gbi, shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, bɔ enyɔ.
7: Kɛkɛ ni Yerubaal ni ji Gideon lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ te shi leebi maaŋkpa, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Harod nubu lɛ naa. Midianbii atabilɔi lɛ jwere jɔɔ lɛ ni kã More gɔŋkpɔ lɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ mli.
Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "Mɛi ni fata ohe lɛ ayi fa tsɔ̃ hã mi bɔ ni matsɔ̃ amɛnɔ mahã oye Midianbii lɛ anɔ kunim, koni Israel akabashwã etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ, 'Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ mikɛhere miyiwala.'

No hewɔ lɛ, abɛnɛ, hã ashiɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ toiŋ akɛ, 'Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ gbeyei ni ŋmiŋmi emɔ lɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ eya shīa.'" Gideon ka amɛ ekwɛ ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ ku amɛsɛɛ, ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋma hi shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "Mɛi lɛ ayi fa tsɔ̃ lolo. Okɛ amɛ akpleke shi kɛya nu lɛ he, ni maka amɛ yɛ jɛi mahã o. Mɔ ni makɛɛ o yɛ ehe akɛ, 'Okɛ mɔnɛ akaya lɛ,' Okɛ lɛ akaya."

Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛ mɛi lɛ kpleke shi kɛtee nu lɛ he. Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ elilɛi aaalɛmɔ nu lɛ tamɔ gbei lɛmɔɔ nu lɛ, akɛ lɛ adamɔ afã; ni nakai nɔŋŋ ofee mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakula enakutsei anaa ni eeenu nu lɛ."
Mɛi ni kɛ amɛnine to amɛnaa ni amɛlɛmɔ lɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ ji mɛi ohai etɛ̃; shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ kula amɛnakutsei anaa amɛnu nu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "Hii ohai etɛ̃ ni lɛmɔ nu lɛ mikɛaahere nyɛ, ni mahã nyɛye Midian nɔ kunim; shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ aya; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya eshīa."
No hewɔ lɛ Gideon he nu kpuji lɛ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ yɛ mɛi ni hiɛ lɛ adɛŋ. Ewo amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛ kɛtee ebuu mli; shi ehã hii ohai etɛ̃ lɛ hi shi. Midian nsra lɛ yɛ ideon shishigbɛ yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "Tee shi ni okpleke shi oyatua Midian nsra lɛ, ejaakɛ mibahã oye amɛnɔ kunim.
Shi kɛji ooshe gbeyei akɛ oooyatua amɛ lɛ, no lɛ, kɛ otsulɔ Pura akpleke shi kɛya nsra lɛ mli,
koni oyabo nii ni amɛwieɔ lɛ toi; kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ lɛ ooona ekãa kɛkpleke shi kɛyatua nsra lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛ etsulɔ Pura kpleke shi kɛtee tabilɔi ni yɔɔ nsra lɛŋ lɛ amasɛi kpaakpa.
Shi Midianbii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii kɛ bokãgbɛbii lɛ fɛɛ bua jɔɔ lɛ mli babaoo tamɔ baalabii. Amɛyoomai lɛ aleee amɛyibɔ; amɛyifalɛ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.

Be ni Gideon shɛ jɛi lɛ, naa mɔ ko ni eegba enaanyo ko lamɔ ni ela. Mɔ ni gbaa lɛ kɛɛ: "Naa, mila lamɔ ko. Mila ni aboloo akwaabɔ ko koklo kɛba Midian nsra lɛ mli kɛbanina buu ko. Ebatswa buu lɛ, ni etoo lɛ ebu shi, ni buu lɛ butu kwraa eshwie shi."
Enaanyo lɛ to he hã lɛ akɛ, "Enɛ lɛ jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni, Yoash, Israelnyo lɛ, bi Gideon aye Midian ta lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim."

Be ni Gideon nu lamɔ ni agba lɛ kɛ eshishitsɛ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, eho ekula shi ni esɔle. Kɛkɛ ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee Israelbii lɛ nsra lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtea shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ nyɛbaaye Midian ta lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim."
Eja hii ohai etɛ̃ lɛ mli kui etɛ, ni ekɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ kɛ kpulu ni kɔti hɔ mli hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ edɛŋ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa mi ni nyɛfea bɔ ni mafee lɛ. Kɛ miyashɛ nsra lɛ naa lɛ, bɔ ni mafee lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai nɔŋŋ.
Kɛ mikɛ mɛi ni fata mihe lɛ kpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ kɛbɔlea Midian nsra lɛ fɛɛ, ni nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Kɛhã Yehowa kɛ Gideon.'"

Gideon kɛ hii oha ni fata ehe lɛ yashɛ Midian nsra lɛ naa nyɔɔŋteŋ buube lɛ shishijee mli be ni amɛtsake bulɔi lɛ sɛɛ pɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛ ewebii lɛ kpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ, ni amɛjwara kpuji ni amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ kui etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ kpãkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ yɛ amɛninejurɔ. Amɛkpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ, ni amɛbɔ oshe akɛ, "Yehowa kɛ Gideon klaŋte!"
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ damɔ egbɛhe kɛbɔle Midian nsra lɛ kpula. Midian ta lɛ bu, ni amɛjo foi kɛ blɔmɔ.

Be ni akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi ohai etɛ̃ lɛ Yehowa hã Midianbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ dɔ eklaŋte eto enyɛmi nɔ yɛ nsra muu lɛ fɛɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Midian ta muu lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kɛtee Bet-Shita ni yɔɔ kɛyaa Zerera gbɛ lɛ, kɛtee Abel-Mehola ni yɔɔ Tabat masɛi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ayatsɛ Israel hii lɛ kɛjɛ Naftali kɛ Asher kɛ Manase fɛɛ, ni amɛtiu Midianbii lɛ.

Agbɛnɛ Gideon tsu mɛi kɛtee Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ ayakɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkplekea shi ni nyɛkɛ Midianbii lɛ abakpea. Nyɛtsimɔa faafoohei gbɛi lɛ kɛyashia Bet-Bara kɛ Yordan naa." No hewɔ lɛ ayakpee Efraim hii lɛ fɛɛ kɛba, ni amɛtsimɔ gbɛi ni akɛyaa fai lɛ anaa kɛyashi Bet-Bara kɛ Yordan naa.

Amɛmɔmɔ Oreb kɛ Zeeb, Midian limɛi enyɔ lɛ. Amɛgbe Oreb yɛ Oreb tɛsaa lɛ he, ni amɛgbe Zeeb yɛ Zeeb wainbu lɛ he. Amɛnyiɛ Midianbii lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ Oreb kɛ Zeel yitsei lɛ bahã Gideon yɛ Yordan faa lɛ sɛɛ.
8: Kɛkɛ ni Efraim hii lɛ bi Gideon akɛ, "Mɛɛba oye wɔ nɛkɛ sane akɛ obakpeee wɔ be ni ofãa ni okɛ Midian ayawu lɛ?" Amɛ kɛ lɛ he nyanyaanya.
Gideon kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mifee ni ekɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee lɛ ye egbɔ? Fioo po ni nyɛ, Efraim, nyɛfee lɛ, efe nɔ ni mikɛ miweku muu fɛɛ efee lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ nyɛgbe Midian lumɛi ni ji Oreb kɛ Zeeb. Mɛni minyɛ mifee ni ekɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee lɛ ye egbɔ?" Nɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛmlifu lɛ naa ba shi.
Gideon kɛ hii ohai etɛ̃ ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ shɛ Yordan faa lɛ naa, ni amɛfo. Etɔ amɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyiɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ asɛɛ lolo.
No hewɔ lɛ Gideon kɛɛ Sukotbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛhãa hii ni mikɛnyiɛ nɛɛ aboloo akwaabɔi nyɛhãa mi, ejaakɛ etɔ amɛ, ni minyiɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna, Midian maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, asɛɛ."
Shi Sukot onukpai lɛ to he akɛ, "Ani onine eshɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɔ momo hewɔ ni wɔhã otabilɔi lɛ aboloo lɛ lo?"
No hewɔ lɛ Gideon kɛɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ! Kɛji Yehowa hã minine shɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mikɛ ŋã mliŋmeii kɛ aklatii baayi nyɛ ni nyɛheloo baafamɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon fã kɛjɛ jɛi kɛtee Penuel. Ekɛ Penuelbii wie tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ Sukotbii wie lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ni Penuelbii lɛ to he hã lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Sukotbii lɛ to he lɛ nɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Penuelbii lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji miye omanye, ni miba lɛ, makumɔ nyɛmɔɔ nɛɛ."
Shi Zeba kɛ Zalmuna kɛ tabilɔi aaafee hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ yɛ Karkor. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi pɛ ni eshwɛ yɛ bokãgbɛbii ata lɛ fɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ tabilɔi akpei ohã kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ enyɔnyɔi.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon tsɔ̃ gbɛ ni gbɛfalɔi aku nyiɛɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ Noba kɛ Yagbeha nokãgbɛ, ni eyahɛŋ henyɛlɔi lɛ trukaa.
Zeba kɛ Zalmuna jo foi; shi Gideon tiu amɛ. Eyamɔmɔ Midian maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ni ji Zeba kɛ Zalmuna lɛ, ni egbɛ amɛta muu lɛ fɛɛ eshwã.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ, ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli. Etsɔ̃ Heres ŋmeŋme lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Emɔ Sukot oblanyo ko, ni ehã eŋmã Sukot nɔyelɔi kɛ emli onukpai lɛ agbɛii ehã lɛ, hii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo.
Gideon banina Sukotbii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ: "Naa, Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɛ! Amɛhewɔ nyɛye mihe fɛo akɛ, 'Ani onine eshɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɔ momo hewɔ ni wɔhãa otabilɔi ni etɔ amɛ lɛ aboloo lɛ lo? Lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon mɔmɔ Sukot maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋã mli ŋmeii kɛ aklatii yi amɛ waa.
Penuel mɔɔ lɛ hu Gideon kumɔ, ni egbe maŋ lɛ mli hii lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Gideon bi Zeba kɛ Zalmuna akɛ, "Hii ni nyɛgbe yɛ Tabor lɛ, te amɛsubaŋ yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?" Amɛto he akɛ, "Amɛtsmɔ bo pɛ; amɛ fɛɛ amɛtamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi abii.'
Gideon kɛɛ: "Minyɛmimɛi ni; minyɛ musuɛbii ji amɛ. Anɔkwale, mina Yehowa akɛ eji nyɛgbeee amɛ kulɛ migbeŋ nyɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ ekromɔbi Yeter akɛ, "Tee shi ni obe amɛ!" Shi oblanyo lɛ gblaaa eklaŋte lɛ; eeshe gbeyei, ejaakɛ edako.

Kɛkɛ ni Zeba kɛ Zalmuna kɛɛ, "Bo diɛŋtsɛ tee shi ni ogbe wɔ, ejaakɛ ja nuu ni nyɛɔ nuu nii etsuɔ," Kɛkɛ ni Gideon te shi ni egbe Zeba kɛ Zalmuna, ni ejie kuɛnii ni afee amɛ nyɔŋtsere fãfãi ni yɔɔ amɛyoomai lɛ akuɛ lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, "Ye wɔnɔ, bo kɛ obi kɛ onabi fɛɛ, ejaakɛ ohere wɔ yɛ Midianbii lɛ adɛŋ."
Shi Gideon kɛɛ amɛ, "Miyeŋ nyɛnɔ, ni mibi hu yeŋ nyɛnɔ; Yehowa aaaye nyɛnɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Mibabi nyɛ nɔ ko; no ji akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ shika toiiaŋmii ni ehã lɛ ahã mi!" (Ejaakɛ akɛni Ishmealbii ji Midianbii lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo shika toiiaŋnii).
Israelbii lɛ to he akɛ, "Wɔkɛaahã kɛ miishɛɛ." Amɛkɛ mama lɛɛ shi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shɛrɛ shika toiiaŋnii ni eha lɛ, eshwiɛ nɔ.

Shika toiiaŋnii lɛ ni Gideon bi lɛ, etsiimɔ ji shika ŋmiiŋmi shekeli akpe kome kɛ ohai kpawo, soro jwinei ni afee amɛ nyɔŋtsere fãfãi kɛ toiiaŋnii kɛ afaseo atadei ni Midian maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ wowoo lɛ, kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ni yɔɔ amɛyoomai lɛ akuɛi lɛ.
Gideon kɛ shika nɛɛ fee efod, ni ekɛto emaŋ ni ji Ofra lɛ mli. Ni Israelbii fɛɛ kwa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtee jɛi ni amɛyaja efod lɛ. Enɛ tsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã Gideon kɛ ewe lɛ.
Bɔ ni fee ni aba Midian shi ahã Israel nɛ. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Midianbii wooo amɛhe nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Gideon wala be mli.
Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ, yi mli etee eyahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋbii, ejaakɛ eŋɔ yei pii.
Ehemɔ ni yɔɔ Shekem lɛ, lɛ hu ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu. Ewo gbekɛ lɛ Abimelek.
Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ gbɔ kotokoto dani egbo. Afu lɛ yɛ etsɛ Yoash fuuhe lɛ yɛ Ofra ni ji Abiezerbii akrowa lɛ mli.
Shi be ni Gideon egbo sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ Baal-Berit fee amɛnyɔŋmɔ.
Amɛkaiii Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ adɛŋ yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.
Asaŋ amɛfeee Yerubaal ni ji Gideon lɛ, we lɛ ejurɔ ko tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ lɛ efee Israel lɛ.
9: Agbɛnɛ Abimelek, Yerubaal bi lɛ, yiŋ etee enyɛ nyɛmimɛi aŋɔɔ yɛ Shekem maŋ lɛ mli. Ekɛ amɛ kɛ enyɛ tsɛ lɛ weku lɛ fɛɛ yawie ni ekɛɛ,

"Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛbia yɛ Shekembii fɛɛ ahiɛ akɛ, 'te emli nɔ ni hi hã nyɛ hu? Akɛ Yerubaal bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ fɛɛ aye nyɛnɔ, aloo mɔ kome kɛkɛ aye nyɛnɔ?' Nyɛkaia hu akɛ, mi lɛ, nyɛheloo kɛ lá ji mi."
Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ wie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛhã lɛ yɛ Shekembii lɛ fɛɛ atoiŋ. Shekembii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ esa akɛ amɛnyiɛ Abimelek sɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, "wɔnyɛmi ni."
Amɛŋɔ jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛjɛ Baal-Berit we lɛ amɛhã lɛ. Abimelek kɛ shika nɛɛ bɔ yakayaka gbɔmɛi yiwulɔi apaa koni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Etee etsɛ we lɛ yɛ Ofra, ni eyagbe Gideon bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ ni ji enyɛmimɛi lɛ, yɛ tɛ kome nɔ. Shi Yotam ni ji Gideon nakutsoŋbi lɛ kome pɛ shwɛ, ejaakɛ etee ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni Shekembii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Milo we lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi ni amɛtee amɛyawo Abimelek maŋtsɛ yɛ tso kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ Shekem lɛ shishi.
Be ni ayagba Yotam lɛ, eyiŋ etee eyadamɔ Gerizim gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ ni ebo ekɛɛ Shekembii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa mi toi, nyɛ Shekembii, koni Nyɔŋmɔ hu abo nyɛ toi.
Gbi ko lɛ tsei yiŋ tee koni amɛyafɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mu ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ. Aamɛkɛɛ mutso akɛ, 'ye wɔnɔ maŋtsɛ.'
Shi mutso kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Ani mihã mimu ni akɛwoɔ nyɔŋmɔi kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ nyam lɛ abɔ mi ni miyaye tsei anɔ lo?'
Kɛkɛ ni tsei lɛ yakɛɛ agbamitso akɛ, 'Bo lɛ ba ni obaye wɔnɔ.'
Shi agbamitso kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Ani mihã miŋɔɔmɔ kɛ miyibii kpakpai lɛ abɔ mi ni miyaye tsei anɔ lo?'
Kɛkɛ ni tsei lɛ yakɛɛ waintso akɛ, 'Bo lɛ ba ni obaye wɔnɔ, maŋtsɛ.'
Shi waintso kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Ani mihã midãa ni shɛjeɔ nyɔŋmɔi kɛ gbɔmɛi amii lɛ abɔ mi, ni mayaye tsei anɔ lo?'
Kɛkɛ ni tsei lɛ fɛɛ yakɛɛ ŋmeitso akɛ, 'Bo lɛ ba ni obaye wɔnɔ mɔ.'

Shi ŋmeitso kɛɛ tsei lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛmiiwo mi maŋtsɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaa nyɛbabaa abo yɛ mishishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ la ajɛ ŋmeitso mli ni eyashã Lebanon tsenedrui lɛ.'
Yotam tee nɔ akɛ, "No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ ni nyɛwo Abimelek lɛ, ani anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ sane nyɛye lɛ? Ani ekpakpa nyɛfaa Gideon kɛ ewe lɛ? Ani nii ni Gideon tsu ehã nyɛ lɛ nyɛto lɛ najiaŋ bɔ ni sa?
Ejaakɛ mitsɛ wu hã nyɛ; ekɛ nyɛ Midianbii oshrã mli, ni ekɛjie nyɛ yɛ Midianbii adɛŋ.
Shi ŋmɛnɛ nyɛte shi nyɛwo mitsɛ we lɛ, ni nyɛgbe ebihii lɛ, mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo sɔŋŋ, yɛ tɛ kome nɔ; ni nyɛwo Abimelek, eweyoo bi lɛ, Shekembii amaŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛmi ji lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛji anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ sane nyɛye Gideon kɛ ewe lɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ,no lɛ nyɛyaa Abimelek he, ni lɛ hu enya nyɛhe.
Shi kɛjeee nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ la ajɛ Abimelek mli ni eyashã Shekembii lɛ kɛ Milo we lɛ; asaŋ la ajɛ Shekembii lɛ amli kɛ Milo we lɛ ni eyashã Abimelek."
Shi akɛni Yotam miishe enyɛi Abimelek gbeyei hewɔ lɛ Yotam jo foi, ni egbla ehe shi kɛtee Beer, ni eyahi jɛi.
Abimelek ye Israelbii anɔ afii etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã nyɛɛ ba Abimelek kɛ Shekembii lɛ ateŋ; Shekembii lɛ yeee Abimelek anɔkwa.
Afee enɛ be ni afee koni gbe ni agbe Gideon musuŋbii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, agbla amɛnyɛmi Abimelek, kɛ Shekembii lɛ atoi yɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛwo Abimelek hewalɛ ni egbe enyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Shekembii lɛ to kawolɔi yɛ gɔ̃ji lɛ ayiteŋ koni amɛwo Abimelek ka. Kawilɔi nɛɛ shɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nii yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Ayagba Abimelek.
Kɛkɛ ni Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba Shekem, ni Shekembii lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Amɛje kpo kɛtee amɛŋmɔji ashi. Amɛkpa amɛwaintromi lɛ amli yibii ni amɛŋã wain lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛye gbijurɔ. Amɛtee amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ. Amɛyeyee nii; amɛnunuu dãi, ni amɛye Abimelek he fɛo.

Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, kɛɛ: "Namɔ ji Abimelek, ni namɛi ji wɔ Shekembii ni wɔsɔmɔɔ lɛ? Ani Gideon bi lɛ kɛ esafoiatsɛ Zebul lɛ, jeee Hamor ni to Shekem lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ be ko ni eho? Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ esa akɛ wɔɔsɔmɔ lɛ?
Mina ni maŋ nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ ni kulɛ makpa Abimelek. Makɛɛ Abimelek akɛ, 'Hã ota yi afa, ni ofã kɛba.'"
Be ni Zebul, maŋ lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ, nu Ebed bi Gaal wiemɔi lɛ, emli wo la,
ni etsu mɛi kɛtee Abimelek ŋɔɔ yɛ Aruma ekɛɛ, "Ebed bi Gaal kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ eba Shekem, ni amɛmiiwo maŋ lɛ yiŋ ni amɛte shi amɛwo o.
No hewɔ lɛ, tee shi nyɔɔŋ, bo kɛ omɛi lɛ, ni oyawo ka yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Leebi, kɛ hulu te shi pɛ, tee shi mra ni obatua maŋ lɛ. Kɛji Gaal kɛ emɛi lɛ je kpo banina o lɛ, feemɔ amɛ bɔ ni ooonyɛ.'
Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ fɛɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ. Amɛgbla amɛmli kui ejwɛ, ni amɛwo Shekem he ka.
Kɛkɛ ni Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, je kpo, ni eyadamɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ te shi kɛjɛ kawoohe lɛ.
Gaal na mɛi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Naa, gbɔmɛi miijɛ ɔ̃ji lɛ ayiteŋ miikpleke shi." Zebul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Gɔ̃ji lɛ asusuma onaa tamɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ."
Shi Gaal wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, 'Naa, gbɔmɛi miijɛ gɔŋ lɛ hiɛ miikpleke shi kɛmiiba, ni ku kome jɛ klamɔfoi atso kple lɛ he gbɛ kɛmiiba."
Kɛkɛ ni Zebul bi Gaal akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ nɛgbe onaabu ni okɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Namɔ ji Abimelek ni wɔsɔmɔɔ lɛ' lɛ yɔɔ? Ani jeee gbɔmɛi lɛ ni ojɛɔ amɛ lɛ nɛ? Agbɛnɛ jee kpo ni okɛ amɛ ayawu."
Kɛkɛ ni Gaal je kpo kɛnyiɛ Shekembii lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ Abimelek bawu.
Shi Abimelek wo Gaal foi, ni enyiɛ Gaal sɛɛ. Apilapilai, ni mɛi babaoo nyɔnyɔɔi aahuu kɛyashi maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa tete.
Abimelek hi Aruma; ni Zebul shwie Gaal kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛje Shekem ni no hewɔ lɛ ehii amɛ jɛihilɛ dɔŋŋ.
Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, maŋbii lɛ je kpo kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Ayagba Abimelek. Hewɔ lɛ eŋɔ emɛi lɛ, ni ejra amɛmli kui etɛ̃. Eyawo ka yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaakwɛ lɛ, naa maŋbii lɛ ni amɛmiije kpo kɛmiijɛ maŋ lɛ mli. Abimelek te shi wo amɛ, ni etswia amɛ nii.
Abimelek kɛ ku ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛtee amɛhiɛ ni amɛysdamɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Kɛkɛ ni kui krokomɛi enyɔ lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛyanina Shekembii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbe Shekembii lɛ fɛɛ.
Abimelek kɛ Shekem maŋ lɛ wu nakai gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ. Egbe gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ. Ebutu maŋ lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋoo shwã mli.
Be ni Shekem mɔɔ lɛ mli hii lɛ fɛɛ nu enɛ lɛ amɛyabote El-Berit we lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Ayagba Abimelek akɛ Shekem mɔɔ lɛ mli hii lɛ fɛɛ eyabua amɛhe naa.

Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ fɛɛ kwɔ Zalmon gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ. Abimelek kɔ lema ehiɛ edɛ̃. Eyafo tso nine ko, ni ewo etswa ekoŋ. Ekɛɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni nyɛna ni mifee nɛɛ, nyɛhe afea oya ni nyɛfea nakai."
No hewɔ lɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yafo tso nine, ni amɛkɛnyiɛ Abimelek sɛɛ. Amɛkɛbashwie mɔɔ lɛ he ni amɛma mɔɔ lɛ naa la. Gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, hii kɛ yei aaafee akpe lɛ fɛɛ hu gboi.
Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek yiŋ etee Tebez. Eyabɔ nsra ewo maŋ lɛ he, ni eŋɔ.
Shi mɔɔ ni wa ko yɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, ni maŋbii lɛ jo foi kɛtee jɛi, hii kɛ yei fɛɛ. Amɛŋã amɛyi, ni amɛkwɔ mɔɔ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ.
Abimelek ba, ni ebatua mɔɔ lɛ. Etsi ebɛŋkɛ mɔɔ lɛ shinaa lɛ koni ema mɔɔ lɛ naa la.
Shi yoo ko ŋmɛɛ wiɛbi he etswa Abimelek yiteŋ, ni ejwa Abimelek yitsoŋoŋo lɛ.

Oya nɔŋŋ ni Abimelek tsɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ lɛ Abimelek lɛ etawuunii lɛ, ni efã oblanyo lɛ akɛ, "Gblamɔ oklaŋte ni ogbe mi, koni akakɛɛ yɛ mihe akɛ, 'Yoo po gbe lɛ.'" No hewɔ lɛ oblanyo lɛ tsu Abimelek nɔ, ni egbo.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Abimelek enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yiŋ etee emaŋ.
Efɔŋ ni Abimelek fee etsɛ akɛ egbe etsɛ lɛ bii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo he nyɔmɔ nɛ.
Asaŋ efɔŋ ni Shekembii fee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbla amɛtoi yɛ fɛɛ he; ni Yotam Gideon bi lɛ, loomɔ lɛ ba amɛnɔ.
10: Abimelek sɛɛ lɛ mɔ ni te shi akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni ehere Israelbii lɛ ji Tola, Isarkanyo lɛ. Dodo bi Pua bi ji lɛ. Ehi Shamir yɛ Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ.
Enyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃, ni egbo. Afu lɛ yɛ Shamir.
Tola sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ni te shi akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Yair, Gileadnyo lɛ. Enyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃; amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ eteji ni etaa nɔ. Amɛyɛ maji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Atsɛɔ maji nɛɛ Yair akrowai kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Yair gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Kamon.

Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ amɛshi Yehowa ekoŋŋ. Amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ Astarte nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni ji Siriabii kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Filistibii anyɔŋmɔi lɛ. Amɛkwa Yehowa, ni amɛsɔmɔɔɔ lɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli wo Israel la, ni ehã Filistibii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ye Israel nɔ.

Filistibii kɛ Amonbii nɛɛ hao Israelbii lɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i amɛ nyɔŋyeli yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ. Amɛye Israelbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan sɛɛ yɛ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ hu Amorbii lɛ bafo Yordan koni amɛkɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin we lɛ kɛ Efraim abawu. Enɛ hã Israelbii lɛ fee yeyeeye naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa amɛkɛɛ: "Wɔfee esha wɔshi o; ejaakɛ wɔkwa o, wɔ-Nyɔɛmɔ lɛ, ni wɔyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Be ni nyɛblɔ nyɛtsɛ mi lɛ, ani jeee mi mihere nyɛ yɛ Egiptbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Filistibii
kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Amalekbi kɛ Midianbii ni wa nyɛ yi lɛ adɛŋ?
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwa mi, ni nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, mihereŋ nyɛyiwala dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛyaa nyɛyablɔa nyɛtsɛa nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni nyɛhala lɛ; amɛ, amɛhere nyɛ yɛ amanehulu be nɛɛ mli."
Shi Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "wɔfee esha; bo lɛ feemɔ wɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa ohiɛ; shi ofai nɛ ni ojie wɔ ŋmɛnɛ kɛkɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛjie nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ amɛshwie, ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa. Amɛnii fee Yehowa mɔbɔ yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ Amonbii lɛ hoo ta ni amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Gilead. Israelbii hu bua amɛhe naa, ni amɛyabɔ nsra yɛ Mizpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Gilead maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ bibii amɛhe akɛ, "Namɔ ji nuu ni kɛ Amonbii lɛ aaababɔ̃i wuu? Lɛ eeefee Gileadbii fɛɛ anukpa."
11: Yefta, Gileadnyo lɛ, tawulɔ kãkãlɔ ji lɛ; shi yoo ajwamaŋ ko bi ni. Yefta lɛ etsɛ ji Gilead. Gilead kɛ eŋã diɛŋtsɛ hu yɛ bihii krokomɛi.
Be ni bii nɛɛ badra lɛ, amɛshwie Yefta, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Oyeŋ gboshinii yɛ wɔtsɛ we lɛ, ejaakɛ yoo kroko bi ji o."
Kɛkɛ ni Yefta jo foi yɛ anyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni eyahi Tob shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Yakayaka gbɔmɛi komɛi bua amɛhe naa amɛyafata Yefta he, ni amɛkɛ lɛ fãa ta, amɛyayeɔ ojo.
No sɛɛ lɛ Amonbii lɛ fã ta wo Israel.
Ni fee nakai lɛ, Gilead onukpai lɛ yiŋ amɛtee amɛyaŋɔ Yefta yɛ Tob shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Amɛkɛɛ Yefta akɛ, "Ba ni obaye asafoiatsɛ ohã wɔ ni wɔkɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu."
Shi Yefta kɛɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ akɛ, "Ani jeee nyɛ nyɛhe tsɛ̃ mi, ni nyɛshwie mi yɛ mitsɛ we lɛ? Mɛɛ hewɔ ni agbɛnɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ amanehulu mli, ni nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ lɛ?"
Gilead onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Yefta akɛ, "No hewɔ moŋ ni wɔgba wɔtua bo agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, koni okɛ wɔ aya ni wɔ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu, ni otsɔ̃ wɔ Gileadbii fɛɛ wɔnukpa."
Yefta kɛɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛ kɛ mi na ku sɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni wɔkɛ Amonbii lɛ yawu, ni Yehowa hã miye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, mi, mibaye nyɔnɔ."
Gilead onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Yefta akɛ, "Yehowa afee wɔ kɛ o teŋ odase akɛ bɔ lɛ nɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Yefta kɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ yiŋ tee, ni maŋ lɛ wo lɛ onukpa kɛ asafoiatsɛ amɛhã maŋ lɛ. Ni Yefta yawie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yefta tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ayabi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ sane okɛ mi yɔɔ hewɔ ni obaa minɔ ni okɛ mimaŋ lɛ abawu nɛɛ?"

Amonbii amantsɛ lɛ hã bɔfoi ni atsu lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Ejaakɛ be ni Israel jɛ Egipt baa lɛ, ekɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ he kɛyashi Yabok faa lɛ kɛ Yordan faa lɛ he; no hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛ minii aku sɛɛ ahã mi kpoo!"
Yefta saa tsu mɛi kɛtee Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ nɔɔ ekoŋŋ,
ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yefta kɛɛ nɛ: Israelbii kɔko Moabbii loo Amonbii ashikpɔŋ ko;
shi moŋ be ni Israelbii jɛ Egipt amɛbaa lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛyashɛ ŋshɔ tsuru lɛ naa, ni amɛba Kadesh.

Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsu mɛi kɛtee Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ofai nɛ, hã wɔtsɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho.' Shi Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ. Amɛtsu Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ hu ŋɔɔ, shi ekplɛ̃ɛɛ; ni Israelbii lɛ hi shi yɛ Kadesh.

Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ ŋã lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyalɔɔ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛyashɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni amɛbato shi yɛ Arnon faa lɛ sɛɛgbɛ. Shi amɛboteee Moab shikpɔŋ mli, ejaakɛ Arnon faa lɛ ji Moab husu.
Agbɛnɛ Israelbii lɛ tsu mɛi kɛtee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon i ji Heshbon maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ofai nɛ, hã wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni wɔyaa nɔ lɛ nɔ.'
Shi Sihon yiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe bɔ ni eeehã amɛtsɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni Sihon bua emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ naa. Eyabɔ nsra yɛ Yahaz, ni ekɛ Israel wu.
Shi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã Israelbii lɛ ye Sihon kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim. No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ amɛfee amɛbɔ.
Amɛŋɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Arnon faa lɛ he kɛyashi Yakob Faa lɛ he; amɛŋɔ kɛjɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛyashi Yordan naa tɔ̃ɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, belɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Amorbii lɛ adɛŋ ehã emaŋ Israel; ni bo otaoɔ ni oŋɔ nɛɛ?
Ani nɔ ni onyɔŋmɔ Kemosh kɛhã o akɛ onɔ lɛ, oŋɔɔɔ? Wɔ hu, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã wɔ lɛ, wɔɔŋɔ akɛ wɔnɔ.
Aso oyɛ hewalɛ fe Balak, Zipor bi lɛ ni ji Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ? Ani ekɛ Israel eple nii ahe pɛŋ aloo ekɛ amɛ ewu pɛŋ?
Israel ehi Heshbon kɛ Aroer kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ kɛ majimaji ni jwere Arnon Faa lɛ he lɛ amli afii ohai etɛ̃. Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛshɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛnii nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ mifeko o efɔŋ ko; shi bo moŋ ni ofeɔ mi efɔŋ akɛ ofã ta kɛba minɔ. Yehowa ni ji kojolɔ lɛ akojo Israelbii kɛ Amonbii ateŋ sane ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ."
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ wiemɔ ni Yefta kɛtsu eŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ bayi Yefta nɔ. Yefta tsɔ̃ Gilead kɛ Manase kɛfoŋ kɛtee Mizpa yɛ Gilead, ni efoŋ yɛ Mizpa kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ.
Yefta wo Yehowa shi ni ekɛɛ: "Kɛji ooohã maye Amonbii lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ,
no lɛ, kɛ miyaye omanye ni miku misɛɛ kɛjɛ Amonbii lɛ aŋɔɔ miiba lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ miwe lɛ agbo lɛ mli aaaba kpee mi lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; ni mikɛ lɛ aaafee shãa afɔle."
Kɛkɛ ni Yefta fã kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ ayawu. Yehowa hã eye amɛnɔ kunim,

ni Yefta tswia amɛ nii ni egbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Aroer aahuu kɛtsɔ̃ Minit kpkpai anɔ, he ni maji nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɔɔ lɛ, aahuu kɛtee Abel-Keramim. Agbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni Israelbii lɛ ye Amonbii lɛ anɔ kunim.
Be ni Yefta ku esɛɛ kɛbaa ewe lɛ yɛ Mizpa lɛ, naa, ebiyoo lɛ je kpo kɛ fabii kɛ joi kɛba koni ebakpee lɛ. Yefta bi koome pɛ ji lɛ; esɛɛ lɛ ebɛ binuu lɛ, ebɛ biyoo hu.
Be ni Yefta na lɛ lɛ, egbla ehe atadei, ni ekɛɛ: "Ao mibi, ohã mihe ejra mi nɛɛ! Ejaakɛ miwo Yehowa shi, ni minyɛŋ minaa makpale."
Ebiyoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mitsɛ, owo Yehowa shi, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni Yehowa tɔ ohe owele yɛ ohenyɛlɔi ni ji Amonbii lɛ anɔ nɛɛ, feemɔ mi bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni owo shi lɛ."
Shi ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "Feemɔ enɛ pɛ ohã mi. Ŋmɛ̃ɛ mi gbɛ kɛyashi biɛ nyɔji enyɔ, koni maya mikɛ minanemɛi lɛ ayakpa shi yɛ gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ maye ŋkɔmɔ akɛ oblayoo fro." Etsɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa!"
Ni ewo lɛ gbɛ eyaye nyɔji enyɔ. Ekɛ enanemɛi lɛ tee eyaye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ akɛ ebaagbo oblayoo fro.
Nyɔji enyɔ lɛ naagbee lɛ, eku esɛɛ eba etsɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni Yefta fee ebiyoo lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ, ni ebiyoo lɛ gbo akɛ oblayoo fro. Enɛ tsɔ̃ kusum yɛ Israel,
akɛ daa afi lɛ Israel oblayei yaa amɛyayeɔ gbii ejwɛ amɛkɛyeɔ Yefta Gileadnyo lɛ biyoo lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ.
12: Efraim hii lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛhã ta. Amɛfo mli kɛtee Zafon ni amɛyakɛɛ Yefta akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ be ni ofã ni okɛ Amonbii lɛ yaa ayawu lɛ, obakpeee wɔ ni wɔkɛ o aya lɛ? Wɔkɛ la baashã oshīa lɛ wɔshwie oyiteŋ."
Yefta kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ mimaŋbii lɛ, bei ni mli wa ba wɔ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ateŋ, shi be ni mitsɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛbahereee mi yɛ Amonbii lɛ adɛŋ.
Be ni mina akɛ nyɛhereŋ mi lɛ, mikɛ mihe wo oshrã mli, ni mifã kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ. Yehowa hã miye amɛnɔ kunim. No hewɔ lɛ mɛni hewɔ nyɛfã kɛba minɔ ŋmɛnɛ ni nyɛkɛ mi abawu lɛ?"

Kɛkɛ ni Yefta bua Gileadbii lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛ Efraimbii lɛ wu, ni amɛye Efraimbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ Gileadbii lɛ kobɔfoi ni bafata Efraimbii kɛ Manasebii ahe ji nyɛ."

Gileadbii tsī Efraimbii lɛ gbɛ yɛ hei ni afoɔ Yodan Faa lɛ yɛ lɛ. Kɛji Efraimbii ni ejo foi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ akɛ, "Hã mafo faa lɛ," Gileadbii biɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ani Efraimbii ji o lo?" Ni kɛ ekɛɛ "Dabi" lɛ,

Gileadbii lɛ kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, "Belɛ kɛɛmɔ, 'Shibolet'; ni kɛ enyɛɛɛ etsɛ wiemɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ ni ekɛɛ 'Sibolet'" lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbeɔ lɛ yɛ hei ni afoɔ Yordan faa lɛ yɛ lɛ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Efraimbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ nyɔnyɔɔi.
Yefta nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii ekpaa. Kɛkɛ ni Yefta, Gileadnyo lɛ gbo. Afu lɛ yɛ emaŋ lɛ mli yɛ Gilead.
Yefta sɛɛ lɛ, Ibzan ni jɛ Betlehem lɛ ji hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ biyei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ. Ekɛ ebiyei lɛ bahãa gblã yɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli, ni eyaŋɔɔ yei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛjɛɔ akutsei krokomɛi amli ebahãa ebihii lɛ.
Ibzan nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii kpawo; kɛkɛ ni egbo. Afu lɛ yɛ Betlehem.
Ibzan sɛɛ lɛ, Elon ni jɛ Zebulon lɛ ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ. Enyiɛ amɛhiɛ afii nyɔŋma;
kɛkɛ ni egbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Ayalon yɛ Zebulon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Elon sɛɛ lɛ, Abdon ni ji Hilel ni jɛ Piraton lɛ bi lɛ ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ nabii hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Ebii kɛ enabii nɛɛ traa tejii nyɔŋmai kpawo nɔ. Abdon nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abdon. Hilel ni ji Piratonnyo lɛ bi lɛ gbo. Afu lɛ yɛ Piraton yɛ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Amalekbii agɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
13: Israelbii lɛ fee esha amɛshi Yehowa ekoŋŋ, ni Yehowa hã Filistibii ye amɛnɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Nuu ko yɛ Zora ni ejɛ Danbii aweku lɛ mli. Egbɛi ji Manoa. Eŋã lɛ kene ji lɛ, ni ebɛ bi.
Yehowa bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kene ji o, ni obɛ bi; shi agbɛnɛ obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ le ohe nɔ kwɛmɔ. Kaanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa, ni kaaye nɔ ko ni he tseee hu.
Ejaakɛ naa, obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu. Asooyi naa akasa eyiteŋ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ baafee mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ musuŋ beebe. Lɛ ebaabɔi Israelbii lɛ heremɔ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ ba ni ebakɛɛ ewu akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ko ba miŋɔɔ. Ehiɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hiɛ, ehe yɛ gbeyei naakpa. Shi mibii lɛ he ni ejɛ, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔɔ mi egbɛi.

Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'naa, obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu; no hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ lɛ, kaanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa; ni kaaye nɔ ko ni he tseee; ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ baafee mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ musuŋ beebe kɛyashi gbi ni eeegbo.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Manoa kpa Yehowa fai ni ekɛɛ, "Ao Yehowa, miikpa o fai, hã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni otsu lɛ aba wɔ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ gbekɛ lɛ ni abaafɔ lɛ wɔhã."
Nyɔŋmɔ fee nɔ ni Manoa bi lɛ ehã lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ ba yoo lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ be ni eta shi yɛ ŋmɔ mli; shi ewu Manoa bɛ jɛi.
Yoo lɛ he fee oya, ni esha foi eyakɛɛ ewu lɛ akɛ, "Naa nuu lɛ ni ba miŋɔɔ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ ebajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi."
Kɛkɛ ni Manoa te shi ni enyiɛ eŋã lɛ sɛɛ ni ebanina nuu lɛ. Ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji nuu lɛ ni kɛ yoo nɛɛ bawie lɛ?" Nuu lɛ to he akɛ, "Miŋ."
Manoa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ kɛ owiemɔi lɛ na ba mli lɛ, te gbekɛ lɛ shihilɛ baatamɔ ahã tɛŋŋ, ni mɛni ebaafee?"
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ to he akɛ, "Nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ yoo lɛ, ehiɛ ahi ehe nɔ yɛ he.
Ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni jɛɔ waintso mli, ni asaŋ ekanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa. Asaŋ ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he tseee. Nibii fɛɛ ni miwo lɛ he kitã lɛ eye nɔ."
Manoa kɛɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, hã wɔtsi onaa fioo, ni wɔkɛ too abotiabi afee niyenii ahã o."
Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Manoa akɛ, "Kɛji otsi minaa tete po, miyeŋ niyenii lɛ eko; shi kɛji shãa afɔle obaashã lɛ, no lɛ shãa ohã Yehowa." Manoa leee akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni.
No hewɔ lɛ Manoa bi bɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Te atsɛɔ o tɛŋŋ? Koni kɛ owiemɔi lɛ na ba mli lɛ, ni wɔwo ohiɛ nyam."
Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Manoa akɛ, "Mɛɛba obiɔ migbɛi? Migbɛɛi lɛ, naakpɛɛ gbɛi ni."
No hewɔ lɛ Manoa ŋɔ too abotiabi, ni ekɛ no kɛ ŋmãa afɔle shã afɔle yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa mɔ ni tsuɔ naakpɛɛnii lɛ.
Be ni lalolɛi lɛ te shi kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tsɔ̃ afɔleshãa latɛ lɔ nɔ lalilɛi lɛ mli ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi. Manoa kɛ eŋã lɛ na; kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ebajieee ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ Manoa kɛ eŋã lɛ dɔŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni Manoa na lɛ akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni.
Manoa kɛɛ eŋã lɛ akɛ, "Gboimɔ wɔbaagboi lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔna Nyɔŋmɔ."
Shi eŋã lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Eji Yehowa miitao wɔ egbe kulɛ eheŋ wɔdɛŋ shãa afɔle kɛ ŋmãa aɔle lɛ, ni asaŋ kulɛ etsɔ̃ŋ wɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni ejieŋ saji ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi kpo etsɔ̃ŋ wɔ."
Yoo lɛ fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ Samson. Gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni Yehowa jɔɔ lɛ.
Yehowa mumɔ bɔ̃i Samson nɔ baa be ni eyɔɔ Dan Shitoohe lɛ, yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol teŋ lɛ.
14: Samson yiŋ etee Timna ni eyana yoo ko yɛ jɛi ni eji Filistibii lɛ eko.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson hu esɛɛ eba, ni ebakɛɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ akɛ, "Miyana Filisti oblayoo ko yɛ Timna; nyɛyaŋɔa lɛ nyɛbahãa mi ni mikɛ lɛ afea miŋã."

Shi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aso yoo ko yoo ko bɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ abiyei lɛ ateŋ aloo wɔjakubii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ hewɔ ni esa akɛ oyaŋɔ yoo yɛ Filistibii foolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ?" Shi Samson kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, "yaaŋɔ lɛ obahã mi, ejaakɛ lɛ misumɔɔ."
Shi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ leee akɛ Yehowa dɛŋ jɛ, ni Filistibii lɛ ahe gbɛ Yehowa taoɔ, ejaakɛ nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Filistibii lɛ yeɔ Israel nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ yiŋ kɛtee Timna. Amɛshɛ Timna waintromi lɛ ahe; kɛkɛ ni jata oblanyo ko bɔ̃i huumɔ kɛ Samson woo.
Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ba Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ, ni Samson tserɛ jata lɛ mli tamɔ atserɛɔ too abotiabi mli, tsɛ ehiɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ. Shi Samson ekɛɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ.
Samson kɛ yoo lɛ yawie, ni yoo lɛ sane sa Samson hiɛ naakpa.
Be fioo sɛɛ lɛ Samson tee ni enyaŋɔ yoo lɛ. Be ni eyaa lɛ egba koni eyakwɛ jata gbonyo lɛ, ni eyana akɛ wobii asafo eto wo yɛ jata lɛ musuŋ.
Samson jie wo lɛ eko ehiɛ edɛ̃, ni ehiɛ yeli kɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ. Ebanina etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni ehã amɛ eko amɛye; shi ekɛɛɛ amɛ akɛ jata gbonyo lɛ musuŋ ejie wo lɛ yɛ.
Etsɛ yiŋ etee ni eyana yoo lɛ; ni Samson ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ nakai oblahii lɛ feɔ.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ na Samson lɛ, amɛyaŋɔ oblahii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛbafata ehe.

Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mibagba nyɛ ajenu ko. Kɛ nyɛaanyɛ mi shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ nɛkɛ gbii kpawo ni nyɛaana nɔ ni ji lɛ, no lɛ mibahã nyɛ shikpɔŋ boi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ hewulamɔ atadei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ mi shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛbaahã mi shikpɔŋ boi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ hewulamɔ atadei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃." Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Gba ojenu lɛ ni wɔbo toi."
Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ji Niyenii ni jɛɔ nɔyelɔ mli; ŋɔɔmɔ nii jɛɔ hewalɔ mli." Gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ baho ni amɛnyɛko ajenu lɛ shishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔlɛ, amɛkɛɛ Samson ŋã lɛ akɛ, "Lakamɔ owu lɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ o ajenu lɛ shishi; kɛjee nakai lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔshã bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ. Aso nyɛkpee wɔ kɛba biɛ ni nyɛshɔ̃ wɔdɛŋ nii?"
Kɛkɛ ni Samson ŋã lɛ fo wo lɛ ni ekɛɛ: "Onyɛɔ mi; osumɔɔ mi. Ogba mijakubii ajenu, shi otsɔ̃ɔɔ mi shishi." Shi Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ; "mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ tete po mitsɔ̃ko amɛ shishi, ni bo mibatsɔ̃ɔ lo?"
Yoo lɛ fo wo Samson gbii kpawo lɛ fɛɛ ni aŋmɛɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ; ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ Samson tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋã lɛ miiye etsui. Kɛkɛ ni eŋã lɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ ejakubii lɛ ajenu lɛ shishi.

No hewɔ lɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, hulu nako anyɔ shi ni maŋ lɛ mli hii lɛ kɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Mɛni ŋɔɔ fe wo? Mɛni he wa fe jata?" Samson hã amɛ hetoo akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ mitsina oblayoo lɛ huuu jikulɛ Nyɛnaŋ mijenu lɛ shishi."

Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã mumɔ bayi Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ kple. Eyiŋ etee Ashkelon, ni eyagbe maŋ lɛ mli hii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃. Ejie amɛhe nibii, ni ekɛ hewulamɔ atade lɛ yaha mei ni tsɔ̃ɔ ajenu lɛ shishi lɛ. Samson mli fu waa ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee etsɛ we lɛ.
Ni akɛ eŋã lɛ hã enaanyo ni ekɛbɔɔ.
15: Be fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ, Samson hiɛ abotiabi kɛtee eyaasra eŋã lɛ yɛ ŋmãakuu be lɛ mli. Ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Matee miŋã ŋɔɔ yɛ sɛɛtsu lɛ mli." Shi eŋã lɛ tsɛ lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ ni eya tsu lɛ mli.
Ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Anɔkwale mli lɛ, misusu akɛ osumɔɔɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ mikɛ lɛ hã onaanyo lɛ. Bɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo fe lɛ? Ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ enajiaŋ."
Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ kɛji mifee Filistibii lɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, amɛsɔ̃ ko wulaaa miyiteŋ."
No hewɔ lɛ Samson yiŋ etee, ni eyamɔmɔ osɔi ohai etɛ̃, ni eklɔ kɔtii. Ekɛ osɔi lɛ aleii tsra enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni ekɛ kɔti wo lei kɛ lei tsamɔhe lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni ema kɔtii lɛ anaa la, ni eŋmɛɛ osɔi lɛ ahe ewo Filistibii lɛ aŋmãa ni mamɔ shi lɛ mli, ni Samson shã ŋmãa kei lɛ kɛ ŋmãa ni mamɔ shi kɛ mutsei abɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

Filistibii lɛ bi akɛ, "Namɔ po ni fee enɛ?" Akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Samson Timnanyo lɛ shaanuu lɛ ni, ejaakɛ eshaanuu lɛ eŋɔ eŋã lɛ ehã Samson naanyo lɛ," kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ yiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyashã yoo lɛ kɛ etsɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Samson kɛɛ Filistibii lɛ akɛ, "No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛfee nɛ? Mina mitsɛ nane akɛ ja mitɔ mihe owele yɛ nyɛnɔ dani mibakpa."
Kɛkɛ ni etswia amɛgbeji kɛ amɛshuɔji anii ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu, ni eyiŋ etee eyahi tɛkplo ko mli yɛ Etam tɛsaa lɛ mli.
Filistibii lɛ ba amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Yuda, ni amɛyatua Lehi.
No hewɔ lɛ Yuda hii lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛfã kɛba wɔnɔ nɛɛ?" Amɛkɛɛ, "Samson fīi wɔba nɛɛ, koni bɔ ni efee wɔ lɛ, wɔfee lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ."

No hewɔ lɛ Yuda hii akpei etɛ̃ yiŋ amɛtee tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Etam tɛsaa lɛ mli lɛ mli, ni amɛyakɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Ani oleee akɛ Filistibii lɛ amɛ amɛji mɛi ni yeɔ wɔnɔ lo? Hewɔ lɛ, mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ?" Eto he akɛ, "Bɔ ni amɛfee mi lɛ, nakai mi hu mifee amɛ lɛ."
Yuda hii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo fīi wɔba nɛɛ, koni wɔkɛ o ayawo Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ." Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkãa mi kitã akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛgbeŋ mi."
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Dabi, fīi kɛkɛ wɔbaafī o, koni wɔkɛ o ayawo amɛdɛŋ; shi gbee lɛ wɔgbeŋ o." No hewɔ lɛ amɛfī lɛ kɛ taŋkpei hei enyɔ, ni amɛjie lɛ kɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli kɛje kpo.

Be ni eshɛ Lehi lɛ, Filistibii lɛ bɔ oshe amɛkɛ lɛ bakpe. Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ bayi Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ kple, ni taŋkpei lɛ ni yɔɔ eniji lɛ tsɔmɔ tamɔ odonti ni akɛ la esa he, ni taŋkpei lɛ tserɛ yɛ eniji.
Kɛkɛ ni ena teji kadaa ŋmɔŋ ko. Ekpã enine mli ekɔ, ni ekɛgbe hii akpe.
No hewɔ lɛ Samson kɛɛ: "Teji kadaa mikɛgbe amɛ mibua shi; gbohii jwere gbohii anɔ, teji kadaa mikɛgbe hii akpe."
Be ni ewie egbe naa lɛ, eshɛ kadaa ni ehiɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ efɔ̃; ni awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Ramat-Lehi.
Kɛkɛ ni kumai ye Samson waa naakpa. Ebo etsɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, "Otsɔ̃ otsulɔ nine nɔ otsu yiwaleheremɔ nitsumɔ kple nɛɛ; ni mɛɛba ni magbo kɛ kumai moŋ ni magbee foolɔi nɛɛ adɛŋ?"

Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ he ko ni enyɔ yɛ Lehi lɛ gba, ni nu tue kɛba. Kɛkɛ ni Samson nu. Ni be ni enu nu lɛ emumɔ ku esɛɛ eba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ En-Hakoree. Eyɛ Lehi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Samson nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ be ni Filistibii yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli.
16: Samson yiŋ etee Filistibii amaŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gaza lɛ mli. Eyana yoo ajwamaŋ ko yɛ jɛi, ni etee eyawɔ eŋɔɔ.

Ayagba Gazabii lɛ akɛ, "Samson eba biɛ." Kɛkɛ ni amɛsa eyi, ni amɛwi lɛ ka nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa. Amɛsɛ̃ koniŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ: "Nyɛhãa wɔmɛa kɛyashi je aaatsɛre koni wɔgbe lɛ."

Shi Samson kã shi kɛyashi nyɔɔŋteŋ, ni ete shi nyɔɔŋ te lɛ mli. Emɔmɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ shinai lɛ kɛ shinaatsei enyɔ lɛ amli, ni efã kɛ esɛɛlaa adabaŋ lɛ fɛɛ. Ekɛtswa ekɔŋ, ni etre kɛtee gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Hebron hiɛ lɛ yiteŋ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Samson tsui mɔ yoo ko yɛ Sorek jɔɔ lɛ mli. Egbɛi ji Delila.

Filistibii alumɛi lɛ ba Delila ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Lakamɔ lɛ ni ona nɔ mli ni ehewalɛ kple lɛ yɔɔ kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔɔnyɛ lɛ wɔmɔ koni wɔfī lɛ ni wɔjɔɔ ehe. Kɛkɛ lɛ wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaahã o jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kɛ oha."
No hewɔ lɛ Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi nɔ mli ni ohewalɛ kple lɛ yɔɔ kɛ bɔ ni aaafee afī o ni anyɛ ohe ajɔɔ."
Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji amɛkɛ kpãi hei ŋmɔji kawekawee kpawo fī mi lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii alumɛi lɛ kɛ kpãi hei ŋmɔji kawekawee kpawo bahã Delila, ni ekɛfī Samson.

Shi Delila yɛ mɛi ni ewo antɛo yɛ pia lɛ mli. No hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ." Kɛkɛ ni Samson tserɛ kpãi lɛ amli tamɔ anaanu kpãa hwiãa tseɔ kɛ esa la he lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ Samson hewalɛ lɛ teemɔŋ sane lɛ ejeee kpo.
Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Naa, mihe fɛo sɔŋŋ oyeɔ nɛɛ, ni olaka mi. Ofai nɛ, agbɛnɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni aaafee afī o."
Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji amɛkɛ taŋkpee kpãi hei ni akɛtsuko nɔ ko dã fī mi lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ."

No hewɔ lɛ Delila ŋɔ taŋkpee kpãi hei ekɛfī lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ!" Shi mɛi ni ewo antɛo lɛ yɛ pia lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni Samson tserɛ taŋkpee kpãi lɛ yɛ eniji oookɛɛ kpãa hwiãa ko kɛkɛ ni.

Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ, mihe fɛo sɔŋŋ oyeɔ, ni olakaa mi. Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni aaafee afī o." Ni ekɛɛ Delila akɛ, "Kɛji omɔmɔ miyitsɔi akuklu kpawo lɛ ofī, ni okɛ piŋ mɔ lɛ kpɛŋŋ lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ, ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ."

No hewɔ lɛ be ni Samson ewɔ lɛ, Delila mɔmɔ Samson, yitsɔi akuklui kpawo lɛ afī, ni ekɛ piŋ mɔ lɛ kpɛŋŋ. Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ." Shi Samson hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli, ni efã piŋ lɛ yɛ eyitsɔi lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, "Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ, oosumɔ mi be ni otsui bɛ mihe lɛ? Shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛ ni olakaa mi, ni otsɔ̃ko mi nɔ mli ni ohewalɛ kple lɛ yɔɔ."
Bɔ ni Delila yeɔ Samson tsui sɔŋŋ daa gbi kɛ ewiemɔi lɛ, ni ehiɛ Samson doo lɛ, ehã jeŋshihilɛ po je Samson tsine. No hewɔ lɛ,

egba Delila eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ ekɛɛ, "Asooyi naa esako miyiteŋ pɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi kɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ beebe. Kɛji ashɛ miyi lɛ, no dani mihewalɛ lɛ aaaje mimli, ni magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ."

Be ni Delila na akɛ Samson egba lɛ eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ lɛ, etsu koni ayakpee Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ kɛba; ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa shi kome nɛɛ hu, ejaakɛ egba mi eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ." Kɛkŋ ni Filistibii alumɛi lɛ ba. Amɛhiɛ shika lɛ kɛba.
Delila wɔle Samson be ni Samson yitso kã enakutsei anɔ. Etsɛ nuu ko, ehã ebashɛ Samson yitsɔi akuklui kpawo lɛ, ni ehewalɛ lɛ je emli.
Kɛkɛ ni Delila kɛɛ, "Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ." Samson hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ ewɔ lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Maje kpo tamɔ tsutsu lɛ ni mahoso mihe." Shi eleee akɛ Yehowa ekpa yɛ esɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ mɔ lɛ ni amɛfamɔ ehiŋmɛii. Amɛkɛ lɛ tee Gaza. Amɛkɛ akɔɔble gboklɛi enyɔ wo lɛ, ni amɛhãa ewiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli.
Shi eyitsɔi ni ashɛ lɛ, bɔ̃i tsaa ekoŋŋ.
Eba mli akɛ Filistibii alumɛi lɛ babua amɛhe naa koni amɛshã afɔle kple amɛhã amɛnyɔŋmɔ Daon lɛ, koni amɛnya, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔnyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã wɔye wɔhenyɛlɔ Samson lɛ nɔ kunim."
Be ni Filisttibii lɛ na Samson lɛ, amɛjie amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔhenyɛlɔ ni ekpãtã wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni egbegbee wɔteŋ mɛi babaoo lɛ, wɔnyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã wɔye enɔ kunim."
Be nu amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɛtsɛa Samson kɛbaa bi ebajie wɔhiɛtserɛ." No hewɔ lɛ amɛyatsɛ Samson yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli, koni ebajie amɛhiɛtserɛ. Amɛhã edamɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ateŋ.
Samson kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ enineshi lɛ akɛ, "Ŋmɛ̃ɛ mi gbɛ ni matra akulashiŋi ni tsu lɛ ma nɔ lɛ ahe makwɛ, mi makpasa amɛ."
Agbɛnɛ shīa lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ hii kɛ yei. Filistibii alumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ jɛi; ni hii kɛ yei aaafee akpei etɛ̃ yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ amɛmiikwɛ bɔ ni Samson jieɔ mɛi ahiɛtserɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson tsɛ Yehowa ni ekɛɛ, "Ao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa o fai kaimɔ mi ni ohã mi hewalɛ shi kome nɛɛ kɛkɛ. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã matɔ mihiŋmɛii enyɔ nɛɛ he owele shi kome yɛ Filistibii lɛ anɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Samson mɔmɔ teŋ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ni tsu lɛ ma nɔ lɛ mli; ekɛ eninejurɔ mɔ ekome mli, ni ekɛ ebɛku hu mɔ ekome mli. Ekɛ etsiimɔ ŋmɛ amɛnɔ,

ni ekɛɛ, "Hã mi kɛ Filistibii lɛ agboi." Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsi akulashiŋi lɛ, ni shīa lɛ wule shwie lumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Mɛi ni Samson gbe yɛ egbele mli lɛ ayi fa fe mɛi ni egbe be ni ehiɛ kã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee ni amɛyawo lɛ. Amɛkɛ lɛ ba amɛbafu lɛ yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol teŋ yɛ etsɛ Manoa fuuhe lɛ. Samson nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
17: Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mika hi shi yɛ Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ.
Ekɛɛ enyɛ akɛ, "Jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kome kɛ oha lɛ ni awo yɛ odɛŋ, nɔ ni olomɔ yɛ he ni owie he hu yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, naa, eyɛ midɛŋ; mi miwo." Enyɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ o mibi."

Mika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kɛ oha lɛ ku sɛɛ hã enyɛ. Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ kɛɛ, "Mijie jwiɛtɛi nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ, ni mijɔɔ nɔ mihã Yehowa yɛ mibi lɛ hewɔ; akɛfee amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ nɔ ni ashwie; enɛ hewɔ lɛ mikɛmiiku sɛɛ mahã o."
Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ ku sɛɛ hã enyɛ. Enyɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli kukuji ohai enyɔ hã nishwielɔ, koni ekɛfee amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ nɔ ni ashwie; ni akɛba Mika we lɛ.
Nuu Mika nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni ejaa yɛ. Efee amãgã ni akɛgbaa kɛ wɔji; ni ewo ebihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome osɔfo koni eye osɔfo ehã lɛ.
Nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni sa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.
Shi oblanyo ko yɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ. Ejɛ Yuda weku lɛ mli; Levinyo ji lɛ, ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Betlehem.
Oblanyo nɛɛ fã yɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ koni eyahi he fɛɛ he ni eeena. Egbɛfãa lɛ mli lɛ, eyaje Mika we lɛ yɛ Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ.
Mika bi oblanyo lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛɛ?" Oblanyo lɛ to he akɛ, "Levinyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ. Miiya miyahi he fɛɛ he ni mina."
Mika kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ mi abahi shi ni otsɔ̃ ŋaawolɔ kɛ osɔfo ohã mi. Daa afi naakplɔ lɛ, mahã o jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ atade kɛ oniyenii."
Levinyo lɛ kplɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ Mika aaahi shi, ni ekɛ Mika hi shi tamɔ ebihii lɛ eko.
Mika wo oblanyo lɛ osɔfo, ni oblanyo lɛ tsɔ̃ Mika osɔfo, ni ehi Mika we lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛɛ, "Kpaako mina mile akɛ Yehowa baahã mashwere, ejaakɛ mina Levinyo akɛ osɔfo."
18: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel. Nakai be lɛ mli hu lɛ Dan akutso lɛ miitao amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ko amɛhã amɛhe koni amɛyahi nɔ; ejaakɛ kɛbashi nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛnako amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ.

No hewɔ lɛ Danbii lɛ tsu hii kãkãlɔi enumɔ kɛjɛ amɛweku lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛjɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol, koni amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛkpa lɛ shi. Amɛkɛ mɛi ni atsu lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakpaa shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ shi." Amɛba Mika shīa lɛ yɛ Efraim gɔ̃ji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbawɔ jɛi.
Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Mika shīa lɛ, oblanyo lɛ wiemɔ hã amɛyoo akɛ Levinyo ji lɛ. Amɛgba kɛtee shīa lɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ kɛ o ba biɛ? Mɛni ofeɔ yɛ biɛ? Mɛni otsuɔ yɛ biɛ?"
Oblanyo lɛ to he akɛ, "Mika kɛ mi eye efua, ni ebɔ mi apaa koni maye osɔfo mahã lɛ."
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, ni obi Nyɔŋmɔ ohã wɔ bɔ ni afee ni wɔle akɛ wɔgbɛ ni wɔnyiɛ nɛɛ aaafee omanyɛ lo?"
Osɔfo lɛ to he hã amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa kɛ omanye. Yehowa hiŋmɛi kã nyɛhe yɛ gbɛ ni nyɛyiɛ nɛɛ mli!"

Kɛkɛ ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ kɛshwie nɔ kɛtee Laish. Amɛna jɛibii lɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ shweshweeshwe amɛhã, tamɔ Sidonbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ kpoo ni amɛyiŋ efeee amɛ kɔshikɔshi yɛ mɔ ko he lɛ. Nɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni he hiaa amɛ; niiatsɛmɛi ji amɛ. Amɛkɛ Sidonbii lɛ ateŋ jekɛ, ni amɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ shramɔ.
Be ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol lɛ, amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, te nyɛyana tɛŋŋ?"
Mɛi ni atsu lɛ kɛɛ, "Nyɛtea shi ni wɔyaa wɔyatutua amɛ, ejaakɛ wɔyana shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ehi naakpa. Mɛni nyɛtra shi nyɛfeɔ? Nyɛkashashaoa shi kwraa ni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛfea nyɛnɔ.
Kɛ nyɛtee lɛ, nyɛbaaya nyɛyanina gbɔmɛi ni kwɛɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ko gbɛ. Shikpɔŋ ni da ni. Anɔkwale mli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã nyɛ. Eji he ko ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nibii fɛɛ mli ekoeko he bɛ ona yɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni hii ohai ekpaa ni jɛ Danbii aweku lɛ mli ni emia kɛ tawuunii fã kɛjɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol,
ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee amɛyabɔ nsra yɛ Kiriat-Yearim yɛ Yuda. No hewɔ lɛ atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Dan Shitoohe kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ. Eyɛ Kiriat-Yearim anaigbɛ.
Amɛfo mli yɛ jɛi kɛtee Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ, ni amɛba Mika shīa lɛ masɛi.

Kɛkɛ ni hii enumɔ lɛ ni tee yasra Laish shikpɔŋ lɛ bi amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛle akɛ shīai nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli lɛ efod kɛ wɔji kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie yɛ mli lo? No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛkwɛa nɔ ni nyɛaafee."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛgba jɛi; ni amɛba Levinyo oblanyo lɛshīa ni ji Mika shīa lɛ, amɛŋã oblanyo lɛ.
Ni Danbii mɛi ohai ekpaa lɛ ni emia kɛ amɛtawuu nii lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa.
Ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ ni tee yasra shikpɔŋ lɛ bote shīa lɛ mli ni amɛyahole amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ kɛ efod lɛ kɛ wɔji kɛ amãgã ni ashwie lɛ.
Be ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ bote Mika shīa lɛ ni amɛyahole amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ kɛ efod lɛ kɛ wɔji lɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie lɛ, osɔfo lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ?"
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Feemɔ diŋŋ; okɛ onine ato onaabu, ni obaho ni wɔtee koni oyatsɔ̃ wɔŋaawolɔ kɛ wɔsɔfo. Te emli nɔ ni hi hã o lɛ, akɛ oooye osɔfo ohã gbɔmɔ kome we aloo akɛ oooye oha Israel muu fɛɛ?"
Sane lɛ ŋɔɔ osɔfo lɛ naa. Ehole amãgã ni akɛgbaa lɛ kɛwɔji lɛ kɛ efod ni akpɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba mɛi aŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee. Amɛhã gbekɛbii lɛ kɛ shīa looloi lɛ kɛ nibii lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛgbɛ.
Be ni amɛkɛ Mika shīai lɛ teŋ gbɛ ejekɛ lɛ, abo atsɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shīai ni bɛŋkɛ Mika shīa lɛ amli lɛ, ni amɛtiu Danbii lɛ.
Amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Danbii lɛ ayisɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Danbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbi Mika akɛ, "Mɛni feɔ o hewɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɛi babaoo baa nɛɛ?"
Mika to he akɛ, "Nyɛŋɔ minyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni mifee lɛ kɛ osɔfo lɛ, kɛmiiya; mɛni eshwɛ mi dɔŋŋ? Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛbiɔ mi akɛ, 'Mɛni feɔ o' lɛ?"
Danbii lɛ kɛɛ Mika akɛ, "Kaahã anu ogbee yɛ wɔteŋ ni mlilatsɛmɛi nɛɛ miitsɛ̃ kɛmiiba onɔ ni amɛbakpãtã bo kɛ owe lɛ mli bii ahiɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Danbii lɛ kɛshwie nɔ. Be ni Mika na akɛ amɛhe wa fe lɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee eshīa.
Danbii lɛ ŋɔ nibii ni Mika efee lɛ kɛ esɔfo lɛ, ni amɛtee Laish. Emli bii lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ kpoo ni amɛkwɛɛɛ efɔŋ ko gbɛ ji amɛ; shi Danbii lɛ kɛ klaŋte gbe amɛ ni amɛshã maŋ lɛ.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni hereɔ Laishbii lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ Sidon jekɛ ni amɛ Laishbii lɛ, amɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nɔ ko feemɔ. Laish maŋ lɛ kã Bet-Rehob jɔɔ lɛ mli. Danbii lɛ saa to maŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi mli.
Amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ Dan ni ji Yakob bi lɛ gbɛi Dan lɛ wo maŋ lɛ. Shi sa lɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Laish.
Danbii lɛ kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ ma shi hã amɛhe. Yonatan, Mose bi Gershom bi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ ye osɔfo hã Dan akutso lɛ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nom lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Danbii lɛ kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ ni Mika fee lɛ ma shi amɛhegbii abɔ fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ yɔɔ Shilo lɛ.
19: Nakai bei lɛ amli be ni maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel lɛ, Levinyo ko yato gbɔ yɛ Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ he ko shɔŋŋ. Ekɛ yoo ko ni jɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda lɛ fee hemɔ.
Shi yoo lɛ mlifu nuu lɛ ni eshi nuu lɛ etee etsɛ we yɛ Betlehem Yuda, ni eyaye nyɔji ejwɛ yɛ jɛi.

Kɛkɛ ni ewu lɛ yiŋ etee koni eyatu esɛɛ ni ekɛ lɛ awie yɛ tsuijurɔ naa koni ekpla lɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ. Nuu lɛ kɛ etsulɔ kɛ tejii enyɔ tee. Be ni Levinyo lɛ tashɛ yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ we lɛ ni eshaanuu lɛ na lɛ lɛ, ehere lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ.
Shaanuu lɛ tsī Levinyo lɛ naa, ni Levinyo lɛ kɛ shaanuu lɛ hi shi gbii etɛ̃. No hewɔ lɛ nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ ye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko ni amɛhishi yɛ jɛi.
Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛte shi leebi maŋkpa, ni Levinyo lɛ miitao eyi mli, kɛkɛ ni eshaanuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ aboloo atrɔma kome ko asa onaa koni no sɛɛ dani nyɛyi mli."
No hewɔ lɛ hii enyɔ lɛ ho amɛtra shi, ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ eshaanuu lɛ akɛ, "Kplɛ̃mɔ ni owɔ biɛ ŋmɛnɛ hu ni omii ashɛ ohe!"
Be ni nuu lɛ te shi ni ebaayi mli lɛ, eshaanuu lɛ tsī enaa, ni ewɔ jɛi ekoŋŋ.
Gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa ni ebaaya, kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Wo onaa nɔ ko dã. Hii shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi." No hewɔ lɛ shaahiimɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ye nii.

Be ni nuu lɛ kɛ ehemɔ lɛ kɛ etsulɔ lɛ te shi ni amɛbaayi mli lɛ, eshaanuu lɛ ni ji yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Amrɔ nɛɛ, je ena etã, nyɛwɔa; duŋ baawo nɔŋŋ. Wɔ biɛ ni omii ashɛ ohe, koni nyɛte shi maŋkɛ mra ni nyɛyi mli, ni oya omaŋ."
Shi nuu lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ ni ewɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ ete shi ni eyi mli. Ebɛŋkɛ Yebus ni ji Yerusalem ŋlɛnɔ. Ekɛ ehemɔ lɛ nyiɛ kɛ tejii enyɔ ni awo amɛnɔ nii.

Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛɔ Yebus lɛ, je ena etã. No hewɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, "Hã ni wɔgba kɛya Yebusbii amaŋ nɛɛ mli ni wɔyawɔ jɛi." 12-13. Shi enuŋtsɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔgbaŋ kɛyaŋ mɛikpɔji amaŋ ko mli, maŋ ni jeee Israelbii amaŋ. Shi moŋ wɔbaafoŋ kɛya Gibea." Ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔtsi wɔshɛ wɔhiɛgbɛ he ko ni wɔyawɔ Gibea loo Rama."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛfoŋ kɛtee amɛhiɛ. Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Gibea ni ji Benyaminbii amaŋ lɛ lɛ, hulu nyɔ shi wo amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛgba Gibea koni amɛyawɔ jɛi. Be ni amɛshɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Levinyo lɛ ho eta maŋ lɛ blohuŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ amɛ kɛyaaa eshīa koni amɛyawɔ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ naa nuumo ko ni eyatsu nii yɛ enumɔ mli ni eku esɛɛ eeba gbɛkɛnaashi mli. Efraim gɔ̃ji lŋ anɔ nyo ji lɛ, ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Gibea maŋ lɛ mli. Gibeabii lɛ Benyaminbii ni.
Be ni nuumo lɛ yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena nuu gbɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ yɛ blohu lɛ mli. Nuumo lɛ bi nuu lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ oyaa, ni nɛgbɛ ojɛ?"
Levinyolɛ to he akɛ, "Wɔjɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ; wɔmiifo mli kɛmiiya Efraim gɔ̃ji lɛ asɛɛgbɛ shɔŋŋ. Efraimnyo ji mi. Mitee Betlehem yɛ Yuda, shi mimaŋ miyaa nɛɛ; ni mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ mi kɛyaaa eshīa.
Shi wɔyɛ jwɛi kɛ niyenii hã wɔtejii lɛ, ni aboloo hu yɛ hã mi kɛ oblayoo lɛ kɛ oblanyo lɛ ni fata wɔhe lɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiãaa wɔ."
Nuumo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Oba kɛ omanye. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaahia o lɛ, mahã o; blohu lɛ mli kɛkɛ ni okawɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ nuumo lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee eshīa mli. Ehã tejii lɛ anii. Gbɔi lɛ fɔfɔɔ amɛnaji ahe; ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko.

Shi be ni amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli bii komɛi ni ji hii yakagbɔmɛi babɔle shīa lɛ kɛkpe. Amɛshimɔ shinaa lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ shīatsɛ ni ji nuumo lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ nuu lɛ ni bato oshīa lɛ aje kpo kɛba ni wɔkɛ lɛ awɔ."
Shi nuumɔ lɛ ni ji sīatsɛ lɛ je kpo kɛba amɛŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Dabida, minyɛmimɛi! Nyɛkafea efɔŋni tamɔ enɛ; akɛni nuu nɛɛ ebato mishīa nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛkafea nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ.
Naa, mibi oblayoo fro kɛ nuu lɛ hu hemɔ. Mikɛ amɛ moŋ baaje kpo kɛba ni nyɛfite amɛ ni nyɛfee amɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; shi nuu nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkafea lɛ nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ."

Shi hii lɛ booo lɛ toi. No hewɔ lɛ Levinyo lɛ ŋɔ ehemɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ je kpo kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ blohu lɛ mli. Amɛnyɛ yoo lɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛ lɛ wɔ, ni amɛfee lɛ niseniianii nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ ni be ni je bɔi tsɛremɔ lɛ, amɛŋmɛ̃ɛ ehe.
Hiɛfutɛfutɛ mli lɛ, yoo lɛ ba ni ebaho ebu shi yɛ nuumo lɛ shīa lɛ he ni ewu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ shinaa lɛ shi kɛyashi be ni hiɛ gble.
Be ni ewu lɛ te shi leebi ni egble shīa lɛ shinaa lɛ ni ebaaje kpo eya lɛ, naa yoo lɛ ni ji ehemɔ lɛ bu shi yɛ shīa lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eniji jwere kpoku lɛ nɔ.
Ewu lɛ kɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi ni wɔtee" shi fɛɛ lɛ kranaa. Kɛkɛ ni ewu lɛ wo egbonyo lɛ eŋmɛ eteji lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛshwie nɔ kɛtee emaŋ.
Be ni eshɛ ewe lɛ, ekɔ kakla, ni emɔ ehemɔ lɛ mli, ni eflɔ emli yɛ etalɔi lɛ anɔ kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Ehã akɛtee akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amli akɛyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Afeko nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã ni asaŋ anako nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã kɛjɛ gbi ni Israelbii jɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ. Nyɛsusua he, nyɛwoa he ŋaa, nyɛwiea he."
20: Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ Dan yɛ kooyigbɛ aahuu kɛyashi Beersheba yɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ bokãgbɛfã kɛba. Amɛbabua amɛhe naa amɛfee asafo kple kome yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa.
Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpai lɛ badamɔ shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ mli. Asafo lɛ yibɔ ji, hii ni nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ, mɛi akpei ohai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ tawuu.
Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ nu he akɛ Israelbii lɛ efã kɛtee Mizpa. Agbɛnɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, "Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ bɔ ni fee ni aye nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ."
Levinyo lɛ ni ji yoo ni agbe lɛ wu lɛ hã hetoo ni ekɛɛ, "Mikɛ mihemɔ ba Benyaminbii amaŋ ni ji Gibea koni wɔbawɔ jɛi.
Gibea hii lɛ te shi wo, ni amɛgba nyɔɔŋ amɛbɔle shia ni miyɔɔ mli lɛ, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe. Amɛgbɔnyɔ mihemɔ lɛ aahuu ni egbo.
Miwo mihemɔ lɛ, ni miflɔ emli dukukuku ni mikɛmaje Israelbii ashikpɔŋ ni ji amɛgboshinii lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ Benyanimbii ebɔ musu ni amɛfee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel.
Naa, nyɛ Israelbii fɛɛ nɛ. Mɛni nyɛkɛɔ; nyɛwoa he ŋaa!"
Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi damɔ shi tamɔ gbɔmɔ kome, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaŋ ebuu mli, ni wɔteŋ mɔ ko ekuŋ esɛɛ eyaŋ eshīa.
Shi nɔ wɔbaafee ji akɛ wɔbaafɔ̃ oshiki koni wɔkɛna bɔ ni wɔbaatua lɛ wɔhã.

Wɔbaajie hii nyɔŋma yɛ mɛi oha fɛɛ oha mli, hii oha yɛ akpe fɛɛ akpe mli, hii akpe yɛ akpei nyɔŋma fɛɛ akpei nyɔŋma mli kɛjɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ mli koni amɛyaŋɔ niyenii amɛbahã maŋ lɛ. Ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaya amɛyagbla Gibeabii atoi yɛ hiɛgbejianii ni amɛtsu yɛ Israel lɛ hewɔ."
No hɛwɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fī tɔo, ni amɛfee jwɛŋmɔ kome amɛwo Gibea maŋ lɛ.
Israel akutsei lɛ tsu mɛi kɛtee Benyamin akutso muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ yiŋsha sane pam aye yɛ nyɛteŋ nɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛjiea hii, yakagbɔmɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Gibea lɛ kɛbaa, koni wɔgbea amɛ ni wɔkɛjie nɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ Israel."
Shi Benyaminbii lɛ boo amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ atoi. Shi moŋ amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛjɛ maji lɛ amli kɛtee Gibea, koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ ayawu.
Nakai gbi lɛ Benyaminbii lɛ bua hii tawulɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa naa kɛjɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli;
esoro hii ohai kpawo ni jɛ Gibea ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ. Hii abɛkulɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɛɔ yitsɔi gaŋŋ kome akromia efɔ̃ɔ ni eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ.
Kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ bɛ mli lɛ, Israel tabilɔi lɛ anaa shiɔ hii akpei ohai ejwɛ ni emīa kɛ klaŋte; ni atsɔse amɛ jogbaŋŋ hã tawuu.
Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel, ni amɛyabi Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ŋaawoo akɛ "Wɔteŋ namɔ tsutsu afã kɛya ni ekɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu?" Yehowa kɛɛ, "Yuda tsutsu afã."
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ te shi leebi ni amɛyabɔ nsra amɛwo Gibea.
Amɛfã kɛtee koni amɛkɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu. Israelbii lɛ gba ta wo Benyaminbii lɛ yɛ Gibea.
Kɛkɛ ni Benyanimbii lɛ fã kpo kɛjɛ Gibea, ni amɛbakpãtã Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ hiɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa nakai gbi lɛ.
Shi Israelbii lɛ na ekãa, ni amɛgba ta lɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ he ni amɛgba yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee ni amɛyafo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ, ni amɛbi Yehowah nii akɛ "Ani wɔtsi wɔbɛŋkɛ ekoŋŋ ni wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi, Benyaminbii lɛ, ayawu?" Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfãa ni nyɛkɛ amɛ ayawua."
No hewɔ lɛ gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Benyaminbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Gibea gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakpãtã Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋma lɛ kpaanyɔ hiɛ; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii tawulɔi ni.

Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ni ji ta muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel ni amɛyafo. Amɛho amɛtra shi yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛhi ŋmãa nakai gbi lɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Amɛshãshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ jɛi,

ni mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ji Finehas, Aaron bi Eleazar bi lɛ. Israelbii lɛ bi Yehowa akɛ, "ani wɔfã ekoŋŋ ni wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbiilɛ ayawu aloo wɔfɔ̃ɔ?" Yehowa kɛɛ, "nyɛfãa kɛyaa ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛye amɛnɔ kunim."
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ to kawolɔi kɛbɔle Gibea kɛkpe.
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã kɛyanina Benyaminbii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛgba ta amɛwo Gibea tamɔ tsutsu lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ fã kpo kɛbanina Israelbii lɛ. Agbla Benyaminbii lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛbɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ nitswiamɔ kɛ amɛgbee tamɔ tsutsu lɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni kã keyaa Betel kɛ nɔ ni kã kɛyaa Gibea yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ. Amɛgbe Israel hii aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Benyaminbii lɛ kɛɛ, "Wɔgbɛ amɛta lɛ tamɔ tsutsu lɛ nɔŋŋ." Shi Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔjoa foi ni wɔkɛgbla amɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛba gbejegbɛi lɛ anɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Israel hii lɛ fɛɛ tetee shi yɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ ni amɛyagba ta yɛ Baal-Tamar. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii ni ewo ka lɛ fãfãa kpo kɛjɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ yɛ Gibea anaigbɛ;
ni hii akpei nyɔŋma ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ kɛjɛ Israel fɛɛ lɛ te shi wo Gibea. Ta lɛ mli bawa po ni ehii; shi Benyaminbii lɛ leee akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ etã.
Yehowa hã Israelbii lɛ ye amɛnɔ kunim. Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãtã Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛ oha hiɛ; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii tawulɔi sɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Benyaminbii lɛ na faŋŋ akɛ aye amɛnɔ. Akɛni Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kã mɛi ni amɛhã amɛwo ka kɛbɔle Gibea lɛ anɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛnaa sɛɛsɛɛ amɛhã Benyaminbii lɛ.
Hii ni ewo ka lɛ he fee oya, ni amɛtsɛ̃ kɛba Gibea nɔ. Amɛgba amɛyi maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ klaŋte gbe maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi okadi ni Israel hii lɛ kɛ kawolɔi lɛ eto yɛ amɛteŋ ji akɛ kɛ kawolɔi lɛ na lasu te shi kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli akɛ okadi lɛ,

Israelbii lɛ adɔ amɛyi kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli. Agbɛnɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ebɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nitswiamɔ kɛ amɛgbee, ni amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, "wɔnine etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ba yɛ tsutsu ta lɛ mli lɛ."
Shi be ni lasu kutuu lɛ bɔ̃i shitee kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ ŋmɛiyaa lɛ, Benyaminbii lɛ kwɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛna akɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miitso kɛmiiya ŋwɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel hii lɛ dɔ amɛhe. Ŋmiŋmi mɔ Benyamin hii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛ̃hã Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ; shi ta lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ waa. Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fã nɔŋŋ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛbote Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛgbegbee Benyaminbii lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ sa Benyaminbii lɛ ayi, ni amɛnyiɛ Benyaminbii lɛ asɛɛ kɛyashi Noha. Amɛnaanaa Benyaminbii lɛ anɔ aahuu kɛyashi Gibea ŋlɛnɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ.
Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋma-kɛ-kpaanyɔ nyɔnyɔɔi; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni.

Mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛyaa Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he gbɛ lɛ. Agbe Amɛteŋ hii akpei enumɔ yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ; anyiɛ amɛsɛɛ waa kɛtee Giseom, ni asaa agbe amɛteŋ hii akpei enyɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɔ nakai gbi lɛ yɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ ji hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ tawulɔi kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni.
Shi hii ohai ekpaa pɛ tse yɛ ta lɛ naa, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛtee Rimon tɛsaa lɛhe. Amɛhi jɛi nyɔji ejwɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛwo Benyaminbii krokomɛi lɛ. Amɛkɛ klaŋte gbegbee Benyaminbii lɛ; amɛgbe gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli kɛ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baje amɛgbɛ nɔ. Asaŋ maji fɛɛ ni amɛyanina lɛ, amɛmamɔ fɛɛ naa la.
21: Agbɛnɛ Israel hii lɛ ekãmɔ kitãi yɛ Mizpa akɛ, "Wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ebiyoo akahã Benyaminnyo gblã."
No hewɔ lɛ maŋ lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel. Amɛhi shi yɛ jɛi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Amɛfo waa kɛ dɔlɛ,
amɛkɛɛ: "Ao Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba enɛ ba yɛ Israel akɛ ŋmɛnɛ akutso kome elaaje yɛ Israel?"
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ te shi maŋkɛ mra, ni amɛma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi. Amɛshã shãa afɔlei kɛ hejɔlɛ afɔlei.
Israelbii lɛ bi akɛ, "Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ, te akutso ni fataaa Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he kɛbaaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ amɛkã kitã wulu akɛ mɔ ni baaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa lɛ, 'Gbe agbe lɛ.'"
Benyaminbii lɛ anii fee amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ mɔbɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ atse akutso kome yɛ Israel he ashɛ afɔ̃.
Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ hu ni wɔna ŋãmɛi wɔhã mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, akɛni wɔkã Yehowa kitã akɛ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei haŋ Benyaminbii gblã nɛɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, "Te Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni lɛ lɛ ebɛ mli ni atee Yehowa ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa lɛ?" Ana akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko jɛɛɛ Yabesh ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ baaa nsra lɛ mli kɛ kpee wulu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ni akane maŋ lɛ, ana akɛ Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ flo bɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ kpee lɛ tsu hii ni feɔ ekãa fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni amɛfã amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbea Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ kɛ klaŋte, yei kɛ hii fɛɛ hu.
Bɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Hii fɛɛ kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni le nuu lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ butubutu."
Mɛi ni atsu lɛ yana oblayei froi ohai ejwɛ yɛ Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ ateŋ ni leko nuu, ni amɛkɛ oblayei nɛɛ ba nsra lɛ mli, yɛ Shilo ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni kpee muu lɛ fɛɛ tsu akɛ wiemɔ yahã Benyaminbii ni yɔɔ Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he lɛ akɛ, akɛ amɛ ekpãtã.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba nakai be lɛ mli, ni akɛ yei ni ahere amɛyiwala yɛ Yabesh-Gilead yei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hã amɛ gblã; shi no tete lɛ eshɛɛɛ amɛ.
Benyaminbii lɛ anii fee maŋ lɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã mligblamɔ eba Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ kpee lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛɛ, "Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ wɔna ŋãmɛi wɔhã mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, akɛni akpãtã Benyamin yei lɛ ahiɛ nɛɛ?"
Amɛkɛɛ, "Esa akɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ ko ahi shi ahã Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni yi na wala lɛ, bɔ ni aee ni akutso ko seshi akabule yɛ Israel.
Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei lɛ ahã amɛ gblã, ejaakɛ Israelbii ekã kitã akɛ, 'Alomɔ mɔ ni aaaŋɔ yoo ko ahã gblã yɛ Benyamin.'"
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛ: "Daa afi lɛ ayeɔ Yehowa gbijurɔ yɛ Shilo. Shilo kã Betel kooyigbɛ kɛ Lebona wuoyigbɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni kã kɛjɛ Betel kɛyaa Shekem lɛ bokãgbɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã Benyaminbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyatea yɛ waintromi lɛ amli.
