Kɛji Shilo oblayei lɛ je kpo ba amɛbajo lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛfãa kpo kɛjea waintromi lɛ amli kɛbaa koni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abamɔ eŋã yɛ Shilo oblayei lɛ ateŋ, koni nyɛkɛ amɛ aya Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Ni kɛji amɛtsɛmɛi ba nyɛŋɔɔ amɛkɛ nyɛ babe lɛ, nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛkwɛa wɔhewɔ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ ahãa wɔ; ejaakɛ jeee ta mli wɔshɔ̃ amɛ yɛ, yɛ nyɛdɛŋ koni wɔkɛ amɛ afee wɔŋãmɛi; ni asaŋ jeee nyɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ hã wɔ ni eeeba lɛ akɛ nyɛaatere wɔyi sɔ̃ ko.'"
Benyaminbii lɛ fee nakai. Amɛmɔmɔ ŋãmɛi yɛ amɛyikulɛ naa yɛ mɛi ni bajo lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ kɛtee. Kɛkɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ. Amɛsaa maji lɛ amɛmamɔ, ni amɛhi mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hu shi jɛi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ku esɛɛ kɛtee ekutso kɛ eweku mli, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee lɛ duɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ ko bɛ Israel; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni ja yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.

1: Kwɛ bɔ ni maŋ ni kulɛ emli bii fa babaoo lɛ, ta shi ekome too! Kwɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ okulafo; lɛ maŋ ni kulɛ eje agbo yɛ majimaji ateŋ lɛ. Lɛ ni kulɛ lumɔ ji lɛ yɛ maji ateŋ lɛ, ŋmɛnɛ, etsɔ̃ mɔ ni atsuɔ lɛ onia.
Fo sɔŋŋ efoɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; yaafonu jwere ehiɛ be fɛɛ be; shi enaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ esuɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ ni shɛjeɔ emii. Enanemɛi lɛ fɛɛ yeee lɛ anɔkwa; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi.
Yuda eshi eshikpɔŋ nɔ yɛ amanehulu kɛ nyɔŋyeli tuutu hewɔ; eyahi majimaji lɛ ateŋ; shi enaaa hejɔlɛ yɛ he ko he ko. Ehenyɛlɔi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ anine eshɛ enɔ yɛ nififiaŋ.

Gbɛjegbɛi ni yaa Zion lɛ miiye awerɛhoo, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko baaa ebayeee gbiijuji ni ato lɛ. Emaŋ agboi lɛ kãmɔ eflo esɔfoi lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, eblayei lalɔi lɛ efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eena nɔ naakpa.
Ehenyɛlɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ yitso agbɛnɛ, ni amɛmiishwere, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã eena nɔ yɛ etɔ̃mɔi babaoo lɛ ahewɔ. Ebii etee; amɛnyiɛ henyɛlɔi ahiɛ kɛtee akɛ nomii.
Yerusalem anumnyam fɛɛ etã. Elumɛi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ ofrotei ni naaa niyelihe ko; amɛjo foi yɛ henyɛlɔi ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ wrɔmiiwrɔmii kɛtee.

Yerusalem kaiɔ, yɛ emanehulu kɛ haomɔ gbii lɛ amli, ojrawa nibii ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ. Be ni emaŋbii gbee henyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni bualɔ ko bualɔ ko bɛ lɛ, henyɛlɔi lɛ ye ehe fɛo ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ yɛ eshigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Yerusalem fee esha kple ni no hewɔ lɛ ehe wo muji. Mɛi fɛɛ ni kulɛ amɛwoɔ Yerusalem lɛ miibu lɛ shikpɔŋ agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna ayayaiaŋ. Naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eekɛ̃mɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ eto afã.
Ehe muji kpa etadei amli; shi ejwɛŋŋ bɔ ni enaagbee baatamɔ. Eshigbeemɔ lɛ yɛ gbeyei, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni shɛjeɔ emii! "Ao! Yehowa, kwɛ bɔ ni minaa amanehulu, ejaakɛ henyɛlɔi eye kunim."
Ehenyɛlɔ ekpã enine mli ewo Yuda nibiiaŋ, ni eloo ejwetri ni jra wa fɛɛ kɛtee. Ena jeŋbii bote Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, mɛi ni ogu amɛ owebii ateŋ futumɔ tete po lɛ.
Emaŋbii lɛ bluublu dɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi be ni amɛtao niyenii; amɛkɛ amɛjwetri tsakeɔ niyenii, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkagboi; "Ao! Nuŋtsɔ, kwɛmɔ mi ni mihe guɔ egbo.

"Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ biɛ kɛhoɔ, ani jeee nyɛhe sane ko ni lo? Nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛaana akɛ awerɛhoo ko yɛ ni etamɔ miwerɛhoo ni kã minɔ nɛɛ, awerɛho ni Yehowa ehã eba minɔ yɛ emlifu ni naa wa gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
"Ehã la jɛ ŋwɛi ebote miwui amli; ekɛ yaa lɛɛ shi etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne; ehã mikpale; eshi mi, ni mifee butuu, ni gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ mifee vii.
"Abua mitɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa afee apã, ekɛ enine fi amɛ ke, ni ewo efɔ̃ mikuɛ; ehã mihewalɛ gbɔjɔ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie mi ewo mɛi ni minyɛŋ amɛhiɛ madamɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
"Nuŋtsɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mi hii kãkãlɔi ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ akɛ amɛhewalɛ jeee fɛifɛi; ni etsɛ asafo ewo mihe koni amɛbakpãtã miblahii lɛ ahiɛ. Nuŋtsɔ enaanaa Yuda biyoo oblayoo lɛ nɔ tamɔ waintsɔne ŋaa wain.
"Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ mifoɔ, ni yaafonu tsereɔ yɛ mihiŋmɛii amli shwieɔ shi lɛ; ejaakɛ mishɛjelɔ ni aaawo mi ekãa ekoŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ mi teŋ ejɛkɛ. Mibii lɛ efee pasaa ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ eye amɛnɔ.
"Migbɛ mifijiaŋ; shi mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni shɛjeɔ mimii. Yehowa efã akɛ Yakob nanemɛi maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi. Yerusalem etsɔ̃ muji nii yɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ.
"Yehowa sane ja, ejaakɛ miyeee ewiemɔ nɔ. Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛkwɛa nɔnaa mli ni miyɔɔ. Miblahii kɛ miblayei lɛ aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee.
"Mitsɛ misuɔlɔi lɛ shi amɛlaka mi. Misɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ kpãtã yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, be ni amɛtaoɔ niyenii amɛye koni amɛkagboi lɛ.
"Ao! Yehowa, kwɛmɔ mi, ejaakɛ miyɛ hejramɔ mli; misusuma miina nɔ, ni mitsui miitse yɛ mimli ejaakɛ mitse ohiɛ atūa fe nine. Klaŋte miikpãta mɛi ahiɛ yɛ blohuŋ, ni shīa teŋ hu, gbele miimɛ.
"Bo bɔ ni mikɛ̃mɔɔ toi ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni shejeɔ mimii. Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ enu mimanehulu lɛ he, ni amɛmiinya akɛ bo odɛŋ ejɛ. Hã gbi ni owo ehe shi lɛ aba, koni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ mi.
"Kwɛmɔ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ koni okɛ amɛ aye tamɔ bɔ ni okɛ mi ye yɛ minifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ. Mikɛ̃ɛmɔ lɛ naa wa, ni mitɔ biti."
2: Kwɛ bɔ ni Yehowa eŋɔ atatu eha Zion nɔ yɛ emlifu naa. Eshɛ Israel anumnyam lɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Emlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekaiii Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni ji enajiashi maaŋoo lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ekpãtã Yuda shihilɛhei fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni enaaa mɔbɔ. Ekumɔ Yuda biyoo lɛ mɔji eshwie shi yɛ emlifu naa. Etsi emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ emli lumɛi etswia shi, ni ewo amɛ hiɛgble.
Efite Israel hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa. Wamɔ ni ekɛbawa Israel lɛ ehã eŋmɛɛ Israel, yɛ Isreal henyɛlɔi ahiɛ. Ekpatã nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ Israel tamɔ la ni miitso grigri.
Egbla egãi tamɔ henyɛlɔ feɔ; ekɛ eninejurɔ eta gãi lɛ tamɔ henyɛlɔi, ni egbe mɛi fɛɛ ni ji wɔshwãanii. Ejie emlifu kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yerusalem shīai lɛ amli tamɔ la.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ henyɛlɔ, ni ekpãtã Israel hiɛ. Efite emaŋtsɛwei lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekpãtã emɔji ni wa lɛ ahiɛ; efee amɛ koikoi, ni ehã ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ yaafo efa yɛ Yuda.

Ekumɔ ejamɔhe lɛ eshwie shi tamɔ trom mli asese. Ekpãtã he ni ayeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbijuji ni eto yɛ lɛ hiɛ. Yehowa efo gbiijuji kɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii asɛɛ yɛ Zion, ni ekwa maŋtsɛ kɛ osɔfo fɛɛ yɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyaŋe afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ; ni ekwa Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni eŋɔ ehe mɔji fɛfɛji lɛ ehã henyɛlɔ lɛ. Ablɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli tamɔ ablɔɔ yɛ gbijurɔ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ etswa efai shi akɛ ebaakpãtã Zion maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ hiɛ. Eŋmɔ kpãa ekɛsusu gbogbo lɛ, eŋmɛko efitemɔ he kwraa. Ehã kpoku kɛ gbogbo fɛɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ; amɛjwere shi butuu.
Zion agboi lɛ enyɔ kɛbote su mli, akumɔ ni afite amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Emaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ eyaje jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ. Mla lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, egbalɔi lɛ enaa Yehowa dɛŋ ninaa ko dɔŋŋ.
Zion maŋ onukpai lɛ shwata shikpɔŋ, ni amɛfee diŋŋ. Amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteiaŋ, ni amɛbumɔ kpekpe. Yerusalem oblayei lɛ emamɔ amɛhiɛ shi.
Mihiŋmɛiŋ nu etã kɛ yaafo, ni misusuma miifo emli. Mitsui ekumɔ kɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã mimaŋbii ahiɛ; ejaakɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii etɔ biti yɛ maŋ lɛ blohui amli.
Amɛmiifo amɛmiitsɛ amɛnyɛmɛi akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ aboloo kɛ wain yɔɔ?" Be mli ni amɛtɔtɔɔ biti, tamɔ pilafoi yɛ maŋ lɛ blohui amli, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ akpɔkɔiaŋ lɛ?

Ao! Yerusalem biyoo, mɛni makɛɛ yɛ ohe, ni mɛni he mikɛ bo baato? Ao! Zion biyoo, oblayoo fro, mɛni he mikɛ bo aaato bɔ ni afee ni manyɛ omii mashɛje? Ejaakɛ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ falɛ lɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ dalɛ, ni namɔ po aaanyɛ bo atsa?
Ninai ni ogblalɔi lɛ egba bo lɛ, apasa kɛ shishiumɔ sɔŋŋ ni; amɛkpako onifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe mama koni no ahã oje nomŋɔɔ mli; shi moŋ amale kɛ lakamɔ ninai sɔŋŋ amɛna.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ tswaa amɛdɛŋ amɛshwieɔ onɔ; amɛboɔ Yerusalem biyoo lɛ "Tsiaa". Amɛbiɔ akɛ, "Maŋ lɛ ni akɛɔ akɛ ehe yɛ fɛo (fe fɛɛ) lɛ nɛ, jeŋ fɛɛ nyamnii lɛ nɛ?"
Ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ŋmɔɔ bo, ni amɛboɔ bo 'Tsiaa!' Amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi, ni amɛblɔɔ akɛ, "Wɔkpãtã ehiɛ pɛ! Yiɛ! Gbi lɛ ni wɔshwe aahuu lɛ nɛ; eshɛ wɔdɛŋ, ni wɔna hu!"
Yehowa etsu eyiŋtoo lɛ he nii; nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ efee tamɔ bɔ ni eto jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ. Ekpãtã nibii ahiɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli; ehã henyɛlɔ lɛ eye bo yɔɔ. Ni ehã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ena onɔ hewalɛ.
Ao! Yerusalem biyoo blɔmɔ waa otsɛ Yehowa! Hã yaafonu aho yɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ tamɔ faa, shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ. Kaajɔɔ ohe; kaafɔ̃ɔ yaafo!

Tee shi koni obo yaafo nyɔɔŋ be fɛɛ be ni bulɔi jeɔ buu shishi. Fɔsemɔ otsuiŋ fɛɛ oshwie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, tamɔ afɔseɔ nu ashwieɔ shikpɔŋ. Holemɔ oniji anɔ otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ obii bibii ni hɔmɔ ehã amɛtɔ biti yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu koŋ lɛ awala hewɔ.
Ao! Yehowa, kwɛmɔ koni oyoo mɔ ni ofee lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ lɛ. Aso ehi akɛ yeifɔyei aye amɛmusuŋbii ni ahiɛ amɛ yɛ fufɔ naa lɛ? Aso ehi akɛ agbe osɔfo kɛ gbalɔ fɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lo?
Gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai fɛɛ jwere mlu mli yɛ blohuiaŋ; miblayei kɛ miblahii lɛ enyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa. Oye awui yɛ omlifu gbi lɛ nɔ; ogbe amɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli.
Okpee henyɛlɔi ni misheɔ lɛ tamɔ akpeɔ mɛi kɛyaa gbijurɔyeli okɛbabɔle mi kpula; ni omlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ejeee mli, ni hiɛkãalɔ ko hu eshwɛɛɛ. Henyɛlɔ lɛ plenee mɛi ni milɛ misumɔɔ lɛ.
3: Miji gbɔmɔ ni mina amanehulu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ naa.
Ekpla mi, ni ekɛ mi ba duŋ ni la ko kwraa bɛ mli lɛ mli.
Anɔkwa, be fɛɛ be nɛɛ lɛ, mi pɛ minɔ ewoɔ enine nɔ yɛ daa.
Ehã miheloo diɛŋtsɛ etã yɛ migbɔmɔtso he, ni ekumɔ miwui yɛ mimli
Ehã saji kɛ joomɔ kɛ nɔnaa ebɔle mi kpula kɛsa miyi.
Ehã mihi duŋ mli tamɔ mɛi ni egboi jeeŋmɔ lɛ.
Etswa gbogbo ekɛsa miyi bɔ ni minyɛŋ foi maje; ekɛ gboklɛi ni tsii ewo mi.
Tsɛbelɛ mibo mitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shi ebooo mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi.
Ekɛ tɛi ni ako eshwie migbɛ nɔ; ehã migbɛ ekɔdɔ̃; tsɔ̃mɔhe bɛ.
Etamɔ oshishibrishi ni ewo ka, loo jata ni etee ehe.
Ekpla mi kɛje migbɛ nɔ, ni etserɛ mimli dukuduku, ni efee mi pasaa.
Eta egãi lɛ ema minɔ ni ebaatsɛ̃ mi.
Etsɛ̃rɛ̃ egãi kotoku lɛ mli gãimlibii lɛ ewo mitsuiŋ.
Mitsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli nɔ mihã mɛi fɛɛ, kɛ amɛdaaŋ lala gbi muu fɛɛ.
Ehã miyi obɔ̃ kɛ joomɔ; ehã jeŋshihilɛ ejoo ewo mi tamɔ taatso.
Ehã mikpe ŋmlitsa; ehã mikoklo shi yɛ lamlu mli.
Mileee nɔ ni toiŋjɔlɛ ji lɛ, mihiɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekpa nɔ ni ji miishɛɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, minumnyam etã, ni mibɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.
Kaimɔ minɔnaa kɛ mishitwiamɔ ni joɔ tamɔ taatso kɛ kɔlikɔ lɛ.
Misusuma jwɛŋɔ he daa nɛɛ, ni ehã misusuma edɔ kɔmɔɔ kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli yɛ mimli.
Shi miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ̃ kɛ mikai akɛ.
Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ sɛɛ efooo kɔkɔɔkɔ, ni emɔbɔnalɛ bɛ naagbee.
Daa leebi lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ hee; Yehowa anɔkwayeli da kple.
Misusuma kɛɔ akɛ, "Migbɛfaŋnɔ ji Yehowa ni no hewɔ lɛ mihiɛ baakã enɔ."
Yehowa mli hi hã mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ, kɛ mɔ ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu.
Ehi akɛ atoɔ tsui shi kpoo amɛɔ Yehowa yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.
Ehi hã gbɔmɔ akɛ etreɔ ekɔŋtso lɛ yɛ eblahiiaŋ.
Kɛji awo kɔŋtso lɛ atere lɛ, ekome eta shi, ni efee dioo. eshwie Zion nɔ; ni eshã maŋ lɛ kɛmɔ eshishitoo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.
Eba ehe shi kpoo, ejaakɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ̃ aaahi shi.
Agbla etoiiaŋ ma, ni abɔ lɛ ahora kpɔtɔɔ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shɛɛɛ mɔ efɔ̃ɔɔ kɛyaaa naanɔ;
ejaakɛ ehãa mɔ he jraa lɛ moŋ, kɛ̃lɛ emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.
Jeee esuɔmɔnaa ji akɛ ehã gbɔmɔ he ajra lɛ, asaŋ akɛ efee gbɔmɔ nidɔɔnii.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le kɛji wɔsusumai etɔ bahao tamɔ gboklɛfoi ni yɔɔ kpabui amli.
Ele kɛji aye mɔ ko toikɔ̃dɔ̃mɔ̃ sane;
Kɛji atsɔ̃ mɔ ko sane hiɛ abu shi lɛ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le.
Namɔ efã ni eba mli pɛŋ akɛ ja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eŋmɛ gbɛ dã?
Ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ daaŋ ejeɔ?
Mɛni hewɔ gbɔmɔ gbigbliɔ emli kɛji agbla etoi yɛ ehe eshai ahewɔ lɛ?
Nyɛhãa wɔtaoa wɔjeŋba mli wɔkwɛa koni wɔkpale kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ.
Nyɛhãa wɔgblea wɔtsuii amli ni wɔholea wɔniji anɔ wɔhãa Nuŋtsɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ni wɔkɛhã akɛ,
"Wɔtɔ̃, ni wɔtse atuã, ni, Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛfako wɔ.
"Okɛ mlifu ha ohe, ni onyiɛ wɔsɛɛ, ni ogbe wɔ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli.
Okɛ mlifu ha ohe, koni faikpamɔ ko akanyɛ egbu kɛtsɔ̃ mli kɛbashɛ oŋɔɔ.
Ohã wɔtsɔ̃ kponɔ muji kɛ tumu yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
"Wɔhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ miibɔ wɔ ahora; ni amɛmiijɛ wɔ.
Wɔyoyro, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ oshrãi amli wɔtswia shi, ni wɔnibii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã kɛho
"Mihiŋmɛi miifɔse yaafonu tamɔ faa yɛ mimaŋbii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã lɛ ahewɔ.
"Mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu baaho daa, ni efɔŋ
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaajɛ ŋwɛi ema ehiɛ shi ekwɛ wɔ.
Miyeɔ hejramɔ kɛji mina sane ni eye mimaŋ oblayei lɛ.
"Mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ gbɔbi mi, tamɔ agbɔbiɔ looflɔ.
Amɛshɛ mi, hiɛkãalɔ, amɛfɔ̃ bu mli ni amɛkɛ tɛi shwie minɔ!
Nu su miyi, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, 'Milaaje'.
"Ao! Yehowa, mijɛ bu lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ mibo mitsɛ bo,
ni onu mifaikpamɔ lɛ. 'Kaakɛɛ akɛ obooo miblɔmɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ toi.'
Be ni mitsɛ bo lɛ, otsi obɛŋkɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, 'Kaashe gbeyei!'
"Ao! Yehowa, otsu misane lɛ he nii ohã mi; ohere miyiwala.
Ao! Yehowa, ona sane fɔŋ ni akɛye mi lɛ, yɛ misane lɛ ohã mi.
Ona owele ni amɛtɔ kɛ yiŋshai fɛɛ ni amɛto yɛ mihe lɛ.
"Ao! Yehowa, onu ahora ni amɛbɔɔ mi lɛ, kɛ yiŋshai fɛɛ ni amɛto yɛ mihe lɛ.
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anaabu kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwere minɔ.
Naa, leebileebi jenamɔ fɛɛ lɛ miji amɛdaaŋ kotsa.
"Ao! Yehowa, feemɔ amɛ otse, yɛ amɛnifeemɔ nii lɛ anaa.
Kaahã amɛmii shɛ amɛhe; oloomɔ akã amɛnɔ.
Ao! Yehowa, okɛ mlifu atiu amɛ, ni okpãtã amɛhiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
4: Kwɛ bɔ ni shika edī tuŋŋ; bɔ ni shika ŋmiiŋmi etsake ehã! Agbɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ tɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ashwã gbɛjegbɛ fɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ koŋ.
Zion, oblahii ni ajra wa tamɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ.
Ŋaŋgbei tete hãa amɛbii fufɔ amɛkɛlɛɔ amɛ; shi mimaŋbii lɛ ayitsoŋ wa; amɛwaa amɛbii ayi, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ shiaŋa nɔ okpɔŋɔlooflɔ̃.
Gbekɛ fufɔoo sɛŋ gbiɔ kɛ kumai; gbɛkɛbii baa niyenii, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko hãaa amɛ.
Mɛi ni ye amɛnaa nii lɛ, ahiɛ ekpãtã yɛ blohuiaŋ; mɛi ni alɛ amɛ fɔfɔɔle lɛ jwere tumu nɔ lamlu mli.
Ejaakɛ mimaŋbii ahe esha lɛ da fe Sodom he esha lɛ, Sodom ni abutu lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli ni gbɔmɔ adesa nine bɛ mli lɛ.
Ebladei lɛ ahe tse keŋkeŋ, amɛyɛɔ fe ayilɔ, amɛgbɔmɔtsei yɛ hewalɛ fe teŋɛ̃lɛo, amɛhe fɛo tamɔ safiro.
Shi agbɛnɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ miidi fe ŋai, ni ayooo amɛ yɛ blohuiaŋ; amɛheloo egbi ekpɛtɛ amɛwui ahe, heloo lɛ egbi keketee tamɔ tso.
Mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ anɔ hi kwraa fe mɛi ni gboɔ yɛ hɔmɔ naa lɛ, fe mɛi ni ŋmɔshi nibaanii ni amɛnaaa amɛye ni no hã amɛtã loo ni amɛpiŋ lɛ.
Be ni akpãtãa mimaŋbii ahiɛ lɛ, yeifɔyei ni yɔɔ musuŋtsɔlɛ tete hoo amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmusuŋbii amɛye.
Yehowa gri kɛ mlila ni naa wa ni efã emlifu lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ eshwie Zion nɔ; ni eshã maŋ lɛ kɛmɔ eshishitoo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.
Je lɛ mli maŋtsɛmɛi heee yeee, ni gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ hu heee yeee, akɛ henyɛlɔ ko aaanyɛ Yerusalem agboi amli ebote.
Shi eba mli, ejaakɛ Yerusalem gbalɔi lɛ fee esha, ni esɔfoi lɛ fee nɔ fɔŋ; amɛshwie jalɔi ala shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛfo shi kɛnyiɛ blohui lɛ amli tamɔ shwilafoi. Lá ewu amɛhe kpɔtɔɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni mɔ ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ amɛtadei ahe eta.
Mɛi blɔɔ woɔ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjea jɛi! Nyɛmɛi ni he tseee! Nyɛjea jɛi! Nyɛkataa nɔ ko he!" No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi, ni majimajianɔbii kɛɛkɛɛ yɛ amɛteiaŋ akɛ, "Amɛkahi wɔteŋ dɔŋŋ! "
Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã, ni ebuuu amɛhe akɔŋtaa dɔŋŋ; ebuuu osɔfoi lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni ehiɛ esɔɔɔ onukpai lɛ hu dɔŋŋ.
Wɔhiŋmɛi shiu kɛ yakagbɛ ni wɔkwɛ yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ; wɔbu, ni wɔkwɛ jaku ko ni nyɛɛɛ wɔ ehere gbɛ.
Henyɛlɔi wɔɔ wɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ wɔblohuiaŋ tete wɔnyiɛ. Wɔnaagbee lɛ eshɛ, gbii lɛ etã; ejaakɛ wɔnaagbee lɛ eshɛ.
Mɛi ni nyiɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ ahe yɛ oya fe okropɔŋ; amɛnyiɛ wɔsɛɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni amɛwo wɔ ka yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Mɔ dɛŋ ni wɔwala yɔɔ, ni ji maŋtsɛ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ, ni amɛmɔ lɛ ŋaa mli. Lɛji mɔ ni wɔkɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, "Yɛ lɛ eshishi lɛ, wɔɔhi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ" lɛ.
Edombii kɛ Uzbii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nyɛmli aflia nyɛ, ni nyɛnaa, shi moŋ nyɛ hu amanehulu miiba. Nyɛaatɔ dãa, ni nyɛaajie nyɛyayaiaŋ nyɛfɔ̃ shi.
Ao! Zion, agbe otoigblamɔ yɛ onishaianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ naa. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ haŋ ohi nomŋɔɔ mli dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ bo Edom, ebaagbla otoi yɛ onishaianii lɛ ahewɔ; ebaahã ohe eshai lɛ abakã kpo nɔ.
5: Ao! Yehowa, kaimɔ nɔ ni eba wɔnɔ lɛ; kwɛmɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ eshwie shi!
Wɔgboshinii etsɔ̃ gbɔi anɔ, ni wɔshīai eyaje gbɔi adɛŋ nɛɛ.
Wɔtsɔ̃mɔ awusãi, wɔbɛ tsɛmɛi, ni wɔnyɛmɛi etsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi.
Nu ni wɔnuɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ shika heɔ, ni lai hu ni wɔshãa lɛ, ja wɔhe.
Ataa wɔkuɛ nɔ kɛ nitsumɔ, ni etɔ wɔ, shi ahãaa wɔ mumɔhe.
Daaŋŋmãa hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔhe hã Egipt kɛ Asiria.
Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fee esha, ni amɛho amɛtee; ni wɔ moŋ amɛsɔ̃ ebatere wɔ.
Wɔnyɔji miiye wɔnɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni kpɔ̃ɔ wɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Gbɔmɔgbelɔi hiɛ klaŋte yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ wɔkɛ wɔwala shwɛɔ asɔ dani wɔnaa nii wɔyeɔ.
Hɔmɔ ni yeɔ wɔ lɛ naawalɛ ehã wɔhe edɔ tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli.
Ato yei lɛ kabonaa yɛ Zion, ni Yuda oblayei froi lɛ hu ato amɛ kabonaa.
Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsɛŋɔ maŋ lumɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ eshwieee onukpai ahiɛiaŋ.
Anyɛɔ oblahii anɔ ni amɛwiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ tamɔ nyɔji; ni gbekɛbii hii didãa yɛ lai kei ni amɛtretree ashishi.
Hiimeji ekpa koishi yaa, ni oblahii hu ekpa amɛsaŋkutswaa.
Wɔtsuiiaŋ miishɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ efo, ni joo ni wɔjoɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli.
Wɔnumnyam akekre eje wɔyitso egbee shi. Kpoo hã wɔ! Ejaakɛ wɔfee esha.
Wɔtsui ekumɔ, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ wɔhiŋmɛii anɔ efee tuutuu.
Ejaakɛ Zion Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃. Jɛi etsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashikpaahe.
Shi Ao! Yehowa, bo lɛ boji maŋtsɛ kɛyaa naanɔ; omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i yɛ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ.
Mɛɛba ohiɛ aaakpa wɔnɔ kɛya naanɔ? Mɛɛba ni okwa wɔ be babaoo nɛkɛ? Ani okaiŋ wɔ kwraa dɔŋŋ?
Ao! Yehowa, kpalemɔ wɔ kɛba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni wɔɔkpale lɛɛlɛŋ. Daimɔ wɔblema shihilɛ lɛ ohã wɔ!
Aloo okwa wɔ kwrakwra? Ani omli efu wɔ waa fe nine?

1: Yehowa jɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli etsɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko miiba ekɛ kooloo abashã afɔle ehã mi, Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ etsinai lɛ loo etoi lɛ ateŋ eko abashã afɔle lɛ.
Kɛji tsina ekɛbaa afɔleshãa lɛ, ehiɛ tsina nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ebahã. Ekɛ kooloo lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni Yehowa ahe efɔle lɛ.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ afɔleshãa kooloo lɛ yiteŋ, ni abaaŋɔ kooloo lɛ akɛshã afɔle ni akɛkpãtã ehe eshã lɛ ahã lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ egbe tsina nuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koji ejwɛ lɛ he lɛ kɛkpe.
Mɔ lɛ akpɔ kooloo lɛ hewolo lɛ koni esaa loo lɛ.
Aaron bihii lɛ ato lai amɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛshɛre la lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ amɛto loo ni asaa lɛ, yitso lɛ kɛ emli fɔ lɛ, amɛshwie lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nuu lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe; ni osɔfo lɛ ashã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; shãa afɔle ni, afɔle ni akɛ la shãa kooloo lɛ fɛɛ ni. Afɔle nɛɛ jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
"Shi kɛji too gwaŋtɛŋ loo abotia mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ, ehiɛ gwantɛŋ nuu loo abotia nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛba.
Egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ekooyigbɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbaswã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Mɔ lɛ asaa loo lɛ; ni osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai be lɛ ato kooloo ni asaa lɛ: Yitso lɛ kɛ emli fɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ashwie lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

Shi mɔ lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe. No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ni tsuɔ nii nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nomɛi hu baashi nɔ, ni eshã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shãa afɔle ni; afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
"Shi kɛji looflɔ mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpo loo shīa okpo pɛmpɛoo.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ looflɔ lɛ abaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; etsɔ̃mɔ ni etse looflɔ lɛ yitso, ni eshã loofiɔ lɛ loo lɛ, shi looflɔ lɛ lá lɛ astere kɛnyiɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Ejie looflɔ lɛ kpɔŋɔshi kɛ emlinii lɛ koni eshɛrɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ebokãgbɛ he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ.
Emɔ looflɔ lɛ fiji lɛ amli koni egba looflɔ lɛ mli, shi ekakplɔ efiji lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ ashã looflɔ lɛ yɛ lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Shãa afɔle ni; afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni."
2: "Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ŋmãa miiba abashã afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ, egblɛ ŋmãa lɛ mã. Ekɛ mu ashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma hu afata he;

koni ekɛbahã Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ. Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpiti mã lɛ kɛ mu lɛ ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma lɛ fɛɛ koni ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ afɔle muu ni akɛbahã Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ. Eji shãa afɔle, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashãa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni; eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ eko ni.
"Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee ŋmãa nii ni ashã yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ, nɔ lɛ efee mã akpiti keeki ni akɛ mu wo mli ashã, loo mã akpiti akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mu ekpa hiɛ.
"Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee nii ni ashãa yɛ looshãa dade nɔ lɛ, no lɛ efee nii ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu fee niyenii.
Akumɔ afɔle lɛ mli dukuduku, ni afɔse mu ashwie nɔ. Niyenii afɔle ni.
"Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee niyenii ni ashī yɛ ŋɛsu mli hu lɛ, afɔle lɛ afee niyenii ni akɛ mã akpiti kɛ mu fee.
Akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ nibii nɛɛ fee lɛ aba akɛ Yehowa nikeenii, ni akɛbahã osɔfo lɛ, ni ekɛya afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Osɔfo lɛ ajie niyenii afɔle lɛ mli eko, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ shãa afɔle muu lɛ ni akɛbahā Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni. Eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa mli eko ni.
"Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ko niyenii afɔle ko ni akɛ mã sha fee akabahãa Yehowa, ni nyɛkashãa nɔ ko ni mã sha loo wo yɔɔ mli akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛhãa Yehowa.
Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛŋɔ nibii nɛɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ nii lɛ eko nyɛbahã Yehowa. Shi moŋ akashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ nii ni jeɔ ŋma.

Nyɛwoa nyɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ amli ŋoo. Ŋoo ji nii ni yeɔ kpãŋmɔ ni nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ he odase lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ akashi ŋoo sɛɛ yɛ nyɛniyenii afɔle fɛɛ mli. Nyɛkɛ ŋoo afataa nyɛfɔlei fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛbaa he.
Kɛji niyenii afɔle ni akɛbaahã Yehowa fee ŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nibaanii lɛ mli eko lɛ, no lɛ afɔle lɛ afee able kpokploku ni ashī mamu.
Akɛ mu ashwie nɔ, ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma afɔ̃ nɔ. Niyenii afɔle ni.
Osɔfɔ lɛ ashã mamu lɛ he ni mu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni fata he lɛ hu fɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni akɛbahã lɛ he lɛ hu fɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni akɛbahã lɛ he odaseyeli nɔ. Eji afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa."
3: "Kɛji mɔ ko miiba ebashã toiŋjɔlɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ etsinai lɛ ateŋ eko, tsina lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Mɔ lɛ kɛ enine aŋmɛ tsina lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lã lɛ abashwã afɔleshãa lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Naanyobɔɔ afɔle kooloo lɛ mli nibii ni sa akɛ ashãa ahãa Yehowa ji fɔ fɛɛ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ,
kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni ashã; shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
"Kɛji mɔ lɛ miiba ebashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa kɛ gwaŋtɛŋi loo lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Kɛji mɔ lɛ hiɛ gwaŋtɛŋ kɛba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ,
ni ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe.
Naanyobɔɔ afɔle kooloo nɛɛ mli nibii ni sa akɛ ashãa ahã Yehowa ji emli fɔ lɛ kɛ elei muu ni ajie kɛjɛ ekotosɛɛ wu lɛ tɔ̃ɔ nɔ, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ,
kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ fɔ hu ni yɔɔ amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.
Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni aashã akɛhã Yehowa.
"Kɛji mɔ lɛ kɛ abotia ba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛbahã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ. Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Kooloo lɛ mli nibii ni ekɛbaahã akɛ afɔle ni ashã ahã Yehowa ji fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ,
kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni ha amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ. Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa kɛŋma akɛhã Yehowa. Fɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni.
Isrealbii akaye kooloo fɔ loo lá. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni akã shi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaahi."
4: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
ekɛɛ Isrealbii lɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃ akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni Yehowa ewo lɛ eko nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ akafee lɛ eko be mli ni mɔ lɛ hiɛ kãaa he lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ:
Kɛji Osɔfonukpa lɛ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, ni no ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ etɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛ tsina oblanyo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe abashã ehe esha lɛ he afɔle ehã Yehowa.
Ekɛ tsina nuu lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ekɛ enine afɔ̃ tsina nuu lɛ yiteŋ ni egbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsina nuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli,
ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, koni ekɛ la lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

Osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsina nuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ ajie fɔ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ esha afɔle tsina nuu lɛ mli, ni ji fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ;
ejie esabai enyɔ lɛ fɔ hu ni ha amɛhe lɛ, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ ekɛfata sabai lɛ ahe,
tamɔ ajieɔ nibii nɛɛ yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔleshãa tsina nuu lɛ loo lɛ he lɛ, koni eshã fɛɛ yɛ shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi tsina nuu lɛ hewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ fɛɛ: Eyitso kɛ enaji lɛ kɛ emlinii lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ,

Osɔfonukpa lɛ awo tsina nuu muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo kɛya he ko ni tse yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ he ko, koni eyashã yɛ lai nɔ yɛ jɛi. He ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ, jɛi ashã afɔle nɛɛ yɛ.

Kɛji Isreal asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni tɔ̃ Yehowa kitãi lɛ eko nɔ, ni amɛfee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni amɛhiɛ kãaa he, ni asaŋ amɛkɔɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ ni amɛ̃tɔ lɛ sɛɛ hu, ni no hewɔ lɛ maŋ lɛ eye sɔ̃ lɛ,
kɛji ana ale esha tɔ̃mɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ kɛ tsina oblanyo ashã esha afɔle. Akɛ tsina oblanyo lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsina lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni agbe tsina lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsina nuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli,
ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

Ekɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsina nuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi.
Tsina nuu lɛ fɔ lɛ ejie fɛɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Bɔ ni efee esha afɔle tsina nuu lɛ loo lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee tsina nuu nɛɛ hu loo lɛ, koni ekpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ koni akɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa amɛ.
Ewo tsina nuu lɛ loo lɛ kɛje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni eshã tamɔ bɔ ni eshã lɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ he esha tsina afɔle loo lɛ. Maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle ni.
Kɛji nɔyelɔ ko tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ejaakɛ efee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa he, ni no hewɔ lɛ eye sɔ̃ lɛ,
kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ekɛbashã afɔle.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ. Esha afɔle ni.
Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi la ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Eshã too kpakpo lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei akooloi lɛ amli fɔ lɛ koni kɛtsɔ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛbaafa lɛ.
Kɛji maŋbii lɛ kɛkɛ ateŋ mɔ ko tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ejaakɛ efee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa ewo he kita akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa he, ni no hewɔ lɛ eye sɛ̃ lɛ,
kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ abotia yoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ni ekɛbashã afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle too lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ shidaa afɔlei akooloi amli fɔ lɛ, ni eshã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni eje ŋma ewo Yehowa, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ehã lɛ, ni akɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ baafa lɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ miiba abashã esha afɔle lɛ, ekɛ gwaŋtɛŋ yoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle kooloo yɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ koni akɛshã esha afɔle yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle kooloo lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ naanyobɔɔ afɔle gwaŋtɛŋ lɛ mli fɔ lɛ koni eshã no kɛ niyenii afɔlei yɛ afɛleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa. Ni osɔfo lɛ baakpãtã ahã lɛ, ni akɛ ehe esha lɛ baafa lɛ.
5: Kɛji atsɛ mɔ ko odase yɛ sane ko he, ni emua enaa, ni ewieee, tsɛbelɛ ena aloo ele sane lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ efee esha, ni eye sɔ̃.

Kɛji mɔ ko ta nɔ ko ni he tseee he, ŋa mli kooloo ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, shīa kooloo ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, kooloo ni wamɔɔ ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, kɛ ehiɛ kãaa he ni eta he tete lɛ, akɛni ebule ehe hewɔ lɛ, eye sɔ̃.
Aloo kɛji eta nɔ ko ni he tseee yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛkɛ ni he tseee ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ he, ni eleee, shi kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, eye sɔ̃.
Kɛji mɔ ko eyakwɛɛɛ jogbaŋŋ ni ekã kitã akɛ eeefee efɔŋ loo ekpakpa ko tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi kãa kitã ni amɛjwɛŋŋ he lɛ, kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji lɛ eyeɔ sɔ̃ yɛ mli.
Kɛji mɔ ko ye sɔ̃ yɛ nii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ
ni ekɛ esɔ̃ afɔle abahã Yehowa yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ. Ekɛ gwaŋtɛŋ loo too abotia yoo aba, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Shi kɛji enyɛɛɛ too ehe lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpobii enyɔ aba ebahã Yehowa akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ; okpo kome akɛ esha afɔle kɛ ekome hu akɛ shãa afɔle.
Ekɛ afɔlei enyɔ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Ekɛ nɔ ni ji esha afɔle lɛ aba tsutsu. Etsɔ̃mɔ looflɔ lɛ yitso yɛ ekuɛ nɔ, shi ekatse kɛje nɔ.
Etsɔ esha afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he. Lá ni baashwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. Afɔle ni akɛjieɔ esha kɛyaa ji no.
Looflɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ekɛfee shãa afɔle yɛ gbɛnaa ni ato lɛ naa; koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ koni akɛfa lɛ.
Shi kɛji enyɛɛɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpobii enyɔ ehã lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mã kilo kome aba akɛ esha afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ. Ekɛ mu akawo mli, ni ekɛ ohɛ hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ esha afɔle ni.
Ekɛba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Osɔfo lɛ atī ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ekɛfee afɔle muu lɛ fɛɛ he, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ashãa ŋmãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ nɔ. Esha afɔle ni.
Osɔfo lɛ afee nɛkɛ koni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ, ni akɛ esha ni efee yɛ enɛmɛi eko gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaafa lɛ. Afɔle lɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔle gbɛfaŋ lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

"Kɛji oniai krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsuɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ mɔ ko hãaa egbɛfaŋnɔ, ni no ehã eye sɔ̃ ni eleee lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ afɔle ni ekɛbaahã Yehowa nɛ: etoi lɛ ateŋ too ojwɛni ni he bɛ kpa ko. Too lɛ jra adamɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shika jra nɔ, ni akɛfee sɔ̃ afɔle.

Mɔ ni efee esha yɛ onia krɔŋkrɔŋ ko gbɛfaŋ lɛ ato onia ni ehãaa lɛ najiaŋ, ni ekɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome afata he. Ekɛhã osɔfo lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ akpãtã akɛ sɔ afɔle ahã lɛ, koni akɛ esha ni efee lɛ afa lɛ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko fee esha, ni efee nii ni Yehowa ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, tsɛbelɛ ehiɛ kãaa he moŋ nɛ, shi eye sɔ̃, ni aaagbla etoi.
Emɔ too ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ ehe yɛ etoi lɛ ateŋ. Abu naa, ni ejra afee sɔ̃ afɔle jra, koni ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee ni eleee lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛbaafa lɛ.
Sɔ̃ afɔle ji enɛ; ejaakɛ eye sɔ̃ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ."
6: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Kɛji mɔ ko fee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha yɛ tso ni etso yɛ nɔ ko ni enyɛmi Israelnyo kɛhã lɛ shitoo aloo ekɛto lɛ awaba, aloo eju enyɛmi lɛ nɔ ko, aloo etswa lɛ ojo,
aloo ena nɔ ko ni elaaje ni ekã amale kitã akɛ enako lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafee nibii nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni gbɔmɛi fɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, efee esha.
Kɛ mɔ ko fee esha ni eye sɔ̃ lɛ, eto nɔ ni eju lɛ, loo nii ni ekɛ amimyeli shɔ̃ lɛ, loo nɔ ni akɛto lɛ awaba ni etso akɛ akɛ nɔ ko hãko lɛ, loo nii ni laaje ni eshiu nɔ lɛ,
loo nɔ ko ni ekã he amale kitã lɛ, najiaŋ.
Esɔ̃ afɔle ni ekɛbaahã osɔfo lɛ ni akɛhã Yehowa lɛ nɛ: etoi lɛ ateŋ too ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ ehe; ejra afee bɔ ni bo oootsɔ̃ɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ aaafa lɛ"
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Fã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ, akɛ shãa afɔle he mla nɛ. Shãa afɔle lɛ ahi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni la ahi shishi kɛyashi leebi.
Osɔfo lɛ awo eklala flaka kɛ eklala tswakotoi lɛ koni eloo lamlu lɛ; shi la lɛ ni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ, eshi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi he ko.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ajie etadei lɛ koni ewo ekroko. Ekɛ lamlu lɛ aje kpo kɛya nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛyashwie he ko ni tse.

La lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ akã he atso daa; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko. Daa leebi lɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ lai ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eto shãa afɔle lɛ gbɛjianɔ eshwie nɔ ni eshã toiŋjɔlɛ afɔlei ahe fɔi lɛ yɛ nɔ.
La atso daa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko"
Ŋmãa afɔle lɛ he mla nɛ: "Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome aŋɔ mã lɛ kɛ emli mu lɛ kɛ ohɛ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɔkɔ kome ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Eji okadi kɛkɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ akɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ fɛɛ ehã Yehowa hiɛ.
Afɔle lɛ nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aye. Afee lɛ mã akpiti keeki, ni aye yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ, no ji yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Aboloo akpiti nɛɛ ji osɔfoi lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni mihã amɛ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa mi lɛ mli. Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni, tamɔ esha afɔle kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ.
Bei fɛɛ, yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ, nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ aye akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ mli. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ."
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Gbi nɔ ni afɔɔ Aaron loo eshwie ko mu akɛ osɔfo lɛ, ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome aba abahã Yehowa tamɔ daa ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ. Akɛ fã aba leebi, ni akɛfã hu aba gbɛkɛ.
Akɛ mu ashi yɛ ŋɛsu mli. Kɛ ebe lɛ, akumɔ mli dukuduku ni akɛba akɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni eŋma sa Yehowa hiɛ.
Aaron bihii lɛ atɛŋ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu ni baaye esɛɛ akɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ afee enɛ ahã Yehowa akɛ akpɔ ni kã shi kɛmiiya naanɔ. Ashã afɔle muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Ŋmãa afɔle ni osɔfo lɛ shãa lɛ akaye eko; ashã emuu lɛ fɛɛ."
Yehowa fã Mose

koni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ bɔ ni ashã esha afɔlei lɛ ahã. He ni agbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa shãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ agbe kooloo ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ yɛ ahã Yehowa. Eji afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.
Osɔfo ni gbeɔ kooloo lɛ kɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aye loo lɛ. Eye yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ; no ji yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni taa loo lɛ he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko tsɛ̃ŋe shwie atade he lɛ, afɔ atade loo nɔ lɛ ni lá lɛ tsɛ̃ŋe shwie he lɛ he yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Sū gbɛ ni ahoo loo lɛ eko yɛ mli lɛ, ajwara; shi kɛ akɔɔble loo dadesɛŋ mli ahoo yɛ lɛ, asha mli ni akɛ nu ajale mli.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye loo lɛ eko; eji nɔ ko ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.
Shi esha afɔle fɛɛ esha afɔle ni akɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko aaaba Kpe Buu lɛ mli ni akɛaakpãtã yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ esha ko hewɔ lɛ, akaye; ashã kɛ la.
7: Sɔ̃ afɔle he mla nɛ. Eji afɔle ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ.
Kooloo ni akɛbaashã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ agbe lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ. Kooloo lɛ lá lɛ afɔse ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ he.
Ajie efɔ lɛ fɛɛ, elei ni ewo fɔ lɛ, fɔ ni ha emlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ
sabai enyɔ ni yɔɔ hɛ mli lɛ, kɛ fɔ ni ha amɛhe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ, koni akɛshã afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ la shãa. Sɔ̃ afɔle ni.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye eko; eye yɛ he ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni.
Esha afɔle lɛ etamɔ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ mla kome nɔŋŋ kã shi hã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ: osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ kɛkpãtãa lɛ, enɔ ji loo lɛ.
Kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hewolo lɛ, osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ nɔ ni.
Niyenii afɔle fɛɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli aloo nɔ ni ashãa yɛ nishãa nɔ nɔ, loo nɔ ni ashīɔ yɛ ŋɛsu mli lɛ, osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ hãa Yehowa lɛ nɔ ni.
Shi niyenii afɔle lɛ, awo mli mu jio, afee lɛ egbiŋ jio, Aaron shwiei osɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni; aja lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana tamɔ bɔ ni enyɛmi na lɛ pɛ.
Bɔ ni sa akɛ ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei ahã Yehowa nɛ.
Kɛ afɔle lɛ shidaa afɔle ni lɛ, nibii ni akɛfata he ji keeki ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu shã kɛ akpaanɔɔ ni akɛ mã akpiti ni akpa hiɛ mu shã kɛ keeki ni akɛ mã ni mu enumɔ mli shã.
Kɛshi naanyobɔɔ shidaa afɔlei nɛɛ anɔ lɛ ekɛ keeki ni akɛ mãsha shã hu abashã afɔle.
Nii ni ekɛba lɛ, ejie fɛɛ mli ekomekome ehã, ni akɛfee nɔwomɔ afɔle ahã Yehowa; Osɔfo lɛ ni tsiɔ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eshwieɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ nɔ ni.
Kooloo ni akɛshãa shidaa afɔle lɛ loo lɛ, aye gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; akashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ.
Kɛji afɔle ni mɔ ko kɛba lɛ shiwoo afɔle ni, loo afɔle ni ekɛba yɛ tsuijurɔ naa ni lɛ, no lɛ ebɛ akɛ aye loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛ loo lɛ eko shwɛ lɛ, aye enɔ jetsɛremɔ.
Shi kɛji loo ni eshwɛ lɛ eko ye gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, ashã.
Kɛji gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ko ye loo lɛ eko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hereŋ mɔ ni kɛ afɔle lɛ ba lɛ. Enaŋ he nyɔmɔwo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Nihii nii ji loo lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye eko lɛ, eloo musu.
Loo ni nɔ ko ni he tseee aaasa he lɛ, akaye, ashã. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni he tse lɛ aye loo lɛ eko.
Shi mɔ ni he tseee ni eeeye naanyobɔɔ afɔle loo ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
Asaŋ kɛ mɔ ko aaaye naanyobɔɔ afɔle nɛɛ eko, be mli ni eta nɔ ko ni he tseee he, gbɔmɔ ni he tseee he eta jio, kooloo ni he tseee he eta jio, nɔ kroko ni jio, aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛkayea fɔ ko fɔ ko; tsina fɔ jio, gwaŋtɛŋ fɔ jio, too abotia fɔ jio, nyɛkayea.

Kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele loo kooloo ni kooloo kroko etserɛ emli lɛ, aaanyɛ akɛ efɔ lɛ afee nɔ kroko; shi loo lɛ akaye. Kooloo ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ efɔ lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye kooloo ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
He fɛɛ he ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛkayea lá ko lá ko, looflɔ lá jio, kooloo naji ejwɛ tsɛ jio.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaku mla nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose
koni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle miiba abahã Yehowa lɛ, ajie afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni ji Yehowa nɔ krɛdɛɛ lɛ ahã lɛ,
Ehiɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ kɛba akɛ niyenii afɔle. Akɛ kooloo lɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ etsitsi lɛ fɛɛ aba ni ekɛbahã Yehowa akɛ nikee nii titri ko hã Yehowa.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, shi tsitsi lɛ Aaron kɛ ebii osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
Kooloo lɛ sɛɛ gbɛ nanejurɔ lɛ akɛhã
osɔfo ni shãa naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ ehãa Yehowa lɛ. Akɛhã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ titri ko.
Ejaakɛ kooloo lɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛgbɛ nanejurɔ lɛ mihe yɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ mihã osɔfoi ni ji Aaron kɛ ehwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛnaanɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ daa.
Enɛ ji afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ mli nɔ ni akɛhã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ gbi nɔ ni awoɔ amɛ osɔfo lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ Yehowa fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛkɛhã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ koni efee amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ daa yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ esha afɔlei kɛ sɔ̃ afɔlei lɛ kɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔlei lɛ.
Enɛ he Yehowa wo Mose kitã yɛ gbi nɔ ni ewo Israelbii lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkɛ amɛfɔlei lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
8: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Ŋɔɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ofata ohe, ni oŋɔ atadei lɛ kɛ mɔ mufɔɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsina nuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ kɛ too ojwɛnii enyɔ lɛ kɛ mã akpiti kafu lɛ koni okɛ amɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ naa.
Ni obua asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ naa."
Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ, ni ehã asafo lɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ mifee lɛ, no mibafee nɛɛ."
Mose hã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ ba hiɛ, ni ekɛ nu ju amɛhe.
Ekɛ flaka lɛ wo Aaron, ni ekɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fī emliteŋ. Ekɛ atade yuu lɛ wo Aaron. Ekɛ efod lɛ hu wo lɛ, ni ekɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fī efod lɛ ekpɛtɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ tsitsinɔ nii lɛ to nɔ, ni ekɛ Urim kɛ Tumim lɛ wo tsitsinɔ nii lɛ kotoku lɛ mli.
Ekɛ yitsofīi nɔ lɛ fi Aaron yitso, ni Mose kɛ shika fɛtɛfɛtɛ ni ji hiɛnaa nii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ta yitsofii nɔ lɛ hiɛnaa. Amɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose wo mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ. Efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ mu koni efee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ekɛ mu lɛ eko shwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo kɛfɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ nibii ni akɛtsuɔ nii yɛ he lɛ kɛ lalakã lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ema nɔ lɛ mu, koni efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa.
Mose fɔse mufɔɔ mu lɛ eko eshwie Aaron yiteŋ, ni ekɛfɔ lɛ mu koni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose hã Aaron bii lɛ ba hiɛ. Ewo amɛ flakai; ekɛ amɛmlifii nii lɛ fimɔ amɛmliteŋ, ni ekɛ amɛfaii lɛ bumɔ amɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ tsina nuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie esha afɔle tsina nuu lɛ yiteŋ.

Mose gbe tsina nuu lɛ. Ekɛ ewao tsɔ lá lɛ eko, ni ekɛkpa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe, koni ekɛtsuu he. Mose tsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi. Efee enɛ ekɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ehã Yehowa.
Mose jie fɔ lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi tsina nuu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ Mose kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ eyashã, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ,

ni Mose gbe lɛ. Etsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ kɛbɔle. 20-21. Esaa too ojwɛni lɛ, ni ekɛ nu fɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe. kɛkɛ ni eshã yitso lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ too muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ. Shãa afɔle nɛɛ niyenii afɔle ni; eŋma lɛ sa Yehowa hiɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni ji enyɔ ni agbeɔ akɛ afɔle kɛji aawo osɔfo lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ,
ni Mose gbe lɛ. Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa Aaron ninejura toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.
Mose hã Aaron bihii lɛ hu ba. Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa amɛninejurɔ toi naa kɛ amɛninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ amɛnane gɔnti naa. Kɛkɛ ni efɔse lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Mose ŋɔ fɔ kɛ lei lɛ ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ fɛɛ ni ha mlinii kɛ mlɛbo lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ kɛ sɛɛ nanejurɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ aboloo kome yɛ mã akpiti kafu ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ mli, kɛ aboloo kome ni mu yɔɔ mli kɛ akpaanɔɔ kome, ni ekɛshwie fɔ lɛ kɛ shuɔ jurɔ lɛ nɔ.
Mose kɛ niyenii nɛɛ fɛɛ wo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ; ni efɔ̃ kɛtee kɛba akɛ afɔle ni afɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Mose saa he niyenii lɛ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ eshi shãa afɔlei ni ashãa fɛɛ emuu lɛ anɔ. Eji osɔfowoo afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa Yehowa, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ lɛ.
Mose kɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni lɛ tsitsi lɛ, ni ekɛshã afɔle ehã Yehowa akɛ nɔkee nɔ titri ko. Mose ŋɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni tsitsi lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kīta lɛ.

Mose ŋɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ eko kɛ lá ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ eko, ni ekɛshwã Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Ekɛ enɛ fee Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa.

Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ loo lɛ ayaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni nyɛyahoa. Nyɛyea loo lɛ kɛ aboloo ni yɔ kafu ni akɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei toɔ mli lɛ mli lɛ yɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ. Nyɛyea tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã akɛ, 'Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aye lɛ.'
Loo kɛ aboloo ni aaashwɛ yɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshãa
Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo ni akɛfeɔ nyɛ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ aaaho; ejaakɛ gbii kpawo akɛfeɔ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ.
Nɔ ni afee ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ afee koni akɛjie nyɛhe esha kɛya.
Nyɛhia Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii kpawo koni nyɛkɛfee nɔ ni Yehowa efã akɛ afee lɛ. Kɛji nyɛfeee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi. Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa wo mi kitã."
No hewɔ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose he kitã lɛ.
9: Gbi ni agbe osɔfowoo kusumi lɛ anaa lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Mose tsɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ.

Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ: "Ŋɔɔ tsina nuu fioo kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too ojwɛni kome hu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ni okɛshã afɔle, ohã Yehowa. Okɛ tsina nuu lɛ ashã esha afɔle ni okɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ashã shãa afɔle.
Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛŋɔ too ojwɛni amɛkɛshã esha afɔle; amɛkɛ tsinabi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋbi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle;
ni amɛkɛ tsina nuu kɛ too ojwɛni kɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni awo mli mu ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle. Amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ."
Amɛkɛ nii ni Mose fã amɛ akɛ amɛkɛba lɛ ba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ, ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi koni amɛja Yehowa.
Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Yehowa fã akɛ nyɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enunyam ni kpɛ kaŋkaŋ lɛ ajie ehe kpo atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ".

Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Tsi obɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni oshã esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle ohã ohe koni okɛfɔ ohe esha kɛ maŋ lɛ he esha. Oshã afɔle nɛɛ koni okɛfɔ maŋ lɛ he eshai, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã lɛ."
Aaron tsi kɛtee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni egbe tsina nuu fioo lɛ ekɛshã esha afɔle ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ ba. Aaron kɛ ewao tsɔ mli, ni ekɛdiki koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ. Ni lá ni shwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni eshã fɔ lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ mlɛbo lɛ he loo ni tsotsoro shi lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose kitã lɛ.
Shi kooloo lɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ eshã yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Mose gbe kooloo ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ hu. Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Amɛkɛ shãa afɔle lɛ hu bahã lɛ, loo ni ashãa lɛ kɛ yitso lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni efɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe, ni ekɛshwie shãa afɔle ni jwere afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eshã fɛɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ maŋ lɛ afɔlei lɛ ba. Eŋɔ too kpakpo ni akɛbaashã maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle lɛ; egbe lɛ ni ekɛshã afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha afɔle lɛ.
Eŋɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hu kɛba, ni ekɛsha afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ ba; ni ekpiti emli eko ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ni ekɛfata shãa afɔle ni ashãa daa leebi lɛ he, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni egbe tsina nuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ekɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã maŋ lɛ; ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Tsina nuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ fɔi lɛ kɛ lei ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ
Aaron kɛ fɛɛ shwie kooloi lɛ atsitsii lɛ anɔ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ tsitsii lɛ kɛ sɛɛ ninejurɔ shwuɔ naji lɛ hã Yehowa akɛ nikee nii titri ko, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose ewo kitã lɛ.
Be ni Aaron eshã esha afɔle kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ maŋ lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni ekpleke shi.
Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ Aaron bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli. Be ni amɛje kpo ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛjɔɔ maŋ lɛ. Ni Yehowa anunyam ni kpɛɔ kaŋkaŋ lɛ jie ehe kpo etɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Trukaa lɛ Yehowa hã la ba ni ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ fɔi lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Be ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ, amɛblɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.
10: Shi Aaron bihii ni ji Nadab kɛ Abihu lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo elajee ŋɛsu, ni amɛkɛ la wo mli. Amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛshã amɛhã Yehowa; shi la ni amɛkɛshã lɛ bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ jeee no he kitã Yehowa wo lɛ.
Yehowa hã la ba ebashã amɛ, ni amɛgboi yɛ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Enɛ ji nɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ be ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ mi lɛ esa akɛ abu mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; majie minunyam lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.'" Shi Aaron mua enaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Mishael kɛ Elzafan, Aaron tsɛkwɛ Uziel bii lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ: "Nyɛbaa nyɛbaholea nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ agbohii lɛ kɛjea He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ."
Amɛba ni amɛbahole Aaron bihii lɛ kɛ amɛflakai ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje shitoohe lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ lɛ.

Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar akɛ, "Nyɛkahãa nyɛyiteŋ fea tsaŋtsaŋ aloo nyɛgblaa nyɛtadei kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛmiiyeŋkɔmɔ. Kɛ nyɛfee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi, ni Yehowa mli baawo maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ la. Nyɛhãa nyɛwekumɛi, Israel maŋ muu fɛɛ, afoa shãa ni Yehowa ehã la eshã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ni amɛgboi nɛɛ.
Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa hu ni nyɛbagboi, ejaakɛ akɛ Yehowa mufɔɔ mu lɛ efɔ nyɛ mu "Amɛfee bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ,
"Bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkanua wain loo dãa ni wa ko be mli ni nyɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ. Kɛ nyɛnu dãa lɛ, nyɛbaagboi. Oshwiei fɛɛ aye akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ.
Esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni kã nɔ ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni buleɔ mɔ teŋ; ni esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ.
Nyɛtsɔ̃a Israelbii lɛ akpɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛ amɛ wie he lɛ."

Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni eshwɛ ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar lɛ akɛ, "Niyenii afɔlei ni shwɛɔ yɛ afɔlei ni ashã ahã Yehowa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshãa mã akpiti aboloo ni nyɛyea yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he ejaakɛ afɔle nɛɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni fe fɛɛ ni.
Nyɛyea yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛgbɛnaa nii ji niyenii afɔle nɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ shãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ asɛɛ lɛ. Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Yehowa kitã ni ewo mi.

Shi tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ ni akɛhãa Yehowa akɛ keenɔ lɛ nyɛyea yɛ he ko ni tse, bo kɛ ohibii kɛ obiyei lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ akɛ afɔlei nɛɛ ehã bo kɛ obii lɛ akɛ nyɛgbɛnaa nii yɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔlei ni Israelbii lɛ shãa lɛ amli.

Akɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛ shwuɔ lɛ afata fɔi lɛ ahe kɛba, be mli ni ashãa fɔi lɛ akɛ afɔle ahãa Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ. Tsitsi lɛ kɛ shwuɔ lɛ, bo kɛ obihii lɛ agbɛnaa nii ni akɛhã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ ni. Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ afee."
Mose tao too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aahuu kɛyashi ena ele akɛ ashã momo. Mose mli wo Eleazar kɛ Itamar Aaron bihii ni eshwɛ lɛ la ni ekɛɛ,
"Mɛɛba nyɛyeee esha afɔle lɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ? Nɔ ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ji afɔle lɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ koni nyɛkɛ kpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni nyɛjie maŋ lɛ he esha lɛ kɛya lɛ.
Akɛni akɛ too ojwɛni lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛye afɔle lɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ bɔ ni mifã lɛ."
Aaron to he ehã Mose akɛ, "Maŋbii lɛ shã amɛhe esha afɔle kɛ amɛshãa afɔle lɛ ŋmɛnɛ; ni kɛ̃lɛ oshra ebashrã mi nɛɛ. Eji miye esha afɔle ŋmɛnɛ kulɛ ehi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ?
Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ ena akɛ eja.
11: Yehowa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron wie koni amɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ ahã Israelbii lɛ ni amɛye nɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ nii ni nyɛye ji:

Nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ koklotoi ni agbla mli aloo aja mli, ni asaŋ amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii ni amɛtaa. 4-6. Shi nyɛkayea yoma kɛ afutuɔkɔ kɛ kpɛŋkplɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee. Amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii, ni amɛtaa moŋ, shi agblako amɛkoklotoi amli.
Nyɛkayea kplotoo, ejaakɛ ehe tseee. Eyɛ koklotoi ni agbla mli moŋ, shi egɔiii eniyenii etaaa.
Nyɛkayea kooloi nɛɛ aloo; nyɛkataa amɛgbohii ahe hu, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
"Yɛ nu mli loi ateŋ lɛ, nyɛyea nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ fiji kɛ totoi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ kɛ fai amli fɛɛ.
Shi nii fɛɛ ni bɛ fiji kɛ totoi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli loo fai amli, bɔɔnii bibii ni ebua amɛhe naa tɔo kɛnyiɛ nu mli jio, bɔɔnii ni yɔɔ nu mli ni dra fe nomɛi jio, nyɛhia amɛ.
Nihiinii ji amɛ; nyɛkayea amɛloo, ni nyɛhia amɛgbohii lɛ tete.
Nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nu mli ni amɛbɛ fiji loo totoi lɛ, nii ni ahiɔ ni.
Yɛ loofɔji ateŋ lɛ, nii ni nyɛhia ni nyɛkayea nɛ: Okropɔŋ kɛ akpaŋa.
kɛ ŋshɔŋ okropɔŋ kɛ laalɔɔ kɛ osansa henɔi srɔtoi lɛ,
kɛ kwaakwaalabite henɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ,
kɛ duguma kɛ nyɔɔŋ akroma kɛ faanaa oka, kɛ akroma henɔi srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ,
kɛ patu kɛ ŋshɔŋ patu, kɛ patu bibioo,
kɛ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kɛ kpokukpoku kɛ guŋ,
kɛ klisto kɛ ehenɔi srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ obleku kɛ aputupata.
"Kooloo bibii fɛɛ ni flikiɔ ni amɛwamɔɔ ni amɛyiɛɔ yɛ amɛnaji ewɛjwɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ nii ni yɔɔ shɔji enyɔɔnyɔ ni tsra amɛnane tokota nɔ ni amɛkɛtumɔɔ lɛ, nyɛyea.
Kooloi nɛɛ ji baalabii kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ, ligɔligɔ kɛ ehenɔi lɛ, kɛ agã kɛ ehenɔi,
flikilɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ ni wamɔɔ ni amɛyɔɔ naji ejwɛɛjwɛ lɛ nyɛkayea ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
Ni enɛɛmɛi buleɔ nyɛ. Kɛ nyɛye lɛ nyɛkɛbaabule nyɛhe. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa kooloi nɛɛ agbohii ahe lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɔ kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni egbo he nɔ ko ehiɛ yɛ edɛ̃ lɛ, efɔ etaadei lɛ ahe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ koklotoi ni agblako mli, ni asaŋ egɔii nii ni eye momo lɛ, ehe tseee. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata eko he lɛ, mɔ lɛ he tseee.
Kooloi fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛniji nyiɛɔ yɛ kooloi naji ejwɛɛjwɛtsɛmɛi ateŋ lɛ, amɛhe tseee. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa eko gbonyo he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni aaawo kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; shi ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Nyɛbua kooloi nɛɛ akɛ kooloi ni ahe tseee.
"Kooloi ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ, nii ni he tseee ji obishi kɛ kwakwe kɛ odaaklɔ kɛ ehenɔi,
kɛ mampam kɛ odiŋmɔlɔ kɛ tsunyɛ kɛ kɔ̃dɔ̃ kɛ obosumaketeo.
Nyɛbua enɛɛmɛi akɛ nii ni he tseee yɛ kooloi ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ ateŋ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa eko ni egbo he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.

Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni egbo aaagbee enɔ lɛ, ehe tseee; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ tso loo mama loo kooloo hewolo fee, loo kpekpe loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛkɛ ni akɛtsuɔ nii jio, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ akɛwo nu mli. Shi ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. No sɛɛ dani ehe aaatse.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ sū fee ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko aaagbee mli lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ he tseee. Ajwa sūnɔ ni nii lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ.
Niyenii fɛɛ ni ayeɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ nu ni jɛ sūnɔ nɛɛ mli aaashwie nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni anuɔ ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ sūnɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo aaagbee nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee. Kɛ flɔnɔɔ loo latɛ nɔ egbee lɛ, akumɔ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee, ni nyɛbua lɛ akɛ nɔ ni he tseee.
Shi kɛ nu hiŋmɛi loo dudɔ ni akɛ nu toɔ mli ni lɛ, no lɛ ehe tse; shi kɛ eko he aaasa kooloo gbonyo he lɛ, ehe tseee.
Kɛji kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo gbee wu ni abaadu nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tse lolo.
Shi kɛ aafɔ dumɔnii lɛ yɛ nu mli, ni gbonyo lɛ gbee nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tseee.
"Kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ lɛ eko gbo lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa egbonyo lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ loo lɛ eko lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Mɔ ni woɔ kooloo lɛ gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
"Kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ nii ni ahiɔ ni.
Kooloi fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ amɛmusu nɔ aloo amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ amɛnaji ejwɛ nɔ, aloo amɛyɔɔ naji piipii, kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ amɛbuleɔ mɔ.
Nyɛkayea koni nyɛkɛ no bule nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛwo nyɛhe muji.
Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ; nyɛtoa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ nibii ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ lɛ ekoeko akabulea nyɛhe.
Miji Yehowa mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
"Belɛ enɛ ji mla ni kã shi yɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɔ nu mli kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni hiɛ kã ni nyiɛɔ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ he.
Awo mla lɛ koni akɛna srɔto ni yɔɔ kooloi ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee teŋ, kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ kɛ nii ni ayeee teŋ."
12: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie
koni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji yoo ko na musu, ni efɔ binuu lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo, tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ eyeianiifeemɔ be mli lɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, afo gbekɛ lɛ ketia.

Yoo lɛ aŋɔ gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ ni ekɛtsuu ehe, ni ekɛjie ehe lá muji lɛ. Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ ekata nɔ ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ he, ni ekaya Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi gbi ni eeegbe ehetsuumɔ lɛ naa.
"Kɛ yoo ko fɔ biyoo lɛ, ehe tseee otsii enyɔ, tamɔ be ni efee yeianii lɛ. Eŋɔ gbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa sɔŋŋ ni ekɛtsuu ehe, ni ekɛjie ehe lá muji lɛ.

"Kɛji gbii ni ekɛtsuɔ ehe lɛ, yɛ binuu loo biyoo hewɔ lɛ ho lɛ, ekɛ too gwaŋtɛŋ bi ni eye afi aba abahã ni akɛshã shãa afɔle, kɛ shīa okpo loo kosɛɛ okpo ni akɛshã esha afɔle. Ekɛba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ afɔle lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ekpãta ehã yoo lɛ, koni ehe atse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ. Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã yoo ni fɔɔ nuu loo yoo lɛ.

"Shi kɛji yoo lɛ naaa too gwaŋtɛŋbi yinii lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shīa okpoi enyɔ aba. Akɛ ekome ashã shãa afɔle, koni akɛ ekome hu ashã esha afɔle. Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ, ni ehe aaatse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ."
13: Yehowa kɛ mlai nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron.
"Kɛji nɔ ko fūu yɛ mɔ ko hewolo nɔ loo fla ko loo gbɛ̃ ko, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ elɛɛ shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ kpiti hela lɛ, akɛ mɔ lɛ aba Osɔfo Aaron loo ebihii osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ŋɔɔ.

Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Kɛ ekwɛ ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, belɛ kpiti ni; ni be ni osɔfo lɛ ekwɛ helatsɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee.
Shi kɛji hewolo nɔ he ni akwɛ lɛ yɛ eyɛŋ ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ hu tsɔ̃ko eyɛŋ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ, ni kɛ hela lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ heloo lɛ hiɛ, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa aŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ.

Kɛji gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ ekoŋŋ, ni kɛ hela lɛ elaaje, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni he tse; hela lɛ gbɛ̃i ni. Helatsɛ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, koni ehe atse.
Shi kɛji gbɛ̃i lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ ehewolo lɛ nɔ be ni osɔfo lɛ ekwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ ehe tse lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ehe ayatsɔɔ osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ.
Kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni gbɛ̃i lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
"Kɛji kpiti shwie mɔ ko he lɛ, akɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ. Kɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ ewo yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ, ni ehã jɛi tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni loo ŋmɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ ni efuu lɛ mli lɛ,
belɛ kpiti momo yɔɔ ehewolo lɛ mli lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni he tseee ni. Osɔfo lɛ akaŋa eyi, ejaakɛ ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ ehe tseee.
Shi kɛji hela lɛ je kpo yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ, ni nɔ ni osɔfo lɛ naa kɛkɛ ji hela lɛ eshwie helatsɛ lɛ hewolo nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ eyiteŋ kɛyashi enaji ahe lɛ,
osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ hela lɛ eha ehewolo nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse. Ni kɛ helatsɛ lɛ he fɛɛ eyɛ futaa lɛ, ehe tse.
Shi gbi nɔ ni aaana fla ŋmɔŋ yɛ helatsɛ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni kɛ ena lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
Shi kɛji fla lɛ tã, ni eesaa estɔ̃ ayɛŋ ekoŋŋ lɛ, helatsɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛ ena akɛ loo ŋmɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, helatsɛ lɛ he tse; ni osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tse.
"Kɛji asane tsɛ̃ mɔ ko hewolo nɔ ni etã,
ni fee sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ bawo yɛ he ni asane lɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ yɛ lɛ, aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni tsuɔo ba jɛi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ. Kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tseee; kpiti ebote asane lɛ mli.
Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ mli, ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ni enaa miilaaje lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.
Kɛji hela lɛ miilɛɛ shi fe bɔ ni kule eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
Shi kɛji nɔ ko yɛŋ lɛ elɛɛɛ shi, ni eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ fladoku ni; asane lɛ shishi ni Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse.
"Kɛji la shã mɔ ko, ni la fla lɛ fee nɔ ko yɛŋ aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni etsuru fioo futu mli lɛ,
osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ. Kɛji tsɔi ni yɔɔ la fla lɛ mli etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, bɛlɛ kpiti ebote la lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
Shi kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ lɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ fla lɛ mli ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ. Kɛji fla lɛ elɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ fe bɔ ni kulɛ eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.

Shi kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni elɛɛko shi efatako he, shi moŋ enaa miilaaje lɛ, belɛ la fla lɛ kɛkɛ ni ehã jɛi efuu lɛ. Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ fla doku kɛkɛ ni.
"Kɛji fla fee nuu loo yoo ko yiteŋ loo etsɛŋ mli lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ.
Kɛji he ni fla lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ hwiaahwiaa ni ehiɛ wuɔfɔ su lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ fafale ni; efeɔ yiteŋ loo tsɛŋ mli.
Kɛji be ni osɔfo lɛ kwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ena akɛ he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ bɛ ediŋ lɛ, eŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi ewo tsuŋ gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji fafale lɛ elɛko, ni tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su ekwɛ̃ko yɛ mli, ni fala lɛ enyɔko hewolo lɛ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ,
ahã mɔ lɛ ashɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ fe he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ pɛ eshi Osɔfo lɛ aŋa mɔ lɛ yi awo tsuŋ gbii krokomɛi kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji elɛɛko ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tse. Mɔ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe koni ehe atse.
Shi kɛji fafale lɛ elɛɛ, yɛ be ni akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tse lɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji fafale lɛ esaaa elɛɛ lɛ, ehe ehiaaa akɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ akɛ eeena tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su lo; nɔ ni kã shi faŋŋ kɛkɛ ji mɔ lɛ he tseee.
Shi kɛji ekwɛ lɛ esusuɔ akɛ fafale lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni tsɔi diŋ ekwɛ̃ yɛ mli lɛ, belɛ fafale lɛ etã. Helatsɛ lɛ he etse; ni osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tse.
"Kɛji nii yɛji hãlãhãlã komɛi ba nuu loo yoo ko hewolo nɔ lɛ,
osɔfo lɛ akwɛ. Kɛji nibii yɛji hãlãhãlã nɛɛ ejeee shi jogbaŋŋ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, belɛ aflimata eshwie mɔ lɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ; mɔ lɛ he tse.
"Kɛji nuu ko yi kpa yɛ eyisɛɛ lɛ, yikpataatsɛ ji lɛ, shi ehe tse
Kɛji ehiɛnaa gbɛ kɛkɛ eyi lɛ kpa yɛ lɛ, hiɛnaa kpataa tsɛ ji lɛ, shi ehe tse.
Shi kɛji nɔ ko yɛŋ ni tsuɔ oo shwie eyiteŋ loo ehiɛnaa he ni ekpa lɛ, kpiti ji nɔ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ. Kɛji osɔfo lɛ naa fafale yɛŋ ni tsuɔ oo yɛ eyisɛɛ loo ehiɛnaa he ni ekpa lɛ, ni etamɔ kpiti yɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ,
osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ eji mɔ ko ni he tseee yɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ eyiteŋ lɛ hewɔ.
"Mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti lɛ egbla etadei, ni ehiɛ eyitso eflo. Eha enaabu nɔ ni eblɔ akɛ, 'Mihe tseee, mihe tseee!'
Gbii abɔ ni hela lɛ yɔɔ ehe lɛ, ehe tseee kwraa. Ekome too ehi shi, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ ahi shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
"Kɛji kpiti ekadi kuŋtu loo klala atade ko mli,
aloo ekadi kuŋtu loo klala kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ mli, loo kooloo wolo loo nɔ ko ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli,
ni kadimɔ lɛ su eŋɔli loo etsuru yɛ atade loo kooloo wolo loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ, loo nɔ ko ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ kpiti he okadi ni; ni esa akɛ akɛtsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ, ni ekɛ nɔ ni mli ni ekadi lɛ ato gbii kpawo.

Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ ekwɛ ekoŋŋ. Kɛji nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ elɛɛ yɛ atadɛ lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ loo kooloo wolo lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo lɛ fee lɛ mli lɛ, belɛ kpiti ni fiteɔ nii eshwie he lɛ; ni nɔ mli ni ekadi lɛ he tseee.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã atade ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ, loo kpãi ni akɛlo kuŋtu loo klala atade lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee ni akadi mli lɛ; ejaakɛ eji kpiti ni fiteɔ nii; ni esa akɛ akɛ la ashã.
"Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ elɛɛko yɛ atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo lɛ, loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ,
no lɛ osɔfo lɛ afã akɛ afɔ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he, ni esaa eŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ.

Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ kadimɔ lɛ su tsakeko be ni afɔ he sɛɛ, ni elɛko hu efatako he lɛ, belɛ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he tseee. Akɛ la ashã; hiɛgbɛ ekadi jio, sɛɛgbɛ jio, no kɔɔɔ he eko.
Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ ni ena akɛ nɔ ni ekadi nii lɛ mli lɛ miilaaje be ni afɔ he sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ etse he ni kadimɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ atade lɛ loo kooloo wolo lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ he.
Shi kɛji aana kadimɔ lɛ lolo yɛ atadɛ lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ mli, loo nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ekadi nii lɛ mli lɛ miiku esɛɛ ekoŋŋ; akɛ la ashã nɔ ni mli ni ekadi lɛ.
Atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo lɛ loo kooloo wolo nɔ lɛ ni afɔ he lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ je mli lɛ, afɔ he ekoŋŋ koni ehe atse.

"Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã kpiti ni eshwie kuŋtu loo odonti mama loo kpãi ni akɛloɔ mama lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee he lɛ. Eji mla hu ni akɛnaa akɛ nɔ ni kpiti eshwie he lɛ he tse aloo ehe tseee."
14: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã lɛ.
Mlai nɛɛ kã shi hã mɔ ni eye kpiti ni ehe etã hetsuumɔ. Gbi nɔ ni aaakɛɛ akɛ ehe etse lɛ, akɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ lɛ aje kpo kɛya nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni eyakwɛ lɛ. Kɛji kpiti ni shwie helatsɛ lɛ etã yɛ ehe lɛ,
osɔfo lɛ afã mɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ koni ekɛ loofɔji hiɛkãlɔi enyɔ ni he tse kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo aba.
Osɔfo lɛ afã ni agbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nu ŋmɔŋ yɔɔ mli nɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ amɔ looflɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ. Ekɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ afata he ni ekɛ fɛɛ atsɔ looflɔ ni agbe lɛ yɛ kã ni nu yɔɔ mli lɛ lá lɛ mli.
Etsɔ la lɛ eshwã kpitiyelɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu ehe. Eŋmɛɛ looflɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ afɔ etadei lɛ ahe. Eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi fɛɛ, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe koni ehe atse. No sɛɛ lɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli, shi ekabote ebuu lɛ mli gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ esaa eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ekoŋŋ kɛ etsɛŋ kɛ ehiŋmɛi sɛɛ tsɔi kɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ. Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.

Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii enyɔ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ gwanɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu ewo mli kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome aba.
Osɔfo ni tsuuɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ he lɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu shinaa lɛ naa.
Emɔ gwaŋtɛŋbii lɛ ateŋ ekome ekɛbahã akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu, koni ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ akɛ keenii titri ko.
Egbe gwaŋtɛŋbi lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ jio, esha afɔle lɛ jio, fɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni; eji nɔ ko krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.
Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ awo mu lɛ ni efo eko ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enineabɛku kɔkɔ mli.
Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ mli lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni eshwɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa he ni akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ sa lɛ.
Mu ni eshwɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, efɔse eshwie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yiteŋ koni osɔfo lɛ akpãta ahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ashã esha afɔle lɛ koni ekɛjie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ he muji lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ agbe too ni akɛ baashã shãa afɔle lɛ;
no sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ashã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, koni ekɛtsuu mɔ lɛ he; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.

Shi kɛ eji ohiafo ni enaaa enɛɛmɛi lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ gwaŋtɛŋbi kome aba akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle, keenii titri ko ni akɛkpãtã ahã lɛ ni. Ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome ni awo mli mu hu aba akɛ niyenii afɔle, kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Asaŋ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shīa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba; emli eko fɛɛ eko ni enine aaashɛ nɔ. Akɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni akɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle.
Ehetsuumɔ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ nibii nɛɛ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ gwaŋtɛŋbi lɛ ni akɛshãa sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ ni ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ keenii titri ko.
Osɔfo lɛ agbe gwaŋtɛŋbi ni akɛshãa sɔ afɔle lɛ. Ekɛ toobi lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.
Osɔfo lɛ afo mu lɛ eko awo enineabɛku kɔkɔ mli.
Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni yɔɔ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ nine jurɔ toi naa, kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ akɛsa he ni lá ni akɛshã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Mu ni eshwɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, efɔse eshwie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yiteŋ, koni ekɛpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okpoi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ, ni enine aaashɛ, kosɛɛ okpoi jio, shīa okpoi jio,
osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle efata niyenii afɔle lɛ he. Efee enɛ ni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti ni enine shɛɛɛ nii ni akɛbaatsuu ehe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron.
Kɛ nyɛshɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛhã nyɛ ni nyɛye nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mihã kpiti shwie shīa ko he yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
no lɛ nakai shīa lɛ tsɛ lɛ aya ni eyakɛɛ osɔfo lɛ akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni nɔ ko tamɔ kpiti eshwie eshīa lɛ he.
Osɔfo lɛ afã ni ajie shīa lɛ mli nii kɛje kpo dani osɔfo lɛ abote shīa lɛ mli ni eyakwɛ nɔ ni eshwie he lɛ. Kɛji afeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ shīa lɛ mli nii fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ nii ni he tseee.
Kɛ osɔfo lɛ yakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni eshwie shīa lɛ gboboi lɛ ahe lɛ, fɔji ŋɔlii kɛ etsuji ni, ni amɛmiikpe kɛmiibote gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ,
no lɛ eje kpo ni eŋmɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ aba ekoŋŋ. Kɛji ekwɛ, ni ena akɛ fɔji lɛ elɛɛlɛɛ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ehe lɛ,
no lɛ efã ni ajie tɛi ni hela lɛ eshwie he lɛ koni asherɛ ashwie maŋ lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni tseee.
No sɛɛ lɛ aŋmla shīa lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ fɛɛ he kɛ kpe, ni akɛ su ni aŋmla lɛ ayashwie maŋ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ he ko ni tseee.
Akɛ tɛi krokomɛi ahlɔ tɛi ni afamɔ lɛ anajiaŋ, ni akɛ su hee ama gboboi lɛ ahe.
Kɛji hela lɛ ku sɛɛ eshwie gbogboi lɛ ahe ekoŋŋ, ni eje shi faŋŋ yɛ he ni afamɔ tɛi lɛ ni aŋmla gbogboi lɛ ahe ni ama he yɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ,
osɔfo lɛ aya ni eyakwɛ. Kɛji ena akɛ nɔ ni eshwie shīa lɛ he lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ hela ko ni tamɔ kpiti ni fiteɔ nii yɛ shīa lɛ; shīa lɛ he tseee.
Akumɔ shīa lɛ ashwie shi, etɛi lɛ kɛ mplaŋi lɛ kɛ shīa lɛ sū lɛ fɛɛ, ni aloo kɛje maŋ lɛ mli kɛyashwie he ko ni tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boteɔ shīa lɛ mli be mli ni ala agbo lɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ;
ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawɔ shìa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe; ni mɔ ni aaaye nii yɛ shīa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe.

Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ ba shīa lɛ ni ebakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ ekuko esɛɛ eshwieko shīa lɛ he kɛjɛ be ni ama shīa lɛ he ekoŋŋ nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, shīa lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ etã kwraa.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ loofɔji enyɔ kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo ashã esha afɔle kɛjwra shīa lɛ.
Egbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu yɔɔ mli lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ kɛ looflɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ fɛɛ atsɔ looflɔ ni agbe lɛ lá lɛ kɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu ni yɔɔ kã lɛ mli lɛ mli koni ekɛshwã shīa lɛ shii kpawo.
Kɛ efee nɛkɛ lɛ, belɛ ekɛ looflɔ lɛ lá lɛ kɛ nuhiɛmɛi ni hoɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ kɛ looflɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ kɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ ejwra shīa lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ eŋmɛɛ looflɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he, yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa, koni efliki kɛya ŋa lɛ nɔ. Gbɛ nɔ ni osɔfo lɛ atsɔ kɛkpãtã ehã shīa lɛ nɛ, koni shīa lɛ he atse.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã hewolo nɔ helai srɔtoi ni tamɔ kpiti henɔ: 55-56. fala, fafala, loosule, gbɛ̃, fuumɔ kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli muji ni kaa mama mli kɛ gbogbo he mla.
Eji mla ni akɛnaa nɔ ni he tseee kɛ nɔ ni he tse; hela ni tamɔ kpiti kɛ ehenɔi ahe mla nɛ.
15: Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron
ni amɛkɛhã Isrealbii lɛ. Kɛji nu miiho yɛ nuu ko nuutso mli lɛ, nu ni hoɔ lɛ he tseee.
Nu lɛ kã he eeho jio, nuutso lɛ etsi enaa ni ehã ekpa hoo jio, gbɔmɔ lɛ he tseee.
Saa fɛɛ saa ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ kãa nɔ lɛ he tseee, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etaa nɔ lɛ he tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa saa lɛ he lɛ afɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni taa mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ sɛ̃i nɔ lɛ afɔ etadei ehe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni taa mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ he lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ tsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwei mɔ ni he tse he lɛ, mɔ ni atsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ashwei ehe lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Sɛ̃i ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ taa nɔ yɛ shwiili mli loo kooloo nɔ lɛ he tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nɔ ko ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ nɔ ko ni tamɔ nakai lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu ni efɔko edɛ aaata ehe lɛ ehe lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Sū nii ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ aaata he lɛ, ajwa; ni tso nii fɛɛ tso nii ni eeeta he lɛ, akɛ nu afɔ mli.
Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ hela lɛ tã lɛ, emɛ gbii kpawo. Efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu aju ehe; Kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shīa okpoi enyɔ aya Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ni ekɛyahã osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle, koni ekpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ nu ni hoɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji nuu ko shwie ehe shi lɛ, ekɛ nu aju ehe fɛɛ; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mama fɛɛ mama kɛ kooloo wolo fɛɛ kooloo wolo ni nu nɛɛ eko aaatee mli lɛ akɛ nu afɔ he; ni ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko wɔ, ni nuu lɛ henu je emli lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ nu aju amɛhe; amɛhe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji yoo ko fee yeanii ni ehe miiho lá lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa ehe lɛ he tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ ekã nɔ gbii abɔ ni etee tsuiasɛɛ lɛ he tseee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ hu he tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ lɛ saa he lɛ, afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko ta nɔ ko ni yɔɔ yoo lɛ saa nɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo lɛ na bɔlɛ ni lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ eko tee ehe lɛ, no lɛ ehe tseee gbii kpawo, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ekã nɔ lɛ he tseee.

Kɛji yoo ko he ho lá gbii pii be ni eshɛko etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ, aloo ehe ho lá yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ehe hoɔ la lɛ ehe tseee, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa gbii lɛ amli lɛ pɛ.
Saa fɛɛ saa ni ekã nɔ gbii abɔ ni ehe hoɔ lá lɛ tamɔ etsuiasɛɛyaa saa lɛ pɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he tseee tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ mli lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nibii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, ehe tseee. Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ sɛɛ fo lɛ, ekane gbii kpawo ehã ehe; no sɛɛ lɛ ehe aaatse.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shīa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ okpoi lɛ ateŋ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle ni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ni ehe aaatse.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose koni ebɔ Isrealbii lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ amɛhe ni tseee lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkabule mi-Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ni amɛbagboi.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã mɔ ni he hoɔ nu kɛ mɔ ni nu jeɔ emli ni no hãaa ehe atse.
Mla nɛɛ kã shi hã mɔ ni kɛ yoo ni miifee yeianii wɔɔ kɛ nuu ko ni kɛ yoo ni he tseee naa bɔlɛ.
16: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Aaron bihii enyɔ ni kɛ la ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ tee Yehowa hiɛ ni amɛgboi lɛ agbele lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ,

"Okɛ onyɛmi Aaron awie koni ekabote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmiiya muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛ̃i ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, be fɛɛ be kɛkɛ, koni ekagbo, ejaakɛ mapue yɛ atatu mli yɛ naanɔ ni bu Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nii ni Aaron kɛbote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛ: tsina nuu oblanyo ni akɛfee esha afɔle kɛ ojwɛni ni akɛfee shãa afɔle.
"Aaron kɛ nu aju ehe, ni ewo klala flaka krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ klala tswakotoi lɛ. Ekɛ klala mlifiinii lɛ afi emli, ni ekɛ klala tɔɔbaŋ afi eyitso. Atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛ.
Israel asafo ku lɛ ahã Aaron too kpakpoi enyɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle, kɛ ojwɛni kome ni akɛbaafee eshãa afɔle.
Aaron kɛ tsina nuu ni ji lɛ diɛŋtse enɔ lɛ abashã esha afɔle kɛjie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai kɛ ewe lɛ he eshai.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ too kpakpoi enyɔ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Efɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki; oshiki kome hã Yehowa kɛ oshiki kome hã Azazel.
Aaron kɛ too kpakpo ni Yehowa oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ aba ni ekɛbashã esha afɔle.
Shi too kpakpo ni Azazel oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ ni kooloo lɛ hiɛ kã. Eŋmɛɛ kooloo lɛ he ehã Azazel yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ koni ewo maŋ lɛ hɛ eshai lɛ kɛya.
"Aaron kɛ estina nuu lɛ aba akɛ esha afɔle ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ ewe lɛ, ni egbe.
Eloo ŋai kɛ la ŋɛsu obɔ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni ashi bɔdɔbɔdɔ ekɔkɔi abɔbɔi enyɔ, ni ekɛbote muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Ekɛ ohɛ lɛ ashwie la lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ohɛ lɛ he lasu kumɔŋŋ lɛ baaha mɔbɔnalɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ he, koni Aaron akana ni egbo.
Ekɛ ewao atsɔ tsina nuu lɛ lá lɛ eko koni ekɛshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛgbɛ; ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko hu ni ekɛshwã Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ shii kpawo.

"No sɛɛ lɛ egbe too kpakpo ni ji maŋ lɛ nɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle lɛ. Ekɛ lá lɛ abote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni etsɔ eko eshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛgbɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛgbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ tsina lá lɛ fee lɛ.
Ni akɛjwra He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni tseee kɛ amɛtūatsemɔi kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ. Aaron afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Kpee Buu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ; efee yɛ amɛmuji nii lɛ ahewɔ.
Be ni Aaron boteɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni eyakpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko akahi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeje kpo. Aaron akpãtã ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ ewe lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ eje kpo kɛya afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ he, ni etsuu he. Ekɛ tsina nuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛ too kpakpo lɛ lá lɛ eko asra koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ahe kɛkpe.
Ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu he efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
"Kɛ Aaron egbe He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ jwramɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ aba.

Ekɛ eniji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ashwei too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ yiteŋ, ni ejaje Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛmla tɔ̃mɔi ni ji amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ eshwie too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ. Etu lɛ ewo nuu ko ni mɛɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ dɛŋ koni eyaŋmɛɛ ehe ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Too kpakpo lɛ baatere amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛya ŋa nɔ he ko kplanaa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ, ni jɛi nuu lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe yɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Aaron abote Kpee Buu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ. Ejie klala atadei ni ewo be ni ebote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ, ni eshi yɛ jɛi.
Eju ehe kɛ nu yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni eklɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ. Eje kpo ni eyashã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshãa afɔle lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ shãa afɔle kooloo lɛ koni ekɛpãtã ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ maŋ lɛ hu.
Eshã fɔ ni yɔɔ esha afɔle lɛ he lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ mɔ ni kɛ too kpakpo lɛ tee eya ŋmɛɛ ehe ehã Azazel lɛ afɔ etadei ehe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe dani eba nsra lɛ mlu.
Akɛ tsina nuu lɛ kɛ too kpakpo lɛ ni akɛshã esha afɔle lɛ ni akɛ amɛlá lɛ tee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni akɛyakpãtã lɛ, aje nsra lɛ mli ni akɛ la ayashã. Ashã amɛloo kɛ amɛhewoji kɛ amɛwamɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mɔ ni yashã lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; no sɛɛ fɛɛ dãni eba shitoohe lɛ mli."
"Enɛ afee akpɔ ahã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ. Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko, nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli bii jio, gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ jio.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ abaapãtã ahã nyɛ koni akɛtsuu nyɛhe ni akɛhã nyɛhe atse yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Hejɔɔmɔgbi wulu ni hã nyɛ. Nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ. Akpɔ ni yɔɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ.
Kusum ni abaafee kɛkpãtã lɛ, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu ni awo lɛ osɔfo koni eye etsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewo klala atadei ni ji atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni efee.
Ejwra He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekpãtã ehã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi hã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, koni akɛkpãtã ahã Israelbii lɛ daa afi shi kome yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ. "Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ Kitã lɛ.
17: Yehowa fã Mose,
koni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ.
"Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo ni gbeɔ tsina loo gwaŋtɛŋ loo abotia yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli loo shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ,
ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni akɛshã afɔle ahã Yehowa yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, eye lá yi sɔ̃. Lá efɔse eshwie shi lɛ, eye lá ashiŋ Yehowa bii anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mla nɛɛ oti ji akɛ kooloi ni Israelbii lɛ gbeɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛkɛba ni amɛkɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni amɛgbe amɛkɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa.
Osɔfo lɛ atsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eshã fɔ lɛ koni eje ŋma ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ akafee amɛhe mɛi ni yeee Yehowa anɔkwa ni amɛshãa afɔlei amɛhãa wɔji ni amɛnyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ. Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni yɔɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ kɛ yinɔi fɛɛ ni baaba yɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
"Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii lɛ ni shãa shãa afɔle loo
afɔle kroko ehãa Yehowa yɛ he kroko ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii lɛ anɔ.
