Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii akaye loo lɛ mli lá, no lɛ majie mihie maka nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ, ni mi kɛ lɛ baafo takoŋ.

Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, elá lɛ mli ewala yɔɔ, ni no hewɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ afɔse lá lɛ fɛɛ ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni akɛjie maŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ. Ejaakɛ lá ni ji wala lɛ akɛjieɔ eshai yɛ gbɔmɔ he.
No hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛ jio, gbɔ ni ebato amɛ jio, amɛkaye loo ni lá yɔɔ mli lɛ.
"Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel lɛ, kɛji eyagbɔbi ni egbe kooloo loo looflɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ, efɔse elá lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɛ sū atsi nɔ,

ejaakɛ bɔɔ nii fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, amɛlá lɛ mli amɛwala yɔɔ; ni no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛkaye loo ko loo ko lá lɛ. Bɔɔnɔ fɛɛ bɔɔnɔ lɛ, elá mli ewala yɔɔ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lá lɛ abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔ.

"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele aloo kooloo ni kooloo awuyelɔ ko tserɛ emli lɛ, Israelnyo ji lɛ jio, gbɔ ni ebato Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji lɛ jio, efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛnu aju ehe; ebaahi shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ dani ehe; ebaahi shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ dani ehe baatse.
Kɛji efɔɔɔ etadei ahe, ni ejuuu ehe lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ akã lɛ diɛŋtse enɔ."
18: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ,
"Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni nyɛhi tsutsu lɛ. Asaŋ nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ nɛɛ lɛ. Amɛ kusum lɛ nyɛkafea.
Nyɛyea mimlai kɛ migbɛjianɔyoi lɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyea migbɛjianɔtoo kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ; nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni enaa wala lɛ. Miji Yehowa.
Nuu ko nuu ko akabɛŋkɛ ewkunyo ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ. Miji Yehowa.
Okɛ onyɛ akawɔ ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi; onyɛ ni, kaahã ehiɛ miishwie shi.
Okɛ otsɛ ŋa akawɔ; obaashwie otsɛ hiɛ shi.
Okɛ onyɛmiyoo ni ji ostɛ loo onyɛ bi akawɔ; alɛ lɛ yɛ nyɛshīa lɛ mli jio, shīa kroko mli jio, okɛ lɛ akawɔ.
Okɛ obinuu biyoo loo obiyoo biyoo akawɔ. Eji nɔ ko ni baashwie bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ shi.
Okɛ oste ŋa biyoo ni ostɛ fɔ lɛ akawɔ. Onyɛmiyoo ni, ni esaaa akɛ ohãa ehiɛ shwieɔ shi.
Okɛ otsɛ nyɛmi yoo akawɔ: Otsɛ lá ji lɛ.
Okɛ onyɛ nyɛmi yoo akawɔ: Onyɛ lá ji lɛ.
Kaabɛŋkɛ otsɛ nyɛmi nuu ŋa ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi: Onyɛkwɛ ni.
Okɛ onyɛminuu ŋa akawɔ: ebaahã onyɛmi nuu lɛ hiɛ ashwie shi.
Okɛ onyɛminuu ŋa akawɔ ni okɛshwie onyɛminuu lɛ hiɛ shi.
Okɛ yoo kɛ ebiyoo fɛɛ akawɔ, ni asaŋ okaŋɔ obinuu biyoo loo ebiyoo lɛ biyoo ni okɛ lɛ yawɔ. Yoo lɛ lá ji amɛ, ni jeŋba ni tamɔ nakai bɛ fɛo.
Kaaŋɔ oŋa nyɛmiyoo ofee oŋa bienyɛ; ni okɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ be mli ni oŋa hiɛ kã lolo.
"Kaaya yoo ŋɔɔ ni okɛ ayawɔ be mli ni etee tsuiasɛɛ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee.
Okɛ onaanyo ŋa akawɔ ni okɛwo ohe muji.
Kaaŋmɛɛ obii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko he ohã ni akɛ lɛ ja Molek ni akɛ no wo o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji. Miji Yehowa.
Okɛ nuu akawɔ tamɔ okɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ; aahi.
Okɛ kooloo ko kooloo ko akawɔ ni okɛwo ohe muji. Nakai nɔŋŋ esaaa akɛ yoo ko kɛ ehe hãa kooloo ko.
Nyɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko akawoa nyɛhe muji; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ jeŋmaji ni mibashwie mahã nyɛ lɛ kɛwoɔ amɛhe muji lɛ.

Gbɛ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni shikpɔŋ fee shikpɔŋ ni he tseee nɛ. Mibagbla etoi yɛ enishaianii lɛ hewɔ, ni ebaafɛ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ eshwie. 26-27. Mɛi ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ fee nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛkɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ he muji. Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkafea nɛkɛ nihii nii nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko. Maŋnyo jio, gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ jio, nyɛyea Yehowa mlai lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ anɔ,
koni shikpɔŋ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ hu eshwie tamɔ bɔ ni efɛ̃ jeŋmaŋ ni tsɔ nyɛhiɛ lɛ eshwie lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ nɛkɛ nihiinii nɛɛ eko lɛ, abuŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mɛi lɛ anɔ.
"No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyea nii ni mifã akɛ nyɛfee lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkafea kusumii ni ahiɔ ni afeɔ dani nyɛba lɛ, koni nyɛkɛkawo nyɛhe muji. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
19: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose,
ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashe enyɛ kɛ etsɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛyea mihejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ; miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
"Nyɛkayanyiɛa yakayaka wɔji asɛɛ, ni nyɛkagea dade wɔji hu ni ashwie nyɛkafea dade wɔji hu ni ashwie nyɛhã nyɛhe; miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
"Kɛji nyɛgbe kooloo nyɛkɛmiishã naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ, nyɛfea lɛ yɛ mlai ni awo yɛ he lɛ naa koni esa mihiɛ ni mahere.
Aye loo lɛ gbi ni ashã afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ; shi nɔ ni baashwɛ kɛyaashi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ la ashã, ejaakɛ ehe tseee;
ni kɛ aye gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ loo lɛ eko lɛ, minaŋ afɔle lɛ he tsui.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ, etere musu, ejaakɛ ewo keenɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛmiihã Yehowa he muji, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ mimɛi lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
"Kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshinii lɛ, nyɛ kaakpa nii ni yɔɔ oŋmɔ lɛ naanaa lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa.
Ni nyɛkakpaa wain tsei lɛ ayibii hu fɛɛ kɛmɔɔ shi; ni wain yibii ni aaashwie shi lɛ hu nyɛkaklɔa. Nyɛshīa nyɛhãa ohiafoi kɛ gbɔi lɛ koni amɛbaye lɛ kpɛkpɛo. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
"Kaaju; kaashishiu onaanyo gbɔmɔ, kaalaka lɛ.
Kaakã kitã yɛ migbɛi mli ni okɛshishiu mɔ ko ni okɛwo o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji. Miji Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
"Kaaye onaayo gbɔmɔ amim, ni kaatswa lɛ ojo. Kaahã je miitsɛre apaafonyo nyɔmɔwo nɔ.
Kaalomɔ toimulɔ, ni okɛ pampi akama shwilafo gbɛ nɔ ni eyatɛ; shi she o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei. Miji Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
"Kaatsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ obu shi ni oye ohã ohiafo aloo ohiɛ shwie gbɔmɔ wulu hiɛ. kojomɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ yɛ jalɛ naa.
Kaanyiɛ kɛmiiya kɛmiiba ni ooye osheku yɛ omaŋ lɛ mli; ni kaate shi oshi onaanyo gbɔmɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɔgbee sane fɔ̃ enɔ; miji Yehowa.
"Kaanyɛ onyɛmi gbɔmɔ yɛ otsui mli; shi kã lɛ blɛoo yɛ etɔ̃mɔ he koni okatere sɔ̃ ko bo diɛŋtsɛ hu.
Kaatɔ ohe owele, ni kaabɛ omaŋbii lɛ eko Owo omli, shi suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ. Miji Yehowa.
"Nyɛyea mikpɔi lɛ anɔ. Kaahã oshīa kooloi srɔtoi miifutu amɛmiikwɔ. Oŋmɔ mli hu kaafutu wui srɔtoi odu. Ni kaawo atade ni akɛ klala kɛ kuŋtu futu lo.

"Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nyɔŋyoo ko wɔ, ni nyɔŋyoo lɛ atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu kroko, shi nuu nɛɛ woko eyi nyɔmɔ koni yoo lɛ aye ehe lɛ, no lɛ abote sane lɛ mli. Agbla yoo lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ toi, shi akagbe amɛ, ejaakɛ ahãko yoo lɛ aye ehe.
Shi nuu lɛ kɛ ojwɛni aba abahã Yehowa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ojwɛni ni ji sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ akpãtã ahã nuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛaafa lɛ.
"Kɛji nyɛyashɛ Kaanan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, yeli tso fɛɛ yeli tso ni nyɛaatɛo ni ayeɔ lɛ, nyɛbua eyibii lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni ehe tseee kɛyashi afii etɛ̃, akaye eyibii lɛ.
Shi afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ afee tso yibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ akɛ afɔle ni aashã ahã mi, Yehowa, kɛda mi shi.
Shi afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛyea yibii lɛ, koni nibaa nii afa babaoo ahã nyɛ. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
" Nyɛkayea loo ni lá yɔɔ mli. Nyɛkaklaa, ni nyɛkayea ŋkunyaa.
Nyɛkashɛa nyɛyitsei ahe, ni nyɛkakua nyɛtsɛŋ nɔ.
Nyɛkabamɔa nyɛhewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛyea gbonyo ko he ŋkɔmɔ; ni nyɛkayea sãmai yɛ nyɛhewolo nɔ. Miji Yehowa.
"Okɛ obiyoo akawɔ ni ohã etsɔ̃ yoo ajwamaŋ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bayi tɔ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ.
Nyɛyea mihejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, ni nyɛshea he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ; miji Yehowa.
"Nyɛkanyiɛa okɔmfoi kɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai anɔ, koni nyɛkawo nyɛhe muji. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
"Ohiɛ asɔ mɛi ni egblɔ, ni owo amɛ. She Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei. Miji Yehowa.
"Kɛ gbɔ ko bato gbɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkawaa lɛ yi.
Nyɛhiɛa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛbaahiɛ nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛsumɔa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyato gbɔ pɛŋ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
"Nyɛkayea sane ni ejaa yɛ nisusumɔ kɛ niŋmɛɛ kɛ nikaa mli.
Nyɛhiɛa nsɛnii kpakpai kɛ niŋmɛɛ kɛ nisusumɔ nii kpakpai. Miji Yehowa ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhiɛ akãa mimlai kɛ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni nyɛyea fɛɛ nɔ. Miji Yehowa."
20: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie,
ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ ebii lɛ eko aaahã ni akɛja Molek lɛ agbe lɛ; shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ebii ateŋ mɔ ko hã Molek, ni ekɛwo He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni ajaa mi yɛŋ lɛ he muji, ni eshwie migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ shi lɛ, mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ.
Shi kɛji mɛi ateŋ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ku amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ nɔ ni efee lɛ nɔ, ni amɛgbeee lɛ lɛ,
mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ kɛ eweku fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa, shi amɛjaa Molek lɛ. Mibuŋ amɛ mishiŋ miwebii anɔ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko yabi nii yɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai aŋɔɔ lɛ, mate shi mawo lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛhiɛ akãa mimlai lɛ ahe ni nyɛyea nɔ; miji Yehowa ni feɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, agbe lɛ. Etsɛ kɛ enyɛ elomɔ lɛ; esɔ̃ atere lɛ.
"Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko ŋa ku gblã mli lɛ, agbe nuu gblãŋkulɔ kɛ yoo gblãŋkulɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Nuu ni kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ eshwie etsɛ hiɛ shi. Gbe agbe lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ eshaayoo ni ji ebinuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, agbe lɛ kɛ eshaayoo lɛ fɛɛ; hiɛgbejianii amɛfee lɛ; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ, amɛfɛɛ nɔ ni ahiɔ; agbe amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko ŋɔ yoo ko kɛ enyɛ fɛɛ efee eŋamɛi lɛ, ashã amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ, fɛɛ yɛ musu ni amɛbɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ kooloo ko wɔ lɛ, agbe lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛji yoo ko bɛŋkɛ kooloo ko, ni ekãa shi ehãa lɛ, ni ekɛ kooloo lɛ wɔ lɛ, agbe yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ fɛɛ; amɛmusu atere amɛ.
"Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛmiyoo ni ji etsɛbi loo enyɛbi wɔ lɛ, amɛfee hiɛgbejianii. Atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ. Nuu lɛ ni kɛ enyɛmiyoo ewɔ lɛ, esɔ̃ atere lɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko ni etee tsuiasɛɛ wɔ lɛ, atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ.
"Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛ nyɛmi yoo loo enyɛ nyɛmi yoo wɔ lɛ, eshwie mɔ ni ekɛ lɛ hiɛ heloo kome hiɛ shi; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛkwɛ ŋa wɔ lɛ, eshwie etsɛkwɛ lɛ hiɛ shi; ekɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ, amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko naŋ bi, ni ebaagbo.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛminuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, amɛbaagboi ni amɛbɛ bi. Nuu lɛ etsu hiɛgbejianii, ni eshwie enyɛmi lɛ hiɛ shi.
"Nyɛyea mimlai lɛ kɛ mipkɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa ni nyɛyahi nɔ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ eshwie.
Nyɛkakasea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akusumi ni amɛfeɔ lɛ. Miishwie nɛkɛ wɔŋjalɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛya. Amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ehã minyaŋe amɛ.
Shi miwo nyɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii nɛɛ he shi, ni mikɛbaahã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛfea srɔto yɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee ateŋ. Nyɛkayea kooloi loo loofɔji ni he tseee. Mihã nyɛle akɛ amɛhe tseee; ni kɛ nyɛye lɛ nyɛhe baawo muji.
Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhãa mi pɛ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mihe tse. Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã koni nyɛfee mi pɛ minɔ.
"Nyɛteŋ nuu loo yoo ni aaayabi nii yɛ sisa ŋɔɔ lɛ, atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ enɛ lɛ egbele sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ."
21: Yehowa fã Mose ni ekɛɛ osɔfoi ni ji Aaron bihii lɛ akɛ, "Osɔfo ko akaya wekunyo ko kɛkɛ ni egbo yara nɔ ni ekɛwo ehe muji,
belɛ ja enyɛ loo etsɛ loo ebinuu loo ebiyoo loo enyɛminuu
loo enyɛmiyoo, ni ji oblayoo fro ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, koni ekɛbule ehe.
Ekaya mɔ ko ni gblã hewɔ efeɔ ewekunyo yara nɔ koni ekɛwo ehe muji.
"Osɔfo ko akakpɔ eyi, ni ekaku etsɛŋ nɔ, ni asaŋ ekabãmɔ ehewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ afee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã mi, ni ekawo migbɛi lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ Yehowa afɔlei ni akɛ la shãa, ni ji e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aboloo lɛ, lɛ ekɛbahãa. No hewɔ lɛ efee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Osɔfo ko akaŋɔ yoo ajwamaŋ ko loo yoo ni le nuu, loo yoo ni ewu eshwie lɛ, ejaakɛ miniyenii afɔle lɛ, osɔfo lɛ kɛbahãa mi; Osɔfo lɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Nyɛbua osɔfo lɛ akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, ji mɔ ni mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kɛji osɔfo ko biyoo fee ehe ajwamaŋ lɛ, ewo etsɛ he muji; ashã lɛ ni egbo.

"Osɔfonukpa lɛ, mɔ ni afɔse mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ ashwie eyiteŋ ni awo lɛ osɔfo, ni ewo osɔfo atadei lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekahiɛ eyitso flo, ni ekagbla etadei hu kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ. 11-12. Afɔ lɛ mu ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi: no hewɔ lɛ ekawo mishihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji; ni ekashi jɛi etee eyabote shīa ko ni gbonyo ko kɛkɛ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ tete gbonyo kã mli.
Eŋɔ oblayoo fro.
Ekaŋɔ yoo okulafo loo mɔ ni ewu eshwie lɛ loo mɔ ni le nuu loo yoo ajwamaŋ; shi moŋ eŋɔ oblayoo fro kɛjɛ etsɛ weku lɛ mli.
Efee enɛ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ eshwiei ni sa akɛ amɛfee krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ahe baawo muji. Miji Yehowa, ni mijɔɔ enɔ mifee lɛ osɔfonukpa."
Yehowa fã Mose,
ni ekɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Oshwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni eje kpa akaba, yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli, ni ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ bahã mi.
Mɔ ko ni kpa yɔɔ egbɔmɔtso he kɛ afɔle lɛ akaba; mɔ ni eshwila aloo etsɔ̃ɔ, loo eji gbɔmɔ akotia loo gbɔmɔ asaabu,
loo mɔ ni enane loo enine eje kpa
loo afutsɛ, loo mɔ ni tɛ kã ehiŋmɛi nɔ, loo mɔ ni he edɔ kpla loo mɔ ni egbɛi mli wui ejwara.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni kpa ko yɔɔ ehe yɛ osɔfo Aaron bihii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ ni ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ bahã mi.
Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nakai lɛ eeenyɛ eye aboloo ni ji nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ amli lɛ eko moŋ,
shi muhɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he kɛkɛ ni ekaba, ni ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ kpa yɛ ehe. No hewɔ lɛ ekawo minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahe muji, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
Belɛ enɛ ji nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
22: Yehowa fã Mose,
ni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ: "Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni Israelbii lɛ tsuuɔ he ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhãa mi lɛ he, koni migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ akagbo. Miji Yehowa.
Kɛji oshwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni he tseee tsi bɛŋkɛ afɔlei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ etsuu he amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhã mi lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ. Mla nɛɛ kã shi hã yinɔi fɛɛ.
"Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miiye hewolo nɔ hela gbeyei-gbeyei aloo ehe miiho nu akaye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ehe aaatse.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni taa nɔ ko ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, loo nu ni ehe nu jeɔ emli hoɔ, loo nuu ni taa waamɔnii ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, aloo etaa mɔ ko ni woɔ mɔ he muji he,
loo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nibii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi hulu aaanyɔ shi. Ni kɛ ejuko ehe lɛ ekaye nikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ eko.
Kɛ hulu enyɔ shi ni ehe tse lɛ, no sɛɛ dani eye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ eko, ejaakɛ nomɛi ji eŋmãa.
Ekaye kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele loo kooloi etserɛ lɛ. Kɛji eye lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ mɔ ni he tseee; miji Yehowa.
"Osɔfoi fɛɛ aye mlai ni miwo nɛɛ anɔ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ amɛaatere sɔ̃, ni amɛaagboi yɛ mimlai krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anɔtɔ̃mɔ hewɔ; ni mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
"Mɔkpɔŋ ko mokpɔŋ ko akaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbɔ loo apaafonyo ni ebato osɔfo gbɔ.
Shi nyɔŋ ni osɔfo lɛ he kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshika, aye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; ni nyɔji ni afɔ amɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ we lɛ kɛ lɛ aye eniyenii lɛ eko.
Kɛ osɔfo ko biyoo yagbã mɔ ko kɛkɛ lɛ, ekaye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli nɔ ni aje gbɛ ajie ato afã lɛ.
Shi kɛji osɔfo biyoo lɛ tsɔ̃ okulafo aloo ewu shwie lɛ, ni ebɛ bi, ni eku esɛɛ kɛba etsɛ we lɛ, tamɔ eyɔɔ yɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, no lɛ eye etsɛ nii lɛ eko. Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko kɛkɛ akaye eko.
"Kɛji mɔ ko ni jɛɛɛ osɔfoi aweku mli leee ehe be ni eyaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko lɛ, eto najiaŋ ni ekɛ mlijai enumɔ mli ekome ashi nɔ.
Osɔfoi lɛ akaŋmɛ mɔ ko kɛkɛ gbɛ ni eye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ eko.
Kɛji amɛŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ amɛbaawo niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, ni amɛaatere tɔ̃mɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃, ni aaagbla amɛtoi, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
Yehowa fã Mose,

koni ekɛ mlai nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ, "Kɛji Israelnyo ko loo mɔ ko ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shãa afɔle miiba abahã Yehowa, shiwoo ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa nii jio, kooloo lɛ afee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Bɔ ni efee ni esa Yehowa hie ni ehe lɛ, koloo lɛ afee tsina loo gwaŋtɛŋ loo abotia nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Kɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe ba lɛ, esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ, ni eheŋ.

Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle, tamɔ akɛ tsina loo too, loo afɔle ni ewo he shi eto, loo afɔle ni eeshã yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, miiba abahã Yehowa lɛ, esaaa akɛ kpa ko ahi kooloo lɛ he; esa akɛ efee kooloo ni eye emuu koni esa Yehowa hiɛ.

Nyɛkɛ kooloo nii eshwila aloo eheko eku, loo ehe nii shɛɛɛ, loo fla ni hoɔ nu yɛ ehe, loo kpla loo ajitɔ eshwie ehe loo, nɔ ko ewo yɛ ehewolo nɔ akaba akɛ nyɛkɛbaahã Yehowa koni akɛshã afɔle ahã lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.

Kɛji afɔle ni nyɛkɛba lɛ tsuijurɔ naa nyɛkɛba lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni enine loo enane bɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ashã afɔle lɛ. Shi kɛ afɔle ni nyɛwo he shi nyɛto nyɛshãa lɛ, no lɛ kooloo lɛ esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ ni eheŋ.
Nyɛkɛ kooloo ni ajwara aloo ashimɔ aloo atserɛ aloo aflɔ egbɛi akashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa. Ni nyɛkafea nakai yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

"Nyɛkahea kooloi nɛɛ eko yɛ maŋsɛɛnyo dɛŋ ni nyɛkɛbahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle, ejaakɛ adebɔɔ mli kpa ko yɛ maŋsɛɛ kooloi nɛɛ ahe. Eji kpa ni eka amɛhe, ni amɛsaŋ Yehowa hiɛ. 26-27. "Kɛji afɔ tsina loo gwaŋteŋ loo abotiabi lɛ, akajie lɛ yɛ enyɛ he kɛyashi gbii kpawo. Kɛjɛ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ, esa hã niyenii afɔle shãa hã Yehowa.
Nyɛkagbea tsina loo gwaŋtɛŋ loo abotia kɛ ebi fɛɛ gbi kome.
Kɛji nyɛmiishã shidaa afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa lɛ, nyɛyea ehe mlai lɛ anɔ, koni afɔle lɛ asa ehiɛ.
Nyɛyea loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ; nyɛkashwɛa eko ni je tsɛre nɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Nyɛhiɛ ahiãa mikpɔi lɛ anɔ ni nyɛyea nɔ; miji Yehowa.
Nyɛkahãa migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ miigbo. Esa akɛ Israelbii fɛɛ abu mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; miji Yehowa, ni mi mifeɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni matsɔ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ; miji Yehowa."
23: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ gbii juji ni, mi Yehowa, mito akɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.

Atsu nii gbii ekpaa; shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔgbi ni; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni nyɛaahi; akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ kɛja lɛ nɛ. Nyɛshiɛa eko fɛɛ eko kɛji ebe ni ato lɛ shɛ lɛ."
"Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ ji Yehowa Hehoo gbi lɛ.
Ni gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ, yɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ lɛ, no ji mã akpiti gbijurɔ lɛ. Nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã gbii kpawo kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ.
Gbii kpawo nɛɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ, nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle abahãa Yehowa gbii kpawo. Ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea Kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa; shi akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkpa enɔ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkɛ nikpamɔnii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ able tso kɛ eyinii lɛ abahãa osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ baafɔ̃ nikpamɔnii nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛya kɛba akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ko ni nyɛsa Yehowa hiɛ. Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ osɔfo lɛ baafɔ̃ afɔle nɛɛ.
Gbi nɔ ni nyɛkɛŋmɔshi nikpamɔ nii afɔle lɛ baaba lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛŋ gwaŋtɛŋbi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛbahãa Yehowa.
Ni niyenii afɔle ni afata kooloo lɛ he ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ, kiloi enyɔ, koni ashã ahã Yehowa koni eje ŋma ewo lɛ; ni dãa afɔle ni akɛfata he ji wain lita kome.
Ni kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔle lɛ aaabahã nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aboloo loo able ni ashã loo able fɔ ko akaya nyɛdaaŋ. Akpɔ nɛɛ kã shi hã nyɛshwiei yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
"Nyɛkanea otsii kpawo kɛjɛ Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ ni ji gbi ni nyɛkɛ ŋmãa ni nyɛku lɛ baahã Yehowa lɛ.
Gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ ni ji Hejɔɔmɔgbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ able fɔ afɔle lɛ abahãa Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ aboloo akwaabɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni akɛŋmãa mamu kiloi enyɔ ni awo mli yiisi shã ajɛa nyɛshīai amli kɛbaa akɛ nyɛkɛŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nikpamɔnii ni nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.

Nyɛkɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii kpawo ni amɛye afifi, ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ afata aboloi lɛ ahe. Akɛ kooloi lɛ kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa lɛ fɛɛ bafee akɛhã Yehowa. Afɔle ni ashãa ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
Asaŋ nyɛkɛ too kpakpo kome afea esha he faikpamɔ afɔle, koni nyɛkɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii enyɔ ni amɛye afifi lɛ afea shidaa afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ baaŋɔ aboloo lɛ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋbii lɛ ehã koni afɔ̃ akɛ fɔ̃ɔ afɔle yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Nibii nɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ Yehowa nii krɔŋkrɔŋ. Aŋɔhã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Ashiɛ koni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛkpe Kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja, ni akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ. Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.

"Ni kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkakpaa ŋmɔ lɛ naanaa nii lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa; nakai nɔŋŋ hu onikpamɔ nii lɛ amli kpɛkpɛbii lɛ hu kaakpɛte; shi moŋ ashi ahã ohiafo kɛ gbɔ koni amɛkɛbaye kpɛkpɛo. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ, nyɛyea lɛ kpoo akɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbijurɔ. Akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ akɛ kaimɔ nɔ kɛshiɛ gbi lɛ, koni akpe Kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja.
Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ; ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle abahãa Yehowa."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

"Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ ji esha kpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ. Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ; asaŋ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa.
Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ kpãtãmɔ gbi ni, koni akpãtã yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ ahã nyɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni waaa ehe yi kɛ hɔmɔ nakai gbi lɛ lɛ, akaneŋ lɛ ashiŋ emaŋbii anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ emaŋbii lɛ ateŋ.
Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ. Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
Hejɔɔmɔgbi wulu nɛ hã nyɛ. Nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ kɛjɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi aahuu kɛyaashi enɔ jetsɛremɔ gbɛkɛnaashi ekoŋŋ. Nyɛyea Hejɔɔmɔgbi krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo ni kã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ ji Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ; aye gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo ahã Yehowa.
Gbi ni ji klɛŋlɛŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.

Gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa nyɛbahãa Yehowa. Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa. Kpee wulu diɛŋtsɛ gbi ni. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.

"Enɛɛmɛi ji gbiijuji ni Yehowa eto lɛ; ni kɛji eko shɛ lɛ nyɛshiɛa koni maŋ lɛ akpe kpei krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛja, asaŋ koni ashã niyenii afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei akɛhã Yehowa, eko fɛɛ eko yɛ egbi nɔ.
Esoro Yehowa Hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ, dani esoro nyɛdaaadaa nikeenii lɛ, ni esoro nyɛshiwoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ hu ni nyɛkɛbahãa Yehowa.
"Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ, be ni nyɛkpa ŋmɔshi nii nyɛgbe naa lɛ, nyɛjea shishi nyɛyea Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ kɛyashia gbii kpawo. Gbi ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi krɛdɛɛ ni.
Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛhiɛa nyɛtsei anɔ aduawai kpakpai fɛfɛji kɛ tɛŋ bɛlɛo kɛ tsei flofloi aniji kɛ faa naa ŋɔi kɛbaa koni nyɛbanyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ gbii kpawo.
Nyɛkɛ gbii kpawo ayea gbijurɔ nɛɛ daa afi nyɛhãa Yehowa yɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ. Eji naanɔ akpɔ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ.
Nyɛhia asesei amli gbii kpawo. Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo ahi asese mli,
koni nyɛshwiei kɛna amɛle akɛ be ni miyakpla Israel kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, asesei amli mihã amɛhi. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. "
Belɛ bɔ ni Mose tsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ gbii juji ni Yehowa eto ehã amɛ akɛ amɛye lɛ nɛ.
24: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Fã Israelbii akɛ amɛbahã bo mutso mu krɔŋŋ ni akɛ mutso ni ashimɔ fee koni akɛ mu lɛ asu Kpee Buu lɛ mli kane lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ahã kane lɛ ama nɔ be fɛɛ be.

Aaron akwɛ koni kane lɛ atso, kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ aahuu kɛyashi daa jetsɛremɔ leebi, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ be fɛɛ be yɛ muhɔɔ ni fo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ kponɔgbɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli. Enɛ afee naanɔ akpɔ ahã nyɛshwiei.
Aaron baakura kanei lɛ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi kanetsei lɛ anɔ, ni ebaakwɛ koni amɛtso yɛ Yehowa hiɛ be fɛɛ be.
"Okɛ ŋmãa mamu ashã aboloo akwabɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, aboloo akwaabɔ kome aye ŋmãa mamu kilo kome.
Too aboloi lɛ sɛrɛnɛɛ kui enyɔ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ. Aboloi ekpaa aye afã biɛ, ni aboloi ekpaa hu aye biɛ.
Okɛ krɔbɔo krɔŋŋ afata aboloo ku kome fɛɛ ku kome he, koni no afee kaimɔ nɔ ni akɛbahã akɛ afɔle ni ashã ahã Yehowa.
Daa Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, Aaron ato aboloi nɛɛ eshwie okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ni kã shi hã Israelbii nɛ.
Aboloi lɛ atsɔ̃ Aaron kɛ eshwiei agbɛfaŋnɔ; ni amɛye nii nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle ni abashã akɛhã Yehowa mli nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni."
Be ko lɛ Israelyoo ko bi nuu ni ekɛ Egiptnuu ko fɔ lɛ kɛ Israelnyo ko yabe yɛ maŋ, yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Israelyoo nɛɛ gbɛi ji Shelomit, ni etsɛ ji Dibri ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli lɛ. Bei lɛ mli lɛ oblanyo lɛ bɔ musu elomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. No hewɔ lɛ amɔ lɛ kɛbahã Mose.
Atsi oblanyo lɛ naa kɛyashi Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni afee lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Mɔ mɔ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje shitoohe lɛ mli kɛya esɛɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nu akɛ elomɔ lɛ kɛ amɛniji abashwie eyiteŋ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋ tso muu lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ,' Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baalomɔ e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ lɛ, emusu baabua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ;
mɔ ni baalomɔ Yehowa lɛ, gbe kɛ̃ aaagbe lɛ. Gbɔ ni jio, maŋnyo ni jio, kɛji ena elomɔ Yehowa lɛ, maŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.'
"Mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu agbe lɛ;
ni mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ kroko kooloo lɛ, eto kooloo lɛ najiaŋ kɛ kooloo nɔŋŋ; akɛ kooloo ato kooloo najiaŋ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko pila enaanyo gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu apila lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ bɔ ni epila enaanyo lɛ koni akɛtse.

Kɛji eku enaanyo lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli wu lɛ, aku lɛ hu ewu akɛtse; kɛji hiŋmɛi ni lɛ, akɛ ehiŋmɛi atse, ni kɛji nyanyɔŋ ni lɛ, akɛ lɛ hu enyanyɔŋ atse. Bɔ ni epila mɔ lɛ ehã lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nɔŋŋ apila lɛ hu kɛtse.
Mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ ko kooloo ko lɛ, eto mɔ lɛ kooloo lɛ najiaŋ; shi mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ gbe agbe lɛ.
Mla koome nɛɛ akã shi ahã nyɛ fɛɛ, gbɔ kɛ maŋnyo fɛɛ, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."

Be ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ewie egbe naa lɛ, maŋbii lɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje amɛshitoohe lɛ mli kɛtee esɛɛ, ni ayatswia lɛ tɛ yɛ jɛi ni egbo. Belɛ kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.
25: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ,
ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa shikpɔŋ lɛ akãa shi eflo afi koni ekɛjɔɔ ehe akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa.
Nyɛhua shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛdua nyɛŋmɔshi nii afii ekpaa, ni nyɛkplɔa nyɛwaintsei ahe, ni nyɛkpaa amɛyibii afii ekpaa hu;
shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, aŋmɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he koni ejɔɔ ehe kpoo, akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa. Akadu nii yɛŋmɔshi, ni akakplɔ waintsei ahe hu.
Ŋmɔshinii ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eeekwɛ̃ lɛ, akakpa ato; ni yibii ni waintsei ni akplɔko amɛhe lɛ aaawo lɛ hu, akakpa ato. Nakai afi lɛ eji hejɔɔmɔ afi hã shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ be nɛɛ mli niyenii ni baakwɛ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ebaashɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɔji hii kɛ yei kɛ nyɛpaafoi kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ fɛɛ,
kɛ nyɛshīa kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yeli aahuu. Niyenii fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba lɛ aye."
"Nyɛkanea shikpɔŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ afi nɛɛ toi kpawo, no ji afii kpawo kpawo toi kpawo. Enɛ feɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ nɛɛhu.
Afi nɛɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ, no ji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi lɛ. Akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ kɛfo shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi nɛɛ nɔ.

Nyɛfea afi ni ji afi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Ashiɛ heyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahã enɔ bii fɛɛ. Etsɔ̃ nyamɔ afi ehã nyɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ko ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ, mɔ lɛ loo eshwie ko aku sɛɛ ayaŋɔ nii lɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ aku esɛɛ eya ewekumɛi aŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.

Nɛkɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɛɛ atsɔ nyamɔ afi ahã nyɛ. Nyɛkadua nii yɛ enɔ; ni nyɛkakpaa niyenii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahä nyɛ lɛ nyɛtoa; asaŋ nyɛkakpaa nyɛwaintsei ni akplɔɔɔ amɛhe lɛ anɔ yibii lɛ hu.
Nyamɔ afi ni, ni nyɛyea lɛ akɛ afi krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahã nyɛ lɛ, no nyɛyea.
"Nɛkɛ nyamɔ afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kulɛ ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ, eya ni eyaŋɔ enii ekoŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛji ohɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ ko ohã onyɛmi Israelnyo, aloo ohe shikpɔŋ ko yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akamɔ enyɛmi lɛ loo eshishiu enyɛmi lɛ.
Adamɔ afii abɔ ni abaanyɛ ahu shikpɔŋ lɛ ni akpa enɔ nibaanii lɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ ashɛ nɔ awo shikpɔŋ lɛ he jra.
Kɛji afii lɛ fa lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jra lɛ awa; ni kɛji afii lɛ faaa lɛ, no lɛ ejra lɛ aba shi, ejaakɛ afii lɛ amli nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo lɛ ji nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akashishiu enyɛmi; shi nyɛshea nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
"Nyɛyea mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ ekpakpa, ni nyɛaahi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba eniyenii, ni nyɛaaye nyɛtrɔ; ni nyɛaahi nɔ shweshweeshwe.
"Eko lɛ nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji wɔduŋ nii, ni wɔkpãŋ ŋmɔshi nii wɔtoŋ yɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ mɛni wɔɔye mɔ?
Naa, mibajɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ bɔ ni ebaaba afii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ niyenii shi kome.
Belɛ afi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ be mli ni nyɛdu nii lɛ, nyɛbaaye blema niyenii ni nyɛkpa nyɛto lɛ kɛyaashi afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛaakpa enɔ nii ni nyɛdu lɛ.
"Akafo shikpɔŋ yibaa ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ owura kosɛɛ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli minɔ ni; ni nyɛ lɛ miwe kɛ mishīa mli gbɔi kɛkɛ ji nyɛ.
"Nyɛŋmɛa shikpɔŋ kpɔ̃mɔ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu ni nyɛyaa ŋɔ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he.
Kɛji efi onyɛmi Israelnyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ eehɔ̃ɔ egboshinii ko lɛ, ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ ebakpɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni enyɛmi lɛ hɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ bɛ mɔ ko ni aaayakpɔ̃ nii lɛ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ amrɔmrɔ nɔŋŋ, shi fee sɛɛ lɛ ena edɛŋ bɔ ni shɛɔ nii ni ehɔɔ lɛ kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ,
no lɛ akane afii abɔ ni nii lɛ eye, kɛjɛ be ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ naa naa, koni mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ awo afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ shɛɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ eku sɛɛ eŋɔ enii lɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ ahi mɔ ni he nii lɛ dɛŋ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ, ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ mli lɛ nihelɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ nii lɛ he, koni nɔtsɛ lɛ aŋɔ enii lɛ ekoŋŋ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko hɔ̃ɔ eshīa ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he mli lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ shīa lɛ kɛyashi enɔ afi naaklpɔ ni ekpɔ̃ɔ shīa lɛ.

Shi kɛji akpɔ̃ɔɔ shīa nɛɛ kɛyashi afi muu ho lɛ, no lɛ shīa nɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni he shīa lɛ kɛ eshwiei agboshinii kɛmiiya naanɔ. Kɛji shɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ tete lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ he ehã mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shi tsui ni yɔɔ akrowai ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe amli lɛ, abu amɛ tamɔ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Abaanyɛ akpɔ̃ amɛ be fɛɛ be; ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ amɛhe ahã tsutsu nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Shi yɛ Levibii amaji ni ahã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ amli shīai lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Levibii lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛkpɔ̃ɔ eko fɛɛ eko ni ahɔ̃ɔ be fɛɛ be.

Kɛji Levinyo ko kpɔ̃ɔɔ shīa ko ni ehɔ̃ɔɔ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ aŋmɛɛ shīa ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ Levibii amaŋ lɛ mli lɛ he ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ shīai ni yɔɔ Levibii amaji lɛ amli lɛ, nomɛi ji Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ nii ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Shi amɛmaji lɛ ahe shikpɔji lɛ akahɔ̃ɔ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni kɛmiiya naanɔ."
"Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni enyɛɛɛ ehe ekwɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, omɔ mli ohã lɛ ni okwɛ lɛ; okɛ lɛ ahi shi akɛ gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo.
Kaahe lɛ nɔ ko he kpa, ni kaaŋmɛ nyɔmɔ ko ni ewoɔ bo nɔ; shi oshe o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei; ni oŋmɛ onyɛmi Israelnyo lɛ gbɛ koni ehi omasɛi.
Kaahe lɛ oshika ni okɛfa lɛ lɛ he kpa; ni onyenii ni ohãa lɛ lɛ hu kaaŋmɛ ejra nɔ.
Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã nyɛ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
"Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã o lɛ, okaye lɛ nyɔŋ,
shi moŋ etsɔ̃ tamɔ apaafonyo loo gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo. Esɔmɔ bo kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji eshɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛ kɛ ebii kɛ hɔi fɛɛ ashi oŋɔɔ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛwekumɛi ateŋ kɛ eseshibii anɔ mli ekoŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni mijie amɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji amɛ; no hewɔ lɛ ebɛ akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ nyɔŋ.
Okaye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ; shi oshe o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Kɛji nyɛmiitao wehii kɛ weyei, nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei lɛ, nyɛyahea amɛ yɛ majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ amli.
Nyɛbaanyɛ hu ni nyɛhe nyɔji kɛjɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ abii ni afɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛgboshinii;
ni nyɛaanyɛ nyɛshi amɛ nyɛhã nyɛbii akɛ amɛgboshinii. Amɛ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛye amɛ nyɔŋ, shi nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israel fɔmɔbii lɛ, amɛ lɛ, akaye amɛteŋ mɔ ko nɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.
"Kɛji gbɔ ko loo mɔkpɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ tsɔ̃ niiatsɛ; shi onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ emasɛi lɛ ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã gbɔ loo mɔkpɔŋ lɛ loo gbɔ lɛ wekunyo ko lɛ,
gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hehɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hegbɛ yɛ lolo akɛ akpɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Esa akɛ enyɛmi nuu ko,
loo etsɛkwɛ̃ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ nyɛmibi loo ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa aya ayakpɔ̃ lɛ, loo jɛji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ena nɔ ko lɛ, ekpɔ̃ ehe.
Ekɛ mɔ ni he lɛ lɛ abu akɔntaa kɛjɛ afi nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã lɛ lɛ, kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ; ni eyinii lɛ abu yɛ afii lɛ ayikulɛ naa. Be ni eye yɛ mɔ ni ehe lɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, abu lɛ akɛ apaayeli be.
Kɛji eshwɛ afii pii dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ eyi shika ni ekɛbaakpɔ̃ ehe lɛ ada.
Kɛji eshwɛ afii fioo ko kɛkɛ dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ po, mɔ ni he lɛ kɛ lɛ abu akɔntaa, koni akwɛ afii abɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, kɛna shika fioo ni sa akɛ ewo kɛkpɔ̃ ehe lɛ.
Mɔ ni he lɛ lɛ abu lɛ tamɔ apaafonyo ni miitsu afi nii yɛ ekɛ lɛ shihilɛ mli. Enuŋtsɔ lɛ akaye enɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ naaa mɔ ko atsɔ̃ gbɛi nɛɛ eko nɔ ni ebakpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe ni eye ehe, lɛ kɛ ebii ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni; amɛji mitsuji ni mijie yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
26: Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkafea amãgãi nyɛhãa nyɛhe, ni nyɛkɛ tɛ akamaa shiu ko, ni nyɛkakpɛa nɔ ko mfoniri yɛ tɛ mli hu nyɛkɛma shi yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkoto shi nyɛja lɛ, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyea gbii juji ni mito lɛ, ni nyɛhiɛ asɔa he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ. Miji Yehowa.
"Kɛji nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbu mikitãi lɛ, ni nyɛye amɛnɔ lɛ,
mahã nu anɛ ahã nyɛ yɛ be ni sa mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba nii babaoo ahã nyɛ, ni ŋmɔshi tsei hu baawo yibii.

Nyɛbaakã he nyɛgbee ŋmãa ni nyɛku aahuu kɛyaashi wainyibii tsemɔ be mli, ni nyɛbaahiɛ wainyibii tsemɔ nɛkɛ aahuu kɛyashi nidumɔ be mli, ni nyɛaaye nyɛboloo nyɛtrɔ. Nyɛaahi nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.
"Mahã jeŋ ajɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛaakamɔ shi nyɛwɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ nyɛhe gbeyei. Mahã kooloi fɔɔji atã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni awuŋ ta yɛ jɛi.
Nyɛaawo nyɛhenyɛlɔi foi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ klaŋte naa.
Nyɛteiaŋ gbɔmɛi enumɔ kɛkɛ aaawo henyɛlɔi oha foi, ni nyɛmɛi oha hu aaawo henyɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma foi. Nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ aaanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ klaŋte naa.
Madro nyɛ, ni mahã nyɛwo shwiei ni nyɛyi afa; ni maye mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛhiɛ able kukudabi ni nyɛto lɛ yeli mli ni able kpokploku baapue, ni no hewɔ lɛ nyɛaajie kukudabi lɛ kɛje kpo koni ana toohe ahã kpokploku lɛ.
Mahi nyɛteŋ yɛ mi-Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni minyaŋeŋ nyɛ.
Manyiɛ nyɛteŋ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.
Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛkahi shi akɛ amɛnyɔji dɔŋŋ lɛ. Mikumɔ tsei ni akɛwo nyɛ apã lɛ, ni mihã nyɛnyiɛ ni apã kãaa nyɛkuɛ."
"Shi kɛji nyɛbooo mi toi, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi nɛɛ anɔ;
ni kɛji nyɛkwa mikpɔi lɛ, ni nyɛnyaŋe mimlai lɛ, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ,

mi hu nɔ ni mibafee nyɛ nɛ: Mibahã tsuifãa saji abahɛŋ nyɛ trukaa, ni wɔlɔmɔ kɛ atridii ni hãa hiŋmɛi fiteɔ, ni etãa gbɔmɔtso loo baaye nyɛ. Nyɛbaagbo deŋme yaka nyɛdu nii ejaakɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi moŋ baaba abaye.
Mijie mihiɛ maka nyɛ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi baaye nyɛnɔ, ni mɛi ni hetsɛ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aaaye nyɛnɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni nyɛbaawo foi be mli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ nyɛsɛɛ.
"Ni kɛji enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbooo mi toi lolo lɛ, no lɛ mibagbla nyɛtoi ekoŋŋ shii kpawo yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ,
ni maku nyɛhe ni nyɛwoɔ kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ lɛ naa, ni mahã ŋwɛi agbi tamɔ dade, ni nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ aaagbi tamɔ akɔɔble,
ni nyɛaagbo yaka deŋme ejaakɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baŋ niyenii, ni enɔ tsei lɛ hu woŋ yibii.
"Kɛji nyɛfeee nɔ ni mi mitaoɔ ni nyɛtee nɔ nyɛbooo mi toi lɛ, mayanɔ magbla nyɛtoi, shii kpawo fe tsustsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa.
Maŋmɛɛ ŋaŋ kooloi ahe mawo nyɛteŋ, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛbii, ni amɛbaakpãtã nyɛshīa kooloi ahiɛ, ni amɛbaahã nyɛ nɔ agbɔ, bɔ ni nane baaje nyɛgbɛjegbɛi anɔ.
"Kɛji yɛ nɛkɛ toigblamɔ nɛɛ hu fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsakeee, shi nyɛtee nɔ nyɛfee nɔ ni mitaooo lɛ,
no lɛ mi hu mate shi mawo nyɛ, ni magbla nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ.

Mahã ta abanina nyɛ koni atsɔ̃ no nɔ kɛgbla nyɛtoi, kɛtɔ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mlikuu he owele. Kɛji nyɛbua nyɛhe naa yɛ nyɛmaji wuji amli, yɛ shweeshwefeemɔ hewɔ hu lɛ, mibahã gbele hela abote nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anine aaashɛ nyɛnɔ.
Mafo nyɛŋmãa ni nyɛnaa nyɛyeɔ sɛɛ lɛ; ni no baahã yei nyɔŋma ashã aboloo fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shãa lɛ yɛ flɔnɔɔ kome pɛ mli. Aboloo lɛ hu abaaŋmɛ kɛ nsɛni ahã nyɛ nyɛye; ni nyɛaaye nɛ shi nyɛtrɔŋ.
"Ni kɛji yɛ enɛ fɛɛ hu sɛɛ lɛ nyɛbooo mi toi, shi nyɛfee nɔ ni mitaooo lɛ,
no lɛ mi hu mate shi mawo nyɛ kɛ mlila, ni magbla nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
"Hɔmɔ naa lɛ nyɛbaagbe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei, nyɛye.
Mibafite hei ni nyɛjaa yɛ, yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ ohɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ; ni mibashɛrɛ nyɛgbohii lɛ mashwie nyɛmãgãi ni akumɔ ashwei shi lɛ anɔ.
Mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei lɛ hu; ni mihereŋ nyɛtsofakɛŋma lɛ ŋma dɔŋŋ.
Makpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ bɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni aaabahi nɔ lɛ tete ahiɛ aaafee amɛ yaa.
Ni nyɛ diɛtsɛ lɛ mahã ta abanina nyɛ, ni magbɛ nyɛ mashwã majimaji ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ anɔ. Gbɔmɛi baatã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛmaji lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i.

Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi eflo ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, belɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miijɔɔ ehe ekɛtse ehejɔɔmɔ be ni nyɛshã nyɛshwie lɛ. Belɛ ja nakai dani shikpɔŋ lɛ baana hegbɛ eye ehejɔɔmɔ be lɛ.
Gbii abɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi eflo ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, belɛ ehejɔɔmɔ ni nyɛhã ŋmɛɛ lɛ be ni nyɛyɔɔ enɔ lɛ, no eyeɔ lɛ.

"Ni nyɛteŋ mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ gbeyelɔi feetɔi, mɛi ni baa ni etse kɛyaagbee shi gbɛɛmɔ kɛkɛ po baawo amɛ foi, ni amɛbaajo foi tamɔ ajoɔ klaŋte naa foi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, mɔ ko kã mɔ ko nɔ tamɔ mɛi ni miijo klaŋte naa foi gbeɔ shi, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko woko amɛ foi; ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ahiɛ nyɛdamɔ.
Nyɛaagboi yɛ maŋsɛɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, ni eeefee tamɔ nɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ emimii nyɛ.

Ni nyɛteŋ mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ, mligbigblimɔ sɔŋŋ baagbegbee nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ hu nyɛaagbigbli nyɛmli tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛyaashi nyɛaagboi tamɔ amɛ.
"Shi kɛji amɛjaje amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee amɛshi mi, kɛ bɔ ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ bɔ ni mi mitaoɔ,
ni no hewɔ hu mi hu mite shi miwo amɛ, ni mihã amɛyaje amɛhenyɛlɔi shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, kɛji amɛtsui ni ekpiliŋ lɛ he jɔ, ni amɛba amɛhe shi, ni amɛkplɛ̃ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ ahe nyɔmɔwo lɛ nɔ lɛ,
no lɛ mibakai mi kɛ Yakob teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ mi kɛ Isak teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, kɛ mi kɛ Abraham teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, ni mibakai amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ.

Shi ja amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi eflo ni ahuuu nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ lɛ ana aye ehejɔɔmɔ be lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ ja agbla amɛtoi kɛwo amɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛnyaŋe mikpɔi lɛ.

Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, be mli ni amɛyɔɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, mikwaŋ amɛ, ni minyaŋeŋ amɛ bɔ ni no baahã makpãtã amɛhiɛ kwraa kɛku mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi amɛhewɔ lɛ, mibakai mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni mijie yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, koni matsɔ̃ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Miji Yehowa."
Akpɔi kɛ kitãi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo yɛ Sinai Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ koni ekã lɛ, Yehowa, kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ji enɛɛmɛi.
27: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko je gbɛ, ni ewo shi krɛdɛɛ, ni ejɔɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi anɔ ekɛke Yehowa koni gbɔmɛi komɛi anɔ ekɛke Yehowa koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ jamɔhe lɛ, jra ni abaawo yɛ amɛyi kɛkpɔ̃ amɛ nɛ:
Nuu ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa lɛ, eyi jra afee jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Kɛji yoo ni lɛ, no lɛ eyi jra lɛ afee jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Yɛ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii enumɔ aahuu kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, awo nuu yi jra jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ yoo hu yi jra jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma.
Shi yɛ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔɔŋ kome aahuu kɛyashi afii enumɔ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, awo nuu yi jra jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ, kɛ yoo hu yi jra jwiɛtɛi shekeli etɛ̃.
Ni mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛyaa lɛ, nuu yi jra ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ, yoo hu yi jra ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma.

"Kɛji mɔ ni wo shi lɛ ohiafo ni, ni enyɛɛɛ jra ni afo lɛ ewo lɛ, no lɛ ekpla gbɔmɔ ni ejɔɔ enɔ eke Yehowa lɛ kɛya osɔfo lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ awo egbɔmɔ lɛ yi jra. Osɔfo lɛ adamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni wo shi lɛ aaana ahã nɔ kɛwo jra lɛ.
"Shi kɛji shīa kooloo ji nɔ ni awo ehe shi ajɔɔ enɔ akɛhã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ, etsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.

Mɔ ni wo shi lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekɛ kooloo kroko toɔ najiaŋ aloo etsakeɔ; ekɛ kooloo kpakpa akato kooloo gbonyo najiaŋ lɛ, ekɛ kooloo gbonyo akatsake ekpakpa. Kɛji ekɛ kooloo tee emomo lɛ tsakemɔ lɛ, no lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo momo lɛ kɛ kooloo hee ni ekɛba tsakemɔ lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ Yehowa nii.
Shi kɛji kooloo lɛ yafee kooloo ni he tseee, ni no hewɔ lɛ akɛshãaa afɔle ahãaa Yehowa lɛ eko ni lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ kpa ni yɔɔ kooloo lɛ he kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ koni ewo eyi jra. Jra ni osɔfo lɛ baawo lɛ, aŋɔ nɔ nakai.
Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ ekooloo lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kooloo lɛ jra lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie kooloo lɛ yi jra ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo eyi nyɔmɔ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ eshīa nɔ eke Yehowa lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nibii ni hi kɛ nibii ni ehiii fɛɛ yɛ shīa lɛ he koni ewo ejra; ni jra ni osɔfo lɛ baawo lɛ aŋɔ nɔ nakai.
Ni kɛji mɔ ni jɔɔ eshīa nɔ eke lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ eshīa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ shīa lɛ jra ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jra ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo shīa lɛ he nyɔmɔ, ni shīa lɛ baatsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ.

"Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii nɔ ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akwɛ dumɔ wui ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yeɔ falɛ kɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ jra. Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ jra lɛ ji akoko kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ akɛhe jwiɛtɛi shekel nyɔŋma.
Kɛji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afiyeli lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ jra lɛ adamɔ jra bɔ ni awo lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛji afiyeli lɛ sɛɛ dani ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi ekoŋŋ yɛ shika mli koni akɛtse jra ni awo lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ni jɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ sumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jra ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jra ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo nyɔmɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ.
Shi kɛji esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, aloo ehɔ̃ɔ ehã mɔ kroko ko lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehiŋ kpɔ̃mɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛji eshɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ, ni aŋmɛɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he tete lɛ, ebaahi shi akɛ Yehowa nɔ, nɔ ko ni ajɔɔ nɔ owura kosɛɛ ake Yehowa; ebaatsɔ̃ osɔfo lɛ nɔ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni jeee gbo agbo ashi ahã lɛ, shi etse shika ekɛhe, nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ,
no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu shikpɔŋ lɛ jra lɛ naa kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ ehã mɔ lɛ, ni mɔ lɛ awo shika nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ akɛ shika lɛ ahã Yehowa akɛ enii yinii.
Ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpale shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã mɔ dɛŋ ni ahe yɛ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii.
"Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo jra fɛɛ jra afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ jwiɛtɛi tɛ lɛ naa; no ji akɛ gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ afee shekel kome.
"Shi kooloi fɛɛ akromɔbii ni ji Yehowa nii momo lɛ, mɔ ko akajɔɔ eko nɔ ekɛmiike Yehowa: Tsina ni jio, too ni jio, Yehowa nɔ ni momo.

Shi kɛji kooloi ni ahe tseee lɛ eko kromɔbi ni lɛ, no lɛ akpɔ̃ lɛ yɛ jra tɛ ni afo lɛ naa; akɛ eyi jra ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jra ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo eyi nyɔmɔ. Shi kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ kpɔ̃ɔɔ ekooloo lɛ, no lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ jra ni awo lɛ kɛkɛ naa.

"Shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mɔ ko yɔɔ, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, shikpɔŋ ni agbo ashi ahã lɛ ni jio, ni ejɔɔ nɔ tswaa ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akahɔ̃ɔ, ni akakpɔ̃ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ lɛ eji Yehowa nii kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa tete ni akɛ lɛ eke koni akpãtã ehiɛ ɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, akakpɔ̃ lɛ; ana agbe lɛ kɛ̃.
"Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmãa ni jio, aduawai ni jio, amɛmlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni; nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Kɛji mɔ ko sumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ egbɛfaŋ nibii lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome agbe yi kɛwo nyɔmɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ji tsinai kɛ toi: no ji kooloi fɛɛ ni akplaa amɛ lɛ amɛyikulɛ nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eji Yehowa nɔ.
Akakpa mli akwɛ akatsake hu. Kɛji mɔ ko aaatsake eko kɛ̃ lɛ, no lɛ no kɛ lɛ kooloo hee ni akɛbaatsake emomo lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm baatsɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; akakpɔ̃ kooloo lɛ."
Enɛɛmɛi ji kitãi ni Yehowa fã Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ewo Israelbii lɛ.

1: Akɛni mɛi pii ekɔ efɔ̃ amɛnɔ akɛ amɛaaaŋma saji ni eba mli yɛ wɔteŋ
tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi ni na kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii kɛjɛ shishijee mli ni amɛji wiemɔ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ jaje tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
Teofilo jurɔ, esa mihiɛ akɛ mi hu ni mitao nibii fɛɛ mli fitsofitso kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, maŋma pɛpɛɛpɛ maha o
koni ona anɔkwale ni yɔɔ nii ni atsɔ̃ɔ o lɛ mli.
Yudea Maŋtsɛ Herode yinɔ lɛ osɔfo ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zakaria; ejɛ Abia osɔfoiaku lɛ mli, eŋa jɛ Aaron biyei lɛ ateŋ, ni agbɛi ji Elisabet.
Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jalɔi ni amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni amɛyeɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitãi kɛ ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe.
Shi amɛbɛ bi, ejaakɛ Elizabet lɛ kene ni, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛdra.
SHi gbi ko be ni eshɛ esɔfoiaku lɛ nɔ, ni esɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ,
ahala lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni esɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ agbɛnaa yɔɔ lɛ, koni ebote Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli eyashã tsofakɛŋma.
Ni tsofakɛŋmashãa be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ misɔle yɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko bajie ehe kpo etsɛ̃ɔ lɛ ni edamɔ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Ni be ni Zakaria na lɛ lɛ, etsui fã ni gbeyei mɔ lɛ.
Shi bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, Zakaria, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebo ofaikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni oŋa Elizabet aaafɔ binuu ahã o, ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yohane.
Eeeehã ona miishɛɛ, ni omli aafli o, ni mɛi pii aaanya efɔnɔ lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ agbo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ. Ni enuŋ wain loo dãa ni wa ko, Ni Mumɔ wain loo dãa ni wa ko, Ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaayi lɛ obɔ̃ kɛaajɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe.
Ni eeekpale Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kɛaaba Nuŋtsɔ, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ŋɔɔ.
Ni eeetsɔ̃ ehiɛ yɛ Eliamumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ mli, ni eyadrɔ tsɛmɛi atsuii kɛba bii ahe, kɛ toigbolɔi hu kɛba jalɔi anilee mli, ni esaa maŋ ni efee klalo eto Nuŋtsɔ lɛ."
Ni Zakaria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mikɛaale enɛ? Mi lɛ nuumo ji mi, ni miŋa hu egbɔ."
Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, "Miji Gabriel ni damɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni atsu mi akɛ mikɛ o abawie ni migba o sane kpakpa nɛɛ.
Ni naa, oootɔ mu ni onyɛŋ owie kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni nii nɛɛ aaaba mli, ejaakɛ oheee miwiemɔ lɛ ni baaba mli kɛ be shɛ lɛ oyeee."
Ni maŋ lɛ miimɛ Zakaria, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ etsɛ nɛkɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi be ni eje kpo lɛ, enyɛɛɛ ekɛ amɛ awie, ni amɛyoo sɛɛ akɛ eyana nii yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ekɛ enine fee okadi etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni etɔ mu lolo.
Be ni egbe esɔ̃ɔmɔ gbii lɛ naa lɛ, eyiŋ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
Shi nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ aŋa Elizabet na musu, ni eteee ehe nyɔji enumɔ ekɛɛ,
"Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ efeee mi nɛ akɛ agbɛnɛ ekwɛ ni ejie mihiɛgble lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ."
Shi nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo Gabriel kɛtee Galilea maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli ni ekɛ wiemɔ ayahã.
oblayoo fro ko ni atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef ni jɛ David we lɛ; oblayoo lɛ gbɛi ji Maria.
Ni bɔ fo lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Hejɔlɛ ahã o, bo n adro o, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ o yɛ."
Etsui fã yɛ bɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ he, ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, "Mɛɛ ŋamɔ po nɛ!"
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei, Maria; ejaakɛ ohiɛ eba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ni naa, obaana musu, ni ooofɔ binuu ni oooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.
Eeetsɔ̃ agbo, ni aaatsɛ lɛ ŋwɛinyo lɛ Bi, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ etsɛ David maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ni eeeye Yakob we lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ. Ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ."
Shi Maria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni enɛ aaaba mliŋ, akɛni mileee nuu nɛɛ?"
Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaaaba onɔ. Ni ŋwɛinyo lɛ hewalɛ aaabahã onɔ, No hewɔ lɛ nakai bi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni ooofɔ lɛ, aaatsɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi.
Ni naa, owekunyo Elizabet lɛ hu, ena binuuu musu yɛ egbɔlɛ mli, ni mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ kene lɛ ena nyɔji ekpaa.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ bɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛŋ afee."
Ni Maria kɛɛ, "Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ weyoo ji mi; bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ aba mli nakai ahã mi!" Ni bɔfo lɛ shi lɛ etee.
Ni yɛ Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ Maria kɛ oyaiyeli yiŋ kɛtee Yuda maŋ ko mli yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ,
ni eyabote Zakaria we lɛ ni eŋa Elizabet musuŋ; ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yi Elizabet obɔ̃;
ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, "Ajɔɔ o yɛ yei teŋ, ni ajɔɔ omusuŋbi lɛ!
Ni nɛɛgbɛ mina nyam kɛɛ kɛjɛ akɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ nyɛ baa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ?
Shi naa, amrɔ pɛ ni oŋamɔ lɛ gbɛɛ yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, abifao lɛ kɛ gbɛɛ yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, abifao lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ tu yɛ mimusuŋ.
Ni ajɔɔ o, bo ni ohe oye akɛ wiemɔi ni ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ aaaba mli lɛ."
Ni Maria kɛɛ, "Mimusuma miikafo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ,
ni mimumɔ mli miifli lɛ yɛ nyɔŋmɔ miyiwalahereɔ lɛ ahewɔ,
akɛ ebakwɛ mi eweyoo ni ji humi lɛ. Ejaakɛ naa, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, yinɔi fɛɛ aaabu mi akɛ mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ;
ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ efee nii wuji ehã mi; ni krɔŋkrɔŋ ji egbɛi lɛ.
Emɔbɔnalɛ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ anɔ kɛyashi yinɔi ayinɔi=,
Ekɛ enine etsu hewalɛ nitsumɔi; mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛtsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ mli lɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã.
Ekpa ojei kɛjɛ amɛsɛ̃ii anɔ, ni ewo mɛi ni ji humii lɛ anɔ.
Ehã mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ etrɔ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni niiatsɛmɛi lɛ eshwie amɛ eflo.
Eye ebua ewenuu Israel, koni ekai emɔbɔnalɛ lLɛ,
tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni yɔɔ hã Abraham kɛ eshwie lɛ kɛya naanɔ."
Ni Maria kɛ lɛ hi shi aaafee nyɔji etɛ̃ ni eku esɛɛ etee eshīa.
Agbɛnɛ Elizabet fɔmɔ be shɛ, ni efɔ binuu.
Ni ekuu lɛ mli bii kɛ ewekumɛi lɛ nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ babaoo, ni amɛ kɛ lɛ nya.
gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛba gbekɛ lɛ ketiafoo, ni kulɛ amɛmiitao amɛkɛ etsɛ gbɛi Zakaria lɛ awo lɛ.
Shi enyɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Dabida, abaatsɛ lɛ Yohane moŋ!"
Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ko bɛ owɛku lɛ mli ni atsɛɔ lɛ naaki.!"
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛnine fee okadi kɛbi etsɛ bɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ atsɛ lɛ.
Ni ebi tao ko, ni eŋma akɛ, "YOhane ji egbɛi." Ni efee amɛ fɛɛ naakpɛɛ.
Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaabu gble ni elilɛi fɛne, ni ewie ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi.
Ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ kuu lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni agba saji nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yudea gɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ kɛto amɛtsuiŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛni po gbekɛ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃?" Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nine kã ehe.
Ni etsɛ Zakaria yi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni egba ekɛɛ,
"Ajie Nuŋtsɔ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, akɛ ebasra emaŋ lɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ.
Ni etee walaheremɔ akloŋto shi ehã wɔ yɛ etsulɔ David we lɛ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ egbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ anɔ ewie lɛ;
akɛ eeehere wɔyiwala kɛaajɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni he tsɛɔ wɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
Ni ena wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ amɔbɔ ni ekai ekpãŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kitã ni ekã wɔtsɛ Abraham lɛ,
akɛ eeehã ajie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ ni wɔsɔmɔ lɛ ni gbeyeishemɔ ko bɛ mli
yɛ hetsemɔ kɛ jalɛ mli yɛ ehiɛ wɔgbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ni bo, gbekɛ nɛɛ, aaatsɛ o ŋwɛi Floflonyo lɛ gablɔ; ejaakɛ obaatsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ ni oyasaa egbɛi lɛ oto,
koni okɛ walaheremɔ he nilee ahã omaŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe eshaifaa
ni jɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ni hãa emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ mli. No hewɔ ni jetsɛremɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ebasra wɔ lɛ.
Koni ehã jeŋ atse ahã mɛi ni tra duŋ gbele hɔɔŋ mli lɛ, Ni akudɔ wɔnaji kɛya hejɔlɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ."
Ni gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni ehe wa yɛ mumɔ mli, ni ehi ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni akɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Israel.
2: Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ akpɔ ko jɛ Kaisare Augutso ŋɔɔ ba, akɛ akane jeŋ fɛɛ ni aŋma.
Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ kanemɔ ni akane be mli ni Kirenio yeɔ amralo yɛ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ tee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ koni aŋma amɛgbɛi.
Ni Yosef hu jɛ Nazaret maŋ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea, ni etee David maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea lɛ mli; ejaakɛ ejɛ David we kɛ eweku lɛ mli.
Etee koni aŋma ekɛ Maria, yoo ni etsɛ ehe baa ni hiɛ musu lɛ, gbɛi.
Be ni amɛyɔɔ Betlehem lɛ ebe shɛ ni ebaafɔ.
Ni efɔ binuu ni ji ekromɔbi lɛ, ni ekɛ mama bla ehe ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa gbɛ yɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ.
Tookwɛlɔi komɛi yɛ ŋa nɔ yɛ jɛi niiaŋ ni amɛmiishi kpe kɛmiibu amɛtoi ahe nyɔɔŋ.
Trukaa lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko badamɔ amɛmasɛi, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anumnyam kpɛ kɛbɔle amɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei; ejaakɛ naa, mibagba nyɛ miishɛɛ sane kpeteŋkple ni ji maŋ fɛɛ nɔ;
akɛ ŋmɛnɛ afɔ walaherelɔ ni ji Kristo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ahã nyɛ, yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.
Enɛ afee okadi ahã nyɛ, nyɛaana abifao ni akɛ mama ebla ehe ni ekã kooloi aniyeniianɔ mli."
Ni trukaa lɛ ŋwɛi ta kple bafata bɔfo lɛ he, ni amɛjie Nyɔŋmɔ yi amɛkɛɛ,
"Anumnyam ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo, ni hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ana gbɔmɛi ahe tsuijurɔ!"
Be ni bɔfoi lɛ eje amɛŋɔɔ amɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Betlehem koo, ni wɔyakwɛa nɔ ni eba ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɛɛ."
Ni amɛtee oya, ni amɛyana Maria kɛ Yosef kɛ abifao lɛ ni ekã kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli.
Be ni amɛna abifao lɛ amɛjaje sane ni agba amɛ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ he lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ fɔlɔi lɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ gba amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Maria kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ to etsuiŋ ni esusuɔ he.
Ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛjie eyi yɛ nibii fɛɛ kwa ni amɛnu ni amɛna lɛ hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni agba amɛ lɛ.
Ni be ni gbii kpaanyɔ shɛ ni abaafo gbekɛ lɛ ketia lɛ, awo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu, ni ji gbɛi ni bɔfo lɛ wo lɛ dani ana lɛ musu lɛ. Akɛ Yesu yaatsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ
Ni beni agbe amɛhetsuumɔ lɛ naa yɛ Mose Mla lɛ naa lɛ, amɛkɛ abifao lɛ tee Yerusalem, koni amɛkɛ lɛ ayatsɔ̃ɔ Nuŋtsɔ̃ɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ,
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, "Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni gbleɔ musu naa lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ nɔ ni afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;"
ni amɛyashã afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, "Kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shīa okpoi bibii enyɔ." lɛ.
Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ Yerusalem ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Simeon; nakai nuu lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni eekwɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ gbɛ. Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ enɔ,
ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ egboŋ ja ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ dã.
Ni MuMɔ lɛ naa lɛ Simeon ba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ. Ni be ni gbɛkɛ Yesu lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ kɛ lɛ ba koni amɛbafee bɔ ni Mla lɛ gbɛnaa yɔɔ amɛhã lɛ lɛ
Simeon he lɛ efɔ̃ ekpɔkɔiaŋ, ni ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi ekɛɛ,
"Agbɛnɛ ooohã otsulɔ aya, Nuŋtsɔ, yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa, yɛ hejɔlɛ mli;
ejaakɛ mihiŋmɛii ena owalaheremɔ lɛ,
nɔ ni osaa oma maji fɛɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
La ni aaaahã jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ agble, ni ewo omaŋ Israel hiɛ nyam lɛ."
Ni Yesu tsɛ kɛ enyɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ nii ni awie yɛ ehe lɛ ahewɔ.
Ni Simeon jɔɔ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ gbekɛ lɛ nyɛ, Maria, akɛ, "Naa, akɛ mɔnɛ edamɔ shi ehã mɛi pii ashigbeemɔ kɛ shitee yɛ Israel, Kɛ okadi ni awieɔ ashiɔ;
(ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu obaaye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ nɔ ni akɛ akplɔ egbu otsuiŋ) ni aaajie tsuii pii amli susumɔi akpo."
Ni gbalɔyoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hana yɛ, ni ji Fanuel biyoo, ni jɛ Asher akutso lɛ mli; egbɔ naakpa, ni ekɛ ewu ehi shi afii kpawo kɛjɛ eblayeiaŋ,
ni agbɛnɛ okulafo ji lɛ, ni eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ejwɛ ni ejeee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kwraa, ejaa Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ faikpamɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
Lɛ hu eba yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, ni ebajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; ni ewie yɛ gbekɛ Yesu lɛ he etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ Yerusalem kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ. Sɛɛkuu kɛ Nazaret yaa
Be ni amɛgbe nibii fɛɛ naa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Nazaret, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea.
Ni gbekɛ Yesu lɛ bada, ni ehe wa, ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nilee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ yɛ enɔ.
Daa afi lɛ efɔlɔi lɛ yaa Yerusalem amɛyayeɔ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ.
Be ni eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ, amɛtee Yerusalem, tamɔ bɔ ni gbijurɔ lɛ kusum yɔɔ lɛ.
Shi be ni aye gbijurɔ lɛ agbe naa ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, gbekɛ Yesu lɛ hi shi yɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yerusalem, ni efɔlɔi lɛ leee.
Amɛsusu akɛ efutu gbɛfalɔi krokomɛi lɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ gbi kome gbɛ amɛtao lɛ yɛ amɛwekumɛi kɛ mɛi ni amɛle ateŋ.
NI be ni amɛnaaa lɛ lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem ekoŋŋ ni amɛmiitao lɛ.
Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ amɛyana lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni eta shi yɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ eebo amɛ toi ni eebibii amɛ nii;
ni mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enilee kɛ hetoi ni ehãa lɛ ahewɔ.
Be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni enyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mibi, mɛɛba ofee wɔ nakai? Naa, mi kɛ otsɛ atao o kɛ tsuiyeli,"
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ mi? Ani nyɛleee akɛ esa akɛ mihiɔ shi yɛ nii ni ji mi-Tsɛ nɔ lɛ mli?"
Shi amɛnuuu wiemɔ ni ekɛ amɛ wie lɛ shishi.
Ni ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee Nazaret, ni eba ehe shi ehã amɛ. Enyɛ kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ to etsui mli.
Ni Yesu tee hiɛ yɛ nilee kɛ dalɛ kɛ dromɔ mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
3: Kaisare Tiberio maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ mli, be ni Pontio Pilato yeɔ amralo yɛ Yudea, ni Herode yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Galilea, ni enyɛmi Filipo yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Iturea kɛ Trakoniti shikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni Lisania yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Abilene,
ni Ana kɛ Kaifa yeɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ ba Zakaria bi Yohane ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ni ena Yordam niiaŋ fɛ, ni eshiɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ ni amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisiamɛ, koni akɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ;
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ mli akɛ, "Mɔ ko miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ. Ni nyɛjajea etempɔŋi lɛ trɔ̃mɔɔ.
Aaatsī jɔɔ fɛɛ jɔɔ, ni aaahã gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ, kɛ ŋmeŋme fɛɛ ŋmeŋme aba shi. Ni aaajaje gbɛi kɔ̃ɔdɔ̃ji. NI gbɛ ni yɔɔ sakasaka lɛ nɔ aaabo.
Ni heloo fɛɛ aaana Nyɔŋmɔ walaheremɔ lɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ asafoi lɛ ni je kpo ba eŋɔɔ ni ebaptisi amɛ lɛ akɛ, "Shikpãi ashwiei, namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛjo mlifu ni baa lɛ naa foi?
Belɛ nyɛwoa yibii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ; ni nyɛkabɔia kɛɛmɔ yɛ nyɛyiŋ akɛ, 'Wɔtsɛ ji Abraham;' ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ atee bii ashi kɛjɛ tɛi nɛɛ amli ehã Abraham.
Agbɛnɛ hu lema lɛ kã tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ anɔ momo; no hewɔ lɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ aaatoo ni aaashɛ afɔ̃ la mli."
Ni asafoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Belɛ mɛni wɔfee mɔ?"
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ni yɔɔ flakai enyɔ lɛ, ekɛ mɔ ni bɛ eko lɛ aja; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmaa hu, efee nakai nɔŋŋ."
Ni toohelɔi hu ba ni abaptisi amɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, mɛni wɔfee?"
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkahea mɔ ko too fe nine."
Ni asraafoi hu babi lɛ akɛ, "Ni wɔ hu mɛni wɔfee?" Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfea mɔ ko soisoi; nyɛkaflɔa mo ko naa yakatswaa; ni nyɛhãa nyɛnyɔmɔwo asaa nyɛhiɛ."
Shi be ni maŋ lɛ hiɛ kã nɔ, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ susuɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ yɛ Yohane he akɛ benɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ,
Yohane here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Mi lɛ nu mikɛbaptisiɔ nyɛ; shi mɔ ko ni he wa fe mi miiba, ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ etokotai anaa kpãa; lɛ ekɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ la aaabaptisi nyɛ.
Ehiɛ eshaatsene yɛ edɛŋ, ni eeebɛɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fitsofitso, ni eeebua ŋmaa lɛ naa ewo eboŋo lɛ mli; shi tutuu lɛ ekɛ la ni gbooo aaasha."
Ewie nibii krokomɛi pii hu ekɛwo maŋ lɛ ŋaa, ni ekɛshiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Shi Lumɔ Herode lɛ, akɛni Yohane kãa lɛ yɛ enyɛmi Filipo ŋa Herodia lɛ hewɔ, kɛ nifɔ̃ɔjianii fɛɛ ni lɛ Herode lɛ efee lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
esaa efee enɛ hu eshi nɔ, akɛ emɔ Yohane ewo tsuŋ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni abaptisi mɛi lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ abaptisi Yesu hu; ni be ni esɔleɔ lɛ ŋwɛi naa gble,
ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpleke shi kɛ su ni tamɔ okpo su kɛba enɔ; ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, "Boji mi-Suɔmɔ Bi lɛ, bo ohe tsui minaa!"
Be ni Yesu bɔ̃i enitsumɔ lɛ eye aaafee afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni tamɔ bɔ ni asusuɔ lɛ, eji Yosef bi, Heli bi,

4: Yesu ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Yordan he, ni Mumɔ lɛ kpla lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ;
ni abonsam ka lɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ. Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ eyeee nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni no sɛɛ lɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji o lɛ, fã tɛ nɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ aboloo."
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aŋma akɛ, 'Jeee abolooo kɛkɛ nɔ gbɔmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ni eyi naa wala.'"
ni abonsam ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ko nɔ. ni ekɛ je nɛɛŋ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa;
ni bonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ , "Bo mikɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛnumnyam lɛ baahã; ejaakɛ mi akɛha, ni mikɛhãa nmɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni misumɔɔ;
No hewɔ lɛ bo lɛ, kɛji oookula shi oja mi lɛ, fɛɛ kwa aaatsɔ̃ onɔ."
Yesu here nɔ a, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aŋma akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ oja, ni lɛ kɛkɛ osɔ̃mɔ!'"
Ni Abonsam kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem, ni akɛ lɛ yadamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yiteŋ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ bi o lɛ, jɛɛ biɛ okɛ ohe atswa shi;
ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, 'Eeefã ebɔfoi lɛ yɛ ohewɔ ni amɛbu ohe jogbaŋŋ,
ni amɛaahiɛ o yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni okɛ onane akashi tɛ ko.'"
Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aŋma akɛ, 'Kaaha Nuŋtsɔ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.'"
Ni be ni abonsam gbe kaa lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ, eshi lɛ dã.
Ni Yesu ku esɛɛ yɛ Mumɔ lɛ hewalɛ mli kɛba Galilea; ni ehe sane jije yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ wo ehiɛ nyam.
Ni Yesu ba Nazaret, he ni alɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, etee kpeehe lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ, ni ete shi koni ekane ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ni akɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ ha lɛ, ni be ni egble mli lɛ, ena he ni aŋma yɛ akɛ,
"Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ yɛ minɔ, ejaakɛ efɔ mi mu, koni mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi.
Etsu mi koni mishiɛ heyeli mitsɔ̃ɔ nomii lɛ, kɛ ninamɔ hã shwilafoi, koni mahã aŋmɛɛ mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ahe, ni amɛye amɛhe, ni mishiɛ afi ko ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ."
Ni ekota wolo lɛ ekɛhã sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ, ni eho eta shi, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ tsu amɛhiɛmɛii amɛshwie enɔ.
Ni ebɔ̃i amɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, "ŋmɛnɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ eba mli yɛ nyɛtoiaŋ."
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ye ehe odase, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ dromɔ wiemɔi ni jɛ enaa lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛkɛ, "Ani jeee Yosef bi lɛ nɛ? "
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛaabu mi nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ akɛ, 'Tsofãtsɛ, tsa bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe! Nii abɔ ni wɔnu akɛ ofee yɛ Kapernuam lɛ, feemɔ yɛ biɛ ni ji omaŋ lɛ mli hu."
Shi ekɛɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ahereee gbalɔ ko yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale akɛ okulafoi pii yɛ Israel yɛ Elia yinɔ, be mli ni aŋa ŋwɛi naa afii efɛ̃ kɛ nyɔji ekpaaa sɔŋŋ ni hɔ̃mɔ kple ba shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ;
shi atsuuu Elia kɛyaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ŋɔɔ, akɛ ja yoo okulafo ko ni yɔɔ Zarefat yɛ Sidon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni kpitiyelɔi pii hu yɛ Israel yɛ gbalɔ Elisha yinɔ, shi atsaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ja Naeman, Sirianyo lɛ kɛkɛ."
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ fɛɛ mli fu naakpa, be ni amɛnu nii nɛɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛte shi ni amɛtserɛ lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ni amɛmaŋ lɛ ma nɔ lɛ toi, koni amɛyatsi eyisɛɛ amɛwo jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Shi etsɔ̃ amɛteŋ kɛho, ni eyiŋ etee.
Ni Yesu tee Kapernuam, Galilea maŋ kpo mli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ anɔ.
Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ewiemɔ lɛ hewalɛ yɛ mli.
Ni nuu ko yɛ kpeehe lɛ ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɛ emli, ni ebo waa
ekɛɛ, "Ao! Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ o yɔɔ, bo Yesu Nazarenyo? Oba wɔhiɛ kpãtãmɔ? Mile mɔ ni ji o, boji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!"
Ni Yesu fã eyi ni ekɛɛ, "Maumɔ onaa ni oje emli!" Ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ tsi lɛ etswa shi yɛ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ ni eje emli, ni eyeee lɛ awui ko.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Mɛɛ wiemɔ nɛ? Ejaakɛ hegbɛ kɛ hewalɛ ekɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, ni amɛjeɔ kpo!"
Ni ehe sane jije yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Ni Yesu je kpeehe lɛ ni eyabote Simon we lɛ. Shi atridii ni wa emɔ Simon shayoo lɛ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai ni ebakwɛ lɛ.
Ni eyadamɔ emasɛi, ni efã atridii lɛ yi, ni etsɛ yɛ enɔ. Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi ni esɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Ni be ni hulu nyɔ shi lɛ. Mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mɛi ni helai srɔtoi hiɛ amɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ ekomekome ni atsa amɛ.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji hu je mɛi pii amli, ni amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Boji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ!" Ni Yesu famɔ amɛyi ni eŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛwie, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ.
Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko; ni asafoi lɛ tao lɛ ni amɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛtsi enaa, koni ekaje amɛŋɔɔ.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Esa akɛ miyajajeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ maji krokomɛi hu, ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ atsu mi."
Ni eshiɛ yɛ Galilea kpeehei lɛ.
5: Gbi ko be ni Yesu damɔ Genesaret Kpaakpo lɛ naa ni mɛi pii jwere enɔ amɛboɔ Nyɔmɔ wiemɔ lɛ toi lɛ,
ena lɛji enyɔ ŋmɔlɔ shi yɛ kpaakpo lɛ naa; wolɛi lɛ eje mli ni amɛmiifɔ amɛyai ahe.

Ni Yesu yabote lɛlɛ lɛ ekome ni ji Simon nɔ lɛ mli, ni ekpa lɛ fai akɛ etsi kɛya nu lɛ hiɛ fioo; ni Yesu ho eta shi, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ anii kɛjɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli. 4 Be ni egbe ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛɛ Simon akɛ, "nyɛwiria kɛyaa he ni kwɔ lɛ ni nyɛyafɔa nyɛyai lɛ, koni nyɛgbe loo."
Ni Simon here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Onukpa, wɔtsu nii waa nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ fɛɛ ni wɔnɔɔ nɔ ko; shi kɛ̃lɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ maŋmɛ yai lɛ."
Ni be ni amɛfee nakai lɛ, amɛgbe loo babaoo bɔ ni amɛyai lɛ bɔ̃i gbalamɔ.
Ni amɛfɔ̃ amɛnanemɛi ni yɔɔ lɛlɛ krokoko lɛ mli ni nine akɛ amɛba ni amɛba ni amɛbawa amɛ. Ni amɛba ni amɛwo lɛji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ loo ni amɛmiihe amɛshiu.
Shi be ni Simon Petro na lɛ, eho ekula Yesu naji anaa, ni ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, jeee mimasɛi; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ eshafeelɔ ji mi!"
Ni ekɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ fɛɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ loo pii ni amɛgbe lɛ hewɔ;
ni nakai nɔŋŋ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bii lɛ ni ji Simon hefatalɔi lɛ, hu ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe. Ni Yesu kɛɛ Simon akɛ, ":Kaashegbeyei!" Kɛkɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ obaahɛ gbɔmɛi."
Ni be ni amɛbakpleke lɛ amɛshi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Gbi ko lɛ Yesu yɛ maŋ lɛ eko mli, kɛkɛ lɛnaa nuu ko ni kpiti eshwie ehe jɛkɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi. Be ni ena Yesu lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji ooosumɔ lɛl, ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse,."
Ni Yesu kpa enine mli eta ehe ni ekɛɛ, "Miisumɔ, ohe atse!" Ni amrɔ lɛ kpiti lɛ tã yɛ ehe.
Ni etswa enaa ma akɛ, "Kaakɛɛ mɔ ko, sho moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe yaatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni oyashã afɔle yɛ ohetsemɔ lɛ hewɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mose to lɛ, koni no afee odase ahã amɛ."
Shi babaoo ni ahe sane lɛ gbɛ shwã moŋ ji no, ni mɛi pii babuaa amɛhe naa ni amɛbabo lɛ toi, ni etsa amɛhelai lɛ.
Shi egblaa ehi shi kɛyaa ŋa nɔ ni eyasɔleɔ.
Agbɛnɛ gbi lɛ eko be ni atsɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ, Farisfoi kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi ni jɛ Galilea kɛ Yudea maji lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalem ba lɛ tra jɛi; ni ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ ni akɛtsãamɔ lɛ kpo yɛ jɛi.
Mɛi krokomɛi kɛ nuu ko ni kã saa nɔ ni ekumɔ ba; ni amɛmiitao akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ aba shīa lɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ abaŋmɛ ehiɛ.
Ni be ni amɛnaaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkɛ lɛ aba ehiɛ yɛ esafo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛkwɔ kɛtee tsu lɛ yiteŋ, ni amɛshiu lɛ kɛ esaa lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ntayai lɛ amli kɛyaŋmɛ amɛteŋ yɛ Yesu hiɛ.
Be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ekɛɛ helatsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naanyo, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa o."
Ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisfoi lɛ bɔ̃i susumɔ akɛ, "Namɔ ji mɔnɛ ni wieɔ musubɔɔ wiemɔ nɛɛ? Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ eshai afa akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ koome pɛ."
Shi be ni Yesu yoo amɛmusumɔi lɛ, ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛsusumɔ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli lɛ?"
Te nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jraaa hu, 'Akɛ ohe eshai efa o ' aloo 'Tee shi ni onyiɛ lɛ?"
SHI be ni afee ni nyɛle akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ." ekɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mikɛɛ o akɛ tee shi ni owo osaa lɛ ni oya owe.!"
NI amrɔ lɛ nu lɛ te shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ewo nɔ ni akã nɔ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe, ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam woo.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, nia mɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa ni amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔna naakpɛɛnii ŋmɛnɛ!"
Nii nɛɛ sɛɛ Lɛ Yesu je kpo, ni ayana toohelɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Levi ni eta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyiɛmɔ miisɛɛ!"
Ni Levi shi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ, ni ete shi ebanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni Levi ŋmɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple yɛ ewe lɛ, ni toohelɔi kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii kɛ amɛ baye nii.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ amɛmlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ wie ekaselɔi lɛ ahe huhuuhu ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nyɛkɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii ni nyɛkɛ amɛ nuɔ nii nɛɛ?”

Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ lɛ ehiaaa amɛ tsofatsɛ, shi mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ moŋ ehia. 32 .Mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi moŋ miba eshafeelɔi atsɛmɔ koni amɛtsake amɛtsui.” 33 .Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yohane kaselɔi lɛ fɔɔ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ, ni Farisifoi lɛ akaselɔi lɛ hu feɔ nakai nɔŋŋ, ni bo lɛ okaselɔi lɛ yeɔ nii ni amɛnuɔ nii.” 34 .Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛaanyɛ nyɛhã yookpeemɔ he bialɔi lɛ ahi ŋmaa, be ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ? 35 .Shi gbii aaaba ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaajɛ amɛŋɔɔ, ni no mli dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.”
Ni ebu amɛ abɛ hu ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko gbaaa mama hee naa ekɛtaaa atade momo; kɛji efee nakai lɛ, eeegbala ehee lɛ, ni mamanaa hee lɛ kɛ atade momo lɛ yeŋ.
Ni mɔ ko kɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli, kɛ efee nakai lɛ, wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolo tɔi lɛ ni eeeshwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ hu aaafite.
Shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli akɛwoɔ.
Asaŋ mɔ ko enuuu wain momo ni amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni etao ehee, ejaakɛ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Emomo lɛ hi.’ ”
6: Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, Yesu yatsɔ̃ abele ŋmɔji amli; ni ekaselɔi lɛ kumɔ abele lɛ, ni amɛkposa, ni amɛkpe.
Shi Farisifoi lɛ ekomɛi bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nyɛfeɔ nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ?”
Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee, be ni hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ:
bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, ni eyakɔlɔ aboloi ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ ni eye eko ni ehã mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ eko, tsɛbelɛ aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ mɔ ko yeɔ akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?”
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ji hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ.” Nuu ni nine kome egbo lɛ
Shi hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ ekroko nɔ lɛ Yesu yiŋ etee kpeehe lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii. Ni nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni eninejurɔ egbo.
Shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ sara lɛ amɛkwɛ akɛ eeetsa hela yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lo, koni amɛna nɔ ko nɔ amɛdamɔ amɛkɛfolɔ enaa.
Shi Yesu le amɛsusumɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ nuu ni nine egbo lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi obadamɔ teŋ!” Ni ete shi ebadamɔ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibabi nyɛ nɔ ko: ani eja gbɛ akɛ afeɔ ekpakpa loo efɔ̃ŋ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, akɛ ahereɔ susuma yiwala aloo akpãtãa ehiɛ?”
Ni ekwɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpã onine lɛ mli!” Ni efee nakai ni enine lɛ ye emuu.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛmli fu waa, ni amɛhala mli yɛ amɛteŋ nɔ po ni amɛaafee Yesu. Kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ahalamɔ
Agbɛnɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, eyiŋ etee sɔlemɔ yɛ gɔŋ ko nɔ, ni eshi kpe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ eesɔle eetsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, etsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ehala amɛteŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, mɛi hu ni etsɛ amɛ bɔfoi lɛ.
Simon, mɔ ni ewo lɛ Petro hu lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea; Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo;
Mateo kɛ Toma; Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Simon, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ;
Yuda, Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ. Yesu shiɛ ni etsa helatsɛmɛi
Ni ekɛ amɛ kpeleke shi kɛbadamɔ he ko ni yɔɔ trɛnɛɛ, kɛ ekaselɔi asafo lɛ kɛ mɛi pii ni jɛ Yudea fɛɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli ni ba lɛ toiboo kɛ amɛhelai atsamɔ lɛ,
kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji haoɔ amɛ lɛ, ni etsa amɛ.
Ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ miitao ehe amɛta, ejaakɛ hewalɛ miije emli ni eetsa amɛ fɛɛ. Jɔɔmɔi kɛ loomɔi
Ni ehole ehiŋmɛi anɔ ekwɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ nyɛ ohiafoi lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛnɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
“Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃mɔ yeɔ nyɛ amrɔ nɛɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛaatɔrɔ. Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛfoɔ amrɔ nɛɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛaaŋmɔ.
“Ajɔɔ nyɛ, kɛji mɛi nyɛ nyɛ, ni amɛkɛ nyɛ tserɛ mli, ni amɛjɛ nyɛ ni amɛgbe nyɛgbɛi akɛ gbɛi fɔ̃ŋ yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
Nyɛnyaa yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ ni nyɛtumɔa, ejaakɛ naa, nyɛnyɔmɔwoo fa yɛ ŋwɛi; ejaakɛ nakai nɔŋŋ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee gbalɔi lɛ.
“Shi nyɛ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ, kpoo hã nyɛ! Ejaakɛ nyɛna nyɛmiishɛjemɔ momo.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtɔrɔ amrɔ nɛɛ! Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ aaaye nyɛ. “Kpoo hã nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛŋmɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ! Ejaakɛ nyɛaaye ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛaafofoi.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, kɛji mɛi fɛɛ aaawie nyɛhe ekpakpa lɛ! Ejaakɛ nakai nɔŋŋ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee amale gbalɔi lɛ.
“Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛboɔ toi nɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi; nyɛfea mɛi ni nyɛɔ nyɛ lɛ ejurɔ;
nyɛjɔa mɛi ni lomɔɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mɛi ni feɔ nyɛ niseniianii.
Mɔ ni aaagba otoi kome mli lɛ, tsɔ̃ ekome lɛ hu ohã lɛ, ni mɔ ni aaashɔ̃ ohebo lɛ, kaakãmã lɛ oflaka lɛ hu.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa bo nii lɛ, hã lɛ, ni mɔ ni aaashɔ̃ onii lɛ, kaabi lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni bɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mɛi afee ahã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛhãa amɛ. 32.Shi kɛji nyɛsumɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ? Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu sumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ amɛ.
Ni kɛji mɛi ni feɔ nyɛ ejurɔ nyɛfeɔ ejurɔ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ? Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu feɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛji nyɛfa mɛi ni nyɛhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ amɛaahã nyɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ? Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu faa eshafeelɔi koni amɛna nakai bɔ nɔŋŋ.
Moŋ nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni nyɛfea ejurɔ, ni nyɛfaa ni nyɛhiɛ kãaa nɔ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni nyɛnyɔmɔwoo aaafa, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ bii, shi lɛ lɛ emli hi hã trumui kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa mɔbɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛTsɛ lɛ hu naa mɔbɔ lɛ.”
“Nyɛkakojoa, koni Nyɔŋmɔ akakojo nyɛ; nyɛkabua fɔ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ akabu nyɛ fɔ; nyɛkɛfaa, ni akɛaafa nyɛ.
Nyɛhãa ni aaahã nyɛ; nii ni asusu jogbaŋŋ ni ahoso ni anyɛmɔ nɔ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛteke nɔ mɛi kɛaashãkã nyɛtsitsi, ejaakɛ nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaaku sɛɛ akɛsusu ahã nyɛ.”
Ni ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ, “Ani shwilafo aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ shwilafo gbɛ? Ani jeee bu mli amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaayagbee?
Kaselɔ efeee etsɔ̃ɔlɔ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni atsɔse lɛ kɛwula shi lɛ, eeetamɔ etsɔ̃ɔlɔ. 41.Shi mɛɛba onaa kuli ni kã onyɛmi hiŋmɛi nɔ lɛ, ni mplaŋ ni yɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ, oyooo lɛ?

Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, ‘Anyɛmi, hã majie kuli ni kã ohiŋmɛi nɔ lɛ,’ be ni onaaa mplaŋ ni yɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ? Osatofo, jiemɔ mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ tsutsu, ni no dani ooona nii faŋŋ ni ojie kuli lɛ yɛ onyɛmi lɛ hiŋmɛiŋ!”
“Ejaakɛ tso kpakpa ko bɛ ni woɔ yibii gbohii, ni asaŋ tso gbonyo ko hu bɛ ni woɔ yibii kpakpai.
Ejaakɛ tso fɛɛ tso diɛŋtsɛ yibii akɛleɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ atseee agbãmi yɛ ŋmeitsei anɔ, ni asaŋ atseee wain yibii yɛ aklatei anɔ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa jieɔ nɔ kpakpa kɛjɛɔ etsui mli jwetri kpakpa lɛ mli, ni gbɔmɔ fɔ̃ŋ jieɔ nɔ fɔ̃ŋ kɛjɛɔ etsui mli jwetri fɔ̃ŋ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ nɔ ni eyi tsui obɔ̃ lɛ, no naabu wieɔ.”
“Shi mɛni hewɔ nyɛtsɛɔ mi akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ!’ Ni nyɛfeee nii ni mikɛɔ lɛ?
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ ni enuɔ miwiemɔi lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ mɔ ni etamɔ:
etamɔ nuu ko ni be ni emaa tsu lɛ etsa shi kwɔŋkwɔŋ ni eto shishi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ; ni nu afua ba, ni eshimɔ nakai tsu lɛ, ni enyɛɛɛ lɛ ehoso, ejaakɛ ato shishi jogbaŋŋ.
Shi mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, etamɔ nuu ko ni ma tsu yɛ shikpɔŋ hiɛ ni etswaaa shishitoo jogbaŋŋ; ni faa ba ni eshimɔ tsu lɛ, ni amrɔ lɛ ewule, ni nakai tsu lɛ wulemɔ lɛ da.”
7: Agbɛnɛ be ni Yesu ewie wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ toiiaŋ lɛ, ebote Kapernaum.
Asraafoiohaiatsɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni etsulɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa he miiye ni eehe egbo.
Ni be ni enu Yesu he lɛ, etsu Yudafoi lɛ anukpai kɛba eŋɔɔ akɛ eekpa lɛ fai ni eba ni ebatsa etsulɔ lɛ.
Be ni amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai naakpa amɛkɛɛ, “Mɔ ni obaafee enɛ ohã lɛ, esa lɛ;
ejaakɛ esumɔɔ wɔmaŋ lɛ, ni kpeehe lɛ, lɛ ema ehã wɔ.”
Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ tee. Shi be ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaashɛ shĩa lɛ, asraafoiohaiatsɛ lɛ tsu eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaagba ohe naa; ejaakɛ esaaa mi akɛ oboteɔ mikoi lɛ shi;
no hewɔ hu ni mibuuu mihe akɛ misa mɔ ni baa oŋɔɔ lɛ; shi moŋ wiemɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, ni aaatsa mitsulɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi po ni mi ji gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nɔyeli shishi lɛ, miyɛ asraafoi yɛ mishishi, ni mikɛɔ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Yaa!’ Ni eyaa; kɛ mɔ kroko hu akɛ, ‘Ba!’ Ni ebaa; ni mikɛɔ mitsulɔ akɛ, ‘Feemɔ enɛ!’ Ni efeɔ.”
Be ni Yesu nu nii nɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ ehewɔ, ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ asafo ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Israel tete minako hemɔkɛyeli ni da tamɔ enɛ dã.”
Ni be ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba shĩa lɛ, amɛbana tsulɔ lɛ ni ehe ewa lɛ. Nain oblanyo lɛ shiteemɔ
Jetsɛre nɔ lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nain lɛ mli; ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kɛ asafo yuu kɛ lɛ nyiɛ.
Shi be ni eshɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa etã lɛ, naa, awo gbonyo ko kɛmiije kpo, ni enyɛ bi kome ji lɛ; ni okulafo ji yoo lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ mli bii pii kɛ lɛ nyiɛ.
Ni be ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ na lɛ lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafo!”
Ni eba ebata adeka lɛ he; ni mɛi ni tere lɛ lɛ wa damɔ shi. Ni ekɛɛ, “Oblanyo, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, Tee shi!”
Ni mɔ ni egbo lɛ te shi eta shi, ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ; ni ekɛ lɛ hã enyɛ.
Ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam amɛkɛɛ, “Gbalɔ kpeteŋkple ete shi yɛ wɔteŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebasara emaŋ lɛ.”
Ni ehe sane nɛɛ jije yɛ Yudea kɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ yagba lɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Ni etsɛ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni etsu amɛ Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛyabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?”
Be ni hii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ tsu wɔ oŋɔɔ. Ekɛɛ, ‘Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?’ ”
Shi nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu tsa mɛi pii ahelai kɛ amɛhejaramɔi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli, ni mɛi pii hu ni eshwila lɛ, ehã amɛna nii.

Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yohane nibii ni nyɛna ni nyɛnu lɛ, akɛ shwilafoi miina nii, obubuafoi miinyiɛ, kpitiyelɔi ahe miitse, toimulɔi miinu nii, gbohii miite shi, ni aajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ aatsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi.
Ni ajɔɔ mɔ ni mihe sane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ enane.”
Shi be ni Yohane bɔfoi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i asafoi lɛ kɛɛmɔ yɛ Yohane he akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛje kpo nyɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyakwɛ? Glã ni kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ lɛ?
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ? Naa, mɛi ni woɔ atade fɛɛfɛo ni amɛyeɔ nii kpakpai lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi awei amɛyɔɔ.
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbalɔ? Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ni fe gbalɔ tete.
Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ he ni aŋma yɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ ato bo lɛ.’
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɛi ni yei fɔ amɛ lɛ ateŋ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni fe Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni ji bibioo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ fe lɛ.”
Ni be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ toohelɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ bem akɛni akɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ baptisi amɛ lɛ.
Shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kpoo Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni eyɔɔ yɛ amɛhe lɛ, akɛni amɛhãaa ni Yohane abaptisi amɛ lɛ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Namɔ he mikɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaato mɔ, ni namɔ amɛtamɔ?
Amɛtamɔ gbekɛbii ni tara jara nɔ ni tsɛtsɛɔ amɛhe amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔkpã blɛ wɔha nyɛ, ni nyɛjooo; wɔwo yara wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛfooo!’
Ejaakɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ba ni eyeee aboloo ni enuuu wain, ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɛ emli.’
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba ni eyeɔ nii ni enuɔ nɔ ko, ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Naa nuu ŋmaayelɔ kɛ dãanulɔ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi ashieŋtsɛ!’
Ni abu nilee bem yɛ ebii lɛ fɛɛ anaa.” Yoo eshafeelɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu
Ni Farisifoi lɛ eko kpee Yesu ni ekɛ lɛ abaye nii, ni eyiŋ etee Farisifonyo lɛ we lɛ, ni eyata niyenii lɛ ahe.
Ni naa, be ni yoo ko ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli ni ji eshafeelɔ lɛ na ele akɛ Yesu miiye nii yɛ Farisifonyo lɛ we lɛ, ekɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ emli mukɛŋma ba;
ni ebadamɔ enajiaŋshi yɛ esɛɛgbɛ, ni efo ni ekɛ eyaafonu lɛ bɔ̃i enaji ahe fɔɔ ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ, ni eshwɔ enaji ahe, ni ekɛ mukɛŋma lɛ kpa he.
Shi be ni Farisifonyo ni kpee Yesu niyeli lɛ na lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ emli akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, gbalɔ ji lɛ jikulɛ, eeele nɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ nɔ yoo ni taa ehe nɛɛ akɛ eshafeelɔ ji lɛ.”
Ni Yesu wo enaa nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Simon, miyɛ sane ko ni mibakɛɛ bo.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛɛmɔ!”
“Niflilɔ ko yɛ ni yɔɔ nyɔjiatsɛmɛi enyɔ; mɔ kome hiɛ lɛ denarioi ohai enumɔ, ni mɔ kome hu hiɛ lɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi akɛni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛaawo nyɔmɔ lɛ, ekɛke amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, te amɛteŋ mɔ ni aaasumɔ lɛ fe enaanyoŋ?”
Ni Simon to he ekɛɛ, “Misusuɔ akɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ pii ke lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obu atɛŋ jogbaŋŋ.”
Ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã yoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ Simon akɛ, “Oona nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ? Ni mibabote owe lɛ nɛɛ, ohãaa mi nu ni mikɛfɔ minaji ahe, shi yoo nɛɛ kɛ yaafonu efɔ minaji ahe, ni ekɛ eyitsɔi etsumɔ.
Minaa hu oshwɔɔɔ; shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, kɛjɛ be mli ni miba nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, efɔ̃ko minaji ahe shwɔmɔ.
Mu hu okɛkpaaa miyiŋ; shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, ekɛ mukɛŋma ekpa minaji ahe.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ehe eshai ni fa lɛ, akɛfa lɛ, ni no hewɔ esuɔmɔ fa babaoo lɛ; shi mɔ ni akɛ fioo efa lɛ lɛ, esuɔmɔ fioo.”
Ni ekɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Akɛ ohe eshai efa bo!”
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii ashi lɛ bɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ nɛ ni kɛ eshai faa po nɛɛ?”
Shi ekɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehere oyiwala, yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli!”
8: Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yakpa maji kɛ akrowai amli eshiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi. Ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fata ehe,
kɛ yei komɛi hu ni efamɔ amɛmumɔi fɔ̃ji ni etsa amɛhelai lɛ: Maria, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Magdalena ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji kpawo je emli lɛ,
kɛ Yohana, Herode tsulɔnukpa Kusa ŋa lɛ, kɛ Susana, kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii ni kɛ amɛnii ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ eko sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Ni be ni asafo babaoo naa ebakpe shi ni mɛi jɛ majimaji anɔ kɛmiiba eŋɔɔ lɛ, ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ,
“Nidulɔ ko yiŋ etee ewui shwãmɔ. Eshwãmɔ mli lɛ, eko yashwie gbɛ toi, ni anaanaa nɔ, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji ba bakɔlɔ.
Eko yashwie tɛsaa nɔ ni be ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ, eŋãla, ejaakɛ enaaa ofɔ̃.
Eko yashwie ŋmei ateŋ, ni ŋmei lɛ kɛ lɛ kwɛ̃ ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Ni eko hu yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni ekwɛ̃, ni ewo yibii toi oha.” Be ni ewie nii nɛɛ lɛ, ebo ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!”
Shi ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Te abɛ nɛɛ shishiŋ?”

Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli teemɔ saji lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛle; shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ akɛhãa amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli; ‘koni na lɛ amɛna nɛ, shi amɛkayoo sɛɛ, ni nu hu amɛnu, shi amɛkanu shishi.’
“Agbɛnɛ abɛ lɛ shishi nɛ; wu lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
