Gbɛ toi bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ, shi abonsam baa ni ebashaa wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ, koni amɛkahe amɛye ni ahere amɛyiwala.
Tɛsaa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ ni amɛheɔ amɛyeɔ be kuku kɛkɛ, ni kaa be mli lɛ amɛkwaa amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Ŋmei ateŋ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ ni amɛyaa, ni je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔi kɛ ninamɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔyeli gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛmli; ni amɛwooo yibii ni hiɔ shi ni saa kɛgbeɔ naa.
Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni kɛji amɛnu wiemɔ lɛ amɛkɛtoɔ tsui ni hi ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ mli, ni amɛkɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ woɔ yibii.”
“Mɔ ko esuuu kane ni ekɛ nɔ ha nɔ aloo ni ekɛma saatso shishi; shi moŋ kanetso nɔ ekɛmaa, koni mɛi ni boteɔ shĩa lɛ mli ana la lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ko bɛ ni akɛtee ni ajieŋ lɛ kpo, ni asaŋ nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ ni aleŋ ni ejeŋ kpo faŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ bɔ ni nyɛnuɔ wiemɔ lɛ nyɛhãa he; ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahã lɛ; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaashɔ̃ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ akɛ eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ.”
Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, shi asafo lɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ eŋɔɔ amɛshɛ.
Ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛna bo.”
Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi ji mɛi ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ!”
Gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ eba mli akɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa kpaakpo lɛ sɛɛ gbɛ.” Ni amɛyiŋ.
Shi be ni amɛyaa lɛ, wɔŋɔ lɛ. Ni ahum batswa yɛ kpaakpo lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛlɛlɛ lɛ yi kɛ nu, ni amɛyɛ amanehulu mli.
Ni amɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbatsiɛ̃ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!” Ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ kɛ nu ni efee hamahama lɛ yi, ni amɛfee diŋŋ, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli yɔɔ?” Ni amɛshe gbeyei ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɔmɔ srɔto po nɛ ni efãa kɔɔyɔi kɛ nui tete yi ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?”
Ni amɛshɛ Gerasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Galilea ŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni ebakpeleke lɛ, nuu ko jɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ lɛ bakpe ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ ni ewooo atade ni ehiii shĩa akɛ ja gbohii abui amli kɛkɛ.
Ni be ni ena Yesu lɛ ebo waa ni ebagbee enaji anaa, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, Bi? Miikpa bo fai, kaapiŋ mi!” (Ekɛɛ enɛ),
ejaakɛ Yesu fã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ akɛ eje emli. Shi emɔɔ lɛ kpitiokpitioo; ni awoɔ lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi kɛ gboklɛi ni abuɔ ehe; shi etsereɔ nii ni akɛfimɔɔ lɛ lɛ amli, ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ lɛ kpalaa lɛ kɛyaa ŋa lɛ mli.
Ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Te ogbɛiŋ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Asafo”; ejaakɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji pii ebote emli lɛ.
Ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekafã amɛ ni ehã amɛyabote bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Shi kplotoi akuu kpele ko yɛ jɛi amɛmiiye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛkpa Yesu fai akɛ eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli. Ni eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ je nuu lɛ mli, ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli, ni kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ wo foi kɛkpeleke gɔŋ lɛ kɛyashwie kpaakpo lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi.
Ni be ni mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛ lɛ na nɔ ni eba lɛ amɛjo foi ni amɛyagba yɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ akrowai lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛje kpo amɛtee nɔ ni eba lɛ kwɛmɔ, ni amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛbana nuu lɛ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ eje emli lɛ. Eta Yesu najianaa ni ewo atade ni ehiɛ etserɛ lɛ. Ni amɛshe gbeyei.

Shi mɛi ni na lɛ hu gba amɛ bɔ ni fee ni atsa mɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli lɛ. 37.Kɛkɛ ni Gerasebii lɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi niiaŋ lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bakpa lɛ fai akɛ eje amɛŋɔɔ eya; ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ naakpa. Ni eyabote lɛlɛ lɛ mli kɛku esɛɛ.
Shi nuu lɛ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ eje emli lɛ kpa lɛ fai ni ekɛ lɛ ahi shi. Shi Yesu jie lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ,
“Kuu osɛɛ oya owe, ni oyagba nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee eha bo lɛ.” Ni eyiŋ etee, ni eyajaje nii abɔ ni Yesu efee ehã lɛ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Be ni Yesu ku esɛɛ eba kpaakpo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, asafo lɛ nya ehe; ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiimɛ lɛ.
Ni naa, nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yairo ni ji kpeehe lɛ onukpa lɛ ba, ni ebagbee Yesu najianaa ni ekpa lɛ fai, koni eba ewe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ biyoo kome pɛ ni eye aaafee afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni eehe egbo. Shi be ni Yesu yaa lɛ, asafoi lɛ mia lɛ.
Ni yoo ko yɛ amɛteŋ ni eye láfɔsemɔ hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; efite enii fɛɛ ekɛwo tsofatsɛmɛi anyɔmɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ atsa.
Ebaje Yesu sɛɛ gbɛ, ni ebata etade naamuu lɛ he, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ elá ni hoɔ lɛ lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ ni ta mihe lɛ?” Shi be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ tso lɛ, Petro kɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, asafoi lɛ ebɔle ohe ni amɛmiimia bo, ni okɛɔ akɛ, Namɔ ta mihe lɛ?”
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Mɔ ko eta mihe, ejaakɛ minu he akɛ, hewalɛ ko eje mimli.”
Shi be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ ehiii lɛ eheteemɔ lɛ eba kɛ hekpokpomɔ ni eho egbee Yesu najianaa ni ejaje nɔ hewɔ ni eta ehe lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ehe wa lɛ amrɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Biyoo, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo; yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.”
Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, mɔ ko jɛ kpeehe onukpa lɛ we lɛ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obiyoo lɛ egbo; kaagba tsɔɔlɔ lɛ naa dɔŋŋ.”
Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ehere nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yairo akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei; hemɔ oye kɛkɛ, ni eyi aaana wala!”
Ni be ni eba shĩa lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni ekɛ lɛ aya jɛi akɛ ja Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo kɛ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛkɛ.
Ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miifo ni amɛmiiye gbekɛ lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ. Shi ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkafoa; egboko, shi wɔ ewɔ.”
Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ egbo.
Shi Yesu mɔ enine shi, ni ebo akɛ, “Gbekɛyoo, tee shi!”
Ni emumɔ ku esɛɛ ba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ete shi amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni Yesu fã akɛ ahã lɛ nɔ ko eye.
Ni efɔlɔi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe; shi etswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkagba mɔ ko nɔ ni afee lɛ.
9: Agbɛnɛ Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛkpe, ni ehã amɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ anɔ ni amɛtsa helai hu.
Ni etsu amɛNyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shiɛmɔ kɛ helatsɛmɛi atsamɔ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkaŋɔa nɔ ko nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛ̃ŋ yɛ nyɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli, nyɛkahiɛa tso loo kotoku loo aboloo loo shika loo atadei enyɔ.
Ni shĩa fɛɛ shĩa ni nyɛaabote mli lɛ, nyɛhia jɛi kɛyashi nyɛaaje jɛi.
He fɛɛ he ni mɛi lɛ hereee nyɛ yɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnajiashi mlu lɛ nyɛkɛyea odase nyɛshia amɛ.”
Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyakpa maji lɛ anɔ amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni amɛtsa mɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Lumɔ Herode nu nii ni afee lɛ fɛɛ he, ni efee yeyeeye, ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ Yohane ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ;
mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ Elia ejie ehe kpo; mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ blema gbalɔi lɛ eko ete shi ekoŋŋ.
Ni Herode kɛɛ, “Yohane lɛ mifo eyi; shi namɔ ji mɔ ni minunuɔ nɛkɛ saji yɛ ehe nɛɛ?” Ni eetao Yesu ena.
Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ, amɛbagba Yesu nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ. Ni ekɛ amɛ tee ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee yɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Betsaida lɛ masɛi.
Be ni asafoi lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛtiu lɛ, ni ehere amɛ atuu ni ejaje Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni etsa mɛi ni tsamɔ he ehia amɛ lɛ.
Be ni je bɔ̃i namɔ lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wo asafo lɛ gbɛ koni amɛya akrowai kɛ ŋmɔji ni kamɔ wɔhewɔ lɛ amli, ni amɛyato jɛmɛi ni amɛna niyenii; ejaakɛ ŋa nɔ wɔyɔɔ nɛɛ.”
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nɔ ko amɛyea.” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔbɛ nɔ ko fe aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ pɛ, ni belɛ ja wɔtee wɔyahe niyenii wɔbahã asafo nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛyi aaafee hii akpei enumɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa amɛtaraa shi kuikui aaafee nyɔŋmai enumɔ enumɔ.”
Amɛfee nakai, ni amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ tara shi.
Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛkɛmamɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ.
Amɛye, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛtɔrɔ, ni akɔlɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ awo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Gbi ko be ni Yesu kome sɔleɔ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ eŋɔɔ; ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mɛi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ mi ji?”
Ni amɛto he akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia; ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, blema gbalɔi lɛ eko ete shi ekoŋŋ.”
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Ni Petro to he ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Kristo lɛ.”
Shi etswa amɛnaa ma ni ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ amɛkatsi tã amɛkɛɛ mɔ ko.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ na amanehulu babaoo, ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kwa lɛ, ni agbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.”
Ni ekɛɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe, ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ daa gbi ni enyiɛ misɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa kɛji ena jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, shi eshɛ ehe efɔ̃ aloo ekpãtã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ lɛ?

Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi kɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ahe feɔ lɛ hiɛgbele lɛ, lɛ hu ehe aaafee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛgbele, be ni eeeba yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam lɛ kɛ eTsɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anɔ lɛ mli lɛ. 27.Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”
Wiemɔi nɛɛ asɛɛ aaafee gbii kpaanyɔ lɛ Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo, ni ekɛ amɛ tee gɔŋ ko nɔ ni eyasɔle.
Be ni esɔleɔ lɛ, ehiɛ su tsake ni etade lɛ yɛ futaa ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ. 30Ni naa, hii enyɔ kɛ lɛ bawie, amɛ ji Mose kɛ Elia,
ni amɛbajie amɛhe kpo yɛ anunyam mli ni amɛwie ejeŋ naa ni ebaaya eyagbe yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ he.
Shi wɔ ni tsii eŋɔ Petro kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ; ni be ni wɔ lɛ tserɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ kwraa lɛ, amɛna Yesu anunyam lɛ kɛ hii enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ.
Ni be ni hii lɛ kɛ lɛ gbalaa mli lɛ, Petro kɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ehi akɛ wɔhiɔ biɛ, ni hã ni wɔfee bui etɛ̃, onɔ ekome kɛ Mose nɔ ekome kɛ Elia nɔ ekome;” shi eleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ.
Be ni ewieɔ enɛ lɛ atatu ba bakete amɛnɔ; ni ekaselɔi lɛ she gbeyei be ni amɛbote atatu lɛ mli lɛ.
Ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji mi-Bi ni mihala lɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi!”
Ni be ni gbee lɛ gbɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kome too ana. Ni amɛfee dioo, ni nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ amɛgbaaa mɔ ko nii ni amɛna lɛ eko.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni amɛjeɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛkpelekeɔ shi lɛ, mɛi pii kɛ lɛ bakpe.
Ni nuu ko jɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ bo ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, miikpa bo fai, kwɛmɔ mibi lɛ, shi mibi kome ji lɛ.
Mumɔ ko mɔɔ lɛ, ni ekpakpa ko dani ejeɔ emli.
Mikpa okaselɔi lɛ fai koni amɛfã lɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ.”
Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ao yinɔbii ni heee yeee ni bɛ amɛŋɛlɛnɔ! Mɛɛ beyinɔ mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi, ni mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi? Kɛ obi lɛ aba biɛ!”

Be ni ebaa ni eshɛko eŋɔɔ lɛ, mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ too lɛ etswa shi ni ehã eshɔ̃, shi Yesu fã mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ lɛ yi, ni etsa gbekɛ lɛ, ni eŋɔ lɛ ehã etsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ. 43.Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ. Shi be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ efee amɛ yaa yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yesu fee lɛ he lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ,
“Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhãa nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ayaa nyɛtoiiaŋ; ejaakɛ aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ.”
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛnaaa wiemɔ nɛɛ shishi, ni akɛtee amɛ ni amɛkayoo sɛɛ, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei akɛ amɛaabi lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ he nɔ ko.
Shi ŋwanejee ko bate shi yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Be ni Yesu na amɛtsuiiaŋ susumɔi lɛ, ekɛ gbekɛ fioo ko badamɔ emasɛi;
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛ fioo nɛɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni ji bibioo yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, lɛ ji agbo fe fɛɛ.”
Ni Yohane here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔna mɔ ko kɛ ogbɛi miifa mumɔi fɔ̃ji, ni wɔtsi lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ ebɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔnyiɛ osɛɛ lɛ ateŋ.”
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkatsia lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo nyɛ lɛ, eyɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ.”
Be ni gbii ni abaaŋɔ Yesu lɛ kɛya ŋwɛi lɛ eshɛ etã lɛ, eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ eeya Yerusalɛm.
Ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ; ni amɛtee amɛyabote Samariabii amaŋ ko mli, koni amɛsaa he ko amɛto lɛ.
Shi amɛhereee lɛ, ejaakɛ eeya Yerusalɛm.
Ni be ni Yakobo kɛ Yohane, ekaselɔi lɛ, na enɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, oosumɔ akɛ wɔkɛɛ ni la ajɛ ŋwɛi aba abashã amɛ?”
Shi etsɔ̃ ehe ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ [ni ekɛɛ, “Ani nyɛleee nɔ mumɔ ni nyɛhiɛ lɛ lo?
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaa gbɔmɛi asusumai ahiɛkpãtãmɔ, shi moŋ amɛyiwalaheremɔ eba.”] Ni amɛtee maŋ kroko mli.
Be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ mɔ ko bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛaatee he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.”
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔi yɛ bui, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji hu yɛ tsui; shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ bɛ he ni ekɛ eyitso ŋmɛɔ.”
Ni ekɛɛ mɔ kroko akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Shi lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ; ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya mayafu mitsɛ dã.”
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni gbohii afu amɛgbohii, shi bo lɛ yaa ni oyashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ!”
Ni mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ, “Manyiɛ osɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ; shi ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya mayashɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ miwe lɛ dã.”
Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni kɛ enine yamɔɔ tsina kɔi mli ni ekuɔ ekuɛ ekwɛɔ esɛɛ lɛ, esaaa Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”
10: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nikpamɔ lɛ fa, shi nitsulɔi lɛ faaa; no hewɔ lɛ nyɛkpaa nukpamɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai, koni etsu nitsulɔi kɛba enikpamɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛyaa! Naa, Miitsu nyɛ tamɔ toobii yɛ klãji ateŋ.
Nyɛkahiɛa fotro loo kotoku loo tokotai ni nyɛkaŋnaa mɔ ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni shīa fɛɛ shia ni nyɛaabote lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Hejɔlɛ aba shīa nɛɛ!"
Ni kɛji hejɔlɛ bi ko yɛ jɛi lɛ, nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ aaahi enɔ; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, eeeku esɛɛ eba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ni nyɛhīa nakai shīa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ; ni nyɛye ni nyɛnu nii ni amɛaahã nyɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nitsulɔ lɛ enyɔmɔwo sa lɛ. Nyɛkajɛa shīa kɛyaa shīa.
Ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli ni nyɛaabote ni amɛhere nyɛ lɛ, nyɛyea nɔ ni akɛaama nyɛhiɛ lɛ;
ni nyɛtsaa hetatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, ni nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ.'

Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli ni nyɛaabote ni amɛhereee nyɛ lɛ, nyɛajea jɛi nyɛyaa eblihui lɛ amli, ni nyɛkɛa kɛ, 11.'Nyɛmaŋ nɛɛŋ mlu tete ni yɔɔ wɔnaji ahe lɛ wɔkplaa wɔshwieɔ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ.,'
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaafaŋ Sodom fe nakai maŋ lɛ!'
"Kpoo hã o, Zorazin, Kpoo hã o, Betsaida! Ejaakɛ Hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Tiro kɛ Sidon atsu yɛ jikulɛ amɛtra kpekpe kɛ lamlu mli amɛtsake amɛtsui jeeŋmɔ.
Shi kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaafaŋ Tiro kɛ Sidon fe nyɛ!
Ni bo Kapernuam, ani aaawo onɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi? Gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ aaaba o shi kɛaatee!
"Mɔ ni boɔ nyɛ toi lɛ, mi toi eboɔ lɛ, ni mɔ ni kwaa nyɛ lɛ, mi ekwaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni kwaa mi lɛ, mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ekwaa lɛ."
Ni mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba kɛ miishɛɛ ni amɛbakɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji tete baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ"
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mina Satan jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shi taɔ srawa.
Naa, mihã nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛaanaa onufui kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakoi kɛ henyɛloi kɛ henyelɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ nyɛ efɔ̃ŋ ko.
Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkanaa enɛ he miishɛɛ, akɛ mumɔi lɛ baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa nyɛ lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛnaa miishɛɛ akɛ aŋma nyɛgbɛi yɛ ŋwɛi."

Nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ Yesu mli lɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ, "Miijie oyi, Ataa; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ oŋɔ nii nɛɛ otee nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, ni ojie otsɔ̃ɔ abifabii; hɛ̃ɛ, Ataa, ejaakɛ nakai sa ohiɛ.
"Mi-Tsɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo midɛŋ, ni mɔ ko leee mɔ ni ji Bi lɛ, ja Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ni ji Tsɛ lɛ hu, ja Bi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni Bi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni Bi lɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ejie lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ."
Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ehã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ akɛ, "Ajɔɔ hiŋmɛii ni naa nibii ni nyɛnaa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ gbalɔi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi pii tao akɛ amɛna nii ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, ni amɛyanaa, ni asaŋ amɛnu nii ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ, ni amɛyanuuu."
Ni naa, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ ko te shi damɔ shi, ni eka lɛ ekɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, mɛni mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?" Yesu bi lɛ akɛ,
"Mɛni aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ? Te okaneɔ tɛŋŋ?"
Ni eto he ekɛɛ, "Suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kɛjɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ osusuma fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ mli, kɛ onaanyo hu tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe."
Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni oto he lɛ ja; feemɔ nakai, ni oyi aaana wala."
Shi lɛ lɛ, akɛni eetao ehe bem ebu hewɔ lɛ, ebi Yesu akɛ, "Ni namɔ ji minaanyo?"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Nuu ko yiŋ kɛjɛ Yerusalem kɛmiiya Yeriko ni eyagbee ojotswalɔi ateŋ, ni amɛkplɔ ehe atadei ni amɛtswia lɛ nii, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛshi lɛ ni egbo fã kɛ fa.
Shi eba mli akɛ osɔfo ko batsɔ̃ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ; shi be ni ena lɛ lɛ, egba afã kɛho.
Ni nakai nɔŋŋ Levinyo ko hu gba afã kɛho, be ni eshɛ jɛi ni ena lɛ lɛ.
Shi Samarianyo ko ni nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ bashɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe,
ni etee eŋɔɔ ni eyafɔse mu kɛ wain eshwie epilamɔi lɛ anɔ ni efimɔ nɔ, ni esaa ewo lɛ eta lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekooloo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ tee gbɔiatoohe ni eyakwɛ lɛ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni eyaa lɛ, eje danarioi enyɔ ehã gbɔiatoohetsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Kwɛmɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ni ooosaa ofite lɛ, kɛ miku misɛɛ miba lɛ mawo o nyɔmɔ.'
Agbɛnɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ateŋ namɔ osusuɔ akɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni gbee ojotswalɔi ateŋ lɛ naanyo?"
Ni ekɛɛ, "Mɔ ni na lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ ni." Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo hu yaa ni oyafee nakai nɔŋŋ."
Be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa lɛ eyabote akrowa ko mli. Ni yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marta lɛ kpee lɛ kɛtee ewe.
Eyɛ nyɛmiyoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Maria; enyɛmiyoo nɛɛ bata Yesu najianaa ni ebo ewiemɔ toi.
Shi Marta gba ehe naa tuutu yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ pii he ni eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ni minyɛmi lɛ eshi mi ni mi kome misɔ̃mɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee ohe sane ko ni lo? No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ lɛ ni ebafata mihe."
Shi Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Marta, Marta! Oogba ohe naa, ni oohao ohe yɛ nibii pii ahe;
nɔ kome ehia. Nɔ ni hi lɛ no Maria ekɔ lɛ, ni no lɛ ashɔŋ yɛ edɛŋ."
11: Gbi ko lɛ Yesu miisɔle yɛ he ko; ni be ni egbe naa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ sɔlemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yohane hu tsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ."
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Wɔtsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ogbɛi lɛ he atse; omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aba. Afee nɔ ni osumɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu; tamɔ bɔ ni afeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Hã wɔ wɔdaa ŋmaa daa gbi,
ni okɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ afa wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔ hu wɔkɛfaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ. Ni okɛ wɔ akaya kaa mli.'"
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni yɔɔ shieŋtsɛ ni eeetee eŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋteŋ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Shieŋtsɛ, faa mi aboloi etɛ̃,
ejaakɛ mishieŋtsɛ ko ejɛ gbɛ ebato mi, ni mibɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛbaama ehiɛ';
ni mɔ ni yɔɔ tsuŋ lɛ hereŋ nɔ akɛ, 'Kaagba minaa; aŋa shinaa lɛ momo ni mi kɛ mibii kamɔ saa nɔ, minyɛŋ shi mate ni mahã o.'
Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ ka eshieŋtsɛ ni ji lɛ hewɔŋ kulɛ eteŋ shi ni ehã lɛ, shi enaagbamɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ eeetee shi kɛ̃ ni eeehã lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni etaoɔ.
Ni mi hu miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛbia, ni aaahã nyɛ; nyɛtaoa ni nyɛaana; nyɛshia, ni aaagble nyɛ.'
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ lɛ, enine shɛɔ nɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ lɛ enaa; ni mɔ ni shiɔ lɛ aaagble lɛ.
Shi mɛɛ tsɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ? Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ loo lɛ, ni eeeŋɔ onufu ehã lɛ yɛ loo najiaŋ.
Aloo kɛji ebi wuɔ wɔlɔ lɛ, eeehã lɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrako?
Belɛ kɛji nyɛ ni nyɛji mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ nyɛle bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ ni nyɛkɛ nikeenii kpakpai keɔ nyɛbii lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ eŋɔŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ehaŋ mɛi ni biɔ lɛ lɛ?"
Be ko lɛ Yesu miifã mumɔ fɔŋ ko ni ji mumui; ni eba mli akɛ, be ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ je kpo lɛ, mumui lɛ wie, ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, "Beelzebul, mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji alumɔ lɛ, hewalɛ naa efãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ."
Ni mɛi komɛi hu la lɛ amɛmiitao ŋwɛi okadi ko yɛ edɛŋ.
Shi akɛni ele amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ ejwaa, ni tsu kumɔɔ shwieɔ tsu nɔ.
Ni kɛji Satan hu gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ edamɔ shiŋ, akɛni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ Beelzebul hewalɛ mikɛfãa mumɔ fɔ̃ɔji lɛ?
Shi kɛji mi lɛ, Beelzebul hewalɛ mikɛfãa mumɔ fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, namɔ nyɛbii lɛ kɛfãa amɛ? No hewɔ lɛ amɛ amɛaakojo nyɛ.
Shi kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ wao mikɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
Kɛ hewalɛ emia egbaja ni eebu emɔ̃ɔ he lɛ, enibii yɛ shweshweeshwe;
shi kɛji mɔ ni he wa fe lɛ batua lɛ ni eye enɔ kunim lɛ, eshɔ̃ɔ etawuunii ni eŋɔɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ ni ejaa enomŋɔɔnii lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ ekɛ mi ena, ni mɔ ni kɛ mi buaaa naa lɛ eegbɛ eeshwã."
"Kɛ mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ je gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, eyanyiɛɔ hei ni nu bɛ etaoɔ hejɔɔmɔ, ni kɛ enaaa eko lɛ, ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Maku misɛɛ matee miwe he ni mijɛ lɛ.'
Ni kɛ eba lɛ, ebaana akɛ abɛɛ mli ni awula mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaa ni eyaŋɔɔ mumɔi krokomɛi kpawo ni ji mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji fe lɛ efataa ehe, ni amɛyaboteɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛhiɔ jɛi, ni nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛkpee shihilɛ tsɔ̃ɔ efɔŋ fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ."
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu wieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, yoo ko ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ wo egbee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ajɔɔ musu ni hiɛ o kɛ fufɔ ni oye lɛ!"
Shi ehere nɔ akɛ, "Ajɔɔ mɛi ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ moŋ!"
Shi be ni asafoi lɛ ebabua amɛhe naa pii lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ akɛ, "Yinɔbii nɛɛ yinɔbii fɔ̃ɔji ni; amɛmiitao okadi, ni ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yona tsɔ̃ okadi hã Ninevebii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ ahã nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ.

Wuoyigbɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni eeebu amɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ ejɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe ni ebabo Solomon nilee toi, ni naa nɔ ko ni fe Solomon nilee toi, ni naa nɔ ko ni fe Solomon nilee yɛ biɛ.
Ninevehii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli ni amɛaabu amɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ na; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ."
"Mɔ ko esuuu kane emaaa kpokplobiiaŋ loo tsese shishi, shi moŋ kanetso nɔ ekɛmaa, koni mɛi ni baa shīa lɛŋ ana ekpɛmɔ lɛ.
Ogbɔmɔtso lɛ kane ji ohiŋmɛi lɛ. Kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tse lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ hu mli tseɔ; shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi ehiii lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso lɛ hu woɔ duŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ kwɛ ni ahi koni la ni yɔɔ omli lɛ akatsɔ̃ duŋ.
Kɛji ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ mli tse ni he ko he ko woko duŋ lɛ, tse nɔŋŋ emuu lɛ fɛɛ mli aaatse tamɔ bɔ ni kane kɛ ekpɛmɔ tsoɔ hãa o lɛ."
Ni be ni Yesu wieɔ lɛ, Farisfonyo ko bakpee lɛ akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abaye nii; ni etee shīa lɛŋ, ni eyata niyenii lɛ ahe.
Shi be ni Farisfonyo lɛ na akɛ efɔflɔko ehe dani ebaaye nii lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa.
NI Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ Farisfoi lɛ nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ, shi nyɛmli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ juu kɛ fɔ̃.
Kwashiai! Ani mɔ ni fee sɛɛ lɛ, jeee lɛ nɔŋŋ efee mli lɛ hu?
Moŋ nyɛŋɔa nibii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ nyɛfea ejurɔ, ni nibii fɛɛ he aaatsɛ ahã nyɛ.

Shi kpoo hã nyɛ, Farisfoi, akɛ nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ shwie kɛ bai srɔtoi fɛɛ mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, ni nyɛshiɔ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni akɛsuɔmɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ! Kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛfeɔ enɛɛmɛi hu nyɛkɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ.
Kpoo hã nyɛ, Farisfoi, akɛ nyɛsumɔɔ onukpai ashitramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ ŋamɔi yɛ jaji anɔ!
Kpoo hã nyɛ, akɛ nyɛtamɔ saŋi ni ejeee shi, ni mɛi ni nyiɛɔ nɔ lɛ leee!"
Ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, kɛ oowie enɛɛmɛi lɛ okɛmiibɔ wɔ hu ahora."
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, "Nyɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu, kpoo hã nyɛ! Akɛ nyɛkɛ jatsui ni tremɔ jraa treɔ mɛi, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛwao kome tete etaaa he.
Kpoo hã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfeɔ saŋi nyɛmamɔɔ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ, gbalɔi ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ gbe lɛ;
belɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛmiitsɛi lɛ anitsumɔi lɛ ahe odase ni eŋɔɔ nyɛnaa; ejaakɛ amɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi nyɛ nyɛfeɔ saŋi nyɛmamɔɔ amɛnɔ.
Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ kɛɛ, 'MIbatsu gbalɔi kɛ bɔfoi kɛya amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛaagbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni amɛaawa mɛi komɛ ayi,'
koni gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ alá ni afɔse ashwie shi kɛjɛ jeŋ shishitoo mli lɛ abi shi yɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ;
kɛjɛ Habel lá lɛ nɔ kɛyahsi Zakaria, mɔ ni agbe lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ te lɛ mli lɛ, lá lɛ nɔ. Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, aaabi shi yɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ!
Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi, ejaakɛ nyɛkɔ nilee naa samfee! Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nyɛboteee mli, ni mɛini taoɔ mli abote lɛ hu, nyɛtsi amɛ gbɛ."
Ni be ni eje kpo kɛjɛ shīa lɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ farisfoi lɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka lɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i enaa saji bɛlɛmɔ babaoo,
kɛmiitsɔ̃ lɛ koni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ.
12: No mli nɔŋŋ, be ni mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ ebabua amɛhe naa ni mɛi naanaa mɛi anɔ lɛ, ebɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛl, Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi lɛ amãsha ni ji osatofeemɔ lɛ he.
Shi nɔ ko bɛ ni atsimɔ nɔ ni ajieŋ lɛ kpo, aloo ni akɛtee ni aleŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛwie yɛ duŋ mli lɛ, aaanu yɛ la hiɛ; ni nɔ ni nyɛwie ablɛbi yɛ piai amli lɛ, aaashiɛ yɛ tsui ayiteaŋ."
"Nyɛ, mishieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛkashea mɛi ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛaanyɛ amɛfee dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Shi matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ mɔ ni gbeyei ni nyɛshe: Nyɛshea mɔ ni kɛ egbe sɛɛ ni eyɔɔ hegbe akɛ eshɛɔ efɔ̃ɔ abonsamiiaje lɛ. Hɛ̃ɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, lɛ gbeyei nyɛshea.
Ani jeee pesewai enyɔ ahɔ̃ɔ aflimatai enumɔ aheɔ? Shi Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kpaaa amɛteŋ ekomeflo nɔ.
SHi nyɛyiteŋ tsɔi tete akane fɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛjra wa fe aflimatai babaoo.'"
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbaa m,i tsiɔ mitã yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu aaagba mli atsi etã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ;
shi mɔ ni kwaa mi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, aaakwa lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie wiemɔ ko ashi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ, shi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, mɔ ni aaawie musubɔɔ wiemɔ ashi lɛ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ.
Shi kɛ amɛkpla nyɛ kɛtee kpeehei lɛ kɛ lumɛi kɛ ogai ahiɛ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa yɛ bɔ ni nyɛaajie nyɛnaa nyɛhã aloo nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ he,
ejaakɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛ, yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛkɛɛ."
Ni mɔ ko jɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛɛ kɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, kɛɛmɔ minyɛmi lɛ ni ekɛ mi aja gboshinii lɛ."
Shi ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naanyo, namɔ womi kojolɔ loo nijalɔ yɛ nyɛnɔ?"
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ hiɛjoomɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ he; ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ nii ni ena ni eteke nɔ lɛ mli ewala yɔɔ."
Ni ebu amɛ abɛ akɛm "Nuu niiatsɛ ko shikpɔŋ ba nii babaoo.
Ni esusu he ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, 'Te mafee tɛŋŋ, akɛni mibɛ he ni mikɛ minibanii lɛ baato nɛɛ?'
Ni ekɛɛ, 'Nɔ ni mafee nɛ; mibakumɔ miboŋoi lɛ mashwie shi, ni mamamɔ ewuji ni mato minibaanii kɛ minii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi;
ni makɛɛ mususuma akɛ, susuma, oyɛ nii kpakpai babaoo ni akɛto ahã o afii pii; jɔɔmɔ Farisifoi lɛ kɛ amɛmlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ wie ekaselɔi lɛ ahe huhuuhu ni amɛkɛɛ, :"Mɛni hewɔ nyɛkɛ amɛ nuɔ nii nɛɛ?"
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwashia, nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ abaabi osusuma shi yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; ni nibii ni osaa oto lɛ, namɔ nɔ eeetsɔ̃?’
Nakai mɔ ni bɔɔ jwetri ehãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, shi ejeee niiatsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ yɔɔ.”
Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ Nyɛkahaoa yɛ nyɛwala he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaaye hewɔ, aloo yɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawo hewɔ;
ejaakɛ susuma lɛ fe ŋmaa, ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ hu fe atade.
Nyɛjwɛŋa kwãakwãalabitei lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ amɛduuu nii, asaŋ amɛkpaaa nii, ni amɛbɛ nitoohe loo aboŋo po, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛɔ amɛ; nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni nyɛjara wa aahu fe loofɔji!
Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ aaanyɛ atsa ekɛlɛ naa ninetalɔ kome? 26.Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ nɔ ni ji bibioo fe fɛɛ nyɛfee lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛgbaa nyɛhe naa yɛ nii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahe mɔ?
Nyɛjwɛŋa fɔfɔii lɛ ahe, amɛtsɛ̃ɛɛ kpãa; asaŋ amɛlooo mama; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Solomon kɛ enunyam lɛ fɛɛ tete ewulaaa tamɔ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ ekome.
Agbɛnɛ kɛji jwɛi ni ŋmɛnɛ lɛ eyɛ ŋa nɔ ni wɔ ni akɛwo flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wulaa nɛkɛ lɛ, ani ewulaŋ nyɛ aahu fe amɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa?
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkadia nɔ ni nyɛaaye aloo nɔ ni nyɛaanu sɛɛ, ni asaŋ nyɛkafea yeyeeye;
ejaakɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ diɔ; shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ le akɛ nii nɛɛ ahe miihia nyɛ.
Moŋ nyɛtaoa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, ni aaaŋɔ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ afata he ahã nyɛ.
“Kaashe gbeyei, kuu bibioo; ejaakɛ nyɛTsɛ lɛ yɛ he tsuijurɔ akɛ eeeŋɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ehã nyɛ.
Nyɛhɔ̃a nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ ni nyɛkɛfea ejurɔ; nyɛfea fotroi ni tsɔ̃mɔɔɔ ememeji nyɛhãa nyɛhe, nyɛtoa jwetri ni etãaa yɛ ŋwɛi, he ni julɔ ko bɛŋkɛɛɛ ni omlɛgɛ kpeee nii yɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ he ni nyɛjwetri lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi nyɛtsui hu aaahi.” 35.“Nyɛfea klalo, ni nyɛhãa nyɛkanei lɛ atsoa;
ni nyɛfea tamɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛnuŋtsɔ gbɛ, be mli ni eeejɛ yookpeemɔ lɛ eeba, koni, kɛ eba ni ebashi lɛ, ni amɛgbele lɛ oya.
Ajɔɔ nakai tsuji lɛ ni be ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba lɛ eeebanina amɛ akɛ amɛmiishi kpe lɛ! Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ eeemĩa, ni eeehã amɛtara niyenii ahe, ni eeeba ebasɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Ni kɛji eba yɛ buube ni ji enyɔ aloo nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli ni ebanina amɛ nakai lɛ, ajɔɔ nakai tsuji lɛ!
Shi nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ akɛ, kɛji shĩatsɛ le nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni julɔ lɛ baa lɛ, kulɛ eeebu ni eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni agbu eshĩa lɛ awoŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛhiɛ kãaa nɔ lɛ nɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaba.”
Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ kɛkɛ obuɔ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ, aloo mɛi lɛ fɛɛ?”
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Shi namɔ mɔ ji tsulɔnukpa anɔkwafo kɛ nilelɔ, ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaawo lɛ onukpa yɛ ewebii anɔ, koni ehã amɛ amɛniyenii yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ?
Ajɔɔ nakai tsulɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ ba ni eeebanina lɛ akɛ eefee nakai lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ eeewo lɛ onukpa yɛ enibii fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi kɛji nakai tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Minuŋtsɔ lɛ miihã ebaabe lɛ miigbala shi’ ni eeebɔ̃i wehii kɛ weyei lɛ yii kɛ niyeli kɛ numɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ lɛ,
nakai tsulɔ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba yɛ gbi nɔ ni ekwɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni eleee, ni eeefo emli enyɔ ni eeehã lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ.
“Shi nakai tsulɔ lɛ ni le enuŋtsɔ suɔmɔnaanii ni esaaa ehe etooo ni esaa efeee esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ aaayi lɛ kpãi pii;
shi mɔ ni leee ni eyafee yiinii lɛ, aaayi lɛ fioo. Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋɔ pii ahã lɛ, pii aaatao yɛ edɛŋ; ni mɔ ni atu pii awo edɛŋ lɛ, aaabi nɔ ni teke nɔ shi yɛ edɛŋ.”
“Lawoo miba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mina ni kulɛ ehere momo! 50 Shi miyɛ baptisimɔ ko ni akɛbaabaptisi mi, ni kwɛ bɔ ni mihe hiaa mi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe naa!
“Ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ hejɔlɛ hãmɔ miba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ? Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, dabida, shi mligbalamɔ moŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ benɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ mɛi enumɔ aaagba yɛ shĩa kome, mɛi etɛ̃ aaate shi awo mɛi enyɔ, ni mɛi enyɔ hu aaate shi awo mɛi etɛ̃.
Mligbalamɔ aaaba tsɛ kɛ ebinuu, kɛ binuu hu kɛ etsɛ teŋ; nyɛ kɛ biyoo kɛ biyoo hu kɛ nyɛ teŋ; shaayoo kɛ shaayoo, ebi ŋa lɛ, teŋ, kɛ lɛ hu kɛ eshaayoo, ewu nyɛ lɛ, teŋ.”
Ni ekɛɛ asafoi lɛ hu akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛna akɛ atatu miiwo yɛ anai lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ baanɛ;’ ni ebaa mli nakai;
ni kɛ wuoyi kɔɔyɔɔ miitswa lɛ, nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Latsaa baaba;’ ni ebaa mli nakai.
Osatofoi, nyɛle atatuiaŋ kɛ shikpɔŋ nibii ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ; shi te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛleee yinɔ nɛɛ shishitsɔɔmɔŋ?
“Ni mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkojooo nɔ ni ja gbɛ nyɛhãaa nyɛhe lɛ?
Shi kɛ okɛ obelɔ miiya lumɔ hiɛ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni okɛ lɛ asaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, koni ekashãtã bo eyahã kojolɔ lɛ, ni kojolɔ lɛ hu ŋɔ bo ehã apãbɔlɔ lɛ hu, ni apãbɔlɔ lɛ wo bo tsuŋ.
Miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ojeŋ jɛi gbi ko gbi ko ja owo onaagbee pesewa lɛ dã.”
13: Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ jɛi ni gba lɛ Galileabii ni Pilato kɛ amɛlá futu amɛfɔlei lɛ amli lɛ ahe sane.
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛ susuɔ akɛ nɛkɛ Galileabii nɛɛ eshafeelɔ ji amɛ fe Galileabii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, hewɔ ni amɛna nɛkɛ amanehulu nɛɛ?
Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ebɛ mli nakai. shi moŋ kɛ nyɛtsakeee nyɛtsui lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã nakai nɔŋŋ.
Aloo nyɛsusuɔ akɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ ni Siloam mɔ̃ɔ lɛ ku shwie amɛnɔ ni egbe amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛji nɔtɔ̃lɔi fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalem?
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ebɛ mli nakai, shi moŋ, kɛ nyɛtsakeee nyɛtsui lɛ , nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni ebu amɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ko tɛo agbãmitso yɛ ewaintrom mli ni eba enɔ yibii taomɔ lɛ, enaaa eko.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ tromsaalɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Naa, afii etɛ̃ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ mibaa mibataoɔ yibii yɛ agbamitso nɛɛ nɔ, shi minaaa eko. Toomɔ ofɔ̃ shi! Mɛɛba hu ni egbeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ?

Shi tromsaalɔ lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ ha ni ehi shi afi nɛɛ hu, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni matsa hewɔ kɛkpe ni mawo eshishi tumu, 9 akɛ aleeemɔ eeewo yibii afi nɛɛ lo; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, dani otoo lɛ ofɔ̃ shi'"
Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehei lɛ eko.
Yoo ko yɛ jɛi ni mumɔ ni hãa mɔ gbɔjɔɔ ehu emli afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni edɔ kɔmɔɔ, ni enyɛɛɛ emli ekpã kwraa po.
Be ni Yesu na lɛ lɛ, etsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yoo, afɛne o kɛjɛ ohela lɛ mli!"
Ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ yoo lɛ jaje trɔmɔɔ, ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Shi kpeehe onukpa lɛ lɛ mli owo lɛ akɛni Yesu tsamɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbik lɛ nɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ atsuɔ nii yɛ mli no hewɔ lɛ nyɛbaa yɛ nomɛi l amli, koni atsa nyɛ, shi jeee hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Osatofoi, Ani hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ fɛneee etsina looo eteji yɛ niyenii anɔ he ekplaaaa lɛ eyahãaa lɛ nu lo?
Shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ ji Abraham biyoo ni Satan efi lɛ nɛkɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ani ejaaa akɛ afɛneɔ lɛ yɛ nɛkɛ kpãa nɛɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lo?
Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ehenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ gboi, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ ma miishɛɛ yɛ anumnyam nibii ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
"Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ, "Mɛni Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ, ni mɛni he mikɛaato?
Etamɔ sinapi wu kuli ni nuu ko kɔ ni eyadu yɛ etrom mli , ni ekwɛ̃, ni efee tso kpele, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji ba bafee tsui jyɛ eniji ateŋ."
Ni ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ., "Mɛni he mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaato?"
Etamɔ masha ni yoo kɔ kɔ ni ekɛhɔ ma tsesei etɛ̃ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni fɛɛ sha."
Ni eyakpa maji kɛ akrowai amli etsɔ̃ɔ nii, ni etsɛ mli kɛmiiya Yerusalem.
Ni mɔ ko bi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ani mɛi fioo kɛkɛ yiwala abaahere?" Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ
"Nyɛplea agbo fiŋtɔ̃ɔ lɛ mlibotemɔ he, ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɛi pii aaatao mli abote shi amɛnyɛŋ.
Be mli ni nyɛaabɔ̃i sɛɛdaamɔ kɛ shinaa lɛ shimɔ, ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, gblemɔ wɔ!' lɛ, eeeherɛ nɔ ekɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Mileee he ni nyɛjɛ.'
No lɛ nyɛbaabɔi kɛɛmɔ akɛ, 'Wɔyɛ nii ni wɔnu nii yɛ ohiɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ wɔblohui amli.'
Ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, 'Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mileee he ni nyɛjɛ; nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtsuɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ!'
Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔjiashishikpemɔ aaahi, be ni nyɛaana Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eshwie nyɛ kɛje kpo lɛ.
Ni mɛi aaajɛ boka kɛ anai kɛ kooyi kɛ wuoyigbɛ aaaba ni amɛaabatra okplɔ̃ he yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ni naa,sɛɛkpeebii yɛ ni baatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii, ni klɛŋklɛŋbii hu yɛ ni batsɔ̃m( sɛɛkpeebii."
Nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛmli nɔŋŋ lɛ Farisfoi Lɛ ekomɛi ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Jee biɛ nɛɛ ni oya, ejaakɛ Herode miitao o agbe."
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa nakai osɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Naa, miifãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji ni miitsa mɛi ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ magbe naa.'
Shi kɛ̃lɛ ja minyiɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ kɛ wɔsɛɛ, ejaakɛ ebaŋ mli akɛ aaagbe gbalɔ ko yɛ he ko akɛ ja Yerusalem.
Yerusalem, Yerusalem, bo mɔ ni ogbeɔ gbalɔi lɛ ni otswiaa mɛi ni atsuɔ amɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ atɛi, shii enyiɛ mitao akɛ mibuaa obii anaa, tamɔ bɔ ni wuɔ buaa ebii anaa ewoɔ efiji ashishi lɛ, ni nyɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ!
Naa, ashi nyɛwe lɛ amaŋfɔ ahã nyɛ. Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyenɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli' lɛ."
14: Be ni Yesu tee niyeli yɛ Farisfoi lɛ anukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome we yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛwɔɔ lɛ.
Nuu ko yɛ ehiɛ ni eeye fuumɔhela.
Ni Yesu bi mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisfoi lɛ akɛ, "Ani eja gbɛ akɛ atsaa mɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ aloo ejaaa gbɛ? "
Shi amɛhãaa lɛ hetoo. Kɛkɛ ni emɔ helatsɛ lɛ mli ni etsa lɛ, ni ejie lɛ gbɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛji eteji loo etsina yagbee nubu mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eyajieŋ lɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ?"
Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ enɛɛmɛi ahetoo amɛhã.
Ni be ni eyoo bɔ ni amɛhalaa onukpai atramɔei lɛ, ebu mɛi ni akpee lɛ abɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
:"Kɛ mɔ ko bakpee o kɛtee yookpeemɔ okplɔ̃ he lɛm kaayata yitso gbɛ, ekolɛ aleee nɔ ekpee mɔ ko ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam fe o,
ni mɔ ni bakpee o kɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ akaba ni ebakɛɛ o akɛ, 'Hã mɔnɛ gbɛ!' No lɛ okɛ hiɛgble aaayata shishi gbɛ.
SHi moŋ, kɛji akpeee o lɛ, yaa ni oyata shishi gbɛ, koni kɛ mɔ ni bakpee o lɛ ba lɛ, ebakɛɛ o akɛ, 'Shieŋtsɛ, ba yitso gbɛ.' No lɛ ohiɛ aaaba nyam yɛ mɛi ni okɛtra shi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ, aaaba lɛ shi, ni mɔ ni ba ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ."
Shi ekɛɛ mɔ ni kpee lɛ lɛ hu akɛ, "Kɛ oŋmɛ shwane loo gbɛkɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kaattsɛ oshieŋtsɛmɛi loo onyɛmimɛi loo owekumɛi loo okutsoŋ niiatsɛmɛi ni eleeenɔ amɛ hu amɛkpee o eko amɛto najiaŋ.
Shi kɛ oŋmɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kpeemɔ ohiafoi kɛ kpajelɔi kɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛ shwilafoi moŋ,
ni aaajɔɔ o, akɛni amɛ lɛ amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛaato o najiaŋ lɛ; ejaakɛ aaato o najiaŋ yɛ jalɔi ashitee lɛ mli."
Ni be ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tra niyenii ashi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nu nii nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ aboloo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!"
Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuu ko ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple, ni ekpee mɛi pii;
ni be ni shɛ niyeli be lɛ, etsu etsulɔ akɛ eyakɛɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛbua, ejaakɛ agbe nibii lɛ fɛɛ naa.'
Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bɔ̃i enaa jiemɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ 'Mihe shikpɔŋ ko ni ehia akɛ maya ni mayakwɛ; miikpa o fai ni ona ohã mi."
"Ni mɔ kroko kɛɛ, 'Mihe tsina ntai enumɔ, ni miiya mayaka amɛ makwɛ; miikpa o fai ni ona ohã mi.'
Ni mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ, 'Mikpee yoo, ni no hewɔ lɛ minyɛŋ maba.'

Ni tsulɔ lɛ ba ni ebagba enuŋtsɔ lɛ nii nɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni shīatsɛ lɛ mli fu, ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Jee kpo mramra kɛya maŋ lɛ mli blihui lɛ kɛ fɔji lɛ amli, ni oyakpee ohiafoi kɛ kpajelɔi kɛ shwilafoi kɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛba biɛ!'
Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, afee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ gbɛ yɛ lolo.'
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ 'Jee kpo oya gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kɛ afãbai lɛ ahe ni oyanyɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛba, koni miwe lɛ ayi tɔ.
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko sa niyenii lɛ anaa fii!"
Be ni ko be mɛi pii kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ , etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Kɛji mɔ ko miiba miŋɔɔ ni enyɛɛɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii kɛ enyɛmimɛi yei kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma hu tete lɛ, enyɛŋ etsɔ̃ mikaselɔ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni treee esɛŋmɔtso kɛnyiɛɛɛ misɛɛ lɛ, enyɛŋ mikaselɔ etsɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eetao mɔ̃ɔ ema lɛ, etaŋ shi ni ebu naa ekwɛ dã akɛ eyɛ nii bɔ ni ekɛaagbe naa lo?
Koni ekaba akɛ be ni eje shishi ni eyanyɛɛɛ naa egbe lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ babɔ̃i ehefɛoyeli akɛ,
'Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ bɔ̃i mɔ̃ɔ maa, shi enyɛɛɛ naa egbe.'
Aloo mɛɛ maŋtsɛ ni kɛji ekɛ maŋtsɛ kroko yaawu lɛ etaŋ shi ni esusu he dã akɛ eeenyɛ ekɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ ni kɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ ba eŋɔɔ lɛ ayakpe lo?
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, be ni mɔ kome lɛ nyiɛ shɔŋŋ kɛbaa lɛ, eeetsu bɔfoi kɛya eŋɔɔ eyakpa kpãtãmɔ he fai.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaaa nibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ enyɛŋ mikaselɔ etsɔ̃."
"ŋoo hi; shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni akɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ?
Esaaa shikpɔŋ loo tumu nɔ tete; tsi atsiɔ ashwieɔ. Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!"
15: Agbɛnɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i tsimɔ kɛ lɛ bɛŋkɛmɔ ni amɛbabo lɛ toi.
Shi Farisfoi kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛkɛɛ, "Nuu nɛɛ hereɔ eshafeelɔi atuu ni ekɛ amɛ yeɔ nii."
Ni ebu amɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ ekɛɛ, 4 "Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eyɛ toi oha ni amɛteŋ ekome laaje lɛ, eshiŋ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni eyatao nɔ ni elaaje lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeena lɛ?
Ni kɛ ena lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ lɛ etswaa ekɔ̃ŋ, ni enaa miishɛɛ;
ni kɛ eba shīa lɛ, etsɛɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ ekuŋ bii kɛkpeɔ, ni ekɛɔ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛkɛ mi anaa miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ mina mitoo ni laaje lɛ.'
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nakai nɔŋŋ miishɛɛ aaaba ŋwɛi yɛ eshafeelɔ kome ni tsakeɔ etsui lɛ hewɔ fe jalɔi nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu ni tsuitsakemɔ he ehiaaa amɛ lɛ."
"Aloo mɛɛ yoo ni yɔɔ jwɛitɛi kukuji nyɔŋma, ni kɛji kuku kome laaje lɛ, ni esuŋ kane ni ebɛɛ shīa lɛ mli fitsofitso ni etao kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeena?
Ni kɛ ena lɛ, etsɛɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ ekuŋbii kɛkpɛɔ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛkɛ mi anaa miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ mina mijwɛitɛi kuku ni laaje lɛ.'
Nakai nɔŋŋ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ naa miishɛɛ yɛ eshafeelɔ kome ni tsakeɔ etsui lɛ hewɔ."
Yesu saa ekɛɛ, "Nuu ko yɛ bihii enyɔ.
Ni amɛteŋ gbekɛ̃ lɛ kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, 'Ataa, hã mi onii lɛ amli nɔ ni ji migbɛfaŋmɔ.' Ni eja nii lɛ amli ehã amɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ yeee gbi ko kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ̃ lɛ bua fɛɛ naa, ni edom etee maŋtsɛ shɔŋŋ he ko, ni jɛi ekɛ nyenyeŋtswibɔɔ yaakpãtã enii lɛ ahiɛ yɛ.
Shi be ni efite fɛɛ lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ni naa wa ko bate shi yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni ebɔ̃i lɛ fimɔ.
Ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ ehe yakpɛtɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ eko he; ni ehã etee ebɔi lɛ amli ni eyalɛ kplokoi.
Ni eba etsine akɛ kulɛ ena yɔɔ ni kplotoi lɛ yeɔ lɛ eko eye ni eyɔ, shi mɔ ko hãaa lɛ.
Shi be ni ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, 'Apaafoi enyiɛ mitsɛ bɛ ni naa niyenii yeɔ ni eko shwɛɔ, ni hɔ̃mɔ gbeɔ mi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ!
Mate shi matee mitsɛ ŋɔɔ ni mayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ataa, mifee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha ni mifee esha mishi o,
ni misaaa mɔ ni atsɛɔ mi obi dɔŋŋ; ŋɔɔ mi ofee tamɔ opaafoi lɛ eko."
Ni ete shi ni eyiŋ eba etsɛ ŋɔɔ. Shi be ni enyiɛ shɔŋŋ kɛbaa lɛ, etsɛ na lɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ, ni esha foi ni eyafua lɛ atuu, ni eshwɔshwɔɔ enaa.
Ni ebi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ataa, mifee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha ni mifee esha, mishi o, ni misaaa mɔ ni atsɛɔ mi obi dɔŋŋ!'
Shi tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛyajiea atade ni yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛbaa mramra, ni nyɛkɛbawoa lɛ, ni nyɛwo enine kpotia kɛ enaji hu tokotai;
ni nyɛkɛ tsinabi ni ewo fɔ lɛ abaa nyɛbagbea, ni nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnaa tsuijurɔ;
ejaakɛ mibi nɛɛ gbo, ni ehiɛ etsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ; elaaje, ni ana lɛ.' Ni amɛbɔ̃i nyamɔ.
"Shi ebi nukpa lɛ yɛ ŋmɔshi. Ni be ni ebaa ni ebabɛŋkɛ shīa lɛ, enu saŋkui kɛ joi ahe,
ni etsɛ tsuji lɛ eko kɛba, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, 'Mɛni afeɔ?' nɛɛ
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Onyɛmi lɛ eba, ni otsɛ egbe tsina bi ni ewo fɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eshɛ edɛŋ kpitiŋŋ.'
Ni bi nukpa lɛ mli fu, ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ shīa lɛ yaa. No hewɔ lɛ etsɛ je kpo ni ebakpa lɛ fai.
Shi eherenɔ ni ekɛɛ etsɛ lɛ akɛ 'Kwɛ afii abɔ sɔŋŋ ni misɔ̃mɔ o, ni mitɔ̃ko okitã ko nɔ dã, ni mi lɛ, ohãko mi too abotiabi po dã, koni mi kɛ mishieŋtsɛmɛi ana tsuijurɔ;
shi ŋmɛnɛ ni nɛkɛ obi nɛɛ ni kɛ ajwamaŋi eyaye onii lɛ ba lɛ, ogbe tsina bi ni ewo fɔ lɛ ohã lɛ.'
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Mibi, bo lɛ, okɛ mi yɔɔ daa nɛɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ onɔŋ;
shi esa akɛ wɔnya ni wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe, ejaakɛ onyɛmi nɛɛ gbo, ni ehiɛ etsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ, ni elaaje, ni ana lɛ.'"
16: Yesu saa kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Niiatsɛko ni yɔɔ, ni eyɛ tsulɔnukpa, ni abaflɔ enaa ahã lɛ akɛ eekpãtã enii ahiɛ.
Ni etsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Mɛni minuɔ yɛ ohe nɛɛ? Baabu onukpayeli lɛ he akɔŋtaa ejaakɛ onyɛŋ onukpa lɛ oye dɔŋŋ.'
Ni tsulɔnukpa lɛ kɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, 'Akɛni minuŋtsɔ shɔ̃ɔ onukpayeli lɛ yɛ midɛŋ nɛɛ, te mafee tɛŋŋ? Minyɛŋ shi matsa, ni sisɛ̃mɔ hu miifee mi hiɛgble.
Mile nɔ ni mafee ni kɛ akpa mi onukpayeli lɛ ni mɛi ahere mi yɛ amɛshīaiaŋ.'
Ni etsɛ enuŋtsɔ nyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba ekomekome, ni ebi klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ enyiɛ ohiɛ minuŋtsɔ lɛ?'
Ni ekɛɛ, 'Mu tɔi oha.' Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Hemɔ owolo lɛ ni ota shi mramra ni oŋma nyɔŋmai enumɔ.'
No sɛɛ lɛ ebi mɔ kroko hu akɛ, 'Shi bo hu enyiɛ hiɛ?' Ni ekɛɛ, 'ŋmaa flɔtɔi oha.' Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Hemɔ owolo lɛ ni oŋma nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.'
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie tsulɔnukpa kutumpɔfo lɛ yi akɛ eye sane lɛ ŋaa mli. Ejaakɛ je nɛɛŋ bii lɛ kɛ amɛyinɔbii lɛ yeɔ yɛ ŋaa mli fe la bii lɛ.
"Ni mi hu miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛŋɔa kutumpɔo ninamɔ lɛ nyɛkɛfea shieŋtsɛmɛi nyɛhãa nyɛhe, koni, be ni nyɛbɛ nɔ ko dɔŋŋ lɛ, amɛhere nyɛ yɛ naanɔ buui lɛ amli.
Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ ko bibioo anɔkwa lɛ, eyeɔ babaoo hu mli anɔkwa; ni mɔ ni yeee nɔ ko bibioo mli anɔkwa lɛ, eyeee babaoo hu mli anɔkwa.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyeko kutumpɔo ninamɔ lɛ po mli anɔkwa lɛ, nɔ ni ji anɔkwa ninamɔ lɛ, namɔ aaatu no awo nyɛdɛŋ?
Ni kɛ nyɛyeko mɔ kroko nɔ mli anɔkwa lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, namɔ kɛaahã nyɛ?
Wenuu ko nyɛŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi enyɔ asɔ̃mɔ.; ejaakɛ no lɛ eeenyɛ mɔ kome ni eeesumɔ mɔ kome lɛ, aloo eeekpɛtɛ mɔ kome he, ni eeegbe mɔ ome lɛ he guɔ., Nyɛnyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ninamɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔ."
Farisfoi lɛ h ni ji shika suɔmɔi lɛ nu nii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛye lɛ ahi.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛji mɛi ni nyɛbuɔ nyɛhe bem yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ;l shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ele nyɛtsuiaŋ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni ji gojoo yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ nihiinii ni.
"Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yɔɔ nɔ kɛbashi Yihane nɔ; kɛjɛ naakai be lɛ nɔ nɛɛ aasshiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hw Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ boteɔ mli ekãa naa.
Shi ejraaa akɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ aaaho aya fe nɔ ni mli lɛ mli kuli kome aaaje mli.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mɔ ni ewu eshwie lɛ lɛ, Lɛ hu efite gblã."
"Nuu niiatsɛ ko ni yɔɔ, ni ewoɔ atade tsuru kɛ atade yeŋ fɛɛfɛo, ni ekɛ ŋɔɔmɔnii kpakpai ayeli naa tsuijurɔ daa gbi.
Ni ohiafo ko hu yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lazaro ni akɛ lɛ ebaŋmɛ egbo lɛ naa kɛ ehe faji obɔ̃,
ni ebaa etsine akɛ eŋa ŋmaa fufuji ni jɛɔ niiatsɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ shwieɔ shi lɛ eye; shi gbei tete baa balemɔ̃ɔ afaji lɛ anɔ.
Ni ohiafo lɛ bagbo, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi bawo lɛ kɛtee Abraham mnlishi; ni niiatsɛ lɛ hu bagbo ni afu lɛ.
Ni be ni eyɔɔ hejramɔi amli yɛ gbohiiaje ni eyaawo ehiɛ n0 lɛ, ena Abraham yɛ shɔŋŋ, kɛ Lazaro ni hɔ emlishi.
Ni ebo ekɛɛ, "Ataa Abraham, naa mi mɔbɔ ni otsu Lazaro ni ekɛ ewao naa ayɛtsɔ nu mli ni ekabajɔɔ mililɛi he, ejaakɛ miina nɔ yɛ lililɛi nɛɛ amli!
Shi Abraham kɛɛ, 'Mibi, kaimɔ akɛ bo lɛ oye ejurɔ yɛ owalabe mli, shi Lazaro na nɔ; shi agbɛnɛ aaashɛje emii yɛ biɛ, ni bo lɛ aapiŋ o.
Ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ hu lɛ, jɔɔ kpeteŋkple ko kã wɔ kɛ nyɛ teŋ, koni mɛi ni taoɔ ajɛ biɛ aya nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ akanyɛ, ni mɛi hu ni taoɔ ajɛ afoŋ kɛba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ akanyɛ.'
Shi niiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, 'Belɛ miikpa o fai mɔ, ataa, ni otsu lɛ mitsɛ we lɛ;
ejaakɛ miyɛ nyɛmimɛi enumɔ, bɔ ni afee ni eyaye odase kɛmɔ amɛ kɔkɔ koni amɛ hu amɛkaba piŋmɔhe nɛɛ.'
Ni Abraham kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Amɛyɛ Mose kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛbo amɛ toi!'
Shi lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, 'Dabi, Ataa Abraham, shi kɛji mɔ ko jɛ gbohii ateŋ tee amɛŋɔɔ lɛ, no amɛaatsake amɛtsui.'
Shi Abraham kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛ amɛbooo Mose kɛ gbalɔi lɛ atoi lɛ, no lɛ kɛji mɔ ko te shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ tete lɛ, amɛyiŋ tsɔ̃ɛ'"
17: Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Be fɛɛ be ni fee lɛ nibii ni hãa nane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ baaba; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛbaa lɛ!
Aaawa ahã lɛ fe nɔ ni akɛ teji wie ŋmɔekuɛ ni eyashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃tɔ̃ bibii ɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nane lɛ."
"Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia! Kɛji onyɛmi tɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, kã ehiɛ; ni kɛji eshwa ehe lɛ kɛfa lɛ.
Ni Kɛji etɔ̃ onɔ shii kpawo gbi kome , ni shii kpawo hu gbi kome esaa eku esɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, 'Mishwa mihe' lɛ, kɛfa lɛ ."
Ni Bɔfoi lɛ kɛɛ NuŋTsɔ lɛ akɛ, "Fatamɔ wɔhemɔkɛyeli he ohã wɔ!"
SHhi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli tamɔ sinapi wu kuli lɛ, kulɛ nyɛaakɛɛ osuŋ nɛɛ akɛ,'Fãa kɛ oshishifãi ni oyama ŋshɔŋ!' Ni eeeebo nyɛ toi."
"Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ yɔɔ tsulɔ ni ekɛv tsina kɔi miihu aloo eekwɛ kooloi, ni kɛji ejɛ ŋmɔshi eba pɛ lɛ, eeekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Baata shi mramra ni oye nii,'
Shi ekɛŋ lɛ moŋ akɛ, 'Too nii ohã mi ni omīa koni osɔ̃mɔ mi kɛyashi maye nii ni manu nɔ ko; no sɛɛ koni bo hu oye nii ni onu nɔ ko lo?"
Ani eeeda nakai tsulɔ lɛ shi akɛ efee nɔ ni afã lɛ lɛ? Mikpaaa shi.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hi, kɛ nyɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni afã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Tsuji ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko ni ji wɔ; nɔ ni ji wɔgbɛnaa akɛ wɔtsuɔ lɛ, no pɛ wɔtsu nɛɛ.'"
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni enyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa Yerusalem lɛ, eyatsɔ̃ Samariab kɛ Galilea teŋ.
ni amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!"
Bi ne ni ena amɛ lɛm ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyea nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ayatsɔ̃a osɔfoi lɛ. Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni amɛyaa lɛ, amɛhe tã.
Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ, be ni ena akɛ atsa lɛ lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛba, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa bawo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Ni ekɛ ehiɛ babu shi yɛ Yesu najianaa ni eda lɛ shi. Shi mɔnɛ lɛ Samarianyo ni.
Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Ani jeee mɛi nyɔŋma he tã lɛ? Shi mɛi nɛɛhu lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ amɛyɔɔ?
Aso anaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni kuɔ esɛɛ ekɛ anumnyam bahãa Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ ja maŋsɛɛnyo nɛɛ?
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi ni oya; ohemɔkɛyeli etsa o!"
Ni Farisfoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ; "Te be ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baaba lɛ?" Eto he ehã amɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baaa tamɔ nɔ ko ni anaa;
ni asaŋ amɛkɛŋ akɛ, 'Naa, eyɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eyɛ nyɛteŋ."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Gbii aaaba ni nyɛaashwie ni nyɛna Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbii lɛ ekome, ni nyɛnaŋ.
Ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Naa eyɛ biɛ loo eyɛ jɛi!' Nyɛkayaa ni nyɛkanyiɛa sɛɛ.
ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni kɛ srawa gba ni ekpɛɔ nyram kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi afã kome kɛyaa afã kroko lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaatamɔ yɛ egbi lɛ nɔ.
Shi klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ ja ena amanehulu bbaoo ni nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ kwa lɛ.
Ni bɔ ni eba yɛ Noa gbii lɛ amli lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ebaa ba yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbii lɛ amli hu;
amɛmiiyeyee nii, amɛmiinunii dåi, amɛmiiŋɔŋɔɔ yei, ni akɛ yei lɛ miihãhãa gblã kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni Noa bote adeka lɛ mli ni nu afua lɛ ba ni ebakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Etamɔ bɔ ni eba yɛ Lot gbii lɛ amli hu lɛ, Amɛmiiyeyeea nii, amɛmiinunuu dãi, amɛmiihehee nii amɛmiihɔ̃hɔ̃ɔ nii, amɛmiitsɛɔ tsei ni amɛmiimamɔmamɔɔ tsui;
shi gbi nɔ ni Lot je Sodom lɛ, la kɛ swɔɔ nɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, ni ekpãtã amɛ Fɛɛ kwa amɛhiɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ ebaaba gbi ni aaajie Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ kpo lɛ.
"Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ ni enii yɔɔ shīa lɛ akakpleke shi ebaklɔ, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi hu akaku esɛɛ kɛmiiba.
Nyɛkaia Lot ŋa lɛ!"
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ebaa ewala yi lɛ ), eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni fɛɛ mɔ ni aaalaje lɛ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ mɛi enyɔ aaakãmɔ saa kome nɔ: aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome.
Yei enyɔ aaawiɛ yɛ he kome, aaaŋɔ mɔ kome ni aaashi mɔ kome."
(Mɛi enyɔ aaahi ŋmɔshi, aaaŋɔ mɔ kome ni aaashi mɔ kome.)
Ni amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, nɛɛgbɛ?" Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "He ni gbonyo kã lɛ, jɛi akpãai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ."
18: Yesu bu ekaselɔi lɛ bɛ ko ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ esa akɛ amɛsɔleɔ daa ni ekaje amɛtsine.
Ekɛɛ, "Kojolɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko nɔ, ni esheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni asaŋ ebuuu gbɔmɔ ko.
Ni yoo okulafo ko yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli, ni eba eŋɔɔ shii abɔ ebakɛɛ, ';Fã mihe kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ!'
Ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ aahuu. Shi fee Sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, 'Yɛŋ akɛ misheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni mibuuu gbɔmɔ hu moŋ nɛ,
Shi akɛni yoo okulafo nɛɛ miigba minaa hewɔ lɛ, mafã ehe, koni, be ni yi aaawula shi lɛ, ekaba ni ebashwie mihIɛ ma.'"
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Nyɛnu nɔ ni kojolɔ kutumpɔfo lɛ kɛɛ!
Ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɛ aahuu tete kɛ ehalamɔbii ni blɔɔ tsɛɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ ayelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, aso ebafãŋ amɛhe?
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ eeefã amɛhe oya. SHi be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba lɛ, ani eeebaana hemɔkɛyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ?"
Asaŋ ebu mɛi komɛi ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe nɔ akɛ jalɔi ji amɛ ni amɛgbeɔ mɛi krokomɛi ahe guɔ lɛ hu abɛ nɛɛ,
"Mɛi enyɔ yiŋ tee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni amɛyasɔle; mɔ kome lɛ Farisfonyo ji lɛ, ni mɔ kome hu lɛ toohelɔŋ.
Farisfonyo lɛ yadamɔ shi, ni esɔle nɛkɛ, 'Nyɔmɔ, miida o shi akɛ mitamɔ̃ɔɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, ojotswalɔi, kutumpɔfoi, gblãfitelɔI, loo tamɔ nɛkɛ hoohelɔ nɛɛ po;
mihiɔ ŋmaa shii enyɔ yɛ otsi mli, miŋɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ni minaa lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mihãa. '
Shi toohelɔ lɛ damɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni emiii ni ewoɔ ehiɛ nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi tete; shi moŋ eshimɔ etsitsi ni ekɛɛ 'Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi ji eshafeelɔ lɛ akpãtã!'
Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ yiŋ etee ewe ni abu lɛ bem fe mɔkome lɛ. Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ aaaba lɛ shi, shi mɔ ni baa ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ."
Ni akɛ abifabii hu ba eŋɔɔ, koni etra amɛhe; shi be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ, amɛnyafi amɛ.
Shi Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛ anɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ gbekɛ ko lɛ, eboteŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli kɛ mli kwraa."
Ni onukpa ko babi lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni mafee, koni mana naanɔ wala?"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ otsɛɔ mi mɔ kpakpa? Mɔ kpakpa ko bɛ akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ.
Ole kutãi lɛ akɛ, 'Kaafite gblã; kaagbe gbɔmɔ; kaaju; kaaye amale odase; wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ.'"
Shi ekɛɛ, "Miye enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ nɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi.:
Ni be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Eshwɛ o nɔ kome lolo; yaahɔ̃ɔ nibii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ lɛ ni okɛ shika lɛ aja ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba obanyiɛ misɛɛ."
Shi be ni enu enɛ lɛ, ewerɛ ho ehe naakpa, ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Yesu na akɛ ewerɛ eko lɛ ekɛɛ, "Kwɛ bɔ ni ewa hã mɛi ni yɔɔ nii akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!
Ejaakɛ ejraaa hãaa yoma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli tamɔ bɔ ni ejraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
Shi mɛi ni nu lɛ kɛɛ, "Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?"
Shi ekɛɛ, "Nibii ni gbɔmɛi nyɛɛɛɛ afee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ enyɛɔ efeɔ."
Ni Petro kɛɛ, "Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi wɔnii ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ."
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ko bɛ ni eshi shīa loo ŋa loo nyɛmimɛi loo fɔlɔi loo bii yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewɔ
ni enaŋ najiaŋtoo shii abɔ yɛ be nɛɛ mli, ni jeŋ ni baa lɛ mli hu enaŋ naanɔ wala."
Agbɛnɛ etsɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba emasɛi ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalem, ni aaagbe nibii fɛɛ ni gbalɔi lɛ eŋma yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ he lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ abaajie lɛ awo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ; ni aaaye ehe fɛo ni aaafee lɛ niseniianii ni aaafɛ̃ lajɔ ashwie ehe,
ni amɛkɛ kplebii aaayi lɛ ni amɛaagbɛ lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ eeete shi ekoŋŋ."
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛnaaa nii nɛɛ ateŋ ekomeflo shishi, ni akɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ etee amɛ, ni amɛyooo wiemɔi ni ewie lɛ asɛɛ!
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ebɛŋkɛ Yeriko lɛ, shwilafo ko ta gbɛ lɛ toi eebla nii,
Ni be ni shwilafo lɛ nu akɛ mɛi pii miiho lɛ, ebi nɔ ni ji.
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ miiho."
Ni ebo ekɛɛ. "Yesu, david Bi, na mi mɔbɔ!"
Ni mɛi ni nyiɛ hiɛ lɛ fãmɔ eyi akɛ emua enaa; shi eblɔ babaoo moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, "David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!"
Ni Yesu wa damɔ shi, ni efã akɛ akɛ lɛ aba. Ni be ni ebɛŋkɛ lɛ, Yesu bi lɛ
akɛ, "Mɛni atoaɔ akɛ mifee mihã o?" Ni ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ mana nii ekoŋŋ."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa nii, ohemɔkɛyeli atsa o!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ena nii, ni enyiɛ esɛɛ ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam; ni be ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ, amɛjie Nyɔŋmɔ yi.
19: Yesu yabote Yeriko ni eefoŋ.
Ni nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zakeo, ni toohel_ nukpa ji lɛ, ni ena nii hu.
Ni eetao Yesu ena ni ele lɛ, shi mɛi pii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, enyɛɛ, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ kpitioo ji lɛ.
ni esha foi kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ, ni eyakwɔ agbãmitso koni ena lɛ, ejaakɛ jɛi gbɛ ebaatsɔ̃.
Ni be ni Yesu shɛ jɛi lɛ, ewo amɛ ehiɛ nɔ ni ena lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Zakeo, ohe efee oya ni okpleke shi, ejaakɛ owe lɛ sa akɛ mato ŋmɛnɛ"
Ni ehe fee oya ni ekpleke shi, ni ehere lɛ atuu.
Ni be ni mɛi na lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛwie huhuuhu amɛkɛɛ, "Eyato nuu esafeelɔ ŋɔɔ."
Shi Zakeo ho damɔ shi ni ekɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, naa, miiŋɔ minii fã make ohiafoi, ni kɛji mikɛ yaka naaflɔmɔ eshɔ̃ mɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ lɛ."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "ŋmɛnɛ yiwalaheremɔ eba shīa nɛɛ, akɛni lɛ hu Abraham bi ji lɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba nɔ ni elaaje lɛ taomɔ kɛ eyiwalaheremɔ."
Shi be ni amɛboɔ nii nɛɛ atoi lɛ, ebu abɛ ko eshi nɔ, ejaakɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yerusalem ni amɛsusu aKɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛlɛi lɛ baapue.
No hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Ablade ko dom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ ni eyaŋɔ emaŋtsɛyeli ni eku esɛɛ eba.
Ni etsɛ etsuji nyɔŋma, ni ejie menai nyɔŋma ehã amɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa he kɛyashi maba.'
Shi emaŋbii lɛ nyɛ lɛ, ni amɛtsu bɔfoi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛyakɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔsumɔɔɔ ni mɔnɛ abaye wɔnɔ maŋtsɛ.,'
"Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni enine eyashɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, efã akɛ etsɛ tsuji lɛ ni ekɛ shika lɛ hã lɛ kɛba, koni ena yɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Klɛŋlɛŋ mɔ lɛ ba ni ebakɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, omena lɛ efɔ menai nyɔŋma ewoŋ.'
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ahekoo tsulɔ kpakpa! Akɛni oye anɔkwa yɛ nɔ ko bibioo mli hewɔ lɛ, ye maji nyɔŋma anɔ. '
Ni mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ba ebakɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, omena lɛ efɔ menai enumɔ ewoŋ.'
Ni lɛ hu ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo hu ye maji enumɔ nɔ.'
Ni mɔ kroko hu ba ebakɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, naa, omen alɛ ni mifi miwo mama naa kɛto lɛ nɛ;
miyasho o gbeyei, ejaakɛ yiwalɔ ji o, okɔɔ nɔ ni akɛfɔ̃ko shi, ni okpaa nɔ ni oduko.'
Shi ablade lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, 'Tsulɔ fɔ̃ŋ, bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ mikɛaakojo o! Ni ole akɛ yiwalɔ ji mi, ni mikɔɔ nɔ ni mikɛfɔ̃ko shi, ni mikpaa nɔ ni miduko lɛ,
mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni okɛ mishika lɛ eyawoooo shikatoohe lɛ, koni kɛ miba lɛ ni mibahe minii kɛ ehekpa?"
Ni eKɛɛ mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛshɔ̃a mena lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛhãa mɔ ni yɔɔ menai nyɔŋma lɛ.'
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ menai nyɔŋma.'
'Eyɛ mli nakai, shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ aaahã; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete aaashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ.
Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, eho eyi hiɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalem .
Be ni ebɛŋkɛ Betfage kɛ Betania yɛ gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ,
ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ lɛ mli, ni kɛ nyɛbote mli lɛ nyɛaana tejibi ni mɔ ko tako enɔ pɛŋ ŋmɔ shi yɛ jɛi; nyɛfɛne alɛ ni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi nyɛ akɛ, 'Mɛɛba nyɛfɛneɔ lɛ?' lɛ nyɛkea lɛ akɛ, 'Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.'
Ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛfɛneɔ tejibi lɛ, mɛi ni anɔ ji lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛfɛneɔ tejibi lɛ?'"
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ."
Ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei shwie tejibi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛwo Yesu amɛta nɔ.
Ni be ni eyaa lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛtadei ha gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni ebɛŋkɛ he ni akplekeɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ, ekaselɔi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i nyamɔ ni amɛkɛ gbee ni wa jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, yɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni amɛna lɛ hewɔ,
amɛ kɛɛ, "Ajɔɔ maŋtsɛ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ! Hejɔlɛ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni aumnyam yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!"
Ni Farisfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi jɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, kã okaselɔi lɛ."
Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miikɛɛ nyɛɛ akɛ, kɛji mɛnɛɛmɛi aaamua amɛnaa lɛ, no lɛ tɛi aaablɔ."
Ni be ni eshɛ ni ena maŋ lɛ, efo eshwie enɔ,
ni ekɛɛ, "Eji yɛ ogbɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ona ole nii ni hã ohejɔlɛ lɛ kulɛ! Shi amɛbɛnɛ akɛtoo o.
Shi gbii miiba, ni ohenyɛlɔi lɛ aaatsa bu awo ohe, ni amɛaabɔle o kpula ni amɛsaaŋɔ oyi yɛ he fɛɛ he,
Ni amɛaaŋɔ o amɛtswa shi kɛ obii ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, ni amɛshiŋ tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ yɛ omli, ejaakɛ oyoooo osromɔ sramɔbe lɛ."
Ni Yesu tee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni ebɔ̃i mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ nii yɛ jɛi l!ɛ shwiemɔ,
ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Aŋma akɛ, 'Miwe lɛ Sɔlemɔwe ni'; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfee ojoytswalɔi abi."
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii daa nɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ; shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ miitao ehiɛ amɛkpãtã;
shi amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee, ejaakɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpɛtɛ lɛ ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi.
20: Gbi lɛ ko ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ_ maŋ lɛ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni ejajeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ba,
ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ nɔ hegbɛ ni oyɔɔ hewɔ ni ofeɔ nii nɛɛ, ni namɔ i mɔ ni hã o nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ?"
Ni eto he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mi hu mibabi nyɛ sane ko, ni nyɛhãa mi hetoo:
Yohaane baptisimɔ lɛ, ani ŋwɛi ejɛ aloo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ."
Shi amɛhala mli yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, "kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeekɛɛ , 'Mɛɛba ni nyɛheee kɛ nyɛyeee mɔ?'
Ni asaŋ kɛji wɔkɛɛ lɛ akɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ aaatwia wɔ tɛi; ejaakɛ amɛyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ; Yohane lɛ, gbalɔ ji lɛ."
Nia mɛto he akɛ amɛleee he ji ejɛ.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Belɛ mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ ni mifeɔ nii nɛɛ mɔ!"
Ni ebɔ̃i maŋ lɛ kɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ buu akɛ, "Nuu ko fee waintrom ni ekɛhã okwaafoi apaayeli, ni etee maŋsɛɛ ni eyatsɛ aahuu.
Ni be ni shɛ be lɛ, etsu tsulɔ ko kɛtee okwaafoi aŋɔɔ, koni amɛhã lɛ waintrom lɛ mli yibii lɛ eko; shi okwaafoi lɛ yi lɛ, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛ̃ flo.
Ni esaa etsu tsulɔ kroko hu, shi amɛyi lɛ hu ni amɛshwie ehiɛ shi, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛ̃ flo.
Ni esaa etsu mɔ ni ji etɛ̃; shi lɛ hu amɛpila lɛ, ni amɛtsire eyi sɛɛ kɛje kpo.
Ni waintrom lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, 'Mɛni sa akɛ mafee.' Matsu mibi ni misumɔɔ lɛ; ekolɛ lɛ lɛ, kɛ amɛn alɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaaasɔ lɛ.'
Shi be ni okwaafoi lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛ ɛ amɛhe akɛ, 'Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ, koni gboshinii lɛ atsɔ̃ wɔnɔ.
Nia mɛtsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛje waintrom lɛ mli ni amɛyagbe lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni waintromtsɛ lɛ aaafee amɛ?
Eeeba ebakpãtã nɛkɛ okwaafoi nɛɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaaha6 mɛi krokomɛi." Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Enɛ akagbale wɔ fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ!"
Shi ekwɛ amɛ kɛkpe ni ekɛɛ, :"Mɛni nɔ ni aŋma nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ akɛ, 'Tɛ lɛ ni tsutsuwalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ, No nɔŋŋ etsɔ kɔŋtɛ lɛ?'
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbee tɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, emli aaatserɛ; shi mɔ nɔ ni eeegbee lɛ=, eeegblɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ."
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ miito lɛ amɔ yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ amɛyoo akɛ amɛhew( ebu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ; shi amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni amɛsra lɛ, ni amɛtsu sralɔi, mɛi ni fee amɛhe tamɔ jalɔi, koni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛŋɔ lɛ amɛhã amralo lɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ owieɔ ni otsɔ̃ɔ nii jalɛ naa, ni asaŋ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ, shi moŋ anɔkwale mli otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ. (Kɛɛmɔ wɔ.):
Ani eja gbɛ akɛ wɔyeɔ too wɔhãa Kaisare, aloo ejaaa.?>
Shi be ni ekpa amɛŋaa lɛ shi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛkɛ denario atsɔ̃ɔa mi. Namɔ mfoniri nɛ? Ni namɔ he sane aŋ ayɛ nɔ lɛ?" Ni amɛto he amɛkɛɛ =, "Kaisare nɔŋ>"
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Belɛ nyɛ kɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare; ni Nyɔŋm( nii lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ."
Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ enaa enyɔŋ ko amɛmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ , ni ehotoo lɛ fee amɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛbu amɛnaa.
Ni Sadukifo lɛ hu ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ sane ko
amɛkɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, Mose ŋma hã wɔ akɛ, 'Kɛji mɔ o nyɛmi ni yɔɔ ŋa gbo ni eshiii bi lɛ, enyɛmi aŋɔ eŋa lɛ, koni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.'
Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi shi, ni amɛteŋ onukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ woo, ni egbo ni eshiii bi.
Ni esɛɛho lɛ ŋɔ lɛ, ni lɛ hu egbo ni eshibii bi.
Ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hu ŋɔ lɛ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛyi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ amɛfee; ni amɛshiii bii ni amɛgboi.
Ni fee sɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu bagbo.
"Belɛ gbohiaashitee lɛ mli lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ? Ejaakɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ lɛ."
Ni Yesu to he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Je nɛɛŋ bii ŋɔŋɔɔ yei ni amɛkɛ yei hãa gbla,
shi mɛi ni aaasa jeŋ ni baa lɛ kɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ namɔ lɛ, amɛŋɔɔɔ yei, asaŋ amɛkɛ yei hãaa gblã,
ni asŋ amɛnyɛŋ amɛgboi dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi; ni Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji amɛ, ejaakɛ shitee lɛ bii ji amɛ.
Shi akɛ gbohiii baate shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, Mose diɛŋtsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ yɛ kowie lɛ sane lɛ mli, be ni etsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ 'Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ' lɛ;
shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeee gbohiii a-Nyɔŋmɔ ni shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi a-Nyɔŋmɔŋ; ejaakɛ ehiɛ lɛ mɛi fɛɛ hiɛkãmɔ."
Shi mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, owie jogbaŋŋ!"
Ni amɛkaaa lɛ sane ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ kɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ akɛɔ akɛ Kristo lɛ, David biŋ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ David diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Lahai Awolo lɛ mli akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, Ta mininejurɔ nɔ,
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amŋɔ ohiɛnyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajaiashi maaŋoo.'
Kɛ David tsɛ lɛ 'Nuŋtsɔ' lɛ, belɛ te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebi?"
Shi maŋ lɛ fɛɛ toiiaŋ ekɛɛ ekaselɔI lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ni amɛsumɔɔ jaanɔ ŋamɔi kɛ onukpai ashitramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ yitsotamɔ kɛ atsɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ,
amɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, belɛ amɛkwa amɛmiisɔle sɔlemɔi kakadaji. Amɛfabuu lɛ aaafe nine."
21: Yesu wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ena niiatsɛmɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛnikeenii miiwo onia adeka lɛ mli.
Shi ena yoo okulafo ohiafo ko hu ba ni ekɛ pesewai enyɔ bawo mli.
Ni ekɛɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yoo okuylafo nɛɛ, ekɛ pii ewo mli fe mɛi lɛ fɛɛ;
ejaakɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, nɔ i amɛnani eteke nɔ lɛ eko amɛkɛbawo nikeenii lɛ amli nɛɛ, shi mɔnɛ lɛ, ehia mli nii ni ekɛwɛɔ ehe nɔ lɛ fɛɛ ekɛbawo mli nɛɛ."
Ni be ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he, bɔ ni akɛ tɛi fɛɛfɛji kɛ keenii ewula lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ,
"Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, gbii aaaba nu ashiŋ emli tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ ni atsiŋ atswaŋ shi."
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, no hewɔ lɛ mɛɛ be nii nɛɛ aaaba mli? Ni mɛɛ okadi abaana kɛ eshɛ be ni ebaaba mli lɛ?"
Ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, koni akakla nyɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi pii aaaba yɛ migBɛi mli ni amɛaakɛɛ, 'Mi ni' kɛ 'Be lɛ eshɛ etã. Shi nyɛkanyiɛa amɛsɛɛ.
Ni kɛ nyɛnu tai kɛ atūatsemɔi ahe lɛ, nyɛtsui akafãa; ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ba mli dã, shi kɛ̃lɛ naagbee lɛ shɛko bianɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Maŋ baate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyeli hu aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli;
ni shikpɔŋ hosomɔi ni naa wa aaaba hei srɔtoi fɛɛ, kɛ hɔ̃ji kɛ gble helai, ni gbeyei nibii kɛ okadii wuji aaajɛ ŋwɛi aba.
"Shi dani enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaaba lɛ, amɛaamɔmɔ nyɛ ni amaawa nyɛ yi ni amɛkɛ nyɛ aaahã ni akojo nyɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ awo nyɛ tsuŋ, ni amɛaakpla nyɛ kɛatee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi ahiɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Ni no aaahã nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛye odase.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhiɛ ahia nɔni nyɛkasusu nɔ ni nyɛkɛajie nyɛnaa he nyɛto;
ejaakɛ mahã nyɛ naabu kɛ nilee ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛŋ naa adamɔ ni amɛnyɛŋ naa amɛku hu.
Shi fɔlɔi tete kɛ nyɛmimɛi kɛ wekumɛi kɛ shientsɛmɛi aaaŋɔ nyɛ ahã, ni amɛaahã agbe nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi;
ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Shi nyɛyiteŋ tsɔi kome nɛkɛ elaajeŋ.
hiɛmiamɔ nyɛkɛaahere nyɛsusumai lɛ."
"Shi kɛ nyɛna akɛ tai ebɔle Yerusalem lɛ, belɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ fiteemɔ lɛ eshɛ.
No mli lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi aya gɔji lɛ aje kpo, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ akrowai akaba mli.
Ejaakɛ oweletɔɔ gbii lɛ nɛ, koni nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli.
Shi miihã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ yei ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ kpoo! Ejaakɛ fimɔ babaoo baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mlifu baaba nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa, ni aaaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛaatee jeŋmaji fɛɛ mli, ni jeŋmaji lɛ aaananaa Yerusalem nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Jeŋmaji abɛ lɛ aaashɛ."
"Ni okadii aaaba hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii amli, ni jeŋmaji lɛ ahe aaajra amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaafee yeyeeye yɛ ŋshɔ gbeemɔ kɛ ŋshɔkei akuumɔ hewɔ;
ni kɔ aaanyɔnyɔɔ gbɔmɛi anɔ yɛ gbeyei kɛ nibii ni baa je lɛ nɔ lɛ agbɛkwɛmɔ hewɔ; ejaakɛ aaaho so ŋwɛi hewalɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni eeba yɛ atatuŋ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ anumnyam babaoo.
Shi be ni nibii nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛjajea nyɛhe nyɛdamɔ shi ni nyɛholea nyɛyitsei anɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛkpɔ̃mɔ lɛ miibɛŋkɛ."
Ni ebu amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa agbamitso kɛ tsei fɛɛ;
be mli beebe ni amɛfuɔ baa lɛ kɛ nyɛna lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ latsaabe eshɛ etã.
Nakai nɔŋŋ hu, be ni nyɛaana akɛ nibii nɛɛ etsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ shi etã.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ aaaba mli.
ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ aaaho aya; shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ."
"Shi nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ koni fufeemɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ yɛ wala nɛɛ mli nibii ahe akahe nyɛtsuii ni nakai gbi lɛ miibati nyɛ shi trukaa;
ejaakɛ ebaaba mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikp0ŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ tamɔ tsɔne.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsraa ni nyɛsɔlea be fɛɛ be, koni nyɛnyɛ nii ni baaba nɛɛ fɛɛ mli nyɛje, ni nyɛnyɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyɛdamɔ."
Shi kɛ je tsɛre lɛ Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni kɛ je na lɛ, eyaa gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyawɔɔ.
Ni amŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ teɔ shi leebi maaŋkpa kɛbaa eŋɔɔ amɛbaboɔ lɛ toi SɔLemɔwe lɛ.
22: Agbɛnɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hehoo lɛ miishɛ.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ tao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛgbe lɛ; shi amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei.
Shi Satan yabote Yuda mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Iskariot ni ji mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ mli.
Ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ yawie, bɔ ni eeefee ni ejie lɛ ahã amɛ.
Ni amɛnya, ni amɛwo lɛ shi akɛ amɛaahã lɛ shika,
ni ekplɛ̃; ni etao be ni sa ni ekɛaajie lɛ ehã amɛ ni mɛi bɛ jɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Akpiti Gijurɔ ni sa akɛ agbeɔ Hehoo toobi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ bashɛ;
ni etsu Petro kɛ Yohaneni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyasaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ nyɛtao wɔ, koni wɔbaye."
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa wɔto yɛ?"
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛbote maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, naa, nuu ko kɛ nyɛ aaakpe ni ehiɛ nu kɛ kpulu; nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛyaa shīa he ni eeeeyabote lɛ,
ni nyɛyakɛa shīatsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ wɔbakɛɛ o akɛ, Nɛɛgbɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ ni mi kɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo niyenii lɛ yɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?'
Ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ŋwɛisa kple ko ni awula mli; nyɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ nyɛtoa yɛ jɛi. "
Ni amɛyiŋ anɛtee ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto
Ni be ni ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ shɛ lɛ, eho eta niyenii lɛ ahe, i Bɔfoi lɛ fata ehe.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Taomɔ pam mitsoɔ akɛ mikɛ nyɛ aye nɛkɛ Hehoo nɛɛ dani mana amanehulu lɛ;
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miyeŋ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaaaba mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
No hewɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛhea mni nyɛjaa;
ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaaaba.
Ni ekɔ aboloo, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli, ni akɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, (Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso ni akɛhã yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ; nyɛfea enɛ ni nyɛkɛklaia mi."
Nakai nɔŋŋ ewo kpulu lɛ hu yɛ niyenii lɛ asɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ yɛ mila ni akɛshwie shi ahã nyɛ lɛ mli.)
"Shi naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ nine kɛ minine yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ;
ni Gbɔmɔ Bi Lɛ miiya tamɔ bɔ ni akpɛ mli ato lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ!"
Ni amɛ bɔ̃i amɛhe bimɔ akɛ amɛteŋnamɔ po baafee enɛ!
Shi naatamɔ hu bate shi yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ amɛteŋ namɔ sa akɛ abu lɛ agbo fe fɛɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ amɛnɔ hewalɛ lɛ, atsɛɔ amɛ ejurɔfeelɔi.
Shi nYɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi moŋ mɔ ni ji agbo yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, etsɛ tamɔ gbekɛ, ni mɔ ni ji onukpa hu tamɔ mɔ ni sumɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ te mɔ ni fe mɔ hu, mɔ ni taa okplɔ̃ he lɛ, aloo mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ? Ani jeee mɔ ni taa okplɔ̃ he lɛ/ Shi mi lɛ miyɛ nyɛteŋ akɛ mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ.
Shi nyɛji mɛi ni kɛ mi ehi shi yɛ mikai lɛ amli.
Ni mi hu miito maŋtsɛyeli mahã nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mi-Tsɛ eto ehã mi lɛ,
koni nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu yɛ mlikplɔ̃ lɛ he yɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; ni nyɛaatra sɛ̃ii anɔ ni nyɛkojo Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ."
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Simon, Simon, naa, Satan ena hegbɛ, koni esha nyɛ mli tamɔ ŋmaa.
Shi mi lɛ mikpa fai miha o, koni ohemɔkɛyeli akatã; ni bo hu, kɛ okpale lɛ, wo onyɛmimɛi lɛ hewalɛ."
Shi ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, misaa mihe mito ni kɛ tsuŋ o, gbele mli o, mikɛ o aya."
Ekɛɛ, "Petro, miikɛɛ o akɛ ŋmɛnɛ wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni ootso shii etɛ̃ akɛ oleee mi."
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Be ni mitsu nyɛ ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ fotro kɛ kotoku kɛ tokotai lɛ, ani nɔ ko he hia nyɛ." Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Nɔ ko nɔ o he ehiaaa wɔ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ froto lɛ, ekɔ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ kotoku hu akɔ; ni mɔ ni bɛ klaŋte lɛ, ehɔ̃ɔ etade ni ekɛhe eko.
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ni aŋma nɛɛ hu, ja eba mli yɛ mihe, akɛ, 'Ni abu lɛ ashi mlatɔlɔi anɔ.'; ejaakɛ nibii ni aŋmla yɛ mihe lɛ miiba mli."
Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, naa, klaŋtei enyɔ nɛ." Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Efa."
Ni eje kpo, ni tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ eyiŋ kɛtee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ hu nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛsɔlea koni nyɛkabote kaa mli."
Ni egbla ehe shi kɛjɛ amɛŋɔɔ aaafee fɛfɔ̃ɔ jɛkɛmɔ, ni eho ekula shi, ni esɔle
ekɛɛ, "Ataa, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, jiemɔ kpulu nɛɛ kɛje minɔ, Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ."
(Ni bɔfo ko jɛ ŋwɛi bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ebawo lɛ hewalɛ.
Ni be ni ehe jraa lɛ lɛ, ehã esɔlemɔ lɛ mli wa. Ni ehe laatsaaa tsɔ̃ tamɔ lákulibii ni tsereɔ shwieɔ shi,)
Ni be ni esɔle egbe naa ni ete shi kɛba ekaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, ebana amɛ akɛ amɛmiiwɔ ejaakɛ amɛwerɛ eho amɛhe;
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛwɔɔ? Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛsɔLea, koni nyɛkabote kaa mli."
Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa asafoku ko ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yuda lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ! Ni etsi ebɛŋkɛ Yesu, koni eshwɔ enaa.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yuda, okɛ naashwɔmɔ miitsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ?:
Ni be ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ na nɔ ni baaba lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, wɔbamɔ klaŋte lo?"
Ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome bã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ lɛ klaŋte ni efo eninejurɔ toi.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, "Awa biɛ!" Ni eta etoi lɛ he ni atsa lɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ asafoatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ni ba enɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mi minɔ nyɛje kpo kɛba kɛ klaŋte kɛ kpotii tamɔ abaa awutelɔ nɔ nɛɛ?
Daa ni mi kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, nyɛtaa mihe; shi nyɛŋmlɛtswaa lɛ kɛ duŋ hewalɛ lɛ nɛ!"
Ni amɛnɔ lɛ ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee osɔnukpa lɛ we lɛ. Shi Petro nyiɛ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛre la yɛ mɔɔ te lɛ mli ni amɛho amɛtra he lɛ, Petro hu ho yata amɛteŋ.
Ni tsulɔ yoo fioo ko na lɛ ni eta la lɛ he, ni ekwɛ lɛ totooto ni ekɛɛ, "Nuu nɛɛ hu kɛ lɛ yɔɔ."
Shi etso ekɛɛ, "Awo, mileee lɛ!"
No sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ lɛ, mɔ kroko hu na lɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Bo hu, amɛteŋ mɔ ko ji o." Shi Petro kɛɛ, "Ataa, jeee amɛteŋ mɔ ko ji mi!"
No sɛɛ aaafee ŋmlɛtswaa kome lɛ mɔ kroko hu ma nɔ mi veveeve akɛ, "Asɔnakwa, nuu nɛɛ hu kɛ lɛ yɔɔ; ejaakɛ Galileanyo hu hi!"
Shi Petro kɛɛ, "Ataa, mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ nɛɛɛ!" Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, be ni kɛ Yerusalem jekɛmɔ aaafee shitoi kpawo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Emao ni ekã he ewieɔ lolo lɛ, wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ekwɛ Petro; ni Petro kai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "ŋmɛnɛ wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃," lɛ.
Ni Petro je kpo ni eyafo kɛ dɔlɛ.
Shi hii ni hiɛ Yesu lɛ ye ehe fɛo ni amɛyi lɛ.
Ni amɛhã ehiɛ ni amɛbibii lɛ akɛ," Gbaa, namɔ ji mɔ ni gba o ma lɛ."
Ni amɛwie nibii krokomɛi pii amɛkɛbɔ musu amɛshi lɛ.
Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ anaa bakpe shi, ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee amɛkuashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ,
ni amɛkɛɛ, "Kɛji boji Kristo lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ." Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "KɛJi mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ;
ni kɛ sane ko mibi hu, nyɛhaŋ mi hetoo.
Shi kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaata Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Belɛ boji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ? Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛkɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi ni.'"
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛni wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ odase wɔfee dɔŋŋ? Ejaakɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu yɛ enaa."
23: Ni amɛsafo muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi, ni amɛkpla Yesu kɛtee Pilato ŋɔɔ.
Ni amɛbɔ̃i enaa flɔmɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔna nuu nɛɛ ni eewo wɔmaŋ lɛ yiŋ ni eegu oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hamɔ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ lɛ ji Kristo, maŋtsɛ lɛ."
Ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?" Ni amɛ eto he ehã lɛ akɛ, "Okɛɛ."
Ni Pilato kɛɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ asafoi lɛ akɛ, "Minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ nuu nɛɛ he."
Shi amɛka nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ "Ewoɔ maŋ lɛ hirihiri kɛ enii i etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yudea fɛɛ, ni ebɔi kɛjɛ Galilea kɛbashi biɛ nɛɛ."
Shi be ni Pilato nu Galilea gbɛi lɛ, ebi akɛ nuu lɛ Galileanyoŋ lo?
Ni be ni ena ele akɛ ejɛ Herode nɔyelihe lɛ, ehã akɛ lɛ tee Herode, mɔ hu ni eba Yerusalem yɛ nakai gbii lɛ amli lɛ; ŋɔɔ.
Shi be ni Herode na Yesu lɛ, ena miishɛɛ babaoo, ejaakɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ejɛ etaoɔ lɛ ena, ejaakɛ enu ehe saji pii, ni ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eeefee okadi ko ni ena.
Ni ebibii lɛ saji pii; shi ehãaa lɛ ekomeflo hetoo.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ badamɔ shi ni amɛflɔ enaa naakpa.
Ni be ni Herode kɛ esrafoi lɛ ebɔ lɛ ahora ni amɛye ehe fɛo ni amɛwo lɛ atade kaŋkaŋ lɛ, ehã akɛ lɛ tee Pilato ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Shi maŋ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Pilato kɛ Herode bɔ naanyo, shi kulɛ sa lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe yeee.
Ni Pilato tsɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ kɛkpe,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ bahã mi akɛ eewo maŋ lɛ yiŋ; ni naa, mitao esane lɛ mli yɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ, minaaa fɔbuuu sane ko yɛ ehe yɛ saji ni nyɛkɛbaflɔ enaa lɛ ekoeko mli.
Ni Herode hu enaaa eko, ejaakɛ ekpale lɛ kɛbahã wɔ; ni naa, efeko nɔ ko ni sa gbele.
No hewɔ lɛ mibayi lɛ ni maŋmɛɛ ehe."
(Shi ehia kɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛ mɔ kome he ehã amɛ.)
Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛblɔ shi kome amɛkɛɛ, "Okɛ mɔnɛ aya, ni oŋmɛɛ Baraba he ohã wɔ!"
(Baraba nɛɛ ji nuu ko ni atūa ko ni atsɛ yɛ naŋ lɛŋ kɛ awui ko ni aye hewɔ lɛ awo lɛ tsuŋ.)
Shi akɛni Pilato miitao akɛ eŋmɛɛ Yesu he hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ.
Shi amɛblɔ akɛ, "Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!" Sɛŋmɔ lɛ"
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɔ ni ji shi etɛ̃ akɛ, "Shi mɔnɛ lɛ, mɛɛ efɔŋ efee.? Minako nɔ ko ni sa gbele yɛ ehre, no hewɔ lɛ mibayi lɛ ni maŋmɛɛ ehe."
Shi amɛka nɔ kɛ gbee ni wa niamɛmiiao akɛ asɛŋ lɛ; ni amɛgbei kɛ osɔnukpai lɛ anɔ lɛ ye nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato gbe sane lɛ naa akɛ afee bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ;
ni eŋmɛɛ mɔ ni atūatsemɔ kɛ awuyeli hewɔ ni awo lɛ tsuŋ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ lɛ he; shi Yesu lɛ; ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ amɛtaomɔ lɛ naa.
Ni be nu amɛkpla lɛ kɛyaa lɛ amɛnɔ Simon Kerenyo ko ni jɛ kosɛɛ baa lɛ, ni amɛwo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ amɛtre lɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni maŋ lɛ mli bii pii kɛ yei hu ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ ni amɛfoɔ yɛ ehewɔ lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Shi Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe ehã amɛ ni ekɛɛ,m "Yerusalem biyei, nyɛkafoa yɛ mihewɔ; shi moŋ nyɛfo ayɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ nyɛbii ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, gbii miiba no mli ni amɛaakɛɛ., 'Ajɔɔ kenei kɛ musui ni fɔko dã kɛ fufɔi ni ayeko dã!'
No mli lɛ amɛaabɔ̃i gɔji lɛ akɛɛmɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛbagbea wɔnɔ! Kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu akɛ, 'Nyɛbaaha wɔnɔ!"
Ejaakɛ kɛ tso ŋmɔŋ afeɔ enɛ lɛ, tso gbiŋ lɛ, te aaafee lɛ tɛŋŋ?"
Ni bakpla mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ hu ni ji efɔŋfeelɔi afata ehe kɛtee ni ayagbe amɛ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Yitsoŋoŋo lɛ, amɛsɛŋ lɛ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ yɛ jɛi, mɔ kome hu ye ninejurɔgbɛ ni mɔ kome hu ye abɛkugbɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛm "Ataa, kɛfa amɛ; amɛleee nɔ ni amɛfe0 lɛ." Ni amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja atadei lɛ.
Ni maŋbii lɛ damɔ shi amɛmiikwɛ. Ni maŋ onukpai lɛ hu ye lɛ ahi amɛkɛɛ, "Ehereɔ mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala; kɛ lɛ ji Kristo mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ ehala lɛ, ehere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala!"
Ni asraafoi lɛ hu ye ehe fɛo, ni amɛba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbahã lɛ ashiŋ,
ni amɛkɛɛ, "Kɛ boji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ, heremɔ bp diɛŋtysɛ oyiwala!
Shi aŋma ŋmalɛ ko hu yɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, "YUDAFOI Lɛ AMAŋTSɛ Lɛ Nɛ!:"
Ni efɔŋfeelɔi ni asɛŋ lɛ ayteŋ mɔ kome wie musubɔɔ wiemɔ eshi lɛ ekɛɛ, "Jeee boji Kristo lɛ? Jiemɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ wɔ hu!"
Shi mɔ kome lɛ here nɔ ni ekã ehiɛ ekɛɛ., "Ani bo hu ni oyɔɔ fɔbuu kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli osheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei?
Ni wɔnɔ lɛ sa wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔnifeemɔnii ahe nyɔmɔwo wɔna nɛɛ; shi mɔnɛ lɛ efeko nɔ ko ni esaaa.
Ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ mi be ni oooba yɛ omaŋtseyeli lɛ mli lɛ!"
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miikɛɛ o anɔkwale mli akɛ, 'ŋmɛnɛ okɛ mi aaahi Paradeiso!."
Agbɛnɛ aaafee shwane ŋmlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli lɛ, duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛnɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli;
ni hulu wo duŋ, ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba kɛyi shi yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
Ni Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, "Ataa, odɛŋ mituɔ mimumɔ miwoɔ nɛɛ!" Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ ebu enaa.
Sh be ni asraaafoihatsɛ lɛ na nɔ ni efee lɛ, ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam ni ekɛɛ, "Yɛŋ lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ jalɔŋ!"
Be ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ababua amɛhe naa ni amɛkwɛɔ nii nɛɛ na nibii ni ba lɛ, amɛshimɔ amɛtsitsi ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee shīa.
Shi mɛi ni le lɛ fɛɛ kɛ yei ni nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛjɛ Galilea lɛ hu damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ nii nɛɛ.
Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef, ni ji akuashɔnyo; eji gbɔmɔ kpakpa kɛ jalɔ.
Ni ejɛ Arimatia, Yudafoi lɛ amaji lɛ eko nɔ, lɛ lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ amɛyiŋtoo kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ nɔ, ni eeekwɛ Nɔyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛ;
lɛ eyiŋ etee Pilato ŋɔɔ ni eyakpa lɛ fai eŋɔ Yesu gbnyo lɛ ehã lɛ.
Ni ejie lɛ kɛkpleke shi, ni eŋɔ klala ebla ehe, ni eyato lɛ yɛ gbonyobu ni akpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli ni atoko mɔ ko yɛ mli dæ lɛ mli.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ Hesaamɔkɛtoogbi ni, ni Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ miishɛ.
Ni yei lɛ ni kɛ Yesu jɛ Galilea ba lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ, amɛbakwɛ toohe lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ato lɛ gbonyo lɛ ahã.
Ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛyasaa tsofai-kɛ-ŋmai; ni hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛamɛfee kpooo yɛ kitã lɛ naa.
24: Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ leebi maŋkpa lɛ amɛba bu lɛ he, ni amɛhiɛ tsofaikɛŋmai ni amɛsaa amɛto lɛ kɛba.
Amɛna akɛ akoklo tɛ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa;
ni be ni amɛbote mli lɛ, amɛnaaa Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ. 4, Be ni amɛfee yaa yɛ enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, hii enyɔ badamɔ amɛmasɛi, ni amɛwo atadei kaŋkaŋi
Shi be ni amɛsheɔ gbeyei ni amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi lɛ, hii lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ gbohii ateŋ?
Ebɛ biɛ; ete shi! Nyɛkaia bɔ ni ekɛɛ nyɛ be ni eyɔɔ Galilea lolo lɛ,
akɛ, 'Ja aŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ; ni asɛŋ lɛ ni gbi ni nu etɛ̃ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.'"
Ni amɛkai ewiemɔi lɛ,
ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjkɛ bu lɛ naa, ni amɛyagba mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Maria ,Magdalena kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ yei ni eshwɛ ni fata amɛhe lɛ ji mɛi ni bagba bɔfoi lɛ nii nɛɛ.

Ni nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fee tamɔ kwashiaiasane yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛheee amɛyeee. 12.( Shi Petro te sh ni esha foi kɛtee bu lɛ he; ni be ni ekoto shi ekwɛ mli lɛ, enaaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja klala lɛ kɛkɛ. Ni ehe jɛi etee ewe, ni enaaa kpɛ ehe yɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ hewɔ.')
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ yiŋ kɛmiiya akrowa ko ni kɛ Yerusalem jekɛmɔ aaafe shitoi kpawo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Emao lɛ.
Ni amɛmiigbagbaa nibii ni eba nɛɛ fɛɛ he sane yɛ amɛteŋ.
Ni be ni amɛgbagbaa saji lɛ ni amɛtaoɔ mli lɛ, Yesu diɛŋtsɛ bakɛŋkɛ amɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ;
Shi aŋamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛkayoo lɛ.
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ saji nyɛgbaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?" Ni amɛea amɛdamɔ shi kɛ amɛhiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Ni ebi amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kleopa lɛ to e ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani okome pɛ ji gbɔ yɛ Yerusalem ni leee saji ni eba jɛi yɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ?"
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ saji ni?" NI amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nitsumɔ kɛ wiemɔ mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ lɛ he saji lɛ;
kɛ bɔ ni wɔsɔfofonukpai lɛ kɛ wɔmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ la hã ni abu lɛ gbele fɔ, ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ.
Shi wɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kulɛ ji mɔ ni baakpɔ̃ Israel lɛ; ni enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ŋmɛnɛ ji gbi etɛ̃ ni afee nii nɛɛ.
Shi asaŋ wɔteŋ yei komɛi hu hã wɔnaa kpɛ wɔhe, ejaakɛ amɛtee bu lɛ he mra mli,
ni be ni amɛbakɛɛ akɛ bɔfoi komɛi hu jie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ ehiɛ kã.
Ni Mɛi ni kɛ wɔ Yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi tee bu lɛ he, ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni yei lɛ kɛɛ mɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi lɛ ni amɛnaaa."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "O kwashiai ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛtsui mli kɛ nii fɛɛ ni gbalɔi lɛ gba lɛ hemɔkɛyeli.
Ani jeee sa esa akɛ Kristo lɛ ana nɛkɛ amanehului nɛɛ ni ebote enumnyam lɛ mli?"
Ni ebɔ̃i kɛjɛ Mose kɛ Gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, mni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nibii ni yɔɔ ŋmalɛi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ ehe lɛ ashishi .
Ni amɛbɛŋkɛ akrowa ni amɛyaa mli lɛ; ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni eeya ehiɛgbɛ.
Ni amɛnyɛ enɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Okɛ wɔ ahi shi, ejaakɛ je miina ni eshɛ hIɛnule etã." Ni etee mli ni ekɛ amɛ yahi shi.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ekɛ amɛ tra niyenii ahe lɛ, ekɔ aboloo lɛ ni eŋɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli ni ekɛhã amɛ;
Ni amɛte shi hyɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem, ni amɛbana mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ ni amɛbua amɛhe naa;
amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, "Eyɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ete shi, ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Simon,."
Ni amɛhu amɛgba nɔ nia ba yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛ kɛ bɔ ni fee amɛyoo lɛ yɛ abolookuumɔ mli lɛ.
Ni be nu amɛwieɔ nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Yesu diɛŋtsɛ badamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!"
Shi amɛhɛle shu ni amɛshe gbeyei, amɛsusu akɛ mumɔ ko amɛnaa lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ ak!, "Mɛɛba nyɛjijaa, ni mɛɛhewɔ hu ni ŋwanejee teɔ shi yɛ nyɛtsuji amli?
Nyɛkwɛa miniji kɛ minaji (ni nyɛaana akɛ) mi diɛŋtsɛ ni, nyɛtaaa mihe nyɛkwɛa; shi mumɔ bɛ heloo kɛ wui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛnaa akɛ miyɔɔ nɛɛ."
(Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ eniji kɛ enajitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.)
Shi be ni amɛheee amɛyeee lolo yɛ miishɛɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ efee amɛ yaa lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛye nɔ ko ni ayeɔ yɛ biɛ lo? "
Ni amɛhã lɛ loo kukui ni ashi,
ni ehe, ni eye yɛ amɛhiɛ.
