Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Enɛɛmɛi ji miwiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wie be ni mikɛ nyɛyɔɔ lolo lɛ, akɛ ja nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mose mla lɛ kɛ Gbalɔi lɛ kɛ lalai lɛ amli yɛ mihe lɛ na ba mli."
Kɛkɛ lɛ egble amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa, koni amɛna ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nɛkɛ aŋma , ni nɛkɛ esa kaɛ Kristo lɛ ana amanehulu ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ;
ni ashiɛ tsuitsakemɔ kɛ eshaifaa yɛ egbɛi lɛ mli atsɔ̃ɔ maji fɛɛ, ni abɔ̃i kɛjɛ Yertusalem.
Ni nyɛji nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ahe odasefoi.
Ni naa, miiha mi-Tsɛ shiwoo lɛ aba nyɛnɔ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛhiɛ shi yɛ Yerusalem maŋ lɛŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaajɛ ŋwɛi awo nyɛ hewalɛ."
Ni eŋɔ amɛ kɛje kpo kɛtee Betania masɛi, ni ehole eniji anɔ ni ejɔɔ amɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ajɔɔ amɛ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ gbla mli, ni awo lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi.
Ni amɛja lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalem kɛ miishɛɛ pii;
ni amɛyɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ daa nɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ kɛ lɛ jɔɔmɔ.

1: Gbalɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Maleaki nɔ koni ekɛhã Israelbii lɛ nɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, "Misumɔ nyɛ." Shi amɛto he akɛ, "Mɛni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ osumɔ wɔ?" Yehowa here amɛ nɔ akɛ, "Te Esau nyɛminuu ji Yakob; shi bɛ misumɔ Yakob kɛ eshwiei,
ni minyɛ Esau kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ. Mihã egbɛfaŋ gɔ̃ŋ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ, ni ashi jɛi, ni jɛi tsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe.?"

Kɛji Esau shwiei, ni ji Edombii, lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Akpãtã wɔhiɛ moŋ, shi wɔbaaku wɔsɛɛ kɛya ni wɔyasaa wɔtswa wɔtsui ni efee koikoi lɛ," no lɛ Yehoewa baato he akɛ, "Amɛbaanyɛ amɛsaa tsui lɛ amɛmamɔ nɛ, shi mi hu makumɔ tsui lɛ mashwie shi kɛyaashi mɛi aaatsɛ amɛ akɛ, "Maŋ gbonyo ni Yehowa mli efu amɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ.'"
Nyɛbaana nɔ ni baaba lɛ kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa da kɛteke Israel kɛ ehusui fɛɛ."

Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, miikɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, "Bi woɔ etsɛ, ni tsulɔ woɔ enuŋtsɔ. Kolɛ kɛji tsɛ ji mi lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ miwoo lɛ yɔɔ? Ni kɛji nuŋtsɔ hu ji mi lɛ nɛɛgbɛ gbeyei ni nyɛsheɔ mi yɔɔ? Nyɛgbeɔ migbɛi lɛ he guɔ; shi nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛgbeɔ ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ lɛ?'
Nyɛkɛ aboloo ni abule bashãa afɔle yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ. Agbɛnɛ hu nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ wɔhiɛ esɔɔɔ bo?' Nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, 'Nyɛnifeemɔ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛbuuu mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.'

Kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloi shwilafoi bashã afɔle lɛ aso ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo? Ni kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ bashã afɔle lɛ, no hu ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo? Kɛji omɔ nakai kooloo okɛyake amralo lɛ, ani eeena ohe tsuijurɔ, aloo eeekwɛ ohiɛ?"
No hewɔ lɛ osɔfoi, agbɛnɛ nyɛkpaa Naa Nyɔŋmɔ fai koni edrɔ wɔ. Ani nɛkɛ nikeenii ni jɛ nyɛdɛŋ nɛɛ baahã ekwɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ?

Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mina ni kulɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ŋamɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shinai lɛ koni nyɛkayashɛre la yakatswaa yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ. Minaaa nyɛhe miishɛɛ, ni mimɔŋ nikeenii ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi lɛ hu mli.

Kɛjɛ hulu shitee mli aahuu kɛyashi eshinyɔɔ mli lɛ, mɛi miikafo mi yɛ jeŋ majimaji amli. Ni aashãshãa tsofãkɛŋma aahã mi, ni akɛ nibii ni ahe tsetsee miishãshãa afɔle miihã mi, ejaakɛ migbɛi ehehe yɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbuleɔ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛji nyɛkɛɛ akɛ abule Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ momo, ni no hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ niyenii ni nyɛnyaŋeɔ baa bashãa afɔle yɛ nɔ lɛ.

Nɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ ji, 'Mɛɛ tɔlɛ po ji enɛ, ni nyɛshoɔ nyɛgugɔŋ nyɛwoɔ mi.' Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, 'Mɔ ko nii ni ayashɔ̃ akranaŋ naa, loo kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ nyɛkɛbahãa akɛ nyɛfɔle. Aso nyɛsusuɔ akɛ mamɔ nɛkɛ afɔle mli kɛ miishɛɛ lo?

Alomɔ shishiulɔ ni yɔɔ too nuu yɛ etoo ku mli, shi kɛji ewo shi lɛ, ekɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe moŋ bashãa efɔle ehãa Yehowa lɛ, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ji mi,' Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, 'Ni jeŋ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ sheɔ mi gbeyei.'
2: "Agbɛnɛ nyɛ, osɔfoi, kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛ.

Kɛji nyɛbooo wiemɔ nɛɛ toi ni nyɛkɛaato nyɛtsui mli, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ nyɛjeŋba awo migbɛi hiɛ nyam lɛ, no lɛ mibalomɔ nyɛ; mibalomɔ nibii ni ahãa nyɛ ni nyɛkɛkwɛɔ nyɛhe lɛ fɛɛ. Anɔkwale mli lɛ, milomo nibii nɛɛ momo ejaakɛ nyɛbuuu mikitã lɛ.
Naa, mibakã nyɛshwiei ahiɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛfɔleshãa kooloi lɛ awamɔ lɛ aaakpa nyɛhiɛ; ni aaaloo nyɛ kɛ wamɔ lɛ fɛɛ ayashwie tumu nɔ.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni nyɛkɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi mikɛ kitã nɛɛ tsu kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ; ni asaŋ koni kpãŋmɔ ni kã mi kɛ osɔfoi, ni ji Levi shwiei lɛ, ateŋ lɛ akaku mli," Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ.
"Mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ mli lɛ, miwo shi akɛ madro amɛ wala lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, ni mifee hu, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe mi gbeyei, ni amɛhiɛ hu asɔ migbɛi lɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nii ni ja, shi jeee nii ni ejaaa; ni amɛ kɛ mi hi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ jalɛ mli. Amɛfee nii ni ja, ni amɛkpale mɛi babaoo kɛje nɔsha he.
Ejaakɛ osɔfoi agbɛnaa nitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee krɔŋŋ lɛ. Ame amɛŋɔɔ esa akɛ mɛi aya koni amɛyakase mla lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ amɛji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ.
"Shi nyɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, nyɛgba afã kɛje gbɛ ni ja lɛ nɔ. Nyɛkɛ nyɛnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ehã mɛi babaoo etɔ̃ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ, Levi shwiei ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli." Yehowa kɛɛ.
"No hewɔ lɛ bei abɔ ni nyɛyeee mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkwɛɔ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ yɛ nyɛnifeemɔ mli lɛ, mibahã nyɛhe guɔ agbo yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ahiɛ."
Ani jeee tsɛ kome wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɔɔ lo? Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome ni bɔ wɔ lo? Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeee enyɛmi anɔkwa, ni wɔyeee kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Yuda yeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa, ni musubɔɔ nibii sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ efeɔ yɛ Isreal kɛ Yerusalem. Yuda ebule Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ. Yuda hii lɛ eyaŋɔŋɔɔ ŋamɛi ni jaa maŋsɛɛ wɔji.
Yehowa aaaplenee nuu fɛɛ nuu ni feɔ nɛkɛ nɔ ko yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, koni ekahã ena hegbɛ efata he dɔŋŋ kɛshã afɔlei ni maŋbii lɛ shãa hãa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ.

Asaŋ nɔ ni ji enyɔ hu ni nyɛfeɔ nɛ. Nyɛwoɔ yara ni nyɛdɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛyaafonu fɔɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfɔleshãa nibii lɛ esaaa Yehowa hiɛ dɔŋŋ aahuu po ni eeemɔ mli kɛ tsuijurɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.

Nyɛbiɔ nɔ hewɔ ni nibii baa lɛ nakai akɛ Yehowa mɔɔɔ nikeenii lɛ amli lɛ. Ejaakɛ be ni okɛ oblahiiaŋ ŋa lɛ kpãŋɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji nyɛdasefonyo. Owo oŋa lɛ shi akɛ obaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi onyɛɛɛ lɛ anɔkwa lɛ oye; tsɛbelɛ lɛji onaanyo kɛ oŋa fɛɛ yɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa.

Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ ji mɔ ni bɔ wala, asaŋ ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaa wala mumɔ lɛ yi ehã wɔ lɛ lo? Ni mɛni etaoɔ yɛ wɔdɛŋ mɔ? Eekwɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛbaafɔ bii ni baatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔkwale mli. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni shi ni nyɛwo nyɛblahiiaŋ ŋamɛi lɛ nyɛkaku mli kɛtsɔ̃ anɔkwa ni nyɛyeee nɔ.
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, "Miihi mligblamɔ. Miihi kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ye eŋa nɛkɛ sane. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni shi ni nyɛwo lɛ nyɛkakwaa."

"Nyɛhã etɔ Yehowa kɛ nyɛwiemɔi lɛ." Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, 'Mɛni wɔkɛhã etɔ lɛ?' Ejɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ lɛ, ehi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni Yehowa yɛ mɔ lɛ he tsui jurɔ, ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.' Ni nyɛbiɔ hu akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane lɛ yɔɔ?":
3: Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ koni ebasaa gbɛ lɛ eto mi. Kɛkɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ lɛ baaba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ trukaa. Kpãŋmɔ Bɔfo lɛ ni nyɛshwe lɛ aahuu lɛ aaashɛ shi."
Shi namɔ baanyɛ ekpee ebaa lɛ naa? Ni namɔ aaanyɛ shi adamɔ be ni eeebapue lɛ? Ejaakɛ etamɔ niiahetsuulɔ la loo niiahefɔlɔ samla.

Ebaata shi tamɔ jwiɛtɛi hetsuulɔ ni hãa jwiɛtɛi he tseɔ keŋkeŋ lɛ. Nakai ebaatsuu osɔfoi ni ji Levi shwiei lɛ ahe keŋkeŋ tamɔ atsuɔ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi he lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛkɛ afɔleshãa nikeenii ni kpa bɛ he aba abahã Yehowa.
No dani Yudabii kɛ Yerusalembii anikeenii ni amɛkɛbaahã Yehowa baasa ehiɛ tamɔ esa ehiɛ blema yɛ tsutsu afii lɛ amli lɛ.

Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibatsi mabɛŋkɛ nyɛ koni makojo gbɔmɛi abii; mikɛ sane baashi mɛi ni sheee mi gbeyei lɛ oya nɔŋŋ, ŋkunyaayelɔi kɛ gblãfitelɔi kɛ mɛi ni kãmɔɔ amale kita lɛ. Nakai nɔŋŋ maye odase mashi mɛi ni shishiuɔ apaafoi yɛ nyɔmɔwo mli kɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ yoo okulafo kɛ awusa kɛ gbɔ sane hiɛ buɔ shi lɛ.
"Yehowa ji mi, mitsakeee; ni no hewɔ ni nyɛ, Yakob shwiei, nyɛpleneeko kɛbashi benɛ nɛɛ lɛ.

Nyɛgba afã yɛ mikpɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ, tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu fee kɛjɛ blema lɛ, ni nyɛyeee amɛnɔ. Nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ, ni mi hu mibakpale kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ." Yehowa kɛɛ. "Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ wɔɔtsɔ̃ wɔkpale?'

Shi nɔ ni mibiɔ nyɛ ji akɛ, aso eja gbɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa ashishiu Nyɔŋmɔ lo? Dabida! Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi. Nyɛaabi akɛ, 'Yɛ mɛni mli?' Yɛ nibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ afɔlei ni nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ mli.
Naa, nyɛmiilomɔ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛ maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi.
Nyɛkɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ fɛɛ abaa nitoohe lɛ koni niyenii ahi miwe lɛ! Nyɛkɛ enɛ akaa mi nyɛkwɛa akɛ migbeleŋ ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni mifɔseŋ jɔɔmɔ mishwieŋ nyɛnɔ ni ateke nɔ lo?
Nyɛhewɔ lɛ mibatsi baalabii ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ anaa mahã nyɛ koni amɛkafite nyɛŋmɔshi nibii; ni nyɛwain tsei ni yɔɔ ŋanɔ lɛ baawo babaoo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ mli majimaji fɛɛ baabu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni ajɔɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaatsɔ̃ maŋ ni mii eshɛ ehe." Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwie wiemɔi ni naa wa yɛ mihe. Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, 'Mɛni mli wɔwieɔ wɔshiɔ bo yɛ?
Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Sɛɛnamɔ bɛ he akɛ asɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ. Kɛji wɔye egbee nɔ, aloo wɔnyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kwraa po tamɔ mɛi ni agbo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ mli?

Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa jeŋ moŋ ji akɛ mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe lɛ, amɛji mɛi ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ. Ni jeee shweremɔ kɛkɛ mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii shwereɔ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ kaa Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkwɛɔ, ni amɛjeɔ toigblamɔ mli sɔkee.'"

Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ kɛ amɛhe wie. Yehowa bo amɛ toi, ni enu nɔ ni amɛtao. Mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, ni asaŋ amɛjwɛŋɔ egbɛi lɛ hiɛnyamwoo he lɛ aŋmla amɛgbɛii awo wolo mli koni akɛkai amɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ mimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ krɛdɛɛ, gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii lɛ. Mikɛ amɛhe baake amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni tsɛ Ataa kɛ ebi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ he keɔ lɛ lɛ.
No dani nyɛbaana ekoŋŋ nɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ jalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ teŋ, kɛ srɔto ni yɔɔ mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi ni sɔ̃mɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ."
4: Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, gbi ko miiba; ni emli edɔ la tamɔ flɔnɔɔ. Eshishɛɛ lɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ able gbetselii; ebaashã amɛ bɔ ni eshwɛŋ ekoeko shishifã loo tso nine.
Shi nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ mi gbeyei lɛ, mihewalɛ lɛ baate shi tamɔ jalɛ hulu ahã nyɛ, ni eeetsa nyɛ. Nyɛaaje kpo kɛ nyamɔ kɛ tuumɔ tamɔ tsinabii ni agbele amɛ.
Gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaanaanaa mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛnajiashi ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ lamlu." Yehowa kɛɛ.
"Nyɛkaia nibii ni mitsulɔ Mose etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni ji mlai kɛ akpɔi kɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔi ni mikɛhã lɛ yɛ Horeb Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ akɛbahã Israelbii koni amɛye nɔ lɛ.
"Shi dani nakai Yehowa gbi wulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ baashɛ lɛ, mibatsu Gbalɔ Elia kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Ebaahã tsɛmɛi asumɔ amɛbii ekoŋŋ, ni bii hu aaasumɔ amɛtsɛmɛi ekoŋŋ, koni mikaba mibakpãtã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ hiɛ."

1: Yesu Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ , he Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee,
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ mli akɛ, "Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛmiitsɔ̃ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ.
MO ko miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ, nyɛjea etempɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ!"
No hewɔ lɛ Yohane bi ba ni ebaptisi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abptisi amɛ, koni akɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yudea Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalem lɛ tee eŋɔɔ. Amɛjaje amɛhe eshai, ni abaptisi amɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ mli.
Yohane lɛ yooma hetsɔi atade ewoɔ, ni wolokpãa ekɛfiɔ emliteŋ; ni eyeɔ baalabii kɛ ŋanɔ wo.
Eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi kɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni he wa fe mi; misaaa mɔ ni kotoɔ shi fɛneɔ etokotai anaa kpãa tete.
Mi lɛ, nu mikɛ baptisi nyɛ; shi lɛ lɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ekɛaabaptisinyɛ."
Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ eba mli akɛ Yesu jɛ Nazaret yɛ Galilea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba ni Yohane baptisi lɛ yɛ Yordan mli.
Yesu je kpo kɛjɛ nu lɛ mli nɔŋŋ pɛ kɛkɛ ni ena ni ŋwɛi naa miigble ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ miikpleke shi tamɔ okpo kɛmiiba enɔ.
Ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, "Boji misuɔmɔ Bi lɛ. Bo ohe tsui minaa!"
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Mumɔ lɛ kpla lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Eye gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ jɛi, ni Satan ka lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hi shi; ni ŋwɛ bɔfoi basɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni amɔ Yohane sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu tee Galilea ni eyashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ.
Ekɛɛ, "Be lɛ eshɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ enina nyɛ! Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui., ni nyɛhea Sanekpakpa lɛ nyɛyea."
Be ni Yesu nyiɛ Galilea ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ena Simon kɛ enyɛmi Andrea ni amɛmiihɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli ejaakɛ wolɛi ji amɛ.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛnayiɛa misɛɛ ni mafee nyɛ wolɛi ni baahɛ gbɔmɛi."
Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi amɛyai lɛ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni etee ehiɛ fioo lɛ, ena Yakobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Yohane ni amɛ hu amɛyɛ lɛlɛ mli amɛmiikpɛ amɛyai lɛ.
Amrɔ lɛ etsɛ amɛ, ni amɛshi amɛtsɛ Zebedeo kɛ apaafoi lɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Amɛbote maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kapernaum lɛ mli, ni be hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, Yesu tee kpeehe lɛ, ni eyatsɔ̃ɔɔ nii.
Amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, Ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ shi jeee tamɔ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, naa nuu ko yɛ kpeehe lɛ ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli. Ebo waa ekɛɛ,
"Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ o yɔɔ, Yesu Nazarenyo? Oba wɔhiɛ kpãtãmɔ? Mile mɔ ni ji o. Boji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!'
Yesu fã eyi ekɛɛ, "Bu onaa ni oje emli!"
Ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ hã eshɔ̃, ni eblɔ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni eje emli!
Mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ fɛɛ he jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, "Mɛni nɛ? Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hee ko nɛ! Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji po, ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ ehe sane gbɛ shwã Galilea fɛɛ.
Amɛje kpeehe lɛ nɔŋŋ pɛ ni amɛkɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane tee Simon kɛ Andrea we lɛ.
Simon shaayoo lɛ kã shi kɛ atridii, ni Yesu jɛishɛɛ pɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ.
Ete eŋɔɔ, emɔ enineshi, ni ewo enɔ, kɛkɛ ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ, ni ebɔ̃i amɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Gbɛkɛ be ni hulu enyɔ shi lɛ, akɛ helatsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ amɛmliu fɛɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Yesu tsa mɛi pii ni yeyeɔ helai srɔtɔi, ni efãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji pii. Eŋmɛɛɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ agbɛ ni amɛwie, ejaakɛ amɛle lɛ.
Maŋkɛ̃ mra be ni hiɛ gbleko lɛ, Yesu te shi ni eje kpo kɛtee ŋanɔ he ko, ni eyasɔle yɛ jɛi.
Shi Simon kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ tiu lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛyana lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo mɛi fɛɛ taoɔ nɛɛ."
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔyaa maji krokomɛi ni jwere wɔhewɔhewɔ nɛɛ amli, koni mayashiɛ yɛ jɛmɛi hu, ejaakɛ no hewɔ miba."
No hewɔ lɛ, eyashiɛ yɛ amɛkpeehei ni yɔɔ Galilea lɛ fɛɛ, ni efãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji hu.
Kpitiyelɔ ko ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni ebakula ehiɛ ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, "Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse."
Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekpã enine mli eta ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miisumɔ; ohe atse!"
Amrɔ lɛ kpiti lɛ tã yɛ ehe ni ehe tse.
Ni amrɔ lɛ ewo lɛ gbɛ ni etswa enaa ma ekɛɛ,
"Kwɛmɔ ni okakɛɛ mɔ ko nɔ ko; shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni oshã afɔle ni Mose eto lɛ yɛ ohetsuumɔ hewɔ, ni no afee odase ahã amɛ."
Shi lɛ lɛ, be ni eje kpo lɛ, ebɔ̃i sane lɛ shiɛmɔ. Enɛ hã sane lɛ gbɛ shwã bɔ ni Yesu nyɛɛɛ aje faŋŋ abote maŋ ko mli dɔŋŋ; shi ehi ŋa lɛ nɔ hei komɛi, ni mɛi jɛɔ he fɛɛ he baa eŋɔɔ.
2: Gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ Yesu ba Kapernaum ekoŋŋ, ni anu ehe akɛ eyɛ shīa.
Mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa bɔ ni anaaa gbɛ yɛ agbo lɛ naa tete. Be ni eshiɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ,
akɛ mɔ ko ni yeɔ kuumɔhela ni mɛi ejwɛ tre lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.
Shi akɛni mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ ashɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛyafã tsu ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ yiteŋ, ni amɛgbu flɔ ni amɛshi helatsɛ lɛ kɛ saa ni ekã nɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbayi shi.
Be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ekɛɛ helatsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bi, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa o!"
Shi mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi komɛi ni tra jɛi lɛ susu yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ,
"Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ nɛ wiemɔ wiemɔ ni tamɔ enɛ? Eebɔ musu! Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ eshai afa, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ?
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Yesu yoo yɛ emumɔ mli akɛ amɛmiisusu nɛkɛ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛsusuɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛtsuiiaŋ?
Te emli nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jraaa hu, akɛ,'Akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa o,' aloo 'Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ' lɛ?
Shi bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikPɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ"ekɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ,
"Miiikɛɛ o akɛ, Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni oya shīa."
Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi, ni ewo esaa lɛ ni eje kpo yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ. amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam amɛkɛɛ "Wɔnako enɛ eko dã!"
Ni yesu ji kpo ekoŋŋ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Asafo lɛ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Ni be ni ehoɔ lɛ, ena Levi ni ji Alfeo bi lɛ ni eta lɛ, ena Levi ni ji Alfeo bi lɛ ni eta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ shi enyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni Yesu ta niyenii ahe yɛ Levi shīa lɛ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi pii hu fata ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ahe ni ayeɔ nii lɛ ejaakɛ amɛyi fa, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Be ni Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ na akɛ Yesu kɛ eshafeelɔi kɛ toohelɔi nɛɛ miiye nii lɛ, amɛbi ekaselɔi yeɔ nii ni ekɛ amɛ nuɔ nɛɛ?"
Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ tsofãtsɛ he ehiaaa amɛ, shi mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ moŋ. Mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi eshafeelɔi moŋ."
Gbi ko be ni Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ hiɔ ŋmaa lɛ, mɛi komɛi ba Yesu ŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni Yohane kɛ Farisifoi lɛ akaselɔi lɛ hiɔ ŋmaa ni bo lɛ okaselɔi lɛ ehiii ŋmaa lɛ?"
Yesu to he ekɛɛ, "Ani ayɛmfrwu lɛ bialɔi lɛ aaanyɛ ŋmaa ahi be mli ni ayɛmfrowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ? Gbii abɔ ni ayɛmfrowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛŋ ŋmaa amɛhi.
Shi be aaaba ni aaaŋɔ ayemforowu lɛ kɛaajɛ amɛŋɔɔ; ni nakai gbi lɛ dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.
Mɔ ko kɛ mamanaa hee taaa atade momo; ejaakɛ, mamanaa hee lɛ ni akɛta lɛ tserɛɔ emomo lɛ, ni flɔ lɛ lɛɔ.
Asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ wain hee wooo wolotɔi memeji amli; ejaakɛ wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolotɔi lɛ, ni wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolotɔi lɛ aaafite; shi moŋ wain hee lɛ wolotɔi hei amli akɛwoɔ."
Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ Yesu yatsɔ̃ able ŋmɔji komɛi amli, ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ yaa lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i able lɛ kuumɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifo lɛ kɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "KWɛ, mɛɛba okaselɔi lɛ feɔ nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ nɛɛ?"
Yesu to he akɛ, "Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee gbi ko be ni efi lɛ ni hɔmɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ dã.
Bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ yɛ Osɔfonukpa Abiatar yinɔ ni eyaye aboloo ni akɛmãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni ehã mɛi ni ekɛnyie lɛ hu eko amɛye, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ ni eyeɔ akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?"
Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ hewɔ ato hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ, shi jeee hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ hewɔ abɔ gbɔmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ po nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ."
3: Ni Yesu tee kpeehe lɛ ekoŋŋ. Nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni enine kome egbo;
ni amɛsra lɛ akɛ eeetsa lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lo. koni amɛyaflɔ enaa.
Yesu kɛɛ mɔ ni nine egbo lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi ni obadamɔ wɔteŋ!"
Ni ebi mɛi lɛ akɛ, "Ani hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ lɛ eja akɛ afeɔ ekpakpa aloo afeɔ efɔŋ, akɛ ahereɔ gbɔmɔ yiwala aloo agbeɔ lɛ?" Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ.
Ni ekwɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛkpe kɛ mlifu, ejaakɛ edɔ lɛ akɛ amɛtsui wa nɛkɛ; ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, "Kpã onine lɛ mli!" Ekpa mli, ni atsa enine lɛ ni eye emuu.
Farisifoi lɛ je kpo, ni amrɔ lɛ amɛkɛ Herodebii lɛ tee eyinɔ apam bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ gbla amɛhe shi kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Mɛi pii ni jɛ Galilea kɛ Yudea
kɛ Yerusalem kɛ Idumea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yordan sɛɛ kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ fɛɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ. Nɛkɛ asafo yuu nɛɛ ba lɛ ahe.
Mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ hewɔ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛsaa lɛlɛ bibioo ko amɛhã lɛ koni asafo lɛ akamia lɛ.
Etsa mɛi pii hewɔ lɛ mɛi ni helai hiɛhiɛ amɛ fɛɛ bu kɛba eŋɔɔ koni amɛbatra ehe.
Ni be fɛɛ bi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ aaana lɛ lɛ, amɛhoɔ amɛgbeɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ni amɛblɔɔ akɛ, "Boji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ."
Ni etswa amɛnaa ma veveeve akɛ amɛkajie lɛ shi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Ni Yesu tee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni etsɛ mɛi ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etaoɔ lɛ, ni amɛba eŋɔɔ.
Ni ehala mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ koni amɛkɛ lɛ abahi shi ni etsu amɛ shiɛmɔ,
ko ni amɛna hewalɛ ni amɛfamɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji.
Mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni ehala lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Simon, mɔ ni ewo lɛ Petro lɛ,
Kɛ Yokobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ Yohane, enyɛmi lɛ, ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ Boaneges (eshishi ji nyɔŋmɔshimɔ bii);
kɛ Andea kɛ Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo kɛ Toma kɛ Yakobo, Alfea bi lɛ, kɛ Tadeo kɛ Simon, maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ,
kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Ni Yesu ba shīa. Mɛi babaoo naa bakpe shi ekoŋŋ bɔ ni lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ wooo niyeli po.
Be ni ewekumɛi nu he lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyamɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi miikɛɛ akɛ eyiŋ miikã lɛ.
Mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ni jɛ Yerusalem ba lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Beelzebul yɛ emli, mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji alumɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa efãmɔɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli akɛ, "Te Satan aaafee tɛŋŋ afã Satan hu?
Kɛji maŋtsɛyeli ko gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nyɛŋ shi adamɔ.
Ni kɛji shīa ko gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ,nakai shīa lɛ nyɛŋ shi adamɔ.
Ni kɛji Satan te shi wo lɛ diɛŋtsŋɛ ehe ni egba emli lɛ, enyɛŋ shi edamɔ, shi moŋ enaagbee ji no.
"Mɔ ko nyɛŋ hewalɔ ko we abote ni9 eyaha enii, akɛ ja efi hewalɔ lɛ dã kɛkɛ lɛ eeenyɛ ewe lɛ nii eha.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ faŋŋ akɛ, akɛ gbɔmɛi ahe eshai fɛɛ aaafa amɛ kɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ ni amɛwie hu;
shi mɔ ni bɔɔ musu eshiɔ Mumɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko kɛyashi ŋaanɔ shi moŋ eye fɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ."
Yesu wie enɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu nyɛ lɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba, ni amɛbadamɔ agbo lɛ naa, ni amɛtsu aba eŋɔɔ ni abatsɛ lɛ.
Asafo lɛ tra shi yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao o."
Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji minyɛ ni namɛi ji minyɛmimɛi lɛ?"
Ekwɛ mɛi ni tra ehe lɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ, "Naa, minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi nɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, lɛji minyɛminuu kɛ minyɛmiyoo kŋ minyɛ."
4: Yesu bɔ̃i nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ Galilea ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa yɛ ehe, no hewɔ lɛ, ebote lɛlɛ ko mli ni eyata shi. Lɛlɛ lɛ ma nu lɛ hiɛ, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ bua shi yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii pii yɛ abɛbuai amli; yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ ekɛɛ,
"Nyɛboa toi! Naa, nidulɔ ko yiŋ etee nidumɔ.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni eshwãa wui lɛ, ekomɛi yashwie gbɛ toi, ni loofɔji ba amɛbaklɔ.
Ekomɛi yashwie tɛsai anɔ he ni amɛnaaa su pii yɛ, ni mli kwɔ.
Shi be ni hulu je lɛ, eshã amɛ, ni akɛni amɛbɛ fã hewɔ lɛ amɛgbã, ni akɛni amɛbɛ fã hewɔ lɛ lɛ amɛglã.
Wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie ŋmei ateŋ, ni ŋmei lɛ kwɛ̃ kɛba ŋwɛi ni amɛgbe tsei lɛ, hewɔ lɛ amɛwooo yibii.
Shi wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛdra, ni amɛwo yibii: eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko oha."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, "Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, hã ni enu."
Be ni shwɛ Yesu kome lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ ehe lɛ kɛ kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ bi lɛ abɛ lɛ shishi.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he teemɔ sane lɛ ehã nyɛ,shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, abɛbuai amli akɛ amɛ wieɔ nii fɛɛ yɛ koni
'Na lɛ amɛna nɛ, shi amɛkayoo, ni nu lɛ amɛnu nɛ, shi amɛkana shishi; ni eba lɛ akɛ amɛkple ni akɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ afa amɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛnuuu abɛ nɛɛ shishi? Belɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni nyɛaanu abɛi lɛ fɛɛ shishiŋ?
Nidulɔ lɛ duɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Gbɛ toi bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ, shi amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Satan baa ebashraa wiemɔ ni adu yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ.
Tɛsaa shikpɔŋ nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛmɔɔ mli mra kɛ miishɛɛ;
shi amɛbɛ shishifã yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmli hewɔ lɛ be fioo kɛkɛ amɛhiɔ shi, ni kɛ amanehulu loo yiwala te shi yɛ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni ŋwei yɔɔ nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ;
shi je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔ kɛ ninamɔ he lakamɔ kɛ nii krokomɛi ahe akɔnɔ yaboteɔ amemli ni amɛgbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni ewooo yibii.
Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛmɔɔ mli, ni amɛwoɔ yibii, eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ hu ohã."
Ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, "An akɛ kane maa tsese loo saatso shishi? Ani jeee kanetso nɔ akɛmaa?
Nɔ ko bɛ ni babu nɔ ni agbleŋ nɔ, ni asaŋ nɔ ko bɛ ni akɛtee ni ajieŋ lɛ shi.
Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi ni ekɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu."
Ni esaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ he jogbaŋŋ! Nɔ susumɔ nɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, no akɛaasusu ahã nyɛ, ni aaafata he ahã nyɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahã lɛ eko afata he, shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahe fioo ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ."
Yesu tee nɔ ekɛɛ, "Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɔɔ nɛ, etamɔ nuu ko ni shwãa dumɔwui yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Eyawɔɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni eteɔ shi kɛji je tsɛre, ni no mli fɛɛ lɛ dumɔwui lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ, ni edaa, ni eleee bɔ ni feɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ woɔ yibii: jwɛifɔ lɛ tsutsu, kɛkɛ lɛ ŋmãatso lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ŋmãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ ŋmãatso yi.
Shi kɛ ŋmãa lɛ tsu lɛ, amrɔ lɛ ehãa akɛ nikpamɔ kakla lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ŋmãakpamɔbe lɛ eshɛ."
Yesu bi akɛ, "Mɛni he wɔkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaato? Aloo mɛɛ abɛ wɔɔbu yɛ he?
Etamɔ sinapi wu ni ji wu bibioo fe shikpɔŋ nɔ wui fɛɛ.
Shi kɛ adu lɛ, ekwɛ̃ɔ, ni edaa fe shwie bai fɛɛ. Egblaa niji kplei, bɔ ni ŋwɛi loofɔji aaanyɛ afee tsui yɛ ehɔɔŋ lɛ shishi."
Yesu tsɔ̃ abɛbuai pii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi anɔ eshiɛ wiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ amɛnu shishi9.
Ekɛ amɛ ewieee akɛ ja yɛ abɛbuai amli; shi kɛ shwɛ ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ sɔŋŋ lɛ, etɔ̃ɔ amɛ abɛi lɛ fɛɛ shishi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔfoa ŋshɔ lɛ kɛyaa esɛɛgbɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshi asafo lɛ ni amɛŋɔ lɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛtee; ni lɛji krokomɛi hu fata ehe.
Shi ahum kple ko batswa, ni ŋshɔkei kumɔ wo lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni eehe eyi.
Ni Yesu yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; etsɔle sune ni ewɔ. Ni kaselɔi lɛ tsīs lɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ni wɔhiɛ heɔ akpãtã nɛɛ, jeee ohe sane koŋ?"
Ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ yi, ni ekɛɛ ŋshɔ lɛ akɛ, "Bu onaa ni ofee diŋŋ!" Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ dɛmm.
Kɛkɛ ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛsheɔ gbeyei nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba ni nyɛbɛ hemɔkɛyeli?"
Amɛshe gbeyei naakpa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhew akɛ, "Namɔ po nɛ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ ŋshɔ tete boɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?"
5: Ni amɛba Gililea ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Gerasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yesu je lɛlɛ lɛ mli pɛ kɛkɛ ni nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli jɛ gbohii abui lɛ amli kɛ lɛ bakpe.
Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ, gbohii abui amli ehiɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ awo dɔŋŋ;
ejaakɛ awo lɛ gboklɛi kɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i shii abɔ, shi be fɛɛ be ni aaawo lɛ lɛ, etserɛɔ kɔ̃sɔŋkɔ̃0i lɛ ni ekumɔɔ gboklɛi lɛ,ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ ehe ajɔɔ.
Nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane eyɔɔ, ni eblɔɔ ni ekɛ tɛi flɔɔ ehe.
Shi be ni ena Yesu yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ejo foi kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakula shi yɛ ehiɛ;
ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, "Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ Bi, Mɛni sane mikɛ o yɔɔ? Mina Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ kaapiŋ mi!"
Ekɛɛ enɛ ejaakɛ Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Jee gbɔmɔ nɛɛ mli, bo mumɔ fɔŋ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, "Te ogbɛiŋ?" Nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Migbɛi ji Asafo, ejaakɛ wɔyi fa!"
Ni ekpa Yesu fai waa akɛ ekashwie amɛ kɛmiije jɛi niiaŋ.
Kplotoo ku kple ko yɛ jɛi amɛmiiye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ kpa Yesu fai amɛkɛɛ, "Hãa wɔya kplotoi lɛ ateŋ ni wɔyabote amɛmli."
Ni eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ. Mumɔi fɔɔji lɛ je nuu lɛ mli, ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli. Ni kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ aaafee akpei enyɔ wo foi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkpleke shi kɛyashwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni kplotookwɛlɔi lɛ jo foi, ni amɛyagba yɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli, ni mɛi lɛ je kpo amɛbakwɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ.
Amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbana nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji asafo hi emli lɛ ta shi ni ewo atade ni ehiɛ etserɛ lɛ; ni efee amɛ gbeyei.
Mɛi ni na lɛ gba amɛ nɔ ni ba nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji he emli lɛ nɔ kɛ kplotoi lɛ ahe sane lɛ.
Ni amɛbɔ̃i Yesu faikpawɔ akɛ eje amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ eya.
Be ni Yesu boteɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji hi emli lɛ kpa lɛ fai ni ehã ekɛ lɛ ahi shi.
Shi Yesu ekplɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ; moŋ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa owe kɛ owekumɛi aŋɔɔ ni oyagba amɛ nii ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ efee ehã o, kɛ mɔbɔ ni ena o lɛ!"
Ni nuu lɛ yiŋ etee, ni eyabɔ̃i nii ni Yesu efee ehã lɛ lɛ shiɛmɔ yɛ Dekapoli; ni efee amɛ fɛɛ naakpɛɛ.
Be ni Yesu kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ fo ŋshɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛba esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, mɛi pii babua ehe yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni kpeehe lɛ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yario lɛ ba, ni be ni ena Yesu lɛ, eho egbee enaji anaa,
Ni ekpa lɛ fai pii ekɛɛ, "Gbo mibiyoo fioo heɔ agbo nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ ba ni okɛ oniji abashwie enɔ koni ehe awa lɛ ni eyi ana wala!"
Ni Yesu kɛ lɛ tee. Mɛi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛmiififia lɛ.
Ni yoo ko ni eye láhoo hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ,
ni ena nɔ babaoo yɛ tsofãtsɛmɛi pii adɛŋ; efite edɛŋ nii fɔ̃ɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ enaaa he sɛɛ ko kwraa shi wu kɛkɛ moŋ hela lɛ woɔ lɛ,
be ni enu Yesu he lɛ, ebaje esɛɛgbɛ yɛ mɛi pii lɛ ateŋ, ni eta etade lɛ he;
ejaakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, "Kɛji mita etade lɛ po he kɛkɛ lɛ mihe aaawa mi."
Ni amrɔ lɛ elá ni hoɔ lɛ naa mɔ, ni enu he yɛ ehewojiaŋ akɛ atsa ehela lɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu yoo akɛ hewalɛ ko eje emli, ni etsɔ̃ ehe yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ ni ebi akɛ, "Namɔ ta mitade lɛ he lɛ?"
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ooona akɛ asafo lɛ miififia o, ni osaa obiɔ akɛ asafo lɛ miififia o, ni osaa obiɔ akɛ, 'Namɔ ta mihe lɛ?'"
Shi Yesu kwɛ ehe koni ena mɔ ni fee nakai lɛ.
Shi akɛni yoo lɛ le nɔ ni afee ahã lɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ bagbee ehiɛ, ni egba lɛ anɔkwale lɛ fɔ̃ɛ.
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Biyoo, ohemɔkɛyeli ehã ohe ewa o; yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni ohela lɛ ejɔ."
Be ni Yesu wieɔ lolo lɛ, kpeehe onukpa lɛ webii lɛ ekomɛi ba bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Obiyoo lɛ egbo; mɛɛba ogbaa Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ naa lolo?"
Shi be ni Yesu nu wiemɔ ni awie lɛ, ekɛɛ Yario akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei; he oye kɛkɛ!"
Ni ehãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko anyiɛ esɛɛ akɛ ja Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ, kɛkɛ.
Amɛba kpeehe onukpa lɛ we lɛ, ni Yesu bana hoofeemɔ kɛ mɛi ni foɔ ni amɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ babaoo lɛ.
Ni ebote shīa lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ hoo ni nyɛfoɔ nɛkɛ? Gbɛkɛ lɛ gboko; wɔ ewɔɔ!"
Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ. Shi lɛ lɛ eshwie mɛi lɛ fɔ̃ɛ kɛje kpo, ni eŋɔ gbɛkɛ lɛ tsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata lɛ Yesu lɛ he lɛ kɛtee he ni gbekɛ lɛ kã lɛ.
Ni emɔ enine shi ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Talitakuumi!" Eshishi ji, "Gbekɛyoo, miikɛɛ o akɛ, tee shi!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ te shi ni ebɔ̃i shishramɔ; eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Ni mɛi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa;
shi Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma veveeve akɛ amɛkahã mɔ ko le enɛ; ni efã akɛ ahã gbelɛ lɛ nɔ ko ni eye.
6: Yesu je jɛi eyiŋ etee emaŋ lɛ mli, ni ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.

Ni be ni shɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ ebɔ̃i nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ yɛ kpeehe lɛ; ni mɛi pii ni nu lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛba akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ mɔnɛ yana nii nɛɛ kɛjɛ?Mɛɛ nilee akɛhã lɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ enine nɔ atsuɔ nɛkɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi nɛɛ?
Ani jeee ŋaalɔ lɛ nɛ, Maria bi lɛ, kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yose kɛ Yuda kɛ Simon nyɛminuu lɛ, ni jeee enyɛmimɛiyei hu kɛ wɔ yɔɔ biɛ lɛ?" Ni ehe sane lɛ hã amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Akpaaa gbalɔ woo akɛ ja yɛ emaŋ kɛ ewekumɛi ateŋ kɛ ewe kɛkɛ."
Ni enyɛɛɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔ ko etsu yɛ Nazaret, fe akɛ ekɛ eniji ŋmlɛ helatsɛmɛi fioo ko nɔ ni etsa amɛ.
Ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ he ni ameheee amɛyeee lɛ hewɔ. Ni eyakpa akrowai lɛ amli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Ni Yesu tsɛ kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ebɔ̃i amɛ tsumɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni ehã amɛ hewalɛ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃0ji lɛ anɔ.
Ni ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ amɛkahiɛ nɔ ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, akɛ ja tso kɛkɛ; amɛkahiɛ aboloo loo kotoku loo shika yɛ amɛhɛfiinii amli;
shi amɛwo tokotai, ni amɛkawo flakai enyɔ.
Esaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "He fɛɛ he ni nyɛaabote shīa ko yɛ lɛ,nyɛhia jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaje jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaje jɛi.
He fɛɛ he ni mɛi lɛ heree nyɛ ni amɛbooo nyɛ toi yɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije jɛi lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnane shi mlu nyɛshwiea shi nyɛkɛyea odase nyɛshia amɛ."
Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyashiɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui.
Ni amɛfãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji pii ni amɛfɔfɔɔ helatsɛmɛi pii amu ni amɛtsa amɛ.
Ni maŋtsɛ Herode nu he, ejaakɛ Yesu gbɛi ehehe, Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ, "Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, no hewɔ ni hewalɛ nɛɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ emli nɛɛ."
Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, "Elia ni;' shi mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ, "Gbalɔ ni tamɔ blema gbalɔi lɛ eko."
Be ni Herode nu lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Yohane ni mifo eyi lɛ, lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ nɛɛ!"

Ekɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ Herode lɛ etsu ayamɔ Yohane, ni efi lɛ ni ekɛ etsu ayamɔ Yohane, ni efi lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ ewo tsuŋ. Efee enɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ lɛ ewo tsuŋ. Efee enɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ Herodia, enyɛmi Filipo ŋa lɛ, efee eŋa;
ni Yehowa kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ejaaa gbɛ akɛ okɛ onyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ feɔ oŋa."
Hewɔ lɛ Herodia bɛ Yohane wo emli, ni eetao lɛ egbe; shi enyɛɛɛ,'
ejaakɛ Herode miishe Yohane gbeyei, akɛni ele akɛ jalɔ kɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ lɛ, ni eto lɛ shweshweeshwe. Kɛ ebo ewiemɔ toi lɛ, ehe jraa lɛ pii, shi kɛ̃lɛ esumɔɔ akɛ ebo lɛ toi.
Ni gbi ni sa lɛ bashɛ, be ni Herode yeɔ efɔmɔ gbijurɔ ni eŋmɛ ebladei kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ Galilea onukpai lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ:
Herodia biyoo ba ebajo, ni esa Herode kɛ mɛi ni kɛ tra okplɔ̃ lɛ he ahiɛ. Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ gbekɛyoo lɛ akɛ, "Bi mi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ, ni mahã o!"
Ni ekã lɛ kita akɛ, "Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi mi lɛ mahã o, kɛji mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ fã tete po lɛ!"
Ni gbekɛyoo lɛ je kpo yabi enyɛ akɛ, "Mɛni mibi? ni ekɛɛ, "Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso."
Ni amrɔ lɛ eba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ oya ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miitao ni okɛ Yohane Bapitisilɔ lɛ yitso ahã mi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ kã mli."
Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ naakpa; shi ekitã lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tra niyenii lɛ ashi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ akɛ ekãmaa lɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ amŋtsɛ lɛ tsu oblafo, ni efã lɛ akɛ ekɛ Yohane yitso aba.
No etee eyafo eyi yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni ekɛŋmɛ kã mli kɛba ekɛyahã enyɛ.
Ni be ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛba amɛbawo egbonyo lɛ amɛyafu.
Bɔfoi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba lɛ nii ni amɛyafee kɛ nii ni amɛyatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ sɔŋŋ nyɛbaa ni wɔtea ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee ni nyɛyajɔa nyɛhe fioo." Ejaakɛ mɛi ni baa yaa lɛ fa tsɔ̃ ni amɛnaaa dekã kɛye nii tete.
Ni amɛtsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee.
Ni asafoi lɛ na amɛ; ni amɛjɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ mli amɛjo foi kɛtsɔ̃ shikPɔŋ kɛtee jɛi, ni amɛho amɛnaaa.
Be ni Yesu kpleke lɛ, ena asafo kple, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ, ena asafo kple, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ; ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nibii pii tsɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Ni be ni je bɔ̃i namɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "ŋa nɔ jo biɛ, ni je hu miina;
wo mɛi lɛ agbɛ koni amɛya akrowai kɛ maji ni jwerewɔhewɔ nɛɛ amli ni amɛyahe nii amɛye."
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nɔ ko amɛyea." Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Ani wɔya wɔyahe aboloo denarioi ohai enyɔ wɔkɛhã amɛ amɛye?"
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ? Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakwɛa." Be ni amɛyakwɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ."
Ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ atra shi kuikui, ohahai yɛ jwɛifɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛtra shi kuikui, ohiahai kɛ nyɔmai nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔi.
Ni Yesu klɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ nɔ. Ekumɔ aboloi lɛ, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛmamɔ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ. Eja loi enyɔ lɛ hu ehã amɛ fɛɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛye ni amɛtrɔ.
Ni amɛhala aboloo fufuji kɛ loo fufuji lɛ amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Ni mɛi ni ye aboloo lɛ ayibɔ ji hii akpei enumɔ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu tsirɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ayisɛɛ ni amɛya betsaida, kɛyashi Beyinɔ ni eeewo asafo lɛ gbɛ.
Ni be ni ewo amɛ gbɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyasle.
Be ni je na lɛ, lɛlɛ lɛ eshɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ, ni Yesu kome yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Ena akɛ wirimɔ lɛ miitɔ kaselɔi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛmiikpee kɔɔyɔɔ; ni maŋ kɛ hima, aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ loo nɔ mli lɛ, enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba amɛŋɔɔ, ni eetao eho amɛhe.
Be ni amɛna lɛ ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ sisa ni, ni amɛblɔ,
ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛna lɛ, ni amɛtsui fa. Ni amrɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛmli; mi ni nyɛkashea gbeyei!"
Ni eba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa. Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa.
Ejaakɛ amɛyooko nɔ ni aboloo sane lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ sɛɛ; amɛjwɛŋmɔ kpleee he.
Ni be ni amɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ. amɛba Genesaret shikPɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakpleke.
Ni be ni amɛje lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mɛi lɛ yoo Yesu,
ni amɛbɔ̃i mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ aholemɔ yɛ sai anɔ kɛ eŋɔɔbaa yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛnu akɛ eyɔɔ.

Ni he fɛɛ he ni ebote akrowai loo maji loo ŋmɔji amli yɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ helatsɛmɛi bashwieɔ blohuiaŋ, ni amɛkpaa lɛ fai koni ehã amɛna etade naamuu lɛ kɛkɛ he amɛtra; ni mɛi abɔ ni tra he lɛ, amɛhe wa amɛ.
7: Agbɛnɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni jɛ Yerusalem ba lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Amɛna akɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi yeɔ nii kɛ dɛ̃ ni abule, ni ji dɛ̃ ni afɔko.
Ejaakɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ja amɛkɛ nu efɔ amɛfeɔ enɛ amɛkɛyeɔ onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ni kɛ amɛjɛ jramɔ amɛba lɛ, ja amɛju amɛhe dani amɛyeɔ nii. Ni nibii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni ato ahã amɛ ni amɛfeɔ yɛ kpui kɛ gbɛi kɛ ayawai amlifɔmɔ kɛ saatsei ahefɔmɔ he.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ bi Yesu akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ okaselɔi lɛ yeee onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ ni amɛfɔɔɔ amɛdɛ dani amɛyeɔ nii nɛɛ?"
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ Yesaia gba yɛ nyɛ osatofoi nɛɛ ahe tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, 'Maŋ nɛɛ, amɛnaabui amɛkɛwoɔ mi; shi amɛtsui etsi ehe kɛje mihe kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Shi yakatswaa amɛjaa mi lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni ji gbɔmɛi akitãi.'
"Nyŋmɔ kitã lɛ, nyɛshi, ni gbɔmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anɔ nyɛyeɔ."
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ akɛ nyɛkwa Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ koni nyɛye nyŋɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ!
Ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ, 'Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ', kɛ 'Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!;
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ akɛ, 'Nɔ ni kulɛ ooona yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, "Korban" (nɔ ni akɛke Nyɔŋmɔ) ni' lɛ,
belɛ nyɛhãaa efee nɔ ko ehã etsɛ loo enyɛ dɔŋŋ;
ni nyɛkɛ nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ egu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ. ni nyɛfeɔ nibii pii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi."
Ni Yesu tsɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfɛɛ nyɛboa mi toi ni nyɛnua shishi!
Nɔ ko bɛ ni jɛɔ kponɔgbɛ boteɔ gbɔmɔ mli ni aaanyɛ lɛ abule, shi nɔ ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ ji nɔ ni jɛɔ emli lɛ.
(Kɛ mɔ ko yɛŋ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu.")
Ni be ni eje asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ eba shīa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ abɛ lɛ shishi.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani nɛkɛ nyɛ hu nyɛnaaa nii ashishi? Nyɛnaaa akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛɔ kponɔgbɛ boteɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ abule,
ejaakɛ jeee etsui mli eboteɔ shi emusuŋ eyaa, ni eyajeɔ kpo yɛ tiafi mli?"(Yesu kɛɛ enŋ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ŋmaa fɛɛ ŋmaa he tsa.)
Ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni jɛɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, no nɔŋŋ buleɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mligbɛ ni ji gbɔmɛi atsuii amli lɛ, jɛi jwɛŋmɔi fɔ̃ɔji jɛɔ: ajwamaŋbɔɔ, juu, awuyeli,
gblãfitemɔ, hiɛjoomɔ, yiŋsha, shishiumɔ, nyeyeŋtswibɔɔ, hiŋmɛisha, oshekuyeli, hewoo, kwashiaiasaneyeli.
Nii fɔ̃ɔji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, mligbɛ amɛjɛɔ ni amɛbule_ gbɔmɔ."
Ni Yesu je jɛi, ni eyiŋ etee Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ. Eyabote shīa ko, ni esumɔɔ akɛ aleɔ, shi enyɛɛɛ ehe eytee.
Ejaakɛ ejɛishɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni yoo ko ni mumɔfɔŋ yɔɔ ebiyoo fioo mli nu ehe ni eba ebakula shi yɛ enaji anaa.
Shi yoo lɛ jeŋmajiaŋ yoo ji lɛ, ni he ni he ni ejɛ ji Foinike ni yɔɔ Siria lɛ. Ebakpa Yesu fai ni efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ ebiyoo lɛ mli.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã bii lɛ atrɔ fɛɛdã; ejaakɛ akɛ aŋɔɔ bii aboloo lɛ ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ gbeebii."
Shi yoo lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ mli moŋ, shi bɛ gbeebii ni yɔɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi lɛ hu yeɔ bii lɛ afufuji lɛ eko!"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Owiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, yaa! Mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ eje obi lɛ mli."
Yoo lɛ yiŋ etee eshīa ni eyana ebiyoo lɛ kã saa nɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ eje emli.
Yesu ku esɛɛ ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ Tiro niiaŋ kɛfoŋ yɛ Sidon ni etsɔ̃ Dekapoli kpokpai lɛ anɔ kɛba Galilea ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni akɛ mɔ ko ni muɔ toi ni mumui hu ji lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai koni ekɛ enine aŋmɛ enɔ.
Ni Yesu kɛ lɛ ja asafo lɛ teŋ kɛtee afã, ni ekɛ ewabii wo etobii amli, ni etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ekɛsa elilɛi he.
Ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ehuu yɛ emli ni ekɛɛ mumui toimulɔ lɛ akɛ, "Hefata!" Eshishi ji, "Gblemɔ"
Ni amrɔ lɛ etoii lɛ gble, ni elilɛi kpãa lɛ fɛne, ni ewie faŋŋ.
Ni Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko; shi babaoo ni amɛjajeɔ ji no.
Ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Efee nii fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ! Ehãa toimulɔi nuɔ nii, ni mumuii hu wieɔ."
8: Nakai bei lɛ amli, be ni mɛi pii ebabua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ ni amɛnaaa nɔ ko amɛye lɛ, Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ asafo lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ mi ehi shi gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛbaaye.
Ni kɛji mihã amɛkɛ amɛmusuŋ hɔmɔ yiŋ kɛmiiya amɛwe lɛ, amɛaayatɔ biti yɛ gbɛteŋ ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ajɛɛhe jekɛ."
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ aaanyɛ ana aboloo yɛ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ ni aaashɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi anaa?"
Ebi amɛ akɛ, "Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?" Ni amɛkɛɛ,"Kpawo."
Ni efa asafo lɛ akɛ amɛtra shikpɔŋ. Kɛkɛ ni eklɔ aboloi kpawo lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli ekɛhã kaselɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛmamɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ; ni amɛkɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ.
Amɛyɛ loi bibii fioo hu, ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni efã akɛ akɛ no hu amamɔ amɛhiɛ.
Ni amɛye ni amɛtrɔ, ni amɛhala fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ flɔtɔi kpawo obɔ̃bɔ̃.
shi mɛi ni ye lɛ aaafee mɛi akpei-ejwɛ. Ni ewo amɛ gbɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ bote lɛlɛ mli, ni eba Dalmanuta niiaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ ba ni amɛkɛ lɛ babɔi ŋwanejee. Amɛmiitao ŋwɛi okadi yɛ edɛŋ, kɛmiika lɛ.
Ni edomɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ emumɔ mli ekɛɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ taoɔ okadi? Miikɛɛ nyɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ taoɔ okadi? Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, kɛ aaahã yinɔbii nɛɛ okadi ko fii!"
Ni eshi amɛ, ni eyabote lɛlɛ mli ekoŋŋ ni etee faa lɛ sɛɛ.
Shi amɛhiɛ ekpa nɔ ni amɛŋɔ aboloo akwaabɔi amɛkɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ, amɛhiɛɛɛ eko yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, akɛ ja ekome pɛ kɛkɛ,
Yesu bɔ amɛn kɔkɔ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi lɛ amasha kɛ Herode masha lɛ he!"
Ni amɛtao naa yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Benɛ aboloo ni wɔhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ."
Ni be ni Yesu na le lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛsusuɔ akɛ aboloo ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ? Ani nyɛyooko sɛɛ ni asaŋ nyɛnako nii eŋa?
Nyɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, ni nyɛnaaa nii? Nyɛyɛ toii hu, ni nyɛnuuu nii? Ni nyɛkaiii?
Be ni mikumɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ amli miha mɛi akpei enumɔ lɛ, fufuji kafui enyiɛ nyɛhole?" Amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ enyɔ."
"Ni be ni mikumɔ kpawo lɛ mli mihã mɛi akpei ejwɛ lɛ, fufuji flɔtɔi enyiɛ nyɛhole?" Amɛkɛɛ, "Kpawo."
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛnaaa nii anaa lolo nɛɛ?"
Amɛba Betsaida, ni mɛi komɛi kɛ shwilafo ko ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkpa lɛ fai koni eta ehe.
Ni emɔ shwilafo lɛ nineshi ni ekɛ lɛ je akrowa lɛ, ni etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie ehiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Ani oona nii lo?"
Nuu lɛ wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Miina gbɔmɛi, shi amɛtamɔ tsei ni miinyiɛ."
No sɛɛ lɛ esaa ekɛ eniji shwie shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ; agbɛnɛ shwilafo lɛ kwɛ nii hãa, ni atsa lɛ, ni ena nii fɛɛ faŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jie lɛ gbɛ ni eya eshīa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaaya akrowa lɛ mli tete!"
Ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee maji ni yɔɔ Kaisarea Filipi lɛ amli. Ebi amɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Namɔ mɛi kɛɔ akɛ miji?"
Amɛto he akɛ, "Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ; ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia; ni mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji o."
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ miji" Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Boji kristo lɛ!"
Ni Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko ehe sane.
Ni ebɔ̃i amɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ, "Ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ na amanehulu pii, ni onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ekwa lɛ, ni agbe lɛ ni gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ."
Ewie wiemɔ nɛɛ faŋŋ. Enɛ hã Petro kɛ lɛ tee afã, ni ebɔ̃i ehiɛ kãmɔ.
Shi etsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ekwɛ ekaselɔi lɛ, ekã Petro hiɛ ekɛɛ, "Jee mihiɛ, Satan, ejaakɛ osusuuu Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahe, shi gbɔmɛi anibii ahe moŋ ojwɛŋɔ!"
Agbɛnɛ etsɛ asafo lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ hu kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ eba esusuma yi lɛ , eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa, kɛji enine shɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni elaaje lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma lɛ?
Aloo mɛni gbɔmɔ aaahã ni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma?

Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi kɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ahe feɔ lɛ hiɛgble yɛ yinɔbii gblãfitelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi nɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ hu ehe aaafee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛgble be ni eeeba yɛ e-Tsɛ anumnyam lɛ mli kɛ bɔfoi Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
9: Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ akɛ eeba yɛ hewalɛ mli."
Gbii ekpaa sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, ni ekɛ amɛ kɛkɛ tee gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ yɛ afã banee. Ni egbɔmɔtso su tsake yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ni etade lɛ kpɛ ni eyɛ futafuta bɔ ni niiahefɔlɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni aaanyɛ ahã eyɛ nakai.
Ni Elia kɛ Mose jie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ Yesu miiwie.
Ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ehɛ̃, onɔ ekome, kɛ Mose nɔ ekome, kɛ Elia nɔ ekome."
Shi eleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ ejaakɛ amɛjijaa.
Ni atade lɛ mli kɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ ji misumɔ Bi lɛ mli kɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi lɛ, nyɛboa lɛ toi!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ, be ni amɛkwɛkwɛɛ amɛhe kɛkpe lɛ, amɛnaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ akɛ ja Yesu pɛ kɛ amɛ kɛkɛ.
Ni be amɛkplekeɔ gɔŋ lɛ, Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkagbaa mɔ ko nii ni nyɛna lɛ, ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ dã."
Amɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ to amɛyiŋ, shi amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, "Te shitee kɛ gbohii ateŋjɛɛ nɛɛ shishiŋ?"
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Te tɛŋŋ ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ ja Elia eba dã lɛ?"
Eto he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Elia baaba dã lɛɛlɛŋ ni ebato nibii ni aŋma yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ he akɛ eeena amanehulu pii, ni aaaŋɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni abuuu lɛ lɛ?
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ Elia eba momo, ni amɛfee lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ."
Be ni amɛbashɛ kaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛna mɛi pii ni bua amɛhe kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ni amɛmiibibii amɛhe nii.
Amrɔ ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na Yesu lɛ, efee amɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛsha foi kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbafla lɛ.
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛbibiɔ amɛ lɛ?"
Ni mɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, mikɛ mibi nuu ni mumɔ ni ewieee yɔɔ emli ba oŋɔɔ.
He fɛɛ he ni eeemɔ lɛ yɛ, etsiɔ lɛ etswaa shi ni enaa kwɛ̃ɔ afui, ni ekpeɔ enyanyɔji ashishi ni eetã loo. Mikɛɛ okaselɔi lɛ ni amɛfã lɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ."
Yesu to he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ao, yinɔbii ni heee yeeee! Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mi kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kɛyashi? Mɛɛ beyinɔ mato mistui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi? Nyɛkɛ gbekɛ nuu lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ."
Ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba eŋɔɔ. ni be ni mumɔ lɛ na Yesu lɛ, amrɔ lɛ ehã gbekɛ lɛ shɔ̃ kwekweekwe, ni egbee shi, ni ekoklo shi ,ni enaa jwɔ̃ afui.
Yesu bi etsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ enɛ bɔ̃i lɛ feemɔ?" Ni eto he ekɛɛ, "Kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi .
Kpitiokpitio eshɛɔ lɛ efɔ̃ɔ la mli kɛ nui amli koni ekpãtã ehiɛ. shi kɛji ooonyɛ he nɔ ko ofee lɛ, omusuŋ atsɔ̃ o yɛ wɔhe ni ofee he eko ohã wɔ!"
Yesu kɛɛ afee nii fiaa ahã mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ lɛ bo ekɛɛ, "Miihe miiye; ye obua mihemɔkɛyeli ni mibɛ lɛ!"
Shi be ni Yesu na akɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ foi kɛmiiba eŋɔɔ lɛ, efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yi ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo mumɔ mumui kɛ toimulɔ, miifã o akɛ, 'Jee emli, ni kaabote emli dɔŋŋ.'"
Ni mumɔ lɛ blɔ, ni ehã gbekɛ lɛ shɔ̃ kwekweekwe, ni eje emli; ni gbekɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbonyo bɔ ni mɛi pii kɛɛ akɛ egbo.
Shi Yesu mɔ enineshi ni ewo enɔ, ni ete shi edamɔ shi.
Be ni Yesu ba shīa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ yɛ afã akɛ, "Mɛɛba wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ mumɔ lɛ wɔfã lɛ?"
Ni ekŋŋ amɛ akɛ, "Nɛkɛ henɔ nɛɛ, anyɛɛɛ lɛ afã yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko naa, akɛ ja yɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ naa pɛ kɛkɛ."
Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ jie ni amɛyatsɔ̃ Galilea, ni eumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mɔ ko ale;
ejaakɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ anii; ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛ adɛŋ ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni kɛ agbe lɛ lɛ, eeete shi yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ."
Shi amɛnaaa nakai wiemɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei hu akɛ amɛaabi lɛ.
Ni amɛba Kapernaum. Ni be ni eyɔɔ shīa lɛ, ebi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni he nyɛwieɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?"
Shi amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ; ejaakɛ be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtaa naa yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ.
Yesu ho eta shi ni etsɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko miitao klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe mɛi fɛɛ sɛɛkpelɔ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ."
Ni eŋɔ gbekɛ bibioo ko ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛteŋ, ni eloo lɛ atuu, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛbii ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɔ kome yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, jeee mi ehereɔ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ!"
Yohane kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, wɔna mɔ ko ni kɛ ogbɛi miifã mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji, ni wɔtsi lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ wɔ enyiɛɛɛ osɛɛ"
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, "Nyɛkatsia lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni ekɛ migbɛi aaatsu hewalɛ nitsumɔ ko ni eeenyɛ mihe efɔŋ ewie oya.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo wɔ lɛ, eyɛ wɔgbɛfaŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahã nyɛ nu kpulu kome nyɛnu yɛ migbɛi mli akɛ Kristo webii lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ enyɔmɔwo eŋmɛŋ lɛ."
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ mɛi bibii nɛɛ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nane lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni ayashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ.
Kɛ onine miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ foo; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ nine kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni okɛ niji enyɔ aaatee gehena (Abonsamiiaje) yɛ la ni gbooo lɛ mli,
(he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo lɛ mli,ni amɛla lɛ hu gbooo yɛ lɛ)
Ni kɛ onane miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ nane kome bote wala mle fe nɔ ni ohiɛ naji enyɔ ni aaashɛ pfɔ̃ abonsamiiaje yɛ la ni gbooo lɛ mli,
(he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo, ni amɛla hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.)
Ni kɛ ohiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, fãa oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ hiŋmɛi kome bote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli fe nɔ ni ohiɛ hiŋmɛii enyɔ ni aaashɛ o afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje la lɛ mli,
he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo ni amɛla lɛ hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.
"Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ lɛ akɛ la aaawo lɛ ŋoo.
Nɔ kpakpa ji ŋoo; shu kɛji ŋoo dɔŋŋ? Nyɛhãa ŋoo ahīa nyɛmli, ni nyɛhia shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli yɛ nyɛteŋ."
10: Ni Yesu je jɛi ni eyiŋ etee Yudea niiaŋ kɛ Yordan sɛɛgbɛ. Ni mɛi pii babua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ ehe, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, "Ani nuu yɛ hegbɛ akɛ eshwieɔ eŋa? Amɛbi enɛ kɛmiika lɛ.
Shi ehere nɔ ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ kitã Mose wo nyɛ?"
Amɛkɛɛ,"Mose hã hegbɛ akɛ aŋma shwiemɔ wolo ni ashwie lɛ."
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsuiwalɛ hewɔ eŋma kitã nɛɛ ehã nyɛ;
shi kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ shishijee lɛ mli lɛ,, nuu kɛ yoo Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ amɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he;
ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome; belɛ agbɛnɛ amɛjeee mɛi enyɔ dɔŋŋ, shi heloo kome.
No hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsa lɛ, gbɔmɔ akagbla mli."
Ni be ni amɛshɛ shīa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ nakai sane lɛ nɔŋŋ ekoŋŋ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni eyaŋɔɔ mɔ kroko lɛ, efite gblã.
Ni kɛji yoo shwie ewu ni eyagbã mɔ kroko lɛ efite gblã."
Ni mɛi komɛi kɛ gbekɛbii bibii ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ko ni etra amɛhe; shi ekaselɔi lɛ fãmɔ mɛi lɛ.
Shi be ni Yesu na lɛ, emli fu,, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ fɛɛ mɔ ni heee Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ gbekɛ bibioo lɛ, eboteŋ mli kwraa."
Ni eloo amɛ atuu, ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ.
Ni be ni eje kpo ni eyi gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko hiɛ faoi kɛbanina lɛ ni ebakula ehiɛ foi kɛbanina lɛ ni ebakula ehiɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?"
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba otsɛɔ mi mɔ kpakpa? Mɔ kpakpa ko bɛ akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ .
Te ole kitãi lɛ, 'Kaagber gbɔmɔ, kaafite gblã, kaaju, kaaye amale odase, kaashishiu mɔ, wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ!'"
Shi nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, miye enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ nɔ kɛjɛ miblahiiaŋ."
Ni Yesu kwɛ lɛ ni etsui mɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Eshwɛ o nɔ kome: Yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ ni okɛhã ohiɛfoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba ni obanyiɛ misɛɛ."
Shi nuu lɛ hiɛ tsake yɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ, ni eyiŋ etee kɛ dɔlɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Ni Yesu kwɛ ehewɔ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛna bɔ ni ewa hã niiatsɛmɛi akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!"
Kaselɔi lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ahe. Shi Yesu here nɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Bi. te nyŋna bɔ ni ewa hã mɛi ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfdɔ̃ɔ nii anɔ lɛ amɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!
Ejraaa hãaa yoma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli tamɔ bɔ ni ejraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ."
Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa, ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, "Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ"
Yesu kwɛ amɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Gbɔmɛi agbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛŋ afee, shi jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛɔ nii fiaa afeɔ."
Petro bɔ̃i lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, "Naa,wɔ lɛ wɔshi nii fiaa ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ."
Yesu kɛɛ, "Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni eshi shīa loo nyɛmimɛihii loo nyɛmimɛiyei loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo ŋa loo bi shikpɔji yɛ mi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ,
Ni Enaŋ Shiai kɛ nyɛmimeihii kɛ myɛmimɛiyei kɛ nyɛmɛi kɛ bii kɛ shikpɔji toi oha yɛ benɛbe nɛɛ mli beebe, kɛ yiwalɛ hu; ni jeŋ ni baaba lɛ mli eeena naanɔ wala.
Shi klɛŋklɛŋ pii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpelɔi, ni sɛɛkpelɔi aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii."

Ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalem, ni Yesu nyiɛ amɛhiɛ; kaselɔi lɛ ahe ejɔ̃ amɛhe, ni mɛi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ miishe gbeyei. Ni eŋɔ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛtee afã ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nɔ ni baaba enɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ,
"Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalem, ni aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛaabu lɛ gbele fɔ, ni amɛaaŋɔ lɛ amɛhã jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ.
Ni amɛaaye ehe fɛo, ni amɛaafɛ̃ lafɔ̃ amɛaashwie ehe, ni amɛkɛ kplebii aaayi lɛ, ni amɛaagbe lɛ; ni gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, eeete shi ekoŋŋ."
Ni Yokobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bii lɛ, ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, wɔmiisumɔ akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaaba o lɛ ofee ohã wɔ."
Ni ebi amɛ kɛ, "Mɛni nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ mifee mihã nyɛ?"
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hã wɔ hegbɛ koni wɔteŋ mɔ kome ata oninejurɔ nɔ ni kome hu ata obɛku nɔ yɛ onumnyam lɛ mli."
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛleee nɔ ni nyɛbiɔ lɛ; ani nyɛaanyɛ kpulu ni mibanu lŋ nyɛnum, aloo nyɛaanyɛ ni akɛ mibaptisimɔ lɛ abaptisi nyɛ?"
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔɔnyɛ." Shi Yewsu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛaanu, ni baptisimɔ ni akɛaabaptisi mi lɛ akɛaabaptisi nyɛ nɛ;
shi mininejrɔ kɛ mibɛku nɔ tamɔ lɛ jeee minɔŋ ni mikɛhãa, shi moŋ mɛi ni asaa ato lɛ anɔŋ."
Ni be ni mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ nu lɛ amɛmli wo Yakobo kɛ Yohane la.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛle akɛ mɛi ni buɔ amɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔyel0i lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni amɛteŋ gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ agbo atsɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ;
ni mɔ ni taoɔ nyɛteŋ onukpa atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe mɛi fɛɛ atsulɔ.
Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu baaa ni asɔ̃mɔ lɛ, shi sɔ̃ɔmɔ moŋ eba, koni eŋɔ esusuma ehã akɛ kpɔmɔnɔ yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ."
Ni amɛshɛ Yeriko. Ni be ni akɛ ekasrelɔi lɛ kɛ asafo yuu jɛ jɛi amɛyaa lɛ, Timeo bi Bartimeo, shwilafo nibalɔ lɛ, ta gbɛjegbɛ lɛ toi eebla nii.
Ni be enu akɛ Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ni lɛ, ebɔi blɔmɔ akɛ, "Yesu, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!"
Ni mɛi ppii babaoo moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, "Naa tsui, tee shi, eetsɛ o!
Ni eshɛ etade nɔhaa lɛ efɔ̃, ni ete shi pa, ni eba Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee miha6 o?" Ni shwilafo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Rabuni,(eshishi ji Minuŋtsɔ),akɛ mana nii."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa o." Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ena nii, ni enyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
11: Ni be ni amɛkɛɛ amɛbɛŋkɛɔ Yerusalem ni amɛshɛ Betfage kɛ Betania yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yesu tsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ lɛ mli, ni jɛi ni nyɛaashɛ pɛ, nyɛaana tejibi ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tako enɔ dã ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi; nyɛfɛnea lɛ kɛbaa.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi nyɛ akɛ, 'Mɛni hewɔ nyɛfeɔ enɛ?'lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, 'Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi etsɛŋ ni eeetsu ni akɛ lɛ aba ekoŋŋ.'"
Ni amɛtee amɛyana tejibi lɛ ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi yɛ agbo naa yɛ blohu lɛ mli, ni amɛfɛne lɛ.
Mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi bi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ, tejibi lɛ nyɛfɛneɔ lɛ?"
Ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ bɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ tejibi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei shwie enɔ, ni eho eta nɔ.
Ni mɛi pii kɛ amɛtadei hahaa gbɛ lɛ nɔ; ni mɛi komɛi hu flɔ tsei aniji kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ mli ni amɛkɛshwie gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni mɛi nyiɛ hiɛ kɛ miɛ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ blɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Hosiana! Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ!
Ajɔɔ wɔtsɛ David Maŋtsɛyeli ni baa lɛ! Hosiana yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!"
Ni ebote Yerusalem, ni etee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ; ni be ni ekwɛ nibii fɛɛ kɛkpe lɛ, akɛni je ena momo hewɔ lɛ, eje jɛi etee Betania kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ, be ni amɛjɛ Betania amɛbaa lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Ni yɔɔ yi, ni etee eyakwɛ akɛ aleeenɔ eeena nɔ ko yɛ nɔ lo. Shi be ni eshɛ he lɛ, enaaa nɔ ko yɛ nɔ lo. Shi be ni eshɛ he lɛ, enaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja bai kɛkɛ, ejaakɛ agbãmiwoobe shɛko.
Ni Yesu wo enaa nɔ ekɛɛ agbãmitso lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ ko yeŋ onɔ yibii dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ!" Ni ekaselɔi lɛ nu.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalem lɛ, Yesu tee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni ebɔ̃i mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ shwiemɔ, ni etsirɛ shikatsakelɔi lɛ akplɔ̃i kɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ asɛii lɛ etswia shi,
ni eŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko atre nɔ ko kɛtsɔ̃ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekɛɛ, "Ani aŋmako akɛ, 'Aaatsɛ miwe lɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ a-Sɔlemɔwe?' Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu!"
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ nu, ni amɛtao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ; shi amɛmiishe lɛ gbeyei ejaakɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ naa kpɛɔ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he.
Shi kɛ shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ ejeɔ maŋ lɛ mli.
Ni leebi maaŋkpa, be ni amɛhoɔ lɛ, amɛna akɛ agbãmitso lɛ eŋlã kɛ eshishifã fɛɛ.
Ni Petro kai ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "Rabi, naa, agbãmitso lɛ ni olomɔ lɛ eŋlã!"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhea Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛyea!
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, mɔ ni aaakɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ akɛ, 'Faa ni oyagbee ŋshɔŋ!' Ni ejee ŋwane yɛ etsui mli, shi moŋ eheɔ eyeɔ akɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ aaaba mli lɛ, aaafee ahã lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nii abɔ fɛɛ noi nyɛkpaa he fai nyɛna, ni akɛaahå nyɛ.
Ni be fɛɛ be ni nyɛdamɔ shi nyɛsɔleɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛfaa lɛ, koni nyɛŋwɛi-Tsɛ lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ afa nyɛ.
(Shi kɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛfaaa lɛ, nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaŋ nyɛ.")
Ni amɛba Yerusalem ekoŋŋ. Ni be ni Yesu nyiɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ba eŋɔɔ,
ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ "Mɛɛ hegbe oyɔɔ hewɔ ofeɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, aloo namɔ hã o nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ ni okɛfee nibii nɛɛ?'
Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mi hu mabi nyɛ sane kome ni nyɛhã mi hetoo, koni matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni mikɛfeɔ nii nɛɛ.
Yohane Baptisimɔ lɛ ŋwɛi ejɛ aloo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ ejɛ? Nyɛhãa mi hetoo!"
Ni amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛkɛ amɛhe yiyii akɛ, "Kɛji wɔsɛɛ akɛ amɛhe yiyii akɛ,"Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeebi wɔ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee mɔ?"
Ni kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ," amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ buɔ Yohane gbalɔ lɛɛlɛŋ.
Ni amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "Wɔleee." Ni yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Belɛ, ni mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ hewɔ ni mifeɔ nibii nɛɛ mɔ."
12: Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ bɔ̃i wiemɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli akɛ, "Nuu ko fee waintrom, ni amli akɛ, "Nuu ko fee waintrom, ni efo afabaŋ ewo he; etsa wainbu, ni etsawa mɔ̃ɔ yɛ mli, ni ekɛhã bulɔi apaayeli, ni edom.
Be ni shɛ wain kpamɔbe lɛ, etsu tsulɔ ko kɛtee hulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ koni eyaŋɔ waintrom lɛ mlu yibii lɛ eko yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛba.
Shi amɛmɔ lɛ ni amɛyi lɛ, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛŋ flo.
Esaa etsu tsulɔ kroko hu kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ; ni amɛjwrajwraa eyitso, ni amɛshwie ehiɛ shi.
Asaŋ etsu mɔ kroko ekoŋŋ; ni lɛ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii hu; amɛgbe lɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii hu; amɛyiyii mɛi komɛi, niamɛgbegbee mɛi komɛi.
Agbɛnɛ eshwɛ mɔ kome pɛ ni ebaatsu, ebinuu ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ. Naagbee lɛ etsu lɛ hu amɛɔ̃ɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, 'Amɛhiɛ aaasɔ mibi lɛ.'
Shi nɛkɛ okwaafoi nɛɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Niyelɔ lɛ nɛɛ; nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ ni gboshinii lɛ atsɔ̃ wɔnɔ!'
Ni amɛmɔ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ, ni amɛwo lɛ yɛ waintrom lɛ mli amɛshɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni waintromtsɛ lɛ baafee? Eeeba ebakpãtã okwaafoi lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã mɛi krokomɛi.
Ani nyɛkaneko nɛkɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ, 'Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ enɛ jɛ, ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiŋmɛiiaŋ?'"
Ni amɛmiiaŋ lɛ amɛmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ amɛhewɔ ebu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ, shi amɛmiishe asafo lɛ gbeyei. Ni amɛshi lɛ amɛtee.
Ni atsu Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Herodebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ koni amɛbamɔ enaa enyɔŋ yɛ wiemɔ mli.
Ni be ni amɛba lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ anɔkwafo ji o, ni osheee gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ, shi moŋ otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli. Ani eja akɛ ejaaa? Wɔhã, aloo wɔkahã?"
Shi ni eyoo amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Mɛɛba nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi? Nyɛkɛ denario abaa ni makwɛa."
Ni amɛkɛba. Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Namɔ mfoniri nɛ, ni amɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?" Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kaisare nɔŋ."
Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛ Kasisare nii ahãa Kaisare, ni nyɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ." Ni ehe fee amɛ naakpɛɛ.
Ni Sadukifoi ni kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ hu ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ,
"Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, Mose ŋma hã wɔ akɛ, 'Kɛ mɔ ko nyɛmi gbo ni eshi eŋa, shi eshii bi lɛ, enyɛmi lɛ aŋɔ eŋa lɛ ni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.'
Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi shi; ni onukpa lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni eshiii bi;
mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ hɔ ŋɔ yoo lɛ, ni egbo, ni lɛ hu eshiii bi ko yɛ esɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ yoo lɛ hi shi, ni amɛshiii bii yɛ kɛ yoo lɛ hi shi. ni amɛshiii bii yɛ amɛsɛɛ. Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu bagbo.
Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli, be ni amɛaate shi lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ̃, ejaakɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ hi shi?"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani jeee ŋmalɛi lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni nyɛleee lɛ hewɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ be ni amɛaate shi kɛaajɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, hii lɛ eŋɔŋ yei, ni yei lɛ hu egbãŋ; shi moŋ amɛaatamɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi.
Shi akɛ gbohii baate shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ani nyɛkaneko yɛ Mose wolo lɛ mli bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ yɛ ŋmeitso lɛ he sane lɛ mli akɛ, 'Mi lɛ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi,'lɛ?
Enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee gbohii a-Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi a-Nyɔŋmɔ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛmiitɔ̃ babaoo."
Ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni nu akɛ amɛmiibibii lɛ saji lɛ hu ba, ni be ni ena akɛ ehã amɛ hetoo jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, "Te nɔ ni ji kitãi lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ klɛŋklɛŋ nɔŋ?"
Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ "Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji, Bo toi, Israel! Nuŋtsɔ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ kome ni;
ni suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ osusuma fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ!

Kitã ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɛ, 'Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.'Kitã ko bɛ ni fe enɛɛmɛi." 32, Mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, anɔkwale okɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome pɛ yɔɔ, ni mɔ kroko bɛ, ja lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ;
ni lɛ suɔmɔ kɛjɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ susuma fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ fɛɛ mli kɛ naanyo suɔma fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ fɛɛ mli kɛ naanyo suɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ sumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, efe shãa afɔlei kɛ afɔlei fɛɛ."{
Ni be ni Yesu na akɛ, "Okɛ Nyŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ teŋ jekɛɛɛ." Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ sane ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ Kristo lɛ, David biŋ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ David diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋɛ lɛ naa akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, ta mininejurɔ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi mafee onaneshi maaŋoo.'
David diɛŋtsɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ; belɛ te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebi hu?" Ni mɛi babaoo bo lɛ toi kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ mla tsɔ̃ɔlɔi ni sumɔɔ atadei wuyawuyaa woo kɛ sumɔɔ atade wuyawuyaa woo kɛ shisheramɔ kɛ jaanɔ ŋamɔi lɛ ahe;
mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi ni sumɔɔ onukpai yitso tamɔ yɛ niyenii ashi;
amɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛsɔleɔ sɔlemɔi kakadãji amɛtsɔ̃ɔ sɔlemɔi kakadãji amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi; amɛfɔbuu lɛ aaafe nine!"
Ni Yesu yata shikatoohe lɛ ŋlɛnɔ eekwɛ bɔ ni mɛi lɛ kɛ shika woɔ onia adeka lɛ mli lɛ. Ni niiatsɛmɛi pii kɛ babaoo wo mli.
Ni yoo okula fo ko hu ba ni ekɛ kapɛji enyɔ ni shɛɛɛ pɛsɛwa bawo mli.
Ni etsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, nɛkɛ okulafo ohiafo nɛɛ kɛ pii ewo mli fe mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni kɛ eko ebawo adeka lɛ mli lɛ.
Ejakɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛna ni eteke nɔ lɛ eko amɛkɛbawo mli; shi mɔnɛ lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ ehia mli ni ekɛlɛɔ ehe lɛ fɛɛ ejɛbawo mli nɛɛ."
13: Be ni Yesu jeɔ kpo yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, kwɛ tɛi kɛ tsui kplekplei!"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Oona nɛkɛ tsui kpeteŋkplei nɛɛ? Ashiŋ tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ ni atsiŋ shi."
Ni be eta shi yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ we lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ, Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea bi lɛ yɛ afã nigii akɛ,
"Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ be mli ni aaafee nii nɛɛ, ni kɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ kwa aaaba mli lɛ, mɛni ji ehe okadi?"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ebɔ̃i amɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni mɔ ko akalaka nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii aaaba yɛ migbɛi mli, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Miji lɛ!' Ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii.
Shi kɛ nyɛnu tai kɛ tai asaji ahe lɛ, nyɛkahaoa, ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ba mli, shi asaŋ naagbee lɛ shɛko.
Maŋ aaate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyeli aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli, ni shikPɔŋhosomɔi aaaba yɛ hei stɔtoi, ni hɔmɔ aaaba. Enɛɛmɛi ji kɔ̃ɔmɔi abɔ̃imɔ.
"Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛlea nyɛhenɔkwɛmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ kɛaatee gwabɔi amli, ni aaayi nyɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ, ni akɛ nyɛ aaadamɔ lumɛi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ yɛ mihewɔ koni nyɛye odase nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni ja ashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji fɛɛ dã.

Shi kɛ amɛkpla nyɛ kɛtee amɛyahã lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛtoa yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawie hewɔ; shi moŋ nɔ ni akɛaahã nyɛ yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nyɛwiea; ejaakɛ jeee nyɛ nyɛwieɔ lɛ, shi moŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni.
Shi nyɛmi aaaŋɔ nyɛmi ahã gbele, ni tsɛ hu kɛ bi aaahã; ni amɛkɛ amɛ aaahã ni agbe amɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛwulaa shi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala."
"Shi kɛ nyɛna amaŋfɔ̃ bihiinii lɛ akɛ ema he ni esaaa akɛ emaa lɛ, (mɔ ni kaneɔ lɛ, eyoo sɛɛ), no lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi aya gɔji lɛ anɔ;
ni mɔ yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ lɛ akakpleke shi aloo ebote shīa eyakɔ nɔ ko;
ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi lɛ ekaku esɛɛ eyakɔ etade.
Shi kpoo hã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ mɛi ni hãa fɔfɔ yɛ ni hiɛ musu kɛ mɛi ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ!
Shi nyɛsɔlea koni enɛ akaba yɛ fɛ̃ibe mliɛ!
Ejaakɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ amanehulu aaaba ni anãko enɔ dã kɛjɛ jeŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ shishijee mli aahuu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni asaŋ anaŋ enɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni ja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fo gbii lɛ anɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ ahereŋ heloo ko heloo ko yiwala; shi mɛi ni ehala lɛ ahewɔ lɛ eeefo gbii lɛ anɔ.
"Ni no mli lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Naa, Kristo lɛ yɛ biɛ!" Aloo, 'Naa, eyɛ biɛ!" lɛ, nyɛkahea nyɛyea,
ejaakɛ amale kristoi kɛ amale gbalɔi aaate shi ni amɛaafee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii koni kɛ aaaho lɛ, amɛlaka mɛi ni ahala lɛ tete.
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛwɛa jogbaŋŋ; mikɛɛ nyɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mito."
"Shi no bei amli yɛ amanehulu nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hulu hiɛ aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ;
ni ŋulamii aaatserɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi atswia shi, ni aaahoso hewalɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, aaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eeba yɛ atatuiaŋ kɛ hewalɛ kple kɛ anumnyam babaoo.
No ni eeetsu ebɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛaabua mɛi ni ehala lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ kɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ naagbeehe kɛyashi ŋwɛi naagbehe."
"Nyɛkasea agbãmitso he abɛ ni ebuɔ lɛ. Kɛ shɛ be ni eniji efrɔke ni eefu baa lɛ, nyɛle akɛ latsaabe lɛ eshɛ etã.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, yɛ kɛ nyɛna kɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ miiba mli lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ eshɛ agboi anaa etã.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, ja nii nɛɛ fɛɛ eba mli dã.
ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ baaho aya, shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ."
"Shi no gbɛi lɛ loo ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ mɔ ko leee; ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ leee, ni Bi lɛ hu leee,akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea; ejaakɛ nyɛleee beyinɔ ni be lɛ shɛɔ.
Etamɔ nuu ko ni ni edom eshi ewe, ni ehã etsuji lɛ hegbɛ kɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ, ni efã agbonaakwɛlɔ lɛ akɛ ebu.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsraa; ejaakɛ nyɛleee beyinɔ ni shīatsɛ lɛ baa, ekolɛ gbɛkɛ, loo nyɔɔŋteŋ, loo wuɔgbɛɛmɔ, loo leebi;
koni ekaba trukaa ebana nyɛ akɛ nyɛmiiwɔ.
Nɔ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ, mɛi fɛɛ mikɛɔ, Nyɛsraa!"
14: Be ni eshwɛ gbii enyɔ ni ayeɔ Hehoo kɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ tao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ Yesu ŋaa mli ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Shi amɛkɛɛ, "Jeee Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, koni basabasafeemɔ aka akaba maŋ lɛ mli."

Be ni Yesu yɔɔ Betania yɛ Simon, kpitiyelɔ lɛ, we lɛ ni eta niyenii ashi lɛ, yoo ko ni hiɛ alabastro tɔ ni nardo mu ŋmiiŋmi ni jra wa naakpa yɔɔ mli ba; ni ejwa alabastro tɔ lɛ, ni efɔse mu lɛ eshwie Yesu yiteŋ.
Shi mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ amli wo la ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ ni afite mu lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ kulɛ nɛkɛ mu nɛɛ, aaanyɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ana fe denarioi ohai etɛ̃ ni akɛhã ohiafoi!" Ni amɛwie yoo lɛ he huhuuhu.
Shi Yesu Kɛɛ, "Nyɛfɔ̃a lɛ hiɛmɔ! Mɛni hewɔ nyɛhaoɔ lɛ? Etsu nitsumɔ fɛɛfɛo ehã mi.
Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa, ni be fɛɛ be ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ amɛ ejurɔ nyɛfee; shi mi lɛ jeee daa mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Efee nɔ ni ebaanyɛ; etsɔ̃ hiɛ ebafɔ migbɔmɔtso lɛ mu eto mifuu.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, he fɛɛ he mli fɛɛ lɛ, aaagba nɔ ni yoo nɛɛ efee nɛɛ hu akɛkai lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda Iskariot, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, yiŋ etee osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ koni eyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ.
Shi amɛ lɛ be ni amɛnu lɛ amɛnya, ni amɛwo lɛ shi akɛ amɛaahã lɛ shika. Hewɔ lɛ, etao bɔ ni eeefee ni ehã amɛnine ashɛ enɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.
Akpiti Gbii Juji lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni agbeɔ Hehoo toobi lɛ, Yesu kaselɔi lɛ bi akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa nii wɔto wɔhã o ni oye Hehoo lɛ yɛ?"
Ni etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli, ni nuu ko ni hiɛ nu kɛ kpulu kɛ nyɛ aaakpe; nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ;
ni he ni eeeyabote lɛ, nyɛkɛa shīatsɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, nɛɛgbɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ ni mikɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?'
Ni eeeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ŋwɛi asa kpeteŋkple ko ni awula mli ni asaa jɛi; nyɛsaa nii nyɛtoa wɔ yɛ jɛi."
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛyana bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
Ni be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tee jɛi.
Be ni amɛtra shi amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, "Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ kome ni kɛ mi miiye nii baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ."
Ni amɛbɔ̃i ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ lɛ bimɔ ekomekome akɛ, "Miŋ lo?"
Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ komeŋ, mɔ nine ni kɛ minine kpeɔ yɛ kã lɛ mli lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ! Faŋ nɔ ni anaaa afɔ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ."
Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɔ aboloo, ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, "nyɛhea! Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso lɛ."
Ni ewo kpulu lɛ ni eda shi ,ni ekɛhã amɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnu eko.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Enɛ ji milã ni ji kpäŋmɔ lɛ nɔ ni afɔse ashwie shi yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ lɛ.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ kayashi gbi nɔ ni manu lɛ ehee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
Ni be ni amɛla yijiemɔ lala ko lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛtee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, 'Matswa tookwɛlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni toi lɛ aaagbɛ ashwã.'
Shi mishitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛaatee Galilea."
Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ nane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ tete lɛ, mi lɛ minane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miikɛɛ o anɔkwale mli akɛ; ŋmɛnɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ shii enyɔ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃."
Shi Petro wie kɛ ekãa fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji gbo mikɛ o aaagbo tete lɛ, mikpãŋ yɛ osɛɛ!" Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni amɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Getsemane lɛ, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtraa biɛ koni mayesɔle dã."
Ni eŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane efata ehe, ni ehe bɔ̃i kpokpomɔ kɛ haomɔ;
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Misusuma werɛ eho ehe kɛyasashi kpe!"
Ni etee ehiɛ fioo, ni eho ebu shi, ni esɔle koni kɛ aaaho lɛ; ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ aho ehe;
ni ekɛɛ, "Abba, Ataa! Onyeɔ nii fɛɛ ofeɔ; jiemɔ kpulu nɛɛ yɛ minɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ!"
Ni eba ebana amɛ akɛ amɛmiiwɔ, ni ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, "Simon, wɔ owɔɔ? Onyɛ̃ɛɛ kpe oshi ŋmlɛtswaa kome?
Nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea koni nyɛkabote kaa mli. Mumɔ lɛ miikplɛ moŋ, shi heloo lɛ he waaa."
Ni eyiŋ etee ekoŋŋ ni eyasɔle, ni ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni eku esɛɛ eba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebana akɛ amɛwɔ; ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii etsii, ni amɛleee nɔ hetoo ni amɛhãa lɛ.
Ni eba nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ ni nyɛwɔɔ lolo nɛɛ? Efã! ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ, naa, aaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aawo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ.
Nyɛtea shi nyɛhãa wɔyaa;; naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ eshɛ shi etã."
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ; Yuda, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, ba kɛ mɛi babaoo ni jɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ ni hiɛ klaŋtei kɛ tsei.
Shi sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ ehã amɛ okadi ko akɛ, "Mɔ naa ni mashwɔ lɛ, lɛ ni; nyɛmɔa lɛ ni nyɛkplaa lɛ kɛyaa shweshweeshwe."
Ni be ni Yuda shɛ shi nɔŋŋ pɛ ni eba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Rabi!" Ni eshwɔ enaa.
Ni amɛbashwie enɔ ni amɛmɔ lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbla eklaŋte, ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, ni efo etoi.
Ni Yesu fã enaa ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mimɔmɔ nyɛbaa kɛ klaŋtei kɛ tsei tamɔ amɔɔ ojotswalɔ nɛɛ?
Daa ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ, nyɛmɔ̃ɔɔ mi; shi bɔ ni afee ni ŋmalɛi lɛ ana aba mli hewɔŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛɛ jo foi amɛshi lɛ.
Shi oblanyo ko ni kɛ klala ekete eyayaiaŋ nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛmɔ lɛ;
shi eshi klala lɛ ni ejo foi kɛ ehe yayai.
Ni amɛkpla Yesu kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ eŋɔɔ.
Ni Petro nyiɛ esɛɛ flɛŋŋ kɛyabote osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔ̃ɔ kpo te lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tsuji lɛ yatra shi, ni ewere la.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ akuashɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tao Yesu he odase ko ni amɛwo lɛ gbee, shi amɛnaaa eko,
ejaakɛ mɛi pii ye amale odase amɛshi lɛ moŋ nɛ; shi amɛdasei lɛ yeee egbɔ.
Ni mɛi komɛi te shi ni amɛye amale odase amɛshi lɛ amɛkɛɛ,
"Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu ni ekɛɛ akɛ, 'Mi lɛ makumɔ SɔLemɔtsu nɛɛ ni akɛ niji fee lɛ, ni gbii etɛ̃ mli lɛ mãma ekroko ni jeee niji akɛfee.'"
Shi no tete hu, amɛdasei lɛ yeee egbɔ.
Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi damɔ shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ebi Yesu akɛ, "Otooo he ek? Mɛɛ odase mɛnɛɛmɛ yeɔ shiɔ o nɛɛ?"
Shi etswaaa esɛŋ ni etooo he eko. Osɔfonukpa lɛ saa bi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Ani boji Kristo, mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ Bi lɛ lo?"
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, "Miŋ; ni nyɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eta Ofe lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ amli."
Shi osɔfonukpa lɛ gbalɔ etadei ni ekɛɛ, "Mɛɛ odasefoi wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ dɔŋŋ?
Nyɛnu emubɔɔ lɛ; te nyɛjwɛŋɔ tɛŋŋ?" Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛbu lɛ fɔ akɛ esa gbele.
Ni mɛi komɛi bɔ̃i lajɔ̃fɛɛ kɛ ehe shwiemɔ, ni amɛfi ehiɛ, ni amɛyi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Gbaa!" Ni tsuji lɛ shwie enɔ kɛ ma.
Be ni Petro yɔɔ shishi lɛ yɛ mɔ̃ɔ kpo te lɛ mli lɛ, osɔfonukpa lɛ weyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba,
Ni be ni ena Petro ni eewere la lɛ, ekwɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Te bo hu okɛ Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ yɔɔ?"
Shi etso ekɛɛ, "Mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ, ni minaaa shishi tete." Ni eje kpo etee koi lɛ shi, kɛkɛ ni wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Ni oblayoo lɛ na lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni esaa ebɔ̃i mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, "Amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛ!"
Shi Petro tso ekoŋŋ. Ni fee sɛɛ fioo lɛ mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ kɛɛ Petro ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mli lɛ,amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji o, ejaakɛ Galileanyo ji o."
Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i loomɔ kɛ kitãkãmɔ akɛ, "Mileee gbɔmɔ ni nyɛwieɔ ehe nɛɛ!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ wuɔ gbɛɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ; ni Petrpo kai wiemɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ shii enyɔ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃" lɛ. Ni be ni ekai lɛ efo aahuu.
15: Ni be ni je kɛɛ etsɛteɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ akuashɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tee ajina, ni amɛfi Yesu, ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛyahã Pilato.
Ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ? Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛɛ."
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ flɔ enaa pii.
Ni Pilato bi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Otooo he eko? Kwɛ onaa sɔŋŋ ni amɛflɔɔ."
Shi Yesu etooo he eko dɔŋŋ, ni Pilato hiɛ fee lɛ yaa.
Shi daa kɛshɛ Gbijurɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɔ gboklɛfonyo kome ni amɛbiɔ lɛ he ehãa amɛ.
Shi mɔ ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Baraba ni awo lɛ niiaŋ kɛ atūatselɔi ni gbe gbɔmɔ yɛ atūatsemɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni asafo lɛ ba babɔ̃i lɛ faikpamɔ akɛ efee tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ daa lɛ ehã amɛ.
Shi Pilato here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mihã nyɛ lo?"
Ejaakɛ ele akɛ hetsɛ̃ naa ni osɔfonukpai lɛ mɔ lɛ hã lɛ.
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ wo asafo lɛ yiŋ akɛ amɛhã eŋmɛɛ Baraba moŋ he ehã amɛ.
Ni Pilato saa here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Belɛ mɛni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mifee mɔ ni nyɛtsɛɔ lɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mɔ?"
Shi amɛblɔ ekoŋŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!"
Ni Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, Shi mɛɛ efɔŋ po efee?" Shi amɛblɔ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, "Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!"
NI akɛni Pilato taoɔ akɛ efee nɔ ni asafo lɛ taoɔ hewɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ Baraba he ehã amɛ; ni Yesu lɛ, ekɛ kplebii yi lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Ni asraafoi lɛ kpla lɛ kɛtee amralo mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɛ asraafoiaku muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe.
Ni amɛwo lɛ atade tsuru ko, ni amɛfee ŋmɛi akekre amɛkɛfi eyitso.
Ni amɛbɔ̃i lɛ ŋamɔ akɛ, "Oshwiee, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ."
Ni amɛkɛɛ tso tswia eyiteŋ, ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehe, ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛyeyee ehe fɛo lɛ, amɛjie atade tsuru lɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ wo lɛ, ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee ni amɛyasɛŋ lɛ.
Ni asraafoi lɛ nyɛ Simon Kirenenyo ko ni jɛ kosɛɛ ni ji Aleksandro kɛ Rufo tsɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ ewo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ.
Ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Golgota lɛ, eshishi ji Yitsoŋoŋohe.
Ni amɛhã lɛ wain ni akɛ mire efutuŋ akɛ enu; shi enuuu.
Ni be ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ, amɛja etadei lɛ amli, ni amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki, nɔ ni mɔ akɔ.
Shi ŋmlɛ nɛɛhu mli amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ.
Ni aŋma sane ni akɛfɔ̃ enɔ lɛ yɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, "YUDAFOI Lɛ AMAŋTSɛ Lɛ."
Ni amɛsɛŋ ojo tswalɔi enyɔ amɛfata ehe, mɔ kome ye eninejurɔ, ni mɔ kome ye ebɛku.
( Ni ŋmalɛ ni kɛɛ akɛ , "Ni abu lɛ ashi efɔŋfeelɔi anɔ" lɛ ba mli.)
NI mɛi ni hoɔ lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔ amɛshi lɛ, i amɛhoso amɛyitsei ni amɛkɛɛ, "Ei, bo ni okumɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu ni osaa omaa lɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ nɛ!
Heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala, ni oje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ okpleke shi!"
Nakai nɔŋŋ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu ye ehe fɛo yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Ehere mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ehere;
Kristo, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, aje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ akpleke shi koo, koni wɔna ni wɔhe wɔye!" Ni mɛi ni asaŋ afata ehe lɛ hu bɔ lɛ ahora.
Ni be nii shɛ ŋmlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ, duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli.
Ni ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ, Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, "Eloi, Eloi, lama Sabaktani?" Eshishi ji, "Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi?"
Ni be mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛikomɛi nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Naa, eetsɛ Elia."
Ni mɔ ko shã foi ni eyaŋɔ ŋshɔŋ kotsa etsɔ ashiŋ mli, ni ekɛma tso naa ehã lɛ akɛ enu ni ekɛɛ, "nyɛhãa wɔmɛa ni wɔkwɛ akɛ Elia aaabajie lɛ lo."
Ni Yesu bo waa ni ebu enaa.
Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba enyɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi Kɛbayi shi.
Shi be ni asraafoioahatsɛ ni damɔ eŋlɛmɔ lɛ na akɛ ebo nɛkɛ ni ebu enaa lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ni!"
Ni yei komɛi hu yɛ jɛi amɛdamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Maria Magdalena lɛ Maria, Yakobofio kɛ Yose nyɛ lɛ, kɛ Salome,
mɛi ni be ni eyɔɔ Galilea ni amɛnyiɛɔ esɛɛ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ, kɛ yei krokomɛi pii ni kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem lɛ.
Ni be ni shs gbɛkɛ lɛ, akɛni eji Hesaamɔgbi mni nyiɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ hiɛ hewɔ lɛ,
Yosef ni jɛ Arimatia, ni ji akwaashɔŋnyo ko ni yɔɔ gbɛi ni lɛ hu ekwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtseyeli lɛ gbɛ lɛ, ba ni ekɛ ekaa yiŋ kɛtee Pilato ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi Yesu gbonyo lɛ.
Shi Pilato hiɛ fee lɛ yaa akɛ egbo momo; ni etsɛ asraafoioahaatsɛ lɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ egbo etsɛ lo?
Ni be ni enu kɛjɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛ gbonyo lɛ ke Yosef.
Ni Yosef yahe klala lɛ ha ehe, ni ekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ gbonyobu ni akpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli lɛ mli, ni ekoklo tɛ ekɛŋa bu lɛ naa.
Ni Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria, Yose nyɛ lɛ, mikwɛ, ni amɛna he ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lɛ.
16: Ni be ni hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ eho lɛ, Maria Magbalena kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ Salome yahe tsofai-kɛ-ŋma koni amɛba ni amɛkɛ bakpa lɛ.
Ni otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ leebi maaŋkpa, be ni hulu jeɔ lɛ, amɛba bu lɛ naa.
Ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, "Namɔ aaakoklo tɛ lɛ yɛ bu lɛ naa ahã wɔ?"
Shi be amɛyaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛna akɛ akoklo tɛ ni da naakpa lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ.
Ni be ni amɛbote bu lɛ mli lɛ, amɛna oblanyo ko ta ninejurɔgbɛ ni ewo atade yɛŋ kakadaŋŋ; ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei! Nyemiitao Yesu Nazarenyo ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ; ete shi, ebɛ biɛ; naa, he ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ nɛ!
Shi nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ Petro akɛ eetsɔ̃ nyɛiɛ kɛmiiya Galialea; jɛi nyɛaana lɛ yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ."
Ni amɛjekpo, ni amɛjo foi kɛjɛ bu lɛ he; amɛhe kpokpo, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe; ni amɛkɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ ko, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe gbeyei.
(Shi be ni Yesu te shi leebi maaŋkpa yɛ otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ tsutsu ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ji Marria Magbalena, mɔ mli hu ni efã mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji kpawo yɛ lɛ.
Ni lɛ etee eyagba mɛi ni kɛ lɛ hi shi ni yeŋkɔmɔ ni amɛfoɔ lɛ.
Shi amɛ lɛ, be ni amɛnu akɛ ehiɛ kã, ni ena lɛ lɛ, amɛheee amɛyeee.
Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo yɛ su kerko mli etsɔ̃ɔ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ, be ni amɛsheraa shi kɛyaa kosɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛ hu amɛyiŋ amɛtee amɛyakɛɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ,shi amɛheee nomɛi hu tete amɛyeeee.

Fee sɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ diɛŋtsɛ, be ni amɛtra niyenii ashi lɛ, ni ekã amɛhiɛ yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee kɛ amɛtsuiwalɛ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛheee mɛi ni na lɛ yɛ eshitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛyeee.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa je lɛ mli fɛɛ kwa nyɛyashiɛa Sanekpakpa lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni abɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ ni aaabaptisi lɛ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, shi mɔ ni heee yeee lɛ, aaabu lɛ fɔ.
Shi okadi ni aaanyiɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ asɛɛ nɛ, migbɛi mli lɛ amɛaafãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji; amɛaawie wiemɔi heei;
amɛaaahole onufui anɔ; ni kɛji amɛnu nɔ ko ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ, efeɔ amɛ nɔ ko; amɛkɛ amɛniji aaashwie helatsɛmɛi anɔ, ni amɛhe aaawa amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni be ni Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ amɛ ewie sɛɛ lɛ, aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Shi amɛ lɛ, amɛje jɛi, ni amɛyashiɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ tsu nii, ni ekɛ okadii ni fata wiemɔ lɛ he lɛ wo wiemɔ lɛ hewalɛ.)

1: Yesu Kristo, David bi lɛ, Abraham bi lɛ, wekukpãa wolo.
Abraham fɔ Isak, Isak fɔ Yakob, ni Yakob fɔ Yuda kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ;
Yuda kɛ Tamar fɔ Perez kɛ Zera, Perez fɔ Hezron, ni Hezron fɔ Ram;
Ram fɔ Aminadab, ni Aminadab fɔ Nahashon, ni Nahashon fɔ Salmon;
Salmon kɛ Rahab fɔ Boaz, Boaz kɛ Rut fɔ Obed, ni Obed fɔ Ishai;
Ishai fɔ Maŋtsɛ David, ni David kɛ Uria ŋa lɛ fɔ Solmon.
Solomon fɔ Rehabeam, Rehabeam fɔ Abia, ni Abia fɔ Asa;
Asa fɔ Yehoshafat, Yehoshafat fɔ Yoram, ni Yoram fɔ Uzia;
Uzia fɔ Yotam, Yotam fɔ Ahaz, ni Ahaz fɔ Hezekia;
Hezekia fɔ Manase, Manase fɔ Amon, ni Amon fɔ Yosia;
Yosia fɔ Yekonia kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, be ni abaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ.
Ni be ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yekonia fɔ Shealtiel ni Shealtiel fɔ Zerubabel,
Zerubabela fɔ Abiud, Abiud fɔ Eliakim, ni Eliakim fɔ Azor;
Azor fɔ Sadok, Sadok fɔ Akim, ni Akim fɔ Eliud;
Eliud fɔ Eleazar, Eleazar fɔ Matan, ni Matan fɔ Yakob;
Yakob fɔ Yosef ni ji Maria ni fɔ Yesu ni etsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ wu lɛ.
