Belɛ yinɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Abraham nɔ kɛbashi David nɔ lɛ feɔ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ; ni kɛjɛ David nɔ kɛbashi Babilon nomŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ, ni kɛjɛ Babilon nomŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi Kristo nɔ lɛ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni Yesu Kristo fɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛ. Enyɛ Maria lɛ, be ni Yosef etsɛ ehe baa ni amɛnako amɛhi shi lɛ, ana akɛ ehiɛ musu kɛjɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.
Shi Yosef, ewu lɛ, akɛni jalɔ ji lɛ ni etaooo akɛ ebɔ lɛ ahora lɛ eto eyiŋ akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe kpoo.
Shi be ni ejweŋɔ nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yosef, David bi, kaashe oŋa Maria ŋɔɔ gbeyei, shi musu ni ehiɛ nɛɛ ejɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli,
ebaafɔ binuu, ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu, ejaakɛ lɛ ebaahere emaŋ lɛ yiwala kɛjɛ amɛhe lɛ amli."
Shi enɛ fɛɛ ba, koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ,
"Naa, oblayoo fro lɛ aaana musu, Ni eeefɔ binuu, ni amɛaawo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Imanuel, eshishi ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ. "
Ni be ji Yosef te shi kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli lɛ, efee bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni eŋɔ eŋa lɛ;
shi eleee lɛ aahuu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni efɔ binuu. Ni Yosef wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.
2: Be ni afɔ Yesu yɛ Betleham yɛ Yudea, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Herode yinɔ lɛ, nilelɔi jɛ bokã ba Yerusalem babi akɛ,
"Nɛɛgbɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ ni afɔ lɛ yɔɔ? Wɔna eŋulami lɛ yɛ bokã ni wɔba ni wɔbaja lɛ."
Shi be ni Maŋtsɛ Herode nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛ Yerusalem fɛɛ yoyro;
ni ebua maŋ lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ebi amɛ he ni aaafɔ Kristo lɛ yɛ.
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea; shi bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ ŋma nɛ,
'Ni bo, Betlehem ni oyɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jeee boji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ ateŋ kwraa shi omli lumɔ ni aaakwɛ mimaŋ Israel lɛ aaajɛ!"
Kɛkɛ ni Herode tsɛ nilelɔi lɛ nigii, ni ebi amɛ fitsofitso beyinɔ ni ŋulami lɛ pue.
Ni eha amɛtee Betlehem ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyea ni nyɛyataoa abifao lɛ fitsofitso; ni kɛ nyɛna lɛ lɛ, nyɛbakɛa mi, koni mi hu maya ni mayaja lɛ."
Be ni amɛnu maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee. Ni ŋulami lɛ ni amɛna yɛ bokã lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ aahuu, kɛyashi ebadamɔ he ni abifao lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ.
Ni be ni amɛna ŋulami lɛ, amɛna miishɛɛ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni amɛtee shīa lɛ, ni amɛna abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ Maria lɛ; ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ. Amɛfɛne amɛkotokui anaa, ni amɛkekee lɛ nii; shika kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ mire.
Ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli akɛ amɛkaku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee Herode ŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ kroko nɔ kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ.

Ni be ni amɛtee lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli ni ekɛɛ, "Tee shi; ŋɔɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni ojo foi oya Egipt, ni ohi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni makɛɛ o nɔ ko; shi Herode baatao abifao lɛ ni egbe lɛ,"
Ni ete shi eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni eyiŋ etee Egipt.
Ni ehi shi yɛ jɛi kɛyashi Herode gbo; koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ, "Egipt mitsɛ mibi lɛ kɛjɛ."

Agbɛnɛ be ni Herode na akɛ nilelɔi lɛ yeee lɛ anɔkwa lɛ, emli fu waa, ni etsu ayagbe gbekɛbii hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Betlehem kɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, mɛi ni eye afii enyɔ kɛ mɛi ni yeko nakai lɛ, kɛji abu kɛjɛ be ni ebi nilelɔi lɛ sane lɛ fitsofitso lɛ.
No ni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ ba mli akɛ,
"Anu gbee ko yɛ Rama, yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli babaoo; Rahel miifo ebii, ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ miishɛjemɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ."
Shi be ni Herode egbo lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli yɛ Egipt,
ni ekɛɛ "Tee shi ni oŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ ni oya Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni taoɔ abifao lɛ amɛgbe lɛ amɛgboi."
Ni Yosef te shi ni eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni eba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni enu akɛ Arkelao miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yudea yɛ etsɛ Herode sɛɛ lɛ, eshe jɛiyaa gbeyei; ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli lɛ, edɔ eyi kɛtee Galilea niiaŋ.
Ni eba ebahi maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli, koni nɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, "Aaatsɛ lɛ Nazarenyo."
3: Nakai be lɛ amli lɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ba ebashiɛ yɛ Yudea ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui; shi ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ."
Shi mɔ nɛ ji mɔ he ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie akɛ, "Mɔ ko gbee miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, 'Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ! Ni nyɛfea etempɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ!"
Shi lɛ Yohane lɛ, yoma hetsɔi akɛlo etade, ni wolo kpãa fi emliteŋ, ni eniyenii ji baalabii kɛ ŋanɔ wo.
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem kɛ Yudea fɛɛ kɛ Yordan niiaŋ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ;
ni ebaptisi amɛ yɛ Yordan faa lɛ mli, be ni amɛjajeɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ.
Shi be ni ena Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii baa ebaptisimɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Shinɔi ashwiei, namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛjo mlifu ni baaba lɛ naa foi?
Belɛ nyɛwoa yibii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ mɔ!
Ni nyɛkasusua ni nyɛkɛɛ yɛ nyɛmli akɛ, 'Wɔ lɛ wɔtsɛ ji Abrahaml'; shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ etee bii ashi kɛjɛ tɛi nɛɛ amli ehã Abraham.
Shi lema lɛ kã tsei lɛ ashishifã lɛ nɔ momo; hewɔ lɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ atoɔ afɔɔ shi, ni ashɛɔ afɔɔ la mli.
Mi lɛ, nu mikɛbaptisiɔ nyɛ hã tsuitsakemɔ; shi mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ehe wa fe mi; etokotai tete misaaa mɔ ni hiɛɔ. Lɛ eeebaptisi nyɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ la.
Ehiɛ eshaatsene yɛ edɛŋ, ni ebaabɛɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fitsofitso, ni ebaabua eŋmaa lɛ naa eto eboŋo mli; shi tutuu lɛ, ekɛ la ni gbooo baashã,"
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jɛ Galilea eba Yohane ŋɔɔ yɛ Yordan naa, koni ebaptisi lɛ.
Shi Yohane tsi lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, Mi moŋ ni ehia mi akɛ bo obaptisiɔ mi lɛ, ni bo obaa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ?"
Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ "Kplɛ̃mɔ kɛkɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ sa akɛ wɔgbeɔ jalɛ fɛɛ naa." Kɛkɛ ni ekplɛ̃.
Ni be ni abaptisi Yesu lɛ, ejɛ nu lɛ mli amrɔ eje kpo; ni naa, agble ŋwɛi naa ahã lɛ, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ miikpleke shi tamɔ okpo kɛmiiba enɔ.
Ni naa, gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni mina ehe tsui lɛ."
4: Kɛkɛ ni Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔ Yesu kɛtee ŋanɔ, koni abonsam ayaka lɛ.
Ni be ni ehiŋmaa shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Ni abonsam lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji o lɛ, fã koni tɛi nɛɛ atsɔ̃mɔ aboloo."
Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Aŋma akɛ, 'Jeee aboloo kɛkɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala; shi mɔŋ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni jɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ daaŋ lɛ'"
Kɛkɛ ni abonsam lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yiteŋ he ni yɔɔ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ,
ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ "Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji o lɛ, kɛ ohe atswa shi; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, 'Ohewɔ lɛ eeefã ebɔfoi lɛ ni amɛaahiɛ o yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni okɛ onane akashi tɛ ko.'"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Aŋma ekoŋŋ akɛ, 'Kaaka Nuŋtsɔ, o Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.'"
Asaŋ abonsam lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee gɔ̃ŋ ni kwɔ somromoo ko nɔ, ni ekɛ jeŋ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ kɛ amɛnumnyam lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ;
ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ. "Mikɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baahã o, kɛji okula shi oja mi lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Jee mihiɛ, Satan! Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ oja, ni lɛ kɛkɛ osɔ̃mɔ!'"
Kɛkɛ ni abonsam lɛ shi lɛ, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi ba ni amɛbasɔmɔ lɛ.
Shi be ni Yesu nu akɛ amɔ Yohane lɛ, eyiŋ etee Galilea.
Ehiii shi yɛ Nazaret shi moŋ ebahi Kapernuam maŋ ko ni kã ŋshɔ naa, yɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali niiaŋ.
Koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ lɛ aba mli akɛ,
"Zebulon shikpɔŋ kɛ Naftali shikpɔŋ, ŋshɔnagbɛ lɛ, yɛ Yordan sɛɛ lɛ, Galilea, jeŋmaji ashikpɔŋ lɛ,
Maŋ ni ta duŋ mli lɛ, ena la kpeteŋkple, ni mɛi ni tra gbele shikpɔŋ, kɛ ehɔ̃ɔŋ mli lɛ, la ete shi ehã amɛ."
Kɛjɛ no nɔ lɛ Yesu bɔ̃i shiemɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui; shi ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ!"
Be ni Yesu kpaa shi yɛ Galilea ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi enyɔ, Simom ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea, ni amɛmiihɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ wolɛi ji amɛ.
Ni etsɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbanyiɛa misɛɛ, ni mafee nyɛ wolɛi ni baahɛ gbɛmɛi."
Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi amɛyai lɛ, ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni eje jɛi eyaa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi krokomɛi enyɔ, Zebedeo bi Yakob kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ Zebedeo yɛ lɛlɛ mli amɛmiikpɛ amɛyai lɛ; ni etsɛ amɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi lɛlɛ lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛ lɛ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni Yesu kpa Galilea muu lɛ fɛɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni eshiɛɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni etsaa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejramɔ fɛɛ hejramɔ yɛ ma lɛ mli.
Ni ehe sane gbɛ shwã Siria fɛɛ, ni akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɛ hewalɛ ni helai kɛ piŋmɔi srɔtoi hiɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ amɛmli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ gbligbli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ kuumɔhela ba eŋɔɔ, ni etsa amɛ.
Ni asafoi pii jɛ Galilea kɛ Dekapoli kɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yudea kɛ Yordan sɛɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
5: Shi be ni ena mɛi pii lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eho eta shi ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.
Ni egble enaa etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekɛɛ,
"Ajɔɔ mumɔ lɛ mli ohiafoi lɛ; Shi amɛnɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
"Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ; shi aaashɛje amɛmii.
"Ajɔɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
"Ajɔɔ mɛi ni jalɛ he hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai yeɔ amɛ lɛ; shi amɛaatrɔ.
"Ajɔɔ mɛi ni naa mɔbɔ; shi aaana amɛ mɔbɔ.
"Ajɔɔ mɛi ni tsuii amli tse lɛ; shi amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ.
"Ajɔɔ mɛi ni kpãtãa lɛ; shi aaatsɛ amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii.
"Ajɔɔ mɛi ni jalɛ hewɔ ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ; shi amɛnɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
"Ajɔɔ nyɛ, kɛji ajɛ nyɛ mi awa nyɛ yi ni amale awie nyɛhe efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ yɛ mihewɔ lɛ,
nyɛnyaa ni nyɛmli aflia nyɛ ejaakɛ nyɛnyɔmɔwo fa yɛ ŋwɛi; shi nakai amɛwa gbalɔi ni tsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ lɛ ayi."
"Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋoo ji nyɛ. Shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni akɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ? Ehiii hãaa nɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja atsi ashwie, ni gbɔmɛi naana nɔ.
Nyɛji je lɛ mli la lɛ. Maŋ ni ma gɔŋ nɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ akɛtee.
Asaŋ asuuu kane amaaa tsese shishi; shi moŋ akɛmaa kanetso nɔ, ni etsoɔ ehãa mɛ ni yɔɔ shīa lɛ fɛɛ.
Nakai nyɛhãa nyɛla atsoa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, koni amɛna nyɛnifeemɔnii kpakpai lɛ, ni amɛwo nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam."
"Nyɛkasusua akɛ miba Mla lɛ loo gbalɔi lɛ aguu; mibaaa guu shi moŋ miba ni mabahã eye emuu.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ hoko nɛɛ, yota kome loo kuli kome ejeŋ Mla lɛ mli hoŋ, ja fɛɛ eba mli.

No hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagoi kitãi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ ekome ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nakai lɛ, aaatsɛ lɛ bibioo fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye Mla lɛ nɔ ni eeeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ agbo yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛjalɛ lɛ faaa kɛtekeee mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛboteŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa."
"Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, 'Kaagbe gbɔmɔ! Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli.

Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mli fuɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli; ni mɔ Fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ enyɛmi akɛ, 'Yaka gbɔmɔ' lɛ eeeye gwabɔɔ lɛ hiɛ fɔ; ni mɔ Fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Buulu' lɛ eeeye abonsamiiaje la lɛ mliyaa fɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji okɛ onɔkeenɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni okai yɛ jɛi akɛ onyɛmi kɛ o yɛ sane ko lɛ,
Shi onɔkeenɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni oya okɛ onyɛmi lɛ ayakpãtã dã, koni oba ni okɛ anɔkeenɔ lɛ abahã.
Okɛ obelɔ lɛ atsa mra, be ni okɛ lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ, koni obelɔ lɛ kɛ o akahã kojolɔ lɛ, ni kojolɔ lɛ kɛ o hã tsuŋwolɔ lɛ, ni akɛ o wo tsuŋ.
Mikɛɛ o anɔkwale mli akɛ ojeŋ jɛi ojeŋ kpo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooowo naagbee pesewa lɛ."
"Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, 'Kaafite gblã!'
Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ yoo ni ehe feɔ lɛ akɔnɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ efite gblã momo yɛ etsui mli.
Shi kɛji oninejurɔ jiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ fãa ni oshɛ ofɔ; ejaakɛ ehi hã o akɛ ohenii lɛ eko fiteɔ, koni akɛshɛ ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ afɔ̃ obonsamiiaje.
Ni kɛji oninejurɔ miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo ni oshɛ ofɔ̃; ejaakɛ ehi hã o akɛ ohenii lɛ eko fiteɔ, koni ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ akaya abonsamiiaje.
"Asaŋ akɛɛ akɛ, 'Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaashwie eŋa lɛ ehã lɛ shwiemɔ wolo'
Shi mi lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni jeee ajwamaŋbɔɔ sane hewɔŋ lɛ ehãa yoo lɛ fiteɔ gblã; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mɔ ni ashwie lɛ lɛ, fiteɔ gblã."
"Asaŋ nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, 'Kaakã amale kitã, shi ye okitãi lɛ anɔ ohã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.'
Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkakãa kitã kwraa! Kaakã ŋwɛi, shi Nyɔŋmɔ sɛ̃i ni;
loo shikpɔŋ, shi enajiashi maaŋoo ni; loo Yerusalem, shi Maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ maŋ ni.
Ni okakã oyitso tete, ejaakɛ onyɛŋ ofee yitsɔi kome eyɛŋ loo diŋ.
Shi nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ afea: 'Hɛɛ, hɛɛ! 'Dabi, dabi!' Shi nɔ fe enɛɛmɛi lɛ ejɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ mli."
"Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ akɛ, 'Hiŋmɛi yɛ hiŋmɛi najiaŋ; nyanyɔŋ yɛ nyanyɔŋ najiaŋ.
Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkatsia mɔ fɔŋ lɛ gbɛ, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagba oninejurɔ topiŋ lɛ, tsɔ̃ ekome lɛ hu ohã lɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko tao akɛ ekɛ o aye sane ni eshɔ̃ oflaka lɛ, hã eŋɔ ohebo lɛ hu.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaanyɛ onɔ akɛ okɛ lɛ anyiɛ shitoo kome lɛ, okɛ lɛ aya enyɔ.
Mɔ ni baa o nɔ ko lɛ hã lɛ, ni mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ofa lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ ohe oshi lɛ.
"Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ, 'Suɔmɔ onaanyo, ni onyɛ ohenyɛlɔ.'
Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ;
Koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ bii; ejaakɛ ehãa ehulu teɔ shi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ mɛi ni ejaaa lɛ anɔ.
Shi kɛji nyɛsumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ, mɛɛ nyɔmɔwo nyɛyɔɔ? Ani toohelɔi lɛ tete efeee nakai nɔŋŋ?
Ni kɛji nyɛ ŋaa nyɛnyɛmɛi kɛkɛ lɛ, mɛni nyɛfeɔ ni teke nɔ? Ani jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ tete efeeee nakai nɔŋŋ?
No hewɔ lɛ Nyɛhia kɛwulaa shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hi kɛwula shi lɛ."
6: "Nyɛkwɛa ni ahīa ni nyɛkafea nyɛjalɛnii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ koni amɛna nyɛ; no lɛ, nyɛbɛ nyɔmɔwo ko yɛ nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ dɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛ oofee ejurɔ lɛ, kashiɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi, tamɔ osatofoi lɛ feɔ yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ blohui lɛ amli koni gbɔmɛi ajie amɛyi. Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛ ooofee ejurɔ lɛ, kaahã obɛku le nɔ ni oninejurɔ feɔ,
koni ojurɔfeemɔ lɛ ahi teemɔ mli, ni o-Tsɛ lɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo o nyɔŋmɔ."

"Ni kɛ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ osatofoi lɛ; shi amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛdamɔ kpeehei lɛ kɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoi amɛsɔle, koni mɛi ana amɛ. Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oosɔle lɛ, botemɔ opia mli, ni oŋa oshinaa lɛ, ni osɔle otsɛ o-Tsɛ yɛ teemɔ mli; ni o-Tsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo o nyɔmɔ.
"Shi kɛji nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkawiea trilii tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ; shi amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛwiemɔ babaoo lɛ hewɔ aaabo amɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ amɛ; shi nyɛ-Tsɛ lɛ le nii ni hīaa nyɛ dani nyɛbiɔ lɛ."
"No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsɔlea nɛkɛ, 'Wɔ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ogbɛi lɛ he atse;
omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aba. Afee nɔ ni osumɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ afeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Hã wɔ ŋmɛnɛ wɔdaaŋmaa;
ni okɛ wɔnyɔji lɛ akɛ wɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔkɛkeɔ mɛi ni hiɛ wɔ nyɔji lɛ.
Ni okɛ wɔ akaya kaa mli; shi jiemɔ wɔ kɛjɛ efɔŋ mli. (Shi onɔ ji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ anumnyam lɛ kɛyahsiɔ naanɔ. Amen)
"Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔ fa amɛ lɛ, nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛaafa nyɛ hu.
Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔi efaaa amɛ lɛ, nyɛ-Tsɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaŋ nyɛ."
"Shi kɛji nyɛmiihi ŋmaa lɛ nyɛkafea nyɛhiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ tamɔ osatofoi lɛ; shi amɛfeɔ amɛhiɛ nyanyaanya, koni mɛi ana akɛ amɛmiihi ŋmaa. Mikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwo nɔ momo.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oohi ŋmaa lɛ, kpa oyi mli mu ni ofɔ ohiɛ;
koni mɔ akana akɛ oohi ŋmaa, akɛ ja o-Tsɛ ni anaaa lɛ lɛ; ni o-Tsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo o nyɔmɔ."
"Nyɛkabɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni omlɛ̃gɛ̃ kɛ ŋkanale fiteɔ nii ni julɔi gbuɔ kɛboteɔ mli kɛbajuɔ yɛ lɛ.
Shi nyɛbɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi, he ni omlɛ̃gɛ̃ kɛ ŋkanale fitee nii ni julɔi egbuuu kɛboteee mli kɛyajuuu yɛ lɛ.
Shi he ni ojwetri yɔɔ lɛ jɛi otsui aaahi."
"Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane ji hiŋmɛi. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tse lɛ ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ aayi kɛ la.
Shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tseee lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ aaawo duŋ. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji la ni yɔɔ omli lɛ ji duŋ lɛ, te no duŋ lɛ aaafa ahã tɛŋŋ!"
"Mɔ ko nyɛŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi enyɔ asɔ̃mɔ; ejaakɛ no lɛ eeenyɛ mɔ kome ni eeesumɔ mɔ kroko lɛ; aloo eeekpɛtɛ mɔ kome he, eeebu mɔ kroko lɛ akɛ, ejeee mɔ ko. Nyɛnyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mamona (ninamɔ) nyɛsɔ̃mɔ.
"No hewɔ lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛkafea yeyeeye yɛ nyɛwala he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaanu hewɔ, aloo yɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawo hewɔ. Ani wala efeee ŋmaa, ni gbɔmɔtso efeee atade?
Nyɛkwɛa ŋwɛi loofɔji lɛ: Amɛduuu nii, asaŋ amɛkpaaa nii, asaŋ amɛbuaaa naa amɛwooo aboŋoi amli; shi nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ lɛɔ amɛ kɛ̃. Ani nyɛhiii aahuu fe amɛ?
Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ aaanyɛ atsa ekwɔlɛ nɔ ninetalɔ kome?
Ni mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛfeɔ yeyeeye yɛ atade hewɔ? Nyɛjwɛŋa ŋanɔ fɔfɔii lɛ ahe, bɔ ni amɛdraa; amɛgbooo deŋme, asaŋ amɛtsɛ̃ɛɛ kpãa.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Solomon kɛ enumnyam lɛ fɛɛ tete ewulaaa tamɔ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ ekome.
Shi kɛji ŋanɔ jwɛi ni ŋmɛnɛ eyɛ ni wɔ ni ashɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wulaa nɛkɛ lɛ, ani efeŋ nɔ ni fe enɛ ehaŋ nyɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa lɛ lo?
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Mɛni wɔɔye, aloo mɛni wɔɔnu, mɛni hu wɔkɛ aha wɔhe?'
Ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ diɔ. Shi nyɛ-Tsɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ le akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ he miihia nyɛ.
Shi nyɛtaoa Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ ejalɛ lɛ tsutsu ni akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ aaafata he ahã nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛtao wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔ aaahao yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe. Gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ efɔŋ lɛ fa hã lɛ.
7: "Nyɛkakojoa, koni akakojo nyɛ,
Shi nɔ kojomɔ ni nyɛkɛkojoɔ lɛ, akɛaakojo nyɛ; ni nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, akɛasusu ahã nyɛ.
Shio mɛɛba onaa kuli ni yɔɔ onyɛmi hiŋmɛi mli lɛ, shi bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli mplaŋ lɛ oyooo lɛ?
Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni oookɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, 'Hã majie kuli lɛ yɛ ohiŊmɛi mli,' be mli ni mplaŊ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ?
Osatofo, jiemɔ mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli tsutsu, ni no dani ooona nii faŋŋ ni ojie kuli lɛ yɛ onyɛmi lɛ hiŋmɛi mli.
Nyɛkɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akahãa shifɔji; asaŋ nyɛkashɛrɛa nyɛdiagbai nyɛshwiea kplotoi ahiɛ, ni amɛbanaana nɔ yɛ amɛnajiashi, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe amɛbatserɛ nyɛ."
"Nyɛbia, ni aaahã nyɛ; nyɛtaoa, ni nyɛaana; nyɛshia, ni aaagble ahã nyɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ lɛ, enine shɛɔ nɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ lɛ, enaa; ni mɔ ni shiɔ lɛ aaagble ahã lɛ.
Aloo nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ?
Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ ŋshɔŋloo, ni eeehã lɛ onufu?
Belɛ kɛji nyɛ ni nyɛji mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ nyɛle bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ nyɛkɛ nikpakpai hãa nyɛbii lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ekoŋŋ nikpakpai ehaŋ mɛi ni biɔ lɛ lɛ?
"No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mɛi afee nyɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ enɛ ji Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ."
"Nyɛbotea agbo fintɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli! Ejaakɛ agbo ni lɛɛ kɛ gbɛ tɛtrɛɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, ni mɛi ni boteɔ mli lɛ fa.
Shi agbo fintɔ̃ɔ kɛ gbɛ ni etsa ji nɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli lɛ, ni mɛi fioo ji mɛi ni naa no."
"Shi nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ amale gbalɔi lɛ ahe; amɛkɛ too wolo haa amɛhe kɛbaa nyɛŋɔɔ, shi amɛmligbɛ lɛ klaji fulɔi ji amɛ.
Amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛaale amɛ. Ani atseɔ wainyibii yɛ ŋmeitsei anɔ, aloo atseɔ agbãmii yɛ aŋlɛ̃ŋlɛ̃i anɔ?
Nakai nɔŋŋ tso fɛɛ tso ni ji ekpakpa lɛ woɔ yibii kpakpai; shi tso gbonyo woɔ yibii gbohii.
Tso kpakpa nyɛɛɛ awo yibii gbohii, ni asaŋ tso gbonyo nyɛɛɛ awo yibii kpakpai.
Tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ, atoɔ lɛ ni ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ la mli.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛale amɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔi nɛɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ aaato nilelɔ ni ma etsu yɛ tɛsaa nɔ lɛ he.
Mɛi pii aaakɛɛ mi nakai gbi lɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ! Ani jeee bo ogbɛi lɛ mli wɔfee hewalɛnii pii yɛ lo?
Ni no lɛ magba mli makɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Mileee nyɛ kwraa, nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtsuɔ nibii ni ejaa gbɛ!:
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tue, ni faai ba, ni kɔɔyɔɔi tswa, ni amɛshimɔ tsu lɛ, shi ewuleee; ejaakɛ ato shishi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ nɛɛ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ aaato nuu kwashia ni ma etsu yɛ shia nɔ lɛ he.
Ni nyɔŋmɔ tue, ni faai ba, ni kɔɔyɔɔi tswa, ni amɛshimɔ tsu lɛ, ni ewule, ni ewulemɔ lɛ da!"
Ni be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔinɛɛ anaa lɛ, asafoi lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he;
Ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii akɛ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ hegbɛ, shi jeee tamɔ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ,
8: Shi be ni Yesu jɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpleke shi lɛ, asafoi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni naa, kpitiyelɔ ko ba ebakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse!"
Ni Yesu kpã enine mli eta ehe ni ekɛɛ, "Miisumɔ, ohe atse!" Ni amrɔ lɛ ekpiti lɛ tã.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kwɛmɔ ni okakɛɛ mɔ ko; shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfoi lɛ, ni ohã keenii ni Mose to lɛ, ni no aaafee odase ahã amɛ."
Shi be ni Yesu bote Kapernuam lɛ, asraafoiohaatsɛ ko ba eŋɔɔ ebakpa lɛ fai,
ni ekɛɛ "Nuŋtsɔ, miwenuu kã shi yɛ shīa kɛ kuumɔhela, eena nɔ naakpa."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Miiba ni mabatsa lɛ."
Ni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, esaaa mi akɛ obaa mikoi lɛ shi; shi moŋ wiemɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, ni aaatsa miwnuu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi po ni mi ji gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nɔyeli shishi lɛ, miyɛ asraafoi yɛ mishishi, ni mikɛɔ mɔ kome akɛ 'Yaa!' Ni eyaa; kɛ mɔ kroko hu akɛ, 'Ba!' Ni ebaa; ni mikɛɔ mitsulɔ akɛ,'Feemɔ enɛ!' Ni efeɔ."
Shi be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ minako hemɔkɛyeli ni da tamɔ enɛ yɛ Israel!
Shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɛi pii aaajɛ bokã kɛ anai aba, ni amɛkɛ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob aaabatra okplɔ̃ he yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli bii lɛ, aaashwie amɛ awo gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyɛnyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa, bɔ ni ohe oye lɛ, afee nakai ohã o' Ni atsa ewenuu lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.
Ni be ni Yesu ba Petro we lɛ, ena eshaayoo lɛ kã shi kɛ atridii.
Ni emɔ enineshi, ni etridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ, ni ete shi ni esɔmɔ amɛ.
Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, akɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ amɛmli ba eŋɔɔ. Ni ekɛ ewiemɔ fãmɔ mumɔi lɛ, ni etsa mɛi ni he yeɔ fɛɛ.
Koni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, "Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewo wɔhejramɔi lɛ, ni etre wɔhelai lɛ."
Shi be ni Yesu na mɛi pii yɛ ehewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ afo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛya esɛɛgbɛ.
Ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛya he fɛɛ he ni oyaa."
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ "Osɔi yɛ bui, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji yɛ tsui; shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ bɛ he ni ekɛ eyitso ŋmɛɔ."
Ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni mayafu mitsɛ dã."
Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ, ni ohã gbohii afu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbohii."
Ni ebote lɛlɛ ko mli ni ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni naa; ŋshɔ lɛ fee hãmahãma aahuu ani ŋshɔkei miikumɔ miwo lɛlɛ lɛ mli; shi Yesu, ewɔ.
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsiɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!"
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛsheɔ gbeyei nɛkɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa?" Kɛkɛ ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔɔ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ yi, ni eŋmɛ dɛmm.
Shi gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ fee amɛ yaa amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛɛ gbɔmɔ sroto nɛ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ ŋshɔ tete boɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?"
Be ni eyashɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbɛ yɛ Gadarabii shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛi enyɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ amɛmli ni amɛjɛ gbohii afuuhe lɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe; amɛhiɛ ewo la tsɔ̃ bɔ ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃.
Ni naa, amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ o yɔɔ, bo Yesu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ? Ani oba biɛ ni obawo wɔ hejramɔ dani be lɛ ashɛ?
Ni kplotoi akuu kple ko miiye nii yɛ shɔŋŋ.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, "Kɛji ofã wɔ lɛ hã wɔyabote kplotopi akuu lɛ mli."
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa!" Ni amɛje kpo amɛyabote kplotoi akuu lɛ mli; ni naa, kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ wo foi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi yɛ nu lɛ mli.
Ni mɛ ni kwɛɔ amɛ lɛ jo foi, amɛtee maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛyagba saji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ anɔ lɛ hu.
Ni naa, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ je kpo ni amɛkɛ Yesu ayakpe; ni be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ eje amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ eya.
9: Yesu bote lɛlɛ mli, ni efo ŋshɔ lɛ, ni eba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli.
Ni naa, akɛ mɔ mo ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela ni kã saa nɔ ba eŋɔɔ. Ni be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ekɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela lɛ akɛ, "Bi, hã otsui anyɔ omli, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa o!"
Ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ yɛ amɛmli akɛ, "Musu mɔnɛ bɔɔ nɛɛ."
Ni be ni Yesu na amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ nii fɔ̃ɔji yɛ nyɛtsui amli nɛɛ?
Te emli nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jraaa hu, akɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Aŋɔ ohe eshai lɛ afa o,' aloo "Tee shi ni onyiɛ' lɛ?
Shi be ni afee ni nyɛna akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ." Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela lɛ akɛ, "Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni oya shīa!"
Ni ete shi etee shīa.
Shi be ni asafo lɛ na lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ Nyam akɛ ekɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ ehã gbɔmɛi.
Ni be ni Yesu je jɛi eyaa lɛ ena nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mateo ta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!" Ni ete shi enyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni eta niyenii ashi yɛ shīa lɛ, toohelɔi kɛ eshãfeelɔi baaboo ba, ni amɛkɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ batra okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
Ni be ni Farisifoi lɛ na lɛ, amɛbi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii nɛɛ? "
Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, tsofatsɛ he ehiaaa amɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ.
Shi nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakasea nɔ ni ji enɛ shishi. 'Mɔbɔnalɛ mitaoɔ, ni jeee afɔle!' Ejaakɛ mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔi, shi eshafeelɔi moŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ wɔ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ fɔɔ ŋmaahilɛ, shi okaselɔi lɛ ehii ŋmaa lɛ?
Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani yookpeemɔ he bialɔi lɛ aaanyɛ aye ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ ni ayɛmfrowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ? Shi gbii aaaba momo ni aaaŋɔ ayemforowu lɛ kɛaaje amɛteŋ kɛaatee, ni no dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.
"Shi mɔ ko kɛ mamanaa hee taaa atade momo; ejaakɛ nɔ ni akɛta lɛ yeɔ atade lɛ, ni flɔ lɛ lɛɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ.

Asaŋ akɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli; no lɛ, wolo tɔi lɛ aaaflɛ, ni wain lɛ aaaashwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ aaafite; shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli moŋ akɛwoɔ, ni enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ shweshweeshwe. "
Be ni akɛ amɛ wieɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, onukpa ko ba bakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, "Mibiyoo eje mli amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ba ni okɛ onine abaŋmɛ enɔ, ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃."
Ni Yesu te shi ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni naa, yoo ko ni eye láfɔsemɔ hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ baje esɛɛgbɛ eta etade naamuu lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, "Kɛji mina mita etade lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ, mihe aaawa mi."
Shi Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Biyoo, hã otsui anyɔ omli, ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehere oyiwala!" Ni yoo lɛ he wa lɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni Yesu ba onukpa lɛ we lɛ ena blɛkplalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi pii ni feɔ hoo lɛ,
ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa sɛɛ, ejaakɛ oblayoo lɛ gboko, shi wɔ kɛkɛ ewɔɔ." Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi be ni eshwie mɛi lɛ, etee tsu lɛ mli, ni emɔ oblayoo lɛ nineshi, ni ete shi.
Ni kɛkɛ sane nɛɛ jije yɛ jɛi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni Yesu je jɛi ehoɔ lɛ, shwilafoi enyɔ nyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛmiiblɔ akɛ, "Naa wɔ mɔnbɔ, David Bi!"
Ni be ni ebote shīa lɛ, shwilafoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ akɛ manyɛ enɛ mafee lo? Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni etra amɛhiŋmɛi lɛ ahe ni ekɛɛ, "Bɔ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, afee nakai ahã nyɛ."
Ni amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ gble. Ni Yesu bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa ni mɔ ko akalea!"
Shi amɛ lɛ, be ni amɛje jɛi lɛ, amɛyagbɛ ehe sane lɛ amɛshwã yɛ jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Shi be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ, akɛ mumui ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli ba eŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ, mumui lɛ wie. Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe amɛkɛɛ, "Anako nɛkɛ ko pɛŋ yɛ Israel!"
Shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ, "Mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji alumɔ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ efãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ!"
Ni Yesu kpa maji lɛ kɛ akrowai lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni eshiɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kpakpa lɛ, ni etsa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejramɔ fɛɛ hejramɔ.
Shi be ni na mɛi babaoo lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ etɔ amɛ ni amɛfee yuuyaa tamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Nikpamɔ lɛ fa, shi nitsulɔi lɛ faaa.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkpaa nikpamɔ nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai, koni ewo nitsulɔi agbɛ kɛba enikpamɔ lɛ mli!"
10: Ni Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba, ni ehã amɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ anɔ hewalɛ ni amɛfamɔ amɛ ni amɛtsa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejramɔ fɛɛ hejramɔ.
Shi bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ ji Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea; Yakobo, Zebedo bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Yohane;
Filipo kɛ Bartholomeo, Toma kɛ mateo, tòohelɔ lɛ Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Tadeo;
Simon, maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nɛɛ Yesu tsu, ni afã amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkagbalea jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkabotea Samariabii amaŋ ko mli hu;
shi moŋ nyɛyaa Israel we toi ni elaaje lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Shi ni nyɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛshiɛa nyɛkɛa akɛ, 'Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ashɛ shi etã.
Nyɛtsaa helatsɛmɛi, nyɛtea gbohii ashi, nyɛhãa kpitiyelɔi ahe atsea, nyɛfamɔa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji: yaka nyɛna, yaka nyɛkɛhãa.
Nyɛkataoa shika loo jwɛitɛi loo akɔɔble nyɛwoa nyɛhɛfiinii amli;
asaŋ yɛkataoa gbɛfãa kotoku, loo flakai enyɔ, loo tokotai loo tso; shi nitsulɔ lɛ eŋmaa sa lɛ.
"Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ loo akrowa fɛɛ akrowa mli ni nyɛaabote lɛ, nyɛbia mɔ ni sa shi yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛto jɛi, ni nyɛto jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaatee.
Shi kɛ nyɛmiibote shīa lɛ, nyɛŋaa shīa lɛ.
Ni kɛji shīa lɛ sa lɛ, nyɛhãa nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ abaa enɔ; shi kɛji esaaa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ akpale aba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko hereee nyɛ, ni ebooo nyɛwiemɔi lɛ atoi lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije nakai shīa lɛ loo nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnajiashi mlu lɛ.
Mikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, ejraŋ haŋ Sodom kɛ Gomora shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, tamɔ nakai maŋ lɛ."
"Naa mitsu nyɛ tamɔ too Gwaŋtɛŋi yɛ klaji ateŋ; no hewɔ lɛ nyɛhiɛ atɛ̃a tamɔ onufoi, ni nyɛfea kpoo tamɔ okpoi.
"Shi nyɛhīɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ kɛaatee kojomɔhei, ni amɛaayi nyɛ yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ nyɛ aaatee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi ahiɛ yɛ mihewɔ, koni no afee odase ahã amɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ.
Shi kɛji amɛŋɔ nyɛ kɛtee lɛ nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe yɛ bɔ ni nyɛaawie alaoo nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ hewɔ; shi akɛ nɔ ni nyɛwie aahã nyɛ yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ jeee nyɛji mɛi ni wiɛɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛ-Tsɛ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni wieɔ yɛ nyɛmli lɛ.
"Shi nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi aaahã gbele, ni tsɛ kɛ bi aaahã, ni bii aaate shi awo amɛfɔlɔi, ni amɛaahã agbe amɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛyawulaa shi lɛ, aaahere ehiwala.
Shi kɛ amɛmiiwa nyɛ yi yɛ maŋ ko mli lɛ, nyɛjoa foi nyɛyaa ekroko mli; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ nyɛgbeŋ Israel maji lɛ fɛɛ naa dani Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba.
Kaselɔ efeee etsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ni asaŋ nyɔŋ efeee enuŋtsɔ.
Efã hã kaselɔ akɛ eeeta mɔ enuŋtsɔ. Kɛji shīatsɛ lɛ amɛtsɛ Beelzebul lɛ, ewebii lɛ shii enyiɛ amɛtsɛŋ amɛ nakai?'
"Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ, ni agbleŋ nɔ; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni atee nɔ ni aleŋ.
Nɔ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ yɛ duŋ mli lɛ nyɛwiea yɛ la hiɛ; ni nɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛtoiŋ mikɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛshiiɛa yɛ tsui ayiteaŋ.
Ni nyɛkashea mɛi ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ susuma lɛ amɛgbe lɛ gbeyei; shi moŋ nyɛshea mɔ ni nyɛɔ susuma kɛ gbɔmɔtso fɛɛ hiɛ ekpãtãa yɛ abonsamiiaje lɛ gbeyei.
Ani aflimatei enyɔ lɛ jeee pesewa ahɔ̃ɔ aheɔ? Shi amɛteŋ ekoflo enyɔŋ shikpɔŋ, ja ejɛ nyɛ-Tsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.
Shi nyɛyiteŋtsɔ̃i po lɛ akane fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛjra wa aahuu fe aflimatai babaoo."
"Hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbaa mli tsiɔ mitã yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, mi hu magba mli matsi etã yɛ mi-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaa mi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, mi hu makwa lɛ yɛ mi-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ."
"Nyɛkasua akɛ miiba ni mabahã hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; jeee hejɔlɛ hama miba shi klaŋte moŋ.
Ejaakɛ miba mi mabahã mɔ ate shi ashi etsɛ, biyoo ate shi ashi enyɛ, shaayoo ate shi ashi eshaayoo.
Ni mɔ diɛŋtsɛ shīateŋbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi.
Mɔ mi dɔɔ tsɛ loo nyɛ he fe mi lɛ, esaa mi; ni mɔ ni dɔɔ binuu loo biyoo he fe mi lɛ, esaaa mi.
Ni mɔ ni wooo esɛŋmɔtso kɛnyiɛɛɛ misɛɛ lɛ, esaaa mi.
Mɔ ni baa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, enine aaashɛ nɔ."
"Mɔ ni hereɔ nyɛ lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.
Mɔ ni hereɔ gbalɔ yɛ gbalɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, gbalɔ nyɔmɔwo eeena; ni mɔ ni hereɔ jalɔ yɛ jalɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, jalɔ nyɔmɔwo eeena.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahã mɛi bibii nɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nuhɔ̃ɔ kpulu kome pɛ enu yɛ kaselɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, mikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ enyɔmɔwo eŋmɛŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ."
11: Be ni Yesu etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nibii nɛɛ egbe naa lɛ, eje jɛi eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii ni eshiɛ yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli.
Shi be ni Yohane nu Kristo nitsumɔi lɛ ahe yɛ gboklɛfoiatsu lɛ mli lɛ, etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ,
"Ani boji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yohane nɔ ni nyɛnuɔ kɛ nɔ ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ:
Shwilafoi miina nii, ni obubuafoi miinyiɛ; Kpitiyelɔi ahe miitse, ni toimulɔi miinu nii, gbohii miite shi, ni ohiafoi lɛ aajaje sane kpakpa lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛ.
Ni ajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mihe sane etɔtɔŋ enane."
Shi be ni mɛi ni atsu nɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛyaa lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i Yohane he wiemɔ kɛ mɛi babaoo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ, "Mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ? Gla ni kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ?
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ? Naa, mɛi ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi awei amɛyɔɔ.
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee? Gbalɔ? Hɛ̃ɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni fe gbalɔ tete.
Ejaakɛ mɔnɛ ji mɔ hewɔ ni aŋma akɛ, Naa, miitsu mibɔfoi lɛ kɛtsɔ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ ato o lɛ!
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɛi ni yei fɔ amɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko eteko shi ni fe Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ni ji bibioo kwraa yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli fe lɛ.
Shi kɛjɛ Yohane baptisilɔ lɛ yinɔ kɛbaa nɛɛ, hewalɛ naa aŋɔɔ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni hewalɔi gblaa lɛ hewalɛ naa.
Shi gbalɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Mla lɛ gba kɛbashi Yohane nɔ.
Ni kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛmɔ mli lɛ, mɔnɛ ji Elia ni baaba lɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnu nii lɛ, enu!."
"Shi namɔ he mikɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaato? Amɛtamɔ gbekɛbii ni tra jaji anɔ ni amɛtsɛtsɛɔ amɛnanemɛi akɛ,
Wɔkpã blɛ wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛjooo; Wɔwo yara wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛjooo:
Ejaakɛ Yohane ba, ni eyeee nii, ni esaa enuuu nɔ ko lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli."
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba, ni eyeɔ nii ni esaa enuɔ nɔ ko lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Naa, nuu fulɔ kɛ dãanulɔ, tɔ̃ohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi ashiɛŋtsɛ nɛ! Ni abu nilee bem yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa."
Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i maji, hei ni etsi ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ amli tsiimɔ yɛ lɛ, ehiɛ wiemɔ, yɛ amɛstui ni amɛtsakeee lɛ hewɔ, ekɛɛ,
"Kpoo hã o, Korazin! Kpoo hã o. Betsaida! Ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, eji atsu yɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon kulɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ kpekpe kɛ lamlu mli jeeŋmɔ.
Shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ejraŋ haŋ Tiro kɛ Sidon yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ tamɔ nyɛ.
Ni bo Kapernuam, ani aawo onɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi? Gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ aaaba o shi kɛaatee; ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ omli lɛ, eji atsu yɛ Sodom kulɛ ema shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ o akɛ, ejraŋ haŋ Sodom shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ tamɔ bo."
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yesu kɛɛ, "Miijie oyi, Ataa; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ okɛ nii nɛɛ etee nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, ni ojie otsɔ̃ɔ abifabii.
Hɛɛ, Ataa, bɔ ni sa ohiɛ ji no.
Mi-Tsɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo midɛŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko leee lɛ, akɛ ja Bi lɛ, kɛ mɔ ni Bi lɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ejieɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ."
"Nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni etɔ nyɛ ni nyɛjatsui fe nyɛ lɛ, ni mahã nyɛ hejɔɔmɔ.
Nyɛwoa mipã lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛkasea mi; shi mihe jɔ, ni mibaa mihe shi kɛjɛ mitsui mli; ni nyɛaana hejɔɔmɔ nyɛhã nyɛsusumai lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mipã lɛ teremɔ waaa, ni mijatsu lɛ etsiii."
12: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yesu tsɔ̃ able ŋmɔji amli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ; ni hɔ̃mɔ miiye ekaselɔi lɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i able lɛ kuumɔ kɛ kpemɔ.
Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ na lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, okaselɔi lɛ miifee nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ efee yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ."
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee be ni hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ:
Bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, eyaye aboloi ni akɛmãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni aŋmɛɛɛ lɛ gbo loo mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ yeɔ, akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?
Aloo nyɛkaneko yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni amɛyeee fɔ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ ko ni fe Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɛ biɛ.
Shi eji nyɛle wiemɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɔbɔnalɛ mitaoɔ shi jeee afɔle' lɛ shishi kulɛ, nyɛbuŋ mɛi ni yeee fɔ lɛ afɔ.
Ejaakɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ."
Ni eje jɛi eyabote amɛkpeehe lɛ.
Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni enine kome egbo. Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Ani eja gbɛ akɛ atsaa yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ? Bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo enaa flɔmɔ.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eyɛ too kome, ni too lɛ yagbee bu mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni emɔŋ emli ni ejie lɛ?
Ani gbɔmɔ jra waaa babaoo fe too? No hewɔ ni eja gbɛ akɛ efeɔ ejurɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, "Kpã onine lɛ mli!" Ni ekpã mli ni eye emuu tamɔ ekome lɛ.
Shi Farisifoi lɛ je kpo tee eyi nɔ apam, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
Shi be ni Yesu kpa enɛ shi lɛ, egbla ehe shi kɛje jɛi. Ni mɛi babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni etsa amɛ fɛɛ,
ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛkahã anu ehe;
bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie lɛ aba mli akɛ,
"Naa, mitsulɔ ni mihala lɛ, misuɔlɔ ni misusuma naa ehe tsui lɛ; mikɛ mi-Mumɔ lɛ aaaŋmɛ enɔ, ni eeejaje kojomɔ etsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ.
Ebeŋ, ni eblɔŋ hu, ni mɔ ko nuŋ egbee yɛ blohuiaŋ.
Glã ni amia lɛ, ekuŋ, ni kane mli tako ni tsoɔ sulii lɛ, egbeŋ, Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeehã jalɛ eye Kunim.
Ni egbɛi lɛ nɔ jeŋmaji lɛ aaaŋɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃."
Kɛkɛ ni akɛ mɔ ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli ni ji shwilafo kɛ mumui fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni etsa lɛ ni shwilafo ni ji mumɔi hu lɛ wie ni ena nii.
Ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, "Ani jeee David Bi lɛ nɛ?"
Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji alumɔ Beelzebul hewalɛ kɛkɛ mɔnɛ kɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ."
Shi akɛni Yesu yoo amɛjwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, ejwaa; ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ loo shīa fɛɛ shīa ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ edamɔɔɔ shi.
Ni kɛji Satan fã Satan lɛ, egba ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe; belɛ te emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaafee tɛŋŋ adamɔ shiŋ?
Ni Kɛji mi lɛ Beelzebul hewalɛ naa miifãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji yɛ lɛ, nyɛbihii lɛ, namɔ hewalɛ naa amɛfamɔ amɛ yɛ? No hewɔ lɛ amɛ amɛaakojo nyɛ.
Shi kɛji mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ naa mifãa mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ yɛ lɛ, no lɛ ninamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ enina nyɛ lɛ.
Shi kulɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ko aaanyɛ hewalɔ we ebote ni eyaha enibiiŋ, akɛ ja efi hewalɔ lɛ dani eeewo ewe lɛ haa?
Mɔ ni bɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ, shi ete ewo mi; ni mɔ ni kɛ mi buaaa naa lɛ, gbɛ egbɛɔ eshwãa.
No hewɔ lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, akɛ esha kɛ musubɔɔ fɛɛ aaafa gbɔmɛi; shi Mumɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ lɛ akɛfaŋ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie wiemɔ ko ashi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie ashi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ yɛ je nɛɛŋ loo jeŋ ni baaba lɛ mli"
"Nyɛhãa tso lɛ afea tso kpakpa, ni ewo yibii kpakpai; aloo nyɛhãa afea tso gbonyo, ni ewo yibii gbohii; ejaakɛ tso yibii akɛleɔ tso.
Nyɛ shinɔi ashwiei! Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛji mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, ni nyɛaanyɛ ekpakpa nyɛwieŋ? Ejaakɛ nɔ ni eyi tsui obɔ kɛteke nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ naabu wieɔ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa jieɔ nikpakpai kɛjɛɔ etsuiŋ jwetri kpakpa lɛ mli; ni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ hu jieɔ nifɔ̃ɔji kɛjɛɔ etsuiŋ jwetri fɔŋ lɛ mli.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, yaka wiemɔ fɛɛ yaka wiemɔ ni gbɔmɛi wieɔ lɛ, amɛbaabu he akɔŋtaa yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Shi owiemɔi lɛ amli aaajɛ abu o bem, ni owiemɔi lɛ amli aaajɛ abu o fɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, wɔmiitao onine naa okadi ko wɔkwɛ."
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Yinɔbii fɔ̃ɔji kɛ gblãfitelɔi miitao okadi; shi ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko, akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yona ye shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ ŋshɔŋ loo kpeteŋkple lɛ musuŋ lɛ, nakai Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaye shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Nineve hii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛaabu amɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ naa; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ.
Wuoyigbɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni eeebu amɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ ejɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe ebabo Solomom nilee lɛ toi; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Solomon nilee lɛ yɛ biɛ."
"Shi mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ, kɛ eje gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, eyanyiɛɔ hei ni nu bɛ etaoɔ hejɔɔmɔ, shi enaaa eko.
Ni ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Maku misɛɛ matee miwe he ni mijɛ lɛ." Ni kɛ eba lɛ, enaa akɛ ekã shi eflo, ni abɛɛ mli, ni awula mli.

Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaa ni eyaŋɔɔ mumɔi krokomɛi kpawo ni ji mɛi fɔ̃ɔji fe lɛ ekɛfataa ehe, ni amɛbaa amɛbahiɔ jɛi; ni nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ naagbee shihilɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ efɔŋ fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ. Nakai nɔŋŋ ebaaba mli yɛ yinɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ hu gbɛfaŋ."
Shi be ni ekɛ asafoi lɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ badamɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛkɛ lɛ awie.
(Ni mɔ ko bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Naa, onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛkɛ o awie.)
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ mɔ ni bakɛɛ lɛ lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji minyɛ, ni namɛi ji minyɛmimɛi?
Ni ekpã enine mli etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ ekɛɛ, "Naa, minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi nɛ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ mi-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ sumɔnaanii lɛ, lɛji minyɛminuu kɛ minyɛmiyoo lɛ minyɛ. "
13: Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu je shīa lɛ eyata ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni asafo babaoo babua amɛhe naa yɛ eŋɔɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ etee lɛlɛ ko mli eyata shi, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ damɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni ewie wiemɔi pii etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ amɛbuai amli ekɛɛ "Nidulɔ yiŋ etee nidumɔ.
Ni be ni eduɔ lɛ, wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie gbɛ he, ni loofɔji ba baklɔ.
Ni ekomɛi hu yashwie tɛsai anɔ, he ni amɛnaaa su pii yɛ; ni amrɔ lɛ, akɛni amɛbɛ su ni mli kwɔ hewɔ lɛ amɛkwɛ̃ oya.
shi be ni hulu te shi lɛ, amɛshã; ni akɛni amɛbɛ fã ko hewɔ lɛ amɛŋlã.
Ni ekomɛi hu yashwie ŋmei ateŋ ni ŋmei lɛ kwɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Shi ekomɛi hu yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni ewo yibii: eko oha, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛ nuɔ nii lɛ, enu!"
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hewɔ okɛ amɛ wieɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli lɛ?"
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ akɛhã nyɛ akɛ nyɛle ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli teemɔ saji lɛ, shi amɛ lɛ akɛ hãko amɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ aaahã lɛ ni ena kɛteke nɔ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ tete lɛ, aaashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ mikɛ amɛ wieɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiina nɛ shi amɛnaaa, ni amɛmiinu nɛ shi amɛnuuu, ni amɛanaaa shishi hu.
Ni Yesaia gbalɛ lɛ eba mli yɛ amɛhe akɛ, 'Nu lɛ nyɛbaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi; ni na lɛ nyɛbaana nɛ, shi nyɛyoŋ sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ tsui ekpliŋ, ni amɛtoii ewa, ni amɛŋamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii; koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii, ni amɛkanu kɛ amɛtoii, ni amɛtsui hu akana shishi, ni amɛkpale ni mitsa amɛ.
"Shi nyɛ lɛ ajɔɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii lɛ, akɛ amɛmiina nii, kɛ nyɛtoii lɛ, akɛ amɛmiinu nii.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbalɔi kɛ jalɔi pii shwe ni amɛna nii ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, shi amɛyanaaa, aloo ni amɛnu nii ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ, ni amɛyanuuu."
"Agbɛnɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛboa nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi toi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he wiemɔ lɛ ni eyooo sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ lɛ baa bashaa nɔ ni adu yɛ etsui mli lɛ. Mɔnɛ ji gbɛ he he ni adu wu lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Shi tɛsaa ni adu wu lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ damɔ shi hã mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni ehereɔ amrɔ kɛ miishɛɛ;
Shi akɛni ebɛ shishifã lɛ, ehiɔ shi fioo kɛkɛ; ni kɛji haomɔ loo yiwaa ba yɛ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsɛɛɛ kɛkɛ lɛ enane etɔ̃tɔ̃.
Ni ŋmei ateŋ he ni adu wu lɛ yɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔ kɛ nii pii ahe lakamɔ lɛ gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni ewooo yibii.
Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni adu wu lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni nuɔ wienɔ lɛ ni eyoɔ sɛɛ, ni esaa ewoɔ yibii hu, eko oha, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃."
Ebu amɛ abɛ kroko hu ekɛɛ "Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ nuu ko ni duɔ wui kpakpai yɛ eŋmɔ mli.
Shi be ni mɛi wɔ lɛ, ehenyɛlɔ ko ba ebadu jwɛi efutu ŋmaa lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi be ni ŋmaa lɛ kwɛ ni ewo yibii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni jwɛi lɛ hu pue.
Ni shīatsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, ani jeee wui kpakpai odu yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ? Nɛɛgbɛ ekɛ jwɛi nɛɛ jɛ mɔ?
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Henyɛlɔ ko bafee enɛ nɛɛ. Ni etsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Be lɛ ooosumɔ akɛ wɔya ni wɔyafãmɔ lo?
Shi ekɛɛ, 'Dabi, ekolɛ aleeenɔ jwɛi lɛ fãamɔ mli lɛ, nyɛaafãmɔ ŋmaa lɛ hu nyɛfutuŋ.
Nyɛŋmea enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ni amɛdra kɛyashi ŋmãakpamɔbe lɛ makɛɛ nikpalɔi lɛ akɛ, nyɛbuaa jwɛi lɛ anaa tsutsu, ni nyɛfimɔa amɛ keikei, koni ashã; shi ŋmaa lɛ nyɛbuaa naa nyɛyawoa miboŋo lɛ mli.'"
Yesu bu amɛ abɛ kroko ekɛɛ, "Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ sinapi wu ni mɔ ko kɔ ni eyadu yɛ eŋmɔ mli;
eji wui ateŋ bibioo fe fɛɛ, shi kɛ ekwɛ̃ lɛ, edaa fe shwie bai fɛɛ; ni efeɔ tso, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji baa bafeɔ tsui yɛ eniji ateŋ."
Ebu amɛ abɛ kroko akɛ, "Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ mãsha ni yoo ko kɔ ni akɛhɔ mã tsesei etɛ̃ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni fɛɛ sha."
Abɛbuai amli Yesu kɛ asafoi lɛ wie nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ ewieee nɔ ko akɛ ja yɛ abɛbuai amli kɛkɛ;
koni nɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, "Magble minaa yɛ abɛbuai amli; magba nii ni akɛtee kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jie asafoi lɛ agbɛ ni etee shīa lɛ. Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ ŋmɔ lɛ mli jwɛi lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi."
Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Wui kpakpai adulɔ lɛ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ;
ŋmɔ lɛ ji je lɛ; wui kpakpai lɛ ji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli bii lɛ; jwɛi lɛ ji mɔ fɔŋ lɛ bii lɛ;
henyɛlɔ ni du amɛ lɛ ji abonsam; ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ ji je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ; ni ŋmaakpalɔi lɛ ji ŋwɛi bɔfoi.
Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni abuaa jwɛi anaa ni akɛ la shãa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee yɛ je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaatsu ebɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛaabua nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔnii fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii ni shiɔ mla lɛ anaa kɛaaje emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli,
ni amɛkɛ amɛaawo la flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli; jɛi yaaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.
No ni jalɔi lɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ hulu yɛ amɛ-Tsɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli. Mɔ ni Yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ enu!"
"Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ jwetri ni akɛtee yɛ abɔɔ mli, ni be ni mɔ ko yana lɛ, ekɛtee, ni no he miishɛɛ ni ena hewɔ lɛ etee ni eyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhe nakai abɔɔ lɛ.
"Asaŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ guɔyelɔ ko ni taoɔ adiagbai fɛɛfɛji,
ni be ni eyana adiagba kome ni jra wa lɛ, etee ni eyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhe.
"Asaŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ yaa ni afɔ̃ yɛ ŋshɔ mli ni edu loi srɔtoi fɛɛ eko;
ni be ni eyi lɛ, wolɛi lɛ gbla kɛba shīa nɔ, ni amɛtra shi amɛbua ekpakpai lɛ anaa amɛwo kpaii amli; shi nii ni ehiii lɛ amɛshɛrɛ amɛshwie.
Nakai nɔŋŋ abafee yɛ je lɛ naagbee lɛ. Ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ aaaje kpo aba ni amɛaabahala mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ yɛ jalɔi lɛ ateŋ.
ni amɛkɛ amɛ aaawo la flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli. Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi."
Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛna nii nɛɛ fɛɛ ashishi lo?" Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ!
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "No hewɔ lɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ fɛɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni afee lɛ kaselɔ, ahã ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, etamɔ shīatsɛ ko ni jieɔ nii hei kɛ nii memeji kɛjeɔ ejwetrii lɛ mli."
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe abɛbuai nɛɛ anaa lɛ, eje jɛi;
ni be ni eba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii yɛ amɛkpeehe lɛ, ni ehã amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ mɔnɛ yana nilee kɛ hewalɛnii nɛɛ kɛjɛ?
Ani jeee ŋaalɔ lɛ bi lɛ nɛ? Ani jeee enyɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Maria lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii ni yi Yakobo kɛ Yose kɛ Simon kɛ Yuda lɛ?
Ni enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ, ani jeee amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ wɔ yɔɔ? Nɛɛgbɛ mɔnɛ yana nii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ mɔ?
Ni etsɔ̃ pãmpi ehã amɛ. Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Abuɔ gbalɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ja lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe kɛkɛ."
Ni akɛni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ lɛ etsuuu hewalɛnii pii ko yɛ jɛi.
14: Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ lumɔ Herode nu Yesu he sane;
ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ni; lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, no hewɔ ni hewalɛi lɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ emli nɛɛ."
Ekɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ emɔ Yohane efi lɛ ni ewo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ Herodia, enyɛmi Filipo ŋa lɛ hewɔ.
Efee enɛ, ejaakɛ Yohane kɛɔ lɛ akɛ; "Ejaaa gbɛ akɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ."
Ni kulɛ etao akɛ gbe lɛ, shi eeshe asafo lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛbuɔ Yohane gbalɔ.
Shi be ni ayeɔ Herode fɔmɔ gbi lɛ, Herodia biyoo lɛ bajo yɛ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni efee Herode fɛo;
No hewɔ lɛ ekã kitã ekɛwo lɛ shi akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeebi lɛ lɛ eeeeha lɛ.
Ni enyɛ wo lɛ ŋaa, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso ofɔ̃ kã mli ohã mi yɛ biɛ!"
Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi ekitãi ni ekãmɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tra niyenii ashi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ akɛhã lɛ.
Ni etsu ayafo Yohane yitso yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
Ni akɛ eyitso lɛ fɔ̃ kã mli kɛba, ni akɛhã oblayoo lɛ, ni ekɛyahã enyɛ.
Ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ ba amɛbawo egbonyo lɛ ni amɛyafu, ni amɛtee amɛyakɛɛ Yesu.
Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, etsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli kɛje jɛi kɛtee ŋanɔ he ko banee. Ni be ni asafoi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛje maji lɛ amli amɛnyiɛ amɛnane kɛtiu lɛ.
Ni be ni Yesu kpleke lɛ, ebana mɛi babaoo, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ, ni etsa amɛhelatsɛmɛi lɛ.
Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ. "Ŋanɔ ji biɛ, ni je miina; jiemɔ asafoi lɛ agbɛ ni amɛya akrowai lɛ amli ni amɛyahe niyenii amɛye."
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ehiaaa akɛ amɛaatee; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nii amɛyea."
Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nɔ pɛ ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ biɛ ji aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ."
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkɛbaahãa mi yɛ biɛ!"
Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtratra shi yɛ jwɛi lɛ anɔ. Ni eklɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ, ni ekwɛ ŋwɛì ni ejɔɔ nɔ; ni ekumɔ aboloi lɛ amli ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ hu kɛhã asafoi lɛ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛye, ni amɛtrɔ, ni amɛklɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Shi mɛi ni ye lɛ aaashɛ hii akpei enumɔ, sro yei kɛ gbekɛbii.
Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu tsirɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ayisɛɛ, ni amɛbote lɛlɛ lɛ mli ni amɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛya ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, kɛyashi eeewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ.
Ni be ni ewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko baneee ni eyasɔle. Be ni je na lɛ, ekometoo eyɔɔ jɛi.
Shi lɛlɛ lɛ eshɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ momo ni ŋshɔkei lɛ miihɛlɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ eekpee kɔɔyɔɔ.
Ni maŋkɛ̃ hima, aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ loo nɔ mli lɛ, Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, amɛtsui fã, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Sisaŋ!" Ni amɛblɔ kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.
Shi amrɔ lɛ Yesu fã enaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛnaa tsui, miŋ; nyɛkashea gbeyei."
Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji bo ni lɛ, fã mi koni matsɔ̃ nu lɛ hiɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ."
Ni ekɛɛ, "Ba!" Ni Petro je lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni enyiɛ nu lɛ hiɛ kɛmiiya Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Shi be ni ena akɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ miitswa waa lɛ, eshe gbeyei ni ebɔ̃i shiumɔ, ni ebo ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ mi!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu kpã enine mli esɔo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bo ni ohemɔkɛyeli faaa, mɛni hewɔ oje ŋwane?"
Ni be ni amɛbote lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa.
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ bakoto lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji o lɛɛlɛŋ!"
Ni be ni amɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ, amɛba Genesarat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni jɛibii lɛ yoo lɛ lɛ, amɛtsu atee jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni ayaŋɔ helatsɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ;
ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ehã amɛna etade lɛ naamuu lɛ he amɛtra kɛkɛ; ni mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni tra he lɛ he wa amɛ kwraa.
15: Kɛkɛ ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi ni jɛ Yerusalem lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ,
"Mɛɛ hewɔ ni okaselɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ? Ejaakɛ amɛfɔɔɔ amɛdɛ̃ dani amɛyeɔ nii."
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ. "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, 'Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ! Kɛ 'Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!'
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ akɛ, nɔ ni kulɛ ooona yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, mikɛke Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekawo etsɛ loo enyɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ nyɛgu Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ.
Osatofoi! Gbɛ naa pɛ Yesaia gba yɛ nyɛhe akɛ,
'Maŋ nɛɛ kɛ amɛnaabu woɔ mi; shi amɛtsui etsi ehe kɛjɛ mihe kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Shi yakatswaa amɛjaa mi lɛ, Ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni ji gbɔmɛi akitãi.'"
Ni etsɛ asafo lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa toi ni nyɛna shishi!.
Jeee nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ buleɔ gbɔmɔ; shi moŋ nɔ ni jeɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, no buleɔ gbɔmɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni esaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ole akɛ be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, ewo amɛ mlila waa?"
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Tso fɛɛ tso ni jeee miŋwɛi-Tsɛ lɛ tɛoɔ lɛ, fã aaafã.
Nyɛkadia amɛsɛɛ! Shwiliafoi ni tsɔ̃ɔ shwilafoi agbɛ ji amɛ; ni kɛ shwilafoi miitsɔ̃ɔ shwilafo gbɛ lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaagbee bu mli."
Ni Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ abɛ nɛɛ shishi!"
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, "Ani nyɛ hu nyɛnako nii ashishi lolo?
Ani nyɛkpako shi akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, musuŋ eyaa ni ajieɔ awoɔ tiafi mli?
Shi nii ni jɛɔ daaŋ jeɔ kpo lɛ, tsui mli ejɛɔ, ni nomɛi buleɔ mɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ tsui mli ni susumɔi fɔ̃ɔji, gbɔmɔgbee, gblãfitemɔ, ajwamaŋbɔɔ, juu, amale odaseyeli kɛ oshekuyeli jɛɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ; shi dɛ̃ ni afɔɔɔ dani ayeɔ nii lɛ, no buleee mɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni yesu je jɛi eyiŋ etee Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ.
Ni naa, Kanaanyoo ko jɛ jɛi niiaŋ nɔŋŋ bablɔ ekɛɛ, "Naa mi mɔbɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, David Bi; mibiyoo miina nɔ kɛ mumɔ fɔŋ."
Shi efooo edaaŋ. Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba bakpa lɛ fai akɛ, "Wo lɛ gbɛ ni eya, shi eeblɔ kɛnyiɛ wɔsɛɛ!"
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Israel we toi ni elaaje lɛ ŋɔɔ kɛkɛ atsu mi."
Shi yoo lɛ ba bakulã shi yɛ ehiɛ ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, feemɔ he eko ohã mi!"
Shi ekɛɛ, "Ejaa akɛ aŋɔɔ bii aboloo lɛ ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ shifɔ̃ji abii."
"Shi ekɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ mli moŋ; shi bɛ shifɔ̃ji abii lɛ hu yeɔ fufuji ni shwieɔ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi lɛ eko!"
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "O yoo, ohemɔkɛyeli da!" Afee ahã o tamɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ!" Ni atsa ebiyoo lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ni Yesu je jɛi eba Galilea ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Ni ekwɔ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyata shi yɛ jɛi.
Ni asafoi pii ba eŋɔɔ: amɛhiɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛ obubuafoi kɛ shwilafoi kɛ mumuii kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii, ni amɛkɛ amɛ bashwie enaji anaa; ni atsa amɛ.
Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, be ni amɛna akɛ mumuii miiwie, ni obubuafoi ahe ewa amɛ, ni akpaketsɛmɛi miinyiɛ, ni shwilafoi miina nii lɛ; amɛwo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.

Shi Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba ni ekɛɛ, "Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ asafoi lɛ ahe, akɛ amɛkɛ me ehi shi gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛyeɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ miwoɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛ musuŋ hɔ̃mɔ, ni ekolɛ amɛyatɔ biti yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ."
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ wɔbaana aboloi ni fa pii yɛ, yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ, bɔ ni aaashɛ asafo babaoo nɛɛ naa?"
Ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, "Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?" Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Kpawo, kɛ loi bibii fioo ko."
Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtra shi yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Ni eklɔ aboloia kpawo lɛ kɛ loi lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛhã asafoi lɛ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛye ni amɛtrɔ; ni amɛklɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ flɔtoi kpawo obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Mɛi ni ye lɛ ayibɔ ji hii akpei ejwɛ, sro yei kɛ gbekɛbii.
Ni ewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ, ni ebote lɛlɛ mli, ni eba Magadan niiaŋ.
16: Ni Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ baka Yesu, amɛbi lɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ŋwɛi okadi ko.
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Gbekɛ mli lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Jeŋ baatse, ejaakɛŋwɛi etsu."
Ni leebi lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Ŋmɛnɛ nyɔŋmɔ baanɛ', ejaakɛ ŋwɛi etsu ni ehiɛ eha. Osatofoi, nyɛle ŋwɛi atatuiaŋ nibii ashishitsɔɔ̃mɔ, shi bei lɛ ahe okadii lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ!
Yinɔbii fɔ̃ɔji kɛ gblãfitelɔi miitao okadi, shi ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko, akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ." Ni eshi amɛ eyiŋ etee.
Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ yaa ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ kpa nɔ ni amɛŋɔ aboloo amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ amasha lɛ he!"
Shi amɛwiewie he yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, "Aboloo ni wɔhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ!"
Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa! Mɛni hewɔ nyɛwiewieɔ yɛ nyɛyteŋ akɛ aboloo ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ?
Nyɛnako nii anaa lolo? Ni nyɛsaa nyɛkaii mɛi akpei enumɔ lɛ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ kafui abɔ ni nyɛklɔ lɛ,
aloo mɛi akpei ejwɛ lɛ aboloi kpawo lɛ kɛ flɔtɔi abɔ ni nyɛklɔ lɛ?
Te tɛŋŋ ni nyɛnaaa naa akɛ jeee aboloo he mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ? Nyɛhiɛ ahiã nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ amsha lɛ he!"
Agbɛnɛ amɛyoo akɛ jeee aboloo masha hewɔ ekɛɛ amɛhiɛ ahi amɛhe nɔ lɛ, shi moŋ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔŋŋ.
Shi be ni Yesu ba Kaisarea Filipi niiaŋ lɛ, ebi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ mɛi kɛɔ akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ji?"
Amɛkɛɛ akɛ "Mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ni; ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia ni; ni mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ Yeremia loo gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni."
Ebi amɛ akɛ, "Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ miji?"
Simon Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Boji Kristo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Bi lɛ!"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ajɔɔ o, Simon, Yona bi; ejaakɛ jeee heloo kɛ lá jie enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ o, shi moŋ mi-Tsɛ ni Yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Ni mi hu mikɛɛ o akɛ, boji Petro lɛ, ni nɛkɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ nɔ matswa misafo lɛ mama, ni gbohiiaje agboi lɛ nyɛŋ enɔ aye.
Ni maŋɔ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ naa Samfei lɛ mahã o; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofɛnɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛnɛ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni etswa ekaselɔi lɛ anaa mã akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko akɛ lɛji Kristo lɛ."

Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ nɔ lɛ Yesu bɔ̃i ekasealɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ ja etee Yerusalem ni eyana amanehulu pii yɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni agbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ ete shi.
Ni Petro ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee afa, ebɔi lɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ ekɛɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ akahã enɛ ba mli, Nuŋtsɔ; enɛ akagbale o fɔ̃ɔŋfɔ̃!"
Shi etsɔ̃ ehe ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, "Jee mihiɛ, Satan! Ootɔ̃tɔ̃ minane; ejaakɛ ojwɛŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahe, shi gbɔmɛi anii ahe moŋ ojwɛŋɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ Mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, enine aaashɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ baana, kɛji enine shɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, shi elaaje esusuma lɛ? Aloo mɛni gbɔmɔ kɛaahã ni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma lɛ?
Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaba yɛ e-Tsɛ anumnyam lɛ mli kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ; ni no mli lɛ eeewo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiba yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
17: Gbii ekpaa sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni ekɛ amɛ tee gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ekɛ amɛ pɛ.
Ni egbɔmɔtso su tsake yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ehiɛ kpɛ tamɔ hulu, ni etadei lɛ yɛ tamɔ la.
Ni naa, Mose kɛ Elia bajie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ miiwie.
Ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, ehi akɛ wɔyɛ biɛ! Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, mafee buui etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ, onɔ ekome, Kɛ Mose nɔ ekome, kɛ Elia nɔ ekome."
Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, atatu halaŋŋ ko bakete amɛnɔ, ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni minaa ehe tsui lɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi!"
Ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.
Ni Yesu ba ni ebatra amɛhe ekɛɛ, "Nyɛtea shi, nyɛkashea gbeyei!"
Shi be ni amɛwo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja Yesu kome pɛ.
Ni be ni amɛkplekeɔ gɔŋ lɛ, Yesu tswa amɛnaa mã ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkagbaa ninaa nɛɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔa mɔ ko, akɛ ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ dã."
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ja Elia eba dã lɛ?
Yesu here ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɔ Elia miiba, ni ebaato nibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ ekoŋŋ;
shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Elia eba momo, ni amɛyooo lɛ, shi moŋ amɛfee lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu baana amanehulu yɛ amɛdɛŋ."
Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ kɔ sɛɛ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ he ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ.
Be ni amɛshɛ asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, nuu ko ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakula shi yɛ ehiɛ,
ni ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, naa mibi nuu lɛ mɔbɔ, shi eeye gbligbli ni eena nɔ po ni ehiii, ejaakɛ bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee la mli, ni bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee nu mli.
Ni mikɛ lɛ ba okaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ amɛtsa."
Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, "Ao yinɔbii ni heee yeee ni bɛ amɛŋlɛnɔ! Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi? Nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa biɛ nyɛbaahã mi!"
Ni Yesu fã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yi; ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ jɛ emli je kpo, ni gbekɛ lɛ he wa lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ yɛ afã, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛɛba wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ lɛ wɔfã lɛ?"

Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni faaa lɛ hewɔŋ. Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni tamɔ sinapi wu lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ akɛ, 'Fãa yɛ biɛ kɛya jɛi!' Ni eeefã; ni nɔ ko bɛ ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛfee.
(Shi nɛkɛ henɔ nɛɛ, anyɛɛɛ lɛ afã akɛ ja sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ naa kɛkɛ)"
Shi be ni amɛkpaa Galilea lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Abaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ,
Ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi." Ni amɛwerɛ ho amɛhe tsɔ̃.
Be ni amɛba Karpernaum lɛ, oniatsulɔ lɛ Petro ŋɔɔ babi akɛ, "Ani nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ wooo Sɔlemɔtsu onia lɛ?"
Ekɛɛ, "Ewoɔ." Ni be ni eba shīa lɛ, Yesu tsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ, "Te osusumɔ tɛŋŋ Simom? Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, namɛi adɛŋ amɛheɔ too loo onia yɛ? Yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛbii adɛŋ loo mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ?"
Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ." Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɛlɛ bii lɛ yeɔ amɛhe mɔ.

Shi bɔ ni afee ni wɔkato amɛ pãmpi lɛ, yaa ŋshɔ lɛ naa oyãfɔ̃ kpoŋ, ni loo klɛŋklɛŋ ni aaabakɔ kpoŋ lɛ, sha lɛ, ni kɛ ogbɛ edaaŋ lɛ, ooona shika ni naa shiɔ yii enyɔ; kɔ ni okɛhã amɛ, ohã mi kɛ o fɛɛ."
18: Nakai ŋmlatswaa lɛ mli lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli?"
Ni Yesu tsɛ gbɛkɛ bibioo ko kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛteŋ,
ni ekɛɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛtsakeee ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbekɛbii bibii lɛ, nyɛboteŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa.
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa ehe shi tamɔ gbekɛ nɛɛ lɛ, lɛji agbo fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛ fioo kome ni tamɔ mɔnɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi.
"Shi mɔ ni tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ nane lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni akɛ lɛ yakwo ŋshɔ.
Kpoo hã je lɛ yɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ saji ahewɔ! Ejaakɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ saji lɛ baaba kɛ̃ moŋ nɛ; shi kpoo hã gbɔmɔ ni nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ enɔ̃ kɛbaa lɛ!
Shi kɛji onine loo onane miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni oyɛ niji enyɔ loo naji enyɔ ni aaashɛ o afɔ̃ naanɔ la lɛ mli.
Ni kɛji ohiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, fãa yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ hiŋmɛi kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni oyɛ hiŋmɛii enyɔ ni aaashɛ o ofɔ̃ abonsamiiaje."
"Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkabu mɛi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ejeee Mɔ ko; ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, amɛbofoi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kwɛɔ mi-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ daa.
(Shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba nɔ ni elaaje lɛ yiwalaheremɔ.)
"Te nyɛsususmɔ tɛŋŋ, kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi oha ni amɛteŋ ekome du gbɛ lɛ, ani eshiŋ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ ni eya eyatao nɔ ni edu gbɛ lɛ?
Ni kɛji ena lɛ lɛ, anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, emii shɛɔ ehe yɛ no ne fe nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu nu eduko gbɛ lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome laajeɔ."
"Shi kɛji onyɛmi ko tɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, yaa ni oyatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yi enyɔ kɛkɛ. Kɛji ebo o toi lɛ, nyɛmi efee nyɛmi.
Shi kɛji ebooo o toi lɛ, kɛ mɔ kome loo mɛi enyɔ afata ohe, koni odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ daaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi.
Ni kɛji amɛ hu ebooo amɛ toi lɛ, yaakɛɛ asafo lɛ ni kɛji ebooo asafo lɛ hu toi lɛ, buu lɛ tamɔ wɔŋjalɔ kɛ toohelɔ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaafi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ji nyɛaafɛne yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛnɛ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Asaŋ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ kpãa gbee yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni amɛbiɔ lɛ he lɛ, mi-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ aaafe ahã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ he ni mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ, yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, miyɛ amɛtɛŋ yɛ jɛi".
Kɛkɛ ni Petro ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, shii enyiɛ minyɛmi atɔ̃ minɔ ni mikɛfa lɛ? Kɛyashi shii kpawo lo."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mikɛɛɛ o akɛ kɛyashi shii kpawo; shi moŋ shii kpawo toi nyɔŋmai kpawo.
No hewɔ lɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛ yeli tamɔ maŋtsɛ ko ni taoɔ ekɛ etsuji ababu akɔŋtaa.
Ni be ni ebɔ̃i buu lɛ, akɛ mɔ ko ni hiɛ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ talentai akpei nyɔŋma ba eŋɔɔ.
Shi akɛni ebɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛaawo lɛ lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ fã akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ, ni akɛwo nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ho gbee enaji anaa ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo o nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!"
Ni tsulɔ nɛɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ ni eŋmɛɛ ehe, ni ekɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ ke lɛ,
Shi be ni nakai tsulɔ lɛ je kpo lɛ eyana enanemɛi tsulɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ talentai oha; ni emɔ lɛ emia esɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ, 'Wo mi nyɔmɔ ni ohiɛ mi lɛ!'
Kɛkɛ ni enaanyo tsulɔ lɛ ho kula shi ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, 'Too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo o nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!'
Shi lɛ lɛ ekplɛɛɛ; shi moŋ eyawo lɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeewo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Shi be ni enanemɛi tsuji lɛ na nɔ ni ba lɛ, edɔ maɛ tsɔ̃, ni amɛbagba amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
kɛkɛ ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ hã eyatsɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsulɔ fɔŋ! Akɛni okpa mi fai hewɔ lɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ nyɔmɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ ke o.
Ani kulɛ jeee bo hu ogbɛnaa ji akɛ ona onaanyo tsulɔ lɛ mɔmɔ, bɔ ni mi hu mina o mɔbɔ lɛ?'
Ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ mli fu, ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni apiŋ lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeba wo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ mi-Tsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hu aaafee nyɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi tɔ̃mɔ ekeee lɛ kɛjɛɛɛ etsuiŋ lɛ."
19: Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔ nɛɛ anaa lɛ, eje Galilea eba Yuda kpokpoi lɛ anɔ yɛ Yordan sɛɛ;
ni mɛi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ ni etsatsaa amɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsɔ̃ lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ "Ani eja akɛ nuu shwieɔ eŋa yɛ sane fɛɛ sane hewɔ?"
Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛkaneko akɛ, mɔ ni bɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, nuu kɛ yoo ebɔ amɛ?
Ni ekɛɛ, 'Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome lɛ.'
Belɛ agbɛnɛ amɛjeee mɛi enyɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ heloo kome; no hewɔ lɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsa lɛ, akahã gbɔmɔ miigbla mli.''
Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni Mose wo kitã akɛ ahã shwiemɔ wolo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ?"
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Nyɛtsuiwalɛ hewɔ ni Mose hã nyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛshwie nyɛŋamɛi lɛ; shi shishijee lɛ mli lɛ ebɛ nakai.
Shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee ajwamaŋbɔɔ hewɔ jɛ ni eeeshwie eŋa ni eyaŋɔ yoo kroko lɛ efite gblã; (ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ yoo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ, lɛ hu efiteɔ gblã.")
Ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nɛkɛ nuu kɛ eŋa sane yɔɔ lɛ." belɛ ehiii akɛ aŋɔɔ yoo mɔ?"
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Jeee mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ mli amɔ, ja mɛi ni akɛhã lɛ kɛkɛ.

Ejaakɛ osaii komɛi yɛ ni afɔ amɛ nakai kɛjɛ amɛnyɛmɛi amusu mli; ni osaii komɛi yɛ ni gbɔmɛi sa amɛ; ni osaii lɛ ekrokomɛi hu yɛ ni ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsa amɛhe. Mɔ ni aaanyɛ mli amɔ lɛ, emɔ mli!"
Kɛkɛ ni akɛ gbekɛbii bibii ba eŋɔɔ, koni ekɛ eniji ashwie amɛnɔ ni esɔle ehã amɛ. Shi ekaselɔi lɛ fãmɔ amɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa gbɛkɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ."
Ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ; ni eje jɛi.
Ni mɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, mɛɛ nɔ kpakpa po mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?"
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ. "Mɛɛba obiɔ mi nɔ kpakpa he sane." Mɔ kome yɔɔ ni ji mɔ kpakpa (Lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ). Shi kɛji ootao akɛ abote wala mli lɛ, yɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ."
Ebi lɛ akɛ, "Te nii ni jiŋ?": Ni Yesu kɛɛ, "Kaagbe gbɔmɔ; kaafite gblã; kaaju; kaaye amale odase;
wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ; kɛ suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛtsɛ ohe lɛ."
Oblanyo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ miye nɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi. Mɛni shwɛɔ mi lolo?"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji ootao akɛ ohi kɛwula shi lɛ, yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ nii ni oyɔɔ lɛ, ni okɛhã ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba obanyiɛ misɛɛ."
Shi be ni oblanyoo lɛ nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee kɛ dɔlɛ ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ewa hã niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi asaŋ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ejraaa hãaa yoma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ejraa hãa niiatsɛ ekɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ."
Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe tsɔ̃ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?
Shi Yesu kwɛ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Gbɔmɛi agbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛŋ enɛ afee; shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaanyɛ nii fɛɛ afee."
Kɛkɛ ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ 'Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi nii fɛɛ, ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ; belɛ mɛni wɔbaana? "

Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛ misɛɛ nɛɛ, be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaata enumnyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ jɛŋ hee lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛaatra sɛ̃ii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, ni nyɛaakojo Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshi shīai loo nyɛmimɛi hii loo nyɛmimɛi loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo ŋa loo bii shikpɔji yɛ migbɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, aaato lɛ najiaŋ toi oha, ni eeena naanɔ wala.
Shi klɛŋklɛŋ bii pii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpee bii, ni sɛɛkpee bii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ bii."
20: "Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ nuu shiãtsɛ ko ni je kpo maŋkɛ̃ mra ni eyabɔ nitsulɔ apaa kɛya ewaintrom mli.
Ni be ni ekɛ nitsulɔ lɛ eye naa denario kome jenamɔ lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ kɛtee ewaintrom lɛ mli.
Ni kɛbaa ŋmlɛ nɛɛhu mli lɛ, eje kpo ekoŋŋ ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi damɔ shi eflo yɛ jaa lɛ nɔ;
ni ekɛɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi hu akɛ, 'Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli, ni nɔ ni sa lɛ, mahã nyɛ,' ni amɛtee.
Asaŋ kɛbaa ŋmlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli kɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli mli lɛ eje kpo, ni eyafee nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛbaa gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ mli lɛ eje kpo ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi hu damɔ shi eflo, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, 'Mɛɛba ni nyɛdamɔ shi eflo yɛ biɛ jenamɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ?"
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Akɛni mɔ ko ebɔko wɔ apaa lɛ hewɔŋ, Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli."
"Agbɛnɛ be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, waintromtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsulɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, 'Tsɛ nitsulɔi lɛ ni owo amɛ nyɔmɔ, ni oblɔ̃i kɛjɛ sɛɛkpee bii lɛ anɔ kɛyashi klɛŋklɛŋ bii lɛ anɔ.'
Ni be ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ bii lɛ ba lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛna denario komekome.
Ni be ni klɛŋklɛŋ bii lɛ ba lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ amɛaana fe nakai; shi amɛ hu amɛa denario komekome.
Shi be ni eshɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ, amɛshɛ tɔkemɔ kɛ shīatsɛ lɛ woo.
akɛ, 'Sɛɛkpee bii nɛɛ; ŋmlɛtswaa kome kɛkɛ amɛtsu nii, ni ohã amɛ kɛ wɔ ni wɔtsu nii jenamɔ ni etɔ wɔ ni latsaa etsa wɔ lɛ fɛɛ pɛ!'
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome akɛ, 'Naanyo, mifeko o efɔŋ ko; ani jeee denario okɛ mi ye naa?
Ŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji onɔ lɛ ni oya. Shi miisumɔ akɛ mahã sɛɛkpee mɔ nɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mihã o lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Aloo mibɛ hegbɛ akɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minii feɔ nɔ ni misusmɔɔ? Ani mimlihilɛ lɛ hewɔ ohiŋmɛi etsu nɛɛ?
Nɛkɛ ni sɛɛkpeebiii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii, ni klɛŋklɛŋbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpeebii; (ejaakɛ atsɛ mɛi pii, shi mɛi fioo ahala).
Ni be ni Yesu yaa Yerusalem lɛ, ekɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tee afã yɛ gbɛte lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ nigii akɛ,
"Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalem, ni akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaawo osɔfonukpai kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛaabu lɛ gbele fɔ.
Ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaahã jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ni amɛye ehe fɛo ni amɛkɛ kplebii ayi lɛ ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi."
Kɛkɛ ni Zebedeo bii lɛ anyɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakula shi ni eba lɛ nɔ ko.
Ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ "Mɛni otaoɔ?" Ehere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Kɛɛmɔ ni mibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ata oninejurɔ nɔ, ni mɔ kome hu ata obɛku nɔ yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ bii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛleee nɔ ni nyɛbiɔ lɛ. Ani nyɛaanyɛ kpulu ni mibana nu lɛ nyɛnu?" Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔɔnyɛ."
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mikpulu lɛ nyɛaanu moŋ shi mininejurɔ kɛ mibɛku nɔ tamɔ lɛ, ejeee minɔ ni mikɛhãa, shi moŋ mɛi ni mi-Tsɛ esaa eto amɛ lɛ anɔŋ."
Ni be ni mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ nu lɛ, amɛmli wo nyɛmimɛi enyɔ lɛ la.
No hewɔ lɛ Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Nyɛle akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lumɛi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni amɛteŋ gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ hu yɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ agbo atsɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ;
ni mɔ ni taoɔ nyɛteŋ onukpa atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛtsulɔ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaa ni esɔmɔ lɛ, shi eba sɔ̃ɔmɔ moŋ ni ekɛ esusuma lɛ ahã yɛ pii akpɔ̃mɔ hewɔ lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛjɛ Yeriko amɛyaa lɛ, asafo baboo nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni hii shwilafoi enyɔ tra gbɛ lɛ toi, ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Yesu miiho lɛ, amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!"
Shi asafo lɛ famɔ amɛyi akɛ amɛmua amɛnaa; shi amɛblɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!"
Ni Yesu wa damɔ shi ni etsɛ amɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã nyɛ?
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ agble wɔhiŋmɛii lɛ."
Ni Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ, ni etra amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe, ni amrɔ lɛ amɛna nii, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
21: Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Yerusalem ni amɛshɛ Betfage yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yesu tsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ mli, ni amrɔ lɛ nyɛaana teji yoo ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi kɛ ebi; nyɛfɛnea amɛ nyɛbaahã mi.
Ni kɛ mɔ ko bi nyɛ sane ko lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, 'Amɛhe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;' ni amrɔ lɛ eeehã nyɛkɛ amɛ aba."
Shi afee enɛ fɛɛ koni nɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ,
"Nyɛkɛa Zion biyoo lɛ akɛ, naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ. Ehe jɔ, ni eta teji nɔ kɛ teji ni ji nitsumɔ kooloo lɛ bi nɔ."
Ni kaselɔi lɛ tee amɛyafee bɔ ni Yesu fã amɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ teji lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ ba ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei lɛ shwie amɛnɔ, ni eho ata nɔ.
Ni mɛi pii kɛ amɛtadei ha gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi krokomɛi hu flɔ tsei aniji amɛkɛshwie gbɛ lɛ nɔ;
ni asafoi ni nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ blɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Hosiana David Bi lɛ! Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ mli lɛ! Hosiana yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!"
Ni be ni Ebote Yerusalem lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bu hoo amɛkɛɛ, "Namɔ nɛ?"
Shi asafoi lɛ kɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ ji Yesu, gbalɔ lɛ ni jɛ Nazaret yɛ Galilea lɛ."
Ni Yesu tee Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni eyashwie mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni etsirɛ shikatsakelɔi lɛ akplɔ̃i lɛ kɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ asɛii lɛ etswiatswia shi.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Aŋma akɛ, 'Aaatsɛ miwe lɛ Sɔlemɔwe', shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu."
Shi shwilafoi kɛ obubuafoi ba eŋɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni etsa amɛ.
Shi be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ na naakpɛɛnii ni efee kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ ni blɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ akɛ, "Hosiana David Bi." lɛ, amɛmli wo la,
ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Oonu nɔ ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɔ nɛɛ lo?" Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Hɛɛ, ani nyɛkaneko dã akɛ, 'Abifabii kɛ fufɔbii anaa osaa yijiemɔ oto yɛ'?
Shi eshi amɛ eje maŋ lɛ mli etee Betania, ni eyawɔ jɛi.
Shi leebi be ni eku esɛɛ eyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Ni ena agbãmitso ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ he, ni etsi eshɛ he, shi enaaa nɔ ko yɛ nɔ akɛ ja bai kɛkɛ; ni ekɛɛ tso lɛ akɛ, "Owoŋ yibii ko dɔŋŋ gbi ko gbi ko!" Ni agbãmitso lɛ glã amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, "Te afee tɛŋŋ ni agbãmitso lɛ glã amrɔ nɔŋŋ?

Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛjee ŋwane lɛ, jeee nɔ ni afee agbãmitso nɛɛ kɛkɛ nyɛaafee; shi kɛji nyɛkɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ tete akɛ, 'Fãa ni oyagbee ŋshɔŋ lɛ' eeba mli nakai.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaasɔle nyɛbi kɛ hɔmɔkɛyeli lɛ, nyɛnine aaashɛ nɔ."
Ni be ni eba Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ hewɔ ofeɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, ni namɔ hã o nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ?"
Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mi hu mibabi nyɛ sane kome, ni kɛji nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, mi hu matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni mikɛfeɔ nibii nɛ.
Yohane Baptisimɔ lɛ, nɛɛgbɛ ejɛ? ŋwɛi ejɛ, loo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ?" Ni amɛtaoɔ mli yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, "Kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, 'Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛheee Yohane nyɛyeee mɔ?'
Ni kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ, no hu wɔmiishe asafo lɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ buɔ Yohane gbalɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛhere Yesu nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔleee." Lɛ hu ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Belɛ mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ hewɔ ni mifeɔ nibii nɛɛ mɔ."
"Shi agbɛnɛ te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ? Nuu ko yɛ bii enyɔ; ni etee mɔ kome ŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, 'Mibi; ŋmɛnɛ yaatsu nii yɛ miwaintrom lɛ mli.'
Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, 'Miyaaa.' Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ eshwa ehe, ni etee.
Ni etee mɔ kroko lɛ hu ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ. Shi lɛ lɛ, ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, 'Ataa, matee!' Shi eyaaa.

Te mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni fee nɔ ni amɛtsɛ lɛ sumɔɔŋ?" Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsutsumɔ lɛ ni." Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ toohelɔi lɛ kɛ ajwãmaŋi lɛ miitsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛmiiya Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ Yohane ba nyɛnɔɔ yɛ jalɛ gbɛ lɔ nɔ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee; shi tóohelɔi kɛ ajwamaŋi lɛ he lɛ amɛye. Ni fee sɛɛ, be ni nyɛyoo hu lɛ, nyɛshwaaa nyɛhe tete, koni nyɛhe lɛ nyɛye."
"Nyɛboa abɛ kroko hu toi," Yesu kɛɛ, "Shīatsɛ ko yɛ, ni efee waintrom, ni efo afabaŋ ewo he, ni etsa wainbu yɛ mli, ni emã mɔ̃ɔ yɛ mli; ni ekɛhã hulɔi apaayeli; ni edom.
Ni be ni wainyibii kpamɔ be lɛ shɛ lɛ, etsu etsuji kɛtee hulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, akɛ amɛyaŋɔ eyibii lɛ eko amɛbahã lɛ.
Ni hulɔi lɛ mɔmɔ etsuji lɛ, ni amɛyi mɔ kome, ni amɛgbe mɔ kome, ni amɛtswia mɔ kome hu tɛi.
Asaŋ etsu tsuji krokomɛi ni fa fe tsutsu bii lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ etsu ebinuu kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ ekɛɛ, 'Mibi lɛ, lɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ aaasɔ lɛ'
Shi hulɔi lɛ, be ni amɛna binuu lɛ moŋ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, 'Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ! Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ, koni wɔŋɔ egboshinii lɛ."
Ni amɛmɔ lɛ amɛtsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛjɛ waintrom lɛ mli, ni amɛyagbe lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ, kɛji waintromtsɛ lɛ ba lɛ, mɛni eeefee hulɔi nɛɛ?"
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Eeekpãtã gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji nɛɛ ahiɛ butuu ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã hulɔi krokomɛi apaayeli, mɛi ni kɛ yibii aaabahã lɛ yɛ be ni sa mli."
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛkaneko yɛ Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli dã akɛ, "Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ. Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ enɛ jɛ, ni eyɛ naaakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiŋmɛiiaŋ?'
No hewɔ lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ abaashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ; ni akɛaahã jeŋmaŋ ko ni woɔ yibii.
(Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbee tɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ emli aaatsrɛ; shi mɔ ni tɛ lɛ aaagbee enɔ lɛ, eeegblɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.")
Ni be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ nu ebɛi lɛ, amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛ amɛhe ewieɔ lɛ.
Ni kulɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ; shi amɛyashe asafoi lɛ agbeyei, ejaakɛ asafoi lɛ buɔ lɛ gbalɔ.
22: Yesu wo enaa nɔ ekɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ yɛ amɛbuai amli ekɛɛ.
"Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ko ni kpee yoo ehã ebinuu.
Ni etsu etsuji akɛ amɛyatsɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ kɛba yookpeemɔ lɛ, shi mɛi lɛ emiii baa.
Esaa etsu tsuji krokomɛi ekɛ, 'Nyɛyakɛa mɛi ni akpee lɛ akɛ, naa, migbe miniyenii lɛ anaa; agbe mitsinai lɛ kɛ milɛɛ kooloi lɛ, ni agbe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ naa: nyɛbaa yoo kpeemɔ lɛ!"
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛbuuu po, ni amɛtee amɛhei srɔtoi, mɔ kome tee ebɔɔ mli, ni mɔ kroko hu tee eguɔyeli.
Ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ mɔ̃mɔ etsuji lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛ niseniianii, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Shi be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ nu lɛ, emli fu, ni etsu etabilɔi, ni amɛyagbe nɛkɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi nɛɛ, ni ashã amɛmaŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, 'Ato yookpeemɔ lɛ he nii agbe naa moŋ, shi mɛi ni akpee lɛ amɛsaaa.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyaa ŋmaŋmashai lɛ anɔ, ni mɛi abɔ ni nyɛaana lɛ, nyɛkpea amɛ kɛbaa yookpeemɔ lɛ.'
Ni tsuji lɛ je kpo tee gbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛyabua mɛi fɛɛ ni amɛna lɛ anaa, mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ mɛi kpakpai, ni yookpeemɔ he lɛ yi tɔ kɛ mɛi.
"Shi be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ba mɛi lɛ akwɛmɔ lɛ, ebana mɔ ko yɛ jɛi ni wooo yookpeemɔ atade;
ni ebi lɛ akɛ, 'Naanyo, te fee tɛŋŋ ni oba biɛ nɛɛ ni owooo yookpeemɔ atadeŋ?' Ni etɔ mu.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfimɔa eniji kɛ enaji ni nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛyashɛa nyɛfɔ̃a gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli! Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.'
Ejaakɛ etsɛ mɛi pii moŋ; shi fioo ahala."
kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ tee ajina, bɔ mi amɛaafee mi amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ.
Ni amɛtsu amɛkaselɔi lɛ kɛ Herodebii lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ anɔkwafo ji o, ni otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni osheee mɔ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛaŋ;
no hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ wɔ bɔ ni osusuɔ, ani eja akɛ atsuɔ onia ahãa kaisare, aloo ejaaa?"
Shi Yesu yoo amɛyiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Osatofoi, mɛɛba nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi?"
Nyɛkɛ shika ni akɛtsuɔ onia lɛ atsɔ̃a mi!" Ni amɛkɛ shika lɛ bahã lɛ.
ni ebi amɛ akɛ, "Namɔ mfoniri nɛ, ni namɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?"
Amɛkɛɛ, "Kaisere nɔŋ." Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Belɛ nyɛkɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare, ni Nyɔŋmɔ nii lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ!"
Ni be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛshi lɛ amɛtee.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Sadukifoi ni kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ hu ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ,
"Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ, Mose kɛɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko gbo ni ebɛ bii lɛ enyɛmi aŋɔ eŋa lɛ, koni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.'
Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi wɔteŋ, ni kromɔbi lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni ebɛ bii, ni eshi eŋa lɛ ehã enyɛmi lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ eba mli yɛ mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, kɛyashi mɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.
Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu gbo.
Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ, mɛi kpawo lɛ ateŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ ehi shi?"
Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmiitɔ̃ naa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee ŋmalɛi lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ aŋɔɔ yei, ni asaŋ akɛ yei hãaa gblã; shi moŋ amɛtamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi yɛ ŋwɛi.
Shi ani nyɛnaneko nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ yɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ he akɛ,
'Mi lɛ, Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi lɛ?" Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jeee gbohii a-Nyɔŋmɔ ni, shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi a-Nyɔŋmɔ ni,"
Shi be ni a asafoi lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ etsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he.
Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu akɛ eku Sadukifoi lɛ anaa lɛ, amɛbabua amɛhe naa;
ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ji mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ ka lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ,
"Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ te nɔ ni ji Mla lɛ mli kitã wuluŋ?"
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ otsui muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ osusuma muu lɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Kitãi lɛ amli otu kɛ ewulu nɛ.
Ni nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ no, akɛ, 'Suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.
Kitãi enyɔ nɛɛ nɔ Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ."
Ni be ni Farisifoi lɛ anaa ekpe shi lɛ, Yesu bi amɛ akɛ,
"Te nyɛsusuɔ yɛ Kristo lɛ he tɛŋŋ?" Namɔ bi ji lɛ?" Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "David Biŋ."
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba mɔ ni David, yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ tsɛɔ lɛ 'Nuŋtsɔ' ni ekɛɔ akɛ,
"Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, Ta mininejurɔ nɔ Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mikɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ aaawo onaji ashishi lɛ?'
Agbɛnɛ kɛji David tsɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɛ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebiŋ?"
Ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ hetoo ko ahã, ni asaŋ kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ko ekaa lɛ nɔ ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
23: Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ safoi lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ wie ekɛɛ,
"Mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ, Mose sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ amɛtra lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛye nɔ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ ni nyɛfea, shi nyɛkafea nibii mi amɛfeɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ moŋ shi amɛfeee.
Shi amɛfimɔɔ jatsui kɛ tsiimɔ amɛŋmlɛɔ mɛi akɔ̃ji anɔ; shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ amɛkɛ amɛwao saa he.
Shi amɛnii fɛɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ koni mɛi ana. Ejaakɛ amɛhãa amɛsɔlemɔkaimɔ kotokui kɛ amɛtadei anaamui lɛ lɛɔ.
Amɛsumɔɔ yitsotamɔ kɛji atsɛ okplɔ̃, kɛ onukpai asɛ̃ii yɛ kpeehei lɛ,
kɛ jaanɔ ŋamɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ akɛ mɛi atsɛ amɛ 'Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ!'
Shi nyɛ lɛ, akatsɛ nyɛ 'Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ; ejaakɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ-Tsɔ̃lɔ; shi nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ji nyɛ.
Ni nyɛkatsɛa mɔ ko nyɛ-Tsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ mɔ kome pɛ ji nyɛ-Tsɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Asaŋ akatsɛ nyɛ 'Nuŋtsɔ'; ejaakɛ mɔ kome pɛ ji nyɛ-Nuŋtsɔ, lɛji Kristo.
Shi mɔ ni ji agbo yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, etsɔ̃ nyɛtsulɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawo ehe nɔ lɛ, aaaba lɛ shi; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaba ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ.
"Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛŋaa ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ naa, nyɛwoɔ gbɔmɛi; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nyɛboteee mli, ni mɛi ni taoɔ mli abote lɛ hu, nyɛŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛbote mli."
("Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlãtsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛ lakpatoo sɔleɔ sɔlemɔi kakadãji. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkojomɔ aaafe nine.")

"Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi! Nyɛbɔleɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ kpula, koni nyɛfee mɔ kome Yudafonyo; ni be ni mɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ nakai lɛ, nyɛfeɔ lɛ abonsamiiaje bi toi enyɔ fe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe.
