Kpoo ha nyɛ, gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi! Nyɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he kitã lɛ, no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he shika ŋmiiŋmii lɛ kitã lɛ.'
Shwilafoi kwashiai! Te nɔ ni feŋ, shika ŋmiiŋmii lɛ, loo Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni hãa shika ŋmiiŋmii lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?
Ni asaŋ, 'Mɔ ni aaakã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kitã lɛ. no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã enɔ afɔle lɛ kitã lɛ, efiɔ lɛ.'
Shwilafoi kwashiai, Te nɔ ni feŋ, afɔle lɛ, loo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni hãa afɔle lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni aaakã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kitã lɛ, ekã no kɛ nii ni yɔɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ kitã.
Ni mɔ ni kãa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kitã lɛ, ekã no kɛ mɔ ni hiɔ mli lɛ kitã.
Ni mɔ ni kãa ŋwɛi kitã lɛ, ekã Nyɔŋmɔ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ hu kitã.

"Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, asatofoi! Nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ anisi kɛ kumino mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, shi Mla lɛ mli ni he jraa ni jalɛ saneyeli kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɛshiɔ; enɛɛmɛi sa akɛ nyɛfeɔ kɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ.
Gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi nyɛtsɛreɔ nɔ nɔ adɔ̃dɔ̃ŋ, shi nyɛmiɔ yoma!
"Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, asatofoi! Nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ; shi amɛmligbɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ojotswaa kɛ edufudeyeli.
"Farisinyo shwilafo, sha kpulu lɛ kɛ kã lɛ mli aje tsutsu, kɛkɛ lɛ esɛɛ hu aaaje!
"Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, Osatofoi" Nyɛtamɔ gbohii asaŋi ni asha he ni amɛhewɔ efee fɛo moŋ, shi amɛmligbɛ lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbohii awui kɛ muji nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, yɛ kponɔgbɛ lɛ, nyɛpueɔ akɛ jalɔi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi yɛ mligbɛ lɛ nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ osato kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ.
"Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, Osatofoi! Nyɛmãmɔɔ gablɔi lɛ atoohei, ni nyɛwulaa jalɔi lɛ asaŋi lɛ.
ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, 'Eji wɔtsɛmɛi ayinɔ lɛ wɔyɛ jeŋ kulɛ, wɔfataŋ amɛhe kɛyashwieŋ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi.'
Belɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛhe odase akɛ mɛi ni gbe gablɔi lɛ abii ji nyɛ.
Nyɛ hu nyɛwoa nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ asusumɔ tsene lɛ obɔ̃ mɔ!
Onufui, shikpãi ashwiei. Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ nyɛjo abonsamiiaje fɔbuu lɛ naa foiŋ?

No hewɔ lɛ, naa, miitsu gbalɔi kɛ nilelɔi kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, ni nyɛaagbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni nyɛaasɛŋ mɛi komɛi, ni mɛi krokomɛi lɛ nyɛaayi amɛ kplebii yɛ nyɛkpeehei lɛ, ni nyɛaawa amɛ yi kɛaajɛ maŋ kome mli kɛaatee ekroko mli.
Bɔ ni afee ni jalɔi alá fɛɛ ni ashwie shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Abel, jalɔ lɛ, lá lɛ nɔ kɛbashi Zakaria, Bakaria bi lɛ, ni nyɛgbe lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ lá lɛ nɔ lɛ aba nyɛnɔ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaaba yinɔbii nɛɛ anɔ."
"Yerusalem, Yerusalem, bo ni ogbeɔ gbalɔi lɛ ni otswiaa mɛi ni atsuɔ amɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ atɛi; shii enyiɛ mitao akɛ kulɛ mabua obii anaa tamɔ bɔ ni wuɔ buaa ebii anaa ewoɔ efiji ashishi lɛ, ni nyɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ!
Naa, ashi nyɛwe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ahã nyɛ!
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ mli.'"
24: Ni Yesu je kpo yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni be ni eyaa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ tsui lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Te nyɛmiina nii nɛɛ fɛɛ? Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ashiŋ tɛ kome yɛ eko nɔ yɛ biɛ ni akpãŋ aluŋ shi."
Shi be eta shi yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ yɛ afã amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ beyinɔ mi aaafee nii nɛɛ, ni mɛni ji obaa lɛ kɛ je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ he okadi?"
Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni mɔ ko akabalaka nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii kɛ migbɛi aaabakɛɛ akɛ, 'Miji Kristo lɛ! Ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii.
Shi nyɛaanu tai kɛ tai atatsīi ahe;' nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛtsui akafãa; ejaakɛ esa akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ aba mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ naagbee lɛ shɛko.
Shi maŋ aaate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyeli aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli; ni hɔ̃ji kɛ shikpɔŋ hosomɔi aaaba hei srɔtoi.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ kɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ashishijee ni.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ amɛwo amanehulu mli, ni amɛaagbe nyɛ; ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ.
Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛi pii anane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃ɔ amɛnanemɛi asɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛaanyɛnyɛɛ amɛhe.
Ni amale gbalɔi pii aaate shi, ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii.
Ni akɛni mlakwamɔ baafa hewɔ lɛ, mɛi pii asuɔmɔ lɛ he aaajɔ.
Shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛyawulaa shi lɛ, lɛ eyiwala aaahere.
Ni aaashiɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kpakpa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni akɛye jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ odase; ni no dani naagbee lɛ aaaba."
"No hewɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛna 'Amaŋfɔ̃ nihiinii lɛ' ni gbalɔ Daniel wie he lɛ akɛ ema he Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ (mɔ ni kaneɔ lɛ eyoo sɛɛ!)
No lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi amɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ;
mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ lɛ, ekakpleke shi eyakɔ nɔ ko kɛjɛ eshia;
ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi lɛ ekaaku esɛɛ eyakɔ etade.
Shi kpoo hã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ yei ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ!
Shi nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛfoijee lɛ akɛba yɛ fɛ̃i be lɛ mli aloo yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ naaki be lɛ mli lɛ amanehulu kple aaaba ni anako enɔ dã kɛjɛ je lɛ shishijee mli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni asaŋ anaŋ enɔ gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛ afooo nakai gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, ahereŋ heloo ko heloo ko yiwala; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ ahewɔ lɛ aaafo nɔ.
No mli lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Naa, Kristo lɛ yɛ biɛ loo biɛ lɛ', nyɛkahea nyɛyea.
Ejaakɛ amale kristoi kɛ amale gbalɔi aaate shi ni amɛaafee okadii wuji kɛ ashwãi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ, bɔ ni kɛ aaaho lɛ amɛaalaka halamɔbii lɛ tete.
Naa, mikɛɛ nyɛ mito.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji amɛkɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, 'Naa, eyɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ,' nyɛkayaa; aloo, 'Naa, eyɛ piai lɛ amli lɛ;' nyɛkahea nyɛyea.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni srawa gbaa kɛjɛɔ bokã kɛyaa anai lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ aaatamɔ.
Ejaakɛ he fɛɛ he ni gbonyo kã lɛ, jɛi akpaŋai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ."
"Shi nakai gbii lɛ amli amanehului lɛ asɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, hulu aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔŋtsere kpɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ni ŋulamii aaatserɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi atswia shi, ni ŋwɛi hewalɛi lɛ aaahoso.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ okadi lɛ aaapue yɛ ŋwɛi, ni no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaawo yara, ni amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ anɔ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ anumnyam baboo.
Ni eeetsu ebɔfɔi lɛ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ ni gbee wa, ni amɛaabua ehalamɔbii lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛaaje naagbeehe kome kɛaaya naagbeehe kroko lɛ,"
"Shi nyɛkasea agbãmiitso abɛ ni ebuɔ lɛ, be ni eniji lɛ efrɔke ni eefu baa lɛ, nyɛle akɛ latsaa be lɛ eshɛ etã.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛna nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛlea akɛ eshɛ agboi lɛ etã.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, ja nii nɛɛ fɛɛ eba mli dã.
Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ baaho aya, shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ."
"Shi nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee nɔ ko yɛ he, bɔfoi ni yɔɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tete leee, ni Bi lɛ leee, ja Tsɛ lɛ kome kɛkɛ.
Shi bɔ ni Noa gbii lɛ fee lɛ, nakai Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ hu aaatamɔ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ gbii ni nyiɛ nu afua lɛ hiɛ lɛ amli, ni mɛi lɛ hiɛ niyeli kɛ ninumɔ kɛ yooŋɔɔ kɛ gblãhamɔ mli aahuu kɛyashi gbi ni Noa yabote adeka lɛ mli,
ni amɛleee kɛyashi nu afua lɛ baloo amɛ fɛɛ kɛtee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ aaatamɔ.
No mli lɛ mɛi enyɔ aaahi ŋmɔshi; aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome lɛ.
Yei enyɔ aaawiɛ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ; aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsraa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee nɔ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ baa.
Shi nyɛkaia akɛ, kɛ shīatsɛ ko le nɔ ŋmlɛtswaa nɔ ni julɔ baa lɛ, kulɛ eeesra ni eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni agbu ewe lɛ awoŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ nɔ ŋmlɛtswaa ni nyɛsusuuu lɛ nɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa."
"Belɛ namɔ ji tsulɔ anɔkwafo kɛ nilelɔ mɔ ni enuŋtsɔ kɛ lɛ eto ewebii lɛ anɔ, koni ehã amɛ amɛŋmaa Yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ?
Ajɔɔ nakai tsulɔ lɛ, mɔ ni be ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ baa lɛ ni eeebana lɛ ni eefee nakai lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaato enii fɛɛ kwa nɔ.
"Shi kɛji nakai tsulɔ fɔŋ lɛ aaakɛɛ yɛ etsui mli akɛ 'Minuŋtsɔ lɛ miitsi ebaabe lɛ eeto;'
ni eeebɔ̃i enanemɛi tsuji lɛ yii, ni ekɛ dãatɔlɔi lɛ aaaye, ni ekɛ amɛ aaanu lɛ,
nakai tsulɔ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba yɛ gbi nɔ ni ekwɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ ŋmlɛtswaa nɔ ni eleee,
ni eeefo emli enyɔ ni eeehã lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ osatofoi lɛ ateŋ. Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi."
25: "No mli lɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaatãmɔ oblayei nyɔŋma ni hole amɛkanei ni amɛtee amɛkɛ ayɛmfrowu ayakpe.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi enumɔ lɛ kwashiai ji amɛ, ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ nilelɔi ni.
Kwashiai lɛ hole amɛkanei lɛ shi amɛŋɔɔɔ mu amɛhiɛɛ amɛdɛ̃.
Shi nilelɔi lɛ kɛ mu wo amɛtɔi amli amɛfata amɛkanei lɛ ahe.
Ni akɛni anyɛmfrowu lɛ tsɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ ye amɛ fɛɛ ni amɛwɔwɔi.
Shi nyɔɔŋ teŋ lɛ anu blɔmɔ akɛ, 'Naa, ayɛmfrowu lɛ miiba ee! Nyɛjea kpo, nyɛkɛ lɛ ayakpea!'
Kɛkɛ ni oblayei lɛ fɛɛ te shi ni amɛsaa amɛkanei lɛ.
Ni kwashiai lɛ kɛɛ nilelɔi lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛhãa wɔ nyɛmu lɛ eko, ejaakɛ wɔkanei lɛ miigboi.'
Shi nilelɔi lɛ here amɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ 'Ekolɛ ebashɛŋ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ; shi moŋ nyɛyaa mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ lɛ aŋɔɔ nyɛyahea eko nyɛhãa nyɛhe.'
Shi be ni amɛtee hemɔ lɛ, ayɛmfrowu lɛ ba, ni mɛi ni esaa amɛhe eto lɛ kɛ lɛ tee yookpeemɔ lɛ, ni aŋa shinaa lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ oblayei krokomɛi lɛ hu ba ni amɛbakɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, gblemɔ wɔ!'
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, 'Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ mileee nyɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsraa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee gbi lɛ loo ŋmlatswaa lɛ.
"Shi etamɔ nuu ko ni be ni ebaadom lɛ, etsɛ etsuji, ni etu enibii ewo amɛdɛŋ;
ni ehã mɔ kome talentai enumɔ, mɔ kome hu enyɔ, ni mɔ kome hu ekome, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni eeenyɛ he nii etsu; ni edom.
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ mɔ ni na talentai enumɔ lɛ tee ni eyatsɔ̃mɔ he, ni ena talentai enumɔ ebɔ he.
Nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni na enyɔ lɛ hu yana enyɔ ebɔ he.
Shi mɔ ni na ekome lɛ tee eyatsa shi, ni ekɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ shika lɛ tee.
"Shi yɛ mli aahuu lɛ, tsuji nɛɛ anuŋtsɔ lɛ ba, ni ekɛ amɛ babu akɔŋtaa.
Ni mɔ ni na talentai enumɔ lɛ ba, ni ekɛ talentai enumɔ kroko babɔ he ekɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, okɛ talenta enumɔ hã mi, naa, mina enumɔ hu mifata he.'
Ni Enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Aekoo, tsulɔ kpakpa kɛ anɔkwafo, oye anɔkwa yɛ nii fioo he, mato o nii pii anɔkwɛlɔ; botemɔ onuŋtsɔ miishɛɛ lɛ mli.'
Ni mɔ ni na talentai enyɔ lɛ hu ba ni ebakɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, okɛ talenta enyɔ hã mi, naa, mina talentai enyɔ hu mifata he.'
Enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Aekoo, tsulɔ kpakpa kɛ anɔkwafo, oye anɔkwa yɛ nii fioo he, mato o nii pii anɔkwɛlɔ; botemɔ onuŋtsɔ miishɛɛ lɛ mli.'
Shi mɔ ni na talenta kome lɛ hu ba bakɛɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, mile o akɛ yiwalɔ ji o; okpaa nii yɛ he ni oduko nɔ ko yɛ, ni obuaa nii anaa yɛ he ni oshwãko nɔ ko yɛ;
ni no hã mishe gbeyei, ni miyafu otalenta lɛ. Naa onii.'
Shi enuŋtsɔ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Tsulɔ fɔŋ kɛ anihaolɔ! Ni ole akɛ mikpaa nii yɛ he ni miduko nɔ ko yɛ ni mibuaa nii anaa yɛ he ni mishwãko nɔ ko yɛ lɛ,
kulɛ ogbɛnaa ji akɛ oŋɔɔ mishika lɛ owoɔ tsakelɔi adɛŋ, ni kɛ miba lɛ ni mibahe minii kɛ ehekpa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhea talentai lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛhãa mɔ ni yɔɔ talentai nyɔŋma lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ aaahã lɛ, koni ena ni ateke nɔ; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahe nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ.
Ni tsulɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko nɛɛ, nyɛtsia lɛ nyɛwoa gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi!"
"Shi be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba yɛ enumnyam lɛ mli, ni bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ aaafata ehe lɛ, no mli lɛ eeeta enumnyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ;
ni aaabua jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ anaa yɛ ehiɛ, ni eeegbla amɛmli tamɔ bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ gblaa gwaŋteŋi kɛ abotiai amli lɛ.
Ni ekɛ gwaŋtɛŋi lɛ aaadamɔ eninejurɔ nɔ, shi abotiai lɛ ekɛ amɛ aaadamɔ ebɛku nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaakɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ eninejurɔ nɔ lɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛbaa, nyɛ mɛini mi-Tsɛ ejɔɔ nyɛ, nyɛbaŋɔa maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni asaa ato nyɛ kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ!
Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nii miye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nu minu; gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhã mibato nyɛŋɔɔ;
minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwo mi atade; mihe ye, ni nyɛbasra mi; awo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛba miŋɔɔ.'
Kɛkɛ lɛ jalɔi lɛ aaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna o akɛ hɔ̃mɔ miye o, ni wɔhã o nii oyeŋ, aloo akɛ kumai miiye o, ni wɔhã o nɔ ko onuŋ?
Ni te gbi ni wɔna o akɛ gbɔ ji o, ni wɔhã obato wɔŋɔɔŋ; aloo akɛ onyiɛ yayai ni wɔwo o atadeŋ?
Asaŋ te gbi ni wɔna o akɛ ohe miiye aloo awo o tsuŋ, ni wɔba oŋɔɔ?'
Ni amŋtsɛ lɛ aaahere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, 'Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni nyɛfee nyɛhã minyɛmimɛi nɛɛ ateŋ bibioo kome lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ nyɛfee nyɛhã lɛ.'
"Kɛkɛ ni lɛ eeekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ebɛku nɔ lɛ hu akɛ, 'Nyɛjea minɔ, nyɛ mɛi ni alomɔ nyɛ, nyɛyaa naanɔ la lɛ ni asaa ato abonsam kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ mli!"
Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nii maye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nu manu;
gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhãaa mabato nyɛŋɔɔ; minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwooo mi atade; mihe ye ni asaŋ owo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛbasraaa mi.'
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ hu amɛaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna o akɛ hɔmɔ miiye o aloo kumai miiye o aloo akɛ gbɔ ji o aloo onyiɛ yayai aloo ohe miiye aloo owo o tsuŋ, ni wɔbasɔmɔɔɔ bo lɛ?'
Kɛkɛ lɛ eeehere amɛ nɔ eeekɛɛ akɛ, 'Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ ni nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mɛi bibii kwraa nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mi hu!'
Ni mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ, amɛaatee naanɔ hejramɔ mli; shi jalɔi lɛ aaatee naanɔ wala mli."
26: Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ anaa lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛle akɛ eshwɛ gbii enyɔ ni ayeɔ Hehoo lɛ, ni aaajie Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ahã ni asɛŋ lɛ."
No mli lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ eyabua amɛhe naa yɛ osɔfonukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kaiafa lɛ mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli.
Ni amɛtee apãm, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ Yesu ŋaa mli ni agbe lɛ;
shi amɛkɛɛ, "Jeee gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, koni maŋ lɛ mli akabafee hirihiri."
Be ni Yesu yɔɔ Betania yɛ Simon, kpitiyelɔ lɛ, we lɛ,
yoo ko hiɛ, alabastro tɔ kɛ emli mukɛŋma ni jra wa kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni be ni eta niyenii ashi lɛ, efɔse eshwie eyiteŋ.
Shi be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ; amɛmli wo la amɛkɛɛ "Te yaka nifitemɔ nɛɛ shishiŋ?
Ejaakɛ mukɛŋma nɛɛ kulɛ aaanyɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ahe shika pii ni akɛhã ohiafoi."
Shi be ni Yesu na enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ akɛ "Mɛɛba nyɛgbaa yoo lɛ naa? Etsu nitsumɔ fɛɛfɛo ehã mi.
Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa, shi mi lɛ, jeee daa mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Ejaakɛ mukɛŋma nɛɛ ni efɔse eshwie migbɔmɔtso lɛ nɔ nɛɛ, efee eto mifuu lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, he fɛɛhe ni aajaje sane kpakpa nɛɛ yɛ, yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ lɛ, aaagba nɔ ni yoo nɛɛ fee nɛɛ hu akɛkai lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yuda Isakariot lɛ yiŋ etee osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ
ni eyabi akɛ, "Mɛni nyɛaahã mi ni majie lɛ mawo nyɛdɛŋ?" Ni amɛkane jwɛitɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛhã lɛ.
Ni kɛjɛ no be lɛ nɔ lɛ etao ehe gbɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ ewo amɛdɛŋ.
Shi akpiti gbii juji lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa wɔhã o ni oyaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ jɛi?"
Ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli ni nyɛyakɛa ashimashi akɛ, "Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, mibe lɛ eshɛ etã; owe lɛ mikɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ!'"
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ yafee bɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
Be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ yatra niyenii lɛ ahe.
Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, ekɛɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ."
Ni edɔ amɛ naakpa, ni amɛbɔi lɛ bimɔ ekomekome yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, miŋ lo?"
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, "Mɔ nine ni kɛ minine kpeɔ yɛ kã lɛ mli lɛ, lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi sɛɛgbɛ lɛ; faŋ nɔ ni anaaa afɔ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ."
Ni Yuda, esɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ, here nɔ ekɛɛ, "Ani miŋ, Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ?" Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛɛ!"
Shi be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɔ aboloo, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛhea nyɛyea! Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso lɛ."
Ni ewo kpulu lɛ, ni eda shi ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnua eko!
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji mila ni ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni afɔse ashwie shi yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ hã eshaifaa lɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ benɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ, kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ aaanu lɛ ehee yɛ mi-Tsɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli."
Ni be ni amɛla yijiemɔ lala ko lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛtee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɔŋ nɛɛŋ lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ mihewɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, 'Matswa tookwɛlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni tooku lɛ aaagbɛ ashwã,'
Shi mishitee sɛɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛya Galilea."
Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ nane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ ohewɔ lɛ, mi lɛ minane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ gbi ko gbi ko."
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Anɔkwale mikɛɔ o akɛ, nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ nɔŋŋ, dani wuɔ aaagbɛɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃.'
Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji gbi mikɛ o aaagbo tete lɛ mikpãŋ yɛ osɛɛ." Nakai nɔŋŋ kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ hu kɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ba he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Gatsemane; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtraa shi yɛ biɛ, koni maya ni mayasɔle yɛ jɛi."
Ni eŋɔ Petro kɛ Zebedeo bihii enyɔ lɛ efata ehe ni ewerɛ bɔ̃i ehe hoo ni ehao.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ "Misusuma were eho ehe kɛyaashi gbele mli tɔ̃ɔ nyɛhia shi yɛ biɛ ni nyɛkɛ mi ashia kpe!"
Ni etee hiɛ fioo, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, "Mi-Tsɛ, kɛji aaaho lɛ, hã ni kpulu nɛɛ aho mihe aya; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ,"
Ni eba kaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ena akɛ amɛwɔ, ni ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, "No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛkɛ mi ashi kpe ŋmlɛtswaa kome pɛ?
Nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛkabote kaa mli; mumɔ lɛ miikplɛ̃ moŋ, shi heloo lɛ egbede."
Eyiŋ etee ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni eyasɔle ekɛɛ, "Mi-Tsɛ, kɛji kpulu nɛɛ nyɛŋ mihe aho aya akɛ ja minu lɛ, afee bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ."
Ni be ni eba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ena akɛ amɛwɔ; ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii etsii.
Ni esaa eshi amɛ etee ekoŋŋ, ni eyasɔle nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃, ni ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni eba ekaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ ni nyɛwɔɔ nɛɛ? Naa; ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ etã, ni aaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ.
Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔyaa; naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ eshɛ shi etã."
Ni be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, Yuda, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ ba, ni asafo pii ni jɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ, kɛ lɛ nyiɛ, ni amɛhiɛ klaŋtei kɛ kpotii.
Shi esɛɛgbɛtɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ eto amɛ odaki akɛ, "Mɔ naa ni mashwɔ lɛ, lɛ ni; nyɛmɔa lɛ!"
Ni amrɔ lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, "Oshwieee, Rabi! Ni eshwɔ enaa."
Shi Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, "Naanyo, mɛni fɛɛmɔ oba yɛ biɛ? "Kɛkɛ ni mɛi lɛ batutua Yesu ni amɛmɔ lɛ.
Ni naa, mɛi ni kɛ Yesu yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kpã enine mli egbla eklaŋte, ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ, ni efo etoi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ oklaŋte lɛ ato etoohe; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni klɔɔ klaŋte lɛ, klaŋte naa amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ.
Aloo osusuɔ akɛ minyɛŋ mi-Tsɛ fai makpa ni amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ eeehã ŋwɛi bɔfoi fe asafoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ?
Shi no lɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nɔ ni ŋmalɛi lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ ja eba lɛ nɛkɛ lɛ aaaba mliŋ?"
No ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ asafoi lɛ akɛ, "Mimɔmɔ nyɛba kɛ klaŋte kɛ kpotii, tamɔ amɔɔ ojotswalɔ ko nɛɛ? Mitaa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ daa mitsɔ̃ɔ nii, ni nyɛmɔɔɔ mi.
Shi afee enɛ fɛɛ koni nii ni gbalɔi lɛ aŋmla lɛ aba mli." Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi shi lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ mɛi ni mɔ Yesu lɛ kpla lɛ kɛtee Kaiafa, osɔfonukpa lɛ; ŋɔɔ, yɛ he ni mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ.
Shi Petro nyiɛ esɛɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli, ni ebote jɛi akɛ tsuji lɛ yata shi, koni ekwɛ bɔ ni naagbee lɛ aaatamɔ ahã.
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ tao amale odase yɛ Yesu he, koni amɛgbe lɛ;
shi amɛnaaa eko; tsɛbelɛ amale odasefoi pii ba. Fee sɛɛ lɛ amale odasefoi enyɔ ba.
amɛbakɛɛ, "Mɔnɛ kɛɛ akɛ, 'Manyɛ makumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni mama lɛ gbii etɛ̃.
Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi ebi lɛ akɛ," Otooo he eko? Mɛɛ odase mɛnɛɛmɛi yeɔ shiɔ o nɛɛ?"
Shi Yesu etswaaa esɛŋ. Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mina Nyɔŋmɔ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, akɛ kɛji boji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ!"
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛɛ. Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eta Hewalɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ amli."
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ gbla etadei ni ekɛɛ, "Ebɔ musu! Mɛni wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ odasefoi wɔfee dɔŋŋ? Naa, agbɛnɛ nyɛnu emusubɔɔ lɛ!
Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ? "Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Esa gbele!"
Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehiɛ, ni amɛgbla lɛ mai; ni mɛi komɛi hu tswia lɛ nii
amɛkɛɛ, "Kristo, gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ, namɔ ji mɔ ni yi o lɛ?"
Shi Petro ta sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ kpo te lɛ mli; ni oblayoo ko ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ, "Bo hu te okɛ Yesu, Galileanyo lɛ, yɔɔ!"
Shi etso yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ."
Shi be ni Petro te shi etee koi lɛ shi lɛ, mɔ kroko hu na lɛ, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ "Mɔnɛ hu kɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, yɔɔ."
Ni etso ekoŋŋ kɛ kitãkãmɔ ekɛɛ, "Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ."
Ni fee sɛɛ fioo lɛ, mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ bakɛɛ Petro akɛ, "Anɔkwale ji akɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji o; ejaakɛ owiemɔ tete jieɔ o shi!"
Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i loomɔ kɛ kitãkãmɔ akɛ, "Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ" Ni amrɔ lɛ wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Ni Petro kai Yesu wiemɔ ni eKɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Dani wuɔ aaagbɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃" Ni eje kpo eyafo blobloblo.
27: Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ tee Yesu yinɔ apam, koni amɛgbe lɛ.
Ni amɛfi lɛ ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee amɛyahã Amralo Pontio Pilato.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Yuda, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, na akɛ abu lɛ fɔ lɛ, eshwa ehe, ni ekpale jwɛitɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ eyahã osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ,
ni ekɛɛ, "Mifee esha aka mitsɔ̃ɔ lá ni efɔŋ ko bɛ ehe lɛ sɛɛgbɛ." Shi amɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "No jeee wɔhe sane ko; bo diɛŋtsɛ kwɛmɔ nɔ!"
Ni eyashɛrɛ jwɛitɛi lɛ eshwie Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee eyawo esɛ̃ kpãa.
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ yaloo jwɛitɛi lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Ejaaa akɛ akɛtoɔ (Sɔlemɔwe lɛ) nitoohe lɛ mli ejaakɛ lá yinii ni."
Ni amɛtee ajina, ni amɛkɛhe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ abɔɔ lɛ, koni afu gbɔi yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ atsɛɔ nakai abɔɔ lɛ 'Lá Abɔɔ' kɛ ŋmɛnɛ
No ni gbalɔ Yeremia wiemɔ lɛ ba mli akɛ, "Ni amɛŋɔ jwɛitɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ, ni ji mɔ ni aye enaa ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi wo eyi jra lɛ yinii lɛ;
ni amɛkɛhe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ abɔɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã mi lɛ.'
Shi akɛ Yesu badamɔ Amralo lɛ hiɛ, ni Amralo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani boji Judafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?" Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛɛ."
Shi be ni osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ flɔɔ enaa lɛ, ejieee naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, "Ani onuuu saji sɔŋŋ ni amɛkɛshwieɔ onɔ nɛɛ?" Shi Yesu efooo edaaŋ kwraa; ni Amralo lɛ naa kpɛ ehe diɛŋtsɛ.
Shi daa kɛ shɛ gbijurɔ lɛ, Amralo lɛ ŋmɛɔ gboklɛfonyo kome ni asafo lɛ sumɔɔ he ehãa amɛ.
No mli lɛ amɛyɛ gboklɛfonyo kpanaku ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Baraba.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛbabua amɛhe naa lɛ, Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, "Namɔ he nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ mihã nyɛ, Baraba, aloo Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ?"
Ejaakɛ ele akɛ hetsɛ naa amɛkɛ lɛ hã.
Shi be ni eta kojomɔ sɛ̃i anɔ lɛ, eŋa tsu aba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ jalɔ nɛɛ akaye sane ko; ejaakɛ ehewɔ lɛ mihe ejra mi babaoo yɛ wɔlamɔ mli ŋmɛnɛ."
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ wo asafoi lɛ ayiŋ akɛ, amɛbi Baraba moŋ, koni agbe Yesu.
Shi Amralo lɛ bi amɛ akɛ "Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ he nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ mihã nyɛ?" Ni amɛkɛɛ, "Baraba."
Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, "Belɛ mɛni mifee Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ he mɔ?" Amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Hã ni asɛŋ lɛ!"
Ni Amralo lɛ kɛɛ "Mɛɛ efɔŋ efee; Shi amɛblɔ waa moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ amɛkɛɛ, Hã ni asŋ lɛ!"
Be ni Pilato na akɛ enyɛɛɛ he nɔ ko efee; shi moŋ basabasa feemɔ miiba lɛ, ekɛ nu fɔ edɛ̃ yɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Mi lɛ miyeee jalɔ nɛɛ lá yi sɔ̃; nyɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ!"
Ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Elá aba wɔ kɛ wɔbii anɔ!"
Kɛkɛ ni eŋmɛɛ Baraba he ehã amɛ; shi Yesu lɛ, ekɛ kplebii yi lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Amralo lɛ asraafoi lɛ ŋɔ Yesu kɛtee kojomɔhe lɛ, ni amɛyabua asraafoi aku lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛbabɔle lɛ;
ni amɛjie ehe atadei lɛ, ni amɛkɛ atade tsuru yuu ko wo lɛ;
ni amɛfee ŋmei akekre amɛkɛfi eyitso, ni amɛkɛ tso hã lɛ ehiɛ yɛ eninejurɔ, ni amɛkula shi yɛ ehiɛ amɛye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, "Oshwiee, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ!"
Ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehe, ni amɛhe tso lɛ yɛ edɛ̃ ni amɛkɛtswia eyiteŋ.
Ni be ni amɛye ehe fɛo lɛ, amɛjie atade yuu lɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etade lɛ wo lɛ, ni amɛkpla lɛ kɛtee koni amɛyasɛŋ lɛ.
Be ni amɛyaa lɛ; amɛna nuu Kirenenyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon, ni amɛnyɛ enɔ ni ewo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi Golgota ni eshishi ji "Yitsoŋoŋohe" lɛ,
Amɛkɛ wain ni akɛ drɔ efutu mli hã Yesu ni enu; shi be ni esa enaa lɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ enuɔ.
Be ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja etadei lɛ.
Ni amɛho amɛtra jɛi, ni amɛbu ehe.
Ni amɛŋma sane ni akɛfɔ̃ enɔ lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, "Yesu, Yedafoi lɛ a-Maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ!"
No mli lɛ asɛŋ ojotswalɔi enyɔ afata ehe; mɔ kome yɛ eninejurɔ nɔ, ni mɔ kome hu yɛ ebɛku nɔ.
Shi mɛi ni hoɔ lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔ amɛshi lɛ, ni amɛhoso amɛyitsei,
ni amɛkɛɛ, "Bo ni okumɔɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ ni osaa omãa gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala! Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji o lɛ, jee sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ okpleke shi koo!"
Nakai nɔŋŋ osɔfonukpai lɛ hu kɛ mlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ,
"Mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala ehere, shi lɛ diɛntsɛ enɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ehere. Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ji lɛ! Eje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ agbɛnɛ ekpleke shi, ni wɔɔhe lɛ wɔye.
Ekɛ ehe fɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ; ejie lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ koo, kɛji eyɛ ehe tsui lɛ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji mi.'"
Nakai nɔŋŋ ojotswalɔi lɛ ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ hu bɔ lɛ ahora.
Shi kɛjɛ shwane ŋmlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛyashi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ lɛ duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Shi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli yɛ Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, "Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?" Eshishi ji, "Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi?"
Shi bɛ ni mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, "Elia mɔnɛ tsɛɔ nɛɛ."
Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome sha foi eyakɔ ŋshɔŋ kotsa, ni ekɛtsɔ̃ ashiŋ mli, ni ekɛma tso naa ehã lɛ akɛ enu.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ahi shi! Hã wɔkwɛ akɛ Elia aaaba abajie lɛ lo?"
Shi Yesu bo ekoŋŋ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni ebu enaa.
Ni naa, Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba enyɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbayi shi, ni shikpɔŋ hoso, ni tɛsai gbla;
ni gbohii abui anaa gblegblei, ni krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni ewɔ lɛ agbɔmɔtsei pii te shi;
ni eshitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛje kpo kɛjɛ amɛbui lɛ amli, ni amɛtee maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli amɛyajie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi pii.
Shi be nu asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ buɔ Yesu he lɛ na shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ kɛ nii afee lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei tsɔ̃, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi nɛ!"
Shi yei pii yɛ jɛi ni damɔ shɔŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ; amɛji mɛi ni nyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ kɛjɛ Galilea ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ;
amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni ji Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria ni ji Yakobo kɛ Yose nyɛ lɛ, kɛ Zebedeo bii lɛ anyɛ lɛ.
Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, niiatsɛ ko ni jɛ Arimatia ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef lɛ ba; lɛ hu Yesu kaselɔ ji lɛ.
Lɛ etee Pilato ŋɔɔ eyatutɔ lɛ ni ekɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ahã lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Pilato fã akɛ akɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ni Yosef ŋɔ gbonyo lɛ, ni ekɛ klala farefare bla lɛ,
Ni ekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbonyobu hee ni ekpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli lɛ mli, ni ekoklo tɛ kpeteŋkple ekɛtsi gbonyobu lɛ naa, ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria mɔ kome lɛ yɛ jɛi, amɛtra gbonyobu lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Shi Hesaamɔ-kɛ-too-Gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ anaa baakpe shi yɛ Pilato ŋɔɔ,
amɛkɛɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, Wɔkai akɛ, be ni shishiulɔ nɛɛ hiɛ kã lɛ ekɛɛ, 'Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ mate shi ekoŋŋ.'

No hewɔ lɛ fã ni ayabu bu lɛ he jogbaŋŋ kɛyashi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, koni ekaselɔi lɛ akabajulɛ kɛtee, ni amɛyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ 'Ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ'; ni sɛɛkpee shishiumɔ lɛ bafee efɔŋ fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ."
Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa, asrafoi nɛ, nyɛyaa ni nyɛyabua bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee; amɛsɔo tɛ lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ gbonyobu lɛ naa kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛhã asraafoi lɛ bu he.
28: Shi hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ naagbee, be ni je bɔi tsɛremɔ kɛbaa otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria mɔ kome lɛ ba bu lɛ sramɔ.
Ni naa, Shikpɔŋ ehoso waa, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jɛ ŋwɛi kpleke shi, ni ebakoklo tɛ lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ, ni eho eta nɔ.
Ni ehiɛ kpɛɔ tamɔ srawa, ni etade lɛ hu yɛɔ futafuta.
Shi ehe gbeyei hã bulɔi lɛ ahe kpokpo ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbohii.
Shi bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ yei lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛmiitao Yesu mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ;
ebɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ ete shi, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ. Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa hegbɛ ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛyaa mramra nyɛyakɛa ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni eetsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛya Galilea; jɛi nyɛaana lɛ yɛ; naa, mikɛɛ nyɛ."
Ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ bu lɛ he mramra kɛ gbeyei kɛ nyamɔ babaoo, ni amɛhiɛ foi koni amɛyagba ekaselɔi lɛ.
Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ bakpe ni ekɛɛ, "Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!" Ni amɛbamɔmɔ enaji amli; ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa minyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni amɛya Galilea; ni jɛi amɛaana mi yɛ.
Shi be ni amɛyaa lɛ, bulɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi eba maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛbagba nii ni afee lɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ osɔfonukpai lɛ.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ bɔ gwa ni amɛtee ajina, ni amɛhã asraafoi lɛ jwɛitɛi pii,
amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɛkɛa akɛ, nyɔɔŋ, be ni wɔwɔ lɛ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba baju lɛ kɛtee.
Ni Kɛji enɛ bashɛ Amralo lɛ toiŋ lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔkɛ kɛ lɛ baawie ni wɔkwɛ ni akahao nyɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe jwɛitɛi lɛ, ni amɛfee bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ. Ni nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ yiŋ amɛtee Galilea gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Yesu etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ akpe yɛ lɛ,
ni be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ; shi mɛi komɛi je ŋwane.
Ni Yesu ba ekɛ amɛ bawie ekɛɛ, "Aŋɔ hegbɛ fɛɛ ahã mi yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛyaa ni nyɛyafea jeŋmaji fɛɛ mikaselɔi, nyɛbaptisa amɛ nyɛwoa Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ gbɛi mli;
ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛye nii fiaa ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ. Ni naa, mi lɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ daa kɛyashi jeŋ naagbee lɛ." (Amen.) (Hiao.)

1: Maŋtsɛ Yotam kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz kɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, eyinɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ shɛɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ hã Mika ni jɛ maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Moreshet lɛ mli lɛ. Yehowa jie nibii ni kɔɔ Samaria kɛ Yerusalem he nɛɛ fɛɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Mika.
Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ kwa, nyɛboa toi; shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi! Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa, aaajɛ e-Sɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli eye odase eshi nyɛ.
Naa, Yehowa miije kpo kɛjɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni eeeyi shi ni ebanyiɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ.
Gɔ̃ji lɛ aaasre yɛ enaneshi tamɔ wo-agbaku sreɔ yɛ la hiɛ lɛ; gɔ̃ji lɛ aaayiridi awo jɔi lɛ amli ni jɔi lɛ aaagblagblai tamɔ nu ni jɛ gɔŋ yiteŋ eebote jɔɔ mli.

Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baaba yɛ esha ni Israelbii efee eshi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehiɛ atūa ni amɛtse lɛ hewɔ. Israelbii atūatsemɔ lɛ, namɔ ejɛ? Ani jeee Samaria, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ? Wɔŋjamɔ ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ, namɔ ejɛ? Ani jeee Yerusalem?

No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, "Mahã Samaria akumɔ abua shi yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ tamɔ he ko ni atɛoɔ waintsei yɛ. Matsi egbogbo koi lɛ mawo jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni mahã tɛi ni akɛto maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ ashishi lɛ ahe akã.

Aaajwra emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni nii ni akɛbawoɔ sɔlemɔ we lɛ ajwamaŋi anyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashã fɛɛ. Makumɔ ewɔji lɛ fɛɛ mabua shi ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gɔŋ. Ajwamaŋi anyɔmɔwo mli Samaria bua nii nɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ, ni agbɛnɛ Samaria henyɛlɔi aaaloo fɛɛ kɛaatee amɛjamɔhei yɛ hei krokomɛi."
Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛɛ, "Enɛ hewɔ lɛ maye ŋkɔmɔ ni mawo yara, manyiɛ pasaa kɛ mihe yayai. Mawo yara tamɔ ŋaŋgbei, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ looflɔ,
ejaakɛ Samaria pilamɔi lɛ ni ehiii tsamɔ lɛ eko miiba Yuda nɔ. Hiɛkpãtãmɔ eshɛ Yerusalem agboi anaa tɔ̃ɔ; eshɛ he ni mimaŋ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.".
Nyɛkagbaa yɛ Gat; nyɛkahãa amɛnaa nyɛ ni nyɛmiifo. Bet-Leafrabii, nyɛkokloa mlu mli.
Nyɛ Shafirbii, nyɛjea kpo kɛhoa kɛ hiɛgble kɛ nyɛhe yayai. Zaananbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ kpo aje. Kɛji nyɛnu ni Bet-Ezelbii miiye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ abobaahe bɛ jɛi.
Marotbii lɛ miishwe heremɔ, ejaaakɛ Yehowa ehã efɔŋ eshɛ Yerusalem agbo lɛ naa etã.
Nyɛ Lakishbii, nyɛfimɔa shwiilii nyɛkpɛtɛa okpɔŋɔi ni he yɔɔ oya ahe. Israel eshai lɛ nyɛkase feemɔ, ni nyɛkɛhã Yerusalem efee esha.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛkɛ Moreshet-Gat maŋ lɛ naŋ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛŋ Akzib maŋ lɛ mli shīai adɛŋ.
Mareshabi, Yehowa baajie mɔ ehã ni ebaye nyɛnɔ kunim. Ebaaŋɔ nyɛmaŋ lɛ, ni Isreal hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ aaajo foi ayatee yɛ Abdulam tɛkplo lɛ mli.
Yudabii, nyɛshɛa nyɛyi kɛyea ŋkɔmɔ yɛ nyɛbii ni nyɛsumɔ lɛ ahewɔ. Nyɛkpɔa nyɛyi kuekue tamɔ akpaŋa yiteŋ, ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ nyɛbii lɛ anom kɛaaje nyɛhe kɛya.
2: Kpoo hã mɛi ni toɔ efɔŋ he ŋaa yɛ amɛsai anɔ lɛ. Kɛji je tsɛre, ni amɛna hegbɛ lɛ, amɛfeɔ efɔŋ ni amɛto he ŋaa amɛfɔ shi lɛ ejaakɛ efɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ ŋmɔji anɔ, ni amɛŋɔɔ; amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ shīai anɔ, ni amɛŋɔɔ. Mɔ ko mɔ ko gboshinii kɛ ewe fɛɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Mito ni mibahã sane fɔŋ aye nyɛ ni nyɛnyɛŋ enaa foi nyɛjo; amanehulu baaba nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛnyiɛ kɛ nyɛhetsɔ̃ɔmɔ.

Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mɛi kɛ nyɛsane lɛ aaabu abɛ, ni amɛaala nijiaŋwujee lala amɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔhiɛ ekpãtã kwrakwra! Yehowa ehe wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ; ni ekɛhã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ, ni eja wɔŋmɔji ehã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ kɛ be shɛ, ni akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miiku sɛɛ ahã Yehowa bii lɛ, kɛji afɔ̃ oshiki lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko naŋ eko.
Mɛi shiɛɔ ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Kaashiɛ owo wɔ. Kaashiɛ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ owo wɔ; hiɛgble ko bɛ ni baaba wɔnɔ.
Ani osusuɔ akɛ alomɔ Israelbii? Ani Yehowa tsuishitoo lɛ eta? Ani ebaafee nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi? Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja lɛ, ani jeee hi miwiemɔ lɛ hi hã amɛ?"

Yehowa to he akɛ, "Nyɛteɔ shi nyɛwoɔ mimaŋ lɛ tamɔ ateɔ shi awoɔ henyɛlɔi. Mɛi kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛɔ ta naa kɛbaa, ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛfee shweshweeshwe yɛ shīa. Shi naa nyɛ ni nyɛmiimɛ amɛ koni nyɛkplɔ amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe.
Nyɛshwieɔ mimaŋ lɛ mli yei lɛ yɛ amɛshīai ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ; ni jɔɔmɔi ni mikɛjɔɔ amɛbii lɛ, nyɛshɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛyaa. Biɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe dɔŋŋ yɛ nyɛhe eshai ni kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baaba lɛ hewɔ.
"Gbalɔ ni maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ ji gbalɔ ni nyiɛɔ ni ewieɔ fuu ni emaleɔ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, 'Wain kɛ dãa ni wa baabu ahã nyɛ.'

"Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, mabua nyɛnaa, nyɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ni eshwɛ. Mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too gwaŋtɛŋ ku kome; mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too ku yɛ amɛniyelihe yɛ ŋanɔ; nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baashi hoo ekoŋŋ kɛ gbɔmɛi."
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni gbleɔ gbɛ baagble gbɛ ahã amɛ, ni eeenyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba. Amɛaajwa maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ kɛje kpo kɛya heyeli mli. Amɛmaŋtsɛ ni ji Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ aaanyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛje kpo.
3: Nyɛ Israel onukpai ni ji Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛboa toi! Ani jeee nyɛgbɛnaa ji akɛ nyɛaale nɔ ni ja?
Shi nyɛnyɛɔ ekpakpa, ni nyɛsumɔɔ efɔŋ. Nyɛkpɔɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ahe wolo yɛ amɛhe be mli ni amɛhiɛ kã; ni nyɛjieɔ amɛheloo yɛ amɛwui ahe.
Nyɛyeɔ mimaŋbii lɛ aloo. Nyɛkpɔɔ amɛhe wolo yɛ amɛhe; nyɛkumɔɔ amɛwui, ni nyɛdukuɔ mli tamɔ loo ni akɛyaawo kukwɛi wulu mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛaablɔ nyɛtsɛ Yehowa, shi efoŋ nyɛdaaŋ; shi moŋ ekɛ ehiɛ aaatee nyɛ yɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ.

Gbalɔi lɛ lakaa mimaŋ lɛ. Mɛi ni hãa gbalɔi nɛɛ nɔ ko lɛ, gbalɔi lɛ shiɛɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ hejɔlɛ miiba; shi mɛi ni hãaa amɛ nɔ ko lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛhe gbeyei akɛ ta baaba abatua amɛ. Yehowa miikɛɛ gbalɔi nɛɛ akɛ,
"Gbalɔi, eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni nyɛbe baaho. Hulu aaanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛnɔ. Akɛni nyɛhã mimaŋ lɛ du gbɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ ninaa ko dɔŋŋ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ gbalɛ ko hu nyɛgba dɔŋŋ."
Mɛi ni gbaa nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ ahiɛ aaashwie shi, ni klamɔfoi lɛ hu ahiɛ aaagboi. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaagboi ni amɛaamu shi kɔ̃i, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hereee amɛ nɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, Yehowa kɛ emumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ woɔ mimli obɔ̃, ni ehãa mileɔ nɔ ni ji jalɛ, ni ehãa mi ekãa ni akɛkɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ji eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ Yakob we onukpai, nyɛ Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhiɔ jalɛ, ni nyɛhãa jalɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ejaaa, nyɛboa toi koo!
Nyɛmiima Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ wulu ni ji Yerusalem lɛ, nyɛmiima lashishwiemɔ kɛ kutumpɔo.

Maŋ onukpai lɛ, nyɔɔŋnii amɛheɔ dani amɛbuaa sane he; osɔfoi lɛ, nyɔmɔwo hewɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ shika hewɔ amɛgbaa nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ. Kɛ̃lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe kpasaa Yehowa ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ; nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko baŋ wɔnɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ, aaatsa Zion ashwie shi tamɔ atsaa ŋa akɛfeɔ ŋmɔ. Yerusalem aaatsɔ̃ tsu koi ni bua shi tamɔ gɔŋ, ni SɔLemɔwe lɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaatsa atsɔ̃ koo hayii.
4: Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Sɔlemɔ We lɛ gɔŋ lɛ aaakwɔ fe gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ, ni eeeta gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Majimaji aaabu kɛaaba enɔ.

Ni maji amli bii pii aaaba abakɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔyakwɔa Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ, kɛya Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ We lɛ; ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɔ ni etaoɔ ni wɔfee; koni wɔnyiɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ. Ejaakɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ, Yerusalem ebaajɛ; ekɛ emaŋ lɛ wieɔ kɛjɛɔ Zion."

Eeekojo maji pii ateŋ, eeebua maji wuji ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ fɛɛ anaa. Amɛkɛ amɛklaŋtei aaasɔ̃ kɔii, ni amɛkɛ amɛkplɔi lɛ hu aaasɔ̃ kaklai adɔi ni akɛkplɔɔ tso he. Maŋ ko woŋ klaŋte nɔ yɛ maŋ ko nɔ ni amɛsaŋ amɛhe amɛhaŋ tawuu dɔŋŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaata lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewaintsei kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbãmitsei ashishi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ ni kɛɛ enɛ.
Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ jaa, ni eboɔ enyɔŋmɔ toi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔja ni wɔɔbo Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi kɛaatee naanɔ;
"Be miiba," Yehowa kɛɛ, "Ni mabua obubuafoi ni egbɔjɔ kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ, mɛi ni migbla amɛtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛaaba.
Ni mikɛ akpaketsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ, kɛ maŋ, mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaje shishi, ni mafee amɛ maŋ ni da agbo. Ni Yehowa aaaye anɛnɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛaaje nakai be lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ fɛɛ."
Ni bo, Yerusalem, tooku lɛ mɔɔ ni kwɔ, Zion biyoo lɛ gɔŋkpɔ, oootsɔ̃ maŋtsɛmaŋ ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni oyɔɔ tsutsu lɛ.
Mɛɛba oblɔɔ? Mɛɛba okɛ̃mɔɔ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ? Maŋtsɛ ni obɛ hewɔ ni, aloo oŋaawolɔ ni egbo hewɔ ni?
Yerusalembii, nyɛkɛ̃mɔa, ni nyɛkɔ̃mɔa tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eta ehe; ejaakɛ nyɛbaashi maŋ lɛ mli ni nyɛaayahi ŋa lɛ nɔ; nyɛbaaya Babilon tɔ̃ɔ. Shi jɛi lɛ Yehowa aaahere nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Maji pii ekpe ewo nyɛhe, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Afite Yerusalem koni wɔna ni ejwere shi koikoi."
Shi maji nɛɛ leee Yehowa jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, amɛyooo eyiŋto lɛ sɛɛ hu akɛ Yehowa ebua amɛnaa tamɔ abuaa ŋmãakei anaa yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe.

Yehowa kɛɛ, "Yerusalembii, nyɛtea shi; ni nyɛgbea nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ tamɔ agbeɔ ŋmãa! Mahã nyɛhe awa tamɔ tsina nuu kɛ ekloŋtoi ni wa dade kɛ ekoklotoi hu ni wa tamɔ akɔɔble. Nyɛaaye maji pii anɔ kunim; ni nyɛaajɔɔ haanii ni amɛshɔ̃ aklanaŋ naa lɛ nɔ nyɛhã mi, mi ni ji je lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ."
5: Yerusalembii, nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi anaa! Asa wɔyi! Atua Israelbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ!.
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Betlehem Efrata, maji bibii fe fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ ekome ji o, shi omli majie Israel nɔyelɔ kɛaajɛ. Nɔyelɔ nɛɛ weku kpãa aaajɛ blema beebe."

No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa aaaŋmɛɛ emaŋ lɛ he ehã amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni yoofɔyoo lɛ aaafɔ ebinuu lɛ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba amɛnyɛmɛi Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.

Kɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ ba lɛ, eeeye emaŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eeelɛ amɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni jɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; eeeye nɔ kɛ agbojee hu ni ji Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ agbojee. Nɔyelɔ lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ aaahi shi shweshweeshwe, ejaakɛ aaakplɛ̃ nɔ akɛ eje agbo yɛ je lɛ mli he fɛɛ he;
ni ekɛ hejɔlɛ aaaba. Kɛji Asiriabii lɛ aaabatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛji amɛaafite wɔmɔji ni buɔ wɔhe lɛ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mli kɛho lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔtee hiɛnyiɛlɔi kãkãlɔi babaoo shi wɔwo amɛ.
Amɛkɛ klaŋte aaaye Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Nimrod Shikpɔŋ Lɛ mɛaahere wɔ Kɛaajɛ Asiriabii lɛ adɛŋ, Kɛji amɛba amɛbashimɔshimɔɔ shi yɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Israelbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ ŋwɛi bɔ ni Yehowa hãa enyɔɔ maji pii anɔ lɛ. Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ futufuli ni shwãa jwɛfɔ nɔ. Amɛkɛ amɛhe aaafɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ko nɔ.

Israelbii ni aaashwɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ lɛ aaatamɔ jata yɛ kooŋ kooloi ateŋ, aloo tamɔ jata oblanyo yɛ tookui ateŋ. Kɛji eegbɔbi kɛbote kooloi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ehuruɔ eyiɔ amɛnɔ, ni etserɛɔ amɛmli, ni jielɔ ko bɛ.
Israelbii lɛ aaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ makpãtã okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni mafite oshwiilii lɛ.
Mafite maji ni yɔɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni makumɔ mɔji ni buɔ ohe lɛ mashwie shi.
Makpãtã okunyaayelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni okɔmfo kome nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ haŋ bo.
Mafite omãgãi lɛ kɛ owɔŋtɛi lɛ, ni ojaŋ nibii ni okɛ oniji fee lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Wɔŋyoo Ashera wɔŋkoi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, makwao mashwie shi, ni mafite omaji lɛ.
Mikɛ mlifu kple kɛ mlila aaatɔ owele yɛ maji fɛɛ ni booo mi toi ni egbo minɔ toi lɛ anɔ."
6: Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, "Tee shi ni oklɔ ogbee! Hã gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anu osane lɛ."
"Nyɛ gɔji, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo ni yɔɔ daa, nyɛboa Yehowa sane lɛ toi! Yehowa kɛ emaŋ Israel ena; ekɛ sane ni eyɔɔ yɛ amɛhe lɛ baashi lɛ."
Yehowa miibi emaŋ lɛ akɛ, "Mimaŋ, mɛni mifee o? Mɛni mli mihã etɔ o yɛ? Ha mi hetoo.
Ejaakɛ mi mijie bo kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpɔ̃ bo yɛ nyɔnyeli mli. Mitsu Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam kɛba akɛ ohiɛnyiɛlɔi.

Mimaŋbii, nyɛkaia nɔ yiŋ ni Moab maŋtsɛ Balak to yɛ nyɛhe, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni Bileam, Beor bi lɛ, hã lɛ. Nyɛkaia nibii ni ba yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Akasia shitoohe lɛ kɛtee Gilgal tɔ̃ɔ lɛ. Nyɛkaia nibii nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna nibii ni mi, Yehowa, mitsu ni mikɛhere nyɛyiwala lɛ."
Mɛni mikɛaaba Yehowa hiɛ, ni mɛni mikɛaabakoto Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ hiɛ? Miba ehiɛ kɛ shãa afɔlei? Mikɛ tsinabii ni eye afifi abashã shãa afɔlei ahã lɛ?
Ani toi agboi akpekpei aloo mu tsɛnsii akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ aaasa Yehowa hiɛ? Aso mikɛ mikromɔbi, mimusuŋbi lɛ ahã yɛ mihe esha hewɔ?
Dabida! Ao Adesa, Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni hi. Nɔ ni ebiɔ yɛ odɛŋ nɛ, akɛ ofee nɔ ni ja gbɛ, osumɔ onyɛmimɛi, okɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anyiɛ yɛ heshibaa mli.
Ehi akɛ ashe Yehowa gbeyei. Eeetsɛ maŋ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛkpeɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli!
Nɔ ni yɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔi ashīai amli ni ji jwetri ni atsɔ̃ shishiumɔ gbɛi anɔ ana, kɛ susumɔnii kɛ nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ ni akɛŋmɛɔ nii lɛ, ani mihiɛ aaakpa nɔ? Dabida, miihi!
Ani mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ susumɔnii kɛ nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ ahe esha aaafa amɛ lo?
Niiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ shishiuɔ ohiafoi lɛ; ni nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ amalelɔi ji nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mije nyɛ nitswiamɔ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ shishi momo yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
Nyɛaaye nii, shi nyɛtrɔŋ; ni hɔmɔ aaakã he aye nyɛ. Nyɛaaloo nii nyɛto, shi efeŋ shweshweeshwe, ni nɔ ni nyɛaabaa yi tete lɛ, makpãtã hiɛ yɛ ta mli.
Nyɛaadu nii, shi nyɛkpaŋ eko. Nyɛaaŋa mu, shi nyɛnaŋ mu nyɛkpa, ni nyɛaaŋa wain hu, shi nyɛnuŋ wain.
Enɛ baaba mli, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ Omri nibii gbohii lɛ kɛ ebi Ahab nibii fɔɔji lɛ, nomɛi anɔ nyɛtsa. No hewɔ lɛ mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni abuŋ nyɛ, ni aaabo nyɛ 'tsia'!"
7: Kpoo hã mi! Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ ni eetao tsoyibii loo wainyibii ko eye, ejaakɛ akpa wainyibii kɛ agbãmii ni ŋɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ atã, ni shao ko bɛ ni aaana aye; agbãmi hee ni mitsui shweɔ lɛ eko bɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ; mɔ ko bɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miitao akɛ ena hegbɛ ni eshwie lá shi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miigbɔbi enaanyo.
Amɛhe esa kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni amɛfeɔ lɛ kɛ ŋaa. Lumɛi kɛ kojolɔi lɛ heɔ nyɔɔŋnii. Nɔ fɔŋ ni yɔɔ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɔ tsuiŋ lɛ, ejeɔ enaa; kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãŋ amɛto.

Mɔ ni kɛɛ ehi fe fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ, etamɔ kpitikpiti ŋmei, ni mɔ ni kɛɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmei afabaŋ po hi fe lɛ. Shi gbi ni Nyɔŋmɔ baagbla amɛtoi lɛ eshɛ taakɛ ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ kɛtsɔ̃ egbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛjijaa.
Kaahe onaanyo oye; ni kɛ ohiɛ akafɔ̃ oshieŋtsɛ nɔ. Yoo ni kãa osɛɛ tete po lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ he jogbaŋŋ dani okɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko.
Ejaakɛ binuu ebuuu etsɛ, biyoo teɔ shi woɔ enyɛ; ni shaayoo teɔ shi woɔ eshaayoo. Gbɔmɔ henyɛlɔi ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshīa teŋ bii.
Shi mi lɛ, makwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; mamɛ miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabo mi toi.
Ao mihenyɛlɔ, kaaye mi yɔɔ. Kɛ migbee shi lɛ, mibate shi ekoŋŋ; kɛ duŋ wo mi lɛ, Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ la ahã mi.
Makplɛ̃ Yehowa mli ni efu mi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mifee esha mishi lɛ; mamɛ kɛyashi eeefã mihe, ni eeebu mi bem. Eeejie mi kɛaaba la hiɛ ni mana ekpɔmɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mihenyɛlɔ mɔ ni ebi mi akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ" lɛ? Aaana, ni ehiɛ aaagbo kpɔtɔɔ. Mihiŋmɛi aaana lɛ; agbɛnɛ aaanaanaa enɔ tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
Yerusalembii, be miiba ni aaasaa maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ atswa ni aaalɛɛ ehusui amli kɛaatee sɛɛ.

Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba. Aaajɛ Asiria ni yɔɔ bokã lɛ kɛ Egipt ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛaaba. Aaajɛ Asiria ni yɔɔ bokã lɛ kɛ Egipt ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛaaba. Amɛaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ he kɛ ŋshɔi anaa kɛ gɔ̃ji anɔ kɛaaba.
Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa yɛ enɔ bii lɛ anifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ahewɔ. Yehowa aaana Israel mɔbɔ

Yehowa, feemɔ tookwɛlɔ ohã omaŋ lɛ, ni olɛ amɛ, maŋ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ. Amɛyɛ ŋa kplanaa nɔ banee yɛ Gɔŋ Karmel lɛ yiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii bɔle amɛ kɛkpe. Hã ni amɛhi Bashan kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛye enɔ nii tamɔ blema ko lɛ.
Mafee naakpɛɛnii matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tamɔ be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maji lɛ aaana, ni yɛ amɛhewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛnijiaŋ aaaje wui. Amɛkɛ amɛnine aaato amɛnaabu ni amɛaatsimɔ amɛtoii.
Amɛaalɛmɔ shikpɔŋ su, ni amɛaawamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ tamɔ onufu. Amɛaajɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ. Yehowa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ he ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛaashe bo gbeyei.
Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ esha faa tamɔ bo. Okuɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ɔ omaŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ amlatɔ̃mɔ nɔ. Ohiɛɛɛ mlifu mli kɛyaaa naanɔ, ejaakɛ onaa mɔbɔnalɛ he tsui.
Oooku sɛɛ omusuŋ atsɔ̃ o yɛ wɔhe. Okɛ onane aaashwishwia wɔnishaianii lɛ anɔ ni osherɛ oshwie ŋshɔ shishi bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Obaajie onɔkwayeli kɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ omaŋ lɛ, ni ji Abraham kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni owo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi blema bei lɛ amli beebe lɛ.

1: Nineve shigbeemɔ he gbalɛ nɛɛ, ajie atsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Nahum, Elkoshnyo lɛ.
Yehowa lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋa ni, ni asaŋ etɔɔ owele. Oweletɔlɔ ji Yehowa, ni emlifu naa wa. Yehowa tɔɔ owele yɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tswaa anɔ, ni ekɛ emlifu shakãa ehenyɛlɔi anɔ.
Yehowa mli fuuu mra, ni ehewalɛ da kple; ehãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋɔ ehe aye. Ahum kɛ lasuogbele teɔ shi yɛ he ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ kɛho, ni enaneshi mlu ji atatui.
Eŋãa ŋshɔ yi, ni emiɔ; ehãa fai fɛɛ miɔ. Bashan kɛ Karmel gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ ŋãlãa, ni Lebanon ŋã floŋŋ lɛ hu ŋãlãa.
Gɔ̃ji hosoɔ yɛ ehiɛ, gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ sreɔ: Shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ ehiɛ, ni je lɛ kɛ emli bii fɛɛ hu ahiɛ kpãtãa.
Namɔ aaanyɛ emlila naa adamɔ? Namɔ aaanyɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa ekpee? Emlifu tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ la, ni eflɛɔ tɛsai amli.
Yehowa hi, etsɔ̃ɔ teemɔhe yɛ amanehulu be mli, ni ebaa mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ ayi.
Shi ebaa tamɔ faa ni eje ŋã, ni ebakãtãa ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ; etiuɔ ehenyɛlɔi kɛyashiɔ egbeɔ amɛ.
Mɛɛ shi nyɛte nyɛwo Yehowa lɛ? Ebaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ kwraa. Etɔɔɔ owele shii enyɔ.
Abaashã amɛ wɛɛ tamɔ ŋmei ni eloloo, loo gbetseli gbiŋ.
Nineve, ani mɔ ko jɛɛɛ omli ni jwɛŋ Yehowa he efɔŋ, ni to ehe yiŋ fɔŋ?
Israelbii, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, "Yɛ mli akɛ Asiriabii lɛ ayi fa po nɛ, shi amɛhiɛ baakpãtã; ni amɛsɛɛ baafo. Mipiŋ nyɛ kɛho; mipiŋŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ, apã lɛ ni Asiria kɛfɔ̃ nyɛkuɛ lɛ mibakumɔ mli; ni mibatserɛ kpãai ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli."
Kitã ni Yehowa ewo yɛ Asiria he ji enɛ, "Onaŋ shwiei ni baahã akai ogbɛi. Makumɔ sū amãgãi kɛ dade amãgãi lɛ ni yɔɔ ojemawɔji lɛ awei lɛ amli lɛ. Masaa gbonyobu mato bo, Asiria ejaakɛ ohiii kwraa."

Naa, bɔfo ko miiba yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ sane kpakpa; eeba kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ sane. Yudabii, nyɛyea nyɛgbiijuji lɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋnii ni nyɛwo he shi lɛ, nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ. Yitsoŋwalɔi lɛ baŋ abatuaŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ; akpatã amɛhiɛ butuu.
2: Nineve, nifitelɔ lɛ eba ebaatua bo! Mɔ ni baakpãtã ohiɛ lɛ eshɛ shi. Abu maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ he! Nyɛmiaa; buamɔ otabilɔi blublu anaa!
(Yehowa miihã Israel hiɛ aba nyam ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ baye enɔ, ni amɛkpãtã eblema nyam lɛ hiɛ.)

Henyɛlɔi tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ hiɛ tsɛŋi tsuji, ni amɛwowoo atadei tsuji. Amɛmiisaa amɛhe kɛhã maŋ lɛ tuamɔ. Kɛji amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ to kɛdamɔ shi lɛ, amɛhe kplɛɔ tamɔ la ni miitso; amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ miitumɔtumɔɔ.
Tayaa shwiilii lɛ gbaa shi yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyaa amɛbaa kɛ foi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli blohui lɛ amli. Amɛhe kplɛɔ tamɔ kɔtii, ni amɛfoɔ hiŋmɛi naa tamɔ srawa.
Atsɛɔ tabilɔi asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ; shi amɛnaji trɛɔ shi kɛyaa, be mli ni henyɛlɔi lɛ tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaninaa maŋ gbogbo lɛ; ni amɛmamɔɔ nibii kɛtsīɔ amɛhiɛ
Agbele faa lɛ naagbɛ agboi lɛ, maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli yiɔ kɛ hejramɔ.
Aŋɔ maŋnyɛ lɛ nom kɛtee, ni eweyei lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ; amɛgbei etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpoi agbee; amɛmiiyi amɛtsitsii anɔ mã.
Ninevebii eke kɛ foi tamɔ faa ni etue, amɛke kɛ blɔmɔ akɛ, "Nyɛdamɔa shi! Nyɛdamɔa shi!" Shi mɔ ko mɔ ko ekuuu esɛɛ.
Nyɛhaa jwiɛtɛi! Nyɛhaa shika! Jwinei srɔtoi ni abua naa ato yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, jeee hiɛ nɛ.
Akpãtã Nineve hiɛ, afee lɛ butuu etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃! Gbeyei emɔmɔ tsuii, nakutsei miikpokpo hewalɛ etã yɛ mɛi amli, ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ eshale.
Nɛɛgbɛ maŋ lɛ ni tsɔ̃ tamɔ jata oblahii ashihilɛhe lɛ yɔɔ, he ni jata shãtã eniyenii kɛtee ebii aŋɔɔ yɛ, ni mɔ ko gbaaa enaa lɛ?
Jata nuu lɛ gbe loo bɔ ni baashɛ jata yoo kɛ ebii anaa; ewo etɛkplo lɛ mli obɔ̃, kɛ ebui lɛ amli kɛ loo ni egbe.

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Naa, mikɛ nyɛ ena. Mibama nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ anaa la mashã. Nyɛtabilɔi ni tamɔ jata lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔi yɛ ta mli. Mashɔ̃ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛshɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ yɛ mɛi adɛŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, asaŋ anuŋ ohewalɛ he yɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
3: Kpoo hã maŋ ni shwieɔ lá shi ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ amale kɛ yiwalɛ kɛ mɛi anii ni ayaha.
Bo toi! Okpɔŋɔ gwaomɔ kpãa miigbɛɛ, tayaa shwiilii anaji miigbɛɛ; okpɔŋɔi esha foi, ni tayaa shwiilii miihɛlɛ shi!
Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi ewo foi kɛmiiba, klaŋte miikpɛlɛ nyramnyram, ni akplɔ miikplɛ tamɔ srawa! Gbohii bua shi tsãa; mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔi lɛ, babaoo, amɛyi fa fe nine, mɛi mitrɛtrɛɛ amɛ!
Fɛɛ jɛ Nineve ajwamaŋbɔɔ. Ehe yɛ fɛo bɔ ni ekɛ ehe fɛo duɔ maji kɛ gbɔmɛi ni ekɛyeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ.
Yehowa, Tatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji, "Naa, Nineve, mi kɛ bo ena! Mibawo ohiɛ mama nɔ, ni mahã maji ana oyayaiaŋ; amɛbaana ohiɛshishwiemɔ.
Mibanyaŋe bo, ni matsi muji mashwie onɔ, ni mɛi aaakwɛ bo gãa.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni baana bo baasu amɛhe kɛya sɛɛ. Amɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Nineve etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃! Namɔ yeɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ koo! Nɛɛgbɛ mana mɛi aaajɛ abashɛje emii?'"
Nineve, ani ohi fe Tebes, Nilo Faa lɛ toi maŋ lɛ ni nu efo ehe sa kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni ŋshɔ ewaje lɛ kɛfo ehe, ni nu etsɔ̃ gbogbo ehã lɛ lɛ lo?
Tebes na hewalɛ kɛjɛ Sudan kɛ Egipt fɛɛ dɛŋ, nakai ehewalɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ naa adamɔ. Putbii kɛ Libiabii fɛɛ ye bua lɛ.

Kɛ̃lɛ ana aŋɔ lɛ nom hu, ni akɛ emli bii abifabii tswiatswia shi, ni agbɛgbɛɛ amɛ ashwãshwãa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoii fɛɛ. Emli hiɛnaanɔmɛi lɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki kɛja amɛ hã amɛhe, ni awo amɛ gboklɛ, ni akpla amɛ kɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli.
Nineve, nakai bo hu obaatɔ dãa, ni ohiɛ baaha; ni obaatao abobaahe kɛjo ohenyɛlɔ lɛ naa foi.
Omɔji lɛ, naa, amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ agbãmitsei ni amɛklɛŋklɛŋ yibii etsu yɛ amɛnɔ. Hosomɔ nɛkɛ ni aaahoso tsei lɛ, yibii lɛ baakpla ashwie yelɔ lɛ daaŋ.
Naa, otabilɔi lɛ yei sɔŋŋ ji amɛ. Oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ anaa agboi lɛ anaa kãmɔ hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ. La baashã ogboi nɛɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
Nyɛyɛa numɔ nu nyɛtoa be ni abaasa nyɛmaŋ lɛ yi lɛ; nyɛwajeɔ nyɛmɔji lɛ; nyɛnaa su ni akɛfoɔ brikisi lɛ, ni asaa brikisifoo adeka lɛ ato.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔi, kɛjeee yɛ la mli lɛ no lɛ yɛ ta mli. Abaaplenee nyɛ tamɔ baalabii kpãtãa ŋmɔshinii ahiɛ. Nyɛhã nyɛyi afaa tamɔ baalabii, nyɛyi afaa tamɔ otukpɛi.
Nyɛhãa nyɛteiaŋ jrayelɔi ayi yafa fe ŋwɛi ŋulamii tete! Shi bɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ amɛnɔ egbɔ tamɔ baalabii ni bayeɔ nii ni amɛflikiɔ kɛyaa lɛ?
Nyɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ agãi, ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ baalabii ni basɔ̃mɔɔ afabaŋi ahe gbi nɔ ni fɛi miiye. Kɛji hulu lɛ te shi pɛ amɛfliki kɛtee, ni aleee he ni amɛyaa.
Ao! Asiria Maŋtsɛ, omraloi lɛ egboi; ni wɔ enyɔ ohiɛnaanɔbii lɛ anɔ. Agbɛ owebii lɛ ashwã gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa b3 ni buaa amɛnaa.
Pilamɔ ni opila lɛ bɛ tsabaaa ni ofaji lɛ ehiŋ tsamɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he lɛ tswaa amɛdɛ̃ amɛshwieɔ onɔ kɛ nyamɔ; ejaakɛ namɔ po ni yɔɔ ni oyeko lɛ sane fɔŋ dã?

1: Nehemia, Hakalia bi lɛ, saji nɛ. Yɛ Kislev nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, miyɛ Susa, maŋtsɛ maŋ lɛ mli,
ni Hanani ni ji minyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ kɛ hii komɛi jɛ Yuda ba. Mibi amɛ Yudafoi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni hiɛ kã lolo lɛ ahe sane kɛ Yerusalem hu he sane.
Amɛto he akɛ, "Mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni hiɛ kã lolo ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ miina amanehulu kple, ni amɛhiɛ eshwie shi. Yerusalem gbogbo lɛ akumɔ ashwie shi, ni enaa agboi lɛ ashã.
Be ni minu wiemɔ nɛɛ miho mita shi, ni mifo. "Miye ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ, ni mihi ŋmãa. Misɔle mikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai,
ni mikɛɛ, 'Ao Yehowa, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ni oda ni ohe yɔɔ gbeyei! Okɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee yeɔ kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ mɛi ni sumɔɔ o, ni amɛyeɔ okitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ kpãŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ anɔkwafo ji o.
Kwɛmɔ, ni oka otoi ohã fai ni mi, otsulɔ, mikpaa o nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane mihãa otsuji Israelbii lɛ. Miijaje akɛ wɔ, Israelbii, wɔfee esha wɔshi o; ni mi kɛ mitsɛwe lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ fɔ yɛ enɛ mli.
Wɔfee efɔŋ ni naa wa naakpa wɔshi o, ejaakɛ wɔyeko kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni owo kɛtsɔ̃ otsulɔ Mose nɔ lɛ anɔ.'
Kaimɔ wiemɔ ni okɛ otsulɔ Mose wie akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛyeee mi anɔkwa lɛ, magbɛ nyɛ mashwã maji anɔ,
shi kɛji nyɛkpale kɛba miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛye mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛji mɛi ni agbɛ ashwã lɛ yaje jeŋ naagbeehe tete lɛ, mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ jɛi tɔ̃ɔ, ni makpla amɛ kɛaaba he ni mito ni aja mi yɛ lɛ.'
"Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji otsuji kɛ omaŋ ni okɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ekpɔ̃ lɛ.

Ao Nuŋtsɔ, ka otoi ohã fai ni otsulɔ kpaa o lɛ. Ka toi ohã fai ni otsulɔ kpaa o lɛ. Ka toi ohã fai ni otsuji ni sumɔɔ akɛ amɛshe o gbeyei lɛ kpaa o lɛ. Hã otsulɔ aye omanye ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni hã maŋtsɛ lɛ ana mi mɔbɔ." Nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ dãawolɔ ji mi.
2: Gbi ko yɛ Nisan nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ miiye nii, ni wain ma ehiɛ. Miwo wain lɛ, ni mikɛhã lɛ. Enako mi ni mifee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ ehiɛ pɛŋ.
Ebi mi akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni ohiɛ efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ, ni jeee akɛ ohe hu ni yeɔ lɛ? Jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni fe akɛ ooye awerɛhoo yɛ otsui mli." Mihɛle shi amrɔ nɛkɛ,
ni mikɛɛ, "Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ! Nii, mɛɛba ni esaaa akɛ mihiɛ afee mɔbɔmɔbɔ be ni maŋ ni ji he ni mitsɛmɛi asaŋi yɔɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ, ni ashã ehe agboi lɛ?"
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi mi akɛ, "Mɛni ji nɔ ni otaoɔ?" No hewɔ lɛ misɔle mikpa ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai,
ni mikɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji esa maŋtsɛ hiɛ, ni kɛji otsulɔ hiɛ eba nyam yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, no lɛ hã maya Yuda yɛ maŋ ni afu mitsɛmɛi yɛ mli lɛ mli, koni mayasaa mama maŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ."
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Maŋnyɛ lɛ ta maŋtsɛ lɛ masɛi, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi mi akɛ, "Gbii enyiɛ oyaaye, ni mɛɛbe oooku osɛɛ oba ekoŋŋ?" Esa maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ akɛ eŋmɛ mi gbɛ ni maya; ni mito lɛ be.
Asaŋ mikɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ kɛji eesumɔ lɛ, no lɛ ehã mi woji ni mikɛyahã amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ, koni amɛŋmɛ mi gbɛ ni mafo mli kɛba Yuda.

Asaŋ mibi wolo ko hu ni mikɛyahã Asaf, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ koo lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni ehã mi tsumaa tsei. Tsei nɛɛ mikɛbaakpɛ mɔɔ agboi mawo Sɔlemɔwe lɛ he, kɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ kɛ shĩa ni miyahi mli lɛ he. Akɛni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ fee nɔ ni mitaoɔ lɛ fɛɛ ehã mi.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi eto mihe. Miyashɛ amralofoi ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ; ni mikɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ woji lɛ hã amɛ.
Shi be ni Sanbalat, Horonnyo lɛ, kɛ Tobia, Amonnyo ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nu lɛ, edɔ amɛ naakpa akɛ nuu ko eba ni ebatao Israelbii lɛ ejurɔyeli.
Mibashɛ Yerusalem, ni miye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.

Ni mite shi nyɔɔŋ, mi kɛ hii fioo ko ni fata mihe lɛ. Shi migbako mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛwo mitsui mli akɛ miyafee mihã Yerusalem lɛ. Asaŋ mihiɛɛɛ kooloo ko kooloo ko hu akɛ ja kooloo ni mita nɔ lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ.
Mitsɔ̃ jɔɔ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa nyɔɔŋ kɛje kpo kɛtsɔ̃ Drako Nubu lɛ he kɛtee Tumu Agbo lɛ naa. Misra Yerusalem gbogboi lɛ mikwɛ bɔ ni amɛkumɔ amɛshwie shi, kɛ enaa agboi ni ashã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mifoŋ kɛtee Nubu Agbo lɛ naa kɛ Maŋtsɛ Kpaakpo lɛ hu naa; shi kooloo ni mita nɔ lɛ naaa he ko etsɔ̃ yɛ nikikiŋkoi lɛ amli kɛho.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ mli lɛ mitsɔ̃ faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli kɛtee miyakwɛ gbogbo lɛ; ni miku misɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ jɔɔ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi nɔyelɔi lɛ leee he ni mitee kɛ nɔ ni miyafee. Yudafoi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni ji mɛi ni baatsu nii lɛ hu, migbako amɛ.

Shi agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiina nɔ amane mli ni wɔyɔɔ, bɔ ni Yerusalem ekumɔ kɛbua shi, ni ehe agboi lɛ hu ashã. Nyɛbaa, ni nyɛhãa wɔtswaa Yerusalem gbogbo lɛ koni wɔhiɛshishwiemɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ afo."
Ni migba amɛ akɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ. Migba amɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔ ni ekɛ mi wie lɛ hu. Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔbɔia gbogbo lɛ tswaa! Ni amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã nitsumɔ kpakpa lɛ."
Shi be ni Sanbalat, Horonnyo lɛ, kɛ Tobia, Amonnyo ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ kɛ Geshem, Arabianyo lɛ, nu lɛ, amɛŋmɔ wɔ, ni amɛye wɔhe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, "Mɛɛ sane nyɛyeɔ nɛɛ? Aso nyɛmitse Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atūa?"
Mito he akɛ, "Ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ eeehã wɔnyɛ wɔfee. No hewɔ lɛ wɔ, ni ji etsuji lɛ, wɔbaawo gbogbo lɛ tswaa nɔ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ ko loo hegbɛ ko loo kaimɔ nɔ ko yɛ Yerusalem."
3: Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa Eliashib, kɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ tswa Toi Agbo lɛ gbogbo lɛ; amɛtra enaa shinai lɛ, ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ kɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ. Amɛfee gbogbo lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ aahuu kɛyashi Hamea mɔɔ gojoo lɛ kɛ Hananel mɔɔ gojoo lɛ he.
Yeriko hii lɛ tswa gbogbo kɛtsa nɔ; ni Zakur, Imri bi lɛ, hu tswa kɛtsa Yeriko hii lɛ anɔ lɛ nɔ.
Hasenabii lɛ tswa Loi Agbo lɛ gbogbo lɛ. Amɛsɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛtra enaa shinaai kɛ sai kɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
Meremot, Hakoz bi ni ji Uria nabi lɛ, saa gbogbo ni tsa nɔ lɛ. Amɛnɔtsamɔ lɛ Meshulam ni ji Meshezabel bi Berekia bi lɛ basaa. Nɔ ni tsa enɛ hu nɔ lɛ, Bana bi Zadok tswa.
Enɛ nɔtsamɔ lɛ Tekoa hii lɛ ji mɛi ni twsa, shi abledei ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhe wooo amɛ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ mli.
Agbo Momo lɛ, Yoiada, Pasea bi lɛ, kɛ Meshulam, Besodeia bi lɛ, basaa. Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛsɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛtra enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai lɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ kɛyashi faa lɛ anaiagbɛ, he ni amralo lɛ shihilɛhe lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, Melatia, Gibeonnyo lɛ, kɛ Yadon, Meronotnyo lɛ, kɛ Gibeon kɛ Mizpabii lɛ ji mɛi ni basaa.
Enɔtsamɔ lɛ, Harhaia bi Uziel ni jɛ shika ŋaalɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ ji mɔ ni basaa. Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ lɛ, Hanania, ojeŋmafeelɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni batswa. Amɛsaa Yerusalem gbogbo lɛ kɛyashi Agbo Lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ he.
Nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ, Refaia, Hur bi lɛ ni ji Yerusalem mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni basaa.
Enɛ nɔtsamɔ lɛ, Yedaia, Harumaf bi lɛ, basaa; eyɛ eshīa lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ, Hashabneia bi Hatush ji mɔ ni basaa.
Malkia, Harim bi lɛ, kɛ Hashub, Pahat-Moab bi lɛ, basaa nɔ ni tsa nɔ lɛ kɛ Flɔnɔi Amɔɔ lɛ hu.
Enɔtsamɔ lɛ Shalum, Halohesh bi lɛ, ni ji Yerusalem mlija fã lumɔ lɛ basaa; ebiyei lɛ ye bua lɛ kɛsaa.
Hanum kɛ Zanoa maŋ lɛ mli bii basaa Jɔɔ Agbo lɛ. Amɛma ni amɛtra enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai lɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Amɛtswa gbogbo ninetalɔi akpe kɛyashi Tumu Agbo lɛ naa.
Tumu Agbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mɔ ni saa ji Malkia, Rekab bi lɛ ni ji Bet-Hakerem mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ. Lɛ ema ni etra enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.

Nubu Agbo lɛ Shallum, Kol-Hoze bi lɛ ni ji Mizpa mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni basaa. Lɛ ema, ni eha nɔ, ni etra enaa shinai lɛ kɛ amɛhe sai kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ. Lɛ nɔŋŋ etswa Shela Kpaakpo lɛ he gbogbo lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ, aahuu kɛyashi atrakpoi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛjɛɔ David maŋ lɛ mli lɛ he.
Nɔ ni tsa enɛ nɔ lɛ, Nehemia, Azbuk bi lɛ ni ji Bet-Zur mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, basaa. Esaa kɛyashi David saŋi lɛ kɛ kpaakpo ni aje gbɛ afee lɛ kɛ tabilɔi ashihilɛhe lɛ ŋlɛnɔ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Levibii ni abaatsi amɛgbɛii atã nɛɛ batswa gbogbo lɛ hei komɛi: Rehum, Bani bi lɛ, batswa fã ko; Hashabia, Keila kpokpai anɔ mlijaa fã lumɔ lɛ, batswa he ni yɔɔ enɔ mli.
Esɛɛ lɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ batswa eko: Bawai. Henadad bi lɛ, ni ji Kiela mlijaa fã kome lɛ lumɔ lɛ, basaa fã,
ni Ezer, Yeshua bi lɛ ni ji Mizpa lumɔ lɛ, basaa fã hu yɛ he ni atsɔ̃ɔ akwɔɔ kɛyaa tawuunii toohe lɛ yɛ gbogbo lɛ koŋ lɛ.
Esɛɛ lɛ, Baruk, Zabai bi lɛ, basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko kɛjɛ gbogbo lɛ koŋ kɛyashi osɔfonukpa Eliashib shīa lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Baruk sɛɛ lɛ, Meremot, ni ji Hakoz bi Uria bi lɛ, basaa fã kroko kɛjɛ Eliashib we lɛ shinaa lɛ naa kɛyashi Eliashib we lɛ naagbeehe lɛ tɔ̃ɔ
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem kpokpai anɔ lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã ni tsa nɔ lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Benyamin kɛ Hashub basaa fã ni yɔɔ amɛshīai lɛ ahiɛ lɛ. Maaseia bi Azaria ni enii ji Anania basaa fã ni tsa nɔ ni yɔɔ eshīa lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Azaria sɛɛ lɛ Binui, Hanadad bi lɛ, basaa fã kroko kɛjɛ Azaria shīa lɛ he kɛyashi gbogbo lɛ koŋ kɛ he ni gbogbo lɛ dɔ eyi yɛ lɛ.
Palal, Uzai bi lɛ, batswa gbogbo lɛ fã ni kwɛɔ koŋ lɛ kɛ mɔɔ ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shīa lɛ nsrɔdo ni ji enyɔ lɛ he yɛ bulɔi akpo lɛ masɛi lɛ.
Palal sɛɛ lɛ Pedaia, Parosh bi lɛ, kɛ Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni hiɔ Ofel lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko kɛyashi he ko ni yɔɔ Nu Agbo lɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ mɔɔ ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo lɛ masɛi.
Pedaia sɛɛ lɛ, Tekoabii lɛ basaa gbogbo lɛ fã ni kwɛɔ mɔɔ wulu somromoo ni etsɛ̃ kɛje kpo lɛ. Amɛsaa gbogbo lɛ aahuu kɛyashi Ofel gbogbo lɛ he.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ basaa fã kroko. Amɛsaa kɛjɛ Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ sɛɛ kɛtee kooyigbɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tswa gbogbo lɛ fã ni yɔɔ eshia hiɛ lɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Zadok, Imer bi lɛ, basaa fã ni yɔɔ eshīa lɛ hiɛ lɛ. Esɛɛ lɛ, Shemaia, Shekania bi lɛ ni kwɛɔ Bokãgbɛ Agbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, basaa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko lɛ.
Shemaia sɛɛ lɛ, Hanania, Shelemia bi lɛ, kɛ Hanun, Zalaf bi ni ji ekpaa lɛ, basaa fã kroko. Amɛsɛɛ lɛ, Meshulam, Berekia bi lɛ, basaa fã ni yɔɔ esɛɛtsu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ.

Esɛɛ lɛ Malkia ni ji shika ŋaalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ batswa gbogbo lɛ fã kroko lɛ. Etswa kɛyashi Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ jrayelɔi lɛ awe lɛ he, yɛ Henaabuamɔ Agbo lɛ ŋlɛnɔ. Malkiya nɛɛ nɔŋŋ saa gbogbo lɛ kɛyashi ŋwɛitsu ni ma gbogbo lɛ koŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he.
Gbogbo lɛ naagbee fã ni kã ŋwɛitsu lɛ kɛ Toi Agbo lɛ teŋ lɛ, mɛi ni saa no ji shika ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ jrayelɔi lɛ.
4: Be ni Sanbalat nu akɛ wɔ, Yudafoi lɛ, wɔmiitswa gbogbo lɛ, emli fu ni emli wo la naakpa. Eye wɔhe fɛo,

ni ekɛɛ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ Samaria tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ akɛ, "Mɛni nɛkɛ Yudafoi wudɔwudɔi nɛɛ feɔ nɛɛ? Ani aŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ? Ani amɛ susuɔ akɛ kɛji amɛshã afɔlei lɛ amɛaanyɛ nitsumɔ lɛ naa amɛgbe gbi kome jenamɔ lo? Kolɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛjie tɛi lɛ yɛ tsu koi ni ashã ni bua shi kuikui lɛ amli lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni Tobia, Amonnyo ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ, kɛɛ, "Tɛ gbogbo tete po ni amɛtswaa nɛɛ lɛ, kɛ osɔ tete tu eyi nɔ lɛ, eeekumɔ eshwie shi."
Misɔle mikɛɛ, "Bo toi, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ. Bo bɔ ni agbeɔ wɔhe guɔ toi. Hã ni ahora ni amɛbɔɔ wɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ; hã aŋɔ amɛ nom, ni aha amɛnii.
Okɛ esha ni amɛfeɔ lɛ akafa amɛ, ni ohiɛ akakpa amɛhe eshai lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɔ wɔ ahora, ni amɛwo omli la yɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔtswaa gbogbo lɛ ahiɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ wɔtswa gbogbo lɛ kɛkpe kɛyashi enɔkwɔlɛ lɛ mlijaa, ejaakɛ maŋ lɛ yɛ nitsumɔ lɛ he tsui.
Shi be ni Sanbalat kɛ Tobia kɛ Arabiabii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Ashdodbii lɛ nu akɛ atsra Yerusalem gbogboi lɛ kɛkpe, ni abɔ̃i fɔji lɛ tsiimɔ lɛ, amɛmli wo la naakpa.
Amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛtee apam akɛ amɛmiiba ni amɛbatua Yerusalem ni amɛhã jɛi afee basabasa.
Shi wɔsɔle wɔkpa wɔsɔle wɔkpa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, ni wɔto bulɔi wɔto amɛ he koni amɛbu nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
Yudabii yɛ lala ko ni amɛlaa akɛ, "Wɔhewalɛ nɔ miigbɔ kɛ wɔjatsui ni wɔtre lɛ. Tsu gbogbo kukuji ni sa akɛ aloo lɛ fa tsɔ̃. Hewɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ gbogbo lɛ wɔtswa dɔŋŋ."
Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ susu akɛ wɔleŋ, ni asaŋ wɔnaŋ amɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaabote wɔteŋ ni amɛmiigbe wɔ koni nitsumɔ lɛ yi ahɛ shi.
Shi Yudafoi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ ba shii abɔ amɛbatswa wɔ adafi akɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ baajɛ hei srɔtoi ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ amɛbatua wɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ mike mɛi to gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ hei ni kwɔɔɔ ni kã shi kplanaa lɛ. Mito maŋ lɛ yɛ amɛwekui anaa; amɛhiɛ amɛklaŋtei kɛ amɛkplɔi kɛ amɛgãii.

Kɛkɛ ni mikwɛ bɔ ni nibii yɔɔ hãa, ni mikɛɛ maŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashea henyɛlɔi lɛ gbeyei; shi moŋ nyɛkaia Nuŋtsɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ni nyɛwua nyɛhãa nyɛnyɛmimɛi kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛshīaiaŋ lɛ."
Be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ nɔ akɛ abatswa wɔ adafi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛjina lɛ efee yaka lɛ, wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛba gbogbo lɛ he ekoŋŋ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee enitsumɔhe.
Kɛkɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, miwebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi fã tsuɔ nii lɛ, ni mɛi fã hiɛɔ akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi kɛ gaii ni amɛwo damai. Onukpai lɛ fi Yuda we lɛ fɛɛ ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ.
Mɛi ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ kɛ mɛi ni treɔ nibii ni akɛtswaa lɛ tete ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enine kome miitsu nii, belɛ ekɛ ekome hiɛ tawunii.
Mɛi ni tswaa gbogbo lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ klaŋte ŋmɔ ehɛ, ni ekɛtswaa gbogbo lɛ; ni mɔ ni kpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ yɛ mimasɛi.
Mikɛɛ maŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ "Nitsumɔ lɛ fa, ni egbɛ eshwã, ni wɔmli kã haŋŋhaŋŋ yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ, mɔ kɛ enaanyo teŋ jekɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaanu tɛtrɛmantrɛ gbɛɛmɔ yɛ lɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛbaa wɔŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi; wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaawu ahã wɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni wɔtsu nii lɛ nɛ, mɛi lɛ fã hiɛɔ akplɔi kɛjɛɔ hulu shitee kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni ŋulamii pueɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Asaŋ nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ ewebii awɔ Yerusalem koni amɛbu wɔhe nyɔɔŋ, ni shwane lɛ amɛtsu nii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi jio, minanemɛi nitsulɔi lɛ jio, miwebii lɛ kɛ mihebulɔi lɛ jio, wɔjieee wɔtadei; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tawuunii yɛ emasɛi.
5: Maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ wie amɛshi amɛnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ yɛ sane ni eŋɔɔɔ ni amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛyeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ, "Wɔ kɛ wɔbii lɛ, wɔyi fa yɛ wɔshīai amli. Ahã wɔ able bɔ ni sa ni wɔye koni wɔyi ana wla."
Mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, "Hɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromii kɛ wɔshīai totoɔ awabai koni wɔna shika wɔkɛhe able."
Asaŋ mɛi komɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛ onia lɛ tsumɔ hewɔ lɛ wɔyafla shika, ni wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromii lɛ eto naa.

Wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ hewolo kome, ni wɔbii lɛ tamɔ amɛbii lɛ, shi wɔtsiɔ wɔbii lɛ wɔwoɔ nyɔŋyeli mli, koni amɛtsɔmɔ nyɔji; ni wɔbiyei lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, afee amɛ nyɔji momo. Wɔnyɛɛɛ enɛ he nɔ ko wɔfee; ni wɔŋmɔji kɛ wɔwain tromii yɛ mɛi krokomɛi adɛŋ."
Be ni minu saji ni eŋɔɔɔ amɛnaa kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, mimli wo la naakpa,
ni mito miyiŋ nɔ ni sa akɛ mafee. Saji ni ayɔɔ yɛ abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ ahe lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ heɔ enyɛmi hekpa ni fe nine." Mibɔ gwa kpeteŋkple miwo amɛ;

ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ, wɔkpɔ̃ wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi ni ahɔ̃ɔ ahã jeŋmaji lɛ bɔ ni wɔnyɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛmiihɔ̃ɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ? Nyɛmiihɔ̃ɔ amɛ nyɛhã wɔ!" Amɛhãaa hetoo; amɛnãaa nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mitsa miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛɛ, "Nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ ejaaa. Ani esaaa akɛ nyɛkɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ he gbeyeishemɔ baa nyɛjeŋ koni wɔkɛku wɔhe fɛo ni jemajiaŋbii ni ji wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ yeɔ lɛ naa lo?
Mi kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ miwebii lɛ hu, wɔfaa wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudafoi lɛ shika kɛ able. Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ nɛkɛ hekpawoo nɛɛ akea.

Nyɛkɛ amɛŋmɔji kɛ amɛ wain tromi kɛ amɛmu tromi kɛ amɛshīai lɛ akūa sɛɛ ahãa amɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ. Nyɛkɛ shika kɛ able kɛ wain kɛ mu mlijai oha mli ekome ni ji hekpa ni nyɛheɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ hu akūa sɛɛ ahãa amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔkɛbaaku sɛɛ wɔhã amɛ, ni wɔheŋ nɔ ko yɛ amɛdɛŋ. Wɔɔfee tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ." Mitsɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛba, ni mihã maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ kamɔ kitã akɛ amɛaafee bɔ ni amɛwo shi nɛɛ.

Asaŋ mitswa mimlifiinɔ lɛ mli, ni mikɛɛ, "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeee nɛkɛ shiwoo nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatswa emli kɛjie lɛ kɛjɛ ewe kɛ enitsumɔ mli nɛ; bɔ nɔŋŋ ni aaatswa emli ni afee lɛ shwɛm nɛ." Asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Amen!" Ni amɛjie Yehowa yi. Maŋ lɛ ye amɛshiwoo nɛɛ nɔ.

Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni awo mi amralo ni kwɛɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ, no ji afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ sɔŋŋ nɛ lɛ, mi kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ wɔheko niyenii ni ahãa amralo fɛɛ amralo akɛ egbɛnaa niyenii lɛ eko.
Shi sa amraloi ni nyiɛ mihiɛ lɛ hã etɔ maŋ lɛ yɛ shika ni naa shiɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni amɛheɔ kɛshiɔ aboloo kɛ wain ni amɛheɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Asaŋ mikɛ mihewalɛ fɛɛ wo gbogbo lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ mli, ni mitaooo shikpɔŋ ko mihãaa mihe; ni miwebii lɛ fɛɛ bakpeɔ yɛ gbogbo lɛ he kɛhã nitsumɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ Yudafoi lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ bayeɔ nii yɛ mikplɔ̃ he; dani esro mɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji ni bɔlɛ wɔ lɛ ateŋ ni baa wɔŋɔɔ hu.

Nii ni ahoɔ ahãa mi gbi kome ji tsinanuu kome kɛ toi ni eshwi ekpaa kɛ wuɔi; ni daa gbii nyɔŋma sɛɛ lɛ, akɛ wain srɔtoi fɛɛ hu babaoo baa, migbɛnaa niyenii lɛ, mibii shi ejaakɛ onia ni atsuɔ maŋ lɛ efee jatsu ehã maŋ lɛ.
Mi Nyɔŋmɔ, nibii fɛɛ ni mifee mihã nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, kaimɔ mi ni ahi ahã mi.
6: Sanbalat kɛ Tobia kɛ Geshem, Arabianyo lɛ, kɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi krokomɛi lɛ nu akɛ mitswa gbogbo lɛ, ni ehe ko ni ekumɔ bɛ dɔŋŋ; ni eshwɛ agboi lɛ anaa shinai lɛ pɛ ni matra.
No hewɔ lɛ, Sanbalat kɛ Geshem tsu aba miŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ mikɛ lɛ abakpe yɛ Ono ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ akrowai lɛ eko mli. Shi efɔŋ amɛtaoɔ mi amɛfee.
Mitsu mɛi kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ koni ayakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nitsumɔ ni mitsuɔ lɛ da, hewɔ lɛ minyɛŋ maba. Mɛɛ hewɔ ni esa akɛ mahã afɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔ lɛ ni mashi maba nyɛŋɔɔ?"
Amɛtsu kɛba miŋɔɔ shii ejwɛ sɔŋŋ kɛ nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni mito he mihã amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Sanbalat tsu miŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shii enumɔ. Mɔ ni etsu lɛ hiɛ wolo ni asɔoko naa yɛ edɛŋ.
Wolo lɛ mli sane nɛ, "Aatã yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli, ni Geshem hu kɛɛ akɛ akɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ miitoa atsɛ atua, ni no hewɔ otswaa gbogbo lɛ, Asaŋ akɛɛ ootao maŋtsɛ oye.
Akɛɛ hu akɛ owo mɛi komɛi gbalɔi ni amɛshiɛ yɛ ohe yɛ Yerusalem akɛ, 'Maŋtsɛ ko yɛ Yuda!' Agbɛnɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ baaye ayashɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ toiŋ. No hewɔ lɛ ba ni wɔya he ajina."
Kɛkɛ ni mitsu Sanbalat ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, "Nibii ni okɛɔ nɛɛ, afeko nakai nɔ ko; bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fo otã."
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, wɔhe gbeyei kɛkɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛwo, ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnijiaŋ baaje wui yɛ nitsumɔ lɛ he koni egɔ̃. Shi misɔle mikɛɛ, "Ao Nyɔŋmɔ wo mi ekãa."

Gbi ko lɛ mitee Shemaia ni ji Delaia bi ni asaŋ eji Mehetabel nabi lɛ shīa; shi eŋa eyi, ni ekɛɛ, "Hã wɔyakpe yɛ nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni wɔŋamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinai lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaba ni amɛbagbe o. Amɛbaaba amɛbagbe o nyɔɔŋ tete."
Shi mikɛɛ, "Aso nuu tamɔ mi baajo foi? Ani nuu tamɔ mi aaajo foi kɛya Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, koni eyiana wala? Miyaaa!"
Miyoo akɛ jeee Nuyɔŋmɔ ni tsu Shemaia, shi moŋ Tobia kɛ Sanbalat ni ebɔ lɛ apaa hewɔ ni egba nɛkɛ gbalɛ nɛɛ eshi mi lɛ.
Amɛbɔ lɛ apaa bɔ ni afee ni ewo mihe gbeyei ni mafee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ koni mafee esha. Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛbaana sane fɔŋ ko yɛ mihe amɛyatã kɛbɔ mi ahora.

Misɔle mikɛɛ, "Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ ni okɛ Tobia kɛ Sanbalat aye kɛ joomɔ yɛ nibii ni amɛfee lɛ naa. Kaimɔ gbalɔyoo Noadia kɛ gbalɔi krokomɛi lɛ hu koni okɛ amɛ aye; amɛ amɛtaoɔ ni kulɛ amɛwo mihe gbeyei lɛ."
Gbii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, agbe nitsumɔ lɛ naa. Agbe naa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji Elul lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nu lɛ, jeŋmaji ni bɔle wɔ lɛ fɛɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛhiɛ gboi wo amɛyitseiaŋ, ejaakɛ amɛyoo akɛ, nitsumɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa ni anyɛ atsu.
Shi nɛkɛ bei amli fɛɛ lɛ, Yuda abladei lɛ miiŋmla woji pii amɛmiimaje Tobia, ni Tobia hu miiŋmla amɛ woji.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ Yuda ni kɛ Tobia ji ekome, ejaakɛ Ara bi Shekania shaanuu ji lɛ, ni asaŋ, lɛ Tobia lɛ, ebinuu Yehohanan ebaŋɔ Meshulam biyoo ni ji Berekia nabi akɛ ŋa.
Mɛi bawieɔ Tobia he ekpakpa amɛhãa mi, ni amɛyagbaa lɛ nɔ ni mi hu mikɛɔ. Tobia ŋmlaa mi woji, ni ekɛwoɔ mihe gbeyei.
7: Agbɛnɛ atswa gbogbo lɛ agbe naa, ni mitra agboi lɛ anaa shinaai lɛ, ni ato agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ Levibii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mitu Yerusalem miwo minyɛmi Hanani kɛ Hanania, mɔɔ lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ, dɛŋ, ejaakɛ nuu anɔkwafo ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei fe mɛi pii ji Hanania.

Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkahãa agblea Yerusalem agboi lɛ aŋmɛ; ja hulu naa ewa dã. Kɛji bulɔi lɛ damɔ shi amɛmiibu lɛ, aŋamɔ shinaai lɛ ni alalaa sɛɛ. Nyɛtoa bulɔi ni ji Yerusalembii. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahi ebuu nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ adamɔ shi ni eekwɛ eshīa lɛ hiɛ."
Yerusalem maŋ lɛ da, ni emli lɛɛ hu, shi mɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ faaa, ni tsui lɛ hu amamɔko.

Kɛkɛ ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã eba mijwɛŋmɔ mli akɛ mibua abladei lɛ kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ naa koni aŋmã amɛgbɛi yɛ amɛwekukpãa naa. Miyana mɛi ni ba klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ awekukpãa wolo lɛ. Mina ni aŋma yɛ mli akɛ.

Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezer baŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni jɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli ba lɛ. Amɛji mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem kɛ Yuda, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee emaŋ lɛ.

Mɛi ni nyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛba ji Zerubabel, Yeshua, Nehemia, Azaria. Raamia, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Misperet, Bigewai, Nehum kɛ Baana. Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ, amɛyibɔ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛiawei lɛ anaa nɛ:
Paroshbii lɛ: Akpei enyɔ kɛ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ.
Shefatiabii lɛ: Ohai etɛ̃ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ.
Arabii lɛ: Ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Pahat-Moabbii ni ji Yeshua kɛ Yoab shwiei lɛ: Akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Elambii lɛ: Akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Zatubii lɛ: Ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
Zakaibii lɛ: Ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Benuibii lɛ: Ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Bebaibii lɛ: Ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Azgadbii lɛ: Akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Adonikambii lɛ: Ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpawo.
Begewaibii lɛ: Akpei enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpawo.
Adinbii lɛ: Ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Aterbii ni jɛ Hezekia nɔ lɛ mli lɛ: Nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Hashumbii lɛ: Ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Bezaibii lɛ: Ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Harifbii lɛ: Oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Gibeonbii lɛ: Nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enumɔ.
Betlehembii kɛ Netofabii lɛ: Oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Anatotbii lɛ: Oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Bet-Azmavetbii lɛ: Nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Kiriat-Yearimbii kɛ Kefirabii kɛ Beerotbii lɛ: Ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃.
Ramabii kɛ Gebabii lɛ: Ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome.
Mikmasbii lɛ: Oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Betelbii kɛ Aibii lɛ: Oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Nebo kroko lɛ mli bii lɛ: Nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Elam kroko lɛ mli bii lɛ: Akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Harimbii lɛ: Ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Yerikobii lɛ: Ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
Lodbii kɛ Hadidbii kɛ Onobii lɛ: Ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome.
Senaabii lɛ: Akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Osɔfoi lɛ ni ji Yedaiabii ni jɛ Yeshua we lɛ: Ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃.
Imerbii lɛ: Akpe kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Pashurbii lɛ: Akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpawo.
Harimbii lɛ: Akpe kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo.
Levibii lɛ ni ji Yeshuabii kɛ Kadmielbii ni jɛ Hodaviabii ateŋ lɛ: Nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ.
Lalatsɛmɛi ni ji Asafbii lɛ: Oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ abii ni ji Shalumbii kɛ Aterbii kɛ Talmonbii kɛ Akubbii kɛ Hatitabii kɛ Shobaibii lɛ. Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ: Zihabii kɛ Hasufabii kɛ Tabaotbii lɛ.
Kerosbii kɛ Siabii kɛ Padonbii lɛ.
Lebanabii kɛ Hagababii kɛ Shalmaibii,
Hananbii kɛ Gidelbii kɛ Gaharbii lɛ,
Reaiabii kɛ Rezinbii kɛ Nekodabii lɛ,
Gazambii kɛ Uzabii kɛ Paseabii lɛ,

Bakbukbii kɛ Hakufabii kɛ Harhurbii lɛ,
Bazlitbii kɛ Mehidabii kɛ Harshabii lɛ,
Barkosbii kɛ Siserabii kɛ Temabii lɛ.
