Solomon tsuji lɛ abii lɛ: Sotaibii kɛ Soferetbii kɛ Peridabii lɛ,
Yaalabii kɛ Darkonbii kɛ Gidelbii lɛ,
Shefatiabii kɛ Hatilbii kɛ Pokeret-Hazebaimbii kɛ Amonbii lɛ.
Sɔlemɔwe lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Solomon tsuji ashwiei lɛ fɛɛ feɔ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ enyɔ.
Naa mɛi ni fã kɛjɛ Tel-Mela kɛ Tel-Harsha kɛ Kerub kɛ Adan kɛ Imer kɛba, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei loo amɛseshi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Israelbii ji amɛ.
Amɛji Delaiabii kɛ Tobiabii kɛ Nekodabii lɛ. Amɛfeɔ mɛi ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.

Osɔfoi aweku mli bii ni anaaa amɛgbɛii yɛ wolo ko mli ji Hoabaiabii kɛ Hakozbii kɛ Barzilaibii. (Barzilaibii nɛɛ ablematsɛ lɛ baŋɔ Barzilai ni jɛ Gilead lɛ biyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni eŋɔ eshaanuu lɛ gbɛi).
Akɛni anaaa amɛweku gbɛii wolo ko lɛ hewɔ lɛ aŋɔɔɔ amɛ akɛ osɔfoi ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
Amralo lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkaye nii krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ eko, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni osɔfoi lɛ aaaba ni aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ Urim kɛ Tumim nɔ akɛle nɔ gbɔmɛi ni ji amɛ.
Asafo ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ naa shɛɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Sro amɛtsuji hii kɛ amɛweyei ni naa shɛɔ akpei kpawo kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo, kɛ hii lalatsɛmɛi kɛ yei lalatsɛmɛi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
Amɛkpɔŋɔi ayibɔ ji ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa; amɛtejiokpɔŋɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
Amɛyomai ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ; amɛtejii akpei ekpaa ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi bake nii yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ saamɔ hewɔ. Amralo lɛ hã shika ŋmiiŋmi kiloi kpaanyɔ, lalakãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, osɔfoi atadei ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Tsɛmɛi awei lɛ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi bake shika ŋmiiŋmi kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ, kɛ jwiɛtɛi kiloi akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Akɛ fɛɛ wo fotro ni akɛtsuɔ nii lɛ mli.
Nɔ ni maŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ hã ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ osɔfoi atadei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpawo.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ lalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ bahi amɛmaji lɛ amli.
8: Be ni shɛɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli. Maŋ lɛ bluublu bakpe yɛ blohu ko ni yɔɔ Nu Agbo lɛ hiɛ lɛ mli. Amɛkɛɛ Ezra, osɔfo kɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ, akɛ eyakɔ wolo ni Mose Mla ni Yehowa wo Israel wo Israel lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛba.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Ezra kɛ Mla lɛ ba asafo lɛ hiɛ. Hii kɛ yei kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛji amɛnu wiemɔi lɛ ni amɛaanu shishi lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ekane yɛ blohu ni yɔɔ Nu Agbo lɛ hiɛ lɛ mli, kɛjɛ leebi kɛyashi shwane fiŋtiŋŋ yɛ hii kɛ yei kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni aaanyɛ shishi anu lɛ hiɛ. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miibo Mla Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ toi.

Ezra, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, damɔ nɔ ko ni kwɔ ni akɛ tso fee nɔ. Afee yɛ Mla lɛ kanemɔ lɛ hewɔ. Matitia kɛ Shema kɛ Anaia kɛ Uria kɛ Hilkia kɛ Maaseia damɔ emasɛi yɛ eninejurɔ, ni Pedaia kɛ Mishael kɛ Malkiya kɛ Hashum kɛ Hash-Badana kɛ Zakaria kɛ Meshulam damɔ ebɛku.
Ezra gble wolo lɛ mli yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ. He ni edamɔ lɛ kwɔ fe he ni maŋ lɛ damɔ lɛ. Be ni egble wolo lɛ mli lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi damɔ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Ezra jie Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ, yi. Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Amen! Amen!" Amɛhole amɛniji anɔ. No sɛɛ lɛ amɛmamɔ amɛyi shi, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛja Yehowa.

Yeshua kɛ Bani kɛ Sherebia kɛ Yamin ke Akub kɛ Shabetai kɛ Hodia kɛ Maaseia kɛ Kelita kɛ Azaria kɛ Yozabad kɛ Hanan kɛ Pelaia kɛ Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ Mla lɛ shishi. Be ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ shishi lɛ, belɛ maŋ lɛ damɔ amɛdaamɔhe lɛ.
Mɛi ni kaneɔ wolo lɛ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, kane lɛ faŋŋ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ shishi koni anu nɔ ni akaneɔ lɛ shishi faŋŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni Nehemia ni ji amralo lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Ezra ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ Levibii ni tsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii lɛ kɛɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hã Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkayea ŋkɔmɔ, ni nyɛkafoa hu!" Amɛkɛɛ maŋ lɛ nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ be ni maŋ lɛ nu Mla lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo.

Ezra kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛnyɛyea nii ni hi naakpa, ni nyɛnua wain ni ŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ. Ni nyɛkɛ eko amajea mɛi ni afeko nɔ ko atoko amɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hã wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ. No hewɔ hu lɛ nyɛwerɛ akahoa nyɛhe, ejaakɛ Yehowa he nyamɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni baawo nyɛ hewalɛ."
Levibii lɛ shɛje maŋ lɛ fɛɛ mii amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɛfɔa ŋkɔmɔyeli, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni, hewɔ lɛ nyɛwerɛ akahoa nyɛhe."
No hewɔ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyaye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko. Amɛkɛ eko maje, ni amɛna miishɛɛ babaoo; ejaakɛ wiemɔi ni akane atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛnu shishi faŋŋ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ tsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai ni yɔɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ Ezra, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ koni amɛbabo Mla Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ toi.
Amɛna akɛ aŋma yɛ Mla ni Yehowa tsɔ Mose nine nɔ ewo lɛ mli, akɛ Israelbii lɛ ahi asesei amli yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, be ni ayeɔ Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ.

Amɛna akɛ aŋma hu akɛ amɛjaje, ni amɛshiɛ yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ amli kɛ Yerusalem hu akɛ, "Nyɛjea kpo nyɛyaa gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyaŋɔa mutsei aniji kɛ ŋkutsei aniji kɛ merto tsei aniji kɛ blɛoi kɛ tsei kusukusui aniji koni nyɛkɛbafee asesei, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ."

Kɛkɛ ni amɛ lɛ je kpo amɛtee, ni amɛyaŋɔ tsei aniji lɛ kɛba, ni amɛkɛbafee asesei amɛhã amɛhe, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ etsu yiteŋ. Amɛfee asesei yɛ amɛkpoi anɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ Nu Agbo lɛ naa blohu lɛ mli kɛ Efraim Agbo lɛ naa blohu lɛ mli.
Mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ fee asesei, ni amɛshi mli. Israelbii lɛ efeko nakai nɔ ko dã kɛjɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, yinɔ aahuu kɛbashi nakai gbi lɛ nɔ. Amɛmii shɛ amɛhe naakpa.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ kɛyashi naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, akaneɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla Wolo lɛ. Amɛye gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo, ni gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkpe naagbee kpee, tamɔ bɔ ni ato lɛ.
9: Nakai nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ bakpe. Amɛhi ŋmãa; amɛbumɔ kpekpe, ni amɛkɛ mlu wo amɛyiteŋ.
Mɛi ni ji Israel fɔmɔbii lɛ tsɛ amɛhe yɛ mɛikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ ahe; amɛho amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛjaje amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi anifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ.
Amɛte shi amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛkɛ ŋmlɛtswai etɛ̃ kane Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Mla Wolo lɛ. Amɛkɛ ŋmlɛtswai etɛ̃ hu jaje amɛhe eshai, ni amɛja Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Yeshua kɛ Bani kɛ Kadmiel kɛ Shebania kɛ Buni kɛ Sherebia kɛ Bani kɛ Kenani ho damɔ Levibii lɛ akpoku lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsɔle waa amɛtsɛ Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Yeshua kɛ Kadmiel kɛ Bani kɛ Hashabneia kɛ Sherebia kɛ Hodia kɛ Shebania kɛ Patahia ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ Levibii ji amɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛjiea Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi; nyɛjiea eyi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ! Aaajie egbɛi ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ yi, tsɛbelɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ajieɔ egbɛi yi ni akafoɔ lɛ ahãa tete lɛ, eshɛɛɛ egbɛi lɛ dalɛ."

"Bo okome too ji Yehowa, bo obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛiiamli ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛinii huhai abɔ lɛ fɛɛ. Bo obɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ, ŋshɔi kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ amɛmli; ni bo nɔŋŋ ohãa amɛ fɛɛ kwa naa wala ni ŋwɛinii babaoo lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ amɛjaa.
Bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ oŋɔ Abram. Ojie lɛ kɛjɛ Ur yɛ Babilon, ni otsake egbɛi ofee lɛ Abraham.
Ona akɛ eyeɔ bo anɔkwa, ni okɛ lɛ kpãŋ akɛ okɛ Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii kɛ Yebusbii kɛ Girgashbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ baahã eshwiei lɛ; ni oye oshiwoo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ jalɔ ji o.
"Ona amanehulu ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ na yɛ Egipt lɛ, ni obo amɛtsɛmɔ ni amɛtsɛ o lɛ toi yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.

Ofee okadii, ni otsu naakpɛɛnii yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ejaakɛ ole akɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ wo amɛhe amɛwo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ; okɛ enɛ he gbɛi ohã ohe, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
Ohã ŋshɔ lɛ mli gba yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ. Shi mɛi ni tiuɔ amɛ lɛ oshɛrɛ amɛ oshwie ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli ni amɛshiu tamɔ tɛ yɛ nu hamahama lɛ mli.
Okɛ atatu ni ma shi kutuu tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ koni amɛna nii yɛ gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Okpleke shi kɛba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ojɛ ŋwɛi okɛ amɛ wie; ohã amɛ mlai kpakpai kɛ akpɔi kɛ kitãi kpakpai.
Ohejɔɔmɔgbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ohã amɛle, ni otsɔ̃ otsulɔ Mose nine nɔ owo amɛ kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai.
"Be ni hɔmɔ ye amɛ lɛ, ohã amɛ aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi, ni be ni kumai ye amɛ hu, ohã nu je tɛsaa mli ba, ni amɛkɛgbe amɛkumai. Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛba ni amɛbaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ okã he kitã akɛ okɛbaahã amɛ lɛ.
Shi amɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wo amɛhe; amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛyeee okitãi lɛ anɔ.

Amɛbooo bo toi, ni asaŋ amɛkaiii onaakpɛɛnii ni ofee yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ; shi moŋ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi. Amɛtse atua, ni amɛto asafoiatsɛ ni ekɛ amɛ aku sɛɛ kɛya nyɔŋyeli mli ekoŋŋ yɛ Egipt. Shi bo lɛ oji Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ eshai faa, drolɔ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɔ ni toɔ etsui shi ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa, hewɔ lɛ oshiii amɛ.
Amɛfee tsinabi ni ashwie amɛhã amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ no ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ ni jie amɛ kɛje Egipt; amɛbɔ musu babaoo amɛshi o.

Omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, oshiii amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; shwane lɛ atatu ni ma shi yɛ amɛhiɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ lɛ, ejeee amɛhiɛ; ni nyɔɔŋ hu la ni damɔ amɛhiɛ ni hãa amɛnaa nii yɛ gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejeee amɛhiɛ.
Okɛ omumɔ kpakpa lɛ hã amɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii; ohã amɛ mana amɛye, ni ohã amɛ nu amɛkɛgbe amɛkumai.
Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ okwɛ amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaaa amɛ; amɛtadei suuu lɛ, amɛnaji hu efuuu.
"Ohã amɛye maji kɛ maŋtsɛyelii anɔ kunim. Amɛye shikpɔji ni bɛŋkɛ amɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛyashi amɛŋɔ Heshbon ni ji Maŋtsɛ Sihon shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Bashan ni ji Maŋtsɛ Og shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ohã amɛbii lɛ hu ayi fa tamɔ ŋulamii, ni oŋɔ amɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okɛɛ amɛtsɛmɛi akɛ amɛya amɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni bii lɛ ba koni amɛbaye Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛfee amɛ bɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ.

Amɛyaye maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe kɛ shikpɔji ni baa nii anɔ kunim, ni amɛna shīai ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nibii kpakpai fɛɛ: nubui ni atsatsai, waintromii kɛ mutso tromii kɛ yelitsei babaoo amɛye, ni amɛtrɔ, ni amɛshwishwii; ni amɛmii shɛ amɛhe yɛ omlihilɛ kple lɛ hewɔ.
"Shi enɛ moŋ sɛɛ lɛ amɛtoi gbo, ni amɛtsɛ ohiɛ atua; amɛkɛ mla lɛ efeee nɔ ko nɔ ko; amɛgbe gbalɔi lɛ ni bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ lɛ, koni amɛkɛkpale amɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ; ni amɛfee musubɔɔ nibii wuji amɛshi o.

No hewɔ lɛ oŋmɛɛ amɛhe ohã amɛhenyɛlɔi, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ hao amɛ. Amɛhaomɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ amɛfo amɛtsɛ o, ni ohere amɛ nɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi. Omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, ojie hiɛnyiɛlɔi ohã amɛ koni amɛhere amɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.

Shi kɛ amɛna hejɔlɛ pɛ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ efɔŋ amɛshiɔ bo, ni oŋmɛɔ amɛhe owoɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ; ni henyɛlɔi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ. Shi kɛ̃lɛ kɛ amɛtao osɛɛgbɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛfo amɛtsɛ o lɛ, oboɔ amɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, ohereɔ amɛ shii abɔ yɛ amɛnɔnaa lɛ mli.

Obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ koni amɛbɔ̃i omla lɛ nɔyeli ekoŋŋ; shi amɛwo amɛhe, ni amɛbooo okitãi lɛ atoi; amɛfee esha amɛshi omlai lɛ ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi naa wala lɛ. Amɛtsi amɛhe kɛje ohe; amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛbooo bo toi.
Kɛ̃lɛ oto otsui shi ohã amɛ afii pii; okɛ omumɔ lɛ wo gbalɔi lɛ amli, ni otsɔ̃ amɛnɔ obɔ obii lɛ kɔkɔ; shi amɛbooo toi; No hewɔ lɛ ohã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ye amɛnɔ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, oŋmɛɛɛ amɛhe, ni asaŋ okpãtãaa amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ni enaa mɔbɔ ji o.

"Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, oje agbo! Ohe wa, ohe yɛ gbeyei, ni onaa mɔbɔ; kɛji okɛ mɔ ko kpãŋ ni owo shi lɛ, oyeɔ nɔ. Kɛjɛ Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ayinɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, kaahã amanehulu ni ba wɔ kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ wɔnukpai kɛ wɔsɔfoi kɛ wɔgbalɔi kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mifee sane bibioo yɛ ohiɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, saji ni eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, onɔ ja, ejaakɛ bo lɛ oye anɔkwa, shi wɔ lɛ wɔfee efɔŋ.
Wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu kɛ wɔnukpai lɛ kɛ wɔsɔfoi lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ yeko omla lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ amɛboko okitãi kɛ kɔkɔ ni obɔ amɛ lɛ toi.
Be mli tete ni ohã amɛmaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ma shi ni amɛyeɔ shikpɔŋ kplɛlɛɛ ni ewo fɔ nɔ nii lɛ, amɛsɔ̃mɔɔɔ bo, ni amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ feemɔ.
Naa, ŋmɛnɛ wɔtsɔmɔ nyɔji. Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okɛhã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ amɛye enɔ yibii kɛ enɔ nii kpakpai lɛ, naa, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ nyɔji yɛ nɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii babaoo lɛ yaa maŋtsɛmɛi ni akɛto wɔnɔ yɛ wɔhe eshai ahewɔ lɛ moŋ aŋɔɔ. Amɛyeɔ wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi anɔ bɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ: ni wɔyɛ haomɔ kpeteŋkple mli."
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ Israelbii, wɔmiikpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni mli wa, ni wɔmiiŋma; ni wɔnukpai lɛ kɛ wɔ-Levibii lɛ kɛ wɔsɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛgbɛii miiwo shishi amɛkɛmiisɔo naa.

Wɔ, Israelbii, osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ hu ni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ toiboo naa lɛ amɛtse amɛhe yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahe lɛ, wɔ kɛ wɔŋamɛi kɛ wɔbii hii kɛ yei ni hiɛ efã,

wɔ kɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi ni ji wɔhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ efee ekome kɛmiikã kitã. Kɛ wɔku mli lɛ, efee loomɔ ehã wɔ. Wɔmiikã kitã akɛ wɔbaaye Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ ni atsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose nine nɔ awo lɛ nɔ. Wɔbaajwɛŋ nɔ ni wɔye Yehowa, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, kitãi kɛ emlai kɛ ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Wɔkɛ wɔbiiyei haŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gblã, ni asaŋ wɔŋɔŋ amɛbiyei wɔhaŋ wɔbihii.

Kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ guɔnii loo able ba hɔ̃ɔmɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ loo gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko nɔ lɛ wɔheŋ. Asaŋ daa afi nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔhuŋ wɔŋmɔji lɛ, ni nyɔmɔ fɛɛ nyɔmɔ ni ahiɛ wɔ lɛ wɔkɛbaake.
Asaŋ wɔmiikã kitã akɛ daa afi lɛ, wɔɔhã jwiɛtɛi talenta kome mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni asɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi hu hewɔ.

Nibii nɛɛ ji aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ daa gbi lɛ, kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ anɔ nii lɛ kɛ nyɔji heei anɔ afɔlei lɛ kɛ gbii juji ni ato lɛ anɔ nii lɛ kɛ nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ esha afɔlei lɛ ni akɛkpãtã ahãa Israel lɛ. Wɔbaahã kɛhã wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.

Wɔ ni ji osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ maŋbii lɛ, wɔfɔ̃fɔ̃ɔ oshiki yɛ laihamɔ hewɔ, koni ato naa akɛba wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, yɛ bei ni ato lɛ amli daa afi, koni ashã yɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ mla lɛ mli lɛ.
Asaŋ wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nibaanii kɛ tso fɛɛ tso nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii aaaba Yehowa we lɛ daa afi.
Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ, wɔ kɛ wɔkromɔbihii kɛ wɔkooloi akromɔbii hu kɛ wɔtsinai akromɔ bii kɛ wɔtoi akromɔbii aaaba wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ wɔkɛbahã osɔfoi lɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ.

Wɔkɛ mã ni ana yɛ able ni akpa klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ mli kɛ tso fɛɛ tso klɛŋklɛŋ yibii, kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wain kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ mu aaaba abahã osɔfoi lɛ koni akɛwo wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ nitoohe lɛ mli. Wɔkɛ wɔŋmɔshi nibaanii amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome kome baahã Levibii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛji mɛi ni baŋɔɔ nibaanii amɛlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome kome lɛ yɛ akrowai ni wɔhuɔ yɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ.

Kɛ Levibii lɛ miihe nibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ ni ji Aaron bii lɛ afata amɛhe. Levibii lɛ kɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ hu mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome aba wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ ni akɛwo nitoohe lɛ mli.

Ejaakɛ esa akɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ able kɛ wain hee kɛ mu lɛ aya ayawo nitoohe lɛ mli he ni he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nibii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ lalatsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Wɔŋmɛŋ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ he wɔfɔŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
11: Maŋbii lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ hi Yerusalem, ni maŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ fɔ̃fɔ̃ɔ oshikii koni akɛtao mɔ kome yɛ mɛi nyɔŋma fɛɛ mɛi nyɔŋma mli koni ebahi Yerusalem, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, koni mɛi nɛɛhu ni eshwɛ lɛ ayahi maji krokomɛi lɛ amli.
Maŋbii lɛ jie hii fɛɛ ni here amɛhe akɛ amɛaahi Yerusalem lɛ yi.
Yuda maji lɛ amli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ: Israelbii, kɛ osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛ Sɔlemɔwe sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Solomon tsuji abii lɛ.

Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ onukpai komɛi hi Yerusalem. Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ Yudabii ji amɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu Benyaminbii ni. Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Ataia ni ji Uzia bi, Zakaria bi lɛ. Eseshi mli mɛi krokomɛi ji Amaria kɛ Shefatia kɛ Mahalalel ni jɛ Perez weku lɛ mli lɛ.
Yudabii krokomɛi ji Maaseia, Baruk bi lɛ ni eji Kol-Hoze nabi lɛ. Eseshi mli bii krokomɛi ji Hazaia kɛ Adaia kɛ Yoiarib kɛ Zakaria, Yuda bi Shela shwie lɛ.
Perezbii fɛɛ ni hi Yerusalem lɛ ayibɔ feɔ mɛi ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ; hi kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ji amɛ fɛɛ.
Benyaminbii lɛ ekomɛi ji Salu Meshulam bi lɛ ni eji Yoed nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi krokomɛi hu ji Pedaia kɛ Kolaia kɛ Maaseia kɛ Itiel kɛ Yeshaia.
Salu seshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi hu ji Gabai kɛ Salai. Benyaminbii ni hi Yerusalem lɛ fɛɛ naa shiɔ mɛi ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Yoel, Zikri bi lɛ, ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ; ni Yuda, Hasenua bi lɛ, ji esɛɛmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Yedaia, Yoiarib bi, kɛ Yakin.
Kɛ Seraia, Hilkia bi ni ji Meshulam nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi ji Ahitub, mɔ ni ye Osɔfonukpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.

Amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ayibɔ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ sɔmɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ. Mɔ kroko hu ji Adaia, Yeroham bi lɛ ni ji Pelaia nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi ji Amzi kɛ Zakaria kɛ Pashur kɛ Malkiya.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ateiaŋ mɛi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ fee wei amli onukpai. Ekomɛi ji Amashsai Azarel bi ni eji Ahazia nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ emli mɛkomɛi ji Meshilemot kɛ Imer.
Enyɛmimɛi lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni amɛyibɔ ji oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ. Mɔ ni kwɛɔ amɛnɔ ji Zabdiel, Gedolim bi lɛ.
Levibii lɛ ji Shemaia, Hashub ni ji, Azrikam nabi lɛ. Eseshi lɛ mli mɛi komɛi ji Hashabia Buni.
Shabetai kɛ Yozabad ji Levi onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni kwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ kponɔgbɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ.

Mɛi komɛi hu ji Matania, Mika bi ni ji Zabdi nabi mɔ ni eji Asaf shwie lɛ. Lɛ enyiɛ lalɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛlaa kɛdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ. Mɔ ko hu ji Bakbukia ni ji Matania sɛɛmɔ kɛ Abda, Shamua bi lɛ ni ji Galai ni ji Yedutun nabi lɛ.
Levibii fɛɛ ni hi Yerusalem, Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ ayibɔ ji ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Agbonaabulɔi lɛ ji Akub kɛ Talmon kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ. Amɛyibɔ ji mɛi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ.
Israelbii ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hi Yuda maji lɛ fɛɛ amli, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Shi mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ hi Ofel. Amɛnukpai ji Ziha kɛ Gishpa.
Mɔ ni kwɛ Levibii ni hi Yerusalem lɛ nɔ ji Uzi, Bani bi Hashabia bi Matania bi Mika bi lɛ. Ejɛ Asaf bii alalatsɛmɛi ni kwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo kitã yɛ lalatsɛmɛi lɛ ahewɔ, ni ato amɛgbɛnaa afɔ̃ shi kɛhã gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ nitsumɔ.

Yɛ akrowai kɛ humɔhei amlihilɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hi Kiriat-Arba kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli, kɛ Dibon kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli, kɛ Yekabzeel kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli.

kɛ Zanoa kɛ Adulam kɛ amɛhe akrowai lɛ amli. Amɛhi Lakish kɛ ehumɔhei lɛ kɛ Azeka kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli.

Salu kɛ Amok kɛ Hilkia kɛ Yedaia. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji osɔfoi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ onukpai yɛ Yoshua be lɛ mli.

Ezratsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Meshulam, Amariatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Yehohanan.
Melukitsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Yonatan; Shebaniatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Yosef.
Harimtsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Adna; Meraiottsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Helkai.
Idotsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Zakaria; Ginetontsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Meshulam.
Abiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Zikri; Miniamin ni ji Moadiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Piltai.
Bilgatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Shamuatsɛ we; Shemaia lɛ yitso ji Yehonatan.
Yoairibtsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Matenai; Yedaiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Uzi.
Salaitsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Kalai; Amoktsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Eber.
Hilkiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Hashabia; Yedaiatsɛ we lɛ yitso ji Netanel.
Osɔfonukpai ni ji Eliashib kɛ Yoiada kɛ Yohanan kɛ Yadua yinɔ lɛ, aŋmã Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ ayitsei lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ agbɛii. Agbe gbɛiŋmaa nɛɛ naa yɛ Dario, Persianyo lɛ maŋtsɛyeli be lɛ mli.
Shi Levibii ni ji tsɛmɛi awei lɛ ayitsei lɛ, aŋmã amɛgbɛii yɛ wolo ni Yinɔi Anɔ Saji yɔɔ mli lɛ mli. Aŋmã Levibii awei lɛ ayitsei lɛ agbɛii nɛɛ kɛyashi Yohanan, Eliashib nabi lɛ, yinɔ.

Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ ayitsei ni ji Hashibia kɛ Sherebia kɛ Yeshua, Kadmiel bi lɛ, to gbɛjianɔ. Afee kui enyɔ; ku kome miijie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛmiida lɛ shi; belɛ ku ni ji enyɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhiɛ lɛ miihere nɔ. Amɛjie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛda lɛ shi tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ David ewo kitã lɛ.
Matania kɛ Bakbukia kɛ Obadia kɛ Meshulam kɛ Talmon kɛ Akub ji agbonaakwɛlɔi. Amɛ amɛbuɔ agboi lɛ anaa nitoohei lɛ ahe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi hi shi yɛ Yoakim, Yozadak bi Yeshua bi lɛ, kɛ Amralo Nehemia kɛ Osɔfo Ezra ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ yinɔ.

Be ni abaajɔɔ Yerusalem gbogbo lɛ nɔ afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ayatao Levibii yɛ hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ amɛ ba Yerusalem koni amɛbaye hetsuumɔ gbijurɔ lɛ kɛ nyamɔ kɛ shidaa lalai kɛ ŋoŋoi kɛ kpãa saŋkui.
Levibii Lalɔi awekui lɛ babua amɛhe naa. Mɛi ni jɛ Yerusalem niiaŋ kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Netofat akrowai lɛ akpokpai anɔ fɛɛ ba.
Mɛi komɛi hu jɛ Bet-Gilgal kɛ Geba koi asɛɛ kɛ Azmawet, ejaakɛ lalɔi nɛɛ etotoo akrowai kɛbɔle Yerusalem.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tsuu amɛhe. Asaŋ amɛtsuu maŋ lɛ kɛ agboi lɛ kɛ gbogbo lɛ hu ahe.

Kɛkɛ ni mihã Yuda onukpai lɛ kwɔ kɛba gbogbo lɛ nɔ. Mifee lalɔi akui klekplei enyɔ koni amɛto kɛnyiɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛ shidaa lalai. Ku kome tsɔ̃ ninejurɔ gbɛ yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya Tumu Agbo lɛ naa gbɛ.
Hoshaia kɛ Yuda onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi fã nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Mɛi ni fata he ji Azaria kɛ Ezra kɛ Meshulam kɛ
Yuda kɛ Benyamin kɛ Shemaia kɛ Yeremia.
Be ni ayaa lɛ belɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi miikpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi. Amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji Zakaria, Yonatan bi lɛ. Enii kɛ ekaŋsowai ji Shemaia kɛ Matania kɛ Mikaia kɛ Zakur kɛ Asaf.

Ewekumɛi ji Shemaia kɛ Azarel Malalai kɛ Gilalai kɛ Maai kɛ Netanel kɛ Yuda kɛ Hanani. Amɛ hu amɛnyiɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ David nibii ni akɛtswaa lalai aloo akɛkpãa lalai lɛ. Ezra, woloŋmãlɔ kpanaa lɛ nyiɛ ku nɛɛ hiɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃ Nubu Agbo lɛ he; ni amɛtee amɛhiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛyakwɔ atrakpoi ni akwɔɔ kɛyaa David maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Amɛkwɔ yɛ kwɔɔhe lɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ David we lɛ he kɛtee Nu Agbo lɛ he yɛ bokãgbɛ.
Lalɔi ni daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ aku ni ji enyɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ abeku gbɛ. Mi kɛ maŋ lɛ fã nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ Flɔɔnɔi Amɔ̃ɔ lɛ yiteŋ aahuu kɛyashi Gbogbo Lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ he.
Wɔtse mli kɛtsɔ̃ Efraim Agbo lɛ kɛ Agbo Momo lɛ kɛ Loi Agbo lɛ he. Wɔyawa wɔdamɔ shi yɛ Bulɔi Agbo lɛ naa.
No hewɔ lɛ lalɔi akui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ni daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ kɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi fã ni fata mihe lɛ yashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.
Osɔfoi ni fata he ji Eliakim kɛ Maaseia kɛ Miniamin kɛ Mikaia kɛ Elioenai kɛ Zakaria kɛ Hanania ni amɛhiɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi.
Mɛi ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ ji Maaseia kɛ Shemaia kɛ Eleazar kɛ Uzi kɛ Yohanan kɛ Malia kɛ Elam kɛ Ezer. Yezrahia kɛ elalɔi aku lɛ la waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ amɛshã shãa afɔlei babaoo, ni amɛnyã, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe waa naakpa. Yei kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ hu nyãnyãa waa bɔ ni anu nyamɔ ni anyãa yɛ Yerusalem lɛ he yɛ shɔ̃ŋŋ tete.

Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, afamɔ hii komɛi ato nitoohei lɛ anɔ: Nitoohei nɛɛ ji hei ni akɛ nɔwomɔ afɔlei kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii afɔlei lɛ kɛ nibii amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ toɔ. Afamɔ hii nɛɛ koni amɛbua ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ maji lɛ ahe lɛ amli nii lɛ amlijai nyɔŋma ni mla lɛ to lɛ naa amɛwo nitoohei lɛ amli amɛhã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ. Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii na osɔfoi kɛ Levibii ni damɔɔ shi sɔmɔɔ lɛ ahe miishɛɛ;

ejaakɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ ye hetsuumɔ mlai lɛ kɛ gbɛnai krokomɛi ni amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ to lɛ anɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ lalɔi lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ tsu amɛgbɛnaa nii tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ ebi Solomon wo kitã ni afee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Lalatsɛ Asaf yinɔ beebe ato lalɔi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ; ni amɛla yijiemɔ kɛ shidaa lalai amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ.

Zerubabel yinɔ kɛ Nehemia yinɔ lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ hãa nikenii daa gbi, ni akɛkwɛɔ lalɔi lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ. Maŋ lɛ jieɔ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ amɛfɔ̃ɔ shi; ni Levibii lɛ hu jieɔ nɔ ni ji Aaronbii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ amɛfɔ̃ɔ shi amɛhãa amɛ.
13: Nakai gbi lɛ be ni akaneɔ Mose Mla lɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ lɛ, ana ni aŋmã yɛ mli akɛ Amonnyo loo Moabnyo akaba Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii lɛ ahenaabuamɔ lɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ;
ejaakɛ amɛkɛ aboloo kɛ nu ebakpeee Israelbii lɛ, shi moŋ amɛyabɔ Bileam apaa akɛ ebalomɔ amɛ; shi wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã loomɔ lɛ moŋ tsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ nu mla lɛ, amɛjie mɛi fɛɛ ni ji futufutu gbɔmɛi lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Shi dani abaafee enɛ lɛ, osɔfoi Eliashib ni akɛ lɛ eto nitoohei ni yɔɔ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛ Tobia efee ekome kɛto gbɛjianɔ.

Eliashib saa tsu kpeteŋkple ko ehã Tobia ni ehi mli. Tsu nɛɛ, sa lɛ akɛ nibii komɛi toɔ mli. Nibii nɛɛ ji niyenii afɔlei kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ sɔlemɔ we tsɛnsii kɛ ŋmɔshinii ni ji able kɛ wain kɛ mu mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ, ni awo he kitã akɛ akɛhã Levibii lɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ we lalɔi lɛ kɛ agbonaakwɛlɔi lɛ. Nɔ ni fata nibii ni akɛtoɔ tsu nɛɛ mli lɛ he ji afɔlei ni akɛhãa osɔfoi lɛ.
Shi nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ mibɛ Yerusalem, ejaakɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ Artashasta yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mitee eŋɔɔ. Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, mibi maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛ,
ni miku misɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem. Mibana sane gbonyo ni Eliashib eye akɛ esaa tsu ehã Tobia yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ.
Mimli wo la naakpa, ni mijie Tobia nibii fɛɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli mishwie.
Kɛkɛ ni mifã akɛ asha nitoohei lɛ amli koni akɛtsuu amɛmli: Ni mihã akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nibii lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ krɔbɔo lɛ ku sɛɛ akɛbato jɛi ekoŋŋ.
Minu hu akɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ sɔlemɔwe lalɔi lɛ ni amɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ejo foi etee eŋmɔ mli, ejaakɛ ahãaa amɛ amɛgbɛnaa niyenii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mihiɛ dɔ wo hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, ni mibi amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ajo foi ashi Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ?" Mibua Levibii lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli lalɔi lɛ anaa kɛba, ni mikɛ amɛ yato amɛgbɛhe.
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i able kɛ wain kɛ mu mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ nitoohei lɛ amli woo ekoŋŋ.

Mito nitoohe lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi: Amɛji Osɔfoi Shelemai kɛ Zadok, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Pedaia ni jɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ. Amɛsɛɛmɔ ji Hanan, Matania bi Zakur bi lɛ. Mito gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ abuɔ amɛ anɔkwafoi. Amɛnitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛja nii lɛ amɛhã amɛnyɛmimɛi nitsulɔi lɛ.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ mi yɔ enɛ hewɔ, ni ohiɛ akakpa nitsumɔi kpakpai ni mitsu yɛ owe lɛ kɛ emli sɔ̃ɔmɔ ahe lɛ anɔ.

Nakai be lɛ mli mina akɛ mɛi ŋaa wainyibii yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ yɛ Yuda. Mina akɛ akɛ able kɛ wain kɛ wainyibii kɛ agbami jatsui kɛ jatsui srɔtoi fɛɛ tereɔ tejii kɛbaa Yerusalem yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ. Migbɛ miwo amɛ yɛ gbi nɔ ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ hewɔ.
Tirobii komɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ kɛ loo kɛ guɔnii srɔtoi fɛɛ baa amɛbahɔ̃ɔ amɛhãa Yudabii lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ tete yɛ Yerusalem.
Mikã Yuda abladei lɛ ahiɛ, ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ sane fɔŋ nyɛyeɔ ni nyɛkɛbuleɔ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɛɛ?
Ani jeee nɛkɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee ni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã efɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ ba wɔ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ? Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkɛ bulemɔ ni nyɛbuleɔ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ miitsɛ mlifu kɛba Israel nɔ nyɛfata he."

No hewɔ lɛ dani aaaje hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛji hiɛ bɔ̃i tuutuu feemɔ yɛ Yerusalem agboi lɛ amli pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ mifãa ni aŋamɔ agboi lɛ, ni miwoɔ kitã akɛ akagble, ja hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ eho dã. Asaŋ mifamɔ mitsuji lɛ ekomɛi mito agboi lɛ anaa koni akɛ jatsu ko akaba maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ.
Jrayelɔi lɛ kɛ guɔyelɔi ni hɔ̃ɔ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ lɛ bato agboi lɛ asɛɛ shi kome loo shii enyɔ.
Mibɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛbatoɔ gbogbo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ? Kɛ nyɛfee nakai ekoŋŋ lɛ, mibamɔmɔ nyɛ." Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛbaaa hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.

Kɛkɛ ni mifã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛtsuu amɛhe koni amɛba amɛbabu agboi lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni afee hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ mi yɛ enɛ hu hewɔ koni okɛ mihe eshai afa mi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni fa lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ mina akɛ Yudafoi pii eŋɔ Ashdodyei kɛ Amonyei kɛ Moabyei.
Amɛbii lɛ wieɔ Ashdod wiemɔ lɛ loo wiemɔ kroko fã kɛ fã, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ Yudafoi awiemɔ lɛ amɛwie.

Mihiɛ dɔ wo amɛ, ni milomɔ amɛ. Miyi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi, ni mifamɔ amɛyiteŋ tsɔi. Mihã amɛkã Nyɔŋmɔ kitã akɛ amɛkɛ amɛbiyei lɛ haŋ maŋsɛɛbii abiyei amɛhaŋ amɛbihii lɛ. Asaŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu amɛkɛ maŋsɛɛbii ehiŋ shi.

Mikɛ amɛ wie ni mikɛɛ, "Ani jeee yei tamɔ Mɛnɛɛmɛi nɔŋŋ hã Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon fee esha, tsɛ maŋtsɛ ko maŋtsɛ ko bɛ je nɛɛŋ maji babaoo lɛ eko nɔ ni tamɔ lɛ? Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ maŋtsɛ ni eye Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Kɛ̃lɛ Solomon po maŋsɛɛ yei hã efee esha.
Aso wɔɔkɔ nyɛnane ni wɔfee nɛkɛ efɔŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ? Aso wɔɔŋɔ maŋsɛɛ yei ni wɔje wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ?"
Osɔfonukpa Eliashib bi ji Yoiada. Yoiada bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome yaŋɔ Sanbalat Horonnyo lɛ biyoo, ni ekɛ Sanbalat fee shaanuu. No hewɔ lɛ mishwie Yoiada bi lɛ yɛ mihe.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ wo osɔfoyeli he muji ni amɛfite kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ mitsɔ̃ mijie maŋ lɛ kɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni buleɔ mɔ mli. Mito osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ gbɛjianɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale enitsumɔ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ.
Ni mito gbɛjianɔ mihã be ni akɛ afɔleshãa lai kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yelitso yibii aba. Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, kaimɔ mi ni ahi ahã mi.

1: Israelbii lɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛkanea Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa. Aŋmla hii fɛɛ agbɛii,
kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa. Bo kɛ Aaron akane mɛi lɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa.
Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli nuu kome ni ji onukpa yɛ etsɛmɛi awe afata nyɛhe."
Hii, akutseiaŋ onukpai, ni ahala akɛfata Mose kɛ Aaron he koni amɛtsu nii lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Ruben akutso lɛ fã Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ;
ni Simeon akutso lɛ fã Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ;
ni Yuda akutso lɛ fã Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ.
Isakar akutso lɛ fã Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ,
ni Zebulon akutso lɛ fã Eliab, Helon bi lɛ;
ni Efraim akutso lɛ, ni ji Yosef shwiei lɛ, fã Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ; ni Manase akutso, ni ji Yosef nɔŋŋ shwiei hu, fã Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ.
Benyamin akutso lɛ fã Abidan, Gideoni bi lɛ;
ni Dan akutso lɛ fã Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ;
ni Asher akutso lɛ fã Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ;
Gad akutso lɛ fã Eliasaf, Deuel bi lɛ;
ni Naftali akutso lɛ fã Ahira, Enan bi lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji hiɛnaanɔbii, ni asaŋ amɛji amɛtsɛmɛi akutsei lɛ amli anukpai, ni ahala amɛ, ni afee amɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ.
Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔ hii ni atsi amɛgbɛii atã nɛɛ amɛfata amɛhe,

ni amɛbua Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛŋmla maŋbii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa. Hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ aŋmla amɛgbɛii ni akane amɛyibɔ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ, nakai efee, ni ekɛkane Israel asafo lɛ yikulɛ yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Akɛjɛ Ruben ni ji Israel kromɔbi lɛ bii lɛ ashwiei lɛ anɔ, ni aŋmla hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ni asaŋ amɛshɛ tayaa lɛ agbɛii ekomekome yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Rubenbii ayikulɛ ni ana ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Ni Simeon shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ ohai etɛ̃.
Ni Gad shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Yuda shwiei lɛ kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Ni Isakar shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mei akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Ni Zebulon shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Efraim shwiei lɛ, ni yɛ Yosef mli lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Ni Manase shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Ni Benyamin shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Dan shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.
Ni Asher shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Ni Naftali shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee,
mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Israel maŋ onukpai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa ni wa Mose kɛ Aaron kɛkane amɛyikulɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ni akane amɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei anaa akɛ mɛi ni eshɛ tayaa lɛ,
amɛyikulɛ fee mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi Levibii lɛ akaneee amɛ ashiii akutsei krokomɛi lɛ anɔ,
ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛji okane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ, okakane Levibii lɛ oshi nɔ.

Moŋ akɛ mi-Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni fata he lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ awo amɛdɛŋ. Amɛ amɛtre Buu lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛkura Buu lɛ. Ni kɛji ato shi yɛ he ko lɛ, amɛmãmɔ amɛwɔɔhei amɛkɛbɔle Buu lɛ he kpula kɛkpe.
Kɛji maŋ lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Levibii lɛ afã Buu lɛ, ni kɛji shɛ be ni abaashi Buu lɛ, Levibii lɛ nɔŋŋ ashi. Mɔ flo fɛɛ mɔ flo ni aaabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ agbe lɛ.
Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ ashi amɛbuui yɛ amɛsafo kuikui lɛ anaa. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ buu ahi esafo shitoohe mli, ni asaŋ yɛ etsɛmɛi awe flaŋaa shishi.
Shi Levibii lɛ ashishii amɛbuui lɛ kɛbɔle mi-Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; amɛbu he bɔ ni afee ni mɔ flo ko akabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ ni no yatsɛ mimlifu bahã Israelbii lɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee lɛ.
2: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,
"Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi ebuu yɛ esafo shitoohe, yɛ etsɛmɛi awe aflaŋaa lɛ shishi. Amamɔ buui fɛɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ kɛbɔle lɛ kpula kɛkpe.
"Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda aflaŋaa lɛ shishi baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ bokãgbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa; ni amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ.
Ta ni yɔɔ eshishi lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Mɛi ni ashitoohe baatsa Yudabii lɛ anɔ ji Isakarbii lɛ, ni amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ;
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Zebulon akutso lɛ etsa Isakarbii lɛ hu anɔ, kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Eliab, Helon bi lɛ.
Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Yuda aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai ejwɛ. Amɛ esa akɛ amɛnyiɛ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ lɛ.
"Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ruben aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ wuoyigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa. Rubenbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ,
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Mɛi ni ashitoohe baatsa Rubenbii lɛ anɔ ji Simeon akutso lɛ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ;
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ ohai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Gad akutso lɛ atsa Simeonbii lɛ hu anɔ. Gadbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa lɛ ji Eliasaf, Reuel bi lɛ,
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ Ruben aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ. Amɛ amɛji asafo ni ji enyɔ ni baafã kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ.

"Kɛkɛ lɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hu baafã kɛnyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ ateŋ. Bɔ ni ato naa abato shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaato naa kɛfã nyiɛmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anyiɛ egbɛhe yɛ eflaŋaa shishi.
"Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Efraim aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ anaigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa. Efraimbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ;
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Manasebii lɛ atsa Efraim akutso lɛ nɔ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ;
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ hu atsa Manase akutso lɛ nɔ. Benyaminbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Abidan, Gideoni bi lɛ,
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Efraim aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ oha. Amɛ, amɛji asafo ni ji etɛ̃ ni baafã kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ.
"Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Dan aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kooyigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa. Danbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ,
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.
Asherbii lɛ atsa Dan akutso lɛ nɔ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ;
ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Naftali akutso lɛ hu atsa Asherbii lɛ anɔ. Naftalibii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Ahira, Enan bi lɛ.
Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Dan aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ekpaa"
Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni akane yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa yɛ amɛshitoohei lɛ amli naa shiɔ mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi akaneee Levibii lɛ ashiii Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ. Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe lɛ, amɛtoɔ shi yɛ amɛflaŋai lɛ ashishi; ni kɛji amɛfã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ tsɛmɛiawei lɛ anaa.
3: Be mli ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bii ni Aaron kɛ Mose yɔɔ lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ:
Aaron bihii lɛ ji Nadab, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Aaron fɔ ebihii nɛɛ mu, ni ewo amɛ osɔfo koni amɛtsu osɔfoyeli nitsumɔ.
Shi Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi be ni amɛhiɛ la ko ni he tseee kɛtee Yehowa hiɛ be ni ayɔɔ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Amɛshiii bii. Eleazar kɛ Itamar pɛ sɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi yɛ amɛtsɛ Aaron walabeiaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
Ŋɔɔ Levi akutso lɛ kɛba ni owo amɛ yelikɛbualɔi, mɛi ni baawa Osɔfo Aaron yɛ esɔfoyeli nitsumɔ lɛ mli.
Amɛbaasɔ̃mɔ kɛtsu nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni kɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he, ni amɛbaatsu nii amɛhã Osɔfo Aaron kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Amɛbaakwɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli saamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛbaawa maŋbii foji lɛ kɛji amɛba koni amɛbaja yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ.
Ojɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. Oŋɔ amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni ojɔɔ amɛnɔ kwraa ohã koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii osɔfoi lɛ.
Ojɔɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ ohã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ pɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ efee ehe osɔfo lɛ agbe lɛ."
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Naa, miŋɔ Levibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ mikɛmiito kromɔbii ni gbleɔ musu naa yɛ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ anajiaŋ. No hewɔ lɛ Levibii lɛ etsɔ̃ minɔ.
Ejaakɛ gbi ni migbe Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii akromɔbii fɛɛ anɔ mihã mihe, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ kromɔbi nɔ kɛyashi shīa kooloo kromɔbi nɔ. Minii ji amɛ fɛɛ. Miji Yehowa."
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai shiaŋa lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Kanemɔ Levi we lɛ hii fɛɛ kɛjɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛwekui anaa."
Mose kane amɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃, ni amɛgbɛii ji Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.
Gershon bihii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui anaa ji Libni kɛ Shimei.
Kohat yɛ bihii ejwɛ; amɛgbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa ji Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel,
ni Merari bihii enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa ji Maheli kɛ Mushi. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii lɛ awekui lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Gershon shwiei lɛ ji Libnibii lɛ kɛ Shimeibii lɛ.
Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ, ana mɛi akpei kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Gershonbii awekui nɛɛ lɛ, akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛ ni ji anaigbɛ hã amɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbuui lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli wekunukpa lɛ ji Eliasaf, Lael bi lɛ.
Amɛ amɛdɛŋ atu nibii nɛɛ anɔkwɛmɔ kɛ kuramɔ awo: Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ buu lɛ yiteŋ nɔhaanɔ lɛ, kɛ eshinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ,
Kɛ kpo ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ he mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai lɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ hu. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Kohat shwiei lɛ ji Amrambii lɛ kɛ Izeharbii lɛ kɛ Hebronbii lɛ kɛ Uzielbii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Kohatbii lɛ.
Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ ana mɛi akpei kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Kohatbii awekui nɛɛ lɛ akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kɛyaa wuoyigbɛ lɛ hã amɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbuui lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpa lɛ ji Elizafan, Uziel bi lɛ.

Nibii ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ ji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ muhɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Levibii lɛ anukpa fe fɛɛ ji Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron bi lɛ; ni lɛ ekwɛɔ mɛi ni tsuɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ.
Merari shwiei lɛ ji Mahelibii lɛ kɛ Mushibii lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Meraribii lɛ.
Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ, ana mɛi akpei ekpaa kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Meraribii nɛɛ awekui lɛ fɛɛ awekunukpa lɛ ji Zuriel, Abihail bi lɛ. Ahã Meraribii nɛɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ koŋ nɔ kɛyaa kooyigbɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbuui lɛ yɛ jɛi.

Nibii ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ ni amɛkwɛ nɔ ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nibii ni ji mplaŋi lɛ kɛ mliblɛmɔnii lɛ, kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛhe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ kpo lɛ he akulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛ amɛhe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ taŋkpei lɛ hã koni amɛkwɛ nɔ.

Shi mɛi ni baamãmɔ amɛ bui yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ ni amɛkɛ jɛi afee amɛshihilɛhe ji Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ. He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ kusumi fɛɛ ni sa akɛ atsu ahã Israel maŋbii lɛ, amɛ esa akɛ amɛtsu. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛ ehe aaawo amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe lɛ.
Levibii hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ amɛwekui anaa yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ ayikulɛ shɛɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Ŋmaa Israelbii akromɔ bihii fɛɛ; kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, agbɛii koni okane amɛyikulɛ,
ni otse Levibii lɛ ohã mi, Yehowa, koni okɛ amɛ ato Israelbii kromɔ bihii lɛ fɛɛ anajiaŋ. Nakai nɔŋŋ oŋɔ̃ Levibii ashīa kooloi ohã mi koni akɛto Israelbii fɛɛ ashīa kooloi akromɔ bihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ."
Mose kane Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Kromɔ bihii ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa agbɛii ni aŋma lɛ ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ, ni ojɔɔ Levibii ashīa kooloi anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ashīa kooloi akromɔbihii anajiaŋ. Levibii lɛ minii ji amɛ. Mi, miji Yehowa.
Israelbii akromɔbihii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃ ni edɛŋ Levibii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akpɔ̃ amɛ.
Hemɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ yɛ mɔ kome yi, shekel kome feɔ garai nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Ni shika ni akɛbaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni edɛŋ nɔ nɛɛ lɛ okɛhã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose he shika ni awo akɛkpɔ̃ mɛi ni edɛŋ Levibii lɛ anɔ lɛ,
yɛ Israelbii lɛ akromɔbii lɛ adɛŋ. Ena jwiɛtɛi shekeli akpe kome kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ;
ni Mose kɛ mɛi ni akpɔ̃ lɛ shika lɛ hã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ efee lɛ.
4: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kanemɔ Kohatbii ni yɔɔ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ ayikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa,
kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Kohatbii lɛ anitsumɔ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he lɛ kɔɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe.
"Kɛji maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyajie muhɔɔ ni tsiɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛ muhɔɔ nɛɛ aha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he.

No sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ abotia wolo aha muhɔɔ ni akɛha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he lɛ nɔ; ni yɛ no hu sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ mama bluu krɔŋŋ alɛɛ Adeka lɛ nɔ. Enɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ahlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.

"Amɛkɛ mama bluu aha okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Yehowa aboloo lɛ mãa nɔ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛkɛ plɛtei lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛ tsofãkɛŋma woɔ mli lɛ, kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ kpuji ni akɛ aafɔleshãa dãa woɔ mli lɛ amãmɔ nɔ. Be fɛɛ be lɛ aboloo amã okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.

Kɛkɛ lɛ alɛɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ lɛ mli akɛha okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ obotia wolo alɛɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ lɛ nɔ; ni no hu sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ ahlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
"Amɛkɔ mama bluu, ni amɛkɛha kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe kanei lɛ, kɛ lagbeenii lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii tɛtrɛbii lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kanei lɛ woɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ ahe.
No sɛɛ lɛ amɛfi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛwo abotia wolo mli koni amɛkɛwo tso adeka ni akɛtreɔ lɛ mli.
"Shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, amɛlɛɛ mama bluu lɛ mli amɛkɛha nɔ, koni amɛkɛ abotia wolo aha mama bluu lɛ hu nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ latɛ lɛ ahlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
Amɛfi tsɛnsii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ amɛwo mama bluu mli; ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛfi nii lɛ ekoŋŋ amɛwo abotia hewolo mli. Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛma nɔ ni akɛtreɔ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛloo lamlu fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ mama afaseo aha latɛ lɛ nɔ;

ni amɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ashwie latɛ lɛ nɔ. Nibii nɛɛ ji lajee tsɛnsii lɛ, kɛ fakai lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ. Akɛ abotia hewolo aha nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ahlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.

Kɛji Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ eha Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Buu lɛ mli nibii lɛ hu fɛɛ ahe amɛgbe naa, ni maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, no mli dani Kohatbii lɛ abahole nibii lɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnine akata nibii lɛ eko he koni amɛkagboi. Enɛɛmɛi ji Kpee Buu lɛ he nibii ni Kohatbii lɛ baatere lɛ.

"Nibii ni atu awo Osɔfo Eleazar, Aaron bi lɛ, dɛŋ koni akwɛ nɔ ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ daa niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ, kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,
"Nyɛkahãa Kohatbii akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ ashishi miibule yɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ,

kɛtsɔ̃ gboimɔ ni amɛaagboi kɛji amɛmiibɛŋkɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ. Shi moŋ nɔ ni nyɛfee nyɛhã amɛ koni amɛyi ana wala ji akɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ abote Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Kohatbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ kɛ ejatsu hu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji Kohatbii lɛ bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli ni amɛhiŋmɛi gba nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbaagboi."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kanemɔ Gershonbii lɛ hu ayikulɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa,
kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Jatsui ni Gershonbii lɛ atere ji:
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ mama ni haa Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ abotia hewolo ni haa Buu lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ.

Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtre kpo lɛ ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai nɛɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Jatsu ni Gershonbii lɛ baatere kɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni amɛbaatsu lɛ, amɛbaafee yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ afãmɔ naa; ni nyɛ nyɛkɛ jatsui fɛɛ ni amɛbaatere lɛ baawo amɛdɛŋ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Gershonbii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kanemɔ Meraribii lɛ hu ayikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa,
kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Ni jatsui ni amɛbaatere kɛ amɛnitsumɔ fɛɛ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ, kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ,
kɛ kpo lɛ he akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii ni amɛmamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ taŋkpei lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu. Ni nyɛtsɔ̃a mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ejatsu ni ebaatere lɛ gbɛi.
Enɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Meraribii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar."
Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kane Kohatbii hii lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ. Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Mɛi ni ana lɛ ayikulɛ ji mɛi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ
be ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane Kohatbii hii lɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he lɛ.
Gershonbihii ni akane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa,
kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ,
amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Gershonbii hii ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa, koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ ayikulɛ nɛ.
Meraribihii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni akane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa,
kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ,
amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Meraribihii ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ naa lɛ nɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Levibii hii fɛɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa,
kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahuu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli loo Kpee Buu lɛ he loo jatsu teremɔ lɛ,
amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.
Mose nine nɔ atsɔ̃ akane Levibii nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa; ni Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɔŋŋ adamɔ ni ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ kɛ ejatsu.
5: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛjie mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miiye kpiti aloo ehe miiho nu aloo eta gbonyo he ekɛbule ehe yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ, nyɛjiea amɛ kɛyaa koni amɛkabule shitoohe lɛ he ni mihiɔ nyɛteŋ yɛ lɛ."
Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose lɛ, ni amɛjie gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nuu ko loo yoo ko booo Yehowa toi, ni efee enaanyo esha, ni ekɛkwa Yehowa ni nakai mɔ lɛ ye fɔ lɛ,
no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ, ni eto mɔ ni efee lɛ esha lɛ najiaŋ; asaŋ ekɛ nii ni ekɛtoɔ mɔ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome afata he ehã mɔ lɛ.

Shi kɛji mɔ nɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ egbo, ni anaaa ewekunyo ko ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ koni akɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ ahã mɔ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ atsɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni akɛhã osɔfo lɛ; esoro ojwɛni ni tɔ̃lɔ lɛ baahã koni akɛshã afɔle ekɛdãi efɔŋ ni efee lɛ.
Asaŋ nibii fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛaabahã akɛ amɛkɛbake Yehowa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
Osɔfo fɛɛ osɔfo lɛ, nii ni akɛaabahã lɛ lɛ, enɔ ni."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji nuu ko ŋa je esɛɛ,
ni ehã nuu kroko kɛ lɛ bɔ, ni etɔ̃ ewu lɛ nɔ, shi eshiu ewu lɛ sane nɛɛ nɔ ejaakɛ odasefonyo bɛ he, ni asaŋ amɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ yoo lɛ ena ebule ehe
loo kɛji awuŋayeli te shi yɛ nuu ko mli, ni eye eŋa he awuŋa lɛ, yoo lɛ ebule ehe jio, ebuleko ehe jio,

nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ. Nuu lɛ ahiɛ akoko mãmu kilo kome hu kɛba. Ekɛ mu akashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ krɔbɔo hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ eji awuŋayeli he niyenii afɔle ni akɛmiitao anɔkwale lɛ ale.'
"Osɔfo lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba, ni ehã ebadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ nu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko awo su kpulu mli, ni ekpiti shikpɔŋ su yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ewo nu lɛ mli.

Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ afɛne yoo lɛ yitsɔi yɛ eyiteŋ beiaŋ ni edamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ mãmu, ni ji niyenii afɔle ni akɛjieɔ mɔ shi lɛ, ahã yoo lɛ ni ehiɛ. Osɔfo lɛ ahiɛ nu ni joɔ ni gblaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ,
koni ekamɔ kitã eshwie yoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji nuu kroko kɛ bo ebɔko, ni ojeko owu sɛɛ owoko ohe muji lɛ, no lɛ ohe aje loomɔ ni nu joɔ nɛɛ gblaa kɛbaa lɛ mli;
shi kɛji oje owu lɛ sɛɛ, ni nuu kroko kɛ bo ebɔ, ni owo ohe muji lɛ,
(Osɔfo lɛ alomɔ yoo lɛ agbɛnɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ) no lɛ Yehowa ahã otsɔ̃ musumɔ ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛlomɔɔ, aloo akɛkãa kitã yɛ omaŋbii ateŋ. Yehowa ahã oyoohe abɛ, ni omusu afuu.
Kɛji nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ ni gblaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ bote omli lɛ, ehã omusu afūu, ni oyoohe abɛ.'" Yoo lɛ ahere osɔfo lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Amen. Amen!"
Osɔfo lɛ aŋmã loomɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɔ ko nɔ; no sɛɛ lɛ efɔ niŋmãa lɛ ewo nu ni joɔ lɛ mli,
ni ehã yoo lɛ anu nu ni joɔ ni gblaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, koni kɛji nuu lɛ bote yoo lɛ mli lɛ epiŋ lɛ waa.
Dani yoo lɛ baanu nu lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ahe mãmu ni ji niyenii afɔle lɛ ni akɛjieɔ mɔ shi lɛ yɛ yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ewo afɔle lɛ nɔ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛma afɔleshã latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akpiti niyenii afɔle lɛ edɛ̃ kɔkɔ obɔ̃ kome, akɛ nɔ ni ekɛmiiye he odase, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ ehã yoo lɛ anu nu lɛ.
Kɛji yoo lɛ eje ewu lɛ sɛɛ ekɛwo ehe muji lɛ, kɛji enu nu ni joɔ lɛ ni ebote emli lɛ, nu lɛ baahã epiŋ waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni emusu baafūu, ni eyoohe baabɛ, ni lɛ yoo lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ musumɔ yɛ emaŋbii ateŋ.
Shi kɛji yoo lɛ ejeko ewu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe baaje loomɔ lɛ mli, ni ebaawo shwiei.
Enɛ ji mla ni kɔɔ nuu awuŋayeli he lɛ. Kɛji yoo je ewu sɛɛ ni ewo ehe muji,
aloo nuu ye eŋa he awuŋa akɛ eje esɛɛ lɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba koni yoo lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ atsu yoo lɛ he nii yɛ nɛkɛ mla nɛɛ naa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nuu lɛ yeŋ sɔ̃ ko kwraa; shi yoo lɛ kɛji etɔ̃ lɛ no lɛ eyi sɔ̃ lɛ aaatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ.
6: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'nuu fɛɛ nuu loo yoo fɛɛ yoo ni eje gbɛ ewo shi akɛ eeefee ehe Nazirinyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ,
ekanu wain loo dãa ni wa; ekanu vinega ni akɛ wainyibii loo dãa ni wa fee. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ wainyibii fee lɛ ekanu; ni wainyibii ŋmɔŋ jio, nɔ ni aka lɛ egbiŋ jio, ekaye.
Bei abɔ fɛɛ ni etsɛɔ ehe Nazirinyo lɛ ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛ waintso he nɔ ko fee. Eyibii lɛ mli wui tete loo ehe toto po ekaye eko.'

"Kɛyaashi eeeye ebe ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa etã lɛ, ekaku eyi, ni yishɛɛ kakla naa akasa eyiteŋ. Shiwoo lɛ fīɔ lɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ. Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ; ni eŋmɛ eyi kusuu.
Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekaya gbonyo ko masɛi
Kɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ loo enyɛminuu loo enyɛmiyoo tete gbo lɛ, ekaya gbonyo lɛ masɛi ni ekɛbule ehe, yɛ ehe nɔ ni ejɔɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ
bei abɔ fɛɛ ni Nazirinyo ji lɛ lɛ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ hã Yehowa.
"Kɛji mɔ ko tswa shi egbo trukaa yɛ emasei, ni no hewɔ lɛ ebule eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ ni ejɔɔ nɔ lɛ, eshɛ eyi lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛtsuu ehe.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpo bibii enyɔ ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.

Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ okpoi lɛ ekome koni ekɛshã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome lɛ hu ashã shãa afɔle koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ; ejaakɛ gbonyo lɛ ewo ehe muji. Nakai gbi lɛ, mɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ ejɔɔ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ehã Yehowa.

Esaa ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa ekoŋŋ ejaakɛ be ni ewo shi tsuutsu lɛ eho. Ekɛ too gwaŋtɛŋbinuu ni eye afi aba ekɛbashã fɔyeli he afɔle, ejaakɛ ebule ehe nɔ ni ejɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhã be ni eye momo lɛ efee yaka.
"Kɛji Nazirinyo eye be ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa egbe naa lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ: akɛ lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.

Ehiɛ edɛŋ toi etɛ̃ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ni akɛshã afɔle akɛhã Yehowa nɛkɛ: Ekɛ gwaŋtɛŋbinuu ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle, ni ekɛ gwaŋtɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ too ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shidaa afɔle.

Ehiɛ nibii nɛɛ hu efata kooloi lɛ ahe: aboloo ni akɛŋmãa mã akpiti ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛnteŋ kome, kɛ akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mãmu muɛmuɛ fɛfɛo ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛ mã akpiti aboloo kekeree ni akpa hiɛ fɔ. Ekɛ able kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ hu ashi nɔ.
"Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ̃ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni akɛshã esha he afɔle lɛ kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ ehã Nazirinyo lɛ.
Ekɛ too ojwɛni lɛ afata mã akpiti aboloo kɛ kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ he koni akɛshã shidaa afɔle akɛhã Yehowa. Osɔfo lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔle lɛ he niyenii kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ hu afata he.
Nazirinyo lɛ ashɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ni eto kɛjɛ be ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ, koni eloo eyitsɔi lɛ ewo la ni yɔɔ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ shishi lɛ mli.

"Kɛji loo lɛ be lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɔ ojwɛni lɛ nine kome, ni ekɛfata kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ mli mã akpiti aboloo lɛ akwaabɔ kome kɛ akpiti akpaanɔɔ hu kome he koni ekɛwo Nazirinyo lɛ dɛŋ be ni eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ sɛɛ.

Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ahe afɔle lɛ ni efɔ̃ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ akɛ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nii nɛɛ ji nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛhãa osɔfo lɛ kɛfataa too lɛ tsitsinaa lɛ kɛ eshwuɔ lɛ he. Agbɛnɛ Nazirinyo lɛ baanyɛ enu wain kɛjɛ enɛ sɛɛ.

"Mla kɛ kusum ni yɔɔ afɔle ni esa akɛ Nazirinyo, mɔ ni ewo shi kɛjɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa, nɛ. Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ ewo shi fe tɛ ni afo afɔ̃ shi ahã Nazirinyo lɛ, no lɛ eye eshiwoo lɛ nɔ, ehã bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, kɛji amɛmiijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ,
'Yehowa ajɔɔ bo, ni eto bo!
Yehowa atse ehiɛ ehã o, no edro bo.
Yehowa ana bo mɔbɔ, ni ehã bo hejɔlɛ!'
"Kɛji amɛtsɛ migbɛi nɛkɛ amɛkɛjɔɔ Israelbii lɛ, mibajɔɔ maŋbii lɛ."
7: Gbi ni Mose gbe Yehowa kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ekɛtsuu amɛhe, ni esaŋ efɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ hu mu nakai nɔŋŋ ekɛfee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Maŋbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi ni ji Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ anɔ onukpai, ni ji akutsei lɛ atsɛmɛi, mɛi nɔŋŋ hu ni kwɛ maŋbii lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

hiɛ amɛdɛŋ nikee nii kɛba amɛkɛbahã Yehowa. Nibii nɛɛ ji shwiilii ekpaa ni awo amɛ nibii obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; shwiilii lɛ, onukpai enyɔ anɔ ekome, ni tsinai lɛ mɔ kome nɔ ekome. Amɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ba Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Hemɔ nibii ni amɛkɛba lɛ koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii. Ojra ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛ mɔ nitsumɔ naa."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛ shwiilii kɛ nibii lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ hã Levibii lɛ.
Ehã Gershonbii lɛ shwiilii enyɔ kɛ tsinai hu ejwɛ,
ni ehã Meraribii lɛ shwiilii ejwɛ kɛ tsinai hu kpaanyɔ. Ekɛ nibii lɛ wo Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛji mɔ ni kwɛɔ kui nɛɛ anɔ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli.
Shi Kohatbii lɛ shwiili jio, tsina jio Mose hãaa amɛ eko ejaakɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni amɛkwɛɔ nɔ lɛ, kɔ̃ŋ nɔ atreɔ yɛ.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ hiɛ nikee nii hu kɛba gbi ni afɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mu lɛ. Be ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ amɛnikeenii lɛ ba lɛ amɛshã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ,
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Onukpai lɛ aba mɔ kome mɔ kome amɛ kɛ amɛnikeenii lɛ abahã, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbi ni ato ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ koni akɛjɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ kɛgbele naa."
Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ni kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã ji Nahashon ni eji Aminadab bi, ni lɛji Yuda akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ.

Enikeenii lɛ fee jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mãmu ni awo mli fɔ koni akɛshã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofãkɛŋma,
tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle,
kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle,
kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: Tsinai enyɔ kɛ too ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Netanel ni ji Zuar bi, ni lɛji Isakar akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikee nii lɛ bahã.

kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: Tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Ahiezer ni ji Amishadai lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ lɛ, Pagiel ni eji Okran bi, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Asher akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.

Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mãmu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofãkɛŋma,
kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋbi nuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle,
kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle,
kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: Tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Pagiel ni ji Okran bi lɛ nikee nii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahira ni eji Enan bi lɛ, ni lɛji Naftali akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.

Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: Jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ŋmɛɛ tɛ naa. Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mãmu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofãkɛŋma,
kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle;
kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle,
kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: Tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi. Ahira, Enan bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ ji enɛ.

Nibii fɛɛ ni Israel akutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ bahã koni akɛshã afɔle kɛgble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa gbi nɔ ni afɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mu kɛjɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɛ: Jwiɛtɛi plɛte nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolui hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ shika tsɛnsii hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.

Jwiɛtɛi plɛte lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, kɛ okpolu fɛɛ okpolu ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo. Jwiɛtɛi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ tsiimɔ ji shekeli akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Shika okpolui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛmli tsofãkɛŋma obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma, shika ŋmiiŋmi okpolui lɛ fɛɛ feɔ shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.

Tsinai ni akɛbahã koni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ ayibɔ ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ. Abahã ojwɛnii hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ too gwaŋtɛŋ bihii ni eye afi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle hu. Abahã too kpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ hu ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle.

Kooloi fɛɛ ni akɛbahã koni akɛshã shidaa afɔle lɛ ayibɔ ji tsinai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ojwɛnii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ too kpakpoi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii ni eye afi nyɔŋmai ekpaa. Nibii nɛɛ akɛbahã koni akɛshã afɔle kɛgble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa be ni afɔ latɛ lɛ mu kɛtsuu he sɛɛ lɛ.
Be ni Mose bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni ekɛ Yehowa ayawie lɛ, enu Yehowa gbee ni ekɛ lɛ, Mose lɛ, miiwie kɛjɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ gbɛ yɛ kerubii enyɔ lɛ ateŋ.
8: Yehowaa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ kɛji ekɛ kanei lɛ miimamɔ kanetsei kpawo lɛ anɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ amamɔ shi bɔ ni amɛbaakpɛ kɛya kanetso lɛ hiɛgbɛ."
Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ, ni ekɛ kanei lɛ mamɔ shi bɔ ni amɛbaakpɛ kɛya kanetso lɛ hiɛgbɛ.

Bɔ ni kanetso lɛ yɔɔ ji akɛ atswia lɛ shika sɔŋŋ nii kɛjɛ eshitamɔnɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛmɔ ehe fɔfɔii lɛ aahuu kɛyagbe naa emuu. Bɔ ni nɔkwɛmɔnɔ lɛ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Mose lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ afee kanetso lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Halamɔ Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ koni otsuu amɛhe.
Ni bɔ ni ofee amɛ ni otsuu amɛhe nɛ. Okɛ nu ni akɛtsuuɔ mɔ he lɛ ashwã amɛnɔ; amɛshɛ amɛhe tsɔi fɛɛ kɛ kakla, ni amɛfɔ amɛtadei ahe koni amɛhe atse.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ohã amɛŋɔ tsina oblanyo, ni akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mãmu ni awo mli mu afata he; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oŋɔ̃ tsina oblanyo kroko ni okɛshã esha he afɔle.
Ohã Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ababɔ gwa; ni ohã Levibii lɛ adamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ.
Israelbii asafo lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie Levibii lɛ ayitsei ayiteŋ be mli ni ohã Levibii lɛ ebadamɔ Yehowa Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ Aaron ajɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ahã mi, Yehowa, akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ni jɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ mi.
Levibii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsina hii lɛ ayiteŋ; ni okɛ ekome ashã esha he afɔle, ni okɛ ekome hu ashã shãa afɔle okɛhã Yehowa koni okɛkpãtã ohã Levibii lɛ.
"Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi koni amɛwa Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ̃,
koni ojie Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ oto afã akɛ minɔ.
Otsuu amɛhe koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛba Kpee Buu lɛ mli amɛbasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi.
Ejaakɛ miiŋɔ amɛ kwraa yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ miihã mihe; mikɛ amɛ eto nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbleɔ musu naa ni ji Israelbii akromɔbii lɛ anajiaŋ.
Ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni mitswia kromɔbii fɛɛ nii yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi kɛ shīa kooloo kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi hu nɔ mihã mihe, ni mifee lɛ minɔ.
Levibii lɛ mikɛto Israelbii lɛ akromɔbii fɛɛ anajiaŋ.

ni mikɛ Levibii lɛ miihã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kwraa akɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ nikeenii koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Israelbii lɛ anajiaŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkpãtã efɔŋ ni baaba maŋbii anɔ kɛji amɛbɛŋkɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israelbii muu lɛ fɛɛ jɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ amɛhã. Bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee yɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nakai Israelbii lɛ fee Levibii lɛ.
Levibii lɛ tsu kusum kɛfɔ amɛhe eshai; amɛfɔfɔɔ amɛtadei ahe, ni Aaron jɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã akɛ keenii krɛdɛɛ hã Yehowa. Asaŋ etsuu amɛhe hu.
No sɛɛ lɛ Levibii lɛ tee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ashishi. Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee yɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nakai efee amɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Levibii lɛ ahe gbɛjianɔtoo nɛ: Mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛyaa lɛ, amɛtsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli,
ni mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, afɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔ lɛ ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe.
Be nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛwa amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli; shi moŋ nitsumɔ ko akakã amɛnɔ. Gbɛjianɔ ni oto ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ nɛ."
9: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Hã ni Israelbii lɛ aye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli.
Nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, nyɛyea gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli; nyɛyea lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa pɛpɛɛpɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ koni amɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ;
ni amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi, yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee.
Shi hii komɛi yata gbonyo he, ni amɛbule amɛhe; ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ Hehoo gbijurɔ lɛ amɛye yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ. Enɛ hewɔ lɛ hii nɛɛ ba Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔɔ yɛ Hehoo gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Amɛbakɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ wɔyabule wɔhe kɛ gbonyo ko he ni wɔyata lɛ. Mɛni hewɔ ni atsiɔ wɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔnikeenii akabahã Yehowa yɛ ebe ni eto lɛ mli tamɔ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ?"
Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmɛa kɛyashi Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi nɔ ni afee yɛ nyɛhe wɔ."
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko loo nyɛshwiei lɛ eko yata gbonyo he ni ekɛbule ehe, aloo edom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ko tete lɛ, ebaanyɛ eye Hehoo lɛ ehã Yehowa kɛ̃.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi. Amɛkɛ mã akpiti kɛ shwie ni joɔ aye;
amɛkashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ, ni asaŋ amɛkajwa kooloo ni agbe akɛye lɛ wui lɛ eko. Amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ naa.

Shi mɔ ni he tse, ni asaŋ edomko, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekwa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yeli lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ ehiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ Yehowa nikeenii lɛ baaa ebahãaa yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli. Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.'

"Ni kɛji mɔkpɔ̃ŋ ko bato gbɔ yɛ nyɛtɛŋ ni eesumɔ akɛ eye Yehowa Hehoo gbijurɔ lɛ; eye; shi eye yɛ Hehoo lɛ he akpɔ kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ anaa. Akpɔ kome akã shi ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, gbɔ jio, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio."
Gbi nɔ ni ashi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amã shi lɛ, atatu lɛ baha nɔ. Gbɛkɛ lɛ kɛ aakwɛ lɛ atatu lɛ tsoɔ tamɔ la yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashiɔ leebi.
Ni nakai eyɔɔ daa; atatu lɛ haa Buu lɛ nɔ ni gbɛkɛ lɛ etsoɔ tamɔ la.
Be fɛɛ be ni atatu lɛ aaawo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ; ni he ni atatu lɛ aaayawa yɛ lɛ, jɛi Israelbii lɛ toɔ shi yɛ.
Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛtoɔ shi hu yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ nɔŋŋ naa. Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni atatu lɛ ma shi yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hiɔ shitoohe lɛ mli.
Kɛji atatu lɛ tsɛ akɛ amɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ boɔ Yehowa toi, ni amɛfãaa kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Bei komɛi lɛ atatu lɛ yeɔ gbii fioo ko kɛkɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni eba lɛ ehã lɛ, Israelbii lɛ toɔ shi yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛfãa nyiɛmɔ hu yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa.

Kɛji atatu lɛ hi shi kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ kɛyashi jɛtsɛremɔ, ni ewo ehe nɔ leebi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni eye gbi muu kɛmɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ hu, be fɛɛ be ni atatu lɛ woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fãa.
Ni kɛ gbii enyɔ atatu lɛ ye yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio, nyɔŋ kome jio, be kakadaŋŋ jio, gbii abɔ ni eyɔɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ efãaa. Shi kɛji ewo ehe nɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛfã.
Amɛtoɔ shi yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛfãa yɛ Yehowa nɔŋŋ fãmɔ naa. Amɛye Yehowa gbee nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɔ Mose nɔ efã amɛ akɛ amɛfee lɛ.
10: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Okɛ Jwiɛtɛi ni atswia afee tɛtrɛmantrɛi enyɔ koni akɛtsɛ asafo lɛ kɛkpe, ni asaŋ okɛhã amɛfã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ.
Kɛji akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ shikome ni gbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ tsɛ naakpa lɛ, maŋbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa abakpe shi yɛ oŋɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Shi kɛji tɛtrɛmantrɛ kome kɛkɛ akpã lɛ, no lɛ Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ababua amɛhe naa yɛ oŋɔɔ.
Kɛji akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ akɛbɔ oshe ni egbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ lɛ, asafo ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ afã.
Kɛ akpã kɛbɔ oshe nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ asafoi ni jwere wuoyigbɛ lɛ anɔ ni, amɛ amɛfã. Belɛ kɛji aatao akɛ maŋ lɛ afã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ, akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ kɛbɔ oshe.
Shi kɛji aatsɛ maŋ lɛ koni amɛnaa abakpe shi lɛ, akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni egbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ atsɛ, shi akɛkabɔ oshe.
Aaron bihii ni ji osɔfo lɛ ji mɛi ni akpã tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ. "Gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ akpɔ ni akã tɛtrɛmantrɛi nɛɛ akpãmɔ he ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ nɛ:
Kɛji nyɛkɛ henyɛlɔ ko ni gbaa nyɛnaa miiwu yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ kɛbɔa oshe; ni mi, Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibaye mabua nyɛ, ni mibahere nyɛyiwala yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adeŋ.

Asaŋ nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛi lɛ yɛ gbii ni nyɛmiinya hu anɔ, kɛ gbiijuji ni ato lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee shishijee gbi lɛ hu nɔ be mli ni nyɛshãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ yɛ mihiɛ lɛ, ni maye mabua nyɛ. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
Israelbii lɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii asafo lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Atatu lɛ yawa yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ ji Israelbii lɛ aklɛŋklɛŋ fãa ni amɛfã nyiɛmɔ yɛ fãmɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ efã amɛ lɛ naa.
Yudabii akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ tsutsu fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Isakar akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ,
ni mɔ ni ji Zebulon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliab, Helon bi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni afã Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni Gershonbii lɛ kɛ Meraribii lɛ, ni amɛ amɛtreɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu fã nyiɛmɔ.
Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Ruben akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Simeon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Shelumiel Zurishadai bi lɛ;
ni mɔ ni ji Gad akutso lɛ asafo lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliasaf, Deuel bi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ ateŋ Kohatbii lɛ ni treɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nibii lɛ fã. Ashiɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amãa shi dani asafo lɛ yashɛɔ he ni ayaato shi yɛ ehee lɛ.
Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Efraim akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Manase akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ;
ni mɔ ni ji Benyamin akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Abidan, Gideon bi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Dan akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ ni nyiɛɔ Israelbii asafoi lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Asher akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ;
ni mɔ ni ji Naftali akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahira, Enan bi lɛ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ toɔ naa fãa, asaŋ ni amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ anaa kɛji amɛshi shitoohe ko.

Be ni Israel asafoi lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ eŋa nyɛminuu Hobab, ni ji eshaanuu Yetro, Midiannyo lɛ, binuu lɛ akɛ, "Wɔmiifã kɛya he ni Yehowa wo wɔ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ. Fatamɔ wɔhe ni wɔtee. Yehowa ewo shi akɛ ebaahã Israel aye ejurɔ; no hewɔ lɛ wɔ hu wɔɔfee bo ejurɔ."
Shi Hobab here Mose nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ehiŋ mi yaa; shi moŋ matee mi diɛŋtsɛ mijaku shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ mimaŋbii aŋɔɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Hobab akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, kaashi wɔ. Gbii abɔ ni bo ole hei ni sa akɛ wɔtotoo shi yɛ, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ wɔhiɛ.
Kɛji okɛ wɔ nyiɛ lɛ, ejurɔ fɛɛ ni Yehowa aaafee wɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkɛaafee bo."
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Sinai, ni ji Yehowa Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he; ni amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃; ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ amɛshitoohe.
Be fɛɛ be ni amɛaafã nyiɛmɔ amɛshi amɛshitoohe ko lɛ Yehowa atatu lɛ haa amɛnɔ shwane.
Kɛji eshɛ be ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, "Wo ohe nɔ, Yehowa, koni ohenyɛlɔi lɛ agbɛ ashwã, koni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ o lɛ ajo foi yɛ ohiɛ."
Ni kɛji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miito shi lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ, Yehowa, Kɛba Israelbii akpeiakpei abɔ lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ̃."
11: Yehowa toi gbe huhuuhu ni maŋbii lɛ wie tamɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi ni miina nɔ. Be ni Yehowa nu lɛ, emli wo la ni ehã la here yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli ni ekpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ afãgbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ blɔ amɛtsɛ Mose, ni Mose kpa yehowa fai, ni la lɛ gbo.
No hewɔ lɛ awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Tabera, ejaakɛ Yehowa la shã nii yɛ amɛteŋ.

Maŋsɛɛbii komɛi ni futu Israelbii lɛ, amɛsuɔmɔnaanii kwraa ji loo; ni no hewɔ lɛ loo bɔ̃i amɛtsine baa; ni asaŋ, Israelbii lɛ hu bɔ̃i amɛmli gbigblimɔ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ po wɔɔna loo yɛ wɔye.
Loo ni jra waaa enyiɛ po wɔnaaa wɔye yɛ Egipt? Wɔkaiɔ kokumba kɛ waatrɛ kɛ shwie kɛ sabolai!
Shi naa wɔ ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔtɔ biti, ni wɔnaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa wɔye akɛ ja nɛkɛ mana nɛɛ pɛ."
Mana nɛɛ tamɔ dumɔ wui bibiibii kɛ esu wuɔfo oo ko.
Maŋbii lɛ yaklɔɔ, ni amɛbawiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ nɔ, aloo amɛshiɔ yɛ fufuitso mli, ni amɛhoɔ yɛ kukwɛi mli amɛkɛfeɔ niyenii, eŋɔ̃ɔmɔ tamɔ akpiti ni awo mli fɔ ŋɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Nyɔɔŋ be mli ni bɔ nyɔɔ shitoohe lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai be mli mana lɛ hu bashwieɔ shi.
Mose nu ni maŋbii lɛ miifofoi yɛ amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ damɔ ebuu shinaa naa. Yehowa mlifu naakpa; ni sane lɛ eŋɔ̃ɔɔ Mose hu naa kwraa.
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Mɛɛba ni okɛ mi, otsulɔ, yeɔ kɛ joomɔ nɛɛ, ni oná mi mlifu? Mɛɛba ni okɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ fɛɛ yi sɔ̃ etre mi nɛɛ?
Ani mi, mibɔ maŋ muu nɛɛ, aloo mi, mifɔ amɛ, hewɔ ni okɛɛ mi akɛ mihiɛ amɛ yɛ mikpɔkɔiaŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni bihiɛlɔ hiɛɔ bi abifao, kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni owo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Nɛɛgbɛ maná loo yɛ mahã nɛkɛ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiifo amɛmiiwo mi akɛ mihã amɛ loo amɛye?
Mi kome too minyɛŋ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ makura. Nitsumɔ nɛɛ da fe mi.
Kɛji nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni okɛ mi baaye lɛ, no lɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ koni ogbe mi moŋ nyɔŋlo koni mikana mihiɛnaanɔ nii."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Halamɔ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo ni ji hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɛi, ni okɛ amɛ aba miŋɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he, ni ohã amɛdamɔ omasɛi.
Mibakpleke shi mikɛ bo abawie yɛ jɛi, ni maŋɔ mumɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ eko mahã amɛ hu koni amɛwa bo kɛtre maŋ lɛ jatsu lɛ bɔ ni afee ni okome okatre.

Ni okɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛtoa wɔ; shi nyɛbaana loo nyɛye. Yehowa enu yaafo ni nyɛfo akɛ, 'Namɔ aaahã wɔ loo ni wɔye, ejaakɛ be mli ni wɔyɔɔ Egipt lɛ ehi moŋ ehã wɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ Yehowa baahã nyɛ loo ni nyɛye.'
Ni jeee gbi kome, loo gbii enyɔ, loo gbii enumɔ, loo gbii nyɔŋma, loo gbii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛkɛ nyɛbaaye loo nɛɛ;

shi moŋ nyɔŋ kome muu sɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni loo lɛ baaje fu ewo nyɛ, ni ebaaje nyɛtsine. Ejaakɛ nyɛgbe Yehowa ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni nyɛfo nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, 'Wɔyɛ Egipt moŋ kulɛ ehi.'"
Shi Mose here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Maŋbii ni mikɛyɔɔ lɛ ayifalɛ shɛɔ akpei ohai ekpaa, ni okɛɛ obaahã amɛ loo amɛye nyɔŋ kome sɔŋŋ.
Ani toi kɛ tsinai aaagbe ahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa aloo ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ abaaya ayahɛ abahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Ani Yehowa bɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɔ lo? Miwiemɔ lɛ aaaba mli jio, ebaŋ mli jio, obaana ŋmɛnɛ!"
No hewɔ lɛ Mose tee ni eyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ lɛ. Ebua maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ ateŋ hii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ anaa, ni ehã amɛdamɔ shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu lɛ he kɛkpe.

Ni Yehowa kpleke shi yɛ atatu mli, ni ekɛ Mose bawie, ni eŋɔ mumɔ lɛ ni ekɛhã Mose lɛ eko ekɛhã onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ hu. Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni mumɔ lɛ yi amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛgbagbai; shi kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛgbaaa dɔŋŋ.

Maŋ onukpai ni Mose hala lɛ ateŋ hii enyɔ komɛi, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Eldad, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Medad, naaa afata maŋ onukpai lɛ ahe kɛya Kpee Buu lɛ he. Kɛ̃lɛ mumɔ lɛ yi amɛ hu amɛnɔ, ni amɛgba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli.
ni oblanyo ko jo foi ni ebatsī tã etsɔ̃ɔ Mose akɛ Eldad kɛ Medad miigba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli.
Enɛ hã Nun bi Yoshua ni ji Mose sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛjɛ eblahiaŋ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, tsii amɛ gbɛ!"
Shi Mose kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, "Mi oyeɔ awuŋa ohã nɛɛ? Miná ni kulɛ Yehowa maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃mɔ gbalɔi, ni Yehowa fɔse emumɔ lɛ eshwie amɛnɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ku amɛ sɛɛ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ mli.
Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko tswa, ni eloo trakɔkɔi babaoo kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛba ni ekɛ amɛ bashwie shitoohe lɛ mli kɛ ehewɔ fɛɛ kɛbɔle kpula bɔ ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ jekɛmɔ aaafee ninetalɔi enyɔ.

Ni nakai gbi nuu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enyɔɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ fɛɛ lɛ maŋbii lɛ mɔmɔ trakɔkɔi lɛ. Mɔ ni naaa kwraa lɛ ena loo ni tsiimɔ fee kiloi akpe. Amɛgbɛ loo lɛ mli amɛka kɛbɔle shitoohe lɛ he kpula.
Ayeko loo nɛɛ atãko, ni Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ, ni ehã hela ko babote amɛteŋ ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ naakpa.
Sane nɛɛ hã awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Kibrot Hataawa (eshishi ji Tsinebalɔi Agbonyobui), ejaakɛ jɛi ji he ni afu mɛi ni nii ba amɛtsine lɛ yɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Kibrot Hataawa kɛtee Hazerot, ni amɛto shi yɛ jɛi.
12: Miriam kɛ Aaron wie amɛshi Mose yɛ Kushyoo ko ni Mose yaŋɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ,
ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Ani Mose kome kɛkɛ Yehowa kɛwieɔ? Ani wɔ hu ekɛ wɔ ewieko pɛŋ?" Yehowa nu Miriam kɛ Aaron wiemɔ nɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ nuu Mose nɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwa, eji ehe humi fe shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni trukaa lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam akɛ, "Nyɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛjea kpo ni nyɛbaa Kpee Buu lɛ he." Ni amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ amɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpleke shi yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli, ni ebadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni etsɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam. Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ;
ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa mi toi! Kɛji gbalɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ɔ ninaa nɔ mihãa eleɔ mi, ni wɔlamɔ mli mitsɔ̃ɔ mikɛ lɛ wieɔ.
Shi mitsulɔ Mose nɔ bɛ nakai. Lɛ edɛŋ mitu mimaŋ Israel fɛɛ kuramɔ miwo.
No hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ faŋŋ; shi jeee yɛ abɛbuai amli; ni enaa mi, Yehowa, misu. Mɛɛba nyɛsheee gbeyei, ni nyɛwie nyɛshi mitsulɔ Mose lɛ?"
Yehowa mli fu Aaron kɛ Miriam; ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi be ni atatu kutuu lɛ jeɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, naa Miriam ni hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ futaa oookɛɛ kpiti. Aaron yaakwɛ Miriam lɛ, hewolo nɔ hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ oookɛɛ kpiti.
Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, ofai nɛ, kaahã agbla wɔtoi yɛ kwashiaianii kɛ esha ni wɔfee nɛɛ hewɔ.
Kaahã obiyoo tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɔmɔ ni be mli ni enyɛ fɔɔ lɛ beebe lɛ egbo, ni eheloo fã ekpɔtɔ momo."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose bo etsɛ Yehowa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ofai nɛ, tsa obiyoo."

Yehowa here Mose nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji Miriam tsɛ fɛ̃ lajɔ̃ shwie Miriam hiɛ lɛ, ani ashwieko Miriam hiɛ shi kɛyashi gbii kpawo lo? Ashwie Miriam kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ gbii kpawo; no sɛɛ dani ahã eba shitoohe lɛ mli."
Ashwie Miriam yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyahsi gbii kpawo, ni no hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ afã nyiɛmɔ kɛyashi aŋɔ Miriam kɛba shitoohe lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lɛ fã yɛ Hazerot kɛtee, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Paran.
13: Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Tsu hii koni amɛyasra Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛbaahã Israelbii lɛ. Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli lɛ tsu mɔ kome ni eji onukpa yɛ amɛteŋ."
Mose ye Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etsu Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii onukpai akɛ sralɔi kɛjɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ni mɛi ni etsu lɛ agbɛii baa nɛ: Ruben akutso lɛ mɔ lɛ ji Shamua, Zakur bi lɛ;
ni Simeon akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Shafat, Hori bi lɛ;
ni Yuda akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ.
Isakar akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Igal, Yosef bi lɛ;
ni Efraim akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Hoshea, Nun bi lɛ;
ni Benyamin akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Palti, Rafu bi lɛ.
Zebulon akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Gadiel, Sodi bi lɛ;
