ni Manase, Yosef bi lɛ, akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Gadi, Susi bi lɛ.
Dan akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Amiel, Gemali bi lɛ.
Asher akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Setur, Mikael bi lɛ;
ni Naftali akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Nahebi, Vofsi bi lɛ,
ni Gad akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Geuel, Maki bi lɛ.
Hii nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Mose tsu koni amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsake Nun bi Hoshea lɛ gbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Yoshua.
Mose tsu bɔfoi nɛɛ koni amɛyasra Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsɔ̃a kooyigbɛ nɛɛ kɛyaa Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ; ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ nyɛkwɔa gɔji lɛ,
ni nyɛyasraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ nɔ, akɛ amɛhe wa aloo amɛhe waaa, akɛ amɛyi fa aloo amɛyi faaa.
Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni shikpɔŋ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ ehã, akɛ ehi aloo ehiii, akɛ maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe aloo akrowai amli amɛyɔɔ.

Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɔɔ, akɛ ebaa nii aloo ebaaa nii jogbaŋŋ, akɛ tsei yɛ nɔ aloo tsei bɛ nɔ. Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtserɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ eko kɛbaa." Nakai be mli lɛ eshɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wainyibii atsulɛ be.
Bɔfoi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyasra Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii kɛjɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ, aahuu kɛyashi Rehob, he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa Hamat lɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ.

Bɔfoi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashɛ Hebron he ni Ahimanbii lɛ kɛ Sheshaibii lɛ kɛ Talmaibii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi gojogojoo ni, ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ Anakbii lɛ ashwiei ni. Ato Hebron maŋ lɛ afii kpawo dani ato Zoan maŋ ni yɔɔ Egipt lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi lɛ bashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Amɛfo waintso nine kome kɛ enɔ yibii shao yɛ jɛi, ni gbɔmɛi enyɔ wo yibii shao lɛ tsoŋ, ni amɛtre kɛba. Amɛtserɛ akutui lɛ eko kɛ agbamii lɛ hu eko kɛba.
Wainyibii shao ni Israelbii abɔfoi lɛ fo yɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ hewɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ.
Gbii Nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, sralɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ sramɔ lɛ amɛba.
Amɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kadesh yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ. Amɛbagba amɛ bɔ ni amɛyana nibii amɛhã, ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Amɛbɔ Mose amaniɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔtee shikpɔŋ ni otsu wɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ; ni anɔkwale ji akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ewo fɔ ni ebaa nii hu, ni enɔ tsei ayibii po nɛ.
Shi moŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛhe wa; ni amɛmaji lɛ atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe akɛwaje amɛ, ni maji lɛ dra naakpa hu; asaŋ wɔna Anakbii oblaŋi lɛ hu yɛ jɛi.
Amɛlekbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni Hitbii lɛ yɛ Yebusbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni Kanaanbi lɛ kã ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛ Yordan Faa lɛ hu naa."
Shi Kaleb tswa bɔfoi lɛ anaa mã yɛ Mose hiɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔyaa kɛ̃ koni wɔyaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ ejaakɛ wɔbaanyɛ amɛnɔ kunim wɔye aahuu."
Shi hii lɛ ni kɛ Kaleb tee amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔnyɛŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ wɔdamɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe wɔ."

Hii lɛ tsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛyasra lɛ he sane lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi amɛhã Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Naa, shikpɔŋ lɛ ni wɔyakpa nɔ wɔsra lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni egbo ni ebaaa nii ni enɔ bii ana aye; ni gbɔmɛi ni wɔna yɛ nɔ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni;
ni wɔna Anakbii ashwiei, gbɔmɛi oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi hu yɛ jɛi. Kɛji wɔkɛ wɔhe to amɛhe lɛ, wɔtamɔ agãi; ni nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amɛ hu amɛnaa wɔ."
14: Nakai gbi lɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ blɔ, ni maŋ lɛ fo nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ,
ni amɛwie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔgboi moŋ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ po kulɛ bɛ ehi?
Mɛɛba Yehowa ekpla wɔ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ koni wɔbanyɔnyɔi yɛ klaŋte naa koni aŋɔ wɔŋamɛi kɛ wɔbifabii anom nɛɛ? Ani ehiii moŋ akɛ wɔkpale kɛya Egipt ekoŋŋ?"
No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔwoa wɔteŋ mɔ ko onukpa koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ, ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛya Egipt."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi yɛ Israelbii asafo ni ebabɔ gwa lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, ni ji hii ni atsu ni amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛkwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ lɛ, gbla amɛtadei;
ni amɛkɛɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni wɔyakpa nɔ wɔsra wɔkwɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ kpakpa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni.
Kɛji Yehowa yɛ wɔhe tsui lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ wɔ aaayashɛ jɛi, ni eeeŋɔ nakai shikpɔŋ ni hi baa nii lɛ ehã wɔ.

Shi moŋ Yehowa hiɛ atūa kɛkɛ ni nyɛkatsea; ni asaŋ nyɛkashea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛshɛŋ wɔwaosɛɛpelɔ tete; amɛklɔ eje amɛnɔ momo; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei."
Asafo lɛ fɛɛ to amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbaatswia amɛ tɛ pɛ kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anumnyam la lɛ pue yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ maŋ nɛɛ aaakwa mi kɛyahsi? Mɛni shwɛɔ dɔŋŋ dani amɛaahe minɔ amɛye yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee mikɛto amɛ okadii lɛ asɛɛ?
Mibahã gbele hela ababote amɛteŋ koni mikɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ; shi mahã oshwiei atsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa fe maŋ nɛɛ."
Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ Egiptbii lɛ baanu he, ejaakɛ amɛteŋ ojie maŋ nɛɛ kɛjɛ yɛ onineshiwalɛ naa,
ni amɛaagba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ. Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ enu momo akɛ, bo Yehowa, okɛ wɔ yɛ, ni anaa bo faŋŋ kɛ faŋŋ kɛji atatu lɛ bashi edamɔ wɔnɔ; ni bo onyiɛɔ wɔhiɛ yɛ atatu kutuu mli.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛji okpãtã maŋ nɛɛ blublu hiɛ lɛ, majimaji ni enu ogbɛi he lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ,
'Nyɛ ni Yehowa, onyɛɛɛ okɛ omaŋbii lɛ ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni owo shi yɛ he akɛ okɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, hewɔ ni oyaplenee amɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.'
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa, ofai nɛ, hã wɔna ohewalɛ lɛ, ni ohã shi ni owo lɛ aba mli tamɔ okɛɛ oto lɛ akɛ,

'Mi, Yehowa, mimli fuuu mra, ni mimɔbɔnalɛ hu fa; ni mikɛ tɔ̃mɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ faa; shi kɛ̃lɛ mihãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋa ehe aye, ni miwoɔ bii anyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi atɔmɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete nɔ.'
No hewɔ lɛ okɛ maŋ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ afa amɛ yɛ osuɔmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni okɛfa nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛjɛ Egipt aahuu kɛbashi bianɛ lɛ."
Yehowa to he ehã Mose akɛ, "Mikɛfa amɛ bɔ ni obi lɛ.
Shi moŋ anɔkwale sane kome ji akɛ gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, ni asaŋ mi, Yehowa, minumnyam lɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ lɛ,
mɛi fɛɛ ni na minumnyam la kaŋkaŋ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mifɛɛ yɛ Egipt kɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni nomɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ amɛka mi shii nyɔŋma sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi lɛ,
amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo ehe shi mito akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni kwa mi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi akɛni soro mumɔ ni mitsulɔ Kaleb hiɛ, ni asaŋ eye mi anɔkwa kɛwula shi hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ baaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ ni etee ayasra lɛ nɔ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ashwiei anɔ.
Amalekbii lɛ kɛ kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ amrɔ nɛɛ, no hewɔ lɛ wɔ lɛ, nyɛdɔa nyɛyi koni nyɛtsɔ̃a shɔ Tsuru lɛ he gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyajea ŋa lɛ nɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,
"Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nɛkɛ asafo fɔŋ nɛɛ baawie huhuuhu amɛshi mi kɛyashi? Huhuuhu lɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ shiɔ mi lɛ, minu fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ, 'Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, bɔ ni nyɛwie nyɛwo mitoiŋ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mibafee nyɛ.
Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛbaagboi yɛ. Nyɛtɛŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni wie huhuuhu shi mi lɛ,
amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo shi yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛ koni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ, akɛ ja Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ.
Ni nyɛbii bibii lɛ ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, mibakpla amɛ kɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛkpoo lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaale jɛi.
Nyɛ lɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛbaagboi yɛ.
Nyɛbii lɛ baatsomlo, ni amɛbaana nɔ yɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ kwamɔ ni nyɛkwa mi lɛ hewɔ, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛteŋ naagbee mɔ lɛ baagbo.
Gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ ni nyɛye nyɛkɛsra shikpɔŋ lɛ, emli gbi kome fɛɛ gbi kome baatsɔ afi ahã nyɛ, ni nyɛbaana nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ nyɛtoigble lɛ hewɔ koni nyɛkɛna akɛ mikwa nyɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, minã miwie; ni anɔkwa, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mafee nɛkɛ asafo fɔŋ ni fee ekome wo mi nɛɛ. Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛaagboi ni nyɛyi aaatã tɛ.'"
Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ ni Mose tsu yasra shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba ni amɛbatã shikpɔŋ lɛ he sane fɔŋ amɛkɛhã maŋ lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Yehowa lɛ,
gbele hela fɔŋ ko bashi amɛnɔ, ni amɛtswia shi amɛgboi yɛ amɛnajiaŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ni eshwɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, pɛ yɛ hii ni tee yasra shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛyi na wala.
Be ni Mose jaje wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ye ŋkɔmɔ babaoo.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kwɔ kɛtee gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ̃; ni amɛkɛɛ, "Naa wɔ, wɔbaaya he ni Yehowa ewo shi yɛ he lɛ kɛ̃; ejaakɛ wɔfee esha!"
Shi Mose here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛkuɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɛɛ? Nyɛyeŋ omanye.
Nyɛkayaa, ejaakɛ Yehowa bɛ nyɛteŋ, koni nyɛkayanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ.
Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛkɛ nyɛ baakpe, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛ, ejaakɛ gbii abɔ ni nyɛpkale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hu fiŋ nyɛsɛɛ,"
Shi maŋbii lɛ shi amɛtsitsi, ni amɛkã akɛ amɛaakwɔ gɔ̃ŋ lɛ kɛya eyiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ Mose fɛɛ shiii shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyaaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ kpleke shi, ni amɛbaye Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛshwie amɛ aahuu kɛtee Horma tɔ̃ɔɔ.
15: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ ni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ,

kɛji nyɛkɛ tsina loo too baashã afɔle nyɛkɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ, shãa afɔle ni jio, gbee afɔle ni jio, afɔle ni akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa afɔle ni jio, nyɛgbiijuji ni ato lɛ eko nɔ afɔle ni jio, afɔle lɛ ŋma asa mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ.
Mɔ ni baashã afɔle lɛ ekɛ niyenii hu afata kooloo lɛ he kɛba. Niyenii nɛɛ afee ŋmãa mãmu kilo kome ni akɛ mu lita kome efutu mli,
kɛ wain hu lita kome. Akɛ nibii nɛɛ afata toobi kome ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle lɛ he.
Kɛji akɛ ojwɛni baashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ ŋmãa mãmu kiloi enyɔ ni akɛ mu lita kome kɛ fã efutu mli afee kooloo lɛ he niyenii afɔle lɛ;
ni akɛ wain lita kome kɛ fã afata he koni afɔle lɛ ŋma lɛ asa mihiɛ.
Shi kɛji akɛ tsina oblanyo baashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle akɛ akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ loo akɛ shidaa afɔle akɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ.
no lɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛfata tsina oblanyo lɛ he lɛ afee ŋmãa mãmu kilo etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu litai enyɔ efutu mli;
ni akɛ wain litai enyɔ hu afata he. Afɔle ni akɛ la shãa hãa mi Yehowa, ni misumɔɔ eŋma ji enɛ.'
"Niyenii ni afata tsinanuu fɛɛ tsinanuu, loo ojwɛni fɛɛ ojwɛni, loo gwaŋtɛŋbi fɛɛ gwaŋtɛŋbi loo abotiabi fɛɛ abotiabi he nɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kooloi abɔ ni akɛbaashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ eko fɛɛ eko he niyenii afɔle ni ato lɛ afata he yɛ amɛyibɔ lɛ naa.
Israel fɔmɔbi fɛɛ fɔmɔbi afee enɛ kɛji eba ebaashã niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa.
Kɛji mɔkpɔ̃ŋ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ aloo ebadɔmɔ nyɛ kwraa sumɔ akɛ eshã afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma, woɔ mi Yehowa, bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ hu efee.

Gbɛjianɔtoo kome baakã shi ahã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ; ni ekã shi akɛ naanɔ akpɔ ahã nyɛ, Israel fɔmɔbii kɛ mɔkpɔ̃ŋ ni ebato nyɛ gbɔ lɛ fɛɛ ashwiei. Israelnyo kɛ mɔkpɔŋ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ pɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mla kome kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo kome baahi shi ahã nyɛ Israel fɔmɔbii kɛ gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii ni nyɛaana nyɛye lɛ, nyɛkɛ eko ashãa afɔle nyɛhãa mi, Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛkpokploku mã lɛ eko ashãa aboloo nyɛhãa mi akɛ nɔwomɔ afɔle. Bɔ ni nyɛshãa ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ he afɔle lɛ, nakai nyɛshã enɛ hu.
Nyɛbaashã kpokploku mã aboloo afɔle nɛɛ nyɛkɛhã Yehowa yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli.
"Kɛji nyɛtɔ̃ ni nyɛyeee kitãi nɛɛ ni Yehowa ewo Mose lɛ fɛɛ anɔ,
kitãi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo nyɛ, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Yehowa wo nakai mlai lɛ, kɛyashi nyɛyinɔi ayinɔi blublu anɔ lɛ,

ni atɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ ko, yɛ leee ni asafo lɛ leee hewɔ lɛ, no lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ amɛdɛŋ tsina oblanyo kome koni amɛkɛshã shãa afɔle amɛkɛhã mi, akɛ afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma, woɔ mi, Yehowa. Akɛ niyenii kɛ dãa afɔle hu bɔ ni afo akɛ kusum lɛ afata he. Too kpakpo kome hu afata he koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ aaafa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ kãaa he, ni asaŋ, tɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ.
Akɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ aaafa Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gbɔi ni ebato amɛ lɛ hu ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shi nɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko fee esha ni ehiɛ kãaa he lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ abotia yoo ni eye afi aba koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ ni akɛaafa lɛ.
Mla kome akã shi ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee kwa ekwa efee esha lɛ, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, mɔkpɔ̃ŋ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni jio.
"Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehiɛ kã he ni efee no fɔŋ ko lɛ, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, gbɔ ni jio, ebɔ musu ejaakɛ ekwɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ nakai mɔ lɛ gbe agbe lɛ;
ejaakɛ ebuuu Yehowa wiemɔ, ni etɔ̃ ekita nɔ. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ agbe lɛ ko ni emusu atre lɛ."
Be ko be mli ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lolo lɛ, ayana nuu ko ni etee eelɛ lai yɛ hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni yana nuu lɛ kpla lɛ kɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Awo nuu lɛ tsuŋ ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ anako nɔ pɔtɛɛ ni sa akɛ afee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Agbe nuu lɛ. Akɛ lɛ aje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni agbe lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpla nuu lɛ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛ, ni agbe lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛfee ahwanyai amɛwo amɛtadei akoji anaa, ni akɛ kpãa bluu amɔ̃mɔ̃ amɛ. Yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ bii afee nakai.

Ahawanyai nɛɛ atsɔ̃ kaimɔ nii; ni be fɛɛ be ni hiŋmɛi aaagba nɔ lɛ ehã nyɛkai Yehowa kitãi lɛ fɛɛ koni nyɛye nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkanyiɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi akɔnɔ nibii lɛ asɛɛ, nibii asɛɛ ni nyɛyadiɔ ni nyɛkɛkwaa Yehowa lɛ.
Ahwanyai lɛ baakai nyɛ mikitãi lɛ koni nyɛye nɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhã mi, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni matsɔ̃ nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Miji Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ."
16: Izehar bi Kora, ni eji Kohat nabi, ni asaŋ eji Levi nanakansowa lɛ na Ruben akutso lɛ mli gbɔmɛi etɔ̃ komɛi shi enɔ. Gbɔmɛi bɛɛ ji Datan kɛ Abiram, Eliab bii lɛ, kɛ On, Pelet bi lɛ.
Amɛte shi amɛwo Mose. Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni ji asafo lɛ mli onukpai kɛ hiɛnaanɔbii ni yɔɔ gbɛi komɛi hu fata amɛhe.

Gbɔmɛi bɛɛ kpe amɛwo Mose kɛ Aaron he, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃. Ejaakɛ asafo muu lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni; ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ. Mɛɛba ni nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Yehowa asafo lɛ nɔ mɔ?"
Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni esɔle.

Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Kora kɛ asafo lɛ ni ekɛba lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔ ni ji wɔ leebi lɛ Yehowa baahã ale mɔ ni ji enɔ; mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ. Mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ, Lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Nɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Kora, bo kɛ osafo lɛ nyɛklɔa lajee tsɛnsii;
nyɛjea la nyɛwoa amɛmli kɛbaa wɔ, koni nyɛkɛ tsofãkɛŋma abashwiea nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ. Jɛi wɔbaana yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ akɛ lɛ ji mɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃, nyɛ Levibii."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Kora akɛ, "Nyɛboa mi toi koo, nyɛ Levibii!

Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etse nyɛ yɛ Israel asafo lɛ he, ni ehãa nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛbɛŋkɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛtsuɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nii; ni asaŋ nyɛdamɔɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛ, aso no faaa hãaa nyɛ lo?
Yehowa ehã bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ lɛ; ni fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmiitao osɔfoyeli lɛ hu nyɛfata he?
Naa, kpee ni bo kɛ osafo lɛ bakpe nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa he nyɛkpe nyɛwo lɛ, ni huhuuhu ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ Aaron lɛ, Yehowa moŋ nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsu koni ayatsɛ Datan kɛ Abiram, Eliabbii lɛ, kɛba. Shi amɛhã hetoo akɛ, "Wɔbaaa he ko he ko!
Kɛji obakpla wɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ewo fɔ nɔ, ni obaagbegbee wɔ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no kɛkɛ faaa bo; shi no sɛɛ hu lɛ ootao akɛ oyeɔ lumɔ yɛ wɔnɔ lo?
Asaŋ jeee shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ewo fɔ nɔ fɔ nɔ okɛ wɔ ba; ni obahãko wɔ ŋmɔji kɛ waintromi akɛ wɔgboshinii. Obaakã he ni olaka wɔ sɔŋŋ nakai? Wɔbaaa he ko he ko!"
Sane lɛ wo Mose mli la naakpa; ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Kaahe amɛfɔlei lɛ. Mishɔ̃ko amɛteŋ mɔ ko teji yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, miyeko amɛteŋ mɔ ko sane fɔŋ ko!"
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Kora akɛ, "Wɔ lɛ, bo kɛ osafo lɛ fɛɛ aba Yehowa hiɛ. Bo kɛ amɛ kɛ Aaron fɛɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, bo kɛ osafoŋbii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛ Aaron hu, akɔ alajee tsɛnsi, ni ekɛ tsofãkɛŋma awo mli koni nyɛkɛba Yehowa hiɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔ elajee tsɛnsi, ni eje la ewo mli; ni ekɛ tsofãkɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛkɛba amɛbadamɔ shi yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, amɛ kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron fɛɛ.
Kora bua maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa ewo Mose kɛ Aaron; amɛbabɔ gwa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni amɛmiikwɛ Mose. Yehowa anumnyam la lɛ pue trukaa yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,
"Nyɛtsia nyɛhe yɛ nɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ he koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli."
Shi Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ, heloo fɛɛ awala jɛɛhe! Aso mɔ kome aaafee esha, ni okɛ ehe nu aaaju maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he lo?"
Yehowa hã Mose hetoo akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ maŋ muu lɛ akɛ, 'Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shihilɛhei lɛ ahe kɛya sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.'"
Mose te shi, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Datan kɛ Abiram ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛtee.
Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtsia nyɛhe oya kɛjea nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɔɔji nɛɛ abuui lɛ ahe kɛyaa sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ni nyɛkataa amɛnɔ ko nɔ ko he koni akakpãtã nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ."

Wiemɔ nɛɛ hã asafo lɛ gbla amɛhe shi kɛshi Kora Datan kɛ Abiram buui lɛ ahe kɛtee sɛɛ flɛŋŋ. Datan kɛ Abiram je kpo amɛbadamɔ amɛbuui lɛ ashinai lɛ ashi, ni amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛbifabii lɛ fɛɛ hu fata amɛhe.
Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, "Enɛ nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsu mi akɛ mibatsu nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni mifeɔ lɛ, shi jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ mito miyiŋ ni mifeɔ.'
Kɛji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gboi tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi fɛɛ gboiɔ, aloo amɛkɛ oshrã ko kpe ni eji adesã he nɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee Yehowa ni tsu mi nii ni mitsuɔ lɛ tsumɔ.
Shi kɛji Yehowa fee nɔ ko ni bako dã, ni shikpɔŋ gba ni emī gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ, ni amɛpkleke shi kɛtee gbohiiajeŋ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ bɛkɛ hii nɛɛ ebuuu Yehowa."
Mose naa ni nyɔ shi nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ gba yɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shishi,
ni amɛ kɛ amɛ bii kɛ hɔi kɛ Kora hu webii lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɔ bu lɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ mi amɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛtee gbohiiajeŋ hiɛkãalɔi kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ. Shikpɔŋ ni gba lɛ bashi hiɛ ni etsa ekoŋŋ, ni emii amɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛhiɛkpãtã kwrakwra yɛ amɛjakumɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Blɔmɔ ni amɛblɔ lɛ hã Israelbii fɛɛ ni ewo shi yɛ jɛi kɛkpe lɛ jojoo foi, ni amɛ hu amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Akakwɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ bamii wɔ hu."
Yehowa hã la bayi hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ ni kɛ tsofãkɛŋma ba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ anɔ ni eshã amɛ wɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
Kɛɛmɔ Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron binuu lɛ, akɛ ehole lajee tsɛnsii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ ni eshã lɛ ateŋ, ni egbɛ amɛmli la lɛ eshwã kɛya sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsɛnsii lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ,
No hewɔ lɛ atswia hii nɛɛ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛwala wo esha lɛ he nyɔmɔ lɛ, atsɛnsii lɛ tɛtrɛbii, ni akɛha afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni etsɔ̃ okadi ehã Israelbii fɛɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ Osɔfo Eleazar klɔ akɔɔble lajee tsɛnsii lɛ ni hii lɛ ni la lɛ shã lɛ kɛba lɛ, ni atswia akɛfee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hehaanii,

koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔnɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni jeee Aaron shwie ko akatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ akɛ ebaashã tsofãkɛŋma ekɛhã Yehowa, koni ekabatsɔ̃ tamɔ Kora kɛ esafo lɛ. Eleazar fee bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ saa wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛgbe Yehowa webii."
Be ni maŋbii lɛ abaa ebabua kɛbaaya ayanina Mose kɛ Aaron lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ amɛkwɛ Kpee Buu lɛ, ni naa, atatu kutuu lɛ ebaha Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anumnyam la lɛ epue.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron badamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ,
ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjea nɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ he kɛyaa sɛɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli." Shi Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi,

ni Mosɛ kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Kɔ olajee tsɛnsi lɛ, ni oje afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ la lɛ eko owo mli, ni okɛ tsofãkɛŋma ashwie nɔ, ni okɛya asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ mramra okɛyakpãtã ohã amɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa mlifu ete shi momo, ni gbele hela lɛ ebɔ̃i mɛi ahiɛ kpãtãmɔ."
Aaron fee bɔ ni Mosɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ. Ekɔ elajee tsɛnsi lɛ, ni ekɛjo foi kɛtee maŋbii lɛ ateŋ. Eyanina ni gbele hela lɛ ebɔ̃i mɛi ahiɛkpãtãmɔ momo. Eshã tsofãkɛŋma lɛ, ni ekɛkpãtã ehã maŋbii lɛ.
Aaron damɔ gbohii lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ateŋ, ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Gbɔmɛi ni gbele hela lɛ gbe lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai kpawo, soro mɛi ni gboi yɛ Kora sane lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
Be ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo lɛ, Aaron ku esɛɛ kɛba Mose ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
17: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Bi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ abahã bo dɛhiɛmɔtsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, akutso fɛɛ akutso lɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso kome. Ŋmãa akutso fɛɛ akutso gbɛi yɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso ni ekɛba lɛ he;
ni oŋmã Aaron gbɛi yɛ tso ni Levibii kɛba lɛ he. No hewɔ lɛ akutsotsɛ fɛɛ akutsotsɛ lɛ ebaana dɛhiɛmɔtso kome.
Klɔmɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ kɛya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni okɛyashwie Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ he ni mi kɛ bo kpeɔ yɛ lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ji mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ, edɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ baagba afofro; ni mikɛ enɛ baahã huhuuhu ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ amɛshiɔ nyɛ yɛ mihewɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose bi Israelbii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ bahã lɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso komekome yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa. Fɛɛ fee dɛhiɛmɔtsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni akɛ Aaron tso lɛ hu fata he.
Mose kɛ tsei lɛ tee eyashwie Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Mose tee Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ, naa Aaron tso lɛ ni ji Levibii awe lɛ tso lɛ ni efrɔke ni egba afofro, ni ewo yibii hu.
Mose loo tsei lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛje kpo kɛba Israelbii lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ekɛbatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni akutsotsɛ fɛɛ akutsotsɛ kɔ etso.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kpalemɔ ni okɛ Aaron tso lɛ ayafɔ̃ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ ekoŋŋ koni akɛto okadi ahã toigbolɔi lɛ bɔ ni afee ni huhuuhu ni amɛwieɔ amɛshiɔ mi lɛ sɛɛ afo, koni amɛkagboi."
Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Naa, wɔmiiplenee, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã! Wɔ bluublu wɔhiɛ miikpãtã.
Kɛji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ baagbo lɛ, belɛ no lɛ wɔ fɛɛ lɛ, gboimɔ wɔgboi lɛ!"
18: Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Bo kɛ obihii kɛ Levibii fɛɛ ji mɛi ayi ni sɔ̃ baatere kɛji abɔ musu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ gbɛfaŋ; shi yɛ osɔfo nitsumɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ bo kɛ obihii lɛ pɛ baatere sɔ̃ kɛji tɔ̃mɔ ko ba.
Ŋɔɔ onyɛmimɛi, Levibii ni ji otsɛ akutso lɛ mli bii lɛ, ofata ohe koni amɛwa bo be ni bo kɛ obii lɛ tsuɔ osɔfoi anitsumɔ lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛsɔ̃mɔ kɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ kɛkɛ yɛ oshishi; shi amɛkabɛŋkɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ loo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ akagboi.
Amɛ, amɛfata ohe koni amɛtsu amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛŋ lɛ: Shi moŋ mɔ ko ni jeee Levinyo akabɛŋkɛ nyɛ ni ebatsu jɛi nitsumɔ lɛ eko.
Bo kɛ obii lɛ pɛ akwɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ bɔ ni afee ni mimli akafu Israelbii lɛ doŋŋ.
Ni naa, mijie nyɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ateŋ, ni mikɛ amɛ eke nyɛ akɛ mi, Yehowa, minikeenii, koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.

Shi bo kɛ obihii lɛ pɛ asɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ mligbɛ hu. Miŋɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ mihã nyɛ akɛ sɔɔ̃mɔ ni aŋɔke. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ejeee osɔfo ni eeebɛŋkɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Naa, nibii ni Israelbii kɛbahãa mi akɛ afɔle lɛ, amɛmli nibii fɛɛ ni ashãaa lɛ, mijɔɔ nɔ mikɛke bo kɛ obihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛnaanii kɛmiiya naanɔ.

Afɔlei krɔŋkrɔŋi ni fe fɛɛ lɛ amli nibii fɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ afɔleshãa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛnɔ ni. Nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbakeɔ mi akɛ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, niyenii afɔle ni jio, esha he afɔle ni jio, sɔ̃yeli he afɔle ni jio, mijɔɔ nɔ tswaa mikɛke bo kɛ oshwiei.
Nyɛyea nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ. Nuu fɛɛ nuu aaanyɛ aye eko; nyɛbua lɛ akɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
"Mikɛ nibii ni Isrealbii lɛ kɛbahã mi akɛ shidaa afɔle lɛ hu eke nyɛ, ni ji bo kɛ oshwiei hii kɛ yei fɛɛ, akɛ amɛgbɛnaanii kɛmiiya naanɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehe tse yɛ oshwiei ateŋ lɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.
"Mijɔɔ mu kɛ wain kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ able ni akuɔ lɛ mli ekpakpa fe fɛɛ ni Israelbii kɛbahãa mi Yehowa nɔ mihã o.
Klɛŋklɛŋ aduawai ni amɛtseɔ yɛ amɛŋmɔji amli ni amɛkɛhãa mi Yehowa lɛ, onɔ ni. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehe tse yɛ oshwiei ateŋ lɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.
"Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ajɔɔ nɔ akɛke mi yɛ Israel lɛ etsɔ̃ onɔ.
"Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbleɔ musu naa ni akɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, miijɔɔ enɔ mihã nyɛ. Shi gbɔmɔ kromɔbi lɛ ohã akpɔ̃ lɛ; kookoi ni he tseee lɛ ohã akpɔ̃ amɛ
Kɛji amɛye nyɔŋ kome lɛ, jra ni akɛkpɔ̃ amɛji jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ yɛ sɔlemɔwe lɛ jwiɛtɛi jra naa. Shekel kome feɔ gerai nyɔŋmai en yɔ

Shi tsina loo gwaŋteŋ loo abotia kromɔbi lɛ, okahã akpɔ̃ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ amɛhe tse; amɛ okɛshã afɔle okɛhã mi. Okɛ amɛlá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni oshã amɛmli fɔ lɛ koni efee afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Amɛloo lɛ nyɛnɔ ni tamɔ bɔ ni kooloi krokomɛi ni akɛshãa afɔle atsitsinai kɛ ninejurɔ shwuɔji lɛ feɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ.

"Nibii fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahãa mi akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ miijɔɔ fɛɛ nɔ miihã o kɛ oshwiei hii kɛ yei fɛɛ akɛ amɛgbɛnaa nii ni kã shi daa. Kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ bo kɛ oshwiei ekpãŋ nɛɛ akuŋ mli kɛmiiya naanɔ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, "Onaŋ gboshinii ko yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ onaŋ shikpɔŋ ni abaaja lɛ eko. Mi, Yehowa, miji ogbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ ogboshinii ni he hiaa o yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ."
"Too fɛɛ too ni ji nii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome ni awoɔ yɛ Israel ni akɛbahãa mi lɛ, mijɔɔ nɔ mihã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ gboshinii yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ kɛtsuɔ Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ hewɔ.
Ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ akabɛŋkɛ Kpee Buu lɛ dɔŋŋ koni amɛkabaloo musu ni amɛgboi.
Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni baatsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii; ni kɛji nɔ ko tɔ̃ yɛ he lɛ sɔ̃yeli lɛ tere amɛ. Akpɔ nɛɛ akã shi daa ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei. Levibii lɛ, amɛnaŋ gboshinii ko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ,

ejaakɛ nibii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ni Israelbii woɔ akɛ too ni amɛkɛbahãa mi Yehowa akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ, mikɛhã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii. Enɛ hewɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛnaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

"Kɛɛmɔ Levibii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛnine shɛ nibii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ni mibi Israelbii koni amɛwo amɛhã nyɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛjiea mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome nɛɛ mli mlijaa nyɔŋma kome koni nyɛkɛbahãa, mi Yehowa, akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ.
Ni abaabu nyɛfɔle krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ tamɔ abuɔ okwaafonyo ŋmãa hee kɛ wain hee ni ekɛbashãa afɔle lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu nyɛbashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa kɛjɛ nyɛmlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei ni nyɛheɔ kɛjɛɔ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ mli. Nyɛŋɔa afɔle nɛɛ nyɛhãa Osɔfo Aaron.
Nyɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ amli nii kpakpa ni fe fɛɛ lɛ ashãa afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.

No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ Levibii lɛ akɛ, 'Kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛnibii lɛ amli nii kpakpa fe fɛɛ lɛ eshã afɔle lɛ, nyɛŋɔa nibii fɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ sɛɛ lɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ tamɔ okwaafonyo ŋɔɔ eŋmɔshi nii loo wain ni shwɛɔ lɛ akɛ enɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ayea nii ni shwɛɔ hãa nyɛ nɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ nyɛnii ni nyɛtsuɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwo ni.
Nyɛyeee sɔ̃ ko yɛ no hewɔ, kɛji nyɛna nyɛkɛ nii lɛ mli nii kpakpa fe fɛɛ lɛ eshã afɔle momo lɛ. Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ koni nyɛkabule nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni Israelbii kɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ koni nyɛbagboi.'"
19: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ,
"Akpɔ ni mi, Yehowa, miwoɔ nɛ: Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛbahã bo tsinayoo tsuru ni kpa ko kpa ko bɛ ehe, ni asaŋ akɛ apã woko lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ tsuko nii dã.
Akɛ tsina lɛ ahã Osɔfo Eleazar, ni ekɛ kooloo lɛ aje kpo kɛya shitniioohe lɛ sɛɛ koni agbe kooloo lɛ yɛ Eleazar hiɛ.
Osɔfo Eleazar asɔo tsina lɛ lá lɛ eko, ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli ni etsɛŋe lá lɛ eshwã Kpee Buu lɛ naagbɛ shii kpawo.
Ama tsinayoo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa la koni ashã lɛ kɛ ehe wolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ kɛ elá lɛ kɛ ewamɔ fɛɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ aklɔ tsenedru tso kɛ hisopo tso kɛ kpãa tsuru koni efɔ̃ ewo la ni akɛshãa tsinayoo lɛ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ Osɔfo lɛ afɔ atadei ahe, ni eju ehe dani ebote maŋbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli. Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ he tseee aahuu kɛyashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni shã tsina lɛ hu afɔ etadei ahe, ni eju ehe. Lɛ hu ehe tseee kɛyashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ.

Kɛkɛ lɛ mɔ ko ni he tse aloo tsinayoo lɛ lamlu lɛ, ni ekɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni tse koni akɛ lamlu lɛ ayato jɛi. Akɛ lamlu nɛɛ awo nu ni alɛtsuuɔ mɔ he akɛdãiɔ esha ni afee yɛ Israel lɛ mli. Enɛ ji hetsuumɔ afɔle.
Lɛ mɔ ni ebaaloo tsinayoo lɛ lamlu lɛ hu, ebaafɔ atadei ahe. Lɛ hu ehe tseee kɛyashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ. Akpɔ nɛɛ baakã shi daa ahã Israelbii kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ni ebato amɛ gbɔ fɛɛ.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata gbonyo ko he lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyaahsi gbii kpawo.

Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ aju nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he lɛ eko, yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, ni ehe aaatse. Shi kɛji ejuuu nu lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ etsuuko ehe ni ehe tseŋ.
Mɔ ni aaata gbonyo ko he ni atsuuu ehe lɛ, eebule Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ebuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ ejuko nu ni akɛtsuuɔ he lɛ ekɛdãiko ehe, ni no hewɔ lɛ ekã muji lɛ mli lolo.
"Kɛji mɔ ko gbo yɛ buu mli lɛ, ehe mla ni kã shi nɛ: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ buu lɛ mli be ni mɔ lɛ nyɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatee buu lɛ mli lɛ ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbii kpawo;
asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ buu lɛ mli ni abuko naa lɛ abule lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baata mɔ ko ni enyɔ yɛ klaŋte naa gbonyo he, loo mɔ ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele gbonyobu ko he yɛ jwɛiaŋ lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
"Bɔ ni atsɔ̃ atsuu mɔ ni ebule ehe lɛ he nɛ: Akpiti tsina tsuru ni ashã lɛ lamlu lɛ eko awo nɔ̃ mli, ni ayɛ faa ni hoɔ mli nu awo lamlu lɛ he.

Mɔ ko ni ehe tse kɛ hisopo atsɔ nu kɛ lamlu lɛ mli koni ekɛshwã buu lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi kɛ mɛi hu ni tee mli lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Nakai nɔŋŋ akɛ nu nɛɛ ashwã mɔ ni eyata mɔ ni nyɔ yɛ klaŋte naa gbonyo he loo mɔ ni gbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele gbonyo he loo gbonyowu loo gbonyobu he lɛ nɔ.

Mɔ ni he tse lɛ kɛ nu nɛɛ baashwã mɔ ni he tseee lɛ nɔ yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ebaatsuu mɔ ni ebule ehe lɛ he; ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baafɔ atadei lɛ ahe, ni ebaaju ehe, ni gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ mɔ ni kulɛ ehe tseee lɛ he aaatse.
"Shi mɔ ni ebule ehe, shi etsuuu ehe koni ekɛfɔ ehe muji lɛ, abaashwie lɛ yɛ asafo lɛ mli, ejaakɛ eebule Yehowa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ. Ejuko nu ni akɛtsuuɔ he lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ ekã muji lɛ mli lolo.
Akpɔn nɛɛ akã shi ahã Israelbii lɛ daa. Mɔ ni kɛ hetsuumɔ nu lɛ shwãa lɛ, lɛ hu efɔ etadei lɛ ahe; ni mɔ ni aaata hetsuumɔ nu lɛ he lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mɔ ni ebule ehe aaata he lɛ, ebule nɔ lɛ; ni mɔ ni aaata nii ni abule he lɛ, lɛ hu ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbɛkɛ."
20: Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yashɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛto shi yɛ Kadesh. Biɛ Miriam gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ.
Nu bɛ shitoohe nɛɛ hã maŋ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ bakpe,
amɛwo Mose kɛ Aaron he. Amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Wɔgboi tamɔ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ gboi yɛ Yehowa Buu lɛ hiɛ moŋ kulɛ bɛ ehi:
Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ wɔ, Yehowa asafo lɛ, ebaŋa nɛɛ nɔ? Anii jeee koni wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi fɛɛ wɔbagboi yɛ biɛ?
Ni mɛni hewɔ nyɛkpla wɔ kɛjɛ Egipt kɛba shikpɔŋ gbonyo tamɔ enɛ nɔ? Shikpɔŋ gbonyo ni ehiii enɔ nidumɔ, ni agbami kɛ waintso kɛ akutu ko bɛ enɔ he ko he ko; ni nu ni anuɔ tete po bɛ nɔ?
Mose kɛ Aaron je gwabɔɔ lɛ hiɛ, ji amɛtee Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi; kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anumnyam lɛ pue yɛ amɛnɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,

"Kɔ tso lɛ, ni, bo kɛ onyɛmi Aaron, nyɛbuaa asafo lɛ naa, ni okɛ tɛsaa ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ awie yɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ ehã nu ni yɔɔ emli lɛ atue. Nu baajɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli aba ahã maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛkooloi lɛ koni amɛnu."
Mose kɔ tso lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.'
Mose kɛ Aaron bua maŋ lɛ naa yɛ tɛsaa lɛ hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛboa toi ko, nyɛ atuatselɔi! Ani wɔhã nu ajɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ mli ahã nyɛ lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo enine nɔ, ni ekɛ etso lɛ tswa tɛsaa lɛ shii enyɔ, kɛkɛ ni nu tue babaoo, ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛkooloi lɛ na nu amɛnu.
Shi Yehowa kã Mose kɛ Aaron hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Akɛni nyɛheee minɔ nyɛyeee koni nyɛhã maŋbii lɛ ana mihewalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ kple lɛ, nyɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ eyaŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ."
Awo nu lɛ gbɛi akɛ Meriba nu lɛ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yehowa taa naa yɛ jɛi, akɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ lɛɛlɛŋ.
Ni Mose tsu bɔfoi kɛjɛ Kadesh kɛtee Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni onyɛmimɛi Israelbii kɛɛ nɛ: "Bo ni onyɛmimɛi Israelbii kɛɛ nɛ: Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole, amanehului fɛɛ ni wɔna:
bɔ ni wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ tee Egipt, kɛ bɔ ni wɔhi shi yɛ Egipt be kplaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛ bɔ ni Egiptbii fee wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ niseniianii aahuu.
Wɔfo wɔtsɛ Yehowa, ni ebo wɔ toi, ni etsu bɔfo ni ebajie wɔ kɛje Egipt. Wɔbashɛ Kadesh amrɔ nɛɛ, ni ji maŋ ni yɔɔ ohusu lɛ naa kpaakpa.

Ofai nɛ, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho kɛkɛ. Wɔyaŋ ŋmɔji loo wain tromi amli lɛ, wɔnuŋ nubui lɛ amli nu lɛ eko hu. Teŋpɔŋ wulu lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɔ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku kɛyaashi wɔɔfo mli yɛ okpokpai lɛ anɔ."
Shi Edombii lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, "Dabida! Nyɛkabatsɔ̃a wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ wɔbaafã ta wɔwo nyɛ."
Israelbii lɛ to he akɛ, "Teŋpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɔ̃ɛ, Kɛji wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi lɛ aaanu nyɛnu lɛ eko po lɛ, wɔbaawɔ nyɛ nyɔmɔ. Sane ko bɛ sɛɛ fe akɛ wɔmiitao wɔfo mli kpoo kɛkɛ."
Edombii lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Wɔplɔ̃ɛɛ!" Ni amɛfã ta kpeteŋkple kɛyasa Israelbii lɛ anaa.
Akɛni Edombii lɛ eyaŋmɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ gbɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ dɔ amɛyi, ni amɛyatsɔ̃ he kroko.
Israelbii asafo tso muu lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Kadesh, ni amɛba Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he,
yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ naa. Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ jɛi akɛ,
"Aaron naji enyɔ yiŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhã Israelbii lɛ nɔ; ebaagbo ejaakɛ nyɛbooo mi toi be ni nyɛyɔɔ Meriba lɛ.
Ŋɔ̃ɔ Aaron kɛ ebinuu Eleazar koni okɛ amɛ aya Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ.
Jiemɔ osɔfoyeli atadei lɛ yɛ Aaron he yɛ gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ koni okɛwo ebinuu Eleazar. Aaron baagbo yɛ jɛi."
Ni Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ. "Amɛkwɔ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ,
ni Mose jie asɔfoyeli atadei lɛ yɛ Aaron he, ni ekɛwo Aaron binuu Eleazar. Ni Aaron gbo yɛ jɛi yɛ gɔ̃ŋ lɛ yiteŋ, ni Mose kɛ Eleazar kpleke shi kɛjɛ gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israel asafo tso muu lɛ fɛɛ na akɛ Aaron eje jeŋ lɛ, amɛfo Aaron gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
21: Be ni Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni gbɛi ji Arad lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ etsɔ̃ Atarim gbɛ kɛmiiba lɛ, efã ta kɛtee eyatua Israelbii lɛ, ni eŋɔ mɛi komɛi nom,
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wo Yehowa shi, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ; "Kɛji ooohã wɔye gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ kunim lɛ, no lɛ wɔbaakpãtã amɛmaji lɛ ahiɛ butubutu."
Yehowa bi Israelbii lɛ toi, ni ehã amɛye Kanaanbii amaji lɛ ahiɛ butubutu, ni amɛwo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Horma (eshishi ji niihiɛkpãtãmɔ.)
Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naagbɛ, he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Akaba Ble lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛtswa Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛfɔ. Nyiɛmɔ lɛ je Israelbii lɛ atsine yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ,
ni amɛwie amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose amɛkɛɛ akɛ, Mɛɛba kwraa po nyɛjie wɔ yɛ Egipt koni wɔbagboi yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɛɛ? Niyenii bɛ lɛ, nu hu bɛ; niyenii gbonyogbonyo nɛɛ yeli eje wɔtsine."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã onufui ni anaa jraa babote Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛkɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii gboi.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ba Mose ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbaakɛ lɛ akɛ, "Wɔfee esha akɛ wɔwie wɔshi Yehowa kɛ bo fɛɛ. Kpa Yehowa fai ohã wɔ koni ejie onufui nɛɛ kɛje wɔteŋ." Mose kpa fai lɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Okɛ dade ni kplɛɔ afee onufu ni okɛtsotsro tso bloblo nɔ, ni okɛma shi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni onufui lɛ eko ekɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, kɛji ewo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ onufu lɛ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ lɛ, eyi baana wala."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛ akɔɔble fee onufu, ni ekɛ tsotsro tso bloblo nɔ ni ekɛma shi. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni onufui lɛ eko ekɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛɔ akɔɔble onufu lɛ, ni eya naa wala.
Israelbii lɛ fã ekoŋŋ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Obot.
Kɛkɛ Obot lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Abarim maŋ amaŋfɔ̃ ko ni yɔɔ ŋa ni kã Moabbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛfã ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛyato shi yɛ Zered Jɔɔ lɛ mli;
ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yato shi yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kooyigbɛ ŋa kplanaa ni kã shi aahuu kɛyaboteɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ. Arnon Faa nɛɛ ji Moabbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ ahusu.
No hewɔ lɛ aŋmã yɛ Yehowa tai ahe Wolo lɛ mli akɛ, "Wɔtsɔ̃ Waheb yɛ Sufa, kɛ Arnon Faa lɛ jɔi lɛ amli,
kɛ gɔji lɛ hu ni amɛjɔi lɛ yaa kɛyashɛɔ Ar maŋ lɛ shikãmɔhe lɛ anɔ ni ji Moab kpokpai lɛ ahusu lɛ."
Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kooyigbɛ ni amɛyato shi yɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Nubuianaa, he ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ akɛ, "Buamɔ maŋbii lɛ anaa, ni mahã amɛ nu koni amɛnu" lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Israelbii lɛ la nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ: "Nubu, hã nu atue, ni wɔɔbɔ oshe kɛhere lɛ atuu!
Nubu ni lumɛi lɛ tsa, ni maŋ abladei je kɛ amɛtsii kɛ amɛdɛhiɛmɔ tsei lɛ." Israelbii lɛ shi ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛtee Matana,
ni be ni amɛfã yɛ jɛi hu lɛ amɛtee Nahaliel, ni amɛjɛ Nahaliel kɛtee Bamot.
Kɛkɛ Bamot lɛ amɛtee jɔɔ lɛ ni kã Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ mli yɛ Pisga Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ shishi. Kɛjɛ gɔ̃ŋ nɛɛ yiteŋ lɛ anaa shiaŋa kplanaa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ŋɔ̃ɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ,

"Ofai nɛ, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho kɛkɛ. Wɔgbaŋ ŋmɔ ko loo waintrom ko mli lɛ, wɔnuŋ nubui lɛ amli nu lɛ eko hu. Maŋtsɛ teŋpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku kɛyaashi wɔɔfo mli yɛ okpokpai lɛ anɔ."
Shi Maŋtsɛ Sihon ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ akɛ Israelbii lɛ atsɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho. No hewɔ lɛ ebua etabilɔi anaa, ni efã ta kɛyanina Israelbii lɛ yɛ Yahaz ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ wu.

Shi Israelbii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Amorbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ naa aahuu kɛyashwie Yabok Faa lɛ naa, ni ji Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ naa lɛ, ejaakɛ Amonbii lɛ etswa gbogboi yɛ amɛhusu lɛ naa.
Ni Israelbii lɛ shɔ̃ Amorbii amaŋ ni ji Heshbon lɛ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛhi mli.
Heshbon ji Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon lɛ maŋtsɛmaŋ. Sihon kɛ tsutsu Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ wu ni eshɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ kɛbashi Arnon Faa lɛ naa.
No hewɔ ni alaa akɛɔ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa Heshbon, nyɛhãa atswaa; asaa atswa Maŋtsɛ Sihon maŋ lɛ ama shi.
Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ, Heshbon maŋ nɛɛ mli Sihon tabilɔi fã kɛjɛ oookɛɛ la. Kɛyakpãtã Moab Ar maŋ lɛ hiɛ kɛ Arnon gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
Kpoo hã o, bo Moab! Nyɛgbe nyɛjeŋ naa, nyɛ Kemosh jalɔi. Ehã ebihii lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi, ni ebiyei lɛ hu etsɔ̃mɔ Amor Maŋtsɛ Sihon nomii.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛshwiei ahiɛ ekpãtã kɛjɛ Heshbon aahuu kɛyashwie Dibon tɔ̃ɔ; kɛjɛ Nashim kɛtee Nofa yɛ Medeba masɛi."
Bɔ ni fee ni Israelbii lɛ hi Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ.
Mose tsu mɛi ni amɛtee amɛyasra Yazer maŋ lɛ amɛba; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ yatua maŋ lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛshwie Amorbii ni yɔɔ jɛi momo sa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ dɔ amɛyi, ni amɛyi Bashan maŋtsɛ Og fã ta, lɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ, koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ abawu yɛ Edrei.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kaashe lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ miwo odɛŋ. Obaaye enɔ kunim, koni ofee lɛ bɔ ni ofee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni ye kumɔ yɛ Heshbon yɛ."
Israelbii lɛ gbe Maŋtsɛ Og kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni ashii gbɔmɔ hiɛkãlɔ kome nɛkɛ; ni amɛŋɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi nɔ.
22: Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee ni kã Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ.
Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, ena enu nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ efee Amorbii lɛ,
kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayifalɛ hu; ni no hewɔ lɛ, lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ she gbeyei naakpa. Israelbii lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi mɔ Moabbii lɛ.
Moabbii lɛ kɛɛ Midian maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, "Ataamɛi, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni baa kɛ ta nɛɛ baakpãtã nibii ni yɔɔ wɔkpokpai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ tsina kpeɔ ŋanɔ jwɛi lɛ." Kɛkɛ ni Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak

tsu bɔfoi akɛ amɛya Petor ni kã Eufrate Faa lɛ naa yɛ Amawo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ koni amɛyakpee Balaam, beor bi lɛ amɛbahã lɛ. Wiemɔ ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛyahã Balaam ji, "Naa, mɛi komɛi, jaku muu, efã kɛjɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba, ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. Ni miwieɔ nɛɛ amɛbɛŋkɛ biɛ amɛtã, mihiɛ tua amɛ.

No hewɔ lɛ, ofai nɛ, ba nɔŋŋ, shi amɛyi fa fe wɔ, koni obalomɔ amɛ ohã mi akɛ aleee nɔ minine aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ koni mashwie amɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lo. Mile akɛ kɛji ojɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, jɔɔmɔ baa mɔ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji olomɔ mɔ ko hu lɛ, loomɔ baa mɔ lɛ nɔ."
Moab onukpai lɛ kɛ Midian onukpai lɛ yi mli amɛtee; ni amɛhiɛ klamɔ nyɔmɔwo shika kɛtee. Be ni amɛyashɛ Balaam ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ wiemɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Balak kɛtsu amɛ lɛ hã lɛ.

Balaam kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛwɔa biɛ ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ lɛ mibaba mibakɛɛ nyɛ nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi." No hewɔ lɛ Moab onukpai lɛ kɛ Balaam hi shi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ba Balaam ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hii yɔɔ oŋɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?"
Balaam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, tsu amɛ miŋɔ̃ɔ akɛ
maŋ muu ko, ni jɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba, ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ mibalomɔ amɛ mihã lɛ koni enyɛ amɛ ekɛwu, ni ashwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Okɛ bɔfoi lɛ akaya tsɛmɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ okalomɔ nakai mɛi lɛ hu, ejaakɛ mɛi ni mijɔɔ amɛ ni."
No hewɔ lɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Balaam tee Balak bɔfoi lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa nyɛmaŋ. Yehowa ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ehãaa mi akɛ mikɛ nyɛ aya."
Kɛkɛ ni Moab ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Balaam ekplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ eba otsɛmɔ lɛ."
Maŋtsɛ Balak saa tsu bɔfoi ni ahiɛ tsii, asaŋ ni amɛyi fa fe tsutsubii lɛ;
ni amɛtee Balaam ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Ofai nɛ, ni okahã nɔ ko nɔ ko miitsi bo tsɛmɔ lɛ baa gbɛ!
Ejaakɛ mibawo ohiɛ nyam babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni obaakɛɛ mi lɛ, mibafee; no hewɔ lɛ bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba koni obalomɔ mɛi ni ebaje nɛɛ ohã mi kɛkɛ.'"

Kɛkɛ ni Balaam here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Balak bɔfoi lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji Balak ŋɔ̃ ewe lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi tsu obɔ̃ kɛ kpo obɔ̃ tete eke mi po, minyɛŋ maje Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wiemɔ sɛɛ ni mafee nɔ ko ni fe aloo nɔ ko ni shɛɛɛ bɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ mi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, nyɛ hu, nyɛwɔa biɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ tamɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ koni mabo nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ toi."
Nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Balam akɛ, "Kɛji tsɛmɔ kɛkɛ hii nɛɛ ba bo tsɛmɔ lɛ, saamɔ ohe koni okɛ amɛ aya; shi moŋ nɔ pɛ ni makɛɛ bo lɛ no ofee."
No hewɔ lɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Balaam wo eteji nɔ nii, ni ekɛ Moab onukpai lɛ yi mli ni amɛtee.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ mli wo la akɛ Balaam miiya tsɛmɔ lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ be ni Balaam ta eteji lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ni ablahii enyɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ badamɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ koni esa enaa.
Be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni egbla eklaŋte ehiɛ edɛŋ lɛ, ewi gbɛ lɛ, ni eyanyiɛ ŋa lɛ mli. Balaam yi teji lɛ koni ekɛdɔ eyi kɛba gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tee ni eyadamɔ gbɛ leleoo ko ni kã waintromi ateŋ lɛ nɔ; gbogbo yɛ gbɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ekɛ ehe yakpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ, ni emia Balaam nane ekpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Balaam yi teji lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ saa etsi kɛtee ehiɛ, ni eyasa Balaam naa yɛ nififiaŋ he ko, he ni gbɛ bɛ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ he kɛyaa ninejurɔgbɛ loo abɛkugbɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ, eho ebu shi. Balaam mli wo la ni ebɔ̃i teji lɛ yii.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã teji lɛ wie, ni ebi Balaam akɛ, "Mɛni mifee bo hewɔ ni oyi mi shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛɛ?"
Balaam here teji lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ejaakɛ oofee mi buulu. Eji mihiɛ klaŋte kulɛ benɛ migbe bo momo."
Teji lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Ani jeee miji oteji ni otaa minɔ daa nɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ? Ani mifee o nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gble Balaam hiŋmɛii, ni ena Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛ eklaŋte ni egbla ehiɛ edɛŋ. Balaam mã eyi shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni oyi oteji lɛ shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛɛ? Naa, miba koni mibasa onaa, ejaakɛ nyiɛmɔ nɔ ni onyiɛ nɛɛ ejaaa yɛ mihiɛ.
Teji lɛ na mi, ni ewi ehe kɛje mihiɛ shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ. Ewiii ehe kɛjeee mihiɛ kulɛ, benɛ migbe bo momo, ni mihere teji lɛ kɛkɛ yiwala."
Balaam hã Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hetoo akɛ, "Mifee esha; ejaakɛ mileee kwraa akɛ oba oosa minaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ. No hewɔ lɛ kɛji minyiɛmɔ nɛɛ esaaa ohiɛ lɛ, maku misɛɛ mɔ."
Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Okɛ hii lɛ aya kɛkɛ; shi moŋ wiemɔ ni mikɛ bo aaawie lɛ, no nɔŋŋ pɛ owie." Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛ Maŋtsɛ Balak bɔfoi lɛ tsa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtee.
Be ni Balak nu akɛ Balaam miiba etsɛmɔ lɛ, eyi mli kɛtee lɛ kpeemɔ yɛ Ar, ni ji Moabbii amaŋ ko ni kã Arnon Faa lɛ naa lɛ mli. Arnon Faa nɛɛ ji Moabbii ahusu lɛ mli.
Balak kɛɛ balaam akɛ, "Ani jeee tsu mitsu kpɛkpɛ̃ɛkpɛ akɛ abatsɛ bo kɛba? Mɛɛba obaaa klɛŋklɛŋ tsɛmɔ lɛ? Ani osusuɔ akɛ minyɛŋ bo majuro bɔ ni sa lo?"
Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, "Naa mi; miba. Shi moŋ, mɛɛ hewalɛ miyɔɔ? Wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛbaawo minaa lɛ, no nɔŋŋ mawie."
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛ Balak shwie nɔ kɛba maŋ ni gbɛi ji Huzot lɛ mli;
ni Balak kɛ tsinai kɛ toi shã afɔle yɛ jɛi, ni ehã ayahã Balaam kɛ onukpai ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ afɔleshãa loo kɛ eko.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Balak tsɛ Balaam fata ehe, ni amɛkwɔ Baal Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ; ni Balaam jɛ jɛi ni ena Israelbii asafo muu lɛ ayafalɛ.
23: Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, "Maamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ biɛ ohã mi; ni obahã mi tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo."
Balak fee nɔ ni Balaam kɛɛ lɛ lɛ ni lɛ kɛ Balaam shã tsinanuu kome kɛ ojwɛni hu kome yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
Balam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, "Yaadamɔ oshãa afɔle lɛ he, koni maya akɛ aleenɔ mikɛ Yehowa aaakpe lo. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeekɛɛ mi lɛ, mibaba mibakɛɛ bo." Kɛkɛ ni eyi mli etee kpataa ko nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Balaam kpe, ni Balaam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Mimamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo, ni mishã tsinanuu kome kɛ ojwɛni hu kome yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ."
Ni Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ wo Balaam naa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ kɛya Balak ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ bo lɛ."
Be ni Balaam ku esɛɛ kɛba Balak ŋɔɔ lɛ, Balak kɛ Moab lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ Balak shãa afɔle lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam wo egbee nɔ, ni ebɔi gbaa ekɛɛ, "Moab maŋtsɛ Balak yaŋɔ mi kɛjɛ Siria, yɛ boka gɔji lɛ anɔ ekɛɛ: 'Ba, baalomɔ Yakob; Baalomɔ Israelbii ohã mi!'
Shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ malomɔ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ lomɔko lɛ hu? Te aaafe tɛŋŋ mashwɛ musu mahã mɔ ko be ni Yehowa ekɛko nakai?
Tɛsai ayiteŋ mijɛ mina amɛ; ni gɔŋkpɔi anɔ mijɛ mikwɛ amɛ akɛ maŋ ni amɛ kome too amɛyɔɔ. Amɛle akɛ ajɔɔ amɛ fe maji fɛɛ.
Israel shwiei ayikulɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu, Amɛyi fa fe bɔ ni aaanyɛ akane. Hã magbo jalɔi agbele koni minaagbee atamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Te okɛ mi yeɔ tɛŋŋ mɛɛ? Miyaŋɔ bo kɛba koni obalomɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, shi jɔɔmɔ sɔŋŋ moŋ ojɔɔ amɛ nɛɛ!"
Balaam here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ani esaaa akɛ makwɛ jogbaŋŋ koni mawie nɔ ni Yehowa kɛwo minaa lɛ?"
Agbɛnɛ Balak kɛɛ Balam akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, ba ni wɔtee he kroko, he ni ooona Israelbii lɛ yɛ. Obaana amɛfã ko kɛkɛ; onaŋ amɛ fɛɛ; koni olomɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi ohã mi."
Balak kɛ Balaam tee Zofim ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Pisga Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ yiteŋ, ni eyamãmɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ jɛi, ni ekɛ tsinanuu komekome yɛ ojwɛni hu komekome shã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, "Badamɔ biɛ yɛ oshãa afɔle lɛ he, koni matsi kɛya hiɛ fioo koni makɛ Yehowa ayakpe."
Yehowa kɛ Balaam kpe, ni ekɛ wiemɔ wo enaa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kuu osɛɛ kɛya Balak ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ bo lɛ."
Ni Balaam ku esɛɛ kɛba, ni ebanina Balak kɛ Moab onukpai lɛ fɛɛ damɔ Balak shãa afɔle lɛ he. Kɛkɛ ni Balak bi Balaam akɛ, "Mɛni Yehowa kɛɛ?"
Balaam wo egbee nɔ, ni ebɔ̃i gbaa, ni ekɛɛ, "Tee shi, Balak, ni obo mi toi; Zipor binuu, feemɔ toi ohã mi.
Nyɔŋmɔ jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ni eeemale, aloo gbɔmɔ ni eeeshwa ehe yɛ nɔ ni efee hewɔ. Mɛni ekɛɛ dã ni efeee; aloo ewo ehe shi ni eyeee nɔ?
Naa, jɔɔmɔ efã mi akɛ mijɔɔ; Ena ejɔɔ momo, ni minyɛŋ hiɛ matsake
Minaaa akɛ oshrã ko bashrã Israel, aloo Israel he baajra lɛ. Yehowa amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ yɛ; lɛ amɛbɔɔ oshe amɛhãa akɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ jie amɛ kɛje Egipt; amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ he wa oookɛɛ wuo.
Ŋkunyaa ko nyɛŋ Israel, ni klamɔ ko hu mɔŋ lɛ. Odase ni abaaye yɛ Israel he ji akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ.'
Naa, Israel teɔ shi tamɔ jata yoo; ni ewoɔ ehe nɔ tamɔ jata nuu. Ebuuu shi, ja egbe ni eye, ni enu mɛi ni egbegbee alá etã dã."
Kɛkɛ ni Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Kaalomɔ amɛ, ni kaajɔɔ amɛ hu."
Shi Balaam here Balak nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ lɛ no mibafee lo?"
Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Agbɛnɛ hã wɔya he kroko. Eko lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaana he tsui, ni eeeŋmɛ bogbɛ akɛ olomɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ jɛi ohã mi."
Ni Balak kɛ Balaam shwie nɔ kɛtee Poer Gɔ̃ŋ ni kwɛɔ shiaŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ lɛ yiteŋ.
Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, "Mãamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ biɛ ohã mi; ni obahã mi tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo yɛ biɛ."
Balak fee nɔ ni Balaam kɛɛ lɛ lɛ; ni Balak kɛ tsinanuu kɛ ojwɛni shã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
24: Shi Balaam eyɔse akɛ Yehowa suɔmɔ naa ji akɛ ejɔɔ Israelbii lɛ. No hewɔ lɛ eyaaa tamɔ bei krokomɛi lɛ akɛ eyaatao okadii. Shi moŋ ewo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ekwɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ.
Ena Israelbii lɛ ni amɛjwere shi yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa. Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ ba yi Balaam nɔ,
ni ewo enaa nɔ, ni egba ekɛɛ akɛ, "Balaam, Beor bi lɛ, ninaa nɛ, nuu ninalɔ lɛ ninaa nɛ,
Mɔ ni nuɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ ni enaa ninaa ni Ofe lɛ jieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, mɔ ni buɔ shi, shi enaa nii lɛ.
Kwɛ bɔ ni Israel buui lɛ yɔɔ fɛo! Israel shihilɛhei amli yɛ akɔnɔ
tamɔ faa he jɔi ni elɛɛ shi oookɛɛ faa toi abɔi, tamɔ tsei fɛfɛji ni Yehowa tɛo oookɛɛ faa toi tsenedrutsei.
Nu aaajɛ onubui amli, Israel, ashwie shi ni oshwiei kɛaadu nii. Omaŋtsɛ lɛ baaje agbo fe Maŋtsɛ Agag, ni aaawo emaŋtsɛyeli nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ yajie amɛ yɛ Egipt, ni amɛhe wa tamɔ wuo. Amɛbaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ amaji anɔ, ni amɛbaajwra amɛwui wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛgãii lɛ baatsɛ̃rɛ amɛ.
Edɛke shi; ebu shi tamɔ jata, tamɔ jata yoo; namɔ aaatsiɛ lɛ? Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɔɔ bo lɛ, aaajɔɔ lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lomɔɔ bo lɛ, aaalomɔ lɛ."
Balak kɛ mlifu tswa edɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ Balaam akɛ, "Miyakpee bo kɛba koni obalomɔ mihenyɛlɔi ohã mi lɛ, jɔɔmɔ sɔŋŋ moŋ ojɔɔ amɛ shii etɛ̃ nɛɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kuu osɛɛ ni oya omaŋ. Mito miyiŋ akɛ majro bo; shi Yehowa etsi juromɔ ni majro bo lɛ naa."
Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, "Ani mikɛɛɛ obɔfoi ni otsu amɛ mi ŋɔɔ lɛ tete akɛ,
'Naa, kɛji Balak ŋɔ̃ ewe lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi tsu obɔ̃ tete ekɛ mi lɛ, minyɛŋ maje Yehowa wiemɔ sɛɛ koni mato miyiŋ mafee nɔ kpakpa loo nɔ fɔŋ ko. Nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ lɛ no nɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni mawie.'"
Balaam tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Balak akɛ, "Mi lɛ miiya mimaŋ, shi dani mashwie nɔ lɛ, mibatswa bo adafi yɛ nɔ ni Israel maŋ nɛɛ baafee omaŋ lɛ wɔsɛɛ ko he."
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam wo enaa nɔ, ni ebɔ̃i gbaa akɛɛ, "Balaam, Beor binuu lɛ, ninaa nɛ. Nɔ ni mɔ ni agble ehiŋmɛii lɛ kɛɛ nɛ:
'Mɔ ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ, ni eleɔ ŋwɛinyo lɛ yiŋtoi lɛ, ni Ofe lɛ jieɔ ninai etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ, ni ehiɛ bu shi, shi enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ:
Miina Israel, shi jeee bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ minaa lɛ, shi eyɛ shɔŋŋ. Ŋulami ko baaje yɛ Yakob, Maŋtsɛtso ko baate shi yɛ Israel, ni ebaatswia Moab hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ anii, ni ebaaye Set shwiei lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
Ebaaye Edom nɔ, ni eeeye Seir hu nɔ, eeeye ehenyɛlɔi lɛ hu nɔ ni eeeŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ be mli ni Israel yeɔ kunim lɛ.
Israel jaku baanaanaa amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ, ni eeekpãtã mɛi ni aaashwɛ yɛ maji lɛ amli lɛ ahiɛ.'"
Agbɛnɛ Balaam na Amalekbii lɛ yɛ ninaa lɛ mli. Kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ gbalɛ lɛ kɛtee amɛnɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Amalek ji majimaji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ fe fɛɛ; shi naagbee mli aahuu lɛ, ehiɛ baakpãtã kwraa."
Balaam na Kenbii lɛ hu yɛ ninaa lɛ mli, ni egba yɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Oshihilɛhe lɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe tamɔ looflɔ tsu ni mã tɛsaa nɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ Kenbii ahiɛ baakpãtã ni etsɛŋ ni Asiria aaaŋɔ̃ bo nom."
Balaam tee nɔ ni egba gbalɛ nɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ao, namɔ aaahi walaŋ, ni ena be ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaafee nii nɛɛ lɛ?
Akɛ ta lɛji aaajɛ Kipro aba ni aaabaye Asiria kɛ Eber nɔ. Shi tatsɛmɛi nɛɛ hu ahiɛ aaakpãtæ kɛya naanɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam yi mli, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋ, ni Balak hu ku esɛɛ kɛtee ejɛɛhe.
25: Be ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ Shitim, Akasia tso Jɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ, amɛhii lɛ kɛ Moab yei lɛ bɔ̃i ajwamaŋbɔɔ.
Moab yei lɛ kpeɔ Israelhii lɛ kɛyaa hei ni amɛshãa afɔlei amɛkɛhãa amɛmaŋ wɔji lɛ yɛ lɛ; ni Israelhii lɛ yayeɔ afɔleshãa niyenii lɛ eko, ni amɛjaa Moabbii lɛ awɔji lɛ hu.
Ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ amɛhe yabɔ jemawɔŋ Poer lɛ he. No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli wo la,
ni ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mɔ̃ɔmɔ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ koni agbe amɛ shwane ketekete yɛ mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ; bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa mli ni efu Israel fe nine lɛ sɛɛ afo."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛɛ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbelɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekutso lɛ mli nuu fɛɛ nuu ni etsɔ̃ ehe jemawɔŋ Peor jalɔ lɛ."

Israelbii lɛ ateŋ nuu ko tee eyakpla Midianyoo ko ni ekɛ lɛ tee ebuu lɛ mli yɛ Mose kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, be mli ni Mose kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ yeɔ nkɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ.
Be ni Osɔfo Aaron binuu Eleazar binuu Finehas na nifeemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ete shi yɛ asafo lɛ mli, ni eyakɔ akplɔ ehiɛ edɛ̃,
ni etiu Israelnyo lɛ kɛtee buu lɛ mli, ni eyadu Israelnyo lɛ kɛ Midianyoo lɛ fɛɛ akplɔ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ amɛmli kɛyaje kpo. Biɛ tsɔ̃ ni gbele hela lɛ ni miikpãtã Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Shi nakai be mli lɛ hela lɛ egbe mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ momo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Mihe awuŋa ni Osɔfo Aaron binuu Eleazar binuu Finehas ye etɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ naa, ni no hewɔ lɛ mipleneee amɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ Finehas akɛ, 'Miŋɔ mihejɔlɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mihã lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ,
ni mijɔɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ mihã lɛ kɛ eshwiei kɛmiiya naanɔ, ejaakɛ eye awuŋa yɛ mi, mihewɔ, ni ehã akɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni maŋ lɛ tɔ̃ lɛ efa amɛ.'"
Israelnyo lɛ ni agbe lɛ kɛ Midianyoo lɛ, egbɛi ji Zimri; ni etsɛ ji Salu, Simeonbii akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ eko mli onukpa ni.
Ni Midianyoo lɛ ni agbe lɛ gbɛi ji Kozbi; etsɛ gbɛi ji Zur, Midianbii awekui lɛ eko mli onukpa ni.
Yehowa fã Mose akɛ,
"Nyɛfãa ta kɛyatuaa Midianbii lɛ koni nyɛplenee amɛ,

ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛfee nyɛ efɔŋ kɛ lakamɔ ni amɛlaka nyɛ yɛ jemawɔŋ Peor lɛ jamɔ sane lɛ mli, agbɛnɛ amɛlaka nyɛ yɛ amɛnyɛmiyoo Midian onukpa ko biyoo Kozbi sane lɛ mli. Lɛji Midianyoo lɛ ni agbe lɛ yɛ gbele hela gbi lɛ nɔ yɛ Peor lɛ."
26: Gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Osɔfo Aaron binuu Eleazar akɛ,
"Nyɛkanea Israelbii asafo muu lɛ mli hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ayikulɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, no ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa yɛ Israel lɛ."
Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa yɛ Yeriko akɛ,
"Nyɛkanea maŋbii lɛ ateŋ hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii Nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa", bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ. Israelbii lɛ ni shi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ayikulɛ baa nɛ:
Ruben ni ji Yakob kromɔbi lɛ shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai ji Hanokwe kɛ Paluwe.
kɛ Hezronwe kɛ Karmiwe.
Mɛnɛɛmŋɛi ji Rubenbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛteŋ hii ni akane lɛ anaa shɛ akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Palu bi ji Eliab,

ni Eliab bihii ji Nemuel kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram. Datan kɛ Abiram nɛɛ ji hii komɛi ni maŋbii lɛ hala kɛjɛ asafo lɛ mli, ni amɛtse Mose kɛ Aaron hiɛ atūa, ni asaŋ amɛyafata Kora sɛɛbii lɛ ahe kɛte shi amɛshi Yehowa lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ gba ni emī amɛ kɛ Kora fɛɛ kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ hu, be ni la lɛ je ni eshã hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni akɛto okadi lɛ.
Shi moŋ Kora diɛŋtsɛ musuŋbihii lɛ gboiii.
Simeon akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Nemuelwe kɛ Yaminwe kɛ Yakinwe,
kɛ Zerawe kɛ Saulwe,
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Simeonbii awekui lɛ; ni amɛyikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Gad shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Zefonwe kɛ Hagiwe kɛ Shuniwe,
kɛ Ozniwe nɛ Eriwe,
kɛ Arodwe kɛ Areliwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Gadbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛyibɔ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Yuda bihii ji Er kɛ Onan; shi Er kɛ Onan gboi yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yuda shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Shelawe kɛ Perezwe.
Perezwe hiɛ Hezronwe kɛ Hamulwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Yudabii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Isakar shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Tolawe kɛ Puvawe,
kɛ Yashubwe kɛ Shimronwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Isakarbii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli bii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai etɛ̃.
Zebulon shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Seredwe kɛ Elonwe kɛ Yahleelwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Zebulonbii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Yosef shwiei lɛ akutsei ji Manase kɛ Efraim ni ji ebihii enyɔ lɛ.
Manase shwiei lɛ nɛ: Manase fɔ Makir, ni Makir hu fɔ Gilead. Shīai ni jɛ Gilead mli lɛ ji
Yezerwe kɛ Helekwe,
kɛ Asrielwe kɛ Shekemwe,
kɛ Shemidawe kɛ Heferwe.
Hefer bi ji Zelofehad, shi Zelofehad fɔɔɔ bihii fe yei sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ efɔ; ni Zelofehad biyei lɛ agbɛii ji Mahala kɛ Noa, kɛ Hogla kɛ Milka kɛ Tirza.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Manasebii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.
Efraim shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Shutelawe kɛ Bekerwe kɛ Tahanwe,
kɛ Eranwe ni jɛ Shutelawe lɛ mli lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Efraimbii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enumɔ. Yosef shwiei lɛ ashīai ji Shīai nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Benyamin shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Belawe kɛ Ashbelwe kɛ Ahiramwe,
kɛ Shefufamwe kɛ Hufamwe,
kɛ Ardwe kɛ Naamanwe ni amɛjɛ Belawe mli lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Benyaminbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Dan shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīa lɛ ji Shuhamwe,
ni emli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Asher shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Imnawe kɛ Ishwiwe kɛ Beriawe.
Beriawe kɔkrɔɔ hiɛ Heberwe kɛ Malkielwe.
Asher fɔ biyoo ni egbɛi ji Sera.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Asherbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Naftali shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shīai lɛ ji Yahzeelwe kɛ Guniwe,
kɛ Yerwe kɛ Shilemwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Naftalibii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii ni akane fɛɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ ekome kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Jaa shikpɔŋ lɛ ohã akutsei lɛ yɛ amɛmli gbɔmɛi lɛ ayikulɛ naa."
Mɛi ni yi fa lɛ, ohã amɛ shikpɔŋ agbo; ni mɛi ni yi faaa lɛ ana shikpɔŋ bibioo. Akutso fɛɛ akutso ana shikpɔŋ yɛ emlibii lɛ ayikulɛ naa.
Shi moŋ afɔ̃ oshiki ni akɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ akutsei lɛ ashikwɛ̃ɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛii anaa, shīa fɛɛ shīa baana egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Mɛi ni yi fa kɛ mɛi ni yi faaa fɛɛ lɛ, afɔ oshiki koni akɛja amɛgbɛfaŋnii lɛ ahã amɛ.
Yɛ Levi shwiei agbɛfaŋ lɛ, amɛshīai wuji ni akane lɛ amɛmli bii ji Gershonwe kɛ Kohatwe kɛ Merariwe.
Shīai bibii ni jɛ ewuji nɛɛ amli lɛ ji Libiwe kɛ Hebronwe kɛ Maheliwe kɛ Mushiwe kɛ Korawe. Kohat fɔ Amram,
mɔ ni kɛ Levi biyoo Yokebed, mɔ ni efɔ yɛ Egipt lɛ, hi shi akɛ eŋa lɛ. Amram kɛ Yokebed fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose kɛ amɛnyɛmiyoo Miriam.
Ni Aaron fɔ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Shi Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi be ni amɛkɛ la ni bɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yashã afɔle yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ.

Levibii lɛ ateŋ hii fɛɛ ni akane, ni ji mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃. Akaneee Levibii ayikulɛ nɛɛ ashiii Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛ Levibii lɛ ahãaa amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko.
No hewɔ lɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ayikulɛ nɛɛ ji nɔ ni Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar na be ni amɛkane Israelbii lɛ yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ lɛ.
Mɛi abɔ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane, be ni amɛkane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, ateŋ mɔ kome flo nɛkɛ bɛ mɛi ni akane ehee nɛɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe akɛ gboimɔ amɛaagboi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ. Mɛi ni shwɛ ji Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, kɛ Yeshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛkɛ.
27: Zelofehad biyei enumɔ ni amɛgbɛii ji Mahela kɛ Noa kɛ Hogla kɛ Milka kɛ Tirza ni amɛji Hefer nabii kɛ Gilead nanakansowai kɛ Makir nanashishsui, ni asaŋ amɛji Manase nanadadaoi kɛ Yosef hu nanakɔkrɔkɔi lɛ,
ho damɔ Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ,
"Wɔtsɛ Zelofohad gbo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; efataaa Kora kɛ esɛɛbii ni te shi amɛshi Yehowa lɛ ahe. Egbo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha hewɔ ni efɔɔɔ bihii.
Mɛɛba ni agbeɔ wɔtsɛ gbɛi yɛ etsɛmɛiawe lɛ mli? Binuu ni enaaa lɛ hewɔŋ lo? Nyɛhãa wɔ, wɔ hu, wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ wɔtsɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ!"
Mose kɛ Zelofehad biyei lɛ asane lɛ yafɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ,
ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Nɔ ni Zelofehad biyei lɛ biɔ lɛ eja. Hã amɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ amɛtsɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛ, amɛye amɛtsɛ gboshinii.
Okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nuu ko gbo ni ebɛ binuu lɛ, no lɛ ebiyoo aye egboshinii.
Kɛji ebɛ biyoo lɛ, no lɛ enyɛmimɛi hii aye egboshinii.
Kɛji ebɛ nyɛmimɛi hii hu lɛ, etsɛ nyɛmimɛi hii aye egboshinii.
Kɛji etsɛ bɛ nyɛmimɛi hii lɛ, no lɛ ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ yɛ weku mli aye egboshinii lɛ. Enɛ ji mla ni akã shi ahã Israelbii bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mifã bo lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Kwɔɔ Abarim Gɔ̃ŋ nɛɛ kɛya eyiteŋ koni okwɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa Israelbii lɛ.
Kɛji okwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ogbe naa lɛ, bo hu obaagbo tamɔ onyɛmi Aaron,

ejaakɛ nyɛku migbee nɔ yɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ. Be ni maŋ muu lɛ wie amɛshi mi, ni kulɛ sa akɛ nyɛhã amɛna mihewalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ kple lɛ, koni amɛshe mi gbeyei yɛ Meriba lɛ, nyɛfeee nakai." (Meriba nɛɛ ji nu hiŋmɛi ni tue hã Israelbii lɛ yɛ Kadesh yɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.)
Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ,
"Yehowa, bɔɔnii fɛɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ, ofai nɛ, fãa nuu hiɛnyiɛlɔ ohã maŋ lɛ,
Mɔ ni baanyɛ amɛnɔ ekwɛ, asaŋ ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛya ta kɛba bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa asafo lɛ akatsɔ̃ tamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ."
Yehowa hã Mose hetoo akɛ, "Ŋɔɔ Nun binuu Yoshua lɛ, nuu hiɛwalɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ emli lɛ koni okɛ oniji ashwie enɔ,
ni okɛ lɛ adamɔ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni otu nitsumɔ lɛ owo edɛŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ mɔ ni baaye osɛɛ;
asaŋ ni ohã lɛ hewalɛ ni oyɔɔ lɛ eko bɔ ni afee ni Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ abo lɛ toi.
Ebo Osɔfo Eleazar toi be fɛɛ be. Eya eŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ebaafɔ̃ Urim lɛ koni ekɛbi mi nii ehã lɛ yɛ mihiɛ. Lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ ayaakɛbaa mli lɛ, amɛbo Osɔfo Eleazar wiemɔ toi."
Mose fee nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ efee lɛ. Eŋɔ Yoshua ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ,
ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ, ni etu titsumɔ lɛ ewo edɛŋ akɛ mɔ ni baaye esɛɛ taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
28: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛhiɛ ahi minikeenii ni ji niyenii afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ni ajeɔ ŋma ewoɔ mi lɛ nɔ koni amɛkɛbahã mi kɛji afɔle hãmɔ be shɛ lɛ.
"Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ ahã gwaŋtɛŋbii enyɔ ni eye afiafi asaŋ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe koni akɛshã afɔle ahã mi.
Oshã gwaŋtɛŋbi kome leebi, ni oshã ekome hu gbɛkɛnaashi.
Akɛ ŋmãa kilo kome ni akɛ fɔ kpakpa ni ashi mli lita kome ekpɔtɔ afata he.
Daa gbi afɔle ni ashã ji enɛ tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ la shã be ni ayɔɔ Sinai Gɔɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ. Enɛ ji niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Dãa afɔle lita kome afata gwaŋtɛŋbi kome he, koni ofɔse dãa lɛ oshwie shi yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ okɛhã Yehowa.
Gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ oshã gwaŋtɛŋbi kome lɛ hu; ni no hu akɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle afata he tamɔ leebi nɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ koni efee afɔle ni ashãa ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa."
"Daa Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ okɛ gwaŋtɛŋi enyɔ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mãmu kiloi enyɔ ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ abashã afɔle; dãa afɔle hu afata he.
Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ nɔ afɔle nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ hu kɛ ehe dãa afɔle lɛ."
"Nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛshãa afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa. Nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii enyɔ kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashãa.
Niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ahe nɛ: Tsina nuu kome lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ,
ni gwaŋteŋbii kome lɛ mamu kilo kome. Shãa afɔlei nɛɛ eji niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Yɛ dãa ji wain litai enyɔ; ojwɛni kome he dãa ji wain lita kome kɛ fã; ni gwaŋtɛŋbi he dãa ji wain lita kome. Afi mli nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, afɔle ni eshã lɛ he mla ji enɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã eshã hefaikpamɔ afɔle akɛhã Yehowa; dani sro daa gbi afɔle kɛ ehe dãa afɔle ni sa akɛ ashã lɛ hu."
"Afi lɛŋ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ji Yehowa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ gbijurɔ ni. Aye aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kɛjɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Gbijurɔ nɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni aja Yehowa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii enyɔ kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔlei ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ahe nɛ: Tsina nuu lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ni ojwɛni kome lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ,
ni gwaŋteŋbi kome lɛ mamu kilo kome.
Akɛ too Kpakpo kome hu ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã daa gbi leebi afɔle lɛ hu.
Nyɛfea nakai daa gbi kɛyashi gbii kpawo; niyenii afɔle ni, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa. Sro no, ni sro daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ hu.
Ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa Yehowa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ."

"Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ gbijurɔyeli lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɛkɛ ŋmãaŋmɔŋ ni nyɛku baa ni nyɛkɛbaashã afɔle nyɛkɛhã Yehowa lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa. Gbi lɛ akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa;
shi nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii enyɔ kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Kooloi lɛ ahe niyenii afɔle hu ni ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ji enɛ: Tsina nuu kome he niyenii afee mamu kiloi etɛ̃; ni ojwɛni kome he niyenii afee mamu kiloi enyɔ,
ni gwaŋteŋbi kome he niyenii afee mamu kilo kome.
Akɛ too kpakpo kome hu ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã daa gbi afɔle ni kã shi lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa aFɔle lɛ hu pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛkwɛa koni kpa ko kpa ko akahi afɔlei lɛ ahe."
29: Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa Yehowa. Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi lɛ nɔ. Nyɛtɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ kpãmɔ gbi ni;
ni nyɛkɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashãa shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Kooloi nɛɛ ahe niyenii afɔle hu ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ji enɛ: Tsina nuu kome lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ni ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ;
ni gwaŋteŋbii kpawo lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ mamu kilo kome.
Akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã eshã hefaikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ.

Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã nyɔŋ hee shãa afɔle kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ hu kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ hu. Eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe dãa afɔle bɔ ni afo aŋmɛ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Niyenii afɔlei ni akɛ la shãa ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa ni.
"Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ gbi ni nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa. Nyɛhia ŋmãa, ni nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi lɛ nɔ;
shi nyɛkɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Kooloi lɛ ahe niyenii afɔle hu ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ji enɛ: Tsina nuu lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ni ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ;
ni gwaŋteŋbii kpawo lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ mamu kilo komekome.
Asaŋ no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ. Ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ hu kɛ ehe dãa afɔlei lɛ.
"Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ; shi nyɛyea gbijurɔ nyɛhãa mi gbii kpawo.
Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsinai oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ahe nɛ: Tsina nuu kome lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃; ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ,
ni gwaŋteŋ binuu kome lɛ mamu kilo kome.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle. Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔle lɛ hu.
"Gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ tsinai oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikapmɔ afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
"Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome kɛ opjwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Ni niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsinai lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikapmɔ afɔle. No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔle lɛ hu.
"Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsinai lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle. No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
"Gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii nɛɛhu kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsinai lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛɛpɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle. No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔle lɛ hu.
"Gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii kpaanyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã eshãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsina bihii lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwaŋteŋ bihii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
No sɛɛ hu akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle. Ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
"Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle lɛ.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛfãtã tsinai oblahii lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle. No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
"Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛjaa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ;
shi nyɛkɛ tsina nuu kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwaŋtɛŋ bihii kpawo ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo home ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle. No sɛɛ hu ashã daa shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
"Afɔlei ni nyɛshã nyɛkɛhã Yehowa yɛ nyɛgbii juji ni ato lɛ anɔ lɛ nɛ. Esro shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ ni nyɛshãa yɛ shiwoo naa loo suɔmɔ naa lɛ."
Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
30: Mose kɛɛ Israelbii akutsei lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, "Mlai ni Yehowa ewo nɛ:
'Kɛji mɔ ko wo Yehowa shi, aloo ekã kitã ekɛtsi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, akaku shiwoo lɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ. Nɔ ni eje enaa ni ewie lɛ ja ena efee nakai.'
'Kɛji oblayoo ni eyako gblã wo Yehowa shi, aloo ewo shi kɛtsi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ, be mli ni eyɔɔ etsɛ we,
ni etsɛ nu shi ni oblayoo lɛ ewo lɛ, kɛ nɔfeemɔ ni etsiɔ ehe naa yɛ he lɛ he, ni etsɛ lɛ eteee shi eshiii shiwoo lɛ, no lɛ oblayoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ fiɔ lɛ, ni nɔ ni etsiɔ ehe naa yɛ he lɛ hu ja eye nɔ.
Shi kɛji gbi nɔ ni oblayoo lɛ tsɛ nu oblayoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ he nɔŋŋ lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ ebɛ akɛ oblayoo lɛ aaaye eshiwoo lɛ nɔ; ni Yehowa kɛbaafa lɛ ejaakɛ etsɛ ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ.'
'Kɛji oblayoo lɛ ewo shi momo dani etee gblã, ejwɛŋ he dani ewo shi lɛ jio, esha ehe fee jio, aloo ekã kīta ekɛtsi ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ
ni ewu lɛ nu shiwoi lɛ ahe, shi gbi ni enu he lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ekɛɛɛ oblayoo lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ esa akɛ oblayoo lɛ aye eshiwoi lɛ anɔ, ni ehe naa ni etsi lɛ hu fiɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji gbi nɔ ni yoo wu lɛ na enu shwioi lɛ ahe lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ efo eshiwoo lɛ kɛ ehe naa ni etsi lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni Yehowa kɛbaafa lɛ.'
'Kɛji yoo okulafo loo yoo ni ekɛ ewu teŋ etse ewo shi aloo ekã kitã ekɛtsi ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ ja eye nɔ.'
'Shi kɛji yoo nɛɛ wo shi aloo ekã kitã kɛtsi ehe naa be mli ni eyɔɔ ewu we lɛ,
ni ewu lɛ nu he, shi ekɛɛɛ nɔ ko yɛ he, ni ekplɛ̃ nɔ lɛ, ja yoo nɛɛ ye eshiwoo lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etsi ehe naa yɛ he lɛ hu ja eye nɔ.

Shi kɛji ewu lɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ shi ni yoo lɛ wo lɛ nɔ, gbi nɔ ni enu he lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ yoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ tsi ehe naa yɛ he lɛ egbo, ejaakɛ ewu lɛ etswa efɔ̃, ni Yehowa kɛbaafa yoo lɛ.
Shi fɛɛ shi ni yoo baawo kɛ kitã fɛɛ kitã ni yoo ekã ni ekɛtsi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe naa lɛ, ewu ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ ekplɛ̃ɔ nɔ ehãa lɛ aloo etswaa efɔ̃ɔɔ.

Shi kɛji yoo lɛ wu lɛ nu eŋa lɛ shiwoo lɛ he, ni ekɛɛɛ he nɔ ko kwraa kɛyashi jɛtsɛre nɔ lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekplɛ̃ yoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etsi ehe naa yɛ he lɛ nɔ, ni esa akɛ yoo lɛ aye nɔ. Nuu lɛ ekplɛ̃ shiwoo lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ gbi ni enu he lɛ, ekɛɛɛ he nɔ ko.
Shi kɛji ete shi fee sɛɛ eshi akɛ ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ lɛji mɔ ni sɔ̃ lɛ baatere.'"
Enɛɛmɛi ji shiwoo he mlai ni Yehowa wo kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ yɛ yoo ni etee gblã ni eyɔɔ ewu we kɛ yoo ni eyako gblã ni yɔɔ etsɛ we he.
31: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Yaatɔ Israelbii ahe owele yɛ Midianbii lɛ anɔ. Oweletɔɔ Lɛ sɛɛ lɛ obaagbo."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛteŋ hii lɛ asaa amɛhe ahã tayaa, koni amɛkɛ Midianbii lɛ ayawu, ejaakɛ Yehowa baatɔ ehe owele yɛ amɛnɔ.
Israel akutso fɛɛ akutso ahã tabilɔi akpe koni amɛya ta lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso famɔ tabilɔi akpe ehã, ni ana tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni baaya ayawu ta lɛ.
Mose wo tabilɔi nɛɛ gbɛ kɛtee ta lɛ; amɛkɛ Osɔfo Eleazar ni Finehas tee; ehiɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi ni akɛbɔɔ oshe lɛ.
Israelbii kɛ Midianbii lɛ wu tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã Mose lɛ, ni amɛgbe Midian hii fɛɛ;
amɛgbe Midian majiatsɛmɛi enumɔ ni ji Evi kɛ Rekem kɛ Zur kɛ Hur kɛ Reba fɛɛ yɛ ta lɛ mi. Amɛgbe Balaam, Beor bi lɛ, hu kɛ klaŋte.
Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ̃ Midian yei kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ nom, ni amɛha Midianbii atsinai kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛhe nibii fɛɛ hu;
asaŋ amɛmãmɔ Midianbii lɛ amaji kɛ buui ni amɛmãmɔ ni amɛyɔɔ mli fɛɛ anaa la, ni amɛshã.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ ta lɛ mli nibii ni amɛha lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nomii lɛ kɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ ba,
ni amɛkɛba Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Israelbii asafo lɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faal lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ.
Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar lɛ maŋbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔi krokomɛi lɛ je kpo yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli, ni amɛyakpee tabilɔi lɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Mose mli fu tabilɔi onukpai lɛ ni jɛ ta lɛ kɛba lɛ, ni ji mɛi akpe ku kɛ mɛi oha ku anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ,
ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba nyɛhã yei nɛɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ wala mli kɛbashi benɛ?
Naa, Mɛnɛɛmɛi nɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ Balaam ŋaawoo nɔ, ni amɛhã Israelbii tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni amɛkwa lɛ yɛ Peor sane lɛ mli lɛ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ no nɔ ni gbele hela bote Yehowa asafo lɛ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛgbea gbekɛbii lɛ ateŋ nuu fɛɛ nuu, ni nyɛgbea yei lɛ ateŋ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni le nuu hu;
shi gbɛkɛbii yei fɛɛ ni leko nuu lɛ nyɛshīa amɛ nyɛhãa nyɛhe.

Agbɛnɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni egbe mɔ ko, aloo eta mɔ ko ni enyɔ gbonyo he lɛ, ehi shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ kɛyashi gbii kpawo. Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛtsuua nyɛhe, nyɛ kɛ nomii ni nyɛkɛba lɛ fɛɛ.
Asaŋ mama fɛɛ mama kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo he wolo loo abotia he tsɔi loo tso fee lɛ nyɛtsuua he."
Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Eleazar kɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ ni tee ta lɛ akɛ, "Mla ni Yehowa wo Mose nɛ:
Shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ sanyaa kɛ sumui,
no ji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yaa la mli lɛ, nyɛkɛwoa la mli koni ehe atse; shi no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ hetsuumɔ nu lɛ hu eko atsuu he. Shi nii ni eyaaa la mli lɛ, nyɛkɛ hetsuumɔ nu lɛ kɛkɛ atuua he.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛfɔa nyɛtadei lɛ ahe koni nyɛhe atse; ni no sɛɛ dani nyɛba shitoohe lɛ mli."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Bo kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ akutsei lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ, nyɛkanea ta lɛ mli nomŋɔɔnii fɛɛ ni ana kɛba lɛ, gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ aja nii lɛ mli enyɔ; akɛ fã kome ahã tabilɔi ni tee ta lɛ, koni akɛ fã kroko lɛ hu ahã maŋbii lɛ.
Ahe nibii ni yaa tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ anɔ too koni akɛhã Yehowa. Nomli lɛ ni jio, tsinai lɛ ji jio, tejii lɛ ni jio, toi lɛ ni jio, ojie ohai enumɔ fɛɛ ohai enumɔ nɔ ekome,
koni okɛhã Osɔfo Eleazar akɛ afɔle ni amɛkɛmiihã.

Fã ni yaa Israel maŋbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, nomii lɛ ni jio, tsinai lɛ ni jio, tejii lɛ ni jio, toi lɛ ni jio, ojie nyɔŋmai enumɔ fɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ ekome kome okɛhã Levibii lɛ ni amɛ amɛkwɛɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Ta lɛ mli nii ni tabilɔi lɛ ha lɛ mli nii ni shwɛ ni tabilɔi lɛ kɛba ji gwaŋtɛŋi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ,
kɛ tsinai akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ,
kɛ teji akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekome,
kɛ nomii oblayei ni leko nuu akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ.
Nɔ ni tabilɔi ni tee ta lɛ na yɛ nibii nɛɛ amli ji gwaŋtɛŋ akpei ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ,
ni ajie amɛmli gwaŋtɛŋi ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ akɛ too ni atsu akɛhã Yehowa.
Tsinai lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛna lɛ yibɔ fee akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ akɛ too akɛhã Yehowa.
Tejii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛna lɛ yibɔ akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ; ni ajie amɛmli nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekome akɛ too akɛhã Yehowa.
Ni oblayei nomii lɛ ayibɔ ni amɛna ji akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa; ni ajie amɛmli nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ akɛ too akɛhã Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ Mose ŋɔ̃ nibii lɛ anɔ toi ni aye nɛɛ ehã Osɔfo Eleazar akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ni ashã akɛha Yehowa, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ, Mose lɛ, akɛ efee lɛ.
Ta lɛ mli nii ni Mose he yɛ tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ akɛhã koni atsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ asafo lɛ nɔ lɛ fee,
toi akpei ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ; 44; kɛ tsinai akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa,
kɛ tejii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ,
kɛ oblayei nomii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa.

Nii ni ba Israel maŋbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ nɛɛ lɛ, Mose ŋɔ̃ gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ kooloi lɛ hu amli nyɔŋmai enumɔ fɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ mli ekomekome, ni akɛhã Levibii lɛ ni tsuɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni tabilɔi lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni tee ta lɛ ni kwɛɔ mɛi akpekpe kɛ mɛi ohaha akui anɔ lɛ ba Mose ŋɔ̃ɔ,
ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Ofai nɛ, wɔkane tabilɔi ni wɔhiɛ lɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa ekaaa ta lɛ mli.

No hewɔ lɛ shika tsuru nibii ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ na yɛ ta lɛ mli, shikanii ni ji naneshinii kɛ nineshi gai kɛ niianaasɔomɔnii kɛ toiiaŋnii kɛ kuɛnii, lɛ wɔkɛba wɔkɛbake Yehowa koni akɛkpãtã ahã wɔsumai yɛ Yehowa hiɛ."
Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar he shika tsuru nibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Shika nibii lɛ fɛɛ ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛba akɛ keenii lɛ feɔ shekeli akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi tabilɔi fɛɛ tabilɔ ha nii hã diɛŋtsɛ ehe hu.
Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar he shika lɛ yɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛkɛtee Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔnɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
32: Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ yɛ kooloi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ. No hewɔ lɛ be ni amɛna akɛ Yazer kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ hi hã kooloolɛɛ lɛ,
amɛbakɛɛ Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ akɛ,
"Atarot kɛ Dibon kɛ Yazer kɛ Nimra kɛ Heshbon kɛ Eleale kɛ Sebam kɛ Nebo kɛ Beon,
ni ji shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa hã Israelbii ye amɛnɔ bii kɛ anɔ kunim lɛ hi hã kooloolɛɛ, ni wɔyɛ kooloi babaoo.
Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahãa wɔ akɛ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ. Nyɛkɛ wɔ akafoa Yordan lɛ kɛmiiya esɛɛ akɛ wɔyahi jɛi."
Mose here Gad hii lɛ kɛ Rubenbii lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Aso nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aya ni amɛyawu ta be mli ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛtra shi yɛ biɛ lo?
Mɛɛba nyɛfãa Israelbii lɛ atsui koni amɛkafo Yordan lɛ ketee shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ji bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi fee be ni mitsu amɛ kɛjɛ Kadesh Barnea akɛ amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛbashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛna jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ, amɛbafã Israelbii lɛ atsui koni amɛkaya shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa mli wo la nakai gbi lɛ, ekã kitã ekɛɛ,

'Hii ni shi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiŋmɛi enaŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeko mi anɔkwa kɛwulako shi,
ja Keniznyo Yefune binuu Kaleb lɛ kɛ Nun binuu Yoshua lɛ. Amɛ lɛ amɛye mi anɔkwa kɛwula shi'
Yehowa mli fu Isrealbii lɛ, ni ehã amɛtsomlo yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛyashi yinɔbii ni gbo Yehowa nɔ toi lɛ fɛɛ gboi.
Amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ nyɛbaye nyɛtsɛmɛi hii toigbolɔi lɛ anajiaŋ, ni nyɛmiitao akɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ aba Israel nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ?
Kɛji nyɛkwa Yehowa lɛ, lɛ hu eeekwa maŋ lɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni belɛ nyɛaakpãtã Israel maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ hiɛ."
Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔmiitao akɛ wɔmãmɔ kooloi atsui kɛkɛ wɔhã wɔkooloi lɛ, ni wɔto maji hu wɔhã wɔbii abifabii lɛ.

Shi wɔ lɛ wɔsaa wɔhe kɛhã tawuu, ni wɔbaanyiɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛwu ta lɛ kɛyashi wɔkɛ amɛ aaayashɛ amɛ hu amɛshitoohe. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ wɔmiitao akɛ wɔbii lɛ ahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli.
Wɔkuŋ wɔsɛɛ kɛbaŋ wɔshīai amli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Israel akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko aaana gbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ.
