Wɔkɛ amɛ apleŋ shikpɔŋ ko he yɛ Yordan lɛ sɛɛgbɛ kɛyaa fɛɛ, ejaakɛ wɔ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ ebaje Yordan lɛ biɛgbɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ nɛɛ."
Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛaafee nɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛsaa nyɛhe yɛ Yordan hiɛ kɛyaa ta.
Nyɛteŋ tabilɔ fɛɛ tabilɔ afo Yordan Faa lɛ koni akɛ Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ ayawu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaaye ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ,
ni eeeŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ. No sɛɛ dani nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba, ni nyɛaaye bem yɛ Yehowa kɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ, ni Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Shi kɛji nyɛyeee nyɛshiwoo lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛbaana nyɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ he toigblamɔ.
Nyɛmãmɔa tsui nyɛhãa nyɛbii lɛ, ni nyɛmãmɔa kooloi atsui nyɛhãa nyɛkooloi lɛ; ni shi ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaa ewo lɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ."
Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Wɔnuŋtsɔ, bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ wɔbaafee nakai.
Wɔbii abifabii lɛ kɛ wɔŋamɛi lɛ kɛ wɔkooloi lɛ fɛɛ baahi Gilead maji lɛ amli;
shi wɔ, hii lɛ, wɔsaa wɔhe, ni wɔbaanyiɛ Yehowa sɛɛ kɛyawu ta lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Nun bi Yoshua kɛ Israel akutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ ahewɔ ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Kɛji Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaafo Yordan lɛ, ni amɛteŋ hii fɛɛ aaawa nyɛ kɛwu ta lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni nyɛaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ ahãa amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Shi kɛji amɛhii lɛ amiaaa koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ afo Yordan lɛ kɛyawu ta lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛaana yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ eko kɛkɛ nyɛhãa amɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ here Mose nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ nakai otsuji baafee.
Wɔbaamia kɛfo Yordan lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni wɔgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni wɔna yɛ biɛ nɛɛ, yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ahi shi ahã wɔ."
No hewɔ lɛ Mose kɛ shikpɔji kɛ maji ni yɔɔ Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashan maŋtsɛ Og hu shishi lɛ fɛɛ hã Gadbii lɛ kɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Yosef bi Manase shwiei akutso lɛ fã lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Gadbii lɛ saa maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe kɛwaje amɛ lɛ amli tsui lɛ. Dibon kɛ Atarot kɛ Aroer,
kɛ Artot-Shofan kɛ Yazer kɛ Yogbeha,
kɛ Bet-Nimra kɛ Bet-Haran. Amɛmãmɔ kooloi atsui hu yɛ amɛmli.
Rubenbii lɛ saa tsui ni yɔɔ maji nɛɛ amli lɛ amɛmãmɔ: Heshbon kɛ Eleale kɛ Kiriataim,
kɛ Nebo kɛ Baal-Meon, maŋ ni amɛtsake egbɛi lɛ, kɛ Shibma. Amɛwowoo maji ni amɛsaa nɛɛ fɛɛ gbɛii hei.
Manase binuu Makir shwiei lɛ fã ta kɛtee, ni amɛyatua Gilead, ni amɛshɔ̃ jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshwie Amorbii lɛ ni yɔɔ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɔɔ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eha Manase bi Makir shwiei lɛ, ni amɛhi jɛi.
Manase binuu Yair hu tee ni eyatua Amorbii akrowai komɛi, ni eshɔ̃, ni ewo jɛi akɛ, "Yair Akrowai."
Noba hu tee eyatua Kenat maŋ lɛ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ, ni eshɔ̃ fɛɛ, ni ekɛ egbɛi "Noba" lɛ wo maŋ lɛ.
33: Be ni Isrealbii lɛ shi Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, hei ni amɛtotoo shi yɛ yɛ anɛgbɛfãa lɛŋ lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ.
Mose ŋmã he fɛɛ he ni yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ ayiɔ mli yɛ lɛ, kɛ he fɛɛ he ni atoɔ shi yɛ lɛ hu gbɛi; ni nomɛi baa nɛɛ.

Israelbii lɛ fã nyɛmɔ kɛjɛ Rameses yɛ afi lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ, ni ji Hehoo gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ. Egiptbii lɛ miikwɛ Israelbii lɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni amɛfa yɛ Yehowa hewalɛ naa.
No mli lɛ Egiptbii lɛ miifufuu amɛkromɔbii fɛɛ ni Yehowa egbe lɛ agbohii lɛ. Yehowa kɛ nɛkɛ gbele nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eyɛ hewalɛ fe Egiptbii awɔji lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Rameses, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Sukot.
Amɛfã kɛjɛ Sukot ni amɛyato shi yɛ Etam yɛ shiaŋa lɛ naa.
Amɛfa yɛ Etam, ni amɛdɔ amɛyi kɛtee Pi-Hahirot ni yɔɔ Baal-Zefon bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Migdol masɛi.
Amɛshi Pi-Hahirot ni amɛfo ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ kɛyashɛ Shur Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ; ni be ni amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ lɛ amɛto shi yɛ Mara.
Be ni amɛfã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Mara lɛ amɛyanina nubui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amitsrɔbi tsei hu nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ Elim; no hewɔ lɛ amɛto shi yɛ jɛi.
Amɛfã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Elim ni amɛyato shi yɛ ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.
Ni amɛshi ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa lɛ, amɛyato shi yɛ Sin Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ;
ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Dofka.
Amɛshi Dofka kɛtee Alush;
be ni amɛjɛ Alush lɛ, amɛyawa yɛ Refidim; amɛnaaa nu amɛnu yɛ jɛi.
Kɛjɛ Refidim lɛ hei ni Israelbii lɛ totoo shi yɛ aahuu kɛyashɛ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ;
kɛkɛ lɛ Kibrot Hataawa;
kɛkɛ lɛ Hazerot;
kɛkɛ lɛ Ritma;
kɛkɛ lɛ Rimon Perez;
kɛkɛ lɛ Libna;
kɛkɛ lɛ Risa;
kɛkɛ lɛ Kehelata;
kɛkɛ lɛ Shefer Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ;
kɛkɛ lɛ Harada;
kɛkɛ lɛ Makelot;
kɛkɛ lɛ Tahat;
kɛkɛ lɛ Tera;
kɛkɛ lɛ Milka;
kɛkɛ lɛ Hashmona;
kɛkɛ lɛ Moserot;
kɛkɛ lɛ Bene Yaakan;
Kɛkɛ lɛ Hor Hagidgad;
kɛkɛ lɛ Yotbata;
kɛkɛ lɛ Abrona;
kɛkɛ lɛ Ezion Geber;
kɛkɛ lɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, no ji Kadesh;
kɛkɛ lɛ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he yɛ Edombii ashikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ naa.
Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ Osɔfo Aaron kwɔ kɛtee Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyagbo yɛ jɛi yɛ Israelbii lɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Aaron eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃, be ni egbo yɛ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Arad maŋtsɛ ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ miiba.
Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Zalmona;
ni kɛjɛ Zalmona lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Punon.
Kɛjɛ Punon lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Obot;
Kɛjɛ Punon lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Abarim ni ji maŋ amaŋfɔ̃ ni yɔɔ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Be ni amɛfã kɛjɛ Abarim lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Dibon Gad;
ni kɛjɛ Dibon Gad lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Almon Diblataim
ni kɛjɛ Almon Diblataim lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Abarim Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he yɛ Nebo Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ masɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã yɛ Abarim Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ he ni amɛyato shi yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ.
Israelbii lɛ to shi yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa, ni amɛjwere shi kɛjɛ Bet Yeshimot aahuu kɛyashi Akasia Jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
nyɛshwiea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nɔ; ni nyɛkpãtãa amɛtɛ shiui lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛmãgãi ni ashwie lɛ hu fɛɛ ahiɛ; asaŋ nyɛfitea hei ni amɛjaa amɛwɔji lɛ yɛ lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Nyɛŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ koni nyɛhia nɔ, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ nɔ mihã nyɛ koni etsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ.

Nyɛfɔa oshiki koni nyɛkɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã nyɛkutsei lɛ. Akutso ni yi fa lɛ, ena shikpɔŋ agbo; ni akutso ni yi faaa lɛ ena shikpɔŋ fioo. Bɔ ni oshiki lɛ baagbee shi ehã lɛ, nakai naa aja shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã akutso fɛɛ akutso.

Shi naa, kɛji nyɛshwieee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛjeee nyɛteŋ lɛ, no lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi ni nyɛbaashi lɛ baagba nyɛnaa tamɔ aklatii ni miitsulɔ nyɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ kɛ ŋmei yɛ nyɛŋmawuiaŋ; ni amɛbaahao nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji nyɛshwieee amɛ lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mito mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mibafee nyɛ hu."
34: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Wo Israelbii lɛ kitã ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛyashɛ Kanaan ni ji shikpɔŋ ni mijɔɔ edalɛ tso muu fɛɛ nɔ akɛ mikɛmiihã nyɛ kɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ehusei lɛ baafee ji nɛkɛ.
Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ baakã shi kɛjɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ebaanyiɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ nɔ. Nyɛwuoyigbɛ husu lɛ baajɛ ŋoo ŋshɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ naagbee gbɛ,
ni ebaadɔ eyi kɛya wuoyigbɛ Akrabim Jɔɔ lɛ mli. Kɛjɛ lɛ efo mli kɛtsɔ Zin kɛtee wuoyigbɛ aahuu kɛyashɛ Kadesh Barnea. Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ husu lɛ baadɔ eyi eŋmɛ kooyi anaigbɛ kɛtsɔ Hazar Adar kɛya Azmon.
Husu lɛ baadɔ eyi yɛ Azmon kɛyanina Egipt husu lɛ naa jɔɔ lɛ, ni enaa baaya eyatã yɛ Mediterenia ŋshɔ lɛ na.
Nyɛnaigbɛ husu lɛ ji Mediterenia ŋshɔ lɛ kɛ enaa shikpɔŋ lɛ.
"Nyɛkooyigbɛ husu lɛ nyɛbaajie kɛjɛ Mediterenia ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyamɔ Hor Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ;
ni ebaajɛ jɛi hu kɛyamɔ Hamat, koni etsa nɔ kɛya Zedad,
Kɛyashɛ Zifron; ni ebaanyiɛ nɔ koni enaa ayatã yɛ Hazar Enan. Enɛ baafee nyɛkooyigbɛ husu.
"Nyɛbaakadi nyɛbokãgbɛ husus lɛ kɛjɛ Hazar Enan kɛyamɔ Shefam;
ni husu lɛ baatsa nɔ kɛjɛ Shefam koni ekpleke shi kɛya Harbel yɛ Ain bokãgbɛ. Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ enyiɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛyanina Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ yɛ ebokãgbɛ;
etsa nɔ kɛyamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ koni enaa ayatã yɛ ŋoo ŋshɔ lɛ naa. Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe husui ni bɔle lɛ kpulu lɛ nɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ ni nyɛbaafɔ̃ oshiki kɛja nyɛhã nyɛhe lɛ nɛ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa wo he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã akutsei nɛɛhu kɛ fã lɛ.
Rubenbii akutso lɛ kɛ Gadbii akutso lɛ kɛ Manase akutso lɛ fã lɛ ena amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa momo,
yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
"Hii ni aja shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã maŋbii lɛ ji Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Nun binuu yoshua.
Shi ŋɔɔ lumɔ kome yɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso mli koni amɛwa kɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ."
Lumɛi ni aŋɔ yɛ akutsei lɛ amli lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Yudabii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ;
Simeonbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Shelumiel, Amihud bi lɛ,
ni Benyaminbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Elidad, Kison bi lɛ.
Danbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Buki, Yogli bi lɛ,
Manasebii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Haniel, Efod bi lɛ;
ni Efraimbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Kemuel, Shiftan bi lɛ,
Zebulonbii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Elizafan, Parnak bi lɛ,
Isakarbii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Paltiel, Azan bi lɛ,
ni Asherbii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Ahihud, Shelomi bi lɛ,
ni Naftalibii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Pedahel, Amihud bi lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji hii ni Yehowa fã akɛ amɛja Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã Israelbii lɛ.
35: Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ akɛ,
"Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛhala maji komɛi yɛ shikpɔji ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ anɔ amɛkɛhã Levibii lɛ koni amɛhi mli; asaŋ amɛhã Levibii lɛ shikpɔji hu yɛ maji lɛ ahe koni amɛkɛlɛ kooloo.
Maji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ Levibii lɛ ashihilɛhei; ni maji lɛ ahe shikpɔji lɛ akamɔ shi koni amɛkooloi fɛɛ ana nii aye yɛ nɔ.
Maji lɛ ahe shikpɔji ni nyɛkɛbaahã Levibii lɛ ajɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ he kɛya sɛɛgbɛ kɛyashi ninetalɔi akpe jɛkɛmɔ kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kpula kɛkpe.

No hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ ni ekɛlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi akpei enyɔ baakã shi yɛ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni nakai jekɛmɔ nɔŋŋ baakã shi yɛ ewuoyigbɛ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ anaigbɛ kɛ nakai jekɛmɔ nɔŋŋ yɛ ekooyigbɛ fɛɛ, ni maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baakã shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ. Shikpɔŋ ni baakã maŋ lɛ he ahã Levibii lɛ dalɛ nɛ.

Nyɛhãa Levibii lɛ maji ekpaa koni amɛkɛfee abobaahe maji, hei ni mɔ ko ni egbe gbɔmɔ be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa lɛ he baajo foi kɛya eyaba abo yɛ. Nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ nyɛhãa Levibii lɛ maji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ hu
koni maji fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛbaahã Levibii lɛ afee nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji.
Maji abɔ ni abaahe yɛ Israelbii akutso ko mli koni akɛhã Levibii lɛ, ebaakwɛ nakai akutso lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ dalɛ. Akutso ni eshikpɔŋ fa lɛ ehã maji babaoo, ni akutso ni eshikpɔŋ faaa lɛ ehã maji fioo."
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ,
ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,
nyɛhalaa maji nyɛkɛfea abobaa maji koni mɔ ko ni egbe mɔ ko ni jeee gbɛ eje ajo foi kɛya jɛi ni eyaba abo.
Maji nɛɛ atsɔ̃mɔ hei ni aaayaba abo yɛ kɛje mɔ ni taoɔ lá he owele etɔ dɛŋ. Akagbe gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ akɛ ja akɛ lɛ eba asafo lɛ hiɛ ni akojo lɛ dã.
Maji ni nyɛbaahala nyɛkɛfee abobaa maji lɛ ayikulɛ afee ekpaa.
Nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ hu yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛfee amɛ abobaa maji.
Nɛkɛ maji ekpaa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ abobaa maji ahã nyɛ Isrealbii lɛ kɛ gbɔi ni ebato nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni abadɔmɔ aaagbe mɔ ko be mli ni jeee gbɛ eje lɛ ajo foi kɛya jɛi ayaba abo.
"Shi kɛji mɔ ko kɛ dade tswa mɔ ko ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ tɛ ni aaanyɛ gbɔmɔ agbe, ni ekɛ tɛ lɛ tswa mɔ ko, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, tɛtswalɔ lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ tso ni aaanyɛ gbɔmɔ agbe, ni ekɛtswa mɔ ko, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Mɔ ni agbe lɛ wekunyo yɛ hegbɛ ni etɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ lá lɛ he owele. He fɛɛ he ni ekɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaakpe yɛ lɛ, egbe lɛ.
"Kɛji mɔ ko miinyɛ mɔ ko, ni no hewɔ lɛ eyawo mɔ lɛ ka, ni etsu mɔ lɛ nɔ, aloo etsi lɛ egbee shi, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo,

aloo egba mɔ lɛ ma, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, gbɔmɔ ni gba mɔ lɛ ma lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ. Mɔ ni agbe lɛ wekunyo yɛ hegbɛ ni etɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ lá lɛ he owele. He fɛɛ he ni ekɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaakpe yɛ lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ akɛ egbeɔ lɛ.
"Shi kɛji oshrã naa ni mɔ ko gbe mɔ ko be mli ni ebɛ mɔ lɛ mli esha eto, etsi lɛ egbee shi jio, efɔ̃ nɔ ko ekɛtswa mɔ lɛ jio;
aloo mɔ ko fɔ̃ tɛ be mli ni enaaa mɔ ko, shi fee sɛɛ lɛ tɛ lɛ tee eyatswa mɔ ko ni egbe lɛ be mli ni ekɛgbɔmɔ nɛɛ bɛ bei ko, eto ni ejeee ehenyɛlɔ, ni etaooo lɛ efɔŋ lɛ,
no lɛ yɛ mlai nɛɛ anaa lɛ asafo lɛ akojo mɔ ni tswa mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ lá he oweletɔlɔ lɛ teŋ.

Asafo lɛ ahere gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yiwala yɛ lá oweletɔlɔ lɛ dɛŋ koni ahã gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ ahi shi yɛ maŋ he ni ejo foi kɛtee eyaba abo yɛ lɛ mli, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu akɛ osɔfonukpa ni yɔɔ be mli ni eyaba abo lɛ aaagbo.
Shi kɛji eshɛ be ko ni gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ shi abobaa maŋ lɛ mli he ni etee eyaba abo yɛ lɛ husu nɔ
ni lá he oweletɔlɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ yakpe yɛ maŋ lɛ husu lɛ sɛɛ, ni egbe lɛ lɛ, oweletɔlɔ lɛ yeee gbɔmɔ nɛɛ lá yi sɔ̃.

Ejaakɛ kulɛ esa akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ ahi abobaa maŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni osɔfonukpa ni yɔɔ be mli ni eyabɔ abo lɛ aaagbo. No sɛɛ dani gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yɔɔ hegbɛ ni ekuɔ esɛɛ eyaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ he ni ejo foi eshi lɛ.
Mlai nɛɛ akã shi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ayinɔi fɛɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni nyɛaayahi.
"Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akɛ sane eshi lɛ akɛ egbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, adamɔ odasefoi kɛjɛ mɛi enyɔ loo nɔ nɔ kɛyaa anaa wiemɔ nɔ akɛbu lɛ gbele fɔ. Akadamɔ odasefonyo kometoo naa wiemɔ nɔ akɛbu mɔ ko gbele fɔ.
Gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni abu lɛ gbelefɔ lɛ ja agbe lɛ. Akaŋmɛ gbɛ ni ewo shika ko kwraa ekɛkpɔ̃ ehe kɛje gbele lɛ mli.
Asaŋ akahe shika ko yɛ mɔgbelɔ ni ejo foi eyaba abo yɛ abobaa maŋ lɛ dɛŋ akɛ ehekpɔ̃mɔ nii, bɔ ni afee ni ekanyɛ eku esɛɛ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ beyinɔ ni osɔfonukpa mɔ yinɔ ni eyaba abo lɛ nako agbo,
koni nyɛkabule shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ lashishwiemɔ buleɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ; ni nɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni akɛdãiɔ shikpɔŋ ni ashwie lá shi yɛ nɔ, akɛ ja mɔ ni shwie lá shi lɛ nɔŋŋ lá.
Nyɛkabulea shikpɔŋ ni mi kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, miyɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ."
36: Yosef bi Manase bi Makir bi Gilead shwiei lɛ atsɛmɛi ashīai lɛ amli onukpai lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ akutseiaŋ onukpai lɛ,
ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Yehowa fã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfɔ̃ oshiki koni nyɛkɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã Israelbii lɛ. Asaŋ efã hu akɛ nyɛkɛ wɔ yɛmi Zelofehad gbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ ahã ebiyei lɛ.

Belɛ kɛji biyei nɛɛ kɛ Israel hii ni jɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli yabote gblãshihilɛ mli lɛ, abaajie amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ni abaahã wɔ lɛ mli koni akɛfata amɛwumɛi lɛ atsɛmɛi agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ he; enɛ baahã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛji eshɛ Isrealbii a-Nyamɔ Afiyeli be lɛ abaaŋɔ nɛkɛ amɛfaŋnɔ nɛɛ afata akutsei ni amɛtee gblã yɛ mli lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ he, ni ebaaje wɔtsɛmɛi agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ mli kwraa."
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Mose wo Isrealbii lɛ kitã yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni Yosef bi Manase shwiei akutso lɛ kɛɛ lɛ eja.

Kitã ni Yehowa woɔ yɛ Zelofehad biyei lɛ ahewɔ nɛ: Zelofehad biyei lɛ yɛ hegbɛ aahuu akɛ amɛkɛ hii fɛɛ hii ni amɛsumɔɔ boteɔ gblãshihilɛ mli moŋ shi esa akɛ hii lɛ ajɛ amɛtsɛmɛi akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ eko mli,
bɔ ni afee ni Isrealbii akutso gbɛfaŋnii akaje akutso kome dɛŋ kɛmiiya akutso kroko dɛŋ; shi moŋ Israelnyo gbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ ebaafata etsɛmɛi awe gbɛfaŋnɔ ko lɛ he.

Biyoo fɛɛ biyoo ni naa Israel akutso ko mli gbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ, esa akɛ egbã etsɛ akutso lɛ mli nuu, bɔ ni afee ni Israelbii ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ ahi akutso lɛ dɛŋ be fɛɛ be,
koni gboshinii akajɛ akutso kome dɛŋ kɛmiiya akutso kroko dɛŋ; shi moŋ akutso fɛɛ akutso mli gboshinii ahi edɛŋ daa."
Zelofehad biyei lɛ ye nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose lɛ nɔ,
ni Mahela kɛ Tirza kɛ Hogla kɛ Milka kɛ Noa, ni ji Zelofehad biyei lɛ, kɛ amɛtsɛkwɛmɛi abihii saŋŋ bote gblãshihilɛ mli.
Amɛwumɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Josef bi Manase shwiei awekui lɛ amli; ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛgboshinii lɛ ka amɛtsɛ weku lɛ akutso lɛ mli.
Mlai kɛ kpɔi ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo Israelbii lɛ be mli ni amɛyɔɔ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan lɛ naa yɛ Yeroko ŋlɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.

1: Gbalɔ Obadia gbalɛ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ nɛ. Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo kɛtee majimaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni wɔnu wiemɔ ni ekɛtee lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛtea shi! Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔ kɛ Edom ayawua ta!"
Yehowa kɛɛ Edom akɛ, "Naa, mibaba ohewalɛ shi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ebuŋ bo kwraa.
Ohenɔwomɔ lɛ elaka bo. Omaŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mashi shiŋŋ yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, ni oshihilɛhe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ nɔ; ni no hewɔ ni okɛɔ ohe akɛ, 'Namɔ aaanyɛ mi shi aba?'
Kɛji oyato oshihilɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tamɔ okrɔpɔŋ tsu, ni shihilɛhe lɛ hɔ ŋulamii ateŋ tete, kɛ̃lɛ majie bo yɛ jɛi kɛyi shi.

"Kɛji julɔi ba bo juu nyɔɔŋ, loo ojotswalɔi bashwie onɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, te amɛaakpãtã onii ahiɛ tɛŋŋ? Ani julɔi lɛ ejuŋ onii bɔ pɛ ni aaashɛ amɛnaa? Kɛji wainyibii kpalɔi ni ba lɛ, ani amɛshiŋ yibii lɛ kpɛkpɛbii lo? Shi naa, bo lɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ekpãtã ohiɛ butuu.
Esau shwiei; kwɛ bɔ ni aha nyɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni afãmɔ nyɛjwetrii ni akɛtee lɛ.
Nyɛhefatalɔi lɛ elaka nyɛ; amɛshwie nyɛ kɛtee husu lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ; mɛi ni nyɛ kɛ yɔɔ gbee jurɔ lɛ hu eye nyɛnɔ kunim. Nanemɛi ni nyɛkɛye nii lɛ tsɔ̃ nyɛ tsɔne; nɔ koni anuuu shishi.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ magbla Edom toi, mibakpãtã enilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛnilee hiɛ akpãtã
Ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ Teman hii kãkãlɔi lɛ, ni Edom tabilɔi fɛɛ baanyɔnyɔi."
"Efɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ohe baafee hiɛgble, ni aaakpãtã ohiɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Odamɔ shi yɛ afã banee, gbi ni gbɔi baloo ejwetri kɛtee lɛ. Odamɔ afã ni gbɔi bote maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛfɔ̃ oshiki kɛja emlinii amɛhã amɛhe lɛ.
Kulɛ esaaa akɛ bo hu oyi awa tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ. Oyeɔ onyɛmimɛi Yudabii lɛ ayɔɔ yɛ amanehulu ni banina amɛ lɛ hewɔ; ni ebɛ akɛ ooonya yɛ amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ; ni esaaa akɛ oshwãa yɛ haomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Kulɛ esaaa akɛ aboteɔ miwebii lɛ amaŋ lɛ mli, yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ebɛ akɛ oyeɔ amɛ yɔɔ yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ni esaaa akɛ oyahaa amɛnii yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Kulɛ esaaa akɛ nyɛdamɔɔ gbɛnta ni nyɛgbegbeɔ mɛi ni joɔ foi lɛ; ni esaaa akɛ nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi hiɛkãalɔi lɛ hãa henyɛlɔi lɛ yɛ hejramɔ gbi lɛ nɔ."
"Ejaakɛ be lɛ eshɛ etã, be ni, mi, Yehowa mibakojo majimaji lɛ. Bɔ ni ofee lɛ nakai aaafee bo, Esau. Onifeemɔnii lɛ baaku sɛɛ abawula oyiteŋ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni nyɛnunuu dãi yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ aaamiimii dãa, ni amɛaadidãa, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi ni ebablako dã."
"Shi mɛi ni aaaje mli lɛ, aaayato maŋ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Eeetsɔ̃ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni Yakob shwiei lɛ anine aaashɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Yakob shwiei lɛ aaastsɔ̃ là, ni Yosef shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ là lilɛi, ni Esau shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ gbetselii, ni aaashã amɛ ni aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko yɛ Esau we lɛ. Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
"Yuda wuoyigbɛbii lɛ aaabashɔ̃ Edom Gɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ; ni mɛi ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ gɔji lɛ ashishi lɛ baashɔ̃ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ. Amɛbaaŋɔ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Samaria hu; ni Benyamin baaŋɔ Gilead.
Israelbii ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ baaŋɔ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛjɛ Foinikia kɛyahsi Zerefat; ni nomii ni jɛ Yerusalem ni akɛ amɛ etee Sarde lɛ baaŋɔ wuoyigbɛ maji lɛ.
Tabilɔi kunimyelɔi aaajɛ Yerusalem ayatua Edom, ni amɛaaye enɔ; ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ aaaye Maŋtsɛ."
Paulo ni ji Kristo Yesu gboklɛfonyo lɛ kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo ŋma yahã Filemon, wɔsuɔlɔ kɛ wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ,
kɛ wɔnyɛmiyoo Apia, kɛ Arkipo ni ji wɔnaanyo tabilɔ lɛ, kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ owe lɛ fɛɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ dɛŋ ahã nyɛ!
Midaa mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa ni mitsiɔ otã, nyɛminuu Filemon, yɛ misɔlemɔi amli,
akɛni minuɔ osuɔmɔ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni ohiɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ he lɛ;
misɔleɔ akɛ naanyobɔɔ ni atsu nii ahã ekpakpa fɛɛ ekpakpa ni yɔɔ wɔmli yɛ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ lee.
Ejaakɛ mina miishɛɛ pii kɛ ekãa yɛ osumɔ lɛ hewɔ, anyɛmi, akɛni ohã mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ atsui enyɔ amɛmli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ Kristo mli akɛ mawo o kitã yɛ nɔ ni sa hewɔ,
shi kɛ̃lɛ suɔmɔ hewɔ lɛ fai moŋ mikpaa o, mi Paulo ni miji nuumo ni amrɔ nɛɛ miji Yesu Kristo gboklɛfonyo hu lɛ.
Miikpa o fai yɛ mibi ni mifɔ yɛ Kristo mli yɛ mikpãi lɛ amli ni ji Onesimo lɛ hewɔ,
mɔ ni sã lɛ ehe eba sɛɛnamɔ ko hã o, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ehe eba sɛɛnamɔ ehã mi kɛ o fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ,
miwo lɛ gbɛ kɛmiiba oŋɔɔ, lɛ ni ji mitsui lɛ.
Kulɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekɛ mi ahi shi, koni esɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ onajiaŋ be mli ni miɔɔ kpãi amli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
Shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mafee nɔ ko ni okplɛ̃ko nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ejurɔ ni obaafee lɛ okabafee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ efee yɛ tsuijurɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ ekolɛ enɛ hewɔ agbla nyɛmli be kukuoo lɛ, koni agbɛnɛ oná lɛ ni ehi oŋɔɔ daa.
Jeee akɛ tsulɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ akɛ mɔ ni fe tsulɔ tete, suɔmɔ nyɛmi ni jra wa hã mi waa, shi bo lɛ ejra wa hã o aahuu fe nakai yɛ heloo kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ fɛɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛ oŋɔɔ mi akɛ onaanyo lɛ, heremɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni obaahere mi diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni kɛji eye o sane fɔŋ ko aloo ehiɛ o nyɔmɔ ko lɛ, buu nakai akɔŋtaa lɛ ohã mi.
Mi Paulo, miiŋma kɛ diɛŋtsɛ minine akɛ mawo; tsɛbelɛ manyɛ makɛɛ o akɛ ohiɛ mi bo diɛŋtsɛ tete oyi nyɔmɔ.
Hɛɛ, anyɛmi, hã mana ohe sɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; hã mitsui anyɔ mimli yɛ Kristo mli.
Akɛni mihiɛ yɛ kã onɔ akɛ ooobo mi toi hewɔ miŋmaa o nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ ooofee fe bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛɛ tete po.
Shi asaŋ saamɔ gbɔiatoohe ko oto mi ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛsɔlemɔi lɛ anɔ akɛ mi aaake nyɛ.
Epafra, mɔ ni ji minaanyo gboklɛfonyo yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ,
kɛ Marko kɛ Aristarko kɛ Dema kɛ Luka, mɛi ni ji minanemɛi nitsumɔi hu miibi o.
Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi! Amen.
Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Yesu Kristo tsuji lɛ; ŋma yahã mɛikrɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Yesu Kristo mli yɛ Filipi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi kɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Midaa mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi be fɛɛ be ni mikaiɔ nyɛ
yɛ midaa faikpamɔi fɛɛ ni mikpaa mihãa nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni mikɛ miishɛɛ kpaa fai,
yɛ wa ni nyɛwa yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛfaŋ kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ kɛbashi be nɛ lɛ hewɔ;
ni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ, akɛ mɔ ni bɛ̃i nitsumɔ kpakpa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeekã he kɛyashi eeegbe naa yɛ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ.
Eja akɛ mijwɛŋɔ enɛ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛkã mitsui nɔ, nyɛ ni yɛ migboklɛi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ kɛ enɔmimaa fɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛ kɛ mi fɛɛ lɛ dromɔ lɛ niyelɔi ji wɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni mikɛ Yesu kristo mlitsɔ̃lɛ lɛ shweɔ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji midasefonyo.
Ni enɛ he fai mikpaa, akɛ nyɛ suɔmɔ lɛ afa kɛya nɔ, ni eteke nɔ yɛ nilee kɛ sɛɛyoomɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ
ni nyɛyoo nii ni hi fɛɛ lɛ, koni nyɛfee krɔŋŋ ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe kɛyashi Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ;
ni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ jalɛ yibii ni awoɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, hã Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam kɛ yijiemɔ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ saji ni ba minɔ lɛ ehã Sanekpakpa lɛ eshwere moŋ.
Ni Asaŋ ehã migboklɛi lɛ eje shi faŋŋ yɛ Kaisare asraafoi amɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, akɛ Kristo hewɔ awo mi tsuŋ lɛ.
Ni nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo etsɔ̃ migboklɛ lɛ anɔ ena hewalɛ ni amɛkɛ ekãa babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ miijaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛsheee gbeyei.
Mɛi komɛi lɛ, hetsɛ̃ kɛ bei hewɔ amɛshiɛɔ Kristo lɛ; shi mɛi komɛi hu kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa shiɛɔ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi jɛɔ suɔmɔ mli shiɛɔ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ lɛ hewɔ ni mikã biɛ nɛɛ.
Shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, amɛkɛ mligblamɔ mumɔ shiɛɔ Kristo, ni jeee Krɔŋŋ ni, shi moŋ amɛjwɛŋmɔ ji akɛ amɛtee amanehulu shi amɛwo mi yɛ migboklɛi lɛ amli.
No hewɔ hewɔ lɛ mɛni? Be fɛɛ be ni fee lɛ, lakopatoo naa jio, anɔkwale naa jio, Kristo kɛ̃ ashiɛɔ lɛ, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ miyɛ miishɛɛ. Ni asaŋ mana miishɛɛ,
ejaakɛ mile akɛ enɛ baatsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ yɛ nyɛfaikpamɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo Mumɔ lɛ yelikɛbuamɔ naa.
Migbɛkwɛmɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛkɛ ji akɛ mihiɛ akagbo yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, shi moŋ, bɔ ni afeɔ daa lɛ, nakai agbɛnɛ hu akɛ ekãa fɛɛ aaawo Kristo hiɛ nyam yɛ migbɔmɔtso mli, yɛ wala mli jio, gbele mli jio.
Ejaakɛ yɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ, Kristo ji wala, ni gbele lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni.
Shi kɛji wala yɛ heloo nɛɛ mli hãa mitsuɔ nii ni woɔ yibii lɛ, mileee emli nɔ ni makɔ;
shi miihao yɛ nibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ; miishwe ni maje mli ni mikɛ Kristo ayashi shi, ejaakɛ no hi aahuu;
shi nyɛhewɔ lɛ heloo mli shihilɛ lɛ he ehīa fe no.
Ni akɛni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mile akɛ mahi shi, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaahi shi, koni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ashwere, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ yɛ mli;
koni nyɛmli ni baafli nyɛ yɛ mihewɔ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ bakpe ekoŋŋ lɛ ateke nɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.

Nɔ kome kɛkɛ ji akɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ, koni kɛ miba mibana nyɛ jio, mikɛ nyɛ bɛ jio, manu nyɛhe akɛ nyɛdamɔ shi yɛ mumɔ kome mli, ni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome miiple Sanekpakpa lɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he,
ni nyɛkahãa henyɛlɔi lɛ miiwoa nyɛhe gbeyei yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli; nyɛgbeyei ni nyɛsheŋ lɛ ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ okadi hã amɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, eji yiwalaheremɔ okadi hã nyɛ, ni enɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ adro nyɛ yɛ Kristo hewɔ, jeee ni nyɛhe enɔ nyɛye kɛkɛ, shi moŋ akɛ nyɛna nɔ hu yɛ ehewɔ.
Ni nakai ta kome lɛ ni nyɛna ni miiwui, ni agbɛnɛ nyɛnuɔ akɛ miiwu lolo lɛ, no nɔŋŋ mli nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
2: No hewɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo mli hewalɛwoo ko yɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ miishɛjemɔ ko yɛ, kɛ mumɔŋ naanyobɔɔ ko yɛ, kɛ musuŋtsɔ̃lɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ko yɛ lɛ,
nyɛhãa mimiishɛɛ lɛ ayia obɔ̃, akɛ nyɛmiijwɛŋ nɔ kome, nyɛhiɛ suɔmɔ kome, susuma kome, mumɔ kome.
Ni nyɛkafea nɔ ko kɛ mligblamɔ mumɔ loo yaka anumnyam taomɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ abua nyɛnanemɛi akɛ amɛfe nyɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aka fo enɔ mli, shi moŋ efo enanyo nɔ mli.
Nɔ ni Kristo Yesu hu jwɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ nyɛjwɛŋa.
Lɛ mɔ ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su moŋ, shi ebuuu egbɔ ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ye lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni sa akɛ ehiɛ mli kpɛŋŋ,
Moŋ ejie efɔ̃ shi. Eŋɔ tsulɔ su efɔ̃ enɔ, Etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ, ni enifeemɔ gbɛfaŋ hu ana lɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ.
Eba ehe shi ni ebo toi kɛtee gbele mli, kɛtee sɛŋmɔtso nɔ gbele mli tete.
Enɛ hewɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo enɔ gojoo, ni edro lɛ gbɛi ni ta gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi nɔ,
koni mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nakutso akula shi yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli;
ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi agba mli kpoo akɛ Yesu Kristo ji Nuŋtsɔ, kɛwo Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.

No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛboɔ toi daa nɛɛ, jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ titri lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ atsua nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he nii;
ejaakɛ sumɔ ni aaasumɔ jio, feemɔ ni aaafee jio, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛ mli bɔ ni lɛ etaoɔ.
Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ ni huhuuhu wiemɔi kɛ naataamɔ akahi mli;
koni nyɛhe akahi shwamɔ, ni nyɛfee mɛi krɔŋi, Nyɔŋmɔ bii ni he bɛ kpa ko yɛ yinɔ kɔ̃ɔdɔŋ ni bɛ eŋlɛnɔ nɛɛ mli, mɛi ateŋ ni nyɛtsoɔ tamɔ kanei yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ.
Ni nyɛhiɛ wala wiemɔ lɛ mli, koni etsɔ̃ shwãanɔ ehã mi yɛ Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ, akɛ mifoijee lɛ efeee yaka ni mideŋmegbomɔ lɛ hu efeee eflo.
Shi kɛji afɔse milã ashwie nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni akɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ afɔle lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, miyɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaana tsuijurɔ;
nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛ hu nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mi anaa tsuijurɔ.
Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ etsɛŋ ni matsu Timoteo nyɛŋɔɔ, koni kɛji minu bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni mi hu mitsui anyɔ mimli.
Ejaakɛ mibɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ mi hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni nyɛhe sane dɔɔ lɛ krɔŋŋ tamɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnii amɛpleɔ, shi jeee Kristo Yesu nii.
Shi nyɛle etɛ naa, akɛ ekɛ mi sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ he tamɔ bi kɛ etsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ mihiɛ kã enɔ, akɛ amrɔ ni mana misane lɛ naa lɛ, matsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
Shi miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu, etsɛŋ ni maba.
Kɛ̃lɛ mijwɛŋ akɛ ehīa akɛ matsu wɔnyɛmi Epafrodito, ni ji minaanyo nitsulɔ kɛ minaanyo tabilɔ lɛ nyɛbɔfo kɛ mihiamɔnii ahe sɔ̃ɔlɔ hu lɛ, nyɛŋɔɔ:
ejaakɛ eeshwe nyɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛni nyɛnu akɛ ehe miiye hewɔ lɛ eehao.
Ehe ye lɛɛlɛŋ, ni ebɛŋkɛ gbele tã, shi Nyɔŋmɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ, ni jeee lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mi hu, koni mikaye ŋkɔmɔ mito ŋkɔmɔ nɔ.
No hewɔ titri mikɛ oyaiyeli tsu lɛ lɛ, koni kɛ nyɛna lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ ni mi hu mikaye ŋkɔmɔ tuutu.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ aherea lɛ atuu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛbua gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo;
ejaakɛ Kristo nitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ gbele kwraa, ni ekɛ ehe wo oshrã mli, koni ebaye nyɛnajiaŋ kɛsɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni ehiii nyɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
3: Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli! Akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, efeee mi ahuŋtoo, ni ehãa nyɛfeɔ shweshweeshwe.
Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbei lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nitsulɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso henii flɔmɔ lɛ he!
Ejaakɛ wɔ moŋ wɔji ketiafolɔi lɛ, wɔ mɛi ni wɔjaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ mumɔ naa, ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔtso nifeemɔ nɔ lɛ,
tsɛbelɛ miyɛ nɔ ko yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ tete ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ̃ nɔ. Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ eyɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, miyɛ nɔ ni fe no.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ afo mi ketia, Israel fɔmɔbi kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli nyo ji mi, Hebrinyo krɛdɛɛ mli Hebrinyo, ni yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, Farisifonyo,
ni jamɔ he hiɛdɔɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asafo lɛ yiwalɔ ji mi, ni yɛ jalɛ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mihe bɛ shwame ko.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ nii ni ji sɛɛnamɔ hã mi sa lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ mibu amɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ.
Anɔkwale mli lɛ mibuɔ fɛɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu, mi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, he nilee ni fe nii fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ; lɛ ehewɔ ni nii fɛɛ ebɔ mi, ni mibuɔ amɛ akɛ tumɔ nɔ nii, koni mana Kristo,
ni ana mi yɛ emli, akɛ mibɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mijalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli, shi moŋ jalɛ ni tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa miyɔɔ,
ni male lɛ Kristo eshitee lɛ hewalɛ lɛ; ni mana emanehului lɛ eko, ni matamɔ lɛ yɛ egbele lɛ gbɛfaŋ;
akɛ aleeenɔ mana mashɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ he lo.
Jeee akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ momo aloo mihi kɛwula shi momo, shi miiple mihiɛ gbɛ ni minine ashɛ nɔ, gbii abɔ ni Kristo Yesu nine eshɛ mi hu minɔ lɛ.
Anyɛmimɛi, mibuuu mihe akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ, shi nɔ kome kɛkɛ mifeɔ: Nii ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ mijieɔ mihiɛ yɛ nɔ, shi nii ni yɔɔ hiɛgbɛ lɛ moŋ mikpãa mimli ni mashɛ he,
ni miitiu oti lɛ kɛyashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛmɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ he juromɔ nɔ lɛ he.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔ mɛi abɔ ni wɔdra yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ wɔjwɛŋa nakai. Ni kɛ nɔ ko yɛ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ ekroko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie no hu kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Shi nɔ ni wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ kɛbashi he ni wɔshɛ nɛɛ, wɔya nɔ wɔkɛ no nɔŋŋ aba wɔjeŋ.
Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkasea mi. Nyɛkwɛa mɛi ni nyiɛɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔtoɔ nyɛ okadi lɛ.
Mikɛɛ nyɛ shii abɔ, ni mikɛɛ nyɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ yaafonui, akɛ mɛi pii yɛ ni baa amɛjeŋ akɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ henyɛlɔi.
Amɛnaagbee ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni amɛmusu taomɔnii ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛhiɛgble mli amɛnumnyam yɔɔ, shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ.
Shi wɔ lɛ wɔmaŋ lɛ ŋwɛi eyɔɔ, he ni wɔkwɛɔ yiwalaherelɔ ni ji Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ebaatsake wɔgbɔmɔtso ni hiɛ bɛ nyam lɛ koni etamɔ enumnyam gbɔmɔtso lɛ su, yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔ ni ekɛnyɛɔ eŋɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ewoɔ eshishi hu lɛ naa lɛ.
4: No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ ni mishweɔ, mimishɛɛ kɛ mikekre, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ nakai yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ!
Mikpa Evodia fai, ni miikpa Sintika fai, akɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ afee ekome yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Hɛ̃ɛ, bo hu miibao, minaanyo sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ anɔkwaleŋ, ni oye obua yei nɛɛ; ejaakɛ amɛfata mihe kɛple Sanekpakpa lɛ he, kɛ Klɛmente hu kɛ minanemɛi nitsulɔi krokomɛi ni amɛgbɛi yɔɔ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli daa! Mikɛɛ ekoŋŋ! Nyɛmii ashɛa!
Nyɛmlijɔlɛ lɛ nyɛhãa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ alea! Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.
Nyɛkahaoa yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he, shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ shidaa atsīa nyɛtaomɔnii lɛ atã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ hejɔlɛ ni fe jwɛŋmɔi fɛɛ lɛ aaabu nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli!

Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nii abɔ ni ji anɔkwa, nii ni sa woo, nii ni ja, nii ni he tse, nii ni yɔɔ fɛo, nii ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa lɛ fɛɛ, kɛji jeŋba kpakpa ko yɛ, kɛji yijiemɔ ko hu yɛ lɛ, enɛɛmɛi ahe nyɛjwɛŋa!
Nii hu ni nyɛkase ni nyɛmɔ mli ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna yɛ mihe lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ nyɛfea, ni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Shi mina miishɛɛ babaoo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛhã mi nɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ efrɔke ekoŋŋ; nyɛjwɛŋɔ he, shi hegbɛ ni nyɛyanaaa.
Jeee akɛ fimɔ ni efi mi hewɔ miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi lɛ mikase akɛ shihilɛ fɛɛ shihilɛ ni miyɔɔ mli lɛ mimii ashɛ he.
Mile ohia mli shihilɛ, ni mile kpɔtɔɔyeli hu; mihe ehomɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ mli; tɔɔ kɛ hɔ̃nɔ, ninamɔ kɛ ohiayeli.
Minyɛɔ nii fɛɛ mifeɔ yɛ mɔ ni wajeɔ mi lɛ mli.
Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ, akɛ nyɛbaye nyɛbua mi yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi nyɛ Filipibii diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛle akɛ, Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee lɛ mli, be ni miyiŋ kɛjɛ Makedonia lɛ, asafo ko bɛ ni kɛ mi bɔɔ naanyo yɛ hãmɔ kɛ hemo gbɛfaŋ, akɛ ja nyɛ kɛkɛ;
ejaakɛ be ni miyɔɔ Tesloniaka lɛ hu nyɛtsu shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ abahã mi nii ni híaa mi lɛ.
Jeee akɛ nikeenii mitaoɔ; shi moŋ miitao yibii ni baahã nyɛkɔntaa lɛ afa.
Shi mina nii fɛɛ ni eteke nɔ; ni akɛni minine eshɛ nii ni nyɛkɛmaje Epafrodito kɛbahã mi lɛ nɔ nɛɛ, mina nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ; eji ŋmajee kpakpa kɛ afɔle kɛ ŋɔ̃ɔmɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛ nii ni hīaa nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ enifalɛ lɛ naa yɛ anumnyam mli, yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
Shi anumnyam ahã wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Nyɛŋaa hetselɔ fɛɛ hetselɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli nyɛhãa mi. Nyɛmimɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ miibi nyɛ.
Hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kaisare we lɛ, miibi nyɛ.
Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi!

1: Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon, David bi lɛ, abɛi nɛ,
Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ nilee, ni amɛhãa mɔ naa tsɔsemɔ. Amɛhãa mɔ nuɔ wiemɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ yɔɔ mli ashishi faŋŋ hu.
Amɛhãa mɔ leɔ nii, eleɔ nɔ ni ja, ni eleɔ anɔkwayeli.
Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni nako jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃ɛ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblanyo hu nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
Nilelɔ hu nuɔ, ni ekaseɔ nii efataa enilee he. Amɛhãa mɔ ni nuɔ niiashishi hu leɔ ŋaa.
Ebaanu abɛi kɛ wiemɔi ni amɛshishinumɔ wa kɛ nilelɔi awiemɔi kɛ amɛjenui ashishi.
Nilee fɛɛ shishijee ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ; shi kwashiai gbeɔ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ.
Mibi, bo otsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi, ni kaashɛ mla ni onyɛ woɔ bo lɛ ofɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ nomɛi ji anumnyam akekre ni fi oyitso kɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ ni kã okuɛ.
Mibi, kɛji eshafeelɔi miilaka bo lɛ, kaakplɛ̃.
Kɛji amɛkɛɛ bo akɛ, "Ba, wɔtee ni wɔyawo mɔ ko antɛo, ni wɔyawo mɔ ko lá ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ ko ka yakatswaa lɛ kaakplɛ̃.
Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ o akɛ hã wɔmīī amɛ hiɛkãalɔi tamɔ bɔ ni gbohiiaje mīiɔ mɛi emuu, aloo tamɔ akplekeɔ shi aboteɔ gbonyobu mli, ni akuuu sɛɛ abaaa dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ akɛ no wɔɔna nibii srɔtoi wɔwo wɔshiai amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ kaapklɛ̃.
Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ akɛ bo lɛ kɛ ohe abɔ wɔhe kɛkɛ; wɔ fɛɛ wɔɔto fotro kome, ni nɔ ni wɔɔna lɛ wɔɔja lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ kaaplɛ̃."
Mibi, okɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi akabɔ. Tsi ohe kɛje amɛhe kwraa.
Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ; amɛhe feɔ oya kɛ láshishwiemɔ.
Eji yaka nɔ kofeemɔ akɛ aaatsɔ̃ looflɔ̃ tsɔne be mli ni eekwɛ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe tsɔne amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwala antɛo.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni shɔ̃ɔ nii ekãa naa yɛ mɛi adɛŋ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛnaagbee tamɔ nɛ, nɔ ni amɛkɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ diɔ sɛɛ lɛ, no dɔŋŋ gbeɔ amɛ.
Bo toi! Nilee miiblɔ waa yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni eewoo egbee yɛ jaji anɔ.
Eblɔɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa kɛ he fɛɛ he ni mɛi ebua amɛhe naa kutuu yɛ.
Ao, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛjwɛŋmɔ naa waaa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaahiɛ nyɛkwashiafeemɔ nɛɛ mli kɛyashi? Ni mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ kwashiai hu aaanyɛ nilee kɛyashi?
Kɛji mikã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛboa toi. Naa, mafɔse mimumɔ mawo nyɛmli, ni mahã nyɛyoo minilee wiemɔi lɛ hu.
Mitsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛbooo mi toi; mikpã miniji amli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔɔɔ mli.
Miŋaawoo lɛ hu nyɛkwa fɛɛ, ni nyɛbuuu mikãmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu nyɛmanehulu mli lɛ, maŋmɔ nyɛ; ni kɛji gbeyei nɔ ko ba lɛ, maye nyɛhe fɛo.
Kɛji tsuifãa nɔ ko batua nyɛ tamɔ ahum, ni nyɛmanehulu te shi tamɔ lasuogbele; ni kɛji hejramɔ kɛ tsuiyeli ba nyɛnɔ lɛ,
no mli lɛ nyɛaatsɛ mi, shi mihereŋ nɔ; nyɛaatao misɛɛgbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛ̃kpɛ̃, shi nyɛnaŋ mi.
Akɛni amɛsumɔɔɔ nilee, ni amɛsheee Yehowa gbeyei;
asaŋ akɛni amɛsumɔɔɔ ŋaa ni miwoɔ amɛ lɛ ekoeko, ni amɛgbe mikãmɔ lɛ fɛɛ he guɔ
hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛdu lɛ, no yibii amɛaakpa, ni ŋaa ni amɛtotoo lɛ he sɛɛ amɛaana.
Mɛi ni jwɛŋmɔ naa waaa kpaleɔ kɛjeɔ nilee he kɛyaa nɔ kroko he, ni no nɔŋŋ gbeɔ amɛ; ni jwɛŋmɔ ni kwashiai jwɛŋɔ akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe lɛ, no nɔŋŋ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boɔ mi toi lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe, ehe aaajɔ lɛ, ni esheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei.
2: Mibi, mɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato.
Ba otoi shi ohã nilee, ni oto otsui shi ohã sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
Mibi, fo otsɛ̃ niiasɛɛnyoomɔ, ni odi niiashishinumɔ sɛɛ,
Taomɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ tamɔ ataoɔ jwiɛtɛi aloo jwetri ko ni akɛtee.
No dani ooonu Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ shishi, ni ooona Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee;
ejaakɛ Yehowa hãa eleɔ nii; edaaŋ nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jɛɔ.
Ehãa jalɔi leɔ nii jogbaŋŋ ni eji tsɛŋ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ.
Ebuɔ jalɔi ajalɛ saneyeli he, ni ebaa emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbɛi ayi.
No dani obaanu jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ anɔkwayeli kɛ nɔ ni ji jeŋba kpakpa shishi.
Ni obaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni nilee baahã osusuma mii ashɛ ehe.
Jwɛŋmɔ aaabaa oyi, ni niiashishinumɔ aaabu ohe.
Eeejie o kɛjɛ jeŋba fɔŋ gbɛ nɔ, kɛaajɛ mɛi ni wieɔ yaka wiemɔ adɛŋ,
kɛ mɛi ni ekwa jalɛ gbɛi ni amɛyanyiɛɔ dujiaŋ gbɛi anɔ lɛ.
Eeejie o kɛjɛ mɛi ni nyaa efɔŋfeemɔ he, ni amɛmli fliɔ amɛ yɛ nɔ fɔŋ feemɔ he lɛ adɛŋ.
Eeejie o kɛjɛ mɛi ni amɛgbɛi ekɔ̃dɔ̃ ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ adɛŋ.
Nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ; nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ yoo kɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.
Eeejie o kɛjɛ yoo ni ekwa eblayeiaŋ wu, ni ehiɛ ekpa kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ lɛ kpãŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Nɛkɛ yoo lɛ, ewe lɛ gbele gbɛ ni; egbɛi fɛɛ anaa kã kɛmiiya gbohiiaje.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa eŋɔɔ, ni eku esɛɛ eba pɛŋ, walagbɛ bɔɔ mɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kasemɔ mɛi kpakpai ajeŋba koni ojeŋba atamɔ jalɔi anɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni ja lɛ, amɛaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ ji mɛi ni aaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi yiwalɔi lɛ aaaflɔ amɛ kɛaaje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ashwie, ni kutumpɔfoi lɛ aaafamɔ amɛ kɛ amɛshishifãi kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
3: Mibi, ohiɛ akakpa mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato otsui mli,
ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ baahã owala sɛɛ atsɛ afii babaoo, ni obaashwere yɛ wala mli. 3, Kaahã mlihilɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli miishi bo; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ, ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ;
no dani ooona nyam kɛ bulɛ kpakpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ kɛ otsui fɛɛ, ni okɛ ohe akakpasa bo diɛŋtsɛ ojwɛŋmɔ;
kaimɔ lɛ yɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ amli; ni lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ ni ja ni onyiɛ nɔ.
Kaabu ohe nilelɔ; she Yehowa gbeyei, ni owi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he.
Enɛ aaafee tsamɔ ahã bo, ni eeewo owui amli hewalɛ.
Okɛ onii ni oyɔɔ kɛ onibaanii fɛɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ awo Yehowa hiɛ nyam;
no dani aaahã oboŋoi lɛ aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa, ni owain gbɛi lɛ hu aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ wain.
Mibi, kaagbe Yehowa tsɔsemɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni kaahã ekãmɔ hu miije otsine.
Bɔ ni tsɛ kãa ebi ni eyɔɔ ehe tsuijurɔ lɛ, nakai pɛ Yehowa kãa ebi ni esumɔɔ lɛ hu.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni leɔ nii, ni enaa niiashishinumɔ hu lɛ,
ejaakɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ no mli lɛ, ehi fe sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika mli.
Nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jra wa aahuu fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ akɛto nilee he.
Wala sɛɛtsɛlɛ yɛ eninejurɔ kɔkɔŋ, ni ninamɔ kɛ anumnyam yɛ ebɛku kɔkɔŋ.
Miishɛɛ yɛ etempɔŋi anɔ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ egbɛi anɔ.
Nilee lɛ wala tso ni hã mɛi ni kɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛɔ lɛ, ni mɛi ni hiɛ emli kpɛŋŋ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ.
Yehowa kɛ nilee to shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni jwɛŋmɔ ni mli kwɔ ekɛha ŋwɛi ma shi shiŋŋ.
Enilee naa hãa fai tueɔ, ni ehãa atatui lɛ nyɔɔ bɔ shwieɔ shi.
Mibi, kɛ nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ ato; kaahã ohiɛ miije nɔ kwraa,
ni eeehã ona wala kɛ hewulamɔnii.
No dani ooonyiɛ ogbɛ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe, ni otɛŋ onane.
Kɛ oho okã shi lɛ, osheŋ gbeyei; shi moŋ oookã shi, ni owɔ lɛ aaaŋɔɔ.
Kaashe kpatu nɔ ko ni baahã otsui afã, aloo bɔ ni ahum fɔŋ tswaa mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ gbeyei,
ejaakɛ Yehowa ji ohiɛnɔkãmɔ, ni lɛ eeebu ohe, ni ooofee shweshweeshwe.
Mɛi ni esa amɛ ejurɔfeemɔ lɛ, kaakãmã amɛ, kɛji eyɛ ohewalɛ mli akɛ ooonyɛ ofee lɛ.
Kɛji nɔ ko yɛ odɛŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛfee onaanyo lɛ ejurɔ lɛ, kaafee lɛ "Yaa ni oba, yaa ni oba".
Kaato onaanyo ko he ŋaa fɔŋ, be mli ni lɛ lɛ ehiɛ kã onɔ akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ omasɛi.
Okɛ mɔ ko akabe yakatswaa, kɛji efeko bo efɔŋ ko.
Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ yiwalɔ ko nɔ, ni egbɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ hu kaakɔ amɛmli ekoeko;
ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi nɔfɔŋ feelɔ, shi jalɔi lɛ eheɔ amɛ eyeɔ.
Yehowa loomɔ kã mɛi fɔ̃ɔji awe nɔ; shi jalɔi awe lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ.
Yehowa yeɔ hefɛoyelɔi ahe fɛo, shi mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ enaa amɛ mɔbɔ.
Nilelɔi ahiɛ baa nyam, shi kwashiai naa hiɛshishwiemɔ.
4: Bii, nyɛboa nyɛtsɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ toi, ni nyɛfea toi ni nyɛlea sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
Jeŋba kpakpa he ŋaa miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ; nyɛkakwaa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ.
Be ni miji gbekɛnuu yɛ mitsɛ masɛi, ni minyɛ bi koome ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe ji mi lɛ, mitsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Hã otsui amɔ miwiemɔi amli, ye mikitãi ni miwoɔ bo lɛ anɔ, ni oyi aaana wala.
Na nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ. Ohiɛ akakpa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ni kaaŋmɛɛ he hu.
Kaakwa nilee, ni eeebaa oyi; suumɔ lɛ, ni eeebu ohe.
Nilee shishijee ji ona nilee, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ona lɛ okɛtao sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛgbɛ.
Buu nilee akɛ nɔ ko ni jra wa, ni eeewo onɔ; kɛji oloo lɛ atuu lɛ, eeewo ohiɛ nyam.
Nilee aaafi bo enumnyam akekre, ni eeebu bo maŋtsɛ fai ni yɔɔ fɛo."
Mibi, bo toi, ni omɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ.
Mitsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee gbɛ lɛ; mikɛ bo etsɔ̃ jalɛ tempɔŋi anɔ.
Kɛji onyiɛ gbɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ onane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ, ni kɛji ojo foi yɛ nɔ po, otɛŋ.
Mɔ tsɔsemɔ mli waa, kaaŋmɛɛ he. Okɛto jogbaŋŋ, shi no ji owala.
Kaayi yiwalɔi agbɛ nɔ, ni mɛi fɔ̃ɔji agbɛ hu okanyiɛ nɔ.
Wii ohe kɛje gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ, kaayi nɔ; tsi ohe kɛje nɔ kwraa, ni ofo mli kɛya.
Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji wɔɔɔ akɛ ja amɛfee efɔŋ dã. Wɔ po tseɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ ja amɛna mɔ ko awui amɛye dã.
Ejaakɛ efɔŋfeelɔi aŋmãa ji yiwalɛ, ni amɛwain ji basabasafeemɔ.
Shi jalɔi agbɛ lɛ etamɔ leebi la ni kpɛɔ, ni eyaa nɔ ekpɛɔ aahuu kɛyashiɔ shwane.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji agbɛ lɛ etamɔ duŋ kabitii; amɛtrɛɔ, ni amɛnaaa nibii ni amɛtrɛɔ lɛ.
Mibi, ka otoi ohã miwiemɔi lɛ; ba otoi shi ohã nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ.
Ohiɛ akaje nɔ. Kɛto otsui mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Ejaakɛ wala eji hã mɔ ni nine shɛɔ nɔ, ni eji tsabaa hã ehewojiaŋ fɛɛ.
Ohiɛ akã otsui he fe nii fɛɛ; ejaakɛ no mli wala jɛɔ.
Wiemɔ gbonyo akaje onaa; ni kaaye kutumpɔo.
Too ohiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ohiɛ ama he ni oyaa lɛ nɔ.
Le onanefãamɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ aaaja ahã bo.
Kaagba ejurɔ loo abɛku. Tsi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he.
5: Mibi, bo minilee lɛ toi, ni oka otoi ohã miniiashishinumɔ;
koni ole sanesɛɛkɔmɔ, ni odaaŋ wiemɔi aaajie onilee kpo.
Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, enaa ŋɔɔ tamɔ wo, ni edaaŋ shamɔ̃ɔ fe eŋmɔmi.
Ni naagbee mli lɛ ejoɔ tamɔ taatso; enaaba tamɔ klaŋte kɛ enaa nta.
Enyiɛ gbele gbɛ, ni ebaakpla bo kɛya gbohiiaje.
Enyiɛɛɛ wala gbɛ, hewɔ lɛ eduɔ gbɛ ni eleee.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mibi, bo mi toi, ni kaashi miwiemɔi lɛ asɛɛ.
Tsi ohe kɛje nɛkɛ yoo he kwraa. Kaabɛŋkɛ ewe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa tete.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ obulɛ baalaje, ni yiwalɔi aaafo owala sɛɛ;
asaŋ nii ni okɛ ohewalɛ tsu lɛ gbɔi baaye amɛtrɔ; ni nibii ni ogbo daŋme yɛ amɛhe lɛ aaaya mɔpkɔŋ ko we.
Ni onaagbee mli lɛ, be ni ohewolo kɛ ogbɔmɔtso hiɛ ekpãtã lɛ obaakɛ̃mɔ.
No be mli oookɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ kwraa minyɛ tsɔsemɔ, ni mikpoo kamɔ̃ kɛjɛ mitsui mli tɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?
Mibooo mitsɔ̃ɔlɔi atoi, ni mikaaa mitoi mihãaa mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii lɛ.
Shwɛ shrao ni mihiɛ akpãtã kwraa yɛ asafo lɛ mli."
Ye oŋa anɔkwa, ni oŋɔ suɔmɔ ohã lɛ ekoome pɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbe mli nu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bii ni okɛ yei krokomɛi aaafɔ lɛ, onaŋ amɛhe sɛɛ.
Obii lɛ adra yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owe, koni amɛye amɛbua bo diɛŋtsɛ, shi jeee mɛi kpɔ̃ji.
No hewɔ lɛ na oŋa he miishɛɛ koni omii ashɛ oblahiiaŋ yoo ni oyakpee lɛ he.
Ehe fɛo tamɔ ofrote, ni ehe yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ yɔɔ; ehe akɔnɔ lɛ ashɛje omii be fɛɛ be; hã ni esuɔmɔ aŋɔ bo nom.
Shi mibi, mɛɛba yoo ni bɛ jeŋba he feɔ bo akɔnɔ, ni oloɔ yoo mɔpkɔŋ atuu?
Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ, ni eekwɛ oyaa kɛ obaa fɛɛ.
Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ enifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tamɔ tsɔne, ni eshai ni efeɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ fimɔɔ lɛ tamɔ kpãa.
Egboɔ ejaakɛ ebɛ tsɔsemɔ, ni ekwashiafeemɔ babaoo hewɔ lɛ ehiɛ kpãtãa.
6: Mibi, kɛji owo onaanyo ko shi yɛ sane ko mli, aloo okɛ mɔ ko ta abasa yɛ onaanyo ko hewɔ,
ni atsɔ̃ olilɛi nɔ adu bo, aloo atsɔ̃ odaaŋ wiemɔ nɔ amɔ bo lɛ,
mibi, feemɔ enɛ ni okɛjie ohe; ejaakɛ onaanyo lɛ nine egbe o. Yaa oya mramra ni oyakpa onaanyo lɛ fai.
Kaahã ohiŋmɛii miina wɔ miiwɔ. Kaahã wɔ miiba ohiɛsɛɛ kwraa.
Jiemɔ ohe kɛjɛ edɛŋ tamɔ soŋai jieɔ ehe yɛ gbɔbilɔ dɛŋ, aloo tamɔ looflɔ jieɔ ehe yɛ looflɔdulɔ dɛŋ lɛ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ, yaa tsatsu ŋɔɔ, jwɛŋmɔ enifeemɔi ahe ni ole nii.
Lɛ po ni ebɛ maŋtsɛ loo nɔkwɛlɔ loo nɔyelɔ ko kwraa lɛ,
etaoɔ eniyenii etoɔ yɛ latsaa be mli, ni ebuaa eŋmãa naa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli,
Hejɔ̃lɔ, mɛɛbe oookã shi owɔ kɛyashi? Mɛɛbe nɔŋŋ ooote shi kɛaajɛ owɔ mli?
Hejɔ̃lɔ kɛɔ akɛ, "Mawɔ fioo; majie mihiɛsɛɛ fioo; makota miniji majɔɔ mihe fioo."
Be ni ooohɛle shi lɛ; ohia ebatua bo tamɔ ojotswalɔ; ni fimɔ aaatua bo tamɔ tabilɔ ni hiɛ tsɛŋ.
Yakagbɔmɔ, nɔfɔŋfeelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, enyiɛɔ eyeɔ kutumpɔo.
Ebeɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi, ekɛ enaji tete wieɔ, ni ekɛ ewaabii toɔ okadi.
Etoɔ nibii fɔ̃ɔji yɛ etsui mli, eshwieɔ eyiŋ ŋaa fɔŋ daa, bei sɔŋŋ ewoɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakpãtã trukaa, ni aaakumɔ lɛ trukaa ashwie shi bɔ ni ebɛ tsabaa.
Yehowa miihi nibii kpawo:
Hewoo; amale lilɛi kɛ niji ni shwieɔ la ni efeko efɔŋ ko shi.
Tsui ni shwieɔ yiŋ fɔŋ, naji ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ amale odase, ni efoɔ sane ni bɛ mli etãa; mɔ ni woɔ nanemɛi ateŋ bei.
Mibi, ye otsɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nii ni onyɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ kaakwa ekoeko.
Ŋɔɔ kitãi lɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ oto otsui mli daa nɛɛ; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ.
Kɛji onyiɛ lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ o gbɛ; kɛji okã shi owɔ lɛ, eeebu ohe, ni kɛji ohiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, ekɛ o aaagba sane.
Ejaakɛ kitã lɛ, kane ni, ni mla lɛ, la ni, ni tsɔ̃semɔkãmɔ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ aaabaa oyi kɛje yoo fɔŋ dɛŋ, eeekpɔ̃ bo kɛje yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lilɛi dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.
Kaadi ehe fɛo sɛɛ yɛ otsui mli, ni kaahã ekɛ ehiɛsɛɛ miimɔ o.
Abaanyɛ akɛ aboloo akwaabɔ abɔ yoo ajwamaŋ apaa, shi yoo gblãfitelɔ aaahã nuu wala tete abɔ lɛ.
Aso mɔ ko aaaje la ashwie emiinaa, ni etadei eshãŋ?
Aloo mɔ ko aaanyiɛ ŋai kɛ la nɔ, ni enaji eshaŋ?
Nakai eji hã nuu ni nyiɛɔ mɔ kroko ŋa sɛɛ; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaata ehe ni eeeye ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Kɛji hɔmɔ naa kɛkɛ ni julɔ yaju lɛ agbeee ehe guɔ.
Shi kɛji amɔ lɛ lɛ, ani ahaŋ eto najiaŋ toi kpawo lo? Ekɛ ewe nii fɛɛ tswɛm hãa.
Shi nuu ni fiteɔ gblã lɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ; mɔ ni feɔ nakai lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efiteɔ.
Pilamɔ kɛ heguɔgbee eeena, ni ehiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ atsumɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ejaakɛ awuŋayeli hãa nuu mlifu naa waa, ni kɛji eetɔ owele lɛ, ekɔ̃ɔɔ efliii.
Eheŋ kpãtãmɔ nii ko, ni nyɔɔŋnii pii po ebaakwa.
7: Mibi, ye miwiemɔi anɔ, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato.
Ye mikitãi lɛ anɔ ní oyi ana wala; ni obu mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tamɔ ohiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ.
Hã ehi owaabii anaa. Ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ.
Tsɛ nilee akɛ, "Minyɛmiyoo," koni otsɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ akɛ oshieŋnyɛ.
Amɛ amɛaabaa oyi kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ, amɛaakpɔ̃ bo kɛjɛ yoo ni naa yɔɔ dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ miwe lɛ samflɛ lɛ mli mikwɛ,
ni mina oblanyo ko ni bɛ yitsoŋ, yɛ oblahii komɛi ni ajwɛŋmɔ esako komɛi ateŋ.
Oblanyo lɛ nyiɛ gbɛjeegbɛ ko ni tsɔ̃ɔ yoo nɛɛ shīa lɛ koŋ lɛ nɔ; ni eyi yoo lɛ we lɛ gbɛ.
Gbɛkɛ ni, ni hiɛ efee tuutuu, ni duŋ kpii miihe awo.
Ni naa, yoo ko kɛ oblanyo lɛ bakpe. Yoo lɛ wo ajwamaŋ atade, ni etsui esa.
Enaa wa, ni etoi egbo, ni etaaa shīa.
Bianɛbianɛ etee agbo lɛ naa; bianɛbianɛ etee jra lɛ nɔ, ni ewoɔ ka yɛ tsu koŋ fɛɛ tsu koŋ.
Yoo nɛɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni eshwɔ enaa, ni yoo lɛ mia ehiɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ,
"Kulɛ esa akɛ mashã afɔle, shi ŋmɛnɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ miyawo mishiwoonii lɛ.
No hã mije kpo koni mabɔ mɔdɛŋ matao bo ni mikɛ o akpe, ni trukaa mibana o nɛɛ.
Mikɛ saanɔboi ni akɛ kpãi sui srɔtoi ni akɛjɛ Egipt lo eha misaa lɛ nɔ.
Mikɛ mire kɛ aloɛ kɛ sinamon ewo misaa lɛ mli ŋma.
Ba ni wɔkɛ suɔmɔ ajie wɔkɔnɔ kɛyashi leebi. Wɔkɛ suɔmɔ anya kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ miwu bɛ, efã gbɛ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Ehiɛ shika pii kɛ kotoku kɛtee. Nyɔŋtsere lɛ baaye emuu dani ebaaba."
Yoo lɛ kɛ ewiemɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ kɔne oblanyo lɛ yiŋ, ni eyitsoŋ tsɔ̃. Ekɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ kpla lɛ kɛtee ewe.
Oblanyo lɛ nyiɛ yoo lɛ sɛɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ kɛtee ewe lɛ tamɔ tsina ni ayaagbe lɛ, aloo ofrote ni tsɔne edu lɛ kpɛŋŋ
kɛyashi beyinɔ ni gãimlibi tsuɔ emusuŋ nii amli. Etamɔ looflɔ ni shaa foi kɛyaduɔ tsɔne ni eleee akɛ lɛ ewala hewɔ atsɔ̃ tsɔne lɛ.
Ao, mibii, nyɛboa mi toi agbɛnɛ. Nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ.
Kaahã otsui mɔ nɛkɛ yoo. Kaadu gbɛ kɛyaje egbɛ nɔ;
ejaakɛ yoo ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi pii ahiɛ, mɛi ni egbe lɛ ayi fa naakpa.
Ewe lɛ, gbohiiaje gbɛ ni, ekã kɛmiiya gbele piai amli tɔ̃ɔ.
8: Ani jeee blɔmɔ nilee blɔɔ kɛtsɛɔ lɛ; ni jeee niiashishinumɔ hu woɔ egbee lɛ?
Edamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ayiteaŋ yɛ gbɛ lɛ he yɛ ŋmaŋmashai lɛ.
Eblɔɔ gegeege yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa yɛ maŋ lɛ klotia; yɛ shinaa lɛ shi akɛ,
"Ao, nyɛ hii, nyɛ miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ, ni nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii, nyɛ miwoɔ migbee nɔ mihãa.
Ao, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnako jwɛŋmɔ, nyɛkasea hiɛtɛ̃ɛ. Ao, nyɛ hii kwashiai hu, nyɛboa toi jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛboa toi, ejaakɛ mibawie wiemɔi wuji ni he jraa; ni minaa ni magble nɛɛ, wiemɔi ni ja sɔŋŋ aaajɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ aaajɛ midaaŋ; midaa miihi nɔ fɔŋ.
Midaaŋ wiemɔi fɛɛ lɛ, jalɛ ni, ekoeko bɛ mli ni ji amale loo kutumpɔo.
Fɛɛ kã shi faŋŋ hã mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ; ni amɛja yɛ nilelɔ hiɛ.
Nyɛmɔa mitsɔsemɔ lɛ moŋ mli fe jwiɛtɛi, kɛ nilee hu mli fe shika ŋmiiŋmi.
Ejaakɛ nilee hi fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o, ni nɔ ko bɛ ni obaatao ni kɛ lɛ ye egbɔ.
Mi, nilee, mihiɛ tɛ̃; milɛ nii, ni mibuɔ atɛŋ kpakpa.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji ohi nɔ fɔŋ. Hewoo kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ, miihi.
Minɔ ji ŋaawoo kɛ nilee kpakpa, miyɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ; miyɛ hewalɛ hu.
Minɔ maŋtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ maŋtsɛ, ni nɔyelɔi hu tsɔ̃ɔ minɔ woɔ jalɛ mla.
Minɔ lumɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ lumɔ, ni abladei yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Misumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi; ni mɛi ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ taoɔ mi lɛ, naa mi.
Ninamɔ kɛ anumnyam fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ; ninamɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ kɛ shweremɔ fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ.
Miyibii hi fe shika, efe shika ŋmiiŋmi; ni minibaanii lɛ hu hi fe jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ.
Minyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ, ni mikojoɔ jalɛ naa.
Ni mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, mifeɔ amɛ niiatsɛmɛi, ni miwoɔ amɛfotroi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Mi Yehowa bɔ kɛje enitsumɔ shishi; miji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ yɛ eblema nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ.
Kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe abɔ mi klɛŋklɛŋ dani aje jeŋbɔɔ shishi.
Be ni ŋshɔ tete po bɛ lɛ, afɔ mi momo, be ni nuhiŋmɛi bɛ lɛ, miyɛ momo.
Dani ashɔ̃ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ, afɔ mi momo.
Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ nako ebɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ jwɛii kɛ je lɛ mli mlu tete lɛ, mi lɛ, abɔ mi momo.
Be ni ebɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, miyɛ jɛi; be ni efo ŋshɔ he akrabatsa lɛ, miyɛ.
Be ni eŋɔ atatui lɛ esɛŋ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi, ní etsi ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ naa lɛ, miyɛ.
Be ni efo husu ewo ŋshɔ lɛ he, ni nu akaku ekitã lɛ nɔ, be ni eto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ,
miyɛ emasɛi akɛ ŋaawolɔ. Ni miji emiishɛjelɔ daa. Ni mimii shɛɔ mihe yɛ ehiɛ.
Minaa je lɛ he miishɛɛ, ni minaa gbɔmɛiabii ahe tsuijurɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibii nyɛboa mi toi! Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ mimlai anɔ lɛ!
Nyɛboa tsɔsemɔ toi koni nyɛle nii; ni nyɛkakwaa lɛ kwraa.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni boɔ mi toi ni ebuɔ migboi lɛ anaa daa; ní emɛɔ daa yɛ mishinai lɛ anaa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni aaaná mi lɛ, ena wala ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Shi mɔ ni nine shɛɛɛ minɔ lɛ, eeye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma awui. Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ, amɛmiisumɔ gbele."
9: Nilee ema etsu kɛ ehe tɛ akulashiŋi kpawo.
Egbe elɛɛ kooloi; efutu ewain lɛ, ni eŋmɛ ekplɔ̃ lɛ hu.
Etsu etsuji yei lɛ kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli hei grɔŋŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni amɛyatsɛ mɛi akɛ,
"Mɔ ni ejwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, ebatsɔ̃ biɛ," ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ,
"Ba ni obaye miniyenii lɛ eko, ni obanu wain ni mifutu lɛ eko.
Kaaŋɔ ohe obɔ kwashia he, koni oyi ana wala; ni dii sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛ."
Mɔ ni jajeɔ hefɛoyelɔ jeŋba lɛ, enaa jɛmɔ; ni mɔ ni kãa yiwamɔ lɛ, enaa pilamɔ.
Hɛfɛoyelɔ lɛ kɛ okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ bo; shi nilelɔ lɛ kɛji okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaasumɔ bo.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nilelɔ nii, ni eeele nii efata nɔ ni ele momo lɛ he; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ jalɔ nii, ni enilee aaafa.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee; ni Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ lee ji sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
Ejaakɛ minɔ baatsɔ̃ ni ogbii baafa; ni owala afii lɛ asɛɛ baatsɛ.
Kɛ ole nii lɛ, ole ohã ohe; shi kɛ hefɛoyelɔ ji o lɛ, bo okome obaatre.
Yoo kwashia lɛ, naawalɔ ni, ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni ehiɛgble tɔ ejwa.
Etaa shi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshinaa shi; etaa hei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli;
ni etsɛɔ mɛi ni hoɔ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛ nɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ.
Ekɛɔ akɛ, "Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, eba biɛ," ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ,
"Nu ni ayaju lɛ, enumɔŋɔɔ."
Mɛi ni ekpeɔ kɛyaa ewe lɛ leee akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yaa jɛi lɛ gboiɔ; amɛleee akɛ mɛi ni akpee kɛtee jɛi momo lɛ, gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ amɛyɔɔ lɛ.
10: Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi bi kwashia lɛ, ehãa enyɛ tsui yeɔ.
Efɔŋfeemɔ mli ninamɔ lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ; shi jalɛ hereɔ mɔ yiwala yɛ gbele dɛŋ.
Yehowa hãaa hɔmɔ aye jalɔi; shi nɔ ni efɔŋfeelɔi shweɔ akɛ amɛna lɛ, etswaa yɛ amɛdeŋ.
Mɔ ni nijiaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ohia hiaa lɛ, shi mɔ ni nine kãaa shi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ niiatsɛ.
Be ni buaa ŋmãa naa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, bi nilelɔ ni; shi bi ni wɔɔ yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, bi ni woɔ mɔ hiɛgble ni.
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni feɔ jalɛ nii, shi efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ haa amɛyitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.
Kɛ akai jalɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ; shi efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ atsiŋ egbɛi tã ajɔŋ lɛ.
Nilelɔ kplɛ̃ɔ kãmɔ; shi kwashia naafuutsɛ hiɛ kpãtãa.
Anɔkwayelɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe, shi mɔ ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, aaayoo lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, ewoɔ bei; shi mɔ ni kɛ ekãa kãa mɔ lɛ, hãa toiŋjɔlɛ baa.
Jalɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; shi efɔŋfeelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ haa yitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ teɔ bei shi; shi suɔmɔ haa tɔ̃mɔi fɛɛ anɔ.
Niiashishinulɔ daaŋ anaa nilee yɛ; shi mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ kpãa kã ekotosɛɛ.
Nilelɔ tīaa nilee, shi kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa.
Niiatsɛ nii ji emɔ̃ɔ ni wa lɛ, shi ohia kpãtãa ohiafo hiɛ.
Jalɛ nitsumɔ he nyɔmɔwoo lɛ wala ni, efɔŋfeemɔ he sɛɛnamɔ ji esha.
Mɔ ni boɔ tsɔ̃semɔ toi lɛ, enyiɛɔ gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli nɔ; shi mɔ ni kwaa kãmɔ lɛ, eduɔ gbɛ.
Mɔ ni kɛ nyɛɛ teɔ lɛ, amalelɔ ni; mɔ ni yeɔ mɔ he osheku lɛ, kwashia ji lɛ.
Wiemɔ babaoo yɔɔ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ kpaaa yɛ mli, shi mɔ ni le enaabu mli mɔmɔ lɛ, nilelɔ ni.
Jalɔ lilɛi lɛ, etamɔ jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ; shi mɔ fɔŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.
Jalɔ naabu lɛɔ mɛi babaoo, shi kwashia lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ ni ebɛ hewɔ lɛ egboɔ.
Yehowa jɔɔmɔ lɛ, no feɔ mɔ niiatsɛ; shi odeŋmegbomɔ nyɛŋ ekɛ nɔ ko afata he.
Kwashia lɛ efɔŋfeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ, shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nilee feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ,
Nɔ ni mɔ fɔŋ sheɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baaba enɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ enine aaashɛ etaomɔ nii anɔ.
Kɛ ahum tswa pɛ, mɔ fɔŋ yi etã, shi jalɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe kɛyaa naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Bɔ ni ashiŋ feɔ nyanyɔji, ni lasu feɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, nakai anihaolɔ feɔ mɛi ni tsu lɛ lɛ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ hãa wala sɛɛ tsɛɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji afii lɛ, aaafo nɔ.
Jalɔi ahiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ baafee miishɛɛ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji agbɛkwɛmɔ lɛ baafee yaka.
Yehowa ji mɔɔ ni wa hã mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, shi eji hiɛkpãtãmɔ hã efɔŋfeelɔ.
Jalɔ lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ ehiŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Jalɔi alilɛi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi kutumpɔo lilɛi lɛ, aaafo ashɛ afɔ̃.
Jalɔ naabu le nɔ ni sa wiemɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ wieɔ kutumpɔo wiemɔ.
11: Yehowa miihi shishiumɔ nsɛni, shi nsɛnitɛ shishiishi lɛ enaa he miishɛɛ.
Kɛ hewoo ba pɛ, hiɛgble nyiɛɔ esɛɛ, shi heshibalɔ lɛ nilelɔ ni.
Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ; shi kutumpɔfo lɛ eshishiumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kpãtãa ehiɛ.
Mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ninamɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko; shi jalɛ jieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele dɛŋ.
Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli hãa egbɛ jaa ehãa lɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ gbeɔ lɛ shi.
Mɛi ni ja lɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ aajie amɛ, shi kutumpɔfoi lɛ, amɛkɔnɔ ŋɔɔ amɛ nom.
Kɛ mɔ fɔŋ gbo lɛ, ehiɛnɔkãmɔ laajeɔ; ni mɔ ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeɔ yaka.
Ajieɔ jalɔi kɛjɛɔ haomɔ mli, shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji yanyɔɔ haomɔ mli.
Mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi fiteɔ amɛnanemɛi; shi atsɔ̃ɔ nilee nɔ, ni ajieɔ jalɔi.
Kɛji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tee bɔ jogbaŋŋ hã jalɔ lɛ maŋ fɛɛ nyaa; ni kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ahiɛ kpãtã lɛ, maŋ fɛɛ boɔ oshe kɛ miishɛɛ.
Jalɔi adɛŋ jɔɔmɔ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji anaabu butuɔ maŋ.
Mɔ ni gbeɔ enaanyo he guɔ lɛ, ebɛ yitsoŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ efeɔ diŋŋ.
Mɔ ni tãa sane kɛfoɔ shi lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ etsimɔɔ sane nɔ.
He ni maŋ kudɔmɔ bɛ lɛ, maŋ gbeɔ shi; shi he ni ŋaawolɔi pii yɔɔ lɛ, maŋ feɔ shweshweeshwe.
Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eeeshwa ehe; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe wooo mli lɛ ehi hã lɛ.
Yoo ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam tiuɔ woo sɛɛ, ni nuu yiwalɔ tiuɔ ninamɔ sɛɛ.
Mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ejurɔ efeɔ; shi mɔ ni yitsoŋ wa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efɔŋ efeɔ.
Mɔ fɔŋ naa shishiumɔ mli nyɔmɔwo; shi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛ nii lɛ enaa anɔkwale mli nyɔmɔwo.
Mɔ ni fiɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ jalɛ mli lɛ, eyi aaana wala; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ sɛɛ lɛ egboɔ.
Yehowa miihi mɛi ni hiɛ yitso fɔŋ; shi Yehowa sumɔɔ mɛi ni shwamɔ bɛ amɛjeŋba he.
Na ole akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ efɔŋfeelɔ yeŋ ehe, shi jalɔ lɛ aaahere eyiwala.
Yoo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni ebɛ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ etamɔ kplotoo ni awo egugɔ mli shika ga.
Jalɔi shweɔ nibii kpakpai sɔŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji agbɛkwɛmɔnii lɛ mlifu ni.
Mɔ ko yɛ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ; shi eyaa nɔ eshwereɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ kɛ̃, mɔ ko hu feɔ kpɛkpɛɛ, shi eyeɔ ohia moŋ.
Mɔ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, enaa nii, ni mɔ ni hãa mɛi trɔɔ lɛ, lɛ hu etɔɔ.
Mɔ ni tiaa able etoɔ lɛ, maŋ lomɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ maŋ jɔɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni tiuɔ nɔ kpakpa sɛɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ naa nɔ kpakpa; shi mɔ ni diɔ efɔŋ sɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ blaa lɛ.
Mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ eninamɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ baa gbiŋ ni kplaa; shi jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ baa ŋmɔŋ.
Mɔ ni gbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshiaŋbii anaa lɛ, eyeɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔ; ni buulu tsɔ̃ɔ tsulɔ hãa nilelɔ be fɛɛ be.
Jalɛ yibii lɛ wala ni; shi mla kwamɔ lɛ wala hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni.
Kɛji jalɔ lɛ enaa enyɔmɔwo yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ kɛ eshafeelɔ lɛ te amɛnyɔmɔwo aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ?
12: Mɔ ni sumɔɔ tsɔsemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ nilee; shi mɔ ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, kwashia ni.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa hiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, shi mɔ ni toɔ yiŋ fɔŋ lɛ, ebuɔ lɛ fɔ.
Efɔŋfeemɔ hãaa mɔ afi shi; shi jalɔi ashishi fã lɛ, anyɛŋ afã kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Yoo kpakpa lɛ ewu akekre ji lɛ; shi yoo ni shwieɔ ewu hiɛ shi lɛ, etamɔ wuiaŋ sasabro.
Jalɔ jwɛŋmɔ ja; shi mɔ fɔŋ ŋaawoo lɛ, kutumpɔo ni.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji woɔ lá antɛo, shi jalɔi awiemɔ hereɔ mɔ yiwala.
Abutuɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ; shi jalɔi awe maa shi shiŋŋ.
Gbɔmɔ nilee akɛjieɔ eyi, shi mɔ ni hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, abuuu lɛ.
Ohiafo humi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko.
Jalɔ nuɔ he ehãa eshīa kooloo tete; shi mɔ fɔŋ musuŋtsɔ̃lɛ tete lɛ, yiwaa ni.
Mɔ ni huɔ eŋmɔ lɛ eeetɔ kɛ ŋmãa pii; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yakanii asɛɛ lɛ ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
Mɔ fɔŋ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa; shi jalɔ shishifã maa shi shiŋŋ.
Mɔ fɔŋ diɛŋtsɛ daaŋ wiemɔ nɔŋŋ ni suɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejeɔ haomɔ mli.
Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni nɔ ni gbɔmɔ tsuɔ lɛ no he nyɔmɔ awoɔ lɛ.
Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ, egbɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ, shi nilelɔ lɛ, eboɔ ŋaawoo toi.
Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ anaa emlifu oya; shi nilelɔ lɛ ebuuu jɛmɔ tete.
Mɔ ni wieɔ anɔkwale lɛ, eyeɔ anɔkwa odase; shi amale odasefonyo lɛ mɔ elakaa.
Mɔ ko yɛ ni ewiemɔ bambam dumɔɔ mɔ tamɔ kakla; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ etsaa mɔ.
Anɔkwale wiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; shi amale lɛ, ehiɔ shi hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ.
Mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi kɛ mɔshishiumɔ; shi mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa kpakpa lɛ amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe.
Haomɔ baaa jalɔ nɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ haomɔi jwere enɔ.
Yehowa miihi amalelɔ; shi mɔ ni yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ enaa ehe miishɛɛ.
Nilelɔ kɛ enilee teɔ; shi kwashia jieɔ ekwashiafeemɔ kpo.
Mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ yeɔ onukpa; shi hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ ayeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ.
Mligbiblimɔ dɔɔ mɔ kɔmɔɔ; shi wiemɔ kpakpa yɔɔ nɛɛ ehãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe.
Jalɔ tsɔ̃ɔ enaanyo gbɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ hãa mɛi duɔ gbɛ moŋ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, enine shɛɛɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ nɔ; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ lɛ enaa nii ni jra wa.
Jalɛ lɛ wala gbɛ ni; shi gbɛ gbonyo lɛ, gbele gbɛ ni.
13: Bi nilelɔ boɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi; hefɛoyelɔ lɛ ebooo kãmɔ toi.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai; shi nɔ ni kutumpɔfoi taoɔ ji basabasafeemɔ.
Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni mɔɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eekpãtã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ shweɔ nɔ ko, ni enaaa; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ naa nii kɛtekeɔ nɔ.
Jalɔ miihi amale, shi mɔ fɔŋ feɔ hiɛgbejianii, ni ebɔɔ ehe ahora.
Jalɛ buɔ mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ he; shi eshafeemɔ butuɔ mɔ fɔŋ.
Mɔ ko yɛ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; mɔ ko hu yɛ ni feɔ ehe ohiafo, tsɛbelɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Gbɔmɔ kpɔ̃mɔ nii ji enii ni eyɔɔ; shi ohiafo bɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛkpɔ̃ɔ ehe.
Jalɔi akane tsoɔ hɛŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji akane lɛ aaagbo.
Hewoo lɛ bei kɛkɛ ekɛbaa; shi mɛ ni boɔ ŋaawoo toi lɛ, amɛleɔ nii.
Nii ni anaa oya lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa; shi nii ni akpɛteɔ shi anaa lɛ eshwereɔ.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni baaa mli mra lɛ, ewoɔ mɔ tsui hela; shi kɛji nɔ ni ashweɔ lɛ na be mli lɛ, ehãa wala.
Mɔ ni gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ, ekpãtãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kitã lɛ, ebaana he sɛɛ.
Nilelɔ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; ejieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele akpa mli.
Nilee kpakpa hãa mɔ hiɛ baa nyam; shi kutumpɔfoi agbɛ lɛ ekpãtãa amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ feɔ enii kɛ nilee; shi kwashia gbɛɔ ebuulufeemɔ eshwãa.
Tsulɔ fɔŋ lɛ ekɛ mɛi woɔ haomɔ mli; shi bɔfo anɔkwafo lɛ ekɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baa.
Mɔ ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ ohia kɛ hiɛgble ji enɔ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kãmɔ lɛ awoɔ ehiɛ nyam.
Kɛji susuma na nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ; shi kwashiai sumɔɔɔ akɛ amɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.
Mɔ ni kɛ nilelɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni kɛ kwashiai bɔɔ lɛ eeena jramɔ.
Eshafeelɔi lɛ efɔŋ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ; shi jalɔi lɛ amɛshwereɔ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa shiɔ gboshinii ehãa ebii abii; shi eshafeelɔ nii lɛ jalɔ atiaa ahãa.
Ohiafoi ashikpɔŋ ni kã shi eflo baa niyenii pii; shi jalɛ sane ni ayeee hewɔ lɛ, nii lɛŋmɛɔ amɛ.
Mɔ ni emiii ni etsɔseɔ ebi kɛ kpãa lɛ, eenyɛ ebi lɛ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔ ebi lɛ, ejeɔ mra etsɔseɔ lɛ.
Jalɔ yɛ nii pii ni eyeɔ etɔɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ musuŋ hɔmɔ po yeɔ lɛ.
14: Yoo nilelɔ kpɛɔ eshīa; shi yoo kwashia jwaa eshīa.
Mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ efeɔ jalɛnii; shi mɔ ni gbeɔ Yehowa he guɔ lɛ efeee jalɛ nii.
Buulu daaŋ wiemɔ gwaoɔ lɛ; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ baa eyi.
He ni tsina hii bɛ lɛ, niyenii bɛ jɛi; shi he ni tsina nuu hewalɔ yɔɔ lɛ jɛi ŋmãa babaoo yɔɔ.
Odasefonyo anɔkwafo maleee; shi apasa odasefonyo maleɔ pam.
Hefɛoyelɔ taoɔ nilee, shi enaaa; shi nilee taomɔ waaa hãaa niiashishinulɔ.
Jee kwashia hiɛ; ejaakɛ onaŋ nilee wiemɔ yɛ edaaŋ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ ni ehiɛ tɛ̃ lɛ, ele he ni eyaa; shi kwashiai abuulufeemɔ hãa amɛduɔ gbɛ.
Kwashia ebuuu eshafeemɔ akɛ eji nɔ fɔŋ; shi jalɔi tiuɔ eshaifaa sɛɛ.
Tsui pɛ ni le enidɔɔnii; ni nɔ ni ji emiishɛɛ lɛ ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ejaaa.
Mɔ fɔŋ we hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi jalɔ we aaashwere.
Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.
Ŋmlɔ mli tete lɛ, tsui werɛ hoɔ ehe; ni miishɛɛ naagbee lɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baa.
Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eeena ejeŋba he nyɔmɔwo; ni mɔ kpakpa lɛ, eeena enifeemɔnii kpakpa he nyɔmɔwo.
Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔɔɔ heɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ eyeɔ; shi hiɛtɛ̃lɔ leɔ enanenaa kwɛmɔ.
Nilelɔ sheɔ ehe gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; shi kwashia feɔ kakampu ni efeɔ enyagbã.
Mɔ ni mli etsɛɛɛ fumɔ lɛ, efeɔ kwashiaianii, ni yitsofɔŋtsɛ lɛ anyɛɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔɔɔ lɛ, abuɔ lɛ buulu fai; shi nilelɔ lɛ afiɔ lɛ nilee akekre.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kotoɔ mɛi kpakpai, ni efɔŋfeelɔi kotoɔ jalɔi yɛ agboi anaa.
Ohiafo lɛ, enaanyo tete sumɔɔɔ lɛ, shi niiatsɛ lɛ, esuɔlɔi faa babaoo.
Mɔ ni nyaŋeɔ enaanyo lɛ, eshafeelɔ ni; shi mɔ ni feɔ ohiafo ekpakpa lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ ani jeee tɔ̃ etɔ̃ɔ lɛ lo? Shi mɔ ni toɔŋaa kpakpa lɛ, afiɔ esɛɛ, ni ayeɔ lɛ anɔkwa.
Sɛɛnamɔ yɛ deŋmegbomɔ mli; shi ohia kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ naabu flo wiemɔ mli.
Nilelɔi akekre ji amɛnilee. Shi kwashiai akekre ji amɛbuulufeemɔ.
Anɔkwa odasefonyo lɛ ehereɔ gbɔmɛi ayiwala; shi amalelɔ lɛ mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ mli hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni mli wa yɔɔ; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ no lɛ ebii naa abobaahe.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hãa wala ni, ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbele tsɔnei amli.
Maŋbii ayifalɛ ji maŋtsɛ anumnyam; shji kɛji maŋbii bɛ lɛ, lumɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni.
Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, eyɛ niiashishinumɔ kple; shi mɔ ni mli fuɔ mramra lɛ ejieɔ ebuulufeemɔ kpo.
Toiŋjɔlɛ hãa gbɔmɔtso naa hewalɛ; shi awuŋayeli woɔ wuiaŋ hela.
Mɔ ni waa ohiafo yi lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ahora; shi mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, eewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ nɔŋŋ butuɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejalɛ ji ebobaahe.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ ele nii; shi kwashia lɛ, ebɛ niiashishinumɔ.
Jalɛ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi esha lɛ, maŋ ahorabɔɔ ni.
Tsulɔ nilelɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ hiɛ sɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ, emli fuɔ lɛ.
15: Naajɔlɛ hetoo kuɔ mlila naa; shi mlila wiemɔ teɔ mlifu shi.
Nilelɔi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi buului awiemɔi jɛɔ kwashiai adaaŋ.
Yehowa hiŋmɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he; ni ekwɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ mɛi kpakpai fɛɛ.
Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ walatso ni; shi kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ efiteɔ mɔ mumɔ.
Kwashia gbeɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ; shi mɔ ni kplɛ̃ɔ kãmɔ lɛ ehiɛ tɛ̃ɔ.
Jwetri babaoo yɛ jalɔ we, shi mɔ fɔŋ ninamɔ lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa.
Nilelɔi awiemɔ gbɛɔ nilee shwãa; shi kwashiai anɔ efeee nakai.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji afɔle lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi jalɔi asɔlemɔ lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ.
Mɔ fɔŋ jeŋba lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi mɔ ni tiuɔ jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, esumɔɔ lɛ.
Toigblamɔ kple kã shi hã mɔ ni tɔ̃ɔ ni mɔ ni ekplɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, gbo eeegbo.
Gbohiiaje kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ bu lɛ tete po naa kã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; aahuu ni gbɔmɛi adesai atsuii.
Hefɛoyelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ akãa lɛ; ni ebɛŋkɛɛɛ nilelɔi hu.
Tsui ni eyi kɛ miishɛɛ lɛ, ehãa mɔ tseɔ ehiɛ; shi tsui ni eyi kɛ awerɛho lɛ ehãa mɔ feɔ gblinii.
Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ; shi kwashiai anaabu tiuɔ buulufeemɔ sɛɛgbɛ.
Nɔnalɔ gbii fɛɛ lɛ, gbii fɔ̃ɔji sɔŋŋ ni; shi mɔ ni tsui enyɔ emli lɛ, lɛ lɛ daa nɛɛ eeye gbijurɔ.
Nii fioo ni Yehowa he gbeyeishemɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe jwetri babaoo ni haomɔ yɔɔ he.
Shwie flo ni akɛŋmɛ okplɔ̃ ni suɔmɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe tsina ni ewo fɔ ni nyɛɛ yɔɔ he.
Mlilatsɛ teɔ bei shi; shi mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, ekpãtãa bei.
Anihaolɔ gbɛ tsaa kɛ ŋmei; shi jalɔ gbɛ lɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni.
Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi kwashia gbeɔ enyɛ he guɔ.
Mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, buulufeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ebaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ.
He ni ajinatoo bɛ lɛ, yiŋtoi feɔ yaka; shi ŋaawolɔi pii hãa yiŋtoi yeɔ omanye.
Wiemɔ hetoohamɔ ni sa lɛ, ehãa mɔ naa miishɛɛ; ni wiemɔ ni awie yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ, ehi pam.
Nilelɔ gbɛ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa ŋwɛi ni; ni ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbohiiaje bu lɛ mli.
Yehowa wuleɔ hewolɔ we; shi ehãa okulafo husu hiɔ shi.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ayiŋtoi lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi wiemɔi ni he tse lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ.
Hiɛjoolɔ hãa haomɔ baa ewe nɔ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ nyɔɔŋnii hemɔ lɛ, eyi aaana wala.
Jalɔ jwɛŋɔ bɔ ni eeehã sane hetoo ehã; shi wiemɔi gbohii jɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji adaaŋ.
Yehowa kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ateŋ jekɛ; shi eboɔ jalɔi afaikpamɔ toi.
Hiɛtsemɔ kɛ mɔhamɔ lɛ, ehãa mɔ miishɛɔ ehe; ni sanekpakpa hãa mɔ wuiaŋ woɔ fɔ.
Mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ krɔŋŋ toi lɛ, ehiɔ nilelɔi ateŋ.
Mɔ ni booo tsɔsemɔ toi lɛ, egbeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe guɔ; shi mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ toi lɛ, enaa niiashishinumɔ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji tsɔsemɔ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii; ni anumnyam yɔɔ nɛɛ heshibaa nyiɛɔ ehiɛ.
16: Yiŋtoo lɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ ni; shi nɔ ni lilɛi wieɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛɔ.
Gbɔmɔ gbɛi fɛɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, ekwɛɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ.
Tuu onitsumɔi owo Yehowa dɛŋ, ni oyiŋtoi aaama shi shiŋŋ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fee lɛ, eyɛ nɔ hewɔ ni efee; gbi fɔŋ tete lɛ, ekã shi ehã mɔ fɔŋ.
Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe; kɛ ata abasa yɛ nɔ po, abaagbla etoi.
Anɔkwayeli nɔ Yehowa damɔɔ ni ekɛ eshai faa; ni mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ adesa jeŋba sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, ehãa ehenyɛlɔi tete kɛ lɛ kpãtãa.
Nii fioo ni ana yɛ anɔkwayeli mli lɛ, ehi fe nii babaoo ni atsɔ̃ gbɛfɔŋ nɔ ana.
Gbɔmɔ adesa toɔ egbɛi ahe ŋaa; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni kudɔɔ enanefãamɔi.
Ŋwɛi hewalɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ wiemɔ mli; ni maŋtsɛ naa kpaaa yɛ atɛŋbuu mli.
Nsɛni kɛ nsɛniitɛ ni yɔɔ shishiishi lɛ, Yehowa nii ni; ni kotoku lɛ mli nsɛnitɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enitsumɔnii ni.
Eji nihiinii akɛ maŋtsɛ aaafee efɔŋ; ejaakɛ jalɛ ni hãa maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i maa shi shiŋŋ.
Maŋtsɛ nyaa mɔ ni wieɔ jalɛ wiemɔ he, ni esumɔɔ mɔ ni wieɔ jalɛ wiemɔ.
Kɛji maŋtsɛ mli fu lɛ, gbele aaanyɛ ajɛ mli aba; shi nilelɔ jɔɔ maŋtsɛ tsui he.
Maŋtsɛ hiɛ ni etseɔ ehãa mɔ lɛ, no mli wala yɔɔ, ni emɔhetsuinamɔ tamɔ atatu ni nɛɔ gbo nu.
Kɛji ole nii lɛ ehi aahuu fe shika; ni kɛji oyɛ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, ehi fe jwiɛtɛi.
Jalɔi agbɛ gbaa kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; mɔ ni kwɛɔ ejeŋba jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi.
Hewoo tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; ni hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ mumɔ tsɔ̃ɔ shigbeemɔ hiɛ.
Ehi akɛ ohi shi akɛ humi yɛ ohiafoi ateŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ hewolɔi aaaja nomŋɔɔnii.
Mɔ ni yeɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ lɛ, eeeshwere; ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ.
Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ; ni wiemɔ ni ŋɔɔ lɛ, no tsakeɔ mɔ jwɛŋmɔ.
Nilee lɛ wala nubu ni hã nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ buulu nii lɛ, eefee kwashiaianii.
Nilelɔ susuɔ nii ahe dani ewieɔ, ni ehãa ewiemɔ ŋɔɔ mɔ naa.
Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ, etamɔ wo agbaku; eŋɔɔ susuma naa, ni ehãa gbɔmɔtso heewalɛ.
Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.
Nitsulɔ lɛ, nii ni baa etsine lɛ, no hãa etsuɔ nii waa, ni no nɔŋŋ woɔ lɛ ekãa.
Yakagbɔmɔ toɔ efɔŋfēemɔ he ŋaa fɔŋ, ni edaaŋ wiemɔ shãa mɔ tamɔ la.
Kutumpɔfo gbɛɔ bei eshwãa, ni oshekuyelɔ tserɛɔ nanemɛi ateŋ.
Basabasafeelɔ lakaa ehe gbɔmɔ, ni ekplaa lɛ kɛyaa gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ.
Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, etoɔ yiŋ fɔŋ; ni mɔ ni kɔ̃ɔ enaa ablafa lɛ, ehãa efɔŋ baa mli.
Waŋ lɛ, anumnyam akekre ni; jalɛ shihilɛ mli pɛ anaa yɛ.
Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ ehu fe kãkãlɔ; ni mɔ ji yeɔ emumɔ nɔ lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni yeɔ maŋ nɔ kunim.
Afɔ̃ɔ oshiki kɛtaoɔ nii anaa; shi bɔ ni eeetamɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ
17: Atrɔma gbiŋ ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe niyenii kpɔtɔɔ ni yɔɔ shīa ni bei yɔɔ mli lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋ ni le nii lɛ, eeeye bi ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ nɔ; ni eeena gboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ musuŋbi lɛ.
Akɛ kukwɛi kaa jwiɛtɛi akwɛɔ, ni akɛ flɔnɔɔ kaa shika; shi gbɔmɔ tsui lɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni kaa ekwɛɔ.
Efɔŋfeelɔi boɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji awiemɔ toi, ni amalelɔ kaa etoi ehãa wiemɔi ni fiteɔ mɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo he fɛo lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni bɔ ohiafo lɛ ahora; ni mɔ ni naa miishɛɛ yɛ mɔ ko amanehulu he lɛ, eyeŋ ehe.
Hiimeji akekre ji amɛnabii; ni bii ahiɛnyam ji amɛtsɛmɛi.
Wiemɔ ni bɛ hiŋmɛi nɔ esaaa kwashia po, aahuu ni apasa wiemɔ aaasa ablade.
Nyɔɔŋnihamɔ yɛ mɔ ni hãa lɛ hiɛ lɛ, etamɔ ashwã awuja; ni he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, efeɔ lɛ akɛ ebaashwere.
Mɔ ni kɛ tɔ̃mɔ faa lɛ, lɛ ehãa naanyobɔɔ mli waa; shi mɔ ni niɔ sane he lɛ, efiteɔ shieŋtsɛmɛi ateŋ.
Mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enuɔ kãmɔ he fe kwashia ni amamɔ lɛ atswrɛi oha.
Gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ atuatsemɔ pɛ amɛtaoɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ tsulɔ ni yitsoŋ wa atsuɔ kɛyaninaa amɛ.
Ehi akɛ gbɔmɔ kɛ oshishibrishi yoo ni amɔ ebi akpe, fe nɔ ni ekɛ kwashia moŋ aaakpe yɛ ebuulufeemɔ mli.
Mɔ ni kɛ efɔŋ toɔ ekpakpa najiaŋ lɛ, efɔŋ kpaŋ yɛ ewe.
Beibɔ̃imɔ lɛ etamɔ nu ni miitsere kɔikɔi; no hewɔ lɛ, be ni naataamɔ mli wako nɛɛ lɛ, ŋmɛɛmɔ he.
Mɔ ni buɔ efɔŋfeelɔ bem, kɛ mɔ ni buɔ jalɔ fɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ kwashia baana, kɛji ekɛ shika yahe nilee; ejaakɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ.
Naanyo sumɔɔ mɔ be fɛɛ be; ni nyɛmi hu fimɔ be hewɔ ni afɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛ yitsoŋ lɛ, lɛ ekplɛ̃ɔ nɔ akɛ eeedamɔ enaanyo sɛɛ.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eshafeemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ bei; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ pupuupu lɛ, ejieɔ amane.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, ehiŋ haŋ lɛ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ kutumpɔo lɛ egbeɔ haomɔ mli.
Bi kwashia lɛ eji awerɛho kɛhã etsɛ, ni tsɛ ni efɔ bi kwashia lɛ enaaa miishɛɛ ko.
Tsuijurɔ lɛ tsofã kpakpa ni; shi ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ egbeɔ mɔ blɛoo.
Efɔŋfeelɔ heɔ nyɔɔŋnii koni etsɔ̃ jalɛ hiɛ ebu shi.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ, shi kwashia woɔ ehiɛ emaa he fɛɛ he.
Bi kwashia lɛ etsɛ awerɛho ji lɛ; ni eji tsuiyeli hã enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ.
Ehiii akɛ agbla jalɔ toi aloo ayi ablade yɛ jalɛ sane hewɔ.
Mɔ ni wiemɔ faaa lɛ ele nii, ni mɔ ni mumɔ he jɔ lɛ, enuɔ niiashishi.
Kwashia tete ni feɔ dioo lɛ, abuɔ lɛ nilelɔ; ni kɛji emua enaa lɛ abuɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ.
18: Mɔ ni tseɔ ehe kɛjeɔ mɛi ahe lɛ, lɛ pɛ enɔ mli efoɔ; ni jalɛ sane ko bɛ ni abaawie ni ebaaŋɔ nɔ.
Kwashia naaa mɛi ashishinumɔ he miishɛɛ, fe akɛ eeewie nɔ ni etsui kɛɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Be ni efɔŋfeemɔ baa lɛ, heguɔgbee hu miiba.
Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ nubu ni mli kwɔ ni; nilee hu tamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni tueɔ.
Ehiii akɛ akwɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hiɛ ni abu lɛ bem, aloo atsɔ̃ jalɔ sane hiɛ abu shi.
Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ bei; ni ewiemɔ hãa ayiɔ lɛ.
Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ kpãtãa ehiɛ, ni ewiemɔ nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tamɔ tsɔne.
Ablɛbiwielɔ wiemɔ ŋɔɔ tamɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔnii; ekplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbɔmɔ musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mɔ ni kɛ enitsumɔ shashaoɔ shi lɛ, nifitelɔ nyɛmi ni.
Mɔɔ ni wa ji Yehowa gbɛi lɛ, ni no mli jalɔ shaa foi kɛyaa, ni ehiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.
Niiatsɛ nii ni eyɔɔ lɛ ji emɔɔ ni wa; ni etamɔ gbogbo grɔŋŋ ni buɔ ehe?
Henɔwomɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; shi heshibaa tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛnyam hiɛ.
Bo sane toi jogbaŋŋ dani ohã hetoo, kɛjee nakai lɛ, obaafee kwashia kɛ buulu.
Gbɔmɔ mli ekãa hãa enyɛɔ hela naa edamɔɔ; shi mumɔ ni egbɔlɔ lɛ, mɛni no aaanyɛ etsu?
Jwɛŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã shi naa nilee; ni nilelɔ toi tiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ.
Gbɔmɔ dɛŋ nikee jeɔ gbɛ hãa lɛ; ni ekɛ lɛ yaa mɛi wuji ahiɛ.
Mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni jajeɔ esane lɛ, efeɔ tamɔ nɔ ni lɛ esane ja; shi kɛ mɔ ni ekɛna lɛ ba ni ebabɔi lɛ sanebimɔ lɛ, no dani akpaa lɛ shi.
Oshikifɔ̃ɔ hãa bei sɛɛ foɔ, ni ebuɔ atɛŋ ahãa kãkãlɔi ni pleɔ nɔ ko he.
Kɛ ofee onyɛmi ekpakpa lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ maŋ ni wa ahãa bo; shi kɛji okɛ lɛ be lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ agbo sɛɛ adabãŋ ehãa bo.
Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ yibii hãa lɛ; ni edaaŋ wiemɔ hãa etɔɔ.
Gbele kɛ wala yɛ gbɔmɔ lilɛi dɛŋ; amɛteŋ nɔ ni gbɔmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ no eŋɔɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni naa ŋa lɛ, ena nɔ kpakpa, ni ehiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ohiafo lɛ fai ekpaa kɛ naajɔlɛ; shi niiatsɛ lɛ ewieɔ kpɛŋkpɛŋ.
Nanemɛi komɛi yɛ nu amɛfeɔ amɛnii oookɛɛ nanemɛi ji amɛ, shi naanyo krɔŋŋ lɛ ekpɛtɛɔ mɔ gbãbãlii fe nyɛmi tete.
19: Ohiafo anɔkwafo lɛ, ehi fe kwashia kutumpɔfo.
Shwe ni ashweɔ nɔ ko ni nilee bɛ mli lɛ ehiii, ni mɔ ni nyiɛɔ kplakpla lɛ eduɔ gbɛ.
Gbɔmɔ buulufeemɔ kɛ lɛ woɔ haomɔ mli, ni eshwaa Yehowa moŋ.
Ninamɔ hãa anaa nanemɛi pii; shi ohiafo lɛ enaanyo tete tsiɔ ehe yɛ ehe.
Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ he ejeŋ sane mli.
Mɛi pii taoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛɔ mlijɔlɔ dɛŋ; ni mɔ ni dɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naanyo ni.
Ohiafo nyɛmimɛi tete nyɛɔ lɛ; enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni enanemɛi tsiŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ? Enyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛ wiemɔ, shi amɛfooo mli.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ nilee lɛ, esumɔɔ ehe; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ eshwereɔ.
Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ hiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ninamɔ kpɔtɔɔ esaaa kwashia, aahuu ni nyɔŋ aaaye lumɛi anɔ.
Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ mlifūuu mra; ni ehiɛ ni ekuɔ efɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ nɔ lɛ woɔ ehiɛ nyam.
Maŋtsɛ mlifu tamɔ jata huumɔ; shi kɛ ena mɔ he tsui lɛ, etamɔ bɔ ni jwere jwɛi nɔ.
Bi kwashia lɛ ekpãtãa etsɛ hiɛ; ni yoo beilɔ lɛ etamɔ tsu yiteŋ nu ni tsereɔ kɔikɔi eshwieɔ shi.
Shia kɛ nii lɛ, fɔlɔi ni gboɔ shiɔ hãa mɔ; shi yoo nilelɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.
Anihaofeemɔ hãa wɔ ni tsii nyɔɔ mɔ nɔ; ni hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni kwaa wiemɔ lɛ, eeegbo.
Mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, ekɛ miifa Yehowa, ni ejurɔ ni efee lɛ, Yehowa aaato lɛ najiaŋ kɛteke nɔ.
Tsɔsemɔ obi egbekɛbiiashi be ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɔɔ lɛ; shi ekaba oyiŋ akɛ oookpãtã ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni mlifu naa wa lɛ, enaa he nyɔmɔwoo; kɛji ojie lɛ kɛje haomɔ kome mli lɛ, ebaabote ekroko hu mli.
Bo ŋaawoo toi, ni okplɛ̃ tsɔ̃semɔ koni wɔsɛɛ lɛ, ole mli.
Yiŋtoi pii yɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔŋ; shi nɔ ni Yehowa eto lɛ, no baa mli obɔ̃.
Anɔkwayeli ataoɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ; ni ohiafo hi fe amalelɔ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ enɛ lɛ etsui tɔɔ; efɔŋ ko baŋ enɔ.
Anihaolɔ kɛ enine tĩɔ nii yɛ kã mli, ni emiii po ni ekɛ enine lɛ woɔ edaaŋ tete.
Tswaa hefɛoyelɔ nɔ, ni mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ eeekase nɔ ko yɛŋ. Kã mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ hiɛ, ni eeele ni.
Mɔ ni yiɔ etsɛ, ni ewoɔ enyɛ foi kɛjeɔ shīa lɛ, bi ni woɔ mɔ hiɛgble ni ebɔɔ mɔ ahora ni.
Mibi, tsɔsemɔ ni hãa aduɔ gbɛ kɛjeɔ nilee he lɛ, kpa toiboo.
Odasefonyo fɔŋ ŋmɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; ni efɔŋfeelɔ naabu nyaa nɔ fɔŋ he.
Fɔbuu kã shi hã hefɛoyelɔi; ni kpãa hu kã shi hã kwashiai akotosɛɛ.
20: Wain lɛ hefɛoyelɔ ni, ni dãa ni wa lɛ hoofeelɔ ni; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni dãa hãa eduɔ gbɛ lɛ, eleee nii.
Maŋtsɛ mlifu ni naawa lɛ etamɔ jata huumɔ; mɔ ni woɔ maŋtsɛ mlifu lɛ, ewala ŋmɛɔ lɛ.
Eji hiɛ nyam kɛhã nuu kɛji enyaaa bei he; shi kwashia fɛɛ kwashia lɛ, bei ebeɔ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ ni huuu yɛ humɔ be mlilɛ, nikpamɔ be mli lɛ enaŋ nɔ ko ekpa.
Adesa yiŋtoo mlikwɔ tamɔ nubu, shi nilelɔ jieɔ yiŋtoi lɛ kpo.
Mɛi babaoo tsɛɔ amɛhe anɔkwafoi; shi anɔkwafo lɛ namɔ yoɔ lɛ?
Gbɔmɔ ni ji jalɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ajɔɔ eshwiei.
Maŋtsɛ ni taa kojomɔ sɛ̃i nɔ lɛ, enaa efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ.
Namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ akɛ, "Mi lɛ, mitsuu mitsui he, ni esha ko be mihe?"
Nsɛni tɛi srɔtoi kɛ susumɔ nii srɔtoi lɛ Yehowa miihi fɛɛ.
Gbekɛbii tete hãa akɛ amɛnifeemɔnii yɔɔ amɛ, nifeemɔnii lɛ he tse jio, eja jio.
Toi ni nuɔ nii kɛ hiŋmɛi ni naa nii lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni fee enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Wɔ akaŋɔɔ onaa, kɛjeee nakai lɛ obaaye ohia. Gblemɔ ohiŋmɛii, ni ooona nii oye otɔ.
Nihelɔ kɛɔ akɛ nɔ ni eheɔ lɛ, "Ehiii, ehiii!" Shi kɛji eyi gbɛ pɛ, eeshwã akɛ ena lɛ ofoo.
Shika kɛ ojrawatɛi babaoo yɛ; shi nilee wiemɔ lɛ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o ni.
Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ etade ato bo awaba; ni mɔ ni damɔɔ maŋsɛɛnyo sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ato awaba.
Ŋmaa ni akɛ kutumpɔo na lɛ eŋɔɔ; shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ daaŋ yiɔ tɔ kɛ ŋmlitsa.
Ŋaawoo akɛtoɔ yiŋ, ni nilee akɛwuɔ ta.
Sanetãlɔ lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; no hewɔ lɛ okɛ naa blɛblɛtsɛ akabɔ.
Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, ewala sɛɛ foɔ tamɔ kane ni agbe yɛ duŋ kpii mli.
Gboshinii ni ana lɛ gidigidi yɛ shishijee mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ baaa nɔ yɛ naagbee mli.
Kaakɛɛ akɛ, "Matɔ efɔŋ he owele." Mɛɛ Yehowa, ni eeeye ebua bo.
Nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ lɛ Yehowa miihi. Shishiumɔ nsɛnii ehiii.
Gbɔmɔ nanefãamɔi lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ eyɔɔ; te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni eeele nɔ ni yɔɔ egbɛ nɔ hu?
Eji tsɔne hã gbɔmɔ akɛ eeesha ehe ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni! Ni shiwoo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ kpaako dam ejwɛŋɔ he" ni naashiwoo sɛɛ dani ejwɛŋ he.
Maŋtsɛ nilelɔ shaa efɔŋfeelɔi amli, ni ekɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ kɛgbɛlɛɔ amɛ.
Gbɔmɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ, Yehowa kane ni; ni ekpaa gbɔmɔ mligbɛ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ.
Anɔkwayeli baa maŋtsɛ yi, ni jalɛ saneyeli hãa emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i maa shi shiŋŋ.
Oblahii anumnyam ji amɛhewalɛ; shi hiimeji ahefɛo ji amɛyiteŋ waŋ lɛ.
Yii pilamɔ fla lɛ etsumɔɔ esha; ni kpãa yii hu tsuɔ tsui mli fɛɛ.
21: Maŋtsɛ tsui lɛ etamɔ faa ni hoɔ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ. Etsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ.
Gbɔmɔ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ja yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, tsui mli ekwɛɔ.
Jalɛ saneyeli kɛ kojomɔ kpakpa lɛ, esa Yehowa hiɛ fe afɔleshãa.
Henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo tsui lɛ, efɔŋfeelɔi akane ni, ni esha ni.
Hiɛshikãlɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛ shweremɔ baa; shi mɔ ni kɛ hejojomɔ feɔ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ ohia baa.
Jwetri ni akɛ lakamɔ na lɛ lamɔ ni hoɔ ni, ni gbele taomɔ ni.
Efɔŋfeelɔi anifeemɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, no nɔŋŋ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛfee nɔ ni ja.
Mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, egbɛ ejaaa; shi bemyelɔ lɛ, lɛ egbɛ ja.
Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi tsu yiteŋ kpokplobiiaŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ aaahi shīa komeŋ.
Yiwalɔi nyaa efɔŋfeemɔ he, amɛnanemɛi po anii efeee amɛ mɔbɔ.
Kɛ agbla hefɛoyelɔ toi lɛ, mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako kaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ mli; ni kɛ atsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ nii lɛ, eleɔ nii.
Nyɔŋmɔjalɔ lɛ, enaa nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ mɔ fɔŋ we; etsiɔ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ etswaa shi, ni ekpãtãa ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi ni ekanu ohiafo blɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eeeblɔ ni aboŋ lɛ toi.
Teemɔŋ nikeenii kpãtãa mlifu; ni nikeenii ni jɛ tsui mli hu kuɔ mlila ni naa wa naa.
Kɛ aye jalɛ sane lɛ, jalɔi naa miishɛɛ; shi edɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔi.
Mɔ ni kɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enaagbeehe ji gbohiiaje; eeeyahi gbohii egwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Mɔ ni daaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ni eyeɔ pɔkūu nii lɛ, ohīa hīaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ wain lɛ, enaŋ nii.
Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, jalɔ kpɔ̃mɔnii ni; ni kutumpɔfo lɛ, mɔ ni eye emuu kpɔ̃mɔnii ni.
Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi shiaŋa nɔ moŋ fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ yrɛdɛɛ aaahi shi.
Abaa jwetri ni jra wa kɛ mu yi yɛ nilelɔ we; shi kwashia lɛ, kpãtãmɔ ekpãtãa hiɛ.
Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ jalɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, enaa wala kɛ hiɛnyam.
Nilelɔ kwɔɔ kãkãlɔi amaŋ he gbogbo, ni ekumɔɔ mɔ̃ɔ ni amɛhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu kɛ elilɛi mli lɛ, ejieɔ ehe kɛjeɔ haomɔ mli.
Mɔ ni woɔ ehe, ni etsɛɔ ehe, ni etsɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ "hefɛoyelɔ."
Anihaolɔ nitaomɔnii gbeɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eniji ekplɛ̃ɛɛ nitsumɔ.
Daa gbi lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ hiɛ miikɔ̃ nii nɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ ehãa, ni ekãmãaa.
Efɔŋfeelɔ afɔle lɛ nihiinii ni; blɔblɔ ni ekɛba kɛ yiŋsha.
Amale odasefonyo hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi wiemɔ ni jɛɔ mɔ ni nu sane daaŋ lɛ, ehiɔ shi daa.
Mɔ fɔŋ kwaa ehãhãa ehiɛ, shi jalɔ toɔ egbɛjianɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nilee loo eniiashishinumɔ, loo eŋaawoo ko bɛ ni kɛ Yehowa nɔ lɛ aaafu daa.
Asaa okpɔŋɔ atoɔ tawuu gbi; shi kunimyeli lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.
22: Gbɛi kpakpa hi fe ninamɔ babaoo, ni hiɛnyam hi fe jwiɛtɛi loo shika.
Niiatsɛ kɛ ohiafo lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ amɛ fɛɛ.
Hiɛtɛ̃lɔ naa oshrã miiba ni eteɔ ehe; shi mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako kɛ lɛ yakpeɔ, ni ehiɛ kpãtãa.
Heshibaa kɛ Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ he sɛɛnamɔ ji ninamɔ kɛ hiɛnyam kɛ wala.
Ŋmeii kɛ tsɔnei yɛ kutumpɔfo gbɛ nɔ; mɔ ni leɔ ehenɔkwɛmɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛteŋ aaajekɛ.
Tsɔsemɔ gbekɛ bɔ ni eba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ ehã, ni edalɛ mli lɛ etsakeŋ.
Niiatsɛ yeɔ ohiafo nɔ; ni mɔ ni yafaa nii tsɔ̃ɔ nyɔŋ ehãa mɔ ni fa lɛ nii lɛ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ toikɔ̃dɔ̃mɔ sane lɛ, enaa amanehulu, ni eyitsoŋwalɛ lɛ sɛɛ foɔ.
Mɔ ni mli jɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ eniyenii lɛ eko kumaa ohiafo.
Shwiemɔ hefɛoyelɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ blɔmɔ kɛ bei kɛ jɛmɔ sɛɛ aaafo.
Mɔ ni tsui mli tse, ni ewiemɔ he tse lɛ, maŋtsɛ kɛ lɛ bɔɔ naanyo.
