Yehowa hiŋmɛii baa nilee yi; shi amalelɔi awiemɔi lɛ ebaaa yi.
Anihaolɔ kɛɔ akɛ, "Jata yɛ agbo lɛ naa; kɛji mije kpo kɛtee blohuŋ lɛ magbo."
Yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ edaa tamɔ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ, mɔ ni Yehowa mli efu lɛ lɛ eeegbee mli.
Buulufeemɔ kpɛtɛ gbekɛ tsui he; shi tsɔsemɔ kpãa lɛ aaashwie buulufeemɔ lɛ kɛaaje ehe kɛya sɛɛ flooflo.
Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo amim koni ekɛna nii, shi ekeɔ niiatsɛ nii lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ohia kɛ̃ hiaa lɛ.
Ba otoi shi koni obo nilelɔi awiemɔi toi; ni okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ akase nii kɛjɛ minilee lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ kɛji okɛto ojwɛŋmɔ mli, ni onyɛ okai yɛ owiemɔi amli lɛ, eyɛ fɛo pam.
Miihã bo tuuŋta ole enɛɛmɛi ŋmɛnɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ona hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Yehowa mli.
Miŋma nilee wiemɔi kɛ ŋaawoi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ miha o.
Wiemɔi ni baatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale; koni okɛ anɔkwa hetoo ayahã mɛi ni tsu o lɛ.
Kaatswa ohiafo ojo yɛ ohiafo ni eji lɛ hewɔ; asaŋ kaagba nɔnalɔ naa yɛ saneyelihe;
ejaakɛ Yehowa yeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ; ni mɛi ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ amɛ hu Yehowa aaahao amɛ.
Okɛ mlifutsɛ akabɔ naanyo, ni okɛ mlilatsɛ akanyiɛ;
Koni okɔ amɛjeŋba lɛ ni oyadu tsɔne.
Kaafee ohe mɛi ni woɔ shi, loo mɛi ni damɔɔ nyɔmɔtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ eko;
kɛji obɛ nɔ ko ni okɛaawo nyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashɔ̃ osaa tete yɛ odɛŋ.
Kaatsi blema shikpɔŋ husu kadimɔ nɔ ni otsɛmɛi lɛ eto efɔ̃ shi lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ.
Nuu ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, ni ele ŋaa jogbaŋŋ yɛ enitsumɔ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ tete eeedamɔ; edamɔŋ mɛi ni abuuu amɛ ahiɛ.
23: Kɛ ota shi, ni okɛ lumɔ ko baaye nii lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ mɔ hiɛ ni ota lɛ he jogbaŋŋ.
Kɛ oji mɔ ni yeɔ ŋmaa lɛ, kaaye pii tse nɔ.
Kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miitsɛ̃ onaa, ejaakɛ niyenii ni lakaa mɔ ni.
Kaagbo deŋme yɛ ninamɔ he; Okɛ jwɛŋmɔ ato he.
Ohiŋmɛi ni aaagba nɔ pɛ etee; ejaakɛ ekwɛ̃ɔ fiji oya, ni eflikiɔ tamɔ okropɔŋ kɛyaa ŋwɛi.
Kaaye kpɛkpɛɛlɔ dɛŋ nii, ni kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miiba otsine.
Ejaakɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni buɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he akɔntaa yɛ eyitsoŋ. Ekɛɔ bo akɛ, "Ye ni onu!" Shi jeee kɛ etsui mli fɛɛ.
Atrɔmai abɔ ni oye lɛ oooshwe oshwie, ni owiemɔi dɔkɔbii lɛ aaafee yaka.
Kaawie ni kwashia nu; ejaakɛ eeegbe onilee wiemɔi lɛ ahe guɔ.
Kaatsi blema husu nɔ̃ okadi hu kɛtee sɛɛ, ni kaaŋɔ awusãi ashikpɔŋ yɛ amɛdɛ̃.
Ejaakɛ amɛkplɔ̃lɔ lɛ hewalɔ ni; ni ekɛ bo baaye ehã amɛ.
Okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ tsɔsemɔ nɔ, ni obo nilee wiemɔi atoi.
Kaatsi gbekɛ tsɔsemɔ naa, ejaakɛ kɛ oyi lɛ kɛ kpãa lɛ egboŋ.
Bo lɛ okɛ kpãa ayi lɛ, ni ooohere eyiwala.
Mibi, kɛji ooona jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, mi hu mitsui aaanyɔ mimli.
Kɛji wiemɔi ni ja miije onaa lɛ, mi hu mimli aaafli mi.
Kaahã ohiɛ miikɔ̃ eshafeelɔi anɔ; shi moŋ kã he oshe Yehowa gbeyei daa nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ wɔsɛɛ ko yɛ, ni ohiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeŋ yaka.
Mibi, bo lɛ, bo toi, koni ole nii, ni oba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ.
Okɛ ohe akabɔ dãatɔlɔi loo ŋmãayelɔi ahe.
Ejaakɛ dãatɔlɔi kɛ ŋmãayelɔi lɛ amɛaaye ohia, ni wɔdɔiwɔlɔi aaabu mama shwɛishwɛi.
Bo otsɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ toi, ni kaagbe onyɛ he guɔ kɛji egbɔ lɛ.
Tse shika ohe anɔkwale kɛ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ, ni okahɔ̃ɔ ekoeko.
Jalɔ tsɛ aaanya babaoo, ni mɔ ni fɔɔ bi nilelɔ lɛ aaana ebi lɛ he miishɛɛ.
Hã otsɛ kɛ onyɛ mii ashɛ amɛhe, ni hã onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ anya.
Mibi ŋɔɔ otsui ohã mi, ni okɔ minane.
Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ ni, ni mɔ kroko ŋa lɛ bu kplokotoo ni.
Ewoɔ ka tamɔ ojotswalɔ, ni ehãa mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa ayi faa yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
Namɔ naa nɔ? Namɔ yeɔ awerɛhoo? Namɔ naa bei? Namɔ naa sane? Namɔ naa pilamɔ yakatswaa? Namɔ hiŋmɛii tsuɔ faa?
Mɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni tsɛɔ yɛ wain he lɛ; mɛi ni yaa yasaa amɛnaa wain ni afutu mli lɛ.
Kaakwɛ wain bɔ ni etsu faa lɛ, bɔ ni ehiɛ yɔɔ fɛo yɛ kplu lɛ mli lɛ, bɔ ni eyaa kpoo lɛ.
Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ, ekɔ̃ɔ mɔ tamɔ onufu, ni efɛ̃ɔ mɔ tamɔ blikã.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ohiŋmɛii ebɔi naakpɛɛ nibii namɔ, ni wiemɔi gbohii aaaje onaa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooofee tamɔ mɔ ko ni kã ŋshɔ teŋ, loo tamɔ mɔ ko ni kã aŋmla nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ.
Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni oookɛɛ ji, "Amɛtswia mi nii, shi ewaaa mihe; amɛyi mi, shi minuuu he. Mɛɛbe mihiɛ aaatsɛ̃? Mibaya ekoŋŋ."
24: Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ɔji anɔ, ni okashwe hu akɛ okɛ amɛ aaabɔ naanyo tete.
Ejaakɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ yiwalɛ nifeemɔi ahe ŋaa amɛjwɛŋmɔ toɔ, ni amɛwieɔ wiemɔi gbohii.
Nilee akɛmaa tsu, ni niiashishinumɔ akɛhãa emaa shi.
Ni nilee akɛhãa piai amli yimɔɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni jra wa ni yɔɔ fɛo.
Nuu nilelɔ lɛ ehe wa fe nuu kakabaŋ; ni nuu ni le nii fɛ efe nuu ni he wa.
Ejaakɛ ŋaa akɛwuɔ ta, ni ŋaawolɔi pii aŋaawoo akɛyeɔ kunim.
Nilee mli kwɔ tsɔ̃ hã kwashia, hewɔ lɛ etswaaa esɛŋ yɛ koi shi.
Mɔ ni toɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa lɛ, lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ ablofo.
Mɔ buulufeemɔ he ŋaatoo lɛ esha ni; ni hefɛoyelɔ hu gbɔmɛi miihi.
Kɛji otɔ biti yɛ haomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ohewalɛ faaa.
Mɛi ni aakpla amɛ ayagbe amɛ yakatswaa lɛ, heremɔ amɛyiwala; ni mɛi hu ni miididãa, ni akɛ amɛmiiya gbeehe lɛ, okaku ohiɛ ofɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Kɛji okɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔleee enɛ wɔto" lɛ, ani mɔ ni naa tsuiaŋnii lɛ, mɔ ni buɔ osusuma he lɛ, eleee, eleee akɛ ole oto lo? Ani ewooo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa?
Mibi, ye wo ejaakɛ ehi, ni bɔ ni wo ni tsereɔ kɔikɔi kɛjɛɔ wo agbaku mli ŋɔɔ onaa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nilee ŋɔɔ osusuma diɛŋtsɛ naa.
Kɛ ona nilee lɛ aaahi aha o wɔsɛɛ, ni ohiɛnɔkãmɔ efeŋ yaka.
Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ, kaawo jalɔ shihilɛhe lɛ he ka, ni kaahao ehejɔɔmɔhe lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ jalɔ gbeɔ shi shii kpawo, ni eteɔ shi ekoŋŋ; shi efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ amanehulu butuɔ lɛ kwrakwra.
Kɛji ohenyɛlɔ gbee shi lɛ, kaanya, ni kɛji etɛ lɛ, omli akafli o.
No lɛ, Yehowa aaana, ni eeedɔ lɛ, ni ebaafo emli ni efu lɛ lɛ sɛɛ.
Kaawo otsui he la yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi ahewɔ, ni ohiɛ akakɔ̃ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji anɔ.
Nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ hã mɔ fɔŋ wɔsɛɛ, ni efɔŋfeelɔi akane lɛ hu aaagbe.
Mibi, she Yehowa gbeyei, kɛ maŋtsɛ hu; ni kaatse amɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ atua.
Ejaakɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛkpãtã ohiɛ trukaa; ni namɔ le nɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni aaajɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ?
Nilelɔi awiemɔi lɛ ekomɛi hu nɛ. Hiɛaŋkwɛmɔ yɛ kojomɔ mli lɛ, ehiii.
Mɔ ni kɛɔ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, "Oye bem" lɛ, mɛi aaalomɔ lɛ; majimaji aaanyaŋe lɛ.
Mɛi ni kãa efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ aaana miishɛɛ; ni jɔɔmɔ kpakpa aaaba amɛnɔ.
Mɔ ni hãa hetoo ni ja lɛ, ohe suɔlɔ ni.
Too onitsumɔ he gbɛjianɔ jogbaŋŋ, feemɔ oŋmɔshinii fɛɛ kralo, no sɛɛ dani obɔi otsu maa.
Kaaye odase oshi onaanyo yakatswaa, ni okɛ onaabu hu akashishiu mɔ ko.
Kaakɛɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni efee mi lɛ, nakai mafee lɛ mato najiaŋ, nɔ ni efee mi lɛ, mawo lɛ he nyɔmɔ."
Mitsɔ̃ anihaolɔ ko ŋmɔ he, kɛ mɔ ni bɛ yitsoŋ waintrom he;
shi, naa, ŋmɔ lɛ mli fɛɛ etsi kɛ ŋmeii; ni sɔnsrɔ̃ sɔŋŋ eha shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; ni ŋmɔ lɛ he lɛ gbogbo lɛ ekumɔ eshwie shi.
Kɛkɛ ni mikwɛ gãa, ni mijwɛŋ he jogbaŋŋ. Mikwɛ, ni mikase nɔ ko kɛjɛ mli.
Mawɔ fioo, majie mihiɛsɛɛ fioo, makota miniji fioo;
be mli ni owɔɔ lɛ, ohia aaabanina o tamɔ ojotswalɔ; ni fimɔ hu aaaba tamɔ nuu ni hiɛ tsɛŋ.
25: Solomon abɛi lɛ akrokomɛi hu ni Yuda maŋtsɛ Hezekia webii lɛ ŋmla nɛ:
Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam ji akɛ ekɛ sane atee; shi maŋtsɛmɛi anumnyam ji akɛ amɛtao sane mli.
Bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ, ni shikpɔŋ hu mli kwɔ lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛmɛi ayitsoŋ kwɔ; anyɛɛɛ ana emli nii.
Jiemɔ jwiɛtɛi fei lɛ kɛje jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli, ni ŋaalɔ lɛ baana jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ ni ekɛ tsu nii lɛ.
Jiemɔ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ kɛje maŋtsɛ he, ni jalɛ sane aaahi sɛ̃i lɛ he.
Kɛji oyɛ maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, kaafee pupuupu; ni kaadamɔ mɛi wuji agbɛhe.
Ejaakɛ ehi moŋ akɛ aaakɛɛ bo akɛ, "Ba yitsogbɛ nɛɛ," fe nɔ ni aaatsi bo kɛaatee najiashigbɛ ni lumɔ lɛ miikwɛ.
Kaaye oyai ni okɛ nɔ ni okɛ ohiŋmɛi kɛkɛ na tee saneyelihe, ejaakɛ naagbee mli kɛji onaanyo lɛ wo bo hiɛgble lɛ, te obaafee tɛŋŋ?
Kɛji okɛ onaanyo na sane lɛ, bo kɛ lɛ sɔŋŋ atao naa; shi kaajie mɔ kroko teemɔŋ sane kpo;
koni mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ akabawo bo hiɛgble ni ogbɛi gbonyo lɛ miika ohe.
Wiemɔ ni aaawie be ni sa mli lɛ, etamɔ shika kpɔbii ni tra jwiɛtɛi mli.
Bɔ ni shika ga kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi hewulamɔnii yɔɔ hã mɔ lɛ, nakai kãlɔ ni le nii yɔɔ hã toibolɔi.
Bɔ ni snoo mli jɔɔ ŋanii yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ji bɔfo anɔkwafo hã mɛi ni tsu lɛ lɛ. Ehãa enuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atsui nyɔɔ amɛmli.
Mɔ ni woɔ nikee he shi, tsɛ, eyeee shiwoo lɛ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ oblɔtu kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni nu bɛ mli.
Aaanyɛ akɛ tsuishitoo blɛoo atsake nɔyelɔ jwɛŋmɔ; ni naajɔlɛ wiemɔ kuɔ wu.
Kɛ ona wo lɛ, kaaye fe nine, koni eti bo, ni oshwe oshwie.
Kaafɔ onaanyo we shwɛmɔ koni osane miije etsine, ni ehe miitsɛ̃ o.
Mɔ ni yeɔ amale odase yɛ enaanyo he lɛ, etamɔ tsokpoti loo klaŋte loo gaimlibi ni naa ba.
Hiɛ ni akɛfɔ̃ɔ kutumpɔfo nɔ yɛ fimɔ be mli lɛ, etamɔ nyanyɔŋ ni ewɔtsɔ loo nane ni elɔŋe.
Mɔ ni jieɔ mɔ he atade yɛ fɛ̃i be mli, aloo ekɛ ashiŋ toɔ pilamɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni laa lalai kɛshɛjeɔ mɔ mii, shi jeee kɛ etsui mli fɛɛ.
Kɛji hɔmɔ miiye ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, hã lɛ nii eye, ni kɛji kumai miiye lɛ lɛ, hã lɛ nu enu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji ofee nakai lɛ, ooowo lɛ hiɛgble kpɔtɔɔ, ni Yehowa aaawo bo he nyɔŋmɔ.
Bɔ ni kooyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ nunɛmɔ baa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔhewiemɔ kɛ hiɛtumɔ baa.
Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi tsu yiteŋ kpokplobiiaŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ aaahi shīa kome mli.
Bɔ ni nu hɔɔŋ yɔɔ hã mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, nakai ji sanekpakpa ni akɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ kɛba.
Jalɔ ni nyɛɛɛ shi afi yɛ mɔ fɔŋ hiɛ lɛ, etamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ní anyiɛ mli kɛ nubu ni akpɔtɔ lɛ.
Woyeli tsɔ̃ ehiii, hiɛtaomɔ tsɔ̃ hu ehiii.
Mɔ ni nyɛɛɛ ehe nɔ eye nɔ eye lɛ, etamɔ maŋ ni akumɔ ehe gbogboi ashwie shi.
26: Snoo enɛɛɛ yɛ lasta be mli, ni nu enɛɛɛ yɛ nikpamɔ beiaŋ, nakai hiɛnyam esaaa kwashia.
Bɔ ni aflimata flikiɔ ni nyɔŋmɔbitɛte flikiɔ lɛ, nakai yaka loomɔ mɔɔɔ mɔ.
Kplebi sa okpɔŋɔ, ni manyoflɛ sa teji, ni kpãa sa kwashia kotosɛɛ.
Kaakwɛ kwashia sanebimɔ ni ohã lɛ nakai hetoo, no lɛ oootsɔ̃ tamɔ lɛ.
Kwɛmɔ kwashia sanebimɔ ni oha lɛ hetoo, koni ekabu ehe nilelɔ.
Mɔ ni kɛ shɛɛ tsuɔ kwashia lɛ, eetɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enane, ni eetao sane ehã ehe.
Bɔ ni obubuafo naji tsotsroɔ ehe ni hewalɛ bɛ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kwashia daaŋ abɛ yɔɔ eflo.
Mɔ ni woɔ kwashia hiɛ nyam lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ko ni ekɔ tɛ ewo akromia mli.
Bɔ ni ŋmei tso yɔɔ yɛ dãatɔlɔ dɛŋ lɛ, nakai abɛ yɔɔ yɛ kwashia daaŋ.
Mɔ ni bɔɔ kwashia loo dãatɔlɔ ni miiho apaa lɛ, etamɔ gãitsɛ̃lɔ ni miipila mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛkɛ.
Kwashia ni kuɔ esɛɛ eyafeɔ ebuuluianii ekoŋŋ lɛ, etamɔ gbee ni kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa eshwee he.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ ha kwashia fe gbɔmɔ ni buɔ ehe nilelɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.
Anihaolɔ ji mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Jata yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ; jata yɛ blohui lɛ amli."
Bɔ ni shinaa tsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ esɛɛ sai anɔ pɛ lɛ, nakai anihaolɔ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ yɔɔ yɛ esaa mli.
Anihaolɔ kɛ enine woɔ kã mli, shi ewaa ehãa lɛ akɛ, ekɛ enine lɛ aaawo edaaŋ tete.
Anihaolɔ buɔ ehe nilelɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ, fe nilelɔi kpawo ni hãa sane hetoo ni ja.
Mɔ ni kɛ ehe woɔ bei ni kɔɔɔ ehe eko mli lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ko ni mɔɔ gbee gbɔ ni miiho toi mli.
Mɔ ni shishiuɔ enaanyo, ni ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ,
"Shwɛmɔ kɛkɛ mikɛ o shwɛɔ" lɛ, etamɔ sɛkɛyelɔ ni kɛ latsei kɛ gãii kɛ gbele shwɛɔ.
Kɛji lai tã lɛ, la gboɔ; ni kɛji ablɛbiwielɔ bɛ lɛ bei sɛɛ foɔ.
Bɔ ni ŋai hãaa lasrɛmi agbo, ni lai hãaa la agbo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ beilɔ hãa bei mli waa.
Ablɛbiwielɔ wiemɔ tamɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔnii ni ŋɔɔ jogbaŋŋ ni wɔsumɔɔ akɛ wɔye wɔwo wɔmusuŋ obɔ̃.
Naadɔkɔbii wiemɔ ni jɛɛɛ tsuijurɔ mli lɛ, etamɔ ŋɛsuko ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi ekpa he.
Nyɛlɔ kɛ enaabu saa ewiemɔ he, shi etsuiŋ lɛ, eelaka mɔ.
Kɛji eewie dɔkɔbii lɛ, kaahe lɛ oye, ejaakɛ yiŋtoi fɔ̃ɔji eyi etsui mli obɔ̃.
Ekɛ emɔnyɛɛ teɔ nɛ, shi aaajie egbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo hiɛ kɛ̃.
Mɔ ni kɛ yiŋtoo fɔŋ tsaa bu lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbee mli; ni mɔ ni kɛ yiŋsha kokloɔ tɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ enɔ tɛ lɛ aaaku sɛɛ agbee.
Kɛji oonyɛ mɔ ko lɛ, no owieɔ omaleɔ efe efɔŋ; ni mɔ yiteŋ mluwoo lɛ ekɛ shigbeemɔ baa.
27: Kaashwã ofɔ̃ wɔ nɔ; ejaakɛ oleee nɔ ni baaba wɔ.
Hã mɔ kroko ajie oyi, shi kshiaaajie bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe yi. Hã gbɔ ajie oyi, shi ekaje bo diɛŋtsɛ onaa.
Tɛ tsii, ni shai hu, jatsu kɛ tsiimɔ ni; shi buulu mlifu tsii fe nibii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Mlila yi wa, ni mlifu tamɔ faa ni esram nɔ; shi namɔ aaanyɛ awuŋayeli hiɛ adamɔ?
Ehi akɛ akã mɔ ko hiɛ yɛ mɛi ahiɛ fe nɔ ni akɛ suɔmɔ aaatsimɔ etɔmɔ nɔ.
Naanyo anɔkwafo ejeee gbɛ epilaaa mɔ; shi henyɛlɔ mɔ atuuloomɔ lɛ, shishiumɔ ni.
Mɔ ni eye nii etɔ lɛ, ekwaa wo agbaku tete; shi mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni joɔ po ŋɔɔ yɛ edaaŋ.
Nuu ni jeɔ ewe eyakpaa shi lɛ, etamɔ looflɔ ni jeɔ etsu mli eyatsomloɔ.
Muŋma kɛ ojeŋma hãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe, shi haomɔ hãa mɔ tsui yeɔ.
Kaakwa bo diɛŋtsɛ onaanyo kɛ otsɛ naanyo. Ofimɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, kaaya onyɛmi we. Ohe gbɔmɔ ni bɛŋkɛ o lɛ, ehi aahuu fe onyɛmi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ.
Mibi, feemɔ nilelɔ, ni ohã mitsui anyɔ mimli; bɔ ni afee ni mana hetoo mahã mɔ ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ.
Hiɛtɛ̃lɔ naa efɔŋ ni baa, ni awiɔ ehe; shi mɛi ni jwɛŋmɔ naa waaa lɛ, amɛyaboteɔ mli.
Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ etade ato bo awaba; ni mɔ ni damɔɔ maŋsɛɛnyo sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ato awaba.
Mɔ ni kɛ gbee ni wa jɔɔ enaanyo leebi maŋkpa lɛ, aaasusu akɛ loomɔ moŋ elomɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Yoo beilɔ lɛ etamɔ tsu yiteŋ nu ni tsereɔ shwieɔ shi kɔikɔi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛji nu miinɛ.
Kɛji aaaka akɛ aaatsi enaa ni efɔ̃ɔ bei lɛ, etamɔ nɔ ni aatsi kɔɔyɔɔ naa ni ekatswa, aloo aamia mu yɛ ninejurɔ dɛ̃kɔkɔ mli.
Dade jɔɔ dade naa, ni gbɔmɔ hu hãa enyɛmi gbɔmɔ leɔ nii.
Mɔ ni baa yelitso yi lɛ, eyeɔ eyibii lɛ eko; ni mɔ ni buɔ enuŋtsɔ he lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ woɔ ehiɛ nyam.
Bɔ ni gbɔmɔ naa ehiɛ yɛ nu mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ hãa enaa bɔ ni eji.
Bɔ ni gbohiiaje kɛ gbonyobu etɔko dã lɛ, nakai gbɔmɔ hiŋmɛi hu etɔko dã.
Niiahetsuumɔ kukwɛi lɛ, eyɛ kɛhã jwiɛtɛi, ni flɔnɔɔ hu yɛ kɛhã shika, ni gbɔmɔ lɛ eyijiemɔ akɛyoɔ lɛ.
Kɛji okɛ fufuitsomlibi shi buulu yɛ fufuitso mli tamɔ ashiɔ able tete lɛ, ebuulufeemɔ lɛ ejeŋ ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ole bɔ ni otoi lɛ yɔɔ, ni okwɛ okooloo kui lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ ninamɔ ehiii shi kɛyaaa naanɔ; ni maŋtsɛyeli akekre hu ehiii shi kɛyaaa yinɔi fɛɛ.
Kɛji jwɛi gbiŋ be ho, ni jwɛi fɔ ba, ni tsei fu bai lɛ, aflɔɔ, ni abuaa naa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Onaa omama kɛjɛɔ too gwaŋtɛŋbii lɛ amli, ni onaa shika kɛjɛɔ too abotiai ni ohɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli okɛheɔ shikpɔŋ.
Ooona abotia fufɔ bɔ ni aaashɛ bo kɛ owɛ lɛ yeli, kɛ nɔ ni okɛaalɛ otsuji yei lɛ.
28: Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji joɔ foi be mli ni mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ, shi jalɔi lɛ amɛfeɔ ekãa tamɔ jata.
Nɔsha hãa shikpɔŋ ko nɔ lumɛi ayi faa; shi kɛ emli mɛi lɛ yɛ niiashishinumɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, lumɔyeli maa shi shiŋŋ, ni esɛɛ tsɛɔ.
Ohiafo ni waa enaanyo ohiafo yi lɛ, etamɔ nunɛmɔ ni loɔ nii kɛyaa, ni ehãaa niyenii aba.
Mɛi ni kwaa mla lɛ, amɛjieɔ mɔ fɔŋ yi; shi mɛi ni yeɔ mla nɔ lɛ teɔ shi amɛwoɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji nuuu jalɛ shishi; shi mɛi ni jaa Yehowa lɛ, amɛnuɔ shishi jogbaŋŋ.
Ohiafo ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehi fe niiatsɛ ni bɛ jeŋba.
Mɔ ni yeɔ mla nɔ lɛ, bi nilelɔ ni; shi mɔ ni kɛ fulɔi bɔɔ naanyo lɛ, ewoɔ etsɛ hiɛgble.
Mɔ ni kɛ hekpa ni fe nine kɛ wieyeli hãa enii faa lɛ, eebua naa ehã mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni booo mla toi ni eye nɔ lɛ, esɔlemɔ tete lɛ, nihiinii ni.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hãa jalɔ nane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ lɛ, eeegbee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebu mli; shi mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ aaana gboshinii kpakpa.
Niiatsɛ buɔ ehe nilelɔ; shi ohiafo ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ kpaa lɛ shi.
Kɛ jalɔi ye kunim lɛ, eyɛ nyam naakpa; shi kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji wo amɛhe nɔ lɛ, mɛi teeteeɔ amɛhe.
Mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etɔ̃mɔi anɔ lɛ, eshwereŋ; shi mɔ ni jajeɔ, ni efɔ̃ɔ efɔŋfeemɔ lɛ, anaa lɛ mɔbɔ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei daa; shi mɔ ni wajeɔ etsui lɛ, egbeɔ haomɔ mli.
Nɔyelɔ fɔŋ ni yeɔ maŋbii ni anii yɔɔ mɔbɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ jata ni huuɔ loo oshishibrishi ni hiɛ ewo la.
Nɔyelɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, yiwalɔ kple ji lɛ; shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ hiɛjoomɔ lɛ, ehãa egbii esɛɛ tsɛɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ko eye mɔ ko lá yi sɔ̃ lɛ, etsɔ̃ kobɔfo kɛmiiya gbonyobu mli; mɔ ko akaye ebua lɛ.
Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala; shi mɔ ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, eeegbee bu mli.
Mɔ ni hūɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ, eeena nii eye etɔ; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yakayaka nii sɛɛ lɛ eeeye ohia kadikadi.
Nuu anɔkwafo aaana jɔɔmɔ babaoo; shi mɔ ni yeɔ oyai koni ena nii lɛ, eyeŋ ehe.
Hiɛaŋkwɛmɔ ehiii, ejaakɛ aboloo atrɔma kome pɛ hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ aaafee efɔŋ.
Kpɛkpɛɛlɔ yeɔ oya ni ena nii; shi eleee akɛ ohia miiba enɔ.
Mɔ ni kãa mɔ lɛ, fee sɛɛ lɛ ehiɛ baa nyam fe mɔ ni kɛ ewiemɔ woɔ mɔ yiteŋ mlu.
Mɔ ni tswaa etsɛ loo enyɛ ojo ni ekɛɔ akɛ, "Enɛ jeee esha" lɛ, mɔ hiɛkpãtãlɔ naanyo ji lɛ.
Hiɛjoolɔ lɛ, ewoɔ bei; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, enaa nii.
Mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe nɔ lɛ, kwashia ni; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yɛ nilee mli lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.
Mɔ ni hãa ohiafo nɔ lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaŋ lɛ, shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ehiɛ etoɔ afã lɛ, aaalomɔ lɛ babaoo.
Kɛji yiwalɔi te shi lɛ, mɛi teeteɔ amɛhe; shi be ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa lɛ, belɛ jalɔi ayi miifa.
29: Mɔ ni afɔɔ lɛ kãmɔ, shi loloolo lɛ ekuɛŋ ti lɛ, trukaa ni aaakumɔ lɛ bɔ ni anaŋ ehe tsabaa.
Kɛji jalɔi miiye maŋ nɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ nyaa; shi kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ɔji miiye nɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ dɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ nilee lɛ, ehãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi mɔ ni kɛ ajwamaŋi bɔɔ lɛ, ekpãtãa enii ahiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli hãa maŋ damɔɔ shi, mɔ ni balaa maŋbii adɛŋ nii lɛ, ebutuɔ maŋ.
Mɔ ni woɔ enaanyo yiteŋ mlu lɛ, eeŋmɛ yaa ehã mɔ lɛ.
Efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tsɔne; shi jalɔ lɛ, elaa, ni enyaa.
Jalɔ le ohiafoi agbɛnaa; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enuuu ohiafoi agbɛnaa nɛɛ shishi.
Hefɛoyelɔi woɔ maŋ bei; shi nilelɔi kuɔ mlifu naa.
Kɛji nilelɔ kɛ buulu gba kadaa lɛ, buulu lɛ griɔ ni eŋmɔɔ kɛkɛ, ni hejɔlɛ baaa.
Lashishwielɔi nyɛɔ mɔ ni tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ehe; ni efɔŋfeelɔi taoɔ egbele.
Kwashia jieɔ emlifu fɛɛ kpo; shi nilelɔ miɔ ŋɔɔ.
Nɔyelɔ ni boɔ amale toi lɛ, etsuji fɛɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji.
Ohiafo kɛ yiwalɔ kpeɔ; Yehowa ni hãa emɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiŋmɛii naa nii.
Maŋtsɛ ni kojoɔ ohiafo yɛ jalɛ naa lɛ, emaŋtsɛsɛi lɛ aaama shi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Kpãa kɛ kãmɔ hãa mɔ leɔ nii; shi gbekɛ ni akpoo ejeŋ ahã lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ enyɛ hiɛgble.
Kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ɔji miiye mɛi anɔ lɛ, efɔŋfeemɔ faa: shi jalɔi aaama amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi.
Tsɔsemɔ obi, ni eeehã ohe ajɔ o; eeehã otsui anyɔ omli.
He ni gbalɛ wiemɔ ko bɛ lɛ, maŋbii ebuuu nɔ; shi ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ mla nɔ.
Akɛ wiemɔ kɛkɛ tsɔseee tsulɔ; ejaakɛ enuɔ shishi moŋ, shi ebuuu.
Ani onu nuu ni enaa yɔɔ blɛblɛ kɛ wiemɔ lo? Hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ hã kwashia fe lɛ.
Mɔ ni hiɛɔ etsulɔ fɔfɔɔle kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, naagbee lɛ ebuuu nɔ.
Mɔ ni mli fuɔ lɛ, eteɔ bei shi; ni mɔ ni mli etsɛɛɛ fumɔ lɛ, etɔ̃ɔ babaoo.
Gbɔmɔ hewoo nɔŋŋ aaaba lɛ shi; shi mɔ ni baa ehe shi yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ, aaawo ehiɛ nyam.
Mɔ ni kɛ julɔ jaa nii lɛ, eenyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewala; enuɔ akɛ aalomɔ nɛ; shi enyɛɛɛ ejaje.
Gbɔmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tsɔne ehãa mɔ; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, eyɛ shweshweeshwe.
Mɛi pii taoɔ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛjɛɔ nɔyeli adɛŋ; shi jalɛ saneyeli lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.
Jalɔi miihi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji; ni mɛi fɔ̃ɔji hu miihi jalɔi.
30: Yake bi Agur abɛi nɛ. Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ kɛɛ Itiel kɛ Ukal akɛ,
"Lɛɛlɛŋ, mifaŋ kooloo; mijeee gbɔmɔ, ni mibɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ hu.
Mikaseko nilee, ni asaŋ mileee Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nɔ ko.
Namɔ ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni esaa ekpleke shi? Namɔ ebua kɔɔyɔɔ naa yɛ ekɔkɔŋ dã? Namɔ efi nu yɛ emama mli dã? Namɔ ŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ koji lɛ emamɔ shi? Te egbɛi hu? Ni mɛni ji ebi lɛ hu gbɛi? Bɛ ole?
Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ, anɔkwale ni; Nyɔŋmɔ ji tsɛŋ kɛhã mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Kaaŋɔ nɔ ko ofata ewiemɔi lɛ ahe, kɛjeee nakai lɛ, eeekã ohiɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ amalelɔ."
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo odɛŋ mibiɔ nibii enyɔ yɛ; kaakãmã mi dani migbo.
Hã mi kɛ kutumpɔo kɛ nablaba teŋ ajekɛ. Kaahã miye ohia lɛ, asaŋ kaahã mina nii hu. Lɛɛ mi kɛ niyenii pɛ ni ehiã mi,
Koni mikatɔ tsɔ̃, ni mikwa o, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Namɔ ji Yehowa." Ni kaahã miye ohia, ni miyaju, ni mikɛgbe mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he guɔ.
Kaaye tsulɔ ko he osheku ohã enuŋtsɔ, koni tsulɔ lɛ akabalomɔ bo, ni ebu bo fɔ.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛlomɔɔ anɛtsɛmɛi, ni amɛjɔɔɔ amɛnyɛmɛi hu.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛbuɔ amɛhe akɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛhe tse; tsɛbelɛ, amɛhe ewo muji kpɔtɔɔ.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ; lɛɛlɛŋ amɛsusuɔ akɛ gbɔmɛi wuji ji amɛ.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛnyanyɔji lɛ klaŋtei ni; amɛnyanyɔji lɛ kaklai ni; ni amɛkɛtserɛɔ ohiafoi amli kɛjeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛkɛtserɛɔ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ kɛjeɔ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
Shiti yɛ biyei enyɔ atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ, "Hã mi, Hã mi". Nibii etɛ̃ etɔɔɔ amɛ, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete kplokaaa amɛ.
Nibii ejwɛ komɛi yɛ ni amɛtrɔko dã; nomɛi ji gbohiiaje kɛ musu ni fɔɔɔ, kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni etɔɔɔ nu, kɛ la ni esraŋ nɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ etsɛ he fɛo ni egbeɔ enyɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ lɛ, kwãakwãalabitei aaafãmɔ ehiŋmɛii, ni akpaŋai aaaye eloo.
Nibii etɛ̃ yɛ ni feɔ mi naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ minuuu shishi;
nomɛi ji, okropɔŋ flikimɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, kɛ onufu nyiɛmɔ yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, kɛ meele nyiɛmɔ yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, kɛ bɔ ni feɔ ni suɔmɔ baa nuu kɛ yoo teŋ.
Nɛkɛ pɛ yoo ajwamaŋ yɔɔ: eyeɔ nii ni etsumɔɔ enaa, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, "Mifeko efɔŋ ko."
Nibii etɛ̃ hãa shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ mli emɔ,
Nomɛi ji, nyɔŋ ni etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ; kɛ buulu ni eye nii etɔ;
kɛ yoo ni akpoo lɛ, ni ena wu; kɛ tsulɔyoo ni etsɔ̃ enuŋtsɔ ŋa.
Nibii ejwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛdraaa; shi amɛle nii pam.
Amɛji tsatsubii; amɛ lɛ kooloi bibii ni he waaa ni, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛniyenii amɛtoɔ yɛ latsaa be mli.
Afutuɔkɔi hu kooloi ni he waaa ni, kɛ̃lɛ amɛfeɔ amɛtsui yɛ tɛsai amli.
Baalabii hu amɛbɛ maŋtsɛ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛfãa yɛ amɛnɔkwɔlɛi anaa.
Ooonyɛ okɛ onine amɔ tsunyɛ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋtsɛmɛi amɔjiaŋ ehiɔ.
Nibii etɛ̃ yɛ ni amɛfamɔɔ amɛnaji abladeiaŋ; ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, enyiɛmɔ yɛ fɛo.
Nomɛi ji jata ni ji kooloi ateŋ ekãalɔ fe fɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔɔ esɛɛ ehãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko.
kɛ wuɔnuu saase, kɛ too kpakpo kɛ maŋtsɛ ni nyiɛ ewebii ahiɛ abladeiaŋ.
Kɛji ofee buuluianii, ni owo ohe nɔ, aloo ojwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, okɛ onine ato onaabu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji osha fufɔ yɛ tɔ mli lɛ, onaa butru; kɛji oka gugɔ̃ atswrɛ lɛ lá jeɔ; ni kɛji owo mɔ ko mli la lɛ bei baa.
31: Gbalɛ wiemɔi ni Maŋtsɛ Lemuel nyɛ kɛtsɔse lɛ nɛ.
Ao mibi! Ao mimusuŋbi! Ao mishiwoi abi,
kaafite ohewalɛ yɛ yei ahe, ni kaanyiɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afitemɔ gbɛi lɛ anɔ.
Ao, Lemuel, esaaa maŋtsɛmɛi akɛ amɛnu wain; aloo nɔyelɔi akɛ amɛaadi dãa ni wa sɛɛ.
Kɛji amɛnu lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpa mla nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ nɔnalɔi fɛɛ asane hiɛ amɛbu shi.
Okɛ dãa ni wa ahã mɔ ni hiɛ heɔ akpãtã, ni okɛ wain ahã mɛi ni amɛwerɛ eho amɛhe lɛ.
hã amɛnu koni amɛhiɛ̃ akpa amɛhia nɔ, ni amɛkakai amɛhaomɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Wiemɔ ohã mumuii ni nyɛɛɛ awie lɛ; ni ofã mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛfã lɛ ahe.
Wiemɔ ni okojo ohã amɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ye ohaifoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ asane ohã amɛ.
Yoo kpakpa lɛ namɔ aaana? Ejra wa aahuu fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o.
Ewu kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ enɔ; ni lɛ wu lɛ, sɛɛnamɔ ko ebɔŋ lɛ.
Yoo lɛ, ewalabeiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ ejurɔ efeɔ ewu lɛ; shi jeee efɔŋ.
Ebɔɔ toohetsɔi kɛ odonti he mɔdɛŋ; ekɛ enine tsuɔ nii kɛ tsui jurɔ.
Etamɔ jrayeli lɛji ni yaa shɔŋŋ yaŋɔɔ niyenii kɛbaa.
Be ni je tsɛreko po lɛ, eteɔ shi ni efeɔ niyenii ehãa eshiaŋbii, ni etsɔ̃ɔ eweyei lɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔ.
Ekwɛɔ shikpɔŋ ni hi ni eheɔ, ni ejɛɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ mli efeɔ abɔɔ.
Emiaa, ni etsuɔ nii kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ.
Ekwɛɔ jogbaŋŋ dani eheɔ jrayeli nii ni sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he; ekane tete gbooo nyɔɔŋ.
Ekɛ enine mɔɔ odonti mlijiemɔ tso mli, ni ekɛ enine nɔŋŋ hiɛɔ akeke lɛ ni ekɛloɔ mama.
Egbleɔ edɛŋ ehãa nɔnalɔ, ni ekpãa enine mli ehãa ohiafo.
Esheee snoo gbeyei yɛ eshiaŋbii lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ shiaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ bumɔɔ mama tsuji fɛɛfɛji.
Eloɔ saanɔboi ehãa ehe; klaka fɛɛfɛo kɛ afaseo mama ji ehe bo.
Ayoɔ ewu yɛ koi shi, kɛji ekɛ maŋ onukpai tra shi lɛ.
Ekpɛɔ klala atadei kɛ hɛfiinɔ, ni ehɔ̃ɔ ehãa guɔyelɔ.
Ehewulamɔ mli ehewalɛ kɛ ehiɛnyam yɔɔ; ni eŋmɔɔ be ni baaba lɛ.
Ewieɔ nilee wiemɔ, ni etsɔseɔ mɔ kɛ mlihilɛ wiemɔ.
Ekwɛɔ eshiaŋbii lɛ ayaa kɛ baa jogbaŋŋ, ni efeee hejɔ̃ kwraa.
Ebii teɔ shi ni amɛjɔɔ lɛ daa; ni ewu hu kafoɔ lɛ.
Ewu kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, "Yei pii ebɔ mɔdɛŋ moŋ, shi bo lɛ ota amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ!"
Hiɛnyam lɛ lakamɔ ni; ni hefɛo hu, yakayakanɔ ni; shi yoo ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, aaakafo lɛ.
Nyɛŋɔa eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ eko nyɛhãa lɛ, ni hã enitsumɔi lɛ ajie eyi yɛ koii lɛ ashi.

1: Ajɔɔ mɛi ni booo mɛi fɔ̃ɔji aŋaawoo toi, ni amɛkɛ eshafeelɔi ebɔɔɔ, ni amɛtaaa hefɛoyelɔi ateŋ.
Shi moŋ amɛmii shɛɔ Yehowa Mla lɛ he, ni amɛjwɛŋɔ he daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Amɛtamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ fai atoi, ni woɔ yibii yɛ amɛbe mli, ni amɛbai kplaaa, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ shwereɔ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji bɛ nakai; amɛ lɛ amɛtamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa.
No hewɔ lɛ eshafeelɔi nyɛŋ kojomɔ naa amɛdamɔ; amɛnaŋ gbɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kudɔɔ jalɔi agbɛ lɛ, shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji agbɛ lɛ ekɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji yaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.
2: Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ toɔ atuatsemɔ he ajina? Mɛɛba maŋbii lɛ kpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi fɔ̃ɔji?
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tseɔ atūa, ni lumɛi lɛ hu feɔ ekome; amɛkpãŋɔ Yehowa kɛ maŋtsɛ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ yinɔ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔkumɔa amɛgboklɛi lɛ; ni wɔtserɛ amɛkɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ yɛ wɔhe."
Nuŋtsɔ mɔ ni ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ŋmɔ̃ɔ amɛ; ni eyeɔ amɛhe fɛo hu.
Ekɛ amɛ aaawie yɛ emlifu naa, ni ekɛ mlila aaawo amɛhe gbeyei.
Ekɛɛ, "Miwo mimaŋtsɛ yɛ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
"Mashiɛ akpɔ ko ni Yehowa ewo mi," Ekɛɛ, "Mibi ji o, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ mifɔ o.
Bi mi, ni maŋɔ majimaji lɛ mahã o akɛ ogboshinii; ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ ogbɛfaŋnɔ.
Okɛ dade dɛhiɛmɔtso aaakumɔ amɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni ooojwra amɛ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi nyɛlea nii; nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelɔi, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa kɛ gbeyeishemɔ;
nyɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ akotoa lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ emli baafu nyɛ oya, ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã. Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
3: Ao Yehowa, kwɛ mɛi abɔ sɔŋŋ ni haoɔ mi! Mɛi babaoo ni teɔ shi woɔ mi!
Mɛi pii kɛɔ yɛ mihe akɛ, "Mɔ nɛ lɛ, enaŋ yiwalaheremɔ ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ."
Shi Yehowa, boji mihebuu tsɛŋ, boji minumnyam, bo ohãa mihiɛ baa nyam.
Miwoɔ migbee nɔ, miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ Yehowa, ni ejɛɔ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ehereɔ mi nɔ.
Mikãa shi miwɔɔ, ni mihiɛ tsɛ̃ɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa buɔ mihe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Misheee mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ ni ebɔ nsra ewo mihe lɛ gbeyei.
Ao Yehowa, tee shi, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, baahere miyiwala, ejaakɛ bo otswiaa mihenyɛlɔi anii; ni okumɔɔ amɛnyanyɔji owoɔ amɛdaaŋ.
Kunimyeli lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ, Yehowa, ojɔɔmɔ aba omaŋ lɛ nɔ.
4: Mijalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛ mitsɛ lɛ heremɔ mi nɔ. Kɛ efi mi lɛ bo ofɛneɔ mi. Naa mi mɔbɔ, ni obo mifaikpamɔ toi.
Nyɛ gbɔmɛi adesai, mɛɛ beyinɔ nyɛaagbe minumnyam lɛ he guɔ kɛyaashi? Shii enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛaasumɔ yakanii ni nyɛaatoa amale sɛɛgbɛ?
Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa eŋɔ jalɔ lɛ ehã ehe; hewɔ lɛ kɛ̃ mitsɛ lɛ lɛ, eboɔ mi toi.
Kɛji agba nyɛnaa lɛ, nyɛkafea esha; nyɛjwɛŋa enɛ he jogbaŋŋ yɛ nyɛsai anɔ, ni nyɛfea dioo.
Nyɛshãa afɔlei ni sa, ni nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ.
Mɛi pii kɛɔ akɛ, "Namɔ aaafee wɔ ejurɔ! Ao Yehowa, tse ohiɛ ohã wɔ."
Ohã mimli efli mi aahuu fe bɔ ni amɛble kɛ amɛwain pii aaanyɛ ahã amɛmli afli amɛ.
Hejɔlɛ mli makã shi mawɔ yɛ ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa, okoome pɛ ohãa mihiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.
5: Ao Yehowa, bo miwiemɔi lɛ atoi, koni onu mikɔmɔ ni miyeɔ lɛ he ohã mi!
Mimaŋtsɛ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ feemɔ toi ohã miblɔmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ bo fai mikpaa nɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, leebi lɛ bo migbee toi; leebi lɛ bo fai mikpaa, ni bo ohetoo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.
Ejaakɛ ojeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni naa efɔŋfeemɔ he tsui; ni mɔ fɔŋ hu kɛ bo ehiii shi.
Hewolɔi nyɛɛɛ ohiɛ amɛdamɔ, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeelɔi fɛɛ.
Okpãtãa amalelɔi ahiɛ. Lashishwielɔi kɛ shishiulɔi lɛ Yehowa miihi amɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ maba owe lɛ; mikɛ woo aaaja bo yɛ o-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ.
Yehowa, kplamɔ mi yɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ. Hã ogbɛ akã shi faŋŋ ahã mi.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kome nɛkɛ bɛ amɛdaaŋ; amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ fitemɔ; amɛsɛ̃ lɛ, gbonyobu ni agble naa ni; amɛkɛ amɛlilɛi wieɔ dɔkɔbii.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, hã amɛsɔ̃ abua amɛyiteŋ. Hã amɛyiŋshai lɛ nɔŋŋ akpãtã amɛhiɛ. Shɛrɛmɔ amɛ oshwie, ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ onɔ babaoo, ni amɛtse ohiɛ atūa.
Shi mɛi fɛɛ ni baa bo abo lɛ, amɛmli fliɔ amɛ. Hã amɛla lalai be fɛɛ be kɛ miishɛɛ. Mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ ogbɛi lɛ, fã amɛhe ni ohã amɛnya.
Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ojɔɔ, ni okɛ mlihilɛ buɔ ehe tamɔ tsɛŋ.
6: Ao Yehowa, kaakã mihiɛ yɛ omlifu mli, ni okɛ mlila hu akagbla mitoi.
Ao Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ miigbɔjɔ. Ao Yehowa, tsa mi ejaakɛ miikpokpo kɛ gbeyei.
Misusuma hu miikpokpo naakpa. Shi ao Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
Ao Yehowa, kuu osɛɛ, heremɔ miyiwala, baakpɔ̃ mi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ akaiii bo yɛ gbele mli; ni gbohiiaje hu, namɔ aaajie oyi yɛ jɛi?
Etɔ mi kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ; mifɔɔ misaa tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ daa nyɔɔŋ kɛ yaafonu.
Awerɛho ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu, ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, mihiŋmɛii anɔ eha.
Nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtsuɔ nifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa enu miyaafo gbee lɛ.
Yehowa enu mifaikpamɔ lɛ, Yehowa ebo misɔlemɔ toi.
Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛaahao naakpa. Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi trukaa.
7: Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo abo mibaa! Heremɔ miyiwala ni ojie mi yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ adɛŋ.

Heremɔ mi koni henyɛlɔi lɛ akagbla mi kɛtee he ni jielɔ ko bɛ, ni amɛyatserɛ mimli tamɔ jata. 3-4. Ao Yehowa mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛji mitɔ̃ mɔ ko nɔ, kɛji mifee naanyo ko efɔŋ, kɛji miwa mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ ayi lɛ,
no lɛ, hã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ atiu mi ni amɛmɔ mi, ni amɛnaanaa minɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni magbo, ni makã mlu mli.
Ao Yehowa, tee shi kɛ mlila, wo ohe nɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ agrimɔ lɛ hewɔ; Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, ohiɛ atsɛ̃; bo ni oto kojomɔ ofɔ shi.
Buamɔ asafokui lɛ anaa kɛbɔle ohe kɛkpe, ni ojɛ ŋwɛi oye amɛnɔ.
Yehowa, bo okojoɔ mɛi fɛɛ! Ao Yehowa, kojomɔ mi yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa, ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mifeko efɔŋ ko.
Ao, hã mɛi fɔ̃ɔji anɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo; Shi jalɔi lɛ, ojuro amɛ; ejaakɛ boji jalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni okaa tsui kɛ jwɛŋmɔ okwɛɔ.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji mitsɛŋ! Lɛ ehereɔ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jalɛ naa kojolɔ ni; ebuɔ efɔŋfeelɔ fɔ be fɛɛ be.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ tsakeee etsui lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔ eklaŋte naa; ni edɔ egãitso lɛ mli, ni eta.
Esaa emɔgbee dadei lɛ eto o, ni ehã egãimlibii lɛ miikplɛ tamɔ la.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji jwɛŋɔ efɔŋ, ni amɛŋɔɔ efɔŋ hɔ, ni amɛfɔɔ amale.
Etsaa bu, ni ehãa emli kwɔɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ egbeɔ bu ni etsa lɛ mli;
emusu buaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ, ni eyiwalɛ lɛ wulaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eyiteŋ.
Mada Yehowa shi yɛ ejalɛ naa, ni mala majie Yehowa, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, gbɛi lɛ yi.
8: Ao Yehowa, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ! Okɛ onumnyam eha ŋwɛi floofloo.
Ohenyɛlɔi ahewɔ lɛ osaa hewalɛ oto yɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii anaa, bɔ ni afee ni ohã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ amua amɛnaa ni amɛfee diŋŋ.
Kɛ mikwɛ oŋwɛi kɛ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ, nyɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii ni obɔ lɛ,
mɛni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe? Namɔ po ji gbɔmɔbi ni ogbaa ohenaa yɛ ehe?
Kɛ̃lɛ, shwɛ shrao ni ohã ekɛ bo Nyɔŋmɔ aye egbɔ; ni okɛ anumnyam kɛ woo efi lɛ akekre.
Bo ohã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛyeɔ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Oŋɔ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ oto enajiashi ni eye amɛnɔ:
toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ tswɛm kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hu,
kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ kɛ bɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli hu.
Yehowa, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
9: Mada Yehowa shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni magba onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
Ohewɔ lɛ manya; ni mimli aaafli mi. Bo Ofe ni oyɔɔ ŋwɛi floofloo, mala, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ; amɛgbeegbee shi, ni amɛplenee yɛ ohiɛ.
Anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyelɔ ji bo yɛ okojomɔ mli. Ota omaŋtsɛsɛi lɛ nɔ ni oye jalɛ sane ohã mi.
Okã majimaji lɛ ahiɛ, okpãta mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ ahiɛ. Ogbe amɛgbɛi kwrakwra kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo kɛmiiya naanɔ; obutu amɛmaji wuji lɛ; ni kaimɔ po, akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, eeye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ; emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã kojomɔ.
Ekojoɔ je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ekwɛɛɛ hiɛaŋ ekojooo mɛi.
Yehowa ji abobaahe hã mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ, eji abobaahe yɛ fimɔ bei amli.
Ni mɛi ni le ogbɛi lɛ ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ onɔ; ejaakɛ bo Yehowa, okwaaa mɛi ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Yehowa ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ yi! Nyɛgbaa enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli.
Ejaakɛ lɛ mɔ ni etɔɔ lá he owele lɛ, ekaiɔ mɛi ni piŋɔ; ni ehiɛ kpaaa nɔnalɔi ablɔmɔ nɔ.
Ao Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ! Kwɛmɔ mimanehulu ni minaa yɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ. Ao, bo mɔ ni owoɔ minɔ kɛjɛɔ gbohiiaje agboi lɛ amli,
koni majaje oyijiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yerusalembii lɛ agboi lɛ amli, mimli aaafli mi, ejaakɛ ohere miyiwala.
Jeŋ maji lɛ egbee bu ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtsa lɛ mli. Tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛtee lɛ edu amɛ.
Yehowa kɛ ejalɛ kojomɔ ehã ale lɛ; mɛi fɔ̃ɔji edɔ tsɔne ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kpaa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ baaya gbohiiaje.
Shi ohiafo lɛ, jeee daa hiɛ aaakpa enɔ, ohiafo hiɛnɔkãmɔ efeŋ yaka, kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
Ao, Yehowa, tee shi; kaahã adesa miiye kunim. Hã ni akojo majimaji lɛ yɛ ohiɛ.
Ao Yehowa, wo amɛhe gbeyei koni majimaji lɛ ana ale akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ.
10: Ao Yehowa, mɛɛba okɛ mi teŋ ejekɛ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba otee ohe yɛ fimɔ bei amli nɛɛ?
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ ntɛŋ haoɔ ohiafoi. Hã mɛi fɔ̃ɔji adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ etsuiŋ sɛɛdii nibii anɔ; ni amimyelɔ lomɔɔ, ni ekwaa Yehowa.
Mɔ fɔŋ hewoo mli lɛ etaooo Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ; eyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ."
Egbɛi fɛɛ shwereɔ be fɛɛ be; okojomɔ lɛ kwɔ fe lɛ, ejwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he; eyeɔ ehenyɛlɔi ahe fɛo.
Ekɛɔ ehe akɛ, "Eshiii mi kpu; ni amanehulu ko baŋ minɔ gbi ko gbi ko."
Loomɔ kɛ kutumpɔo kɛ yiwaa eyi edaaŋ obɔ̃; haomɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ hɔ elilɛi shishi.
Ewoɔ ka yɛ akrowai amli; egbeɔ mɔ ni efeko nɔ ko yɛ nififiaŋ; ejieɔ ehiɛ ekaa mɔ ni efĩ lɛ.
Edɛkeɔ shi tamɔ jata yɛ olɔtɔ mli; ewoɔ ka koni emɔ ohiafo; ekɛ akpa duɔ ohiafo; ni eshãtãa lɛ kɛyaa.
Ekotoɔ shi, edɛkeɔ shi, ni mɛi ni hewaaa lɛ, gbeɔ ekaa mli.
Mɔ fɔŋ susuɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekpa nɔ, ekɛ ehiɛ etee; ni enaŋ gbi ko gbi ko."
Ao Yehowa, tee shi! Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, jiemɔ ohewalɛ kpo, ohiɛ akakpa nɔnalɔi lɛ anɔ.
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ fɔŋ kwaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ekɛɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ, "Etsɛŋ wɔ akɔŋtaabuu?"
Shi bo lɛ onaa nii, lɛɛlɛŋ bo lɛ okadiɔ haomɔ kɛ awerɛho fɛɛ, koni kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ tu ehe ewo odɛŋ lɛ, oye obua lɛ, ejaakɛ boji awusai abualɔ.
Fitemɔ yiwalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hewalɛ lɛ; kolimɔ enifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni onaaa eko dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa ji maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ. Jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã kɛaaje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ao Yehowa, oboɔ humii asɔlemɔ toi; owoɔ amɛ hewalɛ; ni obaa otoi shi ohãa mi,
koni oye awusai kɛ mɛi ni awaa amɛyi lɛ asane ohã amɛ, koni gbɔmɔ adesa ni jɛ su mli, akawo mɔ he gbeyei dɔŋŋ.
11: Yehowa, bo abo mibaa; mɛɛba nyɛkɛɔ mi akɛ, "Flikimɔ tamɔ looflɔ kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, yiwalɔi edrɔ amɛgãii, ni amɛkɛ gãimlibii lɛ emamɔ kpãi lɛ anɔ koni amɛtsrɛ̃ mɛi kpakpai yɛ dujiaŋ.
Kɛji afite fanesi lɛ, mɛni jalɔ aaanyɛ afee dɔŋŋ?"
Yehowa yɛ e-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ, Ŋwɛi emaŋtsɛ Sɛ̃i lɛ ma. Ehiŋmɛi jwere nɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesaiabii feɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa kaa jalɔ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ, shi yiwalɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi lɛ.
Eeehã la ni tsoɔ grigri kɛ swɔɔ anɛ ashwie mɔ fɔŋ nɔ; kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la ekɛaagbla etoi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ni, ni esumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; mɔ ni ja aaana ehiɛ.
12: Yehowa, ye obua wɔ! Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; ni anɔkwafoi etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lakaa enaanyo. Amɛnaa dɔkɔbii kɛ amɛlilɛi nta.
Yehowa ahã mɛi ni wieɔ dɔkɔbii lɛ afee dioo, kɛ lilɛi ni shwãa nibii wuji lɛ,
mɛi hu ni keɔ akɛ, "Wɔkɛ wɔlilɛi aaana nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ. Wɔnaabui lɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnɔ ni. Namɔ yeɔ wɔnɔ Nuŋtsɔ?"
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛni awa ohiafoi ayi, ni mɛi ni efĩ amɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mate shi, ni mɔ ni shweɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ mahere eyiwala."
Yehowa shiwoi lɛ, shiwoi ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ ni; amɛtamɔ jwiɛtɛi ni aka yɛ shikpɔŋ flɔnɔɔ mli, ni atsuu he nɔtoonɔtoo shii kpawo.
Ao Yehowa, buu wɔhe; baamɔ wɔyi daa kɛjɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji foɔ sa kɛkpeɔ, ni mɛi fɔ̃ɔji nyaa yaka saji ahe yɛ gbɔmɛi abii ateŋ.
13: Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po ni ohiɛ aaakpa minɔ? Kɛyaashi naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ lo? Okɛ ohiɛ baatee mi kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
Mɛɛbe misusuma aaapiŋ, ni maye awerɛho yɛ mitsuiŋ gbi muu fɛɛ. Mɛɛbe mihenyɛlɔ aaawo ehe nɔ yɛ minɔ kɛyashi?
Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛmɔ mi ni ohere mi nɔ; tsiɛ̃mɔ mi koni mikawɔ gbele wɔ.
Kaahã mihenyɛlɔ miikɛɛ akɛ, "Miye enɔ", ni mihaolɔi lɛ akanya yɛ mishigbeemɔ hewɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã. Manya kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ejaakɛ obaahere miyiwala.
Ao Yehowa, mala mahã O, ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.
14: Kwashiai kɛɔ yɛ amɛtsuiŋ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ!" Amɛfite, ni amɛfeɔ nyaŋemɔ nii; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ nɔ̃ kpakpa.
Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ gbɔmɛi abii, akɛ aleee nɔ eeena akɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni le nii lo? Ni etaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lo?
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛdu gbɛ, amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfite. Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ ekpakpa. Dabida, mɔ kome flo nɛkɛ bɛ.
Ani nɔfɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, amɛleee nii? Mɛi ni yeɔ mimaŋbii tamɔ ayeɔ kɔmi, ni amɛsɔleee amɛtsɛɛɛ Yehowa lɛ, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ!
Gbeyei kple aaamɔmɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ jalɔi lɛ yɛ.
Nɔfɔŋfeelɔi aaanyɛ afite ohiafo yiŋtoo nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa ji ebobaahe.
Ao, kulɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ajɛ Zion aba! Kɛji Yehowa hã emaŋ lɛ ku sɛɛ na nii ekoŋŋ, no lɛ Yakob aaanya, ni Israel mii aaashɛ ehe.
15: Yehowa, namɔ aaabote obuu lɛŋ? Namɔ aaaja yɛ Zion, ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ?
Namɔ baaba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja, ni ewieɔ anɔkwale kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ;
mɔ ni kɛ elilɛi yeee mɔ he osheku ni efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko; ni ebɔɔɔ enaanyo gbɔmɔ ahora.
Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa amɛ, shi moŋ ewoɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ ahiɛ nyam; mɔ ni kɛ ekã kitã ni eeena amane yɛ he po lɛ, etsakeee.
Mɔ ni kɛ eshika efaaa eheee hekpa ni fe nine; ni eheee nyɔɔŋnii koni ewie eshi mɔ ni yeɔ bem. Mɔ ni feɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, edidaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
16: Ao Yehowa, buu mihe, ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.
Mikɛɔ Yehowa akɛ, "Boji mi-Nuŋtsɔ; osɛɛ lɛ mibɛ nɔ kpakpa ko."
Hetselɔi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ lɛ, anumnyam gbɔmɛi ji amɛ, ni miyɛ amɛhe tsuijurɔ.
Shi mɛi ni yanyiɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko sɛɛ lɛ, amɛhaomɔi faa. Mifɔseŋ lá ni amɛkɛba afɔleshãa lɛ mishwieŋ shi akɛ afɔle; ni mikɛ minaabu etsiŋ amɛgbɛii atã tete.
Yehowa, boji minɔ fɛɛ nɔ, bo ohãa mi mihiamɔ nii fɛɛ Bo odɛŋ miwala yɔɔ.
Mihusu kpãi eyaje he ni yɔɔ fɛo ehã mi; lɛɛlɛŋ, mina gboshinii ni hi naakpa.
Majie Yehowa, mɔ ni woɔ mi ŋaa lɛ yi; mitsu tete kɛ mi wieɔ nyɔɔŋ.
Mikɛ Yehowa ema mihiɛ daa; akɛni eyɔɔ mininejurɔ nɔ nɛɛ, mididaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui enyɔ mimli, ni misusuma tete miinya; migbɔmɔtso hu yɛ shweshweeshwe.
Ejaakɛ oŋmɛŋ mihe ohaŋ gbohiiaje, ni mɔ ni heɔ onɔ eyeɔ lɛ enaŋ gbohiiaje.
Bo otsɔ̃ɔ mi wala gbɛ. Ohiɛ lɛ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ; ni mimii eshɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
17: Ao Yehowa, bo jalɛ sane toi; too otoi ohã miblɔmɔ ni jeee amale ni lɛ toi.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ buu mi bem, ejaakɛ bo onaa nɔ ni ja.
Kɛji oka mitsui okwɛ, kɛ otao mimli nyɔɔŋ, ni oka mi okwɛ lɛ, onaŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko kwraa yɛ mimli; mikɛ minaabu efeee efɔŋ.
Yɛ gbɔmɛi adesai anifeemɔnii agbɛfaŋ lɛ, mibo odaaŋ wiemɔ toi, ni minyiɛɛɛ yiwalɔi agbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Minane emɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni mishaneko.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, miibo miitsɛ bo, ejaakɛ ooohere mi nɔ; ba otoi shi ohã mi ni obo miwiemɔi lɛ atoi.
Jiemɔ onaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ mi. Ao, bo yiwalaherelɔ ni okɛ ohewalɛ hereɔ mɛi ni taoɔ abobaa lɛ ayiwala kɛjɛɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Baamɔ miyi tamɔ abaa hiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ yi. Okɛ mi atee ofiji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli.
Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ni waa mi yi, kɛ mihenyɛlɔi kakawuai ni ebɔle mi kɛkpe lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛkpiŋ amɛtsui, ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabui wieɔ hewoo wiemɔi.
Amɛjaa misɛɛ mo, amɛbɔleɔ mihe kɛkpeɔ kpula; amɛjie amɛhiɛ amɛka mi koni amɛtsi mi amɛtswa shi.
Amɛtamɔ jata ni kɛ hiɛdɔɔ baatserɛ emilɛ loo; amɛtamɔ jatabi ni ewo antɛo yɛ olɔtɔ mli.
Ao Yehowa, tee shi owo mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni obutu amɛ. Okɛ oklaŋte lɛ ajie misusuma yɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.
Yehowa, kɛ onineshiwalɛ ajie mi kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ni amɛna amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ wala be nɛɛ mli lɛ adɛŋ. Hã amɛmusui ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ toigblamɔ ni osaa oto ohã amɛ lɛ; ni pii ashwɛ ahã amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii.
Mi lɛ, mana ohiɛ, yɛ jalɛ mli; ni kɛ mihiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, mitsui aaatɔ, ejaakɛ mina bɔ ni oyɔɔ.
18: Ao Yehowa, miisumɔ bo; boji mihewalɛ.
Yehowa ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔɔ ni wa, kɛ mijielɔ. Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mitɛsaa, mɔ mli ni mibaa abo yɛ; boji mitsɛŋ kɛ miyawalaheremɔ akloŋto. Boji mimɔɔ ni wa.
Mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni sa yijiemɔ lɛ, ni ehere miyiwala kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Gbele kpãi lalaa mi, ni ŋshɔkei wuji lota mi.
Gbohiiajeŋ kpãi lalaa mi kɛkpe, migbee gbele tsɔnei amli.
Mifīmɔ mli lɛ, mitsɛ Yehowa; mibo mitsɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni eye ebua mi. Ejɛ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ tɔ̃ɔ ni enu migbee; ni miblɔmɔ lɛ bote etoiŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo, ni gɔji lɛ afanesi lɛ hu hoso, ni amɛjo bliblibli; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli efu.
Lasu fã kɛjɛ egugɔ mli kɛtee ŋwɛi; ni la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ jɛ edaaŋ; ŋai ni miitso jɛ edaaŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã ŋwɛi kpoo enaa shi, kɛkɛ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebayi shi ni duŋ kabitii yɛ enajiashi.
Eta kerub nɔ, ni efliki; eta kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ kɛkpleke shi oya.
Ekɛ duŋ ha ehe; atatu kpii ni ewo lutulutu eshi yɛ eyiteŋ tamɔ akatamanso.
Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi kɛ ŋai ni miitso klpɛ kɛtsɔ̃ atatu kabitii lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa shi yɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ ŋwɛishiimɔ, ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ wo egbee.
Etsrɛ̃ egãimlibii lɛ, ni ekɛgbɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ eshwã. Ehã srawa gblagblai ni ekɛgbɛ amɛ eshwã kɛ foi.
Ao Yehowa, oyiŋaa naa kɛ ogugɔŋ mumɔ gbɛɛmɔ naa hã ŋshɔ mli ŋkajai lɛ je kpo, ni je fanesi lɛ bakamɔ shi faŋŋ.
Ekpã enine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni ebawo mi, ni egbla mi kɛjɛ nui babaoo mli.
Ejie mi kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni he wa lɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni hetsɛ̃ɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ; ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe mi kwraa.
Amɛbatua mi yɛ mimanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã mihe.
Ejie mi kɛtee he ni lɛɛ lɛkɛtɛɛ. Ejie mi, ejaakɛ eyɛ mihe tsui.
Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa; ejuro mi, ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ mihe.
Ejaakɛ miba mijeŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni mijeko mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.
Ejaakɛ miye emlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mikuko ekpɔi lɛ ekoeko mli.
Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe yɛ ehiɛ, ni miwiɔ mihe kɛjeɔ nɔsha he.
Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ naa, ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ midɛŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
Yehowa, mɛi ni yeɔ bo anɔkwa lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ oyeɔ amɛ anɔkwa; ni mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ, ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ shwamɔ bɛ ohe.
Mɔ ni he tse lɛ, ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ oyɛ krɔŋŋ; ni mɔ ni bɛ eŋlɛnɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yeee.
Mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ, ohereɔ amɛ; ni mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ, obaa amɛ shi.
Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛɛlɛŋ bo ohãa mi kane; ni ohãa miduŋ mli kpɛɔ kɛ la.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, ohewalɛ naa lɛ, mabutu henyɛlɔi asafo. Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, mahuru gbogbo.
Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, enifeemɔinii fɛɛ hi kɛwula shi. Yehowa yeɔ eshiwoi anɔ. Eji tsɛŋ kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo.
Shi namɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ Yehowa sɛɛ? Ni namɔ ji wɔbobaahe yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ ni miãa mi kɛ hewalɛ; ni ehãa mifeɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ migbɛi fɛɛ mli.
Ehã minajiaŋ wa tamɔ ofrote, ni eŋɔ mi edamɔ gɔji anɔ shweshweeshwe.
Etsɔ̃ɔ mi tawuu, koni manyɛ akɔɔble gãi po mli madɔ.
Ao Yehowa, okɛ oyiwalaheremɔ tsɛŋ lɛ ehere miyawala ni ohewalɛ hiɛ mimli, ni oyibaamɔ lɛ ehã mije agbo.
Ohãa mifamɔɔ minaji zãaŋzãaŋ, ni mishaneee.
Mitiu mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ni minina amɛ; mikpaleee kɛjeee amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi miplenee amɛ.
Mitswia amɛ nii bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ. Amenyɔnyɔi yɛ minaji anaa.
Ejaakɛ omia mi, ni mina hewalɛ kɛhã tawuu, ni ohã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔnyɔi yɛ mihiɛ.
Ohã mihenyelɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã mi, ni mikpãtã mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.
Amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaaa. Amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, shi efooo amɛdaaŋ.
Miwiɛ amɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa. Miloo amɛ mishwie tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
Ohãaa maŋsɔ̃ aba mi kɛ maŋbii ateŋ. Ofee mi majimaji lɛ atsɛ; mɛi ni mileee amɛ po basɔmɔ mi.
Maŋsɛɛbii ba amɛhe shi amɛhã mi; amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛaanu mihe lɛ, amɛkotoɔ mi.
Maŋsɛɛbii atsui fã, ni amɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ je kpo kɛjɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli kɛba.
Yehowa hiɛ kã; ajie mitɛsaa lɛ yi; ni awo miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni tɔɔ mihe owele, ni ebaa maji ashi ewoɔ mishishi lɛ.
Lɛ mɔ ni ehereɔ mi kɛjɛɔ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ. Hɛɛ, bo owoɔ minɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi anɔ; bo ojieɔ mi yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mala majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Yehowa hãa emaŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ kunim kplekplei, ni ejieɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ; ni ji David kɛ eshwiei lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
19: Ŋwɛi gbaa Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni atatu jieɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ lɛ kpo.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi gbaa anumnyam lɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔɔŋ shiɛɔ enilee lɛ.
Anuuu gbee ko, anuuu wiemɔ ko. Ni anuuu amɛgbee ko nɛ,
shi kɛ̃lɛ nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ kpleɔ jeŋ fɛɛ, ni anuɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he. Nyɔŋmɔ eshi buu yɛ ŋwɛi ehã hulu, ni hulu fãa kɛjeɔ kpo,
tamɔ ayɛmfrowu jeɔ kpo kɛjɛɔ epia mli; ni emliflimɔ lɛ, etamɔ foidalɔ mliflimɔ ni ekɛdaa foi.
Ejeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome, ni ebɔleɔ shi kɛyaa naagbeehe kroko, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko etee ehe yɛ enaa la lɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa mla lɛ hi kɛwula shi; ehãa gbɔmɔ susuma naa hewalɛ hee. Yehowa mla lɛ maa shi shiŋŋ; ehãa humii leɔ nii.
Yehowa akpɔi lɛ ja pɛ, ehãa mɔ tsui nyaa. Yehowa kitãi lɛ yɛ krɔŋŋ, ehãa mɔ hiŋmɛi gbleɔ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ he tse, ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ. Yehowa kojomɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, fɛɛ ja kɛmɔ shi.
Amɛyɛ akɔnɔ fe shika, amɛfe shika krɔŋŋ tete; amɛŋɔɔ fe wo, amɛŋɔɔ fe wo agbaku po.
Asaŋ nomɛi bɔɔ otsulɔ kɔkɔ; amɛnɔyeli lɛ, sɛɛnamɔ kple yɛ mli.
Namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etɔmɔi ena? Yehowa, jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ midujiaŋ tɔmɔi amli.
Baamɔ mi otsulɔ, miyi kɛjɛ eshai ni gbɔmɔ hiɛ kã he ni efeɔ lɛ mli. Kaahã eshai lɛ miiye minɔ; no dani mahi kɛwula shi, ni mihe aaaje tɔmɔi kplei amli.
Yehowa, hã midaaŋ wiemɔ kɛ mitsuiŋ susumɔi asa ohiɛ; bo mitɛsaa kɛ mikpɔ̃lɔ lɛ!
20: Yehowa abo bo toi yɛ ofimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ! Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu ohe.
Ejɛ ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eye ebua bo, ni ejɛ Zion ewaje bo.
Ekai afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ kwa, ni oshãa afɔlei lɛ asa ehiɛ.
Ehã o nii ni otsui shweɔ, ni ehã oyiŋtoi fɛɛ aba mli.
Wɔɔbɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ yɛ okunimyeli hewɔ; ni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli wɔɔshi wɔflaŋai yɛ. Yehowa ahã bo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni obiɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ mina mile akɛ Yehowa yeɔ ebuaa maŋtsɛ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ, ni eeejɛ eŋwɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ebo lɛ toi, ni Yehowa aaahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛye kunim.
Mɛi komɛi shwãa fɔ̃ɔ tayaa shwiilii anɔ, ni mɛi komɛi hu okpɔŋɔi anɔ; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hewalɛ nɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ.
Nakai mɛi lɛ, amɛaatswia shi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi; shi wɔ lɛ, wɔɔte shi, wɔɔdamɔ shi shiŋŋ.
Ao Yehowa, hã maŋtsɛ lɛ aye kunim; kɛ wɔfo wɔtsɛ bo lɛ, heremɔ wɔ nɔ.
21: Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ yɛ; ni oyelikɛbuamɔ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ nyaa yɛ.
Nɔ ni etsui shweɔ lɛ, ohãa lɛ; ni nɔ ni ebiɔ lɛ okamãaa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ okɛ nii kpakpai amli jɔɔmɔi kumaa lɛ, ni okɛ shika krɔŋŋ akekre fiɔ eyitso.
Eba wala yɛ odɛŋ, ni ohã lɛ; wala kakadaŋŋ odro lɛ.
Oyelikɛbuamɔ hewɔ lɛ, enumnyam lɛ da; odro lɛ woo kɛ agbojee.
Ojɔɔ lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Na ni enaa bo hãa emii shɛɔ ehe.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ; ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ edidãŋ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ nine aaashɛ ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ anɔ; mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ, onine aaashɛ amɛnɔ.
Kɛ ojie ohe kpo lɛ, oooŋla amɛ tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la. Yehowa aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ emlifu lɛ naa, ni la lɛ aaashã amɛ wɛɛ.
Oookpãtã amɛshwiei ahiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; oookpatã amɛbii hu ahiɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi adesai ateŋ.
Kɛ amɛjwɛŋ ohe efɔŋ, ni amɛto ohe ŋaa gbonyo lɛ, amɛyeŋ kunim.
Ejaakɛ ooota ogãi lɛ oma amɛhiɛ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛjo foi.
Ao, Yehowa, wɔmiiwo onɔ gojoo yɛ ohewalɛ kple lɛ hewɔ! Wɔbaala kɛjie ohewalɛ lɛ yi.
22: Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi? Mɛɛba okɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ teŋ jekɛ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba okɛ mikɛ̃ɛmɔ teŋ jekɛ nɛkɛ?
Ao, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, miblɔɔ shwane, shi ohereee mi nɔ. Miblɔɔ nyɔɔŋ hu, ni mijɔɔɔ mihe.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji o; mɔ koome pɛ yi ni isreal jieɔ kɛ lalai lɛ.
Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ he bo ye, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ onɔ ni ojie amɛ.
Bo amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ, ni ohere amɛ. Bo onɔ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ ni amɛhiɛ gboiii!
Shi mi lɛ, gɔgɔmi kɛkɛ ji mi, mishɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ. Mɛi bɔɔ mi ahora, ni mɛi nyaŋeɔ mi.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni naa mi lɛ yeɔ mihe fɛo; amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ, ni amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei,
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Tuu osane lɛ owo Yehowa dɛŋ; hã ni lɛ ehere bo, hã ni lɛ ehere mɔ he miishɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ."
Bo ojie mi kɛjɛ minyɛ musu mli, ohiɛ mi shweshweeshwe, be ni mikã minyɛ fufɔ naa.
Kɛjɛ mifɔmɔ mli beebe, aŋɔ mi aŋmɛ onɔ. Kɛjɛ be ni minyɛ fɔ mi nɛɛ boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ.
Okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ, ejaakɛshi haomɔ ebɛŋkɛ, ni bualɔ ko bɛ.
Henyɛlɔi babaoo ebɔle mi kɛkpe kpula, tamɔ tsina hii, amɛtamɔ Bashan tsina hii hewalɔi, ni efo sa ewo mihe.
Amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ hatohatoo amɛwoɔ mi; amɛtamɔ jata kramakrama ni miihuu.
Aloo mi ashwie tamɔ nu, ni mitalɔi amli egoi: ni mitsui esere yɛ mimli tamɔ wo agbaku.
Misɛŋ egbi tamɔ ŋɛsuko mli, mililɛi ekpɛtɛ midaaŋ; ni oshi mi oŋmɛ su mli tamɔ gbonyo.
Henyɛlɔi ebɔle mi kɛkpe tamɔ shifɔji; mɛi fɔ̃ɔji asafo efo sa ewo mihe kpula, amɛtserɛ miniji kɛ minaji.
Manyɛ makane mimli wui fɛɛ; mihenyɛlɔi lɛ taa gãa amɛkwɛɔ mi.
Amɛja mitadei lɛ amli amɛhã amɛhe, ni mihebo lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki.
Ao Yehowa, kaahi sɛɛ shɔŋŋ. Ao, bo mihewalɛ, feemɔ oya ni oye obua mi.
Jiemɔ misusuma kɛjɛ klaŋte naa gbele mli, heremɔ miyiwala kɛjɛ shifɔji lɛ adɛŋ.
Jeimɔ mi kɛjɛ jatai adaaŋ, heremɔ miyiwala kɛje wuoi akoji ateŋ.
Majaje onifeemɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ minyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni majie oyi yɛ asafo lɛ mli.
Nyɛ Yehowa gbeyeishelɔi, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi. Nyɛ Yakob shwiei fɛɛ, nyɛwoa ehiɛ nyam; ni nyɛ Israel shwiei bluublu, nyɛkɛ woo ahãa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ekwaaa nɔnalɔ nɔnaa lɛ, ni ekuuu ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ nɔnalɔ nɔ. Shi be ni nɔnalɔ bo etsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehere lɛ nɔ.
Bo ohãa mijieɔ oyi yɛ asafo kple lɛ mli; maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei ni amɛjaa bo lɛ ahiɛ.
Ohiafoi aaaye nii, ni amɛaatrɔ; mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, aaajie eyi. Amɛyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ.
Jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ aaakai, ni amɛaakple kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ; ni majimaji lɛ amli akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaakula shi amɛja lɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni, ni lɛ eyeɔ majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewolɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaakoto. Mɛi ni egboi momo, kɛ mɛi ni baagboi fɛɛ baakoto lɛ.
Yinɔbii fɛɛ aaasɔmɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi baagba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he sane atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ.
Abaajaje atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni afɔko tete lɛ akɛ lɛ, Yehowa lɛ, ehere maŋ lɛ yiwala.
23: Yehowa ji mikwɛlɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko ehiaŋ mi.
Ehãa mibuɔ shi yɛ lɛɛhei ni jwɛi frɔ̃frɔ̃ yɔɔ. Ewaa mi kɛyaa nui ni he jɔ lɛ ahe.
Ehãa minaa hewalɛ hee. Ekplaa mi kɛtsɔ̃ɔ jalɛ gbɛi anɔ yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Asaŋ kɛ minyiɛ gbele hɔ̃ɔŋ jɔɔ lɛŋ tete lɛ, misheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okɛ mi yɛ. Otookplamɔtso kɛ odɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ, nomɛi shɛjeɔ mimii.
Oŋmɛɔ mi okplɔ̃ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ahiɛ. Okɛ mufɔɔmu woɔmiyiteŋ; mikpulu lɛ eyi kɛteke nɔ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, ejurɔyeli kɛ omɔbɔnalɛ aaanyiɛ misɛɛ yɛ miwala be lɛ fɛɛ mli; ni asaŋ, mahi Yehowa we lɛ miwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
24: Shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni; ni je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, enɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ lɛ eto shishi yɛ ŋshɔi ashishi tɔ̃ɔ̃ ni ehã ema shi shiŋŋ yɛ fai anɔ.
Namɔ aaakwɔ Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ? Ni namɔ aaadamɔ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?
Mɛi ni amɛdɛŋ bɛ esha ko ni amɛtsuii amli tse. Mɛi ni kɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei hãaa yakayaka nifeemɔ, ni amɛkãaa amale kitã.
Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, amɛaana jɔɔmɔ kɛaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ. Amɛaana bembuu kɛaajɛ amɛyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji gbɔmɛi ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, mɛi ni baa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ao nyɛ agboi, nyɛholea nyɛyitsei anɔ! Ao nyɛ blema shinai, nyɛholea nyɛhe nɔ koni anumnyam maŋtsɛ lɛ aba mli.
Namɔ ji anumnyam maŋtsɛ nɛɛ? Lɛji Yehowa, hewalɔ kɛ kãkãlɔ. Lɛji Yehowa, ta mli kunimyelɔ lɛ.
Nyɛgbelea agboi lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a, nyɛgbelea blema shinai lɛ, koni anumnyam maŋtsɛ lɛ aba mli.
Namɔ ji anumnyam maŋtsɛ nɛɛ? Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni. Lɛji anumnyam maŋtsɛ lɛ.
25: Ao Yehowa, bo miwoɔ misusuma nɔ mihãa.
Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo onɔ mihiɛ kã, kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi, kaahã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ onɔ lɛ, ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ eshwieŋ shi. Mɛi ni ji yaka atuatselɔi lɛ moŋ ahiɛ aaagboi.
Ao Yehowa, hã male ogbɛ̃i lɛ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi otempɔ̃ŋi lɛ.
Kplamɔ mi kɛnyiɛ onɔkwale lɛ mli, ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii; ejaakɛ boji miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ. Bo onɔ mihiɛ kã daa nɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kaimɔ omɔbɔnalɛ kɛ omlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe.
Ao Yehowa, kaakai miblahiiaŋ eshai kɛ tɔmɔi lɛ; shi moŋ kaimɔ mi yɛ omlihilɛ kɛ okpakpafeemɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ.
Yehowa hi, ni jalɔ ji lɛ, hewɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ eshafeelɔi gbɛ ni ja.
Ekplaa heshibalɔi kɛnyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ egbɛ lɛ.
Suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo, kɛ anɔkwayeli sɔŋŋ ji Yehowa gbɛ̀i fɛɛ, kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ mihe esha lɛ ofa mi, ejaakɛ eda.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, lɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ ni enyiɛ nɔ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeshwere, ni eshwiei aaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, amɛ ekɛbɔɔ naanyo, ni ehãa amɛleɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.
Mihiŋmɛii kwɛɔ Yehowa gbɛ daa nɛɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ eeejie minaji kɛaaje yaa mli.
Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ! Ejaakɛ mɔ kome mɔ ji mi; minii yɛ mɔbɔ.
Mitsui mli haomɔi lɛ fa; jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mifimɔi lɛ amli!
Kwɛmɔ minɔnai lɛ, kɛ mihaomɔi lɛ; ni okɛ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ afa mi.
Kwɛmɔ mihenyɛlɔi, ejaakɛ emɛyi fa; kwɛ bɔ ni amɛkɛ yiwaa nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ.
Ao, buu miwala he ni ohere mi; kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi, ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.
Emuuyeli kɛ jalɛ abaa miyi; ejaakɛ bo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, kpɔ̃ Israel kɛje ehaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.
26: Ao Yehowa, buu mi bem, ejaakɛ miiba mijeŋ jobaŋŋ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ kwraa ni migbaŋ afã.
Ao Yehowa, taomɔ mimli ni oka mi okwɛ. Kaa mitsui kɛ mijwɛŋmɔ,
ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɛ mihiɛ be fɛɛ be, ni minyiɛɔ yɛ onɔkwale lɛ mli.
Mikɛ yakayaka gbɔmɛi traaa shi; ni mikɛ osatofoi hu ebɔɔɔ.
Minyɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji agwabɔɔ lɛ, ni mikɛ yiwalɔi hu traaa shi.
Ao Yehowa, mifɔɔ midɛ̃ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miyeko sɔ̃ ko, ni mibɔleɔ ofɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mijaa bo.
Milaa shidaa lala waa, ni migbaa onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, misumɔɔ owe he ni ohiɔ lɛ, kɛ he ni onumnyam lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kaakpãtã mihiɛ oshi eshafeelɔi anɔ, ni kaakpãtã miwala hiɛ ofata lãshishwielɔi ahe.
Kaaŋɔ mi ofata mɛi ni feɔ nifɔ̃ɔjianii, ni amɛheɔ nyɔɔŋnii lɛ ahe.
Shi mi lɛ, mibaa mijeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ emuuyeli mli; heremɔ mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ.
Midamɔ he ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe. Majie Yehowa yi, yɛ gwabɔɔ kple lɛ mli.
27: Yehowa ji mila kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, namɔ po gbeyei mashe? Yehowa ji miwala hewalɛ ni wa, namɔ hiɛ po mihe aaakpokpo yɛ?
Kɛji efɔŋfeelɔi ba amɛbatua mi, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe po, amɛaatrɛ, ni amɛaagbeeegbee shi.
Kɛji asafo ko gba ta ewo mi po, mitsui efaŋ. Kɛji ta te shi wo mi tete lɛ, no mli po lɛ, mana ekãa.
Nɔ koome mibiɔ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ni no sɛɛgbɛ mitiuɔ: akɛ mahi shi yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, miwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ; ni mana Yehowa lɛ, ni makase nii hu yɛ e-Sɔlemwe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ fimɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, eeeŋɔ mi etee ebuu lɛŋ teemɔhe lɛ, eeewo mi edamɔ tɛsaa nɔ.
Ni eeewo minɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni ebɔle mi lɛ anɔ' ni mikɛ mlifimɔ aaabɔ oshe, ni mashã afɔle yɛ ebuu lɛŋ. Mala, ni matswa saŋku mahã Yehowa.
Ao Yehowa, kɛji mibo mitsɛ o lɛ, bo mi toi. Naa mi mɔbɔ, ni ohere mi nɔ.
Owiemɔ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, "Nyɛtaoa mihiɛgbɛ." "Yehowa, bo ohiɛgbɛ lɛ mitaoɔ nɛɛ."
Kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi. Kaashwie otsulɔ yɛ mlifu naa. Boji miyelikɛbualɔ. Kaashɛ mi ofɔ̃, ni kaakwa mi hu, miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Kɛji mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ kwa mi tete lɛ, bo Yehowa ooobaa miyi.
Ao Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi ogbɛ lɛ, ni okpla mi kɛtsɔ̃ tempɔŋ ni kã shi faŋŋ nɔ; ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi fa.
Kaaŋmɛɛ mihe ohã tamɔ bɔ ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ taoɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ amale odasefoi ete shi ewo mi, ni amɛmiishwe ni amɛwa mi yi.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, miheɔ miyeɔ akɛ mana Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Kwɛmɔ Yehowa gbɛ; wajemɔ ohe, ni ona tsui, ni okwɛ Yehowa gbɛ.
28: Ao Yehowa, bo miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ, bo mitɛsaa, kaatsimɔ otoi. Kɛji ofooo midaaŋ lɛ, matamɔ mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ.
Kɛji mibo mitsɛ o koni ohere mi, ni mihole miniji anɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, bo mifaikpamɔ gbee lɛ toi.
Kaaloo mi kɛ yiwalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ oshwie. Mɛi ni kɛ amɛnanemɛi wieɔ toiŋjɔlɛ wiemɔi shi amɛtsuiiaŋ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
Nakai nɔfɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, wo amɛ nyɔmɔ, yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii kɛ amɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ anaa. Wo amɛ nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anaa. Too amɛ najiaŋ bɔ pɛ ni sa amɛ.
Akɛni amɛbuuu Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ kɛ eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ eeebutu amɛ, ni amɛteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, ejaakɛ ebo mifaikpamɔ gbee toi.
Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ mitsɛŋ; enɔ mikɛ mitsui fɔ̃ɔ, ni eyeɔ ebuaa mi ni minaa tsuijurɔ. Mikɛ milala aaada lɛ shi.
Yehowa ji ewebii lɛ ahewalɛ, ni lɛji mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ yiwalaheremɔ mɔ̃ɔ.
Yehowa, heremɔ omaŋbii lɛ ayiwala, ni ojɔɔ owebii ni oŋɔ akɛ onɔ lɛ. Lɛɛ amɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ, ni ohiɛ amɛ mli kɛya naanɔ.
29: Ao nyɛ ŋwɛibii, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi; nyɛkɛ anumnyam kɛ hewalɛ ahãa Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ anumnyam ni sa Yehowa gbɛi lɛ ahãa lɛ. Nyɛkɛ hewulamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ajaa Yehowa.
Anuɔ Yehowa gbee yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ. Anumnyam Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ miishi; Yehowa yɛ ŋshɔi wuji anɔ tete.
Yehowa gbee lɛ yɛ hewalɛ. Yehowa gbee eyi obɔ̃ kɛ agbojee.
Yehowa gbee lɛ kumɔɔ tsenedrui lɛ, Yehowa kumɔɔ Lebanon tsenedrui lɛ.
Ehãa Lebanon gɔji lɛ tumɔɔ tamɔ tsinabii; ni ehãa Hermon Gɔŋ tumɔɔ tamɔ tsina oblanyo.
Yehowa gbee lɛ hãa srawai gblaa.
Yehowa gbee hosoɔ shiaŋa lɛ, Yehowa hosoɔ Kadesh ŋa lɛ.
Yehowa gbee hãa odumtsei hosoɔ ni ehãa koo mli tsei ayibai kplaa; ni yɛ e-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mɛi fɛɛ blɔɔ akɛ, "Anumnyam!"
Yehowa ta nu afua nɔ eeye maŋtsɛ; Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Yehowa aaahã ewebii hewalɛ; Yehowa aaajɔɔ emaŋ lɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
30: Ao Yehowa, makafo O, ejaakɛ ojie mi, ni ohãaa mihenyɛlɔi aye mi yɔɔ.
Yehowa mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, miblɔ mitsɛ o, ni otsa mi.
Yehowa, ojie misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje, kulɛ mifata mɛi ni yaa gbonyobu lɛŋ lɛ ahe; shi mi lɛ, okpale mi kɛba walaŋ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, nyɛ mɛi ni ji emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
Ejaakɛ hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ emlifu hiɔ shi; shi emlihilɛ lɛ hiɔ shi walabeiaŋ fɛɛ. Yaafo toɔ mɔ gbɛkɛ, shi miishɛɛ baa leebi.
Mi lɛ, mikɛɛ yɛ mishweremɔ mli akɛ, "Mididaŋ gbi ko gbi ko."
Ao Yehowa, omlihilɛ naa lɛ, ohã mima shi shiŋŋ tamɔ gɔŋ. Shi moŋ be ni okɛ ohiɛ tee mi pɛ, ni mitsui fã.
Bo Yehowa miblɔ mitsɛ, ni bo Yehowa fai mikpa.
"Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ migbele he, kɛji mikpleke shi kɛbote gbonyobu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ? Ani su aaajie oyi lo? Aloo eeejaje onɔkwale lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ?
Ao Yehowa, bo toi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ. Ao Yehowa, ye obua mi."
Ohã mikɔmɔyeli lɛ estɔ̃ miishɛɛ joo ehã mi. Ojie mihe kpekpe lɛ, ni okɛ miishɛɛ ebu mi tamɔ mama.
No hewɔ lɛ, misusuma aaajie oyi, ni emuaŋ enaa. Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ mada o shi daa kɛya naanɔ.
31: Ao Yehowa, bo abo mibaa, kaahã mihiɛ miigbo gbi ko gbi ko. Okɛ ojalɛ lɛ ahere mi.
Ba otoi shi ohã mi. Feemɔ oya ni ohere mi. Tsɔ̃ mibobaahe tɛsaa, kɛ mɔ̃ɔ ni wa ni okɛhere miyiwala.
Hɛ̃ɛ! Boji mitsɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ. Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ mihiɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ.
Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ mli; ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ pɛ ji mibobaahe.
Miitu mimumɔ miiwo bo odɛŋ, ejaakɛ bo okpɔ̃ mi. Ao Yehowa, bo Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo.
Minyɛɔ mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ yaka amãgãi anɔ lɛ, shi mi lɛ, Yehowa nɔ mihiɛ kã.
Mimli aaafli mi, ni manya yɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ. Ejaakɛ ona minɔnaa lɛ, ni ole mihaomɔ lɛ.
Oŋmɛko mihe owoko henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ; shi moŋ, ohã minane ena maahe.
Ao Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, shi efi mi; mihiŋmɛii kɛ mikla kɛ migbɔmɔtso fɛɛ egbɔjɔ kɛ awerɛho sɔŋŋ.
Shi miyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ miwalabeiaŋ fɛɛ, ni midɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ mifii lɛ amli. Mihe esha hewɔ lɛ, mihewalɛ nɔ egbɔ ni miwui lɛ amli hu egbɔjɔ.
Mitsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔnɔ mihã mihenyɛlɔi. Mitsɔ̃ jatsu kple mihã mihe gbɔmɛi; mitsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ yɛ minanemɛi ahiɛ. Mɛi ni naa mi yɛ blohuiaŋ lɛ, joɔ minaa foi.
Hiɛ ekpa minɔ tamɔ gbonyo ni ajie jwɛŋmɔ yɛ enɔ, Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɛ́ ko.
Hɛɛ! Miinu mɛi pii miiwie ablɛbi. Gbeyei ebɔle mi kɛkpe be ni amɛkpãŋɔ miyi nɔ koni amɛkpãtã mihiɛ lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, bo Yehowa onɔ mihiɛ kã. Mikɛɔ akɛ, "Boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ!"
Miwala be lɛ yɛ odɛŋ; jiemɔ mi kɛje mihenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ adɛŋ.
Osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, heremɔ miyiwala. Kwɛmɔ mi otsulɔ koni ona mi mɔbɔ.
Ao Yehowa, kaahã ashwie mihiɛ shi, ejaakɛ bo miboɔ mitsɛɔ. Hã miyiwalɔi lɛ moŋ ahiɛ ashwie shi. Hã amɛtɔ mu kɛya gbohiiaje.
Hã amalelɔi lɛ amua amɛnaa, mɛi ni kɛ hewoo kɛ heguɔgbee wieɔ wiemɔi ni esaaa shiɔ jalɔi lɛ.
Ao, kwɛ bɔ ni omlihilɛ ni oyɔɔ kɛhã mɛi ni sheɔ o gbeyei lɛ fa babaoo hã. Ojieɔ otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni baa bo abo lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
Oŋɔɔ amɛ oteɔ yɛ ohiɛ teemɔhe lɛ mli. Kɛjeɔ mɛi ayinɔ kpãŋmɔi amli, ni okɛ amɛ toɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ obuu lɛ mli.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa ejaakɛ ejie enaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, be ni atua mi tamɔ maŋ ko ni asa eyi lɛ.
Yɛ mitsuifãa mli lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ashwie mi kɛje ohiɛ kɛtee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ." Kɛ̃lɛ, be ni mibo mitsɛ o lɛ, obo mifaikpamɔ toi.
Nyɛsumɔa Yehowa, nyɛ hetselɔi fɛɛ. Yehowa baa anɔkwafoi ayi, shi henɔwolɔi fɛɛ. Yehowa baa anɔkwafoi ayi, shi henɔwolɔi lɛ, ewoɔ amɛ nyɔmɔ babaoo.
Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛhiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ, nyɛwajea nyɛhe, ni nyɛfea ekãa.
32: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni akɛ etɔmɔ efa lɛ, ni atsumɔ ehe eshai lɛ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni Yehowa enaaa nɔ sha ko yɛ ehe; in ebɛ mɔlakamɔ mumɔ lɛ.
Be ni mitsimɔ mihe esha nɔ lɛ, mitã loo yɛ huumɔ ni mihuuɔ daa jenamɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, onine tsii yɛ minɔ. Mimli hewalɛ fɛɛ tã tamɔ bɔ ni latsaa be mli jeŋ dɔlɛ hãa nii amli nu ŋaa lɛ.
Mijaje mihe esha lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ o, ni minifɔɔjianii lɛ, mitsimɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ. Mikɛɛ akɛ, "Majaje mitɔmɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa." Kɛkɛ ni okɛ mihe esha kɛ tɔmɔ lɛ fa mi.
No hewɔ lɛ hã anɔkwafoi fɛɛ asɔle atsɛ o; ni kɛji haomɔ babaoo ba tamɔ faa ni etue lɛ, eninaŋ amɛ.
Boji mibobaahe. Amanehulu mli lɛ, bo obaa miyi. Okɛ miishɛɛ oshebɔɔ ebɔle mihe kɛkpe.
Mi, Yehowa, mawo bo ŋaa, ni matsɔ̃ɔ o gbɛ ni onyiɛ nɔ; mihiŋmɛi aaakã ohe.
Nyɛkatamɔa okpɔŋɔ loo tejiokpɔŋɔ ni leee nii ni akɛ manyoflɛ kɛ esɛɛ kpãa woɔ amɛ dani amɛhiɔ kudɔmɔ lɛ.
Piŋmɔi babaoo yɛ hã mɔ fɔŋ lɛ; shi mɔ ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo ebɔle ehe kɛkpe.
Ao nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe, yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni nyɛmli aflia nyɛ. Nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ nyamɔ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ, ni nyɛja kɛmɔ shi.
33: Nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛnyaa Yehowa he! Jalɔi anɔ ji akɛ amɛjie Yehowa yi.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi kɛ saŋku; nyɛlaa nyɛjiea eyi kɛ kpãanyɔŋma saŋku.
Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa lɛ, nyɛtswaa kpãa saŋku jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛbɔa oshe waa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni, ni etsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli.
Esumɔɔ jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli; Yehowa mlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ.
Yehowa wiemɔ naa abɔ ŋwɛi yɛ, ni ekɛɛmɔ naa abɔ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii fɛɛ yɛ.
Ebua ŋshɔ mli nu fɛɛ naa, efee lɛ bibioo tamɔ tɔ mli nii; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli nu babaoo lɛ, etsi naa eto nitoohe.
Hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ashe Yehowa gbeyei. Hã je lɛŋ bii fɛɛ he akpokpo yɛ ehiɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ ewie ni eba mli; lɛ efã ni je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ.
Yehowa hãa majimaji lɛ ayiŋtoi lɛ feɔ yaka; ni etswaa amɛyiŋtoi lɛ efɔ̃ɔ.
Yehowa yiŋtoi lɛ, hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; ni etsuiŋ susumɔi lɛ yɛ hã yinɔbii fɛɛ.
Ajɔɔ maŋ ni e-Nyɔŋmɔ ji Yehowa kɛ maŋ ni ehala akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ.
Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ, ni enaa gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ.
Ejɛɔ he ni eta yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ enaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ.
Lɛ eshɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ atsuii, ni enaa amɛnifeemɔi fɛɛ.
Jeee tabilɔi babaoo hãa maŋtsɛ yeɔ kunim; jeee tawulɔ ekãalɔ hewalɛ kple lɛ hereɔ eyiwala.
Yakatswaa ni akɛ hiɛ fɔ̃ɔ tayaa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛhã kunimyeli; ehewalɛ kple lɛ nyɛŋ mɔ yiwala ahere
Yehowa hiŋmɛii yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni amɛhiɛ kã esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe.
Yehowa aaajie amɛ kɛaaje gbele mli, ni eeehã amɛyi ana wala yɛ hɔmɔ be mli.
Wɔmiikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; lɛji wɔbualɔ kɛ wɔtsɛŋ.
Emli wɔnaa miishɛɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔhiɛ kã.
Ao Yehowa, hã osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ kɛwɔ ahi shi bei abɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã onɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
34: Majie Yehowa yi be fɛɛ be; eyijiemɔ aaakã midaaŋ daa nɛɛ.
Mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ. Mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim anu he, koni amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe.
Ao, nyɛ kɛ mi akafoa Yehowa agbojee, ni nyɛhãa wɔfea ekome kɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!
Mitao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, ni ehere mi nɔ; ni ejie mi kɛje migbeyeishemɔ fɛɛ mli.
Ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ enɔ, ni ohiɛ eshwieŋ shi gbi ko gbi ko, shi moŋ ohiɛ aaaba nyam.
Ohiafo blɔ etsɛ Yehowa, ebo lɛ toi, ni ehere lɛ kɛjɛ ehaomɔi fɛɛ mli.
Mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ bɔleɔ amɛhe kɛkpeɔ, ni ejieɔ amɛ.
Nyɛsaa nyɛnaa nyɛkwɛa, ni nyɛaana akɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ. Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Nyɛshea Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko fiŋ amɛ.
Efīɔ jatabii, ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ; shi mɛi ni toaɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nɔ kpakpa ko ehiaŋ amɛ.
Ao mibii, nyɛbaa, nyɛboa mi toi; mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ bɔ ni asheɔ Yehowa gbeyei ahãa.
Namɔ taoɔ akɛ eyi ana wala? Namɔ sumɔɔ akɛ etsɛ yɛ jeŋ ni ena nɔ kpakpa?
Mɔ olilɛi mli ni ekafee efɔŋ; mɔ onaabu hu mli ni ekamale.
Wii ohe kɛje efɔŋ he, ni ofee ekpakpa. Taomɔ toiŋjɔlɛ ni onyiɛ no sɛɛ.
Yehowa hiŋmɛi kã jalɔi ahe, ni efeɔ toi ehãa amɛblɔmɔi.
Yehowa jieɔ ehiɛ ekaa efɔŋfeelɔi, koni akakai amɛ kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛ jalɔi fo tsɛ Yehowa lɛ, eboɔ amɛ toi; ni ehereɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ amɛfimɔi fɛɛ amli.
Yehowa bɛŋkɛɔ mɛi ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ etã, ni ehereɔ mɛi ni werɛ eho amɛhe lɛ.
Jalɔ naa amanehulu babaoo, shi Yehowa jieɔ lɛ kɛjɛɔ fɛɛ mli.
Ebaa ewui ayi shweshweeshwe; ewu kome flo nɛkɛ ekuŋ.
Efɔŋ nɔŋŋ aaagbe efɔŋfeelɔ, ni mɔ ni nyɛɔ jalɔ lɛ aaabu lɛ fɔ.
Yehowa hereɔ etsuji ayiwala; ni mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ, ebuŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko fɔ.
35: Ao Yehowa, okɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ ana; okɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi wuɔ lɛ awu!
Kɔ tsɛŋ wulu kɛ tsɛŋ bibioo ni ote shi oye obua mi.
Gblamɔ akplɔ kɛ lema owo mɛi ni nyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ. Kɛɛmɔ misusuma akɛ, "Miji oyiwalaheremɔ."
Mɛi ni nyiɛ misɛɛ ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi, ni amɛhe guɔ agbo. Mɛi ni jwɛŋɔ mihe efɔŋ lɛ, hã ashwie amɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛ hiɛgble.
Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ shwieɔ amɛ kɛyaa lɛ hã amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa.
Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, hã amɛgbɛ nɔ awo duŋ ni enɔ ashãmɔ.
Mifeko amɛ efɔŋ ko kwraa shi amɛtsɔ mi tsɔne amɛtee; koni edu mi, ni amɛtsa bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ koni magbee mli ni magbo.
Hã amɛhiɛ akpãtã trukaa. Hã tsɔne ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ adu amɛ. Hã amɛgbee bu ni amɛtsa lɛ mli ni amɛhiɛ akpãtã.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, misusuma mli aaafli lɛ yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, mimii aaashɛ mihe, ejaakɛ ehere mi.
Migbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, "Ao Yehowa, namɔ tamɔ bo, bo mɔ ni ohereɔ gbɔjɔlɔi kɛjɛɔ mɛi ni hewa waa fe amɛ lɛ adɛŋ; ni ohereɔ gbedelɔi kɛ ohiafoi kɛjeɔ mɛi ni yeɔ amɛ amim lɛ adɛŋ."
Odasefoi yiwalɔi teɔ shi woɔ mi. Amɛbiɔ mi nibii ni mileee he nɔ ko.
Amɛkɛ efɔŋ toɔ mi ekpakpa najiaŋ; mikla tete etɔ biti.
Shi mi lɛ, be ni amɛhe yeɔ lɛ, mibu kpekpe; mikɛ ŋmãahilɛ wa mihe yi, ni mima miyitso shi misɔle,
tamɔ nɔ ni minaanyo loo minyɛminuu he ŋkɔmɔ miyeɔ lɛ. Minyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ ni mima miyi shi, tamɔ mɔ ko ni enyɛ egbo ni eeye enyɛ he ŋkɔmɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, kɛ mitɛ lɛ, amɛbuaa amɛhe naa kɛ miishɛɛ; amɛbuaa amɛhe naa amɛwoɔ mi; niiahetswialɔi ni mileee amɛ lɛ, kpaaa miheguɔ gbee.
Amɛyeɔ mihe fɛo ni amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ; amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi amɛwoɔ mi.
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛbe oookwɛ enɛ kɛyashi? Jeimɔ mi kɛje amɛdɛŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, heremɔ miyiwala kɛjɛ jatai nɛɛ adɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mada o shi yɛ asafo kple lɛ mli; majie oyi yɛ mɛi pii ahiɛ.
Kaahã mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ; ni kaahã mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ mikpɛkpɛɛ mi.
Ejaakɛ amɛwieee hejɔlɛ wiemɔ; shi moŋ amɛfoɔ saji amɛshwieɔ mɛi ni he jɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ hatoo amɛwoɔ mi; amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Yiɛ, yiɛ, wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛi."
Ao Yehowa, bo diɛŋtsɛ ona, kaafee diŋŋ! Ao Yehowa, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ kwraa.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi-Nuŋtsɔ, kojomɔ ohã mi. Wo ohe nɔ ni oye misane lɛ ohã mi.
Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, buu mi bem yɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa, ni kaahã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ.
Kaahã amɛmiikɛɛ yɛ amɛyiŋ akɛ, "Gbeebi akle, nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ nɛ." Kaahã amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, "Wɔnine egbe lɛ."
Mɛi ni nyaa yɛ mimanehulu hewɔ lɛ hã ashwie amɛhiɛ shi ni amɛhiɛ agboi. Mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ, ni amɛtsɛɔ amɛhe yɛ minɔ lɛ, hã amɛhiɛgble kɛ heguɔgbee lɛ atsɔ̃ amɛhe bo.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mi ejurɔ lɛ, hã amɛbɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ ni amɛkɛɛ daa akɛ, "Naa Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo; lɛ enyaa etsulɔ ejurɔyeli he kɛ miishɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ, majaje ojalɛ lɛ, ni majie oyi daa nɛɛ.
36: Efɔŋ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ wieɔ yɛ etsuiŋ tɔ̃ɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ kome flo nɛkɛ bɛ yiwalɔ mli.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lakaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɛ anaŋ enifɔɔjianii lɛ ni anyaŋe.
Edaaŋ wiemɔi fɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ kɛ shishiumɔ sɔŋŋ ni; eshi nilee kɛ ekpakpafeemɔ sɛɛ.
Etoɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa be ni ekã esaa nɔ; ni eyiɔ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ; nɔ fɔŋ ko kwraa bɛ ni enyaŋeɔ.
Ao Yehowa, osuɔmɔ nii sɛɛ efooo lɛ, kwɔ kɛshɛɔ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ. Onɔkwayeli lɛ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ojalɛ nɔkwɔlɛ tamɔ gɔŋ, ni okojomɔ mlikwɔlɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ mli kwɔlɛ. Ao Yehowa, bo ohereɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ yiwala.
Ao Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ jra wa naakpa, ni gbɔmɛi abii baa abo yɛ ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛyeɔ owe lɛŋ nii babaoo amɛtrɔɔ naakpa; ni amɛnuɔ omlihilɛ lɛ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ.
Ejaakɛ boji wala fɛɛ nubu; ni ola lɛ hãa wɔnaa nii faŋŋ.
Ao, hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ ahi shi daa ahã mɛi ni lɛ bo, ni oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ hu ahi shi daa ahã mɛi ni ja kɛmɔ shi lɛ.
Kaahã hewolɔ lɛ naanaa minɔ, ni kaahã yiwalɔ hu miiwo mi foi.
Efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ jwere shi butuu nɛɛ; atsirɛ amɛ atswia shi, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ
37: Kaawo otsui he la yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi ahewɔ; asaŋ ohiɛ akakɔ̃ mɛi ni feɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ eyeŋ be ko ni aaaflɔ amɛ ashwie tamɔ jwɛi; ni amɛaaŋla tamɔ baa fɔ.
Ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ni ofee nɔ kpakpa, bɔ ni afee ni ohi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.
Hã omii ashɛ ohe yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni eeehã bo nii ni otsui shweɔ lɛ.
Tuu ohe owo Yehowa dɛŋ. Hemɔ lɛ oye, ni eeeye ebua bo.
Eeehã ojalɛ akpɛ faŋŋ tamɔ hulu la; ni obemyeli hu aaaje kpo faŋŋ tamɔ shwane.
Feemɔ dioo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni oto otsui shi omɛ lɛ. Kaawo otsui he la yɛ mɔ ni egbɛ eja ehã lɛ lɛ hewɔ. Kaawo otsui he la yɛ mɔ ni toɔ ŋaa fɔ̃ɔji ni etsuɔ he nii hu lɛ hewɔ.
Kaahã omli miifu, ni omli akawo la kwraa. Kaawo otsui he la, efɔŋfeemɔ mli pɛ ekɛ mɔ yaa.
Ejaakɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, aaaflɔ amɛ ashwie; shi mɛi ni mɛɔ Yehowa lɛ, amɛaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eshwɛ be fioo kɛkɛ, ni mɔ fɔŋ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, oootao lɛ yɛ eshihilɛhe tete; shi onaŋ lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ; ni amɛmii aaashɛ amɛhe yɛ amɛshweremɔ babaoo hewɔ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kpãŋɔ jalɔi ayinɔ, ni amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔjiashi amɛwoɔ amɛ;
shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋmɔɔ yiwalɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ enaa akɛ enaagbee miiba.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji egbla klaŋte ni amɛdrɔ amɛgãi lɛ, ni amɛtsrɛ nɔnalɔi kɛ ohiafoi ni amɛgbe mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja.
Amɛkɛ amɛklaŋte lɛ aaagbegbee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe, ni aaakumɔ amɛgãii lɛ amli dukuduku.
Nii fioo ni jalɔ yɔɔ lɛ hi fe mɛi fɔ̃ɔji babaoo anii.
Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ahewalɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baakpãtã hiɛ, shi jalɔi lɛ Yehowa hiɛɔ amɛmli shweshweeshwe.
Mɛi ni shwamɔ bɛ amɛhe lɛ, Yehowa le amɛwalabe, ni amɛshwiei aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Fimɔ bei amli lɛ, amɛhiɛ gboŋ, ni hɔmɔ bei amli hu lɛ, amɛaatrɔ.
Shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã! Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ amɛnunyam tamɔ jwɛiiaŋ fɔfɔi, amɛaatã tamɔ lasu.
Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ faa shika yɛ mɔ dɛŋ, ni ewooo; shi jalɔ dɛŋ kpɔɔ, ni ehãa mɔ nɔ.
Mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ; shi mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ lɛ, aaaplenee amɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nanefaamɔi fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ eyɔɔ, ni mɔ ni Yehowa miishɛɔ ehe lɛ, ehãa enane mɔɔ shi.
Kɛ nakai gbɔmɔ gbee shi lɛ, ekãŋ jɛi, ejaakɛ Yehowa hiɛ enine mli.
Sa lɛ, gbekɛ ji mi, ni agbɛnɛ mitsɔ̃ nuumo; shi minako jalɔ ko ni akwa lɛ, ni eshwiei miisisɛ̃ aboloo pɛŋ.
Ehãa mɔ nɔ daa nɛɛ, ni efaa mɔ nɔ, ni eshwiei tsɔ̃ɔ jɔɔmɔ.
Wii ohe kɛjɛ efɔŋ he, ni ooohi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa sumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; ekwaŋ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. Abaabaa jalɔi ayi kɛya naanɔ, shi mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ashwiei lɛ, aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Jalɔi lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni amɛaahi nɔ kɛya naanɔ.
Jalɔ naabu wieɔ nilee wiemɔ, ni elilɛi wieɔ nɔ ni ja.
Etoɔ e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ yɛ etsui mli, ni eshiii sɛɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Efɔŋfeelɔ gbɔbiɔ jalɔ, ni etaoɔ lɛ egbe;
shi Yehowa eŋmɛŋ jalɔ lɛ he ewoŋ ehenyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ; ni abuŋ jalɔ lɛ fɔ hu yɛ kojomɔ mli.
Mɛɛ Yehowa ni onyiɛ egbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eeewo onɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ onɔ; ni ooona mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ.
Mina mɔ fɔŋ yiwalɔ ko ni eewa yi ni eewo ehe nɔ tamɔ Lebanon tsenedrutso.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ mitsɔ̃ jɛi ekoŋŋ kɛho ni naa, ebɛ jɛi; mitao lɛ moŋ shi anaaa lɛ.
Kadimɔ mɔ ni hi kɛwula shi; ni okwɛ mɔ ni ja; toiŋjɔlɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ eshwiei shwereɔ babaoo.
Shi efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ aaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei lɛ hu aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Yehowa hereɔ jalɔi ayiwala. Lɛji amɛbobaahe yɛ haomɔ be mli.
Yehowa yeɔ buaa amɛ, ni ehereɔ amɛyiwala. Ekpɔ̃ɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ yiwalɔi adɛŋ, ni ehereɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaa lɛ abo.
38: Ao Yehowa, kaakã mi yɛ omlifu naa, ni kaagbla mitoi yɛ omlila naa,
ejaakɛ ogãimlibii lɛ etsulɔ mimli, ni onine etsii yɛ minɔ.
Omlifu hewɔ lɛ, mihewojiaŋ ejɔɔɔ mi; mihe eshai ewo mi hela.
Ejaakɛ minishaianii lɛ esu mi, etamɔ jatsu ni tsii yɛ minɔ.
Mikwashiafeemɔ hewɔ lɛ, mifaji lɛ ekpɔtɔ, eeje fu.
Midɔ kɔmɔɔ, ni mikumɔ, jenamɔ muu fɛɛ lɛ minyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Ejaakɛ mihɛ mli miishã mi, ni mibɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ.
Migbɔjɔ, ni mikumɔ kwraa, mitsui miiwa mihe, no hewɔ ni mikɛ̃mɔɔ lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, ole mishwee nii fɛɛ; mihuumɔ lɛ, akɛteeko o.
Mitsui tswaa kplakpla; mihewalɛ miitã; ni mihiŋmɛii amli la egbo.
Minanemɛi kɛ mihemɛi tsiɔ amɛhe kɛjeɔ mihe yɛ mile faji lɛ ahewɔ; ni miwekumɛi hu damɔɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ akpãtã lɛ, etsɔ̃ amɛtsɔnei lɛ. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi awui aye lɛ amɛkɛ amɛlilɛi fiteɔ mi, ni amɛkpãŋɔ miyinɔ be fɛɛ be.
Mitamɔ toimulɔ, minuuu nii; ni mitamɔ mumui, minyɛɛɛ mawie.
Hɛɛ! Mitamɔ mɔ ko ni nuuu nii, mɔ ni nyɛɛɛ sane po naa ejie.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, bo Yehowa, onɔ mihiɛ kã. Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo obaahã mi hetoo.
Shi mifaikpamɔ ji akɛ, kɛ mishane migbee shi lɛ, kaahã mihenyɛlɔi, mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ yɛ minɔ lɛ, miiye mi yɔɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, miihe magbee shi, ni mikãhe miipiŋ lolo.
Miijaje mitɔ̃mɔ lɛ; mihe esha lɛ miidɔ mi naakpa.
Mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ, amɛhe wa fe mi; ni mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi eflo lɛ, ayi fa naakpa.
Mɛi ni ŋɔɔ efɔŋ toɔ ekpakpa ni mifeɔ najiaŋ lɛ, ete shi ewo mi; ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mifeɔ ekpakpa.
Ao Yehowa, kaakwa mi; Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, miyiwalaherelɔ, ofai nɛ, ba mramra ni obaye obua mi.
39: Mikɛɛ akɛ, "Male mihenɔkwɛmɔ koni mikɛ mililɛi akafee esha. Mowa minaabu manyoflɛ; be mli ni mɛi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ mihiɛ nɛɛ."
Mitɔ mu, ni mitswaaa misɛŋ; mimua minaa, shi fɛɛ yakatswaa, mipiŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ mi.
Mitsui mli miishã mi. Babaoo ni mitsuimlishãa lɛ woɔ wu ji no; Kɛkɛ ni migble minaa mikɛɛ
"Yehowa, hã male minaagbee, kɛ miwala gbii lɛ ayibɔ, bɔ ni ji, hã male tsɛ ni mitsɛŋ lɛ."
Naa, ofee miwala gbii kuku lɛ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ, ni miwala be lɛ, jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ ohiɛ. Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ adesa yɔɔ lɛ, kɛ edamɔ nɔ akɛ mɛ, lamɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ ehoɔ eyaa tamɔ hɔɔŋ. Anɔkwa, egbaa ehe naa yakatswaa. Etīaa nii anaa, tsɛbelɛ eleee mɔ ni baaye.
"Ni agbɛnɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni mimɛɔ? Mihiɛnɔkãmɔ fɛɛ ji bo.
Kpɔ̃ mi yɛ mitɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli; kaahã kwashia miibɔ mi ahora.
Mitɔ mu: mitswaaa misɛŋ, ejaakɛ bo ohã mipiŋ.
Kaagwao mi dɔŋŋ; yii ni oyiɔ mi lɛ, ehã migbede.
Okãa gbɔmɛi adesai ahiɛ yɛ esha hewɔ, ni ofiteɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jra wa hã amɛ tamɔ omlɛ̃gɛ̃ fiteɔ.
Ao Yehowa, bo mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi ni ofee toi ohã mikɔmɔyeli lɛ. Mihiɛ yaafonu lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaamua onaa; ejaakɛ oshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔ kɛkɛ ji mi, mɔ kpɔŋ tamɔ mitsɛmɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Foo omlifu lɛ sɛɛ koni mana miishɛɛ fioo dani mashi biɛ maya."
40: Mikɛ tsuishitoo kwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; eba etoi shi, ni enu miblɔmɔ lɛ.
Efã mi kɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ bu lɛ mli, ejie mi kɛjɛ ŋmiamɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ minaji mamɔ tɛsaa nɔ, ni ehã minane mɔ shi.
Etsɔ̃ɔ mi lala hee ko lamɔ, no ji lala ni akɛjieɔ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi. Mɛi babaoo aaana, ni amɛaashe gbeyei; ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni ŋɔɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni ekɛ hewolɔi ebɔɔɔ, ni ekɛ mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ kɛyanyiɛɔ amale nyɔŋmɔi asɛɛ lɛ hu ebɔɔɔ lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ Onaakpɛɛ nibii lɛ fa babaoo hã wɔ; ni ojwɛŋmɔ ni oyɔɔ yɛ wɔhe lɛ hu fa naakpa. Mɔ ko bɛ ni akɛ lɛ aaato ohe. Kɛji majaje ni mawie he lɛ, amɛfa fe bɔ ni aaanyɛ akane.
Lã afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, onyaaa he, shi moŋ ogbele mitoiŋ faŋŋ. Shãa afɔle kɛ esha afɔle hu otaooo.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Naa mi; miba; mi ni aŋma mihe sane yɛ wolo kpo lɛ mli lɛ.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, eŋɔɔ minaa akɛ mafee osuɔmɔnaanii; Omla lɛ yɛ mitsui mli."
Ao Yehowa, mijaje kpɔ̃mɔ jurɔ sane lɛ, yɛ asafo kple lɛ mli; naa, ole hu akɛ mimuako minaa.
Oyelikɛbuamɔ ni okɛhereɔ yiwala lɛ, mitsimɔko nɔ yɛ mitsui mli. Mijaje onɔkwayeli kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ; Mishiuko osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwale lɛ nɔ yɛ asafo kple lɛŋ.
Ao Yehowa, kaakãma ni omɔbɔnale lɛ; hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwale lɛ abaa miyi daa.
Ejaakɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni anyɛŋ akane ebɔle mi kɛkpe. Mihe eshai lɛ fa fe mi, bɔ sɔŋŋ ni minyɛɛɛ mihiɛ nɔ mawo. Amɛfa fe miyiteŋ tsɔi, mitsui po efã yɛ mimli.
Ao Yehowa, ofai nɛ ni ojie mi. Ao Yehowa, ye obua mi oya.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ akpãtã lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ agboi; ni amɛhiɛ ashwie shi. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi awui aye lɛ, hã amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛheguɔ agbo.
Mɛi ni kɛɔ mi akɛ, "Gbeebi akle lɛ," hã amɛhe ajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ amɛhiɛgble lɛ hewɔ.
Shi moŋ, hã mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ anya, ni amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe yɛ omli. Mɛi ni sumɔɔ odɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ akɛɛ daa akɛ, "Yehowa je agbo."
Tsɛbelɛ, ohiafo ji mi ni efi mi moŋ nɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋɔ minɔ. Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, boji mibualɔ kɛ mikpɔ̃lɔ, kaatsɛ kwrakwra!
41: Ajɔɔ mɔ ni jwɛŋɔ ohiafo nɔ; gbi fɔŋ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaahere lɛ.
Yehowa aaabaa eyi, ni eeena wala, ni aaajɔɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔŋ lɛ owoŋ ehenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ lɛ lɛ adɛŋ.
Yehowa aaatsɔmɔ lɛ yɛ ehela saa nɔ, ni eeetsa ehelai lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ehã lɛ.
Mi lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ ni otsa mi, ejaakɛ mifee esha mishi bo."
Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ wieɔ mihe kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ. Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Mɛɛbe eeegbo ni egbɛi aaalajekwraa hu!"
Kɛji mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ba mi sramɔ lɛ, amɛkwaa amɛwieɔ osato wiemɔi, be mli ni amɛmiijwɛŋ efɔŋ yɛ amɛtsuiaŋ, ni kɛ amɛje kpo lɛ, amɛyagbaa no.
Mɛi fɛɛ kwa ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ, amɛwieɔ mihe ablɛbi, ni amɛsusuɔ efɔŋ amɛhãa mi.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Gbele hela ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ni shi ni ekã nɛɛ eteŋ shi."
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mishieŋtsɛ po ni miheɔ lɛ miyeɔ, mɔ ni yeɔ midɛŋ aboloo lɛ efã ntia eshi mi.
Shi bo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, ni otee mi shi, koni mawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Enɛ mikɛaale akɛ oyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ lɛɛlɛŋ, ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi yeko minɔ kunim.
Owoɔ minɔ, ejaakɛ mifeɔ nɔ ni ja; ni oto mi yɛ ohiɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ. Amen! Amen!
42: Bɔ ni ofrote shweɔ faa ni hoɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ misusuma shweɔ bo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Misusuma miiye bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ he kumai. Te be po ni maba, ni mabana Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ hu?
Mihiɛ yaafonu etsɔ̃ miniyenii shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, be mli ni mɛi biɔ mi akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ?"
Miwerɛ hoɔ mihe, kɛji mikai enɛɛmɛi: bɔ ni mi kɛ asafo yuu nyiɛɔ, bɔ ni amɛtoɔ yuu, ni minyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ; bɔ ni asafo lɛ bɔɔ oshe kɛ miishɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ shidaa lalai yeɔ gbijurɔ lɛ.
Ao misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ? Mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ? Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ejaakɛ shi majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Misusuma efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ mimli, no hewɔ ni mikaiɔ bo, yɛ Yordan shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon gɔji lɛ, kɛ Hermon gɔji lɛ, kɛ Mizar gɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ.
Onujɔi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ jijeɔ, eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ. Oshɔkei kɛ omlɛ̃mlɛ̃i lɛ fɛɛ ekumɔ eshwie minɔ, ni esu miyi.
Shwane lɛ, Yehowa jieɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi; ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ milaa Yehowa he lala; ni misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ dɛŋ ni miwala yɔɔ lɛ.
Mikɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mitɛsaa lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba sa akɛ manyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ haomɔ ni henyɛlɔ haoɔ mi lɛ hewɔ?"
Ahora ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ mi lɛ, shãa mi tamɔ fla, be mli ni amɛbiɔ mi daa akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?" lɛ.
Ao misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ mimli nɛkɛ? Ni mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ? Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ejaakɛ shi majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
43: Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, ye misane lɛ ohã mi; ni obu mi bem. Fã mihe yɛ maŋbii ni sheee bo gbeyei lɛ adɛŋ. Jiemɔ mi yɛ shishiulɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ adɛŋ!
Ejaakɛ boji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ abo ni mibaa. Mɛɛba oshɛ mi ofɔ̃? Mɛɛba sa akɛ manyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ haomɔ ni henyɛlɔ haoɔ mi lɛ hewɔ?
Ao, hã ola kɛ onɔkwale lɛ aba; koni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ. Hã amɛ kɛ mi aba Zion ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ o-Sɔlemɔwe lɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ maya Nyɔŋmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he; maya Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa mi miishɛɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ŋɔɔ; ni matswa saŋku mikɛaajie oyi. Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ao misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ? Ni mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ? Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ; shi majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃ mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
44: Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi; wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ egba wɔ nibii ni otsu yɛ amɛyinɔ, yɛ blema bei lɛ amli.
Bɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oshwie maji lɛ, ni otɛo owebii yɛ jɛi; bɔ ni ohao maji krokomɛi lɛ, shi owebii lɛ ohã amɛshwere.

Ejaakɛ jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛklaŋte nɔ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ; asaŋ jeee amɛnineshiwalɛ hã amɛye kunim; shi moŋ ohewalɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ naa, kɛ ohiɛ ni kã amɛhe lɛ hã amɛye kunim; ejaakɛ oyɛ amɛhe tsuijurɔ.
Boji mimaŋtsɛ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ohã Israel ye kunim srɔtoi lɛ.
Ohewalɛ naa wɔtsirɛɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi wɔtswiaa shi yɛ; ogbɛi mli wɔnaanaa mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ wɔ lɛ anɔ yɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeee migãi nɔ mihiɛ kã, asaŋ jeee miklaŋte aaahere miyiwala.
Shi moŋ bo ohere wɔyiwala yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni ohã mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ ahiɛ gboi.
Bo Nyɔŋmɔ, onɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ daa nɛɛ, ni wɔɔda bo shi daa kɛaatee naanɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okwa wɔ, ni oba wɔ shi; ni okɛ wɔ efãaa ta dɔŋŋ.
Ohãa wɔjoɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi anaa foi, ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ hee wɔnii.
Ofee wɔ tamɔ toi ni akɛ amɛ miiya gbeehe; ni ogbɛ wɔ oshwã majimaji lɛ amli.
Ohɔ̃ɔ omaŋbii lɛ ofoo, ni ahe amɛ mlɛo.
Ohã mɛi ni bɔle wɔ lɛ bɔɔ wɔ ahora, mɛi ni bɔle wɔ lɛ yeɔ wɔhe fɛo ni amɛŋmɔɔ wɔ.
Ohã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni abuuu amɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ; wɔtsɔ̃mɔ hefɛoyelinii wɔhã majimaji lɛ.
Minaa mihiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ daa jenamɔ tuu; ni hiɛgble hu emɔ mi,
yɛ ahorabɔlɔi lɛ kɛ sopalɔi lɛ awiemɔi ahewɔ; ni hiɛgble hu mɔɔ mi kɛ mina mihenyɛlɔ kɛ mina mihenyɛlɔ kɛ oweletɔlɔ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eba wɔnɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔhiɛ kpako onɔ, ni wɔkuko wɔkɛ o teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.
Wɔkwako bo, ni jeee akɛ wɔbako wɔjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ,
