shi kɛ̃lɛ okumɔ wɔ butubutu yɛ ŋaŋgbei ahilɛhe ni okɛ duŋ kabitii eha wɔnɔ nɛɛ.
Eji wɔhiɛ ekpa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyaja maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko kulɛ,
ani bo Nyɔŋmɔ, oleŋ lo? Ejaakɛ ole tsuiiaŋ teemɔŋnii.
Naa, ohewɔ lɛ akpãtãa wɔhiɛ be fɛɛ be, ni abuɔ wɔ tamɔ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, tee shi, mɛɛba owɔɔ? Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, kaashrɛ wɔ oshwie kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Mɛɛ hewɔ okɛ ohiɛ etee? Mɛɛba ohiɛ ekpa wɔmanehulu kɛ yi ni awaa wɔ lɛ nɔ?
Ejaakɛ anaanaa wɔnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ; ni wɔgbɔmɔtso eka su mli.
Tee shi ni obaye obua wɔ. Yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ heremɔ wɔyiwala.
45: Mitsui eyi tɔ kɛ wiemɔi kpakpai. Nii maŋtsɛ he lalawiemɔ nɛ. Mililɛi tamɔ niŋmalɔ ni he esa niŋmaatso.
Ohe yɛ fɛo fe gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ. Odaaŋ wiemɔ he tse, hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔɔ bo kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ao, bo hewalɛtsɛ maŋtsɛ, miamɔ kɛ oklaŋte yɛ ogbojee kɛ onumnyam mli.
Fãa kɛ agbojee kɛyaye kunim, kɛfã anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ he. Ohewalɛ aaahã oye kunim wuji.
Ogãimlibii anaa ba; amɛgbulɔɔ maŋtsɛ henyɛlɔi atsuiiaŋ; ni majimaji pleneɔ yɛ onaji anaa.
Omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ni, ni ema shi kɛmiiya naanɔ. Olumɔyeli tsi lɛ, jalɛ saneyeli tsi ni.
Osumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ. No hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã oyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ fe onanemɛi maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.
Otadei amli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ anuatrɛ kɛ kashia ŋma. Kpãa saŋkui atswaa akɛshɛjeɔ omii yɛ shwuɔwu mɔ̃ji amli.
Maŋtsɛmɛi abiyei futu oyei hiɛnaanɔbii ateŋ. Maŋnyɛ lɛ ewula kɛ Ofir shika kɛdamɔ oninejurɔ nɔ
Ao biyoo, bo toi, jwɛŋmɔ he; ohiɛ akpa bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋbii kɛ otsɛ we lɛ nɔ.
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakɔ̃ ohefɛo nɔ. Akɛni lɛji onuŋtsɔ lɛ, kotomɔ lɛ.
Tirobii kɛ maŋ lɛŋ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ tete kɛ nikeenii aaaba koni amɛkɛtao ohiɛ gbɛ?
Maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ ewula kiŋkaŋŋ yɛ opia lɛŋ. Etade lɛ akɛ shika kpãa elo mli.
Ewula kɛ atadei ni aye ŋaabii kɛ amɛsui srɔtoi awo mli; ni akpla lɛ kɛyahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, esɛɛbii enanemɛi oblayei froi krokomɛi nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Amɛkɛ nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ boteɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛŋ.
Obihii lɛ aaabaye oblematsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ. Ooowo amɛ lumɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Mahã akai onumnyam gbɛi lɛ yinɔi fɛɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, jeŋ gbɔmɛiabii fɛɛ aaajie oyi daa kɛaatee naanɔ.
46: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔbobaahe kɛ wɔhewalɛ, wɔyelikɛbualɔ krɔŋŋ yɛ fimɔ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji shikpɔŋ hiɛ tsɔ̃ bu shi, kɛji gɔji famɔ yagbee ŋshɔŋ teŋteŋ tete po lɛ, wɔsheŋ gbeyei.
Kɛji ŋshɔ lɛ hūu, ni efee hamahama; kɛji gɔji tete hoso yɛ ŋshɔ grimɔ naa po lɛ, wɔsheŋ gbeyei.
Faa ko yɛ ni eniji lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe. Ehãa Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ shihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe.
Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ emaŋ lɛ mli; nɔ ko nɔ ko haŋ maŋ lɛ afite. Nyɔŋmɔ aaaye abua lɛ leebi maaŋkpa.
Majimaji lɛ feɔ hoo; maŋtsɛyelii lɛ hosoɔ. Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ egbee ni shikpɔŋ lɛ sereɔ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ wɔ yɛ; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji wɔbobaahe;
Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwea Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ; Nyɛbakwɛa bɔ ni ehã hiɛkpãtãmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ehãa tawuumɔ sɛɛ foɔ kɛyashɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ. Ekumɔɔ gãii amli, ni efiteɔ akplɔi. Ekɛ la shãa tsɛŋi lɛ.
"Nyɛfea dioo, ni nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mi, miji Nyɔŋmɔ; Awo minɔ gojoo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, Awo minɔ gojoo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ."
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ wɔ yɛ; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji wɔbabaahe.
47: Nyɛ maji fɛɛ tswɛm, nyɛtswaa nyɛdɛ̃; nyɛkɛ nyamɔ lala abɔa oshe waa ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo lɛ, ehe yɛ gbeyei. Maŋtsɛ kple ji lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Eba maŋbii ashi ewo wɔshishi, ni ehã wɔye majimaji anɔ.
Eŋɔ wɔgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã wɔ, Yakob, mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, shwãanii lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ etee ŋwɛi kɛ oshebɔɔ. Yehowa kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ jijemɔ etee ŋwɛi.
Nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ; nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai koo! Nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa wɔmaŋtsɛ, nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai koo.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ. Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ lalai!
Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ maŋtsɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maji lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ ebua amɛhe naa kɛba; ni amɛbatsɔ̃mɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ webii. Ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tawuu nibii lɛ, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni. Awo enɔ gojoo.
48: Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ kple, yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ maŋ lɛŋ, yɛ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ Zion shimaa yɛ fɛo. Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tsui he nɔ ni. Zion gɔŋ ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ wulu lɛ maŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ehã ale akɛ kɛji oyɛ emaŋ lɛŋ mɔji lɛ amli lɛ, oyɛ abobaahe shweshweeshwe.
Shi naa, maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ bua amɛhe naa amɛba kutuu kɛba Zion gɔŋ lɛ he.
Amrɔ ni amɛna Zion lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe; ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ amɛ, Kɛkɛ ni tswrao amɛjo foi.
Gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛhe jra amɛ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔ̃mɔ,
loo tamɔ boka kɔɔyɔɔ, ni miijwra Tarshish lɛji.
Bɔ ni wɔnu lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔna yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, maŋ wulu lɛŋ. Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã emaŋ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔsusu osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he yɛ o-Sɔlemɔwe lɛŋ.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, bɔ ni ogbɛi lɛ jijeɔ lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ oyijiemɔ jijeɔ, kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei. Oninejurɔ eyi obɔ kɛ kunimyeli.
Hã Zion gɔŋ lɛ anya, hã Yuda maji lɛ amli afli amɛ yɛ ejalɛ kojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Nyɛnyiɛa kɛbɔlea Zion he kpula; nyɛkanea emli mɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ.
Nyɛtɛ̃jea nyɛhiɛ nyɛkwɛa gbogboi lɛ; nyɛkpaa emli mɔji wuji lɛ amli, koni nyɛgbaa yinɔbii ni baaba lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ lɛji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Lɛ nɔŋŋ eeetsɔ̃ɔ wɔ gbɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
49: Nyɛboa enɛ toi, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ! Nyɛ jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi,
nyɛ mɛi ni abuɔ kɛ mɛi ni abuuu, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi fɛɛ!
Nilee wiemɔ baajɛ midaaŋ; mitsuiŋ susumɔ lɛ niiashishinumɔ ni.
Mafee toi mahã abɛbuaiaŋ wiemɔ, ni mikɛ saŋku aaatsɔ̃ɔ mijenu lɛ shishi.
Mɛni hewɔ mashe gbeyei yɛ haomɔ bei amli; be ni mishishinyiɛlɔi kɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ebɔle mi,
mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛninamɔ nɔ ni amɛshwãa akɛ amɛyɛ shika babaoo?
Ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyi nyɔmɔ ewo; aloo enyɛ ekpɔ̃ ehe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ;
ejaakɛ wala kpɔ̃mɔ nii lɛ ejra wa tsɔ̃, bɔ ni enyɛŋ he nyɔmɔ ewo kɔkɔɔkɔ,
koni ehi shi kɛya naanɔ ni ekana gbohiiaje.
Hɛɛ! Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa akɛ nilelɔi tete gboiɔ; asaŋ kwashia kɛ buulu fɛɛ hu gboiɔ; ni amɛshīɔ amɛjwetrii fɛɛ amɛhãa mɛi krokomɛi.
Amɛyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛgbonyobui lɛ ji amɛshīai kɛmiiya naanɔ. Jɛi ji amɛshihilɛhei kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ; tsɛbelɛ, amɛtsɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi akɛ amɛnɔ pɛŋ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa, ekaŋ enumnyam mli, ebaagbo tamɔ kooloo nɔŋŋ.
Mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ nɔ, ni nɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa amɛhiɛ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛnaagbee yɔɔ nɛ:
gbohiiaje kã shi hã amɛ tamɔ toi, gbele baatsɔ̃ amɛkplalɔ. Amɛaakpleke shi oya kɛaatee gbonyobu mli; ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ aaakpɔtɔ. Gbohiiaje aatsɔ̃ amɛwe
Shi mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje hewalɛ dɛŋ. Ejaakɛ eeehe mi eto.
Kaashe mɔ ko ni etsɔ̃ niiatsɛ, ni ewe lɛŋ anumnyam efa babaoo lɛ gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ kɛ egbo lɛ, eŋɔŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛyaŋ. Eninamɔ lɛ ekoeko enyiɛŋ esɛɛ kɛyaŋ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ be ni eyɔɔ wala mli lɛ, ebuɔ ehe akɛ eyi tɔ kɛ miishɛɛ; ni mɛi hu jieɔ eyi akɛ "Yɛ jogbaŋŋ" moŋ nɛ;
shi kɛ̃lɛ, eeetee etsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ gbohiiaje; mɛi ni enaŋ la kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa nyɛŋ ehi enumnyam shihilɛ mli sɔŋŋ; etamɔ kooloo ni hiɛ kpatãa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
50: Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa Ofe lɛ, miiwie ni eetsɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛmiijɛ hulu shiteehe kɛyaashi eshinyɔɔhe.
Nyɔŋmɔ miikpɛ kɛmiijɛ Zion ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛwula shi lɛ mli.
Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ miiba, ebaaa lɛ kpoo. La ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ; ni ahum kple bɔle ehe.
Etsɛ ŋwɛi, ni etsɛ shikpɔŋ, akɛ ebaakojo emɛi lɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbuaa mimɛi anɔkwafoi lɛ anaa nyɛhãa mi; mɛi ni etsɔ̃ afɔle nɔ amɛkɛ mi ekpãŋ lɛ.
Ŋwɛi tete jajeɔ ejalɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ji kojolɔ lɛ.
Ao mimɛi, nyɛboa toi, mibawie. Ao Israel, maye odase mashi o. Miji Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Jeee afɔlei lɛ ahewɔ mikãa o; oshãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ mihiɛ daa!
Mitaoo owe lɛŋ tsina nuu ko loo otoi atsu lɛŋ too kpakpo ko.
Ejaakɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ koo mli, kɛ tsinai ni yɔɔ gɔji akpe nɔ lɛ, mi, minɔ ni.
Mile ŋwɛi loofɔji fɛɛ, ni kooloi ni nyiɛ ŋa mli fɛɛ lɛ, minɔ ni.
Kɛji hɔmɔ miiye mi lɛ, mikɛŋ bo, ejaakɛ je lɛ kɛ emli nii fɛɛ lɛ, minɔ ni.
Ani miyeɔ tsina loo, aloo minuɔ too abotiai ala?
Ŋɔɔ shidaa afɔle ohã Nyɔŋmɔ; koni oye oshi ni owo ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ nɔ;
Tsɛ mi yɛ fimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ! Majie o, ni ooowo mihiɛ nyam."
Shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni hegbɛ oyɔɔ akɛ ojaje mikpɔi lɛ aloo akɛ ohã mikpãŋmɔ lɛ akã olilɛi nɔ?"
Ejaakɛ osumɔɔɔ tsɔsemɔ, ni otswaa miwiemɔ ofɔ̃ɔ afã.
Kɛji ona julɔ ko lɛ, onaanyo ni; ni okɛ gblãfitelɔi bɔɔ.
Ohãa onaabu gbɛ, ni ewieɔ nɔ fɔŋ; ni olilɛi foɔ amale etãa.
Otaa shi oyeɔ onyɛmi he osheku; onyɛ musuŋbi tete po, ofiteɔ egbɛi.
Enɛɛmɛi ofee, shi akɛni mifee dioo hewɔ lɛ, osusuɔ akɛ mitamɔ bo nɔŋŋ. Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, miikã ohiɛ, ni mikɛmiimamɔ ohiɛ faŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkadia enɛ kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mibatserɛ nyɛmli dukuduku ni mɔ ko bɛ ni baahere nyɛyiwala.
Mɔ ni shãa shidaa afɔle lɛ, eewo mihiɛ nyam. Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ ojogbaŋŋ lɛ, mibahere eyiwala.
51: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ. Omɔbɔnale babaoo naa lɛ, gbee mitɔmɔi lɛ.
Fɔ mihe nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ oshwie, koni ohã mihe atse,
Ejaakɛ mitɔmɔi lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mile; ni mihe eshai fɛɛ ma mihiɛ daa.
Bo okoome pɛ mifee esha mishi, ni mifee efɔŋ yɛ ohiɛ. Oyeɔ bem kɛji ooobu mi fɔ, ni tɔ̃mɔ bɛ okojomɔ he.
Naa, afɔ mi yɛ esha mli, ni esha mli mi nyɛŋɔ mi hɔ yɛ.
Naa, nɔ ni otaoɔ yɛ midɛŋ ji anɔkwayeli; no hewɔ lɛ hã male nii yɛ mimligbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mihe esha lɛ okɛ awrɔke afɔ, koni mihe atse; juu mihe, ni mayɛ futaa fe ayilɔ.
Hã manu nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ he; hã wui ni bo okumɔ lɛ amli afli amɛ.
Kaakwɛ eshai ni mifee lɛ; fɔ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ oshwie.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, bɔɔ tsui ni mli tse ohã mi; dromɔ mi mumɔ hee ni gbugbãaa.
Kaashwie mi yɛ ohiɛ, ni kaajie o-Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ mimli.
Hã manu miishɛɛ ni yɔɔ oyiwalaheremɔ mli lɛ he ekoŋŋ; baamɔ mimli toiboo mumɔ lɛ yi,
Koni matsɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃lɔi okitãi lɛ, koni eshafeelɔi aku amɛsɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, kpɔ̃ mi kɛje lashishwiemɔ hɛ fɔyeli mli, ni mala waa kɛjaje okpɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, gblemɔ minaa, ni minaabu ajaje oyijiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ.
Ejaakɛ onyaaa afɔle he; kɛji mishã shãa afɔle tete lɛ onyaŋ he.
Afɔle ni sa ohiɛ ji mumɔ ni werɛ eho ehe. Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, tsui ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ lɛ, okpooŋ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ Zion ejurɔ yɛ odromɔ naa; tswaa Yerusalem gbogboi lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooona afɔlei ni sa ahe tsui shãa afɔlei jio, kooloo muu afɔle ni jio, no ni akɛ tsina hii baashã afɔle yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
52: Ao bo gbɔmɔ kãkãlɔ, mɛɛba okɛ onifɔɔjianii ni ofee oshi mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ shwãa lɛ?
Bo yiŋshatsɛ, olilɛi naa ba tamɔ asooyi; gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, nifitemɔ he kpãŋmɔ okpãŋɔ.
Onyaa efɔŋ he fɛ ekpakpa; onyaa amale he fe anɔkwale.
Ao, amalelɔ, onyaa mɔfitemɔ wiemɔi ahe!
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ o aaatswa shi; ni oteŋ shi dɔŋŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ebaasha bo kɛjɛ obuu lɛ mli, ni ebaatserɛ omli. Ebaafã o kɛ oshishi fã kɛaaje hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Jalɔi lɛ aaana, ni amɛaashe gbeyei, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaaŋmɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛ,
"Naa nuu lɛ ni eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efeee ebobaahe lɛ, shi moŋ eŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ eninamɔ babaoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ eshweshweeshwefeemɔ fɔ̃ eninamɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Shi mi lɛ, mitamɔ mutso kɛ enɔ baa ŋmɔŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ ni tsakeee lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, mibada bo shi kɛya naanɔ, yɛ nɔ ni ofee lɛ hewɔ. Mibakafo ogbɛi yɛ owebii ahiɛ ejaakɛ ohi.
53: Kwashiai kɛɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ." Amɛfite, ni nibii ni ahiɔ pɛ amɛfeɔ, amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni feɔ nɔ kpakpa.
Nyɔŋmɔ jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ gbɔmɛi abii, akɛ eeena mɛi komɛi ni le nii, mɛi ni taoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lo?
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛgba afã, amɛ fɛɛ amɛje amɛŋlɛ nɔ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni feɔ nɔ kpakpa Dabida! Mɔ kome nɛkɛ flo bɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ miibi akɛ, "Aso nakai efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ ni yeɔ mimaŋbii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ aboloo, ni amɛjaaa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛleee nii?
Naa amɛ ni ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ, ŋmiŋmi ni anako ehenɔ dã! Ejaakɛ mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baagbɛ amɛwui lɛ eshwã. Abaahã amɛhiɛ agboi ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa amɛ.
Ao, kulɛ ajɛ Zion ahere Isreal yiwala! Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ hã ewebii ba amɛblema ekoŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ Yakob aaanya, ni Israel mii aaashɛ!
54: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere miyiwala, ni okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ aye misane lɛ ohã mi.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo misɔlemɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ntɛŋfɛɛlɔi ete shi ewo mi, yiwalɔi miitao mihiɛ amɛkpãtã, ejaakɛ jeee amɛhe sane ko ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Shi Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji miyelikɛbualɔ; Yehowa dɛŋ miwala yɔɔ.
Eeewo mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ, yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ. Ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ.
Mibashã tsuijurɔ naa afɔle mahã o. Ao Yehowa, majie ogbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ omli hi.
Ejaake ohere mi kɛjɛ mihaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli, ni mihiŋmɛi ena mihenyɛlɔi anɔ kunim ni aye lɛ.
55: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ, ni kɛji mikpa bo fai lɛ, hã mana bo.
Bo mi toi, ni ohã mi hetoo; mihejramɔ lɛ eye minɔ.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ ablɔmɔ lɛ ehã mitsui efã; yiwalɔi lɛ adɛŋ piŋmɔ ehã mifee butuu; ejaakɛ amɛmiiba amɛbawo mi hejramɔ; amɛmli efu mi, ni amɛmiinyɛ mi naakpa.
Mitsui ehao yɛ mimli; gbele he ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi.
Gbeyei emɔ mi, ni mihe miikpokpo, ni tsuifãa esu miyi.
Ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Mina ni miyɛ fiji tamɔ okpo, kulɛ mafliki kɛaatee koni mayajɔɔ mihe.
Naa, kulɛ! Majo foi kɛya shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni mayato shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Kulɛ maye oyai majo lasuogbele kɛ ahum lɛ naa foi, mayatao abobaahe mahã mihe."
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, futumɔ amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, kaahã amɛmiikpã gbee, ejaakɛ miina basabasafeemɔ kɛ nɔmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛnyiɛɔ maŋ gbogboi lɛ anɔ kɛbɔleɔ maŋ lɛ, shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; nifɔɔjianii kɛ haomɔ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ.
Akpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ mli, yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔ kpaaa yɛ eblohui lɛ amli.
Henyɛlɔ ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ kulɛ, mamɔ mli nakai; ni asaŋ mɔ ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi lɛ ni kulɛ, maŋɔ mihe matee lɛ.
Shi moŋ bo, mitipɛŋfonyo, bo, minaanyo, mishieŋtsɛ ni.
Mikɛ bo yeɔ yitsoŋ sane, ni boji mɔ ni mikɛnyiɛɔ kɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.
Hã amɛgboi, hã amɛya gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi, ejaakɛ amɛshīaiaŋ kɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, miitsɛ bo Nyɔŋmɔ, ni bo Yehowa ooohere mi.
Leebi kɛ shwane kɛ gbɛkɛ fɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ miwerɛho lɛ aaaŋmɛ ehiɛ kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ, ni eeebo mi toi.
Eeehere misusuma shweshweeshwe yɛ ta ni miwuɔ lɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ ayi fa.
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, aaabo mi toi; ni eeeba amɛ shi ejaakɛ amɛtsakeee, ni amɛsheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.
Mitsutsu naanyo lɛ ewo enine nɔ yɛ enanemɛi anɔ; ni eku eshiwoo lɛ mli.
Enaa jɔ fe shwie, shi ebɔɔ yɛ etsui mli; ewiemɔ he jɔ fe mlɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ klaŋte ni naa ba ni.
Shɛ ojatsu lɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni lɛ eeehiɛ omli; eŋmɛŋ gbɛ gbi ko gbi ko ni jalɔ adidãa.
Shi, ao, bo Nyɔŋmɔ, obaashɛrɛ amɛ oshwie bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mnli. Mɔgbelɔi kɛ kutumpɔfoi lɛ, amɛyeŋ amɛwala gbii amli fã tete. Shi, mi lɛ, bo onɔ maŋɔ mihiɛ mafɔ̃.
56: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi miinaanaa minɔ, henyɛlɔi miihao mi gbi muu fɛɛ.
Be fɛɛ be lɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ naanaa minɔ; mɛi pii kɛ mi tswaa kɛ henɔwomɔ.
Kɛji gbeyei mɔ mi lɛ, mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ bo onɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni daaŋ wiemɔ ni mijieɔ yi lɛ, Lɛ enɔ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃; ni misheee gbeyei. Mɛni gbɔmɔ adesa aaanyɛ mi afee?
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, mi awui pɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛye; efɔŋ sɔŋŋ pɛ amɛjwɛŋɔ yɛ mihe.
Amɛbuaa amɛhe naa ni amɛwoɔ mi antɛo, ni amɛjaa misɛɛ mo koni amɛgbe mi.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo amɛ esha ni amɛfee lɛ he nyɔmɔ. Okɛ mlifu atsirɛ amɛ atswia shi.
Ole bɔ ni mitsomloɔ mihãa, Ole miyaafonu falɛ. Ani aŋmãko yɛ owolo mli lo?
Gbi ni mibablɔ matsɛ bo lɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ; mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, oyɛ misɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ daaŋ wiemɔ ni mijieɔ yi lɛ, Yehowa, mɔ daaŋ wiemɔ ni mikafoɔ lɛ,
Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ nɔ ni mihiɛ kã; misheee gbeyei. Mɛni gbɔmɔ adesã aaanyɛ mi afee?
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, maye shii ni miwo bo lɛ anɔ. Mibashã shidaa afɔlei mahã o.
Ejaakɛ ohere misusuma kɛje gbele mli, ni ohãaa aye minɔ, koni manyiɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ yɛ wala la lɛ mli.
57: Naa mi mɔbɔ! Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ bo abo misusuma baa nɛɛ. Ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli maba abo yɛ kɛyaashi hiɛkpãtãmɔ ahum lɛ aaaho.
Miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni feɔ nii fɛɛ hãa mi lɛ,
Ebaatsu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi koni abahere miyiwala; ebaawo mɛi ni haoɔ mi lɛ hiɛgble. Nyɔŋmɔ baajie esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ enɔkwale lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Mikã jatai ni kɛ hɔmɔ tserɛɔ gbɔmɛi amli ateŋ. Amɛnyanyɔji lɛ akplɔi kɛ gãimlibii ni; ni amɛlilɛii lɛ klaŋtei ni naa ba ni.
Ao Naa Nyŋɔmɔ, awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi. Hã onumnyam lɛ akple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Mihenyɛlɔi ŋmɛ mi yaa koni amɛdu mi; misusuma edɔ kɔmɔɔ kɛ awerɛho. Amɛtsa bu yɛ migbɛ nɔ, shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ amɛyagbee mli.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, omli hemɔkɛyeli ni miyɔɔ lɛ, ema shi shiŋŋ etsakeko kwraa! Mala, majie oyi!
Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, misusuma! Nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a, obenta kɛ saŋku! Mibahã je atsɛre mra.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, mibada bo shi yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ. Mibala kɛjie oyi yɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kwɔ kɛyashɛɔ ŋwɛi; ni onɔkwayeli yashɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ gojoo kɛtekɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi. Hã onumnyam lɛ akple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
58: Nyɛ lumɛi, aso nyɛbuɔ atɛŋ yɛ jalɛ naa lo? Ani nyɛkojoɔ gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ yɛ jalɛ naa lo?
Dabida! Nɔ fɔŋ ni nyɛbaafee he nyɛjwɛŋɔ; yiwalɛ nii nyɛfeɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji gbaa jwɛi kɛjɛɔ musuŋ beebe; kɛji ashwie amɛ shi nɔŋŋ pɛ amɛbɔi malemɔ.
Ebɔɔ yɛ amɛmli tamɔ onufu, amɛtsimɔɔ amɛtoi tamɔ ble
koni amɛkanu ŋkunyaayelɔ gbee loo ashwãifeelɔ tsɛmɔ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, kuumɔ amɛdaaŋ nyanyɔji. Ao Yehowa, fãamɔ jata oblahii atsoji.
Hã amɛlaaje tamɔ nu ni hoɔ kɛyaa, ni anaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ jwɛi koni amɛgboi.
Hã amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ waa mli nu kplãnaa; amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ bi ni ashrake ni enaaa hulu.
Dani nyɛkukwɛi aaanu laitso dɔlɛ he lɛ, tso ŋmɔŋ jio, tso ni la efu he momo jio, Yehowa abɛɛ amɛ fɛɛ ashwie.
Jalɔi aaanya be ni amɛaana oweletɔɔ lɛ; amɛaanyiɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ala mli kɛho.
Mɛi aaakɛɛ akɛ, "Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nyɔmɔwo ko yɛ hã jalɔ; lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ ni kojoɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
59: Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ. Kpɔ̃ mi yɛ mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ.
Heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ; heremɔ miyiwala yɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi adɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ naa, amɛwo ka yɛ mi mihewɔ; yiwalɔi ebua amɛhe naa amɛwo mi.
Ao Yehowa, jeee esha ni mifee loo tɔ̃mɔ ko ni mitɔ̃ hewɔ ni amɛjoɔ foi kɛyaa amɛyafeɔ kralo amɛtoɔ mi. Wo ohe nɔ, baakwɛ ni oye obua mi.
Yehowa, bo Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, boji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ. Wo ohe nɔ koni ogbla maji fɛɛ atoi; kaana efɔŋfeelɔi kutumpɔfoi lɛ ekoeko kwraa mɔbɔ.
Daa gbɛkɛ lɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛbaa; amɛblɔɔ tamɔ gbei, ni amɛnyiɛɔ tsoŋtsoŋ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛ amɛyɔɔ jɛi lɛ, amɛwieɔ amɛdaa obɔ̃. Amɛnaa jraa tamɔ klaŋte, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Namɔ nuɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɔ lɛ?"
Shi Ao, bo Yehowa, oŋmɔɔ amɛ; oyeɔ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ahe fɛo.
Ao mi-Hewalɛ, bo pɛ gbɛ mikwɛɔ. Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ boji mimɔɔ.
Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ aaabakpee mi; kɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ; mi-Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã mihiŋmɛi ana mihenyɛlɔi anɔ kunimyeli lɛ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, wɔtsɛŋ, kaagbe amɛ, no lɛ mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ aaakpa nɔ; shi moŋ gbɛɛ amɛ oshwã yɛ ohewalɛ naa, ni okɛ amɛ atswia shi.
Esha wiemɔi ni jeɔ amɛnaa lɛ hewɔ lɛ, hã amɛhewoo lɛ afimɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ. Loomɔ kɛ amale wiemɔi ni amɛwieɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ,
okɛ mlifu akpãtã amɛhiɛ. Kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaashi amɛyi aaatã, koni mɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ naagbeehei fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ Israel nɔ.
Daa gbɛkɛ lɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛbaa; amɛblɔɔ tamɔ gbei, ni amɛnyiɛɔ tsoŋtsoŋ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛkpaa shi amɛtaoɔ niyenii, ni kɛ eshɛɛɛ amɛnaa lɛ, amɛhuuɔ kɛ mlifu.
Shi mi lɛ, mala ohewalɛ lɛ he lala; leebi lɛ, mala osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he lala; ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ mɔ̃ɔ ohã mi, ni otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã mi, yɛ mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ao, mi-Hewalɛ, mala majie oyi, ejaakɛ, Ao, bo Nyɔŋmɔ, boji mimɔ̃ɔ. Boji Nyɔŋmɔ ni ojieɔ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ mi.
60: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okwa wɔ, okumɔ wɔhe afabaŋ, omli efu wɔ. Kuu osɛɛ oba wɔŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ohã shikpɔŋ lɛ ehoso, ni ohã emli egba; tsramɔ hei ni egbla lɛ, ejaakɛ ewɔtsɔ.
Ohã owebii lɛ ena nɔ naakpa. Wɔmiililaa shi tamɔ mɛi ni etɔ wain.
Oshi aflaŋaa akɛ okadi ohã mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ, koni amɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli kɛbaanyiɛ anɔkwale lɛ sɛɛ.
Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere wɔyiwala. Bo wɔ toi bɔ ni afee ni mɛi ni osumɔɔ lɛ ahere amɛyiwala.
Nyɔŋmɔ ejɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ miishɛɛ baaja Shekem mli, ni majra Sukot Jɔɔ lɛ mahã mimaŋ lɛ.
Minɔ ji Gilead, ni minɔ ji Manase; Efraim ji miyitso dade fai; Yuda ji mimaŋtsɛ tsi.
Moab ji mihejuu goga; majie mitokota mashwie Edom kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mi, minɔ ni, ni mabɔ kunimyeli oshe mashwie Filistia nɔ."
Namɔ aaaŋɔ mi kɛaatee maŋ ni awaje lɛ lɛ mli? Namɔ aaanyiɛ mihiɛ kɛaaya Edom?
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ani okwako wɔ? Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔta lɛ efãaa ta dɔŋŋ?
Ao, ye obua wɔ koni wɔkɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ akpe; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ adesã dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ jeee fɛifɛi.
Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ wɔɔye kunim kɛ̃. Lɛji mɔ ni aaanaanaa wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kɛmɔ shi.
61: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo miblɔmɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ.
Kɛ mitsui miisu lɛ, mabo matsɛ bo, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe. Wa mi kɛya tɛsaa ni kwɔ fe mi lɛ nɔ,
ejaakɛ boji mibobaahe, mɔɔ ko ni wa fe henyɛlɔ lɛ.
Hã mahi obuu lɛŋ kɛya naanɔ, koni mafee shweshweeshwe yɛ ofiji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛŋ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ onu mishiwoi lɛ. Okɛ mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ agbɛnaanii ehã mi.
Hã maŋtsɛ lɛ wala sɛɛ atsɛ, ni ehi shi kɛya yinɔi fɛɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ, hã eye lumɔ yɛ ohiɛ kɛya naanɔ; ni okɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli lɛ abu ehe.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mala majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa nɛɛ, be ni miyeɔ mishiwoi lɛ anɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ.
62: Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji mɔ ni misusuma efee kpoo emɛɔ nɛɛ; lɛ edɛŋ miyiwalaheremɔ jɛɔ.
Ekoome pɛ ji mitɛsaa kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, mimɔɔ ni wa. Mididaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ po, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛaahao gbɔmɔ kome kɛyashi? Kɛyaashi mɛɛ be po, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛaatswia lɛ nii, mɔ ko ni tamɔ gbogbo loo afabaŋ ni ekpa kɛyaagbee shi lɛ?
Eyi nɔ ajina sɔŋŋ amɛyaa koni amɛkpa lɛ ni egbojee aŋmɛɛ lɛ. Amɛnyaa amale he; amɛkɛ amɛnaabu jɔɔ, shi amɛlomɔɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji mɔ ni misusuma efee kpoo emɛɔ; ejaakɛ lɛji mihiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Lɛ ekoome ji mitɛsaa kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, mimɔɔ ni wa. Mididaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ miyiwalaheremɔ kɛ minumnyam jɛɔ; mitɛsaa ni wa kɛ mibobaahe ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Nyɛ maŋbii, nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔ̃a Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ be fɛɛ be; nyɛfɔsea nyɛtsuiiaŋ saji fɛɛ nyɛshwiea ehiɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔbobaahe.
Mɛi bibii fɛɛ tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, mɛi wuji hu jeee fɛifɛi kɛji aŋmɛ amɛ yɛ nsɛni mli lɛ, amɛtsii. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsiimɔ shɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko, amɛtamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ akafɔ̃a amimyeli nɔ; nyɛyitsei hu akafūa yɛ juukɛfɔ̃ nibii agbɛfaŋ. Kɛji nii ni nyɛna miifa tete lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii akafɔ̃a nɔ.
Minu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ fe shii abɔ akɛ lɛ edɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo oyɔɔ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee, ejaakɛ owoɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔi anaa.
63: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, miitao bo! Misusuma miiye ohe kumai, migbɔmɔtso miishwe bo, tamɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbi keketee shweɔ nu.
Nɛkɛ mikwɛ o gbɛ yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni mana ohewalɛ kɛ onumnyam lɛ.
Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee ni hi fe wala tete po hewɔ lɛ makafo bo.
Bei abɔ ni mihīɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, majie oyi; mahole miniji anɔ masɔle matsɛ o.
Misusumɔ aaaye wuiaŋ fɔ etɔ, ni minaabu aaala miishɛɛ lala kɛjie oyi.
Kɛji mikai bo yɛ misaa nɔ lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ ohe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ,
ejaakɛ boji miyelikɛbualɔ daa, ni ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛŋ mala kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ.
Misusuma kpɛtɛ bo gbagbalii, ni oninejurɔ hiɛ mimli tswɛ.
Shi mɛi ni taoɔ misusuma hiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ, aaaya gbohiiajeŋ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei aaatsɔ̃mɔ ŋaŋgbei anaa loo.
Shi maŋtsɛ lɛ aaanya yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi mli aaanya, ejaakɛ aaahã amalelɔi amua amɛnaa.
64: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo migbee toi, yɛ mikɔmɔyeli lɛ mli. Gbeyei ni misheɔ henyɛlɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ baamɔ miwala yi.
Ŋɔɔ mi otee yɛ ajina fɔŋ ni efɔŋfeelɔi yaa yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ hewɔ, yɛ nɔshafeelɔi ayiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛjɔ amɛlilɛii anaa tamɔ klaŋte; amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi ni joɔ gbulɔɔ mi tamɔ gãimlibii.
Amɛtsrɛ̃ɔ amɛwiemɔi lɛ kɛjɛɔ amɛteemɔhe lɛ amɛtswiaa mɔ ni eye emuu lɛ; emɛtsrɛ̃ɔ lɛ amɛgãi lɛ trukaa, ni amɛsheee gbeyeii.
Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsuii yɛ yiŋtoo fɔŋ nɛɛ mli; amɛkpɛɔ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi atsɔne yɛ teemɔ mli; ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Namɔ po aaana wɔ?"
Namɔ aaanyɛ ajie nishaianii ni wɔfee wɔtee lɛ kpo? Wɔkɛ ŋaa kpɛ mli jogbaŋŋ. Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yitsoŋ kwɔ, ni etsui mli hu ewo duŋ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsrɛ̃ amɛ gãi, ni eeepila amɛ trukaa.
Ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛlilɛi hewɔ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni aaana amɛ lɛ aaahoso amɛyitso.
Kɛkɛ lɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ kwa aaashe gbeyei, ni amɛaagba nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu lɛ; ni amɛaasusu enifeemɔnii lɛ he.
Hã jalɔi lɛ anya yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni amɛba lɛ abo! Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni atsuiiaŋ tse lɛ anya.
65: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, esa akɛ ajieɔ oyi yɛ Zion; ni bo abaaye shiwoi anɔ ahã!
Ao, bo ni oboɔ sɔlemɔ toi, bo oŋɔɔ adesai fɛɛ baa.
Kɛji wɔnishaianii miipiŋ wɔ lɛ, bo okɛfaa wɔ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni ohala ni ohãa ebɛŋkɛɔ bo, koni ehi ohekrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ. Wɔɔtrɔ kɛ owe lɛŋ nibii kpakpai lɛ, ni ji o-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ nibii lɛ.
Ao wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ onifeemɔ nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei anɔ ohereɔ wɔyiwala! Boji shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋshɔ sɛɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Bo mɔ ni ojɛ ohewalɛ kple lɛ mli obɔ gɔji lɛ, ohã amɛmamɔ shi shiŋŋ kɛ hewalɛ.
Boji mɔ ni ojɔɔ ŋshɔhūumɔ he, kɛ ŋshɔkei ahūumɔ he, ni ojɔɔ adesai ahoofeemɔ hu he.
No hewɔ lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei shɔŋŋshɔŋŋ lɛ sheɔ naakpɛɛ nii ni ofeɔ lɛ gbeyei Onifeemɔnii lɛ hãa anyaa yɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ohãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni odɔɔ ehe ohãa, ni ebaa nii babaoo. Nyɔŋmɔ faa lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ nu. Ohãa able baa hãa gbɔmɛi, ejaakɛ nakai ji bɔ ni oto.
Oshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akofii lɛ anɔ nu babaoo, ni ohãa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ su kukulii lɛ kpɔtɔɔ. Ohãa nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nɔ, ni emli jɔɔ, ni ebaa nii.
Omlihilɛ hãa afi lɛ yiɔ obɔ kɛ niyenii babaoo. He fɛɛ he ni oootsɔ̃ kɛho lɛ, niyenii babaoo baa jɛi.
Ŋanɔ jwɛi fūɔ babaoo, ni gɔji lɛ nyaa kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ŋanɔ jwɛi fɔ lɛ ewula kɛ too kui ni jɔi lɛ hu ewula kɛ able; amɛmiibɔ oshe, ni amɛmiila kɛ miishɛɛ.
66: Nyɛkɛ nyamɔ abɔa oshe nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ!
Nyɛlaa kɛkafoa enumnyam gbɛi lɛ; nyɛkɛ yijiemɔ ni sa lɛlɛ awoa ehiɛ nyam.
Nyɛkɛa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Onitsumɔi lɛ yɛ gbeyei pam! Ohewalɛ lɛ dalɛ naa sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, ohenyɛlɔi kotoɔ bo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.
Hã je lɛŋ bii fɛɛ kwa aja bo, amɛla kɛjie oyi, amɛla kɛkafo ogbɛi lɛ."
Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu, naakpɛɛnii ni etsu yɛ gbɔmɛi abii ateŋ!
Ehã ŋshɔ tsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ, ni wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ nyiɛ nɔ kɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ. Jɛi wɔnya yɛ, yɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Eeye maŋtsɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni ehiŋmɛii kã majimaji fɛɛ ahe. Atuatselɔi akawo amɛhe nɔ!
Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi! Nyɛhãa anua eyijiemɔ gbɛɛmɔ he.
Lɛ ehã wɔhiɛ kã nɛɛ, ni eŋmɛko gbɛ ni wɔshane tete.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, oka wɔ okwɛ; bɔ ni akaa jwiɛtɛi akwɛɔ lɛ nakai oka wɔ okwɛ.
Ohã wɔyadu yaa, ni okɛ jatsui ni tsiitsii tere wɔ.
Ohã wɔhenyɛlɔi naanaa wɔnɔ; wɔtsɔ̃mɔ la kɛ fai amli, shi ojie wɔ kɛba he ni wɔfee shweshweeshwe yɛ.
Mikɛ shãa afɔlei aaaba owe lɛ; mibaye mishiwoi anɔ mahã o!
Mikɛ nibii ni je minaa ni miwo bo shi yɛ he, be mli ni miyɔɔ haomɔŋ lɛ, aaaba!
Mikɛ gwaŋtɛŋi ni ewo fɔ aaashã shãa afɔle; ni ojwɛnii ni akɛshãa afɔle lɛ alasu lɛ aaakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi. Mikɛ tsina hii kɛ abotiai hu aaashã afɔle.
Nyɛbaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni magba nyɛ nɔ ni efee ehã mi!
Mibo waa mitsɛ lɛ, mikafo lɛ kɛ mililɛi!
Eji minya nɔ sha ko he yɛ mitsuiŋ kulɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ boŋ mi toi.
Shi anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ ebo mi toi, efee toi ehã misɔlemɔ lɛ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ etswaaa misɔlemɔ lɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ, ni ehãaa esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ abɔ mi.
67: Nyɔŋmɔ ana wɔ mɔbɔ, ni ejɔɔ wɔ, ni efee wɔ ejurɔ
koni je lɛ fɛɛ ale osuɔmɔnaanii koni majimaji fɛɛ ale oyiwalaheremɔ hewalɛ lɛ!
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ ajie oyi; hã adesai fɛɛ kwa ajie oyi!
Hã majimaji lɛ amii ashɛ amɛhe, koni amɛla kɛ miishɛɛ; ejaakɛ okojoɔ majimaji lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni otsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji lɛ agbɛ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã adesãi ajie oyi, hã adesãi fɛɛ kwa ajie oyi!
Shikpɔŋ lɛ eba enii. Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ wɔ!
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ aya nɔ ajɔɔ wɔ! Hã adesãi ni yɔɔ je lɛŋ hei fɛɛ awo lɛ.
68: Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ ehe nɔ, ni egbɛɔ ehenyɛlɔi eshwãa. Mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ joɔ enaa foi.
Bɔ ni ahuuɔ lasu kɛyaa lɛ, nakai ehuuɔ amɛ kɛyaa; bɔ ni wo agbaku sereɔ yɛ la he lɛ, nakai mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ahiɛ kpãtãa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Shi jalɔi lɛ nyaa, ni amɛlaa kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; amɛmli fliɔ amɛ kɛ nyamɔ!
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɛlaa nyɛkɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi. Nyɛjea gbɛ nyɛhãa mɔ ni ta shwiili mli kɛbaa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ. Egbɛi ji Yehowa; nyɛnyãa yɛ ehiɛ!
Awusaiatsɛ kɛ okulafoi ahebulɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hãa mɔ kome mɔ lɛ shihilɛhe. Ekplaa gboklɛfoi, ni ehãa amɛyeɔ ejurɔ; shi atuatselɔi lɛ, shikpɔŋ gbiŋ keketee nɔ amɛhiɔ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni onyiɛ owebii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, be ni otsɔ̃ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ,
shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ni ŋwɛi nɛ nu shwie shi, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, yɛ bo Sinai Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso yɛ bo, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ohiɛ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ohã nu babaoo nɛ, ni okɛtsīɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbo lɛ hiɛ ohã owebii ni etɔ biti lɛ.
Owebii lɛ na shihilɛhe yɛ jɛi. Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, omlihilɛ naa lɛ, osaa nibii kpakpai ohã mɛi ni ehīa amɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã, ni yei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ gbɛ kunimyeli wiemɔ lɛ shwã.
"Naa, tai lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ejo foi, amɛjwa saŋ!" Yei ni ashi yɛ shīaŋ lɛ, ja haanii lɛ;
tsɛbelɛ too kui lɛ anɔ amɛkwɛ. Nibii ni amɛha lɛ ji okpo fiji ni ashwie he jwiɛtɛi, kɛ etsɛji ni akɛ shika fɛɛfɛo eha he.
Be ni Ofe lɛ gbɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ shwã yɛ Zalmon Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, snoo nɛ jɛi.
Ao Bashan Gɔŋ kpeteŋkple! Gɔŋ kɛ onɔ gɔŋkpɔi gojogojoo.
Mɛɛba ojɛɔ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ okɛ hiŋmɛitsuu kwɛɔ gɔŋ lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ akɛ ehi jɛi lɛ? Yehowa baahi jɛi kɛya naanɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jɛ Sinai eba He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ kɛ tayaa shwiilii wuji akpe toi akpei abɔ
Okwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ grɔŋŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nomii ni nyiɛ osɛɛ, ohe nikee kɛjɛ mɛi, mɛi tete ni te shi wo bo lɛ adɛŋ, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahi jɛi.
Ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi, mɔ ni hiɛ wɔmli daa lɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni hereɔ mɔ yiwala ni. Lɛji Yehowa, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ, ni hereɔ wɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele mli lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaajwra ehenyɛlɔi lɛ ayitsei, mɛi ni baa jɛŋ fɔŋ ni amɛto amɛyi kusukusuu lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibakpla amɛ kɛaajɛ Bashan kɛba ekoŋŋ; mibakpla amɛ kɛaajɛ ŋshɔ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛba ekoŋŋ,
bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ amɛlá afɔ nyɛnaji ahe, koni nyɛgbei ana henyɛlɔi lɛ alá amɛlɛmɔ."
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, anaa oyaakɛbaa kpoo lɛ, Mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mi-Maŋtsɛ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yaa lɛ, anaa.
Lalɔi lɛ nyiɛ hiɛ, saŋkutswalɔi lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ, ni oblayei ni shaa fabii lɛ nyiɛ teŋ.
Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ asafo kple lɛ mli. Ao, nyɛ Yakob shwiei, nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi.
Benyamin, amɛteŋ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ, nyiɛ hiɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ; ni Zebulon limɛi lɛ kɛ Naftali lumɛi lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ohewalɛ lɛ, hewalɛ ni okɛtsu nii ohã wɔ pɛŋ lɛ.
O-Sɔlemɔwe ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi treɔ nikeenii amɛkɛbahãa bo.
Kã Egipt hiɛ; nakai ŋaŋ kooloo ni hɔ glãi lɛ amli lɛ. Kã majimaji lɛ ni lɛɔ tsina hii kɛ tsinabii lɛ kɛyashi amɛ fɛɛ amɛaakoto bo, ni amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi aaahã o. Gbɛɛ majimaji lɛ ni sumɔɔ ta lɛ oshwã.
Hã lumɛi kɛ akɔɔble ajɛ Egipt aba; ni Kushbii ahe afee oya ni amɛhole amɛniji anɔ ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ao, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyeli, nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ! Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi,
mɔ ni taa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ. Nyɛboa toi, ewoɔ egbee, egbee ni wa lɛ.
Nyɛshiɛa Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ, mɔ ni egbojee teke Israel agbojee, ni ehewalɛ lɛ yɔɔ atatui lɛ amli lɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ he yɛ gbeyei kɛji eeba kɛjɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ehãa ewebii ahewalɛ ni ewoɔ amɛ ekãa. Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi!
69: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ miyiwala, shi nu lɛ ebata misɛ̃!
Miishiu yɛ ŋmiamɔ ni mli kwɔ ni shidaamɔhe bɛ mli mli. Miyaje nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ mli, ni nu lɛ miisu mi.
Etɔ mi kɛ blɔmɔ, ni misɛŋ egbi. Mikwɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛ aahuu; agbɛnɛ mihiŋmɛii eshiu.
Mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaalɛ, amɛyi fa fe miyiteŋ tsɔi; mihenyɛlɔi ni maleɔ mihe, mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ amɛyi fa. Nɔ ni mijuko lɛ aso esa akɛ mato najiaŋ lo?
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ole mikwashiafeemɔ; tɔ̃mɔi ni mitɔ̃ lɛ, akɛteko bo.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, kaahã mɛi ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ ahiɛ miigboi yɛ mi, mihewɔ. Ao Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, kaahã mɛi ni jaa bo lɛ ahiɛ miishwie shi yɛ mi mihewɔ.
Bo ohewɔ ni abɔ mi ahora, ni mihiɛ egbo kpɔtɔɔ nɛɛ.
Mitsɔ̃ gbɔ mihã miwekumɛi, kɛ mɔ kpɔŋ yɛ minyɛbii ateŋ,
ejaakɛ owe lɛ he hiɛdɔɔ tsoɔ yɛ mimli tamɔ la; ni ahorai ni mɛi bɔɔ bo lɛ ebashwie minɔ.
Kɛji mifo, ni mikɛ ŋmãahilɛ piŋ misusuma po, no hu tsɔ̃ɔ ahorabɔɔ hãa mi.
Kɛji mibu kpekpe po, amɛboɔ mi "tsia!"
Nɔyelɔi kɛ kojolɔi yɛ koishi, tãa mihe sane ni dãatɔlɔi tete foɔ mihe lala.
Ao Yehowa, shi mi lɛ, masɔle matsɛ bo. Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni sa mli lɛ, jɛɛ osuɔmɔ kpeteŋkple ni tsakeee lɛ naa ohã mi hetoo. Yɛ onɔkwayeli naa lɛ
heremɔ mi koni mikashiu yɛ ŋmiamɔ lɛ mli. Heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, kɛjɛ nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ hu mli.
Kaahã nu lɛ miisu mi, kaahã mishiu yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, loo gbonyobu miimi mi.
Ao Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ, yɛ osuɔmɔ kpakpa ni tsakeee lɛ naa. Omɔbɔnalɛ ni fa babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã mi.
Okɛ ohiɛ akatee otsulɔ, ejaakɛ miyɛ jramɔ mli, heremɔ mi nɔ mra.
Tsi obɛŋkɛ mi ni okpɔ̃ mi; mihenyɛlɔi ahewɔ lɛ, heremɔ mi.
Ole ahora ni abɔɔ mi, mihiɛgble kɛ mihe guɔ ni egbo lɛ. Ole mihenyɛlɔi fɛɛ.
Ahorabɔɔ ehã mitsui ekumɔ, ni ehã miyoyoro. Mikwɛ mɔbɔnalɛ gbɛ, shi eko baaa; mikwɛ miishɛjelɔi hu gbɛ, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko baaa.
Amɛhãa mi ebɔɔ akɛ niyenii, ni be ni kumai ye mi lɛ amɛhã mi ashiŋ akɛ minu.
Hã okplɔ̃ ni amɛŋmɛ lɛ atsɔ̃ tsɔne ahã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛgbiijuji anɔ niyenii lɛ atsɔ̃ akpa ahã amɛ.
Hã amɛhiŋmɛii anɔ afee kusuu koni amɛkana nii; ni ohã amɛhɛ agbɔjɔ be fɛɛ be.
Fɔsemɔ omlila lɛ oshwie amɛnɔ, ni okɛ omlifu ni naa wa lɛ anina amɛ.
Amɛshitoohe atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kaahã mɔ ko miihi amɛbuui amli.
Ejaakɛ amɛwaa mɔ ni otswia lɛ nii momo lɛ yi; ni mɔ ni opila lɛ momo lɛ, amɛyaa nɔ amɛpiŋɔ lɛ.
Too amɛtoigblamɔ lɛ nɔ ohã amɛ, amɛkaye amɛhe kɔkɔɔkɔ yɛ odɛŋ!
Hã agbe amɛgbɛii yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli; akaŋmla amɛgbɛii ashi jalɔi anɔ nɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, apila mi, ni miipiŋ. Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo minɔ koni ohere miyiwala.
Mikɛ lala aaajie Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ yi! Mikɛ shidaa aaakafo lɛ!
Enɛ aaasa Yehowa hiɛ pam fe tsina oblayoo, loo tsina nuu kɛ ekloŋtoi.
Hã mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ana koni amɛmii ashɛ. Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛ mli;
ejaakɛ Yehowa boɔ ohiafoi atoi, ni enyaŋeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi ni yɔɔ gboklɛ mli lɛ.
Hã ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔi kɛ bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ajie eyi.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baahere Zion yiwala, ni eeesaa Yuda maji wuji lɛ ema; etsuji lɛ aaahi amɛmli, ni eeetsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Maji lɛ aaatsɔ̃ etsuji lɛ ni mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ aaahi amɛmli.
70: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ofai nɛ heremɔ miyiwala! Ao Yehowa, ye obua mi nɔŋŋ!
Hã mɛi ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi, ni amɛhiɛ ashwie shi. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi efɔŋ lɛ, hã ashwie amɛ koni amɛhe guɔ agbo.
Hã mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, "Yiɛ, Yiɛ!" lɛ aku amɛsɛɛ kɛ hiɛgble.
Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ anya; ni amɛmli afli amɛ yɛ ohewɔ. Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ akɛɛ daa akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo."
Shi mi lɛ, minii yɛ mɔbɔ, ni efĩ mi. Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ba miŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ. Boji mibualɔ kɛ miherelɔ! Ao Yehowa, kaatsɛ kwraa!
71: Ao Yehowa, bo abo mibaa; kaahã mihiɛ miigbo gbi ko gbi ko!
Akɛni jalɔ ji bo hewɔ lɛ, ye obua mi koni ohere mi. Ba otoi shi ohã mi ni ohere miyiwala.
Tsɔ̃ abobaa tɛkplo ohã mi, kɛ mɔ̃ɔ ni wa ni okɛhere miyiwala, ejaakɛ mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ ji o!
Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi yɛ yiwalɔ lɛ dɛŋ, yɛ nɔshafeelɔ lɛ kɛ yitsoŋwalɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ boji mihiɛnɔkãmɔ. Ao Yehowa, bo onɔ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ kɛjɛ miblahiiaŋ.
Bo mikpasa kɛjɛ fɔmɔ mli. Bo nɔŋŋ obu mihe be mli ni afɔɔ mi. Bo oyi majie daa.
Mitsɔ̃ naakpɛɛ nɔ ko mihã mɛi pii; ejaakɛ boji mibobaahe ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe.
Midaa eyi obɔ̃ kɛ oyijiemɔ gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni majaje onumnyam lɛ.
Kaashɛ mi ofɔ̃ yɛ migbɔlɛ beiaŋ; kaakwa mi be ni migbɔjɔɔ,
ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ wie mihe; mɛi ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ yaa miyinɔ apam,
ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa lɛ; nyɛtiua lɛ, ni nyɛmɔa lɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaahere lɛ."
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi teŋ akajɛkɛ! Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi nɔŋŋ!
Hã mɛi ni foɔ sane fɔ̃ɔ minɔ lɛ ahiɛ agboi, ni amɛhiɛ akpãtã. Mɛi ni taoɔ mi efɔŋ lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi, ni amɛhe guɔ agbo;
kɛ̃lɛ mi lɛ, mihiɛ aaakã onɔ daa, ni majie oyi kɛteke nɔ.
Minaabu aaagba jalɛ nibii ni ofeɔ lɛ, kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ nifeemɔi lɛ gbi muu fɛɛ; tsɛbelɛ mijwɛŋmɔ kpleee he.
Maba mabagba naakpɛɛnii wuji ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee lɛ; mibakafo bo okoome too ojalɛ lɛ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii kɛjɛ miblahiiaŋ; ni miijaje onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ lolo.
Belɛ migbɔlɛ kɛ miwaŋjee nɛɛ mli lɛ, Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, kaakwa mi, kɛyaashi majaje ohewalɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ojalɛ kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛsheɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi. Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ofee nibii wuji osaso bɛ.
Bo mɔ ni ohã mina amanehului babaoo ni jraa lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ ooowo mi hewalɛ ekoŋŋ. Ooojie mi kɛje gbonyo gu mli, ni okɛ mi aaaba kpo nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ooohã minumnyam afa, ni oooshɛje mimii ekoŋŋ.
Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, matswa saŋku hu mikɛjie oyi yɛ onɔkwayeli hewɔ. Ao Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ matswa obenta mikɛkafo bo.
Be ni milaa mijieɔ oyi lɛ minaabu kɛ misusuma ni okpɔ̃ lɛ, aaanya babaoo.
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, mililɛi aaagba ojalɛ, mɔyelikɛbuamɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni ka mi efɔŋ feemɔ lɛ, awo amɛ hiɛgble, ni amɛhiɛ eshwie shi.
72: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, koni ekɛ ojalɛ akojo; ni otsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛbii lɛ ojalɛ saneyeli lɛ.
Hã ekojo omaŋ lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa koni eye jalɛ sane ehã omɛi ni ji ohiafoi.
Hã hejɔlɛ ajɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ aba ahã omaŋ lɛ; ni jalɛ sane ajɛ ŋmeŋmei lɛ anɔ aba.
Efã maŋbii ohiafoi lɛ ahe, ehere ohiafoi ayiwala; ni wieyelɔ lɛ, ekpãtã ehiɛ butubutu.
Amɛshe bo gbeyei gbii abɔ ni hulu yɔɔ nɛɛ; amɛshe o gbeyei gbii abɔ ni nyɔŋtsere yɔɔ nɛɛ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ kwa mli.
Maŋtsɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ nu ni nɛɔ jwɛi ni ashwao nɔ; etsɔ̃ tamɔ futufuli ni shwãa shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Jalɛ saneyeli ashwere yɛ elumɔyeli be lɛŋ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ aba babaoo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɔŋtsere bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Elumɔyeli aaahe shi kɛaajɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛyagbee ŋshɔnaa; kɛaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi je lɛ naagbeehei kɛ̃.
Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ bii aaakoto lɛ, ni ehenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛ amɛhe aaakoklo shi yɛ mlu mli.
Tarshish kɛ ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi aaatsu onia abahã lɛ. Sheba kɛ Seba maŋtsɛmɛi aaabake nii.
Maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaakoto lɛ, majimaji fɛɛ kwa aaasɔmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ekpɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni efĩ lɛ kɛji eblɔ etsɛ lɛ lɛ, ekpɔ̃ɔ ohiafo kɛ mɛi ni bɛ yelikɛbualɔ ko.
Enaa mɔ ni egbɔjɔ kɛ mɔ ni efĩ lɛ lɛ mɔbɔ, ni ehereɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ lɛ yiwala.
Ehereɔ amɛyiwala kɛjeɔ yiwalɛ kɛ nɔnyɛɛ mli; amɛwala jra wa yɛ ehiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala! Ajɛ Sheba abake lɛ shika! Asɔle ahã lɛ be fɛɛ be; ni aba jɔɔmɔ ahã lɛ jenamɔ tuu.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ aba able babaoo kɛyashwie gɔji lɛ anɔ; eba nii tamɔ Lebanon. Gbɔmɛi afrɔke yɛ maji lɛ amli tamɔ ŋanɔ jwɛi.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛi ahe shi kɛya naanɔ; gbii abɔ ni hulu yɔɔ nɛɛ, enumnyam akagbo. Gbɔmɛi aaanya yɛ ehewɔ; ni majimaji fɛɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ.
Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi! Lɛ ekoome too efeɔ naakpɛɛnii.
Ajie enumnyam gbɛi lɛ yi kɛya naanɔ! Jɛŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ayi tɔ kɛ enumnyam lɛ! Amen! Amen!
David, Ishai bi lɛ, sɔlemɔi lɛ anaagbee nɛ.
73: Lɛɛlɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hi hã Israel; ehi ehã mɛi ni atsuiiaŋ tse lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ eshwɛ shrao ni minane atɔ̃tɔ̃; shwɛ shroa kulɛ mishane.
Ejaakɛ be ni mina bɔ ni mɛi fɔ̃ɔji eshwere lɛ, mihiɛ kɔ̃ yiwalɔi lɛ aninamɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛbɛ piŋmɔ ko lɛ, amɛgbɔmɔtsei yɛ hewalɛ kpintiŋkpliŋŋ.
Adesãi ahaomɔ lɛ eko kwraa gbaaa amɛnaa lɛ, amɛpiŋŋ tamɔ adesãi krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ hewoo etsɔ̃ kuɛnii ni amɛwo, ni yiwaa ji amɛhebo.
Fɔ sɔŋŋ ehã amɛhiŋmɛii ekɛ̃lɛ̃ amamɔ shi; amɛtsuii eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ kwashiaianii.
Amɛyeɔ mɛi ahe fɛo, ni nishaianii he amɛwieɔ; amɛfaa amɛhe amɛwieɔ, ni mɛi apiŋmɔ pɛ he amɛjwɛŋɔ.
Amɛhãa amɛnaa yasaa Nyɔŋmɔ tete he; amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi ekple shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ;
hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ekpale kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛkafoɔ amɛ; ni amɛnaaa tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ amɛhe.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Te Nyɔŋmɔ aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ele hu? Ani Ŋwɛinyo lɛ aaale?"
Naa, bɔ ni mɛi fɔ̃ɔji yɔɔ nɛ: Daa nɛɛ amɛhe ejɔ amɛ, ni nii lɛ, na kɛkɛ amɛnaa.
Yakatswaa po mihiɛ mitsuiŋ keŋkeŋ, ni miwoo miniji ahe muji kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ ko lɛ.
Minaa nɔ daa jenamɔ, ni agblaa mitoi daa leebi.
Eji mikɛɛ akɛ, "Mawie nɛkɛ" kulɛ, miyeŋ owebii lɛ ashwiei lɛ anɔkwale.
Shi be ni mibɔ mɔdɛŋ misusu he koni manu sane lɛ shishi lɛ, mina akɛ ewa tsɔ̃ hã mi.
Kɛyashi mibote Nyɔŋmɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ, dani mani bɔ ni amɛnaagbee tamɔ hã.
Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ okɛ amɛ eto hei ni shãmɔɔ trotro; ohãa amɛtswiaa shi, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.
Amɛhiɛ kpãtãa shwiaa, ni ŋmiŋmi loɔ amɛ kɛyaa kwrakwra.
Amɛtamɔ lamɔ ni alaa. Kɛji hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛjeee fɛifɛi dɔŋŋ.
Be ni edɔ mi, ni mitsui mli shã mi lɛ,
asomoaŋ kwashia mifee lɛ, ni mileee nii. Mitamɔ kooloo yɛ ohiɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ miyɛ omasɛi daa, ni ohiɛ mininejurɔ mli.
Okɛ oŋaawoo tsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ; ni kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ ooohere mi owo onumnyam mli.
Namɔ miyɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi fe bo? Ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ yɛ bo osɛɛ.
Miheloo kɛ mitsui aaagbɔjɔ nɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ ji mitsui hewalɛ kɛ migbɛfaŋnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ;
ejaakɛ mɛi ni ekwa bo lɛ, ahiɛ aaakpãtã Okpãtãa mɛi ni yeee bo anɔkwa lɛ ahiɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ masɛi hilɛ hi hã mi. Mikɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ efee mibobaahe, bɔ ni afee ni magba onitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
74: Ao, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba oshɛrɛ wɔ oshwie kwraa nɛkɛ? Mɛɛba omlifu lɛ jɛleɔ woɔ olɛɛhe lɛ toi nɛɛ?
Kaimɔ osafo ni oŋɔ fee onɔ kɛjɛ blema lɛ! Kaimɔ Zion Gɔŋ, he ni obahiɔ lɛ.
Dɔɔ ohe kɛya naanɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli. Henyɛlɔ lɛ efite nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ.
Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ebɔ kunimyeli oshe yɛ Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ; amɛshi amɛflaŋai yɛ jɛi akɛ kunimyeli he okadi.
Amɛkɛ lemai miikumɔ yiteŋgbɛ agbo lɛ he tsei lɛ;
ni agbo lɛ tsei ni ayeyee samai awo he lɛ, amɛkɛ lemai kɛ hãmle ekumɔ.
Ni amɛma Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni amɛbule he ni ajaa bo yɛ lɛ kwrakwra.
Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, "Wɔbaaye amɛnɔ kɛwula shi." Amɛshãshãa Nyɔŋmɔ kpeehei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Wɔnaaa wɔkadii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ! Gbalɔ ko gbalɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ wɔteŋ ni ele bɔ ni sane nɛɛ naa aaayakpa aha.̃
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni henyɛlɔ lɛ aaabɔ ahora kɛyashi? Ani henyɛlɔ lɛ aaagbe ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ kɛaaya naanɔ lo?
Mɛɛba osu onine? Mɛɛba osu ohewalɛ ninejurɔ lɛ owo omlishi?
Kɛ̃lɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, mimaŋtsɛ lɛ, lɛ etsuɔ yiwalaheremɔ nitsumɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ogba ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ ohewalɛ naa; ojwra ŋshɔŋ bonsoi lɛ ayitsei.
Ojwra kooloo leviatan lɛ yitsei lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ; ni oŋɔ egbɔmɔtso lɛ ohã ŋaŋ kooloi koni amɛye.
Ohã nuhiŋmɛii kɛ faa niji tue; ni ohã faa ni hoɔ daa lɛ ŋla.
Shwane lɛ onɔ ni, ni nyɔɔŋ hu onɔ ni. Bo obɔ ŋulamii kɛ hulu.
Bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ husui lɛ fɛɛ; bo obɔ latsaa be kɛ fɛ̃i be fɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni henyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ bo ahora amɛhãa; kɛ bɔ ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ gbeɔ ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ.
Kaaŋmɛɛ omɛi ni ahe waaa lɛ ahe ohã kooloi kakawuai lɛ; ohiɛ akakpa omɛi nɔnalɔi lɛ anɔ kwraa.
Ohiɛ akakpa okpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei ni ewowoo duŋ lɛ eyimɔ tɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.
Kaahã mɔ ni awaa lɛ yi lɛ hiɛ miishwie shi. Hã ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ fɛɛ ajie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo ohe nɔ koni ofã ohe. Kaimɔ bɔ ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei bɔɔ bo ahora gbi muu fɛɛ.
Ohiɛ akakpa ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ablɔmɔ lɛ, amɛhoofeemɔ ni kwɔɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi be fɛɛ be lɛ nɔ.
75: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔmiida bo shi! Wɔmiida bo shi! Ejaakɛ obɛŋkɛ wɔ; wɔgbaa onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.
"Kɛji be ni mito lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibakojo yɛ jalɛ naa.
Kɛji je lɛ hoso kɛ enɔ bɔɔnii fɛɛ lɛ, mi, mihiɛ ekulashii lɛ amli kpɛŋŋ."
Mikɛɔ mɛi ni shwãa lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkashwãa!" Ni mikɛɔ yiwalɔi lɛ akɛ,
"Nyɛkafea ntɛŋ; nyɛkafea ntɛŋ kwraa, nyɛkawiea kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ."
Ejaakɛ kojomɔ jɛɛɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ejɛɛɛ anaigbɛ; asaŋ ejɛɛɛ ŋanɔgbɛ hu ebaaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji kojolɔ! Ebaa mɔ ko shi, ni ewoɔ mɔ ko nɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa hiɛ kpulu ko yɛ edɛŋ kɛ emli wain kpakpa ni miitswa afui. Ebaafo eko ehã, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yiwalɔi lɛ fɛɛ baanu; amɛaashoo wain lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, mibanya kɛaatee naanɔ. Mala majie Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
Ebaaba yiwalɔi ahewalɛi fɛɛ shi; shi jalɔi ahewalɛ lɛ ebaawo nɔ ebaahole nɔ.
76: Ale Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Yuda! Egbɛi tsii yɛ Isreal.
Eshihilɛhe yɛ Salem, ni Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyɔɔ.
Jɛi ekumɔ henyɛlɔ lɛ gãimlibii lɛ kɛ tsɛŋi lɛ kɛ klaŋtei lɛ kɛ tawuu nibii lɛ amli yɛ.
Ohiɛ yɛ nyam, ni ogbojee kwɔ fe naanɔ gɔji lɛ.
Nibii fɛɛ ni hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ha lɛ, ashɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ; tabilɔi lɛ gboi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ enine nɔ ewo ekɛfã ehe.
Ao Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, oŋa amɛyi, okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ fɛɛ tswia shi ni amɛgboi.
Shi bo lɛ, ohe yɛ gbeyei naakpa. Kɛji omli efu lɛ, namɔ aaanyɛ ohiɛ adamɔ?
Ojɛ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ obu atɛŋ; je lɛ she gbeyei ni efee diŋŋ,
bi ni Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, ote shi okojo kɛhere shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔnalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ayiwala lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ adesã mlila tete aaajie oyi. Mɛi ni aaaje gbele mli yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, aaaye ogbii juji lɛ.
Nyɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ni nyɛyea nyɛshiwoi lɛ anɔ. Nyɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ kɛ nikeenii abahã, mɔ ni he yɔɔ gbeyei naakpa lɛ,
lɛ mɔ ni ebaa lumɛi ashi, ni ehãa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ.
77: Miblɔɔ waa mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ waa akɛ ebo mi toi!
Mihaomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, mitaoɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, miholeɔ miniji anɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ mli, ni etɔɔɔ mi; misusuma ekplɛ̃ɛɛ miishɛjemɔ.
Kɛji misusu Nyɔŋmɔ he lɛ, midɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi; ni kɛji mishwie miyiŋ lɛ, mimumɔ tɔɔ biti.
Okɔ wɔ yɛ mihiŋmɛi mli; haomɔ sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, minyɛɛɛ mawie.
Mijwɛŋɔ blema gbii lɛ ahe, ni mikaiɔ teteete afii lɛ hu.
Mitaoɔ mitsuiŋ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; mishweiɔ miyiŋ, ni mikpaa mimli.
"Aso Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpooɔ mɔ kɛyaa naanɔ, ni enaŋ mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ lo?
Aso esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ sɛɛ efo kwraa kɛmiiya naanɔ lo? Aso eshiwoi lɛ hu asɛɛ efo kɛmiiya naanɔ lo?
Aso Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekpa edromɔ lɛ nɔ lo? Aso emlifu ehã ekpa mɔ mɔbɔnalɛ lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Midɔlɛ sane ji akɛ, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ hewalɛ lɛ etsake."
Mibakai Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ! Hɛɛ! Mibakai oblema naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.
Majwɛŋ onitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe; masusu onitsumɔi wuji lɛ ahe.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ogbɛ lɛ he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ. Mɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko je agbo tamɔ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ?
Boji Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsuɔ naakpɛɛ nii, Bo mɔ ni ohã ana ohewalɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Okpɔ̃ owebii ni ji Yakob shwiei kɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni nu lɛ na bo! Hɛɛ be ni nu lɛ na bo, eshe gbeyei; Ni, bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ kpokpo kɛtee eshishi tɔ̃ɔ.
Atatui lɛ nɛ nu shwie shi, ni ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni srawai gbla yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Oŋwɛishiimɔ lɛ gbɛɛ kɛnyiɛ lasuogbele mli kɛho, ni osrawai kpɛlɛ ni je lɛ mli tse, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo, ni ehoso.
Ofo ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ. Onyiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔkei lɛ amli; shi anaaa onanemaamɔhei.
Otsɔ̃ Mose kɛ Aaron nɔ, okpla omaŋbii lɛ tamɔ akplaa tooku.
78: Ao mimaŋ, nyɛboa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ atoi; nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ!
Magble minaa mawie yɛ abɛbuaiaŋ, magbla blema teemɔŋ saji amli,
nii ni wɔnu, ni wɔle, ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gba wɔ lɛ.
Wɔshiuŋ amɛbii lɛ saji lɛ ekoeko nɔ; shi wɔɔgba yinɔbii ni baa lɛ Yehowa anumnyam nitsumɔi lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ.
Ewo mlai ehã Yakob shwiei kɛ akpɔi ehã Israelbii. Ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii mlai nɛɛ;
bɔ ni afee ni nyɛbii ni baaba lɛ ana ale nii nɛɛ, bii ni anako afɔ tete, koni amɛ hu amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii.
Ewo mlai nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ afɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, koni amɛhiɛ akakpa Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ, shi amɛye ekitãi lɛ anɔ,
koni amɛkatamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi kaniŋkajelɔi kɛ yinɔbii atuatselɔi lɛ, yinɔbii ni amɛhemɔkɛyeli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli fiii shi kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ.
Tawuu gbi lɛ, Efraimbii ni emia kɛ gãi lɛ jo foi.
Amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkplɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛaaba amɛjeŋ yɛ emla lɛ naa.
Amɛhiɛ kpa nɔ ni etsu kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni efee etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ anɔ.
Efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Egba ŋshɔ lɛŋ, ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃ mli kɛho; ni ehã ŋshɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo ni ma shi.
Shwane lɛ ekɛ atatu tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fee lɛ ekɛ la gboŋaa tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ.
Ehã tɛsai amli gblagblai yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ehã amɛ nu babaoo ni jɛ shikpɔŋ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ amɛnu.
Ehã nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛŋ, ni ehã nu ho tamɔ faa.
Shi amɛkã he amɛfee esha amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtse Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ hiɛ atūa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ kɛ niyenii ni baa amɛtsine ni amɛbi lɛ.
Amɛwie amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkɛɛ: "Ani Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lo?
Etswa tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, ni nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ mli: ni eyi kɛteke nɔ etsɔ̃ faa tete. Ani eeenyɛ niyenii hu edro, aloo ehã emaŋ lɛ loo lo?"
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yehowa nu lɛ, emli fu naakpa eje la ewo Israel he; emlifu te shi ewo Israel naakpa,
ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ amɛyeee, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eyiwalaheremɔ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ efã ŋwɛi, ni egble ŋwɛi agboi lɛ anaa,
ni enɛ mana eshwie amɛnɔ koni amɛye; ehã amɛ ŋwɛiŋmãa lɛ eko.
Gbɔmɔ adesã yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi aniyenii; ehã amɛ niyenii babaoo amɛye amɛtrɔ.
Ehã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa yɛ ŋwɛi, ehã wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa yɛ ehewalɛ naa.
Enɛ loo eshwie amɛnɔ tamɔ mlu; enɛ loofɔji hu tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.
Ehã loofɔji lɛ shwie shi yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ teŋ kɛbɔle amɛwɔɔhei lɛ.
Amɛye, ni amɛtrɔ kɛteke nɔ, ejaakɛ ehã amɛ nɔ ni baa amɛtsine lɛ.
Shi amɛtsinebaanii lɛ nako eje amɛtsine, amɛmiiye nii lɛ lolo,
kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ te shi wo amɛ, ni egbe amɛteiaŋ oblaŋi lɛ, ni ji Israel oblahii kãkãlɔi lɛ.
Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkã he amɛfee esha; enaakpɛɛnii lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛheee lɛ amɛyeee.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehã amɛwala sɛɛ fo tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ; amɛfii lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ haomɔ.
Kɛ egbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, fãbii lɛ taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ; amɛshwaa amɛhe, ni amɛtaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
Amɛkaiɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛbobaahe, ni Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, ji amɛkpɔ̃lɔ.
Shi amɛhlɔ lɛ kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi, ni amɛmale amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛfi shi kɛye lɛ anɔkwa, amɛyeee ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli anɔkwa.
Shi lɛ lɛ, akɛni mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛnɔsha lɛ fa amɛ, ni ekpãtãaa amɛhiɛ. Bei pii lɛ, emiɔ ŋɔɔ, ni ehãaa emli awo la kɛteke nɔ.
Ekai akɛ adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ ni hoɔ eyaa ni ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.
Kwɛ shii abɔ ni amɛtse ehiɛ atūa yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfee lɛ nidɔɔnii yɛ shiaŋa lɛŋ.
Amɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔtoonɔtoo, ni amɛwo Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli la.
Amɛhiɛ kpa ehewalɛ lɛ, kɛ gbi ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ nɔ;
amɛhiɛ kpa ekadii lɛ ni efee yɛ Egipt, kɛ enaakpɛɛ nibii lɛ yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.
Ehã amɛfai lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ lá ni no hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ fai lɛ amli nu amɛnu.
Ehã ofɔii bashwie amɛnɔ, ni amɛye amɛ; ni ehã kɔkɔdenei hu, kpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ehã gɔgɔmii ye amɛŋmɔshinii, ni baalabii kpãtã amɛnitsumɔnii ahiɛ.
Ekɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi bibii kpãtã amɛwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ ŋyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji gbe amɛsikamore tsei lɛ.
Ekpãtã amɛtsinai lɛ ahiɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi, ni ekpãtã amɛtoi ahiɛ kɛ srawai.
Ehã emlifu ni naa wa lɛ, kɛ egrimɔ kɛ emlila kɛ hejramɔ ba amɛnɔ; ehã bɔfoi fɔ̃ɔji asafo bakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ekɔ̃ɔɔ efliii kwraa, ni ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko he ekeee lɛ, shi ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã gbele hela.
Egbe Egiptbii akromɔbii fɛɛ, Ham shwiei akromɔbii lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ.
Ejie emaŋbii lɛ kɛje kpo tamɔ toi, ni ekpla amɛ kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ tooku.
Ekpla amɛ shweshweeshwe bɔ ni amɛsheee gbeyei; shi ŋshɔ lɛ gbe amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ,
ni ekɛ amɛ ba Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, gɔŋ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ shɔ̃ lɛ he.
Eshwie majimaji lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni eja shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnii, ni ehã Israel akutsei lɛ hi nɔ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe.
Kɛ̃lɛ amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, ni amɛtse ehiɛ atūa, ni amɛyeee ekitãi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgba afã, ni amɛyeee anɔkwa tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ; amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãi ni ekɔ̃dɔ̃.
Amɛkɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ wo emli la, ni amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ hã eye awuŋa.
Nyɔŋmɔ mli wo la be ni ena amãgãi lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ ekwa Israel kwrakwra.
Ekwa eshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ Shilo lɛ, ni ji buu mli ni ehi yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ.
Eŋmɛ gbɛ ni henyɛlɔi shɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ, enumnyam kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ he okadi lɛ, kɛtee.
Emli wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi lɛ la, ni ehã amɛgboi yɛ klaŋte naa.
La kpãtã oblahii lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛblayei lɛ, alaaa yookpeemɔ lala ko ahãaa amɛ.
Amɛsɔfoi nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klaŋte naa, ni amɛkulafoi lɛ wooo yara amɛfooo amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ te shi, tamɔ mɔ ko ni jɛ wɔ mli, oookɛɛ kãkãlɔ ni dãa eba ehiɛ.
Eshwie ehenyɛlɔi lɛ, ewo amɛ naanɔ hiɛgble.
Shi egbɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ eshwã, ni eŋɔ̃ɔɔ Efraim akutso lɛ hu.
Shi moŋ eŋɔ Yuda akutso lɛ, Zion Gɔŋ lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ.
Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ shihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ. Eto lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ebɔ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.
Ehala etsulɔ David eŋɔ lɛ kɛje ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ekpla lɛ kɛjɛ toi yei ni hãa fufɔ lɛ asɛɛ, koni ebakpla emaŋ Israelbii, Israelbii ni ji egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.
David jie etsuiŋ fɛɛ kɛlɛ amɛ, ni ekɛŋaa kpakpa kpla amɛ.
79: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jeŋmajibii ebabote jeŋmajiaŋbii ebabote oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛbule o-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛfee Yerusalem koikoi.
Amɛkɛ otsuji lɛ agbohii hã ŋwɛi loofɔji, ni amɛye; amɛkɛ omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbohii hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi.
Amɛshwie omɛi lɛ alá shi tamɔ nu kɛbɔle Yerusalem; ni anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko po afu amɛ.
Wɔhewɔ maji lɛ miibɔ wɔ ahora; amɛŋmɔɔ wɔ, ni amɛyeɔ wɔhe fɛo.
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ omli aaafu kɛyaashi? Ani omli aaafu kɛya naanɔ lo? Ani owuŋayeli atso tamɔ la lo?
Okɛ omlila lɛ atutua maji ni leee bo lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ ni jaaa bo lɛ,
ejaakɛ amɛgbe omaŋbii, Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛshihilɛhe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
Kaakwɛ wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ anishaianii lɛ ahewɔ ni ogbla wɔtoi. Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, ni oba wɔŋɔɔ mra, ejaakɛ aba wɔ shi naakpa.
Ao wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam hewɔ lɛ, heremɔ wɔyiwala! Ni okɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ afa wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ maji lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?" Hã majimaji lɛ ale, ni hã wɔ hu wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛi, nɔ owele ni obaatɔ yɛ otsuji lɛ ala shi ni ashwie lɛ hewɔ.
Bo gboklɛfoi lɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔi atoi; ni yɛ ohewala lɛ naa lɛ, heremɔ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ ayiwala.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, ahora ni maji ni yɔɔ wɔmasɛi ebɔ bo lɛ, bɔɔ he nakai toi kpawo oshãkã amɛtsisti.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ owebii, olɛɛhe lɛ toi lɛ, wɔɔda bo shi kɛaatee naanɔ; ni wɔɔgba onifeemɔi lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ kɛjie oyi kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyashi yinɔ.
80: Ao Israel Kplalɔ, bo toi! Bo ni okpla Yosef tamɔ tooku, bo ni ota kerubim anɔ baajie ohe shi faŋŋ otsɔ̃ɔ.
Yɛ Efraim kɛ Benyamin kɛ Manase hiɛ. Teemɔ ohewalɛ lɛ shi ni oba obahere wɔ!
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ! Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala!
Ao Yehowa, Tai a-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po ni omlifu aaajɛle awo omaŋ, ni obaŋ omaŋbii asɔlemɔ toi?
Ohã yaafo tsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ ŋmaa, ni ohã yaafonu pii tsɔ̃ amɛnu ni amɛnu.
Ohã wɔhewɔ maji lɛ ple wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ he; ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ŋmɔ wɔ.
Ao Tai a-Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ! Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala.
Wɔba tamɔ waintso kɛjɛ Egipt; oshwie maji lɛ, ni obatɛo wɔ yɛ jɛi.
Osaa shikpɔŋ ohã lɛ; etsrɛ̃ fai kɛtee shikpɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ, ni ekple shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ ha gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni eniji lɛ ha tsenedrui wuji lɛ anɔ;
ekpã eniji lɛ amli kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ, aahuu kɛyanina Eufrate Faa lɛ.
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ okumɔ waintso lɛ he afabaŋ lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ tsereɔ enɔ yibii nɛɛ?
Batafo jeɔ koo mli ebakpãtãa ehiɛ, ni ŋaŋ kooloi hu miiye eyibii.
Ao Tai a-Nyɔŋmɔ, kwɛmɔ wɔ! Jɛɛ ŋwɛi okwɛ ni ohere omaŋbii ayiwala.
Ba koni obabaa waintso lɛ ni otɛo yɛ ohewalɛ naa lɛ yi!
Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ema enaa la amɛshã, ni amɛtoo amɛfɔ̃ shi. Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo amɛ kɛ mlifu koni okpãtã amɛhiɛ!
Baamɔ omaŋbii ni ji owebii ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ ayi, maŋ ni ohã ena hewalɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ wɔkpaleŋ yɛ osɛɛ dɔŋŋ! Hã wɔyi ana wala, ni wɔɔja bo.
Ao Yehowa, Tai a-Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ ni ona wɔ mɔbɔ, koni wɔyi ana wala.
81: Nyɛlaa waa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji wɔhewalɛ lɛ; nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ nyamɔ nyɛhãa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!
Nyɛwoa lala, ni nyɛtswaa ŋoŋo; nyɛkɛ saŋku kɛ obenta atswaa lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛ yɛ wɔgbijurɔyeli gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɔŋ hee eje, kɛ be hu ni nyɔŋ lɛ eye emuu,
ejaakɛ eji akpɔ hã Israel, akpɔ ni jɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Eŋɔ hã Israelbii lɛ, be ni ete shi ewo Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ. Minu gbee ko ni mileee kɛɛ akɛ,
"Miwo jatsu lɛ yɛ nyɛkɔ̃ji anɔ, ni mijie nyɛniji yɛ kɛntɛŋ he.
Nyɛhaomɔ mli lɛ, nyɛtsɛ mi, ni mihere nyɛ. Mihere nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛishiimɔhe lɛ. Mika nyɛ mikwɛ yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he.
Ao mimaŋbii, nyɛboa toi, be mli ni mibɔɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ! Ao Israel, mina ni obo mi toi!
Nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko kwraa akahi nyɛteŋ; nyɛkajaa maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko kwraa.
Miji Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ. Gbɛɛ odaaŋ hatoo ni mawo lɛ obɔ̃ mahã o.
"Shi mimaŋ lɛ booo migbee toi; Israel baaa ehe shi ehãaa mi.
No hewɔ lɛ miŋmɛɛ amɛhe koni amɛhi shi yɛ amɛtsuiwalɛ lɛ mli, koni amɛhi shi bɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ.
Mina ni mimaŋ lɛ bo mi toi, ni Israel ba ejeŋ bɔ ni, mi, mitaoɔ.
Kulɛ etsɛŋ ni mibaba amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ shi, ni maye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Mɛi ni nyɛɔ Yehowa lɛ, aaaba abakoto lɛ, ni amɛtoigblamɔ lɛ aaakã he aya nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Malɛ nyɛ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa fe fɛɛ, ni mahã nyɛ tɛsaa mli wo ni nyɛye nyɛtrɔ."
82: Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ta ŋwɛi gwabɔɔ wulu lɛŋ; eta nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ eekojo.
"Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaaye toikɔdɔmɔ sane, ni nyɛaakwɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ahiɛiaŋ kɛyaashi?
Nyɛyea ohiafo kɛ awusã sane nyɛ̃haa amɛ; nyɛfãa nɔnalɔ kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ he.
Nyɛherea gbɔjɔlɔ kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ lɛ; nyɛjiea amɛ yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
"Amɛleee nii lɛ, amɛnuuu nii ashishi hu; dujiaŋ amɛnyiɛ ni jalɛ saneyeli etã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ; Ŋwɛinyo lɛ bii ji nyɛ blublu kwa;'
kɛ̃lɛ nyɛbaagboi tamɔ gbɔmɛi adesai gboiɔ, nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ tamɔ abladei lɛ ekomɛi nɔŋŋ."
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, ba! Ba ni obaye je lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, onɔ ni.
83: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, kaafee dioo! Kaamua onaa, ni kaafee kpoo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ!
Ejaakɛ, naa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mifee hoo; mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ bo lɛ amɛhole amɛhe nɔ.
Amɛyaa omaŋ lɛ yinɔ apam yɛ ŋaa mli; amɛkpãŋɔ mɛi ni obuɔ amɛhe lɛ ayinɔ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpãtãa amɛhiɛ, koni amɛkafee maŋ dɔŋŋ; ni akakai Israel gbɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ."
Naa, amɛkpãŋ, amɛfee gbee kome, amɛkpãŋ oyinɔ:
Edombii lɛ kɛ Ishmaelbii lɛ kɛ Moabbii lɛ kɛ Hagarbii lɛ,
kɛ Gebalbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Filistiabii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ hu.
Asiriabii lɛ hu eyafata amɛhe; amɛwo mli nine amɛhã Lot shwiei lɛ.
Feemɔ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ofee Midianbii lɛ kɛ Sisera kɛ Yabin lɛ yɛ Kishon Faa lɛ naa lɛ,
mɛi ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ En-Dor ni amɛtsɔ̃ tumu amɛhã shikpɔŋ.
Feemɔ amɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ ofee Oreb kɛ Zeeb lɛ; ye amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim tamɔ ofee Zeba kɛ Zalmuna,
mɛi ni kɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔŋɔa Yehowa ŋa shikpɔŋ lɛ wɔfea wɔnɔ lɛ."
Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, gbɛɛ amɛ oshwã tamɔ lasuogbele mlu, tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa.
Bɔ ni la shãa koo wɛɛ, bɔ ni lalilɛi maa gɔji anaa la lɛ,
nakai okɛ ahum ashwie amɛ, ni okɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ awo amɛhe gbeyei.
Hã amɛhiɛ agboi bɔ ni afee ni amɛtao bo, Yehowa, ogbɛi sɛɛgbɛ.
Hã amɛhiɛ agboi koni amɛye hejramɔ kɛya naanɔ; hã amɛgboi kɛ hiɛgble.
Hã amɛna amɛle akɛ bo mɔ ni ogbɛi ji Yehowa lɛ, bo pɛ ji Ofe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
84: Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni o-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ yɔɔ akɔnɔ hã!
Misusuma hiɛ miitse Yehowa kpoi lɛ anɔ; hiɛtselɛ lɛ hãa misusuma tɔɔ biti po. Mikɛ mitsui kɛ migbɔmɔtso fɛɛ laa kɛ miishɛɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ.
Aflimata po naa eshihilɛhe; ni nyɔŋmɔbitɛte hu naa etsu he ni ekɛ ebii aaato yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe! Ao Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mimaŋtsɛ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ,
kwɛ bɔ ni mɛi ni hiɔ owe lɛ yɔɔ miishɛɛ hã, ni amɛlaa daa kɛjieɔ oyi.
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni odɛŋ amɛhewalɛ jɛɔ, mɛi ni gbɛfãa kɛyaa Zion Gɔŋ nɔ lɛ kã amɛtsui nɔ.
Kɛji amɛnyiɛ Baka jɔɔ lɛŋ kɛmiiho lɛ, amɛhãa jɛi tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi; ni agbiɛnaa nu traa shi yɛ jɛi.
Amɛnyiɛɔ ni amɛhewalɛ nɔ gbɔɔɔ; amɛyanaa nyɔŋmɔi amli Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ Zion.
Ao Yehowa, Tai a-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo misɔlemɔ lɛ toi! Ao Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã mi!
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, jɔɔmɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
Gbi kome too shihilɛ yɛ o-Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ehi fe gbii akpe ni aaaye yɛ he kroko. Masumɔ matsɔ̃ shinaa naabulɔ yɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, fe nɔ ni mahi efɔŋfeelɔi awe mli.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hulu kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ ji lɛ; edroɔ mɔ, ni ewoɔ mɔ hiɛ nyam. Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ Yehowa kamaaa amɛ nɔ kpakpa ko, nɔ kpakpa ko.
Ao Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ onɔ lɛ!
85: Yehowa, ona oshikpɔŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; ohã Israel esaa eshwere ekoŋŋ.
Okɛ omaŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ efa amɛ, ni okɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa amɛ.
Ofo omli ni fu amɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni oŋmɛɛ omlila kple lɛ he.
Ao wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋɔɔ wo oto wɔtoohe ekoŋŋ ni ofo omli ni efu wɔ lɛ sɛɛ!
Aso omli aaafu wɔ kɛaatee naanɔ? Oookã omlifu lɛ he kɛaaya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ?
Aso ohaŋ wɔyi ana wala ekoŋŋ, koni omaŋ lɛ anya kɛkafo bo?
Ao Yehowa, hã wɔna osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, ni ohã wɔyi ana wala!
Hã mabo nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawie toi, ejaakɛ ekɛ emaŋ lɛ kɛ ehetselɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa eŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ, baawie hejɔlɛ wiemɔ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ efee kralo kɛbaahere mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ayiwala koni anumnyam ahi wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Suɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ anɔkwayeli baakpe; ni jalɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ aaafua amɛhe atuu.
Anɔkwayeli aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ, ni jalɛ aaajɛ ŋwɛi egboo ehiɛ shi ekwɛ.
Hɛɛ! Yehowa aaaŋɔ nɔ kpakpa ehã, ni wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii babaoo.
Jalɛ saneyeli aaatsɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ eba; ni ebaasaa gbɛ ehã lɛ.
86: Ao Yehowa, gboo otoi shi ohã mi, ni ohã mi hetoo! Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi, ni efĩ mi!
Baamɔ miwala yi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ji mi. Heremɔ otsulɔ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ yiwala.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ; naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ bo miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ daa jeŋamɔ.
Hã otsulɔ susuma mii ashɛ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, bo misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ ohi ni oŋɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ ofaa; ni suɔmɔ ni osumɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔleɔ tsɛɔ bo lɛ fa babaoo.
Ao Yehowa, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ, ni obo mifaikpamɔ blɔmɔ toi!.
Mihaomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo, ejaakɛ ohereɔ mi nɔ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ ekoeko bɛ ni tamɔ bo; ni nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ onitsumɔ yeɔ egbɔ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ ni bo obɔ lɛ aaaba abakoto bo; ni amɛbaawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Ejaakɛ oje agbo, ni ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii. Bo okoome pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ao Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni miba mijeŋ mihã koni maba mijeŋ yɛ onɔkwale lɛ naa. Hã mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ashe bo gbeyei.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, miida bo shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni mawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ kple ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ fa hã mi. Ohere misusuma kɛje gbohiiajeŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hewolɔi ete shi ewo mi; yiwalɔi asafo miitao misusuma sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛkwɛɛɛ bo kwraa.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, shi bo lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ drolɔ ji o! Omli fuuu mra, ni osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ fa babaoo.
Kwɛmɔ mi ni odro mi, ŋɔɔ ohewalɛ ohã otsulɔ; heremɔ oweyoo bi lɛ yiwala.
Too mi suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔɔ mi lɛ he okadi ko, koni mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ana, ni amɛhiɛ agboi; ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa, oye obua mi, ni oshɛje mimii.
87: Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to lɛ ma!
Yehowa sɔmɔɔ Yerusalem maŋ lɛ fe Israel shihilɛhei fɛɛ!
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ, agbaa ohe anumnyam saji lɛ.
Matsi Egipt kɛ Babilon tã mafata maji ni le mi lɛ ahe. Makane Filistibii kɛ Tirobii kɛ kush mafata mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ ahe. Ejaakɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ: "Mɔnɛ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, jɛi afɔ lɛ yɛ."
Shi Zion lɛ, aaakɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, "Majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii yɛ ni jɛi afɔ amɛ yɛ;" ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baahã ema shi shiŋŋ.
Yehowa aaaŋmla maŋ lɛŋ bii agbɛii ewo woloŋ akɛ Yerusalembii.
Mɛi ni laa kɛ mɛi ni joɔ fɛɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ: "Wɔjɔmɔi fɛɛ kwa jɛɔ Zion."
88: Ao Yehowa, miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ lɛ, miblɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ.
Hã misɔlemɔ ashɛ ohiɛ; gboo otoi shi ohã miblɔmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ haomɔi babaoo eba minɔ, ni miwala miibɛŋkɛ gbohiiaje.
Abuɔ mi ashiɔ mɛi ni yaa gbohiiajeŋ anɔ. Mihewalɛ fɛɛ etã.
Mitamɔ mɛi ni akwa amɛ yɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ eko. Mitamɔ mɛi ni nyɔŋyɔɔi ni amɛkamɔ amɛgbonyobuiaŋ, tamɔ mɛi ni ohiɛ ekpa amɛnɔ kwraa lɛ eko, ejaakɛ obɛ wamɔ ko ni okɛbaawa amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Oshɛ mi ofɔ gbonyobu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, he ni mli kwɔ ni ewo duŋ kpii lɛ.
Omlifu lɛ kã minɔ, ni ohã oshɔkei lɛ fɛɛ ekumɔ eshwie minɔ.
Ohã minanemɛi ekwa mi; ohã mitsɔ̃ musumɔ mihã amɛ; aŋa miyi koni mikanyɛ kpo mije.
Awerɛho ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu. Ao Yehowa, miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo daa gbi, ni mikpãa miniji amli mihãa o.
Ani ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii ohãa gbohii lo? Ani sisai teɔ shi amɛjieɔ oyi lo?
Ani agbaa omlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he sane yɛ gbonyobu mli lo? Aloo awieɔ onɔkwayeli lɛ he yɛ he ni hiɛkpãtãmɔ yɔɔ?
Ani anaa onaakpɛɛnii yɛ he ni ewo duŋ lo? Aloo akaiɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni hiɛ kpaa nii anɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ao Yehowa, mi lɛ miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo; daa leebi maŋkpa lɛ misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ bo.
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛba oshɛ mi ofɔ̃ mɛɛba ni okɛ ohiɛ etee mi?
Kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi beebe lɛ minii yɛ mɔbɔ; ni miihe magbo. Ohe ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi, ni mijijaa.
Omlifu ni naa wa lɛ esu mi! Ohe ŋmiŋmi ekpãtã mihiɛ!
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, ohe ŋmiŋmi lɛ ebɔle mihe tamɔ nu afua, efo mihe sa kɛkpe.
Ohã shieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ nanemɛi fɛɛ ekwa mi, ni duŋ pɛ ji minaanyo ni eshwɛ.
89: Ao Yehowa, mala osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he lala kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ. Mikɛ minaabu baajaje onɔkwayeli lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni onɔkwayeli lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ŋwɛi.
Okɛɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ mɔ ni mihala lɛ ekpãŋ. Mikã mitsulɔ David kitã akɛ, 4.'Oshwiei ji mɛi ni baaye maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ; ni mahã omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ama shi kɛya yinɔi fɛɛ.'"
Ao Yehowa, hã ŋwɛi ajie onaakpɛɛnii yi; ni mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ajie onɛkwayeli lɛ hu yi yɛ asafo lɛ mli!
Ejaakɛ namɔ yɔɔ atatuiaŋ ni ekɛ bo, Yehowa, ye egbɔ? Ŋwɛibii lɛ ateŋ namɔ yɔɔ ni etamɔ Yehowa?
Nyɔŋmɔ ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi agwabɔɔ lɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei fe mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, Ao! Namɔ ji hewalɛtsɛ tamɔ bo, Yehowa? Onɔkwayeli ebɔle ohe kpula kɛkpe!
Oyɛ ŋshɛ grimɔ nɔ hewalɛ! Kɛji emli ŋshɔkei lɛ hole amɛhe nɔ lɛ, bo ojɔɔ amɛhe.
Otserɛ Rehab ni ji ŋshɔŋ kooloo awuiyelɔ lɛ mli, ni ogbe lɛ, ni okɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ gbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã.
Ŋwɛi lɛ onɔ ni, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu onɔ ni; je lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ obɔ.
Bo obɔ kooyi kɛ wuoyi fɛɛ. Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ miishɛɛ jieɔ ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Okɔ̃ɔjiaŋ wa waa! Onineshi wa naakpa! Ohewalɛ lɛ nɔ kwɔ gojoo!
Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ato shishi ama jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ. Anaa suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwayeli yɛ onɔ fɛɛ nɔ feemɔ mli.
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni le gbijurɔyeli lala lɛ, mɛi ni baa amɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa bo, Yehowa, ohiɛ lɛ;
mɛi ni amɛmli fliɔ amɛ gbi muu fɛɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ ni amɛkafoɔ ojalɛ lɛ;
ejaakɛ boji amɛhewalɛ lɛ nyam. Odromɔ hãa wɔyeɔ kunim.
Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã wɔhe lɛ; ni bo, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, bo owo maŋtsɛ ohã wɔ.
Blema ko lɛ okɛ otsuji anɔkwafoi lɛ wie yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, "Miye mibua kãkãlɔ ko, miŋɔ mɔ ko yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ ni miwo enɔ.
Mina mitsulɔ David; mifɔ lɛ mimu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mikɛto lɛ maŋtsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ minine aaahiɛ emli daa; mihewalɛ lɛ aaahã efi shi.
Ehenyɛlɔ nine tsɔ̃ŋ enɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ; yiwalɔ ko yeŋ enɔ kunim.
Mibakpãtã ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ yɛ ehiɛ, ni mibatswia mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ nii.
Maye lɛ anɔkwa, ni masumɔ lɛ kɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ; ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehewalɛ lɛ nɔ aaakwɔ.
Mibagble emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kɛjɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyamɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ.
Eeebo, ni eeekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Boji mi-Tsɛ kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mihebuu Tɛsaa!'
Mafee lɛ mikromɔbi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ wulu fe fɛɛ.
Majɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ mli mana lɛ mɔbɔ kɛaatee naanɔ; ni mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ aaama shi shiŋŋ.
Mahã eseshi ahi shi daa, ni emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ aaahi shi, beiaŋ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɔɔ nɛɛ.
Kɛji eshwiei lɛ kwa mimla lɛ, ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa,
kɛji amɛbule mikpɔi lɛ, ni amɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ,
no lɛ mikɛ dade tete aaagwao amɛ, yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi ahewo; ni mikɛ kplebi aaayi amɛ, yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee ni miyɔɔ hã David lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ, ni shi ni miwo lɛ lɛ, mikwaŋ.
Mikuŋ mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni nɔ ni eje minaa lɛ, mikpaleŋ.
"Mina mikɛ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekã mihe kitã momo; milakaŋ David.
Eshwiei aaahi shi daa kɛaatee naanɔ, ni emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ aaahi shi gbii abɔ ni hulu teɔ shi ni enyɔɔ shi nɛɛ.
Eeehi shi kɛya naanɔ tamɔ nyɔŋtsere; ni eeeye odase yɛ ŋwɛi kɛya naanɔ."
Shi agbɛnɛ okwa lɛ, ni oshɛ lɛ ofɔ̃; omli efu mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
Oku okɛ otsulɔ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, okɛ ekekre lɛ eshwishwia shikpɔŋ, ni obule lɛ.
Okumɔ emaŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ oshwie shi, ni ofee emɔji lɛ koikoi.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ lɛ haa enii; ni ehe gbɔmɛi tete bɔɔ lɛ ahora.
Ohã ehenyɛlɔi anine etsɔ̃ enɔ; ohã ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ miinya.
Ohã eklaŋte lɛ naa fee kutuushii yɛ ta mli, ni owaaa lɛ yɛ ta naa.
Oshɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli tsi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni oŋɔ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ otswa shi.
Ohã esha egbɔ; ohã hiɛgble eloo lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛba? Oooŋɔ ohe otee kɛyashi naanɔ lo? Mɛɛbe omlifu lɛ aaatso tamɔ la kɛyashi?
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ wala be shɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni obɔ adesã akɛ yaka nɔ ko kɛkɛ.
Mɛɛ adesã yɔɔ jeŋ, ni lɛ lɛ esaŋ enaa gbele? Namɔ aaanyɛ ehe ehere yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ?
Nuŋtsɛ, nɛgbɛ oblema suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɔɔ? Nɔ ni ojɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ mli okã David ehe kitã lɛ?
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ bɔ ni abɔɔ otsulɔ ahora ahãa lɛ, bɔ ni mɛi adɛŋ ahorabɔɔ hãa migbigbliɔ mimli lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ ahora; amɛbɔɔ lɛ ahora yɛ he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ kɛhoɔ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa kɛya naanɔ! Amen! Amen!
90: Ao Nuŋtsɔ, boji wɔbobaahe yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.
Be ni onako obɔ gɔji lɛ, ni onako obɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋ lɛ, boji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Okɛɔ akɛ, "Nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa!" Ni ohãa adesa kuɔ esɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ sū.
Ejaakɛ ohiɛ lɛ, afii akpe tamɔ nyɛ kpaakpa nyɛ, ni ebaho kɛtee; etamɔ nyɔɔŋ buu be pɛ.
Oloɔ adesai kɛyaa tamɔ faa loɔ nii; amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ lamɔ ni alaa; amɛtamɔ jwɛi ni feɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ leebi mli;
amɛfeɔ floŋŋ, ni amɛgbaa afofro; gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ amɛgbiɔ, ni amɛkplaa.
Wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ omlifu lɛ naa; ni omlila lɛ he ŋmiŋmi emɔ wɔ.
Oŋɔ wɔnishaianii lɛ oto ohiɛ, ni wɔdujiaŋ eshai lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ faŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ wɔgbii lɛ hoɔ oya yɛ omlifu lɛ naa; wɔyeɔ wɔfii lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.
Wɔwalaŋ afii lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni. Kɛji efa aahuu lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, kɛji gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ yɛ; shi amɛmli shwãanii lɛ, tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme sɔŋŋ ni. Wɔwala sɛɛ foɔ oya, ni wɔlaajeɔ kwraa.
Namɔ le omlifu lɛ mli walɛ? Namɔ le gbeyei ni esa akɛ asheɔ o yɛ omlila lɛ hewɔ?
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ koni wɔle wɔwalagbii lɛ ayibɔ koni wɔhiɛ akã shi?
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛ be yinɔ nɔŋŋ omli aaafu kɛyashi? Naa otsuji mɔbɔ.
Hã wɔtrɔ leebi kɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, koni wɔnya ni wɔmii ashɛ, wɔwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Hã wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe gbii babaoo; tamɔ ohao wɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe afii babaoo tamɔ gbii abɔ kɛ afii abɔ ni wɔye jramɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Hã wɔ ni ji otsuji lɛ ana onitsumɔi wuji lɛ, ni wɔshwiei hu ana onumnyam kple lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ana wɔ mɔbɔ; ehã wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi ashwere ahã wɔ! Hɛɛ! Wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi lɛ hã amɛshwere.
91: Mɔ ni hiɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ teemɔhe lɛ, ni ehiɔ Ofe lɛ hɔŋŋ lɛ shishi lɛ,
eeekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Mibobaahe kɛ mimɔɔ ji o, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ hu ni mihiɛ kã enɔ."
Ejaakɛ lɛ ebaajie bo kɛje henyɛlɔi adujiaŋ tsɔne kɛ gbele hela ni naa wa mli.
Ekɛ etsɛji aaaha onɔ, ni ooona abobaahe yɛ efiji ashishi. Enɔkwayeli lɛ, tsɛŋ kɛ dama ni.
Osheŋ nyɔɔŋ ŋmiŋmi loo gãimlibi ni atsɛ̃ shwane gbeyei;
loo gbele hela ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli, loo hela ni kpãtãa mɔ hiɛ shwane lɛ.
Kɛji mɛi akpe nyɔ yɛ omasɛi, ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋma nyɔ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ po lɛ, bo lɛ ebɛŋkɛŋ bo.
Ohiŋmɛi kɛkɛ okɛaakwɛ, ni ooona mɛi fɔ̃ɔji anyɔmɔwo.
Ejaakɛ okɛ Yehowa efee ohebulɔ; Ofee Ŋwɛinyo lɛ oteemɔhe,
no hewɔ lɛ nɔ fɔŋ ko efeŋ bo, ni haomɔ ko haomɔ ko bɛŋkɛŋ oshihilɛhe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawo ebɔfoi lɛ kitã yɛ ohewɔ ni amɛbu ohe, koni amɛbaa oyi yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.
Amɛaahiɛ o yɛ amɛdɛ̃, koni okaŋɔ onane oshi tɛ ko.
Ooonyiɛ jata kɛ shikpãa nɔ po, ooonaanaa jatabi kɛ jeŋ nɔ.
Mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, majie amɛ, ni mɛi ni le migbɛi lɛ mabu amɛhe.
Kɛji amɛtsɛ mi lɛ, mahere amɛ nɔ. Mi kɛ amɛ aaahi shi yɛ haomɔ mli; mahere amɛ, ni mawo amɛhiɛ nyam.
Mahã amɛtɔ kɛ walasɛɛtsɛlɛ, ni mahã amɛna miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ.
92: Ehi akɛ ada Yehowa shi, ni ala kɛjie, bo Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Ehi akɛ ashiɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he sane daa leebi, koni agba onɔkwayeli lɛ he sane daa gbɛkɛ
Ejaakɛ, bo Yehowa, onifeemɔ nii ehã mimii eshɛ mihe, ni oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ hãa milaa kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kwɛ bɔ ni onitsumɔi lɛ dra hã! Ni ojwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.
Enɛ ji nɔ ko ni buuluu nyɛɛɛ ale, ni kwashia hu nyɛɛɛ shishi anu,
akɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji miifu gblɔ̃gblɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi, ni efɔŋfeelɔi miishwere; kɛ̃lɛ naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ;
ejaakɛ, bo Yehowa ji Ofe kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ Ao Yehowa! Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã kɛ̃. Mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ nishaianii lɛ, aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã.
Shi ohã mihe ewa tamɔ wuo, ni ohã mimii eshɛ mihe.
Mina mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ashigbeemɔ kɛ mihiŋmɛi, ni mikɛ mitoi hu enu mɛi ni te shi wo mi lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ.
Jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ tɛŋ, ni eeeda tamɔ tɛŋ, ni eeeba tamɔ tsenedru ni ma Lebanon.
Amɛtamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ Yehowa we lɛŋ; amɛfrɔkeɔ yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛaakã he amɛwo yibii yɛ amɛgbɔlɛ beiaŋ tete, ni amɛaahi frɔ̃frɔ̃ kɛ amɛmli nu daa
koni amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ni. Lɛji mitɛsaa, ni nɔ ko ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ egbɛfaŋ.
93: Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ; ewula kɛ agbojee; Yehowa ewula; emia kɛ hewalɛ. No hewɔ lɛ je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni anyɛŋ ahoso.
Ao Yehowa, omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ kɛjɛ teteete, ni bo oyɔɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe.
Ao Yehowa, fai lɛ ewo amɛhe nɔ; fai lɛ ewo amɛgbee nɔ, fai lɛ ewo amɛhūumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ je agbo fe fɛɛ. Eje agbo fe nui babaoo lɛ agbɛɛmɔ; efe ŋshɔkei ahewalɛ.
Yehowa, okpɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, Owe lɛ he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛyaashi naanɔ.
94: Ao Yehowa, bo Nuŋtsɔ ni otɔɔ owele, bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni otɔɔ owele, bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni otɔɔ owele, hã ana omlifu.
Ao je lɛ kojolɔ, wo ohe nɔ, koni owo hewolɔi lɛ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa amɛ.
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ aaanya kɛyashi?
Amɛwieɔ amɛdaa obɔ̃, amɛwieɔ hewoo wiemɔi; mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ shwãa.
Ao Yehowa, amɛmiinaanaa owebii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛmiipiŋ omɛi lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, amɛgbeɔ yoo okulafo kɛ gbɔi, ni amɛgbeɔ awusai hu,
ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ "Yehowa enaaa, ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yooo sɛɛ."
Ao, nyɛ maŋ lɛŋ kwashiai, nyɛyoa sɛɛ! Ni nyɛ, buului, te be ni nyɛaale nii lɛ?
Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ toi lɛ, aso enuuu nii? Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, aso enaaa nii?
Lɛ mɔ ni ekuneɔ jeŋ maji lɛ, aso etsɔseee mɔ lo?
Lɛ mɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi anii lɛ, lɛ Yehowa lɛ, eleee akɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kɛkɛ ni lo?
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni bo, Yehowa, otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii, gbɔmɔ ni ojɛɔ omla lɛ mli otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii lɛ,
bɔ ni afee ni ohã ehe ajɔ lɛ fioo, yɛ fimɔ gbii amli, kɛyaashi aaatsa bu ni akɛdu mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kwaŋ emaŋ lɛ, ejeŋ emɛi lɛ asɛɛ,
ejaakɛ aaaku sɛɛ aye jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔhei lɛ, ni jalɔi fɛɛ aaafi sɛɛ kɛ amɛtsuiŋ fɛɛ.
Namɔ aaate shi awo efɔŋfeelɔi ahã mi? Namɔ aaadamɔ shi ashi mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii ahã mi?
Kɛjeee Yehowa ni ye bua mi lɛ, kulɛ benɛ misusuma yɛ gbohiiajeŋ kpoo.
Be ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Miishane lɛ!" Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ mɔ mimli.
Kɛji mikɔmɔyeli fa yɛ mimli lɛ, oshɛjeɔ mimii, ni mimii shɛɔ mihe.
Ani kojolɔi fɔ̃ɔji aaanyɛ amɛkɛ o abɔ, amɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mla moŋ nɔ kɛfeɔ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ?
Amɛkpãŋɔ jalɔ yinɔ, ni amɛbuɔ lá ni efeko efɔŋ ko gbele fɔ.
Shi Yehowa ji mimɔɔ ni wa, ni mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mibobaa tɛsaa.
Ebaahã amɛnishaianii lɛ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ; ni eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ. Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabɛɛ amɛ ashwie.
95: Ao nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔlaa wɔhãa Yehowa! Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa oshe wɔhãa wɔ-Yiwalaheremɔ Tɛsaa lɛ!
Nyɛhãa wɔbaa ehiɛ kɛ shidaa, wɔkɛ lala abɔa oshe kɛjiea eyi.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ji Yehowa, Maŋtsɛ ni fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
Edɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi yɔɔ, gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ hu enɔ ni.
Ŋshɔ lɛ enɔ ni, ni lɛ ebɔ; ni shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ hu eniji ni shɔ̃.
Ao, nyɛbaa! Nyɛhãa wɔkotoa lɛ, ni wɔjaa lɛ! Nyɛhãa wɔkulaa shi yɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Bɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ni wɔji elɛɛhe lɛŋ mɛi kɛ edɛŋ toi. Ao, mina ni kulɛ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛbo egbee toi!
Nyɛkawajea nyɛtsuii tamɔ eba lɛ yɛ Meriba lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfee yɛ Masa gbi lɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ minaa, amɛka mi amɛkwɛ, tsɛbelɛ, amɛna nibii ni mifee mihã amɛ lɛ.
Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ, nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ asane je mitsine, ni mikɛɛ akɛ "amɛji maŋ ko ni yeee anɔkwa, ni amɛbuuu mimlai lɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu mli akɛ, "Kɛ amɛna amɛshɛ hejɔlɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ fīī!"
96: Ao, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa! Jeŋ fɛɛ, nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa!
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi! Nyɛgbaa wɔyiwala ni ehere he sane lɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi.
Nyɛshiɛa enumnyam lɛ, yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ! Nyɛgbaa naakpɛɛnii ni efee lɛ nyɛtsɔa mɛi fɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo, ni esa akɛ asheɔ lɛ gbeyei fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maji krokomɛi anyɔŋmɔi lɛ, amãgãi ni; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
Anumnyam kɛ agbojee ebɔle ehe, hewalɛ kɛ fɛo eyi ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃.
Ao maji amli wekui, nyɛkafoa Yehowa; nyɛkafoa Yehowa; nyɛkafoa enumnyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ!
Nyɛkɛ anumnyam ni sa Yehowa gbɛi lɛ ahãa lɛ; nyɛhiɛa afɔlei kɛbaa, nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ!
Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkotoa kɛjaa Yehowa kɛji epue yɛ egbojeiaŋ! Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa yɛ ehiɛ!
Nyɛkɛa yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ akɛ, "Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ! No hewɔ je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni anyɛŋ lɛ ahoso. Eeekojo gbɔmɛi yɛ jalɛ naa."
Ŋwɛi anya! Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afli lɛ! Hã ŋshɔ ahūu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ!
Ŋa abɔ oshe kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ emli! Kɛkɛ lɛ kooŋ tsei fɛɛ aaala kɛ miishɛɛ,
yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ejaakɛ eeba; eeba koni ebakojo shikpɔŋ lɛ. Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ebaakojo adesa yɛ anɔkwayeli naa.
97: Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ! Shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afli lɛ! Ŋshɔkpɔi babaoo lɛ anya!
Oblɔtu kɛ duŋ kpii ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe! Emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ma jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ.
La tsoɔ kɛnyiɛ ehiɛ, ni ekpãtãa ehenyɛlɔi ni bɔle lɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
Esrawai lɛ hãa jeŋ tseɔ, je lɛ naa enɛ, ni ekpokpoɔ.
Gɔji lɛ sereɔ tamɔ wo agbaku yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ŋwɛi jajeɔ ejalɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni maji fɛɛ tswɛm naa enumnyam lɛ.
Amãgã jalɔi fɛɛ, mɛi ni shwãa fɔ̃ɔ yakayaka amãgãi anɔ lɛ, ahiɛ aaagboi. Nyɛ nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ tswɛm, nyɛkotoa Yehowa.
Ao Yehowa, Zion nu he, ni emii shɛ ehe; ni Yuda maji lɛ amli fli amɛ, yɛ okojomɔi lɛ ahemɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, boji Ofe, mɔ ni kwɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke nyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsumɔɔ Yehowa lɛ, nyɛnyɛa efɔŋ! Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa emɛi anɔkwafoi lɛ awala yi; ehereɔ amɛyiwala kɛjeɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji adɛŋ.
La aaakpɛ ahã jalɔ, ni miishɛɛ aaaba ahã mɔ ni ja yɛ etsuiŋ lɛ.
Ao, nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛnyaa yɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efee hewɔ! Ni nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi kɛ shidaa.
98: Ao, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa, ejaakɛ efee naakpɛɛnii. Ejɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ krɔŋŋ lɛŋ eye kunim ehã ehe.
Yehowa ehã ale kunim ni eye lɛ; ejie edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kpo faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ.
Ekai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ enɔkwayeli ni eyɔɔ hã Isreal we lɛ. Je lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ ena kunim ni wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ye lɛ.
Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ miishɛɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛlaa miishɛɛ lalai, nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai!
Nyɛkɛ kpãa saŋku alaa yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa Yehowa. Hɛɛ! Nyɛtswaa kpãa saŋku kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtrɛmantrɛi, nyɛkpãa koofɛŋi! Ni nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ abɔa oshe yɛ wɔ-maŋtsɛ Yehowa hiɛ!
Ŋshɔ ahūu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ; je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli abɔ oshe!
Fai atswa amɛdɛ̃, ni gɔji bluublu ala kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ;
ejaakɛ eeba ebaye je lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ. Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni ebaakojo gbɔmɛi bɔ ni sa pɛ.
99: Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ; maji lɛ ahe akpokpo! Eta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ kerubii anɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ ahoso!
Yehowa je agbo yɛ Zion, awo enɔ gojoo fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Aaajie ogbɛi kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ yi. Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ!
Maŋtsɛ Ofe ni sumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli, ohã jalɛ saneyeli ema shi; ni aafee nɔ ni ja yɛ Israel.
Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; nyɛjaa yɛ enaneshi maaŋoo lɛ hiɛ! Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mose kɛ Aaron fata osɔfoi lɛ ahe; ni Samuel hu shi mɛi ni ja Yehowa lɛ anɔ. Amɛbo amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni ehere amɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ amɛ wie yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli; amɛye emlai kɛ akpɔi ni eŋɔhã amɛ lɛ anɔ.
Ao Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, ohere amɛ nɔ; otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ŋɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ efaa ji o; tsɛbelɛ ogbla amɛtoi yɛ eshai ni amɛfeefee ahewɔ.
Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ! Nyɛjaa yɛ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
100: Shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛhãa Yehowa!
Nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa kɛ miishɛɛ; nyɛbaa ehiɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala!
Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa lɛ, lɛji Nyɔŋmɔ! Lɛ ebɔ wɔ, ni lɛ enii ji wɔ; emaŋ kɛ elɛɛhe lɛ toi ji wɔ.
Nyɛbotea egboi lɛ amli kɛ shidaa! Nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ yijiemɔ! Nyɛdaa lɛ shi, nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa hi; esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɛ kɛyaa naanɔ; ni enɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ!
101: Mala anɔkwayeli kɛ jalɛ saneyeli he lala! Hɛɛ, bo Yehowa, oyi mala majie.
Mikɛ nilee baaba mijeŋ koni shwamɔ ko akahi mihe. Te be ni manyɛ enɛ he mashɛ hu? Mikɛ tsui krɔŋŋ aaaba mijeŋ yɛ miwe lɛŋ.
Mikɛ nɔ ko gbonyo ko emaŋ mihiɛ. Mihiɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji anifeemɔnii; egbaleŋ mi fɔŋfɔ̃.
Tsui ni yeee anɔkwa akagbale mi fɔŋfɔ̃. Miyeŋ kɛyaŋ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ enaanyo he osheku yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ, makpãtã ehiɛ. Mɔ ni yɔɔ gɛ̃gɛ̃ɛgɛ̃ kɛ henɔwomɔ tsui lɛ mikɛ lɛ yeŋ.
Mana shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anɔkwafoi lɛ mɔbɔ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ mi ahi shi. Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ eeesɔmɔ mi.
Shishiulɔ ko ehiŋ miwe lɛŋ; ni amalelɔ ko damɔŋ mihiɛ.
Daa leebi lɛ, makpãtã mɛi fɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; mɛi ni feɔ nifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ, maflɔ amɛ fɛɛ mashwie kɛje Yehowa maŋ lɛŋ.
102: Ao, Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi; hã miblɔmɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ.
Mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi. Ba otoi shi ohã mi. Gbi nɔ ni mablɔ matsɛ o lɛ, heremɔ mi nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ migbii lɛ hoɔ yaa tamɔ lasu, ni miwui ahe edɔ tamɔ latɛŋ.
Mitsui eboo, ni egbi tamɔ jwɛi. Mihiɛ kpaa miniyeli tete po nɔ.
Mikɛ̃mɔɔ waa; mitã loo kãnyãkãnyã.
Mitsɔ ŋanɔ patu, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ amaŋfɔ̃i amli patu.
Mibɛɛɛ mihiŋmɛi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ. Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ looflɔ ni ekome too eyɔɔ tsu yiteŋ.
