Mihenyɛlɔi bɔɔ mi ahora gbi muu fɛɛ. Mɛi ni yeɔ mihe fɛo lɛ kɛ migbɛi lomɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ lamlu etsɔ̃ miniyenii tamɔ aboloo; ni midãa lɛ mikɛ yaafonu futuɔ mli,
yɛ omlila kɛ omlifu lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ owo mi, ni oshɛ mi ofɔ̃.
Miwala gbii hoɔ tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔɔŋ ni migbi tamɔ jwɛi;
shi, bo Yehowa, ooye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Obaate shi, ni obaana Zion mɔbɔ; ejaakɛ omɔbɔnalɛ be nɛ; be ni ato lɛ eshɛ.
Ejaakɛ Zion mli tɛi lɛ ajra wa yɛ otsuji lɛ ahiɛ; ni amɛmusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.
Majimaji lɛ aaashe Yehowa gbɛi lɛ gbeyei, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaashe onumnyam lɛ.
Kɛji Yehowa Tswa Zion ema shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, eeepue yɛ enumnyam mli.
Eeegboo etoi shi ehã shitswialɔi asɔlemɔ; ni enyaŋeŋ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ.
Hã aŋma enɛ afɔ shi ahã yinɔbii ni baa lɛ, koni mɛi ni afɔko amɛ tete po ajie Yehowa yi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekwɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Koni ebo gboklɛfoi lɛ akɛ̃ɛmɔ toi koni ekpɔ̃ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni ahiɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yɛ Zion; ni ajie eyi hu yɛ Yerusalem;
be mli ni majimaji kɛ matsɛyelii aaabuabua amɛhe naa amɛja Yehowa lɛ.
Yehowa egbɔjɔ mi yɛ miblahiiaŋ; etse miwala gbii lɛ anɔ.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, Bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ lɛ, kaaŋɔ mi kɛmiiya yɛ miwala be lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
Blema beebe oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ŋwɛi lɛ, onijianaa nitsumɔ ni.
Nomɛi ahiɛ aaakpãtã, shi bo lɛ oyɛ daa. Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaatserɛ tamɔ atade; otsakeɔ amɛ tamɔ mama, ni amɛhoɔ amɛyaa.
Shi bo lɛ oyɛ bɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ofii lɛ bɛ naagbee.
Otsuji abii aaahi shi, ni amɛshwiei hu aaahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ ohiɛ.
103: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi misusuma, ni nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mimli, nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
Ao, misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi, ni ohiɛ akakpa nibii juji ni efeɔ lɛ fiaa nɔ.
Lɛji mɔ ni ekɛ onishaianii fɛɛ faa; ni etsaa ohelai fiaa kwa lɛ.
Lɛ ehereɔ oyiwala kɛjeɔ gbonyobu mli, ni ekɛ mlihilɛ kɛ musuŋtsɔle fiɔ bo akekre.
Lɛ ekɛ nii kpakpai droɔ bo owalabeiaŋ fɛɛ; ni oblahiiaŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee tamɔ okropɔŋ.
Yehowa kojoɔ, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ehãa mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim.
Lɛ ehã Mose le eyiŋtoi lɛ, ni ehã Israelbii lɛ le enifeemɔnii lɛ.
Mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ drolɔ ji Yehowa, emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.
Jeee be fɛɛ be ekãa mɔ, ni ebɛɛɛ mɔ ewooo emli.
Ekɛ wɔ yeee yɛ wɔhe eshai anaa, ni ewooo wɔ nyɔŋmɔ yɛ wɔnishaianii lɛ anaa.
Shi moŋ, bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ.
Bɔ ni bokã kɛ anai teŋ jekɛ lɛ, nakai ehãa wɔ kɛ wɔtɔmɔi lɛ ateŋ jekɛɔ.
Bɔ ni tsɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ahe lɛ, nakai Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe.
Ejaakɛ ele wɔsu kɛ wɔbaŋ; ekaiɔ akɛ sū kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa lɛ, egbii tamɔ jwɛi; efeɔ floŋŋ tamɔ jwɛiiaŋ fɔfɔi.
Kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa nɔ kɛho pɛ, ebɛ dɔŋŋ; ni he ni ema lɛ leee lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ eyɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Eyɛ hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, ni ejalɛ lɛ yɛ hã bii abii.
Eyɛ hã mɛi ni toɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkaiɔ ekitãi lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi; ni lɛ eyeɔ jeŋ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ao, nyɛ ebɔfoi ni he wa, ni nyɛyeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛboɔ egbee toi, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ etai lɛ fɛɛ kwa, nyɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi ni feɔ esuɔmɔnaanii, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa bɔ ni yɔɔ enɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi. Ao mikla, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
104: Ao, misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, oda naakpa! Owula naakpa kɛ woo kɛ agbojee.
Oha la tamɔ ahaa mama, ni olɛɛ ŋwɛi mli oha shi tamɔ buu.
Oma oshīa lɛ yɛ nui anɔ: Oŋɔ atatui okɛfee oshwiilii; otaa kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ okɛsheraa shi.
Oŋɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ofeɔ otsuji; ni oŋɔɔ la kɛ la srɛmi ofeɔ osɔ̃ɔlɔi
Oto shikpɔŋ lɛ oma shi shiŋŋ yɛ fanesiinɔ koni ekahoso kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Okɛ nu ha he tamɔ mama, ni nu lɛ su gɔji lɛ ayi.
Oŋa nui lɛ ayi, ni amɛjo foi; oŋwɛishiimɔ naa lɛ, amɛjo foi oya.
Gɔji lɛ holeholee amɛhe nɔ, ni jɔi lɛ hu babaa shi kɛtee he ni oto ohã amɛ lɛ.
Oto husu ohã nui koni amɛkateke ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ohãa nuhiŋmɛii tueɔ kɛjɛɔ jɔi amli, ni amɛhoɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ.
Amɛhãa ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ nu amɛnuɔ, ni ŋaŋ tejii lɛ kɛgbeɔ amɛkumai.
Loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ fai lɛ ahe; ni amɛlaa yɛ tsei aniji lɛ ateŋ.
Ojɛɔ oshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, onɛɔ nu oshwieɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ. Onitsumɔi amli yibii lɛ hãa shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔɔ.
Ohãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ hãa kooloi ni tsei kwɛ̃ɔ hãa gbɔmɛi koni niyenii ajɛ shikpɔŋ aba;
kɛ wain ni hãa adesa tsui nyɔɔ emli, kɛ mu ni hãa gbɔmɔ hiɛ kpɛɔ; kɛ aboloo ni hãa gbɔmɔ adesa hewalɛ lɛ.
Lebanon tsei lɛ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ tɛo lɛ, eshwie amɛnɔ nu jogbaŋŋ.
Tsei nɛɛ anɔ loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ. Gɔ̃dɔ̃i lɛ, sɛsɛoi lɛ amli amɛtsui yɔɔ.
Gɔji somlomoi lɛ anɔ ji duji abobaahe; ni afutuɔkɔi anɔ ji tɛsai amli.
Oto nyɔŋtsere koni ekadi nyɔji lɛ; hulu hu le eshinyɔɔ be.
Ohãa duŋ woɔ, ni je naa; no mli kooŋ kooloi fɛɛ jeɔ kpo.
Jatabii hūɔ kɛtaoɔ milɛ loo; amɛkɛtaoɔ amɛniyenii kɛjɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
Kɛji hulu je lɛ amɛgblaa amɛhe shi; ni amɛyabumɔɔ amɛwɔɔhei.
Kɛkɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ jeɔ kpo eyaa enitsumɔ, ni eyagboɔ deŋme kɛyashiɔ gbɛkɛ.
Ao Yehowa, onitsumɔi lɛ fa naakpa, fɛɛ jɛ onilee mli. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ onibɔɔnii sɔŋŋ.
Ŋshɔ nɛ, eba, ni elɛɛ tɛtrɛɛ; nibii ni anyɛɛɛ akane wamɔɔ yɛ mli, loi bibii kɛ ewuji fɛɛ.
Lɛji nyiɛɔ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ; emli nɔŋŋ Leviatan ni obɔ lɛ shwɛɔ yɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ bo pɛ gbɛ amɛkwɛɔ, koni ohã amɛ amɛniyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.
Ohãa amɛ nii, ni amɛbuaa naa; Ogbeleɔ odɛ̃, ni amɛtrɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.
Kɛ okɛ ohiɛ tee lɛ, amɛhaoɔ, kɛ oŋɔ amɛmumɔ lɛ, amɛgboiɔ; ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛyaa amɛsu ni amɛjɛ mli lɛŋ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji okɛ omumɔ lɛ wo amɛmli lɛ, wala baa amɛmli; ni wala hee baa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa anumnyam lɛ ahi shi kɛya naanɔ. Yehowa anya enitsumɔi lɛ ahe!
Lɛji mɔ ni kɛ ekwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ hosoɔ, kɛ eta gɔji lɛ ahe lɛ, amɛjeɔ lasu.
Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, mala mahã Yehowa. Gbii abɔ ni miyɔɔ wala mli nɛɛ, mala majie mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
Miyiŋsusumɔ asa Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ ehãa minaa miishɛɛ.
Hã eshafeelɔi atã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni efɔŋfeelɔi akahi shi dɔŋŋ. Ao misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
105: Ao, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, Nyɛtsɛa lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ. Nyɛhãa alea enifeemɔnii lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa lɛ; nyɛlaa nyɛjiea eyi. Nyɛgbaa enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fiaa.
Nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃a egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ atsui anyɔ amɛmli.
Nyɛtaoa Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛtaoa ehiɛgbɛ daa. 5-6. Ao nyɛ, etsulɔ Abraham shwiei, nyɛ Yakobbii ni ehala, nyɛkaia naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi ni etsu lɛ; kɛ kojomɔi ni ekojo lɛ.
Lɛji Yehowa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, emlai lɛ yɛ hã jeŋ muu fɛɛ.
Ehiɛ yɛ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ. Ehiɛ yɛ ewiemɔ ni ekɛ ma shi ehã yinɔi akpe lɛ nɔ;
kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kpãŋ lɛ, kitã ni ekã Isak lɛ;
kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa ma nɔ mi ehã Yakob akɛ akpɔ lɛ; nɔ ni ekɛhã Isreal hu akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Bo maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã akɛ nyɛbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ gboshinii."
No be mli be ni amɛyi faaa ko, ni amɛyi shɛɛɛ nɔ ko, ni gbɔi ji amɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ni amɛtsomlo kɛjɛ maŋ kome nɔ kɛtee maŋ kroko nɔ; kɛjɛ maŋtsɛyelihe kome nɔ kɛtee ekroko mli lɛ.
Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ, ni efee amɛ efɔŋ ko; ni ekã majiatsɛmɛi ahiɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkataa mimɛi ni mifɔ amɛmu lɛ ahe; ni migbalɔi lɛ hu, nyɛkafea amɛ efɔŋ ko."
Be ni Yehowa hã hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni anaaa nii aye lɛ,
etsu nuu ko kɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ, Yosef mɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ.
Awo enaji gboklɛ, ni apiŋ lɛ, ni awo ekuɛ dade kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃,
Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ewiemɔ lɛ ba mli, ni Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ ma ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mi.
Egipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu ni ayafɛne lɛ; maji anɔyelɔ lɛ hã eye ehe tswaa.
Ewo lɛ onukpa yɛ ewe lɛ, ni efee lɛ enibii fɛɛ nɔyelɔ;
koni etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ amɛfee, ni etsɔ̃ɔ emaŋ onukpai lɛ hu nilee.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tee Egipt, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Ham shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni Yehowa hã Yakobbii lɛ shwere naakpa; ni ehã amɛhe wa hu fe amɛhenyɛlɔi kwraa.
Yehowa hã Egiptbii lɛ nyɛ Yakob webii lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ ye ŋaa mli.
Kɛkɛ ni etsu etsulɔ Mose kɛ Aaron, mɛi ni ehala lɛ.
Amɛtsu Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ Egipt; amɛfee naakpɛɛ nii lɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã duŋ wo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wo duŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ Egiptbii lɛ booo efamɔ lɛ toi.
Ehã amɛfai amli nui lɛ tsɔ̃ lá, ni amɛmli loi lɛ gboi.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ kɔkɔdenei; amɛbote amɛmaŋtsɛwe lɛ piai amli tete.
Nyɔŋmɔ fã, kɛkɛ ni adɔdɔji kɛ ofɔii bayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ.
Ehã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ nɛ yɛ nu naijaŋ; ni srawa gbla yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ
Ekumɔ amɛwaintsei kɛ agbamitsei lɛ; ekpãtã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Efã, kɛkɛ ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi ni aleee amɛyibɔ ba.
Amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bai fɛɛ, ni amɛ ye ŋmɔjiashi nii fɛɛ hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtã kromɔbi fɛɛ ni ji amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ shishijee lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni ejie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛhiɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni Israelbii lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hewalɛ kpintiŋkpliŋŋ
Egipt nya yɛ amɛjɛijee lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ.
Yehowa lɛɛ atatu mli ekɛha amɛnɔ. Ehã amɛ la ni hã jeŋ tse nyɔɔŋ.
Amɛbi, ni ehã trakɔkɔi ba; ni ehã amɛ niyenii, babaoo ni jɛ ŋwɛi.
Egble tɛsaa naa, ni nu tue kɛho; nu lɛ ho kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ faa.
Ejaakɛ ekai eshiwoo krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni ewo etsulɔ Abraham lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ ejie emaŋ lɛ kɛje kpo kɛ miishɛɛ, ehalamɔbii lɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Eŋɔ majimaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ ehã amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ mɛi lɛ adeŋmegbomɔ mli nitsumɔnii lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ,
bɔ ni afee ni amɛto ekpɔi lɛ ni amɛye nɔ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
106: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Namɔ aaanyɛ Yehowa hewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ agba? Namɔ aaanyɛ eyijiemɔ lɛ agba kɛwula shi?
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ jalɛ sane ni amɛfeɔ nɔ ni ja be fɛɛ be lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kaimɔ mi kɛji ona omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ. Kɛji oohere amɛyiwala lɛ, ye obua mi,
koni mana ohalamɔbii lɛ ashweremɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ mli afli lɛ, koni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ anya kɛ yijiemɔ.
Wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, wɔfee esha; wɔfee efɔŋ, ni wɔye yiwalɛ sane.
Be ni wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ Egipt lɛ, amɛyooo onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ asɛɛ, amɛkaii osuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ; shi moŋ, amɛtse Ŋwɛi Flooflonya lɛ hiɛ atūa, yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ ehere amɛyiwala yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ; koni ehã ale ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ.
Eŋa Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ yi, ni egbi; ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, oookɛɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala kɛjɛ mɔ ni hetsɛ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Nu lɛ su amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi gbidigbidi, eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome flo nɛkɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe ewiemɔi lɛ amɛye; amɛla amɛjie eyi.
Shi yeee be ko, ni amɛhiɛ kpa nii ni etsu ehã amɛ lɛ anɔ, ni amɛmɛɛ eŋaawoo dɔŋŋ.
Amɛyadi amɛkɔnɔnii asɛɛ fe nine yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ehã amɛ amɛnitaomɔnii lɛ, shi ehã lootãa hela ko ni naa wa babote amɛteŋ.
Amɛklɔ Mose kɛ Aaron, Yehowa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, lɛ nɔ, yɛ shitoohe lɛŋ,
ni shikpɔŋ gba, ni emi Datan, ni etsimɔ Abiram kɛ eŋa kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ anɔ gbidigbidi.
La je yɛ amɛsafo lɛ mli, ni la lilɛi shã mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ.
Amɛfee shika tsinabi amãgã hu yɛ Sinai, ni amɛja amãgã ni ashwie lɛ.
Amɛŋɔ anumnyam lɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ amɛhã tsina ni kpeɔ jwɛi amãgã lɛ moŋ.
Amɛhiɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ, amɛyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, mɔ ni fee nii wuji yɛ Egipt lɛ, nɔ.
Lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ Egipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni efee gbeyei nibii yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ to akɛ ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ; shi etsulɔ Mose, mɔ ni eŋɔ lɛ lɛ, damɔ mli ehã amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ejɔɔ mlifu lɛ he koni ekakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Amɛgbe shikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ he guɔ, ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo lɛ amɛyeee.
Amɛwie huhuuhu yɛ amɛbuui amli; ni amɛbooo Yehowa gbee toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ni eshɛrɛ amɛshwiei lɛ eshwã majimaji lɛ amli; egbɛ amɛ eshwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ.
Amɛkɛ amɛhe yabɔ jemawɔŋ Baal jalɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Peor; ni amɛye nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã gbohii.
Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii wo Yehowa mlifu; ni gbele hela bote amɛteŋ.
Shi Finehas te shi, ni edamɔ mli ehã amɛ; kɛkɛ ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Hewɔ lɛ, abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ kɛjɛ yinɔ kome nɔ kɛtee ekroko nɔ, aahuu kɛya shi naanɔ fɛɛ.
Amɛwo Yehowa mlifu yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he, ni amɛhewɔ lɛ, Mose na amane.
Amɛwo Mose mli la, ni amɛhã enaa tɛ shi.
Amɛkpãtãaa jɛŋbii lɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ,
shi moŋ amɛfutu amɛ ni amɛkase amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ.
Yehowa webii lɛ ja maŋsɛɛbii amãgãi lɛ, ni no hã amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃.
Amɛŋɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ, amɛkɛshãshãa afɔlei amɛhã wɔji.
Amɛshwie amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi amɛkashã afɔle amɛhã Kanaan amãgãi lɛ ni amɛkɛ lá lɛ bule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ wo amɛhe muji, ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa.
No hewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu emaŋ lɛ, ni enyaŋe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii lɛ.
Etu amɛ ewo jeŋbii adɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ye amɛnɔ
Amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ wa amɛyi waa, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ba amɛ shi amɛwo amɛhewalɛ shishi.
Yehowa jie amɛ shii abɔ, shi amɛkɛ amɛkuɛŋtilɛ tse ehiɛ atũa; ni aba amɛ shi yɛ amɛhe esha lɛ hewɔ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, be ni enu amɛblɔmɔ lɛ, enu amɛhaomɔ lɛ he ehã amɛ.
Ekai ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
Ehã majimaji fɛɛ ni ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ na amɛ mɔbɔ.
Ao Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala; ni obua wɔnaa kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛba, koni wɔda bo shi, ni wɔjie ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa Irsael Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ; ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛɛ akɛ, "Amen!" Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
107: Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.
Mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ akɛɛ nakai, mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ haomɔ mli lɛ.
Mɛi ni ebua amɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, akɛɛ nakai.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi tsomlo yɛ shiaŋa ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ; amɛnaaa gbɛ ko ni kã kɛyaa maŋ ni gbɔmɛi yɔɔ mli mli.
Hɔmɔ kɛ kumai ye amɛ, ni amɛtɔ biti.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli, ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli;
ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ trɔmɔɔ nɔ, kɛyashɛ maŋ ni gbɔmɔ hiɔ mli mli.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi, yɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi abii lɛ hewɔ.
Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, ehãa lɛ nu enuɔ; ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ lɛ, ehãa etɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.
Mɛi komɛi hu tra duŋ kɛ awerɛho mli, gboklɛfoi ni awo amɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ ni amɛyɔɔ amanehulu mli.
Ejaakɛ amɛte shi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni amɛnyaŋe Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ ŋaawoo lɛ.
Akɛ nitsumɔ keketee jɔɔ amɛhe; amɛgbeegbee shi ni bualɔ ko bɛ.
Ni amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
Ejie amɛ kɛjɛ duŋ kɛ awerɛhoo mli, ni etserɛ amɛkɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ amli.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ ekumɔ akɔɔble agboi lɛ, ni eflɔ dade adabaŋi lɛ amli.
Mɛi komɛi lɛ, amɛnishaianii wo amɛ hela; ni amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ amɛna nɔ.
Niyenii ko niyenii ko baaa amɛtsine, ni amɛbɛŋkɛ gbonyobu naa kpaakpa,
ni amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
Efã, ni ewiemɔ lɛ tsa amɛ; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi, yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.
Hã amɛshã shidaa afɔlei, ni amɛkɛ nyamɔ lalai agba enitsumɔi lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi kɛ lɛji yanyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, ni amɛtsu nii yɛ nui wuji lɛ ahiɛ;
amɛ amɛna Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ; amɛna enaakpɛɛnii lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ lɛ efã ni ehã ahum ni naa wa tswa; ni ehã ŋshɔkei lɛ fee hamahama.
Ŋshɔkei lɛ holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni amɛnyɔɔ shi kɛyaa ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, ni amlakui lɛ atsui fãa yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ mli.
Amɛkpaa, ni amɛdidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔi, ni amɛŋaa fɛɛ laajeɔ amɛ.
Ni amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli, ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
Ehã ahum lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa kwraa, ni ŋshɔkei lɛ ŋmɛ dɛŋŋ.
Amɛmii shɛ amɛhe ejaakɛ haomɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo, ni ekɛ amɛ eshɛ amɛble ni amɛshweɔ lɛ mli shweshweeshwe.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.
Hã amɛkafo lɛ yɛ maŋ asafo lɛŋ, ni amɛjie eyi yɛ onukpai akpee lɛŋ.
Ehãa fai tsɔ̃mɔɔ shiaŋa; ni ehãa he ni nuhiŋmɛi baa yɛ tsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.
Ehãa shikpɔŋ ni baa nii tsɔ̃ɔ ŋoo shikpɔŋ yɛ mɛi ni hiɔ jɛi lɛ anifeemɔnii hewɔ.
Ehãa shiaŋa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo ni ehãa nuhiŋmɛi tueɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ gbiɔ mli.
Ehãa mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ hiɛ jɛi, ni amɛtoɔ maŋ amɛhiɔ mli.
Amɛfeɔ ŋmɔji, ni amɛduɔ nii; amɛfeɔ waintromi, ni amɛkpaa nii babaoo.
Ejɔɔ amɛ, ni amɛyi faa naakpa; ehãaa amɛtsinai ayifalɛ nɔ agbɔ.
Kɛji akɛ yiwalɛ kɛ haomɔ kɛ awerɛho hã amɛnɔ gbɔ, ni aba amɛshi tete lɛ,
egbeɔ lumɛi ahiɛ, ni ehãa amɛtsomloɔ yɛ shiaŋa ni gbɛ kadimɔ nɔ bɛ nɔ;
shi ejieɔ ohiafoi kɛjɛɔ amanehului amli, ni ehãa amɛshwiei shwereɔ tamɔ tookui.
Jalɔ naa kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi, ni amɛmii sheɔ amɛhe, shi efɔŋfeelɔi tɔɔ mu.
Hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji nilelɔ lɛ ekase nii kɛjɛ enɛɛmɛi amli; Hã amɛsusu Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he.
108: Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mitsui enyɔ mimli! Mala lala kɛŋɔɔmɔ mahã bo. Misusuma, ohiɛ atsɛ̃!
Obenta kɛ saŋku, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a! Mahã leebi hiɛ atsɛ̃ mra!
Ao Yehowa, mada bo shi, yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ, ni majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ!
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kwɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi, ni onɔkwayeli lɛ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi, ni onumnyam lɛ ekple shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere wɔyiwala. Bo mifaikpamɔ toi, bɔ ni afee ni ohere mɛi ni osumɔɔ lɛ ayiwala.
Nyɔŋmɔ ewie yɛ Ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ: Ekɛɔ akɛ, "Mikɛ miishɛɛ aaaja Shekem mli, ni maja Sukot Jɔɔ lɛ mahã miwebii.
Minɔ ji Gilead; ni minɔ ji Manase; Efraim ji midade fai, ni Yuda lɛ, mimaŋtsɛ tsi ni.
Moab ji mihejuu goga; majie mitokota matswa Edom; Mabɔ kunimyeli oshe mawo Filistia."
Namɔ aaaŋɔ mi kɛaatee maŋ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ mli? Namɔ aaanyiɛ mihiɛ kɛaatee Edom?
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, ani okwa wɔ lɛɛlɛŋ? Onyiɛɛɛ wɔtai lɛ ahiɛ kɛyaaa ta dɔŋŋ?
Ao, ye obua wɔ koni wɔkɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi awu; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ jeee fɛifɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa lɛ wɔɔye kunim, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ aaanaanaa wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kɛmɔ shi.
109: Ao bo Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ yi ni mijieɔ, kaamua onaa!
Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ osatofoi miitswa mi lilɛi; amɛmiimale mihe.
Amɛhetsɛ̃ wiemɔi efo sa ewo mihe; amɛtua mi yakatswaa ni mifeko nɔ ko.
Be ni miisumɔ amɛ ni miisɔle miihã amɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi moŋ.
Amɛkɛ efɔŋ toɔ mi ekpakpa najiaŋ, ni amɛkɛ nyɛɛ toɔ misuɔmɔ lɛ najiaŋ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Fãa yiwalɔ ko owo ehe, hã naaflɔlɔ ko aflɔ enaa.
Kɛ akojo lɛ lɛ, hã abu lɛ fɔ; ni eŋɔ esɔlemɔ po akɛ eshafeemɔ.
Afo ewala gbii anɔ kuku; ni enii fɛɛ atsɔ̃ mɔ kroko nɔ.
Hã ebii atsɔ̃mɔ awusãi, ni eŋa atsɔ̃ okulafo.
Hã ebii akpa shi amɛsisɛ̃; hã ashwie amɛ yɛ amaŋfɔ̃i tete ni amɛyɔɔ mli lɛ amli.
Enyɔmɔtsɛ ashɔ̃ nii ni eyɔɔ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ; ni gbɔi hu aha edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli nii fɛɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafee lɛ ejurɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hu akana ebii awusãi lɛ mɔbɔ.
Hã aplenee eshwiei fɛɛ, ni agbe egbɛi yɛ yinɔi ni baaba lɛ ateŋ.
Yehowa akai etsɛmɛi lɛ anishaianii lɛ, ni akɛ enyɛ he esha lɛ hu akafa lɛ.
Yehowa akai amɛhe eshai lɛ daa; amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, akakai amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ejwɛŋŋ ejurɔfeemɔ he; shi moŋ ewa ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ewerɛ eho ehe lɛ yi, kɛyashiɔ egbele mli.
Esumɔɔ loomɔ; hewɔ lɛ loomɔ aba enɔ; esumɔɔɔ jɔɔmɔ; hewɔ lɛ ekɛ jɔɔmɔ teŋ ajekɛ.
Ewo loomɔ tamɔ atade; loomɔ lɛ abote ehewojiaŋ tamɔ nu, ni ebote ewuiaŋ tamɔ mu.
Loomɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ mama ni ebu daa; kɛ mlifiinɔ, ni ekɛfi emli daa.
Hã enɛ afee nyɔmɔwo ni aaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ahã minaaflɔlɔi kɛ mɛi ni wieɔ mihe efɔŋ lɛ.
Ao mi-Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ ye misane lɛ ohã mi; ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ heremɔ mi.
Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi, ni minii yɛ mɔbɔ; ni mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli.
Milaaje tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔ̃ɔŋ ahwanya mi tamɔ baalabi.
Ŋmãahilɛ sɔŋŋ ehã minakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ, mitã loo, ni mifee kanyakanya.
Mitsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔnɔ mihã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ; ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei.
Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, ye obua mi. Heremɔ miyiwala yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
Hã amɛle akɛ, bo Yehowa, oninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ, akɛ bo ohere miyiwala.
Hã amɛ lɛ, amɛlomɔ mi; shi bo lɛ ojɔɔ mi! Hã mɛi ni heɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi. Shɛjemɔ otsulɔ mii.
Hã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ awula kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ; ni amɛhiɛgble lɛ akpɛtɛ amɛhe tamɔ mama.
Mikɛ minaabu aaada Yehowa shi babaoo, ni majie eyi yɛ mɛi babaoo ateŋ,
ejaakɛ lɛ efãa ohiafo he, ni ehere eyiwala kɛjɛɔ mɛi ni buɔ lɛ gbele fɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
110: Yehowa kɛɛ mi-nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, "Ta mininejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo."
Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ekɛ omaŋtsɛ tsi wulu lɛ ahã o. Eeekɛɛ akɛ, "Ye lumɔ yɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ."
Gbi nɔ ni ooofã ta lɛ, omaŋbii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa. Oblahii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ tamɔ leebi bɔ yɛ ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa ekã kitã, ni etsakeŋ ejwɛŋmɔ, "Boji osɔfo kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa."
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ; eeetswia maŋtsɛmɛi ashi yɛ emlifu gbi lɛ nu.
Eeekojo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛmli aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbohii. Eeeplenee maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Eeenu faa ni yɔɔ gbɛ toi mli nu, no hewɔ lɛ eeeye omanye.
111: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Mada Yehowa shi yɛ mitsui fɛɛ, yɛ jalɔi agwabɔɔ lɛ mli, yɛ asafo lɛ mli.
Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni naa he tsui lɛ kaseɔ.
Enitsumɔ lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ woo kɛ agbojee; ni ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Ehãa akaiɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ. Drolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa.
Ehãa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ yeɔ nii trɔɔ; be fɛɛ be lɛ ekaiɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.
Ehãa emaŋ lɛ leɔ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ; ejaakɛ ekɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ hãa emaŋ lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii.
Eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ, anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyeli ni; ni ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.
Amɛma shi shiŋŋ daa kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ; koni akɛ anɔkwaleyeli kɛ jalɛ atsu he nii.
Ehã akpɔ̃ ewebii lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛkpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, Egbɛi lɛ he tse, ni egbɛi lɛ he yɛ gbeyei.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee. Mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ amɛnaa niiashishinumɔ kpakpa. Eyijiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
112: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, ni eyɔɔ ekitãi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ lɛ.
Eshwiei aaatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔmɛi wuji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; aaajɔɔ jalɔ lɛ ashwiei.
Ninamɔ kɛ shika aaahi ewe lɛ, ni ejalɛ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaaya naanɔ.
Jalɔi lɛ, la tsoɔ yɛ duŋ mli hãa amɛ; drolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ jalɔ ji lɛ.
Mɔ ni mli hi, ni efaa mɔ nɔ, ni ekɛ anɔkwayeli feɔ enii fɛɛ lɛ, aaahi ahã lɛ.
Jalɔ lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko tsakeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko; aaakai lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Esheee sane fɔŋ ko he adafitswaa gbeyei, ehemɔkɛyeli mli wa, ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa nɔ.
Etsui efãaa, ni esheŋ gbeyei kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anaagbee.
Edɛŋ kpɔɔ pam hãa ohiafoi, ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; aaahã ena hewalɛ, ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam.
Mɛi fɔ̃ɔji naa enɛ, ni amɛmli woɔ la, amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi, ni amɛlaajeɔ; mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ataomɔnii fɛɛ feɔ yaka.
113: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Ao nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea, nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yɛ!
Ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, kɛjɛ benɛ mli aahuu kɛyaashi naanɔ!
Esa akɛ ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi kɛjɛ hulu shiteehe aahuu kɛyaashi eshinyɔɔhe!
Yehowa kwɔ gojoo kɛteke majimaji fɛɛ, ni enumnyam lɛ teke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi.
Namɔ tamɔ Yehowa wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi,
ni emaa ehiɛ shi, ni ekwɛɔ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ?
Eteɔ ohiafo shi kɛjɛɔ mlu mli, ni ewoɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ nɔ kɛjɛɔ tumu nɔ,
koni ehã ekɛ abladei ni ji emaŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ atra shi.
Ehãa yoo kene tsɔ̃ɔ shĩanyɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ biianyɛ ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
114: Be ni Israelbii lɛ je Egipt ni Yakob shwiei lɛ je maŋ ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ lɛŋ lɛ,
Yuda tsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni Israel tsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.
Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ na, ni ejo foi; Yordan hu kpa hoo.
Gɔji lɛ tumɔ tamɔ ojwɛnii, ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu tumɔ tamɔ gwaŋtɛŋbii.
Ao Ŋshɔ, te aye tɛŋŋ, ni ojoɔ foi nɛɛ? Bo Yordan hu, ni okpa hoo nɛɛ?
Ao nyɛ gɔji, mɛni eba ni nyɛtumɔɔ tamɔ ojwɛnii nɛɛ?
Bo shikpɔŋ, ohe akpokpo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ,
mɔ ni hãa tɛsaa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo, ni ehãa tswrɛbo tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi lɛ!
115: Jeee wɔ, Yehowa, jeee wɔ, shi ogbɛi lɛ moŋ aŋɔ anumnyam ahã, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ!
Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbɛ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?"
Wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ eyɔɔ; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.
Amɛmãgãi lɛ, jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni; gbɔmɔ adesa ninenaa nitsumɔ ni.
Amɛyɛ naabu, shi amɛwieee; amɛyɛ hiŋmɛi, shi amɛnaaa nii.
Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii; amɛyɛ gugɔ, shi amɛfuuu nii.
Amɛyɛ niji, shi amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ mli; amɛyɛ naji hu, shi amɛnyiɛɛɛ; ni amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ tete.
Mɛi ni fee amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ lɛ hu tamɔ amɛ.
Ao Israelbii, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔ̃a Yehowa nɔ! Lɛji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.
Ao Aaronwe, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ! Lɛji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ. Lɛji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.
Yehowa ekai wɔ, ni eeejɔɔ wɔ; eeejɔɔ Israel we lɛ; eeejɔɔ Aaron we lɛ.
Eeejɔɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ.
Yehowa aaahã nyɛshwere babaoo, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii fɛɛ.
Yehowa, ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ nyɛ.
Ŋwɛi lɛ, Yehowa ŋwɛi ni; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ, eŋɔ ehã gbɔmɛi abii.
Jeee gbohii jieɔ Yehowa yi, ni jeee mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiajeŋ lɛ;
shi wɔ, hiɛkãalɔi lɛ moŋ wɔɔjie Yehowa yi, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli, aahuu kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ, Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
116: Miisumɔ Yehowa, ejaakɛ ebo migbee kɛ mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi.
Akɛni egboo etoi shi ehã mi hewɔ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ mablɔ matsɛ.
Gbele tsɔnei lɛ bɔle mi kɛkpe, gbohiiaje gbeyei lɛ mɔ mi; mina nɔ̃, ni miwere ho mihe.
Kɛkɛ ni mibo mitsɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Ao Yehowa, miikpa o fai, heremɔ miyiwala!"
Drolɔ kɛ jalɔ ji Yehowa; wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ni.
Yehowa baa humii ayi; be ni aba mi shi lɛ ehere miyiwala.
Ao, misusuma, kuu osɛɛ ni oyajɔɔ ohe, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee bo ejurɔ pii.
Ejaakɛ ojie mi yɛ gbele dɛŋ, ofo mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu sɛɛ, ni ohãaa mashane ni magbee shi.
Yehowa hiŋmɛi aaakã mihe yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mihiɛ mihemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, be ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ahao mi naakpa" lɛ.
Mikɛ tsuifãa kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaaŋɔ he afɔ enɔ."
Mɛni maŋɔto Yehowa najiaŋ, yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni efee mi lɛ hewɔ?
Mawo yiwalaheremɔ kpulu lɛ nɔ, ni matsɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ.
Maye mishiwooi lɛ anɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbele jra wa yɛ ehiɛ.
Ao Yehowa, otsulɔ ji mi; otsulɔ kɛ oweyoo bi ji mi. Okplɔ migboklɛi lɛ.
Mashã shidaa afɔle mahã o, ni maja Yehowa.
Maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ mahã Yehowa yɛ emaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ,
yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ yɛ bo omli. Ao Yerusalem! Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
117: Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛ maji anɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛkafoa lɛ!
Ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ kple ni tsakeee lɛ fa yɛ wɔnɔ; ni Yehowa anɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
118: Ao, nyɛdaaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.
Hã Isrealbii akɛɛ akɛ, "Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa."
Hã Aaronwe lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, "Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa."
Hã mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, "Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa."
Mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ miblɔ mitsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa here mi nɔ, ni ehã miye mihe.
Akɛni Yehowa yɛ misɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, misheee gbeyei! Mɛni gbɔmɔ aaanyɛ mi afee?
Yehowa damɔ mimasɛi akɛ mibualɔ; ni mana mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ anaagbee.
Ehi akɛ abaa Yehowa abo, fe nɔ ni akɛ hiɛ aaafɔ̃ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ.
Ehi akɛ abaa Yehowa abo, fe nɔ ni akɛ hiɛ aaafɔ̃ abladei anɔ.
Majimaji bɔle mihe kɛkpe kpula; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, miflɔ amɛmli mishwie.
Amɛbɔle mi, hɛ̃ɛ, amɛbɔle mi kɛkpe kpula; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, miflɔ amɛmli mishwie.
Amɛbɔle mi tamɔ wobii; amɛtso grigri tamɔ ŋmei la; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, miflɔ amɛmli mishwie.
Atsi mi waa, ni kulɛ miyagbee shi; shi Yehowa ye ebua mi.
Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala; Yehowa etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
Nyɛboa toi, kunimyeli nyamɔ lalai miigbɛɛ yɛ jalɔi abuui amli.
Yehowa hewalɛ kple lɛ ni fee enɛ! Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ehã wɔye kunim. Ehewalɛ kple lɛ ehã wɔye ta mli kunim.
Migboŋ, shi moŋ miyi aaana wala, ni majaje Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.

Ao Yehowa, omɔbɔnalɛ fa babaoo, ojalɛ saneyeli naa lɛ, hã miyi ana wala.
Mɛi ni wala mi yi kɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi fa naakpa; kɛ̃lɛ mishiko omlai lɛ.
Mikwɛɔ mɛi ni bɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ni amɛnii feɔ mi taŋ; ejaakɛ amɛyeee okitãi lɛ anɔ.
Kwɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ omlai lɛ! Hã miyi ana wala, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
Owiemɔ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni; ni ojalɛ kojomɔi lɛ fɛɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Lumɛi flɔɔ minaa yakatswaa kɛ yiwalɛ shi mijɛɔ mitsui mli mibuɔ owiemɔi lɛ.
Minaa owiemɔi lɛ he mishɛɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni eto he miishɛɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni eto jwetri wulu ahuu.
Minyɛɔ, ni mihiɔ apasa; shi misumɔɔ omla lɛ.
Mijieɔ oyi shii kpawo daa gbi, yɛ ojalɛ mlai lɛ ahewɔ.
Mɛi ni sumɔɔ omla lɛ, amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ babaoo naakpa ni nɔ ko nɔ bɛ ni woɔ amɛnajiaŋ.
Ao Yehowa, mihiɛ kã oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ; ni miyeɔ okitãi lɛ anɔ.
Misusuma yeɔ omlai lɛ anɔ; miisumɔ mlai lɛ naakpa.
Miyeɔ omlai kɛ okpɔi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛi jwere nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifeɔ nɔ.
Ao Yehowa, bo miblɔmɔ toi; hã mi niiashishinumɔ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
Hã mifaikpamɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ; heremɔ mi yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.
Minaabu aaafɔse oyijiemɔ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.
Mililɛi aaala omla lɛ he lala, ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ fɛɛ ja.
Feemɔ kralo ni oye obua mi, ejaakɛ miŋɔ omlai lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, miishwe odɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ; ni omla lɛ ji nɔ ni shɛjeɔ mimii.
Hã miyi ana wala bɔ ni afee ni majie oyi; ni ohã omlai lɛ aye abua mi.
Midu gbɛ tamɔ too ni elaaje; blɛ baatao mi, otsulɔ, ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ mihiɛ kpako nɔ.
120: Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, koni ebo mi toi.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, "Ao Yehowa, heremɔ miyiwala kɛje amalelɔi kɛ shishiulɔi adɛŋ.
Bo shishiulɔ, mɛni Yehowa baahã bo, ni mɛni hu ebaafee efata he ehã bo?
Etamɔ tabilɔ gãimlibii ni naa ba kɛ ŋai la ni tsoɔ!
Kpoo hã mi akɛ mibato gbɔ yɛ Mesek, ni mibahi Kedar buui lɛ amasɛi.
Mibahi mɛi ni miihi toiŋjɔlɛ ateŋ be babaoo tsɔ̃.
Mi lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ gbɔmɔ ji mi; shi kɛji miwie pɛ, amɛ lɛ, amɛto ta amɛwo mi.
121: Miiwo mihiɛ nɔ makwɛ gɔ̃ji lɛ; nɛɛgbɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ aaajɛ aba?
Miyelikɛbuamɔ jɛɔ Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ!
Ehaŋ oshane; mɔ ni buɔ buɔ ohe lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i.
Naa, mɔ ni buɔ Isreal he lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i, ni esaa ewɔŋ gbi ko gbi ko.
Yehowa ji ohebulɔ! Yehowa ji ohɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ.
Shwane lɛ hulu eshaŋ bo, ni nyɔɔŋ hu nyɔŋtsere efeŋ bo nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Yehowa aaabu ohe kɛje efɔŋ fɛɛ mli. Eeebu owala he shweshweeshwe.
Yehowa aaabu okpojee kɛ omlibaa he, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ.
122: Mimii shɛɔ mihe kɛji akɛɛ mi akɛ, "Ba ni wɔtee Yehowa we lɛ."
Ao Yerusalem, wɔnaji mamɔ ogboi lɛ mli.
Yerusalem, bo maŋ ni atswa ama shi kɛtsra nɔ kɛkpe maŋ ni ama lɛ kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
Jɛi akutsei ni ji Yehowa akutsei lɛ yaa, taakɛ bɔ ni awo amɛ mla lɛ, koni amɛyada Yehowa shi.
Jɛi akɛ kojomɔ sɛ̃ii emamɔ, David we lɛ kojomɔ sɛ̃ii lɛ.
Nyɛbaa hejɔlɛ nyɛhãa Yerusalem. "Mɛi ni sumɔɔ o lɛ ashwere."
Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi ogbogboi lɛ amli, ni shweshweeshwefeemɔ ahi omɔji lɛ amli.
Minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ minanemɛi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, makɛɛ bo Yerusalem akɛ, "Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi omli."
Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ hewɔ lɛ, matao bo ekpakpa.
123: Ao, bo miwoɔ mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛɔ, bo mɔ ni ota maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
Naa, bɔ ni tsuji kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ amɛnuŋtsɔ nɔ, ni weyoo hu kɛ ehe fɔ̃ɔ ewula nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkwɛɔ Yehowa, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena wɔ mɔbɔ.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ! Ao Yehowa, naa wɔ mɔbɔ! Ejaakɛ agbe wɔhe guɔ babaoo kɛteke nɔ.
Wɔhe fɛo ni mɛi ni he ejɔ amɛ lɛ yeɔ, kɛ wɔhe guɔ ni hewolɔi lɛ gbeɔ lɛ miisu wɔtsui fe nine.
124: Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ, hã Israel akɛɛ akɛ,
"Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ kulɛ be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi te shi wo wɔ,
ni amɛmli wo la wo wɔ lɛ, amɛaamimii wɔ hiɛkãalɔi;
kulɛ nu afua lɛ su wɔyi, ni fai lɛ ha wɔnɔ;
Kulɛ fai ni fee hamahama lɛ su wɔyi."
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ ekɛ wɔ hãaa ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ amɛnyanyɔji anaa loo.
Wɔwala eje amɛdɛŋ tamɔ looflɔ jeɔ looflɔdulɔi atsɔne mli. Tsɔne kpãa lɛ etse ni wɔje mli.
Wɔyelikɛbuamɔ yɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.
125: Mɛi ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, amɛtamɔ Zion Gɔŋ ni hosooo, shi moŋ ema shi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni gɔ̃ji ebɔle Yerusalem kɛkpe kpula lɛ, nakai Yehowa hu ebule emɛi lɛ ahe kɛkpe, kɛjɛ benɛ mli kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, eyeŋ jalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ, koni jalɔi lɛ akafee efɔŋ.
Ao Yehowa, feemɔ mɛi ni hi kɛ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuii amli lɛ ejurɔ.
Shi mɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛyaa amɛgbɛi gbohii anɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaaloo amɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nifɔjianii lɛ kɛaatee. Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!
126: Be ni Yehowa kpla wɔ, Zion nomii lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem ekoŋŋ lɛ, efee wɔ tamɔ nɔ ni lamɔ wɔlaa.
No mli lɛ wɔdaaŋ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛŋmɔlɔ, ni wɔbɔ oshe hu kɛ nyamɔ lala. Kɛkɛ lɛ, akɛɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli akɛ, "Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã amɛ."
Lɛɛlɛŋ, Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã wɔ, ni wɔmii eshɛ wɔhe nɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kpalemɔ wɔblema nibii ni ŋmɛɛ wɔ lɛ kɛba, tamɔ nunɛmɔ hãa faa ni tamɔ nunɛmɔ hãa faa ni emli egbi yiɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ.
Hã mɛi ni duɔ nii kɛ amɛhiɛ yaafonu lɛ, akpa kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Mɛi ni kɛ hiɛ yaafonu hiɛɔ dumɔ wui kɛyaa dumɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ ŋmãa yiteremɔi aaaba shĩa kɛ nyamɔ.
127: Kɛjeee Yehowa ni mãa tsu lɛ, no lɛ yakatswaa mɛi ni mãa lɛ gboɔ he dɛŋme lɛ! Kɛjeee Yehowa ni buɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ, no lɛ yakatswaa bulɔ lɛ shiɔ he kpe lɛ.
Yakatswaa nyɛteɔ shi maŋkɛ̃ mra, ni nyɛgboɔ deŋme aahuu dani nyɛyawɔɔ. Nyɛgboɔ deŋme kɛtaoɔ nyɛdaaŋ ŋmaa; shi mɛi ni Yehowa sumɔɔ amɛ lɛ, ehãa amɛ amɛhiamɔ nibii kɛji amɛwɔ po tete.
Naa, Yehowa gboshinii ni ehãa ji bii; nikeenii kple ji musuŋbii.
Bɔ ni gãimlibii yɔɔ yɛ tabilɔ dɛŋ lɛ, nakai oblahiiaŋ bihii ji.
Ajɔɔ nuu ni nɛkɛ gãimlibii eyi ekotoku mli tɔ lɛ. Kɛji ekɛ ehenyɛlɔi kpe yɛ koishi lɛ, ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi.
128: Ajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa, ni eyeɔ emlai lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Oooye oninenaa nitsumɔ mli nii, omii aaashɛ, ni aaahi ahã o!
Oŋa aaatamɔ waintso ni woɔ yibii yɛ owe lɛ. Obii aaatamɔ mutsei bibii kɛaabɔle okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
Naa, nuu ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, bɔ ni abaajɔɔ lɛ nɛ.
Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ajɔɔ o! Ooona Yerusalem shweremɔ lɛ owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ooohi shi, ni ooona obii abii. Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!
129: "Amɛwa mi yi aahuu kɛjɛ miblahiiaŋ!" Israel akɛɛɛ akɛ,
"Amɛwa mi yi aahuu kɛjɛ miblahiiaŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ mi.
Amɛkplebii fãmɔ mikotosɛɛ, ni faji lɛ tamɔ ŋmɔ mli akofii kakadãji."
Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ji lɛ; eflɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ataŋkpei lɛ amli.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ Zion lɛ ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.
Hã amɛfee tamɔ tsu yiteŋ jwɛi ni ŋlaa dani edaa lɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃ jwɛi ni yii jwɛiflɔlɔ kɔkɔŋ, ni mɔ ni fimɔɔ lɛ hu kɛshakãaa etsitsiŋ.
Mɛi ni hoɔ tete ekɛɛɛ akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ! Wɔmiijɔɔ nyɛ yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli!"
130: Ao Yehowa, bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ miblɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo kɛjɛɔ nɛɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, bo migbee toi; ka otoi ohã migbee ni mikɛkpaa o fai lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kɛji okɛɛ ooodi wɔnishaianii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ po aaaŋɔ ehe eye?
Shi bo odɛŋ eshaifaa yɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ashe o gbeyei.
Miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ! Misusuma miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ! Ni ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.
Misusuma miiwɛ Yehowa fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ. Eemɛ fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ.
Ao Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa dɛŋ suɔmɔ ni tsakee yɔɔ, ni edɛŋ kpɔmɔ ni fa yɔɔ.
Lɛ eeekpɔ̃ Israel kɛaajɛ enishaianii lɛ fɛɛ mli.
131: Ao Yehowa, mitsui wooo ehe nɔ, ni mitsɛɛɛ mihe hu. Ni misaa minyiɛɛɛ nibii wuji loo nibii ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃ hã mi lɛ asɛɛ.
Shi moŋ, migbe mitsui, ni misusuma efee kpoo tamɔ abifao feɔ yɛ enyɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ. Misusuma efee kpoo yɛ mimli tamɔ abifao ni atse lɛ fufɔ.
Ao Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyashi naanɔ.
132: Ao Yehowa, kaimɔ David kɛ amanehului fɛɛ ni ena lɛ:
bɔ ni ekã bo Yehowa kitã, ni ewo bo, Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ Koome lɛ shi akɛ,
"Miboteŋ miwe lɛ mli, ni mikwɔŋ misaatso lɛ hu;
mibɛŋ mihiŋmɛi, ni mijieŋ mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ
kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mana he ko mahã Yehowa. Hɛ̃ɛ, kɛyaashi mana shihilɛhe mahã Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ Koome lɛ."
Naa, wɔnu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he yɛ Betlehem, ni wɔyana yɛ Yearim ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Wɔkɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔbotea Yehowa we lɛŋ; nyɛhãa wɔjaa yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ!"
Ao Yehowa, wo ohe nɔ ni oya ohejɔɔmɔhe lɛ, bo kɛ ohewalɛ Adeka lɛ.
Hã osɔfoi lɛ awula kɛ jalɛ tamɔ atade, ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ abɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.
Otsulɔ David hewɔ lɛ, kaakwa maŋtsɛ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
Yehowa kã David kitã yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni ekuŋ mli. Ekɛɛ akɛ, "Maŋɔ omusuŋbii lɛ eko mata omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji obii lɛ ye mikpãŋmɔi lɛ kɛ mimlai ni matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ kɛ mimlai ni matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ amɛ hu amɛbii aaata omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ daa."
Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Zion, ni eesumɔ akɛ ekɛfee eshihilɛhe.
"Mihejɔɔmɔhe nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ; biɛ mahi, ejaakɛ biɛ misumɔɔ.
Majɔɔ niyenii babaoo nɔ mahã Zion, ni ohiafoi lɛ hu, mahã amɛtrɔ kɛ ŋmaa.
Esɔfoi lɛ, mikɛ miyiwalaheremɔ aaawo amɛ tamɔ atade; ni emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aaabɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.
Mahã Maŋtsɛ wulu ko ajɛ David shwiei lɛ amli, ni mahã mɔ ni mifɔ lɛ mu lɛ lumɔyeli lɛ ama shi.
Ehenyɛlɔi lɛ, mawo amɛ hiɛgble, shi lɛ lɛ, ekekre lɛ aaakplɛ."
133: Kwɛ bɔ ni ehi, bɔ ni eyɔɔ fɛo, kɛji nyɛmimɛi fee ekome kɛhi shi lɛ!
Etamɔ mu kpakpa ni jra wa ni yɔɔ yiteŋ ni tsereɔ eshwieɔ tsɛŋ mli, ni ji Aaron tsɛŋ lɛ. Etsereɔ kɛbashwieɔ etade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ nɔ.
Etamɔ Hermon bɔ ni yɔɔ Zion gɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo Zion jɔɔmɔ kɛ wala he shi kɛyaashi naanɔ.
134: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ ni sɔmɔɔ nyɔɔŋ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ!
Nyɛholea nyɛniji anɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ mli yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
Yehowa ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ajɛ Zion ajɔɔ bo!
135: Nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi! Nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea eyi,
nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdamɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, ejaakɛ Yehowa hi! Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ emli hi!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Yakob ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, eŋɔ Israel efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, efe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋshɔ kɛ bui voovoi lɛ amli lɛ, no efeɔ.
Lɛji mɔ ni hãa atatui woɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ. Lɛ ehãa srawa gblaa kɛfataa nunɛmɔ he ni ehãa kɔɔyɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ enitoohe lɛ.
Etswia Egipt kromɔbii lɛ nii kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloo nɔ.
Egipt lɛ efee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii yɛ mli ekɛgbla Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ toi;
ni etswia majimaji pii anii; ni egbegbee majiatsɛmɛi hewalɔi.
Egbe Sihon, Amorbii lɛ amaŋtsɛ, kɛ Og, Bashan maŋtsɛ lɛ hu, kɛ Kanaan maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã akɛ gboshinii, akɛ gboshinii ehã emaŋ Israelbii lɛ.
Ao, Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ! Ao Yehowa, ohiɛ nyam lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaabu emaŋbii lɛ bem, ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ etsuji lɛ ahe.
Jeŋmaji lɛ amãgãi lɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni, gbɔmɛi aninenaa nitsumɔi ni.
Amɛyɛ naabu, shi amɛwieee; amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii.
Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii, asaŋ wala bɛ amɛmli.
Mɛi ni fɛɛ amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ ji mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ lɛ.
Ao Israel we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Ao Aaron we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Ao Levi we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Ajɛ Zion ajie Yehowa yi, lɛ mɔ ni eyɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ! Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
136: Ao, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ao, nyɛdaa nyɔŋmɔi a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ao, nyɛdaa nuŋtsɔmɛi a-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Mɔ koome ni efeɔ naakpɛɛnii wuji lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni ekɛ nilee bɔ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni elɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli eha nui lɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ebɔ hulu koni eye shwane nɔ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ebɔ nyɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii koni amɛye nyɔɔŋ nɔ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni etswia Egipt kromɔbii lɛ nii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ ejie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Egipt lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ekɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ kpɔiaŋwalɛ tsu enɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni egba Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa;
ni ekpla Israelbii kɛtsɔ̃ teŋ kɛho lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Shi eplenee Farao kɛ eta lɛ yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛŋ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni ekpla emaŋ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni etswia maŋtsɛmɛi wuji nii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ni egbegbee maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Sihon, Amorbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Kɛ Og, Bashan maŋtsɛ lɛ, hu; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ni eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã ewebii akɛ gboshinii lɛ ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Eŋɔ ehã etsulɔ Israel akɛ gboshinii; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛji mɔ ni ekai wɔ be ni wɔfee butuu lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ ejie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ elɛɔ heloo fɛɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ao, nyɛdaa Ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
137: Babilon fai lɛ anaa wɔ ho wɔtra shi yɛ ni wɔfofoo, be ni wɔkai Zion lɛ.
Jɛi faa naa gãlã lɛ anɔ wɔŋɔ wɔsaŋkui lɛ wɔtsotsro.
Ejaakɛ jɛi mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ bi wɔ koni wɔla lalai yɛ. Wɔhaolɔi lɛ tao akɛ wɔjie amɛhiɛtserɛ: Amɛkɛɛ, "Nyɛlaa Zion lalai lɛ eko nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ!"
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔla Yehowa lala yɛ mɛikpɔ̃ji aje hu?
Ao Yerusalem, kɛji mihiɛ kpa onɔ lɛ, no lɛ, hã mininejurɔ agbo yɛ mihe.
Yerusalem, kɛji mikaii bo, ni mibuuu bo fe mimiishɛɛ nɔ titri ko lɛ, hã mililɛi akpɛtɛ midaaŋ.
Ao Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni Edombii lɛ fee lɛ, gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ Yerusalem lɛ, bɔ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkumɔa, nyɛkumɔa kɛyamɔa eshishitoo lɛ tɔ̃ɔ!" lɛ!
Ao, Babilon, abaakpãtã ohiɛ; Aaajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatɔ nɔ ni ofee wɔ lɛ he owele.
Aaajɔɔ mɔ ni aaaŋɔ obii bibii lɛ atswia tɛsaa lɛ!
138: Ao Yehowa, mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ miida o shi, mala majie oyi yɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ahiɛ!
Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mahã o-Sɔlemɔwe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni makula shi, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ohã ogbɛi lɛ kɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehehe fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
Gbi nɔ ni mitsɛ o lɛ, ohere mi nɔ; owo mi ekãa, ni misusuma na hewalɛ.
Ao Yehowa, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaajie oyi; ejaakɛ amɛnu onaa wiemɔi lɛ.
Amɛaala Yehowa nifeemɔi lɛ ahe lala, ejaakɛ Yehowa anumnyam lɛ da!
Yehowa yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ehiɛ kã humi he; shi hewolɔ nyɛɛɛ ehe etee yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛji minyiɛ haomɔ mli lɛ, ohãa miyi naa wala. Kɛji mihenyɛlɔi amli fu mi lɛ, owoɔ onine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ hereɔ miyiwala.
Yehowa aaahã eyiŋtoo lɛ aba mli ahã mi. Ao Yehowa, naanɔ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa; gbee bo diɛŋtsɛ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
139: Ao Yehowa, taomɔ mimli koni ole mi.
Ole mishitamɔ kɛ mishitee mli fɛɛ; oyoɔ miyiŋtoo yɛ shɔŋŋ beebe.
Ole minyiɛmɔ kɛ mishikãmɔ fɛɛ mli, ni ole minifeemɔi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ wiemɔ ko wiemɔ ko bɛ mililɛi nɔ ni bo Yehowa oleee oto.
Ofo afabaŋ owo mihe kɛkpe, ni okɛ onine eŋmɛ minɔ.
Onilee nɛɛ miifee mi naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃; emli kwɔ, ni mijwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he.
Nɛɛgbɛ maje omumɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛaatee; ni nɛɛgbɛ majo foi kɛaajɛ ohiɛ kɛaatee?
Kɛji mikwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, oyɛ jɛi; ni kɛji miyaŋmɛ misaa yɛ gbohiiaje tete, oyɛ jɛi.
Kɛji miŋɔ leebi fiji ni miyahi ŋshɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ,
jɛi tete lɛ, onine aaakpla mi, ni oninejurɔ aaamɔ mimli tswɛ.
Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, "Duŋ kabiti abaha minɔ, ni la ni bɔle mihe lɛ atsɔ̃ duŋ" lɛ,
no tete po lɛ, duŋ wooo duŋ yɛ ohiɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ tseɔ heŋŋ tamɔ shwane nɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛ; ejaakɛ duŋ jio, la jio fɛɛ lɛ ekome ni yɛ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ bo obɔ mimli nibii fɛɛ; bo oshɔ̃ mi yɛ minyɛ musuŋ.
Miijie oyi, ejaakɛ bɔ ni obɔ mi lɛ, eyɛ naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ. Onitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ; mile enɛ krɛdɛɛ.
Aŋɔɔɔ mi ateee bo, be ni abɔɔ migbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ teemɔ mli, ni ashɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Be ni miji lá kukuli tete po lɛ, ohiŋmɛi ena mi momo. Wala gbii ni ato ahã mi lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ owolo lɛ mli dani mije wala shishi tete.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, oyiŋtoi lɛ ajra wa yɛ mihiɛ akɛ nɔ ko; efa babaoo naakpa.
Kɛji mika akɛ makane lɛ, amɛyi fa fe ŋshɔnaa shia. Be ni mihiɛ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ omasɛi nɔŋŋ miyɔɔ.
Ao Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mina ni ogbe mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ, gbɔmɛi lashishwielɔi akabɛŋkɛ mi fɔ̃ɔfɔ̃.
Amɛwieɔ ohe kɛ yiŋsha, ni amɛteɔ shi amɛwoɔ bo.
Ao Yehowa, aso mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ mikanyɛ amɛ? Ni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ bo lɛ, mikate shi miwo amɛ?
Minyɛɔ amɛ naakpa, miŋɔɔ amɛ mihenyɛlɔi.
Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, taomɔ mimli koni ole mitsuiŋ. Kaa mi okwɛ, koni ole mijwɛŋmɔi.
Kwɛmɔ akɛ minyiɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ lo, koni okpla mi kɛya naanɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
140: Ao Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji adɛŋ; baamɔ miyi yɛ yiwalɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛkpãŋɔ nifɔɔjianii yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛhãa ta teɔ shi daa.
Amɛjɔ amɛlilɛii anaa tamɔ onufu, ni shikpãi anaa ebɔɔ yɛ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi.
Ao Yehowa, buu mihe kɛje mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ, ni obaa miyi kɛje gbɔmɛi yiwalɔi adɛŋ, mɛi ni ekpãŋ koni amɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ minane lɛ.
Hewolɔi etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne; ni amɛŋmɛ mi yaa, ni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mi akpa yɛ gbɛ toi.
Mikɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, "Boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ." Ao Yehowa, bo mifaikpamɔ gbee lɛ toi!
Ao Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, miyiwalaherelɔ ni he wa, bo obaa miyi yɛ ta gbi nɔ.
Ao Yehowa, kaahã mɔ fɔŋ nine shɛ nɔ ni eshweɔ lɛ nɔ; ni kaahã eyiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ miiba mli miihã lɛ.
Mɛi ni efo sa ewo mihe lɛ, hã efɔŋ ni jɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnaa lɛ abua amɛyiteŋ.
Hã ŋãi la atso yɛ amɛyiteŋ, hã ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie bui kwɔŋkwɔŋi amli, ni amɛkate shi dɔŋŋ.
Kaahã oshekuyelɔ ko he shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; hã efɔŋ akpãtã yiwalɔ lɛ hiɛ mra.
Mile akɛ Yehowa yeɔ nɔnalɔ sane ehãa lɛ; ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ehãa mɔ ni efi lɛ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, jalɔi aaajie oyi, ni mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii aaahi shi yɛ ohiɛ.
141: Ao Yehowa, bo miblɔɔ miitsɛɔ nɛɛ; ba miŋɔɔ mra! Ba otoi shi ohã mi kɛji mitsɛ o lɛ.
Hã mifaikpamɔ afee tamɔ tsofakɛŋma yɛ ohiɛ; ni miniji anɔholemɔ afee tamɔ gbɛkɛ afɔle!
Ao Yehowa, wo mililɛi manyoflɛ; ni ahã mamɔ minaabu mli.
Kaadɔ mitsui kɛmiiya nɔ fɔŋ ko he, ni mikafata mɛi fɔ̃ji ahe kɛtsu yiwalɛnii; ni kaahã miye amɛdɔkɔdɔkɔ nii lɛ eko.
Hã jalɔ agbla mitoi kɛ mlihilɛ; hã anɔkwafoi akã mi; shi kɛji mɔ fɔŋ miiwo mihiɛ nyam lɛ, hã makwa; ejaakɛ misɔleɔ daa mishiɔ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ.
Kɛji aŋɔ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji ahã kojolɔi, ni amɛbu amɛ fɔ lɛ, no dani amɛaale akɛ miwiemɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni.
Bɔ ni kɛ mɔ ko miihu ni egbɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai agbɛ wɔwui ashwã gbonyobu toi.
Shi bo Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, bo onɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ. Bo nɔŋŋ abo mibaa! Kaashi mi tamɔ mɔ ni bɛ hefãlɔ.
Buu mihe yɛ tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ he buu mihe kɛjɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii akpai lɛ ahe.
Hã mɛi fɔ̃ji adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne lɛ, ni mi lɛ, hã maje mli sɔkee.
142: Miiwo migbee nɔ miiblɔ miitsɛ Yehowa, mikɛ migbee miikpa Yehowa fai.
Miifɔse mikɔmɔi lɛ miishwie ehiɛ, miijaje mihaomɔi lɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
Be ni mimumɔ tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ, bo ole migbɛ lɛ. Mihenyɛlɔi etsɔ̃ tsɔne kɛtee mi yɛ gbɛ ni minyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kwɛ mininejurɔgbɛ, ni ooona akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nile mi. Abobaahe ebɔ mi; Mɔ ko mɔ ko jwɛŋŋ mihe.
Ao Yehowa, miiblɔ miitsɛ bo! Mikɛɛ akɛ boji mibobaahe, boji migbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Feemɔ toi ohã miblɔmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ aba mi shi fe nine. Jiemɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe mi.
Jiemɔ mi kɛje gboklɛfoi atsuŋ, koni mada bo shi. Jalɔi aaabɔle mi kɛkpe, ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.
143: Ao Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã mifaikpamɔ lɛ; heremɔ mi nɔ yɛ onɔkwayeli kɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa.
Okɛ otsulɔ akakojo, ejaakɛ hiɛkãalɔ ko hiɛkãalɔ ko yeŋ bem yɛ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ etiu mi, ekpãtã miwala hiɛ kɛmɔ shi; ehã mita duŋ mli tamɔ mɛi ni egboi jeeŋmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mimumɔ etɔ biti yɛ mimli; mitsui efee shikplikpii yɛ mimli.
Mikaiɔ blema gbii lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ nii ni ofee lɛ fiaa he; misusuɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
Miholeɔ miniji anɔ mihãa bo yɛ sɔlemɔ mli; ohe kumai yeɔ misusuma tamɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.
Ao Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ oya; mimumɔ miitɔ biti; kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi, kɛjee nakai lɛ, matamɔ mɛi ni kplekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiajeŋ lɛ.
Leebi lɛ hã manu osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he, ejaakɛ bo onɔ mihiɛ kã. Hã male gbɛ ni sa akɛ manyiɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ bo miŋɔɔ misusuma mihãa.
Ao Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ! Bo oŋɔɔ mijoɔ foi kɛbaa mibatee yɛ!
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi koni mafee osuɔmɔnaanii, ejaakɛ boji mi-Nyɔŋmɔ. Hã omumɔ kpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ kɛnyiɛ gbɛ tɛ̃ɛ nɔ.
Ao Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, hã miyi ana mala! Ojalɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, jiemɔ mi kɛje haomɔ mli.
Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee hã mi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, flɔmɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwie; ni okpãtã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ; ejaakɛ otsulɔ ji mi.
144: Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, mitɛsaa lɛ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ miniji tawuu kɛ miwaabii nɔmɔ lɛ.
Lɛji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ, mibobaa mɔɔ ni wa, kɛ mijielɔ, mitsɛŋ kɛ mɔ abo ni mibaa lɛ. Lɛ ebaa mimaŋbii shi ewoɔ mishishi.
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛ ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni obuɔ ehe akɔŋtaa, loo gbɔmɔ bi ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe?
Gbɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, egbii lɛ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ ni hoɔ.
Ao Yehowa, kpoo oŋwɛi lɛ naa shi koni oyi shi! Tramɔ gɔ̃ji lɛ ahe koni amɛje lasu!
Hã srawai agbla, koni ogbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã. Tsɛ̃rɛ̃mɔ ogãimlibii lɛ koni owo amɛ foi.
Kpã onine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi; shɔ̃ mi koni ojie mi kɛjɛ nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, kɛjɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ,
mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.
Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ, mala lala hee mahã o! Kpãi nyɔŋmɔ saŋku matswa kɛjie oyi.
Bo ohãa maŋtsɛmɛi yeɔ kunim, ni ohereɔ otsulɔ David yiwala.
Shɔ̃ mi kɛje mɛi klaŋte naa; kpɔ̃ mi kɛje mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ, mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.
Wɔbihii adra yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ, tamɔ tsei ni atɛo ni amɛdra; ni wɔbiyei lɛ hu atãmɔ koŋtɛ ni ako ni akɛmaa maŋtsɛ we.
Wɔboŋoi lɛ ayimɔ obɔbɔ̃, kɛ niyenii srɔtoi fɛɛ; wɔtoi hu afɔfɔɔ akpekpei, kɛ akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai yɛ ŋa nɔ.
Wɔtsinai hu afɔ babaoo; amɛkashrake, ni amɛkalaaje; akanu haomɔ blɔmɔ ko yɛ wɔblohuiaŋ.
Ajɔɔ maŋ ni naa nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ! Ajɔɔ maŋ ni Yehowa ji e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
145: Makafo o, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi-Maŋtsɛ, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Daa gbi lɛ majie oyi, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Yehowa je agbo; ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo, ni egbojee lɛ anaaa naa.
Yinɔ kome aaakafo onitsumɔi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔ kroko; ni amɛaajaje ohewalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Majwɛŋ onumnyam falɛ kɛ ogbojee kɛ onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
Mɛi aaagba ohewalɛ nitsumɔi ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ni majaje ogbojee lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
Amɛaajaje omlihilɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ; amɛaala ojalɛ lɛ he lala waa.
Drolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa; emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.
Yehowa hi hã mɛi fɛɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ he.
Yehowa, obɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ aaada o shi; ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ aaajie oyi.
Amɛaawie omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ anumnyam lɛ he, ni amɛaagba ohewalɛ lɛ,
koni amɛhã gbɔmɛi adesai abii ale ohewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, kɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nyam kɛ egbojee.
Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni; ni olumɔyeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Yehowa sɔoɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni miigbee shi lɛ, ni eholeɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni edrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ.
Bɔɔnii fɛɛ kwɛɔ bo gbɛ, ni bo ohãa amɛ niyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.
Ogbɛɔ odɛŋ, ni ohãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã tɔɔ kɛ nii ni etaoɔ.
Yehowa ja yɛ egbɛi fiaa mli, ni emli hi yɛ enifeemɔi fiaa mli.
Yehowa bɛŋkɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ; ebɛŋkɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
Mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, efeɔ amɛnitaomɔnii ehãa amɛ; eboɔ amɛblɔmɔ toi ni ehereɔ amɛyiwala.
Yehowa baa mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ ayi; shi yiwalɔi lɛ, eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Minaabu aaajie Yehowa yi ni bɔɔnii fɛɛ aaajie egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
146: Jiemɔ Yehowa yi! Ao misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, majie Yehowa yi! Mala majie mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi miwala be fɛɛ.
Nyɛkaŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa lumɛi loo gbɔmɔ adesa bi ko ni yelikɛbuamɔ bɛ edɛŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji emumɔ je emli lɛ, ekuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa esu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ; nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ eyiŋtoo fɛɛ laajeɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji eyelikɛbualɔ, mɔ ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa, e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ebɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; lɛ lɛ eyeɔ anɔkwa kɛyaa naanɔ.
Mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim lɛ, eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ; mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ, ehãa amɛ niyenii. Yehowa fɛneɔ gboklɛfoi agboklɛi.
Yehowa gbleɔ shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii; Yehowa holeɔ mɛi ni edrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ; Yehowa sumɔɔ jalɔi.
Yehowa baa gbɔi ayi; efĩɔ awusa kɛ okulafo sɛɛ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ, ebutuɔ.
Yehowa baaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ, Zion, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
147: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Ehi akɛ ala ajie wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi; ejaakɛ drolɔ ji lɛ, ni yijiemɔ lala sa lɛ.
Yehowa ji mɔ ni maa Yerusalem maŋ lɛ; ebuaa Israelbii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa.
Lɛ etsaa mɛi ni tsuii ekumɔ lɛ, ni efimɔɔ amɛpilamɔi lɛ anɔ.
Lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii lɛ ayibɔ, ni ewoɔ eko fɛɛ eko gbɛi lɛ.
Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ je agbo; ni ehewalɛ fa naakpa, ni enilee lɛ anaaa naa.
Yehowa woɔ heshibalɔi anɔ, shi yiwalɔi lɛ etsirɛɔ amɛ etswiaa shi.
Nyɛlaa shidaa lala nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛkɛ saŋku alaa kɛjiea wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
Lɛ ekɛ atatui haa ŋwɛi, ni ehãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ehãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ gɔŋkpɔi anɔ.
Lɛ ehãa kooloi niyenii, ni elɛɔ kwãakwãalabitei abii ni blɔɔ lɛ hu.
Emiishɛɛnamɔ bɛ okpɔŋɔ hewalɛ mli, ni ebɛ tabilɔi ahewalɛ he miishɛɛ hu.
Shi moŋ Yehowa naa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe miishɛɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ao Yerusalem, kafomɔ Yehowa! Ao Zion, jiemɔ o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi!
Ejaakɛ lɛ ewajeɔ ogboi lɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ kpɛŋŋ; ejɔɔ obii ni yɔɔ omli lɛ.
Ehãa ohusui anɔ jɔɔ; ehãa otɔɔ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa.
Efãa shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ afeɔ lɛ oya.
Ehãa snoo nyɔɔ futaa tamɔ too he tsɔi yɛŋ; egbɛɔ bɔ́ ni efi eshwãa tamɔ lamlu.
Eshɛrɛɔ enutɛi lɛ eshwieɔ shi tamɔ fɔbitɛi. Namɔ aaanyɛ efɛ̃i lɛ naa edamɔ?
Efãa, ni ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, nutɛi lɛ sereɔ. Ehãa ekɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa, ni nui lɛ hoɔ.
Ejajeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israel, ekɛ ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ hãa Israel.
Efeko nakai nɔ ko ehãko maŋ ko maŋ ko dã; emlai lɛ hu, amɛleee. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
148: Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi! Nyɛjɛa ŋwɛi nyɛjiea Yehowa yi; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!
Nyɛ, ebɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi! Nyɛ, etai lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi!
Hulu kɛ nyɔŋtsere, nyɛjiea eyi! Nyɛŋulamii ni kpɛlɛɔ fiaa, nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi, kɛ nui ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ, nyɛjiea eyi!
Hã amɛjie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ lɛ efã, ni abɔ amɛ.
Eŋɔ amɛ emamɔ shi kɛmiiya naanɔ; ewo amɛ akpɔ, ni amɛnyɛŋ nɔ amɛku.
Nyɛjɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nuŋ loi wuji ni he yɔɔ gbeyei, bui ni mli kwɔlɔ fɛɛ,
la kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ, snoo kɛ afua, ahum ni yeɔ efãmɔ nɔ.
Nyɛjiea eyi nyɛ gɔ̃ji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi fiaa, tsei ni woɔ yibii kɛ tsenedrui fɛɛ!
Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ shīa kooloi fɛɛ, waamɔ nibii kɛ loofɔji.
Shikpɔŋ nɔ majiatsɛmɛi kɛ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ, lumɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kojolɔi fɛɛ,
oblahii kɛ oblayei fɛɛ, onukpai kɛ gbekɛbii bluublu,
hã amɛjie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaake ekoome egbɛi lɛ nɔ awo gojoo fe gbɛii fɛɛ. Lɛ enumnyam lɛ kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi fɛɛ tete.
Ekɛ ehewalɛ kple lɛ ewo emaŋbii anɔ. No hewɔ lɛ, emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ajie eyi, Israelbii, ni ji emaŋ ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
149: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛjiea eyi yɛ anɔkwafoi agwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Hã Israel anya ebɔlɔ lɛ he, ni Zion bihii lɛ amli afli amɛ yɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Hã amɛkɛ joo ajie egbɛi lɛ yi, ni amɛkɛ miji kɛ saŋku ala amɛkɛjie eyi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa naa emaŋbii lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ; ehãa humii yeɔ ta mli kunim.
Hã anɔkwafoi lɛ anya yɛ anumnyam mli; hã amɛla nyamɔ lala yɛ amɛsai anɔ.
Hã Nyɔŋmɔ kafomɔ akã amɛlilɛi nɔ, ni amɛhiɛ klaŋte kɛ enaa nta yɛ amɛdɛ̃,
koni amɛkɛtɔ owele yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, koni amɛkɛgbla maŋbii lɛ atoi,
koni amɛkɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i afimɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛwo amɛbladei lɛ dade gboklɛi,
koni amɛkɛ toigblamɔ ni aŋma ato agbla amɛtoi. Enɛ ji anumnyam hã emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ. Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
150: Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ atatu lɛŋ!
Nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ egbojee kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ!
Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ kpãmɔ; nyɛjiea eyi kɛ obenta kɛ saŋku!
Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ miji kɛ joo, nyɛjiea eyi kɛ kpãa saŋku kɛ bɛji!
Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋo ni naa wa; nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋoi ni jijeɔ!
Nyɛhãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni muɔ ajiea Yehowa yi! Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!

1: Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ ní Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã lɛ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ etsuji nii ní sa akɛ aba mli nɔŋŋ ní ekɛtsu ebɔfo lɛ ni ehã etsulɔ, Yohane le lɛ.
Yohane ye Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo odase lɛ he odase, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ena lɛ he.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni kaneɔ galɛ wiemɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nibii ni aŋma yɛ mli lɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ be ni lɛ eshɛ etã.
Yohane ŋma yahã asafoi kpawo ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ. Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɛ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ dɛŋ; kɛ mumɔi kpawo ni yɔɔ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ;
kɛ Yesu Kristo ni ji odasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ, gbohii ateŋ kromɔbi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔyeli lɛ dɛŋ. Esuɔmɔɔ wɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá etsuu wɔhe kɛjɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ amli,
ni ekɛ wɔ efee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ osɔfoi ehã e-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ aŋɔ anumnyam kɛ hewalɛ ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!
Naa, eeba kɛ atatui lɛ, ni hiŋmɛi fɛɛ hiŋmɛi aaana lɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsurɔ lɛ nii lɛ hu. Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaawo yara yɛ ehewɔ. Aba mli nakãi. Amen!
"Miji Alfa kɛ Omega lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɛ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ," Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ kɛɛ.

Mi Yohane ni ji nyɛnyɛmi kɛ nyɛnaanyo yɛ Yesu Kristo amanehulu lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ ehiɛmiamɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Miyɛ ŋshɔkpɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Patmo lɛ nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo he odaseyeli lɛ hewɔ.
Miyɛ mumɔ mli yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko gbɛɛmɔ yɛ misɛɛ tamɔ tɛtrɛmantrɛ
ni kɛɛ akɛ, "Nɔ ni onaa lɛ; ŋmaa owo wolo mli, ni okɛmaje asafoi kpawo lɛ: Efeso kɛ Smirna kɛ Pergamo kɛ Tiatira kɛ Sarde kɛ Filadelfia kɛ Laodikea."
Ni mitsɔ̃ mihe konu makwɛ mɔ gbee ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ. Ni be ni mitsɔ̃ mihe lɛ, mina shika kanetsei kpawo,
kɛ mɔ ko yɛ kanetsei lɛ ateŋ ni tamɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi, ni ewo atade yuu ni ekɛ shika kpãa efi etsitsi.
Eyitso kɛ eyitsɔi yɛɔ tamɔ toohetsɔi yɛŋ, tamɔ snoo, ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi,
ni enaji tamɔ ayawa kaŋkaŋ ni atsuu he yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli, ni egbee tamɔ nui babaoo gbɛɛmɔ.
Ehiɛ ŋulamii kpawo yɛ eninejurɔ, ni tsi kɛ enaa nta ni naa ba jɛ edaaŋ, ni ehiɛ tamɔ hulu ni miitso kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ.
Ni be ji mina lɛ lɛ, migbee shi yɛ enaji anaa tamɔ gbonyo; ni ekɛ eninejurɔ ŋmɛ minɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kaashe gbeyei; miji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ
kɛ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ. Migbo, ni naa, mihiɛ kã kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ, ni mihiɛ gbele kɛ gbohiiaje naa samfei lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ ŋmaa nii ni ona lɛ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ kɛ nii ni baaba yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ.
Ŋulamii kpawo ni ona yɛ mininejurɔ lɛ kɛ shika kanetsei kpawo lɛ ahe teemɔ sane lɛ nɛ: 'Ŋulamii kpawo lɛ ji asafoi kpawo lɛ abɔfoi, ni kanetsei kpawo lɛ ji asafoi kpawo lɛ.'"
2: "Efeso asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyaha lɛ akɛ, 'Nii ni mɔ ni hiɛ ŋulamiii kpawo lɛ yɛ eninejurɔ ni enyiɛɔ shika kanetsei kpawo lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,
Mile onitsumɔi lɛ, kɛ odeŋmegbomɔ lɛ kɛ ohiɛmiamɔ lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni okplɛ̃ɛɛ mɛi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ; mile akɛ oka mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ bɔfoi ji amɛ shi amɛjeee bɔfoi lɛ ni ona akɛ amalelɔi ji amɛ.
Ni ohiɛ mli, ni oŋmɛɔ otsui shi yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ni etɔko o.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ o yɛ sane, no ji akɛ, oŋmɛɛ otsutsu suɔmɔ lɛ he.
No hewɔ lɛ kaimɔ he ni ojɛ ogbee shi lɛ, ni otsake otsui, ni otsu tsutsu nitsumɔi lɛ. Shi kɛ jeee nakai lɛ, maba onɔ oya ni matsi okanetso lɛ kɛaajɛ egbɛhe lɛ, belɛ ja oshwa ohe.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ oyɛ nɔ ko, ni no ji akɛ onyɛɔ Nikolamɛi lɛ anitsumɔi lɛ ni mi hu minyɛɔ lɛ,
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛ nuɔ nii lɛ. Mɔ ni yeɔ kunim lɛ, mahã lɛ hegbɛ ni eye walatso lɛ ni yɔɔ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Paradeiso lɛ mli lɛ nɔ yibii lɛ eko.'"
"Ni Smirna asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, 'Nii ni klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ, mɔ ni gbo ni ehiɛ kã ekoŋŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ:
Mile omanehulu lɛ kɛ ohia lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ niiatsɛ ji o, ni mile mɛi ni kɛ oshekuyeli kɛɔ akɛ Yudafoi ji mɛ, yɛ be mli ni jeee nakai ni, shi moŋ amɛji Satan kpeehe lɛ mli bii.

Kaashe amanehulu ni obaana lɛ ekoeko gbeyei. Naa, abonsam baaŋɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi awo tsuŋ, koni akɛha nyɛ, ni nyɛaana amanehulu gbii nyɔŋna. Feemɔ anɔkwafo kɛyashi gbele mli, ni mahã o wala akekre lɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafo lɛ. Kunimyelɔ lɛ, gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ efeŋ lɛ efɔŋ ko.'"
"Ni Pergamo asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, Nii ni mɔ ni hiɛ tsi kɛ enaa nta ni naa ba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ:
Mile he ni oyɔɔ lɛ, he ni Satan maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i yɔɔ lɛ; ni ohiɛ migbɛi lɛ be mli ni agbe Antipa, midasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ Satan shihilɛhe lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ o yɛ sanefioo yɛ ohe, no ji akɛ oyɛ mɛi yɛ jɛi ni hiɛ Bileam tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; Bileam ni tsɔ̃ɔ Balak akɛ etsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ atsɔ̃ne ni amɛte wɔji afɔleshãanii ni amɛbɔ ajwamaŋ lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ hu oyɔɔ mɛi ni hiɛ Nikolaimɛi atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ tsakemɔ otsui! Shi kɛji jeee nakai lɛ, maba onɔ oya ni mikɛ amɛ aaabawu kɛ midaaŋ tsi lɛ.

Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ. Mɔ ni yeɔ kunim lɛ, maahã lɛ mana ni akɛtee lɛ eko, ni mahã lɛ tɛ yɛŋ, ni tɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋma gbɛi hee ni mɔ ko leee akɛ ja mɔ ni náa lɛ."
"Ni Tiatira asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, "Nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi ni enaji tamɔ ayawa kaŋkaŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.
Mile onitsumɔi lɛ kɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ kɛ osɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ohiɛmiamɔ lɛ, mile onitsumɔi lɛ akɛ sɛɛkpee nii lɛ fe tsutsunii lɛ tete.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ o yɛ sane ko, akɛ oŋmɛ yoo Isabel ni tsɛɔ ehe gbalɔ yoo lɛ gbɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ mitsuji lɛ anii, ni elakaa amɛ ni amɛbɔ ajwamaŋ ni amɛye wɔji afɔkeshãanii.
Ni mihã lɛ be koni ekɛtsake etsui, shi esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ etsake ni efɔ̃ɔ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ.
Naa, mikɛ lɛ miifɔ̃ hela saa nɔ, ni mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ fite gblã lɛ hu miiwo amanehulu kpeteŋkple mli, belɛ ja amɛtsake amɛtsui ni amɛshi enitsumɔi lɛ.
Ni ebii lɛ, gbe magbe amɛ; ni asafoi lɛ fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ miji mɔ ni taoɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ tsuii amli, ni mahã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛmɔ enyɔmɔwo bɔ ni nyɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
"Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Tiatira lɛ, mɛi abɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli ni ameleee 'Satan teemɔŋ nibii ni mli kwɔlɔ', tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ lɛ, akɛ, Mikɛ jatsu koko eŋmɛŋ nyɛnɔ;
Shi nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛa mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba.
Ni kunimyelɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni hiɛɔ minitsumɔi lɛ amli kɛyashi naagbee lɛ, mahã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ,
tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mina kɛjɛ mi-Tsɛŋɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ dadetso aaakpla amɛ ni eeejwra amɛ tamɔ ajwraa su gbɛi;
ni maŋɔ toloo lɛ mahã lɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ.
3: "Ni Sarde asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, 'Nii ni mɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ kɛ ŋulamii kpawo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ: Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; mile ak ohiɛ gbɛi akɛ ohiɛ kã shi ogbo.
Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, ni owaje niini eshwɛ ni heɔ agboi lɛ. Ejaakɛ minako onitsumɔi lɛ akɛ amɛye emuu yɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ kaimɔ nɔ ni ona ni onu lɛ, ni oye nɔ, ni otsake otsui. Shi kɛ ohiɛ etsɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ, maba tamɔ julɔ, ni oleŋ nɔŋmlɛtswaa nɔ ni maba onɔ kwraa.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ oyɛ mɛi fioo ko yɛ Sarde, mɛi ni woko amɛtaadei lɛ amuji; ni amɛkɛ mi baanyiɛ yɛ atadei yɛji amli, ejaakɛ amɛsa nakai.
Kunimyelɔ lɛ aaawo lɛ ataadei yɛji, ni migbɛŋ egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko, ni magba mli matsi egbɛi tã yɛ mi-Tsɛ hiɛ kɛ ebɔoi lɛ ahiɛ.
"Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ."
"Ni Filadefia asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, "Nii ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋlɛ, anɔkwafo lɛ, mɔ ni hiɛ David samfee lɛ, mɔ ni gbleɔ ni mɔ koŋaaa, ni eŋaa hu ni mɔ ko gbleee lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,
Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; naa, mikɛ shinaa ni agble ema ohiɛ ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ aŋa; ejaakɛ hewalɛ fioo oyɔɔ shi oye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okwako migbɛi lɛ.
Naa, mikɛ mɛi ni jɛ Satan kpeehe lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ Yudafoi ji amɛ shi ebɛ mli, shi malemɔ moŋ amɛmaleɔ lɛ aaaba ni amɛbakoto onaji anaa, ni amɛle akɛ mi lɛ miisumɔ o.
Ejaakɛ oye miwiemɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, 'Miamɔ ohiɛ' lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mato o shweshweeshwe yɛ kaaŋmlɛtswaa ni baaba jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛbaaka mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli,
Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ; hiɛmɔ nɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ mli ni awa, koni mɔ ko akashɔ̃ okekre lɛ!

Kunimyelɔ lɛ, mafee lɛ akulashiŋ yɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni ejeŋ kpo dɔŋŋ. Ni maŋma mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi, kɛ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ maŋ ni ji Yerusalem hee ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi kplekeɔ shi kɛjɛɔ mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ enɔ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafoi lɛ."
"Ni Laodikea asafo lɛ bɔfo lɛ; ŋmaa oyahã lɛ akɛ, "Nii ni Amen lɛ ni ji odasefonyo anɔkwafo lɛ kɛ anɔkwayelɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nibɔɔ lɛ shishijee lɛ kɛɛ nɛ,
Mile onitsumɔi lɛ; mile akɛ obɛ ŋanii ni obɛ klakla hu. Mina ni kulɛ ofee ŋanii loo ofee klakla!
Shi nɛkɛ nɛɛ, akɛni kulɔkulɔ oyɔɔ ni obɛ ŋanii ni obɛ klakla hu hewɔ lɛ, mibafɛ̃ o yɛ midaaŋ mashwie.
Ejaakɛ okɛɔ akɛ, 'Niiatsɛ ji mi ni miyɛ nii, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehīaaa mi' Ni oleee akɛ ohao ni onii hu yɛ mɔbɔ ni ohiafo kɛ shwilafo kɛ heyayaitsɛ ji o.
Miiwo oŋaa akɛ ohe shika ni atsuu he yɛ la mli yɛ miŋɔɔ koni ona nii, kɛ ataadei yɛji, koni owo ni oyayaiaŋ hiɛgble lɛ akakã jaanɔ; ni ohe hiŋmɛi tsofã ni okɛfɔ ohiŋmɛii anɔ koni ona nii.
Mi lɛ, mɛi abɔ ni midɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, mikãa amɛ ni mitsɔseɔ amɛ; no hewɔ lɛ ohiɛ adɔ ni otsake otsui.
Naa, Midamɔ shinaa lɛ naa miishi; kɛji mɔ ko nu migbee ni egble shinaa lɛ, maba eŋɔɔ ni mikɛ lɛ aaabaye nii, ni lɛ hu ekɛ mi aaaye.
Kunimyelɔ lɛ mahã ekɛ mi ata mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mi hu miye kunim ni mikɛ mi-Tsɛ ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ.
"Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ asafo lɛ."
4: Nii nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa, shinaa ko ni agble yɛ ŋwɛi; ni klɛŋklɛŋ gbee ni minu ni tamɔ tɛtrɛmantrɛ ni kɛ mi wie lɛ kɛɛ, "Kwɔɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ o nii ni sa akɛ aba mli yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ lɛ amrɔ lɛ mumɔ lɛ yi minɔ; ni naa, maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ko ma shi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni mɔ ko ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.
Ni mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ, kɛ aakwɛ lɛ lɛ, etamɔ yaspi kɛ sardio, ni kwaabuɛtɛ ebɔle maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ, ni kɛ aakwɛ lɛ, etamɔ ameraldo.
Ni maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ mamɔ shi kɛkpe, ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ tra sɛ̃ii lɛ anɔ; amɛwo ataadei yɛji, ni shika akekre fimɔ amɛyitsei.
Ni srawai kɛ gbɛɛmɔi kɛ nyɔŋmɔshimɔi jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli, ni la hai kpawo ni tsoɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ.
Ni nɔ ko tamɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ ni tamɔ kristalo yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ. Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ ni hiŋmɛii eyimɔ amɛhiɛ kɛ amɛsɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ ehewɔ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tamɔ tsina, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ tsina, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ tamɔ gbɔmɔ, ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ tamɔ okropɔŋ ni miifliki.

Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji ekpaa, ni amɛhewɔ kɛ amɛmli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ hiŋmɛii, ni amɛjɔɔɔ amɛhe nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, "Krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni yɛ momo lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni baaba lɛ."
Ni be ni hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ŋɔɔ anumnyam kɛ agbojee kɛ shidaa amɛhãa mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ni ehiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ,
onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ hoɔ gbeɔ shi yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛjaa mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ, ni amɛshɛrɛɔ amɛkekrei lɛ amɛshiwieɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ,
"Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ, osa akɛ oŋɔ anumnyam kɛ woo kɛ hewalɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ bo obɔ nii fɛɛ, ni osuɔmɔ naa obɔ amɛ ni amɛyɔɔ wala."
5: Ni mina wolo ko yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ ninejurɔ, ni aŋma nii yɛ emli kɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ, ni asɔo naa kɛ naasɔomɔi kpawo.
Ni mina bɔfo hewalɔ ko miishiɛ kɛ gbee wulu akɛ, "Namɔ ji mɔ ni sa akɛ egble wolo lɛ naa ni etserɛ enaasɔomɔi lɛ?"
Ni anãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ ŋwɛi koo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi ni aaanyɛ wolo lɛ naa agble loo mli akwɛ.
Ni mifo aahuu, ejaakɛ anãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko ni sa akɛ egble wolo lɛ naa loo ekwɛ mli.
Ni onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kaafo! Naa, jata lɛ ni kɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ ni ji David shishifã lɛ, eye kunim ni ebaanyɛ egble wolo lɛ naa ní etserɛ enaasɔomɔi kpawo lɛ."

Ni miikwɛ, ni naa, maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ teŋ kɛ onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Toobi ko damɔ shi tamɔ nɔ ni agble lɛ, ni eyɛ akloŋtoi kpawo kɛ hiŋmɛii kpawo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔi kpawo lɛ ni atsu kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni eba ni ebahe wolo lɛ yɛ mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ ninejurɔ.

Ni be ni ehe wolo lɛ, hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛkɛ onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ho gbee shi yɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ saŋku kɛ shika tɔi kɛ amɛmli tsofakɛŋma obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ.
Ni amɛka lala hee ko amɛkɛɛ, "Osa akɛ oheɔ wolo lɛ ni otserɛɔ enaasɔomɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ agbe o, ni okɛ olá lɛ akpɔ̃ mɛi ehã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ kɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ jeŋmaji mli.
Ni okɛ amɛ efee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ osɔfoi ahã wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Ni amɛaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Ni mikwɛ, ni minu bɔfoi pii ni ebɔle maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛkpe lɛ agbee, ni amɛyibɔ huuhai abɔ kɛ akpe toi abɔ
ni amɛkɛ gbee wulu kɛɛ akɛ, "Toobi ni agbe lɛ sa hewalɛ kɛ nifalɛ kɛ nilee kɛ nyɛmɔ kɛ woo kɛ anumnyam kɛ jɔɔmɔ."

Ni minu ni bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛ mli lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Jɔɔmɔ woo kɛ anumnyam kɛ nɔyeli ahã mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ!"
Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛɛ, "Amen!" Ni onukpai lɛ ho gbee shi, ni amɛja.
6: Ni mina akɛ Toobi lɛ tsɛ naasɔomɔi kpawo lɛ ekome; ni minu ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ gbee ni tamɔ nyɔŋmɔshimɔ gbee kɛɛ, "Ba!"
Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ, ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ hiɛ gãi, ni ahã lɛ akekre, ni eje kpo tamɔ kunimyelɔ ni miiya eyaye kunim.
Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, minu ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Ba!"
Ni okpɔŋɔ kroko ni tsuɔ je kpo, ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ, ahã lɛ hegbɛ ni ejie hejɔlɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni mɛi agbegbee amɛhe, ni ahã lɛ klaŋte kpeteŋkple ko.
Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, minu ni hiɛkãalɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛɛ, "Ba!" Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ diŋ ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ hiɛ nsɛni yɛ edɛŋ.
Ni minu gbee ko yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ miikɛɛ, "Ŋmaa susumɔnɔ kome denario, ni able susumɔnii etɛ̃ denario; ni mu kɛ wain lɛ kaata he!"
Ni be ni etsɛ naasɔomɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, minu hiɛkãalɔ ni ji ejwɛ kɛ gbee miikɛɛ, "Ba!"

Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, okpɔŋɔ lamlulamlu ni mɔ ni ta enɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Gbele, ni Gbohiiaje nyiɛ esɛɛ kpakpa. Ni ahã amɛ hegbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mlijai ejwɛ mli ekome nɔ, akɛ amɛkɛ klaŋte kɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ gbele hela shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi awuyelɔi agbegbee amɛ.
Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔnɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ, mina mɛi ni agbe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛ odase ni amɛye lɛ hewɔ lɛ asusumai yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Ni amɛblɔ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ "Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ anɔkwafo, mɛɛ beyinɔ po oookojo ni oootɔ wɔla lɛ he owele yɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ?"

Ni akɛ ataade yɛŋ hã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛjɔɔ amɛhe be fioo ko lolo, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛnanemɛi tsuji lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu ni abaagbe amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni agbe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ aaashɛ.
Ni mina be ni etse naasɔomɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ, ni naa, shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni hulu tsɔ ediŋ tamɔ kpekpe ni akɛ yitsɔi fee, ni nyɔŋtsere muu lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ lá;
ni ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ tserɛ shwie shikpɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni agbãmitso yi agbamii ŋmlikitii tserɛɔ shwieɔ shi kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kpeteŋkple hoso agbamiitso lɛ.
Ni ŋwɛi tsi ehe kɛtee sɛɛ tamɔ wolo ni aakota; ni atsirɛ gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔkpɔ fɛɛ ŋshɔkpɔ kɛje egbɛhe.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ji lumɛi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ hewalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɔji fɛɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi fɛɛ yateetee amɛhe yɛ bui amli kɛ gɔji atsɛsai amli,
ni amɛkɛɛ gɔji lɛ kɛ tɛsai lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbagbea wɔnɔ ni nyɛtea wɔnɔ ni wɔkana mɔni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ mlifu lɛ!
Ejaakɛ emlifu gbi wulu lɛ eshɛ, ni namɔ aaanyɛ shi adamɔ?"
7: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mina ŋwɛi bɔfoi ejwɛ damɔ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, ni amɛhiɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ amli, koni kɔɔyɔɔ ko akatswa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ loo ŋshɔ nɔ loo tso ko nɔ.
Ni mina bɔfo kroko miikwɔ kɛmiijɛ hulu shiteehe kɛmiiba, ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ naasɔomɔnɔ, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni ahã amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛfee shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ,
akɛ, "Nyɛfea shikpɔŋ lɛ loo ŋshɔ lɛ loo tsei lɛ efɔŋ ko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔkɛ naasɔomɔnɔ aaakadi wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji lɛ ahiɛŋtsei anɔ dã."
Ni minu mɛi ni akɛ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ ekadi amɛ lɛ ayibɔ: Mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ ni akɛ naasɔomɔnɔ ekadi amɛ kɛjɛ Israelbii lɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso mli:
Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ akɛ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ kadi mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Ruben akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Gad akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ;
Asher akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Naftali akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Manase akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ;
Simeon akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Levi akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Isakar akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ;
Zebulon akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Yosef akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; Benyamin akutso lɛ mli lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.

Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa, asafo kple ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ akane ni jɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ kɛ akutsei kɛ maji kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi amli damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛwo ataadei yɛji, ni amɛhiɛ blɛoi yɛ amɛdɛŋ,
ni amɛblɔ kɛ gbee ni wa amɛkɛɛ, "Yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Toobi lɛ nɔ!"
Ni bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ahe kɛkpe, ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ
amɛkɛɛ, "Amen! Jɔɔmɔ kɛ anumnyam kɛ nilee kɛ shidaa kɛ woo kɛ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ahã wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ. Amen!"
Ni onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome bi mi akɛm "Mɛi ni wo ataadei yɛji nɛɛ, namɛi ni, ni nɛɛgbɛ amɛjɛ?"
Ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, bo ole: Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ "Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni jɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple lɛ mli lɛ, ni amɛfɔ amɛtaadei lɛ ahe, ni amɛhã eyɛ futaa yɛ Toobi lɛ lá lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ amɛyɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛjaa lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane yɛ e-Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ; ni mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛsɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ aaashi ebuu lɛ eto amɛnɔ.
Hɔ̃mɔ yeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ, ni kumai hu yeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ hulu eshaŋ amɛ ni latsaa ko etsaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ;
ejaakɛ Toobi lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ teŋ lɛ aaalɛ amɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛaatee wala nubui ahe. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yaafonui fɛɛ."
8: Ni be ni etse naasɔomɔnɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ, afee diŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi aaafee ŋmlɛtswa fã.
Ni mina bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni akɛ tetremantrɛi kpawo hã amɛ.

Ni bɔfo kroko ba ni ebadamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ehiɛ shika tsofãkɛŋma shãanɔ, ni akɛ tsofãkɛŋma babaoo hã lɛ, koni ekɛfata krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ fɛɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ ahe yɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni tsofãkɛŋma lɛ lasu lɛ te shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛjɛ bɔfo lɛ dɛŋ, ni krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ asɔlemɔi lɛ fata he.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɔ tsofãkɛŋma shãanɔ lɛ, ni eje afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ la lɛ eko ewo lɛ obɔ̃, ni etsi eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kɛ gbɛɛmɔi kɛ srawagblamɔi kɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ ba.
Ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛi kpawo lɛ saa amɛhe koni amɛkpã.
Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ kɛ la ni lá futu mli ba ni ebashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni tsei amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni jwɛi fɔ fɛɛ shã.
Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ashɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ gɔ̃ŋ kpeteŋkple ni shãa kɛ la afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ, ni ŋshɔ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ lá.
Ni ŋshɔ lɛ mli bɔɔnii ni yɔɔ wala lɛ lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome gboi, ni lɛji lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome fite.
Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ŋulami kpeteŋkple ni tsoɔ tamɔ haa jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shi, ni egbee fai lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nubui lɛ anɔ.
Ni ŋulami lɛ gbɛi ji taatso, ni nui lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ taatso ni gbɔmɛi pii gboi yɛ nui lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛmiijoo.

Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni atswa hulu mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nyɔŋtsere mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome nɔ, amɛmlijai etɛ̃ mli ekomekome lɛ wo duŋ, ni shwane mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ jeŋ tseee ni nyɔɔŋ hu nakai nɔŋŋ,

Ni mikwɛ, ni minu okropɔŋ ko mlifliki yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, "Kpoo! Kpoo! Kpoo hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ bɔfoi etɛ̃ eshwɛ lɛ atɛtrɛmantrɛi ni amɛbaakpã lɛ agbɛɛmɔi lɛ ahewɔ!"
9: Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni mina ŋulami ko jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa samfee lɛ hã lɛ.
Ni egble bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa, ni lasu te shi kɛjɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ flɔ̃ɔnɔɔ kpeteŋkple mli lasu, ni hulu kɛ atatuiaŋ wo duŋ yɛ bu lɛ mli lasu lɛ hewɔ.
Ni baalabii jɛ lasu lɛ mli kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ahã amɛ hewalɛ tamɔ hewalɛ ni shikpɔŋ nɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakoi yɔɔ lɛ;
ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkafee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛi loo baaŋmɔŋ loo tso ko efɔŋ ko, akɛ ja gbɔmɛi ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ okadi yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Ni ahãaa amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi moŋ akɛ amɛpiŋ amɛ nyɔji enumɔ. Ni amɛnaajramɔ tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakro naajramɔ, kɛ etsɛ̃ mɔ lɛ.
Ni nakai gbii lɛ amli lɛ gbɔmɛi aaatao gbele, shi amɛnaŋ, ni amɛaashwe ni amɛgboi, shi gbele aaajo amɛnaa foi.
Ni baalabii lɛ asubaŋ tamɔ okpɔŋɔi ni asaa ahã ta, ni nibii komɛi fimɔ amɛyitsei tamɔ shika akekrei, ni amɛhiɛiaŋ tamɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ;
ni amɛyitsɔi tamɔ yei ayitsɔi, ni amɛnyanyɔji tamɔ jatai anɔ;
ni amɛwo damai tamɔ dade damai, ni amɛfijiaŋ gbɛɛmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ shwiilii babaoo ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiya ta agbɛɛmɔ.
Ni amɛyɛ leii tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi aleii kɛ amɛnaa gãii, ni amɛye hewalɛ yɛ amɛleii lɛ amli ni amɛkɛaafee gbɔmɛi efɔŋ nyɔji enumɔ.
Ni amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ bi bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ bɔfo lɛ, ni atsɛɔ egbɛi Hebri wiemo lɛ mli Abadon, ni Hela wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ atsɛɔ gbɛi akɛ Apolion.
Kpoo kome eho; naa, kpoi enyɔ miiba lolo yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ.
Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ akloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ mli
ni miikɛɛ bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ akɛ, "Fɛnemɔ bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni afimɔ amɛ yɛ Eufrate Faa kpeteŋkple lɛ naa lɛ!"
Ni afɛne bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni asaa ato ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ kɛ gbi lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ lɛ kɛ afi lɛ, koni amɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Ni tabilɔi ni tra okpɔŋɔi anɔ lɛ ayibɔ ji akpe toi akpe ohai enyɔ; minu amɛyibɔ lɛ.
Ni bɔ ni mina okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔtralɔi lɛ yɛ ninaa lɛ mli nɛ; amɛwo damai ni hiɛ lá kɛ asafo kɛ swɔɔ su; ni okpɔŋɔi lɛ ayitsei tamɔ jatai ayitsei, ni lá kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ.
Nɛkɛ haomɔi etɛ̃ ni ji lá kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ ni fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ nɛɛ, akɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Ejaakɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahewalɛ yɛ amɛdaaŋ kɛ amɛleii amli, ejaakɛ amɛleii lɛ tamɔ onufui aleii, ni yitsei yɛ he, ni nomɛi amɛkɛfeɔ efɔŋ.

Ni gbɔmɛi ni shwɛ ni nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ egbeee amɛ lɛ, amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛdiɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe. Amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ ayawa kɛ tɛ kɛ tso amãgãi ni nyɛɛɛ amɛna nii loo amɛnu nii loo amɛnyiɛ lɛ ajamɔ.
Ni asaŋ amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛgbɔmɔgbee kɛ amɛsuu kɛ amɛjwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ amɛjuu lɛ ahe.
10: Ni mina bɔfo hewalɛ kroko jɛ ŋwɛi miikpleke shi, ni eha atatu, ni kwaabuɛtɛ yɛ eyiteŋ, ni ehiɛ tamɔ hulu. ni enaji tamɔ la akulashiŋi.
Ni ehiɛ wolo bibioo ko ni agble naa yɛ edɛŋ; ni ekɛ enanejurɔ ma ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ekɛ enane abɛku hu ma shikpɔŋ nɔ.
Ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa, tamɔ jata huuɔ; ni be ni eboɔ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbei.
Ni be ni nyɔŋmɔ shiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbɛi lɛ, kulɛ miiŋma; ni minu gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, "Sɔomɔ nii ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wie lɛ anaa oto, ni oka ŋma."
Ni bɔfo lɛ ni mina akɛ edamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ wó eninejurɔ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi,
ni etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ gbɛi ekɛkã kita akɛ, "Be ko be ko bɛ dɔŋŋ,
shi moŋ be mli ni aaanu bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee be ni eehé ekpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, no lɛ agbe Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ hu naa, bɔ ni ejaje etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ."
Ni gbee ni minu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Yaa ni oyahe wolo lɛ ni agbla naa lɛ yɛ bɔfo ni damɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ."
Ni mitee bɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni miyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Kɛ wolo bibioo lɛ ahã mi." Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Hemɔ ni oye, ni eeejoo yɛ omusuŋ, shi odaaŋ moŋ lɛ eeeŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ tamɔ wo."
Ni mihe wolo bibioo lɛ yɛ bɔfo lɛ dɛŋ ni miye ni eŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo, shi be ni miye lɛ, ejoo yɛ mimusu mli.
Ni akɛɛ mi akɛ, "Esa akɛ ogba gbalɛ ni kɔɔ maji kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ majianɔ wiemɔi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi pii ahe ekoŋŋ."
11: Ni ahã mi glã ko ni tamɔ nisusumɔ tso, ni ekɛɛ, "Tee shi oyasusu Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni okane mɛi ni jaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ mli lɛ.
Ni kpo ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, shi no sɛɛ ni okasusu no, ejaakɛ akɛhã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni amɛaanaanaa maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Ni mahã midasefoi enyɔ lɛ hegbɛ ni amɛgba gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpãa ni amɛwo kpekpe."
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ kanetsei enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao afee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, la jeɔ amɛdaaŋ ni ekpãtãa amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ; ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao akɛ efee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ agbeɔ lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛŋaa ŋwɛi naa, koni nu akanɛ tɛ amɛgbalɛ bei lɛ amli; ni amɛyɛ hegbɛ hu yɛ nui lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhjãa etsɔ̃ɔ lá, ni amɛkɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ haoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shii abɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ.
