Ni kɛ amɛgbe amɛdaseyeli lɛ naa lɛ, kooloo lɛ ni jɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛ amɛ baawu ta, ni eeeye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eeegbee amɛ;
ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaajwere maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ blohu lɛ mli, maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ mli akɛ Sodom kɛ Egipt lɛ, he ni asaŋ amɛ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Ni mɛi komɛi ni jɛ maji lɛ kɛ akutsei amli kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ aaakwɛ amɛgbohii lɛ gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã, ni amɛkplɛ̃ŋ ni afu amɛ.
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaanya yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ, ni amɛ aaamajemajee amɛhe keenii, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbalɔi enyɔ nɛɛ piɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ wala mumɔ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba amɛmli, ni amɛte shi amɛdamɔ amɛnaji anɔ, ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔmɔ mɛi ni na amɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛnu gbee wa ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkwɔa kɛbaa biɛ nɛɛ!" Ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ atatu mli, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ na amɛ.

Ni nakai ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni maŋ lɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome wule, ni shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe gbɔmɛi akpei kpawo, ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ shi gbeyei, ni amɛkɛ anumnyam hã ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Kpoo ni ji enyɔ lɛ eho; naa, kpoo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ miiba oya.
Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni ani gbeei wuji yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, "Je nɛɛ mli maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ e-Kristo lɛ nɔ, ni eeeye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ!"
Ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛni tra amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ
amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔmiida o shi, bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ ni oyɛ ni obaaba lɛ, akɛ oŋɔ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni oye maŋtsɛ!

Ni jeŋmaji lɛ amli efu. Ni omlifu be lɛ eshɛ kɛ be ni abaakojo gbohii lɛ. Ni abaawo otsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ ogbɛi lɛ gbeyei, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ anyɔmɔ. Ni abaafite mɛi ni fiteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ!"
Ni agble Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ana ekpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ yɛ e-Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni srawai gbla kɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni nyɔŋmɔ shimɔ ni shikpɔŋ hoso ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi babaoo nɛ.
12: Ni ana naakpɛɛ okadi kpeteŋkple ko yɛ ŋwɛi: Yoo ko ni hulu ha ehe, ni nyɔŋtsere yɛ enajiashi, ni ŋulamii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ akekre fi eyitso.
Ehiɛ musu ni fɔmɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ nɔnaa ehã eeblɔ.
Ni ana naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, ni naa, drako tsuru kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoinyɔŋma, ni maŋtsɛ faii kpawo bumɔ eyitsei lɛ.
Ni elei miigbla ŋwɛi ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome; ni etsirɛ amɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Ni drako lɛ badamɔ yoo ni baafɔ lɛ hiɛ, koni kɛ efɔ lɛ, ni emi ebi lɛ.
Ni yoo lɛ fɔ binuu ni kɛ dadetso baakpla jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ; ni asha ebi lɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ masɛi.
Ni yoo lɛ jo foi kɛtee ŋanɔ he ko, he ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto ehã lɛ lɛ, koni ayalɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Ni ta te shi yɛ ŋwɛi, Mikael kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ fã drako lɛ nɔ ta. Ni drako lɛ bɔfoi fata ehe kɛwu,
ni drako kɛ ebɔfoi aye, ni asaŋ amɛnaaa gbɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ni ashɛ drako kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ji blema onufu lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abonsam loo Satan lɛ ni shishiuɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ashɛrɛ ebɔfoi lɛ hu ashwie afata ehe.

Ni minu gbee wulu ko yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, "Agbɛnɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni hegbɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ e-Kristo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ ashɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ anaaflɔlɔ lɛ ni flɔɔ amɛnaa yɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ afɔ̃.
Ni amɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ lá lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛdaseyeli wiemɔ lɛ eye enɔ kunim, ni amɛdɔɔɔ amɛwala lɛ he kɛyashi gbele mli tete.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛ ŋwɛii kɛ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ jɛi, nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ! Shi kpoo hã shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ! Ejaakɛ abonsam lɛ ekpleke shi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, egri naakpa, ejaakɛ ele akɛ be fio kɛkɛ eyɔɔ."
Ni be ni drako lɛ na akɛ ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, etsui yoo lɛ ni fɔ binuu lɛ.
Ni akɛ okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ hã yoo lɛ, koni efliki ni eshi onufu ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ egbɛhe lɛ, he ni alɛɔ lɛ yɛ afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ.
Ni onufu lɛ fɛ̃ nu ni tamɔ faa ko kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie yoo lɛ sɛɛ, koni nuu lɛ asha lɛ kɛya.
Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ ye bua yoo lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ gble edaaŋ ni emii faa lɛ ni drako lɛ fɛ̃ kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni drako lɛ mi fu yoo lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ yoo lɛ shwiei ni eshwɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni amɛhiɛ Yesu Kristo odase lɛ mli ayawu.
Ni eyadamɔ ŋshɔ naa shia lɛ nɔ.
13: Ni mina kooloo ko miijie kpo kɛmiijɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli kɛmiiba kɛ eklontoi nyɔŋma kɛ eyitsei kpawo, ni maŋtsɛ faii nyɔŋma bumɔ eklontoi lɛ, ni musubɔɔ gbɛi yɛ eyitsei lɛ ahe.
Ni kooloo lɛ ni mina lɛ tamɔ mlaŋtswi, ni enaji tamɔ oshishibrishi naji, ni enaabu tamɔ jata naabu. Ni drako lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple hã lɛ.
Ni mina eyitsei lɛ ateŋ ekome tamɔ nɔ ni epila gbele pilamɔ, ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ kooloo lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe,
ni amɛja drako lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ hegbɛ lɛ ehã kooloo lɛ, ni amɛja kooloo lɛ hu amɛkɛɛ, "Namɔ tamɔ kooloo lɛ, ni namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ lɛ awu?"
Ni ahã lɛ naabu ni wieɔ wiemɔi wuji kɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi, ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee enɛ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Ni egbele enaa ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ewie egbɛi lɛ kɛ eshihililɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe musubɔɔ wiemɔi.
Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ awu ni eye amɛnɔ kunim; ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ nɔ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaja lɛ. Ja mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋma egbɛi kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee yɛ Toobi ni agbe lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli kɛkɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nii.
Kɛji ato akɛ aŋɔ mɔ ko nom lɛ, aaaŋɔ kɛ nom; ni kɛ ato akɛ akɛ klaŋte agbe mɔ ko lɛ, klaŋte akɛaagbe lɛ. Biɛ wɔnaa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ yɛ.
Ni mina kooloo kroko miije kpo kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ mli kɛ eklontoi enyɔ tamɔ toobi aklontoi, ni wieɔ tamɔ drako.
Ni etsuɔ klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ hegbɛ lɛ fɛɛ he nii yɛ ehiɛ, ni ahãa shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ jaa klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ.
Ni efeɔ okadi wuji, ni ehãa lɛ po jɛɔ ŋwɛi baa shikpɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.

Ni ekɛ okadii ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee yɛ kooloo lɛ hiɛ lɛ shishiɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ amɛfee amãgã amɛhã kooloo lɛ ni klaŋte naa pilamɔ yɔɔ ehe ni ehiɛ kã lɛ.
Ni ahã lɛ gbɛ ni ekɛ mumɔ ahã kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ, koni kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ awie tete, ni ehã agbe mɛi fɛɛ ni jaaa kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ.
Ni ehã akadiɔ mɛi fɛɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafo, odehei kɛ nyɔji yɛ amɛninejurɔ loo amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ.
Koni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ehe nii aloo ehɔ̃ɔ nii, akɛ ja mɔ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ji kooloo lɛ gbɛi loo yibɔ ni damɔ shi hã egbɛi lɛ.
Biɛ nilee he ehia yɛ. Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ abu kooloo lɛ yibɔ lɛ he akɔŋtaa; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yibɔ ni; ni eyibɔ lɛ ji ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa.
14: Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, Toobi lɛ damɔ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ ni aŋma egbɛi kɛ e-Tsɛ gbɛi yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ fata ehe.
Ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ nui pii agbɛɛmɔ, ni asaŋ etamɔ nyɔŋmɔshimɔ kpeteŋkple gbɛɛmɔ; ni gbee ni minu lɛ tamɔ saŋkutswalɔi ni miitswa amɛsaŋkui agbee.
Ni amɛlaa lala hee ko yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ; ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lala lɛ akase, akɛ ja mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.

Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni kɛ yei buleko amɛhe, ejaakɛ oblahii ni he tse ji amɛ, ni amɛnyiɛɔ Toobi lɛ sɛɛ kɛyaa he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ. Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ.
Ni anaaa amale ko yɛ amɛdaaŋ ejaakɛ kpo ko bɛ amɛhe.
Ni mina bɔfo kroko miifliki yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ, ni ehiɛ naanɔ Sanekpakpa ni eyaajaje etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ jeŋma fɛɛ jeŋma kɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli.
Ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, "Nyɛshea Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni nyɛkɛ anumnyam ahãa lɛ ejaakɛ ekojomɔ ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; ni nyɛjaa mɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ!"
Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji enyɔ nyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛɛ, "Egbee shi, Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ dãa lɛ eko."
Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji etɛ̃ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni ekɛ gbee wulu kɛɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko ja kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgãi lɛ, ni ehe ekadi lɛ yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ loo enine nɔ lɛ,
lɛ hu eeenu Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu dãa ŋmiiŋmi ni akɛwo emlifu kpulu lɛ mli lɛ eko, ni aaapiŋ lɛ yɛ la kɛ swɔɔ mli yɛ bɔfo krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ.
Ni amɛpiŋmɔ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ. Ni mɛi ni jaa kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eŋɔ egbɛi okadi lɛ, nãaa hejɔɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwame."
Biɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ni hiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ kɛ Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ he ehia yɛ.

Ni minu gbee jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ mi akɛ, "Ŋmaa: Ajɔɔ gbohii lɛ ni gboiɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ mɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ. Hɛɛ, Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ, koni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe kɛjɛ amɛdeŋmegbomɔi lɛ amli ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ."
Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, atatu yɛŋ, ni mɔ ko ta nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ bi, ni shika akekre fi eyitso, ni ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba yɛ edɛŋ.

Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ni eblɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ, "Okɛ onikpamɔ kakla lɛ awo mli ni okpa nii, ejaakɛ nikpamɔ ŋmlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nikpamɔnii lɛ etsu."
Ni mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ enikpamɔ kakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii lɛ.
Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ mli, ni lɛ hu ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba.

Ni bɔfo kroko ni yɔɔ la nɔ hewalɛ je kpo kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli, ni ebo etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba lɛ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, "Okɛ okakla ni naa ba lɛ awo mli ni okpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ etsu!"
Ni bɔfo lɛ shɛ ekakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ, ni ekɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ wainŋaanɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli.
Ni anaanaa wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ, ni lá ho kɛjɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ mli ni ekɛlɛ ji shitoi ohai enyɔ.
15: Ni mina naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, eda ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ: bɔfo kpawo ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo ni ji naagbeenii lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi akɛgbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ naa.
Ni mina nɔ ko tamɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ ni akɛ lá efutu mli, ni mɛi ni eye koolo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ kɛ ekadi lɛ kɛ egbɛi lɛ yibɔ lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ damɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ saŋkui lɛ.
Ni amɛla Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose lala lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ lala lɛ amɛkɛɛ, "Onitsumɔi lɛ dra ni amɛyɛ naakpɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe! Ogbɛi lɛ ja ni anɔkwale ni, bo jeŋmaji lɛ a-Maŋtsɛ!
Namɔ po sheŋ o gbeyei, Nuŋtsɔ, ni ewoŋ ogbɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ nyam? Ejaakɛ bo okemetoo ji Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; ejaakɛ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba ni amɛbaja yɛ ohiɛ, ejaakɛ ajie ojalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ashi faŋŋ."
Ni nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni agble Odase Buu lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi,
ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ haomɔ kpawo lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni amɛwo kakla ni he tse ni kplɛɔ kaŋkaŋ, ni amɛfimɔ amɛtsitsii kɛ shika mlifiinii.
Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ shika tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ mlila lɛ hã bɔfoi kpawo lɛ.
Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ lasu ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ mli lɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛ̃ɛɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli abote kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ahaomɔi kpawo lɛ naa.
16: Ni minu gbee ni wa ni jɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli miikɛɛ bɔfoi kpawo lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyafɔsea Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu toi kpawoi lɛ nyɛshwiea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ yi mli etee, ni eyafɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni kooloo lɛ okadi yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ famɔ faji fɔ̃ɔji ni waa mɔ he.
Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo ŋshɔ mli; ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gbonyo lá, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ gbo.
Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo fai kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ amli, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ lá.
Ni minu nui lɛ anɔ bɔfo lɛ miikɛɛ, "Jalɔ ji o, bo ni oyɔɔ, ni oyɛ, ni oji Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛni okojo nɛkɛ nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛshwie krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi. Ni lá nɔŋŋ ohã amɛ ni amɛnu; esa amɛ nakai!"
Ni minu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ miikɛɛ, "Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe, anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji okojomɔi lɛ!"
Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie hulu nɔ; ni ahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛ la ashã gbɔmɛi.
Ni la dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ shã gbɔmɛi, ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui ni amɛwo ehiɛ nyam.
Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie kooloo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ wo duŋ, ni gbɔmɛi kɔ̃mɔ amɛlilɛii yɛ nɔnaa lɛ hewɔ.
Ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ nɔnai lɛ kɛ amɛfaji lɛ ahewɔ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ɔji lɛ ahe.
Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo Eufrate Faa agbo lɛ mli. Ni emli nu lɛ gbi, koni akɛsaa gbɛ ahã maŋtsɛmɛi ni jɛ hulu shiteehe lɛ.
Ni mina mumɔi etɛ̃ ni he tseee ni tamɔ kɔkɔdenei miije kpo kɛmiije drako lɛ daaŋ kɛ kooloo lɛ daaŋ kɛ amalegbalɔ lɛ daaŋ.
Ejaakɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji amumɔi ni, ni amɛfeɔ okadii, ni amɛyaa maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ aŋɔɔa, koni amɛyabua amɛnaa amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ ta lɛ.
"Naa, miiba tamɔ julɔ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni sraa ni ekwɛɔ etaadei lɛ anɔ lɛ, koni ekanyiɛ yayai ni ana ehiɛgble lɛ."
Ni mumɔi lɛ bua maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anaa kɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ Harmagedon lɛ,
Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni gbee ni wa ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli kɛɛ akɛ, "Agbe naa!"
Ni srawai gbla kɛ gbɛɛmɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔ shimɔ, ni shikpɔŋ hoso waa diɛŋtsɛ; nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ gbeyeigbeyei nɛɛ, asonɔkwa, anako eko dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni abɔ gbɔmɔ adesa kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ.
Ni maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli gbla etɛ̃, ni jeŋmaji lɛ amaji lɛ fɛɛ wule, ni akai Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ dãa kpulu lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ni ŋshɔkpɔ fɛɛ ŋshɔkpɔ laaje, ni gɔ̃ji lɛ anãaa dɔŋŋ.

Ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi agboi ni amɛtsiimɔ tamɔ talenta jɛ ŋwɛi bashwie gbɔmɛi anɔ, ni gbɔmɛi lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ ahaomɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ haomɔ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛɛ kɛba lɛ yɛ gbeyei po ni ehiii.
17: Bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba, ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, "Ba ni matsɔ̃ɔ o ajwamaŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ta nui babaoo lɛ anɔ lɛ kojomɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ, ni ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa lɛ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ trɔ dãa."
Ni bɔfo lɛ kpla mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee ŋanɔ. Ni mina yoo ko ta kooloo tsuru fɔɔ ko nɔ ni kooloo nɛɛ he fɛɛ lɛ musubɔɔ gbɛii sɔŋŋ, ni eyɛ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma.
Yoo lɛ wo ataade afaseo diŋ kɛ etsuru fɔɔ, ni akɛ shika kɛ tɛi ni jra wa kɛ adiagbai ewula lɛ, ni ehiɛ shika kpulu yɛ edɛŋ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ mli nihiinii kɛ mijinii.
Ni aŋma gbɛi ko ni ji teemɔ sane yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ, "Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ajwamaŋi lɛ kɛ nihiinii lɛ anyɛ lɛ."
Ni mina yoo lɛ akɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ alá lɛ kɛ Yesu he odasefoi lɛ alá lɛ etɔ lɛ dãa. Be ni mina lɛ lɛ, minaa kpɛ mihe naakpaa.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Mɛɛhewɔ onaa ekpɛ ohe? Mibagba o yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo ni eta nɔ ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo lɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ahe teemɔ sane lɛ.

Kooloo lɛ ni ona lɛ be ko mli lɛ eyɛ, shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaajɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli eje kpo kɛya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli. Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aŋmako amɛgbɛii yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ anaa aaakpɛ amɛhe kɛ amɛna kooloo lɛ akɛ be ko mli lɛ, eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaaba lɛ.
"Biɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni nilee yɔɔ mli he ehīa yɛ. Yitsei kpawo lɛ ji gɔ̃ji kpawo ni yoo lɛ ta nɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ maŋtsɛmɛi kpawo hu ni.
Amɛteŋ mɛi enumɔ egbee shi, mɔ kome yɛ, ni mɔ kome lɛ nako aba, ni kɛ eba lɛ, ja ehi shi fioo.
Ni kooloo lɛ ni be ko mli lɛ eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ, ni ejɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ amli, ni eeya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli."
"Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ni ona lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli shɛko amɛdɛŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbaana hegbɛ amɛye maŋtsɛ ŋmlɛtswaa kome kɛ kooloo lɛ.
Amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome, ni amɛkɛ amɛhewalɛ kɛ amɛhegbɛ lɛ hãa kooloo lɛ.
Amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ baawu, shi Toobi lɛ baaye amɛnɔ kunim, ejaakɛ lɛji Nuŋtsɔmɛi a-Nuŋtsɔ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi a-Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni atsɛ kɛ mɛi ni ahala kɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ."
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Nui lɛ ni ona ni yoo ajwamaŋ lɛ ta nɔ lɛ ji maji kɛ asafoi kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi.
Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma ni ona lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ amɛaanyɛ ajwamaŋ lɛ, ni amɛaafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ni amɛkɛla aaashã lɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛwo amɛtsuii amli koni amɛfee eyiŋtoonii lɛ ni amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni amɛkɛ amɛmaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã kooloo lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ aaaba mli."
"Ni yoo lɛ ni ona lɛ ji maŋ kpeteŋkple ni yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ."
18: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mina bɔfo kroko miikpleke shi kɛmiijɛ ŋwɛi, ni eyɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple, ni enumnyam lɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tse;
ni ekɛ̃ ehe shi ebo ekɛɛ, "Egbee shi, Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ni etsɔ̃ mumɔi fɔ̃ɔji ashihilɛhe, kɛ mumɔi ni he tseee fɛɛ atsu kɛ looflɔ̃ fɛɛ looflɔ̃ ni he tseee ni anyaŋeɔ hu tse.
Ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa ni naa wa lɛ eko, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jrayelɔi lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ enye nyeŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa."
Ni minu gbee kroko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, "Nyɛjea emli, mimaŋ, koni nyɛkɛ lɛ akafea eshai ni efeɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkana ehaomɔi lɛ eko.
Ejaakɛ ehe eshai lɛ anɔ ekwɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekai enifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ.
Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu ewo lɛ, ni nyɛkua nyɛbɔa he toi enyɔ nyɛhã lɛ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa. Kpulu lɛ ni efutu dãa yɛ mli, nyɛfutua lɛ toi enyɔ nyɛwoa mli nyɛhãa lɛ.
Bɔ ni ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ nyam ni ebɔ nyenyeŋtswi lɛ, nakai bɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛhãa epiŋmɔ kɛ ewerɛhoo lɛ afaa; ejaakɛ ekɛɔ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, 'Mita shi akɛ maŋnyɛ, ni mijeee okulafo, ni minaŋ awerɛhoo.'
No hewɔ lɛ gbi kome nɔ ehaomɔi lɛ aaaba, gbele kɛ awerɛhoo kɛ hɔ̃mɔ, ni akɛ la aaashã lɛ butuu, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni kojoɔ lɛ he wa."
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamaŋ ni amɛkɛ lɛ bɔ nyenyeŋtswi lɛ aaafo lɛ, ni amɛaawo yara yɛ hewɔ, be ni amɛaana eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ.
Ni amɛaakɛɛ, "Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ, Babilon, maŋ ni he wa lɛ! Ejaakɛ ŋmlɛtswaa kome mli ni okojomɔ eba nɛɛ!"
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jrayelɔi lɛ aaafo lɛ ni amɛaaye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko heee amɛguɔ nii lɛ dɔŋŋ:

shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi, ojrawatɛi kɛ adiagbai, kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaso diŋ, kɛ seda kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ kɛ tso ni jeɔ ŋma kɛ shwuɔwu nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛ tso ni wa kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ marmaratɛ fee,
kɛ sinamon kɛ mrɔŋo kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ mire kɛ ohɛ kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ shikishaŋ kɛ ŋmaa, kɛ tsinai kɛ toi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii kɛ nyɔji kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumai.
Jrayelɔi lɛ kɛɛ, "Ni yibii ni baa otsine lɛ eje odaaŋ, ni ŋɔɔmɔ nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni kplɛɔ nyeramnyeram lɛ ebɔ o, ni onaŋ amɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ."
Ni nibii nɛɛ aguɔyelɔi ni etsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ etsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ epiŋmɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛaafo ni amɛaaye ŋkɔmɔ
ni amɛaakɛɛ, "Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple ni buɔ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaso diŋ kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ, ni ewulaa kɛ shika kɛ ojrawatɛi kɛ adiagbai lɛ!

Ejaakɛ ŋmlɛtswaa kome mli lɛ nɛkɛ nifalɛ babaoo nɛɛ fɛɛ ebɔ lɛ." Ni lɛlɛ kudɔɔtsɛ fɛɛ kudɔɔtsɛ kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nyiɛɔ lɛlɛ mli kɛyaa he ko, kɛ amlãkui kɛ mɛi abɔ ni tsuɔ ŋshɔ hiɛ nii lɛ damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ,
ni be ni amɛna eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ amɛblɔ amɛkɛɛ, "Aso maŋ ko ehi shi pɛŋ ni da tamɔ maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ?

Ni amɛkɛ mlu wo amɛyiteaŋ, ni amɛkɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli bo amɛkɛɛ, "Ao! Ao! Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni emli mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ lɛji yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ eninamɔ lɛ nɔ amɛfee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ! Ejaakɛ ŋmlɛtswaa kome mli ni fɛɛ ebɔ lɛ nɛɛ!
Bo ŋwɛi, kɛ nyɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋbii kɛ bɔfoi kɛ gbalɔi, nyɛnyaa yɛ ehewɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekojo lɛ ehã nyɛ!
Ni bɔfo ni he wa wo tɛ ko ni tamɔ wiɛ wulu, ni eshɛ efɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ ni ekɛɛ, "Nɛkɛ aaatsi Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ atswa shi waa, ni anaŋ lɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ.
Ni anuŋ saŋkutswalɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ blɛkpãlɔi kɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛkpãlɔi lɛ agbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anaŋ ŋaalɔ ko ŋaalɔ ko ni le ŋaa ko kwaa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli,

Ni anaŋ kane la ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anuŋ wiɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anyŋ ayɛmfro wu kɛ ayɛmfro gbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli; ejaakɛ ojrayelɔi lɛ ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi wuji, ni okunyaayeli lɛ akɛshishiu jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ."
Ni emli ana gbalɔi kɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋbii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni agbe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ala lɛ yɛ.
19: Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, minu gbee ni wa ni tamɔ asafo babaoo gbee yɛ ŋwɛi ni miikɛɛ, "Halleluya! Yiwalaheremɔ kɛ anumnyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ ji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ!
Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji ekojomɔi lɛ, akɛni ekojo ajwamaŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni kɛ ejwamŋbɔɔ lɛ efite shikpɔŋ lɛ ni etɔ etsuji lɛ ala lɛ he owele yɛ enɔ lɛ."
Ni amɛkɛɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, "Halleluya!! Ni la ni shãa maŋ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ!"
Ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ho gbee shi ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, "Amen! Haleluya!"
Ni gbee ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, "Nyɛjiea wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, nyɛ nyɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ fɛɛ!"
Ni minu gbee ko tamɔ asafo kpeteŋkple gbee kɛ nui babaoo kɛ nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi ni naa wa agbɛɛmɔ miikɛɛ, "Haleluya! Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ miiye maŋtsɛ!"
"Nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa ni wɔmli aflia wɔ ni wɔwo ehiɛ nyam! Ejaakɛ Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ lɛ eshɛ, ni eŋa lɛ esaa ehe eto.
Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ewo klala ni hetse ni kplɛɔ nyeramnyeram." Ejaakɛ klala lɛ ji Krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ajalɛnii lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Ŋmaa, Ajɔɔ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛba Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ." Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa wiemɔi nɛ."
Ni miho migbee enaji anaa koni maja lɛ. Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kwɛ, kaafee nakai! Bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ni hiɛ Yesu odase lɛ mli lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi. Já Nyɔŋmɔ!" Ejaakɛ Yesu he odase lɛ ji gbalɛ mumɔ lɛ.
Ni mina ni agble ŋwɛi naa, ni mina okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ, ni mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Anɔkwafo kɛ Anɔkwayelɔ; ni jalɛ naa ekojoɔ ni ewuɔ ta yɛ.
Ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi, ni maŋtsɛ fai pii bumɔ eyitso, ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ he ni mɔ ko mɔ leee akɛ ja lɛ diɛŋtsɛ;
ni ewo ataade ni akɛtsɔ lá mli; ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ."
Ni tai ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tra okpɔŋɔi yɛji anɔ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛwo klala yɛŋ futaa ni he tse.
Ni tsi naa ba jɛɔ edaaŋ, koni ekɛ no atswia jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anii; ni ekɛ dadetso aaakpla amɛ. Ni eeenaanaa Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ etaade kɛ egboŋ nɔ akɛ, "Maŋtsɛmɛi a-Maŋtsɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔmɛi a-Nuŋtsɔ."
Ni mina bɔfo ko damɔ hulu mli, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ loofɔji ni flikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple lɛ he,
koni nyɛbaye maŋtsɛmɛi aloo kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi aloo kɛ hewalɔi aloo kɛ okpɔŋɔi aloo kɛ mɛi ni tra amɛnɔ lɛ aloo kɛ odehei kɛ nyɔji lɛ mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ aloo."
Ni mina kooloo lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtai lɛ ni abua amɛnaa ni amɛkɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ eta lɛ ayawu.

Ni amɔ kooloo lɛ, ni amɔ amalegbalɔ lɛ afata ehe, amalegbalɔ lɛ ni fee okadii yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛshishiu mɛi ni ŋɔ kooloo lɛ okadi lɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ. Ni aŋɔ kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ ni akɛ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ wo la kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli ni amɛhiɛ kãmɔ.
Ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ, akɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ tsi ni jɛɔ edaaŋ lɛ gbe amɛ, ni loofɔji fɛɛ ye amɛloo lɛ amɛtrɔ.
20: Ni mina bɔfo ko miikpleke shi kɛmiijɛ ŋwɛi, ni ehiɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa samfee lɛ kɛ kɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ kpeteŋkple ko yɛ edɛŋ.
Ni emɔ drako lɛ, blema onufu lɛ ni ji abonsam kɛ Satan hu lɛ, ni efi lɛ afii akpe,
ni eshɛ̃ lɛ efɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eŋa naa ni esɔo naa, koni ekashishiu jeŋmaji lɛ dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe afii akpe lɛ naa. Ni no sɛɛ lɛ ja afɛne lɛ be fioo ko.

Ni mina maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii ni mɛi ni akɛ kojomɔ ehã amɛ lɛ tra nɔ. Ni mina mɛi ni aflɔ amɛyii yɛ Yesu he odaseyeli lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ asusumai lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni jako kooloo lɛ loo emãgã lɛ ni amɛheko ekadi lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ loo amɛdɛ̃ lɛ. Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ hiɛkãalɔi ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛ Kristo ye maŋtsɛ afii akpe.
Shi gbohii ni shwɛ lɛ ahiɛ etsɛ̃ɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe afii akpe lɛ naa. Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ shitee lɛ.

Mɔ ni naa gbɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ shitee lɛ mli lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ ni mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ. Gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ nakai mɛi lɛ anɔ; moŋ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo osɔfoi, ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ afii akpe.
Ni kɛji agbe akpe lɛ naa lɛ, aaafɛne Satan kɛaajɛ tsu lɛ mli,
ni ebaaje kpo ni eyashishiu jeŋmaji lɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ, Gog kɛ Magog, koni ebua amɛnaa kɛkpe ni amɛya ta. Amɛyifalɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ naa shia.
Ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee kɛyaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛyabɔle mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ansra lɛ kɛ maŋ ni asumɔɔ lɛ kɛkpe. Ni la jɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebashã amɛ butuu.
Ni abonsam lɛ ni shishiuɔ amɛ lɛ, ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ la kɛ swɔɔ kpaakpo lɛ mli, he ni kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ hu yɔɔ lɛ, ni aaapiŋ amɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Ni mina maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i yeŋ ko ni da, kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi jo foi yɛ ehiɛ, ni amɛbɛ gbɛhe dɔŋŋ.

Ni mina gbohii lɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji, damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, ni agble woji anaa; ni agble wolo kroko ni ji wala wolo lɛ hu naa. Ni adamɔ nibii ni aŋmla yɛ woji lɛ amli lɛ anɔ akojo gbohii lɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Ni ŋshɔ jie gbohii ni yɔɔ emli lɛ ehã, ni gbele kɛ gbohiiaje hu jie gbohii ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ amɛhã; ni akojo amɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Ni gbele kɛ gbohiiaje lɛ, ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie la kpaakpo lɛ mli. Enɛ ji gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
Ni kɛjɛi mɔ ko yɛ ni anãaa akɛ aŋma egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ, ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ la kpaakpo lɛ mli.
21: Ni mina ŋwɛi hee lɛ shikpɔŋ hee; ejaakɛ tsutsu ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ tsutsu shikpɔŋ lɛ eho etee, ni ŋshɔ bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni mina Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ji Yerusalem hee lɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi miikpleke shi, ni asaa lɛ ato tamɔ ayɛmfro ni awula lɛ ahã ewu.
Ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, "Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ shishilɛhe lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni eeehi shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ emaŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛ aaahi shi.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yafonui fɛɛ. Gbele bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni ŋkɔmɔyeli loo blɔmɔ loo nɔnaa ko hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ tsutsunii lɛ eho etee."
Ni mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɛ, "Naa, miifee nii fɛɛ ehee." Ni nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli."
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Agbe naa. Miji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ. Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, mahã lɛ wala nubu lɛ mli nu lɛ eko yaka.
Kunimyelɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yelɔ, ni matsɛ e-Nyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ hu eeetsɔ̃ mibi.

Shi gbeyelɔi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi kɛ ajwamaŋbɔlɔi kɛ sulɔi kɛ wɔŋjalɔi kɛ amalelɔi fɛɛ lɛ, amɛna amɛgbɛhe yɛ kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ la kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli. Enɛ ji gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ."
Ni bɔfoi kpawo ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ naagbee haomɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba miŋɔɔ ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, "Ba, ni matsɔ̃ o ayɛmfro lɛ ni ji Toobi lɛ ŋa lɛ."
Ni eŋɔ mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee gɔŋ kple ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi maŋ kpeteŋkple ni ji Yerusalem krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi eekpleke shi,
ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ ni ekpɛɔ tamɔ tɛ ni jra wa waa, tamɔ yaspi ni mli tse akɛ kristalo.
Eyɛ gbogbo kpeteŋkple ni kwɔ kɛ agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ damɔ agboi lɛ anaa, ni aŋmla gbɛii ni ji Israelbii lɛ akutsei nyɔŋmɔ kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ nɔ.
Agboi etɛ̃ yɛ bokagbɛ ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ kooyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ anaigbɛ.
Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ yɛ fanesii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni Toobi lɛ bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛnɔ.
Ni bɔfo ni kɛ mi wie hiɛ shika susumɔtso koni ekɛsusu maŋ lɛ kɛ egboi lɛ kɛ egbogbo lɛ.
Ni maŋ lɛ kã shi koji ejwɛ, ni ekɛlɛ tamɔ elɛɛmɔ nɔŋŋ. Ni ekɛ susumɔtso lɛ susu maŋ lɛ, ni efee shitoi akpe kome kɛ ohai enumɔ. Ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ kɛ ekwɔlɛ ye egbɔ.
Ni esusu egbogbo lɛ efee ninetalɔi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ nisusumɔtso naa, ni ji bɔfo lɛ tso lɛ.
Ni nɔ ni akɛtswa gbogbo lɛ ji yaspi, ni maŋ lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmii ni tamɔ ashwishwɛ krɔŋŋ ni.
Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ fanesii lɛ awula amɛ kɛ tɛi ni jra wa srɔtoi fɛɛ. Klɛŋklɛŋ fanesi lɛ yaspi, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ safiro, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kalkedɔn, nɔ ni ji ejwɛ Ɛmaragbo,

nɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ sardonike, nɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ sardio, nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ krisolito, nɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ berilo, nɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ topasion, nɔ hi ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ hiakinto, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ametisto.
Ni agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ adiagbai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni, agbo kome lɛ adiagba kome akɛfee. Ni maŋ lɛ blohu lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni, ni emli blohu lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni, ni emli tse tamɔ ashwishwɛ.
Ni minaaa sɔlemɔtsu yɛ mli, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ ji e-Sɔlemɔtsu.
Ni hulu loo nyɔŋtsere kpɛmɔ he ehīaaa maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anumyam lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ mli, ni Toobi lɛ ji ela.
Ni jeŋmaji lɛ aaanyiɛ yɛ ela lɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aaaŋɔ amɛnumnyam lɛ kɛaaba mli.
Ni egboi lɛ aŋamɔŋ kwraa shwane, ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi.
Ni akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anumnyam lɛ kɛ amɛwoo lɛ aaaba mli.
Ni nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ mɔ ni maleɔ boteŋ mli kwraa akɛ ja mɛi ni aŋma amɛgbɛi yɛ Toobi lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɛkɛ.
22: Ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi walanu faa ni hiɛ kplɛɔ tamɔ kristalo ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli.
Ni eblohu lɛ teŋ kɛ faa lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ walatso ma shi, ni ewoɔ yibii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ekome nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ, ni tso lɛ yibai lɛ akɛtsaa jeŋmaji lɛ.
Ni musu ko musu ko bɛ dɔŋŋ. Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ aaama maŋ lɛ mli; ni etsuji lɛ aaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ;
ni amɛaana ehiɛ, ni egbɛi lɛ aaahi amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ.
Ni nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi, ni kane la loo hulu la he ehiaŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatso ahã amɛ, ni amɛaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Wiemɔ nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli. Ni Nuŋtsɔ ni ji gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsu ebɔfo lɛ ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ etsuji nii ni sa akɛ aba nɔŋŋ."
"Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ. Ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ."
Ni mi, Yohane, ji mɔ ni nu ni na nii nɛɛ. Ni be ni minu ni mina lɛ miho mibu shi ni maja yɛ bɔfo lɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii nɛɛ lɛ naji anaa.
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kwɛ, kaafee nakai! Ejaakɛ bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi. Já Nyɔŋmɔ!"
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Kaasɔo nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.
Mɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, eya nɔ efee nii ni ejaaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji muji lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji jalɔ lɛ, eya nɔ efee jalɛnii, ni mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eya nɔ ehi krɔŋkrɔŋ."
"Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ, ni mihiɛ minyɔmɔwo lɛ kɛmiiba, ni mawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni sa enitsumɔ lɛ.
Miji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ."
Ajɔɔ mɛi fɔɔ amɛtaadei lɛ ahe, koni amɛna hegbɛ yɛ walatso lɛ he ní amɛna hegbɛ yɛ walatso lɛ he ní amɛtsɔ̃ agboi lɛ amli kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi maŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbei lɛ kɛ sulɔi lɛ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔlɔi lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi lɛ kɛ amãgãjalɔi lɛ kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ amale ni emaleɔ yɔɔ jɛi.
"Mi yesu, mitsu mibɔfo lɛ koni ebaya nii nɛɛ ahe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ amli. Miji David shishifã lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ, toloo ni kpɛɔ lɛ."
Ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛ Ayɛmfro lɛ keɔ akɛ, "Ba!" Ni mɔ ni nuɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, "Ba!" Ni mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, eba, ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ lɛ, ebahe wala nu lɛ yaka.
Mi miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fata nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ haomɔi ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ afata he ahã lɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko jie nɔ ko kɛjɛ nɛkɛ gbalɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie egbɛnaa kɛaaje wala wolo lɛ kɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nii ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ amli.
Mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ he odase lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, 'Hɛɛ, miiba nɔŋŋ!'" Amen! Ba, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu!
Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen!

1: Wolo nɛɛ jɛ mi Paulo, Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ bɔfo ni aatsɛ lɛ ni ajie lɛ ato ahã Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ, dɛŋ.
Sanekpakpa nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ewo he shi eto momo yɛ egbalɔi lɛ anaa yɛ ŋmalɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli,
Sanekpakpa nɛɛ kɔɔ e-Bi lɛ, mɔ ni yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ ajɛ David shwiei lɛ mli afɔ lɛ lɛ, he.
E-Bi nɛɛ hetsemɔ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, atsɔ̃ gbohiiashitee lɛ nɔ ajie lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ hewalɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Bi ni ji Yesu Kristo wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Enɔ mitsɔ̃ mina dromɔ kɛ bɔfo nitsumɔ koni mihã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ abo hemɔkɛyeli lɛ toi, yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Jeŋmaji nɛɛ ateŋ nyɛ Romanbii hu nyɛyɔɔ. Nyɛ mɛi ni atsɛ akɛ nyɛbafee Yesu Kristo mɛi kɛ.
Miiŋma nyɛ mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ ni etsɛ nyɛ ni nyɛji mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Roma lɛ fɛɛ, dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔ-Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, miitsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ miida mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhewɔ, akɛ agbaa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ he sane yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ midasefonyo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ yɛ mimumɔ mli yɛ e-Bi lɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ mli lɛ, akɛ mifɔ̃ko nyɛ kaimɔ dã,
ni mikpaa fai daa yɛ misɔlemɔi amli, akɛ aleenɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ lo.
Ejaakɛ miishwe akɛ maana nyɛ,. koni mikɛ mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii lɛ eko abahã nyɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akɛwaje nyɛ,
no ji akɛ, atsɔ̃ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli bɔ ashɛje mimii, ni atsɔ̃ mi hu minɔ lɛ nɔ ashɛje nyɛmii.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ mifɔɔ miyiŋtoo akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, koni mibana yibii komɛi yɛ nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ, tamɔ mina yɛ jeŋmaji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Mihiɛ Helabii kɛ jekɔ̃ji, nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni leeee nii fɛɛ anyɔmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ miishwɛ akɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Roma lɛ hu, mabajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ mihiɛ gbooo Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ he, ejaakɛ eji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛhereɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ yiwala, Yudanyo lɛ tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu.
Ejaakɛ no mli ajieɔ nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kpo yɛ, kɛjɛɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli kɛyaa hemɔkɛyeli mli, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Shi jalɔ ni tsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala."
Ejaakɛ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kpo kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi kɛbaa gbɔmɛi ni kɛ nishaianii tsīɔ anɔkwale lɛ gbɛ lɛ amusubɔɔ kɛ nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ nɔ,
akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ he nii ni aaanyɛ ale lɛ yɛ faŋŋ hã amɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejie etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ.,
Ejaakɛ ehe nii ni anaaa ni ji enaanɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɔmɔ ni eji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ mli beebe lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ enii ni efee lɛ anɔ ayɔseɔ ni anaa faŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ amɛbɛ naajiemɔ ko;
ejaakɛ amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ, shi amɛwoooo ehiɛ nyam akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛdaaa lɛ shi hu, shi amɛfee shwɛm yɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi amli, ni amɛtsui ni kɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ ewo duŋ.,
Amɛtsɛ amɛhe nilelɔi, shi amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kwashiai,
ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni gbooo lɛ anumnyam lɛ amɛtsake amɛhã gbɔmɔ ni gboɔ lɛ subaŋ henɔ ko kɛ loofɔji kɛ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛtsɛmɛi kɛ waamɔnii anɔ.
No hewɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã muji nitsumɔi yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɔnɔi lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshwie lɛ ahiɛ shi yɛ amɛteaŋ,
Amɛŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ amɛtsakeɔ amale, ni amɛjaa ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ bɔɔnɔ lɛ yɛ bɔlɔ lɛ najiaŋ, bɔlɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ! Amen.
Enɛ hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã hiɛgbejianii ahe hiɛdɔɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ adebɔɔ naanyobɔɔ ni ato lɛ, amɛyei lɛ etsake hiɛ ehã nɔ ni kɛ adebɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo eyaaa;
ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛhii lɛ hu eshi amɛyei lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ akɔnɔ ni naa wa nyiɛɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe sɛɛ, ni hii kɛ hii tsuɔ hiɛgbejianii, ni amɛna amɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ he nyɔmɔwo ni sa yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmli.
Ni akɛni amɛbuuu akɛ esa akɛ amɛleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã jwɛŋmɔ ni esaaa koni amɛfeee nibii ni esaaa;
mɛi ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ fɛɛ, efɔŋfeemɔ, hiɛjoomɔ, nifɔ̃ɔjianii; amɛyimɔ tɔ kɛ hetsɛ, awuyeli, bei, shishiumɔ, nyɛɛ;
amɛyeɔ amɛhe osheku, NyɔŋmɔyelɔI, mɛi ni hiɛ esɔɔɔ mɔ, hetsɔ̃ɔlɔi, shwãlɔi, nɔfɔŋheŋaatsɔlɔi, fɔlɔianɔtoigbolɔi,
mɛi ni bɛ hinilee, kpãŋmɔ mli enaaa mɔbɔ.
Amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ krɛdɛɛnɛ, akɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ sa gbele, shsi kɛ̃lɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ amɛfeɔ, shi moŋ amɛnaa mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ ahe miishɛɛ hu.
2: No hewɔ lɛ, bo, mɔ Fɛɛ mɔ ni kojoɔ lɛ, obɛ naajiemɔ ko; ejaakɛ be mlini okojoɔ mɔ kroko lɛ, oobu bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe fɔ; ejaakɛ bo ni okojoɔ lɛ otsuɔ nakai nii lɛ nɔŋŋ.
SHi wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ ni baa mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ anɔ lɛ ja.
Bo gbɔmɔ ni okojoɔ mɛi ni tsuɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ni ofeɔ nakai nɔŋŋ lɛ, ani osusuɔ akɛ bo lɛ ohe aaaje Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ lɛ mli?
Aloo obuuu emlihilɛ kɛ eyishiŋmɛɛ kɛ etsuishitoo babaoo lɛ, ni oleee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ lɛ gbɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo Kɛya tsuitsakemɔ mli?
Shi okɛ otsuiwalɛ kɛ ohe ni oshwaaa lɛ miitīa mlifu naa ohã ohe oto Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbi lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni ebaatsɔ̃ ejie ejalɛ kojomɔ lɛ kpo lɛ;
lɛ ebaawomɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔ̃mɔ bɔ ni sa enitsumɔi lɛ;
mɛi ni kɛ tsuihiŋmɛɛ hiɛɔ ekpakpafeemɔ mli ni amɛtaoɔ anumnyam kɛ woo kɛ shihilɛ ni fiteŋ lɛ, eeehã amɛ naanɔ wala;
shi mɛi ni sumɔɔ bei ni amɛbooo anɔKwale lɛ toi, shi amɛboɔ nii ni ejaaa moŋ toi lɛ, shi amɛnɔ ji mlifu kɛ mlila.
Amanehulu kɛ hejramɔ aaaba gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ susuma nɔ, Yudanyo tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu;
shi anumnyam kɛ woo kɛ hejɔlɛ aaaba mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nikpakpai anii lɛ nɔ, Yudanyo tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni bɛ Mla lɛ ni amɛfee esha lɛ amɛaalaaje akɛ mɛi ni bɛ Mla; ni mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ Mla lɛ shishi ni amɛfee esha lɛ, Mla lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛaakojo amɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeee Mla lɛ nulɔi ji jalɔi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, shi moŋ Mla lɛ nɔyelɔi ji mɛi ni aaabu amɛ akɛ jalɔi.
Ejaakɛ kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni bɛ Mla lɛ kɛ amɛfɔmɔŋ su lɛ tsuɔ Mla lɛ naanii lɛ, amɛ ni amɛbɛ Mla lɛ amɛji Mla hã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe.
Amɛnifeemɔniii tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ aŋma Mla lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ amɛtsuii amli, ni amɛhenilee hu yeɔ odase, ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ flɔɔ amɛnaa kɛ amɛfee nɔ ni ehiii aloo ejieɔ amɛnaa kɛ amɛfee nɔ ni hi.
Enɛ baaba mli gbi nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ akojo gbɔmɛi ateemɔŋnii lɛ yɛ misanekpakpa lɛ naa lɛ.
Shi kɛji bo lɛ atsɛɔ bo Yudanyo, ni okɛ ohe fɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ nɔ, ni oshwãa ofɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ,
ni ole esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, ni ole nii ni hi, ejaakɛ ajɛ Mla lɛ mli atsɔ̃ɔ bo,
ni obuɔ ohe akɛ oji shwilafoi agbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ mli lɛ ala,
kɛ mɛi ni leee nii atsɔselɔ kɛ abifaibii atsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ejakaɛ oyɛ nilee kɛ anɔkwale he mfoniri kɛjɛ Mla lɛ mli,
bo ni otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi anii lɛ, otsɔ̃ɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe nii? Oshiɛɔ akɛ akaju, shi ojuɔ;
Okɛɔ akɛ akafite gblã, shi ofiteɔ gblã; ohiɔ amãgãia, shi ojuɔ Sɔlemɔwe lɛ nii.
Bo ni okɛ Mla lɛ shwãa lɛ okɛ Mla lɛ nɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ lɛ gbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he guɔ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, "Nyɛhewɔ lɛ awieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔi yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ."
Shi kɛ oyeɔ Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, kulɛ ketiafoo he yɛ Sɛɛnamɔ; shi kɛ ofee ohe Mla lɛ nɔ̃tɔ̃lɔ lɛ, oketiafoo lɛ etsɔ̃ foo.
SHi kɛji foolɔ lɛ yeɔ Mla Lɛ agbɛnai lɛ anɔ lɛ, ani ebuŋ efoo lɛ akɛ ketiafoo?
Ni heloo gbɛfaŋ foolɔ lɛ ni yeɔ Mla lɛ nɔ lŋ, aaakojo bo ni ohiɛ Mla ni aŋma lɛ ni afo o ketia hu ni ofee ohe mlatɔ̃lɔ lɛ/.
Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni anaa lɛ yɛ kponɔgbɛ akɛ Yudanyo doo ji Yudanyo,. ni asaŋ jeee nɔ ni anaa yɛ kponɔgbɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso he ji ketiafoo;m
shi moŋ mɔ ni ji Yudanyo yɛ mligbɛ lɛ ji Yudanyo, ni tsui mli ketiafoo ji nɔ ni atsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ n afo, shi jeee Mla lɛ nɔ, ni enijiemɔ lɛ jɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛɔ.
3: Belɛ agbɛnɛ, mɛni Yudanyo kɛfe mɛi krokomɛi mɔ? Aloo mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ ketiafoo mli?
Efa yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ. Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji akɛ atu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ awo amɛdɛŋ.
Shi kɛ mɛi komɛi heee yeee lɛ, mɛni? Ani he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ aaahã Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwayeli lɛ afee yaka?
Dabida! Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ amalelɔ po, lɛ lɛ ja efee anɔkwafo tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Bɔ ni afee ji ana akɛ osane ja yɛ owiemɔi lɛ amli, ni oye kunim yɛ okojomɔ lɛ mli."
Shi kɛji wɔja ni wɔjaaa lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ =, te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Aso Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ejaaa kɛji emlifu na wɔnɔ lɛ? (Miiwie akɛ gbɔmɔ).
Dabida! Ejaakɛ kɛji nakai ni lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaaakojo je lɛ?
Shi kɛ mimalemɔ lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ faa kɛtekeɔ nɔ hã enumnyam lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni akã he akojoɔ mi akɛ eshafeelɔ?
Ani jeee tamɔ bɔ ni afoɔ sane afɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ yɛ wɔhe akɛ wɔkɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛhãa wɔfea efɔŋ koni ekpakpa aba" Lɛ? Nakai mɛi lɛ afɔbuu lɛ ja pɛ.
Belɛ mɛni? Ani wɔ Yudafoi wɔhi fe mɛi krokomɛi. Jeee nakai kwraa; ejaakɛ wɔflo Yudafoi kɛ Helabii fɛɛ anaa momo akɛ amɛfɛɛ amɛyɛ esha shishi,
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Jalɔ ko bɛ, mɔ kome flo bɛ;
nilelɔ ko bɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ taoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛgba afã, amɛ blublu amɛhiii amɛhãaa nɔ ko; Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ ekpakpa, mɔ kome flo bɛ.
Gbonyobu ni agble naa ji amɛsɛ̃ lɛ; amɛkɛ amɛlilɛii shishiuɔ mɔ, shikpãi anaa ebɔɔ yɛ amɛnaabu.
Loomɔ kɛ joomɔ eyi amɛdaaŋ obɔ̃.
Amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ lâshishwiemɔ;
Ni hejɔlɛ gbɛ lɛ amɛleee.
Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ ko bɛ amɛhiɛ."
Shi agbɛnɛ wɔle akɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Mla lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla lɛ shishi lɛ ekɛwieɔ, koni mɔ ko mɔ ko akana naabu, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aye fɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ adamɔŋ Mla lɛ nitsumɔ nɔ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem yɛ ehiɛ; ejaakɛ Mla nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ aleɔ nɔ ni ji esha .
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ashi Mla lɛ sɛɛ ajie Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ kpo faŋŋ, ni no he odase Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yeɔ;
no ji Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ i heɔ yeɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ srɔto ko bɛ;
ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ efee esha, ni Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ ebɔ amɛ,
ni akɛ edromɔ lɛ buɔ amɛ bem yaka kɛtsɔ̃ɔ kpɔ̃mɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ nɔ.
Lɛji mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jie to akɛ kpãtãmɔ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ elâ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ koni ekɛjie ejalɛ lɛ kpo, yɛ ehiɛ ni eku efɔ̃ eshai ni afee sa lɛ anɔ yɛ etsuishiŋmɛɛ mli lɛ hewɔ;
koni ejie ejalɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ benɛ be nɛɛ mli, ni eye bem ni ebu mɔ ni heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ lɛ hu bem.
Agbɛnɛ mɛni nɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ? Nɔ ko bɛ. Mɛɛ Mla nɔ atsɔ̃? Nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ nɔ lo? Dabi, shi hemɔkɛyeli mla lɛ nɔ moŋ atsɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ wɔbuɔ akɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ abua gbɔmɔ bem, shi jeee Mla nitsumɔi anɔ.
Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Yudafoi kɛkɛ a-Nyɔŋmɔ ni? Ani jeee jeŋmaji lɛ hu a-Nyɔŋmɔ ni? Hɛɛ, jeŋmaji lɛ hu a-Nyɔŋmɔ
akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome ni, ni hemɔkɛyeli naa ebuɔ foo bem lɛ.
Belɛ wɔmiitsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ wɔhã Mla lɛ afee yaka lo? Dabida, shi wɔkɛmiima Mla lɛ nɔ mi moŋ.
4: Belɛ mɛni wɔkɛɛ akɛ Abraham ni ji wɔtsɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ na mɔ?
Kɛ nitsumɔi anɔ adãmɔ abu lɛ bem lɛ, kulɛ eyɛ shwãa nɔ, shi belɛ jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ te ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ tɛŋŋ? "Ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ."
Mɔ ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, abuuu enyɔmɔwo lɛ akɛ dromɔ nɔ ko, shi moŋ akɛ egbɛna nɔ ko.
Shi mɔ ni jeee nii etsuɔ, shi eheɔ mɔ ni buɔ eshafeelɔ bem lɛ nɔ ayeɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ akɛ jalɛ ehãa lɛ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni David hu kɛɔ akɛ ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ shīɔ nitsumɔi asɛɛ ebuɔ lɛ jalɔ lɛ,
"Ajɔɔ mɛ ni akɛ amɛmlatɔ̃mɔi lɛ efa amɛ, ni atsimɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Ajaɔɔ nuu ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ebuuu ehe esha lɛ ehãaa lɛ lɛ."
Agbɛnɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ, mɛi ni afo amɛ ketia kɛkɛ anɔ ni, aloo foolɔi lɛ hu anɔ̃ŋ? Ejaakɛ wɔkɛɔ akɛ abu hemɔkɛyeli lɛ akɛ jalɛ ahã Abraham.
Agbɛnɛ te abu lɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ tɛŋŋ? Be ni afo lɛ ketia lɛ aloo be mli ni afoko lɛ ketia lɛ? Jeee be mli ni afo lɛ ketia, shi moŋ be ni eji foolɔ lɛ.

Ni enine shɛ ketiafoo okadi lɛ nɔ akɛ jalɛ naasɔomɔnɔ ni akɛsoɔ ehemɔkɛyeli ni ena be mli ni eji fɔɔlɔ beebe lɛ naa, ni efee mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ be ni maɛji foolɔi lɛ atsɛ, ni ebu hemɔkɛyeli ahã amɛ hu akɛ jalɛ;
ni asaŋ efee ketiafolɔii atsɛ hu ehã mɛi ni amɛjeee ketiafolɔi kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɔ wɔtsɛ Abraham, mɔ ni he ye be mli ni eji foolɔ beebe lɛ, nane.
Ejaakɛ jeee Mla nɔ ni Abraham ye hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ loo eshwiei ashi akɛ je lɛ aaatsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, shi moŋ akɛni ehe eye ni Nyɔŋmɔ bu lɛ akɛ jalɔ lɛ hewɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ Mla shishibii lɛ ji niyelɔi lɛ, belɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ efee yaka, ni shiwoo lɛ hu he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mla lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa, shi he ni mla bɛ lɛ, mlatɔ̃mɔ hu bɛ.

Enɛ hewɔ ejɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni shiwoo lɛ afee dromɔ sane, ni ama shi shiŋŋ ahã eshwiei lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeee Mla shishibii lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni jɛ Abraham, ni ji wɔ fɛɛ wɔtsɛ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ hu;
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Mikɛ o efee jeŋmaji pii atsɛ" yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ehe eye lɛ hiɛ, mɔ hu ni atsɛ̃ɔ gbohii ahiɛ, ni etsɛɔ nibii ni bɛ lɛ kɛbaa tamɔ nɔ ni amɛyɛ momo lɛ.
Ni he kulɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko bɛ lɛ, ena hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ he ni ehe eye, mɔni etsɔ̃ jeŋmaji pii atsɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Nakai oshwieo lɛ aaatamɔ."
Ni ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɔjɔɔɔ, ni ejwɛŋŋ lɛ diɛŋTsɛ ebbɔmmɔtso gbo ni egbo momo, akɛni eye aaafee afii pha lɛ, kɛ Sara fɔ ni efɔɔɔ kɛ he;
ni eyiŋ efeee lɛ kɔshikɔshi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo lɛ he tamɔ akɛ eheeee eyeee shi moŋ en ahewalɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyma,
ni eyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ jogbaŋŋ akɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo he shi lɛ, eeenyɛ efee hu.
No hewɔ hu ni abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ.
Shi jeee lɛ kɛkɛ ehewɔ aŋma akɛ "abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ" lɛ,
shi moŋ wɔ mɛi ni abaabu ahã wɔ lɛ hu hewɔ, wɔ mɛi ni wɔheɔ mɔ ni tee wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shhi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ;
shi akɛ hã yɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ yɛ wɔbembuu hewɔ.
5: Agbɛnɛ akɛni adamɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem hewɔ lɛ, wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ yɛ hejɔlɛ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ.
Lɛ enɔ wɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ena gbɛ hu kɛna dromɔ ni wɔyɔɔ mli nɛɛ mli, ni wɔnyaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ wɔnyaa yɛ amanehului amli hu, ejaakɛ yɛ amanehului amli hu, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ amanehulu lɛ tsɛɔ hiɛmiamɔ kɛbaa,
ni hiɛmiamɔ tsɛɔ su ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛbaa; ni su nɛɛ tsɛɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛbaa;
ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeee eflo; ejaakɛ atsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ nɔ afɔse Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ awo wɔtsuii amli.
Ejaakɛ be ni mli ni wɔhe waaa lɛ beebe Kristo bagbo yɛ be ni sa mli eha6 mɛi ni efeee Nyɔŋm suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ekpakpa ko dani mɔ ko aaagbo ahã jalɔ ko; ni mɔ kpakpa ko hewɔ lɛ, ekolɛ mɔ ko aashi etsitsi akɛ eeegbo.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ, akɛ be mli ni wɔji eshafeelɔi lɛ beebe ni Kristo bagbo yɛ wɔnajiaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ ni abu wɔ bem yɛ elá lɛ hewɔ lɛ, aaatsɔ̃ enɛ ahere wɔyiwala kɛjɛ mlifu lɛ mli aahu.
Ejaakɛ kɛ be mli ni wɔji henyiɛlɔi lɛ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbele lɛ bakpãtã wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni akpãtã wɔteŋ nɛɛ, aaahere wɔyiwala yɛ ewala lɛ mli aahuu.
Shi jeee no kɛkɛ, shi asaŋ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hu yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, mɔ nɔ mi tsɔ̃ ni agbɛnɛ wɔna kpãtãmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ, gbɔmɔ kome nɔ esha tsɔ̃ kɛba je lɛ mli, ni gbele tsɔ̃ esha nɔ kɛba. Bɔ ni fee nɛ ni gble lɛ tsɛŋe gbɔmɛI fɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee esha lɛ.
Esha yɛ jeŋ dani ahã Mla lɛ; shi akɛni mla bɛ hewɔ lɛ, abuuu esha lɛ he akɔŋtaa.
Kɛ̃lɛ gbele lɛ ye maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Adam yinɔ kɛbashi Mose yinɔ yɛ mɛi po ni efeko esha ni tamɔ Adam nɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ lɛ anɔ, Adam ni ji mɔ ni baaba lɛ mfoniri lɛ.

Shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ shigbeemɔnɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ, kɛ mɔ kome lɛ shigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ ni mɛi pii lɛ gboi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ kɛ nɔkeenɔ ni tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ dromɔ nɔ ba lɛ fã kɛteke nɔ hã mɛi pii lɛ aahuu.
Ni srɔto yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔKeenɔ lɛ kɛ esha ni tsɔ̃ mɔ kome nɔ kɛba lɛ mli; ejaakɛ mɔ kome he esha ni akojo lɛ, ehebuamɔ lɛ fɛɛ fɔbuu; shi dromɔ ni jɛ mɛi pii anɔtɔ̃mɔ mli lɛ tsɔ̃ bembuu.

Ejaakɛ mɔ mɔ kome shigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ jɛ ni gbele tsɔ̃ nakai mɔ kome lɛ nɔ ye maŋtsɛ lɛ, belɛmɛi ni ena dromɔ kɛ jalkɛ nɔkeenɔ ni fa kɛteke nɔ lɛ aatsɔ mɔ kome ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ aye maŋtsɛ yɛ wala mli aahuu.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ mɔ kome ashigbeemɔ nɔ abu gbɔmɛi fɛɛ fɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ atsɔ̃ mɔ kome jalɛ nɔ abu gbɔmɛi fɛɛ awala bem
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ gBɔmɔ kome lɛ toigbele lɛ nɔ ahã mɛi pii tsɔmɔ eshafeelɔi lɛ, nakai lɛ nɔ ahã mɛi pii hua tsɔ̃mɔ jalɔi.
Shi Mla lɛ babote mli koni nɔtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa kɛteke nɔ. Shi he ni esha fa yɛ lɛ, dromɔ lɛ fa kɛteke nɔ yɛ jɛi,
koni bɔ nɔŋŋ ni esha lɛ ye maŋtsɛ yɛ gbele mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ dromɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ jalɛ nɔ aye maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ wala mli yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, hewɔ.
6: Belɛ te wɔɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Aso wɔkã he wɔhi esha lɛ mli, koni dromɔ lɛ afa?
dabida! Wɔ ni esha gbɛfaŋ lɛ w_tamɔ mɛi ni egboi lɛ, te aaaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔhiɛ aaakãmɔ yɛ emli loloŋ?
Aloo nyɛleee akɛ wɔTeŋ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi wɔ awo Kristo Yesui mli lɛ, egbele lɛ mli abaptisi wɔ awo?
No hewɔ lɛ akɛ baptisimɔ ni abaptisi wɔ egbele lɛ mli lɛ afu wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ, koni tamɔ bɔ ni atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ anumnyam naa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔɔnyiɛ yɛ wala hee mli.
Ejaakɛ kɛji wɔ kɛ lɛ efee ekome yɛ egbele lɛ henɔ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ aaafee ekome yɛ eshitee lɛ nɔ lɛ mli hu;
Ejaakɛ wɔle enɛ akɛ asɛŋ wɔgbɔmɔ momo lɛ kɛ lɛ, koni esha gbɔmɔtso Lɛ hiɛ akpãtã ni wɔkasɔ̃mɔ esha lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni egbo lɛ, eye ehe yɛ esha dɛŋ.
Shi kɛ wɔ Kɛ Kristo gbo lɛ, wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ aaana wala hu,
ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ ni atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ nɛɛ, egboŋ dɔŋŋ; gbele naŋ enɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ ni egbo lɛ, esha hewɔ egbo, shi kome pɛ; shi ni ehiɛ kã nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ehiɛ kã ehã,
Nakai nyɛ hu nyɛbua nyɛhe akɛ mɛi ni egboi yɛ eshɛ gbɛfaŋ ni amɛhiɛ kãmɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkãhãaa esha miiyea nyɛgbɔmɔtso ni baagbo lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni nyɛbo lɛ toi yɛ ekɔnɔi lɛ amli;
ni asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ akahãa esha akɛ esha lɛ tawuunii; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ mɛi ni hiɛ etsɛ̃ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ afea jalɛ tawunii nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ esha naŋ nyɛnɔ hewalɛ, ejaakɛ jeee Mla shishi nyɛyɔɔ, shi moŋ dromɔ shishi nyɛyɔɔ.
Belɛ mɛni? Aso wɔfee esha akɛni wɔbɛ mla shishi shi dromɔ moŋ shishi wɔyɔɔ lɛ? Dabida!

Ani nyɛleee akɛ, mɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe feɔ tsuji nyɛhãa ni nyɛboɔ lɛ toi lɛ, nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ni nyɛboɔ lɛ toi lɛ tsui ji nyɛ; eshani kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ tsuji jio, alooo toiboo ni kɛ mɔ yaa jalɛ mli lɛ tsuji jio?
Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ kulɛ sa lɛ esah tsuji ji nyɛ, shi agbɛnɛ nyɛjɛ nyɛtsui fiaa mli nyɛbo nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛ nyɛ ewo mli nɛɛ toi.
Ni akɛni akpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ esha dɛŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ jalɛ tsuji.

Miiwie akɛ gbɔmɔ yɛ nyɛgbedemɔ ni jɛ gbɔmɔtɔmɔ su mli lɛ hewɔ. Tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ fee tsuji nyɛhã nyaŋemɔ nii kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ koni nyɛkɛtɔ̃ Mla lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ agbɛnɛ nɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ afea jalɛ tsuji ahãa krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ.
Be ni nyɛji esha tsuji lɛ, nyɛye nyɛhe kɛjɛ jalɛ dɛŋ.
Ni mɛni nyɛna kɛjɛ mli yɛ nakai be lɛ mli? Yibii ni nyɛhiɛ egboi yɛ he agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi anaagbee ji gbele.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, ni akpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ esha dɛŋ ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji nɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛnaa kɛjɛɔ mli ji krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ, ni enaagbee ji naanɔ wala.
Ejaakɛ esha dɛŋ nyɔmɔwo lɛ gbele ni; shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenɔ lɛ naanɔ walaŋ yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli
7: Aloo nyɛleee, anyɛmimɛi, mɛi ni le Mla mikɛwieɔ nɛɛ, akɛ Mla lɛ yeɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ be mli ni eyɔɔ wala mli lɛ kɛkɛ?
Tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ yoo ni yɔɔ wu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ewu lɛ hiɛ kã lɛ, mla efi lɛ ekpɛtɛ ewu lɛ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo Lɛ, ekɛ ewu mla lɛ bɛ sane ko dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ewu lɛ yɛ jeŋ lolo, ni eyagbãmɔ kroko lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ gblãfitelɔ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, eye ehe jɛkɛ mla lɛ dɛŋ, ni kɛ eyagbã nuu kroko lɛ, ejeee gblãfitelɔ dɔŋŋ.
Minyɛmimɛi, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu atsɔ̃ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ nɔ ahã nyɛgboi yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɔ kroko ni ji mɔ ni atee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nii, koni wɔwo yibii wɔhã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ be ni wɔhi shi yɛ wɔgbɔmɔfɔmɔ su lɛ naa lɛ, eshai ahe akɔnɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ nɔ tsuɔ nii hyɛ wɔhenii lɛ amli ni wɔkɛwo yibii wɔhã gbele.
Shi agbɛnɛ wɔkɛ Mla lɛ bɛ sane ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbohii yɛ nɔ ni fi wɔ kpɛŋŋ lɛ gabɛfaŋ, bɔ ni afee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔ yɛ mumɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee mli, shi jeee yɛ gbɛ momo lɛ ni ji Mla ni aŋma lɛ nɔ.

Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Aso Mla lɛ esha ni? Dabida! SHi moŋ jeee Mla lɛ hewɔŋ kulɛ mileee esha; ejaakɛ kulɛ mileee nɔ ni ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, kɛjeee Mla lɛ kɛɛ akɛ,m "Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ɔ, kɛjeee Mla lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nii anɔ."
Shi esha lɛ tsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ ena hegbɛ ni eteɔ akɔnɔi fɛɛ ashi yɛ mimli; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla bɛ lɛ esha u egbo.
Shi mihi shi pɛŋ ni mibɛ mla; shi be ni kitã lɛ ba lɛ, esha lɛ, esha lɛ hiɛ tsɛ ekoŋŋ;
Shi mi lɛ migbo; ni mina akɛ kitã lɛ ni akɛhã mi yɛ wala hewɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɛ gbele ehã mi.
Ejaakɛ eshe lɛ na hegbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ eshishiu mi, ni ekɛ no nɔŋŋ gbe mi.
Hewɔ lɛ Mla lɛ yɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni kitã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni eja ni ehi hu.
Aso belɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele ehã mi lo? dabida! Shi moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni esha lɛ aje shi akɛ esha; ni ekɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ nɔŋŋ tsɛ gbele ehã ni, koni esha lɛ atsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ esha kɛteke nɔ.
Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ mumɔŋ nɔ ni; shi mi lɛ heloo gbɔmɔ ji mi, ni ahɔ̃ɔ mi awo esha shishi.
Shi nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ mileee, ejaakɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔ lɛ, jeee no mifeɔ, shi nɔ ni mihiɔ moŋ lɛ, no mifeɔ.
Shi kɛ nɔ ni musumɔɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ mikplɛ̃ɔ akɛ Mla lɛ hi.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni hiɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ mimli, no ji migbɔmɔ su lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ko kpakpa ko bɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ lɛ miyɛ eko moŋ, shi akpakpafeemɔ ni ebɔ mi.
Ejaakɛ ekpakpa ni misumɔɔ lɛ mifeee; shi efɔŋ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, no moŋ mifeɔ.
SHi kɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ kɛ̃ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ.
BElɛ minaa mla ko akɛ mi ni misumɔɔ akɛ mafee nɔ ni hi lɛ, efɔŋ moŋ kpɛtɛ mihe.
Mimligbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ miishɛɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ he;
shi minaa mla kroko yɛ mihe nii lɛ amli ni kɛ mijwɛŋmɔ yaa lɛ wuɔ ta, ni eŋɔɔ mi nom ehãa esha mla lɛ ni yɔɔ mihenii lɛ amli lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ ni nii yɔɔ mɔbɔ ji mi! Namɔ aaajie mi kɛaajɛ gbele gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ dɛŋ?
Shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo, wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, nɔ. Belɛ agbɛnɛ ni nɔŋŋ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ moŋ, shi mikɛ migbɔmɔ su sɔ̃mɔɔ esha Mla.
8: NO hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ fɔ ko fɔ ko bɛ ni abaabu mɛi ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mumɔ mla ni hãa wala yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ekpɔ̃ mi yɛ esha kɛ gbele mla lɛ dɛŋ.
Ejaakŋ nɔ ni Mla lɛ nyɛɛɛ afee yɛ gbedemɔ ni heloo lɛ ehã egbede hewɔ lɛ, no Nyɔŋmɔ fee: etsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ e-Bi lɛ yɛ su ni tamɔ esha heloo su mli, yɛ esha hewɔ; ni ebu esha lɛ fɔ yɛ heloo lɛ mli.
koni efee Mla lɛ taomɔnii ni ja lɛ yɛ wɔmli, wɔ mɛi ni wɔnyiɛɛɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa wɔnyiɛɔ lɛ.
Mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ heloo naa lɛ, heloonii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ; shi mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ, mumɔnii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ.
Ejaakɛ heloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, gbele ni, shi mumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, wala kɛ hejɔlɛ ni.
Heloo jwɛŋmɔ Lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛɛ ni, akɛni ebaaa ehe shi ehãaa NYɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni esaa enyɛŋ tete lɛ;
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni hiɔ shi Yɛ Heloo mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ amɛsa.
Nyɛhii shi yɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ, kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ. Shi mɔ ko bɛ KRisto Mumɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee Krsito nɔ ji lɛ.
Shi kɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ egbo yɛ esha hewɔ nɛ, shi Mumɔ lɛ hiɛ kã, yɛ jalɔi ni abu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ni tee Yesu shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ, m( ni tee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ aaahã nyɛgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ hu yi ana wala yɛ e-Mumɔ ni hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ hewɔ>
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɔjiatsɛmɛi ji wɔ, shi jeee heloo lɛ nyɔmɔ wɔhiɛ ni wɔɔhi shi yɛ heloo naa.
Ejaakɛ kɛ heloo naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ lɛ, nyɛbaagboi shi kɛ nyɛkɛ Mumɔ lɛ gbeɔ heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, nyɛhiɛ aaakãmɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ kɛ kplaa amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛji Nyɔŋmɔ bii.
Ejaakɛ jee nyɔŋ mumɔ nyɛna ni aaahã nyɛshe gbeyei ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni hãa mɛi tsɔ̃mɔɔ bii ni hãa wɔboɔ wɔtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, "Aba"! Ataa!" .
Lɛ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔmumɔ lɛ yeɔ odase akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji wɔ.
Ni kɛ bii ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ niyelɔi hu ji wɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ niyelɔi kɛ Kristo nanemɛi niyelɔI; kɛji wɔ kɛ lɛ na amanehulu lɛ, koni awo wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ nyam hu.
Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ amanehului lɛ kɛ anumnyam ni wɔsɛɛ abaajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ yeee egbɔ.
Ejaakɛ bɔɔnii lɛ kɛ gbɛkwɛmɔ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ miimɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ akpojiemɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ ewo yakayakanii ashishi, jeee yɛ amɛ diɛŋTsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa, shi moŋ yɛ mɔ ni ba amɛ shi lɛ suɔmɔ naaa; kɛ̃lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ
akɛ bɔɔNii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu abaahã amɛye amɛhe kɛjɛ fitemɔ ni yeɔ amɛ nYɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ anumnyam heyeli lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ ni amɛkɔ̃mɔ̃ɔ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ.
Shi jeee amɛ kɛkɛŋ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ tete, wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ Mumɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu wɔkɛ̃mɛ̃ɔ yɛ wɔmli, ni wɔkwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔbaatsɔ̃mɔ bii, no ji abaakpɔ̃ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ.
Ejaakɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ naa here wɔyiwala yɛ. Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni anaa lɛ, ejeee hiɛnɔkãmɔ, ejaakɛ namɔ hiɛ kãa nɔ ni enaa nɔ?
Shi kɛ nɔ ni wɔnaaa lɛ nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, belɛ wɔkɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ MUmɔ lɛ hu yeɔ buaa wɔ yɛ wɔgbedemɔi lɛ amli ; ejaakɛ bɔ n sa akɛ wɔselɔ lɛ wɔleee; shi moŋ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ŋtsɔidɔ̃ɔmɔi nia nyɛŋ akɛɛ lɛ dãmɔɔ mli hãa wɔ.
Ni mɔ ni taoɔ tsuii amli lɛ le nɔ ni ji mumɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ edãmɔɔ mli ehãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa.
Shi wɔle akɛ mɛi ni suɔmɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nibii fiaa yeɔ buaa amɛ ni ahi ahãamɛ, amɛ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ yɛ yiŋtoo naa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni ele amɛ eto momo lɛ, amɛ ejie eto ni amɛsubaŋ atamɔ e-Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni efee nyɛmimɛi pii ateŋ kromɔbi.
Shi mɛi ni ejie eto lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ etsɛ; ni Mɛi ni etsɛ lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ bem ebu; ni mɛi ni ebu amɛ bem lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ nyam ewo.
Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ yɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔŋ? Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ wɔSɛɛ lɛ, namɔ aaate shi awo wɔ?
Lɛ mɔ ni kãmãa wɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ e-Bi lɛ, sho moŋ ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnajiaŋ lɛ, ani ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnajiaŋ lɛ, ani eŋɔŋ nibii fiaa efataŋ ehe ekeŋ wɔ?
Namɔ aaaflɔ Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii lɛ anaa? Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ bem.
Namɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ fɔ lɛ? Kristo, mɔ ni gbo, shi mɔ nɔ ni fe no lɛ, mɔ ni atee lɛ shi ni eyɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni esaa edamɔɔ mli ehãa wɔ lɛ?
Namɔ aaagbla wɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni Kristo kɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ mli? Amanehulu loo fimɔ loo yiwaa loo hɔ̃mɔ loo yayainyiɛmɔ loo oshrã loo klaŋte?
Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, "Oheewɔ lɛ agbeɔ wɔ aahuu jenamɔ tuu; abu wɔ akɛ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ."
Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi fiaa mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni sumɔ wɔ lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ kunim tsɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ gbele jio, wala jio; ŋwɛi bɔfoi jio, nɔyeli jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio, hewalɔi jio,
ŋwɛi jio, shishi jio, aloo nibii ni abɔ lɛ amli nɔ kroko jio, amɛnyɛŋ amɛgbla wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu, wɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mi lɛmli .
9: Miiwie anɔkwale yɛ Kristo mli, mimaleeee, ni mihenilee hu miiye mi odase yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli,
akɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ babao, ni mitsui yeɔ daa.
Ejaakɛ mina ni kulɛ ajie mi yɛ Kristo he akɛ musumɔ yɛ minyɛmimɛi ni ji miwekumɛi yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ ahewɔ.
Amɛji Israelbii lɛ; ni amɛnɔ ji bitsɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ mlahãmɔ lɛ jɛ jamɔ lɛ kɛ shiwoi lɛ,
Amɛnɔ ji tsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛmli hu Kristo tete jɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, lɛji nii fiaa nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ. Amen!
Shi jeee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ efee yaka. Ejaakɛ jeee mɛi ni jɛ Israel mli lɛ fɛɛ ji, "Israel musuŋ bii",
ni asaŋ jeee akɛ ni Abraham shwiei ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ, bii ji amɛ fɛɛ, shi moŋ, "Mɛi ni jɛ Isak mli lɛ aaatsɛ amɛ oshwiei."
NO ji akɛ, jeee heloo naa nii lɛ moŋ abua akɛ oshwiei.
Ejaakɛ shiwoo wiemɔ lɛ nɛ, "Wɔsɛɛ agbɔ be nɛ lɛ maba, ni Sara aaana binuu."
Shi jee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ wɔtsɛ Isak kome lɛ nɔŋŋ Rebeka kɛna musu,
Shi be ni anako afɔ bii lɛ, ni amɛsaa amɛfeko nɔ kpakpa ko loo nɔ fɔŋ ko lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni akɛhalaa mɔ lɛ amã shi, ni ekajɛ nitsumɔi amli, shi moŋ ejɛ mɔni tsɛɔ mɔ lɛ,
akɛɛ Rebeka akɛ, "Onukpa lɛ baasɔ̃mɔ gbekɛ lɛ."
Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, "Yakob lɛ, misumɔ lɛ, shi Esau lɛ minyɛ lɛ lɛ."
Belɛ te wɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Ani Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ sane ko ni ejaaa? Dabida!
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, "Mɔ ni minaalɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mɔbɔ mibana, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ mi hãa lɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi ahã."
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ ko suɔMɔ loo emɔdɛŋbɔɔ naa ni, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa ni.
Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ farao akɛ, "Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔmitee o shi; koni majie mihewalɛ kpo kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ, koni atsi migbɛi tã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ."
Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, enaa lɛ mɔbɔ, ni kɛ eeesumɔ akɛ ewaje mɔ ko tsui lɛ, ewajeɔ .
Shi agbɛnɛ ooobi mi akɛ, "Belɛ mɛɛba Nyɔŋmɔ shwaa mɔ̃ mɔ? Ejaakɛ namɔ aaanyɛ eyiŋtoo naa aku? "
SHi, bo, gbɔmɔ, namɔ ji o, ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kaneɔ? Ani nɔ ni ashɔ̃ lɛ aaabi mɔ ni shɔ̃ lɛ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛba oshɔ̃ mi nɛkɛ? "
Aloo gbɛshɔ̃lɔ bɛ hegbɛ yɛ su lɛ nɔ, akɛ ekɛ su ni akpɔtɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ eko aaashɔ̃ nɔ ni yɔɔ nyam ni ekɛ eko hu aaashɔ̃ nɔ ko ni bɛ nyam?
Shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ akɛ ejie emlifu kpo etsɔ̃Oɔ ni ehã ale ehe ni wa lɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ eŋmɛɔ etsui shi babaoo ehiɛɔ mlifu nii ni sa fitemɔ lɛ,
bɔ ni afee ni ehã ale enumnyam falɛ lɛ hu yɛ emɔbɔnalɛ nii ni esaa eto ehã anumnyam lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɛni obaakɛɛ?
Shi nakai etsɛ wɔ hu, jeee mɛi ni yɛ Yudafoi ateŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi mɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ lɛ hu.
Tamɔ bɔ ni eKɛɛ yɛ Hoshea wolo lɛ mli akɛ, "Matsɛ mɛi ni jeee mimaŋ lɛ akɛ mimaŋ, kɛ mɔ ni asumɔɔɔ lɛ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni asUmɔɔ lɛ."
"NI aaaba mli akɛ, he ni akɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, 'Jeee mimaŋ ji nyɛ' lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ aaatsɛ amɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkæalɔ lɛ bii yɛ.
Shi Yesaia bo yɛ Israelhe akɛ, "Kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayibɔ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia lɛ, mɛi fioo ni baashwɛ lɛ yiwala aaahere.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsu ewiemɔ lɛ he nii kuku egbe naa pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ."
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yesaia ekɛɛ eto momo lɛ akɛ, "Eji Tai a-Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eshwɛɛɛ shwiei ko ehãaa wɔ kulɛ, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ Sodom, ni wɔfee tamɔ Gomora pɛ."
Belɛ te wɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ? Akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni ediii jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ ena jalɛ ni ji jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ;
shi Irael moŋ ni diɔ jalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli sɛɛ lɛ, enine shɛɛɛ nɔ.
Mɛɛ hewɔ ni? Ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ amɛtaooo, shi moŋ tamɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔi anɔ taoɔ. Ejaakɛ amɛtrɛ tamɔ tɛ lɛ;
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Naa, mikɛ tɛmɔ tɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ko miima shi yɛ Zion, Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ, ehiɛ gboŋ."
10: Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mitsui shweɔ kɛ fai ni mikpaa Nyɔŋmɔ mihãa Israel ji akɛ ahere amɛyiwala.
Ejaakɛ miiye amɛhe odase akɛ amɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he moŋ, shi jeee nilee naa.
Ejaakɛ amɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ, shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjalɛ moŋ amɛtaoɔ amɛkɛma shi, hewɔ lɛ amɛ baaa amɛhe shi amɛhãaa Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo ji Mla lɛ naagbee, ni lɛji jalɛ hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ji heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ MOse ŋma yɛ jalɛ ni jɛ Mla mlilɛ he akɛ, "Gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ enɛɛmɛi anɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli."
Shi bɔ ni jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, "Kaakɛɛ yɛ otsui mli akɛ,'Namɔ aaakwɔ kɛaatee ŋwɛi?'" No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛkpleke shi.
Aloo, "Namɔ aaakpleke shi kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli?" No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ kɛba .
SHi moŋ te ekɛɔ tɛŋŋ? "Beŋkɛmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ o yɛ odaa mli kɛ otsui mli fɛɛ," no ji hemɔkɛyeli wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔshiɛɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji okɛ onaabu jaje akɛ , "Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ" lɛ, ni ohe oye yɛ otsui mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, aaahere oyi wala.
Ejaakɛ tsui akɛheɔ kɛshɛɔ jalɛ he, ni naabu akɛkajeɔ kɛshɛɔ yiwalaheremɔ he.
Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛm "Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, ehiɛ gboŋ."
Ejaakɛ srɔto ko bɛ Yudanyo kɛ helanyo teŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome amɛ Fɛɛ amɛyɔɔ, ni niiatsɛ hu ji lɛ ha mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ.
"Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyi wala."
Shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaabo amɛtsɛ mɔ ni amɛheko lɛ amɛyeko lɛ hu? Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaahe mɔ ni amɛnuko ehe sane lɛ amɛye hu? Ni asaŋ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaanu kɛ shiɛlɔ ko bɛ lɛ?
Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaashiɛ, kɛ atsuko amɛ lɛ? Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, "Kwɛbɔ ni Sanekpakpa ni shiɛɔ nikpakpailɛ anaji yɔɔ fɛo ha!"
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi, ejaakɛ Yesaia kɛɔ akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye?"
Belɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, sane toiboo mli jɛɔ, ni sane toiboo hu tsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa.
Shi miibi akɛ, "Aso nu amɛnuuu?" Anɔkwale mli lɛ amɛnu, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, "Amɛgbee ejije kɛtee shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛnɔ. Ni amɛwiemɔi lɛ eshɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ."
ShI miibi hu akɛ, Aso le Israel leee?" Mose etsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mahã nYɛye maŋ ni jeee maŋ ko he awuŋa, ni mikɛ maŋ ko ni leee nɔ ko aaawo nyɛ mlila."
Yesaia kɛ ekãa kɛɛ, "Mihã mɛi ni taooo mi lɛ na mi, Ni mijie mihe kpomitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni biko mishi lɛ."
Shi Israel lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Daa jenamɔ migbɛɔ minijiaŋ mihãa maŋ toigbolɔi kɛ sanenaajielɔi lɛ."
11: Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, "Belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ emaŋ lɛ efɔ̃?" dabida! Ejaakɛ mi hu Isrealnyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Abraham shwiei kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ shɛko emaŋ ni ele eto momo lɛ efɔ̃ko. Aloo nyɛleee nɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ Elia yi nɔ lɛ, be ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni eflɔɔ Israel naa akɛ,
"Nuŋtsɔ, ogbalɔi lɛ, amɛgbe amɛ, ni ofɔleshãalatɛi lɛ, amɛwule amɛshwie shi, ni eshwɛ mi kometoo, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe."
SHi mɛɛ hetoo Nyɔŋmɔ hã lɛ? "Mishwɛ hii akpei kpawo ni kɛ amɛnakutsei kulako shui hãko Baal mihã mihe."
Naki nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amrɔ nɛɛ hu eshwɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ dromɔ lɛ naa ni lɛ, belɛ jeee nitsumɔI anaa ni dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ no lɛ dromɔ lɛ jeee dromɔ dɔŋŋ.
Belɛ te tɛŋŋ? Nɔ ni Israel taoɔ lɛ enine shɛɛɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ anine shɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, awaje amɛtsui;
tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, "Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ shɔ̃ɔfeemɔ ko, hiŋmɛii ni amɛkɛnaaa nii, kɛ toii ni amɛkɛnuuu nii kɛbashiŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ."
Ni David kɛɛ akɛ, "Hã amɛkplɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ akpa kɛ looflɔduu tsɔne kɛ tɛmɔnɔkɛ toigblamɔ ahã amɛ.
Hã amɛhiɛ ewo duŋ, ni amɛkana nii, ni ohã amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ daa."
Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, "Belɛ amɛtrɛ koni amɛgbee shi." Dabida! Shi moŋ atsɔ̃ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ nɔ ahere jeŋmaji lɛ ayi wala, koni Israel aye awuŋa.
Shi kɛ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ je lɛ ninamɔ, ni amɛnɔgbɔmɔ lɛ hu tsɔ̃ jeŋmaji aninamɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛyifalɛ lɛ te eeehã ninamɔ lɛ afee tɛŋŋ?
Agbɛnɛ nyɛ ni nyɛji jeŋmajiabii lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, "Gbii abɔ ni mi miji jeŋmaji abɔfo lɛ, mawo misɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam,
akɛ eleeenɔ mikɛaahã mijakubii lɛ aye awuŋa, ni mahere amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ayiwala lo.
Ejaakɛ kɛ amɛshɛmɔkɛfɔ̃ɔ lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ je lɛ kpãtã lɛ, belɛ amɛheremɔ lɛ, ani jeee wala ni jɛ gbohii ateŋ ni?
"Shi kɛji fioo ni ajie ahã Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belɛ nakai masui lɛ fɛɛ hu yɔɔ; ni kɛ tso shishifã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belŋ nakai niji lɛ hu yɔɔ.
Shi kɛji akumɔ tso niji lɛ ekomɛi, ni abatɛo bo ni oji ŋaŋmutso lɛ yɛ amɛnaajiaŋ, ni ona mutso lɛ shishifã lɛ kɛ emlinu lɛ eko lɛ,
Kaashwa yɛ niji lɛ anɔ; shi kɛji oshwã yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, naa, jeee bo ohiɛ shishifã lɛ, shi shishifã lɛ moŋ hiɛ bo."
Agbɛnɛ ekolɛ oookɛɛ akɛ, "Kuumɔ akumɔ niji lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni atsɛo mi awo tso lɛ mli."
Ojogbaŋŋ! He ni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ akumɔ amɛ ni bo lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli okɛdamɔ shi lɛ. Kaawo ohe nɔ, shi moŋ she ohe gbeyei;
ejaakɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebaaa tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niji lɛ ayi lɛ, bo hu ebaaŋ oyi.
No hewɔ lɛ kwɛmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ kɛ bɔ ni ekɛ mɔ yeɔ waa, shi bo lɛ, emli hi yɛ onɔ kɛji ohi emlihilɛ lɛ mli lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo hu aaafo o ashɛ afɔ̃.
Ni amɛ hu, kɛji amɛhiɛɛɛ he ni amɛheeee amɛyeee lɛ mli lɛ, aaatɛo amɛ awo mli; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ atɛo amɛ awo mli ekoŋŋ.

Ejaakɛ, kɛji bo lɛ, fo afo o yɛ tso ni yɛ bɔɔSu naa lɛ ŋaŋmutso ni lɛ he, ni atɛ bo awo mutso kpakpa lɛ mli, ni jeeee adebɔɔ gbɛ ni lɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi ni ji tso lɛ diɛŋTsɛ niji lɛ enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni atɛoŋ amɛ awoŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmutso lɛ mli.!
Ejaakɛ misumɔɔɔ akɛ mishiuɔ nyɛ nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ nɔ, anyɛakɛ, wajemɔ awaje Israel tsui fã kɛ fã kɛyashi beyinɔ ni jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba mli.
Ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ahere Israel fɛɛ yiwala, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Jielɔ lɛ aaajɛ Zion aba ni eeebajie nɔshafeemɔ yɛ Yakob he eshɛ efɔ̃;
ni enɛ ji mi kɛ amɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ majie amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛaatee."
Yɛ Sanekpaka lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ henyɛlɔi ji amɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ;' shi yɛ halamɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asumɔɔ amɛ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwaaaa ehe yɛ edromɔ nii lɛ kɛ etsɛmɔ lɛ he.
Ejaakɛtamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛbooo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, shi agbɛnɛ ana nyɛ mɔbɔ yɛ amɛtoigble lɛ Hewɔ lɛ,m
nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛ hu agbɛnɛ amɛtoi egbo, koni bɔ ni ana nyɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, amɛ hu ana amɛ mɔbɔ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋamɔ mɛi fɛɛ ayi ewo toigbele mli, bɔ ni afee ni ena amɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ nifalɛ kɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee mlikwɔlɛ! Ekojomɔi lɛ anyɛɛɛ shishi ana, ni egbɛi lɛ hu anyɛɛɛ sɛɛ mo aja!
Ejaakɛ "Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, Aloo namɔ ewo lɛ ŋaa pɛŋ?
Aloo namɔ etsɔ̃ hiɛ ehã lɛ nɔ ko, ni kulɛ aaato lɛ najiaŋ? "
Ejaakɛ edɛŋ nii fɛɛ jɛ, ni enɔ amɛtsɔ̃ kɛba, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyɔɔ amɛhã. Lɛ aaaaŋɔ anumnyam ahã kɛya naanɔ. Amen!
12: No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlitsɔ̃lɛ miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛŋɔ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ afɔle ni hiɛ kã ni he tse ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; enɛ ji jamɔ ni sa.
Ni nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ jeŋbii, shi moŋ nyɛkɛnyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee lɛ afea nyɛhe gbɔmɛi hei, koni nyɛyoo nii ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii kpakpai ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ.
SHI miitsɔ̃ dromɔ ni akɛdromɔ mi lɛ nɔ miikɛɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akɛ, ekabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe tuutu fe bɔ ni sa; shi moŋ ejwɛŋ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbɔmɔtso kome lɛ he lɛ wɔyɛ henii pii, shi henii lɛ fɛɛ tsuuu nitsumɔ kome lɛ,
nakai nɔŋŋ wɔyi pii nɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ kɛ Kristo mli, ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ enaanyohenɔ ji lɛ,
ni dromɔ keenii srɔtoi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ; kɛji mɔ ko nɔ ji akɛ egba lɛ, egba yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ naa;
Kɛji sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni lɛ, ehiɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; kɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ ji mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli;
mɔ ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, ehiɛ wiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; mɔ ni kɛ enii feɔ ejurɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ;' mɔ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, ebɔ mɔdɛŋ; mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsuijurɔ.
Suɔmɔ lɛ osato akahi mli. Nyɛhia efɔŋ kwraa; nyɛ kpɛtɛa ekpakpa he;
nyɛkɛ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ni mli wa asumɔsumɔa nyɛhe; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛ woo ahã enaanyo.
Nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ naa akabaa shi;nyɛmumɔ lɛ he adɔa la; nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
NyɛNyãa yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli; nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ yɛ amanehulu mli; nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli daa.
Nyɛhãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiamɔ lɛ afea nyɛ hu nyɛhiamɔ; nyɛbɔa gbɔfeemɔ he mɔdɛŋ.
Nyɛjɔa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ, nyɛjɔa ni nyɛkalomɔa.
Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni nyãa lɛ anyãa, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni foɔ lɛ afoa.
Nyɛjwɛŋjwɛŋa nyɛhe jwɛŋmɔ kome; nyɛkajwɛŋa henɔwomɔ jwɛŋmɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibalɔi lɛ abɔa. Nyɛkabua nyɛhe nilelɔi.
Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ najiaŋ; nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo yɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ nyɛtoa .
Kɛ aaaaho lɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahia shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Suɔlɔi, nyɛkatɔa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe owele, shi moŋ nyɛŋmɛa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, "Minɔji oweletɔɔ, mi mato najiaŋ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ."
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji hɔ̃mɔ miiye ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, hã lɛ nii eye; kɛji kumaimiiye lɛ lɛ, hã lɛ nu enu; ejaakɛ kɛ ofee nakai lɛ, obaabua ŋai kɛ la naa oshwie eyiteŋ.
Kaahã efɔŋ miiye onɔ kunim, shi moŋ okɛ ekpakpafemɔ aye efɔŋ nɔ kunim.
13: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba ehe shi ahã hegɛi ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ. Ejaakɛ hegbɛ ko bɛ ni jeeee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ; hegbɛi ni yɔɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ to.
No hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kuɔ hegbɛ lɛ naa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ ateɔ shi eshiɔ lɛ; ni mɛi ni teɔ shi nakai lɛ aaana amɛkojomɔ.
Ejaakɛ lumɛilɛ, amɛhe bɛ gbeyei hã mɔ ni feɔ ekpakpa, shi hã mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ moŋ; shi kɛji otaooo akɛnɔyelɔ lɛ he ahi gbeyei ahã o Lɛ, feemɔ ekpakpa, ni ooona yijiemɔ yɛ edɛŋ;

ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji lɛ yɛ ohewɔ, koni ahi ahã o, shi kɛji ofee efɔŋ lɛ, she gbeyei; ejaakɛ jeee yaka ehiɛ tsi lɛ; shi eji Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ oweletɔlɔ ni hãa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ sa akɛ abaa he shi, jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ henilee hewɔ hu.
Enɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtsuɔ onia hu lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji ji amɛ, ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ he amɛyɔɔ.
Bɔ ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛnaa lɛ, nYɛfea nyɛhãa lɛ. Mɔ nɔ ni ji onia lɛ, nyɛtsua onia; mɔ nɔ ni ji tòo lɛ, tòoo; mɔ ni ji gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ; mɔ nɔ ni ji woo lɛ, woo.
Nyɛkahiɛa mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔmɔ, akɛ ja suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛaasumɔsumɔ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ enaanyo lɛ eye Mla lɛ nɔ kɛwula shi.
Ejaakɛ kɛji akɛɛ akɛ, "Kaafite gblã! Kaaju! Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ!" Ni Kɛ kitã kroko hu yɛ lɛ, fɛɛ nɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔnɛɛ ni ji "Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe."lɛ mli.
Suɔmɔ efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko, hewɔ lɛ suɔmɔ pɛ ji Mlalɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli.
Ni nyɛle enɛ hu, no ji be lɛ, akɛ ŋmlɛtswaa ni nyɛkɛaate shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli lɛ eshɛ; ejaakɛ wɔyiwalaheremɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ agbɛnɛ fe tsutsu be ni wɔhe wɔye lɛ.
Nyɔɔŋ lɛ eho etã, ni jɛtsɛremɔ ebɛŋkɛ; no hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔjiea duɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ wɔshwiea, ni wɔwo la tawuunii lɛ.

Nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa fɛɛfɛo bɔ ni sa shwane, jeee yɛ dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ mli; jeee ajwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ nyenyeŋtswibɔɔ mli, jeee bei kɛ awuŋayeli mli; 14 shi moŋ nyɛwoa Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo tamɔ dama, ni nyɛkahãa heloo lɛ nɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ heloo lɛ sɛɛdii.
14: Mɔ ni ji gbedelɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ nyɛherea lɛ atuu; shi nyɛkɛ lɛ akakojoa yɛ esusumɔi ahe.
Mɔ ko yɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni ekɛyeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ; shi mɔ ni egbede lɛ, shwie kɛkɛ eyeɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ akagbe mɔni yeee lɛ he guɔ, ni mɔ ni yeeee lɛ akakojomɔ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehere lɛ atuu.
Namɔ ji o ni okojo mɔ kroko wenuu? Edamɔ shi jio, egbee shi jio, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enuŋtsɔ sane ni; shi eeedamɔ shi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ ni eeehã edamɔ shi.
Mɔ ko buɔ gbo ko fe gbi kroko, ni mɔ ko hu buɔ gbi fɛɛ gbi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ enɛ he.
Mɔ ni buɔ gbi titri ko lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ efeɔ. Mɔ ni yeɔ nii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Lɛ hewɔ eyeɔ, ejaakŋ edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi; ni mɔ ni yeee nii lɛ , Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyeee, ni lɛ hu edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ wɔteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ kãaa hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, ni mɔ ko gbooo hu hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Shu kɛji wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ kã wɔhã ni kɛji wɔgboi hu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔgboi wɔhã. No hewɔ lɛ kã jio, wɔgboi jio, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nii ji wɔ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ Kristo gbo ni ete shi ni ehiɛ kã bɔ ni afee ni etsɔ̃ gbohii kɛ hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ a-Nuŋtsɔ.
Shi bo, mɛɛba okojoɔ onyɛmi? Aloo bo hu mɛɛba ogbeɔ onyɛmi he guɔ? Ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, "Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, 'Akɛni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ nakutso fɛɛ nakutso aaakula shi ahã mi, ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi aaajaje Nyɔŋmɔ atsɔ̃ɔɔ.'"
No hewɔ lɛ wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baabua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɔŋtaa ehã Nyɔŋmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛkahãa wɔkojokojoa wɔhe dɔŋŋ; shi enɛ moŋ nyɛkojoa, akɛ mɔ ko kɛ tɛmɔnɔ ko akama enyɛmi gbɛ nɔ aloo eto lɛ pampi.
Mile ni misaa miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni eji bulemɔnɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ. Mɔ ni buɔ nɔ ko akɛ bulemɔnɔ ni lɛ, lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bulemɔnɔ ehãa.
Shi kɛji nɔ o ni oyeɔ lɛ gbaa onyɛmi naa lɛ, belɛ jeee suɔmɔ naa obaa ojeŋ yɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ. Okɛ oniyenii lɛ akakpãtã mɔ ni Kristo gbo hã lɛ lɛ hiɛ.
No hewɔ Lɛ nyɛkahãa awiea nyɛnɔ kpakpa lɛ he efɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ jeee niyeli kɛ ninumɔ ni, shi moŋ jalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ ni;
ni mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Kristo yɛ enɛɛmɛi amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ naa ehe tsuijurɔ ni esa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔtiua hejɔlɛ nibii kɛ nibii ni wɔkɛhã wɔnanemɛi anane amɔ shi moŋ sɛɛ.
Kaafite Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ niyenii ko hewɔ. Nibii fɛɛ he tsɛ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ eji efɔŋ hã gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ ekɛtoɔ pampi lɛ.
Ehi akɛ okaye loo asaŋ okanu wain loo nɔ ko ni aaato onyɛmi pampi.
Bo lɛ oye hemɔkɛyeli? Okɛto oha bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ. Ajɔɔ Mɔ ko ekojooo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yɛ nɔ ni ebuɔ akɛ ehi lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni yiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ lɛ, kɛji eye lɛ, eyeɔ fɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ ejɛɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ esha ni.
15: Wɔ mɛi ni wɔyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔkɛ mɛi ni bɛ hewalɛ lɛ agbɔjɔmɔi lɛ kpeɔ amɛ, ni wɔhe akasa wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhiɛ.
Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asa enaanyo hiɛ, koni ahi ahã lɛ ni enane amɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ Kristo hu hãaa ehe esa ehiɛ; shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, 'Mɛi ni bɔɔ o ahora lɛ ahorabɔi lɛ ebakã minɔ."
Ejaakɛ nibii abɔ ni aŋma ato momo lɛ, aŋmani etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii, koni wɔkɛ hiɛmiamɔ kɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli miishɛjemɔ lɛ ana hiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa wɔnyɛɔ wɔhiɛ wɔmiaa ni eshɛjeɔ wɔmii lɛ ahã nyɛna jwɛŋmɔ kome yɛ nyɛteŋ tamɔ Kristo Yesu,
koni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ naabu kome awo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ nyam.
No hewɔ lɛ nyɛhereherea nyɛhe, tamɔ B0 ni Kristo ehere nyɛ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ anumnyam lɛ mli lɛ.
SHi miikŋŋ akɛ Yesu Kristo tsɔ̃ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ehã Yudafoi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ hewɔ, koni akɛmã shiwoi ni awo tsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ mi;
ni jeŋmaji lɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Enɛ hewɔ lɛ majie oyi yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ, ni matsi ogbɛi tã mala."
Ni ŋmalɛ lɛ saa kɛɛ , "nyɛ jeŋmaji, nyɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ mli aflia nyɛ!"
Ni asaŋ, "nyɛjea Nuŋtsɔ Lɛ yi, nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ, ni nyɛkafoa lɛ, nyɛ maji fɛɛ!"
Ni asaŋ Yesaia kɛɛ akɛ, "Ishai shishifã lɛ aaba, mɔ hu ni aaate shi koni ebaye jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lɛ; lɛ enɔ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ̃."
SHi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ kɛ miishɛɛkɛ hejɔlɛ fɛɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, koni nyɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni ateke nɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ mli.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miheɔ miyeɔ krɛdɛɛ yɛ nyɛhe akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ kɛ mlihilɛ; ni nilee fɛɛ eyimɔ nyɛ tɔ, ni nyɛnyɛɔ nyɛwieɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛhe hu.
Shi, mikɛ ekãa pii ŋmla saji nɛɛ ekomɛi mihã nyɛ, koni mihkɛkai nyɛ, yɛ dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛdro mi lɛ hewɔ;
koni mitsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔ mihã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni mitsu Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ he nii akɛ osɔfo, ni jeŋmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ afɔle ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni atsuu he yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli,.
No hewɔ lɛ miyɛ shwãanɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo mli yɛ nii ni mitsuɔ mihãa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ;
Ejaakɛ mikaŋ akɛ mawie nɔ ko akɛ janɔ ni Kristo tsɔ̃ minɔ etsu ehã jeŋmaji lɛ atoiboo yɛ wiemɔ kɛ nifeemɔni amli,
yɛ okadi kɛ naakpɛɛnii ahewalɛ mli, yɛ Mumɔ hewalɛ mli; bɔ ni fee nɛ ni mijɛ Yerusalem mibɔle shi aahuu kɛyashi Ilirikum ni mishiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ migbe naa.
Nɔ ni mikɛmã mihiɛ titri ji akɛ, he ni atsiko Kristo gbɛi tã yɛ kɛ, jɛi majaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mikayatswa mɔkroko shishitoo nɔ;
Shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, "Mɛi ni ajajeko ehe sane ko atsɔ̃kɔ amɛ lɛ amɛaana, ni mɛi ni nuko lɛ, amɛaanu shishi."
Enɛ nɔŋŋ etsi mi gbɛ aahuu ni mibako nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.
SHi agbɛnɛ akɛni mibɛ nɔ ko tsumɔ yɛ biɛ niiaŋ dɔŋŋ, ni misaa mihe afii pii miitao akɛ mibaa nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ,
be fɛɛ be ni mafã gbɛ kɛaatee Spain lɛ, maba nyɛŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ miiho lɛ, mibaakwa nyɛhiɛ, koni, kɛji mina miishɛɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tswɛm lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya jɛi.
SHi amrɔ nɛɛ mifã gbɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalemni miyasɔ̃mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia fɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ etsu onia ko kɛha6 kRɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ ateŋ ohiafo lɛ.
Tsuijurɔ naa maɛfee yɛ lɛɛlɛ moŋ shi asaŋ amɛhiɛ amɛ nyɔmɔ. Ejaakɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ena amɛmumɔŋ nippakpai lɛ eko lɛ, belɛ esa akɛ amɛ hu amɛkɛ heloo nikpakpai lɛ eko asɔ̃mɔamɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mina migbe enɛ naa ni misɔo nɛkɛ yibii nɛɛ anaa mihã amɛ lɛ, mibatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Spain.
NI mile akɛ, kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli jɔɔmɔ falɛ mli maba yɛ.
Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hewɔ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ suɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, akɛ nyɛfata mihe kɛple yɛ nyɛsɔlemɔini nyɛsɔleɔ nyɛhãa mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ amli,
koni ajie mi yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ adɛŋ, ni misɔ̃ɔmɔ ni miyaa miyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Yerusalem lɛ asa mɛikrɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ jogbaŋŋ;
koni, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, mikɛ miishɛɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ, ni mabawo mitsui yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
Hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi. Amen!
16: Miijie wɔnyɛmiyoo Foibe ni ji Kenkrea asafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ yi mahã nyɛ,

koni nyɛherelɛ hiɛmɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni sa mɛikrɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ , ni nyɛfata ehe yɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni nyɛhe hīaa lɛ yɛ mli lɛ mli; ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu eji mɛi pii kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miyelikɛbualɔ.
Nyɛŋaa Priskila kɛ Akwila, ni ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛhãa mi;
amɛkɛ amɛhe wo gbele mli yɛ miyiwala hewɔ, ni jeeee mi kɛkɛ midaa amɛ shi, shi moŋ jeŋmaji lɛ amli asafoi lɛ fɛɛ hu daa amɛ shi.
Nyɛŋaa asafo ni yɔɔ amɛewe lɛ hu. Nyɛŋaa misyɔlɔ Epaineto ni ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni jɛ Asia ni kɛ ehe hã Kristo lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Maria ni gba ehenaa pii yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Adroniko kɛ Yunia, miwekumɛi ni awo mi kɛ amɛ tsuŋ ni amɛyɔɔ gbɛi yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ. m
Nyɛŋaa Amplia mɔ ni misumɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Urbano ni ji wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, kɛ misuɔlɔ Staki.
Nyɛŋaa Apele mɔ ni he emɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli lɛ. Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Aristobulo shīabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa miwekunyo Herodion lɛ, Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Narkiso shīabii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛyɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Trifosa ni bɔɔ mɔɛŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔlɛ mli lɛ. Nyɛŋaa Persi mɔ ni asumɔɔ ni etsu nii pii yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Rufo mɔ ni ahala lɛ yɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ enyɛ ni ji nyɛ hã mi hu lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Asinkrito, Flegon, Herme, Partroba, Herma kɛnyɛmimɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Filologo kɛ Yulia, Nereakɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ, kɛ Omlimpa kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛkɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ aŋaŋaa nyɛhe. Kristo asafoi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛhiɛ akã mɛi ni jeɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni nyɛkase lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛkɛ mligblamɔi kɛ pampitoo baa lɛ ahe, ni nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛje amɛhe.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, jeee wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmusu; ni amɛkɛ naaŋɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔi lakaa mɛi ni leee efɔŋ lɛ.
Shi nyɛtoiboo lɛ mɛi fɛɛ enu he; no hewɔ lɛ mina nyɛhe miishɛɛ; shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe nilelɔi yɛ ekpakpa gbɛfãŋ; shi efɔŋ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɛi ni leee nɔ ko.
SHi etsɛŋni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaanaanaa Satan nɔ kwraa yɛ nyɛnajiashi. Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ nyɛ ahi shi.
Minaanyo nitsulɔ Timoteo kɛ miwekumɛi Lukiokɛ Yason kɛ Sosipatre miibi nyɛ.
Mi Tertio ni miŋma nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ, miibi nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Gaioni ji mi kɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ shīatsɛ lɛ miiba nyɛ. Erasto ni ji maŋ shikatolɔ lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Kwarto miibi nyɛ.
(Wɔ-Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo drɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.)
Shi mɔ ni aaanyɛ ahã nyɛfi shi shiŋŋ yɛ misanekpakpa lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ lɛ naa, yɛ teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ kpojiemɔ naa,
teemɔ sane ni agbɛnɛ ajie atsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ yɛ naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ famɔ naa, ni atsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ aŋmalɛi lɛ anɔ atsi tã atsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛbo hemɔkɛyeli lɛ toi lɛ naa lɛ,
lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji nilelɔ kometoo lɛ, aŋɔ anumnyam ahã lɛ, yɛ Yesu Kristo mli kɛyashi naanɔ. Amen!

1: Be ko, be ni Israelbii nako ana maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, hɔmɔ ko ba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Hɔmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ nuu ko fã kɛjɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda, ni eyiŋ etee eyato gbɔ yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebihii enyɔ.
Nuu lɛ gbɛi ji Elimelek, eŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Naomi, ni ebihii lɛ hu agbɛii ji Malon kɛ Kilion. Amɛjɛ Efrata akutso lɛŋ.
