Naomi wu, Elimelek, gbo ni ebashɛ Naomi kɛ ebihii enyɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Bihii nɛɛ ŋɔ Moabyei. Yei nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbɛi ji Orpa, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Rut. Amɛhi jɛi aaafee afii nyɔŋma.

Fee sɛɛ lɛ Malon kɛ Kilion hu gboi, ni ebashwɛ yoo okulafo lɛ kɛkɛ, ebɛ wu lɛ, ebɛ bii hu. 6-7. Naomi nu yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ Yehowa ebadro emaŋ Israel niyenii. No hewɔ lɛ ekɛ eshaayi lɛ yiŋ kɛmiiku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya Yuda.
Be ni amɛyaa lɛ, Naomi kɛɛ eshaayei enyɔ lɛ akɛ, "Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa; nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya enyɛ we. Yehowa afee nyɛ ejurɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee mi kɛ gbohii lɛ ejurɔ lɛ.
Ehã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana he ko eta yɛ ewu we." Ni eshwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa, ni ekɛ amɛ ye shɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni amɛjwa yaafo.
Ni amɛkɛɛ Naomi akɛ, "Dabi, shi wɔkɛ bo aaatee omaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ moŋ."
Shi Naomi kɛɛ, "Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ, mibii! Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ mi aaatee? Ani bihii yɛ mimusuŋ lolo ni amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ nyɛwumɛi?
Mibii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa, ejaakɛ migbɔ tsɔ̃ bɔ ni mikɛ nuu aaayahi shi. Ni kɛji mikɛɛ miyɛ hiɛnɔkamɔ tete, ni maya nuu ko ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ koni mafɔ bihii tete lɛ,
aso no hewɔ ni nyɛaamɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaadra? Aloo no hewɔ ni nyɛaatsi nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛkɛ nuu ehiŋ shi? Dabi, mibii! Shi nyɛsane miidɔ mi naakpa; ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛjwa yaafo ekoŋŋ. Ni Orpa shwɔ eshaayoo lɛ naa, ni eku esɛɛ; shi Rut lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekpɛtɛ Naomi lolo.
Ni Naomi kɛɛ Rut akɛ, "Naa, obienyɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ etee emaŋ kɛ esɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ. Kuu osɛɛ ni otiu lɛ."

Shi Rut to he akɛ, "Kaahiɛ mi doo akɛ mishi bo, ni miku misɛɛ ni mifɔ̃ɔ osɛɛnyiɛmɔ! Shi he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ matee, ni he ni oooyahi lɛ jɛi mahi. Omaŋ aaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni o-Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɔ mi hu mi-Nyɔŋmɔ.
He ni ooogbo yɛ lɛ jɛi magbo yɛ, ni he ni aaafū bo yɛ lɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ aaafu mi yɛ. Yehowa kɛ mi aye ni ekɛ mi aye ekoŋŋ, kɛjeee gbele kɛkɛ aaagbla mi kɛ o teŋ fīi."
Agbɛnɛ be ni Naomi na akɛ Rut eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaatee lɛ, efɔ̃ɔ Rut kɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wieɔ lɛ he wiemɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛkɛshwie nɔ ekoŋŋ, kɛyashi amɛshɛ Betlehem. Be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ bu, ni yei lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ akɛ, "Naomi kɛ̃ nɛ?"
Shi ehere amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛkatsɛa mi Naomi dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ nyɛtsɛa mi Mara, ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ tsɔ̃.
Mitee obɔ̃, shi Yehowa kɛ mi eku sɛɛ kɛba eflo. Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtsɛɔ mi Naomi, mi ni Yehowa kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ, ni Ofe lɛ eshwishwia mi shi lɛ?"
Bɔ ni Naomi ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba nɛ, lɛ kɛ eshaayoo Rut, Moabyoo lɛ. Ni be ni amɛba Betlehem lɛ abɔi akoko foo.
2: Shi Naomi wu Elimelek yɛ wekunyo niiatsɛ ko. Egbɛi ji Boaz.
Be ko lɛ Rut kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, "Hã maya ŋmɔji lɛ amli mayanyiɛ mɔ ni aaana mi mɔbɔ nikpalɔi lɛ asɛɛ koni maye akoko kpɛkpɛo." Naomi kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Yaa ni oba oŋ, mibi."
Rut tee ni eyaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ mɛi ni foɔ akoko lɛ asɛɛ yɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli. Ni eba mli akɛ eyaje Boaz, Elimelek wekunyo lɛ, ŋmɔshi.
Boaz jɛ Betlehem eba, ni ehã nikpalɔi lɛ aekoo ekɛɛ, "Yehowa kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!" Ni amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ o!"
Kɛkɛ ni Boaz bi etsulɔ ni ekɛto enikpalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ oblayoo nɛ?"
Tsulɔ lɛ to he akɛ, "Moab oblayoo lɛ ni kɛ Naomi jɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba lɛ ni.
Ebakɛɛ mi akɛ,'Ofai nɛ, hã manyiɛ akoko kei lɛ ateŋ yɛ nikpalɔi lɛ asɛɛ maye kpɛkpɛo koni mabua naa." Ni kɛjɛ leebi tɔ̃ɔ ni eba lɛ, ejɔko ehe kwraa kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, "Mibi yoo, oobo toi? Kaaya ni oyaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ mɔ kroko ŋmɔshi, ni asaŋ okaje biɛ nɛɛ hu; shi moŋ kpɛtɛmɔ miblayei lɛ ahe yɛ biɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ohiɛ ahi ŋmɔ ni amɛfoɔ akoko lɛ yɛ mli lɛ nɔ koni onyiɛ amɛsɛɛ. Miwo miblahii lɛ kitã akɛ mɔ ko akagba onaa. Kɛ kumai miiye o lɛ, yaa gbɛi lɛ ahe koni oyanu nu ni oblahii lɛ eyayɛ lɛ eko."
Kɛkɛ ni Rut ho ekula shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, "Mɛɛ hewɔ ni omli ejɔ ehã mi, ni otseɔ ohiɛ ohãa mi, mi mɔkpɔŋ nɛɛ?"
Boaz to he ehã lɛ akɛ, "Nii ni ofee ohã oshaayoo lɛ yɛ owu gbele lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, agba mi fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ ni oshi otsɛ kɛ onyɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni afɔ o yɛ nɔ lɛ, ni oyiŋ kɛba mɛi ni oleee oto sa aŋɔɔ.
Yehowa ato bo nii ni otsu lɛ najiaŋ. Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ abo ni obaba nɛɛ ato bo najiaŋ shishiishi."
Kɛkɛ ni Rut kɛɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, omli jɔ hã mi, ejaakɛ oshɛje mimii, ni okɛ oweyoo ewie yɛ mlihilɛ naa, tsɛbelɛ mi kɛ oweyei lɛ ekoeko tete yeee hegbɔ."

Be ni shɛ niyeli be lɛ, Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, "Tsi oba biɛ koni obaye aboloo lɛ eko ni bo hu okɛ otrɔma lɛ atsɔ wain lɛ mli eko." Ni Rut ba ebata nikpalɔi lɛ amasɛi; ni Boaz hã lɛ ablefɔ ni ashī lɛ eko, ni ekpe, ni etɔ, ni eshwɛ eko.
Be ni Rut te shi eyaaye kpɛkpɛo lɛ, Boaz wo eblahii lɛ shi akɛ, "Nyɛhãa eyea kpɛkpɛo lɛ yɛ kei ni afīmɔ lɛ ateŋ hu; nyɛkanyafia lɛ.
Asaŋ nyɛfamɔa akoko lɛ eko yɛ kei lɛ amli nyɛshwiea shi nyɛhãa lɛ koni eye lɛ kpɛkpɛo; ni nyɛkawiea ehiɛ."
Rut ye kpɛkpɛo yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi. Egbee kpɛkpɛo ni eye lɛ, ni ena yiteremɔ aaafee kiloi nyɔŋma tsiimɔ.
Ewo kɛtee maŋ lɛŋ, ni ekɛ kpɛkpɛo ni eyaye lɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ eshaayoo lɛ. Rut jie niyenii ni eye etɔ ni shwɛ lɛ ehã eshaayoo lɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni Naomi bi Rut akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ oyatsu nii yɛ? Namɔ ŋmɔshi otee oyaye kpɛkpɛo lɛ yɛ ŋmɛnɛ? Mɔ ni tse ehiɛ ehã o lɛ, aaajɔɔ lɛ." Rut gba eshaayoo lɛ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni eyatsu nii yɛ ekɛɛ, "Nuu ni miyatsu nii yɛ eŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ gbɛi ji Boaz."

Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo lɛ akɛ, "Yehowa, mɔ ni hãko emɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ hiɛkãlɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ." Naomi tee nɔ ekɛɛ, "Nuu lɛ wɔwekunyo ni; weku lɛ mli mɛi ni aaanyɛ akwɛ wɔ ateŋ mɔ kome ji lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Rut, Moabyoo lɛ, kɛɛ, "Belɛ no hewɔ esaa ekɛɛ mi akɛ, 'Kpɛtɛmɔ mipaafoi lɛ ahe kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaagbe minikpamɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ.'"
Ni Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo Rut akɛ, "Ehi, mibi, akɛ okɛ Boaz oblayei lɛ anyiɛ koni akagba onaa yɛ mɔ kroko ŋmɔshi."
No hewɔ lɛ Rut kpɛtɛ Boaz oblayei nitsulɔi lɛ ahe, ni eye kpɛkpɛo lɛ aahuu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe akoko kɛ ŋmãa fɛɛ kpamɔ naa. Rut tee nɔ ekɛ eshaayoo lɛ hi shi.
3: Gbi ko lɛ Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo Rut akɛ, "Mibi, jeee ja mitao he ko mihã o ota ni ahi ahã o?
Boaz mɔ ni okɛ eblayei lɛ yatsu nii lɛ, wɔwekunyo ni. Naa, eesha ekoko gbɛkɛnaashi nɛɛ yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ juu ohe, ni okpa mu, ni owo otade ni yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛya ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ. Shi moŋ kaahã nuu lɛ miiyoo bo kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeye nii, ni eeenu nɔ ko dã.
Shi kɛ eyakã shi lɛ kadimɔ eshikamɔhe lɛ, ni oya oyakpa mama lɛ yɛ enane he, ni oho okã shi; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ofee."
Rut kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, "Nɔ ni okɛɛ mi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mafee."
Kɛkɛ ni Rut yiŋ etee ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ, ni eyafee bɔ ni eshaayoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Boaz eye nii, ni enu nɔ ko, ni emii eshɛ ehe lɛ, etee eyakã shi yɛ akoko ku lɛ sɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ni Rut dɛke shi, ni eyakpa mama lɛ yɛ Boaz nane he, ni eho ekã shi.
Ni nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ Boaz hɛle shi, ni etsɔ̃ ehe, ni naa, yoo ko kã enajiashi.
Ni Boaz bi akɛ, "Bo namɔŋ?" Ni Rut kɛɛ, "Mi oweyoo Rut ni. Ofai nɛ, haa mi omama lɛ eko; ejaakɛ weku lɛ mli niyelɔ ji o."
Boaz here nɔ akɛ, "Yehowa ajɔɔ o, mibiyoo. Ejurɔ ni ofee sɛɛkpee nɛɛ fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ tete akɛ onyiɛɛɛ oblahii asɛɛ, niiatsɛmɛi jio, ohiafoi jio.
Ni agbɛnɛ, mibiyoo, kaashe gbeyei. Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛɔ lɛ mafee mahã o, ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɛ yoo kpakpa ji o.
Eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ owu lɛ wekunyo ni aaanyɛ aŋɔ boji mi moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ niyelɔ lɛ eko yɛ ni eyeɔ dani mi miyeɔ.
Hii shi ni je atsɛre. Kɛji je tsɛre ni eeefee niyelɔ gbɛnaanii lɛ ehã o lɛ, ehi; shi kɛji esumɔɔɔ akɛ efee lɛ, no lɛ gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã nɛɛ mafee. Kã shi ni je atsɛre."
Kɛkɛ ni Rut ho ekã Boaz najiashi kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ. Ni ete shi dani hiɛ gbele bɔ ni aanyɛ mɔ ayoo. Shi Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, "Kaahã mɔ ko le akɛ yoo ko eba ŋmãagbeemɔhe nɛɛ."

Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, "Okɛ mama ni okɛha oyiteŋ lɛ aba, ni olɛɛ mii." Rut kɛ mama lɛ ba, ni elɛɛ mli, ni Boaz ka akoko susumɔ tsenei ekpaa ni etsiimɔ aaafee kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ewo mli, ni ekɛtre Rut, ni ekɛtee maŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni Rut yashɛ eshaayoo lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, eshaayoo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, "Te emli tamɔ tɛŋŋ, mibi?" Rut gba lɛ nɔ ni Boaz fee hã lɛ lɛ fɛɛ; asaŋ
Rut kɛɛ akɛ, "Ehã mi akoko tsenei ekpaa nɛɛ ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, 'Ebɛ ni okɛ odɛ̃ flo yaa oshaayoo lɛ ŋɔɔ.'"
Ni Naomi kɛɛ Rut akɛ, "Mɛɛ mibi, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ooona bɔ ni sane lɛ naa aaayakpa; ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ejɔŋ ehe ja ena sane lɛ naa ŋmɛnɛ."
4: Boaz tee maŋ agbo lɛ naa ni ji amɛkoishi lɛ. Kɛkɛ lɛ naa niyelɔ lɛ ni Boaz tsi etã lɛ miiho. Kɛkɛ ni Boaz tsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, "Anyɛminuu, ofai nɛ, baata shi fioo." Ni eba ebata shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Boaz tsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, "Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛbatraa shi fioo." Amɛbatra shi.
Ni Boaz kɛɛ niyelɔ lɛ akɛ, "Shikpɔŋ kuku ni ji wɔnyɛmi Elimelek shikpɔŋ lɛ, Naomi ni jɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba lɛ miihɔ̃ɔ.

Hewɔ lɛ mikɛɛ mawo otoi nɔ koni ohe yɛ mɛi ni tra biɛ nɛɛ kɛ mimaŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ. Kɛ ooosumɔ ni oye mɔ ni egbo lɛ nii lɛ wiemɔ, ni kɛji osumɔɔɔ hu hã male; ejaakɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni eyeɔ nii lɛ fe bo; ni osɛɛ dani mi." Niyelɔ lɛ jie naa ekɛɛ, "Ojogbaŋŋ, masumɔ maye.'
Boaz kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, "Gbi nɔ ni oooŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Naomi dɛŋ lɛ, belɛ ooŋɔ Rut Moabyoo lɛ, ni ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ ŋa lɛ hu oofata he nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ, koni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akagbo yɛ egboshinii lɛ he."
Kɛkɛ ni niyelɔ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, "Minyɛŋ maye nii lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛji miye lɛ tɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ baaba, mi diɛŋtsɛ migboshiniiyeli mli. ŋɔɔ migbɛnaa nii lɛ ohã ohe."

Blema lɛ kɛji abaaye mɔ ko nii aloo aahɔ̃ɔ nɔ ko yɛ Israel lɛ, nɔ ni akɛmaa nɔ aduatsɔ nɛ: Mɔ ni ŋmɛmɔ nii ahe lɛ aloo ehɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ jieɔ etokota ehãa mɔ ni ŋɔɔ nii lɛ. Enɛ akɛyeɔ nii ni ahɔ̃ɔ ahe lɛ he odase yɛ Israel.
No hewɔ lɛ be ni niyelɔ lɛ kɛɛ Boaz akɛ eye nii lɛ, niyelɔ lɛ jie etokota ekɛhã Boaz.
Kɛkɛ ni Boaz kɛɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, "nyɛji midasefoi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ miŋɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Elimelek nɔ, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Kilion kɛ Malon nɔ lɛ yɛ Naomi dɛŋ.
Asaŋ Rut, Moabyoo, ni ji Malon ŋa lɛ hu miiŋɔ lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ miŋa, koni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akagbo yɛ egboshinii he, ni egbɛi akalaaje yɛ enyɛmimɛi ateŋ kɛ emaŋ koishi hu, nyɛji odasefoi ŋmɛnɛ."

Ni maŋbii ni yɔɔ maŋ koi lɛ shi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ akɛ, "Wɔji odasefoi! Yehowa ahã yoo lɛ ni baa owe lɛ atamɔ Rahel kɛ Lea ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ mli Israel we lɛ jɛ lɛ. Otsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ agbo yɛ Efrata, ni ogbɛi ahehe yɛ Betlehem.
Ni shwiei ni Yehowa aaahã oblayoo nɛɛ awo ahã o lɛ, ahã owe lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ Tamar kɛ Yuda bi Perez we."
Boaz ŋɔ Rut ni etsɔ̃ eŋa; ni Boaz ta Rut he, ni Yehowa hã ena musu ni efɔ binuu.
Ni maŋ lɛŋ yei lɛ kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, "Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa! Ejaakɛ ehã bo gboshiniyelɔ kɛ nabi ŋmɛnɛ. Ehã gbɛkɛ lɛ gbɛi ahehe yɛ Israel.
Gbekɛ nɛɛ, eeehã owala sɛɛ atsɛ, ni eeekwɛ o yɛ ogbɔlɛ mli; ejaakɛ oshaayoo ni sumɔɔ bo, ni ehi hã bo fe bihii kpawo tete lɛ, ni fɔ lɛ."
Ni Naomi he abifao lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ, ni etsɔ̃ abifao lɛ kwɛlɔ.
Ni Naomi kuuŋyei lɛ nya amɛkɛɛ, "Afɔ binuu ahã Naomi eei!" Ni amɛwo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ Obed. Obed nɛɛ lɛ efɔ Ishai, ni Ishai hu fɔ Maŋtsɛ David.
Agbɛnɛ Perez shwiei nɛ: Perez fɔ Hezron.
Hezron fɔ Ram; Ram fɔ Aminadab.
Aminadab fɔ Nahashon; Nahashon fɔ Salmon, ni
Salmon fɔ Boaz; Boaz fɔ Obed.
Obed fɔ Ishai, ni Ishai fɔ Maŋtsɛ David.

1: Solomon lalai amli lala nɛ.
Ao, mina ni kulɛ ooobashwɔ minaa; ejaakɛ osumɔ fe wain.
Omui ni okpaa jeɔ ŋma naakpa, ogbɛi jeɔ ŋma tamɔ muŋma ni afɔse ashwie shi. No hewɔ ni oblayei lɛ sumɔɔ o lɛ.
Mi-Maŋtsɛ, hã manyiɛ osɛɛ; hã wɔye wɔhe oyai kɛya opiai lɛ amli. Wɔɔnya, ni wɔmii aaashɛ. Wɔɔkafo osuɔmɔ lɛ fe wain; ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ no hewɔ yei sumɔɔ o lɛ.
Nyɛ Yerusalem biyei, midiɔ nɛ, shi mihe yɛ fɛo; midiɔ tamɔ Kedar buui lɛ, mitamɔ muhɔɔi ni yɔɔ Solomon we lɛ.
Kaakwɛ mi gãa yɛ dimɔ ni midiɔ, kɛ hulu ni eshã mi hewɔ. Minyɛ bihii lɛ amli fu mi, ni amɛfee mi waintromi anɔkwɛlɔ. Tsɛbelɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ lɛ, mikwɛɛɛ.
Bo mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi otoi alɛɛhe lɛ, kɛ he ni ohãa amɛbumɔɔ shwane. Mɛni hewɔ matamɔ mɔ ni tsomloɔ kɛtaoɔ o yɛ onanemɛi atookui ahe?
Bo yoo ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe yei fɛɛ, kɛ oleee jɛi lɛ, bo lɛ jaa tooku lɛ asɛɛ mo kɛya, ni oyalɛ abotiai abii lɛ yɛ tookwɛlɔi abuui lɛ amasɛi.
Mishieŋnyɛ, mikɛ o toɔ okpɔŋɔi ni yɔɔ Farao shwiilii lɛ ateŋ eko he.
Odabii yɛ fɛo kɛ wulamɔnii; okuɛ hu yɛ fɛo kɛ jwinei ni atsɛ̃rɛ̃.
Wɔbaafee shika hewulamɔnii ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi ehlɔ mli wɔhã o.
Be ni maŋtsɛ kã ekpasa mli lɛ, belɛ minuatrɛ lɛ miije ŋma.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ he jeɔ ŋma krɔbɔo kɛji ekã mifufɔi ateŋ lɛ.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ fɔfɔi yɛ Engedi waintromii lɛ amli hã mi.
Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, mishieŋnyɛ! Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo. Ohiŋmɛi tamɔ okpo hiŋmɛi.
Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, misuɔlɔ, ohe yɛ akɔnɔ hu; jwɛifɔ ji wɔsaa ni wɔkãa nɔ.
Wɔtsu mplaŋi lɛ tsenedru ni. Ni wɔŋmɔŋmloi lɛ sɛsɛo ni.
2: Mi lɛ, Sharon fɔfɔi ji mi, miji jɔi amli oflɔ fɔfɔi.
Bɔ ni oflɔ fɔfɔi yɔɔ yɛ ŋmei ateŋ lɛ, nakai mishieŋnyɛ yɔɔ yɛ oblayei ateŋ.
Bɔ ni akututso yɔɔ yɛ kooŋtsei ateŋ lɛ, nakai misuɔlɔ yɔɔ yɛ oblahii ateŋ. Miishɛɛ mikɛtaa ehɔ̃ɔŋ, ni eyibii lɛ ŋɔɔ minaa.
Ekɛ mi ba shīa ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛŋ ni ekɛ suɔmɔɔ aflaŋaa ha minɔ.
Kɛ wainyibii ni aka lɛ fã kɛ fã awaje mi; kɛ aduawai ajɔɔ mitsui he; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ ewo mi hela.
Mina ni kulɛ, enine abɛku hɔ miyitso shishi, ni ekɛ eninejurɔ efua mi atuu.
Nyɛ Yerusalem biyei, mina soŋai kɛ ŋanɔ ofrote yei akɛ, nyɛkagbaa wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ naa; ni nyɛkatsīɛa ehiɛ kɛjɛ ewɔ mli, kɛyaashi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui aaatɔ. Yoo lɛ
Minu misuɔlɔ lɛ gbee! Naa, eeba, eehurɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ehiɛ foi waa yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ tamɔ soŋai, loo ofrote oblanyo. Naa, edamɔ wɔgbogbo lɛ sɛɛ; eekwɛ samfɛji lɛ amli gãa, eefli kɛ miitsɔ̃ samfɛji fɔji lɛ amli.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Mishieŋnyɛ, mimɔ ni he yɔɔ fɛo! Tee shi, ni oba wɔtee.
Shi, naa, fɛ̃i be lɛ eho etee; nunɛmɔ be lɛ sɛɛ efo kwraa.
Fɔfɔii egba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; lala be lɛ eshɛ, ni aanu kosɛɛ okpo gbee yɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Agbãmitso miiwo yibii, ni waintsei lɛ hu egba afofroi kɛ ŋma. No hewɔ lɛ, misuɔlɔ, tee shi ni oba wɔtee, boji mimɔ ni he yɔɔ fɛo.
Mikosɛɛ okpo ni hiɔ tɛsaa fɔjiaŋ, yɛ gɔ̃ɔ grɔŋŋ hɔ̃ɔŋ, hã mana ohiɛ, ni manu ogbee; ejaakɛ ogbee ŋɔɔ, ni ohiɛ hu yɛ fɛo.
Nyɛmɔmɔa osɔi lɛ, osɔi bibii ni fiteɔ waintromii lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔwaintsei lɛ egba afofro."
Minɔ ji misuɔlɔ lɛ, ni lɛ hu enɔ ji mi. Elɛɔ etoi lɛ yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ.
Kuu osɛɛ, misuɔlɔ, tamɔ soŋai loo ofrote oblanyo, yɛ Beta gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni oba dani je atsɛre, ni duŋ alaaje.
3: Be ni mikã misaa nɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, mitao mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ; mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ. Mitsɛ lɛ, shi ehereee mi nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ mate shi mayakpa maŋ lɛ mli gbɛjegbɛi kɛ blohuiaŋ. Mayatao mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ. Mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ.
Bulɔi ni buɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, na mi. Mibi amɛ akɛ, "Ani nyɛna mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ lo?"
Miho amɛhe fioo pɛ, kɛkɛ ni mina mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ. Mimɔ emli; ni miŋmɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛyashi mikɛ lɛ ba minyɛwe lɛ, kɛtee minyɛ, mɔ ni fɔ mi lɛ sɛɛtsuŋ.
Nyɛ Yerusalem biyei, mina soŋai kɛ ŋanɔ ofrote akɛ nyɛkagbaa wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ naa, ni nyɛkatsīɛa ehiɛ kɛjɛ ewɔ mli kɛyaashi be ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui aaatɔ. Yoo lɛ
Mɛni ji nɔ ni jɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ baa tamɔ lasu kusuu ni teɔ shi nɛɛ? Namɔ nɛ ni mire kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ jrayelɔi atsofãi srɔtoi fɛɛ jeɔ ŋma yɛ ehe nɛɛ?
Naa, Solomon ji mɔ ni atere yɛ akpãkãi lɛ mli lɛ. Asraafoi kakabaŋi nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni jɛ Israel kãkãalɔi ateŋ lɛ ebɔle ehe.
Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛmia kɛ tawuu klaŋtei, ni amɛhe esa kɛ tawuu. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ klaŋte ŋmɔ ehɛ, yɛ nyɔɔŋ tuamɔ hewɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Lebanon tsei fee akpakãi hã ehe.
Ehe tsei lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee. Emli kpasamɔnɔ lɛ akɛ shika fee. Emli sɛ̃i lɛ akɛ mama afaseo ha he. Yerusalem biyei lɛ kɛ suɔmɔ wula emligbɛ lɛ.
Nyɛ Zion biyei, nyɛjea kpo nyɛbakwɛa Maŋtsɛ Solomon, kɛ akekre ni enyɛ kɛfi lɛ kɛ eyookpeemɔ gbi kɛ emliflimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
4: Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, misuɔlɔ, naa, ohe yɛ fɛo. Ohiŋmɛiŋ kplɛɔ kɛ suɔmɔ tamɔ okpo hiŋmɛii, kɛtsɔ̃ɔ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli. Oyitsɔi bua onɔ tamɔ abotiai aku ni bua shi yɛ Gilead gɔji lɛ ahe.
Onyanyɔji yɛɔ futafuta tamɔ gwaŋtɛŋi ni aku amɛhetsɔi ni aju amɛhe. Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfɔfɔɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni ekoeko gboko.
Onaabu tamɔ kpãa tsuru, ni onaabu yɛ fɛo kɛ wiemɔ. Odabii yɛ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli tamɔ maŋo tsuru.
Okuɛ tamɔ David mɔ̃ɔ ni kwɔ, ni ato tamuunii yɛ mli lɛ, ni tawulɔi atsɛŋi bibii kɛ ewuji tsotsro shi yɛ mli fɛɛ tamɔ kuɛnii.
Ofufɔi tamɔ soŋai bii enyɔ. Tamɔ ofrotebii hãaji ni yeɔ nii yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ.
Mayatee mihe yɛ mire gɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mayashera shi yɛ krɔbɔo gɔ̃ŋkpɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni je aaana ni hiɛ aaabu.
Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo kɛmɔ shi; kpa ko kpa ko bɛ ohe.
Miyɛmfro, okɛ mi ajɛ Lebanon; okɛ mi ajɛ Lebanon ni wɔya. Jɛɛ Amana gɔ̃ŋ lɛ yiteŋ oba; Jɛɛ Senir kɛ Hermon gɔji lɛ anɔ, jatai kɛ mlaŋtswii ashihilɛhe lɛ, oba ni wɔtee.
Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, oŋɔ mitsui; okɛ okwɛmɔ ni okwɛ mi shi kome kɛ ojrawatɛ kome ni yɔɔ okuɛnii lɛ mli lɛ eŋɔ mitsui kwraa.
Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, osuɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ aahuu fe wain. Omui lɛ jeɔ ŋma aahuu fe tsofakɛŋmai srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Miyɛmfro, onaabu tsereɔ wo shwieɔ shi; wo kɛ fufɔ yɛ olilɛi shishi. Ohebo mli ŋma tamɔ Lebanon ŋma.
Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro lɛ, etamɔ trom ni aŋmɛ naa; etamɔ abɔɔ ni aŋmɛ naa; etamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni tueɔ ni asɔo naa.
Otsei fɔbii lɛ tamɔ trom ni maŋo tsei yɔɔ mli, ni amɛwo_ yibii srɔtoi ni yɔɔ fɛo naakpa tamɔ kofer fɔfɔi kɛ nardo fiaa.
Trom ni nardo kɛ safron kɛ kalamo kɛ sinamon kɛ krɔbɔo tsei fɛɛ kɛ mire kɛ aloe kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai titrii lɛ fɛɛ kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ omli.
Bo oji abɔɔ ni nuhiŋmɛi kɛ wala nubu yɔɔ omli, fai ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ Lebanon ji bo.
Bo, kooyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ, ohiɛ atsɛ̃, ni bo wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ, ba ni obatswa yɛ mitrom lɛ mli, koni anu emli ŋma gblaŋŋ lɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ. Hã misuɔlɔ lɛ aba ebɔɔ lɛ mli ni ebaye etsei ayibii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
5: Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, miba mitrom lɛ mli, miibua mimire kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai anaa. Miiye miwo agbaku kɛ emli wo lɛ. Miinu miwain kɛ mifufɔ lɛ. Minanemɛi, nyɛyea ni nyɛnua, ni nyɛ, suɔlɔi, nyɛnua ni nyɛtrɔa! Lala ni ji ejwɛ Yoo lɛ
Be ni miwɔ lɛ, mitsui hiɛ kã. Naa! Mishieŋtsɛ miishi shinaa lɛ. Minyɛmiyoo, misuɔlɔ! Mikosɛɛ okpo, misuɔlɔ ni fe fɛɛ, bɔ efɔ miyitsei ahe fɛɛ; miyitsɔi akuklui lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɔɔŋ bɔ. Yoo lɛ
Mijie mitade lɛ; mɛni hewɔ mawo ekoŋŋ? Mifɔ minaji ahe, mɛni hewɔ mawo amɛhe muji ekoŋŋ?
Misuɔlɔ lɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ klɔklɔ lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni mitsui tswa kɛ miishɛɛ.
Mite shi ni mayagbla misuɔlɔ lɛ, mire tsere yɛ miniji ahe, mire ŋleŋle tsere yɛ miwabii ahe shwie shinaa klɔklɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni migble misuɔlɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe etee momo. Mishwe akɛ manu agbee. Mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ. Mitsɛ lɛ, shi ehereee mi nɔ hu.
Bulɔi lɛ na mi be ni amɛnyiɛ amɛbuɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ. Amɛtswai mi nii, ni amɛpila mi. Gbogbo nɔ bulɔi lɛ shɔ̃ mihiɛhaanɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ Yerusalem biyei, nyɛwoa mi shi veveeve akɛ kɛji nyɛna misuɔlɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, suɔmɔ ewo mi hela.
Bo yoo ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe yei fɛɛ, Mɛni osuɔlɔ lɛ kɛfe suɔlɔ kroko, hewɔ ni obiɔ akɛ wɔwo o shi veveeve nɛɛ?
Misuɔlɔ lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni ehewolo kã. Esro lɛ yɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma he.
Ehiɛ tsuɔ oo, eyitsɔi edrɔdrɔi; ni ediɔ tamɔ kwaakwaalabite.
Ehiŋmɛii tamɔ fai ahe okpoi ahiŋmɛii; okpoi ni amɛju amɛhe kɛ fufɔ ni amɛdamɔ fai atoi.
Edabii tamɔ tsofakɛŋma akofii ni miije ŋma. Enaabu yɛ fɛo tamɔ Oflɔ fɔfɔi ni efɔ kɛ krɔbɔo ŋleŋle.
Eniji yɛ fɛo, ni ewo gai ni ojrawatɛi tra mli. Egbɔmɔtso tamɔ nɔ ko ni akɛ shwuɔ wu fee, ni akɛ safiro etra he.
Eshwuɔji tamɔ alabastro akulashiŋi, ni mamɔ shika nibii anɔ. Eje agbo tamɔ Lebanon gɔ̃ŋ lɛ, ni eje oblaŋ tamɔ Lebanon tsenedrutso lɛ.
Edaaŋ wiemɔ ŋɔɔ naakpa, ni enɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ akɔnɔ. Naa, nyɛ Yerusalem biyei, bɔ ni misuɔlɔ, mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ nɛ.
6: Bo mɔ ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ yɛ yei ateŋ, nɛgbɛ osuɔlɔ lɛ etee? Nɛgbɛ osuɔlɔ lɛ etsɔ̃, koni wɔ kɛ bo fɛɛ ayatao lɛ?
Misuɔlɔ lɛ etee etrom lɛ mli, yɛ tsofakɛŋma akofii lɛ ahe, koni eyalɛ etooku lɛ yɛ jɛi, koni etserɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii hu.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ nɔ ji mi, ni mi hu minɔ ji lɛ. Lɛ mɔ ni elɛɔ etooku lɛ yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ lɛ.
Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo tamɔ Tirza maŋ, ni ohe yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ Yerusalem. Ohe yɛ gbeyei tamɔ tabilɔi ni hiɛ aflaŋai.
Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oto afã ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛii gbaa minaa. Oyitsɔi tamɔ abotiai aku ni miikpleke Gilead gɔji lɛ ahetsɔi.
Onyanyɔji yɛɔ futaa tamɔ gwaŋtɛŋi ni aju amɛhe ni amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfɔfɔɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni amɛteŋ ekome flo gboko.
Odabii yɛ fɛo tamɔ maŋo ni etsu yɛ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ aaahi maŋnyɛmɛi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ hemɛi nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, kɛ oblayei ni aleee amɛyibɔ moŋ nɛ;
shi mɔ koome pɛ ji misuɔlɔ, ni ehe yɛ fɛo tamɔ okpo. Enyɛ suɔmɔ bi koome ji lɛ. Enyɛ enaaa kpa ko yɛ ehe. Oblayei lɛ na lɛ, ni amɛna ehe miishɛɛ. Maŋnyɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi jie eyi.
Namɔ pueɔ tamɔ leebi hulu nɛɛ, ni ehe yɔɔ fɛo tamɔ nyɔŋtsere, ni ehe tse tamɔ hulu, ni ehe yɔɔ gbeyei tamɔ tabilɔi ni hiɛ aflaŋai nɛɛ?
Mikpleke shi kɛtee tsoyibii atrom lɛ mli koni mayakwɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli jwɛi frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ. Mitee koni mayakwɛ akɛ waintsei lɛ kɛ maŋotsei lɛ hu agba afofro lo?
Be ni mihɛleɔ shi lɛ, naa mi, ni mita shwiili mli, ni mi yɛ misuɔlɔ lɛ masɛi.
Kuu osɛɛ, kuu osɛɛ bo Shulamyoo! Kuu osɛɛ, kuu osɛɛ, koni wɔkwɛ o. Mɛni hewɔ nyɛbaakwɛ Shulamyoo? Te aaafee tɛŋŋ majo joo enyɔ hu?
7: Bo lumɔ biyoo, Onajifãamɔi yɛ otokotai amli yɛ fɛo naakpa! Oshwuɔji yɛ fɛo tamɔ jwinei ni ŋaalɔ nukpa kɛ eniji fee.
Olaŋmɔ tamɔ likɔlikɔ kokroo ni wain ni ŋɔɔ etãko yɛ mli dã. Omusu tamɔ ŋmãa ku, ni akɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii etserɛ he.
Ofufɔi tamɔ ofrote bii enyɔ, loo tamɔ soŋaibii hãaji.
Okuɛ kɛ tamɔ shwuɔwu mɔ̃ɔ. Ohiŋmɛii tamɔ Heshbon kpaakpoi ni yɔɔ Bat-Rabbim maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ he lɛ. Ogugɔ yɛ fɛo tamɔ Lebanon mɔɔ ni kwɔ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ Damasko gbɛ lɛ.
Oyitso ni ma onɔ tamɔ Karmel Gɔ̃ŋ; Oyitsɔi akuklui tamɔ mama afaseo. Oyitsɔi fɛo lɛ ŋɔɔ maŋtsɛ nom.
Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo, ni ohe yɛ akɔnɔ akɛ nɔ ko.
Oje oblaŋ tamɔ tɛŋ, ni ofufɔi tamɔ ŋmedrui.
Mikɛɛ, "Makwɔ tɛŋ lɛ, ni mamɔmɔ eniji lɛ amli. Ao, mina ofufɔi tamɔ waintso yibii ŋmedrui, ni mumɔ ni jɛɔ ogugɔ mli jeɔ ŋma tamɔ aadɔŋ."
Mina ni onaashwɔmɔ ŋɔɔmɔ tamɔ wain kpakpa fe fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ naabu kɛ nyanyɔŋ teŋ, kɛyaa omusuŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mi lɛ, misuɔlɔ lɛ nɔ ji mi. Ni miji mɔ ni eshweɔ.
Misuɔlɔ, ba ni wɔtee ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyato gbɔ yɛ akrowai lɛ amli.
Hã wɔte shi maŋkɛ̃ mra, ni wɔya waintromii lɛ amli, ni wɔyakwɛ akɛ waintso lɛ miifrɔke ni eegba afofro, ni maŋotsei lɛ hu egba afofro lo? Jɛi mikɛ misuɔmɔ baahã bo yɛ.
Ao! Misuɔlɔ suɔmɔ yibii lɛ miije ŋma, ni tso yibii ni jra wa srɔtoi fɛɛ yɛ wɔshinaa lɛ shi. Mikɛ ememeji kɛ eheei fɛɛ eto ehã o.
8: Ao, mina ni kulɛ minyɛmi nuu ni ye minyɛ fufɔ ji o. Kulɛ kɛ mina o yɛ agbo naa ni mishwɔ onaa lɛ, mɔ ko shwaŋ mi po.
Kulɛ manyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya minyɛ we lɛ, manyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya minyɛ awo ni fɔ mi sɛɛtsuŋ. Ni mahã o wain ni jeɔ ŋma onu; ni tamɔ migranata dãa.
Mina ni kulɛ miyitso tsɔle enineabɛku ni ekɛ eninejurɔ efua mi atuu.
Nyɛ Yerusalem biyei, nyɛwoa mi shi veveeve akɛ, nyɛhosoŋ misuɔlɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkatsiɛ̃a ehiɛ hu, kɛyaashi be ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ. Yei lɛ
Namɔ ji yoo nɛɛ ni jɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ baa ni ekɛ esuɔlɔ ela kɛ baa nɛɛ? Mi mitsiɛ̃ ohiɛ yɛ akututso lɛ shishi, jɛi ji he ni onyɛ kɔ̃mɔ o yɛ, jɛi onyɛ ni fɔ o lɛ kɔ̃mɔ o yɛ.
Sɔomɔ minaa owo otsui mli tamɔ adikiɔ nine he lɛ. Okɛ yoo ko yoo ko akala, ja mi pɛ. Ejaakɛ suɔmɔ he wa tamɔ gbele; ni awuŋayeli hu yi wa tamɔ gbele. Ehere tamɔ la, ni etsoɔ grigri.
Nu babaoo po nyɛɛɛ suɔmɔ agbe, ni nu afua tete nyɛɛɛ lɛ ashiu. Kɛji mɔ ko eshīaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ehã ekɛmiihe suɔmɔ lɛ, ŋmɔ abaaŋmɔ lɛ.
Wɔyɛ nyɛmiyoo fioo ko ni ejeko fufɔ. Mɛni wɔɔfee wɔhã wɔnyɛmi yoo nɛɛ, gbi ni aaaba akɛ abaatsɛ ehebaa lɛ?
Eji gbogbo ji lɛ kulɛ wɔɔma jwitɛi mɔɔ ni kwɔ wɔma enɔ. Eji shinaa ji lɛ kulɛ wɔkɛ tsenedrutsei ŋmoŋmlo aaaha ehe.
Mi lɛ, gbogbo ji mi, ni mifufɔi mamɔshi tamɔ mɔji. Ni yɛ misuɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, mitsui nyɔɔ mimli, ni minaaa hejɔlɛ.
Solomon yɛ waintrom ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Baal-Hammon. Ekɛ waintrom lɛ hã mɛi ni amɛhu mli. Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ woɔ jwitɛi kukuji akpe akɛ adɔde.
Miwantrom, ni ji mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ lɛ, mikoome minɔ ni. Bo Solomon, ooona akpe lɛ, ni mɛi ni ji apaafoi lɛ aaana ohai enyɔ.
Ao, bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ abɔi lɛ amli, minanemɛi lɛ miibo ogbee toi.Hã mi hu manu ogbee lɛ.
Ohe afee oya, misuɔlɔ, ofoi awa tamɔ soŋai, tamɔ ofrote oblanyo yɛ tsofakɛŋma gɔji lɛ anɔ.

1: Paulo, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo lɛ; ŋma wolo nɛɛ. Nyɔŋmɔ hala mi ni etsu mi koni mayawo Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbɔi lɛ ahemɔkɛyeli kɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ anɔkwale lɛ he nilee lɛ mli hewalɛ
ni amɛna naanɔ wala lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ. Naanɔ wala nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wo he shi dani abɔ je lɛ.
Shi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebe ni sa lɛ mli lɛ ejie ewiemɔ lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ shiɛmɔ sane ni ato awo midɛŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ fãmɔ naa lɛ mli.
Miŋma wolo nɛɛ miyahã Tito ni ji mibi krɔŋŋ yɛ hemɔkeyeli koome ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ naa. Dromɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, dɛŋ ahã o.
Enɛ hewɔ mishi bo yɛ Kreta, koni oto nii ni eshwɛ lɛ gbɛjianɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni owowoo onukpai yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ bo momo lɛ.
Onukpa afee mɔ ko ni kpa ko bɛ ehe, mɔ ko ni yɔɔ ŋa kome ni eyɔɔ bii ni heɔ Kristo nɔ yeɔ ni awieee amɛhe akɛ nyenyeŋtswibɔlɔi loo toigbolɔi ji amɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ kpa ko hiɔ ehe, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ we nɔ tsulɔnukpa ji lɛ. Ekafee ehe mɔ ni feɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsuinaanii, jeee mlifutsɛ, jeee dãanulɔ, jeee ninekpokpookpotsɛ, jeee hiɛjoolɔ.
Shi moŋ efee ehe gbɔfeelɔ, mɔ ni sumɔɔ ekpakpa, nilelɔ, jalɔ, mɔ ni he tse, mɔ ni yeɔ ehe nɔ.
Mɔ ni hiɛɔ anɔkwa wiemɔ lɛ yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa lɛ mli, koni enyɛ ekɛ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ awo mɛi ahewalɛ, ni ehã mɛi ni wieɔ shiɔ wiemɔ lɛ ana amɛtɔ̃mɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ ni ji toigbolɔi, mɛi ni wieɔ nii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, kɛ shishiulɔi, titri lɛ mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Amɛji gbɔmɛi ni sa akɛ awo amɛnaa manyoflɛ. Amɛ, amɛbutuɔ shīai muji fɛɛ, ni sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛgble hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni ejaaa.
Amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni ji amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Kretabii maleɔ daa; kooloi fɔ̃ɔji ni; ŋmaayelɔi hejɔ̃lɔi ni."
Nɛkɛ odase nɛɛ anɔkwale ni. No hewɔ lɛ kã amɛshiɛ veveeve, koni amɛhemɔkɛyeli afee hemɔkɛyeli kpakpa,
ni amɛkabo Yudafoi adesai lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛjɛɔ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ akitãi lɛ atoi.
Mɛi ni he tse lɛ, nii fɛɛ he tse hã amɛ; shi mɛi ni he tseee ni amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ amɛyeee lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni he tse hã amɛ, shi moŋ amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli kɛ amɛhenilee fɛɛ ewo muji.
Amɛjajeɔ akɛ amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, shi amɛkɛ amɛnitsumɔi kwaa lɛ, ni amɛji gbɔmɛi ni ahiɔ, kɛ toi gbolɔi, mɛi ni ehiii hãaa nitsumɔ kpakpa ko kwraa.
2: Shi bo lɛ, wiemɔ nibii ni sa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ.
Hiimeji lɛ, amɛhiɛ akã shi, amɛfee mɛi ni hiɛ tsii, amɛjweŋmɔ akã shi, amɛfee mɛi ni yɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli kpakpa kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hiɛmiamɔ.
Yeimeji hu nakai nɔŋŋ, amɛba amɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa mɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ. Amɛkafee amɛhe oshekuyelɔi, amɛkafee amɛhe mɛi ni dãa eŋɔ amɛ nom, amɛfee mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ ni kpakpai.
Koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblayei lɛ ni amɛsumɔ amɛwumɛi, amɛsumɔ amɛbii,
amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi, amɛhe atse, amɛtsu amɛshīa nii jogbaŋŋ, amɛmli ahi, amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi, koni akawie Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔ.
Oblahii hu nakai nɔŋŋ, wiemɔ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ koni amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ, ŋɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe ofee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ohã amɛ yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai agbɛfaŋ. Nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ mli lɛ hã ana o akɛ mɔ ni miifee kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
Owiemɔ ahi bɔ ni anaŋ he sane ko atã, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni kɛ wɔ yeee lɛ hiɛ agbo, yɛ na ni enaaa nɔsha ko ekɛɛ yɛ wɔhe lɛ hewɔ.
Tsuji lɛ, amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ, amɛsa amɛhiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli. Amɛkajie sane naa,
amɛkashra nii, shi moŋ amɛhã ana amɛ akɛ mɛi yeɔ anɔkwa kɛmɔ shi, koni amɛwula Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nibii fɛɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni akɛhereɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwala lɛ epue.
Ni etsɔseɔ wɔ koni wɔkwa she ni asheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei kɛ je nɛɛŋ akɔnɔi lɛ ni wɔkɛ hiɛshikãmɔ kɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ ahi shi yɛ je nɛɛŋ,
be mli ni wɔmiikwɛ jɔɔmɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ kɛ wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ Yesu Krito anumnyam lɛ puemɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Lɛ ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔnajiaŋ, koni ekpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ nɔtɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ mli ni, etsuu wɔhe ehã ehe akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, maŋ ni hiɛ dɔɔ yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe lɛ.
Wiemɔ nii nɛɛ, ni owo amɛ ŋaa yɛ he, ni okã amɛhiɛ yɛ he kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ. Kaahã mɔ ko miigbe ohe guɔ.
3: Kaimɔ amɛ ni amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã onukpai kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ, amɛbo amɛ toi, amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsmɔ kpakpa.
Amɛkawie mɔ ko he efɔŋ, amɛkabe, shi moŋ amɛfee kpoo, ni amɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ana amɛ akɛ amɛhe jɔ kwraa.
Ejaakɛ sa lɛ, wɔ hu wɔfee wɔhe kwashiai, toigbolɔi, gbɛdulɔi, mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ akɔnɔi kɛ miishɛɛ nibii srɔtoi pii. Ni wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ nifɔ̃ɔjianifeemɔ kɛ hetsɛ̃ mli, wɔhe yɛ taŋ, ni wɔnyɛnyɛɔ wɔhe.
Shi be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ mlihilɛ kɛ egbɔmɛiahedɔɔ lɛ pue lɛ,
jeee jalɛ nitsumɔi ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔtsu naa shi moŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɔbɔnalɛ naa etsɔ̃ɔ eheefeemɔ lɛ nɔ ehere wɔyiwala.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ nɔ, efɔse eshwie wɔnɔ babaoo,
koni ahã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ niyelɔi yɛ naanɔ wala lɛ gbɛfaŋ yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ naa, akɛni abu wɔ bem yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ edromɔ naa lɛ.
Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ. Ni nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ anɔ ni mitaoɔ akɛ oma, koni mɛi ni ehe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ amɛye lɛ akwɛ ni amɛbɔ nitsumɔ kpakpai ahe mɔdɛŋ. Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ji ni yɔɔ fɛo ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ hã gbɔmɛi.
Shi kwashiai aŋwanejei kɛ wekukpãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ naataamɔ kɛ Mla he bei lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he, ejaakɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni ejeee fɛi hu.
Gbɔmɔ ko ni kɛ mligblamɔ baa lɛ, kɛ obɔ lɛ kɔkɔ shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ lɛ, kwa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ole akɛ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ nakai lɛ, eje eŋlɛnɔ ni efeɔ esha ni ekɛaabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe fɔ.
Kɛ mitsu Artema loo Tihiko kɛba oŋɔɔ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba miŋɔɔ yɛ Nikopoli, ejaakɛ jɛi mikpɛ mli akɛ mibaye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ owo Zena, mlalelɔ lɛ, kɛ Apolo gbɛ jogbaŋŋ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he akahia amɛ.
Shi hã ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmɛi lɛ hu akase nitsumɔ kpakpai ahe mɔdɛŋbɔɔ yɛ fimɔ kɛ hiamɔ hewɔ, koni amɛkafee mɛi ni wooo yibii.
Mɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ miibi o. Wɔmiibi mɛi ni sumɔɔ wɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ. Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi! Amen.

1: Pershia Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ gbalɔ Zakaria ni ji Berekia bi ni eji Ido nabi lɛ wie ni ekɛɛ mɛi lɛ akɛ,
"Mi Yehowa, mimli efu nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ waa naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɔ amɛ nɛ, 'Nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ ni mi hu makpale kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.
Nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ; mɛi ni tsutsu gbalɔi lɛ shiɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛje amɛgbɛi fɔɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ amɛnifeemɔ nii gbohii lɛ ahe lɛ. Ni amɛbooo toi, shi moŋ amɛkwa mi.
Nɛgbɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ? Ni gbalɔi lɛ hu ani amɛhiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ lo?

Shi miwiemɔi kɛ mikpɔi lɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ shɛ amɛdɛŋ, shi amɛyabuuu, ni amɛna he toigblamɔ hu. No hewɔ lɛ amɛshwa amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, bɔ ni mito akɛ mikɛ amɛ baaye yɛ amɛjeŋba kɛ nifeemɔnii hewɔ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mikɛ amɛ eye nɛɛ.'"

Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ, ni ji Shebat nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Zakaria, Berekia bi lɛ, ni eji Ido nabi lɛ wie ekoŋŋ. No hewɔ lɛ Zakaria gba ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Mina ninaa ko nyɔɔŋ ni nuu ko ta okpɔŋɔ tsuru nɔ, ni edamɔ shi yɛ mirto tsei ateŋ yɛ jɔɔ ko mli. Ni okpɔŋɔi tsuji kɛ okpɔŋɔi okɔbɛŋi kɛ okpɔŋɔi yɛji hu damɔ shi yɛ esɛɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni, mi Zakaria, mibi nuu lɛ akɛ, "Mi-Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?" Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo akɛ, "Mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo amɛshishi."
No hewɔ lɛ bɔfo lɛ ni damɔ mirto tsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, "Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni Yehowa tsu koni amɛyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni amɛ hu amɛjie Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ni damɔ shi yɛ mirto tsei lɛ ateŋ ni wie lɛ naa amɛkɛɛ, "Wɔtee wɔyasra shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nɔ ni wɔna ji akɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kã shi butuu ni hewalɛ ko bɛ lɛ."
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ wo egbee nɔ ekɛɛ, "Ao, Yehowa, afii nyɔŋmai kpawo sɔŋŋ nɛ ni omli fu Yerusalem kɛ Yuda maji lɛ. Mɛɛbe omusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ o yɛ amɛhe"
Yehowa kɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ wie miishɛjemɔ wiemɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Gbaa akɛ bɔ ni Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, Yerusalem kɛ Zion maji lɛ fɛɛ asane kã mitsui nɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Shi mimli efu maji ni he ejɔ amɛ lɛ naakpa, ejaakɛ be ni mimli fu mimaŋ lɛ fioo lɛ, jeŋmaji lɛ kã amɛnɔnaa lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ eku misɛɛ kɛba Yerusalem; aaama miwe lɛ yɛ emli, ni aaatswa Yerusalem ama shi ekoŋŋ."
"Shiɛmɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, 'Mimaji lɛ aaashwere ekoŋŋ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni aaashɛje Zion mii, ni eeeŋɔ Yerusalem ekoŋŋ efee emaŋ.'"
Ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina akloŋtoi ejwɛ yɛ ninaa kroko mli,
ni mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi?" Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ, "Enɛɛmɛi ji akloŋtoi ni ji nɔyelɔi ahewalɛi ni gbɛ Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ Yerusalem shwã lɛ."
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa jie sɔ̃lɔi ejwɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi.

Ni mibi akɛ, :Mɛni mɛnɛɛmɛi hu baa amɛbafee?" Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo akɛ, "Amɛba koni amɛbawo akloŋtoi ejwɛ ni gbɛ Yuda shwã bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko wooo eyitso nɔ lɛ ahe gbeyei; amɛbakplɔ maji lɛ akloŋtoi ni amɛkɛshilɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛgbɛ Yuda amɛshwã lɛ."
2: Misaa miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina nuu ko ni hiɛ susumɔ kpãa yɛ edɛŋ.
Mibi lɛ akɛ, "Nɛgbɛ oyaa?" Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ, "Miyasusu Yerusalem koni mana ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ."
Ni naa, bɔfo lɛ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ je kpo; ni bɔfo kroko hu je kpo tee kɛ lɛ yakpe.

Klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ fã bɔfo kroko lɛ ekɛɛ, "Sha foi ni oyakɛɛ nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ ni hiɛ susumɔ kpãa lɛ akɛ, Yerusalem he baakã eflo tamɔ akrowa ni atswako gbogbo awoko he yɛ emli gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ayifalɛ hewɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, matsɔ̃ la kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe, tamɔ gbogbo, ni matsɔ̃ emli anumnyam. Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Yehowa kɛɛ, "Huui! Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛjɛa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa Yerusalem; ejaakɛ mi, migbɛ nyɛ mishwã tamɔ ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ." Yehowa kɛɛ,
"Huui! Kuu osɛɛ oba Zion, bo mɔ ni okɛ Babilon biyoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Enumnyam lɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsu mi kɛtee maji ni hahaa nyɛnii lɛ aŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko ta nyɛhe lɛ eta mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ he.
Naa, mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ haanii amɛhã amɛtsuji ni sɔ̃mɔ amɛ lɛ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ."
"Nyɛlaa, ni nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛ Yerusalembii, shi naa, miba mibahi nyɛteŋ."
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, maji babaoo kɛ amɛhe aaahã Yehowa ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimɛi, ni mahi amɛteŋ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ hu Yehowa aaaŋɔ Yuda akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ; asaŋ eeeŋɔ Yerusalem hu akɛ emaŋ ekoŋŋ.
Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee dioo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ ete shi kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
3: Agbɛnɛ ehã mina Yoshua ni ji osɔfonukpa lɛ ni edamɔ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hiɛ, ni edamɔ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hiɛ, ni satan hu damɔ Yoshua ninejurɔ ni ebaaflɔ enaa.
Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Satan akɛ, "Satan, Yehowa akã ohiɛ. Yehowa mɔ ni eŋɔ Yerusalem akɛ enɔ lɛ aaakã ohiɛ. Ani oleee akɛ latso ni afã yɛ la naa ji mɔ nɛ?"
No mli lɛ Yoshua wo atadei mujimuji kɛdamɔ bɔfo lɛ hiɛ.

Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã mɛi ni damɔ ehiɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, "Nyɛjiea atadei mujimuji lɛ yɛ ehe." Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yoshua hu akɛ, "Bɔ ni ajie ohe atadei nɛɛ lɛ, nakai ajie ohe eshai lɛ ashwie, ni mawula o kɛ atadei ni jra wa."
Ni mikɛɛ akɛ, "Akɛ fai ni he tse abu lɛ." No hewɔ lɛ amɛkɛ fai ni he tse bu lɛ, ni amɛwula lɛ kɛ atadei. Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ shi yɛ jɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ,

"Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Kɛji oooba ojeŋ bɔ ni mitaoɔ, ni oooye mimlai ni miwo lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ bo obaakwɛ misɔlemɔwe lɛ kɛ ehe kpoi lɛ anɔ. Asaŋ mahã o hegbɛ ni ofata mimɛi ni damɔɔ biɛ lɛ ahe.
Agbɛnɛ, bo osɔfonukpa Yoshua, bo toi, bo kɛ onanemɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ fɛɛ. Mɛi nɛɛ ji shade ni baaba lɛ he okadi lɛ. Naa, mibawo mitsulɔ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tsonine, gbɛ kɛba.
Asaŋ mikɛ tɛ koome ni yɛ hiɛi kpawo ema Yoshua hiɛ, ni makpɛ niŋmãa yɛ nakai tɛ lɛ nɔ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ. Ni mikɛ gbi kome baagbe shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaakpee enaanyo kɛaaba ewaintso kɛ agbamitso shishi, Yehowa kɛɛ.'"
4: Bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ batsiɛ mi ekoŋŋ tamɔ atsiɛɔ mɔ yɛ ewɔ mli.

Ni ebi mi akɛ, "Mɛni onaa nɛɛ? Mihã hetoo akɛ, "Miina kanetso ni akɛ shika sɔŋŋ fee; ni emutɔ ko ma eyiteŋ. Kanetso nɛɛ yɛ kanei kpawo mamɔ eyiteŋ; ni kanei nɛɛ, eko fɛɛ eko hu yɛ odoŋtii kpawo ni asuɔ.
Asaŋ mutsei enyɔ mamɔ kanetso lɛ masɛi; ekome yɛ mutɔ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni ekome hu yɛ ebɛku nɔ."
Agbɛnɛ mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, "Minuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?"
Bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, "Ani oleee nɔ ni nibii nɛɛ ji?" Ni mikɛɛ, "Mi-Nuŋtsɔ, dabida."
Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhãa Zerubabel nɛ, 'Jeee onyɛmɔ baahã oye kunim, loo ohewalɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mi-mumɔ lɛ ni baahã oye kunim,' Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ."
Shi bo gɔ̃ŋ kpeteŋkple, mɛni mli oyɔɔ? Obaatsɔ̃ ŋa kplanaa yɛ Zerubabel hiɛ. Ebaakɔ oyiteŋ tɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛba, ni aaabɔ oshe kɛaaba akɛ, "Dromɔ, dromɔ naa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ."
Yehowa saa ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Zerubabel eto shīa nɛɛ shishi, ni ebaatswa egbe naa hu. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.

Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbe nitsumɔ lɛ ni eyaaa nɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ baana Zerubabel ni ehiɛ tsumalɔi akulomulo lɛ yɛ edɛŋ ekɛ miitswa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni amɛbaanya. Kanetsei kpawo nɛɛ ji Yehowa hiŋmɛii ni ekɛkwɛɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ."
Agbɛnɛ mibi bɔfo lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ kanetso lɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku lɛ?
Misaa mibi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ akɛ, te mutsei enyɔ ni yɔɔ shika bɛji enyɔ lɛ ni mu hoɔ yɛ mli lɛ ashishi hu?"
Bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, "Ani oleee enɛɛmɛi ashishi?" Mihã hetoo akɛ, "Mi-Nuŋtsɔ Dabida."
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Nibii nɛɛ damɔ shi hã mɛi enyɔ ni ahala amɛ, ni afɔ amɛ mu koni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa mɔ ni ji jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ."
5: Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina wolo kpo ko ni miifliki.
Ni bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, "Mɛni onaa nɛɛ?" Mihã lɛ hetoo mikɛɛ akɛ, "Miina wolo kpo ko ni miifliki; ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma."

Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Enɛ ji loomɔ ni gbɛɔ eshwãa shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nu lɛ. No ji akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni juɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakã kitã ni eyeŋ nɔ lɛ aaana nakai toigblamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ."

Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, "Miihã loomɔ nɛɛ asa julɔ fɛɛ julɔ we he, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsɛɔ migbɛi ekɛkãa kitã ni eyeee nɔ lɛ hu we he. Loomɔ nɛɛ aaahi mɔ lɛ we lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi eeekpatã shiã lɛ kɛ emli tsei kɛ tɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ."
Agbɛnɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, "Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ nɔ ni baa lɛ."
Mibi lɛ akɛ, "Mɛni ni?" Ni ehere nɔ akɛ, "Kɛŋtɛŋ ni, ni edamɔ shi hã je lɛ fɛɛ he esha lɛ."
No sɛɛ lɛ agble kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ naa; enaanɔ lɛ sumui akɛfee; ni yoo ko ta shi yɛ kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ naa akɛ, "Mɔ nɛ damɔ shi hã yiwalɛ." Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ yoo lɛ nɔ ewo kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ naanɔ ni akɛ sumui fee lɛ bu kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ naa.
Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina yei enyɔ ni miifliki kɛmiiba kɛ fiji ni tamɔ faanaa oka nɔ. Amɛbawo kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ kɛtee.
Mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, "Nɛɛgbɛ amɛkɛ kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ yaa nɛɛ?"
Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Amɛkɛmiiya Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; koni amɛyama tsu yɛ jɛi amɛha lɛ. Kɛji agbe tsu lɛ maa naa lɛ amɛkɛ kɛŋtɛŋ lɛ baayi shi kɛyama egbɛhe."
6: Misaa miwo mihiɛ nɔ ni mina tayaa shwiilii ejwɛ komɛi fã kpo kɛjɛ akɔɔble gɔji enyɔ komɛi ateŋ kɛba.
Klɛŋklɛŋ tayaa shwiili lɛ okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni gblaa, ni shwiili ni ji enyɔ lɛ okpɔŋɔi diji ni gblaa;
shwiili ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ okpɔŋɔi yɛji ni gblaa; ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ okpɔŋɔi truntrai ni hewa gblaa.
Kɛkɛ ni mibi bɔfo lɛ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, "Mi-Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?"
Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, "Enɛɛmɛi damɔ shi hã ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ. Amɛmiiya amɛkɛ amɛhe ayatsɔ̃ɔ jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛya ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ."
Tayaa shwiili lɛ ni okpɔŋɔi diji lɛ gblaa lɛ miiya kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi yɛji lɛ gblaa lɛ miiya anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi truntrai lɛ gbaa miiya wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Shi be ni okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni he wa lɛ fã kpo lɛ, amɛhe tswa shi koni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã amɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nyɛyakpaa shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ." No hewɔ lɛ amɛtee amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Naa, okpɔŋɔi ni yaa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ejɔɔ mi, Yehowa, mitsui he yɛ nakai kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ."
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ,
"Ŋɔɔ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii hu ni nomii lɛ ni ji Heldai kɛ Tobia kɛ Yedaia kɛjɛ Babilon kɛbakɛ lɛ, ni okɛya Zefania bi Yosia we lɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Okɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni oŋɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ afee maŋtsɛ fai ni okɛbu Yehozadak bi Yoshua, ni ji osɔfonukpa lɛ.
No sɛɛ Lɛ okɛɛ lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Naa, nuu lɛ ni egbɛi ji Tsonine lɛ, ebaada yɛ enajiaŋ, ni lɛ ebaama Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ.

Lɛji mɔ ni ebaama Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ, ni abaawo ehiɛ nyam akɛ lumɔ ni ebaata emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛye elumɔ lɛ. Osɔfo ko hu baahi emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ he, ni shishinumɔ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baahi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛteŋ.'
Ato nɛkɛ maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ mli, koni akɛkai Heldai kɛ Tobia kɛ Yedaia kɛ Yosia ni ji Zefania bi lɛ."
Mɛi baajɛ maji asɛɛ shɔŋŋ abaye abua kɛma Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ. No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ. Kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, enɛ aaaba mli ahã nyɛ.
7: Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu, ni ji Kislev nyɔŋ, lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Zakaria wie.
No mli lɛ Betelbii lɛ etsu Sharezer kɛ Regem-Melek kɛ amɛmɛi kɛba Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ koni amɛbasɔle amɛkpa fai.
Asaŋ koni amɛbi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ akɛ, "Ani wɔfo ni wɔhi ŋmãa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ hu nɔ tamɔ wɔfeɔ yɛ afii babaoo ni eho lɛ amli lɛ lo?"
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ mi akɛ,

"Bi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, be ni nyɛhi ŋmãa ni nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ hu nɔ, yɛ afi nyɔŋmai kpawo nɛɛ mli lɛ, ani mi, Yehowa nyɛhi ŋmãa lɛ nyɛhã lo?
Be ni nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii lɛ ani jeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii nyɛhã lɛ?"

Be ni mɛi yɔɔ Yerusalem ni ekɛ emaji kɛ eshikpɔji ni bɔle ehe lɛ shwereɔ lɛ, be mli ni mɛi yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ kɛ ŋanɔ gbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, ani jeee nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɔŋŋ Yehowa hã ashiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ lo?
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Zakaria wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ,
"Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, 'Nyɛkojoa yɛ jalɛ naa, ni nyɛkɛ musuŋtsɔle kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ahia shi akɛ nyɛmimɛi.
Nyɛkawaa okulafo loo awusa loo gbɔ loo ohiafo yi. Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akasusu enyɛmi he efɔŋ ko yɛ emli.'
"Shi moŋ mimaŋ lɛ waje amɛtsui ni amɛkɛ kuɛŋtilɛ booo toi; amɛtsimɔ amɛtoii koni amɛkanu wiemɔ lɛ.
Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui koni amɛkabo mla lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ emumɔ lɛ nɔ ekɛtsu eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ ni eŋɔhã lɛ toi. No hewɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ mlifu amɛ naakpa lɛ.
Akɛni mitsɛ amɛ shi amɛfooo mli lɛ, no hewɔ ni amɛblɔ amɛtsɛ mi ni mi hu mibooo amɛ toi lɛ. Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.

Ni no hã mi kɛ lasuogbele gbɛ amɛshwã kɛtee majiasɛɛ hei ni amɛleee lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ ni amɛshi nɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ amɛsɛɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko eyaaa mli, ni mɔ ko ejeee mli hu lɛ. Amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃."
8: Yehowa kɛɛ, ebaatswa Yerusalem ekoŋŋ. Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ mi, Zakaria, wie akɛ,
"Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ nɛ, miiye awuŋa ni naa wa naakpa yɛ Zion he; mikɛ hiɛdɔɔ ni naa wa miiye ehe awuŋa nɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, mibaku misɛɛ kɛba Zion, ni mibahi Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli, ni abaatsɛ Yerusalem akɛ anɔkwale maŋ, kɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ gɔ̃ŋ lɛ hu akɛ, 'Krɔŋkrɔŋ.'
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, hiimeji kɛ yeimeji ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso yɛ egbɔlɛ hewɔ baatra Yerusalem blohuiaŋ ekoŋŋ;
Ni maŋ lɛ mli blohuiaŋ aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbekɛbii hii kɛ gbekɛbii yei ni miishwɛ.
Kɛji gbalɛ nɛɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ b ei nɛɛ amli yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, ani mi hu eeefee naakpɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ lo? Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, naa, mibahere mimaŋbii lɛ ayiwala kɛaajɛ bokã kɛ anai shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ;
ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba koni amɛbahi Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ mli." Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ,
"Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnuɔ gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli yɛ gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ be ni ato Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, Sɔlemɔwe lɛ maa shishi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnijiaŋ akajea wui bɔ ni afee ni anyɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ama.

Ejaakɛ be ni nakai be lɛ shɛko lɛ gbɔmɔ nitsumɔ feɔ yaka, ni kooloo nitsumɔ hu feɔ yaka, ni kooloo nitsumɔ feɔ yaka, ni mɔ ni jeɔ kpo loo ebaa mli lɛ naaa hejɔlɛ yɛ haolɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mihã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ete ewo enaanyo.
Shi agbɛnɛ mikɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ nɛɛ yeŋ kɛ joomɔ tamɔ mifee tsutsu bii lɛ." Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.
"Ejaakɛ aaadu nii yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli, waintsei lɛ aaawo yibii, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii, bɔ aaajɛ ŋwɛi anyɔ ashwie nɔ, ni mibahã enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ atsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ.

Naa, Yuda we kɛ Israel we, bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ akɛ majimaji, ni amɛkɛ nyɛgbɛi lomɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mahere nyɛyiwala, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ni akɛ nyɛgbɛi baajɔɔ. Nyɛkashea gbeyei, shi moŋ nyɛwajea nyɛhe ni nyɛfea ekãa kɛkɛ."
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, "Bɔ ni mito miyiŋ ni mafee nyɛ efɔŋ ni mishwaŋ mihe be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ wo mi mlifu lɛ,
nakai mito miyiŋ bei nɛɛ amli akɛ mibafee Yerusalem kɛ Yuda we ejurɔ. Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei.
Nyɛfea nibii nɛɛ: Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awiea anɔkwale; asaŋ nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ nyɛkoii ashi bɔ ni baahã toiŋjɔlɛ aba.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabɛ enaanyo ewo emli. Nyɛkasumɔa amale kitãkãmɔ; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi ji nibii ni minyɛɔ. Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ."
Ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɔ nɛ,

"Ŋmãa ni nyɛhiɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ mliflimɔ gbii juji ahã Yudabii. No hewɔ lɛ nyɛsumɔa anɔkwale kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ."
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, "Mɛi aaakã he ajɛ majimaji babaoo anɔ aba.
Ni maŋ kome mli bii aaaya maŋ kroko mli ayakɛɛ akɛ, 'Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔyakpaa Yehowa fai, ni asaŋ wɔyatao esɛɛ gbɛ hu. Mi hu maya.'
Mɛi babaoo kɛ majimaji ni hewa tete aaba Yerusalem abatao Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ ni amɛaakpa lɛ fai."

Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, "Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛin yɔŋma ni jɛ majimaji ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi anɔ baamɔ Yudanyo kome atade mli, ni amɛaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Ha wɔkɛ bo aya, ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ yɛ.'"
9: Yehowa wie eshi Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nakai wiemɔ lɛ saa Damasko hu he; ejaakɛ Siria maji wuji lɛ hu Yehowa nɔ ji fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni enɔ ji Israel akutsei lɛ.
Enɔ ji Hamat hu ni kɛ Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ je husu lɛ, kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon fɛɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛnilee naa wa naakpa.
Tiro etswa gbogbo ewo ehe ni ebua jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu kɛ shika tsuru hu naa tamɔ blohuŋ shia.
Shi naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baashɔ̃ enii ni ena nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni aaashɛrɛ enii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ ashwie ŋshɔ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ akɛ la aakpãtã ehiɛ.
Ashkelon maŋ lɛ aaana ni eeeshe gbeyei; Gaza hu aaana ni ehe aaakpokpo naakpa. Ekron hu aaana ejaakɛ ehiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ aaafee yakatswaa. Gaza maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã, ni Ashkelon hu baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Yoo ajwamaŋbii aaahi Ashdod; Filistibii lɛ ahewoo lɛ, mafo sɛɛ.

Mahã amɛkpa loo ni emli lá fɛɛ tsereko yeli kwraa, ni amɛnihiinii tekeŋ amɛtsɛ̃ŋ, ni emli mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ aaashwɛ ahã wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yuda akutsei lɛ eko; ni Ekronbii hu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yebusbii.
No sɛɛ lɛ mabu miwebii lɛ ahe tamɔ bulɔ, koni asraafoi akuu ko kuu ko akatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee kɛba. Miŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni haolɔ ko agba miwebii lɛ anaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛi kã amɛhe.
Omli afli o, bo Zion biyoo; Bɔɔ oshe waa, bo Yerusalem biyoo! Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ; Eeba kɛ agbojee kɛ kunimyeli. Eta teji oblanyo ni ji teji yoo bi ko nɔ.

Makpãtã ta shwiilii fɛɛ ni aaajɛ Efraim aba lɛ ahiɛ; ni majie ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ hu kɛje Yerusalem. Makumɔ tawuu gãii lɛ amli dukuduku. Eeeshi maji lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ ni elumɔyeli aaajɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛyagbee ŋshɔnaa. Ni eeejɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi je lɛ naagbee hei tɔ̃ɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ saa kɛɛ, "Bo Zion biyoo hu, Milá ni mikɛsɔo mikɛo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa hewɔ lɛ, majie obii ni etsɔ̃mɔ gboklɛfoi lɛ yɛ bu ni nu bɛ mli lɛ mli.
Nyɛ gboklɛfoi ni nyɛyɔɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa mɔ̃ɔ ni wa lɛ mli. Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mibato nyɛ najiaŋ toi enyɔ.
Ejaakɛ midɔ Yuda mli tamɔ gãitso, ni mikɛ Efraim efee egãimlibi. Bo Zion, matee obihii lɛ ashi ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ klaŋte yɛ midɛŋ, yɛ bo, Hela, obihii lɛ anɔ."
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa aaapue yɛ ewebii lɛ anɔ ni egaimlibii lɛ aafliki tamɔ srawa gblaa lɛ. Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni aaakpã eta tɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni eeefã tamɔ wuoyigbɛ lasuogbele.

Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaabu emɛi ahe; Amɛaatserɛ amɛhenyelɔi amli, ni amɛaanaanaa amɛ nɔ. Amɛaashwie amɛhenyɛlɔi alá shi ni lá lɛ aaaho tamɔ afɔleshãa kooloo lá ni afɔse kɛmiijɛ okpolu mli aashwie afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahere amɛyiwala; ejaakɛ etooku ji amɛ; Amɛaaklpɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ akekre he ojrawatɛi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaaŋɔɔ, eeefee fɛo; able aaahã oblahii afrɔke ni wain hee hu aaahã oblayei afrɔke.
10: Nyɛbia Yehowa koni ehã agbiɛnaa nu anɛ nyɛ. Nyɛbia Yehowa mɔ ni hãa ahum fãa ni ehãa nu nɛɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋanɔ tsei fɛɛ anɔ lɛ.

Nɔ ni amãgãi lɛ kɛɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli, ni klamɔfoi lɛ aninaa lɛ apasa sɔŋŋ ni. Mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔi ashishi lɛ maleɔ, ni amɛshɛjeɔ mɔ mii yakatswaa; no hewɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ kpaa shi tamɔ toi, amɛnaa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ.

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mimli efu tookwɛlɔi ni ji maŋsɛɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni magbla amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ atoi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jwɛŋɔ etooku ni ji Yudabii lɛ ahe; ni eeehã amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ etayaa okpɔŋɔ ni eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ.
Koŋtɛ lɛ aaajɛ Yuda mli, emli nɔŋŋ buu lɛ shiŋmlitso lɛ hu aaajɛ, kɛ tawuu gãitso lɛ kɛ lumɛi srɔtoi fɛɛ hu.

Yudabii lɛ aaatsɔmɔ kãkãlɔi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛaanaanaa amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ tamɔ anaa ŋmiamɔ. Amɛbaawu tai ni amɛaahã amɛhenyɛlɔi tabilɔi okpɔŋɔianɔtralɔi ahiɛ ashwie shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ amɛ yɛ.

"Mibahã Yuda he awa, ni mahere Israel yiwala. Mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba ejaakɛ mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe. Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi ni mikwako amɛ dã, ejaakɛ miji Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mabo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.
Nakai be lɛ Efraim aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ kpaanaa, ni emlibii amli aaafli amɛ tamɔ mɛi ni enu wain. Amɛshwiei aaana nɔ ni Yehowa etsu lɛ; ni amɛmii aaashɛ amɛhe; ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ.
"Mikɛ okadi aaatsɛ amɛ, ni mabua amɛnaa ejaakɛ mi mikpɔ̃ amɛ, ni amɛyi aaafa ekoŋŋ tamɔ sa.
Migbɛ amɛ mishwã maŋsɛɛ maji anɔ moŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, amɛaakai mi, yɛ hei ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ. Amɛ kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ yi aaana wala, ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛaaba ekoŋŋ.
Makpla amɛ kɛjɛ Egipt kɛba. Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ Asiria hu. Mikɛ amɛ aaaba Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ Lebanon shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ kɛyaashi anaŋ gbɛ yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ.
Amɛbaafo amanehulu ŋshɔ lɛ, mahã ŋshɔkei lɛ aŋmɛ dɛŋŋ. Nilo Faa lɛ fɛɛ kwa baagbi. Abaaba Asiria hetsɛmɔ lɛ shi, ni Egipt hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo.
Mawo amɛ hewalɛ lɛ yɛ Yehowa mli, ni amɛbaanya yɛ egbɛi mli. Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ."
11: "Ao, Lebanon, gblemɔ oshinai lɛ, koni la ashã otsenedrui lɛ.
Ao, sɛsɛo, wo yara ni ofo, ejaakɛ tsenedru lɛ eku egbee shi; ejaakɛ tsei ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã. Bashan odum, wo yara nyɛfoa, ejaakɛ agba koo haii lɛ tete.
Bo toi, tookwɛlɔi lɛ ewo yara. Bo toi, jatai miihuu, Naa, Yordan he koo lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã, ejaakɛ amɛnumnyam sɛɛ efo.
Bɔ ni Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, "Feemɔ ohe tamɔ tookwɛlɔ ni kwɛɔ tooku ni ayaagbe amɛ.
Mɛni hewɔ tookwɛlɔi lɛ gbeɔ toi nɛɛ ni agblaaa amɛ toi. Mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ toi nɛɛ hu kɛɔ akɛ, 'Ajie Yehowa yi ejaakɛ wɔtsɔmɔ niiatsɛmɛi.' Ni amɛkwɛlɔi lɛ tete po enaaa kooloi lɛ amɔbɔ."
"No hewɔ lɛ, minaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ; naa, maŋmɛɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he mawo enɔkwɛlɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛ hu dɛŋ. Ni nɔkwɛlɔi nɛɛ baakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni mihereŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yiwala.
"Hewɔ lɛ mitsɔ̃ toi ni abaagbe ahã tookwɛlɔi nɛɛ akwɛlɔ. Miklɔ kplamɔtsei enyɔ. Miwo ekome gbɛi akɛ, 'Dromɔ' kɛ ekome hu akɛ, 'Ekomefeemɔ!' Nomɛi mikɛkplaa tooku lɛ.
Mikpãtã tookwɛlɔi etɛ̃ ahiɛ yɛ nyɔŋ kome mli, ejaakɛ minaaa amɛhe tsui, ni amɛ hu amɛnyaŋe mi.
No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ mifeŋ nyɛkwɛlɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ. Too ni baagbo lɛ, egbo, nɔ ni hiɛ baakpatã hu, ehiɛ akpãtã; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, amɛyeyee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi aloo."
Kɛkɛ ni mikɔ mikplamɔtso ni gbɛi ji 'Dromɔ' lɛ, ni miku mli, ni mikɛku kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ miwebii lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli.
Hewɔ lɛ aku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ. Ni too jrayelɔi lɛ ni kwɛɔ mi lɛ nu shishi akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naanii ni.
Agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ jrayelɔi lɛ akɛ, "Kɛji esa nyɛhiɛ lɛ no lɛ nyɛwoa mi nyɔmɔ; shi kɛji esaaa nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɔmɔwoo lɛ ahi shi." Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛkɛwo mi nyɔmɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Okɛyawo Sɔlemɔwe lɛ fotro lɛ mli." No hewɔ lɛ mikɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni amɛkɛwo mi nyɔmɔ lɛ yawo Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ fotro lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ miku kplamɔtso ni ji enyɔ lɛ ni gbɛi ji 'Ekomefeemɔ' lɛ mli, ni mikɛfo nyɛmimɛi anaanyɔbɔɔ ni kã Yuda kɛ Israel teŋ lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, "Klɔmɔ tookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ nitsumɔ nibii ohiɛ,

Shi naa, miitee tookwɛlɔ ko shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; lɛ lɛ, jeee ehe sane ko ji too ni miigbo lɛ. Toi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ ebuaŋ amɛnaa. Nɔ ni eheko eku lɛ, etsaŋ lɛ; ni toi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ lɛ ehaŋ amɛ niyenii amɛyeŋ; shi moŋ gbee eeegbe toi ni ewowoo fɔ lɛ eye, belɛ eekplɔ amɛnaji ahe koklotoi lɛ eeshwie.
Kpoo hã mitookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni shīɔ etooku lɛ; lɛ lɛ, aaafo eninejurɔ yɛ ta mli, ni aaajwa eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi hu yɛ ta mli. Enine agbo kwraa yɛ ehe, ni eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ hu ashwila kwrakwra."
12: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Israel he lɛ nɛ. Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi ni ha shi nɛɛ ni bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ebɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ kɛɛ enɛ,

"Naa, mahã Yerusalem atsɔ̃ tamɔ dãa yɛ kpulu mli mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabasa enaa ekwɛ lɛ aaabidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ. Kɛji maŋ ko fã ta basa Yerusalem yi lɛ, belɛ ekɛ ta lɛ etua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ hu.

Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã Yerusalem atsɔ̃ tɛ ni tsii mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ. Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaka tɛ nɛɛ nɔ womɔ lɛ aaapila. Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ aaafee ekome amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalem.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã henyɛlɔi lɛ akpoŋɔi fɛɛ ajijaa, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ hu aye sɛkɛ. Shi be ni mashwila henyɛlɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiŋmɛii lɛ mahã mihiŋmɛii akã Yudabii lɛ ahe. Mi Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda akutsei lɛ baakɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, 'Yerusalembii lɛ ahewalɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ni ji amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ ejɛ.'

"Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mahã Yuda akutsei lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ la kɛ ŋɛsu yɛ laii ateŋ; amɛaatamɔ jateŋ ni tsoɔ ni shãa gbiŋ ablebaa gbi; ni amɛaakpãtã maji krokomɛi ni yɔɔ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ. Yerusalembii aaafee shweshweeshwe, yɛ Yerusalem.
"Yehowa baahã Yuda akutso lɛ mli tabilɔi tsutsu aye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, bɔ ni afee ni hiɛ akasɔ David shwiei lɛ, kɛ Yerusalembii lɛ hu akunim ni amɛye lɛ fe kunim ni Yudabii baaye lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ tsɛŋ ko aaabu Yerusalembii lɛ ahe, ni mɔ ni he waaa kwraa yɛ amɛteŋ he aaawa tamɔ David; ni David shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ; amɛaatamɔ Yehowa bɔfo ni nyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ ni aaate shi awo Yerusalem lɛ makpãtã amɛhiɛ.

"Mafɔse mimɔbɔnalɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ mumɔ mashwie David shwiei lɛ kɛ Yerusalem maŋbii lɛ anɔ bɔ ni kɛ amɛna mɔ ko ni amɛye lɛ awui ko lɛ, amɛaaye mɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ ayeɔ bi koome ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ; ni amɛaafo lɛ kɛ mlishãlɛ tamɔ afoɔ kromɔbi ni egbo.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ yara ni abaawo yɛ Yerusalem lɛ baatamɔ yara ni awo kɛfo Hadad-Rimmom yɛ Megido ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.

Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ baawo yara wekuiaŋwekuiaŋ. Davidwe lɛ baawo yara lɛ enɔ aŋkro ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu bawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro; Nakai nɔŋŋ Natanwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro nii amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro.
Leviwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro. Shimɛiwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro.
Ni wekui krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ baawo amɛyara aŋkroaŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo amɛnɔ aŋkroaŋkro."
13: "Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ abaagble nu hiŋmɛi naa ahã David we lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem lɛ, koni akɛfɔ amɛhe eshai kɛ amɛhe muji ashwie."

Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibagbe wɔji lɛ agbɛii kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ majie gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mumɔi ni ahe tseee lɛ hu kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaaba ekoŋŋ akɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ lɛ, etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ tete aaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, 'Gbalɔ amalelɔ ji o, ni osa gbele, ejaakɛ oomale yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.' Ni kɛji ekã he eegba lolo lɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ baatsu lɛ nɔ̃, koni amɛgbe lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ fɛɛ gbalɔ hiɛ baagbo yɛ eninaa ni agba lɛ hewɔ, ni ewoŋ gbalɔi atade kɛ ehiɛ fɛŋfɛŋ ni amɛwoɔ kɛshishiuɔ mɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi moŋ nɔ ni ebaakɛɛ ji akɛ, 'Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, okwaafonyo ji mi, mibɔ̃i humɔ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.'
Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi lɛ akɛ, 'Mɛni faji anaa yɔɔ osɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ?' Eeehã hetoo akɛ, 'Minanemɛi ni pila mi nɛɛ.'"
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, "Bo klaŋte, wo ohe nɔ owo mitookwɛlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji misɛɛ mɔ lɛ, koni toi lɛ agbɛ ashwã. Mawo minine nɔ yɛ too bibiibii tete anɔ ni maplenee amɛ.
Aaakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ amlijaa etɛ̃ mli enyɔ hiɛ, ni amɛaagboi; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ lɛ yi aaana wala.

Nɛkɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baawo la mli ni matsuu amɛhe, tamɔ akɛ la tsuɔ jwiɛtɛi he; makpa amɛ shi makwɛ tamɔ akpaa shika shi akwɛɔ lɛ. Amɛaasɔle kɛtsɛ mi, ni mahere amɛ nɔ. Makɛɛ akɛ, 'Mimɛi ji amɛ,' ni amɛ hu amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, 'Yehowa ji wɔ-Nyɔŋmɔ.' Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ."
14: Naa, Yehowa gbi ko miiba, ni ta mli nii ni henyɛlɔi ha yɛ bo Yerusalem omli lɛ, abaaja yɛ bo nɔŋŋ omli.

Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mabua maji lɛ anaa koni amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalem ni amɛkɛ lɛ awu. Amɛbaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ, ni abaasha shīai lɛ amli nii, ni amɛbaato amɛmli yei lɛ kɛbanaa. Abaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ mlijaa fã nom, shi mlijaa fã ni baashwɛ lɛ abaashi amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, afeŋ amɛ nɔ ko.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ nakai maji lɛ baawu tamɔ afeɔ yɛ ta beiaŋ lɛ.

Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baadamɔ Mugɔ̃ŋ lɛ ni ma Yerusalem bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ. Mugɔ̃ŋ nɛɛ mli baagba enyɔ kɛjɛ bokã kɛyashi anai, ni jɔɔ kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ baakã teŋ. Gɔ̃ŋ lɛ fã baaye kooyigbɛ, ni fã hu baaye wuoyigbɛ.

Nyɛbaajo foi kɛtsɔ̃ jɔɔ ni kã migɔ̃ŋ ni emli egba enyɔ lɛ mli. Nyɛbaajo foi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ jo foi be ni shikpɔŋ hoso yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Uzia yinɔ lɛ. No sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa, mi-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ baaba abapue.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛ̃i yeŋ, ni afua hu woŋ.
Asaŋ je naŋ; anaŋ be ni ji shwane kɛ be ni ji gbɛkɛ, ejaakɛ gbɛkɛ tete lɛ hulu miitso. (Yehowa pɛ ji mɔ ni le nɛkɛ gbi nɛɛ).

Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ wala nu baaho kɛaajɛ Yerusalem; fã kome kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni fã kome lɛ hu kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli. Hulutsoobe kɛ fɛ̃ibe mli fɛɛ lɛ nu nɛɛ baakã he eho.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaale lɛ akɛ Yehowa kome kɛ egbɛi hu koome; ejaakɛ lɛ ebaaye shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.

Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ ni kã shi kɛjɛ Geba yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ aahuu kɛtee Rimon yɛ Yerusalem wuoyigbɛ lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ ŋa kplanaa; shi Yerusalem baahi shi grɔŋŋ yɛ eblema shimaahe lɛ. Ebaajɛ Benyamin Agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi he ni agbo yɔɔ tsutsu lɛ, ni ji Koŋ Agbo lɛ; ebaatsa nɔ kɛyamɔ Hananel Mɔ̃ɔ grɔŋŋ lɛ, aahuu kɛyanina maŋtsɛ wainŋaahe lɛ.
Mɛi baahi Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli, ni musu ko yeŋ amɛ, ni Yerusalem mlihilɛ baafee shweshweeshwe.
Majimaji fɛɛ ni baafa tã kɛtua Yerusalem lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ amɛ baaye ahã nɛ: amɛheloo baakpɔtɔ be mli ni amɛhiɛ kamɔ; amɛhiŋmɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛyitsei ahe, ni amɛlilɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛdaaŋ.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baahã ehe ŋmiŋmi kpeteŋkple amɔ̃mɔ amɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawo enine nɔ yɛ enaanyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi Yuda tete po baafata Yerusalem he kewu ta kɛfã Yerusalem he, ni maji ni bɔle amɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, amɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ atadei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Hela gbonyo aaamɔmɔ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi kɛ yomai kɛ tejii kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ nakai henyɛlɔi lɛ shitoohei lɛ amli lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ maji ni kulɛ amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalem lɛ mli mɛi ni baashwɛ lɛ baaya Yerusalem daa afi koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, koni amɛye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ hu.
Kɛji maŋ ko yɛ ni emli bii lɛ eyaaa Yerusalem koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, nu enɛŋ amɛ.
Ni kɛji Egiptbii lɛ hu eyaaa Yerusalem koni amɛyaye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ amɛhu haomɔ ni Yehowa ha eba maji lɛ ni yayeee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ anɔ lɛ aaaba amɛ hu amɛnɔ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaabla Egiptbii kɛ maji fɛɛ ni amɛyayeee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ atoi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaŋmalã yɛ ŋmɛji ni tsotsroɔ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe lɛ anɔ akɛ; "Eyɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hã Yehowa." Ni kukwɛi ni yɔɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔwe lɛ baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ kãi ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ.

Kukwɛi fɛɛ kukwɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda fɛɛ hu baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ; bɔ ni afee ni mɛi fɛɛ ni baashã afɔle ahole amɛ kɛhoo afɔleshãa loo lɛ. Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ jrayelɔ ko jrayelɔ ko eyayeŋ jra yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ we lɛ dɔŋŋ.

1: Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Zefania wie be mli ni Amon bi Yosia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ. Zefania Kush bi lɛ, enii ji Gedalia, Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi Amaria bi lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, Mibakpãtã nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
"Mibakpãtã gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo hiɛ; mibakpãtã loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ ahiɛ, mibsakpãtã yiwalɔi ahiɛ; mibaplenee gbɔmɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
"Mibagbla gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ atoi. Mibafã Baal jamɔ shishi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni akaiŋ wulɔmɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jemawɔji lɛ dɔŋŋ.

Mibakpãtã mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɔɔ kɛyaa tsui ayiteiaŋ amɛyajaa hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii yɛ jɛi lɛ ahiɛ. Mibakpãtã mɛi hu ni kotoɔ Yehowa lɛ, ni amɛkãa lɛ kitã akɛ amɛbaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi amɛkɛ jemawɔŋ Molek gbɛi lɛ kãa kita ahiɛ.
Mibakpãtã mɛi fɛɛ ni ekpale, ni amɛjaaa Yehowa lɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ ahiɛ, ni ji mɛi ni taooo mi, Yehowa lɛ, misɛɛgbɛ aloo amɛbiii mi nii dɔŋŋ lɛ."
Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ etã, no hewɔ lɛ nyɛfea diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ. Yehowa esaa afɔle lɛ eto, ni etsuu emɛi ni ekpee lɛ ahe.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Gbi ni mibaplenee mɛi lɛ, mibagbla maŋ lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ maŋsɛɛbii akusum lɛ atoi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, migbagbla mɛi fɛɛ ni jaa tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi jaa lɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni tsɔ̃ɔ yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔ nɔ amɛkɛnaa nii amɛwoɔ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi awei amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ atoi."
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, abaanu yaafo he kɛbaajɛ Loo Agbo lɛ naa yɛ Yerusalem, ni abaawɔ lele yɛ maŋ lɛ akutso hee lɛ mli, ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ ayiteiaŋ baashimɔ.
Nyɛ, maŋ lɛ Jɔɔnaabii, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa kɛji nyɛnu gbɛɛmɔi nɛɛ; ejaakɛ akpãta jrayelɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni aplenee mɛi ni yeɔ jwiɛtɛi jra lɛ.

"Nakai be lɛ mikɛ kane baakpa Yerusalem maŋ lɛ mli, ni mibagbla emli mɛi ni amɛtsui enyɔ amɛmli, ni amɛheɔ amɛhe amɛyeɔ lɛ atoi. No ji mɛi ni kɛɔ amɛhe akɛ, 'Yehowa efeŋ ekpakpa, ni esaa efeŋ efɔŋ hu lɛ'.
Abaaha amɛjrayeli nibii, ni amɛshīai hu baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃. Amɛaamamɔ tsui nɛ, shiamɛwɔŋ mli, ni amɛaafee waintromi, shi amɛnuŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko."
Yehowa gbi wulu lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etã, eeba nɔŋŋ. Gbi lɛ baajoo naakpa, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ, kãkãlɔi tete baafo waa.
Nakai gbi lɛ, mlifu kɛ amanehulu gbi ni, nifitemɔ kɛ nihiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi ni; duŋ baawo, ni jeŋ baafee kpii; atatu kɛ oblɔtu kabitii hu gbi ni.
Gbi lɛ tɛtrɛmantrɛ baagbɛɛ, ni abaabɔ oshe kɛtua maji ni atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ hu.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibahao gbɔmɛi, ni amɛbaanyiɛ tamɔ shwilafoi. Akɛni amɛgbo Yehowa nɔ toi lɛ, aaashwie amɛlá shi tamɔ nu, ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ wamɔ."

Nakai Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ajwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere. Emlifu ni jɛ awuŋayeli mli lɛ naa la lɛ naawalɛ baakpãtã je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ejaakɛ trukaa ni eeeplenee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
2: Ao, maŋ ni hiɛgble tɔ ejwa, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛsusua nyɛhe,
dani aba mli akɛ aaakpla nyɛ kɛya tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa tutuu, dani Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ aba nyɛnɔ, dani ashɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ!
Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ heshibalɔi fɛɛ ni feɔ Yehowa suɔmɔnaa nii, nyɛtoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛtaoa jalɛ sɛɛgbɛ; ni nyɛtaoa heshibaa sɛɛgbɛ, ni eko lɛ aaaŋɔ nyɛ atee yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Abaashi Gaza maŋ lɛ afɔ̃ shi, ni Ashkelon baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃. Abaashwie Ashdod maŋbii lɛ shwane fintiŋŋ, ni abaafã Ekronbii lɛ hu kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ.
Kpoo ha nyɛ, nyɛŋshɔnaabii, bo Keretibii amaŋ. Kanaaan, Filistibii ashikpɔŋ, Yehowa ebu bo fɔ; ni mibakpãtã ohiɛ, bɔ ni eshwɛŋ omɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Ni bo, ŋshɔnaa niiaŋ, obaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ kooloi alɛɛhei kɛ tookwɛlɔi asesei kɛ toi atsui kɛkɛ.

Ŋshɔnaa shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ Yudabii ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ. Jɛi amɛbaalɛ amɛkooloi yɛ, ni Ashkelon maŋ lɛ shīai lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ kooloi lɛ awɔɔhei; ejaakɛ Yehowa, amɛ-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, musuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni ebaahã amɛshwere ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Minu jɛmɔi ni Moabbii jɛɔ mimaŋbii lɛ, kɛ ahora ni Amonbii hu bɔɔ miwebii lɛ, kɛ shwãa ni amɛshwãa akɛ amɛbaashɔ̃ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ.

Beiaŋ ni mi tuuŋtu ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ ja Moab tsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom, ni Amonbii lɛ hu tsɔ̃ tamɔ Gomora. Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ ŋoo bui ashikpɔŋ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ; ni sansrɔ baatsa yɛ enɔ. Mimaŋbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaaha Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ hu anii, ni amɛaaŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ."
Enɛ akɛaagbla Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ atoi yɛ amɛhenɔ ni amɛwo lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛbɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, webii lɛ ahora.
Amɛbaashe Yehowa gbeyei naakpa. Yehowa baashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jemawɔji fɛɛ ahiɛ shi; ni kɛkɛ lɛ maji fɛɛ baaja Yehowa yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ diɛŋtsɛ Shikpɔŋ nɔ.
Ni nyɛ, Sudanbii, Yehowa baaplenee nyɛ hu.
Yehowa baakpa enine mli kɛshɛ kooyigbɛ kɛkpãtã Asiria hiɛ; ni ebaahã Nineve maŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni enɔ baagbi wesewese tamɔ shiaŋa nɔ.

Jɛi baatsɔ̃ kooloi kui kɛ kooloi srɔtoi fɛɛ ashibuumɔhe. Akpaŋai kɛ shadeboai kɛ tsui koi lɛ amli baafee amɛshihilɛhei. Patui baablɔ yɛ samfɛji lɛ anaa, ni kwaakwaalabitei baablɔ yɛ shinaa kpokui lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ shīai lɛ fɛɛ ewulewulee ewowoo mli.

Naa, maŋ lɛ ni emli fli lɛ, ni esusu akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe, ni no hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, "Miji mi, ni mi misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ lɛ, te tɛŋŋ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ kooloi kakawuai ashihilɛhe nɛɛ? Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ ehe kɛho lɛ aaahoso eyitso, ni ehe aaajɔ̃ ehe."
3: Kpoo ha Yerusalem, maŋ ni yi wa, maŋ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebule ehe!
Ebooo mɔ ko mɔ ko wiemɔ toi lɛ, ekplɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ hu; ekɛ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, etsiii ebɛŋkɛɛɛ e-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Emli lumɛi lɛ jatai ni huuɔ ni, emli kojolɔi lɛ hu klaji hɔmɔwɔlɔi ni shiii niyenii ko niyenii ko ni je atsɛre nɔ.
Emli gbalɔi lɛ yiŋflɛflɛtsɛmɛi kɛ kutumpɔfoi sɔŋŋ ni; ni emli osɔfoi lɛ ebule nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni amɛtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi.

Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni ja pɛ efeɔ; efeee nɔ ko ni ejaaa. Daa leebi lɛ efeɔ nɔ ni ja yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ, leebi ko kwraa bɛ ni efɔ̃ɔ jalɛ nii feemɔ. Shi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble tɔ ejwa.

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mikpãtã maji ahiɛ dã. Mikumɔ amɛtabilɔi atasui lɛ mishwie shi; ni amɛblohui amli kamɔ shi efoji, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hooo yɛ mli; afite amɛmaji lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ mli, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ amɛmli dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, 'Anɔkwa, eeeshe mi gbeyei, ni eeekplɛ̃ mitsɔsemɔ lɛ, ni ekuŋ ehiɛ efɔŋ mimlai ni miwo lɛ lɛ eko eko nɔ.' Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ babaoo moŋ ni amɛfee nibii gbohiigbohii ji no."

Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa mi gbɛ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mate shi maye odase mashi jeŋ maji lɛ; ejaakɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mabua majimaji lɛ anaa, ni mabua maŋtsɛmɛi hu anaa kɛkpe, koni amɛsa mimlifu kɛ mimlila ni naa wa lɛ naa amɛkwɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ miwuŋayeli lɛ mli mlifu la lɛ baakpãtã jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
"Nakai be lɛ mibatsake majimaji lɛ adaaŋ wiemɔ koni amɛwiemɔ he atse; ni amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛbaaja mi, Yehowa, kɛ wiemɔ ni he tse.
Mijalɔi ni ji mimɛi ni agbɛ ashwã lɛ ashwiei baajɛ Sudan fai lɛ asɛɛ niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ amɛkɛ afɔlei abahã mi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ nibii ni nyɛfeefee nyɛkɛtse mihiɛ atūa lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ majie ntɛŋfeelɔi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛwoŋ nyɛhe nɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ migɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ,
ejaakɛ mibashi gbɔmɛi omlɛfoi kɛ humii pɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ. Amɛbaatao abobaahe yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli,
amɛ mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ Isreal lɛ. Amɛfeŋ nɔfɔŋ lɛ, amɛmaleŋ lɛ, mɔshishiumɔ wiemɔ ko ejeŋ amɛnaa. Amɛbaahi shi, ni amɛbaashwere, ni mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei."
Zion biyoo, la nyamɔ lala waa! Israel, bɔɔ oshe! Yerusalem biyoo, nya; omli afli bo kɛ otsui fɛɛ!
Yehowa efo otoigblamɔ lɛ sɛɛ; eshwie ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee. Yehowa, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yɛ nyɛteŋ; nyɛsheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei dɔŋŋ!
Be miiba, be ni abaakɛɛ Yerusalem akɛ, "Kwɛ, Zion, kaashe gbeyei! Kaahã onijiaŋ miije wui!
Yehowa, o-Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ bo yɛ, Taiatsɛ ni hãa ayeɔ kunim lɛ. Eeenya ohe kɛ miishɛɛ, eeeku sɛɛ esumɔ bo ekoŋŋ. Ebaala kɛ mliflimɔ yɛ ohewɔ,
tamɔ alaa yɛ gbijurɔ nɔ lɛ." Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, "Mibawo amanehulu kɛje onɔ koni ohiɛ akashwie shi yɛ no hewɔ!
Be lɛ miiba! Mikɛ mɛi ni haoɔ bo lɛ fɛɛ aaaye; Mahere mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔɔ oshii ayiwala, ni makpla mɛi ni ashwie lɛ kɛba shīa ekoŋŋ. Mahã amɛhiɛgble lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛsɔlɛ, ni amɛaana gbɛi yɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ.

Nakai be lɛ mikɛ nyɛ baaba shīa, be mli ni mibabua nyɛnaa lɛ. Mahã nyɛgbɛi ahehe, ni abaakafo nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ, ni mahã nyɛshwere ekoŋŋ yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛiŋ." Yehowa wiemɔ nɛ.
